While Casandalee constructed your new body artificially, it is otherwise similar to the old, with the same effects as a critical success on a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kqhPt9344UkcGVYO]{Resurrect} ritual. Casandalee is instead willing to provide different bodies to those who request them.
_desc_ko:
카산달리가 자신의 신성한 데이터 흐름 속에 당신의 기억과 영혼을 백업한다.

당신이 죽은 후, 그녀는 당신의 의식을 새로운 인공 육체에 실어 보낸다. 카산달리가 당신의 새 육체를 인공적으로 만들긴 했지만, 그 외에는 옛 육체와 비슷하며, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kqhPt9344UkcGVYO]{소생} 의식에서의 대성공과 같은 효과를 지닌다. 카산달리는 요청하는 자들에게 대신 다른 육체를 기꺼이 제공한다.

name: Torag - Moderate Boon

description.value:
You are counted as family among Torag and his followers.

You gain the effects of a single dwarf ancestry feat of Torag's choice, even if you are not a dwarf, as long as you maintain Torag's blessing.

_desc_en:
You are counted as family among Torag and his followers.

You gain the effects of a single dwarf ancestry feat of Torag's choice, even if you are not a dwarf, as long as you maintain Torag's blessing.
_desc_ko:
당신은 토라그와 그의 추종자들 사이에서 가족으로 여겨진다.

당신은 토라그의 축복을 유지하는 한, 드워프가 아니더라도 토라그가 선택한 드워프 혈통 재주 하나의 효과를 얻는다.

name: Nivi Rhombodazzle - Minor Curse

description.value: Those who betray Nivi's trust find defeat where there was sure to be victory. Once, when you roll a natural 20 on a die, the result becomes a natural 1 instead. Nivi typically uses this curse for maximum poetic justice.

_desc_en: Those who betray Nivi's trust find defeat where there was sure to be victory. Once, when you roll a natural 20 on a die, the result becomes a natural 1 instead. Nivi typically uses this curse for maximum poetic justice.
_desc_ko: 니비의 신뢰를 배신한 자들은 승리가 확실했던 곳에서 패배를 맞는다. 한 번, 당신이 주사위에서 자연 20을 굴릴 때, 그 결과는 대신 자연 1이 된다. 니비는 보통 최대한의 인과응보적 정의를 위해 이 저주를 사용한다.

name: Erastil - Moderate Curse

description.value: Erastil's beasts take a dislike to you. Animals' attitudes toward you are one category worse (friendly instead of helpful, indifferent instead of friendly, and so on).

_desc_en: Erastil's beasts take a dislike to you. Animals' attitudes toward you are one category worse (friendly instead of helpful, indifferent instead of friendly, and so on).
_desc_ko: 에라스틸의 짐승들이 당신을 싫어한다. 당신에 대한 동물의 태도가 한 단계 나빠진다(협조적 대신 우호적, 우호적 대신 무관심 등).

name: Casandalee - Moderate Curse

description.value: Casandalee attempts to bring you unwanted intellectual advancement to help you become something better. Each day, at some point during the day, Casandalee bestows a strange insight upon you that you find uncomfortable. If you embrace it, you aren't otherwise affected, but if you don't, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 10 minutes.

_desc_en: Casandalee attempts to bring you unwanted intellectual advancement to help you become something better. Each day, at some point during the day, Casandalee bestows a strange insight upon you that you find uncomfortable. If you embrace it, you aren't otherwise affected, but if you don't, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 10 minutes.
_desc_ko: 카산달리가 당신을 더 나은 존재로 만들고자 원치 않는 지적 진보를 가져오려 한다. 매일, 하루 중 어느 시점에, 카산달리는 당신이 불편하게 느끼는 기이한 통찰을 당신에게 내린다. 이를 받아들이면 그 외에는 영향을 받지 않지만, 받아들이지 않으면 당신은 10분간 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{혼란} 상태가 된다.

name: Rovagug - Minor Boon

description.value:
Your attack becomes more destructive.

Once, one of your failed or successful attacks becomes a critical hit, and your weapon or unarmed attack gains the deadly d12 trait for this attack, replacing any deadly trait it already had.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.boons-and-curses.Item.epHQeILdRs3NuxMZ]{Effect: Rovagug's Destruction}

Rovagug typically grants this boon when the critical hit could destroy something precious or significant.

_desc_en:
Your attack becomes more destructive.

Once, one of your failed or successful attacks becomes a critical hit, and your weapon or unarmed attack gains the deadly d12 trait for this attack, replacing any deadly trait it already had.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.boons-and-curses.Item.epHQeILdRs3NuxMZ]{Effect: Rovagug's Destruction}

Rovagug typically grants this boon when the critical hit could destroy something precious or significant.
_desc_ko:
당신의 공격이 더욱 파괴적이 된다.

한 번, 당신의 실패했거나 성공한 공격 하나가 치명타가 되며, 당신의 무기나 비무장 공격은 이 공격에 대해 치명 d12 특성을 얻어, 이미 지니고 있던 어떤 치명 특성이든 대체한다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.boons-and-curses.Item.epHQeILdRs3NuxMZ]{효과: 로바구그의 파괴}

로바구그는 보통 그 치명타가 소중하거나 중요한 무언가를 파괴할 수 있을 때 이 축복을 내린다.

name: Brigh - Major Curse

description.value: Constructs—even mindless constructs you thought you could control—seek your demise. All constructs are hostile to you and attack you when they notice your presence. Occasionally, inanimate statues and other objects animate as constructs to pursue Brigh's vengeance.

_desc_en: Constructs—even mindless constructs you thought you could control—seek your demise. All constructs are hostile to you and attack you when they notice your presence. Occasionally, inanimate statues and other objects animate as constructs to pursue Brigh's vengeance.
_desc_ko: 구조물은—당신이 통제할 수 있다고 여겼던 정신 없는 구조물조차도—당신의 파멸을 노립니다. 모든 구조물이 당신에게 적대적이며, 당신의 존재를 알아차리면 공격합니다. 때때로 생명 없는 조각상이나 다른 물체가 구조물로 살아 움직이며 브라이의 복수를 좇습니다.

name: Desna - Moderate Boon

description.value:
Desna twists fortune in your favor.

Once per day, after determining the result of a check, you can reroll the check and take the new result.

_desc_en:
Desna twists fortune in your favor.

Once per day, after determining the result of a check, you can reroll the check and take the new result.
_desc_ko:
데스나가 운명을 당신에게 유리하게 비틀어 줍니다.

하루에 한 번, 판정 결과를 확인한 뒤 그 판정을 다시 굴리고 새로운 결과를 취할 수 있습니다.

name: Nethys - Major Curse

description.value: Nethys severs your connection to magic. You lose all your spellcasting abilities and cannot gain any future spellcasting.

_desc_en: Nethys severs your connection to magic. You lose all your spellcasting abilities and cannot gain any future spellcasting.
_desc_ko: 네시스가 당신과 마법의 연결을 끊습니다. 당신은 모든 주문시전 능력을 잃으며, 앞으로 어떠한 주문시전 능력도 얻을 수 없습니다.

name: Lamashtu - Minor Curse

description.value: Horrid visions torment your mind, overlaying reality at inopportune times. You treat everything around you as if it was @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

_desc_en: Horrid visions torment your mind, overlaying reality at inopportune times. You treat everything around you as if it was @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.
_desc_ko: 끔찍한 환영이 당신의 정신을 괴롭히며, 원치 않는 순간에 현실 위로 겹쳐집니다. 당신은 주변의 모든 것을 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{은폐}된 것처럼 취급합니다.

name: Sivanah - Moderate Curse

description.value: Those who betray the secrets of others find their own secrets laid bare. Each person from whom you are keeping a secret immediately learns one of your secrets involving that person. This curse doesn't give away other people's secrets you are keeping, only your own.

_desc_en: Those who betray the secrets of others find their own secrets laid bare. Each person from whom you are keeping a secret immediately learns one of your secrets involving that person. This curse doesn't give away other people's secrets you are keeping, only your own.
_desc_ko: 남의 비밀을 배신하는 자는 자신의 비밀이 드러나게 됩니다. 당신이 비밀을 숨기고 있는 각 사람은 즉시 그 사람과 관련된 당신의 비밀 하나를 알게 됩니다. 이 저주는 당신이 지키고 있는 다른 사람들의 비밀을 누설하지 않으며, 오직 당신 자신의 비밀만 드러냅니다.

name: Nocticula - Moderate Curse

description.value: You are plagued with doubt in your own skills. You are always untrained with Crafting, Performance, and one other skill (determined by the GM, but themed to the event that brought on your curse), regardless of any effect that would improve your proficiency. You can't retrain those skills.

_desc_en: You are plagued with doubt in your own skills. You are always untrained with Crafting, Performance, and one other skill (determined by the GM, but themed to the event that brought on your curse), regardless of any effect that would improve your proficiency. You can't retrain those skills.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신의 기량에 대한 의심에 시달립니다. 당신은 숙련도를 향상시키는 어떠한 효과와 관계없이 제작, 공연, 그리고 그 외 한 가지 기술(GM이 정하되, 저주를 초래한 사건과 관련된 주제로)에 대해 항상 미숙련입니다. 당신은 그 기술들을 재훈련할 수 없습니다.

name: Chaldira - Moderate Boon

description.value: You gain a lucky impetuousness, allowing you to roll for initiative twice and use the higher result once per day. This is a fortune effect.

_desc_en: You gain a lucky impetuousness, allowing you to roll for initiative twice and use the higher result once per day. This is a fortune effect.
_desc_ko: 당신은 행운 어린 충동성을 얻어, 하루에 한 번 우선권을 두 번 굴리고 더 높은 결과를 사용할 수 있습니다. 이것은 행운 효과입니다.

name: Tsukiyo - Minor Curse

description.value: Those who offend Tsukiyo find that light actively shuns them. You lose any low-light vision or darkvision you have, and you treat all light levels as one step lower.

_desc_en: Those who offend Tsukiyo find that light actively shuns them. You lose any low-light vision or darkvision you have, and you treat all light levels as one step lower.
_desc_ko: 츠키요를 노하게 한 자는 빛이 그들을 능동적으로 기피하게 됩니다. 당신은 가지고 있던 미광 시야나 암시야를 잃으며, 모든 조명 수준을 한 단계 낮은 것으로 취급합니다.

name: Lamashtu - Minor Boon

description.value:
Lamashtu's touch mutates a part of your body.

You gain either an unarmed Strike that deals 1d6 damage or one that deals 1d4 damage and has the finesse and agile traits.

Whether the attack deals bludgeoning, slashing, or piercing damage depends on the mutation.

If the unarmed Strike replaces a limb, you can still use the mutated limb for its original functions. Lamashtu chooses the form and function of your mutation.

_desc_en:
Lamashtu's touch mutates a part of your body.

You gain either an unarmed Strike that deals 1d6 damage or one that deals 1d4 damage and has the finesse and agile traits.

Whether the attack deals bludgeoning, slashing, or piercing damage depends on the mutation.

If the unarmed Strike replaces a limb, you can still use the mutated limb for its original functions. Lamashtu chooses the form and function of your mutation.
_desc_ko:
라마슈투의 손길이 당신 신체의 일부를 변형시킵니다.

당신은 1d6 피해를 입히는 비무장 타격, 또는 1d4 피해를 입히며 정교함과 기민함 특성을 지닌 비무장 타격 중 하나를 얻습니다.

그 공격이 타격, 참격, 관통 피해 중 무엇을 입히는지는 변형에 따라 달라집니다.

비무장 타격이 팔다리를 대체하는 경우에도, 당신은 변형된 팔다리를 원래 기능대로 계속 사용할 수 있습니다. 라마슈투가 당신 변형의 형태와 기능을 선택합니다.

name: Grandmother Spider - Minor Boon

description.value:
Grandmother Spider rescues your prank from the jaws of failure.

Once, when you would fail a Deception check, you critically succeed instead.

Grandmother Spider typically grants this boon for deceptions that are necessary for an interesting or consequential prank.

_desc_en:
Grandmother Spider rescues your prank from the jaws of failure.

Once, when you would fail a Deception check, you critically succeed instead.

Grandmother Spider typically grants this boon for deceptions that are necessary for an interesting or consequential prank.
_desc_ko:
할머니 거미가 당신의 장난을 실패의 아가리에서 구해냅니다.

한 번, 당신이 기만 판정에 실패하려 할 때, 대신 대성공합니다.

할머니 거미는 보통 흥미롭거나 중대한 장난에 꼭 필요한 기만에 대해 이 축복을 부여합니다.

name: Milani - Minor Boon

description.value:
Once, when you roll a failure on a Deception or Stealth check to protect an uprising from discovery, you critically succeed instead.

Milani typically grants this boon for extremely significant checks on which the uprising's survival hinges.

_desc_en:
Once, when you roll a failure on a Deception or Stealth check to protect an uprising from discovery, you critically succeed instead.

Milani typically grants this boon for extremely significant checks on which the uprising's survival hinges.
_desc_ko:
한 번, 봉기가 발각되지 않도록 보호하기 위한 기만 또는 은신 판정에서 실패를 굴릴 때, 대신 대성공합니다.

밀라니는 보통 봉기의 생존이 달린 극도로 중대한 판정에 대해 이 축복을 부여합니다.

name: Torag - Minor Curse

description.value: Shoddy artisanship makes itself known. Whenever an item you're using takes damage, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken}.

_desc_en: Shoddy artisanship makes itself known. Whenever an item you're using takes damage, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken}.
_desc_ko: 조잡한 장인 솜씨가 그 실체를 드러냅니다. 당신이 사용하는 물품이 피해를 입을 때마다, 그것은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{파손됨} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Nivi Rhombodazzle - Minor Boon

description.value:
Those who have earned Nivi's trust are blessed with wild turns of luck in the worst of circumstances.

Once, instead of attempting the check you would normally roll, you attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11] with the same results.

Nivi always grants this boon when the odds are stacked against you (though this same effect is an alternate to her minor curse if she uses it for a check when you would have been very likely to succeed).

_desc_en:
Those who have earned Nivi's trust are blessed with wild turns of luck in the worst of circumstances.

Once, instead of attempting the check you would normally roll, you attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11] with the same results.

Nivi always grants this boon when the odds are stacked against you (though this same effect is an alternate to her minor curse if she uses it for a check when you would have been very likely to succeed).
_desc_ko:
니비의 신뢰를 얻은 자는 최악의 상황에서 거친 운의 반전이라는 축복을 받습니다.

한 번, 당신이 평소에 굴릴 판정을 시도하는 대신, 동일한 결과를 적용하여 @Check[flat|dc:11]을 시도합니다.

니비는 승산이 당신에게 불리하게 쌓였을 때 항상 이 축복을 부여합니다(다만 이 동일한 효과는, 당신이 성공할 가능성이 매우 높았던 판정에 그녀가 사용할 경우 그녀의 경미 저주의 대안이 되기도 합니다).

name: Gorum - Major Boon

description.value:
Gorum feeds you the zeal of his undying warriors, allowing you to draw upon your own life force to fight on and on without falling.

Whenever you would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, you are instead healed to half your maximum Hit Points and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} (or increase your doomed condition by 1).

_desc_en:
Gorum feeds you the zeal of his undying warriors, allowing you to draw upon your own life force to fight on and on without falling.

Whenever you would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, you are instead healed to half your maximum Hit Points and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} (or increase your doomed condition by 1).
_desc_ko:
고룸이 자신의 불사 전사들의 열정을 당신에게 불어넣어, 당신 자신의 생명력을 끌어내 쓰러지지 않고 계속해서 싸울 수 있게 합니다.

당신이 히트 포인트 0으로 감소하려 할 때마다, 대신 최대 히트 포인트의 절반까지 치유되고 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{파멸 1} 상태가 됩니다(또는 파멸 조건을 1 증가시킵니다).

name: Nivi Rhombodazzle - Moderate Curse

description.value: Those who arouse Nivi's wrath find themselves bound to the earth with no place to hide. You are wreathed in constant @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HRb2doyaLtaoCfi3]{Faerie Fire} and constantly affected by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gPvtmKMRpg9I9D7H]{Earthbind}, and any effect that grants @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisibility} doesn't work on you.

_desc_en: Those who arouse Nivi's wrath find themselves bound to the earth with no place to hide. You are wreathed in constant @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HRb2doyaLtaoCfi3]{Faerie Fire} and constantly affected by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gPvtmKMRpg9I9D7H]{Earthbind}, and any effect that grants @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisibility} doesn't work on you.
_desc_ko: 니비의 진노를 산 자는 숨을 곳 없이 대지에 묶이게 됩니다. 당신은 끊임없이 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HRb2doyaLtaoCfi3]{요정불}에 휩싸이고 항상 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gPvtmKMRpg9I9D7H]{대지 속박}의 영향을 받으며, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{투명} 상태를 부여하는 어떠한 효과도 당신에게는 작동하지 않습니다.

name: Chaldira - Moderate Curse

description.value: You are plagued with ill luck just when fortune is most needed. You must always roll flat checks twice and use the worse result. This is a misfortune effect.

_desc_en: You are plagued with ill luck just when fortune is most needed. You must always roll flat checks twice and use the worse result. This is a misfortune effect.
_desc_ko: 당신은 행운이 가장 필요한 바로 그 순간에 불운에 시달립니다. 당신은 언제나 평면 판정을 두 번 굴려 더 나쁜 결과를 사용해야 합니다. 이것은 불운 효과입니다.

name: Nethys - Major Boon

description.value:
You are granted supreme magical knowledge and mastery.

If you are a prepared spellcaster, you can switch one of your prepared spells for another spell you could have prepared in that slot; if you are a spontaneous spellcaster, you can switch one of the spells in your spell repertoire for another spell you could have chosen for your repertoire instead.

In either case, you make this switch by using a single action, which has the concentrate trait. (If you are neither a prepared nor a spontaneous spellcaster, Nethys won't grant you his major boon.)

_desc_en:
You are granted supreme magical knowledge and mastery.

If you are a prepared spellcaster, you can switch one of your prepared spells for another spell you could have prepared in that slot; if you are a spontaneous spellcaster, you can switch one of the spells in your spell repertoire for another spell you could have chosen for your repertoire instead.

In either case, you make this switch by using a single action, which has the concentrate trait. (If you are neither a prepared nor a spontaneous spellcaster, Nethys won't grant you his major boon.)
_desc_ko:
당신은 최고의 마법 지식과 숙달을 부여받습니다.

당신이 준비형 주문시전자라면, 준비한 주문 하나를 그 슬롯에 준비할 수 있었던 다른 주문으로 바꿀 수 있습니다. 당신이 자발형 주문시전자라면, 주문 목록에 있는 주문 하나를 목록에 선택할 수 있었던 다른 주문으로 바꿀 수 있습니다.

어느 경우든, 당신은 집중 특성을 지닌 단일 행동을 사용하여 이 교체를 수행합니다. (당신이 준비형도 자발형도 아닌 주문시전자라면, 네시스는 당신에게 그의 중대 축복을 부여하지 않습니다.)

name: Casandalee - Minor Curse

description.value: Your joints stiffen, and your mind becomes clouded. You take a -2 status penalty to all rolls for initiative.

_desc_en: Your joints stiffen, and your mind becomes clouded. You take a -2 status penalty to all rolls for initiative.
_desc_ko: 당신의 관절이 뻣뻣해지고, 정신이 흐려집니다. 당신은 모든 우선권 굴림에 -2 상태 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Nocticula - Moderate Boon

description.value: You draw on the power of midnight to guide you on your journeys. You gain darkvision. If you already had darkvision, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4GE2ZdODgIQtg51c]{Darkness} once per day as a divine innate spell.

_desc_en: You draw on the power of midnight to guide you on your journeys. You gain darkvision. If you already had darkvision, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4GE2ZdODgIQtg51c]{Darkness} once per day as a divine innate spell.
_desc_ko: 당신은 여정에서 당신을 인도하도록 자정의 힘을 끌어냅니다. 당신은 암시야를 얻습니다. 이미 암시야를 지니고 있었다면, 하루에 한 번 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4GE2ZdODgIQtg51c]{암흑}을 신성 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Urgathoa - Moderate Curse

description.value: Urgathoa cuts you off from vitality energy without granting you the blessing of undeath. You are harmed by vitality effects and don't recover Hit Points from them, as if you were an undead or had void healing, but you are still harmed by void effects as normal.

_desc_en: Urgathoa cuts you off from vitality energy without granting you the blessing of undeath. You are harmed by vitality effects and don't recover Hit Points from them, as if you were an undead or had void healing, but you are still harmed by void effects as normal.
_desc_ko: 우르가토아가 언데드의 축복은 주지 않은 채 당신을 활력 에너지로부터 차단합니다. 당신은 언데드이거나 공허 치유를 지닌 것처럼 활력 효과에 의해 해를 입고 그것으로부터 히트 포인트를 회복하지 못하지만, 여전히 공허 효과에 의해서는 정상적으로 해를 입습니다.

name: Groetus - Moderate Boon

description.value: Groetus grants you knowledge to further the end times. Each week, he sends you a cryptic, incoherent message about something important to the end times that will happen in the coming week.

_desc_en: Groetus grants you knowledge to further the end times. Each week, he sends you a cryptic, incoherent message about something important to the end times that will happen in the coming week.
_desc_ko: 그로에투스가 종말을 앞당길 지식을 당신에게 부여합니다. 매주, 그는 다가오는 한 주 동안 일어날 종말과 관련된 중요한 무언가에 대해 수수께끼 같고 조리 없는 전언을 당신에게 보냅니다.

name: Gruhastha - Major Boon

description.value:
You are a divine inspiration to others around you.

When attempting any checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, you can roll twice and use the better result; this is a fortune effect. Additionally, allies within 60 feet gain a +2 status bonus to Will saves.

_desc_en:
You are a divine inspiration to others around you.

When attempting any checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, you can roll twice and use the better result; this is a fortune effect. Additionally, allies within 60 feet gain a +2 status bonus to Will saves.
_desc_ko:
당신은 주변 사람들에게 신성한 영감이 됩니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{지식 회상}을 위한 어떤 판정을 시도하든, 당신은 두 번 굴려 더 나은 결과를 사용할 수 있습니다. 이것은 행운 효과입니다. 또한, 60피트 이내의 아군은 의지 내성 굴림에 +2 상태 보너스를 받습니다.

name: Besmara - Minor Boon

description.value:
Besmara wants you to amuse her, placing both plunder and peril in your path.

This intercession often takes the form of an unexpected treasure map, a message in a bottle, or some other sign leading you to a great reward, assuming you can handle the challenges along the way.

_desc_en:
Besmara wants you to amuse her, placing both plunder and peril in your path.

This intercession often takes the form of an unexpected treasure map, a message in a bottle, or some other sign leading you to a great reward, assuming you can handle the challenges along the way.
_desc_ko:
베스마라는 당신이 자신을 즐겁게 해주기를 바라며, 당신의 앞길에 전리품과 위험을 함께 놓습니다.

이 개입은 흔히 예상치 못한 보물 지도, 병 속의 편지, 또는 그 밖에 당신을 큰 보상으로 이끄는 어떤 징표의 형태를 취하되, 도중의 시련들을 감당할 수 있다는 전제하에서입니다.

name: Chaldira - Major Curse

description.value: Ill luck causes even once-certain aid to fail with frustrating regularity. You cannot benefit from circumstance or status bonuses, or from fortune effects.

_desc_en: Ill luck causes even once-certain aid to fail with frustrating regularity. You cannot benefit from circumstance or status bonuses, or from fortune effects.
_desc_ko: 불운이 한때는 확실했던 도움조차 좌절스러울 만큼 규칙적으로 실패하게 만듭니다. 당신은 상황 또는 상태 보너스로부터, 그리고 행운 효과로부터 이익을 얻을 수 없습니다.

name: Kurgess - Minor Boon

description.value: The Strong Man blesses you with a measure of his strength. Increase your maximum and encumbered Bulk limits by 2.

_desc_en: The Strong Man blesses you with a measure of his strength. Increase your maximum and encumbered Bulk limits by 2.
_desc_ko: 장사(壯士)가 자신의 힘 일부를 당신에게 축복으로 내립니다. 당신의 최대 및 과적 부피 한계를 2 증가시킵니다.

name: Nivi Rhombodazzle - Moderate Boon

description.value: Nivi bestows a fraction of her skill at pushing consequences down the road. Once per day, after attempting a check, you can roll a second time. You must use the result of the second roll, even if it is worse. This is a fortune effect. At any point after you use this boon, the GM can replace one of your check results with the first result of the check you attempted when using this boon; this delayed result can't be further delayed, prevented, or affected in any way, even by other divine intercessions.

_desc_en: Nivi bestows a fraction of her skill at pushing consequences down the road. Once per day, after attempting a check, you can roll a second time. You must use the result of the second roll, even if it is worse. This is a fortune effect. At any point after you use this boon, the GM can replace one of your check results with the first result of the check you attempted when using this boon; this delayed result can't be further delayed, prevented, or affected in any way, even by other divine intercessions.
_desc_ko: 니비가 결과를 뒤로 미루는 자신의 기량 일부를 하사합니다. 하루에 한 번, 판정을 시도한 뒤 두 번째로 다시 굴릴 수 있습니다. 두 번째 굴림의 결과가 더 나쁘더라도 그 결과를 사용해야 합니다. 이것은 행운 효과입니다. 이 축복을 사용한 뒤 어느 시점에서든, GM은 당신의 판정 결과 하나를, 이 축복을 사용할 때 시도했던 판정의 첫 번째 결과로 대체할 수 있습니다. 이 지연된 결과는 다른 신성 개입에 의해서라도 더 이상 지연되거나, 방지되거나, 어떤 식으로도 영향받을 수 없습니다.

name: Casandalee - Major Curse

description.value: The code of your soul is constantly being rewritten, and not for the better. You are never temporarily immune against a harmful effect.

_desc_en: The code of your soul is constantly being rewritten, and not for the better. You are never temporarily immune against a harmful effect.
_desc_ko: 당신 영혼의 코드가 끊임없이 다시 쓰이며, 그것도 더 나쁜 쪽으로 쓰입니다. 당신은 유해한 효과에 대해 결코 일시적으로 면역이 되지 않습니다.

name: Hei Feng - Minor Boon

description.value:
The Heavenly Court's most boastful deity ensures your boasts hit home.

Once, when you fail an Intimidation check, you critically succeed instead.

Hei Feng grants this boon capriciously based on his mood, sometimes even for trivial or inconsequential boasts, and he sometimes grants it for other skill checks related to boasts.

_desc_en:
The Heavenly Court's most boastful deity ensures your boasts hit home.

Once, when you fail an Intimidation check, you critically succeed instead.

Hei Feng grants this boon capriciously based on his mood, sometimes even for trivial or inconsequential boasts, and he sometimes grants it for other skill checks related to boasts.
_desc_ko:
천상 궁정에서 가장 허풍이 심한 신이 당신의 호언장담이 적중하도록 보장합니다.

한 번, 당신이 위협 판정에 실패할 때, 대신 대성공합니다.

헤이 펑은 기분에 따라 변덕스럽게 이 축복을 부여하며, 때로는 사소하거나 하찮은 호언장담에 대해서도, 때로는 호언장담과 관련된 다른 기술 판정에 대해서도 부여합니다.

name: Torag - Major Boon

description.value:
Standing watch or guarding a location counts as resting for you, preventing you from being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} due to lack of rest as long as you stand watch for at least 6 hours a day.

You can recover your Focus Points (if you have them) by standing guard in addition to any other options you have available.

When on guard, you gain a +4 status bonus to Perception to notice ambushes and other dangers approaching.

As long as you are holding a shield, you are always @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYtYKa1gDEl7y2N0]{Defending} during exploration without needing to move at half your travel speed, and you can perform another exploration activity as well.

While you are using a shield, its Hardness increases by 5.

_desc_en:
Standing watch or guarding a location counts as resting for you, preventing you from being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} due to lack of rest as long as you stand watch for at least 6 hours a day.

You can recover your Focus Points (if you have them) by standing guard in addition to any other options you have available.

When on guard, you gain a +4 status bonus to Perception to notice ambushes and other dangers approaching.

As long as you are holding a shield, you are always @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYtYKa1gDEl7y2N0]{Defending} during exploration without needing to move at half your travel speed, and you can perform another exploration activity as well.

While you are using a shield, its Hardness increases by 5.
_desc_ko:
보초를 서거나 장소를 지키는 것은 당신에게 휴식으로 간주되어, 하루에 최소 6시간 보초를 서는 한 휴식 부족으로 인한 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{피로} 상태가 되는 것을 막아줍니다.

당신은 다른 이용 가능한 선택지에 더해, 보초를 섬으로써 (지니고 있다면) 집중 점수를 회복할 수 있습니다.

보초를 설 때, 당신은 매복이나 접근하는 다른 위험을 알아차리기 위한 지각에 +4 상태 보너스를 받습니다.

방패를 들고 있는 한, 당신은 탐사 중 이동 속도의 절반으로 이동할 필요 없이 항상 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYtYKa1gDEl7y2N0]{방어} 상태이며, 다른 탐사 활동도 함께 수행할 수 있습니다.

방패를 사용하는 동안, 그 방패의 경도가 5 증가합니다.

name: Torag - Moderate Curse

description.value:
You must prove your skills at a craft by providing your own equipment.

You gain item bonuses only from items you make yourself.

_desc_en:
You must prove your skills at a craft by providing your own equipment.

You gain item bonuses only from items you make yourself.
_desc_ko:
당신은 스스로 장비를 마련함으로써 장인으로서의 기량을 증명해야 합니다.

당신은 오직 스스로 만든 물품으로부터만 물품 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Sivanah - Moderate Boon

description.value: You wear a veil of illusion wherever you go. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise} at will as an innate divine spell.

_desc_en: You wear a veil of illusion wherever you go. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise} at will as an innate divine spell.
_desc_ko: 당신은 어디를 가든 환영의 베일을 두릅니다. 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{환영 변장}을 선천 신성 주문으로 마음껏 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Gozreh - Moderate Curse

description.value:
The current of the waves constantly fights against you, putting you at risk of drowning any time you must @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c8TGiZ48ygoSPofx]{Swim}.

You lose any swim Speed you have, unless it's your only Speed, in which case you take a –20-foot status penalty to your swim Speed.

When you roll an Athletics check to Swim, you always use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of your roll.

_desc_en:
The current of the waves constantly fights against you, putting you at risk of drowning any time you must @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c8TGiZ48ygoSPofx]{Swim}.

You lose any swim Speed you have, unless it's your only Speed, in which case you take a –20-foot status penalty to your swim Speed.

When you roll an Athletics check to Swim, you always use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of your roll.
_desc_ko:
파도의 물살이 끊임없이 당신을 거스르며, 당신이 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c8TGiZ48ygoSPofx]{수영}해야 할 때마다 익사할 위험에 처하게 합니다.

당신은 가지고 있던 수영 속도를 잃습니다. 다만 그것이 당신의 유일한 이동 속도라면, 대신 당신의 수영 속도에 –20피트 상태 페널티를 받습니다.

수영하기 위해 운동 판정을 굴릴 때, 당신은 항상 굴림 결과보다 한 성공 단계 낮은 결과를 적용합니다.

name: Gozreh - Moderate Boon

description.value: You gain the touch of the sea. You can breathe underwater and gain a swim Speed equal to your land Speed.

_desc_en: You gain the touch of the sea. You can breathe underwater and gain a swim Speed equal to your land Speed.
_desc_ko: 당신은 바다의 손길을 얻습니다. 당신은 수중에서 호흡할 수 있으며, 육상 속도와 동일한 수영 속도를 얻습니다.

name: Sivanah - Major Curse

description.value: Mirrors break whenever you cross their paths. You cannot be concealed by illusion magic of any kind (the spell automatically fails), and all creatures that see you know your true identity.

_desc_en: Mirrors break whenever you cross their paths. You cannot be concealed by illusion magic of any kind (the spell automatically fails), and all creatures that see you know your true identity.
_desc_ko: 당신이 지나는 길목마다 거울이 깨집니다. 당신은 어떠한 종류의 환영 마법으로도 은폐될 수 없으며(주문이 자동으로 실패함), 당신을 보는 모든 생물이 당신의 진짜 정체를 알게 됩니다.

name: Nocticula - Minor Curse

description.value: Midnight looms and obscures your fate. You are only able to see up to 60 feet away from you, regardless of the lighting or what senses you have.

_desc_en: Midnight looms and obscures your fate. You are only able to see up to 60 feet away from you, regardless of the lighting or what senses you have.
_desc_ko: 자정이 어른거리며 당신의 운명을 가립니다. 당신은 조명이나 당신이 지닌 감각과 관계없이, 자신으로부터 최대 60피트 떨어진 곳까지만 볼 수 있습니다.

name: Shizuru - Moderate Curse

description.value: Shizuru decrees that her light is no longer your ally. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.I0HYG0ctCLP5JRsW]{Light Blindness}.

_desc_en: Shizuru decrees that her light is no longer your ally. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.I0HYG0ctCLP5JRsW]{Light Blindness}.
_desc_ko: 시즈루가 그녀의 빛이 더 이상 당신의 아군이 아님을 선포합니다. 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.I0HYG0ctCLP5JRsW]{빛 실명}을 얻습니다.

name: Alseta - Moderate Curse

description.value: Crossing thresholds becomes daunting. Whenever you move through a portal, gateway, or door, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} condition. Magical travel is even more exhausting; after traveling via teleportation, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5bTt2CvYHPvaR7QQ]{Interplanar Teleport}, or the like, you also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} condition until you get a full night's rest.

_desc_en: Crossing thresholds becomes daunting. Whenever you move through a portal, gateway, or door, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} condition. Magical travel is even more exhausting; after traveling via teleportation, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5bTt2CvYHPvaR7QQ]{Interplanar Teleport}, or the like, you also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} condition until you get a full night's rest.
_desc_ko: 문턱을 넘는 일이 두려워집니다. 당신이 관문, 통로, 또는 문을 통해 이동할 때마다, 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{구역질 2} 조건을 얻습니다. 마법적 이동은 훨씬 더 소모적입니다. 순간이동, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5bTt2CvYHPvaR7QQ]{차원간 순간이동}, 또는 그와 유사한 수단으로 이동한 뒤에는, 하룻밤을 온전히 쉴 때까지 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{피로} 조건도 얻습니다.

name: Erastil - Major Curse

description.value: Erastil leaves you unable to have children (or otherwise reproduce or propagate if you do so in a different manner). This curse also affects your livestock, pets, and crops.

_desc_en: Erastil leaves you unable to have children (or otherwise reproduce or propagate if you do so in a different manner). This curse also affects your livestock, pets, and crops.
_desc_ko: 에라스틸이 당신을 아이를 가질 수 없게(또는 다른 방식으로 번식하거나 자손을 남기는 경우 그렇게 하지 못하도록) 만듭니다. 이 저주는 당신의 가축, 반려동물, 작물에도 영향을 미칩니다.

name: Erastil - Moderate Boon

description.value:
You share Erastil's sharp eye, allowing you to use a longbow in any situation.

When you attack with a longbow, you can ignore the longbow's volley trait, and longbows have double the normal range increment for you.

_desc_en:
You share Erastil's sharp eye, allowing you to use a longbow in any situation.

When you attack with a longbow, you can ignore the longbow's volley trait, and longbows have double the normal range increment for you.
_desc_ko:
당신은 에라스틸의 날카로운 눈을 공유하여, 어떤 상황에서도 장궁을 사용할 수 있게 됩니다.

당신이 장궁으로 공격할 때, 장궁의 일제사격 특성을 무시할 수 있으며, 당신에게 장궁의 사거리 증가폭은 평소의 두 배가 됩니다.

name: Groetus - Minor Boon

description.value:
You wield power over disorder.

Once, when you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, you act normally enough to control your own actions in combat without penalty for the duration, though you still babble incoherently and otherwise behave strangely.

_desc_en:
You wield power over disorder.

Once, when you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, you act normally enough to control your own actions in combat without penalty for the duration, though you still babble incoherently and otherwise behave strangely.
_desc_ko:
당신은 혼돈에 대한 힘을 휘두릅니다.

한 번, 당신이 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{혼란} 상태일 때, 그 지속시간 동안 페널티 없이 전투에서 자신의 행동을 통제할 만큼 정상적으로 행동합니다. 다만 여전히 조리 없이 중얼거리고 그 밖에는 기이하게 행동합니다.

name: Casandalee - Minor Boon

description.value:
Casandalee frees your thinking from dangerous control.

Once, when you fail a Will save against an effect that would control your actions, you critically succeed instead.

Casandalee typically grants this boon for particularly consequential violations of autonomy and agency.

_desc_en:
Casandalee frees your thinking from dangerous control.

Once, when you fail a Will save against an effect that would control your actions, you critically succeed instead.

Casandalee typically grants this boon for particularly consequential violations of autonomy and agency.
_desc_ko:
카산달리가 당신의 사고를 위험한 지배로부터 해방시킵니다.

당신의 행동을 지배하려는 효과에 대한 의지 내성 굴림에 실패할 때, 한 번에 한해 대신 대성공한 것으로 처리합니다.

카산달리는 대개 자율성과 자기 결정권을 특히 중대하게 침해당한 경우에 이 축복을 내립니다.

name: Hei Feng - Minor Curse

description.value: Hei Feng's belligerence hangs over you like a thunderhead. You take a -1 status penalty to checks with Charisma-based skills. If you consume even a drop of alcohol, this penalty becomes -3 until the next sunrise.

_desc_en: Hei Feng's belligerence hangs over you like a thunderhead. You take a -1 status penalty to checks with Charisma-based skills. If you consume even a drop of alcohol, this penalty becomes -3 until the next sunrise.
_desc_ko: 헤이펑의 호전성이 먹구름처럼 당신을 뒤덮습니다. 당신은 매력 기반 기술 판정에 -1 상태 페널티를 받습니다. 술을 한 방울이라도 마시면, 이 페널티는 다음 일출까지 -3이 됩니다.

name: Desna - Moderate Curse

description.value:
Misfortune follows you in your travels and requires acts of contrition or benevolence to keep at bay.

You must always roll twice and take the worst result when attempting a check. This is a misfortune effect.

You can express your remorse and ignore this effect for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds} by spending an action, which has the concentrate trait.

If you perform a truly selfless act of compassion, you ignore this effect for 1 day.

_desc_en:
Misfortune follows you in your travels and requires acts of contrition or benevolence to keep at bay.

You must always roll twice and take the worst result when attempting a check. This is a misfortune effect.

You can express your remorse and ignore this effect for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds} by spending an action, which has the concentrate trait.

If you perform a truly selfless act of compassion, you ignore this effect for 1 day.
_desc_ko:
여정 중에 불운이 당신을 따라다니며, 이를 막으려면 참회나 선행이 필요합니다.

당신은 판정을 시도할 때 항상 두 번 굴려 더 나쁜 결과를 취해야 합니다. 이것은 불운 효과입니다.

집중 특성을 지닌 행동 하나를 소모하여 후회를 표현하면 [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 라운드}동안 이 효과를 무시할 수 있습니다.

진정으로 사심 없는 연민의 행위를 하면, 1일 동안 이 효과를 무시합니다.

name: Nethys - Moderate Curse

description.value:
Your magic wars against itself like Nethys's dueling halves. Whenever you cast a spell, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11].

On a failure, if your spell was harmful, you instead cast a beneficial spell of the same rank on your intended targets, and if it was beneficial, you instead cast a harmful spell of the same rank on your intended targets.

If the spell benefited some targets and harmed others, you cast a spell of the same rank that switches who benefited (for instance, changing a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} spell that harmed undead and healed the living to a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} spell that healed undead and harmed the living).

You still lose the spell slot for the spell you were trying to cast.

_desc_en:
Your magic wars against itself like Nethys's dueling halves. Whenever you cast a spell, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11].

On a failure, if your spell was harmful, you instead cast a beneficial spell of the same rank on your intended targets, and if it was beneficial, you instead cast a harmful spell of the same rank on your intended targets.

If the spell benefited some targets and harmed others, you cast a spell of the same rank that switches who benefited (for instance, changing a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} spell that harmed undead and healed the living to a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} spell that healed undead and harmed the living).

You still lose the spell slot for the spell you were trying to cast.
_desc_ko:
당신의 마법이 네시스의 대립하는 반쪽처럼 서로 싸웁니다. 주문을 시전할 때마다 @Check[flat|dc:11]를 시도합니다.

실패하면, 당신의 주문이 해로운 것이었다면 대신 같은 랭크의 이로운 주문을 의도한 대상에게 시전하고, 이로운 것이었다면 대신 같은 랭크의 해로운 주문을 의도한 대상에게 시전합니다.

주문이 일부 대상에게는 이롭고 일부에게는 해로웠다면, 이로움을 받는 대상을 뒤바꾸는 같은 랭크의 주문을 시전합니다(예를 들어, 언데드에게 해를 입히고 산 자를 치유한 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{치유} 주문을, 언데드를 치유하고 산 자에게 해를 입히는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{해악} 주문으로 바꿉니다).

당신은 시전하려던 주문의 주문 슬롯은 여전히 잃습니다.

name: Sivanah - Minor Boon

description.value:
Sivanah prevents your enemies from pulling off your veil.

Once, when a foe rolls a success on a Perception check to disbelieve your illusion, it gets a critical failure instead.

Sivanah typically grants this benefit to protect an elaborate or consequential illusory deception, and she never uses it to improve the effect of a harmful illusion.

_desc_en:
Sivanah prevents your enemies from pulling off your veil.

Once, when a foe rolls a success on a Perception check to disbelieve your illusion, it gets a critical failure instead.

Sivanah typically grants this benefit to protect an elaborate or consequential illusory deception, and she never uses it to improve the effect of a harmful illusion.
_desc_ko:
시바나가 적들이 당신의 베일을 벗기지 못하게 막습니다.

한 번에 한해, 적이 당신의 환영을 간파하기 위한 지각 판정에서 성공을 굴리면, 대신 대실패로 처리됩니다.

시바나는 대개 정교하거나 중대한 환영 기만을 보호하기 위해 이 혜택을 내리며, 해로운 환영의 효과를 강화하는 데에는 결코 사용하지 않습니다.

name: Irori - Minor Curse

description.value: Irori challenges you to seek another path, rather than treat every problem as a nail just because you have a hammer. If you select a check for which you have a higher bonus when another method would have been more appropriate for the situation, such as using Deception to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} through life because it's your highest modifier, even if it would be better to reach a compromise through Diplomacy, you must roll twice and take the lower result.

_desc_en: Irori challenges you to seek another path, rather than treat every problem as a nail just because you have a hammer. If you select a check for which you have a higher bonus when another method would have been more appropriate for the situation, such as using Deception to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} through life because it's your highest modifier, even if it would be better to reach a compromise through Diplomacy, you must roll twice and take the lower result.
_desc_ko: 이로리는 망치가 있다는 이유만으로 모든 문제를 못처럼 다루는 대신, 다른 길을 모색하도록 당신에게 도전합니다. 상황에 다른 방법이 더 적절했음에도 더 높은 보너스를 가진 판정을 선택한다면, 예를 들어 외교를 통해 타협에 이르는 편이 나았을 텐데도 기만이 가장 높은 수정치라는 이유로 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{거짓말}로 삶을 헤쳐 나간다면, 당신은 두 번 굴려 더 낮은 결과를 취해야 합니다.

name: Besmara - Minor Curse

description.value: You feel some of the effects of scurvy, making your wounds flow more easily. The DC of the flat check for you to remove persistent bleed damage is 20 instead of 15 (or 15 instead of 10 if using extremely efficient methods to assist your recovery), and you don't recover from persistent bleed damage automatically when you reach full Hit Points.

_desc_en: You feel some of the effects of scurvy, making your wounds flow more easily. The DC of the flat check for you to remove persistent bleed damage is 20 instead of 15 (or 15 instead of 10 if using extremely efficient methods to assist your recovery), and you don't recover from persistent bleed damage automatically when you reach full Hit Points.
_desc_ko: 당신은 괴혈병의 일부 증상을 느끼며, 상처가 더 쉽게 피를 흘립니다. 지속 출혈 피해를 제거하기 위한 평판정의 DC가 15가 아니라 20이 되며(회복을 돕는 극도로 효율적인 방법을 사용할 경우에는 10 대신 15), 최대 히트 포인트에 도달해도 지속 출혈 피해가 자동으로 회복되지 않습니다.

name: Abadar - Moderate Boon

description.value:
Abadar blesses all your enterprises, leading to financial success as all your ventures always seems to work out.

If you roll a critical failure at a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income}, you get a failure instead.

If you roll a success on a check to Earn Income, you earn twice the usual amount of income.

_desc_en:
Abadar blesses all your enterprises, leading to financial success as all your ventures always seems to work out.

If you roll a critical failure at a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income}, you get a failure instead.

If you roll a success on a check to Earn Income, you earn twice the usual amount of income.
_desc_ko:
아바다르가 당신의 모든 사업을 축복하여, 당신의 모든 벤처가 언제나 잘 풀리는 것처럼 재정적 성공으로 이끕니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{수입 벌기} 판정에서 대실패를 굴리면, 대신 실패로 처리됩니다.

수입 벌기 판정에서 성공을 굴리면, 평소의 두 배에 해당하는 수입을 법니다.

name: Nivi Rhombodazzle - Major Curse

description.value: Nivi curses unworthy adherents with recklessness. Any time you are presented with a wager, you are compelled to accept, no matter the odds. If you succeed at a @Check[will|dc:40] save, you can at least attempt to alter the stakes of that wager in your favor, but you must still accept.

_desc_en: Nivi curses unworthy adherents with recklessness. Any time you are presented with a wager, you are compelled to accept, no matter the odds. If you succeed at a @Check[will|dc:40] save, you can at least attempt to alter the stakes of that wager in your favor, but you must still accept.
_desc_ko: 니비는 자격 없는 추종자를 무모함으로 저주합니다. 내기가 제시될 때마다, 당신은 승산이 어떻든 이를 받아들이도록 강요당합니다. @Check[will|dc:40] 내성에 성공하면, 적어도 그 내기의 판돈을 당신에게 유리하게 바꾸려는 시도는 할 수 있지만, 여전히 받아들여야 합니다.

name: Pharasma - Major Curse

description.value: Pharasma wills the end of your life and your lineage. You become unable to have children (or otherwise procreate by any means, including create spawn abilities) and are permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 2}.

_desc_en: Pharasma wills the end of your life and your lineage. You become unable to have children (or otherwise procreate by any means, including create spawn abilities) and are permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 2}.
_desc_ko: 파라스마는 당신의 삶과 혈통의 종말을 바랍니다. 당신은 자식을 가질 수 없게 되며(또는 하수인 생성 능력을 포함해 어떤 수단으로도 번식할 수 없게 되며), 영구적으로 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{파멸 2} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Sarenrae - Major Curse

description.value:
Sarenrae restricts your ability to harm others.

All attacks you make, spells you cast, and other sources of damage you deal are nonlethal except against fiends and undead, and you can't ever make them lethal.

You deal minimum damage except against fiends and undead.

All creatures except fiends and undead gain a +4 status bonus to their AC and saving throws against your attacks and other effects.

_desc_en:
Sarenrae restricts your ability to harm others.

All attacks you make, spells you cast, and other sources of damage you deal are nonlethal except against fiends and undead, and you can't ever make them lethal.

You deal minimum damage except against fiends and undead.

All creatures except fiends and undead gain a +4 status bonus to their AC and saving throws against your attacks and other effects.
_desc_ko:
사렌레가 다른 이를 해치는 당신의 능력을 제약합니다.

당신이 가하는 모든 공격, 시전하는 모든 주문, 그리고 당신이 입히는 다른 모든 피해 원천은 악마와 언데드를 상대할 때를 제외하고는 비살상이며, 결코 이를 살상으로 만들 수 없습니다.

악마와 언데드를 상대할 때를 제외하고는 최소 피해를 입힙니다.

악마와 언데드를 제외한 모든 크리처는 당신의 공격 및 기타 효과에 대해 AC와 내성 굴림에 +4 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Tsukiyo - Major Curse

description.value: When Tsukiyo truly loses patience with someone, he forces them to experience the hardships of others firsthand. Whenever you touch another creature or another creature touches you, you immediately gain any negative curses, diseases, and conditions they are suffering. These effects spread to you even when you Strike another creature or a creature Strikes you.

_desc_en: When Tsukiyo truly loses patience with someone, he forces them to experience the hardships of others firsthand. Whenever you touch another creature or another creature touches you, you immediately gain any negative curses, diseases, and conditions they are suffering. These effects spread to you even when you Strike another creature or a creature Strikes you.
_desc_ko: 츠키요가 누군가에게 진정으로 인내심을 잃으면, 그는 그들이 타인의 고난을 직접 겪게 만듭니다. 당신이 다른 크리처를 만지거나 다른 크리처가 당신을 만질 때마다, 당신은 그들이 겪고 있는 모든 부정적 저주, 질병, 상태를 즉시 얻습니다. 이러한 효과는 당신이 다른 크리처를 타격하거나 크리처가 당신을 타격할 때에도 당신에게 퍼집니다.

name: Calistria - Major Boon

description.value:
Calistria guides you towards vengeance.

You always know the direction and distance towards the nearest creature that has wronged you and thus far gone unpunished.

_desc_en:
Calistria guides you towards vengeance.

You always know the direction and distance towards the nearest creature that has wronged you and thus far gone unpunished.
_desc_ko:
칼리스트리아가 당신을 복수로 인도합니다.

당신은 아직 벌받지 않은 채 당신에게 잘못을 저지른 가장 가까운 크리처의 방향과 거리를 항상 알 수 있습니다.

name: Alseta - Minor Curse

description.value: Doors jam and locks stick when you try to open them. It takes 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} actions for you to open even an unlocked door, and each attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick a Lock} takes you 2 rounds instead of 2 actions.

_desc_en: Doors jam and locks stick when you try to open them. It takes 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} actions for you to open even an unlocked door, and each attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick a Lock} takes you 2 rounds instead of 2 actions.
_desc_ko: 당신이 열려고 하면 문은 걸리고 자물쇠는 뻑뻑해집니다. 잠기지 않은 문조차 여는 데 3번의 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{상호작용} 행동이 걸리며, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{자물쇠 따기} 시도는 2번의 행동이 아니라 2라운드가 걸립니다.

name: Achaekek - Major Curse

description.value: The Mantis God doesn't waste his time toying with or tormenting those who truly anger him or those who dare to consider themselves divine. He rips open a portal to your location, kills you, drags your soul to judgment in a way that prevents resurrection magic, and then leaves.

_desc_en: The Mantis God doesn't waste his time toying with or tormenting those who truly anger him or those who dare to consider themselves divine. He rips open a portal to your location, kills you, drags your soul to judgment in a way that prevents resurrection magic, and then leaves.
_desc_ko: 사마귀 신은 자신을 진정으로 노하게 한 자들이나 감히 스스로를 신적 존재로 여기는 자들을 가지고 놀거나 괴롭히는 데 시간을 낭비하지 않습니다. 그는 당신의 위치로 향하는 차원문을 찢어 열고, 당신을 죽이며, 부활 마법을 막는 방식으로 당신의 영혼을 심판대로 끌고 간 뒤, 떠납니다.

name: Shizuru - Major Boon

description.value:
Shizuru bestows upon you a golden suit of armor made from sunlight, or transforms your favorite armor to gain that aspect.

Once per hour while you are wearing the armor, if an attack would reduce your Hit Points to 0, the attack is instead completely negated.

_desc_en:
Shizuru bestows upon you a golden suit of armor made from sunlight, or transforms your favorite armor to gain that aspect.

Once per hour while you are wearing the armor, if an attack would reduce your Hit Points to 0, the attack is instead completely negated.
_desc_ko:
시즈루가 당신에게 햇빛으로 만든 황금 갑옷을 하사하거나, 당신이 가장 아끼는 갑옷을 변화시켜 그 성질을 갖게 합니다.

갑옷을 착용하고 있는 동안 시간당 한 번, 어떤 공격이 당신의 히트 포인트를 0으로 떨어뜨리려 할 때, 그 공격은 대신 완전히 무효화됩니다.

name: Milani - Major Curse

description.value: Small wounds bleed more than seems physically possible. Whenever you take slashing or piercing damage, you also take persistent bleed damage equal to the level of the creature or effect that inflicted the damage.

_desc_en: Small wounds bleed more than seems physically possible. Whenever you take slashing or piercing damage, you also take persistent bleed damage equal to the level of the creature or effect that inflicted the damage.
_desc_ko: 작은 상처도 물리적으로 가능해 보이는 것 이상으로 피를 흘립니다. 당신이 참격 또는 관통 피해를 입을 때마다, 그 피해를 입힌 크리처나 효과의 레벨과 동일한 지속 출혈 피해도 함께 입습니다.

name: Arazni - Moderate Boon

description.value: Blood from your wounds forms into armor or a piece of equipment you need. If what you need most is information, the blood forms letters spelling out that information.

_desc_en: Blood from your wounds forms into armor or a piece of equipment you need. If what you need most is information, the blood forms letters spelling out that information.
_desc_ko: 당신의 상처에서 흐르는 피가 당신에게 필요한 갑옷이나 장비 한 점으로 형성됩니다. 당신에게 가장 필요한 것이 정보라면, 그 피가 그 정보를 이루는 글자로 형성됩니다.

name: Nethys - Moderate Boon

description.value: Nethys grants you insight into the secrets of magic. Add one spell from a different tradition of magic to your spell list. You still must learn it or add it to your repertoire normally.

_desc_en: Nethys grants you insight into the secrets of magic. Add one spell from a different tradition of magic to your spell list. You still must learn it or add it to your repertoire normally.
_desc_ko: 네시스가 당신에게 마법의 비밀에 대한 통찰을 부여합니다. 다른 마법 전통의 주문 하나를 당신의 주문 목록에 추가합니다. 당신은 여전히 이를 정상적으로 배우거나 목록에 추가해야 합니다.

name: Gorum - Minor Boon

description.value:
Gorum grants you a weapon whenever you need one.

You can use an Interact action to draw a 0-level non-magical iron weapon, even if you have no weapons on your person. Such a weapon lasts only as long as you continue using it to attack, and it can't be sold, given away, melted for scrap iron, or the like.

_desc_en:
Gorum grants you a weapon whenever you need one.

You can use an Interact action to draw a 0-level non-magical iron weapon, even if you have no weapons on your person. Such a weapon lasts only as long as you continue using it to attack, and it can't be sold, given away, melted for scrap iron, or the like.
_desc_ko:
고룸은 당신이 무기가 필요할 때마다 무기를 부여합니다.

당신은 몸에 무기가 하나도 없더라도 상호작용 행동을 사용해 0레벨 비마법 철제 무기를 뽑을 수 있습니다. 그러한 무기는 당신이 계속 그것으로 공격하는 동안에만 지속되며, 팔거나, 넘겨주거나, 고철로 녹이거나 하는 것 등은 할 수 없습니다.

name: Tsukiyo - Moderate Boon

description.value: Tsukiyo watches over you and guards your sleep. You are guaranteed a peaceful night's rest no matter what conditions you are sleeping in. Even nightmare and similar abilities can't disrupt your sleep unless they come from a deity, artifact, or similarly powerful source.

_desc_en: Tsukiyo watches over you and guards your sleep. You are guaranteed a peaceful night's rest no matter what conditions you are sleeping in. Even nightmare and similar abilities can't disrupt your sleep unless they come from a deity, artifact, or similarly powerful source.
_desc_ko: 츠키요가 당신을 지켜보며 당신의 잠을 보호합니다. 당신은 어떤 조건에서 잠들든 평온한 밤의 휴식을 보장받습니다. 악몽 및 유사한 능력조차 신, 아티팩트, 또는 그에 준하는 강력한 원천에서 비롯된 것이 아닌 한 당신의 잠을 방해할 수 없습니다.

name: Shelyn - Major Curse

description.value:
Those who spread misery via false love face Shelyn's greatest curse.

You lose the ability to distinguish any living being from another through appearance, voice, scent, or similar sensory means. You can make out physical size (so you wouldn't mistake an ant for a horse), but nothing further.

If you were merely shallow, every creature you see has generic, bland features, but if your deeds were vile, you see only the faces of those you have wronged.

_desc_en:
Those who spread misery via false love face Shelyn's greatest curse.

You lose the ability to distinguish any living being from another through appearance, voice, scent, or similar sensory means. You can make out physical size (so you wouldn't mistake an ant for a horse), but nothing further.

If you were merely shallow, every creature you see has generic, bland features, but if your deeds were vile, you see only the faces of those you have wronged.
_desc_ko:
거짓된 사랑으로 비참함을 퍼뜨리는 자들은 셸린의 가장 큰 저주에 직면합니다.

당신은 외모, 목소리, 냄새, 또는 유사한 감각 수단을 통해 어떤 생명체를 다른 생명체와 구별하는 능력을 잃습니다. 물리적 크기는 알아볼 수 있지만(개미를 말과 혼동하지는 않습니다), 그 이상은 알 수 없습니다.

당신이 단지 천박했을 뿐이라면, 당신이 보는 모든 크리처는 평범하고 밋밋한 이목구비를 지니지만, 당신의 행실이 비열했다면, 당신은 당신이 잘못을 저지른 자들의 얼굴만을 보게 됩니다.

name: Iomedae - Minor Curse

description.value: Your blade and armor have dulled like lead. Your weapons, armor, and shields have half their usual Hit Points and Break Threshold.

_desc_en: Your blade and armor have dulled like lead. Your weapons, armor, and shields have half their usual Hit Points and Break Threshold.
_desc_ko: 당신의 검과 갑옷이 납처럼 무뎌졌습니다. 당신의 무기, 갑옷, 방패는 평소의 절반에 해당하는 히트 포인트와 파손 한계치를 지닙니다.

name: Arazni - Major Curse

description.value: When you would regain Hit Points due to either a vitality or void effect, you lose that many Hit Points instead.

_desc_en: When you would regain Hit Points due to either a vitality or void effect, you lose that many Hit Points instead.
_desc_ko: 당신이 활력 또는 공허 효과로 히트 포인트를 회복하게 될 때, 대신 그만큼의 히트 포인트를 잃습니다.

name: Nethys - Minor Curse

description.value: The secrets of magic become mentally taxing. You are permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}.

_desc_en: The secrets of magic become mentally taxing. You are permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}.
_desc_ko: 마법의 비밀이 정신적으로 부담스러워집니다. 당신은 영구적으로 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{멍함 1} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Calistria - Moderate Boon

description.value: A foot-long wasp finds and befriends you. It serves you as a familiar as long as you maintain Calistria's grace. The wasp always has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.uy15sDBuYNK48N3v]{Burrower} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.ZHSzNt3NxkXbj1mI]{Flier} familiar abilities.

_desc_en: A foot-long wasp finds and befriends you. It serves you as a familiar as long as you maintain Calistria's grace. The wasp always has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.uy15sDBuYNK48N3v]{Burrower} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.ZHSzNt3NxkXbj1mI]{Flier} familiar abilities.
_desc_ko: 1피트 길이의 말벌이 당신을 찾아내 친구가 됩니다. 당신이 칼리스트리아의 은총을 유지하는 한, 그것은 사역마로서 당신을 섬깁니다. 이 말벌은 항상 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.uy15sDBuYNK48N3v]{굴착꾼}과 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.ZHSzNt3NxkXbj1mI]{비행체} 사역마 능력을 지닙니다.

name: Shizuru - Minor Boon

description.value:
Your attacks help eradicate darkness.

When you successfully Strike a foe, your weapon glows with bright light out to 60 feet for 1 minute. This is a light effect with a counteract rank equal to half your level rounded up.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.boons-and-curses.Item.i8hVCNQTBFPJ1qEG]{Effect: Shizuru's Light}

_desc_en:
Your attacks help eradicate darkness.

When you successfully Strike a foe, your weapon glows with bright light out to 60 feet for 1 minute. This is a light effect with a counteract rank equal to half your level rounded up.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.boons-and-curses.Item.i8hVCNQTBFPJ1qEG]{Effect: Shizuru's Light}
_desc_ko:
당신의 공격이 어둠을 몰아내는 데 도움을 줍니다.

당신이 적을 성공적으로 타격하면, 당신의 무기가 1분 동안 60피트까지 밝은 빛으로 빛납니다. 이것은 당신의 레벨 절반을 올림한 값과 동일한 상쇄 랭크를 지닌 빛 효과입니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.boons-and-curses.Item.i8hVCNQTBFPJ1qEG]{효과: 시즈루의 빛}

name: Arazni - Minor Boon

description.value:
Once, when you fail a saving throw against an effect that would compel you to take some action against your will, you critically succeed instead.

Arazni typically grants this boon for consequential actions or particularly egregious violations of free will.

_desc_en:
Once, when you fail a saving throw against an effect that would compel you to take some action against your will, you critically succeed instead.

Arazni typically grants this boon for consequential actions or particularly egregious violations of free will.
_desc_ko:
한 번에 한해, 당신의 의지에 반하는 어떤 행동을 강제하려는 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 실패할 때, 대신 대성공한 것으로 처리합니다.

아라즈니는 대개 중대한 행동이나 특히 심각한 자유 의지 침해에 대해 이 축복을 내립니다.

name: Milani - Major Boon

description.value: You gain +4 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request} during attempts to satisfy one of Milani's edicts. Once per day, you can sound a battle cry that grants creatures within a @Template[emanation|distance:30] the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aqRYNoSvxsVfqglH]{Unfettered Movement} and affects all doors, locks, containers, and other bindings used to restrain or imprison others with the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6Ot4N22t5tPD51BO]{Knock} spell.

_desc_en: You gain +4 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request} during attempts to satisfy one of Milani's edicts. Once per day, you can sound a battle cry that grants creatures within a @Template[emanation|distance:30] the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aqRYNoSvxsVfqglH]{Unfettered Movement} and affects all doors, locks, containers, and other bindings used to restrain or imprison others with the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6Ot4N22t5tPD51BO]{Knock} spell.
_desc_ko: 당신은 밀라니의 계율 중 하나를 충족하려는 시도 중에 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{요청} 판정에 +4 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 하루에 한 번, 전투 함성을 지를 수 있으며, 이는 @Template[emanation|distance:30] 내의 크리처에게 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aqRYNoSvxsVfqglH]{자유로운 이동}의 효과를 부여하고, 타인을 억류하거나 가두는 데 사용된 모든 문, 자물쇠, 용기, 기타 결속물에 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6Ot4N22t5tPD51BO]{노크} 주문의 효과를 미칩니다.

name: Desna - Minor Boon

description.value:
For those at the end of a journey, Desna gifts a deep sleep.

Once, after you rest, you completely recover all Hit Points, remove all negative conditions, and become free of any curses or diseases.

_desc_en:
For those at the end of a journey, Desna gifts a deep sleep.

Once, after you rest, you completely recover all Hit Points, remove all negative conditions, and become free of any curses or diseases.
_desc_ko:
여정의 끝에 다다른 이들에게, 데스나는 깊은 잠을 선사합니다.

한 번에 한해, 휴식을 취한 뒤 당신은 모든 히트 포인트를 완전히 회복하고, 모든 부정적 상태를 제거하며, 어떤 저주나 질병으로부터도 자유로워집니다.

name: Cayden Cailean - Minor Boon

description.value:
Cayden Cailean helps you recover from nights of carousing.

While you still get drunk and otherwise experience the effects of alcohol normally, you are never hung over the next morning.

_desc_en:
Cayden Cailean helps you recover from nights of carousing.

While you still get drunk and otherwise experience the effects of alcohol normally, you are never hung over the next morning.
_desc_ko:
케이든 케일리언이 흥청망청 마신 밤에서 회복하도록 당신을 돕습니다.

당신은 여전히 취하고 그 외에도 술의 효과를 정상적으로 경험하지만, 다음 날 아침에는 결코 숙취에 시달리지 않습니다.

name: Shizuru - Minor Curse

description.value: Your equipment turns on you for a disgraceful act. The next time you make an attack, your weapon or armor gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} condition.

_desc_en: Your equipment turns on you for a disgraceful act. The next time you make an attack, your weapon or armor gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} condition.
_desc_ko: 당신의 장비가 수치스러운 행위에 대해 당신을 배신합니다. 당신이 다음번 공격을 할 때, 당신의 무기나 갑옷이 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{파손됨} 상태를 얻습니다.

name: Kazutal - Moderate Boon

description.value: You always seem to find safe shelter when you most need it. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GzdgM0m7wXKuFSho]{Rope Trick} as a divine innate spell.

_desc_en: You always seem to find safe shelter when you most need it. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GzdgM0m7wXKuFSho]{Rope Trick} as a divine innate spell.
_desc_ko: 당신은 가장 필요할 때 언제나 안전한 은신처를 찾아내는 것 같습니다. 하루에 한 번, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GzdgM0m7wXKuFSho]{밧줄 속임수}를 신성 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Gorum - Major Curse

description.value: You are unable to keep up with the rigors of combat. The moment a combat breaks out, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}. At the end of each of your turns, your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} condition increases by 1. These conditions end only when you are no longer in combat.

_desc_en: You are unable to keep up with the rigors of combat. The moment a combat breaks out, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}. At the end of each of your turns, your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} condition increases by 1. These conditions end only when you are no longer in combat.
_desc_ko: 당신은 전투의 격렬함을 따라갈 수 없습니다. 전투가 발발하는 순간, 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{피로}와 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{둔화 1} 상태가 됩니다. 당신의 각 턴이 끝날 때, 당신의 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{둔화} 상태가 1 증가합니다. 이러한 상태는 당신이 더 이상 전투 중이 아닐 때에만 끝납니다.

name: Nivi Rhombodazzle - Major Boon

description.value:
Those who have done much to please Nivi find themselves slipping from sight when needed.

Any time you attempt a Stealth check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}, you also gain the effects of 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aEM2cttJ2eYcLssW]{Fleet Step} spells to help you elude your enemies. These effects last until the end of your next turn or until you stop Hiding or Sneaking, whichever comes first (you can continue to Hide or Sneak, turn after turn, to extend these effects).

_desc_en:
Those who have done much to please Nivi find themselves slipping from sight when needed.

Any time you attempt a Stealth check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}, you also gain the effects of 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aEM2cttJ2eYcLssW]{Fleet Step} spells to help you elude your enemies. These effects last until the end of your next turn or until you stop Hiding or Sneaking, whichever comes first (you can continue to Hide or Sneak, turn after turn, to extend these effects).
_desc_ko:
니비를 흡족하게 하기 위해 많은 일을 한 자들은 필요할 때 시야에서 슬며시 사라집니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{숨기}나 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{은밀 이동}을 위한 은신 판정을 시도할 때마다, 당신은 적을 따돌리는 데 도움이 되도록 2랭크 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{투명화}와 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aEM2cttJ2eYcLssW]{신속한 걸음} 주문의 효과도 얻습니다. 이러한 효과는 당신의 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지, 또는 당신이 숨기나 은밀 이동을 멈출 때까지 중 먼저 오는 시점까지 지속됩니다(당신은 턴을 거듭하여 계속 숨기나 은밀 이동을 함으로써 이러한 효과를 연장할 수 있습니다).

name: Hei Feng - Moderate Curse

description.value: Your heart is as quick to change as Hei Feng's. If you roll a failure on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical failure instead.

_desc_en: Your heart is as quick to change as Hei Feng's. If you roll a failure on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical failure instead.
_desc_ko: 당신의 마음은 헤이펑의 마음만큼이나 쉽게 변합니다. 감정 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 실패를 굴리면, 대신 대실패로 처리됩니다.

name: Kazutal - Moderate Curse

description.value: Your strength betrays you, preventing you from taking more than your fair share. You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} and can't carry anything beyond the gear you are actively wearing or using.

_desc_en: Your strength betrays you, preventing you from taking more than your fair share. You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} and can't carry anything beyond the gear you are actively wearing or using.
_desc_ko: 당신의 힘이 당신을 배신하여, 당신이 정당한 몫 이상을 취하지 못하게 막습니다. 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{약화됨 2} 상태이며, 당신이 실제로 착용하거나 사용 중인 장비 외에는 아무것도 지닐 수 없습니다.

name: Hei Feng - Moderate Boon

description.value: Fair winds and currents speed your passage. Any vessel you use to travel over the sea gains a +10-foot status bonus to its Speeds.

_desc_en: Fair winds and currents speed your passage. Any vessel you use to travel over the sea gains a +10-foot status bonus to its Speeds.
_desc_ko: 순풍과 순조로운 해류가 당신의 항로를 재촉합니다. 당신이 바다를 건너기 위해 사용하는 모든 선박은 이동력에 +10피트 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Urgathoa - Moderate Boon

description.value: Urgathoa blesses you as one of her children. You gain void healing.

_desc_en: Urgathoa blesses you as one of her children. You gain void healing.
_desc_ko: 우르가토아가 당신을 자신의 자식 중 하나로 축복합니다. 당신은 공허 치유를 얻습니다.

name: Grandmother Spider - Major Curse

description.value: Grandmother Spider throws all of her might behind the underdog. Any time a creature with a level lower than yours rolls a success on a check against you, it critically succeeds instead; any time you roll a failure on a check against a creature with a level lower than yours, you critically fail instead.

_desc_en: Grandmother Spider throws all of her might behind the underdog. Any time a creature with a level lower than yours rolls a success on a check against you, it critically succeeds instead; any time you roll a failure on a check against a creature with a level lower than yours, you critically fail instead.
_desc_ko: 할머니 거미는 자신의 모든 힘을 약자 편에 실어 줍니다. 당신보다 낮은 레벨의 크리처가 당신을 상대로 한 판정에서 성공을 굴릴 때마다, 대신 대성공으로 처리됩니다. 당신보다 낮은 레벨의 크리처를 상대로 한 판정에서 당신이 실패를 굴릴 때마다, 대신 대실패로 처리됩니다.

name: Chaldira - Minor Boon

description.value: Once, you can choose the result of the next ordinary coin you flip or ordinary die you roll. If this ability is used for personal gain at the expense of someone innocent or less fortunate, Chaldira levies her moderate curse on you as punishment.

_desc_en: Once, you can choose the result of the next ordinary coin you flip or ordinary die you roll. If this ability is used for personal gain at the expense of someone innocent or less fortunate, Chaldira levies her moderate curse on you as punishment.
_desc_ko: 한 번, 당신이 다음번에 던지는 평범한 동전이나 굴리는 평범한 주사위의 결과를 당신이 선택할 수 있다. 이 능력을 무고하거나 불운한 이의 희생을 대가로 사적인 이익을 위해 사용한다면, 챌디라는 벌로서 당신에게 중급 저주를 내린다.

name: Abadar - Minor Curse

description.value: Any time you steal, illegally harm or kill another creature, or undermine a law-abiding officer or court, a symbol or word describing your crime appears on a visible spot on your skin. This symbol cannot be removed or hidden with makeup (though it can be covered with clothing) and it doesn't vanish until you make legal restitution for the crime, such as by serving your sentence.

_desc_en: Any time you steal, illegally harm or kill another creature, or undermine a law-abiding officer or court, a symbol or word describing your crime appears on a visible spot on your skin. This symbol cannot be removed or hidden with makeup (though it can be covered with clothing) and it doesn't vanish until you make legal restitution for the crime, such as by serving your sentence.
_desc_ko: 당신이 다른 생물을 훔치거나, 불법으로 해치거나 죽이거나, 준법 관리나 법정을 훼방할 때마다, 당신의 범죄를 묘사하는 상징이나 단어가 당신 피부의 눈에 띄는 곳에 나타난다. 이 상징은 화장으로 제거하거나 감출 수 없으며(옷으로 가릴 수는 있다), 형기를 복역하는 등 그 범죄에 대해 합법적으로 배상하기 전까지는 사라지지 않는다.

name: Gorum - Minor Curse

description.value: Gorum rewards cowardice with frailty. Any armor you wear and shield you wield reduces its item bonus to AC by 2 (minimum 0) and its Hardness, Hit Points, and Break Threshold by half.

_desc_en: Gorum rewards cowardice with frailty. Any armor you wear and shield you wield reduces its item bonus to AC by 2 (minimum 0) and its Hardness, Hit Points, and Break Threshold by half.
_desc_ko: 고룸은 비겁함을 나약함으로 보답한다. 당신이 착용한 갑옷과 든 방패는 AC에 주는 아이템 보너스가 2 감소하며(최소 0), 경도, 체력, 파괴 한계치가 절반으로 줄어든다.

name: Milani - Moderate Boon

description.value: When you use it to protect others, your shield blooms with roses brimming with razor-sharp thorns. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.5vXc2s2siR1ihpBT]{Shield Warden (Fighter)} feat, even if you don't meet its prerequisites. If you already had that feat, if your shield takes damage from a melee Strike in defense of your ally, the attacker takes piercing damage equal to half the shield's Hardness.

_desc_en: When you use it to protect others, your shield blooms with roses brimming with razor-sharp thorns. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.5vXc2s2siR1ihpBT]{Shield Warden (Fighter)} feat, even if you don't meet its prerequisites. If you already had that feat, if your shield takes damage from a melee Strike in defense of your ally, the attacker takes piercing damage equal to half the shield's Hardness.
_desc_ko: 당신이 다른 이들을 보호하기 위해 방패를 사용할 때, 방패에 면도날처럼 날카로운 가시로 뒤덮인 장미가 피어난다. 당신은 전제 조건을 충족하지 않더라도 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.5vXc2s2siR1ihpBT]{방패 수호자(전사)} 재주를 얻는다. 이미 그 재주를 가지고 있었다면, 아군을 방어하다가 당신의 방패가 근접 타격으로 피해를 입을 때 공격자는 방패 경도의 절반에 해당하는 관통 피해를 받는다.

name: Abadar - Major Curse

description.value: You become honest to a fault. You constantly suffer the critical failure effect of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aewxsale5xWEPKLk]{Ring of Truth}. Additionally, you are always offered the worst possible option in a bargain.

_desc_en: You become honest to a fault. You constantly suffer the critical failure effect of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aewxsale5xWEPKLk]{Ring of Truth}. Additionally, you are always offered the worst possible option in a bargain.
_desc_ko: 당신은 지나칠 정도로 정직해진다. 당신은 항상 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aewxsale5xWEPKLk]{진실의 고리}의 대실패 효과를 겪는다. 게다가 당신은 흥정에서 언제나 최악의 선택지를 제안받는다.

name: Tsukiyo - Moderate Curse

description.value: If Tsukiyo is particularly offended by someone, they may find themselves lost in delusions of moonlight. When attempting to navigate or find something at night, if you roll a success or critical success on your Perception check, Survival check, or other check to do so, you get a failure instead.

_desc_en: If Tsukiyo is particularly offended by someone, they may find themselves lost in delusions of moonlight. When attempting to navigate or find something at night, if you roll a success or critical success on your Perception check, Survival check, or other check to do so, you get a failure instead.
_desc_ko: 츠키요가 누군가에게 특히 기분이 상했다면, 그자는 달빛의 망상 속에서 길을 잃을 수 있다. 밤에 길을 찾거나 무언가를 찾으려 시도할 때, 이를 위한 지각 판정, 생존 판정, 또는 그 밖의 판정에서 성공이나 대성공을 굴리면 대신 실패한 것으로 처리한다.

name: Pharasma - Minor Curse

description.value: Horrifying or enticing visions of your final judgment distract you from the task at hand. You take a -2 status penalty to initiative rolls.

_desc_en: Horrifying or enticing visions of your final judgment distract you from the task at hand. You take a -2 status penalty to initiative rolls.
_desc_ko: 당신의 최후 심판에 대한 끔찍하거나 매혹적인 환영이 눈앞의 과업에서 당신의 주의를 흐트러뜨린다. 당신은 우선권 굴림에 -2 상태 페널티를 받는다.

name: Rovagug - Major Curse

description.value:
You are useful only as a beacon of destruction.

You are permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, rampaging against anything and everything in your sight, and you deal an additional 18 damage with your unarmed and weapon Strikes.

_desc_en:
You are useful only as a beacon of destruction.

You are permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, rampaging against anything and everything in your sight, and you deal an additional 18 damage with your unarmed and weapon Strikes.
_desc_ko:
당신은 오직 파괴의 봉화로서만 쓸모가 있다.

당신은 영구히 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{혼란} 상태가 되어 시야에 보이는 모든 것에 대고 날뛰며, 비무장 타격과 무기 타격으로 추가로 18의 피해를 입힌다.

name: Cayden Cailean - Major Curse

description.value:
Cayden curses you to suffer in the presence of drinking, making it hard for you to bear entering any tavern.

Whenever any creature drinks alcohol within 100 feet of you, you suffer all negative effects from the alcohol (but only the alcohol) instead. This doesn't apply if the creature gains any special effect from drinking alcohol.

_desc_en:
Cayden curses you to suffer in the presence of drinking, making it hard for you to bear entering any tavern.

Whenever any creature drinks alcohol within 100 feet of you, you suffer all negative effects from the alcohol (but only the alcohol) instead. This doesn't apply if the creature gains any special effect from drinking alcohol.
_desc_ko:
케이든은 당신이 음주하는 자리에서 고통받도록 저주를 내려, 당신이 어떤 선술집에도 들어가기 힘들게 만든다.

당신으로부터 100피트 이내에서 어떤 생물이 술을 마실 때마다, 대신 당신이 그 술(오직 술)로 인한 모든 부정적 효과를 겪는다. 그 생물이 음주로부터 특별한 효과를 얻는 경우에는 적용되지 않는다.

name: Zon-Kuthon - Moderate Boon

description.value:
Each morning, during your daily preparations, scars gather into words on your flesh.

The scars function as a scroll of a divine spell of Zon-Kuthon's choosing.

After you use the scroll or receive magical healing, the boon fades for the day, though some or all of the scars might remain as a reminder.

_desc_en:
Each morning, during your daily preparations, scars gather into words on your flesh.

The scars function as a scroll of a divine spell of Zon-Kuthon's choosing.

After you use the scroll or receive magical healing, the boon fades for the day, though some or all of the scars might remain as a reminder.
_desc_ko:
매일 아침 일과 준비를 하는 동안, 흉터가 당신의 살갗에 모여 단어를 이룬다.

그 흉터는 존쿠손이 선택한 신성 주문의 두루마리처럼 작동한다.

당신이 그 두루마리를 사용하거나 마법 치유를 받고 나면 그날의 은총은 사라지지만, 흉터 중 일부 또는 전부가 기억처럼 남아 있을 수 있다.

name: Kurgess - Major Curse

description.value: The wrath of Kurgess withers you almost to nothing. You are permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 4}.

_desc_en: The wrath of Kurgess withers you almost to nothing. You are permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 4}.
_desc_ko: 쿠르게스의 분노가 당신을 거의 아무것도 아닌 존재로 시들게 한다. 당신은 영구히 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{생명력 고갈 2}이자 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{약화됨 4} 상태가 된다.

name: Groetus - Minor Curse

description.value: Whenever you are illuminated by a light source other than natural sunlight, your head appears to be a bare skull. The DC for your recovery checks is 12 + your dying value, rather than 10 + your dying value, and you don't benefit from effects that reduce the DC, such as from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.AmP0qu7c5dlBSath]{Toughness} feat.

_desc_en: Whenever you are illuminated by a light source other than natural sunlight, your head appears to be a bare skull. The DC for your recovery checks is 12 + your dying value, rather than 10 + your dying value, and you don't benefit from effects that reduce the DC, such as from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.AmP0qu7c5dlBSath]{Toughness} feat.
_desc_ko: 자연 햇빛이 아닌 광원에 비춰질 때마다, 당신의 머리는 앙상한 해골처럼 보인다. 당신의 회복 판정 DC는 10 + 빈사 수치가 아니라 12 + 빈사 수치이며, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.AmP0qu7c5dlBSath]{강인함} 재주 등 DC를 낮추는 효과의 혜택을 받지 못한다.

name: Sarenrae - Moderate Boon

description.value: Your blade burns the irredeemable. Your attacks deal an additional 1d6 fire damage that ignores fire resistance.

_desc_en: Your blade burns the irredeemable. Your attacks deal an additional 1d6 fire damage that ignores fire resistance.
_desc_ko: 당신의 칼날이 구제 불가능한 자들을 불태운다. 당신의 공격은 화염 저항을 무시하는 추가 1d6 화염 피해를 입힌다.

name: Zon-Kuthon - Major Curse

description.value:
Zon-Kuthon steals away your joy, leaving you with only pain.

You lose that which you cherish the most forever, and lose the ability to feel joy. You can't gain benefits from emotion effects based on positive emotions.

If Zon-Kuthon feels you are ready to renounce, destroy, mutilate, or torture that which you once cherished most, he might return it to you to allow you to do so.

_desc_en:
Zon-Kuthon steals away your joy, leaving you with only pain.

You lose that which you cherish the most forever, and lose the ability to feel joy. You can't gain benefits from emotion effects based on positive emotions.

If Zon-Kuthon feels you are ready to renounce, destroy, mutilate, or torture that which you once cherished most, he might return it to you to allow you to do so.
_desc_ko:
존쿠손이 당신의 기쁨을 앗아가, 오직 고통만을 남긴다.

당신은 가장 아끼는 것을 영원히 잃고, 기쁨을 느끼는 능력을 잃는다. 당신은 긍정적 감정에 기반한 감정 효과로부터 혜택을 얻을 수 없다.

당신이 한때 가장 아끼던 것을 버리거나, 파괴하거나, 훼손하거나, 고문할 준비가 되었다고 존쿠손이 느끼면, 그는 당신이 그렇게 할 수 있도록 그것을 당신에게 돌려줄 수도 있다.

name: Kazutal - Major Boon

description.value:
Kazutal smiles upon those who seek to offer aid, no matter how meek or helpless they may be.

Any time creatures attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} you, they can choose to automatically succeed. If a creature chooses to roll for the attempt and rolls a success, it gets a critical success instead, granting a +4 circumstance bonus even if it doesn't have legendary proficiency in that skill. You gain the same benefits when you attempt to Aid others.

_desc_en:
Kazutal smiles upon those who seek to offer aid, no matter how meek or helpless they may be.

Any time creatures attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} you, they can choose to automatically succeed. If a creature chooses to roll for the attempt and rolls a success, it gets a critical success instead, granting a +4 circumstance bonus even if it doesn't have legendary proficiency in that skill. You gain the same benefits when you attempt to Aid others.
_desc_ko:
카주탈은 아무리 미약하거나 무력할지라도 도움을 베풀고자 하는 이들에게 미소 짓는다.

생물들이 당신을 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{지원}하기 위해 판정을 시도할 때마다, 그들은 자동으로 성공하기를 선택할 수 있다. 생물이 시도를 굴리기로 선택하여 성공을 굴리면, 대신 대성공을 거두어 그 기술에 전설 숙련도가 없더라도 +4 상황 보너스를 받는다. 당신이 다른 이들을 지원하려 시도할 때도 같은 혜택을 얻는다.

name: Pharasma - Major Boon

description.value:
Pharasma keeps you alive to fulfill your fate.
