The GM secretly chooses a fate Pharasma knows you must fulfill. Until you fulfill this fate, any time you would die, a grave but nonfatal misfortune instead befalls you.

You take at least a full day to recuperate and you potentially face permanent consequences, but you don't die. If you would have died even once without this boon, once your fate is complete, you let out a final sigh and then die peacefully.

_desc_en:
Pharasma keeps you alive to fulfill your fate.

The GM secretly chooses a fate Pharasma knows you must fulfill. Until you fulfill this fate, any time you would die, a grave but nonfatal misfortune instead befalls you.

You take at least a full day to recuperate and you potentially face permanent consequences, but you don't die. If you would have died even once without this boon, once your fate is complete, you let out a final sigh and then die peacefully.
_desc_ko:
파라스마는 당신이 운명을 완수하도록 당신을 살려둔다.

GM은 파라스마가 당신이 반드시 완수해야 함을 아는 운명을 은밀히 선택한다. 이 운명을 완수하기 전까지, 당신이 죽게 될 때마다 대신 치명적이지는 않으나 심각한 불운이 당신에게 닥친다.

당신은 회복하는 데 최소 하루가 온전히 걸리며 영구적인 대가를 치를 가능성도 있지만, 죽지는 않는다. 이 은총이 없었다면 단 한 번이라도 죽었을 상황이었다면, 당신의 운명이 완수된 순간 당신은 마지막 한숨을 내쉬고 평온히 죽는다.

name: Kurgess - Minor Curse

description.value: Difficulty lifting burdens is a sign of divine disapproval. Your maximum and encumbered Bulk limits decrease by 2.

_desc_en: Difficulty lifting burdens is a sign of divine disapproval. Your maximum and encumbered Bulk limits decrease by 2.
_desc_ko: 짐을 들어 올리는 데 어려움을 겪는 것은 신의 못마땅함을 나타내는 징표다. 당신의 최대 및 과적 부피 한계가 2 감소한다.

name: Desna - Minor Curse

description.value:
You always seem to lose your way or have strange mishaps on the road that delay your travel.

You (and thus any group that travels with you) travel at only 3/4 normal exploration Speed, before taking into account the terrain and other features that might slow you down further.

_desc_en:
You always seem to lose your way or have strange mishaps on the road that delay your travel.

You (and thus any group that travels with you) travel at only 3/4 normal exploration Speed, before taking into account the terrain and other features that might slow you down further.
_desc_ko:
당신은 언제나 길을 잃거나 이동을 지연시키는 이상한 사고를 당하는 것처럼 보인다.

당신은(따라서 당신과 함께 이동하는 모든 무리도) 지형이나 그 밖에 당신을 더 느리게 만들 수 있는 요소를 고려하기 전 기준으로, 평상시 탐험 이동속도의 3/4로만 이동한다.

name: Sarenrae - Moderate Curse

description.value:
The sun shines its light on everything you say.

You become unable to tell @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lies}, and if you attempt to do so, you instead compulsively blurt out the truth on the matter in question. You are still able to withhold information or lie by omission.

_desc_en:
The sun shines its light on everything you say.

You become unable to tell @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lies}, and if you attempt to do so, you instead compulsively blurt out the truth on the matter in question. You are still able to withhold information or lie by omission.
_desc_ko:
태양이 당신이 하는 모든 말에 빛을 비춘다.

당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{거짓말}을 할 수 없게 되며, 그렇게 하려 시도하면 대신 해당 사안에 대한 진실을 강박적으로 불쑥 내뱉는다. 당신은 여전히 정보를 숨기거나 침묵으로써 거짓말을 할 수는 있다.

name: Sarenrae - Minor Curse

description.value: The sun burns you for your transgression. You receive a sunburn that causes you to become permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}.

_desc_en: The sun burns you for your transgression. You receive a sunburn that causes you to become permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}.
_desc_ko: 태양이 당신의 죄를 벌하여 당신을 불태운다. 당신은 화상을 입어 영구히 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{둔함 1} 상태가 된다.

name: Sivanah - Major Boon

description.value:
You spread your illusions over a larger area.

You can designate an area to permanently gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HBJPsonQnWcC3qdX]{Mirage}. All creatures within this area gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise}, changing their forms as you wish. You can designate a new area as a 1-minute activity, but doing so dismisses any previously designated areas.

_desc_en:
You spread your illusions over a larger area.

You can designate an area to permanently gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HBJPsonQnWcC3qdX]{Mirage}. All creatures within this area gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise}, changing their forms as you wish. You can designate a new area as a 1-minute activity, but doing so dismisses any previously designated areas.
_desc_ko:
당신은 자신의 환영을 더 넓은 범위에 펼친다.

당신은 한 범위를 지정하여 영구히 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HBJPsonQnWcC3qdX]{신기루}의 효과를 얻게 할 수 있다. 이 범위 안의 모든 생물은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{환영 변장}의 효과를 얻어, 당신이 원하는 대로 그 모습이 바뀐다. 당신은 1분 활동으로 새 범위를 지정할 수 있지만, 그렇게 하면 이전에 지정한 모든 범위가 해제된다.

name: Groetus - Major Boon

description.value:
Your touch unravels things that have survived past their appointed time, according to Groetus's reckoning.

Such a creature or object takes @Damage[10d6[void]] damage each round you continue touching it; the damage ignores all Hardness and is capable of destroying nonliving objects, creatures immune to void effects, and even undead or other creatures with void healing. This boon might even be able to destroy some artifacts that have survived past their time.

_desc_en:
Your touch unravels things that have survived past their appointed time, according to Groetus's reckoning.

Such a creature or object takes @Damage[10d6[void]] damage each round you continue touching it; the damage ignores all Hardness and is capable of destroying nonliving objects, creatures immune to void effects, and even undead or other creatures with void healing. This boon might even be able to destroy some artifacts that have survived past their time.
_desc_ko:
그로에투스의 셈에 따라 정해진 때를 넘겨 살아남은 것들을 당신의 손길이 풀어헤친다.

그러한 생물이나 물체는 당신이 계속 접촉하는 매 라운드마다 @Damage[10d6[void]] 피해를 받는다. 이 피해는 모든 경도를 무시하며, 무생물, 공허 효과에 면역인 생물, 심지어 언데드나 그 밖에 공허 치유를 받는 생물조차 파괴할 수 있다. 이 은총은 정해진 때를 넘겨 살아남은 일부 유물조차 파괴할 수 있을지도 모른다.

name: Norgorber - Minor Curse

description.value:
Norgorber allows thieves to get the better of you.

Whenever you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income}, you earn money as if the task were 2 levels lower due to theft, loss, or bad fortune.

_desc_en:
Norgorber allows thieves to get the better of you.

Whenever you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income}, you earn money as if the task were 2 levels lower due to theft, loss, or bad fortune.
_desc_ko:
노르고르베르는 도둑들이 당신을 앞지르게 한다.

당신이 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{수입 획득}을 할 때마다, 절도, 손실, 불운으로 인해 그 과업이 2레벨 낮은 것처럼 돈을 번다.

name: Lamashtu - Major Boon

description.value:
Lamashtu uses your body to birth a new monster, regardless of your gender.

Once per day, you can spend 1 minute to birth a monster determined by the GM, which rips its way from your belly. The monster's level is up to your level and it does as it pleases, following Lamashtu's will, though it doesn't attack you unless you have lost her favor. You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3} from the ordeal.

_desc_en:
Lamashtu uses your body to birth a new monster, regardless of your gender.

Once per day, you can spend 1 minute to birth a monster determined by the GM, which rips its way from your belly. The monster's level is up to your level and it does as it pleases, following Lamashtu's will, though it doesn't attack you unless you have lost her favor. You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3} from the ordeal.
_desc_ko:
라마쉬투는 당신의 성별과 관계없이 당신의 몸을 이용해 새로운 괴물을 낳는다.

하루에 한 번, 당신은 1분을 들여 GM이 정한 괴물을 낳을 수 있으며, 그 괴물은 당신의 배를 찢고 나온다. 괴물의 레벨은 당신의 레벨까지이며, 라마쉬투의 뜻을 따르되 자신이 원하는 대로 행동한다. 다만 당신이 그녀의 총애를 잃지 않는 한 당신을 공격하지는 않는다. 이 시련으로 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{생명력 고갈 3} 상태가 된다.

name: Brigh - Major Boon

description.value: You gain the companionship of a loyal construct ally of Brigh's choice at least 1 level lower than you. If the construct is destroyed, it rebuilds itself over the course of a week, and as you gain levels, the construct upgrades and improves itself, becoming more powerful.

_desc_en: You gain the companionship of a loyal construct ally of Brigh's choice at least 1 level lower than you. If the construct is destroyed, it rebuilds itself over the course of a week, and as you gain levels, the construct upgrades and improves itself, becoming more powerful.
_desc_ko: 당신은 브리가 선택한, 당신보다 최소 1레벨 낮은 충직한 구조물 아군의 동행을 얻는다. 이 구조물이 파괴되면 일주일에 걸쳐 스스로 재건되며, 당신이 레벨을 올림에 따라 구조물도 스스로를 개량하고 향상시켜 더 강력해진다.

name: Kazutal - Major Curse

description.value: You are cursed to depend upon others for your survival. You can't eat anything, drink anything, or use any gear or magic items unless they were willingly given to you by someone who rightfully owns them. Work-arounds like having an ally strip the gear from someone's corpse and then give it to you willingly automatically fail.

_desc_en: You are cursed to depend upon others for your survival. You can't eat anything, drink anything, or use any gear or magic items unless they were willingly given to you by someone who rightfully owns them. Work-arounds like having an ally strip the gear from someone's corpse and then give it to you willingly automatically fail.
_desc_ko: 당신은 생존을 위해 타인에게 의존하도록 저주받았다. 당신은 정당한 소유자가 기꺼이 건네준 것이 아니면 아무것도 먹거나 마시거나, 어떤 장비나 마법 아이템도 사용할 수 없다. 아군이 시체에서 장비를 벗겨내 당신에게 기꺼이 건네주게 하는 식의 편법은 자동으로 실패한다.

name: Gozreh - Minor Curse

description.value: Lightning begins to strike twice. You gain weakness 5 to electricity, and any natural or magical bolts of lightning always target you rather than the other creatures around you.

_desc_en: Lightning begins to strike twice. You gain weakness 5 to electricity, and any natural or magical bolts of lightning always target you rather than the other creatures around you.
_desc_ko: 번개가 두 번 내리치기 시작한다. 당신은 전기에 약점 5를 얻으며, 자연적이거나 마법적인 번개는 언제나 주변의 다른 생물이 아닌 당신을 향한다.

name: Urgathoa - Minor Curse

description.value:
You must overindulge or partake in forbidden feasts before you find yourself even remotely sated.

You need to eat 20 times as much food as normal to avoid starvation, though you always feel hungry regardless of how much you eat.

If you dine on the flesh and blood of sapient creatures, you need to eat only the normal amount of such meals and your hunger abates.

_desc_en:
You must overindulge or partake in forbidden feasts before you find yourself even remotely sated.

You need to eat 20 times as much food as normal to avoid starvation, though you always feel hungry regardless of how much you eat.

If you dine on the flesh and blood of sapient creatures, you need to eat only the normal amount of such meals and your hunger abates.
_desc_ko:
당신은 조금이라도 포만감을 느끼려면 과도하게 탐닉하거나 금기시된 연회에 빠져들어야 한다.

당신은 굶주림을 피하기 위해 평소의 20배에 달하는 음식을 먹어야 하지만, 아무리 많이 먹어도 언제나 배고픔을 느낀다.

당신이 지각 있는 생물의 살과 피를 먹는다면, 그런 식사는 평소만큼만 먹으면 되고 굶주림이 가라앉는다.

name: Tsukiyo - Major Boon

description.value:
Tsukiyo shares some of his own nature and can lead a favored soul back along the same path he has walked.

The next time you would die, you are instead instantly restored to full health and lose any negative conditions you have.

_desc_en:
Tsukiyo shares some of his own nature and can lead a favored soul back along the same path he has walked.

The next time you would die, you are instead instantly restored to full health and lose any negative conditions you have.
_desc_ko:
츠키요는 자기 본성의 일부를 나누어, 총애하는 영혼을 자신이 걸어온 것과 같은 길로 다시 이끌 수 있다.

당신이 다음번에 죽게 될 때, 대신 즉시 완전한 건강 상태로 회복되며 지니고 있던 모든 부정적 조건을 잃는다.

name: Kurgess - Moderate Boon

description.value: You fear no exertion. You can employ exploration tactics normally while @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.

_desc_en: You fear no exertion. You can employ exploration tactics normally while @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.
_desc_ko: 당신은 어떤 노고도 두려워하지 않는다. 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{피로} 상태에서도 탐험 전술을 정상적으로 사용할 수 있다.

name: Gruhastha - Major Curse

description.value: The written word turns against you, blurring into illegibility. You are incapable of reading anything or making out symbols of any sort, including the words on scrolls, spellbooks, or magic items.

_desc_en: The written word turns against you, blurring into illegibility. You are incapable of reading anything or making out symbols of any sort, including the words on scrolls, spellbooks, or magic items.
_desc_ko: 글로 쓰인 말이 당신에게 등을 돌려, 흐릿하게 번져 읽을 수 없게 된다. 당신은 두루마리, 주문서, 마법 아이템에 적힌 글을 포함해 무엇도 읽거나 어떤 종류의 상징도 알아볼 수 없다.

name: Grandmother Spider - Moderate Curse

description.value: Grandmother Spider weaves a web to ensnare you, and you trail webs behind you wherever you go. You become permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and take a –10-foot circumstance penalty to your Speeds.

_desc_en: Grandmother Spider weaves a web to ensnare you, and you trail webs behind you wherever you go. You become permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and take a –10-foot circumstance penalty to your Speeds.
_desc_ko: 거미 할머니가 당신을 옭아매려 거미줄을 짜고, 당신은 가는 곳마다 뒤로 거미줄을 끌고 다닌다. 당신은 영구히 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{둔화 1} 상태가 되며 이동속도에 –10피트 상황 페널티를 받는다.

name: Gruhastha - Moderate Boon

description.value: The Keeper speeds your path toward learning new talents. You become permanently trained in two additional skills of your choice. Additionally, you can select a skill you are already trained in and permanently increase your proficiency rank in that skill, following the usual rules for skill increases.

_desc_en: The Keeper speeds your path toward learning new talents. You become permanently trained in two additional skills of your choice. Additionally, you can select a skill you are already trained in and permanently increase your proficiency rank in that skill, following the usual rules for skill increases.
_desc_ko: 수호자가 당신이 새로운 재능을 배우는 길을 재촉한다. 당신은 원하는 추가 기술 두 개에 영구히 숙련된다. 게다가 당신은 이미 숙련된 기술 하나를 선택하여, 기술 향상에 관한 통상 규칙에 따라 그 기술의 숙련도 등급을 영구히 올릴 수 있다.

name: Nocticula - Major Curse

description.value: You are exiled from companionship. You can't communicate with any other creature, nor can you feel other creatures' touch.

_desc_en: You are exiled from companionship. You can't communicate with any other creature, nor can you feel other creatures' touch.
_desc_ko: 당신은 벗과의 교류로부터 추방된다. 당신은 다른 어떤 생물과도 의사소통할 수 없으며, 다른 생물의 접촉을 느낄 수도 없다.

name: Cayden Cailean - Major Boon

description.value:
An embodiment of freedom, you break fetters with ease.

At the end of each of your turns, you can end one effect that is currently making you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} (including effects that make you immobilized by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbing} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restraining} you) as a free action.

_desc_en:
An embodiment of freedom, you break fetters with ease.

At the end of each of your turns, you can end one effect that is currently making you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} (including effects that make you immobilized by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbing} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restraining} you) as a free action.
_desc_ko:
자유의 화신으로서, 당신은 속박을 손쉽게 끊어낸다.

당신의 각 턴이 끝날 때, 당신을 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{이동 불가} 상태로 만들고 있는 효과(당신을 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{조이기}하거나 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{억제}하여 이동 불가로 만드는 효과 포함) 하나를 자유 행동으로 끝낼 수 있다.

name: Rovagug - Moderate Boon

description.value:
You can devour all. You mouth grows into a horrible circular, insectile maw of needle-like teeth.

You gain a bite unarmed attack that deals 1d8 piercing damage.

Additionally, you can stomach eating anything you can fit down your throat-even rocks or small objects.

You gain a +4 status bonus to saves resulting from eating something, such as diseases, poisons, or other effects of the ingested object. This doesn't allow you to digest magic items that would otherwise be difficult or impossible to destroy, such as cursed items or artifacts.

_desc_en:
You can devour all. You mouth grows into a horrible circular, insectile maw of needle-like teeth.

You gain a bite unarmed attack that deals 1d8 piercing damage.

Additionally, you can stomach eating anything you can fit down your throat-even rocks or small objects.

You gain a +4 status bonus to saves resulting from eating something, such as diseases, poisons, or other effects of the ingested object. This doesn't allow you to digest magic items that would otherwise be difficult or impossible to destroy, such as cursed items or artifacts.
_desc_ko:
당신은 모든 것을 집어삼킬 수 있다. 당신의 입은 바늘 같은 이빨이 늘어선 끔찍한 원형의 곤충 같은 아가리로 자라난다.

당신은 1d8 관통 피해를 입히는 물기 비무장 공격을 얻는다.

게다가 당신은 목구멍으로 넘길 수 있는 것이라면 바위나 작은 물체라도 삼켜서 소화할 수 있다.

당신은 질병, 독, 또는 그 밖에 삼킨 물체의 효과 등 무언가를 먹어서 발생하는 내성 굴림에 +4 상태 보너스를 얻는다. 이는 저주받은 아이템이나 유물처럼 파괴하기 어렵거나 불가능한 마법 아이템을 소화할 수 있게 해주지는 않는다.

name: Zon-Kuthon - Moderate Curse

description.value:
You share the pain of others, and even minor wounds bring you incredible pain.

Whenever you see (or otherwise sense) a creature take damage, you take @Damage[1d6[mental]] damage.

Whenever you take damage any other way than from the first part of this curse, you take 1d6 mental damage from increased pain and are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. Mental damage from this curse ignores any resistance you have to mental damage.

_desc_en:
You share the pain of others, and even minor wounds bring you incredible pain.

Whenever you see (or otherwise sense) a creature take damage, you take @Damage[1d6[mental]] damage.

Whenever you take damage any other way than from the first part of this curse, you take 1d6 mental damage from increased pain and are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. Mental damage from this curse ignores any resistance you have to mental damage.
_desc_ko:
당신은 타인의 고통을 함께 느끼며, 사소한 상처조차 당신에게 엄청난 고통을 가져온다.

당신이 어떤 생물이 피해를 받는 것을 보거나(또는 다른 방식으로 감지)할 때마다, 당신은 @Damage[1d6[mental]] 피해를 받는다.

당신이 이 저주의 첫 번째 부분 외의 다른 방식으로 피해를 받을 때마다, 당신은 커진 고통으로 인해 1d6 정신 피해를 받고 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{구역질 1} 상태가 된다. 이 저주로 인한 정신 피해는 당신이 가진 정신 피해에 대한 모든 저항을 무시한다.

name: Asmodeus - Moderate Boon

description.value: Your eyes glow red like embers and your skin takes on a crimson tone. You gain darkvision and fire resistance 5.

_desc_en: Your eyes glow red like embers and your skin takes on a crimson tone. You gain darkvision and fire resistance 5.
_desc_ko: 당신의 눈이 잉걸불처럼 붉게 빛나고 피부가 진홍빛을 띤다. 당신은 암시야와 화염 저항 5를 얻는다.

name: Alseta - Major Boon

description.value:
You transition unimpeded through the world.

You can open any door or portal simply by placing your palm upon it with a single Interact action, even if it's locked or magically sealed, and you can enter any open door or threshold, even if it's magically warded to prevent entry. This doesn't overcome the locks and magic of artifacts, deities, and similarly powerful effects.

_desc_en:
You transition unimpeded through the world.

You can open any door or portal simply by placing your palm upon it with a single Interact action, even if it's locked or magically sealed, and you can enter any open door or threshold, even if it's magically warded to prevent entry. This doesn't overcome the locks and magic of artifacts, deities, and similarly powerful effects.
_desc_ko:
당신은 세상을 거침없이 통과해 나아간다.

당신은 단 한 번의 상호작용 행동으로 손바닥을 대기만 하면, 잠겨 있거나 마법으로 봉인되어 있더라도 어떤 문이나 관문이든 열 수 있으며, 마법으로 진입을 막도록 방비되어 있더라도 열려 있는 문이나 문지방이라면 어디든 들어갈 수 있다. 이는 유물, 신, 그리고 그에 준하는 강력한 효과의 자물쇠와 마법은 극복하지 못한다.

name: Achaekek - Minor Boon

description.value:
Once, when you would fail a Stealth check, you critically succeed instead.

Achaekek typically grants this boon for an extremely consequential Stealth check that could lead to an assassination, such as one that could get you into position to kill an important target, but rarely on a Stealth check to help you escape.

_desc_en:
Once, when you would fail a Stealth check, you critically succeed instead.

Achaekek typically grants this boon for an extremely consequential Stealth check that could lead to an assassination, such as one that could get you into position to kill an important target, but rarely on a Stealth check to help you escape.
_desc_ko:
한 번, 당신이 은신 판정에 실패하게 될 때, 대신 대성공을 거둔다.

아카에케크는 보통 중요한 표적을 죽일 수 있는 위치를 잡게 해주는 판정처럼, 암살로 이어질 수 있는 극도로 중대한 은신 판정에 대해 이 은총을 내리며, 탈출을 돕기 위한 은신 판정에는 좀처럼 내리지 않는다.

name: Torag - Major Curse

description.value: You are forever cast out from your home. Members of your community have their attitudes towards you shift two steps worse, meaning those who used to be helpful are now indifferent, those who were friendly are now unfriendly, and all others are now hostile. This doesn't necessarily result in violence, but hostile community members generally seek your permanent exile.

_desc_en: You are forever cast out from your home. Members of your community have their attitudes towards you shift two steps worse, meaning those who used to be helpful are now indifferent, those who were friendly are now unfriendly, and all others are now hostile. This doesn't necessarily result in violence, but hostile community members generally seek your permanent exile.
_desc_ko: 당신은 영원히 고향에서 추방됩니다. 당신의 공동체 구성원들은 당신을 향한 태도가 두 단계 나빠지는데, 즉 당신을 돕던 이들은 이제 무관심하고, 우호적이던 이들은 이제 비우호적이며, 나머지 모두는 이제 적대적입니다. 이것이 반드시 폭력으로 이어지지는 않지만, 적대적인 공동체 구성원들은 대체로 당신을 영구히 추방하려 듭니다.

name: Rovagug - Major Boon

description.value:
You can crack the surface of Golarion, accelerating the release of the Rough Beast.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.FMjihpGLn9eQ14Gw]{Quaking Stomp} barbarian feat.

_desc_en:
You can crack the surface of Golarion, accelerating the release of the Rough Beast.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.FMjihpGLn9eQ14Gw]{Quaking Stomp} barbarian feat.
_desc_ko:
당신은 골라리온의 표면을 갈라 거친 야수의 해방을 앞당길 수 있습니다.

당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.FMjihpGLn9eQ14Gw]{지진 발구르기} 바바리안 재주를 얻습니다.

name: Alseta - Minor Boon

description.value:
Alseta's guiding hand aids your journeys.

Once, when employing teleportation magic, you appear exactly on target, even if you used a notoriously imprecise spell like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5bTt2CvYHPvaR7QQ]{Interplanar Teleport}.

Alseta typically grants this boon for extremely consequential magical travel, especially when time is of the essence.

_desc_en:
Alseta's guiding hand aids your journeys.

Once, when employing teleportation magic, you appear exactly on target, even if you used a notoriously imprecise spell like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5bTt2CvYHPvaR7QQ]{Interplanar Teleport}.

Alseta typically grants this boon for extremely consequential magical travel, especially when time is of the essence.
_desc_ko:
알세타의 인도하는 손길이 당신의 여정을 돕습니다.

순간이동 마법을 사용할 때, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5bTt2CvYHPvaR7QQ]{차원간 순간이동}처럼 부정확하기로 악명 높은 주문을 사용하더라도, 한 번은 목표 지점에 정확히 나타납니다.

알세타는 보통 극도로 중대한 마법적 이동에 대해, 특히 시간이 촉박할 때 이 은총을 내립니다.

name: Rovagug - Moderate Curse

description.value:
Your destructive rage seeks to remain unbound.

Any armor you wear automatically becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken}. Other items in your possession occasionally become broken over time.

_desc_en:
Your destructive rage seeks to remain unbound.

Any armor you wear automatically becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken}. Other items in your possession occasionally become broken over time.
_desc_ko:
당신의 파괴적 분노는 속박되지 않으려 합니다.

당신이 착용하는 모든 갑옷은 자동으로 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{파손됨} 상태가 됩니다. 당신이 소지한 다른 물품들도 시간이 지나면서 이따금 파손됩니다.

name: Ghlaunder - Major Boon

description.value:
Ghlaunder rewards his followers with the ability to safely spread illness—or on occasion, offers respite to desperate petitioners who please him.

You do not take negative effects from any disease you are infected with unless or until Ghlaunder rescinds this benefit.

_desc_en:
Ghlaunder rewards his followers with the ability to safely spread illness—or on occasion, offers respite to desperate petitioners who please him.

You do not take negative effects from any disease you are infected with unless or until Ghlaunder rescinds this benefit.
_desc_ko:
글라운더는 자신의 추종자에게 안전하게 질병을 퍼뜨리는 능력으로 보상하며, 때로는 자신을 기쁘게 한 절박한 청원자에게 유예를 베풀기도 합니다.

당신은 감염된 어떤 질병으로부터도 부정적인 효과를 받지 않으며, 이는 글라운더가 이 혜택을 거두어들일 때까지 지속됩니다.

name: Tsukiyo - Minor Boon

description.value:
Tsukiyo's simplest show of gratitude is a gift of clarity.

Once, when you roll a failure on a saving throw against a mental effect, you get a critical success instead.

Tsukiyo typically grants this boon against a particularly consequential mental effect.

_desc_en:
Tsukiyo's simplest show of gratitude is a gift of clarity.

Once, when you roll a failure on a saving throw against a mental effect, you get a critical success instead.

Tsukiyo typically grants this boon against a particularly consequential mental effect.
_desc_ko:
츠키요의 가장 소박한 감사의 표시는 명료함의 선물입니다.

한 번은 정신 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 실패를 굴렸을 때, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

츠키요는 보통 특히 중대한 정신 효과에 대해 이 은총을 내립니다.

name: Grandmother Spider - Major Boon

description.value:
Grandmother Spider rejoices in freedom and tricks those who would limit it.

Any time you would become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:10]. On a success, you ignore the effect, and the originator of the effect becomes grabbed, immobilized, or restrained instead. If this simply causes a creature to grab itself, it can usually @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} as a free action, but it might be stuck if it tried to immobilize you in other ways.

_desc_en:
Grandmother Spider rejoices in freedom and tricks those who would limit it.

Any time you would become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:10]. On a success, you ignore the effect, and the originator of the effect becomes grabbed, immobilized, or restrained instead. If this simply causes a creature to grab itself, it can usually @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} as a free action, but it might be stuck if it tried to immobilize you in other ways.
_desc_ko:
거미 할머니는 자유를 기뻐하며 자유를 제한하려는 자들을 속입니다.

당신이 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{조이기}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{이동 불가}, 또는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{억제} 상태가 되려 할 때마다, @Check[flat|dc:10]을 시도하십시오. 성공하면 당신은 그 효과를 무시하고, 대신 그 효과의 시전자가 조이기, 이동 불가, 또는 포박 상태가 됩니다. 이로 인해 단지 어떤 생물이 자기 자신을 붙잡게 되었다면, 그 생물은 보통 자유 행동으로 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{탈출}할 수 있지만, 다른 방식으로 당신을 이동 불가로 만들려 했다면 옴짝달싹 못하게 될 수도 있습니다.

name: Iomedae - Major Boon

description.value:
Iomedae imbues your blade with great power.

Longswords you wield gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.DH0kB9Wbr5pDeunX]{Holy} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.woxl2FrrgAcJDu0t]{Major Striking} runes while you hold them. These property runes count toward the number of runes you can have on your weapon, and if this would cause your weapon to exceed its limit, choose which ones to keep each day when you prepare.

You gain a +2 status bonus to attack rolls with longswords.

_desc_en:
Iomedae imbues your blade with great power.

Longswords you wield gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.DH0kB9Wbr5pDeunX]{Holy} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.woxl2FrrgAcJDu0t]{Major Striking} runes while you hold them. These property runes count toward the number of runes you can have on your weapon, and if this would cause your weapon to exceed its limit, choose which ones to keep each day when you prepare.

You gain a +2 status bonus to attack rolls with longswords.
_desc_ko:
이오메대가 당신의 검에 거대한 힘을 불어넣습니다.

당신이 쥐고 있는 롱소드는 그것을 쥐고 있는 동안 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.DH0kB9Wbr5pDeunX]{신성} 및 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.woxl2FrrgAcJDu0t]{대(大) 타격} 룬을 얻습니다. 이 속성 룬은 무기에 새길 수 있는 룬의 개수에 포함되며, 이로 인해 무기가 한계를 초과하게 된다면 매일 준비할 때 어느 것을 유지할지 선택하십시오.

당신은 롱소드로 하는 명중 굴림에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Sarenrae - Major Boon

description.value:
You are a voice of peace and rehabilitation.

When you roll a success at a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request} something, you get a critical success instead.

In addition, all creatures other than fiends, undead, and mindless creatures allow you one chance to speak your piece and make requests before entering combat. If you or an ally ever use the time from the request to gain an advantage in an ensuing combat (for example, by casting preparatory spells, positioning for combat, or waiting out your opponent's preparatory spells), Sarenrae immediately revokes this boon, or possibly curses your ally.

_desc_en:
You are a voice of peace and rehabilitation.

When you roll a success at a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request} something, you get a critical success instead.

In addition, all creatures other than fiends, undead, and mindless creatures allow you one chance to speak your piece and make requests before entering combat. If you or an ally ever use the time from the request to gain an advantage in an ensuing combat (for example, by casting preparatory spells, positioning for combat, or waiting out your opponent's preparatory spells), Sarenrae immediately revokes this boon, or possibly curses your ally.
_desc_ko:
당신은 평화와 갱생의 목소리입니다.

무언가를 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{요청}하는 판정에서 성공을 굴렸을 때, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

또한, 악마, 언데드, 지성 없는 생물을 제외한 모든 생물은 전투에 돌입하기 전에 당신이 할 말을 하고 요청할 기회를 한 번 허락합니다. 만약 당신이나 아군이 그 요청으로 얻은 시간을 이어지는 전투에서 유리함을 얻는 데 사용한다면(예를 들어 사전 준비 주문을 시전하거나, 전투를 위해 위치를 잡거나, 상대의 준비 주문이 끝나기를 기다리는 등), 사렌레이는 즉시 이 은총을 거두거나 어쩌면 당신의 아군에게 저주를 내립니다.

name: Asmodeus - Minor Curse

description.value: Asmodeus's flames burn you with great malice. You gain weakness 5 to fire.

_desc_en: Asmodeus's flames burn you with great malice. You gain weakness 5 to fire.
_desc_ko: 아스모데우스의 화염이 큰 악의로 당신을 태웁니다. 당신은 화염에 약점 5를 얻습니다.

name: Chaldira - Minor Curse

description.value: Any time you refuse a request made in good faith, you vomit up a frog, mouse, or other small animal. This deals no damage and causes no conditions, but is obvious to all bystanders.

_desc_en: Any time you refuse a request made in good faith, you vomit up a frog, mouse, or other small animal. This deals no damage and causes no conditions, but is obvious to all bystanders.
_desc_ko: 당신이 선의로 이루어진 요청을 거절할 때마다, 개구리, 생쥐, 또는 다른 작은 동물을 토해냅니다. 이는 피해를 주거나 어떤 상태도 일으키지 않지만, 곁에 있는 모든 이에게 명백히 보입니다.

name: Iomedae - Minor Boon

description.value:
You always present yourself at your best. Your clothing and person are always clean and unrumpled, the metal of your blade and armor shining and unblemished.

This doesn't prevent you from being exposed to diseases and other afflictions via filth, but it protects you as well as if you had washed thoroughly right away.

_desc_en:
You always present yourself at your best. Your clothing and person are always clean and unrumpled, the metal of your blade and armor shining and unblemished.

This doesn't prevent you from being exposed to diseases and other afflictions via filth, but it protects you as well as if you had washed thoroughly right away.
_desc_ko:
당신은 언제나 최상의 모습으로 자신을 드러냅니다. 당신의 옷과 몸은 항상 깨끗하고 구김 없으며, 검과 갑옷의 금속은 반짝이고 흠 하나 없습니다.

이것이 오물을 통해 질병이나 다른 재앙에 노출되는 것을 막아주지는 않지만, 마치 곧바로 철저히 씻은 것처럼 당신을 보호해 줍니다.

name: Urgathoa - Major Boon

description.value:
When you contract contagions, you experience fever dreams filled with insight.

Once afflicted with a disease, you gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qsNeG9KZpODSACMq]{Foresight} with yourself as the target until no longer afflicted with any disease.

_desc_en:
When you contract contagions, you experience fever dreams filled with insight.

Once afflicted with a disease, you gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qsNeG9KZpODSACMq]{Foresight} with yourself as the target until no longer afflicted with any disease.
_desc_ko:
당신이 전염병에 걸리면, 통찰로 가득 찬 열병 몽상을 겪습니다.

질병에 걸리면, 당신을 대상으로 한 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qsNeG9KZpODSACMq]{예지}의 효과를 얻으며, 이는 어떤 질병에도 더 이상 걸려 있지 않게 될 때까지 지속됩니다.

name: Torag - Minor Boon

description.value:
Torag repairs your equipment so you may continue your vigil.

Once, a shield, weapon, or other item you hold or are wearing recovers all of its Hit Points. The item's Hardness doubles for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.boons-and-curses.Item.HN5Fp1pNudfwzyx2]{Effect: Torag's Repairs}

Torag can grant this boon just as the item would have been destroyed, preventing the item's destruction.

Occasionally, he grants this boon to restore an item important to dwarven history that has already been fully destroyed.

_desc_en:
Torag repairs your equipment so you may continue your vigil.

Once, a shield, weapon, or other item you hold or are wearing recovers all of its Hit Points. The item's Hardness doubles for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.boons-and-curses.Item.HN5Fp1pNudfwzyx2]{Effect: Torag's Repairs}

Torag can grant this boon just as the item would have been destroyed, preventing the item's destruction.

Occasionally, he grants this boon to restore an item important to dwarven history that has already been fully destroyed.
_desc_ko:
토라그가 당신의 장비를 수리하여 당신이 경계를 이어갈 수 있게 합니다.

한 번은 당신이 쥐고 있거나 착용한 방패, 무기, 또는 다른 물품이 모든 히트 포인트를 회복합니다. 그 물품의 견고도는 1분 동안 두 배가 됩니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.boons-and-curses.Item.HN5Fp1pNudfwzyx2]{효과: 토라그의 수리}

토라그는 물품이 막 파괴되려는 바로 그 순간에 이 은총을 내려 물품의 파괴를 막을 수 있습니다.

이따금 그는 드워프 역사에 중요한, 이미 완전히 파괴된 물품을 되살리기 위해 이 은총을 내리기도 합니다.

name: Sarenrae - Minor Boon

description.value:
Your healing hands are blessed with a warm flame.

Once, when you heal another creature, instead of healing it for the normal amount, you heal the creature to full Hit Points, no matter how much damage it has taken.

Sarenrae typically grants this boon in extremely consequential circumstances.

_desc_en:
Your healing hands are blessed with a warm flame.

Once, when you heal another creature, instead of healing it for the normal amount, you heal the creature to full Hit Points, no matter how much damage it has taken.

Sarenrae typically grants this boon in extremely consequential circumstances.
_desc_ko:
당신의 치유의 손길은 따뜻한 불꽃으로 축복받았습니다.

한 번은 다른 생물을 치유할 때, 그 생물이 얼마나 많은 피해를 입었든 상관없이, 통상적인 양만큼 치유하는 대신 그 생물을 최대 히트 포인트까지 치유합니다.

사렌레이는 보통 극도로 중대한 상황에서 이 은총을 내립니다.

name: Achaekek - Major Boon

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.j1JE61quDxdge4mg]{Sneak Attack} rogue class feature, dealing 3d6 precision damage. If you already have that class feature, you increase your sneak attack damage by 3d6.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.j1JE61quDxdge4mg]{Sneak Attack} rogue class feature, dealing 3d6 precision damage. If you already have that class feature, you increase your sneak attack damage by 3d6.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.j1JE61quDxdge4mg]{기습 공격} 로그 클래스 특징을 얻어 3d6 정밀 피해를 입힙니다. 이미 그 클래스 특징을 가지고 있다면, 기습 공격 피해가 3d6만큼 증가합니다.

name: Urgathoa - Major Curse

description.value:
Urgathoa teaches you that pointless lives in slavery to death and morality are bound to end in tragedy.

You develop an incurable wasting disease that leaves you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}, and unable to move except by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Tj055UcNm6UEgtCg]{Crawling}. This disease never progresses further to kill you, but it passes to your friends and loved ones merely by sight, wasting them away unto death before your eyes and causing them to rise as undead to haunt you.

_desc_en:
Urgathoa teaches you that pointless lives in slavery to death and morality are bound to end in tragedy.

You develop an incurable wasting disease that leaves you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}, and unable to move except by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Tj055UcNm6UEgtCg]{Crawling}. This disease never progresses further to kill you, but it passes to your friends and loved ones merely by sight, wasting them away unto death before your eyes and causing them to rise as undead to haunt you.
_desc_ko:
우르가토아는 죽음과 도덕에 예속된 무의미한 삶이 비극으로 끝날 수밖에 없음을 당신에게 가르칩니다.

당신은 치유 불가능한 소모성 질병에 걸려 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{둔함 2}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{약화됨 2} 상태가 되고, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Tj055UcNm6UEgtCg]{기어가기}로만 이동할 수 있게 됩니다. 이 질병은 결코 더 진행되어 당신을 죽이지는 않지만, 단지 눈으로 보는 것만으로 당신의 친구와 사랑하는 이들에게 전염되어, 당신의 눈앞에서 그들을 죽음에 이르도록 시들게 하고 언데드로 일어나 당신을 괴롭히게 만듭니다.

name: Zon-Kuthon - Major Boon

description.value:
Shadows are deeper around you.

Darkvision and greater darkvision cannot penetrate darkness within 60 feet of you, but you can see through it normally.

_desc_en:
Shadows are deeper around you.

Darkvision and greater darkvision cannot penetrate darkness within 60 feet of you, but you can see through it normally.
_desc_ko:
당신 주위의 그림자가 더 깊어집니다.

암시야와 상급 암시야는 당신으로부터 60피트 이내의 어둠을 꿰뚫어 볼 수 없지만, 당신은 그 어둠을 정상적으로 볼 수 있습니다.

name: Cayden Cailean - Minor Curse

description.value: Individuals who raise Cayden's passing displeasure awake as if from a hard night of drinking and find that drink tastes foul.

_desc_en: Individuals who raise Cayden's passing displeasure awake as if from a hard night of drinking and find that drink tastes foul.
_desc_ko: 케이든의 순간적인 불쾌를 산 자들은 마치 밤새 진탕 마신 것처럼 깨어나며, 술맛이 역겹게 느껴집니다.

name: Irori - Minor Boon

description.value:
Irori grants you great insight and knowledge.

Once, when you roll a failure at a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, you get a critical success instead. Furthermore, the check loses the secret trait, so you know for sure that the result was a critical success.

Irori typically grants this boon for an extremely consequential check to Recall Knowledge.

_desc_en:
Irori grants you great insight and knowledge.

Once, when you roll a failure at a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, you get a critical success instead. Furthermore, the check loses the secret trait, so you know for sure that the result was a critical success.

Irori typically grants this boon for an extremely consequential check to Recall Knowledge.
_desc_ko:
이로리가 당신에게 큰 통찰과 지식을 내립니다.

한 번은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{지식 회상} 판정에서 실패를 굴렸을 때, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다. 나아가 그 판정은 은밀 특성을 잃으므로, 결과가 대성공이었음을 확실히 알 수 있습니다.

이로리는 보통 극도로 중대한 지식 회상 판정에 대해 이 은총을 내립니다.

name: Asmodeus - Minor Boon

description.value:
Pleased by your talent for manipulation, Asmodeus amplifies your skills.

Once, when you fail at the Diplomacy check to make a significant or consequential @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request}, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qwlh6aDgi86U3Q7H]{Suggestion} on the target of your Request, suggesting the same course of action. This is a divine innate spell.

_desc_en:
Pleased by your talent for manipulation, Asmodeus amplifies your skills.

Once, when you fail at the Diplomacy check to make a significant or consequential @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request}, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qwlh6aDgi86U3Q7H]{Suggestion} on the target of your Request, suggesting the same course of action. This is a divine innate spell.
_desc_ko:
당신의 조종 재능에 흡족해한 아스모데우스가 당신의 기술을 증폭시킵니다.

한 번은 중대하거나 중요한 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{요청}을 하기 위한 외교 판정에 실패했을 때, 당신은 요청의 대상에게 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qwlh6aDgi86U3Q7H]{암시}를 시전하여 동일한 행동을 제안할 수 있습니다. 이것은 신성 선천 주문입니다.

name: Calistria - Major Curse

description.value:
You have wronged those unable to obtain revenge for themselves, and Calistria's curse grants their revenge its own life.

Whenever another creature imagines vengeance upon you but can't pursue that vengeance because you are too powerful, well connected, or otherwise untouchable, a creature of roughly your level manifests out of their imagination and performs their desired revenge.

Once the revenge is complete or the manifestation is destroyed, the summoned creature vanishes from existence.

_desc_en:
You have wronged those unable to obtain revenge for themselves, and Calistria's curse grants their revenge its own life.

Whenever another creature imagines vengeance upon you but can't pursue that vengeance because you are too powerful, well connected, or otherwise untouchable, a creature of roughly your level manifests out of their imagination and performs their desired revenge.

Once the revenge is complete or the manifestation is destroyed, the summoned creature vanishes from existence.
_desc_ko:
당신은 스스로 복수할 수 없는 이들에게 잘못을 저질렀고, 칼리스트리아의 저주는 그들의 복수에 스스로의 생명을 부여합니다.

다른 생물이 당신에게 복수를 상상하지만 당신이 너무 강하거나, 연줄이 좋거나, 그 밖의 이유로 손댈 수 없어서 그 복수를 실행할 수 없을 때마다, 대략 당신 레벨의 생물이 그들의 상상에서 발현되어 그들이 바라던 복수를 실행합니다.

복수가 완료되거나 그 발현체가 파괴되면, 소환된 생물은 존재에서 사라집니다.

name: Abadar - Minor Boon

description.value:
Abadar warns his favored against those who might unfairly take advantage.

Once, when someone rolls a success on a Deception check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} maliciously to you and you alone, they get a critical failure instead.

Abadar typically chooses to grant this boon in response to an extremely consequential lie.

_desc_en:
Abadar warns his favored against those who might unfairly take advantage.

Once, when someone rolls a success on a Deception check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} maliciously to you and you alone, they get a critical failure instead.

Abadar typically chooses to grant this boon in response to an extremely consequential lie.
_desc_ko:
아바다르는 자신이 총애하는 이들에게 부당하게 이득을 취하려는 자들을 경고합니다.

한 번은 누군가가 오직 당신에게만 악의적으로 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{거짓말}하기 위한 기만 판정에서 성공을 굴렸을 때, 그들은 대신 대실패를 얻습니다.

아바다르는 보통 극도로 중대한 거짓말에 대응하여 이 은총을 내리기로 선택합니다.

name: Kurgess - Moderate Curse

description.value: Kurgess's displeasure breaks your competitive edge, causing you to fail at the cusp of success. If your check result exactly equals the DC, you fail instead of succeeding.

_desc_en: Kurgess's displeasure breaks your competitive edge, causing you to fail at the cusp of success. If your check result exactly equals the DC, you fail instead of succeeding.
_desc_ko: 쿠르게스의 불쾌가 당신의 경쟁적 예리함을 무너뜨려, 성공의 문턱에서 실패하게 만듭니다. 당신의 판정 결과가 DC와 정확히 같으면, 성공하는 대신 실패합니다.

name: Cayden Cailean - Moderate Boon

description.value:
You share some of the bravery Cayden espoused during his ascension.

When you roll a success on a saving throw against a fear effect, you get a critical success instead. If you have the fighter @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.GJKJafDGuX4BeAeN]{Bravery} class feature, when you roll a critical failure on a save against a fear effect, you get a failure instead.

_desc_en:
You share some of the bravery Cayden espoused during his ascension.

When you roll a success on a saving throw against a fear effect, you get a critical success instead. If you have the fighter @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.GJKJafDGuX4BeAeN]{Bravery} class feature, when you roll a critical failure on a save against a fear effect, you get a failure instead.
_desc_ko:
당신은 케이든이 승천 중에 보여준 용기의 일부를 나눠 받습니다.

공포 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴렸을 때, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다. 파이터 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.GJKJafDGuX4BeAeN]{용맹} 클래스 특징을 가지고 있다면, 공포 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 대실패를 굴렸을 때 대신 실패를 얻습니다.

name: Lamashtu - Moderate Curse

description.value:
Lamashtu marks you as prey.

Any creature with imprecise or better scent can smell you from 100 × the usual range of their scent and can't shake the feeling that you smell like prey, so they might attack you even if they would normally avoid attacking creatures of your ancestry.

This smell doesn't magically compel their action, and the scent of prey doesn't overcome a deeper bond such as that with an animal companion.

_desc_en:
Lamashtu marks you as prey.

Any creature with imprecise or better scent can smell you from 100 × the usual range of their scent and can't shake the feeling that you smell like prey, so they might attack you even if they would normally avoid attacking creatures of your ancestry.

This smell doesn't magically compel their action, and the scent of prey doesn't overcome a deeper bond such as that with an animal companion.
_desc_ko:
라마슈투가 당신을 사냥감으로 낙인찍습니다.

부정확 이상의 후각을 가진 생물은 평소 후각 범위의 100배 거리에서 당신의 냄새를 맡을 수 있으며, 당신이 사냥감 냄새를 풍긴다는 느낌을 떨칠 수 없어, 평소라면 당신 혈통의 생물을 공격하지 않을 생물이라도 당신을 공격할 수 있습니다.

이 냄새가 그들의 행동을 마법적으로 강제하지는 않으며, 사냥감의 냄새가 동물 동료와의 유대 같은 더 깊은 결속을 넘어서지는 못합니다.

name: Brigh - Minor Boon

description.value:
Knowledge floods your mind.

Once, you can reroll a failed skill check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}; you must use the second result, even if it's worse.

_desc_en:
Knowledge floods your mind.

Once, you can reroll a failed skill check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}; you must use the second result, even if it's worse.
_desc_ko:
지식이 당신의 정신에 밀려듭니다.

한 번은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{지식 회상} 기술 판정에 실패했을 때 다시 굴릴 수 있습니다. 두 번째 결과를 사용해야 하며, 더 나쁘더라도 그렇습니다.

name: Norgorber - Moderate Boon

description.value:
Your poisons are everlasting.

If your Strike with a poisoned weapon critically fails, or succeeds but fails to deal slashing or piercing damage, the poison is not spent. The poison is still spent once successfully applied to a creature.

_desc_en:
Your poisons are everlasting.

If your Strike with a poisoned weapon critically fails, or succeeds but fails to deal slashing or piercing damage, the poison is not spent. The poison is still spent once successfully applied to a creature.
_desc_ko:
당신의 독은 오래갑니다.

독 바른 무기로 하는 타격이 대실패하거나, 성공했지만 참격 또는 관통 피해를 입히지 못한 경우, 독은 소모되지 않습니다. 그 독은 생물에게 성공적으로 발린 경우에는 여전히 소모됩니다.

name: Sivanah - Minor Curse

description.value: Your hair becomes a wild variety of colors, which cannot be altered with mundane or magical means, and it somehow grows out from under any cap, scarf, or other headwear intended to disguise it. You gain a -2 status penalty to Deception skill checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} anyone else.

_desc_en: Your hair becomes a wild variety of colors, which cannot be altered with mundane or magical means, and it somehow grows out from under any cap, scarf, or other headwear intended to disguise it. You gain a -2 status penalty to Deception skill checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} anyone else.
_desc_ko: 당신의 머리카락은 갖가지 요란한 색깔로 변하며, 이는 평범하거나 마법적인 수단으로도 바꿀 수 없고, 그것을 감추려는 어떤 모자, 스카프, 다른 머리 장식 아래에서도 어떻게든 삐져나옵니다. 당신은 다른 누군가를 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{흉내내기}하기 위한 기만 기술 판정에 -2 상태 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Erastil - Minor Boon

description.value:
Erastil shares in his bounty as long as you work for it.

Whenever you roll a critical failure at a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{Subsist} in the wild, you get a failure instead.

_desc_en:
Erastil shares in his bounty as long as you work for it.

Whenever you roll a critical failure at a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{Subsist} in the wild, you get a failure instead.
_desc_ko:
에라스틸은 당신이 노력하는 한 자신의 풍요를 나눕니다.

야생에서 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{연명}하기 위한 판정에서 대실패를 굴릴 때마다, 대신 실패를 얻습니다.

name: Brigh - Moderate Curse

description.value: Whenever you try to perform engineering or science tasks, everything just seems to explode. Whenever you attempt to create or use an alchemical item or a construct, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable a Device}, and so on, you must attempt a @Check[flat|dc:15]. On a failure, something explodes and you take @Damage[1d6[fire]] damage (or a different type of damage, if appropriate) per level of the item, construct, or device (@Check[reflex|dc:40|basic] save).

_desc_en: Whenever you try to perform engineering or science tasks, everything just seems to explode. Whenever you attempt to create or use an alchemical item or a construct, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable a Device}, and so on, you must attempt a @Check[flat|dc:15]. On a failure, something explodes and you take @Damage[1d6[fire]] damage (or a different type of damage, if appropriate) per level of the item, construct, or device (@Check[reflex|dc:40|basic] save).
_desc_ko: 당신이 공학이나 과학 작업을 수행하려 하면, 모든 것이 그저 폭발하는 것만 같습니다. 당신이 연금술 물품이나 구조물을 만들거나 사용하려 할 때, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{장치 무력화}를 할 때 등등, @Check[flat|dc:15]를 시도해야 합니다. 실패하면 무언가 폭발하여 당신은 그 물품, 구조물, 또는 장치의 레벨당 @Damage[1d6[fire]] 피해(또는 적절하다면 다른 유형의 피해)를 입습니다(@Check[reflex|dc:40|basic] 내성).

name: Ghlaunder - Moderate Boon

description.value: Ghlaunder teaches you to bide your time, corrupting and infecting until the time is right. When you expose a creature to a disease and it succeeds at its Fortitude save, it is still infected unless it critically succeeds. However, such a creature experiences no effects and the disease does not progress for the first 24 hours, even if the disease is normally fast-acting or someone uses another ability to progress the disease. It's very difficult to detect the infection in the first day; the DC for Medicine checks to do so is 5 higher.

_desc_en: Ghlaunder teaches you to bide your time, corrupting and infecting until the time is right. When you expose a creature to a disease and it succeeds at its Fortitude save, it is still infected unless it critically succeeds. However, such a creature experiences no effects and the disease does not progress for the first 24 hours, even if the disease is normally fast-acting or someone uses another ability to progress the disease. It's very difficult to detect the infection in the first day; the DC for Medicine checks to do so is 5 higher.
_desc_ko: 글라운더는 당신에게 때를 기다리는 법, 즉 적절한 때가 올 때까지 부패시키고 감염시키는 법을 가르칩니다. 당신이 어떤 생물을 질병에 노출시켰을 때 그 생물이 건강 내성에 성공하더라도, 대성공하지 않는 한 여전히 감염됩니다. 다만 그런 생물은 처음 24시간 동안 아무런 효과도 겪지 않으며, 질병이 보통 빠르게 진행되는 종류이거나 누군가가 다른 능력으로 질병을 진행시키더라도 질병이 진행되지 않습니다. 첫날에는 감염을 감지하기가 매우 어렵습니다. 이를 위한 의학 판정의 DC는 5 더 높습니다.

name: Besmara - Moderate Boon

description.value: You are at home on the seas and always ready to plunder an enemy vessel or defend your own. When aboard a boat, you gain a +2 status bonus to all initiative rolls, Acrobatics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance}, and Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb}. In addition, you never get seasick.

_desc_en: You are at home on the seas and always ready to plunder an enemy vessel or defend your own. When aboard a boat, you gain a +2 status bonus to all initiative rolls, Acrobatics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance}, and Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb}. In addition, you never get seasick.
_desc_ko: 당신은 바다에서 편안하며, 언제든 적의 배를 약탈하거나 자신의 배를 방어할 준비가 되어 있습니다. 배에 타고 있을 때, 당신은 모든 우선권 굴림, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{균형 잡기}를 위한 곡예 판정, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{오르기}를 위한 운동 판정에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 또한 당신은 결코 뱃멀미를 하지 않습니다.

name: Ghlaunder - Major Curse

description.value: You are struck with a contagious disease of the GM's choice. You and anyone else you infect can't be cured of the disease or improve its condition to an earlier stage in any way until you infect two other sapient beings with the disease.

_desc_en: You are struck with a contagious disease of the GM's choice. You and anyone else you infect can't be cured of the disease or improve its condition to an earlier stage in any way until you infect two other sapient beings with the disease.
_desc_ko: 당신은 GM이 선택한 전염성 질병에 걸립니다. 당신과 당신이 감염시킨 다른 누구든, 당신이 다른 두 명의 지성 있는 존재를 그 질병에 감염시키기 전까지는 어떤 방법으로도 그 질병을 치유하거나 상태를 이전 단계로 호전시킬 수 없습니다.

name: Nethys - Minor Boon

description.value:
Nethys casts a powerful spell to help you in a pinch.

Once, Nethys casts a spell 1 rank higher than the highest-rank spell you can cast. If you can't cast spells, Nethys casts a 1st-rank spell to help you.

_desc_en:
Nethys casts a powerful spell to help you in a pinch.

Once, Nethys casts a spell 1 rank higher than the highest-rank spell you can cast. If you can't cast spells, Nethys casts a 1st-rank spell to help you.
_desc_ko:
네티스가 위기의 순간에 당신을 돕기 위해 강력한 주문을 시전합니다.

한 번은 네티스가 당신이 시전할 수 있는 가장 높은 랭크의 주문보다 1랭크 높은 주문을 시전합니다. 당신이 주문을 시전할 수 없다면, 네티스가 1랭크 주문을 시전하여 당신을 돕습니다.

name: Urgathoa - Minor Boon

description.value:
You feast on the spoils of life and death.

You gain the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.heritages.Item.gyoN45SVfRZwHMkk]{Irongut Goblin} heritage, regardless of your ancestry. If you already have this heritage, the circumstance bonus increases to +4.

_desc_en:
You feast on the spoils of life and death.

You gain the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.heritages.Item.gyoN45SVfRZwHMkk]{Irongut Goblin} heritage, regardless of your ancestry. If you already have this heritage, the circumstance bonus increases to +4.
_desc_ko:
당신은 삶과 죽음의 전리품으로 잔치를 벌입니다.

당신은 자신의 혈통과 상관없이 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.heritages.Item.gyoN45SVfRZwHMkk]{강철위장 고블린} 혈통의 이점을 얻습니다. 이미 이 혈통을 가지고 있다면, 상황 보너스가 +4로 증가합니다.

name: Shelyn - Minor Curse

description.value:
You heart churns with remorse. Each day, you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} as a specific misdeed plays out in your mind over and over in guilt.

You can't remove this condition, though it abates enough for you to quickly eat and drink when necessary. If you make amends or otherwise earnestly pursue redemption for the misdeed, the sickened condition fades completely that day.

_desc_en:
You heart churns with remorse. Each day, you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} as a specific misdeed plays out in your mind over and over in guilt.

You can't remove this condition, though it abates enough for you to quickly eat and drink when necessary. If you make amends or otherwise earnestly pursue redemption for the misdeed, the sickened condition fades completely that day.
_desc_ko:
당신의 마음은 회한으로 휘몰아칩니다. 매일 당신은 특정한 악행이 죄책감 속에서 머릿속에 되풀이되면서 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{구역질 1} 상태가 됩니다.

당신은 이 상태를 제거할 수 없지만, 필요할 때 재빨리 먹고 마실 수 있을 만큼은 누그러집니다. 그 악행에 대해 속죄하거나 그 밖에 진심으로 구원을 추구한다면, 그날 구역질 상태가 완전히 사라집니다.

name: Irori - Major Boon

description.value:
You can temporarily ascend to a greater form.

You can cast 8th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MMCQsh12TPaDdPbV]{Sacred Form} once per day as an occult innate spell. When you do, your form appears unremarkable, rather than clad in powerful armaments.

_desc_en:
You can temporarily ascend to a greater form.

You can cast 8th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MMCQsh12TPaDdPbV]{Sacred Form} once per day as an occult innate spell. When you do, your form appears unremarkable, rather than clad in powerful armaments.
_desc_ko:
당신은 일시적으로 더 위대한 형상으로 승천할 수 있습니다.

당신은 하루에 한 번 8랭크 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MMCQsh12TPaDdPbV]{신성한 형상}을 비학 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 그럴 때 당신의 형상은 강력한 무장을 두른 모습이 아니라 눈에 띄지 않는 모습으로 나타납니다.

name: Gozreh - Major Curse

description.value:
Those who displease Gozreh are shunned by nature itself.

All animals and nonsapient plant creatures are hostile to you, and any animal companion or familiar abandons you.

Sapient plants' attitude toward you begins two categories worse than normal, as something about you seems repugnant to them.

While plants and animals might not attack you outright if it's not normally in their nature to do so when they are hostile, dogs growl at you, cats hiss, and so on.

_desc_en:
Those who displease Gozreh are shunned by nature itself.

All animals and nonsapient plant creatures are hostile to you, and any animal companion or familiar abandons you.

Sapient plants' attitude toward you begins two categories worse than normal, as something about you seems repugnant to them.

While plants and animals might not attack you outright if it's not normally in their nature to do so when they are hostile, dogs growl at you, cats hiss, and so on.
_desc_ko:
고즈레를 불쾌하게 한 자들은 자연 그 자체로부터 배척당합니다.

모든 동물과 지성 없는 식물 생물은 당신에게 적대적이며, 어떤 동물 동료나 사역마도 당신을 버립니다.

지성 있는 식물의 당신을 향한 태도는 무언가 당신에게서 혐오스러운 것을 느끼는 듯 평소보다 두 단계 나쁘게 시작합니다.

식물과 동물이 적대적일 때 평소 본성상 그렇게 하지 않는다면 당신을 대놓고 공격하지는 않더라도, 개는 당신에게 으르렁대고, 고양이는 하악거리는 등의 반응을 보입니다.

name: Gorum - Moderate Boon

description.value: Your blows become unstoppable, carrying the momentum of Gorum's thrill for battle. Your greatsword Strikes gain the forceful trait.

_desc_en: Your blows become unstoppable, carrying the momentum of Gorum's thrill for battle. Your greatsword Strikes gain the forceful trait.
_desc_ko: 당신의 일격은 고룸의 전투에 대한 전율의 기세를 실어 멈출 수 없게 됩니다. 당신의 그레이트소드 타격은 강력 특성을 얻습니다.

name: Shelyn - Major Boon

description.value:
Your inner beauty and love surround you in an aura.

As long as you bear them no ill will, all creatures other than fiends, undead, and mindless creatures start with an attitude of friendly toward you, unless they would have been helpful instead. This doesn't mean they are willing to change their life or plans for you, and this boon does not prevent their attitudes from worsening if you try to thwart them. This effect doesn't work against deities and similarly powerful creatures.

Additionally, the love you share with your friends inspires them. You and your allies gain a +3 status bonus to saving throws and skill checks as long as you can see each other.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.boons-and-curses.Item.qACkkLk3F5WeACHO]{Effect: Shelyn's Love}

_desc_en:
Your inner beauty and love surround you in an aura.

As long as you bear them no ill will, all creatures other than fiends, undead, and mindless creatures start with an attitude of friendly toward you, unless they would have been helpful instead. This doesn't mean they are willing to change their life or plans for you, and this boon does not prevent their attitudes from worsening if you try to thwart them. This effect doesn't work against deities and similarly powerful creatures.

Additionally, the love you share with your friends inspires them. You and your allies gain a +3 status bonus to saving throws and skill checks as long as you can see each other.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.boons-and-curses.Item.qACkkLk3F5WeACHO]{Effect: Shelyn's Love}
_desc_ko:
당신의 내면의 아름다움과 사랑이 오라가 되어 당신을 감쌉니다.

당신이 그들에게 악의를 품지 않는 한, 악마·언데드·정신 없는 생물을 제외한 모든 생물은 당신에게 우호적인 태도로 시작합니다. 단, 원래대로라면 협조적이었을 경우에는 그대로 유지됩니다. 이는 그들이 당신을 위해 자신의 삶이나 계획을 바꿀 의향이 있다는 뜻은 아니며, 당신이 그들을 방해하려 할 경우 이 은총이 그들의 태도가 악화되는 것을 막아주지는 않습니다. 이 효과는 신격 및 그에 준하는 강력한 생물에게는 통하지 않습니다.

추가로, 당신이 친구들과 나누는 사랑이 그들에게 영감을 줍니다. 서로를 볼 수 있는 한, 당신과 당신의 아군은 내성 굴림과 기술 판정에 +3 상태 보너스를 받습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.boons-and-curses.Item.qACkkLk3F5WeACHO]{효과: 셀린의 사랑}

name: Zon-Kuthon - Minor Curse

description.value: You are surrounded by spectral chains that cause you to always be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered} and that have the same effects as armor with the noisy trait.

_desc_en: You are surrounded by spectral chains that cause you to always be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered} and that have the same effects as armor with the noisy trait.
_desc_ko: 당신은 유령 같은 사슬에 둘러싸여 항상 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{과적} 상태가 되며, 소음 특성을 지닌 갑옷과 동일한 효과를 받습니다.

name: Norgorber - Major Boon

description.value:
You become a living secret.

You are immune to divination effects and attempts to magically alter your memory, unless you choose to be affected or those effects come from a deity, artifact, or similarly powerful source. You also can never be tricked or forced by mundane means into uttering a secret you wish to keep.

_desc_en:
You become a living secret.

You are immune to divination effects and attempts to magically alter your memory, unless you choose to be affected or those effects come from a deity, artifact, or similarly powerful source. You also can never be tricked or forced by mundane means into uttering a secret you wish to keep.
_desc_ko:
당신은 살아있는 비밀이 됩니다.

당신은 점술 효과와 당신의 기억을 마법적으로 변경하려는 시도에 면역이 됩니다. 단, 당신이 영향받기를 선택하거나 그러한 효과가 신격·아티팩트, 혹은 그에 준하는 강력한 근원에서 비롯된 경우는 예외입니다. 또한 당신은 지키고자 하는 비밀을 평범한 수단으로는 결코 속거나 강요당해 발설하지 않습니다.

name: Gorum - Moderate Curse

description.value:
You've lost the glory of slaying a worthy opponent.

All of your weapon and unarmed attacks decrease their damage dice by one step, and all your attacks are nonlethal.

_desc_en:
You've lost the glory of slaying a worthy opponent.

All of your weapon and unarmed attacks decrease their damage dice by one step, and all your attacks are nonlethal.
_desc_ko:
당신은 걸맞은 적수를 처치하는 영광을 잃었습니다.

당신의 모든 무기 및 비무장 공격은 피해 주사위가 한 단계 감소하며, 당신의 모든 공격은 비치명적이 됩니다.

name: Groetus - Moderate Curse

description.value: The horrors at the end of reality become overwhelming and constantly race through your mind. You are permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}.

_desc_en: The horrors at the end of reality become overwhelming and constantly race through your mind. You are permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}.
_desc_ko: 현실의 종말에 도사린 공포가 압도적으로 밀려와 끊임없이 당신의 마음을 스칩니다. 당신은 영구적으로 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{멍함 2} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Abadar - Major Boon

description.value:
Your silver tongue is infallible, allowing you to reach a compromise if one is even remotely possible.

Once per day, you know just what to offer to make a deal or broker a negotiation, and if you offer your divinely inspired deal, you can automatically receive a result of 20 + your Diplomacy modifier on your Diplomacy check instead of rolling. This does not increase your degree of success like rolling a 20 would.

If there is legitimately nothing you could offer to reach an agreement, you learn that, and you don't expend your daily use of the boon.

_desc_en:
Your silver tongue is infallible, allowing you to reach a compromise if one is even remotely possible.

Once per day, you know just what to offer to make a deal or broker a negotiation, and if you offer your divinely inspired deal, you can automatically receive a result of 20 + your Diplomacy modifier on your Diplomacy check instead of rolling. This does not increase your degree of success like rolling a 20 would.

If there is legitimately nothing you could offer to reach an agreement, you learn that, and you don't expend your daily use of the boon.
_desc_ko:
당신의 은빛 혀는 틀림이 없어, 조금이라도 가능성이 있는 한 타협에 이를 수 있습니다.

하루에 한 번, 당신은 거래를 성사시키거나 협상을 중개하기 위해 무엇을 제안해야 할지 정확히 알게 되며, 신의 영감을 받은 그 거래를 제안할 경우 외교 판정을 굴리는 대신 자동으로 20 + 당신의 외교 수정치의 결과를 받을 수 있습니다. 이는 20을 굴렸을 때처럼 성공 등급을 올려주지는 않습니다.

합의에 도달하기 위해 제안할 수 있는 것이 정말로 아무것도 없다면, 당신은 그 사실을 알게 되며 이 은총의 일일 사용 횟수를 소모하지 않습니다.

name: Desna - Major Boon

description.value: Desna bestows you with a swirling cloud of lights that forms a pair of wondrous butterfly wings. These wings grant you a fly Speed of 40 feet and shine dim light to a range of 20 feet.

_desc_en: Desna bestows you with a swirling cloud of lights that forms a pair of wondrous butterfly wings. These wings grant you a fly Speed of 40 feet and shine dim light to a range of 20 feet.
_desc_ko: 데스나가 소용돌이치는 빛 구름을 당신에게 내려, 한 쌍의 경이로운 나비 날개를 형성합니다. 이 날개는 당신에게 40피트의 비행 속도를 부여하며, 20피트 범위까지 어스름한 빛을 비춥니다.

name: Abadar - Moderate Curse

description.value: Abadar curses all your enterprises, leading to financial disaster as all your ventures always seem to fail. The result of your check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income} is always one degree of success worse than the one you rolled.

_desc_en: Abadar curses all your enterprises, leading to financial disaster as all your ventures always seem to fail. The result of your check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income} is always one degree of success worse than the one you rolled.
_desc_ko: 아바다르가 당신의 모든 사업을 저주하여, 당신의 모든 벤처가 언제나 실패하는 듯하며 재정적 파탄으로 이어집니다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{수입 벌기} 판정의 결과는 항상 당신이 굴린 것보다 한 등급 낮은 성공 등급이 됩니다.

name: Erastil - Major Boon

description.value:
You become a friend to the land.

You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qvwIwJ9QBihy8R0t]{Speak with Plants} as a divine innate spell.

When you are in a healthy natural environment, the land sustains you without need for food or drink.

You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7DN13ILADW2N9Z1t]{Commune} ritual without any secondary casters or secondary checks.

_desc_en:
You become a friend to the land.

You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qvwIwJ9QBihy8R0t]{Speak with Plants} as a divine innate spell.

When you are in a healthy natural environment, the land sustains you without need for food or drink.

You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7DN13ILADW2N9Z1t]{Commune} ritual without any secondary casters or secondary checks.
_desc_ko:
당신은 대지의 벗이 됩니다.

당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qvwIwJ9QBihy8R0t]{식물과 대화}를 신성 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

당신이 건강한 자연 환경에 있을 때, 대지가 당신을 지탱해 주어 음식이나 물이 필요 없습니다.

당신은 보조 시전자나 보조 판정 없이 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7DN13ILADW2N9Z1t]{교감} 의식을 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Calistria - Moderate Curse

description.value: People react as though you're insulting them, even in normal conversation. Whenever you attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}, the outcome is one degree of success worse than the result of your roll. If you converse with someone over a long enough period of time but don't attempt to Make an Impression, you still insult them, and you suffer the effect of a critical failure to Make an Impression.

_desc_en: People react as though you're insulting them, even in normal conversation. Whenever you attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}, the outcome is one degree of success worse than the result of your roll. If you converse with someone over a long enough period of time but don't attempt to Make an Impression, you still insult them, and you suffer the effect of a critical failure to Make an Impression.
_desc_ko: 평범한 대화 중에도 사람들은 당신이 자신들을 모욕하는 것처럼 반응합니다. 당신이 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{인상 남기기}를 시도할 때마다, 그 결과는 당신이 굴린 결과보다 한 등급 낮은 성공이 됩니다. 인상 남기기를 시도하지 않고도 누군가와 충분히 오랜 시간 대화한다면, 당신은 여전히 그들을 모욕하게 되며 인상 남기기 대실패의 효과를 받습니다.

name: Gruhastha - Minor Curse

description.value: As you stray from the truth, dissonant notes seem to interrupt you whenever you speak. You take a -2 status penalty to all Deception checks.

_desc_en: As you stray from the truth, dissonant notes seem to interrupt you whenever you speak. You take a -2 status penalty to all Deception checks.
_desc_ko: 당신이 진실에서 벗어날수록, 말할 때마다 불협화음이 당신을 가로막는 듯합니다. 당신은 모든 기만 판정에 -2 상태 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Milani - Moderate Curse

description.value: Ropes, chains, manacles, and other equipment used to bind or constrain become blazing hot in your hands, bursting into flame or melting as if engulfed in a forge. When you attempt to hold such an item, you take @Damage[2d6[fire]] damage and the item is destroyed.

_desc_en: Ropes, chains, manacles, and other equipment used to bind or constrain become blazing hot in your hands, bursting into flame or melting as if engulfed in a forge. When you attempt to hold such an item, you take @Damage[2d6[fire]] damage and the item is destroyed.
_desc_ko: 결박하거나 구속하는 데 쓰이는 밧줄, 사슬, 수갑 및 기타 장비가 당신의 손안에서 이글이글 뜨거워져, 대장간에 삼켜진 듯 불타오르거나 녹아내립니다. 당신이 그러한 물건을 들려고 시도하면 @Damage[2d6[fire]] 피해를 입고 그 물건은 파괴됩니다.

name: Brigh - Moderate Boon

description.value: You become a wellspring of invention. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.XR95taODq1sq82Du]{Inventor} feat, even if you don't meet its prerequisites, and when you roll a Crafting check for the Inventor feat, you use the result one degree of success better than the result you rolled.

_desc_en: You become a wellspring of invention. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.XR95taODq1sq82Du]{Inventor} feat, even if you don't meet its prerequisites, and when you roll a Crafting check for the Inventor feat, you use the result one degree of success better than the result you rolled.
_desc_ko: 당신은 발명의 원천이 됩니다. 당신은 선행 조건을 충족하지 못하더라도 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.XR95taODq1sq82Du]{발명가} 재주를 얻으며, 발명가 재주를 위해 제작 판정을 굴릴 때 당신이 굴린 결과보다 한 등급 높은 성공 등급의 결과를 사용합니다.

name: Arazni - Minor Curse

description.value: Someone you've wronged gains information they desire about you, with the effects of a critical success at the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7DN13ILADW2N9Z1t]{Commune} ritual.

_desc_en: Someone you've wronged gains information they desire about you, with the effects of a critical success at the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7DN13ILADW2N9Z1t]{Commune} ritual.
_desc_ko: 당신에게 해를 입은 누군가가 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7DN13ILADW2N9Z1t]{교감} 의식의 대성공 효과로 당신에 관해 그들이 원하는 정보를 얻습니다.

name: Alseta - Moderate Boon

description.value: New doors open themselves for you. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6Ot4N22t5tPD51BO]{Knock} once per day as a divine innate spell.

_desc_en: New doors open themselves for you. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6Ot4N22t5tPD51BO]{Knock} once per day as a divine innate spell.
_desc_ko: 새로운 문들이 당신을 위해 스스로 열립니다. 당신은 하루에 한 번 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6Ot4N22t5tPD51BO]{노크}를 신성 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Ghlaunder - Minor Curse

description.value: Ghlaunder drains away your life force for himself. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and can't reduce your drained condition below 1.

_desc_en: Ghlaunder drains away your life force for himself. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and can't reduce your drained condition below 1.
_desc_ko: 글라운더가 당신의 생명력을 자신을 위해 빨아들입니다. 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{생명력 고갈 1} 상태가 되며, 생명력 고갈 상태를 1 미만으로 낮출 수 없습니다.

name: Erastil - Minor Curse

description.value: Erastil curses your table and punishes you for relying on others' hard work. Any food you didn't grow, gather, or otherwise harvest yourself tastes like ash and leaves you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.

_desc_en: Erastil curses your table and punishes you for relying on others' hard work. Any food you didn't grow, gather, or otherwise harvest yourself tastes like ash and leaves you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.
_desc_ko: 에라스틸이 당신의 식탁을 저주하여, 남의 노고에 기대는 당신을 벌합니다. 당신이 직접 기르거나 채집하거나 수확하지 않은 음식은 모두 재 맛이 나며 당신을 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{피로} 상태로 만듭니다.

name: Lamashtu - Major Curse

description.value: Your dreams are an unending stream of nightmares. You need 16 hours of rest to try to get enough sleep to recover resources in daily preparation that normally require an 8-hour rest, and even then, you must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:15] to do so, and you are still @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} on a successful check.

_desc_en: Your dreams are an unending stream of nightmares. You need 16 hours of rest to try to get enough sleep to recover resources in daily preparation that normally require an 8-hour rest, and even then, you must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:15] to do so, and you are still @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} on a successful check.
_desc_ko: 당신의 꿈은 끝없이 이어지는 악몽의 연속입니다. 통상 8시간의 휴식이 필요한 일일 준비로 자원을 회복하기에 충분한 수면을 취하려면 16시간의 휴식이 필요하며, 그마저도 @Check[flat|dc:15] 판정에 성공해야 하고, 성공하더라도 여전히 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{피로} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Iomedae - Moderate Boon

description.value:
Your heart beats with a determined valor.

Once, Iomedae ends all negative effects affecting you, unless they are from an artifact, deity, or similarly powerful source; she also restores all lost Hit Points and replenishes your spells, Focus Points, and other daily resources.

_desc_en:
Your heart beats with a determined valor.

Once, Iomedae ends all negative effects affecting you, unless they are from an artifact, deity, or similarly powerful source; she also restores all lost Hit Points and replenishes your spells, Focus Points, and other daily resources.
_desc_ko:
당신의 심장이 굳건한 용맹으로 고동칩니다.

단 한 번, 이오메다에가 당신에게 영향을 미치는 모든 부정적 효과를 종료시킵니다. 단, 그것이 아티팩트·신격, 혹은 그에 준하는 강력한 근원에서 비롯된 경우는 예외입니다. 또한 그녀는 잃은 히트 포인트를 모두 회복시키고, 당신의 주문·집중 점수 및 기타 일일 자원을 다시 채워줍니다.

name: Grandmother Spider - Minor Curse

description.value: When your pranks start going wrong, they dissolve into a string of catastrophic failures. When you roll a failure on a Deception or Stealth check, you get a critical failure instead.

_desc_en: When your pranks start going wrong, they dissolve into a string of catastrophic failures. When you roll a failure on a Deception or Stealth check, you get a critical failure instead.
_desc_ko: 당신의 장난이 어긋나기 시작하면, 그것은 파국적 실패의 연쇄로 무너집니다. 당신이 기만 또는 은신 판정에서 실패를 굴리면, 대신 대실패가 됩니다.

name: Irori - Moderate Curse

description.value: Irori challenges you to adapt to adversity in order to perfect yourself. You become weighed down as if under heavy weights, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered} until you accomplish a challenging task of Irori's choosing.

_desc_en: Irori challenges you to adapt to adversity in order to perfect yourself. You become weighed down as if under heavy weights, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered} until you accomplish a challenging task of Irori's choosing.
_desc_ko: 이로리가 당신에게 역경에 적응하여 스스로를 완성하라는 시련을 내립니다. 당신은 무거운 짐을 진 것처럼 짓눌려, 이로리가 정한 도전적인 과업을 완수할 때까지 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{둔함 2} 및 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{과적} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Nocticula - Major Boon

description.value:
You become an idealized version of yourself, as if created by a divine artist.

You permanently gain a set of 4 ability boosts that follow the same rules as the ability boosts you gain at every 5th level.

_desc_en:
You become an idealized version of yourself, as if created by a divine artist.

You permanently gain a set of 4 ability boosts that follow the same rules as the ability boosts you gain at every 5th level.
_desc_ko:
당신은 신성한 예술가가 창조한 듯한 이상화된 자신이 됩니다.

당신은 매 5레벨마다 얻는 능력치 강화와 동일한 규칙을 따르는 4개의 능력치 강화 세트를 영구적으로 얻습니다.

name: Arazni - Major Boon

description.value: Upon death, you return to life with the effects of a critical success on a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kqhPt9344UkcGVYO]{Resurrect} ritual to enact vengeance against your killers. When you successfully achieve vengeance, abandon your vengeance for other pursuits, or fail outright, you crumble to scarlet dust.

_desc_en: Upon death, you return to life with the effects of a critical success on a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kqhPt9344UkcGVYO]{Resurrect} ritual to enact vengeance against your killers. When you successfully achieve vengeance, abandon your vengeance for other pursuits, or fail outright, you crumble to scarlet dust.
_desc_ko: 죽음을 맞이하면, 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kqhPt9344UkcGVYO]{소생} 의식의 대성공 효과로 되살아나 당신을 죽인 자들에게 복수를 실행합니다. 복수를 성공적으로 완수하거나, 다른 목적을 위해 복수를 포기하거나, 완전히 실패하면, 당신은 진홍빛 먼지로 부스러집니다.

name: Iomedae - Moderate Curse

description.value: Tactical advantages never seem to work the way you planned. You can't receive a circumstance bonus to your attack rolls, and enemies don't take any circumstance penalties to their AC against your attacks.

_desc_en: Tactical advantages never seem to work the way you planned. You can't receive a circumstance bonus to your attack rolls, and enemies don't take any circumstance penalties to their AC against your attacks.
_desc_ko: 전술적 이점이 결코 당신이 계획한 대로 작동하지 않는 듯합니다. 당신은 명중 굴림에 상황 보너스를 받을 수 없으며, 적은 당신의 공격에 대한 AC에 어떤 상황 페널티도 받지 않습니다.

name: Grandmother Spider - Moderate Boon

description.value: You can feel tugs on the strands of fate. You gain a +2 status bonus to initiative rolls.

_desc_en: You can feel tugs on the strands of fate. You gain a +2 status bonus to initiative rolls.
_desc_ko: 당신은 운명의 실이 당겨지는 것을 느낄 수 있습니다. 당신은 우선권 굴림에 +2 상태 보너스를 받습니다.

name: Gruhastha - Moderate Curse

description.value: Enlightenment begins to elude you, leaving you at a loss for knowledge. Whenever you attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, you use a result one degree of success worse than the result you rolled.

_desc_en: Enlightenment begins to elude you, leaving you at a loss for knowledge. Whenever you attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, you use a result one degree of success worse than the result you rolled.
_desc_ko: 깨달음이 당신을 피하기 시작하여, 지식 앞에서 갈피를 잡지 못하게 됩니다. 당신이 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{지식 회상} 판정을 시도할 때마다, 당신이 굴린 결과보다 한 등급 낮은 성공 등급의 결과를 사용합니다.

name: Hei Feng - Major Curse

description.value: The Duke of Thunder's ire follows you wherever you go. The weather in a 500-foot radius around you is always stormy. Roughly twice each minute you are outside, you are struck by a bolt of lightning that deals @Damage[10d6[electricity]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:40|basic] save).

_desc_en: The Duke of Thunder's ire follows you wherever you go. The weather in a 500-foot radius around you is always stormy. Roughly twice each minute you are outside, you are struck by a bolt of lightning that deals @Damage[10d6[electricity]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:40|basic] save).
_desc_ko: 뇌정공(雷霆公)의 분노가 당신이 가는 곳마다 따라다닙니다. 당신 주위 500피트 반경의 날씨는 항상 폭풍우입니다. 당신이 실외에 있을 때 대략 매 분 두 번씩, 당신은 @Damage[10d6[electricity]] 피해를 입히는 번개에 맞습니다(@Check[reflex|dc:40|basic] 내성).

name: Asmodeus - Major Boon

description.value:
Asmodeus helps enforce your bargains and contracts.

When a creature enters a bargain or contract with you, uncoerced and of its own free will, it can't voluntarily violate its side of the bargain as long as you uphold your side.
