You gain scent as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} in areas of forest and snow. You sprout a pair of horns from your forehead, gaining a horns unarmed attack that deals 1d8 bludgeoning damage. Your horns are in the brawling group and have the shove and trip traits.
_desc_ko: 당신의 몸이 진화하고 적응하기 시작하며, 사우멘 카르의 고대 저주와 자신을 융합하기 위한 첫걸음을 내딛습니다. 당신은 더 커지고 더 덩치 커져, 당신의 체격에 비해 키와 체중의 한계에 다다릅니다. 30피트 범위 내에서 부정확한 후각을 얻으며, 숲과 눈 덮인 지역에서 @link[actions.sneak] 또는 @link[actions.hide] 스텔스 판정 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 이마에서 한 쌍의 뿔이 돋아나며, 1d8 타격 피해를 주는 비무장 공격을 사용하게 됩니다. 이 뿔은 격투 무기 그룹에 속하며 밀치기와 넘어뜨리기 특성을 지닙니다.

name: Elemental Summons

description.value: You can call the elements to you. You can spend 10 minutes in concert with nature to replace a spell you've prepared in one of your druid spell slots with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lpT6LotUaQPfinjj]{Summon Elemental} spell of the same rank.

_desc_en: You can call the elements to you. You can spend 10 minutes in concert with nature to replace a spell you've prepared in one of your druid spell slots with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lpT6LotUaQPfinjj]{Summon Elemental} spell of the same rank.
_desc_ko: 당신은 원소들을 자신에게 불러올 수 있습니다. 자연과 조화를 이루며 10분을 보내면, 준비한 드루이드 주문 슬롯 중 하나에 있는 주문을 동일한 랭크의 @link[spells.summon-elemental] 주문으로 대체할 수 있습니다.

name: Wind Pillow

description.value: The winds have whispered to you all your life, and the essence of air itself helps you at times, making you somewhat buoyant when you're suspended in space. Treat all falls as though they were 10 feet less than the actual distance traveled. You also gain the Powerful Leap skill feat, even if you don't meet that feat's prerequisites.

_desc_en: The winds have whispered to you all your life, and the essence of air itself helps you at times, making you somewhat buoyant when you're suspended in space. Treat all falls as though they were 10 feet less than the actual distance traveled. You also gain the Powerful Leap skill feat, even if you don't meet that feat's prerequisites.
_desc_ko: 평생 바람이 당신에게 속삭여왔고, 때로는 공기 그 자체의 정수가 당신을 돕습니다. 공중에 떠 있을 때 다소 부양력을 얻게 됩니다. 모든 낙하를 실제 이동 거리보다 10피트 낮은 것으로 간주한다. 또한 해당 특성의 전제 조건을 충족하지 않더라도 강력한 도약 기술 특성을 획득한다.

name: Perfect Mutagen

description.value: You have enhanced the formulas for your mutagens, aligning them perfectly to your physiology. When under the effect of a mutagen you crafted, you do not suffer its drawback.

_desc_en: You have enhanced the formulas for your mutagens, aligning them perfectly to your physiology. When under the effect of a mutagen you crafted, you do not suffer its drawback.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신의 혈청 제조법을 개선하여 자신의 생리 구조에 완벽하게 맞췄습니다. 자신이 제작한 혈청의 효과 하에서는 그 단점을 겪지 않습니다.

name: Spirit's Absolution

description.value:
Cost 1 spirit wisp or spirit remnant from your spirit dwelling

Requirements You are holding your spirit dwelling.

You purify a spirit by absolving it of its sins and regrets. This cathartic experience restores your Hit Points or those of an adjacent ally. If you expend a spirit wisp, the target recovers @Damage[(@actor.level)d4[healing,vitality]] Hit Points. If you expend a spirit remnant, the target recovers 1d6 Hit Points per level of the incorporeal undead or haunt from which you gained the remnant.

_desc_en:
Cost 1 spirit wisp or spirit remnant from your spirit dwelling

Requirements You are holding your spirit dwelling.

You purify a spirit by absolving it of its sins and regrets. This cathartic experience restores your Hit Points or those of an adjacent ally. If you expend a spirit wisp, the target recovers @Damage[(@actor.level)d4[healing,vitality]] Hit Points. If you expend a spirit remnant, the target recovers 1d6 Hit Points per level of the incorporeal undead or haunt from which you gained the remnant.
_desc_ko:
비용 영혼 거처에서 영혼의 위습 1개 또는 영혼의 잔해 1개

요구 사항 영혼 거처를 소지하고 있어야 합니다.

영혼의 죄와 후회를 사면하여 정화합니다. 이 정화 경험은 당신의 HP 또는 인접한 아군의 HP를 회복시킵니다. 영혼의 불씨를 소모하면 대상은 회복 활력 HP를 회복합니다. 영혼의 잔해를 소모하면 대상은 당신이 그 잔해를 얻은 비물질적 언데드 또는 유령의 레벨당 1d6 HP를 회복합니다.

name: Surprise Strike

description.value: Whenever you make a Strike with an improvised weapon against a creature that hasn't seen you make a Strike using an improvised weapon or that is otherwise ignorant of your skill with improvised weapons, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against you for that Strike.

_desc_en: Whenever you make a Strike with an improvised weapon against a creature that hasn't seen you make a Strike using an improvised weapon or that is otherwise ignorant of your skill with improvised weapons, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against you for that Strike.
_desc_ko: 임시 무기로 공격을 가할 때, 상대가 당신이 임시 무기로 공격하는 모습을 본 적이 없거나 당신의 임시 무기 사용 능력을 전혀 모르는 경우, 해당 공격에 대해 상대는 당신에게 @link[conditions.off-guard]가 됩니다.

name: Dual-Weapon Blitz

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding two one-handed melee weapons, each in a different hand.

You attack as you weave your way around the battlefield. Stride up to your Speed. During this movement, you can Strike once with each of the two one-handed melee weapons. Each of these Strikes can be made at any point during your movement.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding two one-handed melee weapons, each in a different hand.

You attack as you weave your way around the battlefield. Stride up to your Speed. During this movement, you can Strike once with each of the two one-handed melee weapons. Each of these Strikes can be made at any point during your movement.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손에 각각 다른 한손 근접 무기를 휘두르고 있어야 합니다.

전장을 누비며 공격한다. 이동 속도만큼 전진한다. 이 이동 중 양손의 한손 근접 무기로 각각 한 번씩 타격할 수 있다. 각 타격은 이동 중 언제든지 수행할 수 있다.

name: Elucidation

description.value:
Trigger You succeed at a saving throw to disbelieve an illusion.

You can cut through illusions with such precision that all those around you find their senses sharpened as well. Whenever you disbelieve an illusion, all allies within 15 feet can use a free action to attempt a saving throw to disbelieve the illusion as well.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Trigger You succeed at a saving throw to disbelieve an illusion.

You can cut through illusions with such precision that all those around you find their senses sharpened as well. Whenever you disbelieve an illusion, all allies within 15 feet can use a free action to attempt a saving throw to disbelieve the illusion as well.
_desc_ko:
발동 환상을 의심하는 내성 굴림에서 성공합니다.

당신은 환상을 매우 정밀하게 꿰뚫어 보는 능력으로 주변 모든 이들의 감각도 함께 예민해지게 합니다. 당신이 환상을 의심할 때마다, 15피트 내의 모든 아군은 자유 행동으로 환상을 의심하는 내성 굴림을 시도할 수 있습니다.

name: Advanced Domain Spirit

description.value: Your connection with your domain spirit has deepened. You gain the advanced domain spell from the domain granted by your domain spirit.

_desc_en: Your connection with your domain spirit has deepened. You gain the advanced domain spell from the domain granted by your domain spirit.
_desc_ko: 당신의 영역 영혼과의 유대가 깊어졌습니다. 영역 영혼이 부여한 영역의 고급 영역 주문을 얻습니다.

name: Blank Slate

description.value: Your deceptions confound even the most powerful magic that could spy on you. Detection, revelation, and scrying effects pass right over you, your possessions, and your auras, detecting nothing unless the detecting effect has a counteract rank of 10 or higher. For example, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic} would still detect other magic in the area but not any magic on you, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight} wouldn't reveal you, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.LQzlKbYjZSMFQawP]{Locate} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r784cIz17eWujtQj]{Scrying} wouldn't find you, and so on.

_desc_en: Your deceptions confound even the most powerful magic that could spy on you. Detection, revelation, and scrying effects pass right over you, your possessions, and your auras, detecting nothing unless the detecting effect has a counteract rank of 10 or higher. For example, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic} would still detect other magic in the area but not any magic on you, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight} wouldn't reveal you, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.LQzlKbYjZSMFQawP]{Locate} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r784cIz17eWujtQj]{Scrying} wouldn't find you, and so on.
_desc_ko: 당신의 기만은 당신을 감시할 수 있는 가장 강력한 마법조차 혼란스럽게 합니다. 탐지, 폭로, 점술 효과는 당신과 당신의 소유물, 그리고 당신의 오라를 그냥 지나쳐, 탐지 효과가 10 이상의 반격 등급을 가지지 않는 한 아무것도 감지하지 못합니다. 예를 들어, @link[spells.detect-magic]는 주변의 다른 마법은 감지하지만 당신에게 걸린 마법은 감지하지 못합니다. @link[spells.truesight]은 당신을 드러내지 못하며, @link[spells.locate]이나 @link[spells.scrying]도 당신을 찾지 못합니다. 이와 같습니다.

name: Lightning Rings' Overcharge

description.value: Your familiar can adopt an electrical form to empower weapon strikes. Your familiar gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.zwWgHjcU0iZ6gUDY]{Lightning Armillary} ability.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your familiar can adopt an electrical form to empower weapon strikes. Your familiar gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.zwWgHjcU0iZ6gUDY]{Lightning Armillary} ability.
_desc_ko: 당신의 패밀리어는 전기 형태를 취해 무기 강타를 강화할 수 있습니다. 당신의 패밀리어는 @link[actions.lightning-armillary] 능력을 얻습니다.

name: Godbreaker

description.value:
Requirements You have a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

You have mastered an ultimate grappling technique capable of breaking even the mightiest of foes. You hurl the creature 20 feet into the air, following behind it with a powerful jump, and then make an unarmed Strike. If the Strike is successful, you can repeat this process up to two more times, moving the creature an additional 20 feet directly up into the air with each Strike; the creature keeps the grabbed or restrained condition throughout the sequence. If you miss with any of the Strikes, Godbreaker and the grabbed or restrained condition immediately end and both you and the opponent fall, taking falling damage as normal for the total height of your jump.

If all three Strikes are successful, you immediately grab the creature and bring it crashing to the ground, dealing your unarmed Strike damage plus falling damage to it. You land on your feet adjacent to the creature, you take no damage from the fall, and the creature remains grabbed or restrained by you.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

You have mastered an ultimate grappling technique capable of breaking even the mightiest of foes. You hurl the creature 20 feet into the air, following behind it with a powerful jump, and then make an unarmed Strike. If the Strike is successful, you can repeat this process up to two more times, moving the creature an additional 20 feet directly up into the air with each Strike; the creature keeps the grabbed or restrained condition throughout the sequence. If you miss with any of the Strikes, Godbreaker and the grabbed or restrained condition immediately end and both you and the opponent fall, taking falling damage as normal for the total height of your jump.

If all three Strikes are successful, you immediately grab the creature and bring it crashing to the ground, dealing your unarmed Strike damage plus falling damage to it. You land on your feet adjacent to the creature, you take no damage from the fall, and the creature remains grabbed or restrained by you.
_desc_ko:
Requirements 당신은 생물 @link[conditions.grabbed] 또는 @link[conditions.restrained] 상태를 유지하고 있습니다.

당신은 가장 강력한 적조차 분쇄할 수 있는 궁극의 그랩 기술을 마스터했습니다. 당신은 생물을 20피트 공중으로 내던진 뒤 강력한 점프로 뒤따라가 비무장 공격을 가합니다. 공격이 성공하면 최대 두 번까지 이 과정을 반복할 수 있으며, 매 공격마다 생물을 추가로 20피트 수직 상공으로 이동시킵니다. 이 시퀀스 내내 생물은 붙잡기 또는 구속 상태를 유지합니다. 어떤 공격이라도 실패하면, 신살자와 신성 저항의 붙잡기 또는 구속 상태는 즉시 종료되며, 당신과 상대방 모두 떨어지면서 점프한 총 높이만큼의 낙하 피해를 정상적으로 받습니다.

세 번의 공격이 모두 성공하면, 당신은 즉시 생물을 잡아 땅에 내리쳐 비무장 공격 피해와 추락 피해를 입힙니다. 당신은 생물 옆에 발을 딛고 착지하며 추락 피해를 입지 않으며, 생물은 계속해서 당신에게 붙잡기되거나 제압된 상태로 남습니다.

name: Directed Poison

description.value: When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MlpbeZ61Euhl0d60]{Toxic Cloud}, modify its duration to be sustained up to 1 minute, and modify its standard effect to include the following: The cloud doesn't move away from you each round. Once per round when you Sustain the Spell, you can move the cloud 10 feet in the direction of your choice.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en: When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MlpbeZ61Euhl0d60]{Toxic Cloud}, modify its duration to be sustained up to 1 minute, and modify its standard effect to include the following: The cloud doesn't move away from you each round. Once per round when you Sustain the Spell, you can move the cloud 10 feet in the direction of your choice.
_desc_ko: {독성 구름}을 시전할 때, 지속 시간을 최대 1분으로 수정자하고 표준 효과에 다음을 포함하도록 수정: 구름은 매 라운드마다 시전자로부터 멀어지지 않는다. 주문 지속 시 라운드당 한 번, 구름을 원하는 방향으로 10피트 이동시킬 수 있다.

name: Imposing Destrier

description.value:
Under your care, your mount has realized its innate potential. The mount you gained with Faithful Steed is now a nimble or savage animal companion.

Your animal companion has greater independence. During an encounter, even if you don't use the Command an Animal action, your animal companion can still use 1 action that round on your turn to Stride or Strike. It can do this at any point during your turn, as long as you aren't currently taking an action. If it does, that's all the actions it gets that round—you can't Command it later.

_desc_en:
Under your care, your mount has realized its innate potential. The mount you gained with Faithful Steed is now a nimble or savage animal companion.

Your animal companion has greater independence. During an encounter, even if you don't use the Command an Animal action, your animal companion can still use 1 action that round on your turn to Stride or Strike. It can do this at any point during your turn, as long as you aren't currently taking an action. If it does, that's all the actions it gets that round—you can't Command it later.
_desc_ko:
당신의 보살핌 아래, 당신의 탈것은 타고난 잠재력을 깨달았습니다. 충실한 탈것으로 얻은 탈것은 이제 민첩하거나 사나운 동물 동료가 되었습니다.

당신의 동물 동료는 더 큰 독립성을 가집니다. 전투 중, 당신이 '동물을 지휘하다' 행동을 사용하지 않더라도, 당신의 동물 동료는 당신의 턴에 그 라운드 동안 1번의 행동으로 '이동'이나 '공격'을 할 수 있습니다. 당신이 현재 행동을 취하고 있지 않다면, 당신의 턴 중 언제든지 이를 수행할 수 있습니다. 만약 그렇게 한다면, 그것이 그 라운드 동안 동물이 취할 수 있는 모든 행동입니다-나중에 커맨더할 수 없습니다.

name: Polished Distraction

description.value:
Requirements You aren't in dim light or darkness.

You take pride in the sheen of your armor, and how useful it is at distracting your enemies when you reflect light from it. Creatures within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] that can see you must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class] save against your class DC. Once a creature attempts a save against this effect, it's temporarily immune for 24 hours.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round and dazzled for 2 rounds.

Critical Failure The creature is blinded for 2 rounds and dazzled for 1 minute.

_desc_en:
Requirements You aren't in dim light or darkness.

You take pride in the sheen of your armor, and how useful it is at distracting your enemies when you reflect light from it. Creatures within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] that can see you must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class] save against your class DC. Once a creature attempts a save against this effect, it's temporarily immune for 24 hours.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round and dazzled for 2 rounds.

Critical Failure The creature is blinded for 2 rounds and dazzled for 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 당신은 흐린 빛이나 어둠 속에 있지 않습니다.

당신은 자신의 갑옷 광택과, 거기서 빛을 반사해 적을 교란하는 유용함에 자부심을 느낍니다. 당신을 볼 수 있는 @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] 내의 생물은 당신의 클래스 DC에 대해 @Check[fortitude|against:class] 내성 굴림을 시도해야 합니다. 생물이 이 효과에 대해 내성 굴림을 시도하고 나면, 24시간 동안 일시적으로 면역이 됩니다.

대성공 그 생물은 영향받지 않습니다.

성공 그 생물은 1라운드 동안 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{눈부심} 상태가 됩니다.

실패 그 생물은 1라운드 동안 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{눈멈} 상태가 되고 2라운드 동안 눈부심 상태가 됩니다.

대실패 그 생물은 2라운드 동안 눈멈 상태가 되고 1분 동안 눈부심 상태가 됩니다.

name: Combat Climber

description.value: Your techniques allow you to fight as you climb. You're not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while Climbing and can Climb with a hand occupied. You must still use another hand and both legs to Climb.

_desc_en: Your techniques allow you to fight as you climb. You're not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while Climbing and can Climb with a hand occupied. You must still use another hand and both legs to Climb.
_desc_ko: 당신의 기술은 등반 중에도 전투를 가능하게 합니다. 등반 중에는 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 아니며, 한 손을 사용한 상태로도 등반할 수 있습니다. 다만 등반에는 여전히 다른 한 손과 양 다리를 사용해야 합니다.

name: Lesson of Unified Elusion

description.value: You and your student react as one to common threats. When you and your student are both targeted by the same effect that requires a Reflex saving throw, you and your student take the better of each of your die rolls for the save. You each still add your own Reflex save modifier to the die result.

_desc_en: You and your student react as one to common threats. When you and your student are both targeted by the same effect that requires a Reflex saving throw, you and your student take the better of each of your die rolls for the save. You each still add your own Reflex save modifier to the die result.
_desc_ko: 당신과 제자는 공통된 위협에 일체로 대응합니다. 당신과 제자가 모두 반사 내성 굴림 결과를 요구하는 동일한 효과의 대상이 될 경우, 내성 굴림 굴림 결과 중 더 좋은 값을 적용합니다. 각자 자신의 반사 내성 수정자를 내성 굴림 굴림 결과에 추가합니다.

name: Feet That Stride the Sky

description.value: You feel the call of the sky, or perhaps a desperate urge to test the limits of the earth's hold on you. When you or a creature you're mounted on attempts a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump}, you can spend a Mythic Point to allow you or the mount to attempt the check at mythic proficiency; determine the DC using the Long Jump DCs, and increase your maximum distance to double your Speed.

_desc_en: You feel the call of the sky, or perhaps a desperate urge to test the limits of the earth's hold on you. When you or a creature you're mounted on attempts a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump}, you can spend a Mythic Point to allow you or the mount to attempt the check at mythic proficiency; determine the DC using the Long Jump DCs, and increase your maximum distance to double your Speed.
_desc_ko: 하늘의 부름을 느끼거나, 어쩌면 지구의 구속을 시험해보고 싶은 절박한 충동을 느낀다. 당신이나 당신이 타고 있는 생물이 @link[actions.high-jump] 또는 @link[actions.long-jump]를 시도할 때, 신화 포인트를 소모하여 당신이나 탈것이 신화 숙련도로 해당 판정을 시도하다 할 수 있게 합니다. 멀리뛰기 난이도(DC)를 기준으로 DC를 결정하고, 최대 거리를 당신의 이동 속도의 두 배로 증가시킵니다.

name: Rising Hurricane

description.value:
A hurricane lifts your enemies into the air before bringing them crashing down in a bloody rain. Your hurricane appears in a cylinder that's 40 feet tall, has a @Template[cylinder|distance:15]{30-foot diameter}, and is within 120 feet. All creatures in the area take @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -6)/3)+2)d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. Lift any creature that fails its save to any height you choose within the area, move it up to 5 feet in any direction, then drop it. It takes falling damage normally unless it has a fly Speed.

Level (+3) The rain damage increases by 1d6, and the cylinder's height increases by 5 feet.

_desc_en:
A hurricane lifts your enemies into the air before bringing them crashing down in a bloody rain. Your hurricane appears in a cylinder that's 40 feet tall, has a @Template[cylinder|distance:15]{30-foot diameter}, and is within 120 feet. All creatures in the area take @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -6)/3)+2)d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. Lift any creature that fails its save to any height you choose within the area, move it up to 5 feet in any direction, then drop it. It takes falling damage normally unless it has a fly Speed.

Level (+3) The rain damage increases by 1d6, and the cylinder's height increases by 5 feet.
_desc_ko:
허리케인이 적들을 공중으로 들어 올린 후 피비린내 나는 비처럼 내리꽂아 부숴 버립니다. 허리케인은 높이 40피트, 15피트의 원통형 영역으로 나타나며, 120피트 이내에 존재합니다. 영역 내 모든 생물은 타격 피해를 입으며, 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 기본 인내 내성에 성공해야 합니다. 내성에 실패한 생물은 영역 내에서 당신이 선택한 높이까지 들어 올려지고, 어느 방향으로든 최대 5피트 이동한 후 떨어뜨려집니다. 비행 속도가 없는 경우 정상적으로 낙하 피해를 입습니다.

레벨 (+3) 비 피해가 1d6 증가하고 원통의 높이가 5피트 증가합니다.

name: Cackle

description.value: Your patron's power fills you with confidence, letting you sustain a magical working even as a quick burst of laughter leaves your lips. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YVK3JUkPVzHIeGXQ]{Cackle} hex.

_desc_en: Your patron's power fills you with confidence, letting you sustain a magical working even as a quick burst of laughter leaves your lips. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YVK3JUkPVzHIeGXQ]{Cackle} hex.
_desc_ko: 후원자의 힘이 당신을 자신감으로 채워, 입에서 터져 나오는 짧은 웃음소리 속에서도 마법 작업을 지속할 수 있게 합니다. 당신은 @link[spells.cackle] 저주를 배웁니다.

name: Moderate Enhance Venom

description.value:
You upgrade the vishkanyan venom you can apply with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.s4V7JWSMF9JPJAeX]{Envenom} to moderate vishkanyan venom. Envenom's frequency becomes once per 10 minutes.

Moderate Vishkanyan Venom (level 9)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[3d6[poison]] damage (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[4d6[poison]] damage (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[5d6[poison]] damage (1 round)

_desc_en:
You upgrade the vishkanyan venom you can apply with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.s4V7JWSMF9JPJAeX]{Envenom} to moderate vishkanyan venom. Envenom's frequency becomes once per 10 minutes.

Moderate Vishkanyan Venom (level 9)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[3d6[poison]] damage (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[4d6[poison]] damage (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[5d6[poison]] damage (1 round)
_desc_ko:
{Envenom}으로 적용 가능한 비슈카니안 독을 보통 비슈카니안 독으로 업그레이드합니다. Envenom의 사용 빈도가 10분에 한 번으로 변경됩니다.

중간 비슈카냔 맹독 (레벨 9)

발동 빈도 10분에 한 번

내성 굴림 인내

최대 지속 시간 6 라운드

1단계 3d6 독 피해 (1 라운드)

2단계 4d6 독 피해 (1라운드)

3단계 5d6 독 피해 (1 라운드)

name: Resilient Mind

description.value: You're firm in your convictions and have girded your mind against outside influence. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against mental effects. This bonus increases to +2 against mental effects originating from undead.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en: You're firm in your convictions and have girded your mind against outside influence. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against mental effects. This bonus increases to +2 against mental effects originating from undead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 확고한 신념을 지니고 외부 영향으로부터 마음을 단단히 다져 놓았습니다. 정신 효과에 대한 내성에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 보너스는 언데드로부터 비롯된 정신 효과에 대해서는 +2로 증가합니다.

name: Practiced Guidance

description.value: Making one's way to safety can be harrowing, but you have extensive practice at helping others along that path. When you roll a success to Aid a member of your crop, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: Making one's way to safety can be harrowing, but you have extensive practice at helping others along that path. When you roll a success to Aid a member of your crop, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 안전한 곳으로 가는 길은 해로우 카드 점술할 수 있지만, 당신은 그 길에서 타인을 돕는 데 풍부한 경험을 쌓았습니다. 동료에게 도움을 주는 데 성공을 굴릴 때, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Puzzle Solver

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You have a natural affinity for problem-solving and the unknown. Whenever you attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about a subject or creature, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next skill check regarding that creature or subject (even if you didn't succeed at the check). This bonus increases to +2 if you are a master in the skill used to Recall Knowledge.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

You have a natural affinity for problem-solving and the unknown. Whenever you attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about a subject or creature, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next skill check regarding that creature or subject (even if you didn't succeed at the check). This bonus increases to +2 if you are a master in the skill used to Recall Knowledge.
_desc_ko:
빈도 시간당 1회

당신은 문제 해결과 미지의 것에 대한 타고난 친화력을 지녔습니다. 어떤 주제나 생물에 대해 @link[actions.recall-knowledge]을 시도할 때마다, 해당 생물이나 주제에 관한 다음 기술 판정에서 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다(해당 판정에서 성공하지 못했더라도). 지식 회상 기술의 달인라면 이 보너스는 +2로 증가합니다.

name: Apparition Sense

description.value:
You can see and interact with things others can't. You have apparition sight, an imprecise sense that allows you to detect the presence of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} spirits, haunts, and undead within 30 feet of you.

You can allow a spirit or undead otherwise incapable of speech to speak through you as long as you are in direct contact with it. As an activity that takes 10 minutes, you can act as a link between disembodied souls and their mortal bodies. As long as you are in contact with both a spirit and a living body that belonged to it in life during that entire time, the spirit can use you to return to that body; this does not allow you to bring the dead back to life, but can assist in restoring a disembodied soul to a still-living body. If the body is occupied by another spirit or soul, that entity must succeed at a Will save against your spell DC or be cast from the body when its original owner is returned.

_desc_en:
You can see and interact with things others can't. You have apparition sight, an imprecise sense that allows you to detect the presence of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} spirits, haunts, and undead within 30 feet of you.

You can allow a spirit or undead otherwise incapable of speech to speak through you as long as you are in direct contact with it. As an activity that takes 10 minutes, you can act as a link between disembodied souls and their mortal bodies. As long as you are in contact with both a spirit and a living body that belonged to it in life during that entire time, the spirit can use you to return to that body; this does not allow you to bring the dead back to life, but can assist in restoring a disembodied soul to a still-living body. If the body is occupied by another spirit or soul, that entity must succeed at a Will save against your spell DC or be cast from the body when its original owner is returned.
_desc_ko:
다른 이들이 볼 수 없는 것들을 보고 상호작용할 수 있습니다. 당신은 유령 시력을 지니고 있어, 30피트 이내의 @link[conditions.invisible] 또는 @link[conditions.hidden]된 영혼, 유령, 언데드의 존재를 감지할 수 있는 불확실한 감각을 가집니다.

말할 수 없는 영혼이나 언데드가 당신과 직접 접촉하는 동안 당신을 통해 말하도록 할 수 있습니다. 10분이 소요되는 활동으로, 당신은 육체를 잃은 영혼과 그 영혼이 생전에 속했던 육체 사이의 연결고리 역할을 할 수 있습니다. 그 시간 내내 영혼과 생전에 그 영혼이 속했던 살아있는 육체 모두와 접촉을 유지하는 한, 영혼은 당신을 통해 그 육체로 돌아갈 수 있습니다. 이는 죽은 자를 되살리는 것은 아니지만, 육체를 잃은 영혼을 아직 살아있는 육체로 되돌리는 데 도움을 줄 수 있습니다. 해당 육체가 다른 영혼이나 정신에 점유된 경우, 그 존재는 당신의 주문 DC에 대한 의지 내성에 성공해야 하며, 그렇지 않으면 원래 주인이 돌아올 때 육체에서 쫓겨나게 됩니다.

name: Automaton Armament

description.value:
You've been provided a body part designed for combat. You gain either a claw or pincer unarmed attack. The claw deals 1d4 slashing damage, is in the brawling group, and has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits. The pincer deals 1d6 piercing damage, is in the brawling group, and has the grapple and unarmed traits. Your body can be reconfigured; you can select this feat at any level, and you can retrain into or out of this feat or change the type of attack you gain.

Enhancement Your attacking part is reinforced. Increase the damage die of the unarmed attack you gain from this feat by one step (from 1d4 to 1d6, or from 1d6 to 1d8).

_desc_en:
You've been provided a body part designed for combat. You gain either a claw or pincer unarmed attack. The claw deals 1d4 slashing damage, is in the brawling group, and has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits. The pincer deals 1d6 piercing damage, is in the brawling group, and has the grapple and unarmed traits. Your body can be reconfigured; you can select this feat at any level, and you can retrain into or out of this feat or change the type of attack you gain.

Enhancement Your attacking part is reinforced. Increase the damage die of the unarmed attack you gain from this feat by one step (from 1d4 to 1d6, or from 1d6 to 1d8).
_desc_ko:
전투용으로 설계된 신체 부위를 부여받았습니다. 발톱 또는 집게발 비무장 공격 중 하나를 획득합니다. 발톱은 1d4 베기 피해를 입히며, 격투 무기 그룹에 속하고 기민성, 기교, 무장 특성을 지닙니다. 집게는 1d6 관통 피해를 입히며, 난투 무기 그룹에 속하고, 붙잡기와 비무장 공격을 가집니다. 신체는 재구성 가능하며, 이 피트는 레벨에 상관없이 선택할 수 있고, 재훈련을 통해 획득하거나 포기하거나 획득하는 공격 유형을 변경할 수 있습니다.

강화 공격 부위가 강화됩니다. 이 재주로 얻는 비무장 공격의 피해 주사위를 한 단계 증가시킵니다(1d4 → 1d6, 또는 1d6 → 1d8).

name: Thorough Reports

description.value: Your reports are thorough and informative, and putting your thoughts to paper helps you retain the information. Keep track of each type of creature you successfully identify with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}. When attempting Recall Knowledge checks against creatures on your list in later encounters, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus, and you learn an additional fact about such creatures on a success.

_desc_en: Your reports are thorough and informative, and putting your thoughts to paper helps you retain the information. Keep track of each type of creature you successfully identify with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}. When attempting Recall Knowledge checks against creatures on your list in later encounters, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus, and you learn an additional fact about such creatures on a success.
_desc_ko: 당신의 보고서는 철저하고 유익하며, 생각을 종이에 적는 것이 정보를 기억하는 데 도움이 됩니다. @link[actions.recall-knowledge]으로 성공적으로 식별한 각 생물 유형을 기록해 두세요. 이후 전투에서 목록에 있는 생물에 대해 지식 회상 판정을 시도하다 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 성공 시 해당 생물에 관한 추가 정보를 습득합니다.

name: Form Lock

description.value:
Requirements You have a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

Your ability to manipulate your enemy's entire body is potent enough that you can tear and break apart alternate forms. Attempt an Athletics check to counteract a polymorph effect currently affecting the creature you have grabbed or restrained. If the target is somehow under the effect of multiple polymorph effects, you can choose which one to attempt to counteract; the GM chooses randomly if the separate effects aren't obvious. The target is then temporarily immune for 1 day.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

Your ability to manipulate your enemy's entire body is potent enough that you can tear and break apart alternate forms. Attempt an Athletics check to counteract a polymorph effect currently affecting the creature you have grabbed or restrained. If the target is somehow under the effect of multiple polymorph effects, you can choose which one to attempt to counteract; the GM chooses randomly if the separate effects aren't obvious. The target is then temporarily immune for 1 day.
_desc_ko:
Requirements 당신은 생물 @link[conditions.grabbed] 또는 @link[conditions.restrained] 상태입니다.

당신의 적의 전신을 조종하는 능력은 대체 형태를 찢고 부수기에 충분할 정도로 강력합니다. 잡거나 구속한 생물에게 현재 걸린 변형 효과를 반격하기 위해 운동 판정을 시도하십시오. 대상이 여러 변형 효과의 영향을 받고 있다면, 반격할 효과를 선택할 수 있습니다. 별개의 효과가 명확하지 않은 경우 GM이 무작위로 선택합니다. 대상은 이후 1일간 일시적으로 면역 상태가 됩니다.

name: Retaliating Rescue

description.value: When an ally is in danger, you can hustle to reach them and punish the foe threatening them. Stride up to your Speed. You must end this movement adjacent to an ally who is within an enemy's reach. Then, you push your ally up to 5 feet (as normal for forced movement, this movement doesn't trigger reactions) and make a melee Strike against an enemy within your reach. If your ally was in that enemy's reach and your push moved them out of it, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your attack roll.

_desc_en: When an ally is in danger, you can hustle to reach them and punish the foe threatening them. Stride up to your Speed. You must end this movement adjacent to an ally who is within an enemy's reach. Then, you push your ally up to 5 feet (as normal for forced movement, this movement doesn't trigger reactions) and make a melee Strike against an enemy within your reach. If your ally was in that enemy's reach and your push moved them out of it, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your attack roll.
_desc_ko: 동료가 위험에 처했을 때, 당신은 서두르며 달려가 위협하는 적을 응징할 수 있습니다. 이동 속도만큼의 거리를 순식간에 이동합니다. 이 이동을 끝낼 때는 반드시 적의 공격 범위 내에 있는 동료와 인접한 위치에 있어야 합니다. 그런 다음, 아군을 최대 5피트까지 밀어내며(강제 이동 규칙 적용, 이 이동은 반응을 유발하지 않음) 자신의 도달 범위 내 적에게 근접 공격을 가한다. 아군이 해당 적의 도달 범위 내에 있었고 밀어내기 동작으로 그 범위 밖으로 이동시켰다면, 명중 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻는다.

name: Herbal Forager

description.value: Your skill with herbs has improved. Each day as part of your daily preparations, you can harvest ingredients from your surroundings to craft one temporary alchemical item you know the formula for. This alchemical item must have the healing trait. If not consumed by your next daily preparations, the item is rendered inert.

_desc_en: Your skill with herbs has improved. Each day as part of your daily preparations, you can harvest ingredients from your surroundings to craft one temporary alchemical item you know the formula for. This alchemical item must have the healing trait. If not consumed by your next daily preparations, the item is rendered inert.
_desc_ko: 당신의 약초 활용 능력이 향상되었습니다. 매일 일일 준비의 일환으로 주변에서 재료를 채취하여, 당신이 제조법을 알고 있는 임시 연금술 아이템 하나를 제작할 수 있습니다. 이 연금술 아이템은 반드시 치유 특성을 가져야 합니다. 다음 일일 준비까지 소비되지 않으면, 해당 아이템은 효력을 잃습니다.

name: Alchemical Discoveries

description.value: You've devoted extra time in the lab to improve your knowledge of alchemy. You learn the formulas for two alchemical items each time you level up instead of one; these must still be elixirs or tools. The number of versatile vials you can create each day increases by one if you're an expert in Crafting, two if you're a master, or three if you're legendary.

_desc_en: You've devoted extra time in the lab to improve your knowledge of alchemy. You learn the formulas for two alchemical items each time you level up instead of one; these must still be elixirs or tools. The number of versatile vials you can create each day increases by one if you're an expert in Crafting, two if you're a master, or three if you're legendary.
_desc_ko: 실험실에서 추가 시간을 투자해 연금술 지식을 향상시켰습니다. 레벨업할 때마다 알케미 아이템 제조법을 하나가 아닌 두 개씩 습득합니다. 이 아이템들은 여전히 엘릭서나 도구여야 합니다. 제작 기술이 전문가 수준이면 하루에 만들 수 있는 다용도 약병 수가 1개 증가하고, 달인 수준이면 2개, 전설급이면 3개 증가합니다.

name: Pack Stalker

description.value: Ambushes are an honored kholo tradition. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.beyw5bdA5hkQbmaG]{Terrain Stalker} feat and can extend its effects to a single ally so long as they remain within 10 feet of you. If you have master proficiency in Stealth, you can extend the effect to two allies. If you have legendary proficiency in Stealth, you can extend it to four allies.

_desc_en: Ambushes are an honored kholo tradition. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.beyw5bdA5hkQbmaG]{Terrain Stalker} feat and can extend its effects to a single ally so long as they remain within 10 feet of you. If you have master proficiency in Stealth, you can extend the effect to two allies. If you have legendary proficiency in Stealth, you can extend it to four allies.
_desc_ko: 매복은 콜로 종족의 오랜 전통이다. @link[feats.terrain-stalker] 재주를 획득하며, 10피트 이내에 머무르는 한 동맹 한 명에게 그 효과를 확장할 수 있습니다. 은신에 숙련을 달인했다면 두 명의 동맹에게, 전설적인 숙련을 가졌다면 네 명의 동맹에게 효과를 확장할 수 있습니다.

name: Bon Mot

description.value:
You launch an insightful quip at a foe, distracting them. Choose a foe within 30 feet and roll a @Check[diplomacy|against:will] check against the target's Will DC.

Critical Success The target is distracted and takes a –3 status penalty to Perception and Will saves for 1 minute.

The target can end the effect early with a retort to your Bon Mot. This can either be a single action that has the concentrate trait or an appropriate skill action to frame their retort. The GM determines which skill actions qualify, though they must take at least 1 action. Typically, the retort needs to use a linguistic Charisma-based skill action.

Success As critical success, but the penalty is –2.

Critical Failure Your quip is atrocious. You take the same penalty an enemy would take had you succeeded. This ends after 1 minute or if you issue another Bon Mot and succeed.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.GoSls6SKCFmSoDxT]{Effect: Bon Mot}

_desc_en:
You launch an insightful quip at a foe, distracting them. Choose a foe within 30 feet and roll a @Check[diplomacy|against:will] check against the target's Will DC.

Critical Success The target is distracted and takes a –3 status penalty to Perception and Will saves for 1 minute.

The target can end the effect early with a retort to your Bon Mot. This can either be a single action that has the concentrate trait or an appropriate skill action to frame their retort. The GM determines which skill actions qualify, though they must take at least 1 action. Typically, the retort needs to use a linguistic Charisma-based skill action.

Success As critical success, but the penalty is –2.

Critical Failure Your quip is atrocious. You take the same penalty an enemy would take had you succeeded. This ends after 1 minute or if you issue another Bon Mot and succeed.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.GoSls6SKCFmSoDxT]{Effect: Bon Mot}
_desc_ko:
적에게 통찰력 있는 재치 있는 말을 던져 주의를 분산시킵니다. 30피트 내의 적을 선택하고 대상의 의지 DC에 대해 외교 굴림을 수행합니다.

대성공 대상은 주의가 산만해져 1분 동안 지각 및 의지 내성에 -3 상태 페널티를 받습니다.

대상은 당신의 재치 있는 말에 반박하여 효과를 조기에 종료할 수 있습니다. 이는 집중 특성이 있는 액션 하나가거나 적절한 기술 행동으로 반박을 구성하는 것입니다. GM이 어떤 기술 행동이 해당되는지 결정하지만, 최소 1개의 행동을 취해야 합니다. 일반적으로 반박은 언어적 매력 기반 기술 행동을 사용해야 합니다.

성공 대성공과 동일하나, 페널티는 -2입니다.

대실패 당신의 재치 있는 말은 형편없습니다. 성공했을 때 적에게 적용되는 것과 동일한 페널티를 받습니다. 이 효과는 1분 후 또는 다른 재치 있는 말을 성공적으로 사용하면 종료됩니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.GoSls6SKCFmSoDxT]{효과: 재치 있는 말}

name: Expeditious Advance

description.value:
Requirements You are unarmored or wearing light armor.

You advance and retreat quickly. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your speed.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are unarmored or wearing light armor.

You advance and retreat quickly. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your speed.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 갑옷을 입지 않았거나 경갑을 착용 중이어야 합니다.

당신은 신속하게 전진하고 후퇴합니다. 이동 속도에 +10피트 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Tributary Circulation

description.value: Never distant from water's succoring presence, your refined breathing techniques focus your awareness and control of water inward. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Will saves and saves against poison until the beginning of your next turn. If you spent two actions on Tributary Circulation, you can also attempt a flat check to end persistent poison damage you're suffering, reducing the DC to 10 as if you had gained the benefits of assisted recovery.

_desc_en: Never distant from water's succoring presence, your refined breathing techniques focus your awareness and control of water inward. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Will saves and saves against poison until the beginning of your next turn. If you spent two actions on Tributary Circulation, you can also attempt a flat check to end persistent poison damage you're suffering, reducing the DC to 10 as if you had gained the benefits of assisted recovery.
_desc_ko: 물의 치유적 존재로부터 결코 멀어지지 않은 채, 정교한 호흡 기술로 물에 대한 인식과 통제를 내면으로 포커스합니다. 다음 차례 시작까지 의지 내성 및 독 내성에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 지류 순환에 두 행동을 사용했다면, 지속적 독 피해를 끝내기 위한 단순 판정을 시도할 수 있으며, 마치 보조 회복의 혜택을 얻은 것처럼 DC를 10으로 낮출 수 있습니다.

name: Rebel's Map

description.value:
Trigger You roll initiative.

Rebellions require an intricate knowledge of one's surroundings—because you might need to escape at any moment. You remember the locations of escape routes, ambush spots, and cover from a scouting expedition or a previous visit to the area. Roll a [[/r 1d20]]{d20}. At any point during the subsequent combat, you can substitute the result of this roll instead of rolling a d20 on one Deception check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} or on one Stealth check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}.

value.value: Horizon Walker Dedication or Scout Dedication

_desc_en:
Trigger You roll initiative.

Rebellions require an intricate knowledge of one's surroundings—because you might need to escape at any moment. You remember the locations of escape routes, ambush spots, and cover from a scouting expedition or a previous visit to the area. Roll a [[/r 1d20]]{d20}. At any point during the subsequent combat, you can substitute the result of this roll instead of rolling a d20 on one Deception check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} or on one Stealth check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신은 인니셔티브를 굴립니다.

반란은 주변 환경에 대한 정교한 지식을 요구한다-언제든 도주해야 할 상황이 발생할 수 있기 때문이다. 정찰 활동이나 해당 지역 방문 경험을 통해 탈출 경로, 매복 지점, 은신처의 위치를 기억하고 있다. d20을 굴려라. 이후 전투 중 언제든지, @link[actions.create-a-diversion]을 위한 한 번의 속임수 판정나 @link[actions.hide]를 위한 한 번의 은신 판정에서 d20을 굴리는 대신 이 결과로 대체할 수 있다.

name: Drag Down

description.value:
While swimming in water at least 10 feet deep, you grab an adjacent creature (on nearby land or in the water) and pull it below the surface.

Attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} the creature. On a success, if the creature is on land, in addition to the normal effects of Grapple, you pull the creature into the water in a space adjacent to you. If the creature is already in the water, on a success, in addition the normal effects of Grapple, you drag the creature 10 feet deeper into the water, moving 10 feet with the creature.

Moving a creature into water or deeper into water using Drag Down is forced movement for the creature but not for you.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Absalom, City of Lost Omens

_desc_en:
While swimming in water at least 10 feet deep, you grab an adjacent creature (on nearby land or in the water) and pull it below the surface.

Attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} the creature. On a success, if the creature is on land, in addition to the normal effects of Grapple, you pull the creature into the water in a space adjacent to you. If the creature is already in the water, on a success, in addition the normal effects of Grapple, you drag the creature 10 feet deeper into the water, moving 10 feet with the creature.

Moving a creature into water or deeper into water using Drag Down is forced movement for the creature but not for you.
_desc_ko:
최소 10피트 깊이의 물속에서 수영할 때, 인접한 생물(근처 육지 또는 물속)을 붙잡기하여 수면 아래로 끌어당깁니다.

해당 생물을 @link[actions.grapple]하기 위해 운동 판정을 시도한다. 성공 시, 생물이 육지에 있을 경우 일반적인 붙잡기 효과에 더해 그 생물을 당신과 인접한 공간의 물속으로 끌어당깁니다. 생물이 이미 물속에 있을 경우 성공 시, 일반적인 붙잡기 효과에 더해 그 생물을 물속으로 10피트 더 깊이 끌고 들어가며, 생물과 함께 10피트를 이동합니다.

끌어내리기로 생물을 물속으로 이동시키거나 더 깊은 물속으로 끌고 가는 것은 해당 생물에게는 강제 이동이지만, 당신에게는 해당되지 않습니다.

name: Regurgitate Mutagen

description.value:
Requirements You are under the effects of a mutagen.

You redirect a mutagen within your body to spit a stream of stomach acid at a foe. A creature within 30 feet takes 1d6 acid damage for every 2 levels you have (@Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))d6[acid]]), with a @Check[reflex|against:alchemist|basic] save against your class DC. On a failure, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure). The mutagen's duration immediately ends.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are under the effects of a mutagen.

You redirect a mutagen within your body to spit a stream of stomach acid at a foe. A creature within 30 feet takes 1d6 acid damage for every 2 levels you have (@Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))d6[acid]]), with a @Check[reflex|against:alchemist|basic] save against your class DC. On a failure, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure). The mutagen's duration immediately ends.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 변이 유발 물질의 영향을 받고 있습니다.

당신은 체내의 혈청을 재조정하여 적에게 위산 줄기를 뱉어냅니다. 30피트 내의 생물은 당신이 가진 레벨 2당 1d6 산성 피해를 입으며( ]), 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 기본 반사 내성을 발휘합니다. 저항에 실패한 생물은 @link[conditions.sickened]{1} 상태가 되며(대실패 시 @link[conditions.sickened]{2}), 혈청의 지속 시간은 즉시 종료된다.

name: Eye for Numbers

description.value:
You've learned to quickly estimate the number of items in a group with relative accuracy at only a glance. You immediately learn the number of visually similar items in a group you can see, rounded to the first digit in the total number. For example, you could look at a case of potion vials and learn that it held about 30 vials, but you wouldn't know that it was exactly 33 vials, how many different types of potions there were, or how many of which type. Similarly, you could look at a pile of 2,805 coins and know that there were about 3,000 coins in all. You can use this ability only on items that can typically be counted, so you can't use it on grains of sand or stars in the sky, for example.

If you count a specific number of items possessed by an enemy, such as the number of coins or pieces of equipment they're carrying, you can use this information the next time you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} against that target within 1 minute. If you do, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your check and can use Society instead of Deception for the check.

You can use this action during an attempt to Decipher Writing that is primarily numerical or mathematical to gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your check.

_desc_en:
You've learned to quickly estimate the number of items in a group with relative accuracy at only a glance. You immediately learn the number of visually similar items in a group you can see, rounded to the first digit in the total number. For example, you could look at a case of potion vials and learn that it held about 30 vials, but you wouldn't know that it was exactly 33 vials, how many different types of potions there were, or how many of which type. Similarly, you could look at a pile of 2,805 coins and know that there were about 3,000 coins in all. You can use this ability only on items that can typically be counted, so you can't use it on grains of sand or stars in the sky, for example.

If you count a specific number of items possessed by an enemy, such as the number of coins or pieces of equipment they're carrying, you can use this information the next time you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} against that target within 1 minute. If you do, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your check and can use Society instead of Deception for the check.

You can use this action during an attempt to Decipher Writing that is primarily numerical or mathematical to gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your check.
_desc_ko:
한눈에 그룹 내 물품 수를 상대적으로 정확하게 빠르게 추정하는 법을 익혔습니다. 시야에 들어온 시각적으로 유사한 물건들의 수를 즉시 파악할 수 있으며, 총 수의 첫 자리 숫자로 반올림하여 알 수 있습니다. 예를 들어, 물약 병이 든 상자를 보고 약 30병이 들어 있음을 알 수 있지만, 정확히 33병인지, 몇 종류의 물약이 있는지, 각 종류별 개수는 알 수 없습니다. 마찬가지로, 2,805개의 동전이 쌓여 있는 것을 보면 전체가 약 3,000개 정도임을 알 수 있습니다. 이 능력은 일반적으로 셀 수 있는 물건에만 사용할 수 있으므로, 예를 들어 모래알이나 하늘의 별에는 사용할 수 없습니다.

적의 소지품 중 특정 수량(예: 동전이나 장비의 개수)을 세어 기록해 두면, 1분 이내에 해당 대상에게 @link[actions.feint] 또는 @link[actions.create-a-diversion]을 사용할 때 이 정보를 활용할 수 있습니다. 이 경우, 해당 판정에서 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 판정 시 기만 대신 사회성을 사용할 수 있습니다.

주로 숫자나 수학적인 내용을 해독하는 시도하는 중 이 행동을 사용하면, 해당 판정에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Energy Heart

description.value:
Your eidolon's heart beats with energy.

Choose an energy damage type other than force. One of its unarmed attacks changes its damage type to the chosen type, and it gains resistance to that type equal to half your level (minimum 1).

_desc_en:
Your eidolon's heart beats with energy.

Choose an energy damage type other than force. One of its unarmed attacks changes its damage type to the chosen type, and it gains resistance to that type equal to half your level (minimum 1).
_desc_ko:
당신의 에이돌론의 심장은 에너지로 뛰고 있다.

힘 이외의 에너지 피해 유형 하나를 선택한다. 비무장 공격 중 하나가 선택한 유형으로 피해 유형이 변경되며, 해당 유형에 대해 네 레벨의 절반(최소 1)에 해당하는 저항력을 얻는다.

name: Restorative Channel

description.value: You can remove conditions with divine grace. You can sacrifice one @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} spell you've prepared in your extra slots from your healing font to cast one of the following spells instead: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EfFMLVbmkBWmzoLF]{Clear Mind}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Et8RSCLx8w7uOLvo]{Sound Body}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.BCuHKrDeJ4eq53M6]{Sure Footing}. The spell is heightened to the same rank as the spell you sacrificed.

_desc_en: You can remove conditions with divine grace. You can sacrifice one @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} spell you've prepared in your extra slots from your healing font to cast one of the following spells instead: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EfFMLVbmkBWmzoLF]{Clear Mind}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Et8RSCLx8w7uOLvo]{Sound Body}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.BCuHKrDeJ4eq53M6]{Sure Footing}. The spell is heightened to the same rank as the spell you sacrificed.
_desc_ko: 신성한 은총으로 상태 이상을 제거할 수 있습니다. 치유 원천의 추가 슬롯에 준비해 둔 @link[spells.heal] 주문 하나를 희생하여 다음 주문 중 하나를 대신 시전할 수 있습니다: @link[spells.cleanse-affliction], @link[spells.clear-mind], @link[spells.sound-body], 또는 @link[spells.sure-footing] 중 하나를 대신 시전할 수 있습니다. 시전된 주문은 희생한 주문과 동일한 랭크으로 강화됩니다.

name: Sailfish Strike

description.value:
Trigger You reach the top of your Propelled Leap.

You've learned how to convert your upward momentum into a powerful attack. At the top of your Propelled Leap, you can make a melee or ranged Strike as a reaction instead of choosing to [[/act grab-an-edge]]. Your Strike gains a +4 circumstance bonus to damage. After your attack, hit or miss, you fall back into the water.

_desc_en:
Trigger You reach the top of your Propelled Leap.

You've learned how to convert your upward momentum into a powerful attack. At the top of your Propelled Leap, you can make a melee or ranged Strike as a reaction instead of choosing to [[/act grab-an-edge]]. Your Strike gains a +4 circumstance bonus to damage. After your attack, hit or miss, you fall back into the water.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신이 추진 도약의 정점에 도달합니다.

당신은 위로 향하는 추진력을 강력한 공격으로 전환하는 법을 배웠습니다. 추진 도약의 정점에서, [[/act grab-an-edge]]를 선택하는 대신 반응으로 근접 또는 원거리 타격을 할 수 있습니다. 당신의 타격은 피해에 +4 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 명중이든 빗나감이든, 공격 후 당신은 물속으로 다시 떨어집니다.

name: Shattering Spellstrike

description.value:
Requirements You're in Arcane Cascade stance and wielding an improvised weapon.

You intentionally channel a rampaging cascade of magic through your weapon, breaking it to deal more damage. Make a Spellstrike against a target with your improvised weapon. If the attack hits, it deals an additional @Damage[2d6[force]] damage as your improvised weapon breaks. If the spell used with the Spellstrike wasn't a cantrip or focus spell, increase this additional damage by the spell's rank.

If the item has a Hardness greater than your level, or if it's an artifact, cursed item, or other item that's difficult to break or destroy, it doesn't break and you don't deal additional damage.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're in Arcane Cascade stance and wielding an improvised weapon.

You intentionally channel a rampaging cascade of magic through your weapon, breaking it to deal more damage. Make a Spellstrike against a target with your improvised weapon. If the attack hits, it deals an additional @Damage[2d6[force]] damage as your improvised weapon breaks. If the spell used with the Spellstrike wasn't a cantrip or focus spell, increase this additional damage by the spell's rank.

If the item has a Hardness greater than your level, or if it's an artifact, cursed item, or other item that's difficult to break or destroy, it doesn't break and you don't deal additional damage.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 아케인 캐스케이드 자세를 취하고 있으며, 즉석 무기를 휘두르고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 의도적으로 무기를 통해 마법의 격렬한 캐스케이드를 집중시켜, 무기를 부수며 더 큰 피해를 입힙니다. 임시 무기로 대상에게 스펠스트라이크를 가합니다. 공격이 명중하면, 임시 무기가 부서지면서 추가로 2d6 역장의 피해를 입힙니다. 마법 타격에 사용된 주문이 캔트립이나 포커스 주문이 아닌 경우, 이 추가 피해는 해당 주문의 랭크만큼 증가합니다.

해당 아이템의 경도가 당신의 레벨보다 높거나, 유물, 저주받은 아이템, 기타 파괴하기 어려운 아이템인 경우, 무기는 부서지지 않으며 추가 피해를 입히지 않습니다.

name: Forever Among Humanity

description.value: Passing unseen within society is second nature to you now. You can use Among Humanity three times per day instead of once per day.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Passing unseen within society is second nature to you now. You can use Among Humanity three times per day instead of once per day.
_desc_ko: 사회 속에서 눈에 띄지 않고 지나가는 것은 이제 당신에게 제2의 본능이 되었다. 인간 속에 숨기를 하루에 한 번이 아닌 세 번 사용할 수 있다.

name: Tunneling Claws

description.value: You have elongated claws and enhanced senses, making you uncanny at digging the underground passageways needed to construct ghoul warrens and rob graves without arousing suspicion. You gain a burrow Speed of 15 feet and a tremorsense (imprecise) of 60 feet. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.H6v1VgowHaKHnVlG]{Burrow} through any earthen matter, including rock, while moving at your full burrow Speed. When you move in this way, you can choose either to leave tunnels behind you that are large enough to allow creatures of your size or smaller to move through them or move through the ground while leaving no tunnels or signs of your passing.

_desc_en: You have elongated claws and enhanced senses, making you uncanny at digging the underground passageways needed to construct ghoul warrens and rob graves without arousing suspicion. You gain a burrow Speed of 15 feet and a tremorsense (imprecise) of 60 feet. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.H6v1VgowHaKHnVlG]{Burrow} through any earthen matter, including rock, while moving at your full burrow Speed. When you move in this way, you can choose either to leave tunnels behind you that are large enough to allow creatures of your size or smaller to move through them or move through the ground while leaving no tunnels or signs of your passing.
_desc_ko: 당신은 길쭉한 발톱과 강화된 감각을 지녀, 구울 굴을 건설하거나 의심을 사지 않고 무덤을 털기 위해 필요한 지하 통로를 파내는 데 놀라운 능력을 발휘합니다. 땅속 이동 속도 15피트와 진동 감지(정확하지 않음) 60피트를 얻습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.burrow] 능력으로 바위를 포함한 모든 토양 물질을 완전한 굴착 속도로 이동하며 통과할 수 있습니다. 이 방식으로 이동할 때, 당신은 자신의 크기 이하의 생물이 통과할 수 있을 만큼 넓은 터널을 남기거나, 터널이나 이동 흔적을 전혀 남기지 않고 지면을 통과할 수 있습니다.

name: Fortified Mind

description.value: Your mind is unusually resilient and resistant to influence. When you would gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} or stupefied condition, you can attempt a @Check[flat|dc:17]. On a success, you don't gain the fascinated or stupefied condition.

_desc_en: Your mind is unusually resilient and resistant to influence. When you would gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} or stupefied condition, you can attempt a @Check[flat|dc:17]. On a success, you don't gain the fascinated or stupefied condition.
_desc_ko: 당신의 정신은 비정상적으로 탄력적이고 영향에 저항력이 있습니다. @link[conditions.fascinated] 상태나 멍함 상태를 얻게 될 때, DC 17 단순를 시도할 수 있습니다. 성공 시, 매혹 상태나 멍함 상태를 얻지 않습니다.

name: Expert Bard Spellcasting

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{Expert Spellcasting Feat} benefits.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{Expert Spellcasting Feat} benefits.
_desc_ko: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{전문 주문 시전 피트}의 혜택을 얻습니다.

name: Solo Dancer

description.value: You often dance alone with a grace exceeding that of most other performers, carrying yourself with a poise and confidence that draws the attention of those around you. You can always roll Performance for initiative, and during the first round of combat, creatures that act after you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You often dance alone with a grace exceeding that of most other performers, carrying yourself with a poise and confidence that draws the attention of those around you. You can always roll Performance for initiative, and during the first round of combat, creatures that act after you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you.
_desc_ko: 당신은 종종 다른 공연자들보다 뛰어난 우아함으로 홀로 춤을 추며, 주변 사람들의 시선을 사로잡는 당당함과 자신감으로 자신을 표현합니다. 당신은 항상 인니셔티브를 결정할 때 공연 능력을 굴릴 수 있으며, 전투 첫 라운드 동안 당신보다 나중에 행동하는 생물들은 당신에게 @link[conditions.off-guard]가 됩니다.

name: Drain Soul Cage

description.value: You make your soul cage into your bonded item, allowing you to harness its abundant magical energy. Once per day, when you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.v82XtjAVN4ffgVVR]{Drain Bonded Item}, you can choose any spell in your spellbook that you can cast, even if you haven't prepared or cast it that day. Your soul cage doesn't need to be on your person for you to use Drain Bonded Item. If your soul cage is broken or destroyed, you can't use Drain Soul Cage. Even if you can Drain Bonded Item more than once per day, for instance if you are a universalist wizard, you can still only choose a spell you haven't prepared and cast once per day.

_desc_en: You make your soul cage into your bonded item, allowing you to harness its abundant magical energy. Once per day, when you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.v82XtjAVN4ffgVVR]{Drain Bonded Item}, you can choose any spell in your spellbook that you can cast, even if you haven't prepared or cast it that day. Your soul cage doesn't need to be on your person for you to use Drain Bonded Item. If your soul cage is broken or destroyed, you can't use Drain Soul Cage. Even if you can Drain Bonded Item more than once per day, for instance if you are a universalist wizard, you can still only choose a spell you haven't prepared and cast once per day.
_desc_ko: 당신은 영혼의 감옥을 결속 아이템으로 만들어 그 풍부한 마법 에너지를 활용할 수 있게 됩니다. 하루에 한 번, @link[actions.drain-bonded-item]를 사용할 때, 그날 준비하거나 시전하지 않았더라도 주문서에 있는 시전 가능한 주문 중 아무거나 선택할 수 있습니다. 영혼의 감옥이 몸에 지니고 있지 않아도 영혼의 감옥 흡수 사용이 가능하다. 영혼의 감옥이 파손되거나 파괴된 경우 영혼의 감옥 흡수를 사용할 수 없다. 하루에 영혼의 감옥 흡수를 여러 번 사용할 수 있는 경우(예: 범용 위자드)에도, 하루에 한 번만 준비하지 않았거나 시전하지 않은 주문을 선택할 수 있다.

name: Piston Punch

description.value: You lash out with a powerful punch, extending your dynamo to a greater length in order to attack two creatures in a row. Make a single bludgeoning or piercing dynamo Strike and compare the attack roll result to the ACs of up to two foes. The first foe must be within your melee reach and the second foe must be adjacent to the first foe in a straight line away from you. Roll damage only once and apply it to each creature you hit. A Piston Punch counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty. Reduce the operational time of your sterling dynamo by 1 hour.

_desc_en: You lash out with a powerful punch, extending your dynamo to a greater length in order to attack two creatures in a row. Make a single bludgeoning or piercing dynamo Strike and compare the attack roll result to the ACs of up to two foes. The first foe must be within your melee reach and the second foe must be adjacent to the first foe in a straight line away from you. Roll damage only once and apply it to each creature you hit. A Piston Punch counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty. Reduce the operational time of your sterling dynamo by 1 hour.
_desc_ko: 강력한 펀치를 휘둘러, 두 생물을 연속으로 공격하기 위해 다이나모를 더 길게 뻗습니다. 둔기 또는 관통 다이나모 타격을 한 번 수행하고, 명중 굴림 결과를 최대 두 명의 적의 AC와 비교합니다. 첫 번째 적은 근접 공격 범위 내에 있어야 하며, 두 번째 적은 첫 번째 적과 직선으로 연결된 상태에서 당신으로부터 멀어지는 방향에 인접해 있어야 합니다. 피해는 한 번만 굴리고 명중한 각 생물에게 적용합니다. 피스톤 펀치는 다중 공격 페널티 계산 시 두 번의 공격으로 간주됩니다. 스털링 다이나모의 작동 시간을 1시간 감소시킵니다.

name: Abscission Shards

description.value:
Requirements Your last action was a successful frenzied claw or spinning talon Strike.

You twist your claw, breaking off a piece in your target. The shard deals @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] damage. This increases to 2d6 if your unarmed attacks deal three weapon damage dice, such as under a greater striking rune, and 3d6 if they deal four weapon damage dice.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your last action was a successful frenzied claw or spinning talon Strike.

You twist your claw, breaking off a piece in your target. The shard deals @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] damage. This increases to 2d6 if your unarmed attacks deal three weapon damage dice, such as under a greater striking rune, and 3d6 if they deal four weapon damage dice.
_desc_ko:
마지막 행동이 성공한 광란의 발톱 또는 회전 발톱 공격이어야 합니다.

당신은 발톱을 비틀어 대상에게서 조각을 떼어냅니다. 이 파편은 1d6 지속 출혈의 피해를 줍니다. 이 피해는 비무장 공격이 강타 (중급) 룬과 같이 무기 피해 주사위 3개를 주는 경우 2d6로, 4개를 주는 경우 3d6로 증가합니다.

name: Snap Shot

description.value: You can react with ranged weapons when a creature is in close quarters. You can use a reaction that normally allows you to make a melee weapon Strike to instead make a ranged weapon Strike. You must be Striking an adjacent target. If necessary for the reaction's trigger, you treat your ranged weapon as if it had a reach of 5 feet. If the reaction has other requirements, such as wielding a specific kind of weapon, Snap Shot doesn't allow you to ignore them; it allows you only to replace a melee weapon Strike with a ranged weapon Strike.

_desc_en: You can react with ranged weapons when a creature is in close quarters. You can use a reaction that normally allows you to make a melee weapon Strike to instead make a ranged weapon Strike. You must be Striking an adjacent target. If necessary for the reaction's trigger, you treat your ranged weapon as if it had a reach of 5 feet. If the reaction has other requirements, such as wielding a specific kind of weapon, Snap Shot doesn't allow you to ignore them; it allows you only to replace a melee weapon Strike with a ranged weapon Strike.
_desc_ko: 생물이 근접 거리에 있을 때 원거리 무기로 반응할 수 있습니다. 일반적으로 근접 무기 공격을 허용하는 반응을 대신하여 원거리 무기 공격을 할 수 있습니다. 인접한 대상을 강타 중이어야 합니다. 반응 발동 조건에 필요한 경우, 원거리 무기의 도달 거리를 5피트로 간주합니다. 특정 무기 사용 등 다른 요구 사항이 있을 경우, 스냅 샷은 해당 조건을 무시할 수 있게 해주지 않습니다 . 단지 근접 무기 공격을 원거리 무기 공격으로 대체할 수 있게 할 뿐입니다.

name: Army of One

description.value:
Requirements Your nimbus is active.

Even alone, you're a force to be reckoned with—an army of one, so long as you have your celestial armaments. Spend 1 Mythic Point. If you're not currently wielding your celestial armament, it immediately teleports into your hand. With a gesture and a whispered prayer, you launch your celestial armament into the air, where it flies with a mind of its own, attacking every enemy within your nimbus. Make a Strike with that weapon against each enemy in the bright light of your nimbus. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but your penalty doesn't increase until you have made all your attacks. After these attacks are complete, your weapon returns to your hand.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your nimbus is active.

Even alone, you're a force to be reckoned with—an army of one, so long as you have your celestial armaments. Spend 1 Mythic Point. If you're not currently wielding your celestial armament, it immediately teleports into your hand. With a gesture and a whispered prayer, you launch your celestial armament into the air, where it flies with a mind of its own, attacking every enemy within your nimbus. Make a Strike with that weapon against each enemy in the bright light of your nimbus. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but your penalty doesn't increase until you have made all your attacks. After these attacks are complete, your weapon returns to your hand.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신의 신성한 후광이 활성화되었습니다.

혼자서도 당신은 무시무시한 존재다-천상체의 무기를 지닌 한, 당신은 혼자서도 군대다. 신화 포인트 1점을 소모하라. 현재 천상체의 무기를 휘두르고 있지 않다면, 즉시 당신의 손으로 순간이동한다. 손짓과 속삭이는 기도로, 당신은 천상체의 무기를 공중으로 발사한다. 무기는 스스로의 의지를 가지고 날아가, 당신의 신성광환 안에 있는 모든 적을 공격한다. 당신 후광의 밝은 빛 안에 있는 각 적에게 그 무기로 공격을 가한다. 각 공격은 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되지만, 모든 공격을 완료하기 전까지는 페널티가 증가하지 않는다. 이 공격이 끝나면 무기는 다시 당신의 손으로 돌아온다.

name: Familiar Foe

description.value: You regularly face off against undead and can identify many with a glance. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on skill checks to Recall Knowledge about undead. Whenever you roll a critical failure on a check to Recall Knowledge about undead, you get a failure instead.

value.value: expert in Religion or Undead Lore

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en: You regularly face off against undead and can identify many with a glance. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on skill checks to Recall Knowledge about undead. Whenever you roll a critical failure on a check to Recall Knowledge about undead, you get a failure instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 정기적으로 언데드와 맞서 싸우며, 많은 언데드를 한눈에 식별할 수 있습니다. 언데드에 관한 지식 회상 기술 판정 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 언데드에 관한 지식 회상 판정에서 대실패를 굴릴 때마다, 대신 실패로 처리됩니다.

name: Ivy Playhouse Strike

description.value: You've spent so many hours at the Ivy Playhouse or sparring with the Street Performers and Actors' Guild that you've picked up some stage combat techniques. In a fight, you can apply these approaches to make an attack less harmful but more confounding to your foes. Make a melee Strike. If you hit, you take a circumstance penalty to damage equal to the number of weapon damage dice, and the damage gains the nonlethal trait. However, the target is perplexed by the theatricality of your attack and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until the end of your next turn.

rules.text: The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until the end of your next turn.
rules.title: {item|name}

_desc_en: You've spent so many hours at the Ivy Playhouse or sparring with the Street Performers and Actors' Guild that you've picked up some stage combat techniques. In a fight, you can apply these approaches to make an attack less harmful but more confounding to your foes. Make a melee Strike. If you hit, you take a circumstance penalty to damage equal to the number of weapon damage dice, and the damage gains the nonlethal trait. However, the target is perplexed by the theatricality of your attack and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko: 당신은 아이비 극장에서 오랜 시간을 보내거나 거리 공연자 및 배우 조합과 겨루며 무대 격투 기법을 익혔습니다. 전투에서 당신은 이러한 방식을 적용해 공격의 살상력은 낮추되 적을 더 혼란스럽게 만들 수 있습니다. 근접 타격을 하십시오. 명중하면, 당신은 무기 피해 주사위 개수와 같은 상황 페널티를 피해에 받으며, 그 피해는 비살상 특성을 얻습니다. 그러나 대상은 당신의 연극적인 공격에 당황해 당신의 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{둔함 1} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Steal Essence

description.value:
Requirements A magic item is within your reach.

Being in the presence of the aeon orbs as they deteriorated has taught you how to siphon energy, and you do so with the required magic item. The DC to steal the properties of a magic item is equal to the DC for the item's level or the normal DC to Steal the item, whichever is higher. The targeted item then becomes temporarily immune for 24 hours. If the object was on a creature, that creature is also temporarily immune (which prevents you from attempting to Steal the Essence of another object on it).

If you successfully steal the properties of an item, it loses its magical properties for 24 hours and you can move those properties to a non-magical object of the same general kind (such as moving a hat's properties to another piece of headgear or moving a weapon's properties to another weapon) for the same length of time. If the moved properties are counteracted, they return immediately to the original item. You automatically fail to Steal the Essence of an artifact, cursed item, or similar item.

_desc_ko:
요구 사항 마법 아이템이 손이 닿는 곳에 있습니다.

쇠퇴하는 영원의 구슬들 곁에 있었던 경험으로 당신은 에너지를 빼내는 법을 배웠으며, 필요한 마법 아이템을 이용해 이를 실행합니다. 마법 아이템의 속성을 훔치는 데 필요한 난이도(DC)는 해당 아이템의 레벨에 해당하는 DC와 아이템을 훔치는 일반적인 DC 중 더 높은 쪽과 동일합니다. 표적 아이템은 이후 24시간 동안 일시적으로 면역 상태가 된다. 해당 물체가 생물에게 장착되어 있었다면, 그 생물도 일시적으로 면역 상태가 된다(이로 인해 그 생물에게 장착된 다른 물체의 정수를 시도하다 실패하게 됨).

아이템의 속성을 성공적으로 훔친 경우, 해당 아이템은 24시간 동안 마법적 속성을 상실하며, 당신은 동일한 종류의 비마법적 물체(예: 모자의 속성을 다른 모자로 옮기거나 무기의 속성을 다른 무기로 옮기는 등)로 그 속성을 동일한 기간 동안 이동시킬 수 있습니다. 이동된 속성이 반격되면 즉시 원래 아이템으로 돌아갑니다. 유물, 저주받은 아이템 또는 유사한 아이템의 본질을 훔치는 시도는 자동으로 실패합니다.

name: Pact of Fey Glamour

description.value:
You've sworn a pact with fey powers, granting you the otherworldly appearance of your dreams in exchange for oaths of hospitality. As long as you keep your end of the bargain, your base appearance changes indefinitely to any one appearance you wish that's within the bounds of possibility for your ancestry; this effect can't be counteracted or removed except by violating the pact. Additionally, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise} as a primal innate spell once per hour, using the higher of your class DC and your spell DC to determine the DC.

In exchange, you promise to accept any fey's request for hospitality, granting them food, drink, and lodging for up to 3 days and 3 nights. You also promise not to harm any creature to whom you've offered hospitality or who has shown hospitality to you, whether or not that creature is fey, unless that creature does harm first. If you refuse hospitality to a fey or violate hospitality, you lose the benefits of this feat until you atone for your transgressions, instantly reverting your appearance to the one you had before the pact.

_desc_ko:
당신은 페이의 힘과 계약을 맺어 환대 서약을 대가로 꿈에 그리던 초월적인 외모를 얻었습니다. 약속을 지키는 한, 당신의 기본 외모는 혈통상 가능한 범위 내에서 원하는 어떤 모습으로든 무기한 변합니다. 이 효과는 계약을 위반하지 않는 한 반격되거나 제거될 수 없습니다. 추가로, 시간당 한 번씩 @link[spells.illusory-disguise]을 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있으며, 시전 난이도는 직업 난이도와 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽을 기준으로 합니다.

대신, 당신은 모든 페이의 환대 요청을 받아들여 최대 3일 3야간 동안 음식, 음료, 숙소를 제공할 것을 약속합니다. 또한 당신이 환대를 제공했거나 당신에게 환대를 베푼 존재에게는, 그 존재가 페이인지 여부와 상관없이, 먼저 해를 가하지 않는 한 해를 끼치지 않기로 약속합니다. 요정에게 환대를 거부하거나 환대를 위반할 경우, 당신의 과오를 속죄할 때까지 이 피트의 혜택을 상실하며, 즉시 협정 전의 모습으로 되돌아갑니다.

name: Statue Form

description.value: An inconspicuous statue in front of a shop is the perfect form to wait for things to blow over. When you Change Shape, you can assume the form of a statue, shop sign, or other heavy object of up to Large size. Using statue form counts as setting up a disguise for the Impersonate use of Deception, except that you can Impersonate an object instead of a creature, it gives you a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through your disguise, and you add your level even if you're untrained. Your weight increases to match the object you're impersonating while in statue form, allowing you to use your spell DC or your class DC instead of the relevant DC to resist forced movement (usually Fortitude), if they're higher. You can speak while in statue form, but you can't attack, cast spells, or move.

_desc_ko: 가게 앞에 있는 눈에 띄지 않는 동상은 사태가 잠잠해질 때까지 기다리기에 완벽한 형태다. 형태 변신 시, 대형 크기까지의 동상, 간판 또는 기타 무거운 물체의 형태를 취할 수 있다. 동상 형태 사용은 기만 능력의 '모방' 사용을 위한 변장 설정으로 간주되나, 생물 대신 물체를 모방할 수 있으며, 변장을 간파당하지 않도록 하는 기만 판정 시 +4 상태 보너스를 부여하고, 훈련받지 않은 경우에도 레벨을 추가한다. 동상 형태일 때 체중은 변장 대상 물체의 무게만큼 증가하며, 강제 이동 저항 시(보통 인내 저항) 해당 DC보다 높은 경우 주문 DC 또는 직업 DC를 사용할 수 있다. 동상 형태로 말할 수는 있으나 공격, 주문 시전, 이동은 불가능하다.

name: Serpentine Swimmer

description.value: You undulate your body in a series of sinuous serpentine motions as you swim, drastically improving the speed at which you move through the water. Your swim Speed increases from 10 feet to 25 feet.

_desc_en: You undulate your body in a series of sinuous serpentine motions as you swim, drastically improving the speed at which you move through the water. Your swim Speed increases from 10 feet to 25 feet.
_desc_ko: 수영 시 몸을 뱀처럼 유연하게 굽이치며 움직여 물속 이동 속도가 크게 향상됩니다. 수영 속도가 10피트에서 25피트로 증가합니다.

name: Bullseye

description.value: You carefully take aim to avoid your foe's concealment and cover. On your next Strike with a thrown weapon before the end of your turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your attack roll and ignore your target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition, as well as the target's lesser cover or standard cover; if the target had greater cover, they instead have only standard cover against the Strike.

_desc_ko: 적의 은폐와 엄폐를 피하기 위해 신중하게 조준합니다. 턴 종료 전 다음 투척 무기 공격 시, 명중 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며 대상의 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태와 반엄폐/표준 엄폐 효과를 무시한다. 대상이 완전 엄폐 상태였다면, 해당 공격에 대해 표준 엄폐 상태로 변경된다.

name: Warpriest's Armor

description.value: Your training has helped you adapt to ever-heavier armor. You are trained in heavy armor. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in medium armor, you also gain that proficiency in heavy armor. You treat armor you wear of 2 Bulk or higher as though it were 1 Bulk lighter (to a minimum of 1 Bulk).

Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in medium armor, you also gain that proficiency in heavy armor. You treat armor you wear of 2 Bulk or higher as though it were 1 Bulk lighter (to a minimum of 1 Bulk).
_desc_ko: 당신의 훈련은 점점 더 중갑에 적응하는 데 도움이 되었습니다. 당신은 중갑 훈련을 받았습니다. 중갑에 대한 숙련도(전문가 이상)를 부여하는 직업 특성을 획득할 때마다, 평갑에 대한 숙련도도 함께 획득합니다. 착용하는 갑옷의 벌크가 2 이상일 경우, 이를 1 벌크 가볍게 취급합니다(최소 1 벌크).

name: Folksy Patter

description.value: You are adept at disguising coded messages as folksy idioms. Using slang, jokes, halfling loanwords, and the like, you convey a simple message consisting of three basic words (such as "Danger assassin flee" or "Meet me moonrise"). Your intended listener can attempt a @Check[perception|dc:20] check to discern the message. This DC is reduced by 5 if the listener is a halfling or has Folksy Patter, or by 10 if both apply (@Check[perception|dc:15] @Check[perception|dc:10]). Eavesdroppers can also attempt a @Check[perception|against:deception] check against your Deception DC to discern your meaning. Any bonuses or penalties to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} apply to checks to understand Folksy Patter.

_desc_ko: 당신은 암호화된 메시지를 민속적 관용구로 위장하는 데 능숙합니다. 속어, 농담, 하플링 외래어 등을 활용해 세 개의 기본 단어로 구성된 간단한 메시지("위험 암살자 도망" 또는 "달 뜨면 만나자" 등)를 전달합니다. 의도된 수신자는 메시지를 알아차리기 위해 DC 20 지각 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다. 수신자가 하플링이거나 민속적 수다 기술을 보유한 경우 DC가 5 감소하며, 두 조건이 모두 적용될 경우 10 감소합니다(DC 15 지각 DC 10 지각). 엿듣는 자들도 당신의 기만 DC에 대한 지각 판정을 시도해 의미를 파악할 수 있습니다. @link[actions.sense-motive]에 대한 지각 판정 보너스나 페널티는 민속어체 이해 판정에도 동일하게 적용됩니다.

name: Champion Dedication

description.value:
Choose a deity. You are bound by your deity's anathema and gain the champion's aura and sanctification as described in the champion class. Choose a cause as you would if you were a champion, with the same options a champion must abide by. You gain its edicts and anathema but don't gain the other abilities.

You become trained in Religion and your deity's associated skill; for each of these skills in which you were already trained, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You become trained in champion class DC. If you later gain a devotion spell, you become trained in spell attack modifier and spell DC.

You become trained in light armor and medium armor. If you already were trained in light armor and medium armor, you gain training in heavy armor as well. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in any type of armor (but not unarmored defense), you also gain that proficiency in the armor types granted to you by this feat. If you have a class feature that grants you expert proficiency in unarmored defense and you're 13th level or higher, you also become an expert in the armor types granted to you by this feat.
