_desc_ko:
신 한 분을 선택하십시오. 당신은 선택한 신의 저주에 구속되며, 챔피언 클래스에 기술된 대로 챔피언의 오라와 성화를 얻습니다. 챔피언이 선택하는 방식과 동일한 선택지를 통해 대의를 선택하십시오. 챔피언이 준수해야 하는 동일한 선택지를 따릅니다. 당신은 그 대의의 칙령과 저주를 얻지만, 다른 능력들은 얻지 않습니다.

종교와 해당 신과 연관된 기술에 숙련됩니다. 이미 숙련된 해당 기술 각각에 대해, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다. 챔피언 클래스 DC에 숙련됩니다. 추후 헌신 주문을 획득하면, 주문 공격 수정자와 주문 DC에 숙련됩니다.

경갑과 평갑 숙련을 얻습니다. 이미 경갑과 평갑 숙련을 가진 경우, 중갑 숙련도 추가로 얻습니다. 갑옷 유형(비무장 방어는 제외)에 대한 전문가 이상의 숙련을 부여하는 클래스 피트를 획득할 때마다, 이 재주로 부여받은 갑옷 유형에 대해서도 해당 숙련을 얻습니다. 비무장 방어에 대한 숙련자 숙련도를 부여하는 클래스 피트를 보유하고 있으며 13레벨 이상인 경우, 이 피트로 부여받은 갑옷 유형에 대해서도 숙련자가 됩니다.

name: Hell's Bane

description.value:
Your in-depth knowledge of your foes grants you insight into their weaknesses, granting you an advantage when fighting against them. When you critically succeed at a skill check to Recall Knowledge about a devil or Hellknight, you gain a +4 status bonus to damage against that creature for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.00gozjbtueYWop0w]{Effect: Hell's Bane}

_desc_en:
Your in-depth knowledge of your foes grants you insight into their weaknesses, granting you an advantage when fighting against them. When you critically succeed at a skill check to Recall Knowledge about a devil or Hellknight, you gain a +4 status bonus to damage against that creature for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.00gozjbtueYWop0w]{Effect: Hell's Bane}
_desc_ko:
적에 대한 당신의 심도 있는 지식은 그들의 약점에 대한 통찰을 주어, 그들과 싸울 때 유리함을 얻게 합니다. 악마나 헬나이트에 대한 지식 회상 기술 판정에 대성공하면, 1분 동안 그 생물에 대한 피해에 +4 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.00gozjbtueYWop0w]{효과: 지옥의 재앙}

name: Invented Vulnerability

description.value:
Frequency once per round

You list off the potential fears and weaknesses of an enemy you can see or hear, speaking with such certainty that they become real. Attempt a @Check[deception|against:will] check against the enemy's Will DC. Select bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. Regardless of your result, the target is temporarily immune to Invented Vulnerability for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target gains weakness to the selected type of damage equal to 3 + half your level for 1 round.

Success The target gains weakness 5 to the selected type of damage for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.nOYXxWUT9i3z75GI]{Effect: Invented Vulnerability}

_desc_en:
Frequency once per round

You list off the potential fears and weaknesses of an enemy you can see or hear, speaking with such certainty that they become real. Attempt a @Check[deception|against:will] check against the enemy's Will DC. Select bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. Regardless of your result, the target is temporarily immune to Invented Vulnerability for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target gains weakness to the selected type of damage equal to 3 + half your level for 1 round.

Success The target gains weakness 5 to the selected type of damage for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.nOYXxWUT9i3z75GI]{Effect: Invented Vulnerability}
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 라운드당 1회

당신은 눈에 보이거나 들리는 적의 잠재적 공포와 약점을 열거하며, 그 확신에 찬 말투로 그 두려움들을 현실로 만듭니다. 적의 의지 DC에 맞서 기만 판정을 시도하세요. 타격, 관통, 베기 중 하나의 피해 유형을 선택한다. 결과와 무관하게 대상은 10분 동안 '발명된 약점'에 일시적으로 면역이 된다.

대성공 대상은 선택한 피해 유형에 대해 3 + 자신의 레벨 절반에 해당하는 약점을 1라운드 동안 얻습니다.

성공 대상은 선택한 피해 유형에 대해 1라운드 동안 약점 5를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.nOYXxWUT9i3z75GI]{효과: 발명된 약점}

name: Idyllkin

description.value:
Your wild, unique features betray your agathion birthright. Serene celestials from the plane of Nirvana, agathions seek the peaceful path, ensuring a better world for all to coexist. Your halcyon demeanor leads you to search for peaceful resolution to conflict.

You gain the trained proficiency rank in Nature. If you would automatically become trained in Nature (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You know the Fey language and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.WC4xLBGmBsdOdHWu]{Natural Medicine} skill feat.

_desc_en:
Your wild, unique features betray your agathion birthright. Serene celestials from the plane of Nirvana, agathions seek the peaceful path, ensuring a better world for all to coexist. Your halcyon demeanor leads you to search for peaceful resolution to conflict.

You gain the trained proficiency rank in Nature. If you would automatically become trained in Nature (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You know the Fey language and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.WC4xLBGmBsdOdHWu]{Natural Medicine} skill feat.
_desc_ko:
당신의 거칠고 독특한 외모는 아가티온 혈통을 드러냅니다. 열반계의 고요한 천상체인 아가티온은 평화로운 길을 추구하며, 모두가 공존할 수 있는 더 나은 세상을 보장합니다. 당신의 평온한 태도는 갈등에 대한 평화적 해결책을 찾도록 이끌어줍니다.

자연 기술에 숙련 등급을 얻습니다. 배경이나 직업 등으로 자연 기술에 자동 숙련이 되는 경우, 대신 선택한 기술에 숙련됩니다. 페이 언어를 알고 @link[feats.natural-medicine] 기술 피트를 얻습니다.

참고: 이 피트로 제공되는 기술에 이미 숙련된 경우, 대체 기술을 수동으로 선택해야 합니다.

name: Whirlpool's Pull

description.value: You briefly conjure a tendril of water that allows you to grab an improvised weapon and then subsume that water to power your magic. You Interact to pick up an unattended object within 15 feet you could use as an improvised weapon and then Cast a Spell that is a cantrip or conflux spell that takes 1 action to cast.

_desc_en: You briefly conjure a tendril of water that allows you to grab an improvised weapon and then subsume that water to power your magic. You Interact to pick up an unattended object within 15 feet you could use as an improvised weapon and then Cast a Spell that is a cantrip or conflux spell that takes 1 action to cast.
_desc_ko: 잠시 물줄기를 소환하여 임시 무기를 붙잡은 후, 그 물을 흡수해 마법의 원동력으로 삼습니다. 15피트 이내에 있는 방치된 물체 중 임시 무기로 사용할 수 있는 것을 집어 들고, 캐스트하는 데 1 행동이 소요되는 캔트립 또는 컨플럭스 주문 주문을 시전합니다.

name: Willing Runes

description.value:
Magical markings of every kind seem eager to aid your endeavors. Whenever you read text, be it mundane or magical, the writing itself seems to almost to leap into your thoughts. You gain a +2 status bonus to checks to Decipher Writing, Identify Magic, Learn a Spell, or any Research check or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} check involving reading.

You gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws and to your AC against effects from hazards that involve reading, such as those created by a rune trap ritual. If you were the one who triggered the hazard by reading the triggering runes, the status bonus increases to +4.

If you prepare spells from a spellbook, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rJTg9cKnBF0jsGbr]{Draw From the Pages} activity.

publication.title: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

_desc_en:
Magical markings of every kind seem eager to aid your endeavors. Whenever you read text, be it mundane or magical, the writing itself seems to almost to leap into your thoughts. You gain a +2 status bonus to checks to Decipher Writing, Identify Magic, Learn a Spell, or any Research check or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} check involving reading.

You gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws and to your AC against effects from hazards that involve reading, such as those created by a rune trap ritual. If you were the one who triggered the hazard by reading the triggering runes, the status bonus increases to +4.

If you prepare spells from a spellbook, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rJTg9cKnBF0jsGbr]{Draw From the Pages} activity.
_desc_ko:
온갖 종류의 마법 표식이 당신의 노력을 돕고자 안달하는 듯합니다. 세속적이든 마법적이든 글을 읽을 때마다, 그 글 자체가 거의 당신의 생각 속으로 뛰어드는 것 같습니다. 당신은 글 해독, 마법 식별, 주문 학습, 혹은 모든 조사 판정이나 읽기와 관련된 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{지식 회상} 판정에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

당신은 룬 함정 의식으로 만들어진 것과 같이 읽기와 관련된 위험 요소로부터의 효과에 대해 내성 굴림과 AC에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 당신이 유발 룬을 읽어 그 위험 요소를 발동한 당사자라면, 상태 보너스는 +4로 증가합니다.

주문서에서 주문을 준비한다면, 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rJTg9cKnBF0jsGbr]{책장에서 끌어내기} 활동을 얻습니다.

name: Ice Crafter

description.value: The ancient ice-crafting techniques of the saumen kar awaken within you. You become trained in Crafting, or become an expert if you were already trained. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xWY5omyIcILNR7y1]{Magical Crafting} skill feat. You can craft permanent items out of ice instead of metal or wood; these items are a translucent crystal-blue in color, resemble icicles and glacier ice, and have the same statistics and properties as cold iron, including the price and the ability to deal additional damage to certain kinds of creatures. Any creature who wields or wears a piece of ice-crafted equipment takes 1 cold damage each round from contact with the primal cold of the crafted ice.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth

_desc_en: The ancient ice-crafting techniques of the saumen kar awaken within you. You become trained in Crafting, or become an expert if you were already trained. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xWY5omyIcILNR7y1]{Magical Crafting} skill feat. You can craft permanent items out of ice instead of metal or wood; these items are a translucent crystal-blue in color, resemble icicles and glacier ice, and have the same statistics and properties as cold iron, including the price and the ability to deal additional damage to certain kinds of creatures. Any creature who wields or wears a piece of ice-crafted equipment takes 1 cold damage each round from contact with the primal cold of the crafted ice.
_desc_ko: 사우멘 카르의 고대 얼음 제작 기술이 당신 안에서 깨어납니다. 제작 기술에 숙련되거나, 이미 숙련된 경우 전문가가 됩니다. @link[feats.magical-crafting] 기술 피트를 획득합니다. 금속이나 나무 대신 얼음으로 영구적인 아이템을 제작할 수 있습니다. 이 아이템들은 반투명한 수정 같은 푸른색을 띠며, 고드름이나 빙하 얼음을 닮았습니다. 가격과 특정 생물에게 추가 피해를 입히는 능력을 포함해, 차가운 철과 동일한 통계와 속성을 가집니다. 얼음으로 제작된 장비를 휘두르거나 착용하는 모든 생물은 제작된 얼음의 프라이멀 냉기와 접촉하여 매 라운드마다 1점의 냉기 피해를 받습니다.

name: Carried with the Swarm

description.value: When your swarm is sharing your space and Strides, you can choose to have your swarm carry you with it. You stay in the same basic position within its space while it moves and when you arrive at your new location (with your exact location determined by the GM if it's unclear). Because you're moving voluntarily, your movement isn't forced movement and therefore still triggers reactions based on movement. If your swarm Flies, and you don't have a fly Speed, you fall at the end of this movement.

_desc_en: When your swarm is sharing your space and Strides, you can choose to have your swarm carry you with it. You stay in the same basic position within its space while it moves and when you arrive at your new location (with your exact location determined by the GM if it's unclear). Because you're moving voluntarily, your movement isn't forced movement and therefore still triggers reactions based on movement. If your swarm Flies, and you don't have a fly Speed, you fall at the end of this movement.
_desc_ko: 당신의 군집이 당신과 같은 공간을 공유하며 이동할 때, 군집이 당신을 함께 운반하도록 선택할 수 있습니다. 군집이 이동하는 동안 당신은 군집 공간 내 동일한 기본 위치에 머무르며, 새로운 위치에 도착합니다(정확한 위치는 불분명한 경우 GM이 결정). 자발적 이동이므로 강제 이동이 아니며, 이동에 기반한 반응을 여전히 유발합니다. 군집이 비행하고 당신이 비행 속도를 가지지 않은 경우, 이 이동 종료 시 추락합니다.

name: Sprite's Spark

description.value:
You can fling a portion of your magic at foes. You gain a ranged unarmed attack in the sling weapon group with a maximum range of 20 feet that deals 1d4 damage. (No ability modifier is added to the damage roll.) The damage type and name of the unarmed attack depends on your heritage, described below; most sprite heritages not presented in this book also use luminous spark. Like other unarmed attacks, you can improve this attack with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.FNDq4NFSN0g2HKWO]{Handwraps of Mighty Blows}.

Draxie euphoric spark (mental)

Firefly Sprite luminous spark (fire)

Grig dissonant note (sonic)

Melixie sting shot (poison)

Nyktera ultrasonic pulse (sonic)

Pixie pixie dust (mental)

Dijiang primordial pulse (spirit)

Gandharva celestial song (sonic)

Kanchil puzzling bolt (mental)

Leungli surging splash (bludgeoning)

(No ability modifier is added to the damage roll.) The damage type and name of the unarmed attack depends on your heritage, described below; most sprite heritages not presented in this book also use luminous spark. Like other unarmed attacks, you can improve this attack with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.FNDq4NFSN0g2HKWO]{Handwraps of Mighty Blows}.

Dijiang primordial pulse (spirit)

Gandharva celestial song (sonic)

Kanchil puzzling bolt (mental)

Leungli surging splash (bludgeoning)
_desc_ko:
당신은 마법의 일부를 적에게 던질 수 있습니다. 최대 사거리 20피트의 투석기 무기 그룹에 속하는 원거리 비무장 공격을 얻으며, 1d4의 피해를 입힙니다. (피해 주사위에는 능력치 수정자가 적용되지 않습니다.) 이 비무장 공격의 피해 유형과 명칭은 아래에 설명된 당신의 혈통에 따라 달라집니다. 이 책에 소개되지 않은 대부분의 스프라이트 혈통도 빛나는 불꽃을 사용합니다. 다른 비무장 공격과 마찬가지로, @link[equipment.handwraps-of-mighty-blows]으로 이 공격을 강화할 수 있습니다.

드락시 행복감 불꽃 (정신)

반딧불이 정령 빛나는 불꽃 (불)

그리그 불협화음 음표 ([sonic])

멜릭시 독침 발사 (독)

닉테라 초음파 펄스 (소닉)

Pixie 요정 가루 (정신)

디장 원초적 맥동 (영혼)

강다르바 천상체의 노래 ([sonic])

칸칠 수수께끼 같은 번개 (정신)

룽리 솟구치는 물보라 (타격)

name: Awakened Animal Lore

description.value:
You have taken the time to learn about the process of awakening and the experiences of your fellow awakened animals. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Arcana and Nature. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Awakened Animal Lore.

_desc_en:
You have taken the time to learn about the process of awakening and the experiences of your fellow awakened animals. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Arcana and Nature. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Awakened Animal Lore.
_desc_ko:
당신은 각성 과정과 동료 각성 동물들의 경험에 대해 깊이 연구했습니다. 주문학 및 자연에 대한 숙련 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 해당 기술 중 하나에 자동으로 숙련이 부여될 경우, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련이 부여됩니다.

또한 각성 동물 지식에 대한 @link[feats.additional-lore] 일반 피트를 획득합니다.

name: Echoing Fury

description.value: You cheat the rules of time to co-locate during your attack. When you use Temporal Fury, your Step can be up to 15 feet. If your second Strike is against the same creature as your first Strike, your second Strike deals an additional die of weapon damage; if both Strikes hit, you combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.

publication.title: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

_desc_en: You cheat the rules of time to co-locate during your attack. When you use Temporal Fury, your Step can be up to 15 feet. If your second Strike is against the same creature as your first Strike, your second Strike deals an additional die of weapon damage; if both Strikes hit, you combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.
_desc_ko: 당신은 시간의 규칙을 속여 공격 중에 같은 위치에 존재합니다. 시간의 분노를 사용할 때, 당신의 걸음은 최대 15피트까지 가능합니다. 두 번째 타격이 첫 번째 타격과 같은 생물을 대상으로 한다면, 두 번째 타격은 추가로 무기 피해 주사위 하나만큼의 피해를 입힙니다. 두 타격이 모두 명중하면, 저항과 약점 적용을 위해 그 피해를 합산합니다.

name: Snare Specialist

description.value:
You specialize in creating quick traps to obstruct your enemies on the battlefield. If your proficiency rank in Crafting is expert, you gain the formulas for three common or uncommon snares. If your rank is master, you gain 6. If your rank is legendary, you gain 9.

Each day during your daily preparations, you can prepare four snares from your formula book for quick deployment; if they normally take 1 minute to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft}, you can Craft them with 3 Interact actions. The number of snares increases to six if you have master proficiency in Crafting and eight if you have legendary proficiency in Crafting. Snares prepared in this way don't cost you any resources to Craft.

_desc_en:
You specialize in creating quick traps to obstruct your enemies on the battlefield. If your proficiency rank in Crafting is expert, you gain the formulas for three common or uncommon snares. If your rank is master, you gain 6. If your rank is legendary, you gain 9.

Each day during your daily preparations, you can prepare four snares from your formula book for quick deployment; if they normally take 1 minute to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft}, you can Craft them with 3 Interact actions. The number of snares increases to six if you have master proficiency in Crafting and eight if you have legendary proficiency in Crafting. Snares prepared in this way don't cost you any resources to Craft.
_desc_ko:
전장에서 적을 방해하기 위한 신속한 함정 제작에 특화됩니다. 제작 숙련도가 전문가 등급일 경우, 일반 또는 희귀 덫 3종의 제작법을 얻습니다. 숙련도가 달인 등급일 경우 6종, 전설 등급일 경우 9종을 얻습니다.

매일 준비 시간 동안, 당신은 제작법 책에서 신속한 배치를 위해 네 개의 덫을 준비할 수 있습니다. 일반적으로 1분이 소요되는 @link[actions.craft] 작업을, 3번의 상호작용 행동으로 수행할 수 있습니다. 제작 숙련도가 달인라면 올가미 수는 여섯 개로, 전설이라면 여덟 개로 증가합니다. 이렇게 준비한 올가미는 제작 시 자원을 소모하지 않습니다.

name: Animal Summoner

description.value: The connection between you and primal magic deepens. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4YnON9JHYqtLzccu]{Summon Animal} as a primal innate spell once per day, heightened to half your level rounded up.

_desc_en: The connection between you and primal magic deepens. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4YnON9JHYqtLzccu]{Summon Animal} as a primal innate spell once per day, heightened to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 당신과 프라이멀 마법 사이의 연결이 깊어집니다. 하루에 한 번, 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 @link[spells.summon-animal]을 시전할 수 있으며, 이 마법은 당신의 레벨의 절반(올림)까지 강화됩니다.

name: Harrower Dedication

description.value:
You become trained in Occultism; if you are already trained in this skill, you become trained in a different skill of your choice instead. You also become trained in Fortune-Telling Lore, and you learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ofAQyLtLEGnOIs3N]{Harrowing} ritual.

In addition, once a day when you perform your daily preparations, you can perform a harrow reading for yourself if you have access to a harrow deck. Draw a card from your harrow deck—that card's suit becomes your active harrow omen for the next 24 hours and modifies several other harrower feats as detailed on the following pages. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ePfdZYZRmycMpSWU]{Avoid Dire Fate} reaction.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.rp6hA52dWVwtuu5F]{Effect: Harrow Omen}

Special You can't select another dedication feat until you've gained two other feats from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.OtBPlgtudM4PlTWD]{Harrower} archetype. If you retrain out of this feat, you lose the harrowing ritual you learned from it

_desc_en:
You become trained in Occultism; if you are already trained in this skill, you become trained in a different skill of your choice instead. You also become trained in Fortune-Telling Lore, and you learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ofAQyLtLEGnOIs3N]{Harrowing} ritual.

In addition, once a day when you perform your daily preparations, you can perform a harrow reading for yourself if you have access to a harrow deck. Draw a card from your harrow deck—that card's suit becomes your active harrow omen for the next 24 hours and modifies several other harrower feats as detailed on the following pages. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ePfdZYZRmycMpSWU]{Avoid Dire Fate} reaction.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.rp6hA52dWVwtuu5F]{Effect: Harrow Omen}

Special You can't select another dedication feat until you've gained two other feats from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.OtBPlgtudM4PlTWD]{Harrower} archetype. If you retrain out of this feat, you lose the harrowing ritual you learned from it
_desc_ko:
당신은 오컬트에 숙련됩니다. 이미 이 기술에 숙련된 경우, 대신 선택한 다른 기술에 숙련됩니다. 또한 점술 지식에 숙련되며, @link[spells.harrowing] 의식을 배웁니다.

또한, 하루에 한 번 일일 준비를 수행할 때, 해로우 카드 덱을 사용할 수 있다면 자신에게 해로우 점술을 행할 수 있습니다. 해로우 카드 덱에서 카드를 한 장 뽑으십시오-그 카드의 무늬가 다음 24시간 동안 당신의 활성 해로우 징조가 되며, 다음 페이지에 상세히 설명된 여러 해로우 점술 관련 피트를 조정합니다. @link[actions.avoid-dire-fate] 반응을 획득합니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.rp6hA52dWVwtuu5F]{효과: 해로우 징조}

특수 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.OtBPlgtudM4PlTWD]{해로우어} 아키타입에서 다른 두 가지 피트를 획득하기 전까지 다른 헌신 피트를 선택할 수 없습니다. 이 피트를 재훈련하여 제거할 경우, 이 피트로 배운 해로우 카드 점술의식을 잃게 됩니다.

name: Sweeping Fan Redirection

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding two fans, one in each hand.

You can redirect ammunition back at the creature that fired it with sweeping gusts of wind. When @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.dY8LGT6KDcGy93GY]{Sweeping Fan Block} prevents an attack from hitting you, instead of recovering the ammunition, you can make a ranged Strike against the triggering target using the normal attack bonus and damage of your fans as part of the same reaction. You also apply any special effects the ammunition might have.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding two fans, one in each hand.

You can redirect ammunition back at the creature that fired it with sweeping gusts of wind. When @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.dY8LGT6KDcGy93GY]{Sweeping Fan Block} prevents an attack from hitting you, instead of recovering the ammunition, you can make a ranged Strike against the triggering target using the normal attack bonus and damage of your fans as part of the same reaction. You also apply any special effects the ammunition might have.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손에 각각 부채 하나씩을 들고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 휘몰아치는 바람으로 발사된 탄환을 발사한 생물에게 되돌려 보낼 수 있습니다. @link[feats.sweeping-fan-block]가 공격을 막아내면, 탄환을 회수하는 대신 동일한 반응의 일부로 부채의 기본 공격 보너스와 피해를 적용하여 발동 대상에게 원거리 공격을 가할 수 있습니다. 또한 탄환이 지닌 특수 효과도 적용됩니다.

name: Turpin Rowe Lumberjack Dedication

description.value:
Access You must befriend at least one Turpin Rowe logger.

Your logging training has made you intimately familiar with all aspects of forestry, and you have trained extensively to reach around trees and utilize their bulk to your advantage. You become trained in Milling Lore and Forest Lore, or an expert if you were already trained. You can always @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} when you are within forest terrain to gain cover, even if you're not next to an obstacle you can Take Cover behind. In addition, any enemy who gains standard cover from a tree gains only lesser cover against your attacks (or only standard cover, if the enemy otherwise gains greater cover).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.uGsGn5sgR7wn0TQD]{Turpin Rowe Lumberjack}

_desc_en:
Access You must befriend at least one Turpin Rowe logger.

Your logging training has made you intimately familiar with all aspects of forestry, and you have trained extensively to reach around trees and utilize their bulk to your advantage. You become trained in Milling Lore and Forest Lore, or an expert if you were already trained. You can always @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} when you are within forest terrain to gain cover, even if you're not next to an obstacle you can Take Cover behind. In addition, any enemy who gains standard cover from a tree gains only lesser cover against your attacks (or only standard cover, if the enemy otherwise gains greater cover).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.uGsGn5sgR7wn0TQD]{Turpin Rowe Lumberjack}
_desc_ko:
접근 터핀 로우 벌목꾼 중 최소 한 명과 친분을 쌓아야 합니다.

벌목 훈련을 통해 산림의 모든 측면에 익숙하게 되었으며, 나무를 휘감고 그 벌크를 유리하게 활용하는 법을 철저히 익혔습니다. 제재소 지식와 산림 지식를 숙련하게 되며, 이미 숙련 상태였다면 전문가가 됩니다. 숲 지형 내에 있을 때는 항상 @link[actions.take-cover]를 사용하여 엄폐를 얻을 수 있습니다. 장애물 뒤에 엄폐할 수 있는 위치에 있지 않더라도 가능합니다. 또한, 나무로부터 표준 엄폐를 얻는 적들은 당신의 공격에 대해 반엄폐만 얻습니다(적에게 완전 엄폐가 적용되는 경우라면 표준 엄폐만 얻습니다).

name: Reloading Trick

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding an unloaded hand crossbow or an unloaded gauntlet bow.

You can fire off a single shot even when it seems like you are unprepared. You Interact to reload your hand crossbow or gauntlet bow and attempt a ranged Strike with it.

Special If you have the Repeating Hand Crossbow Training feat, you can use this feat with a repeating hand crossbow to load an entire magazine, but the speed means you can fire only one bolt before the magazine jams and becomes useless. You must fully replace a magazine as normal before firing with a repeating hand crossbow after using this ability.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding an unloaded hand crossbow or an unloaded gauntlet bow.

You can fire off a single shot even when it seems like you are unprepared. You Interact to reload your hand crossbow or gauntlet bow and attempt a ranged Strike with it.

Special If you have the Repeating Hand Crossbow Training feat, you can use this feat with a repeating hand crossbow to load an entire magazine, but the speed means you can fire only one bolt before the magazine jams and becomes useless. You must fully replace a magazine as normal before firing with a repeating hand crossbow after using this ability.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 장전되지 않은 핸드 크로스보우 또는 장갑 활을 들고 있어야 합니다.

준비되지 않은 것처럼 보일 때도 단발 사격을 할 수 있습니다. 상호작용으로 핸드 크로스보우나 건틀릿 보우를 재장전하고 원거리 강타 시도합니다.

특수 리피팅 핸드 크로스보우 훈련 피트를 보유한 경우, 이 피트를 리피팅 핸드 크로스보우에 적용해 탄창 전체를 장전할 수 있으나, 속도상 탄창이 걸려 무용지물이 되기 전 한 발만 발사할 수 있다. 이 능력을 사용한 후 리피팅 핸드 크로스보우로 발사하려면 평소처럼 탄창을 완전히 교체해야 한다.

name: Eclectic Obsession

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Your desire for stimulation has led you from one pursuit to another and granted you a smattering of expertise with myriad crafts and professions. You reflect on snippets you've learned to temporarily become trained in one Lore skill of your choice. This proficiency lasts for 10 minutes or until you critically fail a check with that skill. Since this training is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a permanent character option like a feat or a skill increase.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Your desire for stimulation has led you from one pursuit to another and granted you a smattering of expertise with myriad crafts and professions. You reflect on snippets you've learned to temporarily become trained in one Lore skill of your choice. This proficiency lasts for 10 minutes or until you critically fail a check with that skill. Since this training is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a permanent character option like a feat or a skill increase.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

자극에 대한 갈망은 당신을 끊임없이 새로운 추구로 이끌었고, 수많은 제작과 직업에 대한 얕은 전문성을 부여했습니다. 배운 단편들을 되새기며 선택한 지식 기술 하나를 일시적으로 숙련하게 됩니다. 이 숙련도는 10분 동안 지속되거나 해당 기술로 대실패를 할 때까지 유지됩니다. 이 훈련은 일시적이므로 재주나 피트 같은 영구적인 캐릭터 옵션의 전제 조건으로 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Hydraulic Maneuvers

description.value:
You batter your foes with a torrent of water siphoned from your surroundings.

If the next action you take is an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}, that action has a range of 15 feet. You don't receive any item bonuses to that check or any circumstance bonuses related to your physical body, but if you roll a critical failure on that Athletics check, you get a failure instead.

rules.text:
If you roll a critical failure on your Athletics check to Disarm, Shove or Trip using Hydraulic Maneuvers, you get a failure instead.

You don't receive any item bonuses to the triggering Athletics check or any circumstance bonuses related to your physical body when using Hydraulic Maneuvers.

_desc_en:
You batter your foes with a torrent of water siphoned from your surroundings.

If the next action you take is an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}, that action has a range of 15 feet. You don't receive any item bonuses to that check or any circumstance bonuses related to your physical body, but if you roll a critical failure on that Athletics check, you get a failure instead.
_desc_ko:
주변에서 빨아들인 물의 폭풍으로 적을 강타한다.

다음 행동이 @link[actions.disarm], @link[actions.shove], 또는 @link[actions.trip] 운동 판정인 경우, 해당 행동의 범위는 15피트입니다. 해당 판정에는 아이템 보너스나 신체 관련 상황 보너스가 적용되지 않지만, 운동 판정에서 대실패를 굴렸을 경우 실패로 처리됩니다.

name: Vengeful Strike

description.value:
Trigger A creature within your reach succeeds at an attack against you.

Requirements You're under the effect of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Z9gzWFk3qom2z904]{Come and Get Me}.

When struck by an enemy, you respond in turn. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the triggering attack was a critical success, you can use Vengeful Strike as a free action instead of a reaction.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature within your reach succeeds at an attack against you.

Requirements You're under the effect of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Z9gzWFk3qom2z904]{Come and Get Me}.

When struck by an enemy, you respond in turn. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the triggering attack was a critical success, you can use Vengeful Strike as a free action instead of a reaction.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신의 손이 닿는 범위 내의 생물이 당신을 상대로 한 공격에 성공합니다.

요구 사항 당신은 @link[feats.come-and-get-me].

의 효과를 받고 있다.

적에게 공격을 당하면 차례를 사용해 대응한다. 발동한 생물에게 근접 공격을 가한다. 발동한 공격이 대성공이었다면, 반응 대신 자유 행동으로 복수 타격을 사용할 수 있다.

name: Define “Report”

description.value: Look, getting caught in a lie is a normal part of venture-gossip life. Sometimes you have to give a sheepish smile and apologize for what you've done. When you fail a Deception check, reroll with your Diplomacy modifier. On a success, there are no hard feelings and the other person's attitude condition doesn't worsen. On a critical success, you can attempt the Deception again with no consequences.

publication.title: Paizo Blog: Foolish Housekeeping and Other Articles

_desc_en: Look, getting caught in a lie is a normal part of venture-gossip life. Sometimes you have to give a sheepish smile and apologize for what you've done. When you fail a Deception check, reroll with your Diplomacy modifier. On a success, there are no hard feelings and the other person's attitude condition doesn't worsen. On a critical success, you can attempt the Deception again with no consequences.
_desc_ko: 자, 거짓말이 들통나는 건 모험가들의 수다 속에서 흔히 있는 일이지. 때로는 어색한 미소를 지으며 자신의 행동에 사과해야 할 때도 있다. 기만 판정 실패 시, 외교 수정자를 적용해 재굴림한다. 성공 시, 상대방의 감정이 상하지 않으며 태도 상태가 악화되지 않는다. 대성공 시, 아무런 불이익 없이 기만을 다시 시도할 수 있다.

name: Poison Resistance

description.value:
Alchemist Repeated exposure to toxic reagents has fortified your body against poisons of all kinds.

Druid Your affinity for the natural world grants you protection against some of its dangers.

You gain poison resistance equal to half your level, and you gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against poisons.

_desc_en:
Alchemist Repeated exposure to toxic reagents has fortified your body against poisons of all kinds.

Druid Your affinity for the natural world grants you protection against some of its dangers.

You gain poison resistance equal to half your level, and you gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against poisons.
_desc_ko:
연금술사 유독한 시약에 반복적으로 노출되면서 모든 종류의 독에 대한 내성이 강화되었습니다.

드루이드 자연계와의 친화력이 일부 위험으로부터 당신을 보호해 줍니다.

당신은 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 독 저항력을 얻으며, 독에 대한 내성 굴림 시 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Swallow Pain

description.value: You're capable of absorbing pain with less difficulty than others, and your bond with your horse helps it similarly ignore such suffering. You and your mount gain resistance to mental damage equal to half your level.

_desc_en: You're capable of absorbing pain with less difficulty than others, and your bond with your horse helps it similarly ignore such suffering. You and your mount gain resistance to mental damage equal to half your level.
_desc_ko: 당신은 남들보다 덜 어렵게 고통을 흡수할 수 있으며, 당신의 말과의 결속은 말 또한 그러한 고통을 무시하도록 돕습니다. 당신과 당신의 탈것은 당신의 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 정신 피해 저항을 얻습니다.

name: Living Vessel Dedication

description.value:
Whether willingly or not, you've become a vessel for a being of unimaginable power. You and your GM should work together to determine the being's nature and decide how much you know and how much remains a mystery to you for now. Some decisions might influence your options later. You might need to decide whether the entity is a demon, for instance, to know if you qualify for later feats.

You need to spend at least an hour each day assuaging the entity within you or you take a –1 penalty to Will saves for 24 hours. The process of assuaging the entity is determined together between you and the GM. It might be as simple as meditating with the entity to learn more about them, but it might be as extreme as committing gruesome, unspeakable sacrifices to keep their unknowable blessings. After a full week of failing to assuage your entity, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}, and you can't remove or ameliorate the condition until you allow your entity to take full possession of your body for 24 hours, during which time it pursues its own agenda.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.5bCZGpp9yFHXDz1j]{Entity's Resurgence} reaction, allowing you to unleash your entity in lieu of falling @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, though at the risk of letting it enact its will.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.LgkfmZnFP3TWtkuy]{Living Vessel}

_desc_en:
Whether willingly or not, you've become a vessel for a being of unimaginable power. You and your GM should work together to determine the being's nature and decide how much you know and how much remains a mystery to you for now. Some decisions might influence your options later. You might need to decide whether the entity is a demon, for instance, to know if you qualify for later feats.

You need to spend at least an hour each day assuaging the entity within you or you take a –1 penalty to Will saves for 24 hours. The process of assuaging the entity is determined together between you and the GM. It might be as simple as meditating with the entity to learn more about them, but it might be as extreme as committing gruesome, unspeakable sacrifices to keep their unknowable blessings. After a full week of failing to assuage your entity, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}, and you can't remove or ameliorate the condition until you allow your entity to take full possession of your body for 24 hours, during which time it pursues its own agenda.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.5bCZGpp9yFHXDz1j]{Entity's Resurgence} reaction, allowing you to unleash your entity in lieu of falling @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, though at the risk of letting it enact its will.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.LgkfmZnFP3TWtkuy]{Living Vessel}
_desc_ko:
자발적이든 아니든, 당신은 상상조차 할 수 없는 힘을 지닌 존재의 그릇이 되었습니다. 당신과 게임 마스터는 협력하여 그 존재의 본질을 결정하고, 당신이 현재 알고 있는 것과 아직 미스터리로 남아 있는 것의 정도를 정해야 합니다. 일부 결정은 향후 선택지에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다. 예를 들어, 해당 존재가 데몬인지 여부를 결정해야 나중에 특정 피트를 획득할 자격이 있는지 알 수 있습니다.

매일 최소 한 시간 동안 내면의 존재를 달래야 합니다. 그렇지 않으면 24시간 동안 의지 내성에 -1 페널티를 받습니다. 달래는 과정은 당신과 GM이 함께 결정합니다. 그것은 그 존재에 대해 더 많이 배우기 위해 함께 명상하는 것처럼 단순할 수도 있지만, 그들의 알 수 없는 축복을 유지하기 위해 끔찍하고 말로 표현할 수 없는 희생을 바치는 것처럼 극단적일 수도 있습니다. 일주일 내내 실체를 달래는 데 실패하면 @link[conditions.doomed]{1} 상태가 되며, 실체가 24시간 동안 당신의 몸을 완전히 지배하도록 허용할 때까지 이 상태를 제거하거나 완화할 수 없습니다. 이 기간 동안 실체는 자신의 의지를 추구합니다.

또한 @link[actions.entitys-resurgence] 반응을 얻어, @link[conditions.unconscious] 상태에 빠지는 대신 실체를 해방시킬 수 있으나, 그 대가로 실체가 자신의 의지를 실행하도록 내버려 두는 위험을 감수해야 한다.

name: Tut-Tut

description.value:
Trigger You hit a creature with a melee attack roll.

The Sapphire Butterfly is not one for violence when simply intimidating a foe will do. From that vigilante's techniques, you've learned how to pull a deadly blow at the last moment, threatening your target instead of striking them. Rather than dealing damage with the triggering Strike, attempt an Intimidation check with a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} all enemies within 30 feet who can see you. If you critically succeed at your check to Demoralize the target of your Strike, their attitude toward you improves by one step while they also become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

_desc_en:
Trigger You hit a creature with a melee attack roll.

The Sapphire Butterfly is not one for violence when simply intimidating a foe will do. From that vigilante's techniques, you've learned how to pull a deadly blow at the last moment, threatening your target instead of striking them. Rather than dealing damage with the triggering Strike, attempt an Intimidation check with a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} all enemies within 30 feet who can see you. If you critically succeed at your check to Demoralize the target of your Strike, their attitude toward you improves by one step while they also become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 근접 명중 굴림으로 생물을 명중시킨다.

사파이어 나비는 단순히 적을 위협하는 것으로 충분할 때는 폭력을 선호하지 않습니다. 그 자경단의 기술에서 당신은 마지막 순간에 치명타를 거두는 법을 배웠습니다. 상대를 공격하기보다는 위협하는 것이죠. 치명타를 유발하는 공격으로 피해를 입히기보다는, 당신을 볼 수 있는 30피트 내의 모든 적에게 @link[actions.demoralize]에 +2 상황 보너스를 적용한 위협 판정을 시도하십시오. 타격 대상에 대한 사기 저하 판정에서 대성공을 거두면, 해당 대상의 당신에 대한 태도가 한 단계 개선되며 동시에 @link[conditions.frightened]{2} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Dodge Away

description.value:
Trigger You are the target of a melee attack.

Requirements You're aware of the attack and aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}.

You use your acrobatic prowess to evade an attack, using momentum to keep yourself moving, if you choose.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses you, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.UHpkTuCtyaPqiCAB]{Step} after the Strike.

If you're a master in Acrobatics, you can move 10 feet on this Step instead of 5 feet.

_desc_en:
Trigger You are the target of a melee attack.

Requirements You're aware of the attack and aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}.

You use your acrobatic prowess to evade an attack, using momentum to keep yourself moving, if you choose.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses you, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.UHpkTuCtyaPqiCAB]{Step} after the Strike.

If you're a master in Acrobatics, you can move 10 feet on this Step instead of 5 feet.
_desc_ko:
발동 근접 공격의 대상이 되었습니다.

요구 사항 당신은 공격을 인지하고 있으며 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 아닙니다.

당신은 곡예적인 기량을 활용해 공격을 회피하며, 원한다면 그 기세를 이용해 계속 움직일 수 있습니다.

발동 공격에 대해 AC에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 공격이 빗나간 경우, 타격 후 @link[actions.step]을 할 수 있습니다.

곡예 달인라면, 이 {신중한 발걸음}에서 5피트 대신 10피트를 이동할 수 있다.

name: Forceful Shot

description.value:
Your ranged attacks push your foes away from your allies. Make a ranged Strike, adding the following effects in addition to the normal effects of the Strike.

Critical Success The target is pushed 10 feet away from you.

Success The target is pushed 5 feet away from you.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en:
Your ranged attacks push your foes away from your allies. Make a ranged Strike, adding the following effects in addition to the normal effects of the Strike.

Critical Success The target is pushed 10 feet away from you.

Success The target is pushed 5 feet away from you.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round.
_desc_ko:
원거리 공격 시 적을 아군 쪽으로 밀어냅니다. 원거리 공격 검사를 수행하며, 공격의 일반 효과에 다음 효과를 추가합니다.

대성공 대상이 당신으로부터 10피트 밀려납니다.

성공 대상이 당신으로부터 5피트 밀려난다.

실패 대상은 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 1라운드 동안 지속됩니다.

name: Hard Tail

description.value: Your tail is much stronger than most, and you can lash out with it with the strength of a whip. You gain a tail unarmed attack that deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage.

_desc_en: Your tail is much stronger than most, and you can lash out with it with the strength of a whip. You gain a tail unarmed attack that deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage.
_desc_ko: 당신의 꼬리는 대다수보다 훨씬 강하며, 채찍 같은 힘으로 휘둘러 공격할 수 있습니다. 꼬리를 이용한 비무장 공격을 얻으며, 이는 1d6 타격을 입힙니다.

name: Cantorian Reinforcement

description.value: The life energy that helped create the first hobgoblins is particularly potent in you, protecting you from ongoing maladies. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a disease or poison, you get a critical success instead. If you have a different ability that would improve the save in this way (such as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.gdSmSTaGDxf4g2d8]{Battle Hardened} fighter class feature), if you roll a critical failure on the save you get a failure instead.

_desc_en: The life energy that helped create the first hobgoblins is particularly potent in you, protecting you from ongoing maladies. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a disease or poison, you get a critical success instead. If you have a different ability that would improve the save in this way (such as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.gdSmSTaGDxf4g2d8]{Battle Hardened} fighter class feature), if you roll a critical failure on the save you get a failure instead.
_desc_ko: 최초의 홉고블린을 창조하는 데 기여한 생명 에너지가 당신에게 특히 강력하게 작용하여 지속적인 질병으로부터 보호합니다. 질병이나 독에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴릴 경우, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다. 이 방식으로 내성 성공률을 향상시키는 다른 능력(예: @link[feats.battle-hardened] 파이터 클래스 특성)을 보유한 경우, 내성 굴림에서 대실패를 굴리면 대신 실패를 얻습니다.

name: Climate Adaptation

description.value: Like evergreen trees, which stay healthy and vibrant from winter through summer, you too can adapt to a variety of extreme climates. You're unaffected by mild cold or heat environmental effects, and when you're in severe cold or heat, you take the effects of mild cold or heat instead. This doesn't protect you from extreme or incredible cold or heat.

_desc_en: Like evergreen trees, which stay healthy and vibrant from winter through summer, you too can adapt to a variety of extreme climates. You're unaffected by mild cold or heat environmental effects, and when you're in severe cold or heat, you take the effects of mild cold or heat instead. This doesn't protect you from extreme or incredible cold or heat.
_desc_ko: 겨울부터 여름까지 건강하고 생기 넘치는 상록수처럼, 당신도 다양한 극한 기후에 적응할 수 있습니다. 약한 추위나 더위 환경 효과의 영향을 받지 않으며, 극심한 추위나 더위 환경에 있을 때는 약한 추위나 더위 효과만 받습니다. 극한 또는 엄청난 추위나 더위로부터는 보호받지 못합니다.

name: Remote Detonation

description.value:
Brastlewark snarecrafters know that sometimes it's more advantageous to magically destroy a snare before it's triggered. Choose a magical snare within 120 feet that you crafted. The snare is automatically destroyed and each creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] takes @Damage[1d6[force]|options:area-damage] damage per level of the destroyed snare with a basic @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

Special If you detonate a broad snare or giant snare, choose one square that snare occupies to be the center of the emanation.

_desc_en:
Brastlewark snarecrafters know that sometimes it's more advantageous to magically destroy a snare before it's triggered. Choose a magical snare within 120 feet that you crafted. The snare is automatically destroyed and each creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] takes @Damage[1d6[force]|options:area-damage] damage per level of the destroyed snare with a basic @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

Special If you detonate a broad snare or giant snare, choose one square that snare occupies to be the center of the emanation.
_desc_ko:
브래슬워크 덫 장인들은 때로는 덫이 발동되기 전에 마법으로 파괴하는 것이 더 유리하다는 것을 압니다. 당신이 제작한 120피트 내의 마법 덫 하나를 선택하십시오. 그 덫은 자동으로 파괴되고, @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] 내의 각 생물은 파괴된 덫의 레벨당 @Damage[1d6[force]|options:area-damage] 피해를 입으며, 당신의 클래스 DC와 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽에 대해 기본 @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] 내성 굴림을 합니다.

특수 광역 덫이나 거대 덫을 기폭한다면, 그 덫이 차지하는 칸 중 하나를 발산의 중심으로 선택하십시오.

name: Execution

description.value:
Requirements You have condemned a foe with Harsh Judgment.

You swing wide, attempting to behead your condemned foe. Make a melee Strike against your condemned foe. If you hit, your condemned foe takes 8d6 extra precision damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. If the condemned foe is reduced to 0 Hit Points by the execution and requires a head to live, they die. For creatures with multiple heads, this usually kills the creature only if you sever its last head. The creature then becomes temporarily immune to your Execution for 1 day.

publication.title: Pathfinder Adventure: Night of the Gray Death

_desc_en:
Requirements You have condemned a foe with Harsh Judgment.

You swing wide, attempting to behead your condemned foe. Make a melee Strike against your condemned foe. If you hit, your condemned foe takes 8d6 extra precision damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. If the condemned foe is reduced to 0 Hit Points by the execution and requires a head to live, they die. For creatures with multiple heads, this usually kills the creature only if you sever its last head. The creature then becomes temporarily immune to your Execution for 1 day.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 가혹한 심판으로 적을 처형했습니다.

당신은 처형된 적의 목을 베려고 크게 휘둘렀습니다. 처형 대상 적에게 근접 공격을 가하십시오. 명중 시, 처형 대상 적은 8d6의 추가 정밀 피해를 입으며, 이 피해는 기본 인내 귀하의 직업 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽에 대한 내성을 사용합니다. 처형으로 인해 처형 대상 적의 HP가 0이 되고, 생존에 머리가 필요한 경우, 그 적은 죽습니다. 여러 개의 머리를 가진 생물의 경우, 일반적으로 마지막 머리를 베어야만 생물이 죽습니다. 해당 생물은 이후 1일간 당신의 처형 기술에 대해 일시적으로 면역 상태가 됩니다.

name: Magus's Analysis

description.value: You make an assessment informed by your knowledge of how a creature fights. Attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about a creature. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your check if you previously hit the creature with a Strike this turn. If your check is successful, recharge your Spellstrike. The subject of your check is temporarily immune to Magus's Analysis for 1 day.

_desc_en: You make an assessment informed by your knowledge of how a creature fights. Attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about a creature. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your check if you previously hit the creature with a Strike this turn. If your check is successful, recharge your Spellstrike. The subject of your check is temporarily immune to Magus's Analysis for 1 day.
_desc_ko: 당신은 생물의 전투 방식을 아는 지식을 바탕으로 평가를 내립니다. 생물에 대한 @link[actions.recall-knowledge] 판정을 시도하십시오. 이번 턴에 해당 생물에게 강타로 명중시킨 적이 있다면, 해당 판정에서 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 판정에 성공하면, 당신의 스펠스트라이크가 재충전됩니다. 판정의 대상은 1일간 메이거스의 분석에 대해 일시적으로 면역 상태가 됩니다.

name: Song of Marching

description.value: You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.LTUaK3smfm5eDiFK]{Song of Marching} composition cantrip, which enables you and your allies to cross vast distances without strain.

_desc_en: You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.LTUaK3smfm5eDiFK]{Song of Marching} composition cantrip, which enables you and your allies to cross vast distances without strain.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @link[spells.song-of-marching] 작곡 캔트립을 익히게 되며, 이를 통해 당신과 아군들은 무리 없이 광활한 거리를 가로질러 이동할 수 있습니다.

name: Godling Dedication

description.value:
Your Calling allows you to begin walking the path to true deific ascension, inspiring followers as your divine seed grows. Your first follower is your hierophant—the high priest of your new faith—whom you rely on to spread your word and provide an anchoring mortal presence as your perspectives are increasingly pulled toward the cosmic. When you gain this feat, choose one willing ally to be your hierophant. If your hierophant is not trained in spell attack modifier and spell DC, they become trained for as long as they are your designated hierophant. If your hierophant dies or chooses to part ways with you, you can designate a new hierophant by communing with the chosen ally for a period of 24 hours.

Your Calling allows you to seize the divine magic typically restricted to deities. Choose one domain to claim from the list on Player Core, or from other domains you have access to. You learn the initial domain spell for this domain. You gain a pool of Focus Points with 1 Focus Point and you can Refocus by taking 10 minutes to replenish your divine energy from the planes beyond. You gain expert proficiency in spell modifier and spell DC, and your spellcasting ability for these spells is your choice of Wisdom or Charisma, decided when you gain this feat.

Your hierophant also gains the Cast a Spell activity and can cast the domain spell you learned with Godling Dedication. When they Cast the Spell in this way, your Focus Point is expended as the cost of the spell. Your hierophant uses their own spellcasting proficiency in spell modifier and spell DC when casting a spell in this way, and they use their own Wisdom or Charisma modifier (matching your choice). If your hierophant has mythic power, they can spend a Mythic Point to cast any divine spell they gain by being your hierophant at mythic proficiency.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.AJQCccOtbPq1dIWY]{Godling}

When they Cast the Spell in this way, your Focus Point is expended as the cost of the spell. Your hierophant uses their own spellcasting proficiency in spell modifier and spell DC when casting a spell in this way, and they use their own Wisdom or Charisma modifier (matching your choice). If your hierophant has mythic power, they can spend a Mythic Point to cast any divine spell they gain by being your hierophant at mythic proficiency.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.AJQCccOtbPq1dIWY]{Godling}
_desc_ko:
당신의 소명은 진정한 신성 승천의 길을 걷기 시작하게 하며, 신성한 씨앗이 자라남에 따라 추종자들에게 영감을 불어넣습니다. 첫 번째 추종자는 당신의 신앙의 대제사장인 계시자입니다. 당신은 우주적 관점으로 점점 더 끌려감에 따라, 당신의 말씀을 전파하고 인간적 존재감을 제공해 줄 계시자에게 의지합니다. 이 피트를 획득할 때, 기꺼이 당신의 계시자가 되어줄 동료를 한 명 선택하십시오. 당신의 계시자가 주문 공격 수정자와 주문 DC에 숙련되지 않았다면, 그들이 당신의 지정된 계시자로 있는 동안 숙련 상태가 됩니다. 당신의 계시자가 사망하거나 당신과 헤어지기로 선택하면, 선택한 동료와 24시간 동안 교감함으로써 새로운 계시자를 지정할 수 있습니다.

당신의 소명은 일반적으로 신들에게만 제한된 신성한 마법을 사용할 수 있게 합니다. 플레이어 코어에 기재된 목록이나 접근 가능한 다른 도메인 중에서 하나의 도메인을 선택하여 주장하십시오. 해당 도메인의 초기 도메인 주문을 습득합니다. 1초점 포인트로 구성된 포커스 풀을 얻으며, 10분 동안 초점을 재조정하여 초월계로부터 신성한 에너지를 보충할 수 있습니다. 해당 도메인 마법의 수정자와 주문 DC에 숙련도를 얻으며, 이 마법들의 시전 능력치는 지혜 또는 매력 중 선택할 수 있습니다. 선택 시점은 이 재주를 획득할 때입니다.

당신의 계시자는 또한 '주문 시전' 행동을 획득하며, 신령 헌신으로 배운 도메인 주문을 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 방식으로 주문을 시전할 때, 당신의 포커스 포인트가 주문 비용으로 소모됩니다. 이 방식으로 주문을 시전할 때, 당신의 계시자는 주문 수정자와 주문 DC에 자신의 주문 시전 숙련도를 적용하며, 자신의 지혜 또는 매력 수정자(당신이 선택한 능력치에 따라)를 사용합니다. 계시자가 신화적 힘을 보유한 경우, 신화적 포인트를 소모하여 계시자로서 획득한 모든 신성 주문을 신화적 숙련도로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Advanced Qi Spells

description.value:
Your talent at controlling your qi has reached new heights. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.oo7YcRC2gcez81PV]{Qi Blast}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Az3PmWnlWSb5ELX9]{Shrink the Span}, or another 3rd-rank qi spell you have access to.

Special You can select this feat more than once, choosing a different spell each time.

_desc_en:
Your talent at controlling your qi has reached new heights. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.oo7YcRC2gcez81PV]{Qi Blast}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Az3PmWnlWSb5ELX9]{Shrink the Span}, or another 3rd-rank qi spell you have access to.

Special You can select this feat more than once, choosing a different spell each time.
_desc_ko: 기(氣)를 제어하는 당신의 재능이 새로운 경지에 도달했습니다. @link[spells.qi-blast], @link[spells.shrink-the-span]}, 또는 당신이 사용할 수 있는 다른 3rd 랭크 기(氣) 주문을 획득합니다.

name: Four-Armed Aspect

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You intone vows to shoulder others' pains; in response, your torso sprouts an additional pair of arms to help you bear those burdens. For the following minute, you can carry 3 more Bulk than normal before becoming encumbered and up to a maximum of 6 more Bulk. You can also use these arms as free hands to perform only the following actions or activities: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}. After this minute or when you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, whichever comes first, these additional arms fade away.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:

_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

타인의 고통을 짊어지겠다는 서약을 외치자, 그 응답으로 몸통에서 추가 팔 한 쌍이 돋아나 그 짐을 함께 지게 된다. 이후 1분 동안, 과적 상태에 빠지기 전까지 평소보다 3 더 많은 벌크를 운반할 수 있으며 최대 6까지 추가로 운반 가능하다. 또한 이 팔들을 빈 손으로 사용하여 다음 행동이나 활동만을 수행할 수 있다: @link[actions.disarm], @link[actions.grapple], @link[actions.shove], @link[actions.trip]. 1분이 지나거나 @link[conditions.unconscious] 상태가 되면, 먼저 발생하는 경우에 따라 이 추가 팔들은 사라집니다.

name: Defensive Advance

description.value:
With the protection of your shield, you dive into battle! You Raise your Shield and Stride. If you end your movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, you can make a melee Strike against that enemy.

You can use Defensive Advance while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

_desc_en:
With the protection of your shield, you dive into battle! You Raise your Shield and Stride. If you end your movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, you can make a melee Strike against that enemy.

You can use Defensive Advance while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.
_desc_ko:
방패의 보호 아래 전투에 뛰어들다! 방패를 들고 이동한다. 적어도 한 명의 적과 근접 공격 범위 내에 이동을 종료하면, 해당 적에게 근접 공격을 가할 수 있다.

해당 이동 유형을 가진 경우, 땅속 이동, 등반, 비행 또는 수영 시에도 방어적 전진 대신 이동할 수 있습니다.

name: Cellular Reconstruction

description.value: Your ostilli takes control of your nervous system and kicks your cellular functions into overdrive when you're about to die. You regain Hit Points equal to your level. For the next 2 rounds, at the start of your turn, you regain Hit Points equal to half your level. The first time you regain Hit Points at the start of your turn, you reduce your wounded condition by 1.

_desc_en: Your ostilli takes control of your nervous system and kicks your cellular functions into overdrive when you're about to die. You regain Hit Points equal to your level. For the next 2 rounds, at the start of your turn, you regain Hit Points equal to half your level. The first time you regain Hit Points at the start of your turn, you reduce your wounded condition by 1.
_desc_ko: 당신이 죽기 직전, 오스티리가 신경계를 장악하고 세포 기능을 극한으로 끌어올립니다. 당신은 레벨에 해당하는 HP를 회복합니다. 이후 2라운드 동안, 당신의 턴 시작 시마다 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 HP를 회복합니다. 턴 시작 시 HP를 회복하는 첫 번째 차례에는 부상 상태를 1 감소시킵니다.

name: You're an Embarrassment!

description.value:
Trigger An ally within 30 feet fails a Will saving throw against an incapacitation effect.

Some Firebrands can't stand it when their allies are ruining their moment, and you're no different. Your loud and forceful condemnation of an ally succumbing to an incapacitation effect gives them a second chance to impress you and shake off the effect. Your ally rerolls the triggering Will saving throw with a +1 circumstance bonus. Regardless of the result of the save, your ally is temporarily immune to You're an Embarrassment! for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.zUvicEXd4OgCZ1cO]{Effect: You're an Embarrassment}

_desc_en:
Trigger An ally within 30 feet fails a Will saving throw against an incapacitation effect.

Some Firebrands can't stand it when their allies are ruining their moment, and you're no different. Your loud and forceful condemnation of an ally succumbing to an incapacitation effect gives them a second chance to impress you and shake off the effect. Your ally rerolls the triggering Will saving throw with a +1 circumstance bonus. Regardless of the result of the save, your ally is temporarily immune to You're an Embarrassment! for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.zUvicEXd4OgCZ1cO]{Effect: You're an Embarrassment}
_desc_ko:
발동 30피트 내 아군이 무력화 효과에 대한 의지 내성 굴림에 실패할 때.

일부 불꽃들은 아군이 자신의 순간을 망치는 걸 참지 못하는데, 너도 마찬가지다. 동료가 무력화 효과에 굴복하자 네가 큰 소리로 기세 있게 비난하자, 그 동료는 너에게 다시 한번 인상을 남기고 효과를 떨쳐낼 기회를 얻는다. 동료는 발동된 의지 내성 굴림을 +1 상황 보너스와 함께 재굴림한다. 내성 굴림 결과와 상관없이, 동료는 10분 동안 '네가 창피해!' 효과에 일시적으로 면역이 된다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.zUvicEXd4OgCZ1cO]{효과: 네가 창피해}

name: Hobgoblin Lore

description.value:
You've studied traditional hobgoblin exercises and fieldcraft, all of which have a militaristic bent. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Athletics and Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Hobgoblin Lore.

_desc_en:
You've studied traditional hobgoblin exercises and fieldcraft, all of which have a militaristic bent. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Athletics and Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Hobgoblin Lore.
_desc_ko:
당신은 홉고블린의 전통적인 훈련법과 야전 기술을 연구했으며, 이 모든 것은 군사적 성향을 띠고 있습니다. 당신은 운동과 제작에 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 해당 기술 중 하나에 자동으로 숙련된 상태가 된다면, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련된 상태가 됩니다.

홉고블린 지식에 대한 @link[feats.additional-lore] 일반 피트를 획득합니다.

name: Divine Castigation

description.value: Your deity's grace doesn't extend to your sworn enemies. When you cast a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} spell, you can add your holy or unholy trait to it. If you do, the spell deals damage to creatures with the opposing trait, even if it wouldn't normally damage them. The spell deals spirit damage when used this way. For example, if you are holy, you could add the holy trait to a heal spell and deal spirit damage to a fiend that has the unholy trait.

_desc_en: Your deity's grace doesn't extend to your sworn enemies. When you cast a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} spell, you can add your holy or unholy trait to it. If you do, the spell deals damage to creatures with the opposing trait, even if it wouldn't normally damage them. The spell deals spirit damage when used this way. For example, if you are holy, you could add the holy trait to a heal spell and deal spirit damage to a fiend that has the unholy trait.
_desc_ko: 당신의 신의 은총은 맹세한 적에게는 미치지 않습니다. @link[spells.harm] 또는 @link[spells.heal] 주문을 시전할 때, 당신의 신성한 또는 불경한 특성을 추가할 수 있습니다. 그렇게 할 경우, 해당 주문은 반대 특성을 가진 생물에게 피해를 입히며, 평소에는 피해를 입히지 않는 대상도 포함됩니다. 이 방식으로 사용될 때 주문은 영혼 피해를 입힙니다. 예를 들어, 당신이 신성한 특성이라면 치유 주문에 신성한 특성을 추가하여 불경한 특성을 가진 핀드에게 영혼 피해를 입힐 수 있습니다.

name: Eternal Memories

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You have lived longer than most realize, and due to your many lifetimes of practice you remember almost everything from your previous incarnations now. You examine your memories, changing the skills you selected with Ancient Memories and Endless Memories.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You have lived longer than most realize, and due to your many lifetimes of practice you remember almost everything from your previous incarnations now. You examine your memories, changing the skills you selected with Ancient Memories and Endless Memories.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신은 대부분의 사람들이 인식하는 것보다 더 오래 살아왔으며, 수많은 생애에 걸친 수행 덕분에 이제 이전 환생에서의 거의 모든 것을 기억합니다. 당신은 자신의 기억을 살피며, 고대의 기억과 끝없는 기억으로 선택했던 기술을 변경합니다.

name: Hazard Finder

description.value: You have an intuitive ability to sense hazards. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to find traps and hazards, to AC against their attacks, and to saves against their effects. You can find hazards that would normally require you to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} even if you aren't Searching.

rules.label: Hazard Finder (to find traps and hazards)
Hazard Finder (vs. attacks from traps and hazards)
Hazard Finder (saves vs. traps and hazards)

_desc_en: You have an intuitive ability to sense hazards. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to find traps and hazards, to AC against their attacks, and to saves against their effects. You can find hazards that would normally require you to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} even if you aren't Searching.
_desc_ko: 위험을 감지하는 직관적 능력을 지녔습니다. 함정과 위험을 발견하는 지각 판정, 그 공격에 대한 AC, 그 효과에 대한 내성에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 일반적으로 @link[actions.search]이 필요한 위험도 탐색하지 않아도 발견할 수 있습니다.

name: Spellstriker

description.value: You gain the magus's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QDW9H8XLIjuW2fE4]{Spellstrike} activity. You can recharge it only as an activity that takes 1 minute. This restriction applies even if you gain another ability that recharges Spellstrike.

_desc_en: You gain the magus's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QDW9H8XLIjuW2fE4]{Spellstrike} activity. You can recharge it only as an activity that takes 1 minute. This restriction applies even if you gain another ability that recharges Spellstrike.
_desc_ko: 당신은 메이거스의 @link[actions.spellstrike] 능력을 얻습니다. 이 능력은 1분이 소요되는 행동으로만 재충전할 수 있습니다. 다른 능력으로 스펠스트라이크를 재충전할 수 있게 되더라도 이 제한은 적용됩니다.

name: Master of the Dead

description.value: You have reached the pinnacle of the reanimator's craft: the ability to raise nearly any corpse or skeleton as a gruesome mockery of the creature it once was. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Z82DvtSXafPmh4KV]{Shambling Horror} focus spell. Your focus pool increases by 1 Focus Point.

_desc_en: You have reached the pinnacle of the reanimator's craft: the ability to raise nearly any corpse or skeleton as a gruesome mockery of the creature it once was. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Z82DvtSXafPmh4KV]{Shambling Horror} focus spell. Your focus pool increases by 1 Focus Point.
_desc_ko: 당신은 부활술의 정점에 도달했습니다: 거의 모든 시체나 해골을 한때의 생명을 흉측하게 모방한 존재로 되살리는 능력입니다. 당신은 @link[spells.shambling-horror] 포커스 주문을 배웁니다. 당신의 포커스 풀이 1 포커스 포인트 증가합니다.

name: Advanced First Aid

description.value: You use your medical training to ameliorate sickness or assuage fears. When you use Medicine to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid}, instead of Stabilizing a character or Stopping Bleeding, you can reduce an ally's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} condition by 2, or remove either of those conditions entirely on a critical success. You can remove only one condition at a time. The DC for the Medicine check is usually the DC of the effect that caused the condition.

_desc_en: You use your medical training to ameliorate sickness or assuage fears. When you use Medicine to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid}, instead of Stabilizing a character or Stopping Bleeding, you can reduce an ally's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} condition by 2, or remove either of those conditions entirely on a critical success. You can remove only one condition at a time. The DC for the Medicine check is usually the DC of the effect that caused the condition.
_desc_ko: 당신은 의학 지식을 활용해 질병을 완화하거나 두려움을 달래줍니다. 의술로 @link[actions.administer-first-aid]를 수행할 때, 대상의 상태를 안정시키거나 출혈을 멈추는 대신 아군의 @link[conditions.frightened] 또는 @link[conditions.sickened] 상태를 2만큼 감소시키거나, 대성공 시 해당 상태 중 하나를 완전히 제거할 수 있습니다. 한 번에 하나의 상태만 제거할 수 있습니다. 의술 판정 난이도는 일반적으로 해당 상태를 유발한 효과의 난이도와 동일합니다.

name: Turn Away Misfortune

description.value:
Trigger You would attempt a roll affected by a misfortune effect.

You perform a superstition, such as casting salt over your shoulder to ward off bad luck. Turn Away Misfortune's fortune trait cancels out the misfortune effect, causing you to roll normally. As normal, you can apply only one fortune ability to a roll, so if you Turned Away Misfortune on an attack roll, you couldn't also use an ability like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ZbRVqf14RTJJIZXG]{Halfling Luck} to alter the roll further.

_desc_en:
Trigger You would attempt a roll affected by a misfortune effect.

You perform a superstition, such as casting salt over your shoulder to ward off bad luck. Turn Away Misfortune's fortune trait cancels out the misfortune effect, causing you to roll normally. As normal, you can apply only one fortune ability to a roll, so if you Turned Away Misfortune on an attack roll, you couldn't also use an ability like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ZbRVqf14RTJJIZXG]{Halfling Luck} to alter the roll further.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 불운 효과의 영향을 받는 굴림을 시도할 때.

당신은 어깨 너머로 소금을 뿌려 불운을 수호부하는 등 미신을 행합니다. '불운을 물리치다'의 운명 특성은 불운 효과를 무효화하여 정상적으로 주사위를 굴리게 합니다. 일반적으로 한 번의 굴림에 하나의 운명 능력만 적용할 수 있으므로, 명중 굴림에 '불운을 물리치다'를 사용했다면 하플링의 행운 같은 다른 능력을 추가로 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Phantom Orchestra

description.value: An easy way to trick others is to throw your voice into a nearby forest or thicket to make strange noises. You can cast 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yV7Ouzaoe7DHLESI]{Ventriloquism} as an innate primal spell once per day. You can also cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0zU8CPejjQFnhZFI]{Figment} cantrip as a primal innate spell at will, heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: An easy way to trick others is to throw your voice into a nearby forest or thicket to make strange noises. You can cast 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yV7Ouzaoe7DHLESI]{Ventriloquism} as an innate primal spell once per day. You can also cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0zU8CPejjQFnhZFI]{Figment} cantrip as a primal innate spell at will, heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 다른 사람을 속이는 쉬운 방법은 목소리를 근처 숲이나 덤불 속으로 던져 이상한 소리를 내는 것이다. 하루에 한 번, 선천적 프라이멀 마법으로 (2nd) @link[spells.ventriloquism]을 시전할 수 있다. 또한 @link[spells.figment] 캔트립을 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 마음대로 시전할 수 있으며, 이 마법의 랭크은 자신의 레벨 절반(올림)에 해당하는 마법 랭크으로 강화된다.

name: Rapid Manifestation

description.value:
Trigger You roll initiative or a hazard attacks you.

Your unwavering soul brings up your defenses as soon as you're in danger. You Manifest your Soulforged Armament.

_desc_en:
Trigger You roll initiative or a hazard attacks you.

Your unwavering soul brings up your defenses as soon as you're in danger. You Manifest your Soulforged Armament.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 이니셔티브를 굴리거나 위험이 당신을 공격할 때.

위기에 처하자마자 흔들림 없는 영혼이 방어막을 치솟게 한다. 영혼으로 단련된 무장을 창조한다.

name: Pierce the Eye

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a ranged weapon.

You aim a shot from your weapon directly at a foe's eye, blinding them in the process. Make a ranged Strike. On a hit, the target additionally takes 2d8 persistent bleed damage. The target must also attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class] save against your class DC with the following effects.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until the end of its next turn.

Failure The target is blinded for as long as they are taking the persistent bleed damage and for 1 additional round thereafter.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target also takes a –2 circumstance penalty to the flat check to remove the persistent bleed damage; a creature Administering First Aid to stop this persistent bleed damage takes a –2 circumstance penalty to the Medicine check.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.QjIiY4ofmhCspUJb]{Effect: Pierce the Eye}

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a ranged weapon.

You aim a shot from your weapon directly at a foe's eye, blinding them in the process. Make a ranged Strike. On a hit, the target additionally takes 2d8 persistent bleed damage. The target must also attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class] save against your class DC with the following effects.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until the end of its next turn.

Failure The target is blinded for as long as they are taking the persistent bleed damage and for 1 additional round thereafter.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target also takes a –2 circumstance penalty to the flat check to remove the persistent bleed damage; a creature Administering First Aid to stop this persistent bleed damage takes a –2 circumstance penalty to the Medicine check.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.QjIiY4ofmhCspUJb]{Effect: Pierce the Eye}
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 원거리 무기를 휘두르고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 무기로 적의 눈을 직접 겨냥하여 사격하며, 이 과정에서 적을 실명시킵니다. 원거리 공격을 시도하십시오. 명중 시, 대상은 추가로 2d8 지속 출혈 피해를 입습니다. 표적은 또한 다음 효과에 대해 당신의 클래스 DC로 인내 내성을 시도해야 합니다.

대성공 표적은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 대상은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.blinded] 상태가 됩니다.

실패 대상은 지속 출혈 피해를 받는 동안과 그 후 1라운드 동안 눈멈 상태가 됩니다.

대실패 실패 시와 동일하나, 대상은 지속 출혈 피해를 제거하기 위한 단순 판정에서 -2 상황 페널티를 추가로 받음; 이 지속 출혈 피해를 멈추기 위해 응급처치를 시행하는 생물은 의학 판정에서 -2 상황 페널티를 받음.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.QjIiY4ofmhCspUJb]{효과: 눈을 관통하다}

name: Aggressive Block

description.value:
Trigger You use the Shield Block reaction, and the opponent that triggered Shield Block is adjacent to you and is your size or smaller.

You push back as you block, knocking your foe away or off balance. You use your shield to push the triggering creature, either automatically Shoving it 5 feet or causing it to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn. The triggering creature chooses whether to be moved or become off-guard. If it chooses to be moved, you choose the direction. If the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} would cause it to hit a solid object, enter a square of difficult terrain, or enter another creature's space, it must become off-guard instead of being moved.

_desc_en:
Trigger You use the Shield Block reaction, and the opponent that triggered Shield Block is adjacent to you and is your size or smaller.

You push back as you block, knocking your foe away or off balance. You use your shield to push the triggering creature, either automatically Shoving it 5 feet or causing it to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn. The triggering creature chooses whether to be moved or become off-guard. If it chooses to be moved, you choose the direction. If the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} would cause it to hit a solid object, enter a square of difficult terrain, or enter another creature's space, it must become off-guard instead of being moved.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 방패 막기 반응을 사용하며, 방패 막기를 발동시킨 상대가 당신과 인접해 있고 당신의 크기 이하일 때.

방어하면서 밀쳐내 적을 밀어내거나 균형을 잃게 합니다. 방패로 발동 생물을 밀어내며, 자동으로 5피트 밀치거나 다음 턴 시작까지 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 되게 합니다. 발동 대상 생물은 밀려나거나 무방비가 될지 선택한다. 밀려나기를 선택하면 방향은 당신이 정한다. @link[actions.shove]로 인해 대상이 단단한 물체에 부딪히거나, 어려운 지형 칸에 들어가거나, 다른 생물의 공간에 들어가는 경우, 밀려나기 대신 무방비가 되어야 한다.

name: Shadowdancer Dedication

description.value:
You dedicate yourself to the shadows. Your coloring becomes gray and gloomy, your senses adjust to the darkness, and you can sneak through darkness with ease.

You gain greater darkvision. You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks when you are within dim light or darkness.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.MKU4d2hIpLuXGN2J]{Shadowdancer}

_desc_en:
You dedicate yourself to the shadows. Your coloring becomes gray and gloomy, your senses adjust to the darkness, and you can sneak through darkness with ease.

You gain greater darkvision. You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks when you are within dim light or darkness.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.MKU4d2hIpLuXGN2J]{Shadowdancer}
_desc_ko:
당신은 그림자에 헌신합니다. 당신의 색조는 회색빛으로 어두워지고, 감각이 어둠에 적응하며, 어둠 속을 쉽게 {은밀 이동}할 수 있습니다.

당신은 더 뛰어난 암흑 시야를 얻습니다. 또한 희미한 빛이나 어둠 속에 있을 때 은신 판정에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: All the Time in the World

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Your firsthand experience of the subjective nature of time and space has given you new observational insights. Your mind processes information so quickly that time appears to stop for all creatures but you. You can take up to 9 actions in 3 sets of up to 3 actions each. During this time, you can use purely mental and observational abilities such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.m0f2B7G9eaaTmhFL]{Devise a Stratagem}, and you can use an action to move a mental projection of yourself to a location within a 60- foot radius to observe objects more closely and from different angles, though you can't affect your surroundings in any way (for instance, you could move your mental projection more closely to a distant door to read a minute inscription on its handle, but you could not open it to observe the other side). When the duration elapses, time resumes its normal flow.

name_en: All the Time in the World

Frequency once per hour
