_desc_ko:
빈도 10분마다 한 번

일부 동물과 야수들은 몸속에 전기 기관을 지니고 있어 먹잇감을 감전시킬 수 있습니다. 당신은 그런 생리적 구조를 갖추지 못했을지라도, 프라이멀 마법의 터치로 동일한 효과를 낼 수 있습니다. 생물에게 근접 비무장 공격을 가하십시오. 공격이 적중하면 추가로 1d12의 전기 피해를 입히고, 해당 생물은 당신의 직업 난이도(DC)와 주문 난이도(DC) 중 높은 쪽에 대한 인내 내성을 갖추어야 합니다.

대성공 생물은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 생물은 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.clumsy]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

실패 해당 생물은 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.clumsy]{2} 상태가 됩니다.

대실패 해당 생물은 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.clumsy]{3} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Vigilant Mask

description.value: Your mask grants the extraordinary magical senses of Carmine Jaws, the Hyena who Looks Between. You gain scent as a precise sense to a range of 60 feet. If you already have scent as a precise sense, increase its range by 60 feet. You can sometimes catch a faint whiff of magic itself. Immediately after you Cast a non-cantrip Spell, your scent extends between worlds, like Carmine Jaws's own. This causes you to be able to smell ethereal creatures, those in an extradimensional space with an aperture that's within your scent range, incorporeal creatures and objects, and other creatures and objects that are insubstantial or not fully in phase with reality. Unlike your normal scent, this is an imprecise sense.

_desc_en: Your mask grants the extraordinary magical senses of Carmine Jaws, the Hyena who Looks Between. You gain scent as a precise sense to a range of 60 feet. If you already have scent as a precise sense, increase its range by 60 feet. You can sometimes catch a faint whiff of magic itself. Immediately after you Cast a non-cantrip Spell, your scent extends between worlds, like Carmine Jaws's own. This causes you to be able to smell ethereal creatures, those in an extradimensional space with an aperture that's within your scent range, incorporeal creatures and objects, and other creatures and objects that are insubstantial or not fully in phase with reality. Unlike your normal scent, this is an imprecise sense.
_desc_ko: 당신의 가면은 세계 사이를 바라보는 하이에나, 카민 조스의 비범한 마법적 감각을 부여합니다. 60피트 범위 내에서 후각을 정밀한 감각으로 얻습니다. 이미 후각을 정밀한 감각으로 가지고 있다면, 그 범위를 60피트 증가시킵니다. 때로는 마법 그 자체의 희미한 냄새를 맡을 수 있습니다. 캔트립 주문을 시전한 직후, 당신의 후각이 카민 죠스처럼 세계 사이로 확장됩니다. 이로 인해 당신은 에테리얼 생물, 당신의 후각 범위 내에 개구부가 있는 초차원 공간에 있는 존재들, 비물질적 생물 및 물체, 그리고 실체가 없거나 현실과 완전히 동조하지 않는 다른 생물 및 물체의 냄새를 맡을 수 있습니다. 일반적인 후각과 달리, 이는 부정확한 감각입니다.

name: This is What it's Like to Die

description.value:
It's one thing to remember your previous lives. It's quite another to remember how you died in each of those lives. You can recall dozens, if not more, of excruciating, humiliating, and devastating ends you've suffered over the eons, and you can inflict upon your enemies a vision of these pains. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MJx7DmjsWYzDZ3a4]{Phantasmagoria} as an occult innate spell that you can cast once per day.

When you gain this feat, choose any two of the following damage types: acid, bludgeoning, cold, electricity, fire, piercing, poison, slashing, or sonic. These damage types caused your deaths more often than not in your previous lives, and whenever a creature takes damage from a phantasmagoria spell you cast, you can swap the mental damage that spell normally causes for one of the two damage types you chose.

이 재주를 얻을 때, 다음 피해 유형 중 두 가지를 선택하십시오: 산성, 타격, 냉기, 전기, 화염, 관통, 독, 참격, 음파. 이 피해 유형들이 전생에서 대개 당신의 죽음을 초래했으며, 생물이 당신이 시전한 환영극 주문으로 피해를 입을 때마다, 그 주문이 통상적으로 유발하는 정신 피해를 당신이 선택한 두 피해 유형 중 하나로 바꿀 수 있습니다.

name: Oozemorph Dedication

description.value:
You are plagued by sporadic anatomical rearrangements, which grant you insights into other creatures with unusual anatomies. You become trained in Occultism and Ooze Lore; if you were already trained, you become an expert instead. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves to avoid being Engulfed by creatures, and to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} after being Engulfed.

As you develop more abilities based on your amorphous affliction, you become increasingly off-putting to mundane creatures. You take a penalty to Diplomacy checks against animals and humanoids. This penalty is equal to your number of class feats from the oozemorph archetype, to a maximum of -4 for four or more feats.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.tJQ5f8C8m5gpZsF1]{Oozemorph}
_desc_ko:
당신은 간헐적인 해부학적 재편성으로 고통받으며, 이로 인해 특이한 해부학적 구조를 가진 다른 생물에 대한 통찰력을 얻습니다. 당신은 오컬트과 오즈 지식 중 오즈 지식(우즈 지식)에 숙련됩니다. 이미 숙련 상태였다면 전문가로 승급합니다. 생물에게 삼켜지는 것을 피하기 위한 반사 내성에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 삼켜진 후 @link[actions.escape]에 대한 판정에도 동일한 보너스가 적용됩니다.

형체 없는 질병에 기반한 능력을 더 발전시킬수록, 당신은 평범한 생물들에게 점점 더 불쾌한 존재가 됩니다. 동물과 인간형 생물 대상 외교 판정 시 불이익을 받습니다. 이 불이익은 우즈 형체 원형의 클래스 피트 수와 같으며, 피트 4개 이상일 경우 최대 -4까지 적용됩니다.

name: Master Druid Spellcasting

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#master-spellcasting-feat]{Master Spellcasting Feat} benefits.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#master-spellcasting-feat]{Master Spellcasting Feat} benefits.
_desc_ko: {마스터 주문 시전 피트}의 혜택을 얻습니다.

name: Autonomic Psychic Action

description.value: Your power wants to be free. You're permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}, and can use the additional action only for psyche actions.

_desc_en: Your power wants to be free. You're permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}, and can use the additional action only for psyche actions.
_desc_ko: 당신의 힘은 자유롭기를 원합니다. 당신은 영구적으로 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{가속} 상태이며, 그 추가 행동을 프시케 행동에만 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Harmonize

description.value: You can perform multiple compositions simultaneously, typically by performing in multiple ways at the same time, using special vocal techniques to double your voice, or creating occult magic that replicates your song or speech. If your next action is to cast a composition, it becomes a harmonized composition. Unlike a normal composition, a harmonized composition doesn't end if you cast another composition, and you can cast another composition on the same turn as a harmonized one. Casting another harmonized composition ends any harmonized composition you already have in effect.

_desc_en: You can perform multiple compositions simultaneously, typically by performing in multiple ways at the same time, using special vocal techniques to double your voice, or creating occult magic that replicates your song or speech. If your next action is to cast a composition, it becomes a harmonized composition. Unlike a normal composition, a harmonized composition doesn't end if you cast another composition, and you can cast another composition on the same turn as a harmonized one. Casting another harmonized composition ends any harmonized composition you already have in effect.
_desc_ko: 여러 곡을 동시에 연주할 수 있습니다. 일반적으로 여러 방식으로 동시에 연주하거나, 특수 발성 기법으로 목소리를 복제하거나, 노래나 말을 복제하는 오컬트 마법을 사용합니다. 다음 행동이 작곡 시전인 경우, 이는 하모나이즈드 작곡이 됩니다. 일반 작곡과 달리, 하모나이즈드 작곡은 다른 작곡을 시전해도 종료되지 않으며, 하모나이즈드 작곡과 같은 턴에 다른 작곡을 시전할 수 있습니다. 다른 하모나이즈드 작곡을 시전하면 기존에 효과가 있던 모든 하모나이즈드 작곡이 종료됩니다.

name: Root Magic

description.value:
Your talismans ward against foul magic. During your daily preparations, you can assemble a small pouch with bits of herbs, hair, sacred oils, and other ritual ingredients, which you give to one ally; the ally cannot be yourself. The first time that day the ally attempts a saving throw against a spell or haunt, they gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the roll. This bonus increases to +2 if you're an expert in Occultism or +3 if you're legendary.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.jO7wMhnjT7yoAtQg]{Effect: Root Magic}

_desc_en:
Your talismans ward against foul magic. During your daily preparations, you can assemble a small pouch with bits of herbs, hair, sacred oils, and other ritual ingredients, which you give to one ally; the ally cannot be yourself. The first time that day the ally attempts a saving throw against a spell or haunt, they gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the roll. This bonus increases to +2 if you're an expert in Occultism or +3 if you're legendary.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.jO7wMhnjT7yoAtQg]{Effect: Root Magic}
_desc_ko:
당신의 수호부는 사악한 마법으로부터 보호합니다. 매일 준비 시간에 약초 조각, 머리카락, 성유, 기타 의식 재료로 작은 주머니를 만들어 한 명의 아군에게 줄 수 있습니다. 아군은 자신이 될 수 없습니다. 그 동맹이 그날 처음으로 주문이나 유령에 대한 내성 굴림을 시도할 때, 해당 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 당신이 오컬트에 숙련자라면 이 보너스는 +2로, 전설적인 수준이라면 +3으로 증가합니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.jO7wMhnjT7yoAtQg]{효과: 뿌리 마법}

name: Ru-shi

description.value: You were born to a jiang-shi, one of the so-called hopping vampires found most often in Tian-Xia. Your parent had a supernatural obsession with counting small objects, which manifests in you as a preternatural gift for linguistics and mathematics. You are trained in Society and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.0N8TtGSk5enoLBZ8]{Eye for Numbers} skill feat. If you would automatically become trained in Society (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

_desc_en: You were born to a jiang-shi, one of the so-called hopping vampires found most often in Tian-Xia. Your parent had a supernatural obsession with counting small objects, which manifests in you as a preternatural gift for linguistics and mathematics. You are trained in Society and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.0N8TtGSk5enoLBZ8]{Eye for Numbers} skill feat. If you would automatically become trained in Society (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.
_desc_ko: 당신은 티엔 샤에서 가장 흔히 발견되는 소위 '뛰는 흡혈귀' 중 하나인 강시에게서 태어났습니다. 당신의 부모는 작은 물건을 세는 데 초자연적인 집착을 보였는데, 이는 당신에게 언어학과 수학에 대한 초자연적인 재능으로 창조됩니다. 당신은 사회에 숙련되어 있으며 @link[feats.eye-for-numbers] 기술 재주를 얻습니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 자동으로 사회에 숙련될 경우, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다.

name: Invigorating Breath

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements You are adjacent to your spirit guide or it is sharing your space.

Your spirit guide exhales its sweet-smelling breath on you, granting you the strength to push through your pain. You gain 20 temporary Hit Points for 10 minutes. At 15th level, you instead gain 30 temporary Hit Points for 10 minutes.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements You are adjacent to your spirit guide or it is sharing your space.

Your spirit guide exhales its sweet-smelling breath on you, granting you the strength to push through your pain. You gain 20 temporary Hit Points for 10 minutes. At 15th level, you instead gain 30 temporary Hit Points for 10 minutes.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 시간당 1회

요구 사항 당신은 영혼의 안내자와 인접해 있거나, 그 안내자가 당신의 공간을 공유하고 있습니다.

당신의 영혼 안내자가 달콤한 향기의 숨결을 내뿜어 고통을 이겨낼 힘을 부여합니다. 10분 동안 20의 임시 HP를 얻습니다. 15레벨부터는 대신 10분 동안 30의 임시 HP를 얻습니다.

name: Additional Servings

description.value:
Your number of versatile vials per day increases to 5.

Special At 12th level or higher, you can select this feat a second time to increase your number of versatile vials per day to 6. At 18th level or higher, you can select this feat a third time to increase your number of versatile vials per day to 7.

value.value: expert in Crafting or Cooking Lore

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Your number of versatile vials per day increases to 5.

Special At 12th level or higher, you can select this feat a second time to increase your number of versatile vials per day to 6. At 18th level or higher, you can select this feat a third time to increase your number of versatile vials per day to 7.
_desc_ko:
하루에 사용할 수 있는 다용도 약병 수가 5개로 증가한다.

특수 12레벨 이상에서 이 피트를 두 번째로 선택하면 하루에 사용할 수 있는 다용도 약병의 수가 6개로 증가합니다. 18레벨 이상에서 이 피트를 세 번째로 선택하면 하루에 사용할 수 있는 다용도 약병의 수가 7개로 증가합니다.

name: Hellbreaker's Resolve

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You gird yourself in both mind and body for danger, steeling your resolve. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last for 1 minute. While you have those temporary Hit Points, you gain a +1 status bonus to Will saves.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.wZcxrAL40jM5I5Dm]{Effect: Hellbreaker's Resolve}

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

You gird yourself in both mind and body for danger, steeling your resolve. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last for 1 minute. While you have those temporary Hit Points, you gain a +1 status bonus to Will saves.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.wZcxrAL40jM5I5Dm]{Effect: Hellbreaker's Resolve}
_desc_ko:
빈도 시간당 한 번

당신은 위험에 대비해 정신과 육체 모두를 다잡으며 결의를 굳힙니다. 당신은 1분 동안 지속되는, 당신의 레벨과 같은 임시 생명점을 얻습니다. 그 임시 생명점을 지니고 있는 동안, 당신은 의지 내성에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.wZcxrAL40jM5I5Dm]{효과: 지옥파괴자의 결의}

name: Call From Death's Door

description.value:
Trigger The @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition of an ally you're observing would increase.

Even death halts in the face of your power. Spend a Mythic Point; the triggering ally loses the dying condition, their @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition doesn't increase, and they heal a number of Hit Points equal to @Damage[(2*@actor.level)[healing]]{twice your level}.

_desc_en:
Trigger The @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition of an ally you're observing would increase.

Even death halts in the face of your power. Spend a Mythic Point; the triggering ally loses the dying condition, their @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition doesn't increase, and they heal a number of Hit Points equal to @Damage[(2*@actor.level)[healing]]{twice your level}.
_desc_ko:
발동 관찰 중인 아군의 @link[conditions.dying] 상태가 증가하려던 순간.

당신의 힘 앞에서는 죽음마저 멈춘다. 신화 포인트 1점을 소모하면, 발동 대상 아군의 @link[conditions.dying] 상태가 사라지고, @link[conditions.wounded] 상태가 증가하지 않으며, 당신의 레벨 × 2만큼의 HP를 치유합니다.

name: Orc Lore

description.value:
The hold elders taught you your people's histories, told tales of great athletic feats, and shared with you the hardships your ancestors endured so that you can pass this wisdom down to future generations. You become trained in Athletics and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Orc Lore.

_desc_en:
The hold elders taught you your people's histories, told tales of great athletic feats, and shared with you the hardships your ancestors endured so that you can pass this wisdom down to future generations. You become trained in Athletics and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Orc Lore.
_desc_ko:
족장의 장로들은 당신에게 민족의 역사를 가르쳤고, 위대한 운동 피트의 이야기를 들려주었으며, 후대에 이 지혜를 전할 수 있도록 선조들이 겪은 고난을 공유했습니다. 당신은 운동과 생존에 숙련됩니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 자동으로 그 중 하나의 기술에 숙련될 경우, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다.

또한 오크 지식에 대한 @link[feats.additional-lore] 일반 피트를 얻습니다.

name: Clue Them All In

description.value: You can clue in all your allies at once. When you use the Clue In reaction, any of your allies who are attempting the same check to investigate one of your active investigations receive the circumstance bonus from Clue In. If you use this ability during an encounter, they must attempt their check within 1 round of when you Clued them In.

_desc_en: You can clue in all your allies at once. When you use the Clue In reaction, any of your allies who are attempting the same check to investigate one of your active investigations receive the circumstance bonus from Clue In. If you use this ability during an encounter, they must attempt their check within 1 round of when you Clued them In.
_desc_ko: 동료 모두에게 단서를 동시에 제공할 수 있습니다. '단서 제공' 반응을 사용할 때, 당신의 활성 조사 중 하나를 조사하기 위해 동일한 판정을 시도하는 동료들은 '단서 제공'의 상황 보너스를 받습니다. 이 능력을 전투 중 사용할 경우, 동료들은 당신이 단서를 제공한 후 1라운드 이내에 판정을 시도해야 합니다.

name: Powerful Snares

description.value: Your snares are particularly difficult for enemies to avoid. When you set a snare, the saving throw DC for that snare is equal to its normal DC or your class DC, whichever is higher.

_desc_en: Your snares are particularly difficult for enemies to avoid. When you set a snare, the saving throw DC for that snare is equal to its normal DC or your class DC, whichever is higher.
_desc_ko: 당신의 올가미는 적들이 피하기 특히 어렵습니다. 올가미를 설치할 때, 해당 올가미의 내성 굴림 DC는 일반 DC와 당신의 클래스 DC 중 더 높은 값과 동일합니다.

name: Plane Hop

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

The spaces between planes are obvious to you, and you can use them to move in unexpected ways. You instantly teleport to any point you could reach with your Speed.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

The spaces between planes are obvious to you, and you can use them to move in unexpected ways. You instantly teleport to any point you could reach with your Speed.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 10분에 한 번

평면 사이의 공간은 당신에게 명백하며, 이를 이용해 예상치 못한 방식으로 이동할 수 있습니다. 당신은 자신의 스피드로 도달 가능한 지점으로 즉시 순간이동합니다.

name: Planar Resilience

description.value:
Your body has adapted to the variety of harsh climes that you encounter in your travels. You treat temperature-based environmental effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold or heat becomes extreme, extreme cold or heat becomes severe, and so on).

Additionally, the planar energies that move through you allow you to further adapt your body with some concentration and effort. During your daily preparations, choose either cold or fire. You gain resistance to that damage equal to half your level (minimum 1).

_desc_en:
Your body has adapted to the variety of harsh climes that you encounter in your travels. You treat temperature-based environmental effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold or heat becomes extreme, extreme cold or heat becomes severe, and so on).

Additionally, the planar energies that move through you allow you to further adapt your body with some concentration and effort. During your daily preparations, choose either cold or fire. You gain resistance to that damage equal to half your level (minimum 1).
_desc_ko:
당신의 몸은 여행 중 마주치는 다양한 가혹한 기후에 적응했습니다. 온도 기반 환경 효과는 한 단계 덜 극단적인 것으로 간주합니다(극한의 추위나 더위는 극도로, 극한의 추위나 더위는 심하게, 등등).

또한, 당신을 통해 흐르는 평면 에너지는 집중과 노력을 통해 신체를 더욱 적응시킬 수 있게 합니다. 일일 준비 시간에 냉기 또는 화염 중 하나를 선택하세요. 해당 피해에 대해 레벨의 절반(최소 1)에 해당하는 저항력을 얻습니다.

name: Spirit Sheath

description.value:
You've magically constructed an extradimensional sheath for your weapon that you access through your clothing, typically through a pocket, sleeve, or seam. This sheath is hard to notice, granting a +2 circumstance bonus to your Stealth checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.qVNVSmsgpKFGk9hV]{Conceal} an Item within it. A spirit sheath can hold only one weapon at a time, and the weapon must be 1 Bulk or less.

During a Spellstrike, you can Interact to draw the weapon before you Cast the Spell. You can draw or return a weapon in a spirit sheath as an Interact action, as can anyone else holding or wearing the clothing that contains the sheath. A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} spell or similar effect can be used against the spirit sheath to expel the weapon. The counteract check is made against your spell DC and uses the sheath's counteract rank of 1. The weapon is also expelled if you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.

_desc_en:
You've magically constructed an extradimensional sheath for your weapon that you access through your clothing, typically through a pocket, sleeve, or seam. This sheath is hard to notice, granting a +2 circumstance bonus to your Stealth checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.qVNVSmsgpKFGk9hV]{Conceal} an Item within it. A spirit sheath can hold only one weapon at a time, and the weapon must be 1 Bulk or less.

During a Spellstrike, you can Interact to draw the weapon before you Cast the Spell. You can draw or return a weapon in a spirit sheath as an Interact action, as can anyone else holding or wearing the clothing that contains the sheath. A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} spell or similar effect can be used against the spirit sheath to expel the weapon. The counteract check is made against your spell DC and uses the sheath's counteract rank of 1. The weapon is also expelled if you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.
_desc_ko:
당신은 마법으로 무기를 위한 초차원 칼집을 제작했으며, 이는 일반적으로 주머니, 소매, 또는 솔기를 통해 의복을 통해 접근할 수 있습니다. 이 칼집은 눈에 띄기 어려워, 그 안에 있는 아이템을 은닉하기 위한 은신 판정 시 +2 상황 보너스를 부여합니다. 영혼 칼집은 한 번에 하나의 무기만 보관할 수 있으며, 해당 무기는 벌크가 1 이하여야 합니다.

스펠스트라이크 시, 주문을 시전하기 전에 상호작용 행동으로 무기를 뽑을 수 있습니다. 영혼 칼집에 꽂힌 무기를 뽑거나 칼집에 넣는 것은 상호작용 행동으로 가능하며, 칼집이 달린 옷을 착용하거나 들고 있는 다른 사람도 동일하게 수행할 수 있습니다. @link[spells.dispel-magic] 주문이나 유사한 효과를 영혼 칼집에 사용하면 무기를 쫓아낼 수 있습니다. 이 반격 판정은 당신의 주문 DC를 기준으로 하며, 칼집의 반격 랭크 1을 사용합니다. 또한 당신이 @link[conditions.unconscious] 상태가 되면 무기가 쫓겨납니다.

name: Gentle Death and Rebirth

description.value: You were once born from the energies of the land and nature, and by their power, you can return to life again. Once per year, when you die, your remains become protected as if under the effects of a 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.xRgU9rrhmGAgG4Rc]{Peaceful Rest} spell. If your remains are brought and buried within 1 mile of where you were born, after a week, you return to life with the effects of a successful (but not critically successful) 9th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kqhPt9344UkcGVYO]{Resurrect} ritual.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You were once born from the energies of the land and nature, and by their power, you can return to life again. Once per year, when you die, your remains become protected as if under the effects of a 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.xRgU9rrhmGAgG4Rc]{Peaceful Rest} spell. If your remains are brought and buried within 1 mile of where you were born, after a week, you return to life with the effects of a successful (but not critically successful) 9th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kqhPt9344UkcGVYO]{Resurrect} ritual.
_desc_ko: 당신은 한때 땅과 자연의 에너지로부터 태어났으며, 그 힘으로 다시 생명을 되찾을 수 있습니다. 일년에 한 번, 당신이 죽을 때 당신의 유해는 (5th)랭크 @link[spells.peaceful-rest] 주문 효과 아래 있는 것처럼 보호받습니다. 유해가 태어난 곳으로부터 1마일 이내로 옮겨져 매장되면, 일주일 후 대성공(하지만 치명적으로 대성공하지 않은) 9랭크 @link[spells.resurrect] 의식의 효과를 지닌 채 생명을 되찾는다.

name: Bloc Tactics

description.value:
You have experience in undertaking direct action and know how to protect the identity and health of you and your allies when doing so. During your daily preparations, you can select a number of targets equal to half your level. You disguise the targets to hide their identities, which gives them a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through their disguises, and lets them add their level even if untrained. Additionally, the disguises also protect from smoke, fumes, and inhaled substances, giving the targets a +3 status bonus to saving throws against them. The targets can quickly doff or don their disguises with a two-action activity.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.Eu3hA5BrHX9u9Bjc]{Effect: Bloc Tactics}

_desc_en:
