@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.Eu3hA5BrHX9u9Bjc]{Effect: Bloc Tactics}
_desc_ko:
당신은 직접 행동 수행 경험이 있으며, 그 과정에서 자신과 동맹의 신원과 안전을 보호하는 방법을 알고 있습니다. 일일 준비 단계에서, 당신은 자신의 레벨 절반에 해당하는 수의 표적을 선택할 수 있습니다. 표적의 신분을 숨기기 위해 변장을 시킵니다. 이로 인해 표적은 변장을 간파당하지 않도록 기만 판정에서 +4 상태 보너스를 얻으며, 훈련받지 않은 경우에도 자신의 레벨을 추가할 수 있습니다. 또한 변장은 연기, 가스, 흡입 물질로부터도 보호하여 표적이 이에 대한 내성 굴림에서 +3 상태 보너스를 받게 합니다. 표적은 두 행동을 소모하여 변장을 빠르게 벗거나 착용할 수 있습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.Eu3hA5BrHX9u9Bjc]{효과: 블록 전술}

name: Smooth Hover

description.value:
Trigger You're airborne at the end of your turn.

You remain airborne through sheer effort. You don't fall, even if you didn't use Fly or a similar action this turn.

_desc_en:
Trigger You're airborne at the end of your turn.

You remain airborne through sheer effort. You don't fall, even if you didn't use Fly or a similar action this turn.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 자신의 턴 종료 시 공중에 떠 있다.

순전히 노력으로 공중에 머무릅니다. 이번 턴에 비행이나 유사한 행동을 사용하지 않았더라도 떨어지지 않습니다.

name: Tactical Guidance

description.value: You can provide tactical guidance to help your follower act more efficiently. You can spend 2 actions to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.H72AAzknXiojqXdY]{Direct your Follower} instead of 1. If you do, your follower gains an additional action.

_desc_en: You can provide tactical guidance to help your follower act more efficiently. You can spend 2 actions to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.H72AAzknXiojqXdY]{Direct your Follower} instead of 1. If you do, your follower gains an additional action.
_desc_ko: 추종자가 더 효율적으로 행동하도록 전술적 지도를 제공할 수 있습니다. 1회 대신 2회의 행동을 소모하여 @link[actions.direct-follower]를 수행할 수 있습니다. 그렇게 할 경우, 추종자는 추가 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Efficient Alchemy (Paragon)

description.value:
Your daily preparations are particularly efficient and plentiful. When using your infused reagents to create alchemical items during your daily preparations, you make a batch of three of a given item instead of a batch of two, or a batch of four if your field normally lets you create three of that item.

Note: This feat is incompatible with the Alchemist class presented in Player Core 2, and is not automated as a result.

_desc_en:
Your daily preparations are particularly efficient and plentiful. When using your infused reagents to create alchemical items during your daily preparations, you make a batch of three of a given item instead of a batch of two, or a batch of four if your field normally lets you create three of that item.

Note: This feat is incompatible with the Alchemist class presented in Player Core 2, and is not automated as a result.
_desc_ko:
당신의 일일 준비 작업은 특히 효율적이고 풍성합니다. 일일 준비 시간에 주입된 시약을 사용해 연금술 아이템을 제작할 때, 해당 아이템을 2개가 아닌 3개씩 한 번에 제작합니다. 해당 아이템을 3개 제작할 수 있는 환경이라면 4개씩 한 번에 제작합니다.

참고: 이 재주는 플레이어 코어 2에 소개된 연금술사 클래스와 호환되지 않으며, 그 결과 자동화되지 않습니다.

name: Target of Opportunity

description.value:
Trigger An ally succeeds at a ranged Strike against an opponent in your weapon's first range increment.

Requirements You have a ranged or thrown weapon in hand.

You capitalize on your ally's attack and use the opportunity to secure a blow of your own, adding to the oncoming barrage. Make a ranged Strike with a –2 penalty against the opponent targeted by the triggering attack. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike. If this Strike is successful, combine the damage from the attack with the damage from your ally's attack for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.

_desc_en:
Trigger An ally succeeds at a ranged Strike against an opponent in your weapon's first range increment.

Requirements You have a ranged or thrown weapon in hand.

You capitalize on your ally's attack and use the opportunity to secure a blow of your own, adding to the oncoming barrage. Make a ranged Strike with a –2 penalty against the opponent targeted by the triggering attack. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike. If this Strike is successful, combine the damage from the attack with the damage from your ally's attack for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 아군이 당신의 무기 첫 사거리 구간 내에 있는 상대에게 원거리 공격을 성공시킬 때.

요건 손에 원거리 무기나 투척 무기를 들고 있어야 합니다.

동료의 공격을 활용하여 기회를 잡아 자신만의 일격을 가하며, 다가오는 공격에 합류한다. 발동 공격의 대상이 된 상대에게 -2 페널티를 적용한 원거리 타격을 수행합니다. 이 타격은 다중 공격 페널티 계산에 포함되지 않으며, 다중 공격 페널티도 이 타격에 적용되지 않습니다. 이 타격이 성공하면, 저항 및 약점 적용을 위해 이 공격의 피해와 아군의 공격 피해를 합산합니다.

name: Legion's Aim

description.value: Long hours of experimentation with the Platinum Wing have familiarized you with experimental weaponry. You have familiarity with martial firearms and alchemical bombs, treating them as simple weapons for the purposes of proficiency. You ignore the penalty for making ranged attacks within your second range increment with alchemical bombs. You gain access to uncommon firearms and alchemical bombs.

_desc_en: Long hours of experimentation with the Platinum Wing have familiarized you with experimental weaponry. You have familiarity with martial firearms and alchemical bombs, treating them as simple weapons for the purposes of proficiency. You ignore the penalty for making ranged attacks within your second range increment with alchemical bombs. You gain access to uncommon firearms and alchemical bombs.
_desc_ko: 플래티넘 윙에서의 오랜 실험 시간이 당신을 실험적 무기에 익숙하게 만들었습니다. 당신은 상급 화기와 연금술 폭탄에 익숙하여, 숙련도 목적상 이를 단순 무기로 취급합니다. 당신은 연금술 폭탄으로 두 번째 사거리 구간 내에서 원거리 공격을 할 때의 페널티를 무시합니다. 당신은 비일상 화기와 연금술 폭탄에 대한 접근 권한을 얻습니다.

name: Guardian Resiliency

description.value: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each guardian archetype class feat you have. As you continue selecting guardian archetype class feats, you continue to gain additional Hit Points in this way.

value.value: class granting no more Hit Points per level than 10 + your Constitution modifier

_desc_en: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each guardian archetype class feat you have. As you continue selecting guardian archetype class feats, you continue to gain additional Hit Points in this way.
_desc_ko: 가디언 아키타입 클래스 피트를 하나씩 선택할 때마다 추가 HP 3을 얻습니다. 가디언 아키타입 클래스 피트를 계속 선택하면 이 방식으로 추가 HP를 계속 얻습니다.

name: Glory and Valor!

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You call upon your ascendant blood with a mighty cry that fills you with a revitalizing energy for 1 minute or until you critically fail a Strike, whichever comes first. For the duration, the first time each round you successfully Strike a creature of your level or higher, you regain @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))[healing]]{Hit Points equal to half your level}.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You call upon your ascendant blood with a mighty cry that fills you with a revitalizing energy for 1 minute or until you critically fail a Strike, whichever comes first. For the duration, the first time each round you successfully Strike a creature of your level or higher, you regain @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))[healing]]{Hit Points equal to half your level}.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신은 강렬한 함성으로 상승한 피를 불러내어 1분 동안 또는 대실패 시까지 (둘 중 먼저 도래하는 시점까지) 활력을 되찾는 에너지로 가득 차게 됩니다. 지속 시간 동안, 매 라운드마다 처음으로 자신과 동등하거나 더 높은 레벨의 생물을 공격에 성공할 때마다 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 HP를 회복합니다.

name: True Debilitating Bomb

description.value: You have discovered increasingly devastating ways for your bombs to impede your foes. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.sv4LeEbkOJyLen10]{Debilitating Bomb}, add the following to the list of effects you can choose from: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}, or a –15-foot status penalty to Speeds.

_desc_en: You have discovered increasingly devastating ways for your bombs to impede your foes. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.sv4LeEbkOJyLen10]{Debilitating Bomb}, add the following to the list of effects you can choose from: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}, or a –15-foot status penalty to Speeds.
_desc_ko: 당신은 폭탄으로 적을 방해하는 점점 더 파괴적인 방법을 발견했습니다. @link[feats.debilitating-bomb]을 사용할 때, 선택 가능한 효과 목록에 다음을 추가합니다: @link[conditions.enfeebled]{2}, @link[conditions.stupefied]{2}, 또는 이동 속도에 -15피트 상태 페널티.

name: Diverse Mystery

description.value:
You have broadened your understanding of the divine and can tap into the wonders of a different mystery. Select one revelation spell from a mystery other than your own. You can choose only an initial revelation spell or an advanced revelation spell.

This spell gains the cursebound trait for you, and when you cast it, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zXZjC8HLaRoLR17U]{Cursebound 1} effects of its mystery in addition to your normal curse effects. Any ability that lets you use a cursebound ability without increasing the severity of your curse also prevents you from gaining this additional curse effect.

You can't cast your chosen revelation spell if any of the following conditions are true:

  • its mystery's curse effects directly conflict with or negate the effects of your own mystery's curse,

  • the curse would have no effect on you (for example, removing an ability from your original mystery that you lack),

  • or if either of these criteria would be met once you finish Casting the Spell

_desc_en:
You have broadened your understanding of the divine and can tap into the wonders of a different mystery. Select one revelation spell from a mystery other than your own. You can choose only an initial revelation spell or an advanced revelation spell.

This spell gains the cursebound trait for you, and when you cast it, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zXZjC8HLaRoLR17U]{Cursebound 1} effects of its mystery in addition to your normal curse effects. Any ability that lets you use a cursebound ability without increasing the severity of your curse also prevents you from gaining this additional curse effect.

You can't cast your chosen revelation spell if any of the following conditions are true:

  • its mystery's curse effects directly conflict with or negate the effects of your own mystery's curse,

  • the curse would have no effect on you (for example, removing an ability from your original mystery that you lack),

  • or if either of these criteria would be met once you finish Casting the Spell
_desc_ko:
신성에 대한 이해를 넓혀 다른 신비의 경이로움을 활용할 수 있게 되었다. 자신의 신비가 아닌 다른 신비의 계시 주문 하나를 선택한다. 초급 계시 주문이나 고급 계시 주문 중 하나만 선택할 수 있다.

이 주문은 당신에게 저주결속 특성을 부여하며, 이를 시전할 때 기존 저주 효과에 더해 해당 신비의 @link[conditions.cursebound]{1} 효과를 얻습니다. 저주의 심각도를 증가시키지 않고 저주결속 능력을 사용할 수 있게 하는 능력은 이 추가 저주 효과 획득을 방지합니다.

다음 조건 중 하나라도 해당될 경우 선택한 계시 주문을 시전할 수 없습니다:

  • 해당 신비의 저주 효과가 자신의 신비 저주 효과와 직접 충돌하거나 상쇄하는 경우,

  • 저주가 당신에게 아무런 효과를 미치지 않을 경우 (예: 당신이 보유하지 않은 원래 신비의 능력을 제거하는 경우),

  • 또는 주문 시전을 완료한 후 이 조건 중 하나라도 충족될 경우

name: Wisdom from Another Life

description.value: You absorbed a wide variety of facts before you died, and your soul still remembers slivers of this precious knowledge. You gain the trained proficiency rank in one skill of your choice and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} skill feat as a bonus feat.

publication.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

_desc_en: You absorbed a wide variety of facts before you died, and your soul still remembers slivers of this precious knowledge. You gain the trained proficiency rank in one skill of your choice and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} skill feat as a bonus feat.
_desc_ko: 죽기 전 다양한 지식을 흡수했으며, 영혼은 여전히 이 소중한 지식의 조각들을 기억하고 있습니다. 선택한 한 가지 기술에 숙련 숙련도 등급을 획득하고 @link[feats.additional-lore] 기술 피트를 보너스 피트로 얻습니다.

name: Dazing Blow

description.value:
Requirements You have a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}.

You pummel a held foe, hoping to stagger them. Make a melee Strike against a creature you have grabbed. The weapon damage from this Strike is bludgeoning damage. If the Strike hits, the creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:fighter|traits:incapacitation] save against your class DC; this is an incapacitation effect.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3}.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}.

You pummel a held foe, hoping to stagger them. Make a melee Strike against a creature you have grabbed. The weapon damage from this Strike is bludgeoning damage. If the Strike hits, the creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:fighter|traits:incapacitation] save against your class DC; this is an incapacitation effect.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3}.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 생물 @link[conditions.grabbed].

당신은 붙잡은 적을 마구 때려 비틀거리게 하려 합니다. 붙잡은 생물에게 근접 공격을 시도하세요. 이 공격의 무기 피해는 타격 피해로 처리됩니다. 공격이 명중하면, 해당 생물은 당신의 클래스 DC(DC)에 대한 인내 내성을 시도해야 합니다. 이는 무력화 효과입니다.

대성공 생물은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 생물은 @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

실패 생물은 @link[conditions.stunned]{2} 상태가 됩니다.

대실패 생물은 @link[conditions.stunned]{3} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Graceful Guidance

description.value: You can demonstrate how to quickly twist out of the way of dangerous effects. You can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} reaction to grant a bonus to an ally's Reflex save. As usual for Aid, you need to prepare by using an action on your turn to encourage the ally.

_desc_en: You can demonstrate how to quickly twist out of the way of dangerous effects. You can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} reaction to grant a bonus to an ally's Reflex save. As usual for Aid, you need to prepare by using an action on your turn to encourage the ally.
_desc_ko: 위험한 효과에서 재빨리 몸을 비켜가는 방법을 보여줄 수 있습니다. @link[actions.aid] 반응을 사용해 아군의 반사 내성 저항에 보너스를 부여할 수 있습니다. 지원의 일반적인 규칙과 마찬가지로, 자신의 턴에 행동을 사용해 아군을 격려하는 준비가 필요합니다.

name: Mercenary Motivation

description.value:
A large part of being in the Mercenary League entails doing mercenary work. You spend 1 minute planning a course of action that will allow you to complete a task you've been hired or requested to do. Work with your GM to determine the circumstances of any job or task if need be, but typically, they can involve protecting a place or person, defeating a foe or enemy force, or retrieving an item. The course of action you plan must be something you believe you can accomplish.

Active Plan You can have only one course of action planned at a time. If you use Mercenary Motivation to plan a second course of action, you no longer receive the bonus to checks related to the first course of action.

On the Job Whenever you attempt a Perception check or skill check that will advance your course of action, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the check. The exact checks this bonus applies to depend on your current job and are determined by the GM.

Finishing a Plan When you complete the course of action you planned to do, you don't lose the bonus or other benefits until you make a different plan with Mercenary Motivation or voluntarily Dismiss the current plan.

_desc_en:
A large part of being in the Mercenary League entails doing mercenary work. You spend 1 minute planning a course of action that will allow you to complete a task you've been hired or requested to do. Work with your GM to determine the circumstances of any job or task if need be, but typically, they can involve protecting a place or person, defeating a foe or enemy force, or retrieving an item. The course of action you plan must be something you believe you can accomplish.

Active Plan You can have only one course of action planned at a time. If you use Mercenary Motivation to plan a second course of action, you no longer receive the bonus to checks related to the first course of action.

On the Job Whenever you attempt a Perception check or skill check that will advance your course of action, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the check. The exact checks this bonus applies to depend on your current job and are determined by the GM.

Finishing a Plan When you complete the course of action you planned to do, you don't lose the bonus or other benefits until you make a different plan with Mercenary Motivation or voluntarily Dismiss the current plan.
_desc_ko:
용병 연맹에 속한다는 것은 용병 일을 하는 것을 의미합니다. 고용되거나 요청받은 임무를 완수할 수 있는 행동 계획을 1분 동안 세웁니다. 필요 시 GM과 협의하여 임무나 작업의 상황을 결정하되, 일반적으로 장소나 인물 보호, 적군 격파, 물품 회수 등이 포함될 수 있다. 계획한 행동 방침은 자신이 달성할 수 있다고 믿는 것이어야 한다.

활성 계획 한 번에 하나의 행동 방침만 계획할 수 있습니다. 용병 동기 부여를 사용해 두 번째 행동 방침을 계획하면, 첫 번째 행동 방침과 관련된 판정 보너스를 더 이상 받지 못합니다.

직업 수행 중 행동 방침을 진전시키는 지각 판정나 기술 판정을 시도할 때마다 해당 판정에서 +1 상황 보너스를 받습니다. 이 보너스가 적용되는 정확한 판정은 현재 직업에 따라 다르며 GM이 결정합니다.

계획 완료 계획한 행동 과정을 완료하면 용병 동기 부여로 다른 계획을 세우거나 현재 계획을 자발적으로 해제할 때까지 보너스나 기타 혜택이 사라지지 않습니다.

name: Stay Down!

description.value:
Trigger A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} foe within your reach Stands.

You have ways of keeping your foes down. Attempt an @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the triggering foe's Fortitude DC. On a success, the action is disrupted, causing the creature to remain prone. On a critical success, the creature also can't Stand until its next turn.

_desc_en:
Trigger A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} foe within your reach Stands.

You have ways of keeping your foes down. Attempt an @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the triggering foe's Fortitude DC. On a success, the action is disrupted, causing the creature to remain prone. On a critical success, the creature also can't Stand until its next turn.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신의 도달 범위 내 @link[conditions.prone] 상태의 적이 일어서게 됩니다.

당신은 적을 제압하는 방법을 알고 있습니다. 발동한 적의 인내 DC에 대해 운동 판정을 시도하세요. 성공 시, 해당 행동이 방해받아 생물이 계속 넘어짐 상태로 남습니다. 대성공 시, 생물은 다음 차례까지 일어설 수 없습니다.

name: Sanguine Tenacity

description.value: Your blood carries permanent regenerative properties. The penalties from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled} and the penalties and lost HP from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} both affect you as if the condition values were 1 lower than they actually are. You also gain resistance 5 to persistent bleed damage and reduce the DC of checks to recover from persistent bleed damage to 11, or 6 if you have particularly effective assistance.

_desc_en: Your blood carries permanent regenerative properties. The penalties from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled} and the penalties and lost HP from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} both affect you as if the condition values were 1 lower than they actually are. You also gain resistance 5 to persistent bleed damage and reduce the DC of checks to recover from persistent bleed damage to 11, or 6 if you have particularly effective assistance.
_desc_ko: 당신의 혈액은 영구적인 재생 능력을 지닙니다. @link[conditions.enfeebled] 상태의 페널티와 @link[conditions.drained] 상태의 페널티 및 HP 손실은 실제 수치보다 1 낮게 적용됩니다. 또한 지속 출혈 피해에 대한 저항력 5를 얻으며, 지속 출혈 피해 회복을 위한 판정 DC를 11로 낮춥니다. 특히 효과적인 도움을 받는 경우 판정 DC는 6으로 낮아집니다.

name: Listener's Boon

description.value:
Isthralei has given you a gift to assist you on your journey. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.hT4INKGtly4QY8KN]{Domain Initiate} feat for the domain of fire, knowledge, protection, or travel. You can Refocus by spending 10 minutes telling stories of your travels or listening to others' stories of theirs. You gain the trained proficiency rank in spell attack modifier and spell DC, increasing to expert at 11th level.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, selecting a different domain each time and gaining its domain spell.

PFS Note: For the purposes of this feat, use charisma as your spellcasting attribute.

_desc_en:
Isthralei has given you a gift to assist you on your journey. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.hT4INKGtly4QY8KN]{Domain Initiate} feat for the domain of fire, knowledge, protection, or travel. You can Refocus by spending 10 minutes telling stories of your travels or listening to others' stories of theirs. You gain the trained proficiency rank in spell attack modifier and spell DC, increasing to expert at 11th level.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, selecting a different domain each time and gaining its domain spell.

PFS Note: For the purposes of this feat, use charisma as your spellcasting attribute.
_desc_ko:
이스라레이가 여정에 도움이 될 선물을 주었다. 불, 지식, 보호, 여행 도메인 중 하나의 @link[feats.domain-initiate] 피트를 얻는다. 는 10분 동안 자신의 여행 이야기를 들려주거나 타인의 이야기를 듣는 것으로 재집중할 수 있습니다. 주문 공격 수정자(수정치)와 주문 DC에 숙련 숙련도 등급을 얻으며, 11레벨에 도달하면 전문가 등급으로 상승합니다.

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있으며, 매번 다른 도메인을 선택하여 해당 도메인의 도메인 주문을 획득합니다.

PFS 참고: 이 피트 적용 시, 주문 시전 능력치로 매력를 사용합니다.

name: Dual Studies

description.value:
You and your eidolon have some skills you practice on your own.

Choose two skills. Your eidolon becomes trained in one of those skills and you become trained in the other skill.

At 7th level, you each become an expert in the chosen skills. These skill proficiencies are not shared between you and your eidolon.

_desc_en:
You and your eidolon have some skills you practice on your own.

Choose two skills. Your eidolon becomes trained in one of those skills and you become trained in the other skill.

At 7th level, you each become an expert in the chosen skills. These skill proficiencies are not shared between you and your eidolon.
_desc_ko:
당신과 당신의 에이돌론은 각자 따로 연마하는 기술들을 가지고 있습니다.

두 가지 기술을 선택하십시오. 당신의 에이돌론은 그 중 하나의 기술에 숙련되고, 당신은 다른 기술에 숙련됩니다.

7레벨에 도달하면, 당신과 당신의 에이돌론은 각각 선택한 기술의 전문가가 됩니다. 이 기술 숙련도는 당신과 에이돌론 사이에 공유되지 않습니다.

name: Opportune Throw

description.value:
Requirements You are Juggling a thrown weapon.

Trigger A creature within 10 feet of you uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

You make a thrown ranged Strike with the required weapon against the triggering creature. If you critically succeed and the trigger was a manipulate action, you disrupt that action. This Strike doesn't count against your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

publication.title: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On

_desc_en:
Requirements You are Juggling a thrown weapon.

Trigger A creature within 10 feet of you uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

You make a thrown ranged Strike with the required weapon against the triggering creature. If you critically succeed and the trigger was a manipulate action, you disrupt that action. This Strike doesn't count against your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.
_desc_ko:
요건 던진 무기를 저글링 중이어야 한다.

발동 조건 당신으로부터 10피트 이내의 생물이 조작 행동이나 이동 행동을 사용하거나, 원거리 공격을 하거나, 사용 중인 이동 행동 중에 한 칸을 떠날 때.

당신은 필요한 무기로 유발 생물을 향해 투척 원거리 타격을 가합니다. 대성공 시 유발 행동이 조작 행동이었다면 해당 행동을 방해합니다. 이 타격은 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되지 않으며, 다중 공격 페널티도 이 타격에 적용되지 않습니다.

name: Forest's Heart

description.value:
Requirements Your attuned apparition grants Forest Lore or Herbalism Lore as one of its apparition skills.

You adopt a stance that allows your apparitions to channel spiritual energy down through you to inhabit roots, control vines, and command plant-life from the ground you stand on to fight on your behalf. You call forth roots, vines, or other plant growth native to the region and can use them to make unarmed attacks. These deal @Damage[4d8[bludgeoning]] damage, are in the brawling group, and have the finesse, grapple, and reach 30 feet traits. Attacks made with these unarmed attacks don't gain additional damage from striking runes, but can benefit from the item bonus to attack rolls and property runes of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.FNDq4NFSN0g2HKWO]{Handwraps of Mighty Blows} you wear.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your attuned apparition grants Forest Lore or Herbalism Lore as one of its apparition skills.

You adopt a stance that allows your apparitions to channel spiritual energy down through you to inhabit roots, control vines, and command plant-life from the ground you stand on to fight on your behalf. You call forth roots, vines, or other plant growth native to the region and can use them to make unarmed attacks. These deal @Damage[4d8[bludgeoning]] damage, are in the brawling group, and have the finesse, grapple, and reach 30 feet traits. Attacks made with these unarmed attacks don't gain additional damage from striking runes, but can benefit from the item bonus to attack rolls and property runes of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.FNDq4NFSN0g2HKWO]{Handwraps of Mighty Blows} you wear.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신의 조율된 유령은 숲의 지식 또는 약초학 지식를 유령 기술 중 하나로 부여합니다.

당신은 유령들이 당신을 통해 영적 에너지를 내려보내 뿌리에 깃들게 하고, 덩굴을 조종하며, 당신이 서 있는 땅의 식물들을 지휘하여 당신을 위해 싸우게 하는 자세를 취합니다. 해당 지역에 자생하는 뿌리, 덩굴 또는 기타 식물성 생장을 불러내어 비무장 공격을 할 수 있습니다. 이 공격은 4d8 타격의 피해를 입히며, 난투 공격 그룹에 속하고, 기교, 그랩, 30피트 도달 범위를 지닙니다. 이 비무장 공격으로 수행된 공격은 강타 룬으로부터 추가 피해를 얻지 않지만, 착용한 @link[equipment.handwraps-of-mighty-blows]의 명중 굴림에 대한 아이템 보너스와 속성 룬의 혜택을 받을 수 있습니다.

name: Pounce Mimicry

description.value:
Requirements You're unarmored or wearing light armor.

You have mastered the art of stalking your prey and striking when they are most vulnerable. You Stride and then Strike. If you began this action @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, you remain hidden until after the Strike. You can use Pounce Mimicry while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

value.value: you have seen a creature use an ability that lets them Stride and Strike as a single action (such as Pounce) or have identified a creature with such an ability in combat

_desc_en:
Requirements You're unarmored or wearing light armor.

You have mastered the art of stalking your prey and striking when they are most vulnerable. You Stride and then Strike. If you began this action @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, you remain hidden until after the Strike. You can use Pounce Mimicry while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 갑옷을 입지 않았거나 경갑을 착용 중이어야 합니다.

당신은 먹잇감을 추적하고 그들의 가장 약한 순간에 강타하는 기술을 마스터했습니다. 당신은 이동한 후 공격합니다. 이 행동을 @link[conditions.hidden]에서 시작했다면, 공격이 끝날 때까지 숨기 상태를 유지합니다. 해당 이동 유형을 가진 경우, 이동 대신 땅파기, 등반, 비행 또는 수영 중에도 포운스 모방을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Vivacious Bravado

description.value:
Requirements You gained @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.LzYi0OuOoypNb6jd]{Panache} this turn.

Your ego swells, granting you a temporary reprieve from your pain. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level plus your Charisma modifier that last until the start of your next turn.

_desc_en:
Requirements You gained @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.LzYi0OuOoypNb6jd]{Panache} this turn.

Your ego swells, granting you a temporary reprieve from your pain. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level plus your Charisma modifier that last until the start of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 이번 턴에 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.uBJsxCzNhje8m8jj]{파나슈}를 획득했습니다.

자아에 부풀어 오르며 고통에서 일시적으로 벗어납니다. 다음 턴 시작까지 지속되는 레벨 + 매력 수정자만큼의 임시 HP를 얻습니다.

name: Sneak Adept

description.value: It's almost impossible to spot you. When you roll a failure on a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} action, you get a success instead. You can still critically fail.

_desc_en: It's almost impossible to spot you. When you roll a failure on a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} action, you get a success instead. You can still critically fail.
_desc_ko: 당신을 발견하는 것은 거의 불가능하다. @link[actions.sneak] 행동에 실패를 굴렸을 때, 대신 성공을 얻는다. 여전히 대실패는 발생할 수 있다.

name: Knockback Strike

description.value: You focus your strength into a blow powerful enough to push an enemy away from you. Make an unarmed Strike. If you hit, attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} the target. This attack uses the same multiple attack penalty as your Strike, and doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty.

_desc_en: You focus your strength into a blow powerful enough to push an enemy away from you. Make an unarmed Strike. If you hit, attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} the target. This attack uses the same multiple attack penalty as your Strike, and doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty.
_desc_ko: 당신은 힘을 포커스해 적을 밀쳐낼 만큼 강력한 일격을 가한다. 비무장 공격을 시도합니다. 명중 시, 대상에게 @link[actions.shove]를 시도하기 위해 운동 판정을 시도합니다. 이 공격은 공격 시 적용되는 다중 공격 페널티와 동일하게 적용되며, 다중 공격 페널티 계산에는 포함되지 않습니다.

name: Invoke Disaster

description.value: You can invoke nature's fury upon your foes. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XYhU3Wi94n1RKxTa]{Storm Lord} order spell.

_desc_en: You can invoke nature's fury upon your foes. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XYhU3Wi94n1RKxTa]{Storm Lord} order spell.
_desc_ko: 적에게 자연의 분노를 불러일으킬 수 있다. @link[spells.storm-lord] 계급 주문을 획득한다.

name: Spirit Soother

description.value: You are attuned to the minute sounds and sensations of restless spirits. Even if you aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Searching}, you can attempt a check to find haunts that normally require you to be Searching. You still need to meet any other requirements to find the haunt. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to disable haunts.

_desc_en: You are attuned to the minute sounds and sensations of restless spirits. Even if you aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Searching}, you can attempt a check to find haunts that normally require you to be Searching. You still need to meet any other requirements to find the haunt. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to disable haunts.
_desc_ko: 당신은 불안한 영혼들의 미세한 소리와 감각에 민감하게 반응합니다. @link[actions.search] 상태가 아니더라도, 일반적으로 탐색이 필요한 유령의 흔적을 찾는 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다. 유령을 찾기 위한 다른 조건은 여전히 충족해야 합니다. 유령을 무력화하는 판정에는 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Infiltrator's Reload

description.value: You specialize in reloading while preparing for the next step in your infiltration. Interact to reload a weapon you have familiarity with from this archetype, then either Hide, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover}.

_desc_en: You specialize in reloading while preparing for the next step in your infiltration. Interact to reload a weapon you have familiarity with from this archetype, then either Hide, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover}.
_desc_ko: 당신은 잠입의 다음 단계를 준비하며 재장전하는 데 특화되어 있습니다. 상호작용하여 이 아키타입에서 익숙한 무기를 재장전한 후, {숨기}, @link[actions.sneak], 또는 @link[actions.take-cover] 중 하나를 수행합니다.

name: Animal Strength

description.value: You tap into the primal strength of your animal feature. When you gain a claw or jaws attack from animal feature, you can choose a weapon you're carrying and apply all runes from that weapon (if they're applicable) to that unarmed attack. This replaces any runes the unarmed attacks would normally have from other sources, like handwraps of mighty blows. In addition, when you critically hit with a claw or jaws attack from animal feature, you deal @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] damage.

_desc_en: You tap into the primal strength of your animal feature. When you gain a claw or jaws attack from animal feature, you can choose a weapon you're carrying and apply all runes from that weapon (if they're applicable) to that unarmed attack. This replaces any runes the unarmed attacks would normally have from other sources, like handwraps of mighty blows. In addition, when you critically hit with a claw or jaws attack from animal feature, you deal @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] damage.
_desc_ko: 당신은 동물 특성의 프라이멀한 힘을 끌어낸다. 동물 특성으로 발톱이나 이빨 공격을 얻었을 때, 휴대 중인 무기 하나를 선택하여 해당 무기의 모든 룬(적용 가능한 경우)을 그 비무장 공격에 적용할 수 있다. 이는 비무장 공격이 일반적으로 다른 출처(예: 강력한 주먹의 핸드랩)로부터 얻는 룬을 대체한다. 또한 동물적 특성으로부터의 발톱이나 이빨 공격으로 치명타를 성공시킬 경우, 1d6 지속 출혈의 피해를 입힌다.

name: Unravel Mysteries

description.value: You can understand the true meaning of texts quickly, and even when you get lost or hit a dead end, you aren't discouraged from making further attempts to get to the bottom of things. When you Decipher Writing, you need only half as long as usual (reducing the time from about 1 minute to about half a minute per page), and if you fail, you don't take the usual -2 circumstance penalty to further checks to decipher that text.

value.value: master in a Decipher Writing skill

_desc_en: You can understand the true meaning of texts quickly, and even when you get lost or hit a dead end, you aren't discouraged from making further attempts to get to the bottom of things. When you Decipher Writing, you need only half as long as usual (reducing the time from about 1 minute to about half a minute per page), and if you fail, you don't take the usual -2 circumstance penalty to further checks to decipher that text.
_desc_ko: 본문의 진정한 의미를 빠르게 이해할 수 있으며, 길을 잃거나 막다른 골목에 부딪혀도 사물을 깊이 파고들려는 시도를 포기하지 않습니다. 문자 해독 시 평소보다 절반의 시간만 소요됩니다( 페이지당 약 1분에서 약 30초로 단축). 실패하더라도 해당 텍스트 해독에 대한 추가 판정 시 평소처럼 -2 상황 페널티를 받지 않습니다.

name: Draconic Scent

description.value: Your sense of smell has heightened to be as keen as that of a dragon. You gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet. At their discretion, the GM might double this range if you're downwind from the creature or halve this range if you're upwind.

_desc_en: Your sense of smell has heightened to be as keen as that of a dragon. You gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet. At their discretion, the GM might double this range if you're downwind from the creature or halve this range if you're upwind.
_desc_ko: 당신의 후각이 용만큼 예민해졌습니다. 30피트 범위의 부정확한 후각 능력을 얻습니다. GM의 재량에 따라, 당신이 생물체의 바람 아래쪽에 있을 경우 이 범위를 두 배로 늘리거나 바람 위쪽에 있을 경우 반으로 줄일 수 있습니다.

name: Precious Alloys

description.value:
Choose cold iron or silver. Your melee unarmed attacks have the special properties of a weapon made of that metal. If you are at least 13th level, you can choose adamantine instead of just cold iron or silver.

Special You can take this ancestry feat multiple times, choosing a different metal each time.

_desc_en:
Choose cold iron or silver. Your melee unarmed attacks have the special properties of a weapon made of that metal. If you are at least 13th level, you can choose adamantine instead of just cold iron or silver.

Special You can take this ancestry feat multiple times, choosing a different metal each time.
_desc_ko:
냉철 또는 은 중 하나를 선택한다. 근접 비무장 공격 시 해당 금속으로 제작된 무기의 특수 속성을 갖는다. 13레벨 이상일 경우 냉철 또는 은 대신 아다만틴을 선택할 수 있다.

특수 이 혈통 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있으며, 매번 다른 금속을 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Expert Spellcasting

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{Expert Spellcasting Feat} archetype benefits.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{Expert Spellcasting Feat} archetype benefits.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{전문 주문 시전 피트} 아키타입 혜택을 얻습니다.

name: Improved Familiar (Witch)

description.value: You find it easy to attract a powerful and unusual familiar to your side. The number of abilities required to make your familiar a specific familiar is two lower than normal.

_desc_en: You find it easy to attract a powerful and unusual familiar to your side. The number of abilities required to make your familiar a specific familiar is two lower than normal.
_desc_ko: 당신은 강력하고 특이한 패밀리어를 자신의 편으로 끌어들이는 데 능숙합니다. 특정 패밀리어를 자신의 패밀리어라 만들기 위해 필요한 능력 점수는 일반적인 경우보다 두 점 낮습니다.

name: Reset the Past

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You manipulate time to recharge one of your temporal techniques—by revising your past so you never used it in the first place. Select one of your chronoskimmer feats that has a frequency of once per day (or more frequent) that you've already used. You can use the feat again, as if you hadn't used it already.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You manipulate time to recharge one of your temporal techniques—by revising your past so you never used it in the first place. Select one of your chronoskimmer feats that has a frequency of once per day (or more frequent) that you've already used. You can use the feat again, as if you hadn't used it already.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

시간을 조작하여 자신의 시간 기술 중 하나를 재충전한다-과거를 수정하여 애초에 그 기술을 사용하지 않았던 것처럼 만드는 것이다. 이미 사용한 일일 1회(또는 그 이상) 사용 빈도를 가진 크로노스키머 피트 중 하나를 선택한다. 마치 아직 사용하지 않은 것처럼 그 피트를 다시 사용할 수 있다.

name: Start the Festival!

description.value: No distance can stop tanuki from making their way to a good party. You whistle and point, and 808 tanuki, in their raccoon dog forms, somehow appear from the surrounding terrain and fill a @Template[type:burst|distance:30] within 120 feet. The tanuki scurry over the ground, leap through the air, and climb up walls and surfaces, dealing @Damage[6d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage to all enemies in the area as they're trampled and danced upon. The tanuki continue to party in the area for the next minute, dealing @Damage[3d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage to any enemy that ends its turn in the area and transforming the area into difficult terrain (though the tanuki allow you and your allies to pass normally). Creatures in raccoon dog form can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} within the mass of tanuki. After 1 minute, the tanuki clap 30 times and run off to the next party. You can Dismiss the effect, though if you do, the tanuki grumble as the party ends early.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: No distance can stop tanuki from making their way to a good party. You whistle and point, and 808 tanuki, in their raccoon dog forms, somehow appear from the surrounding terrain and fill a @Template[type:burst|distance:30] within 120 feet. The tanuki scurry over the ground, leap through the air, and climb up walls and surfaces, dealing @Damage[6d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage to all enemies in the area as they're trampled and danced upon. The tanuki continue to party in the area for the next minute, dealing @Damage[3d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage to any enemy that ends its turn in the area and transforming the area into difficult terrain (though the tanuki allow you and your allies to pass normally). Creatures in raccoon dog form can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} within the mass of tanuki. After 1 minute, the tanuki clap 30 times and run off to the next party. You can Dismiss the effect, though if you do, the tanuki grumble as the party ends early.
_desc_ko: 어떤 거리도 타누키가 즐거운 파티에 가는 걸 막을 수 없다. 당신이 휘파람을 불고 손가락으로 가리키자, 808마리의 타누키가 너구리 형태로 주변 지형에서 나타나 120피트 이내의 30피트 폭발를 채운다. 타누키들은 땅 위를 뛰어다니고, 공중을 날아오르며, 벽과 표면을 기어오르며, 밟히고 밟히는 모든 적에게 6d8 타격의 피해를 입힌다. 타누키들은 이후 1분 동안 해당 지역에서 계속 춤을 추며, 턴을 끝내는 모든 적에게 3d8 타격의 피해를 입히고 해당 지역을 어려운 지형으로 변환합니다(단, 타누키들은 당신과 아군에게는 정상적인 통과를 허용합니다). 너구리 형태의 생물은 타누키 무리 속에서 @link[actions.hide]를 시도할 수 있습니다. 1분 후, 타누키들은 30번 박수를 치고 다음 파티 장소로 달려갑니다. 효과를 해제할 수 있지만, 그렇게 하면 파티가 일찍 끝나 너구리들이 불평합니다.

name: March the Mines

description.value: You march through the earth and lead an ally along. You gain a burrow Speed of 15 feet when you use this activity (if you don't have a higher one), and then you either Stride twice or Burrow twice. You can choose one willing ally adjacent to you at the start of your movement to move with you. That ally ends its movement one square behind you.

_desc_en: You march through the earth and lead an ally along. You gain a burrow Speed of 15 feet when you use this activity (if you don't have a higher one), and then you either Stride twice or Burrow twice. You can choose one willing ally adjacent to you at the start of your movement to move with you. That ally ends its movement one square behind you.
_desc_ko: 당신은 땅속을 행진하며 아군 한 명을 이끌고 이동합니다. 이 활동을 사용할 때 (더 높은 속도가 없다면) 15피트의 굴착 이동 속도를 얻으며, 이후 두 번의 대보행 또는 두 번의 굴착을 수행한다. 이동 시작 시 인접한 의지하는 아군 한 명을 선택해 함께 이동할 수 있다. 해당 아군은 너보다 한 칸 뒤에서 이동을 종료한다.

name: Radiant Circuitry

description.value: Your biological circuitry emits light like a torch, casting bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet). The light shuts off when you take this action again or are knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.

_desc_en: Your biological circuitry emits light like a torch, casting bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet). The light shuts off when you take this action again or are knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.
_desc_ko: 생물학적 회로가 횃불처럼 빛을 발산하여 반경 20피트 내에 밝은 빛을, 그 다음 20피트 내에 희미한 빛을 비춘다. 이 행동을 다시 취하거나 @link[conditions.unconscious] 상태가 되면 빛이 꺼진다.

name: Warden's Focus

description.value: Your connection with your surroundings deepens and expands, allowing you to draw in more of nature's primal power as you focus. When you Refocus, you regain all your Focus Points instead of 1.

_desc_en: Your connection with your surroundings deepens and expands, allowing you to draw in more of nature's primal power as you focus. When you Refocus, you regain all your Focus Points instead of 1.
_desc_ko: 주변 환경과의 연결이 깊어지고 확장되어 집중할수록 자연의 프라이멀한 힘을 더 많이 끌어모을 수 있습니다. 재집중 시, 포커스 포인트 1점이 아닌 모든 포커스 포인트를 회복합니다.

name: Undead Empathy

description.value: Your relationship with undeath gives you a stronger bond with other undead. You can use Diplomacy to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on mindless undead or make simple requests of them. As long as there aren't living creatures nearby, they usually let you speak. If the undead creature currently is in the thrall of a creature whose level is higher than yours, you typically need a critical success on your Diplomacy skill check.

_desc_en: Your relationship with undeath gives you a stronger bond with other undead. You can use Diplomacy to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on mindless undead or make simple requests of them. As long as there aren't living creatures nearby, they usually let you speak. If the undead creature currently is in the thrall of a creature whose level is higher than yours, you typically need a critical success on your Diplomacy skill check.
_desc_ko: 불사의 존재와의 관계로 인해 다른 언데드와의 유대가 더욱 강해집니다. 외교 기술로 무의식적인 언데드에게 @link[actions.make-an-impression] 간단한 요청을 할 수 있습니다. 주변에 살아있는 생물이 없는 한, 그들은 대개 당신의 말을 들어줍니다. 해당 언데드 생물이 현재 당신보다 레벨이 높은 생물의 지배를 받고 있다면, 일반적으로 외교 기술 판정에서 대성공이 필요합니다.

name: Unfetter Eidolon

description.value:
You can allow your eidolon to travel far from your side.

You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.hW9pgce6vTme61g1]{Unfetter Eidolon} link spell. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.

_desc_en:
You can allow your eidolon to travel far from your side.

You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.hW9pgce6vTme61g1]{Unfetter Eidolon} link spell. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.
_desc_ko:
당신은 자신의 에이돌론이 멀리 떨어져 이동하도록 허용할 수 있습니다.

@link[spells.unfetter-eidolon] 링크 주문을 배운다. 포커스 풀의 포커스 포인트 수를 1 증가시킨다.

name: Extra Squishy

description.value:
Your rubbery physique makes it easier for you to wedge yourself into tight spaces and more difficult for your enemies to dislodge you.

You become trained in Acrobatics. If you would automatically become trained in Acrobatics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

If you roll a success to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeeze}, you get a critical success instead. While you're Squeezing, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DCs against attempts to Shove you or otherwise move you from your space.

_desc_en:
Your rubbery physique makes it easier for you to wedge yourself into tight spaces and more difficult for your enemies to dislodge you.

You become trained in Acrobatics. If you would automatically become trained in Acrobatics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

If you roll a success to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeeze}, you get a critical success instead. While you're Squeezing, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DCs against attempts to Shove you or otherwise move you from your space.
_desc_ko:
고무 같은 체격 덕분에 좁은 공간에 몸을 끼우기 쉬워지고, 적들이 당신을 밀어내기 어려워집니다.

당신은 곡예에 숙련됩니다. 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 자동으로 곡예에 숙련될 경우, 대신 선택한 기술에 숙련됩니다.

@link[actions.squeeze]에 굴림 성공할 경우, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다. 비집고 들어간 상태에서는, 당신을 밀치거나 공간에서 이동시키려는 시도에 대한 인내 또는 반사 DC에 +4 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Weight of Guilt

description.value: Guilt clouds the minds of those who ignore your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tuZnRWHixLArvaIf]{Glimpse of Redemption}. Instead of making the triggering creature enfeebled 2, you can make it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for the same duration.

_desc_en: Guilt clouds the minds of those who ignore your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tuZnRWHixLArvaIf]{Glimpse of Redemption}. Instead of making the triggering creature enfeebled 2, you can make it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for the same duration.
_desc_ko: 죄책감은 당신의 @link[actions.glimpse-of-redemption]을 무시하는 자들의 정신을 흐리게 합니다. 발동 대상 생물을 @link[actions.glimpse-of-redemption]{2} 상태로 만드는 대신, 동일한 지속 시간 동안 @link[conditions.stupefied]{2} 상태로 만들 수 있습니다.

name: Petal Step

description.value: You have a mastery over your own movement and can distribute your weight to dance lightly over the ground like petals drifting on the water. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Stealth checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} and aren't detectable by tremorsense.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You have a mastery over your own movement and can distribute your weight to dance lightly over the ground like petals drifting on the water. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Stealth checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} and aren't detectable by tremorsense.
_desc_ko: 자신의 움직임을 완벽히 통제하여 무게 중심을 조절함으로써 물 위에 떠다니는 꽃잎처럼 땅 위를 가볍게 춤추듯 이동할 수 있습니다. 은신 판정(@link[actions.sneak])에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 진동 감지 능력으로 탐지될 수 없습니다.

name: Manifold Conduit

description.value: You can manifest multiple spirits at once in a cyclone around you. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Vg4K3dTDswNQf4Bx]{Entreat the Many} focus spell.

_desc_en: You can manifest multiple spirits at once in a cyclone around you. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Vg4K3dTDswNQf4Bx]{Entreat the Many} focus spell.
_desc_ko: 당신은 주변에 회오리바람을 일으켜 한 번에 여러 영혼을 창조할 수 있습니다. @link[spells.entreat-the-many] 포커스 주문을 획득합니다.

name: Halfling Weapon Familiarity

description.value:
You favor traditional halfling weapons, so you've learned how to use them more effectively. You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the halfling trait. You have familiarity with weapons with the halfling trait plus the sling and shortsword—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

_desc_en:
You favor traditional halfling weapons, so you've learned how to use them more effectively. You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the halfling trait. You have familiarity with weapons with the halfling trait plus the sling and shortsword—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
_desc_ko:
전통적인 하플링 무기를 선호하여 더 효과적으로 다루는 법을 익혔습니다. 하플링 특성이 부여된 모든 흔하지 않은 무기를 다룰 수 있게 됩니다. 하플링 특성이 부여된 무기 외에도 슬링과 숏소드에 숙련되어 있습니다. 숙련도 목적상, 이 중 무술 무기인 것은 단순 무기로, 고급 무기인 것은 무술 무기로 취급합니다.

5레벨에 도달하면, 이 무기들로 치명타를 기록할 때마다 해당 무기의 치명타 특화 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Fling Into Action

description.value: You release mythic power to turn disaster into opportunity and hurl yourself into an advantageous position. When you attempt a Reflex save, you can spend a Mythic Point to attempt the save at mythic proficiency. If the check is successful, you immediately fling yourself up to 30 feet in a direction of your choice, or up to 60 feet on a critical success. When flinging yourself in this manner, you can move the entire distance in a straight horizontal or vertical line, or you can move 5 feet horizontally for every 10 feet you move vertically. For example, if you got a critical success using Fling Into Action while Grabbing an Edge as you fall from the middle of a cliff, you could hurl yourself 40 feet up the cliffside and 20 feet forward onto a plateau at the top of the cliff.

_desc_en: You release mythic power to turn disaster into opportunity and hurl yourself into an advantageous position. When you attempt a Reflex save, you can spend a Mythic Point to attempt the save at mythic proficiency. If the check is successful, you immediately fling yourself up to 30 feet in a direction of your choice, or up to 60 feet on a critical success. When flinging yourself in this manner, you can move the entire distance in a straight horizontal or vertical line, or you can move 5 feet horizontally for every 10 feet you move vertically. For example, if you got a critical success using Fling Into Action while Grabbing an Edge as you fall from the middle of a cliff, you could hurl yourself 40 feet up the cliffside and 20 feet forward onto a plateau at the top of the cliff.
_desc_ko: 신화적 힘을 발산하여 재앙을 기회로 전환하고 유리한 위치로 몸을 날린다. 반사 내성을 시도할 때 신화 포인트를 소모하면 신화 숙련도로 내성을 시도할 수 있다. 판정이 성공하면 즉시 선택한 방향으로 최대 30피트(9m)까지, 대성공 시 최대 60피트(18m)까지 날아간다. 이 방식으로 날아갈 때, 수평 또는 수직 직선으로 전체 거리를 이동하거나, 수직으로 10피트(3m) 이동할 때마다 수평으로 5피트(1.5m) 이동할 수 있다. 예를 들어, 절벽 중간에서 추락하는 동안 '가장자리 붙잡기'를 사용하며 '행동으로 날아가기'를 대성공했을 경우, 절벽을 따라 40피트 위로 날아가 절벽 정상 고원에 20피트 앞으로 착지할 수 있습니다.

name: Premonition of Clarity

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You fail a saving throw against a mental effect.

Your deity sends you a vision of faith to steel you against mental attacks. Reroll the triggering saving throw with a +2 circumstance bonus. You must use the second result, even if it's worse.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You fail a saving throw against a mental effect.

Your deity sends you a vision of faith to steel you against mental attacks. Reroll the triggering saving throw with a +2 circumstance bonus. You must use the second result, even if it's worse.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

발동 조건 정신 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 실패할 때.

당신의 신이 정신 공격에 맞서도록 믿음의 환상을 보냅니다. 발동된 내성 굴림을 +2 상황 보너스와 함께 재굴림하십시오. 결과가 더 나쁘더라도 두 번째 결과를 반드시 사용해야 합니다.

name: Sequestered Spell

description.value: You consumed so much of a type of magic as a larva that you can now cast it purely on instinct. Choose one cantrip from the spell list of your magiphage ability. You can cast this cantrip as an innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

_desc_en: You consumed so much of a type of magic as a larva that you can now cast it purely on instinct. Choose one cantrip from the spell list of your magiphage ability. You can cast this cantrip as an innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 유충 시절 특정 마법을 과도하게 흡수하여 이제는 본능적으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 마기페이지 능력의 주문 목록에서 캔트립 하나를 선택하세요. 이 캔트립을 선천적 주문으로 자유롭게 시전할 수 있습니다. 해당 캔트립은 레벨의 절반(올림)에 해당하는 주문 랭크으로 강화됩니다.

name: Toppling Transformation

description.value:
Trigger Your size increases due to a polymorph effect.

You use your body's expansion as leverage to displace a nearby creature. You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} an adjacent creature. For the purposes of determining what size creature you can affect, use your final size after the triggering effect.

_desc_en:
Trigger Your size increases due to a polymorph effect.

You use your body's expansion as leverage to displace a nearby creature. You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} an adjacent creature. For the purposes of determining what size creature you can affect, use your final size after the triggering effect.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 변형 효과로 인해 당신의 크기가 증가합니다.

당신은 몸의 팽창을 지렛대로 삼아 근처 생물을 밀어냅니다. 인접한 생물을 @link[actions.shove]하거나 @link[actions.trip]하려 시도합니다. 영향을 줄 수 있는 생물의 크기를 결정할 때는 발동 효과 이후의 최종 크기를 기준으로 합니다.

name: Cautious Word

description.value:
Trigger An enemy hits you with a Strike.

Requirements You're currently unable to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TVKNbcgTee19PXZR]{Shield} because you used @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} with it.

You let your words defend you, just as your allies in the Vellumis Scholars defend through knowledge. You immediately cast shield and gain its bonus to AC even though you normally couldn't cast it, and you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

_desc_en:
Trigger An enemy hits you with a Strike.

Requirements You're currently unable to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TVKNbcgTee19PXZR]{Shield} because you used @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} with it.

You let your words defend you, just as your allies in the Vellumis Scholars defend through knowledge. You immediately cast shield and gain its bonus to AC even though you normally couldn't cast it, and you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 적이 공격으로 당신을 명중시킬 때.

Requirements 현재 @link[spells.shield]를 시전할 수 없습니다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{방패 막기}를 사용했기 때문입니다.

당신은 말로 자신을 방어합니다. 벨루미스 학파의 동료들이 지식으로 방어하듯 말이죠. 당신은 즉시 방패를 시전하여 평소에는 시전할 수 없었음에도 AC 보너스를 얻으며, 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.slowed]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Weight of Stone

description.value:
A packed cloud of thundering boulders descends from the sky, beating down everyone in its path. The rain of stone falls in a @Template[cylinder|distance:10]{cylinder 20 feet in diameter} and 80 feet high, and the bottom must be within 120 feet of you. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -6)/2)+4)d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage and might be pushed downward, depending on its @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] save against your class DC.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is pushed downward 40 feet without taking falling damage. If it reaches the bottom of the cylinder or the ground, the push ends. If the creature is pushed to the ground, it can't Fly, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.fI20AVwOzJMHXRdo]{Levitate}, or otherwise leave the ground for 1 round.

Critical Failure As failure, but double damage and the distance the creature is pushed is 80 feet.

Level (+2) The damage increases by 1d8.

_desc_en:
A packed cloud of thundering boulders descends from the sky, beating down everyone in its path. The rain of stone falls in a @Template[cylinder|distance:10]{cylinder 20 feet in diameter} and 80 feet high, and the bottom must be within 120 feet of you. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -6)/2)+4)d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage and might be pushed downward, depending on its @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] save against your class DC.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is pushed downward 40 feet without taking falling damage. If it reaches the bottom of the cylinder or the ground, the push ends. If the creature is pushed to the ground, it can't Fly, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.fI20AVwOzJMHXRdo]{Levitate}, or otherwise leave the ground for 1 round.

Critical Failure As failure, but double damage and the distance the creature is pushed is 80 feet.

Level (+2) The damage increases by 1d8.
_desc_ko:
우르릉거리는 바위 덩어리들이 빽빽이 모여 하늘에서 내려와, 그 경로에 있는 모든 이를 내리친다. 돌비오는 10피트 영역에 높이 80피트까지 떨어지며, 바닥은 당신으로부터 120피트 이내에 위치해야 한다. 해당 영역 내 모든 생물은 타격의 피해를 입으며, 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 반사 내성에 따라 아래로 밀려날 수 있다.

대성공 생물은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 생물은 절반의 피해를 입습니다.

실패 생물은 전체 피해를 입으며 낙하 피해를 입지 않고 40피트 아래로 밀려난다. 실린더 바닥이나 지면에 닿으면 밀림이 종료된다. 생물이 지면으로 밀려난 경우, 1라운드 동안 비행, @link[spells.levitate], 또는 기타 방법으로 지면을 떠날 수 없습니다.

대실패 실패와 동일하나, 피해는 두 배이며 밀려나는 거리는 80피트이다.

레벨 (+2) 피해량이 1d8 증가한다.

name: Dalang's Ally

description.value: You move your shadow as a master puppeteer, allowing it to dance around your enemies and serve you in combat. Until the start of your next turn, your shadow darts around with your foes, providing flanking for you against all enemies within your reach. Flanking with your shadow is the same as flanking with an ally and so is subject to effects like all-around vision or the deny advantage class feature.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You move your shadow as a master puppeteer, allowing it to dance around your enemies and serve you in combat. Until the start of your next turn, your shadow darts around with your foes, providing flanking for you against all enemies within your reach. Flanking with your shadow is the same as flanking with an ally and so is subject to effects like all-around vision or the deny advantage class feature.
_desc_ko: 당신은 마스터 인형사처럼 자신의 그림자를 움직여 적 주위를 춤추게 하며 전투에서 당신을 돕게 합니다. 다음 차례 시작 전까지 당신의 그림자는 적들 사이를 날아다니며, 당신의 손이 닿는 범위 내 모든 적에게 당신을 위한 측면 공격을 제공합니다. 그림자로 측면 공격을 하는 것은 아군과 함께 측면 공격을 하는 것과 동일하므로, 전방위 시야나 '이점 거부' 클래스 특성과 같은 효과의 적용을 받습니다.

name: Reanimating Spark

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You have the dying condition and are about to attempt a recovery check.

The magic that animates you strains to keep you alive. You're restored to 1 Hit Point, lose the dying and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} conditions, and can act normally on this turn. You gain or increase the wounded condition as normal when losing the dying condition in this way.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You have the dying condition and are about to attempt a recovery check.

The magic that animates you strains to keep you alive. You're restored to 1 Hit Point, lose the dying and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} conditions, and can act normally on this turn. You gain or increase the wounded condition as normal when losing the dying condition in this way.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 죽어가는 상태에 걸렸으며 회복 판정을 시도하다.

당신을 움직이는 마법이 간신히 생명을 유지하려 애씁니다. HP가 1로 회복되고, 죽음 직전 상태와 @link[conditions.unconscious] 상태가 해제되며, 이번 턴에 정상적으로 행동할 수 있습니다. 이 방식으로 죽음 직전 상태가 해제될 때, 일반적으로 부상 상태를 획득하거나 증가시킵니다.

name: Bark and Tendril

description.value: You wield primal magic. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.J6vNvrUT3b1hx2iA]{Entangling Flora} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YWrfKetOqDwVFut7]{Oaken Resilience} as 2nd-rank primal innate spells once per day each.

_desc_en: You wield primal magic. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.J6vNvrUT3b1hx2iA]{Entangling Flora} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YWrfKetOqDwVFut7]{Oaken Resilience} as 2nd-rank primal innate spells once per day each.
_desc_ko: 당신은 프라이멀 마법을 휘두릅니다. 하루에 한 번씩 @link[spells.entangling-flora]과 @link[spells.oaken-resilience]을 (2nd)랭크 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Genie Weapon Flourish

description.value: Whenever you critically hit using a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.XGtIUZ4ZNKuFx1uL]{Falchion}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.UfurZQK6H6SgOjqe]{Ranseur}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.grmaV4GdoGD7sKbn]{Scimitar}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.FJrsDoaIXksVjld9]{Trident}, or a geniekin weapon, you apply the weapon's critical specialization effect.

_desc_en: Whenever you critically hit using a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.XGtIUZ4ZNKuFx1uL]{Falchion}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.UfurZQK6H6SgOjqe]{Ranseur}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.grmaV4GdoGD7sKbn]{Scimitar}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.FJrsDoaIXksVjld9]{Trident}, or a geniekin weapon, you apply the weapon's critical specialization effect.
_desc_ko: @link[equipment.falchion], @link[equipment.ranseur], @link[equipment.scimitar], @link[equipment.trident] 또는 지니킨 무기로 치명타를 기록할 때마다, 해당 무기의 치명타 특화 효과를 적용한다.

name: Incredible Initiative

description.value: You react more quickly than others can. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls.

_desc_en: You react more quickly than others can. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls.
_desc_ko: 당신은 다른 이들보다 더 빠르게 반응합니다. 이니셔티브 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Incredible Recollection

description.value: You can sift through knowledge locked within your mind at an incredible pace. You instantly use up to 5 Recall Knowledge actions. If you have any special abilities or free actions that would normally be triggered when you Recall Knowledge, you can't use them for these actions.

_desc_en: You can sift through knowledge locked within your mind at an incredible pace. You instantly use up to 5 Recall Knowledge actions. If you have any special abilities or free actions that would normally be triggered when you Recall Knowledge, you can't use them for these actions.
_desc_ko: 당신은 놀라운 속도로 마음속에 잠긴 지식을 샅샅이 뒤질 수 있습니다. 최대 5회의 지식 회상 행동을 즉시 사용합니다. 지식 회상 시 일반적으로 발동되는 특수 능력이나 자유 행동이 있다면, 이 행동들에 대해서는 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Unseen Passage

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You have mastered a magical technique for moving through dangerous woodlands unseen. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zlnXpME1T2uvn8Lr]{Vanishing Tracks} as an innate primal spell heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You have mastered a magical technique for moving through dangerous woodlands unseen. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zlnXpME1T2uvn8Lr]{Vanishing Tracks} as an innate primal spell heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko:
빈도 하루에 한 번

위험한 숲속을 보이지 않게 이동하는 마법 기술을 마스터했습니다. @link[spells.vanishing-tracks]을 선천적 프라이멀 주문으로 시전할 수 있으며, 이 주문은 레벨의 절반(반올림)에 해당하는 주문 랭크으로 강화됩니다.

name: Voice of the Elements

description.value: You inherit a primal dragon's bond to base elements. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks to [[/act make-an-impression]] on creatures with the elemental trait. You can also ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with elementals that don't speak any language.

_desc_en: You inherit a primal dragon's bond to base elements. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks to [[/act make-an-impression]] on creatures with the elemental trait. You can also ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with elementals that don't speak any language.
_desc_ko: 당신은 원시 용이 기본 원소와 맺은 결속을 물려받습니다. 당신은 정령 특성을 지닌 생물에게 [[/act make-an-impression]]하기 위한 외교 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 또한 당신은 어떤 언어도 말하지 못하는 정령에게 질문을 하고, 답을 받고, 외교 기술을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Ooze Empathy

description.value: You can connect with oozes (and other amorphous aberrations, at the GM's discretion) on a rudimentary level. You can use Diplomacy to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on oozes and to make very simple @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Requests} of them. In most instances, oozes will give you time to make your case.

value.value: at least two other class feats from the Oozemorph archetype

You can use Diplomacy to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on oozes and to make very simple @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Requests} of them. In most instances, oozes will give you time to make your case.
_desc_ko: 당신은 우즈(GM의 재량에 따라 다른 무정형 이형체도 포함)와 기초적인 수준에서 소통할 수 있습니다. 우즈에게 @link[actions.make-an-impression]를 위해 외교 기술을 사용할 수 있으며, 매우 간단한 @link[actions.request]을 할 수 있습니다. 대부분의 경우 우즈는 당신의 주장을 들을 시간을 줄 것입니다.

name: Decree of Execution

description.value:
You proclaim that a foe has violated the sanctity of your realm and must die. Speak your decree; a creature you designate within 60 feet who can hear your decree must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Once targeted, the creature is temporarily immune for 1 year. Whether the target perishes or is marked for death depends on their level and the result of their saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success If the target is 14th level or lower, it drops to 1 Hit point. If the target is 15th level or higher, it takes @Damage[50[spirit]] damage.

Failure If the target is 14th level or lower, it dies instantly. If the target is 15th level or higher, it takes @Damage[50[spirit]] damage; if this damage brings it to 0 Hit Points, it dies instantly. Otherwise, it gains weakness 20 to all damage for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, but a target who survives the damage is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} for 1 minute.

When you speak a Decree of Execution, you can spend a Mythic Point as part of the action to remove the incapacitation trait.

_desc_en:
You proclaim that a foe has violated the sanctity of your realm and must die. Speak your decree; a creature you designate within 60 feet who can hear your decree must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Once targeted, the creature is temporarily immune for 1 year. Whether the target perishes or is marked for death depends on their level and the result of their saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success If the target is 14th level or lower, it drops to 1 Hit point. If the target is 15th level or higher, it takes @Damage[50[spirit]] damage.

Failure If the target is 14th level or lower, it dies instantly. If the target is 15th level or higher, it takes @Damage[50[spirit]] damage; if this damage brings it to 0 Hit Points, it dies instantly. Otherwise, it gains weakness 20 to all damage for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, but a target who survives the damage is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} for 1 minute.

When you speak a Decree of Execution, you can spend a Mythic Point as part of the action to remove the incapacitation trait.
_desc_ko:
당신은 적이 당신의 영역의 신성함을 모독했기에 죽어야 한다고 선포합니다. 당신의 칙령을 선포하라. 60피트 내의 당신의 칙령을 들을 수 있는 생물은 당신의 직업 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 더 높은 쪽에 대해 의지 저항 검사를 시도해야 한다. 표적이 된 생물은 1년간 일시적으로 면역 상태가 된다. 표적이 사망하거나 죽음의 표식을 받게 되는지는 대상의 레벨과 저항 검사 결과에 따라 결정된다.

대성공 대상은 영향을 받지 않는다.

성공 대상이 14레벨 이하일 경우, HP가 1로 감소합니다. 대상이 15레벨 이상일 경우, 50 영혼의 피해를 입습니다.

실패 대상이 14레벨 이하일 경우 즉시 사망한다. 대상이 15레벨 이상일 경우 50 영혼의 피해를 입는다; 이 피해로 HP가 0이 되면 즉시 사망한다. 그렇지 않은 경우, 1분 동안 모든 피해에 대해 약화 20 상태를 얻습니다.

대실패 실패와 동일하나, 피해를 견뎌낸 대상은 1분 동안 @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태가 된다.

처형의 칙령을 발동할 때, 행동의 일부로 신화 포인트를 소모하여 무력화 특성을 제거할 수 있다.

name: Vacate Vision

description.value:
Trigger You fail (but don't critically fail) a saving throw against an effect with the visual trait.

You cause your eyes to liquefy and run out of your eye sockets, leaving them empty. You get a success on the save against the triggering effect, but you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for the duration the effect would have had on a failure. At that time, your eyes regrow and your normal vision returns.

_desc_en:
Trigger You fail (but don't critically fail) a saving throw against an effect with the visual trait.

You cause your eyes to liquefy and run out of your eye sockets, leaving them empty. You get a success on the save against the triggering effect, but you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for the duration the effect would have had on a failure. At that time, your eyes regrow and your normal vision returns.
_desc_ko:
발동 시각적 특성을 가진 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 실패(대실패는 아님)합니다.

당신은 자신의 눈을 액체화시켜 안구에서 흘러나가게 하여 빈 공간을 남깁니다. 발동 효과에 대한 내성에 성공하지만, 실패했을 때 효과가 지속되는 동안 @link[conditions.blinded] 상태가 됩니다. 그 후, 당신의 눈은 재생되어 정상적인 시력이 회복됩니다.

name: Sinbladed Spell

description.value:
Requirements You are holding a weapon in the polearm or spear group.

You punctuate your spellcasting with a flourish of your weapon, imparting physical force to your magic. If the next spell you cast is a non-cantrip sin or curriculum spell that affects a single target, and you either succeed on your attack roll or the target fails its saving throw against the spell, a wound in the shape of your personal rune appears on the target, dealing additional persistent bleed damage equal to the spell's rank, in addition to its regular effects.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are holding a weapon in the polearm or spear group.

You punctuate your spellcasting with a flourish of your weapon, imparting physical force to your magic. If the next spell you cast is a non-cantrip sin or curriculum spell that affects a single target, and you either succeed on your attack roll or the target fails its saving throw against the spell, a wound in the shape of your personal rune appears on the target, dealing additional persistent bleed damage equal to the spell's rank, in addition to its regular effects.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 창병기 또는 창 계열 무기를 들고 있어야 합니다.

주문 시기에 무기를 휘둘러 마법에 물리적 힘을 실어줍니다. 다음에 시전하는 주문이 캔트립이 아닌 단일 대상에 영향을 미치는 죄악 또는 교과 주문이며, 명중 굴림에 성공하거나 대상이 주문에 대한 내성 굴림에서 실패할 경우, 대상에게 개인 룬 모양의 상처가 나타나며, 해당 주문의 랭크에 해당하는 지속적인 출혈 피해를 추가로 입힙니다. 이는 주문의 기본 효과에 더해지는 것입니다.

name: Consume Power

description.value:
Trigger You would take acid, electricity, fire, or sonic damage.

You absorb energy and hold it in your kinetic gate. You gain resistance equal to your level to the triggering damage—choose one eligible type of resistance. If this reaction prevents any damage, you gain a status bonus equal to half your level to the damage roll of the next metal impulse you use before the end of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.m5kXngVAHiprZea1]{Effect: Consume Power}

_desc_en:
Trigger You would take acid, electricity, fire, or sonic damage.

You absorb energy and hold it in your kinetic gate. You gain resistance equal to your level to the triggering damage—choose one eligible type of resistance. If this reaction prevents any damage, you gain a status bonus equal to half your level to the damage roll of the next metal impulse you use before the end of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.m5kXngVAHiprZea1]{Effect: Consume Power}
_desc_ko:
발동 산성, 전기, 화염 또는 음파 피해를 입습니다.

당신은 에너지를 흡수하여 키네틱 게이트에 저장합니다. 발동된 피해에 대해 레벨과 동일한 저항력을 얻습니다-적용 가능한 저항 유형 중 하나를 선택하세요. 이 반응으로 피해를 막았을 경우, 다음 턴이 끝나기 전에 사용하는 다음 금속 충격의 피해 주사위 굴림에 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Syu Tak-nwa's Skillful Tresses

description.value: You can expertly control your living hair and use it to perform various tasks. You can perform simple Interact actions with your hair such as opening an unlocked door or picking up objects. Your hair can't perform actions that require fingers or significant manual dexterity, including any action that would require a check to accomplish. Your hair can hold items of up to 1 Bulk, but can't Activate or attack with any items it's holding.

_desc_en: You can expertly control your living hair and use it to perform various tasks. You can perform simple Interact actions with your hair such as opening an unlocked door or picking up objects. Your hair can't perform actions that require fingers or significant manual dexterity, including any action that would require a check to accomplish. Your hair can hold items of up to 1 Bulk, but can't Activate or attack with any items it's holding.
_desc_ko: 당신은 살아있는 머리카락을 능숙하게 조종하여 다양한 작업을 수행할 수 있습니다. 잠금 해제된 문을 열거나 물건을 집는 등 머리카락으로 간단한 상호작용 행동을 할 수 있습니다. 머리카락은 손가락이나 상당한 손재주가 필요한 행동, 즉 수행에 판정이 필요한 모든 행동은 할 수 없습니다. 머리카락은 최대 1벌크의 물건을 잡을 수 있으나, 잡고 있는 물건으로 활성화하거나 공격할 수는 없습니다.

name: Fierce Grasp

description.value:
Requirements You have an opponent @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

Once you get your hands on someone, it's hard for them to get away. Your opponent takes a –2 circumstance penalty to their next attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} from being grabbed or restrained by you, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your AC against any attacks they make against you while you have them grabbed.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have an opponent @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

Once you get your hands on someone, it's hard for them to get away. Your opponent takes a –2 circumstance penalty to their next attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} from being grabbed or restrained by you, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your AC against any attacks they make against you while you have them grabbed.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 상대방이 @link[conditions.grabbed] 상태이거나 @link[conditions.restrained] 상태여야 합니다.

상대를 붙잡으면 그들이 벗어나기 어렵습니다. 상대는 당신이 붙잡거나 제압한 상태에서 @link[actions.escape]을 시도할 때 상황 페널티 -2를 받으며, 당신이 상대를 붙잡고 있는 동안 상대가 당신을 공격할 때 당신의 AC에 상황 보너스 +1을 얻습니다.

name: Quicksoul

description.value:
The elemental metal in your bloodline literally courses through your veins in the form of liquid metals like mercury, rubidium, gallium, and djezet, giving your actions a languid fluidity. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Acrobatics. If you would automatically become trained in Acrobatics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. As these metals are largely toxic to organic life, you also gain the Toxic Touch action.

Toxic Touch 1 (poison)

Frequency once per day

Requirements Your most recent action was to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through}, and you successfully moved through an enemy's space

Effect Make a melee unarmed Strike against the enemy whose space you moved through. On a hit, the target takes @Damage[1d6[persistent,poison]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (or takes 2d6 persistent poison and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical hit).

_desc_en:
The elemental metal in your bloodline literally courses through your veins in the form of liquid metals like mercury, rubidium, gallium, and djezet, giving your actions a languid fluidity. If you would automatically become trained in Acrobatics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.
