These effects last for 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

당신은 신성한 불꽃을 받아들여 잠재력을 완전히 발휘합니다. 신성한 후광이 자동으로 활성화되며(아직 활성화되지 않은 경우) 후광 범위가 두 배로 확장됩니다. 60피트 범위 내에는 밝은 빛을, 그 다음 60피트 범위 내에는 희미한 빛을 발산합니다. 신성한 불꽃을 집중하는 동안 후광을 억제할 수 없습니다. 레벨에 해당하는 임시 HP를 획득하며, 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 물리 피해 저항력을 얻습니다. @link[conditions.quickened] 상태를 얻으며, 매 라운드 추가 행동으로 오직 타격 및 이동 행동만 사용할 수 있습니다. 근접 공격으로 생물에게 피해를 입힐 때마다, 무료 행동으로 해당 생물을 @link[actions.shove]하거나 @link[actions.trip]하는 것을 시도할 수 있습니다. 이 효과는 1분 동안 지속됩니다.

name: Jealous Grip

description.value:
Trigger A creature in your reach that you're aware of attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} you, or damage or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} an item in your possession.

You are protective of your hoard, and woe betide anyone who tries to take what's yours. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If your attack is a critical hit and the triggering action was a manipulate action, you disrupt that action. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature in your reach that you're aware of attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} you, or damage or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} an item in your possession.

You are protective of your hoard, and woe betide anyone who tries to take what's yours. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If your attack is a critical hit and the triggering action was a manipulate action, you disrupt that action. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신이 인지하고 있는, 당신의 사정거리 내의 생물이 당신을 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{무장 해제}하거나, 당신이 소유한 물건에 피해를 주거나 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{훔치기}하려 시도합니다.

당신은 자신의 축재물에 대해 방어적이며, 자신의 것을 빼앗으려는 자에게는 화가 미칠지어다. 발동한 생물에게 근접 타격을 하십시오. 당신의 공격이 결정타이고 발동한 행동이 조작 행동이었다면, 그 행동을 방해합니다. 이 타격은 당신의 다중공격 페널티에 산입되지 않으며, 당신의 다중공격 페널티도 이 타격에 적용되지 않습니다.

name: Wildborn Adept

description.value: The whispers of the jungle grant you more diverse access to simple primal magic. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kcelf6IHl3L9VXXg]{Vitality Lash} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uZK2BYzPnxUBnDjr]{Tangle Vine} as innate primal spells at will. If you chose one of those spells with Wildborn Magic, you can select a new spell for Wildborn Magic.

_desc_en: The whispers of the jungle grant you more diverse access to simple primal magic. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kcelf6IHl3L9VXXg]{Vitality Lash} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uZK2BYzPnxUBnDjr]{Tangle Vine} as innate primal spells at will. If you chose one of those spells with Wildborn Magic, you can select a new spell for Wildborn Magic.
_desc_ko: 정글의 속삭임은 당신에게 단순한 프라이멀 마법에 대한 더 다양한 접근을 허락합니다. @link[spells.light], @link[spells.vitality-lash], @link[spells.tangle-vine]을 선천적 프라이멀 마법으로 자유롭게 시전할 수 있습니다. 야생의 마법으로 이 중 하나의 주문을 선택했다면, 야생의 마법으로 사용할 새 주문을 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Guiding Shot

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a ranged weapon.

Your ranged attack helps guide your allies into striking your enemy's weak point. Attempt a Strike with the required weapon. If the Strike hits, the next creature other than you to attack the same target before the start of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their roll, or a +2 circumstance bonus if your Strike was a critical hit.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.21pCT4n3Aixyvp4h]{Effect: Guiding Shot}

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a ranged weapon.

Your ranged attack helps guide your allies into striking your enemy's weak point. Attempt a Strike with the required weapon. If the Strike hits, the next creature other than you to attack the same target before the start of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their roll, or a +2 circumstance bonus if your Strike was a critical hit.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.21pCT4n3Aixyvp4h]{Effect: Guiding Shot}
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 원거리 무기를 장비하고 있어야 합니다.

당신의 원거리 공격은 아군이 적의 약점을 공격하도록 유도합니다. 필요한 무기로 공격을 시도하십시오. 공격이 적중하면, 다음 턴이 시작되기 전에 같은 대상을 공격하는 당신 이외의 다음 생물은 주사위 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 당신의 공격이 치명타였다면 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Flames of Vision

description.value:
Access dokkaebi goblin heritage or Tian Xia origin

Dokkaebi were among the first goblins to pioneer gazing through flames, spectral or physical, to cast their senses far and wide. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zvKWclOZ7A53DObE]{Clairvoyance} as a 4th-rank innate occult spell twice per day. To see through the spell's eye, you must be staring into a source of fire.

Special If you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6DfLZBl8wKIV03Iq]{Ignition}, including from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.gRa4bvQn7rI1LoRl]{Dokkaebi Fire} feat, then you can cast that spell as part of casting clairvoyance. Instead of the cantrip's normal effect, you conjure flames in your hand, which persist for the duration of your clairvoyance spell for you to gaze through.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Access dokkaebi goblin heritage or Tian Xia origin

Dokkaebi were among the first goblins to pioneer gazing through flames, spectral or physical, to cast their senses far and wide. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zvKWclOZ7A53DObE]{Clairvoyance} as a 4th-rank innate occult spell twice per day. To see through the spell's eye, you must be staring into a source of fire.

Special If you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6DfLZBl8wKIV03Iq]{Ignition}, including from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.gRa4bvQn7rI1LoRl]{Dokkaebi Fire} feat, then you can cast that spell as part of casting clairvoyance. Instead of the cantrip's normal effect, you conjure flames in your hand, which persist for the duration of your clairvoyance spell for you to gaze through.
_desc_ko:
접근 도깨비 고블린 유산 또는 티엔 샤 기원

도깨비는 불꽃을 통해 바라보는 기술을 최초로 개척한 고블린 중 하나로, 영적 또는 물리적 불꽃을 통해 감각을 멀리까지 뻗어 사용할 수 있었다. 하루에 두 번, (4th)랭크 선천적 오컬트 주문인 @link[spells.clairvoyance]을 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 주문의 눈으로 보려면 불의 근원을 응시하고 있어야 합니다.

특수 @link[spells.ignition]를 시전할 수 있다면(@link[feats.dokkaebi-fire] 피트 포함), 해당 주문을 투시력 시전 과정의 일부로 사용할 수 있습니다. 이 캔트립의 일반 효과 대신, 손에 불꽃을 소환하여 투시 주문 지속 시간 동안 바라볼 수 있게 한다.

name: Analyze Weakness

description.value:
Requirements You have identified a creature with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}.

Your knowledge of a creature's physiology helps you attack with pinpoint accuracy. You carefully study a creature that you've identified to scope out particularly weak points in its positioning or physical form. The next time you deal sneak attack damage to the chosen creature with a Strike before the end of your turn, add an additional 2d6 precision damage.

At 11th level, the additional damage becomes 3d6, and at 17th level it becomes 4d6.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have identified a creature with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}.

Your knowledge of a creature's physiology helps you attack with pinpoint accuracy. You carefully study a creature that you've identified to scope out particularly weak points in its positioning or physical form. The next time you deal sneak attack damage to the chosen creature with a Strike before the end of your turn, add an additional 2d6 precision damage.

At 11th level, the additional damage becomes 3d6, and at 17th level it becomes 4d6.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 @link[actions.recall-knowledge]을 가진 생물을 식별했습니다.

생물의 생리학적 지식이 공격의 정확도를 극대화합니다. 식별한 생물을 면밀히 관찰하여 위치나 신체 구조상의 취약점을 파악합니다. 자신의 턴 종료 전까지 선택한 생물에게 암습 공격 피해를 입힐 경우, 추가로 2d6 정밀 피해를 가합니다.

11레벨에 도달하면 추가 피해가 3d6으로 증가하며, 17레벨에 도달하면 4d6으로 증가한다.

name: Observant Explorer

description.value: Thanks to the time you've spent wandering through wild and untamed environments, you've gained an intuitive sense about creatures. You sometimes notice them before they attack, or spot them nearby even if they weren't planning on attacking. You can attempt a check to notice hidden creatures attempting to Avoid Notice nearby even if you aren't actively Searching for them. You still need to meet any other requirements to notice a particular creature.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en: Thanks to the time you've spent wandering through wild and untamed environments, you've gained an intuitive sense about creatures. You sometimes notice them before they attack, or spot them nearby even if they weren't planning on attacking. You can attempt a check to notice hidden creatures attempting to Avoid Notice nearby even if you aren't actively Searching for them. You still need to meet any other requirements to notice a particular creature.
_desc_ko: 야생의 거친 환경을 헤매며 보낸 시간 덕분에, 당신은 생물에 대한 직관적인 감각을 얻었습니다. 때로는 그들이 공격하기 전에 눈치채거나, 공격할 의도가 없더라도 근처에 있는 것을 발견하기도 합니다. 적극적으로 탐색하지 않더라도 근처에서 은신 중인 생물들이 '주의 회피'를 시도하는 것을 알아차리기 위한 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다. 특정 생물을 알아차리기 위한 다른 조건들은 여전히 충족해야 합니다.

name: Beastmaster Bond

description.value: You can communicate telepathically with your animal companions within 100 feet. If you're legendary in Nature, you can communicate telepathically with your animal companions anywhere on the planet.

_desc_en: You can communicate telepathically with your animal companions within 100 feet. If you're legendary in Nature, you can communicate telepathically with your animal companions anywhere on the planet.
_desc_ko: 100피트 이내의 동물 동료와 텔레파시로 소통할 수 있습니다. 자연계에서 전설적인 존재라면 지구상 어디에 있든 동물 동료와 텔레파시로 소통할 수 있습니다.

name: Student of the Staff

description.value:
You've studied the staff extensively to learn the hidden capabilities of your chosen weapon. When you critically succeed at an attack roll using a staff, you apply the critical specialization effect of the club group. While you're in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HbejhIywqIufrmVM]{Arcane Cascade} stance, your staff gains the deadly d6 trait, with the damage from the deadly die being the same damage type as the extra damage from Arcane Cascade.

In addition, you can place property runes into a magic staff you prepare, even though a magic staff can't typically hold property runes. You must first inscribe the property runes into your spellbook, using the same process as transferring a rune. The rune takes the form of a specialized diagram in your spellbook, occupying one page. You can't inscribe runes that can't be placed on a non-magical staff, nor can you inscribe the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.roeYtwlIe65BPMJ1]{Shifting} rune. When you prepare a staff, you can impart any number of property runes from your spellbook into the staff, up to the limit imposed by the staff's weapon potency rune.

_desc_en:
You've studied the staff extensively to learn the hidden capabilities of your chosen weapon. When you critically succeed at an attack roll using a staff, you apply the critical specialization effect of the club group. While you're in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HbejhIywqIufrmVM]{Arcane Cascade} stance, your staff gains the deadly d6 trait, with the damage from the deadly die being the same damage type as the extra damage from Arcane Cascade.

In addition, you can place property runes into a magic staff you prepare, even though a magic staff can't typically hold property runes. You must first inscribe the property runes into your spellbook, using the same process as transferring a rune. The rune takes the form of a specialized diagram in your spellbook, occupying one page. You can't inscribe runes that can't be placed on a non-magical staff, nor can you inscribe the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.roeYtwlIe65BPMJ1]{Shifting} rune. When you prepare a staff, you can impart any number of property runes from your spellbook into the staff, up to the limit imposed by the staff's weapon potency rune.
_desc_ko:
당신은 선택한 무기의 {숨겨진} 능력을 배우기 위해 장봉을 깊이 연구했습니다. 지팡이를 사용한 명중 굴림에 대성공 시, 클럽 계열의 크리티컬 특화 효과인 ' '를 적용합니다. @link[actions.arcane-cascade] 스탠스에 있을 때, 지팡이는 치명적인 d6 특성을 얻으며, 치명 주사위의 피해는 아케인 캐스케이드의 추가 피해와 동일한 피해 유형입니다.

또한, 마법 지팡이는 일반적으로 속성 룬을 보유할 수 없지만, 준비한 마법 지팡이에 속성 룬을 장착할 수 있습니다. 먼저 룬을 전이하는 것과 동일한 과정을 통해 속성 룬을 주문서에 새겨야 합니다. 이 룬은 주문서에서 특수한 도형 형태를 취하며 한 페이지를 차지합니다. 비마법 지팡이에 장착할 수 없는 룬은 새길 수 없으며, @link[equipment.shifting] 룬도 새길 수 없습니다. 지팡이를 준비할 때, 지팡이의 무기 위력 룬이 정한 한도 내에서 주문서에서 원하는 수의 속성 룬을 지팡이에 부여할 수 있습니다.

name: Shieldmarshal Dedication

description.value:
Your elite shieldmarshal training makes you equally at home in the squalor of Smokeside and the splendor of Skyside. You're intimately familiar with the city's labyrinthine streets and statutes. You become trained in Society; if you were already trained, you become an expert in Society instead. In urban environments, you can attempt [[/act sense-direction skill=society]]{Society} checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.fJImDBQfqfjKJOhk]{Sense Direction}. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.JtjnFsOToBLnSRO9]{Courtly Graces} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.X2jGFfLU5qI5XVot]{Streetwise} skill feats.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.ssd83GMzktmP3ZEC]{Shieldmarshal}

_desc_en:
Your elite shieldmarshal training makes you equally at home in the squalor of Smokeside and the splendor of Skyside. You're intimately familiar with the city's labyrinthine streets and statutes. You become trained in Society; if you were already trained, you become an expert in Society instead. In urban environments, you can attempt [[/act sense-direction skill=society]]{Society} checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.fJImDBQfqfjKJOhk]{Sense Direction}. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.JtjnFsOToBLnSRO9]{Courtly Graces} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.X2jGFfLU5qI5XVot]{Streetwise} skill feats.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.ssd83GMzktmP3ZEC]{Shieldmarshal}
_desc_ko: 정예 쉴드마셜 훈련으로 인해 당신은 스모크사이드의 비참함 속에서도, 스카이사이드의 화려함 속에서도 똑같이 편안함을 느낍니다. 도시의 미로 같은 거리와 법규에 패밀리어를 가지고 있습니다. 사회에 숙련됩니다. 이미 숙련된 경우, 대신 사회에 전문가가 됩니다. 도시 환경에서 사회 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다. 또한 @link[feats.courtly-graces]과 @link[feats.streetwise] 기술 피트를 획득합니다.

name: Shield Your Eyes

description.value: You reflexively place your shield between your eyes and visual dangers. While your shield is raised, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to all defenses against effects with the light or visual trait. If you critically fail your save against such an effect while your shield is raised, you fail instead. Likewise, if such an effect critically succeeds against your DC, it's a success instead.

_desc_en: You reflexively place your shield between your eyes and visual dangers. While your shield is raised, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to all defenses against effects with the light or visual trait. If you critically fail your save against such an effect while your shield is raised, you fail instead. Likewise, if such an effect critically succeeds against your DC, it's a success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 반사적으로 눈을 가리고 시각적 위험으로부터 보호합니다. 방패를 든 상태에서는 빛이나 시각적 특성을 가진 효과에 대한 모든 방어에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 방패를 든 상태에서 해당 효과에 대한 내성에 대실패를 하면, 대신 실패로 처리된다. 마찬가지로, 해당 효과가 당신의 DC에 대해 대성공을 하면, 대신 성공으로 처리된다.

name: Keen Magical Detection

description.value: You sense magical dangers. When using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Yb0C1uLzeHrVLl7a]{Detect Magic} exploration activity, you can roll initiative twice and use the better result so long as at least one opponent has a magical effect or magic item and is in range of your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic}.

_desc_en: You sense magical dangers. When using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Yb0C1uLzeHrVLl7a]{Detect Magic} exploration activity, you can roll initiative twice and use the better result so long as at least one opponent has a magical effect or magic item and is in range of your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic}.
_desc_ko: 마법적 위험을 감지합니다. @link[actions.detect-magic] 탐사 활동을 사용할 때, 적어도 한 명의 상대가 마법 효과나 마법 아이템을 지니고 있으며 당신의 @link[spells.detect-magic] 범위 내에 있다면, 이니셔티브를 두 번 굴려 더 좋은 결과를 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Ancestor's Transformation

description.value: You can commune with ancestor spirits to assume the form of an enormous primeval strix. You can cast 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.NzXpEzcZAjuDTZjK]{Aerial Form} as a primal innate spell once per day, but you take the form of a primeval strix, using the statistics for a bird form.

_desc_en: You can commune with ancestor spirits to assume the form of an enormous primeval strix. You can cast 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.NzXpEzcZAjuDTZjK]{Aerial Form} as a primal innate spell once per day, but you take the form of a primeval strix, using the statistics for a bird form.
_desc_ko: 조상의 영혼과 교감하여 거대한 원시적인 스트릭스의 모습을 취할 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, (5th)랭크 @link[spells.aerial-form]를 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있으나, 새 형태의 능력치를 사용하며 원시적인 스트릭스의 형태를 취한다.

name: Sense Iniquity

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Your Hellknight training gives you the ability to focus your senses and root out those who would attempt to deceive or hide from you. For 1 minute, you gain a +2 status bonus to your Perception DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} you, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} to you. During this time, if you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} to locate a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} creature or to see through a creature's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} attempt, you gain a +2 status bonus to the Perception check.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Your Hellknight training gives you the ability to focus your senses and root out those who would attempt to deceive or hide from you. For 1 minute, you gain a +2 status bonus to your Perception DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} you, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} to you. During this time, if you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} to locate a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} creature or to see through a creature's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} attempt, you gain a +2 status bonus to the Perception check.
_desc_ko:
빈도 시간당 한 번

당신의 헬나이트 훈련은 감각을 집중해 당신을 속이거나 당신에게서 숨으려는 자들을 색출하는 능력을 부여합니다. 1분 동안, 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{교란 만들기}, 당신을 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{기만 동작}, 혹은 당신에게 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{거짓말}을 하려는 시도에 대한 지각 DC에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 시간 동안, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{숨겨짐} 생물을 찾거나 생물의 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{위장} 시도를 간파하기 위해 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{탐색}한다면, 지각 판정에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Energize Bite

description.value:
Requirements Your most recent action was to use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7y8DKd24c7eqzJGV]{Breath of the Dragon}.

The deadly energy of your breath remains in your jaws to empower your attacks. Until the end of your turn, your jaws unarmed attack deals an extra 1d6 damage of a type matching that of your draconic benefactor. This ability has the trait associated with the type of damage it deals.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your most recent action was to use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7y8DKd24c7eqzJGV]{Breath of the Dragon}.

The deadly energy of your breath remains in your jaws to empower your attacks. Until the end of your turn, your jaws unarmed attack deals an extra 1d6 damage of a type matching that of your draconic benefactor. This ability has the trait associated with the type of damage it deals.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 당신의 가장 최근 행동이 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7y8DKd24c7eqzJGV]{용의 숨결} 사용이었습니다.

당신의 숨결의 치명적인 에너지가 아가리에 남아 공격을 강화합니다. 당신의 턴이 끝날 때까지, 당신의 아가리 비무장 공격은 당신의 용 후원자의 유형과 일치하는 유형의 추가 1d6 피해를 입힙니다. 이 능력은 그것이 입히는 피해 유형과 관련된 특성을 지닙니다.

name: Stone Bones

description.value:
Trigger You are struck by a critical hit that deals physical damage.

Your intractable nature can help you shrug off even the most grievous injuries. Attempt a @Check[flat|dc:17|showDC:all]. If you are successful, the attack becomes a normal hit.

_desc_en:
Trigger You are struck by a critical hit that deals physical damage.

Your intractable nature can help you shrug off even the most grievous injuries. Attempt a @Check[flat|dc:17|showDC:all]. If you are successful, the attack becomes a normal hit.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 물리 피해를 입히는 치명타를 맞았다.

당신의 완고한 성격은 가장 심각한 부상조차도 무시할 수 있게 해줍니다. DC 17 단순을 시도하세요. 성공하면 공격은 일반 타격으로 바뀝니다.

name: Shaitan Skin

description.value: When in danger, you can harden the stone in your skin into armor, much like a shaitan. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2BV2yYPfVJ5zirZt]{Mountain Resilience} on yourself only, 3 times per day as a 4th-rank arcane innate spell.

_desc_en: When in danger, you can harden the stone in your skin into armor, much like a shaitan. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2BV2yYPfVJ5zirZt]{Mountain Resilience} on yourself only, 3 times per day as a 4th-rank arcane innate spell.
_desc_ko: 위험에 처했을 때, 샤이탄처럼 피부 속 돌을 갑옷처럼 단단하게 만들 수 있다. 하루에 3번, 자신에게만 @link[spells.mountain-resilience]을 (4th)랭크 아케인 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있다.

name: Robust Recovery

description.value: You learned folk medicine to help recover from diseases and poison, and using it diligently has made you especially resilient. When you Treat a Disease or a Poison, or someone else uses one of these actions on you, increase the circumstance bonus granted on a success to +4, and if the result of the patient's saving throw is a success, the patient gets a critical success.

_desc_en: You learned folk medicine to help recover from diseases and poison, and using it diligently has made you especially resilient. When you Treat a Disease or a Poison, or someone else uses one of these actions on you, increase the circumstance bonus granted on a success to +4, and if the result of the patient's saving throw is a success, the patient gets a critical success.
_desc_ko: 질병과 독에서 회복하는 데 도움이 되는 민간 요법을 배웠으며, 이를 꾸준히 사용해 특히 회복력이 강해졌습니다. 질병이나 독을 치료하거나, 다른 사람이 당신에게 이 행동을 사용할 때 성공 시 부여되는 상황 보너스를 +4로 증가시킵니다. 또한 환자의 내성 굴림 결과가 성공일 경우 환자는 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Turn Back the Clock

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a skill check or saving throw.

After failing a test of skill, you hop back in your personal timeline so you can try again. You reroll the triggering check with a +1 circumstance bonus as you apply your experience from your last attempt. You must use the new result, even if it's worse than your first roll.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a skill check or saving throw.

After failing a test of skill, you hop back in your personal timeline so you can try again. You reroll the triggering check with a +1 circumstance bonus as you apply your experience from your last attempt. You must use the new result, even if it's worse than your first roll.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 기술 판정나 내성 굴림에서 실패할 때.

기술 검사에 실패한 후, 다시 시도하기 위해 개인 타임라인으로 되돌아갑니다. 이전 시도의 경험을 적용하여 +1 상황 보너스와 함께 유발 판정을 재굴림합니다. 첫 번째 굴림보다 결과가 나쁘더라도 새로운 결과를 반드시 사용해야 합니다.

name: Hellknight-Errant

description.value:
Either through unfortunate circumstances or your own choice, you remain a Hellknight armiger instead of entering the true ranks of your order, though you still believe in the tenets of law and order. You likely take on an adventuring life with a group of like-minded individuals who aren't Hellknights. The resistance to mental damage you gained from the Hellknight Dedication feat increases to 5 + your number of archetype class feats from the Hellknight archetype.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.NKjQup6NyQvg2J7y]{Warding Shift} action, which allows you to keep your allies from harm.

Special You can't take both this feat and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.oNh2vedij8xbDbph]{Hellknight Preferment} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.62hpJOuvYYSa4X7u]{Hellknight Signifer Preferment}.

value.value: you’ve refused to take or have failed the Hellknight Test

_desc_en:
Either through unfortunate circumstances or your own choice, you remain a Hellknight armiger instead of entering the true ranks of your order, though you still believe in the tenets of law and order. You likely take on an adventuring life with a group of like-minded individuals who aren't Hellknights. The resistance to mental damage you gained from the Hellknight Dedication feat increases to 5 + your number of archetype class feats from the Hellknight archetype.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.NKjQup6NyQvg2J7y]{Warding Shift} action, which allows you to keep your allies from harm.

Special You can't take both this feat and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.oNh2vedij8xbDbph]{Hellknight Preferment} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.62hpJOuvYYSa4X7u]{Hellknight Signifer Preferment}.
_desc_ko:
불운한 상황 때문이든 당신 자신의 선택 때문이든, 당신은 소속 기사단의 정식 대열에 들어가는 대신 헬나이트 종자로 남아 있지만, 여전히 법과 질서의 신조를 믿습니다. 당신은 아마도 헬나이트가 아닌 뜻이 맞는 이들의 무리와 함께 모험가의 삶을 살게 됩니다. 헬나이트 전념 재주에서 얻은 정신 피해 저항이 5 + 헬나이트 아키타입에서 얻은 아키타입 클래스 재주의 개수로 증가합니다.

당신은 또한 아군을 위험에서 지킬 수 있게 해주는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.NKjQup6NyQvg2J7y]{방어 이동} 행동을 얻습니다.

특수 이 재주와 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.oNh2vedij8xbDbph]{헬나이트 승진} 또는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.62hpJOuvYYSa4X7u]{헬나이트 시니퍼 승진}을 둘 다 습득할 수는 없습니다.

name: Greater Security

description.value: Shield in hand, you offer your ally its full protection you do yourself. While the companion shield is in effect, if your shield is raised, the ally with the companion shield gets the same bonus to AC your shield grants, and you can trigger @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} if that ally would meet the trigger. This uses your shield's statistics and applies damage to your shield.

_desc_en: Shield in hand, you offer your ally its full protection you do yourself. While the companion shield is in effect, if your shield is raised, the ally with the companion shield gets the same bonus to AC your shield grants, and you can trigger @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} if that ally would meet the trigger. This uses your shield's statistics and applies damage to your shield.
_desc_ko: 손에 든 방패로, 당신은 아군에게 자신에게 적용되는 방패의 완전한 보호를 제공합니다. 동반 방패 효과가 지속되는 동안, 당신의 방패가 올라가 있다면 동반 방패를 가진 아군은 당신의 방패가 부여하는 것과 동일한 AC 보너스를 받으며, 해당 아군이 발동 조건을 충족할 경우 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{방패 막기}를 발동할 수 있습니다. 이때 당신의 방패 통계가 적용되며, 피해는 당신의 방패에 가해집니다.

name: Punishing Shove

description.value: When you push a foe away, you put the entire force of your armored form into it. When you successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} a creature, that creature takes an amount of @Damage[(@actor.abilities.str.mod + @actor.skills.athletics.rank*(@actor.skills.athletics.rank - 1))[bludgeoning]]{bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier} (or @Damage[(2*(@actor.abilities.str.mod + @actor.skills.athletics.rank*(@actor.skills.athletics.rank - 1)))[bludgeoning]]{double that amount} on a critical success). This damage increases by 2 when you become an expert in Athletics, 6 when you become a master, and 12 when you become legendary.

_desc_en: When you push a foe away, you put the entire force of your armored form into it. When you successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} a creature, that creature takes an amount of @Damage[(@actor.abilities.str.mod + @actor.skills.athletics.rank*(@actor.skills.athletics.rank - 1))[bludgeoning]]{bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier} (or @Damage[(2*(@actor.abilities.str.mod + @actor.skills.athletics.rank*(@actor.skills.athletics.rank - 1)))[bludgeoning]]{double that amount} on a critical success). This damage increases by 2 when you become an expert in Athletics, 6 when you become a master, and 12 when you become legendary.
_desc_ko: 적에게 밀쳐낼 때, 갑옷으로 강화된 몸 전체의 힘을 쏟아붓는다. 생물을 성공적으로 @link[actions.shove]하면, 그 생물은 근력 능력치 수정자에 해당하는 타격 피해를 받습니다(대성공 시 그 두 배의 피해를 받습니다). 이 피해는 운동 숙련자가 되면 2 증가하고, 달인이 되면 6 증가하며, 전설적인 달인이 되면 12 증가한다.

name: Blast Resistance

description.value:
Access You are from Dongun Hold or Alkenstar.

You're used to the clamor of steel, the crack of a firearm, and the thunderous blast of explosions. You gain resistance 3 to fire and sonic. If you roll a success on a saving throw against an effect that causes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} conditions, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en:
Access You are from Dongun Hold or Alkenstar.

You're used to the clamor of steel, the crack of a firearm, and the thunderous blast of explosions. You gain resistance 3 to fire and sonic. If you roll a success on a saving throw against an effect that causes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} conditions, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko:
Access 동군 홀드 또는 알켄스터 출신이다.

철의 요란한 소음, 화기의 탕하는 소리, 그리고 폭발의 우레 같은 굉음에 익숙하다. 당신은 화염과 [sonic]에 대한 저항력 3을 얻습니다. @link[conditions.dazzled] 또는 @link[conditions.deafened] 상태를 유발하는 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴리면, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Strategic Repose

description.value: You've trained extensively in fighting the undead and have learned to infuse a small amount of vitality energy into your weapon. When you deal precision damage with strategic strike, you may choose for that damage to be vitality damage instead.

_desc_en: You've trained extensively in fighting the undead and have learned to infuse a small amount of vitality energy into your weapon. When you deal precision damage with strategic strike, you may choose for that damage to be vitality damage instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 언데드와의 전투를 위해 광범위하게 훈련했으며, 무기에 소량의 활력 에너지를 주입하는 법을 익혔습니다. 전략적 타격으로 정밀 피해를 입힐 때, 해당 피해를 활력 피해로 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Renewed Vigor

description.value: Through the haze of battle, you quickly recover your raging vigor. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level plus your Constitution modifier. If you made an attack action this turn, increase the number of temporary Hit Points to your level plus your Constitution modifier. These temporary Hit Points last until the end of your rage.

_desc_en: Through the haze of battle, you quickly recover your raging vigor. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level plus your Constitution modifier. If you made an attack action this turn, increase the number of temporary Hit Points to your level plus your Constitution modifier. These temporary Hit Points last until the end of your rage.
_desc_ko: 전투의 혼란 속에서도 당신은 격노한 활력을 빠르게 회복합니다. 레벨의 절반에 건강 수정자를 더한 만큼의 임시 HP를 얻습니다. 이번 턴에 공격 행동을 수행했다면, 임시 HP 수치를 레벨에 건강 수정자를 더한 값으로 증가시킵니다. 이 임시 HP는 격노가 끝날 때까지 지속됩니다.

name: Grand Talisman Esoterica

description.value: You've gained the ability to place multiple talismans on an item. Normally, affixing more than one talisman to an item causes the talismans to be suppressed, but when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.UAaQk93a30nx0nYY]{Affix a Talisman}, you can specially treat one item you're working on, allowing it to have two active talismans at once. This special treatment ends if you use Affix a Talisman to treat a new item with this ability.

_desc_en: You've gained the ability to place multiple talismans on an item. Normally, affixing more than one talisman to an item causes the talismans to be suppressed, but when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.UAaQk93a30nx0nYY]{Affix a Talisman}, you can specially treat one item you're working on, allowing it to have two active talismans at once. This special treatment ends if you use Affix a Talisman to treat a new item with this ability.
_desc_ko: 비전의 부적 연구를 완성하여, 하나의 아이템에 여러 부적을 부착할 수 있는 능력을 얻었습니다. 일반적으로 아이템에 두 개 이상의 부적을 부착하면 부적들이 억제되지만, @link[actions.affix-a-talisman]을 사용할 때 작업 중인 아이템 하나를 특별히 처리하여 두 개의 부적이 동시에 활성화되도록 할 수 있습니다. 이 특수 처리는 이 능력으로 새로운 아이템에 부적 부착을 사용할 경우 종료됩니다.

name: After You

description.value:
Trigger You're about to roll initiative.

You allow your foes to make the first move in a show of incredible confidence. You don't roll initiative; instead you voluntarily go last. You gain panache. If more than one character uses this ability or another ability to go last, use the normal rules for resolving a tie: NPCs and monsters act before PCs, and within those groups, the creatures can choose whichever order they want.

_desc_en:
Trigger You're about to roll initiative.

You allow your foes to make the first move in a show of incredible confidence. You don't roll initiative; instead you voluntarily go last. You gain panache. If more than one character uses this ability or another ability to go last, use the normal rules for resolving a tie: NPCs and monsters act before PCs, and within those groups, the creatures can choose whichever order they want.
_desc_ko:
발동조건 이니셔티브 주사위를 굴리려는 순간.

당신은 놀라운 자신감을 보여주기 위해 적들이 먼저 행동하도록 허용합니다. 당신은 이니셔티브를 굴리지 않고 자발적으로 마지막에 행동합니다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.uBJsxCzNhje8m8jj]{파나슈}를 얻습니다. 두 명 이상의 캐릭터가 이 능력이나 다른 능력을 사용해 마지막에 행동할 경우, 동점 해결을 위한 일반 규칙을 적용합니다: NPC와 몬스터는 플레이어 캐릭터보다 먼저 행동하며, 해당 그룹 내에서는 생물들이 원하는 순서를 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Unseen Shot

description.value: Your attacks are deadly, silent, and nearly untraceable. The first time each round that you attempt to Strike a target you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9evPzg9E6muFcoSk]{Unnoticed} by while using a weapon you have familiarity with from this archetype, you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from the target after the attack, as they cannot tell where the attack came from.

_desc_en: Your attacks are deadly, silent, and nearly untraceable. The first time each round that you attempt to Strike a target you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9evPzg9E6muFcoSk]{Unnoticed} by while using a weapon you have familiarity with from this archetype, you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from the target after the attack, as they cannot tell where the attack came from.
_desc_ko: 당신의 공격은 치명적이고, 소리 없이 이루어지며, 거의 추적할 수 없습니다. 매 라운드마다 처음으로 타깃에 강타하려고 시도할 때마다 당신은 @link[conditions.undetected] 상태이거나 @link[conditions.unnoticed] 상태가 됩니다. 이 아키타입에서 익숙한 무기를 사용할 경우, 공격 후 대상은 공격이 어디서 왔는지 알 수 없어 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Fox Possession

description.value: You can project a spiritual form to possess another. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wU6hNzK8Yfqdmc8m]{Possession} as an innate divine spell once per day. The target of your possession assumes one or more unusual quirks, such as more angular features or strange food preferences, giving the target a –1 circumstance penalty to their Deception DC when someone uses @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} to see if they're possessed.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You can project a spiritual form to possess another. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wU6hNzK8Yfqdmc8m]{Possession} as an innate divine spell once per day. The target of your possession assumes one or more unusual quirks, such as more angular features or strange food preferences, giving the target a –1 circumstance penalty to their Deception DC when someone uses @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} to see if they're possessed.
_desc_ko: 영적 형태를 투사하여 타인을 점령할 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, 선천적 신성 주문으로 @link[spells.possession]을 시전할 수 있습니다. 빙의 대상은 각진 얼굴 특징이나 이상한 음식 취향 등 하나 이상의 특이한 기질을 가지게 되며, 누군가가 @link[actions.sense-motive]로 빙의 여부를 확인하려 할 때 대상의 기만에 -1 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Oni Weapon Familiarity

description.value:
Oni prefer large, cruel weapons for smashing their foes to pieces, and so do you. For the purposes of proficiency, you treat the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.KgKSX95uVSg8iBBA]{Khakkhara}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.KtarUneAx0hibGtW]{Nodachi}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Oiq3QgLrM4i3W5Hg]{Ogre Hook}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.FjeKuljhpaIiDTI7]{Tetsubo} as simple weapons.

The ogre hook is an uncommon martial weapon that costs 1 gp, deals 1d10 piercing damage, has 2 Bulk, requires two hands to use, is in the pick weapon group, and has the deadly d10 and trip weapon traits.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, or with your horns unarmed Strike, you get its critical specialization effect.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Oni prefer large, cruel weapons for smashing their foes to pieces, and so do you. For the purposes of proficiency, you treat the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.KgKSX95uVSg8iBBA]{Khakkhara}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.KtarUneAx0hibGtW]{Nodachi}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Oiq3QgLrM4i3W5Hg]{Ogre Hook}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.FjeKuljhpaIiDTI7]{Tetsubo} as simple weapons.

The ogre hook is an uncommon martial weapon that costs 1 gp, deals 1d10 piercing damage, has 2 Bulk, requires two hands to use, is in the pick weapon group, and has the deadly d10 and trip weapon traits.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, or with your horns unarmed Strike, you get its critical specialization effect.
_desc_ko:
오니는 적을 산산조각 내기 위해 크고 잔혹한 무기를 선호하며, 당신도 마찬가지다. 숙련도 목적상, 당신은 @link[equipment.khakkhara], @link[equipment.nodachi], @link[equipment.ogre-hook], 그리고 @link[equipment.tetsubo]를 단순 무기로 취급한다.

오우거 훅은 희귀한 무기로, 가격은 1gp이며 1d10 관통 피해를 입히고, 부피는 2 벌크입니다. 양손으로 사용해야 하며, 픽 무기 그룹에 속하고 치명적 d10 및 넘어뜨리기 특성을 지닙니다.

5레벨에 도달하면, 이 무기들 중 하나로 치명타를 기록하거나 뿔을 이용한 비무장 공격으로 치명타를 기록할 때마다 해당 무기의 치명타 특화 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Animal Soul Siblings

description.value: Your eyes have been opened to the spiritual essence suffusing the world. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.BBvV7qoXGdw09q1C]{Speak with Animals} as a primal innate spell that you can cast once per day. You get a +1 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information} from animals.

publication.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

_desc_en: Your eyes have been opened to the spiritual essence suffusing the world. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.BBvV7qoXGdw09q1C]{Speak with Animals} as a primal innate spell that you can cast once per day. You get a +1 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information} from animals.
_desc_ko: 당신의 눈은 세상을 가득 채운 영적 본질에 열렸습니다. @link[spells.speak-with-animals]를 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 얻으며, 하루에 한 번 시전할 수 있습니다. 동물로부터 @link[actions.gather-information]을 위한 외교 기술 판정 시 +1 상황 보너스를 받습니다.

name: Angel of Death

description.value:
All your Strikes against a creature you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.orjJjLdm4XNAcFi8]{Marked for Death} have the death trait, causing the mark to be instantly killed when reduced to 0 Hit Points.

In addition, if the creature is killed this way, attempts to communicate with it, return it to life, turn it into an undead, or otherwise disturb its afterlife fail unless the effect's counteract rank is higher than half your level rounded up, or originates from an artifact or a deity. Use the level you were when you killed the creature, even if your level is higher at the time the attempt was made.

_desc_en:
All your Strikes against a creature you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.orjJjLdm4XNAcFi8]{Marked for Death} have the death trait, causing the mark to be instantly killed when reduced to 0 Hit Points.

In addition, if the creature is killed this way, attempts to communicate with it, return it to life, turn it into an undead, or otherwise disturb its afterlife fail unless the effect's counteract rank is higher than half your level rounded up, or originates from an artifact or a deity. Use the level you were when you killed the creature, even if your level is higher at the time the attempt was made.
_desc_ko:
{죽음의 표식}을 부여한 생물에게 가하는 모든 공격은 죽음 속성을 가지며, 해당 표식이 부여된 생물이 HP가 0이 되면 즉시 사망합니다.

또한, 이 방법으로 생물이 죽었을 경우, 그 생물과 소통하거나, 되살리거나, 언데드로 만들거나, 그 사후 세계를 방해하려는 시도하는 것은 해당 효과의 반격 등급이 당신의 레벨 반올림한 절반보다 높거나, 유물이나 신으로부터 비롯된 것이 아니면 실패한다. 시도가 이루어질 당시 당신의 레벨이 더 높더라도, 생물을 죽였을 당시의 레벨을 사용한다.

name: Opportune Opening

description.value:
Trigger An ally lands a critical hit on a creature within your melee reach.

Your combat training taught you to capitalize on any moment of weakness from your foe. You make a melee Strike against the same creature your ally just hit. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against this Strike

_desc_en:
Trigger An ally lands a critical hit on a creature within your melee reach.

Your combat training taught you to capitalize on any moment of weakness from your foe. You make a melee Strike against the same creature your ally just hit. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against this Strike
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 아군이 근접 공격 범위 내 생물에게 치명타를 성공시킨다.

당신의 전투 훈련은 적의 약점을 놓치지 않도록 가르쳤습니다. 아군이 방금 공격한 동일한 생물에게 근접 공격을 가합니다. 이 생물은 이 공격에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태입니다.

name: Fabricated Credentials

description.value: You're so familiar with the paperwork necessary to maintain your cover that you can easily whip up documents that support your fabrications. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ftG89SjTSa9DYDOD]{Create a Forgery} using [[/act create-forgery skill=deception]]{Deception}, rather than Society, and doing so only takes 10 minutes, or 1 minute if you're legendary in Deception. With your paranoid nature, you're always on the lookout for forgeries. The GM rolls a secret Perception or Society check for you any time you encounter a forgery, even if you don't examine it closely.

_desc_en: You're so familiar with the paperwork necessary to maintain your cover that you can easily whip up documents that support your fabrications. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ftG89SjTSa9DYDOD]{Create a Forgery} using [[/act create-forgery skill=deception]]{Deception}, rather than Society, and doing so only takes 10 minutes, or 1 minute if you're legendary in Deception. With your paranoid nature, you're always on the lookout for forgeries. The GM rolls a secret Perception or Society check for you any time you encounter a forgery, even if you don't examine it closely.
_desc_ko: 당신은 위장을 유지하는 데 필요한 서류에 매우 익숙하여, 자신의 날조를 뒷받침하는 문서를 손쉽게 뚝딱 만들어낼 수 있습니다. 당신은 사회 대신 [[/act create-forgery skill=deception]]{기만}을 사용해 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ftG89SjTSa9DYDOD]{위조품 만들기}를 할 수 있으며, 그렇게 하는 데 10분, 기만에 전설이라면 1분만 걸립니다. 편집증적 기질을 지닌 당신은 항상 위조품을 경계합니다. 당신이 위조품을 마주칠 때마다, 자세히 살펴보지 않더라도 GM이 당신을 위해 비밀 지각 또는 사회 판정을 굴립니다.

name: Shake Off the Gods

description.value:
Requirements You're under an effect with the divine trait that required a saving throw.

Your trust in the Pure Legion rushes forth as you fight off the influence of a god. You can attempt a new saving throw against the required effect with a +2 status bonus to the save. You can't get a worse result than your original saving throw.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're under an effect with the divine trait that required a saving throw.

Your trust in the Pure Legion rushes forth as you fight off the influence of a god. You can attempt a new saving throw against the required effect with a +2 status bonus to the save. You can't get a worse result than your original saving throw.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 당신은 내성 굴림이 필요했던 신성 특성 효과의 영향을 받고 있습니다.

신의 영향력에 맞서 싸우는 동안 순수 군단에 대한 당신의 신뢰가 솟구칩니다. 당신은 그 필요한 효과에 대해 내성에 +2 상태 보너스를 받고 새로운 내성 굴림을 시도할 수 있습니다. 당신은 원래의 내성 굴림보다 나쁜 결과를 얻을 수 없습니다.

name: Alter Ego Dedication

description.value:
You make yourself into a living mirror, becoming a double of someone unremarkable, and you slip into exactly the role that can get you past security or into a sensitive facility. You become an expert in Deception. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lAvEK4yNL3Y7pVmr]{Assume a Role} activity.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.HZHzpATOyhTjUDrR]{Alter Ego}

_desc_en:
You make yourself into a living mirror, becoming a double of someone unremarkable, and you slip into exactly the role that can get you past security or into a sensitive facility. You become an expert in Deception. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lAvEK4yNL3Y7pVmr]{Assume a Role} activity.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.HZHzpATOyhTjUDrR]{Alter Ego}
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신을 살아있는 거울로 만들어 평범한 누군가의 복제체가 되며, 보안 검색을 통과하거나 민감한 시설에 침투할 수 있는 정확한 역할을 수행합니다. 당신은 기만의 전문가가 됩니다. @link[actions.assume-a-role] 활동을 획득합니다.

name: Specialized Companion (Druid)

description.value:
Your animal companion continues to grow in power and ability. It gains one specialization of your choice

Special You can select this feat up to three times. Each time, add a different specialization to your companion.

_desc_en:
Your animal companion continues to grow in power and ability. It gains one specialization of your choice

Special You can select this feat up to three times. Each time, add a different specialization to your companion.
_desc_ko:
당신의 동물 동료는 계속해서 힘과 능력을 키워갑니다. 선택한 하나의 전문화를 획득합니다.

특수 이 피트를 최대 세 번까지 선택할 수 있습니다. 매번 다른 전문화를 동반자에게 부여합니다.

name: Conscious Spell Specialization

description.value: You become more adept with the spells that are always in your mind. You gain an additional spell slot of 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 4th ranks. You can use these spell slots to cast only a spell granted by your conscious mind. At 18th level, you also gain an additional 5th-rank spell slot, with the same restrictions.

_desc_en: You become more adept with the spells that are always in your mind. You gain an additional spell slot of 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 4th ranks. You can use these spell slots to cast only a spell granted by your conscious mind. At 18th level, you also gain an additional 5th-rank spell slot, with the same restrictions.
_desc_ko: 당신은 항상 마음속에 간직한 주문들을 더욱 능숙하게 다루게 됩니다. 1, 2, 3, 4레벨 주문 슬롯을 각각 하나씩 추가로 얻습니다. 이 주문 슬롯은 의식적으로 부여받은 주문만 시전할 수 있습니다. 18레벨에 도달하면 동일한 제한이 적용되는 (5th)레벨 주문 슬롯을 추가로 얻습니다.

name: Dragon's Rage Breath

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You breathe deeply and exhale powerful energy in a @Template[cone|distance:30], dealing @Damage[(@actor.level)d6[@actor.flags.system.barbarian.instinct.dragon.damageType]|options:area-damage] damage to each creature in the area with a @Check[reflex|against:barbarian|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. The damage type matches your instinct's dragon breath, and this action gains the trait of your dragon instinct's tradition.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You breathe deeply and exhale powerful energy in a @Template[cone|distance:30], dealing @Damage[(@actor.level)d6[@actor.flags.system.barbarian.instinct.dragon.damageType]|options:area-damage] damage to each creature in the area with a @Check[reflex|against:barbarian|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. The damage type matches your instinct's dragon breath, and this action gains the trait of your dragon instinct's tradition.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 10분에 한 번

깊게 숨을 들이쉬고 30피트 방향으로 강력한 에너지를 내뿜어, 해당 영역 내 모든 생물에게 기본 반사 내성(당신의 직업 DC 기준)을 요구하며 의 피해를 입힙니다. 피해 유형은 당신의 본능에 따른 드래곤의 숨결과 일치하며, 이 행동은 당신의 용 본능 전통 특성을 획득합니다.

name: Call the First Tools

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You can call upon the ancient powers bestowed on you by the gods to create any tools you might need at a moment's notice. You conjure forth a simple tool, such as a shovel or hammer, into your hands. This tool remains conjured until your next daily preparations so long as it's on your person. If the tool leaves your possession for more than 1 minute, it falls apart into a pile of silk that then dissolves into nothingness.

At 9th level, you can use this ability once per hour instead of once per day. When using it in this way, you can maintain only one tool at a time; any previous tool you conjured dissolves into nothingness.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You can call upon the ancient powers bestowed on you by the gods to create any tools you might need at a moment's notice. You conjure forth a simple tool, such as a shovel or hammer, into your hands. This tool remains conjured until your next daily preparations so long as it's on your person. If the tool leaves your possession for more than 1 minute, it falls apart into a pile of silk that then dissolves into nothingness.

At 9th level, you can use this ability once per hour instead of once per day. When using it in this way, you can maintain only one tool at a time; any previous tool you conjured dissolves into nothingness.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

신들이 부여한 고대의 힘을 불러내어 필요한 도구를 순식간에 창조할 수 있습니다. 손에 삽이나 망치 같은 간단한 도구를 소환합니다. 이 도구는 몸에 지니고 있는 한 다음 일일 준비 시간까지 소환된 상태로 유지됩니다. 도구가 1분 이상 소유자의 손에서 벗어나면 실크 더미로 분해된 후 허공으로 사라집니다.

9레벨에 도달하면 이 능력을 하루에 한 번이 아닌 시간당 한 번 사용할 수 있습니다. 이 방식으로 사용할 경우 한 번에 하나의 도구만 유지할 수 있으며, 이전에 소환한 도구는 모두 허공으로 사라집니다.

name: Green Empathy

description.value:
You can communicate with plants and fungi on a basic level and use Diplomacy to Make an Impression on them and to make very simple Requests of them. Non-creature plants and fungi typically can't fulfill most requests you might ask of them unless you have access to other magic such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qvwIwJ9QBihy8R0t]{Speak with Plants}.

Because of your affiliation with the leaf order, plants and fungi have a sense that you support them, so you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your check to Make a Request of a plant or fungus using Green Empathy.

_desc_en:
You can communicate with plants and fungi on a basic level and use Diplomacy to Make an Impression on them and to make very simple Requests of them. Non-creature plants and fungi typically can't fulfill most requests you might ask of them unless you have access to other magic such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qvwIwJ9QBihy8R0t]{Speak with Plants}.

Because of your affiliation with the leaf order, plants and fungi have a sense that you support them, so you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your check to Make a Request of a plant or fungus using Green Empathy.
_desc_ko:
당신은 식물 및 균류와 기초적인 수준으로 소통할 수 있으며, 외교 기술로 그들에게 인상을 남기거나 매우 간단한 요청을 할 수 있습니다. 생물이 아닌 식물과 균류는 일반적으로 @link[spells.speak-with-plants]와 같은 다른 마법을 사용할 수 없는 한, 당신이 요청하는 대부분의 일을 수행할 수 없습니다.

잎의 계급과의 유대감 덕분에 식물과 균류는 당신이 그들을 지지한다는 느낌을 받습니다. 따라서 녹색 공감으로 식물이나 균류에게 요청을 할 때 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Witch's Broom

description.value:
A broom is the only steed you need to fly through the night sky. During your daily preparations, you can anoint a single broom, staff, polearm, or similarly shaped object with a flying ointment made of special herbs and oils. Until the next time you make your daily preparations, it gains the magical trait, and you can ride on it while you're holding it with at least 1 hand. It moves at a fly Speed of 20 feet. The broom takes a –10-foot penalty to its Speed if laden with more than 20 Bulk, and crashes to the ground if it carries more than 30 Bulk. The broom can't be controlled by anyone but you. If you anoint a weapon or other held item, you can't ride the broom and wield it at the same time.

You can Craft your broomstick into a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.1erd18HS57aCyC6r]{Flying Broomstick} as though you had the formula for that item. If you anoint an item that's already a flying broomstick, the broom gains a +10-foot status bonus to its Speed and you can choose whether it works for anyone or only you.

_desc_ko:
밤하늘을 날아다니기 위해 필요한 유일한 탈것은 빗자루입니다. 일일 준비 시간 동안, 특별한 허브와 기름으로 만든 비행 연고를 빗자루, 지팡이, 장창 또는 유사한 모양의 물체 하나에 바를 수 있습니다. 다음 일일 준비 시간까지 해당 물체는 마법적 특성을 얻으며, 최소 한 손으로 잡고 있을 때 탑승할 수 있습니다. 비행 속도는 20피트입니다. 빗자루는 20 벌크 이상의 짐을 싣고 이동할 경우 이동 속도에 -10피트 페널티를 받으며, 30 벌크 이상을 싣고 이동할 경우 땅에 추락합니다. 빗자루는 당신 외에는 누구도 조종할 수 없습니다. 무기나 다른 손에 든 물건에 발라주면, 빗자루를 타고 이동하면서 동시에 그 물건을 휘두를 수 없습니다.

당신은 빗자루를 @link[equipment.flying-broomstick]로 제작할 수 있으며, 이는 해당 아이템의 제작법을 가진 것과 동일합니다. 이미 비행 빗자루인 아이템에 기름을 바르면, 빗자루의 이동 속도에 +10피트 상태 보너스가 적용되며, 누구나 사용할 수 있도록 할지 아니면 당신만 사용할 수 있도록 할지 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Fatal Aria

description.value: Your songs overwhelm the target with unbearable emotion, potentially striking them dead on the spot. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lyJDBD9OFW11vLyT]{Fatal Aria} composition spell.

_desc_en: Your songs overwhelm the target with unbearable emotion, potentially striking them dead on the spot. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lyJDBD9OFW11vLyT]{Fatal Aria} composition spell.
_desc_ko: 당신의 노래가 대상에게 견딜 수 없는 감정을 쏟아부어, 그 자리에서 강타하여 즉사시킬 수 있습니다. 당신은 @link[spells.fatal-aria] 작곡 주문을 배웁니다.

name: Caustic Nectar

description.value:
You have specialized glands inside your throat, which produce acidic nectar that you can spit long distances. You gain a nectar ranged unarmed attack with a range increment of 20 feet that deals 1d4 acid damage. On a critical hit, the target is additionally @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. Your nectar doesn't add critical specialization effects. You're immune to your own nectar.

Special This feat gains the trait for your ancestry.

value.value: ardande trait, plant trait, or wood trait

Special This feat gains the trait for your ancestry.
_desc_ko:
목구멍 내부에 특수한 샘이 있어 산성 넥타를 생성하며, 이를 거리로 뱉어낼 수 있습니다. 20피트 사거리의 꿀 원거리 비무장 공격을 얻으며, 1d4 산성 피해를 입힙니다. 치명타 시 대상은 추가로 @link[conditions.sickened]{1} 상태가 됩니다. 당신의 꿀은 치명타 특화 효과를 추가하지 않습니다. 당신은 자신의 꿀에 면역입니다.

특수 이 피트는 당신의 혈통에 대한 특성을 부여합니다.

name: Syu Tak-nwa's Hexed Locks

description.value: Your hair unarmed attack gains the reach trait. You can deliver hexes through your hair. When you successfully cast a hex focus spell that requires 2 or more actions to cast and that doesn't require a spell attack roll, if your target is within your reach, as part of the spellcasting activity you can make a hair Strike against the foe before applying any effects of the hex. If this Strike misses, the hex has no effect.

_desc_en: Your hair unarmed attack gains the reach trait. You can deliver hexes through your hair. When you successfully cast a hex focus spell that requires 2 or more actions to cast and that doesn't require a spell attack roll, if your target is within your reach, as part of the spellcasting activity you can make a hair Strike against the foe before applying any effects of the hex. If this Strike misses, the hex has no effect.
_desc_ko: 당신의 머리카락 비무장 공격은 도달 범위 특성을 얻습니다. 당신은 머리카락을 통해 저주를 전달할 수 있습니다. 2개 이상의 행동이 필요하고 명중 굴림이 필요하지 않은 저주 포커스 주문을 성공적으로 시전할 때, 대상이 당신의 도달 범위 내에 있다면, 주문 시전 활동의 일부로 저주의 효과를 적용하기 전에 적에게 머리카락 공격을 가할 수 있습니다. 이 공격이 빗나간다면 저주는 효과가 없습니다.

name: Dance of the Tiger

description.value:
Tales tell of the Tiger stalking the Mousedeer for days, hidden and instilling dread upon its prey. Your dance embodies the character role so well you can trail an opponent from its own shadow. Attempt a @Check[performance|against:will] check against the Will DC of a single adjacent enemy.

Critical Success You step on the foe's shadow, bringing a cold dread. The opponent is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}; its shadow remains pinned underfoot, stretching and deforming to remain connected to your square, and indicates where it has gone even if you lose sight of the foe. The creature can't reduce its frightened condition below 1 as long as you remain on its shadow. Your connection to its shadow breaks if the distance between you and the target exceeds 120 feet or if you don't end your turn adjacent to the target. Once your connection to its shadow breaks, the enemy is immune to Dance of the Tiger for 1 hour.

Success As critical success, except the creature is only @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} and your connection to its shadow breaks at 60 feet instead of 120.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_ko:
전설에 따르면 호랑이는 쥐사슴을 며칠 동안 숨어서 추적하며 먹잇감에게 공포를 심어준다고 한다. 당신의 춤은 그 역할을 너무나 잘 구현하여 상대의 그림자 속에서 그들을 추적할 수 있다. 인접한 적 한 명의 의지 DC에 대해 공연 판정을 시도한다.

대성공 당신은 적의 그림자를 밟아 차가운 공포를 불러일으킨다. 상대는 @link[conditions.frightened]{2}가 된다. 그 그림자는 발밑에 고정된 채로 늘어나고 뒤틀리며 네 칸과 연결된 상태를 유지하며, 적을 시야에서 잃어도 그 위치를 알려준다. 네가 그 그림자 위에 머무는 한, 그 생물은 공포 상태를 1 이하로 낮출 수 없다. 당신과 대상 사이의 거리가 120피트를 초과하거나, 턴을 대상과 인접한 상태로 종료하지 않으면 그림자와의 연결이 끊어집니다. 연결이 끊어지면 적들은 1시간 동안 호랑이 춤에 면역이 됩니다.

성공 대성공과 동일하나, 대상은 @link[conditions.frightened]{1} 상태만 되며 그림자 연결은 120피트가 아닌 60피트에서 끊어집니다.

name: Viking Vindicator

description.value: You are one of the raiders eagerly planning to launch an assault by sea on the Whispering Tyrant's Isle of Terror. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.qQt3CMrhLkUV1wCv]{Sudden Charge} fighter feat, though it's a viking feat for you instead. As normal when gaining an additional feat from an archetype feat, gaining Sudden Charge doesn't count toward fulfilling the special requirement for Viking Dedication. If you already had Sudden Charge, you can retrain it as part of gaining this feat. When you use Sudden Charge to Strike a target in shallow water, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against your Strike, as you use the water kicked up by your passage to camouflage your angle of attack. If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.j9Rp4fOZIxizyvYy]{Viking Weapon Familiarity} or Viking Weapon Specialist, add the bastard sword and rapier to the list of weapons in those feats.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.qQt3CMrhLkUV1wCv]{Sudden Charge} fighter feat, though it's a viking feat for you instead.
