If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.j9Rp4fOZIxizyvYy]{Viking Weapon Familiarity} or Viking Weapon Specialist, add the bastard sword and rapier to the list of weapons in those feats.
_desc_ko: 당신은 속삭이는 폭군의 공포의 섬을 해상으로 공격할 계획을 세우는 약탈자 중 한 명입니다. @link[feats.sudden-charge] 파이터 피트를 얻지만, 당신에게는 바이킹 피트로 적용됩니다. 아키타입 재주로 추가 피트를 획득할 때와 마찬가지로, 갑작스러운 돌격 획득은 바이킹 헌신의 특수 요구 사항 충족에 포함되지 않습니다. 이미 갑작스러운 돌격을 보유하고 있다면, 이 피트 획득 과정에서 재훈련할 수 있습니다. 갑작스러운 돌격을 사용하여 얕은 물속의 대상을 공격할 때, 대상은 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다. 이는 당신이 지나가며 일으킨 물보라로 공격 각도를 위장했기 때문입니다. @link[feats.viking-weapon-familiarity] 또는 바이킹 무기 전문가 재주를 보유한 경우, 해당 재주에서 다루는 무기 목록에 배스터드 소드와 레이피어를 추가합니다.

name: Counter Curse

description.value:
Trigger You or an ally within 30 feet is targeted by or in the emanation of a curse or misfortune effect from an opponent or object of which you're aware.

Requirements You're in a curse maelstrom state.

You gather the energy of your maelstrom and fling its unleashed power into the enemy's curse, attempting to neutralize it. Attempt a counteract check against the triggering effect, using half your level rounded up as your counteract rank and the higher of your class DC – 10 or spell DC – 10 as the counteract modifier. On a success, you neutralize the curse or misfortune effect. If the effect was constant, such as a misfortune aura, it returns automatically at the beginning of the creature or object's next turn. Whether you succeed or fail, your curse maelstrom state ends.

_desc_en:
Trigger You or an ally within 30 feet is targeted by or in the emanation of a curse or misfortune effect from an opponent or object of which you're aware.

Requirements You're in a curse maelstrom state.

You gather the energy of your maelstrom and fling its unleashed power into the enemy's curse, attempting to neutralize it. Attempt a counteract check against the triggering effect, using half your level rounded up as your counteract rank and the higher of your class DC – 10 or spell DC – 10 as the counteract modifier. On a success, you neutralize the curse or misfortune effect. If the effect was constant, such as a misfortune aura, it returns automatically at the beginning of the creature or object's next turn. Whether you succeed or fail, your curse maelstrom state ends.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 저주 소용돌이 상태에 있어야 합니다.

발동 조건 당신이나 30피트 내의 아군이 당신이 인지하는 적이나 사물로부터 저주나 불운 효과의 표적이 되거나 그 영향권 내에 있을 때.

당신은 소용돌이의 에너지를 모아 그 해방된 힘을 적의 저주에 내던져 중화시키려 합니다. 유발 효과에 대해 반격 판정을 시도하세요. 당신의 레벨 절반(올림)을 반격 랭크으로, 당신의 클래스 DC와 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽을 반격 수정자로 사용합니다. 성공 시 저주나 불운 효과를 중화시킨다. 불운 오라처럼 지속 효과였던 경우, 해당 생물이나 물체의 다음 턴 시작 시 자동으로 재발동한다. 성공 여부와 상관없이 저주 소용돌이 상태는 종료된다.

name: Everstand Strike

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a shield in two hands.

Your follow-up blow leaves you an opening to set your shield. Make a Strike with the wielded shield. If the Strike hits and deals damage, you also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xjGwis0uaC2305pm]{Raise your Shield}.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a shield in two hands.

Your follow-up blow leaves you an opening to set your shield. Make a Strike with the wielded shield. If the Strike hits and deals damage, you also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xjGwis0uaC2305pm]{Raise your Shield}.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손으로 방패를 들고 있어야 합니다.

후속 타격으로 방패를 설정할 수 있는 틈이 생깁니다. 들고 있는 방패로 공격을 가하세요. 강타가 적중하여 피해를 입혔다면, 동시에 @link[actions.raise-a-shield].

name: Wheedle and Jig

description.value: You make capering motions and silly sounds to captivate onlookers. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IihxWhRfpsBgQ5jS]{Enthrall} as a 3rd-rank arcane innate spell once per day.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en: You make capering motions and silly sounds to captivate onlookers. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IihxWhRfpsBgQ5jS]{Enthrall} as a 3rd-rank arcane innate spell once per day.
_desc_ko: 당신은 춤추는 동작과 우스꽝스러운 소리로 구경꾼들을 사로잡습니다. 하루에 한 번, (3rd) 아케인 내재 마법인 @link[spells.enthrall]을 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Kaleidoscopic Entreaty

description.value:
If your next action is to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Yph1UqZU8vMc9bJG]{Entreat Spirit}, you can cause that spirit to unleash a brilliant display of color, light, and sound in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] centered on you. Each creature in the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC with the following results.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is dazzled for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round and dazzled for 1 minute.

_desc_en:
If your next action is to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Yph1UqZU8vMc9bJG]{Entreat Spirit}, you can cause that spirit to unleash a brilliant display of color, light, and sound in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] centered on you. Each creature in the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC with the following results.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is dazzled for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round and dazzled for 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
다음 행동이 @link[spells.entreat-spirit] 시전인 경우, 해당 영혼이 당신을 중심으로 한 10피트 발산 범위 내에서 화려한 색채, 빛, 소리의 향연을 펼치게 할 수 있습니다. 해당 영역 내 모든 생물은 당신의 직업 난이도(DC) 또는 주문 DC에 대한 인내 내성을 시도해야 하며, 결과는 다음과 같습니다.

대성공 생물은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 생물은 @link[conditions.dazzled] 상태가 되어 1라운드 동안 지속됩니다.

실패 생물은 1분 동안 눈부심 상태가 됩니다.

대실패 해당 생물은 @link[conditions.blinded] 상태가 1라운드 지속되고 눈부심 상태가 1분간 지속됩니다.

name: Gnome Weapon Familiarity

description.value:
You favor unusual weapons tied to your people, such as blades with curved and peculiar shapes. You gain access to kukris and all uncommon weapons with the gnome trait. You have familiarity with weapons with the gnome trait plus the glaive and kukri—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

_desc_en:
You favor unusual weapons tied to your people, such as blades with curved and peculiar shapes. You gain access to kukris and all uncommon weapons with the gnome trait. You have familiarity with weapons with the gnome trait plus the glaive and kukri—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
_desc_ko:
당신은 고블린 종족과 연관된 특이한 무기, 예를 들어 휘어진 독특한 형태의 칼날을 선호합니다. 쿠크리와 노움 특성을 지닌 모든 희귀 무기를 사용할 수 있게 됩니다. 너는 노움 특성을 가진 무기 외에도 글레이브와 쿠크리에 익숙하다. 숙련도 목적상, 이 중 무술 무기인 것은 단순 무기로, 고급 무기인 것은 무술 무기로 취급한다.

5레벨에 도달하면, 이 무기들로 치명타를 기록할 때마다 해당 무기의 치명타 특화 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Towering Transformation

description.value:
Trigger Your size increases due to a polymorph effect.

The physical growth of your transformation is a spectacle that shakes foes to their core. Each enemy smaller than your new size within 30 feet of you must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell|options:area-effect,inflicts:frightened] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}, and you can push it up to 10 feet from you. This is forced movement.

_desc_en:
Trigger Your size increases due to a polymorph effect.

The physical growth of your transformation is a spectacle that shakes foes to their core. Each enemy smaller than your new size within 30 feet of you must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell|options:area-effect,inflicts:frightened] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}, and you can push it up to 10 feet from you. This is forced movement.
_desc_ko:
발동 변형 효과로 인해 당신의 크기가 증가합니다.

변신으로 인한 신체적 성장은 적들을 공포에 떨게 하는 장관입니다. 30피트 내의 적 중 새로운 크기보다 작은 모든 적은 의지 귀하의 직업 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 더 높은 쪽에 대한 저항 검사를 시도해야 합니다.

성공 시 해당 생물은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

실패 생물은 @link[conditions.frightened]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

대실패 생물은 @link[conditions.frightened]{2} 상태가 되며, 당신은 그 생물을 최대 10피트까지 밀어낼 수 있습니다. 이는 강제 이동입니다.

name: Sand Snatcher

description.value:
A figure of sand with grasping arms arises in an unoccupied square within 30 feet. You can choose to make it Small or Medium size, and it can flank. When the sand snatcher appears, you can have it attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} one creature adjacent to it that's no more than one size larger than it. This Grapple uses your impulse attack roll instead of an Athletics check and shares your multiple attack penalty. The sand snatcher lasts until the end of your next turn, and you can Sustain the impulse up to 1 minute. Each time you Sustain the impulse, you can have the sand snatcher either Grapple again or Burrow, Climb, or Stride up to 20 feet. Attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} its grasp use your class DC.

Level (10th) You can also choose Large size.

Level (14th) You can also choose Large or Huge size.

_desc_en:
A figure of sand with grasping arms arises in an unoccupied square within 30 feet. You can choose to make it Small or Medium size, and it can flank. When the sand snatcher appears, you can have it attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} one creature adjacent to it that's no more than one size larger than it. This Grapple uses your impulse attack roll instead of an Athletics check and shares your multiple attack penalty. The sand snatcher lasts until the end of your next turn, and you can Sustain the impulse up to 1 minute. Each time you Sustain the impulse, you can have the sand snatcher either Grapple again or Burrow, Climb, or Stride up to 20 feet. Attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} its grasp use your class DC.

Level (10th) You can also choose Large size.

Level (14th) You can also choose Large or Huge size.
_desc_ko:
30피트 이내의 비어 있는 칸에 팔을 뻗은 모래 형상이 나타난다. 모래잡이의 크기를 소형 또는 중형으로 선택할 수 있으며, 측면 공격이 가능하다. 모래잡이가 나타날 때, 그와 인접한 크기가 자신보다 한 단계 이상 크지 않은 생물 한 마리를 @link[actions.grapple]하도록 시도할 수 있다. 이 잡기 시도는 운동 판정 대신 당신의 임펄스 명중 굴림을 사용하며, 다중 공격 페널티를 공유한다. 모래잡이는 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 지속되며, 최대 1분 동안 임펄스 공격을 유지할 수 있다. 임펄스 공격을 유지할 때마다 모래잡이가 다시 붙잡기하거나, 땅속 파기, 등반, 최대 20피트까지 이동하도록 할 수 있다. 그 붙잡기에서 @link[actions.escape]을 시도하다(시도하다)면 네 직업 난이도(DC)를 사용한다.

레벨 (10th) 대형 크기를 선택할 수도 있습니다.

레벨 (14급) 대형 또는 초대형 크기도 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Weakening Assault

description.value: With a barrage of blows, you diminish an enemy's strength. Strike an enemy affected by your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.4DYFJ4TUsNkgFBDb]{Taunt} twice. If either Strike hits, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the beginning of your next turn. If both Strikes hit, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3} instead.

_desc_en: With a barrage of blows, you diminish an enemy's strength. Strike an enemy affected by your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.4DYFJ4TUsNkgFBDb]{Taunt} twice. If either Strike hits, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the beginning of your next turn. If both Strikes hit, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3} instead.
_desc_ko: 연속적인 강타로 적의 힘을 약화시킵니다. 당신의 @link[actions.taunt]에 걸린 적을 두 번 강타합니다. 두 공격 중 하나라도 적중하면, 대상은 다음 차례 시작까지 @link[conditions.enfeebled]{1} 상태가 됩니다. 두 공격 모두 적중하면, 대상은 대신 @link[conditions.enfeebled]{3} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Adaptive Stratagem

description.value:
Trigger You roll initiative.

Your constant training and strong bond with your allies allow you to change tactics on the fly. Replace one of your prepared expert, mobility, or offensive tactics with another tactic in your folio.

_desc_en:
Trigger You roll initiative.

Your constant training and strong bond with your allies allow you to change tactics on the fly. Replace one of your prepared expert, mobility, or offensive tactics with another tactic in your folio.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신이 인니셔티브를 굴립니다.

끊임없는 훈련과 동료들과의 강한 유대감 덕분에 전술을 즉석에서 변경할 수 있습니다. 준비한 전문가, 기동성, 공격 전술 중 하나를 포트폴리오에 있는 다른 전술로 대체하세요.

name: Enshroud Soul Cage

description.value: You wreathe your soul cage in an ever-growing collection of obfuscating illusions and protective abjurations to hide it from your enemies. You disguise the soul cage as any non-magical object of the same Bulk, and it gains the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PRrZ7anETWPm90YY]{Disguise Magic} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EoKBlgf6Smt8opaU]{Veil of Privacy} spells. The effects have unlimited durations, are heightened to half your level rounded up, and use your spell DC against any attempt to counteract them. The magic aura makes your soul cage appear non-magical. You can ignore the effects of any of these spells when dealing with your own soul cage. You are mentally alerted whenever your soul cage is damaged.

_desc_en: You wreathe your soul cage in an ever-growing collection of obfuscating illusions and protective abjurations to hide it from your enemies. You disguise the soul cage as any non-magical object of the same Bulk, and it gains the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PRrZ7anETWPm90YY]{Disguise Magic} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EoKBlgf6Smt8opaU]{Veil of Privacy} spells. The effects have unlimited durations, are heightened to half your level rounded up, and use your spell DC against any attempt to counteract them. The magic aura makes your soul cage appear non-magical. You can ignore the effects of any of these spells when dealing with your own soul cage. You are mentally alerted whenever your soul cage is damaged.
_desc_ko: 당신은 영혼의 감옥을 점점 더 많은 혼란의 환상과 보호의 저주 마법으로 감싸 적들로부터 숨깁니다. 영혼의 감옥을 동일한 벌크의 비마법적 물체로 위장하며, @link[spells.disguise-magic]과 @link[spells.veil-of-privacy] 주문의 효과를 얻습니다. 이 효과들은 지속 시간이 무제한이며, 당신의 레벨의 반(반올림)까지 강화되고, 이를 반격하려는 시도에 대해 당신의 주문 DC가 적용됩니다. 마법 오라로 인해 영혼의 감옥은 비마법적으로 보입니다. 자신의 영혼의 감옥을 다룰 때는 이 주문들의 효과를 무시할 수 있습니다. 영혼의 감옥이 피해받을 때마다 정신적으로 경고를 받습니다.

name: Faithful Stride

description.value:
Requirements You are riding your mount.

Confident in your faith, you Command an Animal to order your mount to Stride up to twice its Speed (or up to three times its Speed if you used 3 actions for Faithful Stride). During this movement, your mount can Stride across liquid and other surfaces that don't support its weight. If your mount ends its movement on a surface that can't support it, your mount (and you) fall in or it collapses as normal.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are riding your mount.

Confident in your faith, you Command an Animal to order your mount to Stride up to twice its Speed (or up to three times its Speed if you used 3 actions for Faithful Stride). During this movement, your mount can Stride across liquid and other surfaces that don't support its weight. If your mount ends its movement on a surface that can't support it, your mount (and you) fall in or it collapses as normal.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 탈것을 타고 있습니다.

믿음에 대한 확신을 바탕으로, 당신은 동물에게 명령하여 탈것을 최대 두 배의 속도(또는 충실한 걸음에 3개의 행동을 사용한 경우 최대 세 배의 속도)로 이동하게 합니다. 이 이동 중 탈것은 액체나 체중을 지탱하지 못하는 다른 표면 위를 이동할 수 있습니다. 탈것이 이동을 체중을 지탱하지 못하는 표면에서 끝내면, 탈것(과 당신)은 평소처럼 그 안으로 빠지거나 무너집니다.

name: Legendary Performer

description.value: Your fame has spread throughout the lands. Creatures who have any listed skill in Society have heard of you and usually have an attitude toward you one step better than normal, depending on your reputation and the creature's disposition. For instance, if you're well-known for cruel and demanding behavior, creatures might be intimidated by you, rather than be friendly toward you. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income} with Performance, you attract higher-level audiences than your location would allow, as audiences flock to see you. For instance, rulers and angels might travel to your small tower in the woods to hear you perform. Typically, this increases the audiences available to your level or by two levels, whichever is higher.

_desc_en: Your fame has spread throughout the lands. Creatures who have any listed skill in Society have heard of you and usually have an attitude toward you one step better than normal, depending on your reputation and the creature's disposition. For instance, if you're well-known for cruel and demanding behavior, creatures might be intimidated by you, rather than be friendly toward you. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income} with Performance, you attract higher-level audiences than your location would allow, as audiences flock to see you. For instance, rulers and angels might travel to your small tower in the woods to hear you perform. Typically, this increases the audiences available to your level or by two levels, whichever is higher.
_desc_ko: 당신의 명성은 온 땅에 퍼져 있습니다. 사회 기술 중 하나라도 가진 생물들은 당신에 대해 들어본 적이 있으며, 당신의 평판과 생물의 성향에 따라 보통보다 한 단계 우호적인 태도를 보입니다. 예를 들어, 잔혹하고 까다로운 행동으로 유명하다면 생물들은 당신에게 친근하게 다가오기보다는 위축될 수 있습니다. 공연으로 @link[actions.earn-income] 경우, 관객들이 당신을 보려고 몰려들기 때문에 위치가 허용하는 것보다 더 높은 레벨의 관객을 끌어모읍니다. 예를 들어 통치자나 천사들이 숲속의 작은 탑까지 찾아와 당신의 공연을 감상할 수 있습니다. 일반적으로 이는 당신의 레벨에 해당하는 관객 또는 두 레벨 위의 관객 중 더 높은 쪽으로 관객 규모를 증가시킵니다.

name: Not So Fast!

description.value:
Trigger A creature within your reach leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Requirements You are in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.UKXaMhb9qlPYw1HD]{Hampering Stance}.

You lash out when foes try to get past you, possibly stopping them in their tracks. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. The Strike gains the following additional results.

Critical Success The target's movement is disrupted.

Success The target takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speed for the rest of its triggering movement. This penalty might cause the triggering creature's movement to end immediately based on its affected Speed.

Failure As success, but the target instead takes a –5-foot circumstance penalty to its Speed.

Critical Failure The target is unaffected.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature within your reach leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Requirements You are in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.UKXaMhb9qlPYw1HD]{Hampering Stance}.

You lash out when foes try to get past you, possibly stopping them in their tracks. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. The Strike gains the following additional results.

Critical Success The target's movement is disrupted.

Success The target takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speed for the rest of its triggering movement. This penalty might cause the triggering creature's movement to end immediately based on its affected Speed.

Failure As success, but the target instead takes a –5-foot circumstance penalty to its Speed.

Critical Failure The target is unaffected.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신의 도달 범위 내에 있는 생물이 이동 행동을 사용하며 한 칸을 떠날 때.

요건 당신은 @link[feats.hampering-stance]를 취하고 있다.

적들이 당신을 지나가려 할 때, 당신은 휘둘러 공격하며 그들을 제자리에서 멈출 수 있습니다. 유발한 생물에게 근접 공격을 수행하십시오. 이 공격은 다음과 같은 추가 결과를 얻습니다.

대성공 대상의 이동이 방해받습니다.

성공 시 대상은 발동한 이동이 끝날 때까지 이동 속도에 -10피트 상황 페널티를 받습니다. 이 페널티로 인해 발동한 생물의 이동이 영향을 받은 속도에 따라 즉시 종료될 수 있습니다.

실패 성공과 동일하나, 대상은 대신 이동 속도에 -5피트 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

대실패 대상은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

name: Revelation's Focus

description.value: The further extents of your mystery provide an endless wellspring of magic. When you Refocus, you regain all your Focus Points instead of 1.

_desc_en: The further extents of your mystery provide an endless wellspring of magic. When you Refocus, you regain all your Focus Points instead of 1.
_desc_ko: 당신의 신비로운 힘은 끝없는 마법의 원천이 됩니다. 재집중 시, 1점이 아닌 모든 포커스를 회복합니다.

name: Histrionic Injury

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger A creature you can see damages you with a melee Strike.

You respond with a startled look, dramatic pratfall, or theatrical arm-flailing that stymies your attacker. The attacker must succeed at a Will saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} on a critical failure).

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger A creature you can see damages you with a melee Strike.

You respond with a startled look, dramatic pratfall, or theatrical arm-flailing that stymies your attacker. The attacker must succeed at a Will saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} on a critical failure).
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

발동 조건 시야 내에 있는 생물이 근접 공격으로 당신에게 피해를 입힐 때.

당신은 깜짝 놀란 표정, 극적인 넘어짐, 또는 공격자를 당황하게 하는 연극적인 팔 휘두르기로 대응합니다. 공격자는 네 직업 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 더 높은 쪽에 대한 의지 내성 굴림에서 성공해야 하며, 실패 시 @link[conditions.stupefied]{1}이 된다(@link[conditions.stupefied]{2}).

name: Oath of the Avenger

description.value:
You've sworn an oath to punish wicked acts you witness. You gain the edict "hunt down those who have harmed innocents or committed heinous atrocities." When you see a creature harm an ally, an innocent, or a noncombatant, you can invoke your oath against that creature. Like speaking, this doesn't require an action. Most champions choose to invoke these oaths out loud if they're able. The invocation lasts indefinitely, though you can choose to end if you are satisfied that the target has reformed, atoned, or been forgiven.

You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zNN9212H2FGfM7VS]{Lay on Hands} to damage a creature you have invoked your oath against as if it were undead; in this case, lay on hands deals spirit damage instead of vitality damage, gains the spirit trait, and loses the vitality trait. This doesn't prevent you from healing such a creature with lay on hands if you so choose.

_desc_en:
You've sworn an oath to punish wicked acts you witness. You gain the edict "hunt down those who have harmed innocents or committed heinous atrocities." When you see a creature harm an ally, an innocent, or a noncombatant, you can invoke your oath against that creature. Like speaking, this doesn't require an action. Most champions choose to invoke these oaths out loud if they're able. The invocation lasts indefinitely, though you can choose to end if you are satisfied that the target has reformed, atoned, or been forgiven.

You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zNN9212H2FGfM7VS]{Lay on Hands} to damage a creature you have invoked your oath against as if it were undead; in this case, lay on hands deals spirit damage instead of vitality damage, gains the spirit trait, and loses the vitality trait. This doesn't prevent you from healing such a creature with lay on hands if you so choose.
_desc_ko:
당신은 목격한 악행을 처벌하겠다고 맹세했습니다. "무고한 자를 해치거나 잔혹한 만행을 저지른 자들을 추적하라"는 칙령을 얻습니다. 동료, 무고한 자, 비전투원이 생물에게 해를 입는 것을 목격할 때, 그 생물에게 맹세를 발동할 수 있습니다. 말하기와 마찬가지로 행동을 소모하지 않습니다. 대부분의 전사는 가능하면 이 맹세를 소리 내어 발동합니다. 발동은 영구적으로 지속되나, 대상이 개과천선하거나 속죄하거나 용서받았다고 판단되면 종료할 수 있습니다.

맹세를 발동한 대상에게 @link[spells.lay-on-hands]를 사용하면 언데드처럼 피해를 줄 수 있다. 이 경우 안수치료은 활력 피해 대신 영혼 피해를 입히며, 영혼 속성을 얻고 활력 속성을 잃는다. 이것은 당신이 원한다면 안수치료로 그러한 생물을 치유하는 것을 막지 않습니다.

name: Feed on Pain

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You deal mental damage.

The psychic feedback of another creature's pain fills you with false life. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the mental damage you dealt from the triggering effect. If the triggering action dealt mental damage to multiple creatures, calculate these temporary Hit Points using the creature that took the most damage. You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You deal mental damage.

The psychic feedback of another creature's pain fills you with false life. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the mental damage you dealt from the triggering effect. If the triggering action dealt mental damage to multiple creatures, calculate these temporary Hit Points using the creature that took the most damage. You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

발동 조건 정신 피해를 입힐 때.

다른 생물의 고통이 주는 사이킥 피드백이 당신을 거짓 생명으로 채웁니다. 발동 효과로 가한 정신 피해의 절반에 해당하는 임시 HP를 얻습니다. 발동 행동이 여러 생물에게 정신 피해를 입혔다면, 가장 많은 피해를 입은 생물을 기준으로 이 임시 HP를 계산합니다. 1분 후 남은 임시 HP는 모두 사라집니다.

name: We March On

description.value: You make sure that your allies push themselves while traveling. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.5ZsmRm7HvFAw2XDZ]{Caravan Leader} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.38uOVS8fLZxraUrg]{Pick up the Pace} general feats, even if you don't meet the prerequisites.

_desc_en: You make sure that your allies push themselves while traveling. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.5ZsmRm7HvFAw2XDZ]{Caravan Leader} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.38uOVS8fLZxraUrg]{Pick up the Pace} general feats, even if you don't meet the prerequisites.
_desc_ko: 당신은 동행하는 동료들이 이동 중 스스로를 채찍질하도록 합니다. 당신은 @link[feats.caravan-leader]와 @link[feats.pick-up-the-pace] 일반 피트를 획득합니다. 해당 피트의 전제 조건을 충족하지 않더라도 적용됩니다.

name: Scholar's Hunch

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You fail a Lore or Occultism skill check.

Scholarly debates have taught you to think on your feet. Reroll the failed check and use the new result.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You fail a Lore or Occultism skill check.

Scholarly debates have taught you to think on your feet. Reroll the failed check and use the new result.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

발동 조건 지식 또는 오컬트 기술 판정 실패 시.

학문적 토론을 통해 즉흥적으로 대응하는 법을 배웠습니다. 실패한 판정을 재굴림하고 새로운 결과를 사용하세요.

name: Undead Spotter

description.value: Your studies of the undead have taught you telltale signs of a disguised undead creature. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xTK2zsWFyxSJvYbX]{Pursue a Lead} that involves a corpse or creature within your reach, you can touch that corpse or creature to immediately determine if it is undead. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} checks about undead creatures and to determine if a creature is undead.

_desc_en: Your studies of the undead have taught you telltale signs of a disguised undead creature. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xTK2zsWFyxSJvYbX]{Pursue a Lead} that involves a corpse or creature within your reach, you can touch that corpse or creature to immediately determine if it is undead. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} checks about undead creatures and to determine if a creature is undead.
_desc_ko: 당신의 언데드 연구는 변장한 언데드 생물의 특징적인 징후를 알려주었습니다. 당신이 @link[actions.pursue-a-lead]을 수행할 때, 손이 닿는 범위 내의 시체나 생물이 관련되어 있다면, 그 시체나 생물을 만져 즉시 언데드인지 판단할 수 있습니다. 또한 언데드 생물에 관한 @link[actions.recall-knowledge] 판정 및 생물이 언데드인지 판단하는 데 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Unconventional Weaponry

description.value:
You've familiarized yourself with a particular weapon, potentially from another ancestry or culture. Choose an uncommon simple or martial weapon with a trait corresponding to an ancestry (such as dwarf, goblin, or orc) or that is common in another culture. You gain access to that weapon, and for the purpose of proficiency, you treat it as a simple weapon.

If you are trained in all martial weapons, you can instead choose an uncommon advanced weapon that has an ancestry's trait or is common in another culture. You gain access to that weapon and have familiarity with that weapon. For the purpose of proficiency, you treat it as a martial weapon.

_desc_en:
You've familiarized yourself with a particular weapon, potentially from another ancestry or culture. Choose an uncommon simple or martial weapon with a trait corresponding to an ancestry (such as dwarf, goblin, or orc) or that is common in another culture. You gain access to that weapon, and for the purpose of proficiency, you treat it as a simple weapon.

If you are trained in all martial weapons, you can instead choose an uncommon advanced weapon that has an ancestry's trait or is common in another culture. You gain access to that weapon and have familiarity with that weapon. For the purpose of proficiency, you treat it as a martial weapon.
_desc_ko:
당신은 다른 혈통이나 문화에서 유래했을 수도 있는 특정 무기에 패밀리어되었습니다. 드워프, 고블린, 오크와 같은 혈통에 해당하는 특성을 지닌, 또는 다른 문화에서 흔히 볼 수 있는 흔하지 않은 단순 무기나 무술 무기를 선택하십시오. 해당 무기를 사용할 수 있게 되며, 숙련도 목적상 단순 무기로 취급합니다.

모든 무술 무기에 숙련된 경우, 대신 특정 조상의 특성을 지니거나 다른 문화권에서 흔히 사용되는 희귀 고급 무기를 선택할 수 있습니다. 해당 무기에 접근할 수 있으며 패밀리어를 얻습니다. 숙련도 목적상 이 무기는 무술 무기로 간주됩니다.

name: Shall not Falter, Shall not Rout

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rnFAHvKpcsU4BJD4]{Shall not Falter, Shall not Rout} focus spell. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can regain using the Refocus activity to recite the Crimson Oath and meditate on its teachings. If you already have a focus pool, increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1. Your knight reclaimant focus spells are divine spells; when you gain this feat, you become trained in divine spell attacks and spell DCs and your spellcasting ability is Charisma.

name_en: Shall not Falter, Shall not Rout
_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rnFAHvKpcsU4BJD4]{Shall not Falter, Shall not Rout} focus spell. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can regain using the Refocus activity to recite the Crimson Oath and meditate on its teachings. If you already have a focus pool, increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1. Your knight reclaimant focus spells are divine spells; when you gain this feat, you become trained in divine spell attacks and spell DCs and your spellcasting ability is Charisma.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @link[spells.shall-not-falter-shall-not-rout] 포커스 주문을 얻습니다. 아직 포커스 풀이 없다면, 1점의 포커스 포인트로 구성된 포커스 풀을 얻습니다. 이 포인트는 재집중 활동을 통해 진홍의 맹세를 암송하고 그 가르침에 명상함으로써 회복할 수 있습니다. 이미 포커스 풀을 보유하고 있다면, 포커스 풀의 포커스 포인트 수를 1 증가시킵니다. 귀하의 기사 재수련자 포커스 주문은 신성 주문입니다. 이 재주를 획득하면 신성 주문 공격 및 주문 난이도(DC)에 숙련되며, 주문 시전 능력치는 매력가 됩니다.

name: Gripping Limbs

description.value: Nodules, hooks, or claws on your limbs allow you to cling to surfaces with ease. You gain a climb Speed of 15 feet.

_desc_en: Nodules, hooks, or claws on your limbs allow you to cling to surfaces with ease. You gain a climb Speed of 15 feet.
_desc_ko: 사지에 생긴 결절, 갈고리, 또는 발톱 덕분에 표면에 쉽게 매달릴 수 있습니다. 등반 속도가 15피트로 증가합니다.

name: Poultice Preparation

description.value:
When you create an herbal elixir, you can prepare it as a poultice instead. A poultice gains the oil trait (but remains alchemical, not magical) and loses the elixir and ingested traits. You can apply a poultice by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interacting} with one hand.

When you apply a poultice, in addition to the item's normal effects, the recipient can attempt an immediate flat check to recover from a single source of persistent acid, bleed, or fire damage, with the DC reduction from appropriate assistance.

_desc_en:
When you create an herbal elixir, you can prepare it as a poultice instead. A poultice gains the oil trait (but remains alchemical, not magical) and loses the elixir and ingested traits. You can apply a poultice by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interacting} with one hand.

When you apply a poultice, in addition to the item's normal effects, the recipient can attempt an immediate flat check to recover from a single source of persistent acid, bleed, or fire damage, with the DC reduction from appropriate assistance.
_desc_ko:
초본 엘릭서를 제작할 때, 대신 파스 형태로 준비할 수 있습니다. 고약은 오일 특성을 얻지만(마법이 아닌 연금술로 남음) 엘릭서 및 섭취 특성은 상실합니다. 고약은 한 손으로 @link[actions.interact]하여 적용할 수 있습니다.

도포제를 적용할 때, 해당 아이템의 일반 효과에 더해 수혜자는 지속성 산성, 출혈, 화상 피해 중 하나의 원천으로부터 회복하기 위해 즉각적인 단순 판정을 시도하다, DC 감소가 적용됩니다.

name: Rapid Assessment

description.value:
Trigger You roll initiative.

You quickly evaluate your enemies. Attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} against one creature you are observing.

_desc_en:
Trigger You roll initiative.

You quickly evaluate your enemies. Attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} against one creature you are observing.
_desc_ko:
발동 이니셔티브를 굴립니다.

적들을 신속히 평가합니다. 관찰 중인 한 생물에 대해 @link[actions.recall-knowledge] 판정을 시도하십시오.

name: Waking Dream

description.value: While in your trance, you can blur the line between dreams and reality for others. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OmhnoYOzFhrp6rXv]{Waking Dream} focus spell, which you can use only while you're in a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.5LW1k5DUkzbbYuYL]{Daydream Trance}. You gain a pool of Focus Points with 1 Focus Point, and you can Refocus by taking a nap for 10 minutes. You become trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics, and your spellcasting attribute for these spells is Wisdom.

_desc_en: While in your trance, you can blur the line between dreams and reality for others. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OmhnoYOzFhrp6rXv]{Waking Dream} focus spell, which you can use only while you're in a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.5LW1k5DUkzbbYuYL]{Daydream Trance}. You gain a pool of Focus Points with 1 Focus Point, and you can Refocus by taking a nap for 10 minutes. You become trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics, and your spellcasting attribute for these spells is Wisdom.
_desc_ko: 트랜스 상태에서는 타인에게 꿈과 현실의 경계를 흐릴 수 있습니다. @link[spells.waking-dream] 포커스 주문을 획득하며, 이는 백일몽 트랜스 상태에서만 사용할 수 있습니다. 포커스 포인트 풀을 획득하며 초기 1포인트를 보유합니다. 10분간 낮잠을 자면 재집중할 수 있습니다. 오컬트 주문 명중 굴림과 주문 난이도(DC)에 숙련되며, 해당 주문들의 주문 시전 능력치는 지혜로 적용됩니다.

name: Uncanny Dodge

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.PNpmVmD21zViDtGC]{Deny Advantage} class feature.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.PNpmVmD21zViDtGC]{Deny Advantage} class feature.
_desc_ko: {이점 거부} 클래스 특성을 획득한다.

name: Clear as Air

description.value:
Compact layers of air diffract and bend light around your body, making you appear as clear as the sky on a perfect day. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} until the end of your next turn. You can Sustain the impulse. If you use a hostile action, the impulse ends after that action is completed. If you activate your kinetic aura, the impulse conceals its elements, though any special effects of your aura might give away your location.

This impulse weakens if you use it too frequently. Using it again within 10 minutes makes you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} instead of invisible.

Level (10th) The impulse doesn't end if you take a hostile action, but if you're invisible, you become concealed instead of invisible until the start of your next turn.

Level (16th) Taking a hostile action has no effect on the impulse.

_desc_en:
Compact layers of air diffract and bend light around your body, making you appear as clear as the sky on a perfect day. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} until the end of your next turn. You can Sustain the impulse. If you use a hostile action, the impulse ends after that action is completed. If you activate your kinetic aura, the impulse conceals its elements, though any special effects of your aura might give away your location.

This impulse weakens if you use it too frequently. Using it again within 10 minutes makes you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} instead of invisible.

Level (10th) The impulse doesn't end if you take a hostile action, but if you're invisible, you become concealed instead of invisible until the start of your next turn.

Level (16th) Taking a hostile action has no effect on the impulse.
_desc_ko:
공기의 촘촘한 층이 빛을 회절하고 굴절시켜, 당신의 몸 주위를 완벽한 날의 하늘처럼 투명하게 보이게 합니다. 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.invisible] 상태가 됩니다. 이 효과를 지속할 수 있습니다. 적대적 행동을 사용하면 해당 행동 완료 후 효과가 종료됩니다. 키네틱 오라를 활성화하면 효과의 요소가 숨겨지지만, 오라가 일으키는 특수 효과로 인해 위치를 노출할 수 있습니다.

이 임펄스는 지나치게 자주 사용하면 효과가 약해집니다. 10분 이내에 다시 사용하면 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태가 됩니다.

레벨 (10th) 적대적 행동을 취해도 이 효과는 종료되지 않지만, 투명 상태일 경우 다음 턴 시작까지 투명 대신 은폐 상태가 됩니다.

레벨 (16급) 적대적 행동을 취해도 임펄스에 영향이 없습니다.

name: Song of the Fallen

description.value: The moving power of your songs can stir the spirits of the dead to rise once more and fight alongside you. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IGXGs9PlqUCvODcH]{Song of the Fallen} composition spell. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.

_desc_en: The moving power of your songs can stir the spirits of the dead to rise once more and fight alongside you. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IGXGs9PlqUCvODcH]{Song of the Fallen} composition spell. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.
_desc_ko: 당신의 노래가 지닌 감동적인 힘은 죽은 자들의 영혼을 다시 일으켜 당신과 함께 싸우게 할 수 있습니다. 당신은 @link[spells.song-of-the-fallen] 작곡 주문을 배웁니다. 포커스 풀의 포커스 포인트 수를 1 증가시킵니다.

name: Dragonblood Paragon

description.value:
Your draconic anatomy becomes especially pronounced. You increase the power of one of the following kobold heritages or feats you have.

Dracomancer Increase the number of times you can cast each of the granted 1st- and 2nd-rank innate spells by 1.

Kobold Breath Creatures that critically fail their save against your Kobold Breath take 3d4 persistent damage of the type dealt by your draconic patron.

Strongjaw Kobold Your jaws unarmed attack gains the deadly d6 trait.

Venomtail Kobold You produce enough venom to use the Tail Toxin action twice per day.

value.value: strongjaw kobold heritage, venomtail kobold heritage, Dracomancer, or Kobold Breath

_desc_en:
Your draconic anatomy becomes especially pronounced. You increase the power of one of the following kobold heritages or feats you have.

Dracomancer Increase the number of times you can cast each of the granted 1st- and 2nd-rank innate spells by 1.

Kobold Breath Creatures that critically fail their save against your Kobold Breath take 3d4 persistent damage of the type dealt by your draconic patron.

Strongjaw Kobold Your jaws unarmed attack gains the deadly d6 trait.

Venomtail Kobold You produce enough venom to use the Tail Toxin action twice per day.
_desc_ko:
당신의 드라코닉 해부학적 특징이 특히 두드러지게 나타납니다. 당신이 가진 다음 코볼트 유산이나 피트 중 하나의 힘을 증가시킵니다.

드라코맨서 부여받은 1랭크 및 2랭크 선천적 주문 각각의 시전 횟수를 1회 증가시킵니다.

코볼트 브레스 코볼트 브레스에 대한 내성에 대실패한 생물은 네 드라코닉 후원자가 가하는 유형의 피해를 받는다.

강력한 턱 코볼트 비무장 공격에 치명적인 d6 특성이 부여됩니다.

독꼬리 코볼트 하루에 두 번 꼬리 독 액션을 사용할 수 있을 만큼의 맹독을 생성합니다.

name: Great Boaster

description.value: Your bragging is particularly effective. If you succeed at a boast, you can attempt a great boast about that same skill by using your Firebrand Braggart Dedication action about the same action during the duration of your original boast's circumstance bonus; this is an exception to the rule that you can't make another boast about the same action until your next daily preparations. A great boast uses the Firebrand Braggart Dedication action, except that if you succeed, your circumstance bonus increases to +2 and remains for 1 hour. If you fail the great boast, you take a -2 circumstance penalty to attempt the same action for 4 hours. Once you declare a great boast about a particular action, you can't declare a great boast about the same action until the next time you make daily preparations, regardless of whether you succeed or fail at the check. The minimum challenging task for a great boast is one with at least a hard DC for your level.

_desc_en: Your bragging is particularly effective. If you succeed at a boast, you can attempt a great boast about that same skill by using your Firebrand Braggart Dedication action about the same action during the duration of your original boast's circumstance bonus; this is an exception to the rule that you can't make another boast about the same action until your next daily preparations. A great boast uses the Firebrand Braggart Dedication action, except that if you succeed, your circumstance bonus increases to +2 and remains for 1 hour. If you fail the great boast, you take a -2 circumstance penalty to attempt the same action for 4 hours. Once you declare a great boast about a particular action, you can't declare a great boast about the same action until the next time you make daily preparations, regardless of whether you succeed or fail at the check. The minimum challenging task for a great boast is one with at least a hard DC for your level.
_desc_ko: 당신의 허세는 특히 효과적이다. 자랑에 성공하면, 원래 자랑의 상황 보너스가 지속되는 동안 동일한 행동에 대해 불씨 브라가트 헌신 행동을 사용하여 그 기술에 대한 위대한 자랑을 시도할 수 있습니다. 이는 다음 일일 준비 시간까지 동일한 행동에 대해 다른 자랑을 할 수 없다는 규칙의 예외입니다. 위대한 허세는 불씨 브라가트 헌신 행동을 사용하지만, 성공 시 상황 보너스가 +2로 증가하며 1시간 동안 유지됩니다. 위대한 허세를 실패하면, 4시간 동안 동일한 행동을 시도할 때 -2 상황 페널티를 받습니다. 특정 행동에 대해 위대한 허세를 선언한 후에는, 성공 여부와 상관없이 다음 일일 준비를 할 때까지 동일한 행동에 대해 위대한 허세를 선언할 수 없습니다. 위대한 허세의 최소 도전 과제는 자신의 레벨에 대해 최소한 어려운 난이도(DC)를 가진 것입니다.

name: Memory of Nothing

description.value:
With a look and a gesture, you turn a thinking creature's mind against itself, causing the creature to struggle to remember how to perform more complex actions. Choose a target within 30 feet and spend a Mythic Point. The target must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC (whichever is higher) at mythic proficiency.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success For the next 3 rounds, if the target performs an activity that requires three or more actions, they take @Damage[12d8[mental]] damage.

Failure For the next 3 rounds, if the target performs an activity that requires two or more actions, they take 12d8 mental damage.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} as its mind struggles to function.

_desc_en:
With a look and a gesture, you turn a thinking creature's mind against itself, causing the creature to struggle to remember how to perform more complex actions. Choose a target within 30 feet and spend a Mythic Point. The target must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC (whichever is higher) at mythic proficiency.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success For the next 3 rounds, if the target performs an activity that requires three or more actions, they take @Damage[12d8[mental]] damage.

Failure For the next 3 rounds, if the target performs an activity that requires two or more actions, they take 12d8 mental damage.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} as its mind struggles to function.
_desc_ko:
한 번의 시선과 제스처로 사고하는 생물의 마음을 뒤흔들어, 그 생물이 더 복잡한 행동을 수행하는 방법을 기억해내려 애쓰게 만든다. 30피트 내의 대상을 선택하고 신화 포인트를 소모한다. 대상은 신화 숙련도로 네 직업 DC 또는 주문 DC(둘 중 높은 쪽)에 대한 의지 저항 검사를 시도해야 한다.

대성공 대상은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 다음 3라운드 동안, 대상이 세 개 이상의 행동이 필요한 활동을 수행할 경우 12d8 정신의 피해를 입습니다.

실패 다음 3라운드 동안, 대상이 두 개 이상의 행동이 필요한 활동을 수행할 경우 12d8 정신 피해를 입습니다.

대실패 실패 효과와 동일하나, 대상은 정신 기능이 마비되며 @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태가 된다.

name: Musical Summons

description.value: Your studies have given you a deeper understanding of animals and beasts, allowing you to call them to your side as you cast your spell. You cast summon animal and a one-action composition spell.

_desc_en: Your studies have given you a deeper understanding of animals and beasts, allowing you to call them to your side as you cast your spell. You cast summon animal and a one-action composition spell.
_desc_ko: 당신의 연구는 동물과 야수에 대한 깊은 이해를 선사하여, 주문을 시전할 때 그들을 곁으로 부를 수 있게 합니다. 당신은 소환 동물 주문과 1회 행동 작곡 주문을 시전합니다.

name: Decry Thief

description.value:
When you attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}, you can make it harder for the target to flee, in place of the action's normal effects.

Critical Success For 1 round, the target takes a –10-foot status penalty to Speed and a -4 status penalty to Stealth.

Success For 1 round, the target takes a –5-foot status penalty to Speed and a -2 status penalty to Stealth.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.FyaekbWsazkJhJda]{Effect: Decry Thief}

_desc_en:
When you attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}, you can make it harder for the target to flee, in place of the action's normal effects.

Critical Success For 1 round, the target takes a –10-foot status penalty to Speed and a -4 status penalty to Stealth.

Success For 1 round, the target takes a –5-foot status penalty to Speed and a -2 status penalty to Stealth.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.FyaekbWsazkJhJda]{Effect: Decry Thief}
_desc_ko:
@link[actions.demoralize]를 시도할 때, 행동의 일반 효과 대신 대상이 도주하기 어렵게 만들 수 있습니다.

대성공 1라운드 동안 대상은 이동 속도에 -10피트 상태 페널티를, 은신에 -4 상태 페널티를 받습니다.

성공 1라운드 동안 대상은 이동 속도에 -5피트 상태 페널티를, 은신에 -2 상태 페널티를 받습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.FyaekbWsazkJhJda]{효과: 도둑 저주}

name: Esoteric Polymath

description.value:
You keep a book of occult spells, similar to a wizard's spellbook, and can use its spells to supplement your spell repertoire. Add all the spells in your repertoire to this book for free. You can use the Occultism skill to Learn Spells and add them to your spellbook by paying the appropriate cost.

During your daily preparations, choose any one spell from your book of occult spells. If that spell is already in your spell repertoire, you can treat it as an additional signature spell that day. If it isn't in your repertoire, treat it as though it were until your next daily preparations.

_desc_en:
You keep a book of occult spells, similar to a wizard's spellbook, and can use its spells to supplement your spell repertoire. Add all the spells in your repertoire to this book for free. You can use the Occultism skill to Learn Spells and add them to your spellbook by paying the appropriate cost.

During your daily preparations, choose any one spell from your book of occult spells. If that spell is already in your spell repertoire, you can treat it as an additional signature spell that day. If it isn't in your repertoire, treat it as though it were until your next daily preparations.
_desc_ko:
위자드의 주문서와 유사한 오컬트 주문서를 소지하고 있으며, 이 책의 주문을 사용하여 자신의 주문 목록을 보완할 수 있습니다. 레퍼토리에 있는 모든 주문을 이 책에 무료로 추가할 수 있습니다. 오컬트 스킬을 사용해 주문을 학습하고 적절한 비용을 지불하여 주문서에 추가할 수 있습니다.

일일 준비 시간 동안, 오컬트 주문서에서 주문 하나를 선택하세요. 해당 주문이 이미 주문 목록에 있다면, 그날 추가 시그니처 주문으로 취급할 수 있습니다. 만약 레퍼토리에 없다면, 다음 일일 준비 시간까지 레퍼토리에 있는 것처럼 취급하십시오.

name: Enhanced Psychopomp Familiar

description.value:
Your psychopomp's continued service in Pharasma's name brings it favor from the goddess. It might change appearance to look like a different, more powerful kind of psychopomp. You can select four familiar or master abilities each day, instead of two, but two must be from the Psychopomp Familiar feat or the following ability.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.mKmBgQmPmiLOlEvw]{Augury} Your familiar can glimpse the strands of fate to give you a cryptic clue regarding your future. Your familiar can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X]{Augury} once per day using your magical tradition and spell DC. You must be at least 8th level to select this ability.

_desc_en:
Your psychopomp's continued service in Pharasma's name brings it favor from the goddess. It might change appearance to look like a different, more powerful kind of psychopomp. You can select four familiar or master abilities each day, instead of two, but two must be from the Psychopomp Familiar feat or the following ability.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.mKmBgQmPmiLOlEvw]{Augury} Your familiar can glimpse the strands of fate to give you a cryptic clue regarding your future. Your familiar can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X]{Augury} once per day using your magical tradition and spell DC. You must be at least 8th level to select this ability.
_desc_ko:
당신의 사이코폼프 패밀리어의 파라스마의 이름으로 계속된 봉사는 여신의 은총을 받게 됩니다. 그것은 더 강력해 보이는 다른 종류의 사이코폼프로 외형을 바꿀 수 있습니다. 매일 두 가지 대신 네 가지 패밀리어나 마스터 패밀리어를 선택할 수 있지만, 그중 두 가지는 반드시 사이코폼프 패밀리어 피트나 다음 피트에서 선택해야 합니다.

  • @link[actions.augury] 당신의 패밀리어는 운명의 실타래를 엿보아 당신의 미래에 관한 암시적인 단서를 줄 수 있습니다. 당신의 패밀리어는 하루에 한 번, 당신의 마법 전통과 주문 DC를 사용하여 @link[spells.augury] 주문을 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 능력을 선택하려면 최소 8th 레벨 이상이어야 합니다.

name: Skirmish Strike

description.value: Your feet and weapon move in tandem. Either Step and then Strike, or Strike and then Step.

_desc_en: Your feet and weapon move in tandem. Either Step and then Strike, or Strike and then Step.
_desc_ko: 발과 무기가 동시에 움직입니다. 발을 내디딘 후 공격하거나, 공격한 후 발을 내디딜 수 있습니다.

name: Phantom Resemblance

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Your can now draw from experience to wear any face you remember. When you use Phantom Visage, you gain the effects of a 3rd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise} for 1 hour or until you shift back, whichever comes first.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Your can now draw from experience to wear any face you remember. When you use Phantom Visage, you gain the effects of a 3rd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise} for 1 hour or until you shift back, whichever comes first.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

이제 경험에서 얻은 기억을 바탕으로 어떤 얼굴이든 취할 수 있습니다. 유령의 얼굴을 사용할 때, (3rd)등급 @link[spells.illusory-disguise]의 효과를 1시간 동안 또는 원래 모습으로 돌아갈 때까지(둘 중 먼저 도래하는 시점까지) 얻습니다.

name: Witch's Communion

description.value: You can keep watch over multiple charges. Each day during your preparations, you can designate a number of charges equal to your Intelligence modifier instead of just one.

_desc_en: You can keep watch over multiple charges. Each day during your preparations, you can designate a number of charges equal to your Intelligence modifier instead of just one.
_desc_ko: 여러 개의 충전량을 동시에 감시할 수 있습니다. 매일 준비 시간 동안 지능 능력치 수정자만큼의 충전량을 지정할 수 있으며, 한 개만 지정할 필요가 없습니다.

name: Ride On

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You would gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} condition.

Even when tired, you refuse to give up, pushing yourself to extreme feats of endurance. You delay the effects of the fatigued condition for 3 rounds. If the fatigued condition has a duration, the duration begins to elapse only after the delay. You can't further delay or prevent the fatigued condition after this ability ends.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You would gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} condition.

Even when tired, you refuse to give up, pushing yourself to extreme feats of endurance. You delay the effects of the fatigued condition for 3 rounds. If the fatigued condition has a duration, the duration begins to elapse only after the delay. You can't further delay or prevent the fatigued condition after this ability ends.
_desc_ko:
빈도 시간당 1회

트리거 당신은 @link[conditions.fatigued] 상태를 얻게 됩니다.

지친 상태에서도 포기하지 않고 극한의 인내력을 발휘합니다. 피로 상태의 효과를 3라운드 동안 지연시킵니다. 피로 상태에 지속 시간이 있다면, 지연이 끝난 후에만 지속 시간이 시작됩니다. 이 능력이 끝난 후에는 피로 상태를 더 이상 지연시키거나 막을 수 없습니다.

name: Invoke the Elements

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You summon an aura of shimmering heat, flurrying snow, crashing waves, or swirling wind and lightning.

For 1 minute, you gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealment} against creatures more than 5 feet away, and any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of you suffers @Damage[(ternary(gte(@actor.level,17),3,ternary(gte(@actor.level,13),2,1)))d12[@item.flags.system.rulesSelections.changelingType]] damage (@Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher).

At 13th and 17th level, this damage increases by 1d12.

A veil may changeling deals fire damage, a snow may changeling deals cold damage, a brine may changeling deals bludgeoning damage and the effect gains the water trait, and a virga may changeling deals electricity damage.

value.value: Brine May, Snow May, Veil May, or Virga May

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You summon an aura of shimmering heat, flurrying snow, crashing waves, or swirling wind and lightning.

For 1 minute, you gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealment} against creatures more than 5 feet away, and any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of you suffers @Damage[(ternary(gte(@actor.level,17),3,ternary(gte(@actor.level,13),2,1)))d12[@item.flags.system.rulesSelections.changelingType]] damage (@Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher).

At 13th and 17th level, this damage increases by 1d12.

A veil may changeling deals fire damage, a snow may changeling deals cold damage, a brine may changeling deals bludgeoning damage and the effect gains the water trait, and a virga may changeling deals electricity damage.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

반짝이는 열기, 휘날리는 눈보라, 부서지는 파도, 또는 소용돌이치는 바람과 번개의 오라를 소환합니다.

1분 동안, 5피트 이상 떨어진 생물에게 @link[conditions.concealed] 효과를 얻으며, 자신의 턴을 5피트 이내에서 끝내는 모든 생물은 피해를 입습니다 (기본 반사 자신의 직업 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽을 사용한 내성 굴림).

13레벨과 17레벨에 도달하면 이 피해량이 1d12만큼 증가한다.

베일 체인질링은 화염 피해를, 스노우 체인질링은 냉기 피해를, 브라인 체인질링은 타격 피해를 입히며 효과에 물 속성이 부여되고, 버가 체인질링은 전기 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Variable Core

description.value:
You adjust your innovation's core, changing the way it explodes. When you choose this feat, select acid, cold, or electricity. Your innovation's core runs on that power source. When using the Explode action, or any time your innovation explodes on a critical failure and damages you, change the damage type from fire damage to the type you chose.

If you have the offensive boost class feature and retrain Variable Core to a different damage type, you can also switch to a different offensive boost that deals the same damage type if you wish.

_desc_en:
You adjust your innovation's core, changing the way it explodes. When you choose this feat, select acid, cold, or electricity. Your innovation's core runs on that power source. When using the Explode action, or any time your innovation explodes on a critical failure and damages you, change the damage type from fire damage to the type you chose.

If you have the offensive boost class feature and retrain Variable Core to a different damage type, you can also switch to a different offensive boost that deals the same damage type if you wish.
_desc_ko:
당신은 혁신 장치의 핵심을 조정하여 폭발 방식을 변경합니다. 이 피트를 선택할 때 산성, 냉기, 전기 중 하나를 선택하세요. 혁신의 핵심은 해당 에너지원으로 작동한다. 폭발 행동을 사용하거나, 혁신이 대실패로 폭발하여 당신에게 피해를 입힐 때마다, 화염 피해 유형을 선택한 유형으로 변경한다.

공격 부스트 클래스 특성을 보유하고 변형 코어를 다른 피해 유형으로 재훈련할 경우, 원한다면 동일한 피해 유형을 주는 다른 공격 부스트로도 전환할 수 있습니다.

name: Enter Divine Realm

description.value: You are granted access to your deity's realm and can travel there quickly. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5bTt2CvYHPvaR7QQ]{Interplanar Teleport} once per day as an innate divine spell with a casting time of only 1 minute. You act as the planar key for the destination, and you can only travel to your deity's realm. You and the other targets of the spell always appear in the center of your deity's realm, and you (but not necessarily your allies) are immune to all the realm's harmful conditions (such as toxic air or extreme temperatures) while there. You can return to your previous location by spending 1 minute picturing your destination; you can bring up to 8 willing creatures back with you in this way, and they need not be the same targets of the previous casting of interplanar teleport.

_desc_en: You are granted access to your deity's realm and can travel there quickly. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5bTt2CvYHPvaR7QQ]{Interplanar Teleport} once per day as an innate divine spell with a casting time of only 1 minute. You act as the planar key for the destination, and you can only travel to your deity's realm. You and the other targets of the spell always appear in the center of your deity's realm, and you (but not necessarily your allies) are immune to all the realm's harmful conditions (such as toxic air or extreme temperatures) while there. You can return to your previous location by spending 1 minute picturing your destination; you can bring up to 8 willing creatures back with you in this way, and they need not be the same targets of the previous casting of interplanar teleport.
_desc_ko: 당신은 신의 렐름에 접근할 수 있는 권한을 부여받아 신속하게 그곳으로 이동할 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, 발동 시간이 단 1분인 선천적 신성 주문으로 @link[spells.interplanar-teleport]을 시전할 수 있습니다. 당신은 목적지의 평면 열쇠 역할을 하며, 오직 당신의 신의 렐름으로만 이동할 수 있습니다. 당신과 이 주문 대상들은 항상 신의 렐름 중심부에 나타나며, 당신은 (동료들은 반드시 그렇지 않을 수 있음) 그곳에 머무는 동안 렐름의 모든 유해한 상태(독성 공기나 극한 온도 등)에 면역됩니다. 1분간 목적지를 상상함으로써 이전 위치로 돌아갈 수 있다. 이 방법으로 최대 8명의 동의한 대상을 함께 데려올 수 있으며, 이들은 이전 순간이동의 대상과 동일할 필요는 없다.

name: Diving Armor

description.value: You've modified your armor with fins, rotors, and other devices to make it easy for you to move through the water, plus mechanical gills that can help you extract breathable air from water. While wearing your armor innovation, you can breathe underwater and gain a swim Speed equal to your land Speed.

_desc_en: You've modified your armor with fins, rotors, and other devices to make it easy for you to move through the water, plus mechanical gills that can help you extract breathable air from water. While wearing your armor innovation, you can breathe underwater and gain a swim Speed equal to your land Speed.
_desc_ko: 당신은 갑옷에 지느러미, 로터 및 기타 장치를 조정하여 물속을 쉽게 이동할 수 있게 했으며, 물에서 호흡 가능한 공기를 추출하는 데 도움이 되는 기계식 아가미도 장착했습니다. 이 갑옷 혁신 장비를 착용 중일 때, 당신은 수중에서 호흡할 수 있으며 지상 속도 및 동일한 수영 속도를 얻습니다.

name: Elven Instincts

description.value: Your senses let you react rapidly. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks made as initiative rolls. Additionally, if your initiative roll result is tied with that of an opponent, you go first, regardless of whether you rolled Perception or not.

_desc_en: Your senses let you react rapidly. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks made as initiative rolls. Additionally, if your initiative roll result is tied with that of an opponent, you go first, regardless of whether you rolled Perception or not.
_desc_ko: 당신의 감각은 신속한 반응을 가능케 합니다. 이니셔티브 롤로 수행하는 지각 판정 시 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 또한, 상대방과 이니셔티브 롤 결과가 동점일 경우, 지각 판정을 했는지 여부와 관계없이 당신이 먼저 행동합니다.

name: Dandy Dedication

description.value:
You are a consummate student of dignity, etiquette, and fashion. You become trained in Deception and Society; if you were already trained in either, you become an expert in it instead. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HFv62jIK98S2xw4x]{Influence Rumor} downtime activity.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.s9kLzXOCl2GNT6TY]{Dandy}

_desc_en:
You are a consummate student of dignity, etiquette, and fashion. You become trained in Deception and Society; if you were already trained in either, you become an expert in it instead. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HFv62jIK98S2xw4x]{Influence Rumor} downtime activity.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.s9kLzXOCl2GNT6TY]{Dandy}
_desc_ko: 당신은 품위, 예절, 패션에 정통한 학자입니다. 기만 및 사교술에 숙련됩니다. 이미 숙련된 경우 해당 기술에 대해 전문가가 됩니다. @link[actions.influence-rumor] 다운타임 활동을 획득합니다.

name: Snarecrafter Dedication

description.value:
You have studied the art of crafting snares and laying traps, and few have shown more talent in these arts than you. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.DMetdzt1VJL2Y62i]{Snare Crafting} feat. When you set a snare, the DC of any saving throw it requires uses the higher of your class DC or the snare's DC. If a snare normally takes 1 minute to Craft, you can Craft it with 3 Interact actions instead.

Each day during your daily preparations, you can prepare four snares from your formula book for quick deployment (increasing to six snares if you're a master in Crafting and eight if you're legendary). Snares prepared in this way don't cost you any resources to Craft.

When you increase your proficiency rank in Crafting to expert, master, or legendary, add three additional snare formulas to your formula book. The snares must be of your level or lower.

Special Rangers can adapt snare crafting techniques to create snares from natural materials. If you are a ranger, you can use Survival instead of Crafting for all prerequisites and functions of feats from this archetype. (This includes using Survival to Craft a snare.)

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.G9Fzy5ZK4KtAmcFb]{Snarecrafter}

_desc_en:
You have studied the art of crafting snares and laying traps, and few have shown more talent in these arts than you. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.DMetdzt1VJL2Y62i]{Snare Crafting} feat. When you set a snare, the DC of any saving throw it requires uses the higher of your class DC or the snare's DC. If a snare normally takes 1 minute to Craft, you can Craft it with 3 Interact actions instead.

Each day during your daily preparations, you can prepare four snares from your formula book for quick deployment (increasing to six snares if you're a master in Crafting and eight if you're legendary). Snares prepared in this way don't cost you any resources to Craft.

When you increase your proficiency rank in Crafting to expert, master, or legendary, add three additional snare formulas to your formula book. The snares must be of your level or lower.

Special Rangers can adapt snare crafting techniques to create snares from natural materials. If you are a ranger, you can use Survival instead of Crafting for all prerequisites and functions of feats from this archetype. (This includes using Survival to Craft a snare.)

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.G9Fzy5ZK4KtAmcFb]{Snarecrafter}
_desc_ko:
당신은 올가미 제작과 함정 설치 기술을 연구했으며, 이 분야에서 당신보다 뛰어난 재능을 보인 이는 거의 없습니다. @link[feats.snare-crafting] 피트를 획득합니다. 덫을 설치할 때, 해당 덫이 요구하는 내성 굴림의 DC는 당신의 직업 DC와 덫의 DC 중 높은 쪽을 사용합니다. 일반적으로 제작에 1분이 소요되는 덫을, 3회의 상호작용 행동으로 제작할 수 있습니다.

매일 준비 시간 동안, 당신은 공식집에서 네 개의 올가미를 신속히 배치할 수 있도록 준비할 수 있습니다(제작에 달인인 경우 여섯 개, 전설적인 경우 여덟 개로 증가). 이렇게 준비된 올가미는 제작에 자원을 소모하지 않습니다.

제작 숙련도를 전문가, 달인, 전설 등급으로 올릴 때마다 포획 장치 제작법 3종을 추가로 제작법 책에 기록할 수 있습니다. 포획 장치는 자신의 레벨 이하이어야 합니다.

특수 레인저는 덫 제작 기술을 응용하여 천연 재료로 덫을 만들 수 있습니다. 레인저인 경우, 이 아키타입의 모든 재주 전제 조건 및 기능에 제작 대신 생존 기술을 사용할 수 있습니다. (생존 기술을 사용하여 덫을 제작하는 것도 포함됩니다.)

name: Elven Weapon Familiarity

description.value:
You favor bows and other elegant weapons. You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the elf trait. You have familiarity with weapons with the elf trait plus @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.MVAWttmT0QDa7LsV]{Longbows}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.dUC8Fsa6FZtVikS3]{Composite Longbows}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.tH5GirEy7YB3ZgCk]{Rapiers}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.hIgqLgH3YcLZBeoT]{Shortbows}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.e4NwsnPnpQKbDZ9F]{Composite Shortbows}—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

_desc_en:
You favor bows and other elegant weapons. You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the elf trait. You have familiarity with weapons with the elf trait plus @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.MVAWttmT0QDa7LsV]{Longbows}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.dUC8Fsa6FZtVikS3]{Composite Longbows}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.tH5GirEy7YB3ZgCk]{Rapiers}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.hIgqLgH3YcLZBeoT]{Shortbows}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.e4NwsnPnpQKbDZ9F]{Composite Shortbows}—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
_desc_ko:
당신은 활과 다른 우아한 무기를 선호합니다. 엘프 특성이 부여된 모든 흔하지 않은 무기를 사용할 수 있습니다. 엘프 특성이 부여된 무기에 더해 @link[equipment.longbow], @link[equipment.composite-longbow], @link[equipment.rapier], @link[equipment.shortbow], @link[equipment.composite-shortbow]에 대한 숙련도를 얻습니다. 숙련도 목적상, 이 중 무술 무기인 것은 단순 무기로, 고급 무기인 것은 무술 무기로 취급합니다.

5레벨에 도달하면, 이 무기들로 치명타를 성공시킬 때마다 해당 무기의 치명타 특화 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Lightning Snares

description.value: You can rig a trap with incredible speed. When you create a snare that normally takes 1 minute to Craft, you can Craft it using a single Interact action instead.

_desc_en: You can rig a trap with incredible speed. When you create a snare that normally takes 1 minute to Craft, you can Craft it using a single Interact action instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 놀라운 속도로 함정을 설치할 수 있습니다. 일반적으로 제작에 1분이 소요되는 올가미를 만들 때, 단일 상호작용 행동으로 제작할 수 있습니다.

name: Arcana of Iron

description.value: You eschew wands and staves for more advanced weaponry. You become trained in advanced weapons. If you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.9XLUh9iMepZesdmc]{Weapon Expertise} class feature, your proficiency in martial and advanced weapons increases to expert. The extra damage you deal with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.tWBK7Zbt80JlPryC]{Bespell Strikes} increases to 1d8.

_desc_en: You eschew wands and staves for more advanced weaponry. You become trained in advanced weapons. If you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.9XLUh9iMepZesdmc]{Weapon Expertise} class feature, your proficiency in martial and advanced weapons increases to expert. The extra damage you deal with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.tWBK7Zbt80JlPryC]{Bespell Strikes} increases to 1d8.
_desc_ko: 당신은 지팡이와 마법봉 대신 더 진보된 무기를 선택합니다. 당신은 고급 무기 사용에 숙련됩니다. @link[feats.weapon-expertise] 클래스 특성을 획득하면, 무술 무기와 고급 무기에 대한 숙련도가 전문가 수준으로 상승합니다. @link[feats.bespell-strikes]으로 가하는 추가 피해가 1d8로 증가한다.

name: Cratering Drop

description.value:
Requirements Your previous action was Pluck from the Sky using a melee Strike, and the target failed or critically failed its saving throw.

You follow up your enemy's fall, driving you both to the earth in a meteoric descent. You Fly straight down, increasing the amount the enemy falls by your Fly speed. If you reach the ground, you drive the enemy into the ground, dealing double the normal falling damage.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your previous action was Pluck from the Sky using a melee Strike, and the target failed or critically failed its saving throw.

You follow up your enemy's fall, driving you both to the earth in a meteoric descent. You Fly straight down, increasing the amount the enemy falls by your Fly speed. If you reach the ground, you drive the enemy into the ground, dealing double the normal falling damage.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 이전 행동으로 근접 공격을 사용한 '하늘에서 뜯어내기'를 수행했으며, 대상이 내성 굴림에서 실패하거나 대실패했습니다.

당신은 적의 추락을 따라가며, 둘 다 유성처럼 땅으로 내리꽂힙니다. 당신은 직선으로 내려가며, 적의 추락 거리를 당신의 비행 속도만큼 증가시킵니다. 지면에 닿으면 적을 땅속으로 박아 넣으며, 일반 낙하 피해의 두 배를 입힙니다.

name: Emissary Assistance

description.value: As an emissary, you have assisted land-bound creatures in journeying underwater to visit your settlements. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.RvBlSIJmxiqfCpR9]{Feet to Fins} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MZGkMsPBztFN0pUO]{Water Breathing} as 3rd-rank primal innate spells. You can cast each of these spells once per day.

_desc_en: As an emissary, you have assisted land-bound creatures in journeying underwater to visit your settlements. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.RvBlSIJmxiqfCpR9]{Feet to Fins} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MZGkMsPBztFN0pUO]{Water Breathing} as 3rd-rank primal innate spells. You can cast each of these spells once per day.
_desc_ko: 사절로서 육상 생물들이 수중을 여행하여 당신의 정착지를 방문하도록 지원해 왔습니다. 당신은 @link[spells.feet-to-fins]와 @link[spells.water-breathing]을 (3rd)랭크 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 얻습니다. 이 마법들은 각각 하루에 한 번씩 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Parting Shot

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a loaded ranged weapon or a ranged weapon with reload 0.

You jump back and make a quick shot that catches your opponent by surprise. You Step and then make a ranged Strike with the required weapon. Your target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the attack.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a loaded ranged weapon or a ranged weapon with reload 0.

You jump back and make a quick shot that catches your opponent by surprise. You Step and then make a ranged Strike with the required weapon. Your target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the attack.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 장전된 원거리 무기 또는 재장전 0인 원거리 무기를 휘두르고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 뒤로 점프하며 상대를 놀라게 하는 빠른 사격을 가합니다. 스텝을 사용한 후 요구되는 무기로 원거리 공격을 수행합니다. 대상은 이 공격에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태입니다.

name: Reactive Transformation

description.value:
Trigger varies

You transform reflexively when in danger. You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form} to transform into one shape granted by one of the prerequisite feats you have, depending on the trigger. Your shape's resistances and weaknesses apply against the triggering damage.

Trigger You fall 10 feet or more

Effect Choose a shape from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.NzXpEzcZAjuDTZjK]{Aerial Form}.

Trigger You take fire damage

Effect Choose a fire elemental shape from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1K6AYGisvo9gqdhs]{Elemental Form}.

Trigger You take poison damage

Effect Choose a shape from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zCcfPS4y5SrZzU2x]{Plant Form}.
