_desc_ko:
발동 조건 다양함

위험에 처하면 반사적으로 변신합니다. 당신은 @link[spells.untamed-form]를 시전하여 트리거에 따라 보유한 피트 중 하나로 부여된 한 가지 형태로 변신합니다. 변신 형태의 저항력과 약점은 트리거가 된 피해에 적용됩니다.

트리거 10피트 이상 추락할 때

효과 @link[spells.aerial-form]에서 형태를 선택한다.

발동 조건 당신이 타격 또는 독 피해를 입을 때

효과 발동 피해를 저항하는 @link[spells.dragon-form] 중 하나의 원시 프라이멀 용 형태를 선택한다.

발동 당신은 화염 피해를 받습니다

효과 @link[spells.elemental-form]에서 불 원소 형태를 선택한다.

발동 조건 독 피해를 받음

효과 @link[spells.plant-form]에서 형태를 선택하십시오.

name: Archer Dedication

description.value:
You have familiarity with all weapons in the bow and crossbow weapon groups. For the purposes of proficiency, treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

If you are at least an expert in the bow or crossbow you are using, you get the critical specialization effect of that weapon when you get a critical hit with it.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.o71hqcfzhCKXcSml]{Archer}

_desc_en:
You have familiarity with all weapons in the bow and crossbow weapon groups. For the purposes of proficiency, treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

If you are at least an expert in the bow or crossbow you are using, you get the critical specialization effect of that weapon when you get a critical hit with it.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.o71hqcfzhCKXcSml]{Archer}
_desc_ko:
활과 석궁 무기 그룹에 속하는 모든 무기에 숙련을 가지고 있습니다. 숙련도 목적상, 이 중 무술 무기는 단순 무기로, 고급 무기는 무술 무기로 취급합니다.

사용 중인 활 또는 석궁에 대해 최소한 전문가 등급을 보유한 경우, 해당 무기로 치명타를 성공시킬 때 해당 무기의 치명타 특화 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Embodied Dreadnought Subjectivity

description.value:
Access You're from Nex.

Your colossal might marks you as a behemoth, the pride of Nex's Fleshforges, and the heaviest ordnance is a child's toy in your monumental grasp. You're a dreadnought, a living siege weapon, albeit one that wields other siege weapons in battle as your endoskeleton and flesh toughens. You gain the Hefty Hauler skill feat, and your maximum Bulk limit further increases by 3, for a total of 2 to your encumbered limit and 5 to your maximum limit.

_desc_en:
Access You're from Nex.

Your colossal might marks you as a behemoth, the pride of Nex's Fleshforges, and the heaviest ordnance is a child's toy in your monumental grasp. You're a dreadnought, a living siege weapon, albeit one that wields other siege weapons in battle as your endoskeleton and flesh toughens. You gain the Hefty Hauler skill feat, and your maximum Bulk limit further increases by 3, for a total of 2 to your encumbered limit and 5 to your maximum limit.
_desc_ko:
접근 당신은 넥스 출신이다.

당신의 거대한 힘은 넥스 플레시포지의 자부심인 거대한 괴물로 당신을 표시하며, 가장 무거운 포탄도 당신의 기념비적인 손아귀에서는 아이 장난감에 불과합니다. 당신은 드레드노트, 살아있는 공성 무기입니다. 비록 전투에서는 다른 공성 무기를 휘두르지만, 당신의 내골격과 살갗은 더욱 단단해집니다. 당신은 '거대한 운반자' 기술 피트를 획득하며, 최대 벌크 제한이 3 증가합니다. 이로 인해 과적 가능한 최대 벌크와 최대 벌크 제한이 각각 2, 5 증가합니다.

name: Hobnobber

description.value: You are skilled at learning information through conversation. The @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information} exploration activity takes you half as long as normal (typically reducing the time to 1 hour). If you're a master in Diplomacy and roll a critical failure to Gather Information, you get a failure instead. There is still no guarantee that a rumor you learn with Gather Information is accurate.

_desc_en: You are skilled at learning information through conversation. The @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information} exploration activity takes you half as long as normal (typically reducing the time to 1 hour). If you're a master in Diplomacy and roll a critical failure to Gather Information, you get a failure instead. There is still no guarantee that a rumor you learn with Gather Information is accurate.
_desc_ko: 대화를 통해 정보를 습득하는 데 능숙합니다. @link[actions.gather-information] 탐사 활동에 소요되는 시간이 절반으로 단축됩니다(일반적으로 1시간으로 감소). 외교에 달인인 경우 정보 수집에 대실패를 굴림해도 실패로 처리됩니다. 정보 수집으로 알게 된 소문이 정확하다는 보장은 여전히 없습니다.

name: Vigorous Anthem

description.value:
You instill magical vigor in your allies when you inspire them to attack. If your next action is to cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IAjvwqgiDr3qGYxY]{Courageous Anthem} composition cantrip, you and all affected allies gain temporary HP equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier that last for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.7AzGhIOx4Df5Cicr]{Effect: Vigorous Anthem}

_desc_en:
You instill magical vigor in your allies when you inspire them to attack. If your next action is to cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IAjvwqgiDr3qGYxY]{Courageous Anthem} composition cantrip, you and all affected allies gain temporary HP equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier that last for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.7AzGhIOx4Df5Cicr]{Effect: Vigorous Anthem}
_desc_ko:
동료들에게 공격을 독려할 때 마법적 활력을 불어넣습니다. 다음 행동으로 @link[spells.courageous-anthem] 작곡 캔트립을 시전하면, 자신과 영향을 받은 모든 동료는 3 + 매력 능력치 수정자만큼의 임시 HP를 1분 동안 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.7AzGhIOx4Df5Cicr]{효과: 활력 찬가}

name: Instinct Ability

description.value: You gain the instinct ability for the instinct you chose for Barbarian Dedication.

_desc_en: You gain the instinct ability for the instinct you chose for Barbarian Dedication.
_desc_ko: 당신은 바바리안의 헌신에서 선택한 본능에 대한 본능 능력을 얻습니다.

name: Avenger of Sloth

description.value: You've become a champion of the runelords of sloth. They spur you toward idleness, and their spirits are slow to come to your aid. Once they arrive, however, their combined might is undeniable. The first time each day you spend 10 minutes resting, you gain 1 Mythic Point. During this time, you don't need to sleep, but you can't perform activities like Refocus or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.S2WNjzwdnwziZSee]{Summon Sloth} activity.

_desc_en: You've become a champion of the runelords of sloth. They spur you toward idleness, and their spirits are slow to come to your aid. Once they arrive, however, their combined might is undeniable. The first time each day you spend 10 minutes resting, you gain 1 Mythic Point. During this time, you don't need to sleep, but you can't perform activities like Refocus or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.S2WNjzwdnwziZSee]{Summon Sloth} activity.
_desc_ko: 당신은 나태의 룬로드들의 대변자가 되었습니다. 그들은 당신을 나태로 부추기며, 그들의 영혼은 더디게 당신을 도우러 옵니다. 그러나 일단 도착하면, 그들의 합쳐진 힘은 부정할 수 없습니다. 매일 처음으로 10분간 휴식하면, 당신은 신화 점수 1점을 얻습니다. 이 시간 동안 당신은 잠을 잘 필요가 없지만, 재집중이나 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{상처 치료} 같은 활동은 할 수 없습니다. 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.S2WNjzwdnwziZSee]{나태 소환} 활동을 얻습니다.

name: Voice of Elements

description.value:
You can speak with the secret tones of elements you channel, finding words in the crackle of flame, the grinding of stone. Your kinetic aura grants you these three benefits while active.

  • You can speak all the languages of your kinetic elements (Sussuran for air, Petran for earth, Pyric for fire, Talican for metal, Thalassic for water, Muan for wood).
  • You can communicate with mindless elementals on a basic level if they have a trait that matches one of your kinetic elements or are made of one of those elements. This allows you to use Diplomacy to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on them and to make very simple @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Requests}.
  • You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Charisma-based skill checks you attempt against elementals of one of your kinetic elements.

_desc_en:
You can speak with the secret tones of elements you channel, finding words in the crackle of flame, the grinding of stone. Your kinetic aura grants you these three benefits while active.

  • You can speak all the languages of your kinetic elements (Sussuran for air, Petran for earth, Pyric for fire, Talican for metal, Thalassic for water, Muan for wood).
  • You can communicate with mindless elementals on a basic level if they have a trait that matches one of your kinetic elements or are made of one of those elements. This allows you to use Diplomacy to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on them and to make very simple @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Requests}.
  • You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Charisma-based skill checks you attempt against elementals of one of your kinetic elements.
_desc_ko:
당신은 자신이 통제하는 원소의 비밀스러운 음색으로 말할 수 있으며, 불꽃의 타닥거림과 돌의 갈리는 소리 속에서 말을 찾아냅니다. 당신의 키네틱 오라가 활성화된 동안 이 세 가지 혜택을 부여합니다.

  • 당신은 자신의 운동 원소 언어(공기: 수수란어, 땅: 페트란어, 불: 파이릭어, 금속: 탈리칸어, 물: 탈라식어, 나무: 무안어)를 모두 구사할 수 있습니다.
  • 당신의 운동 원소 중 하나와 특성이 일치하거나 해당 원소로 이루어진 무의식적 원소체와 기본적인 수준으로 소통할 수 있습니다. 이를 통해 외교 기술로 그들에게 @link[actions.make-an-impression] 수 있으며 매우 간단한 @link[actions.request]을 할 수 있습니다.
  • 당신은 자신의 운동 원소 중 하나를 가진 정령을 상대로 시도하는 매력 기반 기술 판정에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Ghoran's Wrath

description.value: You have such a strong connection to the natural world that you can inspire it to attack at those who threaten you. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YtBZq49N4Um1cwm7]{Nature's Reprisal} once per hour as a primal innate spell.

_desc_en: You have such a strong connection to the natural world that you can inspire it to attack at those who threaten you. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YtBZq49N4Um1cwm7]{Nature's Reprisal} once per hour as a primal innate spell.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자연계와 매우 강한 유대감을 지니고 있어, 당신을 위협하는 자들에게 자연이 공격하도록 부추길 수 있습니다. 시간당 한 번씩 @link[spells.natures-reprisal]을 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Distracting Performance

description.value: Your performances are especially distracting, allowing your allies to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} away with ease. You [[/act create-a-diversion statistic=performance]], except you roll a Performance check instead of Deception, and the benefits of successful checks apply to an ally of your choice instead of you. The effects of a success last until the end of that ally's turn, and can end early based on the ally's actions. You don't need to be observing your ally or know where they are, but you need to know they're present to choose them.

_desc_en: Your performances are especially distracting, allowing your allies to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} away with ease. You [[/act create-a-diversion statistic=performance]], except you roll a Performance check instead of Deception, and the benefits of successful checks apply to an ally of your choice instead of you. The effects of a success last until the end of that ally's turn, and can end early based on the ally's actions. You don't need to be observing your ally or know where they are, but you need to know they're present to choose them.
_desc_ko: 당신의 공연은 특히 산만하여, 아군이 @link[actions.sneak]하여 쉽게 빠져나갈 수 있게 합니다. 당신은 주의 분산 (공연)을 수행합니다. 단, 기만 대신 공연 판정을 굴리며, 성공 시 혜택은 본인 대신 선택한 아군에게 적용됩니다. 성공 효과는 해당 아군의 턴이 끝날 때까지 지속되며, 아군의 행동에 따라 조기 종료될 수 있습니다. 동료를 관찰하거나 위치를 알 필요는 없으나, 선택하려면 그 존재를 인지하고 있어야 합니다.

name: Disarming Twist

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a single one-handed melee weapon and hold nothing else in your hands.

After your initial attack redirects your foe's defenses, your follow-up wrests their weapon from their grasp. Make a melee Strike with a one-handed melee weapon. In addition to its other effects, this Strike gains the success and critical success effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} action. The Strike also has the following failure effect.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your current turn.

Special If you're in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1p5ErCp33nGOzEsk]{Disarming Stance}, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the attack roll.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a single one-handed melee weapon and hold nothing else in your hands.

After your initial attack redirects your foe's defenses, your follow-up wrests their weapon from their grasp. Make a melee Strike with a one-handed melee weapon. In addition to its other effects, this Strike gains the success and critical success effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} action. The Strike also has the following failure effect.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your current turn.

Special If you're in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1p5ErCp33nGOzEsk]{Disarming Stance}, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the attack roll.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 한 손으로 휘두르는 근접 무기 하나만 들고 있으며, 손에 다른 것을 들고 있지 않아야 합니다.

초기 공격으로 적의 방어 태세를 무너뜨린 후, 후속 공격으로 적의 무기를 빼앗습니다. 한손 근접 무기로 근접 강타를 가하세요. 이 강타는 다른 효과 외에도 @link[actions.disarm] 행동의 성공 및 대성공 효과를 얻습니다. 또한 다음과 같은 실패 효과가 적용됩니다.

실패 대상은 현재 턴이 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 된다.

특수 @link[feats.disarming-stance] 상태일 경우, 명중 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Steel Yourself!

description.value:
You encourage an ally to toughen up, giving them a fighting chance. Choose one ally in your marshal's aura. The ally gains temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier and a +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves. Both benefits last until the start of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.HoNojV4S2Yb6CoZR]{Effect: Steel Yourself!}

_desc_en:
You encourage an ally to toughen up, giving them a fighting chance. Choose one ally in your marshal's aura. The ally gains temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier and a +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves. Both benefits last until the start of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.HoNojV4S2Yb6CoZR]{Effect: Steel Yourself!}
_desc_ko:
동료를 격려하여 버티게 하여 싸울 기회를 줍니다. 마셜의 오라 안에 있는 동료 한 명을 선택합니다. 해당 동료는 당신의 매력 수정자만큼의 임시 HP를 얻고, 인내 내성에 +2 상황 보너스를 받습니다. 두 효과 모두 당신의 다음 턴 시작까지 지속됩니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.HoNojV4S2Yb6CoZR]{효과: 강인해져라!}

name: Mantis Form

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.bKDsmKVosexwJ80i]{Mantis Form} focus spell. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.bKDsmKVosexwJ80i]{Mantis Form} focus spell. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point.
_desc_ko: @link[spells.mantis-form] 포커스 주문을 획득합니다. 아직 포커스 풀이 없다면, 1 포커스 포인트의 포커스 풀을 얻습니다.

name: Phenom's Verve

description.value:
You're possessed with an incredibly vivacious spark that separates you not only from ordinary gun users and gunslingers, but even from other phenoms. Using that distinctive verve, when you perform impeccably and control the scene with your abilities, you also manage to set up your foes for disaster and ensure they remain in your sights for any follow-up attacks you want to make against them. If you critically succeed at a Performance check for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.A2EBy2L4acrehiAA]{Pistol Twirl} or a pistol phenom archetype feat, you gain a +1 status bonus to your attack rolls with one-handed firearms and one-handed melee weapons until the end of your turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.1ssTlwNcRRkatmPC]{Effect: Phenom Verve}

_desc_en:
You're possessed with an incredibly vivacious spark that separates you not only from ordinary gun users and gunslingers, but even from other phenoms. Using that distinctive verve, when you perform impeccably and control the scene with your abilities, you also manage to set up your foes for disaster and ensure they remain in your sights for any follow-up attacks you want to make against them. If you critically succeed at a Performance check for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.A2EBy2L4acrehiAA]{Pistol Twirl} or a pistol phenom archetype feat, you gain a +1 status bonus to your attack rolls with one-handed firearms and one-handed melee weapons until the end of your turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.1ssTlwNcRRkatmPC]{Effect: Phenom Verve}
_desc_ko:
당신은 평범한 총기 사용자나 건슬링거는 물론 다른 페놈들조차도 따를 수 없는 놀라울 정도로 생기 넘치는 기운을 지니고 있습니다. 이 독특한 열정을 활용하여 완벽하게 공연하고 능력으로 현장을 장악할 때, 당신은 적을 재앙으로 몰아넣고 원하는 후속 공격을 위해 그들을 시야에 계속 잡아둘 수 있습니다. @link[feats.pistol-twirl] 또는 권총 천재 아키타입 피트 판정에서 대성공을 거두면, 턴 종료 시까지 한 손으로 사용하는 화기 및 한 손 근접 무기로 명중 굴림에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.1ssTlwNcRRkatmPC]{효과: 페놈 열정}

name: Shield Salvation

description.value:
You can save your shield from total destruction, even after a devastating attack. If your shield would be destroyed due to damage taken during your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}, the shield remains intact at 1 Hit Point instead.

Its construction is weakened until you take the time to repair it thoroughly, preventing you from using Shield Salvation to save the same shield until your next daily preparations.

_desc_en:
You can save your shield from total destruction, even after a devastating attack. If your shield would be destroyed due to damage taken during your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}, the shield remains intact at 1 Hit Point instead.

Its construction is weakened until you take the time to repair it thoroughly, preventing you from using Shield Salvation to save the same shield until your next daily preparations.
_desc_ko:
치명적인 공격을 받은 후에도 방패가 완전히 파괴되는 것을 막을 수 있습니다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{방패 막기} 중 입은 피해로 인해 방패가 파괴될 경우, 대신 방패는 1 HP로 온전하게 유지됩니다.

그러나 완전히 수리할 때까지 방패의 구조는 약화된 상태로 유지되며, 다음 일일 준비 시간까지 동일한 방패에 대해 방패 구원을 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Piercing Doom

description.value:
Requirements You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 2} or greater.

You have grown accustomed to the curse that comes with your blessing, able to channel its effects through your attacks and forestall your own demise. Make a melee Strike; on a success, the target takes an additional @Damage[1d10[void]] damage and your doomed value is reduced by 1.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 2} or greater.

You have grown accustomed to the curse that comes with your blessing, able to channel its effects through your attacks and forestall your own demise. Make a melee Strike; on a success, the target takes an additional @Damage[1d10[void]] damage and your doomed value is reduced by 1.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 @link[conditions.doomed]{2} 이상 상태여야 합니다.

당신은 축복과 함께 찾아온 저주에 익숙해져, 그 효과를 공격을 통해 발현하고 자신의 죽음을 막을 수 있습니다. 근접 공격을 시도하세요; 성공 시, 대상은 추가로 1d10 공허의 피해를 입으며 당신의 파멸 값이 1 감소합니다.

name: Second Wind

description.value: You can enter a second rage, but afterward you need to catch your breath. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Ah5g9pDwWF9b9VW9]{Rage}, you can choose to gain temporary HP from the Rage even if 1 minute hasn't passed (or a full turn if you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.qMtyQGUllPdgpzUo]{Revitalizing Rage} class feature). If you do, once this Rage ends you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} until you rest for 10 minutes.

_desc_en: You can enter a second rage, but afterward you need to catch your breath. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Ah5g9pDwWF9b9VW9]{Rage}, you can choose to gain temporary HP from the Rage even if 1 minute hasn't passed (or a full turn if you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.qMtyQGUllPdgpzUo]{Revitalizing Rage} class feature). If you do, once this Rage ends you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} until you rest for 10 minutes.
_desc_ko: 두 번째 분노 상태에 진입할 수 있으나, 이후 숨을 고를 시간이 필요하다. @link[actions.rage] 상태에 있을 때, 1분이 지나지 않았더라도(혹은 {회복하는 분노} 클래스 특성이 있다면 전체 턴이 지나지 않았더라도) 분노로부터 임시 HP를 얻기로 선택할 수 있다. @link[feats.revitalizing-rage] 클래스 특성을 보유한 경우). 그렇게 할 경우, 이 분노가 끝난 후 10분간 휴식을 취할 때까지 @link[conditions.fatigued]가 된다.

name: Tail Guard

description.value:
Trigger A creature enters a square that would flank you.

Enemies who attempt to stab you in the back will be unhappy to find your lashing tail on guard. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If your attack is a critical hit, the movement is disrupted. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature enters a square that would flank you.

Enemies who attempt to stab you in the back will be unhappy to find your lashing tail on guard. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If your attack is a critical hit, the movement is disrupted. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 생물이 당신을 측면 공격할 수 있는 칸에 진입한다.

당신의 등을 찌르려고 시도하는 적들은 경계 태세의 채찍질하는 꼬리를 마주하게 될 것이다. 발동한 생물에게 근접 공격을 가한다. 공격이 치명타일 경우, 이동이 방해된다. 이 공격은 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되지 않으며, 다중 공격 페널티도 이 공격에는 적용되지 않는다.

name: Eerie Compression

description.value: Your limbs and even your torso can collapse in on themselves, allowing you to fit through tight spaces as though you were a Small creature. You can move at full Speed while Squeezing.

_desc_en: Your limbs and even your torso can collapse in on themselves, allowing you to fit through tight spaces as though you were a Small creature. You can move at full Speed while Squeezing.
_desc_ko: 팔다리는 물론 몸통까지 스스로 붕괴되어, 마치 소형 생물인 것처럼 좁은 공간을 통과할 수 있습니다. 압축 상태에서도 최대 속도로 이동할 수 있습니다.

name: One-Millimeter Punch

description.value:
Your punches have incredible force and control. When you damage a target using One-Inch Punch, you can focus your qi to send the foe flying. If you do, the target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:monk] save against your class DC.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is pushed back 5 feet.

Failure The target is pushed back 10 feet.

Critical Failure The target is pushed back 10 feet for each action you spent on One-Inch Punch.

_desc_en:
Your punches have incredible force and control. When you damage a target using One-Inch Punch, you can focus your qi to send the foe flying. If you do, the target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:monk] save against your class DC.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is pushed back 5 feet.

Failure The target is pushed back 10 feet.

Critical Failure The target is pushed back 10 feet for each action you spent on One-Inch Punch.
_desc_ko:
당신의 주먹은 놀라운 힘과 통제력을 지녔습니다. 원인치 펀치로 대상에게 피해를 입힐 때, 기를 포커스하여 적을 날려버릴 수 있습니다. 그렇게 할 경우, 대상은 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 인내 내성을 시도해야 합니다.

대성공 대상은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 대상이 5피트 뒤로 밀려납니다.

실패 대상이 10피트 뒤로 밀려난다.

대실패 원인치 펀치에 사용한 행동마다 대상이 10피트 밀려납니다.

name: Tactical Cadence

description.value: Your remarkable breath control and concise instructions allow you to coordinate your allies more effectively, even in desperate situations. When you grant allies the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition using Cadence Call, they can use the extra action to either Stride or Strike, and they aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} on their following turn if they use the extra action.

_desc_en: Your remarkable breath control and concise instructions allow you to coordinate your allies more effectively, even in desperate situations. When you grant allies the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition using Cadence Call, they can use the extra action to either Stride or Strike, and they aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} on their following turn if they use the extra action.
_desc_ko: 탁월한 호흡 조절과 간결한 지시로, 절박한 상황에서도 아군을 효과적으로 지휘할 수 있습니다. 동료에게 @link[conditions.quickened] 상태를 부여할 때, 그들은 추가 행동으로 '이동'이나 '공격'을 선택할 수 있으며, 추가 행동을 사용한 경우 다음 턴에 @link[conditions.slowed]{1} 상태가 되지 않습니다.

name: Empowered Onslaught

description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger You critically hit and Sustain a battle aura.

When your body and mind are perfectly in sync and pushed to the limit, it can produce even greater results. You channel your combat focus into the power of your battle auras. Choose one active battle aura you have; that battle aura's status bonus or penalty increases by 1, to a maximum of 4. This value remains for the rest of the aura's duration.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ik5QuOpF0IO275Nm]{Effect: Empowered Onslaught}

_desc_en:
Frequency once per round

Trigger You critically hit and Sustain a battle aura.

When your body and mind are perfectly in sync and pushed to the limit, it can produce even greater results. You channel your combat focus into the power of your battle auras. Choose one active battle aura you have; that battle aura's status bonus or penalty increases by 1, to a maximum of 4. This value remains for the rest of the aura's duration.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ik5QuOpF0IO275Nm]{Effect: Empowered Onslaught}
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 라운드당 1회

발동 조건 치명타를 성공시키고 전투 오라를 유지한다.

신체와 정신이 완벽히 조화를 이루고 한계까지 밀어붙일 때, 더 큰 결과를 만들어낼 수 있다. 전투 포커스를 전투 오라의 힘으로 집중시킨다. 보유한 활성 전투 오라 중 하나를 선택한다. 해당 전투 오라의 상태 보너스 또는 페널티가 1 증가하며, 최대 4까지 상승한다. 이 값은 오라 지속 시간 동안 유지된다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ik5QuOpF0IO275Nm]{효과: 강화된 맹공}

name: Unbalancing Blow

description.value: Interweaving attacks, you unbalance your foes. Whenever your Strike is a critical hit and deals damage, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against your attacks until the end of your next turn.

_desc_en: Interweaving attacks, you unbalance your foes. Whenever your Strike is a critical hit and deals damage, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against your attacks until the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko: 교차하는 공격으로 적의 균형을 무너뜨립니다. 당신의 공격이 치명타로 적중하여 피해를 입힐 때마다, 대상은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 당신의 공격에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Ambersoul

description.value: Your elemental heritage is reflected in the oils and fragrances of plants, in tree resin that fossilizes into amber, or in the gentle smell of a flower. Sticky, golden sap runs through your veins instead of blood. Each time a creature deals slashing or piercing damage to you with a melee Strike, your sap coats its weapon or unarmed attack. The creature takes a –1 circumstance penalty on attack rolls with that weapon or unarmed attack until the end of its turn.

_desc_en: Your elemental heritage is reflected in the oils and fragrances of plants, in tree resin that fossilizes into amber, or in the gentle smell of a flower. Sticky, golden sap runs through your veins instead of blood. Each time a creature deals slashing or piercing damage to you with a melee Strike, your sap coats its weapon or unarmed attack. The creature takes a –1 circumstance penalty on attack rolls with that weapon or unarmed attack until the end of its turn.
_desc_ko: 당신의 원소적 유산은 식물의 기름과 향기, 호박으로 화석화된 나무 수지, 또는 꽃의 은은한 향기 속에 반영됩니다. 당신의 혈관에는 피 대신 끈적한 황금빛 수액이 흐릅니다. 근접 공격으로 당신에게 베기 또는 관통 피해를 입힐 때마다, 그 수액이 상대의 무기나 비무장 공격에 묻습니다. 해당 턴이 끝날 때까지 상대는 그 무기나 비무장 공격으로 명중 굴림에 -1 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Heaven's Step Offense

description.value:
Trigger Your melee Strike reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points

Your lessons from the stage find life in the storied mercy and fearlessness of Grand Prince Gennaris III. With a theatrical flourish, the Strike becomes nonlethal, and you can Stride up to half your Speed in a straight line toward another enemy. This attention-arresting movement does not provoke reactions from enemies unless they are immune to mental effects.

_desc_en:
Trigger Your melee Strike reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points

Your lessons from the stage find life in the storied mercy and fearlessness of Grand Prince Gennaris III. With a theatrical flourish, the Strike becomes nonlethal, and you can Stride up to half your Speed in a straight line toward another enemy. This attention-arresting movement does not provoke reactions from enemies unless they are immune to mental effects.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신의 근접 공격이 생물의 HP를 0으로 감소시킵니다

무대에서의 교훈이 대공 제나리스 3세의 전설적인 자비와 두려움 없는 모습에 생명을 불어넣습니다. 극적인 제스처와 함께 공격은 비살상하게 변하며, 당신은 속도의 절반까지 직선으로 다른 적을 향해 이동할 수 있습니다. 이 주목을 끄는 움직임은 정신 효과에 면역이 아닌 한 적의 반응을 유발하지 않습니다.

name: Heroic Weakness

description.value:
As word of your faith spreads, so too does word of your foibles and weaknesses. Where originally these disadvantages may have been myths themselves, or simply manifestations of ill fortune or chance, when you take this feat, one of those weaknesses becomes real.

Work with your GM to choose your heroic weakness—it must be to a specific damage type and must be associated with a specific condition, both of which must be elements that are going to be significant parts of your story's future. For example, you could choose for a weakness to be spirit damage caused to you by a follower of a rival god, physical damage from a specific category of weapon, void damage caused by a specific kind of undead, or fire damage taken in a certain part of the world or from creatures from that part of the world. The amount of weakness you gain to this damage is equal to twice your level.

But with this new weakness comes a new source of power, for when your foes would take advantage of your weakness, you can use the pain and humiliation to bolster your own resolve. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.k3Dbgb8iS73atDqB]{Makes Me Stronger} reaction.

_desc_en:
As word of your faith spreads, so too does word of your foibles and weaknesses. Where originally these disadvantages may have been myths themselves, or simply manifestations of ill fortune or chance, when you take this feat, one of those weaknesses becomes real.

Work with your GM to choose your heroic weakness—it must be to a specific damage type and must be associated with a specific condition, both of which must be elements that are going to be significant parts of your story's future. For example, you could choose for a weakness to be spirit damage caused to you by a follower of a rival god, physical damage from a specific category of weapon, void damage caused by a specific kind of undead, or fire damage taken in a certain part of the world or from creatures from that part of the world. The amount of weakness you gain to this damage is equal to twice your level.

But with this new weakness comes a new source of power, for when your foes would take advantage of your weakness, you can use the pain and humiliation to bolster your own resolve. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.k3Dbgb8iS73atDqB]{Makes Me Stronger} reaction.
_desc_ko:
당신의 신앙이 퍼져나감에 따라, 당신의 결점과 약점 역시 알려지게 됩니다. 원래 이러한 불리함은 신화 자체였거나 단순히 불운이나 우연의 표현이었을 수 있지만, 이 피트를 선택하면 그 중 하나의 약점이 현실이 됩니다.

GM과 협의하여 영웅적 약점을 선택하십시오. 특정 피해 유형에 대한 취약성과 특정 상태 이상과 연관되어야 하며, 둘 다 향후 이야기에서 중요한 요소가 되어야 합니다. 예를 들어, 경쟁 신의 추종자가 가하는 영혼 피해, 특정 무기 범주에 의한 물리 피해, 특정 종류의 언데드가 가하는 공허 피해, 특정 지역에서 입거나 그 지역 출신 생물에게서 받는 화염 피해 등을 약점으로 선택할 수 있습니다. 이 피해에 대한 약점의 정도는 당신의 레벨의 두 배에 해당합니다.

하지만 이 새로운 약점과 함께 새로운 힘의 원천이 생깁니다. 적들이 당신의 약점을 이용하려 할 때, 당신은 그 고통과 굴욕을 자신의 결의를 다지는 데 활용할 수 있기 때문입니다. 당신은 @link[actions.makes-me-stronger] 반응을 얻습니다.

name: Phalanx Formation

description.value: You know how to clear a line of fire for your allies. You don't provide lesser cover to enemies against your allies' attacks.

_desc_en: You know how to clear a line of fire for your allies. You don't provide lesser cover to enemies against your allies' attacks.
_desc_ko: 동료들을 위해 사격로를 확보하는 방법을 알고 있다. 적에게 동료들의 공격에 대한 반엄폐를 제공하지 않는다.

name: Master Red Mantis Magic

description.value: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

_desc_en: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.
_desc_ko: 달인 주문 시전 숙련의 혜택을 얻습니다.

name: Mounting Leap

description.value:
Requirements You're within 10 feet of a creature that is at least one size larger than you and is willing to be your mount.

You jump atop your mount from afar, landing comfortably astride it. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} toward the creature and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PM5jvValFkbFH3TV]{Mount} it.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're within 10 feet of a creature that is at least one size larger than you and is willing to be your mount.

You jump atop your mount from afar, landing comfortably astride it. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} toward the creature and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PM5jvValFkbFH3TV]{Mount} it.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 자신보다 최소 한 크기 이상 큰 생물체로부터 10피트 이내에 위치하며, 해당 생물체가 자신의 탈것이 되기를 원해야 합니다.

멀리서 탈것 위로 뛰어올라 편안하게 안장 위에 착지한다. @link[actions.leap]생물을 향해 {도약}하고 @link[actions.mount]한다.

name: Link Focus

description.value: Your focus recovers faster. If you have spent at least 2 Focus Points since the last time you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OSefkMgojBLqmRDh]{Refocused}, you recover 2 Focus Points when you Refocus instead of 1.

_desc_en: Your focus recovers faster. If you have spent at least 2 Focus Points since the last time you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OSefkMgojBLqmRDh]{Refocused}, you recover 2 Focus Points when you Refocus instead of 1.
_desc_ko: 포커스 회복 속도가 빨라집니다. 마지막으로 @link[actions.refocus]한 이후 최소 2포커스 포인트를 소모했다면, 포커스 재조정 시 1포커스 포인트가 아닌 2포커스 포인트를 회복합니다.

name: Tripartite Omen

description.value:
You invoke religious portents to ward yourself against danger without losing sight of the history that led to this point. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.9EqUTnbV8WHE2aKm]{Dualistic Synergy}, if your next action is to Cast a Spell from your spell slots and that spell is divine, you gain a +1 status bonus to AC for 1 round. If the spell is a halcyon spell, you gain this benefit in addition to the benefits described in Dualistic Synergy.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.q2t1ZtSPP1p0lz3R]{Effect: Tripartite Omen}

_desc_en:
You invoke religious portents to ward yourself against danger without losing sight of the history that led to this point. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.9EqUTnbV8WHE2aKm]{Dualistic Synergy}, if your next action is to Cast a Spell from your spell slots and that spell is divine, you gain a +1 status bonus to AC for 1 round. If the spell is a halcyon spell, you gain this benefit in addition to the benefits described in Dualistic Synergy.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.q2t1ZtSPP1p0lz3R]{Effect: Tripartite Omen}
_desc_ko:
당신은 종교적 징조를 불러내 위험으로부터 자신을 수호부하지만, 이 지점까지 이르게 한 역사를 잊지 않습니다. @link[feats.dualistic-synergy]를 사용할 때, 다음 행동이 주문 슬롯에서 주문을 시전하는 것이며 해당 주문이 신성 주문일 경우, 1라운드 동안 AC에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 해당 주문이 평온 주문일 경우, 이원적 시너지에 설명된 혜택에 추가로 이 혜택을 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.q2t1ZtSPP1p0lz3R]{효과: 삼중 예감}

name: Changeling Lore

description.value:
All too aware of your true nature, you've studied hags and their powers. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Deception and Occultism. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Hag Lore.

_desc_en:
All too aware of your true nature, you've studied hags and their powers. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Deception and Occultism. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Hag Lore.
_desc_ko:
진정한 본성을 너무나 잘 알고 있기에, 당신은 마녀와 그들의 힘을 연구해왔다. 당신은 기만 및 오컬트에 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻는다. 만약 당신의 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 그 기술 중 하나에 자동으로 숙련되게 된다면, 대신 네가 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련된다.

또한 당신은 @link[feats.additional-lore] 일반 피트를 마녀 지식에 대해 획득한다.

name: Esoteric Reflexes

description.value: Reacting with an implement becomes instinct. At the start of your turn, you gain an additional reaction, which you can use for only reactions granted by your implements.

value.value: an implement that grants a reaction

_desc_en: Reacting with an implement becomes instinct. At the start of your turn, you gain an additional reaction, which you can use for only reactions granted by your implements.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신의 도구들과 매우 강한 유대감을 형성하여, 본능적으로 그 도구들의 반응 능력을 사용할 수 있습니다. 자신의 턴 시작 시, 추가 반응을 얻으며, 이 반응은 오직 자신의 도구들이 부여하는 반응에만 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Advanced Hallowed Spell

description.value:
You dig deeper into the magical tools found in wizard schools and divine domains. You gain an advanced focus spell, either the necromancer advanced school spell @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zvvHOQV78WKUB33l]{Life Siphon} or the advanced domain spell of the death domain, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.J5MNC4xq3CHH31qT]{Eradicate Undeath}. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1. If you choose life siphon, it triggers when you expend spell slots from your class even if they aren't wizard spell slots.

Special You can select this feat a second time, choosing the other advanced focus spell.

value.value: necromancer initial school spell or death initial domain spell

_desc_en:
You dig deeper into the magical tools found in wizard schools and divine domains. You gain an advanced focus spell, either the necromancer advanced school spell @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zvvHOQV78WKUB33l]{Life Siphon} or the advanced domain spell of the death domain, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.J5MNC4xq3CHH31qT]{Eradicate Undeath}. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1. If you choose life siphon, it triggers when you expend spell slots from your class even if they aren't wizard spell slots.

Special You can select this feat a second time, choosing the other advanced focus spell.
_desc_ko:
위자드 학교와 신성 영역에서 발견되는 마법 도구에 대해 더 깊이 연구한다. 네크로맨서 고급 학교 주문 @link[spells.life-siphon] 또는 죽음 영역의 고급 영역 주문 @link[spells.eradicate-undeath] 중 하나를 선택한다. 포커스 풀의 집중 포인트 수를 1 증가시킨다. 생명 흡수를 선택한 경우, 마법사 주문 슬롯이 아니더라도 자신의 클래스 주문 슬롯을 소모할 때 발동한다.

특수 이 피트를 두 번째로 선택할 수 있으며, 다른 고급 포커스 주문 선택을 할 수 있다.

name: Light Step

description.value: You aren't bothered by tricky footing. When you Stride or Step, you can ignore difficult terrain.

_desc_en: You aren't bothered by tricky footing. When you Stride or Step, you can ignore difficult terrain.
_desc_ko: 험한 지형에 방해받지 않습니다. 이동이나 신중함을 기하는 발걸음을 할 때 어려운 지형을 무시할 수 있습니다.

name: Manifold Modifications

description.value: You've modified your innovation using clever workarounds, so you can include another initial modification without compromising its structure. Your innovation gains an additional initial modification from the list for innovations of its type.

_desc_en: You've modified your innovation using clever workarounds, so you can include another initial modification without compromising its structure. Your innovation gains an additional initial modification from the list for innovations of its type.
_desc_ko: 교묘한 해결책으로 혁신을 조정했으므로, 구조를 해치지 않고 또 다른 초기 수정을 포함할 수 있습니다. 해당 유형의 혁신 목록에서 추가 초기 수정을 획득합니다.

name: Contingency Gadgets

description.value:
You are too brilliant to be caught off guard, and you always have just the right gadget for the situation. When you prepare your gadgets during your daily preparations, you can choose to leave one of them as a contingency gadget that you keep ready for just this situation, rather than declaring which gadget you're making. You can pull the contingency gadget out using an Interact action, at which point you must choose which gadget you had prepared as a contingency.

If you're legendary in Crafting, you can leave two contingency gadgets during your daily preparations, instead of just one.

_desc_en:
You are too brilliant to be caught off guard, and you always have just the right gadget for the situation. When you prepare your gadgets during your daily preparations, you can choose to leave one of them as a contingency gadget that you keep ready for just this situation, rather than declaring which gadget you're making. You can pull the contingency gadget out using an Interact action, at which point you must choose which gadget you had prepared as a contingency.

If you're legendary in Crafting, you can leave two contingency gadgets during your daily preparations, instead of just one.
_desc_ko:
당신은 너무나 영리해서 당황하지 않으며, 항상 상황에 딱 맞는 장치를 지니고 있습니다. 일일 준비 단계에서 장치를 준비할 때, 어떤 장치를 만들지 선언하는 대신 이 상황에 대비해 미리 준비해 둔 컨틴전시 장치 하나를 선택해 둘 수 있습니다. 상호작용 행동을 사용해 컨틴전시 도구를 꺼낼 수 있으며, 이때 미리 준비해 둔 컨틴전시 도구 중 하나를 선택해야 합니다.

제작에 전설적인 실력을 지녔다면, 일일 준비 단계에서 컨틴전시 장치를 하나가 아닌 두 개까지 준비해 둘 수 있습니다.

name: Terrain Expertise

description.value:
Your experience in navigating a certain type of terrain makes you supremely confident while doing so. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Survival checks in one of the following types of terrain, chosen when you select this feat: aquatic, arctic, desert, forest, mountain, plains, sky, swamp, or underground.

Special You can select this feat more than once, choosing a different type of terrain each time.

_desc_en:
Your experience in navigating a certain type of terrain makes you supremely confident while doing so. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Survival checks in one of the following types of terrain, chosen when you select this feat: aquatic, arctic, desert, forest, mountain, plains, sky, swamp, or underground.

Special You can select this feat more than once, choosing a different type of terrain each time.
_desc_ko:
특정 지형 탐색 경험으로 인해 해당 지형에서 극도의 자신감을 얻습니다. 이 재주를 선택할 때 지정하는 다음 지형 유형 중 하나에서 생존 판정 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다: 수중, 북극, 사막, 숲, 산악, 평원, 하늘, 습지, 지하.

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있으며, 매번 다른 지형을 선택해야 합니다.

name: Darting Monkey

description.value: You have a heightened awareness in combat, and your darting strikes prevent your foes from distracting you or breaking your focus. When you hit a creature of your level or lower while that creature is flanking you, flanking doesn't make you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to that creature. This benefit lasts until the start of your next turn or until the creature moves, whichever comes first. The creature can still help its other allies flank.

_desc_en: You have a heightened awareness in combat, and your darting strikes prevent your foes from distracting you or breaking your focus. When you hit a creature of your level or lower while that creature is flanking you, flanking doesn't make you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to that creature. This benefit lasts until the start of your next turn or until the creature moves, whichever comes first. The creature can still help its other allies flank.
_desc_ko: 전투 중 당신의 경계심이 강화되어, 날카로운 강타로 적들이 당신을 방해하거나 포커스를 흐트러뜨리지 못하게 합니다. 당신과 같은 레벨 이하의 생물이 당신을 측면 공격할 때, 그 생물의 측면 공격은 당신을 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태로 만들지 않습니다. 이 효과는 당신의 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 또는 해당 생물이 이동할 때까지 지속됩니다(둘 중 먼저 발생하는 시점). 해당 생물은 여전히 다른 아군들의 측면 공격을 도울 수 있습니다.

name: Claim the Field

description.value:
Requirements Your banner is attached to a thrown weapon.

You hurl your banner forward with precision, claiming the battlefield for yourself and your allies. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xEeCaJsQeDtRAVk1]{Plant the Banner}, but you can place it at any corner within the required weapon's first range increment, rather than the corner of your square. The calculated confidence of this brash maneuver unnerves your enemies; any enemy who attempts to damage or remove your banner while it is planted in this way must succeed at a @Check[will|against:commander|options:inflicts:fleeing|traits:incapacitation,mental] save against your class DC or the attempt fails. On a critical failure, the enemy is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round. This is an incapacitation and mental effect.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your banner is attached to a thrown weapon.

You hurl your banner forward with precision, claiming the battlefield for yourself and your allies. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xEeCaJsQeDtRAVk1]{Plant the Banner}, but you can place it at any corner within the required weapon's first range increment, rather than the corner of your square. The calculated confidence of this brash maneuver unnerves your enemies; any enemy who attempts to damage or remove your banner while it is planted in this way must succeed at a @Check[will|against:commander|options:inflicts:fleeing|traits:incapacitation,mental] save against your class DC or the attempt fails. On a critical failure, the enemy is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round. This is an incapacitation and mental effect.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신의 깃발이 투척 무기에 부착되어 있어야 합니다.

정확하게 깃발을 앞으로 던져 전장을 자신과 아군에게 차지합니다. 깃발을 꽂지만, 자신의 칸 모서리가 아닌 요구되는 무기의 첫 번째 사거리 구간 내 어느 모서리에도 배치할 수 있습니다. 이 무모한 작전의 계산된 자신감은 적들을 불안하게 만듭니다. 깃발이 이렇게 꽂혀 있는 동안 깃발에 피해를 주거나 제거하려는 모든 적은 당신의 직업 난이도(DC)에 대한 의지 내성에 성공해야 시도 자체가 실패합니다. 대실패 시, 적은 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.fleeing] 상태가 됩니다. 이는 무력화 및 정신 효과입니다.

name: Broken Chain Dedication

description.value:
Your Calling was sparked by your outrage at tyrants, after having witnessed a brutal act of oppression that you could no longer abide. You may spend a Mythic Point when you attempt an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} check to do so at mythic proficiency. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cwBsPU24715fUCub]{Ultimatum of Liberation} action, but you also gain the anathema, "You must not use Ultimatum of Liberation on a creature you don't believe to be oppressing others or who has conceded their power". If you break this anathema, you lose access to abilities granted by this archetype until you atone or make amends.

Your GM has final say about what constitutes oppression, which can be a difficult and sometimes nebulous concept. In general, oppression is the cruel and unjust use of authority or power. Some examples include performing acts of violence against those without power, removing an individual's agency through mind control magic, and engaging in organized mistreatment or exploitation of others. When the members of a royal guard assault a beggar just to get him off the street, that is oppression. When a tax collector levies higher charges against the less fortunate because it's the law, they are participating in a system of oppression.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.8gUHChhAFihZP5M4]{Broken Chain}

_desc_en:
Your Calling was sparked by your outrage at tyrants, after having witnessed a brutal act of oppression that you could no longer abide. You may spend a Mythic Point when you attempt an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} check to do so at mythic proficiency. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cwBsPU24715fUCub]{Ultimatum of Liberation} action, but you also gain the anathema, "You must not use Ultimatum of Liberation on a creature you don't believe to be oppressing others or who has conceded their power". If you break this anathema, you lose access to abilities granted by this archetype until you atone or make amends.

Your GM has final say about what constitutes oppression, which can be a difficult and sometimes nebulous concept. In general, oppression is the cruel and unjust use of authority or power. Some examples include performing acts of violence against those without power, removing an individual's agency through mind control magic, and engaging in organized mistreatment or exploitation of others. When the members of a royal guard assault a beggar just to get him off the street, that is oppression. When a tax collector levies higher charges against the less fortunate because it's the law, they are participating in a system of oppression.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.8gUHChhAFihZP5M4]{Broken Chain}
_desc_ko:
당신의 소명은 더 이상 참을 수 없는 잔혹한 억압 행위를 목격한 후, 폭군들에 대한 분노에서 비롯되었습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.escape] 시도할 때마다 Mythic Point를 사용할 수 있습니다. @link[actions.force-open] 판정 시 신화적 숙련도로 수행할 수 있습니다. 또한 @link[actions.ultimatum-of-liberation] 행동을 얻지만, 동시에 "당신은 타인을 억압하지 않는다고 믿거나 권력을 포기한 존재에게는 해방의 최후통첩을 사용해서는 안 된다"는 저주를 받습니다. 이 저주를 어길 경우, 속죄하거나 보상할 때까지 이 아키타입이 부여하는 능력을 사용할 수 없게 됩니다.

억압의 정의는 GM의 최종 판단에 따르며, 이는 때로 모호하고 어려운 개념일 수 있습니다. 일반적으로 억압이란 권위나 힘을 잔혹하고 부당하게 행사하는 것을 의미합니다. 예를 들어 무력한 자에 대한 폭력 행위, 정신 통제 마법으로 개인의 의지를 박탈하는 행위, 조직적인 학대나 착취 등이 포함됩니다. 왕실 경비대가 거리를 비우기 위해 거지를 폭행하는 것은 억압입니다. 세금 징수원이 질서라는 이유로 불우한 이들에게 더 높은 세금을 부과하는 것은 억압 체제에 가담하는 행위입니다.

name: Incredible Investiture

description.value: You have an incredible ability to invest more magic items. Increase your limit on invested items from 10 to 12.

_desc_en: You have an incredible ability to invest more magic items. Increase your limit on invested items from 10 to 12.
_desc_ko: 당신은 마법 아이템을 더 많이 장착할 수 있는 놀라운 능력을 지녔습니다. 장착 가능한 아이템 한도가 10개에서 12개로 증가합니다.

name: Bear Empathy

description.value: You have a magical affinity for bears and can speak to them through sounds and body language. You can communicate with all bears, as well as other ursine creatures at the GM's discretion.

_desc_en: You have a magical affinity for bears and can speak to them through sounds and body language. You can communicate with all bears, as well as other ursine creatures at the GM's discretion.
_desc_ko: 곰과 마법적 교감을 가지며 소리나 몸짓으로 소통할 수 있습니다. 모든 곰은 물론, GM의 재량에 따라 다른 곰과 유사한 생물과도 의사소통이 가능합니다.

name: Occult Dragonblood

description.value: Your blood contains a tiny fragment of unusual or inexplicable power from a mysterious dragon, such as a conspirator dragon or omen dragon. You are drawn to the stranger parts of the world and can generally spot them with a glance. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Occultism. If you would automatically become trained in Occultism (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.hDGosy2ZTwnyctEP]{Oddity Identification} skill feat. If you choose a draconic exemplar, you must choose an occult dragon.

_desc_en: Your blood contains a tiny fragment of unusual or inexplicable power from a mysterious dragon, such as a conspirator dragon or omen dragon. You are drawn to the stranger parts of the world and can generally spot them with a glance. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Occultism. If you would automatically become trained in Occultism (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.hDGosy2ZTwnyctEP]{Oddity Identification} skill feat. If you choose a draconic exemplar, you must choose an occult dragon.
_desc_ko: 당신의 혈액에는 음모의 용이나 전조의 용과 같은 신비로운 용으로부터 비롯된 비정상적이거나 설명할 수 없는 힘의 미세한 조각이 담겨 있습니다. 당신은 세상의 기이한 부분들에 끌리며, 대개 한눈에 그것들을 알아볼 수 있습니다. 당신은 오컬트에 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 오컬트에 자동으로 숙련된 상태가 된다면, 대신 선택한 기술에 숙련된 상태가 됩니다. 당신은 @link[feats.oddity-identification] 기술 재주를 얻습니다. 용의 전형(드라코닉 이그젬플러)을 선택할 경우, 반드시 오컬트 드래곤을 선택해야 합니다.

name: Masked Casting

description.value:
Trigger You begin Casting a Spell.

Requirements You're wearing your signifer's mask.

You harness the magical energy flowing through your eyeless mask to effortlessly protect you from visual effects. You [[/act avert-gaze]]. While Averting your Gaze in this way, you also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws and checks to disbelieve illusions.

_desc_en:
Trigger You begin Casting a Spell.

Requirements You're wearing your signifer's mask.

You harness the magical energy flowing through your eyeless mask to effortlessly protect you from visual effects. You [[/act avert-gaze]]. While Averting your Gaze in this way, you also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws and checks to disbelieve illusions.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 신호병의 가면을 쓰고 있다.

발동 조건 당신이 주문을 시전하기 시작합니다.

눈이 없는 가면을 통해 흐르는 마법 에너지를 활용하여 시각적 효과로부터 손쉽게 자신을 보호합니다. 당신은 @link[actions.avert-gaze].

name: Familiar Master Dedication

description.value:
You have forged a mystical bond with a creature. This might have involved complex rituals and invocations, such as meditating under the moon until something crept out of the forest. Or maybe you just did each other a good turn, such as rescuing the beast from a trap or a foe, and then being rescued in turn.

Whatever the details, you are now comrades until the end. You gain a familiar. If you already have a familiar, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.N7dTFxpjXGn4ddq8]{Enhanced Familiar} feat.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.yaR8E2drX6pFUFCK]{Familiar Master}

_desc_en:
You have forged a mystical bond with a creature. This might have involved complex rituals and invocations, such as meditating under the moon until something crept out of the forest. Or maybe you just did each other a good turn, such as rescuing the beast from a trap or a foe, and then being rescued in turn.

Whatever the details, you are now comrades until the end. You gain a familiar. If you already have a familiar, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.N7dTFxpjXGn4ddq8]{Enhanced Familiar} feat.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.yaR8E2drX6pFUFCK]{Familiar Master}
_desc_ko:
당신은 한 생물과 신비로운 유대를 맺었습니다. 이는 복잡한 의식과 주문이 수반되었을 수 있습니다. 예를 들어 달빛 아래 명상하다가 숲에서 무언가가 기어 나오는 것을 목격하는 식이죠. 아니면 단순히 서로에게 큰 도움을 주고받은 것일 수도 있습니다. 예를 들어 덫이나 적에게서 그 짐승을 구해준 뒤, 그 대가로 당신도 구출받는 식이죠.

세부 사항은 어찌 되었든, 이제 당신은 끝까지 함께하는 동료가 되었습니다. 당신은 패밀리어를 얻습니다. 이미 패밀리어가 있다면, @link[feats.enhanced-familiar] 피트를 얻습니다.

name: You Can't Hide From Us

description.value:
Requirements Your united companion made a successful Strike against a creature this round.

When you and your companion attack together, you can ensure that escape is but a whispered dream. Strike the same creature that your united companion hit. If your Strike is successful, the targeted creature has been marked for death by you and your companion and can't become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to you and your companion for 1 minute or until it moves more than 60 feet away from either you or your companion, whichever comes first. If the triggering creature is under an effect or spell that would normally grant it this condition, you can immediately attempt to counteract the effect. Your counteract rank is half your level rounded up, and your counteract check modifier is equal to the higher of your class DC –10 or spell DC –10.

_desc_ko:
요구 사항 이번 턴에 당신의 연합한 동료가 생물에게 성공적인 공격을 가했습니다.

당신과 동료가 함께 공격할 때, 당신은 도망이 속삭임 같은 꿈에 불과하도록 만들 수 있습니다. 동료가 공격한 동일한 생물을 강타하십시오. 공격이 성공하면, 표적 생물은 당신과 동료에게 죽음의 표식을 받게 되며, 1분 동안 또는 당신이나 동료로부터 60피트 이상 떨어질 때까지(둘 중 먼저 발생하는 경우) 당신과 동료에게 @link[conditions.hidden] 또는 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태가 될 수 없습니다. 발동 생물이 이 상태를 부여하는 효과나 주문 아래에 있을 경우, 즉시 해당 효과를 반격하는 시도할 수 있습니다. 반격 랭크은 레벨의 절반(올림)이며, 반격 판정 수정자는 직업 DC -10과 주문 DC -10 중 높은 값입니다.

name: Lingering Flames

description.value:
When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{Fireball}, you can modify its effects, decreasing the base damage to 5d6 and causing it to deal 2 persistent fire damage to creatures that fail their save, doubled as normal on a critical failure. If you do, replace its heightened entry with the following.

Heightened (+1) The damage is increased by 1d6 and the persistent fire damage is increased by 2.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en:
When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{Fireball}, you can modify its effects, decreasing the base damage to 5d6 and causing it to deal 2 persistent fire damage to creatures that fail their save, doubled as normal on a critical failure. If you do, replace its heightened entry with the following.

Heightened (+1) The damage is increased by 1d6 and the persistent fire damage is increased by 2.
_desc_ko:
{화염구}를 시전할 때, 그 효과를 수정할 수 있다. 기본 피해를 5d6으로 감소시키고, 내성에 실패한 생물에게 2의 지속 화상 피해를 입히며, 대실패 시 정상적으로 두 배로 증가시킨다. 이렇게 할 경우, 강화 항목을 다음과 같이 대체한다.

강화 (+1) 피해량이 1d6 증가하고 지속 화상 피해가 2 증가합니다.

name: Titan Slinger

description.value: You have learned how to use your sling to fell enormous creatures. When you hit on an attack with a weapon of the sling group against a Large or larger creature, increase the size of the weapon damage die by one step.

_desc_en: You have learned how to use your sling to fell enormous creatures. When you hit on an attack with a weapon of the sling group against a Large or larger creature, increase the size of the weapon damage die by one step.
_desc_ko: 당신은 슬링으로 거대한 생물을 쓰러뜨리는 법을 익혔습니다. 슬링 계열 무기로 대형 이상의 생물을 공격해 명중했을 때, 무기 피해 주사위 크기를 한 단계 증가시킵니다.

name: Defensive Coordination

description.value: Like the storied heroes who persist in the face of overwhelming odds, you and your allies will hold the line. If your next action is to cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.bH0kPuf7UKxRvi2P]{Rallying Anthem} composition cantrip, you can Raise a Shield, and one ally of your choice who gains a status bonus from the spell can immediately use their reaction to Raise a Shield.

_desc_en: Like the storied heroes who persist in the face of overwhelming odds, you and your allies will hold the line. If your next action is to cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.bH0kPuf7UKxRvi2P]{Rallying Anthem} composition cantrip, you can Raise a Shield, and one ally of your choice who gains a status bonus from the spell can immediately use their reaction to Raise a Shield.
_desc_ko: 압도적인 역경 속에서도 꿋꿋이 버티는 전설의 영웅들처럼, 당신과 동맹들은 전선을 지킬 것입니다. 다음 행동으로 @link[spells.rallying-anthem] 작곡 캔트립을 시전할 경우, 당신은 방패를 들어올릴 수 있으며, 이 주문으로 상태 보너스를 얻는 선택한 아군 한 명이 즉시 반응으로 방패를 들어올릴 수 있습니다.

name: Witch's Charge

description.value:
You forge a magical link with another creature, granting you awareness of that creature's condition and creating a conduit for spellcasting. During your daily preparations, you can designate one willing creature as your charge. You are always aware of your charge's direction from you, its distance from you, and any conditions affecting it. In addition, you can cast spells with a range of touch on your charge from a range of 30 feet. These effects persist until your next daily preparations.

Special This feat has the trait corresponding to the tradition of spells you cast (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

_desc_en:
You forge a magical link with another creature, granting you awareness of that creature's condition and creating a conduit for spellcasting. During your daily preparations, you can designate one willing creature as your charge. You are always aware of your charge's direction from you, its distance from you, and any conditions affecting it. In addition, you can cast spells with a range of touch on your charge from a range of 30 feet. These effects persist until your next daily preparations.

Special This feat has the trait corresponding to the tradition of spells you cast (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).
_desc_ko:
당신은 다른 생물과 마법적 연결을 형성하여 그 생물의 상태를 인지하고 주문 시전을 위한 통로를 만듭니다. 일일 준비 시간 동안, 당신은 한 명의 동의한 생물을 당신의 보호 대상으로 지정할 수 있습니다. 당신은 항상 보호 대상이 당신으로부터 어느 방향에 있는지, 당신과의 거리, 그리고 그 생물에게 영향을 미치는 모든 상태를 인지합니다. 또한 30피트 거리에서 보호 대상에게 접촉 범위의 주문을 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 효과는 다음 일일 준비 시간까지 지속됩니다.

특수 이 피트는 당신이 시전하는 주문 전통(아케인, 신성, 오컬트, 프라이멀)에 해당하는 특성을 지닙니다.

name: Irresistible Magic

description.value: You've studied ways of overcoming the innate defenses against magic that dragons, otherworldly beings, and certain other powerful creatures have. Any creature that has a status bonus to saving throws against magic reduces that bonus by 1 against your spells.

_desc_en: You've studied ways of overcoming the innate defenses against magic that dragons, otherworldly beings, and certain other powerful creatures have. Any creature that has a status bonus to saving throws against magic reduces that bonus by 1 against your spells.
_desc_ko: 당신은 용, 초자연적 존재, 그리고 특정 강력한 생물들이 지닌 마법에 대한 선천적 방어력을 극복하는 방법을 연구했습니다. 마법에 대한 내성 굴림에 상태 보너스를 가진 모든 생물은 당신의 주문에 대해 그 보너스를 1 감소시킵니다.

name: Ghost Dedication

description.value:
You have risen as a shell of your former self, a spirit of mist and anguish. You gain the ghost, spirit, and undead traits, and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.ancestryfeatures.Item.SAbzItAI4uwbdnQk]{Basic Undead Benefits}. Your undead craving is to settle your unfinished business. You also gain the incorporeal trait, except you can't pass through solid objects unless you select the Pass Through feat. Being a ghost has the following major effects.

Floating You can float but are still tethered to the ground. Replace your land Speed with an equal fly Speed. You can't rise more than a few inches above the ground when you Fly. This means you can move above many types of difficult or hazardous terrain without moving slowly or being damaged, even though you can't fly without limit. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump}, and take similar actions, and use your fly Speed for any calculations that would normally require your land Speed.

Items You can transmute physical items to make them part of your incorporeal form. This requires spending 10 minutes with the items within reach, during which you transform the items into part of your form; you can return items you already have incorporated to a corporeal state at the same time. The items retain all their runes and other abilities, need to be invested normally if they have the invested trait, and need to be worn, held, or stowed appropriately. Once you've incorporated the items, you and other incorporeal creatures can use them normally-you can Interact with them, Release them, and so on. Your incorporated weapons gain the benefits of the ghost touch property rune, allowing you to use them normally against both corporeal and incorporeal creatures. Incorporated items become corporeal again only if you transmute them back or are destroyed, in which case, they drop to the ground under you.

Attacks Your unarmed attacks become magical and deal void damage instead of their normal type.

Strength Unlike most incorporeal creatures, your Strength modifier is not -5; you keep the same Strength score you had before you became a ghost, though you can only attempt Strength-based skill checks-typically Athletics checks-against other incorporeal creatures, as normal for an incorporeal creature. Against incorporeal creatures, use your Strength normally to determine the results of Athletics checks, Strikes with melee weapons, and any other checks or damage rolls dependent on Strength.

Ties that Bind When you become a ghost, work with your GM to choose a bound site and unfinished business, both of which matter for your character's story, as well as some ghost archetype feats. Your bound site tethers you to the physical world and is typically either a location important to you in life or the place where you died. Unfinished business keeps you from passing to the afterlife. If someone resolves your unfinished business, you decide whether to accept the change and pass on, or to fight it. If you pass on, you get a few minutes to say your goodbyes, and then move into the River of Souls and the afterlife. Your character ceases to be. If you fight the change, you remain, though you and the GM might determine a new unfinished business. If you are physically destroyed, you cease your existence as a ghost but still might not be able to pass on to the afterlife if your unfinished business is incomplete. In this liminal state, you might come across strange energies and become another sort of creature, or anchor to a summoner and become an eidolon.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.aIpIUbupTjw2863C]{Ghost}
