Your flesh grows thick and bloated, protecting you against harm. You gain resistance equal to half your level versus one of the following types of damage, chosen when you take the feat: fire, cold, or bludgeoning. This choice cannot be changed.

When you're unarmored, your flesh gives you a +2 item bonus to AC with a Dexterity cap of +3. You can apply with armor potency runes and property runes directly to your flesh, though excruciatingly painful.

Special You can take this feat up to three times, each time selecting a new damage type from the list.
_desc_ko:
당신의 살갗이 두껍고 부풀어 올라 피해를 막아줍니다. 이 재주를 선택할 때 다음 중 하나의 피해 유형에 대해 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 저항력을 얻습니다: 화염, 냉기, 타격. 이 선택은 변경할 수 없습니다.

갑옷을 착용하지 않았을 때, 네 살갗이 민첩 상한 +3까지 AC에 +2 아이템 보너스를 제공한다. 갑옷의 위력 룬이나 속성 룬을 살갗에 직접 새길 수 있으나, 극심한 고통을 동반한다.

특수 이 피트를 최대 세 번까지 선택할 수 있으며, 매번 목록에서 새로운 피해 유형을 선택해야 합니다.

name: Ambush Awareness

description.value: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks attempted as initiative rolls. Additionally, if your initiative roll result is tied with that of an opponent, you go first, regardless of whether you rolled Perception or not.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks attempted as initiative rolls. Additionally, if your initiative roll result is tied with that of an opponent, you go first, regardless of whether you rolled Perception or not.
_desc_ko: 이니셔티브 주사위 굴림으로 시도하는 지각력 판정 시 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 또한, 상대방과 이니셔티브 주사위 굴림 결과가 동점일 경우, 지각력 판정을 굴렸는지 여부와 관계없이 당신이 먼저 행동합니다.

name: Faith in the Fallen

description.value:
Access You're a member of the Vellumis Scholars.

The Gravelands are full of fallen spirits seeking to move on, and you consider it your obligation to assist in that regard. You gain the ability to store spirit wisps in your body, becoming a living spirit dwelling (see the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.WvleaXPfigawBvtN]{Exorcist} archetype). Each day during your daily preparations, your spirit dwelling attracts a spirit wisp who comes to dwell inside. If your spirit dwelling contains no wisps, you can spend 10 minutes in a minor ritual to cast your spirit dwelling around an area and attract another wisp. Additionally, you gain a spirit wisp when a haunt or incorporeal undead creature is destroyed within 30 feet of you.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.am7GMqh4t7m7bbaW]{Spirit Sanctification} action.

Every day before your daily preparations, any spirit wisps remaining within your spirit dwelling from the previous day are purified and can continue along the River of Souls.

_desc_en:
Access You're a member of the Vellumis Scholars.

The Gravelands are full of fallen spirits seeking to move on, and you consider it your obligation to assist in that regard. You gain the ability to store spirit wisps in your body, becoming a living spirit dwelling (see the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.WvleaXPfigawBvtN]{Exorcist} archetype). Each day during your daily preparations, your spirit dwelling attracts a spirit wisp who comes to dwell inside. If your spirit dwelling contains no wisps, you can spend 10 minutes in a minor ritual to cast your spirit dwelling around an area and attract another wisp. Additionally, you gain a spirit wisp when a haunt or incorporeal undead creature is destroyed within 30 feet of you.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.am7GMqh4t7m7bbaW]{Spirit Sanctification} action.

Every day before your daily preparations, any spirit wisps remaining within your spirit dwelling from the previous day are purified and can continue along the River of Souls.
_desc_ko:
접근 당신은 벨루미스 학회의 일원입니다.

그레이브 랜드는 떠나고자 하는 타락한 영혼들로 가득 차 있으며, 당신은 그들을 돕는 것을 자신의 의무로 여깁니다. 당신은 영혼의 위습을 몸속에 저장할 수 있는 능력을 얻어 살아있는 영혼의 거처가 됩니다(@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.WvleaXPfigawBvtN]{엑소시스트} 아키타입 참조). 매일 수행하는 일과 중, 당신의 영혼의 거처는 그 안에 머물러 살기 위해 찾아오는 영혼의 위습 하나를 끌어당깁니다. 영혼의 거처에 영혼의 불꽃이 없을 경우, 10분간의 간단한 의식으로 영혼의 거처를 주변 지역에 펼쳐 다른 위습을 끌어들일 수 있습니다. 또한, 30피트 이내에서 유령이나 비물질적 언데드 생물이 파괴될 때마다 영혼의 위습 하나를 얻습니다.

당신은 @link[actions.spirit-sanctification] 행동을 얻습니다.

매일 일일 준비 전에, 전날부터 영혼의 거처 내에 남아 있던 모든 영혼의 위습이 정화되어 영혼의 강을 따라 계속 나아갈 수 있습니다.

name: Topple Foe

description.value:
Trigger An ally succeeds at a melee Strike against an enemy you are both adjacent to.

You take advantage of the opening created by your ally to tip your foe off their feet. Attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} the target of the triggering attack.

_desc_en:
Trigger An ally succeeds at a melee Strike against an enemy you are both adjacent to.

You take advantage of the opening created by your ally to tip your foe off their feet. Attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} the target of the triggering attack.
_desc_ko:
발동 아군이 당신과 인접한 적에게 근접 공격을 성공시킬 때.

동료가 만든 틈을 이용해 적을 넘어뜨린다. 발동 공격의 대상에게 @link[actions.trip]를 시도하다.

name: Leshy Familiar

description.value: You call a minor spirit of nature into a plant body, creating a leshy companion to aid you in your spellcasting. You gain a familiar, which has your choice of either the plant or fungus familiar ability; this doesn't count against your usual limit of familiar abilities (typically 2). The spirit you call has a more tenuous connection to its plant body than fully independent leshies, so it is Tiny in size like other familiars.

_desc_en: You call a minor spirit of nature into a plant body, creating a leshy companion to aid you in your spellcasting. You gain a familiar, which has your choice of either the plant or fungus familiar ability; this doesn't count against your usual limit of familiar abilities (typically 2). The spirit you call has a more tenuous connection to its plant body than fully independent leshies, so it is Tiny in size like other familiars.
_desc_ko: 당신은 식물체에 자연의 최하급 영혼을 불러들여, 당신의 주문 시전을 돕는 레시 동반자를 창조합니다. 당신은 식물 또는 균류 패밀리어 능력 중 하나를 선택할 수 있는 패밀리어를 얻습니다. 이는 일반적인 패밀리어 능력 제한(보통 2개)에 포함되지 않습니다. 소환된 영혼은 완전히 독립적인 레시보다 식물 몸체와의 연결이 더 약하므로, 다른 친숙과 마찬가지로 크기가 아주 작습니다.

name: Breath of the Dragon (Dragonblood)

description.value:
Tapping into the physiology of your draconic ancestor, you can exhale a torrent of energy in a @Template[cone|distance:15] or a @Template[line|distance:30], dealing 1d4 damage. Each creature in the area must attempt a basic saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. You can't use this ability again for [[/r 1d4 #Recharge Breath of the Dragon]]{1d4 rounds}.

At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d4. The shape of the breath, the damage type, and the saving throw match those of your draconic exemplar. This ability has the trait associated with the type of damage it deals.

_desc_en:
Tapping into the physiology of your draconic ancestor, you can exhale a torrent of energy in a @Template[cone|distance:15] or a @Template[line|distance:30], dealing 1d4 damage. Each creature in the area must attempt a basic saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. You can't use this ability again for [[/r 1d4 #Recharge Breath of the Dragon]]{1d4 rounds}.

At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d4. The shape of the breath, the damage type, and the saving throw match those of your draconic exemplar. This ability has the trait associated with the type of damage it deals.
_desc_ko:
용의 드라코닉 혈통을 가진 조상의 생리적 특성을 활용하여, 15피트 또는 30피트 범위로 에너지 폭풍을 내뿜어 1d4의 피해를 입힐 수 있습니다. 에 있는 모든 생물은 당신의 클래스 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽에 대한 기본 내성 굴림을 시도해야 합니다. 이 능력은 1d4 라운드 동안 다시 사용할 수 없습니다.

3레벨과 이후 2레벨마다 피해량이 1d4 증가한다. 불기의 형태, 피해 유형, 내성 굴림은 네 드라코닉 이그젬플러의 것과 동일하다. 이 능력은 가하는 피해 유형과 관련된 특성을 지닌다.

name: Basic Oracle Spellcasting

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{Basic Spellcasting Feat} benefits. When you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the oracle archetype, add a common divine spell or another divine spell you have learned or discovered (including the granted spells associated with your mystery) to your repertoire, of that spell rank.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{Basic Spellcasting Feat} benefits. When you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the oracle archetype, add a common divine spell or another divine spell you have learned or discovered (including the granted spells associated with your mystery) to your repertoire, of that spell rank.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{기본 주문 시전 피트}의 혜택을 얻습니다. 오라클 아키타입으로부터 새로운 랭크의 주문 슬롯을 획득할 때, 해당 랭크의 일반 신성 주문 또는 당신이 배웠거나 발견한 다른 신성 주문(당신의 신비와 연관된 부여된 주문 포함)을 당신의 레퍼토리에 추가합니다.

name: Volcanic Escape

description.value:
Trigger An enemy in your kinetic aura damages you.

Lava reflexively explodes underneath you and the creature that hurt you. The triggering enemy takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -6)/4)+1)d6[fire]] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic] save against your class DC. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} up to half your Speed in any direction; this movement doesn't trigger reactions.

Level (+4) The damage increases by 1d6.

_desc_en:
Trigger An enemy in your kinetic aura damages you.

Lava reflexively explodes underneath you and the creature that hurt you. The triggering enemy takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -6)/4)+1)d6[fire]] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic] save against your class DC. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} up to half your Speed in any direction; this movement doesn't trigger reactions.

Level (+4) The damage increases by 1d6.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신의 키네틱 오라 안에 있는 적이 당신에게 피해를 입힙니다.

당신과 당신을 공격한 생물 아래에서 용암이 반사적으로 폭발합니다. 발동시킨 적은 화염의 피해를 입으며, 당신의 직업 DC에 대한 기본 반사 내성을 수행합니다. 당신은 @link[actions.leap]으로 이동 속도의 절반까지 어느 방향으로든 이동합니다. 이 이동은 반응을 발동시키지 않습니다.

레벨 (+4) 피해량이 1d6 증가합니다.

name: Tumbling Theft

description.value: You reach for an opponent's item as you move past a foe. If you critically succeed at your check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} an enemy's space, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} something from the enemy as a reaction. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Thievery check to Steal as your tumbling make it difficult for your enemy to keep track of your movement. You can Steal any immediately accessible item of light or negligible Bulk on the enemy's person, such as a potion or coin purse hanging from a belt, but not anything inside a container or anything the enemy is holding. The GM has final say on what you can Steal.

_desc_en: You reach for an opponent's item as you move past a foe. If you critically succeed at your check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} an enemy's space, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} something from the enemy as a reaction. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Thievery check to Steal as your tumbling make it difficult for your enemy to keep track of your movement. You can Steal any immediately accessible item of light or negligible Bulk on the enemy's person, such as a potion or coin purse hanging from a belt, but not anything inside a container or anything the enemy is holding. The GM has final say on what you can Steal.
_desc_ko: 적 옆을 지나갈 때 상대의 아이템을 훔친다. 적의 공간을 @link[actions.tumble-through]하는 데 대성공할 경우, 반응으로 @link[actions.steal] 를 시도할 수 있다. 회피 돌파가 적의 추적을 어렵게 하여 훔치기 도둑질 판정 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻는다. 적의 몸에 바로 접근 가능한 가벼운 물건이나 벌크가 미미한 물건(예: 벨트에 매달린 물약이나 동전 주머니)은 훔칠 수 있으나, 용기 안에 있는 물건이나 적이 들고 있는 물건은 훔칠 수 없습니다. 훔칠 수 있는 물건에 대한 최종 결정권은 GM에게 있습니다.

name: Fane's Fourberie

description.value:
Stella Fane has perfected a technique for using playing cards as weapons that's one part sleight of hand and one part magic.

When you enter this stance, choose whether to treat playing cards in your possession as daggers or darts; you can wield a playing card in all ways as the chosen weapon until the stance ends. As long as the majority of the deck remains in your possession, any cards that are lost or thrown can be found after 1 minute. Otherwise, the remaining cards are likely lost or destroyed.

A character who has this feat can enchant a single deck of playing cards as a magic weapon, etching fundamental and property runes directly onto the deck of cards.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en:
Stella Fane has perfected a technique for using playing cards as weapons that's one part sleight of hand and one part magic.

When you enter this stance, choose whether to treat playing cards in your possession as daggers or darts; you can wield a playing card in all ways as the chosen weapon until the stance ends. As long as the majority of the deck remains in your possession, any cards that are lost or thrown can be found after 1 minute. Otherwise, the remaining cards are likely lost or destroyed.

A character who has this feat can enchant a single deck of playing cards as a magic weapon, etching fundamental and property runes directly onto the deck of cards.
_desc_ko:
스텔라 페인은 카드 기술을 무기로 활용하는 기법을 완성했는데, 이는 손재주와 마법이 결합된 것이다.

이 자세를 취할 때, 소지한 카드들을 단검으로 취급할지, 아니면 다트로 취급할지 선택하십시오. 자세가 끝날 때까지 선택한 무기로 카드를 모든 방식으로 휘둘 수 있습니다. 카드 덱의 대부분이 계속 소지되어 있는 한, 잃어버리거나 던져진 카드는 1분 후에 찾을 수 있습니다. 그렇지 않으면 남은 카드들은 분실되거나 파괴될 가능성이 높습니다.

이 피트를 가진 캐릭터는 한 벌의 카드 덱을 마법 무기로 마법 부여할 수 있으며, 카드 덱에 직접 기본 및 속성 룬을 새길 수 있다.

name: Loaner Spell

description.value:
During your daily preparations, you can gain the assistance of an allied prepared spellcaster to prepare one spell for the day. The spell can be up to 3rd level. Your ally must be able to prepare and cast it, and the spell must have a Targets entry or an area. Your ally loses a spell slot of the corresponding spell rank, and you gain the ability to cast the prepared spell once that day.

When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast the Spell}, use your class DC for any saving throws required by the spell, and your class DC - 10 as a spell attack roll modifier.

value.value: trained in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion

_desc_en:
During your daily preparations, you can gain the assistance of an allied prepared spellcaster to prepare one spell for the day. The spell can be up to 3rd level. Your ally must be able to prepare and cast it, and the spell must have a Targets entry or an area. Your ally loses a spell slot of the corresponding spell rank, and you gain the ability to cast the prepared spell once that day.

When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast the Spell}, use your class DC for any saving throws required by the spell, and your class DC - 10 as a spell attack roll modifier.
_desc_ko:
일일 준비 시간 동안, 동맹 관계의 준비된 주문 시전자의 도움을 받아 하루 동안 사용할 주문 하나를 준비할 수 있습니다. 해당 주문은 최대 3레벨까지 가능합니다. 동료는 해당 주문을 준비하고 시전할 수 있어야 하며, 주문은 대상 항목이나 영역을 가져야 합니다. 동료는 해당 주문 랭크에 해당하는 주문 슬롯을 잃고, 당신은 그날 한 번 그 준비된 주문을 시전할 수 있는 능력을 얻습니다.

당신이 @link[actions.cast-a-spell], 주문이 요구하는 모든 내성 굴림에는 당신의 직업 DC를 사용하고, 주문 명중 굴림 수정자로는 당신의 직업 DC - 10을 사용합니다.

name: Warp Likeness

description.value:
Frequency once per minute

Requirements You hit a creature with a melee Strike on your last action.

You channel some of your own nature through your blow, temporarily warping your target's form to resemble your own. The creature you hit must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target resists the effect but its form twists in the process. It's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until the end of its next turn.

Failure The target's body briefly warps to resemble yours. It's clumsy 1 until the end of its next turn and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The target's body warps to resemble yours for a significant time. It's clumsy 1 for 1 minute and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per minute

Requirements You hit a creature with a melee Strike on your last action.

You channel some of your own nature through your blow, temporarily warping your target's form to resemble your own. The creature you hit must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target resists the effect but its form twists in the process. It's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until the end of its next turn.

Failure The target's body briefly warps to resemble yours. It's clumsy 1 until the end of its next turn and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The target's body warps to resemble yours for a significant time. It's clumsy 1 for 1 minute and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 분당 1회

요구 사항 마지막 행동으로 근접 공격으로 생물을 명중시켰습니다.

당신은 자신의 본성을 일부 불어넣어 타격함으로써, 일시적으로 대상의 형태를 자신과 유사하게 변형시킵니다. 맞은 생물은 당신의 직업 난이도(DC)와 주문 DC(DC) 중 높은 쪽에 대한 인내 내성을 시도해야 합니다.

대성공 대상은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 대상은 효과를 저항하지만 그 과정에서 형태가 뒤틀립니다. 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.clumsy]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

실패 대상의 몸이 잠시 당신을 닮도록 뒤틀린다. 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 둔함 1 상태가 되며 @link[conditions.sickened]{1} 상태가 된다.

대실패 대상의 몸이 상당한 시간 동안 당신을 닮도록 왜곡됩니다. 1분 동안 둔함 1 상태가 되며 @link[conditions.sickened]{2} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Heroic Defiance

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} condition.

Even as shadows of your doom haunt the corners of your vision, your implacable spirit surges and cries out that your time has not yet come. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level and a +1 status bonus to all saving throws, both of which last for 1 minute.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} condition.

Even as shadows of your doom haunt the corners of your vision, your implacable spirit surges and cries out that your time has not yet come. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level and a +1 status bonus to all saving throws, both of which last for 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
발동 주기 10분에 한 번

발동 조건 당신은 @link[conditions.doomed] 상태를 얻습니다.

죽음의 그림자가 시야 구석구석을 배회하지만, 당신의 불굴의 영혼이 솟구쳐 아직 때가 아니라고 외칩니다. 레벨에 해당하는 임시 HP와 모든 내성 굴림에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻으며, 둘 다 1분 동안 지속됩니다.

name: Stoney Skin

description.value: Your skin takes on the hardness of stone. You gain resistance to physical damage (except adamantine) equal to your number of class feats from the Stone Brawler archetype.

_desc_en: Your skin takes on the hardness of stone. You gain resistance to physical damage (except adamantine) equal to your number of class feats from the Stone Brawler archetype.
_desc_ko: 피부가 돌처럼 단단해집니다. 스톤 브롤러 아키타입의 클래스 피트 수만큼 물리 피해(아다만틴 제외)에 대한 저항력을 얻습니다.

name: Snowcaster

description.value: Your magical power grows as the shard's icy influence spreads ever deeper into your being. You gain the basic spellcasting benefits. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new level from this archetype, add a spell of the appropriate spell rank (including heightened versions of lower-rank spells) to your repertoire, either a common spell of the arcane tradition that has the cold trait or another cold spell you have access to.

_desc_en: Your magical power grows as the shard's icy influence spreads ever deeper into your being. You gain the basic spellcasting benefits. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new level from this archetype, add a spell of the appropriate spell rank (including heightened versions of lower-rank spells) to your repertoire, either a common spell of the arcane tradition that has the cold trait or another cold spell you have access to.
_desc_ko: 파편의 얼음 영향이 당신의 존재 깊숙이 퍼져감에 따라 마력이 성장합니다. 기본 주문 시전 혜택을 얻습니다. 이 아키타입으로 새로운 레벨의 주문 슬롯을 얻을 때마다, 해당 주문 랭크(하위 랭크 주문의 강화 버전 포함)에 맞는 주문을 레퍼토리에 추가합니다. 냉기 속성을 가진 아케인 전통의 일반 주문이나, 접근 가능한 다른 냉기 주문 중 하나를 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Armor Rune Shifter

description.value: You learn the secrets of armor runes by viewing them through gems and can alter them at your discretion. Once per day when you make your daily preparations, you can focus on a rune's magical energies through a crystal's facets to alter a single property rune on one suit of armor in your possession to suppress its normal effects and make it function as a different property rune. You can temporarily alter the rune to function as one of the following runes: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Lw3B9DpnyrpXD9Di]{Energy-Resistant}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.8buhFcGwuaJRrp0y]{Fortification}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.iTxqImupNnm8gvoe]{Raiment}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.VDudQ4x2ozosAbTb]{Invisibility}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.kEy7Uc1VisizGgtf]{Shadow}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.uQOaRpfkUFVYD0Gx]{Slick}. The property rune remains altered until you make your next daily preparations. The armor must meet the prerequisites for the temporary rune, and any other runes that required the suppressed rune are also suppressed while the rune is transformed. The rune is obviously altered, and thus the armor can't be sold as though it had the temporary rune.

publication.title: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City
