_desc_ko: 보석을 통해 갑옷 룬의 비밀을 관찰하여 익히고, 마음대로 변경할 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, 일일 준비를 할 때 수정 면을 통해 룬의 마법 에너지에 포커스를 맞춰 소유한 갑옷 한 벌의 속성 룬 하나를 변경할 수 있습니다. 이로써 해당 룬의 정상 효과를 억제하고 다른 속성 룬 처럼 기능하게 합니다. 룬을 일시적으로 다음과 같은 룬 중 하나로 변경할 수 있습니다: @link[equipment.energy-resistant], @link[equipment.fortification], @link[equipment.raiment], @link[equipment.invisibility], @link[equipment.shadow], @link[equipment.slick] 중 하나로 변경할 수 있습니다. 속성 룬은 다음 일일 준비를 할 때까지 변경된 상태로 유지됩니다. 갑옷은 임시 룬의 전제 조건을 충족해야 하며, 억제된 룬을 요구하는 다른 룬들도 룬이 변형되는 동안 억제됩니다. 룬은 명백히 변경되었으므로, 갑옷을 임시 룬이 있는 것처럼 판매할 수 없습니다.

name: Blessed Blood (Sorcerer)

description.value: Your deity's blessings manifest in your blood-borne power. Add up to three of your deity's spells (spells your deity grants to clerics) to your spell list. They are not automatically added to your repertoire, but you can select them just as you would spells normally on the divine spell list.

_desc_en: Your deity's blessings manifest in your blood-borne power. Add up to three of your deity's spells (spells your deity grants to clerics) to your spell list. They are not automatically added to your repertoire, but you can select them just as you would spells normally on the divine spell list.
_desc_ko: 당신의 신의 축복이 피를 통한 힘으로 창조됩니다. 신이 부여하는 주문 중 최대 세 가지를 당신의 주문 목록에 추가합니다. 이 주문들은 자동으로 레퍼토리에 추가되지는 않지만, 신성 주문 목록에서 일반 주문 선택과 동일한 방식으로 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Revitalizing Finisher

description.value:
Your swagger instills confidence in you and your allies. Make a Strike. On a hit, you and all allies within 30 feet gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level.

Failure You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.EgOcWruvNdVIpNAC]{Effect: Revitalizing Finisher}

_desc_en:
Your swagger instills confidence in you and your allies. Make a Strike. On a hit, you and all allies within 30 feet gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level.

Failure You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.EgOcWruvNdVIpNAC]{Effect: Revitalizing Finisher}
_desc_ko:
당신의 당당한 기세가 당신과 아군에게 자신감을 불어넣습니다. 공격을 수행하세요. 명중 시, 당신과 30피트 내 모든 아군은 당신의 레벨 절반에 해당하는 임시 HP를 얻습니다.

실패 당신은 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 임시 HP를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.EgOcWruvNdVIpNAC]{효과: 활력 회복 마무리}

name: Accurate Flurry

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding two melee weapons, each in a different hand.

You refine the precision of your unbelievable storm of blows.

When you perform an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.OqHfUQQorVBkx34j]{Impossible Flurry}, your first attack with each weapon instead takes the multiple attack penalty as though you had already made one attack this turn. All subsequent attacks take the maximum multiple attack penalty, as though you had already made two or more attacks this turn.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding two melee weapons, each in a different hand.

You refine the precision of your unbelievable storm of blows.

When you perform an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.OqHfUQQorVBkx34j]{Impossible Flurry}, your first attack with each weapon instead takes the multiple attack penalty as though you had already made one attack this turn. All subsequent attacks take the maximum multiple attack penalty, as though you had already made two or more attacks this turn.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손에 각각 다른 근접 무기를 들고 있어야 합니다.

믿기 힘든 연타의 정밀도를 더욱 다듬습니다.

@link[feats.impossible-flurry]를 수행할 때, 각 무기의 첫 번째 공격은 마치 이번 턴에 이미 한 번 공격한 것처럼 다중 공격 페널티를 받습니다. 이후 모든 공격은 마치 이번 턴에 이미 두 번 이상 공격한 것처럼 최대 다중 공격 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Expansive Spellstrike

description.value: You can blast the energy of a spell out around the target of your attack. When you Spellstrike with a spell that has an area of a burst, cone, or line, the spell creates an area instead of affecting only the target. The target must be in the area. A burst is centered on a corner of the target's square; if the target is Large or larger, the burst use the square corner closest to the center of the target and choose the corner if more than one is eligible. A cone or line emits from you and must include the target; if you're not adjacent to the target (using a reach weapon or starlit span, for example), choose any square adjacent to the target as the source. The spell affects all creatures in the area as normal, but the Strike still targets only one creature.

_desc_en: You can blast the energy of a spell out around the target of your attack. When you Spellstrike with a spell that has an area of a burst, cone, or line, the spell creates an area instead of affecting only the target. The target must be in the area. A burst is centered on a corner of the target's square; if the target is Large or larger, the burst use the square corner closest to the center of the target and choose the corner if more than one is eligible. A cone or line emits from you and must include the target; if you're not adjacent to the target (using a reach weapon or starlit span, for example), choose any square adjacent to the target as the source. The spell affects all creatures in the area as normal, but the Strike still targets only one creature.
_desc_ko: 공격 대상 주변으로 스펠스트라이크할 수 있습니다. 폭발, 원뿔, 선 형태의 범위를 가진 주문으로 스펠스트라이크를 사용할 때, 해당 주문은 대상만 영향을 주는 대신 영역을 생성합니다. 대상은 해당 영역 내에 있어야 한다. 폭발형은 대상의 칸 모서리를 중심으로 하며, 대상이 대형 이상일 경우 대상 중심에 가장 가까운 칸 모서리를 사용한다. 해당 모서리가 여러 개일 경우 하나를 선택한다. 원뿔형 또는 선형은 당신으로부터 발산되며 반드시 대상을 포함해야 합니다. 대상과 인접하지 않은 경우(예: 도달 무기나 별빛 스팬 사용 시), 대상과 인접한 임의의 칸을 발원지로 선택합니다. 주문은 해당 영역 내 모든 생물에게 정상적으로 영향을 미치지만, 공격은 여전히 하나의 생물만을 대상으로 합니다.

name: Healing Transformation

description.value: You can take advantage of shapechanging magic to close wounds and patch injuries. If your next action is to cast a non-cantrip polymorph spell that targets only one creature, your polymorph spell also restores 1d6 Hit Points per spell rank to that creature. This is a healing effect.

_desc_en: You can take advantage of shapechanging magic to close wounds and patch injuries. If your next action is to cast a non-cantrip polymorph spell that targets only one creature, your polymorph spell also restores 1d6 Hit Points per spell rank to that creature. This is a healing effect.
_desc_ko: 변신 마법을 이용해 상처를 봉합하고 부상을 치료할 수 있습니다. 다음 행동으로 한 생물만을 대상으로 하는 캐스트급 이하의 변신 주문을 시전할 경우, 해당 주문은 대상 생물에게 주문 랭크당 1d6 HP를 회복시킵니다. 이는 치유 효과입니다.

name: Ubiquitous Overdrive

description.value: You prepare a variety of incredible gizmos on each of your allies, linking them together through careful modification to enable you to power them up all at once. During your daily preparations, select up to six willing allies. Whenever you Overdrive, you grant the benefits of your overdrive to any of these allies you choose who are within 30 feet of you. The allies don't gain the increased damage from expert, master, or legendary overdrive.

_desc_en: You prepare a variety of incredible gizmos on each of your allies, linking them together through careful modification to enable you to power them up all at once. During your daily preparations, select up to six willing allies. Whenever you Overdrive, you grant the benefits of your overdrive to any of these allies you choose who are within 30 feet of you. The allies don't gain the increased damage from expert, master, or legendary overdrive.
_desc_ko: 당신은 각 아군에게 다양한 놀라운 장치를 준비하고, 세심한 개조를 통해 이들을 연결하여 한 번에 모두 강화할 수 있게 합니다. 일일 준비 단계에서 최대 여섯 명의 동의한 아군을 선택하세요. 오버드라이브를 사용할 때마다, 30피트 이내에 있는 선택한 아군에게 오버드라이브의 혜택을 부여합니다. 동료들은 전문가, 달인, 전설적 오버드라이브의 추가 피해를 얻지 못한다.

name: Twin Weakness

description.value:
Requirements You're holding an implement and a weapon, you are using Exploit Vulnerability with mortal weakness or personal antithesis, and the target creature is within reach of both your implement and weapon.

As you make an attack augmented by your esoterica, you also press your implement against the creature, applying its weakness as your implement's energies sear the creature's flesh. Make a melee Strike against the target of your Exploit Vulnerability. On any attack roll result but a critical failure, you also press your implement against the creature, automatically dealing the additional damage from Exploit Vulnerability. This is in addition to any damage from your Strike, including the weakness the Strike applies from Exploit Vulnerability. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're holding an implement and a weapon, you are using Exploit Vulnerability with mortal weakness or personal antithesis, and the target creature is within reach of both your implement and weapon.

As you make an attack augmented by your esoterica, you also press your implement against the creature, applying its weakness as your implement's energies sear the creature's flesh. Make a melee Strike against the target of your Exploit Vulnerability. On any attack roll result but a critical failure, you also press your implement against the creature, automatically dealing the additional damage from Exploit Vulnerability. This is in addition to any damage from your Strike, including the weakness the Strike applies from Exploit Vulnerability. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty.
_desc_ko:
요건 당신은 도구와 무기를 모두 들고 있으며, 치명적 약점 또는 개인적 대립을 이용한 취약점 공략을 사용 중이고, 대상 생물이 당신의 도구와 무기 모두의 도달 범위 내에 있어야 합니다.

에소테리카를 강화한 공격을 가할 때, 동시에 도구로 생물체를 눌러 그 약점을 적용합니다. 도구의 에너지가 생물체의 살점을 태우며 약점을 발동시키죠. '취약점 이용' 대상에게 근접 공격하세요. 대실패를 제외한 모든 명중 굴림 결과에서, 당신은 또한 당신의 도구를 생물에게 밀어붙여 취약점 공략으로 인한 추가 피해를 자동으로 입힙니다. 이는 당신의 공격으로 인한 피해(취약점 공략으로 인한 타격의 약점 적용 포함)에 추가됩니다. 이는 다중 공격 페널티를 계산할 때 두 번의 공격으로 간주됩니다.

name: Rain of Razors

description.value:
Razor-sharp slivers of metal fall from the sky. Each creature in a @Template[burst|distance:20] within 60 feet takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -12)/2)+9)d6[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. The razors embed in all surfaces in the area, making them hazardous terrain for 1 minute. A creature that moves through this hazardous terrain takes @Damage[(floor((max(12,@actor.level)-12)/2)+3)[slashing]] damage for every square of the area it moves into.

Level (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d6 and the hazardous terrain damage increases by 1.

_desc_en:
Razor-sharp slivers of metal fall from the sky. Each creature in a @Template[burst|distance:20] within 60 feet takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -12)/2)+9)d6[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. The razors embed in all surfaces in the area, making them hazardous terrain for 1 minute. A creature that moves through this hazardous terrain takes @Damage[(floor((max(12,@actor.level)-12)/2)+3)[slashing]] damage for every square of the area it moves into.

Level (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d6 and the hazardous terrain damage increases by 1.
_desc_ko:
날카로운 금속 조각들이 하늘에서 떨어진다. 60피트 내의 20피트 영역에 있는 모든 생물은 참격 피해를 입으며, 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 기본 반사 내성에 성공해야 합니다. 날카로운 조각들은 해당 영역의 모든 표면에 박혀 1분 동안 위험 지형을 만든다. 이 위험 지형을 통과하는 생물은 이동한 영역의 각 칸마다 참격의 피해를 입는다.

레벨 (+2) 초기 피해가 1d6 증가하고 위험 지형 피해가 1 증가합니다.

name: Right Where You Want Them

description.value: Whether with a weapon or your bare hands, you keep your opponents in their place. Increase the maximum distance you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} an opponent to 10 feet on a success or 15 feet on a critical success.

_desc_en: Whether with a weapon or your bare hands, you keep your opponents in their place. Increase the maximum distance you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} an opponent to 10 feet on a success or 15 feet on a critical success.
_desc_ko: 무기를 쓰든 맨손으로 하든, 당신은 상대를 제자리에 묶어둡니다. 성공 시 @link[actions.reposition] 또는 @link[actions.shove]로 상대를 최대 10피트까지, 대성공 시 15피트까지 밀어낼 수 있습니다.

name: Burning Demand

description.value:
You create a faintly glowing sigil (shedding normal light in a 5-foot radius) on the target's body, after which you command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. The target then attempts a @Check[fortitude|against:class] save against your class DC.

Critical Success The sigil immediately vanishes, and the creature is unaffected.

Success The sigil acts as a magnet for your fiery attacks, granting the creature a –1 penalty to its saves and AC against your fire impulses. The sigil lasts until the end of your next turn or until the creature spends at least 1 action obeying your command, whichever happens first.

Failure At the start of the creature's next turn, if it doesn't use their first action to obey the command, the sigil ignites as it vanishes, dealing @Damage[((@actor.level/2)+2)d6[fire]] damage and @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -12)/2)+2)d6[persistent,fire]] damage to the creature.

Critical Failure The creature must spend the first action of its next turn to obey your command; it can't Delay. The sigil vanishes at the end of its turn; it ignites if the creature didn't use all its remaining actions to continue to obey your command, dealing @Damage[((@actor.level/2)+2)d6[fire]] damage and @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -12)/2)+2)d6[persistent,fire]] damage to the creature.

Level (+2) The damage increases by 1d6, and the persistent damage increases by 1d6.

_desc_en:
You create a faintly glowing sigil (shedding normal light in a 5-foot radius) on the target's body, after which you command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. The target then attempts a @Check[fortitude|against:class] save against your class DC.

Critical Success The sigil immediately vanishes, and the creature is unaffected.

Success The sigil acts as a magnet for your fiery attacks, granting the creature a –1 penalty to its saves and AC against your fire impulses. The sigil lasts until the end of your next turn or until the creature spends at least 1 action obeying your command, whichever happens first.

Failure At the start of the creature's next turn, if it doesn't use their first action to obey the command, the sigil ignites as it vanishes, dealing @Damage[((@actor.level/2)+2)d6[fire]] damage and @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -12)/2)+2)d6[persistent,fire]] damage to the creature.

Critical Failure The creature must spend the first action of its next turn to obey your command; it can't Delay. The sigil vanishes at the end of its turn; it ignites if the creature didn't use all its remaining actions to continue to obey your command, dealing @Damage[((@actor.level/2)+2)d6[fire]] damage and @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -12)/2)+2)d6[persistent,fire]] damage to the creature.

Level (+2) The damage increases by 1d6, and the persistent damage increases by 1d6.
_desc_ko:
대상의 몸에 희미하게 빛나는 문장(반경 5피트에 일반 빛을 발산)을 새기고, 그 후 대상에게 당신에게 다가오거나, 도망치거나(@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{도주} 상태인 것처럼), 들고 있는 것을 놓거나, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{넘어짐}이 되거나, 제자리에 서 있으라고 명령합니다. 그 후 대상은 당신의 클래스 DC에 대해 @Check[fortitude|against:class] 내성을 시도합니다.

대성공 문장이 즉시 사라지고, 그 생물은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 문장은 당신의 화염 공격에 대한 자석 역할을 하여, 그 생물은 당신의 화염 충동에 대한 내성과 AC에 –1 페널티를 받습니다. 문장은 당신의 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 또는 그 생물이 당신의 명령에 따르는 데 최소 1 행동을 소비할 때까지 중 먼저 오는 시점까지 지속됩니다.

실패 그 생물의 다음 턴이 시작될 때, 그 생물이 첫 번째 행동으로 명령에 따르지 않으면, 문장이 사라지며 발화하여 그 생물에게 @Damage[((@actor.level/2)+2)d6[fire]] 피해와 @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -12)/2)+2)d6[persistent,fire]] 피해를 입힙니다.

대실패 그 생물은 다음 턴의 첫 번째 행동을 당신의 명령에 따르는 데 소비해야 하며, 지연할 수 없습니다. 문장은 그 생물의 턴이 끝날 때 사라집니다. 그 생물이 남은 모든 행동을 계속 명령에 따르는 데 사용하지 않았다면 문장이 발화하여, 그 생물에게 @Damage[((@actor.level/2)+2)d6[fire]] 피해와 @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -12)/2)+2)d6[persistent,fire]] 피해를 입힙니다.

레벨 (+2) 피해가 1d6, 지속 피해가 1d6 증가합니다.

name: Courageous Onslaught

description.value: You use your performance to orchestrate an onslaught against your enemies. If your next action is to cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IAjvwqgiDr3qGYxY]{Courageous Anthem} composition cantrip, one ally of your choice who gains a status bonus from the spell can immediately use their reaction to Stride and then make a melee Strike.

_desc_en: You use your performance to orchestrate an onslaught against your enemies. If your next action is to cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IAjvwqgiDr3qGYxY]{Courageous Anthem} composition cantrip, one ally of your choice who gains a status bonus from the spell can immediately use their reaction to Stride and then make a melee Strike.
_desc_ko: 당신은 연주를 통해 적들에 대한 맹공을 지휘합니다. 다음 행동으로 @link[spells.courageous-anthem] 작곡 캔트립을 시전할 경우, 해당 주문으로 상태 보너스를 얻은 선택한 아군 한 명이 즉시 반응을 사용해 이동한 후 근접 공격을 할 수 있다.

name: Murksight

description.value: Your vision pierces through non-magical fog, mist, rain, and snow. You don't take circumstance penalties to ranged attacks or Perception checks caused by non-magical precipitation, and your targeted attacks don't require a flat check to succeed against a target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} only by such effects.

_desc_en: Your vision pierces through non-magical fog, mist, rain, and snow. You don't take circumstance penalties to ranged attacks or Perception checks caused by non-magical precipitation, and your targeted attacks don't require a flat check to succeed against a target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} only by such effects.
_desc_ko: 당신의 시야는 비마법적 안개, 안개비, 비, 눈을 관통한다. 비마법적 강수 현상으로 인한 원거리 공격이나 지각 판정 시 환경 페널티를 받지 않으며, 이러한 효과로만 @link[conditions.concealed] 대상에 대한 표적 공격은 단순 판정으로 성공할 수 있습니다.

name: Nephilim Resistance

description.value:
You resist energy like your extraplanar predecessors. Choose one of the following energy damage types: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. You gain resistance 5 to that damage type.

The damage type typically matches an extraplanar entity associated with your bloodline. For instance, an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ydgCsYsgqSkFWEDK]{Angelkin} might choose resistance to cold, while a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.EXVHePH8alsTZ5TB]{Hellspawn} might choose resistance to fire.

_desc_en:
You resist energy like your extraplanar predecessors. Choose one of the following energy damage types: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. You gain resistance 5 to that damage type.

The damage type typically matches an extraplanar entity associated with your bloodline. For instance, an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ydgCsYsgqSkFWEDK]{Angelkin} might choose resistance to cold, while a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.EXVHePH8alsTZ5TB]{Hellspawn} might choose resistance to fire.
_desc_ko:
당신은 초월적 선조들처럼 에너지에 저항합니다. 다음 에너지 피해 유형 중 하나를 선택하세요: 산성, 냉기, 전기, 화염, 또는 [sonic]. 해당 피해 유형에 대해 저항력 5를 얻습니다.

해당 피해 유형은 일반적으로 당신의 혈통과 연관된 초월적 존재와 일치합니다. 예를 들어, @link[feats.angelkin]은 냉기 저항을 선택할 수 있고, @link[feats.hellspawn]은 화염 저항을 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Swift Eel Mount

description.value: Your rapport with your eel lets you guide it to avoid dangers as it swims. While you're mounted on an eel, that eel ignores difficult terrain while Swimming and gets a +2 circumstance bonus to all defenses against reactions triggered by its movement.

_desc_en: Your rapport with your eel lets you guide it to avoid dangers as it swims. While you're mounted on an eel, that eel ignores difficult terrain while Swimming and gets a +2 circumstance bonus to all defenses against reactions triggered by its movement.
_desc_ko: 당신과 장어 사이의 유대감 덕분에 장어가 헤엄칠 때 위험을 피하도록 이끌 수 있습니다. 장어에 올라탄 동안, 그 장어는 헤엄칠 때 어려운 지형을 무시하며, 자신의 이동으로 인해 유발되는 반응에 대한 모든 방어에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Genie Weapon Familiarity

description.value:
You've trained with weapons used by your genie ancestors. You are trained with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.XGtIUZ4ZNKuFx1uL]{Falchions}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.UfurZQK6H6SgOjqe]{Ranseurs}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.grmaV4GdoGD7sKbn]{Scimitars}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.FJrsDoaIXksVjld9]{Tridents}.

In addition, you gain access to all uncommon geniekin weapons. For the purpose of determining your proficiency, martial geniekin weapons are simple weapons and advanced geniekin weapons are martial weapons.

_desc_en:
You've trained with weapons used by your genie ancestors. You are trained with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.XGtIUZ4ZNKuFx1uL]{Falchions}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.UfurZQK6H6SgOjqe]{Ranseurs}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.grmaV4GdoGD7sKbn]{Scimitars}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.FJrsDoaIXksVjld9]{Tridents}.

In addition, you gain access to all uncommon geniekin weapons. For the purpose of determining your proficiency, martial geniekin weapons are simple weapons and advanced geniekin weapons are martial weapons.
_desc_ko:
당신은 지니 선조들이 사용하던 무기로 훈련받았습니다. @link[equipment.falchion], @link[equipment.ranseur], @link[equipment.scimitar], @link[equipment.trident]에 숙련되어 있습니다.

또한 모든 희귀 지니킨 무기를 사용할 수 있습니다. 숙련도 판정 시, 무술 지니킨 무기는 단순 무기로, 고급 지니킨 무기는 무술 무기로 간주됩니다.

name: Snare Genius

description.value:
If the snare normally takes 1 minute to Craft, you can Craft it with 3 Interact actions instead. Each day during your daily preparations, you can prepare three snares from your formula book for quick deployment (increasing to four snares if you're a master in Crafting and five if you're legendary). Snares prepared in this way don't cost you any resources to Craft.

When a creature critically fails its saving throw against and takes damage from the initial effect of a snare you Crafted and deployed, that creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of its next turn.

_desc_en:
If the snare normally takes 1 minute to Craft, you can Craft it with 3 Interact actions instead. Each day during your daily preparations, you can prepare three snares from your formula book for quick deployment (increasing to four snares if you're a master in Crafting and five if you're legendary). Snares prepared in this way don't cost you any resources to Craft.

When a creature critically fails its saving throw against and takes damage from the initial effect of a snare you Crafted and deployed, that creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of its next turn.
_desc_ko:
덫 제작에 보통 1분이 소요된다면, 대신 상호작용 행동 3회로 제작할 수 있습니다. 매일 준비 시간 동안, 제작 서적에서 덫 세 개를 준비해 신속하게 배치할 수 있습니다(제작 숙련도가 마스터라면 네 개, 전설이라면 다섯 개까지 증가). 이 방법으로 준비한 올가미는 제작 시 자원을 소모하지 않습니다.

당신이 제작하여 배치한 올가미의 초기 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 대실패하고 피해를 입은 생물은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Roll with it (Kingmaker)

description.value:
Trigger Your hunted prey, which must be a giant, hits you with a melee attack.

You can dodge attacks from giants. Attempt a Reflex save using 10 + the giant's attack bonus as the save DC. If the result allows you to Stride as part of the reaction, you may instead Fly or Swim if you have the corresponding movement type.

Critical Success The attack misses you (or if the attack was a critical hit, it becomes a regular hit). You can Stride up to 10 feet as part of the reaction; if you do so, the reaction gains the move trait.

Success The attack deals half damage. You can Stride up to 5 feet as part of the reaction, but you must end this movement adjacent to the triggering giant. If you do so, the reaction gains the move trait.

Critical Failure You fail to avoid the attack and are knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} by the blow.

_desc_en:
Trigger Your hunted prey, which must be a giant, hits you with a melee attack.

You can dodge attacks from giants. Attempt a Reflex save using 10 + the giant's attack bonus as the save DC. If the result allows you to Stride as part of the reaction, you may instead Fly or Swim if you have the corresponding movement type.

Critical Success The attack misses you (or if the attack was a critical hit, it becomes a regular hit). You can Stride up to 10 feet as part of the reaction; if you do so, the reaction gains the move trait.

Success The attack deals half damage. You can Stride up to 5 feet as part of the reaction, but you must end this movement adjacent to the triggering giant. If you do so, the reaction gains the move trait.

Critical Failure You fail to avoid the attack and are knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} by the blow.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신이 추적하는 거대 생물이 근접 공격으로 당신을 공격합니다.

거인의 공격은 회피할 수 있습니다. 회피 DC로 10 + 거인의 공격 보너스를 적용한 반사 내성을 시도하세요. 결과가 반응의 일환으로 '이동'을 허용한다면, 해당 이동 유형을 보유한 경우 대신 '날기'나 '수영'을 선택할 수 있습니다.

대성공 공격이 빗나간다(또는 치명타였던 공격은 일반 히트로 변경됨). 반응의 일환으로 최대 10피트까지 이동할 수 있다; 그렇게 할 경우, 해당 반응은 이동 특성을 획득한다.

성공 공격은 절반의 피해를 입힙니다. 반응의 일부로 최대 5피트까지 이동할 수 있지만, 이 이동은 반드시 유발한 거인에 인접한 위치에서 끝나야 합니다. 그렇게 할 경우, 반응은 이동 특성을 얻습니다.

대실패 공격을 피하지 못하고 타격으로 인해 @link[conditions.prone]가 된다.

name: Lightning Dash

description.value:
For an instant, you transform yourself into a being of pure lightning and fly forward, shocking anyone in your way. You propel yourself forward in a @Template[line|distance:30]. You can move through creatures during this movement, and this movement doesn't trigger reactions that are triggered by movement. Each creature you move through takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -4)/3)+2)d12[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. You return to your normal form in the final square of the line. If you're in the air, you fall unless you have a fly Speed.

Level (+3) The length of the line increases by 5 feet, and the damage increases by 1d12.

_desc_en:
For an instant, you transform yourself into a being of pure lightning and fly forward, shocking anyone in your way. You propel yourself forward in a @Template[line|distance:30]. You can move through creatures during this movement, and this movement doesn't trigger reactions that are triggered by movement. Each creature you move through takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -4)/3)+2)d12[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. You return to your normal form in the final square of the line. If you're in the air, you fall unless you have a fly Speed.

Level (+3) The length of the line increases by 5 feet, and the damage increases by 1d12.
_desc_ko:
순간적으로 순수한 번개 존재로 변신하여 앞으로 날아가며, 경로상의 모든 대상에게 충격을 가한다. 30피트로 전진한다. 이 이동 중에는 생물체를 통과할 수 있으며, 이동에 의해 유발되는 반응을 발생시키지 않는다. 통과하는 각 생물은 전기 피해를 입으며, 이는 네 클래스 DC에 대한 기본 반사 내성에 성공해야 회피할 수 있다. 직선의 마지막 칸에서 네 본래 모습으로 돌아온다. 공중에 있다면, 비행 속도가 없다면 추락한다.

레벨 (+3) 선의 길이가 5피트 증가하고, 피해량이 1d12 증가합니다.

name: Infiltration Assassination

description.value:
Requirements You're wearing a loaded gauntlet bow.

With a high-priority target in reach, you quickly move to eliminate them. Make a melee Strike using your gauntlet bow as a gauntlet. If the Strike is successful, you automatically latch onto the target, giving them the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} condition, then make a ranged Strike against them with your gauntlet bow. This Strike does not trigger reactions normally triggered by ranged attacks. If you are holding or wearing an injury poison, you can apply it to the bolt used in the attack as a free action before making the ranged Strike.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wearing a loaded gauntlet bow.

With a high-priority target in reach, you quickly move to eliminate them. Make a melee Strike using your gauntlet bow as a gauntlet. If the Strike is successful, you automatically latch onto the target, giving them the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} condition, then make a ranged Strike against them with your gauntlet bow. This Strike does not trigger reactions normally triggered by ranged attacks. If you are holding or wearing an injury poison, you can apply it to the bolt used in the attack as a free action before making the ranged Strike.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 장갑에 장착된 활을 장전한 상태여야 합니다.

우선순위가 높은 목표물이 손에 닿는 거리에 있으면, 당신은 신속하게 움직여 그들을 제거합니다. 건틀릿 보우를 건틀릿으로 사용하여 근접 공격을 수행하세요. 공격이 성공하면, 당신은 자동으로 목표물에 달라붙어 그들에게 @link[conditions.grabbed] 상태를 부여한 후, 건틀릿 보우로 그들을 상대로 원거리 공격을 수행합니다. 이 공격은 일반적으로 원거리 공격으로 유발되는 반응을 유발하지 않습니다. 부상 독을 소지하거나 착용 중이라면, 원거리 공격을 수행하기 전 자유 행동으로 해당 공격에 사용된 화살에 독을 발라 적용할 수 있다.

name: Warren Digger

description.value: You've learned to put your sturdy claws to work digging through the earth. You gain a burrow Speed of 15 feet.

_desc_en: You've learned to put your sturdy claws to work digging through the earth. You gain a burrow Speed of 15 feet.
_desc_ko: 튼튼한 발톱으로 땅을 파고드는 법을 익혔습니다. 땅파기 이동 속도 15피트를 얻습니다.

name: Greater Mental Evolution

description.value: Your bloodline's deep connection to mental essence greatly enhances your spell repertoire. Add one spell to your spell repertoire for each spell rank you can cast.

_desc_en: Your bloodline's deep connection to mental essence greatly enhances your spell repertoire. Add one spell to your spell repertoire for each spell rank you can cast.
_desc_ko: 혈통이 정신 본질과 깊이 연결되어 있어 주문 목록이 크게 확장됩니다. 시전 가능한 주문 랭크마다 주문 목록에 주문 하나를 추가합니다.

name: Sunder Spell

description.value:
You draw upon your superstitious fury to destroy a spell. Make a melee Strike with a weapon or unarmed attack against a creature, object, or a spell manifestation (such as the wall created by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IarZrgCeaiUqOuRu]{Wall of Fire} or the guardian from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jQdm301h6e8hIY4U]{Spiritual Guardian}). If you're targeting something that doesn't have an AC listed, its AC against this Strike is usually 10 for targets that are very easy to hit, like a wall, or a different AC determined by the GM. If your Strike hits, you can attempt to counteract a single spell or magical effect on the target. Your counteract rank for this attempt is equal to half your level rounded up, and you use the result of your attack roll for the counteract check.

Whether or not you succeed at your Strike, the target becomes temporarily immune to your Sunder Spell for 24 hours.

_desc_en:
You draw upon your superstitious fury to destroy a spell. Make a melee Strike with a weapon or unarmed attack against a creature, object, or a spell manifestation (such as the wall created by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IarZrgCeaiUqOuRu]{Wall of Fire} or the guardian from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jQdm301h6e8hIY4U]{Spiritual Guardian}). If you're targeting something that doesn't have an AC listed, its AC against this Strike is usually 10 for targets that are very easy to hit, like a wall, or a different AC determined by the GM. If your Strike hits, you can attempt to counteract a single spell or magical effect on the target. Your counteract rank for this attempt is equal to half your level rounded up, and you use the result of your attack roll for the counteract check.

Whether or not you succeed at your Strike, the target becomes temporarily immune to your Sunder Spell for 24 hours.
_desc_ko:
당신은 미신적인 분노를 끌어내어 주문을 파괴합니다. 무기 또는 비무장 공격으로 생물, 물체, 또는 주문 현현(@link[spells.wall-of-fire]이 생성한 벽이나 @link[spells.wall-of-fire])을 파괴합니다. @link[spells.spiritual-guardian]의 수호자 등). 명중난이도가 명시되지 않은 대상의 경우, 벽처럼 명중하기 매우 쉬운 대상은 일반적으로 AC 10이 적용되며, 그 외 대상은 GM이 결정한 AC가 적용됩니다. 타격이 적중하면 대상에게 걸린 단일 주문이나 마법 효과를 반격할 수 있습니다. 이 시도의 반격 랭크은 레벨의 절반을 올림한 값이며, 명중 굴림 결과로 반격 판정을 시도합니다.

타격 성공 여부와 관계없이, 대상은 24시간 동안 당신의 '주문 파괴'에 일시적으로 면역 상태가 됩니다.

name: Discordant Voice

description.value: Your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IAjvwqgiDr3qGYxY]{Courageous Anthem} lets loose a discordant shriek that imbues your allies' attacks with powerful sonic reverberations. While your allies are affected by your courageous anthem, their weapon Strikes and unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d6 sonic damage.

_desc_en: Your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IAjvwqgiDr3qGYxY]{Courageous Anthem} lets loose a discordant shriek that imbues your allies' attacks with powerful sonic reverberations. While your allies are affected by your courageous anthem, their weapon Strikes and unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d6 sonic damage.
_desc_ko: 당신의 @link[spells.courageous-anthem]는 불협화음의 비명을 내뿜어 아군의 공격에 강력한 [sonic] 울림을 부여합니다. 동료들이 당신의 용기의 찬가의 영향을 받는 동안, 그들의 무기 공격과 비무장 공격은 추가로 1d6 음파 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Draconic Sight

description.value: You have a fraction of the senses of your draconic forebear. You gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already grants you low-light vision.

_desc_en: You have a fraction of the senses of your draconic forebear. You gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already grants you low-light vision.
_desc_ko: 당신은 드라코닉 선조의 감각 일부를 지녔습니다. 저조도 시야를 얻거나, 선조로부터 이미 저조도 시야를 부여받은 경우 암흑 시야를 얻습니다.

name: Metallic Envisionment

description.value: You always account for every weakness, allowing your mind to imagine just the right physical form to take advantage of your opponents. Choose between cold iron or silver; all your mind weapon Strikes are treated as the chosen type of metal.

_desc_en: You always account for every weakness, allowing your mind to imagine just the right physical form to take advantage of your opponents. Choose between cold iron or silver; all your mind weapon Strikes are treated as the chosen type of metal.
_desc_ko: 상대의 모든 약점을 항상 고려하여, 그 약점을 공략하기에 가장 적합한 물리적 형태를 마음속으로 그려낸다. 냉철 또는 은 중 하나를 선택하라; 선택한 금속 유형으로 간주되는 정신 무기 공격 모두 사용할 수 있다.

name: Lepidstadt Surgeon Dedication

description.value:
Before everything else, before the blood and the monsters and the Stasian technology and the horror, you are a doctor. You are, in fact, an exceptionally good doctor. You become an expert in Medicine.

When you successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid} to stabilize a dying creature that doesn't yet have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition, it regains @Damage[(2d8 + 10*max(0,(@actor.system.skills.medicine.rank - 2)))[healing]] Hit Points; this healing increases by 10 when you are a master of Medicine and by another 10 when you are legendary in Medicine.

When you successfully Administer First Aid to stop bleeding, the target rolls the flat check (with lowered DC for an assisted recovery) twice and takes the better result; this is a fortune effect.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.45nzYsMBTP6PIxDN]{Effect: Lepidstadt Surgeon Dedication (Stop Bleeding)}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.siGGQuh9SijE9nlt]{Lepidstadt Surgeon}

_desc_en:
Before everything else, before the blood and the monsters and the Stasian technology and the horror, you are a doctor. You are, in fact, an exceptionally good doctor. You become an expert in Medicine.

When you successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid} to stabilize a dying creature that doesn't yet have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition, it regains @Damage[(2d8 + 10*max(0,(@actor.system.skills.medicine.rank - 2)))[healing]] Hit Points; this healing increases by 10 when you are a master of Medicine and by another 10 when you are legendary in Medicine.

When you successfully Administer First Aid to stop bleeding, the target rolls the flat check (with lowered DC for an assisted recovery) twice and takes the better result; this is a fortune effect.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.45nzYsMBTP6PIxDN]{Effect: Lepidstadt Surgeon Dedication (Stop Bleeding)}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.siGGQuh9SijE9nlt]{Lepidstadt Surgeon}
_desc_ko:
피와 괴물, 스타시아 기술, 공포보다 먼저, 당신은 의사다. 사실 당신은 매우 뛰어난 의사다. 의학의 전문가가 된다.

당신이 @link[actions.administer-first-aid]를 성공적으로 수행하여 아직 @link[conditions.wounded] 상태가 아닌 죽어가는 생물에게 @link[actions.administer-first-aid]를 성공적으로 시행하면, 그 생물은 회복 HP를 회복한다. 이 치유량은 의학의 달인이 되면 10 증가하며, 의학의 전설이 되면 추가로 10 증가한다.

출혈을 멈추기 위해 응급처치를 성공적으로 시행할 경우, 대상은 단순 판정(도움을 받은 회복 시 DC 감소 적용)를 두 번 굴림하고 더 좋은 결과를 적용받습니다. 이는 행운 효과입니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.45nzYsMBTP6PIxDN]{효과: 레피드슈타트 외과의 헌신 (출혈 정지)}

name: Sword-Light Wave

description.value: You channel spiritual energy through your weapon, unleashing it as a torrent of devastating power. Make a ranged Strike against an opponent within 60 feet using a one-handed, agile, or finesse melee weapon, or your fist unarmed attack. The attack is made at your normal proficiency with the chosen weapon or fist unarmed attack and has the same traits, damage dice, and runes, but all damage dealt by the attack is spirit damage.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You channel spiritual energy through your weapon, unleashing it as a torrent of devastating power. Make a ranged Strike against an opponent within 60 feet using a one-handed, agile, or finesse melee weapon, or your fist unarmed attack. The attack is made at your normal proficiency with the chosen weapon or fist unarmed attack and has the same traits, damage dice, and runes, but all damage dealt by the attack is spirit damage.
_desc_ko: 무기를 통해 영적 에너지를 집중시켜 파괴적인 힘의 폭풍으로 발산합니다. 60피트 내의 상대에게 한손 무기, 기민한 무기, 기교 무기 또는 맨손 주먹 공격으로 원거리 타격을 가합니다. 이 공격은 선택한 무기나 맨손 비무장 공격에 대한 정상 숙련도로 수행되며 동일한 특성, 피해 주사위, 룬을 가집니다. 단, 이 공격으로 입히는 모든 피해는 영혼 피해입니다.

name: Rat Magic

description.value: There always seems to be a little rat around to carry messages for you. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yhz9fF69uwRhnHix]{Animal Messenger} once per day as a primal innate spell. When you do, the animal that responds is always a rat. If there are no rats within range, the spell is lost.

_desc_en: There always seems to be a little rat around to carry messages for you. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yhz9fF69uwRhnHix]{Animal Messenger} once per day as a primal innate spell. When you do, the animal that responds is always a rat. If there are no rats within range, the spell is lost.
_desc_ko: 항상 당신을 위해 메시지를 전달해 줄 작은 쥐가 주변에 있는 듯합니다. 하루에 한 번 @link[spells.animal-messenger]을 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 시전 시 응답하는 동물은 항상 쥐입니다. 범위 내에 쥐가 없으면 마법은 소멸됩니다.

name: Shared Synergy

description.value: You can grant the benefit from Dualistic Synergy to an ally within 30 feet instead of yourself, either allowing that ally to Recall Knowledge, granting that ally temporary Hit Points, or both, depending on the spell's tradition.

_desc_en: You can grant the benefit from Dualistic Synergy to an ally within 30 feet instead of yourself, either allowing that ally to Recall Knowledge, granting that ally temporary Hit Points, or both, depending on the spell's tradition.
_desc_ko: 당신은 이중적 시너지의 혜택을 자신 대신 30피트 내의 아군에게 부여할 수 있습니다. 해당 아군이 지식을 회상하거나, 임시 HP를 얻거나, 또는 둘 다를 허용하는 것은 주문의 전통에 따라 결정됩니다.

name: Speedrun Strats

description.value:
Whenever you take a move action to Stride, you can attempt a @Check[acrobatics|dc:15] check to roll forward.

Critical Success You gain 5 extra feet of movement to your Speeds and can move through solid obstacles such as walls until the end of your Stride action.

Success You gain 5 extra feet of movement to your Speeds until the end of your Stride action.

Failure You lose 5 feet of movement from your Speeds until the end of your Stride action.

Critical Failure Your character softlocks and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} permanently. Only a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} ritual or similar magic can reverse this effect.

publication.title: Paizo Blog: Foolish Housekeeping and Other Articles

_desc_en:
Whenever you take a move action to Stride, you can attempt a @Check[acrobatics|dc:15] check to roll forward.

Critical Success You gain 5 extra feet of movement to your Speeds and can move through solid obstacles such as walls until the end of your Stride action.

Success You gain 5 extra feet of movement to your Speeds until the end of your Stride action.

Failure You lose 5 feet of movement from your Speeds until the end of your Stride action.

Critical Failure Your character softlocks and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} permanently. Only a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} ritual or similar magic can reverse this effect.
_desc_ko:
이동 행동을 취할 때마다, 앞으로 굴리기 DC 15 곡예 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다.

대성공 이동 속도에 5피트가 추가되고, 이동이 끝날 때까지 벽 같은 단단한 장애물을 통과할 수 있다.

성공 스트라이드 행동이 끝날 때까지 이동 속도에 5피트가 추가됩니다.

실패 당신의 속도 능력에서 5피트의 이동 거리를 잃으며, 이 효과는 당신의 이동 행동이 끝날 때까지 지속됩니다.

대실패 캐릭터가 소프트락 상태가 되어 영구적으로 @link[conditions.paralyzed]됩니다. @link[spells.wish] 의식이나 유사한 마법만이 이 효과를 되돌릴 수 있습니다.

name: Ghoran Weapon Practice

description.value: With plenty of practice, the memories of previous fights from previous lives come flooding back. Whenever you critically hit using a glaive, greatclub, hatchet, scythe, sickle, or ghoran weapon, you apply the weapon's critical specialization effect.

_desc_en: With plenty of practice, the memories of previous fights from previous lives come flooding back. Whenever you critically hit using a glaive, greatclub, hatchet, scythe, sickle, or ghoran weapon, you apply the weapon's critical specialization effect.
_desc_ko: 충분한 연습을 통해 전생의 전투 기억들이 쏟아져 돌아온다. 글레이브, 그레이트클럽, 해쳇, 낫, 낫칼, 고란 무기로 치명타를 기록할 때마다 해당 무기의 치명타 전문화 효과를 적용한다.

name: Iron Lung

description.value: Your lungs are infused with the resilience of iron. Treat the result of your save against an inhaled poison as one degree of success better than you rolled. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.aCFKA59YgGDNnSJ8]{Exhale Poison} ability.

_desc_en: Your lungs are infused with the resilience of iron. Treat the result of your save against an inhaled poison as one degree of success better than you rolled. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.aCFKA59YgGDNnSJ8]{Exhale Poison} ability.
_desc_ko: 당신의 폐는 철의 강인함으로 가득 차 있습니다. 흡입된 독에 대한 내성 굴림 결과는 주사위 굴림보다 한 단계 높은 성공으로 처리됩니다. 또한 @link[actions.exhale-poison] 능력을 얻습니다.

name: Friendly Nudge

description.value: You don't always have time to wait for your allies to make room, so it's best to politely move them yourself. Attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} an ally. You don't need to have a free hand to attempt this check. If your ally is willing, treat the result as one degree of success higher.

_desc_en: You don't always have time to wait for your allies to make room, so it's best to politely move them yourself. Attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} an ally. You don't need to have a free hand to attempt this check. If your ally is willing, treat the result as one degree of success higher.
_desc_ko: 동료가 자리를 비켜줄 때까지 기다릴 시간이 항상 있는 것은 아니므로, 직접 정중하게 이동시키는 것이 최선이다. 운동 판정을 시도하여 @link[actions.shove]로 동료를 이동시킨다. 이 판정을 시도할 때 빈 손이 필요하지 않습니다. 아군이 동의한다면, 검사 결과를 한 단계 높은 성공으로 처리하세요.

name: Shadow's Assault

description.value: Your shadow assaults your foes. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IqJ9URobmJ9L9UBG]{Shadow Blast} as a 5th-rank occult innate spell once per day. At 17th level, your shadow blast is heightened to 6th level.

_desc_en: Your shadow assaults your foes. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IqJ9URobmJ9L9UBG]{Shadow Blast} as a 5th-rank occult innate spell once per day. At 17th level, your shadow blast is heightened to 6th level.
_desc_ko: 당신의 그림자가 적을 공격합니다. 하루에 한 번, (5th)랭크 오컬트 선천 마법인 @link[spells.shadow-blast]을 시전할 수 있습니다. 17레벨에 도달하면, 당신의 그림자 폭발은 6레벨로 강화된다.

name: Ornate Tattoo

description.value: You expand your tattoos to encompass greater magic. Choose a 1st-rank arcane spell from the same school as your Arcane Tattoos, either a common spell or another to which you have access. You can cast that spell once per day as an innate arcane spell.

_desc_en: You expand your tattoos to encompass greater magic. Choose a 1st-rank arcane spell from the same school as your Arcane Tattoos, either a common spell or another to which you have access. You can cast that spell once per day as an innate arcane spell.
_desc_ko: 문신을 확장하여 더 큰 마법을 포용한다. 자신의 '비전의 문신'과 동일한 학파의 1랭크 아케인 주문을 선택한다. 일반 주문이거나 접근 가능한 다른 주문이어야 한다. 이 주문을 하루에 한 번 선천적 아케인 주문으로 시전할 수 있다.

name: Aldori Riposte

description.value:
Trigger An opponent within your reach critically fails a Strike against you.

Requirements You are using an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.iSceAVMkVv1uKK7t]{Aldori Dueling Sword} to parry.

You riposte with your Aldori dueling sword when your enemy leaves an opening. Make a melee Strike against or attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} the triggering opponent using your Aldori dueling sword.

_desc_en:
Trigger An opponent within your reach critically fails a Strike against you.

Requirements You are using an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.iSceAVMkVv1uKK7t]{Aldori Dueling Sword} to parry.

You riposte with your Aldori dueling sword when your enemy leaves an opening. Make a melee Strike against or attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} the triggering opponent using your Aldori dueling sword.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신의 공격 범위 내에 있는 상대가 당신을 상대로 한 공격에 대실패를 합니다.

요구 사항 당신은 @link[equipment.aldori-dueling-sword]으로 패리하고 있다.

적의 빈틈을 노려 알도리 결투검으로 반격합니다. 알도리 결투검으로 적을 향해 근접 공격을 가하거나 @link[actions.disarm]를 시도하세요.

name: Physical Training

description.value: You spend a lot of time focusing on your physical fitness. You increase your proficiency rank in Acrobatics and Athletics from expert to master.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en: You spend a lot of time focusing on your physical fitness. You increase your proficiency rank in Acrobatics and Athletics from expert to master.
_desc_ko: 당신은 신체적 체력에 포커스를 두는 데 많은 시간을 보냅니다. 곡예과 운동 숙련도 등급이 전문가에서 달인로 상승합니다.

name: Spellshield

description.value: Your shield becomes a bonded item capable of storing your spells. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.au0lwQ1nAcNQwcGh]{Arcane Bond} class feature and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.v82XtjAVN4ffgVVR]{Drain Bonded Item} action. You must select a shield as your bonded item. When you make your daily preparations, you can prepare one fewer wizard spell to infuse that magic into your bonded item. This spell must be at least 1 rank lower than the highest-rank wizard spell slot you have. When you Drain your Bonded Item to Cast a Spell, that spell is automatically heightened to the rank of spell you infused into your shield, no matter what rank you originally prepared it at.

_desc_en: Your shield becomes a bonded item capable of storing your spells. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.au0lwQ1nAcNQwcGh]{Arcane Bond} class feature and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.v82XtjAVN4ffgVVR]{Drain Bonded Item} action. You must select a shield as your bonded item. When you make your daily preparations, you can prepare one fewer wizard spell to infuse that magic into your bonded item. This spell must be at least 1 rank lower than the highest-rank wizard spell slot you have. When you Drain your Bonded Item to Cast a Spell, that spell is automatically heightened to the rank of spell you infused into your shield, no matter what rank you originally prepared it at.
_desc_ko: 방패가 주문의 힘을 저장할 수 있는 결합 아이템이 됩니다. @link[feats.arcane-bond] 클래스 특성과 @link[actions.drain-bonded-item] 액션을 획득합니다. 반드시 방패를 결합 아이템으로 선택해야 합니다. 일일 준비를 할 때, 결합된 아이템에 마법을 주입하기 위해 위자드 주문을 하나 덜 준비할 수 있습니다. 이 주문은 당신이 보유한 최고 랭크 위자드 주술사 주문 슬롯보다 최소 1랭크 낮아야 합니다. 결합된 아이템을 흡수하여 주문을 시전할 때, 원래 준비한 랭크과 상관없이 해당 주문은 방패에 주입한 주문 랭크으로 자동 강화됩니다.

name: Mark of the Sage

description.value:
Usage imbued into a worn ikon

Your ikon gains a pin, stripe, or similar marking showing you as a master of your craft. The imbued ikon gains the following ability.

Transcendence—@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c40APnn4a7bWhtcZ]{A Challenge for Heroes} 2 (concentrate, mental, spirit, transcendence)

@Embed[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c40APnn4a7bWhtcZ inline]

_desc_en:
Usage imbued into a worn ikon

Your ikon gains a pin, stripe, or similar marking showing you as a master of your craft. The imbued ikon gains the following ability.

Transcendence—@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c40APnn4a7bWhtcZ]{A Challenge for Heroes} 2 (concentrate, mental, spirit, transcendence)

@Embed[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c40APnn4a7bWhtcZ inline]
_desc_ko:
사용법 착용한 이콘에 부여

당신의 이콘에 핀, 줄무늬 또는 유사한 표식이 부여되어 당신이 그 분야의 마스터임을 나타냅니다. 이 주입된 이콘은 다음 능력을 얻습니다.

초월-@link[actions.a-challenge-for-heroes] 2 (집중, 정신, 영혼, 초월)

@link[actions.a-challenge-for-heroes]

name: Kashrishi Revivification

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You have the dying condition and are about to attempt a recovery check. You can use Kashrishi Revivification even if you're otherwise unable to act.

The well of psychic energy held within your mind can exceed the limitations of your physical body. You're restored to 1 Hit Point, lose the dying and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} conditions, and can act normally on this turn. You gain or increase the wounded condition as normal for losing the dying condition.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You have the dying condition and are about to attempt a recovery check. You can use Kashrishi Revivification even if you're otherwise unable to act.

The well of psychic energy held within your mind can exceed the limitations of your physical body. You're restored to 1 Hit Point, lose the dying and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} conditions, and can act normally on this turn. You gain or increase the wounded condition as normal for losing the dying condition.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 죽어가는 상태에 걸렸고 회복 검사를 시도하려 할 때. 다른 행동이 불가능한 상황에서도 카슈리시 부활을 사용할 수 있다.

당신의 정신 속에 담긴 사이킥 에너지의 우물은 육체의 한계를 뛰어넘을 수 있습니다. HP가 1로 회복되고, 죽음 직전 상태와 @link[conditions.unconscious] 상태가 해제되며, 이번 턴에 정상적으로 행동할 수 있습니다. 죽음 직전 상태가 해제됨에 따라 정상적으로 부상 상태를 획득하거나 증가시킵니다.

name: Improved Elemental Blast

description.value:
The power of your elemental blast improves. The damage of your elemental blast increases by one die.

Special You can take Improved Elemental Blast a second time at 14th level to increase your Elemental Blast to three damage die, and a third time at 18th level to increase your Elemental Blast to four damage die.

_desc_en:
The power of your elemental blast improves. The damage of your elemental blast increases by one die.

Special You can take Improved Elemental Blast a second time at 14th level to increase your Elemental Blast to three damage die, and a third time at 18th level to increase your Elemental Blast to four damage die.
_desc_ko:
원소 폭발의 위력이 향상됩니다. 원소 폭발의 피해가 주사위 하나만큼 증가합니다.

특수 14레벨에 강화된 원소 폭발을 두 번째로 선택하여 원소 폭발의 피해를 3주사위로 증가시킬 수 있으며, 18레벨에 세 번째로 선택하여 원소 폭발의 피해를 4주사위로 증가시킬 수 있습니다.

name: Spirit Familiar (Animist)

description.value: When you attune to your apparitions during your daily preparations, you can choose to dedicate a small amount of your life force to allow one of them to physically manifest as a familiar, which gains the spirit trait. If your familiar is slain or destroyed, you lose all other benefits from the apparition until you remanifest the familiar during your next daily preparations. If you disperse the apparition you have manifested as a familiar, the familiar is destroyed.

_desc_en: When you attune to your apparitions during your daily preparations, you can choose to dedicate a small amount of your life force to allow one of them to physically manifest as a familiar, which gains the spirit trait. If your familiar is slain or destroyed, you lose all other benefits from the apparition until you remanifest the familiar during your next daily preparations. If you disperse the apparition you have manifested as a familiar, the familiar is destroyed.
_desc_ko: 일일 준비 시간에 유령들과 교감할 때, 생명력의 일부를 바쳐 그중 하나가 패밀리어를 창조하도록 할 수 있으며, 이 창조된 패밀리어는 영혼 특성을 얻습니다. 당신의 패밀리어가 살해되거나 파괴되면, 다음 일일 준비 시간에 패밀리어를 재현출할 때까지 해당 환영으로부터 얻는 다른 모든 혜택을 상실합니다. 패밀리어로 창조한 환영을 해산시킬 경우, 패밀리어는 파괴됩니다.

name: Embodiment of the Balance

description.value: Your place in the balance between the forces of life and entropy expands the spells you can pull from the spirit realms. You add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} to your apparition spell repertoire, allowing you to cast them with your apparition spellcasting.

_desc_en: Your place in the balance between the forces of life and entropy expands the spells you can pull from the spirit realms. You add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} to your apparition spell repertoire, allowing you to cast them with your apparition spellcasting.
_desc_ko: 생명력과 엔트로피의 힘 사이에서 당신이 차지하는 위치는 영혼계에서 끌어낼 수 있는 주문들을 확장시킵니다. @link[spells.heal]와 @link[spells.harm]을 환영 주술 주문 목록에 추가하여, 환영 주술 시전으로 이들을 발동할 수 있습니다.

name: Leap and Fire

description.value: You're quick enough to line up a shot even while diving to the ground. When you use your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.6LFBPpPPJjDq07fg]{Hit the Dirt!} reaction, at any point during your Leap you can also make a ranged Strike with a loaded firearm or crossbow, targeting the creature whose attack triggered the reaction.

_desc_en: You're quick enough to line up a shot even while diving to the ground. When you use your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.6LFBPpPPJjDq07fg]{Hit the Dirt!} reaction, at any point during your Leap you can also make a ranged Strike with a loaded firearm or crossbow, targeting the creature whose attack triggered the reaction.
_desc_ko: 땅으로 몸을 던지는 순간에도 빠르게 조준하여 사격할 수 있다. @link[feats.hit-the-dirt] 반응을 사용할 때, 도약 동작 중 어느 시점에서든 장전된 화기나 석궁으로 원거리 공격을 가할 수 있으며, 이 공격은 반응을 유발한 생물을 대상으로 한다.

name: Cross the Final Horizon

description.value:
Requirements You're in Sky and Heaven Stance.

You Stride up to your Speed, and your ki enshrouds your limbs in terrifying stormy energy, increasing the reach of your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.UjEeHamC2C8JfgJz]{Sky and Heaven Stance} unarmed attacks by 5 feet. At the end of your movement, make up to three Strikes against a target you can reach, each at a –2 penalty. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after you've made all your attacks. Instead of the usual slashing or piercing damage, the damage for these Strikes is either electricity or sonic, as you choose with each Strike. If you successfully hit with all three Strikes, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3}.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're in Sky and Heaven Stance.

You Stride up to your Speed, and your ki enshrouds your limbs in terrifying stormy energy, increasing the reach of your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.UjEeHamC2C8JfgJz]{Sky and Heaven Stance} unarmed attacks by 5 feet. At the end of your movement, make up to three Strikes against a target you can reach, each at a –2 penalty. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after you've made all your attacks. Instead of the usual slashing or piercing damage, the damage for these Strikes is either electricity or sonic, as you choose with each Strike. If you successfully hit with all three Strikes, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3}.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 하늘과 천국 자세를 취하고 있어야 한다.

당신은 속도만큼 이동하며, 기가 사지를 끔찍한 폭풍 에너지로 감싸 @link[feats.sky-and-heaven-stance]의 비무장 공격 범위를 5피트 증가시킵니다. 이동 종료 시, 도달 가능한 대상에게 최대 세 번의 공격을 가할 수 있으며, 각 공격은 -2 페널티를 받습니다. 각 공격은 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되나, 모든 공격을 완료하기 전까지는 페널티가 증가하지 않는다. 일반적인 베기 또는 관통 피해 대신, 이 공격들의 피해는 각 공격마다 선택한 대로 전기 또는 음파 피해로 발생한다. 세 번의 공격 모두 성공 시, 대상은 @link[conditions.drained]{3} 상태가 된다.

name: Eternal Wings (Sylph)

description.value: Your wings are now a permanent part of your body. You gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.FUOUyhHufNH4ri7H]{Wings of Air} at all times rather than just once per day for 10 minutes.

_desc_en: Your wings are now a permanent part of your body. You gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.FUOUyhHufNH4ri7H]{Wings of Air} at all times rather than just once per day for 10 minutes.
_desc_ko: 이제 당신의 날개는 영구적인 신체 일부가 되었습니다. @link[feats.wings-of-air] 효과를 하루에 한 번 10분 동안만 얻는 것이 아니라 항상 얻게 됩니다.

name: Brightness Seeker

description.value: Once per day, you can spend 10 minutes studying your surroundings in search of omens related to a particular course of action to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X]{Augury} as an innate divine spell. Unless the result of the augury was "nothing," you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.mk6rzaAzsBBRGJnh]{Call Upon the Brightness} reaction for the next 30 minutes.

_desc_en: Once per day, you can spend 10 minutes studying your surroundings in search of omens related to a particular course of action to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X]{Augury} as an innate divine spell. Unless the result of the augury was "nothing," you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.mk6rzaAzsBBRGJnh]{Call Upon the Brightness} reaction for the next 30 minutes.
_desc_ko: 하루에 한 번, 특정 행동 방침과 관련된 징조를 찾기 위해 주변을 10분간 관찰함으로써 @link[spells.augury]을 선천적 신성 마법으로 시전할 수 있다. 점괘의 결과가 "아무것도 없음"이 아닌 경우, 다음 30분 동안 @link[actions.call-upon-the-brightness] 반응을 얻습니다.

name: Five-Breath Vanguard Dedication

description.value:
Access Tian Xia origin or exposure to Tian elementalism

You flow like the elemental cycle, adapting your stance and techniques constantly in response to whatever circumstances you face. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Oh6H1fuXC6jK4Hcp]{Cycle Elemental Stance} action.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.lCmFR1N4lCMOYXcE]{Five-Breath Vanguard}

value.value: Two of the five elemental stances (Ironblood Stance, Mountain Stance, Reflective Ripple Stance, Stoked Flame Stance, and Tangled Forest Stance)

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Access Tian Xia origin or exposure to Tian elementalism

You flow like the elemental cycle, adapting your stance and techniques constantly in response to whatever circumstances you face. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Oh6H1fuXC6jK4Hcp]{Cycle Elemental Stance} action.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.lCmFR1N4lCMOYXcE]{Five-Breath Vanguard}
_desc_ko:
접근 티엔 샤 출신 또는 천 원소술 노출

당신은 원소의 순환처럼 흐르며, 마주하는 어떤 상황에도 끊임없이 자세와 기술을 적응시킵니다. 당신은 @link[actions.cycle-elemental-stance] 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Call the Swarm

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You give a shrill whistle and point, and a massive swarm of rats pours forth from the surrounding terrain to fill a @Template[burst|distance:30] within 120 feet. The rats scurry over the ground and climb up walls and surfaces, biting and clawing as they deal @Damage[6d8[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage to all enemies in the area. The rats continue to swarm in the area for the next minute, dealing @Damage[3d8[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage to any enemy that ends its turn in the area and transforming the area into difficult terrain (though the rats allow you and your allies to pass normally). You can Dismiss the effect.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You give a shrill whistle and point, and a massive swarm of rats pours forth from the surrounding terrain to fill a @Template[burst|distance:30] within 120 feet. The rats scurry over the ground and climb up walls and surfaces, biting and clawing as they deal @Damage[6d8[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage to all enemies in the area. The rats continue to swarm in the area for the next minute, dealing @Damage[3d8[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage to any enemy that ends its turn in the area and transforming the area into difficult terrain (though the rats allow you and your allies to pass normally). You can Dismiss the effect.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신은 날카로운 휘파람을 불고 한 곳을 가리키자, 주변 지형에서 거대한 쥐 떼가 쏟아져 나와 120피트 이내의 30피트 영역을 가득 메운다. 쥐들은 땅 위를 기어 다니고 벽과 표면을 기어오르며, 이 영역 내 모든 적에게 6d8 관통의 피해를 입히며 물어뜯고 할퀴어댄다. 쥐들은 이후 1분 동안 해당 지역에 계속 떼를 지어 머물며, 턴을 끝내는 모든 적에게 3d8 관통의 피해를 입히고 해당 지역을 어려운 지형으로 변환한다(단, 당신과 아군들은 쥐들 사이를 정상적으로 통과할 수 있음). 이 효과를 해제할 수 있다.

name: Nocturnal Kindred

description.value:
You have an innate connection with other creatures of the night and understand some of them. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use Diplomacy with bats, rats, and wolves. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on such animals.

Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Aap7nGpC7neTWm78]{Animal Allies} as a divine innate spell, using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. The creatures it summons are bats, rats, and wolves. At 5th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the spell is heightened by an additional level, to a maximum of a 9th-rank animal allies when you are 19th level.

_desc_en:
You have an innate connection with other creatures of the night and understand some of them. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use Diplomacy with bats, rats, and wolves. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on such animals.

Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Aap7nGpC7neTWm78]{Animal Allies} as a divine innate spell, using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. The creatures it summons are bats, rats, and wolves. At 5th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the spell is heightened by an additional level, to a maximum of a 9th-rank animal allies when you are 19th level.
_desc_ko:
당신은 밤의 다른 생물들과 타고난 유대감을 가지고 있으며 그들 중 일부를 이해합니다. 박쥐, 쥐, 늑대에게 질문을 하고 답변을 받을 수 있으며, 이 동물들에게 외교 기술을 사용할 수 있습니다. 또한 이러한 동물들에게 @link[actions.make-an-impression]에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

하루에 한 번, @link[spells.animal-allies]을 신성 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 이때 클래스 DC와 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽을 사용합니다. 소환되는 생물은 박쥐, 쥐, 늑대입니다. 5레벨에 도달하고 이후 2레벨마다 이 주문은 추가 레벨만큼 강화되며, 19레벨에 도달하면 최대 (9th)레벨의 동물 동맹을 소환할 수 있다.

name: Stunning Blows

description.value: The focused power of your flurry threatens to overwhelm your opponent. When you target the same creature with two Strikes from your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.nbfNETdpee8CVM17]{Flurry of Blows}, you can try to stun the creature. If either Strike hits and deals damage, the target must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3} on a critical failure). This is an incapacitation effect.

_desc_en: The focused power of your flurry threatens to overwhelm your opponent. When you target the same creature with two Strikes from your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.nbfNETdpee8CVM17]{Flurry of Blows}, you can try to stun the creature. If either Strike hits and deals damage, the target must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3} on a critical failure). This is an incapacitation effect.
_desc_ko: 연타의 집중된 힘이 상대를 압도할 듯 위협한다. @link[actions.flurry-of-blows]의 두 번의 공격으로 같은 생물을 공격할 때, 그 생물을 기절시키려 시도할 수 있다. 두 공격 중 하나라도 명중하여 피해를 입히면, 대상은 네 클래스 난이도(DC)에 대한 인내 내성에 성공해야 한다. 실패 시 @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태가 된다(대실패 시 @link[conditions.stunned]{3} 상태). 이는 무력화 효과이다.

name: Shaitan Magic

description.value: The magic of shaitans runs through your blood. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0qaqksrGGDj74HXE]{Revealing Light} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Fr58LDSrbndgld9n]{Resist Energy} once per day each as 2nd-rank arcane innate spells.

_desc_en: The magic of shaitans runs through your blood. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0qaqksrGGDj74HXE]{Revealing Light} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Fr58LDSrbndgld9n]{Resist Energy} once per day each as 2nd-rank arcane innate spells.
_desc_ko: 샤이탄의 마법이 당신의 피 속에 흐릅니다. 하루에 한 번씩 @link[spells.revealing-light]과 @link[spells.resist-energy]을 각각 (2nd)랭크 아케인 비전 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Ward Medic

description.value: You've studied in large medical wards, treating several patients at once and tending to all their needs. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TC7OcDa7JlWbqMaN]{Treat Disease} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}, you can treat up to two targets. If you're a master in Medicine, you can treat up to four targets, and if you're legendary, you can treat up to eight targets.

_desc_en: You've studied in large medical wards, treating several patients at once and tending to all their needs. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TC7OcDa7JlWbqMaN]{Treat Disease} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}, you can treat up to two targets. If you're a master in Medicine, you can treat up to four targets, and if you're legendary, you can treat up to eight targets.
_desc_ko: 당신은 대규모 의료실에서 여러 환자를 동시에 치료하며 그들의 모든 필요를 돌보는 법을 배웠습니다. @link[actions.treat-disease]나 @link[actions.treat-wounds]를 사용할 때 최대 두 명의 대상까지 치료할 수 있습니다. 의학에 달인인 경우 최대 4명의 대상까지 치료할 수 있으며, 전설적인 경우 최대 8명의 대상까지 치료할 수 있습니다.

name: Enigma's Knowledge

description.value: Your muse whispers knowledge to you at all the right times. You gain the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.H3I2X0f7v4EzwxuN]{Automatic Knowledge} skill feat with any skill you can use to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}. As per the special clause in the Automatic Knowledge feat, you can still only use Automatic Knowledge once per round.

_desc_en: Your muse whispers knowledge to you at all the right times. You gain the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.H3I2X0f7v4EzwxuN]{Automatic Knowledge} skill feat with any skill you can use to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}. As per the special clause in the Automatic Knowledge feat, you can still only use Automatic Knowledge once per round.
_desc_ko: 당신의 뮤즈가 적절한 순간마다 지식을 속삭여 줍니다. @link[feats.automatic-knowledge] 기술 피트의 혜택을 @link[actions.recall-knowledge]에 사용할 수 있는 모든 기술에 적용받습니다. 자동 지식 특성의 특별 조항에 따라, 여전히 라운드당 한 번만 자동 지식을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Bonds of Death

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You have cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9WGeBwIIbbUuWKq0]{Summon Undead} this turn.

You sway with the motions of your spells that animate the dead, channeling your power to sustain two at the same time. You Sustain your previous casting of animate dead, binding the necromantic energy of the two spells together with metaphysical twine. On subsequent rounds, you can Sustain both animate dead spells with a single action to Sustain the Spell. This benefit lasts until either of the spells ends.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You have cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9WGeBwIIbbUuWKq0]{Summon Undead} this turn.

You sway with the motions of your spells that animate the dead, channeling your power to sustain two at the same time. You Sustain your previous casting of animate dead, binding the necromantic energy of the two spells together with metaphysical twine. On subsequent rounds, you can Sustain both animate dead spells with a single action to Sustain the Spell. This benefit lasts until either of the spells ends.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

요구 사항 이번 턴에 @link[spells.summon-undead]을 시전했어야 합니다.

당신은 죽은 자를 움직이게 하는 주문의 움직임에 몸을 맡기며, 동시에 두 주문을 유지하기 위해 힘을 집중합니다. 당신은 이전에 시전한 '죽은 자를 움직이다' 주문을 유지하며, 두 주문의 네크로맨틱 에너지를 형이상학적 실로 묶어둡니다. 이후 라운드에는 '주문 유지' 액션 하나로 두 '죽은 자를 움직이다' 주문을 모두 유지할 수 있습니다. 이 효과는 두 주문 중 하나가 종료될 때까지 지속됩니다.

name: Consult the Spirits (Rivethun Emissary)

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You spend 1 hour communing with powerful spirits of the world to gain insight, information, or advice. Select advice or answers.

If you selected advice, choose a particular goal or activity you plan to engage in today, or an event you might expect to happen today. The spirits share with you a cryptic clue or piece of advice that could help with the chosen event, often in the form of a rhyme or omen.

If you selected answers, ask two clear and concise questions. The spirits answer your questions. If the question is easy for the spirits to answer accurately, they answer clearly. Otherwise, they answer cryptically, often in the form of a rhyme or omen.

Regardless of your choice, the spirits additionally bless you, granting you a +1 status bonus with a skill that the spirits believe will be of use to you today. The GM selects this skill on behalf of the spirits. This bonus lasts until the end of the day.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.sEv8H8PrMd0C3wJ7]{Effect: Consult the Spirits}

당신은 1시간 동안 세상의 강력한 영혼들과 교감하며 통찰력, 정보 또는 조언을 얻습니다. 조언 또는 답변을 선택하세요.

조언을 선택했다면, 오늘 계획 중인 특정 목표나 활동, 혹은 오늘 일어날 것으로 예상되는 사건을 선택하세요. 영혼들은 선택한 사건에 도움이 될 수 있는 암시적인 단서나 조언을, 종종 운율이나 징조의 형태로 전해줍니다.

답변을 선택했다면, 명확하고 간결한 질문 두 가지를 하십시오. 영혼들이 당신의 질문에 답합니다. 영혼들이 정확히 답하기 쉬운 질문이라면 명확히 답합니다. 그렇지 않다면, 종종 운율이나 징조의 형태로 암시적으로 답합니다.

선택과 무관하게, 영혼들은 추가로 당신을 축복하여 오늘 당신에게 유용할 것이라고 믿는 기술에 +1 상태 보너스를 부여합니다. GM이 영혼들을 대신하여 이 기술을 선택합니다. 이 보너스는 하루가 끝날 때까지 지속됩니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.sEv8H8PrMd0C3wJ7]{효과: 영혼과 상담하기}

name: Endure Death's Touch

description.value:
Requirements You are wearing medium or heavy armor in which you have expert proficiency.

Trigger An undead hits you with an unarmed attack.

Your conviction redirects the undead's attack through your armor and then harmlessly away. You gain resistance 5 to physical damage and resistance 10 to void damage against the triggering attack. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus on any saving throws against effects from the undead's natural attack; if you succeed at the saving throw, you get a critical success instead.

value.value: expert in medium or heavy armor

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wearing medium or heavy armor in which you have expert proficiency.

Trigger An undead hits you with an unarmed attack.

Your conviction redirects the undead's attack through your armor and then harmlessly away. You gain resistance 5 to physical damage and resistance 10 to void damage against the triggering attack. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus on any saving throws against effects from the undead's natural attack; if you succeed at the saving throw, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 평갑 또는 중갑옷을 착용하고 있으며, 이에 숙련 숙련도를 보유하고 있습니다.

발동 조건 언데드가 비무장 공격으로 당신을 명중시킵니다.

당신의 확신이 언데드의 공격을 갑옷을 통해 무해하게 튕겨내게 합니다. 해당 공격에 대해 물리 피해에 대한 저항력 5와 공허 피해에 대한 저항력 10을 얻습니다. 언데드의 자연 공격 효과에 대한 모든 내성 굴림에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 내성 굴림에 성공하면 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Sentinel Dedication

description.value:
You have trained carefully to maximize the protective qualities of your armor. You become trained in light armor and medium armor. If you already were trained in light armor and medium armor, you gain training in heavy armor as well. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in any type of armor (but not unarmored defense), you also gain that proficiency in the armor types granted to you by this feat. If you have a class feature that grants you expert proficiency in unarmored defense and you're 13th level or higher, you also become an expert in the armor types granted to you by this feat.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.TnD2hTWTyjGKlw9b]{Sentinel}

_desc_en:

If you already were trained in light armor and medium armor, you gain training in heavy armor as well. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.TnD2hTWTyjGKlw9b]{Sentinel}
_desc_ko: 당신은 갑옷의 방어 성능을 극대화하기 위해 세심하게 훈련했습니다. 경갑과 평갑에 숙련됩니다. 이미 경갑과 평갑에 숙련된 경우, 평갑에 대한 숙련도 추가로 얻습니다. 어떤 갑옷 유형에 대해 숙련자 이상의 숙련도를 부여하는 클래스 피트를 획득할 때마다(비무장 방어는 제외), 이 피트로 부여받은 갑옷 유형에 대해서도 동일한 숙련도를 얻습니다. 비무장 방어에 대해 숙련자 숙련도를 부여하는 클래스 피트가 있고 13레벨 이상인 경우, 이 피트로 부여받은 갑옷 유형에 대해서도 숙련자가 됩니다.

name: Crowned in Tempest's Fury

description.value:
You become one with a devastating thunderstorm from the Plane of Air, placing a crown of lightning upon your brow. Sparks flash in your eyes, and lightning strikes constantly in the air around you as howling winds lift you from the ground.

  • Any creature that enters your kinetic aura or ends its turn there takes @Damage[2d12[electricity]] damage.
  • If you don't have a fly Speed, you gain a 20-foot fly Speed. If you have the Cyclonic Ascent impulse, you instead gain that fly Speed and the extra benefits.
  • You gain a +10-foot status bonus to all your Speeds.
  • Your air Elemental Blasts deal an additional @Damage[1d12[electricity]] damage.

_desc_en:
You become one with a devastating thunderstorm from the Plane of Air, placing a crown of lightning upon your brow. Sparks flash in your eyes, and lightning strikes constantly in the air around you as howling winds lift you from the ground.

  • Any creature that enters your kinetic aura or ends its turn there takes @Damage[2d12[electricity]] damage.
  • If you don't have a fly Speed, you gain a 20-foot fly Speed. If you have the Cyclonic Ascent impulse, you instead gain that fly Speed and the extra benefits.
  • You gain a +10-foot status bonus to all your Speeds.
  • Your air Elemental Blasts deal an additional @Damage[1d12[electricity]] damage.
_desc_ko:
공기계의 파괴적인 뇌우와 하나가 되어 이마에 번개의 왕관을 씌운다. 눈에서 불꽃이 번쩍이고, 울부짖는 바람이 땅에서 당신을 들어 올리는 동안 주변 공기에 번개가 끊임없이 강타한다.

  • 당신의 키네틱 오라에 들어오거나 그 안에서 턴을 끝내는 모든 생물은 2d12 전기의 피해를 입는다.
  • 비행 속도가 없다면 20피트 비행 속도를 얻는다. 사이클론 상승 충동을 가진 경우, 대신 해당 비행 속도와 추가 혜택을 얻는다.
  • 모든 이동 속도에 +10피트 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.
  • 공기 원소 폭발이 1d12 전기의 추가 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Rallying Cry

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You call out to your allies and push them to give their all in combat. All allies in a @Template[emanation|distance:30] that can hear you gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level. In addition, these allies become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 1 minute but can use the extra action only to Step, Stride, or Strike.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You call out to your allies and push them to give their all in combat. All allies in a @Template[emanation|distance:30] that can hear you gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level. In addition, these allies become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 1 minute but can use the extra action only to Step, Stride, or Strike.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

동료들에게 외쳐 전투에서 최선을 다하도록 독려한다. 소리를 들을 수 있는 30피트 내 모든 동료는 네 레벨과 동일한 수의 임시 HP를 얻는다. 또한 이 동료들은 1분 동안 @link[conditions.quickened] 상태가 되지만, 추가 행동으로 이동, 급행, 공격만 사용할 수 있다.

name: Lotus Above the Wind

description.value: Your qi, dancing ever diligently toward cultivation, eludes the grasp of the world's muck and mire. When you cast your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GUnw9YXaW3YyaCAU]{Adapt Self} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.UGJzJRJDoonfWqqI]{Athletic Rush} focus spells, you ignore difficult terrain until the end of your next turn.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide
