When you cast your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GUnw9YXaW3YyaCAU]{Adapt Self} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.UGJzJRJDoonfWqqI]{Athletic Rush} focus spells, you ignore difficult terrain until the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko: 수련을 향해 끊임없이 춤추듯 흐르는 당신의 기운은 세상의 더러움과 진창의 손아귀를 피해 나갑니다. @link[spells.adapt-self] 또는 @link[spells.athletic-rush] 포커스 주문을 시전할 때, 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 어려운 지형을 무시한다.

name: Entities From Afar

description.value:
You can call in aberrations to fight for you or to answer questions. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i1TvBID5QLyXrUCa]{Summon Entity} as an innate occult spell once per day. If you couldn't already cast occult spells, these spells use Intelligence as your spellcasting ability, and you become trained in spell attack rolls and spell DCs for occult spells; if you could already cast occult spells, your proficiency in spell attack rolls and spell DCs for occult spells increases to expert.

As soon as the aberration arrives, instead of giving it any other commands, you can demand that it help you with a single question you pose to it. For the creature to effectively answer, you must Sustain the Spell for 1 minute, and you must understand and be understood by the aberration. If you do, the aberration gives you a cryptic clue as provided by the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.pkcOby5prOausy1k]{Read Omens} spell, except that the clue is even more enigmatic than normal; the creature then immediately returns from whence it came without providing you any other benefit. At 16th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the summon entity spell is heightened by 1 rank (to a maximum of 8th rank when you reach 20th level).

_desc_en:
You can call in aberrations to fight for you or to answer questions. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i1TvBID5QLyXrUCa]{Summon Entity} as an innate occult spell once per day. If you couldn't already cast occult spells, these spells use Intelligence as your spellcasting ability, and you become trained in spell attack rolls and spell DCs for occult spells; if you could already cast occult spells, your proficiency in spell attack rolls and spell DCs for occult spells increases to expert.

As soon as the aberration arrives, instead of giving it any other commands, you can demand that it help you with a single question you pose to it. For the creature to effectively answer, you must Sustain the Spell for 1 minute, and you must understand and be understood by the aberration. If you do, the aberration gives you a cryptic clue as provided by the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.pkcOby5prOausy1k]{Read Omens} spell, except that the clue is even more enigmatic than normal; the creature then immediately returns from whence it came without providing you any other benefit. At 16th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the summon entity spell is heightened by 1 rank (to a maximum of 8th rank when you reach 20th level).
_desc_ko:
당신은 이형체들을 소환하여 당신을 위해 싸우게 하거나 질문에 답하게 할 수 있습니다. 당신은 @link[spells.summon-entity]을 하루에 한 번 선천적 오컬트 주문으로 시전할 수 있다. 기존에 오컬트 주문을 시전할 수 없었다면, 이 주문들은 지능을 주문 시전 능력치로 사용하며, 오컬트 주문의 주문 명중 굴림과 주문 난이도(DC)에 숙련된다. 기존에 오컬트 주문을 시전할 수 있었다면, 오컬트 주문의 주문 명중 굴림과 주문 난이도(DC)에 대한 숙련도가 전문가 수준으로 상승한다.

이형체가 도착하자마자, 다른 명령을 내리는 대신 단 하나의 질문에 대한 답변을 요구할 수 있다. 효과적인 답변을 얻으려면 1분 동안 주문을 유지해야 하며, 이형체를 이해하고 그로부터 이해받아야 한다. 성공 시, 이형체는 @link[spells.read-omens] 주문과 동일한 방식으로 암시적인 단서를 제공합니다. 단, 이 단서는 평소보다 훨씬 더 난해합니다. 이후 이형체는 다른 이득 없이 즉시 원래 있던 곳으로 돌아갑니다. 16레벨에 도달하고 이후 2레벨마다 소환체 주문은 1랭크씩 강화됩니다(20레벨에 도달하면 최대 8th 랭크까지 강화됨).

name: Devil's Advocate

description.value:
Access Chelaxian nationality

You know more about the habits of devils than is entirely safe. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks against devils and saving throws against their abilities.

In addition, whenever you meet a devil in a social situation, you can immediately attempt a Diplomacy check to Make an Impression on that creature rather than needing to converse for 1 minute. You take a -5 penalty to the check. If you fail, you can engage in 1 minute of conversation and attempt a new check at the end of that time rather than accepting the failure or critical failure result.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.cc8O47KFsODReoBe]{Glad-Hand} skill feat, you don't take the penalty to your immediate Diplomacy check if the target is a devil.

_desc_en:
Access Chelaxian nationality

You know more about the habits of devils than is entirely safe. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks against devils and saving throws against their abilities.

In addition, whenever you meet a devil in a social situation, you can immediately attempt a Diplomacy check to Make an Impression on that creature rather than needing to converse for 1 minute. You take a -5 penalty to the check. If you fail, you can engage in 1 minute of conversation and attempt a new check at the end of that time rather than accepting the failure or critical failure result.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.cc8O47KFsODReoBe]{Glad-Hand} skill feat, you don't take the penalty to your immediate Diplomacy check if the target is a devil.
_desc_ko:
접근 첼락시아 국적

당신은 데빌의 습관에 대해 안전하지 않을 정도로 많이 알고 있습니다. 데빌을 상대로 한 지각 판정 및 그들의 능력에 대한 내성 굴림에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

또한 사교 상황에서 데빌을 만날 때마다, 1분간 대화할 필요 없이 즉시 외교 판정을 시도해 그 생물에게 인상을 남길 수 있습니다. 판정에는 -5 페널티가 적용됩니다. 실패 시, 실패 또는 대실패 결과를 받아들이지 않고 1분간 대화를 나눈 후 시간 종료 시 새로운 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다.

특수 @link[feats.glad-hand] 기술 피트를 보유한 경우, 대상이 데빌일 때 즉각적인 외교 판정 페널티를 받지 않습니다.

name: Smashing Tail

description.value: You have a tail that serves as a potent weapon. You gain a tail unarmed attack that deals @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] damage, has the sweep trait, and is in the brawling weapon group.

_desc_en: You have a tail that serves as a potent weapon. You gain a tail unarmed attack that deals @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] damage, has the sweep trait, and is in the brawling weapon group.
_desc_ko: 당신은 강력한 무기로 사용되는 꼬리를 지녔습니다. 꼬리 비무장 공격을 얻으며, 이 공격은 1d6 타격의 피해를 주고, 쓸기 특성을 가지며, 격투 무기 그룹에 속합니다.

name: Lesson of Sympathetic Vulnerability

description.value:
Trigger Your student triggered a creature's weakness to energy damage with a Strike or spell on their previous turn.

You temporarily borrow the essence of your student's attack to infuse yourself. Until the end of your current turn, damage you deal to enemies from Strikes and spells is the same type that triggered the creature's weakness instead of its usual type.

_desc_en:
Trigger Your student triggered a creature's weakness to energy damage with a Strike or spell on their previous turn.

You temporarily borrow the essence of your student's attack to infuse yourself. Until the end of your current turn, damage you deal to enemies from Strikes and spells is the same type that triggered the creature's weakness instead of its usual type.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신의 제자가 지난 턴에 공격이나 주문으로 생물의 에너지 피해 약점을 발동시켰습니다.

당신은 제자의 공격 본질을 일시적으로 빌려 자신에게 주입합니다. 현재 턴이 끝날 때까지, 당신이 적에게 가하는 공격과 주문 피해는 평소 유형 대신 해당 생물의 약점을 유발한 에너지 유형으로 적용됩니다.

name: Bloody Denial

description.value:
You strike a foe with force to prevent them from reacting. Make a Strike. If you hit, the target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:guardian|options:inflicts:stunned] saving throw against your class DC. If your Strike was a critical hit, the result of the save is one degree of success worse.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success Choose an ally. Until the start of your next turn, the creature can't use reactions against that ally.

Failure The creature can't use reactions until the start of your next turn.

Critical Failure As failure, plus the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

_desc_en:
You strike a foe with force to prevent them from reacting. Make a Strike. If you hit, the target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:guardian|options:inflicts:stunned] saving throw against your class DC. If your Strike was a critical hit, the result of the save is one degree of success worse.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success Choose an ally. Until the start of your next turn, the creature can't use reactions against that ally.

Failure The creature can't use reactions until the start of your next turn.

Critical Failure As failure, plus the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.
_desc_ko:
상대가 반응하지 못하도록 힘차게 타격한다. 공격 검사를 수행한다. 명중 시, 대상은 네 직업 난이도(DC)에 대한 인내 내성 굴림을 시도해야 한다. 공격이 치명타였을 경우, 내성의 결과는 한 단계 더 나빠진다.

대성공 생물은 영향을 받지 않는다.

성공 아군 하나를 선택합니다. 다음 차례 시작 전까지 해당 생물은 선택한 아군에게 반응 행동을 사용할 수 없습니다.

실패 해당 생물은 다음 차례 시작까지 반응을 사용할 수 없습니다.

대실패 실패 효과에 더해, 해당 생물은 @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태가 된다.

name: Perfect Truths

description.value:
Your knowledge of Razmir's faith and doctrines has grown. You excel in debating priests of rival faiths, wielding truths as subtly and deftly as any charlatan might wield a lie. When you use Deception to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie}, you can carefully structure your deceits so that each individual statement you make is the truth, from a certain perspective.

As long as you are wearing your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.UaOrOGrjcXgSeBvr]{Razmiri Mask}, you don't take a penalty to Deception checks while subject to the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aewxsale5xWEPKLk]{Ring of Truth} spell or similar effects. Whenever you are subject to ring of truth or a similar effect, you can attempt a @Check[deception] check when you first begin speaking to counteract the spell's effects, with a counteract rank equal to half your level (rounded up); succeeding at this check doesn't end the spell or effect, but it does cause it to indicate that you are speaking the truth, even when you are actually lying, as you weave a web of words so delicate that even you can't be certain where the truth ends and deception begins.

_desc_en:
Your knowledge of Razmir's faith and doctrines has grown. You excel in debating priests of rival faiths, wielding truths as subtly and deftly as any charlatan might wield a lie. When you use Deception to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie}, you can carefully structure your deceits so that each individual statement you make is the truth, from a certain perspective.

As long as you are wearing your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.UaOrOGrjcXgSeBvr]{Razmiri Mask}, you don't take a penalty to Deception checks while subject to the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aewxsale5xWEPKLk]{Ring of Truth} spell or similar effects. Whenever you are subject to ring of truth or a similar effect, you can attempt a @Check[deception] check when you first begin speaking to counteract the spell's effects, with a counteract rank equal to half your level (rounded up); succeeding at this check doesn't end the spell or effect, but it does cause it to indicate that you are speaking the truth, even when you are actually lying, as you weave a web of words so delicate that even you can't be certain where the truth ends and deception begins.
_desc_ko:
라즈미르 신앙과 교리에 대한 당신의 지식이 깊어졌습니다. 당신은 경쟁 종교의 사제들과 논쟁할 때 탁월한 능력을 발휘하며, 사기꾼이 거짓말을 능숙하게 휘두르듯 진실을 교묘하고 능숙하게 활용합니다. 기만을 사용하여 @link[actions.lie]을 할 때, 특정 관점에서 보면 각 개별 진술이 진실인 방식으로 신중하게 거짓말을 구성할 수 있습니다.

@link[equipment.razmiri-mask]을 착용 중일 때, @link[spells.ring-of-truth] 주문이나 유사 효과의 영향을 받더라도 기만 판정 페널티를 받지 않습니다. 진실의 고리 또는 유사한 효과에 걸렸을 때, 말하기 시작하는 순간 기만 판정을 시도하여 주문의 효과를 반격할 수 있습니다. 반격 랭크은 레벨의 절반(올림)과 같습니다. 이 체커에 성공해도 주문이나 효과가 끝나지는 않지만, 당신이 실제로 거짓말을 하고 있을 때조차도 진실을 말하고 있다는 인상을 주게 됩니다. 당신이 엮어내는 말의 거미줄은 너무나 섬세해서 진실이 끝나고 기만이 시작되는 지점을 당신조차도 확신할 수 없기 때문입니다.

name: Deft Cooperation

description.value: When you set things up to help your allies, you also gain some of the fruits of your labors. When you successfully Aid an attack roll or AC, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls or AC against that enemy until the end of your next turn, whichever you granted to your ally. When you successfully Aid a skill check, if you attempt the exact same skill check (not just using the same skill, but using it for the same purpose, for instance a check to Climb the same wall) on your next turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your skill check.

_desc_en: When you set things up to help your allies, you also gain some of the fruits of your labors. When you successfully Aid an attack roll or AC, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls or AC against that enemy until the end of your next turn, whichever you granted to your ally. When you successfully Aid a skill check, if you attempt the exact same skill check (not just using the same skill, but using it for the same purpose, for instance a check to Climb the same wall) on your next turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your skill check.
_desc_ko: 동료를 돕기 위해 준비를 할 때, 그 노력의 일부 결실을 얻습니다. 명중 굴림이나 AC에 대한 지원에 성공하면, 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 해당 적에 대한 명중 굴림이나 AC에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 기술 판정 지원에 성공했을 때, 다음 턴에 정확히 동일한 기술 판정(동일한 기술을 사용하는 것뿐만 아니라 동일한 목적으로 사용하는 것, 예를 들어 같은 벽을 오르기 위한 판정)를 시도하면 해당 기술 판정에서 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Bonekeeper's Bane

description.value: Whenever an enemy starts its turn adjacent to you, it must attempt a Will saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is highest. On a failure, the enemy takes a –1 status penalty to attack rolls and skill checks for as long as it remains adjacent to you. Regardless of the result of its save, the creature is then temporarily immune to bonekeeper's bane for 24 hours.

_desc_en: Whenever an enemy starts its turn adjacent to you, it must attempt a Will saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is highest. On a failure, the enemy takes a –1 status penalty to attack rolls and skill checks for as long as it remains adjacent to you. Regardless of the result of its save, the creature is then temporarily immune to bonekeeper's bane for 24 hours.
_desc_ko: 적군이 당신과 인접한 상태로 자신의 턴을 시작할 때마다, 당신의 직업 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 더 높은 쪽에 대한 의지 내성 굴림을 시도해야 합니다. 실패 시, 적군은 당신과 인접한 상태를 유지하는 동안 명중 굴림과 기술 판정에서 -1 상태 페널티를 받습니다. 내성 결과와 무관하게, 해당 생물은 이후 24시간 동안 뼈지기의 저주에 일시적으로 면역됩니다.

name: Alkenstar Agent Dedication

description.value:
Access You have been initiated by the grand duchess of Alkenstar or one of her agents.

You put on the persona of a rough and tumble outlaw, but your real goals are to report threats to Alkenstar back to the grand duchess. You become an expert in Deception and trained in your choice of Underworld Lore or Legal Lore; if you were already trained, you become an expert instead. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Dvz54d6aPhjsmUux]{Lie to Me} skill feat.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.ttkG4geKXTao5pku]{Alkenstar Agent}

value.value: trained in Deception and at least one firearm

publication.title: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powder Keg

_desc_en:
Access You have been initiated by the grand duchess of Alkenstar or one of her agents.

You put on the persona of a rough and tumble outlaw, but your real goals are to report threats to Alkenstar back to the grand duchess. You become an expert in Deception and trained in your choice of Underworld Lore or Legal Lore; if you were already trained, you become an expert instead. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Dvz54d6aPhjsmUux]{Lie to Me} skill feat.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.ttkG4geKXTao5pku]{Alkenstar Agent}
_desc_ko:
접근 당신은 알켄스터 대공녀 또는 그녀의 요원 중 한 명에게 입문자되었습니다.

당신은 거친 무법자의 모습을 취하지만, 진정한 목표는 알켄스터에 대한 위협을 대공녀에게 보고하는 것입니다. 당신은 기만에 능숙해지며, 지하세계 지식 또는 법정 지식( Lore) 중 하나를 선택하여 훈련받습니다. 이미 훈련받은 경우, 대신 전문가가 됩니다. @link[feats.lie-to-me] 기술 피트를 획득한다.

name: Forager

description.value:
While using Survival to Subsist, if you roll any result worse than a success, you get a success. On a success, you can provide subsistence living for yourself and four additional creatures, and on a critical success, you can take care of twice as many additional creatures. You can choose to support half the number of creatures with a comfortable living.

Increase the number of additional creatures you feed on a success to eight if you're an expert in Survival, 16 if you're a master, and 32 if you're legendary.

_desc_en:
While using Survival to Subsist, if you roll any result worse than a success, you get a success. On a success, you can provide subsistence living for yourself and four additional creatures, and on a critical success, you can take care of twice as many additional creatures. You can choose to support half the number of creatures with a comfortable living.

Increase the number of additional creatures you feed on a success to eight if you're an expert in Survival, 16 if you're a master, and 32 if you're legendary.
_desc_ko:
생존 기술로 생계를 유지할 때, 성공보다 낮은 결과를 굴렀다면 성공으로 처리한다. 성공 시 자신과 추가 생물 4마리에게 생계 유지를 제공할 수 있으며, 대성공 시 두 배의 추가 생물을 돌볼 수 있다. 생물의 절반에게 편안한 생활을 제공하도록 선택할 수 있다.

생존 기술이 전문가 수준일 경우 성공 시 추가 생물 수를 8마리로, 달인 수준일 경우 16마리로, 전설적 수준일 경우 32마리로 증가시킵니다.

name: Fey Caller

description.value: You have learned some of the tricks the fey use to bend primal magic toward illusions and trickery. Add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2oH5IufzdESuYxat]{Illusory Object}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ucf8eynbZMfUucjE]{Illusory Scene} to your spell list, which you cast as primal spells.

_desc_en: You have learned some of the tricks the fey use to bend primal magic toward illusions and trickery. Add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2oH5IufzdESuYxat]{Illusory Object}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ucf8eynbZMfUucjE]{Illusory Scene} to your spell list, which you cast as primal spells.
_desc_ko: 당신은 페이들이 프라이멀 마법을 환상과 속임수로 활용하는 몇 가지 기술을 익혔습니다. @link[spells.illusory-disguise], @link[spells.illusory-object], @link[spells.illusory-scene]을 프라이멀 마법으로 시전하는 당신의 주문 목록에 추가합니다.

name: Duskwalker Weapon Familiarity

description.value:
You have familiarity with the bo staff, longbow, composite longbow, scythe, and staff—for the purpose of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

_desc_en:
You have familiarity with the bo staff, longbow, composite longbow, scythe, and staff—for the purpose of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
_desc_ko:
당신은 육척봉, 롱보우, 컴포지트 롱보우, 낫, 스태프에 숙련되어 있습니다. 숙련도 목적상, 이 중 무술 무기인 것은 단순 무기로, 고급 무기인 것은 무술 무기로 취급합니다.

5레벨에 도달하면, 이 무기들로 치명타를 성공시킬 때마다 해당 무기의 치명타 특화 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Liberate Soul

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements Your spiral is glowing.

The light flows from your sigil of Pharasma to shatter the bonds imprisoning a soul. You attempt to counteract a possession effect, or an effect, object, or spell that is imprisoning a soul (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GYmXvS9NJ7QwfWGg]{Seize Soul}, a soul gem, or a devourer's devoured souls).

You must be within 60 feet of the possessed creature or object, or of the receptacle imprisoning the soul. Your counteract rank is half your level rounded up, and your counteract modifier is your divine spell DC -10. If the attempt fails, you can't use Liberate Soul against that particular effect again unless circumstances have changed drastically, as determined by the GM.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements Your spiral is glowing.

The light flows from your sigil of Pharasma to shatter the bonds imprisoning a soul. You attempt to counteract a possession effect, or an effect, object, or spell that is imprisoning a soul (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GYmXvS9NJ7QwfWGg]{Seize Soul}, a soul gem, or a devourer's devoured souls).

You must be within 60 feet of the possessed creature or object, or of the receptacle imprisoning the soul. Your counteract rank is half your level rounded up, and your counteract modifier is your divine spell DC -10. If the attempt fails, you can't use Liberate Soul against that particular effect again unless circumstances have changed drastically, as determined by the GM.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 시간당 1회

요구 사항 당신의 나선형이 빛나고 있습니다.

파라스마의 인장으로부터 흘러나온 빛이 영혼을 가둔 속박을 산산조각 낸다. 당신은 영혼을 가두는 효과(예: @link[spells.seize-soul], 영혼 보석, 또는 삼켜진 자의 삼켜진 영혼들)를 가진 효과, 물체, 또는 주문을 반격하려 시도합니다.

당신은 소유된 생물이나 물체, 또는 영혼을 가두고 있는 용기로부터 60피트 이내에 있어야 합니다. 당신의 반격 랭크은 레벨의 절반을 올림한 값이며, 반격 수정자는 신성 주문 DC -10입니다. 시도가 실패하면, GM이 판단한 대로 상황이 극적으로 바뀌지 않는 한 해당 효과에 대해 다시는 영혼 해방 주문을 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Dragon Stance

description.value:
Requirements You are unarmored

You enter the stance of a dragon and make powerful leg strikes like a lashing dragon's tail. You can make dragon tail attacks that deal 1d10 bludgeoning damage. They are in the brawling group and have the backswing, nonlethal, and unarmed traits.

While in Dragon Stance, you can ignore the first square of difficult terrain while Striding.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are unarmored

You enter the stance of a dragon and make powerful leg strikes like a lashing dragon's tail. You can make dragon tail attacks that deal 1d10 bludgeoning damage. They are in the brawling group and have the backswing, nonlethal, and unarmed traits.

While in Dragon Stance, you can ignore the first square of difficult terrain while Striding.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 갑옷을 착용하지 않은 상태여야 함

용의 자세를 취하고 휘두르는 용의 꼬리처럼 강력한 다리 공격을 가합니다. 1d10 타격을 주는 용 꼬리 공격을 할 수 있습니다. 이 공격은 난투 그룹에 속하며 백스윙, 비살상, 비무장 특성을 가집니다.

용의 자세 상태에서는 이동 시 첫 번째 칸의 어려운 지형을 무시할 수 있다.

name: Exacting Strike

description.value:
You make a controlled follow-up attack, fully accounting for your momentum. Make a Strike. The Strike gains the following failure effect.

Failure This attack doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty.

_desc_en:
You make a controlled follow-up attack, fully accounting for your momentum. Make a Strike. The Strike gains the following failure effect.

Failure This attack doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty.
_desc_ko:
당신은 관성력을 완전히 고려한 제어된 후속 공격을 가합니다. 타격을 수행하세요. 해당 타격은 다음과 같은 실패 효과를 얻습니다.

실패 시 이 공격은 다중 공격 페널티 계산에 포함되지 않습니다.

name: Pinch Time

description.value:
One of your parents has a human life span and another an elven life span, with your own somewhere between. As a result, you have an unusual perspective on time, which you've learned to manifest to aid yourself in moments of stress.

You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{Haste} as a 3rd-rank arcane innate spell, though you can target only yourself. You can Cast this Spell once per day.

_desc_en:
One of your parents has a human life span and another an elven life span, with your own somewhere between. As a result, you have an unusual perspective on time, which you've learned to manifest to aid yourself in moments of stress.

You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{Haste} as a 3rd-rank arcane innate spell, though you can target only yourself. You can Cast this Spell once per day.
_desc_ko:
당신의 부모 중 한 분은 인간의 수명을, 다른 한 분은 엘프의 수명을 지니며, 당신의 수명은 그 중간 정도입니다. 그 결과, 당신은 시간에 대한 독특한 관점을 가지게 되었으며, 스트레스가 심한 순간에 자신을 돕기 위해 이를 창조하는 법을 배웠습니다.

당신은 @link[spells.haste]을 (3rd)랭크 아케인 선천 주문으로 얻습니다. 단, 자신만을 대상으로 할 수 있습니다. 이 주문을 하루에 한 번 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Dazzling Bullet

description.value: Your tricks discombobulate your opponent, leaving spots in their vision from the bright flash of your gunshot reflected straight into their eyes (or other visual organs). Attempt a @Check[performance|defense:will] check against the target creature's Will DC and make a ranged firearm Strike against that target. If the Strike deals damage to the target creature and you succeed at the Performance check, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

_desc_en: Your tricks discombobulate your opponent, leaving spots in their vision from the bright flash of your gunshot reflected straight into their eyes (or other visual organs). Attempt a @Check[performance|defense:will] check against the target creature's Will DC and make a ranged firearm Strike against that target. If the Strike deals damage to the target creature and you succeed at the Performance check, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.
_desc_ko: 당신의 속임수가 상대를 혼란스럽게 하여, 총탄의 밝은 섬광이 상대방의 눈(또는 다른 시각 기관)에 직접 반사되어 시야에 반점이 생기게 합니다. 대상 생물의 의지 DC에 대한 공연 판정(Perform: Firearms)를 시도하고, 해당 대상에 대해 원거리 화기 공격을 가한다. 공격이 대상 생물에게 피해를 입히고 퍼포먼스 판정에서 성공하면, 그 생물은 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.dazzled]가 된다.

name: Fight Choreography

description.value: You've spent enough time training in stage fighting and teaching a wide range of stunts that you can prepare your companions with directions on how to avoid peril in battle. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} an ally's Acrobatics or Athletics check with a Theater Lore check. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cyl7y8GcGjd8ENC7]{Swift Choreography} reaction.

_desc_en: You've spent enough time training in stage fighting and teaching a wide range of stunts that you can prepare your companions with directions on how to avoid peril in battle. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} an ally's Acrobatics or Athletics check with a Theater Lore check. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cyl7y8GcGjd8ENC7]{Swift Choreography} reaction.
_desc_ko: 무대 격투 훈련과 다양한 스턴트 지도를 충분히 쌓아 동료들에게 전투 중 위험을 피하는 방법을 지시할 수 있다. 연극 지식 판정으로 아군의 곡예 또는 운동 판정을 @link[actions.aid]할 수 있다. @link[actions.swift-choreography] 반응을 획득합니다.

name: Paralyzing Slash

description.value: Your enzymes can paralyze your foes rather than merely making it harder for them to heal their wounds. Strike with your claw or jaws. If you hit a living non-elf creature, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} unless it succeeds at a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Regardless of the result of the save, the creature is temporarily immune to Paralyzing Slash for 24 hours. A creature that becomes paralyzed can attempt a new save to end the paralysis at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.

_desc_en: Your enzymes can paralyze your foes rather than merely making it harder for them to heal their wounds. Strike with your claw or jaws. If you hit a living non-elf creature, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} unless it succeeds at a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Regardless of the result of the save, the creature is temporarily immune to Paralyzing Slash for 24 hours. A creature that becomes paralyzed can attempt a new save to end the paralysis at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.
_desc_ko: 당신의 효소는 상대의 상처 치유를 어렵게 할 뿐만 아니라 마비시킬 수도 있습니다. 발톱이나 이빨로 공격하십시오. 살아있는 비엘프 생물을 명중시키면, 해당 생물은 당신의 직업 난이도(DC) 또는 주문 난이도(DC) 중 더 높은 쪽에 대한 인내 내성에 성공하지 못하면 @link[conditions.paralyzed] 상태가 됩니다. 내성 결과와 상관없이, 해당 생물은 24시간 동안 마비 베기에 대해 일시적으로 면역이 됩니다. 마비된 생물은 자신의 턴이 끝날 때마다 마비를 해제하기 위한 새로운 내성을 시도하다, 이러한 내성마다 DC가 누적적으로 1씩 감소한다.

name: Prototype Companion

description.value: You have created a construct companion, and while it might not be an innovation, it serves as a trustworthy minion. You gain a prototype construct companion.

_desc_en: You have created a construct companion, and while it might not be an innovation, it serves as a trustworthy minion. You gain a prototype construct companion.
_desc_ko: 당신은 구조체 동반자를 창조했습니다. 혁신적인 발명품은 아니지만, 믿음직한 하수인 역할을 합니다. 당신은 프로토타입 구조체 동반자를 얻습니다.

name: Avenger of Greed

description.value: You've become a champion of the runelords of greed. Their whispers encourage you to prepare for disasters that might never come to pass. The first time each day you touch an object worth at least 2,000 gp that you've never touched before, you gain 1 Mythic Point. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.6uHxON55vtaperC2]{Convocation of Greed} activity.

_desc_en: You've become a champion of the runelords of greed. Their whispers encourage you to prepare for disasters that might never come to pass. The first time each day you touch an object worth at least 2,000 gp that you've never touched before, you gain 1 Mythic Point. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.6uHxON55vtaperC2]{Convocation of Greed} activity.
_desc_ko: 당신은 탐욕의 룬로드들의 대변자가 되었습니다. 그들의 속삭임은 결코 오지 않을지도 모르는 재앙에 대비하라고 당신을 부추깁니다. 매일 처음으로 한 번도 만진 적 없는, 최소 2,000gp 가치의 물건을 만질 때, 당신은 미시적 점수 1점을 얻습니다. 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.6uHxON55vtaperC2]{탐욕의 소집} 활동을 얻습니다.

name: Wing Step

description.value: With a sharp flap of your wings, you stay light on your feet as you move. You Step 5 feet twice.

_desc_en: With a sharp flap of your wings, you stay light on your feet as you move. You Step 5 feet twice.
_desc_ko: 날개를 날카롭게 퍼덕이며 발걸음을 가볍게 유지하며 이동합니다. 5피트를 두 번 {신중한 발걸음}합니다.

name: Terra Dragonblood

description.value: Each step upon the earth makes your blood resonate. You gain tremorsense as an imprecise sense to a range of 30 feet; if you already have tremorsense, increase its range by 5 feet. If you choose a draconic exemplar, you must choose a dragon with a burrow Speed.

_desc_en: Each step upon the earth makes your blood resonate. You gain tremorsense as an imprecise sense to a range of 30 feet; if you already have tremorsense, increase its range by 5 feet. If you choose a draconic exemplar, you must choose a dragon with a burrow Speed.
_desc_ko: 땅을 밟는 걸음마다 당신의 피가 공명합니다. 당신은 30피트 사거리의 비정밀 감각으로 진동 감지를 얻습니다. 이미 진동 감지가 있다면, 그 사거리를 5피트 증가시킵니다. 용족 귀감을 선택한다면, 굴착 이동력을 가진 용을 선택해야 합니다.

name: Killing Stone

description.value: Your star orb hides a deadly miasma. You can cast 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MlpbeZ61Euhl0d60]{Toxic Cloud} as a divine innate spell once per day. The spell's normal components are replaced with a focus component (your star orb) and a somatic component to aim the orb towards the location for the spell.

_desc_en: Your star orb hides a deadly miasma. You can cast 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MlpbeZ61Euhl0d60]{Toxic Cloud} as a divine innate spell once per day. The spell's normal components are replaced with a focus component (your star orb) and a somatic component to aim the orb towards the location for the spell.
_desc_ko: 당신의 별 구슬에는 치명적인 독기가 숨겨져 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, (5th)랭크 @link[spells.toxic-cloud]을 신성 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 주문의 일반 구성 요소는 포커스 구성 요소(당신의 별구슬)와 주문을 발동할 위치를 겨냥하는 신체적 구성 요소로 대체됩니다.

name: Grit and Tenacity

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You fail a Fortitude or Will save.

You call upon deep reserves of toughness and mental fortitude to power through an otherwise debilitating effect. Reroll the triggering save with a +2 circumstance bonus; you must use the second result.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You fail a Fortitude or Will save.

You call upon deep reserves of toughness and mental fortitude to power through an otherwise debilitating effect. Reroll the triggering save with a +2 circumstance bonus; you must use the second result.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

발동 조건 인내 내성 또는 의지 내성에 실패할 때.

당신은 깊은 내구성과 정신을 발휘하여 치명적인 효과를 극복합니다. 유발된 저항 검사를 +2 상황 보너스와 함께 재굴림하며, 두 번째 결과를 반드시 사용해야 합니다.

name: Sublime Mobility

description.value: Your heritage has granted you either impressive athletic skill or a physical feature that aids in traversal. You gain either a climb Speed or a swim Speed of 10 feet.

_desc_en: Your heritage has granted you either impressive athletic skill or a physical feature that aids in traversal. You gain either a climb Speed or a swim Speed of 10 feet.
_desc_ko: 당신의 혈통은 뛰어난 운동 능력이나 이동에 도움이 되는 신체적 특징을 부여했습니다. 등반 속도 또는 수영 속도 10피트를 얻습니다.

name: Reassuring Presence

description.value:
Trigger An ally within 30 feet gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition.

You serve as an anchor to your close companions, calming them in times of stress. Decrease the value of the triggering ally's frightened condition by 1. The ally is then temporarily immune to your Reassuring Presence for 1 hour.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en:
Trigger An ally within 30 feet gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition.

You serve as an anchor to your close companions, calming them in times of stress. Decrease the value of the triggering ally's frightened condition by 1. The ally is then temporarily immune to your Reassuring Presence for 1 hour.
_desc_ko:
발동 30피트 내 아군이 @link[conditions.frightened] 상태를 얻습니다.

당신은 가까운 동료들에게 버팀목이 되어 스트레스 상황에서 그들을 진정시킵니다. 발동된 아군의 공포 상태 수치를 1 감소시킵니다. 해당 아군은 이후 1시간 동안 당신의 '안심시키는 존재감'에 일시적으로 면역됩니다.

name: Scarred Hide

description.value: Your hide is an impenetrable mass of scars, accrued over countless bloody conflicts. When in your hybrid or animal shape, you gain resistance to non-silver slashing damage equal to half your level.

_desc_en: Your hide is an impenetrable mass of scars, accrued over countless bloody conflicts. When in your hybrid or animal shape, you gain resistance to non-silver slashing damage equal to half your level.
_desc_ko: 당신의 피부는 무수한 피비린내 나는 전투를 통해 쌓인 뚫을 수 없는 상처의 덩어리입니다. 혼혈 형태나 동물 형태일 때, 은이 아닌 절단 피해에 대해 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 저항력을 얻습니다.

name: Death from Above (Eternal Legend)

description.value:
Requirements You are adjacent to a climbable surface at least 10 feet tall.

Seemingly to defy gravity, you use a nearby vertical surface to propel yourself upward and then strike downward like the driving rain. Stride up to half your Speed upward on the required surface; if you have a climb Speed, you may use your full climb Speed instead. The surface does not need to span the full height of your Stride. You can then either make a ranged Strike at a target within your weapon's first range increment and land in the space you began (or an adjacent space) without taking falling damage, or you can land in a space adjacent to a creature within 10 feet of the required surface without taking falling damage and make a melee Strike against that creature. Either Strike deals an extra two dice of weapon damage. In addition, the target dealt damage by your Strike must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:class] saving throw against your class DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are adjacent to a climbable surface at least 10 feet tall.

Seemingly to defy gravity, you use a nearby vertical surface to propel yourself upward and then strike downward like the driving rain. Stride up to half your Speed upward on the required surface; if you have a climb Speed, you may use your full climb Speed instead. The surface does not need to span the full height of your Stride. You can then either make a ranged Strike at a target within your weapon's first range increment and land in the space you began (or an adjacent space) without taking falling damage, or you can land in a space adjacent to a creature within 10 feet of the required surface without taking falling damage and make a melee Strike against that creature. Either Strike deals an extra two dice of weapon damage. In addition, the target dealt damage by your Strike must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:class] saving throw against your class DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 최소 10피트 높이의 등반 가능한 표면에 인접해 있어야 합니다.

중력을 거스르는 듯, 근처 수직 표면을 발판 삼아 위로 치솟은 뒤 쏟아지는 빗줄기처럼 아래로 내리꽂습니다. 필요한 표면 위에서 이동 속도의 절반까지 위로 이동합니다. 등반 속도가 있다면 전체 등반 속도를 사용할 수 있습니다. 표면이 이동 거리 전체 높이를 차지할 필요는 없습니다. 이후 다음 중 하나를 선택할 수 있다: 무기의 첫 사거리 범위 내 목표를 원거리 공격하거나, 시작 위치(또는 인접 공간)에 낙하 피해 없이 착지하거나, 필요한 표면으로부터 10피트 이내에 있는 생물과 인접한 공간에 낙하 피해 없이 착지한 후 해당 생물을 근접 공격한다. 두 공격 모두 무기 피해에 추가로 주사위 2개를 더합니다. 또한, 공격으로 피해를 입은 대상은 당신의 직업 난이도(DC)에 대한 인내 내성 굴림에 성공하지 못하면 @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Ratfolk Roll

description.value: You roll up into a ball and move up to four times your Speed in a straight line down an incline. If you reach the bottom of the incline or hit an obstacle during this first turn of movement, you stop rolling safely. Otherwise, you automatically keep rolling at this Speed during subsequent turns until you hit the bottom of the incline or an obstacle ends this movement (which can happen in the middle of your turn). You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} each turn after the first that you keep rolling, and if you hit an obstacle on a turn after the first, you and the obstacle both take @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]] damage and you stop rolling.

_desc_en: You roll up into a ball and move up to four times your Speed in a straight line down an incline. If you reach the bottom of the incline or hit an obstacle during this first turn of movement, you stop rolling safely. Otherwise, you automatically keep rolling at this Speed during subsequent turns until you hit the bottom of the incline or an obstacle ends this movement (which can happen in the middle of your turn). You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} each turn after the first that you keep rolling, and if you hit an obstacle on a turn after the first, you and the obstacle both take @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]] damage and you stop rolling.
_desc_ko: 공처럼 몸을 둥글게 말아 경사면을 따라 직선으로 굴리며, 굴림 속도의 최대 4배까지 이동할 수 있습니다. 첫 번째 이동 턴에 경사면 바닥에 도달하거나 장애물에 부딪히면 안전하게 멈춥니다. 그렇지 않으면, 이후 턴 동안 경사면 바닥에 도달하거나 장애물에 부딪혀 이동이 종료될 때까지(턴 중간에 발생할 수 있음) 자동으로 이 속도로 계속 굴림합니다. 첫 번째 턴 이후 계속 굴리는 각 턴마다 @link[conditions.slowed]{2} 상태가 되며, 첫 번째 턴 이후 턴에 장애물에 부딪히면 너와 장애물 모두 4d6 타격 피해를 입으며 굴림을 멈춘다.

name: Commitment to Liberty

description.value:
Requirements A creature has an ally @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

You can't abide when a foe has one of your allies in its grip. Make a Strike against the required creature. If this Strike hits, the grabbed or restrained ally can immediately attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} as a free action. If the Strike was a critical hit, that ally gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their Escape attempt.

_desc_en:
Requirements A creature has an ally @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

You can't abide when a foe has one of your allies in its grip. Make a Strike against the required creature. If this Strike hits, the grabbed or restrained ally can immediately attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} as a free action. If the Strike was a critical hit, that ally gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their Escape attempt.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 생물이 동료를 @link[conditions.grabbed] 또는 @link[conditions.restrained] 상태로 만든다.

적에게 아군이 붙잡힘 상태를 참을 수 없다. 해당 생물에게 공격을 시도한다. 공격이 적중하면 붙잡기거나 제압당한 아군은 즉시 무료 행동으로 @link[actions.escape]을 시도할 수 있다. 공격이 치명타일 경우 해당 아군은 탈출 시도 시 +2 상황 보너스를 얻는다.

name: Battle Scars

description.value: You've faced enough opponents that your experience is written across your skin, toughening you against your fiendish foes. You gain resistance to bludgeoning and slashing damage from devils and creatures allied with the Chelaxian government (as determined by the GM) equal to half your level.

_desc_en: You've faced enough opponents that your experience is written across your skin, toughening you against your fiendish foes. You gain resistance to bludgeoning and slashing damage from devils and creatures allied with the Chelaxian government (as determined by the GM) equal to half your level.
_desc_ko: 당신은 충분히 많은 적을 상대해 왔기에 그 경험이 피부에 새겨져, 악마 같은 적들에 맞서 당신을 단단하게 만들었습니다. 당신은 데빌과 첼리액스 정부에 속한 생물(GM이 판단)로부터의 타격 및 참격 피해에 대해 당신 레벨의 절반과 같은 저항을 얻습니다.

name: Unbreakable-er Goblin

description.value: As hard as most unbreakable goblins are to break, you are that much harder to break. You gain 20 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 10. When you fall, you take no falling damage. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.AlhyF8LCW011w9kq]{Bouncy Goblin} feat, after falling or jumping from a height of at least 20 feet, you can bounce back into the air, up to half the distance you fell (and half as far forward if you jumped). These bounces continue until you bounce less than 20 feet.

_desc_en: As hard as most unbreakable goblins are to break, you are that much harder to break. You gain 20 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 10. When you fall, you take no falling damage. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.AlhyF8LCW011w9kq]{Bouncy Goblin} feat, after falling or jumping from a height of at least 20 feet, you can bounce back into the air, up to half the distance you fell (and half as far forward if you jumped). These bounces continue until you bounce less than 20 feet.
_desc_ko: 대부분의 불굴의 고블린도 깨기 어렵지만, 당신은 그보다 훨씬 더 강인합니다. 혈통으로 얻는 HP가 10이 아닌 20입니다. 추락 시 낙하 피해를 받지 않습니다. @link[feats.bouncy-goblin] 재주를 보유한 경우, 최소 20피트 높이에서 추락하거나 점프한 후, 추락한 거리 절반(점프 시 전진한 거리 절반)까지 공중으로 다시 튀어 오를 수 있다. 이 반동은 20피트 미만으로 튀어 오를 때까지 계속된다.

name: Emergency Medical Assistance

description.value:
Requirements An adjacent ally is suffering persistent damage.

You've learned a variety of methods for helping allies who are bleeding, burning, or otherwise suffering persistent damage, from brushing off acid to patting down fires. Your ally immediately attempts a flat check to remove all types of persistent damage, and your use of this feat automatically counts as especially effective aid, reducing the DC from 15 to 10 for all future flat checks to remove the persistent damage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.bxXZYHCp6ftPSMCC]{Effect: Emergency Medical Assistance}

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en:
Requirements An adjacent ally is suffering persistent damage.

You've learned a variety of methods for helping allies who are bleeding, burning, or otherwise suffering persistent damage, from brushing off acid to patting down fires. Your ally immediately attempts a flat check to remove all types of persistent damage, and your use of this feat automatically counts as especially effective aid, reducing the DC from 15 to 10 for all future flat checks to remove the persistent damage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.bxXZYHCp6ftPSMCC]{Effect: Emergency Medical Assistance}
_desc_ko:
요건 인접한 아군이 지속 피해를 받고 있을 것.

출혈, 화상 또는 기타 지속적 피해를 입은 아군을 돕는 다양한 방법을 익혔습니다. 산을 털어내거나 불을 끄는 등 말이죠. 아군은 즉시 모든 유형의 지속적 피해를 제거하기 위한 단순 판정을 시도하며, 이 재주 사용은 자동으로 특히 효과적인 도움으로 간주되어 향후 지속적 피해 제거를 위한 모든 단순 판정의 난이도(DC)를 15에서 10으로 낮춥니다.

name: Improved Familiar (Familiar Master)

description.value: You find it easy to attract a powerful and unusual familiar to your side. The number of abilities required to make your familiar a specific familiar is two lower than normal.

_desc_en: You find it easy to attract a powerful and unusual familiar to your side. The number of abilities required to make your familiar a specific familiar is two lower than normal.
_desc_ko: 당신은 강력하고 특이한 패밀리어를 자신의 편으로 끌어들이는 것이 쉽습니다. 특정 패밀리어를 만들기 위해 필요한 능력의 수가 평소보다 두 개 적습니다.

name: Tough Tumbler

description.value: You've taken your share of licks while scurrying around the battlefield and know how to defend yourself against opportunistic attackers. Your movement ends only when you critically fail an Acrobatics check to Tumble Through an enemy's space (or when you don't have enough Speed to move all the way through its space). You still trigger reactions on a failure to Tumble Through, but you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against attacks that you trigger in this way.

_desc_en: You've taken your share of licks while scurrying around the battlefield and know how to defend yourself against opportunistic attackers. Your movement ends only when you critically fail an Acrobatics check to Tumble Through an enemy's space (or when you don't have enough Speed to move all the way through its space). You still trigger reactions on a failure to Tumble Through, but you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against attacks that you trigger in this way.
_desc_ko: 전장을 누비며 수많은 타격을 견뎌온 당신은 기회주의적 공격자들로부터 자신을 방어하는 법을 알고 있습니다. 적의 공간을 회피 돌파하기 위한 곡예 판정에 대실패를 하거나(또는 그 공간을 완전히 통과할 만큼의 속도가 부족할 때)만 당신의 이동이 종료됩니다. 회피 돌파를 실패해도 여전히 반응을 유발하지만, 이 방식으로 유발한 공격에 대해 AC에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Vexing Tumble

description.value:
You tumble around your foes, expertly avoiding their reactions. Stride up to half your Speed and roll an @Check[acrobatics] check. Compare the result to the Reflex DC of each enemy whose reach you began in or enter during the movement, in sequence.

Critical Success This movement doesn't trigger reactions from the enemy, and the enemy is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you until the end of your turn

Success This movement doesn't trigger reactions from the enemy.

Critical Failure Your movement immediately stops when you enter the creature's reach; if you began in the creature's reach, you don't move.

_desc_en:
You tumble around your foes, expertly avoiding their reactions. Stride up to half your Speed and roll an @Check[acrobatics] check. Compare the result to the Reflex DC of each enemy whose reach you began in or enter during the movement, in sequence.

Critical Success This movement doesn't trigger reactions from the enemy, and the enemy is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you until the end of your turn

Success This movement doesn't trigger reactions from the enemy.

Critical Failure Your movement immediately stops when you enter the creature's reach; if you began in the creature's reach, you don't move.
_desc_ko:
당신은 적들 사이를 비틀거리며 그들의 반응을 능숙하게 피해 나간다. 이동 속도의 절반까지 전진하고 곡예 검사를 굴린다. 결과를 이동 시작 시 또는 이동 중 진입한 각 적의 리플렉스 DC와 순차적으로 비교한다.

대성공 이 이동은 적의 반응을 유발하지 않으며, 적들은 당신의 턴이 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다.

성공 이 이동은 적의 반응을 유발하지 않습니다.

대실패 생물의 도달 범위에 진입하는 즉시 이동이 중단됩니다. 생물의 도달 범위 내에서 시작했을 경우 이동하지 않습니다.

name: Overextending Feint

description.value:
You goad a foe into overextending. On a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint}, you can use the following success and critical success effects instead of any other effects that would occur when you Feint.

Critical Success The target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to all attack rolls against you before the end of its next turn.

Success The target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to its next attack roll against you before the end of its next turn.

_desc_en:
You goad a foe into overextending. On a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint}, you can use the following success and critical success effects instead of any other effects that would occur when you Feint.

Critical Success The target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to all attack rolls against you before the end of its next turn.

Success The target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to its next attack roll against you before the end of its next turn.
_desc_ko:
당신은 적을 과도하게 노출되도록 유도합니다. @link[actions.feint]에 성공하면, 페인트 시 발생하는 다른 효과 대신 다음 성공 및 대성공 효과를 사용할 수 있습니다.

대성공 대상은 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 당신을 상대로 하는 모든 명중 굴림에 -2 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

성공 대상은 다음 턴이 끝나기 전까지 당신을 상대로 하는 다음 명중 굴림에 -2 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Specialized Megafauna Companion

description.value:
You've trained your mammoth or other megafauna companion to perform in unusual or extreme situations, granting it abilities far beyond others of its kind. Your megafauna gains your choice of the bully, racer, tracker, or wrecker specialization.

Special You can select this feat up to three times. Each time, add a different specialization of the ones listed above to your megafauna companion. Your megafauna can't have more than three specializations.

_desc_en:
You've trained your mammoth or other megafauna companion to perform in unusual or extreme situations, granting it abilities far beyond others of its kind. Your megafauna gains your choice of the bully, racer, tracker, or wrecker specialization.

Special You can select this feat up to three times. Each time, add a different specialization of the ones listed above to your megafauna companion. Your megafauna can't have more than three specializations.
_desc_ko:
당신은 매머드나 다른 거대동물 동반자를 비정상적이거나 극한 상황에서 수행하도록 훈련시켜, 그 종의 다른 개체들보다 훨씬 뛰어난 능력을 부여했습니다. 당신의 거대동물은 당신이 선택한 불리, 레이서, 트래커, 또는 레커 특화 능력을 얻습니다.

특수 이 피트를 최대 세 번까지 선택할 수 있습니다. 매번 위에서 열거된 전문 분야 중 다른 하나를 당신의 거대동물 동반자에게 추가합니다. 당신의 거대동물은 세 가지 이상의 전문 분야를 가질 수 없습니다.

name: Spiritual Strike

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a weapon with at least one fundamental rune and your familiar is adjacent to you or in your space.

Your spirit guide enhances your attacks with occult power. Make a Strike with a weapon that has at least one fundamental rune. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. The Strike has the effects of the ghost touch property rune and deals an additional 2d6 force damage. If your weapon has a major striking rune, this Strike instead deals 3d6 force damage.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a weapon with at least one fundamental rune and your familiar is adjacent to you or in your space.

Your spirit guide enhances your attacks with occult power. Make a Strike with a weapon that has at least one fundamental rune. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. The Strike has the effects of the ghost touch property rune and deals an additional 2d6 force damage. If your weapon has a major striking rune, this Strike instead deals 3d6 force damage.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 기본 룬이 하나 이상 새겨진 무기를 휘두르고 있으며, 당신의 패밀리어가 당신과 인접하거나 당신의 공간 내에 위치해야 합니다.

당신의 영혼 안내자가 오컬트 힘으로 공격을 강화합니다. 기본 룬 하나 이상이 새겨진 무기로 공격을 하십시오. 이 공격은 다중 공격 페널티 계산 시 두 번의 공격으로 간주됩니다. 이 공격은 고스트 터치 속성 룬의 효과를 가지며 추가로 2d6 역장 피해를 입힙니다. 무기에 강타 (상급) 룬이 새겨져 있다면, 이 공격은 대신 3d6 역장 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Relentless Disarm

description.value:
When you succeed, but don't critically succeed, at a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} a creature, your circumstance bonus to further checks to Disarm that creature is +4 instead of +2. Other creatures gain only the normal bonus.

When you critically succeed at a Disarm check, you can immediately @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} your target as a reaction.

_desc_en:
When you succeed, but don't critically succeed, at a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} a creature, your circumstance bonus to further checks to Disarm that creature is +4 instead of +2. Other creatures gain only the normal bonus.

When you critically succeed at a Disarm check, you can immediately @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} your target as a reaction.
_desc_ko:
생물의 무기를 해제하는 @link[actions.disarm] 판정에서 성공했지만 대성공은 아니었을 경우, 해당 생물에 대한 추가 무장 해제 판정 시 상황 보너스가 +2가 아닌 +4가 됩니다. 다른 생물들은 일반 보너스만 받습니다.

무장 해제 판정에서 대성공을 거둘 경우, 즉시 반응으로 대상에게 @link[actions.demoralize]를 적용할 수 있습니다.

name: Greenwatch Veteran

description.value:
Trigger Your turn starts, and you're in combat against a creature you spent at least 10 minutes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Tracking}.

Your time spent tracking your target allows you to quickly identify its weaknesses and relay them to your allies. Attempt a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} check against the creature you were Tracking. On a success, you always know the creature's greatest weakness and highest resistance or immunity, in addition to any other information the check would typically provide. You immediately use a quick series of hand gestures to signal this information to any allies who can see you.

_desc_en:
Trigger Your turn starts, and you're in combat against a creature you spent at least 10 minutes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Tracking}.

Your time spent tracking your target allows you to quickly identify its weaknesses and relay them to your allies. Attempt a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} check against the creature you were Tracking. On a success, you always know the creature's greatest weakness and highest resistance or immunity, in addition to any other information the check would typically provide. You immediately use a quick series of hand gestures to signal this information to any allies who can see you.
_desc_ko:
Trigger 당신의 턴이 시작되며, 최소 10분 동안 @link[actions.track]한 생물과 교전 중입니다.

추적에 소요된 시간 덕분에 당신은 그 생물의 약점을 신속히 파악하고 동료들에게 전달할 수 있습니다. 추적하던 생물을 대상으로 @link[actions.recall-knowledge] 판정을 시도하십시오. 성공 시, 해당 생물의 가장 큰 약점과 가장 높은 저항력 또는 면역력을 항상 알게 되며, 판정이 일반적으로 제공하는 기타 정보도 함께 파악합니다. 즉시 손동작으로 이 정보를 볼 수 있는 모든 아군에게 신속하게 전달합니다.

name: Dualistic Synergy

description.value: If your next action is to Cast a Spell from your spell slots, you gain a benefit. If the spell is arcane, you can attempt a skill check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} with a +1 status bonus to the check after casting the spell, or a +2 status bonus if the spell is 7th rank or higher. If the spell is primal, you gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to the spell's rank for 1 round. If the spell is a halcyon spell, you gain both benefits.

_desc_en: If your next action is to Cast a Spell from your spell slots, you gain a benefit. If the spell is arcane, you can attempt a skill check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} with a +1 status bonus to the check after casting the spell, or a +2 status bonus if the spell is 7th rank or higher. If the spell is primal, you gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to the spell's rank for 1 round. If the spell is a halcyon spell, you gain both benefits.
_desc_ko: 다음 행동이 자신의 주문 슬롯에서 주문을 시전하는 것이라면, 이점을 얻습니다. 해당 주문이 아케인인 경우, 주문 시전 후 @link[actions.recall-knowledge] 기술 판정을 시도할 수 있으며, 검사 시 +1 상태 보너스를 받습니다. 주문이 (7th)랭크 이상인 경우 +2 상태 보너스를 받습니다. 주술이 프라이멀한 경우, 1라운드 동안 주술의 랭크과 동일한 수의 임시 HP를 얻습니다. 주술이 평온 주술인 경우, 두 가지 이점을 모두 얻습니다.

name: Improved Poison Weapon

description.value: You deliver poisons in ways that maximize their harmful effects. When you apply a simple poison with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ALbosSUygdq4T1Yk]{Poison Weapon}, the poison deals @Damage[2d4[poison]] damage instead of 1d4 poison damage. You don't waste a poison you apply with Poison Weapon on a critically failed attack roll.

_desc_en: You deliver poisons in ways that maximize their harmful effects. When you apply a simple poison with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ALbosSUygdq4T1Yk]{Poison Weapon}, the poison deals @Damage[2d4[poison]] damage instead of 1d4 poison damage. You don't waste a poison you apply with Poison Weapon on a critically failed attack roll.
_desc_ko: 독의 유해 효과를 극대화하는 방식으로 독을 투여합니다. @link[feats.poison-weapon]로 단순 독을 적용할 때, 독은 1d4 독 피해 대신 2d4 독 피해를 입힙니다. 독 무기로 적용한 독은 대실패한 명중 굴림에도 낭비되지 않는다.

name: Many Faces

description.value:
Frequency three times per day

Putting on a new face offers a great way to get a fresh perspective on life. When you Change Shape into your everyday form, you gain the effects of a 3rd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise} for 1 hour or until you shift back, whichever comes first, except it's a polymorph effect rather than an illusion. However, your transformations can be broken with a good shock; if you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} condition while transformed, your transformation ends, returning you to your tanuki form, and your confidence is so shaken you can't attempt to resume that specific disguise again until your next daily preparations.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Frequency three times per day

Putting on a new face offers a great way to get a fresh perspective on life. When you Change Shape into your everyday form, you gain the effects of a 3rd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise} for 1 hour or until you shift back, whichever comes first, except it's a polymorph effect rather than an illusion. However, your transformations can be broken with a good shock; if you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} condition while transformed, your transformation ends, returning you to your tanuki form, and your confidence is so shaken you can't attempt to resume that specific disguise again until your next daily preparations.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루 세 번

새로운 얼굴을 쓰면 삶에 대한 신선한 시각을 얻을 수 있는 좋은 방법이 됩니다. 일상적인 형태로 형태 변신하면 1시간 동안 또는 원래 형태로 돌아갈 때까지(둘 중 먼저 도래하는 시점까지) 3등급 @link[spells.illusory-disguise] 효과를 얻습니다. 단, 이는 환상이 아닌 변형 효과입니다. 그러나 강한 충격으로 변신이 깨질 수 있습니다. 변신 상태에서 @link[conditions.frightened] 또는 @link[conditions.stunned] 상태를 얻으면 변신이 끝나고 타누키 형태로 돌아갑니다. 또한 자신감이 크게 흔들려 다음 일일 준비 시간까지 해당 변장을 다시 시도하다 할 수 없습니다.

name: I Will Return

description.value: Your special connection to death and rebirth allows you to sense when it's your time to enter the Great Beyond, and now isn't the time. You gain +2 status bonus to saving throws against death effects. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.I0BhPWqYf1bbzEYg]{Diehard} feat. The first time each day that you lose the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition, you do not increase your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your special connection to death and rebirth allows you to sense when it's your time to enter the Great Beyond, and now isn't the time. You gain +2 status bonus to saving throws against death effects. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.I0BhPWqYf1bbzEYg]{Diehard} feat. The first time each day that you lose the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition, you do not increase your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition.
_desc_ko: 죽음과 재생에 대한 특별한 연결로 인해, 당신이 대천국으로 들어갈 때가 왔음을 감지할 수 있으며, 지금은 그 때가 아닙니다. 사망 효과에 대한 내성에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. @link[feats.diehard] 피트를 얻습니다. 매일 처음으로 @link[conditions.dying] 상태를 벗어날 때, @link[conditions.wounded] 상태가 증가하지 않습니다.

name: Uncanny Bombs

description.value: You lob bombs unerringly, despite obstructions or distance. When you throw an alchemical item with the bomb trait, its range increment increases to 60 feet, you reduce any circumstance bonus to the target's AC from cover by 1, and you automatically succeed at the flat check when targeting a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} creature.

_desc_en: You lob bombs unerringly, despite obstructions or distance. When you throw an alchemical item with the bomb trait, its range increment increases to 60 feet, you reduce any circumstance bonus to the target's AC from cover by 1, and you automatically succeed at the flat check when targeting a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} creature.
_desc_ko: 장애물이나 거리를 막론하고 폭탄을 정확히 투척합니다. 폭탄 특성을 가진 연금술 아이템을 투척할 때, 사거리 증가량이 60피트로 증가하며, 은폐로 인한 대상의 AC 상황 보너스를 1 감소시키고, @link[conditions.concealed] 상태의 생물을 표적으로 삼을 때 단순 판정에서 자동으로 성공한다.

name: Consume Energy

description.value:
Trigger An enemy within 60 feet uses an ability that has the trait corresponding to your deviation damage type.

Your connection to energy is so much stronger than the offending display in front of you, allowing you to claim it for yourself. Attempt a @Check[deviant]{counteract check} against the triggering effect as you draw it into your body. If you successfully counteract the ability, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to double the counteract rank of the ability, which last for 1 minute.

Awakening The energy you consume helps empower your abilities. The next ability from the dragon classification that you use increases its range by 30 feet if it has a range, or increases its area by 10 feet if it's a cone or line. If you don't use this benefit within 1 minute, it fades.

@Template[cone|distance:40]

@Template[line|distance:70]

Awakening You channel some of the seized energy into your next attack. Choose one of your weapons or unarmed attacks. Until the end of your next turn, Strikes with the chosen weapon or unarmed attack deal an additional 1d6 damage of a type matching the energy you consumed.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.eMsI1lR0SuJBCYjn]{Effect: Consume Energy (Augment Strike)}

_desc_en:
Trigger An enemy within 60 feet uses an ability that has the trait corresponding to your deviation damage type.

Your connection to energy is so much stronger than the offending display in front of you, allowing you to claim it for yourself. Attempt a @Check[deviant]{counteract check} against the triggering effect as you draw it into your body. If you successfully counteract the ability, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to double the counteract rank of the ability, which last for 1 minute.

Awakening The energy you consume helps empower your abilities. The next ability from the dragon classification that you use increases its range by 30 feet if it has a range, or increases its area by 10 feet if it's a cone or line. If you don't use this benefit within 1 minute, it fades.

@Template[cone|distance:40]

@Template[line|distance:70]

Awakening You channel some of the seized energy into your next attack. Choose one of your weapons or unarmed attacks. Until the end of your next turn, Strikes with the chosen weapon or unarmed attack deal an additional 1d6 damage of a type matching the energy you consumed.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.eMsI1lR0SuJBCYjn]{Effect: Consume Energy (Augment Strike)}
_desc_ko:
발동 60피트 이내의 적이 당신의 편차 피해 유형에 해당하는 특성을 가진 능력을 사용한다.

당신의 에너지 연결은 눈앞의 위협보다 훨씬 강력하여 이를 자신에게 흡수할 수 있습니다. 능력을 몸속으로 끌어들이며 반격 판정을 시도합니다. 능력을 성공적으로 반격하면, 반격 능력의 반격 등급의 두 배에 해당하는 임시 HP를 얻으며, 이는 1분 동안 지속됩니다.

각성 당신이 소비하는 에너지는 당신의 능력을 강화하는 데 도움이 됩니다. 다음에 사용하는 용 계통 능력의 사거리가 있다면 30피트 증가하며, 원뿔형이나 선형 범위라면 그 범위가 10피트 확대됩니다. 이 혜택을 1분 이내에 사용하지 않으면 사라집니다.

70피트

각성 당신은 흡수한 에너지 일부를 다음 공격에 집중합니다. 당신의 무기나 비무장 공격 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지, 선택한 무기나 비무장 공격으로 가하는 공격은 당신이 소모한 에너지의 유형과 일치하는 추가 1d6 피해를 입힙니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.eMsI1lR0SuJBCYjn]{효과: 에너지 소모 (타격 강화)}

name: Hurling Charge

description.value:
You make a ranged Strike with a thrown weapon you already have in your hand, Stride, and then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} to draw another weapon.

Special If you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Ah5g9pDwWF9b9VW9]{Raging}, and end the Stride adjacent to an enemy, that enemy is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the next Strike you make against it with the weapon you drew before the end of your next turn.

_desc_en:
You make a ranged Strike with a thrown weapon you already have in your hand, Stride, and then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} to draw another weapon.

Special If you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Ah5g9pDwWF9b9VW9]{Raging}, and end the Stride adjacent to an enemy, that enemy is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the next Strike you make against it with the weapon you drew before the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
손에 쥔 투척 무기로 원거리 공격을 수행한 후, 이동하여 @link[actions.interact]으로 다른 무기를 뽑습니다.

특수 당신이 @link[actions.rage]이고, 이동을 적과 인접한 상태로 종료할 경우, 해당 적은 다음 턴 종료 전까지 당신이 뽑은 무기로 그 적에게 가하는 다음 공격에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 된다.

name: Banner Twirl

description.value: You spin your banner in an elaborate pattern that your enemies find inscrutable. You and any ally adjacent to you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealment} from ranged attacks until the start of your next turn.

_desc_en: You spin your banner in an elaborate pattern that your enemies find inscrutable. You and any ally adjacent to you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealment} from ranged attacks until the start of your next turn.
_desc_ko: 당신은 적들이 이해할 수 없는 정교한 패턴으로 깃발을 휘둘러 댑니다. 당신과 인접한 모든 아군은 다음 차례 시작까지 원거리 공격에 대해 은폐 상태를 유지합니다.

name: Jagged Berms

description.value:
You conjure up to six cube-shaped mounds of packed earth. Each appears in an unoccupied square within 120 feet, fills its square, and provides cover. A mound has AC 10, Hardness 10, and 20 HP, and is immune to critical hits and precision damage. If destroyed, a mound becomes difficult terrain. The mounds last for an unlimited duration, but if you use the impulse again, any previous one ends.

Sharpened wooden stakes protrude from each mound into adjacent squares. They can project from any of its sides; you choose which sides for each mound. For each square of wooden stakes a creature enters, that creature takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -6)/2)+2)d6[piercing]] damage. Destroying a mound also destroys its stakes.

Level (+2) The HP of each section of the wall increases by 10, and the piercing damage increases by 1d6.

_desc_en:
You conjure up to six cube-shaped mounds of packed earth. Each appears in an unoccupied square within 120 feet, fills its square, and provides cover. A mound has AC 10, Hardness 10, and 20 HP, and is immune to critical hits and precision damage. If destroyed, a mound becomes difficult terrain. The mounds last for an unlimited duration, but if you use the impulse again, any previous one ends.

Sharpened wooden stakes protrude from each mound into adjacent squares. They can project from any of its sides; you choose which sides for each mound. For each square of wooden stakes a creature enters, that creature takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -6)/2)+2)d6[piercing]] damage. Destroying a mound also destroys its stakes.

Level (+2) The HP of each section of the wall increases by 10, and the piercing damage increases by 1d6.
_desc_ko:
최대 6개의 꽉 다져진 흙으로 된 정육면체 모양의 언덕을 소환합니다. 각 언덕은 120피트 이내의 비어 있는 칸에 나타나 해당 칸을 채우며 엄폐를 제공합니다. 언덕은 AC 10, 경도 10, HP 20을 가지며 치명타와 정밀 피해에 면역이다. 파괴되면 언덕은 어려운 지형이 된다. 언덕은 지속 시간이 무제한이지만, 이 임펄스를 다시 사용하면 기존 언덕은 모두 사라진다.

날카롭게 깎인 나무 말뚝이 각 토루에서 인접한 칸으로 삐져나와 있다. 말뚝은 토루의 어느 쪽에서든 튀어나올 수 있으며, 각 토루마다 튀어나올 방향을 선택한다. 생물이 나무 말뚝이 있는 칸 하나마다 들어설 때마다, 해당 생물은 관통의 피해를 입는다. 토루를 파괴하면 그 말뚝들도 함께 파괴된다.

레벨 (+2) 벽의 각 구간별 HP가 10 증가하고 관통 피해가 1d6 증가합니다.

name: Pack Tactics

description.value: You have mastered how to hunt with your pack. If an enemy is within reach of you and at least two of your allies, that enemy is off-guard against you.

_desc_en: You have mastered how to hunt with your pack. If an enemy is within reach of you and at least two of your allies, that enemy is off-guard against you.
_desc_ko: 당신은 무리와 함께 사냥하는 법을 마스터했습니다. 적이 당신과 최소 두 명의 아군에게 닿을 수 있는 거리에 있을 경우, 그 적은 당신에게 무방비가 됩니다.

name: Exude Demonic Corruption

description.value:
Most of the changes from the demon within you have harmed you so far, but you've found a way to expel some of the corruption within you to poison others. Until the beginning of your next turn, you and your weapons are covered in toxic sludge or another similar manifestation of the demonic corruption; your melee Strikes deal an additional @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage, and each time a creature hits you with a melee unarmed attack or otherwise touches you, it takes @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage.

At 14th level, the poison damage increases to 2d6, and at 20th level, the poison damage increases to 3d6.

_desc_en:
Most of the changes from the demon within you have harmed you so far, but you've found a way to expel some of the corruption within you to poison others. Until the beginning of your next turn, you and your weapons are covered in toxic sludge or another similar manifestation of the demonic corruption; your melee Strikes deal an additional @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage, and each time a creature hits you with a melee unarmed attack or otherwise touches you, it takes @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage.

At 14th level, the poison damage increases to 2d6, and at 20th level, the poison damage increases to 3d6.
_desc_ko:
지금까지 당신 안의 데몬이 일으킨 변화는 대부분 당신을 해쳤지만, 당신은 그 부패의 일부를 밖으로 내뿜어 다른 이들을 중독시키는 법을 찾아냈습니다. 당신의 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지, 당신과 당신의 무기는 유독성 진창 또는 그와 유사한 악마적 부패의 발현물로 뒤덮입니다. 당신의 근접 타격은 추가로 @Damage[1d6[poison]] 피해를 입히며, 생물이 근접 비무장 공격으로 당신을 명중시키거나 그 밖의 방식으로 당신을 만질 때마다 그 생물은 @Damage[1d6[poison]] 피해를 받습니다.

14레벨에는 독 피해가 2d6으로, 20레벨에는 독 피해가 3d6으로 증가합니다.

name: Reversing Charge

description.value: You dive into the fray before rewinding yourself to safety. Stride up to your Speed. If you end your movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, you can make a melee Strike against that enemy. You then teleport back to the square from which you began your Reversing Charge. You can use Reversing Charge while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

_desc_en: You dive into the fray before rewinding yourself to safety. Stride up to your Speed. If you end your movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, you can make a melee Strike against that enemy. You then teleport back to the square from which you began your Reversing Charge. You can use Reversing Charge while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.
_desc_ko: 전투에 뛰어들었다가 자신을 안전지대로 되감습니다. 이동 속도만큼 전진합니다. 적어도 한 명의 적과 근접 공격 범위 내에서 이동을 종료하면 해당 적에게 근접 공격을 가할 수 있습니다. 그런 다음 스냅백 돌격을 시작한 칸으로 순간이동한다. 해당 이동 유형이 있다면, 돌진 대신 땅굴 파기, 등반, 비행, 수영 중 하나를 사용하며 역회전 돌격을 사용할 수 있다.

name: Kaiju Defense Oath

description.value:
You've sworn an oath to defend the helpless from dangerous titanic beasts, including kaiju that roam the surface of Golarion. Attacks made as part of your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.zUWj4zmBNWOTzeFJ]{Overwhelming Combination} ability gain a +4 circumstance bonus to damage against a creature at least 2 sizes larger than you, or +6 if you have master proficiency with the weapon you used. You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws and DCs against kaiju hazards. You gain the following edict.

Edict You must do everything within your power to protect others from massive creatures they can't defend themselves from; in the event the victims are evil or actively trying to harm you or other innocents, you don't have to save them.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws and DCs against kaiju hazards. You gain the following edict.
