The creature doesn't become stuck if it is incorporeal, is liquid (like a water elemental or some oozes), or could otherwise escape without effort.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신은 @link[actions.flurry-of-blows]를 사용하여 동일한 대상에게 두 번의 원거리 관통 무기 공격을 가한다.

관통형 투사체로 상대의 의복, 장비 또는 느슨한 살점을 노려 그들을 지면이나 근처 표면에 고정시킵니다.

두 공격이 모두 명중하면, 대상은 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 반사 내성에 성공하지 못하면 @link[conditions.immobilized] 상태가 된다. 대상이나 인접한 생물이 DC 10 운동 판정에 성공해 고정용 투사체를 제거할 때까지 지속된다.

생물이 비물질체이거나 액체 상태(물 정령이나 일부 우즈 등)이거나, 별다른 노력 없이 탈출할 수 있는 경우 고정되지 않습니다.

name: Mauler Dedication

description.value:
You specialize in melee weapons that require two hands. You have familiarity with all melee weapons that require two hands to wield or have the two-hand trait. For the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

If you are at least an expert in such a weapon, you gain access to the critical specialization effect with that weapon.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.RoF5NOFBefXAPftS]{Mauler}

_desc_en:
You specialize in melee weapons that require two hands. You have familiarity with all melee weapons that require two hands to wield or have the two-hand trait. For the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

If you are at least an expert in such a weapon, you gain access to the critical specialization effect with that weapon.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.RoF5NOFBefXAPftS]{Mauler}
_desc_ko:
양손으로 사용하는 근접 무기에 특화됩니다. 양손으로 휘두르거나 양손 특성을 가진 모든 근접 무기에 숙련되어 있습니다. 숙련도 목적상, 이 중 무술 무기는 단순 무기로, 고급 무기는 무술 무기로 취급합니다.

해당 무기에서 적어도 전문가 등급 이상일 경우, 해당 무기로 치명타 특화 효과를 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Special Sentinel Technique

description.value:
You can channel the power of your constellation into a unique technique. You gain either the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1H3T9UwxW44Y0YaS]{Luminous Stardust Healing} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yuhhRjqBzFgkKYrq]{Shining Starlight Attack} focus spell, which you can cast only in sentinel form. When you gain this feat, decide a name for your technique, which becomes the spell's incantation.

If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can Refocus by spending 10 minutes outside of your sentinel form to reflect on the values of your constellation. Starlit sentinel focus spells are arcane spells. You become trained in spell attack modifier and spell DC, and your spellcasting ability for these spells is Charisma.

Special You can take this feat a second time, gaining the focus spell that you didn't gain the first time.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You can channel the power of your constellation into a unique technique. You gain either the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1H3T9UwxW44Y0YaS]{Luminous Stardust Healing} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yuhhRjqBzFgkKYrq]{Shining Starlight Attack} focus spell, which you can cast only in sentinel form. When you gain this feat, decide a name for your technique, which becomes the spell's incantation.

If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can Refocus by spending 10 minutes outside of your sentinel form to reflect on the values of your constellation. Starlit sentinel focus spells are arcane spells. You become trained in spell attack modifier and spell DC, and your spellcasting ability for these spells is Charisma.

Special You can take this feat a second time, gaining the focus spell that you didn't gain the first time.
_desc_ko:
자신의 별자리 힘을 독특한 기술로 집중시킬 수 있습니다. @link[spells.luminous-stardust-healing] 또는 @link[spells.shining-starlight-attack] 포커스 주문을 획득하며, 이 주문은 센티넬 형태에서만 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 재주를 획득할 때 기술의 이름을 정하면, 그 이름이 주문의 주문문이 됩니다.

아직 보유하지 않았다면, 1 포커스 포인트의 포커스 풀을 얻습니다. 이 풀은 센티넬 형태를 벗어난 상태에서 10분간 자신의 별자리 가치를 성찰함으로써 재충전할 수 있습니다. 별빛 센티넬 포커스 주문은 아케인 주문입니다. 당신은 주문 공격 수정자와 주문 DC에 숙련되며, 이 주문들의 주문 시전 능력치는 매력입니다.

특수 이 피트를 두 번째로 선택할 수 있으며, 첫 번째 선택 시 얻지 못한 포커스 주문을 획득한다.

name: Intuitive Cooperation

description.value:
Access Jaric ethnicity

You are accustomed to working alongside others, relying on each other to get by. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid}, and your allies gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Aid you.

_desc_en:
Access Jaric ethnicity

You are accustomed to working alongside others, relying on each other to get by. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid}, and your allies gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Aid you.
_desc_ko:
접근 자릭 민족성

당신은 다른 이들과 함께 일하며 서로 의지해 살아가는 데 익숙합니다. @link[actions.aid] 판정 시 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 동맹들은 당신을 지원하는 판정 시 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Alloy Flesh and Steel

description.value:
Elemental energy replaces every cell of your body with raw metal. You gain the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.89Hj5QuqvcwVXcqj]{Ferrous Form} spell (except you can't cast needle darts) until the end of your next turn. You can Sustain the impulse up to 1 minute, and when you do, you can Raise a metal Shield if you're wielding one. Your metal Elemental Blasts deal an additional die of damage. If you suspend any conditions with Alloy Flesh and Steel, when it ends, you're temporarily immune to Alloy Flesh and Steel for 1 hour.

Level (16th) The resistance is 15.

_desc_en:
Elemental energy replaces every cell of your body with raw metal. You gain the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.89Hj5QuqvcwVXcqj]{Ferrous Form} spell (except you can't cast needle darts) until the end of your next turn. You can Sustain the impulse up to 1 minute, and when you do, you can Raise a metal Shield if you're wielding one. Your metal Elemental Blasts deal an additional die of damage. If you suspend any conditions with Alloy Flesh and Steel, when it ends, you're temporarily immune to Alloy Flesh and Steel for 1 hour.

Level (16th) The resistance is 15.
_desc_ko:
원소 에너지가 당신의 몸속 모든 세포를 원시 금속으로 대체합니다. 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[spells.ferrous-form] 주문 효과(바늘 다트 시전 불가)를 얻습니다. 이 충동을 최대 1분간 유지할 수 있으며, 유지할 경우 금속 방패를 들고 있다면 이를 들어 올릴 수 있다. 금속 원소 폭발은 추가로 주사위 하나만큼의 피해를 입힌다. 합금 육체와 강철로 어떤 상태를 일시 중지한 경우, 효과가 끝날 때 1시간 동안 합금 육체와 강철에 대한 일시적 면역을 얻는다.

레벨 (16급) 저항은 15입니다.

name: Cobra Stance

description.value:
You enter a tight stance, coiled up like a lashing cobra with your hands poised as venomous fangs.

While in this stance, the only Strikes you can make are cobra fang unarmed attacks. These deal 1d4 piercing damage; are in the brawling group; and have the agile, deadly d10, finesse, unarmed, and venomous traits.

While in Cobra Stance, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves and your Fortitude DC, and you gain poison resistance equal to half your level.

_desc_en:
You enter a tight stance, coiled up like a lashing cobra with your hands poised as venomous fangs.

While in this stance, the only Strikes you can make are cobra fang unarmed attacks. These deal 1d4 piercing damage; are in the brawling group; and have the agile, deadly d10, finesse, unarmed, and venomous traits.

While in Cobra Stance, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves and your Fortitude DC, and you gain poison resistance equal to half your level.
_desc_ko:
당신은 팽팽하게 긴장된 자세를 취하며, 휘감는 코브라처럼 몸을 웅크리고 양손을 맹독에 젖은 송곳니처럼 준비합니다.

이 자세를 취하고 있을 때, 수행할 수 있는 공격은 코브라 팡 비무장 공격뿐이다. 이 공격은 1d4 관통 피해를 입히며, 격투 그룹에 속하고, 기민한, 치명적 d10, 기교, 비무장, 독성 특성을 지닌다.

코브라 자세를 취하는 동안, 인내 내성에 +1 상황 보너스와 인내 내성 DC를 얻으며, 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 독 저항력을 얻습니다.

name: Bouncy Goblin

description.value: You have a particular elasticity that makes it easy for you to bounce and squish. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Acrobatics (or another skill of your choice, if you were already trained in Acrobatics). You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to Tumble Through a foe's space.

_desc_en: You have a particular elasticity that makes it easy for you to bounce and squish. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Acrobatics (or another skill of your choice, if you were already trained in Acrobatics). You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to Tumble Through a foe's space.
_desc_ko: 당신은 특별한 탄력성을 지녀 쉽게 튀어오르고 찌그러질 수 있습니다. 곡예에 숙련 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다(이미 곡예에 숙련된 경우, 선택한 다른 기술에 적용). 또한 적의 공간을 회피 돌파하는 곡예 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Tengu Weapon Familiarity

description.value:
You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the tengu trait plus the katana, khakkara, temple sword, and wakizashi. You have familiarity with these weapons—for the purpose of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

During your daily preparations, you can practice with a weapon from the sword group that's in your possession. You gain familiarity with that weapon as well. This lasts until you practice with a different sword in the same way.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.h8kgxDMclDHj6bIr]{Effect: Sword Practice}

_desc_en:
You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the tengu trait plus the katana, khakkara, temple sword, and wakizashi. You have familiarity with these weapons—for the purpose of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

During your daily preparations, you can practice with a weapon from the sword group that's in your possession. You gain familiarity with that weapon as well. This lasts until you practice with a different sword in the same way.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.h8kgxDMclDHj6bIr]{Effect: Sword Practice}
_desc_ko:
텐구 특성이 있는 모든 흔하지 않은 무기(katana, khakkara, temple sword, wakizashi 포함)를 사용할 수 있습니다. 숙련도 목적상 이 무기들에 대해 패밀리어를 가지며- , 이 중 무술 무기는 단순 무기로, 고급 무기는 무술 무기로 취급합니다.

일일 준비 시간 동안, 소지한 검 계열 무기 중 하나로 연습할 수 있습니다. 해당 무기에 대한 패밀리어 또한 획득합니다. 이 효과는 동일한 방식으로 다른 검으로 연습할 때까지 지속됩니다.

5레벨에 도달하면, 이 무기들로 치명타를 성공시킬 때마다 해당 무기의 치명타 특화 효과를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.h8kgxDMclDHj6bIr]{효과: 검술 연습}

name: Terraforming Trickery

description.value:
You know how to channel the transformative aspects of your blood magic to alter your surroundings. You know the following blood magic effect.

Blood Magic—Terraforming Trickery Either each space adjacent to you becomes difficult terrain, or each space adjacent to you is no longer difficult terrain. This doesn't have any effect on greater difficult terrain and doesn't remove the damaging effects of hazardous terrain.

_desc_en:
You know how to channel the transformative aspects of your blood magic to alter your surroundings. You know the following blood magic effect.

Blood Magic—Terraforming Trickery Either each space adjacent to you becomes difficult terrain, or each space adjacent to you is no longer difficult terrain. This doesn't have any effect on greater difficult terrain and doesn't remove the damaging effects of hazardous terrain.
_desc_ko:
당신은 혈통 마법의 변형적 측면을 활용해 주변 환경을 바꾸는 방법을 알고 있습니다. 다음 혈통 마법 효과를 숙지하고 있습니다.

혈통 마법-지형 변형 술법 당신과 인접한 모든 공간이 어려운 지형이 되거나, 당신과 인접한 모든 공간이 더 이상 어려운 지형이 아니게 됩니다. 이는 매우 어려운 지형에는 영향을 미치지 않으며, 위험 지형의 피해 효과도 제거하지 않습니다.

name: Toughness

description.value: Your body can withstand more punishment than most before succumbing. Increase your maximum Hit Points by your level. You reduce the DC of recovery checks by 1.

_desc_en: Your body can withstand more punishment than most before succumbing. Increase your maximum Hit Points by your level. You reduce the DC of recovery checks by 1.
_desc_ko: 당신의 몸은 대부분의 사람들보다 더 많은 고통을 견딜 수 있습니다. 최대 HP를 레벨만큼 증가시킵니다. 회복 판정의 DC를 1 감소시킵니다.

name: Redirect Elements

description.value:
Trigger The spell attack roll for a foe's spell with an elemental trait targeting you fails or critically fails, and the elemental trait is in your elemental philosophy.

You seize the elemental essence of an incoming spell and redirect the spell to a creature of your choice within the spell's area. The attacker rerolls the spell's attack roll against the new target.

_desc_en:
Trigger The spell attack roll for a foe's spell with an elemental trait targeting you fails or critically fails, and the elemental trait is in your elemental philosophy.

You seize the elemental essence of an incoming spell and redirect the spell to a creature of your choice within the spell's area. The attacker rerolls the spell's attack roll against the new target.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신을 표적으로 삼은 원소 특성을 지닌 적의 주문 명중 굴림이 실패하거나 대실패할 때, 해당 원소 특성이 당신의 원소 철학에 속할 경우.

당신은 날아오는 주문의 원소 정수를 붙잡아, 그 주문의 범위 내 원하는 생물로 주문을 재지향합니다. 공격자는 새로운 대상을 상대로 주문의 명중 굴림을 재굴립니다.

name: Bloodline Conduit

description.value:
Frequency once per minute

Your inborn magical nature lets you redirect ambient energies to fuel your spells. If your next action is to Cast a Spell of 5th rank or lower that has no duration, you don't expend the spell's slot when you cast it.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per minute

Your inborn magical nature lets you redirect ambient energies to fuel your spells. If your next action is to Cast a Spell of 5th rank or lower that has no duration, you don't expend the spell's slot when you cast it.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 분당 1회

선천적인 마법적 본성으로 주변 에너지를 재편성하여 주문의 원동력으로 삼을 수 있습니다. 지속 시간이 없는 5랭크 이하의 주문을 다음 행동으로 시전할 경우, 해당 주문 슬롯을 소모하지 않습니다.

name: Megafauna Veterinarian

description.value: By heeding the wise advice of elders in your following- and aided by your own experience-you've learned how to provide medical care to the megafauna of the Mammoth Lord followings. You can attempt a Nature check instead of a Medicine check for any of Medicine's trained and untrained uses, provided the subject of your medical care is a megafauna. If you're attempting an action that requires a particular proficiency rank in Medicine (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}), use your proficiency rank in Nature instead. If the subject of your care is your megafauna and you roll a success on your check, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: By heeding the wise advice of elders in your following- and aided by your own experience-you've learned how to provide medical care to the megafauna of the Mammoth Lord followings. You can attempt a Nature check instead of a Medicine check for any of Medicine's trained and untrained uses, provided the subject of your medical care is a megafauna. If you're attempting an action that requires a particular proficiency rank in Medicine (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}), use your proficiency rank in Nature instead. If the subject of your care is your megafauna and you roll a success on your check, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 추종자 중 원로들의 현명한 조언을 경청하고 자신의 경험을 바탕으로, 당신은 매머드 군주의 추종자들인 거대동물에게 의료 서비스를 제공하는 법을 익혔습니다. 의료 기술의 숙련 및 비숙련 사용 시, 치료 대상이 대형동물일 경우 의학 판정 대신 자연 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다. 의학에 특정 숙련도 등급이 필요한 행동(예: @link[actions.treat-wounds])을 시도할 때는 자연 숙련도 등급을 사용하십시오. 치료 대상이 자신의 거대동물이고 판정에서 성공을 굴렸다면, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Frightening Appearance

description.value:
Your dramatic appearances can frighten bystanders.

When you make a Startling Appearance, you can also attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} each opponent within 10 feet to whom you were unnoticed before your Strike.

_desc_en:
Your dramatic appearances can frighten bystanders.

When you make a Startling Appearance, you can also attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} each opponent within 10 feet to whom you were unnoticed before your Strike.
_desc_ko:
당신의 극적인 등장은 주변인을 공포에 떨게 할 수 있습니다.

당신이 놀라운 모습을 드러낼 때, 공격 전에 당신이 눈에 띄지 않았던 10피트 내의 각 상대에게 @link[actions.demoralize]를 시도할 수도 있습니다.

name: Stone Passage

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Calling upon your knowledge of stonework and inherent magic, you momentarily make a section of stone insubstantial, allowing you to pass through. Stride up to your Speed. You can move through stone or rock objects, such as walls, as if they were unoccupied spaces. If you end your movement inside a square that you normally would not be able to pass through, you are thrown back to the last unoccupied square you moved into.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Calling upon your knowledge of stonework and inherent magic, you momentarily make a section of stone insubstantial, allowing you to pass through. Stride up to your Speed. You can move through stone or rock objects, such as walls, as if they were unoccupied spaces. If you end your movement inside a square that you normally would not be able to pass through, you are thrown back to the last unoccupied square you moved into.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

석공술과 내재된 마법에 대한 지식을 활용하여, 순간적으로 돌의 일부를 실체가 없게 만들어 통과할 수 있게 합니다. 이동 속도만큼 전진합니다. 벽과 같은 돌이나 암석 물체를 마치 비어 있는 공간인 양 통과할 수 있습니다. 평소라면 통과할 수 없는 칸 안에서 이동을 종료하면, 마지막으로 이동한 비어 있는 칸으로 되돌아가게 됩니다.

name: Forlorn

description.value: Watching your friends age and die fills you with moroseness that protects you against harmful emotions. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion effects. If you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.

rules.text: If you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.
rules.title: {item|name}

_desc_en: Watching your friends age and die fills you with moroseness that protects you against harmful emotions. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion effects. If you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 친구들이 늙어가고 죽어가는 모습을 지켜보는 것은 당신을 우울함으로 채워 해로운 감정으로부터 보호합니다. 감정 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 감정 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴리면 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Hidden Thorn

description.value: Some flowers can hide their thorns, and yours happen to be hidden along your arms. You gain a thorns unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Your thorns are in the knife weapon group and have the finesse and unarmed traits.

_desc_en: Some flowers can hide their thorns, and yours happen to be hidden along your arms. You gain a thorns unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Your thorns are in the knife weapon group and have the finesse and unarmed traits.
_desc_ko: 어떤 꽃들은 가시를 숨길 수 있으며, 당신의 가시는 팔을 따라 숨겨져 있습니다. 당신은 1d6 관통 피해를 주는 비무장 공격을 얻습니다. 당신의 가시는 칼 무기 그룹에 속하며, 기교와 무기 특성을 지닙니다.

name: Unkillable

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You would be reduced to 0 HP.

You're relentless and nigh unkillable, shrugging off blows that should destroy you, though they might make your body start to fall apart. You are reduced to 1 HP instead of 0 HP. You must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:6] or your body deteriorates.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You would be reduced to 0 HP.

You're relentless and nigh unkillable, shrugging off blows that should destroy you, though they might make your body start to fall apart. You are reduced to 1 HP instead of 0 HP. You must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:6] or your body deteriorates.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

발동 HP가 0이 됩니다.

당신은 끈질기고 거의 죽일 수 없는 존재로, 당신을 파괴해야 할 공격을 가볍게 무시하지만, 그 공격은 당신의 몸을 부서지기 시작하게 할 수 있습니다. 당신은 0 HP가 아닌 1 HP로 감소합니다. DC 6 단순에 성공해야 하며, 그렇지 않으면 당신의 몸이 쇠퇴합니다.

name: Shared Prey

description.value: Hunting as a duo, you and your ally both single out your prey. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JYi4MnsdFu618hPm]{Hunt Prey} and select only one prey, you can grant your Hunt Prey benefits and hunter's edge to an ally in addition to gaining them yourself. The ally retains these benefits until you use Hunt Prey again.

_desc_en: Hunting as a duo, you and your ally both single out your prey. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JYi4MnsdFu618hPm]{Hunt Prey} and select only one prey, you can grant your Hunt Prey benefits and hunter's edge to an ally in addition to gaining them yourself. The ally retains these benefits until you use Hunt Prey again.
_desc_ko: 둘이서 사냥할 때, 당신과 동료는 각각 한 마리의 먹잇감을 지정합니다. @link[actions.hunt-prey]을 사용해 단 하나의 먹잇감만 선택할 경우, 자신뿐만 아니라 동료에게도 사냥감 추적의 혜택과 헌터스 엣지를 부여할 수 있습니다. 동료는 당신이 다시 사냥감 추적을 사용할 때까지 이 혜택을 유지한다.

name: Delay Trap

description.value:
Trigger A trap within your reach is triggered.

You try to jam the workings of a trap to delay its effects. Attempt a Thievery check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable a Device} on the trap with the following results instead of the normal ones for the action.

Critical Success You either prevent the trap from being triggered or delay the activation until the start or end of your next turn.

Success As above, but the GM chooses whichever is worse for you.

Failure No effect.

Critical Failure You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn.

_desc_en:
Trigger A trap within your reach is triggered.

You try to jam the workings of a trap to delay its effects. Attempt a Thievery check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable a Device} on the trap with the following results instead of the normal ones for the action.

Critical Success You either prevent the trap from being triggered or delay the activation until the start or end of your next turn.

Success As above, but the GM chooses whichever is worse for you.

Failure No effect.

Critical Failure You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
발동 손이 닿는 범위 내의 함정이 발동된다.

당신은 함정의 작동 장치를 방해하여 효과를 지연시키려 합니다. 이 함정에 대해 @link[actions.disable-a-device] 도둑질 판정을 시도하세요. 이 행동에 대한 일반적인 결과 대신 다음과 같은 결과가 적용됩니다.

대성공 함정이 작동하는 것을 막거나, 다음 턴 시작 또는 종료 시까지 작동이 지연됩니다.

성공 위와 같으나, GM이 당신에게 더 불리한 쪽을 선택합니다.

실패 효과 없음.

대실패 다음 차례 시작까지 @link[conditions.off-guard]가 됩니다.

name: Peculiar Anatomy

description.value:
Your circulatory system contains viscous protoplasmic fluid instead of ordinary blood. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against disease and poison, and resistance to poison damage equal to half your level.

In addition, your resistance to precision damage from Disturbing Defense increases to an amount equal to 7 + your number of class feats from the oozemorph archetype, and the DC of your flat checks to recover from persistent bleed damage is 8 rather than 13.

_desc_en:
Your circulatory system contains viscous protoplasmic fluid instead of ordinary blood. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against disease and poison, and resistance to poison damage equal to half your level.

In addition, your resistance to precision damage from Disturbing Defense increases to an amount equal to 7 + your number of class feats from the oozemorph archetype, and the DC of your flat checks to recover from persistent bleed damage is 8 rather than 13.
_desc_ko:
당신의 순환계에는 일반적인 혈액 대신 점성 있는 원형질 액체가 흐릅니다. 질병과 독에 대한 내성 굴림에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 독 피해에 대한 저항력을 얻습니다.

또한, 불안한 방어의 정밀 피해에 대한 내성이 7 + 우즈 형체 아키타입의 클래스 피트 수만큼 증가하며, 지속적인 출혈 피해 회복을 위한 단순 판정 난이도(DC)는 13이 아닌 8입니다.

name: Culvert's Collapse

description.value:
Requirements You are in Flood Stance and were damaged by an enemy since your previous turn.

Under your foes' onslaught, the water within your violent blood stirs. Your killing intent swells, your agonies marshaling your inevitable resurgence. Make a flooded river Strike against the enemy who dealt damage to you since your previous turn. That Strike deals an additional 1d8 bleed damage.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are in Flood Stance and were damaged by an enemy since your previous turn.

Under your foes' onslaught, the water within your violent blood stirs. Your killing intent swells, your agonies marshaling your inevitable resurgence. Make a flooded river Strike against the enemy who dealt damage to you since your previous turn. That Strike deals an additional 1d8 bleed damage.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 홍수 자세 상태이며, 지난 턴 이후 적에게 피해를 입었습니다.

적의 맹공에 당신의 격렬한 피 속 물결이 요동친다. 살의가 솟구치고 고통이 필연적인 부활을 마셜한다. 지난 턴 이후 당신에게 피해를 준 적에게 범람한 강 공격으로 강타하라. 해당 공격은 추가로 1d8 출혈 피해를 입힌다.

name: Courageous Assault

description.value: With a mighty shout, you can stir an ally to attack. If your next action is to cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IAjvwqgiDr3qGYxY]{Courageous Anthem} composition cantrip, one ally of your choice who gains a status bonus from the spell can immediately use their reaction to make a melee Strike.

_desc_en: With a mighty shout, you can stir an ally to attack. If your next action is to cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IAjvwqgiDr3qGYxY]{Courageous Anthem} composition cantrip, one ally of your choice who gains a status bonus from the spell can immediately use their reaction to make a melee Strike.
_desc_ko: 강력한 함성으로 아군을 자극해 공격하게 할 수 있습니다. 다음 행동으로 @link[spells.courageous-anthem] 작곡 캔트립을 시전할 경우, 해당 주문으로 상태 보너스를 얻은 선택한 아군 한 명이 즉시 반응을 사용해 근접 공격을 할 수 있습니다.

name: Rejuvenation

description.value: The call of your unfinished business recreates you after destruction. When you're destroyed, you reform after [[/r 2d4 #Days]]{2d4 days} within your bound site, fully healed. If your unfinished business is resolved while you're waiting, you pass on immediately unless you and the GM determine you have new unfinished business.

_desc_en: The call of your unfinished business recreates you after destruction. When you're destroyed, you reform after [[/r 2d4 #Days]]{2d4 days} within your bound site, fully healed. If your unfinished business is resolved while you're waiting, you pass on immediately unless you and the GM determine you have new unfinished business.
_desc_ko: 미완의 임무가 부름을 받으면 파괴 후 재생됩니다. 파괴될 경우, 2d4일 이내에 속박된 장소에서 완전히 치유된 상태로 재구성됩니다. 대기 중 미완의 과제가 해결되면, 당신과 GM이 새로운 미완의 과제가 생겼다고 판단하지 않는 한 즉시 전생한다.

name: Prayer Attack

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a sawtooth saber in each hand.

You've mastered the signature assassination style of the Red Mantis. Attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} an enemy within 30 feet. If your Feint is successful, when you use Prayer Attack on subsequent turns you automatically make the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against your melee attacks for that turn without rolling a check to Feint, so long as you remain visible to the target and the target remains within 30 feet of you. If you use your Prayer Attack against a different target, you must attempt to Feint the target normally.

When you use Prayer Attack, your next successful Strike with a sawtooth saber that turn deals 2d6 persistent bleed damage to the target.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a sawtooth saber in each hand.

You've mastered the signature assassination style of the Red Mantis. Attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} an enemy within 30 feet. If your Feint is successful, when you use Prayer Attack on subsequent turns you automatically make the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against your melee attacks for that turn without rolling a check to Feint, so long as you remain visible to the target and the target remains within 30 feet of you. If you use your Prayer Attack against a different target, you must attempt to Feint the target normally.

When you use Prayer Attack, your next successful Strike with a sawtooth saber that turn deals 2d6 persistent bleed damage to the target.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손에 톱니 모양 세이버를 휘두르고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 레드 맨티스의 시그니처 암살 스타일을 마스터했습니다. 30피트 이내의 적에게 @link[actions.feint]를 시도하십시오. 페인트가 성공하면, 이후 턴에 기도 공격을 사용할 때 대상은 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 되며, 해당 턴 동안 근접 공격에 대한 페인트 판정 없이 공격이 성공한다. 단, 대상이 당신을 계속 볼 수 있고 30피트 이내에 머물러야 한다. 다른 대상에게 기도 공격을 사용할 경우, 정상적으로 페인트 판정을 시도해야 한다.

기도 공격을 사용한 턴에 톱니형 세이버로 다음 공격이 성공하면 대상에게 2d6 지속 출혈 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Magical Scholastics

description.value: While study is key to your success, a bit of magic can be a helpful aid in discovering the secrets of the past. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.izcxFQFwf3woCnFs]{Guidance}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OhD2Z6rIGGD5ocZA]{Read Aura} as occult innate cantrips.

_desc_en: While study is key to your success, a bit of magic can be a helpful aid in discovering the secrets of the past. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.izcxFQFwf3woCnFs]{Guidance}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OhD2Z6rIGGD5ocZA]{Read Aura} as occult innate cantrips.
_desc_ko: 공부가 성공의 열쇠이긴 하지만, 과거의 비밀을 발견하는 데 약간의 마법이 도움이 될 수 있습니다. @link[spells.detect-magic], @link[spells.guidance], @link[spells.read-aura]를 오컬트 선천적 캔트립으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Splendid Companion

description.value: Your animal companion continues to develop. It becomes a nimble or savage animal companion (your choice), gaining abilities determined by its type. Increase its proficiency rank in Performance to master instead of Athletics or Acrobatics.

publication.title: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God

_desc_en: Your animal companion continues to develop. It becomes a nimble or savage animal companion (your choice), gaining abilities determined by its type. Increase its proficiency rank in Performance to master instead of Athletics or Acrobatics.
_desc_ko: 동물 동료는 계속 성장합니다. 민첩한 동물 동료 또는 야성적인 동물 동료(선택)로 진화하며, 유형에 따른 능력을 얻습니다. 운동 능력이나 곡예 대신 공연 숙련도 등급을 달인 수준으로 올립니다.

name: Basic Sorcerer Spellcasting

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{Basic Spellcasting Feat} benefits. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new level from the sorcerer archetype, add a spell of the appropriate spell rank to your repertoire: a common spell of your bloodline's tradition, one of your bloodline's granted spells, or another spell you have learned or discovered.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{Basic Spellcasting Feat} benefits. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new level from the sorcerer archetype, add a spell of the appropriate spell rank to your repertoire: a common spell of your bloodline's tradition, one of your bloodline's granted spells, or another spell you have learned or discovered.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{기본 주문 시전 피트}의 혜택을 얻습니다. 소서러 아키타입으로부터 새로운 레벨의 주문 슬롯을 획득할 때마다, 해당 주문 랭크에 맞는 주문을 레퍼토리에 추가합니다: 혈통 전통의 일반 주문, 혈통이 부여한 주문 중 하나, 또는 배우거나 발견한 다른 주문입니다.

name: Minotaur Lore

description.value:
You were raised in a minotaur enclave or have spent a great deal of time studying your culture and ancestry. You become trained in Society and Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Minotaur Lore.

_desc_en:
You were raised in a minotaur enclave or have spent a great deal of time studying your culture and ancestry. You become trained in Society and Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Minotaur Lore.
_desc_ko:
당신은 미노타우루스 집단에서 자랐거나 그들의 문화와 조상을 연구하는 데 많은 시간을 보냈습니다. 사회와 은신에 숙련됩니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 자동으로 그 중 하나의 기술에 숙련된다면, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다.

또한 미노타우루스 지식에 대한 @link[feats.additional-lore] 일반 피트를 획득합니다.

name: Sickening Bite

description.value:
Your saliva causes severe nausea and mild fever in the living, weakening them so that you can more easily finish them off. When you critically hit a creature with your jaws, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. This is a disease effect.

If you are satiated, you can end your satiation to make the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} on a regular hit instead.

_desc_en:
Your saliva causes severe nausea and mild fever in the living, weakening them so that you can more easily finish them off. When you critically hit a creature with your jaws, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. This is a disease effect.

If you are satiated, you can end your satiation to make the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} on a regular hit instead.
_desc_ko:
당신의 타액은 살아있는 존재에게 심한 메스꺼움과 가벼운 열을 유발하여 그들을 약화시켜 당신이 더 쉽게 마무리할 수 있게 합니다. 당신이 턱으로 생물을 치명타로 공격할 때, 그 생물은 @link[conditions.sickened]{1}이 됩니다. 이는 질병 효과입니다.

포만 상태일 때, 포만 상태를 해제하면 일반 공격으로 대상에게 @link[conditions.sickened]{1} 상태를 부여할 수 있습니다.

name: Masterful Companion

description.value: Your animal companion shares your incredible hunting skills, allowing it to take down your shared prey with ease. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JYi4MnsdFu618hPm]{Hunt Prey}, your animal companion gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.RVZC4wVy5B5W2OeS]{Masterful Hunter} benefit associated with your hunter's edge, rather than just your original hunter's edge benefit.

_desc_en: Your animal companion shares your incredible hunting skills, allowing it to take down your shared prey with ease. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JYi4MnsdFu618hPm]{Hunt Prey}, your animal companion gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.RVZC4wVy5B5W2OeS]{Masterful Hunter} benefit associated with your hunter's edge, rather than just your original hunter's edge benefit.
_desc_ko: 당신의 동물 동료는 당신의 놀라운 사냥 기술을 공유하여, 함께 노리는 먹이를 손쉽게 제압할 수 있습니다. 당신이 @link[actions.hunt-prey]을 할 때, 당신의 동물 동료는 원래의 헌터스 엣지 대신 당신의 헌터스 엣지와 연관된 @link[feats.masterful-hunter] 이점을 얻습니다.

name: Fear No Law, Fear No One

description.value: When your allies see you stand up to fear, they become similarly emboldened. Make a Strike. If you hit and deal damage, each ally within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] around you who can see you reduces the value of their @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition by 1. If the target of your Strike was the source of their frightened condition, they reduce the value by 2 instead.

name_en: Fear No Law, Fear No One
name_ko: 질서도 두려워하지 말고, 누구도 두려워하지 마라
_desc_en: When your allies see you stand up to fear, they become similarly emboldened. Make a Strike. If you hit and deal damage, each ally within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] around you who can see you reduces the value of their @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition by 1. If the target of your Strike was the source of their frightened condition, they reduce the value by 2 instead.
_desc_ko: 공포 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴릴 때, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다. 또한 @link[conditions.frightened]를 획득할 때마다 해당 상태의 수치를 1 감소시킵니다. 평소와 같이 이 능력은 초기 공포 상태를 1 감소시키므로, 유사한 능력을 여러 개 보유한 경우 중복 적용되지 않습니다.

name: Mischievous Tail

description.value: Your tail can bedevil your foes. You can Disarm and Trip creatures with your tail, even if you don't have a free hand. All restrictions of Skillful Tail otherwise continue to apply. If you have Smashing Tail, your tail unarmed attack gains the disarm and trip traits.

_desc_en: Your tail can bedevil your foes. You can Disarm and Trip creatures with your tail, even if you don't have a free hand. All restrictions of Skillful Tail otherwise continue to apply. If you have Smashing Tail, your tail unarmed attack gains the disarm and trip traits.
_desc_ko: 당신의 꼬리는 적을 괴롭힐 수 있습니다. 빈 손이 없더라도 꼬리로 생물의 무장을 빼앗거나 넘어뜨릴 수 있습니다. 숙련된 꼬리의 다른 모든 제한 사항은 계속 적용됩니다. 파괴적인 꼬리 능력을 가진 경우, 꼬리로 하는 비무장 공격에 무기 빼앗기와 넘어뜨리기 특성이 부여됩니다.

name: Mobile Magical Combat

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a melee weapon and have Cast a Spell requiring at least 1 action this turn.

You dart around the battlefield, casting spells while you carefully make melee attacks with your weapon. Stride once. If you end your movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, you can make a melee Strike against that enemy. You can use Mobile Magical Combat while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a melee weapon and have Cast a Spell requiring at least 1 action this turn.

You dart around the battlefield, casting spells while you carefully make melee attacks with your weapon. Stride once. If you end your movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, you can make a melee Strike against that enemy. You can use Mobile Magical Combat while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 근접 무기를 장비하고 있으며, 이번 턴에 최소 1 행동이 필요한 주문을 시전한 상태여야 한다.

전장을 누비며 주문을 시전하는 동시에 무기로 근접 공격을 신중하게 가한다. 한 번의 이동을 한다. 이동을 끝낸 위치가 적어도 한 명의 적과 근접 공격 범위 내에 있다면, 해당 적에게 근접 공격을 가할 수 있다. 해당 이동 유형을 가진 경우, 땅속 이동, 등반, 비행 또는 수영 시에도 이동을 대신하여 기동 마법 전투를 사용할 수 있다.

name: Triple Time

description.value: You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.c8R2fpk88fBwJ1ie]{Triple Time} composition cantrip, which speeds up you and your allies for a round.

_desc_en: You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.c8R2fpk88fBwJ1ie]{Triple Time} composition cantrip, which speeds up you and your allies for a round.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @link[spells.triple-time] 구성 캔트립을 습득합니다. 이 주문은 당신과 아군들의 속도를 1라운드 동안 증가시킵니다.

name: Twirl Through

description.value: You sweep across the battlefield in a fluttering of movement honed from years of coordinating perfectly spaced movements alongside fellow dancers. When you attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} an enemy's space, you can use [[/act tumble-through skill=performance]]{Performance} instead of Acrobatics.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You sweep across the battlefield in a fluttering of movement honed from years of coordinating perfectly spaced movements alongside fellow dancers. When you attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} an enemy's space, you can use [[/act tumble-through skill=performance]]{Performance} instead of Acrobatics.
_desc_ko: 수년간 동료 무용수들과 완벽한 간격으로 움직임을 조율하며 연마한 날렵한 동작으로 전장을 가로지른다. 적의 공간을 @link[actions.tumble-through] 시도할 때, 곡예 대신 공연를 사용할 수 있다.

name: Legendary Shot

description.value: You focus on your hunted prey, perceiving angles, air resistance, and every variable that would affect your ranged attack. If you have master proficiency with your ranged weapon, you can ignore the penalty for attacking up to five range increments away when attacking your hunted prey.

_desc_en: You focus on your hunted prey, perceiving angles, air resistance, and every variable that would affect your ranged attack. If you have master proficiency with your ranged weapon, you can ignore the penalty for attacking up to five range increments away when attacking your hunted prey.
_desc_ko: 사냥감을 추적하며 사격 각도, 공기 저항 등 원거리 공격에 영향을 미치는 모든 변수를 파악한다. 원거리 무기 숙련도가 달인 등급일 경우, 사냥감을 공격할 때 최대 5사거리 증가 거리까지의 공격 페널티를 무시할 수 있다.

name: Shoki's Argument

description.value: You feel a connection to shokis, the rambling collectors of wayward souls, and might have found old texts written by one. You are trained in Diplomacy. If you were already trained in Diplomacy (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You can also cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kcelf6IHl3L9VXXg]{Vitality Lash} as a divine innate cantrip at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

_desc_en: You feel a connection to shokis, the rambling collectors of wayward souls, and might have found old texts written by one. You are trained in Diplomacy. If you were already trained in Diplomacy (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You can also cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kcelf6IHl3L9VXXg]{Vitality Lash} as a divine innate cantrip at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 방황하는 영혼들을 수집하는 쇼키들과 유대감을 느끼며, 그들 중 한 명이 쓴 고대 문헌을 발견했을 수도 있습니다. 당신은 외교에 숙련되어 있습니다. (배경이나 직업 등으로) 이미 외교에 숙련되어 있었다면, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다. 또한 @link[spells.vitality-lash]을 신성 선천적 캔트립으로 마음대로 시전할 수 있습니다. 캔트립은 레벨의 절반(올림)에 해당하는 주문 랭크으로 강화됩니다.

name: Multilingual Cipher

description.value:
You use multiple languages to create and break codes. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing}.

If another creature attempts to Decipher Writing you encoded, they take a -2 circumstance penalty unless they speak all the languages you used when you created the writing.

_desc_en:
You use multiple languages to create and break codes. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing}.

If another creature attempts to Decipher Writing you encoded, they take a -2 circumstance penalty unless they speak all the languages you used when you created the writing.
_desc_ko:
여러 언어를 사용하여 암호를 만들고 해독합니다. @link[actions.decipher-writing]에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

다른 생물이 당신이 암호화한 문자를 해독하려고 시도할 경우, 당신이 문자를 생성할 때 사용한 모든 언어를 구사하지 않는 한 -2 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Opportune Trickster

description.value:
Trigger An adjacent ally makes a melee Strike against a creature.

Requirements You're adjacent to both your ally and the creature.

You aren't above using underhanded tactics to gain an advantage, easily routing your opponents when they attack. Attempt a @Check[deception|against:perception] check against the Perception DC of the creature that's the target of the triggering attack. Regardless of the result, the target is temporarily immune to your attempts to use Opportune Trickster for the next 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} (including against the triggering attack) until the end of your ally's turn.

Success The target is off-guard against the triggering attack.

Critical Failure You lose your balance in your attempt to assist your ally and fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.5eNKs6738aykAhK2]{Dirty Trick} skill feat, you can attempt a @Check[thievery|against:perception] check instead of a Deception check; if you do, this action loses the mental trait

_desc_en:
Trigger An adjacent ally makes a melee Strike against a creature.

Requirements You're adjacent to both your ally and the creature.

You aren't above using underhanded tactics to gain an advantage, easily routing your opponents when they attack. Attempt a @Check[deception|against:perception] check against the Perception DC of the creature that's the target of the triggering attack. Regardless of the result, the target is temporarily immune to your attempts to use Opportune Trickster for the next 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} (including against the triggering attack) until the end of your ally's turn.

Success The target is off-guard against the triggering attack.

Critical Failure You lose your balance in your attempt to assist your ally and fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.5eNKs6738aykAhK2]{Dirty Trick} skill feat, you can attempt a @Check[thievery|against:perception] check instead of a Deception check; if you do, this action loses the mental trait
_desc_ko:
발동 인접한 아군이 생물에게 근접 타격을 합니다.

요구조건 당신은 아군과 그 생물 모두에게 인접해 있습니다.

당신은 이점을 얻기 위해 비겁한 수법을 쓰는 것도 마다하지 않으며, 적들이 공격할 때 손쉽게 그들을 무너뜨립니다. 발동시킨 공격의 대상인 생물의 지각 DC에 대해 @Check[deception|against:perception] 판정을 시도하십시오. 결과와 관계없이, 그 대상은 이후 10분 동안 당신의 기회의 책략가 사용 시도에 일시적으로 면역이 됩니다.

대성공 대상은 당신 아군의 턴이 끝날 때까지 (발동시킨 공격에 대해서도 포함하여) @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{무방비}입니다.

성공 대상은 발동시킨 공격에 대해 무방비입니다.

대실패 당신은 아군을 돕려다 균형을 잃고 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{넘어짐} 상태가 됩니다.

특수 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.5eNKs6738aykAhK2]{더러운 수작} 기술 재주가 있다면, 기만 판정 대신 @Check[thievery|against:perception] 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다. 그렇게 하면 이 행동은 정신 특성을 잃습니다.

name: Bone Caller

description.value: Using a mixture of dinosaur bones and the bones of your ancestors to focus your magic, you animate lizards and dinosaurs to carry messages or serve as mounts. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yhz9fF69uwRhnHix]{Animal Messenger} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WPKJOhEihhcIm2uQ]{Marvelous Mount} as primal innate spells once per day each. The animal messenger is always a Tiny dinosaur or lizard, and your innate spell transforms it from bones to flesh, even if there are no dinosaurs or lizards nearby. The phantom steed looks like a dinosaur rather than a horse but functions identically.

_desc_en: Using a mixture of dinosaur bones and the bones of your ancestors to focus your magic, you animate lizards and dinosaurs to carry messages or serve as mounts. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yhz9fF69uwRhnHix]{Animal Messenger} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WPKJOhEihhcIm2uQ]{Marvelous Mount} as primal innate spells once per day each. The animal messenger is always a Tiny dinosaur or lizard, and your innate spell transforms it from bones to flesh, even if there are no dinosaurs or lizards nearby. The phantom steed looks like a dinosaur rather than a horse but functions identically.
_desc_ko: 공룡 뼈와 선조의 뼈를 혼합하여 마법에 포커스를 맞추면, 도마뱀과 공룡을 움직여 메시지를 전달하거나 탈것으로 사용할 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번씩 각각 @link[spells.animal-messenger]과 @link[spells.marvelous-mount]을 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 하루에 각각 한 번씩 시전할 수 있다. 동물 전령은 항상 소형 공룡이나 도마뱀이며, 선천 마법은 주변에 공룡이나 도마뱀이 없더라도 뼈를 살로 변환한다. 유령 탈것은 말보다는 공룡처럼 보이지만 기능은 동일하다.

name: Energy Blessed

description.value: Energy runs through your blood more powerfully. When you use Energy Emanation, you can create an emanation of @Template[emanation|distance:5]{5 feet}, @Template[emanation|distance:10]{10 feet}, or @Template[emanation|distance:15]{15 feet}. The damage increases to 6d6 plus an additional 1d6 for every level you have above 9th, instead of 1d6 plus an additional 1d6 for every 2 levels above 1st.

_desc_en: Energy runs through your blood more powerfully. When you use Energy Emanation, you can create an emanation of @Template[emanation|distance:5]{5 feet}, @Template[emanation|distance:10]{10 feet}, or @Template[emanation|distance:15]{15 feet}. The damage increases to 6d6 plus an additional 1d6 for every level you have above 9th, instead of 1d6 plus an additional 1d6 for every 2 levels above 1st.
_desc_ko: 에너지가 혈류를 통해 더욱 강력하게 흐릅니다. 에너지 발산 사용 시, 5피트, 10피트, 또는 15피트의 에너지 방출을 생성할 수 있습니다. 피해는 1레벨당 1d6 + 추가 1d6이 아닌, (9th) 이상일 경우 레벨당 6d6 + 추가 1d6으로 증가합니다.

name: Basic Spellcasting

description.value: You increase your ability to cast spells. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{Basic Spellcasting Feat} benefits granted by spellcasting archetypes, gaining a spell repertoire. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new level from the basic, expert, and master spellcasting benefits from pervasive magic feats, add a spell of the appropriate spell rank to your repertoire: a common spell of the magical tradition matching your trait, or another spell of that tradition that you have learned or discovered.

_desc_en: You increase your ability to cast spells. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{Basic Spellcasting Feat} benefits granted by spellcasting archetypes, gaining a spell repertoire. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new level from the basic, expert, and master spellcasting benefits from pervasive magic feats, add a spell of the appropriate spell rank to your repertoire: a common spell of the magical tradition matching your trait, or another spell of that tradition that you have learned or discovered.
_desc_ko: 주문 시전 능력이 향상됩니다. 주문 시전 아키타입이 부여하는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{기본 주문 시전 피트} 혜택을 얻어 주문 목록을 획득합니다. 퍼베이시브 매직 특성의 기본, 전문가, 달인 주문 시전 혜택으로 새로운 레벨의 주문 슬롯을 획득할 때마다, 해당 레벨에 맞는 주문을 주문 목록에 추가합니다: 특성에 맞는 마법 전통의 일반 주문, 또는 해당 전통에서 배웠거나 발견한 다른 주문입니다.

name: Charming Liar

description.value: Your charm allows you to win over those you lie to. When you get a critical success using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} action, the target's attitude toward you improves by one step, as though you'd succeeded at using Diplomacy to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}. This works only once per conversation, and if you critically succeed against multiple targets using the same result, you choose one creature's attitude to improve. You must be lying to impart seemingly important information, inflate your status, or ingratiate yourself, which trivial or irrelevant lies can't achieve.

_desc_en: Your charm allows you to win over those you lie to. When you get a critical success using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} action, the target's attitude toward you improves by one step, as though you'd succeeded at using Diplomacy to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}. This works only once per conversation, and if you critically succeed against multiple targets using the same result, you choose one creature's attitude to improve. You must be lying to impart seemingly important information, inflate your status, or ingratiate yourself, which trivial or irrelevant lies can't achieve.
_desc_ko: 당신의 매력은 거짓말을 하는 상대방을 설득하게 합니다. @link[actions.lie] 행동으로 대성공을 거둘 경우, 대상의 당신에 대한 태도가 @link[actions.make-an-impression]에 외교를 성공한 것처럼 한 단계 향상됩니다. 이는 대화당 한 번만 적용되며, 동일한 결과로 여러 대상에게 대성공을 거둘 경우 한 생물의 태도만 선택하여 향상시킬 수 있습니다. 중요해 보이는 정보를 전달하거나 지위를 과장하거나 호감을 사기 위해 거짓말을 해야 하며, 사소하거나 무관한 거짓말로는 달성할 수 없습니다.

name: Battle Assessment

description.value:
With careful observation during battle, you identify an enemy's strengths and weaknesses. The GM rolls a secret Perception check for you against the Deception or Stealth DC (whichever is higher) of an enemy of your choice who is not concealed from you, hidden from you, or undetected by you, and who is engaged in combat. The GM might apply a penalty for the distance between you and the enemy. The enemy is then temporarily immune to your Battle Assessment for 1 day.

Critical Success The GM chooses two of the following pieces of information about the enemy to tell you: which of the enemy's weaknesses is highest, which of the enemy's saving throws has the lowest modifier, one immunity the enemy has, or which of the enemy's resistances is highest. If the event of a tie, the GM should pick one at random.

Success The GM chooses one piece of information from the above list to tell you about the enemy.

Critical Failure The GM gives you false information (the GM makes up the information).

_desc_en:
With careful observation during battle, you identify an enemy's strengths and weaknesses. The GM rolls a secret Perception check for you against the Deception or Stealth DC (whichever is higher) of an enemy of your choice who is not concealed from you, hidden from you, or undetected by you, and who is engaged in combat. The GM might apply a penalty for the distance between you and the enemy. The enemy is then temporarily immune to your Battle Assessment for 1 day.

Critical Success The GM chooses two of the following pieces of information about the enemy to tell you: which of the enemy's weaknesses is highest, which of the enemy's saving throws has the lowest modifier, one immunity the enemy has, or which of the enemy's resistances is highest. If the event of a tie, the GM should pick one at random.

Success The GM chooses one piece of information from the above list to tell you about the enemy.

Critical Failure The GM gives you false information (the GM makes up the information).
_desc_ko:
전투 중 세심한 관찰을 통해 적의 강점과 약점을 파악한다. GM은 당신이 선택한 적 중 당신에게 은폐되지 않았거나, 숨겨지지 않았거나, 탐지되지 않았으며 전투 중인 대상의 기만 또는 은신 DC(둘 중 높은 쪽)에 대해 비밀로 지각 검사를 굴립니다. GM은 당신과 적 사이의 거리에 따른 페널티를 적용할 수 있습니다. 해당 적은 이후 1일간 당신의 전투 평가에 일시적으로 면역됩니다.

대성공 GM은 적에 관한 다음 정보 중 두 가지를 선택하여 알려줍니다: 적의 가장 높은 약점, 적의 내성 굴림 중 가장 낮은 수정자를 가진 것, 적의 한 가지 면역력, 또는 적의 가장 높은 저항력. 동점일 경우, GM은 무작위로 하나를 선택해야 합니다.

성공 GM은 위 목록에서 한 가지 정보를 선택하여 적에 대해 알려줍니다.

대실패 GM은 거짓 정보를 제공합니다(GM이 정보를 지어냅니다).

name: Shattering Strike (Weapon Improviser)

description.value:
Trigger An improvised weapon that you are wielding becomes broken as a result of a critical success on an Improvised Pummel.

The improvised weapon shatters, destroying it completely but dealing an additional @Damage[3d6[piercing]] damage to the creature you hit with the Improvised Pummel. This extra damage you apply on the critical hit doesn't double from the critical hit, as normal.

_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신이 휘두르는 즉석 무기가 즉석 주먹질에 대성공을 거두면 부서진다.

임시 제작 무기가 산산조각 나 완전히 파괴되지만, 임시 제작 주먹질로 맞춘 생물에게 3d6 관통의 추가 피해를 입힙니다. 이 치명타 시 적용되는 추가 피해는 일반적인 치명타처럼 두 배로 증가하지 않습니다.

name: Noble Bloom

description.value:
Access chrysanthemum leshy heritage

Trigger An ally within 30 feet would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.

Frequency once per day

Certain plants and flowers hold a reputation throughout Tian Xia for being strong and upstanding, able to weather adversity. In the moment your ally would succumb to their injuries, you stand tall and bloom proudly, radiating this strength for them. Your ally avoids being knocked out and remains at 1 Hit Point, and their @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition increases by 1, as does your own.

접근 국화 레시 유산

발동 30피트 내의 아군은 HP가 0으로 감소하지만 즉시 죽지는 않는다.

발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

특정 식물과 꽃들은 티엔 샤에 걸쳐 강인하고 의기양양하며 역경을 견뎌내는 것으로 명성이 자자하다. 동료가 부상으로 쓰러질 순간, 당신은 당당히 서서 그들을 위해 이 힘을 발산하며 꽃을 피운다. 동료는 기절을 피하고 1 HP로 남으며, @link[conditions.wounded] 상태가 1 증가하고 당신도 동일하게 적용된다.

name: Shift the Little Ones

description.value: With your large size, you need to be careful around your smaller friends. You have learned to move in such a way that it gives others the chance to make room for you. Stride up to your Speed. If you end your movement in a position where one or more of your spaces are occupied by an ally, each of those allies can immediately Step as a free action so that they are no longer occupying the same space as you. If this isn't possible, you must end your movement so that you aren't sharing a space with an ally, as normal.

_desc_en: With your large size, you need to be careful around your smaller friends. You have learned to move in such a way that it gives others the chance to make room for you. Stride up to your Speed. If you end your movement in a position where one or more of your spaces are occupied by an ally, each of those allies can immediately Step as a free action so that they are no longer occupying the same space as you. If this isn't possible, you must end your movement so that you aren't sharing a space with an ally, as normal.
_desc_ko: 당신의 큰 체구 때문에 작은 친구들 주변에서는 조심해야 합니다. 당신은 다른 이들이 당신을 위해 자리를 마련할 수 있도록 움직이는 법을 익혔습니다. 속도에 맞춰 이동하라. 이동을 끝낸 위치에서 하나 이상의 공간이 아군에 의해 점유된 경우, 해당 아군들은 즉시 자유 행동으로 이동하여 더 이상 너와 같은 공간을 점유하지 않도록 할 수 있다. 이것이 불가능할 경우, 평소처럼 아군과 공간을 공유하지 않도록 이동을 끝내야 한다.

name: Soul Well

description.value:
Your brush your fingers across your splinter of finality, momentarily creating a metaphysical vortex from which mortal spirits struggle to escape. For the next minute, incorporeal undead treat all squares within 30 feet of you as difficult terrain and living creatures within the same area die from the dying condition at dying 5 rather than dying 4.

As it comes close to tasting a living soul, the splinter of finality is empowered. If a living creature's dying value increases while within your Soul Well, your spectral dagger deals one additional weapon die of damage until the end of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.HKk3oUYJNN82heeH]{Effect: Soul Well (Additional Damage)}

_desc_ko:
당신은 손가락으로 최종성의 파편을 쓸어내리며, 순간적으로 필멸자의 영혼들이 탈출하기 위해 몸부림치는 형이상학적 소용돌이를 생성합니다. 이후 1분 동안, 비물질적 언데드는 당신으로부터 30피트 이내의 모든 칸을 어려운 지형으로 간주하며, 동일한 영역 내의 생명체는 죽음 상태 4가 아닌 죽음 상태 5로 인해 사망합니다.

생명의 영혼을 맛보려는 순간, 최종성의 파편은 힘을 얻는다. 당신의 영혼의 우물 안에 있는 동안 생명체의 죽음의 수치가 증가하면, 당신의 유령 단검은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 무기 주사위 1개의 피해를 추가로 가한다.

name: Trespass Teleportation

description.value:
Requirements You are benefiting from Exploit Vulnerability.

Trigger The target of your Exploit Vulnerability is within 120 feet and uses a teleportation effect.

You can hunt your foe to the ends of creation. You teleport along with the enemy, appearing the same direction and distance from it as you were before it teleported (or the nearest unoccupied space if your destination is occupied). Any allies affected by Share Weakness or Ubiquitous Weakness, if you have those abilities, can spend their reaction to teleport along with the enemy if they're within 120 of the enemy and choose to do so.

_desc_ko:
요구사항 당신은 약점 악용의 혜택을 받고 있습니다.

발동 조건 악용 약점의 대상이 120피트 이내에 있으며 순간이동 효과를 사용 중입니다.

당신은 적을 창조계의 끝까지 추적할 수 있습니다. 당신은 적과 함께 순간이동하며, 적의 순간이전 전과 동일한 방향 및 거리(목적지가 점유된 경우 가장 가까운 비어 있는 공간)에 나타납니다. 당신이 '약점 공유' 또는 '보편적 약점' 능력을 보유하고 있다면, 해당 능력의 영향을 받는 아군들은 적과 120피트 이내에 위치하고 선택할 경우, 자신의 반응을 소모하여 적과 함께 순간이동할 수 있습니다.

name: Defensive Needles

description.value:
Your body is covered in sharp needles or spines which you can use to defend yourself. Each time you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by a creature or an adjacent creature hits you with an unarmed attack, you twist and thrash your body around, dealing 2 piercing damage to that creature. This damage increases to 3 at 9th level, 4 at 13th level, and 5 at 17th level.

@Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/4))[piercing]]{Leveled damage}

name: Concealing Legerdemain

description.value:
Rather than hide an object somewhere the inspectors won't search, you're skilled at keeping the object on the move so it's never where they look.

When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.qVNVSmsgpKFGk9hV]{Conceal an Object} of light Bulk or less, you can use Thievery instead of Stealth for your checks and for the DC of an active searcher's Perception check. You roll the check only once, but you must continue to use actions to Conceal an Object throughout the process.

물건을 조사관들이 수색하지 않을 곳에 {숨기}보다는, 물건을 계속 움직여 그들이 찾는 곳에는 절대 두지 않는 데 능숙합니다.

당신이 @link[actions.conceal-an-object]할 때, 그 물건의 벌크가 가벼운 벌크 이하라면, 은신 대신 도둑질을 사용하여 판정하고, 능동적으로 수색하는 자의 지각 판정 난이도(DC)를 적용할 수 있습니다. 판정은 한 번만 굴림하지만, 그 과정 내내 계속해서 행동을 사용해 물건을 은닉해야 합니다.

name: Brilliant Flash

description.value: Your light cleanses souls of fear. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ITWUi1r8Z7EtChkB]{Flash of Grandeur}, the attacker is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round.

name: Divine Apex

description.value: You can pour divine power into an item, letting the wearer exceed their limits. When you complete your daily preparations, you can touch one worn magical item that doesn't have the apex trait. It gains the apex trait until your next preparations, and you choose one of your deity's divine attributes. The item increases that attribute modifier by 1 or to +4, whichever is higher. A character can benefit from only one apex item at a time, as normal.

_desc_ko: 신성한 힘을 아이템에 주입하여 착용자가 자신의 한계를 뛰어넘게 할 수 있습니다. 일일 준비를 완료하면, 정점 특성이 없는 착용 중인 마법 아이템 하나를 만질 수 있습니다. 해당 아이템은 다음 준비 시까지 정점 특성을 얻으며, 당신은 자신의 신의 신성 속성 중 하나를 선택합니다. 아이템은 해당 속성 수정자를 1 또는 +4 중 더 높은 값으로 증가시킵니다. 캐릭터는 평소와 같이 한 번에 하나의 정점 아이템만 혜택을 받을 수 있습니다.

name: Achaekek's Grip

description.value: You sense if a creature you have slain in the last year has been restored to life, as long as you and that creature are on the same plane. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IT1aaqDBAISlHDUV]{Achaekek's Clutch} focus spell. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point.

name: Soothing Vials

description.value:
The healing chemicals in your versatile vials also help calm a patient's mind. When a living creature affected by a mental effect regains Hit Points from one of your versatile vials, it can immediately attempt a new Will saving throw to end one mental effect of its choice. It gains a +1 item bonus to the saving throw.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.fqK8TsXmHr1JiM5e]{Effect: Soothing Vials}

name: Counterclockwork Focus

description.value:
Frequency once per round

You understand the need for law enforcement doctrine to adapt to the ever-changing innovations in technology and arcana. Your training in special weapons and tactics give you access to unusual techniques to respond to clockwork- and magic-related crimes. You apply special additives to a loaded firearm. On your next Strike with that firearm before the end of your turn, you deal an additional 2d6 damage if the target is a construct, and you can treat the ammunition as your choice of cold iron or adamantine. At 18th level, this additional damage increases to 3d6, and you can choose to instead treat the ammunition as orichalcum.
