_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 라운드당 1회

당신은 법 집행 교리가 끊임없이 변화하는 기술과 주문학에 적응해야 할 필요성을 이해합니다. 특수 무기 및 전술 훈련을 통해 시계 장치 및 마법 관련 범죄에 대응하기 위한 특이한 기법을 습득했습니다. 장전된 화기에 특수 첨가제를 적용합니다. 당신의 턴이 끝나기 전 해당 화기로 가하는 다음 공격 시, 대상이 구조물일 경우 추가로 2d6의 피해를 입히고, 탄약을 냉철철 또는 아다만틴 중 선택하여 취급할 수 있습니다. 18레벨에 도달하면 이 추가 피해가 3d6로 증가하며, 대신 탄약을 오리칼쿰으로 취급하도록 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Adrenaline Rush

description.value:
In the heat of battle, you are capable of amazing feats of strength.

While you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Ah5g9pDwWF9b9VW9]{Raging}, increase your encumbered and maximum Bulk limits by 2; you also gain a +1 status bonus to Athletics checks to lift heavy objects, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open}.

_desc_en:
In the heat of battle, you are capable of amazing feats of strength.

While you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Ah5g9pDwWF9b9VW9]{Raging}, increase your encumbered and maximum Bulk limits by 2; you also gain a +1 status bonus to Athletics checks to lift heavy objects, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open}.
_desc_ko:
격렬한 전투 속에서 당신은 놀라운 힘의 피트를 발휘할 수 있습니다.

분노 상태일 때, @link[actions.rage] 상태에서는 과적 가능한 최대 벌크 한도와 최대 벌크 한도가 2 증가합니다. 또한 무거운 물건을 들어 올리는 운동 판정, @link[actions.escape], @link[actions.force-open]에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Heightened Captivation

description.value:
You can infuse your enchantments and illusions with more power. Choose one of your spells granted by captivator archetype feats; this spell can't be from your highest level of non-cantrip captivator spells. The spell you choose is heightened to the highest level of captivator spell you can cast, not including cantrips. You can't later change the spell that is heightened by this feat.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you choose a different spell.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en:
You can infuse your enchantments and illusions with more power. Choose one of your spells granted by captivator archetype feats; this spell can't be from your highest level of non-cantrip captivator spells. The spell you choose is heightened to the highest level of captivator spell you can cast, not including cantrips. You can't later change the spell that is heightened by this feat.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you choose a different spell.
_desc_ko:
당신은 자신의 마법과 환상에 더 큰 힘을 불어넣을 수 있습니다. 매혹자 아키타입 피트로 부여받은 주문 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 이 주문은 캐스트할 수 있는 최고 레벨의 캔트립이 아닌 매혹자 주문에서 선택할 수 없습니다. 선택한 주문은 캐스트프리 주문을 제외한 캐스트할 수 있는 최고 레벨의 매혹자 주문으로 강화됩니다. 이 재주로 강화된 주문은 나중에 변경할 수 없습니다.

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 선택할 때마다 다른 주문을 선택합니다.

name: Golden Erinys Stance

description.value:
Whether you're a keen student of vengeance or you picked up techniques after being a common target for the sisters' punishment, you've learned to dig painfully into your opponent's flesh. In this stance, you can make fury's fang unarmed attacks. These deal 1d6 piercing damage; are in the brawling group; and have the agile, backstabber, finesse, forceful, nonlethal, and unarmed traits.

While in the stance, if you critically hit with a melee Strike that deals piercing damage, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (with a DC to remove equal to your class DC); this is in addition to any critical specialization effect you might gain from the attack.

value.value: Sister of the Golden Erinys Dedication

_desc_en:
Whether you're a keen student of vengeance or you picked up techniques after being a common target for the sisters' punishment, you've learned to dig painfully into your opponent's flesh. In this stance, you can make fury's fang unarmed attacks. These deal 1d6 piercing damage; are in the brawling group; and have the agile, backstabber, finesse, forceful, nonlethal, and unarmed traits.

While in the stance, if you critically hit with a melee Strike that deals piercing damage, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (with a DC to remove equal to your class DC); this is in addition to any critical specialization effect you might gain from the attack.
_desc_ko:
당신이 복수를 진지하게 연구한 학도이든, 자매들의 형벌의 흔한 표적이 된 후 기술을 익혔든, 당신은 적의 살에 고통스럽게 파고드는 법을 배웠습니다. 이 자세에서 당신은 격노의 송곳니 비무장 공격을 할 수 있습니다. 이는 1d6 관통 피해를 입히고, 격투군에 속하며, 민첩, 등찌르기, 정교함, 강력, 비살상, 비무장 특성을 가집니다.

이 자세 중에 관통 피해를 입히는 근접 타격으로 대성공하면, 대상은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{구역질 1}이 됩니다(제거 DC는 당신의 클래스 DC와 같음). 이는 당신이 그 공격으로 얻을 수 있는 대성공 특화 효과에 더해집니다.

name: Aldori Swordlord

description.value:
You are an Aldori swordlord. You can always obtain free room and board at the Aldori Academy for yourself and your allies.

You can use Dueling Lore instead of Diplomacy to [[/act make-an-impression skill=dueling-lore]]{Make an Impression} or [[/act request skill=dueling-lore]]{Request} provided that the target you are Making an Impression on would be aware of the Aldori swordlords or your Request is related to your standing as a swordlord.

Whenever you successfully Strike a creature with an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.iSceAVMkVv1uKK7t]{Aldori Dueling Sword}, you gain 5 temporary Hit Points (or 10 temporary Hit Point on a critical success) that last for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.eJyyBqrXLOE4R9JI]{Effect: Aldori Swordlord (Temporary Hit Points)}

Special You can't take both this feat and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.i8lCqWJDng4c3Cgp]{Swordlord Exile}.

value.value: you have taken the last name of Aldori, sworn to the Aldori swordpact, and demonstrated skill at swordplay by winning a duel using only a sword in the presence of an Aldori swordlord.

_desc_en:
You are an Aldori swordlord. You can always obtain free room and board at the Aldori Academy for yourself and your allies.

You can use Dueling Lore instead of Diplomacy to [[/act make-an-impression skill=dueling-lore]]{Make an Impression} or [[/act request skill=dueling-lore]]{Request} provided that the target you are Making an Impression on would be aware of the Aldori swordlords or your Request is related to your standing as a swordlord.

Whenever you successfully Strike a creature with an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.iSceAVMkVv1uKK7t]{Aldori Dueling Sword}, you gain 5 temporary Hit Points (or 10 temporary Hit Point on a critical success) that last for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.eJyyBqrXLOE4R9JI]{Effect: Aldori Swordlord (Temporary Hit Points)}

Special You can't take both this feat and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.i8lCqWJDng4c3Cgp]{Swordlord Exile}.
_desc_ko:
당신은 알도리 검의 군주입니다. 알도리 아카데미에서 자신과 동맹을 위한 숙식 제공을 항상 무료로 받을 수 있습니다.

외교 대신 결투 지식를 사용하여 인상 남기기 또는 요청하기를 수행할 수 있습니다. 단, 인상 남기기 대상이 알도리 검의 군주들을 알고 있거나, 요청이 검의 군주로서의 지위와 관련되어야 합니다.

@link[equipment.aldori-dueling-sword]으로 생물을 성공적으로 강타할 때마다, 1라운드 동안 지속되는 임시 HP 5(대성공 시 10)를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.eJyyBqrXLOE4R9JI]{효과: 알도리 검의 군주 (임시 HP)}

특수 이 피트와 @link[feats.swordlord-exile]을 동시에 선택할 수 없습니다.

name: Megaton Strike

description.value:
You activate gears, explosives, and other hidden mechanisms in your innovation to make a powerful attack. You make a Strike, dealing an extra die of weapon damage. If you're at least 10th level, increase this to two extra dice, and if you're at least 18th level, increase it to three extra dice. The type of Strike you can make depends on your innovation.

  • Armor You Strike with a melee unarmed attack or a melee weapon. To use a melee weapon for this, you must have prepared it in advance with special contraptions when you make your daily preparations.
  • Construct Your minion innovation Strikes.
  • Weapon You Strike with your weapon innovation.

Unstable Function You put even more force into the Strike, though you risk stress fractures to your innovation. Add the unstable trait to Megaton Strike. The Strike deals another extra damage die, for a total of two extra dice at 4th level, three at 10th level, and four at 18th level.

Special If your innovation is a minion, it can take this action rather than you.

_desc_en:
You activate gears, explosives, and other hidden mechanisms in your innovation to make a powerful attack. You make a Strike, dealing an extra die of weapon damage. If you're at least 10th level, increase this to two extra dice, and if you're at least 18th level, increase it to three extra dice. The type of Strike you can make depends on your innovation.

  • Armor You Strike with a melee unarmed attack or a melee weapon. To use a melee weapon for this, you must have prepared it in advance with special contraptions when you make your daily preparations.
  • Construct Your minion innovation Strikes.
  • Weapon You Strike with your weapon innovation.

Unstable Function You put even more force into the Strike, though you risk stress fractures to your innovation. Add the unstable trait to Megaton Strike. The Strike deals another extra damage die, for a total of two extra dice at 4th level, three at 10th level, and four at 18th level.

Special If your innovation is a minion, it can take this action rather than you.
_desc_ko:
당신은 혁신 장치 내의 기어, 폭발물 및 기타 숨겨진 메커니즘을 작동시켜 강력한 공격을 가합니다. 공격을 수행하며 무기 피해에 추가 주사위 하나를 더합니다. 10레벨 이상일 경우 추가 주사위를 두 개로, 18레벨 이상일 경우 세 개로 증가시킵니다. 사용 가능한 타격 유형은 혁신 장치에 따라 달라집니다.

  • 방어구 근접 무기 비무장 공격 또는 근접 무기로 강타합니다. 이를 위해 근접 무기를 사용하려면 일일 준비 시 특수 장치로 미리 준비해야 합니다.
  • 구축체 당신의 하수인 혁신이 공격합니다.
  • 무기 무기 혁신으로 공격한다.

불안정한 기능 혁신에 스트레스 균열 위험을 감수하며 공격에 더 큰 힘을 실어준다. 메가톤 타격에 불안정 특성을 추가한다. 타격은 추가 피해 주사위 하나를 더 입히며, (4th)레벨에서는 총 두 개, (10th)레벨에서는 세 개, 18레벨에서는 네 개의 추가 주사위를 사용한다.

특수 혁신이 하수인인 경우, 본인이 아닌 하수인이 이 행동을 수행할 수 있습니다.

name: Pyrophilic Recovery

description.value: You rely on fire and extreme heat to sprout and regrow. Whenever you take fire damage, at the beginning of your next turn, you regain Hit Points equal to half your character level (minimum 1). The total number of Hit Points you recover in this way, including any adjustments that increase the effects of healing, can't exceed half the Hit Points you lost from the fire damage you took. For example, if an effect deals 15 fire Damage and you have fire resistance 5, you would take 10 fire Damage and Pyrophilic Recovery could recover at most 5 Hit Points, regardless of any other effects that increase healing. If you take fire damage more than once before your next turn, the Hit Points recovered from Pyrophilic Recovery are cumulative, though still no more than half the fire damage taken each time.

_desc_en: You rely on fire and extreme heat to sprout and regrow. Whenever you take fire damage, at the beginning of your next turn, you regain Hit Points equal to half your character level (minimum 1). The total number of Hit Points you recover in this way, including any adjustments that increase the effects of healing, can't exceed half the Hit Points you lost from the fire damage you took. For example, if an effect deals 15 fire Damage and you have fire resistance 5, you would take 10 fire Damage and Pyrophilic Recovery could recover at most 5 Hit Points, regardless of any other effects that increase healing. If you take fire damage more than once before your next turn, the Hit Points recovered from Pyrophilic Recovery are cumulative, though still no more than half the fire damage taken each time.
_desc_ko: 당신은 불꽃과 극한의 열기를 통해 싹을 틔우고 재성장합니다. 화염 피해를 입을 때마다, 다음 턴 시작 시 캐릭터 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 HP를 회복합니다(최소 1). 이 방법으로 회복하는 총 HP는 치유 효과를 증가시키는 모든 조정치를 포함하더라도, 받은 화염 피해로 잃은 HP의 절반을 초과할 수 없습니다. 예를 들어, 효과가 15 화염 피해를 주고 화염 저항력이 5라면, 10 화염 피해를 입게 되며 화염 친화적 회복은 치유를 증가시키는 다른 효과와 무관하게 최대 5 HP만 회복할 수 있습니다. 다음 턴 전에 화염 피해를 여러 번 입었을 경우, 화염 친화 회복으로 회복되는 HP는 누적되지만, 여전히 각 피해 시 입은 화염 피해의 절반을 초과할 수 없습니다.

name: Lore Seeker

description.value: You see what others don't, and you've developed magical tricks to find hidden truth. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vTQvfYu2llKQedmY]{Translate}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Et8RSCLx8w7uOLvo]{Sound Body}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen} as innate spells, each once per day. If you could already cast spells, these spells are of the same tradition. Otherwise, they are arcane spells, you use Intelligence as your spellcasting ability, and you become trained in spell attack rolls and spell DCs for arcane spells.

_desc_en: You see what others don't, and you've developed magical tricks to find hidden truth. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vTQvfYu2llKQedmY]{Translate}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Et8RSCLx8w7uOLvo]{Sound Body}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen} as innate spells, each once per day. If you could already cast spells, these spells are of the same tradition. Otherwise, they are arcane spells, you use Intelligence as your spellcasting ability, and you become trained in spell attack rolls and spell DCs for arcane spells.
_desc_ko: 당신은 다른 이들이 보지 못하는 것을 보며, 숨겨진 진실을 찾아내는 마법적 기술을 개발했습니다. @link[spells.translate], @link[spells.sound-body], 그리고 @link[spells.see-the-unseen]를 선천적 주문으로 하루에 한 번씩 시전할 수 있습니다. 이미 주문을 시전할 수 있었다면, 이 주문들은 동일한 전통에 속합니다. 그렇지 않다면, 이들은 아케인 주문이며, 지능을 주문 시전 능력치로 사용하며, 아케인 주문의 명중 굴림과 명중 굴림(DC)에 숙련됩니다.

name: Far Lobber

description.value: You've learned how to throw a longer distance. When you throw an alchemical bomb, it has a range increment of 30 feet instead of the usual 20 feet.

_desc_en: You've learned how to throw a longer distance. When you throw an alchemical bomb, it has a range increment of 30 feet instead of the usual 20 feet.
_desc_ko: 더 먼 거리를 던지는 법을 익혔습니다. 연금술 폭탄을 던질 때, 일반적인 20피트 대신 30피트 사거리 증가량을 가집니다.

name: Agile Grace

description.value: Your graceful moves with agile weapons are beyond compare. Your multiple attack penalty with agile weapons and agile unarmed attacks becomes –3 for your second attack and –6 for subsequent attacks (rather than –4 and –8).

_desc_en: Your graceful moves with agile weapons are beyond compare. Your multiple attack penalty with agile weapons and agile unarmed attacks becomes –3 for your second attack and –6 for subsequent attacks (rather than –4 and –8).
_desc_ko: 기민한 무기로 펼치는 우아한 움직임은 비교할 수 없을 정도로 뛰어납니다. 기민한 무기 및 기민한 비무장 공격 시 다중 공격 페널티가 두 번째 공격은 -3, 이후 공격은 -6이 됩니다(기존 -4 및 -8 대신).

name: Death Dive

description.value:
Requirements You are riding your dragon companion and are airborne.

You guide your mount into a plummet, diving headlong at a single foe. You command your mount to Fly twice. It must end this movement at a lower altitude than it began its turn at. You and your mount gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against reactions triggered by this movement. At the end of this movement, your mount attempts a melee Strike against one creature in its reach. If the Strike hits, the target is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} if it's smaller than your mount; if it's a critical hit, the target is knocked prone if it's the same size as your mount or smaller.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are riding your dragon companion and are airborne.

You guide your mount into a plummet, diving headlong at a single foe. You command your mount to Fly twice. It must end this movement at a lower altitude than it began its turn at. You and your mount gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against reactions triggered by this movement. At the end of this movement, your mount attempts a melee Strike against one creature in its reach. If the Strike hits, the target is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} if it's smaller than your mount; if it's a critical hit, the target is knocked prone if it's the same size as your mount or smaller.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 당신은 당신의 용 동료를 타고 있으며 공중에 있습니다.

당신은 탈것을 급강하로 이끌어, 단일 적을 향해 머리부터 내리꽂습니다. 당신은 탈것에게 두 번 비행하라고 명령합니다. 탈것은 이 이동을 자신의 턴을 시작한 고도보다 더 낮은 고도에서 끝내야 합니다. 당신과 당신의 탈것은 이 이동으로 발동된 반응에 대한 AC에 +4 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 이동이 끝날 때, 당신의 탈것은 자신의 도달 범위 내의 생물 하나에게 근접 타격을 시도합니다. 타격이 명중하면, 대상이 당신의 탈것보다 작을 경우 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{넘어짐} 상태가 됩니다. 대성공이라면, 대상이 당신의 탈것과 같은 크기이거나 더 작을 경우 넘어짐 상태가 됩니다.

name: Spark Fist

description.value:
Access You are from Dongun Hold or Alkenstar.

Frequency once per minute

You dust explosive black powder on your fist or glove before attacking, which combusts as you hit an opponent. The resulting pops of flame harm both you and your enemy. Until the end of your next turn, your fist loses the nonlethal trait and deals an additional 1 fire damage on a successful Strike. Each time you succeed on a fist Strike, you take 1 fire damage. If your fist would deal more than one weapon damage die, the fire damage dealt on a successful Strike, to both you and your opponent, is equal to the number of weapon damage dice.

_desc_en:
Access You are from Dongun Hold or Alkenstar.

Frequency once per minute

You dust explosive black powder on your fist or glove before attacking, which combusts as you hit an opponent. The resulting pops of flame harm both you and your enemy. Until the end of your next turn, your fist loses the nonlethal trait and deals an additional 1 fire damage on a successful Strike. Each time you succeed on a fist Strike, you take 1 fire damage. If your fist would deal more than one weapon damage die, the fire damage dealt on a successful Strike, to both you and your opponent, is equal to the number of weapon damage dice.
_desc_ko:
접근 귀하는 동군 홀드 또는 알켄스터 출신입니다.

발동 빈도 분당 1회

공격 전 주먹이나 장갑에 폭발성 흑색 화약을 뿌리면, 적을 타격할 때 발화합니다. 발생한 화염 폭발은 당신과 적 모두에게 피해를 줍니다. 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 당신의 주먹은 비살상 특성을 잃고, 공격 성공 시 추가로 화염 피해 1을 입힙니다. 주먹 공격에 성공할 때마다 당신은 화염 피해 1을 받습니다. 주먹이 무기 피해 주사위 하나 이상을 입힐 경우, 공격 성공 시 당신과 상대방 모두에게 입히는 화염 피해는 무기 피해 주사위 개수와 동일합니다.

name: Nocturnal Tripkee

description.value:
You tend to do most of your hunting and work at night and have adapted to the requirements of nocturnal life. You gain darkvision, allowing you to see in darkness and dim light just as well as you can in bright light. However, in darkness, you see in black-and-white only.

Special You can take this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain out of this feat or into this feat.

_desc_en:
You tend to do most of your hunting and work at night and have adapted to the requirements of nocturnal life. You gain darkvision, allowing you to see in darkness and dim light just as well as you can in bright light. However, in darkness, you see in black-and-white only.

Special You can take this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain out of this feat or into this feat.
_desc_ko:
당신은 주로 밤에 사냥과 일을 하며 야행성 생활에 적응했습니다. 암흑 시야를 얻어 어둠과 희미한 빛 속에서도 밝은 빛 아래와 똑같이 잘 볼 수 있습니다. 그러나 완전한 어둠 속에서는 흑백으로만 볼 수 있습니다.

특수 이 피트는 1레벨에만 선택할 수 있으며, 재훈련으로 이 피트를 포기하거나 다시 선택할 수 없습니다.

name: Familiar's Resolve

description.value: When you weave magic, your familiar traces symbols that throw off fear and doubt. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell, you or an ally within 30 feet gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against effects that would cause you to be doomed or frightened for 1 round. At 14th level, you or an ally gain a +3 status bonus to saving throws against these effects instead.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: When you weave magic, your familiar traces symbols that throw off fear and doubt. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell, you or an ally within 30 feet gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against effects that would cause you to be doomed or frightened for 1 round. At 14th level, you or an ally gain a +3 status bonus to saving throws against these effects instead.
_desc_ko: 당신이 마법을 엮을 때, 당신의 패밀리어가 공포와 의심을 떨쳐내는 상징을 새깁니다. 다음 행동으로 주문을 시전할 경우, 당신이나 30피트 내의 아군은 1라운드 동안 {파멸 상태나 공포 상태에 빠지게 하는 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 14레벨에 도달하면, 당신이나 아군이 이러한 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 +3 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Rushing Goat Stance

description.value:
Requirements You're unarmored.

You enter the stance of an unruly goat, lowering your body and preparing to butt heads with your foes. The only Strikes you can make are ramming horn attacks. These strikes deal 1d8 bludgeoning damage, are in the brawling group, and have the forceful, nonlethal, shove, and unarmed traits. When you make a ramming horn attack and your previous action was to Climb, Stride, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, you gain a circumstance bonus to damage equal to the number of weapon damage dice. You can make ramming horn Strikes while Climbing even if you don't have a free hand.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Requirements You're unarmored.

You enter the stance of an unruly goat, lowering your body and preparing to butt heads with your foes. The only Strikes you can make are ramming horn attacks. These strikes deal 1d8 bludgeoning damage, are in the brawling group, and have the forceful, nonlethal, shove, and unarmed traits. When you make a ramming horn attack and your previous action was to Climb, Stride, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, you gain a circumstance bonus to damage equal to the number of weapon damage dice. You can make ramming horn Strikes while Climbing even if you don't have a free hand.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 갑옷을 착용하지 않아야 한다.

당신은 제멋대로인 염소의 자세를 취하며 몸을 낮추고 적과 머리를 부딪칠 준비를 합니다. 수행할 수 있는 공격은 뿔로 들이받는 공격뿐입니다. 이 공격은 1d8 타격을 입히며, 난투 그룹에 속하고, 다음과 같은 특성을 가집니다: 공격 유형, 기세, 비살상, 밀치기, 무장하지 않음. 뿔로 들이받기 공격을 수행할 때, 이전 행동이 등반, 이동, 또는 @link[actions.leap]이었다면 무기 피해 주사위 수만큼의 상황 보너스를 피해에 얻는다. 빈 손이 없더라도 등반 중에도 뿔로 들이받기 공격을 할 수 있다.

name: Ley Line Conduit

description.value:
Frequency once per minute

You can draw magic from the ley lines of the world. If your next action is to Cast a Spell of 5th rank or lower that has no duration, you don't expend the prepared spell as you cast it.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per minute

You can draw magic from the ley lines of the world. If your next action is to Cast a Spell of 5th rank or lower that has no duration, you don't expend the prepared spell as you cast it.
_desc_ko:
빈도 분당 1회

세계의 레이 라인에서 마법을 끌어낼 수 있습니다. 다음 행동이 지속 시간이 없는 5th 랭크 이하의 주문을 시전하는 것이라면, 시전 시 준비된 주문을 소모하지 않습니다.

name: Wild Lights

description.value: When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light}, you can modify its duration to be 1 minute and modify its standard effects to create a single floating light in the shape of a Tiny creature, instead of up to four floating lights. The creature hovers over your head unless you spend a single action that has the concentrate trait to direct the light to move up to 30 feet, in which case it remains there until you direct it again. If you direct it back to your head, it hovers there and follows you again until you direct it elsewhere. If the light ever moves beyond 120 feet of you, it winks out immediately.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en: When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light}, you can modify its duration to be 1 minute and modify its standard effects to create a single floating light in the shape of a Tiny creature, instead of up to four floating lights. The creature hovers over your head unless you spend a single action that has the concentrate trait to direct the light to move up to 30 feet, in which case it remains there until you direct it again. If you direct it back to your head, it hovers there and follows you again until you direct it elsewhere. If the light ever moves beyond 120 feet of you, it winks out immediately.
_desc_ko: {빛} 주문을 시전할 때, 지속 시간을 1분으로 수정하고 표준 효과를 수정하여 최대 4개의 떠다니는 빛 대신 작은 크기의 생물 모양을 한 단일 떠다니는 빛을 생성할 수 있습니다. 이 생물은 당신의 머리 위에 떠 있다. 집중 특성을 가진 액션 하나를 소비하여 빛을 최대 30피트까지 이동시키도록 지시할 수 있으며, 이 경우 다시 지시할 때까지 그 자리에 머문다. 머리 위로 다시 지시하면 그곳에 떠 있으며, 다른 곳으로 지시할 때까지 당신을 따라다닌다. 빛이 당신으로부터 120피트 이상 떨어지면 즉시 꺼진다.

name: Distracting Shot

description.value: The sheer power of your attacks, or the overwhelming number of them, leaves an enemy flustered. If you critically hit your hunted prey with a ranged weapon, or hit it at least twice on the same turn with a ranged weapon, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn.

_desc_en: The sheer power of your attacks, or the overwhelming number of them, leaves an enemy flustered. If you critically hit your hunted prey with a ranged weapon, or hit it at least twice on the same turn with a ranged weapon, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn.
_desc_ko: 당신의 공격이 지닌 엄청난 위력이나 압도적인 공격 횟수로 인해 적을 당황하게 만듭니다. 원거리 무기로 사냥감을 치명타로 명중시키거나, 같은 턴에 원거리 무기로 적어도 두 번 명중시키면, 다음 턴 시작까지 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Endemic Herbs

description.value:
The herbal items you create use medicinal plants endemic to your location. When a creature consumes one of your herbal items, that creature gains the benefit matching the location where you created that item. If the benefit is not immediate, it lasts for 1 minute unless otherwise stated.

  • Aquatic Gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves.
  • Arctic For 1 hour, treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less severe.
  • Desert For 1 hour, treat environmental heat effects as if they were one step less severe.
  • Forest Gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against disease and poison effects.
  • Mountain Gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves.
  • Plains Gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves.
  • Swamp Remove one source of persistent bleed damage.
  • Underground Gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.NviQYIVZbPCSWLqT]{Effect: Endemic Herbs}

_desc_en:
The herbal items you create use medicinal plants endemic to your location. When a creature consumes one of your herbal items, that creature gains the benefit matching the location where you created that item. If the benefit is not immediate, it lasts for 1 minute unless otherwise stated.

  • Aquatic Gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves.
  • Arctic For 1 hour, treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less severe.
  • Desert For 1 hour, treat environmental heat effects as if they were one step less severe.
  • Forest Gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against disease and poison effects.
  • Mountain Gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves.
  • Plains Gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves.
  • Swamp Remove one source of persistent bleed damage.
  • Underground Gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.NviQYIVZbPCSWLqT]{Effect: Endemic Herbs}
_desc_ko:
당신이 만드는 약초 아이템은 해당 지역에 자생하는 약용 식물을 사용합니다. 생물이 당신의 약초 아이템을 섭취하면, 그 생물은 해당 아이템을 제작한 지역과 일치하는 이점을 얻습니다. 이점이 즉시 적용되지 않는 경우, 별도 명시되지 않는 한 1분 동안 지속됩니다.

  • 수중 인내 내성에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.
  • 북극 1시간 동안 환경적 냉기 효과를 한 단계 덜 심한 것으로 간주합니다.
  • 사막 1시간 동안 환경적 열 효과는 한 단계 덜 심한 것으로 간주한다.
  • 숲 질병 및 독 효과에 대한 내성에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.
  • 산악 반사 내성에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.
  • 평원 의지 내성에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.
  • 늪 지속 출혈 피해 원천 하나를 제거한다.
  • 지하 지각 능력에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.NviQYIVZbPCSWLqT]{효과: 토착 약초}

name: Waxed Feathers

description.value: Your feathers are coated in a waxy substance that repels water. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects that have the water trait. So long as you're in a dry place, you can spend one action to shake off any water that clings to your clothing and feathers to instantly become dry.

_desc_en: Your feathers are coated in a waxy substance that repels water. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects that have the water trait. So long as you're in a dry place, you can spend one action to shake off any water that clings to your clothing and feathers to instantly become dry.
_desc_ko: 당신의 깃털은 물을 밀어내는 왁스 같은 물질로 코팅되어 있습니다. 물 속성을 가진 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 건조한 장소에 있는 한, 한 번의 행동을 소비하여 옷과 깃털에 달라붙은 물을 털어내 즉시 건조해질 수 있습니다.

name: Greater than the Sum

description.value: You call upon the familial bonds you share with your allies and other ratfolk to become an overwhelming force in battle. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge} as a 6th-rank primal innate spell once per day.

_desc_en: You call upon the familial bonds you share with your allies and other ratfolk to become an overwhelming force in battle. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge} as a 6th-rank primal innate spell once per day.
_desc_ko: 동료 및 다른 랫포크와 공유하는 혈연의 유대를 불러일으켜 전투에서 압도적인 힘이 된다. 하루에 한 번, (6th)랭크 프라이멀 선천 마법인 @link[spells.enlarge]를 시전할 수 있다.

name: Mineral Deposits

description.value: Precious metals from your bloodstream line your claws, jaws, or the tip of your tail, and you're able call upon your blood to surge and empower your attacks. Choose cold iron or silver and a claw, jaws, or tail unarmed attack that you have. Until the end of your turn, your Strikes with the chosen unarmed attack count as being made of the chosen metal. At 17th level, you can choose adamantine.

_desc_en: Precious metals from your bloodstream line your claws, jaws, or the tip of your tail, and you're able call upon your blood to surge and empower your attacks. Choose cold iron or silver and a claw, jaws, or tail unarmed attack that you have. Until the end of your turn, your Strikes with the chosen unarmed attack count as being made of the chosen metal. At 17th level, you can choose adamantine.
_desc_ko: 당신의 혈류에서 나온 귀금속이 발톱, 턱, 또는 꼬리 끝을 감싸며, 당신은 피를 끓어오르게 하여 공격을 강화할 수 있습니다. 냉철이나 은을 선택하고, 당신이 가진 발톱, 턱, 또는 꼬리 비무장 공격 하나를 선택하십시오. 당신의 턴이 끝날 때까지, 선택한 비무장 공격으로 하는 타격은 선택한 금속으로 만들어진 것으로 간주됩니다. 17레벨에는 아다만틴을 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Armor Proficiency

description.value:
You become trained in light armor. If you already were trained in light armor, you gain training in medium armor. If you were trained in both, you become trained in heavy armor. If you are at least 13th level, you become an expert in this armor type.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time, you become trained in the next type of armor, as detailed above.

_desc_en:
You become trained in light armor. If you already were trained in light armor, you gain training in medium armor. If you were trained in both, you become trained in heavy armor. If you are at least 13th level, you become an expert in this armor type.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time, you become trained in the next type of armor, as detailed above.
_desc_ko:
당신은 경갑 숙련을 얻습니다. 이미 경갑 숙련을 가진 경우 평갑 숙련을 얻습니다. 둘 다 숙련된 경우 평갑 숙련을 얻습니다. 13레벨 이상인 경우 해당 갑옷 유형의 전문가가 됩니다.

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 매번 선택할 때마다 위에서 설명한 대로 다음 유형의 갑옷에 숙련됩니다.

name: Snare Expert

description.value: Your knowledge of traps aids you in defending your hideout. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.DMetdzt1VJL2Y62i]{Snare Crafting} feat. When you set a snare, any saving throw it requires uses the higher of your class DC or the snare's DC. Snares you set within your favored location increase their Stealth DC by 2.

_desc_en: Your knowledge of traps aids you in defending your hideout. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.DMetdzt1VJL2Y62i]{Snare Crafting} feat. When you set a snare, any saving throw it requires uses the higher of your class DC or the snare's DC. Snares you set within your favored location increase their Stealth DC by 2.
_desc_ko: 함정에 대한 지식이 은신처 방어에 도움이 됩니다. @link[feats.snare-crafting] 피트를 획득합니다. 덫을 설치할 때, 해당 덫이 요구하는 내성 굴림에는 클래스 피트(DC)와 덫의 피트 중 높은 쪽이 적용됩니다. 선호 위치 내에서 설치한 덫은 은신 피트가 2 증가합니다.

name: Astral Blink

description.value:
You've attuned your core to allow you to phase in and out of the Astral Plane, allowing you to teleport periodically. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Translocate} once per hour as a 4th-rank innate arcane spell.

Enhancement Your attunement allows you to teleport in a series of quick jumps rather than in one big leap. You can expend your hourly use of translocate as a free action when you begin your turn. If you do, your Strides are augmented until the end of your turn, allowing you to instantly teleport to any point you could reach with your Speed instead of traversing normally to the location. While augmented, your Strides gain the teleportation trait. Your augmented Strides don't trigger reactions that can be triggered by move actions or upon leaving or entering a square, unless those reactions trigger on teleportation.

_desc_en:
You've attuned your core to allow you to phase in and out of the Astral Plane, allowing you to teleport periodically. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Translocate} once per hour as a 4th-rank innate arcane spell.

Enhancement Your attunement allows you to teleport in a series of quick jumps rather than in one big leap. You can expend your hourly use of translocate as a free action when you begin your turn. If you do, your Strides are augmented until the end of your turn, allowing you to instantly teleport to any point you could reach with your Speed instead of traversing normally to the location. While augmented, your Strides gain the teleportation trait. Your augmented Strides don't trigger reactions that can be triggered by move actions or upon leaving or entering a square, unless those reactions trigger on teleportation.
_desc_ko:
당신은 아스트랄계로 들어가고 나올 수 있도록 핵심을 조율하여 주기적으로 순간이동할 수 있게 되었습니다. 시간당 한 번씩 @link[spells.translocate]을 (4th)랭크 선천적 아케인 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

강화 당신의 조율로 인해 한 번에 큰 도약 대신 일련의 빠른 점프를 통해 순간이동할 수 있습니다. 턴 시작 시 무료 행동으로 시간당 사용 가능한 순간이동 횟수를 소모할 수 있습니다. 그렇게 하면, 당신의 이동이 턴 종료 시까지 강화되어, 해당 위치까지 정상적으로 이동하는 대신 당신의 이동 속도로 도달 가능한 지점으로 즉시 순간이동할 수 있습니다. 강화된 동안, 당신의 이동은 순간이동 특성을 얻습니다. 강화된 이동은 이동 행동이나 칸을 떠나거나 들어갈 때 발동되는 반응을 유발하지 않습니다. 단, 해당 반응이 순간이동에 의해 발동되는 경우는 예외입니다.

name: Elemental Fist

description.value: You can color your qi in bright elemental energy. When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZL8NTvB22NeEWhVG]{Inner Upheaval}, in addition to the damage types normally available, you can deliver the extra damage with elemental magic, adding the element's trait and changing the damage type to the listed one: air electricity (sparking gust), earth bludgeoning (chunk of stone), fire fire (flickering flame), metal slashing (flying metal shards), water cold (wave of frigid water), or wood bludgeoning (pummeling pine cones).

_desc_en: You can color your qi in bright elemental energy. When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZL8NTvB22NeEWhVG]{Inner Upheaval}, in addition to the damage types normally available, you can deliver the extra damage with elemental magic, adding the element's trait and changing the damage type to the listed one: air electricity (sparking gust), earth bludgeoning (chunk of stone), fire fire (flickering flame), metal slashing (flying metal shards), water cold (wave of frigid water), or wood bludgeoning (pummeling pine cones).
_desc_ko: 기운을 선명한 원소 에너지로 물들일 수 있다. @link[spells.inner-upheaval]을 시전할 때, 일반적으로 사용 가능한 피해 유형 외에도 원소 마법으로 추가 피해를 입힐 수 있으며, 이때 해당 원소의 특성을 부여하고 피해 유형을 아래 표기된 것으로 변경한다: 공기 전기 (불꽃이 튀는 돌풍), 땅 타격 (돌덩이), 불 화염 (흔들리는 불꽃), 금속 베기 (날아다니는 금속 파편), 물 냉기 (얼음물 파도), 또는 나무 타격 (소나무 솔방울로 내리치는).

name: Wilderness Spotter

description.value:
Select one type of terrain from the following list: aquatic, arctic, desert, forest, mountain, plains, sky, swamp, or underground. You can use Survival in place of Perception to roll initiative when in the selected terrain in a natural location (not a structure) even if you weren't tracking or otherwise using Survival before the encounter. You can also use Survival instead of Perception to notice traps in natural locations in the chosen terrain; if you find a snare in this way, you can also use Survival instead of Thievery to Disable the Device.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, the feat applies to a new type of terrain.

publication.title: Pathfinder Adventure: The Fall of Plaguestone

_desc_en:
Select one type of terrain from the following list: aquatic, arctic, desert, forest, mountain, plains, sky, swamp, or underground. You can use Survival in place of Perception to roll initiative when in the selected terrain in a natural location (not a structure) even if you weren't tracking or otherwise using Survival before the encounter. You can also use Survival instead of Perception to notice traps in natural locations in the chosen terrain; if you find a snare in this way, you can also use Survival instead of Thievery to Disable the Device.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, the feat applies to a new type of terrain.
_desc_ko:
다음 목록에서 지형 유형 하나를 선택하십시오: 수중, 북극, 사막, 숲, 산악, 평원, 하늘, 습지, 지하. 선택한 지형의 자연 지형(구조물이 아닌)에 있을 때, 전투 전까지 추적이나 생존 기술을 사용하지 않았더라도, 인니셔티브 굴림 시 지각 대신 생존 기술을 사용할 수 있습니다. 또한 선택한 지형의 자연 지형에서 함정을 발견할 때 지각 대신 생존 기술을 사용할 수 있습니다. 이 방법으로 올가미를 발견한 경우, 도둑질 대신 생존 기술을 사용하여 장치를 해제할 수도 있습니다.

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 선택할 때마다 새로운 지형 유형에 적용됩니다.

name: Emphatic Emissary

description.value:
Trigger You roll initiative.

You can tell when diplomacy has failed and a meeting is close to unraveling or falling to blows. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your initiative roll. During your first turn in combat, you can use your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ZGgFrQAQWk0keaFW]{Disarming Smile}, targeting every hostile intelligent humanoid creature that can see you but has yet to act. If you choose to sustain your Disarming Smile, you sustain the effect for only one creature, as normal.

_desc_en:
Trigger You roll initiative.

You can tell when diplomacy has failed and a meeting is close to unraveling or falling to blows. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your initiative roll. During your first turn in combat, you can use your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ZGgFrQAQWk0keaFW]{Disarming Smile}, targeting every hostile intelligent humanoid creature that can see you but has yet to act. If you choose to sustain your Disarming Smile, you sustain the effect for only one creature, as normal.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 이니셔티브 주사위를 굴립니다.

외교가 실패하고 회담이 무너지거나 싸움으로 번질 위기에 처했음을 감지할 수 있습니다. 이니셔티브 주사위에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 전투 중 첫 턴에, 당신은 @link[feats.disarming-smile]를 사용할 수 있습니다. 이 기술은 당신을 볼 수 있지만 아직 행동하지 않은 모든 적대적인 지능형 인간형 생물을 대상으로 합니다. 무장 해제하는 미소를 지속하기로 선택하면, 평소처럼 단 하나의 생물에게만 효과를 유지합니다.

name: Opportunistic Grapple

description.value:
Trigger Your prey critically fails on an attack roll against you with a melee Strike.

Requirements Your prey is within your reach, you have one free hand, and your target is no more than one size larger than you.

You use an opening to capture your prey. You attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} your prey.

_desc_en:
Trigger Your prey critically fails on an attack roll against you with a melee Strike.

Requirements Your prey is within your reach, you have one free hand, and your target is no more than one size larger than you.

You use an opening to capture your prey. You attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} your prey.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신의 먹잇감이 근접 공격으로 당신을 상대로 한 명중 굴림에서 대실패합니다.

요건 사냥감이 당신의 손이 닿는 범위 내에 있고, 한 손이 자유로우며, 대상의 크기가 당신보다 한 단계 이상 크지 않아야 합니다.

기회를 노려 사냥감을 붙잡습니다. 운동 판정을 시도하여 @link[actions.grapple]으로 사냥감을 제압합니다.

name: Pactbound Dedication

description.value:
You befriended one of the last saumen kar and were infused with a fraction of their power, granting you the potential to become a guardian of their ancient pact. You gain cold resistance equal to half your level. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} while it's snowing even lightly, even if it wouldn't be thick enough to normally grant concealment. Finally, all saumen kar can sense the mark of their pact upon you, and their attitude toward you is typically one step better than it would be otherwise (hostile to unfriendly, unfriendly to indifferent, etc.) Most saumen kar are unfriendly to outsiders; this would make them indifferent to you.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.YODf1eNWi9jnR93y]{Pactbound Initiate}

value.value: must have earned the trust of a saumen kar who initiates you into the archetype

Finally, all saumen kar can sense the mark of their pact upon you, and their attitude toward you is typically one step better than it would be otherwise (hostile to unfriendly, unfriendly to indifferent, etc.) Most saumen kar are unfriendly to outsiders; this would make them indifferent to you.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.YODf1eNWi9jnR93y]{Pactbound Initiate}
_desc_ko: 마지막 사우멘 카르 중 한 명과 우정을 쌓아 그들의 힘 일부를 흡수했으며, 이로 인해 그들의 고대 협정의 가디언이 될 잠재력을 얻었습니다. 당신은 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 냉기 저항력을 얻습니다. 눈이 살짝 내리는 상황에서도 @link[actions.hide]와 @link[actions.sneak]이 가능하며, 이는 일반적으로 은폐 효과를 부여하기에 충분하지 않은 눈량일 때도 마찬가지입니다. 마지막으로, 모든 사우멘 카르는 당신에게 새겨진 그들의 계약의 흔적을 감지할 수 있으며, 당신에 대한 그들의 태도는 일반적으로 평소보다 한 단계 나아집니다(적대적에서 우호적, 우호적에서 중립 등). 대부분의 사우멘 카르는 외부인에게 우호적이지 않습니다. 이 능력은 그들이 당신에게 중립적인 태도를 보이게 합니다.

name: Reach Spell

description.value: You can extend your spells' range. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has a range, increase that spell's range by 30 feet. As is standard for increasing spell ranges, if the spell normally has a range of touch, you extend its range to 30 feet.

_desc_en: You can extend your spells' range. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has a range, increase that spell's range by 30 feet. As is standard for increasing spell ranges, if the spell normally has a range of touch, you extend its range to 30 feet.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신의 주문 사거리를 확장할 수 있습니다. 다음에 사용하는 행동이 사거리가 있는 주문을 시전하는 것이라면, 해당 주문의 사거리를 30피트 증가시킵니다. 주문 사거리 증가의 표준 규칙에 따라, 해당 주문이 원래 접촉 사거리인 경우 사거리를 30피트로 확장합니다.

name: Ambush Bladderwort

description.value:
You plant the seed of a giant bladderwort in an unoccupied square of ground or water within 30 feet. It lasts for 10 minutes. Using this impulse again ends any previous one. If a creature enters its square, the seed erupts into a voluminous, translucent plant that seals tight around the triggering creature and fills with water. Unless the creature succeeds at a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist] save against your class DC, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} within the bladderwort and must hold its breath or begin drowning. The @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} DC is also your class DC. The plant has AC 10 and 50 Hit Points.

If a creature dies inside it, the plant shrinks down, converting itself and the remains into a watery fruit. A creature can eat this consumable to regain @Damage[((floor((max(4,@actor.level)-4)/4)+1)d8+(floor((max(4,@actor.level)-4)/4)*4+4))[healing]] HP, after which that creature is temporarily immune for 10 minutes. This fruit rots after 1 hour.

Level (+4) The bladderwort's HP increase by 25 and the fruit's healing increases by 1d8+4.

_desc_en:
You plant the seed of a giant bladderwort in an unoccupied square of ground or water within 30 feet. It lasts for 10 minutes. Using this impulse again ends any previous one. If a creature enters its square, the seed erupts into a voluminous, translucent plant that seals tight around the triggering creature and fills with water. Unless the creature succeeds at a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist] save against your class DC, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} within the bladderwort and must hold its breath or begin drowning. The @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} DC is also your class DC. The plant has AC 10 and 50 Hit Points.

If a creature dies inside it, the plant shrinks down, converting itself and the remains into a watery fruit. A creature can eat this consumable to regain @Damage[((floor((max(4,@actor.level)-4)/4)+1)d8+(floor((max(4,@actor.level)-4)/4)*4+4))[healing]] HP, after which that creature is temporarily immune for 10 minutes. This fruit rots after 1 hour.

Level (+4) The bladderwort's HP increase by 25 and the fruit's healing increases by 1d8+4.
_desc_ko:
30피트 이내의 비어 있는 땅이나 물 위에 거대 방울풀 씨앗을 심습니다. 효과는 10분간 지속됩니다. 이 임펄스를 다시 사용하면 이전 효과는 모두 종료됩니다. 생물이 그 칸에 들어서면 씨앗이 부풀어 오르는 투명한 식물로 변하며, 발동시킨 생물을 꽉 조여 물을 채운다. 해당 생물이 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 반사 내성에 성공하지 못하면, @link[conditions.immobilized] 되어 물풀 속에 갇히며 숨을 참지 않으면 익사하기 시작한다. @link[actions.escape] DC 역시 당신의 클래스 DC와 동일합니다. 이 식물의 AC는 10이며 HP는 50입니다.

생물이 그 안에서 죽으면 식물은 수축하며, 자신과 시체를 물기 가득한 열매로 변환한다. 생물은 이 소모품을 먹어 회복 HP를 회복할 수 있으며, 이후 10분 동안 일시적으로 면역 상태가 된다. 이 열매는 1시간 후에 썩습니다.

레벨 (+4) 물풀의 HP가 25 증가하고 열매의 치유량이 1d8+4 증가합니다.

name: Silence the Profane

description.value:
Trigger A creature you can observe within reach of your deity's favored weapon casts a spell.

Requirements You are wielding your deity's favored weapon.

Your training included instruction on how to prevent enemy priests from using their magic against you, a technique you have mastered and adapted. Make a Strike with your deity's favored weapon against the triggering creature. On a success, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your next turn. The triggering spell is disrupted on a critical success, or on a success if the target is your hunted prey and the spell is a divine spell.

Special If your deity's favored weapon is a ranged weapon, this reaction can trigger if the target is within its first range increment and you can make a ranged Strike instead of a melee Strike.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature you can observe within reach of your deity's favored weapon casts a spell.

Requirements You are wielding your deity's favored weapon.

Your training included instruction on how to prevent enemy priests from using their magic against you, a technique you have mastered and adapted. The triggering spell is disrupted on a critical success, or on a success if the target is your hunted prey and the spell is a divine spell.

Special If your deity's favored weapon is a ranged weapon, this reaction can trigger if the target is within its first range increment and you can make a ranged Strike instead of a melee Strike.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 신이 선호하는 무기의 도달 범위 내에서 관찰 가능한 생물이 주문을 시전할 때.

요구 사항 당신은 신이 선호하는 무기를 휘두르고 있다.

당신의 훈련에는 적 사제가 당신에게 마법을 사용하는 것을 막는 방법이 포함되어 있었으며, 당신은 이 기술을 마스터하고 응용했습니다. 신이 선호하는 무기로 발동 대상 생물에게 공격을 가하십시오. 성공 시, 대상은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다. 대성공 시 발동 마법이 방해받으며, 대상이 사냥감 추적이고 마법이 신성 마법인 경우 성공 시에도 방해받습니다.

특수 당신의 신이 선호하는 무기가 원거리 무기인 경우, 대상이 그 무기의 첫 번째 사거리 내에 있고 근접 공격 대신 원거리 공격을 할 수 있을 때 이 반응이 발동할 수 있습니다.

name: Agile Maneuvers

description.value: Your easily maneuver against your foes. Your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} actions have a lower multiple attack penalty. Even if your weapon or unarmed attack doesn't have the agile trait, the penalty is –4 if the action is your second attack on your turn, or –8 if it's your third or subsequent attack. If your weapon or unarmed attack is agile and you have panache, the penalty is reduced further, to –3 if it's the second attack on your turn or –6 if it's the third or subsequent.

Your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} actions have a lower multiple attack penalty. Even if your weapon or unarmed attack doesn't have the agile trait, the penalty is –4 if the action is your second attack on your turn, or –8 if it's your third or subsequent attack. If your weapon or unarmed attack is agile and you have panache, the penalty is reduced further, to –3 if it's the second attack on your turn or –6 if it's the third or subsequent.
_desc_ko: 적에 대한 기동이 용이해집니다. @link[actions.disarm], @link[actions.grapple], @link[actions.reposition] @link[actions.shove], @link[actions.trip] 행동의 다중 공격 페널티가 낮아집니다. 무기나 비무장 공격에 기민한 특성이 없더라도, 해당 행동이 턴 내 두 번째 공격일 경우 페널티는 -4, 세 번째 이상 공격일 경우 -8입니다. 무기나 비무장 공격이 기민한 특성을 지니고 파나슈를 보유한 경우, 페널티는 추가로 감소하여 턴 내 두 번째 공격 시 -3, 세 번째 이후 공격 시 -6이 됩니다.

name: Eerie Traces

description.value:
The tracks you leave behind are strange, somehow disconcerting and unnerving—they might travel backward, or through places no one would think to pass through. You change your tracks into eerie traces, moving up to half your travel speed as you do so. You don't need to attempt a Survival check to change your tracks, but anyone tracking you must attempt a Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

Success The tracker is unaffected.

Failure The tracker becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} for as long as it follows your tracks. This condition doesn't decrease until the tracker stops following you, and it comes back if the tracker resumes following your tracks. If the tracker enters into an encounter with you after following your tracks, it begins the encounter frightened 1.

Critical Failure As failure, but your disturbing traces cause the tracker to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} instead.

_desc_en:
The tracks you leave behind are strange, somehow disconcerting and unnerving—they might travel backward, or through places no one would think to pass through. You change your tracks into eerie traces, moving up to half your travel speed as you do so. You don't need to attempt a Survival check to change your tracks, but anyone tracking you must attempt a Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

Failure The tracker becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} for as long as it follows your tracks. Critical Failure As failure, but your disturbing traces cause the tracker to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} instead.
_desc_ko:
당신이 남기는 발자국은 이상하고, 어쩐지 불안하고 소름 끼치는 느낌을 준다-뒤로 이동하거나, 아무도 지나갈 거라 생각하지 않는 곳을 통과할 수도 있다. 당신은 자신의 발자국을 섬뜩한 흔적으로 바꾸며, 그렇게 하는 동안 이동 속도의 절반까지 속도를 높인다. 발자국을 바꾸기 위해 생존 능력 판정을 시도할 필요는 없지만, 당신을 추적하는 자는 당신의 직업 DC와 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽에 대한 의지 내성을 시도해야 한다.

성공 추적자가 당신의 흔적을 따라가는 동안 @link[conditions.frightened]{1} 상태가 됩니다. 이 상태는 추적자가 당신을 따라가는 것을 멈출 때까지 감소하지 않으며, 추적자가 다시 당신의 흔적을 따라가기 시작하면 재발합니다. 추적자가 당신의 흔적을 따라간 후 당신과 조우하게 되면, 조우 시 공포 1로 시작합니다.

대실패 실패 시와 동일하나, 당신의 불안한 흔적이 추적자를 @link[conditions.frightened]{2} 상태로 만듭니다.

name: Hypnotic Lure

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Your unblinking gaze is so intense it can befuddle the mind of others, drawing your victims toward you even against their better judgment. You stare at a creature within 30 feet. The target must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure On its turn, the target must spend its first action to approach you. It can't Delay or take reactions until it has done so.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to approach you. It can't Delay or take any reactions until it has reached a space that's adjacent to you (or as close to you as possible if it reaches an impassable barrier).

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Your unblinking gaze is so intense it can befuddle the mind of others, drawing your victims toward you even against their better judgment. You stare at a creature within 30 feet. The target must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to approach you. It can't Delay or take any reactions until it has reached a space that's adjacent to you (or as close to you as possible if it reaches an impassable barrier).
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 시간당 한 번

당신의 깜빡임 없는 시선은 너무나 강렬하여 타인의 정신을 혼란스럽게 하여, 희생자들이 자신의 판단을 거스르더라도 당신에게로 이끌리게 합니다. 당신은 30피트 이내의 생물을 응시합니다. 대상은 당신의 클래스 DC와 주문 DC 중 더 높은 수치에 대해 의지 내성을 시도하다 실패해야 합니다.

성공 시 대상은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

실패 대상은 자신의 턴에 첫 번째 행동을 사용하여 당신에게 접근해야 합니다. 그렇게 하기 전까지는 지연 행동이나 반응 행동을 취할 수 없습니다.

대실패 대상은 다음 턴에 모든 행동을 사용하여 당신에게 접근해야 합니다. 당신과 인접한 공간(또는 통과 불가능한 장벽에 도달한 경우 가능한 한 가까운 위치)에 도달할 때까지 지연하거나 반응을 취할 수 없습니다.

name: Breath Unleashed

description.value: You're able to channel more of your draconic benefactor's power and focus it into your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.PPUNMjRLQYnmwQvF]{Kobold Breath}, increasing its effectiveness but requiring more time to recover. When you use Kobold Breath, you can increase the damage dice to d8s and increase the area to @Template[cone|distance:30]{30 feet for a cone} or @Template[line|distance:60]{60 feet for a line}. If you do, you can't use Kobold Breath again for 1 hour. During this time, Kobold Breath cannot be recharged using Kobold Momentum.

_desc_en: You're able to channel more of your draconic benefactor's power and focus it into your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.PPUNMjRLQYnmwQvF]{Kobold Breath}, increasing its effectiveness but requiring more time to recover. When you use Kobold Breath, you can increase the damage dice to d8s and increase the area to @Template[cone|distance:30]{30 feet for a cone} or @Template[line|distance:60]{60 feet for a line}. If you do, you can't use Kobold Breath again for 1 hour. During this time, Kobold Breath cannot be recharged using Kobold Momentum.
_desc_ko: 당신은 용족 후원자의 힘을 더 많이 전도하여 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.PPUNMjRLQYnmwQvF]{코볼드 숨결}에 집중시킬 수 있으며, 그 효과를 높이지만 회복하는 데 더 많은 시간이 필요합니다. 코볼드 숨결을 사용할 때, 피해 주사위를 d8로 늘리고 범위를 @Template[cone|distance:30]{원뿔 30피트} 또는 @Template[line|distance:60]{직선 60피트}로 늘릴 수 있습니다. 그렇게 하면 1시간 동안 코볼드 숨결을 다시 사용할 수 없습니다. 이 시간 동안 코볼드 숨결은 코볼드 기세로 재충전될 수 없습니다.

name: Bolstered Recovery

description.value: Whenever you rest, you recover with remarkable speed. Double the number of Hit Points you regain and the amount by which condition values are reduced from a full night's rest. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.8UJaVPsT5FA8XH87]{Instant Recovery} action.

publication.title: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

_desc_en: Whenever you rest, you recover with remarkable speed. Double the number of Hit Points you regain and the amount by which condition values are reduced from a full night's rest. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.8UJaVPsT5FA8XH87]{Instant Recovery} action.
_desc_ko: 휴식할 때마다, 당신은 놀라운 속도로 회복합니다. 하룻밤의 완전한 휴식으로 회복하는 히트 포인트 수와 상태 수치가 감소하는 양을 두 배로 만듭니다. 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.8UJaVPsT5FA8XH87]{즉각 회복} 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Insulated Poppet

description.value: You've used insulating wraps or special glazes to reduce your weakness to current and temperature. You no longer have the weakness to either electricity or cold caused by your tsukumogami heritage.

value.value: you have a metal or ceramic body

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

name: Fulu Familiar

description.value: You can imprint your familiar's spiritual essence into a fulu, a small paper charm that can be affixed to objects, creatures, or structures. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.NT1rtY5DFJGsR5QR]{Create Familiar Fulu} action, which you can use once per day; at 12th level, this increases to twice per day, and at 18th level, it increases to three times per day.

_desc_ko: 당신은 패밀리어의 영혼을 풀루에 각인할 수 있습니다. 풀루는 물체, 생물, 구조물에 부착할 수 있는 작은 종이 부적입니다. @link[actions.create-familiar-fulu] 행동을 획득하며, 하루에 한 번 사용할 수 있습니다. 12레벨에 도달하면 하루에 두 번, 18레벨에 도달하면 하루에 세 번으로 증가합니다.

name: Long-Distance Taunt

description.value: You can draw the wrath of your foes even at a great distance. When you use Taunt, you can choose a target within 120 feet.

_desc_en: You can draw the wrath of your foes even at a great distance. When you use Taunt, you can choose a target within 120 feet.
_desc_ko: 먼 거리에서도 적의 분노를 불러일으킬 수 있습니다. 도발을 사용할 때 120피트 이내의 대상을 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Kijimuna Whistle

description.value:
Access kijimuna gnome heritage or Tian Xia origin

Your connection to nature—and trees, in particular—has become so strong that you can summon the plants you befriended in the forests of your youth. Once per day, you can whistle the distinct, cheery sound that's a signature of the kijimuna gnome community to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jSRAyd57kd4WZ4yE]{Summon Plant or Fungus} as a 5th-rank primal innate spell. The spell loses the manipulate trait as the incantations and gestures used for this spell involve only whistling. Nearby kijimuna gnomes automatically recognize this celebratory trill and will usually answer or join in the music making if they can.

value.value: kijimuna gnome heritage or at least one primal innate spell from a gnome heritage or feat

_desc_ko:
접근 키지무나 노움 혈통 또는 티엔 샤 출신

자연, 특히 나무와의 유대가 너무나 강해져서 젊은 시절 숲에서 친구가 된 식물들을 소환할 수 있게 되었다. 하루에 한 번, 키지무나 노움 공동체의 상징인 독특하고 명랑한 휘파람 소리를 내어 @link[spells.summon-plant-or-fungus]을 (5th)랭크 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있다. 이 주문은 휘파람 소리만으로 주문을 외우고 제스처를 취하기 때문에 조작 특성을 상실합니다. 근처의 키지무나 노움들은 이 축제적인 휘파람 소리를 자동으로 인식하며, 가능하면 응답하거나 음악에 동참합니다.

name: More Real Than Real

description.value: Your performances aren't just well-known, they're famous across the land and beyond. Your ability to make people believe the stories you perform has taken on supernatural power. You gain the ability to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6s0UW4bujggma9TC]{Fabricated Truth} once per day as an occult innate spell.

value.value: Acrobat, Celebrity, Dandy, or Gladiator Dedication

_desc_en: Your performances aren't just well-known, they're famous across the land and beyond. Your ability to make people believe the stories you perform has taken on supernatural power. You gain the ability to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6s0UW4bujggma9TC]{Fabricated Truth} once per day as an occult innate spell.
_desc_ko: 당신의 공연은 단순히 잘 알려진 수준을 넘어 전국은 물론 그 너머까지 유명합니다. 당신이 연기하는 이야기를 사람들이 믿게 만드는 능력은 초자연적인 힘을 지니게 되었습니다. 하루에 한 번 @link[spells.fabricated-truth]을 오컬트 선천적 주문으로 시전할 수 있는 능력을 얻습니다.

name: Unbelievable Interception

description.value:
Trigger An enemy you're observing attempts to Strike an ally you can also observe.

You move with unbelievable alacrity to intercept an enemy's attack. Spend a Mythic Point; stride twice directly toward the triggering enemy. If you end within the attack's range or reach, you become the target of the triggering Strike, using the original attack roll and comparing the result to your AC. If the enemy's attack fails and the enemy is within your reach, you can immediately attempt a melee Strike against the enemy at mythic proficiency.

_desc_en:
Trigger An enemy you're observing attempts to Strike an ally you can also observe.

You move with unbelievable alacrity to intercept an enemy's attack. Spend a Mythic Point; stride twice directly toward the triggering enemy. If you end within the attack's range or reach, you become the target of the triggering Strike, using the original attack roll and comparing the result to your AC. If the enemy's attack fails and the enemy is within your reach, you can immediately attempt a melee Strike against the enemy at mythic proficiency.
_desc_ko:
발동 관찰 중인 적이, 당신도 관찰 가능한 아군을 공격하려고 시도할 때.

믿기 힘든 민첩성으로 적의 공격을 가로막는다. 신화 포인트 1점을 소모하고, 공격을 시작한 적을 향해 두 번의 이동을 사용해 직접 이동한다. 공격 범위나 도달 거리 내에 도착하면, 해당 공격의 대상이 되어 원래의 명중 굴림을 사용하며 그 결과를 네 AC와 비교한다. 적의 공격이 실패하고 적이 네 도달 거리 내에 있다면, 즉시 신화 숙련도로 적에게 근접 공격을 시도하다.

name: Crimson Oath Devotion

description.value: You've made the Crimson Oath a part of yourself; you mumble it in your sleep and recite it under your breath as you march. You become an expert in divine spell attacks and spell DCs. If you have spent at least 2 Focus Points since the last time you Refocused, you recover 2 Focus Points when you Refocus instead of 1.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en: You've made the Crimson Oath a part of yourself; you mumble it in your sleep and recite it under your breath as you march. You become an expert in divine spell attacks and spell DCs. If you have spent at least 2 Focus Points since the last time you Refocused, you recover 2 Focus Points when you Refocus instead of 1.
_desc_ko: 당신은 진홍의 맹세를 자신의 일부로 만들었습니다. 잠든 사이 중얼거리며 행군할 때도 속삭이듯 읊조립니다. 신성 마법 공격과 마법 DC에 대한 전문가가 됩니다. 마지막 재집중 이후 최소 2점의 포커스를 소모했다면, 재집중 시 1점이 아닌 2점의 포커스를 회복한다.

name: Reflective Defense

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger A creature within 30 feet of you targets you, and you can see the attacker.

Requirements You are in dim or bright light.

Your body's natural luster has been polished to a gleaming shine. You use this to reflect light back into your enemy's eyes, disrupting its aim and focus; it must succeed at a Reflex save against your class DC or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the end of your next turn.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger A creature within 30 feet of you targets you, and you can see the attacker.

Requirements You are in dim or bright light.

Your body's natural luster has been polished to a gleaming shine. You use this to reflect light back into your enemy's eyes, disrupting its aim and focus; it must succeed at a Reflex save against your class DC or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 10분에 한 번

발동 조건 30피트 이내의 생물이 당신을 공격 대상으로 삼고, 당신이 공격자를 볼 수 있을 때.

요구 사항 당신은 희미한 빛이나 밝은 빛 속에 있어야 합니다.

당신의 몸이 지닌 자연스러운 광택이 반짝이는 광채로 연마되었습니다. 이를 이용해 빛을 적의 눈으로 반사시켜 조준과 포커스를 방해합니다. 적은 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 반사 내성 내성 성공해야 하며, 실패 시 @link[conditions.dazzled] 상태가 되어 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 지속됩니다.

name: Solidarity

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You bestow some of your own life energies to mend damage. You touch a non-magical object of 2 Bulk or less, or a magical object of 1 Bulk or less, and you @Damage[(2*@actor.level)[healing]]{restore Hit Points} to the target equal to twice your level. You lose as many Hit Points as the target regained. This direct transfer of vitality means that no effects apply that would increase the Hit Points the target regains or decrease the Hit Points you lose. This transfer also ignores any temporary Hit Points you or the target have. You can't reduce your Hit Points below 1 using Solidarity. You can't replace lost pieces or repair an object that has been completely destroyed.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.LKkX8Ft92u0ax6Yh]{Minuscule Mentee} feat, you can use Solidarity to heal your familiar.

발동 빈도 10분에 한 번

당신은 자신의 생명 에너지를 일부 부여하여 피해를 치유합니다. 벌크 2 이하의 비마법 물체나 벌크 1 이하의 마법 물체를 만지면, 대상에게 당신의 레벨의 두 배에 해당하는 HP 회복을 부여합니다. 대상이 회복한 HP만큼 당신은 HP를 잃습니다. 이 활력의 직접 전달로 인해 대상이 회복하는 HP를 증가시키거나 당신이 잃는 HP를 감소시키는 효과는 적용되지 않습니다. 또한 이 전달은 당신이나 대상이 가진 임시 HP를 무시합니다. 연대감으로 HP를 1 이하로 낮출 수 없습니다. 분실한 부품을 교체하거나 완전히 파괴된 물건을 수리할 수 없습니다.

특수 @link[feats.minuscule-mentee] 피트를 보유한 경우, 연대감을 사용하여 자신의 패밀리어를 치유할 수 있습니다.

name: Glider Form

description.value:
Your eidolon evolves wings, a buoyant body, or some other means to control descent.

It glides slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down and up to 25 feet forward through the air.

As long as it spends at least 1 action gliding each round and has not yet reached the ground, it remains in the air at the end of your turn.

_desc_en:
Your eidolon evolves wings, a buoyant body, or some other means to control descent.

It glides slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down and up to 25 feet forward through the air.

As long as it spends at least 1 action gliding each round and has not yet reached the ground, it remains in the air at the end of your turn.
_desc_ko:
당신의 에이돌론이 날개, 부력 있는 몸체 또는 하강을 제어할 수 있는 다른 수단을 진화시킵니다.

그것은 천천히 지면을 향해 활공하며, 5피트 아래로 내려가고 최대 25피트 앞으로 공중을 이동합니다.

매 턴 최소 1회 행동을 활공에 사용하며 아직 지면에 도달하지 않은 한, 당신의 턴 종료 시에도 공중에 머무릅니다.

name: Duelist's Edge

description.value:
Trigger You roll initiative, and you are observing at least one opponent.

You hone your reaction time through duels and learn to draw your weapon seamlessly as you begin a fight. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the triggering initiative roll, and you can immediately Interact to draw an Aldori dueling sword.

_desc_en:
Trigger You roll initiative, and you are observing at least one opponent.

You hone your reaction time through duels and learn to draw your weapon seamlessly as you begin a fight. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the triggering initiative roll, and you can immediately Interact to draw an Aldori dueling sword.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 이니셔티브를 굴렸으며, 적어도 한 명의 적을 관찰하고 있다.

당신은 결투를 통해 반응 속도를 연마하고, 싸움을 시작할 때 무기를 매끄럽게 뽑는 법을 배웁니다. 발동 이니셔티브 주사위에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 즉시 행동하여 알도리 결투용 검을 뽑을 수 있습니다.

name: Phalanx Breaker

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a two-handed firearm or a two-handed crossbow.

You know that to take out an enemy formation, you must punch a hole through its center. Make a ranged Strike with the required weapon against a target within the weapon's first range increment. The target is pushed directly back 10 feet (20 feet on a critical hit), and if this pushes the target into an obstacle, the target takes bludgeoning damage equal to half your level.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a two-handed firearm or a two-handed crossbow.

You know that to take out an enemy formation, you must punch a hole through its center. Make a ranged Strike with the required weapon against a target within the weapon's first range increment. The target is pushed directly back 10 feet (20 feet on a critical hit), and if this pushes the target into an obstacle, the target takes bludgeoning damage equal to half your level.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손 화기 또는 양손 석궁을 사용 중입니다.

적의 진형을 무너뜨리려면 중심부에 구멍을 내야 한다는 것을 알고 있습니다. 요구되는 무기로 무기의 첫 번째 사거리 범위 내의 대상에게 원거리 공격을 가하십시오. 대상은 10피트(치명타 시 20피트) 뒤로 밀려납니다. 이로 인해 대상이 장애물에 부딪히면, 대상은 당신의 레벨 절반에 해당하는 타격 피해를 입습니다.

name: Sudden Leap

description.value:
Barbarian You swing at a foe while mid-leap.

Fighter You make an impressive leap and swing while you soar.

Make a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump} and attempt one melee Strike at any point during your jump. Immediately after the Strike, you fall to the ground if you're in the air, even if you haven't reached the maximum distance of your jump. If the distance you fall is no more than the height of your jump, you take no damage and land upright.

When attempting a High Jump or Long Jump during a Sudden Leap, determine the jump distance using Long Jump's rules, and change your maximum distance to double your Speed.

Special If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Ad0XBuETAkMD6doj]{Felling Strike}, you can use Felling Strike instead of a normal Strike. This doesn't change the number of actions Sudden Leap takes.

_desc_en:
Barbarian You swing at a foe while mid-leap.

Fighter You make an impressive leap and swing while you soar.

Make a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump} and attempt one melee Strike at any point during your jump. Immediately after the Strike, you fall to the ground if you're in the air, even if you haven't reached the maximum distance of your jump. If the distance you fall is no more than the height of your jump, you take no damage and land upright.

When attempting a High Jump or Long Jump during a Sudden Leap, determine the jump distance using Long Jump's rules, and change your maximum distance to double your Speed.

Special If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Ad0XBuETAkMD6doj]{Felling Strike}, you can use Felling Strike instead of a normal Strike. This doesn't change the number of actions Sudden Leap takes.
_desc_ko:
바바리안 공중에서 적을 향해 휘두릅니다.

파이터 당신은 인상적인 도약을 하며 공중에서 휘두른다.

@link[actions.leap], @link[actions.high-jump], 또는 @link[actions.long-jump]를 수행하고 점프 중 어느 시점에서든 근접 공격을 한 번 시도하다. 타격 직후, 공중에 있다면 점프 최대 거리에 도달하지 않았더라도 즉시 지상으로 추락한다. 추락 거리가 점프 높이 이하라면 피해를 입지 않고 똑바로 착지한다.

갑작스러운 도약 중 높이뛰기나 멀리뛰기를 시도할 때는 멀리뛰기 규칙으로 거리를 결정하고, 최대 거리를 자신의 속도 두 배로 변경한다.

특수 @link[feats.felling-strike]을 보유한 경우, 일반 공격 대신 벌목 타격을 사용할 수 있다 . 이는 돌발 점프에 소요되는 행동 횟수를 변경하지 않는다.

name: Wandering Oasis

description.value: You're surrounded by soothing energy. You and allies within 60 feet of you are protected from severe environmental heat and cold. If you're legendary in Survival, you and those allies are also protected from extreme environmental heat and cold.

_desc_en: You're surrounded by soothing energy. You and allies within 60 feet of you are protected from severe environmental heat and cold. If you're legendary in Survival, you and those allies are also protected from extreme environmental heat and cold.
_desc_ko: 당신은 평온한 에너지에 둘러싸여 있습니다. 당신과 60피트 이내의 아군들은 극심한 환경적 열기와 추위로부터 보호받습니다. 생존 기술이 전설급이라면, 당신과 아군들은 극한의 환경적 열기와 추위로부터도 보호받습니다.

name: Sleek Reposition

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a finesse weapon or polearm.

While your opponent is still recovering from your prior attack, you snag its armor, clothing, or flesh to move it as you please. Make a melee Strike with a finesse weapon or polearm. If you hit a target that is your size or smaller, you can automatically @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition} it, with the same benefits as the Reposition action (including the critical success effect, if your Strike was a critical hit). If you used a weapon with reach, use the weapon's reach for this Reposition. If you're wielding a polearm, you can ignore Reposition's requirement that you have a hand free.

This Strike has the following failure effect.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your current turn.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a finesse weapon or polearm.

While your opponent is still recovering from your prior attack, you snag its armor, clothing, or flesh to move it as you please. Make a melee Strike with a finesse weapon or polearm. If you hit a target that is your size or smaller, you can automatically @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition} it, with the same benefits as the Reposition action (including the critical success effect, if your Strike was a critical hit). If you used a weapon with reach, use the weapon's reach for this Reposition. If you're wielding a polearm, you can ignore Reposition's requirement that you have a hand free.

This Strike has the following failure effect.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your current turn.
_desc_ko:
Requirements 기교 무기나 장창을 휘두르고 있어야 합니다.

상대가 이전 공격에서 회복 중인 동안, 그 갑옷이나 옷, 살점을 잡아당겨 마음대로 움직일 수 있습니다. 기교 무기나 장창으로 근접 공격을 시도하십시오. 자신과 같은 크기 이하의 대상에게 명중하면, 자동으로 @link[actions.reposition]할 수 있습니다. 이 재위치는 재위치 행동과 동일한 이점을 제공합니다(공격이 치명타였을 경우 치명타 성공 효과 포함). 도달 거리가 있는 무기를 사용한 경우, 이 재배치에 해당 무기의 도달 거리를 적용한다. 장창을 휘두르는 경우, 재배치에 필요한 한 손이 자유로워야 한다는 조건을 무시할 수 있다.

이 공격은 다음과 같은 실패 효과를 가집니다.

실패 시 대상은 현재 턴이 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Risky Reload

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a firearm.

You've practiced a technique for rapidly reloading your firearm, but attempting to use this technique is a dangerous gamble with your firearm's functionality. Interact to reload a firearm, then make a Strike with that firearm. If the Strike fails, the firearm misfires.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a firearm.

You've practiced a technique for rapidly reloading your firearm, but attempting to use this technique is a dangerous gamble with your firearm's functionality. Interact to reload a firearm, then make a Strike with that firearm. If the Strike fails, the firearm misfires.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 화기를 장전 중입니다.

당신은 총기를 신속하게 재장전하는 기술을 연습했지만, 이 기술을 시도하는 것은 총기의 기능성에 대한 위험한 도박입니다. 총기를 재장전하기 위해 상호작용한 후, 그 총기로 강타를 시도하세요. 강타가 실패하면 총기가 오발합니다.

name: Stasian Charge

description.value: Charging a living body with electricity may seem like a bad idea, but you know better. When a creature gains temporary Hit Points from your In Lightning, Life, they gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition until the end of their next turn. They can use the extra action only for Stride and Strike actions.

_desc_en: Charging a living body with electricity may seem like a bad idea, but you know better. When a creature gains temporary Hit Points from your In Lightning, Life, they gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition until the end of their next turn. They can use the extra action only for Stride and Strike actions.
_desc_ko: 생체에 전기를 충전하는 것은 나쁜 생각처럼 보일 수 있지만, 당신은 더 잘 알고 있다. 생물이 당신의 '번개 속 생명력' 능력으로 임시 HP를 얻으면, 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.quickened] 상태가 된다. 추가 행동은 오직 '이동'과 '공격' 행동에만 사용할 수 있다.

name: Conductive Sphere

description.value:
A floating metal ball forms in a space within 30 feet, flashing with electricity. It can't be targeted or damaged. Any of your allies adjacent to it gain resistance to electricity equal to your level and add the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.NVst7e69agGG9Qwd]{Shock} rune to all their Strikes with metal objects. The sphere lasts until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it up to 1 minute.

When you conjure the sphere and the first time you Sustain the impulse on subsequent rounds, you can either have it Fly up to 20 feet or deal @Damage[(floor((@actor.level - 5)/3))d12[electricity]] damage to an adjacent creature with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic] save against your class DC.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.sl3umfGcLROU3U5U]{Effect: Conductive Sphere}

Level (+3) The damage dealt by the sphere increases by 1d12.

_desc_en:
A floating metal ball forms in a space within 30 feet, flashing with electricity. It can't be targeted or damaged. Any of your allies adjacent to it gain resistance to electricity equal to your level and add the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.NVst7e69agGG9Qwd]{Shock} rune to all their Strikes with metal objects. The sphere lasts until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it up to 1 minute.

When you conjure the sphere and the first time you Sustain the impulse on subsequent rounds, you can either have it Fly up to 20 feet or deal @Damage[(floor((@actor.level - 5)/3))d12[electricity]] damage to an adjacent creature with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic] save against your class DC.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.sl3umfGcLROU3U5U]{Effect: Conductive Sphere}

Level (+3) The damage dealt by the sphere increases by 1d12.
_desc_ko:
30피트 내 공간에 번뜩이는 전기를 뿜는 부유 금속 구체가 생성됩니다. 표적이 되거나 피해를 입을 수 없습니다. 인접한 아군들은 당신의 레벨에 해당하는 전기 저항력을 얻으며, 금속 물체를 사용한 모든 공격에 @link[equipment.shock] 룬을 모든 금속 물체 공격에 부여한다. 구체는 다음 턴 종료까지 지속되나, 최대 1분까지 유지할 수 있다.

구체를 소환할 때와 이후 라운드에 처음으로 지속할 때, 구체가 최대 20피트까지 날아가게 하거나 인접한 생물에게 전기의 피해를 입힐 수 있다. 피해는 대상이 당신의 직업 DC에 대한 내성 굴림을 성공해야 회피할 수 있다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.sl3umfGcLROU3U5U]{효과: 전도 구체}

레벨 (+3) 구체가 가하는 피해가 1d12만큼 증가합니다.

name: Spine Stabber

description.value: The quills on your arms are particularly sharp and sturdy. You gain a quills unarmed attack that deals @Damage[1d6[piercing]] damage. Your quills are in the knife weapon group and have the finesse and unarmed traits.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: The quills on your arms are particularly sharp and sturdy. You gain a quills unarmed attack that deals @Damage[1d6[piercing]] damage. Your quills are in the knife weapon group and have the finesse and unarmed traits.
_desc_ko: 팔의 가시가 특히 날카롭고 튼튼합니다. 1d6 관통의 피해를 주는 가시 비무장 공격을 얻습니다. 가시는 칼 무기 그룹에 속하며, 기교와 비무장 특성을 가집니다.

name: Consult Celestial Advisor

description.value:
Frequency once per day

For many, the Calling of an ascended celestial is a wondrous but challenging path, which they must walk alone. This isn't the case for you. A single celestial is responsible for shepherding you into the celestial ranks and has offered to serve as a mentor to you throughout the time of your transformation. You can call upon this mentor for advice, guidance, and support. Once per day, you can spend 30 minutes in deep meditation. During this time, you spiritually converse with your celestial advisor. You gain three benefits during this conversation, which can occur in any order of your choosing.

You discuss a topic of interest with your celestial advisor. This allows you to Recall Knowledge on any topic once, with mythic proficiency. You can spend 1 Mythic Point to instead Recall Knowledge on any three topics with mythic proficiency.

You discuss a goal, activity, or event with your celestial advisor. This must be a goal you plan to achieve or an event you expect to happen within 1 week. Your celestial advisor gives you a piece of advice to help you achieve your goal or to see your way through the expected event. This has the effect of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.pkcOby5prOausy1k]{Read Omens}.

You discuss an immediate action that you intend to take with your celestial advisor. This must be an action you plan to take within the next 8 hours. Your celestial advisor gives you their opinion on the outcome. This has the effect of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X]{Augury}, except that the augury can see 8 hours into the future, and the GM doesn't roll a flat check for a failure.

_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

많은 이들에게 승천한 천상체의 부름은 경이롭지만 도전적인 길이며, 그들은 이 길을 홀로 걸어야 합니다. 그러나 당신에게는 그렇지 않습니다. 한 명의 천상체가 당신을 천상체의 계급으로 인도하는 목자 역할을 맡았으며, 당신의 변모 기간 내내 멘토로 섬기겠다고 제안했습니다. 이 멘토에게 조언과 지도, 지원을 요청할 수 있다. 하루에 한 번, 30분간 깊은 명상에 잠길 수 있다. 이 시간 동안 영적으로 천상체 조언자와 대화한다. 대화 중 다음 세 가지 혜택을 얻으며, 순서는 자유롭게 선택할 수 있다.

천상체의 조언자와 관심 주제에 대해 논의합니다. 이를 통해 신화적 숙련도로 어떤 주제든 한 번 지식 회상할 수 있습니다. 대신 신화적 숙련도로 세 가지 주제에 대해 지식 회상하려면 신화 포인트 1점을 소모할 수 있습니다.

천상체의 조언자와 목표, 활동 또는 사건에 대해 논의합니다. 이는 1주일 이내에 달성할 계획인 목표나 예상되는 사건이어야 합니다. 천상체의 조언자는 목표 달성을 돕거나 예상 사건을 헤쳐나가는 데 도움이 되는 조언을 제공합니다. 이는 @link[spells.read-omens]의 효과를 가집니다.

당신은 천상체의 조언자와 취할 즉각적인 행동에 대해 논의합니다. 이는 향후 8시간 이내에 실행할 계획인 행동이어야 합니다. 천상체의 조언자가 그 결과에 대한 의견을 제시합니다. 이는 @link[spells.augury] 효과를 가지나, 점술이 8시간 후의 미래를 볼 수 있으며, GM이 실패를 위한 단순 판정을 굴리지 않는다는 점이 다릅니다.

name: Final Shot Knows the Way

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a ranged warshard weapon and used it to make a ranged Strike against a foe this round.

You judge a foe's defenses after attacking them and channel that knowledge into your warshard weapon and its ammunition. Spend a Mythic Point, then Stride twice. At any point during this movement, attempt a ranged Strike at mythic proficiency with your warshard weapon against the same foe you already attacked this round. This Strike ignores any modifiers from cover or concealment the target may have, as the ammunition weaves and twists through the air in an impossible flight. All penalties from range increments are negated during this Strike. If this shot hits its target, the target is so astounded by the shot that they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your next turn.
