You put your alchemical interest into practice. You become trained in alchemical bombs, the alchemist class DC, and Crafting; if you were already trained in Crafting, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.Jkl5KOZih7MoMqAJ]{Quick Alchemy} benefits, creating up to 4 versatile vials during your daily preparations. Add the formulas for four additional common alchemical items to your formula book, in addition to those you gain from Alchemical Crafting.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.Ux0sa5SUBu616i5k]{Alchemist}
_desc_ko:
당신은 연금술에 대한 관심을 실천으로 옮깁니다. 연금술 폭탄, 연금술사 직업 DC, 제작 기술에 숙련됩니다. 이미 제작 기술에 숙련된 경우, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.Jkl5KOZih7MoMqAJ]{신속한 연금술} 효과를 얻어, 일일 준비 시간 동안 최대 4개의 다용도 약병을 제작할 수 있습니다. 연금술 제작으로 얻는 것 외에도, 네 가지 추가 일반 연금술 아이템의 제조법을 제조법 책에 추가합니다.

name: Living for the Applause

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points (but not immediately killed) during a combat encounter that has spectators.

Nothing can stop you as long as you have an audience cheering you on. The attention reinvigorates you and keeps you from being knocked out. You remain at 1 Hit Point, and your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition increases by 1.

In addition, attempt a @Check[performance|dc:@self.dc] check; the DC is determined by the GM but is typically the standard DC for your level or the DC to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on the spectators, whichever is higher. On a success, the crowd erupts in applause and cheers at your comeback, much to the dismay of your enemies. Concern for the crowd's reaction should your opponent deliver a finishing blow gives you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the end of your next turn. On a critical success, you don't expend your daily use of Living for the Applause and can use the reaction an additional time on the same day.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.YMdRmEcOlM3uU9Em]{Effect: Living for the Applause}

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points (but not immediately killed) during a combat encounter that has spectators.

Nothing can stop you as long as you have an audience cheering you on. The attention reinvigorates you and keeps you from being knocked out. You remain at 1 Hit Point, and your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition increases by 1.

In addition, attempt a @Check[performance|dc:@self.dc] check; the DC is determined by the GM but is typically the standard DC for your level or the DC to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on the spectators, whichever is higher. On a success, the crowd erupts in applause and cheers at your comeback, much to the dismay of your enemies. Concern for the crowd's reaction should your opponent deliver a finishing blow gives you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the end of your next turn. On a critical success, you don't expend your daily use of Living for the Applause and can use the reaction an additional time on the same day.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.YMdRmEcOlM3uU9Em]{Effect: Living for the Applause}
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 관중이 있는 전투 중일 때 HP가 0이 됩니다(즉시 사망하지는 않음).

관중이 당신을 응원하는 한 아무것도 당신을 막을 수 없습니다. 그 관심은 당신에게 활력을 불어넣고 기절하지 않도록 합니다. 당신은 1 HP 포인트를 유지하며, @link[conditions.wounded] 상태가 1 증가합니다.

추가로 공연 판정을 시도하십시오. DC는 GM이 결정하지만, 일반적으로 당신의 레벨에 따른 표준 DC나 관중들에게 @link[actions.make-an-impression]를 위한 DC 중 더 높은 쪽이 적용됩니다. 성공 시, 군중은 당신의 반격에 박수와 환호로 폭발하며 적들은 크게 당황한다. 상대 가 마무리 일격을 가할 경우 군중의 반응에 대한 우려로 인해 다음 턴 종료까지 AC에 +1 상황 보너스를 받는다. 대성공 시, '박수를 위한 생명력'의 일일 사용량을 소모하지 않으며 같은 날에 이 반응을 한 번 더 사용할 수 있다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.YMdRmEcOlM3uU9Em]{효과: 박수를 위한 생존}

name: Wild Winds Initiate

description.value:
You learn a stance that lets you attack from a distance. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SkarN4VlNxSJSJNw]{Wild Winds Stance} qi spell.

While entering the stance is a qi spell, the wind crash Strikes the stance grants are not, so you can use them as often as you like while in the stance.

_desc_en:
You learn a stance that lets you attack from a distance. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SkarN4VlNxSJSJNw]{Wild Winds Stance} qi spell.

While entering the stance is a qi spell, the wind crash Strikes the stance grants are not, so you can use them as often as you like while in the stance.
_desc_ko:
거리에서 공격할 수 있는 자세를 익힙니다. @link[spells.wild-winds-stance] 기 주문을 얻습니다.

자세를 취하는 것은 기 주문이지만, 바람의 충돌 공격은 자세 부여 효과가 아니므로 자세를 취한 상태에서는 원하는 만큼 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Wounded Rage

description.value:
Trigger You take damage and are capable of entering a rage

You roar in pain, awakening the rage within you. You Rage.

_desc_en:
Trigger You take damage and are capable of entering a rage

You roar in pain, awakening the rage within you. You Rage.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신이 피해를 입었고 분노 상태에 진입할 수 있을 때

고통에 울부짖으며 내면의 분노를 깨운다. 분노 상태가 된다.

name: Merfolk Lore

description.value:
You paid close attention to your lessons in school. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Arcana and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} feat for Merfolk Lore.

_desc_en:
You paid close attention to your lessons in school. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Arcana and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} feat for Merfolk Lore.
_desc_ko:
학교 수업에 집중해서 들었습니다. 주문학 및 사회에 숙련 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 자동으로 숙련이 되는 기술이 있다면, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련이 됩니다.

또한 어인족 지식에 대한 @link[feats.additional-lore] 피트를 얻습니다.

name: Spiritual Flurry

description.value: When you use Spiritual Strike, hit targets become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your current turn. In addition, the additional force damage dealt by the Strike increases by 2d6.

_desc_en: When you use Spiritual Strike, hit targets become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your current turn. In addition, the additional force damage dealt by the Strike increases by 2d6.
_desc_ko: 영혼의 일격을 사용할 때, 명중된 대상은 현재 턴이 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다. 또한 일격이 가하는 추가 역장 피해가 2d6만큼 증가합니다.

name: Crossblooded Evolution

description.value: Odd interactions in your bloodline provide you with unexpected effects. Choose another @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.2goYo6VNbwC6aKF1]{Bloodline}. You know the blood magic effect of that bloodline. If the blood magic effect has a variable effect based on a choice you would have made at 1st level (such as the elemental bloodline's elemental influence), you make that decision when you take this feat.

_desc_en: Odd interactions in your bloodline provide you with unexpected effects. Choose another @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.2goYo6VNbwC6aKF1]{Bloodline}. You know the blood magic effect of that bloodline. If the blood magic effect has a variable effect based on a choice you would have made at 1st level (such as the elemental bloodline's elemental influence), you make that decision when you take this feat.
_desc_ko: 혈통 내의 기이한 상호작용이 예상치 못한 효과를 제공합니다. 다른 @link[feats.bloodline]을 선택하십시오. 해당 혈통의 혈통 마법 효과를 알고 있습니다. 혈통 마법 효과가 1레벨 시 선택했을 내용(예: 원소 혈통의 원소 영향력)에 따라 효과가 달라지는 경우, 이 피트를 선택할 때 해당 결정을 내립니다.

name: Dragonscaled Lore

description.value: The study of dragons is not merely academic to you but part of your family tree. Tracking lineages, benefactors, and communities has become second nature. You become trained in Intimidation and your choice of Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion. For each of these skills in which you were already trained, you become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Dragon Lore.

_desc_en: The study of dragons is not merely academic to you but part of your family tree. Tracking lineages, benefactors, and communities has become second nature. You become trained in Intimidation and your choice of Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion. For each of these skills in which you were already trained, you become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Dragon Lore.
_desc_ko: 용에 대한 연구는 당신에게 단순한 학문이 아니라 가문의 계보의 일부입니다. 혈통, 후원자, 공동체를 추적하는 것이 당신에게는 제2의 천성이 되었습니다. 당신은 위협에, 그리고 주문학, 자연학, 오컬티즘, 종교학 중 당신이 선택한 하나에 숙련이 됩니다. 이미 숙련되어 있던 각 기술에 대해, 당신은 원하는 기술 하나에 숙련이 됩니다. 또한 당신은 용 지식에 대한 추가 지식 일반 재주를 얻습니다.

name: Mountain's Stoutness

description.value:
Your hardiness lets you withstand more punishment than most. Increase your maximum Hit Points by your level. When you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying 1} condition, the DC of your recovery checks is equal to 9 + your dying value (instead of 10 + your dying value).

If you also have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.AmP0qu7c5dlBSath]{Toughness} feat, the Hit Points gained from it and this feat are cumulative, and the DC of your recovery checks is equal to 6 + your dying value.

_desc_en:
Your hardiness lets you withstand more punishment than most. Increase your maximum Hit Points by your level. When you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying 1} condition, the DC of your recovery checks is equal to 9 + your dying value (instead of 10 + your dying value).

If you also have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.AmP0qu7c5dlBSath]{Toughness} feat, the Hit Points gained from it and this feat are cumulative, and the DC of your recovery checks is equal to 6 + your dying value.
_desc_ko:
당신의 강인함은 대부분의 존재보다 더 많은 고통을 견딜 수 있게 합니다. 최대 HP를 레벨만큼 증가시킵니다. @link[conditions.dying]{1} 상태일 때, 회복 판정 난이도는 10 + 죽어감 수치 대신 9 + 죽어감 수치와 같습니다.

@link[feats.toughness] 피트도 보유한 경우, 해당 피트와 본 피트로 얻는 HP는 누적되며 회복 판정 DC는 6 + 죽음 직전 수치와 동일합니다.

name: Second Sting

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding two melee weapons, each in a different hand.

You read your prey's movements and transform them into openings, so failures with one weapon set up glancing blows with the other. Make a melee Strike with one of the required weapons against your hunted prey. The Strike gains the following failure effect.

Failure You deal the damage the other required weapon would have dealt on a hit, excluding all damage dice. (This removes dice from weapon runes, spells, and special abilities, not just weapon damage dice.)

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding two melee weapons, each in a different hand.

You read your prey's movements and transform them into openings, so failures with one weapon set up glancing blows with the other. Make a melee Strike with one of the required weapons against your hunted prey. The Strike gains the following failure effect.

Failure You deal the damage the other required weapon would have dealt on a hit, excluding all damage dice. (This removes dice from weapon runes, spells, and special abilities, not just weapon damage dice.)
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손에 각각 다른 근접 무기를 들고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 사냥감의 움직임을 읽어 틈으로 전환하므로, 한 무기의 실패는 다른 무기의 스치기 공격으로 이어집니다. 사냥감에게 요구된 무기 중 하나로 근접 공격을 가하세요. 이 공격은 다음 실패 효과를 얻습니다.

실패 시 다른 필수 무기가 명중 시 입혔을 피해량(모든 피해 주사위 제외)을 입힌다. (이는 무기 주사위뿐만 아니라 무기 룬, 주문, 특수 능력의 주사위도 제거한다.)

name: Janatimo's Lessons

description.value: Thanks to Janatimo's secret techniques, you can weave your knowledge and words into powerful tools to assist your allies in life-threatening situations. When you use Uzunjati Recollection to tell a story and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about a creature during a combat encounter, if you succeed at both checks, your story carries deeper meaning. This grants your allies a +1 circumstance bonus to their next attack roll and saving throw against the creature during that encounter, as well as to their AC against that creature's next attack roll during that encounter. If you critically succeed at both checks, the bonuses also apply to all attack rolls, saves, and AC against that creature for 2 rounds.

_desc_en: Thanks to Janatimo's secret techniques, you can weave your knowledge and words into powerful tools to assist your allies in life-threatening situations. When you use Uzunjati Recollection to tell a story and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about a creature during a combat encounter, if you succeed at both checks, your story carries deeper meaning. This grants your allies a +1 circumstance bonus to their next attack roll and saving throw against the creature during that encounter, as well as to their AC against that creature's next attack roll during that encounter. If you critically succeed at both checks, the bonuses also apply to all attack rolls, saves, and AC against that creature for 2 rounds.
_desc_ko: 자나티모의 비법 덕분에, 당신은 지식과 말을 엮어 생명을 위협하는 상황에서 동료를 돕는 강력한 도구로 만들 수 있습니다. 전투 중 우준자티 회상을 사용해 이야기를 전하고 @link[actions.recall-knowledge]으로 생물에 대해 설명할 때, 두 판정 모두 성공하면 이야기에 더 깊은 의미가 담깁니다. 이로 인해 아군은 해당 전투에서 그 생물에 대한 다음 명중 굴림과 내성 굴림, 그리고 그 생물의 다음 명중 굴림에 대한 AC에 +1 상황 보너스를 받습니다. 두 판정 모두에 대성공을 거두면, 해당 생물체에 대한 모든 명중 굴림, 내성 굴림, AC에 2라운드 동안 보너스가 적용됩니다.

name: Text Decoder

description.value: Thanks to your constant involvement with cryptic texts, you have attained an almost-supernatural ability to decipher complex codes and understand ancient writings. You can always use [[/act decipher-writing skill=occultism]]{Occultism} or [[/act decipher-writing skill=religion]]{Religion} when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing}, no matter the subject matter. In addition, you can ignore language constraints when Deciphering Writing, and when you critically fail to Decipher Writing, you get a failure instead.

_desc_en: Thanks to your constant involvement with cryptic texts, you have attained an almost-supernatural ability to decipher complex codes and understand ancient writings. You can always use [[/act decipher-writing skill=occultism]]{Occultism} or [[/act decipher-writing skill=religion]]{Religion} when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing}, no matter the subject matter. In addition, you can ignore language constraints when Deciphering Writing, and when you critically fail to Decipher Writing, you get a failure instead.
_desc_ko: 수수께끼 같은 문헌에 꾸준히 관여한 덕분에, 당신은 복잡한 암호를 해독하고 고대 문헌을 이해하는 초자연적 능력에 가까운 실력을 갖추게 되었습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.decipher-writing] 시 주제와 상관없이 항상 오컬트 또는 종교를 사용할 수 있습니다. 또한 문자 해독 시 언어 제약을 무시할 수 있으며, 문자 해독에 대실패를 할 경우 대신 실패로 처리됩니다.

name: Hammer Quake

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a non-finesse melee weapon in two hands.

You smash the ground with your weapon, knocking nearby creatures to the ground. Choose a square within your reach, including your own space. If there's an enemy in the chosen square, you can Strike that enemy with your two-handed weapon. Regardless of whether you attempted a Strike, you then attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} every enemy in the chosen square plus each square adjacent to that square, ignoring Trip's requirement that you have a hand free.

Hammer Quake counts as three attacks toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after you've made the Strike, if any, and all the Trip attempts.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a non-finesse melee weapon in two hands.

You smash the ground with your weapon, knocking nearby creatures to the ground. Choose a square within your reach, including your own space. If there's an enemy in the chosen square, you can Strike that enemy with your two-handed weapon. Regardless of whether you attempted a Strike, you then attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} every enemy in the chosen square plus each square adjacent to that square, ignoring Trip's requirement that you have a hand free.

Hammer Quake counts as three attacks toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after you've made the Strike, if any, and all the Trip attempts.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손으로 기교 근접 무기를 휘두르고 있어야 합니다.

무기로 땅을 내리쳐 근처 생물들을 땅에 넘어뜨립니다. 당신의 도달 범위 내의 한 칸(당신의 칸 포함)을 선택하십시오. 선택한 칸에 적이 있다면, 양손 무기로 그 적을 강타할 수 있습니다. 강타 시도를 했는지 여부와 관계없이, 선택한 칸과 그 칸에 인접한 모든 칸에 있는 적을 대상으로 @link[actions.trip]를 시도합니다. 이때 넘어뜨리기에 필요한 한 손이 자유로워야 한다는 조건은 무시됩니다.

해머 퀘이크는 다중 공격 페널티 계산 시 세 번의 공격으로 간주되나, 페널티는 공격 시도(해당 시)와 모든 트립 시도가 완료된 후에만 증가한다.

name: Stoney Deflection

description.value:
Requirements You are in Stonestrike Stance.

You gather the resiliency of stone to block attacks against you. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and to any defenses against being Shoved or Tripped until the beginning of your next turn.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are in Stonestrike Stance.

You gather the resiliency of stone to block attacks against you. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and to any defenses against being Shoved or Tripped until the beginning of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 돌격 자세를 취하고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 돌의 탄력성을 모아 자신에게 가해지는 공격을 막습니다. 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 AC와 밀치기 또는 걸려 넘어뜨리기에 대한 모든 방어에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Web Weaver

description.value:
You can produce a soft silk to weave into useful items. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.QLeMH5mQgh28sa5o]{Specialty Crafting} feat with a specialty in weaving.

You can use your webbing to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} simple, nonconsumable threaded items, such as clothing and rope, at zero cost as long as their base Price is 1 sp or less. These items have no resale value, and they naturally degrade after 24 hours without regular (if minor) maintenance. You can maintain up to 10 such items at a time; if you create a new one, your oldest creation breaks down from neglect.

These temporary items take you only 1 day to Craft instead of 4. If you're an expert in Crafting, you can Craft these items in 1 hour; if you're a master, you can Craft them in 10 minutes; if you're legendary, you can Craft them in 1 minute.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en:
You can produce a soft silk to weave into useful items. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.QLeMH5mQgh28sa5o]{Specialty Crafting} feat with a specialty in weaving.

You can use your webbing to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} simple, nonconsumable threaded items, such as clothing and rope, at zero cost as long as their base Price is 1 sp or less. These items have no resale value, and they naturally degrade after 24 hours without regular (if minor) maintenance. You can maintain up to 10 such items at a time; if you create a new one, your oldest creation breaks down from neglect.

These temporary items take you only 1 day to Craft instead of 4. If you're an expert in Crafting, you can Craft these items in 1 hour; if you're a master, you can Craft them in 10 minutes; if you're legendary, you can Craft them in 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
부드러운 실크를 생산하여 유용한 물건으로 엮을 수 있습니다. @link[feats.specialty-crafting] 피트를 획득하며, 그 특기 분야는 직조입니다.

직조물을 이용해 @link[actions.craft]할 수 있습니다. 기본 가격이 1 sp 이하인 의류나 밧줄 같은 단순한 비소모성 실 제품들을 비용 없이 제작할 수 있습니다. 이러한 제품들 은 재판매 가치가 없으며, 정기적인(비록 최하급) 관리 없이는 24시간 후 자연적으로 분해됩니다. 한 번에 최대 10개까지 유지할 수 있으며, 새 아이템을 제작하면 가장 오래된 제작품이 방치로 인해 파손됩니다.

이 임시 아이템들은 제작에 4일이 아닌 단 1일만 소요됩니다. 제작에 능숙하다면 1시간, 마스터라면 10분, 전설급이라면 1분 만에 제작할 수 있습니다.

name: Grove-Harbored

description.value: You are accustomed to exploring thick woodlands and defending yourself against the attacks of magical plants. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against plant, poison, and wood effects, and if you roll a success on a save against a poison effect, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: You are accustomed to exploring thick woodlands and defending yourself against the attacks of magical plants. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against plant, poison, and wood effects, and if you roll a success on a save against a poison effect, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 울창한 숲을 탐험하고 마법 식물의 공격으로부터 자신을 방어하는 데 익숙합니다. 식물, 독, 나무 효과에 대한 내성에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 독 효과에 대한 내성에서 성공을 굴릴 경우 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Summon Ensemble

description.value: When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yvs1zN5Pai5U4CJX]{Summon Instrument}, you can modify its duration to be sustained, up to 1 minute. When you do, you summon a number of instruments equal to your spellcasting ability modifier that hover around you and play of their own accord. Once per turn when you Sustain the Spell, choose an opponent within 30 feet who can hear your performance. The target must attempt a @Check[will] save against the spell's DC; on a failure, it becomes distracted by your performance and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round. The target is then temporarily immune for 24 hours.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

The target is then temporarily immune for 24 hours.
_desc_ko: {악기 소환}을 시전할 때 지속 시간을 최대 1분까지 지속형으로 변경할 수 있습니다. 이때 시전 능력치 수정자만큼의 악기가 주변에 떠다니며 스스로 연주합니다. 턴당 한 번, 이 주문을 지속할 때 30피트 이내에서 당신의 공연을 들을 수 있는 적을 선택한다. 대상은 주문의 DC에 대한 의지 내성 굴림을 시도해야 한다. 실패 시, 대상은 당신의 공연에 정신이 팔려 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 된다. 이후 대상은 24시간 동안 일시적으로 면역 상태가 된다.

name: Shielding Formation

description.value: You have mastered unique magical techniques designed to protect your allies from harm. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6QEWTuCKRQQTyoeS]{Shielding Formation} focus spell.

_desc_en: You have mastered unique magical techniques designed to protect your allies from harm. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6QEWTuCKRQQTyoeS]{Shielding Formation} focus spell.
_desc_ko: 동료를 위험으로부터 보호하기 위해 고안된 독특한 마법 기술을 마스터했습니다. @link[spells.shielding-formation] 포커스 주문을 획득합니다.

name: Dwarven Weapon Familiarity

description.value:
Your kin have instilled in you an affinity for hard-hitting weapons, and you prefer these to more elegant arms. You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the dwarf trait. You have familiarity with weapons with the dwarf trait plus the battle axe, pick, and warhammer—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

_desc_en:
Your kin have instilled in you an affinity for hard-hitting weapons, and you prefer these to more elegant arms. You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the dwarf trait. You have familiarity with weapons with the dwarf trait plus the battle axe, pick, and warhammer—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
_desc_ko:
당신의 혈족은 당신에게 강력한 무기에 대한 친화력을 심어주었으며, 당신은 우아한 무기보다 이런 무기를 선호합니다. 드워프 특성을 가진 모든 흔하지 않은 무기를 사용할 수 있습니다. 드워프 특성을 가진 무기 외에도 전투 도끼, 곡괭이, 전쟁 망치에 패밀리어가 있다. 숙련도 목적상, 이 중 무술 무기인 것은 단순 무기로, 고급 무기인 것은 무술 무기로 취급한다.

5레벨에 도달하면, 이 무기들로 치명타를 기록할 때마다 해당 무기의 치명타 특화 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Mist Child

description.value: You blend in with unnatural subtlety. When you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, increase the DC of the flat check to target you to 6 if you're concealed or 12 if you're hidden.

_desc_en: You blend in with unnatural subtlety. When you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, increase the DC of the flat check to target you to 6 if you're concealed or 12 if you're hidden.
_desc_ko: 당신은 비정상적인 섬세함으로 주변과 녹아든다. 당신이 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태이거나 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태일 때, 당신을 대상으로 하는 단순 판정 DC를 가려진 시 6, 숨겨진 시 12로 증가시킵니다.

name: Fiendish Form

description.value: Your features reshape into those of a type of fiend who serves your deity; for example, as a demon you might have putrid scales, twisted horns, and red eyes. You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed. You gain darkvision if you don't already have it, and you gain the fiend trait and the trait appropriate to the type of servitor you've become (such as daemon, demon, or devil).

_desc_en: Your features reshape into those of a type of fiend who serves your deity; for example, as a demon you might have putrid scales, twisted horns, and red eyes. You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed. You gain darkvision if you don't already have it, and you gain the fiend trait and the trait appropriate to the type of servitor you've become (such as daemon, demon, or devil).
_desc_ko: 당신의 외모는 당신의 신을 섬기는 핀드의 유형으로 변형됩니다. 예를 들어, 데몬이 되면 썩은 비늘, 뒤틀린 뿔, 붉은 눈을 가질 수 있습니다. 당신의 이동 속도와 동일한 비행 속도를 얻습니다. 아직 암흑 시야를 가지지 않았다면 이를 얻으며, 핀드 특성과 당신이 된 종복 유형(예: 데이몬, 데몬, 데빌)에 해당하는 특성을 얻습니다.

name: Ka Stone Ritual

description.value:
You inscribe your true name on your ka stone, as well as oaths to gods and pharaohs, and embed it in your forehead in a special ritual with a sphinx or with a living monolith who already has this feat. The ka stone is an invested magic item that you automatically invest each day. It can't be removed without your permission, nor can it be dispelled, and you can never lose investiture in the ka stone. Its Bulk is negligible.

The ka stone grants you a +1 item bonus to saves against death effects and negative effects, which increases to +2 at 8th level, +3 at 14th level, and +4 at 20th level.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.C9VvYnjbWertzgMc]{Ka Stone}

Activate 2 (envision), or a different activation if otherwise specified

Frequency a number of times each day equal to the number of class feats you have from the Living Monolith archetype

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge} on yourself or use one of the other activated abilities granted by a later Living Monolith feat.

value.value: a sphinx or living monolith with this feat performs a ritual with you

_desc_ko:
당신은 자신의 카 스톤에 진정한 이름과 신 및 파라오에 대한 맹세를 새긴 후, 스핑크스나 이 피트를 이미 가진 살아있는 거석과 함께 특별한 의식으로 이 돌을 이마에 박아 넣습니다. 카 스톤은 매일 자동으로 투여되는 마법 아이템이다. 당신의 허락 없이는 제거될 수 없으며, 해제될 수도 없고, 카 스톤에 대한 투여 상태를 영원히 잃을 수 없다. 벌크는 무시할 수 있을 정도로 작다.

카 스톤은 죽음 효과 및 부정적 효과에 대한 내성에 +1 아이템 보너스를 부여하며, (8th) 레벨에 +2, 14레벨에 +3, 20레벨에 +4로 증가합니다.

활성화 2 (envision), 또는 별도로 명시된 경우 다른 활성화 방식

빈도 하루에 여러 번, 살아있는 거석 아키타입에서 가진 클래스 피트 수만큼

효과 자신에게 @link[spells.enlarge]를 시전하거나, 이후 생명의 거대 피트 재주로 부여받은 다른 활성화 능력 중 하나를 사용한다.

name: Investigator Dedication

description.value:
You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.6FasgIXUJ1X8ekRn]{On the Case} class feature, which grants you both the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xTK2zsWFyxSJvYbX]{Pursue a Lead} activity and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.25WDi1cVUrW92sUj]{Clue In} reaction. You become trained in Society and another skill of your choice. If you were already trained in Society, you instead become trained in an additional skill of your choice. You also become trained in investigator class DC.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.mmB3EkkdCpLke7Lk]{Investigator}

_desc_en:
You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.6FasgIXUJ1X8ekRn]{On the Case} class feature, which grants you both the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xTK2zsWFyxSJvYbX]{Pursue a Lead} activity and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.25WDi1cVUrW92sUj]{Clue In} reaction. _desc_ko: 당신은 @link[feats.on-the-case] 클래스 특성을 얻습니다. 이 특성은 @link[actions.pursue-a-lead] 활동과 @link[actions.clue-in] 반응을 모두 부여합니다. 사회 및 선택한 다른 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다. 이미 사회에 숙련된 경우, 대신 선택한 추가 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다. 또한 조사자 클래스 DC에 숙련됩니다.

name: Scrounger Dedication

description.value:
While others need specialized tools and a dedicated space, you have found a way to build just about anything, anywhere. You can Craft items even without appropriate tools or a workshop. Additionally, you don't need a physical formula book to remember all of your formulas; you pay the same cost as normal to learn them, but you memorize them all. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PE1jm9lBveujj2md]{Cobble Together} activity.

An item you Cobble Together is a shoddy item, but when creating it you can choose one creature to build it specifically for. That creature doesn't take the normal penalty for using this shoddy item. Your temporary item lasts for [[/gmr 1d4 #hours]]{1d4 hours} before falling apart into its raw components; the GM rolls the number of hours secretly.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.rlKxNuq1obXe3m5J]{Scrounger}

_desc_ko:
다른 이들이 전문 도구와 전용 공간이 필요한 반면, 당신은 어디서든 거의 모든 것을 제작하는 방법을 터득했습니다. 적절한 도구나 작업장 없이도 아이템을 제작할 수 있습니다. 또한 모든 제작법을 기억하기 위해 물리적 제작법 서적이 필요하지 않습니다. 학습 비용은 평소와 동일하지만, 모든 제작법을 암기합니다. @link[actions.cobble-together] 활동을 얻습니다.

당신이 급조한 아이템은 조잡한 물건이지만, 제작 시 특정 생물을 위해 특별히 만들 수 있습니다. 해당 생물은 이 조잡한 아이템 사용 시 일반적인 페널티를 받지 않습니다. 당신의 임시 아이템은 1d4시간 동안 지속된 후 원재료로 분해됩니다; GM은 비밀리에 지속 시간을 굴림합니다.

name: Oni Rampage

description.value:
Trigger You're reduced to less than half your maximum Hit Points by a creature within your reach.

Nothing invigorates you more than your own freshly spilled blood. You gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{Haste} for 1 minute.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Trigger You're reduced to less than half your maximum Hit Points by a creature within your reach.

Nothing invigorates you more than your own freshly spilled blood. You gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{Haste} for 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신의 최대 HP가 닿을 수 있는 범위 내의 생물에게 절반 이하로 감소당합니다.

자신의 갓 흘린 피만큼 당신을 활기차게 하는 것은 없습니다. 1분 동안 @link[spells.haste] 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Ceremony of the Evened Hand

description.value:
You have cultivated your exoskeleton's form for close combat, using knots, whorls, and reinforced branches. When you select this feat, you gain a claws unarmed attack that deals 1d4 slashing damage and has the agile and finesse traits or a branch unarmed attack that deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage and has the backswing trait. Each of these unarmed attacks is in the brawling weapon group and uses one of your hands.

Special You can select this feat twice, choosing the other unarmed attack the second time you take it.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en:
You have cultivated your exoskeleton's form for close combat, using knots, whorls, and reinforced branches. When you select this feat, you gain a claws unarmed attack that deals 1d4 slashing damage and has the agile and finesse traits or a branch unarmed attack that deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage and has the backswing trait. Each of these unarmed attacks is in the brawling weapon group and uses one of your hands.

Special You can select this feat twice, choosing the other unarmed attack the second time you take it.
_desc_ko:
당신은 매듭, 소용돌이, 강화된 가지들을 이용해 근접전을 위한 외골격 형태를 연마했습니다. 이 피트를 선택하면, 1d4 베기 피해를 주고 기민한 및 기교 특성을 지닌 발톱 비무장 공격 또는 1d6 타격 피해를 주고 백스윙 특성을 지닌 가지 비무장 공격 중 하나를 얻습니다. 이 비무장 공격들은 각각 싸움 무기 그룹에 속하며 한 손을 사용합니다.

특수 이 피트를 두 번 선택할 수 있으며, 두 번째 선택 시 다른 비무장 공격을 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Profane Bargain

description.value:
You can strike a profane bargain with a willing, sapient creature. That creature promises to never take hostile actions against you, to never lie to you, to never speak of this bargain, and to either perform, or refrain from performing, one other specified task, such as paying you a specified sum every year, gifting you their first-born child, or never speaking.

If the target accepts, they verbally make a request. You can choose to twist their request by selecting specific details, as long as you still fulfill the requirements of their request. If the request could be granted by a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} ritual, you spend 1 Mythic Point and the request is magically granted.

As long as the bargain persists, you always know the target's location, can communicate telepathically with the target at any distance, and can see through the target's senses by taking a single action that has the concentrate trait. Once per day, you can take control of the target as an activity that takes three actions and has the concentrate trait. When you do, they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} by you for 10 minutes. They have no memory of their time spent under your control.

If the target ever breaks the terms of this bargain, you immediately select one of the following punishments: they die, they die and you possess their soul, they become permanently controlled by you, or they become imprisoned in a cell within your realm's dungeon (you must have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.GPIKvj8K2yk2eVOC]{Imprison Foe} feat to select this final option).

A target can only enter into a Profane Bargain with you once—not even the breaking of this bargain, death, a wish ritual, or divine intervention frees them of this limitation. You can't make a Profane Bargain with yourself.

If the target accepts, they verbally make a request. You can choose to twist their request by selecting specific details, as long as you still fulfill the requirements of their request. If the request could be granted by a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} ritual, you spend 1 Mythic Point and the request is magically granted.

As long as the bargain persists, you always know the target's location, can communicate telepathically with the target at any distance, and can see through the target's senses by taking a single action that has the concentrate trait. Once per day, you can take control of the target as an activity that takes three actions and has the concentrate trait. When you do, they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} by you for 10 minutes. They have no memory of their time spent under your control.

If the target ever breaks the terms of this bargain, you immediately select one of the following punishments: they die, they die and you possess their soul, they become permanently controlled by you, or they become imprisoned in a cell within your realm's dungeon (you must have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.GPIKvj8K2yk2eVOC]{Imprison Foe} feat to select this final option).

A target can only enter into a Profane Bargain with you once—not even the breaking of this bargain, death, a wish ritual, or divine intervention frees them of this limitation. You can't make a Profane Bargain with yourself.
_desc_ko:
동의한 대상과 신성모독적인 거래를 체결할 수 있습니다. 해당 생물은 당신에게 적대적 행동을 취하지 않으며, 당신에게 거짓말을 하지 않으며, 이 거래에 대해 절대 언급하지 않으며, 매년 정해진 금액을 지급하거나, 첫째 아이를 선물하거나, 영원히 침묵하는 등 지정된 한 가지 추가 임무를 수행하거나 수행하지 않기로 약속합니다.

대상이 수락하면 구두로 요청을 한다. 당신은 요청의 필수 조건을 충족하는 한, 세부 사항을 선택하여 요청을 왜곡할 수 있다. 요청이 @link[spells.wish] 의식으로 이루어질 수 있다면, 신화 포인트 1점을 소모하고 요청은 마법적으로 이루어진다.

거래가 지속되는 동안, 당신은 항상 대상의 위치를 파악할 수 있으며, 거리 제한 없이 대상과 텔레파시로 소통할 수 있고, 집중 특성을 가진 액션 하나를 통해 대상의 감각으로 사물을 볼 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, 집중 특성을 가진 세 행동을 소모하는 활동으로 대상의 통제권을 장악할 수 있습니다. 이 경우, 대상은 10분 동안 당신에게 @link[conditions.controlled] 상태가 됩니다. 대상은 통제 기간 동안의 기억을 전혀 가지지 않습니다.

대상이 이 거래 조건을 위반할 경우, 즉시 다음 처벌 중 하나를 선택한다: 대상이 사망한다, 대상이 사망하고 네가 그 영혼을 소유한다, 대상이 영구적으로 네 통제하에 들어간다, 또는 대상이 네 렐름 지하 감옥의 감방에 갇힌다(마지막 옵션을 선택하려면 @link[feats.imprison-foe] 피트가 필요하다).

대상은 당신과 단 한 번만 신성모독적 거래를 체결할 수 있다-이 거래의 파기, 죽음, 소원 의식, 신의 개입조차도 이 제한에서 해방시키지 못한다. 당신은 자신과 신성모독적 거래를 체결할 수 없다.

name: Kineticist Dedication

description.value:
You become trained in kineticist class DC and impulse attack rolls. Choose one element to be your kinetic element (air, earth, fire, metal, water, or wood). You gain a kinetic aura and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.g8QrV39TmZfkbXgE]{Channel Elements} action, though you don't get to use an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.6lbr0Jnv0zMB5uGb]{Elemental Blast} or stance impulse when you take that action. You gain the Elemental Blast action. Your Elemental Blast does not automatically gain additional damage dice every four levels, instead requiring you to take the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.8VlGHrDKjlY69jFv]{Improved Elemental Blast} feat. You become trained in Nature; if you were already trained in Nature, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice.

name: Spell Trickster Dedication

description.value:
Your experience with magic and its traditions lets you specialize in the casting of certain spells, customizing familiar spells to create novel effects. Whenever you gain a feat from this archetype, you either learn to modify the effects of a single spell, or you change one of the modifications from a previous feat. Each time you Cast the Spell corresponding to the feat you chose, you decide whether to cast its normal or modified version. You can only apply one modification to a spell at a time, even if you know more than one modification for that spell. Besides modifications mentioned in the feat, the spell functions as normal.

Choose up to two 4th-level spell trickster archetype feats for which you meet the spell-casting prerequisite. You gain those feats, ignoring their level prerequisite.

Special You can't select another dedication feat until you have gained two other feats from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DztQF2FexWvnzcaE]{Spell Trickster} archetype. The two feats you gain from taking the dedication don't count toward this total.

_desc_ko:
마법과 그 전통에 대한 경험으로 특정 주문 시전에 특화되어 익숙한 주문을 변형해 새로운 효과를 창출할 수 있습니다. 이 아키타입의 재주를 획득할 때마다 단일 주문의 효과를 수정하는 법을 배우거나, 이전 재주로 얻은 수정자 중 하나를 변경합니다. 선택한 피트에 해당하는 주문을 시전할 때마다, 정상 버전과 조정됨 버전 중 하나를 시전할지 결정합니다. 해당 주문에 대해 하나 이상의 수정자를 알고 있더라도, 한 번에 하나의 수정자만 적용할 수 있습니다. 특성에 명시된 수정자 외에는 주문이 정상적으로 작동합니다.

주문 시전 전제 조건을 충족하는 4레벨 트릭스터 아키타입 주문 재주 중 최대 두 개를 선택합니다. 해당 피트를 레벨 전제 조건 없이 획득합니다.

특수 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DztQF2FexWvnzcaE]{주문 사기꾼} 아키타입에서 다른 두 가지 피트를 획득하기 전까지는 다른 헌신 피트를 선택할 수 없습니다. 헌신 피트 선택으로 얻는 두 가지 피트는 이 총계에 포함되지 않습니다.

name: Fluid Contortionist

description.value: You can ignore difficult terrain caused by moving through tight spaces that aren't tight enough to force you to Squeeze. When you roll a critical failure on a check to Squeeze, you get a failure instead, and when you roll a success, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: You can ignore difficult terrain caused by moving through tight spaces that aren't tight enough to force you to Squeeze. When you roll a critical failure on a check to Squeeze, you get a failure instead, and when you roll a success, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 몸을 비틀어 지나갈 수 있을 정도로 좁은 공간을 통과할 때 발생하는 어려운 지형을 무시할 수 있습니다. 몸을 비틀어 지나가기 능력 판정에서 대실패를 굴렸을 때는 실패로, 성공을 굴렸을 때는 대성공으로 처리됩니다.

name: Transcend the Azimuth

description.value: As the earth drinks the light of sun and moon, so does your steady vow imbibe superlunary forces, ready to be unleashed with a moment's mantra. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IHUs4qn27RrdFQ5Y]{Cosmic Form} on yourself as a 7th-rank primal innate spell once per day, your shadow lengthening and becoming a mandala of fundamental energies. In addition to the spell's normal effects, you can Sustain the spell to switch between the sun battle form and the moon battle form once per turn.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

name: Stonebane

description.value: Your stonestrike attacks deal 1d6 additional damage against constructs, creatures with the earth trait, and earthen objects, such as a stone door.

_desc_en: Your stonestrike attacks deal 1d6 additional damage against constructs, creatures with the earth trait, and earthen objects, such as a stone door.
_desc_ko: 당신의 돌격 공격은 구조물, 대지 특성을 가진 생물, 돌문과 같은 대지 물체에게 1d6의 추가 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Calaca's Showstopper

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You've spent many an evening learning songs and tales featuring calacas, death's wandering minstrels. You dramatically unleash a stunning blast of sound by smashing an instrument you hold or belting out a discordant note. This has the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.BilnTGuXrof9Dt9D]{Synaptic Pulse}, but the effect is auditory rather than mental. The DC is either your @Check[will|against:class-spell]{class or spell DC}, whichever is higher.

name: Improved Twin Riposte (Ranger)

description.value: At the start of each of your turns, you gain an additional reaction that you can use only to perform a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.GJIAecRq1bD2r8O0]{Twin Riposte}. You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.GJIAecRq1bD2r8O0]{Twin Riposte} even if you aren't benefiting from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Y8LHfkzGyOhPlUou]{Twin Parry} (though you must be wielding two melee weapons, one in each hand).

name: Hierophant's Power

description.value: You have entwined yourself with the natural world, and its full power flows through you. You gain an additional 10th-rank spell slot.

_desc_en: You have entwined yourself with the natural world, and its full power flows through you. You gain an additional 10th-rank spell slot.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자연계와 하나가 되어 그 모든 힘이 당신을 통해 흐릅니다. 10랭크 주문 슬롯을 추가로 획득합니다.

name: Deific Font

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Your life force can fuel the stuff of miracles. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} or increase the value of your drained condition by 1 if you already have the drained condition. The spell loses whatever tradition trait it would normally have and gains the divine trait.

name: Tempest Gaze

When you use Storming Gaze, you can increase the area to a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] and @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))d4[electricity],(ceil(@actor.level/2))d4[sonic]|options:area-damage]{double the number of damage dice}; half deal electricity damage, and half deal sonic damage. If you Storming Gaze in this way, you can't use it again for 1 hour.

name: Methodical Debilitations

  • Debilitation The target doesn't gain a circumstance bonus to AC from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xjGwis0uaC2305pm]{Raising a Shield}, lesser cover, or standard cover; it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC only from greater cover or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Taking Cover}. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.4HNPQ6pnMDRe8jaN]{Effect: Methodical Debilitations (Cover)}
_desc_ko:
적의 전술적 이점을 약화시키거나 무력화시키기 위해 전략적으로 약화 효과를 제작합니다. 약화 타격을 사용할 때 선택할 수 있는 목록에 다음 약화 효과를 추가합니다.

  • 약화 효과 대상은 측면 공격을 할 수 없으며 아군의 측면 공격에도 기여할 수 없습니다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.emSh1VxHVtTmt925]{효과: 체계적 약화 효과 (측면 공격)}
  • 쇠약 대상은 @link[actions.raise-a-shield], 반엄폐, 표준 엄폐로부터 AC에 상황 보너스를 얻지 못한다; 대상은 오직 완전 엄폐나 @link[actions.take-cover]로부터만 AC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻는다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.4HNPQ6pnMDRe8jaN]{효과: 체계적 쇠약화 (엄폐)}

name: Beastmaster's Trance

description.value: You can enter a trance that allows you to briefly inhabit the body of one of your animal companions and share its senses. You gain the focus spell @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5WM3WjshXgrkVCg6]{Beastmaster Trance}. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.

_desc_en: You can enter a trance that allows you to briefly inhabit the body of one of your animal companions and share its senses. You gain the focus spell @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5WM3WjshXgrkVCg6]{Beastmaster Trance}. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.
_desc_ko: 당신은 동물의 몸에 잠깐 들어가 그 감각을 공유할 수 있는 트랜스에 들어갈 수 있습니다. 포커스 주문 @link[spells.beastmaster-trance]를 얻습니다. 포커스 풀의 포커스 포인트 수를 1 증가시킵니다.

name: Aberration Kinship

description.value: Your mind resonates with the inscrutable thought processes that inhuman aberrations use to communicate. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.D442XMADp01qJ7Cs]{Mindlink} as an innate occult spell once per day, but you can target only aberrations.

_desc_en: Your mind resonates with the inscrutable thought processes that inhuman aberrations use to communicate. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.D442XMADp01qJ7Cs]{Mindlink} as an innate occult spell once per day, but you can target only aberrations.
_desc_ko: 당신의 정신은 비인간적 이형체들이 의사소통에 사용하는 헤아릴 수 없는 사고 과정과 공명합니다. 하루에 한 번, 선천적 오컬트 주문으로 @link[spells.mindlink]를 시전할 수 있지만, 대상은 이형체로만 한정됩니다.

name: Advanced Breakthrough

description.value:
You gain one inventor feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your inventor level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another inventor feat.

_desc_en:
You gain one inventor feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your inventor level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another inventor feat.
_desc_ko:
발명가 피트 하나를 획득합니다. 해당 피트의 전제 조건을 충족하기 위한 목적으로, 당신의 발명가 레벨은 캐릭터 레벨의 절반과 동일합니다.

특수 이 재주를 여러 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 선택할 때마다 발명가 피트 하나를 추가로 얻습니다.

name: Steadfast Grip

description.value: The connection you have with your warshard weapon strengthens it and assists you in maintaining your grip on it in battle. Your DCs against attempts made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal}, or otherwise remove your warshard weapon from your possession are calculated at mythic proficiency. When you designate a warshard weapon, its Hardness increases by an amount equal to half your level, and its Hit Points increase by an amount equal to your level for as long as it is your warshard weapon.

publication.title: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

_desc_en: The connection you have with your warshard weapon strengthens it and assists you in maintaining your grip on it in battle. Your DCs against attempts made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal}, or otherwise remove your warshard weapon from your possession are calculated at mythic proficiency. When you designate a warshard weapon, its Hardness increases by an amount equal to half your level, and its Hit Points increase by an amount equal to your level for as long as it is your warshard weapon.
_desc_ko: 당신이 전쟁조각 무기와 맺은 연결은 그 무기를 강화하고, 전투 중 당신이 그것을 계속 쥐고 있도록 돕습니다. 당신의 전쟁조각 무기를 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{무장 해제}하거나, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{훔치기}하거나, 그 밖의 방식으로 당신의 소유에서 제거하려는 시도에 대한 당신의 DC는 미시적 숙련도로 계산됩니다. 전쟁조각 무기를 지정할 때, 그것이 당신의 전쟁조각 무기인 동안 그 경도는 당신 레벨의 절반과 같은 양만큼, 그 히트 포인트는 당신 레벨과 같은 양만큼 증가합니다.

name: Spirit Walk

description.value: Your allied apparitions ward you against the predations of their restless peers. You and allies in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] gain a +2 status bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} checks about spirits, haunts, and undead. While you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Searching} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Yb0C1uLzeHrVLl7a]{Detecting Magic} in exploration mode, this bonus also applies to AC and saves against reactions any of you trigger from haunts and spirits. During your first turn in an encounter, you and allies in the aura have resistance equal to half your level against damage dealt by haunts or spirits.

_desc_en: Your allied apparitions ward you against the predations of their restless peers. You and allies in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] gain a +2 status bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} checks about spirits, haunts, and undead. While you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Searching} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Yb0C1uLzeHrVLl7a]{Detecting Magic} in exploration mode, this bonus also applies to AC and saves against reactions any of you trigger from haunts and spirits. During your first turn in an encounter, you and allies in the aura have resistance equal to half your level against damage dealt by haunts or spirits.
_desc_ko: 동료 유령들이 당신을 불안한 동료들의 습격으로부터 수호부합니다. 당신과 30피트 발산 내 동맹들은 영혼, 유령, 언데드에 관한 @link[actions.recall-knowledge] 판정에서 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 당신이 @link[actions.search] 또는 @link[actions.detect-magic]를 탐사 모드로 수행할 때, 이 보너스는 귀신이나 영혼의 반응을 유발할 때 AC와 내성에 적용됩니다. 교전 첫 턴 동안, 당신은 및 오라 내 동맹들은 귀신이나 영혼이 가하는 피해에 대해 당신의 레벨 절반에 해당하는 저항력을 얻습니다.

name: Greater Debilitating Bomb

description.value: You have learned enhanced techniques and alchemical secrets that allow you to expand the range of effects you can impose with your bombs. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.sv4LeEbkOJyLen10]{Debilitating Bomb}, add the following to the list you can choose from: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}, or –10-foot status penalty to Speeds.

_desc_en: You have learned enhanced techniques and alchemical secrets that allow you to expand the range of effects you can impose with your bombs. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.sv4LeEbkOJyLen10]{Debilitating Bomb}, add the following to the list you can choose from: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}, or –10-foot status penalty to Speeds.
_desc_ko: 폭탄으로 가할 수 있는 효과의 범위를 확장하는 강화된 기술과 연금술의 비밀을 습득했습니다. @link[feats.debilitating-bomb]을 사용할 때, 선택 가능한 목록에 다음을 추가합니다: @link[conditions.clumsy]{1}, @link[conditions.enfeebled]{1}, @link[conditions.stupefied]{1}, 또는 이동 속도에 -10피트 상태 페널티.

name: Animalistic Resistance

description.value: Your animalistic connections help you resist natural afflictions. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saves to resist diseases and poisons.

_desc_en: Your animalistic connections help you resist natural afflictions. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saves to resist diseases and poisons.
_desc_ko: 당신의 동물적 연결은 자연적 고통에 저항하는 데 도움을 줍니다. 질병과 독에 저항하는 내성에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Steady Balance

description.value: You can keep your balance easily, even in adverse conditions. Whenever you roll a success using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} action, you get a critical success instead. You're not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while attempting to Balance on narrow surfaces and uneven ground.

_desc_en: You can keep your balance easily, even in adverse conditions. Whenever you roll a success using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} action, you get a critical success instead. You're not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while attempting to Balance on narrow surfaces and uneven ground.
_desc_ko: 불리한 조건에서도 쉽게 균형을 유지할 수 있습니다. @link[actions.balance] 행동으로 성공을 굴릴 때마다 대신 대성공을 얻습니다. 좁은 표면이나 고르지 않은 지면에서 균형을 잡으려고 시도할 때 @link[conditions.off-guard]가 되지 않습니다.

name: Stone Blood

description.value: You can selectively stop your bleeding with ease. Reduce the DC of flat checks to stop persistent bleed damage you have from 15 to 10, and you can use a single action that has the concentrate trait to gain an early flat check without physically binding the wounds. You recover naturally from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} condition twice as quickly as normal.

_desc_en: You can selectively stop your bleeding with ease. Reduce the DC of flat checks to stop persistent bleed damage you have from 15 to 10, and you can use a single action that has the concentrate trait to gain an early flat check without physically binding the wounds. You recover naturally from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} condition twice as quickly as normal.
_desc_ko: 출혈을 선택적으로 쉽게 멈출 수 있습니다. 지속적인 출혈 피해를 멈추기 위한 단순 판정 난이도를 15에서 10으로 낮추며, 집중 특성을 가진 액션 하나로 상처를 물리적으로 봉합하지 않고도 조기 단순 판정을 수행할 수 있습니다. @link[conditions.drained] 상태에서 정상보다 두 배 빠르게 자연 회복됩니다.

name: Game Hunter Dedication

description.value:
You are skilled at tracking big game animals and similar creatures. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JYi4MnsdFu618hPm]{Hunt Prey} action, but you can designate only animals, beasts, and dragons as prey. In addition to the other benefits of Hunt Prey, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks against your hunted prey.

When you succeed at a Strike against your hunted prey while it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, it must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC. On a failure, the prey's Speeds are each reduced by 10 feet for 1 round; on a critical failure, the duration of this effect is 1 minute. The prey is then temporarily immune to this effect for 10 minutes.

If you already have Hunt Prey, you become an expert in Survival. You apply the Stealth bonus and the Speed reduction only when your prey is an animal, beast, or dragon.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.eTosCwuCMf09fYYH]{Effect: Game Hunter (Failure)}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.lfbDqyKUMssoxUTZ]{Effect: Game Hunter (Critical Failure)}

_desc_ko:
당신은 대형 사냥감 동물과 유사한 생물들을 추적하는 데 능숙합니다. @link[actions.hunt-prey] 행동을 획득하지만, 사냥감으로 지정할 수 있는 대상은 동물, 야수, 용으로만 제한됩니다. 사냥감 추적의 다른 혜택에 더해, 사냥하는 사냥감을 상대로 한 은신 판정 시 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

사냥감이 @link[conditions.off-guard]일 때 공격에 성공하면, 사냥감은 당신의 직업 난이도(DC)에 맞춘 인내 내성 굴림을 시도해야 합니다. 실패 시, 사냥감의 이동 속도는 1라운드 동안 각각 10피트 감소합니다. 대실패 시, 이 효과의 지속 시간은 1분입니다. 이후 사냥감은 10분 동안 이 효과에 일시적으로 면역됩니다.

이미 사냥감 추적 능력을 보유한 경우, 생존 기술에 숙련자가 됩니다. 은신 보너스와 이동 속도 감소 효과는 사냥감이 동물, 야수 또는 용일 때만 적용됩니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.eTosCwuCMf09fYYH]{효과: 게임 헌터 (실패)}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.lfbDqyKUMssoxUTZ]{효과: 게임 헌터 (대실패)}

name: Primal Howl

description.value: Your companion can let out a howl laced with your primal magic. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.wnZhAUiYcs2mv8sZ]{Primal Howl} advanced maneuver, in addition to any advanced maneuvers it already knows.

_desc_en: Your companion can let out a howl laced with your primal magic. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.wnZhAUiYcs2mv8sZ]{Primal Howl} advanced maneuver, in addition to any advanced maneuvers it already knows.
_desc_ko: 동료는 당신의 프라이멀 마법이 깃든 울부짖음을 내뿜을 수 있습니다. 이미 알고 있는 고급 기동 외에도 @link[actions.primal-howl] 고급 기동을 추가로 얻습니다.

name: Crossbow Ace

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a crossbow with reload 1 or higher.

Your deep understanding of the crossbow allows you to reload efficiently while moving yourself out of the line of return fire. Either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover}, then Interact to reload. As normal, you must meet the requirements to Take Cover; you must be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, benefiting from cover, or near a feature that allows you to Take Cover.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a crossbow with reload 1 or higher.

Your deep understanding of the crossbow allows you to reload efficiently while moving yourself out of the line of return fire. Either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover}, then Interact to reload. As normal, you must meet the requirements to Take Cover; you must be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, benefiting from cover, or near a feature that allows you to Take Cover.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 재장전 1 이상인 석궁을 사용 중이어야 합니다.

석궁에 대한 깊은 이해로 인해, 반격 사선에서 벗어나며 효율적으로 재장전할 수 있습니다. @link[actions.create-a-diversion] 또는 @link[actions.take-cover]를 수행한 후, 상호작용하여 재장전하십시오. 일반적으로 엄폐 요건을 충족해야 합니다: @link[conditions.prone]여야 하며, 엄폐물의 보호를 받거나 엄폐가 가능한 지형 근처에 있어야 합니다.

name: Flexible Spellcaster Dedication

description.value:
You now have four cantrips per day instead of three. At 4th level, you have five cantrips per day instead of four.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.4YtHynO8i1a33zo9]{Flexible Spellcaster (Class Archetype)}

_desc_en:
You now have four cantrips per day instead of three. At 4th level, you have five cantrips per day instead of four.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.4YtHynO8i1a33zo9]{Flexible Spellcaster (Class Archetype)}
_desc_ko: 하루에 3번이 아닌 4번의 캔트립을 사용할 수 있습니다. 4레벨에 도달하면 하루에 4번이 아닌 5번의 캔트립을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Murderous Thorns

description.value: Your thorns are many, vicious, and sharp. If you have the Hidden Thorn feat, your thorn attack gains the deadly d6 trait. If you have the thorned rose heritage, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ncdryKskPwHMgHFh]{Wicked Thorns} reaction once every hour.

_desc_en: Your thorns are many, vicious, and sharp. If you have the Hidden Thorn feat, your thorn attack gains the deadly d6 trait. If you have the thorned rose heritage, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ncdryKskPwHMgHFh]{Wicked Thorns} reaction once every hour.
_desc_ko: 당신의 가시는 많고 사납고 날카롭습니다. 숨겨진 가시 피트를 보유한 경우, 가시 공격에 치명적인 d6 특성이 부여됩니다. 가시 장미 혈통을 보유한 경우, @link[actions.wicked-thorns] 반응을 시간당 한 번 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Read Shibboleths

description.value:
All communication is filled with slight tells and signals. If you interact with someone for at least 10 minutes, their regional words, pronunciation changes, and nonverbal cues provide you with a minor fact about their social environment, such as their hometown or certain groups they might belong to.

If a target of this ability is being deceptive about their social environment, such as a commoner pretending to be a noble, they must attempt a Deception, Society, or appropriate Lore check against your Society DC, providing you a false minor fact consistent with their assumed identity on a success.

Once you've gleaned one or more true minor facts about a person, you can then incorporate these mannerisms into your speech to present yourself in a way that they find familiar. This grants you a +1 circumstance bonus to your Diplomacy and Deception checks with them.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ivGiUp0EC5nWT9Hb]{Effect: Read Shibboleths}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ivGiUp0EC5nWT9Hb]{Effect: Read Shibboleths}
_desc_ko:
모든 의사소통은 미묘한 신호와 암시로 가득합니다. 누군가와 최소 10분간 교류하면, 그들의 지역어, 발음 변화, 비언어적 신호를 통해 고향이나 소속된 특정 집단 등 사회적 환경에 관한 사소한 사실을 파악할 수 있습니다.

이 능력의 대상이 자신의 사회적 배경에 대해 속이고 있는 경우(예: 평민이 귀족인 척하는 경우), 대상은 당신의 사회 DC에 맞서 기만, 사회, 또는 적절한 지식 판정을 시도해야 하며, 성공 시 그들이 꾸민 신분과 일치하는 거짓 사소한 사실을 당신에게 제공합니다.

한 사람에 대해 하나 이상의 진실된 사소한 사실을 파악한 후, 이 행동 양식을 자신의 말투에 반영하여 상대방이 패밀리어하게 느끼는 방식으로 자신을 표현할 수 있습니다. 이로 인해 해당 대상과의 외교 및 기만 판정 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ivGiUp0EC5nWT9Hb]{효과: 시볼레트 읽기}

name: As a Thousand Soldiers

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Though you may have stolen from the hive, you've nothing but respect for the armies guarding it, and you borrow their strength to overwhelm your foes. Your body transforms into a swarm of bees. You Fly up to twice your Speed; during this movement you can pass through any space that would be small enough for a single insect, and your movement does not trigger reactions. If you pass through an enemy's space, you can inflict a storm of stings that deals @Damage[(floor((@actor.level - 2)/ 2)d4)[piercing],(floor((@actor.level - 2)/ 2)d4)[poison]] damage, with a @Check[reflex|against:exemplar|basic] save against your class DC. At the end of your movement, you return to your original form. At 10th level and every two levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d4 piercing damage and 1d4 poison damage.

publication.title: Pathfinder #217: Death Sails a Wine-Dark Sea

_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

비록 벌집에서 훔쳤을지라도, 그곳을 지키는 군대에 대한 존경심만 있을 뿐이며, 적을 압도하기 위해 그들의 힘을 빌린다. 네 몸은 벌 떼로 변한다. 네 이동 속도의 최대 두 배까지 날아오를 수 있다. 이 이동 중에는 단일 곤충이 통과할 수 있을 만큼 작은 공간이라면 어디든 통과할 수 있으며, 이 이동은 반응을 유발하지 않는다. 적의 공간을 통과할 경우, 관통 독 피해를 주는 벌침 폭풍을 가할 수 있으며, 이는 네 클래스 DC에 대한 기본 반사 내성에 성공해야 회피할 수 있다. 이동 종료 시 원래 형태로 복귀한다. 10레벨 달성 시 및 이후 2레벨마다 피해량이 관통 피해 1d4와 독 피해 1d4씩 증가한다.

name: Devastating Weaponry

description.value: You release a volley of projectiles from your weapon, or power it to fly in every direction across the battlefield and Strike multiple creatures. Make a Strike with your weapon innovation against each foe within 30 feet of you. Don't increase your multiple attack penalty until after making all the attacks. If your innovation is a melee weapon and any of the attacks are outside your reach, you Release the weapon before the Strikes, and it returns to your grasp after all of them. If your hands are full when the weapon returns, it falls to the ground in your space. As normal, if your weapon innovation requires one or more actions to reload between Strikes, you can't use it to make multiple attacks with Devastating Weaponry.

_desc_en: You release a volley of projectiles from your weapon, or power it to fly in every direction across the battlefield and Strike multiple creatures. Make a Strike with your weapon innovation against each foe within 30 feet of you. Don't increase your multiple attack penalty until after making all the attacks. If your innovation is a melee weapon and any of the attacks are outside your reach, you Release the weapon before the Strikes, and it returns to your grasp after all of them. If your hands are full when the weapon returns, it falls to the ground in your space. As normal, if your weapon innovation requires one or more actions to reload between Strikes, you can't use it to make multiple attacks with Devastating Weaponry.
_desc_ko: 무기에서 일제 사격을 발사하거나 전장을 가로질러 사방으로 날아가게 하여 여러 생물을 공격한다. 30피트 내의 각 적에게 무기 혁신으로 공격을 가한다. 모든 공격을 완료할 때까지 다중 공격 페널티를 증가시키지 않는다. 혁신이 근접 무기이고 공격 중 일부가 당신의 도달 범위를 벗어나는 경우, 공격 전에 무기를 발사하고 모든 공격이 끝난 후 다시 손에 쥡니다. 무기가 돌아올 때 손이 가득 차 있다면, 무기는 당신의 공간에 떨어집니다. 평소와 마찬가지로, 혁신 무기가 공격 사이에 재장전을 위해 하나 이상의 행동을 필요로 하는 경우, 파괴적인 무기 사용으로 다중 공격을 할 수 없습니다.

name: Haft Beatdown

description.value:
Frequency once per minute

Requirements You are in Haft Striker Stance.

The momentum of each of your attacks feeds into the next blow in the routine, creating a brutal rhythm that enables you to give your target one continuous beatdown. Strike twice, once with your weapon and once with its haft. Each attack counts towards your multiple attack penalty, but do not increase your penalty until you have made both attacks. Then Strike twice again, once with your weapon and once with its haft.

_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 분당 1회

요구 사항 당신은 하프트 스트라이커 스탠스에 있습니다.

각 공격의 추진력이 다음 타격으로 이어지며 잔혹한 리듬을 만들어내, 대상에게 끊임없는 연타를 가할 수 있게 합니다. 무기로 한 번, 자루로 한 번, 총 두 번 공격하세요. 각 공격은 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되나, 두 번 모두 공격을 완료하기 전까지는 페널티를 증가시키지 마십시오. 그런 다음 다시 무기로 한 번, 자루로 한 번, 총 두 번 공격하세요.

name: Fearsome Fangs

description.value: Your claws and jaws are brutally powerful and efficient, even by ursine standards. The base damage of your jaws unarmed attack from Ursine Avenger Form increases to 1d12. The base damage of your claws unarmed attack from Ursine Avenger Form increases to 1d8.

_desc_en: Your claws and jaws are brutally powerful and efficient, even by ursine standards. The base damage of your jaws unarmed attack from Ursine Avenger Form increases to 1d12. The base damage of your claws unarmed attack from Ursine Avenger Form increases to 1d8.
_desc_ko: 곰의 기준으로도 당신의 발톱과 이빨은 잔혹할 정도로 강력하고 효율적이다. 곰의 복수자 형태의 비무장 공격 시 이빨의 기본 피해가 1d12로 증가한다. 곰의 복수자 형태의 비무장 공격 시 발톱의 기본 피해가 1d8로 증가한다.

name: Cunning Trickster Mask

description.value: Your mask carries the legacy of Verdant Spider, the Speaker of Needs, allowing you to deceive and outwit your foes. You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} a target from up to 30 feet away, and if you succeed or critically succeed in your Feint attempt, the target of your Feint takes a -2 circumstance penalty to saving throws against your spells until the start of your next turn. If you don't have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.sIeuPW0j39fTZm08]{Conceal Spell} feat, you gain it as a bonus feat, allowing you to disguise your spellcasting from others' eyes. If you already have the Conceal Spell feat, you can use Conceal Spell once per round as a free action instead of as a single action.

_desc_en: Your mask carries the legacy of Verdant Spider, the Speaker of Needs, allowing you to deceive and outwit your foes. You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} a target from up to 30 feet away, and if you succeed or critically succeed in your Feint attempt, the target of your Feint takes a -2 circumstance penalty to saving throws against your spells until the start of your next turn. If you don't have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.sIeuPW0j39fTZm08]{Conceal Spell} feat, you gain it as a bonus feat, allowing you to disguise your spellcasting from others' eyes. If you already have the Conceal Spell feat, you can use Conceal Spell once per round as a free action instead of as a single action.
_desc_ko: 당신의 가면은 욕구의 대변자 버던트 스파이더의 유산을 지니고 있어, 적을 속이고 능수능란하게 제압할 수 있게 합니다. 최대 30피트 거리에서 대상에게 @link[actions.feint]을 시도할 수 있으며, 위장 시도에 성공하거나 대성공하면 대상은 다음 턴 시작까지 당신의 주문에 대한 내성 굴림 시 -2 상황 페널티를 받습니다. @link[feats.conceal-spell] 재주를 보유하지 않았다면, 보너스 재주로 획득하여 타인의 시선으로부터 자신의 주문 시전을 숨길 수 있습니다. 이미 주문 은폐 재주를 보유한 경우, 라운드당 한 번씩 액션 하나 대신 자유 행동으로 주문 은폐를 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Foretell Harm

description.value:
Frequency once per round

Requirements Your previous action was to Cast a non-cantrip Spell that dealt damage.

Your magic echoes ominously as you glimpse injury in the target's future. At the beginning of your target's next turn, it takes damage equal to twice the triggering spell's rank as a seemingly random and minor misfortune finds it. The damage and type of misfortune is of a type matching the spell; for instance, if you dealt fire damage, a flame might spontaneous ignite on them or they might burn a hand on their torch. The target is then temporarily immune to Foretell Harm for 24 hours.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per round

Requirements Your previous action was to Cast a non-cantrip Spell that dealt damage.

Your magic echoes ominously as you glimpse injury in the target's future. _desc_ko:
발동 빈도 라운드당 1회

요구 사항 이전 행동으로 피해를 입은 캐스트 캔트립이 아닌 주문을 시전했어야 함.

당신의 마법이 불길하게 메아리치며, 대상의 미래에 상처가 스쳐 지나간다. 대상의 다음 턴 시작 시, 발동된 주문의 랭크 수치 두 배에 해당하는 피해를 입는다. 마치 우연히 찾아온 사소한 불운처럼 말이다. 피해를 입힌 마법의 속성과 동일한 유형의 불운이 발생한다. 예를 들어 화염 피해를 입혔다면, 대상에게 불꽃이 갑자기 붙거나 횃불에 손을 데일 수 있다. 이후 대상은 24시간 동안 '피해를 예견하다'에 일시적으로 면역이 된다.

name: Blood Frenzy

description.value:
Requirements Your eidolon's last action dealt bleed damage to a living creature.

Your eidolon flies into a frenzy. It gains the benefits of boost eidolon and gains temporary HP equal to your level, but takes a -2 penalty to AC. It can't voluntarily end the frenzy or start another frenzy while in the frenzy.

The frenzy lasts for 1 minute, after which your eidolon is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} for 1 minute and can't start another frenzy for 1 minute.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your eidolon's last action dealt bleed damage to a living creature.

Your eidolon flies into a frenzy. It gains the benefits of boost eidolon and gains temporary HP equal to your level, but takes a -2 penalty to AC. It can't voluntarily end the frenzy or start another frenzy while in the frenzy.

The frenzy lasts for 1 minute, after which your eidolon is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} for 1 minute and can't start another frenzy for 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신의 에이돌론이 마지막 행동으로 살아있는 생물에게 출혈 피해를 입혔습니다.

당신의 에이돌론이 광란 상태에 빠집니다. 에이돌론 강화의 효과를 얻으며, 레벨에 해당하는 임시 HP를 얻지만, AC에 -2 페널티를 받습니다. 광란 상태에서는 스스로 광란을 끝내거나 다른 광란을 시작할 수 없습니다.

광란 상태는 1분간 지속되며, 이후 당신의 에이돌론은 @link[conditions.fatigued]가 되어 1분간 지속되고, 1분 동안 다른 광란 상태를 시작할 수 없습니다.

name: Tripkee Weapon Familiarity

description.value:
You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the tripkee trait. You have familiarity with weapons with the tripkee trait plus the blowgun, dart, hatchet, scythe, and shortbow—for the purpose of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

_desc_en:
You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the tripkee trait. You have familiarity with weapons with the tripkee trait plus the blowgun, dart, hatchet, scythe, and shortbow—for the purpose of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
_desc_ko:
트립키 특성을 가진 모든 흔하지 않은 무기를 사용할 수 있습니다. 숙련도 목적상, 트립키 특성을 가진 무기 외에도 블로우건, 다트, 손도끼, 낫, 단궁에 숙련되어 있습니다. 이 중 무술 무기인 것은 단순 무기로, 고급 무기인 것은 무술 무기로 취급합니다.

5레벨에 도달하면, 이 무기들로 치명타를 기록할 때마다 해당 무기의 치명타 특화 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Vicious Critique

description.value:
Trigger You are about to attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce} a merchant or crafter.

You have an eye for detail and a mouth for pointing out flaws, which makes it all the easier to convince the merchants and crafters of King's Heart to help you. You quickly analyze the triggering creature's wares in hopes of finding something useful in your coercion and attempt a Crafting check.

Critical Success You have plenty to work with and can leave your target shocked with your analysis. If you a roll a success on your Intimidation check, you get a critical success instead. If you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead.

Success As critical success, but you only gain the benefits when rolling a success on your Intimidation check.

Failure You misjudge the wares, which makes you come across as unknowledgeable and less intimidating. You take a –1 circumstance penalty to your Intimidation check to Coerce.

Critical Failure As failure, but the penalty is –2.

_desc_en:
Trigger You are about to attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce} a merchant or crafter.

You have an eye for detail and a mouth for pointing out flaws, which makes it all the easier to convince the merchants and crafters of King's Heart to help you. You quickly analyze the triggering creature's wares in hopes of finding something useful in your coercion and attempt a Crafting check.

Critical Success You have plenty to work with and can leave your target shocked with your analysis. If you a roll a success on your Intimidation check, you get a critical success instead. If you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead.

Success As critical success, but you only gain the benefits when rolling a success on your Intimidation check.

Failure You misjudge the wares, which makes you come across as unknowledgeable and less intimidating. You take a –1 circumstance penalty to your Intimidation check to Coerce.

Critical Failure As failure, but the penalty is –2.
_desc_ko:
트리거 상인이나 제작자를 @link[actions.coerce]하려고 시도합니다.

당신은 세부 사항을 꼼꼼히 살피고 결점을 지적하는 데 능숙하여, 킹스 하트의 상인과 장인들을 설득해 도움을 받기 더욱 수월합니다. 강요에 유용할 만한 것을 찾기 위해 트리거링 생물의 상품을 재빨리 분석하고 제작 판정을 시도합니다.

대성공 당신은 활용할 만한 자료가 풍부하여 분석으로 상대를 충격에 빠뜨릴 수 있습니다. 협박 판정에서 성공을 굴렸다면 대성공으로 대체됩니다. 대실패를 굴렸다면 실패로 대체됩니다.

성공 대성공과 동일하나, 협박 판정에서 성공을 굴릴 때만 이점을 얻습니다.

실패 상품을 잘못 판단하여 무지하고 덜 위협적으로 보입니다. {강요} 위의 협박 판정 시 상황 페널티 -1을 받습니다.

대실패 실패와 동일하나 페널티는 -2입니다.

name: Axuma's Awakening

description.value: Choose two cantrips from the arcane spells list. You can cast these cantrips at will as arcane innate spells. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. Then, choose one 1st-rank spell and one 2nd-rank spell from the arcane spells list. You can cast each of these spells once per day as arcane innate spells. Spells gained from this feat must be common spells or spells to which you have access.

value.value: Exposure to the Well of Axuma

Then, choose one 1st-rank spell and one 2nd-rank spell from the arcane spells list. You can cast each of these spells once per day as arcane innate spells. Spells gained from this feat must be common spells or spells to which you have access.
_desc_ko: 비전 주문 목록에서 두 개의 캔트립을 선택하십시오. 이 캔트립들은 비전 아케인 선천 주문으로 마음대로 시전할 수 있습니다. 캔트립은 레벨의 절반(올림)에 해당하는 주문 랭크으로 강화됩니다. 그런 다음 비전 주문 목록에서 1랭크 주문 하나와 2nd-랭크 주문 하나를 선택하십시오. 이 주문들은 하루에 한 번씩 아케인 선천적 주문으로 시전할 수 있다. 이 피트로 획득한 주문은 반드시 일반 주문이거나 접근 가능한 주문이어야 한다.

name: Amplifying Touch

An ally that recovers Hit Points from your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zNN9212H2FGfM7VS]{Lay on Hands} gains a +1 status bonus to their attack rolls and deals 1 additional spirit damage on all their Strikes until the end of their next turn. In addition, all their Strikes are holy until the end of their next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.94Vuzui165y0rgP5]{Effect: Amplifying Touch}

You take a –1 penalty to your AC against that creature's Strikes until the beginning of your next turn, and your student gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their Strikes against the target creature during that time.

name: Clever Gambit

description.value:
Trigger Your Strike critically hits and deals damage to a creature you've identified with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}.

Your battle tactics are aided by assessing your foe's capabilities and range. You Step or Stride; this movement doesn't trigger reactions from the triggering creature.

name: Sonic Strafe

description.value:
Requirements You currently have a fly Speed.

You can now achieve such flight speeds that your passage splits the very air. Fly twice. Any creature that is adjacent to you at any point during your movement takes @Damage[10d6[sonic]] damage (@Check[fortitude|against:class|basic] save against your class DC). On a critical failure, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 hour.

_desc_en:

You can now achieve such flight speeds that your passage splits the very air. Fly twice. Any creature that is adjacent to you at any point during your movement takes @Damage[10d6[sonic]] damage (@Check[fortitude|against:class|basic] save against your class DC). On a critical failure, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 hour.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 현재 비행 속도를 보유하고 있어야 합니다.

이제 공기를 가르는 비행 속도를 낼 수 있습니다. 비행 2회. 이동 중 어느 시점에서든 인접한 모든 생물은 10d6 음파 피해를 받습니다 (기본 인내 직업 DC 내성에 성공). 대실패 시, 해당 생물은 1시간 동안 @link[conditions.deafened] 상태가 된다.

name: Cheat Death

description.value:
Trigger You take damage that would reduce you to 0 Hit Points.

Somehow you always escape the reaper by a hair's breadth. You avoid being knocked out or killed and remain at 1 Hit Point and gain panache, but you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} (or increase your doomed value by 1 if you were already doomed).

You can't reduce or ignore the doomed condition from Cheating Death. The doomed condition from Cheating Death lasts for 10 minutes, though this doesn't affect the duration of any other doomed condition you have.

_desc_en:

Somehow you always escape the reaper by a hair's breadth. You avoid being knocked out or killed and remain at 1 Hit Point and gain panache, but you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} (or increase your doomed value by 1 if you were already doomed).

You can't reduce or ignore the doomed condition from Cheating Death. The doomed condition from Cheating Death lasts for 10 minutes, though this doesn't affect the duration of any other doomed condition you have.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신이 0 HP로 감소시킬 피해를 입습니다.

어찌된 일인지 당신은 항상 죽음의 사신에게서 간발의 차로 벗어납니다. 기절하거나 죽는 것을 피하고 1 HP로 남으며 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.uBJsxCzNhje8m8jj]{파나슈}를 얻지만, @link[conditions.doomed]{1} 상태가 됩니다(이미 파멸 상태였다면 해당 수치가 1 증가합니다).

죽음을 속임으로 인한 {파멸 상태}는 감소하거나 무시할 수 없습니다. 죽음을 속임으로 인한 {파멸 상태}는 10분 동안 지속되지만, 이는 다른 {파멸 상태}의 지속 시간에는 영향을 미치지 않습니다.

name: Vigorous Health

description.value: You can withstand blood loss startlingly well. Whenever you would gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} condition, you can attempt a @Check[flat|dc:17]. On a success, you don't gain the drained condition.

_desc_en: You can withstand blood loss startlingly well. Whenever you would gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} condition, you can attempt a @Check[flat|dc:17]. On a success, you don't gain the drained condition.
_desc_ko: 당신은 놀라울 정도로 출혈을 잘 견뎌냅니다. @link[conditions.drained] 상태를 얻게 될 때마다, DC 17 단순를 시도할 수 있습니다. 성공 시, 흡수 상태를 얻지 않습니다.

name: General Training

description.value:
Your adaptability manifests in your mastery of a range of useful abilities. You gain a 1st-level general feat. You must meet the feat's prerequisites, but if you select this feat during character creation, you can select the feat later in the process in order to determine which prerequisites you meet.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, choosing a different feat each time.

You must meet the feat's prerequisites, but if you select this feat during character creation, you can select the feat later in the process in order to determine which prerequisites you meet.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, choosing a different feat each time.
_desc_ko:
당신의 적응력은 다양한 유용한 능력에 대한 숙련도로 창조됩니다. 1레벨 일반 피트를 획득합니다. 해당 피트 재주의 전제 조건을 충족해야 하지만, 캐릭터 생성 시 이 피트를 선택한 경우, 전제 조건 충족 여부를 확인하기 위해 생성 과정 후반에 피트를 선택할 수 있습니다.

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있으며, 매번 다른 피트를 선택해야 합니다.

name: Storming Gaze

description.value:
You can open or energize a notable third eye on your forehead to strike with storming power. You deal @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))d4[@item.flags.system.rulesSelections.stormingGaze]|options:area-damage]{3d4 electricity or 3d4 sonic damage} in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15]; Storming Gaze gains this trait. Each creature in the area must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. You can't use this ability again for [[/r 1d4 #Recharge Storming Gaze]]{1d4 rounds}.

At 7th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d4.
