_desc_ko:
당신은 구울 열병에 굴복하여 죽음을 맞이하고, 죽은 살점을 향한 끝없는 갈망에 저주받은 언데드인 구울로 되살아납니다. 이 갈망은 서서히 당신의 이성과 의지를 압도하여, 갈망하는 식사를 위해 무엇이든 하게 만듭니다. 성격 변화 외에도 신체도 변합니다. 귀는 뾰족해지고 피부는 푸르스름하고 창백해진다. 손톱은 발톱처럼 날카로워지고, 이빨은 뼈에서 살점을 뜯어낼 만큼 날카로워지며, 혀는 길고 뾰족해진다.

너는 구울 특성과 언데드 특성, 그리고 @link[feats.basic-undead-benefits]을 얻는다. 네 언데드적 갈망은 죽은 생물의 살점을 향한다; 지성을 가진 생물의 갓 죽은 시체가 지성을 갖지 않거나 썩은 시체보다 갈망을 훨씬 더 충족시키지만, 어떤 죽은 생물이라도 적어도 잠시 동안은 굶주림을 달랠 수 있다. 당신은 격투 무기 그룹에서 두 번의 비무장 공격을 얻습니다. 첫 번째 비무장 공격은 기민한성과 기교 특성을 지닌 1d4 베기 피해를 주는 발톱이며, 두 번째 비무장 공격은 1d6 관통 피해를 주고 기교 특성을 지닌 턱입니다.

@link[actions.consume-flesh] 행동을 획득한다. 갈망을 충족시키는 것은 어렵다. 육체를 섭취하면 일시적으로 포만감을 얻는다. 많은 구울 피트는 포만 상태일 때 사용할 수 있는 추가 능력이나 기능을 지니지만, 해당 능력 사용 시 포만 상태는 해제됩니다. 언제든 육체 섭취는 가능하나, 정상량 이상 섭취해도 추가 효과는 없습니다. 구울의 배고픔은 포만 상태이거나 그렇지 않은 상태뿐입니다.

name: Triple Threat

description.value: You can divide your attention three ways when hunting. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JYi4MnsdFu618hPm]{Hunt Prey}, you can designate three creatures as prey, designate two creatures as prey and share the effect with one ally (as Shared Prey), or designate one creature as prey and share the effect with two allies.

_desc_en: You can divide your attention three ways when hunting. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JYi4MnsdFu618hPm]{Hunt Prey}, you can designate three creatures as prey, designate two creatures as prey and share the effect with one ally (as Shared Prey), or designate one creature as prey and share the effect with two allies.
_desc_ko: 사냥 시 주의를 세 방향으로 분산시킬 수 있습니다. @link[actions.hunt-prey]을 사용할 때, 세 마리의 생물을 사냥감 추적 대상으로 지정하거나, 두 마리의 생물을 사냥감 추적 대상으로 지정하고 한 명의 아군과 효과를 공유하거나(공유 사냥감 추적), 한 마리의 생물을 사냥감 추적 대상으로 지정하고 두 명의 아군과 효과를 공유할 수 있습니다.

name: Reflective Pocket

description.value: You've formed a connection with a small hand mirror, allowing you to use it as an extradimensional storage space. You can store one item of light Bulk in your mirror at a time. Storing or retrieving an item requires an Interact action and any creature can do so. While an item is stored within the mirror, the mirror reflects the item's image. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.qVNVSmsgpKFGk9hV]{Conceal the Object} unless someone checks the mirror's reflection.

_desc_en: You've formed a connection with a small hand mirror, allowing you to use it as an extradimensional storage space. You can store one item of light Bulk in your mirror at a time. Storing or retrieving an item requires an Interact action and any creature can do so. While an item is stored within the mirror, the mirror reflects the item's image. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.qVNVSmsgpKFGk9hV]{Conceal the Object} unless someone checks the mirror's reflection.
_desc_ko: 작은 손거울과 연결을 형성하여 초차원 저장 공간으로 사용할 수 있습니다. 거울에는 한 번에 가벼운 벌크의 아이템 하나를 보관할 수 있습니다. 물건을 보관하거나 꺼내는 데는 상호작용 행동이 필요하며, 어떤 생물도 이를 수행할 수 있습니다. 물건이 거울 안에 보관되어 있는 동안, 거울은 그 물건의 이미지를 반사합니다. 누군가가 거울의 반사상을 판정하지 않는 한, @link[actions.conceal-an-object] 은신 검사 시 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Arcane Sight

description.value: You've trained yourself to constantly be on the lookout for magical effects, even when focusing on looking out for other things. When you are Searching, you also gain the benefits of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Yb0C1uLzeHrVLl7a]{Detect Magic} unless you choose not to.

value.value: ability to cast the detect magic cantrip

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: You've trained yourself to constantly be on the lookout for magical effects, even when focusing on looking out for other things. When you are Searching, you also gain the benefits of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Yb0C1uLzeHrVLl7a]{Detect Magic} unless you choose not to.
_desc_ko: 당신은 다른 것에 포커스를 둘 때조차 마법 효과를 끊임없이 감지하도록 자신을 훈련시켰습니다. 탐색 중일 때, 선택하지 않는 한 @link[actions.detect-magic]의 이점도 얻습니다.

name: Evolved Spellhorn

description.value: Your inborn arcane power grows. Choose one common 1st-rank arcane spell and one common 2nd-rank arcane spell. You can cast each of these spells once per day as arcane innate spells.

_desc_en: Your inborn arcane power grows. Choose one common 1st-rank arcane spell and one common 2nd-rank arcane spell. You can cast each of these spells once per day as arcane innate spells.
_desc_ko: 선천적인 아케인 힘이 성장한다. 일반 1랭크 아케인 주문 하나와 일반 2랭크 아케인 주문 하나를 선택한다. 이 주문들은 하루에 한 번씩 아케인 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있다.

name: Crystal Keeper Dedication

description.value:
You can use Arcana, Occultism, Religion, or Society to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing} by meditating before a crystal, regardless of the type of writing. When you Decipher Writing and roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead, and when you Decipher Writing and roll a success, you get a critical success instead.

Additionally, you gain resistance 10 to damage from hazards associated with crystals.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.rxyJUbQosVfgRjLr]{Crystal Keeper}

value.value: trained in Elven Lore or Society

publication.title: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City

_desc_en:
You can use Arcana, Occultism, Religion, or Society to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing} by meditating before a crystal, regardless of the type of writing. When you Decipher Writing and roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead, and when you Decipher Writing and roll a success, you get a critical success instead.

Additionally, you gain resistance 10 to damage from hazards associated with crystals.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.rxyJUbQosVfgRjLr]{Crystal Keeper}
_desc_ko:
주문학, 오컬트, 종교 또는 사회 능력으로 @link[actions.decipher-writing]을 수행할 수 있습니다. 글자의 종류에 관계없이 수정 앞에서 명상함으로써 가능합니다. 문자 해독 시 대실패를 굴리면 실패로 처리되며, 성공을 굴리면 대성공으로 처리됩니다.

또한, 수정과 관련된 위험으로부터 받는 피해에 대해 저항력 10을 얻습니다.

name: Domain Fluency

description.value: You command a deep understanding of the domains related to your mystery. Choose one of the domains associated with your mystery for which you have an initial domain spell. You gain an advanced domain spell from that domain, which you cast as a revelation spell.

_desc_en: You command a deep understanding of the domains related to your mystery. Choose one of the domains associated with your mystery for which you have an initial domain spell. You gain an advanced domain spell from that domain, which you cast as a revelation spell.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신의 신비와 관련된 도메인에 대한 깊은 이해를 지니고 있습니다. 초기 도메인 주문을 가진 신비와 연관된 도메인 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 해당 도메인의 고급 도메인 주문을 얻으며, 이를 계시 주문으로 시전합니다.

name: Claw and Talon Flow

description.value:
Requirements You're in either claw stance or talon stance.

You fluidly shift between your two stances. You use the unarmed attack associated with your current clawdancer stance, then switch into the other stance (if you're in claw stance, make a frenzied claw Strike and then shift to talon stance, or vice versa).

_desc_en:
Requirements You're in either claw stance or talon stance.

You fluidly shift between your two stances. You use the unarmed attack associated with your current clawdancer stance, then switch into the other stance (if you're in claw stance, make a frenzied claw Strike and then shift to talon stance, or vice versa).
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 발톱 자세 또는 뾰족발톱 자세 중 하나를 취하고 있어야 한다.

두 자세 사이를 유연하게 전환합니다. 현재 발톱무용수 자세에 연결된 비무장 공격을 사용한 후 다른 자세로 전환합니다(발톱 자세일 경우 광란의 발톱 공격을 수행한 후 발톱발톱 자세로 전환하거나 그 반대의 경우).

name: Misty Transformation

description.value:
Frequency once per minute

Trigger You transform due to a polymorph effect. Wild mists cover your form.

You create a hazy cloud in a @Template[burst|distance:5] centered on one corner of your space. If your new form is Large or larger, the cloud covers your entire space instead. All creatures within the area are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all others are concealed to them. The cloud lasts until the beginning of your next turn but is immediately dispersed by a strong wind.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per minute

Trigger You transform due to a polymorph effect. Wild mists cover your form.

You create a hazy cloud in a @Template[burst|distance:5] centered on one corner of your space. If your new form is Large or larger, the cloud covers your entire space instead. All creatures within the area are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all others are concealed to them. The cloud lasts until the beginning of your next turn but is immediately dispersed by a strong wind.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 분당 1회

발동 조건 다형 효과로 인해 변신합니다. 야생의 안개가 당신의 모습을 감쌉니다.

당신은 자신의 공간 한 모서리를 중심으로 5피트 크기의 흐릿한 안개를 생성합니다. 새로운 형태가 대형 이상일 경우, 안개는 당신의 전체 공간을 덮습니다. 영역 내 모든 생물은 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태가 되며, 그들에게는 다른 모든 대상이 가려진다. 이 안개는 다음 턴 시작까지 지속되나 강한 바람에 즉시 흩어진다.

name: Draconic Arrogance

description.value: Few can sway you from your goals while the fury of combat fills you. While raging, you gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against emotion effects.

_desc_en: Few can sway you from your goals while the fury of combat fills you. While raging, you gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against emotion effects.
_desc_ko: 전투의 분노가 당신을 채울 때, 목표에서 당신을 흔들 수 있는 이는 거의 없습니다. 격노 상태에서는 감정 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Everdistant Defense

description.value:
Trigger A creature within your aura is targeted by a ranged attack or a creature moves through your aura.

Requirements You have at least one aura from a champion feat or feature.

The spatial barrier of Syndara's Island has taught you that distance can foil enemies better than any armor. You warp space, causing each square within your aura that the attack or creature would move through to count as triple the distance. If this reaction is used on a ranged attack, the attack takes range increment penalties based on the adjusted range and fails if this would cause it to exceed its maximum range.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature within your aura is targeted by a ranged attack or a creature moves through your aura.

Requirements You have at least one aura from a champion feat or feature.

The spatial barrier of Syndara's Island has taught you that distance can foil enemies better than any armor. You warp space, causing each square within your aura that the attack or creature would move through to count as triple the distance. If this reaction is used on a ranged attack, the attack takes range increment penalties based on the adjusted range and fails if this would cause it to exceed its maximum range.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신의 오라 안에 있는 생물이 원거리 공격의 표적이 되거나, 생물이 당신의 오라를 통과할 때.

요구 사항 챔피언 특기나 특성으로 얻은 오라를 하나 이상 보유 중이어야 한다.

신다라 섬의 공간 장벽을 통해 당신은 어떤 갑옷보다 거리가 적을 더 효과적으로 저지한다는 사실을 깨달았다. 공격이나 생물이 통과하려는 오라 내 각 칸의 거리를 3배로 계산하도록 공간을 왜곡합니다. 이 반응이 원거리 공격에 사용될 경우, 공격은 조정된 사거리에 따른 사거리 증가 페널티를 받으며, 이로 인해 최대 사거리를 초과하게 되면 실패합니다.

name: Vellumis Excision

description.value:
Access You're a member of the Vellumis Scholars.

You seek to excise the rot from the Gravelands and have made progress to do so. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.x5rGOmhDRDVQPrnW]{Field of Life} as a 6th-rank halcyon spell, and you gain a 6th-rank halcyon spell slot. When you cast your halcyon field of life as a primal spell, any living creatures in the area when you Sustain the spell gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against curses, diseases, and poisons for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.KHxkVwXSFsN3eATu]{Effect: Vellumis Excision}

Special If you have the Halcyon Spellcasting Sage feat, you treat the field of life halcyon spell gained from this feat as a signature spell, even though halcyon spells normally can't be signature spells.

_desc_en:
Access You're a member of the Vellumis Scholars.

You seek to excise the rot from the Gravelands and have made progress to do so. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.x5rGOmhDRDVQPrnW]{Field of Life} as a 6th-rank halcyon spell, and you gain a 6th-rank halcyon spell slot. When you cast your halcyon field of life as a primal spell, any living creatures in the area when you Sustain the spell gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against curses, diseases, and poisons for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.KHxkVwXSFsN3eATu]{Effect: Vellumis Excision}

Special If you have the Halcyon Spellcasting Sage feat, you treat the field of life halcyon spell gained from this feat as a signature spell, even though halcyon spells normally can't be signature spells.
_desc_ko:
접근 당신은 벨루미스 학회의 일원이다.

당신은 그레이브 랜드의 부패를 제거하고자 하며, 이를 위해 진전을 이루었습니다. @link[spells.field-of-life]을 6랭크 할시온 주문으로 시전할 수 있으며, 6랭크 할시온 주문 슬롯을 획득합니다. 당신이 평온의 생명 필드를 프라이멀 마법으로 시전할 때, 마법 유지 시 해당 영역에 있는 모든 생명체는 1라운드 동안 저주, 질병, 독에 대한 내성 굴림에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.KHxkVwXSFsN3eATu]{Effect: Vellumis Excision}

Special 당신이 '평온한 주문 시전 현자' 피트를 가지고 있다면, 이 피트로 얻은 생명 영역 평온한 주문을 시그니처 주문으로 취급한다. 비록 평온한 주문은 일반적으로 시그니처 주문이 될 수 없더라도.

name: Take Wing

description.value:
Frequency once per round

You have strengthened your wings and can now fly for short distances. You Fly. If you don't normally have a fly Speed, you gain a fly Speed of 15 feet for this movement. If you aren't on solid ground at the end of this movement, you fall.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per round

You have strengthened your wings and can now fly for short distances. You Fly. If you don't normally have a fly Speed, you gain a fly Speed of 15 feet for this movement. If you aren't on solid ground at the end of this movement, you fall.
_desc_ko:
빈도 라운드당 한 번

당신은 날개를 강화하여 이제 짧은 거리를 날 수 있습니다. 당신은 비행합니다. 평소 비행 이동력이 없다면, 이 이동에 한해 15피트의 비행 이동력을 얻습니다. 이 이동이 끝날 때 단단한 지면 위에 있지 않다면, 당신은 추락합니다.

name: Rivethun Devotion

description.value: Through study, dedication, and introspection, you've learned to wield magic that affects the spirit. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yHujiDQPdtXW797e]{Spirit Link} as 2nd-rank divine innate spells. You can cast each of these spells once per day. If you're a master in Religion, spirit link is heightened to 3rd rank. If you're legendary in Religion, spirit link is heightened to 4th rank.

_desc_en: Through study, dedication, and introspection, you've learned to wield magic that affects the spirit. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yHujiDQPdtXW797e]{Spirit Link} as 2nd-rank divine innate spells. You can cast each of these spells once per day. If you're a master in Religion, spirit link is heightened to 3rd rank. If you're legendary in Religion, spirit link is heightened to 4th rank.
_desc_ko: 연구와 헌신, 내적 성찰을 통해 당신은 영혼에 영향을 미치는 마법을 다루는 법을 터득했습니다. 당신은 @link[spells.see-the-unseen]와 @link[spells.spirit-link]을 2랭크 신성 선천 마법으로 얻습니다. 이 주문들은 하루에 한 번씩 시전할 수 있습니다. 종교 숙련도가 달인라면 영혼의 연결이 (3rd)랭크으로 강화됩니다. 종교 숙련도가 전설이라면 영혼의 연결이 (4th)랭크으로 강화됩니다.

name: Dual Onslaught

description.value:
When you lash out with both weapons, you leave no room for the target to escape your attack.

When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.onde0SxLoxLBTnvm]{Double Slice}, if you miss with both @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{Strikes}, choose one of the two weapons and apply the effects of a hit with that weapon.

You can't choose a weapon if your attack roll with that weapon was a critical failure, meaning you still miss entirely if both attack rolls were critical failures.

_desc_en:
When you lash out with both weapons, you leave no room for the target to escape your attack.

When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.onde0SxLoxLBTnvm]{Double Slice}, if you miss with both @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{Strikes}, choose one of the two weapons and apply the effects of a hit with that weapon.

You can't choose a weapon if your attack roll with that weapon was a critical failure, meaning you still miss entirely if both attack rolls were critical failures.
_desc_ko:
두 무기로 동시에 공격할 때, 상대가 공격을 피할 여지를 남기지 않는다.

@link[feats.double-slice]를 사용할 때, 두 @link[actions.strike] 모두 빗나갔다면 두 무기 중 하나를 선택하여 해당 무기로 명중한 효과를 적용한다.

해당 무기로 명중 굴림이 대실패인 경우 무기를 선택할 수 없습니다. 즉, 두 명중 굴림 모두 대실패인 경우 여전히 완전히 빗나갑니다.

name: Call of Elysium

description.value:
The wild wonder of Elysium harmonizes within you, and in dire straits, you can share its benefits with your allies.

Your Speed increases by 5 feet; the Speed increase from this feat isn't cumulative with any Speed increase from your ancestry feats (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.kCO4r8NOm8E2T3eH]{Nimble Elf}).

Allies who begin their turn in combat adjacent to you gain a +5-foot status bonus to their Speed for the round.

_desc_en:
The wild wonder of Elysium harmonizes within you, and in dire straits, you can share its benefits with your allies.

Your Speed increases by 5 feet; the Speed increase from this feat isn't cumulative with any Speed increase from your ancestry feats (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.kCO4r8NOm8E2T3eH]{Nimble Elf}).

Allies who begin their turn in combat adjacent to you gain a +5-foot status bonus to their Speed for the round.
_desc_ko:
엘리시움의 야생적 경이로움이 당신 안에서 조화를 이루며, 위급한 순간에 그 혜택을 아군과 나눌 수 있습니다.

당신의 이동 속도가 5피트 증가합니다. 이 재주로 인한 이동 속도 증가는 조상 재주(예: @link[feats.nimble-elf])로 인한 이동 속도 증가와 중첩되지 않습니다.

전투 중 자신의 턴을 당신과 인접한 상태로 시작하는 아군은 해당 라운드 동안 이동 속도에 +5피트 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Guerrilla Dedication

description.value:
You're skilled in subtle tactics and using the environment against your enemies. You become trained in your choice of Deception or Thievery; if you are already trained in both, you become an expert in one instead. When you take this dedication, choose a single, discrete urban or wilderness location, such as "Mzali" or "the Verduran Forest"; this becomes your favored location. When you are in this location and undetected by all enemies, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} without attempting a Stealth check as long as you move no more than half your Speed. During exploration, this also allows you to automatically approach within 15 feet of other creatures while Avoiding their Notice, as long as they aren't actively Searching or on guard.

You can change your favored location by spending 1 week of downtime in the new location you would like to set as your favored location.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.6bVnGg5GyWZgYZst]{Guerrilla}

_desc_en:
You're skilled in subtle tactics and using the environment against your enemies. You become trained in your choice of Deception or Thievery; if you are already trained in both, you become an expert in one instead. When you take this dedication, choose a single, discrete urban or wilderness location, such as "Mzali" or "the Verduran Forest"; this becomes your favored location. When you are in this location and undetected by all enemies, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} without attempting a Stealth check as long as you move no more than half your Speed. During exploration, this also allows you to automatically approach within 15 feet of other creatures while Avoiding their Notice, as long as they aren't actively Searching or on guard.

You can change your favored location by spending 1 week of downtime in the new location you would like to set as your favored location.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.6bVnGg5GyWZgYZst]{Guerrilla}
_desc_ko:
당신은 교묘한 전술과 환경을 이용해 적을 제압하는 데 능숙합니다. 기만 또는 도둑질 중 하나를 선택하여 숙련됩니다. 이미 두 가지 모두 숙련된 경우, 그중 하나를 전문적으로 숙련됩니다. 이 헌신을 선택할 때, "므잘리"나 "베르두란 숲"처럼 도시나 야생의 특정 장소를 하나 선택하십시오. 이곳이 당신의 선호 장소가 됩니다. 이 장소에 있고 모든 적에게 발각되지 않은 상태라면, 이동 속도의 절반 이하로 움직일 때, 은신 시도 없이 @link[actions.sneak]할 수 있습니다. 탐사 중에는 이 능력으로 다른 생물체로부터 15피트 이내로 자동 접근할 수 있으며, 상대가 적극적으로 탐색 중이거나 경계 상태가 아닌 한 그들의 주의를 피할 수 있습니다.

선호 위치를 변경하려면, 선호 위치로 설정하고자 하는 새로운 장소에서 1주의 다운타임을 보내야 합니다.

name: Whirling Grindstone

description.value:
A whirling grindstone made of flint appears in an unoccupied square within 30 feet. The grindstone shreds flesh and shoots sparks. Attempt an @Check[impulse|defense:ac]{impulse attack} roll against the AC of a creature adjacent to the grindstone. On a hit, the creature takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -4)/5)+2)d6[slashing], (floor((@actor.level -4)/5)+1)d6[fire]] damage (or double damage on a critical hit). The grindstone lasts until the end of your next turn, and you can Sustain the impulse up to 1 minute. On subsequent turns, the first time you Sustain the impulse that turn, you can roll the grindstone up to 20 feet and can repeat the attack.

A creature within reach of the grindstone can Interact with it to sharpen a metal weapon. This grants a +2 circumstance bonus to the next damage roll made with that weapon within 1 minute.

Level (+5) The grindstone's damage increases by 1d6 slashing and 1d6 fire, and the bonus to weapons increases by 1.

_desc_en:
A whirling grindstone made of flint appears in an unoccupied square within 30 feet. The grindstone shreds flesh and shoots sparks. Attempt an @Check[impulse|defense:ac]{impulse attack} roll against the AC of a creature adjacent to the grindstone. On a hit, the creature takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -4)/5)+2)d6[slashing], (floor((@actor.level -4)/5)+1)d6[fire]] damage (or double damage on a critical hit). The grindstone lasts until the end of your next turn, and you can Sustain the impulse up to 1 minute. On subsequent turns, the first time you Sustain the impulse that turn, you can roll the grindstone up to 20 feet and can repeat the attack.

A creature within reach of the grindstone can Interact with it to sharpen a metal weapon. This grants a +2 circumstance bonus to the next damage roll made with that weapon within 1 minute.

Level (+5) The grindstone's damage increases by 1d6 slashing and 1d6 fire, and the bonus to weapons increases by 1.
_desc_ko:
화강암으로 만들어진 회전하는 숫돌이 30피트 이내의 비어 있는 칸에 나타난다. 숫돌은 살점을 갈가리 찢고 불꽃을 뿜어낸다. 숫돌에 인접한 생물의 AC를 상대로 임펄스 명중 굴림을 시도하다. 명중 시, 생물은 참격 화염의 피해를 입는다 (치명타 시 피해는 두 배가 된다). 연마석은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 지속되며, 최대 1분 동안 임펄스를 유지할 수 있다. 이후 차례에서 해당 차례에 처음으로 임펄스를 유지할 때, 연마석을 최대 20피트까지 굴릴 수 있으며 공격을 반복할 수 있다.

갈돌이 손이 닿는 범위 내의 생물은 이를 이용해 금속 무기를 갈 수 있습니다. 이로 인해 1분 이내에 해당 무기로 가하는 다음 피해 주사위 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스가 부여됩니다.

레벨 (+5) 숫돌의 피해량이 베기 1d6과 화염 1d6 증가하며, 무기에 부여되는 보너스가 1 증가합니다.

name: Bloodsoaked Dash

description.value: Injuries don't bother you anymore—in fact, the pain invigorates you. If you're at or below half of your maximum Hit Points, you gain a 10-foot status bonus to all of your Speeds.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Injuries don't bother you anymore—in fact, the pain invigorates you. If you're at or below half of your maximum Hit Points, you gain a 10-foot status bonus to all of your Speeds.
_desc_ko: 부상은 더 이상 당신을 괴롭히지 않습니다-사실, 고통이 당신을 활기차게 만듭니다. 최대 HP의 절반 이하일 경우, 모든 이동 속도에 10피트 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Whispers of Warning

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You would be hit, but not critically hit, by an attack.

Your protective apparitions alert you to an incoming attack. The attacker must roll its attack roll a second time and take the lower result.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You would be hit, but not critically hit, by an attack.

Your protective apparitions alert you to an incoming attack. The attacker must roll its attack roll a second time and take the lower result.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 10분마다 한 번

발동 조건 공격을 받아 치명타는 아니지만 피해를 입을 때.

보호 유령이 다가오는 공격을 경고합니다. 공격자는 명중 굴림을 다시 한 번 굴려야 하며, 더 낮은 결과를 적용받습니다.

name: Desperate Wrath

description.value:
Trigger Your turn begins, and your current Hit Points are at half your maximum or less.

Your blood boils when you take a beating, and you throw caution to the wind to finish the fight. You get a +2 circumstance bonus to attack rolls, a –1 penalty to AC, and a –1 penalty to saves. These bonuses and penalties last until your Rage ends or until you are above half Hit Points, whichever comes first.

_desc_en:
Trigger Your turn begins, and your current Hit Points are at half your maximum or less.

Your blood boils when you take a beating, and you throw caution to the wind to finish the fight. You get a +2 circumstance bonus to attack rolls, a –1 penalty to AC, and a –1 penalty to saves. These bonuses and penalties last until your Rage ends or until you are above half Hit Points, whichever comes first.
_desc_ko:
발동조건 당신의 턴이 시작되고, 현재 HP가 최대 HP의 절반 이하일 때.

당신은 구타를 당할 때 피가 끓어오르며, 싸움을 끝내기 위해 신중함을 내던집니다. 명중 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻고, AC에 -1 페널티, 내성에 -1 페널티를 받습니다. 이 보너스와 페널티는 분노가 끝날 때까지 또는 HP가 절반 이상으로 회복될 때까지 지속됩니다. 둘 중 먼저 발생하는 시점까지입니다.

name: Hellspawn

description.value: Your lineage descends from devils, conniving schemers of Hell. You're as skilled at noticing lies and twisted wordings as you are at constructing them. You are trained in Deception and Legal Lore. If you were already trained in Deception (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Dvz54d6aPhjsmUux]{Lie to Me} skill feat.

_desc_en: Your lineage descends from devils, conniving schemers of Hell. You're as skilled at noticing lies and twisted wordings as you are at constructing them. You are trained in Deception and Legal Lore. If you were already trained in Deception (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Dvz54d6aPhjsmUux]{Lie to Me} skill feat.
_desc_ko: 당신의 혈통은 지옥의 교활한 음모가인 데빌로부터 이어져 왔습니다. 거짓말과 뒤틀린 표현을 만들어내는 것만큼이나 그것들을 간파하는 데도 능숙하다. 당신은 기만과 법률 지식에 숙련되어 있다. 만약 이미 기만에 숙련되어 있었다면(배경이나 직업 등으로 인해), 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련되어 있다. 또한 @link[feats.lie-to-me] 기술 재주를 얻는다.

name: Emerald Boughs Accustomation

description.value: You are comfortable and socially capable in almost any cultural context. When you use the Society skill to Subsist, if you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead; if you roll a success, you get a critical success instead; and if you roll a critical success, you can provide for another additional creature. Furthermore, when you attempt a Society check to Recall Knowledge about cultural practices and roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead.

_desc_en: You are comfortable and socially capable in almost any cultural context. When you use the Society skill to Subsist, if you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead; if you roll a success, you get a critical success instead; and if you roll a critical success, you can provide for another additional creature. Furthermore, when you attempt a Society check to Recall Knowledge about cultural practices and roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 거의 모든 문화적 맥락에서 편안하고 사회적으로 능숙합니다. 사회 기술로 생계를 유지할 때, 대실패를 굴리면 실패로 대체되고, 성공을 굴리면 대성공으로 대체되며, 대성공을 굴리면 추가 생물 한 마리를 부양할 수 있습니다. 또한 문화적 관습에 대한 지식을 회상하기 위해 사회성 판정을 시도하고 대실패를 굴리면, 대신 실패로 처리됩니다.

name: Embed Aeon Stone

description.value:
You discover the secrets to embedding aeon stones into your flesh. You spend 1 day attuning to an aeon stone and physically embedding it in your skin. While the stone is embedded this way, you gain the benefits of the aeon stone as if it were orbiting above your head, but it protects the stone from being noticed or stolen as easily. Aeon stones in your flesh must be invested to function, as usual.

You can also use this activity to safely remove an embedded aeon stone in 1 day. Someone without this feat can attempt to surgically remove it safely by spending 1 day and succeeding at a @Check[medicine|dc:30|showDC:all] check, or hastily by simply ripping it from a corpse.

_desc_en:
You discover the secrets to embedding aeon stones into your flesh. You spend 1 day attuning to an aeon stone and physically embedding it in your skin. While the stone is embedded this way, you gain the benefits of the aeon stone as if it were orbiting above your head, but it protects the stone from being noticed or stolen as easily. Aeon stones in your flesh must be invested to function, as usual.

You can also use this activity to safely remove an embedded aeon stone in 1 day. Someone without this feat can attempt to surgically remove it safely by spending 1 day and succeeding at a @Check[medicine|dc:30|showDC:all] check, or hastily by simply ripping it from a corpse.
_desc_ko:
당신은 에온 스톤을 육체에 삽입하는 비결을 발견합니다. 1일을 들여 에온 스톤을 조율하고 피부 속에 물리적으로 삽입한다. 이렇게 삽입된 상태에서는 에온 스톤이 머리 위를 공전하는 것과 동일한 효과를 얻지만, 쉽게 발견되거나 도난당하지 않도록 보호된다. 육체에 삽입된 에온 스톤은 평소처럼 투자를 해야 기능한다.

이 활동을 통해 1일 만에 이식된 에온 스톤을 안전하게 제거할 수도 있다. 이 피트가 없는 자는 1일을 소모하고 DC 30 의학 판정에서 성공하면 안전하게 수술적 제거를 시도할 수 있으며, 시체에서 단순히 뜯어내는 방식으로 급하게 제거할 수도 있다.

name: Ranger's Bramble

description.value: You can cause plants to grow and trap your foes with thorns. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KktHf7zIAWOr499h]{Ranger's Bramble} warden spell. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.

_desc_en: You can cause plants to grow and trap your foes with thorns. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KktHf7zIAWOr499h]{Ranger's Bramble} warden spell. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.
_desc_ko: 식물을 자라게 하여 가시로 적을 가둘 수 있습니다. @link[spells.rangers-bramble] 워든 주문을 획득합니다. 포커스 풀의 포커스 포인트 수를 1 증가시킵니다.

name: Entreat with Forebears

description.value:
Something about your presence causes creatures of your bloodline to, consciously or not, recognize you as one of their own, and you become inured to their tricks.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy, Deception, and Intimidation checks when interacting with creatures that have the trait corresponding to your bloodline, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception and saving throws against such creatures.

For example, an aberrant bloodline sorcerer would gain this benefit against creatures with the aberration trait. The GM is the final arbiter of which creatures match your bloodline.

value.value: a bloodline that corresponds with a creature trait

_desc_en:
Something about your presence causes creatures of your bloodline to, consciously or not, recognize you as one of their own, and you become inured to their tricks.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy, Deception, and Intimidation checks when interacting with creatures that have the trait corresponding to your bloodline, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception and saving throws against such creatures.

For example, an aberrant bloodline sorcerer would gain this benefit against creatures with the aberration trait. The GM is the final arbiter of which creatures match your bloodline.
_desc_ko:
당신의 존재감은 혈통을 공유하는 생물들로 하여금 의식적이든 무의식적이든 당신을 동족으로 인식하게 하며, 당신은 그들의 속임수에 면역이 됩니다.

당신은 혈통에 해당하는 특성을 지닌 생물과 상호작용할 때 외교, 기만, 위협 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 그러한 생물에 대한 지각 능력과 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

예를 들어, 이형체 혈통의 소서러는 이형체 특성을 가진 생물에게 이 혜택을 받습니다. 어떤 생물이 당신의 혈통과 일치하는지는 GM이 최종적으로 판단합니다.

name: Terrible Transformation

description.value: You let out a mighty roar as part of your transformation. When you use Ursine Avenger Form, you can make an Intimidation check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} against each enemy within 30 feet that can see you, and you don't take a penalty to your Demoralize check if the creature doesn't understand your language.

_desc_en: You let out a mighty roar as part of your transformation. When you use Ursine Avenger Form, you can make an Intimidation check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} against each enemy within 30 feet that can see you, and you don't take a penalty to your Demoralize check if the creature doesn't understand your language.
_desc_ko: 변신 과정의 일환으로 당신은 우렁찬 포효를 내뿜는다. 곰의 복수자 형태를 사용할 때, 30피트 이내에서 당신을 볼 수 있는 각 적에게 @link[actions.demoralize]를 위한 위협 판정을 시도할 수 있으며, 해당 생물이 당신의 언어를 이해하지 못하더라도 사기 저하 판정 페널티를 받지 않습니다.

name: Bloodrager Dedication

description.value:
Drinking powerful blood has awakened magical potential within you. You gain a spell repertoire with two cantrips of your choice, from either the arcane or divine spell list. You choose these cantrips from the common spells for your tradition or from other spells you have access to on that tradition's spell list. At least one cantrip must require a spell attack roll. You're trained in spell attack modifier and spell DC. Your key spellcasting attribute for these spells is Charisma. Spells in your repertoire gain the rage trait while you are raging, and when you Cast a Spell from your repertoire, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (or increase the value of your drained condition by 1); you can reduce the value of this condition only by Harvesting Blood (see below). You become trained in Arcana if you chose arcane cantrips or Religion if you chose divine cantrips. If you were already trained in this skill, you become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Harvest Blood action.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.V87pMN1WuIHaoYpQ]{Bloodrager}

_desc_en:
Drinking powerful blood has awakened magical potential within you. You gain a spell repertoire with two cantrips of your choice, from either the arcane or divine spell list. You choose these cantrips from the common spells for your tradition or from other spells you have access to on that tradition's spell list. At least one cantrip must require a spell attack roll. You're trained in spell attack modifier and spell DC. Your key spellcasting attribute for these spells is Charisma. Spells in your repertoire gain the rage trait while you are raging, and when you Cast a Spell from your repertoire, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (or increase the value of your drained condition by 1); you can reduce the value of this condition only by Harvesting Blood (see below). You become trained in Arcana if you chose arcane cantrips or Religion if you chose divine cantrips. If you were already trained in this skill, you become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Harvest Blood action.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.V87pMN1WuIHaoYpQ]{Bloodrager}
_desc_ko: 강력한 피를 마심으로써 내면의 마법적 잠재력이 깨어났습니다. 선택한 두 개의 캔트립을 포함한 주문 목록을 얻습니다. 이 캔트립은 아케인 주문 목록이나 신성 주문 목록에서 선택할 수 있습니다. 해당 전통의 공통 주문이나 그 전통의 주문 목록에서 접근 가능한 다른 주문 중에서 선택합니다. 최소 하나의 캔트립은 주문 명중 굴림을 요구해야 합니다. 당신은 주문 공격 수정자와 주문 DC에 숙련됩니다. 당신의 주요 주문 시전 능력치는 매력입니다. 레퍼토리의 주문은 당신이 격노 상태일 때 격노 특성을 얻으며, 레퍼토리의 주문을 시전할 때 당신은 @link[conditions.drained]{1} 상태가 됩니다(또는 기력 소모 상태의 수치를 1 증가시킵니다); 이 상태의 수치는 오직 하베스팅 블러드(하단 참조)로만 감소시킬 수 있습니다. 주문학 캔트립을 선택했다면 주문학에 숙련되고, 신성 캔트립을 선택했다면 종교에 숙련됩니다. 해당 기술에 이미 숙련된 경우, 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다. 또한 하베스팅 블러드 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Light Paws

description.value: You can balance on your toes to step carefully over obstructions. You Stride and then Step, or Step and then Stride, ignoring difficult terrain during this movement.

_desc_en: You can balance on your toes to step carefully over obstructions. You Stride and then Step, or Step and then Stride, ignoring difficult terrain during this movement.
_desc_ko: 발끝으로 균형을 잡으며 장애물을 조심스럽게 넘을 수 있습니다. 이 동작 중에는 어려운 지형을 무시하고, 먼저 이동한 뒤 신중하게 발걸음을 하거나, 발걸음을 한 뒤 이동할 수 있습니다.

name: Preternatural Parry

description.value:
Trigger You're targeted by a Strike or a spell attack roll, or you're about to roll a saving throw against a spell effect.

Requirements You have one or more hands free.

You snap your weapon or limb into place to ward off harm at the last second. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws against the triggering effect until the start of your next turn.

_desc_en:
Trigger You're targeted by a Strike or a spell attack roll, or you're about to roll a saving throw against a spell effect.

Requirements You have one or more hands free.

You snap your weapon or limb into place to ward off harm at the last second. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws against the triggering effect until the start of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신이 타격 또는 주문 명중 굴림의 대상이 되었거나, 주문 효과에 대한 내성 굴림을 수행하려 할 때.

요구 사항 한 손 이상이 자유로워야 합니다.

마지막 순간에 무기나 사지를 제자리에 꽂아 피해를 수호부합니다. 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 유발 효과에 대한 AC와 내성 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Eyes of God

description.value: You can see things as they truly are. You are constantly under the effect of 8th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight} spells. Additionally, you gain a +4 status bonus to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} checks and to your Perception DC against Lies.

_desc_en: You can see things as they truly are. You are constantly under the effect of 8th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight} spells. Additionally, you gain a +4 status bonus to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} checks and to your Perception DC against Lies.
_desc_ko: 당신은 사물을 있는 그대로 볼 수 있습니다. 당신은 지속적으로 (8th) @link[spells.see-the-unseen]와 @link[spells.truesight] 마법의 효과를 받습니다. 또한 @link[actions.sense-motive] 판정 및 거짓말에 대한 지각 DC에 +4 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Drive-By Attack

description.value:
Requirements You are piloting a vehicle.

You can smoothly line up an attack without disrupting your control.You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.uS3qDAgOkZ7b8ERL]{Drive}, gaining the effects of the Drive action for the same number of actions you spent to Drive-By Attack. At any point during your vehicle's movement, you Strike.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are piloting a vehicle.

You can smoothly line up an attack without disrupting your control.You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.uS3qDAgOkZ7b8ERL]{Drive}, gaining the effects of the Drive action for the same number of actions you spent to Drive-By Attack. At any point during your vehicle's movement, you Strike.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 차량을 조종하고 있습니다.

조종을 방해받지 않고 공격을 매끄럽게 연결할 수 있습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.drive]하여, 드라이브-바이 어택에 소모한 액션 수만큼 드라이브 액션의 효과를 얻습니다. 차량 이동 중 언제든지 강타합니다.

name: Terrifying Mien

description.value:
Whether they have heard of your legend or seen your prowess on the field of battle, those already quaking in their boots grow weak when forced to stand against you. You gain resistance against bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage against Strikes made by creatures with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition. This resistance is equal to four times the value of that creature's frightened condition.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.9p4Ieqw6qAkhc4m3]{Effect: Terrifying Mien}

When this resistance applies to at least one of a creature's Strikes during their turn, that creature doesn't reduce the value of their frightened condition at the end of their turn.

_desc_en:
Whether they have heard of your legend or seen your prowess on the field of battle, those already quaking in their boots grow weak when forced to stand against you. You gain resistance against bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage against Strikes made by creatures with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition. This resistance is equal to four times the value of that creature's frightened condition.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.9p4Ieqw6qAkhc4m3]{Effect: Terrifying Mien}

When this resistance applies to at least one of a creature's Strikes during their turn, that creature doesn't reduce the value of their frightened condition at the end of their turn.
_desc_ko:
전설을 들었든 전장에서의 위용을 목격했든, 이미 두려움에 떨던 자들은 당신과 맞서야 할 때 더욱 쇠약해진다. @link[conditions.frightened] 상태의 생물이 가하는 공격에 대해 둔기, 관통, 베기 피해에 대한 저항력을 얻습니다. 이 저항력은 해당 생물의 공포 상태 수치의 4배에 해당합니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.9p4Ieqw6qAkhc4m3]{효과: 공포의 기색}

이 저항이 자신의 턴 동안 적어도 하나의 공격에 적용될 경우, 해당 생물은 자신의 턴 종료 시 공포 상태의 수치를 감소시키지 않는다.

name: Veteran Follower

description.value: Your followers' training has made them veterans of battle. They all become veteran followers.

_desc_en: Your followers' training has made them veterans of battle. They all become veteran followers.
_desc_ko: 추종자들의 훈련은 그들을 전투의 베테랑으로 만들었습니다. 모두 베테랑 추종자가 됩니다.

name: Universal Longevity

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You've perfected your ability to keep up with all the skills you've learned over your long life, so you're almost never truly untrained at a skill. You reflect on your life experiences, changing the skill you selected with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.WoLh16gyDp8y9WOZ]{Ancestral Longevity} (and the skill you selected with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.vfuHVSuExvtyajkW]{Expert Longevity} if you have that feat).

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You've perfected your ability to keep up with all the skills you've learned over your long life, so you're almost never truly untrained at a skill. You reflect on your life experiences, changing the skill you selected with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.WoLh16gyDp8y9WOZ]{Ancestral Longevity} (and the skill you selected with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.vfuHVSuExvtyajkW]{Expert Longevity} if you have that feat).
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

긴 생애 동안 배운 모든 기술을 유지하는 능력을 완벽하게 연마했기에, 어떤 기술도 완전히 익히지 못한 상태가 거의 없습니다. 당신은 자신의 인생 경험을 되돌아보며, @link[feats.ancestral-longevity]로 선택한 기술(그리고 해당 피트를 보유한 경우 @link[feats.expert-longevity]로 선택한 기술)을 변경합니다.

name: Guide the Timeline

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You know the result you want and subtly nudge the timeline to your intended destination. Choose an ally or a foe. If you choose an ally, the next time within the next round that ally makes an attack roll or skill check, they roll it twice and take the higher result; this is a fortune effect. If you choose a foe, the next time within the next round that foe makes an attack roll or skill check, they must roll twice and take the lower result unless they succeed at a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your chronoskimmer DC; this is a misfortune effect. Regardless of your choice, the target becomes temporarily immune for 24 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.bxxek5BP4zqP5GzM]{Effect: Guide the Timeline}

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You know the result you want and subtly nudge the timeline to your intended destination. Choose an ally or a foe. If you choose an ally, the next time within the next round that ally makes an attack roll or skill check, they roll it twice and take the higher result; this is a fortune effect. If you choose a foe, the next time within the next round that foe makes an attack roll or skill check, they must roll twice and take the lower result unless they succeed at a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your chronoskimmer DC; this is a misfortune effect. Regardless of your choice, the target becomes temporarily immune for 24 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.bxxek5BP4zqP5GzM]{Effect: Guide the Timeline}
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

원하는 결과를 알고 있으며, 은밀하게 타임라인을 의도한 방향으로 이끌어갑니다. 아군 또는 적군을 선택하세요. 아군을 선택한 경우, 다음 라운드 내 해당 아군이 명중 굴림이나 스킬 판정을 수행할 때 두 번 굴려 높은 결과를 적용받습니다. 이는 행운 효과입니다. 적을 선택하면, 다음 라운드 내 적의 명중 굴림이나 기술 판정 시 두 번 굴려 낮은 결과를 적용받습니다. 단, 당신의 크로노스키머 DC에 대한 의지 내성에 성공하면 예외입니다. 이는 불운 효과입니다. 선택과 무관하게 대상은 24시간 동안 일시적으로 면역 상태가 됩니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.bxxek5BP4zqP5GzM]{효과: 타임라인 유도}

name: Mysterious Repertoire

description.value:
Your mystery holds unknowable depths of magic not always associated with the divine. You can have one spell in your spell repertoire not on the divine spell list, in addition to spells you've added to your spell list from abilities like divine access.

You cast that spell as a divine spell. You can swap which spell you add and from which tradition as you could any other oracle spell, but you can't use this feat to have more than one spell from another tradition in your spell repertoire at the same time

_desc_en:
Your mystery holds unknowable depths of magic not always associated with the divine. You can have one spell in your spell repertoire not on the divine spell list, in addition to spells you've added to your spell list from abilities like divine access.

You cast that spell as a divine spell. You can swap which spell you add and from which tradition as you could any other oracle spell, but you can't use this feat to have more than one spell from another tradition in your spell repertoire at the same time
_desc_ko:
당신의 신비는 신성 마법과 항상 연관되지 않는 알 수 없는 깊이를 지닙니다. 신성 접근 같은 능력으로 주문 목록에 추가한 주문 외에도, 신성 주문 목록에 없는 주문 하나를 레퍼토리에 가질 수 있습니다.

당신은 그 주문을 신성 주문으로 시전합니다. 다른 오라클 주문과 마찬가지로 추가할 주문과 전통을 바꿀 수 있지만, 이 피트를 사용해 레퍼토리에 다른 전통의 주문을 동시에 두 개 이상 가질 수는 없습니다.

name: Merge with the Source

description.value: You're among the most powerful of Speakers and can adopt the form of the spirits you entreat with. Select one of the following spells, which you can cast once per day as a 7th-rank innate spell. If you're a Faithspeaker, select from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.E3zIZ4pjlOuWeGRz]{Angel Form}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aSDfGcUOUVGU5m1g]{Daemon Form}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dKbv80rlAWVpz83C]{Demon Form}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dR53f0p15EW7D0xC]{Devil Form}, which you cast as a divine spell; if you're a Greenspeaker, select from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1K6AYGisvo9gqdhs]{Elemental Form} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zCcfPS4y5SrZzU2x]{Plant Form}, which you cast as a primal spell.

value.value: budding speaker centaur heritage or Speaker in Training

_desc_en: You're among the most powerful of Speakers and can adopt the form of the spirits you entreat with. Select one of the following spells, which you can cast once per day as a 7th-rank innate spell. If you're a Faithspeaker, select from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.E3zIZ4pjlOuWeGRz]{Angel Form}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aSDfGcUOUVGU5m1g]{Daemon Form}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dKbv80rlAWVpz83C]{Demon Form}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dR53f0p15EW7D0xC]{Devil Form}, which you cast as a divine spell; if you're a Greenspeaker, select from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1K6AYGisvo9gqdhs]{Elemental Form} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zCcfPS4y5SrZzU2x]{Plant Form}, which you cast as a primal spell.
_desc_ko: 당신은 가장 강력한 스피커 중 한 명으로, 간청하는 영혼의 형태를 취할 수 있습니다. 다음 주문 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 이 주문은 하루에 한 번 (7th)랭크 선천적 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 신앙의 화자라면 @link[spells.angel-form], @link[spells.daemon-form], @link[spells.demon-form] 또는 @link[spells.devil-form] 중에서 선택하십시오. 이 주문은 신성 마법으로 시전됩니다. 녹색의 화자라면 @link[spells.elemental-form] 또는 @link[spells.plant-form] 중에서 선택하십시오. 이 주문은 프라이멀 마법으로 시전됩니다.

name: Pei Zing Adept

description.value:
Access Tian Xia origin

You're practiced at timing preparations to the point where you can treat multiple patients at once. During your daily preparations, you can administer up to two elemental medicines to different recipients.

If you're a master in one of the prerequisite skills, you can administer to up to four recipients, and if you're legendary, you can administer to up to eight.

value.value: expert in Crafting, Herbalism Lore, or Medicine

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Access Tian Xia origin

You're practiced at timing preparations to the point where you can treat multiple patients at once. During your daily preparations, you can administer up to two elemental medicines to different recipients.

If you're a master in one of the prerequisite skills, you can administer to up to four recipients, and if you're legendary, you can administer to up to eight.
_desc_ko:
접근 티엔 샤 기원

여러 명의 환자를 동시에 치료할 수 있을 정도로 준비 시점을 숙달했습니다. 일상적인 준비 과정에서 서로 다른 대상에게 최대 두 가지 원소 약을 투여할 수 있습니다.

필수 기술 중 하나에서 마스터라면 최대 4명에게, 전설급이라면 최대 8명에게 투여할 수 있습니다.

name: Superimpose Time Duplicates

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You call alternate versions of yourself, either from a different timeline or perhaps yourself from a different point in your current timeline, to aid you in combat. Until the start of your next turn, these alternate selves flicker in and out in your vicinity, providing flanking for you against all enemies within your reach. Flanking with your time duplicates is the same as flanking with an ally and so is subject to effects like all-around vision or the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.PNpmVmD21zViDtGC]{Deny Advantage} class feature.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

You call alternate versions of yourself, either from a different timeline or perhaps yourself from a different point in your current timeline, to aid you in combat. Until the start of your next turn, these alternate selves flicker in and out in your vicinity, providing flanking for you against all enemies within your reach. Flanking with your time duplicates is the same as flanking with an ally and so is subject to effects like all-around vision or the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.PNpmVmD21zViDtGC]{Deny Advantage} class feature.
_desc_ko:
빈도 시간당 한 번

당신은 다른 타임라인에서, 혹은 현재 타임라인의 다른 시점에서 온 자신의 대체 버전을 소환하여 전투를 지원받습니다. 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 이 대체 자아들은 주변에서 번쩍이며 나타나고 사라지며, 당신의 도달 범위 내 모든 적에게 측면 공격을 제공합니다. 시간 복제체와의 측면 공격은 아군과의 측면 공격과 동일하게 적용되며, 전방위 시야나 @link[feats.deny-advantage] 클래스 특성과 같은 효과의 대상이 됩니다.

name: Shory Aeromancer

description.value: Your ancestors hailed from the flying cities of the Shory, and a few simple tricks have come down through the ages to you. You can cast 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.A2JfEKe6BZcTG1S8]{Fly} on yourself as an innate arcane spell once per day.

_desc_en: Your ancestors hailed from the flying cities of the Shory, and a few simple tricks have come down through the ages to you. You can cast 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.A2JfEKe6BZcTG1S8]{Fly} on yourself as an innate arcane spell once per day.
_desc_ko: 당신의 조상들은 쇼리의 비행 도시 출신이며, 몇 가지 간단한 기술이 세대를 거쳐 전해져 왔습니다. 하루에 한 번, 자신에게 (4th)랭크 @link[spells.fly] 아케인 주문을 선천적 아케인 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Counterspell (Prepared)

description.value:
Trigger A creature Casts a Spell that you have prepared

When a foe Casts a Spell and you can see its manifestations, you can use your magic to disrupt it. You expend a prepared spell to counter the triggering creature's casting of that same spell. You lose your spell slot as if you had cast the triggering spell. You then attempt to counteract the triggering spell.

Special This feat has the trait corresponding to the tradition of spells you cast (arcane, divine, primal, or occult).

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature Casts a Spell that you have prepared

When a foe Casts a Spell and you can see its manifestations, you can use your magic to disrupt it. You expend a prepared spell to counter the triggering creature's casting of that same spell. You lose your spell slot as if you had cast the triggering spell. You then attempt to counteract the triggering spell.

Special This feat has the trait corresponding to the tradition of spells you cast (arcane, divine, primal, or occult).
_desc_ko:
발동 생물이 당신이 준비한 주문을 시전할 때

적의 주문 발동 시 그 효과를 볼 수 있다면, 마법으로 방해할 수 있다. 준비된 주문을 소모하여 발동 생물이 같은 주문을 시전하는 것을 카운터한다. 발동 주문을 시전한 것처럼 주문 슬롯을 잃는다. 이후 발동 주문을 반격하려 시도한다.

특수 이 피트는 당신이 시전하는 주문 전통(아케인, 신성, 프라이멀, 오컬트)에 해당하는 특성을 지닌다.

name: Cautious Delver

description.value:
You've studied the many ways that ancient architects and spellcasters protected their possessions, such as by implementing deadly traps and curses, and learned some magic to counteract them. You can cast dispel magic, knock, and resist energy as innate spells, each once per day. If you can already cast spells, these spells are of the same tradition.

Otherwise, they're arcane spells, you use Intelligence as your spellcasting ability, and you become trained in spell attack rolls and spell DCs for arcane spells.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en:
You've studied the many ways that ancient architects and spellcasters protected their possessions, such as by implementing deadly traps and curses, and learned some magic to counteract them. You can cast dispel magic, knock, and resist energy as innate spells, each once per day. If you can already cast spells, these spells are of the same tradition.

Otherwise, they're arcane spells, you use Intelligence as your spellcasting ability, and you become trained in spell attack rolls and spell DCs for arcane spells.
_desc_ko:
고대 건축가와 마법사들이 치명적인 함정과 저주를 설치하는 등 소유물을 보호한 다양한 방법을 연구했으며, 이를 반격하는 마법도 배웠다. 마법 해제, 노크, 에너지 저항을 선천적 주문으로 하루에 한 번씩 시전할 수 있다. 이미 주문을 시전할 수 있다면, 이 주문들은 동일한 전통에 속한다.

그렇지 않은 경우, 이 주문들은 아케인 주문이며, 지능을 주문 시전 능력치로 사용하며, 아케인 주문의 명중 굴림과 명중 굴림(DC)에 숙련됩니다.

name: Whirling in the Summer Storm

description.value:
Requirements You're in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.VN6Cws7BBta81AQ9]{Twisting Petal Stance}.

Your hands move in a hypnotic and distracting flurry that throws your foes off-balance before you cast them away with a violent pirouette. You Step. Then each enemy within your reach must attempt a Will save against the higher of your @Check[will|against:class]{class DC} or your @Check[will|against:deception]{Deception DC}; on a failure, they're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to melee attacks from you and your allies until the end of your next turn. Then, [[/act shove]] up to three adjacent enemies; each Shove counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but you don't increase your penalty until after you've resolved all the Shove attempts.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Requirements You're in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.VN6Cws7BBta81AQ9]{Twisting Petal Stance}.

Your hands move in a hypnotic and distracting flurry that throws your foes off-balance before you cast them away with a violent pirouette. You Step. Then each enemy within your reach must attempt a Will save against the higher of your @Check[will|against:class]{class DC} or your @Check[will|against:deception]{Deception DC}; on a failure, they're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to melee attacks from you and your allies until the end of your next turn. Then, [[/act shove]] up to three adjacent enemies; each Shove counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but you don't increase your penalty until after you've resolved all the Shove attempts.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 @link[feats.twisting-petal-stance]를 취하고 있습니다.

당신의 손이 최면적이고 혼란스러운 움직임으로 적들의 균형을 무너뜨린 후, 격렬한 피루엣으로 그들을 내던집니다.

당신은 한 걸음 내딛습니다. 그러면 당신의 도달 범위 내 모든 적들은 당신의 직업 난이도(DC)와 기만 난이도(DC) 중 높은 쪽에 대한 의지 내성을 시도해야 합니다. 실패 시, 그들은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 당신과 아군의 근접 공격에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다. 그런 다음, @link[actions.shove]로 인접한 적 최대 3명을 밀쳐냅니다. 각 밀치기는 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되지만, 모든 밀치기 시도를 해결한 후에야 페널티가 증가합니다.

name: Greater Magical Scholastics

description.value:
You broaden your magical studies, allowing you to find the right path, detect hidden objects, and conceal those objects from unscrupulous rivals.

You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X]{Augury}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.LQzlKbYjZSMFQawP]{Locate}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EoKBlgf6Smt8opaU]{Veil of Privacy} as occult innate spells, each once per day. You can cast this veil of privacy spell only on an object, and it's automatically heightened to half your level rounded up.

_desc_en:
You broaden your magical studies, allowing you to find the right path, detect hidden objects, and conceal those objects from unscrupulous rivals.

You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X]{Augury}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.LQzlKbYjZSMFQawP]{Locate}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EoKBlgf6Smt8opaU]{Veil of Privacy} as occult innate spells, each once per day. You can cast this veil of privacy spell only on an object, and it's automatically heightened to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko:
당신은 마법 연구를 확장하여 올바른 길을 찾고, 숨겨진 물건을 탐지하며, 부도덕한 경쟁자들로부터 그 물건을 {숨기}게 됩니다.

@link[spells.augury], @link[spells.locate], @link[spells.veil-of-privacy]을 오컬트 선천 마법으로 하루에 한 번씩 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 사생활의 베일 주문은 오직 물체에만 시전할 수 있으며, 자동으로 당신의 레벨의 반(반올림)으로 강화됩니다.

name: Cycle Spell

description.value: Your devotion to the cycle of souls grants you an additional divine spell. Choose from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2iQKhCQBijhj5Rf3]{Infuse Vitality}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal}. You must make this selection when you take this feat and it can't be changed. Once per day, while your spiral is glowing, you can cast the selected spell as a divine innate spell.

_desc_en: Your devotion to the cycle of souls grants you an additional divine spell. Choose from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2iQKhCQBijhj5Rf3]{Infuse Vitality}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal}. You must make this selection when you take this feat and it can't be changed. Once per day, while your spiral is glowing, you can cast the selected spell as a divine innate spell.
_desc_ko: 영혼의 순환에 대한 당신의 헌신은 추가 신성 주문을 부여합니다. @link[spells.bless], @link[spells.infuse-vitality], 또는 @link[spells.heal] 중에서 선택하십시오. 이 피트를 선택할 때 반드시 선택해야 하며 변경할 수 없습니다. 하루에 한 번, 당신의 나선형이 빛나고 있을 때 선택한 주문을 신성 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Divine Reflexes

description.value: At the start of each of your turns, you gain an additional reaction that you can use only for your champion's reaction.

_desc_en: At the start of each of your turns, you gain an additional reaction that you can use only for your champion's reaction.
_desc_ko: 당신의 턴이 시작될 때마다, 당신의 챔피언의 반응에만 사용할 수 있는 추가 반응을 얻습니다.

name: Stunning Appearance

description.value: Your sudden appearance leaves your foe unable to respond. When you use Startling Appearance, if your foe's level is equal to or lower than yours, they are also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} on a hit, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2} on a critical hit.

_desc_en: Your sudden appearance leaves your foe unable to respond. When you use Startling Appearance, if your foe's level is equal to or lower than yours, they are also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} on a hit, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2} on a critical hit.
_desc_ko: 갑작스러운 출현으로 적의 대응이 불가능해진다. 당신이 놀라운 등장을 사용할 때, 적의 레벨이 당신과 같거나 낮다면, 적중 시 @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태가 되며, 치명타 시 @link[conditions.stunned]{2} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Extraplanar Haze

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Your body emits tiny particles of extraplanar matter, such as crystalline motes or smoky vapor, that surround you in a haze. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, though you can't use this concealment to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}, as normal for concealment where your position is still obvious. These particles stay within an inch of your skin, move with you, and last for a number of rounds equal to half your level.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Your body emits tiny particles of extraplanar matter, such as crystalline motes or smoky vapor, that surround you in a haze. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, though you can't use this concealment to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}, as normal for concealment where your position is still obvious. These particles stay within an inch of your skin, move with you, and last for a number of rounds equal to half your level.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신의 몸에서 결정체 같은 미립자나 연기 같은 증기와 같은 초차원 물질의 미세한 입자들이 방출되어 당신을 안개처럼 둘러쌉니다. 당신은 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태가 되지만, 이 은폐 상태를 이용해 @link[actions.hide]나 @link[actions.sneak]에는 사용할 수 없습니다. 이는 위치가 여전히 노출된 은폐 상태의 일반적인 규칙입니다. 이 입자들은 피부에서 1인치 이내를 유지하며, 당신과 함께 움직이고, 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 턴 수 동안 지속됩니다.

name: Fiendish Strikes

description.value: Your festering connection to the forces of evil infuses your weapons with debilitating malevolence, tearing down creatures of good with every attack. All your weapon and unarmed Strikes gain the unholy and magical traits.

_desc_en: Your festering connection to the forces of evil infuses your weapons with debilitating malevolence, tearing down creatures of good with every attack. All your weapon and unarmed Strikes gain the unholy and magical traits.
_desc_ko: 악의 세력과의 부패한 연결은 당신의 무기에 쇠약하게 만드는 악의를 불어넣어, 공격할 때마다 선한 존재들을 무너뜨립니다. 당신의 모든 무기 및 비무장 공격은 불경함과 마법적 특성을 얻습니다.

name: Virtue-Forged Tattoos

description.value: Your tattoos are a work of eldritch genius, a masterpiece of art, magic, and skin. Choose a 3rd-rank arcane spell from the same school as your Arcane Tattoos, either a common spell or another to which you have access, including a lower-rank spell heightened to 3rd level if you wish. You can cast that spell once per day as an innate arcane spell.

_desc_en: Your tattoos are a work of eldritch genius, a masterpiece of art, magic, and skin. Choose a 3rd-rank arcane spell from the same school as your Arcane Tattoos, either a common spell or another to which you have access, including a lower-rank spell heightened to 3rd level if you wish. You can cast that spell once per day as an innate arcane spell.
_desc_ko: 당신의 문신은 기이한 천재성의 산물로서, 예술과 마법, 그리고 피부가 어우러진 걸작이다. 당신의 아케인 문신과 동일한 학파의 3랭크 아케인 주문을 선택하라. 일반 주문이거나 접근 가능한 다른 주문(원한다면 하위 랭크 주문을 (3rd)랭크으로 강화한 것도 포함)이어야 한다. 이 주문을 하루에 한 번 선천 아케인 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Elemental Shape

description.value: You understand the fundamental elements of nature such that you can imbue them into your body and manifest as a living embodiment of those elements. Add the shapes in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1K6AYGisvo9gqdhs]{Elemental Form} to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form} list. Whenever you're polymorphed into another shape using untamed form, you gain resistance 5 to fire.

_desc_en: You understand the fundamental elements of nature such that you can imbue them into your body and manifest as a living embodiment of those elements. Add the shapes in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1K6AYGisvo9gqdhs]{Elemental Form} to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form} list. Whenever you're polymorphed into another shape using untamed form, you gain resistance 5 to fire.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자연의 근본 원소를 이해하여 이를 몸에 스며들게 하고, 그 원소들의 살아있는 화신으로 창조할 수 있습니다. @link[spells.elemental-form]의 형태들을 @link[spells.untamed-form] 목록에 추가한다. 야생 형태를 사용하여 다른 형태로 변형될 때마다, 불에 대한 저항력 5를 얻는다.

name: Storm Retribution

description.value:
Trigger An opponent adjacent to you critically hits you with a melee weapon or melee unarmed attack.

Requirements You have at least 1 available Focus Point.

You lash out, directing a burst of storming fury toward a creature that has harmed you. You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ho1jSoYKrHUNnM90]{Tempest Surge} on the triggering opponent and push that creature, moving it 5 feet away from you if it fails its Reflex save, or 10 feet if it critically fails. This movement is forced movement.

_desc_en:
Trigger An opponent adjacent to you critically hits you with a melee weapon or melee unarmed attack.

Requirements You have at least 1 available Focus Point.

You lash out, directing a burst of storming fury toward a creature that has harmed you. You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ho1jSoYKrHUNnM90]{Tempest Surge} on the triggering opponent and push that creature, moving it 5 feet away from you if it fails its Reflex save, or 10 feet if it critically fails. This movement is forced movement.
_desc_ko:
발동조건 인접한 상대가 근접 무기 또는 비무장 공격으로 당신에게 치명타를 입힐 때.

요구 사항 사용 가능한 포커스 포인트가 최소 1개 이상 있어야 합니다.

당신은 자신을 해친 생물에게 격노의 폭풍을 쏟아부으며 공격합니다. 발동 대상 상대에게 @link[spells.tempest-surge]를 시전하고, 해당 생물을 밀어냅니다. 반사 내성에 실패하면 5피트, 대실패하면 10피트 멀리 이동시킵니다. 이 이동은 기세 이동입니다.

name: Bombing Run

description.value:
Requirements You currently have a fly Speed.

Using your elevation and speed to your advantage, you deliver aerial payloads with greater force. You Fly and can Interact to draw a bomb. At any point during your movement, you can also make a Strike with an alchemical bomb. The bomb deals its splash damage to every creature within 10 feet of the target.

_desc_en:
Requirements You currently have a fly Speed.

Using your elevation and speed to your advantage, you deliver aerial payloads with greater force. You Fly and can Interact to draw a bomb. At any point during your movement, you can also make a Strike with an alchemical bomb. The bomb deals its splash damage to every creature within 10 feet of the target.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 현재 당신은 날개 속도를 가지고 있습니다.

고도와 속도를 활용하여 공중에서 힘차게 폭탄을 발사합니다. 비행 중 상호작용으로 폭탄을 장착할 수 있습니다. 이동 중 언제든지 연금술 폭탄으로 공격을 가할 수 있습니다. 폭탄은 대상 10피트 내 모든 생물에게 방사 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Wiles on the Wind

description.value:
Speaking lies, you set them loose upon a drifting wind. You create an auditory illusion that comes from a square within 500 feet and can be as loud as four normal humans talking. The sound can be intricate, including speech or music, though the GM might require you to attempt a check or know a language for it to be convincing. The illusion lasts until the end of your next turn, and you can Sustain the impulse.

You can have any creature within 40 feet of the illusion, or that comes within 40 feet of it during the duration, attempt a @Check[will|against:kineticist] save against your class DC. This is a mental effect.

Success The creature is unaffected, disbelieves the illusion, and is temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with the source of the sound until the end of its next turn. When the fascination ends, the creature is temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is fascinated for 1 minute or until it disbelieves.

_desc_en:
Speaking lies, you set them loose upon a drifting wind. You create an auditory illusion that comes from a square within 500 feet and can be as loud as four normal humans talking. The sound can be intricate, including speech or music, though the GM might require you to attempt a check or know a language for it to be convincing. The illusion lasts until the end of your next turn, and you can Sustain the impulse.

You can have any creature within 40 feet of the illusion, or that comes within 40 feet of it during the duration, attempt a @Check[will|against:kineticist] save against your class DC. This is a mental effect.

Success The creature is unaffected, disbelieves the illusion, and is temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with the source of the sound until the end of its next turn. When the fascination ends, the creature is temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is fascinated for 1 minute or until it disbelieves.
_desc_ko:
거짓말을 하며, 그들을 떠도는 바람에 실어 보낸다. 500피트 이내의 한 칸 영역에서 발생하는 청각적 환상을 창조한다. 이 환상은 네 명의 평범한 인간이 말하는 정도의 소리를 낼 수 있다. 말소리나 음악을 포함한 복잡한 소리도 가능하나, GM이 설득력 있게 만들기 위해 능력 판정을 시도하거나 언어 지식을 요구할 수 있다. 환상은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 지속되며, 지속 임펄스를 사용할 수 있다.

환각 범위 40피트 내의 모든 생물, 또는 지속 시간 동안 40피트 내로 접근하는 생물은 네 직업 난이도(DC)에 대한 의지 저항 검사를 시도하다. 이는 정신 효과이다.

성공 시 해당 생물은 영향을 받지 않고 환상을 믿지 않으며, 1시간 동안 일시적으로 면역 상태가 됩니다.

실패 생물은 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 소리의 근원에 @link[conditions.fascinated] 상태로 있습니다. 매혹이 끝나면 생물은 1시간 동안 일시적으로 면역 상태가 됩니다.

대실패 실패 효과와 동일하나, 생물은 1분 동안 또는 믿음을 잃을 때까지 매혹 상태가 지속된다.

name: Saving Slash

description.value:
Trigger An opponent critically hits you with a melee attack.

You quickly whirl your blade, trying to deflect enough momentum to avoid the worst of the attack. Attempt a @Check[flat|dc:15|showDC:all]. If you succeed, the attack becomes a normal hit, instead of a critical hit.

_desc_en:
Trigger An opponent critically hits you with a melee attack.

You quickly whirl your blade, trying to deflect enough momentum to avoid the worst of the attack. Attempt a @Check[flat|dc:15|showDC:all]. If you succeed, the attack becomes a normal hit, instead of a critical hit.
_desc_ko:
발동조건 상대방이 근접 공격으로 당신에게 치명타를 입혔을 때.

당신은 재빨리 칼을 휘둘러 공격의 최악의 피해를 피할 만큼의 기세를 튕겨내려 합니다. DC 15 단순을 시도하세요. 성공하면 치명타 대신 일반 타격으로 바뀝니다.

name: Sportlebore Choke

description.value:
Requirements Your swarm is outside your body.

Like nefarious sportlebores, a species of insect that plague adventurers by hiding in their rations as counterfeit food, your swarm can crawl down throats. The sportlebores attempt to force their way into the mouth of each creature in your swarm's space. Each creature takes @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))d4[piercing]] damage depending on its @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. The damage increases by 1d4 at 10th level and every 2 levels thereafter. Regardless of the result of its save, the creature is temporarily immune to sportlebore choke for 1 hour.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} as it spits out most of the offending sportlebores.

Failure The sportlebores crawl down the creature's throat. The creature takes full damage and is sickened 1.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신의 군집이 몸 밖에 위치해 있어야 합니다.

사악한 스포틀보어처럼, 모조 식품으로 모험가들의 식량에 숨겨져 괴롭히는 곤충 종족처럼, 당신의 군집은 목구멍으로 기어들어갈 수 있습니다. 스포틀보어들은 군집 공간에 있는 각 생물의 입으로 기세롭게 들어가려 시도합니다. 각 생물은 당신의 클래스 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽에 대한 인내 내성에 따라 관통의 피해를 입습니다. 이 피해는 10레벨에 1d4씩 증가하며, 이후 2레벨마다 추가로 증가합니다. 내성 결과와 무관하게, 생물은 1시간 동안 스포틀보어 질식에 일시적으로 면역됩니다.

대성공 생물은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 생물은 절반의 피해를 입으며, 대부분의 유해한 스포틀보어를 토해내면서 @link[conditions.sickened]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

실패 스포틀보어들이 생물의 목구멍으로 기어내려간다. 생물은 전체 피해를 입으며 구역질 1 상태가 된다. 1.

대실패 실패와 동일하나, 생물은 두 배의 피해를 입으며 @link[conditions.sickened]{2} 상태가 된다.

name: Powerful Guts

description.value: Your stomach is particularly durable. When you succeed at a Fortitude save to reduce your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} value, you reduce it by 2 (or by 3 on a critical success).

_desc_en: Your stomach is particularly durable. When you succeed at a Fortitude save to reduce your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} value, you reduce it by 2 (or by 3 on a critical success).
_desc_ko: 당신의 위장은 특히 튼튼합니다. @link[conditions.sickened] 수치를 줄이기 위한 인내 내성에 성공할 때, 해당 수치를 2만큼 감소시킵니다(대성공 시 3만큼 감소).

name: Critter Shape

description.value:
Once per hour, you can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.34E7k2YRcsOU5uyl]{Change Shape} to enter a critter shape. While in critter shape, you gain the effect of a 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gfPjmG6Fe6D3MFjl]{Pest Form}, except you can only transform into an animal matching your inherent animal.

You can remain in critter shape for up to 10 minutes, after which you transform back into your hybrid shape and can't enter your critter shape again for 1 hour. You can instead use Change Shape to return to your humanoid or hybrid shape at any time during the duration of Critter Shape.

If your inherent animal is normally larger than Tiny, you transform into a smaller, younger version of the animal, such as a Tiny bear cub. If your inherent animal has a fly Speed, you can turn into that animal (unlike normal for 1st-rank pest form), but you still don't gain a fly Speed.

_desc_en:
Once per hour, you can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.34E7k2YRcsOU5uyl]{Change Shape} to enter a critter shape. While in critter shape, you gain the effect of a 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gfPjmG6Fe6D3MFjl]{Pest Form}, except you can only transform into an animal matching your inherent animal.

You can remain in critter shape for up to 10 minutes, after which you transform back into your hybrid shape and can't enter your critter shape again for 1 hour. You can instead use Change Shape to return to your humanoid or hybrid shape at any time during the duration of Critter Shape.

If your inherent animal is normally larger than Tiny, you transform into a smaller, younger version of the animal, such as a Tiny bear cub. If your inherent animal has a fly Speed, you can turn into that animal (unlike normal for 1st-rank pest form), but you still don't gain a fly Speed.
_desc_ko:
시간당 한 번, @link[actions.change-shape]을 사용하여 크리터 형태로 들어갈 수 있습니다. 크리터 형태일 때, 1등급 @link[spells.pest-form]의 효과를 얻습니다. 단, 본래의 동물과 일치하는 동물로만 변신할 수 있습니다.

크리터 형태는 최대 10분간 유지할 수 있으며, 이후 하이브리드 형태로 되돌아갑니다. 이후 1시간 동안은 다시 크리터 형태로 변신할 수 없습니다. 대신 크리터 형태 지속 중 언제든지 변신 능력을 사용해 인간형 또는 하이브리드 형태로 돌아갈 수 있습니다.

본래의 동물이 일반적으로 초소형보다 크다면, 당신은 그 동물의 더 작고 어린 버전으로 변신합니다. 예를 들어 초소형 곰 새끼로 변신할 수 있습니다. 본래의 동물이 비행 속도를 가진 경우, 해당 동물로 변신할 수 있습니다(1등급 해충 형태와는 다름). 그러나 여전히 비행 속도는 획득하지 못합니다.

name: Roaring Heart

description.value:
Requirements Your attuned apparition grants Mountain Lore as an apparition skill.

You surge forward inexorably. You Stride twice. At any point during this movement, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} up to two creatures you pass adjacent to. When you end the movement, the turbulent spirits you're attuned to reward you for acting in an appropriately fierce manner: you and each ally in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level if you successfully Shoved at least one enemy, or equal to your level if you succeeded at Shoving both. These temporary Hit Points last until the beginning of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.K2hqRFjGMX0GCIUi]{Effect: Roaring Heart}

_desc_en:

You surge forward inexorably. You Stride twice. At any point during this movement, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} up to two creatures you pass adjacent to. These temporary Hit Points last until the beginning of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.K2hqRFjGMX0GCIUi]{Effect: Roaring Heart}
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신의 조율된 유령은 유령 기술로 산악 지식를 부여합니다.

당신은 멈출 수 없이 앞으로 돌진합니다. 두 번의 이동합니다. 이 이동 중 언제든지, 지나가며 인접한 최대 두 명의 생물을 @link[actions.shove] 수 있습니다. 이 이동을 끝낼 때, 당신이 조율한 격렬한 영혼들은 당신이 적절히 맹렬하게 행동한 것에 대한 보상으로 당신과 30피트 발산에 있는 각 아군에게 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 의 임시 HP를 부여합니다. 적어도 한 명의 적을 밀쳐내는 데 성공했을 경우, 또는 두 명 모두를 밀쳐내는 데 성공했을 경우 레벨에 해당하는 HP를 부여합니다. 이 임시 HP는 당신의 다음 턴 시작까지 지속됩니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.K2hqRFjGMX0GCIUi]{효과: 포효하는 심장}

name: Flensing Slice

description.value:
Requirements Your last action was a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.onde0SxLoxLBTnvm]{Double Slice}, and both attacks hit the target.

When you hit with both attacks with Double Slice, you flense the target, making it bleed and creating a weak spot. The target takes 1d8 persistent bleed damage per weapon damage die of whichever of the weapons you used that has the most weapon damage dice (maximum 4d8 for a major striking weapon).

In addition, until the start of your next turn the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, and its resistances to any physical damage types are reduced by 5.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.bdq8ulAzatPMX8iK]{Effect: Flensing Slice}

_desc_en:
Requirements Your last action was a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.onde0SxLoxLBTnvm]{Double Slice}, and both attacks hit the target.

When you hit with both attacks with Double Slice, you flense the target, making it bleed and creating a weak spot. The target takes 1d8 persistent bleed damage per weapon damage die of whichever of the weapons you used that has the most weapon damage dice (maximum 4d8 for a major striking weapon).

In addition, until the start of your next turn the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, and its resistances to any physical damage types are reduced by 5.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.bdq8ulAzatPMX8iK]{Effect: Flensing Slice}
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 마지막 행동이 @link[feats.double-slice]였으며, 두 공격 모두 대상에 명중해야 합니다.

더블 슬라이스로 두 번 공격에 모두 명중하면, 대상을 갈라내어 피를 흘리게 하고 약점을 생성합니다.

표적은 사용한 무기 중 무기 피해 주사위가 가장 많은 무기의 피해 주사위 당 1d8 출혈의 피해를 받습니다(강타 (상급) 무기의 경우 최대 4d8).

표적은 무방비가 되며, 모든 물리 피해 유형에 대한 저항력이 5 감소합니다. 이 두 효과는 당신의 다음 턴 시작까지 지속됩니다.

name: Nimble Roll

description.value:
You throw yourself into a roll to escape imminent danger. You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.dNH8OHEvx3vI9NBQ]{Nimble Dodge} before attempting a Reflex save in addition to its original trigger. If you do, the circumstance bonus applies to your Reflex save against the triggering effect.

When you use Nimble Dodge and the triggering attack fails or critically fails, or when you succeed or critically succeed at the saving throw, you can also Stride up to 10 feet as part of the reaction. If you do, the reaction gains the move trait. You can use Nimble Roll while Flying or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

_desc_en:
You throw yourself into a roll to escape imminent danger. You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.dNH8OHEvx3vI9NBQ]{Nimble Dodge} before attempting a Reflex save in addition to its original trigger. If you do, the circumstance bonus applies to your Reflex save against the triggering effect.

When you use Nimble Dodge and the triggering attack fails or critically fails, or when you succeed or critically succeed at the saving throw, you can also Stride up to 10 feet as part of the reaction. If you do, the reaction gains the move trait. You can use Nimble Roll while Flying or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.
_desc_ko:
당신은 임박한 위험을 피하기 위해 몸을 던져 굴림합니다. 반사 내성 굴림 시도 전에 @link[feats.nimble-dodge]를 원래 발동 조건 외에 사용할 수 있습니다. 그렇게 할 경우, 발동 효과에 대한 반사 내성 굴림 시 상황 보너스가 적용됩니다.

민첩 회피를 사용했을 때 유발 공격이 실패하거나 대실패했을 때, 또는 내성 굴림에 성공하거나 대성공했을 때, 반응의 일부로 최대 10피트까지 이동할 수 있다. 그렇게 할 경우, 해당 반응은 이동 특성을 얻는다. 비행 중이거나 수영 중일 때 해당 이동 유형이 있다면, 걸어가는 대신 민첩 회전을 사용할 수 있다.

name: Flower Chimera

description.value:
Access Tian Xia origin

You call on a guardian of the wild to burst forth from the land to aid you. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jQdm301h6e8hIY4U]{Spiritual Guardian} as a 5th-rank innate primal spell once per day, even if you don't have a deity; this guardian manifests as a kami or other nature spirit. When you reach 17th level, you can heighten this spell to 7th rank.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide
