name: Frightening Indignation

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Your anger at the world's many injustices boil out from you in a wave of palpable energy. An enemy that ends its turn within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] around you must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. This aura lasts for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to your Frightening Indignation for 1 minute.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and can't reduce its frightened condition below 1 while it's in your aura.

Critical Failure As failure, but @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Your anger at the world's many injustices boil out from you in a wave of palpable energy. An enemy that ends its turn within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] around you must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. This aura lasts for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to your Frightening Indignation for 1 minute.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and can't reduce its frightened condition below 1 while it's in your aura.

Critical Failure As failure, but @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.
_desc_ko:
빈도 하루 1회

세상의 수많은 불의에 대한 당신의 분노가 감지할 수 있는 에너지의 파동이 되어 당신에게서 뿜어져 나옵니다. 당신 주위 @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] 안에서 자기 턴을 끝내는 적은 당신의 클래스 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 더 높은 값에 대해 @Check[will|against:class-spell] 내성 굴림을 시도해야 합니다. 이 오라는 1분간 지속됩니다.

대성공 해당 존재는 영향을 받지 않으며 1분간 당신의 공포의 분개에 일시적으로 면역이 됩니다.

성공 해당 존재는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{공포 1}이 됩니다.

실패 해당 존재는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{공포 2}가 되며, 당신의 오라 안에 있는 동안에는 공포 상태를 1 미만으로 줄일 수 없습니다.

대실패 실패와 같지만 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{공포 3}이 됩니다.

name: Fey Fellowship

description.value:
Your enhanced fey connection (either through your blood or via prolonged contact with their kind) affords you a warmer reception from creatures of the First World as well as tools to foil their tricks or withstand their magic. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to both Perception checks and saving throws against fey.

In addition, whenever you meet a fey creature in a social situation, you can immediately attempt a Diplomacy check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on that creature rather than needing to converse for 1 minute. You take a –5 penalty to the check. If you fail, you can engage in 1 minute of conversation and attempt a new check at the end of that time rather than accepting the failure or critical failure result.

_desc_en:
Your enhanced fey connection (either through your blood or via prolonged contact with their kind) affords you a warmer reception from creatures of the First World as well as tools to foil their tricks or withstand their magic. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to both Perception checks and saving throws against fey.

In addition, whenever you meet a fey creature in a social situation, you can immediately attempt a Diplomacy check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on that creature rather than needing to converse for 1 minute. You take a –5 penalty to the check. If you fail, you can engage in 1 minute of conversation and attempt a new check at the end of that time rather than accepting the failure or critical failure result.
_desc_ko:
혈통이나 오랜 접촉을 통해 강화된 페이 연결은 제1세계 생물들의 우호적인 대우와 그들의 속임수를 무력화하거나 마법에 저항할 수 있는 수단을 제공합니다. 페이 대상에 대한 지각 판정 및 내성 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

또한, 사회적 상황에서 페이 생물을 만날 때마다 1분간 대화할 필요 없이 즉시 외교 판정을 시도하여 @link[actions.make-an-impression]를 할 수 있습니다. 해당 판정에는 -5 페널티가 적용됩니다. 실패 시, 실패 또는 대실패 결과를 받아들이지 않고 1분간 대화를 나눈 후 시간 종료 시 새로운 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다.

name: Wind Jump

description.value: You gather the wind beneath you, allowing you to soar as you jump. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kRxlkPPe6Gr7Du59]{Wind Jump} qi spell.

_desc_en: You gather the wind beneath you, allowing you to soar as you jump. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kRxlkPPe6Gr7Du59]{Wind Jump} qi spell.
_desc_ko: 발밑의 바람을 모아 점프할 때 공중으로 치솟을 수 있습니다. @link[spells.wind-jump] 기 주문을 획득합니다.

name: Initial Eidolon Ability

description.value: Your link to your eidolon becomes stronger, granting it a new ability. Your eidolon gains the initial ability for an eidolon of its type.

_desc_en: Your link to your eidolon becomes stronger, granting it a new ability. Your eidolon gains the initial ability for an eidolon of its type.
_desc_ko: 에이돌론과의 유대가 강화되어 새로운 능력을 부여받습니다. 에이돌론은 해당 유형의 에이돌론이 가진 초기 능력을 획득합니다.

name: Vicious Venom

description.value: The venom you produce is exceptionally potent and difficult to overcome. Your vishkanyan venom gains the virulent trait, requiring two consecutive saves to reduce the venom's stage by 1. A critical success reduces your venom's stage by only 1 instead of by 2.

_desc_en: The venom you produce is exceptionally potent and difficult to overcome. Your vishkanyan venom gains the virulent trait, requiring two consecutive saves to reduce the venom's stage by 1. A critical success reduces your venom's stage by only 1 instead of by 2.
_desc_ko: 당신이 생성하는 독은 매우 강력하고 극복하기 어렵습니다. 비슈카냔 독은 독성이 강한 특성을 얻어, 독의 단계를 1 감소시키려면 연속으로 두 번의 내성 굴림을 성공해야 합니다. 대성공 시 독의 단계는 2가 아닌 1만 감소합니다.

name: Deity's Domain

description.value: You embody an aspect of your deity. Choose one of your deity's domains. You gain the domain's initial domain spell as a devotion spell.

_desc_en: You embody an aspect of your deity. Choose one of your deity's domains. You gain the domain's initial domain spell as a devotion spell.
_desc_ko: 당신은 신의 한 측면을 구현합니다. 신의 영역 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 해당 영역의 초기 영역 주문을 헌신 주문으로 얻습니다.

name: The Immortal Attains the Summit

description.value:
Your cultivation bearing glorious fruit, you behold Heaven's will. Returning from your vision of the Holy Mountain, you become an immortal with mystic potency over the terrestrial realms of wind and water.

You cease aging and, regardless of your actual existential state, now register as a living being to effects that can detect living creatures (such as lifesense or spiritsense).

In addition, you learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XkDCzMIyc0YOjw05]{Control Weather} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZhJ8d9Uk4lwIx86b]{Plant Growth} rituals. You can use Occultism instead of Nature for these rituals. On a success with one of these rituals, you gain the effects of a critical success instead.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Your cultivation bearing glorious fruit, you behold Heaven's will. Returning from your vision of the Holy Mountain, you become an immortal with mystic potency over the terrestrial realms of wind and water.

You cease aging and, regardless of your actual existential state, now register as a living being to effects that can detect living creatures (such as lifesense or spiritsense).

In addition, you learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XkDCzMIyc0YOjw05]{Control Weather} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZhJ8d9Uk4lwIx86b]{Plant Growth} rituals. You can use Occultism instead of Nature for these rituals. On a success with one of these rituals, you gain the effects of a critical success instead.
_desc_ko:
수련이 결실을 맺어 천계의 뜻을 엿보게 된다. 성산에서 환상을 경험하고 돌아온 너는 바람과 물의 지상 렐름에 신비한 힘을 휘두르는 불사가 된다.

노화가 멈추며, 실제 존재 상태와 무관하게 생명체 감지 효과(생명감지나 영혼감지 등)에 살아있는 존재로 인식된다.

또한 @link[spells.control-weather]과 @link[spells.plant-growth] 의식을 습득한다. 이 의식들에선 자연 대신 오컬트를 사용할 수 있다. 이 의식들 중 하나에 성공하면, 대신 대성공의 효과를 얻는다.

name: Dueling Dance (Fighter)

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a single one-handed melee weapon and hold nothing else in your hands.

Using a free hand as pivot and balance, you both attack and defend with your weapon. While you are in this stance, you constantly have the benefits of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.n7nQQR940OvFbw7T]{Dueling Parry}.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a single one-handed melee weapon and hold nothing else in your hands.

Using a free hand as pivot and balance, you both attack and defend with your weapon. While you are in this stance, you constantly have the benefits of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.n7nQQR940OvFbw7T]{Dueling Parry}.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 한 손으로 휘두르는 근접 무기 하나만을 장비하고 있으며, 손에 다른 무기를 들고 있지 않아야 합니다.

빈 손을 축과 균형점으로 삼아 무기로 공격과 방어를 동시에 수행합니다. 이 자세를 유지하는 동안 지속적으로 @link[feats.dueling-parry]의 효과를 받습니다.

name: Crescent Cross Training

description.value:
You have familiarity with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.KaYvuSNXZaOammij]{Crescent Cross}, an ingenious weapon that combines an arm-mounted, multi-chamber crossbow with a crescent-shaped blade. For the purposes of proficiency, you treat both its configurations as simple weapons.

Feats and abilities from this archetype that normally work with a gauntlet bow also work with your crescent cross, treating the melee form of the crescent cross as a gauntlet where appropriate. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2XQowhfM4SfAhJaf]{Crescent Spray} action.

_desc_en:
You have familiarity with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.KaYvuSNXZaOammij]{Crescent Cross}, an ingenious weapon that combines an arm-mounted, multi-chamber crossbow with a crescent-shaped blade. For the purposes of proficiency, you treat both its configurations as simple weapons.

Feats and abilities from this archetype that normally work with a gauntlet bow also work with your crescent cross, treating the melee form of the crescent cross as a gauntlet where appropriate. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2XQowhfM4SfAhJaf]{Crescent Spray} action.
_desc_ko:
팔에 장착하는 다중 발사구 석궁과 초승달 모양의 칼날을 결합한 독창적인 무기인 @link[equipment.crescent-cross]에 패밀리어로 익숙합니다. 숙련도 목적상, 두 형태 모두를 단순 무기로 취급합니다.

이 아키타입의 피트와 능력 중 건틀릿 보우와 함께 작동하는 것들은 크레센트 크로스와도 함께 작동하며, 적절한 경우 크레센트 크로스의 근접 형태를 건틀릿으로 취급합니다. 당신은 @link[actions.crescent-spray] 액션을 얻습니다.

name: Breath Like Honey

description.value: You smell of honey and savory things. Your circumstance bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} if the target can smell your breath increases to +2. In addition, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IihxWhRfpsBgQ5jS]{Enthrall} as a 3rd-rank occult innate spell once per day, except the spell has a range of 30 feet and the olfactory trait instead of the auditory trait. Targets don't gain any circumstance bonus for disagreeing with you.

_desc_en: You smell of honey and savory things. Your circumstance bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} if the target can smell your breath increases to +2. In addition, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IihxWhRfpsBgQ5jS]{Enthrall} as a 3rd-rank occult innate spell once per day, except the spell has a range of 30 feet and the olfactory trait instead of the auditory trait. Targets don't gain any circumstance bonus for disagreeing with you.
_desc_ko: 당신의 숨결은 꿀과 향긋한 것들의 향기를 풍깁니다. 대상이 당신의 숨결 냄새를 맡을 수 있을 경우, @link[actions.make-an-impression] 판정 시 받는 상황 보너스가 +2로 증가합니다. 또한 하루에 한 번, @link[spells.enthrall]을 (3rd)랭크 오컬트 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있다. 단, 이 마법의 범위는 30피트이며 청각 특성이 아닌 후각 특성을 가진다. 대상은 당신과 의견이 다를 경우 상황 보너스를 얻지 못한다.

name: Steady on Stone

description.value: Your connection to the earth makes natural uneven surfaces less of a hindrance for you. You can ignore difficult terrain caused by rubble and uneven ground made of stone and earth. In addition, when you use the Acrobatics skill to Balance on narrow surfaces or uneven ground made of stone and earth, you aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, and when you roll a success at one of these Acrobatics checks, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: Your connection to the earth makes natural uneven surfaces less of a hindrance for you. You can ignore difficult terrain caused by rubble and uneven ground made of stone and earth. In addition, when you use the Acrobatics skill to Balance on narrow surfaces or uneven ground made of stone and earth, you aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, and when you roll a success at one of these Acrobatics checks, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 대지와의 연결로 인해 자연적인 불규칙 지형이 당신에게 덜 방해가 됩니다. 돌과 흙으로 이루어진 잔해나 고르지 않은 지형으로 인한 어려운 지형을 무시할 수 있습니다. 또한, 곡예 기술로 돌과 흙으로 이루어진 좁은 표면이나 고르지 않은 지형에서 균형을 잡을 때, 당신은 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 되지 않으며, 이러한 곡예 판정 중 하나에서 성공을 굴릴 경우 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Contact With the Enemy

description.value: You know that even the best-laid plans rarely survive contact with the enemy, and you have prepared your allies to adapt with a wide array of contingencies. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.44pzixSVmRQiUoba]{Adaptive Stratagem}, you can replace any master tactics or legendary tactics you have prepared with any other tactics in your folio.

_desc_en: You know that even the best-laid plans rarely survive contact with the enemy, and you have prepared your allies to adapt with a wide array of contingencies. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.44pzixSVmRQiUoba]{Adaptive Stratagem}, you can replace any master tactics or legendary tactics you have prepared with any other tactics in your folio.
_desc_ko: 가장 완벽한 계획조차 적과의 접촉을 견디기 어렵다는 것을 알고 있으며, 동맹들이 다양한 컨틴전시 상황에 적응할 수 있도록 준비시켰다. 적응 전략을 사용할 때, 준비한 달인 전술이나 전설적 전술을 자신의 전술집에 있는 다른 전술로 대체할 수 있다.

name: Specialized Companion (Ranger)

description.value:
Your animal companion continues to grow in power and ability, and it is now cunning enough to become specialized. Your animal companion gains one specialization of your choice.

Special You can select this feat up to three times. Each time, add a different specialization to your companion.

_desc_en:
Your animal companion continues to grow in power and ability, and it is now cunning enough to become specialized. Your animal companion gains one specialization of your choice.

Special You can select this feat up to three times. Each time, add a different specialization to your companion.
_desc_ko:
당신의 동물 동료는 힘과 능력이 계속 성장하여 이제 재치 있어 전문화될 수 있습니다. 당신의 동물 동료는 당신이 선택한 하나의 전문화를 얻습니다.

특수 이 피트를 최대 세 번까지 선택할 수 있습니다. 매번 다른 전문화를 동반자에게 부여합니다.

name: Greater Animal Senses

description.value:
Your senses advance to match those of your animal aspect. You gain one of the following senses available to your inherent animal: echolocation (imprecise) 30 feet or tremorsense (imprecise) 30 feet. If your inherent animal doesn't typically have a specific type of sense, you can't gain the sense with this feat.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, either choosing a different sense or improving an imprecise sense granted by this feat to a precise sense.

_desc_en:
Your senses advance to match those of your animal aspect. You gain one of the following senses available to your inherent animal: echolocation (imprecise) 30 feet or tremorsense (imprecise) 30 feet. If your inherent animal doesn't typically have a specific type of sense, you can't gain the sense with this feat.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, either choosing a different sense or improving an imprecise sense granted by this feat to a precise sense.
_desc_ko:
당신의 감각이 동물적 측면에 맞춰 발전합니다. 본래의 동물이 가진 다음 감각 중 하나를 획득한다: 반향 위치 파악(정확하지 않음) 30피트 또는 진동 감지(정확하지 않음) 30피트. 본래의 동물이 일반적으로 특정 유형의 감각을 가지지 않는다면, 이 재주로 그 감각을 획득할 수 없다.

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있으며, 다른 감각을 선택하거나 이 피트로 부여받은 부정확한 감각을 정확한 감각으로 향상시킬 수 있습니다.

name: Folk Dowsing

description.value:
You can find what you're looking for using a dowsing rod or pendulum. If you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} while wielding a dowsing rod or pendulum, in addition to the normal checks for Searching, the GM rolls a secret Survival check for you to detect the largest source of water, oil, or another natural non-bodily fluid in the area. Even if the liquid is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from you—for example, if it stems from an underground spring or is piped through a wall—this technique points you in the right direction. The GM determines the DC, which is usually the trained simple DC with a hard or very hard adjustment if the source of water is small.

If you're an expert in Survival, the GM also makes a Survival check for you to detect sizable deposits of metal, minerals, and nearby graves. The DC is usually the expert simple DC, with DC adjustments for smaller deposits.

_desc_en:
You can find what you're looking for using a dowsing rod or pendulum. If you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} while wielding a dowsing rod or pendulum, in addition to the normal checks for Searching, the GM rolls a secret Survival check for you to detect the largest source of water, oil, or another natural non-bodily fluid in the area. Even if the liquid is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from you—for example, if it stems from an underground spring or is piped through a wall—this technique points you in the right direction. The GM determines the DC, which is usually the trained simple DC with a hard or very hard adjustment if the source of water is small.

If you're an expert in Survival, the GM also makes a Survival check for you to detect sizable deposits of metal, minerals, and nearby graves. The DC is usually the expert simple DC, with DC adjustments for smaller deposits.
_desc_ko:
수맥 탐지봉이나 진자를 사용해 원하는 것을 찾을 수 있습니다. 수맥탐지봉이나 진자를 들고 탐색할 경우, 일반적인 탐색 판정 외에도 GM이 해당 지역에서 가장 큰 물, 기름 또는 기타 자연적 비체액의 원천을 감지하기 위한 비밀 생존 판정을 대신 굴림합니다. 액체가 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태일지라도-예를 들어, 지하 샘에서 비롯되거나 벽을 통해 배관된 경우-이 기술은 올바른 방향을 가리킵니다. GM이 난이도(DC)를 결정하며, 일반적으로 훈련된 기본 DC에 적용됩니다. 물의 원천이 작을 경우 어려움 또는 매우 어려움 조정이 적용됩니다.

생존 기술에 숙련된 경우, GM은 금속·광물 매장지나 인근 무덤 탐지를 위한 생존 판정도 수행합니다. DC는 일반적으로 숙련 단순 DC이며, 매장지가 작을수록 DC가 조정됩니다.

name: Gunpowder Gauntlet

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a loaded one-handed firearm.

Your flair keeps foes' attention, as your motions with your gun draw your foes into a deadly game. As you toy with them and performatively brandish your weapon, you build their tunnel vision, leaving them trapped in a perceptual gauntlet of your own making. Attempt a @Check[performance|against:will] check against the Will DC of a single target within your one-handed firearm's first range increment.

Critical Success The target takes a –2 status penalty to attack rolls against creatures other than you until the beginning of your next turn.

Success The target takes a –1 status penalty to attack rolls against creatures other than you until the beginning of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.FaEvoqZXfQ7xnpRo]{Effect: Gunpowder Gauntlet}

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a loaded one-handed firearm.

Your flair keeps foes' attention, as your motions with your gun draw your foes into a deadly game. As you toy with them and performatively brandish your weapon, you build their tunnel vision, leaving them trapped in a perceptual gauntlet of your own making. Attempt a @Check[performance|against:will] check against the Will DC of a single target within your one-handed firearm's first range increment.

Critical Success The target takes a –2 status penalty to attack rolls against creatures other than you until the beginning of your next turn.

Success The target takes a –1 status penalty to attack rolls against creatures other than you until the beginning of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.FaEvoqZXfQ7xnpRo]{Effect: Gunpowder Gauntlet}
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 장전된 한손용 화기를 휘두르고 있습니다.

당신의 화려한 움직임이 적의 시선을 사로잡습니다. 총을 다루는 동작이 적을 치명적인 게임 속으로 끌어들이죠. 그들을 가지고 놀며 공연적으로 무기를 휘두를수록, 당신은 적의 시야를 좁혀 자신만의 인식의 덫에 가둡니다. 한 손 총기의 첫 사거리 구간 내에 있는 단일 대상의 의지 DC에 대해 공연 판정을 시도합니다.

대성공 대상은 다음 차례 시작까지 당신 이외의 생물에게 명중 굴림에 -2 상태 페널티를 받습니다.

성공 대상은 다음 턴 시작까지 당신 이외의 생물에게 명중 굴림에 -1 상태 페널티를 받습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.FaEvoqZXfQ7xnpRo]{효과: 화약 장갑}

name: The Dead Walk

description.value: You beseech warrior spirits to come forth and aid you. Two ghostly warriors manifest within a @Template[emanation|distance:30] of you and each attempt a Strike against an adjacent enemy, using your spell attack modifier. The warriors' Strikes each deal @Damage[4d6[spirit]] damage and the warriors can flank with one another and with you and your allies. If you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zXZjC8HLaRoLR17U]{Cursebound 2} when you use The Dead Walk, you instead summon three warriors, and if you are cursebound 3, you instead summon four warriors. The warriors disappear at the start of your next turn.

_desc_en: You beseech warrior spirits to come forth and aid you. Two ghostly warriors manifest within a @Template[emanation|distance:30] of you and each attempt a Strike against an adjacent enemy, using your spell attack modifier. The warriors' Strikes each deal @Damage[4d6[spirit]] damage and the warriors can flank with one another and with you and your allies. If you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zXZjC8HLaRoLR17U]{Cursebound 2} when you use The Dead Walk, you instead summon three warriors, and if you are cursebound 3, you instead summon four warriors. The warriors disappear at the start of your next turn.
_desc_ko: 당신은 전사 영혼들을 불러내어 도움을 부르기 위해 부릅니다. 두 유령 전사가 당신으로부터 30피트 이내에 창조되어 각각 인접한 적을 상대로 당신의 주문 공격 수정자 수정치를 사용한 공격을 시도합니다. 전사들의 공격은 각각 4d6 영혼의 피해를 입히며, 전사들은 서로와 당신 및 아군과 함께 측면 공격을 할 수 있습니다. 당신이 @link[conditions.cursebound]{2} 상태일 때 죽은 자의 행진을 사용하면 대신 세 명의 전사를 소환하며, 저주에 묶임 3일 경우 네 명의 전사를 소환합니다. 전사들은 당신의 다음 턴 시작 시 사라집니다.

name: Tenacious Toxins

description.value: Your victims tend to expire long before your poisons, since the latter have been specifically formulated to last longer. The maximum duration of any poison you create increases by an amount equal to the poison's stage 1 interval, to a maximum of twice the poison's maximum duration.

_desc_en: Your victims tend to expire long before your poisons, since the latter have been specifically formulated to last longer. The maximum duration of any poison you create increases by an amount equal to the poison's stage 1 interval, to a maximum of twice the poison's maximum duration.
_desc_ko: 당신의 독보다 희생자가 먼저 숨을 거두는 경우가 많다. 독은 특별히 오래 지속되도록 제조되었기 때문이다. 당신이 생성하는 모든 독의 최대 지속 시간은 해당 독의 1단계 간격만큼 증가하며, 최대 지속 시간의 두 배를 초과할 수 없다.

name: Bloom of Health

description.value: You shout a rallying cry that inspires the well-being of your kingdom's protectors. All your knights who hear your cry gain fast healing equal to half your level for 1 minute.

_desc_en: You shout a rallying cry that inspires the well-being of your kingdom's protectors. All your knights who hear your cry gain fast healing equal to half your level for 1 minute.
_desc_ko: 당신은 왕국 수호자들의 건강을 고취시키는 함성을 지른다. 당신의 함성을 들은 모든 기사들은 1분 동안 당신의 레벨 절반에 해당하는 빠른 치유 효과를 얻는다.

name: Drilled Reflexes

description.value: You leave a lasting impression on your squadmates that makes them particularly adept at following your commands. When you use your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.A5nOG2HuM8ZhMJ5p]{Drilled Reactions} ability, you can give an extra reaction to up to two allies instead of only one.

_desc_en: You leave a lasting impression on your squadmates that makes them particularly adept at following your commands. When you use your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.A5nOG2HuM8ZhMJ5p]{Drilled Reactions} ability, you can give an extra reaction to up to two allies instead of only one.
_desc_ko: 당신은 분대원들에게 지속적인 인상을 남기며, 그들이 당신의 명령을 특히 능숙하게 따르도록 합니다. 훈련된 반응 능력을 사용할 때, 한 명 대신 최대 두 명의 아군에게 추가 반응을 부여할 수 있습니다.

name: Nimble Hooves

description.value:
You possess hooves, ankle wings, or some other feature that hastens your movement. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.

Special The Speed increase from this feat isn't cumulative with any Speed increase from other ancestry feats.

_desc_en:
You possess hooves, ankle wings, or some other feature that hastens your movement. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.

Special The Speed increase from this feat isn't cumulative with any Speed increase from other ancestry feats.
_desc_ko:
발굽, 발목 날개 또는 이동 속도를 높여주는 다른 특징을 지녔습니다. 이동 속도가 5피트 증가합니다.

특수 이 재주로 인한 이동 속도 증가는 다른 혈통 피트로 인한 이동 속도 증가와 중첩되지 않습니다.

name: Return to the Sea

description.value:
You adapt a creature to living and moving in water. Target a willing creature within 30 feet. For 10 minutes, it gains the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.RvBlSIJmxiqfCpR9]{Feet to Fins} spell, can breathe water, and gets a +1 status bonus to AC and saves against any creature with the amphibious, aquatic, or water trait. In addition, its attacks ignore the effects water normally has on bludgeoning and slashing attacks. If you use Return to the Sea again, any existing one ends.

Level (6th) You can target up to 5 willing creatures.

_desc_en:
You adapt a creature to living and moving in water. Target a willing creature within 30 feet. For 10 minutes, it gains the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.RvBlSIJmxiqfCpR9]{Feet to Fins} spell, can breathe water, and gets a +1 status bonus to AC and saves against any creature with the amphibious, aquatic, or water trait. In addition, its attacks ignore the effects water normally has on bludgeoning and slashing attacks. If you use Return to the Sea again, any existing one ends.

Level (6th) You can target up to 5 willing creatures.
_desc_ko:
생물이 물속에서 생활하고 이동할 수 있도록 적응시킵니다. 30피트 내의 동의한 대상을 대상으로 합니다. 10분 동안 대상은 @link[spells.feet-to-fins] 주문 효과를 얻으며, 물을 호흡할 수 있고, 양서류, 수생 또는 물 속성을 가진 모든 생물에 대한 AC와 내성에 +1 상태 보너스를 받습니다. 또한 대상의 공격은 물이 타격 및 베기 공격에 미치는 효과를 무시합니다. 바다로 돌아가기 주문을 다시 사용하면 기존 효과는 종료됩니다.

레벨 (6th) 최대 5명의 동의한 대상들을 대상으로 할 수 있습니다.

name: Lizardfolk Lore

description.value:
You listened carefully to the tales passed down among your community. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Survival and either Nature or Occultism. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for either Astrology Lore or Lizardfolk Lore.

_desc_en:
You listened carefully to the tales passed down among your community. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Survival and either Nature or Occultism. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for either Astrology Lore or Lizardfolk Lore.
_desc_ko:
당신은 공동체에서 전해 내려오는 이야기를 주의 깊게 들었습니다. 생존 기술과 자연학 또는 오컬트 중 하나의 숙련 등급을 획득합니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 해당 기술 중 하나에 자동으로 숙련이 부여된다면, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련이 부여됩니다.

또한 점성술 지식 또는 리자드포크 지식 중 하나의 @link[feats.additional-lore] 일반 피트를 획득한다.

name: Heal Companion

description.value: You have a deep devotion to your animal companion that enables you to magically heal their wounds. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KIV2LqzS5KtqOItV]{Heal Companion} warden spell and a focus pool of 1 Focus Point.

_desc_en: You have a deep devotion to your animal companion that enables you to magically heal their wounds. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KIV2LqzS5KtqOItV]{Heal Companion} warden spell and a focus pool of 1 Focus Point.
_desc_ko: 당신은 동물 동료에 대한 깊은 헌신으로 그들의 상처를 마법으로 치유할 수 있습니다. @link[spells.heal-companion] 워든 주문을 획득하고 1 포커스 포인트의 포커스 풀을 얻습니다.

name: Expert Drill Sergeant

description.value: While exploring, when you are leading and allies are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tfa4Sh7wcxCEqL29]{Following the Expert}, instead of granting a +2 circumstance bonus in the applicable skill, you grant a +3 circumstance bonus if you're an expert and a +4 circumstance bonus if you're a master.

_desc_en: While exploring, when you are leading and allies are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tfa4Sh7wcxCEqL29]{Following the Expert}, instead of granting a +2 circumstance bonus in the applicable skill, you grant a +3 circumstance bonus if you're an expert and a +4 circumstance bonus if you're a master.
_desc_ko: 탐험 중, 당신이 선두에 서 있고 동료들이 @link[actions.follow-the-expert], 해당 기술에 +2 상황 보너스를 부여하는 대신, 당신이 전문가라면 +3 상황 보너스를, 마스터라면 +4 상황 보너스를 부여합니다.

name: Fortissimo Composition

description.value: Your anthems grow louder and more potent, bolstered by your muse's power. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kF0rs9mCPvJGfAZE]{Fortissimo Composition} spellshape focus spell.

_desc_en: Your anthems grow louder and more potent, bolstered by your muse's power. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kF0rs9mCPvJGfAZE]{Fortissimo Composition} spellshape focus spell.
_desc_ko: 뮤즈의 힘으로 당신의 찬가가 더욱 웅장하고 강력해집니다. 당신은 @link[spells.fortissimo-composition] 스펠셰이프 포커스 주문을 배웁니다.

name: Song of Strength

description.value: Your performances inspire strength in your allies to aid them at physical tasks. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Xxdwkt0EEDgP1LGc]{Song of Strength} composition cantrip.

_desc_en: Your performances inspire strength in your allies to aid them at physical tasks. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Xxdwkt0EEDgP1LGc]{Song of Strength} composition cantrip.
_desc_ko: 당신의 공연은 동맹들에게 육체적 작업에 도움이 되는 힘을 불어넣습니다. 당신은 @link[spells.song-of-strength] 작곡 캔트립을 배웁니다.

name: Adaptive Mask Familiar

description.value: Your mask familiar adapts quickly to material form, allowing it to gain more familiar and master abilities. You select four master and familiar abilities each day instead of two.

_desc_en: Your mask familiar adapts quickly to material form, allowing it to gain more familiar and master abilities. You select four master and familiar abilities each day instead of two.
_desc_ko: 마스크 패밀리어는 물질 형태에 빠르게 적응하여 더 많은 패밀리어 및 마스터 능력을 획득할 수 있습니다. 매일 두 가지 대신 네 가지 마스터 및 패밀리어 능력을 선택합니다.

name: Double Poison

description.value: You can apply two different infused injury poisons to the same weapon, though not to a piece of ammunition. Each poison's level must be 2 or more levels lower than your level. You have to apply the two poisons individually. Once you've applied both, the poisons merge into a double poison that uses the lower of the two poisons' DCs and number of stages. If the poisons require different types of saving throws (such as Fortitude and Will), choose which of them the double poison uses. This double poison is virulent only if both poisons were virulent. Combine the effects of each stage of the poison on any creature affected by it. For each stage of the poison, use the effects of both poisons and the longer interval for that stage among the two poisons.

_desc_en: You can apply two different infused injury poisons to the same weapon, though not to a piece of ammunition. Each poison's level must be 2 or more levels lower than your level. You have to apply the two poisons individually. Once you've applied both, the poisons merge into a double poison that uses the lower of the two poisons' DCs and number of stages. If the poisons require different types of saving throws (such as Fortitude and Will), choose which of them the double poison uses. This double poison is virulent only if both poisons were virulent. Combine the effects of each stage of the poison on any creature affected by it. For each stage of the poison, use the effects of both poisons and the longer interval for that stage among the two poisons.
_desc_ko: 같은 무기에 두 가지 다른 주입형 상처 독을 적용할 수 있으나, 탄약에는 적용할 수 없다. 각 독의 레벨은 당신의 레벨보다 2레벨 이상 낮아야 한다. 두 독은 개별적으로 적용해야 합니다. 두 독을 모두 적용하면, 두 독 중 더 낮은 DC와 단계 수를 사용하는 이중 독으로 합쳐집니다. 이 이중 독은 두 독 모두 독성이 있을 때만 독성이 있습니다. 독의 각 단계 효과가 영향을 받은 생물에게 적용될 때, 두 독의 효과를 모두 사용하고 해당 단계에서 두 독 중 더 긴 간격을 적용합니다.

name: Spiritual Disruption

description.value: You channel disruptive power that severs a foe's spiritual connection to their magic. Make a melee Strike. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. If the attack hits, the target takes @Damage[1d6[persistent,spirit]] damage. The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until it stops taking the persistent spirit damage.

_desc_en: You channel disruptive power that severs a foe's spiritual connection to their magic. Make a melee Strike. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. If the attack hits, the target takes @Damage[1d6[persistent,spirit]] damage. The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until it stops taking the persistent spirit damage.
_desc_ko: 당신은 적의 이단 마법과의 영적 연결을 끊는 교란의 힘을 발산합니다. 근접 공격을 시도하십시오. 공격이 명중하면, 대상이 신성 마법이나 오컬트 마법을 시전하려 할 때마다 해당 마법은 DC 5 단순(치명타 시 DC 7 단순)에 성공하지 못하면 방해받습니다. 대상이 @link[conditions.stupefied]인 경우, 두 단순 판정 중 더 어려운 판정 하나를 시도해야 합니다(둘 다 아님). 이 효과는 1분 동안 지속됩니다.

name: Summon Water Elemental

description.value: You can summon an elemental ally. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lpT6LotUaQPfinjj]{Summon Elemental} as a 5th-rank primal innate spell, but the elemental summoned must be a water elemental.

_desc_en: You can summon an elemental ally. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lpT6LotUaQPfinjj]{Summon Elemental} as a 5th-rank primal innate spell, but the elemental summoned must be a water elemental.
_desc_ko: 원소 동료를 소환할 수 있다. 하루에 한 번, @link[spells.summon-elemental]을 (5th)랭크 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있으나, 소환된 원소는 반드시 물 원소여야 한다.

name: Fang Sharpener

description.value: You have filed your teeth into jagged points and have an unusually powerful jaw, making your mouth a dangerous weapon. If you're an irongut goblin, you gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d4 piercing damage, and if you're a razortooth goblin, your jaws unarmed attack deals 1d8 piercing damage and loses the finesse trait. Whenever you score a critical hit with your jaws unarmed attack, your target takes @Damage[1[bleed]] damage per weapon damage die.

value.value: irongut goblin or razortooth goblin heritage

_desc_en: You have filed your teeth into jagged points and have an unusually powerful jaw, making your mouth a dangerous weapon. If you're an irongut goblin, you gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d4 piercing damage, and if you're a razortooth goblin, your jaws unarmed attack deals 1d8 piercing damage and loses the finesse trait. Whenever you score a critical hit with your jaws unarmed attack, your target takes @Damage[1[bleed]] damage per weapon damage die.
_desc_ko: 당신은 이빨을 뾰족하게 갈고 이례적으로 강력한 턱을 지녀 입이 위험한 무기가 됩니다. 아이언거트 고블린이라면 턱 비무장 공격으로 1d4 관통 피해를 입히며, 레이저투스 고블린이라면 턱 비무장 공격으로 1d8 관통 피해를 입히지만 기교 특성을 상실한다. 턱 비무장 공격으로 치명타를 성공시킬 때마다 대상은 무기 피해 주사위당 1 출혈 피해를 추가로 입는다.

name: Steady Spellcasting (Magus)

description.value:
Confident in your technique, you don't easily lose your concentration when you Cast a Spell.

If a reaction would disrupt your spellcasting action, attempt a @Check[flat|showDC:all|dc:15] check. If you succeed, your action isn't disrupted.

_desc_en:
Confident in your technique, you don't easily lose your concentration when you Cast a Spell.

If a reaction would disrupt your spellcasting action, attempt a @Check[flat|showDC:all|dc:15] check. If you succeed, your action isn't disrupted.
_desc_ko:
당신의 기술에 자신감을 가지고 있어, 주문을 시전할 때 쉽게 집중력을 잃지 않습니다.

반응이 당신의 주문 시전 행동을 방해할 경우, DC 15 단순 판정을 시도하십시오. 성공하면 행동이 방해받지 않습니다.

name: Widen Spell

description.value: You manipulate the energy of your spell, causing it to spread out and affect a wider area. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has an area of a burst, cone, or line and does not have a duration, increase the area of that spell. Add 5 feet to the radius of a burst that normally has a radius of at least 10 feet (a burst with a smaller radius is not affected). Add 5 feet to the length of a cone or line that is normally 15 feet long or smaller, and add 10 feet to the length of a larger cone or line.

_desc_en: You manipulate the energy of your spell, causing it to spread out and affect a wider area. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has an area of a burst, cone, or line and does not have a duration, increase the area of that spell. Add 5 feet to the radius of a burst that normally has a radius of at least 10 feet (a burst with a smaller radius is not affected). Add 5 feet to the length of a cone or line that is normally 15 feet long or smaller, and add 10 feet to the length of a larger cone or line.
_desc_ko: 당신은 주문 에너지를 조작하여 더 넓은 영역에 퍼져 영향을 미치게 합니다. 다음 행동으로 지속 시간이 없는 폭발, 원뿔, 선 형태의 영역을 가진 주문을 시전할 경우, 해당 주문의 영역을 확대합니다. 반경이 최소 10피트인 폭발형 마법의 반경에 5피트를 추가합니다(반경이 더 작은 폭발형 마법은 영향을 받지 않음). 길이가 15피트 이하인 원뿔형 또는 선형 마법의 길이에 5피트를 추가하고, 더 긴 원뿔형 또는 선형 마법의 길이에 10피트를 추가합니다.

name: Wyldsinger

description.value:
Passion and song are your weapons of choice. You learn either the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6TudR1rDkxWMj1cv]{Menacing Lament} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.nRsBM1zkhMmV3VST]{Valiant Anthem} focus spell. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point.

Special You can take this feat a second time, gaining the focus spell you didn't gain the first time.

_desc_en:
Passion and song are your weapons of choice. You learn either the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6TudR1rDkxWMj1cv]{Menacing Lament} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.nRsBM1zkhMmV3VST]{Valiant Anthem} focus spell. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point.

Special You can take this feat a second time, gaining the focus spell you didn't gain the first time.
_desc_ko:
열정과 노래가 당신의 선택한 무기입니다. @link[spells.menacing-lament] 또는 @link[spells.valiant-anthem] 포커스 주문을 배웁니다. 아직 포커스 풀이 없다면, 1 포커스 포인트의 포커스 풀을 얻습니다.

특수 이 재주를 두 번째로 선택할 수 있으며, 첫 번째 선택 시 얻지 못한 포커스 주문을 얻습니다.

name: Mystic Life Force

description.value:
Magic energy sustains you, supporting your form far beyond the capabilities of mere flesh. You can't die except due to old age as long as you're under the effects of an ongoing spell or within your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XIgvCPaSy5WXStVD]{Spellsurge} aura; if your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} condition would increase to a high enough value to kill you, it doesn't increase, and any effect that would instantly kill you instead just reduces you to 0 Hit Points.

If you die for any reason, you transform into a magical font attached to an allied creature of your choice within 1 mile. This creature gains knowledge of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HBxsMKXzZM0HviEE]{Embodied Font} ritual to return you to your corporeal state. Until you're restored, once per hour, you can cast spellsurge, centered on the chosen creature. You still make all choices for the spellsurge and can take actions allowed by the spell, though you can take no other actions.

_desc_en:
Magic energy sustains you, supporting your form far beyond the capabilities of mere flesh. You can't die except due to old age as long as you're under the effects of an ongoing spell or within your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XIgvCPaSy5WXStVD]{Spellsurge} aura; if your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} condition would increase to a high enough value to kill you, it doesn't increase, and any effect that would instantly kill you instead just reduces you to 0 Hit Points.

If you die for any reason, you transform into a magical font attached to an allied creature of your choice within 1 mile. This creature gains knowledge of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HBxsMKXzZM0HviEE]{Embodied Font} ritual to return you to your corporeal state. Until you're restored, once per hour, you can cast spellsurge, centered on the chosen creature. You still make all choices for the spellsurge and can take actions allowed by the spell, though you can take no other actions.
_desc_ko:
마법 에너지가 당신을 지탱하여, 단순한 육체의 한계를 훨씬 뛰어넘는 형태를 유지하게 합니다. 지속되는 주문의 효과 아래 있거나 @link[spells.spellsurge] 오라 내에 있는 한, 노쇠로 인한 경우를 제외하고는 죽을 수 없습니다. 만약 당신의 @link[conditions.dying] 또는 @link[conditions.doomed] 상태가 치명적 수준으로 증가할 경우, 해당 상태는 증가하지 않으며 즉시 죽음을 초래할 수 있는 효과는 대신 HP를 0으로 감소시킵니다.

어떤 이유로든 죽으면, 1마일 이내의 선택한 아군 생물에게 부착된 마법 분수로 변한다. 이 생물은 당신을 육체 상태로 되돌리는 @link[spells.embodied-font] 의식의 지식을 얻는다. 회복되기 전까지, 시간당 한 번씩 선택한 생물체를 중심으로 주문발동을 시전할 수 있다. 주문발동에 대한 모든 선택은 여전히 자신이 하며, 주문이 허용하는 행동은 취할 수 있지만 다른 행동은 할 수 없다.

name: Brains!

description.value:
Trigger You Feast upon a humanoid's brain. The humanoid can't be mindless (or, if you're Feasting on a corpse, can't have been mindless while alive).

You consume the brains of your foe, causing synapses long rotten to fire and enabling you to shake off your mental torpor. You gain a +1 status bonus on skill checks to Recall Knowledge for 1 hour. If the humanoid had a higher modifier to the skill check you're using to Recall Knowledge than you do, the status bonus increases to +2.

_desc_en:
Trigger You Feast upon a humanoid's brain. The humanoid can't be mindless (or, if you're Feasting on a corpse, can't have been mindless while alive).

You consume the brains of your foe, causing synapses long rotten to fire and enabling you to shake off your mental torpor. You gain a +1 status bonus on skill checks to Recall Knowledge for 1 hour. If the humanoid had a higher modifier to the skill check you're using to Recall Knowledge than you do, the status bonus increases to +2.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신은 인간형 생물의 뇌를 먹어치운다. 해당 인간형 생물은 정신이 없는 상태일 수 없다(혹은 시체를 먹어치우는 경우, 생전에도 정신이 없었던 상태일 수 없다).

당신은 적의 뇌를 섭취하여 오래전 썩어버린 시냅스를 활성화시키고 정신적 무기력에서 벗어나게 합니다. 1시간 동안 지식 회상 기술 판정에서 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 해당 인간형 생물이 지식 회상 기술 판정에서 당신보다 높은 수정자를 가졌다면 상태 보너스는 +2로 증가합니다.

name: Resist Ruin

description.value: Your duskwalker heritage allows you to extend protection against void energy. You gain resistance 5 to void, and once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8ViwItUgwT4lOvvb]{False Vitality} as a 5th-rank divine innate spell.

_desc_en: Your duskwalker heritage allows you to extend protection against void energy. You gain resistance 5 to void, and once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8ViwItUgwT4lOvvb]{False Vitality} as a 5th-rank divine innate spell.
_desc_ko: 황혼의 방랑자 혈통 덕분에 공허 에너지에 대한 보호를 확장할 수 있습니다. 공허에 대한 저항력 5를 얻으며, 하루에 한 번 @link[spells.false-vitality]을 (5th)랭크 신성 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Pain Tolerance

description.value:
Access You're from Alkenstar or the Mana Wastes.

You gain resistance to mental damage equal to half your level and a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects that would make you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}.

publication.title: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powder Keg

_desc_en:
Access You're from Alkenstar or the Mana Wastes.

You gain resistance to mental damage equal to half your level and a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects that would make you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}.
_desc_ko:
접근 당신은 알켄스터 또는 마나 웨이스트 출신입니다.

당신은 정신 피해에 대해 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 저항력을 얻으며, @link[conditions.clumsy], @link[conditions.drained], 또는 @link[conditions.enfeebled] 상태를 유발하는 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Inhale, Exhale!

description.value: You take an especially deep breath as a prelude to unleashing your dragonet breath on your foes. If your next action is to use your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.RaqjaXp2miOq4Bis]{Dragonet Breath}, add 5 feet to the length of the cone or line. If your breath deals damage, you also deal one additional die of damage.

_desc_en: You take an especially deep breath as a prelude to unleashing your dragonet breath on your foes. If your next action is to use your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.RaqjaXp2miOq4Bis]{Dragonet Breath}, add 5 feet to the length of the cone or line. If your breath deals damage, you also deal one additional die of damage.
_desc_ko: 당신은 적에게 드래고넷 브레스를 뿜어내기에 앞서 유난히 깊게 숨을 들이마십니다. 당신의 다음 행동이 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.RaqjaXp2miOq4Bis]{드래고넷 브레스} 사용이라면, 원뿔이나 직선의 길이에 5피트를 추가합니다. 당신의 브레스가 피해를 입힌다면, 추가로 주사위 1개만큼의 피해를 더 입힙니다.

name: Minor Magic

description.value: You've dabbled in minor magical abilities. Choose arcane, divine, occult, or primal magic, and gain two cantrips from the common cantrips that are available in that tradition. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast a Spell} activity, your key spellcasting ability is Charisma, and you're trained in spell attack rolls and DCs for the tradition you chose.

_desc_en: You've dabbled in minor magical abilities. Choose arcane, divine, occult, or primal magic, and gain two cantrips from the common cantrips that are available in that tradition. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast a Spell} activity, your key spellcasting ability is Charisma, and you're trained in spell attack rolls and DCs for the tradition you chose.
_desc_ko: 당신은 사소한 마법 능력에 손을 대본 적이 있습니다. 아케인 마법, 신성 마법, 오컬트 마법, 프라이멀 마법 중 하나를 선택하고, 해당 전통에서 공통 캔트립 중 두 가지를 획득합니다. @link[actions.cast-a-spell] 행동을 획득하며, 주문 시전의 주요 능력치는 매력입니다. 또한 선택한 전통의 주문 명중 굴림과 난이도(DC)에 숙련됩니다.

name: Terrain Advantage

description.value: Non-lizardfolk creatures in difficult terrain are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you. If you have a swim Speed, non-lizardfolk creatures that are in water and lack a swim Speed are also off-guard to you.

_desc_en: Non-lizardfolk creatures in difficult terrain are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you. If you have a swim Speed, non-lizardfolk creatures that are in water and lack a swim Speed are also off-guard to you.
_desc_ko: 어려운 지형에 있는 리자드포크가 아닌 생물은 당신에게 @link[conditions.off-guard]가 됩니다. 당신이 수영 속도를 가진 경우, 물속에 있고 수영 속도가 없는 리자드포크가 아닌 생물도 당신에게 무방비가 됩니다.

name: Spell Swipe

description.value:
Requirements Your Spellstrike is charged.

You attack in an arc and enact your spell against everyone you hit. Make a Spellstrike, but roll separate Strikes to attack two creatures, each of whom must be within your melee reach and adjacent to each other. If your spell could affect two or more targets, your spell affects whichever foes you hit, not just the first target; otherwise, choose one target to affect with the spell. A Spell Swipe counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after you make both attacks.

If you're using a weapon that has the sweep trait, its circumstance bonus applies against both targets. You can use this activity with only melee Strikes, even if you have the starlit span hybrid study or a similar ability.

If you use Expansive Spellstrike to Spellstrike with an area spell, apply the area as described in Expansive Spellstrike, choosing one of the creatures you Strike to determine the area and whether the spell fails due to a critically failed Strike. If you use Expansive Spellstrike to Spellstrike with a targeted spell, the spell is lost completely only if both Strikes are critical failures.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your Spellstrike is charged.

You attack in an arc and enact your spell against everyone you hit. Make a Spellstrike, but roll separate Strikes to attack two creatures, each of whom must be within your melee reach and adjacent to each other. If your spell could affect two or more targets, your spell affects whichever foes you hit, not just the first target; otherwise, choose one target to affect with the spell. A Spell Swipe counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after you make both attacks.

If you're using a weapon that has the sweep trait, its circumstance bonus applies against both targets. You can use this activity with only melee Strikes, even if you have the starlit span hybrid study or a similar ability.

If you use Expansive Spellstrike to Spellstrike with an area spell, apply the area as described in Expansive Spellstrike, choosing one of the creatures you Strike to determine the area and whether the spell fails due to a critically failed Strike. If you use Expansive Spellstrike to Spellstrike with a targeted spell, the spell is lost completely only if both Strikes are critical failures.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신의 스펠스트라이크가 충전되어 있어야 합니다.

당신은 호를 그리며 공격하고 맞은 모든 대상에게 주문을 발동합니다. 스펠스트라이크를 수행하되, 두 생물을 공격하려면 각각 근접 공격 범위 내에 있고 서로 인접한 상태여야 하며 별도의 공격 주사위를 굴립니다. 주문이 두 개 이상의 대상에 영향을 줄 수 있다면, 첫 번째 대상뿐만 아니라 맞은 모든 적에게 주문이 적용됩니다. 그렇지 않은 경우, 주문이 적용될 대상 하나를 선택합니다. 주문 휘두르기는 다중 공격 페널티 계산 시 두 번의 공격으로 간주되나, 페널티는 두 공격을 모두 수행한 후에야 증가한다.

스윕 특성을 가진 무기를 사용할 경우, 해당 무기의 상황 보너스가 두 대상 모두에게 적용됩니다. 별빛 스팬 혼합 연구나 유사한 능력을 보유한 경우에도 근접 공격으로만 이 행동을 사용할 수 있습니다.

확장 스펠스트라이크로 영역 스펠스트라이크로 스펠스트라이크를 할 경우, 확장 스펠스트라이크에 설명된 대로 영역을 적용하며, 강타한 생물 중 하나를 선택하여 영역을 결정하고 대실패한 공격으로 인해 마법이 실패하는지 여부를 판단합니다. 확장 스펠스트라이크로 대상 지정 스펠스트라이크로 스펠스트라이크를 할 경우, 두 공격 모두 대실패일 때만 마법이 완전히 소멸됩니다.

name: Vengeful Oath

description.value: You've sworn an oath to hunt down wicked evildoers and bring them to judgment. You gain the following edict: "You must hunt down and exterminate creatures that have committed heinous atrocities." You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zNN9212H2FGfM7VS]{Lay on Hands} to damage a creature you witness harming an innocent or a ally as if it were undead; in this case, lay on hands deals spirit damage instead of vitality damage and gains the holy trait. This doesn't prevent you from healing such a creature with lay on hands; you choose whether to heal or harm.

_desc_en: You've sworn an oath to hunt down wicked evildoers and bring them to judgment. You gain the following edict: "You must hunt down and exterminate creatures that have committed heinous atrocities." You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zNN9212H2FGfM7VS]{Lay on Hands} to damage a creature you witness harming an innocent or a ally as if it were undead; in this case, lay on hands deals spirit damage instead of vitality damage and gains the holy trait. This doesn't prevent you from healing such a creature with lay on hands; you choose whether to heal or harm.
_desc_ko: 당신은 사악한 악당들을 추적하여 심판에 넘기겠다는 맹세를 했습니다. 다음의 칙령을 얻습니다: "당신은 잔혹한 만행을 저지른 생물들을 추적하여 박멸해야 한다." @link[spells.lay-on-hands]를 사용하여 무고한 자나 아군을 해치는 생물을 목격할 경우, 마치 언데드인 것처럼 피해를 줄 수 있습니다. 이 경우 안수치료는 활력 피해 대신 영혼 피해를 입히며 신성한 속성을 얻습니다. 이는 안수치료로 해당 생물을 치유하는 것을 막지 않습니다. 치유할지 해칠지는 당신이 선택합니다.

name: Expert Oracle Spellcasting

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{Expert Spellcasting Feat} benefits.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{Expert Spellcasting Feat} benefits.
_desc_ko: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{전문 주문 시전 피트}의 혜택을 얻습니다.

name: Battlefront Sabotage

description.value:
Requirements You have a free hand.

You know methods of sabotaging your enemy's war machines and weaponry. You can attempt to sabotage a siege weapon or vehicle with a @Check[thievery] check against the standard DC of the weapon or vehicle's level.

Critical Success The next time the weapon is Launched or the vehicle moves, it targets or moves to a square of your choice instead of its intended target.

Success As critical success, but the weapon or vehicle targets or moves to a random square.

Failure The sabotage fails.

Additionally, you can use Battlefront Sabotage to sabotage a weapon an enemy is wielding. Choose a creature wielding a melee or ranged weapon within your reach and attempt a Thievery check against their Reflex DC. On a success, the weapon's wielder must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:11] the next time it attempts a Strike with that weapon or the action is disrupted, as part of the weapon's structural integrity falters. The creature is then temporarily immune to Battlefront Sabotage of their weapons for 10 minutes.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have a free hand.

You know methods of sabotaging your enemy's war machines and weaponry. You can attempt to sabotage a siege weapon or vehicle with a @Check[thievery] check against the standard DC of the weapon or vehicle's level.

Critical Success The next time the weapon is Launched or the vehicle moves, it targets or moves to a square of your choice instead of its intended target.

Success As critical success, but the weapon or vehicle targets or moves to a random square.

Failure The sabotage fails.

Additionally, you can use Battlefront Sabotage to sabotage a weapon an enemy is wielding. Choose a creature wielding a melee or ranged weapon within your reach and attempt a Thievery check against their Reflex DC. On a success, the weapon's wielder must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:11] the next time it attempts a Strike with that weapon or the action is disrupted, as part of the weapon's structural integrity falters. The creature is then temporarily immune to Battlefront Sabotage of their weapons for 10 minutes.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 빈 손이어야 합니다.

적의 전쟁 기계와 무기를 파괴하는 방법을 알고 있습니다. 공성 무기나 차량을 파괴하려면 해당 무기나 차량의 레벨에 따른 표준 DC(DC)에 맞춘 도둑질 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다.

대성공 다음에 해당 무기가 발사되거나 차량이 이동할 때, 원래 목표 대신 당신이 선택한 칸을 목표로 삼거나 그곳으로 이동합니다.

성공 대성공과 동일하나, 무기나 차량이 무작위 칸으로 표적 설정 또는 이동합니다.

실패 사보타주가 실패합니다.

추가로, 배틀프론트 사보타주를 사용해 적이 휘두르는 무기를 사보타주할 수 있다. 자신의 도달 범위 내에 근접 무기나 원거리 무기를 휘두르는 생물을 선택하고, 그 생물의 반사 DC에 대해 도둑질 판정을 시도하다. 성공 시, 해당 무기 사용자는 다음에 그 무기로 공격을 시도할 때 DC 11 단순에 성공해야 하며, 그렇지 않으면 무기의 구조적 안정성이 약화되어 행동이 방해받습니다. 이후 10분 동안 해당 생물은 자신의 무기에 대한 전선 파괴술에 일시적으로 면역됩니다.

name: Shroud of the Seas

description.value: You've learned to camouflage yourself among the shadows and currents of the ocean so you're hard to see from above. When you're fully underwater, you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to all opponents who are out of the water, and hidden to those who are out of the water and more than 10 feet away from you.

_desc_en: You've learned to camouflage yourself among the shadows and currents of the ocean so you're hard to see from above. When you're fully underwater, you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to all opponents who are out of the water, and hidden to those who are out of the water and more than 10 feet away from you.
_desc_ko: 당신은 바다의 그림자와 물살 속에 몸을 숨기는 법을 익혀 위에서 보기 어려워졌습니다. 완전히 물속에 있을 때, 당신은 물 밖에 있는 모든 적에게 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{은폐} 상태이며, 물 밖에 있으면서 당신으로부터 10피트 넘게 떨어져 있는 대상에게는 숨겨짐 상태입니다.

name: Scattering Shout

description.value:
With a flex of your mighty thews and a guttural bellow that can make ears bleed, you drive back any enemies surrounding you. Each enemy within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class|options:area-effect] saving throw against your class DC.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is pushed 5 feet away from you.

Failure The creature is pushed 10 feet away from you and takes @Damage[8d6[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage.

Critical Failure The creature is pushed 15 feet away from you and takes @Damage[16d6[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage.

_desc_en:
With a flex of your mighty thews and a guttural bellow that can make ears bleed, you drive back any enemies surrounding you. Each enemy within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class|options:area-effect] saving throw against your class DC.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is pushed 5 feet away from you.

Failure The creature is pushed 10 feet away from you and takes @Damage[8d6[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage.

Critical Failure The creature is pushed 15 feet away from you and takes @Damage[16d6[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage.
_desc_ko:
당신의 강력한 근육을 휘두르며 귀를 찢을 듯한 목구멍 깊은 포효를 내지르자, 주변의 모든 적들이 밀려납니다. 10피트 발산 범위 내의 각 적은 당신의 클래스 DC(DC)에 맞춘 인내 내성 굴림을 시도해야 합니다.

대성공 대상은 영향을 받지 않는다.

성공 생물은 당신으로부터 5피트 밀려납니다.

실패 생물은 당신으로부터 10피트 밀려나며 8d6 음파의 피해를 입습니다.

대실패 해당 생물은 당신으로부터 15피트 밀려나며 16d6 음파의 피해를 입습니다.

name: Remake the World

description.value:
For the briefest of moments, you can reach into the realm of true gods, gaining the power to shape reality to your will. Once per day, you can create the effects of a divine spell of 8th level or lower. The spell must be common or one to which you otherwise have access, and it costs as many actions as it would typically take to cast. Use your class DC in place of any necessary spell DC and your class DC – 10 in place of any necessary counteract modifier or spell attack modifier.

Because you are creating these effects with your godly might rather than Casting a Spell, they can't be dispelled or counteracted, like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.O3vj6p7K49gKKVWM]{Strike Rivers, Seize Winds}.

_desc_en:
For the briefest of moments, you can reach into the realm of true gods, gaining the power to shape reality to your will. Once per day, you can create the effects of a divine spell of 8th level or lower. The spell must be common or one to which you otherwise have access, and it costs as many actions as it would typically take to cast. Use your class DC in place of any necessary spell DC and your class DC – 10 in place of any necessary counteract modifier or spell attack modifier.

Because you are creating these effects with your godly might rather than Casting a Spell, they can't be dispelled or counteracted, like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.O3vj6p7K49gKKVWM]{Strike Rivers, Seize Winds}.
_desc_ko:
순간적으로 진정한 신들의 렐름에 닿아 현실을 자신의 의지대로 형성하는 힘을 얻을 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, (8th) 레벨 이하의 신성 마법 효과를 창조할 수 있습니다. 해당 주문은 일반 주문이거나 본인이 사용할 수 있는 주문이어야 하며, 시전하는 데 일반적으로 소요되는 행동 수만큼의 행동을 소모한다. 필요한 주문 난이도(DC) 대신 본인의 직업 난이도(DC)를, 필요한 반격 수정자나 주문 공격 수정자 대신 본인의 직업 난이도(DC) - 10을 사용한다.

이 효과들은 주문을 시전하는 것이 아니라 신성한 힘으로 창조하는 것이므로, @link[feats.strike-rivers-seize-winds]와 같이 해제되거나 반격될 수 없습니다.

name: Stone Blood (Stonebound)

description.value: Your blood becomes thick and sluggish, but no less effective at oxygenating your cells. You can selectively stop your bleeding with ease. Reduce the DC of flat checks to stop persistent bleed damage from 15 to 10, and you can use a single action that has the concentrate trait to gain an early flat check without physically binding the wounds. You recover from the drained condition twice as quickly as normal.

_desc_en: Your blood becomes thick and sluggish, but no less effective at oxygenating your cells. You can selectively stop your bleeding with ease. Reduce the DC of flat checks to stop persistent bleed damage from 15 to 10, and you can use a single action that has the concentrate trait to gain an early flat check without physically binding the wounds. You recover from the drained condition twice as quickly as normal.
_desc_ko: 혈액이 끈적하고 느려지지만 세포 산소 공급 능력은 유지됩니다. 출혈을 선택적으로 쉽게 멈출 수 있습니다. 지속적 출혈 피해를 멈추기 위한 단순 판정 난이도를 15에서 10으로 낮추며, 집중 특성을 가진 액션 하나로 상처를 물리적으로 봉합하지 않고도 조기 단순 판정을 수행할 수 있습니다. 흡수 상태에서 회복 속도가 정상보다 두 배 빠릅니다.

name: Epiphany at the Crossroads

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger Your turn begins.

Requirements You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition.

The crossroads between life and death is a place that can reveal many secrets. You gain the effects of an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X]{Augury} spell in a strange, near-death vision. Empowered by the realization, you then lose the dying condition (becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded 1} or increasing your wounded value by 1, as normal), regain @Damage[2*@actor.level[healing]] Hit Points, and can Stand.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger Your turn begins.

Requirements You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition.

The crossroads between life and death is a place that can reveal many secrets. You gain the effects of an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X]{Augury} spell in a strange, near-death vision. Empowered by the realization, you then lose the dying condition (becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded 1} or increasing your wounded value by 1, as normal), regain @Damage[2*@actor.level[healing]] Hit Points, and can Stand.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 자신의 턴이 시작될 때.

조건 당신은 @link[conditions.unconscious] 상태이며 @link[conditions.dying] 상태를 가지고 있습니다.

삶과 죽음의 경계는 수많은 비밀을 드러내는 장소입니다. 당신은 기이한 임사 체험 속에서 @link[spells.augury] 주문의 효과를 얻습니다. 깨달음에 힘입어, 당신은 죽어감 상태를 잃고 (일반적인 방식대로 @link[conditions.wounded]{1} 상태가 되거나 일반적인 방식으로 부상 수치를 1 증가시킵니다), 회복 HP를 회복하고, 일어설 수 있습니다.

name: Avowed Insight

description.value:
You become trained in the Lore skill corresponding to one creature type mentioned by your vow (for example, Fey Lore if your heritage is deny the firstborn pursuit). Whenever you successfully Recall Knowledge about this type of creature, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws against that creature's attacks and abilities for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.P4EkIpTqPDB3gNba]{Effect: Avowed Insight}

value.value: Yaksha heritage with an edict that requires you to confront a certain type of creature

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You become trained in the Lore skill corresponding to one creature type mentioned by your vow (for example, Fey Lore if your heritage is deny the firstborn pursuit). Whenever you successfully Recall Knowledge about this type of creature, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws against that creature's attacks and abilities for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.P4EkIpTqPDB3gNba]{Effect: Avowed Insight}
_desc_ko:
서약에 언급된 생물 유형 하나에 해당하는 지식(예: 첫째를 거부하는 추구를 계보로 삼았다면 페이 지식)에 숙련됩니다. 이 생물 유형에 대한 지식을 성공적으로 회상할 때마다, 해당 생물의 공격 및 능력에 대한 AC와 내성 굴림에 1라운드 동안 +1의 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.P4EkIpTqPDB3gNba]{효과: 맹세한 통찰}

name: Defy the Darkness

description.value: Using ancient dwarven methods developed to fight enemies wielding magical darkness, you've honed your darkvision and sworn not to use such magic yourself. You gain greater darkvision, enabling you to see through magical darkness even if it normally hampers darkvision (such as the darkness created by a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4GE2ZdODgIQtg51c]{Darkness} spell). You can't cast spells with the darkness trait, use item activations with the darkness trait, or use any other ability with the darkness trait.

_desc_en: Using ancient dwarven methods developed to fight enemies wielding magical darkness, you've honed your darkvision and sworn not to use such magic yourself. You gain greater darkvision, enabling you to see through magical darkness even if it normally hampers darkvision (such as the darkness created by a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4GE2ZdODgIQtg51c]{Darkness} spell). You can't cast spells with the darkness trait, use item activations with the darkness trait, or use any other ability with the darkness trait.
_desc_ko: 마법적 어둠을 휘두르는 적과 싸우기 위해 고대 드워프들이 개발한 방법을 사용해, 당신은 암흑 시야를 연마했으며 스스로 그런 마법을 사용하지 않겠다고 맹세했습니다. 고급 암흑 시야를 얻어, 일반적으로 암흑 시력을 방해하는 마법적 어둠(예: 4랭크 @link[spells.darkness] 주문이 만들어내는 어둠) 속에서도 볼 수 있다. 어둠 속성을 가진 주문을 시전하거나, 어둠 속성을 가진 아이템의 발동 효과를 사용하거나, 어둠 속성을 가진 다른 능력을 사용할 수 없다.

name: Redirecting Draft

description.value:
Trigger You or an ally within 10 feet of you is the target of a ranged physical Strike.

You flap your wings to blow arrows off course. You or the triggering ally gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses, you redirected the attack's flight path.

_desc_en:
Trigger You or an ally within 10 feet of you is the target of a ranged physical Strike.

You flap your wings to blow arrows off course. You or the triggering ally gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses, you redirected the attack's flight path.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신 또는 당신으로부터 10피트 이내의 아군이 원거리 물리 공격의 대상이 된다.

날개를 퍼덕여 화살의 궤도를 빗나가게 합니다. 당신 또는 발동한 아군은 해당 공격에 대해 AC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 공격이 빗나간 경우, 당신은 공격의 비행 경로를 변경한 것입니다.

name: Magic Warrior Aspect

description.value: You can alter your form to gain an aspect of the animal your mask represents. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.b6UnLNikoq2Std1f]{Magic Warrior Aspect} focus spell.

_desc_en: You can alter your form to gain an aspect of the animal your mask represents. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.b6UnLNikoq2Std1f]{Magic Warrior Aspect} focus spell.
_desc_ko: 마스크가 상징하는 동물의 형상을 취할 수 있습니다. @link[spells.magic-warrior-aspect] 포커스 주문을 획득합니다.

name: Burrowing Shot

description.value: You tune your light mortar to maximize penetration into hard surfaces. You Launch your light mortar, dealing half the normal amount of damage to creatures in the area of the blast but double damage to objects and structures.

_desc_en: You tune your light mortar to maximize penetration into hard surfaces. You Launch your light mortar, dealing half the normal amount of damage to creatures in the area of the blast but double damage to objects and structures.
_desc_ko: 경박격포를 단단한 표면 관통력을 극대화하도록 조정한다. 경박격포를 발사하여 폭발 반경 내 생물에게 일반 피해량의 절반을, 물체와 구조물에는 두 배의 피해를 입힌다.

name: Aggravating Scratch

description.value: Your claws carry an irritant that is harmless to you but can be damaging to others. Your claw Strikes deal an additional 1d4 persistent poison damage on a critical hit.

_desc_en: Your claws carry an irritant that is harmless to you but can be damaging to others. Your claw Strikes deal an additional 1d4 persistent poison damage on a critical hit.
_desc_ko: 당신의 발톱에는 당신에게는 무해하지만 타인에게 해를 끼칠 수 있는 자극 물질이 묻어 있습니다. 발톱 공격이 치명타를 기록할 경우 추가로 1d4 지속 독 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Share Thoughts

description.value: You have an uncanny knack of communicating with other elves without speaking, though this habit that is often uncomfortable to observers. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.D442XMADp01qJ7Cs]{Mindlink} as an innate occult spell once per day, but you can target only other elves or half-elves.

_desc_en: You have an uncanny knack of communicating with other elves without speaking, though this habit that is often uncomfortable to observers. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.D442XMADp01qJ7Cs]{Mindlink} as an innate occult spell once per day, but you can target only other elves or half-elves.
_desc_ko: 당신은 말을 하지 않고도 다른 엘프들과 소통하는 기이한 재주를 지녔으나, 이 습관은 종종 관찰자들에게 불편함을 준다. 하루에 한 번, 선천적 오컬트 주문으로 @link[spells.mindlink]를 시전할 수 있으나, 대상은 다른 엘프나 하프엘프만 지정할 수 있다.

name: Piercing Critical

description.value: Your attacks with your preferred weapons deal especially devastating wounds. When you Strike with a firearm or crossbow for which you have legendary proficiency, you critically succeed if you roll a 19 on the die, as long as that result is a success.

_desc_en: Your attacks with your preferred weapons deal especially devastating wounds. When you Strike with a firearm or crossbow for which you have legendary proficiency, you critically succeed if you roll a 19 on the die, as long as that result is a success.
_desc_ko: 선호 무기로 가하는 공격은 특히 치명적인 상처를 입힌다. 전설적 숙련도를 가진 화기나 석궁으로 공격할 때, 주사위 결과 19가 나오면 성공 시 대성공으로 처리된다.

name: Ghost-Path Epiphany

description.value:
Deviating from the orthodox path, you tread an inauspicious descent littered with flowers of death; this heretical choice will, in time, earn you the enmity and fear of more traditional cultivators. You become sanctified with the unholy trait. You also learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gsYEuWv04XTDxe91]{Call Spirit} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7DN13ILADW2N9Z1t]{Commune} rituals, which can be used to contact only undead or entities from the Void or the Netherworld.

When you cast a ritual, you can reduce the number of secondary casters by 1 as you direct decaying fragments of your own soul, felled by your proximity to death, to assist with the ritual. When you do, you must fulfill any requirements for the secondary caster, and you attempt the secondary check normally performed by that secondary caster. You can't replace a secondary caster who's the target of the spell (as in the atone ritual).

정통의 길에서 벗어나 죽음의 꽃이 흩뿌려진 불길한 하강을 걷게 된다. 이 이단적인 선택은 시간이 지나면 전통적인 수행자들의 적대감과 두려움을 사게 할 것이다. 너는 불경한 특성을 지닌 성스러운 존재가 된다. 또한 @link[spells.call-spirit]과 @link[spells.commune] 의식을 익히게 되는데, 이 의식들은 언데드나 공허 또는 저승의 존재들과만 접촉할 수 있다.

의식을 시전할 때, 죽음에 가까워져 썩어가는 자신의 영혼 조각을 의식에 동원하여 보조 시전자 수를 1명 줄일 수 있습니다. 이때 보조 시전자의 요구 사항을 모두 충족해야 하며, 해당 보조 시전자가 수행하는 보조 판정을 시도합니다. 주문의 대상이 되는 보조 시전자(속죄 의식처럼)는 대체할 수 없다.

name: Quick Mount

description.value:
Requirements You are adjacent to a creature that is at least one size larger than you and is willing to be your mount.

You and your mount can spring into action at a moment's notice. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PM5jvValFkbFH3TV]{Mount} the creature and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{Command an Animal} to issue it an order of your choice.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are adjacent to a creature that is at least one size larger than you and is willing to be your mount.

You and your mount can spring into action at a moment's notice. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PM5jvValFkbFH3TV]{Mount} the creature and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{Command an Animal} to issue it an order of your choice.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 자신보다 최소 한 크기 이상 큰 생물과 인접해 있으며, 그 생물이 자신의 탈것이 되기를 원해야 합니다.

당신과 당신의 탈것은 순간적으로 행동에 나설 수 있습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.mount]을 타고 @link[actions.command-an-animal]하여 원하는 명령을 내립니다.

name: Tengu Feather Fan

description.value:
You've learned to bind some of your feathers together into a fan to focus your ancestral magic. You gain a tengu feather fan: a magic item of light Bulk with a level equal to your level and the primal trait. You (and only you) can cast tengu magic with the Wave Fan activation. If your fan is lost or destroyed, you can create a replacement during your daily preparations; if you do so, your previous fan falls apart into mundane feathers.

Your tengu feather fan contains a 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.g8QqHpv2CWDwmIm1]{Gust of Wind} spell. Further feats might add more spells and grant you additional activations of your tengu feather fan, but you can never have more than three activations per day, no matter how many such feats you have.

Activate—Wave Fan (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You cast your choice of one spell contained in your tengu feather fan. You can instead cast a cantrip you've gained from a heritage or an ancestry feat; this doesn't use up one of the fan's daily activations. This activation takes the spell's normal number of actions. The spell's DC is your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

_desc_ko:
당신은 선조의 마법을 포커스하기 위해 깃털 일부를 부채 모양으로 묶는 법을 익혔습니다. 당신은 텐구 깃털 부채를 얻습니다: 당신의 레벨과 프라이멀 특성에 해당하는 레벨을 가진 가벼운 벌크의 마법 아이템입니다. 당신(오직 당신만)은 부채 흔들기 발동으로 텐구 마법을 시전할 수 있습니다. 부채를 분실하거나 파괴당하면 일일 준비 시간에 대체품을 제작할 수 있습니다. 이때 기존 부채는 평범한 깃털로 분해됩니다.

당신의 텐구 깃털 부채에는 1랭크 @link[spells.gust-of-wind] 주문이 내재되어 있습니다. 추가 피트를 통해 더 많은 마법을 부여받고 텐구 깃털 부채의 발동 횟수를 늘릴 수 있지만, 하루에 최대 세 번 이상 발동할 수는 없습니다. 피트를 아무리 많이 보유해도 마찬가지입니다.

활성화-웨이브 팬 (조작)

사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

효과 당신은 텐구 깃털 부채에 담긴 주문 중 하나를 선택하여 시전합니다. 대신 유산 또는 혈통 피트로 얻은 캔트립을 시전할 수도 있습니다. 이 경우 부채의 일일 사용 횟수를 소모하지 않습니다. 이 사용은 해당 주문의 정상적인 행동 횟수를 소모합니다. 주문의 난이도(DC)는 당신의 직업 난이도(DC) 또는 주문 DC 중 더 높은 쪽으로 적용됩니다.

name: Second Sight

description.value:
You peer into the next several seconds to watch the potential timelines around a nearby creature unfold. Spend a Mythic Point, then make a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} at mythic proficiency about a creature you can see. This check gains the following additional effects.

Critical Success You learn all the actions the creature will take on its next turn (or in the first round of combat if combat hasn't begun), such as "Stride toward Seelah" or "Cast shield." These actions are locked in and the creature must attempt them, even if the situation changes, though it need not perform the actions in the order stated. For instance, if the creature locked in the actions "Stride toward Seelah," "Make a longsword Strike against Seelah," and "Raise a shield," and Seelah spent her turn moving adjacent to the creature, the creature can make the longsword Strike as its first action if it wishes. If the creature is unable to fulfill an action it committed to, it loses that action as it reels from a temporal paradox.

Success You gain one additional piece of information about the creature, as if you had critically succeeded at the Recall Knowledge check. If the situation changes drastically (perhaps Seelah becomes invisible and the creature is unaware where Seelah is), the GM determines what happens.

_desc_ko:
당신은 다가올 수 초를 들여다보며 근처 존재를 둘러싼 가능성의 시간선이 펼쳐지는 것을 지켜봅니다. 신화 점수를 소모한 뒤, 당신이 볼 수 있는 존재에 대해 신화 숙련도로 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{지식 회상} 판정을 합니다. 이 판정은 다음의 추가 효과를 얻습니다.

대성공 당신은 그 존재가 다음 턴(전투가 아직 시작되지 않았다면 전투 첫 라운드)에 취할 모든 행동을 알게 됩니다. 예를 들어 "셀라를 향해 보폭"이나 "방패 시전" 같은 것입니다. 이 행동들은 확정되어 상황이 바뀌더라도 해당 존재는 반드시 시도해야 하지만, 명시된 순서대로 수행할 필요는 없습니다. 예를 들어 어떤 존재가 "셀라를 향해 보폭", "셀라를 향해 장검 타격", "방패 올리기" 행동을 확정했고 셀라가 자기 턴에 그 존재와 인접하게 이동했다면, 그 존재는 원한다면 첫 행동으로 장검 타격을 할 수 있습니다. 만약 그 존재가 확정한 행동을 수행할 수 없게 되면, 시간의 역설로 인해 휘청거리며 그 행동을 잃습니다.

성공 당신은 마치 지식 회상 판정에서 대성공을 거둔 것처럼 그 존재에 대한 정보를 한 가지 추가로 얻습니다. 상황이 급격히 바뀌면(예를 들어 셀라가 투명해져 그 존재가 셀라의 위치를 모르게 되면), GM이 어떻게 될지 결정합니다.

name: Mask Familiar

description.value:
Your mask takes on a personality of its own, allowing it to serve as your familiar. Though you can still wear it as a mask, you can detach it from your face to grant it a bodily form of colored light that allows it to move around; usually, this is a miniature form of the animal the mask represents. Detaching or reattaching the familiar to transform it is a two-action activity. Even in mask form, the familiar can move around on its master's face and speaks in a distinct voice (if it can talk). It is easily recognized as more than a simple mask unless the familiar succeeds at a Deception check to Impersonate a mask. Other than its appearance and the fact that it can be worn, it functions as other familiars. Your mask familiar has access to the mask freeze familiar ability

Mask Freeze When in mask form, your familiar can hide its obvious supernatural qualities to pass as a simple, unassuming mask. It doesn't need to Impersonate to fool a passing glance, and it gains a +4 circumstance bonus to its Deception DC against an active observer Seeking or otherwise studying it.

_desc_ko:
당신의 가면은 독자적인 개성을 지니게 되어 당신의 패밀리어 역할을 합니다. 여전히 가면으로 착용할 수 있지만, 얼굴에서 분리하여 움직일 수 있는 색채 빛의 신체 형태를 부여할 수 있습니다. 일반적으로 이는 가면이 상징하는 동물의 미니어처 형태입니다. 익숙한 패밀리어를 분리하거나 재부착하여 변형시키는 것은 두 번의 행동이 필요한 활동이다. 가면 형태일 때도 익숙한 패밀리어는 마스터의 얼굴 위를 돌아다닐 수 있으며, 말할 수 있다면 독특한 목소리로 말한다. 익숙한 패밀리어가 가면을 가장하는 기만 판정에 성공하지 않는 한, 단순한 가면 이상으로 쉽게 인식된다. 외형과 착용 가능성 외에는 다른 익숙한 패밀리어와 동일하게 기능한다. 마스크 친숙체는 마스크 동결 패밀리어 능력을 사용할 수 있습니다

마스크 동결 가면 형태일 때, 당신의 패밀리어는 뚜렷한 초자연적 특성을 숨겨 평범하고 눈에 띄지 않는 가면으로 위장할 수 있습니다. 스쳐 지나가는 시선에는 기만술을 사용하지 않아도 속일 수 있으며, 적극적으로 관찰하거나 탐구하는 대상에 대한 속임수 DC에 +4 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Juggernaut Charge

description.value:
Requirements You are wearing medium or heavy armor.

As you move forward in a rush, you put the weight of your armor behind an attack that can drag a foe with you. You Stride. If you end your movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, you can make a melee Strike against that enemy, then Stride again. If your Strike hit and dealt damage, that enemy is pulled with you and is moved the same direction and distance as your second Stride.

_desc_en:

If you end your movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, you can make a melee Strike against that enemy, then Stride again. If your Strike hit and dealt damage, that enemy is pulled with you and is moved the same direction and distance as your second Stride.
_desc_ko:
Requirements 평갑 또는 중갑옷을 착용하고 있다.

돌진하며 전진할 때, 갑옷의 무게를 실어 적을 끌고 갈 수 있는 공격을 가한다. 스트라이드를 사용합니다. 적어도 한 명의 적과 근접 공격 범위 내에 이동을 종료하면, 해당 적에게 근접 공격을 가한 후 다시 스트라이드를 사용할 수 있습니다. 공격이 적중하여 피해를 입혔다면, 그 적은 당신과 함께 끌려가며 두 번째 스트라이드의 이동 방향과 거리만큼 이동합니다.

name: Feral Senses

description.value: The eyes and noses of animals are naturally sharper than most humanoids. While in your hybrid or animal shape, you gain low-light vision and imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet.

_desc_en: The eyes and noses of animals are naturally sharper than most humanoids. While in your hybrid or animal shape, you gain low-light vision and imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet.
_desc_ko: 동물의 눈과 코는 대부분의 인간형 생물보다 본질적으로 예민합니다. 혼혈 형태나 동물 형태일 때, 당신은 30피트 범위의 저조도 시야와 부정확한 후각을 얻습니다.

name: Form of the Beloved Mother

description.value:
Access Tian Xia origin or follower of Nalinivati

You channel the blessings of Nalinivati to transform into a manifestation of her will. You can cast 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wp09USMB3GIW1qbp]{Animal Form} as an occult innate spell once per day, but you can choose only snake form with the spell. You can spend an additional action casting animal form to also cast 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.xFp4EwVcYwSG336t]{Slither} centered on your location; Nalinivati's will ensures that the shadow snakes created by the spell never harm you, so you're unaffected by the spell. If you Dismiss animal form, the effects of slither end as well.
