_desc_ko:
당신은 적의 개인적 시간 흐름을 가속시켜, 그들이 더 빠른 속도로 시간을 겪게 만들어 정신과 신체에 끔찍한 부담을 지웁니다. 30피트 내의 대상으로 삼은 존재는 @Check[will|against:oracle|basic] 내성 굴림과 함께 @Damage[3d6[persistent,mental]] 피해를 받습니다. 대상의 턴이 끝날 때, 그들은 다른 모든 지속 피해 이후에 이 지속 피해를 받습니다. 그들이 지속 피해를 끝내기 위한 평면 판정을 굴리기 전에, 그들에게는 한 라운드가 추가로 흐릅니다. 이는 모든 이로운 효과, 부정적 효과, 질병, 상태, 기타 지속 피해의 지속시간에 영향을 미칩니다. 대상은 마치 그 시간이 흐른 것처럼 내성 굴림, 평면 판정, 기타 모든 굴림을 시도하고 피해를 받습니다. 그들은 빌린 시간으로 인한 지속 정신 피해를 한 라운드에 두 번 이상 받지는 않습니다.

빌린 시간을 사용할 때 당신이 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zXZjC8HLaRoLR17U]{저주속박 2}라면, 지속 피해가 4d6으로 증가합니다. 빌린 시간을 사용할 때 당신이 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zXZjC8HLaRoLR17U]{저주속박 3}이라면, 지속 피해가 5d6으로 증가합니다.

name: Cruel Piercing

description.value: You learn to impale your targets. When you're in Golden Erinys Stance, you gain the Puncture Flesh action.

_desc_en: You learn to impale your targets. When you're in Golden Erinys Stance, you gain the Puncture Flesh action.
_desc_ko: 당신은 대상을 꿰뚫는 법을 익힙니다. 당신이 황금 에리니에스 자세에 있을 때, 당신은 살점 꿰뚫기 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Hybrid Study Spell

description.value: Gain the conflux spell from a hybrid study of your choice. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can Refocus by studying your spellbook and performing a physical regimen. You don't gain any of the hybrid study's other benefits.

_desc_en: Gain the conflux spell from a hybrid study of your choice. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can Refocus by studying your spellbook and performing a physical regimen. You don't gain any of the hybrid study's other benefits.
_desc_ko: 선택한 혼혈 연구로부터 컨플럭스 주문을 획득합니다. 아직 보유하지 않았다면, 1 포커스 포인트의 포커스 풀을 얻으며, 주문서를 연구하고 신체 훈련을 수행함으로써 재집중할 수 있습니다. 혼혈 연구의 다른 혜택은 획득하지 않습니다.

name: Claw Snag

description.value:
Trigger A creature attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} while you have them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

You hook into the target, pulling yourself forward and rending flesh. Shift into claw stance if you aren't in it already, then make a frenzied claw Strike against the triggering creature.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} while you have them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

You hook into the target, pulling yourself forward and rending flesh. Shift into claw stance if you aren't in it already, then make a frenzied claw Strike against the triggering creature.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신이 그 생물을 붙잡거나 @link[conditions.restrained]한 상태에서 생물이 @link[actions.escape]을 시도할 때.

당신은 대상에게 갈고리를 걸어 앞으로 당기며 살점을 찢어냅니다. 아직 발동하지 않았다면 발톱 자세로 전환한 후, 발동한 생물에게 광란의 발톱 공격을 가합니다.

name: Automatic Knowledge

description.value:
You know basic facts off the top of your head. Choose a skill you're an expert in that has the Recall Knowledge action and for which you have the Assurance feat. You can use the Recall Knowledge action with that skill as a free action once per round. If you do, you must use Assurance on the skill check.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, choosing a different skill each time. You can use Automatic Knowledge with any skills you have chosen, but you can still use Automatic Knowledge only once per round.

value.value: expert in a skill with the recall knowledge action

_desc_en:
You know basic facts off the top of your head. Choose a skill you're an expert in that has the Recall Knowledge action and for which you have the Assurance feat. You can use the Recall Knowledge action with that skill as a free action once per round. If you do, you must use Assurance on the skill check.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, choosing a different skill each time. You can use Automatic Knowledge with any skills you have chosen, but you can still use Automatic Knowledge only once per round.
_desc_ko:
당신은 기본적인 사실을 즉각적으로 알고 있습니다. 당신이 전문가가 된 기술 중 지식 회상 행동을 가지고 있으며 확신 피트를 가진 기술을 선택하십시오. 당신은 그 기술로 지식 회상 행동을 라운드당 한 번 무료 행동으로 사용할 수 있습니다. 그렇게 할 경우, 반드시 그 기술 판정에서 확신을 사용해야 합니다.

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있으며, 매번 다른 기술을 지정합니다. 선택한 모든 기술에 자동 지식 사용이 가능하지만, 여전히 라운드당 한 번만 자동 지식을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Remediate

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

If your next action is to use your divine font to cast a 3-action @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} spell, you can harness the residual energy to counterbalance opposing forces. In addition to its normal effects, you use your heal or harm spell to attempt to counteract one divine effect in the spell's area.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

If your next action is to use your divine font to cast a 3-action @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} spell, you can harness the residual energy to counterbalance opposing forces. In addition to its normal effects, you use your heal or harm spell to attempt to counteract one divine effect in the spell's area.
_desc_ko:
빈도 시간당 1회

다음 행동이 신성 샘을 사용해 3행동 소모의 @link[spells.heal] 또는 @link[spells.harm] 주문을 시전하는 것이라면, 잔여 에너지를 활용해 반대 세력을 상쇄할 수 있습니다. 일반 효과에 더해, 치유 또는 손상 주문을 사용하여 해당 주문 영역 내 하나의 신성 효과를 반격하려 시도합니다.

name: The Tyrant Falls!

description.value:
You've reached the apex of the Crimson Oath's power. The oath's power is overwhelming—too much for a mortal frame—but victory is worth any price. When you use this feat, you cry out the final line of the Crimson Oath, unleashing unbridled power for 1 minute. You can Dismiss this effect. While this effect is active, you gain the following effects:

  • At the beginning of each of your turns, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} or increase the value of your drained condition by 1 if you are already drained. You can't reduce the value of your drained condition or remove it while The Tyrant Falls! is active. While The Tyrant Falls! is active, your drained condition does not penalize your Fortitude save.
  • You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.AsKLseOo8hwv5Jha]{Invoke the Crimson Oath} at will without expending Focus Points. When you do, increase the area to a @Template[cone|distance:40].
  • You gain resistance to all damage equal to half your character level.
  • Any melee weapon you wield gains the reach trait if it didn't already possess it, or increases its reach by 5 feet if it already has the reach trait. Your Strikes with that weapon deal an extra 2d6 vitality or void damage (whichever is more effective against the target).

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en:
You've reached the apex of the Crimson Oath's power. The oath's power is overwhelming—too much for a mortal frame—but victory is worth any price. When you use this feat, you cry out the final line of the Crimson Oath, unleashing unbridled power for 1 minute. You can Dismiss this effect. While this effect is active, you gain the following effects:

  • At the beginning of each of your turns, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} or increase the value of your drained condition by 1 if you are already drained. You can't reduce the value of your drained condition or remove it while The Tyrant Falls! is active. While The Tyrant Falls! is active, your drained condition does not penalize your Fortitude save.
  • You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.AsKLseOo8hwv5Jha]{Invoke the Crimson Oath} at will without expending Focus Points. When you do, increase the area to a @Template[cone|distance:40].
  • You gain resistance to all damage equal to half your character level.
  • Any melee weapon you wield gains the reach trait if it didn't already possess it, or increases its reach by 5 feet if it already has the reach trait. Your Strikes with that weapon deal an extra 2d6 vitality or void damage (whichever is more effective against the target).
_desc_ko:
당신은 진홍 맹세의 힘의 정점에 도달했습니다. 맹세의 힘은 압도적입니다-인간 육신으로는 감당하기 어려울 정도-하지만 승리는 어떤 대가도 치를 가치가 있습니다. 이 피트를 사용할 때, 당신은 진홍 맹세의 마지막 구절을 외치며 1분 동안 억제되지 않은 힘을 발산합니다. 이 효과를 해제할 수 있다. 효과가 지속되는 동안 다음 효과를 얻는다:

  • 당신의 턴이 시작될 때마다, 당신은 @link[conditions.drained]{1}이 되거나, 이미 흡수 상태라면 그 수치를 1 증가시킵니다. '폭군이 쓰러진다!'가 활성화된 동안 당신의 고갈 상태 수치를 감소시키거나 제거할 수 없습니다. '폭군이 쓰러진다!'가 활성화된 동안 당신의 고갈 상태는 인내 내성에 불이익을 주지 않습니다.
  • 포커스를 소모하지 않고 자유롭게 @link[spells.invoke-the-crimson-oath]을 시전할 수 있다. 시전 시, 효과 범위를 40피트로 확대한다.
  • 당신은 캐릭터 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 모든 피해에 대한 저항력을 얻습니다.
  • 당신이 휘두르는 근접 무기는 기존에 도달 범위가 없으면 도달 범위 특성을 획득하거나, 이미 도달 범위 특성이 있다면 도달 범위가 5피트 증가합니다. 해당 무기로 가하는 공격은 추가로 2d6 활력 또는 공허 피해(대상에게 더 효과적인 쪽)를 입힙니다.

name: Improvise Admixture

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You have fewer than your maximum number of versatile vials, and you're either holding or wearing an alchemist's toolkit.

You scrounge together enough ingredients from what's left in your alchemist's toolkit to produce a few more versatile vials on the fly. Attempt a @Check[crafting|dc:@self.level] check. The DC is usually a standard-difficulty DC for your level, but the GM can assign a different DC based on the circumstances. The number of vials you regain depends on the result of your check (up to your maximum).

Critical Success You regain 3 versatile vials.

Success You regain 2 versatile vials.

Failure You regain 1 versatile vial.

Critical Failure You don't regain any versatile vials.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You have fewer than your maximum number of versatile vials, and you're either holding or wearing an alchemist's toolkit.

You scrounge together enough ingredients from what's left in your alchemist's toolkit to produce a few more versatile vials on the fly. Attempt a @Check[crafting|dc:@self.level] check. The DC is usually a standard-difficulty DC for your level, but the GM can assign a different DC based on the circumstances. The number of vials you regain depends on the result of your check (up to your maximum).

Critical Success You regain 3 versatile vials.

Success You regain 2 versatile vials.

Failure You regain 1 versatile vial.

Critical Failure You don't regain any versatile vials.
_desc_ko:
빈도 하루에 한 번

요구 사항 다용도 약병의 최대 보유량보다 적게 가지고 있으며, 연금술사 도구 키트를 소지하거나 착용 중이어야 합니다.

연금술사 도구 세트에 남은 재료로 급하게 다용도 약병을 몇 개 더 만들어 낸다. 제작 판정을 시도하다. DC는 일반적으로 해당 레벨의 표준 DC이지만, GM은 상황에 따라 다른 DC를 지정할 수 있다. 회복하는 병의 수는 판정 결과에 따라 달라집니다(최대치까지).

대성공 다용도 병 3개를 회복합니다.

성공 다용도 약병 2개를 회복합니다.

실패 다용도 약병 1개를 되찾습니다.

대실패 다용도 약병을 하나도 되찾지 못합니다.

name: Hulking Size

description.value: Your eidolon grows substantially. Your eidolon becomes Large, instead of its previous size, and its reach increases to 10 feet. This doesn't change any of its other statistics.

_desc_en: Your eidolon grows substantially. Your eidolon becomes Large, instead of its previous size, and its reach increases to 10 feet. This doesn't change any of its other statistics.
_desc_ko: 당신의 에이돌론이 크게 성장합니다. 에이돌론의 크기가 기존 크기에서 대형으로 변경되며, 도달 거리가 10피트로 증가합니다. 이로 인해 다른 능력치는 변경되지 않습니다.

name: Expand Aura

description.value: You focus your divine power to extend your influence and protection. Expand the radius of your champion's aura to 30 feet until the start of your next turn. At 10th level, the expansion lasts for 1 minute, and at 16th level, it lasts until you Dismiss it.

_desc_en: You focus your divine power to extend your influence and protection. Expand the radius of your champion's aura to 30 feet until the start of your next turn. At 10th level, the expansion lasts for 1 minute, and at 16th level, it lasts until you Dismiss it.
_desc_ko: 신성한 힘을 포커스하여 영향력과 보호 범위를 확장합니다. 다음 턴 시작까지 챔피언의 오라 반경을 30피트까지 확장합니다. (10th)레벨에 도달하면 확장 효과가 1분 동안 지속되며, (16th)레벨에 도달하면 해제할 때까지 지속됩니다.

name: Knight Reclaimant Dedication

description.value:
You have sworn the Crimson Oath and become a full member of the Crimson Reclaimers. You gain expert proficiency in Stealth and Survival. Whenever you roll a success on a saving throw against an undead's special ability, you get a critical success instead. This applies to any abilities that come from being undead, including an undead's innate spells (but not its prepared or spontaneous spells).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.OcioDiLTdgzvT8VX]{Knight Reclaimant}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.OcioDiLTdgzvT8VX]{Knight Reclaimant}
_desc_ko: 당신은 진홍의 맹세를 맹세하고 진홍의 회수자들의 정식 일원이 되었습니다. 은신과 생존에 숙련 숙련도를 얻습니다. 언데드의 특수 능력에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴릴 때마다 대신 대성공을 얻습니다. 이는 언데드 본연의 능력(준비된 주문이나 즉흥 주문은 제외)을 포함한 모든 언데드 기원에서 비롯된 능력에 적용됩니다.

name: Rivethun Emissary Dedication

description.value:
Access Followers of Rivethun have access to this feat.

You're a practicing Rivethun emissary, skilled at interacting and bonding with the spirits of living creatures. You become an expert in Diplomacy and Religion. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.4d6QSFBP4lMUYrVK]{Bond with Spirit} activity and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Yph1UqZU8vMc9bJG]{Entreat Spirit} focus spell. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool, which you can regain using the Refocus activity to nurture your personal well of spiritual power. Your Rivethun focus spells are divine spells; when you gain this feat, you become trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for Rivethun focus spells is Wisdom.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.mozFKLZrgEO3F7sE]{Rivethun Emissary}

Your key spellcasting attribute for Rivethun focus spells is Wisdom.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.mozFKLZrgEO3F7sE]{Rivethun Emissary}
_desc_ko:
접근 리베툰의 추종자들은 이 피트에 접근할 수 있습니다.

당신은 리베툰의 사자로서 살아있는 존재들의 영혼과 교감하고 유대감을 형성하는 데 능숙합니다. 외교와 종교에 정통하게 됩니다. 또한 @link[actions.bond-with-spirit] 활동과 @link[spells.entreat-spirit] 포커스 주문을 획득합니다. 아직 보유하지 않았다면, 포커스 풀을 획득합니다. 이 포커스 풀은 재집중 활동을 통해 회복할 수 있으며, 개인의 영적 힘의 원천을 가꾸는 데 사용됩니다. 리베툰 포커스 주문은 신성 주문입니다. 이 재주를 획득하면 주문 공격 수정자와 주문 DC 통계에 숙련됩니다. 리베툰 포커스 주문의 주요 주문 시전 능력치는 지혜입니다.

name: Shadow Blending

description.value:
Trigger A creature attempts a flat check to target you while you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} due to dim light or darkness.

You draw shadows close to create a shroud. Increase the DC of the flat check by 2.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature attempts a flat check to target you while you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} due to dim light or darkness.

You draw shadows close to create a shroud. Increase the DC of the flat check by 2.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 희미한 빛이나 어둠으로 인해 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태이거나 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태인 동안, 생물이 당신을 대상으로 단순 판정을 시도할 때.

당신은 그림자를 가까이 끌어당겨 장막을 만듭니다. 단순 판정의 DC를 2 증가시킵니다.

name: Form of the Bat

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You can transform into a harmless bat. You gain the effects of a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gfPjmG6Fe6D3MFjl]{Pest Form}, except you always transform into a bat.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

You can transform into a harmless bat. You gain the effects of a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gfPjmG6Fe6D3MFjl]{Pest Form}, except you always transform into a bat.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

무해한 박쥐로 변신할 수 있다. (4th) 등급 @link[spells.pest-form]의 효과를 얻지만, 항상 박쥐로 변신합니다.

name: Sanguimancer Dedication

description.value:
The life essence in your blood recovers naturally over time. You gain a special type of temporary Hit Points called sanguimancy Hit Points that follow the normal rules for temporary Hit Points with two exceptions: you can spend them to power some sanguimancy feats, and you can never have a greater number of sanguimancy Hit Points than double your level.

After a full 8-hour rest, you gain sanguimancy HP equal to your level that last for 8 hours. If someone successfully restores HP to you with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}, you also gain 1 sanguimancy HP for every 10 Hit Points recovered (minimum 1 sanguimancy HP).

Special Sanguimancer actions have the trait matching your spellcasting tradition; if you don't have one, choose divine or occult when you select the Sanguimancer Dedication.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.bneFqTyD70v26JaE]{Sanguimancer}

_desc_en:
The life essence in your blood recovers naturally over time. You gain a special type of temporary Hit Points called sanguimancy Hit Points that follow the normal rules for temporary Hit Points with two exceptions: you can spend them to power some sanguimancy feats, and you can never have a greater number of sanguimancy Hit Points than double your level.

After a full 8-hour rest, you gain sanguimancy HP equal to your level that last for 8 hours. If someone successfully restores HP to you with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}, you also gain 1 sanguimancy HP for every 10 Hit Points recovered (minimum 1 sanguimancy HP).

Special Sanguimancer actions have the trait matching your spellcasting tradition; if you don't have one, choose divine or occult when you select the Sanguimancer Dedication.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.bneFqTyD70v26JaE]{Sanguimancer}
_desc_ko:
피 속에 담긴 생명 에센스는 시간이 지나면 자연스럽게 회복됩니다. 당신은 '혈마술 HP'이라는 특수한 임시 HP를 얻게 되며, 이는 일반 임시 HP의 규칙을 따르되 두 가지 예외가 있습니다: 이를 소모하여 일부 혈마술 피트를 발동할 수 있으며, 혈마술 HP는 절대로 자신의 레벨의 두 배를 초과할 수 없습니다.

8시간의 완전한 휴식 후, 레벨과 동일한 수의 생혈력 HP를 획득하며 이는 8시간 동안 지속됩니다. 누군가가 @link[actions.treat-wounds]로 당신의 HP를 성공적으로 회복시켜 주면, 회복된 HP 10당 1의 상귀만시 HP를 추가로 얻습니다(최소 1 상귀만시 HP).

특수 상귀술사의 행동은 당신의 주문 시전 전통과 일치하는 특성을 가집니다. 만약 전통이 없다면, 상귀술사 헌신을 선택할 때 신성 또는 오컬트를 선택하십시오.

name: Spiritual Sense

description.value:
You have a vague connection to the Ethereal Plane that enables you to notice spirits. While you're exploring but not Searching, the GM rolls a secret check for you to find haunts that usually require Searching, as well as spirits, creatures on the Ethereal Plane, and beings made entirely of spiritual essence such as celestials, fiends, and monitors.

You can also potentially notice ethereal creatures and spirits inside solid objects, provided they are within 30 feet of you. This applies while Searching, while Seeking, and on the automatic secret check you gain while exploring even if you aren't Searching. You can still notice spirits only on a successful check, and you can't see them if they're more than 5 feet inside an object. When you notice a creature with this sense, you also learn its location, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to you if it had been @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.

_desc_en:
You have a vague connection to the Ethereal Plane that enables you to notice spirits. While you're exploring but not Searching, the GM rolls a secret check for you to find haunts that usually require Searching, as well as spirits, creatures on the Ethereal Plane, and beings made entirely of spiritual essence such as celestials, fiends, and monitors.

You can also potentially notice ethereal creatures and spirits inside solid objects, provided they are within 30 feet of you. This applies while Searching, while Seeking, and on the automatic secret check you gain while exploring even if you aren't Searching. You can still notice spirits only on a successful check, and you can't see them if they're more than 5 feet inside an object. When you notice a creature with this sense, you also learn its location, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to you if it had been @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.
_desc_ko:
당신은 에테르계와 희미한 연결고리를 지녀 영혼을 감지할 수 있습니다. 탐색 중이지만 탐색 기술을 사용하지 않을 때, GM은 비밀 판정을 굴려 일반적으로 탐색 기술이 필요한 유령, 영혼, 에테르계의 생물, 천상체 존재, 핀드, 모니터 등 순수 영적 본질로 이루어진 존재들을 발견할 수 있게 합니다.

또한 고체 물체 내부에 있는 에테리얼 생물이나 영혼을 감지할 수도 있습니다. 단, 그 대상이 당신으로부터 30피트 이내에 있어야 합니다. 이 능력은 탐색 중, 추적 중, 그리고 탐색 중이 아니더라도 탐험 시 자동으로 얻는 비밀 발견 판정 시에도 적용됩니다. 영혼은 성공적인 판정에서만 감지할 수 있으며, 물체 내부 5피트 이상 깊이에는 보이지 않습니다. 이 감각으로 생물을 감지하면 그 위치도 알게 되며, 해당 생물이 @link[conditions.undetected]였다면 @link[conditions.hidden]로 전환됩니다.

name: Advanced Shooter

description.value: You've dedicated your training to mastering even the most complex and weird firearms and crossbows from across the world. You gain proficiency with all advanced firearms as if they were martial firearms and with all advanced crossbows as if they were martial crossbows.

_desc_en: You've dedicated your training to mastering even the most complex and weird firearms and crossbows from across the world. You gain proficiency with all advanced firearms as if they were martial firearms and with all advanced crossbows as if they were martial crossbows.
_desc_ko: 당신은 가장 복잡하고 특이한 무기류에 훈련을 집중했습니다. 화기 또는 석궁을 선택하세요. 모든 고급 화기에 대해 무술 화기처럼 숙련도를 얻거나, 모든 고급 석궁에 대해 무술 석궁처럼 숙련도를 얻습니다.

name: Perfect Debilitation

description.value: You have perfected the formulas for bombs that impede your enemies. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.sv4LeEbkOJyLen10]{Debilitating Bomb}, your target avoids the condition the bomb imposes only if it critically succeeds at its saving throw.

rules.text: If your bomb hits, the target must critically succed at its Fortitude save to avoid the condition the bomb imposes.
rules.title: {item|name}

_desc_en: You have perfected the formulas for bombs that impede your enemies. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.sv4LeEbkOJyLen10]{Debilitating Bomb}, your target avoids the condition the bomb imposes only if it critically succeeds at its saving throw.
_desc_ko: 적의 행동을 방해하는 폭탄 제조법을 완벽히 터득했다. @link[feats.debilitating-bomb]을 사용할 때, 대상은 내성 굴림에서 대성공을 거두어야만 폭탄이 부여하는 상태 이상을 피할 수 있다.

name: Master of Apprentice

description.value: Teaching is a difficult art form, but you've gotten a pretty good handle on it. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income} during downtime, you can also attempt to Aid another creature doing the same with the same skill if they have a lower proficiency bonus than you. If you succeed, they can use the better result between your check and their own check.

value.value: master in Crafting, Performance, or a Lore skill

_desc_en: Teaching is a difficult art form, but you've gotten a pretty good handle on it. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income} during downtime, you can also attempt to Aid another creature doing the same with the same skill if they have a lower proficiency bonus than you. If you succeed, they can use the better result between your check and their own check.
_desc_ko: 가르치는 일은 어려운 예술이지만, 당신은 꽤 잘 해내고 있습니다. 다운타임에 @link[actions.craft] 또는 @link[actions.earn-income]을 할 때, 동일한 기술로 같은 행동을 하는 다른 생물이 당신보다 숙련 보너스가 낮다면 그 생물을 돕기 위해 시도할 수 있습니다. 성공하면 상대는 당신의 판정과 자신의 판정 중 더 좋은 결과를 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Additional Circus Trick

description.value: Your signature trick can have one additional trait beyond the normal number. If the trick trait has an associated skill (such as Intimidation with the fire trait) and that skill is one of your trick checks, your checks with that skill to Perform a Trick aren't penalized if you Perform a Trick using a different skill. For example, if your signature trick has Acrobatics and Intimidation as trick checks and you take this feat to add the fire trait, you can Perform a Trick using Acrobatics (at no penalty), then Acrobatics again (at a -5 penalty), and then Intimidation (at no penalty).

value.value: You must have a signature trick

_desc_en: Your signature trick can have one additional trait beyond the normal number. If the trick trait has an associated skill (such as Intimidation with the fire trait) and that skill is one of your trick checks, your checks with that skill to Perform a Trick aren't penalized if you Perform a Trick using a different skill. For example, if your signature trick has Acrobatics and Intimidation as trick checks and you take this feat to add the fire trait, you can Perform a Trick using Acrobatics (at no penalty), then Acrobatics again (at a -5 penalty), and then Intimidation (at no penalty).
_desc_ko: 당신의 시그니처 트릭은 일반적인 수를 초과하여 하나의 추가 특성을 가질 수 있습니다. 해당 트릭 특성에 연관된 스킬(예: 불 특성과 협박)이 있고, 그 스킬이 당신의 트릭 판정 중 하나라면, 다른 스킬을 사용하여 트릭을 수행할 때 해당 스킬로 트릭 판정을 할 때 페널티를 받지 않습니다. 예를 들어, 시그니처 트릭의 트릭 판정으로 곡예과 협박술을 사용하며 이 피트를 선택해 불 속성을 추가한 경우, 곡예 을 사용해 트릭을 수행할 때 페널티 없이, 다시 곡예을 사용하면 -5 페널티를 받고, 마지막으로 협박술을 사용하면 페널티 없이 트릭을 수행할 수 있습니다.

name: Share Tincture

description.value: You use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QHFMeJGzFWj2QczA]{Quick Tincture}, and the item you create remains potent until the start of your next turn. Then you can Interact to pass the item to another creature. If you pass it by throwing it, your ranged attack automatically succeeds. You must have a versatile vial to use Quick Tincture, as normal.

_desc_en: You use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QHFMeJGzFWj2QczA]{Quick Tincture}, and the item you create remains potent until the start of your next turn. Then you can Interact to pass the item to another creature. If you pass it by throwing it, your ranged attack automatically succeeds. You must have a versatile vial to use Quick Tincture, as normal.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @link[actions.quick-tincture]를 사용하며, 생성한 아이템은 다음 턴 시작까지 효력을 유지합니다. 이후 상호작용을 통해 다른 생물에게 아이템을 전달할 수 있습니다. 던져서 전달할 경우, 원거리 공격이 자동으로 성공합니다. 신속한 팅크를 사용하려면 평소처럼 다용도 약병이 필요합니다.

name: Gear Up

description.value:
Whether it's wooden stakes, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.z9T4c1hXwOotsMCp]{Holy Water}, or more unusual tools, you always have just the right thing to handle an undead's unusual weaknesses and vulnerabilities. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.bh2jHyyYrkLMsIdX]{Prescient Planner} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.lHFz4MmebvPqTb0A]{Prescient Consumable} feats. When using Prescient Planner specifically to pull out an item you need to deal with an undead's weakness or vulnerability, you can pull out the item as a 2-action activity to remove your backpack (or similar container) and draw the item, rather than taking 1 minute.

If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.HVP3ZGIOlxlFy0ni]{Hunter's Sanctum} feat, you keep your sanctum well stocked with the basics and can spend 1 hour in your sanctum refreshing your supplies in order to meet the requirements for Prescient Planner, even if you haven't been able to purchase goods.

_desc_en:
Whether it's wooden stakes, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.z9T4c1hXwOotsMCp]{Holy Water}, or more unusual tools, you always have just the right thing to handle an undead's unusual weaknesses and vulnerabilities. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.bh2jHyyYrkLMsIdX]{Prescient Planner} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.lHFz4MmebvPqTb0A]{Prescient Consumable} feats. When using Prescient Planner specifically to pull out an item you need to deal with an undead's weakness or vulnerability, you can pull out the item as a 2-action activity to remove your backpack (or similar container) and draw the item, rather than taking 1 minute.

If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.HVP3ZGIOlxlFy0ni]{Hunter's Sanctum} feat, you keep your sanctum well stocked with the basics and can spend 1 hour in your sanctum refreshing your supplies in order to meet the requirements for Prescient Planner, even if you haven't been able to purchase goods.
_desc_ko:
나무 말뚝이든, @link[equipment.holy-water]이든, 더 특이한 도구든, 당신은 언데드의 특이한 약점과 취약점을 처리하기에 딱 맞는 도구를 항상 지니고 있습니다. @link[feats.prescient-planner]와 @link[feats.prescient-consumable] 피트를 획득합니다. 예지 계획가 재주를 언데드의 약점이나 취약점을 처리하기 위해 필요한 아이템을 꺼내는 데 특별히 사용할 경우, 1분이 아닌 2행동 활동으로 배낭(또는 유사한 보관함)을 벗고 아이템을 꺼낼 수 있습니다.

@link[feats.hunters-sanctum] 피트를 보유한 경우, 성소에 기본 물품을 충분히 비축해 둘 수 있으며, 물품을 구매하지 못했더라도 성소에서 1시간을 소모해 물품을 보충함으로써 예지 계획자의 요건을 충족할 수 있습니다.

name: Offensive Analysis

description.value: You can enhance your senses and mental state to consider every aspect of an attack. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{Sure Strike} as a divine innate spell once per day.

_desc_en: You can enhance your senses and mental state to consider every aspect of an attack. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{Sure Strike} as a divine innate spell once per day.
_desc_ko: 공격의 모든 측면을 고려하기 위해 감각과 정신 상태를 강화할 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번 신성 선천 마법으로 @link[spells.sure-strike]을 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Stories of Home

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You share the joy of every story of long-awaited homecoming you've offered to Isthralei. You can spend 10 minutes sharing this joy with your allies within 30 feet. You and those allies regain Hit Points equal to their Constitution modifier (minimum 1) times their level and recover from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} conditions as though they had a full night's rest (though they gain no other benefits associated with having a full night's rest).

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You share the joy of every story of long-awaited homecoming you've offered to Isthralei. You can spend 10 minutes sharing this joy with your allies within 30 feet. You and those allies regain Hit Points equal to their Constitution modifier (minimum 1) times their level and recover from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} conditions as though they had a full night's rest (though they gain no other benefits associated with having a full night's rest).
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신은 이스라레이에게 선사한 모든 기다림 끝에 찾아온 귀향 이야기의 기쁨을 나눕니다. 30피트 내의 아군과 10분간 이 기쁨을 공유할 수 있습니다. 당신과 아군은 건강 수정자(최소 1)에 레벨을 곱한 만큼의 HP를 회복하고 @link[conditions.doomed], @link[conditions.drained], @link[conditions.fatigued] 상태에서 벗어나게 됩니다. 이는 마치 완전한 밤의 휴식을 취한 것과 같습니다(단, 완전한 밤의 휴식과 관련된 다른 혜택은 얻지 못합니다).

name: Lengthy Diversion

description.value: When you critically succeed to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion}, you continue to remain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} after the end of your turn. This effect lasts for an amount of time that depends on the diversion and situation, as determined by the GM (minimum 1 additional round).

_desc_en: When you critically succeed to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion}, you continue to remain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} after the end of your turn. This effect lasts for an amount of time that depends on the diversion and situation, as determined by the GM (minimum 1 additional round).
_desc_ko: {주의 분산}에 대성공을 거두면, 자신의 턴 종료 후에도 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태를 유지합니다. 이 효과는 GM이 결정하는 기만 행위와 상황에 따라 지속됩니다(최소 1라운드 추가).

name: Astonishing Explosion

description.value:
Frequency once per minute

Trigger You use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.NlEZ0piDxg9buXCL]{Advanced Alchemy} to craft an alchemical bomb that deals splash damage and is at least 2 levels lower than your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Pe0zmIqyTBc2Td0I]{Advanced Alchemy} level.

Your bomb incorporates an explosive spark of wonder that leaves witnesses dumbfounded. Any target hit by your Strike with the bomb is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by you for 1 round. On a critical success, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per minute

Trigger You use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.NlEZ0piDxg9buXCL]{Advanced Alchemy} to craft an alchemical bomb that deals splash damage and is at least 2 levels lower than your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Pe0zmIqyTBc2Td0I]{Advanced Alchemy} level.

Your bomb incorporates an explosive spark of wonder that leaves witnesses dumbfounded. Any target hit by your Strike with the bomb is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by you for 1 round. On a critical success, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 분당 1회

발동 조건 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.NlEZ0piDxg9buXCL]{고급 연금술}을 사용하여 @link[feats.advanced-alchemy] 레벨보다 최소 2레벨 낮은 방사 피해를 주는 연금술 폭탄을 제작합니다.

폭탄에는 경이로움의 폭발적 불꽃이 담겨 있어 목격자들을 벙찐 상태로 만듭니다. 폭탄으로 공격에 명중된 대상은 1라운드 동안 당신에게 @link[conditions.fascinated] 상태가 됩니다. 대성공 시 대상은 추가로 @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Skin Split

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You claw open the top layer of your scales and peel off the premature shed in order to remove harmful substances from your skin. You immediately end all persistent damage from effects that coat your skin (such as fire and most persistent acid damage). If you're suffering from an effect other than persistent damage that depends on continuous contact with your skin, and if that effect allows a saving throw, immediately attempt a new saving throw against that effect.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You claw open the top layer of your scales and peel off the premature shed in order to remove harmful substances from your skin. You immediately end all persistent damage from effects that coat your skin (such as fire and most persistent acid damage). If you're suffering from an effect other than persistent damage that depends on continuous contact with your skin, and if that effect allows a saving throw, immediately attempt a new saving throw against that effect.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신은 비늘의 최상층을 긁어 열고 조기 탈락한 비늘을 벗겨내어 피부에서 유해 물질을 제거합니다. 피부 표면에 달라붙은 효과(예: 화상 및 대부분의 지속성 산성 피해)로 인한 모든 지속성 피해를 즉시 종료합니다. 지속적 피해 이외에 피부에 지속적인 접촉을 필요로 하는 효과를 받고 있고, 해당 효과가 내성 굴림을 허용한다면 즉시 그 효과에 대한 새로운 내성 굴림을 시도한다.

name: Dual-Handed Assault

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a one-handed melee weapon and have a free hand.

You snap your free hand over to grip your weapon just long enough to add momentum and deliver a more powerful blow to your opponent. Make a Strike with the required weapon. You quickly switch your grip during the Strike in order to make the attack with two hands. If the weapon doesn't normally have the two-hand trait, increase its weapon damage die by one step for this attack. If the weapon has the two-hand trait, you gain the benefit of that trait and a circumstance bonus to damage equal to the weapon's number of damage dice. When the Strike is complete, you resume gripping the weapon with only one hand. This action doesn't end any stance or fighter feat effect that requires you to have one hand free.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a one-handed melee weapon and have a free hand.

You snap your free hand over to grip your weapon just long enough to add momentum and deliver a more powerful blow to your opponent. Make a Strike with the required weapon. You quickly switch your grip during the Strike in order to make the attack with two hands. If the weapon doesn't normally have the two-hand trait, increase its weapon damage die by one step for this attack. If the weapon has the two-hand trait, you gain the benefit of that trait and a circumstance bonus to damage equal to the weapon's number of damage dice. When the Strike is complete, you resume gripping the weapon with only one hand. This action doesn't end any stance or fighter feat effect that requires you to have one hand free.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 한 손으로 근접 무기를 휘두르고 있으며 빈 손이 있어야 합니다.

빈 손을 휘둘러 무기를 잡는 동작을 취합니다. 이 동작은 순간적인 가속도를 더해 상대에게 더 강력한 일격을 가하기 위한 것입니다. 필요한 무기로 공격을 수행하세요. 공격 동작 중에 빠르게 그립을 전환하여 양손으로 공격합니다. 해당 무기가 원래 양손 특성을 가지지 않는 경우, 이번 공격에 한해 무기 피해 주사위를 한 단계 증가시킵니다. 무기에 양손 특성이 있다면, 해당 특성의 이점과 무기의 피해 주사위 수만큼의 상황 보너스를 피해에 적용받는다. 공격이 완료되면 다시 한 손으로만 무기를 잡는다. 이 행동은 한 손을 비워야 하는 자세나 파이터 재주 효과를 종료시키지 않는다.

name: Seneschal Witch Dedication

description.value:
As you work to understand the connection with your missing patron, it's increasingly easy to form bonds with those around you. Raw magical energy spills easily through the connection but, without a patron's control, it sometimes resists your demands for it to form proper spells.

You gain the Witch's Charge feat, but can't choose your familiar or another creature with the minion trait as a charge. When you cast or Sustain manifest will, as long as your charge is within 30 feet, you can choose to center the spell's emanation on your charge instead of yourself.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.4goI7CCdYrtao62w]{Seneschal}

_desc_en:
As you work to understand the connection with your missing patron, it's increasingly easy to form bonds with those around you. Raw magical energy spills easily through the connection but, without a patron's control, it sometimes resists your demands for it to form proper spells.

You gain the Witch's Charge feat, but can't choose your familiar or another creature with the minion trait as a charge. When you cast or Sustain manifest will, as long as your charge is within 30 feet, you can choose to center the spell's emanation on your charge instead of yourself.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.4goI7CCdYrtao62w]{Seneschal}
_desc_ko:
실종된 후원자와의 연결을 이해하려 노력할수록 주변 이들과 유대를 형성하기가 점점 쉬워진다. 원시 마법 에너지는 연결을 통해 쉽게 흘러넘치지만, 후원자의 통제 없이서는 때로 적절한 주문을 형성하라는 당신의 요구를 거부하기도 한다.

당신은 마녀의 돌격 재주를 얻지만, 돌격 대상으로는 패밀리어나 하수인 특성을 가진 다른 생물을 선택할 수 없습니다. 당신이 주문을 시전하거나 지속 의지를 발현할 때, 돌격 대상이 30피트 이내에 있는 한, 주문의 발산 중심을 자신 대신 돌격 대상에 맞출 수 있습니다.

name: Skim Scroll

description.value: You can activate the magic of a scroll with a cursory read as you draw it from your belt. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} to draw forth a scroll, then use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.uR62fVC9FyQAMCO1]{Trick Magic Item} on the scroll.

_desc_en: You can activate the magic of a scroll with a cursory read as you draw it from your belt. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} to draw forth a scroll, then use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.uR62fVC9FyQAMCO1]{Trick Magic Item} on the scroll.
_desc_ko: 벨트에서 두루마리를 꺼내면서 대충 훑어보는 것만으로 두루마리의 마법을 발동할 수 있습니다. 두루마리를 꺼내기 위해 @link[actions.interact]을 수행한 후, 두루마리에 @link[feats.trick-magic-item]를 사용합니다.

name: Maneuvering Spell

description.value:
Trigger You begin to Cast a Spell that requires at least 2 actions to cast.

You instantly tap into the magical power of a spell you're casting to quickly pounce around the battlefield. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.UHpkTuCtyaPqiCAB]{Step}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OdIUybJ3ddfL7wzj]{Stand}. This action can be before or after you Cast the Spell.

_desc_en:
Trigger You begin to Cast a Spell that requires at least 2 actions to cast.

You instantly tap into the magical power of a spell you're casting to quickly pounce around the battlefield. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.UHpkTuCtyaPqiCAB]{Step}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OdIUybJ3ddfL7wzj]{Stand}. This action can be before or after you Cast the Spell.
_desc_ko:
발동 최소 2회 이상의 행동이 필요한 주문을 시전하기 시작한다.

당신은 시전 중인 마법의 힘을 즉시 끌어내어 전장을 재빠르게 뛰어다닙니다. 당신은 @link[actions.step], @link[actions.leap], 또는 @link[actions.stand]합니다. 이 행동은 마법 시전 전이나 후에 수행할 수 있습니다.

name: Powerful Leap

description.value: You can jump 5 feet up with a vertical @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} without making a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump}. You also increase the horizontal distance when you Leap, including as part of a High Jump or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump}, by 5 feet.

_desc_en: You can jump 5 feet up with a vertical @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} without making a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump}. You also increase the horizontal distance when you Leap, including as part of a High Jump or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump}, by 5 feet.
_desc_ko: 수직 @link[actions.leap]으로 5피트 높이까지 점프할 수 있으며, @link[actions.high-jump]를 수행하지 않아도 됩니다. 또한 도약 시, 높이뛰기나 @link[actions.long-jump]의 일부로 수행할 때도 수평 거리를 5피트 증가시킵니다.

name: Reliable Magic

description.value:
Magic stored in written form or within wands is more reliable in your capable hands. Whenever you overcharge a wand, reduce the DC of the flat check to avoid destroying the wand by 4. It still gains the broken condition on a success.

When you Cast a Spell from a scroll you can spend a Mythic Point as a free action. The spell is cast at mythic proficiency. Once you cast the spell using this ability, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11]. If this check is successful, the scroll is not destroyed, and instead glows with light equivalent to that of a candle for 10 minutes. You can Cast a Spell from this scroll again, but if you do so you cannot enhance it in any way (such as by using this feat), and the scroll is destroyed. If not used before the end of the 10 minutes, the scroll is destroyed.

publication.title: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

_desc_en:
Magic stored in written form or within wands is more reliable in your capable hands. Whenever you overcharge a wand, reduce the DC of the flat check to avoid destroying the wand by 4. It still gains the broken condition on a success.

When you Cast a Spell from a scroll you can spend a Mythic Point as a free action. The spell is cast at mythic proficiency. Once you cast the spell using this ability, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11]. If this check is successful, the scroll is not destroyed, and instead glows with light equivalent to that of a candle for 10 minutes. You can Cast a Spell from this scroll again, but if you do so you cannot enhance it in any way (such as by using this feat), and the scroll is destroyed. If not used before the end of the 10 minutes, the scroll is destroyed.
_desc_ko:
글로 기록된 형태나 완드 안에 저장된 마법은 당신의 유능한 손에서 더욱 믿음직해집니다. 완드를 과충전할 때마다, 완드가 파괴되는 것을 피하기 위한 평면 판정의 DC를 4만큼 낮춥니다. 성공하더라도 완드는 여전히 파손됨 상태가 됩니다.

당신이 두루마리에서 주문을 시전할 때 자유 행동으로 신화 점수를 소모할 수 있습니다. 그 주문은 신화 숙련도로 시전됩니다. 이 능력을 사용해 주문을 시전한 뒤, @Check[flat|dc:11]을 시도합니다. 이 판정이 성공하면 두루마리는 파괴되지 않고, 대신 10분간 촛불에 해당하는 빛으로 빛납니다. 당신은 이 두루마리에서 주문을 다시 시전할 수 있지만, 그렇게 하면 (이 재주를 사용하는 것 등) 어떤 방식으로도 강화할 수 없으며 두루마리는 파괴됩니다. 10분이 끝나기 전에 사용하지 않으면 두루마리는 파괴됩니다.

name: Natural Illusionist

description.value: By drawing upon the First World's magic, you can siphon a portion of that malleable world to create a convincing illusion. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4ZGte0i9YbLh4dRi]{Item Facade}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yV7Ouzaoe7DHLESI]{Ventriloquism}. At 7th level, the spell is heightened to 2nd rank, and every 2 levels thereafter, the spell is heightened an additional spell rank.

_desc_en: By drawing upon the First World's magic, you can siphon a portion of that malleable world to create a convincing illusion. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4ZGte0i9YbLh4dRi]{Item Facade}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yV7Ouzaoe7DHLESI]{Ventriloquism}. At 7th level, the spell is heightened to 2nd rank, and every 2 levels thereafter, the spell is heightened an additional spell rank.
_desc_ko: 제1세계의 마법을 끌어모아 그 가변적인 세계의 일부를 흡수하여 설득력 있는 환상을 창조할 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, @link[spells.illusory-disguise], @link[spells.item-facade], 또는 @link[spells.ventriloquism]을 시전할 수 있다. 7레벨에 도달하면 해당 주문은 2nd 랭크으로 강화되며, 이후 2레벨마다 추가로 1랭크씩 강화한다.

name: Redirecting Shot

description.value:
Trigger An ally misses with a ranged attack that uses a thrown weapon or ammunition. The ally must be willing to accept your assistance, you must see the attack's target, and the attack's target must be within the first range increment of your firearm or crossbow.

Requirements You're wielding a loaded firearm or crossbow.

Seeing your ally's attack about to go astray, you fire your weapon to right its course. Discharge your firearm and roll a d20. Your ally uses this roll instead of their own, and the attack ignores any bonuses the target would gain against the attack from lesser or standard cover, as well as the flat check if the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

_desc_en:
Trigger An ally misses with a ranged attack that uses a thrown weapon or ammunition. The ally must be willing to accept your assistance, you must see the attack's target, and the attack's target must be within the first range increment of your firearm or crossbow.

Requirements You're wielding a loaded firearm or crossbow.

Seeing your ally's attack about to go astray, you fire your weapon to right its course. Discharge your firearm and roll a d20. Your ally uses this roll instead of their own, and the attack ignores any bonuses the target would gain against the attack from lesser or standard cover, as well as the flat check if the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 동맹이 투척 무기나 탄약을 사용하는 원거리 공격을 빗나가게 한다. 동료는 당신의 도움을 받아들여야 하며, 당신은 공격 대상이 보일 위치에 있어야 하고, 공격 대상은 당신의 화기 또는 석궁의 첫 번째 사거리 구간 내에 있어야 합니다.

요건 장전된 화기나 석궁을 장전한 상태여야 합니다.

동료의 공격이 빗나갈 것을 보고, 당신은 궤도를 바로잡기 위해 무기를 발사합니다. 화기를 발사하고 d20을 굴리십시오. 동료는 자신의 공격 대신 이 굴림 결과를 사용하며, 이 공격은 대상이 (하급) 또는 표준 엄폐로부터 얻는 모든 보너스와 대상이 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태일 경우의 단순 판정을 무시합니다.

name: Read Disaster

description.value:
You spend 10 minutes and open yourself to the divine mysteries of the world, peering into the most sinister portents of the future.

You gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X]{Augury}, except you learn only about the dangers ahead; any results of "good" are instead "nothing," and results of "mixed" are instead "bad." If you are legendary in Religion, you take only 1 minute to Read Disaster.

_desc_en:
You spend 10 minutes and open yourself to the divine mysteries of the world, peering into the most sinister portents of the future.

You gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X]{Augury}, except you learn only about the dangers ahead; any results of "good" are instead "nothing," and results of "mixed" are instead "bad." If you are legendary in Religion, you take only 1 minute to Read Disaster.
_desc_ko:
10분을 소모하여 세상의 신성한 신비에 마음을 열고, 미래의 가장 불길한 징조를 들여다봅니다.

@link[spells.augury]의 효과를 얻지만, 앞으로 닥칠 위험에 대해서만 알게 된다. "좋은" 결과는 "아무것도 아님"으로, "혼합된" 결과는 "나쁨"으로 대체된다. 종교 분야에서 전설적인 인물이라면 재앙을 읽는 데 1분만 소요된다.

name: To the Ends of the Earth

description.value: Your ability to track your prey has surpassed explanation, allowing you to trace your prey's movements and predict its location with ease. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JYi4MnsdFu618hPm]{Hunt Prey} on a creature within 100 feet, you can follow that creature's movements, allowing you to know the creature's exact location no matter how far away it becomes, as long as it remains your prey. You must be legendary in Nature to track your prey's location across teleportation or planar travel. This feat gains the detection and primal traits if you're legendary in Nature.

name_en: To the Ends of the Earth
_desc_en: Your ability to track your prey has surpassed explanation, allowing you to trace your prey's movements and predict its location with ease. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JYi4MnsdFu618hPm]{Hunt Prey} on a creature within 100 feet, you can follow that creature's movements, allowing you to know the creature's exact location no matter how far away it becomes, as long as it remains your prey. You must be legendary in Nature to track your prey's location across teleportation or planar travel. This feat gains the detection and primal traits if you're legendary in Nature.
_desc_ko: 당신의 사냥감 추적 능력은 설명을 초월하여, 사냥감의 움직임을 추적하고 위치를 쉽게 예측할 수 있게 합니다. 100피트 이내의 생물에게 @link[actions.hunt-prey]을 사용하면, 그 생물의 움직임을 따라갈 수 있어 아무리 멀리 떨어져도 사냥감으로 남아 있는 한 정확한 위치를 알 수 있다. 순간이동이나 차원 이동을 넘어 사냥감의 위치를 추적하려면 자연에 관한 전설적인 지식이 필요합니다. 자연에 관한 전설적인 지식을 보유한 경우, 이 재주는 탐지 및 프라이멀 특성을 획득합니다.

name: Compliant Gold

description.value:
Usage imbued into a melee weapon ikon

You can command your weapon to shrink or grow, for convenience or power. Even when your ikon is not empowered, you can shrink it to a miniature size (with negligible Bulk) and keep it tucked behind an ear, in your hair, or in a similar discreet location. You can shrink your weapon or regrow it to its normal size as part of drawing it, putting it away, swapping it, or picking it up.

Immanence Your ikon gains the reach trait. If it already had the reach trait, it instead increases your reach by an additional 10 feet, instead of the usual additional 5 feet.

편의나 힘을 위해 무기를 축소하거나 확대할 수 있습니다. 이콘에 힘이 실리지 않은 상태에서도 무기를 미니어처 크기(벌크 무시)로 축소해 귀 뒤나 머리카락 속 등 눈에 띄지 않는 곳에 보관할 수 있습니다. 무기를 뽑거나, 넣거나, 교체하거나, 집어 들 때 무기를 축소하거나 원래 크기로 되돌릴 수 있습니다.

name: Fortune's Favor

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You're about to reroll a failed skill check or saving throw due to a fortune effect.

You understand when an investment in you has the chance to pay off. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the triggering roll.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 운명 효과로 인해 실패한 기술 판정나 내성 굴림을 재굴림하려 할 때.

당신은 자신에 대한 투자가 언제 수익을 낼 수 있는지 이해합니다. 발동 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Stonemason's Eye

description.value:
You understand the intricacies of stonework. You become trained in Crafting. If you're already trained in Crafting, you instead gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.QLeMH5mQgh28sa5o]{Specialty Crafting} skill feat for stonemasonry.

You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to notice unusual stonework. This bonus applies to checks to discover mechanical traps made of stone or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} within stone.

If you aren't using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action or searching, the GM automatically rolls a secret check for you to notice unusual stonework anyway. This check doesn't gain your normal circumstance bonus.

_desc_en:
You understand the intricacies of stonework. You become trained in Crafting. If you're already trained in Crafting, you instead gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.QLeMH5mQgh28sa5o]{Specialty Crafting} skill feat for stonemasonry.

You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to notice unusual stonework. This bonus applies to checks to discover mechanical traps made of stone or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} within stone.

If you aren't using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action or searching, the GM automatically rolls a secret check for you to notice unusual stonework anyway. This check doesn't gain your normal circumstance bonus.
_desc_ko:
당신은 석공술의 정교한 기술을 이해하게 됩니다. 제작 기술에 숙련됩니다. 이미 제작 기술에 숙련된 경우, 대신 석공술에 대한 @link[feats.specialty-crafting] 기술 피트를 얻습니다.

또한 특이한 석공술을 알아차리는 지각 판정 시 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 보너스는 석재로 만들어진 기계적 함정이나 @link[conditions.hidden] 석재 내부의 함정을 발견하는 판정에도 적용됩니다.

{탐색} 행동을 사용하거나 수색 중이 아닐 경우, GM은 특이한 석조물을 알아차리기 위해 자동으로 비밀 판정을 굴림합니다. 이 판정에는 일반 상황 보너스가 적용되지 않습니다.

name: Strix Lore

description.value: You're well connected to your tribe and perhaps even strix communities beyond your own, where you've learned about the land and techniques of graceful movement. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Acrobatics and Nature. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also become trained in Strix Lore.

_desc_en: You're well connected to your tribe and perhaps even strix communities beyond your own, where you've learned about the land and techniques of graceful movement. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Acrobatics and Nature. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also become trained in Strix Lore.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신의 부족은 물론 다른 스트릭스 공동체와도 긴밀히 연결되어 있으며, 그곳에서 땅에 대한 지식과 우아한 움직임의 기술을 배웠습니다. 당신은 곡예과 자연에 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 해당 기술 중 하나에 자동으로 숙련이 부여된다면, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련이 부여됩니다. 또한 스트릭스 지식에 숙련이 부여됩니다.

name: Sheltering Pulse

description.value:
You thrust your hand or weapon into the ground and release a pulse that creates a sheltering nexus of energy for you and your allies. Choose an unoccupied square within 15 feet. The nexus appears in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] around that square and lasts for 3 rounds. You and your allies gain a +1 status bonus to AC while in the area.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.m0hi0jpIF6tNJzzo]{Effect: Sheltering Pulse}

_desc_ko:
당신은 손이나 무기를 땅에 찔러 넣고, 당신과 아군을 위한 보호 에너지 연결점을 생성하는 파동을 방출합니다. 15피트 이내의 비어 있는 칸을 선택한다. 그 칸을 중심으로 15피트 발산 크기의 영역이 나타나며 3라운드 동안 지속된다. 해당 영역 내에 있는 너와 아군은 AC에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻는다.

name: Improved Knockback

description.value: When you successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} a creature, increase both the distance you can push the creature and the distance you can move to follow along with the target by 5 feet on a success or 10 feet on a critical success. If you push the target into another creature or obstacle, they both take @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] damage per 5 feet of movement that was prevented.

_desc_en: When you successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} a creature, increase both the distance you can push the creature and the distance you can move to follow along with the target by 5 feet on a success or 10 feet on a critical success. If you push the target into another creature or obstacle, they both take @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] damage per 5 feet of movement that was prevented.
_desc_ko: 생물을 성공적으로 @link[actions.shove]할 때, 밀어낼 수 있는 거리와 대상과 함께 따라갈 수 있는 이동 거리를 성공 시 5피트, 대성공 시 10피트 증가시킵니다. 추가로, 대상이 다른 생물이나 장애물에 밀려 부딪히면, 막힌 이동 거리 5피트당 1d6 타격의 피해를 입습니다.

name: Silent Step

description.value: You Step, then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}. You still need to meet the requirements to Hide or Sneak, as normal.

_desc_en: You Step, then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}. You still need to meet the requirements to Hide or Sneak, as normal.
_desc_ko: 당신은 신중하게 발걸음을 한 후 @link[actions.hide] 또는 @link[actions.sneak]을 시도합니다. 평소와 같이 숨기거나 은밀 이동할 조건을 충족해야 합니다.

name: Archfiend Dedication

description.value:
Driven by your Calling, you've begun to make plans for your own personal realm from whence you're destined to rule over an army of fiends. Name your realm and describe its eventual appearance. Whether it contains raging hellfire, ponds of caustic acid, or banks of poisonous fog, your realm should be marked by distinctive terrain. Select one of the following damage types associated with your realm's environmental dangers: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or poison. This is your realm's damage type. You gain resistance to the selected damage type equal to half your level. If you already have resistance to this damage type, increase your resistance by 5.

The certainty of your will is such that you can temporarily bring forth a portion of your realm into this world. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IfWF56KiSFQbNmHj]{Manifest Realm} ability. Other feats allow you to further manipulate your manifested realm.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DoPWEGMjKIE2wwRr]{Archfiend}

_desc_en:

You gain resistance to the selected damage type equal to half your level. If you already have resistance to this damage type, increase your resistance by 5.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DoPWEGMjKIE2wwRr]{Archfiend}
_desc_ko:
소명에 이끌려, 당신은 핀드 군단을 통치할 운명의 개인 영역을 계획하기 시작했다. 당신의 영역에 이름을 붙이고 최종적인 모습을 묘사하십시오. 격렬한 지옥불, 부식성 산의 연못, 독성 안개가 자욱한 강둑 등, 당신의 영역은 독특한 지형으로 특징지어져야 합니다. 영역의 환경적 위험과 연관된 다음 피해 유형 중 하나를 선택하십시오: 산성, 냉기, 전기, 화염, 또는 독. 이것이 당신의 영역의 피해 유형입니다. 선택한 피해 유형에 대해 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 저항력을 얻습니다. 이미 해당 피해 유형에 대한 저항력이 있다면, 저항력을 5 증가시킵니다.

당신의 의지는 확고하여 영역의 일부를 일시적으로 이 세계로 불러낼 수 있습니다. @link[actions.manifest-realm] 능력을 얻습니다. 다른 피트를 통해 창조된 영역을 더욱 조작할 수 있습니다.

name: Sure Foot

description.value: You know the secrets of moving in your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.sgo7J9BVofBqwlsF]{Favored Terrain}. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to skill checks to move within your favored terrain, such as Acrobatics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} on ice, Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c8TGiZ48ygoSPofx]{Swim} in rough water, Acrobatics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cS9nfDRGD83bNU1p]{Fly} in windy conditions, and so forth.

_desc_en: You know the secrets of moving in your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.sgo7J9BVofBqwlsF]{Favored Terrain}. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to skill checks to move within your favored terrain, such as Acrobatics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} on ice, Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c8TGiZ48ygoSPofx]{Swim} in rough water, Acrobatics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cS9nfDRGD83bNU1p]{Fly} in windy conditions, and so forth.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @link[feats.favored-terrain]에서 움직이는 비결을 알고 있습니다. 선호 지형 내에서 이동하는 기술 판정(예: 얼음 위에서 @link[actions.balance] 판정, 거친 물에서 @link[actions.swim]에 대한 운동 능력 판정)에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. @link[actions.balance] 검사, 거친 물속에서 @link[actions.swim]하기 위한 운동 능력 판정, 바람이 부는 조건에서 @link[actions.fly]하기 위한 곡예 판정 등이 포함됩니다.

name: Infiltrator's Blitz

description.value:
Requirements You're not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.

Though your training is meant to ensure you don't get caught by your enemies, your missions are often high risk, and sometimes the only option you have left when things go wrong is to unleash a blistering torrent of violence while running away as fast as possible.

You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} any effect that is currently immobilizing you. You gain a +10-foot circumstance bonus to your Speed and can Stride up to three times. At any point during each of these Strides, you can Strike with a weapon you have familiarity with from this archetype and can then immediately Interact to reload that weapon.

After using Infiltrator's Blitz, you become fatigued for 1 minute.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.

Though your training is meant to ensure you don't get caught by your enemies, your missions are often high risk, and sometimes the only option you have left when things go wrong is to unleash a blistering torrent of violence while running away as fast as possible.

You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} any effect that is currently immobilizing you. You gain a +10-foot circumstance bonus to your Speed and can Stride up to three times. At any point during each of these Strides, you can Strike with a weapon you have familiarity with from this archetype and can then immediately Interact to reload that weapon.

After using Infiltrator's Blitz, you become fatigued for 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
요건 당신은 @link[conditions.fatigued]가 아니다.

적에게 발각되지 않도록 훈련받았지만, 임무는 종종 고위험이며, 일이 잘못되었을 때 남은 유일한 선택은 가능한 한 빨리 도주하면서 맹렬한 폭력의 폭풍을 쏟아내는 것뿐이다.

당신은 현재 자신을 이동 불가 상태로 만드는 모든 효과에 대해 @link[actions.escape]을 시도할 수 있습니다. 이동 속도에 +10피트 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 최대 세 번까지 이동을 할 수 있습니다. 각 이동 동안 언제든지, 이 아키타입에서 패밀리어한 무기로 공격할 수 있으며, 즉시 상호작용하여 해당 무기를 재장전할 수 있습니다.

침투자의 돌격을 사용한 후, 1분 동안 피로 상태가 됩니다.

name: Greater Revelation

description.value: You unlock deeper revelations hidden within your mystery. You gain your mystery's greater revelation spell

_desc_en: You unlock deeper revelations hidden within your mystery. You gain your mystery's greater revelation spell
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신의 신비 속에 숨겨진 더 깊은 계시를 해제합니다. 당신은 신비의 (중급) 계시 주문을 얻습니다

name: As in Life, So in Death

description.value: Specific memories of your old life are hard to hold onto, but you know things without remembering why. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ihN8gkHSdPG9Trte]{Adopted Ancestry} feat. You can choose any ancestry, but it is likely to be one that matches both your skeleton heritage and who you were in life. As long as your body is completely covered by armor or clothing, you do not have to attempt Deception checks against a creature's Perception DC to successfully Impersonate yourself as a member of that ancestry. This is a non-magical disguise that doesn't protect against divination. This disguise doesn't provide any benefit against a creature actively attempting a Perception check against you.

name_en: As in Life, So in Death
_desc_en: Specific memories of your old life are hard to hold onto, but you know things without remembering why. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ihN8gkHSdPG9Trte]{Adopted Ancestry} feat. You can choose any ancestry, but it is likely to be one that matches both your skeleton heritage and who you were in life. As long as your body is completely covered by armor or clothing, you do not have to attempt Deception checks against a creature's Perception DC to successfully Impersonate yourself as a member of that ancestry. This is a non-magical disguise that doesn't protect against divination. This disguise doesn't provide any benefit against a creature actively attempting a Perception check against you.
_desc_ko: 과거 삶의 구체적인 기억은 간직하기 어렵지만, 이유를 기억하지 못해도 어떤 것들은 알고 있습니다. 당신은 @link[feats.adopted-ancestry] 재주를 얻습니다. 어떤 혈통이든 선택할 수 있지만, 당신의 해골 유산과 생전 정체성을 모두 반영하는 혈통일 가능성이 높습니다. 신체가 갑옷이나 의복으로 완전히 가려져 있는 한, 특정 종족 구성원으로 위장하는 데 성공하기 위해 상대 생물의 지각 DC에 대한 속임수 검사 시도를 할 필요가 없습니다. 이는 점술에 대한 보호 효과가 없는 비마법적 변장입니다. 이 변장은 상대 생물이 당신을 대상으로 적극적으로 지각 검사를 시도할 때 어떠한 이점도 제공하지 않습니다.

name: Hunter's Sanctum

description.value: You establish a safe house where you can prepare for your hunt. The sanctum is roughly the size of a 20-foot cube. This sanctum is in a location you have access to and can be part of a larger structure, such as the basement of a temple or hidden room of a library. Setting up or moving your sanctum takes a week of downtime. Your sanctum protects objects and people inside it from magical detection and the prying eyes of undead. This has the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EoKBlgf6Smt8opaU]{Veil of Privacy}, using your Religion modifier for the counteract DC and half your level rounded up for the counteract rank. Additionally, undead attempting to locate the entrance to your sanctum via mundane Perception must succeed against either your Religion DC or the normal DC to find the sanctum, whichever is higher.
