This sanctum is in a location you have access to and can be part of a larger structure, such as the basement of a temple or hidden room of a library. Setting up or moving your sanctum takes a week of downtime. Your sanctum protects objects and people inside it from magical detection and the prying eyes of undead. This has the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EoKBlgf6Smt8opaU]{Veil of Privacy}, using your Religion modifier for the counteract DC and half your level rounded up for the counteract rank. Additionally, undead attempting to locate the entrance to your sanctum via mundane Perception must succeed against either your Religion DC or the normal DC to find the sanctum, whichever is higher.
_desc_ko: 당신은 사냥을 준비할 수 있는 안전가옥을 마련합니다. 이 성역은 대략 20피트 큐브 크기입니다. 이 성역은 당신이 접근 가능한 장소에 위치하며, 사원의 지하실이나 도서관의 비밀실처럼 더 큰 구조물의 일부일 수 있습니다. 성역을 설치하거나 이동하는 데는 일주일의 다운타임이 소요됩니다. 성역 내부의 물건과 사람들은 마법 탐지 및 언데드의 시선으로부터 보호받습니다. 이는 @link[spells.veil-of-privacy] 효과를 가지며, 반격 DC에는 종교 수정자를, 반격 등급에는 반올림한 레벨의 절반을 적용합니다. 추가로, 언데드가 평범한 지각 능력으로 성소의 입구를 찾으려고 시도할 경우, 당신의 종교 DC 또는 성소를 찾는 일반 DC 중 더 높은 쪽을 성공해야 합니다.

name: Targeting Shot

description.value: You carefully track your prey's position and defenses, allowing you to follow up around obstacles that block your shot. Make a ranged weapon Strike against your hunted prey. You ignore the target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition and all cover.

_desc_en: You carefully track your prey's position and defenses, allowing you to follow up around obstacles that block your shot. Make a ranged weapon Strike against your hunted prey. You ignore the target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition and all cover.
_desc_ko: 당신은 사냥감의 위치와 방어 태세를 꼼꼼히 추적하여 사격을 방해하는 장애물을 우회할 수 있습니다. 사냥감을 대상으로 원거리 무기 공격을 수행하십시오. 대상의 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태와 모든 엄폐물을 무시합니다.

name: Planar Sidestep

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger A creature hits you with a melee Strike.

You shift your body briefly between planes, reducing the damage from your foe's attack. You gain resistance 25 to all damage against the triggering attack. Observers simply see you shimmer with elemental energy for a moment, just as the attack lands.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger A creature hits you with a melee Strike.

You shift your body briefly between planes, reducing the damage from your foe's attack. You gain resistance 25 to all damage against the triggering attack. Observers simply see you shimmer with elemental energy for a moment, just as the attack lands.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 생물이 근접 공격으로 당신을 강타합니다.

당신은 순간적으로 차원을 이동하며 적의 공격으로 인한 피해를 감소시킵니다. 발동 공격에 대해 모든 피해에 대해 저항력 25를 얻습니다. 관찰자들은 공격이 닿는 순간, 당신이 원소 에너지로 잠시 반짝이는 모습만을 보게 됩니다.

name: Dominion Aura

description.value:
Frequency once per day

For a short time, you fully manifest the expectations of the god destroyer within you. All creatures within a @Template[emanation|distance:10] take @Damage[8d6[force]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] save. A creature that fails this save is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. For 1 minute, any creature who ends its turn within the 10-foot emanation takes @Damage[5d6[force]|options:area-damage] damage with a basic Fortitude save. If you aren't drained, you can choose to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} when you use Dominion Aura to increase the radius of the emanation from 10 feet to 20 feet.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

For a short time, you fully manifest the expectations of the god destroyer within you. All creatures within a @Template[emanation|distance:10] take @Damage[8d6[force]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] save. A creature that fails this save is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. For 1 minute, any creature who ends its turn within the 10-foot emanation takes @Damage[5d6[force]|options:area-damage] damage with a basic Fortitude save. If you aren't drained, you can choose to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} when you use Dominion Aura to increase the radius of the emanation from 10 feet to 20 feet.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

잠시 동안, 당신은 내면에 깃든 신의 파괴자에 대한 기대를 완전히 창조합니다. 10피트 범위 내의 모든 생물은 기본 인내 내성에 성공하지 못하면 8d6 역장의 피해를 입습니다. 이 내성에 실패한 생물은 @link[conditions.prone] 상태가 된다. 1분 동안, 10피트 반경 내에서의 턴을 종료하는 모든 생물은 기본 인내 내성을 통해 5d6 역장 피해를 입는다. 흡수가 되지 않은 상태라면, 지배의 기운을 사용하여 방사 반경을 10피트에서 20피트로 확장할 때 @link[conditions.drained]{2} 상태가 되도록 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: General's Gambit

description.value:
You move strategically forward to draw the enemy's attention away from your allies. You Stride toward an enemy and attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion}, except you can use Society or Warfare Lore instead of Deception.

On a success, in addition to the normal outcome for Creating a Diversion, the enemy becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with you until the start of your next turn and can't use reactions against allies in your aura. On a critical success, the enemy becomes fascinated with you until the end of your next turn.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You move strategically forward to draw the enemy's attention away from your allies. You Stride toward an enemy and attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion}, except you can use Society or Warfare Lore instead of Deception.

On a success, in addition to the normal outcome for Creating a Diversion, the enemy becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with you until the start of your next turn and can't use reactions against allies in your aura. On a critical success, the enemy becomes fascinated with you until the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
동료들의 주의를 분산시키기 위해 전략적으로 전진합니다. 적을 향해 이동하여 @link[actions.create-a-diversion]을 시도합니다. 단, 기만 대신 사회 또는 전쟁학 지식를 사용할 수 있습니다.

성공 시, 일반적인 주의를 분산시키는 결과에 더해, 적은 다음 차례 시작까지 당신에게 @link[conditions.fascinated] 상태가 되며, 당신의 오라 안에 있는 아군에게 반응을 사용할 수 없습니다. 대성공 시, 적은 다음 차례 끝까지 당신에게 매혹 상태가 됩니다.

name: Wing Bounce

description.value: You rush forward, flapping your wings for a bit of lift, and can use that momentum to knock down a foe. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, and if you land within melee reach of at least one enemy, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} that enemy. You don't need to have one hand free. If you successfully knock the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, you can Leap again. If you have a fly Speed, you can Fly instead of Leap.

_desc_en: You rush forward, flapping your wings for a bit of lift, and can use that momentum to knock down a foe. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, and if you land within melee reach of at least one enemy, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} that enemy. You don't need to have one hand free. If you successfully knock the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, you can Leap again. If you have a fly Speed, you can Fly instead of Leap.
_desc_ko: 날개를 퍼덕여 약간의 양력을 얻으며 앞으로 돌진하고, 그 기세를 이용해 적을 쓰러뜨릴 수 있습니다. @link[actions.leap] 후 적어도 한 명의 적과 근접 공격 범위 내에 착지하면, 해당 적을 @link[actions.trip] 시도할 수 있습니다. 한 손을 비울 필요는 없습니다. 만약 당신이 대상이 @link[conditions.prone] 상태가 되는 것을 성공하여 knock하면, 다시 도약할 수 있습니다. 비행 속도를 가진 경우 도약 대신 비행할 수 있습니다.

name: Cindersoul

description.value: The fire of your elemental ancestor manifests like dying embers of a blaze, and your inner charcoal helps staunch bleeding, purify simple poisons, and absorb acid. The DC for you to recover from persistent acid, bleed, and poison damage is 10 instead of 15 (or @Check[flat|dc:5] if you have particularly effective assistance).

_desc_en: The fire of your elemental ancestor manifests like dying embers of a blaze, and your inner charcoal helps staunch bleeding, purify simple poisons, and absorb acid. The DC for you to recover from persistent acid, bleed, and poison damage is 10 instead of 15 (or @Check[flat|dc:5] if you have particularly effective assistance).
_desc_ko: 당신의 원소 조상의 불꽃은 꺼져가는 불씨처럼 창조되며, 내면의 숯은 출혈을 멈추고 단순한 독을 정화하며 산을 흡수하는 데 도움을 줍니다. 지속적인 산성, 출혈, 독 피해로부터 회복하는 데 필요한 난이도(DC)는 15가 아닌 10입니다(또는 특히 효과적인 도움을 받는 경우 DC 5 단순).

name: Draconic Sycophant

description.value: You possess features that dragons find particularly cute or charming, making it easier to endear yourself to them, or at least cause them to momentarily forgive your insolence. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks and saving throws against dragons. In addition, whenever you meet a creature with the dragon trait in a social situation, you can attempt a Diplomacy check to [[/act make-an-impression]] on that creature immediately, rather than after conversing for 1 minute; you take a –5 circumstance penalty to this check. If you fail, you can choose to engage in 1 minute of conversation and then attempt a new check rather than accept the failure or critical failure result.

_desc_en: You possess features that dragons find particularly cute or charming, making it easier to endear yourself to them, or at least cause them to momentarily forgive your insolence. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks and saving throws against dragons. In addition, whenever you meet a creature with the dragon trait in a social situation, you can attempt a Diplomacy check to [[/act make-an-impression]] on that creature immediately, rather than after conversing for 1 minute; you take a –5 circumstance penalty to this check. If you fail, you can choose to engage in 1 minute of conversation and then attempt a new check rather than accept the failure or critical failure result.
_desc_ko:
당신은 용족이 유난히 호감을 느끼는 매력을 지녔으며, 그것이 통하지 않을 때는 언제 피해야 할지 안다. 용에 대한 지각 판정 및 내성 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻는다.

또한, 사회적 상황에서 용 특성을 가진 생물을 만날 때마다, 1분간 대화한 후가 아닌 즉시 그 생물에게 @link[actions.make-an-impression]를 시도할 수 있습니다. 이 판정에는 -5 페널티가 적용됩니다. 실패 시, 실패 또는 대실패 결과를 받아들이지 않고 1분간 대화를 나눈 후 새로운 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다.

특수 @link[feats.glad-hand] 기술 피트를 보유한 경우, 대상이 용의 특성을 지녔을 때 즉각적인 외교 판정 페널티를 받지 않습니다.

name: Greater Sun Blessing

description.value:
Your connection to the Old Sun Gods grows stronger. You gain an advanced domain spell from a domain you chose with Blessing of the Sun Gods. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.

Special You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, you must select a different domain for which you have an initial domain spell from Blessing of the Sun Gods.

_desc_en:
Your connection to the Old Sun Gods grows stronger. You gain an advanced domain spell from a domain you chose with Blessing of the Sun Gods. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.

Special You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, you must select a different domain for which you have an initial domain spell from Blessing of the Sun Gods.
_desc_ko:
옛 태양 신들과의 유대가 더욱 강해집니다. 태양 신들의 축복으로 선택한 도메인에서 고급 도메인 주문을 하나 얻습니다. 포커스 풀의 포커스 포인트 수를 1 증가시킵니다.

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 선택할 때마다 태양 신들의 축복으로 초기 도메인 주문을 가진 서로 다른 도메인을 선택해야 합니다.

name: Metal Carapace

description.value:
Sheets of bent and rusted metal cover you in an armored shell. The carapace is medium armor but uses your highest armor proficiency. The carapace's statistics are: AC Bonus +3; Dex Cap +2; Check Penalty –2; Speed Penalty –5 feet; Strength +2; Bulk 2; Group plate; Armor Traits noisy. Any bonuses, runes, and magical abilities of your actual armor are suppressed, but any that could apply to the metal carapace are replicated onto it.

When you use this impulse, you can also create a rusty steel shield in a free hand, which uses the statistics of a regular steel shield. You can Shield Block with this shield even if you don't have that feat. The hand wielding this shield counts as a free hand for using impulses. The shield crumbles to flakes of rust if it becomes broken or leaves your grasp. The impulse lasts for 10 minutes, and you can Dismiss this impulse. If you use this impulse again, any existing one ends. The metal is rusted and fragile. If you take damage from a critical hit, the metal shatters and the impulse ends.

Level (+3) The shield's Hardness increases by 1, its HP by 4, and its BT by 2.

_desc_en:
Sheets of bent and rusted metal cover you in an armored shell. The carapace is medium armor but uses your highest armor proficiency. The carapace's statistics are: AC Bonus +3; Dex Cap +2; Check Penalty –2; Speed Penalty –5 feet; Strength +2; Bulk 2; Group plate; Armor Traits noisy. Any bonuses, runes, and magical abilities of your actual armor are suppressed, but any that could apply to the metal carapace are replicated onto it.

When you use this impulse, you can also create a rusty steel shield in a free hand, which uses the statistics of a regular steel shield. You can Shield Block with this shield even if you don't have that feat. The hand wielding this shield counts as a free hand for using impulses. The shield crumbles to flakes of rust if it becomes broken or leaves your grasp. The impulse lasts for 10 minutes, and you can Dismiss this impulse. If you use this impulse again, any existing one ends. The metal is rusted and fragile. If you take damage from a critical hit, the metal shatters and the impulse ends.

Level (+3) The shield's Hardness increases by 1, its HP by 4, and its BT by 2.
_desc_ko:
구부러지고 녹슨 금속판들이 갑옷 같은 외피로 당신을 감쌉니다. 이 갑각은 평갑이지만, 당신의 가장 높은 방어구 숙련도를 적용합니다. 갑각의 통계는 다음과 같다: AC 보너스 +3; 민첩 상한 +2; 판정 페널티 -2; 이동 속도 페널티 -5피트; 근력 +2; 벌크 2; 무게 그룹 플레이트; 갑옷 특성 시끄러움. 실제 갑옷의 모든 보너스, 룬, 마법 능력은 억제되지만, 금속 갑각에 적용될 수 있는 능력은 그대로 복제된다.

이 임펄스를 사용할 때, 빈 손에 녹슨 강철 방패를 생성할 수 있으며 이는 일반 강철 방패의 통계를 사용합니다. 해당 피트가 없어도 이 방패로 방패 막기가 가능합니다. 이 방패를 든 손은 임펄스 사용 시 빈 손으로 간주됩니다. 방패가 파손되거나 손에서 떨어지면 녹 조각으로 부서집니다. 이 임펄스는 10분간 지속되며, 해제할 수 있습니다. 이 임펄스를 다시 사용하면 기존 임펄스는 종료됩니다. 금속은 녹슬고 취약합니다. 치명타로 피해를 입으면 금속이 산산조각나며 임펄스가 종료됩니다.

레벨 (+3) 방패의 경도가 1 증가하고, HP가 4 증가하며, BT가 2 증가합니다.

name: First Revelation

description.value: You gain your mystery's initial revelation spell. If you don't have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You can Refocus by reconciling the conflicting nature of your mystery, which also reduces your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zXZjC8HLaRoLR17U]{Cursebound} value by 1.

_desc_en: You gain your mystery's initial revelation spell. If you don't have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You can Refocus by reconciling the conflicting nature of your mystery, which also reduces your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zXZjC8HLaRoLR17U]{Cursebound} value by 1.
_desc_ko: 당신은 신비의 초기 계시 주문을 얻습니다. 만약 가지고 있지 않다면, 1 포커스 포인트의 포커스 풀을 얻습니다. 당신은 신비의 상충하는 본질을 조화시켜 재집중할 수 있으며, 이는 또한 당신의 @link[conditions.cursebound] 값을 1 감소시킵니다.

name: Goloma Courage

description.value: The most important thing you've learned living with fear is how to overcome it. When you roll a success on a saving throw against a fear effect, you get a critical success instead. In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves against fear effects and a +2 circumstance bonus to your Will DC against attempts to Demoralize you.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: The most important thing you've learned living with fear is how to overcome it. When you roll a success on a saving throw against a fear effect, you get a critical success instead. In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves against fear effects and a +2 circumstance bonus to your Will DC against attempts to Demoralize you.
_desc_ko: 두려움 속에서 살아가며 배운 가장 중요한 것은 두려움을 극복하는 법이다. 공포 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴릴 경우, 대신 대성공을 얻는다. 또한 공포 효과에 대한 의지 내성 굴림에서 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 사기를 꺾으려고 시도하는 것에 대한 의지 난이도(DC)에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻는다.

name: It Takes a Village

description.value: Your community bond creates better dynamics when working together. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to checks to Aid.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your community bond creates better dynamics when working together. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to checks to Aid.
_desc_ko: 공동체 유대감은 협업 시 더 나은 시너지를 창출합니다. 지원 판정 시 +4 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Returning Throw

description.value:
You have mastered the technique of arcing a projectile so that it returns to your hand after being thrown, though this requires a moment to precisely calculate the trajectory and possible ricochets.

Make a ranged Strike with a thrown weapon. Once the Strike is complete, the weapon arcs or ricochets back to your hand. If your hands are full when the weapon returns, it falls to the ground in your space.

_desc_en:
You have mastered the technique of arcing a projectile so that it returns to your hand after being thrown, though this requires a moment to precisely calculate the trajectory and possible ricochets.

Make a ranged Strike with a thrown weapon. Once the Strike is complete, the weapon arcs or ricochets back to your hand. If your hands are full when the weapon returns, it falls to the ground in your space.
_desc_ko:
투사체를 궤적을 그리며 던진 후 손으로 되돌리는 기술을 마스터했습니다. 다만 정확한 궤적과 반사 가능성을 계산하는 데 잠시 시간이 필요합니다.

투척 무기로 원거리 공격을 수행한다. 공격이 완료되면 무기는 궤적을 그리거나 튕겨져 당신의 손으로 돌아온다. 무기가 돌아올 때 손이 가득 차 있다면, 무기는 당신의 공간에 떨어진다.

name: Halcyon Spellcasting Initiate

description.value: Your knowledge of halcyon magic increases. You gain two common 2nd-rank halcyon spells and two 3rd-rank halcyon spells. You also gain a 2nd-rank halcyon spell slot and a 3rd-rank halcyon spell slot. These and all future halcyon spell slots work like the 1st-rank halcyon spell slot you gained from Halcyon Speaker Dedication.

_desc_en: Your knowledge of halcyon magic increases. You gain two common 2nd-rank halcyon spells and two 3rd-rank halcyon spells. You also gain a 2nd-rank halcyon spell slot and a 3rd-rank halcyon spell slot. These and all future halcyon spell slots work like the 1st-rank halcyon spell slot you gained from Halcyon Speaker Dedication.
_desc_ko: 당신의 평온 마법에 대한 지식이 증가합니다. 일반 2랭크 할시온 주문 2개와 3랭크 할시온 주문 2개를 획득합니다. 또한 2랭크 할시온 주문 슬롯 1개와 3랭크 할시온 주문 슬롯 1개를 얻습니다. 이 슬롯들과 향후 획득하는 모든 할시온 주문 슬롯은 할시온 화자 헌신에서 얻은 1랭크 할시온 주문 슬롯과 동일하게 작동합니다.

name: Sarangay Lore

description.value:
You listened carefully to the tales passed down among your community. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Nature and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Sarangay Lore.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You listened carefully to the tales passed down among your community. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Nature and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Sarangay Lore.
_desc_ko:
당신은 공동체에서 전해 내려오는 이야기들을 주의 깊게 들었습니다. 자연과 생존에 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 만약 (배경이나 직업 등으로 인해) 그 기술 중 하나에 자동으로 숙련되게 된다면, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다.

또한 사랑가이 지식에 대한 @link[feats.additional-lore] 일반 피트를 획득한다.

name: Terrifying Howl

description.value: You unleash a terrifying howl. Attempt Intimidation checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} each enemy within 30 feet: you don't take a penalty if the creature doesn't understand your language. Regardless of the results of your checks, each target is then temporarily immune to Terrifying Howl for 1 minute.

_desc_en: You unleash a terrifying howl. Attempt Intimidation checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} each enemy within 30 feet: you don't take a penalty if the creature doesn't understand your language. Regardless of the results of your checks, each target is then temporarily immune to Terrifying Howl for 1 minute.
_desc_ko: 당신은 공포를 불러일으키는 울부짖음을 내지른다. 30피트 내의 각 적에게 @link[actions.demoralize]를 위한 위협 판정 시도하다: 대상이 당신의 언어를 이해하지 못해도 페널티를 받지 않는다. 판정 결과와 상관없이, 각 대상은 이후 1분 동안 공포의 울부짖음에 일시적으로 면역이 된다.

name: Psi Development

description.value: You've found a new mental form. You gain another psi cantrip from your conscious mind: either the standard cantrip you didn't take with Psychic Dedication, or the unique surface psi cantrip. You gain the psychic benefits for this second psi cantrip. You gain the ability to amp your psi cantrips. If you don't have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can use to amp your psi cantrips, and you can Refocus by meditating on your new powers.

_desc_en: You've found a new mental form. You gain another psi cantrip from your conscious mind: either the standard cantrip you didn't take with Psychic Dedication, or the unique surface psi cantrip. You gain the psychic benefits for this second psi cantrip. You gain the ability to amp your psi cantrips. If you don't have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can use to amp your psi cantrips, and you can Refocus by meditating on your new powers.
_desc_ko: 새로운 정신 형태를 발견했다. 의식적 정신에서 또 다른 사이 캔트립을 얻는다: 정신 헌신으로 선택하지 않은 표준 사이 캔트립, 혹은 고유한 표면 사이 캔트립 중 하나다. 이 두 번째 사이 캔트립의 효과와 앰프를 얻는다. 포커스 풀의 포커스 수를 1 증가시킨다.

name: Ship's Shadow

description.value: After extensive training around and on board ships, you've learned how to use their size and contours to conceal yourself. When in the water within 20 feet of a sea vehicle or climbing aboard one, you can move at your full Speed while Sneaking.

_desc_en: After extensive training around and on board ships, you've learned how to use their size and contours to conceal yourself. When in the water within 20 feet of a sea vehicle or climbing aboard one, you can move at your full Speed while Sneaking.
_desc_ko: 선박 주변과 선상에서 광범위한 훈련을 거친 뒤, 당신은 배의 크기와 굴곡을 이용해 몸을 숨기는 법을 익혔습니다. 해상 탈것으로부터 20피트 내의 물속에 있거나 그 위로 기어오를 때, 당신은 은밀 이동을 하면서 완전한 속도로 이동할 수 있습니다.

name: Lethargy Poisoner

description.value: You've learned more than the use of hand crossbows. During your daily preparations, you can prepare a dose of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zo0ophqfKunJFxZN]{Lethargy Poison} from ordinary materials in a wilderness or urban area. If you're an expert in Crafting, you can instead craft a dose of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.nn2HAN1XKkKHfVnM]{Stupor Poison}. You can prepare two doses (of either poison) if you're a master in Crafting and three doses if you're legendary in Crafting. The save DC for this poison is equal to your class DC. Only you can use these poisons, and they expire the next time you make your daily preparations. The GM might decide that the area you're in is too barren to provide the materials you need for this feat.

_desc_en: You've learned more than the use of hand crossbows. During your daily preparations, you can prepare a dose of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zo0ophqfKunJFxZN]{Lethargy Poison} from ordinary materials in a wilderness or urban area. If you're an expert in Crafting, you can instead craft a dose of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.nn2HAN1XKkKHfVnM]{Stupor Poison}. You can prepare two doses (of either poison) if you're a master in Crafting and three doses if you're legendary in Crafting. The save DC for this poison is equal to your class DC. Only you can use these poisons, and they expire the next time you make your daily preparations. The GM might decide that the area you're in is too barren to provide the materials you need for this feat.
_desc_ko: 손 석궁 사용법 이상의 것을 배웠습니다. 일상적인 준비 과정에서 야생지대나 도시 지역에서 일반 재료로 @link[equipment.lethargy-poison] 한 병을 준비할 수 있습니다. 제작에 숙련된 경우, 대신 @link[equipment.stupor-poison] 한 병을 제작할 수 있습니다. 제작에 마스터라면 두 병(어느 독약이든), 전설급이라면 세 병을 준비할 수 있습니다. 이 독약의 내성 DC는 당신의 직업 DC와 동일합니다. 이 독들은 오직 당신만이 사용할 수 있으며, 다음 일일 준비 시점에 소멸됩니다. GM은 당신이 있는 지역이 이 피트에 필요한 재료를 제공하기에 너무 황폐하다고 판단할 수 있습니다.

name: Draw From the Land

description.value:
Requirements You gained a terrain attunement benefit this turn, and it matched the terrain you're in.

You pull strength from the surrounding terrain. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level. They last for 1 round. If you previously gained the plains terrain attunement effect this turn, combine the temporary Hit Points together.

_desc_en:
Requirements You gained a terrain attunement benefit this turn, and it matched the terrain you're in.

You pull strength from the surrounding terrain. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level. They last for 1 round. If you previously gained the plains terrain attunement effect this turn, combine the temporary Hit Points together.
_desc_ko:
요건 이번 턴에 지형 조율 혜택을 얻었고, 현재 위치한 지형과 일치한다.

주변 지형에서 힘을 끌어모읍니다. 레벨과 동일한 임시 HP를 얻습니다. 이 효과는 1라운드 동안 지속됩니다. 이번 턴에 평원 지형 조화 효과를 이미 얻었다면, 임시 HP를 합산합니다.

name: Maiden's Mending

description.value:
Frequency once per minute

Trigger You cast a non-cantrip occult spell or an innate spell from a changeling ancestry feat.

You can tap into some of the magic that flows through your blood to give you new life. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level (minimum 1) that last until the end of your next turn.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per minute

Trigger You cast a non-cantrip occult spell or an innate spell from a changeling ancestry feat.

You can tap into some of the magic that flows through your blood to give you new life. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level (minimum 1) that last until the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 분당 1회

발동 조건 캐스트 트립이 아닌 오컬트 주문이나 체인질링 혈통 피트의 선천적 주문을 시전할 때.

혈통을 통해 흐르는 마법의 일부를 끌어내 새로운 생명을 얻습니다. 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 임시 HP(최소 1)을 얻으며, 이는 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 지속됩니다.

name: Hydra's Bond

description.value:
When the hero-gods built Pol-Sylirica and its seven armies, they feared betrayal from within. They took inspiration from the multi-headed hydra, and bound the seven armies together with supernatural ties to make them behave as if they shared one body. Following these tactics, during daily preparations, you can select a number of willing creatures equal to half your level to be part of your hydra's bond. Members of the same hydra's bond always know if another member is telling the truth.

When a member of the hydra's bond saves against an effect that would have them act against their allies (such as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} condition, a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P]{Dominate} spell, or other mental effects that would give an ally the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} condition), you can spend a Mythic Point to allow that character to attempt the save at mythic proficiency. If a member of the hydra's bond fails a save against such an effect, other members automatically know that the target is controlled or under the influence of a mental effect. In addition, all members of the hydra's bond gain a +2 circumstance bonus to any roll made to counteract that effect.

_desc_en:
When the hero-gods built Pol-Sylirica and its seven armies, they feared betrayal from within. They took inspiration from the multi-headed hydra, and bound the seven armies together with supernatural ties to make them behave as if they shared one body. Following these tactics, during daily preparations, you can select a number of willing creatures equal to half your level to be part of your hydra's bond. Members of the same hydra's bond always know if another member is telling the truth.

When a member of the hydra's bond saves against an effect that would have them act against their allies (such as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} condition, a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P]{Dominate} spell, or other mental effects that would give an ally the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} condition), you can spend a Mythic Point to allow that character to attempt the save at mythic proficiency. If a member of the hydra's bond fails a save against such an effect, other members automatically know that the target is controlled or under the influence of a mental effect. In addition, all members of the hydra's bond gain a +2 circumstance bonus to any roll made to counteract that effect.
_desc_ko:
영웅신들이 폴-실리리카와 그 일곱 군대를 건설할 때, 그들은 내부 배신을 두려워했다. 그들은 다수 머리를 가진 히드라에서 영감을 얻어, 일곱 군대를 초자연적 유대로 묶어 마치 하나의 몸을 공유하는 것처럼 행동하게 만들었다. 이 전술을 따라, 매일 준비 단계에서 당신은 자신의 레벨 절반에 해당하는 수의 동의한 대상 을 선택해 히드라의 결속의 일원으로 삼을 수 있다. 같은 히드라의 결속의 구성원들은 항상 다른 구성원이 진실을 말하고 있는지 알 수 있다.

히드라 결속의 일원이 동료를 배신하게 만드는 효과(@link[conditions.confused] 상태, @link[spells.dominate] 주문, 또는 동료를 내리게 만드는 정신적 효과)에 대해 내성 @link[conditions.controlled] 상태)에 걸릴 뻔한 효과를 막았을 때, 신화 포인트를 소모하여 해당 캐릭터가 신화 숙련도로 저항 검사를 시도하다. 히드라 유대 구성원이 이러한 효과에 대한 내성에 실패하면, 다른 구성원들은 자동으로 대상이 {제어됨} 또는 정신 효과의 영향을 받고 있음을 알게 됩니다. 또한 히드라 유대 구성원 모두 해당 효과를 반격하기 위한 모든 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Disarming Intercept

description.value:
Trigger You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.vhO1f7oTD2s3Ncg9]{Intercept an Attack} that was made with a melee weapon by a creature you're adjacent to.

When you catch a weapon in your armor, you can move your body to wrench it from your foe's grasp. After Intercepting the Attack, attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} the weapon used for that attack. You don't need to have a hand free, and you gain an item bonus to the Athletics check equal to the value of your armor's potency rune.

_desc_en:
Trigger You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.vhO1f7oTD2s3Ncg9]{Intercept an Attack} that was made with a melee weapon by a creature you're adjacent to.

When you catch a weapon in your armor, you can move your body to wrench it from your foe's grasp. After Intercepting the Attack, attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} the weapon used for that attack. You don't need to have a hand free, and you gain an item bonus to the Athletics check equal to the value of your armor's potency rune.
_desc_ko:
Trigger 당신은 @link[actions.intercept-attack]을 수행하여 인접한 생물이 근접 무기로 가한 공격을 막습니다.

갑옷으로 무기를 잡았을 때, 몸을 움직여 적의 손아귀에서 무기를 빼낼 수 있습니다. 공격을 가로챈 후, 해당 공격에 사용된 무기를 @link[actions.disarm]하려 시도하십시오. 손을 비울 필요는 없으며, 갑옷의 위력 룬 값과 동일한 아이템 보너스를 운동 판정에서 얻습니다.

name: Pummeling Whirlpool

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You draw water from the environs, swirling it into a rough torrent around you to punish your foes. Each creature in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] (or @Template[emanation|distance:15]{15 feet} if you're in a body of water) takes @Damage[8d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. A creature that fails its save is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. At 17th level, the damage increases to 11d6.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You draw water from the environs, swirling it into a rough torrent around you to punish your foes. Each creature in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] (or @Template[emanation|distance:15]{15 feet} if you're in a body of water) takes @Damage[8d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. A creature that fails its save is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. At 17th level, the damage increases to 11d6.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

주변의 물을 끌어와 당신 주위를 거친 소용돌이로 휘몰아 적을 응징합니다. 10피트(물속에 있을 경우 15피트) 내의 모든 생물은 8d6 타격의 피해를 입으며, 기본 반사에 대한 내성 굴림(클래스 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽)를 수행합니다. 내성에 실패한 생물은 @link[conditions.prone] 상태가 된다. 17레벨에 도달하면 피해가 11d6로 증가한다.

name: Scrutinizing Gaze

description.value:
Access You are from Dongun Hold or Alkenstar.

Your family's traditions of defending against Geb's undead have granted you a sixth sense for detecting spirits, haunts, and other restless dead, no matter their form or the strength of their presence. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} when trying to determine if a creature is possessed or under the influence of an effect that would make them controlled, a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks made to see through disguises worn by undead, and a +2 circumstance bonus when using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to find @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} or undetected haunts or undead within 30 feet of you.

If you aren't using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action or searching, the GM automatically rolls a secret check for you to notice haunts or undead within 30 feet anyway. This check doesn't gain the usual +2 circumstance bonus, and instead takes a –2 circumstance penalty.

_desc_en:
Access You are from Dongun Hold or Alkenstar.

Your family's traditions of defending against Geb's undead have granted you a sixth sense for detecting spirits, haunts, and other restless dead, no matter their form or the strength of their presence. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} when trying to determine if a creature is possessed or under the influence of an effect that would make them controlled, a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks made to see through disguises worn by undead, and a +2 circumstance bonus when using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to find @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} or undetected haunts or undead within 30 feet of you.

If you aren't using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action or searching, the GM automatically rolls a secret check for you to notice haunts or undead within 30 feet anyway. This check doesn't gain the usual +2 circumstance bonus, and instead takes a –2 circumstance penalty.
_desc_ko:
접근 당신은 동군 홀드나 알켄스터 출신이다.

가족 대대로 게브의 언데드 로부터 방어해 온 전통 덕분에, 당신은 형태나 존재감의 강약에 상관없이 영혼, 유령, 그리고 다른 안식하지 못한 죽은 자들을 감지하는 여섯 번째 감각을 지니게 되었습니다. 당신은 다음에 수행할 지각 판정에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다: @link[actions.sense-motive] - 생물이 빙의되었거나 통제 효과를 받고 있는지 판단할 때, 언데드가 착용한 변장을 간파하기 위한 지각 판정, 그리고 @link[actions.seek] 행동을 사용하여 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태이거나 감지되지 않은 유령이나 언데드를 찾는 @link[actions.seek] 행동 시 +2 상황 보너스를 받습니다.

@link[actions.seek] 행동을 사용하거나 수색하지 않을 경우, GM은 30피트 내의 유령이나 언데드를 알아차리기 위해 자동으로 비밀 판정을 굴림합니다. 이 판정에는 일반적인 +2 상황 보너스가 적용되지 않으며, 대신 -2 상황 페널티가 적용됩니다.

name: Barbarian Resiliency

description.value: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each barbarian archetype class feat you have. As you continue selecting barbarian archetype class feats, you continue to gain additional Hit Points in this way.

value.value: class granting no more Hit Points per level than 10 + your Constitution modifier

_desc_en: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each barbarian archetype class feat you have. As you continue selecting barbarian archetype class feats, you continue to gain additional Hit Points in this way.
_desc_ko: 당신이 가진 바바리안 아키타입 클래스 피트마다 추가 HP 3점을 얻습니다. 바바리안 아키타입 클래스 피트를 계속 선택함에 따라, 이 방식으로 추가 HP를 계속 얻습니다.

name: Impossible Riposte

description.value:
Your ripostes can deflect attacks back at their source. You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Jtn7IugykXDlIoZq]{Opportune Riposte} with a trigger of "A foe outside of your reach critically fails an attack roll against you" in addition to its usual trigger.

When you use Opportune Riposte with this new trigger against a ranged attack, your Strike deflects some of the triggering effect back toward its source. Compare the result of your attack roll to the AC of the triggering foe.

On a hit, you deal the normal amount of damage for your Strike, but the damage type changes to that of the triggering attack. For instance, if you used Opportune Riposte to deflect a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZxHC7V7HtjUsB8zH]{Blazing Bolt}, your Strike would deal fire damage instead of its normal damage type.

_desc_en:
Your ripostes can deflect attacks back at their source. You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Jtn7IugykXDlIoZq]{Opportune Riposte} with a trigger of "A foe outside of your reach critically fails an attack roll against you" in addition to its usual trigger.

When you use Opportune Riposte with this new trigger against a ranged attack, your Strike deflects some of the triggering effect back toward its source. Compare the result of your attack roll to the AC of the triggering foe.

On a hit, you deal the normal amount of damage for your Strike, but the damage type changes to that of the triggering attack. For instance, if you used Opportune Riposte to deflect a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZxHC7V7HtjUsB8zH]{Blazing Bolt}, your Strike would deal fire damage instead of its normal damage type.
_desc_ko:
당신의 반격은 공격을 원천으로 되돌려 튕겨낼 수 있습니다. @link[feats.opportune-riposte]을 기존 발동 조건에 더해 "도달 범위 밖에 있는 적이 당신을 상대로 한 명중 굴림에 대실패를 할 때"라는 발동 조건으로 사용할 수 있습니다.

이 새로운 발동 조건으로 원거리 공격에 기습 반격을 사용할 경우, 당신의 공격이 발동 효과를 일부 원격 공격자에게 되돌려 반사합니다. 당신의 명중 굴림 결과를 발동시킨 적의 AC와 비교하십시오.

명중 시, 당신은 공격의 정상적인 피해를 입히지만 피해 유형은 유발 공격의 피해 유형으로 변경됩니다. 예를 들어, 당신이 @link[spells.blazing-bolt]을 반사하기 위해 적절한 반격을 사용했다면, 당신의 공격은 정상적인 피해 유형 대신 화염 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Telekinetic Slip

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger Your turn begins, and you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

A thin shell of telekinetic energy pushes from your skin, widening your enemy's grasp enough for you to slip free. You gain a +2 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} from whatever has you grabbed or restrained. This bonus lasts until either you're no longer grabbed or restrained, or you fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger Your turn begins, and you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

A thin shell of telekinetic energy pushes from your skin, widening your enemy's grasp enough for you to slip free. You gain a +2 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} from whatever has you grabbed or restrained. This bonus lasts until either you're no longer grabbed or restrained, or you fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

트리거 당신의 턴이 시작되며, 당신은 @link[conditions.grabbed] 또는 @link[conditions.restrained] 상태입니다.

텔레키네틱 에너지의 얇은 껍질이 피부에서 밀려나와 적의 손아귀를 넓혀, 당신이 빠져나갈 수 있게 합니다. 당신은 붙잡기거나 구속된 상태에서 @link[actions.escape]에 대한 판정 시 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 보너스는 붙잡기거나 구속된 상태가 해제되거나, @link[conditions.unconscious] 상태가 될 때까지 지속됩니다.

name: Advanced General Training

description.value:
Over the long course of your adventuring life, your adaptability has let you pick up numerous useful abilities. You gain a general feat of 7th level or lower. You must meet the feat's prerequisites.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, choosing a different feat each time.

_desc_en:
Over the long course of your adventuring life, your adaptability has let you pick up numerous useful abilities. You gain a general feat of 7th level or lower. You must meet the feat's prerequisites.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, choosing a different feat each time.
_desc_ko:
모험을 거듭하며 길러진 적응력 덕분에 수많은 유용한 능력을 습득했습니다. 7레벨 이하의 일반 피트를 하나 얻습니다. 해당 피트의 전제 조건을 충족해야 합니다.

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있으며, 매번 다른 피트를 선택해야 합니다.

name: Advanced Concoction

description.value:
You gain one alchemist feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your alchemist level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another alchemist feat.

_desc_en:
You gain one alchemist feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your alchemist level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another alchemist feat.
_desc_ko:
연금술사 피트 하나를 얻습니다. 해당 피트의 전제 조건을 충족하기 위한 연금술사 레벨은 캐릭터 레벨의 절반으로 간주됩니다.

특수 이 재주를 여러 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 선택할 때마다 추가로 연금술사 피트를 하나 얻습니다.

name: Shoulder Check

description.value:
Requirements You are wearing medium or heavy armor.

You hit a foe with your armor to throw them off balance. Make a fist Strike even if you don't have a hand free; if you're wielding a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Ix2vicchE79d6Cl3]{Gauntlet} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.YFfG2fMyaIAXkmtr]{Spiked Gauntlet}, you can make a Strike with one of those weapons instead. The Strike gains the following additional results.

Critical Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against melee attacks you attempt against it until the end of your next turn.

Success The target is off-guard against the next melee attack you attempt against it before the end of your current turn.

Critical Failure You are off-guard against melee attacks the target attempts against you until the end of your next turn.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wearing medium or heavy armor.

You hit a foe with your armor to throw them off balance. Make a fist Strike even if you don't have a hand free; if you're wielding a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Ix2vicchE79d6Cl3]{Gauntlet} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.YFfG2fMyaIAXkmtr]{Spiked Gauntlet}, you can make a Strike with one of those weapons instead. The Strike gains the following additional results.

Critical Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against melee attacks you attempt against it until the end of your next turn.

Success The target is off-guard against the next melee attack you attempt against it before the end of your current turn.

Critical Failure You are off-guard against melee attacks the target attempts against you until the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 평갑 또는 중갑옷을 착용하고 있어야 합니다.

갑옷으로 적을 가격하여 균형을 무너뜨립니다. 손이 자유롭지 않더라도 주먹을 쥐고 공격하십시오. @link[equipment.gauntlet]이나 @link[equipment.spiked-gauntlet]을 착용 중이라면 해당 무기로 공격할 수 있습니다. 이 공격 은 다음 추가 결과를 얻습니다.

대성공 대상은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 당신이 시도하는 근접 공격에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다.

성공 대상은 현재 턴이 끝날 때까지 당신이 시도하는 다음 근접 공격에 대해 무방비 상태입니다.

대실패 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 대상이 당신에게 시도하는 근접 공격에 대해 당신이 무방비가 무너집니다.

name: Repeating Hand Crossbow Training

description.value:
The specific needs of your organization or mission warrant your use of the latest in ingenious crossbow technology. You gain access to repeating hand crossbows and repeater bandoliers.

If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.meQJfsKVar9tm6c9]{Running Reload} or a similar feat that allows you to reload and perform another action or activity as a single action, you can use that action more efficiently with a repeating weapon. You can use the action as a 3-action activity to reload a magazine into a repeating weapon after you perform its other granted action, or as a 2-action activity if you use a magazine from a repeater bandolier.

_desc_en:
The specific needs of your organization or mission warrant your use of the latest in ingenious crossbow technology. You gain access to repeating hand crossbows and repeater bandoliers.

If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.meQJfsKVar9tm6c9]{Running Reload} or a similar feat that allows you to reload and perform another action or activity as a single action, you can use that action more efficiently with a repeating weapon. You can use the action as a 3-action activity to reload a magazine into a repeating weapon after you perform its other granted action, or as a 2-action activity if you use a magazine from a repeater bandolier.
_desc_ko:
조직이나 임무의 특수한 요구사항으로 인해 최신식 독창적인 석궁 기술을 사용해야 합니다. 반복식 손 석궁과 반복용 탄띠를 사용할 수 있습니다.

@link[feats.running-reload] 또는 액션 하나로 재장전과 다른 행동/활동을 수행할 수 있는 유사 피트를 보유한 경우, 반복식 무기 사용 시 해당 행동을 더 효율적으로 활용할 수 있습니다. 반복 무기에 탄창을 재장전하는 행동을 3행동 활동으로 수행할 수 있습니다. 이때 다른 부여된 행동을 먼저 수행한 후 재장전합니다. 또는 반복 탄띠에서 탄창을 사용할 경우 2행동 활동으로 수행할 수 있습니다.

name: Golden Dragon's Bounty

description.value: Your familiar alters the material of a spell into that of a precious metal. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that deals bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, that damage is your choice of cold iron, silver, or steel for the purposes of weaknesses, resistances, vulnerabilities, and the like. At 14th level, adamantine is added to the list of metal choices. The spell gains the metal trait.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your familiar alters the material of a spell into that of a precious metal. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that deals bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, that damage is your choice of cold iron, silver, or steel for the purposes of weaknesses, resistances, vulnerabilities, and the like. At 14th level, adamantine is added to the list of metal choices. The spell gains the metal trait.
_desc_ko: 당신의 패밀리어는 주문의 재질을 귀금속으로 변환합니다. 다음 행동으로 타격, 관통, 베기 피해를 주는 주문을 시전할 경우, 해당 피해는 약점, 저항, 취약점 등에 대해 냉철, 은, 강철 중 선택한 재질로 처리됩니다. 14레벨에 도달하면 선택 가능한 금속 목록에 아다만틴이 추가됩니다. 해당 주문은 금속 특성을 획득합니다.

name: Familiar Mascot

description.value: When selecting master abilities, you can choose an ally to benefit from any specific master ability. Each master ability can benefit only a single character, and you can select a specific master ability only once unless the ability says otherwise.

_desc_en: When selecting master abilities, you can choose an ally to benefit from any specific master ability. Each master ability can benefit only a single character, and you can select a specific master ability only once unless the ability says otherwise.
_desc_ko: 마스터 능력 선택 시, 특정 마스터 능력의 혜택을 받을 동료를 지정할 수 있습니다. 각 마스터 능력은 단일 캐릭터에게만 적용되며, 해당 마스터 능력에 별도 명시가 없는 한 특정 마스터 능력은 한 번만 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Surki Weapon Familiarity

description.value:
Surki weapons favor utility and practicality over grace and brutality. You have familiarity with picks, light hammers, sickles, scythes, and one additional common weapon of your choice from the axe or hammer group—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

_desc_en:
Surki weapons favor utility and practicality over grace and brutality. You have familiarity with picks, light hammers, sickles, scythes, and one additional common weapon of your choice from the axe or hammer group—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
_desc_ko:
수르키 무기는 우아함이나 잔혹함보다 실용성과 효율성을 중시합니다. 당신은 곡괭이, 경망치, 낫, 낫과 도끼 또는 망치 계열 중 선택한 일반 무기 하나에 패밀리어입니다. 숙련도 목적상, 이 중 무술 무기는 단순 무기로, 고급 무기는 무술 무기로 취급합니다.

5레벨에 도달하면, 이 무기들로 치명타를 성공시킬 때마다 해당 무기의 치명타 특화 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Retreating Finisher

description.value:
You make a calculated attack without letting down your guard. Make a melee Strike with the following failure effect.

Failure You Step as a free action.

_desc_en:
You make a calculated attack without letting down your guard. Make a melee Strike with the following failure effect.

Failure You Step as a free action.
_desc_ko:
경계를 늦추지 않은 채 계산된 공격을 가합니다. 다음 실패 효과를 가진 근접 공격을 수행하세요.

실패 시 자유 행동으로 한 걸음 이동한다.

name: Emancipator's Mask

description.value: Your mask grants you the abilities of Whistling Kite, the Vigilant Seer, who emancipated thousands. When you are attempting a check to free someone else from an effect that immobilizes, paralyzes, or controls them, roll twice and take the higher result; this is a fortune effect. The GM might decide that this fortune effect applies when attempting checks to remove other conditions or effects to free another. Immediately after you Cast a non-cantrip Spell that targets only one creature, you can choose to permit the target to make an attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}.

_desc_en: Your mask grants you the abilities of Whistling Kite, the Vigilant Seer, who emancipated thousands. When you are attempting a check to free someone else from an effect that immobilizes, paralyzes, or controls them, roll twice and take the higher result; this is a fortune effect. The GM might decide that this fortune effect applies when attempting checks to remove other conditions or effects to free another. Immediately after you Cast a non-cantrip Spell that targets only one creature, you can choose to permit the target to make an attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}.
_desc_ko: 당신의 가면은 수천 명을 해방시킨 경계하는 예언자 휘슬링 카이트의 능력을 부여합니다. 누군가를 고정, 마비, 통제 효과에서 해방시키려는 시도를 할 때, 두 번 굴려 높은 결과를 적용합니다. 이는 행운 효과입니다. GM은 다른 상태나 효과를 제거하여 타인을 해방시키려는 시도에 이 행운 효과가 적용되도록 결정할 수 있습니다. 단일 생물만을 대상으로 하는 캔트립 주문을 시전한 직후, 대상이 @link[actions.escape] 시도를 할 수 있도록 허용할 수 있습니다.

name: Gigantic Megafauna Companion

description.value: The mammoths and other megafauna ridden by your people are larger than any ordinary beast. Your megafauna companion increases in size to Huge but doesn't otherwise change its statistics.

_desc_en: The mammoths and other megafauna ridden by your people are larger than any ordinary beast. Your megafauna companion increases in size to Huge but doesn't otherwise change its statistics.
_desc_ko: 당신의 종족이 타는 매머드와 다른 거대동물들은 일반적인 짐승보다 훨씬 큽니다. 당신의 거대동물 동반자는 크기가 거대로 증가하지만, 그 외의 능력치는 변하지 않습니다.

name: Sinister Appearance

description.value: You possess horns, a tail, or red eyes, or could otherwise be mistaken for a tiefling. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Intimidation. If you would automatically become trained in Intimidation (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xQMz6eDgX75WX2ce]{Intimidating Glare} skill feat, as well as a +2 circumstance bonus on Deception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} when pretending to be a version of yourself who is a tiefling.

_desc_en: You possess horns, a tail, or red eyes, or could otherwise be mistaken for a tiefling. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Intimidation. If you would automatically become trained in Intimidation (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xQMz6eDgX75WX2ce]{Intimidating Glare} skill feat, as well as a +2 circumstance bonus on Deception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} when pretending to be a version of yourself who is a tiefling.
_desc_ko: 뿔, 꼬리, 붉은 눈을 지녔거나 티플링으로 오인될 수 있는 외모를 가졌다. 위협 기술에 숙련 등급을 획득한다. 배경이나 직업 등으로 위협 기술에 자동으로 숙련이 부여되는 경우, 대신 선택한 기술에 숙련이 부여된다. @link[feats.intimidating-glare] 기술 피트를 획득하며, 티플링인 자신의 모습으로 가장할 때 @link[actions.impersonate] 기만 판정에서 +2 상황 보너스를 받습니다.

name: Safety Measures

description.value: You're often careful to be sure you're not hoisted on your own petard, or anyone else's, for that matter. When you have cover from a bomb, you gain resistance to damage caused by that bomb equal to half your level, plus a value equal to the circumstance bonus to AC granted by the cover. You gain these benefits against your own bombs regardless of whether you have cover.

_desc_en: You're often careful to be sure you're not hoisted on your own petard, or anyone else's, for that matter. When you have cover from a bomb, you gain resistance to damage caused by that bomb equal to half your level, plus a value equal to the circumstance bonus to AC granted by the cover. You gain these benefits against your own bombs regardless of whether you have cover.
_desc_ko: 자신의 함정에 걸리지 않도록, 또는 다른 이의 함정에 걸리지 않도록 항상 주의를 기울입니다. 폭탄으로부터 엄폐를 받을 경우, 해당 폭탄으로 인한 피해에 대해 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 저항력을 얻으며, 여기에 엄폐가 제공하는 AC에 대한 ' ' 상황 보너스 값이 추가됩니다. 자신이 설치한 폭탄에 대해서는 엄폐 유무와 상관없이 이 혜택을 받습니다.

name: Powerful Sneak

description.value: You've learned to exploit your enemies' openings. Your sneak attack damage ignores any immunity or resistance the target has to precision damage. In addition, when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}, you can designate one creature you're undetected by at the end of that action. On the next attack you make against that creature before the end of your next turn, any sneak attack die you roll that's less than 3 is a 3 instead. This has no benefit if your next attack against the creature doesn't deal sneak attack damage, and if you designate a new creature you lose the benefit on any previous one.

_desc_en: You've learned to exploit your enemies' openings. Your sneak attack damage ignores any immunity or resistance the target has to precision damage. In addition, when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}, you can designate one creature you're undetected by at the end of that action. On the next attack you make against that creature before the end of your next turn, any sneak attack die you roll that's less than 3 is a 3 instead. This has no benefit if your next attack against the creature doesn't deal sneak attack damage, and if you designate a new creature you lose the benefit on any previous one.
_desc_ko: 당신은 적의 허점을 이용하는 법을 터득했습니다. 당신의 암습 피해는 대상이 정밀 피해에 대해 가진 모든 면역이나 저항을 무시합니다. 또한, 당신이 @link[actions.sneak]을 할 때, 해당 이동이 끝날 때까지 당신이 감지되지 않은 생물 한 마리를 지정할 수 있습니다. 다음 턴이 끝나기 전에 해당 생물에게 가하는 다음 공격에서, 굴린 암습 주사위 중 3 미만인 모든 주사위는 3으로 간주된다. 해당 생물에게 가하는 다음 공격이 암습 피해를 입히지 않으면 이 효과는 적용되지 않으며, 새로운 생물을 지정하면 이전에 지정했던 생물에 대한 이 효과는 사라진다.

name: Primal Summons

description.value: Whenever you summon an ally, you can empower it with the elemental power of air, earth, fire, or water. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kwlKUxEuT8T15YW6]{Primal Summons} order spell.

_desc_en: Whenever you summon an ally, you can empower it with the elemental power of air, earth, fire, or water. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kwlKUxEuT8T15YW6]{Primal Summons} order spell.
_desc_ko: 동료를 소환할 때마다 공기, 대지, 불, 물의 원소력으로 강화할 수 있습니다. @link[spells.primal-summons] 명령 주문을 획득합니다.

name: Diehard

description.value: It takes more to kill you than most. You die from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition at dying 5, rather than dying 4.

_desc_en: It takes more to kill you than most. You die from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition at dying 5, rather than dying 4.
_desc_ko: 당신을 죽이려면 보통보다 더 많은 것이 필요합니다. 당신은 죽어감 4 단계가 아닌 죽어감 5 단계에서 @link[conditions.dying] 상태로 인해 사망합니다.

name: Lie Detector

description.value:
You're adept at noticing the tells of a liar—sweat, flushing, a quavering voice, a quickening pulse. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} and to Perception DCs against attempts to Lie to you. When you determine someone is lying to you, you can use their deceit to your advantage to gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the next Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Performance check you attempt against that creature within the next minute.

If you would gain your Pursue a Lead investigation bonus to any of the above checks, that bonus increases by 1 instead of you gaining the +1 bonus listed.

_desc_en:
You're adept at noticing the tells of a liar—sweat, flushing, a quavering voice, a quickening pulse. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} and to Perception DCs against attempts to Lie to you. When you determine someone is lying to you, you can use their deceit to your advantage to gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the next Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Performance check you attempt against that creature within the next minute.

If you would gain your Pursue a Lead investigation bonus to any of the above checks, that bonus increases by 1 instead of you gaining the +1 bonus listed.
_desc_ko:
당신은 거짓말쟁이의 신호-땀, 얼굴이 붉어짐, 떨리는 목소리, 가속된 맥박-를 포착하는 데 능숙합니다. @link[actions.sense-motive]에 대한 지각 판정 및 당신에게 거짓말을 시도하는 행위에 대한 지각 DC에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 누군가가 당신에게 거짓말을 하고 있다고 판단할 경우, 그 속임수를 이용해 이점을 얻을 수 있습니다. 이후 1분 이내에 해당 생물에게 시도하는 다음 기만, 외교, 협박, 공연 판정에서 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

위 판정들에 적용되는 '단서 추적' 수사 보너스가 적용될 경우, 해당 보너스는 명시된 +1 보너스 대신 1 증가합니다.

name: Sink and Swim

description.value: Your body looks like it's made of flowing water, clear and pristine, providing a natural grace to all your movements. You gain a swim Speed equal to your land Speed. If you already had a swim Speed, it's increased by 10 feet. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eBgO5gp5kKhGtmk9]{Water Transfer} activity, which enables you to teleport through a body of water.

value.value: You've been brought to 0 Hit Points by an enemy that has the water trait or an enemy's ability that has the water trait

_desc_en: Your body looks like it's made of flowing water, clear and pristine, providing a natural grace to all your movements. You gain a swim Speed equal to your land Speed. If you already had a swim Speed, it's increased by 10 feet. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eBgO5gp5kKhGtmk9]{Water Transfer} activity, which enables you to teleport through a body of water.
_desc_ko: 당신의 몸은 흐르는 물처럼 맑고 투명해 보이며, 모든 동작에 자연스러운 우아함을 더합니다. 지상 속도와 동일한 수영 속도를 얻습니다. 이미 수영 속도가 있다면 10피트 증가합니다. @link[actions.water-transfer] 능력을 얻어, 물속을 순간이동할 수 있습니다.

name: Cantrip Casting

description.value: You increase your ability to cast simple spells. You gain two additional cantrips from the tradition matching your trait.

_desc_en: You increase your ability to cast simple spells. You gain two additional cantrips from the tradition matching your trait.
_desc_ko: 당신은 간단한 주문을 시전하는 능력을 향상시킵니다. 당신의 특성에 맞는 전통에서 추가로 두 개의 캔트립을 얻습니다.

name: Practiced Paddler

description.value: You're skilled at navigating bogs and marshes, even for a paddler shoony. You gain a swim Speed of 15 feet.

_desc_en: You're skilled at navigating bogs and marshes, even for a paddler shoony. You gain a swim Speed of 15 feet.
_desc_ko: 당신은 노 젓는 기술이 서툰 사람치고도 늪과 습지를 능숙하게 항해합니다. 수영 속도가 15피트 증가합니다.

name: Continuous Assault

description.value: You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.OKSsFlHY5UKc4dKu]{Elemental Assault} once per hour instead of once per day.

_desc_en: You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.OKSsFlHY5UKc4dKu]{Elemental Assault} once per hour instead of once per day.
_desc_ko: @link[feats.elemental-assault]을 하루에 한 번이 아닌 시간당 한 번 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Vampire Dedication

description.value:
You're a newly risen vampire. You gain the undead and vampire traits and the basic undead benefits, and your undead hunger is for the blood of the living. Your incisors elongate; you gain a fangs unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. They're in the brawling group and have the grapple and unarmed traits. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.ancestryfeatures.Item.dkZ8RxdQFJrdxwQo]{Revulsion} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.ancestryfeatures.Item.bHUrm79wJCcI7L3A]{Sunlight} vulnerabilities detailed on and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.49F65W6VwuXhmv8K]{Drink Blood} ability.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.G3AtnAkIKNHrahmd]{Vampire}

value.value: You were a killed by a vampire drinking your blood.

_desc_en:
You're a newly risen vampire. You gain the undead and vampire traits and the basic undead benefits, and your undead hunger is for the blood of the living. Your incisors elongate; you gain a fangs unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. They're in the brawling group and have the grapple and unarmed traits. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.ancestryfeatures.Item.dkZ8RxdQFJrdxwQo]{Revulsion} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.ancestryfeatures.Item.bHUrm79wJCcI7L3A]{Sunlight} vulnerabilities detailed on and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.49F65W6VwuXhmv8K]{Drink Blood} ability.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.G3AtnAkIKNHrahmd]{Vampire}
_desc_ko: 당신은 새로 부활한 뱀파이어입니다. 언데드 및 뱀파이어 특성, 기본 언데드 혜택을 얻으며, 생명의 피를 갈망하는 언데드 본능을 지닙니다. 앞니가 길어져 1d6 관통 피해를 주는 송곳니 비무장 공격을 사용합니다. 그들은 난투 그룹에 속하며, 그랩과 무기 없는 특성을 지닙니다. 당신은 @link[feats.revulsion]과 @link[feats.sunlight] 약점을 얻으며, @link[actions.drink-blood] 능력을 획득합니다.

name: Only My Doom May Claim Me

description.value: The power of your legend, fueled by your legendary deeds, resists any weapon that is not tied to your curse. You gain resistance equal to half your level against weapon and unarmed attacks that deal a damage type other than the type chosen for your cursed weakness.

name_en: Only My Doom May Claim Me
name_ko: 오직 나의 파멸만이 나를 데려갈 수 있다
_desc_en: The power of your legend, fueled by your legendary deeds, resists any weapon that is not tied to your curse. You gain resistance equal to half your level against weapon and unarmed attacks that deal a damage type other than the type chosen for your cursed weakness.
_desc_ko: 전설적인 업적으로 강화된 전설의 힘은 저주와 연결되지 않은 무기에 저항한다. 저주받은 약점으로 선택한 피해 유형이 아닌 다른 유형의 피해를 주는 무기 및 비무장 공격에 대해 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 저항력을 얻는다.

name: Spiritual Aid

description.value: When you call your spirit guide for aid, its presence bolsters your will and agility. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GmqHs4NEhAjqyAze]{Spiritual Aid} reaction.

_desc_en: When you call your spirit guide for aid, its presence bolsters your will and agility. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GmqHs4NEhAjqyAze]{Spiritual Aid} reaction.
_desc_ko: 당신의 영혼 안내자에게 도움을 요청하면, 그 존재가 당신의 의지와 기민함을 강화합니다. 당신은 @link[actions.spiritual-aid] 반응을 얻습니다.

name: Ten Lives

description.value: When your character would die, you can attempt a @Check[flat|dc:17]. On a success, you're instead reduced to 0 HP and a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} value 1 less than what would normally kill you (typically dying 3). This doesn't change the result for any other creature affected.

_desc_en: When your character would die, you can attempt a @Check[flat|dc:17]. On a success, you're instead reduced to 0 HP and a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} value 1 less than what would normally kill you (typically dying 3). This doesn't change the result for any other creature affected.
_desc_ko: 캐릭터가 사망할 때, DC 17 단순을 시도할 수 있습니다. 성공 시, 대신 HP가 0으로 감소하고 @link[conditions.dying] 값이 정상적으로 사망하게 하는 수치보다 1 감소합니다(일반적으로 3으로 사망). 다른 생물에게 미치는 결과는 변경되지 않습니다.

name: Elite Dracomancer

description.value: Your draconic power equals that of a lesser dragon. Choose one 3rd-rank spell and one 4th-rank spell from those listed for a dragon spellcaster of your draconic benefactor's type (for example, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zvKWclOZ7A53DObE]{Clairvoyance} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.DCQHaLrYXMI37dvW]{Paralyze} for a conspirator dragon benefactor). You can cast each of these spells once per day as innate spells of the same tradition as your draconic benefactor.

_desc_en: Your draconic power equals that of a lesser dragon. Choose one 3rd-rank spell and one 4th-rank spell from those listed for a dragon spellcaster of your draconic benefactor's type (for example, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zvKWclOZ7A53DObE]{Clairvoyance} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.DCQHaLrYXMI37dvW]{Paralyze} for a conspirator dragon benefactor). You can cast each of these spells once per day as innate spells of the same tradition as your draconic benefactor.
_desc_ko:
당신의 마법은 (하급) 드래곤에 필적합니다. 당신의 드라코닉 이그젬플러 유형에 해당하는 드래곤 마법사에게 허용된 (3rd)랭크 주문 하나와 (4th)랭크 주문 하나를 선택하십시오(예: 블랙 드래곤 본형의 경우 @link[spells.paralyze]와 @link[spells.stinking-cloud]).

이 주문들은 하루에 한 번씩 아케인 선천적 주문으로 시전할 수 있다.

name: Plummeting Roll

description.value: Through nimble movements, a graceful landing, and a bit of luck, you can manage to fall from spectacular heights without a scratch. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.LQw0yIMDUJJkq1nD]{Cat Fall} skill feat and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XiiR6WwfTcwIUvHG]{Plummeting Roll} reaction.

_desc_en: Through nimble movements, a graceful landing, and a bit of luck, you can manage to fall from spectacular heights without a scratch. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.LQw0yIMDUJJkq1nD]{Cat Fall} skill feat and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XiiR6WwfTcwIUvHG]{Plummeting Roll} reaction.
_desc_ko: 민첩한 움직임, 우아한 착지, 그리고 약간의 운이 더해지면, 당신은 놀라운 높이에서 떨어지더라도 상처 하나 없이 무사할 수 있습니다. 당신은 @link[feats.cat-fall] 기술 피트와 @link[actions.plummeting-roll] 반응을 얻습니다.

name: Plant Shape

description.value:
You can take the shape of a plant creature. If you don't have untamed form, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zCcfPS4y5SrZzU2x]{Plant Form} once per day, heightened to the same rank as your highest-rank druid spell slot.

If you do have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.VaIHQzOE5ibmbtqU]{Untamed Form}, add the shapes listed in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zCcfPS4y5SrZzU2x]{Plant Form} to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form} list, and whenever you're polymorphed into another shape using untamed form, you gain resistance 5 to poison.

_desc_en:
You can take the shape of a plant creature. If you don't have untamed form, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zCcfPS4y5SrZzU2x]{Plant Form} once per day, heightened to the same rank as your highest-rank druid spell slot.

If you do have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.VaIHQzOE5ibmbtqU]{Untamed Form}, add the shapes listed in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zCcfPS4y5SrZzU2x]{Plant Form} to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form} list, and whenever you're polymorphed into another shape using untamed form, you gain resistance 5 to poison.
_desc_ko:
식물 생물의 형태를 취할 수 있습니다. 야생 형태가 없다면, 하루에 한 번 @link[spells.plant-form]를 시전할 수 있으며, 이는 가장 높은 랭크의 드루이드 주문 슬롯과 동일한 랭크으로 강화됩니다.

@link[feats.untamed-form]를 보유한 경우, @link[spells.plant-form]에 명시된 형태들을 @link[spells.untamed-form] 목록에 추가하며, 야생 형태를 사용해 다른 형태로 변형될 때마다 독에 대한 저항력 5를 얻습니다.

name: Chemical Contagion

description.value: Your injury poisons can spray onto creatures. You gain the toxicologist alchemist's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.tnqyQrhrZeDtDvcO]{Greater Field Discovery}.

_desc_en: Your injury poisons can spray onto creatures. You gain the toxicologist alchemist's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.tnqyQrhrZeDtDvcO]{Greater Field Discovery}.
_desc_ko: 당신의 상처 독은 생물에게 분사될 수 있습니다. 당신은 독물학자 연금술사의 @link[feats.greater-field-discovery-toxicologist] 능력을 얻습니다.

name: Harmless Doll

description.value: You look like nothing more than an ordinary toy, doll, or statuette, and you can fool others with your innocuous appearance. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Deception (or another skill if you're already trained in Deception), and you can Impersonate an inanimate toy or a mindless poppet. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} without any cover or concealment from creatures that don't realize you're alive, so long as you're in a location where a toy of your shape wouldn't be out of place, like a carnival booth, city street, or toy shop (at the GM's discretion). If you succeed, onlookers still see you, but they mistake you for an inanimate toy. After being fooled once, they realize you're alive, and you can't Hide from them in that way again.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en: You look like nothing more than an ordinary toy, doll, or statuette, and you can fool others with your innocuous appearance. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Deception (or another skill if you're already trained in Deception), and you can Impersonate an inanimate toy or a mindless poppet. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} without any cover or concealment from creatures that don't realize you're alive, so long as you're in a location where a toy of your shape wouldn't be out of place, like a carnival booth, city street, or toy shop (at the GM's discretion). If you succeed, onlookers still see you, but they mistake you for an inanimate toy. After being fooled once, they realize you're alive, and you can't Hide from them in that way again.
_desc_ko:
당신은 평범한 장난감, 인형, 조각상에 불과해 보이며, 무해한 외모로 타인을 속일 수 있습니다. 당신은 기만(혹은 이미 기만에 숙련된 경우 다른 기술)에 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻으며, 무생물 장난감이나 무의식적인 인형을 흉내낼 수 있습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.hide] 기술을 사용하여, 당신이 살아있다는 사실을 인지하지 못하는 생물체로부터 은신처나 은폐물 없이도 숨을 수 있습니다. 단, 카니발 부스, 도시 거리, 장난감 가게 등 당신의 형태의 장난감이 어울리는 장소여야 하며(GM의 재량에 따름), 그 장소에서 장난감이 존재하는 것이 자연스러워야 합니다. 성공 시, 주변 사람들은 여전히 당신을 보지만 무생물 장난감으로 오인합니다. 한 번 속은 후에는 당신이 살아있음을 깨닫게 되며, 그들에게는 다시는 이 방법으로 {숨기}할 수 없습니다.

참고: 이 피트가 제공하는 기술을 이미 숙련한 경우, 대체 기술을 수동으로 선택해야 합니다.

name: Now You See Me

description.value: You flash through several possible timelines as you move. Stride up to your Speed. This movement doesn't provoke reactions, and you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} until the end of your turn. All creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you until the end of your turn. You can use Now You See Me while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

publication.title: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

_desc_en: You flash through several possible timelines as you move. Stride up to your Speed. This movement doesn't provoke reactions, and you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} until the end of your turn. _desc_ko: 당신은 이동하면서 여러 가능한 시간선을 스쳐 지나갑니다. 당신의 속도만큼 보폭합니다. 이 이동은 반응을 유발하지 않으며, 당신의 턴이 끝날 때까지 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{은폐} 상태입니다. 당신의 턴이 끝날 때까지 모든 존재는 당신에게 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{무방비} 상태입니다. 당신이 해당 이동 유형을 지녔다면, 보폭 대신 굴착, 등반, 비행, 또는 수영을 하면서 이제 보이지를 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Magnetic Pinions

description.value:
Small pieces of metal fly from you, propelled with magnetism at great velocity. Make ranged @Check[impulse|defense:ac]{impulse attack} rolls against up to three creatures within 60 feet of you; you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your attack roll against any target wearing metal armor or made of metal. All three attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but it doesn't increase until after all the attacks. The metal pieces deal @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -1)/2)+1)d4[bludgeoning],(floor((@actor.level -1)/2)+1)d4[piercing]] damage on a hit (or double damage on a critical hit).

Level (+2) Each type of damage increases by 1d4.

_desc_en:
Small pieces of metal fly from you, propelled with magnetism at great velocity. Make ranged @Check[impulse|defense:ac]{impulse attack} rolls against up to three creatures within 60 feet of you; you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your attack roll against any target wearing metal armor or made of metal. All three attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but it doesn't increase until after all the attacks. The metal pieces deal @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -1)/2)+1)d4[bludgeoning],(floor((@actor.level -1)/2)+1)d4[piercing]] damage on a hit (or double damage on a critical hit).

Level (+2) Each type of damage increases by 1d4.
_desc_ko:
자력을 이용해 고속으로 날아가는 작은 금속 조각들이 당신에게서 발사됩니다. 60피트 이내의 최대 세 생물을 대상으로 원거리 임펄스 명중 굴림을 수행하세요. 금속 갑옷을 착용하거나 금속으로 만들어진 대상에 대한 명중 굴림에는 +1 상황 보너스가 적용됩니다. 세 번의 공격 모두 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되나, 페널티는 모든 공격이 끝난 후에야 증가한다. 금속 조각은 명중 시 타격 관통 피해를 입힌다(치명타 시 피해는 두 배).

레벨 (+2) 각 피해 유형당 1d4씩 증가합니다.

name: Brightsoul

description.value: The fire inside you asserts itself as beaming, radiant light. Your body is naturally luminescent, glowing with the effects of a primal @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light} cantrip. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. The light is involuntary and constant; if counteracted, it returns in [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}. You suffer a -2 circumstance penalty on Stealth checks to Hide or Sneak and gain a +1 circumstance bonus on saves against light effects and effects that inflict the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} conditions.

_desc_en: The fire inside you asserts itself as beaming, radiant light. Your body is naturally luminescent, glowing with the effects of a primal @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light} cantrip. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. The light is involuntary and constant; if counteracted, it returns in [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}. You suffer a -2 circumstance penalty on Stealth checks to Hide or Sneak and gain a +1 circumstance bonus on saves against light effects and effects that inflict the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} conditions.
_desc_ko: 당신 내면의 불꽃이 눈부신 빛으로 발산됩니다. 당신의 몸은 자연적으로 발광하며, 프라이멀 @link[spells.light] 캔트립의 효과로 빛납니다. 캔트립은 당신의 레벨 절반(올림)에 해당하는 주문 랭크으로 강화됩니다. 이 빛은 의지와 무관하게 지속적으로 발산되며, 반격될 경우 1d4 라운드 후에 다시 나타납니다. 은신(숨기거나 은밀 이동) 은신 판정 시 -2 상황 페널티를 받으며, 빛 효과 및 @link[conditions.blinded] 또는 @link[conditions.dazzled] 상태를 유발하는 효과에 대한 내성 판정 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Stella's Stab and Snag

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a piercing or slashing melee weapon.

You dart towards your opponent, seeking to stab them and slice their purse-strings with a single movement. Stride up to your Speed; this movement does not trigger reactions triggered by movement. At any point during this movement you can Strike an opponent within reach. If this Strike is successful, you can attempt a Thievery check to Steal from the target.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a piercing or slashing melee weapon.

You dart towards your opponent, seeking to stab them and slice their purse-strings with a single movement. Stride up to your Speed; this movement does not trigger reactions triggered by movement. At any point during this movement you can Strike an opponent within reach. If this Strike is successful, you can attempt a Thievery check to Steal from the target.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 관통형 또는 베기형 근접 무기를 휘두르고 있어야 합니다.

상대를 향해 돌진하며, 한 번의 동작으로 찌르고 지갑 끈을 베어내려 합니다. 속도만큼 이동합니다. 이 동작은 이동에 의해 유발되는 반응을 발생시키지 않습니다. 이 동작 중 언제든지 도달 범위 내의 상대를 공격할 수 있습니다. 이 공격이 성공하면, 대상에게서 물건을 훔치기 위해 도둑질 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다.

name: Kobold Lore

description.value:
You attentively learned key kobold survival strategies from your elders. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Stealth and Thievery. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Kobold Lore.

_desc_en:
You attentively learned key kobold survival strategies from your elders. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Stealth and Thievery. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Kobold Lore.
_desc_ko:
당신은 장로들로부터 코볼트의 핵심 생존 전략을 주의 깊게 배웠습니다. 은신과 도둑질 기술에 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 해당 기술 중 하나에 자동으로 숙련된 상태가 된다면, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련된 상태가 됩니다.

또한 코볼트 지식에 대한 @link[feats.additional-lore] 일반 피트를 획득합니다.

name: Callow May

description.value: You are among the most common of changelings—those born to sweet hags—and a vibrant green eye signifies that parentage. Your mother's manipulative nature and versatile voice gives you an edge when deceiving others. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.B6HbYsLBWb1RR6Fx]{Charming Liar} skill feat. If you roll Deception for initiative, foes in that combat encounter that haven't acted yet are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against you.

_desc_en: You are among the most common of changelings—those born to sweet hags—and a vibrant green eye signifies that parentage. Your mother's manipulative nature and versatile voice gives you an edge when deceiving others. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.B6HbYsLBWb1RR6Fx]{Charming Liar} skill feat. If you roll Deception for initiative, foes in that combat encounter that haven't acted yet are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against you.
_desc_ko: 당신은 가장 흔한 체인질링 중 하나인 달콤한 마녀에게서 태어난 존재이며, 생생한 녹색 눈이 그 혈통을 나타냅니다. 어머니의 교활한 성격과 다재다능한 목소리는 타인을 속일 때 당신에게 우위를 제공합니다. @link[feats.charming-liar] 기술 피트를 얻습니다. 인니셔티브를 위해 기만 능력치로 주사위를 굴렸을 때, 해당 전투에서 아직 행동하지 않은 적들은 당신에게 @link[conditions.off-guard]가 됩니다.

name: Buzzing Death Cicadas

description.value: Your swarm takes on characteristics of the death cicadas of the Mana Wastes, whose distinctive buzz is said to be a herald of imminent demise. The inclusion of these death cicadas grants your swarm a fly Speed of 20 feet. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.6iGoVnEJuBHJqgpi]{Death Drone} action.

_desc_en: Your swarm takes on characteristics of the death cicadas of the Mana Wastes, whose distinctive buzz is said to be a herald of imminent demise. The inclusion of these death cicadas grants your swarm a fly Speed of 20 feet. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.6iGoVnEJuBHJqgpi]{Death Drone} action.
_desc_ko: 당신의 군집은 마나 웨이스트의 죽음의 매미 특성을 지니게 되며, 그 독특한 윙윙거림은 임박한 죽음을 예고한다고 전해진다. 이 죽음의 매미의 포함으로 군집은 비행 속도 20피트를 얻는다. 또한 @link[actions.death-drone] 행동을 획득한다.

name: Rapid Switch

description.value:
Frequency once per round

Requirements Your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XIgvCPaSy5WXStVD]{Spellsurge} aura is active.

You've honed your control over your spellsurge aura and can rapidly alter its effects. Sustain spellsurge to choose a different effect for its aura.
