You've honed your control over your spellsurge aura and can rapidly alter its effects. Sustain spellsurge to choose a different effect for its aura.
_desc_ko:
빈도 라운드당 한 번

요구 사항 당신의 @link[spells.spellsurge] 오라가 활성화되었습니다.

당신은 주문파동 오라에 대한 통제력을 연마하여 그 효과를 신속히 변경할 수 있습니다. 주문파동을 유지하여 오라의 효과를 달리 선택하십시오.

name: Foil Senses

description.value: You are adept at foiling creatures' special senses and cautious enough to safeguard against them at all times. Whenever you use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} actions, you are always considered to be taking precautions against special senses.

_desc_en: You are adept at foiling creatures' special senses and cautious enough to safeguard against them at all times. Whenever you use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} actions, you are always considered to be taking precautions against special senses.
_desc_ko: 당신은 생물의 특수 감각을 교묘히 무력화하는 데 능숙하며, 항상 이를 경계하여 대비합니다. @link[actions.avoid-notice], @link[actions.hide], 또는 @link[actions.sneak]} 행동을 사용할 때마다, 당신은 항상 특수 감각에 대한 예방 조치를 취한 것으로 간주됩니다.

name: Methodical Magic

description.value: You can reorder the world with your magic. Choose two of the following spells: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.b515AZlB0sridKSq]{Calm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Azoh0BSoCASrA1lr]{Lock}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dINQzhqGmIsqGMUY]{Mending}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.CXICME10TkEJxz0P]{Shape Wood}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vTQvfYu2llKQedmY]{Translate}. You can use each of the chosen spells once per day as 2nd-rank divine innate spells.

Choose two of the following spells: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.b515AZlB0sridKSq]{Calm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Azoh0BSoCASrA1lr]{Lock}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dINQzhqGmIsqGMUY]{Mending}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.CXICME10TkEJxz0P]{Shape Wood}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vTQvfYu2llKQedmY]{Translate}. You can use each of the chosen spells once per day as 2nd-rank divine innate spells.
_desc_ko: 당신은 마법으로 세계를 재구성할 수 있습니다. 다음 주문 중 두 가지를 선택하십시오: @link[spells.calm], @link[spells.dispel-magic], @link[spells.lock], @link[spells.mending], @link[spells.shape-wood], 또는 @link[spells.translate] 중에서 두 가지를 선택하십시오. 선택한 각 주문을 하루에 한 번씩 (2nd)랭크 신성 선천 주문으로 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Athamaru Lore

description.value:
You've immersed yourself in community learning, particularly around navigating the waters and tending to animals. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Athletics and Nature. If you automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Athamaru Lore.

_desc_en:
You've immersed yourself in community learning, particularly around navigating the waters and tending to animals. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Athletics and Nature. If you automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Athamaru Lore.
_desc_ko:
당신은 공동체 학습, 특히 항해와 동물 돌보기에 몰두했습니다. 운동과 자연에 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 해당 기술 중 하나에 자동으로 숙련된다면, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다.

또한 아타마루 지식에 대한 @link[feats.additional-lore] 일반 피트를 획득합니다.

name: Explosive Metamorphosis

description.value:
You use additional primal energy to transform, creating a burst of elemental energy to complement your transformation. If your next action is to cast a non-cantrip morph or polymorph spell, select acid, cold, electricity, or fire. Your transformation creates a @Template[emanation|distance:5] around your new form that deals 1d6 damage of that type per rank of the spell. Each creature in that area attempts a basic Reflex save against your spell DC.

If your polymorph action had a trait corresponding to an energy type, you must select that one if possible. This action gains the trait corresponding to the energy type selected.

If your next action is to cast a non-cantrip morph or polymorph spell, select acid, cold, electricity, or fire. Your transformation creates a @Template[emanation|distance:5] around your new form that deals 1d6 damage of that type per rank of the spell. Each creature in that area attempts a basic Reflex save against your spell DC.

If your polymorph action had a trait corresponding to an energy type, you must select that one if possible. This action gains the trait corresponding to the energy type selected.
_desc_ko:
추가적인 프라이멀 에너지를 사용해 변신하며, 변신을 보완하는 원소 에너지 폭발을 생성합니다. 다음 행동이 캐스트 캔트립 변형 또는 다형 주문을 시전하는 것이라면 산성, 냉기, 전기, 화염 중 하나를 선택합니다. 변신 시 새로운 형태 주변에 5피트이 생성되며, 해당 영역 내 모든 생물은 주문 랭크당 해당 속성 피해 1d6을 입힌다. 각 생물은 기본 반사 내성 굴림(주문 DC)를 시도한다. 이 영역은 주문 랭크당 해당 속성 피해 1d6을 입힌다.

변형 행동에 에너지 유형에 해당하는 특성이 있었다면, 가능하다면 해당 특성을 선택해야 합니다. 이 행동은 선택한 에너지 유형에 해당하는 특성을 얻습니다.

name: Tikling Bird Twirl

description.value:
Trigger You roll a critical hit on a melee Strike against an enemy.

You trained your footwork by dancing to music between snapping bamboo poles, and your increased mobility helps you succeed when hunting dangerous beasts or fighting multiple opponents. This style of bobbing and weaving and alternating fight and flight disorients your enemies and allows you to choose your engagements. After resolving your attack, you can immediately Step, Stride, or Swim.

_desc_ko:
발동 조건 적에게 근접 공격을 가해 치명타를 굴림한다.

당신은 대나무 장대를 꺾는 사이에서 음악에 맞춰 춤추며 발놀림을 연마했습니다. 이로 인해 향상된 기동성은 위험한 야수를 사냥하거나 다수의 적과 싸울 때 성공률을 높여줍니다. 이처럼 몸을 흔들며 피하고, 공격과 도주를 번갈아 가며 하는 스타일은 적을 혼란스럽게 하여 당신이 교전을 선택할 수 있게 합니다. 공격을 해결한 후 즉시 {신중한 발걸음}, 스트라이드, 또는 수영을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Boundless Reprisals

description.value:
Fighter With a sixth sense for the flow of combat, you can quickly react to any situation as required. At the start of each enemy's turn, you gain a reaction you can use only during that turn for any reaction from a fighter feat or class feature.

Guardian With a sixth sense for the flow of combat, you can quickly react to any situation as required. At the start of each enemy's turn, you gain a reaction you can use only during that turn for any reaction from a guardian feat or class feature.

_desc_en:
Fighter With a sixth sense for the flow of combat, you can quickly react to any situation as required. At the start of each enemy's turn, you gain a reaction you can use only during that turn for any reaction from a fighter feat or class feature.

Guardian With a sixth sense for the flow of combat, you can quickly react to any situation as required. At the start of each enemy's turn, you gain a reaction you can use only during that turn for any reaction from a guardian feat or class feature.
_desc_ko:
파이터 전투 흐름에 대한 예민한 감각으로 어떤 상황에도 신속히 대응할 수 있습니다. 적의 턴이 시작될 때마다, 해당 턴 동안만 사용할 수 있는 반응을 얻으며, 이 반응은 파이터 재주나 클래스 피트의 반응에 사용할 수 있습니다.

수호자 전투 흐름에 대한 예민한 감각으로 어떤 상황에도 신속히 대응할 수 있습니다. 각 적의 턴이 시작될 때마다, 해당 턴 동안에만 사용할 수 있는 반응을 얻습니다. 이 반응은 수호자 재주나 클래스 피트의 반응에 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Clever Counterspell

description.value: You creatively apply your prepared spells to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.EpBG4CFMNSZQx7vI]{Counterspell} a much wider variety of your opponents' magic. Instead of being able to counter a foe's spell with Counterspell only if you have that same spell prepared, you can use Counterspell as long as you have the spell the foe is casting in your spellbook. When you use Counterspell in this way, you must still expend a prepared spell; the prepared spell you expend must share a trait with the triggering spell other than concentrate, manipulate, or its tradition trait. The GM might allow you to instead use a spell that has an opposing trait or that otherwise logically would counter the triggering spell (such as using a cold or water spell to counter @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{Fireball} or using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EfFMLVbmkBWmzoLF]{Clear Mind} to counter a fear spell).

_desc_en: You creatively apply your prepared spells to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.EpBG4CFMNSZQx7vI]{Counterspell} a much wider variety of your opponents' magic. Instead of being able to counter a foe's spell with Counterspell only if you have that same spell prepared, you can use Counterspell as long as you have the spell the foe is casting in your spellbook. When you use Counterspell in this way, you must still expend a prepared spell; the prepared spell you expend must share a trait with the triggering spell other than concentrate, manipulate, or its tradition trait. The GM might allow you to instead use a spell that has an opposing trait or that otherwise logically would counter the triggering spell (such as using a cold or water spell to counter @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{Fireball} or using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EfFMLVbmkBWmzoLF]{Clear Mind} to counter a fear spell).
_desc_ko: 준비한 주문을 창의적으로 활용하여 @link[feats.counterspell-prepared]으로 상대방의 훨씬 다양한 마법을 차단할 수 있습니다. 적의 주문을 카운터스펠로 반격하려면 반드시 동일한 주문을 준비해 두어야 하는 기존 규칙과 달리, 상대가 시전하는 주문이 자신의 주문서에 수록되어 있다면 카운터스펠을 사용할 수 있습니다. 이 방식으로 카운터스펠을 사용할 때도 준비된 주문을 소모해야 하며, 소모하는 준비 주문은 집중, 조작, 전통 속성을 제외한 트리거 주문과 공통된 속성을 가져야 합니다. GM은 대신 반대 특성을 지닌 주문이나 논리적으로 발동 주문을 카운터할 수 있는 주문(예: 냉기나 물 주문을 사용해 @link[spells.fireball]을 카운터하거나 @link[spells.clear-mind]를 사용해 공포 주문을 카운터하는 경우)을 사용할 수 있도록 허용할 수 있습니다.

name: Rally Support

description.value:
You often rely on the local populace for supplies and shelter. Once per day, you can attempt a check to [[/act request]] or [[/act coerce]] against an easy DC for your level when speaking with someone who is a non-hostile, long-term resident of your favored location. On a success, choose one of the following to obtain.

  • A nonmagical item of your level or lower
  • A safe place to shelter for 24 hours
  • 3 days' worth of food and water for you and up to 5 allies

value.value: trained in either Diplomacy or Intimidation

_desc_en:

On a success, choose one of the following to obtain.

  • A nonmagical item of your level or lower

_desc_ko:
당신은 종종 지역 주민들에게 보급품과 숙소를 의지합니다. 하루에 한 번, 선호하는 지역의 비적대적 장기 거주자와 대화할 때, 당신의 레벨에 따른 쉬운 난이도(DC)로 요청 또는 강요 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다. 성공 시 다음 중 하나를 선택하여 획득합니다.

  • 당신 레벨 이하의 비마법 아이템
  • 24시간 동안 안전하게 머무를 수 있는 장소
  • 당신과 최대 5명의 동료를 위한 3일치 식량과 물

name: Escape Timeline

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger Your turn begins.

You step outside of the flow of time momentarily, allowing you to avoid dangers. Your physical form stops existing momentarily, and you can't be targeted or affected until the start of your next turn—you simply don't exist at that moment in time. Your turn ends immediately, advancing 1 round for all timed durations and effects, such as conditions and afflictions. You still attempt saving throws, flat checks, or any other checks at the end of your turn as normal, but you don't take any damage due to these checks (though you take any non-damaging effects as normal). At the start of your next turn, you reenter the flow of time and reappear in the same space where you left time last round. If the space isn't clear, you arrive in the nearest open space.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

At the start of your next turn, you reenter the flow of time and reappear in the same space where you left time last round. If the space isn't clear, you arrive in the nearest open space.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 당신의 턴이 시작될 때.

당신은 잠시 시간의 흐름 밖으로 벗어나 위험을 피할 수 있습니다. 당신의 물리적 형태는 순간적으로 존재를 멈추며, 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 표적이 되거나 영향을 받을 수 없습니다-그 순간 당신은 단순히 존재하지 않습니다. 당신의 턴은 즉시 종료되며, 상태나 고통 같은 모든 시간 기반 지속 효과와 효과가 1라운드 진행됩니다. 당신은 여전히 턴 종료 시 정상적으로 내성 굴림, 단순 판정 또는 기타 판정을 시도하지만, 이러한 검사 때문에 피해를 입지 않습니다(비피해 효과는 정상적으로 적용됨). 다음 턴이 시작되면 시간의 흐름으로 재진입하며, 지난 라운드에 시간을 떠난 동일한 공간에 재등장한다. 해당 공간이 비어 있지 않을 경우 가장 가까운 빈 공간에 도착한다.

name: Fossil Rider

description.value: Using your ancestors' bones, you manifest their spirits around you in a fossilized form. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.O6VQC1Bs4aSYDa6R]{Mask of Terror} on yourself as an innate spell once per day. When you do, you appear as a skeletal lizardfolk ancestor, twisted in a way that inspires the deepest fears of those who observe you.

_desc_en: Using your ancestors' bones, you manifest their spirits around you in a fossilized form. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.O6VQC1Bs4aSYDa6R]{Mask of Terror} on yourself as an innate spell once per day. When you do, you appear as a skeletal lizardfolk ancestor, twisted in a way that inspires the deepest fears of those who observe you.
_desc_ko: 조상의 뼈를 이용해 화석화된 형태로 주변에 그들의 영혼을 창조합니다. 하루에 한 번, 선천적 주문으로 자신에게 @link[spells.mask-of-terror]을 시전할 수 있다. 시전 시, 관찰자에게 깊은 공포를 불러일으키는 뒤틀린 모습의 해골 리자드포크 조상으로 변한다.

name: Shielded Attrition

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a shield.

You provoke attacks from foes that might otherwise stop your allies from moving. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xjGwis0uaC2305pm]{Raise your Shield}, then choose whether to Stride up to half your Speed. This movement triggers enemies' reactions as normal. Each enemy who could have reacted to your movement is unable to react to your allies' movement until the start of your next turn (regardless of whether it chose to react to your movement).

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a shield.

You provoke attacks from foes that might otherwise stop your allies from moving. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xjGwis0uaC2305pm]{Raise your Shield}, then choose whether to Stride up to half your Speed. This movement triggers enemies' reactions as normal. Each enemy who could have reacted to your movement is unable to react to your allies' movement until the start of your next turn (regardless of whether it chose to react to your movement).
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 방패를 장비하고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 아군의 이동을 막을 수 있는 적의 공격을 유도합니다. @link[actions.raise-a-shield], 그런 다음 이동 속도의 절반까지 전진할지 선택하세요. 이 이동은 적의 반응을 정상적으로 유발합니다. 당신의 이동에 반응할 수 있었던 각 적은 다음 차례 시작까지 아군의 이동에 반응할 수 없습니다(당신의 이동에 반응했는지 여부와 무관하게).

name: Denounce Tyranny

description.value:
Requirements You witnessed a creature harm an ally, harm a noncombatant, or commit a wantonly evil act in the last round.

You call out a creature's despicable or cowardly actions, disrupting its alliances or even making its allies ashamed to be seen with it. Attempt a @Check[diplomacy|against:will] check and compare the result to the Will DCs of up to three of the triggering creature's allies within 30 feet of you. If you succeed on the check, the target refuses to treat the triggering creature as an ally for 1 round (2 rounds on a critical success). It's possible to get a different degree of success for each target. If you're a master in Diplomacy, you can instead target up to five creatures, and if you're legendary in Diplomacy, you can target up to 10 creatures.

_desc_en:
Requirements You witnessed a creature harm an ally, harm a noncombatant, or commit a wantonly evil act in the last round.

You call out a creature's despicable or cowardly actions, disrupting its alliances or even making its allies ashamed to be seen with it. Attempt a @Check[diplomacy|against:will] check and compare the result to the Will DCs of up to three of the triggering creature's allies within 30 feet of you. If you succeed on the check, the target refuses to treat the triggering creature as an ally for 1 round (2 rounds on a critical success). It's possible to get a different degree of success for each target. If you're a master in Diplomacy, you can instead target up to five creatures, and if you're legendary in Diplomacy, you can target up to 10 creatures.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 당신은 지난 라운드에 어떤 존재가 아군을 해치거나, 비전투원을 해치거나, 무분별하게 악한 행위를 저지르는 것을 목격했습니다.

당신은 어떤 존재의 비열하거나 비겁한 행위를 규탄하여, 그 동맹을 무너뜨리거나 심지어 그 아군들이 그와 함께 있는 것을 부끄러워하게 만듭니다. @Check[diplomacy|against:will] 판정을 시도하여 그 결과를 당신으로부터 30피트 내에 있는 발동 조건 존재의 아군 최대 3명의 의지 DC와 비교합니다. 판정에 성공하면 대상은 1라운드(대성공 시 2라운드) 동안 발동 조건 존재를 아군으로 대하지 않습니다. 대상마다 다른 성공 단계가 나올 수 있습니다. 당신이 외교 달인이라면 대신 최대 5명의 존재를 대상으로 삼을 수 있고, 외교 전설이라면 최대 10명의 존재를 대상으로 삼을 수 있습니다.

name: Elemental Existence

description.value: Your body becomes infused with elemental earth. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ihN8gkHSdPG9Trte]{Adopted Ancestry} feat and gain a 1st level oread ancestry feat as a bonus feat, ignoring the limitations of the lineage trait. When you gain new ancestry feats, you can select oread feats in addition to feats allowed by your ancestry and heritage.

_desc_en: Your body becomes infused with elemental earth. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ihN8gkHSdPG9Trte]{Adopted Ancestry} feat and gain a 1st level oread ancestry feat as a bonus feat, ignoring the limitations of the lineage trait. When you gain new ancestry feats, you can select oread feats in addition to feats allowed by your ancestry and heritage.
_desc_ko: 당신의 몸은 원소 대지의 기운으로 충만해집니다. @link[feats.adopted-ancestry] 피트를 획득하며, 혈통 특성의 제한을 무시하고 보너스 피트로 1레벨 오레아드 혈통 피트를 얻습니다. 새로운 혈통 피트를 획득할 때, 혈통과 유산이 허용하는 피트 외에도 오레아드 피트를 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Elemental Bulwark

description.value:
Trigger An enemy is about to damage you with cold, electricity, or fire, or with a spell that has the air, earth, fire, or water trait.

You call upon the corresponding elements of your suli heritage to resist the effect. You gain resistance 5 against the triggering damage.

_desc_en:
Trigger An enemy is about to damage you with cold, electricity, or fire, or with a spell that has the air, earth, fire, or water trait.

You call upon the corresponding elements of your suli heritage to resist the effect. You gain resistance 5 against the triggering damage.
_desc_ko:
발동조건 적이 냉기, 전기, 화염 속성으로, 또는 공기, 땅, 불, 물 특성을 지닌 주문으로 당신에게 피해를 입히려 할 때.

당신은 수리 혈통의 해당 원소를 불러내 효과를 저항합니다. 발동된 피해에 대해 저항력 5를 얻습니다.

name: Mummy Dedication

description.value:
Whether through natural processes or foul rituals, your body was mummified, and you've risen as an undead mummy. You gain the mummy and undead traits, as well as basic undead benefits.

Many effects that harm the living are far less effective against your desiccated form. Unfortunately, your dried-out body is also highly flammable. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.AmP0qu7c5dlBSath]{Toughness} feat, but also fire weakness equal to half your level. Your fist draws moisture from the living by touch, making it more damaging and deadly. The damage die for your fist increases to 1d6 instead of 1d4, and your fist loses the nonlethal trait.

Finally, you become supernaturally bound to the dominant terrain in which you were created, either because you formed naturally from the weather of that terrain or because of the local ingredients and methods used in an intentional mummification process. Choose arctic, desert, mountain, or swamp. This choice can't be changed and may alter the effects of some of your feats.

Special You can't select another dedication feat until you have gained two other feats from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.ZewC2i5YdZPsWO8X]{Mummy} archetype.

value.value: you are dead and were mummified (by natural or ritualistic means)

Special You can't select another dedication feat until you have gained two other feats from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.ZewC2i5YdZPsWO8X]{Mummy} archetype.
_desc_ko:
자연적 과정이든 사악한 의식이든, 당신의 몸은 미라화되었고 언데드 미라로 부활했습니다. 미라 특성과 언데드 특성을 획득하며, 기본 언데드 혜택도 받습니다.

생명을 해치는 많은 효과들은 당신의 건조한 형태에 대해 훨씬 덜 효과적입니다. 불행히도, 당신의 마른 몸은 또한 매우 가연성이 높습니다. 당신은 @link[feats.toughness] 피트를 얻지만, 동시에 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 화염 약점도 얻습니다. 네 주먹은 접촉 시 생물의 수분을 흡수하여 더 치명적이고 치명적인 공격이 된다. 주먹의 피해 주사위가 1d4에서 1d6으로 증가하며, 비살상 특성을 상실한다.

마지막으로, 당신은 초자연적으로 생성된 주요 지형과 결속됩니다. 이는 해당 지형의 기후 조건에서 자연적으로 형성되었거나, 의도적인 미라화 과정에서 사용된 지역 재료와 방법 때문일 수 있습니다. 북극, 사막, 산악, 습지 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 이 선택은 변경할 수 없으며, 일부 피트의 효과를 변경할 수 있습니다.

특수 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.ZewC2i5YdZPsWO8X]{미라} 아키타입에서 다른 피트 두 가지를 획득하기 전까지는 다른 헌신 재주를 선택할 수 없습니다.

name: Jotunborn Lore

description.value:
You were taught the history of your people's planar travels as well as the skills necessary to thrive in sub-planar environments. You become trained in Occultism and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Jotunborn Lore.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.heritages.Item.NUUWs7jFwsIPmx3p]{Sage Jotunborn} heritage, you gain the Additional Lore feat a second time for a lore of your choice.

_desc_en:
You were taught the history of your people's planar travels as well as the skills necessary to thrive in sub-planar environments. You become trained in Occultism and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Jotunborn Lore.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.heritages.Item.NUUWs7jFwsIPmx3p]{Sage Jotunborn} heritage, you gain the Additional Lore feat a second time for a lore of your choice.
_desc_ko:
당신은 종족의 평면 여행 역사와 하위 평면 환경에서 생존하는 데 필요한 기술을 배웠습니다. 오컬트와 하위 평면 생존에 숙련됩니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 해당 기술 중 하나에 자동으로 숙련이 부여된다면, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다. 또한 요툰본 지식에 대한 @link[feats.additional-lore] 일반 피트를 얻습니다.

특수 @link[heritages.sage-jotunborn] 혈통을 가진 경우, 선택한 지식 분야에 대해 추가 지식 피트를 두 번째로 획득합니다.

name: Envenom Fangs

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You envenom your fangs. If the next fangs Strike you make before the end of your next turn hits and deals damage, the Strike deals an additional 1d6 persistent poison damage. The poison becomes inert after you hit, or at the end of your next turn, whichever comes first.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

You envenom your fangs. If the next fangs Strike you make before the end of your next turn hits and deals damage, the Strike deals an additional 1d6 persistent poison damage. The poison becomes inert after you hit, or at the end of your next turn, whichever comes first.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 시간당 1회

이빨에 독을 묻힙니다. 다음 차례가 끝나기 전에 가하는 다음 이빨 공격이 적중하여 피해를 입힐 경우, 해당 공격은 추가로 1d6 지속 독 피해를 입힌다. 독은 적중 후 또는 다음 차례가 끝나는 시점 중 먼저 도래하는 시점에 소멸한다.

name: Familiar Conduit

description.value:
Requirements You have line of effect to your familiar.

Under your tutelage, your familiar has grown attuned to the hidden currents of the world and can serve as a conduit for your magic. If the next action you use is to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast a Spell} that has a range, the spell uses the familiar as its origin point.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have line of effect to your familiar.

Under your tutelage, your familiar has grown attuned to the hidden currents of the world and can serve as a conduit for your magic. If the next action you use is to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast a Spell} that has a range, the spell uses the familiar as its origin point.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 자신의 패밀리어와 효과 선상에 있어야 합니다.

당신의 지도 아래, 당신의 패밀리어 존재는 세상의 숨겨진 흐름에 익숙해져 당신의 마법을 전달하는 전도체 역할을 할 수 있습니다. 당신이 다음에 사용하는 행동이 @link[actions.cast-a-spell]이며, 그 주문에 범위가 있다면, 그 주문은 패밀리어 존재를 기점으로 사용합니다.

name: Expert Cathartic Spellcasting

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{Expert Spellcasting Feat} benefits.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{Expert Spellcasting Feat} benefits.
_desc_ko: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{전문 주문 시전 피트}의 혜택을 얻습니다.

name: Legendary Thief

description.value: Your ability to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} defies belief. You can attempt to Steal something that is actively wielded or that would be extremely noticeable or time consuming to remove (like worn shoes or armor). You must do so slowly and carefully, spending at least 1 minute (and significantly longer for items that are normally time consuming to remove, like armor). Throughout this duration you must have some means of staying @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, such as the cover of darkness or a bustling crowd. Even if you succeed, if the item is extremely prominent—like a suit of full plate armor—onlookers will quickly notice it's gone after you steal it.

_desc_en: Your ability to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} defies belief. You can attempt to Steal something that is actively wielded or that would be extremely noticeable or time consuming to remove (like worn shoes or armor). You must do so slowly and carefully, spending at least 1 minute (and significantly longer for items that are normally time consuming to remove, like armor). Throughout this duration you must have some means of staying @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, such as the cover of darkness or a bustling crowd. Even if you succeed, if the item is extremely prominent—like a suit of full plate armor—onlookers will quickly notice it's gone after you steal it.
_desc_ko: 당신의 @link[actions.steal] 능력은 믿기 어려울 정도입니다. 착용 중인 물건이나 제거하기에 극히 눈에 띄거나 시간이 많이 소요되는 물건(신발이나 갑옷 등)도 시도하여 도둑질할 수 있습니다. 이를 위해 최소 1분(갑옷처럼 제거에 시간이 많이 걸리는 물건은 훨씬 더 오래) 동안 천천히 조심스럽게 행동해야 합니다. 이 시간 동안 어둠의 {숨기}나 북적이는 군중처럼 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태를 유지할 수단이 반드시 필요합니다. 성공하더라도, 풀 플레이트 갑옷처럼 매우 눈에 띄는 물건은 훔친 직후 주변인들이 사라진 것을 금방 알아챌 것입니다.

name: Vicious Fangs

description.value: You aim for your victim's prominent arteries. Your fangs Strike deals an additional 1d6 persistent bleed damage on a critical hit. At 14th level, the persistent bleed damage increases to 2d6, and at 20th level, the persistent bleed damage increases to 3d6.

_desc_en: You aim for your victim's prominent arteries. Your fangs Strike deals an additional 1d6 persistent bleed damage on a critical hit. At 14th level, the persistent bleed damage increases to 2d6, and at 20th level, the persistent bleed damage increases to 3d6.
_desc_ko: 당신은 희생자의 주요 동맥을 노린다. 치아 공격이 치명타를 기록할 경우 추가로 1d6 지속 출혈 피해를 입힌다. 14레벨에 도달하면 지속 출혈 피해가 2d6로 증가하며, 20레벨에 도달하면 3d6로 증가한다.

name: Get Used to Disappointment

description.value:
Requirements Your turn begins, and one target within 30 feet failed an attack roll or skill check against you on its last turn.

You capitalize on an opponent's failure with smug attitude and swagger, reminding them of the gap in skill between you and your opponent. You attempt to [[/act demoralize traits=bravado]] the opponent. Regardless of the result, the target becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your turn begins, and one target within 30 feet failed an attack roll or skill check against you on its last turn.

You capitalize on an opponent's failure with smug attitude and swagger, reminding them of the gap in skill between you and your opponent. You attempt to [[/act demoralize traits=bravado]] the opponent. Regardless of the result, the target becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신의 턴이 시작되고, 30피트 이내의 한 대상이 지난 턴에 당신을 상대로 한 명중 굴림이나 기술 판정에서 실패했습니다.

당신은 상대방의 실패를 교만한 태도와 거만한 걸음걸이로 이용하며, 당신과 상대방 사이의 실력 차이를 상기시킵니다. 당신은 상대방을 사기 꺾기하려고 시도합니다. 결과와 상관없이 대상은 1분 동안 일시적으로 면역 상태가 됩니다.

name: Hail of Splinters

description.value:
A fusillade of jagged splinters flies from you. Creatures in a @Template[cone|distance:30] take @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -1)/2)+1)d4[piercing],(floor((@actor.level -1)/2)+1)d4[persistent,bleed]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC.

Level (+2) Each type of damage increases by 1d4.

_desc_en:
A fusillade of jagged splinters flies from you. Creatures in a @Template[cone|distance:30] take @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -1)/2)+1)d4[piercing],(floor((@actor.level -1)/2)+1)d4[persistent,bleed]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC.

Level (+2) Each type of damage increases by 1d4.
_desc_ko:
당신에게서 날카로운 파편들이 쏟아져 나온다. 30피트 내의 생물들은 관통 지속적 출혈 피해를 입으며, 기본 반사 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 내성 굴림을 수행한다.

레벨 (+2) 각 피해 유형당 1d4씩 증가합니다.

name: Whirling Blade Stance

description.value:
You enter a mindful stance that creates a deep connection between you and your monk weapons, allowing you to manipulate them with your qi, even at a distance. All melee monk weapons you wield with the finesse trait gain the thrown 10 feet trait (unless they already have the thrown trait with a greater range).

Once you've made a thrown Strike with such a weapon, you can use the precision of your throw to make additional strikes with it, even from a distance. Start from the space of the previous Strike's target to determine the range increment and whether the new target has cover. At the end of your turn, the thrown weapon flies directly back to you in a straight line. If a solid barrier blocks its path, it falls to the ground after hitting the barrier.

_desc_en:
You enter a mindful stance that creates a deep connection between you and your monk weapons, allowing you to manipulate them with your qi, even at a distance. All melee monk weapons you wield with the finesse trait gain the thrown 10 feet trait (unless they already have the thrown trait with a greater range).

Once you've made a thrown Strike with such a weapon, you can use the precision of your throw to make additional strikes with it, even from a distance. Start from the space of the previous Strike's target to determine the range increment and whether the new target has cover. At the end of your turn, the thrown weapon flies directly back to you in a straight line. If a solid barrier blocks its path, it falls to the ground after hitting the barrier.
_desc_ko:
당신은 마음챙김 자세를 취해 자신과 몽크 무기 사이에 깊은 연결을 형성합니다. 이를 통해 기를 이용해 무기를 조종할 수 있으며, 거리에서 가능하기도 합니다. 당신이 기교 특성을 지닌 근접 몽크 무기를 휘두를 때, 해당 무기는 10피트 투척 특성을 얻습니다(이미 더 긴 사거리의 투척 특성을 가진 경우는 제외).

이러한 무기로 투척 공격을 한 후에는, 투척의 정확도를 이용해 거리에서도 추가 공격을 할 수 있습니다. 이전 공격 대상의 위치에서 시작하여 사거리 증가량과 새 대상의 엄폐 여부를 판단합니다. 당신의 턴이 끝날 때, 투척 무기는 직선으로 당신에게 바로 돌아옵니다. 단단한 장벽이 경로를 막으면 장벽에 부딪힌 후 땅에 떨어집니다.

name: Shadowplay

description.value:
Requirements Your last action was a melee Strike that damaged your opponent.

As your blow lands, you detach from your shadow to get the drop on your enemy. You attempt to [[/act tumble-through options=shadowplay]] the opponent's space, with a +2 circumstance bonus to the Acrobatics check. If you succeed, your shadow rises up from the ground, flanking your opponent until the beginning of your next turn.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Requirements Your last action was a melee Strike that damaged your opponent.

As your blow lands, you detach from your shadow to get the drop on your enemy. You attempt to [[/act tumble-through options=shadowplay]] the opponent's space, with a +2 circumstance bonus to the Acrobatics check. If you succeed, your shadow rises up from the ground, flanking your opponent until the beginning of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 마지막 행동이 상대에게 피해를 준 근접 공격이었어야 합니다.

타격이 적중하는 순간, 당신은 그림자에서 분리되어 적을 기습합니다. 당신은 회피 돌파 options=shadowplay로 상대방의 공간을 돌파하려 시도하며, 곡예 판정 시 +2 상황 보너스를 받습니다. 성공 시, 당신의 그림자가 지면에서 떠오르며 다음 턴 시작까지 적의 측면을 포위합니다.

name: Fresh Produce

description.value:
You grow a nourishing nut, vegetable, seed, or fruit. Choose a creature in your kinetic aura. The produce grows in their open hand, or at their feet if they have no open hands. The produce has light Bulk. A creature can eat it with an Interact action to regain @Damage[((floor((max(1,@actor.level)-1)/2)+1)d4+(floor((max(1,@actor.level)-1)/2)*5+1))[vitality,healing]] HP; this is a healing vitality effect. The creature feels full for 10 minutes, during which it has resistance 2 to void damage and can't eat another piece of produce. Produce not consumed by the start of your next turn withers away.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.2GWZgsvMJF9DN0DO]{Effect: Fresh Produce}

Level (+2) The healing increases by 1d4+5, and the resistance increases by 2.

_desc_en:
You grow a nourishing nut, vegetable, seed, or fruit. Choose a creature in your kinetic aura. The produce grows in their open hand, or at their feet if they have no open hands. The produce has light Bulk. A creature can eat it with an Interact action to regain @Damage[((floor((max(1,@actor.level)-1)/2)+1)d4+(floor((max(1,@actor.level)-1)/2)*5+1))[vitality,healing]] HP; this is a healing vitality effect. The creature feels full for 10 minutes, during which it has resistance 2 to void damage and can't eat another piece of produce. Produce not consumed by the start of your next turn withers away.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.2GWZgsvMJF9DN0DO]{Effect: Fresh Produce}

Level (+2) The healing increases by 1d4+5, and the resistance increases by 2.
_desc_ko:
영양가 있는 견과류, 채소, 씨앗 또는 과일을 재배합니다. 당신의 키네틱 오라 안에 있는 생물 하나를 선택하세요. 재배물은 그 생물의 열린 손바닥 위에서 자라나며, 열린 손바닥이 없다면 발밑에서 자랍니다. 이 생산물은 가벼운 벌크를 가집니다. 생물은 상호작용 행동으로 이를 먹어 활력 회복 HP를 회복할 수 있습니다. 이는 치유 활력 효과입니다. 생물은 10분 동안 포만감을 느끼며, 이 기간 동안 공허 피해에 대한 저항력 2를 얻고 다른 생산물을 먹을 수 없습니다. 다음 턴 시작 시까지 소비되지 않은 생산물은 시들어 사라집니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.2GWZgsvMJF9DN0DO]{효과: 신선한 농산물}

레벨 (+2) 치유량이 1d4+5 증가하고, 저항력이 2 증가합니다.

name: Aura of Vengeance

description.value: When you call upon others to take retribution, you also guide their aim. When you use Retributive Strike, your allies who make Strikes take only a -2 penalty, instead of a -5 penalty.

_desc_en: When you call upon others to take retribution, you also guide their aim. When you use Retributive Strike, your allies who make Strikes take only a -2 penalty, instead of a -5 penalty.
_desc_ko: 당신이 타인에게 보복을 촉구할 때, 그들의 목표도 함께 이끕니다. 당신이 보복의 일격을 사용할 때, 공격을 가하는 아군들은 -5 페널티 대신 -2 페널티만 받습니다.

name: Murderer's Circle

description.value: You Strike a target within reach and then Step to any other open space adjacent to that target. Your target is then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against your next Strike this turn.

_desc_en: You Strike a target within reach and then Step to any other open space adjacent to that target. Your target is then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against your next Strike this turn.
_desc_ko: 당신은 도달 범위 내의 대상을 공격한 후, 그 대상과 인접한 다른 빈 공간으로 이동합니다. 대상은 이번 턴 동안 당신의 다음 공격에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Repulse the Wicked

description.value:
Trigger An undead within your reach critically fails an attack roll targeting you.

You use your foe's failure as an opening to push them away. You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} the undead.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en:
Trigger An undead within your reach critically fails an attack roll targeting you.

You use your foe's failure as an opening to push them away. You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} the undead.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신의 손이 닿는 범위 내의 언데드가 당신을 대상으로 한 명중 굴림에 대실패를 합니다.

당신은 적의 실패를 틈타 그들을 밀쳐냅니다. 당신은 언데드를 @link[actions.shove]하려 시도합니다.

name: Landscape Form

description.value: While walking down the road on a moonlit night, one might be puzzled to find a shop or hill that wasn't there before. In reality, this is a tanuki at the height of their power. When you Change Shape, you can transform into a building or terrain feature up to 50 feet tall and up to 50 feet on a side. Mundane features of your landscape form function as normal—for instance, if you transform into a hot spring, the hot spring contains relaxing hot water, and if you transform into an inn, the inn contains bedrooms, beds, and delicious food—though no aspect of your landscape form can be an active hazard that can cause damage or impose conditions, and any objects created within your landscape form turn into leaves if taken outside of it. You can speak while in landscape form, but you can't attack, cast spells, or move. You can remain in landscape form for up to 8 hours, and when you exit landscape form, it dissolves around anyone who was inside of it.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: While walking down the road on a moonlit night, one might be puzzled to find a shop or hill that wasn't there before. In reality, this is a tanuki at the height of their power. When you Change Shape, you can transform into a building or terrain feature up to 50 feet tall and up to 50 feet on a side. Mundane features of your landscape form function as normal—for instance, if you transform into a hot spring, the hot spring contains relaxing hot water, and if you transform into an inn, the inn contains bedrooms, beds, and delicious food—though no aspect of your landscape form can be an active hazard that can cause damage or impose conditions, and any objects created within your landscape form turn into leaves if taken outside of it. You can speak while in landscape form, but you can't attack, cast spells, or move. You can remain in landscape form for up to 8 hours, and when you exit landscape form, it dissolves around anyone who was inside of it.
_desc_ko: 달빛이 비치는 밤길에 걷다 보면, 예전에 없던 가게나 언덕이 갑자기 나타나는 것을 보고 당황할 수도 있다. 사실 이는 전성기의 타누키다. 형태 변신 시 최대 높이 50피트, 한 변 길이 50피트 이내의 건물이나 지형으로 변할 수 있다. 지형 형태의 일상적 기능은 정상적으로 작동한다-예를 들어 온천으로 변신하면 온천에는 편안한 온수가 담겨 있고, 여관으로 변신하면 여관에는 침실과 침대, 맛있는 음식이 마련된다-다만 지형 형태의 어떤 부분도 피해를 주거나 상태 이상을 유발하는 능동적 위험 요소가 될 수 없으며, 지형 형태 내에서 생성된 물체는 그 밖으로 가져가면 나뭇잎으로 변한다. 경관 형태로 있을 때 말은 할 수 있지만, 공격하거나 주문을 시전하거나 이동할 수는 없습니다. 최대 8시간 동안 경관 형태를 유지할 수 있으며, 경관 형태에서 벗어나면 그 안에 있던 모든 이 주변에서 형태가 사라집니다.

name: Shorthanded

description.value: Typically, a siege weapon is meant to be run by a crew with a very specific minimum number of members designed to ensure that your crew can account for every possible variable and necessity in loading, aiming, and firing the weapon. In a pinch, however, you can operate it with fewer people, provided you know what you're doing. You can operate a siege weapon with fewer than the minimum number of crew, at an increasing penalty. You and your crew take a –2 penalty to checks to Load, Aim, Launch, move, or Repair the weapon for each person below the minimum crew. The maximum number of missing minimum crew members you can handle with this feat is 5. For example, if a siege weapon had a minimum crew size of 8, you would still need a crew of 3, and you would take a –10 penalty when doing so.

_desc_en: Typically, a siege weapon is meant to be run by a crew with a very specific minimum number of members designed to ensure that your crew can account for every possible variable and necessity in loading, aiming, and firing the weapon. In a pinch, however, you can operate it with fewer people, provided you know what you're doing. You can operate a siege weapon with fewer than the minimum number of crew, at an increasing penalty. You and your crew take a –2 penalty to checks to Load, Aim, Launch, move, or Repair the weapon for each person below the minimum crew. The maximum number of missing minimum crew members you can handle with this feat is 5. For example, if a siege weapon had a minimum crew size of 8, you would still need a crew of 3, and you would take a –10 penalty when doing so.
_desc_ko: 공성 무기는 일반적으로 탄약 장전, 조준, 발사 과정에서 발생할 수 있는 모든 변수와 필요 사항을 처리할 수 있도록 매우 구체적인 최소 인원으로 구성된 승무원이 운용하도록 설계되었습니다. 그러나 긴급 상황에서는 숙련된 인원이 적게 투입되어도 운용이 가능합니다. 공성 무기는 최소 승무원 수보다 적은 인원으로 운용할 수 있으나, 이에 따른 페널티가 증가합니다. 최소 승무원 수보다 부족한 인원당, 무기 장전, 조준, 발사, 이동 또는 수리 판정 시 당신과 승무원들은 -2 페널티를 받습니다. 이 피트로 처리 가능한 최소 승무원 부족 인원의 최대치는 5명이다. 예를 들어 공성 무기의 최소 승무원 수가 8명인 경우, 3명의 승무원만으로도 운용할 수 있으나 이 경우 -10 페널티를 받는다.

name: Burrowing Form

description.value: Your eidolon can burrow through loose dirt. Your eidolon gains a burrow Speed of 15 feet.

_desc_en: Your eidolon can burrow through loose dirt. Your eidolon gains a burrow Speed of 15 feet.
_desc_ko: 당신의 에이돌론은 느슨한 흙 속을 파고들 수 있습니다. 에이돌론은 15피트의 파고들기 속도를 얻습니다.

name: Sever Magic

description.value:
Requirements You're holding an implement.

You apply a frayed thread, a pinch of fulu ash, or a similar undone charm to your weapon, and swing to break a spell. Make a Strike against an enemy. If you hit and deal damage, you attempt to counteract a single spell active on the target (your choice). Your counteract rank is equal to half your level (rounded up), and your counteract check modifier is equal to your class DC - 10.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're holding an implement.

You apply a frayed thread, a pinch of fulu ash, or a similar undone charm to your weapon, and swing to break a spell. Make a Strike against an enemy. If you hit and deal damage, you attempt to counteract a single spell active on the target (your choice). Your counteract rank is equal to half your level (rounded up), and your counteract check modifier is equal to your class DC - 10.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 도구를 들고 있어야 합니다.

너는 무기에 닳은 실, 풀루 재 한 꼬집 또는 비슷한 풀린 부적을 바르고, 마법을 깨기 위해 휘두른다. 적에게 강타를 시도한다. 명중하여 피해를 입히면, 대상에게 걸린 마법 중 하나(네가 선택)를 반격하려 시도하다. 반격 등급은 레벨의 절반(올림)이며, 반격 판정 수정자는 직업 DC - 10이다.

name: Pluck from the Sky

description.value:
Access tengu, strix, or awakened animal (flying animal) ancestry

The skies are your rightful place, and you will not suffer another to occupy them. Make a Strike against a flying creature. If the attack deals damage, the target must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class] save against your class DC.

Critical Success No effect.

Success The target falls 15 feet but doesn't take damage if it reaches the ground.

Failure The target falls 30 feet but doesn't take damage if it reaches the ground.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target takes falling damage.

_desc_en:
Access tengu, strix, or awakened animal (flying animal) ancestry

The skies are your rightful place, and you will not suffer another to occupy them. Make a Strike against a flying creature. If the attack deals damage, the target must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class] save against your class DC.

Critical Success No effect.

Success The target falls 15 feet but doesn't take damage if it reaches the ground.

Failure The target falls 30 feet but doesn't take damage if it reaches the ground.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target takes falling damage.
_desc_ko:
접근 텐구, 스트릭스, 또는 각성한 동물(비행 동물) 혈통

하늘은 당신의 정당한 영역이며, 다른 이가 이를 차지하는 것을 용납하지 않습니다. 비행 생물에게 공격을 가하십시오. 공격이 피해를 입히면, 대상은 당신의 직업 DC(DC)에 대한 반사 저항 검사를 시도해야 합니다.

대성공효과 없음.

성공 대상은 15피트 떨어지지만 지면에 닿으면 피해를 입지 않습니다.

실패 대상은 30피트 떨어지지만 지면에 닿으면 피해를 입지 않는다.

대실패 실패와 동일하나, 대상은 추락 피해를 입는다.

name: Enjoy the Show

description.value:
You address an ally or any onlookers to your combat, flaunting to your foes how little attention they require. When you @Check[performance|traits:action:perform,bravado]{Perform}, you can choose single creature within 30 feet and use the following success, critical success, and critical failure effects instead of the normal results; if you do, Perform gains the bravado trait, as well as the auditory and linguistic trait as normal for oration.

Critical Success The target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls against creatures other than you until the end of its next turn.

Success The target takes a –1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls against creatures other then you until the end of its next turn.

Critical Failure The target gains a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls targeting you until the end of its next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.4USRFNH06dwOlgL5]{Effect: Enjoy the Show}

_desc_en:
You address an ally or any onlookers to your combat, flaunting to your foes how little attention they require. When you @Check[performance|traits:action:perform,bravado]{Perform}, you can choose single creature within 30 feet and use the following success, critical success, and critical failure effects instead of the normal results; if you do, Perform gains the bravado trait, as well as the auditory and linguistic trait as normal for oration.

Critical Success The target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls against creatures other than you until the end of its next turn.

Success The target takes a –1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls against creatures other then you until the end of its next turn.

Critical Failure The target gains a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls targeting you until the end of its next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.4USRFNH06dwOlgL5]{Effect: Enjoy the Show}
_desc_ko:
당신은 아군이나 전투를 지켜보는 이들에게 말을 걸며, 적들에게 그들이 얼마나 신경 쓸 가치가 없는 존재인지 과시합니다. 당신이 공연 시, 30피트 내의 단일 생물을 선택하여 일반 결과 대신 다음 성공, 대성공, 대실패 효과를 사용할 수 있다. 이때 공연에는 브라바도와 함께 연설의 청각 및 언어 특성이 정상적으로 부여된다.

대성공 대상은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 당신 이외의 생물에게 명중 굴림에서 -2 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

성공 대상은 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 당신 이외의 생물에게 명중 굴림에 -1 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

대실패 대상은 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 당신을 대상으로 하는 명중 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.4USRFNH06dwOlgL5]{효과: 쇼를 즐겨라}

name: Lifeblood's Call

description.value: The impulse to survive and continue fighting resonates deep within you. You gain a circumstance bonus to damage rolls on your melee Strikes equal to twice the sum of your wounded and doomed conditions (to a maximum of a +8 circumstance bonus to damage) whenever you have one or both conditions.

_desc_en: The impulse to survive and continue fighting resonates deep within you. You gain a circumstance bonus to damage rolls on your melee Strikes equal to twice the sum of your wounded and doomed conditions (to a maximum of a +8 circumstance bonus to damage) whenever you have one or both conditions.
_desc_ko: 생존하고 계속 싸우려는 임펄스가 네 마음 깊은 곳에서 울려 퍼진다. 네가 부상 상태나 죽음 직전 상태 중 하나 또는 둘 다를 가질 때마다, 근접 공격의 피해 주사위 굴림에 부상 상태와 죽음 직전 상태의 피해 감소 합계의 두 배에 해당하는 상황 보너스(최대 +8)를 얻는다.

name: Felling Shot

description.value:
Your ranged attacks can shoot an unprepared foe right out of the air. Make a ranged Strike against an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creature. If the Strike is a success and deals damage, the target must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:rogue] save against your class DC.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target falls up to 120 feet. If it hits the ground, it takes no damage from the fall.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target can't fly, jump, levitate, or otherwise leave the ground until the end of your next turn.

_desc_en:
Your ranged attacks can shoot an unprepared foe right out of the air. Make a ranged Strike against an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creature. If the Strike is a success and deals damage, the target must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:rogue] save against your class DC.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target falls up to 120 feet. If it hits the ground, it takes no damage from the fall.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target can't fly, jump, levitate, or otherwise leave the ground until the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
당신의 원거리 공격은 준비되지 않은 적을 공중에서 바로 격추시킬 수 있습니다. @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태의 생물에게 원거리 강타를 가하십시오. 강타가 성공하여 피해를 입히면, 대상은 당신의 직업 DC에 대한 반사 내성 굴림을 시도해야 합니다.

성공 시 대상은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

실패 대상은 최대 120피트 높이까지 떨어집니다. 지면에 충돌하더라도 낙하로 인한 피해를 입지 않습니다.

대실패 실패와 동일하며, 대상은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 비행, 점프, 공중부양 또는 기타 방법으로 지면을 떠날 수 없습니다.

name: Mortal Possibility

description.value: You made yourself into a paragon of mortality and prove that deities aren't needed to achieve greatness. Choose a skill you have master proficiency in. You become legendary in that skill. In addition, you gain a skill feat of your choice for that skill. The first time each day that you succeed at a skill check with that skill, you gain a +3 status bonus to your next skill check of any skill within the next hour.

_desc_en: You made yourself into a paragon of mortality and prove that deities aren't needed to achieve greatness. Choose a skill you have master proficiency in. You become legendary in that skill. In addition, you gain a skill feat of your choice for that skill. The first time each day that you succeed at a skill check with that skill, you gain a +3 status bonus to your next skill check of any skill within the next hour.
_desc_ko: 당신은 스스로를 필멸자의 귀감으로 만들어, 위대함을 이루는 데 신이 필요치 않음을 증명합니다. 당신이 달인 숙련도를 지닌 기술 하나를 선택합니다. 당신은 그 기술에서 전설이 됩니다. 또한 당신은 그 기술에 대해 원하는 기술 재주 하나를 얻습니다. 매일 처음으로 그 기술로 기술 판정에 성공할 때, 당신은 다음 한 시간 안에 시도하는 다음번 아무 기술 판정에 +3 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Heart of Earth

description.value: The earth parts to allow you passage. You gain a burrow Speed of 15 feet. While burrowing, your tremorsense becomes precise up to 15 feet. When you Burrow, you can choose to leave behind a tunnel of your size or smaller for others to traverse through.

_desc_en: The earth parts to allow you passage. You gain a burrow Speed of 15 feet. While burrowing, your tremorsense becomes precise up to 15 feet. When you Burrow, you can choose to leave behind a tunnel of your size or smaller for others to traverse through.
_desc_ko: 대지가 갈라져 당신에게 길을 내줍니다. 당신은 15피트의 굴착 속도를 얻습니다. 굴착하는 동안, 당신의 진동감지는 15피트까지 정밀해집니다. 굴착할 때, 당신은 다른 이들이 통과할 수 있도록 당신 크기 이하의 터널을 뒤에 남길 수 있습니다.

name: Quick Identification

description.value: You can Identify Magic swiftly. You take only 1 minute when using Identify Magic to determine the properties of an item, ongoing effect, or location, rather than 10 minutes. If you're a master, it takes a 3-action activity, and if you're legendary, it takes 1 action.

value.value: trained in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion

_desc_en: You can Identify Magic swiftly. You take only 1 minute when using Identify Magic to determine the properties of an item, ongoing effect, or location, rather than 10 minutes. If you're a master, it takes a 3-action activity, and if you're legendary, it takes 1 action.
_desc_ko: 마법 식별을 신속하게 수행할 수 있습니다. 마법 식별을 사용하여 아이템, 지속 효과 또는 위치의 속성을 판단할 때 10분이 아닌 1분만 소요됩니다. 마스터라면 3-액션 활동이 소요되며, 전설적인 마스터라면 1-액션이 소요됩니다.

name: High Alert

description.value:
You're constantly on guard, keeping watch over your allies against fiendish forces—no one can get the jump on your group while you're around. Choose an ally you can see within 30 feet. They gain a +1 circumstance bonus to their AC and Reflex saving throws against devils and creatures allied with the Chelaxian government (as determined by the GM) until the beginning of your next turn. This action gains the visual trait, the auditory trait, or both, depending on how you alert your ally.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.FlwmvnPH3Fu62hTE]{Effect: High Alert}

_desc_en:
You're constantly on guard, keeping watch over your allies against fiendish forces—no one can get the jump on your group while you're around. Choose an ally you can see within 30 feet. They gain a +1 circumstance bonus to their AC and Reflex saving throws against devils and creatures allied with the Chelaxian government (as determined by the GM) until the beginning of your next turn. This action gains the visual trait, the auditory trait, or both, depending on how you alert your ally.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.FlwmvnPH3Fu62hTE]{Effect: High Alert}
_desc_ko:
당신은 끊임없이 경계 태세를 유지하며 악마의 세력으로부터 아군을 감시합니다. 당신이 곁에 있는 한 누구도 당신 무리를 기습할 수 없습니다. 30피트 내에 당신이 볼 수 있는 아군 하나를 선택합니다. 그들은 당신의 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 악마 및 첼리아스 정부와 동맹한 존재(GM이 판단)에 대해 AC와 반사 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 행동은 당신이 아군에게 경고하는 방식에 따라 시각 특성, 청각 특성, 또는 둘 다를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.FlwmvnPH3Fu62hTE]{효과: 고도 경계}

name: Dire Growth

description.value: You transform into a primal reflection of your animal shape. If you aren't already in your animal shape from Werecreature Dedication, you Change Shape into it. As long as you stay in animal shape, you have the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge}.

value.value: your animal shape is not Small

_desc_en: You transform into a primal reflection of your animal shape. If you aren't already in your animal shape from Werecreature Dedication, you Change Shape into it. As long as you stay in animal shape, you have the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge}.
_desc_ko: 당신은 동물 형태의 프라이멀 반영으로 변신합니다. 늑대인간 헌신으로 이미 동물 형태가 아닌 경우, 그 형태로 변신합니다. 동물 형태를 유지하는 동안 @link[spells.enlarge] 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Legendary Size

description.value: The vanaras of old were tricksters able to step across wide rivers or slip into impossibly small spaces. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PjhUmyKnq6K5uDby]{Shrink} once per day each as 2nd-rank divine innate spells. You can target only yourself and other vanaras with these spells.

_desc_en: The vanaras of old were tricksters able to step across wide rivers or slip into impossibly small spaces. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PjhUmyKnq6K5uDby]{Shrink} once per day each as 2nd-rank divine innate spells. You can target only yourself and other vanaras with these spells.
_desc_ko: 옛 바나라들은 넓은 강을 건너거나 불가능해 보이는 좁은 공간으로 스며들 수 있는 사기꾼들이었다. 당신은 하루에 한 번씩 @link[spells.enlarge]와 @link[spells.shrink]를 (2nd)랭크 신성 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 마법들은 오직 자신과 다른 바나라만을 대상으로 할 수 있습니다.

name: Avoid Fate's Gaze

description.value: Your past and current enemies may know you by reputation, but spying on you with magic is much more difficult. Whenever you attempt a saving throw against a scrying or effect, you do so at mythic proficiency. Scrying effects that attempt to observe you that don't allow saving throws to resist (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HXhWYJviWalN5tQ2]{Clairaudience} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zvKWclOZ7A53DObE]{Clairvoyance}) treat you as if you were @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} and actively trying to Hide or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} unless they are mythic as well.

publication.title: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

_desc_en: Your past and current enemies may know you by reputation, but spying on you with magic is much more difficult. Whenever you attempt a saving throw against a scrying or effect, you do so at mythic proficiency. Scrying effects that attempt to observe you that don't allow saving throws to resist (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HXhWYJviWalN5tQ2]{Clairaudience} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zvKWclOZ7A53DObE]{Clairvoyance}) treat you as if you were @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} and actively trying to Hide or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} unless they are mythic as well.
_desc_ko: 과거와 현재의 적들이 소문으로 당신을 알고 있을 수는 있지만, 마법으로 당신을 감시하는 것은 훨씬 더 어렵습니다. 당신이 정찰 효과에 대해 내성 굴림을 시도할 때마다, 신화 숙련도로 시도합니다. 당신을 관찰하려 시도하되 저항할 내성 굴림을 허용하지 않는 정찰 효과(@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HXhWYJviWalN5tQ2]{클레어오디언스}나 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zvKWclOZ7A53DObE]{클레어보이언스} 등)는, 그것이 신화급이 아닌 한, 당신을 마치 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{은폐} 상태이며 적극적으로 숨기 또는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{은밀 이동}을 시도하고 있는 것처럼 취급합니다.

name: Swift Sneak

description.value: You can move your full Speed when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}. You can use Swift Sneak while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

_desc_en: You can move your full Speed when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}. You can use Swift Sneak while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.
_desc_ko: @link[actions.sneak] 시 최대 이동 속도로 이동할 수 있다. 해당 이동 유형을 보유한 경우, 땅파기, 등반, 비행, 수영 시에도 '신속한 은신'을 '이동' 대신 사용할 수 있다.

name: Shared Mind, Shared Heart

description.value: Your thoughts and dreams are your student's thoughts and dreams, and vice versa. You develop a permanent mental connection, allowing you to communicate telepathically as long as you're on the same plane. When one of you fails a save against a mental effect, the other can choose to take the results of the failed save instead. If both of you are targeted by the same mental effect requiring a saving throw, you and your student take the better of each of your die rolls for the save. You each still add your own save modifier to the die result. This is a fortune effect.

_desc_en: Your thoughts and dreams are your student's thoughts and dreams, and vice versa. You develop a permanent mental connection, allowing you to communicate telepathically as long as you're on the same plane. When one of you fails a save against a mental effect, the other can choose to take the results of the failed save instead. If both of you are targeted by the same mental effect requiring a saving throw, you and your student take the better of each of your die rolls for the save. You each still add your own save modifier to the die result. This is a fortune effect.
_desc_ko: 당신의 생각과 꿈은 제자의 생각과 꿈이 되며, 그 반대도 마찬가지입니다. 영구적인 정신적 연결이 형성되어 같은 차원에 있는 한 텔레파시로 소통할 수 있습니다. 둘 중 한 명이 정신 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 실패하면, 다른 한 명이 대신 그 실패한 검사 결과를 감수할 수 있습니다. 둘 다 동일한 정신 효과의 대상이 되어 내성 굴림을 해야 할 경우, 당신과 제자는 각자의 내성 굴림 굴림 중 더 좋은 결과를 적용합니다. 각자 자신의 내성 수정자를 내성 굴림 굴림에 추가합니다. 이는 행운 효과입니다.

name: Web Hunter

description.value: Through the careful cultivation of highly sensitive hairs, you've developed the ability to sense creatures without seeing them. You gain imprecise tremorsense at a range of 15 feet. When you and a creature are both touching the same anchored, threadlike object (such as a rope, webbing, or wire), your imprecise tremorsense can sense that creature at a range of 60 feet.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: Through the careful cultivation of highly sensitive hairs, you've developed the ability to sense creatures without seeing them. You gain imprecise tremorsense at a range of 15 feet. When you and a creature are both touching the same anchored, threadlike object (such as a rope, webbing, or wire), your imprecise tremorsense can sense that creature at a range of 60 feet.
_desc_ko: 극도로 민감한 털을 정교하게 발달시켜, 당신은 보이지 않는 생물을 감지하는 능력을 얻었습니다. 15피트 범위 내에서 부정확한 진동 감지 능력을 얻습니다. 당신과 다른 생물이 동일한 고정된 실 모양의 물체(예: 밧줄, 거미줄, 철사)에 접촉하고 있을 때, 부정확한 진동 감지 능력으로 60피트 범위 내의 그 생물을 감지할 수 있습니다.

name: Finest Trick

description.value: Many fiends—rakshasa rajas and demonic succubi most famously—can take on the forms of others. With practice, you can do the same. When you use Devil in Plain Sight, you can alter your appearance to match a generic member of your base ancestry, rather than one that's obviously you without your tieflings features. In addition, you can imitate a specific person's appearance (of any ancestry of the same size and kind as your base ancestry, typically a humanoid for most ancestries) if you consume a bit of their blood, a lock of their hair, or appropriate equivalents as part of the action. You still must know what the creature looks like, and you must be aware that the consumed portion comes from their body.

_desc_en: Many fiends—rakshasa rajas and demonic succubi most famously—can take on the forms of others. With practice, you can do the same. When you use Devil in Plain Sight, you can alter your appearance to match a generic member of your base ancestry, rather than one that's obviously you without your tieflings features. In addition, you can imitate a specific person's appearance (of any ancestry of the same size and kind as your base ancestry, typically a humanoid for most ancestries) if you consume a bit of their blood, a lock of their hair, or appropriate equivalents as part of the action. You still must know what the creature looks like, and you must be aware that the consumed portion comes from their body.
_desc_ko: 라크샤사 라자스나 악마 수쿠비처럼 많은 핀드들은 타인의 모습을 취할 수 있습니다. 연습을 통해 당신도 같은 능력을 발휘할 수 있습니다. '눈앞의 데빌'을 사용할 때, 티플링의 특징이 없는 당신의 기본 혈통에 속하는 평범한 구성원의 모습으로 외형을 바꿀 수 있습니다. 또한, 행동의 일부로 특정 인물의 피 한 방울, 머리카락 한 올 또는 이에 상응하는 물건을 섭취하면 그 인물의 외모를 모방할 수 있다(기본 조상 및 크기 및 종류가 동일한 조상, 대부분의 조상에서는 일반적으로 인간형). 해당 생물의 외모를 알고 있어야 하며, 섭취한 부분이 그 생물의 신체에서 나온 것임을 인지해야 한다.

name: Ironblood Surge

description.value:
Requirements You are in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.x9cYkB8DrUBBwqJd]{Ironblood Stance}

You steel yourself, preparing to resist oncoming attacks and using your muscles to absorb the impact.

You gain the benefits of your iron sweep's parry trait (a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn) and your resistance from Ironblood Stance increases to your Strength modifier (if it's higher) for the same duration.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.x9cYkB8DrUBBwqJd]{Ironblood Stance}

You steel yourself, preparing to resist oncoming attacks and using your muscles to absorb the impact.

You gain the benefits of your iron sweep's parry trait (a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn) and your resistance from Ironblood Stance increases to your Strength modifier (if it's higher) for the same duration.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 @link[feats.ironblood-stance]

상태에 있습니다.

당신은 다가오는 공격을 견디기 위해 마음을 다잡고, 근육을 이용해 충격을 흡수합니다.

당신은 철의 쓸기 기술의 패리 특성 효과(+1 상황 보너스, 다음 턴 시작까지 지속)를 얻으며, 철혈의 자세로 인한 저항력이 동일한 지속 시간 동안 근력 능력치 수정자(더 높을 경우)까지 증가합니다.

name: Executioner Weapon Training

description.value:
Your Gray Gardener training has made you deeply skilled with the weapons that execute with a swift chop to the neck. You become trained with the following weapons: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.War0uyLBx1jA0Ge7]{Battle Axe}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.XGtIUZ4ZNKuFx1uL]{Falchion}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.8COlYvHe6hKCXY8x]{Greataxe}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.grmaV4GdoGD7sKbn]{Scimitar}.

Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency with a given weapon or weapons, you also gain that proficiency for these weapons.

회색 정원사 훈련을 통해 목을 재빠르게 베어 처형하는 무기에 능숙해졌습니다. 다음 무기에 숙련됩니다: @link[equipment.battle-axe], @link[equipment.falchion], @link[equipment.greataxe], @link[equipment.scimitar].

특정 무기나 무기들에 대해 전문가 이상의 숙련도를 부여하는 클래스 특성을 획득할 때마다, 이 무기들에 대해서도 동일한 숙련도를 획득합니다.

name: Startling Appearance (Fleshwarp)

description.value: You are trained in Intimidation (or another skill of your choice, if you were already trained in Intimidation) and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xQMz6eDgX75WX2ce]{Intimidating Glare} skill feat as a bonus feat.

_desc_ko: 위협(혹은 위협에 이미 숙련된 경우 선택한 다른 기술)에 숙련되며, 보너스 피트로 @link[feats.intimidating-glare] 기술 재주를 얻습니다.

name: Exultant Blood Magic

description.value: The magic in your blood sings an exultant song of battle. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#master-spellcasting-feat]{master spellcasting} benefits. Increase the spell slots you gain from the bloodrager archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank. In addition, when you Cast a Spell from your repertoire and you are at least @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}, double the extra damage dealt by that spell from Rage instead.

name: Catfolk Dance

description.value:

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.5bEnBqVOgdp4gROP]{Effect: Catfolk Dance}

Success The target creature gains a -2 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves until the start of your next turn.

다른 생물이 움직이려 할 때 항상 방해하는 습관이 있습니다. 인접한 생물의 반사 DC에 대해 곡예 판정을 시도하십시오.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.5bEnBqVOgdp4gROP]{효과: 캣포크의 춤}

성공 대상 생물은 다음 차례 시작까지 반사 내성에 -2 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Captivator Dedication

description.value:
Your ability to captivate others borders on the preternatural. You are seldom at a loss in social situations, and you can create minor enchantments or illusions. Choose Deception or Diplomacy. You become trained in that skill, or become an expert if you were already trained.

Choose two cantrips from the occult list; each cantrip must be from either the enchantment or illusion school. You gain access to the Cast a Spell activity and can cast these spells as occult innate spells. You're trained in occult spell attack rolls and spell DCs. If you have a hand free, you can usually replace material components with somatic components, so you don't need to use a spell component pouch. Your key spellcasting ability for these spells is Charisma.
