@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.BXfE7LbUyoJbIQBT]{Nidalese Horselord}
_desc_ko:
접근 당신은 니달 출신입니다.

당신의 니달 말과 나누는 깊은 유대 덕분에, 두 사람은 놀라운 능력을 얻습니다. 두 사람 모두 암시야와 어둠 또는 그림자 특성을 지닌 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 당신 말의 속도도 5피트 증가합니다.

당신은 다음의 교리와 금기를 얻습니다.

교리 가능한 곳에서 그늘 궁정의 세력에 맞서라, 어둠 속에서 고통받는 이들에게 위안을 주어라

금기 당신의 말을 학대하는 것, 존-쿠손을 숭배하거나 존-쿠손을 숭배하는 자들과 영구적으로 동맹하는 것

특수 당신이 이미 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.5Q69PI8jdQVkb1ZT]{기병 헌신} 재주를 취했다면 니달 기마군주의 대의에 헌신을 맹세할 수 있으며, 추가 기병 재주 두 개를 취하지 않았더라도 이 헌신 재주를 취할 수 있습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.BXfE7LbUyoJbIQBT]{니달 기마군주}

name: Waters of Creation

description.value: Water is the source of life, and you draw upon this primordial force to heal your allies' wounds. A gentle ring ripples out from you in a @Template[emanation|distance:15], restoring @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))d6[healing,vitality]|shortLabel:true] Hit Points to creatures in the area. At 12th level and every two levels thereafter, the amount restored increases by 1d6. If you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zXZjC8HLaRoLR17U]{Cursebound 3} when you use Waters of Creation, the amount healed increases to @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))d8[healing,vitality]|shortLabel:true].

_desc_en: Water is the source of life, and you draw upon this primordial force to heal your allies' wounds. A gentle ring ripples out from you in a @Template[emanation|distance:15], restoring @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))d6[healing,vitality]|shortLabel:true] Hit Points to creatures in the area. At 12th level and every two levels thereafter, the amount restored increases by 1d6. If you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zXZjC8HLaRoLR17U]{Cursebound 3} when you use Waters of Creation, the amount healed increases to @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))d8[healing,vitality]|shortLabel:true].
_desc_ko: 물은 생명의 근원이며, 당신은 이 원초적인 힘을 빌려 아군의 상처를 치유합니다. 당신으로부터 15피트 반경으로 부드러운 물결이 퍼져나가, 해당 영역 내 생물들의 회복 활력 HP를 회복시킵니다. 12레벨과 그 이후 2레벨마다 치유량이 1d6 증가합니다. 창조수의 물을 사용할 때 @link[conditions.cursebound]{3} 상태라면 치유량이 회복 활력로 증가합니다.

name: Shameless Request

description.value: You can downplay the consequences or outrageousness of your requests using sheer brazenness and charm. When you Request something, you reduce any DC increases for making an outrageous request by 2, and if you roll a critical failure for your Request, you get a failure instead. While this means you can never cause your target to reduce their attitude toward you by making a Request, they eventually tire of requests, even though they still have a positive attitude toward you.

_desc_en: You can downplay the consequences or outrageousness of your requests using sheer brazenness and charm. When you Request something, you reduce any DC increases for making an outrageous request by 2, and if you roll a critical failure for your Request, you get a failure instead. While this means you can never cause your target to reduce their attitude toward you by making a Request, they eventually tire of requests, even though they still have a positive attitude toward you.
_desc_ko: 당신은 뻔뻔함과 매력으로 요구의 결과나 터무니없음을 축소할 수 있습니다. 요청을 할 때, 터무니없는 요청으로 인한 DC 증가치를 2 감소시킵니다. 또한 요청에 대실패를 굴렸을 경우, 실패로 처리됩니다. 이는 요청으로 인해 대상이 당신에 대한 태도를 낮추게 할 수 없음을 의미하지만, 대상은 여전히 당신에게 긍정적인 태도를 유지하면서도 결국 요청에 지치게 됩니다.

name: Watchful Gaze

description.value: You use your many eyes to look in all directions at once, making you extremely observant for a short period of time. You gain All-Around Vision until the start of your next turn. This lets you see in all directions and prevents you from being flanked.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: You use your many eyes to look in all directions at once, making you extremely observant for a short period of time. You gain All-Around Vision until the start of your next turn. This lets you see in all directions and prevents you from being flanked.
_desc_ko: 여러 개의 눈으로 동시에 사방 주위를 살피며, 짧은 시간 동안 극도로 예민해집니다. 다음 차례 시작까지 전방위 시야를 얻습니다. 이로 인해 사방이 모두 보이고 측면 공격을 당하지 않습니다.

name: Divine Declaration

description.value: You can call forth a holy or unholy word from the realms beyond to punish your foes. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sX2o0HH4RjJDAZ8C]{Divine Decree} as a 7th-rank divine innate spell.

_desc_en: You can call forth a holy or unholy word from the realms beyond to punish your foes. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sX2o0HH4RjJDAZ8C]{Divine Decree} as a 7th-rank divine innate spell.
_desc_ko: 당신은 저 너머의 영역에서 신성한 또는 불경한 말씀을 불러내 적을 벌할 수 있다. 하루에 한 번, 당신은 @link[spells.divine-decree]을 (7th)랭크 신성 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있다.

name: Masquerade of Seasons Stance

description.value: You have mastered the opening steps to the Masquerade of Seasons, a dance that channels the power of spring, summer, winter, and autumn. Choose one of the following traits: water, fire, void, or cold. You gain resistance 5 to damage dealt by effects with the chosen trait. You can use an action to reenter this stance at any time, changing the granted resistance to another of the available options. If you are at least 12th level, the granted resistance increases to be equal to half your level.

_desc_en: You have mastered the opening steps to the Masquerade of Seasons, a dance that channels the power of spring, summer, winter, and autumn. Choose one of the following traits: water, fire, void, or cold. You gain resistance 5 to damage dealt by effects with the chosen trait. You can use an action to reenter this stance at any time, changing the granted resistance to another of the available options. If you are at least 12th level, the granted resistance increases to be equal to half your level.
_desc_ko: 당신은 봄, 여름, 겨울, 가을의 힘을 끌어내는 춤인 계절의 가면무도회의 초보 단계를 마스터했습니다. 다음 특성 중 하나를 선택하세요: 물, 불, 공허, 또는 냉기. 선택한 속성을 지닌 효과로 입는 피해에 대해 저항력 5를 얻습니다. 언제든지 행동을 사용해 이 자세로 재진입할 수 있으며, 부여된 저항력 을 다른 선택 가능한 옵션으로 변경할 수 있습니다. 12레벨 이상일 경우 부여된 저항력은 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 수치로 증가합니다.

name: Green Dash

description.value:
Frequency Once per 10 minutes

Requirements You're adjacent to a tree, shrub, or plant that occupies at least a 5-foot square.

The spirits of vegetation send you on your way, letting you move in a burst of speed. You Stride with a +15-foot status bonus to your Speed. You can Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead if you have the corresponding movement type.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Frequency Once per 10 minutes

Requirements You're adjacent to a tree, shrub, or plant that occupies at least a 5-foot square.

The spirits of vegetation send you on your way, letting you move in a burst of speed. You Stride with a +15-foot status bonus to your Speed. You can Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead if you have the corresponding movement type.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 10분에 한 번

요구 사항 최소 5칸 정사각형 공간을 차지하는 나무, 관목 또는 식물과 인접해 있어야 합니다.

식물의 영혼들이 당신을 보내주어, 순간적으로 빠르게 이동하게 합니다. 당신은 이동 속도에 +15피트 상태 보너스를 받고 일반 이동으로 이동합니다. 해당 이동 유형을 가진 경우, 땅파기, 등반, 비행 또는 수영으로 대체할 수 있습니다.

name: Coral Reserve

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.

Your coral symbiotes provide a store of energy that you can call upon when needed. You suppress your enfeebled or fatigued condition. (If you're affected by both, choose one to suppress.) After 1 minute, the condition returns with any remaining duration it had when you suppressed it.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.

Your coral symbiotes provide a store of energy that you can call upon when needed. You suppress your enfeebled or fatigued condition. (If you're affected by both, choose one to suppress.) After 1 minute, the condition returns with any remaining duration it had when you suppressed it.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

요구 사항 당신은 @link[conditions.enfeebled] 상태이거나 @link[conditions.fatigued] 상태입니다.

당신의 산호 공생체는 필요할 때 사용할 수 있는 에너지 저장고를 제공합니다. 당신은 약화된 상태나 피로 상태를 억제합니다. (두 상태 모두에 걸렸다면, 하나를 선택하여 억제합니다.) 1분 후, 억제했을 때 남은 지속 시간이 있는 상태는 다시 돌아옵니다.

name: Horselord's Bond

description.value: Your bond with your horse becomes supernaturally strong as the two of you continue your crusade against Zon-Kuthon's dominion. You and your horse gain greater darkvision. In addition, when your horse succeeds at a save against effects that would cause the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} condition, it gets a critical success instead.

_desc_en: Your bond with your horse becomes supernaturally strong as the two of you continue your crusade against Zon-Kuthon's dominion. You and your horse gain greater darkvision. In addition, when your horse succeeds at a save against effects that would cause the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} condition, it gets a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신과 말이 존-쿠손의 지배에 맞선 성전을 이어가면서, 당신의 말과의 유대가 초자연적으로 강해집니다. 당신과 당신의 말은 상위 암시야를 얻습니다. 또한, 당신의 말이 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{혼란}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{지배됨}, 또는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{매혹} 상태를 유발하는 효과에 대한 내성에 성공할 때, 대신 대성공을 거둡니다.

name: Scour the Library

description.value: Seeing an enemy's attack, you quickly consult multiple scraps of lore in your mind, synthesizing them into the perfect plan. Make a check to Recall Knowledge (using an appropriate skill) about one creature within 60 feet. On a success, in addition to the normal benefits, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll against that creature and to your AC against the creature's next attack. On a critical success, the bonuses are +2.

_desc_en: Seeing an enemy's attack, you quickly consult multiple scraps of lore in your mind, synthesizing them into the perfect plan. Make a check to Recall Knowledge (using an appropriate skill) about one creature within 60 feet. On a success, in addition to the normal benefits, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll against that creature and to your AC against the creature's next attack. On a critical success, the bonuses are +2.
_desc_ko: 적의 공격을 목격하자마자, 당신은 머릿속에 저장된 여러 지식 조각들을 재빨리 참조하여 완벽한 계획을 수립합니다. 60피트 이내의 한 생물에 대한 지식 회상(적절한 기술 사용) 판정을 수행하세요. 성공 시, 일반적인 효과에 더해 해당 생물체에 대한 다음 명중 굴림과 그 생물체의 다음 공격에 대한 AC에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 대성공 시 보너스는 +2입니다.

name: Wide Overwatch

description.value: Through a variety of perceptive techniques, careful routines, and upgrades to your enhanced visual gear, you have become able to observe and maintain your overwatch at a much greater distance. Increase the size of your overwatch field from 30 feet to 60 feet.

_desc_en: Through a variety of perceptive techniques, careful routines, and upgrades to your enhanced visual gear, you have become able to observe and maintain your overwatch at a much greater distance. Increase the size of your overwatch field from 30 feet to 60 feet.
_desc_ko: 다양한 지각 기술, 세심한 루틴, 그리고 강화된 시각 장비의 업그레이드를 통해, 당신은 훨씬 더 먼 거리에서 관측 및 감시를 유지할 수 있게 되었습니다. 감시 범위를 30피트에서 60피트로 확대합니다.

name: Terrain Scout

description.value: You have mastered movement in many different environments. You gain the Terrain Stalker skill feat twice, choosing a different terrain each time. If you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice} while exploring and any allies use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tfa4Sh7wcxCEqL29]{Follow the Expert} to follow you as you do so, you can choose one of those allies to gain the benefit of any one Terrain Stalker feat you have.

_desc_en: You have mastered movement in many different environments. You gain the Terrain Stalker skill feat twice, choosing a different terrain each time. If you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice} while exploring and any allies use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tfa4Sh7wcxCEqL29]{Follow the Expert} to follow you as you do so, you can choose one of those allies to gain the benefit of any one Terrain Stalker feat you have.
_desc_ko: 여러 환경에서의 이동을 마스터했습니다. 지형 추적자 기술 피트를 두 번 획득하며, 매번 다른 지형을 선택합니다. 탐색 중 @link[actions.avoid-notice]를 성공하고, 동료를 @link[actions.follow-the-expert]로 따라오게 할 경우, 그 동료 중 한 명을 선택하여 당신이 가진 지형 추적자 재주 중 하나의 혜택을 부여할 수 있습니다.

name: Night's Shine

description.value:
Your power from the moon and stars becomes strong enough to illuminate the night sky. You gain your choice of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KG7amdeXWc7MjGXe]{Asterism} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.oXCwHBeDja4e0Mx0]{Touch of the Moon} domain spell.

Special You can take this feat a second time, gaining the focus spell that you didn't gain the first time.

_desc_en:
Your power from the moon and stars becomes strong enough to illuminate the night sky. You gain your choice of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KG7amdeXWc7MjGXe]{Asterism} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.oXCwHBeDja4e0Mx0]{Touch of the Moon} domain spell.

Special You can take this feat a second time, gaining the focus spell that you didn't gain the first time.
_desc_ko:
달과 별에서 얻은 당신의 힘이 밤하늘을 밝힐 만큼 강해집니다. @link[spells.asterism] 또는 @link[spells.touch-of-the-moon] 도메인 주문을 선택하여 획득합니다.

특수 이 피트를 두 번째로 선택할 수 있으며, 첫 번째 선택 시 얻지 못한 포커스 주문을 획득한다.

name: That Was a Close One, Huh?

description.value:
Frequency once per round

Requirements Either you used Accidental Shot and hit your opponent with the Strike this turn, or you used Lucky Escape since your last turn and the triggering attack missed you.

You laugh innocently about the inexplicable luck of your last shot hitting its mark or how close the attack that just missed you came to taking your head off, causing your foes to second guess whether it's a good idea to oppose you in battle. Attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} either the foe you hit with Accidental Shot or the foe that missed you due to Lucky Escape. You use Deception instead of Intimidation to attempt the check to [[/act demoralize statistic=deception]]{Demoralize}.

name_en: That Was a Close One, Huh?
_desc_en:
Frequency once per round

Requirements Either you used Accidental Shot and hit your opponent with the Strike this turn, or you used Lucky Escape since your last turn and the triggering attack missed you.

You laugh innocently about the inexplicable luck of your last shot hitting its mark or how close the attack that just missed you came to taking your head off, causing your foes to second guess whether it's a good idea to oppose you in battle. Attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} either the foe you hit with Accidental Shot or the foe that missed you due to Lucky Escape. You use Deception instead of Intimidation to attempt the check to [[/act demoralize statistic=deception]]{Demoralize}.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 라운드당 1회

요구 사항 이번 턴에 우발적 사격을 사용해 상대방을 공격했거나, 지난 턴 이후 행운의 탈출을 사용해 발동 공격을 피했어야 합니다.

당신은 지난 발사가 어떻게 명중했는지, 혹은 아슬아슬하게 빗나간 공격이 머리를 날릴 뻔했던 불가사의한 운에 대해 순진하게 웃어 넘깁니다. 이로 인해 적들은 당신과 싸우는 것이 과연 현명한 선택인지 다시 한번 의심하게 됩니다. @link[actions.demoralize]를 시도하세요. 대상은 우연한 명중으로 맞춘 적이나 행운의 탈출로 당신을 빗나간 적 중 하나입니다. 사기 저하 (기만) 판정을 시도할 때 협박 대신 기만을 사용합니다.

_desc_ko:
독침 사용 시 선택 가능한 약화 효과에 다음 중 하나를 추가합니다. 이 약화 효과는 명시된 대로 모든 단계의 피해를 감소시킵니다.

  • 실수 (레벨 13) 피해 1주사위 감소

    2단계 @link[conditions.clumsy]{1}

  • 탈기화 (레벨 13) 피해를 주사위 3개만큼 감소시킴

name: Improvisational Defender

description.value: You are always prepared for fights that frequently disrupt seemingly peaceful times. When you use an improvised weapon or a shoddy weapon, you don't take the -2 item penalty to attack rolls.

_desc_en: You are always prepared for fights that frequently disrupt seemingly peaceful times. When you use an improvised weapon or a shoddy weapon, you don't take the -2 item penalty to attack rolls.
_desc_ko: 겉보기 평화로운 시간에 자주 발생하는 싸움에 항상 대비하고 있습니다. 즉석 무기나 허술한 무기를 사용할 때 명중 굴림에 -2 아이템 페널티를 받지 않습니다.

name: Heroic Recovery

description.value:
The restorative power of your healing invigorates the recipient. If the next action you use is to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} targeting a single living creature and the target regains Hit Points from the spell, the target also gains three bonuses until the end of its next turn: a +5-foot status bonus to its Speed, a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, and a +1 status bonus to damage rolls. In addition, if the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, it can immediately Stand as a free action that doesn't trigger reactions.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.7ogytOgDmh4h2g5d]{Effect: Heroic Recovery}

If the next action you use is to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} targeting a single living creature and the target regains Hit Points from the spell, the target also gains three bonuses until the end of its next turn: a +5-foot status bonus to its Speed, a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, and a +1 status bonus to damage rolls. In addition, if the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, it can immediately Stand as a free action that doesn't trigger reactions.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.7ogytOgDmh4h2g5d]{Effect: Heroic Recovery}
_desc_ko:
당신의 치유가 지닌 회복력이 대상에게 활력을 불어넣습니다. 다음 행동으로 @link[spells.heal] 주문을 단일 생명체를 대상으로 시전하고 대상이 해당 주문으로 HP를 회복할 경우, 대상은 다음 턴 종료 시까지 세 가지 보너스를 추가로 얻습니다: 이동 속도에 +5피트 상태 보너스, 명중 굴림에 +1 상태 보너스, 피해 굴림에 +1 상태 보너스. 또한 대상이 @link[conditions.prone]라면, 반응을 유발하지 않는 자유 행동으로 즉시 일어서할 수 있습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.7ogytOgDmh4h2g5d]{효과: 영웅적 회복}

name: Scholar's Inheritance

description.value: Your parents devoted themselves to alchemical experiments involving elemental energy. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in Crafting (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.is3Oz9wt11lNq62K]{Alchemical Crafting} skill feat.

_desc_en: Your parents devoted themselves to alchemical experiments involving elemental energy. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in Crafting (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.is3Oz9wt11lNq62K]{Alchemical Crafting} skill feat.
_desc_ko: 부모님은 원소 에너지를 이용한 연금술 실험에 몰두하셨습니다. 제작 기술에 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 제작 기술에 자동으로 숙련된 상태가 된다면, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련된 상태가 됩니다. 또한 @link[feats.alchemical-crafting] 기술 피트를 얻습니다.

name: Harbinger's Caw

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger A creature within 60 feet is about to attempt an attack roll or skill check.

You caw ominously, cursing the creature with misfortune. The target creature must roll the triggering check twice and take the lower result.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger A creature within 60 feet is about to attempt an attack roll or skill check.

You caw ominously, cursing the creature with misfortune. The target creature must roll the triggering check twice and take the lower result.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 60피트 이내의 생물이 명중 굴림이나 기술 판정을 시도하다.

당신은 불길하게 까악거리며 그 생물에게 불운을 저주한다. 대상 생물은 유발 판정을 두 번 굴려야 하며 낮은 결과를 적용받는다.

name: Stonewalker

description.value:
You have a deep reverence for and connection to stone. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vh1RpbWfqdNC4L3P]{One with Stone} as a 3rd-rank divine innate spell once per day.

If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.HOUHs5rahwIsQoBf]{Stonemason's Eye} feat, you can attempt to find unusual stonework and stonework traps that require legendary proficiency in Perception. If you have both Stonemason's Eye and legendary proficiency in Perception, when the GM rolls a secret check for you to notice unusual stonework, you keep your bonus from Stonemason's Eye.

_desc_en:
You have a deep reverence for and connection to stone. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vh1RpbWfqdNC4L3P]{One with Stone} as a 3rd-rank divine innate spell once per day.

If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.HOUHs5rahwIsQoBf]{Stonemason's Eye} feat, you can attempt to find unusual stonework and stonework traps that require legendary proficiency in Perception. If you have both Stonemason's Eye and legendary proficiency in Perception, when the GM rolls a secret check for you to notice unusual stonework, you keep your bonus from Stonemason's Eye.
_desc_ko:
당신은 돌에 대한 깊은 경외심과 유대감을 지니고 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, @link[spells.one-with-stone]을 (3rd)랭크 신성 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

@link[feats.stonemasons-eye] 피트를 보유한 경우, 전설적 숙련도가 필요한 특이한 석조물과 석조 함정을 발견하려고 시도할 수 있습니다. 석공의 안목 특성과 지각에 대한 전설적 숙련도를 모두 보유한 경우, GM이 특이한 석조물을 알아차리기 위한 비밀 판정을 굴릴 때 석공의 안목 특성의 보너스를 유지한다.

name: Well of Potential

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Your mind is a deep well of psychic potential. You regain 1 Focus Point, up to your usual maximum.

value.value: at least one innate spell from a kashrishi heritage or ancestry feat that shares a tradition with at least one of your focus spells

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Your mind is a deep well of psychic potential. You regain 1 Focus Point, up to your usual maximum.
_desc_ko:
빈도 하루에 한 번

당신의 마음은 사이킥 잠재력의 깊은 우물입니다. 평소 최대치까지 1점의 포커스를 회복합니다.

name: Ostentatious Reload

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding two one-handed firearms.

Every good Firebrand knows that style can be as important as substance—so long as you don't screw up the delivery. Make a @Check[performance|dc:@self.level|adjustment:-2] check against an easy DC for your level as you spin your guns around and juggle ammunition to reload them.

Critical Success You Interact to reload up to two firearms you are currently wielding.

Success You Interact to reload a single firearm you are currently wielding.

Failure You drop one of the required firearms and a round of ammunition on the ground in your space.

Critical Failure You drop both firearms and two rounds on the ground in your space.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding two one-handed firearms.

Every good Firebrand knows that style can be as important as substance—so long as you don't screw up the delivery. Make a @Check[performance|dc:@self.level|adjustment:-2] check against an easy DC for your level as you spin your guns around and juggle ammunition to reload them.

Critical Success You Interact to reload up to two firearms you are currently wielding.

Success You Interact to reload a single firearm you are currently wielding.

Failure You drop one of the required firearms and a round of ammunition on the ground in your space.

Critical Failure You drop both firearms and two rounds on the ground in your space.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손에 각각 한 자루씩의 한손용 화기를 들고 있어야 합니다.

모든 훌륭한 화염술사는 스타일이 실력만큼 중요할 수 있다는 걸 안다-물론 실수만 안 한다면 말이다. 총을 휘두르며 탄약을 저글링해 재장전할 때, 레벨에 따른 쉬운 난이도 DC로 공연 판정을 수행하라.

대성공 현재 장착 중인 총기 최대 두 정을 재장전합니다.

성공 현재 장전 중인 단일 화기를 재장전합니다.

실패 필요한 총기 중 하나와 탄환 한 발을 자신의 공간 바닥에 떨어뜨립니다.

대실패 두 개의 화기와 두 발의 탄환을 모두 자신의 공간 바닥에 떨어뜨립니다.

name: Font of Life or Death

description.value: As you reach ever higher in your quest to achieve true divinity, the powers of life and death flow evermore easily from you. Choose either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm}; you gain the chosen spell as an 8th rank innate spell you can cast three times per day. Your hierophant can cast these innate spells as well by expending one of your daily uses.

_desc_en: As you reach ever higher in your quest to achieve true divinity, the powers of life and death flow evermore easily from you. Choose either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm}; you gain the chosen spell as an 8th rank innate spell you can cast three times per day. Your hierophant can cast these innate spells as well by expending one of your daily uses.
_desc_ko: 진정한 신성을 추구하며 점점 더 높은 경지에 이를수록, 생명의 힘과 죽음의 힘이 당신에게서 더욱 쉽게 흘러나옵니다. @link[spells.heal] 또는 @link[spells.harm] 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 선택한 주문을 (8th)랭크 선천적 주문으로 획득하며, 하루에 세 번 시전할 수 있습니다. 당신의 계시자도 당신의 일일 사용 횟수 중 하나를 소모하여 이 선천적 주문을 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Quick Snares

description.value: You can rig a snare in only moments. You can Craft snares that normally take 1 minute to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} with 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} actions, even if you haven't prepared them.

_desc_en: You can rig a snare in only moments. You can Craft snares that normally take 1 minute to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} with 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} actions, even if you haven't prepared them.
_desc_ko: 순식간에 올가미를 설치할 수 있습니다. 평소 1분이 소요되는 올가미를 @link[actions.craft]하는 데 3번의 @link[actions.interact] 행동만으로 만들 수 있으며, 미리 준비하지 않았더라도 가능합니다.

name: Ongoing Investigation

description.value: You're always investigating what's around you, even as you perform other activities. You can move at full Speed while using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate} exploration activity, and you can use another exploration activity while Investigating.

_desc_en: You're always investigating what's around you, even as you perform other activities. You can move at full Speed while using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate} exploration activity, and you can use another exploration activity while Investigating.
_desc_ko: 다른 활동을 수행 중에도 주변을 항상 조사합니다. @link[actions.investigate] 탐색 활동을 사용하면서 최대 속도로 이동할 수 있으며, 조사 중에도 다른 탐색 활동을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Grave Mummification

description.value:
Exposure to the elements, magic, alchemy, and other phenomena intensified the changes from your mummification. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.ancestryfeatures.Item.YGk41WV42aTM7CQV]{Advanced Undead Benefits}.

In addition, you gain resistance equal to half your level against any damage you'd take from your bound terrain, including its dangerous temperatures, weather, hazardous terrain, and environmental hazards.

_desc_en:
Exposure to the elements, magic, alchemy, and other phenomena intensified the changes from your mummification. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.ancestryfeatures.Item.YGk41WV42aTM7CQV]{Advanced Undead Benefits}.

In addition, you gain resistance equal to half your level against any damage you'd take from your bound terrain, including its dangerous temperatures, weather, hazardous terrain, and environmental hazards.
_desc_ko:
자연 환경, 마법, 연금술 및 기타 현상에 노출되면서 미라화 과정의 변화가 가속화되었습니다. 당신은 @link[feats.advanced-undead-benefits]을 얻습니다.

또한, 귀하는 속박된 지형으로부터 받는 모든 피해(위험한 온도, 날씨, 위험 지형, 환경적 위험 포함)에 대해 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 저항력을 얻습니다.

name: Bring Into the Fold

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Not all who oppress are irredeemable, and given encouragement and some time, they will abandon their cause and join your fight against the very system they used to uphold. If your next action is to issue an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cwBsPU24715fUCub]{Ultimatum of Liberation}, you may have up to 10 targets who can hear you attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. You can cause any changes in attitude to last longer than the current social interaction by spending at least 10 minutes speaking with the affected targets earnestly about your cause.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target's attitude toward you improves by one step.

Critical Failure The target's attitude toward you improves by two steps.

_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

억압하는 자 모두가 구제불능은 아니며, 격려와 시간이 주어진다면 그들은 자신의 대의를 버리고 예전에 지탱하던 바로 그 체제에 맞서는 당신의 싸움에 합류할 것이다. 다음 행동으로 @link[actions.ultimatum-of-liberation]을 발령할 경우, 최대 10명의 대상이 당신의 클래스 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 더 높은 쪽에 대한 의지 내성 굴림을 시도할 수 있습니다. 당신은 최소 10분 동안 영향을 받은 대상과 진지하게 당신의 대의에 대해 이야기함으로써, 태도 변화가 현재의 사회적 상호작용보다 오래 지속되도록 할 수 있습니다.

성공 대상은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

실패 대상의 당신에 대한 태도가 한 단계 개선됩니다.

대실패 대상의 당신에 대한 태도가 두 단계 개선됩니다.

name: Fan Dancer Dedication

description.value:
Access Tian Xia origin

You sweep across the battlefield, manifesting both the gentle spring breeze and the crisp autumn gusts. You become an expert in Performance. At 7th level you become a master in Performance, and at 15th level, you become legendary in Performance. Whenever you Feint while holding a fan, you can give your Feint the air trait. If you do, you can Stride 10 feet before or after as part of the same action.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.RK6AbtT26DHbHlLj]{Fan Dancer}

_desc_ko:
접근 티엔 샤 출신

전장을 가로지르며 부드러운 봄바람과 선선한 가을바람을 동시에 창조합니다. 당신은 공연의 전문가가 됩니다. (7th)레벨에 공연의 달인이 되고, 15레벨에 공연의 전설이 됩니다. 천하선풍 부채를 들고 페인트를 사용할 때마다, 그 페인트에 공기 속성을 부여할 수 있습니다. 그렇게 할 경우, 동일한 행동의 일부로 10피트를 전진하거나 후진할 수 있습니다.

name: Web Walker

description.value: You have plenty of practice navigating webs. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saves and AC against the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9s5tqqXNzcoKamWx]{Web} spell, natural webbing, and effects that entrap you in webbing, as well as a +1 circumstance bonus against other effects that snare and entangle you, like the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.J6vNvrUT3b1hx2iA]{Entangling Flora} spell. Whenever you roll a success on a saving throw against an effect involving a web, you get a critical success instead.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: You have plenty of practice navigating webs. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saves and AC against the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9s5tqqXNzcoKamWx]{Web} spell, natural webbing, and effects that entrap you in webbing, as well as a +1 circumstance bonus against other effects that snare and entangle you, like the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.J6vNvrUT3b1hx2iA]{Entangling Flora} spell. Whenever you roll a success on a saving throw against an effect involving a web, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 거미줄을 헤쳐 나가는 데 능숙합니다. @link[spells.web] 주문, 자연 거미줄, 거미줄에 갇히는 효과에 대한 저항력 및 AC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며, @link[spells.entangling-flora] 주문처럼 당신을 얽히게 하거나 얽매이는 다른 효과에 대해서는 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 거미줄 관련 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴릴 때마다, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Coordinated Charge

description.value: You heroically dash into the fray, inspiring your allies to follow. You Stride up to your Speed and make a melee Strike. If your Strike hits and damages an enemy, each ally within 60 feet who saw you hit can use a reaction to Stride, but they each must end their Stride closer to the creature you hit than where they started.

_desc_en: You heroically dash into the fray, inspiring your allies to follow. You Stride up to your Speed and make a melee Strike. If your Strike hits and damages an enemy, each ally within 60 feet who saw you hit can use a reaction to Stride, but they each must end their Stride closer to the creature you hit than where they started.
_desc_ko: 당신은 용맹하게 전장으로 돌진하며 동료들에게 따라오도록 고무합니다. 당신은 이동 속도만큼 전진하며 근접 공격을 가합니다. 공격이 적을 명중시켜 피해를 입혔을 경우, 60피트 내의 모든 아군 중 당신의 공격을 목격한 자는 반응으로 이동할 수 있습니다. 단, 각 아군은 시작 위치보다 당신이 공격한 생물체에 더 가까이 이동해야 합니다.

name: Speak with Kindred

description.value: You have a connection with creatures that share your physiology. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with plants and fungi. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks with plants or fungi of your kind. Generally, fungus leshies get this bonus with mushrooms and fungi; gourd leshies with gourds, melons, and similar fruiting plants; leaf leshies with deciduous trees; and vine leshies with vines and climbing plants.

_desc_en: You have a connection with creatures that share your physiology. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with plants and fungi. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks with plants or fungi of your kind. Generally, fungus leshies get this bonus with mushrooms and fungi; gourd leshies with gourds, melons, and similar fruiting plants; leaf leshies with deciduous trees; and vine leshies with vines and climbing plants.
_desc_ko: 당신은 생리 구조를 공유하는 생명체들과 연결되어 있습니다. 식물과 균류에게 질문을 던지고, 답변을 받을 수 있으며, 그들과 외교 기술을 사용할 수 있습니다. 동종 식물이나 균류와의 외교 검사 시 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 일반적으로 버섯 레시는 버섯과 균류에, 호박 레시는 호박, 멜론 및 유사한 열매 맺는 식물에, 잎 레시는 낙엽수에, 덩굴 레시는 덩굴과 등반 식물에 대해 이 보너스를 받습니다.

name: Hunter's Defense

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger A creature with the animal, beast, elemental, fey, fungus, or plant trait attacks you, and you can see the attacker.

Your canny understanding of natural and primal creatures helps you predict and dodge their attacks. The triggering attack roll targets your Nature DC instead of your AC. Though this allows you to avoid taking penalties to your AC, it doesn't remove any conditions or other effects causing such penalties. For example, an enemy with sneak attack would still deal extra damage to you for being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, even though you wouldn't take the –2 circumstance penalty against the attack.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger A creature with the animal, beast, elemental, fey, fungus, or plant trait attacks you, and you can see the attacker.

Your canny understanding of natural and primal creatures helps you predict and dodge their attacks. The triggering attack roll targets your Nature DC instead of your AC. Though this allows you to avoid taking penalties to your AC, it doesn't remove any conditions or other effects causing such penalties. For example, an enemy with sneak attack would still deal extra damage to you for being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, even though you wouldn't take the –2 circumstance penalty against the attack.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

발동 조건 동물, 야수, 원소, 페이, 균류, 식물 특성을 가진 생물이 당신을 공격하고, 당신이 공격자를 볼 수 있을 때.

자연과 프라이멀 생물에 대한 당신의 예리한 이해는 그들의 공격을 예측하고 회피하는 데 도움이 됩니다. 발동 명중 굴림은 당신의 AC 대신 자연 DC를 대상으로 합니다. 이로 인해 AC에 적용되는 페널티는 피할 수 있지만, 해당 페널티를 유발하는 상태 이상이나 기타 효과는 제거되지 않습니다. 예를 들어, 암습을 가진 적의 경우, 해당 공격에 대해 -2 상황 페널티를 받지 않더라도 @link[conditions.off-guard]로 인해 추가 피해를 입게 됩니다.

name: Premonition of Avoidance

description.value:
Trigger You are about to roll a saving throw against a hazard.

Your deity grants you a moment's foresight. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the triggering saving throw.

_desc_en:
Trigger You are about to roll a saving throw against a hazard.

Your deity grants you a moment's foresight. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the triggering saving throw.
_desc_ko:
트리거 위험에 대한 내성 굴림을 수행하려 합니다.

당신의 신이 순간적인 예지력을 부여합니다. 발동되는 내성 굴림에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Subjugation

description.value:
You have managed to gain a degree of control over the runelord's ancient soul within your mind, enough that you can project this invasive influence into the minds of others. Spend a Mythic Point. You attempt to send your runelord's influence into the mind of a creature you can sense within 30 feet. The creature attempts a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Giants take a –2 status penalty to this saving throw. Regardless of the result, the target is temporarily immune to this ability for 24 hours once the Subjugation ends.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} as it fights off your runelord's influence. You gain awareness of its abilities and weaknesses as if you achieved a critical success on a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} check to identify the creature.

Failure The creature relinquishes control of its faculties and abilities. You gain awareness of its abilities and weaknesses as success. You control the creature until the end of its next turn.

Critical Failure As failure, but you control the creature for 1 minute.

publication.title: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

_desc_en:
You have managed to gain a degree of control over the runelord's ancient soul within your mind, enough that you can project this invasive influence into the minds of others. Spend a Mythic Point. You attempt to send your runelord's influence into the mind of a creature you can sense within 30 feet. The creature attempts a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Giants take a –2 status penalty to this saving throw. Regardless of the result, the target is temporarily immune to this ability for 24 hours once the Subjugation ends.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} as it fights off your runelord's influence. You gain awareness of its abilities and weaknesses as if you achieved a critical success on a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} check to identify the creature.

Failure The creature relinquishes control of its faculties and abilities. You gain awareness of its abilities and weaknesses as success. You control the creature until the end of its next turn.

Critical Failure As failure, but you control the creature for 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
당신은 정신 속 룬로드의 고대 영혼을 어느 정도 통제하는 데 성공하여, 이 침습적 영향력을 다른 이의 정신에 투사할 수 있을 만큼이 되었습니다. 신화 점수를 소모합니다. 당신은 30피트 내에 감지할 수 있는 존재의 정신에 룬로드의 영향력을 보내려 시도합니다. 그 존재는 당신의 클래스 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 더 높은 값에 대해 @Check[will|against:class-spell] 내성 굴림을 시도합니다. 거인은 이 내성 굴림에 -2 상태 페널티를 받습니다. 결과에 관계없이, 대상은 복속이 끝나면 24시간 동안 이 능력에 일시적으로 면역이 됩니다.

대성공 해당 존재는 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 해당 존재는 당신의 룬로드의 영향력을 떨쳐내며 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{둔화 1}이 됩니다. 당신은 그 존재를 식별하기 위한 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{지식 회상} 판정에서 대성공을 거둔 것처럼 그 능력과 약점을 인지하게 됩니다.

실패 해당 존재는 자신의 기능과 능력에 대한 통제권을 넘깁니다. 당신은 성공에서와 같이 그 능력과 약점을 인지하게 됩니다. 당신은 그 존재의 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 그 존재를 통제합니다.

대실패 실패와 같지만, 당신은 1분간 그 존재를 통제합니다.

name: Elemental Familiar

description.value:
Your familiar becomes an elemental spirit capable of taking on aspects of the elements. Other than taking the form of an elemental instead of an animal, this familiar continues to use all the same rules as other familiars.

Your familiar gains one additional familiar ability each day, which must be one of the following elemental familiar abilities. While your familiar has an elemental familiar ability, your familiar is composed of the associated elemental matter and gains the matching elemental trait. You can't select more than one elemental familiar ability at a time.

  • Air If your familiar stays completely still for 1 round, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} until it next takes an action. Any motion, even being moved or carried by another creature, ends this effect.
  • Earth Your familiar gains resistance to physical damage (except adamantine) equal to half your level.
  • Fire Your familiar sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) and emits warmth. Creatures that remain within a @Template[emanation|distance:15] don't take damage from severe environmental cold.
  • Metal Your familiar gains resistance to physical damage from metal weapons equal to half your level.
  • Water Your familiar can move through a gap at least 2 inches wide without @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeezing} and can Squeeze through a gap at least 1 inch wide.
  • Wood If your familiar remains in bright light for 1 round, it gains fast healing equal to half your level. Once it is out of bright light, this effect ends.

_desc_en:
Your familiar becomes an elemental spirit capable of taking on aspects of the elements. Other than taking the form of an elemental instead of an animal, this familiar continues to use all the same rules as other familiars.

Your familiar gains one additional familiar ability each day, which must be one of the following elemental familiar abilities. While your familiar has an elemental familiar ability, your familiar is composed of the associated elemental matter and gains the matching elemental trait. You can't select more than one elemental familiar ability at a time.

  • Air If your familiar stays completely still for 1 round, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} until it next takes an action. Any motion, even being moved or carried by another creature, ends this effect.
  • Earth Your familiar gains resistance to physical damage (except adamantine) equal to half your level.
  • Fire Your familiar sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) and emits warmth. Creatures that remain within a @Template[emanation|distance:15] don't take damage from severe environmental cold.
  • Metal Your familiar gains resistance to physical damage from metal weapons equal to half your level.
  • Water Your familiar can move through a gap at least 2 inches wide without @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeezing} and can Squeeze through a gap at least 1 inch wide.
  • Wood If your familiar remains in bright light for 1 round, it gains fast healing equal to half your level. Once it is out of bright light, this effect ends.
_desc_ko:
당신의 패밀리어는 원소의 특성을 취할 수 있는 원소 영혼이 됩니다. 동물 대신 원소 형태를 취하는 것 외에는, 이 패밀리어는 다른 패밀리어와 동일한 규칙을 계속 적용받습니다.

당신의 패밀리어는 매일 추가로 하나의 패밀리어 능력을 획득하며, 이는 다음 원소 패밀리어 능력 중 하나여야 합니다. 패밀리어가 원소 패밀리어 능력을 보유하는 동안, 패밀리어는 해당 원소 물질로 구성되며 일치하는 원소 특성을 얻습니다. 한 번에 하나의 원소 패밀리어 능력만 선택할 수 있습니다.

  • 공기 당신의 패밀리어가 1라운드 동안 완전히 움직이지 않으면, 다음 행동을 취할 때까지 @link[conditions.invisible] 상태가 됩니다. 어떤 움직임이라도, 다른 생물에 의해 이동되거나 운반되는 경우조차도 이 효과를 종료시킵니다.
  • 대지 당신의 친숙한 생물은 물리 피해(아다만틴 제외)에 대해 당신의 레벨 절반에 해당하는 저항력을 얻습니다.
  • 불 당신의 패밀리어는 반경 20피트 내에 밝은 빛을 내뿜고(다음 20피트 내에는 희미한 빛을 내뿜음), 온기를 발산합니다. 15피트 안에 머무르는 생물들은 극심한 환경적 추위로부터 피해를 입지 않습니다.
  • 금속 당신의 패밀리어는 금속 무기로부터 받는 물리적 피해에 대해 당신의 레벨 절반에 해당하는 저항력을 얻습니다.
  • 물 당신의 패밀리어는 최소 2인치 너비의 틈새를 @link[actions.squeeze] 동작 없이 통과할 수 있으며, 최소 1인치 너비의 틈새를 비집고 들어갈 수 있습니다.
  • 나무 당신의 패밀리어 존재가 밝은 빛 속에 1라운드 동안 머무르면, 당신의 레벨 절반에 해당하는 빠른 치유를 얻습니다. 밝은 빛에서 벗어나면 이 효과는 종료됩니다.

name: Vicious Vengeance

description.value: While your vengeance is painful for both you and your foe, none can doubt that your enemies suffer more. You gain a circumstance bonus to the damage you deal from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.r5Uth6yvCoE4tr9z]{Destructive Vengeance} equal to the number of damage dice from the reaction. This only applies to the damage the enemy takes, not the damage to yourself or the extra damage you gain after using the reaction.

_desc_en: While your vengeance is painful for both you and your foe, none can doubt that your enemies suffer more. You gain a circumstance bonus to the damage you deal from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.r5Uth6yvCoE4tr9z]{Destructive Vengeance} equal to the number of damage dice from the reaction. This only applies to the damage the enemy takes, not the damage to yourself or the extra damage you gain after using the reaction.
_desc_ko: 당신의 복수는 당신과 적 모두에게 고통스럽지만, 적들이 더 큰 고통을 받는다는 사실은 의심의 여지가 없습니다. 반응으로 얻은 피해 주사위 수만큼 @link[actions.destructive-vengeance]로 입히는 피해에 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 이는 적에게 입히는 피해에만 적용되며, 자신에게 입는 피해나 반응 사용 후 얻는 추가 피해에는 적용되지 않습니다.

name: Steal Death

description.value:
Trigger Another creature within 30 feet gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition or their doomed or dying condition increases.

As a harbinger of daemonkind, you gain authority to delay the death of others if it serves your purposes, and in doing so, you bolster the well-being of both you and your mount to allow you sow further havoc. The triggering creature reduces their doomed or dying condition by 1.

For the next minute, you and your apocalypse mount gain fast healing 5 as long as you are within 10 feet of each other. If you use this reaction again within that minute, you and your mount's fast healing increases by 1, but the duration isn't increased.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.d0TYadetRJvNb2Au]{Effect: Steal Death}

_desc_en:
Trigger Another creature within 30 feet gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition or their doomed or dying condition increases.

As a harbinger of daemonkind, you gain authority to delay the death of others if it serves your purposes, and in doing so, you bolster the well-being of both you and your mount to allow you sow further havoc. The triggering creature reduces their doomed or dying condition by 1.

For the next minute, you and your apocalypse mount gain fast healing 5 as long as you are within 10 feet of each other. If you use this reaction again within that minute, you and your mount's fast healing increases by 1, but the duration isn't increased.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.d0TYadetRJvNb2Au]{Effect: Steal Death}
_desc_ko:
발동 30피트 내의 다른 생물이 @link[conditions.doomed] 또는 @link[conditions.dying] 상태를 얻거나, 이미 가진 파멸 또는 죽어감 상태가 악화됩니다.

악마의 하브링거로서, 당신은 자신의 목적을 위해 타인의 죽음을 지연시킬 권한을 얻으며, 이를 통해 당신과 당신의 탈것 모두의 안녕을 강화하여 더 큰 혼란을 퍼뜨릴 수 있게 됩니다. 발동한 생물은 자신의 파멸 상태나 죽음 직전 상태를 1 감소시킵니다.

다음 1분 동안, 너와 종말의 탈것이 서로 10피트 이내에 있는 한, 너와 탈것은 빠른 치유 5를 얻는다. 이 1분 안에 이 반응을 다시 사용하면 너와 탈것의 빠른 치유가 1 증가하지만, 지속 시간은 연장되지 않는다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.d0TYadetRJvNb2Au]{효과: 죽음 도둑질}

name: Mask of Fear

description.value:
Trigger You start your turn with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition.

Requirements You're wearing your warmask.

Your warmask burns off of your face, releasing your apprehension. You remove the frightened condition. Your warmask is destroyed, and you can't reapply it until your next daily preparations.

Special You can use this free action even if you have a condition tied to the frightened condition that would normally prevent you from using a free action, such as "@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} as long as you're frightened" or "@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} as long as you're frightened."

_desc_en:
Trigger You start your turn with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition.

Requirements You're wearing your warmask.

Your warmask burns off of your face, releasing your apprehension. You remove the frightened condition. Your warmask is destroyed, and you can't reapply it until your next daily preparations.

Special You can use this free action even if you have a condition tied to the frightened condition that would normally prevent you from using a free action, such as "@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} as long as you're frightened" or "@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} as long as you're frightened."
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 자신의 턴 시작 시 @link[conditions.frightened]를 받습니다.

요구 사항 당신은 전투용 가면을 착용하고 있습니다.

당신의 전투 가면이 얼굴에서 타버리며 불안감이 사라집니다. 공포 상태가 해제됩니다. 당신의 전투 가면은 파괴되었으며, 다음 일일 준비 시간까지 다시 착용할 수 없습니다.

Special 이 무료 행동은 공포 상태에 묶인 상태 효과로 인해 일반적으로 무료 행동을 사용할 수 없는 경우에도 사용할 수 있습니다. 예를 들어 "@link[conditions.fleeing] 상태인 동안 공포 상태일 경우" 또는 "@link[conditions.paralyzed] 상태인 동안 공포 상태일 경우" 등이 해당됩니다.

name: Incredible Familiar (Familiar Master)

description.value: Your familiar is infused with even more magic than other familiars. You can select six familiar or master abilities each day, instead of four.

_desc_en: Your familiar is infused with even more magic than other familiars. You can select six familiar or master abilities each day, instead of four.
_desc_ko: 당신의 패밀리어는 다른 패밀리어보다 훨씬 더 많은 마법이 스며들어 있습니다. 매일 4개 대신 6개의 패밀리어 능력 또는 마스터 능력을 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Clever Improviser

description.value: You've learned how to handle situations when you're out of your depth. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.9jGaBxLUtevZYcZO]{Untrained Improvisation} general feat. In addition, you can attempt skill actions that normally require you to be trained, even if you are untrained.

_desc_en: You've learned how to handle situations when you're out of your depth. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.9jGaBxLUtevZYcZO]{Untrained Improvisation} general feat. In addition, you can attempt skill actions that normally require you to be trained, even if you are untrained.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신이 감당하기 어려운 상황을 처리하는 법을 배웠습니다. @link[feats.untrained-improvisation] 피트를 얻습니다. 또한, 훈련을 받지 않았더라도 일반적으로 훈련이 필요한 기술 행동을 시도할 수 있습니다.

name: Impenetrable Fog

description.value:
Fog condenses in a chaotic, swirling pattern, thick enough that it seems to push back against you. You call forth a fog bank in a @Template[burst|distance:10] within 120 feet. All creatures in the fog are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the fog become concealed to creatures within it. The fog is so magically dense it impedes movement, making the area difficult terrain. The fog lasts until the end of your next turn, and you can Sustain the impulse up to 1 minute.

Level (+3) You can make the radius of the burst larger. Increase its maximum size by 5 feet.

_desc_en:
Fog condenses in a chaotic, swirling pattern, thick enough that it seems to push back against you. You call forth a fog bank in a @Template[burst|distance:10] within 120 feet. All creatures in the fog are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the fog become concealed to creatures within it. The fog is so magically dense it impedes movement, making the area difficult terrain. The fog lasts until the end of your next turn, and you can Sustain the impulse up to 1 minute.

Level (+3) You can make the radius of the burst larger. Increase its maximum size by 5 feet.
_desc_ko:
안개가 혼란스럽게 소용돌이치며 응축되어, 당신을 밀어내는 듯한 두께를 이룹니다. 당신은 120피트 이내의 10피트 영역에 안개 덩어리를 불러냅니다. 안개 속 모든 생물은 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태가 되며, 안개 밖의 모든 생물은 안개 속 생물에게 은폐 상태로 인식된다. 마법적으로 짙은 안개는 이동을 방해하여 해당 지역을 어려운 지형으로 만든다. 안개는 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 지속되며, 최대 1분 동안 임펄스를 유지할 수 있다.

레벨 (+3) 폭발 반경을 더 크게 만들 수 있습니다. 최대 크기를 5피트 증가시킵니다.

name: Tree's Ward

description.value: You've lived among trees for so long they recognize your presence and seek to protect you from harm. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.K9gI08enGtmih5X1]{Protector Tree} as a primal innate spell once per day.

_desc_en: You've lived among trees for so long they recognize your presence and seek to protect you from harm. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.K9gI08enGtmih5X1]{Protector Tree} as a primal innate spell once per day.
_desc_ko: 오랜 세월 나무들 사이에서 살아온 덕분에 나무들은 당신의 존재를 알아보고 해로부터 보호하려 합니다. 하루에 한 번, 프라이멀 선천 마법인 @link[spells.protector-tree]를 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Deathguard

description.value: The twisting rotted limbs, clattering bones, or swirling ectoplasm of your horde can hide you from others' vision. You and your allies can occupy the same space as your horde, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to all creatures when you do so.

_desc_en: The twisting rotted limbs, clattering bones, or swirling ectoplasm of your horde can hide you from others' vision. You and your allies can occupy the same space as your horde, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to all creatures when you do so.
_desc_ko: 당신의 군단이 만들어내는 뒤틀린 썩은 사지, 덜거덕거리는 뼈, 또는 소용돌이치는 엑토플라즘은 다른 이들의 시야에서 당신을 숨길 수 있습니다. 당신과 당신의 아군은 군단과 동일한 공간을 점유할 수 있으며, 그렇게 할 경우 모든 생물에게 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Parallel Breakthrough

description.value: You expand your mind beyond your area of psychic specialty. You gain a 1st-rank psi cantrip for a conscious mind other than your own; this can be either the unique surface cantrip or one of the common cantrips and the accompanying amp. If you choose a common cantrip, you also gain the special benefit granted by that conscious mind when casting the cantrip without an amp. You don't gain any other benefits of that conscious mind, such as additional spells known.

_desc_en: You expand your mind beyond your area of psychic specialty. You gain a 1st-rank psi cantrip for a conscious mind other than your own; this can be either the unique surface cantrip or one of the common cantrips and the accompanying amp. If you choose a common cantrip, you also gain the special benefit granted by that conscious mind when casting the cantrip without an amp. You don't gain any other benefits of that conscious mind, such as additional spells known.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신의 사이킥 전문 분야를 넘어 의식을 확장합니다. 자신 이외의 의식 있는 정신을 대상으로 1레벨 사이 캔트립을 획득합니다. 이는 고유한 표면 캔트립이나 일반 캔트립 중 하나와 그에 따른 앰프일 수 있습니다. 일반 캔트립을 선택할 경우, 해당 정신이 앰프 없이 캐스트를 시전할 때 부여하는 특수 혜택도 함께 얻습니다. 추가로 아는 주문 같은 해당 정신의 다른 혜택은 얻지 못합니다.

name: Otherworldly Acumen

description.value:
The arcane magic you possess grows in power and complexity. Choose one common 2nd-rank spell from the same tradition as an innate spell you previously gained from another elf ancestry feat (from the arcane list if you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Pat4H0VbmApblZxc]{Otherworldly Magic}, for example). You can cast that spell as an innate spell once per day, using the same tradition as the list you chose the spell from.

Your magic is adaptable. By spending 1 day of downtime, you can change the spell you chose to a different common 2nd-rank spell from the same tradition.

value.value: at least one innate spell gained from an elf ancestry feat

_desc_en:
The arcane magic you possess grows in power and complexity. Choose one common 2nd-rank spell from the same tradition as an innate spell you previously gained from another elf ancestry feat (from the arcane list if you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Pat4H0VbmApblZxc]{Otherworldly Magic}, for example). You can cast that spell as an innate spell once per day, using the same tradition as the list you chose the spell from.

Your magic is adaptable. By spending 1 day of downtime, you can change the spell you chose to a different common 2nd-rank spell from the same tradition.
_desc_ko:
당신이 지닌 아케인 마법의 힘과 복잡성이 증가합니다. 다른 엘프 혈통 재주에서 이전에 획득한 선천적 주문과 동일한 전통의 일반 2랭크 주문 하나를 선택하십시오(예: @link[feats.otherworldly-magic]을 보유한 경우 비전 목록에서). 해당 주문을 선택한 목록과 동일한 전통을 사용하여 하루에 한 번 선천적 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

당신의 마법은 적응력이 뛰어납니다. 다운타임 1일을 소모하면 선택한 주문을 동일한 전통의 다른 일반 2랭크 주문으로 변경할 수 있습니다.

name: Venipuncture

description.value:
Cost all your remaining sanguimancy Hit Points (minimum 3)

A shell made up of hundreds of razor-thin needles of blood forms around you before exploding outward, lacerating foes in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]. The needles deal piercing damage equal to double the number of sanguimancy Hit Points you spent, to a maximum of 80 damage. Creatures caught in the blast must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save. The DC for this save is your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

_desc_en:
Cost all your remaining sanguimancy Hit Points (minimum 3)

A shell made up of hundreds of razor-thin needles of blood forms around you before exploding outward, lacerating foes in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]. The needles deal piercing damage equal to double the number of sanguimancy Hit Points you spent, to a maximum of 80 damage. Creatures caught in the blast must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save. The DC for this save is your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.
_desc_ko:
비용 남은 모든 생기술 HP (최소 3)

수백 개의 날카로운 혈액 바늘로 이루어진 껍질이 당신 주위에 형성된 후 바깥쪽으로 폭발하며, 30피트 발산 범위 내의 적들을 베어 상처를 입힙니다. 이 바늘들은 당신이 소모한 생혈술 HP의 두 배에 해당하는 관통 피해를 입히며, 최대 80의 피해를 줍니다. 폭발에 휘말린 생물들은 기본 반사 저항 검사를 시도해야 합니다. 이 저항 검사의 난이도는 당신의 직업 난이도(DC) 또는 주문 난이도(DC) 중 더 높은 쪽입니다.

name: Among Humanity

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Your talents in shapechanging allow you to pass unseen. When you Change Shape into your humanoid form, you gain the effects of 3rd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise} for 1 hour or until you shift back, except it's a polymorph effect rather than an illusion.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Your talents in shapechanging allow you to pass unseen. When you Change Shape into your humanoid form, you gain the effects of 3rd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise} for 1 hour or until you shift back, except it's a polymorph effect rather than an illusion.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

변신 능력으로 눈에 띄지 않게 지나갈 수 있습니다. 인간형으로 변신할 때, 1시간 동안 또는 원래 모습으로 돌아갈 때까지 (3rd) @link[spells.illusory-disguise] 효과를 얻습니다. 단, 이는 환상이 아닌 변형 효과입니다.

name: Legendary Medic

description.value: You've discovered medical breakthroughs or techniques that achieve miraculous results. Once per day for each target, you can spend 1 hour treating that target and attempt a Medicine check to remove a disease or the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} condition. Use the DC of the disease or of the spell or effect that created the condition. If the effect's source is an artifact, above 20th level, or similarly powerful, increase the DC by 10.

_desc_en: You've discovered medical breakthroughs or techniques that achieve miraculous results. Once per day for each target, you can spend 1 hour treating that target and attempt a Medicine check to remove a disease or the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} condition. Use the DC of the disease or of the spell or effect that created the condition. If the effect's source is an artifact, above 20th level, or similarly powerful, increase the DC by 10.
_desc_ko: 당신은 기적적인 결과를 내는 의학적 돌파구나 기술을 발견했습니다. 하루에 한 번, 대상마다 1시간 동안 치료를 제공하며 의학 검사를 시도해 질병이나 @link[conditions.blinded], @link[conditions.deafened], @link[conditions.doomed], 또는 @link[conditions.drained] 상태를 제거하기 위해 의학 검사를 시도할 수 있습니다. 질병이나 해당 상태를 유발한 주문 또는 효과의 난이도(DC)를 사용하십시오. 효과의 원인이 유물, 20레벨 이상, 또는 유사한 수준의 강력한 존재인 경우 DC를 10 증가시킵니다.

name: Hidden Paragon

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You successfully use Stealth to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from all of your current foes, or use Stealth to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all your current foes.

When you slip out of sight, you disappear. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} for 1 minute, even if you use a hostile action. Not even @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0qaqksrGGDj74HXE]{Revealing Light}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen}, or similar effects can reveal you, though creatures can still use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to locate you as normal.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You successfully use Stealth to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from all of your current foes, or use Stealth to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all your current foes.

When you slip out of sight, you disappear. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} for 1 minute, even if you use a hostile action. Not even @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0qaqksrGGDj74HXE]{Revealing Light}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen}, or similar effects can reveal you, though creatures can still use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to locate you as normal.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

발동 은신 기술을 성공해 @link[actions.hide] 상태가 되어 현재의 모든 적에게 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태가 되거나, 은신 기술을 사용해 @link[actions.sneak]하여 현재 모든 적에게 @link[conditions.undetected] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Diverse Lore

description.value: Your wandering studies mean you've heard rumors or theories about almost every topic... though admittedly, your sources aren't always the most reliable. You can take a -2 penalty to your check to Recall Knowledge with Esoteric Lore to Recall Knowledge about any topic, not just the usual topics available for Esoteric Lore. Additionally, when you succeed at your check to Exploit a Vulnerability, compare the result of your Esoteric Lore check to the DC to Recall Knowledge for that creature; if that number would be a success or a critical success, you gain information as if you had succeeded at the Recall Knowledge check.

name: Petrifying Gaze Mimicry

description.value:
Either by witnessing or surviving the petrifying stare of a medusa or similar creature, you have learned to petrify those you lock eyes with. You stare at a creature you can see within 30 feet. The creature attempts a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. You must wait [[/r 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds} before using this ability again.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune to your Petrifying Gaze Mimicry for 24 hours.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is slowed 1 for 1 round and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round or until it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escapes}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 round and immobilized until it Escapes.

value.value: you have attempted a saving throw against a creature's petrifying gaze or a similar ability or have identified a creature with such an ability in combat

_desc_ko:
메두사나 유사 생물의 석화 시선을 목격하거나 생존함으로써, 당신은 시선을 맞춘 대상들을 석화시키는 법을 터득했습니다. 30피트 내 시야에 있는 생물을 응시합니다. 생물은 당신의 직업 DC와 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽에 대해 인내 내성을 시도합니다. 이 능력을 다시 사용하려면 1d4 라운드를 기다려야 합니다.

대성공 해당 생물은 영향을 받지 않으며, 24시간 동안 당신의 석화 시선 모방 능력에 대해 일시적으로 면역 상태가 됩니다.

성공 해당 생물은 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.slowed]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

실패 생물은 1라운드 동안 느려짐{1}을 받고 @link[conditions.immobilized] 상태가 됩니다. 이 상태는 1라운드 동안 지속되거나 생물이 @link[actions.escape]할 때까지 유지됩니다.

대실패 해당 생물은 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.slowed]{2} 상태가 되며, 탈출할 때까지 이동 불가 상태가 됩니다.

name: The Truth As I See It

description.value:
Your knack for spinning a believable reality from threads of story is so practiced that sometimes even you begin to believe what you're saying. When you use Deception to Lie, you can carefully structure your deceits so that each individual statement you make is the truth, from a certain perspective. Once per day when using Deception to Lie, you can roll twice and take the better result. This is a fortune effect.

You don't take a penalty to Deception checks while subject to the ring of truth spell or similar effects. Whenever you are subject to ring of truth or a similar effect, you can attempt a Deception check when you first begin speaking to counteract the spell's effects, with a counteract rank equal to half your level (rounded up); succeeding at this check doesn't end the spell or effect, but it does cause it to indicate that you are speaking the truth, even when you are actually lying.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ahBcuJWrRXEGvwxb]{Effect: The Truth As I See It}

_desc_ko:
이야기의 실타래를 엮어 믿을 만한 현실을 만들어내는 당신의 재주는 너무나 숙달되어 있어, 때로는 당신 스스로도 자신이 하는 말을 믿기 시작할 정도입니다. 기만을 이용해 거짓말을 할 때, 특정 관점에서 보면 각 개별 진술이 진실인 것처럼 속임수를 정교하게 구성할 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, 기만을 이용해 거짓말을 할 때 두 번 굴림을 하여 더 좋은 결과를 선택할 수 있습니다. 이는 행운 효과입니다.

진실의 고리 주문이나 유사한 효과에 걸려 있을 때도 기만 판정 페널티를 받지 않습니다. 진실의 고리나 유사한 효과에 걸렸을 때, 말을 시작하는 순간에 기만 판정을 시도하여 주문의 효과를 반격할 수 있다. 반격 랭크은 자신의 레벨 절반(올림)과 같다. 이 검사 성공은 주문이나 효과를 종료시키지는 않지만, 실제로 거짓말을 하고 있을 때조차 당신이 진실을 말하고 있다고 표시하게 만든다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ahBcuJWrRXEGvwxb]{효과: 내가 보는 진실}

name: Split Hex

description.value: You siphon some of the power from an offensive hex you cast to direct it at a second target as well. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell to cast a harmful hex with a single target, reduce its rank by 2 (making it 2 ranks lower than the maximum spell rank you can cast). If you do, you can select a second target for that hex to affect.

If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell to cast a harmful hex with a single target, reduce its rank by 2 (making it 2 ranks lower than the maximum spell rank you can cast). If you do, you can select a second target for that hex to affect.

name: Group Impression

description.value: When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}, you can compare your Diplomacy check result to the Will DCs of up to 10 targets you conversed with, with no penalty. The number of targets increases to 20 if you're an expert, 50 if you're a master, and 100 if you're legendary.

The number of targets increases to 20 if you're an expert, 50 if you're a master, and 100 if you're legendary.

name: Tree of Duality

description.value:
An ephemeral tree bursts forth, floating on air in an unoccupied square of your choice within 60 feet. Blooming flowers and fungal growths shed pollen and spores, which a swirling gust of air spreads in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] around it. The tree lasts until the end of your next turn, and you can Sustain it up to 1 minute. This has both of the following effects.

  • Cleansing Pollen (healing, vitality) Each living ally that's in the area or enters it regains @Damage[(floor((max(6,@actor.level)-6)/2)+3)d4[healing]] HP and is then temporarily immune to regaining HP from Tree of Duality for 10 minutes.
  • Hallucinogenic Spores (mental) Enemies in the area are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}. An enemy that leaves the area remains dazzled until the start of its next turn.

Level (+2) The healing increases by 1d4.

Level (+2) The healing increases by 1d4.
_desc_ko:
일시적인 나무가 60피트 이내의 빈 칸에 공중에 떠서 갑자기 나타납니다. 피어난 꽃과 균류가 꽃가루와 포자를 뿌리면, 소용돌이치는 돌풍이 이를 10피트 주변으로 퍼뜨립니다. 이 나무는 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 지속되며, 최대 1분 동안 유지할 수 있다. 이는 다음 두 가지 효과를 모두 가진다.

  • 정화 꽃가루 (치유, 활력) 해당 영역에 있거나 진입하는 모든 살아있는 아군은 회복 HP를 회복하며, 이후 10분 동안 이중성의 나무로부터 HP 회복 효과를 일시적으로 받지 않습니다.
  • 환각 포자 (정신) 영역 내의 적들은 @link[conditions.dazzled] 상태가 됩니다. 이 지역을 벗어난 적도 다음 턴 시작까지 눈부심 상태가 지속됩니다.

레벨 (+2) 치유량이 1d4 증가합니다.

name: Aphet Flash

description.value:
Requirements Your swarm is outside your body.

Your swarm can emit a bright flash, much like aphet beetles, a genus of flash beetles once used by Osirian miners as sources of light. Each creature in its space must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round (2 rounds on a critical failure). The swarm then glows with light like a torch until it returns to your body.

_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신의 군집은 신체 외부로 나와 있어야 합니다.

당신의 군집은 아페트 딱정벌레와 유사한 밝은 섬광을 발산할 수 있습니다. 아페트 딱정벌레는 오시리아 광부들이 한때 빛의 원천으로 사용했던 섬광 딱정벌레의 한 속입니다. 해당 공간에 있는 모든 생물은 당신의 직업 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 더 높은 쪽에 대한 인내 저항에 성공해야 하며, 실패 시 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.dazzled] 상태가 됩니다(대실패 시 2라운드). 이후 무리는 몸으로 돌아올 때까지 횃불처럼 빛을 발합니다.
