value.value: master in Arcana or Religion, depending on your chosen tradition

_desc_en: Your blood courses with magic. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{Expert Spellcasting Feat} benefits. In addition, when you Cast a Spell from your repertoire and you are at least @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}, increase the extra damage dealt by that spell from Rage by an additional 2 (for a total of 3).
_desc_ko: 당신의 피에는 마법이 흐릅니다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{전문 주문 시전 피트}의 혜택을 얻습니다. 또한, 주문 목록에서 주문을 시전할 때 분노 상태이며 최소 @link[conditions.drained]{2} 상태일 경우, 해당 주문이 분노로 가하는 추가 피해를 2 더 증가시킵니다(총 3).

name: Reclaim Spell

description.value:
You have learned to manipulate reflections of magic, similar to the resonant reflections. You reclaim the magic of an ongoing spell, using it reprepare a spell with a duration.

You Dismiss a Spell of 4th level or lower that you cast today from a spell slot with at least half its duration remaining, even if that spell can't normally be Dismissed.

You can then spend 10 minutes to reprepare the spell in that spell slot, as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.a1TSGGsA6b5gjP3H]{Reprepare Spell}.

_desc_en:
You have learned to manipulate reflections of magic, similar to the resonant reflections. You reclaim the magic of an ongoing spell, using it reprepare a spell with a duration.

You Dismiss a Spell of 4th level or lower that you cast today from a spell slot with at least half its duration remaining, even if that spell can't normally be Dismissed.

You can then spend 10 minutes to reprepare the spell in that spell slot, as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.a1TSGGsA6b5gjP3H]{Reprepare Spell}.
_desc_ko:
공명 반사와 유사하게 마법의 반사를 조작하는 법을 익혔습니다. 지속 중인 주문의 마법을 회수하여 지속 시간형 주문을 재준비하는 데 사용합니다.

당신은 오늘 시전한 4레벨 이하의 주문을, 지속 시간의 절반 이상이 남은 상태에서 주문 슬롯에서 해제할 수 있습니다. 해당 주문이 일반적으로 해제될 수 없는 경우에도 가능합니다.

그런 다음 10분을 소모하여 해당 주문 슬롯에 @link[feats.reprepare-spell]로 주문을 재준비할 수 있다.

name: Gnaw

description.value: With enough time and determination, you can chew through nearly anything. You deal double your jaws damage to an unattended, inanimate object.

_desc_en: With enough time and determination, you can chew through nearly anything. You deal double your jaws damage to an unattended, inanimate object.
_desc_ko: 충분한 시간과 결의만 있다면, 거의 모든 것을 씹어 넘길 수 있다. 방치된 무생물 대상에게 턱 피해를 두 배로 가한다.

name: Corpse Tender's Font

description.value: You easily tend to the wounds of the dead. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} as a divine innate spell once per day. This spell is heightened to half your level, rounded up. You can target only mindless undead with this spell.

_desc_en: You easily tend to the wounds of the dead. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} as a divine innate spell once per day. This spell is heightened to half your level, rounded up. You can target only mindless undead with this spell.
_desc_ko: 죽은 자의 상처를 쉽게 치료할 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, 신성 선천 마법으로 @link[spells.harm]을 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 마법은 당신의 레벨의 절반(반올림)까지 강화됩니다. 이 마법은 오직 정신이 없는 언데드만을 대상으로 할 수 있습니다.

name: Recharging Transference

description.value: You can break your spells down into raw magical potential and transfer it to an ally. Expend one prepared spell, spell slot, or Focus Point, and choose an adjacent ally or an ally within your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XIgvCPaSy5WXStVD]{Spellsurge} aura. If you expended a spell or spell slot, the ally regains one expended spell or spell slot with a rank equal to or lower than the spell or spell slot you expended. If you expended a Focus Point, the ally regains a Focus Point. This feat can't grant more spell slots or Focus Points than the target can normally possess. You can't target yourself with this ability. Only one spell, spell slot, or Focus Point can be transferred with each use of this ability.

_desc_en: You can break your spells down into raw magical potential and transfer it to an ally. Expend one prepared spell, spell slot, or Focus Point, and choose an adjacent ally or an ally within your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XIgvCPaSy5WXStVD]{Spellsurge} aura. If you expended a spell or spell slot, the ally regains one expended spell or spell slot with a rank equal to or lower than the spell or spell slot you expended. If you expended a Focus Point, the ally regains a Focus Point. This feat can't grant more spell slots or Focus Points than the target can normally possess. You can't target yourself with this ability. Only one spell, spell slot, or Focus Point can be transferred with each use of this ability.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신의 주문을 원시 마법 잠재력으로 분해하여 아군에게 전달할 수 있습니다. 준비된 주문 하나, 주문 슬롯 하나, 또는 포커스 포인트 하나를 소모하고 인접한 아군 또는 @link[spells.spellsurge] 오라 범위 내의 아군을 선택합니다. 주문이나 주문 슬롯을 소모한 경우, 아군은 소모한 주문이나 주문 슬롯과 동급 이하의 소모된 주문 하나 또는 주문 슬롯 하나를 회복합니다. 포커스를 소모한 경우, 아군은 포커스 1점을 회복합니다. 이 피트는 대상이 정상적으로 보유할 수 있는 마법 슬롯이나 포커스보다 더 많은 것을 부여할 수 없습니다. 이 능력으로 자신을 대상으로 지정할 수 없습니다. 이 능력을 사용할 때마다 하나의 주문, 마법 슬롯 또는 포커스만 이전할 수 있습니다.

name: Cat Fall

description.value: Your catlike aerial acrobatics allow you to cushion your falls. Treat falls as 10 feet shorter. If you're an expert in Acrobatics, treat falls as 25 feet shorter and 50 feet if you're a master. If you're legendary in Acrobatics, you always land on your feet and don't take damage, regardless of the distance of the fall.

_desc_en: Your catlike aerial acrobatics allow you to cushion your falls. Treat falls as 10 feet shorter. If you're an expert in Acrobatics, treat falls as 25 feet shorter and 50 feet if you're a master. If you're legendary in Acrobatics, you always land on your feet and don't take damage, regardless of the distance of the fall.
_desc_ko: 고양이 같은 공중 곡예로 낙하 충격을 완화합니다. 낙하 거리를 10피트 줄여 처리합니다. 곡예에 숙련된 경우 낙하 거리를 25피트 줄여 처리하며, 달인인 경우 50피트 줄여 처리합니다. 곡예에 전설적인 실력자라면 낙하 거리와 상관없이 항상 발로 착지하며 피해를 입지 않습니다.

name: Sense Thoughts

description.value: You have an even stranger knack for knowing what other people are thinking. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KHnhPHL4x1AQHfbC]{Mind Reading} as an innate occult spell once per day.

_desc_en: You have an even stranger knack for knowing what other people are thinking. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KHnhPHL4x1AQHfbC]{Mind Reading} as an innate occult spell once per day.
_desc_ko: 다른 사람의 생각을 알아내는 더 기이한 재주를 지녔습니다. 하루에 한 번 @link[spells.mind-reading]을 선천적 오컬트 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Incorporeal Shot

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You can concentrate an immense amount of magic to create a piece of ammunition that phases through everything but your target.

Make a bow or crossbow Strike against a foe who is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.1wQY3JYyhMYeeV2G]{Observed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to you (but not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}).

The ammunition travels to your target in a straight line, passing through any non-magical barriers or walls in its way, though magical barriers stop the arrow. The shot ignores all cover, the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition, the hidden condition, and circumstance bonuses to AC from shields. It has a +4 status bonus to hit creatures wearing any type of armor.

The Strike's damage can't be reduced with a Shield Block reaction using a non-magical shield.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You can concentrate an immense amount of magic to create a piece of ammunition that phases through everything but your target.

Make a bow or crossbow Strike against a foe who is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.1wQY3JYyhMYeeV2G]{Observed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to you (but not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}).

The ammunition travels to your target in a straight line, passing through any non-magical barriers or walls in its way, though magical barriers stop the arrow. The shot ignores all cover, the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition, the hidden condition, and circumstance bonuses to AC from shields. It has a +4 status bonus to hit creatures wearing any type of armor.

The Strike's damage can't be reduced with a Shield Block reaction using a non-magical shield.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

엄청난 양의 마법을 집중하여 목표물 외에는 모든 것을 통과하는 탄환을 생성할 수 있습니다.

당신이 @link[conditions.observed]하거나 @link[conditions.hidden] 적(@link[conditions.undetected]한 적은 제외)에게 활이나 석궁 강타를 가하십시오.

탄환은 직선으로 목표물을 향해 날아가며, 경로상의 비마법적 장벽이나 벽을 통과하지만 마법적 장벽은 화살을 막습니다. 이 공격은 모든 엄폐물, @link[conditions.concealed] 상태, 숨겨진 상태, 방패로 인한 AC 상황 보너스를 무시합니다. 모든 유형의 갑옷을 착용한 생물에게 명중 시 +4 상태 보너스를 받습니다.

이 공격의 피해는 비마법 방패를 사용한 방패 막기 반응으로 감소시킬 수 없습니다.

name: Tenacious Endurance

description.value: You encourage your companion to refuse to yield, against even the mightiest of foes. When one of your animal companions is reduced to 0 Hit Points, if it isn't wounded, it can remain standing with 1 Hit Point and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded 1}.

_desc_en: You encourage your companion to refuse to yield, against even the mightiest of foes. When one of your animal companions is reduced to 0 Hit Points, if it isn't wounded, it can remain standing with 1 Hit Point and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded 1}.
_desc_ko: 당신은 동료에게 가장 강력한 적 앞에서도 항복하지 말라고 독려합니다. 당신의 동물 동료 중 하나가 HP가 0이 되었을 때, 부상 상태가 아니라면 1의 HP를 유지한 채 서 있을 수 있으며 @link[conditions.wounded]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Necromantic Heir

description.value: Your affinity for void energy spills outward and grants you a refilling well of necromantic essence. Once per hour, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} as a 6th-rank divine innate spell.

_desc_en: Your affinity for void energy spills outward and grants you a refilling well of necromantic essence. Once per hour, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} as a 6th-rank divine innate spell.
_desc_ko: 공허 에너지에 대한 당신의 친화력이 외부로 흘러나와 네크로맨틱 정수의 재충전되는 샘을 부여합니다. 시간당 한 번, @link[spells.harm]을 (6th)랭크 신성 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Avenge Ally

description.value:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

Requirements You are within 30 feet of an ally with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition.

Though you know that you will eventually outlive your companions, seeing them at death's door brings clarity to your attacks. Make a Strike. Roll twice on the attack roll and use the higher result.

_desc_en:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

Requirements You are within 30 feet of an ally with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition.

Though you know that you will eventually outlive your companions, seeing them at death's door brings clarity to your attacks. Make a Strike. Roll twice on the attack roll and use the higher result.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 10분마다 한 번

요구 사항 @link[conditions.dying] 상태인 아군으로부터 30피트 이내에 위치해야 합니다.

동료들보다 오래 살게 될 것을 알지만, 그들이 죽음의 문턱에 선 모습을 보며 공격에 집중력이 생깁니다. 타격을 가하세요. 명중 굴림을 두 번 굴리고 높은 결과를 사용합니다.

name: Instinctive Strike

description.value: You trust your instincts and your sense of smell, using all your senses to pinpoint your opponent's location. When you make a melee Strike against an opponent you're detecting using scent, ignore any flat check required due to the target being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}.

_desc_en: You trust your instincts and your sense of smell, using all your senses to pinpoint your opponent's location. When you make a melee Strike against an opponent you're detecting using scent, ignore any flat check required due to the target being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}.
_desc_ko: 당신은 본능과 후각을 믿으며, 모든 감각을 동원해 상대의 위치를 정확히 파악합니다. 냄새로 감지 중인 상대에게 근접 공격을 할 때, 대상이 @link[conditions.concealed] 또는 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태라 요구되는 단순 판정 수치를 무시한다.

name: Faultless Defense

description.value:
Trigger You would take damage from a Strike made by a creature.

As you are struck, your steely determination reminds those who fight you that they are destined to be no more than footnotes in your tale. Spend a Mythic Point to gain resistance equal to half your level to the triggering damage, and then attempt a Strike at mythic proficiency against the creature that attacked you. If the Strike hits and deals damage, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

_desc_en:
Trigger You would take damage from a Strike made by a creature.

As you are struck, your steely determination reminds those who fight you that they are destined to be no more than footnotes in your tale. Spend a Mythic Point to gain resistance equal to half your level to the triggering damage, and then attempt a Strike at mythic proficiency against the creature that attacked you. If the Strike hits and deals damage, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.
_desc_ko:
Trigger 당신은 생물의 공격으로 피해를 입을 뻔했다.

공격을 받는 순간, 당신의 강철 같은 결의는 당신과 싸우는 자들에게 그들이 당신의 이야기 속 한 줄의 각주에 불과할 운명임을 상기시킨다. 신화 포인트 1점을 소모하여 발동 피해에 대해 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 저항력을 얻고, 당신을 공격한 생물에게 신화 숙련도로 공격을 시도합니다. 공격이 명중하여 피해를 입히면, 해당 생물은 @link[conditions.slowed]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Awakened Magic

description.value: When you awakened, primal magic was released within you. Choose one cantrip from the primal spell list. You can cast this spell as an primal innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

_desc_en: When you awakened, primal magic was released within you. Choose one cantrip from the primal spell list. You can cast this spell as an primal innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 깨어남과 동시에 프라이멀 마법이 당신 안에서 해방되었습니다. 프라이멀 주문 목록에서 캔트립 하나를 선택하십시오. 이 주문을 프라이멀 선천적 주문으로 마음대로 시전할 수 있습니다. 캔트립은 당신의 레벨 절반(올림)에 해당하는 주문 랭크으로 강화됩니다.

name: Arcane Communication

description.value:
You can deliver silent messages. You gain touch telepathy, allowing you to communicate silently and mentally with any creature you're touching, as long as you share a language.

Enhancement You can send your messages even further. Your telepathy gains a range of 10 feet, but you still have to share a language with your target.

_desc_en:
You can deliver silent messages. You gain touch telepathy, allowing you to communicate silently and mentally with any creature you're touching, as long as you share a language.

Enhancement You can send your messages even further. Your telepathy gains a range of 10 feet, but you still have to share a language with your target.
_desc_ko:
소리 없는 메시지를 전달할 수 있습니다. 접촉 텔레파시 능력을 얻어, 언어를 공유하는 모든 생물과 접촉한 상태에서 소리 없이 정신적으로 소통할 수 있습니다.

강화 메시지를 더 멀리 보낼 수 있습니다. 텔레파시 범위가 10피트 증가하지만, 여전히 대상과 언어를 공유해야 합니다.

name: Persistent Boost

description.value: Your innovation sets foes on fire, covers them in acid, leaves barbed thorns behind, or otherwise deals persistent damage to your foes that sticks around long after you deliver your boosted attack. When you or your construct innovation damage a foe with offensive boost, that foe also takes 1d8 persistent damage of the same damage type as the offensive boost damage.

_desc_en: Your innovation sets foes on fire, covers them in acid, leaves barbed thorns behind, or otherwise deals persistent damage to your foes that sticks around long after you deliver your boosted attack. When you or your construct innovation damage a foe with offensive boost, that foe also takes 1d8 persistent damage of the same damage type as the offensive boost damage.
_desc_ko: 당신의 혁신은 적을 불태우거나, 산성으로 뒤덮거나, 가시덤불을 남기거나, 강화 공격 후에도 오랫동안 지속되는 피해를 적에게 입힙니다. 당신이나 당신의 창조물이 공격 부스트로 적에게 피해를 입힐 때, 해당 적은 공격 부스트 피해와 동일한 피해 유형의 지속 피해 1d8을 추가로 받습니다.

name: Verdant Presence

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You take damage or cast a primal spell.

The life-giving properties of the aeon orbs flourish within you. Small plants or fungi magically appear on all surfaces in a @Template[emanation|distance:60] around you. This life withers after 1 day unless the environment can support it. You can choose one of the following options each time you use this feat.

  • You can cause any number of 5-foot squares in the area to be light undergrowth, which is difficult terrain and provides lesser cover.
  • You can cause a tree or giant mushroom to appear in any unoccupied location in the area; it occupies an entire 5-foot square and provides standard cover. The tree or mushroom has 5 Hardness and 50 Hit Points.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You take damage or cast a primal spell.

The life-giving properties of the aeon orbs flourish within you. Small plants or fungi magically appear on all surfaces in a @Template[emanation|distance:60] around you. This life withers after 1 day unless the environment can support it. You can choose one of the following options each time you use this feat.

  • You can cause any number of 5-foot squares in the area to be light undergrowth, which is difficult terrain and provides lesser cover.
  • You can cause a tree or giant mushroom to appear in any unoccupied location in the area; it occupies an entire 5-foot square and provides standard cover. The tree or mushroom has 5 Hardness and 50 Hit Points.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

발동 당신이 피해를 입거나 프라이멀 주문을 시전합니다.

영원 구슬의 생명력 부여 특성이 당신 안에서 활짝 피어납니다. 당신 주변 60피트 반경 내 모든 표면에 작은 식물이나 균류가 마법처럼 나타납니다. 이 생명체는 환경이 이를 지탱할 수 없는 한 1일 후 시들게 됩니다. 이 피트를 사용할 때마다 다음 옵션 중 하나를 선택할 수 있습니다.

  • 영역 내 원하는 수의 5피트 칸에 가벼운 덤불을 생성할 수 있습니다. 이는 어려운 지형이며 반엄폐를 제공합니다.
  • 해당 영역 내 비어 있는 위치에 나무나 거대 버섯을 생성할 수 있습니다. 이는 5피트 칸 전체를 차지하며 엄폐를 제공합니다. 나무나 버섯은 경도 5와 HP 50을 가집니다.

name: Slink

description.value: You can move through gloom with the speed of darkness. You can move 5 feet farther when you take the Sneak action, up to your Speed. In addition, as long as you continue to use Sneak actions and succeed at your Stealth check, you don't become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.1wQY3JYyhMYeeV2G]{Observed} if you end a Sneak action in dim light or darkness, as long as you have cover or greater cover or are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} at the end of your turn.

_desc_en: You can move through gloom with the speed of darkness. You can move 5 feet farther when you take the Sneak action, up to your Speed. In addition, as long as you continue to use Sneak actions and succeed at your Stealth check, you don't become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.1wQY3JYyhMYeeV2G]{Observed} if you end a Sneak action in dim light or darkness, as long as you have cover or greater cover or are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} at the end of your turn.
_desc_ko: 어둠 속을 어둠의 속도로 이동할 수 있습니다. {은밀 이동} 행동을 취할 때 최대 이동 속도까지 5피트 더 멀리 이동할 수 있습니다. 또한, 은밀 이동 행동을 계속 사용하고 은신 판정에서 성공하는 한, 은밀 이동 행동을 희미한 빛이나 어둠 속에서 끝내더라도, 커버나 완전 엄폐를 가지고 있거나 턴 종료 시 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태라면 @link[conditions.observed] 상태가 되지 않습니다.

name: Armor Assist

description.value:
After your service aiding armored combatants, you are practiced in helping yourself and others don heavy gear.

You can attempt an Athletics or Warfare Lore check with a DC determined by the GM (but usually 15 for common armor, DC 20 for uncommon armor, and DC 25 for rare armor) to halve the time you take to don armor.

You can halve an ally's time to don armor by working with them to don the armor and succeeding at an Athletics or Warfare Lore check against the same DC.

value.value: trained in Athletics or Warfare Lore

_desc_en:
After your service aiding armored combatants, you are practiced in helping yourself and others don heavy gear.

You can attempt an Athletics or Warfare Lore check with a DC determined by the GM (but usually 15 for common armor, DC 20 for uncommon armor, and DC 25 for rare armor) to halve the time you take to don armor.

You can halve an ally's time to don armor by working with them to don the armor and succeeding at an Athletics or Warfare Lore check against the same DC.
_desc_ko:
갑옷을 입은 전사들을 돕는 임무를 수행한 경험으로, 자신과 타인이 중갑을 착용하도록 돕는 데 능숙해졌습니다.

GM이 정한 DC(일반 갑옷은 보통 15, 희귀 갑옷은 20, 초희귀 갑옷은 25)의 운동 또는 전쟁학 지식 판정을 시도하여 갑옷 착용 시간을 절반으로 줄일 수 있다.

동료와 협력하여 갑옷을 착용하고 동일한 DC에 대해 운동 또는 전쟁 지식 판정에 성공하면 동료의 갑옷 착용 시간을 절반으로 줄일 수 있습니다.

name: Ferocious Shape

description.value: You've mastered the shape of dinosaurs. Add the shapes listed in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KhM8MhoUgoUjBMIz]{Dinosaur Form} to your untamed form list. Whenever you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form} to take a shape that grants you a specific Athletics modifier, you gain a +1 status bonus to your Athletics checks.

_desc_en: You've mastered the shape of dinosaurs. Add the shapes listed in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KhM8MhoUgoUjBMIz]{Dinosaur Form} to your untamed form list. Whenever you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form} to take a shape that grants you a specific Athletics modifier, you gain a +1 status bonus to your Athletics checks.
_desc_ko: 공룡의 형태를 마스터했습니다. @link[spells.dinosaur-form]에 나열된 형태들을 당신의 야생 형태 목록에 추가하세요. @link[spells.untamed-form]를 사용하여 특정 운동 수정자를 부여하는 형태를 취할 때마다, 운동 판정에서 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Living Stone

description.value: Your body becomes living stone. You don't need to eat or drink and need only 6 hours of rest to feel well rested. You must still rest at least 8 hours and spend 1 hour of preparation to regain resources usable only a limited number of times per day, such as spell slots. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases, poisons, and effects that would cause the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} conditions. When you roll a successful saving throw against a disease or poison, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: Your body becomes living stone. You don't need to eat or drink and need only 6 hours of rest to feel well rested. You must still rest at least 8 hours and spend 1 hour of preparation to regain resources usable only a limited number of times per day, such as spell slots. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases, poisons, and effects that would cause the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} conditions. When you roll a successful saving throw against a disease or poison, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신의 몸이 살아있는 돌이 됩니다. 음식이나 음료가 필요하지 않으며, 6시간의 휴식만으로 충분히 휴식을 취한 상태가 됩니다. 하지만 하루에 제한된 횟수만 사용할 수 있는 자원(예: 주문 슬롯)을 회복하려면 여전히 최소 8시간의 휴식과 1시간의 준비 시간이 필요합니다. 질병, 독, 그리고 @link[conditions.paralyzed] 또는 @link[conditions.stunned] 상태를 유발하는 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 질병이나 독에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공할 경우, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Sage of Scattered Leaves

description.value:
The epics of your people's tragic yet proud history blaze like burning leaves in the forests of ancestral memory. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Nature and Religion. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Yaksha Lore.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
The epics of your people's tragic yet proud history blaze like burning leaves in the forests of ancestral memory. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Nature and Religion. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Yaksha Lore.
_desc_ko:
조상의 기억 숲속에서 타오르는 낙엽처럼, 당신의 민족이 겪은 비극적이면서도 자랑스러운 역사의 서사시가 불타오릅니다. 자연과 종교에 숙련 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 해당 기술 중 하나에 자동으로 숙련이 부여될 경우, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련이 부여됩니다.

또한 야크샤 지식에 대한 @link[feats.additional-lore] 일반 피트를 획득합니다.

name: No Hard Feelings

description.value: Despite the devastation your weapons tend to inflict upon their targets or the destruction you might unleash upon an area, your foes still manage to walk away at the end of a fight-at least sometimes. You can choose to add the nonlethal trait to your ranged weapons, making the choice of whether to add the trait or not just before each Strike.

_desc_en: Despite the devastation your weapons tend to inflict upon their targets or the destruction you might unleash upon an area, your foes still manage to walk away at the end of a fight-at least sometimes. You can choose to add the nonlethal trait to your ranged weapons, making the choice of whether to add the trait or not just before each Strike.
_desc_ko: 당신의 무기가 대상에게 가하는 파괴력이나 지역에 퍼붓는 파괴에도 불구하고, 적들은 전투 끝에 종종 무사히 빠져나간다. 원거리 무기에 비살상 특성을 추가할 수 있으며, 각 공격 직전에 해당 특성을 적용할지 여부를 선택할 수 있다.

name: Freeze It!

description.value:
You are no rime hag or Jadwiga, but the magic of the north has still left a mark on you. Frigid ice runs through your veins, and you can expel frost from your body to freeze your foes. Attempt an @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the Fortitude DC of an adjacent foe. If you have master proficiency in Athletics, you can affect up to two adjacent foes, rolling one Athletics check against each foe.

Critical Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} for 1 round.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

_desc_en:
You are no rime hag or Jadwiga, but the magic of the north has still left a mark on you. Frigid ice runs through your veins, and you can expel frost from your body to freeze your foes. Attempt an @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the Fortitude DC of an adjacent foe. If you have master proficiency in Athletics, you can affect up to two adjacent foes, rolling one Athletics check against each foe.

Critical Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} for 1 round.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is temporarily immune for 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
당신은 서리 마녀나 야드비가는 아니지만, 북방의 마법이 여전히 당신에게 흔적을 남겼습니다. 얼음처럼 차가운 기운이 네 혈관을 흐르며, 네 몸에서 서리를 내뿜어 적을 얼릴 수 있다. 인접한 적의 인내 DC에 맞서 운동 판정을 시도하다. 운동 숙련도를 달인한 경우, 인접한 적 최대 두 명에게 영향을 줄 수 있으며 각 적마다 하나의 운동 판정을 굴림.

대성공 대상은 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.clumsy]{2} 상태가 된다.

성공 대상은 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.clumsy]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

대실패 대상은 1분 동안 일시적으로 면역 상태가 됩니다.

name: Unlimited Ghost Flight

description.value: You put your connection to the material world farther behind you. Your fly Speed no longer restricts the height you can fly. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.zJXsGF61lH0WHw5v]{Ghost Flight}, instead of its normal effect, you gain a +10-foot status bonus to your fly Speed for 10 minutes.

_desc_en: You put your connection to the material world farther behind you. Your fly Speed no longer restricts the height you can fly. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.zJXsGF61lH0WHw5v]{Ghost Flight}, instead of its normal effect, you gain a +10-foot status bonus to your fly Speed for 10 minutes.
_desc_ko: 당신은 물질계와의 연결을 더욱 멀리 뒤로 남깁니다. 비행 속도가 더 이상 비행 고도를 제한하지 않습니다. @link[feats.ghost-flight]을 사용할 때, 일반 효과 대신 10분 동안 비행 속도에 +10피트 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Withstand Death

description.value: Through repeated exposure, you've trained to resist the damage wrought by undead. Your resistance to void damage also applies to damage dealt by the attacks and abilities of undead creatures, regardless of damage type.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en: Through repeated exposure, you've trained to resist the damage wrought by undead. Your resistance to void damage also applies to damage dealt by the attacks and abilities of undead creatures, regardless of damage type.
_desc_ko: 반복적인 노출을 통해, 당신은 언데드가 가하는 피해에 저항하도록 훈련되었습니다. 공허 피해에 대한 당신의 저항력은 피해 유형에 관계없이 언데드 생물의 공격과 능력으로 가해지는 피해에도 적용됩니다.

name: Adept Storyteller

description.value: Your ability to tell stories rivals those of the finest bards. You can use your proficiency rank in any skill that can be used to Recall Knowledge to meet the requirements of skill feats that require a particular rank in Performance. You gain two Performance skill feats of 7th level or lower that you meet the prerequisites for.

value.value: master in a Recall Knowledge skill

_desc_en: Your ability to tell stories rivals those of the finest bards. You can use your proficiency rank in any skill that can be used to Recall Knowledge to meet the requirements of skill feats that require a particular rank in Performance. You gain two Performance skill feats of 7th level or lower that you meet the prerequisites for.
_desc_ko: 당신의 이야기 전달 능력은 최고의 음유시인들과 견줄 만합니다. 지식 회상에 사용 가능한 모든 기술의 숙련도 등급을 활용하여, 공연 기술의 특정 등급을 요구하는 기술 피트의 요건을 충족시킬 수 있습니다. 전제 조건을 충족하는 7레벨 이하의 공연 기술 피트 두 가지를 획득합니다.

name: Rise, My Creature!

description.value:
You have created life! You have usurped the power of the gods themselves! You gain a prototype construct companion pieced together from corpses and animated by chemicals or Stasian technology. You use Medicine in place of Crafting to Repair your construct or rebuild it if it's been destroyed.

Your creation has an affinity for the lightning that brought it to life. When your construct companion takes electricity damage, it gains a +1 circumstance bonus to its Athletics skill checks until the end of its next turn.

Although the coils or alchemical residue make it obvious to you and those with similar training that your creation is not undead, others must generally succeed at a @Check[crafting|dc:15], @Check[medicine|dc:15], or @Check[religion|dc:15] check to verify those claims with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}.

_desc_en:
You have created life! You have usurped the power of the gods themselves! You gain a prototype construct companion pieced together from corpses and animated by chemicals or Stasian technology. You use Medicine in place of Crafting to Repair your construct or rebuild it if it's been destroyed.

Your creation has an affinity for the lightning that brought it to life. When your construct companion takes electricity damage, it gains a +1 circumstance bonus to its Athletics skill checks until the end of its next turn.

Although the coils or alchemical residue make it obvious to you and those with similar training that your creation is not undead, others must generally succeed at a @Check[crafting|dc:15], @Check[medicine|dc:15], or @Check[religion|dc:15] check to verify those claims with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}.
_desc_ko:
당신은 생명을 창조했습니다! 신들의 힘을 빼앗은 것입니다! 시체로 조각조각 만들어 화학 물질이나 스타시안 기술로 움직이게 한 프로토타입 구조체 동반자를 얻습니다. 파괴된 구조체를 수리하거나 재조립할 때 제작 대신 의학 기술을 사용합니다.

당신의 창조물은 생명을 불어넣은 번개에 대한 친화력을 지녔습니다. 구조물 동료가 전기 피해를 입으면, 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 운동 기술 판정에서 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

코일이나 연금술 잔여물로 인해 당신과 유사한 훈련을 받은 자들에게는 창조물이 언데드가 아님을 명백히 알 수 있지만, 다른 이들은 일반적으로 DC 15 제작, DC 15 의학 또는 DC 15 종교학 판정에 성공해야만 @link[actions.recall-knowledge].

name: Palatine Detective Dedication

description.value:
You have delved into the study of the occult and divine, becoming exceptionally skilled at identifying when such forces are at work. Using this esoteric knowledge and your own ingenuity, you have crafted a small charm that soothes your mind and protects you against harm. This charm usually takes the form of a silver chain, a golden scarab, or a withered hand. While you wear this charm, you gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against mental effects. In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ur4AfegC9RqRgy3e]{Mystic Aegis} reaction.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.jnx6oWfmhuKetO2j]{Palatine Detective}

_desc_en:
You have delved into the study of the occult and divine, becoming exceptionally skilled at identifying when such forces are at work. Using this esoteric knowledge and your own ingenuity, you have crafted a small charm that soothes your mind and protects you against harm. This charm usually takes the form of a silver chain, a golden scarab, or a withered hand. While you wear this charm, you gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against mental effects. In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ur4AfegC9RqRgy3e]{Mystic Aegis} reaction.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.jnx6oWfmhuKetO2j]{Palatine Detective}
_desc_ko: 당신은 오컬트·신성한 현상에 대한 연구를 깊이 탐구하여, 그러한 힘이 작용하는 시점을 식별하는 데 탁월한 능력을 갖추게 되었습니다. 이 신비한 지식과 자신의 독창성을 활용하여, 마음을 진정시키고 해로부터 보호해주는 작은 부적을 제작했습니다. 이 부적은 보통 은색 사슬, 황금 풍뎅이, 또는 시든 손의 형태를 띱니다. 이 부적을 착용 중일 때, 정신 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 또한 @link[actions.mystic-aegis] 반응을 얻습니다.

name: Rose Warden Dedication

description.value:
As a follower of the Everbloom, you stand up against tyranny and oppression, understanding that revolution against an unjust ruler must sometimes be enacted in secret. You become trained in Deception. If you're already trained in Deception, you become an expert in your choice of Deception or Stealth. When you get a critical success to Lie to a figure of authority, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude DC and saving throws against being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by that figure of authority for 24 hours.

You add the edicts and anathema of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.fTJLgTfEMZreJ19r]{Milani} to your own. Failing to uphold edicts or committing acts that violate the anathema result in you losing access to any abilities granted by this archetype, as determined by your GM. You can regain these lost abilities through the atone ritual as normal.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.bdzVlHHuGGDEreTx]{Effect: Rose Warden Dedication}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.sUXT7lhQp3znvDAV]{Rose Warden}

_desc_ko:
상록화의 추종자로서, 당신은 폭정과 억압에 맞서 일어서며, 부당한 통치자에 대한 혁명이 때로는 은밀히 이루어져야 함을 이해합니다. 당신은 기만에 숙련이 됩니다. 이미 기만에 숙련되어 있다면, 기만 또는 은신 중 선택하여 전문가가 됩니다. 권위자에게 거짓말을 해서 대성공을 거두면, 당신은 그 권위자에 의한 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{혼란}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{지배됨}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{조이기}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{이동 불가}, 또는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{억제}에 대한 내성 굴림과 완강함 DC에 24시간 동안 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.fTJLgTfEMZreJ19r]{밀라니}의 교리와 금기를 당신 자신의 것에 더합니다. 교리를 지키지 못하거나 금기를 위반하는 행위를 저지르면, GM의 판단에 따라 이 아키타입이 부여하는 능력의 사용권을 잃습니다. 당신은 평소처럼 속죄 의식을 통해 이 잃은 능력을 되찾을 수 있습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.bdzVlHHuGGDEreTx]{효과: 장미 파수꾼 헌신}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.sUXT7lhQp3znvDAV]{장미 파수꾼}

name: Soothing Ballad

description.value: You soothe your allies' wounds with the power of your performance. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0JigNJDRwevZOyjI]{Soothing Ballad} composition spell.

_desc_en: You soothe your allies' wounds with the power of your performance. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0JigNJDRwevZOyjI]{Soothing Ballad} composition spell.
_desc_ko: 당신은 공연의 힘으로 아군의 상처를 달래줍니다. @link[spells.soothing-ballad] 작곡 주문을 배웁니다.

name: Guiding Words

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Your words speak divine truth, guiding blades and arrows to their mark. Choose an ally within 30 feet and attempt a @Check[diplomacy] check. The DC is equal to the hard difficulty DC of the level of your ally. On a success, the first time the targeted ally makes an attack roll before the end of their next turn, they roll the attack twice and use the better result.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.9hIzh4UvjSTyYBby]{Effect: Guiding Words}

Regardless of the result, the target becomes immune to Guiding Words for 10 minutes.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Your words speak divine truth, guiding blades and arrows to their mark. Choose an ally within 30 feet and attempt a @Check[diplomacy] check. The DC is equal to the hard difficulty DC of the level of your ally. On a success, the first time the targeted ally makes an attack roll before the end of their next turn, they roll the attack twice and use the better result.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.9hIzh4UvjSTyYBby]{Effect: Guiding Words}

Regardless of the result, the target becomes immune to Guiding Words for 10 minutes.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 10분에 한 번

당신의 말은 신성한 진리를 전하며, 검과 화살을 목표물로 인도합니다. 30피트 내의 아군을 선택하고 외교 판정을 시도하십시오. DC는 아군의 레벨에 해당하는 어려운 난이도 DC와 같습니다. 성공 시, 대상 아군이 다음 턴이 끝나기 전에 처음으로 명중 굴림을 수행할 때, 명중 굴림을 두 번 굴리고 더 좋은 결과를 사용합니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.9hIzh4UvjSTyYBby]{효과: 인도하는 말}

결과와 상관없이 대상은 10분 동안 인도하는 말에 면역이 됩니다.

name: Heal Mount

description.value:
Your devotion to your mount manifests as a surge of vital energy.

When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zNN9212H2FGfM7VS]{Lay on Hands} on your mount, instead of the normal amount, the spell restores 10 Hit Points, plus 10 for each heightened rank.

_desc_en:
Your devotion to your mount manifests as a surge of vital energy.

When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zNN9212H2FGfM7VS]{Lay on Hands} on your mount, instead of the normal amount, the spell restores 10 Hit Points, plus 10 for each heightened rank.
_desc_ko:
당신의 탈것에 대한 헌신이 생명력의 급증으로 창조됩니다.

승용동물에게 @link[spells.lay-on-hands]를 시전할 때, 일반적인 회복량 대신 10의 HP를 회복하며, 강화 랭크마다 추가로 10씩 회복합니다.

name: Wind Seeker

description.value:
Wings free you from the shackles of the ground below. You add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.NzXpEzcZAjuDTZjK]{Aerial Form} to your apparition spell repertoire, allowing you to cast it with your apparition spellcasting. Whenever you use aerial form to gain a form that grants you a specific Acrobatics modifier, you gain a +1 status bonus to Acrobatics checks.

Special If you are attuned to an apparition of darkened boughs, add the bat and bird forms in aerial form to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.BhJtCTLbngvZm8EA]{Darkened Forest Form} lists.

_desc_en:
Wings free you from the shackles of the ground below. You add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.NzXpEzcZAjuDTZjK]{Aerial Form} to your apparition spell repertoire, allowing you to cast it with your apparition spellcasting. Whenever you use aerial form to gain a form that grants you a specific Acrobatics modifier, you gain a +1 status bonus to Acrobatics checks.

Special If you are attuned to an apparition of darkened boughs, add the bat and bird forms in aerial form to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.BhJtCTLbngvZm8EA]{Darkened Forest Form} lists.
_desc_ko:
날개는 땅의 섀클스에서 당신을 해방시킵니다. 당신은 @link[spells.aerial-form]를 유령 소환 주문 목록에 추가하여, 유령 소환 주문 시전 능력으로 이를 시전할 수 있습니다. 공중 형태를 사용해 특정 곡예 수정자를 부여하는 형태를 획득할 때마다, 곡예 판정에서 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

특수 어둠에 잠긴 나뭇가지의 환영과 조율된 상태라면, 공중 형태의 박쥐와 새 형태를 @link[spells.darkened-forest-form] 목록에 추가한다.

name: Azaersi's Roads

description.value: Azaersi has granted you limited access to the Stone Roads, attuning you to the tiniest sliver of the Onyx Key. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5bTt2CvYHPvaR7QQ]{Interplanar Teleport} as a primal innate spell. You can cast it twice per week. This can be used only to travel back and forth between the Plane of Earth and the Material Plane. Due to your attunement to the Onyx Key, you can act as the spell focus, and you do not require a tuning fork.

_desc_en: Azaersi has granted you limited access to the Stone Roads, attuning you to the tiniest sliver of the Onyx Key. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5bTt2CvYHPvaR7QQ]{Interplanar Teleport} as a primal innate spell. You can cast it twice per week. This can be used only to travel back and forth between the Plane of Earth and the Material Plane. Due to your attunement to the Onyx Key, you can act as the spell focus, and you do not require a tuning fork.
_desc_ko: 아자르시가 당신에게 오닉스 열쇠의 아주 작은 조각에 조율되도록 하여 돌길에 대한 제한된 접근을 허락했습니다. 당신은 @link[spells.interplanar-teleport]을 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 얻습니다. 이 주술은 주당 두 번 시전할 수 있습니다. 오직 대지의 차원과 물질계 사이를 오가는 이동에만 사용 가능합니다. 오닉스 열쇠와의 조율 덕분에, 당신은 주술의 포커스로 작용할 수 있으며, 조율용 음차(音叉)가 필요하지 않습니다.

name: Staff Acrobat Dedication

description.value:
When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump} while wielding your staff, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to any Athletics check required and add 5 feet to the distance you can Leap vertically and horizontally. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} even if you don't have a free hand, provided you are wielding your staff. Finally, when you roll a success on a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} while wielding your staff, you get a critical success instead.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.BRxlFHXu8tN14TDI]{Staff Acrobat}

value.value: trained with at least one of the following weapons: staff, bo staff, halfling sling staff, or any weapon in the spear or polearm group (referred to in this archetype as "your staff")

publication.title: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On

_desc_en:
When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump} while wielding your staff, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to any Athletics check required and add 5 feet to the distance you can Leap vertically and horizontally. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} even if you don't have a free hand, provided you are wielding your staff. Finally, when you roll a success on a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} while wielding your staff, you get a critical success instead.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.BRxlFHXu8tN14TDI]{Staff Acrobat}
_desc_ko: 지팡이를 휘두르며 @link[actions.high-jump], @link[actions.leap], 또는 @link[actions.long-jump]를 수행할 때, 필요한 운동 판정에는 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며 수직 및 수평 도약 거리가 5피트 증가합니다. 지팡이를 휘두르고 있는 경우, 빈 손이 없더라도 @link[actions.shove]와 @link[actions.trip]를 사용할 수 있습니다. 마지막으로, 지팡이를 휘두르고 있는 상태에서 @link[actions.balance] 판정에서 성공을 굴릴 경우, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Nodal Healing

description.value: You can induce wound repair by circulating magic throughout your body. If you rest for 10 minutes, you regain Hit Points equal to your @Damage[(@actor.system.abilities.con.mod * floor(@actor.level/2))[healing]]{Constitution modifier × half your level}. This is a magical healing effect and is cumulative with any healing you receive from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}.

_desc_en: You can induce wound repair by circulating magic throughout your body. If you rest for 10 minutes, you regain Hit Points equal to your @Damage[(@actor.system.abilities.con.mod * floor(@actor.level/2))[healing]]{Constitution modifier × half your level}. This is a magical healing effect and is cumulative with any healing you receive from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}.
_desc_ko: 마법을 전신에 순환시켜 상처 회복을 유도할 수 있습니다. 10분간 휴식을 취하면 건강 수정자 × 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 HP를 회복한다. 이는 마법적 치유 효과로, @link[actions.treat-wounds]로 받는 치유 효과와 중첩된다.

name: Construct Shell

description.value:
You've adjusted your construct innovation so that when you ride it, special plates, hollows, or similar form partial barriers around you to add additional protection. You have lesser cover from all attacks when mounted on your construct innovation, not just from attacks where the construct would be in the way.

Additionally, if your construct uses an emanation while you're riding on it, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.naKVqd8POxcnGclz]{Explode}, you can choose not to be affected by the emanation.

_desc_en:
You've adjusted your construct innovation so that when you ride it, special plates, hollows, or similar form partial barriers around you to add additional protection. You have lesser cover from all attacks when mounted on your construct innovation, not just from attacks where the construct would be in the way.

Additionally, if your construct uses an emanation while you're riding on it, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.naKVqd8POxcnGclz]{Explode}, you can choose not to be affected by the emanation.
_desc_ko:
당신은 구조체 혁신을 조정하여 탑승 시 특수한 판, 오목부 또는 유사한 형태가 주변에 부분적인 장벽을 형성해 추가 보호를 제공합니다. 구조체 혁신에 탑승 중일 때는 구조체가 방해가 되는 공격뿐만 아니라 모든 공격으로부터 반엄폐 효과를 받습니다.

또한, 당신이 탑승 중일 때 창조물이 @link[actions.explode]과 같은 발산 효과를 사용하면, 그 발산 효과의 영향을 받지 않도록 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Commitment to Valor

description.value:
Trigger You would gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition.

While fear might distract you from your duty, it'll never cause you to abandon it. Instead of becoming fleeing, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for as long you would be fleeing. If you have the frightened condition, decrease its value by 1.

_desc_en:
Trigger You would gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition.

While fear might distract you from your duty, it'll never cause you to abandon it. Instead of becoming fleeing, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for as long you would be fleeing. If you have the frightened condition, decrease its value by 1.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신이 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{도주} 상태를 얻으려 합니다.

공포가 당신의 의무에서 주의를 흐트러뜨릴 수는 있어도, 결코 그것을 저버리게 만들지는 못합니다. 도주가 되는 대신, 당신은 도주 상태였을 기간 동안 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{멍함 1}이 됩니다. 당신이 공포 상태라면, 그 값을 1 줄입니다.

name: Story Crooner

description.value: You're a talented story weaver and use your voice effectively. You are trained in Performance. If you would automatically become trained in Performance, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Impressive Performance skill feat and gain a +1 circumstance bonus when Performing for an audience of strix.

_desc_en: You're a talented story weaver and use your voice effectively. You are trained in Performance. If you would automatically become trained in Performance, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Impressive Performance skill feat and gain a +1 circumstance bonus when Performing for an audience of strix.
_desc_ko: 당신은 재능 있는 이야기꾼이며 목소리를 효과적으로 활용합니다. 공연 기술에 숙련되어 있습니다. 자동으로 공연 기술 숙련 상태가 되는 대신, 원하는 기술 하나를 숙련 상태로 선택할 수 있습니다. 또한 인상적인 공연 기술 피트를 획득하며, 스트릭스 관객 앞에서 공연할 때 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Clan Pistol

description.value:
Access You are from Dongun Hold or Alkenstar.

Raised in the ancient halls of Dongun Hold or the surrounding region, you display your lineage with a clan pistol, rather than a clan dagger. You get one clan pistol of your clan for free, as it was given to you at birth. This replaces your clan dagger. Selling this pistol is a terrible taboo and earns you the disdain of other dwarves. You are trained with the clan pistol. In addition, when your clan pistol is visible, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus on checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} when interacting with citizens of Alkenstar, Dongun Hold, or their allies.

_desc_en:
Access You are from Dongun Hold or Alkenstar.

Raised in the ancient halls of Dongun Hold or the surrounding region, you display your lineage with a clan pistol, rather than a clan dagger. You get one clan pistol of your clan for free, as it was given to you at birth. This replaces your clan dagger. Selling this pistol is a terrible taboo and earns you the disdain of other dwarves. You are trained with the clan pistol. In addition, when your clan pistol is visible, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus on checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} when interacting with citizens of Alkenstar, Dongun Hold, or their allies.
_desc_ko:
접근 당신은 동운 홀드 또는 알켄스터 출신입니다.

동군 홀의 고대 전당이나 그 주변 지역에서 자라난 당신은 클랜 단검 대신 클랜 권총으로 혈통을 드러냅니다. 출생 시 받은 클랜 권총 한 자루를 무료로 획득합니다. 이는 클랜 단검을 대체합니다. 이 권총을 판매하는 것은 끔찍한 금기이며 다른 드워프들의 경멸을 사게 됩니다. 당신은 클랜 권총 사용에 숙련되어 있습니다. 또한, 클랜 권총이 노출된 상태에서 알켄스터, 동운 홀드 또는 그 동맹 시민들과 교류할 때 @link[actions.gather-information] 또는 @link[actions.make-an-impression] 판정 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Electrify Armor

description.value:
Requirements You are wearing your armor innovation.

You electrify your armor to punish foes who dare to attack you. For 1 round, any creature that touches you, or that hits you with a melee unarmed attack or a non-reach melee weapon attack, takes @Damage[1d4[electricity]|overrideTraits] damage. The effect ends if you cease wearing your armor innovation.

If you have the revolutionary innovation class feature, the damage increases to 2d4.

Unstable Function You create an unstable chain reaction, sending countless sparks dancing across your armor. Add the unstable trait to Electrify Armor. The effects last for 1 minute instead of 1 round, and the damage dice increase from d4s to d12s.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wearing your armor innovation.

You electrify your armor to punish foes who dare to attack you. For 1 round, any creature that touches you, or that hits you with a melee unarmed attack or a non-reach melee weapon attack, takes @Damage[1d4[electricity]|overrideTraits] damage. The effect ends if you cease wearing your armor innovation.

If you have the revolutionary innovation class feature, the damage increases to 2d4.

Unstable Function You create an unstable chain reaction, sending countless sparks dancing across your armor. Add the unstable trait to Electrify Armor. The effects last for 1 minute instead of 1 round, and the damage dice increase from d4s to d12s.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 갑옷 혁신 장비를 착용하고 있습니다.

당신은 감히 당신을 공격하는 적을 벌하기 위해 갑옷에 전기를 흘려보냅니다. 1라운드 동안, 당신을 접촉하거나 근접 무기 공격 또는 도달 거리 미만의 근접 무기 공격으로 당신을 명중시킨 모든 생물은 1d4 전기의 피해를 입습니다. 이 효과는 당신이 갑옷 혁신 장비를 착용하지 않을 경우 종료됩니다.

혁명적 혁신 클래스 특성을 보유한 경우, 피해량이 2d4로 증가한다.

불안정한 기능 갑옷에 불안정한 연쇄 반응을 일으켜 수많은 불꽃이 갑옷 위를 춤추듯 날아다닙니다. '전기화 갑옷'에 '불안정' 특성을 추가합니다. '불안정한 기능' 효과는 1라운드 대신 1분 동안 지속되며, 피해 주사위는 d4에서 d12로 증가합니다.

name: Mythic Allies

description.value:
You channel mythic power through your body and into a summoned ally, temporarily reinforcing them with a shared fraction of your mythic potential. Spend a Mythic Point; the summoned creature gains a +2 status bonus to its attack rolls, a +2 status bonus to all of its defenses, and a number of additional Hit Points equal to your level that last for the duration of its summoning. The next Strike made by the summoned creature after you use this ability gains a +4 circumstance bonus to the attack roll.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.X22o74v8rk7ySnzX]{Effect: Mythic Allies}

value.value: ability to cast spells from slots
at least one summon spell in your spellbook or repertoire

_desc_en:
You channel mythic power through your body and into a summoned ally, temporarily reinforcing them with a shared fraction of your mythic potential. Spend a Mythic Point; the summoned creature gains a +2 status bonus to its attack rolls, a +2 status bonus to all of its defenses, and a number of additional Hit Points equal to your level that last for the duration of its summoning. The next Strike made by the summoned creature after you use this ability gains a +4 circumstance bonus to the attack roll.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.X22o74v8rk7ySnzX]{Effect: Mythic Allies}
_desc_ko:
신화적 힘을 몸으로 끌어 모아 소환한 동맹에게 전달하여, 자신의 신화적 잠재력의 일부를 공유함으로써 일시적으로 그들을 강화합니다. 신화 포인트 1점을 소모합니다. 소환된 생물은 소환 지속 시간 동안 명중 굴림에 +2 상태 보너스, 모든 방어에 +2 상태 보너스, 그리고 당신의 레벨과 동일한 추가 HP를 얻습니다. 이 능력을 사용한 후 소환된 생물이 다음에 가하는 공격은 명중 굴림에 +4 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.X22o74v8rk7ySnzX]{효과: 신화적 동맹}

name: Delver

description.value: Subterranean life taught you to swim through the ground like water. You gain a burrow Speed of 10 feet through loose soil or dirt.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: Subterranean life taught you to swim through the ground like water. You gain a burrow Speed of 10 feet through loose soil or dirt.
_desc_ko: 지하 생활은 당신에게 땅속을 물속처럼 헤엄치듯 이동하는 법을 가르쳤습니다. 느슨한 흙이나 토양을 통해 10피트의 굴착 이동 속도를 얻습니다.

name: Propelled Leap

description.value:
Like a flying fish, you can build up momentum and launch yourself into the air. Swim toward the surface at up to twice your swim Speed, then attempt a @Check[athletics|dc:30] check to propel yourself out of the water. If you do not swim at least 10 feet, you automatically fail. If your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} takes you near any structure or object and have at least one hand free, you can use the [[/act grab-an-edge]] reaction. If you do not succeed in Grabbing an Edge, you do not take any falling damage as you re-enter the water but are submerged to a distance that equals the height of your Leap.

Critical Success You Leap up to 15 feet vertically and 5 feet horizontally.

Success You Leap up to 10 feet vertically and 5 feet horizontally.

Failure You Leap up to 5 feet vertically and 5 feet horizontally.

Critical Failure You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn.

Failure You Leap up to 5 feet vertically and 5 feet horizontally.

Critical Failure You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
날치처럼, 당신은 추진력을 모아 공중으로 몸을 날릴 수 있습니다. 당신의 수영 속도의 최대 2배로 수면을 향해 수영한 뒤, @Check[athletics|dc:30] 판정을 시도하여 물 밖으로 몸을 밀어 올립니다. 최소 10피트를 수영하지 않으면 자동으로 실패합니다. 당신의 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{도약}이 당신을 어떤 구조물이나 물체 가까이로 데려가고 손이 최소 하나 비어 있다면, 당신은 [[/act grab-an-edge]] 반응을 사용할 수 있습니다. 가장자리 붙잡기에 성공하지 못하면, 당신은 물속으로 다시 들어갈 때 낙하 피해를 전혀 받지 않지만 당신의 도약 높이와 같은 깊이만큼 잠깁니다.

대성공 당신은 수직으로 최대 15피트, 수평으로 5피트 도약합니다.

성공 당신은 수직으로 최대 10피트, 수평으로 5피트 도약합니다.

실패 당신은 수직으로 최대 5피트, 수평으로 5피트 도약합니다.

대실패 당신은 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{무방비} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Hybrid Shape

description.value:
Mastery of your shapeshifting lets you combine the best features of your humanoid and spider forms. When using your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.34E7k2YRcsOU5uyl]{Change Shape} ability, you can assume a bipedal hybrid shape.

This form gains all the benefits of your spider shape as well as the ability to use items and take manipulate actions just as easily as your human shape.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en:
Mastery of your shapeshifting lets you combine the best features of your humanoid and spider forms. When using your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.34E7k2YRcsOU5uyl]{Change Shape} ability, you can assume a bipedal hybrid shape.

This form gains all the benefits of your spider shape as well as the ability to use items and take manipulate actions just as easily as your human shape.
_desc_ko:
변신술 숙련으로 인간형과 거미 형태의 장점을 결합할 수 있습니다. @link[actions.change-shape] 능력을 사용할 때, 두 발로 걷는 혼합 형태를 취할 수 있습니다.

이 형태는 거미 형태의 모든 이점을 얻으며, 인간 형태와 마찬가지로 물건을 사용하고 조작 행동을 취할 수 있는 능력을 부여받습니다.

name: Demolitionist Dedication

description.value:
You know how to set explosives to cause the maximum possible damage to buildings and other structures. You become trained in Engineering Lore or become an expert in it if you were already trained. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.vvYsE7OiSSCXhPdr]{Set Explosives} action.

_desc_ko:
건물 및 기타 구조물에 최대한의 피해를 입히도록 폭발물을 설치하는 방법을 알고 있습니다. 공학 지식에 숙련되거나, 이미 숙련된 경우 전문가 수준이 됩니다. @link[actions.set-explosives] 행동을 획득합니다.

폭발물 설치 2 (집중)

name: Crimson Shroud

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You swathe yourself in a veil of red mist for 1 minute. While the shroud is active, you gain fast healing equal to half your level. You can Interact with your shroud, swirling it around you, to gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the beginning of your next turn. Finally, if you die while the shroud is active, you can choose to have your entire body vanish into red mist, leaving behind only your gear; you make this choice when you activate Crimson Shroud.

At 10th level, you can use this ability once per hour instead of once per day.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You swathe yourself in a veil of red mist for 1 minute. While the shroud is active, you gain fast healing equal to half your level. You can Interact with your shroud, swirling it around you, to gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the beginning of your next turn. Finally, if you die while the shroud is active, you can choose to have your entire body vanish into red mist, leaving behind only your gear; you make this choice when you activate Crimson Shroud.

At 10th level, you can use this ability once per hour instead of once per day.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

1분 동안 붉은 안개로 몸을 감싼다. 이 장막이 활성화된 동안, 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 빠른 치유를 얻는다. 장막과 상호작용하여 몸을 휘감게 하면, 다음 턴 시작 전까지 AC에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻는다. 마지막으로, 이 장막이 활성화된 상태에서 사망할 경우, 장비만 남기고 온몸이 붉은 안개 속으로 사라지도록 선택할 수 있다. 이 선택은 '진홍의 장막'을 활성화할 때 결정한다.

10레벨에 도달하면 이 능력을 하루에 한 번이 아닌 시간당 한 번 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Unified Stance

description.value:
Requirements You and your united companion are within 15 feet of each other.

You and your companion enter a unified fighting style that allows you to fight in tandem more succinctly. When you enter this stance, your united companion gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and, when Commanded, can use the extra action to Stride or Strike.

_desc_en:
Requirements You and your united companion are within 15 feet of each other.

You and your companion enter a unified fighting style that allows you to fight in tandem more succinctly. When you enter this stance, your united companion gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and, when Commanded, can use the extra action to Stride or Strike.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신과 통합된 동료가 서로 15피트 이내에 위치해야 합니다.

당신과 동료는 통합된 전투 스타일을 취하여 더 간결하게 협동 전투를 펼칠 수 있습니다. 이 자세를 취하면 통합된 동료는 @link[conditions.quickened] 상태를 얻으며, 명령을 받을 경우 추가 행동으로 이동하거나 공격할 수 있습니다.

name: Jungle Strider

description.value: You are adept at dodging roots, foliage, and other jungle obstacles. You ignore difficult terrain in forests and jungles. In addition, when you use the Acrobatics skill to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} on narrow surfaces or uneven ground made of plant material, you aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, and when you roll a success at one of these Acrobatics checks, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: You are adept at dodging roots, foliage, and other jungle obstacles. You ignore difficult terrain in forests and jungles. In addition, when you use the Acrobatics skill to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} on narrow surfaces or uneven ground made of plant material, you aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, and when you roll a success at one of these Acrobatics checks, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 뿌리, 잎사귀, 기타 정글 장애물을 능숙하게 피합니다. 숲과 정글에서 어려운 지형을 무시합니다. 또한, 곡예 기술로 @link[actions.balance]를 식물성 재료로 된 좁은 표면이나 고르지 않은 지면에서 사용할 때, 당신은 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 되지 않으며, 이러한 곡예 판정 중 하나에서 성공을 굴릴 경우 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Tusks (Orc)

description.value:
You have particularly long, jagged tusks perfect for tearing meat from bone. You gain a tusks unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Your tusks are in the brawling group and have the finesse and unarmed traits.

Special You can take this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain into this feat. You can retrain out of this feat only through drastic measures, such as breaking, filing, or extracting your tusks.

_desc_en:
You have particularly long, jagged tusks perfect for tearing meat from bone. You gain a tusks unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Your tusks are in the brawling group and have the finesse and unarmed traits.

Special You can take this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain into this feat. You can retrain out of this feat only through drastic measures, such as breaking, filing, or extracting your tusks.
_desc_ko:
당신은 특히 길고 들쭉날쭉한 엄니를 지니고 있어 뼈에서 고기를 뜯어내는 데 완벽합니다. 1d6 관통 피해를 주는 비무장 공격인 '엄니'를 얻습니다. 당신의 엄니는 격투 무기 그룹에 속하며, 기교와 무기 없는 공격 특성을 지닙니다.

특수 이 피트는 1레벨에서만 선택할 수 있으며, 재훈련으로 이 피트를 다시 선택할 수 없습니다. 이 피트를 재훈련으로 포기하려면 엄니를 부러뜨리거나, 갈아내거나, 뽑아내는 등 극단적인 조치를 취해야 합니다.

name: Ears of the Forest

description.value: Beyond relying on your own senses, you keep an ear open for nearby creatures for help in exploring your surroundings. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek}, if there are any willing animals in the selected area, you can borrow their senses. Doing so lets you Seek with scent and tremorsense as imprecise senses, along with any other senses appropriate to the animals in the area, at the GM's discretion.

_desc_en: Beyond relying on your own senses, you keep an ear open for nearby creatures for help in exploring your surroundings. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek}, if there are any willing animals in the selected area, you can borrow their senses. Doing so lets you Seek with scent and tremorsense as imprecise senses, along with any other senses appropriate to the animals in the area, at the GM's discretion.
_desc_ko: 자신의 감각에만 의존하지 않고, 주변 생물들의 소리에 귀 기울여 탐색을 돕습니다. 당신이 @link[actions.seek]할 때, 선택한 지역에 의지가 있는 동물들이 있다면 그들의 감각을 빌릴 수 있습니다. 이렇게 하면 냄새와 진동 감지를 부정확한 감각으로 탐색할 수 있으며, GM의 재량에 따라 해당 지역의 동물들에게 적합한 다른 감각들도 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Undead Master Dedication

description.value:
You gain the services of an undead companion that travels with you and obeys your commands. The rules for undead companions appear on page 37 and utilize those for animal companions from the Core Rulebook on page 214. Contrary to the usual rules for companions, as an undead master it's possible for you to have more than one undead companion at a time. However, only one of those companions, your "active companion," follows you during exploration and encounters; the rest are reduced to an "inactive" state that can be easily tucked into an inventory or stored in a nearby crypt. If you ever have more than one undead companion, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.8kGpUUUSX1sB2OqQ]{Call Companion} action, with your undead companions taking the place of animal companions.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.f7tFLR7aFonXTLQa]{Undead Master}

_desc_en:
You gain the services of an undead companion that travels with you and obeys your commands. The rules for undead companions appear on page 37 and utilize those for animal companions from the Core Rulebook on page 214. Contrary to the usual rules for companions, as an undead master it's possible for you to have more than one undead companion at a time. However, only one of those companions, your "active companion," follows you during exploration and encounters; the rest are reduced to an "inactive" state that can be easily tucked into an inventory or stored in a nearby crypt. If you ever have more than one undead companion, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.8kGpUUUSX1sB2OqQ]{Call Companion} action, with your undead companions taking the place of animal companions.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.f7tFLR7aFonXTLQa]{Undead Master}
_desc_ko: 당신은 당신과 동행하며 명령에 복종하는 언데드 동료의 도움을 얻습니다. 언데드 동료 규칙은 37페이지에 설명되어 있으며, 코어 룰북 214페이지의 동물 동료 규칙을 활용합니다. 동료에 대한 일반 규칙과 달리, 언데드 마스터는 한 번에 여러 언데드 동료를 가질 수 있습니다. 그러나 그 중 오직 한 명, 즉 "활성 동료"만이 탐험과 전투 중에 당신을 따릅니다. 나머지는 "비활성" 상태로 전환되어 인벤토리에 쉽게 넣거나 근처 묘실에 보관할 수 있습니다. 언데드 동반자가 둘 이상일 경우, @link[actions.call-companion] 행동을 획득하며, 이때 언데드 동반자가 동물 동료의 역할을 대신합니다.

name: Circle of Spirits

description.value:
Frequency once per round

With a thought, word, or gesture, you reach your mind out to another spirit. Choose another apparition from among those you've attuned to; it becomes your primary apparition, replacing your current one.

Special The number of Focus Points in your focus pool is equal to the number of focus spells you have or the number of apparitions you are attuned to, whichever is higher (maximum 3).

_desc_en:
Frequency once per round

With a thought, word, or gesture, you reach your mind out to another spirit. Choose another apparition from among those you've attuned to; it becomes your primary apparition, replacing your current one.

Special The number of Focus Points in your focus pool is equal to the number of focus spells you have or the number of apparitions you are attuned to, whichever is higher (maximum 3).
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 라운드당 1회

생각, 말, 또는 제스처로 다른 영혼에게 마음을 뻗어 닿습니다. 조율한 유령 중 하나를 선택하세요; 그것이 현재의 유령을 대체하여 주 유령이 됩니다.

특수 포커스 풀의 포커스 포인트 수는 보유한 포커스 주문 수 또는 조율된 환영 수 중 더 높은 쪽과 동일합니다(최대 3).

name: Secret Eyes

description.value: You can call forth an invisible eye to let you peek on secrets. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ek5XI0aEdZhBgm21]{Scouting Eye} as an innate occult spell.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: You can call forth an invisible eye to let you peek on secrets. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ek5XI0aEdZhBgm21]{Scouting Eye} as an innate occult spell.
_desc_ko: 비밀을 엿볼 수 있도록 보이지 않는 눈을 불러낼 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, @link[spells.scouting-eye]을 선천적 오컬트 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Gravelands Herbalist

description.value:
Access Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

Your time with the Knights of Lastwall has taught you the secrets of creating and improving upon @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.VeCNWhvEr82ZNoSV]{Lastwall Soup}. Add Lastwall soup to your list of herbal items. At 10th level, you can make @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.VcEd9Bh4q5vQfpLv]{Lastwall Soup (Improved)} that grants a +3 item bonus. At 18th level, you can make @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ed8gAxli6Of58kAM]{Lastwall Soup (Greater)} that grants a +4 item bonus, and its nourishing properties grant you 10 temporary Hit Points that last up to 10 minutes after eating it.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en:
Access Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

Your time with the Knights of Lastwall has taught you the secrets of creating and improving upon @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.VeCNWhvEr82ZNoSV]{Lastwall Soup}. Add Lastwall soup to your list of herbal items. At 10th level, you can make @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.VcEd9Bh4q5vQfpLv]{Lastwall Soup (Improved)} that grants a +3 item bonus. At 18th level, you can make @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ed8gAxli6Of58kAM]{Lastwall Soup (Greater)} that grants a +4 item bonus, and its nourishing properties grant you 10 temporary Hit Points that last up to 10 minutes after eating it.
_desc_ko:
접근 라스트월 기사단은 이 피트에 접근할 수 있습니다.

라스트월 기사단에서의 시간은 @link[equipment.lastwall-soup]를 만들고 개선하는 비법을 가르쳐 주었습니다. 라스트월 수프를 당신의 약초 아이템 목록에 추가하세요. (10th) 레벨에 도달하면 +3 아이템 보너스를 부여하는 @link[equipment.lastwall-soup-improved]을 만들 수 있습니다. 18레벨에 도달하면 @link[equipment.lastwall-soup-greater]를 만들 수 있으며, 이는 +4 아이템 보너스를 부여합니다. 또한 이 수프의 영양 효과로 섭취 후 최대 10분 동안 지속되는 10의 임시 HP를 얻습니다.

name: Uncanny Suction

description.value: Your limbs produce strange, sucker-like growths that allow you to adhere to walls, objects, and most other surfaces. You gain a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb} Speed equal to your half your land Speed (minimum 5 feet). If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.P04Hw8E6WAWARKHP]{Quick Climb} feat, your climb Speed is equal to your land Speed. In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Reflex DC to avoid being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarmed}.

_desc_en: Your limbs produce strange, sucker-like growths that allow you to adhere to walls, objects, and most other surfaces. You gain a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb} Speed equal to your half your land Speed (minimum 5 feet). If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.P04Hw8E6WAWARKHP]{Quick Climb} feat, your climb Speed is equal to your land Speed. In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Reflex DC to avoid being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarmed}.
_desc_ko: 당신의 사지에 기묘한 흡반 같은 돌기가 생겨 벽, 물체 및 대부분의 표면에 달라붙을 수 있습니다. 지상 속도의 절반에 해당하는 @link[actions.climb] 속도(최소 5피트)를 얻습니다. @link[feats.quick-climb] 피트를 보유한 경우, 등반 속도는 지상 속도와 동일해집니다. 또한 무기에서 @link[actions.disarm]되는 것을 피하기 위한 반사 DC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Vomit Stomach

description.value:
Trigger You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} condition or fail a saving throw against an ingested poison.

Frequency once per day

In dire circumstances you can vomit out your stomach to expel toxins. Reduce your sickened condition by 2 and immediately attempt a saving throw with a +2 circumstance bonus against any ingested poisons you have been exposed to within the last minute. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round as your exposed stomach makes you especially vulnerable to attacks.

Trigger You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} condition or fail a saving throw against an ingested poison.

Frequency once per day

_desc_ko:
발동 조건 @link[conditions.sickened] 상태를 얻거나 섭취한 독에 대한 내성 굴림에 실패할 때.

발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

위급한 상황에서는 위를 토해내어 독소를 배출할 수 있습니다. 구역질 상태를 2 감소시키고, 지난 1분 이내에 노출된 모든 섭취 독에 대해 즉시 +2 상황 보너스를 적용한 내성 굴림을 시도합니다. 노출된 위가 공격에 특히 약점을 만들기 때문에 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Giant's Lunge

description.value: You extend your body and prepare to attack foes outside your normal reach. Until your rage ends, all your melee weapons and unarmed attacks gain a reach of 10 feet. This doesn't increase the reach of any weapon or unarmed attack that already has the reach trait, but it does combine with abilities that increase your reach due to increased size, such as Giant's Stature.

_desc_en: You extend your body and prepare to attack foes outside your normal reach. Until your rage ends, all your melee weapons and unarmed attacks gain a reach of 10 feet. This doesn't increase the reach of any weapon or unarmed attack that already has the reach trait, but it does combine with abilities that increase your reach due to increased size, such as Giant's Stature.
_desc_ko: 당신은 몸을 뻗어 정상적인 도달 범위를 벗어난 적을 공격할 준비를 합니다. 분노가 끝날 때까지, 모든 근접 무기와 비무장 공격의 도달 거리가 10피트 증가한다. 이는 이미 도달 거리 특성을 가진 무기나 비무장 공격의 도달 거리를 증가시키지 않지만, 거인의 체격과 같이 크기가 증가하여 도달 거리가 늘어나는 능력과는 중첩된다.

name: Campfire Chronicler Dedication

description.value:
You've gained Isthralei's attention and can now offer stories up to him, either passing on your own stories or collecting those of travelers as he did. You become trained in Religion and Survival; for either of these skills in which you were already trained, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7wQe43fSCG9DSWdj]{Offer Story} action.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.NmnvKVQl51xoGQU7]{Campfire Chronicler}

_desc_en:
You've gained Isthralei's attention and can now offer stories up to him, either passing on your own stories or collecting those of travelers as he did. You become trained in Religion and Survival; for either of these skills in which you were already trained, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.
