@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.NmnvKVQl51xoGQU7]{Campfire Chronicler}
_desc_ko: 이제 이스라레이의 관심을 얻어 그에게 이야기를 전할 수 있습니다. 자신의 이야기를 전하거나, 그가 그랬던 것처럼 여행자들의 이야기를 수집할 수 있습니다. 종교와 생존 기술에 숙련됩니다. 이미 숙련된 이 두 기술 중 하나를 선택하여, 대신 원하는 다른 기술에 숙련됩니다. @link[actions.offer-story] 행동을 획득합니다.

name: Bound in Ice

description.value:
You become a hybrid of your ancestry and a saumen kar. Your size increases to Large, and your reach becomes 10 feet. Your cold resistance increases to be equal to your level, and you gain fire resistance equal to half your level.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.a47Npi5XHXo47y49]{Blizzard Evasion} reaction.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth

_desc_en:
You become a hybrid of your ancestry and a saumen kar. Your size increases to Large, and your reach becomes 10 feet. Your cold resistance increases to be equal to your level, and you gain fire resistance equal to half your level.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.a47Npi5XHXo47y49]{Blizzard Evasion} reaction.
_desc_ko:
당신은 자신의 혈통과 사우멘 카르의 혼혈체가 됩니다. 크기가 대형으로 증가하고, 도달 거리가 10피트가 됩니다. 냉기 저항력이 레벨과 동일하게 증가하며, 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 화염 저항력을 얻습니다.

또한 @link[actions.blizzard-evasion] 반응을 얻습니다.

name: Cobble Dancer

description.value: You know how to take advantage of foes thrown off-balance by unstable flooring, loose cobblestones, or similar impediments. While in an outdoor urban environment, you can Step into difficult terrain and enemies in difficult terrain are off-guard to you.

_desc_en: You know how to take advantage of foes thrown off-balance by unstable flooring, loose cobblestones, or similar impediments. While in an outdoor urban environment, you can Step into difficult terrain and enemies in difficult terrain are off-guard to you.
_desc_ko: 불안정한 바닥, 느슨한 자갈길 또는 유사한 장애물로 균형을 잃은 적을 이용하는 방법을 알고 있다. 야외 도시 환경 에 있을 때, 어려운 지형으로 {신중한 발걸음}할 수 있으며 어려운 지형에 있는 적들은 당신에게 무방비 상태가 된다.

name: Glean Lore

description.value:
You tap into the collected lore of the divine, accessing a variety of potentially useful information.

Attempt a @Check[religion] check to understand the information you gain. The GM sets the DC (similar to the DC to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}), potentially adjusting the DC of the check for topics far removed from your mystery.

Critical Success You comprehend the lore accurately or gain a useful clue from the divine about your situation.

Success You learn two pieces of information about the topic, one true and one erroneous, but you don't know which is which.

Failure You recall incorrect information or gain an erroneous or misleading clue.

Critical Failure You recall two pieces of incorrect information or gain two erroneous or misleading clues.

_desc_en:
You tap into the collected lore of the divine, accessing a variety of potentially useful information.

Attempt a @Check[religion] check to understand the information you gain. The GM sets the DC (similar to the DC to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}), potentially adjusting the DC of the check for topics far removed from your mystery.

Critical Success You comprehend the lore accurately or gain a useful clue from the divine about your situation.

Success You learn two pieces of information about the topic, one true and one erroneous, but you don't know which is which.

Failure You recall incorrect information or gain an erroneous or misleading clue.

Critical Failure You recall two pieces of incorrect information or gain two erroneous or misleading clues.
_desc_ko:
신성한 존재들이 축적한 지식를 활용하여 다양한 유용한 정보를 얻습니다.

얻은 정보를 이해하기 위해 종교학 판정을 시도합니다. GM이 DC를 설정하며(@link[actions.recall-knowledge]의 DC와 유사), 당신의 수수께끼와 거리가 먼 주제에 대해서는 판정 DC를 조정할 수 있습니다.

대성공 지식를 정확히 이해하거나 신성한 존재로부터 자신의 상황에 대한 유용한 단서를 얻습니다.

성공 주제와 관련된 두 가지 정보를 얻습니다. 하나는 사실이고 하나는 오류이지만, 어느 것이 어느 것인지 알 수 없습니다.

실패 잘못된 정보를 떠올리거나 오류가 있거나 오해의 소지가 있는 단서를 얻습니다.

대실패 두 가지 잘못된 정보를 떠올리거나 두 가지 오류가 있거나 오해의 소지가 있는 단서를 얻습니다.

name: Medic Dedication

description.value:
You become an expert in Medicine. When you succeed with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.wYerMk6F1RZb0Fwt]{Battle Medicine} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}, the target gains a circumstance bonus to the number of Hit Points they regain equal to 5 HP at DC 20, 10 HP at DC 30, or 15 HP at DC 40.

Once per day, you can use Battle Medicine on a creature that's temporarily immune due to having already been treated with Battle Medicine. If you're a master in Medicine, you can do so once per hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.XWkyCVISmVtJ0ZY3]{Medic}

_desc_en:
You become an expert in Medicine. When you succeed with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.wYerMk6F1RZb0Fwt]{Battle Medicine} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}, the target gains a circumstance bonus to the number of Hit Points they regain equal to 5 HP at DC 20, 10 HP at DC 30, or 15 HP at DC 40.

Once per day, you can use Battle Medicine on a creature that's temporarily immune due to having already been treated with Battle Medicine. If you're a master in Medicine, you can do so once per hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.XWkyCVISmVtJ0ZY3]{Medic}
_desc_ko:
의학에 전문가가 됩니다. @link[feats.battle-medicine] 또는 @link[actions.treat-wounds]에 성공할 경우, 대상은 회복하는 HP에 상황에 따른 보너스를 얻습니다. DC 20 시 5 HP, DC 30 시 10 HP, DC 40 시 15 HP에 해당하는 보너스입니다.

하루에 한 번, 이미 전투 의술로 치료받아 일시적으로 면역 상태인 생물에게도 전투 의술을 사용할 수 있습니다. 의술 달인인 경우 시간당 한 번씩 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Domain Embodiment

description.value:
Your deity contains multitudes, and you can express any aspect of them you desire. During your daily preparations, you can gain two initial or advanced domain spells from any of your deity's domains or alternate domains. You can cast these as innate spells until your next daily preparations.

Domain spells are a type of focus spell. Casting any of your focus spells costs you 1 Focus Point. The maximum number of Focus Points in your pool is equal to the number of focus spells you know or 3, whichever is lower. You refill your focus pool during your daily preparations, and you can regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to pray to your deity or do service toward their causes. Your domain spells are divine spells. If you were not already, you become trained in spell attacks and spell DCs. Your spellcasting attribute for domain spells is Wisdom.

_desc_en:
Your deity contains multitudes, and you can express any aspect of them you desire. During your daily preparations, you can gain two initial or advanced domain spells from any of your deity's domains or alternate domains. You can cast these as innate spells until your next daily preparations.

Domain spells are a type of focus spell. Casting any of your focus spells costs you 1 Focus Point. The maximum number of Focus Points in your pool is equal to the number of focus spells you know or 3, whichever is lower. You refill your focus pool during your daily preparations, and you can regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to pray to your deity or do service toward their causes. Your domain spells are divine spells. If you were not already, you become trained in spell attacks and spell DCs. Your spellcasting attribute for domain spells is Wisdom.
_desc_ko:
당신의 신은 다중성을 지니며, 원하는 어떤 측면도 표현할 수 있습니다. 일일 준비 시간 동안 신의 도메인 또는 대체 도메인 중 어느 것에서든 초급 또는 고급 도메인 주문 두 개를 획득할 수 있습니다. 다음 일일 준비 시간까지 이 주문들을 선천적 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

도메인 주문은 포커스 주문 유형에 속합니다. 포커스 주문을 시전할 때마다 포커스 1점을 소모합니다. 보유할 수 있는 최대 포커스 포인트 수는 알고 있는 포커스 주문 수 또는 3 중 더 낮은 수치와 같습니다. 포커스 풀은 일일 준비 시간에 재충전되며, 10분 동안 재집중 활동으로 신에게 기도하거나 신의 대의를 위해 봉사함으로써 포커스 1점을 회복할 수 있습니다. 도메인 주문은 신성 주문입니다. 아직 숙련되지 않았다면, 주문 공격과 주문 난이도(DC)에 숙련됩니다. 도메인 주문의 주문 시전 능력치는 지혜입니다.

name: Instant Armor

description.value: A knight is nothing without their armor, and you know how to keep yours ready. You can perform a 10-minute ritual, which has the conjuration and magical traits, to divert a set of heavy armor you are wearing into an extradimensional space connected to you. While the armor is in this space, you can use a three-action activity, which has the concentrate, conjuration, and teleportation traits, to phase the armor back and instantly don it. The armor automatically phases away if you don another set of armor, if you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or if you die. If you are incapable of wearing the armor when it phases back, it appears in your square instead.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en: A knight is nothing without their armor, and you know how to keep yours ready. You can perform a 10-minute ritual, which has the conjuration and magical traits, to divert a set of heavy armor you are wearing into an extradimensional space connected to you. While the armor is in this space, you can use a three-action activity, which has the concentrate, conjuration, and teleportation traits, to phase the armor back and instantly don it. The armor automatically phases away if you don another set of armor, if you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or if you die. If you are incapable of wearing the armor when it phases back, it appears in your square instead.
_desc_ko: 기사는 갑옷 없이는 아무것도 아니며, 당신은 자신의 갑옷을 항상 준비 상태로 유지하는 법을 알고 있습니다. 소환술과 마법 특성을 지닌 10분간의 의식을 수행하여 착용 중인 중갑 한 벌을 자신과 연결된 초차원 공간으로 전환시킬 수 있습니다. 갑옷이 이 공간에 있는 동안, 집중, 소환, 순간이동 특성을 지닌 3행동 활동을 사용해 갑옷을 다시 불러와 즉시 착용할 수 있다. 다른 갑옷을 착용하거나 @link[conditions.unconscious] 상태가 되거나 사망하면 갑옷은 자동으로 사라진다. 갑옷이 돌아왔을 때 착용할 수 없는 상태라면, 대신 네 칸에 나타난다.

name: Living Rune

description.value: You've bridged a connection between the runes on your body and the magic of runestones, allowing you to place an armor rune on your living flesh. Your body can hold a single property rune; you can't etch a property rune on your body if it has requirements on the type or category of armor or if the property would affect the armor instead of its wearer. If you wear armor, you gain the property rune's effects in addition to any effects of that armor.

_desc_en: You've bridged a connection between the runes on your body and the magic of runestones, allowing you to place an armor rune on your living flesh. Your body can hold a single property rune; you can't etch a property rune on your body if it has requirements on the type or category of armor or if the property would affect the armor instead of its wearer. If you wear armor, you gain the property rune's effects in addition to any effects of that armor.
_desc_ko: 당신은 몸에 새겨진 룬과 룬석의 마법 사이에 연결 고리를 만들어, 살아있는 살갗에 갑옷 룬을 새길 수 있게 되었습니다. 당신의 몸은 하나의 속성 룬만 보유할 수 있습니다. 해당 속성 룬이 갑옷의 유형이나 범주에 대한 요구 사항 을 가지거나, 그 속성이 착용자가 아닌 갑옷 자체에 영향을 미치는 경우 몸에 새길 수 없습니다. 갑옷을 착용할 경우, 해당 갑옷의 효과에 더해 속성 룬의 효과도 얻습니다.

name: Comforting Presence

description.value:
Trigger An adjacent ally becomes frightened or stupefied.

You use your occult connection to your allies to take on the fear and confusion they feel. Focus on your own calmness and pull in your nearby allies' emotions. Reduce the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied} condition values of adjacent allies by 1, and increase your frightened and stupefied condition values by the same amount.

publication.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

_desc_en:
Trigger An adjacent ally becomes frightened or stupefied.

You use your occult connection to your allies to take on the fear and confusion they feel. Focus on your own calmness and pull in your nearby allies' emotions. Reduce the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied} condition values of adjacent allies by 1, and increase your frightened and stupefied condition values by the same amount.
_desc_ko:
발동 인접한 아군이 공포에 질리거나 혼미합니다.

당신은 동료들과의 오컬트 연결을 이용해 그들이 느끼는 공포와 혼란을 감당합니다. 자신의 평정심을 포커스하며 주변 아군의 감정을 흡수합니다. 인접한 아군의 @link[conditions.frightened] 및 @link[conditions.stupefied] 상태 수치를 1씩 감소시키고, 자신의 공포 및 멍함 상태 수치를 동일한 양만큼 증가시킵니다.

name: Celebrity Dedication

description.value:
The more people you have looking at you, the more content you are, and you take every opportunity to show up others when their performances are less than perfect.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.F0JgJR2rXKOg9k1z]{Upstage} reaction. In addition, when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income}, if the level of the task is higher than your level, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your check to Earn Income.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.h1zdUIWX1k5PKTnc]{Celebrity}

_desc_en:
The more people you have looking at you, the more content you are, and you take every opportunity to show up others when their performances are less than perfect.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.F0JgJR2rXKOg9k1z]{Upstage} reaction. In addition, when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income}, if the level of the task is higher than your level, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your check to Earn Income.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.h1zdUIWX1k5PKTnc]{Celebrity}
_desc_ko:
당신을 바라보는 사람이 많을수록 만족감이 커지며, 타인의 공연이 완벽하지 않을 때면 그들을 드러내 보일 기회를 놓치지 않는다.

당신은 @link[actions.upstage] 반응을 얻습니다. 또한, 당신이 @link[actions.earn-income]할 때, 해당 작업의 레벨이 당신의 레벨보다 높다면, 수입 획득 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Sacred Armaments

description.value: Through the power of your faith or the blessing of a priest, your weapons are fully effective against incorporeal creatures. Weapons you wield have the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{Ghost Touch} property rune for as long as you wield them.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en: Through the power of your faith or the blessing of a priest, your weapons are fully effective against incorporeal creatures. Weapons you wield have the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{Ghost Touch} property rune for as long as you wield them.
_desc_ko: 신앙의 힘이나 사제의 축복으로 인해, 당신의 무기는 비물질적 생물에게 완전히 효과적입니다. 당신이 휘두르는 무기는 휘두르는 동안 @link[equipment.ghost-touch] 속성 룬의 효과를 지닙니다.

name: Bounce Back

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You lose the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition.

You recover from near-death experiences with astounding resilience. Don't increase the value of your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition due to losing the dying condition.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You lose the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition.

You recover from near-death experiences with astounding resilience. Don't increase the value of your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition due to losing the dying condition.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 @link[conditions.dying] 상태를 잃습니다.

당신은 죽음 직전의 경험에서 놀라운 회복력을 보여 회복합니다. 죽어가는 상태를 잃는다고 해서 @link[conditions.wounded] 상태의 값을 증가시키지 마십시오.

name: Reveal Hidden Self

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to at least one enemy.

While hidden, you manifest a version of your animalistic nature. You create an illusion of a Large or smaller creature within 60 feet of your location with the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{Illusory Creature} spell. The creature shares your animalistic beastbrood features. Unlike most actions taken while hidden, using Reveal Hidden Self and Sustaining the Spell don't automatically end your hidden condition. Use the higher of your class DC or spell DC against attempts to disbelieve the illusion. If a creature observes you, it automatically disbelieves the illusion, and if you're no longer hidden to at least one enemy, the effect ends.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to at least one enemy.

While hidden, you manifest a version of your animalistic nature. You create an illusion of a Large or smaller creature within 60 feet of your location with the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{Illusory Creature} spell. The creature shares your animalistic beastbrood features. Unlike most actions taken while hidden, using Reveal Hidden Self and Sustaining the Spell don't automatically end your hidden condition. Use the higher of your class DC or spell DC against attempts to disbelieve the illusion. If a creature observes you, it automatically disbelieves the illusion, and if you're no longer hidden to at least one enemy, the effect ends.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

요구 사항 적 최소 한 명에게 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태여야 함.

은신 상태에서, 당신은 동물적인 본성의 한 형태를 창조합니다. 위치로부터 60피트 이내에 대형 이하 크기의 생물 환영을 생성하며, 이는 @link[spells.illusory-creature] 주문의 효과를 가집니다. 이 생물은 당신의 동물적 야수 혈통 특성을 공유합니다. 은신 상태에서 취하는 대부분의 행동과 달리, '은신 상태 드러내기' 및 '주문 유지' 사용은 자동으로 은신 상태를 종료하지 않습니다. 환상을 의심하려는 시도에 대해 당신의 직업 난이도(DC)와 주문 DC(DC) 중 높은 쪽을 적용합니다. 생물이 당신을 관찰하면 자동으로 환상을 의심하며, 적어도 한 명의 적에게 더 이상 은신 상태가 아니면 효과가 종료됩니다.

name: Ongoing Selfishness

description.value: Your powerful personality and incredible ego demand that you protect yourself above all else. After you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.enQieRrITuEQZxx2]{Selfish Shield}, you gain resistance to all further damage from the triggering enemy until the end of the turn on which you used the reaction. This resistance is equal to half your Selfish Shield resistance.

_desc_en: Your powerful personality and incredible ego demand that you protect yourself above all else. After you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.enQieRrITuEQZxx2]{Selfish Shield}, you gain resistance to all further damage from the triggering enemy until the end of the turn on which you used the reaction. This resistance is equal to half your Selfish Shield resistance.
_desc_ko: 당신의 강력한 성격과 엄청난 자아는 무엇보다 자신을 보호할 것을 요구합니다. @link[actions.selfish-shield]를 사용한 후, 반응을 사용한 턴이 끝날 때까지 발동한 적의 모든 추가 피해에 대해 저항력을 얻습니다. 이 저항력은 이기적인 방패 저항력의 절반과 같습니다.

name: Jelly Body

description.value: Some of the ooze that surrounded you made its way permanently into parts of your body, turning you soft to the touch and semitransparent enough to show bones. You gain resistance equal to your level to precision damage and damage from critical hits. You can submerge up to 1 Bulk of items within your body by sticking them inside of yourself. While the protrusion of the item is still visible from the outside, the items don't count toward making you encumbered or your maximum Bulk while stored in you. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} to retrieve or store an item submerged into your body.

value.value: You've been reduced to 0 Hit Points while engulfed by an ooze.

_desc_en: Some of the ooze that surrounded you made its way permanently into parts of your body, turning you soft to the touch and semitransparent enough to show bones. You gain resistance equal to your level to precision damage and damage from critical hits. You can submerge up to 1 Bulk of items within your body by sticking them inside of yourself. While the protrusion of the item is still visible from the outside, the items don't count toward making you encumbered or your maximum Bulk while stored in you. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} to retrieve or store an item submerged into your body.
_desc_ko: 주변의 우즈 일부가 영구적으로 몸속으로 스며들어, 만지면 부드러워지고 뼈가 비칠 정도로 반투명해졌습니다. 정밀 피해와 치명타 피해에 대해 레벨만큼의 저항력을 얻습니다. 몸속에 물건을 밀어 넣어 최대 1벌크까지 잠수시킬 수 있다. 물건의 돌출부는 외부에서 여전히 보이지만, 몸속에 보관 중일 때는 과적이나 최대 벌크 계산에 포함되지 않는다. @link[actions.interact]을 통해 몸속에 잠수시킨 물건을 꺼내거나 보관할 수 있다.

name: Eternal Torch

description.value:
You open a connection to your kinetic gate, large enough for a torch flame to flow. You create a magical, torch-like flame within 120 feet in any color you choose. It's as bright and hot as a torch. You can have it orbit a target willing creature or emit from a target object that's unattended or attended by a willing creature. If you create a flame on a weapon, you still need to use it as an improvised weapon to attack with the flame, just as with a torch.

The flame has an unlimited duration. You can have a maximum number of Eternal Torches equal to your Constitution modifier, and you can Dismiss each torch individually.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.61qS86bjxg8HCJBY]{Effect: Eternal Torch}

Level (8th) All your torches—even ones you already created—shed bright light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).

_desc_en:
You open a connection to your kinetic gate, large enough for a torch flame to flow. You create a magical, torch-like flame within 120 feet in any color you choose. It's as bright and hot as a torch. You can have it orbit a target willing creature or emit from a target object that's unattended or attended by a willing creature. If you create a flame on a weapon, you still need to use it as an improvised weapon to attack with the flame, just as with a torch.

The flame has an unlimited duration. You can have a maximum number of Eternal Torches equal to your Constitution modifier, and you can Dismiss each torch individually.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.61qS86bjxg8HCJBY]{Effect: Eternal Torch}

Level (8th) All your torches—even ones you already created—shed bright light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).
_desc_ko:
당신은 키네틱 게이트에 연결을 열어, 횃불 불꽃이 흐를 만큼 충분히 넓게 만듭니다. 120피트 이내에서 원하는 색상의 마법적인 횃불 같은 불꽃을 생성합니다. 이 불꽃은 횃불만큼 밝고 뜨겁다. 동의한 대상이 목표물로 삼은 대상 주위를 맴돌게 하거나, 방치된 목표물이나 동의한 대상이 관리하는 목표물에서 발산되도록 할 수 있다. 무기에 불꽃을 생성할 경우, 횃불과 마찬가지로 불꽃으로 공격하려면 여전히 그 무기를 즉석 무기로 사용해야 한다.

이 불꽃은 지속 시간이 무제한이다. 건강 능력치 수정자만큼의 영원한 횃불을 동시에 소지할 수 있으며, 각 횃불을 개별적으로 해제할 수 있다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.61qS86bjxg8HCJBY]{효과: 영원한 횃불}

레벨 (8th) 모든 횃불(이미 생성된 것 포함)은 반경 60피트 내에 밝은 빛을, 그 다음 60피트 내에 희미한 빛을 비춘다.

name: Surging Focus

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger An ally you can see falls to 0 Hit Points.

When an ally you can see falls in battle, your surge of righteous indignation allows you to draw upon untapped reserves of divine power. You instantly regain 1 Focus Point.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger An ally you can see falls to 0 Hit Points.

When an ally you can see falls in battle, your surge of righteous indignation allows you to draw upon untapped reserves of divine power. You instantly regain 1 Focus Point.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 시야 내에 있는 아군의 HP가 0이 될 때.

시야에 들어오는 아군이 전투 중 쓰러지면, 의로운 분노가 솟구쳐 신성한 힘의 숨겨진 저장을 끌어낼 수 있습니다. 즉시 포커스 1점을 회복합니다.

name: Empathetic Plea

description.value:
Trigger You are attacked by a creature that you haven't yet acted hostile toward. You must use this reaction before the creature rolls its attack.

The way you cringe or use those puppy-dog eyes you've been practicing elicits an empathetic response in the attacker. Attempt a @Check[diplomacy|defense:will] check against your attacker's Will DC.

Critical Success The creature pulls its attack, wasting its action, and can't use hostile actions against you until the beginning of its next turn.

Success The creature takes a -2 circumstance penalty to damage on the triggering Strike and all its Strikes against you until the beginning of its next turn. The penalty is -4 if you're an expert in Diplomacy, -6 if you're a master, and -8 if you're legendary.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.tI2fM9pAOpCWP2V9]{Effect: Empathetic Plea}

Failure The creature's attack is unaffected, and the creature is temporarily immune to your Empathic Pleas for 24 hours.

_desc_en:
Trigger You are attacked by a creature that you haven't yet acted hostile toward. You must use this reaction before the creature rolls its attack.

The way you cringe or use those puppy-dog eyes you've been practicing elicits an empathetic response in the attacker. Attempt a @Check[diplomacy|defense:will] check against your attacker's Will DC.

Critical Success The creature pulls its attack, wasting its action, and can't use hostile actions against you until the beginning of its next turn.

Success The creature takes a -2 circumstance penalty to damage on the triggering Strike and all its Strikes against you until the beginning of its next turn. The penalty is -4 if you're an expert in Diplomacy, -6 if you're a master, and -8 if you're legendary.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.tI2fM9pAOpCWP2V9]{Effect: Empathetic Plea}

Failure The creature's attack is unaffected, and the creature is temporarily immune to your Empathic Pleas for 24 hours.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신이 아직 적대적인 행동을 취하지 않은 생물에게 공격을 받습니다. 이 반응은 해당 생물이 명중 굴림을 하기 전에 사용해야 합니다.

당신이 움츠리거나 연습해 온 강아지 같은 눈빛을 보이자 공격자에게 공감 반응이 일어난다. 공격자의 의지 DC에 맞서 외교 판정을 시도한다.

대성공 생물은 공격을 취소하고 행동을 낭비하며, 다음 턴 시작 전까지 당신에게 적대적 행동을 할 수 없습니다.

성공 해당 생물은 다음 턴 시작 전까지 발동된 타격과 당신을 대상으로 한 모든 공격에 피해에 -2 상황 페널티를 받습니다. 당신이 외교에 숙련자라면 페널티는 -4, -6, 달인일 경우 -8의 페널티를 받습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.tI2fM9pAOpCWP2V9]{효과: 공감적 호소}

실패 해당 생물의 공격은 영향을 받지 않으며, 24시간 동안 당신의 공감적 호소에 일시적으로 면역 상태가 됩니다.

name: Preventative Treatment

description.value: You provide preventative remedies and care to help your patient fight off future maladies. You Treat a Condition the target doesn't yet have, naming any condition you could normally treat with Treat Condition. The counteract check gains the secret trait, so the GM rolls it secretly. The next time within the next minute the creature would be affected by that condition, your treatment immediately attempts to reduce the condition value with the effects of Treat Condition, using the secret roll result for the check. Preventative Treatment lasts on a creature for 1 minute, until the treatment is used, or until you use Preventative Treatment again on that creature, whichever comes first.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en: You provide preventative remedies and care to help your patient fight off future maladies. You Treat a Condition the target doesn't yet have, naming any condition you could normally treat with Treat Condition. The counteract check gains the secret trait, so the GM rolls it secretly. The next time within the next minute the creature would be affected by that condition, your treatment immediately attempts to reduce the condition value with the effects of Treat Condition, using the secret roll result for the check. Preventative Treatment lasts on a creature for 1 minute, until the treatment is used, or until you use Preventative Treatment again on that creature, whichever comes first.
_desc_ko: 환자가 향후 질병을 이겨낼 수 있도록 예방적 치료와 관리를 제공합니다. 대상이 아직 걸리지 않은 상태를 치료하며, '상태 치료'로 일반적으로 치료 가능한 상태를 지정합니다. 반격 판정에는 비밀 특성이 적용되므로 GM이 비밀리에 주사위를 굴립니다. 다음 1분 이내에 해당 생물이 그 상태에 영향을 받을 때, 당신의 치료는 즉시 상태 치료 효과로 상태 수치를 감소시키려 시도하며, 이 판정에는 비밀 굴림 결과를 사용합니다. 예방 치료는 생물에게 1분 동안 지속되며, 치료가 사용되거나 해당 생물에게 다시 예방 치료를 사용할 때까지 유지됩니다(둘 중 먼저 발생하는 경우).

name: Calm and Centered

description.value: Your occult connection to the world helps you deal with being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied}. When your frightened or stupefied condition values would decrease, decrease the value by 2.

publication.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

_desc_en: Your occult connection to the world helps you deal with being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied}. When your frightened or stupefied condition values would decrease, decrease the value by 2.
_desc_ko: 당신의 세계와의 오컬트 연결은 @link[conditions.frightened]나 @link[conditions.stupefied]를 견디는 데 도움을 줍니다. 공포 상태나 멍함 상태의 지속 시간이 감소할 때, 그 값을 2만큼 줄입니다.

name: Water Sprint

description.value:
Experience and training have taught you that water has just enough surface tension for a master sprinter to traverse the surface.

When you Stride in a straight line, if you move at least half your Speed over ground, you can move any amount of the remaining distance across a level body of water. If you don't end your Stride on solid ground, you fall into the water.

If you're legendary in Athletics, as long as you start on solid ground, any part of your Stride can cross the water's surface, even if you aren't moving a straight line, though you still fall into the water if you don't end your movement on solid ground.

_desc_en:
Experience and training have taught you that water has just enough surface tension for a master sprinter to traverse the surface.

When you Stride in a straight line, if you move at least half your Speed over ground, you can move any amount of the remaining distance across a level body of water. If you don't end your Stride on solid ground, you fall into the water.

If you're legendary in Athletics, as long as you start on solid ground, any part of your Stride can cross the water's surface, even if you aren't moving a straight line, though you still fall into the water if you don't end your movement on solid ground.
_desc_ko:
경험과 훈련을 통해 당신은 물 표면의 장력이 마스터 스프린터가 표면을 가로지르기에 충분하다는 것을 깨달았습니다.

직선으로 이동할 때, 지상에서 이동 속도의 절반 이상을 이동하면 남은 거리를 평평한 수면 위에서 얼마든지 이동할 수 있습니다. 스트라이드를 단단한 땅에서 끝내지 않으면 물에 빠집니다.

운동에서 전설적인 실력을 지녔다면, 단단한 땅에서 시작하는 한 직선으로 움직이지 않더라도 이동의 어느 부분이라도 수면을 가로질러 이동할 수 있다. 다만 이동을 단단한 땅에서 끝내지 않으면 여전히 물속으로 떨어진다.

name: Heir of the Saoc

description.value: In the past, you would have been a proud initiate of the Saoc Brethren. Today, you carry on their legacy. When you use Saoc Astrology, roll 1d4 instead; on a 1, you take a –1 penalty to the skill check. On any other result, you gain a circumstance bonus of that value (for instance, a +3 circumstance bonus on a 3).

_desc_en: In the past, you would have been a proud initiate of the Saoc Brethren. Today, you carry on their legacy. When you use Saoc Astrology, roll 1d4 instead; on a 1, you take a –1 penalty to the skill check. On any other result, you gain a circumstance bonus of that value (for instance, a +3 circumstance bonus on a 3).
_desc_ko: 과거에 당신은 사오크 형제단의 자랑스러운 입문자였을 것입니다. 오늘날 당신은 그들의 유산을 이어가고 있습니다. 사오크 점성술을 사용할 때, 대신 1d4을 굴리십시오. 1이 나오면 해당 기술 판정에서 -1 페널티를 받습니다. 다른 결과일 경우, 해당 수치만큼 상황 보너스를 얻습니다(예: 3일 경우 +3 상황 보너스).

name: Homing Beacon

description.value:
As your spell strikes a target, you plant a beacon in the target's mind that announces its presence to those nearby. Use this amp in place of a psi cantrip's normal amp entry. The amped cantrip must be one that has one or more targets and must either require a spell attack roll or have a saving throw.

Amp Choose one creature hit by the spell (if the spell has a spell attack roll) or that fails its save against the spell (if the spell requires a save). A psychic beacon emits from the creature's location, making it easier to notice the creature as the mind and attention of onlookers is subtly drawn to it. For 1 minute, if the target would be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, it's instead merely @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and if it would be concealed, it's no longer concealed.

_desc_en:
As your spell strikes a target, you plant a beacon in the target's mind that announces its presence to those nearby. Use this amp in place of a psi cantrip's normal amp entry. The amped cantrip must be one that has one or more targets and must either require a spell attack roll or have a saving throw.

Amp Choose one creature hit by the spell (if the spell has a spell attack roll) or that fails its save against the spell (if the spell requires a save). A psychic beacon emits from the creature's location, making it easier to notice the creature as the mind and attention of onlookers is subtly drawn to it. For 1 minute, if the target would be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, it's instead merely @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and if it would be concealed, it's no longer concealed.
_desc_ko:
주문이 대상에 강타할 때, 당신은 대상의 정신에 주변 존재들에게 그 존재를 알리는 비콘을 심습니다. 이 앰프를 사이 캔트립의 일반 앰프 항목 대신 사용하십시오. 증폭된 캔트립은 하나 이상의 대상을 가져야 하며, 주문 명중 굴림이 필요하거나 내성 굴림을 가져야 합니다.

앰프 주문에 맞은 생물 하나(주문이 명중 굴림을 요구하는 경우) 또는 주문에 대한 내성 굴림에 실패한 생물 하나(주문이 내성 굴림을 요구하는 경우)를 선택한다. 생물의 위치에서 사이킥 신호가 발산되어 주변 관찰자들의 정신과 주의가 은은하게 그 생물로 이끌리면서 생물을 더 쉽게 알아차리게 합니다. 1분 동안, 대상이 @link[conditions.invisible] 상태가 될 경우 대신 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태가 되며, 은폐 상태가 될 경우 더 이상 가려지지 않습니다.

name: Walk on the Wind

description.value: A flighty breeze follows you wherever you go, granting a dramatic flair to everything you do. You're light on your feet, your voice gains an airy quality that allows it to travel further than normal, and your clothing and hair rustle gently around you at all times. You can Stride at half your land Speed across calm air. If you attempt to carry another creature with you while walking on air, even if it's in an extradimensional space, you fall.

value.value: You've been brought to 0 Hit Points by an enemy that has the air trait or an enemy's ability that has the air trait

_desc_en: A flighty breeze follows you wherever you go, granting a dramatic flair to everything you do. You're light on your feet, your voice gains an airy quality that allows it to travel further than normal, and your clothing and hair rustle gently around you at all times. You can Stride at half your land Speed across calm air. If you attempt to carry another creature with you while walking on air, even if it's in an extradimensional space, you fall.
_desc_ko: 가벼운 바람이 어디를 가든 당신을 따라다니며, 당신이 하는 모든 일에 극적인 매력을 더해줍니다. 발걸음이 가벼워지고 목소리에 공중을 가르는 듯한 특성이 생겨 평소보다 멀리까지 전달되며, 옷과 머리카락이 항상 주변에서 살랑거린다. 평온한 공기 위에서는 지상 속도의 절반으로 이동할 수 있다. 공중을 이동할 때 다른 생물을 함께 운반하려고 시도하면, 차원이 다른 공간에 있더라도 반드시 추락한다.

name: Firework Technician Dedication

description.value:
You've learned the secrets of making fire and sound bloom using black powder, metals, and paper. You most likely came by this knowledge through formal training with a fireworks house in Tian Xia or a fireworks company from Vudra, though perhaps you mastered fireworks completely by yourself after finding a secret stash in an old shipwreck.

You become trained in Fireworks Lore or become an expert if you were already trained in it. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.Jkl5KOZih7MoMqAJ#quick-alchemy-benefits]{quick alchemy benefits}, creating up to 4 pyrotechnic versatile vials during your daily preparations. These vials have the fire trait and deal fire damage instead of acid. You can use pyrotechnic versatile vials only to throw as bombs, for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.yUjuLbBMflVum8Yn]{Launch Fireworks} action or with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.yzNJgwzV9XqEhKc6]{Quick Alchemy} to create fireworks consumables, including @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.AOOQJfSkTPiSzfB9]{Doses} or rounds of black powder, the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.hd8D1Dm6aVhMYpEL]{Sparkler} item, and other items determined by the GM. You can replenish your versatile vials during exploration the same way an alchemist can.

You can create fireworks displays to have distinctive effects you can use to make onlookers marvel and even to gain an advantage in combat. You gain the Launch Fireworks action and learn some basic effects. You can learn additional, more complex displays that use your versatile vials through other firework technician feats. These add a new fireworks display to your options for Launch Fireworks, each of which lists its number of actions and effects. The DC for Launch Fireworks is equal to your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

Special If you have Quick Alchemy from another source (such as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.kzxu2dI7tFxv6Ix6.JournalEntryPage.Om4e4tsgNWrComie]{alchemist} class or multiclass archetype), you can use standard versatile vials to Launch Fireworks or create fireworks consumables. Each time you create a versatile vial, you choose whether it's a standard vial or pyrotechnic vial. Both types count toward your maximum number of versatile vials. You can replenish only pyrotechnic vials during exploration unless another ability lets you replenish standard versatile vials (such as the benefit of the alchemist class), in which case you can choose the type each time you replenish.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.S4BZW9c5n6CctDxl]{Firework Technician}

_desc_ko:
당신은 흑색 화약, 금속, 종이를 이용해 불과 소리를 피워 올리는 비법을 터득했습니다. 아마도 티엔 샤의 불꽃놀이 제작소나 부드라의 불꽃놀이 회사에서 정식 훈련을 통해 이 지식을 얻었을 것입니다. 하지만 오래된 난파선에서 비밀 창고를 발견한 후 완전히 독학으로 불꽃놀이를 마스터했을 가능성도 있습니다.

불꽃놀이 지식에 숙련되거나, 이미 숙련된 경우 전문가가 됩니다. 연금술 제작 피트, 고급 연금술 혜택, 신속 연금술 혜택을 얻어 매일 준비 과정에서 최대 4개의 다용도 약병을 제작할 수 있습니다. 탐험 중에도 연금술사처럼 이 약병을 보충할 수 있습니다. 다용도 약병으로 불꽃놀이를 제작하거나 @link[actions.launch-fireworks]를 사용하며, 이 아키타입의 다른 피트를 활용할 수 있습니다.

고급 연금술 혜택의 일일 소모품을 사용해 '불꽃놀이 디스플레이'라는 특수 아이템을 제작할 수도 있습니다. 이 디스플레이는 관중을 놀라게 하거나 전투에서 이점을 얻는 데 활용할 수 있는 독특한 효과를 연출하도록 설계되었습니다. '불꽃놀이 발사' 행동을 획득하고 기본 효과를 익힙니다. 다른 불꽃놀이 기술자 재주를 통해 일일 불꽃놀이 디스플레이 자원을 사용하는 추가적이고 복잡한 디스플레이를 배울 수 있습니다. 모든 디스플레이의 난이도(DC)는 직업 난이도(DC) 또는 주문 난이도(DC) 중 더 높은 쪽과 동일합니다.

name: Efficient Explorer

description.value: You are more efficient at exploring uncharted territories. As long as you're in a hex that is predominantly a terrain in which you are trained in an associated Lore skill, you grant your group one additional hexploration activity.

value.value: trained in Lore about a specific terrain

_desc_en: You are more efficient at exploring uncharted territories. As long as you're in a hex that is predominantly a terrain in which you are trained in an associated Lore skill, you grant your group one additional hexploration activity.
_desc_ko: 미개척 지역 탐사에 더 능숙합니다. 관련 지식 지식 훈련을 받은 지형이 주를 이루는 육각형에 위치한 동안, 파티원에게 추가로 한 번의 육각형 탐사 활동을 부여합니다.

name: Too Much to Swallow

description.value:
Trigger You're subject to an effect you could attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}.

While you might be small enough to grab normally, you can change that at a moment's notice. You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form}. If you took on a new form that's too large for the effect, you automatically escape. Otherwise, you attempt to Escape. If this ends an effect where you entered the creature's space, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.uJSseLa57HZYSMUu]{Swallow Whole}, exit that creature to an adjacent area where your new form could fit.

_desc_en:
Trigger You're subject to an effect you could attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}.

While you might be small enough to grab normally, you can change that at a moment's notice. You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form}. If you took on a new form that's too large for the effect, you automatically escape. Otherwise, you attempt to Escape. If this ends an effect where you entered the creature's space, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.uJSseLa57HZYSMUu]{Swallow Whole}, exit that creature to an adjacent area where your new form could fit.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신은 @link[actions.escape]을 시도할 수 있는 효과에 걸렸습니다.

당신은 보통 붙잡기 위해 작을 수 있지만, 순간적으로 그 상태를 바꿀 수 있습니다. 당신은 @link[spells.untamed-form]를 시전합니다. 만약 효과가 적용될 수 없을 만큼 큰 새로운 형태를 취했다면, 당신은 자동으로 탈출합니다. 그렇지 않으면 탈출을 시도한다. 이로 인해 @link[actions.swallow-whole]처럼 생물의 공간에 진입한 효과가 종료된다면, 그 생물을 벗어나 새로운 형태가 들어갈 수 있는 인접 영역으로 이동한다.

name: Familiar Ritualist

description.value: Your familiar's magical presence can serve as an aspect of a ritual. When you cast a ritual, your familiar can serve as a secondary caster, fulfilling any requirements for the secondary caster as well as a secondary check. You can't replace a secondary caster who's the target of the spell.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your familiar's magical presence can serve as an aspect of a ritual. When you cast a ritual, your familiar can serve as a secondary caster, fulfilling any requirements for the secondary caster as well as a secondary check. You can't replace a secondary caster who's the target of the spell.
_desc_ko: 당신의 패밀리어의 마법적 존재감은 의식의 한 측면으로 작용할 수 있습니다. 의식을 시전할 때, 당신의 패밀리어는 보조 시전자 역할을 수행하여 보조 시전자에 대한 모든 요구 사항과 보조 판정을 충족시킬 수 있습니다. 해당 주문 대상인 보조 시전자를 대체할 수는 없습니다.

name: Theoretical Acumen

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You succeed at a skill check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} to identify a creature.

You study a creature's form and behavior to hypothesize likely means of overcoming its strengths. Once before the end of your next turn, you can use the skill modifier from the triggering check in place of your saving throw modifier against one of the creature's abilities, in place of your Perception modifier to Seek the creature, in place of your Deception modifier to Feint against the creature, or in place of your Intimidation modifier to Demoralize the creature. Alternatively, against one of the creature's attacks, you can use your DC for the skill used in the triggering check in place of your AC.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You succeed at a skill check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} to identify a creature.

You study a creature's form and behavior to hypothesize likely means of overcoming its strengths. Once before the end of your next turn, you can use the skill modifier from the triggering check in place of your saving throw modifier against one of the creature's abilities, in place of your Perception modifier to Seek the creature, in place of your Deception modifier to Feint against the creature, or in place of your Intimidation modifier to Demoralize the creature. Alternatively, against one of the creature's attacks, you can use your DC for the skill used in the triggering check in place of your AC.
_desc_ko:
빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 생물을 식별하기 위한 @link[actions.recall-knowledge] 기술 판정에서 성공해야 합니다.

당신은 생물의 형태와 행동을 연구하여 그 강점을 극복할 수 있는 방법을 가설로 세웁니다. 다음 턴이 끝나기 전 한 번, 당신은 해당 생물의 능력 중 하나에 대한 내성 굴림 수정자 대신 발동 판정에서 얻은 기술 수정자를 사용할 수 있습니다. 또한 해당 생물을 추적할 때 지각 수정치 대신, 속임수를 쓸 때 기만 수정치 대신, 사기를 꺾을 때 위협 수정치 대신 사용할 수 있습니다. 또는 해당 생물의 공격 하나에 대해, 발동 판정 시 사용한 기술의 DC를 AC 대신 사용할 수 있다.

name: Duelist's Form

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding only an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.iSceAVMkVv1uKK7t]{Aldori Dueling Sword} and have your other hand or hands free; you are not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.

Many assume that a duelist's habit of fighting with one hand behind their back or on their hip is an insult or self-restriction. This could not be further from the truth. Fighting with a single hand dictates mastery and heightens the duelist's focus by narrowing points of interest, allowing them to move and react to changing situations with unnatural speed. While in this stance, you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}. You can use this extra action only to Step or use a single-action activity gained from the Aldori duelist archetype. If you use your free hand for anything, this stance ends. When this stance ends, you become fatigued until you rest for at least 10 minutes.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding only an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.iSceAVMkVv1uKK7t]{Aldori Dueling Sword} and have your other hand or hands free; you are not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.

Many assume that a duelist's habit of fighting with one hand behind their back or on their hip is an insult or self-restriction. This could not be further from the truth. Fighting with a single hand dictates mastery and heightens the duelist's focus by narrowing points of interest, allowing them to move and react to changing situations with unnatural speed. While in this stance, you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}. You can use this extra action only to Step or use a single-action activity gained from the Aldori duelist archetype. If you use your free hand for anything, this stance ends. When this stance ends, you become fatigued until you rest for at least 10 minutes.
_desc_ko:
Requirements 당신은 @link[equipment.aldori-dueling-sword]만을 휘두르고 있으며, 다른 손은 자유로워야 합니다. 또한 @link[conditions.fatigued]가 아니어야 합니다.

많은 이들이 결투사가 한 손을 등 뒤나 허리에 둔 채 싸우는 습관을 모욕이나 자제력으로 여긴다. 이는 진실과 거리가 멀다. 한 손으로 싸우는 것은 숙련도를 요구하며, 관심의 초점을 좁혀 결투사의 포커스를 강화한다. 이를 통해 그들은 비정상적인 속도로 움직이고 변화하는 상황에 반응할 수 있다. 이 자세를 취하는 동안 당신은 @link[conditions.quickened] 상태가 된다. 이 추가 행동은 오직 이동하거나 알도리 결투사 아키타입에서 얻은 액션 하나에만 사용할 수 있다. 빈 손을 다른 용도로 사용하면 이 자세는 종료된다. 이 자세가 종료되면 최소 10분간 휴식을 취할 때까지 피로 상태가 된다.

name: Marshal Dedication

description.value:
You've combined your social skills and combat training to become a talented combat leader. Choose Diplomacy or Intimidation. You become trained in that skill or become an expert if you were already trained in it.

In addition, you're surrounded by a marshal's aura in a @Template[emanation|distance:15]. Your aura has the emotion, mental, and visual traits and grants you and allies within the aura a +1 status bonus to saving throws against fear.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.1F84oh5hoG86mZIw]{Marshal}

value.value: trained in martial weapons and either Diplomacy or Intimidation

_desc_en:
You've combined your social skills and combat training to become a talented combat leader. Choose Diplomacy or Intimidation. You become trained in that skill or become an expert if you were already trained in it.

In addition, you're surrounded by a marshal's aura in a @Template[emanation|distance:15]. Your aura has the emotion, mental, and visual traits and grants you and allies within the aura a +1 status bonus to saving throws against fear.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.1F84oh5hoG86mZIw]{Marshal}
_desc_ko:
사회적 기술과 전투 훈련을 결합하여 재능 있는 전투 지도자가 되었습니다. 외교 또는 협박술 중 하나를 선택하세요. 해당 기술에 숙련되거나, 이미 숙련된 경우 전문가 수준이 됩니다.

또한, 당신은 반경 15피트 내에 마셜의 오라로 둘러싸여 있습니다. 이 오라는 감정적, 정신, 시각적 특성을 지니며, 오라 안에 있는 당신과 아군에게 공포에 대한 내성 굴림 시 +1 상태 보너스를 부여합니다.

name: Liberty's Promise

description.value:
Your devotion to Andoran's ideals is as much spiritual as philosophical. You gain the cleric's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.hT4INKGtly4QY8KN]{Domain Initiate} feat but must select @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.EEZvDB1Z7ezwaxIr.JournalEntryPage.5MjSsuKOLBoiL8FB]{freedom}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.EEZvDB1Z7ezwaxIr.JournalEntryPage.lgsJz7mZ1OTe340e]{truth}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.EEZvDB1Z7ezwaxIr.JournalEntryPage.DI3MYGIK8iEycanU]{zeal} as your domain. You cast that domain's domain spell as a divine focus spell, and you Refocus by contemplating or spreading the ideas of the Common Rule rather than praying to a god. When an ability would manifest a divine symbol—such as the word of truth focus spell—it instead manifests as an eagle clutching a sword in its talons.

Special You can take this feat multiple times, selecting a different domain each time.

Your devotion to Andoran's ideals is as much spiritual as philosophical. You gain the cleric's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.hT4INKGtly4QY8KN]{Domain Initiate} feat but must select @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.EEZvDB1Z7ezwaxIr.JournalEntryPage.5MjSsuKOLBoiL8FB]{freedom}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.EEZvDB1Z7ezwaxIr.JournalEntryPage.lgsJz7mZ1OTe340e]{truth}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.EEZvDB1Z7ezwaxIr.JournalEntryPage.DI3MYGIK8iEycanU]{zeal} as your domain. You cast that domain's domain spell as a divine focus spell, and you Refocus by contemplating or spreading the ideas of the Common Rule rather than praying to a god. When an ability would manifest a divine symbol—such as the word of truth focus spell—it instead manifests as an eagle clutching a sword in its talons.

Special You can take this feat multiple times, selecting a different domain each time.
_desc_ko:
안도란의 이상에 대한 당신의 헌신은 철학적인 만큼이나 영적인 것입니다. 당신은 성직자의 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.hT4INKGtly4QY8KN]{권역 입문자} 재주를 얻지만, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.EEZvDB1Z7ezwaxIr.JournalEntryPage.5MjSsuKOLBoiL8FB]{자유}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.EEZvDB1Z7ezwaxIr.JournalEntryPage.lgsJz7mZ1OTe340e]{진실}, 또는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.EEZvDB1Z7ezwaxIr.JournalEntryPage.DI3MYGIK8iEycanU]{열정}을 당신의 권역으로 선택해야 합니다. 당신은 그 권역의 권역 주문을 신성 집중 주문으로 시전하며, 신에게 기도하는 대신 공통 규율의 이상을 사색하거나 전파함으로써 재집중합니다. 진실의 말 집중 주문처럼 어떤 능력이 신성 상징을 발현시킬 때, 그것은 대신 발톱에 검을 움켜쥔 독수리로 발현됩니다.

특수 당신은 매번 다른 권역을 선택하여 이 재주를 여러 번 취할 수 있습니다.

name: Perfect Dive

description.value: You dive into the water with exceptional skill and connection to the waves, urging the water itself to cushion your fall. You intentionally Leap or otherwise fall into the water, taking no falling damage regardless of the distance.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Absalom, City of Lost Omens

_desc_en: You dive into the water with exceptional skill and connection to the waves, urging the water itself to cushion your fall. You intentionally Leap or otherwise fall into the water, taking no falling damage regardless of the distance.
_desc_ko: 탁월한 기술과 파도와 하나 되는 감각으로 물속으로 뛰어들어 물 자체에 충격을 흡수하게 합니다. 의도적으로 도약하거나 물속으로 떨어지며, 거리와의 상관없이 낙하 피해를 입지 않습니다.

name: Lock On

description.value:
Aha! You lock on to your enemy's weak point to assist your construct companion in destroying it. When you Lock On, designate an enemy you can see. If your next action is to Command your construct, the construct gains a +2 circumstance bonus to attack rolls against the designated enemy until the end of the turn. If you use 2 actions for the Command, the bonus is instead a +3 circumstance bonus, or a +4 circumstance bonus if you're legendary in Crafting.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.xtqOIXCe0Nsd0QCt]{Effect: Lock On}

Aha! You lock on to your enemy's weak point to assist your construct companion in destroying it. When you Lock On, designate an enemy you can see. If your next action is to Command your construct, the construct gains a +2 circumstance bonus to attack rolls against the designated enemy until the end of the turn. If you use 2 actions for the Command, the bonus is instead a +3 circumstance bonus, or a +4 circumstance bonus if you're legendary in Crafting.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.xtqOIXCe0Nsd0QCt]{Effect: Lock On}
_desc_ko:
아하! 당신은 적의 약점을 조준하여 조종하는 창조물이 이를 파괴하도록 지원합니다. 락 온 시, 시야 내에 있는 적 하나를 지정하세요. 다음 명령 행동으로 창조물을 지휘할 경우, 해당 창조물은 지정된 적에 대한 명중 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 이 효과는 턴 종료 시까지 지속됩니다. 명령에 2개의 행동을 사용하면 보너스는 +3 상황 보너스로 변경되며, 제작에 전설적인 숙련도를 가진 경우 +4 상황 보너스를 받는다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.xtqOIXCe0Nsd0QCt]{효과: 락 온}

name: Assume Godhood

description.value:
You complete your apotheosis into living godhood, allowing you to empower more followers. You can serve as the deity for classes with a deity feature, such as clerics, empowering them to cast divine spells with their class features. When you serve as the deity in this way, you can provide any aspect of a deity stat block (such as domains or a favored weapon) that you yourself have acquired from a godling feat. In addition, you can choose one skill you are legendary in to act as your divine skill, and your divine attributes include your key attribute and one other attribute of your choosing.

When you Assume Godhood, choose three spells from any list other than the divine list; one must be 1st rank, one must be 2nd or 3rd rank, and one can be of any rank. These spells become additional cleric spells you can grant to your followers. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.0MZ5tFUYKGMq21NV]{Intercession Spell} ability, allowing you to directly provide the magic that your hierophant uses to enact your miracles.

If you die after Assuming Godhood, only your mortal body perishes, and you continue your existence as a deity, watching over the Universe from afar. In this deific form, you cannot move, act, or speak normally, though you still grant spells to your followers and can perceive and affect them using your godling abilities like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ttWl0hOh9cdk7Zko]{Receive Prayers} or Intercession Spell, regardless of range. If you need to take more direct action in creation, you can descend to the Universe and incarnate yourself into a mortal body of your choosing within 1 mile of one of your followers or a holy site relevant to your faith, which has the same statistics and abilities that you had before you died. This new body can have any appearance you wish, but typically retains at least one feature important to your divine iconography, such as eye color, a scar, or a unique birthmark. You can incarnate yourself as often as you like, but repeated direct intercessions in the affairs of mortals typically attract the attention and sanction of older and more established deities.

_desc_ko:
살아있는 신으로의 신격화를 완성하여 더 많은 추종자에게 힘을 부여할 수 있습니다. 클레릭처럼 신성 특성을 가진 직업의 신으로 섬길 수 있으며, 이들에게 직업 특성을 통해 신성 마법을 시전할 수 있는 힘을 부여합니다. 이처럼 신으로 섬길 때, 당신은 신성 재주에서 획득한 신의 통계 블록 속성(예: 영역이나 선호 무기)을 제공할 수 있습니다. 또한 전설적인 숙련도를 가진 기술 중 하나를 신성 기술로 선택할 수 있으며, 신성 속성에는 핵심 능력치와 선택한 다른 한 가지 능력치가 포함됩니다.

신격화 시 신성 주문 목록 외의 목록에서 주문 3개를 선택합니다. 하나는 1랭크, 하나는 (2nd) 또는 3랭크이어야 하며, 하나는 랭크 제한 없이 선택할 수 있습니다. 이 주문들은 추종자들에게 부여할 수 있는 추가 클레릭 주문이 됩니다. @link[actions.intercession-spell] 능력을 획득하여, 신관(神官)이 기적을 행할 때 사용하는 마법을 직접 제공할 수 있습니다.

신격화 후 사망할 경우, 오직 육체만 소멸되며 당신은 신으로서의 존재를 지속하며 우주를 멀리서 지켜봅니다. 이 신적 형태에서는 정상적으로 움직이거나 행동하거나 말할 수 없으나, 여전히 추종자들에게 주문을 부여할 수 있으며 @link[feats.receive-prayers]나 중재 주문과 같은 신성 능력을 통해 그들을 감지하고 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다. 창조계에서 더 직접적인 행동이 필요할 경우, 신은 신도나 신앙과 관련된 신성한 성지로부터 1마일 이내의 선택한 필멸자의 육신으로 강림하여 육화할 수 있습니다. 이 육신은 신이 죽기 전과 동일한 능력치와 능력을 지닙니다. 이 새로운 육체는 원하는 어떤 외모도 가질 수 있으나, 일반적으로 신성한 상징에 중요한 특징 하나 이상(예: 눈 색깔, 흉터, 독특한 모반)을 유지한다. 원하는 만큼 자주 육화할 수 있으나, 인간들의 일에 반복적으로 직접 개입하면 일반적으로 더 오래되고 확립된 신들의 주목과 제재를 받게 된다.

name: Come at Me!

description.value: You're a legendary duelist, welcoming all challengers, enabling you to challenge many foes even while other challenges are active. There is no longer a limit to the number of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.yOyMlFGAgLfRas8m]{Pistolero's Challenges} you can have in effect at one time.

_desc_en: You're a legendary duelist, welcoming all challengers, enabling you to challenge many foes even while other challenges are active. There is no longer a limit to the number of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.yOyMlFGAgLfRas8m]{Pistolero's Challenges} you can have in effect at one time.
_desc_ko: 당신은 전설적인 결투사로, 모든 도전자들을 환영하며 다른 도전이 진행 중일 때도 여러 적에게 도전할 수 있습니다. 동시에 발동할 수 있는 @link[feats.pistoleros-challenge]의 수에 제한이 없어집니다.

name: Gaze of Veracity

description.value: You can channel your mask's power to pierce through lies and see the truth in any situation. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZjbVgIIqMstmdkqP]{Glimpse the Truth} focus spell. This has the same tradition trait as the spellcasting class feature used as a prerequisite for Hellknight Signifer Preferment. You gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point if you don't already have a focus pool or increase your focus pool by 1 (to a maximum of 3). You can Refocus by studying tomes of law or by contemplating the Measure and the Chain.

_desc_en: You can channel your mask's power to pierce through lies and see the truth in any situation. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZjbVgIIqMstmdkqP]{Glimpse the Truth} focus spell. This has the same tradition trait as the spellcasting class feature used as a prerequisite for Hellknight Signifer Preferment. You gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point if you don't already have a focus pool or increase your focus pool by 1 (to a maximum of 3). You can Refocus by studying tomes of law or by contemplating the Measure and the Chain.
_desc_ko: 가면의 힘을 집중하여 어떤 상황에서도 거짓을 관통하고 진실을 볼 수 있습니다. 포커스 풀의 포커스 포인트 수를 1 증가시킵니다. 가면을 착용 중일 때, 클레릭 도메인 주문 @link[spells.glimpse-the-truth]를 신성 포커스 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Energy Fusion

description.value:
You fuse two spells together, combining their energy types. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that deals energy damage, select a non-cantrip spell in your spell repertoire that deals a different type of energy damage, and expend an additional spell slot of the same rank as this secondary spell.

The spell you cast deals additional damage equal to the rank of the secondary spell slot expended. The spell's total damage is divided evenly between the energy type of the spell you cast and the energy type of the secondary spell.

_desc_en:
You fuse two spells together, combining their energy types. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that deals energy damage, select a non-cantrip spell in your spell repertoire that deals a different type of energy damage, and expend an additional spell slot of the same rank as this secondary spell.

The spell you cast deals additional damage equal to the rank of the secondary spell slot expended. The spell's total damage is divided evenly between the energy type of the spell you cast and the energy type of the secondary spell.
_desc_ko:
두 주문을 융합하여 에너지 유형을 결합합니다. 다음 행동으로 에너지 피해를 주는 주문을 시전할 경우, 자신의 주문 목록에서 다른 유형의 에너지 피해를 주는 캔트립이 아닌 주문을 선택하고 그리고 이 보조 주문과 동일한 랭크의 추가 주문 슬롯을 소모한다.

시전한 주문은 소모된 보조 주문 슬롯의 랭크에 해당하는 추가 피해를 입힌다. 총 피해량은 시전한 주문의 에너지 유형과 보조 주문의 에너지 유형 사이에 균등하게 분배된다.

name: March of Law

description.value:
Frequency once per round

Requirements The target has attempted a hostile action against you since your previous turn.

When faced with lawbreakers, you become almost unstoppable, and your purposeful steps instill terror. Stride toward the required target with a +10-foot status bonus to your Speeds and ignoring difficult terrain. If you end your movement adjacent to the required target, each enemy adjacent to you who saw your movement becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}. You can use March of Law while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

Frequency once per round

Requirements The target has attempted a hostile action against you since your previous turn.

When faced with lawbreakers, you become almost unstoppable, and your purposeful steps instill terror. Stride toward the required target with a +10-foot status bonus to your Speeds and ignoring difficult terrain. If you end your movement adjacent to the required target, each enemy adjacent to you who saw your movement becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}. You can use March of Law while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.
_desc_ko:
빈도 라운드당 1회

요구조건 대상이 당신의 이전 턴 이후로 당신에게 적대적 행동을 시도했습니다.

법을 어기는 자들과 마주하면, 당신은 거의 막을 수 없게 되고, 당신의 단호한 걸음은 공포를 심어줍니다. 요구되는 대상을 향해 당신의 속도에 +10피트 상태 보너스를 받으며 험지를 무시하고 보폭합니다. 요구되는 대상과 인접하게 이동을 마치면, 당신의 이동을 본 당신과 인접한 각 적은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{공포 2}가 됩니다. 당신이 해당 이동 유형을 지녔다면, 보폭 대신 굴착, 등반, 비행, 또는 수영을 하면서 법의 행진을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Tactical Entry

description.value:
Requirements You rolled Stealth for initiative in this encounter, and neither you nor any enemies have acted yet.

You Stride. This movement doesn't trigger any reactions.

_desc_en:
Requirements You rolled Stealth for initiative in this encounter, and neither you nor any enemies have acted yet.

You Stride. This movement doesn't trigger any reactions.
_desc_ko:
요구사항 당신은 이 전투에서 인니셔티브를 위해 은신 검사를 굴림했으며, 당신이나 적 중 누구도 아직 행동하지 않았습니다.

당신은 스트라이드를 사용합니다. 이 이동은 어떤 반응도 유발하지 않습니다.

name: Avatar's Protection

description.value:
Trigger You are critically hit by an enemy.

Requirements You have an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ckUOoqOM7Kg7VqxB]{Avatar} spell prepared.

In moments of danger, you can call upon your god's form in an instant. You cast avatar from your spell slots. The triggering critical hit is reduced to a normal hit, and its damage is applied after gaining the avatar spell's temporary Hit Points.

_desc_en:
Trigger You are critically hit by an enemy.

Requirements You have an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ckUOoqOM7Kg7VqxB]{Avatar} spell prepared.

In moments of danger, you can call upon your god's form in an instant. You cast avatar from your spell slots. The triggering critical hit is reduced to a normal hit, and its damage is applied after gaining the avatar spell's temporary Hit Points.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 적에게 치명타를 당함.

요구 사항 당신은 @link[spells.avatar] 주문을 준비했습니다.

위험한 순간에 당신은 순간적으로 신의 형상을 불러낼 수 있습니다. 당신은 주문 슬롯에서 아바타를 시전합니다. 발동된 치명타는 일반 타격으로 감소되며, 그 피해는 아바타 주문의 임시 HP를 획득한 후에 적용됩니다.

name: Greater Snow Step

description.value: You can't be impeded by environmental effects that rely on cold or its byproducts. You ignore greater difficult terrain caused by snow and ice.

_desc_en: You can't be impeded by environmental effects that rely on cold or its byproducts. You ignore greater difficult terrain caused by snow and ice.
_desc_ko: 추위나 그 부산물에 의존하는 환경 효과로 인해 방해받지 않습니다. 눈과 얼음으로 인한 매우 어려운 지형을 무시합니다.

name: Stand Still

description.value:
Trigger A creature within your reach uses a move action or leaves a square during a move action it's using

You strike out when your foe tries to flee. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a move action, you disrupt that action.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature within your reach uses a move action or leaves a square during a move action it's using

You strike out when your foe tries to flee. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a move action, you disrupt that action.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신의 도달 범위 내에 있는 생물이 이동 행동을 사용하거나, 사용 중인 이동 행동 중에 한 칸을 떠날 때

적군이 도주하려 할 때 공격한다. 발동 대상 생물에게 근접 공격을 가한다. 공격이 치명타이고 발동 원인이 이동 행동이었다면, 해당 행동을 방해한다.

name: Interrupt Charge

description.value:
Trigger A foe within reach attempts to move away from you.

Requirements You have a hand free.

You attempt to snag the foe before they run away. Attempt an Athletics check against the higher of the triggering creature's Athletics DC or Fortitude DC.

Critical Success You disrupt the movement.

Success You are able to slow the triggering creature down. It takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speed for the rest of its triggering movement. This penalty might cause the triggering creature's movement to end immediately based on its affected Speed.

Failure As success, but the creature instead takes a –5-foot circumstance penalty to its Speed.

_desc_ko:
발동 도달 범위 내의 적이 당신으로부터 멀어지려 시도합니다.

요구 사항 한 손이 자유로워야 합니다.

적들이 도망가기 전에 붙잡으려 시도합니다. 발동한 생물의 운동 DC 또는 인내 DC 중 높은 쪽을 상대로 운동 판정을 시도하세요.

대성공 이동을 방해합니다.

성공 당신은 유발 생물의 속도를 늦출 수 있습니다. 유발 생물은 남은 유발 이동 동안 속도에 -10피트 상황 페널티를 받습니다. 이 페널티는 영향을 받은 속도에 따라 유발 생물의 이동이 즉시 종료될 수 있습니다.

실패 성공과 동일하나, 대신 해당 생물의 이동 속도에 -5피트 상황 페널티가 적용됩니다.

name: Recognize Spell

description.value:
Trigger A creature within line of sight casts a spell that you don't have prepared or in your spell repertoire, or a trap or similar object casts such a spell. You must be aware of the casting.

If you are trained in the appropriate skill for the spell's tradition and it's a common spell of 2nd rank or lower, you automatically identify it (you still roll to attempt to get a critical success, but can't get a worse result than success). The highest rank of spell you automatically identify increases to 4 if you're an expert, 6 if you're a master, and 10 if you're legendary. The GM rolls a secret Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion check, whichever corresponds to the tradition of the spell being cast. If you're not trained in the skill, you can't get a result better than failure.

Critical Success You correctly recognize the spell and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your saving throw or your AC against it.

Success You correctly recognize the spell.

Failure You fail to recognize the spell.

Critical Failure You misidentify the spell as another spell entirely, of the GM's choice.

value.value: trained in Arcana, Nature, Occultism or Religion

_desc_ko:
발동 시야 내에 있는 생물이 당신이 준비하지 않았거나 당신의 주문 목록에 없는 주문을 시전하거나, 함정이나 유사한 물체가 그러한 주문을 시전합니다. 당신은 시전 사실을 인지해야 합니다.

해당 주문 전통에 필요한 기술을 숙련하고 있으며, 2랭크 이하의 일반 주문일 경우 자동으로 식별한다(대성공을 시도하지만, 성공보다 낮은 결과는 나올 수 없다). 자동 식별 가능한 최대 주문 랭크은 전문가는 4, 달인는 6, 전설급은 10까지 상승합니다. GM은 시전되는 주문의 전통에 해당하는 주문학, 자연, 오컬트, 종교 중 하나를 비밀로 판정을 굴립니다. 해당 기술에 숙련되지 않았다면 실패보다 나은 결과를 얻을 수 없습니다.

대성공 당신은 주문을 정확히 인식하고, 해당 주문에 대한 내성 굴림이나 AC에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

성공 당신은 주문을 정확히 알아챘습니다.

실패 당신은 그 주문을 알아보지 못합니다.

대실패 당신은 그 주문을 GM이 선택한 완전히 다른 주문으로 오인합니다.

name: Perfect Distraction

description.value: You use clever tactics to mislead your foes as you sneak away. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} while leaving a decoy behind. The decoy acts as the spell @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WPXzPl7YbMEIGWfi]{Mislead}, though you aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, just @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}. You can continue to concentrate to move your decoy, as with the spell, whether or not you remain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} throughout the duration. Once you use Perfect Distraction, you need to spend 10 minutes to set up another decoy before you can use it again.

_desc_ko: 당신은 교묘한 전술로 적을 속이며 은밀 이동한다. 당신은 @link[actions.sneak] 상태로 도주하며 미끼를 남깁니다. 이 미끼는 @link[spells.mislead] 주문과 동일하게 작용하지만, 당신은 @link[conditions.invisible] 상태가 아닌 단순히 탐지되지 않은 상태입니다. 주문과 마찬가지로, 지속 시간 내내 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태를 유지하든 아니든, 집중을 유지하며 미끼를 이동시킬 수 있습니다. 완벽한 주의 분산을 사용한 후에는 다시 사용하기 전에 10분 동안 다른 미끼를 준비해야 합니다.

name: Summon Wood Elemental

description.value: Your connection to the Plane of Wood allows you to summon elemental allies. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lpT6LotUaQPfinjj]{Summon Elemental} as a 5th-rank primal innate spell, but the elemental must be a wood elemental.

_desc_en: Your connection to the Plane of Wood allows you to summon elemental allies. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lpT6LotUaQPfinjj]{Summon Elemental} as a 5th-rank primal innate spell, but the elemental must be a wood elemental.
_desc_ko: 나무계면과의 연결로 원소 동료를 소환할 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, @link[spells.summon-elemental]을 (5th)랭크 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있으나, 소환되는 원소는 반드시 나무 원소여야 합니다.

name: Necromantic Resistance (Undead Slayer)

description.value: As part of your training, you've inured yourself against necromancy through grueling, repeated exposure. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against necromancy effects and gain resistance to void damage equal to half your level.

_desc_en: As part of your training, you've inured yourself against necromancy through grueling, repeated exposure. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against necromancy effects and gain resistance to void damage equal to half your level.
_desc_ko: 훈련의 일환으로, 당신은 혹독하고 반복적인 노출을 통해 네크로맨시에 대한 내성을 길러왔습니다. 네크로맨시 효과에 대한 저항에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 공허 피해에 대한 저항력을 얻습니다.

name: Warrior of Legend Dedication

description.value:
You have been given a powerful blessing of battle that is also your cursed doom. As long as you aren't wearing heavy armor or wielding a shield, spears and polearms you wield gain the parry trait. If the weapon already has the parry trait, increase the bonus when parrying to +2. In addition, you deal an additional amount of damage equal to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} value with weapons in the spear and polearm groups. This damage is the same type as the required weapon.

_desc_ko: 당신은 강력한 전투의 축복을 받았으나, 이는 동시에 저주받은 운명이기도 하다. 중갑을 착용하거나 방패를 휘두르지 않는 한, 당신이 휘두르는 창과 장창은 패리 특성을 얻는다. 해당 무기가 이미 패리 특성을 지닌 경우, 패리 시 보너스가 +2로 증가한다. 또한 창과 장창 계열 무기로 공격 시, @link[conditions.doomed] 값에 해당하는 추가 피해를 입힌다. 이 피해는 사용한 무기의 속성과 동일하다.

name: Precious Ammunition

description.value:
You have learned to mimic the power that lies between magic and material. You enchant a piece of ammunition on your person with the magical essence of a precious material, allowing you to leverage certain creatures' weaknesses.

Choose cold iron or silver; if you shoot the arrow or bolt before the end of your turn, it counts as that material. At 14th level, add adamantine to the list of materials you can choose from.

_desc_en:
You have learned to mimic the power that lies between magic and material. You enchant a piece of ammunition on your person with the magical essence of a precious material, allowing you to leverage certain creatures' weaknesses.

Choose cold iron or silver; if you shoot the arrow or bolt before the end of your turn, it counts as that material. At 14th level, add adamantine to the list of materials you can choose from.
_desc_ko:
당신은 마법과 물질 사이의 힘을 모방하는 법을 터득했습니다. 소지한 탄환 한 발에 귀중한 물질의 마법적 정수를 부여하여 특정 생물의 약점을 공략할 수 있습니다.

냉철 또는 은 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 자신의 턴이 끝나기 전에 화살이나 볼트를 발사하면 해당 재료로 간주됩니다. 14레벨에 도달하면 선택 가능한 재료 목록에 아다만틴을 추가합니다.

name: Phantom Charm

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You attempt a check that would be subject to a misfortune effect.

You can harness the spiritual connection in your blood, allowing you to shift the negative threads of fate. You negate the misfortune effect and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the triggering check.

_desc_en:

_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 불운 효과의 대상이 되는 판정을 시도할 때.

혈액 속의 영적 연결을 활용하여 운명의 부정적 실타래를 바꿀 수 있습니다. 불운 효과를 무효화하고 유발 판정에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Weapon Improviser Dedication

description.value:
You don't take the normal –2 penalty to attack rolls with improvised weapons. Improvised weapons you use have a minimum weapon damage die of 1d6, or 1d4 if the improvised weapon is agile.

name: Sword of Sealing

description.value: Your spiritual power pierces both body and soul, pinning your foe in place. Make a melee Strike with a one-handed, agile, or finesse weapon, or your fist unarmed attack. On a successful hit, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or your spell DC, or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}. The target can end this immobilization with a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} attempt using the higher of your class DC or your spell DC as the Escape DC.

name: Iridian Choirmaster Dedication

description.value:
When you take this dedication, choose one willing, non-minion ally to be your student in the ways of the Iridian Choir. As part of your training in this archetype, you teach your student the necessary mindset and techniques; they gain the benefits of your abilities without having to take any feats of their own. You gain the benefits of your Iridian Choirmaster archetype feats only if both you and your student are alive and conscious.

You and your student can trade nonverbal messages as a single action, which have the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLzFcIaSXs7YTIqJ]{Message} spell but are non-magical. This requires a single action, has the concentrate, mental, and linguistic traits, and requires that you be able to see each other.

If your student dies, or if you and your student choose to part ways, you can choose and develop a new student by spending 1 week of downtime training another willing, non-minion ally.

Special Your student can't be the student of another character with the Iridian Choirmaster Dedication, and if your student takes the Iridian Choirmaster Dedication, they must choose you to be their student.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.717fNt85QebVFOS3]{Iridian Choirmaster}
