_desc_ko:
이 헌신을 선택하면, 원하며 하수인이 아닌 아군 한 명을 선택하여 이리디안 성가대의 길에서 제자로 삼을 수 있습니다. 이 아키타입 훈련의 일환으로, 당신은 제자에게 필요한 마음가짐과 기술을 가르칩니다. 제자는 별도의 피트를 선택하지 않아도 당신의 능력 효과를 얻습니다. 당신과 제자가 모두 생존하고 의식이 있을 때에만 이리디안 합창단장 아키타입 피트의 혜택을 얻습니다.

당신과 제자는 액션 하나로 비언어적 메시지를 교환할 수 있으며, 이는 @link[spells.message] 주문의 효과를 가지나 비마법적입니다. 이는 액션 하나를 필요로 하며, 집중, 정신, 언어 특성을 가지며, 서로를 볼 수 있어야 합니다.

제자가 사망하거나, 당신과 제자가 헤어지기로 선택한 경우, 1주의 다운타임 동안 훈련을 원하는 비하수인 동료를 선택하여 새로운 제자를 양성할 수 있습니다.

특수 당신의 제자는 다른 ' ' 캐릭터의 'Iridian Choirmaster 헌신'을 가진 제자가 될 수 없으며, 만약 당신의 제자가 'Iridian Choirmaster 헌신'을 선택한다면 반드시 당신을 자신의 스승으로 선택해야 합니다.

name: Folktales Lore

description.value:
You can pull bits of wisdom from any tale. You become trained in Folktales Lore, a special Lore skill that can be used only to Recall Knowledge, but on any topic. If you fail a check to Recall Knowledge with Folktales Lore, you get the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1Bt7uCW2WI4sM84P]{Dubious Knowledge} skill feat.

If you are legendary in the Performance skill, you gain expert proficiency in Folktales Lore, but you can't increase your proficiency rank in Folktales Lore by any other means.

publication.title: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind

_desc_en:
You can pull bits of wisdom from any tale. You become trained in Folktales Lore, a special Lore skill that can be used only to Recall Knowledge, but on any topic. If you fail a check to Recall Knowledge with Folktales Lore, you get the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1Bt7uCW2WI4sM84P]{Dubious Knowledge} skill feat.

If you are legendary in the Performance skill, you gain expert proficiency in Folktales Lore, but you can't increase your proficiency rank in Folktales Lore by any other means.
_desc_ko:
어떤 이야기에서도 지혜의 조각을 끌어낼 수 있습니다. 민담 지식에 숙련되어, 지식 회상에만 사용 가능한 특수 지식 기술로 모든 주제를 다룰 수 있습니다. 민담 지식로 지식 회상 판정에 실패하면 @link[feats.dubious-knowledge] 피트의 효과를 받습니다.

공연 기술에서 전설적인 수준이라면 민담 지식에 숙련자 숙련도를 얻지만, 다른 방법으로 민담 지식 숙련도 등급을 올릴 수는 없습니다.

name: Raise Haft

description.value: You know how to use the haft of larger weapons to block your enemies' attacks. Two-handed weapons you wield gain the parry trait. If the weapon already has the parry trait, you increase the circumstance bonus to AC it provides to +2.

_desc_en: You know how to use the haft of larger weapons to block your enemies' attacks. Two-handed weapons you wield gain the parry trait. If the weapon already has the parry trait, you increase the circumstance bonus to AC it provides to +2.
_desc_ko: 당신은 더 큰 무기의 손잡이 부분을 이용해 적의 공격을 막는 법을 알고 있습니다. 당신이 휘두르는 양손 무기는 패리 특성을 얻습니다. 해당 무기가 이미 패리 특성을 가지고 있다면, 그것이 제공하는 AC에 대한 상황 보너스를 +2로 증가시킵니다.

name: Pack Attack

description.value: You have mastered techniques for hunting alongside your pack. Your Strikes deal an additional 1d4 precision damage to creatures within reach of at least two of your allies.

_desc_en: You have mastered techniques for hunting alongside your pack. Your Strikes deal an additional 1d4 precision damage to creatures within reach of at least two of your allies.
_desc_ko: 당신은 무리와 함께 사냥하는 기술을 마스터했습니다. 당신의 공격은 최소 두 명의 아군이 도달 가능한 범위 내에 있는 생물에게 추가로 1d4 정밀 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Shisk Lore

description.value: You hoard knowledge like a dragon hoards gold. You gain the trained proficiency rank in three Lore skills of your choice. You also become trained in Shisk Lore.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: You hoard knowledge like a dragon hoards gold. You gain the trained proficiency rank in three Lore skills of your choice. You also become trained in Shisk Lore.
_desc_ko:
당신은 용이 금을 모으듯 지식을 쌓습니다. 선택한 세 가지 지식 기술에 숙련 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 또한 시스크 지식에 숙련됩니다.

참고: 이 피트가 제공하는 기술에 이미 숙련된 경우, 대체 기술을 수동으로 선택해야 합니다. 또한 부여된 지식 기술을 수동으로 입력해야 합니다.

name: Desiccating Inhalation

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You draw in the moisture from nearby creatures, draining them dry to heal your wounds. Creatures in a @Template[cone|distance:30] take @Damage[floor(@actor.level/2)d8[void]|options:area-damage] damage, with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. A creature that critically fails this saving throw is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}. As long as at least one creature was damaged by your Desiccating Inhalation, you regain @Damage[@actor.level[healing]]{HP equal to your level}.

At 14th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d8.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

You draw in the moisture from nearby creatures, draining them dry to heal your wounds. Creatures in a @Template[cone|distance:30] take @Damage[floor(@actor.level/2)d8[void]|options:area-damage] damage, with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. A creature that critically fails this saving throw is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}. As long as at least one creature was damaged by your Desiccating Inhalation, you regain @Damage[@actor.level[healing]]{HP equal to your level}.

At 14th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d8.
_desc_ko:
발생 빈도 시간당 1회

당신은 주변 생물들의 수분을 흡수하여 그들을 말려버리고 자신의 상처를 치유합니다. 30피트 내에 있는 생물들은 공허의 피해를 입으며, 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 기본 반사 내성에 성공해야 합니다. 이 내성 굴림에서 대실패를 한 생물은 @link[conditions.drained]{1} 상태가 됩니다. 당신의 '수분 흡수'로 피해를 입은 생물이 한 마리라도 존재하는 한, 당신은 레벨에 해당하는 HP를 회복합니다.

14레벨과 이후 2레벨마다 피해량이 1d8 증가합니다.

name: Warshard Rune

description.value: When you choose a warshard weapon during your daily preparations, you can empower it with an additional magical effect. Choose one common weapon property rune that's of a level equal to or lower than your level. That rune is applied to your warshard weapon as if it were etched onto it normally, but this weapon property does not count against the normal maximum number of property runes a weapon can have. If you empower a weapon with a property rune of the same type, only the highest-level one applies. This additional rune functions only when you wield your warshard weapon and have at least 1 unspent Mythic Point; otherwise, the rune becomes dormant until these conditions are met.

publication.title: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

_desc_en: When you choose a warshard weapon during your daily preparations, you can empower it with an additional magical effect. Choose one common weapon property rune that's of a level equal to or lower than your level. That rune is applied to your warshard weapon as if it were etched onto it normally, but this weapon property does not count against the normal maximum number of property runes a weapon can have. If you empower a weapon with a property rune of the same type, only the highest-level one applies. This additional rune functions only when you wield your warshard weapon and have at least 1 unspent Mythic Point; otherwise, the rune becomes dormant until these conditions are met.
_desc_ko: 일일 준비 때 전쟁파편 무기를 선택할 때, 당신은 그것에 추가 마법 효과를 부여할 수 있습니다. 당신의 레벨과 같거나 낮은 레벨의 일상 무기 속성 룬 하나를 선택합니다. 그 룬은 마치 정상적으로 새겨진 것처럼 당신의 전쟁파편 무기에 적용되지만, 이 무기 속성은 무기가 지닐 수 있는 통상적인 최대 속성 룬 수에 포함되지 않습니다. 같은 유형의 속성 룬으로 무기를 부여하면, 가장 높은 레벨의 것만 적용됩니다. 이 추가 룬은 당신이 전쟁파편 무기를 다루고 있고 최소 1점의 소모하지 않은 신화 점수를 지녔을 때만 작동합니다. 그렇지 않으면 이 조건이 충족될 때까지 룬은 휴면 상태가 됩니다.

name: Coffin Bound

description.value:
You bind your spirit to a coffin filled with soil of your homeland, making it a place of recovery. If you rest inside your coffin for 10 minutes, you regain Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier x half your level. You can still be healed in other ways during that time, though you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and therefore unable to heal yourself. The GM might allow you to Refocus while resting, depending on whether it's a type of Refocusing you can achieve while you slumber.

If you would be destroyed, you instead remain near death. This doesn't change your dying or wounded value, and you remain unconscious. After 1 hour, you're destroyed. If returned to your coffin before that hour is up, you avoid destruction; if you spend 1 hour resting in your coffin, you regain 1 HP and lose the dying and wounded conditions. You can't be healed in any other way when near death.

Your coffin can't heal you if you're staked through the chest. You can be staked only if unconscious, and it takes three actions. You lose all benefits of this feat if your coffin is destroyed or the soil is lost. You must procure a new coffin and fill it with soil of your homeland to restore the feat's function.

_desc_en:
You bind your spirit to a coffin filled with soil of your homeland, making it a place of recovery. If you rest inside your coffin for 10 minutes, you regain Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier x half your level. You can still be healed in other ways during that time, though you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and therefore unable to heal yourself. The GM might allow you to Refocus while resting, depending on whether it's a type of Refocusing you can achieve while you slumber.

If you would be destroyed, you instead remain near death. This doesn't change your dying or wounded value, and you remain unconscious. After 1 hour, you're destroyed. If returned to your coffin before that hour is up, you avoid destruction; if you spend 1 hour resting in your coffin, you regain 1 HP and lose the dying and wounded conditions. You can't be healed in any other way when near death.

Your coffin can't heal you if you're staked through the chest. You can be staked only if unconscious, and it takes three actions. You lose all benefits of this feat if your coffin is destroyed or the soil is lost. You must procure a new coffin and fill it with soil of your homeland to restore the feat's function.
_desc_ko:
고향의 흙으로 채워진 관에 영혼을 묶어 회복의 장소로 삼습니다. 관 안에서 10분간 휴식하면 건강 수정자 × 레벨 절반에 해당하는 HP를 회복합니다. 이 시간 동안 다른 방법으로 치유받을 수는 있으나, @link[conditions.unconscious] 상태이므로 스스로 치유할 수 없습니다. GM은 휴식 중에도 재집중을 허용할 수 있으며, 이는 잠든 상태에서도 달성 가능한 재집중 유형인지에 따라 결정됩니다.

파괴될 상황이라면 대신 죽음 직전 상태로 남습니다. 이는 죽음 직전 상태나 중상 상태 수치에 영향을 주지 않으며, 의식불명 상태는 유지됩니다. 1시간 후에는 파괴됩니다. 그 시간 전에 관으로 돌아가면 파괴를 피할 수 있으며, 관 안에서 1시간 동안 휴식을 취하면 HP 1을 회복하고 죽음 직전 상태와 중상 상태를 해제합니다. 죽음 직전 상태에서는 다른 어떤 방법으로도 치유받을 수 없다.

가슴에 말뚝이 박힌 상태에서는 관이 치유 효과를 발휘하지 못한다. 말뚝 박기는 의식이 없는 상태에서만 가능하며, 세 번의 행동이 소요된다. 관이 파괴되거나 고향의 흙을 잃으면 이 피트의 모든 혜택을 상실한다. 피트의 기능을 회복하려면 새로운 관을 마련하고 고향의 흙으로 채워야 한다.

name: Deceptive Tactics

description.value:
Requirements You can prepare at least three tactics.

Your training has taught you that the art of war is the art of deception. You can use your Warfare Lore modifier in place of your Deception modifier for Deception checks to [[/act create-a-diversion skill=warfare-lore]] or [[/act feint skill=warfare-lore]], and can use your proficiency rank in Warfare Lore instead of your proficiency rank in Deception to meet the prerequisites of feats that modify the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} actions (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.HEBXaS656MZTiWFu]{Lengthy Diversion}). You gain the Lengthy Diversion feat.

_desc_en:
Requirements You can prepare at least three tactics.

Your training has taught you that the art of war is the art of deception. You can use your Warfare Lore modifier in place of your Deception modifier for Deception checks to [[/act create-a-diversion skill=warfare-lore]] or [[/act feint skill=warfare-lore]], and can use your proficiency rank in Warfare Lore instead of your proficiency rank in Deception to meet the prerequisites of feats that modify the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} actions (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.HEBXaS656MZTiWFu]{Lengthy Diversion}). You gain the Lengthy Diversion feat.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 최소한 세 가지 전술을 준비할 수 있습니다.

당신의 훈련은 전쟁의 기술이 속임수의 기술임을 가르쳤습니다. 당신은 Warfare Lore 수정자를 Deception 판정에 대신 사용하여 @link[actions.create-a-diversion] 또는 @link[actions.feint]에 대한 속임수 검사 시 속임수 숙련도 대신 전쟁 지식 숙련도를 사용할 수 있으며, '주의 분산 만들기'나 '위장 공격' 행동을 수정하는 재주(예: '장시간 주의 분산')의 전제 조건을 충족할 때 속임수 숙련도 대신 전쟁 지식 숙련도를 사용할 수 있습니다. '장시간 주의 분산' 피트를 획득합니다.

name: Perpetual Breadth

description.value:
You have expanded your supply of near-infinite items. Choose a research field. Add one item from the list of options available to that field from perpetual infusions, or two items if you choose your own field.

If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.JOdbVu14phvdjhaY]{Perpetual Potency} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.3R19zS7gERhEX87F]{Perpetual Perfection}, you gain an additional item (or items if you chose your own field) appropriate to the field you chose, for instance a higher-level version of the bomb you chose or a new poison.

_desc_en:
You have expanded your supply of near-infinite items. Choose a research field. Add one item from the list of options available to that field from perpetual infusions, or two items if you choose your own field.

If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.JOdbVu14phvdjhaY]{Perpetual Potency} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.3R19zS7gERhEX87F]{Perpetual Perfection}, you gain an additional item (or items if you chose your own field) appropriate to the field you chose, for instance a higher-level version of the bomb you chose or a new poison.
_desc_ko:
당신은 거의 무한한 아이템 공급을 확장했습니다. 연구 분야를 선택하세요. 해당 분야에 영구 주입으로 제공되는 옵션 목록에서 아이템 하나를 추가하거나, 직접 분야를 선택할 경우 아이템 두 개를 추가합니다.

@link[feats.perpetual-potency-toxicologist] 또는 @link[feats.perpetual-perfection-toxicologist]을 보유 중이라면, 선택한 분야에 적합한 추가 아이템(또는 자체 분야 선택 시 아이템들)을 획득합니다. 예를 들어 선택한 폭탄의 상위 버전이나 새로운 독 등이 해당됩니다.

name: Merciful Elixir

description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger You craft an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.hDLbR56Id2OtU318]{Elixir of Life} using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.sPtl05wwTpqFI0lL]{Quick Alchemy}, and that elixir is at least 2 levels lower than your advanced alchemy level

You mix a special additive into your elixir that calms the drinker's body and mind.

The elixir of life attempts to counteract one fear effect or one effect imposing the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} condition on the drinker using the item's level and a counteract modifier equal to your class DC - 10.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per round

Trigger You craft an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.hDLbR56Id2OtU318]{Elixir of Life} using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.sPtl05wwTpqFI0lL]{Quick Alchemy}, and that elixir is at least 2 levels lower than your advanced alchemy level

You mix a special additive into your elixir that calms the drinker's body and mind.

The elixir of life attempts to counteract one fear effect or one effect imposing the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} condition on the drinker using the item's level and a counteract modifier equal to your class DC - 10.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 라운드당 1회

발동 조건 @link[equipment.elixir-of-life-minor]을 @link[feats.quick-alchemy]으로 제작하며, 해당 엘릭서의 레벨이 당신의 고급 연금술 레벨보다 최소 2레벨 낮을 때

당신은 엘릭서에 특별한 첨가제를 섞어 마시는 이의 몸과 마음을 진정시킵니다.

생명의 비약은 아이템 레벨과 당신의 직업 DC - 10에 해당하는 반격 수정자를 사용하여 마신 이에게 적용된 하나의 공포 효과 또는 하나의 @link[conditions.paralyzed] 상태 효과를 반격하려 시도합니다.

name: Godspeed

description.value: Mythic power grants you speed to rival beasts and demigods. Spend a Mythic Point; for the next minute, you gain a +10-foot status bonus to all your Speeds and are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}. You can use the extra action each round to Stride, Step, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}.

_desc_en: Mythic power grants you speed to rival beasts and demigods. Spend a Mythic Point; for the next minute, you gain a +10-foot status bonus to all your Speeds and are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}. You can use the extra action each round to Stride, Step, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}.
_desc_ko: 신화적 힘은 짐승과 반신에 필적하는 속도를 부여합니다. 신화 포인트 1점을 소모하면, 다음 1분 동안 모든 이동 속도에 +10피트 상태 보너스를 얻으며 @link[conditions.quickened] 상태가 됩니다. 매 라운드 추가 행동을 사용하여 이동, 신중한 발걸음, 또는 @link[actions.leap]을 할 수 있습니다.

name: Intuitive Illusions

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger Your turn begins.

Illusion magic comes to you so naturally that you can effortlessly sustain your magical ruses. You immediately gain the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3f5DMFu8fPiqHpRg]{Sustain a Spell} action to extend the duration of one of your active illusion spells.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger Your turn begins.

Illusion magic comes to you so naturally that you can effortlessly sustain your magical ruses. You immediately gain the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3f5DMFu8fPiqHpRg]{Sustain a Spell} action to extend the duration of one of your active illusion spells.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 당신의 턴이 시작됩니다.

환상 마법이 당신에게 너무나 자연스럽게 다가와 마법적 속임수를 쉽게 유지할 수 있습니다. 즉시 @link[actions.sustain] 행동의 효과를 얻어 활성 상태인 환상 주문 중 하나의 지속 시간을 연장합니다.

name: Stealthy Companion

description.value: You've trained your animal companion to blend in to its surroundings. Your animal companion gains the benefit of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.qqe5VmcO1s8iTOfd]{Camouflage} feat. If your companion is a specialized ambusher, its proficiency rank for Stealth increases to master (or legendary if it was already master).

_desc_en: You've trained your animal companion to blend in to its surroundings. Your animal companion gains the benefit of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.qqe5VmcO1s8iTOfd]{Camouflage} feat. If your companion is a specialized ambusher, its proficiency rank for Stealth increases to master (or legendary if it was already master).
_desc_ko: 당신은 동물 동료가 주변 환경에 녹아들도록 훈련시켰습니다. 당신의 동물 동료는 @link[feats.camouflage] 피트의 혜택을 얻습니다. 동반자가 전문적인 매복자라면, 은신 숙련도 등급이 달인(이미 달인 상태라면 전설)으로 상승합니다.

name: Golem Grafter Dedication

description.value:
Your flesh has been specially treated with the same arcane and alchemical processes used to toughen the skin of flesh golems. Increase your maximum Hit Points by an amount equal to your level. You gain resistance to physical damage (except adamantine) equal to your number of class feats from the golem grafter archetype.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.qlQSYjCwnoCzfto2]{Golem Grafter}

value.value: expert in Arcana and Crafting, or an ally with expert proficiency in those skills willing to augment you

_desc_en:
Your flesh has been specially treated with the same arcane and alchemical processes used to toughen the skin of flesh golems. Increase your maximum Hit Points by an amount equal to your level. You gain resistance to physical damage (except adamantine) equal to your number of class feats from the golem grafter archetype.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.qlQSYjCwnoCzfto2]{Golem Grafter}
_desc_ko: 당신의 육체는 골렘의 피부를 강화하는 데 사용되는 것과 동일한 아케인 연금술적 공정을 통해 특별히 처리되었습니다. 최대 HP를 레벨 수만큼 증가시킵니다. 골렘 접목사 아키타입의 클래스 피트 수만큼 물리 피해(아다만틴 제외)에 대한 저항력을 얻습니다.

name: Ranged Disarm

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a simple firearm or simple combination weapon.

When using a simple firearm, you can shoot objects right out of your enemy's hands. Attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} the target using a ranged attack roll with the required firearm or combination weapon, instead of attempting an Athletics check against the target's Reflex DC.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a simple firearm or simple combination weapon.

When using a simple firearm, you can shoot objects right out of your enemy's hands. Attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} the target using a ranged attack roll with the required firearm or combination weapon, instead of attempting an Athletics check against the target's Reflex DC.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 단순한 화기 또는 단순한 복합 무기를 사용 중이어야 합니다.

단순 화기를 사용할 때, 적의 손에서 물건을 쏘아 떨어뜨릴 수 있습니다. 대상의 반사 DC에 대한 운동 능력 검사 대신, 필요한 화기나 복합 무기로 원거리 명중 굴림으로 대상에게 @link[actions.disarm]를 시도하십시오.

name: Fountain of Secrets

description.value:
Frequency once per round

You constantly remember details about the world. You attempt a check to Recall Knowledge. If you succeed, you gain additional information or context. If you critically succeed, at the GM's discretion you might gain even more additional information or context than normal.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en:
Frequency once per round

You constantly remember details about the world. You attempt a check to Recall Knowledge. If you succeed, you gain additional information or context. If you critically succeed, at the GM's discretion you might gain even more additional information or context than normal.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 라운드당 1회

당신은 끊임없이 세상에 대한 세부 사항을 기억합니다. 지식 회상 판정을 시도합니다. 성공하면 추가 정보나 맥락을 얻습니다. 대성공하면, GM의 재량에 따라 평소보다 더 많은 추가 정보나 맥락을 얻을 수도 있습니다.

name: Basic Glory

description.value: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level exemplar feat.

_desc_en: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level exemplar feat.
_desc_ko: 1레벨 또는 2레벨의 이그젬플러 피트를 얻습니다.

name: Resilient Shell

description.value: Your eidolon is resilient against attacks. It gains resistance to physical damage equal to its Constitution modifier.

_desc_en: Your eidolon is resilient against attacks. It gains resistance to physical damage equal to its Constitution modifier.
_desc_ko: 당신의 에이돌론은 공격에 대해 탄력적입니다. 건강 능력치 수정자만큼의 물리 피해에 대한 저항력을 얻습니다.

name: Posse

description.value:
Requirements You have designated prey with Hunt Prey.

By spending 1 minute giving guidance to help hunt down your prey, you instruct up to five willing creatures to assist you. They gain a +1 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} your prey, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} your prey, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information} about your prey. You and the creatures assisting you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls when entering combat with your prey.

These benefits lasts until you designate a new prey or your prey dies, whichever comes first. An individual creature assisting you loses this benefit if they're out of your presence for too long to benefit from your instructions. This is usually 1 hour, but is determined by the GM.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have designated prey with Hunt Prey.

By spending 1 minute giving guidance to help hunt down your prey, you instruct up to five willing creatures to assist you. They gain a +1 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} your prey, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} your prey, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information} about your prey. You and the creatures assisting you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls when entering combat with your prey.

These benefits lasts until you designate a new prey or your prey dies, whichever comes first. An individual creature assisting you loses this benefit if they're out of your presence for too long to benefit from your instructions. This is usually 1 hour, but is determined by the GM.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 사냥감 추적 기술로 사냥감을 지정했습니다.

1분 동안 사냥감을 추적하는 데 필요한 지침을 제공함으로써, 최대 다섯 마리의 동의한 대상에게 당신을 돕도록 지시합니다. 이들은 사냥감을 @link[actions.seek], @link[actions.track], 그리고 사냥감에 대한 @link[actions.gather-information]에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 당신과 당신을 돕는 생물들은 먹잇감과 전투에 돌입할 때 이니셔티브 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

이 혜택은 새로운 먹이를 지정하거나 먹이가 죽을 때까지 지속됩니다. 당신을 돕는 개별 생물은 당신의 지시를 받을 수 없을 만큼 오랫동안 당신 곁을 떠나면 이 혜택을 잃습니다. 일반적으로 1시간이지만, GM이 결정합니다.

name: Command Attention

description.value:
You command the attention of all around you with style, ensuring their gaze falls only upon you until the end of your next turn. Whenever a creature in a @Template[emanation|distance:30] around you attempts a saving throw against a different visual effect, it gets a result one degree of success better than it rolled. This is a fortune effect.

When an enemy within the aura attempts to use a visual effect that involves focusing its attention on a particular creature (such as a medusa's Focus Gaze), it must succeed at a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, in order to target any creature except you.

Allies in the aura can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} even if they don't have cover, as you are continually providing a distraction.

_desc_en:
You command the attention of all around you with style, ensuring their gaze falls only upon you until the end of your next turn. Whenever a creature in a @Template[emanation|distance:30] around you attempts a saving throw against a different visual effect, it gets a result one degree of success better than it rolled. This is a fortune effect.

When an enemy within the aura attempts to use a visual effect that involves focusing its attention on a particular creature (such as a medusa's Focus Gaze), it must succeed at a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, in order to target any creature except you.

Allies in the aura can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} even if they don't have cover, as you are continually providing a distraction.
_desc_ko:
당신은 주변 모든 이의 시선을 우아하게 사로잡아, 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 그들의 시선이 오직 당신에게만 머물게 합니다. 당신 주변 30피트 범위 내의 생물이 다른 시각 효과에 대한 내성 굴림을 시도할 때마다, 그 결과는 실제 굴린 수치보다 성공 등급이 한 단계 높아집니다. 이는 행운 효과입니다.

오라 내의 적이 특정 생물에게 주의를 집중하는 시각적 효과(예: 메두사의 시선 집중)를 사용하려고 시도할 때, 당신을 제외한 다른 생물을 대상으로 삼으려면 당신의 직업 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 더 높은 쪽에 대한 의지 내성에 성공해야 합니다.

오라 내의 아군은 당신이 지속적으로 주의를 분산시키므로, 엄폐물이 없더라도 @link[actions.hide]를 시도할 수 있습니다.

name: Shadow Sneak Attack

description.value:
You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.j1JE61quDxdge4mg]{Sneak Attack} class feature, except you deal 1d6 precision damage regardless of your level.

Sneak attack from multiple sources isn't cumulative. If you have sneak attack from more than one source, use only the highest number of dice when you sneak attack rather than adding the amounts together.

_desc_en:
You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.j1JE61quDxdge4mg]{Sneak Attack} class feature, except you deal 1d6 precision damage regardless of your level.

Sneak attack from multiple sources isn't cumulative. If you have sneak attack from more than one source, use only the highest number of dice when you sneak attack rather than adding the amounts together.
_desc_ko:
@link[feats.sneak-attack] 클래스 특성을 얻습니다. 단, 레벨에 관계없이 1d6 정밀 피해를 입힙니다.

여러 출처의 암습은 누적되지 않습니다. 두 개 이상의 출처에서 암습을 얻을 경우, 주사위 수를 합산하지 않고 가장 높은 주사위 수만 사용합니다.

name: Bloodline Mutation

description.value:
You permanently mutate to become more like the creatures of your bloodline. You gain the appropriate trait or traits for those types of creatures (aberration for aberrant, angel and celestial for angelic, demon and fiend for demonic, and so on). You gain low-light vision or darkvision, if one is appropriate for creatures with those traits. Choose one of the following.

  • If the creatures associated with your bloodline have the ability to fly, you gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed.
  • If the creatures associated with your bloodline are aquatic or amphibious, you become amphibious, able to breathe water and air equally well, and you gain a swim Speed equal to your land Speed.

  • If creatures associated with your bloodline have a resistance or immunity to acid, cold, electricity, fire, void, or sonic, choose an energy type your bloodline is immune or resistant to and gain resistance 20 against that energy type.

value.value: a bloodline based on a specific type of creature

_desc_en:
You permanently mutate to become more like the creatures of your bloodline. You gain the appropriate trait or traits for those types of creatures (aberration for aberrant, angel and celestial for angelic, demon and fiend for demonic, and so on). You gain low-light vision or darkvision, if one is appropriate for creatures with those traits. Choose one of the following.

  • If the creatures associated with your bloodline have the ability to fly, you gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed.
  • If the creatures associated with your bloodline are aquatic or amphibious, you become amphibious, able to breathe water and air equally well, and you gain a swim Speed equal to your land Speed.

  • If creatures associated with your bloodline have a resistance or immunity to acid, cold, electricity, fire, void, or sonic, choose an energy type your bloodline is immune or resistant to and gain resistance 20 against that energy type.
_desc_ko:
당신은 혈통의 생물과 더 닮도록 영구적으로 변이합니다. 해당 유형의 생물(이형체는 이형체, 천사와 천상체는 천사계, 데몬과 핀드는 데몬계 등)에 적합한 특성을 하나 이상 얻습니다. 해당 특성을 가진 생물에게 적합한 경우, 저조도 시야 또는 암흑 시야를 얻습니다. 다음 중 하나를 선택하십시오.

  • 혈통과 연관된 생물이 비행 능력을 가진 경우, 지상 속도와의 동일한 비행 속도를 얻습니다.
  • 혈통 관련 생물이 수생 또는 양서류인 경우, 물과 공기를 동등하게 호흡할 수 있는 양서류 특성을 획득하며, 지상 속도와 동일한 수영 속도를 얻습니다.

  • 혈통과 연관된 생물이 산성, 냉기, 전기, 화염, 공허, [sonic]에 대한 저항력 또는 면역력을 가질 경우, 혈통이 면역되거나 저항하는 에너지 유형을 선택하고 해당 에너지 유형에 대해 저항력 20을 얻습니다.

name: Inner Fire (Naari)

description.value: You can call the fire inside you into the palm of your hand. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6DfLZBl8wKIV03Iq]{Ignition} cantrip as an innate primal or arcane spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

_desc_en: You can call the fire inside you into the palm of your hand. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6DfLZBl8wKIV03Iq]{Ignition} cantrip as an innate primal or arcane spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 당신은 내면의 불을 손바닥으로 불러낼 수 있습니다. 당신은 @link[spells.ignition] 캔트립을 선천적 프라이멀 마법 또는 아케인 마법으로 마음대로 시전할 수 있습니다. 캔트립은 당신의 레벨 절반(올림)에 해당하는 마법 랭크으로 강화됩니다.

name: Tales of the Road

description.value: The blessings of Isthralei connect you to the thrum of the stories that underlie all settlements. When attempting a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about a city you have visited, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus and can use an associated Lore skill (such as Nerosyan Lore) with your level as your proficiency bonus even if you're untrained.

_desc_en: The blessings of Isthralei connect you to the thrum of the stories that underlie all settlements. When attempting a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about a city you have visited, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus and can use an associated Lore skill (such as Nerosyan Lore) with your level as your proficiency bonus even if you're untrained.
_desc_ko: 이스스라레이의 축복은 모든 정착지의 근간이 되는 이야기의 맥박과 당신을 연결합니다. 방문한 도시 관련 @link[actions.recall-knowledge] 판정을 시도할 때 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 비숙련 상태라도 관련 지식 기술(예: 네로시안 지식)을 레벨만큼 숙련 보너스로 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: We Are One

description.value: You and your companion move as one, never tripping each other up. This fluid movement throws your enemies off balance. You and your united companion can share each other's spaces. When you do so, both you and your united companion provide @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.other-effects.Item.I9lfZUiCwMiGogVi]{Lesser Cover} to one another. You and your united companion also count as being adjacent to one another when sharing each other's spaces. A target is automatically @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the first Strike each round each of you and your united companion make while sharing one another's spaces; this benefit also applies if you are mounted on your united companion.

_desc_en: You and your companion move as one, never tripping each other up. This fluid movement throws your enemies off balance. You and your united companion can share each other's spaces. When you do so, both you and your united companion provide @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.other-effects.Item.I9lfZUiCwMiGogVi]{Lesser Cover} to one another. You and your united companion also count as being adjacent to one another when sharing each other's spaces. A target is automatically @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the first Strike each round each of you and your united companion make while sharing one another's spaces; this benefit also applies if you are mounted on your united companion.
_desc_ko: 당신과 동료는 하나처럼 움직여 서로 걸려 넘어지지 않습니다. 이 유연한 움직임은 적의 균형을 무너뜨립니다. 당신과 결합된 동료는 서로의 공간을 공유할 수 있습니다. 이 경우, 당신과 동료는 서로에게 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.other-effects.Item.I9lfZUiCwMiGogVi]{반엄폐}를 제공합니다. 또한 공간을 공유할 때 서로 인접한 상태로 간주된다. 공간을 공유하는 동안 각자가 첫 번째 공격할 때 대상은 자동으로 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 된다. 이 효과는 동료 위에 올라탄 상태에서도 적용된다.

name: Shared Stratagem

description.value: The plans you make include your allies as well as yourself. When you hit a creature with an attack on which you substituted your attack roll due to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.m0f2B7G9eaaTmhFL]{Devising a Stratagem}, designate one ally. The creature you hit is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to that ally on the next attack that ally makes against that creature before the start of your next turn.

_desc_en: The plans you make include your allies as well as yourself. When you hit a creature with an attack on which you substituted your attack roll due to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.m0f2B7G9eaaTmhFL]{Devising a Stratagem}, designate one ally. The creature you hit is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to that ally on the next attack that ally makes against that creature before the start of your next turn.
_desc_ko: 당신이 세우는 계획에는 자신뿐만 아니라 아군도 포함됩니다. @link[actions.devise-a-stratagem]으로 명중 굴림을 대체한 명중 굴림으로 생물을 명중시킬 때, 아군 한 명을 지정한다. 명중당한 생물은 다음 차례 시작 전까지 해당 아군이 그 생물을 상대로 하는 다음 공격에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 된다.

name: Unassuming Heroes

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Access peachchild leshy heritage

You have a talent for making friends through simple kindness, often among stray animals or other creatures that people tend to overlook, and your inherent magic can make these acts take on additional power. As an Interact action, you can feed a small treat, such as a millet dumpling, to an animal that has an indifferent or better attitude toward you. For the next 1 minute, one of the animal's unarmed attacks becomes a +1 striking unarmed attack. If it was already a +1 striking attack, it instead gains the effects of the ghost touch rune.

_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

사용 조건 복숭아 아이 레시 혈통

당신은 단순한 친절을 통해 친구를 사귀는 재능을 지녔으며, 특히 사람들이 소홀히 하는 길 잃은 동물이나 다른 생명체들 사이에서 두드러집니다. 타고난 마법은 이러한 행동에 추가적인 힘을 부여하기도 합니다. 상호작용 행동으로, 당신에게 무관심하거나 그 이상의 태도를 보이는 동물에게 기장 경단 같은 작은 간식을 줄 수 있습니다. 다음 1분 동안, 해당 동물의 비무장 공격 중 하나가 +1 강타 비무장 공격으로 바뀝니다. 이미 +1 강타 공격이었다면, 대신 고스트 터치 룬의 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Benefactor's Wings

description.value:
Requirements You are holding or wearing your draconic gift.

Calling on your draconic gift, spectral wings carry you to your destination. You Fly. If you don't normally have a fly Speed, you gain a fly Speed of 20 feet for this movement. If your spectral dragon shares your space, this fly Speed is instead 30 feet, and your spectral dragon moves with you. If you aren't on solid ground at the end of this movement, you fall.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are holding or wearing your draconic gift.

Calling on your draconic gift, spectral wings carry you to your destination. You Fly. If you don't normally have a fly Speed, you gain a fly Speed of 20 feet for this movement. If your spectral dragon shares your space, this fly Speed is instead 30 feet, and your spectral dragon moves with you. If you aren't on solid ground at the end of this movement, you fall.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 당신은 드래곤의 선물을 들거나 착용하고 있습니다.

드래곤의 선물을 불러내어, 유령 같은 날개가 당신을 목적지로 실어 나릅니다. 당신은 비행합니다. 당신이 평소 비행 속도가 없다면, 이 이동을 위해 20피트의 비행 속도를 얻습니다. 당신의 유령 드래곤이 당신의 공간을 공유하고 있다면, 이 비행 속도는 대신 30피트가 되며 당신의 유령 드래곤이 당신과 함께 이동합니다. 이 이동이 끝날 때 당신이 단단한 지면 위에 있지 않으면, 당신은 떨어집니다.

name: Plot the Future

description.value:
You spend 10 minutes in contemplation to uncannily predict how events will play out. Choose a particular goal or activity you plan to engage in within 1 week, or an event you expect might happen within 1 week. You analyze whether it's likely to come to pass, learning whether it's highly likely, somewhat likely, somewhat unlikely, or highly unlikely. You also gain a piece of advice suggesting a course of action you or your allies could take that might make the chosen event more or less likely, whichever you prefer.

The GM determines the likeliness of the event and the piece of advice you learn.

_desc_en:
You spend 10 minutes in contemplation to uncannily predict how events will play out. Choose a particular goal or activity you plan to engage in within 1 week, or an event you expect might happen within 1 week. You analyze whether it's likely to come to pass, learning whether it's highly likely, somewhat likely, somewhat unlikely, or highly unlikely. You also gain a piece of advice suggesting a course of action you or your allies could take that might make the chosen event more or less likely, whichever you prefer.

The GM determines the likeliness of the event and the piece of advice you learn.
_desc_ko:
10분간 깊이 생각하여 사건의 전개 방식을 놀랍도록 정확히 예측합니다. 1주일 이내에 계획 중인 특정 목표나 활동, 혹은 1주일 이내에 발생할 것으로 예상되는 사건을 선택하세요. 그 일이 일어날 가능성을 분석하여 매우 높음, 다소 높음, 다소 낮음, 매우 낮음 중 어느 정도인지 파악한다. 또한 선택한 사건의 발생 가능성을 높일 수도 낮출 수도 있는, 본인이 원하는 방향으로의 행동 방침을 제안하는 조언 한 가지를 얻는다.

GM이 사건의 발생 가능성과 얻게 될 조언을 결정합니다.

name: Shadow Mark

description.value:
You have learned special tricks that help you follow individuals without them noticing you.

When you attempt a Stealth check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice} while following a specific target, the target takes a -2 circumstance penalty to their Perception DC. If you have master proficiency in Stealth, the penalty is -3 or -4 if you're legendary.

If you start an encounter with the target while shadowing them, the target takes this penalty to their initiative roll and to their Perception DC to determine if they notice you, as normal for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}.

_desc_en:
You have learned special tricks that help you follow individuals without them noticing you.

When you attempt a Stealth check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice} while following a specific target, the target takes a -2 circumstance penalty to their Perception DC. If you have master proficiency in Stealth, the penalty is -3 or -4 if you're legendary.

If you start an encounter with the target while shadowing them, the target takes this penalty to their initiative roll and to their Perception DC to determine if they notice you, as normal for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}.
_desc_ko:
당신은 상대방이 눈치채지 못하게 따라다니는 특별한 기술을 익혔습니다.

특정 대상을 추적하며 @link[actions.avoid-notice] 은신 판정을 시도할 때, 대상은 지각 DC에 -2 상황 페널티를 받습니다. 은신 숙련도가 달인라면 페널티는 -3, 전설적이라면 -4입니다.

표적을 은밀히 추적 중일 때 교전을 시작하면, 표적은 이 페널티를 이니셔티브 롤과 당신을 발견하는지 여부를 결정하는 지각 DC에 적용받습니다. 이는 @link[actions.sneak]의 일반 규칙과 동일합니다.

name: Enhanced Familiar

description.value:
Animist You are able to materialize more of your attuned apparition's essence, creating a more powerful vessel for it to inhabit and aid you with.

Druid You infuse your familiar with additional primal energy, increasing its abilities.

Magus You infuse your familiar with more magical energy.

Sorcerer, Wizard, Witch You infuse your familiar with additional magical energy.

Thaumaturge By applying the best of multiple traditions of magic, you've found a more efficient way for your familiar to store its energy.

You can select four familiar or master abilities each day, instead of two.

Special Add the bonus familiar abilities you gain for being a witch to this amount. If your arcane thesis is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.SNZ46g3u7U6x0XJj]{Improved Familiar Attunement}, your familiar's base number of familiar abilities, before adding any extra abilities from the arcane thesis, is four.

_desc_en:
Animist You are able to materialize more of your attuned apparition's essence, creating a more powerful vessel for it to inhabit and aid you with.

Druid You infuse your familiar with additional primal energy, increasing its abilities.

Magus You infuse your familiar with more magical energy.

Sorcerer, Wizard, Witch You infuse your familiar with additional magical energy.

Thaumaturge By applying the best of multiple traditions of magic, you've found a more efficient way for your familiar to store its energy.

You can select four familiar or master abilities each day, instead of two.

Special Add the bonus familiar abilities you gain for being a witch to this amount. If your arcane thesis is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.SNZ46g3u7U6x0XJj]{Improved Familiar Attunement}, your familiar's base number of familiar abilities, before adding any extra abilities from the arcane thesis, is four.
_desc_ko:
애니미스트 당신은 조율된 환영의 정수를 더 많이 구체화하여, 그 환영이 깃들어 당신을 돕는 더 강력한 그릇을 창조할 수 있습니다.

드루이드 당신은 패밀리어에게 추가적인 프라이멀 에너지를 주입하여 그 능력을 향상시킵니다.

메이거스 당신은 패밀리어에게 더 많은 마법 에너지를 주입합니다.

소서러, 위자드, 위치 당신은 자신의 패밀리어에게 추가적인 마법 에너지를 주입합니다.

타우마터지 여러 마법 전통의 장점을 적용하여, 당신은 패밀리어가 에너지를 저장하는 더 효율적인 방법을 찾아냈습니다.

하루에 두 가지가 아닌 네 가지의 패밀리어 또는 마스터 능력을 선택할 수 있습니다.

특수 마녀로서 얻는 추가 패밀리어 능력 보너스를 이 수치에 더하십시오. 당신의 아케인 논문이 @link[feats.improved-familiar-attunement]인 경우, 아케인 논문에서 추가 능력을 더하기 전 패밀리어 능력의 기본 개수는 네 개입니다.

name: A Miracle of Science!

description.value: Once, you dreamed of creating life. Now you know that merely creating life lacks ambition. No, you have taken life and improved upon it. Your construct companion becomes a paragon construct companion.

_desc_en: Once, you dreamed of creating life. Now you know that merely creating life lacks ambition. No, you have taken life and improved upon it. Your construct companion becomes a paragon construct companion.
_desc_ko: 한때 당신은 생명을 창조하는 꿈을 꾸었습니다. 이제 당신은 단순히 생명을 창조하는 것만으로는 야망이 부족하다는 것을 깨달았습니다. 아니, 당신은 생명을 가져와 그것을 개선했습니다. 당신의 구조체 동료는 파라곤 구조체 동료가 됩니다.

name: Arcane Camouflage

description.value:
You have developed magical techniques to aid you with stalking your prey. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.3JG1t3T4mWn6vTke]{Blur} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} each once per day as 2nd-rank arcane innate spells.

Enhancement Your camouflage is more potent. Your blur spell now lasts 10 minutes and when you cast invisibility, you can choose to gain the effects of the 4th-rank version of the spell. In addition, you can now cast blur and invisibility each twice per day.

_desc_en:
You have developed magical techniques to aid you with stalking your prey. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.3JG1t3T4mWn6vTke]{Blur} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} each once per day as 2nd-rank arcane innate spells.

Enhancement Your camouflage is more potent. Your blur spell now lasts 10 minutes and when you cast invisibility, you can choose to gain the effects of the 4th-rank version of the spell. In addition, you can now cast blur and invisibility each twice per day.
_desc_ko:
당신은 사냥감을 추적하는 데 도움이 되는 마법 기술을 개발했습니다. 하루에 한 번씩 @link[spells.blur]과 @link[spells.invisibility]를 (2nd)랭크 아케인 선천적 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

강화 위장 능력이 더욱 강력해졌습니다. 흐릿함 주문 지속 시간이 10분으로 증가하며, 투명화 주문을 시전할 때 (4th)랭크 버전의 효과를 선택할 수 있습니다. 또한 흐릿함과 투명화 주문을 각각 하루에 두 번씩 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Fox Arson

description.value: When you critically hit with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.qCV04rZMty2TJBrX]{Foxfire} Strike, the target takes an additional 1d4 persistent damage of the same type as the foxfire. You gain an item bonus to this persistent damage equal to the foxfire's item bonus to attack rolls. When the target taking persistent damage comes into physical contact with another creature (for instance, if one of its allies touches it while @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administering First Aid}), you can use a reaction to command the flame to leap to the second target, ending the persistent damage on the first creature and moving it to the second.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: When you critically hit with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.qCV04rZMty2TJBrX]{Foxfire} Strike, the target takes an additional 1d4 persistent damage of the same type as the foxfire. You gain an item bonus to this persistent damage equal to the foxfire's item bonus to attack rolls. When the target taking persistent damage comes into physical contact with another creature (for instance, if one of its allies touches it while @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administering First Aid}), you can use a reaction to command the flame to leap to the second target, ending the persistent damage on the first creature and moving it to the second.
_desc_ko: 여우불 타격으로 치명타를 성공시킬 경우, 대상은 여우불과 동일한 유형의 지속 피해 1d4를 추가로 받습니다. 이 지속 피해에 대해 당신은 여우불의 명중 굴림 아이템 보너스와 동일한 아이템 보너스를 얻습니다. 지속 피해를 입은 대상이 다른 생물과 신체 접촉할 경우(예: @link[actions.administer-first-aid] 중인 아군이 접촉), 반응으로 불꽃을 두 번째 대상으로 옮기도록 명령할 수 있다. 이 경우 첫 번째 생물의 지속 피해는 종료되고 두 번째 생물로 이동한다.

name: Fast Recovery

description.value: Your body quickly bounces back from afflictions. You regain twice as many Hit Points from resting. Each time you succeed at a Fortitude save against an ongoing disease or poison, you reduce its stage by 2, or by 1 against a virulent disease or poison. Each critical success you achieve against an ongoing disease or poison reduces its stage by 3, or by 2 against a virulent disease or poison. In addition, you reduce the severity of your drained condition by 2 when you rest for a night instead of by 1.

_desc_en: Your body quickly bounces back from afflictions. You regain twice as many Hit Points from resting. Each time you succeed at a Fortitude save against an ongoing disease or poison, you reduce its stage by 2, or by 1 against a virulent disease or poison. Each critical success you achieve against an ongoing disease or poison reduces its stage by 3, or by 2 against a virulent disease or poison. In addition, you reduce the severity of your drained condition by 2 when you rest for a night instead of by 1.
_desc_ko: 당신의 몸은 질병이나 중독에서 빠르게 회복됩니다. 휴식 시 회복하는 HP가 두 배로 증가합니다. 지속되는 질병이나 중독에 대한 인내 내성 굴림에서 성공할 때마다 그 단계가 2 감소하며, 악성 질병이나 중독의 경우 1 감소합니다. 지속되는 질병이나 독에 대한 대성공을 거둘 때마다 그 단계가 3단계 감소하며, 악성 질병이나 독에 대해서는 2단계 감소합니다. 또한 밤새 휴식을 취할 때 고갈 상태의 심각도가 1단계가 아닌 2단계 감소합니다.

name: Violent Unleash

description.value:
Requirement Your previous action was to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7GeguyqyD1TjoC4r]{Unleash your Psyche}.

The force of your mind unleashing itself wracks your enemies with a violent shockwave that batters your enemies. You deal @Damage[ceil(@actor.level/2)d6[force]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:20], with a @Check[reflex|against:occult|basic|options:area-effect] save.

At 5th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6.

_desc_en:
Requirement Your previous action was to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7GeguyqyD1TjoC4r]{Unleash your Psyche}.

The force of your mind unleashing itself wracks your enemies with a violent shockwave that batters your enemies. You deal @Damage[ceil(@actor.level/2)d6[force]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:20], with a @Check[reflex|against:occult|basic|options:area-effect] save.

At 5th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신은 @link[actions.unleash-psyche].

당신의 정신이 해방되면서 발생하는 힘이 적들에게 격렬한 충격파를 일으킵니다. 당신은 20피트 반경 내의 모든 생물에게 역장의 피해를 입히며, 기본 반사 내성 굴림을 적용합니다. 이 폭발은 당신에게 부담을 주어 @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태가 됩니다. 5레벨과 이후 2레벨마다 피해량이 1d6 증가합니다.

name: Flash of Omnipresence

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Empowered with divine energy, you can be at an ally's side in the blink of an eye. You teleport to an empty space adjacent to an ally within 100 feet. If you spend a Mythic Point as part of this action, you can teleport to anywhere within a mile, and when you arrive, any enemies adjacent to you must succeed at a @Check[will|against:class-spell] saving throw against your class DC or spell DC or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Empowered with divine energy, you can be at an ally's side in the blink of an eye. You teleport to an empty space adjacent to an ally within 100 feet. If you spend a Mythic Point as part of this action, you can teleport to anywhere within a mile, and when you arrive, any enemies adjacent to you must succeed at a @Check[will|against:class-spell] saving throw against your class DC or spell DC or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

신성한 에너지로 강화되어, 당신은 순식간에 아군의 곁에 있을 수 있습니다. 당신은 100피트 이내의 아군과 인접한 빈 공간으로 순간이동합니다. 이 행동에 신화 포인트를 소모하면 1마일 이내 어디든 순간이동할 수 있으며, 도착 시 인접한 모든 적들은 당신의 직업 DC 또는 주문 DC에 대한 의지 저항 검사에서 성공하지 못하면 @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태가 된다.

name: Sociable Vow

description.value: You can leverage your vow in more social interactions. The circumstance bonus from your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.9X80J5RN21Uoaeiw]{Binding Vow} also applies to attempts to [[/act gather-information options=binding-vow]], [[/act make-an-impression options=binding-vow]], or [[/act demoralize options=binding-vow]] you make directly in service of fulfilling the vow.

_desc_en: You can leverage your vow in more social interactions. The circumstance bonus from your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.9X80J5RN21Uoaeiw]{Binding Vow} also applies to attempts to [[/act gather-information options=binding-vow]], [[/act make-an-impression options=binding-vow]], or [[/act demoralize options=binding-vow]] you make directly in service of fulfilling the vow.
_desc_ko: 당신은 더 많은 사회적 상호작용에서 맹세를 활용할 수 있습니다. 결속 서약의 상황 보너스는 서약 이행에 직접적으로 기여하는 정보 수집, @link[actions.make-an-impression], 또는 @link[actions.demoralize] 시도하는 행동에도 적용됩니다.

name: Master Spellcasting

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#master-spellcasting-feat]{Master Spellcasting Feat} archetype benefits.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#master-spellcasting-feat]{Master Spellcasting Feat} archetype benefits.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#master-spellcasting-feat]{달인 주문 시전 피트} 아키타입 혜택을 얻습니다.

name: Fascinated by Society

description.value:
Just as some humanoids find themselves driven to study nature, you are obsessed with the artificial constructs of society and can't get enough. You are trained in Society. If you would automatically become trained in Society, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

As a newcomer, sometimes your understanding is a bit off target. When you fail, but don't critically fail, a Society check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing}, you learn the correct information (as you would on a success) and erroneous information (as you would on a critical failure). You don't have any way to differentiate which is which.

_desc_en:
Just as some humanoids find themselves driven to study nature, you are obsessed with the artificial constructs of society and can't get enough. You are trained in Society. If you would automatically become trained in Society, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

As a newcomer, sometimes your understanding is a bit off target. When you fail, but don't critically fail, a Society check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing}, you learn the correct information (as you would on a success) and erroneous information (as you would on a critical failure). You don't have any way to differentiate which is which.
_desc_ko:
일부 인간형 생물들이 자연 연구에 몰두하듯, 당신은 사회의 인공적 구조물에 집착하며 이를 탐구하는 데 지칠 줄 모릅니다. 사회에 숙련됩니다. 자동으로 사회 숙련이 부여될 경우, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다.

신참인 탓에 때로 당신의 이해는 다소 빗나간다. 실패했지만 대실패는 아닐 때, @link[actions.recall-knowledge] 또는 @link[actions.decipher-writing]에 대한 사회성 검사를 수행하면, 성공 시와 마찬가지로 올바른 정보를 얻고, 대실패 시와 마찬가지로 잘못된 정보를 얻습니다. 어느 것이 어느 것인지 구분할 방법이 없습니다.

name: Energized Font

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You can focus your mind more quickly thanks to the magic that flows within you. You regain 1 Focus Point, up to your usual maximum.

value.value: at least one innate spell from a gnome heritage or ancestry feat that shares a tradition with at least one of your focus spells

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You can focus your mind more quickly thanks to the magic that flows within you. You regain 1 Focus Point, up to your usual maximum.
_desc_ko:
빈도 하루에 한 번

몸속으로 흐르는 마법 덕분에 정신을 더 빠르게 포커스할 수 있습니다. 평소 최대치까지 포커스 포인트 1점을 회복합니다.

name: Overdrive Ally

description.value:
Requirements You are currently in overdrive.

You quickly fling some of your powered-up mechanisms to an ally, sharing your benefits with them briefly. Choose an ally within 30 feet. Until the end of their next turn, that ally's Strikes deal additional damage equal to half your Intelligence modifier, or your full Intelligence modifier if you were in critical overdrive. The ally doesn't gain the increased damage from expert, master, or legendary overdrive.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.a4C89wVlcwV6Uxx4]{Effect: Overdrive Ally}

_desc_en:
Requirements You are currently in overdrive.

You quickly fling some of your powered-up mechanisms to an ally, sharing your benefits with them briefly. Choose an ally within 30 feet. Until the end of their next turn, that ally's Strikes deal additional damage equal to half your Intelligence modifier, or your full Intelligence modifier if you were in critical overdrive. The ally doesn't gain the increased damage from expert, master, or legendary overdrive.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.a4C89wVlcwV6Uxx4]{Effect: Overdrive Ally}
_desc_ko:
요구사항 현재 과부하 상태입니다.

당신은 강화된 메커니즘 일부를 아군에게 재빨리 던져 잠시 동안 혜택을 공유합니다. 30피트 이내의 아군을 선택하세요. 해당 아군의 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지, 그 아군의 공격은 당신의 지능 수정자의 절반에 해당하는 추가 피해를 입힙니다. 극한 오버드라이브 상태였다면 지능 수정자 전체가 적용됩니다. 아군은 숙련, 달인, 전설적 오버드라이브의 추가 피해 효과를 얻지 못합니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.a4C89wVlcwV6Uxx4]{효과: 오버드라이브 아군}

name: Magpie Snatch

description.value: You move quickly, snatching a shiny item that catches your eye. Stride twice, and you can Interact to pick up an unattended object at any point during your movement.

_desc_en: You move quickly, snatching a shiny item that catches your eye. Stride twice, and you can Interact to pick up an unattended object at any point during your movement.
_desc_ko: 당신은 재빠르게 움직이며 눈에 띄는 반짝이는 물건을 낚아챈다. 두 번의 이동 후, 이동 중 언제든지 상호작용을 통해 방치된 물건을 집을 수 있다.

name: Cayden's Freedom

description.value: Even if you've never downed a tankard of ale nor indulged in a night of rowdy revelry, you appreciate the dedication to freedom from Cayden Cailean and his worshippers. After much physical practice, you've become difficult to restrain, and if you're ever @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, you can access a little bit of the Accidental God's luck. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude DC when resisting an opponent's attempts to [[/act grapple]] you or Swallow you Whole. In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VqGjR43bBd36k0XI]{Liberate Self} action.

_desc_en: Even if you've never downed a tankard of ale nor indulged in a night of rowdy revelry, you appreciate the dedication to freedom from Cayden Cailean and his worshippers. After much physical practice, you've become difficult to restrain, and if you're ever @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, you can access a little bit of the Accidental God's luck. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude DC when resisting an opponent's attempts to [[/act grapple]] you or Swallow you Whole. In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VqGjR43bBd36k0XI]{Liberate Self} action.
_desc_ko: 당신이 에일 한 잔을 들이켠 적도, 소란스러운 흥청망청한 밤을 즐긴 적도 없더라도, 당신은 케이든 케일리언과 그 숭배자들의 자유를 향한 헌신을 높이 삽니다. 많은 신체 수련 끝에, 당신은 억제하기 어려운 존재가 되었고, 만약 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{조이기} 상태가 되면 우연의 신의 행운을 조금 끌어올 수 있습니다. 당신은 적이 당신을 [[/act grapple]]하거나 통째로 삼키려는 시도에 저항할 때 완강함 DC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 또한 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VqGjR43bBd36k0XI]{자기 해방} 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Concentrated Assault

description.value: You and your spotter combine your efforts to bring down your target. If you and your spotter both use the Ready activity to make a Strike against the same opponent and choose the same trigger for the readied action, resolve your attacks at the same time. Each of you can use the higher of the two attack rolls for your Strikes, each using your own modifier; this is a fortune effect. If both attacks are successful, total the damage for both attacks for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.

_desc_en: You and your spotter combine your efforts to bring down your target. If you and your spotter both use the Ready activity to make a Strike against the same opponent and choose the same trigger for the readied action, resolve your attacks at the same time. Each of you can use the higher of the two attack rolls for your Strikes, each using your own modifier; this is a fortune effect. If both attacks are successful, total the damage for both attacks for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.
_desc_ko: 당신과 스포터는 힘을 합쳐 목표를 쓰러뜨립니다. 당신과 스포터가 모두 준비 활동 을 사용하여 동일한 상대에게 공격을 가하고, 준비된 행동에 동일한 트리거를 선택한 경우, 두 공격을 동시에 해결합니다. 각각은 자신의 수정자를 적용한 두 명중 굴림 중 높은 값을 공격에 사용할 수 있습니다. 이는 행운 효과입니다. 두 공격 모두 성공할 경우, 저항 및 약점 적용을 위해 두 공격의 피해를 합산합니다.

name: Greater Vital Evolution

description.value: Vital power surges through you like a font of energy. Twice per day, you can cast a spell after you've run out of spell slots of the appropriate spell rank; the two spells you cast with this feat must be of different spell ranks.

_desc_en: Vital power surges through you like a font of energy. Twice per day, you can cast a spell after you've run out of spell slots of the appropriate spell rank; the two spells you cast with this feat must be of different spell ranks.
_desc_ko: 활력이 에너지의 샘처럼 당신을 관통합니다. 하루에 두 번, 해당 주문 랭크의 주문 슬롯이 모두 소진된 후에도 주문을 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 피트로 시전하는 두 주문은 서로 다른 주문 랭크이어야 합니다.

name: Explosive Maneuver

description.value:
Requirements Your last action was a successful Strike against a foe using your weapon innovation.

Thanks to a hidden experimental feature you built into your weapon, your weapon explosively deploys levers, tangling hooks, or similar mechanisms to provide significant assistance when you perform a combat maneuver. When you use Explosive Maneuver, choose Grapple, Shove, or Trip. Your weapon innovation must have a weapon trait that matches the action you chose (for instance, to choose Grapple, your weapon must have the grapple trait). You take the chosen action against the same foe as your previous successful Strike, using the same multiple attack penalty as your previous successful Strike. You still increase your multiple attack penalty after the Grapple, Shove, or Trip, as normal.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your last action was a successful Strike against a foe using your weapon innovation.

Thanks to a hidden experimental feature you built into your weapon, your weapon explosively deploys levers, tangling hooks, or similar mechanisms to provide significant assistance when you perform a combat maneuver. When you use Explosive Maneuver, choose Grapple, Shove, or Trip. Your weapon innovation must have a weapon trait that matches the action you chose (for instance, to choose Grapple, your weapon must have the grapple trait). You take the chosen action against the same foe as your previous successful Strike, using the same multiple attack penalty as your previous successful Strike. You still increase your multiple attack penalty after the Grapple, Shove, or Trip, as normal.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 마지막 행동이 무기 혁신을 사용한 적에 대한 성공적인 공격이었어야 합니다.

무기에 내장한 숨겨진 실험적 기능 덕분에, 전투 기동을 수행할 때 무기가 폭발적으로 레버, 얽히는 갈고리 또는 유사한 장치를 전개하여 상당한 지원을 제공합니다. 폭발적 기동을 사용할 때, 그랩, 밀치기 또는 걸어 넘어뜨리기를 선택하십시오. 선택한 행동과 일치하는 무기 특성을 무기 혁신이 가져야 합니다(예: 그랩을 선택하려면 무기가 그랩 특성을 가져야 함). 선택한 행동은 이전 성공한 타격과 동일한 적에게 수행하며, 동일한 다중 공격 페널티를 적용합니다. 그랩, 밀치기, 걸어 넘어뜨리기 후에도 평소처럼 다중 공격 페널티가 증가합니다.

name: Jotun's Boost

description.value:
Requirements You have at least one hand free and are adjacent to an ally.

Your giant might allows you to pick up your allies and hurl them across the battlefield. Pick up an adjacent willing ally who is smaller than you and toss them to an unoccupied space you can see within 25 feet; if you have two hands free, you can instead toss them into a space within 30 feet. Your ally's movement doesn't trigger reactions. Your ally ends this movement on their feet and doesn't take damage from the fall. If your ally ends this movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, they can make a melee Strike against an enemy within their reach as a reaction.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have at least one hand free and are adjacent to an ally.

Your giant might allows you to pick up your allies and hurl them across the battlefield. Pick up an adjacent willing ally who is smaller than you and toss them to an unoccupied space you can see within 25 feet; if you have two hands free, you can instead toss them into a space within 30 feet. Your ally's movement doesn't trigger reactions. Your ally ends this movement on their feet and doesn't take damage from the fall. If your ally ends this movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, they can make a melee Strike against an enemy within their reach as a reaction.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 한 손 이상이 자유롭고 아군과 인접해 있어야 합니다.

당신의 거대한 힘으로 아군을 들어 올려 전장을 가로질러 던질 수 있습니다. 인접한 의지가 있는 아군 중 당신보다 작은 아군을 들어 올려, 25피트 이내에 있는 당신이 볼 수 있는 빈 공간으로 던집니다. 양손이 자유로운 경우, 대신 30피트 이내의 공간으로 던질 수 있습니다. 동료의 이동은 반응을 유발하지 않습니다. 동료는 이 이동을 끝내고도 발을 딛고 서 있으며 추락으로 인한 피해를 입지 않습니다. 동료가 적어도 한 명의 적과 근접 공격 범위 내에 이 이동을 끝낸다면, 반응으로 자신의 범위 내 적을 상대로 근접 공격을 시도할 수 있습니다.

name: Preemptive Reconfiguration

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would take bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage.

Your body anticipates the blow. The impact area briefly reorganizes into a strengthened tissue lattice that blunts the attack. You gain resistance equal to your level to the triggering damage type, which applies against the triggering damage.

If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Ewk7h9aQpKvy1RJo]{Extraplanar Haze} feat, you can use Preemptive Reconfiguration without expending a usage of the reaction for the purpose of the feat's Frequency limit. Instead, the usage counts toward your number of Crystalline Dust uses per day, as if you had used that feat instead.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would take bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage.

Your body anticipates the blow. The impact area briefly reorganizes into a strengthened tissue lattice that blunts the attack. You gain resistance equal to your level to the triggering damage type, which applies against the triggering damage.

If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Ewk7h9aQpKvy1RJo]{Extraplanar Haze} feat, you can use Preemptive Reconfiguration without expending a usage of the reaction for the purpose of the feat's Frequency limit. Instead, the usage counts toward your number of Crystalline Dust uses per day, as if you had used that feat instead.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 타격, 관통, 베기 피해를 입을 때.

신체가 타격을 예측한다. 충격 부위가 순간적으로 강화된 조직 격자로 재구성되어 공격을 무력화합니다. 발동된 피해 유형에 대해 레벨만큼의 저항력을 얻으며, 이는 해당 발동 피해에 적용됩니다.

@link[feats.extraplanar-haze] 피트를 보유한 경우, 이 피트의 사용 빈도 제한 목적상 선제 재구성을 반응 사용 횟수를 소모하지 않고 사용할 수 있다. 대신 해당 사용은 마치 그 피트를 사용한 것처럼 하루에 사용할 수 있는 결정 가루 사용 횟수에 포함된다.

name: Ward Against Corruption

description.value: Your soul is warded against the power of undeath and plague, as well as that of the evil former psychopomps known as sahkils. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against death effects, disease, and all effects from undead or sahkils. This bonus increases to +2 against an undead or sahkil's death effect or disease.

_desc_en: Your soul is warded against the power of undeath and plague, as well as that of the evil former psychopomps known as sahkils. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against death effects, disease, and all effects from undead or sahkils. This bonus increases to +2 against an undead or sahkil's death effect or disease.
_desc_ko: 당신의 영혼은 언데드와 역병의 힘, 그리고 사킬이라 불리는 사악한 전직 사이코폼프의 힘으로부터 수호부됩니다. 사망 효과, 질병, 그리고 언데드나 사킬의 모든 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 보너스는 언데드나 사킬의 사망 효과나 질병에 대해서는 +2로 증가합니다.

name: Wonder Worker

description.value: The thaumaturge's path culminates with the working of wonders. Once per day, you can align your esoterica to cast a spell of 8th rank or lower that takes 1, 2, or 3 actions to cast. The spell must be common or one to which you have access. You can choose a spell of any tradition for which you're legendary in the associated skill (Arcana for arcane, Nature for primal, Occultism for occult, or Religion for divine). Use your thaumaturge class DC in place of any necessary spell DC and your thaumaturge class DC - 10 in place of any necessary counteract modifier or spell attack modifier.

value.value: legendary in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion

_desc_en: The thaumaturge's path culminates with the working of wonders. Once per day, you can align your esoterica to cast a spell of 8th rank or lower that takes 1, 2, or 3 actions to cast. The spell must be common or one to which you have access. You can choose a spell of any tradition for which you're legendary in the associated skill (Arcana for arcane, Nature for primal, Occultism for occult, or Religion for divine). Use your thaumaturge class DC in place of any necessary spell DC and your thaumaturge class DC - 10 in place of any necessary counteract modifier or spell attack modifier.
_desc_ko: 쏘마터지의 길은 기적을 행하는 것으로 정점에 이릅니다. 하루에 한 번, 자신의 에소테리카를 성향하여 1, 2, 또는 3 행동이 소요되는 8th 랭크 이하의 주문을 시전할 수 있습니다. 해당 주문은 일반 주문이거나 본인이 접근 가능한 주문이어야 합니다. 관련 기술(비전의 경우 비전, 원소의 경우 자연, 오컬트의 경우 오컬트, 신성의 경우 종교)에서 전설적인 명성을 가진 모든 전통의 주문을 선택할 수 있다. 필요한 주문 난이도 대신 쏘마터지 직업 난이도를, 필요한 저항 수정자나 주문 공격 수정자 대신 쏘마터지 직업 난이도 -10을 사용한다.

name: Swaggering Initiative

description.value:
Trigger You are about to roll initiative.

You swagger readily into any fight. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your initiative roll and can Interact to draw a weapon. If you are the first to act in combat, you gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.uBJsxCzNhje8m8jj]{Panache}.

_desc_ko:
발동조건 이니셔티브 주사위를 굴리려는 순간.

당신은 싸움에 당당히 뛰어듭니다. 이니셔티브 롤에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 무기를 뽑기 위해 상호작용할 수 있습니다. 전투에서 가장 먼저 행동할 경우 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.uBJsxCzNhje8m8jj]{파나슈}를 얻습니다.

name: Jungle Runner

description.value: You run through the jungle as easily as you would through an open field. You ignore difficult terrain from underbrush within forests and jungles. You can always use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} action when you're within forest or jungle terrain to gain cover, even if you aren't adjacent to an obstacle you can Take Cover behind.

_desc_en: You run through the jungle as easily as you would through an open field. You ignore difficult terrain from underbrush within forests and jungles. You can always use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} action when you're within forest or jungle terrain to gain cover, even if you aren't adjacent to an obstacle you can Take Cover behind.
_desc_ko: 당신은 정글을 마치 평야를 달리는 것처럼 쉽게 질주합니다. 숲과 정글 내의 덤불로 인한 어려운 지형을 무시합니다. 숲이나 정글 지형 내에 있을 때는 항상 @link[actions.take-cover] 행동을 사용하여 엄폐를 얻을 수 있습니다. 뒤에 엄폐할 수 있는 장애물과 인접하지 않은 경우에도 마찬가지입니다.

name: Liberty or Death

description.value:
Requirements A creature has been the target of your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cwBsPU24715fUCub]{Ultimatum of Liberation} for at least 1 minute

You have given a despot enough time to think, and now is the time for them to forfeit their control or die. Spend a Mythic Point and make a Strike at mythic proficiency against the required creature. If you succeed and deal damage, the target must succeed on a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC (whichever is higher) or die. If the target succeeds, they are immune to this ability for 24 hours.

_desc_ko:
요건 생물이 당신의 @link[actions.ultimatum-of-liberation]의 대상이 된 지 최소 1분이 지났을 때

당신은 폭군에게 생각할 충분한 시간을 주었으며, 이제 그들이 통제권을 포기하거나 죽을 때입니다. 신화 포인트 1점을 소모하고 대상 생물에게 신화 숙련도로 공격을 가하십시오. 성공하여 피해를 입히면, 대상은 당신의 직업 DC 또는 주문 DC(둘 중 높은 쪽)에 대한 인내 내성에 성공하지 못하면 죽습니다. 대상이 내성에 성공하면, 24시간 동안 이 능력에 면역이 됩니다.

name: Rock Runner

description.value: Your innate connection to stone makes you adept at moving across uneven surfaces. You can ignore difficult terrain caused by stone (such as rubble or gravel) and uneven ground made of stone and earth. In addition, when you use the Acrobatics skill to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} on narrow surfaces or uneven ground made of stone or earth, you aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, and when you roll a success at one of these Acrobatics checks, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: Your innate connection to stone makes you adept at moving across uneven surfaces. You can ignore difficult terrain caused by stone (such as rubble or gravel) and uneven ground made of stone and earth. In addition, when you use the Acrobatics skill to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} on narrow surfaces or uneven ground made of stone or earth, you aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, and when you roll a success at one of these Acrobatics checks, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신의 돌과의 타고난 연결은 고르지 않은 지면을 가로지르는 데 능숙하게 합니다. 돌로 인한 어려운 지형(예: 잔해나 자갈)과 돌과 흙으로 이루어진 고르지 않은 지면을 무시할 수 있습니다. 또한, 좁은 표면이나 돌과 흙으로 이루어진 고르지 않은 지면에서 곡예 기술로 @link[actions.balance]를 사용할 때, 당신은 @link[conditions.off-guard]가 되지 않으며, 이러한 곡예 판정 중 하나에서 성공을 굴릴 경우 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Superior Propulsion

description.value:
By experimenting with the effects of momentum gained from your signature vehicle's movement, you have learned to get more from propulsion than just speed when the pilot pushes the vehicle to its limit. Each time the pilot Drives your signature vehicle as a 2- or 3-action activity and succeeds at the Piloting check, the vehicle produces an additional effect, depending on its method of propulsion. If your signature vehicle has more than one propulsion method, the pilot can select which benefit to gain each time they succeed at the Piloting check to Drive the vehicle as a 2- or 3-action activity.

Alchemical The caustic runoff from the alchemical engines is now weaponized. Creatures adjacent to your signature vehicle when it begins its movement take acid damage equal to your level.

Clockwork More resilient gears allow the vehicle to remain functional, even when damaged. If your signature vehicle is broken, it does not need to make the flat check to avoid losing operating time.

Magical The residual magic from your signature vehicle interferes with hostile spells. Pilots, crew, and passengers of the vehicle gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against spells until the start of the pilot's next turn.

Pulled You have eased the amount of effort needed for those pulling your signature vehicle to move it. The vehicle gains a +10 circumstance bonus to its Speed.

Rowed Reinforced ports protect the rowers below decks from harm. Rowers of your signature vehicle who are below decks have greater cover from attacks from outside the vehicle and are not damaged when the vehicle takes collision damage.

Steam The outlet of steam forms a cloud around the vehicle as it moves. For the duration of its movement, your signature vehicle is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Wind The draft of the wind helps the vehicle turn. During this movement, your signature vehicle can turn normally, rather than needing to move in a straight line as normal for a 2- or 3-action Drive.

_desc_ko:
당신은 시그니처 차량의 운동에서 얻는 운동량의 효과를 실험함으로써, 조종사가 차량을 한계까지 몰아붙일 때 추진력으로 속도 이상의 것을 얻을 수 있는 방법을 터득했습니다. 조종사가 시그니처 차량을 2-액션 또는 3-액션 활동으로 운전하며 조종 판정에서 성공할 때마다, 차량은 추진 방식에 따라 추가 효과를 발생시킵니다. 시그니처 차량이 두 가지 이상의 추진 방식을 가질 경우, 조종사는 2-액션 또는 3-액션 활동으로 차량을 운전하는 조종 판정에서 성공할 때마다 얻을 혜택을 선택할 수 있습니다.

연금술적 연금술 엔진에서 흘러나오는 부식성 유출물이 무기화됩니다. 당신의 시그니처 차량이 이동을 시작할 때 인접한 생물은 당신의 레벨에 해당하는 산성 피해를 입습니다.

시계장치 더 튼튼해진 기어 덕분에 차량은 피해 상태에서도 작동할 수 있습니다. 시그니처 차량이 고장 나더라도 작동 시간 손실을 피하기 위한 단순 판정을 수행할 필요가 없습니다.

마법적 시그니처 차량의 잔류 마법이 적대적 주문에 간섭합니다. 차량의 조종사, 승무원, 승객은 조종사의 다음 턴 시작까지 주문 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

끌림 당신의 시그니처 차량을 움직이기 위해 끄는 이들의 노력량을 줄였습니다. 차량의 속도에 +10 상황 보너스가 적용됩니다.

노를 저음 강화된 포트가 갑판 아래 노 젓는 이들을 보호합니다. 갑판 아래에 있는 시그니처 차량의 노 젓는 이들은 차량 외부 공격으로부터 완전 엄폐를 받으며, 차량이 충돌 피해를 입을 때도 피해를 입지 않습니다.

증기 증기 배출구가 차량 주변에 구름을 형성하며 이동합니다. 이동 중 시그니처 차량은 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태가 됩니다.

바람 바람의 기류가 차량의 회전을 돕습니다. 이 동작 동안, 당신의 시그니처 차량은 2-3액션 드라이브 시 일반적으로 직선으로 이동해야 하는 대신 정상적으로 회전할 수 있습니다.

name: Final Form

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You embrace your monstrous blood and make it your own, screaming out to the heavens and hells alike in rage, pain, and defiance. Reality buckles and twists under your sudden power—each tiefling has a unique transformation, but it might include sulfurous flames, choruses of shrieks, or twisting, serpentine lightning. Every creature within 10 feet of you is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round unless they succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Your final form has the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.hiVL8qsnTJtpouw0]{Divine Vessel} for a deity that shares an alignment with your fiendish lineage. Your final form resembles a creature from your fiendish lineage, and you remain in that form for 1 minute. While in your final form, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sRfSBHWHdbIa0aGc]{Chilling Darkness}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{Fireball}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9AAkVUCwF6WVNNY2]{Lightning Bolt} as 6th-rank divine innate spells, once each per use of this feat.

When you emerge from your final form, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3}. In addition, if you have this feat, you gain weakness 10 to holy even when not in your final form.

Special At the GM's discretion, the specific elements of this feat can be adjusted to better fit the tiefling's lineage—for example, a GM might decide that a particular beastbrood tiefling could cast a 6th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tlcrVRqW1MSKJ5IC]{Phantasmal Killer} instead of fireball.
