Frequency once per day

Trigger You are reduced to 0 Hit Points and would gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition or would otherwise die.

Death is as natural as breathing to you, and you can move past it as easily as the other troubles in your life. You prevent yourself from dying and regain Hit Points equal to @Damage[((6d8+floor(@actor.level/2)))[healing]]{6d8 plus half your level}. If the cause of your death was a condition or effect that would still cause you to die after regaining Hit Points, such as a high value on the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} condition, you suppress that effect for 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 HP가 0이 되어 @link[conditions.dying] 상태가 되거나, 그렇지 않으면 죽게 됩니다.

죽음은 숨 쉬는 것만큼 자연스러운 일이며, 당신은 인생의 다른 어려움들처럼 쉽게 그것을 극복할 수 있습니다. 당신은 죽음을 막고 6d8 + 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 HP를 회복합니다. 만약 사망 원인이 HP 회복 후에도 여전히 사망을 초래할 상태나 효과(예: @link[conditions.doomed] 상태의 높은 수치)였다면, 해당 효과를 1분 동안 억제한다.

name: Accurate Swing

description.value: You strike cleanly with wide, sweeping attacks to inflict maximum damage, taking advantage of your judged foe's fear to land a felling blow. If you Strike a creature you condemned with Harsh Judgment that has the frightened condition with a sweep melee weapon or a sweep unarmed attack, you gain a circumstance bonus to the Strike's damage equal to the number of weapon damage dice your weapon deals.

publication.title: Pathfinder Adventure: Night of the Gray Death

_desc_en: You strike cleanly with wide, sweeping attacks to inflict maximum damage, taking advantage of your judged foe's fear to land a felling blow. If you Strike a creature you condemned with Harsh Judgment that has the frightened condition with a sweep melee weapon or a sweep unarmed attack, you gain a circumstance bonus to the Strike's damage equal to the number of weapon damage dice your weapon deals.
_desc_ko: 당신은 넓게 휘두르는 공격으로 깔끔하게 강타하여 최대 피해를 입히며, 판단된 적의 공포를 이용해 쓰러뜨리는 일격을 가합니다. 혹독한 심판으로 심판한 공포 상태의 생물을 휘두르는 근접 무기나 휘두르는 비무장 공격으로 강타할 경우, 해당 무기의 피해 주사위 수만큼 강타 피해에 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Mythic Refocus

description.value: As your ability to control your mythic power grows, you learn to channel it to restore and reinforce other forms of power at your command. Spend a Mythic Point; you immediately recover all your Focus Points, filling your focus pool to its current maximum.

_desc_en: As your ability to control your mythic power grows, you learn to channel it to restore and reinforce other forms of power at your command. Spend a Mythic Point; you immediately recover all your Focus Points, filling your focus pool to its current maximum.
_desc_ko: 신화적 힘을 제어하는 능력이 성장함에 따라, 당신은 이를 활용하여 자신이 지휘하는 다른 형태의 힘을 회복하고 강화하는 법을 배운다. 신화 포인트 1점을 소모하면, 즉시 모든 포커스를 회복하여 포커스 풀을 현재 최대치로 채운다.

name: Palatine Strike

description.value: Your strikes are particularly deadly against supernatural creatures. Whenever you deal precision damage with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.2Fe4YZCvAr9Yf6w7]{Strategic Strike} to a creature about which you have successfully used Occultism or Religion to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, you deal an additional 2d6 precision damage with your strategic strike.

_desc_en: Your strikes are particularly deadly against supernatural creatures. Whenever you deal precision damage with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.2Fe4YZCvAr9Yf6w7]{Strategic Strike} to a creature about which you have successfully used Occultism or Religion to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, you deal an additional 2d6 precision damage with your strategic strike.
_desc_ko: 당신의 공격은 초자연적 생물에게 특히 치명적이다. 에 대해 오컬트나 종교를 성공적으로 사용해 @link[actions.recall-knowledge]을 한 생물에게 @link[feats.strategic-strike]으로 정밀 피해를 입힐 때마다, 전략적 타격으로 추가 2d6 정밀 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Healer's Halo

description.value:
Trigger You or allies within 30 feet recover Hit Points while your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.PGVXjbAi1Fa4uTmD]{Halo} is active.

Your halo can enhance positive energy. Creatures who have recovered Hit Points from a positive healing effect recover an additional @Damage[1d6[healing]] Hit Points. Creatures who benefit from this power become temporarily immune to its effect for the next 10 minutes.

_desc_en:
Trigger You or allies within 30 feet recover Hit Points while your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.PGVXjbAi1Fa4uTmD]{Halo} is active.

Your halo can enhance positive energy. Creatures who have recovered Hit Points from a positive healing effect recover an additional @Damage[1d6[healing]] Hit Points. Creatures who benefit from this power become temporarily immune to its effect for the next 10 minutes.
_desc_ko:
Trigger @link[feats.halo]이 활성화된 동안, 당신 또는 30피트 내의 아군은 HP를 회복합니다.

당신의 후광은 긍정적인 에너지를 증폭시킬 수 있습니다. 긍정적인 치유 효과로 HP를 회복한 생물은 추가로 1d6 회복 HP를 회복합니다. 이 능력의 혜택을 받은 생물은 이후 10분 동안 해당 효과에 일시적으로 면역됩니다.

name: Speak for the Gravelands

description.value:
Access You're a member of the Vellumis Scholars.

You have learned much of what the Gravelands need and are confident in your ability to speak for them. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.E8SDesgMD6Zbye2j]{Geomancer Dedication} archetype feat, even if you normally couldn't take another dedication feat until you take more feats from your current archetype. You can benefit from the following Gravelands terrain attunement when in the Gravelands.

Gravelands (vitality) You gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against the spells and abilities of haunts and undead creatures for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ag1Ix1cnhcV4k9iu]{Effect: Terrain Attunement (Gravelands)}

value.value: can cast at least one spell with the vitality trait

_desc_en:
Access You're a member of the Vellumis Scholars.

You have learned much of what the Gravelands need and are confident in your ability to speak for them. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.E8SDesgMD6Zbye2j]{Geomancer Dedication} archetype feat, even if you normally couldn't take another dedication feat until you take more feats from your current archetype. You can benefit from the following Gravelands terrain attunement when in the Gravelands.

Gravelands (vitality) You gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against the spells and abilities of haunts and undead creatures for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ag1Ix1cnhcV4k9iu]{Effect: Terrain Attunement (Gravelands)}
_desc_ko:
접근 당신은 벨루미스 학회의 일원입니다.

당신은 그레이브 랜드가 필요로 하는 것들을 많이 배웠으며, 그들을 대변할 수 있는 능력에 자신감을 가지고 있습니다. 당신은 @link[feats.geomancer-dedication] 아키타입 피트를 획득합니다. 이는 현재 아키타입에서 더 많은 피트를 선택하기 전까지는 다른 헌신 피트를 선택할 수 없는 경우에도 적용됩니다. 그레이브 랜드에 있을 때 다음 그레이브 랜드 지형 적응 효과의 혜택을 받을 수 있습니다.

그레이브 랜드 (활력) 유령과 언데드 생물의 주문 및 능력에 대한 내성 굴림에 1라운드 동안 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ag1Ix1cnhcV4k9iu]{효과: 지형 조율 (그레이브 랜드)}

name: Goblin Club

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You can summon a mass of magic energy in your hand that, naturally, you use to smack those who offend you. You conjure forth a spectral bangmangi club for 1 minute, which appears in your hands, though you can give it to another creature to wield. This weapon is a +1 striking ghost touch club.

At 13th level, the bangmangi is a +2 greater striking ghost touch club.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You can summon a mass of magic energy in your hand that, naturally, you use to smack those who offend you. You conjure forth a spectral bangmangi club for 1 minute, which appears in your hands, though you can give it to another creature to wield. This weapon is a +1 striking ghost touch club.

At 13th level, the bangmangi is a +2 greater striking ghost touch club.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신은 손에 마법의 에너지 덩어리를 소환할 수 있으며, 당연히 이걸로 당신을 건드린 자들을 때려눕힙니다. 1분 동안 유령 같은 방망이 몽둥이를 만들어내는데, 이 무기는 당신의 손에 나타나지만 다른 생물에게 건네줄 수도 있습니다. 이 무기는 +1의 강타 공격력을 가진 유령의 고스트 터치 몽둥이입니다.

13레벨에 도달하면 방망이는 +2 강타 (중급) 유령 터치 몽둥이가 된다.

name: Hybrid Form

description.value: When you Change Shape, you retain elements of your kitsune form, allowing you to speak in a fox form, use kitsune unarmed attacks in a tailless form, or gain a tail in your tailless form to use abilities that require one. You can Change Shape to alter the details of your hybrid form without fully changing into your true form or your alternate form. While in hybrid form, your foxlike features make it obvious that you aren't a normal humanoid.

_desc_en: When you Change Shape, you retain elements of your kitsune form, allowing you to speak in a fox form, use kitsune unarmed attacks in a tailless form, or gain a tail in your tailless form to use abilities that require one. You can Change Shape to alter the details of your hybrid form without fully changing into your true form or your alternate form. While in hybrid form, your foxlike features make it obvious that you aren't a normal humanoid.
_desc_ko: 형태 변신을 할 때, 너는 키츠네 형태의 요소를 유지하여 키츠네 형태로 말하거나, 꼬리가 없는 형태로 키츠네 비무장 공격을 사용하거나, 꼬리가 없는 형태에서 꼬리를 얻어 꼬리가 필요한 능력을 사용할 수 있다. 변신 능력을 사용해 혼합 형태의 세부 사항을 변경할 수 있습니다. 혼합 형태일 때 여우 같은 특징으로 인해 평범한 인간형이 아님을 알 수 있습니다.

name: Strong Arm

description.value: When you Strike with a thrown weapon, the weapon's range increment increases by 10 feet.

_desc_en: When you Strike with a thrown weapon, the weapon's range increment increases by 10 feet.
_desc_ko: 투척 무기로 강타할 때, 무기의 사거리 증가량이 10피트 증가합니다.

name: Incredible Dragon Companion

description.value: Your mature dragon companion develops further, becoming more robust and formidable. Your dragon companion becomes a nimble or savage animal companion, gaining additional capabilities determined by the type of companion.

_desc_en: Your mature dragon companion develops further, becoming more robust and formidable. Your dragon companion becomes a nimble or savage animal companion, gaining additional capabilities determined by the type of companion.
_desc_ko: 당신의 성숙한 드래곤 반려가 더욱 발전하여, 더 강건하고 가공할 존재가 됩니다. 당신의 드래곤 반려는 민첩형 또는 흉포형 동물 반려가 되며, 반려 유형에 따라 결정되는 추가 능력을 얻습니다.

name: Well-Armed

description.value: Your detachable limbs offer flexibility. You Interact to remove your arm and wield it in the other one, increasing your reach by 5 feet for any one-handed weapon held in that arm. If your next action is a Strike with that weapon, creatures that were outside your reach that you can now hit are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against your first attack. You don't have a free hand while holding the arm. You can Interact to reattach the arm while holding it.

_desc_en: Your detachable limbs offer flexibility. You Interact to remove your arm and wield it in the other one, increasing your reach by 5 feet for any one-handed weapon held in that arm. If your next action is a Strike with that weapon, creatures that were outside your reach that you can now hit are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against your first attack. You don't have a free hand while holding the arm. You can Interact to reattach the arm while holding it.
_desc_ko: 분리 가능한 사지가 유연성을 제공합니다. 상호작용으로 팔을 분리해 반대쪽 팔로 휘두를 수 있으며, 해당 팔에 든 모든 한손 무기의 공격 범위가 5피트 증가합니다. 해당 무기로 다음 행동이 공격일 경우, 이전에는 공격 범위에 없었지만 이제 공격 가능한 대상은 첫 번째 공격에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다. 팔을 들고 있을 때는 빈 손이 없습니다. 팔을 들고 있는 상태에서 상호작용을 통해 팔을 재부착할 수 있습니다.

name: Discerning Strike

description.value:
Requirements You have successfully identified the target with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} during this combat.

Identifying a creature is the first step in finding its weaknesses. Attempt a Strike against the target; if successful, you deal an additional 1d6 precision damage. If you have succeeded on a Recall Knowledge check against the target during this combat and their creature type was previously recorded using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.0Dy8RlFqrzCVOTl4]{Thorough Reports}, you also deal 1 point of persistent bleed damage. The creature is then temporarily immune to Discerning Strike for 1 day.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en:
Requirements You have successfully identified the target with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} during this combat.

Identifying a creature is the first step in finding its weaknesses. Attempt a Strike against the target; if successful, you deal an additional 1d6 precision damage. If you have succeeded on a Recall Knowledge check against the target during this combat and their creature type was previously recorded using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.0Dy8RlFqrzCVOTl4]{Thorough Reports}, you also deal 1 point of persistent bleed damage. The creature is then temporarily immune to Discerning Strike for 1 day.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 이번 전투 중 @link[actions.recall-knowledge]으로 대상의 정체를 성공적으로 확인했어야 한다.

생물의 약점을 찾는 첫 단계는 그 생물을 식별하는 것입니다. 대상에게 강타를 시도하세요. 성공 시 추가로 1d6 정밀 피해를 입힙니다. 이번 전투 중 대상에 대해 지식 회상 판정에 성공했고, 그 생물 유형이 이전에 @link[feats.thorough-reports]로 기록된 경우, 지속 출혈 피해 1점을 추가로 입힙니다. 해당 생물은 이후 1일간 식별 강타에 일시적으로 면역됩니다.

name: War Mage Dedication

description.value:
Your studies into the battlefield applications of magic have made your spells particularly effective at disrupting enemy formations or manipulating enemy troops into positions where they are more vulnerable to wide-scale magical attacks. When you cast a non-cantrip spell that deals damage in an area, choose a number of targets equal to your Intelligence modifier who failed their saving throw against the effect. Move each one up to 10 feet from their original position after they take damage and any other effects from the spell. You can't move a creature into or through obstacles. A Medium or smaller creature counts as one target; a Large creature counts as two Medium creatures; and a Huge creature counts as four Medium creatures. You can't move Gargantuan creatures in this way.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Warfare Lore. If you were already trained in Warfare Lore, you become trained in a Lore skill of your choice.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.NkQidn5vlt6U1EFv]{War Mage (Class Archetype)}

value.value: You have a spellcasting class feature.

_desc_en:
Your studies into the battlefield applications of magic have made your spells particularly effective at disrupting enemy formations or manipulating enemy troops into positions where they are more vulnerable to wide-scale magical attacks. When you cast a non-cantrip spell that deals damage in an area, choose a number of targets equal to your Intelligence modifier who failed their saving throw against the effect. Move each one up to 10 feet from their original position after they take damage and any other effects from the spell. You can't move a creature into or through obstacles. A Medium or smaller creature counts as one target; a Large creature counts as two Medium creatures; and a Huge creature counts as four Medium creatures. You can't move Gargantuan creatures in this way.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Warfare Lore. If you were already trained in Warfare Lore, you become trained in a Lore skill of your choice.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.NkQidn5vlt6U1EFv]{War Mage (Class Archetype)}
_desc_ko:
전장에서 마법을 활용하는 법을 연구한 덕분에, 당신의 주문은 적의 진형을 교란하거나 적군을 대규모 마법 공격에 약점 있는 위치로 유도하는 데 특히 효과적입니다. 영역에 피해를 주는 캔트립이 아닌 주문을 시전할 때, 그 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 실패한 대상 중 지능 능력치 수정자만큼의 수를 선택하세요. 각 대상이 주문으로 인한 피해 및 기타 효과를 받은 후, 원래 위치에서 최대 10피트까지 이동시킵니다. 장애물 안이나 통과하여 생물을 이동시킬 수 없습니다. 중간 크기 이하 생물은 하나의 대상으로 간주됩니다. 대형 생물은 중간 크기 생물 두 마리로, 초대형 생물은 중간 크기 생물 네 마리로 계산됩니다. 거대 생물은 이 방법으로 이동시킬 수 없습니다.

또한 전쟁학에 대한 @link[feats.additional-lore] 일반 피트를 획득한다. 이미 전쟁학에 숙련된 경우, 선택한 지식 기술에 숙련된다.

name: Ringmaster's Introduction

description.value:
Requirements The ally hasn't acted in the current combat.

Trigger An ally's turn begins.

You announce the triggering ally with a litany of their legendary achievements, spurring them to action. The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} this turn and can spend the extra action to Stride, Strike, Demoralize, Feint, or Perform.

_desc_en:
Requirements The ally hasn't acted in the current combat.

Trigger An ally's turn begins.

You announce the triggering ally with a litany of their legendary achievements, spurring them to action. The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} this turn and can spend the extra action to Stride, Strike, Demoralize, Feint, or Perform.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 아군이 현재 전투에서 행동하지 않았습니다.

발동 조건 아군의 턴이 시작될 때.

당신은 발동 대상 동맹의 전설적인 업적을 열거하며 그들을 행동으로 이끌어냅니다. 대상은 이번 턴 동안 @link[conditions.quickened] 상태가 되며, 추가 행동을 사용하여 이동, 공격, 사기 저하, 페인트, 또는 공연할 수 있습니다.

name: Mana Detonation

description.value: You can violently discorporate your form. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KY2xyMavZHAoG69D]{Arcane Explosion} focus spell.

_desc_en: You can violently discorporate your form. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KY2xyMavZHAoG69D]{Arcane Explosion} focus spell.
_desc_ko: 자신의 형태를 격렬하게 해체할 수 있습니다. @link[spells.arcane-explosion] 포커스 주문을 획득합니다.

name: Hellknight Mobility

description.value: You've learned how best to move in your heavy armor. When wearing heavy armor, if you meet the Strength requirement, instead of reducing the movement penalty by 5 feet, you reduce the penalty by 10 feet (typically reducing the penalty to 0). If you're a dwarf with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.C1R4wd6G46CAVIn7]{Unburdened Iron} feat, increase your Speed by 5 feet.

value.value: expert in Hellknight half plate or Hellknight plate

_desc_en: You've learned how best to move in your heavy armor. When wearing heavy armor, if you meet the Strength requirement, instead of reducing the movement penalty by 5 feet, you reduce the penalty by 10 feet (typically reducing the penalty to 0). If you're a dwarf with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.C1R4wd6G46CAVIn7]{Unburdened Iron} feat, increase your Speed by 5 feet.
_desc_ko: 당신은 중갑을 입고 가장 잘 움직이는 법을 익혔습니다. 중갑을 착용하고 있을 때 근력 요구조건을 충족한다면, 이동 페널티를 5피트 줄이는 대신 10피트 줄입니다(보통 페널티를 0으로 줄입니다). 당신이 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.C1R4wd6G46CAVIn7]{무거움 없는 강철} 재주를 지닌 드워프라면, 당신의 속도를 5피트 늘립니다.

name: Ask the Bones

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You keep the bone of an ancestor or a friend to call upon for advice. Attempt to Recall Knowledge. If the bones belonged to a person particularly knowledgeable on the subject, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your check.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You keep the bone of an ancestor or a friend to call upon for advice. Attempt to Recall Knowledge. If the bones belonged to a person particularly knowledgeable on the subject, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your check.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

조상이나 친구의 뼈를 간직하여 조언을 구합니다. 지식 회상 시도하다. 해당 뼈가 해당 주제에 특히 박식한 인물의 것이라면, 판정 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Armored Rest

description.value: You've slept many nights in your armor and gotten used to it. You can sleep in armor overnight without being fatigued the next day. If you were already fatigued before sleeping, the armor doesn't prevent you from recovering from being fatigued.

value.value: trained in light, medium, or heavy armor

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en: You've slept many nights in your armor and gotten used to it. You can sleep in armor overnight without being fatigued the next day. If you were already fatigued before sleeping, the armor doesn't prevent you from recovering from being fatigued.
_desc_ko: 갑옷을 입고 여러 밤을 자며 익숙해졌습니다. 갑옷을 입고 하룻밤을 자도 다음날 피로하지 않습니다. 잠들기 전 이미 피로 상태였다면, 갑옷이 피로 회복을 방해하지 않습니다.

name: Incredible Familiar (Animist)

description.value: Your connection to your apparition and your mastery of spiritual magic reach a new threshold that allows you to channel even more power into the physical form you allow it to take on as your familiar. You can select a base of six familiar or master abilities each day, instead of four.

_desc_en: Your connection to your apparition and your mastery of spiritual magic reach a new threshold that allows you to channel even more power into the physical form you allow it to take on as your familiar. You can select a base of six familiar or master abilities each day, instead of four.
_desc_ko: 당신의 환영과의 유대감과 영적 마법 숙련도가 새로운 경지에 도달하여, 패밀리어로 삼은 물리적 형태에 더 많은 힘을 집중시킬 수 있게 됩니다. 매일 4개 대신 6개의 기본 패밀리어 능력 또는 마스터 능력을 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Panache Paragon

description.value: You find opportunities to perform stylish feats in the moments between others' heartbeats and eye blinks. You are permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}. You can use the extra action only to perform a bravado action.

_desc_en: You find opportunities to perform stylish feats in the moments between others' heartbeats and eye blinks. You are permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}. You can use the extra action only to perform a bravado action.
_desc_ko: 당신은 타인의 심장 박동과 눈 깜빡임 사이의 순간들 속에서 세련된 피트를 펼칠 기회를 포착합니다. 당신은 영구적으로 @link[conditions.quickened] 상태입니다. 추가 행동은 오직 브라바도 행동을 수행하는 데만 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Only the Worthy

description.value: You can designate your ikons as movable by only your own hand, leaving them fixed in place as surely as if they were lodged in stone. Whenever you Release an ikon, you can spend an action to command it to remain motionless. While motionless, the ikon can be moved only if 8,000 pounds of pressure are applied to it or if a creature uses Athletics to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} the ikon with a DC equal to your class DC. You can Release your ikon over an adjacent @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} enemy to hold them down with the ikon's motionlessness—while so Released, you can't use the ikon, but the enemy must succeed at the Athletics check to Stand or to move. The ikon automatically flies back to your hand when the effect is broken or if you spend an Interact action to hold out a hand and draw it back.

_desc_en: You can designate your ikons as movable by only your own hand, leaving them fixed in place as surely as if they were lodged in stone. Whenever you Release an ikon, you can spend an action to command it to remain motionless. While motionless, the ikon can be moved only if 8,000 pounds of pressure are applied to it or if a creature uses Athletics to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} the ikon with a DC equal to your class DC. You can Release your ikon over an adjacent @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} enemy to hold them down with the ikon's motionlessness—while so Released, you can't use the ikon, but the enemy must succeed at the Athletics check to Stand or to move. The ikon automatically flies back to your hand when the effect is broken or if you spend an Interact action to hold out a hand and draw it back.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신의 이콘을 오직 자신의 손으로만 이동 가능하도록 지정할 수 있으며, 이를 통해 이콘은 마치 돌에 박힌 것처럼 이동 불가 상태를 유지합니다. 이콘을 해제할 때마다, 행동을 소모하여 이콘이 움직이지 않도록 명령할 수 있습니다. 움직이지 않는 동안, 이콘은 8,000파운드의 압력이 가해지거나 생물이 운동으로 @link[actions.force-open]를 시도하여 DC가 당신의 직업 DC와 같을 때만 이동될 수 있습니다. 인접한 @link[conditions.prone] 적 위에 아이콘을 해제하면 아이콘의 움직임 없음이 적을 제압합니다. 해제된 상태에서는 아이콘을 사용할 수 없지만, 적은 기립하거나 이동하기 위해 운동 판정에 성공해야 합니다. 효과가 해제되거나 상호작용 행동을 사용해 손을 내밀어 아이콘을 되돌리면 아이콘은 자동으로 당신의 손으로 돌아옵니다.

name: Animal Shape

description.value:
You have full control over your shape and can transform into your inherent animal. You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.34E7k2YRcsOU5uyl]{Change Shape} to enter an animal shape.

When you gain this feat, choose either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.NzXpEzcZAjuDTZjK]{Aerial Form}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wp09USMB3GIW1qbp]{Animal Form}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KhM8MhoUgoUjBMIz]{Dinosaur Form}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XI6Lzd2B5pernkPd]{Insect Form}; after you choose a form, you can't change the form.

While in animal shape, you gain the effects of a 5th-rank casting of your chosen form spell, except you always transform into an animal matching your inherent animal and can use your humanoid form's AC if it's higher than what the animal form grants.

If your inherent animal isn't among the animals listed in the form, you default to the statistics and abilities of the bird battle form, cat battle form, deinonychus battle form, or ant battle form for aerial form, animal form, dinosaur form, or insect form respectively (at the GM's discretion, you instead default to a different form that is closest to your inherent animal).

You can remain in animal shape indefinitely and can use Change Shape to return to your humanoid or hybrid shape at any time.

If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.F6C25qZ9UNYPw7pj]{Critter Shape} feat, you can choose to gain the effects of a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gfPjmG6Fe6D3MFjl]{Pest Form}, can remain in critter shape indefinitely, and can return to your critter shape at any time after leaving the shape, just as you can with Animal Shape.

While in animal shape, you gain the effects of a 5th-rank casting of your chosen form spell, except you always transform into an animal matching your inherent animal and can use your humanoid form's AC if it's higher than what the animal form grants.

If your inherent animal isn't among the animals listed in the form, you default to the statistics and abilities of the bird battle form, cat battle form, deinonychus battle form, or ant battle form for aerial form, animal form, dinosaur form, or insect form respectively (at the GM's discretion, you instead default to a different form that is closest to your inherent animal).

You can remain in animal shape indefinitely and can use Change Shape to return to your humanoid or hybrid shape at any time.

If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.F6C25qZ9UNYPw7pj]{Critter Shape} feat, you can choose to gain the effects of a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gfPjmG6Fe6D3MFjl]{Pest Form}, can remain in critter shape indefinitely, and can return to your critter shape at any time after leaving the shape, just as you can with Animal Shape.
_desc_ko:
자신의 형태를 완전히 통제하며 본래의 동물로 변신할 수 있습니다. @link[actions.change-shape]를 사용하여 동물 형태로 들어갈 수 있습니다.

이 피트를 획득할 때 @link[spells.aerial-form], @link[spells.animal-form], @link[spells.dinosaur-form], 또는 @link[spells.insect-form] 중 하나를 선택하십시오; 형태를 선택한 후에는 변경할 수 없습니다.

동물 형태일 때, 선택한 형태 주문의 (5th)랭크 시전 효과를 얻습니다. 단, 항상 본래의 동물에 맞는 동물로 변신하며, 동물 형태가 부여하는 AC보다 높은 경우 인간형 형태의 AC를 사용할 수 있습니다.

본래의 동물이 양식에 기재된 동물에 포함되지 않을 경우, 공중 형태, 동물 형태, 공룡 형태 또는 곤충 형태로 각각 적용됩니다(GM의 재량에 따라 본래 동물에 가장 가까운 다른 형태로 대체 적용될 수 있음).

동물 형태로 무기한 머무를 수 있으며, 언제든지 형태 변화 능력을 사용해 인간형 또는 혼혈 형태로 돌아갈 수 있다.

@link[feats.critter-shape] 피트를 보유한 경우, (4th)랭크 @link[spells.pest-form]의 효과를 선택적으로 획득할 수 있으며, 크리터 형태를 무기한 유지할 수 있고, 동물 형태와 마찬가지로 형태를 벗은 후 언제든지 크리터 형태로 복귀할 수 있습니다.

name: Molten Wit

description.value: Your elemental soul has sparked not just your body but also your mind. You either become trained in Deception and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.B6HbYsLBWb1RR6Fx]{Charming Liar} skill feat, or you become trained in Diplomacy and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KpFetnUqTiweypZk]{Group Impression} skill feat. If you're already trained in one of these skills, you must take the other and can choose from either skill feat. If you're trained in both skills, you become trained in a different skill of your choice instead and can choose from either skill feat.

_desc_en: Your elemental soul has sparked not just your body but also your mind. You either become trained in Deception and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.B6HbYsLBWb1RR6Fx]{Charming Liar} skill feat, or you become trained in Diplomacy and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KpFetnUqTiweypZk]{Group Impression} skill feat. If you're already trained in one of these skills, you must take the other and can choose from either skill feat. If you're trained in both skills, you become trained in a different skill of your choice instead and can choose from either skill feat.
_desc_ko: 당신의 원소 영혼은 육체뿐만 아니라 정신까지도 불태웠습니다. 당신은 기만에 숙련되어 @link[feats.charming-liar] 기술 피트를 얻거나, 외교에 숙련되어 @link[feats.group-impression] 기술 피트를 획득한다. 이미 이 중 하나의 기술에 숙련된 경우, 다른 기술을 반드시 숙련해야 하며 두 기술 피트 중 하나를 선택할 수 있다. 두 기술 모두 숙련된 경우, 대신 선택한 다른 기술에 숙련되며 두 기술 피트 중 하나를 선택할 수 있다.

name: Impossible Flurry

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding two melee weapons, each in a different hand.

You forgo precision to attack at an impossible speed. Make three melee Strikes with each of the required weapons. Your first attack with each weapon takes the multiple attack penalty as though you had already made one attack this turn. All of the remaining Strikes take the maximum multiple attack penalty.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding two melee weapons, each in a different hand.

You forgo precision to attack at an impossible speed. Make three melee Strikes with each of the required weapons. Your first attack with each weapon takes the multiple attack penalty as though you had already made one attack this turn. All of the remaining Strikes take the maximum multiple attack penalty.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손에 각각 다른 근접 무기를 들고 있어야 합니다.

정밀도를 포기하고 불가능한 속도로 공격합니다. 필요한 각 무기로 근접 공격을 세 번 수행합니다. 각 무기의 첫 번째 공격은 이번 턴에 이미 한 번 공격한 것처럼 다중 공격 페널티를 받습니다. 나머지 모든 공격은 최대 다중 공격 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Scroll Esoterica

description.value:
Your esoterica includes scraps of scriptures, magic tomes, druidic markings, and the like, which you can use to create temporary scrolls. Each day during your daily preparations, you can create a single temporary scroll containing a 1st-rank spell of any tradition. The spell must be common, or you must otherwise have access to it. This scroll is an unstable, temporary item and loses its magic the next time you make your daily preparations if you haven't used it by then. It can't be used to Learn the Spell.

At 8th level, add a second temporary scroll containing a 2nd-rank spell.

_desc_en:
Your esoterica includes scraps of scriptures, magic tomes, druidic markings, and the like, which you can use to create temporary scrolls. Each day during your daily preparations, you can create a single temporary scroll containing a 1st-rank spell of any tradition. The spell must be common, or you must otherwise have access to it. This scroll is an unstable, temporary item and loses its magic the next time you make your daily preparations if you haven't used it by then. It can't be used to Learn the Spell.

At 8th level, add a second temporary scroll containing a 2nd-rank spell.
_desc_ko:
당신의 에소테리카에는 경전의 파편, 마법 서적, 드루이드의 표식 등이 포함되어 있으며, 이를 이용해 임시 두루마리를 만들 수 있습니다. 매일 준비 시간 동안, 당신은 신비한 전통의 1랭크 주문 하나를 담은 임시 두루마리 하나를 만들 수 있습니다. 해당 주문은 반드시 일반 주문이어야 하며, 그렇지 않다면 당신이 그 주문을 사용할 수 있는 권한이 있어야 합니다. 이 두루마리는 불안정한 임시 아이템으로, 사용하지 않은 상태에서 다음 일일 준비를 할 때 마법이 사라집니다. 이 두루마리는 @link[actions.learn-a-spell]

에 사용할 수 없습니다.

8레벨에 도달하면 (2nd)랭크 주문을 담은 두 번째 임시 두루마리를 추가한다.

name: Reactive Striker

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KAVf7AmRnbCAHrkT]{Reactive Strike} reaction.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KAVf7AmRnbCAHrkT]{Reactive Strike} reaction.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @link[actions.reactive-strike] 반응을 얻습니다.

name: Devrin's Cunning Stance

description.value:
You've learned Devrin Arlos's guileful ways, and his sly teachings help you remind your allies to keep their wits about them. When you use this action, attempt a @Check[deception|dc:@self.level] check. The DC is usually a standard-difficulty DC of your level, but the GM can assign a different DC based on the circumstances. The effect depends on the result of your check.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.kyrvZfZfzKK1vx9b]{Stance: Devrin's Cunning Stance}

Critical Success Your marshal's aura increases to a @Template[emanation|distance:20], and it grants you and your allies a +1 status bonus to skill checks. When you or an ally in the aura successfully Strike an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} enemy, that enemy can't use reactions until the beginning of its next turn.

Success As critical success, but your aura's size doesn't increase.

Failure You fail to enter the stance.

Critical Failure You fail to enter the stance and can't take this action again for 1 minute.

The effect depends on the result of your check.

When you or an ally in the aura successfully Strike an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} enemy, that enemy can't use reactions until the beginning of its next turn.

Success As critical success, but your aura's size doesn't increase.

Failure You fail to enter the stance.

Critical Failure You fail to enter the stance and can't take this action again for 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
당신은 데브린 알로스의 교활한 방식을 배웠으며, 그의 간교한 가르침은 동맹들이 정신을 차리도록 상기시키는 데 도움이 됩니다. 이 행동을 사용할 때, 기만 판정을 시도하십시오. DC는 일반적으로 당신의 레벨에 해당하는 표준 난이도이지만, GM은 상황에 따라 다른 DC를 지정할 수 있습니다. 효과는 당신의 판정 결과에 따라 달라집니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.kyrvZfZfzKK1vx9b]{자세: 데브린의 재치 있는 자세}

대성공 당신의 마셜 오라가 20피트로 강화되며, 당신과 아군에게 기술 판정 시 +1 상태 보너스를 부여합니다. 당신이나 오라 내 아군이 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태의 적을 공격에 성공하면, 해당 적은 다음 턴 시작 전까지 반응을 사용할 수 없습니다.

성공 대성공과 동일하나, 기운의 범위는 증가하지 않습니다.

실패 자세를 취하는 데 실패합니다.

대실패 자세를 취하는 데 실패했으며, 1분 동안 이 행동을 다시 취할 수 없습니다.

name: Metabolic Control

description.value: You're able to better control your body's metabolism to preserve energy. After eating a proper meal, you can go without food and water for 1 week before taking damage from starvation and thirst. You aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} during this week.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You're able to better control your body's metabolism to preserve energy. After eating a proper meal, you can go without food and water for 1 week before taking damage from starvation and thirst. _desc_ko: 당신은 에너지를 보존하기 위해 신체의 대사 작용을 더 잘 제어할 수 있습니다. 적절한 식사를 한 후에는 굶주림과 갈증으로 인한 피해를 입기 전까지 1주일 동안 음식과 물을 섭취하지 않고 버틸 수 있습니다. 이 기간 동안 당신은 @link[conditions.fatigued]가 되지 않습니다.

name: Rule of Three

description.value:
Requirements You have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.hPZQ5vA9QHEPtjFW]{Spun a Tale}.

Trigger The villain of the tale you've spun makes an attack roll with a given weapon or unarmed attack, uses a particular special ability (such as a Breath Weapon), or Casts a Spell against the hero, and they used that same attack, special ability, or spell against the hero on the previous turn.

Heroes learn from their previous failures, often succeeding on the third attempt. You narrate a tale of the hero's success, granting them a +2 circumstance bonus to their AC or saving throw against the triggering effect. If the villain has used the same effect against the hero on both of their last two turns, and you used Rule of Three on that effect last turn as well, the bonus increases to +4.

publication.title: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind

_desc_en:
Requirements You have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.hPZQ5vA9QHEPtjFW]{Spun a Tale}.

Trigger The villain of the tale you've spun makes an attack roll with a given weapon or unarmed attack, uses a particular special ability (such as a Breath Weapon), or Casts a Spell against the hero, and they used that same attack, special ability, or spell against the hero on the previous turn.

Heroes learn from their previous failures, often succeeding on the third attempt. You narrate a tale of the hero's success, granting them a +2 circumstance bonus to their AC or saving throw against the triggering effect. If the villain has used the same effect against the hero on both of their last two turns, and you used Rule of Three on that effect last turn as well, the bonus increases to +4.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 @link[actions.spin-tale].

Trigger 당신이 꾸며낸 이야기의 악당이 특정 무기나 비무장 공격으로 명중 굴림을 하거나, 특정 특수 능력(예: 숨결 무기)을 사용하거나, 영웅에게 마법을 시전할 때, 그 악당이 바로 전 턴에도 동일한 공격, 특수 능력 또는 마법을 영웅에게 사용한 경우.

영웅은 이전 실패에서 교훈을 얻어 종종 세 번째 시도에서 성공한다. 당신은 영웅의 성공 이야기를 서술하며, 해당 효과에 대한 영웅의 AC 또는 내성 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 부여한다. 악당이 지난 두 차례 턴 모두 동일한 효과를 영웅에게 사용했고, 지난 턴에도 그 효과에 대해 '세 번의 법칙'을 적용했다면 보너스는 +4로 증가한다.

name: Eye of the Arclords

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Access You are a member of the Arclords of Nex.

You open an incandescent third eye upon your forehead.

The eye can remain open for 1 minute, and you can close it before then with a single action with the concentrate trait. It can remain open for 2 minutes if you're a master in Arcana, or 5 minutes if you're legendary.

While the eye is open, you gain the following benefits:

  • you gain the effects of the detect magic arcane innate spell from your Arcane Sense at the start of each of your turns without needing to cast the spell;
  • you gain darkvision;
  • you gain a +2 status bonus to Perception checks to Seek undetected and hidden creatures and to your Perception DC against Hide and Sneak.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.5IGz4iheaiUWm5KR]{Effect: Eye of the Arclords}

After your third eye closes, you are dazzled for an amount of time equal to how long you had it open.

_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

사용 조건 당신은 넥스의 아크로드 일원입니다.

당신은 이마에 백열하는 제삼의 눈을 엽니다.

이 눈은 1분 동안 열려 있을 수 있으며, 집중 특성을 가진 액션 하나로 그 전에 닫을 수 있습니다. 주문학에 달인인 경우 2분, 전설적인 경우 5분 동안 열려 있을 수 있습니다.

눈이 열린 동안 다음과 같은 이점을 얻습니다:

  • 당신은 자신의 차례가 시작될 때마다 마법 감지 아케인 본능 주문의 효과를 얻으며, 해당 주문을 시전할 필요가 없습니다;
  • 암흑 시야를 얻습니다;
  • 감지되지 않은 은신 생물을 찾는 지각 판정 및 {숨기}와 {은밀 이동}에 대한 지각 DC에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.5IGz4iheaiUWm5KR]{효과: 아크로드의 눈}

세 번째 눈이 감긴 후, 그 눈을 뜬 시간과 동일한 시간 동안 눈부심 상태가 됩니다.

name: Brastlewark Snare Engineering

description.value: You've trained with the Brastlewark gnomes or studied their teachings, and learned the art of crafting their more magical snares. You learn the formulas for crafting the pit illusion snare and the shadow cloak snare or two uncommon magical snares of your level or lower that you have access to. When you set a magical snare, the DC of any saving throw it requires uses your spell DC if that's higher. When you craft a non-magical snare, you can choose to give it the magical trait. When you do so and the snare is one that normally deals damage, it deals an additional amount of force damage equal to its level.

_desc_en: You've trained with the Brastlewark gnomes or studied their teachings, and learned the art of crafting their more magical snares. You learn the formulas for crafting the pit illusion snare and the shadow cloak snare or two uncommon magical snares of your level or lower that you have access to. When you set a magical snare, the DC of any saving throw it requires uses your spell DC if that's higher. When you craft a non-magical snare, you can choose to give it the magical trait. When you do so and the snare is one that normally deals damage, it deals an additional amount of force damage equal to its level.
_desc_ko: 당신은 브래슬워크 노움들과 함께 수련했거나 그들의 가르침을 연구하여, 보다 마법적인 함정을 제작하는 기술을 익혔습니다. 당신은 함정 착시 함정과 그림자 망토 함정을 제작하는 공식을 배우거나, 당신이 접근할 수 있는 당신 레벨 이하의 비일상 마법 함정 두 종의 공식을 배웁니다. 당신이 마법 함정을 설치할 때, 그 함정이 요구하는 모든 내성 굴림의 DC는 당신의 주문 DC가 더 높다면 그것을 사용합니다. 당신이 비마법 함정을 제작할 때, 그것에 마법 특성을 부여하도록 선택할 수 있습니다. 그렇게 할 때 해당 함정이 보통 피해를 주는 종류라면, 그 레벨과 동일한 추가 힘 피해를 줍니다.

name: Ocean Wariness

description.value: Stories about those who have mistreated your people in the past (particularly stories about alghollthu mind control) left you untrusting of those outside your community. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your defenses against Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, and Performance checks.

_desc_en: Stories about those who have mistreated your people in the past (particularly stories about alghollthu mind control) left you untrusting of those outside your community. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your defenses against Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, and Performance checks.
_desc_ko: 과거에 당신의 종족을 학대한 자들에 관한 이야기들(특히 알골투 정신 조종에 관한 이야기들)은 당신으로 하여금 공동체 외부인들을 믿지 못하게 만들었습니다. 당신은 기만, 외교, 협박, 공연 기술 판정으로부터의 방어에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Metal-veined Strikes

description.value: Metallic veins grow throughout your body, giving your unarmed attacks a metallic sheen. Choose either cold iron or silver. Your unarmed attacks are treated as the chosen type of metal.

_desc_en: Metallic veins grow throughout your body, giving your unarmed attacks a metallic sheen. Choose either cold iron or silver. Your unarmed attacks are treated as the chosen type of metal.
_desc_ko: 금속 정맥이 몸 전체에 퍼져 비무장 공격에 금속 광택을 부여합니다. 냉철 또는 은 중 하나를 선택하세요. 비무장 공격은 선택한 금속 유형으로 간주됩니다.

name: One with the Spirits

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements You're under the effects of Enter Spirit Trance.

The spirits you've invoked throughout your life have left behind echoes and spiritual fragments, which you can manifest across your own flesh, temporarily transforming you into something more akin to spirit than mortal. For 1 minute, you gain fast healing 5 and you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}. You can't use this concealment to Hide. Your Strikes gain the benefits of a ghost touch property rune. Whenever you deal damage with a Strike, you can choose to have that Strike deal spirit damage, rather than its usual damage type.

If you would be knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} or your dying value would increase while One with the Spirits is active, the spirits revive you at the beginning of your next turn, restoring you to 30 Hit Points. One with the Spirits then immediately ends.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements You're under the effects of Enter Spirit Trance.

The spirits you've invoked throughout your life have left behind echoes and spiritual fragments, which you can manifest across your own flesh, temporarily transforming you into something more akin to spirit than mortal. For 1 minute, you gain fast healing 5 and you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}. You can't use this concealment to Hide. Your Strikes gain the benefits of a ghost touch property rune. Whenever you deal damage with a Strike, you can choose to have that Strike deal spirit damage, rather than its usual damage type.

If you would be knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} or your dying value would increase while One with the Spirits is active, the spirits revive you at the beginning of your next turn, restoring you to 30 Hit Points. One with the Spirits then immediately ends.
_desc_ko:
빈도 시간당 한 번

요구 사항 당신은 '영혼의 황홀경' 효과에 걸려 있습니다.

평생 불러낸 영혼들이 남긴 메아리와 영혼의 파편을 당신의 육체에 창조하여, 일시적으로 인간보다 영혼에 가까운 존재로 변모시킵니다. 1분 동안 빠른 치유 5를 얻으며 {가려진} 상태가 됩니다. 이 은폐는 {숨기기에} 사용할 수 없습니다. 당신의 공격은 고스트 터치 속성 룬의 효과를 얻습니다. 공격으로 피해를 입힐 때마다, 해당 공격이 일반 피해 유형 대신 영혼 피해를 입히도록 선택할 수 있습니다.

영혼과 하나됨이 활성화된 상태에서 기절 상태가 되거나 사망 수치가 증가할 경우, 영혼들이 다음 턴 시작 시 당신을 소생시켜 HP를 30으로 회복시킵니다. 이후 영혼과 하나됨은 즉시 종료됩니다.

name: Aeon Resonance

description.value:
You gain the resonant power of one embedded aeon stone as if it were placed in a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.gbwr57aT9ou8yKWT]{Wayfinder}. While you can embed multiple aeon stones in your flesh, you can gain the resonance power from only one embedded stone at a time, selected each day when you make your daily preparations.

Special At 8th level, you can take this feat again. If you do, you gain the resonance powers of up to four invested aeon stones instead of only one.

PFS Note: This feat acts as if an aeon stone was embedded in a wayfinder, and thus would not allow a second aeon stone to provide its resonance power from being embedded in a wayfinder.

_desc_en:
You gain the resonant power of one embedded aeon stone as if it were placed in a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.gbwr57aT9ou8yKWT]{Wayfinder}. While you can embed multiple aeon stones in your flesh, you can gain the resonance power from only one embedded stone at a time, selected each day when you make your daily preparations.

Special At 8th level, you can take this feat again. If you do, you gain the resonance powers of up to four invested aeon stones instead of only one.

PFS Note: This feat acts as if an aeon stone was embedded in a wayfinder, and thus would not allow a second aeon stone to provide its resonance power from being embedded in a wayfinder.
_desc_ko:
당신은 하나의 에온 스톤이 @link[equipment.wayfinder]에 장착된 것처럼 그 공명력을 얻습니다. 여러 에온 스톤을 육체에 내장할 수 있지만, 매일 준비를 할 때 선택한 하나의 내장된 에온 스톤으로부터만 공명력을 얻을 수 있습니다.

특수 (8th) 레벨에 도달하면 이 피트를 다시 선택할 수 있다. 그렇게 할 경우, 하나의 에온 스톤 대신 최대 네 개의 에온 스톤이 부여하는 공명력을 획득한다.

PFS 참고: 이 피트는 에온 스톤이 웨이파인더에 박혀 있는 것처럼 작용하므로, 두 번째 에온 스톤이 웨이파인더에 박혀 공명 능력을 제공할 수 없게 합니다.

name: Determined Lore Seeker

description.value: You've mastered useful spells that let you find hidden truths others might miss, and a preferred spell comes naturally to you. When you gain this feat, choose one of the innate spells granted by the Lore Seeker feat: comprehend language, restore senses, or see invisibility. You can cast this spell three times per day instead of once per day. When you cast any of the spells granted by Lore Seeker as innate spells, they gain additional effects. When you cast comprehend language, the spell is heightened to 4th level. When you cast restore senses,the spell is heightened to half your level, rounded up. When you cast see invisibility, for the duration of the spell you can use an action, which has the concentrate trait, to see invisible creatures normally (instead of seeing them as translucent shapes that are concealed to you) until the end of your next turn.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en: You've mastered useful spells that let you find hidden truths others might miss, and a preferred spell comes naturally to you. When you gain this feat, choose one of the innate spells granted by the Lore Seeker feat: comprehend language, restore senses, or see invisibility. You can cast this spell three times per day instead of once per day. When you cast any of the spells granted by Lore Seeker as innate spells, they gain additional effects. When you cast comprehend language, the spell is heightened to 4th level. When you cast restore senses,the spell is heightened to half your level, rounded up. When you cast see invisibility, for the duration of the spell you can use an action, which has the concentrate trait, to see invisible creatures normally (instead of seeing them as translucent shapes that are concealed to you) until the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko: 당신은 다른 이들이 놓칠 수 있는 숨겨진 진실을 찾아내는 유용한 주문들을 마스터했으며, 선호하는 주문 하나가 자연스럽게 사용됩니다. 이 피트를 획득할 때, 지식 탐구자 재주로 부여되는 선천적 주문 중 하나를 선택하세요: 언어 이해, 감각 회복, 투시. 이 주문을 하루에 한 번이 아닌 세 번 시전할 수 있습니다. 지식 탐구자가 부여한 주문을 선천적 주문으로 시전할 때, 해당 주문은 추가 효과를 얻습니다. 언어 이해를 시전할 때, 주문은 (4th)레벨로 강화됩니다. 감각 회복을 시전할 때, 주문은 자신의 레벨 절반(반올림)으로 강화됩니다. 투시 마법을 시전할 경우, 마법 지속 시간 동안 집중 특성이 있는 행동을 사용하여 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 투명 생물을 정상적으로 볼 수 있다(투명 생물이 반투명 형태로 은폐 상태로 보이는 대신).

name: Furious Vengeance

description.value:
Trigger An enemy within your melee reach critically hits you with a melee Strike.

Your enemy's blow fuels your rage and provokes your immediate retaliation. Make a melee Strike against the triggering enemy.

_desc_en:
Trigger An enemy within your melee reach critically hits you with a melee Strike.

Your enemy's blow fuels your rage and provokes your immediate retaliation. Make a melee Strike against the triggering enemy.
_desc_ko:
Trigger 근접 공격 범위 내의 적이 근접 공격으로 치명타를 입힙니다.

적의 공격이 분노를 자극하여 즉각적인 보복을 유발합니다. 발동한 적을 상대로 근접 공격을 수행하십시오.

name: Ghostly Grasp

description.value: Your control over your ghostly form grows. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.ancestryfeatures.Item.YGk41WV42aTM7CQV]{Advanced Undead Benefits} and can interact with physical objects, with limits. You can attempt Strength-based skill checks against physical creatures and objects. You can Interact with physical objects, but the action has no effect unless you succeed at a @Check[athletics|dc:20] or @Check[thievery|dc:20] check.

_desc_en: Your control over your ghostly form grows. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.ancestryfeatures.Item.YGk41WV42aTM7CQV]{Advanced Undead Benefits} and can interact with physical objects, with limits. You can attempt Strength-based skill checks against physical creatures and objects. You can Interact with physical objects, but the action has no effect unless you succeed at a @Check[athletics|dc:20] or @Check[thievery|dc:20] check.
_desc_ko: 유령 형태에 대한 통제력이 강화됩니다. @link[feats.advanced-undead-benefits]을 획득하며, 제한적으로 물리적 물체와 상호작용할 수 있습니다. 물리적 생물체나 물체에 대해 근력 기반 기술 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다. 물리적 물체와 상호작용할 수 있으나, DC 20 운동 또는 DC 20 도둑질 판정에서 성공하지 않으면 해당 행동은 효과를 발휘하지 않습니다.

name: Keep Pace

description.value:
Trigger Your prey is within reach and attempts to move away from you.

Bounty Hunter Once you are upon your prey, they can't escape.

Game Hunter When your hunted prey tries to bolt, you follow.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Bcxarzksqt9ezrs6]{Stride} up to your Speed, following the foe and keeping it in reach throughout its movement until it stops moving or you've moved your full Speed. You can use Keep Pace to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.H6v1VgowHaKHnVlG]{Burrow}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cS9nfDRGD83bNU1p]{Fly}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c8TGiZ48ygoSPofx]{Swim} instead of Stride if you have the corresponding movement type.

value.value: Bounty Hunter Dedication or Game Hunter Dedication

_desc_en:
Trigger Your prey is within reach and attempts to move away from you.

Bounty Hunter Once you are upon your prey, they can't escape.

Game Hunter When your hunted prey tries to bolt, you follow.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Bcxarzksqt9ezrs6]{Stride} up to your Speed, following the foe and keeping it in reach throughout its movement until it stops moving or you've moved your full Speed. You can use Keep Pace to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.H6v1VgowHaKHnVlG]{Burrow}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cS9nfDRGD83bNU1p]{Fly}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c8TGiZ48ygoSPofx]{Swim} instead of Stride if you have the corresponding movement type.
_desc_ko:
발동 사냥감이 손이 닿는 거리에 있으며 당신에게서 벗어나려 시도합니다.

현상금 사냥꾼 - 일단 먹잇감에게 다가가면, 그들은 도망칠 수 없습니다.

게임 헌터 - 사냥감이 도망치려 하면, 당신은 쫓아간다.

@link[actions.stride] 속도만큼 이동하며, 적을 따라가 그 이동이 멈추거나 자신의 전체 속도를 다 이동할 때까지 계속해서 접근 거리를 유지한다. 해당 이동 유형을 보유한 경우, @link[actions.burrow], @link[actions.climb], @link[actions.fly], 또는 @link[actions.swim] 대신 속도 유지로 대체할 수 있습니다.

name: Quick Climb

description.value: When Climbing, you move 5 more feet on a success and 10 more feet on a critical success, up to your Speed. If you're legendary in Athletics, you gain a climb Speed equal to your Speed.

_desc_en: When Climbing, you move 5 more feet on a success and 10 more feet on a critical success, up to your Speed. If you're legendary in Athletics, you gain a climb Speed equal to your Speed.
_desc_ko: 등반 시 성공 시 5피트, 대성공 시 10피트 추가 이동합니다(이동 속도 범위 내). 운동에 전설적 숙련도를 보유한 경우, 등반 속도가 이동 속도와 동일해집니다.

name: Herald's Strike

description.value:
The power of your blows can send your victim hurling through your deity's realm for a fragment of a second. You activate Herald's Weapon, ignoring the frequency, and make a Strike with your transformed weapon or unarmed attack against a creature. If you hit and deal damage, the target must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. If your Strike was a critical hit, the creature uses the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of their saving throw. Regardless of the result, the target becomes immune to Herald's Strike for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[3d10[spirit]] damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The target takes @Damage[6d10[spirit]] damage and becomes dazzled for 1 round and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Critical Failure The target takes @Damage[12d10[spirit]] damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}.
