You can't move the creature into or through obstacles.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 10분마다 1회

요구 사항 당신의 무리가 소환됩니다.

당신의 무리는 비틀거리며 전진할 때 원치 않는 희생자들을 끌고 갈 수 있습니다. 당신의 무리는 이동 속도만큼 전진하며 대형 이하 크기의 생물들이 있는 공간을 통과할 수 있으나, 반드시 비어 있는 공간에서 이동을 종료해야 합니다. 무리가 통과하는 각 생물은 무리의 @link[actions.mobbing-assault]에 노출되며, 평소와 같이 기본 반사 내성 굴림을 시도합니다. 내성 굴림에 실패한 생물은 또한 @link[actions.reposition]되어 무리가 최종적으로 위치한 칸에 인접한 빈 칸 중 당신이 선택한 곳으로 이동됩니다. 당신은 그 생물을 장애물 안으로 또는 장애물을 통과하여 이동시킬 수 없습니다.

name: Cornered Animal

description.value:
Requirements You are in animal or hybrid form and are flanked.

You become more dangerous when surrounded by enemies. You make unarmed Strikes against two different creatures flanking you. The attacks take a –2 penalty if the unarmed weapon is not agile. Both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after you've made both of them.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are in animal or hybrid form and are flanked.

You become more dangerous when surrounded by enemies. You make unarmed Strikes against two different creatures flanking you. The attacks take a –2 penalty if the unarmed weapon is not agile. Both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after you've made both of them.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 동물 형태 또는 혼합 형태이며 측면 공격을 받고 있어야 합니다.

적에게 포위당하면 더 위험해집니다. 양측에서 포위하는 두 개의 서로 다른 생물에게 비무장 공격을 가합니다. 무기 없이 공격하는 무기가 기민하지 않은 경우 공격에 -2 페널티가 적용됩니다. 두 공격 모두 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되지만, 페널티는 두 공격을 모두 수행한 후에야 증가합니다.

name: Malleable Mental Forge

description.value: You open your mind to further weapon customization. During your daily preparations, you can choose any two weapon traits from the Mental Forge feat to place on your weapon for 24 hours or until your next daily preparations (whichever comes first), replacing the traits you chose from the Mental Forge feat. Each day you can swap the choices with any other options on the list.

_desc_en: You open your mind to further weapon customization. During your daily preparations, you can choose any two weapon traits from the Mental Forge feat to place on your weapon for 24 hours or until your next daily preparations (whichever comes first), replacing the traits you chose from the Mental Forge feat. Each day you can swap the choices with any other options on the list.
_desc_ko: 무기 맞춤 설정을 위해 정신을 개방한다. 일일 준비 시간 동안 정신 단조 피트의 무기 특성 중 두 가지를 선택하여 24시간 동안 또는 다음 일일 준비 시간까지(둘 중 먼저 도래하는 시점까지) 무기에 적용할 수 있다. 이때 정신 단조 피트에서 선택했던 특성을 대체한다. 매일 목록의 다른 옵션으로 선택을 교체할 수 있다.

name: Transposable Compliance

description.value: Your protean vitality is fecund and many-succoring: your veins run with life-giving ichor that adapts to the blood and physiology of any body, and your skin molts on command, creating wound-stanching sheaths of tissue for yourself and others. You become trained in Medicine. If you were already trained in Medicine, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You can Administer First Aid without healer's tools by using your physiology instead, but you must take 1 damage to make the attempt. Similarly, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} without healer's tools but take [[/r 2d8 #damage]]{2d8 damage}. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on all Medicine checks to Administer First Aid and Treat Wounds using your own physiology.

_desc_en: Your protean vitality is fecund and many-succoring: your veins run with life-giving ichor that adapts to the blood and physiology of any body, and your skin molts on command, creating wound-stanching sheaths of tissue for yourself and others. You become trained in Medicine. If you were already trained in Medicine, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You can Administer First Aid without healer's tools by using your physiology instead, but you must take 1 damage to make the attempt. Similarly, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} without healer's tools but take [[/r 2d8 #damage]]{2d8 damage}. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on all Medicine checks to Administer First Aid and Treat Wounds using your own physiology.
_desc_ko: 당신의 다형적 활력은 풍요롭고 다방면으로 도움을 줍니다: 당신의 혈관에는 생명을 주는 이코르가 흐르며, 이는 어떤 몸의 혈액과 생리에도 적응합니다. 또한 당신의 피부는 명령에 따라 탈피하여 자신과 타인을 위한 상처를 막아주는 조직의 보호막을 생성합니다. 의술 숙련을 획득합니다. 이미 의술 숙련을 가진 경우, 대신 선택한 기술 숙련을 획득합니다. 치유자의 도구 없이 생리학적 능력으로 응급처치를 시행할 수 있으나, 시도하다 1의 피해를 입습니다. 마찬가지로, 치료 도구 없이 @link[actions.treat-wounds]를 수행할 수 있으나 2d8 피해를 받는다. 자신의 생리학적 특성을 이용해 응급처치와 상처 치료를 수행하는 모든 의학 판정에서 +1 상황 보너스를 얻는다.

name: Venomous Weapons

description.value: Your skill with poisons is such that your preferred weapons also contain trace amounts of it, even when you don't actively apply a dose. Blowguns and slings you are wielding have the venomous trait.

_desc_en: Your skill with poisons is such that your preferred weapons also contain trace amounts of it, even when you don't actively apply a dose. Blowguns and slings you are wielding have the venomous trait.
_desc_ko: 당신의 독 사용 기술은 매우 뛰어나서, 적극적으로 독을 발라 넣지 않아도 선호하는 무기에는 미량의 독이 묻어 있습니다. 당신이 휘두르는 블로우건과 슬링은 맹독 특성을 지닙니다.

name: Inner Fire (Monk)

description.value: While you're in Stoked Flame Stance, you have cold and fire resistance equal to half your level, and any creature that hits you with an unarmed attack, tries to Grab or Grapple you, or otherwise touches you takes @Damage[@actor.abilities.wis.mod[fire]]{fire damage} equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). A creature can take this damage no more than once per turn.

_desc_en: While you're in Stoked Flame Stance, you have cold and fire resistance equal to half your level, and any creature that hits you with an unarmed attack, tries to Grab or Grapple you, or otherwise touches you takes @Damage[@actor.abilities.wis.mod[fire]]{fire damage} equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). A creature can take this damage no more than once per turn.
_desc_ko: 불꽃 활력 자세 상태에서는 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 냉기 및 화염 저항력을 가지며, 비무장 공격이나, 붙잡기/잡기 시도를 하거나, 신체 접촉을 시도하는 모든 생물은 화염 피해를 입습니다. 이 피해는 지혜 능력치 수정자만큼 증가합니다 (최소 1). 한 턴에 한 번만 이 피해를 입을 수 있다.

name: Legs of Stone

description.value: You gain a +2 status bonus to your Fortitude and Reflex DCs against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} you. You can Shove creatures even if you don't have a hand free. When you successfully Shove a foe, you can Stride away from your opponent (instead of toward it), but you must move the same distance in the opposite direction from where you Shoved it.

_desc_en: You gain a +2 status bonus to your Fortitude and Reflex DCs against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} you. You can Shove creatures even if you don't have a hand free. When you successfully Shove a foe, you can Stride away from your opponent (instead of toward it), but you must move the same distance in the opposite direction from where you Shoved it.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신을 @link[actions.shove]하거나 @link[actions.trip]하려는 시도에 대해 인내 및 반사 DC에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 손이 자유롭지 않아도 생물을 밀어낼 수 있습니다. 적을 성공적으로 밀어낸 경우, 상대방 쪽이 아닌 반대 방향으로 일반 이동으로 이동할 수 있지만, 밀어낸 거리만큼 반대 방향으로 이동해야 합니다.

name: Predict Weather

description.value:
By observing often subtle indicators in the environment, you may try to predict the day's weather. Spend 10 minutes outdoors then attempt a @Check[survival|dc:20] check. (This check is reduced to @Check[survival|dc:15] if you have a commanding view of the region, but increases to @Check[survival|dc:30] if conditions are poor, such as attempting to predict weather with impaired visibility). Once you make an attempt to Predict the Weather, you cannot attempt to do so again for 24 hours.

Critical Success You accurately predict the day's precipitation, temperature, and wind. You learn if a weather event will occur in the region within the next 24 hours, and if so, what the event is and approximately when it will occur. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Survival checks made to prepare for this weather event.

Success You accurately predict the day's precipitation, temperature, and wind. You learn if a weather event will occur in the region during the next 24 hours, but not what that event will be or when it will take place. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Survival checks made to prepare for this weather event.

Critical Failure You come to a dramatically wrong conclusion. The GM provides information to you as though you had received a critical success, including the specifics of a weather event that will not occur that day (instead, a different event-or no event-may occur).

_desc_en:
By observing often subtle indicators in the environment, you may try to predict the day's weather. Spend 10 minutes outdoors then attempt a @Check[survival|dc:20] check. (This check is reduced to @Check[survival|dc:15] if you have a commanding view of the region, but increases to @Check[survival|dc:30] if conditions are poor, such as attempting to predict weather with impaired visibility). Once you make an attempt to Predict the Weather, you cannot attempt to do so again for 24 hours.

Critical Success You accurately predict the day's precipitation, temperature, and wind. You learn if a weather event will occur in the region within the next 24 hours, and if so, what the event is and approximately when it will occur. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Survival checks made to prepare for this weather event.

Success You accurately predict the day's precipitation, temperature, and wind. You learn if a weather event will occur in the region during the next 24 hours, but not what that event will be or when it will take place. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Survival checks made to prepare for this weather event.

Critical Failure You come to a dramatically wrong conclusion. The GM provides information to you as though you had received a critical success, including the specifics of a weather event that will not occur that day (instead, a different event-or no event-may occur).
_desc_ko:
환경 속의 미묘한 징후들을 관찰함으로써 당일의 날씨를 예측해 볼 수 있습니다. 야외에서 10분을 보낸 후 DC 20 생존 판정을 시도하십시오. 해당 지역을 한눈에 조망할 수 있다면 이 판정은 DC 15 생존로 감소하지만, 시야가 불량한 등 조건이 나쁠 경우(예: 시야가 제한된 상태에서 날씨 예측 시도하다)에는 DC 30 생존로 증가합니다). 날씨 예측 시도를 한 후에는 24시간 동안 다시 시도하다 할 수 없습니다.

대성공 당일 강수량, 기온, 바람을 정확히 예측합니다. 향후 24시간 내 해당 지역에 기상 현상이 발생할지 여부와 발생 시 그 종류 및 대략적인 발생 시점을 파악합니다. 이 기상 현상에 대비하기 위한 생존 판정 시 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

성공당일 강수량, 기온, 풍속을 정확히 예측합니다. 향후 24시간 내 해당 지역에서 기상 현상이 발생할지 여부를 알게 되지만, 그 현상이 무엇인지 또는 언제 발생할지는 알 수 없습니다. 이 기상 현상에 대비하기 위한 생존 판정 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

대실패 극단적으로 잘못된 결론에 도달합니다. GM은 대성공을 얻은 것처럼 정보를 제공하며, 당일 발생하지 않을 기상 현상의 세부 사항까지 포함합니다(대신 다른 현상이나 아무 현상도 발생하지 않을 수 있음).

name: Ceaseless Shadows

description.value: You excel at going unnoticed, especially among a crowd. You no longer need to have cover or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}. If you would have lesser cover from a creature, you gain standard cover instead and can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover}; if you would have standard cover from a creature, you gain greater cover instead.

_desc_en: You excel at going unnoticed, especially among a crowd. You no longer need to have cover or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}. If you would have lesser cover from a creature, you gain standard cover instead and can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover}; if you would have standard cover from a creature, you gain greater cover instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 특히 군중 속에서 눈에 띄지 않는 데 탁월합니다. 이제 은폐물이나 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태가 아니어도 @link[actions.hide]하거나 @link[actions.sneak]할 필요가 없습니다. 생물로부터 반엄폐를 얻었을 경우, 대신 엄폐를 얻고 @link[actions.take-cover]를 할 수 있습니다. 생물로부터 엄폐를 얻었을 경우, 대신 완전 엄폐를 얻습니다.

name: Big Debut

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You're about to roll initiative.

Now's your chance! You're a Firebrand, and the world must know it. You strike a dramatic pose, deliver a snappy quip, or reveal a shocking new costume, captivating everyone who can see you. You don't roll initiative. Instead, you voluntarily go last. Enemies who can see you must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. On a failure, the enemy is overcome with anticipation for what you'll do next on the battlefield and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2} on a critical failure). As your first action on your first turn, you can Interact to draw or stow an item of light Bulk as a free action; if this item is a small garment or accessory, such as a fan, a pair of gloves, or a wine glass, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus on Charisma-based skill checks until the end of your turn.

Trigger You're about to roll initiative.

Now's your chance! You're a Firebrand, and the world must know it. You strike a dramatic pose, deliver a snappy quip, or reveal a shocking new costume, captivating everyone who can see you. _desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 이니셔티브 주사위를 굴리려는 순간.

지금이 기회다! 당신은 불꽃의 전사이며, 세상이 이를 알아야 합니다. 극적인 포즈를 취하거나, 재치 있는 말을 던지거나, 충격적인 새 복장을 드러내며 당신을 볼 수 있는 모든 이를 사로잡습니다. 당신은 이니셔티브를 굴리지 않습니다. 대신 자발적으로 마지막에 행동합니다. 당신을 볼 수 있는 적들은 당신의 직업 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 더 높은 쪽에 대해 의지 내성 굴림을 시도해야 합니다. 실패 시, 적은 전장에서 네가 다음에 무엇을 할지 기대감에 사로잡혀 @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태가 된다(대실패 시 @link[conditions.stunned]{2} 상태). 첫 턴의 첫 행동으로, 가벼운 벌크의 아이템을 꺼내거나 넣는 상호작용을 무료 행동으로 수행할 수 있습니다. 해당 아이템이 부채, 장갑 한 켤레, 와인 잔과 같은 소형 의복이나 액세서리인 경우, 턴 종료 시까지 매력 기반 기술 판정에서 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.G7tYqJYFX8YBnF3r]{효과: 화려한 데뷔}

name: Terrain Ghost

description.value: You move through your territory like a living shadow. Within your favored location, you're permanently under the effect of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zlnXpME1T2uvn8Lr]{Vanishing Tracks}, and you're always @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from all foes unless you choose not to be.

_desc_en: You move through your territory like a living shadow. Within your favored location, you're permanently under the effect of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zlnXpME1T2uvn8Lr]{Vanishing Tracks}, and you're always @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from all foes unless you choose not to be.
_desc_ko: 당신은 살아있는 그림자처럼 자신의 영역을 움직입니다. 선호하는 위치에서는 영구적으로 @link[spells.vanishing-tracks]의 효과를 받으며, 당신이 원하지 않는 한 항상 모든 적에게 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태이다.

name: Aldori's Retort

description.value: You can flow through combat reactions with graceful ease. At the start of each of your turns, you gain an additional reaction that you can use only for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.8RppI1i4LfI0CYsX]{Aldori Riposte}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.F3ZBkDEWZ24NOR2j]{Saving Slash}, or any dueling action.

_desc_en: You can flow through combat reactions with graceful ease. At the start of each of your turns, you gain an additional reaction that you can use only for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.8RppI1i4LfI0CYsX]{Aldori Riposte}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.F3ZBkDEWZ24NOR2j]{Saving Slash}, or any dueling action.
_desc_ko: 당신은 우아한 여유로 전투 반응을 흘러넘길 수 있습니다. 각 턴 시작 시, @link[feats.aldori-riposte], @link[feats.saving-slash], 또는 모든 결투 행동에만 사용할 수 있는 추가 반응을 얻습니다.

name: Divine Emissary

description.value:
Your familiar is a divine emissary, sent to you by your deity or patron and infused with celestial powers. You can select one additional familiar ability each day, which must be one of the following divine emissary familiar abilities. You can't select more than one divine emissary familiar ability at a time.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.cy7bdQqVANipyljS]{Erudite}

_desc_ko:
당신의 패밀리어는 신성한 사자로, 당신의 신이나 후원자가 보낸 존재로 천상체의 힘이 깃들어 있습니다. 매일 추가로 하나의 패밀리어 능력을 선택할 수 있으며, 이는 다음 신성한 사자 패밀리어 능력 중 하나여야 합니다. 한 번에 두 개 이상의 신성한 사자 패밀리어 능력을 선택할 수 없습니다.

name: Constant Levitation

description.value: Your power has unbound you from the earth below. You're affected by a constant @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.A2JfEKe6BZcTG1S8]{Fly} spell, and when your Psyche is Unleashed, you gain a +10-foot status bonus to your fly Speed.

_desc_en: Your power has unbound you from the earth below. You're affected by a constant @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.A2JfEKe6BZcTG1S8]{Fly} spell, and when your Psyche is Unleashed, you gain a +10-foot status bonus to your fly Speed.
_desc_ko: 당신의 힘은 당신을 아래 땅으로부터 해방시켰습니다. 당신은 지속적인 @link[spells.fly] 마법의 영향을 받으며, 정신이 해방되었을 때 비행 속도에 +10피트 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Impeccable Crafting

description.value: You craft flawless creations with great efficiency. Whenever you roll a success at a Crafting check to make an item of the type you chose with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.QLeMH5mQgh28sa5o]{Specialty Crafting}, you get a critical success instead.

rules.text: Whenever you roll a success at a Crafting check to make an item of the type you chose with Specialty Crafting, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_ko: 당신은 매우 효율적으로 흠잡을 데 없는 작품을 제작합니다. @link[feats.specialty-crafting]으로 선택한 유형의 아이템을 제작하기 위한 제작 판정에서 성공을 굴릴 때마다, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Deathly Secrets

description.value:
No means of creating or ruling the undead is beyond your grasp, even those of magical traditions not your own. You learn either the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.DLFupJuCfzyLCQcO]{Eyes of the Dead} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Cd6Crl4wpQaMSYrF]{Subjugate Undead} focus spell. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can Refocus by meditating over the earthly remains of a dead sentient creature. Focus spells granted by the reanimator archetype are from the same tradition as those used to meet the archetype's prerequisite.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time, you learn a different spell and your focus pool increases by 1 Focus Point.

_desc_en:
No means of creating or ruling the undead is beyond your grasp, even those of magical traditions not your own. You learn either the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.DLFupJuCfzyLCQcO]{Eyes of the Dead} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Cd6Crl4wpQaMSYrF]{Subjugate Undead} focus spell. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can Refocus by meditating over the earthly remains of a dead sentient creature. Focus spells granted by the reanimator archetype are from the same tradition as those used to meet the archetype's prerequisite.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time, you learn a different spell and your focus pool increases by 1 Focus Point.
_desc_ko:
당신은 자신과 다른 마법 전통의 방법까지도 포함해 언데드를 창조하거나 지배하는 모든 수단을 완벽히 숙지하고 있습니다. 당신은 @link[spells.eyes-of-the-dead] 또는 @link[spells.subjugate-undead] 포커스 주문을 습득합니다. 아직 보유하지 않았다면, 1 포커스 포인트의 포커스 풀을 얻으며, 죽은 지성 생물의 육체를 명상함으로써 재집중할 수 있다. 재생술사 아키타입이 부여하는 포커스 주문은 아키타입 전제 조건 충족에 사용된 주문과 동일한 전통에서 비롯된다.

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있다. 매번 다른 주문을 습득하며 포커스 풀이 포커스 포인트 1점 증가한다.

name: Night's Warning

description.value:
Trigger A creature targets you with an attack and you can see the attacker.

Frequency once per hour

Requirements You can see the night sky.

Portents written in the night sky show you how to avoid an attack. The triggering attack roll targets your Occultism DC instead of your AC. Though this allows you to avoid taking penalties to your AC, it doesn't remove any conditions or other effects causing such penalties. For example, an enemy with sneak attack would still deal extra damage to you for being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, even though you wouldn't take the –2 circumstance penalty when defending against the attack.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature targets you with an attack and you can see the attacker.

Frequency once per hour

Requirements You can see the night sky.

Portents written in the night sky show you how to avoid an attack. The triggering attack roll targets your Occultism DC instead of your AC. Though this allows you to avoid taking penalties to your AC, it doesn't remove any conditions or other effects causing such penalties. For example, an enemy with sneak attack would still deal extra damage to you for being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, even though you wouldn't take the –2 circumstance penalty when defending against the attack.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 생물이 당신을 공격 대상으로 삼고, 당신이 공격자를 볼 수 있을 때.

발동 빈도 시간당 한 번

요구 사항 밤하늘을 볼 수 있어야 합니다.

밤하늘에 쓰인 징조가 공격을 피하는 방법을 알려줍니다. 발동 명중 굴림은 AC 대신 오컬트 DC를 대상으로 합니다. 이로 인해 AC에 페널티를 받지 않게 되지만, 해당 페널티를 유발하는 상태 이상이나 기타 효과는 제거되지 않습니다. 예를 들어, 암습을 가진 적이라면 @link[conditions.off-guard]로 인해 여전히 추가 피해를 입히지만, 해당 공격을 방어할 때 -2 상황 페널티는 적용되지 않습니다.

name: Fearsome Familiar

description.value: Your familiar trades places with an elemental from its elemental plane. Summon a common creature that has the elemental trait and a level no greater than your level - 4. This creature appears in the same space as your familiar, which disappears for the duration of this impulse. The elemental can appear in a space it can't normally reach. A creature you summon with the Fearsome Familiar feat gains the summoned trait. You can Sustain this impulse up to 1 minute. When the impulse ends, the familiar appears in the space the summoned elemental occupied. A familiar can endure this process only so often-if you use this impulse on your familiar more than once per day, it dies as soon as it returns the second time.

_desc_en: Your familiar trades places with an elemental from its elemental plane. Summon a common creature that has the elemental trait and a level no greater than your level - 4. This creature appears in the same space as your familiar, which disappears for the duration of this impulse. The elemental can appear in a space it can't normally reach. A creature you summon with the Fearsome Familiar feat gains the summoned trait. You can Sustain this impulse up to 1 minute. When the impulse ends, the familiar appears in the space the summoned elemental occupied. A familiar can endure this process only so often-if you use this impulse on your familiar more than once per day, it dies as soon as it returns the second time.
_desc_ko: 당신의 패밀리어가 그 속성의 원소계에 있는 원소체와 자리를 바꿉니다. 원소 특성을 지니고 당신의 레벨 - 4 이하인 일반 생물을 소환합니다. 이 생물은 당신의 패밀리어와 같은 공간에 나타나며, 패밀리어는 이 임펄스가 지속되는 동안 사라집니다. 원소수는 평소 도달할 수 없는 공간에도 나타날 수 있다. '위엄 있는 패밀리어' 피트로 소환한 생물은 소환된 특성을 얻는다. 이 임펄스를 최대 1분간 지속시킬 수 있다. 임펄스가 끝나면 패밀리어는 소환된 원소수가 차지했던 공간에 나타난다. 패밀리어는 이 과정을 여러 번 견딜 수 없다. 하루에 한 번 이상 패밀리어에게 이 임펄스를 사용하면, 두 번째로 돌아온 즉시 죽는다.

name: Soothing Pulse

description.value: Your ostilli can use its stored magic to help staunch your wounds, granting you the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PWNi3h0F9EsttE2p]{Administer Ambient Magic} action.

_desc_en: Your ostilli can use its stored magic to help staunch your wounds, granting you the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PWNi3h0F9EsttE2p]{Administer Ambient Magic} action.
_desc_ko: 당신의 오스티리는 저장된 마법을 사용해 상처를 지혈할 수 있으며, @link[actions.administer-ambient-magic] 행동을 부여합니다.

name: Surrounding Flames

description.value: When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IarZrgCeaiUqOuRu]{Wall of Fire}, you can modify its standard effects as follows: Instead of a 5-foot-thick, 10-foot-radius ring of flame, you can form the wall into a @Template[burst|distance:10]{10-foot-radius} hemisphere of fire.

value.value: ability to cast wall of fire

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en: When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IarZrgCeaiUqOuRu]{Wall of Fire}, you can modify its standard effects as follows: Instead of a 5-foot-thick, 10-foot-radius ring of flame, you can form the wall into a @Template[burst|distance:10]{10-foot-radius} hemisphere of fire.
_desc_ko: @link[spells.wall-of-fire]을 시전할 때, 표준 효과를 다음과 같이 수정할 수 있습니다: 5피트 두께, 10피트 반경의 불의 고리 대신, 벽을 10피트의 불의 반구 형태로 형성할 수 있습니다.

name: Orc Ferocity

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.

Fierceness in battle runs through your blood, and you refuse to fall from your injuries no matter how terrible they may be. You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point, and your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition increases by 1.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.

Fierceness in battle runs through your blood, and you refuse to fall from your injuries no matter how terrible they may be. You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point, and your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition increases by 1.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 대상의 HP가 0이 되지만 즉시 사망하지는 않는다.

전투에 대한 맹렬함이 당신의 피 속에 흐르고, 아무리 끔찍한 부상이라도 쓰러지기를 거부합니다. 기절을 피하고 1 HP로 남으며, @link[conditions.wounded] 상태가 1 증가합니다.

name: Foreseen Failure

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger A spell you cast has no effect because you critically failed all your spell attack rolls or because all targets critically succeeded at their saving throws.

You see your spell fail to take hold to disastrous end, then snap back to reality—it was all a precognition, and you know to try a different spell. Your spell is expended, but you can Cast a Spell that requires the same number of actions as the triggering spell or fewer to cast. The second spell must be a different spell than the first.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger A spell you cast has no effect because you critically failed all your spell attack rolls or because all targets critically succeeded at their saving throws.

You see your spell fail to take hold to disastrous end, then snap back to reality—it was all a precognition, and you know to try a different spell. Your spell is expended, but you can Cast a Spell that requires the same number of actions as the triggering spell or fewer to cast. The second spell must be a different spell than the first.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 당신이 시전한 주문이 모든 주문 명중 굴림에서 대실패를 하거나 모든 대상이 내성 굴림에서 대성공을 해서 효과가 없다.

당신은 자신의 주문이 재앙적인 결과로 실패하는 것을 목격한 뒤 현실로 돌아옵니다. 그것은 모두 예지력이었고, 당신은 다른 주문을 시도해야 한다는 것을 알게 됩니다. 주문은 소모되었지만, @link[actions.cast-a-spell]을 사용할 수 있습니다. 이 주문은 발동 주문과 동일한 수의 행동 또는 그 이하의 행동으로 시전할 수 있어야 합니다. 두 번째 주문은 첫 번째 주문과 다른 주문이어야 합니다.

name: Ankle Bite

description.value:
Trigger A foe gives you the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} condition using a part of its body.

Whenever someone grabs onto you, you instinctively bite down hard. Sometimes that makes them let go, and sometimes it just makes them angrier, but either way, it's both satisfying and tasty. Make a jaws Strike against the triggering foe. On a critical hit, you are no longer grabbed. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

value.value: Fang Sharpener or razortooth goblin heritage

_desc_en:
Trigger A foe gives you the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} condition using a part of its body.

Whenever someone grabs onto you, you instinctively bite down hard. Sometimes that makes them let go, and sometimes it just makes them angrier, but either way, it's both satisfying and tasty. Make a jaws Strike against the triggering foe. On a critical hit, you are no longer grabbed. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.
_desc_ko:
발동 적이 자신의 신체 일부를 사용하여 당신에게 @link[conditions.grabbed] 또는 @link[conditions.restrained] 상태를 부여합니다.

누군가 당신을 붙잡을 때마다, 당신은 본능적으로 세게 물어버린다. 때로는 그로 인해 상대가 놓아주기도 하고, 때로는 더 화를 내기도 하지만, 어느 쪽이든 만족스럽고 맛있다. 발동한 적에게 턱 공격을 가한다. 치명타 시, 더 이상 붙잡히지 않는다. 이 공격은 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되지 않으며, 다중 공격 페널티도 이 공격에는 적용되지 않는다.

name: Natural Ambition

description.value: You were raised to be ambitious and always reach for the stars, leading you to progress quickly in your chosen field. You gain a 1st-level class feat for your class. You must meet the prerequisites, but you can select the feat later in the character creation process in order to determine which prerequisites you meet.

_desc_en: You were raised to be ambitious and always reach for the stars, leading you to progress quickly in your chosen field. You gain a 1st-level class feat for your class. You must meet the prerequisites, but you can select the feat later in the character creation process in order to determine which prerequisites you meet.
_desc_ko: 당신은 야망을 품고 항상 별을 향해 도전하도록 길러져 선택한 분야에서 빠르게 성장했습니다. 해당 직업의 1레벨 클래스 피트를 획득합니다. 전제 조건을 충족해야 하지만, 어떤 전제 조건을 충족하는지 결정하기 위해 캐릭터 생성 과정 후반에 재주를 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Cheek Pouches

description.value: Your cheeks are stretchy, and you can store up to four items of light Bulk or less in these cheek pouches. None of these items can have a dimension longer than 1 foot. As long as you have at least one item in your cheek pouches, your speech is noticeably difficult to understand. Placing an item in your cheek pouch or retrieving one is an Interact action. You can empty your mouth with a single action, causing everything you had stored in your cheek pouches to fall to the ground in your square.

_desc_en: Your cheeks are stretchy, and you can store up to four items of light Bulk or less in these cheek pouches. None of these items can have a dimension longer than 1 foot. As long as you have at least one item in your cheek pouches, your speech is noticeably difficult to understand. Placing an item in your cheek pouch or retrieving one is an Interact action. You can empty your mouth with a single action, causing everything you had stored in your cheek pouches to fall to the ground in your square.
_desc_ko: 당신의 뺨은 신축성이 있어, 이 뺨 주머니에 최대 네 개의 가벼운 벌크 아이템을 보관할 수 있습니다. 이 물품들의 길이는 1피트를 초과할 수 없습니다. 뺨 주머니에 물품이 하나라도 들어 있는 동안에는 말투가 현저히 알아듣기 어려워집니다. 뺨 주머니에 물품을 넣거나 꺼내는 것은 상호작용 행동입니다. 액션 하나만으로 입을 비울 수 있으며, 이때 뺨 주머니에 보관 중이던 모든 물품이 자신의 칸 바닥으로 떨어집니다.

name: Trailblazing Stride

description.value:
While moving on land, you ignore any difficult terrain caused by plants, fungi, or uneven ground. When you succeed at a skill check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about a creature with the animal, beast, fungus, or plant trait, you gain a +10-foot circumstance bonus to your Speeds for the rest of your turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.P6hfR6mJHqQpR1c8]{Effect: Trailblazing Stride}

_desc_en:
While moving on land, you ignore any difficult terrain caused by plants, fungi, or uneven ground. When you succeed at a skill check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about a creature with the animal, beast, fungus, or plant trait, you gain a +10-foot circumstance bonus to your Speeds for the rest of your turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.P6hfR6mJHqQpR1c8]{Effect: Trailblazing Stride}
_desc_ko: 당신은 야생 지대를 이동하는 데 익숙합니다. 육상 이동 시 비마법적 어려운 지형의 효과를 무시합니다.

name: Diverting Vortex

description.value:
Requirements Your most recent action was to cast a non-cantrip spell.

You transfer vestiges of magical energy to the air around you, creating a vortex that deflects ranged attacks. Until the start of your next turn, you gain a +1 status bonus to AC against ranged weapon attacks and physical ranged unarmed attacks.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your most recent action was to cast a non-cantrip spell.

You transfer vestiges of magical energy to the air around you, creating a vortex that deflects ranged attacks. Until the start of your next turn, you gain a +1 status bonus to AC against ranged weapon attacks and physical ranged unarmed attacks.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 가장 최근 행동이 캔트립이 아닌 주문을 시전한 것이어야 한다.

주변 공기에 마법의 잔영을 전달하여 원거리 공격을 회피하는 소용돌이를 생성합니다. 다음 턴 시작 전까지 원거리 무기 공격 및 물리적 원거리 비무장 공격에 대해 AC에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Potent Nectar

description.value:
Your nectar becomes particularly dangerous. Select one of the following benefits when you gain this feat. This choice is permanent and can't be changed.

  • Your nectar is sticky, and clings to your target. Your nectar unarmed attack deals an additional 1d4 persistent acid damage to the target. This persistent damage isn't multiplied on a critical hit.
  • Your nectar is shot at a high velocity, and splashes upon contact. Your nectar unarmed attack additionally deals 1d4 acid splash damage. This splash damage isn't multiplied on a critical hit.

Special This feat gains the trait for your ancestry.

_desc_en:
Your nectar becomes particularly dangerous. Select one of the following benefits when you gain this feat. This choice is permanent and can't be changed.

  • Your nectar is sticky, and clings to your target. Your nectar unarmed attack deals an additional 1d4 persistent acid damage to the target. This persistent damage isn't multiplied on a critical hit.
  • Your nectar is shot at a high velocity, and splashes upon contact. Your nectar unarmed attack additionally deals 1d4 acid splash damage. This splash damage isn't multiplied on a critical hit.

Special This feat gains the trait for your ancestry.
_desc_ko:
당신의 꿀이 특히 위험해집니다. 이 피트를 획득할 때 다음 효과 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 이 선택은 영구적이며 변경할 수 없습니다.

  • 당신의 꿀은 끈적거려 대상에게 달라붙습니다. 당신의 꿀 비무장 공격은 대상에게 추가로 1d4 지속성 산성 피해를 입힙니다. 이 지속성 피해는 치명타 시 배가되지 않습니다.
  • 당신의 꿀은 고속으로 발사되어 접촉 시 튀어 오릅니다. 당신의 꿀 비무장 공격은 추가로 1d4 산성 방사 피해를 입힙니다. 이 방사 피해는 치명타 시 배가되지 않습니다.

특수 이 피트는 당신의 혈통에 대한 특성을 부여합니다.

name: Aegis of the Dissolution

description.value: You are a friend of shadows and know how to avoid the troubles they bring. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects with the darkness or shadow traits.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You are a friend of shadows and know how to avoid the troubles they bring. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects with the darkness or shadow traits.
_desc_ko: 당신은 그림자의 친구이며 그들이 가져오는 문제를 피하는 법을 알고 있습니다. 어둠 또는 그림자 특성을 가진 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Dig Quickly

description.value:
Requirements You are standing on dirt, sand, snow, or similar particulate material.

Your hands work as effectively as shovels when you need to dig a quick hole. You dig a shallow pit in the square you currently occupy, turning the square into difficult terrain (including for you). In addition, you also kick up a cloud of grit in a direction of your choice. The cloud extinguishes small, unattended, non-magical fires and helps smother the flames on burning creatures located within the cone; creatures in this cone that are taking @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistent Fire Damage} can immediately attempt an additional flat DC 15 check to end the persistent damage.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are standing on dirt, sand, snow, or similar particulate material.

Your hands work as effectively as shovels when you need to dig a quick hole. You dig a shallow pit in the square you currently occupy, turning the square into difficult terrain (including for you). In addition, you also kick up a cloud of grit in a direction of your choice. The cloud extinguishes small, unattended, non-magical fires and helps smother the flames on burning creatures located within the cone; creatures in this cone that are taking @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistent Fire Damage} can immediately attempt an additional flat DC 15 check to end the persistent damage.
_desc_ko:
요건 흙, 모래, 눈 또는 이와 유사한 입상 물질 위에 서 있어야 합니다.

급히 구덩이를 파야 할 때, 당신의 손은 삽처럼 효과적으로 작동합니다. 현재 위치한 칸에 얕은 구덩이를 파내며, 해당 칸을 (당신에게도) 어려운 지형으로 바꿉니다. 또한 선택한 방향으로 모래먼지 구름을 일으킵니다. 이 구름은 작고 방치된 비마법적 불을 끄며, 원뿔 영역 내 불타는 생물의 화염을 억제합니다. 이 원뿔 영역에서 @link[conditions.persistent-damage]를 받고 있는 생물은 즉시 추가 평탄 DC 15 판정을 시도해 지속 피해를 종료할 수 있습니다.

name: Treespeech

description.value: Your connection to elemental wood allows you to communicate with trees in the Universe in Muan, the language of wood elementals. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with woody plants like trees and shrubs.

_desc_en: Your connection to elemental wood allows you to communicate with trees in the Universe in Muan, the language of wood elementals. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with woody plants like trees and shrubs.
_desc_ko: 당신은 원소 목(木)과의 연결을 통해 우주의 나무들과 나무 정령의 언어인 무안으로 소통할 수 있습니다. 나무나 관목 같은 목본 식물에게 질문을 하고, 답변을 받으며, 외교 기술을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Opportune Backstab

description.value:
Trigger A creature within your melee reach is hit by a melee attack from one of your allies.

When your enemy is hit by your ally, you capitalize upon the distraction. Make a Strike against the triggering creature.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature within your melee reach is hit by a melee attack from one of your allies.

When your enemy is hit by your ally, you capitalize upon the distraction. Make a Strike against the triggering creature.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 근접 공격 범위 내의 생물이 아군의 근접 공격을 맞음.

적군이 아군에게 공격을 당하는 순간, 당신은 그 혼란을 이용한다. 발동 대상 생물에게 강타를 가한다.

name: Wild Witch's Armaments

description.value:
Your patron's power continues to enhance your natural offensive capabilities. You gain additional effects for any of the unarmed Strikes you chose from Witch's Armaments. If you took that feat multiple times to gain multiple attacks, you gain the appropriate additional effects.

  • Eldritch Nails Your nails can tear and rend with the force of a beast. If you hit the same enemy with two consecutive nails Strikes, that enemy takes additional slashing damage equal to half your level on the second Strike.
  • Iron Teeth Like a true predator, your teeth can crunch bone. A creature that you critically hit with a jaws Strike must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.
  • Living Hair Part of your hair hardens into sharp quills that you can eject with force. You gain a quills ranged unarmed strike that deals 1d4 piercing damage with a range of 15 feet. Your quills are in the dart group.

_desc_en:
Your patron's power continues to enhance your natural offensive capabilities. You gain additional effects for any of the unarmed Strikes you chose from Witch's Armaments. If you took that feat multiple times to gain multiple attacks, you gain the appropriate additional effects.

  • Eldritch Nails Your nails can tear and rend with the force of a beast. If you hit the same enemy with two consecutive nails Strikes, that enemy takes additional slashing damage equal to half your level on the second Strike.
  • Iron Teeth Like a true predator, your teeth can crunch bone. A creature that you critically hit with a jaws Strike must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.
  • Living Hair Part of your hair hardens into sharp quills that you can eject with force. You gain a quills ranged unarmed strike that deals 1d4 piercing damage with a range of 15 feet. Your quills are in the dart group.
_desc_ko:
당신의 후원자의 힘이 계속해서 당신의 타고난 공격 능력을 강화합니다. 마녀의 무기에서 선택한 모든 비무장 공격에 추가 효과를 얻습니다. 여러 번 공격을 얻기 위해 해당 피트를 여러 번 선택했다면, 그에 상응하는 추가 효과를 얻습니다.

  • 초자연적 손톱 당신의 손톱은 짐승의 힘으로 힘차게 찢고 갈기갈기 찢을 수 있습니다. 동일한 적을 연속으로 두 번의 손톱 공격으로 명중시킬 경우, 두 번째 공격 시 해당 적에게 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 추가 베기 피해를 입힙니다.
  • 철의 이빨 (최상급) 포식자처럼, 당신의 이빨은 뼈를 부술 수 있습니다. 이빨 공격으로 치명타를 입힌 생물은 네 클래스 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽에 대한 인내 저항에 성공하지 못하면 @link[conditions.sickened]{1} 상태가 된다.
  • 살아있는 머리카락 머리카락 일부가 날카로운 가시로 굳어져 힘차게 발사할 수 있습니다. 15피트 사거리로 1d4 관통 피해를 주는 가시 원거리 비무장 공격을 얻습니다. 가시는 다트 그룹에 속합니다.

name: Double Shot

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a ranged weapon with reload 0.

You shoot twice in blindingly fast succession. Make two Strikes, each against a separate target and with a –2 penalty. Both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after you've made both of them.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a ranged weapon with reload 0.

You shoot twice in blindingly fast succession. Make two Strikes, each against a separate target and with a –2 penalty. Both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after you've made both of them.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 재장전 0의 원거리 무기를 장비하고 있어야 합니다.

눈부시게 빠른 속도로 두 번 연속 발사합니다. 각각 다른 대상에게 -2 페널티를 적용하여 두 번의 공격을 수행합니다. 두 공격 모두 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되지만, 페널티는 두 공격을 모두 수행한 후에야 증가합니다.

name: Sympathetic Portrayal

description.value: You portrayed Grand Prince Stavian III in Fall of the Troubled King, a production dedicated to the life and times of the paranoid Taldan ruler whose violent resistance to new policies on succession kicked off the War for the Crown. Your acting won rave reviews for recasting Stavian's paranoia and political machinations in a sympathetic light, and you've learned to apply these subtle techniques outside of the stage to win others over. Whenever you succeed at a Deception or Performance check to portray a famous figure, you can select one creature within 60 feet who observed your performance. As long as this creature isn't hostile, its attitude toward you automatically improves by two steps (three steps if your check was a critical success). If it's hostile, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 minute as it tries to reconcile its desire to harm you with its newfound sympathy for you.

_desc_en: You portrayed Grand Prince Stavian III in Fall of the Troubled King, a production dedicated to the life and times of the paranoid Taldan ruler whose violent resistance to new policies on succession kicked off the War for the Crown. Your acting won rave reviews for recasting Stavian's paranoia and political machinations in a sympathetic light, and you've learned to apply these subtle techniques outside of the stage to win others over. Whenever you succeed at a Deception or Performance check to portray a famous figure, you can select one creature within 60 feet who observed your performance. As long as this creature isn't hostile, its attitude toward you automatically improves by two steps (three steps if your check was a critical success). If it's hostile, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 minute as it tries to reconcile its desire to harm you with its newfound sympathy for you.
_desc_ko: 당신은 <혼란의 왕의 몰락>에서 스타비안 3세 대공을 연기했습니다. 이 작품은 새로운 계승 정책에 대한 폭력적 저항으로 왕관 전쟁을 촉발시킨 편집증적 탈단 통치자의 생애와 시대를 헌신한 작품입니다. 당신의 연기는 스타비안의 편집증과 정치적 술책을 동정적인 시각으로 재해석해 호평을 받았으며, 무대 밖에서도 이러한 미묘한 기법을 활용해 타인을 설득하는 법을 터득했습니다. 유명 인물을 연기하는 기만 또는 공연 판정에서 성공할 때마다, 60피트 이내에서 당신의 공연을 지켜본 생물 한 마리를 선택할 수 있습니다. 이 생물이 적대적이지 않은 한, 당신에 대한 태도가 자동으로 두 단계 상승합니다(대성공 시 세 단계). 적대적일 경우, 당신을 해치려는 욕구와 새로 생긴 동정심 사이에서 갈등하며 @link[conditions.stupefied]{2} 상태가 1분간 지속됩니다.

name: Mobile Finisher

description.value:
You attack in motion. Stride and then Strike.

You can use Mobile Finisher while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

_desc_en:
You attack in motion. Stride and then Strike.

You can use Mobile Finisher while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.
_desc_ko:
움직이는 상태에서 공격한다. 먼저 이동한 후 공격한다.

해당 이동 유형을 보유한 경우, 스트라이드 대신 버로잉, 클라이밍, 플라잉, 스위밍 중 하나를 사용하며 모바일 피니셔를 사용할 수 있다.

name: Expert Rivethun Spellcasting

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{Expert Spellcasting Benefits}.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{Expert Spellcasting Benefits}.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{전문 주문 시전 혜택}을 얻습니다.

name: Necromancer's Visage

description.value:
Necromantic energy demonstrates your power over undead, creating a demeanor that commands their fear and respect. Undead creatures can immediately sense your Necromancer's Visage and tend to act accordingly. If you take a hostile action against an undead creature, it becomes permanently immune to your Necromancer's Visage, and your Necromancer's Visage ends. You can spend 10 minutes to restore your Necromancer's Visage, though any creatures that became permanently immune remain so. Each time an undead creature 2 or more levels lower than you attacks you, it must attempt a Will save against your spell DC. If you're also affected by sanctuary or a similar effect, only one affects the attacker (you choose which).

Critical Success The creature is permanently immune to your Necromancer's Visage.

Success The creature can attempt its attack and any other attacks against you this turn.

Failure The creature can't attack you and wastes the action. It can't attempt further attacks against you this turn.

Critical Failure The creature wastes the action and can't attempt to attack you as long as your Necromancer's Visage persists.

Special This feat has the trait matching your spellcasting tradition.

cleric with a negative font, oracle of bones, or necromancer wizard

_desc_en:
Necromantic energy demonstrates your power over undead, creating a demeanor that commands their fear and respect. Undead creatures can immediately sense your Necromancer's Visage and tend to act accordingly. If you take a hostile action against an undead creature, it becomes permanently immune to your Necromancer's Visage, and your Necromancer's Visage ends. You can spend 10 minutes to restore your Necromancer's Visage, though any creatures that became permanently immune remain so. Each time an undead creature 2 or more levels lower than you attacks you, it must attempt a Will save against your spell DC. If you're also affected by sanctuary or a similar effect, only one affects the attacker (you choose which).

Critical Success The creature is permanently immune to your Necromancer's Visage.

Success The creature can attempt its attack and any other attacks against you this turn.

Failure The creature can't attack you and wastes the action. It can't attempt further attacks against you this turn.

Critical Failure The creature wastes the action and can't attempt to attack you as long as your Necromancer's Visage persists.

Special This feat has the trait matching your spellcasting tradition.
_desc_ko:
네크로맨틱 에너지는 네크로맨서가 언데드에 대한 지배력을 보여줌으로써, 그들에게 공포와 경외심을 불러일으키는 위엄을 창조한다. 언데드 생물들은 네크로맨서의 얼굴을 즉시 감지하고 그에 따라 행동하는 경향이 있다. 네크로맨서의 얼굴을 가진 자는 언데드 생물에게 적대적인 행동을 취하면, 해당 생물은 영구적으로 네크로맨서의 얼굴에 면역이 되며 네크로맨서의 얼굴 효과는 종료됩니다. 10분을 소모하면 네크로맨서의 얼굴을 회복할 수 있으나, 영구 면역을 획득한 생물은 그대로 유지됩니다. 네크로맨서의 얼굴을 가진 자가 공격받을 때, 자신보다 레벨이 2 이상 낮은 언데드 생물이 공격할 때마다 해당 생물은 네크로맨서의 얼굴의 주문 DC에 대한 의지 내성 굴림을 시도하다. 당신이 성역이나 유사한 효과의 영향을 동시에 받고 있다면, 공격자에게는 그중 하나만 적용됩니다(당신이 선택).

대성공 해당 생물은 네크로맨서의 얼굴에 영구적으로 면역됩니다.

성공 해당 생물은 이번 턴에 당신을 대상으로 한 공격 및 기타 모든 공격을 시도할 수 있습니다.

실패 해당 생물은 당신을 공격할 수 없으며 행동을 낭비합니다. 이번 턴 동안 당신에 대한 추가 공격을 시도할 수 없습니다.

대실패 해당 생물은 행동을 낭비하며, 네크로맨서의 얼굴이 지속되는 동안 당신을 공격하려고 시도할 수 없습니다.

특수 이 피트는 당신의 주문 시전 전통과 일치하는 특성을 지닙니다.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time, you gain another oracle feat.

_desc_ko:
오라클 재주 하나를 얻습니다. 전제 조건을 충족하기 위해, 당신의 오라클 레벨은 당신의 레벨 절반과 같습니다.

특수 이 재주를 여러 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 매번 선택할 때마다 다른 오라클 피트를 얻습니다.

name: Duskwalker Magic

description.value: Your connection to psychopomps gives you the power to glimpse the near future and protect corpses from the ravages of undeath. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X]{Augury} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.xRgU9rrhmGAgG4Rc]{Peaceful Rest} each once per day as 2nd-rank divine innate spells.

_desc_en: Your connection to psychopomps gives you the power to glimpse the near future and protect corpses from the ravages of undeath. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X]{Augury} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.xRgU9rrhmGAgG4Rc]{Peaceful Rest} each once per day as 2nd-rank divine innate spells.
_desc_ko: 사이코폼프와의 연결로 가까운 미래를 엿볼 수 있는 능력을 얻으며, 시체가 언데드의 파괴로부터 보호됩니다. @link[spells.augury]과 @link[spells.peaceful-rest]을 각각 하루에 한 번씩 (2nd)랭크 신성 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있다.

name: Unleash the Blight

description.value:
You unleash the rot infecting you, spreading the blight to those nearby. All living creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:60] take @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2)d6)[void]|options:area-damage]{1d6 void} damage for every 2 levels you have, with a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] save.

Awakening The blight is infectious. Creatures damaged by your blight take an additional @Damage[1d6[persistent,void]] damage, as they begin to decompose.

Awakening The blight is debilitating. Creatures damaged become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} for one round on a success, drained 1 for 1 minute on a failure, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} for 1 minute on a critical failure.

_desc_en:
You unleash the rot infecting you, spreading the blight to those nearby. _desc_ko:
당신은 자신에게 스며든 부패를 발산하여 주변에 재앙을 퍼뜨립니다. 60피트 내 모든 생명체는 당신의 레벨 2당 1d6 void 피해를 받으며, 기본 인내 내성에 성공할 수 있습니다.

각성 이 병폐는 전염성이 있습니다. 당신의 병폐로 피해를 입은 생물은 부패하기 시작하며 추가로 1d6 지속 공허의 피해를 입습니다.

각성 이 병폐는 쇠약하게 한다. 피해를 입은 생물은 성공 시 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.drained]{1} 상태가 되며, 실패 시 1분 동안 기력이 1 감소하고, 대실패 시 1분 동안 @link[conditions.drained]{2} 상태가 됩니다.

_desc_en: When you perform the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ofAQyLtLEGnOIs3N]{Harrowing} ritual, the DC for the Primary Check is never more than the standard DC by level, and the cost for the ritual is halved. If you use a fine harrow deck, the cost for the ritual is removed entirely.

description.value:
Trigger You miss with your Strike during @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.o5q9FBrPsAYqEl5w]{Channel Smite}.

The energy from your smite persists for a moment, allowing you to pass it to a new target. Cast the 1-action version of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} spell you expended, targeting a creature other than the target of your Strike.

_desc_ko:
발동 조건 @link[feats.channel-smite] 중 공격이 빗나갔을 때.

네 스마이트의 에너지가 잠시 지속되어 새로운 대상에게 전달할 수 있다. 사용한 @link[spells.harm] 또는 @link[spells.heal] 주문의 1-액션 버전을 시전하여, 네 타격의 대상이 아닌 다른 생물을 목표로 삼는다.

name: Alchemical Shot

description.value:
Requirements You have an alchemical bomb worn or in one hand, and are wielding a firearm or crossbow.

You've practiced a technique for mixing alchemical bombs with your loaded shot. You Interact to retrieve the bomb (if it's not already in your hand) and pour its contents onto your ammunition, consuming the bomb, then resume your grip on the required weapon. Next, Strike with your firearm. The Strike deals damage of the same type as the bomb (for instance, fire damage for alchemist's fire), and it deals an additional 1d6 persistent damage of the same type as the bomb. If the Strike is a failure, you take 1d6 damage of the same type as the bomb you used, and the firearm misfires.

The persistent damage increases to 2d6 if the bomb is 11th level or higher, or 3d6 if it's 17th level or higher.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have an alchemical bomb worn or in one hand, and are wielding a firearm or crossbow.

You've practiced a technique for mixing alchemical bombs with your loaded shot. You Interact to retrieve the bomb (if it's not already in your hand) and pour its contents onto your ammunition, consuming the bomb, then resume your grip on the required weapon. Next, Strike with your firearm. The Strike deals damage of the same type as the bomb (for instance, fire damage for alchemist's fire), and it deals an additional 1d6 persistent damage of the same type as the bomb. If the Strike is a failure, you take 1d6 damage of the same type as the bomb you used, and the firearm misfires.

The persistent damage increases to 2d6 if the bomb is 11th level or higher, or 3d6 if it's 17th level or higher.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 알케미 폭탄을 착용하거나 한 손에 들고 있으며, 화기나 석궁을 휘두르고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 장전된 탄환에 연금술 폭탄을 혼합하는 기술을 연습했습니다. 폭탄을 회수하고(이미 손에 들고 있지 않은 경우) 그 내용물을 탄환에 부어 폭탄을 소모한 후, 필요한 무기를 다시 쥡니다. 다음으로 화기로 강타합니다. 이 공격은 폭탄과 동일한 유형의 피해를 입히며(예: 연금술사의 불은 화염 피해), 폭탄과 동일한 유형의 추가 지속 피해 1d6을 입힙니다. 공격이 실패하면 사용한 폭탄과 동일한 유형의 피해 1d6을 받고 화기가 오작동합니다.

폭탄이 11레벨 이상일 경우 지속 피해는 2d6으로 증가하며, 17레벨 이상일 경우 3d6으로 증가한다.

name: Dragon Prince

description.value: The blood of the Dragon Kings runs strong in your veins. Your draconic heritage is clearly visible, with hair that is almost entirely crimson, azure, or the like, and that shines like a dragon's scales. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.JcobNl4iE9HmMYtE]{Dragon Breath} sorcerer bloodline spell as an innate arcane spell once per day, but you can use only the dragon breath that is associated with your heritage and that matches the energy type of your Dragon Spit feat. At 12th level and every 3 levels thereafter, the spell is heightened by an additional spell rank.

_desc_en: The blood of the Dragon Kings runs strong in your veins. Your draconic heritage is clearly visible, with hair that is almost entirely crimson, azure, or the like, and that shines like a dragon's scales. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.JcobNl4iE9HmMYtE]{Dragon Breath} sorcerer bloodline spell as an innate arcane spell once per day, but you can use only the dragon breath that is associated with your heritage and that matches the energy type of your Dragon Spit feat. At 12th level and every 3 levels thereafter, the spell is heightened by an additional spell rank.
_desc_ko: 용왕의 피가 당신의 혈관 속을 강하게 흐릅니다. 드라코닉 혈통은 거의 전적으로 진홍색, 청색 또는 이와 유사한 색깔 의 머리카락으로 뚜렷이 드러나며, 용의 비늘처럼 빛납니다. 당신은 하루에 한 번, 선천적인 아케인 주문으로 @link[spells.dragon-breath] 소서러 혈통 주문을 시전할 수 있습니다. 단, 당신의 혈통과 연관되고 용의 침 솜씨 피트의 에너지 유형과 일치하는 드래곤의 숨결만 사용할 수 있습니다. 12레벨과 그 이후 3레벨마다, 이 주문은 추가 주문 랭크만큼 강화됩니다.

name: Gigaton Strike

description.value:
When you use a full-power Megaton Strike, you can knock your foe back. When you succeed at your Strike while using an unstable Megaton Strike, your target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:inventor] save against your class DC.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is pushed back 5 feet.

Failure The creature is pushed back 10 feet.

Critical Failure The creature is pushed back 20 feet.

Special If your innovation is a minion, this benefit applies on its unstable Megaton Strikes.

_desc_en:
When you use a full-power Megaton Strike, you can knock your foe back. When you succeed at your Strike while using an unstable Megaton Strike, your target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:inventor] save against your class DC.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is pushed back 5 feet.

Failure The creature is pushed back 10 feet.

Critical Failure The creature is pushed back 20 feet.

Special If your innovation is a minion, this benefit applies on its unstable Megaton Strikes.
_desc_ko:
당신이 최대 위력의 메가톤 스트라이크를 사용할 때, 적을 뒤로 밀쳐낼 수 있습니다. 불안정한 메가톤 스트라이크 사용 중 스트라이크에 성공하면, 대상은 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 인내 내성 굴림을 시도해야 합니다.

대성공 생물은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 생물이 5피트 뒤로 밀려납니다.

실패 생물이 10피트 뒤로 밀려난다.

대실패 생물이 20피트 뒤로 밀려난다.

특수 당신의 혁신이 하수인인 경우, 이 혜택은 그 하수인의 불안정한 메가톤 공격에 적용됩니다.

name: Rend Armor

description.value:
Requirements Your last action was a critical Strike that dealt bludgeoning or piercing damage.

Your enemies' defenses are no match for you as you wrench your weapon to compromise their armor. The creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to their AC that lasts until they can take 10 minutes to repair their armor. The creature can also Interact to adjust their armor, which removes this penalty for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.CBEHOTjal3nllTtt]{Effect: Rend Armor}

Requirements Your last action was a critical Strike that dealt bludgeoning or piercing damage.

Your enemies' defenses are no match for you as you wrench your weapon to compromise their armor. The creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to their AC that lasts until they can take 10 minutes to repair their armor. The creature can also Interact to adjust their armor, which removes this penalty for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.CBEHOTjal3nllTtt]{Effect: Rend Armor}
_desc_ko:
요구조건 당신의 마지막 행동이 타격 또는 관통 피해를 준 치명 타격이었어야 합니다.

당신이 무기를 비틀어 적의 갑옷을 무력화하니, 적의 방어는 당신에게 상대가 되지 않습니다. 그 생물은 자신의 갑옷을 수리하는 데 10분을 들일 수 있을 때까지 지속되는 –2의 상황 페널티를 AC에 받습니다. 그 생물은 또한 상호작용을 하여 갑옷을 조정할 수 있으며, 이는 1분 동안 이 페널티를 제거합니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.CBEHOTjal3nllTtt]{효과: 갑옷 찢기}

name: Headshot

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a loaded firearm or crossbow.

You attempt to finish your target with a final, well-placed shot. Make a crossbow or firearm Strike. If you've damaged the target within the last minute with the same weapon and you get a critical success on your attack roll, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:gunslinger|traits:death,incapacitation] save against your class DC or die; this is a death and incapacitation effect. A creature that survives is temporarily immune for 1 day. Creatures with no head (such as dullahans or oozes) are immune to this ability, and creatures with redundant heads (such as ettins) might survive the destruction of a head.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a loaded firearm or crossbow.

You attempt to finish your target with a final, well-placed shot. Make a crossbow or firearm Strike. If you've damaged the target within the last minute with the same weapon and you get a critical success on your attack roll, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:gunslinger|traits:death,incapacitation] save against your class DC or die; this is a death and incapacitation effect. A creature that survives is temporarily immune for 1 day. Creatures with no head (such as dullahans or oozes) are immune to this ability, and creatures with redundant heads (such as ettins) might survive the destruction of a head.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 장전된 화기나 석궁을 휘두르고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 마지막으로 정확히 조준한 일격으로 목표를 마무리하려고 시도합니다. 석궁 또는 화기 공격을 수행하십시오. 지난 1분 이내에 동일한 무기로 목표에게 피해를 입혔고 명중 굴림에서 대성공을 거두었다면, 목표는 당신의 클래스 DC(DC)에 대한 인내 내성에 성공하지 못하면 죽거나 무력화됩니다. 생존한 생물은 1일간 일시적으로 면역 상태가 된다. 머리가 없는 생물(듀라한이나 우즈 등)은 이 능력에 면역이며, 머리가 여러 개인 생물(에틴 등)은 한 개의 머리가 파괴되어도 생존할 수 있다.

name: Familiar's Eyes

description.value:
You use your familiar's senses as easily as your own.

You project your senses into your familiar. When you do, you lose all sensory information from your own body, but you can sense through your familiar's body until you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AjLSHZSWQ90exdLo]{Dismiss} the effect.

While projecting your senses in this way, you can converse telepathically with your familiar if it understands a language.

Special This feat has the trait corresponding to the tradition of spells you cast (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

_desc_en:
You use your familiar's senses as easily as your own.

You project your senses into your familiar. When you do, you lose all sensory information from your own body, but you can sense through your familiar's body until you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AjLSHZSWQ90exdLo]{Dismiss} the effect.

While projecting your senses in this way, you can converse telepathically with your familiar if it understands a language.

Special This feat has the trait corresponding to the tradition of spells you cast (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).
_desc_ko:
당신은 자신의 감각처럼 손쉽게 자신의 패밀리어의 감각을 사용합니다.

당신은 자신의 감각을 패밀리어에게 투사합니다. 이 경우 자신의 신체로부터 오는 모든 감각 정보를 잃게 되지만, 효과를 @link[actions.dismiss]할 때까지 패밀리어의 신체를 통해 감각을 느낄 수 있습니다.

이렇게 감각을 투사하는 동안, 당신의 패밀리어 존재가 언어를 이해한다면 텔레파시로 대화할 수 있습니다.

특수 이 피트는 당신이 시전하는 주문 전통(아케인, 신성, 오컬트, 프라이멀)에 해당하는 특성을 지닌다.

name: Lion's Might

description.value: You've trained with the weapons of the Bright Lions. You gain access to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Ak3oHoPDJoMR14yg]{Lion Scythes} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zWp7Kcn7mhKyGFxW]{Sun Slings}. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in certain weapons, you also gain that proficiency rank with lion scythes and sun slings.

_desc_en: You've trained with the weapons of the Bright Lions. You gain access to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Ak3oHoPDJoMR14yg]{Lion Scythes} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zWp7Kcn7mhKyGFxW]{Sun Slings}. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in certain weapons, you also gain that proficiency rank with lion scythes and sun slings.
_desc_ko: 당신은 브라이트 라이언의 무기로 훈련했습니다. @link[equipment.lion-scythe]과 @link[equipment.sun-sling]를 사용할 수 있게 됩니다. 특정 무기에 숙련자 이상의 숙련도를 부여하는 클래스 특성을 획득할 때마다, 사자 낫과 태양 투석기에 대해서도 동일한 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다.

name: Consume Magic

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You attempt a saving throw against an area effect from the tradition matching your magiphage ability.

You consume the magic of an incoming spell or effect to protect your allies, though you might give yourself indigestion. Attempt a counteract check against the triggering effect; your counteract rank equals half your level (rounded up), and for the roll, use either your class DC – 10 or your spellcasting attribute modifier plus your spellcasting proficiency bonus. If you counteract the triggering effect, you end the effect for all other creatures in the area, but you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} as your body struggles to absorb the influx of magic.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You attempt a saving throw against an area effect from the tradition matching your magiphage ability.

You consume the magic of an incoming spell or effect to protect your allies, though you might give yourself indigestion. Attempt a counteract check against the triggering effect; your counteract rank equals half your level (rounded up), and for the roll, use either your class DC – 10 or your spellcasting attribute modifier plus your spellcasting proficiency bonus. If you counteract the triggering effect, you end the effect for all other creatures in the area, but you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} as your body struggles to absorb the influx of magic.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

발동 조건 마기페이지 능력과 일치하는 전통의 영역 효과에 대해 내성 굴림을 시도한다.

당신은 다가오는 주문이나 효과의 마법을 흡수하여 아군을 보호하지만, 소화불량을 일으킬 수도 있습니다. 발동 효과에 대해 반격 판정을 시도하십시오. 당신의 반격 랭크은 레벨의 절반(올림)이며, 굴림에는 직업 난이도(DC) - 10 또는 주문 시전 능력치 수정자 + 주문 시전 숙련 보너스 중 하나를 사용하십시오. 발동 효과를 반격하면 해당 영역 내 다른 모든 생물에게서 효과를 종료시키지만, 마법의 유입을 흡수하려는 몸의 노력으로 인해 @link[conditions.sickened]{1} 상태가 된다.

name: Miraculous Medic

description.value: Your ability to heal others is miraculous enough to bring people back from near-death. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Hnc7eGi7vyZenAIm]{Breath of Life} as an innate primal spell.

_desc_en: Your ability to heal others is miraculous enough to bring people back from near-death. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Hnc7eGi7vyZenAIm]{Breath of Life} as an innate primal spell.
_desc_ko: 당신의 치유 능력은 기적적이어서 죽음 직전의 사람을 되살릴 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, 당신은 @link[spells.breath-of-life]을 선천적 프라이멀 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Water Strider

description.value: Water cradles your every step, allowing you to walk on its surface. Stride up to your Speed. During your movement, you can move across liquids that don't support your weight. If you end your movement on a surface that can't support you, you fall into the liquid at the end of your movement. You can increase the number of actions to 3 to Stride up to three times your Speed.

_desc_en: Water cradles your every step, allowing you to walk on its surface. Stride up to your Speed. During your movement, you can move across liquids that don't support your weight. If you end your movement on a surface that can't support you, you fall into the liquid at the end of your movement. You can increase the number of actions to 3 to Stride up to three times your Speed.
_desc_ko: 물이 당신의 모든 발걸음을 받쳐주어 표면 위를 걸을 수 있게 합니다. 이동 속도만큼 걸을 수 있습니다. 이동 중 체중을 지탱하지 못하는 액체 위를 건널 수 있습니다. 이동을 체중을 지탱하지 못하는 표면에서 끝내면, 이동 종료 지점에서 액체 속으로 떨어집니다. 행동 횟수를 3회로 늘려 이동 속도의 최대 3배까지 걸을 수 있다.

name: Sour Bomb

description.value:
You can mix ingredients with a powerful sour smell into an alchemical bomb to make its explosion an overpowering stench. Any creature hit by the bomb must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class] save against your class DC in addition to the bomb's normal effects.

Success The creature is unaffected beyond a strong craving for pickles.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round from the smell.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You can mix ingredients with a powerful sour smell into an alchemical bomb to make its explosion an overpowering stench. Any creature hit by the bomb must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class] save against your class DC in addition to the bomb's normal effects.

Success The creature is unaffected beyond a strong craving for pickles.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round from the smell.
_desc_ko:
강력한 신맛을 풍기는 재료를 연금술 폭탄에 혼합하면 폭발 시 압도적인 악취를 발생시킬 수 있습니다. 폭탄에 맞은 모든 생물은 폭탄의 일반 효과에 더해, 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 인내 내성을 시도해야 합니다.

성공 피클에 대한 강한 갈망 외에는 아무런 영향도 받지 않습니다.

실패 생물은 @link[conditions.sickened]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

대실패 생물은 @link[conditions.sickened]{2} 상태가 되며, 냄새로부터 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.fleeing] 상태가 된다.

name: Meditate on This!

description.value:
Access Tian Xia origin

You meditate to alter your qi, coloring it with your resentment and anger. Until the start of your next turn, whenever you hit a creature with an unarmed Strike, or an adjacent creature deals piercing, slashing, or bleed damage to you, the creature that you hit or that damaged you must attempt a @Check[will|against:barbarian|options:inflicts:fleeing,inflicts:frightened] save against your class DC. The creature is then temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} until the end of its next turn.
