_desc_ko:
접근 티엔 샤 기원

당신은 기를 바꾸기 위해 명상하며, 원한과 분노로 기를 물들입니다. 다음 차례 시작 전까지, 당신이 비무장 공격으로 생물을 명중시키거나 인접한 생물이 당신에게 관통, 베기, 출혈 피해를 입힐 때마다, 당신이 명중시킨 생물이나 당신에게 피해를 입힌 생물은 당신의 직업 난이도(DC)에 대한 의지 저항 검사를 시도해야 합니다. 해당 생물은 이후 1분 동안 일시적으로 면역 상태가 되며, 대성공 후 생물에게 영향 없음.

성공 생물은 @link[conditions.frightened]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

실패 생물은 @link[conditions.frightened]{2} 상태가 됩니다.

대실패 해당 생물은 @link[conditions.frightened]{3} 상태가 되며, 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.fleeing] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Bat Around

description.value: Your attack moves a foe into a position that your united companion can take full advantage of. Make a melee Strike against an enemy. As long as your Strike deals damage, you can attempt an Athletics check to either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} the creature you hit. Both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but it doesn't increase until after you've made both attacks. If your Reposition or Shove moves the target and it ends this movement within your united companion's reach, your companion can Strike the target. Unless it critically fails, your companion can also attempt an Athletics check to Reposition or Shove the creature. These attacks affect your united companion's multiple attack penalty the same way.

_desc_en: Your attack moves a foe into a position that your united companion can take full advantage of. Make a melee Strike against an enemy. As long as your Strike deals damage, you can attempt an Athletics check to either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} the creature you hit. Both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but it doesn't increase until after you've made both attacks. If your Reposition or Shove moves the target and it ends this movement within your united companion's reach, your companion can Strike the target. Unless it critically fails, your companion can also attempt an Athletics check to Reposition or Shove the creature. These attacks affect your united companion's multiple attack penalty the same way.
_desc_ko: 당신의 공격은 적을 연합한 동료가 최대한 활용할 수 있는 위치로 이동시킵니다. 적에게 근접 공격을 가하십시오. 공격이 피해를 입힌 경우, 명중시킨 생물을 @link[actions.reposition]하거나 @link[actions.shove]하기 위해 운동 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다. 두 공격 모두 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되지만, 두 공격을 모두 수행한 후에야 페널티가 증가합니다. 재위치시키기나 밀치기로 대상이 이동하여 그 이동이 당신의 연합된 동료의 도달 범위 내에서 끝난다면, 동료는 그 대상을 공격할 수 있습니다. 대실패하지 않는 한, 동료는 또한 운동 판정을 시도하여 그 생물을 재위치시키거나 밀칠 수 있습니다. 이 공격들도 당신의 연합된 동료의 다중 공격 페널티에 동일한 방식으로 영향을 미칩니다.

name: Rapid Hybridization

description.value:
Trigger You roll initiative.

When danger threatens, your instincts kick in, and you can assume a different shape at a moment's notice. You use Change Shape to enter your hybrid shape.

_desc_en:
Trigger You roll initiative.

When danger threatens, your instincts kick in, and you can assume a different shape at a moment's notice. You use Change Shape to enter your hybrid shape.
_desc_ko:
트리거 당신은 인니셔티브를 굴립니다.

위험이 닥치면 본능이 발동하여 순식간에 다른 형태로 변신할 수 있습니다. 형태 변신을 사용해 혼합 형태로 진입합니다.

name: Pack Movement

description.value: You and your companion move to take down a common enemy. You and your animal companion both Stride. If both of you end your movement within reach of the same creature, you and your animal companion each make a melee Strike against the creature. You can use Pack Movement to Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead of Stride if both you and your animal companion have the corresponding movement type.

_desc_en: You and your companion move to take down a common enemy. You and your animal companion both Stride. If both of you end your movement within reach of the same creature, you and your animal companion each make a melee Strike against the creature. You can use Pack Movement to Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead of Stride if both you and your animal companion have the corresponding movement type.
_desc_ko: 당신과 동료는 공동의 적을 쓰러뜨리기 위해 함께 움직입니다. 당신과 동물 동료는 모두 이동을 합니다. 둘 다 같은 생물에게 도달 가능한 범위 내에서 이동을 끝낸다면, 당신과 동물 동료는 각각 그 생물을 상대로 근접 공격을 가합니다. 당신과 동물 동료가 모두 해당 이동 유형을 가진다면, 이동을 대신하여 굴착, 등반, 비행 또는 수영을 위해 무리 이동을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Bonded Focus

description.value: Your connection to your bonded item increases your focus pool. Whenever you Refocus while your bonded item is in your possession, you completely refill your focus pool.

_desc_en: Your connection to your bonded item increases your focus pool. Whenever you Refocus while your bonded item is in your possession, you completely refill your focus pool.
_desc_ko: 결속된 아이템과의 연결은 당신의 포커스 풀을 증가시킵니다. 결속된 아이템을 소지한 상태에서 재집중할 때마다, 당신의 포커스 풀이 완전히 재충전됩니다.

name: Defender's Grit

description.value:
You can't protect anyone if you're dead. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.I0BhPWqYf1bbzEYg]{Diehard} general feat. If you start your turn adjacent to your designated ally, you gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level that lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.wIaXcsccLYf1Wi6Y]{Effect: Defender's Grit}

_desc_en:
You can't protect anyone if you're dead. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.I0BhPWqYf1bbzEYg]{Diehard} general feat. If you start your turn adjacent to your designated ally, you gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level that lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.wIaXcsccLYf1Wi6Y]{Effect: Defender's Grit}
_desc_ko:
죽은 자는 누구도 지킬 수 없다. @link[feats.diehard] 피트를 얻는다. 지정된 아군과 인접한 상태로 자신의 턴을 시작하면, 자신의 레벨 절반에 해당하는 임시 HP를 얻으며 이는 다음 턴 시작까지 지속된다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.wIaXcsccLYf1Wi6Y]{효과: 수호자의 투지}

name: Maker of Miracles

description.value: You are a conduit for truly deific power. You gain an additional 10th-rank spell slot.

_desc_en: You are a conduit for truly deific power. You gain an additional 10th-rank spell slot.
_desc_ko: 당신은 진정한 신성한 힘의 통로입니다. 10th-rank 주문 슬롯을 하나 추가로 얻습니다.

name: Lab Rat

description.value: You've spent more than your share of time in an alchemy lab. You have been exposed to a wide variety of alchemical poisons and harmful substances, leaving you with an increased tolerance of their effects. You have a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against poisons and diseases. If you roll a success on your saving throw against a poison or disease, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: You've spent more than your share of time in an alchemy lab. You have been exposed to a wide variety of alchemical poisons and harmful substances, leaving you with an increased tolerance of their effects. You have a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against poisons and diseases. If you roll a success on your saving throw against a poison or disease, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 연금술 실험실에서 남다른 시간을 보냈습니다. 다양한 연금술 독과 유해 물질에 노출되어 그 효과에 대한 내성이 높아졌습니다. 독과 질병에 대한 저항에 +1 상황 보너스를 받습니다. 독이나 질병에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴리면 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Steadying Stone

description.value:
The earth has taught you how to remain unyielding and firm. If you roll a success on an Acrobatics check made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} on uneven ground composed of earth or rock, you get a critical success instead.

As long as you remain on the ground, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to Shove or Trip you. This bonus also applies to saving throws against spells or effects that would attempt to knock you prone. If you're a rock dwarf, this bonus increases to +3.

_desc_en:
The earth has taught you how to remain unyielding and firm. If you roll a success on an Acrobatics check made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} on uneven ground composed of earth or rock, you get a critical success instead.

As long as you remain on the ground, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to Shove or Trip you. This bonus also applies to saving throws against spells or effects that would attempt to knock you prone. If you're a rock dwarf, this bonus increases to +3.
_desc_ko:
대지는 당신에게 굽히지 않고 굳건히 버티는 법을 가르쳤습니다. 흙이나 바위로 이루어진 고르지 않은 지면에서 @link[actions.balance]를 위한 곡예 판정에서 성공을 굴리면, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

지상에 머무르는 동안, 밀치기나 걸려 넘어뜨리기에 대한 인내 또는 반사 DC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 보너스는 당신을 쓰러뜨리려고 시도하는 주문이나 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에도 적용됩니다. 바위 드워프라면 이 보너스가 +3으로 증가합니다.

name: Larger than Life

description.value: When you Change Shape, you can assume the form of a creature that's Large or Huge in size. In addition to your increased space, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Intimidation checks.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: When you Change Shape, you can assume the form of a creature that's Large or Huge in size. In addition to your increased space, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Intimidation checks.
_desc_ko: 형태 변신을 사용할 때, 대형 또는 초대형 크기의 생물 형태를 취할 수 있습니다. 공간 증가 효과 외에도, 협박 판정 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Studious Capacity

description.value: Your continued study of occult magic has increased your magical capacity, allowing you to cast spells even when it seems impossible. You can cast one spell each day even after you've run out of spell slots of the appropriate spell rank, but you can't use this ability to cast a spell of your highest spell rank.

_desc_en: Your continued study of occult magic has increased your magical capacity, allowing you to cast spells even when it seems impossible. You can cast one spell each day even after you've run out of spell slots of the appropriate spell rank, but you can't use this ability to cast a spell of your highest spell rank.
_desc_ko: 오컬트 마법에 대한 지속적인 연구로 마법 능력이 향상되어 불가능해 보이는 상황에서도 주문을 시전할 수 있게 되었습니다. 해당 주문 랭크의 주문 슬롯이 모두 소진된 후에도 하루에 한 번씩 주문을 시전할 수 있지만, 이 능력으로 최고 랭크의 주문을 시전할 수는 없습니다.

name: Formation Master

description.value: You can assemble a formation even with members of ancestries that lack the hobgoblins' military discipline, and you can extend these benefits to your hobgoblin allies. When you are adjacent to at least two humanoid allies, you gain the benefits of Formation Training, even if they aren't hobgoblin allies. Hobgoblin allies adjacent to you and at least one other hobgoblin ally also gain the bonuses from your Formation Training feat.

_desc_en: You can assemble a formation even with members of ancestries that lack the hobgoblins' military discipline, and you can extend these benefits to your hobgoblin allies. When you are adjacent to at least two humanoid allies, you gain the benefits of Formation Training, even if they aren't hobgoblin allies. Hobgoblin allies adjacent to you and at least one other hobgoblin ally also gain the bonuses from your Formation Training feat.
_desc_ko: 홉고블린의 군사적 규율이 부족한 조상의 구성원들과도 포메이션을 구성할 수 있으며, 이러한 혜택을 홉고블린 동맹에게도 확대 적용할 수 있습니다. 최소 두 명의 인간형 동맹과 인접해 있을 때, 그들이 홉고블린 동맹이 아니더라도 편대 훈련의 혜택을 얻습니다. 당신과 최소 한 명의 다른 홉고블린 동맹과 인접한 홉고블린 동맹도 당신의 편대 훈련 피트에서 오는 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Greater Deathly Secrets

description.value:
Your undead secrets grow stronger still. You learn either the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qzsQmpiQodHBBWYI]{Malignant Sustenance} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2YIr0S2Gt14PMMQp]{Grasping Grave} focus spell. Your focus pool increases by 1 point.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time, you learn a different spell and your focus pool increases by 1 Focus Point.

_desc_en:
Your undead secrets grow stronger still. You learn either the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qzsQmpiQodHBBWYI]{Malignant Sustenance} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2YIr0S2Gt14PMMQp]{Grasping Grave} focus spell. Your focus pool increases by 1 point.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time, you learn a different spell and your focus pool increases by 1 Focus Point.
_desc_ko:
네 언데드 비밀은 더욱 강해진다. @link[spells.malignant-sustenance] 또는 @link[spells.grasping-grave] 포커스 주문을 익힌다. 네 포커스 풀이 1 포인트 증가한다.

특수 이 재주를 여러 번 선택할 수 있다. 매번 다른 주문을 습득하며 포커스 풀이 포커스 포인트 1점 증가한다.

name: Chemical Trail

description.value: You can leave a faint chemical trail as you move and can use the chemical trails of other surkis to navigate. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all checks and saves to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.fJImDBQfqfjKJOhk]{Sense Direction} or reorient yourself.

_desc_en: You can leave a faint chemical trail as you move and can use the chemical trails of other surkis to navigate. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all checks and saves to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.fJImDBQfqfjKJOhk]{Sense Direction} or reorient yourself.
_desc_ko: 이동 시 희미한 화학 흔적을 남길 수 있으며, 다른 수르키스의 화학 흔적을 이용해 길 찾기가 가능합니다. @link[actions.sense-direction] 또는 방향 전환 관련 모든 판정 및 내성에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Vicious Incisors

description.value: Your jaws unarmed attack deals 1d6 piercing damage instead of 1d4, and gains the backstabber trait. You can file down your teeth and regrow them later on, enabling you to select this feat at any level, and to retrain into and out of this feat.

_desc_en: Your jaws unarmed attack deals 1d6 piercing damage instead of 1d4, and gains the backstabber trait. You can file down your teeth and regrow them later on, enabling you to select this feat at any level, and to retrain into and out of this feat.
_desc_ko: 비무장 공격 시 1d4 관통 피해 대신 1d6 관통 피해를 입히며, 뒤에서 찌르기 특성을 얻습니다. 이를 갈아내고 나중에 다시 자라게 할 수 있어, 이 피트를 레벨에 상관없이 선택할 수 있으며, 이 피트로 재훈련하거나 재훈련을 취소할 수 있습니다.

name: Liberty's Devotion

description.value:
You've deepened your connection with the ideals of Andoran. You gain an advanced domain spell from one domain you selected with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.MbNLIACQfPdVOL6F]{Liberty's Promise}. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.

Special You can take this feat multiple times, each time selecting a different advanced domain spell from a domain you selected with Liberty's Promise.

_desc_en:
You've deepened your connection with the ideals of Andoran. You gain an advanced domain spell from one domain you selected with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.MbNLIACQfPdVOL6F]{Liberty's Promise}. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.

Special You can take this feat multiple times, each time selecting a different advanced domain spell from a domain you selected with Liberty's Promise.
_desc_ko:
당신은 안도란의 이상과의 연결을 더욱 깊게 했습니다. 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.MbNLIACQfPdVOL6F]{자유의 약속}으로 선택한 한 영역에서 상급 영역 주문 하나를 얻습니다. 집중 풀의 집중 점수 수를 1 증가시킵니다.

특수 당신은 이 재주를 여러 번 취득할 수 있으며, 매번 자유의 약속으로 선택한 영역에서 서로 다른 상급 영역 주문을 선택합니다.

name: Counter Thought

description.value:
Trigger A creature Casts a Spell with the mental trait.

Requirements You have an unexpended spell slot you could use to Cast a Spell with the mental trait.

When a foe Casts a Spell that has the mental trait and you can see its manifestations, you can use your own mental magic to disrupt it. You expend one of your spell slots to counter the triggering creature's casting of a spell with the mental trait. You lose your spell slot as if you had cast the triggering spell; this spell slot must be one for which you could Cast a Spell with the mental trait. You then attempt to counteract the triggering spell.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature Casts a Spell with the mental trait.

Requirements You have an unexpended spell slot you could use to Cast a Spell with the mental trait.

When a foe Casts a Spell that has the mental trait and you can see its manifestations, you can use your own mental magic to disrupt it. You expend one of your spell slots to counter the triggering creature's casting of a spell with the mental trait. You lose your spell slot as if you had cast the triggering spell; this spell slot must be one for which you could Cast a Spell with the mental trait. You then attempt to counteract the triggering spell.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 생물이 정신 속성을 가진 주문을 시전할 때.

요구 사항 정신 속성을 가진 주문을 시전할 수 있는 사용하지 않은 주문 슬롯이 있어야 합니다.

적군이 정신 속성을 지닌 주문을 시전하고 그 창조를 볼 수 있을 때, 자신의 정신 마법으로 이를 방해할 수 있습니다. 정신 속성을 지닌 주문을 시전하는 유발 생물의 주문을 저지하기 위해 자신의 주문 슬롯 하나를 소모합니다. 유발 주문을 시전한 것처럼 주문 슬롯을 잃게 되며, 이 슬롯은 정신 속성을 지닌 주문을 시전할 수 있는 슬롯이어야 합니다. 그런 다음 유발 주문을 반격하려 시도합니다.

name: Speak with the Sleeping

description.value:
Access Tian Xia origin

You can speak to all inanimate objects and the slumbering spirits within them. Once per day, you can speak to an object and ask it a question to gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5LYi9Efs6cko4GGL]{Object Reading}, though the object gives you its response 1 minute later (as it takes the spirit within the object some time to rouse). An object's ability to answer is limited by its particular nature; a pair of shoes might know where their owner has walked, while a house knows the history of the denizens within, but not what they do elsewhere.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Access Tian Xia origin

You can speak to all inanimate objects and the slumbering spirits within them. Once per day, you can speak to an object and ask it a question to gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5LYi9Efs6cko4GGL]{Object Reading}, though the object gives you its response 1 minute later (as it takes the spirit within the object some time to rouse). An object's ability to answer is limited by its particular nature; a pair of shoes might know where their owner has walked, while a house knows the history of the denizens within, but not what they do elsewhere.
_desc_ko:
접근 티엔 샤 기원

당신은 모든 무생물과 그 안에 잠든 영혼과 대화할 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, 물체에게 질문하여 @link[spells.object-reading] 효과를 얻을 수 있으나, 물체가 답을 주는 데는 1분이 걸립니다(물체 안에 있는 영혼이 깨어나기까지 시간이 필요하기 때문입니다). 물건의 답변 능력은 그 특성에 따라 제한됩니다. 신발 한 켤레는 주인이 걸어간 곳을 알 수 있지만, 집은 그 안에 살았던 사람들의 역사를 알 수 있을 뿐 그들이 다른 곳에서 무엇을 하는지는 알 수 없습니다.

name: Specialty Crafting

description.value:
Your training focused on Crafting one particular kind of item. Select one of the specialties listed below; you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Crafting checks to Craft items of that type. If you are a master in Crafting, this bonus increases to +2. If it's unclear whether the specialty applies, the GM decides. Some specialties might apply only partially. For example, if you were making a morningstar and had specialty in woodworking, the GM might give you half your bonus because the item requires both blacksmithing and woodworking.

Specialty Applicable Items
Alchemy* Alchemical items such as elixirs
Artistry Fine art, including jewelry
Blacksmithing Durable metal goods, including metal armor
Bookmaking Books and paper
Glassmaking Glass, including glassware and windows
Leatherworking Leather goods, including leather armor
Pottery Ceramic goods
Shipbuilding Ships and boats
Stonemasonry Stone goods and structures
Tailoring Clothing
Weaving Textiles, baskets, and rugs
Woodworking Wooden goods and structures

* You must have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.is3Oz9wt11lNq62K]{Alchemical Crafting} skill feat to Craft alchemical items.

_desc_en:
Your training focused on Crafting one particular kind of item. Select one of the specialties listed below; you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Crafting checks to Craft items of that type. If you are a master in Crafting, this bonus increases to +2. If it's unclear whether the specialty applies, the GM decides. Some specialties might apply only partially. For example, if you were making a morningstar and had specialty in woodworking, the GM might give you half your bonus because the item requires both blacksmithing and woodworking.

Specialty Applicable Items

Tailoring Clothing

Woodworking Wooden goods and structures

* You must have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.is3Oz9wt11lNq62K]{Alchemical Crafting} skill feat to Craft alchemical items.
_desc_ko:
당신의 훈련은 특정 종류의 아이템 제작에 포커스를 두었습니다. 아래 나열된 전문 분야 중 하나를 선택하세요; 해당 유형의 아이템을 제작할 때 제작 판정에서 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 제작에 달인인 경우, 이 보너스는 +2로 증가합니다. 전문 분야가 적용되는지 불분명한 경우, GM이 결정합니다. 일부 전문 분야는 부분적으로만 적용될 수 있습니다. 예를 들어, 목공 전문 분야를 가진 상태에서 모닝스타를 제작할 경우, 해당 아이템이 대장장이 기술과 목공 기술을 모두 필요로 하므로 GM이 보너스의 절반만 부여할 수 있습니다.

Specialty 적용 대상 아이템
Alchemy* 엘릭서 같은 연금술 아이템
Artistry 미술품(보석류 포함)
Blacksmithing 내구성 금속 제품, 금속 갑옷 포함
Bookmaking 책과 종이
Glassmaking 유리, 유리제품 및 창문 포함
가죽 세공 가죽 제품, 가죽 갑옷 포함
Pottery 도자기 제품
Shipbuilding 선박 및 보트
Stonemasonry 석재 제품 및 구조물
Tailoring Clothing
Weaving 직물, 바구니 및 러그
Woodworking 목재 제품 및 구조물

* 연금술 아이템을 제작하려면 @link[feats.alchemical-crafting] 스킬 피트가 필요합니다.

name: Reach Beyond

description.value: You've learned to move your spiritual energy past yourself to attack spirits where others can't. You can make melee Strikes against incorporeal creatures that are inside solid objects as long as the object is within your reach. An incorporeal creature inside of a solid object is hidden, requiring you to succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:11] when you target it. You can spend an action, which has the concentrate trait, to focus on a creature inside of a solid object. If you do, the next melee Strike you make this turn requires you to succeed at only a @Check[flat|dc:6] to affect the creature.

_desc_en: You've learned to move your spiritual energy past yourself to attack spirits where others can't. You can make melee Strikes against incorporeal creatures that are inside solid objects as long as the object is within your reach. An incorporeal creature inside of a solid object is hidden, requiring you to succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:11] when you target it. You can spend an action, which has the concentrate trait, to focus on a creature inside of a solid object. If you do, the next melee Strike you make this turn requires you to succeed at only a @Check[flat|dc:6] to affect the creature.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신의 영적 에너지를 자신을 넘어 이동시켜 타인이 공격할 수 없는 영혼을 공격하는 법을 익혔습니다. 손이 닿는 범위 내에 있는 고체 물체 안에 있는 비물질적 생물에게 근접 공격을 가할 수 있습니다. 고체 물체 안에 있는 비물질적 생물은 {숨겨져} 있으므로, 이를 표적으로 삼을 때 DC 11 단순에 성공해야 합니다. 집중 특성을 가진 행동을 소모하여 고체 물체 안의 생물에 포커스를 둘 수 있습니다. 그렇게 하면, 이번 턴에 수행하는 다음 근접 공격은 해당 생물에게 영향을 미치기 위해 DC 6 단순에만 성공하면 됩니다.

name: Perfect Resistance

description.value:
You gain resistance equal to half your level to all damage from effects with the appropriate trait for your School of Perfection: fire for Unblinking Flame, water for Unbreaking Waves, air for Unfolding Wind, and earth for Untwisting Iron. After using a Student of Perfection ki spell, the resistance increases to be equal to your level for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.DyX4E7KDkzRnDxzc]{Effect: Perfect Resistance}

_desc_en:
You gain resistance equal to half your level to all damage from effects with the appropriate trait for your School of Perfection: fire for Unblinking Flame, water for Unbreaking Waves, air for Unfolding Wind, and earth for Untwisting Iron. After using a Student of Perfection ki spell, the resistance increases to be equal to your level for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.DyX4E7KDkzRnDxzc]{Effect: Perfect Resistance}
_desc_ko:
당신은 완벽의 학파에 해당하는 속성을 지닌 효과로부터 받는 모든 피해에 대해 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 저항력을 얻습니다: 불꽃의 학파는 불꽃의 학파, 물의 학파는 파도의 학파, 공기의 학파는 바람의 학파, 대지의 학파는 풀림강철에 해당합니다. 완벽의 제자 기(氣) 주문을 사용한 후, 1라운드 동안 저항력이 레벨만큼 증가한다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.DyX4E7KDkzRnDxzc]{효과: 완벽한 저항}

name: Titan Swing

description.value:
Your limbs tense as you deliver a mighty swing. Make a melee Strike. If it hits, you deal an extra die of weapon damage and push the target back by 5 feet. If you're at least 10th level, increase this to two extra dice and push the target by 10 feet, and if you're at least 18th level, increase it to three extra dice and push the target by 15 feet.

Awakening On a critical hit, you push the target back double the normal distance and knock it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Awakening On a hit, you deal 1d6 bleed damage. This increases to 2d6 at 10th level and 3d6 at 18th level.

_desc_en:
Your limbs tense as you deliver a mighty swing. Make a melee Strike. If it hits, you deal an extra die of weapon damage and push the target back by 5 feet. If you're at least 10th level, increase this to two extra dice and push the target by 10 feet, and if you're at least 18th level, increase it to three extra dice and push the target by 15 feet.

Awakening On a critical hit, you push the target back double the normal distance and knock it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Awakening On a hit, you deal 1d6 bleed damage. This increases to 2d6 at 10th level and 3d6 at 18th level.
_desc_ko:
강력한 휘두름을 날리며 사지가 긴장됩니다. 근접 공격을 시도한다. 명중 시 추가 무기 피해 주사위 1개를 적용하고 대상을 5피트 밀쳐낸다. (10th) 레벨 이상일 경우 추가 주사위를 2개로 늘리고 대상을 10피트 밀쳐내며, (18th) 레벨 이상일 경우 추가 주사위를 3개로 늘리고 대상을 15피트 밀쳐낸다.

각성 치명타 시, 대상은 일반 거리의 두 배만큼 밀려나며 @link[conditions.prone] 상태가 된다.

각성 명중 시 1d6 출혈 피해를 입힙니다. 10레벨에 2d6, 18레벨에 3d6으로 증가합니다.

name: Laughing Kholo

description.value: Your sinister giggle is a sound of warning and threat. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ePObIpaJDgDb9CQj]{Battle Cry} skill feat. You don't take a penalty when you attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a creature that doesn't understand your language.

_desc_en: Your sinister giggle is a sound of warning and threat. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ePObIpaJDgDb9CQj]{Battle Cry} skill feat. You don't take a penalty when you attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a creature that doesn't understand your language.
_desc_ko: 당신의 사악한 킥킥거림은 경고와 위협의 소리다. 당신은 @link[feats.battle-cry] 피트를 얻는다. 당신의 언어를 이해하지 못하는 생물을 @link[actions.demoralize]하려고 시도할 때 페널티를 받지 않는다.

name: Impressive Landing

description.value:
Trigger You fall at least 10 feet and land on a solid surface.

You slam into the ground, shattering it around you. Treat the fall as 10 feet shorter. You land on your feet. The ground in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] becomes difficult terrain. Any creature in the emanation when you land takes @Damage[5[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage as the debris hits it and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of its next turn.

_desc_en:
Trigger You fall at least 10 feet and land on a solid surface.

You slam into the ground, shattering it around you. Treat the fall as 10 feet shorter. You land on your feet. The ground in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] becomes difficult terrain. Any creature in the emanation when you land takes @Damage[5[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage as the debris hits it and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of its next turn.
_desc_ko:
발동 최소 10피트 이상 추락하여 단단한 지면에 착지한다.

땅에 강하게 부딪혀 주변 지면을 산산조각 낸다. 낙하 높이를 10피트 낮게 처리한다. 발로 착지한다. 착지 지점 반경 5피트의 지면이 어려운 지형이 된다. 착지 시 파편이 닿은 반경 내 모든 생물은 파편에 맞아 5 타격의 피해를 입으며, 다음 턴 시작까지 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 된다.

name: Shattershields

description.value:
Four plates of pitted metal float around you to intercept attacks. You and allies in your kinetic aura gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC. When any creature with this bonus would take damage from a physical attack, one of the plates reduces the damage by its Hardness of 5. If the damage exceeds the Hardness, that plate is destroyed. You can replenish all destroyed plates as a single action that has the concentrate trait.

Level (+2) The Hardness increases by 1.

_desc_en:
Four plates of pitted metal float around you to intercept attacks. You and allies in your kinetic aura gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC. When any creature with this bonus would take damage from a physical attack, one of the plates reduces the damage by its Hardness of 5. If the damage exceeds the Hardness, that plate is destroyed. You can replenish all destroyed plates as a single action that has the concentrate trait.

Level (+2) The Hardness increases by 1.
_desc_ko:
구멍이 뚫린 금속판 네 장이 주변을 맴돌며 공격을 막아낸다. 당신과 당신의 키네틱 오라에 있는 아군은 AC에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 보너스를 가진 생물이 물리 공격으로 피해를 입을 때, 판 중 하나가 그 판의 경도 5만큼 피해를 감소시킵니다. 피해가 경도를 초과하면 해당 판은 파괴됩니다. 당신은 집중 특성을 가진 액션 하나로 파괴된 모든 판을 보충할 수 있습니다.

레벨 (+2) 경도가 1 증가합니다.

name: Unbelievable Luck

description.value: While no one, not even you, might appear to understand why, you demonstrate a greater ability to hit your targets regardless of the obstacles in your way. You can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.FzZAYGib08aEq5P2]{Accidental Shot} activity granted to you by the Unexpected Sharpshooter Dedication once per hour instead of once per day.

_desc_en: While no one, not even you, might appear to understand why, you demonstrate a greater ability to hit your targets regardless of the obstacles in your way. You can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.FzZAYGib08aEq5P2]{Accidental Shot} activity granted to you by the Unexpected Sharpshooter Dedication once per hour instead of once per day.
_desc_ko: 아무도, 심지어 당신조차도 그 이유를 이해하지 못할지라도, 당신은 방해물이 있더라도 목표물을 명중시키는 능력이 더 뛰어납니다. 예기치 못한 명사수 헌신으로 부여받은 @link[actions.accidental-shot] 행동을 하루에 한 번이 아닌 시간당 한 번 사용할 수 있다.

name: Bloodsense

description.value: You're extraordinarily sensitive to the presence of blood. You gain bloodsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 15 feet. This allows you to sense the presence of creatures, living or dead, that have blood (this includes most creatures that aren't immune to bleed). You're similarly able to detect the presence of fresh blood in volumes of one pint or more, so long as it's no more than 24 hours old.

_desc_en: You're extraordinarily sensitive to the presence of blood. You gain bloodsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 15 feet. This allows you to sense the presence of creatures, living or dead, that have blood (this includes most creatures that aren't immune to bleed). You're similarly able to detect the presence of fresh blood in volumes of one pint or more, so long as it's no more than 24 hours old.
_desc_ko: 당신은 피의 존재에 대해 비정상적으로 민감합니다. 15피트 범위의 부정확한 감각으로 혈액 감지 능력을 얻습니다. 이를 통해 피를 가진 생물(출혈에 면역이 아닌 대부분의 생물 포함)의 존재를 감지할 수 있습니다. 마찬가지로, 24시간 이내에 발생한 1파인트 이상의 신선한 피도 감지할 수 있습니다.

name: Wildspell Dedication

description.value:
You gain the ability to tap into a powerful well of magic. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XIgvCPaSy5WXStVD]{Spellsurge} focus spell. This spell is of your main casting tradition.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.fLtbqWjffjM40o1U]{Wildspell}

value.value: ability to cast spells from spell slots

_desc_en:
You gain the ability to tap into a powerful well of magic. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XIgvCPaSy5WXStVD]{Spellsurge} focus spell. This spell is of your main casting tradition.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.fLtbqWjffjM40o1U]{Wildspell}
_desc_ko: 당신은 강력한 마법의 원천을 활용할 수 있는 능력을 얻습니다. 당신은 @link[spells.spellsurge] 포커스 주문을 얻습니다. 이 주문은 당신의 주 주문 전통에 속합니다.

name: Rising Blood Magic

description.value: The power within your blood grows. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{Basic Spellcasting Feat} benefits. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the bloodrager archetype, add a common spell of the appropriate tradition and rank to your repertoire. In addition, when you Cast a Spell from your repertoire and you are at least @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}, increase the extra damage dealt by that spell from Rage by 1.

_desc_en: The power within your blood grows. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{Basic Spellcasting Feat} benefits. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the bloodrager archetype, add a common spell of the appropriate tradition and rank to your repertoire. In addition, when you Cast a Spell from your repertoire and you are at least @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}, increase the extra damage dealt by that spell from Rage by 1.
_desc_ko: 피 속에 깃든 힘이 성장한다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{기본 주문 시전 피트}의 혜택을 얻는다. 혈노자 아키타입으로 새로운 랭크의 주문 슬롯을 획득할 때마다, 해당 전통과 랭크에 맞는 일반 주문을 레퍼토리에 추가한다. 또한, 레퍼토리의 주문을 시전할 때 @link[conditions.drained]{1} 이상일 경우, 그 주문의 분노로 인한 추가 피해를 1 증가시킨다.

name: Ultimate Polymath

description.value: You can flexibly cast all of your spells, granting a dizzying array of possible options. All of the spells in your repertoire are signature spells for you.

_desc_en: You can flexibly cast all of your spells, granting a dizzying array of possible options. All of the spells in your repertoire are signature spells for you.
_desc_ko: 당신은 모든 주문을 유연하게 시전할 수 있어, 어지러울 정도로 다양한 선택지를 제공합니다. 당신의 레퍼토리에 있는 모든 주문은 당신만의 시그니처 주문입니다.

name: Tempo Duelist

description.value: You move with an unpredictable tempo, shifting between unnervingly slow and rapid movements. You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} for 1 round. As the nature of this effect still leaves your location obvious, you can't use this concealment to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}.

_desc_en: You move with an unpredictable tempo, shifting between unnervingly slow and rapid movements. You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} for 1 round. As the nature of this effect still leaves your location obvious, you can't use this concealment to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}.
_desc_ko: 당신은 예측 불가능한 속도로 움직이며, 불안할 정도로 느린 동작과 빠른 동작 사이를 오간다. 당신은 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태가 1라운드 동안 지속됩니다. 이 효과의 특성상 위치가 여전히 노출되므로, 이 은폐 상태를 이용해 @link[actions.hide]나 @link[actions.sneak]을 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Stitch Flesh

description.value: You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} to restore Hit Points to undead creatures, not just living ones. The techniques you use to do so vary, but all require sutures, bandages, and other tools included in healer's tools. Some conditions that might raise the DC of treating undead's wounds differ from that of living creatures. For instance, the GM might increase the DC if the undead being treated is in a church of Pharasma or the wounds were caused by powerful vitality energy.

_desc_en: You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} to restore Hit Points to undead creatures, not just living ones. The techniques you use to do so vary, but all require sutures, bandages, and other tools included in healer's tools. Some conditions that might raise the DC of treating undead's wounds differ from that of living creatures. For instance, the GM might increase the DC if the undead being treated is in a church of Pharasma or the wounds were caused by powerful vitality energy.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @link[actions.treat-wounds]를 사용해 살아있는 생물뿐만 아니라 언데드 생물의 HP도 회복시킬 수 있다. 이를 수행하는 기술은 다양하지만, 모두 봉합사, 붕대 및 치유사 도구 세트에 포함된 기타 도구가 필요하다. 언데드의 상처를 치료할 때 DC가 상승할 수 있는 조건은 생물과 다를 수 있습니다. 예를 들어, 치료 대상 언데드가 파라스마의 성당에 있거나 강력한 활력 에너지로 인한 상처인 경우 GM이 DC를 높일 수 있습니다.

name: Predictive Purchase (Investigator)

description.value:
You have just the thing for the situation. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.bh2jHyyYrkLMsIdX]{Prescient Planner} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.lHFz4MmebvPqTb0A]{Prescient Consumable} feats.

When using Prescient Planner, you can pull out the item as a 2-action activity to remove your backpack (or a similar container) and draw the item, rather than taking 1 minute.

_desc_en:
You have just the thing for the situation. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.bh2jHyyYrkLMsIdX]{Prescient Planner} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.lHFz4MmebvPqTb0A]{Prescient Consumable} feats.

When using Prescient Planner, you can pull out the item as a 2-action activity to remove your backpack (or a similar container) and draw the item, rather than taking 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
당신은 상황에 딱 맞는 것을 가지고 있습니다. @link[feats.prescient-planner]와 @link[feats.prescient-consumable] 피트를 얻습니다.

예지 계획가 재주를 사용할 때, 1분이 아닌 2행동 활동으로 배낭(또는 유사한 보관함)을 벗고 아이템을 꺼낼 수 있습니다.

name: Wind God's Fan

description.value: Your fan can stir up even more powerful winds. You can use the Wave Fan activation one additional time per day. Add a 3rd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.it4ZsAi6XgvGcodc]{Wall of Wind} spell to the spells contained within your fan.

_desc_en: Your fan can stir up even more powerful winds. You can use the Wave Fan activation one additional time per day. Add a 3rd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.it4ZsAi6XgvGcodc]{Wall of Wind} spell to the spells contained within your fan.
_desc_ko: 당신의 부채는 더욱 강력한 바람을 일으킬 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번 더 파도 부채 발동 효과를 사용할 수 있습니다. 부채에 담긴 주문에 (3rd)랭크 @link[spells.wall-of-wind] 주문을 추가합니다.

name: Defy Fey

description.value: You are keen to the wiles of the fey and can usually shake off their magic. Whenever you fail, but don't critically fail, a save against a spell with a duration of at least 1 round cast by a fey creature, you can attempt a second save against the original DC at the start of your next turn to end any lingering effects the spell might have. This can end persistent damage caused by a spell but can't reverse any effects that have been resolved already (such as damage dealt when the spell was cast).

_desc_en: You are keen to the wiles of the fey and can usually shake off their magic. Whenever you fail, but don't critically fail, a save against a spell with a duration of at least 1 round cast by a fey creature, you can attempt a second save against the original DC at the start of your next turn to end any lingering effects the spell might have. This can end persistent damage caused by a spell but can't reverse any effects that have been resolved already (such as damage dealt when the spell was cast).
_desc_ko: 당신은 페이의 계략에 예민하며, 보통 그들의 마법을 떨쳐낼 수 있습니다. 페이 생물이 시전한 지속 시간이 1라운드 이상인 주문에 대한 내성 굴림에서 실패했지만 대실패는 아닌 경우, 다음 턴 시작 시 원래 난이도(DC)로 두 번째 내성 굴림을 시도하여 해당 주문이 남긴 잔여 효과를 종료할 수 있습니다. 이는 주문으로 인한 지속 피해를 종료할 수 있지만, 이미 해결된 효과(예: 주문 시전 시 가해진 피해)는 되돌릴 수 없습니다.

name: Air Shroud

description.value: Turbulent air suffuses your kinetic aura. This doesn't displace other matter but provides air for creatures in your kinetic aura that need air to breathe. Attacks with ranged weapons take a -1 circumstance penalty to their attack rolls if their paths pass through your kinetic aura. Air in your kinetic aura is difficult terrain for flying creatures other than yourself.

_desc_en: Turbulent air suffuses your kinetic aura. This doesn't displace other matter but provides air for creatures in your kinetic aura that need air to breathe. Attacks with ranged weapons take a -1 circumstance penalty to their attack rolls if their paths pass through your kinetic aura. Air in your kinetic aura is difficult terrain for flying creatures other than yourself.
_desc_ko: 소용돌이치는 공기가 당신의 키네틱 오라를 가득 채웁니다. 이는 다른 물질을 밀어내지 않지만, 당신의 키네틱 오라 안에 있는 생물 중 호흡을 위해 공기가 필요한 생물에게 공기를 제공합니다. 원거리 무기로 공격할 때, 그 공격 경로가 당신의 키네틱 오라를 통과한다면 명중 굴림에 -1 상황 페널티를 받습니다. 당신의 키네틱 오라 안의 공기는 당신을 제외한 비행 생물에게 어려운 지형입니다.

name: Magic Rider

description.value: Your people used powerful magic to travel between distant worlds in the distant past, and the remnants of that magic make such transportation easier for you. When you are the target of a teleportation spell that transports more than one person, it can affect an additional person beyond the normal limit, chosen by the caster. Additionally, when you're the target of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.69L70wKfGDY66Mk9]{Teleport} spell, you and the other targets arrive no farther than 1 mile off target, regardless of distance traveled.

_desc_en: Your people used powerful magic to travel between distant worlds in the distant past, and the remnants of that magic make such transportation easier for you. When you are the target of a teleportation spell that transports more than one person, it can affect an additional person beyond the normal limit, chosen by the caster. Additionally, when you're the target of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.69L70wKfGDY66Mk9]{Teleport} spell, you and the other targets arrive no farther than 1 mile off target, regardless of distance traveled.
_desc_ko: 당신의 종족은 먼 과거에 강력한 마법을 사용해 먼 세계 사이를 여행했으며, 그 마법의 잔재가 당신에게 그러한 이동을 더 쉽게 만들어 줍니다. 여러 명을 동시에 이동시키는 순간이동 주문의 대상이 될 때, 시전자가 선택한 한 명을 추가로 정상 한도 이상으로 이동시킬 수 있습니다. 또한 @link[spells.teleport] 주문의 대상이 될 경우, 이동 거리와 무관하게 당신과 다른 대상들은 목표 지점에서 1마일 이내에만 도착합니다.

name: Innate Magical Intuition

description.value: You've spent countless hours learning to recognize and predict a creature's innate magical abilities. The first time you successfully Recall Knowledge to identify a creature, in addition to any information you learn from your successful check, you learn the names of three of the highest-level innate spells it can cast, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your next save against an innate spell cast by that creature.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en: You've spent countless hours learning to recognize and predict a creature's innate magical abilities. The first time you successfully Recall Knowledge to identify a creature, in addition to any information you learn from your successful check, you learn the names of three of the highest-level innate spells it can cast, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your next save against an innate spell cast by that creature.
_desc_ko: 당신은 생물의 선천적 마법 능력을 인식하고 예측하는 법을 익히기 위해 수많은 시간을 보냈습니다. 생물의 신생 마법 능력을 처음으로 성공적으로 식별한 지식 회상 시, 성공한 판정에서 얻은 정보 외에 해당 생물이 시전할 수 있는 최고 레벨 신생 주문 세 가지의 이름을 알게 되며, 그 생물이 시전하는 신생 주문에 대한 다음 내성에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Blowgun Poisoner

description.value:
You can capably deliver toxins with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.FPwsiGqMCNPLHmjX]{Blowgun}. Your blowgun @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{Strikes} can apply injury poisons even if they deal no damage due to a creature's resistance. If you critically succeed at a blowgun Strike using a poisoned dart, the target's initial save against the poison is one degree of success worse than the creature rolls; this is a misfortune effect.

In addition, if you make a blowgun Strike while @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}, you don't automatically become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.1wQY3JYyhMYeeV2G]{Observed}. Instead, immediately attempt a @Check[stealth|against:perception] check against the Perception DC of the target. If you succeed, you don't become observed, and are hidden (if you were undetected, you still become hidden rather than remaining undetected).

_desc_en:
You can capably deliver toxins with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.FPwsiGqMCNPLHmjX]{Blowgun}. Your blowgun @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{Strikes} can apply injury poisons even if they deal no damage due to a creature's resistance. If you critically succeed at a blowgun Strike using a poisoned dart, the target's initial save against the poison is one degree of success worse than the creature rolls; this is a misfortune effect.

In addition, if you make a blowgun Strike while @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}, you don't automatically become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.1wQY3JYyhMYeeV2G]{Observed}. Instead, immediately attempt a @Check[stealth|against:perception] check against the Perception DC of the target. If you succeed, you don't become observed, and are hidden (if you were undetected, you still become hidden rather than remaining undetected).
_desc_ko:
당신은 @link[equipment.blowgun]으로 독을 능숙하게 전달할 수 있습니다. 당신의 블로우건 @link[actions.strike]은 생물의 저항으로 인해 피해를 입히지 못하더라도 상처 독을 적용할 수 있습니다. 독이 묻은 다트를 사용한 블로우건 타격에 대성공 시, 대상의 초기 독 내성 굴림 성공 확률은 생물이 굴린 결과보다 한 단계 낮아집니다. 이는 불운 효과입니다.

또한, @link[conditions.hidden] 상태나 @link[conditions.undetected] 상태에서 블로우건 공격을 강타할 경우, 자동으로 @link[conditions.observed] 상태가 되지 않습니다. 대신 즉시 대상의 지각 DC에 대한 은신 판정을 시도한다. 성공하면 관찰되지 않은 상태가 되지 않으며, 은신 상태가 된다(미탐지 상태였다면 여전히 은신 상태가 되며 미탐지 상태로 남지 않는다).

name: Goblin Song

description.value:
You sing annoying goblin songs, distracting your foes with silly and repetitive lyrics. Attempt a @Check[performance|defense:will] check against the Will DC of a single enemy within 30 feet. This has all the usual traits and restrictions of a Performance check to sing.

You can affect up to two targets within range if you have expert proficiency in Performance, four if you have master proficiency, and eight if you have legendary proficiency.

Critical Success The target takes a –1 status penalty to Perception checks and Will saves for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.bIRIS6mnynr72RDw]{Effect: Goblin Song (Critical Success)}

Success The target takes a –1 status penalty to Perception checks and Will saves for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.5veOBmMYQxywTudd]{Effect: Goblin Song (Success)}

Critical Failure The target is temporarily immune to Goblin Song for 1 hour.

_desc_en:
You sing annoying goblin songs, distracting your foes with silly and repetitive lyrics. Attempt a @Check[performance|defense:will] check against the Will DC of a single enemy within 30 feet. This has all the usual traits and restrictions of a Performance check to sing.

You can affect up to two targets within range if you have expert proficiency in Performance, four if you have master proficiency, and eight if you have legendary proficiency.

Critical Success The target takes a –1 status penalty to Perception checks and Will saves for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.bIRIS6mnynr72RDw]{Effect: Goblin Song (Critical Success)}

Success The target takes a –1 status penalty to Perception checks and Will saves for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.5veOBmMYQxywTudd]{Effect: Goblin Song (Success)}

Critical Failure The target is temporarily immune to Goblin Song for 1 hour.
_desc_ko:
당신은 성가신 고블린 노래를 부르며, 우스꽝스럽고 반복적인 가사로 적의 주의를 분산시킵니다. 30피트 이내의 단일 적을 대상으로 의지 DC에 대한 공연 판정을 시도합니다. 이는 노래를 부르는 공연 판정의 일반적인 특성과 제한 사항을 모두 따릅니다.

공연에 숙련 숙련도를 보유한 경우 범위 내 최대 두 명의 대상에게, 달인 숙련도를 보유한 경우 네 명에게, 전설적 숙련도를 보유한 경우 여덟 명에게 영향을 줄 수 있다.

대성공 대상은 1분 동안 지각 판정 및 의지 내성에 -1 상태 페널티를 받습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.bIRIS6mnynr72RDw]{효과: 고블린 노래 (대성공)}

성공 대상은 1라운드 동안 지각 판정 및 의지 내성에 -1 상태 페널티를 받습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.5veOBmMYQxywTudd]{효과: 고블린 노래 (성공)}

대실패 대상은 1시간 동안 고블린 노래에 일시적으로 면역 상태가 됩니다.

name: Hag Claws

description.value:
When you came of age, your fingernails grew long and sharp. You gain a claw unarmed attack that deals 1d4 slashing damage. Your claws are in the brawling group and have the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits.

Special Hag claws can develop at any point in a changeling's life. You can select this feat anytime you would gain an ancestry feat, but you can't retrain out of it.

_desc_en:
When you came of age, your fingernails grew long and sharp. You gain a claw unarmed attack that deals 1d4 slashing damage. Your claws are in the brawling group and have the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits.

Special Hag claws can develop at any point in a changeling's life. You can select this feat anytime you would gain an ancestry feat, but you can't retrain out of it.
_desc_ko:
성년이 되면서 손톱이 길고 날카롭게 자랐다. 무기 없이 발동하는 발톱 공격을 얻으며, 1d4 베기 피해를 입힌다. 발톱은 격투 무기 그룹에 속하며 기민한, 기교, 비무장 공격 특성을 지닌다.

특수 해그의 발톱은 체인질링의 생애 어느 시점에서든 발달할 수 있다. 이 재주는 조상 재주를 획득할 때마다 선택할 수 있으나, 재훈련으로 포기할 수 없다.

name: Cantorian Restoration

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger A living creature within 60 feet would die.

The energy that flows in your blood can save a life in the direst of times. You prevent the creature from dying and restore @Damage[(6d8+@actor.system.abilities.con.mod)[healing]]{6d8 + your Constitution modifier} Hit Points to it. You can't use Cantorian Restoration if the triggering effect was a death effect or an effect that leaves no remains, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]{Disintegrate}.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger A living creature within 60 feet would die.

The energy that flows in your blood can save a life in the direst of times. You prevent the creature from dying and restore @Damage[(6d8+@actor.system.abilities.con.mod)[healing]]{6d8 + your Constitution modifier} Hit Points to it. You can't use Cantorian Restoration if the triggering effect was a death effect or an effect that leaves no remains, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]{Disintegrate}.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 60피트 내의 생명체가 죽을 뻔했다.

당신의 피 속에 흐르는 에너지는 가장 절박한 순간에 생명을 구할 수 있다. 당신은 그 생물이 죽는 것을 막고 6d8 + 건강 능력치 수정자의 HP를 회복시켜 줍니다. 발동 효과가 사망 효과이거나 @link[spells.disintegrate]처럼 유해를 남기지 않는 효과인 경우 칸토리아의 회복을 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Into the Fray

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a one-handed melee weapon in one hand and a shield in another hand.

You charge into battle with shield-splintering fury. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, Stride, or Swim. Make two melee Strikes during this movement, one with your one-handed melee weapon and one with your shield or a weapon attached to the shield (like a shield boss or shield spikes). You can make these Strikes at any points during your movement, and each must target a different enemy. Both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but don't increase your penalty until you have made both attacks.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a one-handed melee weapon in one hand and a shield in another hand.

You charge into battle with shield-splintering fury. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, Stride, or Swim. Make two melee Strikes during this movement, one with your one-handed melee weapon and one with your shield or a weapon attached to the shield (like a shield boss or shield spikes). You can make these Strikes at any points during your movement, and each must target a different enemy. Both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but don't increase your penalty until you have made both attacks.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 한 손에는 한손 근접 무기를, 다른 손에는 방패를 들고 있어야 합니다.

방패를 산산조각낼 듯한 분노로 전투에 돌진합니다. @link[actions.leap]도약, 이동, 또는 수영을 합니다. 이 이동 중 근접 공격을 두 번 수행합니다. 한 번은 한손 근접 무기로, 다른 한 번은 방패나 방패에 부착된 무기(방패의 돌기나 방패의 가시 등)로 공격합니다. 이 공격들은 이동 중 언제든지 수행할 수 있으며, 각각 다른 적을 대상으로 해야 합니다. 두 공격 모두 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되지만, 두 공격을 모두 수행하기 전까지는 페널티가 증가하지 않습니다.

name: Fey Magic

description.value: You can use faerie magic to hide yourself and expose hidden foes. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HRb2doyaLtaoCfi3]{Faerie Fire} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} each once per day as primal innate spells.

_desc_en: You can use faerie magic to hide yourself and expose hidden foes. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HRb2doyaLtaoCfi3]{Faerie Fire} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} each once per day as primal innate spells.
_desc_ko: 요정 마법을 사용해 자신을 숨기고 숨겨진 적을 드러낼 수 있습니다. @link[spells.faerie-fire]과 @link[spells.invisibility]를 각각 하루에 한 번씩 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Cry of Rebellion

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You let loose a yell of unbridled passion, which fuels your allies, and pounds against your foes. Allies within 60 feet who can hear you gain a +2 status bonus to attack rolls, Perception checks, saving throws, and skill checks for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.AsYHSc1sNEXYELj7]{Effect: Cry of Rebellion}

Additionally, foes within 30 feet of you take @Damage[(@actor.level)d4[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher). This sonic damage increases by 1d4 at 17th level and every level thereafter.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

You let loose a yell of unbridled passion, which fuels your allies, and pounds against your foes. Allies within 60 feet who can hear you gain a +2 status bonus to attack rolls, Perception checks, saving throws, and skill checks for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.AsYHSc1sNEXYELj7]{Effect: Cry of Rebellion}

Additionally, foes within 30 feet of you take @Damage[(@actor.level)d4[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher). This sonic damage increases by 1d4 at 17th level and every level thereafter.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

당신은 억제할 수 없는 열정의 함성을 내지르며, 이 함성은 아군에게는 힘을 불어넣고 적에게는 강타를 가한다. 60피트 내의 아군 중 당신의 함성을 들을 수 있는 자는 1분 동안 명중 굴림, 지각 판정, 내성 굴림, 기술 판정에서 +2 상태 보너스를 얻는다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.AsYHSc1sNEXYELj7]{효과: 반란의 함성}

또한, 30피트 내의 적들은 음파의 피해를 입는다 (기본 인내 네 직업 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 더 높은 것에 대한 저항 검사). 이 음파 피해는 17레벨 이후 매 레벨마다 1d4씩 증가한다.

name: Impaling Finisher

description.value:
You stab two foes with a single thrust or bash them together with one punch.

Make a bludgeoning or piercing melee Strike and compare the attack roll result against the AC of up to two foes. One foe must be adjacent to you, and the other foe must be adjacent to and directly behind the first foe, in a straight line from your space.

Roll damage once and apply it to each creature you hit. An Impaling Finisher counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty.

_desc_en:
You stab two foes with a single thrust or bash them together with one punch.

Make a bludgeoning or piercing melee Strike and compare the attack roll result against the AC of up to two foes. One foe must be adjacent to you, and the other foe must be adjacent to and directly behind the first foe, in a straight line from your space.

Roll damage once and apply it to each creature you hit. An Impaling Finisher counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty.
_desc_ko:
한 번의 찌르기로 두 적을 찌르거나 한 번의 주먹으로 두 적을 함께 내리친다.

타격하거나 관통하는 근접 공격을 수행하고, 최대 두 명의 적의 AC에 대해 명중 굴림 결과를 비교한다. 한 명은 당신과 인접해야 하며, 다른 한 명은 첫 번째 적과 인접하고 당신의 위치에서 직선으로 이어지는 직선 상에 첫 번째 적의 바로 뒤에 위치해야 한다.

피격한 모든 생물에게 한 번의 피해를 굴려 적용한다. 관통 마무리 공격은 다중 공격 페널티 계산 시 두 번의 공격으로 간주된다.

name: Glacial Prison

description.value:
Intense cold swirls around your foe, covering it in frost that slows it down and turns its body to ice. Target a creature you can observe within 120 feet. It must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:kineticist] save against your class DC. The creature is then temporarily immune for 24 hours.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of its next turn.

Failure The target is frozen solid. It can't act, its AC is 9, it has Hardness 5, and it's immune to other cold effects, critical hits, and precision damage. This lasts until the end of your next turn, but if the target is affected by a hostile action, this effect ends immediately after that action.

Critical Failure As failure, but after becoming unfrozen, the creature is slowed 1 until the end of its next turn.

_desc_en:
Intense cold swirls around your foe, covering it in frost that slows it down and turns its body to ice. Target a creature you can observe within 120 feet. It must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:kineticist] save against your class DC. The creature is then temporarily immune for 24 hours.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of its next turn.

Failure The target is frozen solid. It can't act, its AC is 9, it has Hardness 5, and it's immune to other cold effects, critical hits, and precision damage. This lasts until the end of your next turn, but if the target is affected by a hostile action, this effect ends immediately after that action.

Critical Failure As failure, but after becoming unfrozen, the creature is slowed 1 until the end of its next turn.
_desc_ko:
강렬한 추위가 적 주위를 휘감으며 서리로 덮어 속도를 늦추고 몸을 얼음으로 변하게 합니다. 120피트 내 관측 가능한 생물을 대상으로 지정합니다. 대상은 당신의 직업 난이도(DC)에 대한 인내 저항 검사를 시도해야 합니다. 해당 생물은 이후 24시간 동안 일시적으로 면역 상태가 된다.

대성공 대상은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 대상은 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.slowed]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

실패 대상은 완전히 얼어붙습니다. 행동할 수 없으며, AC는 9, 경도는 5이며, 다른 냉기 효과, 치명타, 정밀 피해에 면역입니다. 이 효과는 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 지속되지만, 대상이 적대적 행동의 영향을 받으면 해당 행동 직후 즉시 종료됩니다.

대실패 실패와 동일하나, 해동된 후 해당 생물은 다음 턴 종료 시까지 이동 속도가 1 느려짐.

name: Three Pecks of Dew

description.value:
At this stage of cultivation, your body is as much spirit as flesh. While still fettered to the physical realm, your form flourishes without needing conventional food or drink, and your natural healing now rivals that brought by scalpel and suture.

You become sanctified with the holy trait. When you perform the Subsist downtime activity, you can use Occultism for the skill check (instead of the skills normally associated with your environment). If you do so, this activity gains the vitality trait as you subsist on ambient qi within your environment's dew-laden air and create shelter from solidified emanations of qi.

Additionally, when you Refocus, you can also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} at the same time. If you do so, you can use Occultism for checks to Treat Wounds and disregard the need for a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.s1vB3HdXjMigYAnY]{Healer's Toolkit}; this activity gains the vitality trait as you circulate healing qi through your own body or transfuse your ally with healing qi.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
At this stage of cultivation, your body is as much spirit as flesh. While still fettered to the physical realm, your form flourishes without needing conventional food or drink, and your natural healing now rivals that brought by scalpel and suture.

You become sanctified with the holy trait. When you perform the Subsist downtime activity, you can use Occultism for the skill check (instead of the skills normally associated with your environment). If you do so, this activity gains the vitality trait as you subsist on ambient qi within your environment's dew-laden air and create shelter from solidified emanations of qi.

Additionally, when you Refocus, you can also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} at the same time. If you do so, you can use Occultism for checks to Treat Wounds and disregard the need for a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.s1vB3HdXjMigYAnY]{Healer's Toolkit}; this activity gains the vitality trait as you circulate healing qi through your own body or transfuse your ally with healing qi.
_desc_ko:
이 경지에 이르러 당신의 육체는 영혼과 다름없습니다. 여전히 물리적 영역에 속박되어 있지만, 일반적인 음식이나 음료 없이도 형태가 번성하며, 자연 치유력은 이제 수술과 봉합에 버금갑니다.

당신은 신성한 특성을 부여받아 성화됩니다. '생존' 다운타임 활동을 수행할 때, 환경과 연관된 일반 기술 대신 오컬트를 기술 검사 수단으로 사용할 수 있습니다. 이를 선택할 경우, 이 활동은 활력 특성을 획득합니다. 이는 이슬 낀 공기 속의 주변 기(氣)를 흡수하며 생존하고, 응결된 기의 발산으로 피난처를 창조하기 때문입니다.

추가로, 재집중 시 동시에 @link[actions.treat-wounds]를 수행할 수 있습니다. 이 경우, 상처 치료 판정 시 오컬트를 사용할 수 있으며 @link[equipment.healers-toolkit]가 필요하지 않습니다. 이 활동은 자신의 몸에 치유 기를 순환시키거나 아군에게 치유 기를 수혈함으로써 활력 특성을 획득합니다.

name: Reliable Luck

description.value: You survive danger with surprising regularity. You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7qBuzHY8kEG8SdEP]{Cat's Luck} once per hour, rather than once per day.

_desc_en: You survive danger with surprising regularity. You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7qBuzHY8kEG8SdEP]{Cat's Luck} once per hour, rather than once per day.
_desc_ko: 당신은 놀라울 정도로 꾸준히 위험에서 살아남는다. @link[feats.cats-luck]을 하루에 한 번이 아닌 시간당 한 번 사용할 수 있다.

name: Sunbird Glare

description.value:
Requirements You're in bright light.

By keeping your feathers clean and sleek, you can catch the light across your wings to create a startling glare in the eyes of a creature within 20 feet. The target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:class] save against your class DC or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round (1 minute on a critical failure). Regardless of their result, the target is temporarily immune to Sunbird Glare for 10 minutes.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're in bright light.

By keeping your feathers clean and sleek, you can catch the light across your wings to create a startling glare in the eyes of a creature within 20 feet. The target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:class] save against your class DC or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round (1 minute on a critical failure). Regardless of their result, the target is temporarily immune to Sunbird Glare for 10 minutes.
_desc_ko:
Requirements 당신은 밝은 빛 속에 있습니다.

깃털을 깨끗하고 매끈하게 유지함으로써, 날개에 비친 빛을 포착해 20피트 이내의 생물 눈에 놀랄 만한 눈부심을 일으킬 수 있습니다. 대상은 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 인내 내성에 성공해야 하며, 실패 시 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.dazzled] 상태가 됩니다(대실패 시 1분). 결과와 상관없이 대상은 10분 동안 선버드 눈부심에 일시적으로 면역됩니다.

name: Expert Captivator Spellcasting

description.value: You learn more powerful spells to enchant and deceive. You learn a 4th-rank occult spell. At 12th level, you learn a 5th-rank spell, and at 14th level, you learn a 6th-rank spell. Each of these spells must come from either the enchantment or illusion school. You Cast these Spells as occult innate spells. You become an expert with spell attack rolls and spell DCs for occult spells.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en: You learn more powerful spells to enchant and deceive. You learn a 4th-rank occult spell. At 12th level, you learn a 5th-rank spell, and at 14th level, you learn a 6th-rank spell. Each of these spells must come from either the enchantment or illusion school. You Cast these Spells as occult innate spells. You become an expert with spell attack rolls and spell DCs for occult spells.
_desc_ko: 더 강력한 주문으로 매혹하고 속이는 법을 배웁니다. 4랭크 오컬트 주문을 배운다. 12레벨에 5랭크 주문을, 14레벨에 6랭크 주문을 배운다. 이 주문들은 반드시 매혹 또는 환상 계열에서 선택해야 한다. 이 주문들은 오컬트 선천적 주문으로 시전한다. 오컬트 주문의 주문 명중 굴림과 주문 난이도(DC)에 대해 전문가가 된다.

name: Bloody Debilitation

description.value:
Your attacks slice arteries and veins. Add the following debilitation to the list you can choose from when you use Debilitating Strike.

  • Debilitation The target takes @Damage[3d6[bleed]] damage.

_desc_en:
Your attacks slice arteries and veins. Add the following debilitation to the list you can choose from when you use Debilitating Strike.

  • Debilitation The target takes @Damage[3d6[bleed]] damage.
_desc_ko:
당신의 공격은 동맥과 정맥을 베어 넘깁니다. 쇠약 타격을 사용할 때 선택할 수 있는 쇠약 효과 목록에 다음을 추가하십시오.

  • 쇠약 대상은 3d6 출혈의 피해를 입습니다.

name: Vicious Snares

description.value: You deal an additional 1d6 precision damage with damage snares you craft. This increases to 2d6 additional precision damage if you're legendary in Crafting.

_desc_en: You deal an additional 1d6 precision damage with damage snares you craft. This increases to 2d6 additional precision damage if you're legendary in Crafting.
_desc_ko: 제작한 피해 덫에 추가로 1d6 정밀 피해를 입힙니다. 제작 기술이 전설 등급일 경우 추가 정밀 피해가 2d6로 증가합니다.

name: Ward Casting

description.value:
Trigger You attempt a flat check for Steady Spellcasting, but you haven't rolled yet.

You carefully ward your spell by drawing from a mantle of magical energy you prepared to protect your casting, increasing your chance of retaining the spell. You reduce the DC of the flat check for Steady Spellcasting from 15 to 10.

_desc_en:
Trigger You attempt a flat check for Steady Spellcasting, but you haven't rolled yet.

You carefully ward your spell by drawing from a mantle of magical energy you prepared to protect your casting, increasing your chance of retaining the spell. You reduce the DC of the flat check for Steady Spellcasting from 15 to 10.
_desc_ko:
트리거 당신은 안정된 주문 시전을 위한 단순 판정을 시도하지만, 아직 주사위를 굴리지 않았습니다.

당신은 주문을 수호부하기 위해 미리 준비해 둔 마법 에너지의 장막에서 힘을 끌어내어 주문을 신중하게 수호합니다. 이로 인해 주문을 유지할 확률이 높아집니다. 안정된 주문 시전 단순 판정 난이도(DC)를 15에서 10으로 낮춥니다.

name: Spell Survivor

description.value: Once you've resisted an opponent's magic, anything else they throw your way becomes less effective. When you attempt a saving throw against a spell using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.EFhh3AenX7wtAmrs]{Orc Superstition} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.VphmK5JRR35SyEhV]{Pervasive Superstition} and critically succeed, you gain resistance 1 to all damage dealt by that triggering spell's caster until the end of their next turn. At 9th level and every 4 levels thereafter, the resistance increases by 1.

_desc_en: Once you've resisted an opponent's magic, anything else they throw your way becomes less effective. When you attempt a saving throw against a spell using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.EFhh3AenX7wtAmrs]{Orc Superstition} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.VphmK5JRR35SyEhV]{Pervasive Superstition} and critically succeed, you gain resistance 1 to all damage dealt by that triggering spell's caster until the end of their next turn. At 9th level and every 4 levels thereafter, the resistance increases by 1.
_desc_ko: 상대의 마법에 한 번 저항하면, 그 상대가 던지는 다른 마법은 효과가 약해진다. 당신이 내성 굴림을 시도하는 경우를 제외하고는, 당신이 내성 굴림을 시도하는 경우를 제외하고는, 당신이 내성 굴림을 시도하는 경우를 제외하고 @link[feats.orc-superstition] 또는 @link[feats.pervasive-superstition]을 사용하여 마법에 대한 저항 검사를 시도하고 대성공할 경우, 해당 마법을 시전한 시전자가 가하는 모든 피해에 대해 저항력 1을 얻으며, 이는 시전자의 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 지속됩니다. 9레벨에 도달하고 이후 4레벨마다 저항력이 1씩 증가합니다.

name: Clinging Shadows Initiate

description.value: You learn a mystical stance that transforms your qi into sticky smoke that shrouds your limbs. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uJXs4M6IeixfPBLc]{Clinging Shadows Stance} qi spell. While entering the stance is a qi spell, the shadow grasp attacks it grants are not, so you can use them as often as you like while in the stance.

_desc_en: You learn a mystical stance that transforms your qi into sticky smoke that shrouds your limbs. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uJXs4M6IeixfPBLc]{Clinging Shadows Stance} qi spell. While entering the stance is a qi spell, the shadow grasp attacks it grants are not, so you can use them as often as you like while in the stance.
_desc_ko: 당신은 신비로운 자세를 익혀 기를 끈적한 연기로 변환하여 사지를 감쌉니다. @link[spells.clinging-shadows-stance] 기 주문을 얻습니다. 자세를 취하는 것은 기 주문이지만, 이 자세가 부여하는 그림자 잡기 공격은 기 주문이 아니므로 자세를 취하는 동안 원하는 만큼 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Inexorable

description.value:
You imbue yourself with the resilience of the cave worm. When you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} condition, roll a @Check[flat|dc:15]. On a success you ignore the condition.

When using Worm Form you are immune to penalties to your Speed and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} condition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} you, and you ignore difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain.

publication.title: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm

_desc_en:
You imbue yourself with the resilience of the cave worm. When you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} condition, roll a @Check[flat|dc:15]. On a success you ignore the condition.

When using Worm Form you are immune to penalties to your Speed and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} condition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} you, and you ignore difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain.
_desc_ko:
당신은 동굴 벌레의 회복력을 몸에 새깁니다. 당신이 @link[conditions.paralyzed], @link[conditions.slowed], 또는 @link[conditions.stunned] 상태를 얻었을 때, DC 15 단순를 굴립니다. 성공 시 해당 상태를 무시합니다.

벌레 형태 사용 시, 이동 속도 페널티와 @link[conditions.immobilized] 상태에 면역이 되며, 다음 시도를 저지하기 위해 인내 또는 반사 DC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다: @link[actions.shove] 또는 @link[actions.trip] 시도에 대한 인내 또는 반사 DC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 어려운 지형과 매우 어려운 지형을 무시합니다.

name: Momentous Charge

description.value:
Requirements You're in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BQWGOK0lVmljCunm]{Rushing Goat Stance}.

You rush into your enemies with great and reckless force. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb}, Stride, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, then make a ramming horn Strike. On a success, the target of the Strike is pushed up to 10 feet directly away from you. On a critical success, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Requirements You're in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BQWGOK0lVmljCunm]{Rushing Goat Stance}.

You rush into your enemies with great and reckless force. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb}, Stride, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, then make a ramming horn Strike. On a success, the target of the Strike is pushed up to 10 feet directly away from you. On a critical success, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 @link[feats.rushing-goat-stance]에 있다.

당신은 거칠고 무모한 힘으로 적에게 돌진합니다. 당신은 @link[actions.climb], 이동, 또는 @link[actions.leap]를 사용한 후, 뿔로 들이받는 강타를 가합니다. 성공 시, 강타 대상은 당신으로부터 최대 10피트까지 직선으로 밀려납니다. 대성공 시, 대상은 @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태가 된다.

name: Repel Darkness

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Your stoicism and courage seem to drive off darkness and shadow. For 1 minute, you suppress magical darkness effects of a rank equal to or lower than half your level rounded up within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10]. This doesn't provide light, but merely restores the area to its natural illumination level. You can Dismiss this aura.

If your horse is at least a mature animal companion, you can use Repel Darkness to cause the aura to emanate from your horse instead of you, as long as your horse is within 100 feet.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Your stoicism and courage seem to drive off darkness and shadow. For 1 minute, you suppress magical darkness effects of a rank equal to or lower than half your level rounded up within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10]. This doesn't provide light, but merely restores the area to its natural illumination level. You can Dismiss this aura.

If your horse is at least a mature animal companion, you can use Repel Darkness to cause the aura to emanate from your horse instead of you, as long as your horse is within 100 feet.
_desc_ko:
빈도 시간당 1회

당신의 극기심과 용기가 어둠과 그림자를 몰아내는 듯합니다. 1분 동안, 당신은 @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] 내에서 당신 레벨의 절반(올림)과 같거나 낮은 랭크의 마법 어둠 효과를 억제합니다. 이는 빛을 제공하지 않으며, 단지 해당 지역을 자연스러운 조명 수준으로 복원할 뿐입니다. 당신은 이 오라를 해제할 수 있습니다.

당신의 말이 최소한 성숙한 동물 동료라면, 당신의 말이 100피트 내에 있는 한, 어둠 물리치기를 사용하여 오라가 당신 대신 말에게서 발산되도록 할 수 있습니다.

name: Pathfinder Agent Dedication

description.value:
Access You are from Absalom.

Your Pathfinder training has broadened your horizons and made you more flexible at various skills, since you never know when you might need an obscure skill to complete your mission. You become trained in one skill of your choice, or expert in a skill of your choice in which you were trained. You also become trained in Pathfinder Lore, or an expert if you were already trained. When using a skill untrained, your proficiency bonus is equal to your level instead of 0. You gain access to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.gbwr57aT9ou8yKWT]{wayfinders}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.fTxZjmNLckRwZ4Po]{Pathfinder Agent}

_desc_en:
Access You are from Absalom.

Your Pathfinder training has broadened your horizons and made you more flexible at various skills, since you never know when you might need an obscure skill to complete your mission. You become trained in one skill of your choice, or expert in a skill of your choice in which you were trained. You also become trained in Pathfinder Lore, or an expert if you were already trained. When using a skill untrained, your proficiency bonus is equal to your level instead of 0. You gain access to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.gbwr57aT9ou8yKWT]{wayfinders}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.fTxZjmNLckRwZ4Po]{Pathfinder Agent}
_desc_ko:
Access 당신은 압살롬 출신입니다.

당신의 패스파인더 훈련은 시야를 넓히고 다양한 기술에 더 유연하게 대처할 수 있게 했습니다. 임무를 완수하기 위해 언제 희귀한 기술이 필요할지 모르기 때문입니다. 선택한 한 가지 기술에 숙련되거나, 이미 숙련된 선택한 기술에 전문가가 됩니다. 또한 패스파인더 지식에 숙련되거나, 이미 숙련 상태였다면 패스파인더 전문가가 됩니다. 숙련되지 않은 기술을 사용할 때 숙련 보너스는 0이 아닌 자신의 레벨만큼 적용됩니다. @link[equipment.wayfinder]를 사용할 수 있게 됩니다.

name: Recollect Studies

description.value:
Requirements You're fighting a creature of your level or lower that could be identified by Recall Knowledge with a skill in which you're an expert.

You paid attention during your studies and remember the right way to attack various creatures. Choose a creature that meets the requirements. You learn the resistances, immunities, or weaknesses of the creature (your choice) without needing to successfully Recall Knowledge.

value.value: expert in a skill used to Recall Knowledge

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en:
Requirements You're fighting a creature of your level or lower that could be identified by Recall Knowledge with a skill in which you're an expert.

You paid attention during your studies and remember the right way to attack various creatures. Choose a creature that meets the requirements. You learn the resistances, immunities, or weaknesses of the creature (your choice) without needing to successfully Recall Knowledge.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신이 전문 분야인 기술로 지식 회상을 통해 식별 가능한, 자신과 동급 이하의 생물과 전투 중일 것.

공부할 때 집중해서 다양한 생물을 공격하는 올바른 방법을 기억하고 있습니다. 조건에 맞는 생물을 선택하세요. 지식 회상에 성공하지 않아도 해당 생물의 저항력, 면역력 또는 약점(선택)을 알게 됩니다.

name: Shield Wall

description.value:
Trigger Your shield is raised and an adjacent ally Raises a Shield.

You use your shield in tandem with an ally's, forming a barricade. Both you and the triggering creature have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.other-effects.Item.I9lfZUiCwMiGogVi]{Standard Cover} as long as you remain adjacent to each other and you both have your shields raised; when this is no longer the case, the effect ends. You and your ally can't use this cover to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}, as it's obvious you're standing there holding your shields, but you and your ally can use it to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover}. Normally, if you and your ally don't move, Shield Wall lasts until the beginning of your next turn, when your shield is no longer raised.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en:
Trigger Your shield is raised and an adjacent ally Raises a Shield.

You use your shield in tandem with an ally's, forming a barricade. Both you and the triggering creature have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.other-effects.Item.I9lfZUiCwMiGogVi]{Standard Cover} as long as you remain adjacent to each other and you both have your shields raised; when this is no longer the case, the effect ends. You and your ally can't use this cover to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}, as it's obvious you're standing there holding your shields, but you and your ally can use it to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover}. Normally, if you and your ally don't move, Shield Wall lasts until the beginning of your next turn, when your shield is no longer raised.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신의 방패가 치켜올라가고 인접한 아군이 방패를 치켜든다.

당신은 아군의 방패와 함께 방패를 사용해 바리케이드를 형성합니다. 당신과 방패를 든 상태로 서로 인접해 있는 동안, 당신과 방패를 든 아군 모두 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.other-effects.Item.I9lfZUiCwMiGogVi]{표준 엄폐}를 얻습니다. 이 조건이 충족되지 않으면 효과는 종료됩니다. 당신과 아군은 이 엄폐를 @link[actions.hide]에 사용할 수 없습니다. 방패를 들고 서 있는 모습이 명백하기 때문입니다. 그러나 @link[actions.take-cover]에는 사용할 수 있습니다. 일반적으로 당신과 아군이 움직이지 않으면, 방패 벽은 다음 턴 시작 시까지 지속됩니다. 이때 당신의 방패는 더 이상 들어 올려져 있지 않습니다.

name: Greater Merciful Elixir

description.value: Your additives contain panaceas that can remedy a plethora of maladies. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Mvw3ZFrdwMHedAxY]{Merciful Elixir}, your elixir can instead attempt to counteract the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} condition.

_desc_en: Your additives contain panaceas that can remedy a plethora of maladies. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Mvw3ZFrdwMHedAxY]{Merciful Elixir}, your elixir can instead attempt to counteract the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} condition.
_desc_ko: 당신의 첨가물에는 수많은 질병을 치료할 수 있는 만병통치약이 포함되어 있습니다. @link[feats.merciful-elixir]를 사용할 때, 당신의 엘릭서는 대신 @link[conditions.blinded]에 반격하려고 시도합니다. @link[conditions.deafened], @link[conditions.sickened], 또는 @link[conditions.slowed] 상태를 상쇄하려 시도할 수 있습니다.

name: Guarded Thoughts

description.value: Your mind, like a dark naga's, foils attempts to read your thoughts. Any effect that specifically attempts to read your mind to glean information must succeed at a counteract check against the higher of your class DC or your spell DC to do so successfully; otherwise, it gains no information. The counteract rank is equal to half your level rounded up.

_desc_en: Your mind, like a dark naga's, foils attempts to read your thoughts. Any effect that specifically attempts to read your mind to glean information must succeed at a counteract check against the higher of your class DC or your spell DC to do so successfully; otherwise, it gains no information. The counteract rank is equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 당신의 정신은 어둠의 나가처럼, 당신의 생각을 읽으려고 시도하는 것을 좌절시킵니다. 정보를 얻기 위해 당신의 마음을 읽으려고 시도하는 모든 효과는 성공하려면 당신의 직업 난이도(DC)와 주문 난이도(DC) 중 높은 쪽에 대한 반격 판정에 성공해야 합니다. 그렇지 않으면 아무런 정보도 얻지 못합니다. 반격 랭크은 당신의 레벨 절반을 올림한 수치와 같습니다.

name: Arcane School Spell

description.value: You gain your school's initial school spell. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OSefkMgojBLqmRDh]{Refocus} by studying.

_desc_en: You gain your school's initial school spell. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OSefkMgojBLqmRDh]{Refocus} by studying.
_desc_ko: 해당 학파의 기본 학파 주문을 획득합니다. 아직 보유하지 않은 경우, 1 포커스 포인트의 포커스 풀을 얻으며, 이는 @link[actions.refocus]을 통해 연구로 전환할 수 있습니다.

name: Elemental Trade

description.value: You have a strong connection with stone and metal. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Crafting.
