_desc_ko:
접근티엔 샤 출신

당신은 기가 몸을 흐르는 경로를 연구했습니다. 치료사 도구함에 보관된 침은 특정 경혈점에 적용될 때 기의 흐름을 조작하고 건강을 개선할 수 있습니다. 동료를 하루 동안 관찰하여 의학 판정을 시도해 동료를 위한 표준 DC(동료 레벨 기준)로 그들의 기를 개선할 수 있습니다. 그러면 해당 동료는 1주간 모든 침술사 기술 사용에 면역이 됩니다.

대성공동료에게 다음 일주일 내 다운타임 활동 기술 판정 중 하나에 +2 상황 보너스를 선택하거나, 다음 일주일 내 질병 내성 굴림에서 두 번 굴려 높은 결과를 적용할 수 있는 능력을 부여합니다. 이는 행운 효과입니다.

성공 당신은 아군에게 향후 일주일 내 한 번의 다운타임 활동 기술 판정에서 +1 상황 보너스를 부여합니다.

대실패 아군이 향후 일주일 동안 수행하는 모든 다운타임 활동 기술 판정에서 -1 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.fHM9xvCBWrBqcDQY]{효과: 침술사}

name: Orc Sight

description.value:
Your orc blood grants you the keen vision of your forebears. You gain darkvision, allowing you to see in darkness and dim light just as well as you can in bright light. However, in darkness, you see in black and white only.

Special You can take this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain out of this feat or into this feat.

_desc_en:
Your orc blood grants you the keen vision of your forebears. You gain darkvision, allowing you to see in darkness and dim light just as well as you can in bright light. However, in darkness, you see in black and white only.

Special You can take this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain out of this feat or into this feat.
_desc_ko:
오크의 피는 선조들의 예리한 시력을 부여합니다. 암흑 시야를 얻어 어둠과 희미한 빛 속에서도 밝은 빛 아래와 똑같이 잘 볼 수 있습니다. 다만 어둠 속에서는 흑백으로만 보입니다.

특수 이 피트는 1레벨에서만 선택할 수 있으며, 재훈련으로 이 피트를 포기하거나 다시 선택할 수 없습니다.

name: Aura Expertise

description.value:
Trigger Your turn begins.

You've become so accustomed to maintaining your battle auras that it's become second nature to you. You immediately gain the effects of the Sustain action for one of your battle auras.

_desc_en:
Trigger Your turn begins.

You've become so accustomed to maintaining your battle auras that it's become second nature to you. You immediately gain the effects of the Sustain action for one of your battle auras.
_desc_ko:
Trigger 당신의 턴이 시작됩니다.

전투 오라를 유지하는 데 너무 익숙해져서 이제는 본능적으로 이루어집니다. 당신의 전투 오라 중 하나에 대해 즉시 지속 행동의 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Triggerbrand Salvo

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a combination weapon.

You slice, stab, or batter your opponent with the melee portion of your combination weapon before pulling the trigger at point-blank range. Make a melee Strike with your combination weapon. If the Strike is successful, you can immediately make a ranged Strike against the same target with that combination weapon, and you get a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll. This counts as two attacks toward your multiple attack penalty, but you don't apply the multiple attack penalty until after making both attacks.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a combination weapon.

You slice, stab, or batter your opponent with the melee portion of your combination weapon before pulling the trigger at point-blank range. Make a melee Strike with your combination weapon. If the Strike is successful, you can immediately make a ranged Strike against the same target with that combination weapon, and you get a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll. This counts as two attacks toward your multiple attack penalty, but you don't apply the multiple attack penalty until after making both attacks.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 복합 무기를 장비하고 있어야 합니다.

근접 무기 부분으로 상대를 베거나 찌르거나 내리친 후, 근접 거리에서 방아쇠를 당깁니다. 복합 무기로 근접 공격을 수행하십시오. 공격이 성공하면, 동일한 대상에게 해당 복합 무기로 즉시 원거리 공격을 수행할 수 있으며, 명중 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 받습니다. 이는 다중 공격 페널티에 대해 두 번의 공격으로 간주되지만, 두 공격을 모두 수행한 후에야 다중 공격 페널티가 적용됩니다.

name: Call Gun

description.value: You build a powerful magical connection with a chosen gun or crossbow. During your daily preparations, choose a single crossbow or firearm. Until your next daily preparations, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ESMIHOOahLQoqxW1]{Call Gun} action to call the gun to your hand.

_desc_en: You build a powerful magical connection with a chosen gun or crossbow. During your daily preparations, choose a single crossbow or firearm. Until your next daily preparations, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ESMIHOOahLQoqxW1]{Call Gun} action to call the gun to your hand.
_desc_ko: 선택한 총기 또는 석궁과 강력한 마법적 연결을 구축합니다. 일일 준비 단계에서 석궁 또는 화기 중 하나를 선택하세요. 다음 일일 준비 단계까지 @link[actions.call-gun] 행동을 사용하여 해당 무기를 손에 소환할 수 있습니다.

name: Dragon Roar

description.value:
Requirements You are in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.8sy3sHwOHS4ImwvJ]{Dragon Stance}

You bellow, instilling fear in your enemies. Enemies within a @Template[emanation|distance:15] must succeed at a @Check[will|against:intimidation|options:area-effect,inflicts:frightened] save against your Intimidation DC or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure). When a creature frightened by the roar begins its turn adjacent to you, it can't reduce its frightened value below 1 on that turn.

Your first attack that hits a frightened creature after you roar and before the end of your next turn gains a +4 circumstance bonus to damage.

After you use Dragon Roar, you can't use it again for [[/r 1d4 #Recharge Dragon Roar]]{1d4 rounds}. Its effects end immediately if you leave Dragon Stance. Creatures in the area are then temporarily immune for 1 minute.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.8sy3sHwOHS4ImwvJ]{Dragon Stance}

You bellow, instilling fear in your enemies. Enemies within a @Template[emanation|distance:15] must succeed at a @Check[will|against:intimidation|options:area-effect,inflicts:frightened] save against your Intimidation DC or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure). When a creature frightened by the roar begins its turn adjacent to you, it can't reduce its frightened value below 1 on that turn.

Your first attack that hits a frightened creature after you roar and before the end of your next turn gains a +4 circumstance bonus to damage.

After you use Dragon Roar, you can't use it again for [[/r 1d4 #Recharge Dragon Roar]]{1d4 rounds}. Its effects end immediately if you leave Dragon Stance. Creatures in the area are then temporarily immune for 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 @link[feats.dragon-stance]

상태에 있어야 합니다.

당신은 포효하며 적들에게 공포를 심어줍니다. 15피트 범위 내의 적들은 당신의 위협 DC에 대한 의지 내성에 성공해야 합니다. 실패 시 @link[conditions.frightened]{1}(@link[conditions.frightened]{2}는 대실패 시). 포효로 공포 상태가 된 생물이 당신과 인접한 상태로 자신의 턴을 시작할 경우, 해당 턴 동안 공포 상태 수치를 1 이하로 낮출 수 없다.

포효 후 다음 턴 종료 전까지 공포 상태 생물을 명중시킨 첫 공격은 피해에 +4 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

용의 포효 사용 후 1d4 라운드 동안 재사용 불가. 용의 자세를 해제하면 효과가 즉시 종료되며, 해당 영역 내 생물들은 1분간 일시적으로 면역 상태가 된다.

name: Fierce Competitor

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You challenge a single ally to a physical competition. This competition must involve accomplishing a specific goal for a specific use of the Acrobatics or Athletics skill, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climbing} to the top of a wall, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Tripping} a specific foe, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jumping} across a chasm. You and your selected ally gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the associated skill check for 1 minute or until one of you wins the challenge, whichever is first. If you win this competition, you gain a +2 status bonus to Intimidation checks for 1 hour.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You challenge a single ally to a physical competition. This competition must involve accomplishing a specific goal for a specific use of the Acrobatics or Athletics skill, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climbing} to the top of a wall, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Tripping} a specific foe, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jumping} across a chasm. You and your selected ally gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the associated skill check for 1 minute or until one of you wins the challenge, whichever is first. If you win this competition, you gain a +2 status bonus to Intimidation checks for 1 hour.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신은 한 명의 아군에게 육체적 경쟁을 제안합니다. 이 경쟁은 곡예 또는 운동 스킬의 특정 사용을 위한 특정 목표 달성을 포함해야 합니다. 예를 들어 @link[actions.climb]으로 벽 꼭대기에 오르기, @link[actions.trip] 특정 적을 넘어뜨리기, @link[actions.long-jump] 협곡 건너뛰기 등. 당신과 선택한 아군은 1분 동안 또는 도전 중 한 쪽이 승리할 때까지, 먼저 도달하는 시점까지 해당 기술 판정에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 경쟁에서 승리하면 1시간 동안 협박 판정에서 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Natural Ambassador

description.value: You remember what it was like to speak easily with other animals, using old, familiar ways of communication to learn what they want and ask for favors in return. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with all animals, not just those of your kind. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy when you do, or a +2 circumstance bonus with animals of your kind.

_desc_en: You remember what it was like to speak easily with other animals, using old, familiar ways of communication to learn what they want and ask for favors in return. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with all animals, not just those of your kind. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy when you do, or a +2 circumstance bonus with animals of your kind.
_desc_ko: 다른 동물들과 쉽게 대화하던 시절을 기억합니다. 오래되고 패밀리어한 의사소통 방식으로 그들의 요구를 알아내고, 그 대가로 호의를 요청하던 방식이죠. 자신의 종족이 아닌 모든 동물에게 질문하고, 답변을 받으며, 외교 기술을 사용할 수 있습니다. 이때 외교에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 같은 종족 동물에게는 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Prismatic Scales

description.value: You can cause your scales to glow with scintillating, many-hued colors, protecting you from energy while dazzling foes. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4nEY2BcV85wavKLO]{Prismatic Armor} as an occult innate spell, except the spell alters the coloration of your scales instead of causing you to be clad in armor. This difference is cosmetic, and the spell has all the same effects as normal.

_desc_en: You can cause your scales to glow with scintillating, many-hued colors, protecting you from energy while dazzling foes. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4nEY2BcV85wavKLO]{Prismatic Armor} as an occult innate spell, except the spell alters the coloration of your scales instead of causing you to be clad in armor. This difference is cosmetic, and the spell has all the same effects as normal.
_desc_ko: 당신은 비늘을 반짝이는 다채로운 색으로 빛나게 하여 에너지를 막고 적을 현혹시킬 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, @link[spells.prismatic-armor]을 오컬트 선천적 주문으로 시전할 수 있다. 단, 이 주문은 갑옷을 입히는 대신 비늘의 색채를 변화시킨다. 이 차이는 외관상의 차이일 뿐, 주문은 일반적인 효과와 동일하게 적용된다.

name: Emissary of Peace

description.value: Even when bloodshed is inevitable, you would rather see your foes surrender. You attempt a Diplomacy check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} against a single foe whose Hit Points are at less than half of their maximum value, followed by an immediate Request to convince that creature to cease fighting. You take a -5 penalty to your Diplomacy check. The GM sets the DC of the Request based on the circumstances; it's generally at least a very hard DC for the creature's level. Some creatures might simply refuse, and those who agree to parley might find your arguments lacking and start fighting again.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en: Even when bloodshed is inevitable, you would rather see your foes surrender. You attempt a Diplomacy check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} against a single foe whose Hit Points are at less than half of their maximum value, followed by an immediate Request to convince that creature to cease fighting. You take a -5 penalty to your Diplomacy check. The GM sets the DC of the Request based on the circumstances; it's generally at least a very hard DC for the creature's level. Some creatures might simply refuse, and those who agree to parley might find your arguments lacking and start fighting again.
_desc_ko: 피를 흘리는 것이 불가피한 상황에서도, 당신은 적들이 항복하기를 바라게 됩니다. 당신은 HP가 최대치의 절반 미만인 단일 적을 대상으로 @link[actions.make-an-impression] 외교 기술 판정을 시도하다, 그 생물이 전투를 중단하도록 즉시 설득하는 요청을 합니다. 외교 기술 판정에는 -5 페널티가 적용됩니다. GM은 상황에 따라 요청의 DC를 설정합니다. 일반적으로 해당 생물의 레벨에 비해 매우 어려운 DC 이상입니다. 일부 생물은 단순히 거절할 수 있으며, 협상에 응한 생물도 당신의 주장이 설득력이 부족하다고 판단해 다시 싸움을 시작할 수 있습니다.

name: Avalanche Strike

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a melee weapon in two hands.

You attack all nearby adversaries. Make a melee Strike with your two-handed weapon against each enemy within its melee reach. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but don't increase your penalty until you have made all your attacks.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a melee weapon in two hands.

You attack all nearby adversaries. Make a melee Strike with your two-handed weapon against each enemy within its melee reach. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but don't increase your penalty until you have made all your attacks.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손으로 근접 무기를 휘두르고 있어야 합니다.

근접 공격 범위 내의 모든 적을 공격합니다. 양손 무기로 각 적에게 근접 공격을 가하세요. 각 공격은 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되지만, 모든 공격을 완료할 때까지 페널티를 증가시키지 않습니다.

name: Basic Wizard Spellcasting

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{Basic Spellcasting Feat} benefits. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the wizard archetype, add two common spells of that rank to your spellbook.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{Basic Spellcasting Feat} benefits. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the wizard archetype, add two common spells of that rank to your spellbook.
_desc_ko: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{기본 주문 시전 피트}의 혜택을 얻습니다. 위자드 아키타입으로부터 새로운 랭크의 주문 슬롯을 얻을 때마다, 해당 랭크의 일반 주문 두 가지를 주문서에 추가합니다.

name: Advanced Flair

description.value:
You gain one swashbuckler feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your swashbuckler level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another swashbuckler feat.

_desc_en:
You gain one swashbuckler feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your swashbuckler level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another swashbuckler feat.
_desc_ko:
스워시버클러 재주 하나를 획득합니다. 해당 재주의 전제 조건을 충족할 때, 스워시버클러 레벨은 캐릭터 레벨의 절반으로 간주됩니다.

특수 이 재주를 여러 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 선택할 때마다 추가로 스워시버클러 피트를 하나 얻습니다.

name: Advanced Deific Power

description.value: Like a muscle, the more you flex your divine power, the stronger it gets. Choose two common divine spells, one of 2nd rank and one of 3rd rank. You can cast each of these spells as divine innate spells once per day.

_desc_en: Like a muscle, the more you flex your divine power, the stronger it gets. Choose two common divine spells, one of 2nd rank and one of 3rd rank. You can cast each of these spells as divine innate spells once per day.
_desc_ko: 근육처럼, 당신이 신성한 힘을 더 많이 발휘할수록 그것은 더 강해집니다. 2랭크 하나와 3랭크 하나로 일반 신성 주문 두 개를 선택합니다. 당신은 이 주문들을 각각 하루 1회 신성 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Swordmaster Dedication

description.value:
Your Swords training taught you to never lose hold of your weapon. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Reflex DC when foes attempt to Disarm you. If you have the Deft Cooperation feat and critically succeed on a check to Aid an ally's attack roll or skill check, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus from Deft Cooperation (instead of a +1 bonus) the first time you attempt an attack roll or attempt a skill check where the bonus would apply.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.Y4DiXz5I8krCh1fC]{Swordmaster}

value.value: member of the Pathfinder Society affiliated with the School of Swords

_desc_en:
Your Swords training taught you to never lose hold of your weapon. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Reflex DC when foes attempt to Disarm you. If you have the Deft Cooperation feat and critically succeed on a check to Aid an ally's attack roll or skill check, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus from Deft Cooperation (instead of a +1 bonus) the first time you attempt an attack roll or attempt a skill check where the bonus would apply.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.Y4DiXz5I8krCh1fC]{Swordmaster}
_desc_ko: 검술 훈련으로 무기를 절대 놓치지 않게 되었습니다. 적들이 당신을 {무장 해제} 시도할 때, 반사 DC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 민첩한 협력 피트를 보유하고 있으며, 아군의 명중 굴림이나 기술 판정 지원에 대성공할 때, 해당 보너스가 적용되는 첫 번째 명중 굴림이나 기술 판정 시 민첩한 협력에서 +2 상황 보너스(+1 보너스 대신)를 얻습니다.

name: Venomous Touch

description.value: You've learned to channel the sting of the worm. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ayRXv0wQH00TTNZe]{Purple Worm Sting} as an innate primal spell that you can cast once per day.

publication.title: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm

_desc_en: You've learned to channel the sting of the worm. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ayRXv0wQH00TTNZe]{Purple Worm Sting} as an innate primal spell that you can cast once per day.
_desc_ko: 벌레의 독침을 다루는 법을 익혔습니다. @link[spells.purple-worm-sting]을 선천적 프라이멀 마법으로 획득하며, 하루에 한 번 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Inscribed with Elders' Deeds

description.value: Your tattoos commemorate unique exploits that (according to legends) only an orc could accomplish. During your daily preparations, you can reconfigure part of your storied skin to depict a specific orc hero, granting you a 1st-level ancestry feat with the orc trait until you prepare again; this ancestry feat cannot require any physiological feature you lack, as determined by the GM. Since this feat is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for permanent character options, such as for a feat. At 13th level, you can instead gain a 5th-level ancestry feat with the orc trait.

_desc_en: Your tattoos commemorate unique exploits that (according to legends) only an orc could accomplish. During your daily preparations, you can reconfigure part of your storied skin to depict a specific orc hero, granting you a 1st-level ancestry feat with the orc trait until you prepare again; this ancestry feat cannot require any physiological feature you lack, as determined by the GM. Since this feat is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for permanent character options, such as for a feat. At 13th level, you can instead gain a 5th-level ancestry feat with the orc trait.
_desc_ko: 당신의 문신은 (전설에 따르면) 오직 오크만이 이룰 수 있는 독특한 피트를 기념합니다. 일일 준비 단계에서, 당신은 전설이 새겨진 피부 일부를 재구성하여 특정 오크 영웅을 묘사할 수 있습니다. 이는 다음 준비 단계까지 오크 특성을 가진 1레벨 조상 피트를 부여합니다. 이 조상 피트는 GM이 판단한 바에 따라 당신이 결여한 생리적 특징을 요구할 수 없습니다. 이 재주는 일시적이므로, 영구적인 캐릭터 옵션(예: 피트)의 전제 조건으로 사용할 수 없습니다. 13레벨에 도달하면, 대신 오크 특성을 가진 5레벨 조상 피트를 획득할 수 있습니다.

name: Reverberating Spell

description.value: Your spell disorients your targets with a metallic clangor. If the next action you use this turn is to Cast a non-cantrip Spell that deals damage in an area (such as a burst, line, or cone), the spell deals an additional @Damage[1d8[sonic]] damage and all creatures who fail their save against the spell are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round. Targets who critically fail their saves against this spell are instead deafened for 1 minute. The spell gains the sonic trait.

value.value: metal is in your elemental philosophy

_desc_en: Your spell disorients your targets with a metallic clangor. If the next action you use this turn is to Cast a non-cantrip Spell that deals damage in an area (such as a burst, line, or cone), the spell deals an additional @Damage[1d8[sonic]] damage and all creatures who fail their save against the spell are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round. Targets who critically fail their saves against this spell are instead deafened for 1 minute. The spell gains the sonic trait.
_desc_ko: 당신의 주문은 금속성 울림으로 대상들을 혼란스럽게 합니다. 이번 턴에 다음 행동으로 범위 피해(폭발, 선, 원뿔 등)를 주는 비캔트립 주문을 시전할 경우, 해당 주문은 추가로 1d8 음파의 피해를 입히고, 내성에 실패한 모든 생물은 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.deafened] 상태가 된다. 이 주문에 대한 내성에 대실패한 대상은 대신 1분 동안 귀머거리가 된다. 이 주문은 음파 속성을 얻는다.

name: Corpse Tender Dedication

description.value:
You have a connection to mindless undead that allows you to communicate your intentions to them on a rudimentary level. You can use Diplomacy to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on mindless undead and to make very simple @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Requests} of them; their mindless trait doesn't grant immunity to these mental effects. Most mindless undead are likely hostile toward you by default and must be kept at a safe distance to give you time to Make an Impression.

You become trained in Diplomacy; if already trained, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.jFhTp57zO3ej6HDt]{Corpse Tender}

_desc_en:
You have a connection to mindless undead that allows you to communicate your intentions to them on a rudimentary level. You can use Diplomacy to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on mindless undead and to make very simple @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Requests} of them; their mindless trait doesn't grant immunity to these mental effects. Most mindless undead are likely hostile toward you by default and must be kept at a safe distance to give you time to Make an Impression.

You become trained in Diplomacy; if already trained, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.jFhTp57zO3ej6HDt]{Corpse Tender}
_desc_ko:
당신은 무의식적 언데드와 연결되어 있어 그들에게 기초적인 수준으로 의도를 전달할 수 있습니다. 외교 기술로 무의식적 언데드에게 @link[actions.make-an-impression] 수 있으며, 그들에게 매우 간단한 @link[actions.request]을 할 수 있습니다. 그들의 무의식적 특성은 이러한 정신적 효과에 대한 면역을 부여하지 않습니다. 대부분의 무의식적 언데드는 기본적으로 당신에게 적대적일 가능성이 높으며, 인상을 남길 시간을 확보하기 위해 안전한 거리를 유지해야 합니다.

당신은 외교에 숙련됩니다. 이미 숙련된 경우, 대신 선택한 다른 기술에 숙련됩니다.

name: Performative Weapons Training

description.value:
You're skilled with flashy weapons and can use them to great effect. You have familiarity with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.hMYdSFmMWzidzHih]{Bo Staff}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.DA3HgyEBGEbtRNOo]{Dueling Cape}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zi9ovfoRp2fMhfpO]{Spiked Chain}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.VitLIpdIAmKlGb7i]{Sword Cane}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.FJrsDoaIXksVjld9]{Trident}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.mVxA9E2ernBL6fM6]{War Flail}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.f1gwoTkf3Nn0v3PN]{Whip}. For the purposes of proficiency, you treat these as simple weapons. The GM may add other martial weapons to this list as appropriate for the world or region you are playing in.

Whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

_desc_en:
You're skilled with flashy weapons and can use them to great effect. You have familiarity with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.hMYdSFmMWzidzHih]{Bo Staff}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.DA3HgyEBGEbtRNOo]{Dueling Cape}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zi9ovfoRp2fMhfpO]{Spiked Chain}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.VitLIpdIAmKlGb7i]{Sword Cane}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.FJrsDoaIXksVjld9]{Trident}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.mVxA9E2ernBL6fM6]{War Flail}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.f1gwoTkf3Nn0v3PN]{Whip}. For the purposes of proficiency, you treat these as simple weapons. The GM may add other martial weapons to this list as appropriate for the world or region you are playing in.

Whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
_desc_ko:
당신은 화려한 무기를 능숙하게 다루며 이를 효과적으로 활용할 수 있습니다. @link[equipment.bo-staff], @link[equipment.dueling-cape], @link[equipment.spiked-chain], @link[equipment.sword-cane], @link[equipment.trident], @link[equipment.war-flail], @link[equipment.whip]에 익숙합니다. 숙련도 목적상 이 무기들은 단순 무기로 취급됩니다. GM은 플레이 중인 세계관이나 지역에 맞게 이 목록에 다른 무술용 무기를 추가할 수 있습니다.

이 무기들로 치명타를 성공시킬 때마다 해당 무기의 치명타 특화 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Vigorous Victor

description.value: Long years of success have not only shown you where your limits lie, they've expanded them. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects that would cause you to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed}. Whenever you attempt such a save, you can spend a Mythic Point do so at mythic proficiency. The bonus increases to +3 at 18th level.

publication.title: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

_desc_en: Long years of success have not only shown you where your limits lie, they've expanded them. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects that would cause you to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed}. Whenever you attempt such a save, you can spend a Mythic Point do so at mythic proficiency. The bonus increases to +3 at 18th level.
_desc_ko: 오랜 세월의 성공은 당신에게 당신의 한계가 어디에 있는지 보여주었을 뿐만 아니라, 그 한계를 확장시켰습니다. 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{생명력 고갈}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{약화됨}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{피로}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{구역질}, 또는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{둔화}가 되게 하는 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 당신이 그러한 내성을 시도할 때마다, 신화 점수를 소비하여 신화 숙련도로 시도할 수 있습니다. 이 보너스는 18레벨에 +3으로 증가합니다.

name: Dragon's Presence

description.value:
As kin to dragonkind, you project unflappable confidence (that collapses catastrophically against the deadliest foes). When you roll a success on a saving throw against a fear effect, you get a critical success instead. When you roll a failure against a fear effect, you get a critical failure instead.

In addition, when you attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a foe of your level or lower, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the Intimidation check.

_desc_en:
As kin to dragonkind, you project unflappable confidence (that collapses catastrophically against the deadliest foes). When you roll a success on a saving throw against a fear effect, you get a critical success instead. When you roll a failure against a fear effect, you get a critical failure instead.

In addition, when you attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a foe of your level or lower, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the Intimidation check.
_desc_ko:
용족의 혈통을 이어받은 자로서, 당신은 흔들림 없는 자신감을 발산합니다(가장 치명적인 적 앞에서는 참담하게 무너지지만). 공포 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴릴 경우, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다. 공포 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 실패를 굴릴 경우, 대신 대실패를 얻습니다.

또한, 네 레벨 이하의 적을 @link[actions.demoralize]하려고 시도할 때, 협박 판정에서 +1 상황 보너스를 얻는다.

name: Battlefield Arcana

description.value: You have learned to safely cast spells even in the heat of battle. If the next action you use is to cast a wizard cantrip, or a wizard spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank wizard spell slot you have, that spell does not trigger reactions that normally trigger due to a spell being cast or someone using an action with the manipulate trait.

_desc_en: You have learned to safely cast spells even in the heat of battle. If the next action you use is to cast a wizard cantrip, or a wizard spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank wizard spell slot you have, that spell does not trigger reactions that normally trigger due to a spell being cast or someone using an action with the manipulate trait.
_desc_ko: 당신은 격렬한 전투 중에도 안전하게 주문을 시전하는 법을 익혔습니다. 다음 행동으로 위자드의 캔트립이나, 자신이 보유한 최고 랭크 위자드 주문 슬롯보다 최소 2랭크 낮은 위자드 주문을 시전할 경우, 해당 주문은 주문 시전이나 조작 특성이 있는 행동 사용으로 인해 일반적으로 발동되는 반응을 유발하지 않습니다.

name: Intimidating Spell

description.value: The devastation wrought by your large-scale spells is particularly terrifying. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that deals damage in an area, any target who fails their saving throw is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure).

_desc_en: The devastation wrought by your large-scale spells is particularly terrifying. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that deals damage in an area, any target who fails their saving throw is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure).
_desc_ko: 당신의 대규모 주문이 초래하는 파괴는 특히나 끔찍합니다. 다음 행동으로 영역에 피해를 주는 주문을 시전할 경우, 내성 굴림 실패한 대상은 @link[conditions.frightened]{1} 상태가 됩니다(대실패 시 @link[conditions.frightened]{2} 상태).

name: Sky Master Mask

description.value: Your mask holds the legacy of Black Heron, the Wings of Knowledge, who united the aeromancers of the Shory Empire. You can harness residual magical power to fly. You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed. Immediately after you Cast a non-cantrip Spell that targets only you, your fly Speed doubles until your next turn.

_desc_en: Your mask holds the legacy of Black Heron, the Wings of Knowledge, who united the aeromancers of the Shory Empire. You can harness residual magical power to fly. You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed. Immediately after you Cast a non-cantrip Spell that targets only you, your fly Speed doubles until your next turn.
_desc_ko: 이 가면은 지식의 날개, 블랙 헤론의 유산을 간직하고 있습니다. 그는 쇼리 제국의 공중 마법사들을 통합한 인물입니다. 잔존 마법력을 활용해 비행할 수 있습니다. 비행 속도가 자신의 이동 속도와 동일해집니다. 자신만을 대상으로 하는 캐스트 캔트립이 아닌 주문을 시전한 직후, 다음 차례까지 비행 속도가 두 배로 증가합니다.

name: Perfect Ki Exemplar

description.value: You gain an appropriate qi spell for your School of Perfection: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KADeCawMG6WAzYHa]{Unblinking Flame Emblem} for Unblinking Flame, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YtJXpiu4ijkB6nP2]{Unbreaking Wave Barrier} for Unbreaking Waves, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ww4cPZ3QHTSpaM1m]{Unfolding Wind Blitz} for Unfolding Wind, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8eOMAIvT7S1CJSit]{Untwisting Iron Augmentation} for Untwisting Iron. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1. You become an expert in occult spell DCs and occult spell attack rolls.

_desc_en: You gain an appropriate qi spell for your School of Perfection: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KADeCawMG6WAzYHa]{Unblinking Flame Emblem} for Unblinking Flame, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YtJXpiu4ijkB6nP2]{Unbreaking Wave Barrier} for Unbreaking Waves, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ww4cPZ3QHTSpaM1m]{Unfolding Wind Blitz} for Unfolding Wind, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8eOMAIvT7S1CJSit]{Untwisting Iron Augmentation} for Untwisting Iron. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1. You become an expert in occult spell DCs and occult spell attack rolls.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신의 완벽 학파에 적합한 기 주문을 얻습니다: @link[spells.unblinking-flame-emblem]은 눈부신 불꽃 학파용, @link[spells.unbreaking-wave-barrier]은 끊임없는 파도 학파용, @link[spells.unfolding-wind-blitz]은 펼쳐지는 바람에, @link[spells.untwisting-iron-augmentation]는 풀어내는 철에 적용됩니다. 포커스 풀의 포커스 포인트 수를 1 증가시킵니다. 귀하는 오컬트 주문 난이도(DC)와 오컬트 주문 명중 굴림에 대한 전문가가 됩니다.

name: Frightful Condemnation

description.value:
Trigger You hit your condemned foe with a melee Strike in the same turn during which you condemned it with Harsh Judgment.

Requirements You have condemned a foe to death with Harsh Judgment.

Your willingness to follow through on your pitiless judgment is frightful to the person you have condemned, and they begin to dread what you will do to them next. Your condemned foe is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} if the triggering Strike was a critical hit.

publication.title: Pathfinder Adventure: Night of the Gray Death

_desc_en:
Trigger You hit your condemned foe with a melee Strike in the same turn during which you condemned it with Harsh Judgment.

Requirements You have condemned a foe to death with Harsh Judgment.

Your willingness to follow through on your pitiless judgment is frightful to the person you have condemned, and they begin to dread what you will do to them next. Your condemned foe is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} if the triggering Strike was a critical hit.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 가혹한 심판으로 저주한 적을 같은 턴에 근접 공격으로 명중시켰을 때.

요구 사항 가혹한 심판으로 적을 죽음에 처한 상태여야 합니다.

당신의 무자비한 심판을 끝까지 실행하려는 의지는 처형 대상자에게 공포를 불러일으키며, 그들은 당신이 다음에 자신에게 무슨 짓을 할지 두려워하기 시작합니다. 처형 대상 적군은 @link[conditions.frightened]{1} 상태가 되며, 발동 타격이 치명타였던 경우 @link[conditions.frightened]{2} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Fleet Tempo

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

To rush after a criminal or reach someone in need, you ring a sprightly tone. You and all allies within 30 feet gain a +10-foot status bonus to all Speeds for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.pQ9e5njvIOe5QzFa]{Effect: Fleet Tempo}

publication.title: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

To rush after a criminal or reach someone in need, you ring a sprightly tone. You and all allies within 30 feet gain a +10-foot status bonus to all Speeds for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.pQ9e5njvIOe5QzFa]{Effect: Fleet Tempo}
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

범죄자를 추격하거나 도움이 필요한 사람을 구하기 위해 경쾌한 벨소리를 울립니다. 당신과 30피트 내의 모든 아군은 1분 동안 모든 이동 속도에 +10피트의 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.pQ9e5njvIOe5QzFa]{효과: 빠른 템포}

name: Starlit Spells

description.value: The stars reveal and punish your enemies. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0qaqksrGGDj74HXE]{Revealing Light} and 3rd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.DyiD239dNS7RIxZE]{Holy Light} as occult innate spells, each once per day.

_desc_en: The stars reveal and punish your enemies. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0qaqksrGGDj74HXE]{Revealing Light} and 3rd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.DyiD239dNS7RIxZE]{Holy Light} as occult innate spells, each once per day.
_desc_ko: 별들이 적을 드러내고 벌한다. @link[spells.revealing-light]과 3rd @link[spells.holy-light]을 오컬트 선천 마법으로 하루에 각각 한 번씩 시전할 수 있다.

name: Mammoth Lord Dedication

description.value:
You've undertaken the ultimate challenge of the Mammoth Lords and tamed a megafauna. You gain a megafauna you tamed as a young animal companion. Your megafauna animal companion must be a megafauna appropriate to the Realm of the Mammoth Lords;. While an animal companion usually starts as Small, you can begin with a Medium version of that animal (changing no statistics other than its size).

Contrary to the usual rules for animal companions, this feat can give you a second animal companion. If you have more than one animal companion, you can adventure with only one of them at a time. You can switch between them like a beastmaster does. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.8kGpUUUSX1sB2OqQ]{Call Companion} action, as the beastmaster archetype, and you follow all the other rules found in the Call Companion sidebar; see @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.wdmUH6hdat7jpEWt]{Beastmaster Dedication} for details on this action and the rules for multiple companions.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.iH3Vrt35DyUbhxZj]{Mammoth Lord}

_desc_en:
You've undertaken the ultimate challenge of the Mammoth Lords and tamed a megafauna. You gain a megafauna you tamed as a young animal companion. Your megafauna animal companion must be a megafauna appropriate to the Realm of the Mammoth Lords;. While an animal companion usually starts as Small, you can begin with a Medium version of that animal (changing no statistics other than its size).

Contrary to the usual rules for animal companions, this feat can give you a second animal companion. If you have more than one animal companion, you can adventure with only one of them at a time. You can switch between them like a beastmaster does. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.8kGpUUUSX1sB2OqQ]{Call Companion} action, as the beastmaster archetype, and you follow all the other rules found in the Call Companion sidebar; see @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.wdmUH6hdat7jpEWt]{Beastmaster Dedication} for details on this action and the rules for multiple companions.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.iH3Vrt35DyUbhxZj]{Mammoth Lord}
_desc_ko:
당신은 매머드 군주의 궁극적 도전을 수행하여 거대동물을 길들였습니다. 길들인 메가파우나를 어린 동물 동료로 얻습니다. 당신의 메가파우나 동물 동료는 매머드 렐름에 적합한 메가파우나여야 합니다. 동물 동료는 일반적으로 소형으로 시작하지만, 해당 동물의 중형 버전으로 시작할 수 있습니다(크기 외에는 어떤 능력치도 변경되지 않음).

일반적인 동물 동료 규칙과 달리, 이 피트는 두 번째 동물 동료를 부여할 수 있습니다. 동물 동료가 둘 이상일 경우, 한 번에 한 마리만 모험에 동행할 수 있습니다. 비스트마스터처럼 동반자를 교체할 수 있습니다. 비스트마스터 아키타입과 동일하게 @link[actions.call-companion] 행동을 획득하며, 동료 소환 사이드바에 명시된 모든 규칙을 따릅니다. 이 행동과 다중 동료 규칙에 대한 자세한 내용은 @link[feats.beastmaster-dedication]을 참조하십시오.

name: Mutate Weapon

description.value: Select one unarmed attack you gained with Living Weapon. The damage die for that attack increases by one step until the end of your turn. In addition, choose to either have the attack gain a reach of 10 feet until the end of your turn or for you to gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls with the chosen unarmed attack until the end of your turn.

_desc_en: Select one unarmed attack you gained with Living Weapon. The damage die for that attack increases by one step until the end of your turn. In addition, choose to either have the attack gain a reach of 10 feet until the end of your turn or for you to gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls with the chosen unarmed attack until the end of your turn.
_desc_ko: 비무장 공격으로 획득한 무기 공격 중 하나를 선택한다. 해당 공격의 피해 주사위가 당신의 턴이 끝날 때까지 한 단계 증가한다. 추가로, 해당 공격이 당신의 턴이 끝날 때까지 10피트의 도달 거리를 얻거나, 선택한 비무장 공격으로 하는 명중 굴림에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻도록 선택하십시오.

name: Majestic Proclamation

description.value:
Requirements You're in your sentinel form.

You announce your name to your enemies, bringing your constellation to bear in a blinding display. Attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} all enemies within 30 feet. Demoralize loses the auditory trait and gains the visual trait when used this way. In addition to the regular effects of Demoralize, enemies become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 minute on a successful check (and also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round on a critical success).

You can use Majestic Proclamation as a single action if your previous action was @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M4ALaFXoQDJGxSsI]{Starlit Transformation}.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Requirements You're in your sentinel form.

You announce your name to your enemies, bringing your constellation to bear in a blinding display. Attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} all enemies within 30 feet. Demoralize loses the auditory trait and gains the visual trait when used this way. In addition to the regular effects of Demoralize, enemies become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 minute on a successful check (and also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round on a critical success).

You can use Majestic Proclamation as a single action if your previous action was @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M4ALaFXoQDJGxSsI]{Starlit Transformation}.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 파수꾼 형태입니다.

당신은 적들에게 자신의 이름을 알리며 눈부신 광경으로 자신의 별자리를 드러냅니다. 30피트 내의 모든 적에게 @link[actions.demoralize]를 시도합니다. 이 방식으로 사용 시 사기 저하는 청각적 특성을 잃고 시각적 특성을 얻습니다. 사기 저하의 일반 효과에 더해, 적들은 성공 시 1분 동안 @link[conditions.dazzled] 상태가 됩니다(대성공 시 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.blinded] 상태도 추가됨).

이전 행동이 @link[actions.starlit-transformation]인 경우 위엄 선포를 액션 하나에 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Power Slide

description.value:
Requirements You are piloting a vehicle.

You throw the vehicle into a barely controlled skid, turning sharply to evade pursuit or bring your weapons to bear. You Drive with a –2 penalty to your piloting check, gaining the effects of the Drive action for the same number of actions you spent to Power Slide. At the end of the movement, if you succeed, you can turn the vehicle up to 90 degrees. If you critically succeed at your piloting check, you can instead turn the vehicle up to 180 degrees.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are piloting a vehicle.

You throw the vehicle into a barely controlled skid, turning sharply to evade pursuit or bring your weapons to bear. You Drive with a –2 penalty to your piloting check, gaining the effects of the Drive action for the same number of actions you spent to Power Slide. At the end of the movement, if you succeed, you can turn the vehicle up to 90 degrees. If you critically succeed at your piloting check, you can instead turn the vehicle up to 180 degrees.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 차량을 조종 중이어야 합니다.

차량을 간신히 지배됨 상태로 미끄러지게 하여 급회전하며 추격을 회피하거나 무기를 겨누게 합니다. 조종 판정 시 -2 페널티를 받고 운전합니다. 파워 슬라이드에 소모한 행동 횟수만큼 운전 행동의 효과를 얻습니다. 이동 종료 시 성공하면 차량을 최대 90도까지 회전시킬 수 있습니다. 조종 판정에서 대성공 시 차량을 최대 180도까지 회전시킬 수 있습니다.

name: Aeonbound

description.value: Your lineage is influenced or directly tied to the supernatural inhabitants of the Perfect City of Axis, a realm of pure and absolute order. This energy suffuses your body and helps it maintain coherency, resisting effects that would undermine your function or mar your otherwise orderly form. You and your allies can Treat your Wounds without a healer's toolkit. Once per day, when someone rolls a failure or a critical failure on a check to Treat your Wounds, you can focus on your internal cohesion to increase the degree of success by one step.

_desc_en: Your lineage is influenced or directly tied to the supernatural inhabitants of the Perfect City of Axis, a realm of pure and absolute order. This energy suffuses your body and helps it maintain coherency, resisting effects that would undermine your function or mar your otherwise orderly form. You and your allies can Treat your Wounds without a healer's toolkit. Once per day, when someone rolls a failure or a critical failure on a check to Treat your Wounds, you can focus on your internal cohesion to increase the degree of success by one step.
_desc_ko: 당신의 혈통은 순수하고 절대적인 질서의 영역인 완벽한 도시 액시스의 초자연적 존재들에게 영향을 받거나 직접적으로 연결되어 있습니다. 이 에너지는 당신의 몸을 가득 채워 일관성을 유지하도록 돕고, 당신의 기능을 저해하거나 질서 정연한 형태를 손상시킬 수 있는 효과에 저항합니다. 당신과 동맹은 치료사 도구 없이도 상처를 치료할 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, 누군가가 당신의 상처 치료 판정에서 실패나 대실패를 굴렸을 때, 당신은 내적 응집력에 포커스를 맞춰 성공 단계를 한 단계 높일 수 있습니다.

name: Deny Support

description.value:
Access Help either the Washboard Dogs or the Diobel Sweepers destroy their rival.

When you succeed or critically succeed at a Deception check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} an opponent, that target can't flank with their allies until the beginning of your next turn.

_desc_en:
Access Help either the Washboard Dogs or the Diobel Sweepers destroy their rival.

When you succeed or critically succeed at a Deception check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} an opponent, that target can't flank with their allies until the beginning of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
접근 워시보드 독스나 디오벨 스위퍼스 중 한 쪽이 상대방을 파괴하도록 도와주세요.

상대를 기만하는 기만 판정(@link[actions.feint])에 성공하거나 대성공하면, 해당 대상은 당신의 다음 턴 시작 전까지 아군과 함께 측면 공격을 할 수 없습니다.

name: Swimming Poppet

description.value: Your fins, flippers, or other accessories assist with steering you through water. You gain a swim Speed of 15 feet.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en: Your fins, flippers, or other accessories assist with steering you through water. You gain a swim Speed of 15 feet.
_desc_ko: 지느러미, 플리퍼 또는 기타 보조 장비가 물속에서 방향 전환을 돕습니다. 수영 속도가 15피트 증가합니다.

name: Change of Face

description.value: You know that for the best disguise to work, one requires not only the right skills but also the right look—luckily you can copy both using special magical techniques. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate}, you don't need a disguise kit; instead, simple illusions or temporary transformations ripple over your body like mirror shards, providing the supplies that the kit ordinarily would. When you Impersonate in this way, your Impersonate activity gains the occult trait.

_desc_en: You know that for the best disguise to work, one requires not only the right skills but also the right look—luckily you can copy both using special magical techniques. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate}, you don't need a disguise kit; instead, simple illusions or temporary transformations ripple over your body like mirror shards, providing the supplies that the kit ordinarily would. When you Impersonate in this way, your Impersonate activity gains the occult trait.
_desc_ko: 최고의 변장이 성공하려면 적절한 기술뿐만 아니라 적절한 외모도 필요하다는 것을 알고 있습니다. 다행히도 특별한 마법 기술을 사용해 둘 다 모방할 수 있습니다. 당신이 @link[actions.impersonate]할 때, 변장 키트가 필요하지 않습니다. 대신 단순한 환영이나 일시적인 변형이 거울 조각처럼 몸에 퍼져, 키트가 일반적으로 제공하는 물품을 대신합니다. 이런 방식으로 변장할 때, 당신의 변장 활동은 오컬트 특성을 얻습니다.

name: Ferocious Gust

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

With heavy wing beats, you whip up a furious gust and direct it at your opponents. This air blast has the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.g8QqHpv2CWDwmIm1]{Gust of Wind} with a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|traits:air]{fortitude DC} equal to your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

With heavy wing beats, you whip up a furious gust and direct it at your opponents. This air blast has the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.g8QqHpv2CWDwmIm1]{Gust of Wind} with a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|traits:air]{fortitude DC} equal to your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 10분에 한 번

강력한 날갯짓으로 격렬한 돌풍을 일으켜 상대방에게 휘둘러댄다. 이 공기 폭발은 @link[spells.gust-of-wind]의 효과를 가지며, 인내 DC는 네 클래스 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 더 높은 쪽과 동일하다.

name: Suspect of Opportunity

description.value:
Trigger A creature who isn't, to your knowledge, tied to any of your active investigations takes a hostile action against you in combat.

Sometimes something intrudes upon your case unexpectedly, such as an ambush sent to bring your investigation to a close. You use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.csPhQeHWbUXL64p9]{Person of Interest} against the triggering creature. This doesn't allow you to use Person of Interest more frequently than normal.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature who isn't, to your knowledge, tied to any of your active investigations takes a hostile action against you in combat.

Sometimes something intrudes upon your case unexpectedly, such as an ambush sent to bring your investigation to a close. You use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.csPhQeHWbUXL64p9]{Person of Interest} against the triggering creature. This doesn't allow you to use Person of Interest more frequently than normal.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신이 아는 한 현재 진행 중인 수사 사건과 관련이 없는 생물이 전투 중 당신에게 적대적 행동을 취할 때.

때로는 당신의 사건에 예상치 못한 방해가 개입하기도 합니다. 예를 들어, 당신의 수사를 종결시키기 위해 보낸 매복 같은 것이죠. 당신은 @link[feats.person-of-interest]을 발동한 생물에게 사용합니다. 이는 당신이 관심 대상을 평소보다 더 자주 사용할 수 있게 해주지 않습니다.

name: Food Preservation

description.value:
Your techniques extend the storage life for certain ingredients and food through pickling, alcohol, or fermentation. When you use advanced alchemy to create alchemical food, you can designate one infused item to not automatically expire when you next make your daily preparations. When you preserve another item in this way, the previous item becomes inedible.

The number of items you can preserve during your daily preparation and the maximum number of items you can have preserved before spoiling older items increases to two if you're an expert in Crafting or Cooking Lore, to three if you're a master, and to five if you're legendary.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Your techniques extend the storage life for certain ingredients and food through pickling, alcohol, or fermentation. When you use advanced alchemy to create alchemical food, you can designate one infused item to not automatically expire when you next make your daily preparations. When you preserve another item in this way, the previous item becomes inedible.

The number of items you can preserve during your daily preparation and the maximum number of items you can have preserved before spoiling older items increases to two if you're an expert in Crafting or Cooking Lore, to three if you're a master, and to five if you're legendary.
_desc_ko:
당신의 기술은 절임, 알코올, 발효를 통해 특정 재료와 음식의 저장 수명을 연장합니다. 고급 연금술로 연금술 음식을 만들 때, 다음 일일 준비 시 자동으로 소멸되지 않도록 한 가지 주입된 아이템을 지정할 수 있습니다. 이 방법으로 다른 아이템을 보존할 경우, 이전 아이템은 먹을 수 없게 됩니다.

일일 준비 과정에서 보존할 수 있는 아이템 수와 오래된 아이템이 상하기 전에 보존할 수 있는 최대 아이템 수는 제작 또는 요리 지식에 숙련된 경우 2개, 달인인 경우 3개, 전설적인 경우 5개로 증가합니다.

name: Advanced Monastic Weaponry

description.value: Your rigorous training regimen allows you to wield complex weaponry with ease. For the purposes of proficiency, you treat advanced monk weapons as if they were martial monk weapons.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your rigorous training regimen allows you to wield complex weaponry with ease. For the purposes of proficiency, you treat advanced monk weapons as if they were martial monk weapons.
_desc_ko: 엄격한 훈련으로 복잡한 무기를 손쉽게 다룰 수 있습니다. 숙련도 목적상, 고급 몽크 무기를 무술 몽크 무기로 간주합니다.

name: Patron's Truth

description.value: You have mastered the greatest secrets of your patron's magic and learned a fundamental truth about your patron, even if their identity still remains a mystery. You gain an additional 10th-rank spell slot.

_desc_en: You have mastered the greatest secrets of your patron's magic and learned a fundamental truth about your patron, even if their identity still remains a mystery. You gain an additional 10th-rank spell slot.
_desc_ko: 당신은 후원자의 마법 중 가장 위대한 비밀을 마스터했으며, 그 정체는 여전히 수수께끼로 남아 있더라도 후원자에 관한 근본적인 진실을 깨달았습니다. 10랭크 주문 슬롯을 하나 추가로 얻습니다.

name: Call Your Shot

description.value:
When you successfully Play to the Crowd, add the following to the list of benefits you can choose from:

  • Choose a creature within 30 feet that can see you to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}. This effect has the emotion, fear, mental, and visual traits.

_desc_en:
When you successfully Play to the Crowd, add the following to the list of benefits you can choose from:

  • Choose a creature within 30 feet that can see you to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}. This effect has the emotion, fear, mental, and visual traits.
_desc_ko:
관중을 사로잡는 데 성공하면, 선택할 수 있는 혜택 목록에 다음을 추가합니다:

  • 당신을 볼 수 있는 30피트 내의 생물 하나를 선택하여 @link[conditions.frightened]{2}가 되게 합니다. 이 효과는 감정, 공포, 정신, 시각적 특성을 가집니다.

name: Giant Snare

description.value:
You can create bigger snares for quick deployment, making it more likely for a creature to walk into your snares.

When you prepare snares for quick deployment, you can prepare some of them as giant snares. A giant snare takes up a 10-foot-by-10-foot area but costs two of your quick deployment snares. A giant snare can trigger from a creature entering any portion of its area, and all its effects apply over the full area.

_desc_en:
You can create bigger snares for quick deployment, making it more likely for a creature to walk into your snares.

When you prepare snares for quick deployment, you can prepare some of them as giant snares. A giant snare takes up a 10-foot-by-10-foot area but costs two of your quick deployment snares. A giant snare can trigger from a creature entering any portion of its area, and all its effects apply over the full area.
_desc_ko:
빠른 배치를 위해 더 큰 올가미를 만들 수 있으며, 이로 인해 생물이 올가미에 걸릴 확률이 높아집니다.

신속 배치용 올가미를 준비할 때 일부를 거대 올가미로 준비할 수 있습니다. 거대 올가미는 10피트×10피트 영역을 차지하지만 신속 배치용 올가미 두 개를 소모합니다. 거대 올가미는 영역의 어느 부분에든 생물이 진입하면 발동되며, 모든 효과가 전체 영역에 적용됩니다.

name: Leshy Glide

description.value: Using your own leaves, you can control your descent. You glide slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down and up to 25 feet forward through the air. As long as you spend at least 1 action gliding each round and have not yet reached the ground, you remain in the air at the end of your turn.

value.value: leaf leshy heritage or Cat Fall skill feat

_desc_en: Using your own leaves, you can control your descent. You glide slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down and up to 25 feet forward through the air. As long as you spend at least 1 action gliding each round and have not yet reached the ground, you remain in the air at the end of your turn.
_desc_ko: 자신의 잎을 이용해 하강 속도를 조절할 수 있습니다. 공중에서 천천히 지면을 향해 5피트 하강하며 최대 25피트 전진합니다. 매 턴 최소 1개의 행동을 글라이딩에 사용하며 아직 지면에 도달하지 않은 경우, 자신의 턴 종료 시에도 공중에 머무를 수 있습니다.

name: Tamper

description.value:
You tamper with a foe's weapon or armor, using a free hand. Choose either a weapon held by an enemy in your reach or a suit of armor worn by an enemy in your reach. Attempt a @Check[crafting|against:reflex] check against the enemy's Reflex DC.

Critical Success Your tampering is incredibly effective. If you tampered with a weapon, the enemy takes a -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and damage rolls with that weapon. If you tampered with armor, the armor hampers the enemy's movement, making the enemy @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} and inflicting a –10-foot penalty to its Speeds. The effect lasts until the enemy Interacts to remove it, regardless of which one you used. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.rzcpTJU9MvW1x1gz]{Effect: Armor Tampered With (Critical Success)} @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.o7qm13OmaYOMwgib]{Effect: Weapon Tampered With (Critical Success)}

Success Your tampering is temporarily effective. As critical success, but the effect ends at the start of your next turn, even if the enemy doesn't Interact to end it. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.IfRkgjyh0JzGalIy]{Effect: Armor Tampered With (Success)} @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.4QWayYR3JSL9bk2T]{Effect: Weapon Tampered With (Success)}

Critical Failure Your tampering backfires dramatically, creating a small explosion from your own tools or gear. You take @Damage[(@actor.level)[fire]]{fire damage equal to your level}.

_desc_en:
You tamper with a foe's weapon or armor, using a free hand. Choose either a weapon held by an enemy in your reach or a suit of armor worn by an enemy in your reach. Attempt a @Check[crafting|against:reflex] check against the enemy's Reflex DC.

Critical Success Your tampering is incredibly effective. If you tampered with a weapon, the enemy takes a -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and damage rolls with that weapon. If you tampered with armor, the armor hampers the enemy's movement, making the enemy @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} and inflicting a –10-foot penalty to its Speeds. The effect lasts until the enemy Interacts to remove it, regardless of which one you used. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.rzcpTJU9MvW1x1gz]{Effect: Armor Tampered With (Critical Success)} @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.o7qm13OmaYOMwgib]{Effect: Weapon Tampered With (Critical Success)}

Success Your tampering is temporarily effective. As critical success, but the effect ends at the start of your next turn, even if the enemy doesn't Interact to end it. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.IfRkgjyh0JzGalIy]{Effect: Armor Tampered With (Success)} @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.4QWayYR3JSL9bk2T]{Effect: Weapon Tampered With (Success)}

Critical Failure Your tampering backfires dramatically, creating a small explosion from your own tools or gear. You take @Damage[(@actor.level)[fire]]{fire damage equal to your level}.
_desc_ko:
빈 손으로 적의 무기나 갑옷을 조작합니다. 자신의 도달 범위 내에 있는 적이 들고 있는 무기나 입고 있는 갑옷 중 하나를 선택하세요. 적의 반사 DC에 대해 제작 판정을 시도합니다.

대성공 당신의 방해는 놀라울 정도로 효과적이다. 무기를 조작한 경우, 적의 해당 무기 명중 굴림과 피해 굴림에 -2 상황 페널티가 적용됩니다. 갑옷을 조작한 경우, 갑옷이 적의 이동을 방해하여 적을 @link[conditions.off-guard]로 만들고 이동 속도에 -10피트 페널티를 가합니다. 효과 지속 시간은 적군이 이를 제거하기 위해 상호작용할 때까지이며, 사용한 유형에 관계없이 동일합니다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.rzcpTJU9MvW1x1gz]{효과: 방어구 조작 (대성공)} @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.o7qm13OmaYOMwgib]{효과: 무기 조작 (대성공)}

대성공 당신의 조작은 일시적으로 유효합니다. 대성공과 동일하지만, 적의 상호작용 없이도 다음 턴 시작 시 효과가 종료됩니다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.IfRkgjyh0JzGalIy]{효과: 방어구 조작 (성공)} @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.4QWayYR3JSL9bk2T]{효과: 무기 조작 (성공)}

대실패 당신의 조작이 역효과를 내며, 자신의 도구나 장비에서 작은 폭발이 발생합니다. 당신은 레벨에 해당하는 화염 피해를 입습니다.

name: Lock Down

description.value:
Requirements You are in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.UKXaMhb9qlPYw1HD]{Hampering Stance}.

You attack an enemy to ensure they can't move beyond your reach. Strike an enemy within your reach. If you hit and deal damage, that enemy can't use move actions to move beyond the reach of the weapon or unarmed attack you used for the Strike. The enemy can still move to other squares within reach of that weapon or unarmed attack. This effect lasts until the beginning of your next turn, until you move, or until you use that weapon or unarmed attack to make another attack, whichever comes first.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.UKXaMhb9qlPYw1HD]{Hampering Stance}.

You attack an enemy to ensure they can't move beyond your reach. Strike an enemy within your reach. If you hit and deal damage, that enemy can't use move actions to move beyond the reach of the weapon or unarmed attack you used for the Strike. The enemy can still move to other squares within reach of that weapon or unarmed attack. This effect lasts until the beginning of your next turn, until you move, or until you use that weapon or unarmed attack to make another attack, whichever comes first.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 @link[feats.hampering-stance]에 있어야 합니다.

당신은 적이 자신의 공격 범위 밖으로 이동하지 못하도록 공격합니다. 자신의 공격 범위 내에 있는 적을 강타하세요. 명중하여 피해를 입힌 경우, 해당 적은 공격에 사용한 무기나 비무장 공격의 도달 범위를 벗어나는 이동 행동을 사용할 수 없습니다. 적은 여전히 해당 무기나 비무장 공격의 도달 범위 내 다른 칸으로 이동할 수 있습니다. 이 효과는 다음 턴 시작 시점, 당신이 이동할 때까지, 또는 해당 무기나 비무장 공격으로 다시 공격할 때까지 지속됩니다. 중복 발생 시 먼저 도래하는 시점에 종료됩니다.

name: Iron Belly

description.value:
A good laugh comes from the belly, and by laughing every day, yours has grown quite strong. You have a belly melee unarmed Strike, which deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage, is in the brawling group, and has the forceful trait.

Special It's never too late to learn to laugh, so you can select this feat at any level and retrain into and out of this feat.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
A good laugh comes from the belly, and by laughing every day, yours has grown quite strong. You have a belly melee unarmed Strike, which deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage, is in the brawling group, and has the forceful trait.

Special It's never too late to learn to laugh, so you can select this feat at any level and retrain into and out of this feat.
_desc_ko:
배꼽에서 우러나는 웃음은 건강의 원천이며, 매일 웃음을 터뜨리다 보니 당신의 배는 꽤나 단단해졌습니다. 당신은 복부 비무장 공격을 가할 수 있으며, 이는 1d6 타격 피해를 입히고, 난투 기술 그룹에 속하며, 기세를 지닙니다.

특수 웃음을 배우기엔 늦은 때가 없으니, 이 피트는 레벨에 상관없이 선택할 수 있으며 재훈련을 통해 언제든지 재취득하거나 포기할 수 있습니다.

name: Cling

description.value:
Requirements Your last action was a successful Strike and you have a free hand.

You hang onto a foe to harry them into submission. If your target moves while you're hanging onto it, you can choose to move with the target. The target is released if you choose not to move with it, at the start of your next turn, or if the target Escapes. Attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} from a Cling are made against your Acrobatics DC, but they end the Cling instead of the conditions normally ended by the Escape action.

Special You can use this action without a free hand if your preceding Strike was made with your jaws or a similar unarmed attack you could use to hang on. The GM determines which unarmed attacks apply. Hanging on in this way prevents you from using that unarmed attack.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your last action was a successful Strike and you have a free hand.

You hang onto a foe to harry them into submission. If your target moves while you're hanging onto it, you can choose to move with the target. The target is released if you choose not to move with it, at the start of your next turn, or if the target Escapes. Attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} from a Cling are made against your Acrobatics DC, but they end the Cling instead of the conditions normally ended by the Escape action.

Special You can use this action without a free hand if your preceding Strike was made with your jaws or a similar unarmed attack you could use to hang on. The GM determines which unarmed attacks apply. Hanging on in this way prevents you from using that unarmed attack.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 마지막 행동이 성공적인 타격이었고, 빈 손이 자유로워야 한다.

상대를 붙잡아 굴복시킬 때까지 괴롭힙니다. 붙잡고 있는 동안 대상이 이동하면, 함께 이동할 수 있습니다. 동반 이동을 선택하지 않거나, 다음 턴 시작 시, 또는 대상이 탈출할 경우 대상은 놓아집니다. @link[actions.escape] 시도는 당신의 곡예 DC에 대해 이루어지지만, 탈출 행동이 일반적으로 종료시키는 조건 대신 붙잡기 상태를 종료시킵니다.

특수 이전 공격이 턱이나 매달리는 데 사용할 수 있는 유사한 비무장 공격으로 이루어졌다면, 빈 손이 없어도 이 행동을 사용할 수 있습니다. 적용 가능한 비무장 공격은 GM이 결정합니다. 이러한 방식으로 매달리면 해당 비무장 공격을 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Log Roll

description.value:
Requirements You and an adjacent creature are both on a narrow surface or uneven ground and the other creature is off-guard.

You shuffle your feet to dislodge the surface beneath you or otherwise cause your opponent to become unsteady. Attempt an @Check[acrobatics|defense:reflex] check against the adjacent creature's Reflex saving throw DC. On a success, the creature falls. On a critical failure, you fall.

_desc_en:
Requirements You and an adjacent creature are both on a narrow surface or uneven ground and the other creature is off-guard.

You shuffle your feet to dislodge the surface beneath you or otherwise cause your opponent to become unsteady. Attempt an @Check[acrobatics|defense:reflex] check against the adjacent creature's Reflex saving throw DC. On a success, the creature falls. On a critical failure, you fall.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신과 인접한 생물이 모두 좁은 표면이나 고르지 않은 지면에 있으며, 상대 생물이 무방비 상태여야 합니다.

발을 비비며 발밑의 지면을 흔들거나 상대가 균형을 잃게 만듭니다. 인접한 생물의 반사 내성 DC에 대해 곡예 판정을 시도합니다. 성공 시 상대가 넘어집니다. 대실패 시 당신이 넘어집니다.

name: Two Truths

description.value: Your ability to imitate your progenitor is so strong, you can even convince yourself. When you use this action, you alter your thought processes to your progenitor or from your progenitor back to yourself. As long as what you say is true from the point of view of your current identity, you can say it even under effects like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aewxsale5xWEPKLk]{Ring of Truth} that force you to speak truly.

_desc_en: Your ability to imitate your progenitor is so strong, you can even convince yourself. When you use this action, you alter your thought processes to your progenitor or from your progenitor back to yourself. As long as what you say is true from the point of view of your current identity, you can say it even under effects like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aewxsale5xWEPKLk]{Ring of Truth} that force you to speak truly.
_desc_ko: 당신의 조상을 모방하는 능력은 너무나 강력하여 스스로를 설득할 수도 있습니다. 이 행동을 사용할 때, 당신은 사고 과정을 조상의 방식으로 바꾸거나 조상의 방식에서 다시 자신의 방식으로 되돌릴 수 있습니다. 현재 정체성의 관점에서 진실인 한, @link[spells.ring-of-truth]처럼 진실을 말하도록 기세 효과 아래에서도 이를 말할 수 있다.

name: Derring-Do

description.value: When you compound panache with even more derring-do, it somehow tends to work out. When you already have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.LzYi0OuOoypNb6jd]{Panache}, you can roll twice and use the higher result on checks to which the circumstance bonus from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.TALz3cU06Hb14Key]{Stylish Combatant} applies (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} and any skill actions with the bravado trait).

_desc_en: When you compound panache with even more derring-do, it somehow tends to work out. When you already have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.LzYi0OuOoypNb6jd]{Panache}, you can roll twice and use the higher result on checks to which the circumstance bonus from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.TALz3cU06Hb14Key]{Stylish Combatant} applies (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} and any skill actions with the bravado trait).
_desc_ko: 당신이 파나슈에 더욱 대담한 행동을 더할 때, 어떻게든 일이 잘 풀리는 경향이 있습니다. @link[feats.panache]를 이미 보유한 경우, @link[feats.stylish-combatant]의 상황 보너스가 적용되는 판정(@link[actions.tumble-through] 및 브라바도 특성이 있는 모든 스킬 액션)에 대해 두 번 굴리고 높은 결과를 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Mighty Wings

description.value: Your dragon wings are now a permanent part of your body, giving you a fly Speed equal to your Speed. If you spend 1 Focus Point to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HWJODX2zPg5cg34F]{Dragon Wings}, your fly Speed increases to 90 feet for the duration, unless your Speed is faster, and you gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.K8vvrOgW4bGakXxm]{Dragon Claws} for the duration.

_desc_en: Your dragon wings are now a permanent part of your body, giving you a fly Speed equal to your Speed. If you spend 1 Focus Point to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HWJODX2zPg5cg34F]{Dragon Wings}, your fly Speed increases to 90 feet for the duration, unless your Speed is faster, and you gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.K8vvrOgW4bGakXxm]{Dragon Claws} for the duration.
_desc_ko: 용의 날개가 이제 영구적으로 몸에 붙어 있어, 비행 속도가 이동 속도와 동일해집니다. 포커스 1점을 소모하여 @link[spells.dragon-wings]를 시전하면, 지속 시간 동안 비행 속도가 90피트로 증가합니다(기존 속도가 더 빠를 경우 제외). 또한 지속 시간 동안 @link[spells.flurry-of-claws]의 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Blessed Medicine

description.value:
Trigger You fail a check to Treat a Disease that was inflicted by an undead (such as ghoul fever or mummy rot).

Your experience battling undead has uniquely prepared you to fight the diseases they inflict on the survivors, and you know that leaving these maladies untreated for long will eventually lead to more undead. Reroll the failed check and use the new result.

_desc_en:
Trigger You fail a check to Treat a Disease that was inflicted by an undead (such as ghoul fever or mummy rot).

Your experience battling undead has uniquely prepared you to fight the diseases they inflict on the survivors, and you know that leaving these maladies untreated for long will eventually lead to more undead. Reroll the failed check and use the new result.
_desc_ko:
발동 언데드(구울 열병이나 미라 부패 등)에 의해 감염된 질병을 치료하는 판정에 실패합니다.

당신은 언데드와의 전투 경험으로 인해 그들이 생존자들에게 전염시키는 질병과 싸울 수 있는 특별한 준비를 갖추었습니다. 또한 이러한 질병을 오랫동안 방치하면 결국 더 많은 언데드가 발생한다는 사실을 알고 있습니다. 실패한 판정을 재굴림하고 새로운 결과를 사용하십시오.

name: Quick Reversal

description.value:
Requirements You are flanked by at least two enemies.

You turn your foes' flanking against them with a quick reverse. Make a melee Strike against one of the flanking enemies and make a second Strike with the same weapon or unarmed attack against a different enemy that is flanking you. This second Strike has the same multiple attack penalty of the initial attack and doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty.

_desc_ko:
요구 사항 적 최소 두 명에게 측면 공격을 받고 있어야 합니다.

적의 측면 공격을 재빠른 역습으로 역이용한다. 측면 공격 중인 적 중 한 명에게 근접 공격을 가한 후, 동일한 무기나 비무장 공격으로 다른 측면 공격 중인 적에게 두 번째 공격을 가한다. 이 두 번째 공격은 첫 번째 공격과 동일한 다중 공격 페널티를 적용받으며, 본인의 다중 공격 페널티 계산에는 포함되지 않는다.

name: Soulforger Dedication

description.value:
You can manifest the power of your spirit in combat to realize your motivations. You manifest an armor, shield, or weapon as a soulforged armament. Choose one essence power for the armament. Changing an essence power requires 1 week of retraining, and you can't retrain it while you have soulforged corruption.

You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KMKuJ0onVS72t9Fv]{Manifest Soulforged Armament} to summon your armaments in combat.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.LWgcWM8B85HHVCtZ]{Soulforger}

ESSENCE POWERS

Your soulforged armament has an essence power you choose when you first bind it. It gains the power temporarily when you manifest its essence form. Each power has a corruption flaw that affects you if you have soulforged corruption. Essence powers that only apply to some types of armament indicate which.

Adaptable Persona (transmutation) Armor only. When you manifest the essence form, gain your choice of a climb Speed or swim Speed equal to your land Speed. If you're 8th level or higher, you can choose a fly Speed instead. Corruption Flaw You take a –10-foot penalty to all your Speeds.

Bounding Spirit Melee weapon only. The weapon gains the thrown 30 feet trait and has the returning rune (even if it already has its maximum number of property runes). Corruption Flaw When you make a Strike with a thrown or ranged weapon and miss, reroll the Strike, targeting your ally nearest to the target. This Strike uses the same multiple attack penalty as the missed Strike and doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty.

Deep-Seeded Fear You gain a +2 status bonus to your Intimidation checks and don't take any penalties for not sharing a language when Demoralizing foes who can perceive your armament's essence form. When you manifest the essence form, you can attempt to Demoralize an enemy who can perceive the manifestation. Corruption Flaw If you attempt to Demoralize an enemy, your Demoralize also targets the ally closest to you.

Determined Toughness Any status penalties you take from the following conditions are 1 less than their condition's value: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied}. This doesn't change the actual condition value, or any other effects of the condition (such as stupefied's disruption and its DC). Corruption Flaw Whenever you take a status penalty from the listed conditions, you also take a -1 penalty to the same statistics.

Harmful Malice (void) Your Strikes deal an additional 1d4 void damage. Once while the armament is manifested, you can cast harm as an innate spell, with a level equal to half your level rounded up. Corruption Flaw Reduce any damage you would deal by half your level.

Heroic Heart (enchantment, mental) You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, Perception checks, skill checks, and saves. Corruption Flaw You take a -1 penalty to attack rolls.

Healing Grace (healing, vitality) You gain fast healing equal to half your level. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} once as an innate spell with a level equal to half your level rounded up. Corruption Flaw Reduce all healing you would receive or grant with a spell by half your level.

Magical Resilience (abjuration) Armor or shield only. You gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws and AC against spells. If you're 5th level or higher, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} once as an innate spell. The spell rank is equal to 1 lower than half your level rounded up (2nd level if you're 5th or 6th level, and so on). Corruption Flaw You take a -1 penalty to saving throws and AC against spells.

Planar Bond (abjuration) Armor or shield only. When you manifest the essence form, choose one damage type: acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic, spirit, vitality, or void. You gain resistance equal to your level + 2 to damage of the selected type. Corruption Flaw You gain weakness 1 to all damage.

Planar Pain (evocation) Weapon only. When you manifest the essence form, choose one damage type: acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic, spirit, vitality, or void. Attacks with the weapon deal this type of damage instead of their physical damage with a +2 status bonus to the damage. Corruption Flaw When you deal damage with a weapon or unarmed attack, you take 2 damage of the last type you chose for planar pain, even if the damage type normally wouldn't harm you, such as spirit damage if you aren't evil.

Pull of Stasis (transmutation) Weapon only. Any time you hit with the soulforged weapon, the target takes a –10-foot penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. On a critical hit, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round instead. Corruption Flaw You take a –10-foot penalty to all your Speeds.

Reflecting Spirit Armor or shield only. You gain a +2 status bonus to AC against physical ranged attacks. If an enemy's physical ranged attack misses you, you can use your reaction to immediately attempt a ranged Strike against the attacker using the projectile that missed. Corruption Flaw You have weakness 5 to physical ranged attacks.

Resolute Defiance Shield only. The shield gains a +2 status bonus to its Hardness and gains temporary Hit Points equal to your level + 2 that last until the essence effect ends. If you don't have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction, you gain it while your shield is manifested. Corruption Flaw When you take damage while Raising a Shield or use Shield Block, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:5]. If you fail, the shield is Dismissed if it's your soulforged armament or Dropped if it's a different shield.

_desc_ko:
전투에서 영혼의 힘을 창조하여 자신의 동기를 실현할 수 있습니다. 당신은 영혼으로 단련된 무기로 갑옷, 방패 또는 무기를 창조합니다. 무기에 적용할 본질의 힘 하나를 선택하십시오. 본질의 힘을 변경하려면 1주간의 재훈련이 필요하며, 영혼으로 단련된 타락 상태에서는 재훈련할 수 없습니다.

전투 중 @link[actions.manifest-soulforged-armament]를 사용하여 무기를 소환할 수 있다.

ESSENCE POWERS

당신의 영혼으로 단련된 무기는 처음 결합할 때 선택한 본질의 힘을 지닙니다. 본질 형태를 창조할 때 일시적으로 그 힘을 얻습니다. 각 힘에는 영혼 단련된 타락 상태일 경우 영향을 미치는 타락 결함이 있습니다. 특정 유형의 무기에만 적용되는 본질의 힘은 해당 유형을 명시합니다.

적응형 페르소나 (변형) 갑옷 전용. 본질 형태를 창조할 때, 지상 속도 및 동일한 등반 속도 또는 수영 속도 중 하나를 선택하여 획득합니다. 8레벨 이상일 경우 비행 속도를 대신 선택할 수 있습니다. 부패 결함 모든 이동 속도에 10피트 페널티를 받습니다.

도약하는 영혼 근접 무기 전용. 해당 무기는 30피트 투척 특성을 획득하며 귀환 룬을 지닌다(이미 최대 속성 룬 수를 보유한 경우에도 적용). 부패 결함 투척 무기나 원거리 무기로 공격을 시도해 빗나갔을 때, 가장 가까운 아군을 대상으로 공격을 재시도한다. 이 공격은 빗나간 공격과 동일한 다중 공격 페널티를 적용받으며, 다중 공격 페널티 계산에는 포함되지 않는다.

깊은 공포의 씨앗 적의 무기 본질 형태를 인지할 수 있는 적을 위축시킬 때, 협박 판정 능력치에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻으며 언어 불일치 페널티를 받지 않습니다. 본질 형태를 창조할 때, 그 창조를 인지할 수 있는 적을 사기 저하시키려 시도할 수 있다. 부패 결함 적을 사기 저하시키려 시도할 경우, 그 사기 저하는 가장 가까운 아군도 함께 대상으로 삼는다.

결연한 강인함 다음 상태 이상으로 받는 모든 상태 페널티는 해당 상태 이상 값보다 1 감소합니다: @link[conditions.clumsy], @link[conditions.drained], @link[conditions.enfeebled], @link[conditions.frightened], @link[conditions.sickened], @link[conditions.stupefied]. 이는 실제 상태 수치나 상태의 다른 효과(예: 멍함 상태의 방해 효과 및 DC)를 변경하지 않습니다. 부패 결함 나열된 상태 이상으로 상태 페널티를 받을 때마다, 동일한 능력치에 -1 페널티를 추가로 받습니다.

해로운 악의 (공허) 당신의 공격은 추가로 1d4 공허 피해를 입힙니다. 무기가 창조된 상태에서 한 번, 당신은 본능적 주문으로 해를 시전할 수 있으며, 그 레벨은 당신의 레벨 절반을 올림한 값과 같습니다. 부패 결함 당신이 입히는 모든 피해를 당신의 레벨 절반만큼 감소시킵니다.

영웅의 심장 (마법 부여, 정신) 명중 굴림, 지각 판정, 기술 판정, 내성에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 타락 결함 명중 굴림에 -1 페널티를 받습니다.

치유의 은총 (치유, 활력) 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 빠른 치유를 얻습니다. @link[spells.heal]를 레벨의 절반(올림)에 해당하는 레벨로 선천적 주문으로 한 번 시전할 수 있습니다. 부패 결함 주문으로 받거나 부여하는 모든 치유 효과를 레벨의 절반만큼 감소시킵니다.

마법 저항 (방어 마법) 갑옷이나 방패에만 적용됩니다. 마법에 대한 내성 굴림 및 AC에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 5레벨 이상일 경우, 선천적 주문으로 @link[spells.dispel-magic]를 한 번 시전할 수 있습니다. 주문 랭크은 레벨의 절반에서 1을 뺀 값으로 반올림한 수치와 같습니다(5레벨 또는 6레벨일 경우 2nd, 그 이상은 해당 레벨에서 1을 뺀 수치). 부패 결함 마법에 대한 내성 굴림 및 AC에 -1 페널티를 받습니다.

계층적 유대 (방어 마법) 갑옷이나 방패에만 적용됩니다. 본질 형태를 창조할 때 다음 중 하나의 피해 유형을 선택합니다: 산성, 냉기, 전기, 화염, 음파, 영혼, 활력, 공허. 선택한 유형의 피해에 대해 레벨 +2에 해당하는 저항력을 얻습니다. 부패 결함 모든 피해에 대해 약점 1을 얻습니다.

차원적 고통 (소환) 무기 전용. 본질 형태를 발현할 때 다음 중 하나의 피해 유형을 선택하십시오: 산성, 냉기, 전기, 화염, 음파, 영혼, 활력, 공허. 이 무기로 공격할 때 물리 피해 대신 선택한 유형의 피해를 입히며, 피해에 +2 상태 보너스가 적용됩니다. 부패 결함 무기나 비무장 공격으로 피해를 입힐 때, 평면 통증에 마지막으로 선택한 피해 유형으로 2의 피해를 받는다. 이 피해 유형이 본래 당신에게 피해를 주지 않는 경우(예: 악이 아닌 경우 영혼 피해)에도 적용된다.

정체의 끌림 (변형) 무기 전용. 영혼이 깃든 무기로 적중시킬 때마다, 대상은 1라운드 동안 이동 속도에 -10피트 페널티를 받습니다. 치명타 시, 대신 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.immobilized] 상태가 된다. 부패 결함 모든 이동 속도에 -10피트 페널티를 받는다.

반사하는 영혼 갑옷 또는 방패에만 적용됩니다. 물리 원거리 공격에 대해 AC에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 적의 물리 원거리 공격이 당신을 빗나갈 경우, 반응 행동으로 즉시 빗나간 투사체를 이용해 공격자에게 원거리 강타를 시도하다. 부패 결함물리 원거리 공격에 대해 약점 5를 가집니다.

단호한 저항 방패 전용. 방패의 경도에 +2 상태 보너스가 부여되며, 본질 효과가 지속되는 동안 지속되는 레벨 +2에 해당하는 임시 HP를 얻습니다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{방패 막기} 반응을 보유하지 않은 경우, 방패가 창조된 동안 이를 획득합니다. 부패 결함 방패를 치거나 방패 막기를 사용할 때 피해를 입으면 DC 5 단순을 시도합니다. 실패하면, 해당 방패가 영혼으로 단련된 무기일 경우 해제되고, 다른 방패일 경우 떨어뜨려집니다.

name: Witch's Hut

description.value:
Your home is an animated structure that obeys your commands. By performing a rite that takes 1 day, you create an animated object from a hut, small house, covered wagon, tent, or similar construction of up to Huge size.

The hut uses your AC, saving throw modifiers, and Perception modifier and has 150 HP and Hardness 10. It has the construct armor ability, meaning once it's reduced to less than half its Hit Points, or immediately upon being damaged by a critical hit, its AC is reduced by 4 until it is repaired.

The hut can't attack or attempt skill checks. You can give the hut a command as a single action, which has the auditory and concentrate traits; after 1 round of reconfiguring itself, the hut then follows that command until you give it a different command.

  • Guard The hut watches for trespassers within 120 feet using your Perception modifier and screams if it spots any.
  • Hide The hut appears to be a normal, mundane object of its type. This is a 10th-rank illusion effect.
  • Leap The hut spins around or leaps into the air, then casts 10th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.69L70wKfGDY66Mk9]{Teleport}, transporting itself and all creatures within it.
  • Lock With a slam, each entrance to the hut becomes sealed with a lock spell. You can give this command again to unlock its entrances.
  • Move The hut gains a Speed of 60 feet, growing giant bird or bone legs, if necessary, and follows an extremely basic movement command you give it, such as "follow me" or "move that direction." While perfectly suitable for overland travel, the hut's broad movements and 1-round delay on response time are too imprecise to predictably direct in a combat encounter or other situation where seconds and precise locations count.

You can have only one witch's hut at a time. If you animate a new hut, your previous hut immediately reverts to its original, mundane form. If you die, the hut continues following the last order you gave it indefinitely.
