If you critically fail at a Deception check while in your false priest form, your transformation is broken, returning you to your tanuki form, and you're so embarrassed that you can't resume your False Priest Form until your next daily preparations, after you've taken a night to sleep on it.
_desc_ko: 누구도 타누키를 존중하지 않지만, 존경받는 사제는 대부분이 존중하니, 좀 더 수월하게 살아가려면 이보다 더 좋은 형태가 어디 있겠는가? 형태 변신 시, 선택한 종교의 사제나 다른 종교 관계자의 모습을 취할 수 있다. 가짜 승려 형태일 때, 종교에 관한 지식 회상 기만 판정을 시도할 수 있으며, @link[spells.divine-lance]과 @link[spells.haunting-hymn]를 프라이멀 선천적 캔트립으로 시전할 수 있다. 거짓 사제 형태로 변신한 상태에서 기만 판정에서 대실패를 하면 변신이 깨져 타누키 형태로 돌아가고, 너무 당황하여 다음 일일 준비 시간까지(하룻밤을 자고 난 후) 거짓 사제 형태를 재개할 수 없습니다.

name: Homeward Bound

description.value:
Frequency twice per week

The connection between you and the First World resonates within your body stronger than it does for most gnomes, allowing you to cross the threshold between the Universe and the First World. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5bTt2CvYHPvaR7QQ]{Interplanar Teleport} as a primal innate spell. You can cast it twice per week. This can be used only to travel back and forth between the First World and the Universe. Due to your body's natural resonance, you can act as a locus for the spell, and you don't require a specially attuned planar key.

_desc_en:
Frequency twice per week

The connection between you and the First World resonates within your body stronger than it does for most gnomes, allowing you to cross the threshold between the Universe and the First World. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5bTt2CvYHPvaR7QQ]{Interplanar Teleport} as a primal innate spell. You can cast it twice per week. This can be used only to travel back and forth between the First World and the Universe. Due to your body's natural resonance, you can act as a locus for the spell, and you don't require a specially attuned planar key.
_desc_ko:
빈도 주 2회

당신과 제1세계 사이의 연결은 대부분의 노움보다 당신의 몸 안에서 더 강하게 공명하여, 우주와 제1세계 사이의 경계를 넘나들 수 있게 합니다. 당신은 @link[spells.interplanar-teleport]을 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 얻습니다. 이 주술은 주당 두 번 시전할 수 있습니다. 오직 제1세계와 우주 사이를 오가는 이동에만 사용 가능합니다. 본인의 신체적 공명 특성으로 인해, 본인이 주술의 발동 지점이 될 수 있으며 특별히 조율된 평면 열쇠가 필요하지 않습니다.

name: Hampering Stance

description.value: You make it difficult for enemies to move past you. While you are in this stance, squares in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] are difficult terrain for your enemies.

_desc_en: You make it difficult for enemies to move past you. While you are in this stance, squares in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] are difficult terrain for your enemies.
_desc_ko: 적들이 당신을 지나가도록 어렵게 만듭니다. 이 자세를 취하는 동안, 5피트 발산의 칸은 적들에게 어려운 지형이 됩니다.

name: Fiendish Magic

description.value:
You possess fiendish magic. Choose two of the following spells: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PRrZ7anETWPm90YY]{Disguise Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8ViwItUgwT4lOvvb]{False Vitality}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1xbFBQDRs0hT5xZ9]{Shatter}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Mkbq9xlAUxHUHyR2]{Paranoia}. You can use each of the chosen spells once per day as 2nd-rank divine innate spells.

Grimspawn typically take false vitality and see the unseen, pitborn typically take paranoia and shatter, and hellspawn typically take invisibility and disguise magic.

value.value: Grimspawn, Pitborn, Hellspawn, or another lineage feat associated with fiends

_desc_en:
You possess fiendish magic. Choose two of the following spells: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PRrZ7anETWPm90YY]{Disguise Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8ViwItUgwT4lOvvb]{False Vitality}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1xbFBQDRs0hT5xZ9]{Shatter}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Mkbq9xlAUxHUHyR2]{Paranoia}. You can use each of the chosen spells once per day as 2nd-rank divine innate spells.

Grimspawn typically take false vitality and see the unseen, pitborn typically take paranoia and shatter, and hellspawn typically take invisibility and disguise magic.
_desc_ko:
당신은 악마의 마법을 지닌다. 다음 주문 중 두 가지를 선택한다: @link[spells.disguise-magic], @link[spells.false-vitality], @link[spells.invisibility], @link[spells.see-the-unseen], @link[spells.shatter], 또는 @link[spells.paranoia]. 선택한 각 주문을 하루에 한 번씩 (2nd)랭크 신성 선천 주문으로 사용할 수 있다.

그림스폰은 일반적으로 거짓 활력을 선택하고 보이지 않는 것을 보며, 핏본은 일반적으로 편집증과 산산조각을 선택하고, 헬스폰은 일반적으로 투명화와 변장을 선택한다.

name: Eye for Masonry

description.value:
Your familiarity with architecture allows you to easily spot subtle stonework. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to notice unusual stonework. This bonus applies to checks to discover mechanical traps made of stone or hidden within stone, as well as secret doors in stone.

When using Athletics to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} a stone door or Thievery to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable a Device} made primarily of stone, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to that check.

_desc_en:
Your familiarity with architecture allows you to easily spot subtle stonework. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to notice unusual stonework. This bonus applies to checks to discover mechanical traps made of stone or hidden within stone, as well as secret doors in stone.

When using Athletics to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} a stone door or Thievery to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable a Device} made primarily of stone, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to that check.
_desc_ko:
건축에 대한 당신의 친숙함 덕분에 미묘한 석조 작업을 쉽게 알아챌 수 있습니다. 특이한 석조 작업을 발견하는 지각 판정 시 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 보너스는 석재로 만들어졌거나 석재 속에 숨겨진 기계적 함정, 그리고 석재로 된 비밀문을 발견하는 판정에도 적용됩니다.

운동 능력으로 @link[actions.force-open]하여 돌문을 열거나, 도둑질 능력으로 @link[actions.disable-a-device]하여 주로 돌로 만들어진 장치를 해제할 때, 해당 능력 판정에서 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Underwater Volcano

description.value: You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.O7ZEqWjwdKyo2CUv]{Volcanic Eruption} as a 7th-rank primal innate spell once per day, except that you can only evoke the volcano on the floor of a body of water, and the effects that normally happen to flying creatures happen to swimming creatures instead.

_desc_en: You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.O7ZEqWjwdKyo2CUv]{Volcanic Eruption} as a 7th-rank primal innate spell once per day, except that you can only evoke the volcano on the floor of a body of water, and the effects that normally happen to flying creatures happen to swimming creatures instead.
_desc_ko: 하루에 한 번, (7th)랭크 프라이멀 선천 마법인 @link[spells.volcanic-eruption]을 시전할 수 있습니다. 단, 화산은 반드시 수역 바닥에서만 발생시킬 수 있으며, 일반적으로 비행 생물에게 발생하는 효과가 대신 수영 생물에게 적용됩니다.

name: Pied Piping

description.value: You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Um0aaJotqMKGmAlR]{Pied Piping} composition spell, which enables you to control the actions of weak-minded individuals.

_desc_en: You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Um0aaJotqMKGmAlR]{Pied Piping} composition spell, which enables you to control the actions of weak-minded individuals.
_desc_ko: @link[spells.pied-piping] 작곡 주문을 습득하여 정신이 약한 개인의 행동을 조종할 수 있게 됩니다.

name: Sapping Symbol

description.value:
Trigger While you have your symbol raised, you are about to take damage from a melee attack.

Your religious symbol glows with sacred energy, turning the attacker's strength to weakness. Attempt a @Check[religion|defense:will] check against the triggering creature's Will DC. Regardless of the result, the creature is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} until it spends at least 1 action moving away from you.

Success As critical success, but @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

_desc_en:
Trigger While you have your symbol raised, you are about to take damage from a melee attack.

Your religious symbol glows with sacred energy, turning the attacker's strength to weakness. Attempt a @Check[religion|defense:will] check against the triggering creature's Will DC. Regardless of the result, the creature is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} until it spends at least 1 action moving away from you.

Success As critical success, but @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신이 상징을 들고 있는 동안, 근접 공격으로 피해를 입으려 할 때.

당신의 종교적 상징이 신성한 에너지로 빛나며 공격자의 힘을 약점으로 바꿉니다. 발동한 생물의 의지 DC에 대해 종교학 판정을 시도하십시오. 결과와 상관없이 해당 생물은 1분 동안 일시적으로 면역 상태가 됩니다.

대성공 해당 생물은 @link[conditions.enfeebled] 상태가 되며, 최소 1회 행동을 사용해 당신에게서 멀어지기 전까지 지속됩니다.

성공 대성공과 동일하나 @link[conditions.enfeebled]{1} 상태가 적용됩니다.

name: Stalwart Song

description.value:
Trigger You're about to attempt a saving throw against a fear effect.

Requirements You're in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.5HZ4cYDowUw2oUbZ]{Tenacious Stance}.

As a stalwart defender, you rely on your martial training and your tried-and-true armor to face any danger without flinching. Your mountain-like resilience and courage draw strength from the centuries-old traditions of dwarven song. You bring to mind—and possibly give voice to—a cherished dwarven song of inspiring heroism, granting you a +2 circumstance bonus to the saving throw.

_desc_en:
Trigger You're about to attempt a saving throw against a fear effect.

Requirements You're in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.5HZ4cYDowUw2oUbZ]{Tenacious Stance}.

As a stalwart defender, you rely on your martial training and your tried-and-true armor to face any danger without flinching. Your mountain-like resilience and courage draw strength from the centuries-old traditions of dwarven song. You bring to mind—and possibly give voice to—a cherished dwarven song of inspiring heroism, granting you a +2 circumstance bonus to the saving throw.
_desc_ko:
발동 공포 효과에 대한 내성 굴림을 시도하다.

요구 사항 당신은 @link[actions.tenacious-stance] 상태입니다.

당신은 확고한 수호자로서, 무술 훈련과 검증된 갑옷에 의지하여 어떤 위험에도 주저하지 않고 맞섭니다. 산처럼 굳건한 회복력과 용기는 수세기 동안 이어져 온 드워프의 노래 전통에서 힘을 얻습니다. 당신은 영감을 주는 영웅주의를 담은 소중한 드워프의 노래를 떠올리게 하고, 아마도 그 노래를 불러내어 내성 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 부여합니다.

name: Metabolize Element

description.value:
Trigger You take damage from a foe's spell or magical ability with a trait of one of the elements in your elemental philosophy.

You rapidly metabolize the elemental particles in your opponent's spell to gain a boost of energy. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition until the end of your next turn. You can use the extra action only to Step or Stride.

_desc_en:
Trigger You take damage from a foe's spell or magical ability with a trait of one of the elements in your elemental philosophy.

You rapidly metabolize the elemental particles in your opponent's spell to gain a boost of energy. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition until the end of your next turn. You can use the extra action only to Step or Stride.
_desc_ko:
발동 자신의 원소 철학에 속한 원소 속성을 지닌 적의 주문이나 마법 능력으로 피해를 입습니다.

상대방의 주문에 포함된 원소 입자를 신속히 대사하여 에너지 부스트를 얻습니다. 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.quickened] 상태를 얻습니다. 추가 행동은 {신중한 발걸음} 또는 이동에만 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Gunslinger Dedication

description.value:
You excel in using specific types of ranged weapons. You have familiarity with martial crossbows and firearms, treating them as simple weapons for the purposes of proficiency.

You gain access to uncommon martial and simple crossbows and firearms that do not have an ancestry trait. You become trained in gunslinger class DC.

Choose a gunslinger way. You become trained in your way's associated skill; if you were already trained in this skill, you become trained in a skill of your choice. You don't gain any other abilities from your choice of way.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.CSVoyUvynmM5LzPW]{Gunslinger}

_desc_en:
You excel in using specific types of ranged weapons. You have familiarity with martial crossbows and firearms, treating them as simple weapons for the purposes of proficiency.

You gain access to uncommon martial and simple crossbows and firearms that do not have an ancestry trait. You become trained in gunslinger class DC.

Choose a gunslinger way. You become trained in your way's associated skill; if you were already trained in this skill, you become trained in a skill of your choice. You don't gain any other abilities from your choice of way.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.CSVoyUvynmM5LzPW]{Gunslinger}
_desc_ko:
특정 유형의 원거리 무기 사용에 탁월합니다. 무술용 석궁과 화기에 패밀리어로, 숙련도 목적상 이를 단순 무기로 취급합니다.

조상 특성이 없는 흔하지 않은 무술용 및 단순 석궁과 화기를 사용할 수 있게 됩니다. 건슬링어 클래스 난이도(DC)에 숙련됩니다.

건슬링어의 길을 선택하십시오. 해당 길과 연관된 기술에 숙련됩니다. 이미 해당 기술에 숙련된 경우, 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다. 길 선택으로 인한 다른 능력은 얻지 못합니다.

name: Experienced Follower

description.value:
Your followers' skills have developed over the course of your adventures. All your followers become experienced followers.

Additionally, your followers have grown accustomed to the perils of battle, developing the confidence to attack foes without your direction. During an encounter, even if you don't use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.H72AAzknXiojqXdY]{Direct Follower} action, your active follower spend can still use 1 action that round on your turn to Stride or Strike. They can do this at any point during your turn, as long as you aren't currently taking an action. If they do, that's all the actions they get that round—you can't Direct them later.

_desc_en:
Your followers' skills have developed over the course of your adventures. All your followers become experienced followers.

Additionally, your followers have grown accustomed to the perils of battle, developing the confidence to attack foes without your direction. During an encounter, even if you don't use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.H72AAzknXiojqXdY]{Direct Follower} action, your active follower spend can still use 1 action that round on your turn to Stride or Strike. They can do this at any point during your turn, as long as you aren't currently taking an action. If they do, that's all the actions they get that round—you can't Direct them later.
_desc_ko:
모험을 거듭하며 추종자들의 기술이 발전했습니다. 모든 추종자가 숙련된 추종자가 됩니다.

추종자들은 전투의 위험에 익숙해져, 당신의 지시 없이도 적을 공격할 자신감을 키웠습니다. 전투 중, 당신이 @link[actions.direct-follower] 행동을 사용하지 않더라도, 활성 추종자 지출은 여전히 당신의 턴에 그 라운드 동안 1개의 행동을 사용하여 이동하거나 공격할 수 있습니다. 당신이 현재 행동을 취하고 있지 않은 한, 당신의 턴 중 언제든지 이를 수행할 수 있습니다. 만약 그렇게 한다면, 그것이 그 라운드 동안 그들이 취할 수 있는 모든 행동입니다-나중에 그들을 지시할 수 없습니다.

name: Expanded Runelord Magic

description.value: Your ability to use magic associated with your chosen sin grows. You gain the ability to cast one more arcane spell as an innate spell. This spell must be chosen from those listed in Avenging Runelord Dedication above, as well as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WG91Z5TiR6oO5FOw]{Contingency}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9igi8LcrNQKwljK7]{Spell Riposte}, or any 7th-rank spell from your chosen sin's school. You can cast this spell as an arcane innate spell once per day. The spell is automatically heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. Use mythic proficiency to determine any attack rolls or spell DCs.

publication.title: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

_desc_en: Your ability to use magic associated with your chosen sin grows. You gain the ability to cast one more arcane spell as an innate spell. This spell must be chosen from those listed in Avenging Runelord Dedication above, as well as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WG91Z5TiR6oO5FOw]{Contingency}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9igi8LcrNQKwljK7]{Spell Riposte}, or any 7th-rank spell from your chosen sin's school. You can cast this spell as an arcane innate spell once per day. The spell is automatically heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. Use mythic proficiency to determine any attack rolls or spell DCs.
_desc_ko: 당신이 선택한 죄악과 연관된 마법을 사용하는 능력이 성장합니다. 당신은 비전 주문 하나를 추가로 선천 주문으로 시전하는 능력을 얻습니다. 이 주문은 위의 복수하는 룬로드 전념에 나열된 것들, 그리고 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WG91Z5TiR6oO5FOw]{우발 대비}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9igi8LcrNQKwljK7]{주문 반격}, 또는 당신이 선택한 죄악의 학파의 7랭크 주문 중에서 선택해야 합니다. 당신은 이 주문을 하루 1회 비전 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 주문은 자동으로 당신 레벨의 절반(올림)과 동일한 주문 랭크로 강화됩니다. 명중 굴림이나 주문 DC를 결정할 때는 신화 숙련도를 사용합니다.

name: Palatine Enchantment

description.value: You have found yourself facing supernatural beings often and have learned how to combat them. Whenever you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.m0f2B7G9eaaTmhFL]{Devise a Stratagem} against a creature about which you could Recall Knowledge using Occultism or Religion, you can make the subsequent Strike against that creature as if the weapon has either a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{Ghost Touch} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.LwQb7ryTC8FlOXgX]{Vitalizing} property rune.

_desc_en: You have found yourself facing supernatural beings often and have learned how to combat them. Whenever you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.m0f2B7G9eaaTmhFL]{Devise a Stratagem} against a creature about which you could Recall Knowledge using Occultism or Religion, you can make the subsequent Strike against that creature as if the weapon has either a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{Ghost Touch} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.LwQb7ryTC8FlOXgX]{Vitalizing} property rune.
_desc_ko: 당신은 초자연적 존재들과 자주 맞서게 되면서 그들을 상대하는 법을 터득했습니다. 오컬트나 종교로 지식 회상이 가능한 생물에게 @link[actions.devise-a-stratagem]를 사용할 때마다, 해당 생물에게 가하는 후속 공격은 무기에 @link[equipment.ghost-touch] 또는 @link[equipment.vitalizing] 속성 룬이 새겨진 것처럼 공격할 수 있다.

name: Explosive Leap

description.value:
You aim an explosion from your innovation downward to launch yourself into the air. You jump up to 30 feet in any direction without touching the ground. You must land on a space of solid ground, or else you fall after using your next action. As normal for effects where you fall after using your next action, you still fall at the end of your turn, even if you don't use any further actions that turn.

Special If your innovation is a minion, it can take this action rather than you.

_desc_en:
You aim an explosion from your innovation downward to launch yourself into the air. You jump up to 30 feet in any direction without touching the ground. You must land on a space of solid ground, or else you fall after using your next action. As normal for effects where you fall after using your next action, you still fall at the end of your turn, even if you don't use any further actions that turn.

Special If your innovation is a minion, it can take this action rather than you.
_desc_ko:
당신은 발명품으로 아래를 향해 폭발을 일으켜 공중으로 도약합니다. 지면에 닿지 않고 어느 방향으로든 최대 30피트까지 점프할 수 있습니다. 반드시 단단한 지면 공간에 착지해야 하며, 그렇지 않으면 다음 행동을 사용한 후 추락합니다. 다음 행동을 사용한 후 추락하는 효과의 일반 규칙에 따라, 해당 턴에 추가 행동을 사용하지 않더라도 턴 종료 시 반드시 추락한다.

특수 혁신 대상이 하수인인 경우, 본인이 아닌 하수인이 이 행동을 수행할 수 있습니다.

name: Harmonize Self

description.value: You can restore your health by tapping into your qi. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qJZZdYBdNaWRJFER]{Harmonize Self} qi spell.

_desc_en: You can restore your health by tapping into your qi. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qJZZdYBdNaWRJFER]{Harmonize Self} qi spell.
_desc_ko: 기(氣)를 활용하여 HP를 회복할 수 있습니다. @link[spells.harmonize-self] 기(氣) 주문을 획득합니다.

name: Ancestral Form

description.value: Casting your memory back deep into the past, you take the form of an ancestral guardian. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wp09USMB3GIW1qbp]{Animal Form} on yourself as a 3rd-rank primal innate spell once per day. You must choose the crocodile form.

value.value: bakuwa lizardfolk heritage or makari lizardfolk heritage

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Casting your memory back deep into the past, you take the form of an ancestral guardian. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wp09USMB3GIW1qbp]{Animal Form} on yourself as a 3rd-rank primal innate spell once per day. You must choose the crocodile form.
_desc_ko: 기억을 먼 과거로 거슬러 올라가며, 당신은 조상의 수호자 형태를 취합니다. 하루에 한 번, 자신에게 @link[spells.animal-form]를 (3rd)랭크 프라이멀 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 반드시 악어 형태를 선택해야 합니다.

name: Feral Scramble

description.value:
Requirements You're in hybrid or animal shape.

Sinking your claws in, you propel yourself at shocking speed. You Climb up to your land Speed and make a claw Strike at any point during that movement. After you finish the movement, attempt an @Check[athletics] check against the surface's Climb DC.

Success You maintain your position.

Failure You slide down 60 feet or to the ground without taking falling damage.

value.value: your animal shape grants a claw unarmed attack

_desc_en:
Requirements You're in hybrid or animal shape.

Sinking your claws in, you propel yourself at shocking speed. You Climb up to your land Speed and make a claw Strike at any point during that movement. After you finish the movement, attempt an @Check[athletics] check against the surface's Climb DC.

Success You maintain your position.

Failure You slide down 60 feet or to the ground without taking falling damage.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 하이브리드 형태나 동물 형태를 취하고 있어야 합니다.

발톱을 박아 넣으며 놀라운 속도로 몸을 내던진다. 지상 속도까지 기어오르며 이동 중 언제든 발톱 공격을 가한다. 이동을 마친 후 표면의 등반 DC에 맞서 운동 판정을 시도하다.

성공 시 자리를 유지한다.

실패 추락 피해를 입지 않고 60피트 아래로 미끄러져 내려가거나 지면에 닿습니다.

name: Advanced Seeker of Truths

description.value:
You have unlocked deeper secrets to uncovering and hoarding lore. You gain an advanced domain spell from one domain you selected with Seeker of Truths. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.

Special You can take this feat up to three times, each time selecting a different advanced domain spell from a domain you selected with Seeker of Truths.

_desc_en:
You have unlocked deeper secrets to uncovering and hoarding lore. You gain an advanced domain spell from one domain you selected with Seeker of Truths. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.

Special You can take this feat up to three times, each time selecting a different advanced domain spell from a domain you selected with Seeker of Truths.
_desc_ko:
당신은 지식를 발견하고 축적하는 더 깊은 비밀을 해금했습니다. 진실의 탐구자로 선택한 하나의 영역에서 고급 포커스 주문을 얻습니다. 포커스 풀의 포커스 포인트 수를 1 증가시킵니다.

특수 이 피트를 최대 세 번까지 선택할 수 있으며, 매번 진실의 탐구자로 선택한 영역 중 다른 고급 영역 주문을 선택합니다.

name: Showstopper

description.value: Your twirling weapons create a grand distraction that's difficult to look away from. When using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.A2EBy2L4acrehiAA]{Pistol Twirl} to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint}, you can target all enemies within your weapon's first range increment who you can perceive and who can see you. You roll one Deception check and compare it against each target's Perception DC.

_desc_en: Your twirling weapons create a grand distraction that's difficult to look away from. When using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.A2EBy2L4acrehiAA]{Pistol Twirl} to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint}, you can target all enemies within your weapon's first range increment who you can perceive and who can see you. You roll one Deception check and compare it against each target's Perception DC.
_desc_ko: 당신의 휘두르는 무기는 눈을 뗄 수 없는 화려한 주의를 분산시킵니다. @link[feats.pistol-twirl]을 @link[actions.feint]에 사용할 때, 당신은 무기의 첫 번째 사거리 범위 내에 있고 당신이 인지할 수 있으며 당신을 볼 수 있는 모든 적을 대상으로 삼을 수 있습니다. 당신은 하나의 기만 판정을 굴리고 각 대상의 지각 DC와 비교합니다.

name: Battle Hymn to the Lost

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Your movements in combat are an artistic dirge to those spirits who could not fight to see another day. You make a Strike. Regardless of whether the Strike succeeds, spirits of warriors who died gloriously in battle surge out to attack with you. They appear in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] if you make a melee Strike or in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] around your target if you made a ranged Strike. Each enemy in the area takes @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/4))d10[untyped]|options:area-damage|shortLabel] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:exemplar|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC; you choose whether the damage is bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing. At 12th level and every 4 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d10.

As they join the battle, the spirits call your fallen allies back to the fight. Any of your allies in the area who are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} regain Hit Points equal to the damage you rolled. This is a divine, healing, vitality effect.

value.value: of verse unbroken or peerless under heaven

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Your movements in combat are an artistic dirge to those spirits who could not fight to see another day. You make a Strike. Regardless of whether the Strike succeeds, spirits of warriors who died gloriously in battle surge out to attack with you. They appear in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] if you make a melee Strike or in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] around your target if you made a ranged Strike. Each enemy in the area takes @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/4))d10[untyped]|options:area-damage|shortLabel] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:exemplar|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC; you choose whether the damage is bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing. At 12th level and every 4 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d10.

As they join the battle, the spirits call your fallen allies back to the fight. Any of your allies in the area who are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} regain Hit Points equal to the damage you rolled. This is a divine, healing, vitality effect.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

전투 중 당신의 움직임은 다음 날을 보지 못하고 싸우다 죽은 영혼들을 위한 예술적인 애가입니다. 당신은 공격을 가합니다. 공격 성공 여부와 상관없이, 전투에서 영광스럽게 죽은 전사들의 영혼이 당신과 함께 공격하기 위해 솟아납니다. 근접 공격을 가했다면 30피트 원뿔에, 원거리 공격을 가했다면 대상 주변 10피트 발산에 나타납니다. 해당 영역 내의 각 적은 의 피해를 입으며, 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 기본 반사 내성에 성공해야 합니다. 피해 유형은 타격, 관통, 베기 중 하나를 선택합니다. 12레벨과 그 이후 4레벨마다 피해량이 1d10 증가합니다.

전투에 합류하는 영혼들은 쓰러진 아군을 다시 전투로 불러옵니다. 해당 지역에 있는 @link[conditions.dying] 상태의 아군은 당신이 굴린 피해량만큼 HP를 회복합니다. 이는 신성, 치유, vitality 효과입니다.

name: Push It

description.value: You can push your vehicle's performance beyond the limits envisioned by its makers. Whenever you succeed at a piloting check, the vehicle you are piloting gains a +5-foot circumstance bonus to all its Speeds until the end of your turn. If you critically succeed, this bonus increases to +10 feet.

_desc_en: You can push your vehicle's performance beyond the limits envisioned by its makers. Whenever you succeed at a piloting check, the vehicle you are piloting gains a +5-foot circumstance bonus to all its Speeds until the end of your turn. If you critically succeed, this bonus increases to +10 feet.
_desc_ko: 당신은 차량의 성능을 제작자가 예상한 한계를 넘어 밀어붙일 수 있습니다. 조종 판정에서 성공할 때마다, 당신이 조종하는 차량은 당신의 턴이 끝날 때까지 모든 속도에 +5피트 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 대성공하면 이 보너스는 +10피트로 증가합니다.

name: Ears That Hear the Truth

description.value: You have an acute understanding of the rhythms of living things, and you never miss the quaver that betrays a spoken lie. When you attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive}, or when you roll Perception for initiative, you can spend a Mythic Point to attempt the check or roll at mythic proficiency.

_desc_en: You have an acute understanding of the rhythms of living things, and you never miss the quaver that betrays a spoken lie. When you attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive}, or when you roll Perception for initiative, you can spend a Mythic Point to attempt the check or roll at mythic proficiency.
_desc_ko: 당신은 생명체의 리듬을 예리하게 이해하며, 거짓말을 드러내는 떨림을 절대 놓치지 않습니다. @link[actions.sense-motive]를 시도하거나, 인니셔티브를 위해 지각 능력 판정을 할 때 신화 포인트를 소모하면 신화 숙련도로 해당 판정나 주사위를 굴릴 수 있습니다.

name: Makeshift Strike

description.value: You quickly snatch up whatever is nearby and then attack with it as an improvised weapon. You Interact to pick up an unattended object in reach you could use as an improvised weapon, then Strike with that improvised weapon.

_desc_en: You quickly snatch up whatever is nearby and then attack with it as an improvised weapon. You Interact to pick up an unattended object in reach you could use as an improvised weapon, then Strike with that improvised weapon.
_desc_ko: 근처에 있는 물건을 재빨리 집어 들고 즉석 무기로 공격합니다. 즉석 무기로 사용할 수 있는 손이 닿는 곳에 있는 방치된 물건을 집어 들기 위해 상호작용을 사용한 후, 그 즉석 무기로 공격합니다.

name: Strong Swimmer

description.value: Your swim Speed increases to match your land Speed.

_desc_en: Your swim Speed increases to match your land Speed.
_desc_ko: 수영 속도가 지상 속도와 동일해집니다.

name: Battlefield Agility

description.value:
Requirements You're flanked by at least two enemies.

Your enemies might think they have you surrounded, but you know just how to extricate yourself. Make a melee Strike against one of the enemies flanking you and Step, in any order.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're flanked by at least two enemies.

Your enemies might think they have you surrounded, but you know just how to extricate yourself. Make a melee Strike against one of the enemies flanking you and Step, in any order.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 적 최소 두 명에게 측면 공격을 받고 있을 때.

적들은 당신을 포위했다고 생각할지 모르나, 당신은 빠져나갈 방법을 알고 있다. 측면 공격을 가하는 적 중 한 명을 상대로 근접 공격을 시도하고, 순서는 자유롭게 선택하여 {신중한 발걸음}으로 이동하라.

name: Sense Holiness

description.value: The presence of goodness sickens you with its saccharine self-righteousness. You can sense the presence of creatures with the holy trait within 120 feet. This functions as a vague sense, similar to humans' sense of smell. A holy creature using a disguise or otherwise trying to hide its presence attempts a @Check[deception|against:perception|rollerRole:target|showDC:all] check against your Perception DC to hide its sanctification from you. If the creature succeeds at its Deception check, it is then temporarily immune to your Sense Holiness for 1 day.

_desc_en: The presence of goodness sickens you with its saccharine self-righteousness. You can sense the presence of creatures with the holy trait within 120 feet. This functions as a vague sense, similar to humans' sense of smell. A holy creature using a disguise or otherwise trying to hide its presence attempts a @Check[deception|against:perception|rollerRole:target|showDC:all] check against your Perception DC to hide its sanctification from you. If the creature succeeds at its Deception check, it is then temporarily immune to your Sense Holiness for 1 day.
_desc_ko: 선함의 존재는 그 달콤한 독선으로 당신을 병약하게 만듭니다. 당신은 120피트 이내에 있는 신성한 특성을 가진 생물의 존재를 감지할 수 있습니다. 이는 인간의 후각과 유사한 막연한 감각으로 기능합니다. 신성한 생물이 변장이나 다른 방법으로 자신의 존재를 숨기려 할 경우, 당신의 지각 DC에 맞서 기만 기만 판정을 시도하여 당신에게서 자신의 신성한 것을 숨기려 한다. 해당 생물이 기만 판정에 성공하면, 1일 동안 당신의 신성한 것 감지 능력에 대해 일시적으로 면역이 된다.

name: Bloodline Breadth

description.value: Your repertoire expands, and you can cast more spells of your bloodline's tradition each day. Increase the number of spells in your repertoire and number of spell slots you gain from sorcerer archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest spell slots.

_desc_en: Your repertoire expands, and you can cast more spells of your bloodline's tradition each day. Increase the number of spells in your repertoire and number of spell slots you gain from sorcerer archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest spell slots.
_desc_ko: 당신의 레퍼토리가 확장되어 혈통 전통의 주문을 매일 더 많이 시전할 수 있습니다. 가장 높은 두 주문 슬롯을 제외한 각 주문 랭크마다 레퍼토리 내 주문 수와 소서러 아키타입 재주로 얻는 주문 슬롯 수를 1씩 증가시킵니다.

name: Seven-Part Link

description.value: Many traditions hold the number seven as significant. By exchanging pieces of a seven-part set of esoterica, you create a magical web by which your allies can affect each other at a distance. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.S5vOQ7J8DKR8sEj0]{Paired Link} during your daily preparations, you can exchange linking esoterica with up to six willing allies, keeping one piece for yourself. In addition to the normal effects of Paired Link, if a linked ally casts a spell with a range of touch, they can target linked allies within 30 feet with that spell.

_desc_en: Many traditions hold the number seven as significant. By exchanging pieces of a seven-part set of esoterica, you create a magical web by which your allies can affect each other at a distance. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.S5vOQ7J8DKR8sEj0]{Paired Link} during your daily preparations, you can exchange linking esoterica with up to six willing allies, keeping one piece for yourself. In addition to the normal effects of Paired Link, if a linked ally casts a spell with a range of touch, they can target linked allies within 30 feet with that spell.
_desc_ko: 많은 전통에서 숫자 일곱을 중요하게 여깁니다. 일곱 조각으로 이루어진 일곱 부분의 에소테리카 세트를 교환함으로써, 동맹들이 거리에서도 서로에게 영향을 미칠 수 있는 마법의 거미줄을 만들어냅니다. 일일 준비 단계에서 @link[feats.paired-link]을 사용하면, 최대 여섯 명의 동의를 얻은 동맹과 결속된 에소테리카를 교환할 수 있으며, 그중 하나는 자신에게 남깁니다. 쌍결속의 일반 효과에 더해, 결속된 동맹이 접촉 범위의 주문을 시전할 경우, 30피트 내의 결속된 동맹을 그 주문의 대상으로 지정할 수 있습니다.

name: Let My Creature Live!

description.value: You continue to tinker with your creation's muscles and rudimentary mind, granting it a limited form of autonomy. Your construct companion becomes an advanced construct companion. During an encounter, even if you don't use the Command a Minion action, your construct companion can still use 1 action on your turn that round to Stride or Strike.

_desc_en: You continue to tinker with your creation's muscles and rudimentary mind, granting it a limited form of autonomy. Your construct companion becomes an advanced construct companion. During an encounter, even if you don't use the Command a Minion action, your construct companion can still use 1 action on your turn that round to Stride or Strike.
_desc_ko: 당신은 창조물의 근육과 기초적인 정신을 계속해서 땜질하여 제한된 형태의 자율성을 부여합니다. 당신의 구조체 동료는 고급 구조체 동료로 진화합니다. 전투 중, 당신이 '하수인 지령 ' 행동을 사용하지 않더라도, 당신의 구조체 동료는 해당 라운드 당신의 턴에 1개의 행동을 사용하여 '이동' 또는 '공격'을 할 수 있습니다.

name: Adroit Manipulation

description.value:
Access Mihrini ethnicity

You've fiddled with knots, locks, and blacksmith's puzzles since you were a child to give your hands something to do. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Thievery (or another skill of your choice, if you're already trained in Thievery). If you roll a success on a Thievery check to Pick a Lock, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en:
Access Mihrini ethnicity

You've fiddled with knots, locks, and blacksmith's puzzles since you were a child to give your hands something to do. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Thievery (or another skill of your choice, if you're already trained in Thievery). If you roll a success on a Thievery check to Pick a Lock, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko:
접근 미르니 인종

어릴 적부터 손이 심심해하지 않도록 매듭, 자물쇠, 대장장이의 퍼즐 등을 만지작거려왔다. 도둑질(또는 이미 도둑질에 숙련된 경우 선택한 다른 기술)에 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻는다. 자물쇠 따기 도둑질 판정에서 성공을 굴리면 대신 대성공을 얻는다.

name: As On the Board, So On the Battlefield

description.value:
You're a master of strategy games, able to translate strategies and mechanics from these games to the actual battles they were created to simulate. You can use your proficiency rank in Games Lore for anything that requires proficiency in Warfare Lore (such as prerequisites) and use your Games Lore modifier in place of your Warfare Lore modifier for checks. You can use Games Lore to [[/act make-an-impression]] on military professionals, such as mercenaries and commanders. Your reputation as a strategist opens up opportunities while you're in a military camp, near a battlefield, or somewhere else that has numerous non-hostile soldiers, allowing you to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income} with Games Lore with a task level of at least your level –1.

If you lead a troop and have had time to create a skirmish bond with them, you've also spent time going over the finer points of strategy and even played against many members of your troop. Once per day, you can roll Games Lore for initiative when leading this troop.

name_en: As On the Board, So On the Battlefield
_desc_en:

You can use Games Lore to [[/act make-an-impression]] on military professionals, such as mercenaries and commanders. Your reputation as a strategist opens up opportunities while you're in a military camp, near a battlefield, or somewhere else that has numerous non-hostile soldiers, allowing you to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income} with Games Lore with a task level of at least your level –1.

If you lead a troop and have had time to create a skirmish bond with them, you've also spent time going over the finer points of strategy and even played against many members of your troop. Once per day, you can roll Games Lore for initiative when leading this troop.
_desc_ko:
당신은 전략 게임의 달인으로, 이러한 게임의 전략과 메커니즘을 그것들이 모의하도록 만들어진 실제 전투에 옮길 수 있습니다. 당신은 전쟁 지식 숙련이 필요한 모든 것(선행 조건 등)에 게임 지식 숙련도 등급을 사용할 수 있으며, 판정 시 전쟁 지식 수정치 대신 게임 지식 수정치를 사용할 수 있습니다. 당신은 게임 지식을 사용하여 용병이나 지휘관 같은 군사 전문가들에게 [[/act make-an-impression]]을 할 수 있습니다. 전략가로서 당신의 명성은 당신이 군영 안에, 전장 근처에, 또는 비적대적인 병사가 다수 있는 다른 곳에 있는 동안 기회를 열어주어, 최소한 당신 레벨 –1의 과제 레벨로 게임 지식을 사용하여 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{수입 벌기}를 할 수 있게 합니다.

당신이 부대를 이끌고 그들과 교전 유대를 형성할 시간이 있었다면, 당신은 또한 전략의 세부 사항을 검토하고 심지어 부대의 여러 구성원과 대결해 본 시간을 보낸 것입니다. 하루 1회, 당신은 이 부대를 이끌 때 우선권에 게임 지식을 굴릴 수 있습니다.

name: Eagle Eyes

description.value: You and your spotter are adept at watching out for one another. As long as you can see or hear each other, neither of you is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}, or flanking creatures of your level or lower, or to creatures of your level or lower using a surprise attack. However, they can still help their allies flank.

_desc_en: You and your spotter are adept at watching out for one another. As long as you can see or hear each other, neither of you is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}, or flanking creatures of your level or lower, or to creatures of your level or lower using a surprise attack. However, they can still help their allies flank.
_desc_ko: 당신과 당신의 정찰병은 서로를 지켜보는 데 능숙합니다. 서로를 보거나 들을 수 있는 한, 둘 다 @link[conditions.off-guard]가 되어 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태의, @link[conditions.undetected] 상태의, 또는 자신의 레벨 이하의 생물에게 측면 공격을 당하거나, 자신의 레벨 이하의 생물에게 기습 공격을 당하지 않습니다. 다만, 그들은 여전히 아군이 측면 공격을 하는 것을 도울 수 있습니다.

name: Feign Innocence

description.value:
You convince a creature that, despite appearances, you're on its side. Choose an enemy within 60 feet, and attempt a @Check[deception|against:will] check against its Will DC. The target is then temporarily immune to Feign Innocence for 1 hour. If you've taken a hostile action against it this round, your result can be no better than a failure.

Critical Success You and the target are considered allies until the end of your next turn or until you take a hostile action against it, whichever comes first. In order to take a hostile action against you, the target must succeed at a Will save against your Deception DC or it loses the action.

Success As critical success, but lasts until the end of your turn or until you take a hostile action against it, whichever comes first.

Failure No effect.

Critical Failure The target knows you attempted to fool it and plays along. You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to the target until the beginning of your next turn.

_desc_en:
You convince a creature that, despite appearances, you're on its side. Choose an enemy within 60 feet, and attempt a @Check[deception|against:will] check against its Will DC. The target is then temporarily immune to Feign Innocence for 1 hour. If you've taken a hostile action against it this round, your result can be no better than a failure.

Critical Success You and the target are considered allies until the end of your next turn or until you take a hostile action against it, whichever comes first. In order to take a hostile action against you, the target must succeed at a Will save against your Deception DC or it loses the action.

Success As critical success, but lasts until the end of your turn or until you take a hostile action against it, whichever comes first.

Failure No effect.

Critical Failure The target knows you attempted to fool it and plays along. You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to the target until the beginning of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
당신은 겉모습과 달리 당신이 자기 편이라고 생물을 믿게 합니다. 60피트 내의 적 하나를 선택하고, 그 의지 DC에 대해 @Check[deception|against:will] 판정을 시도합니다. 그러면 대상은 1시간 동안 결백 가장에 일시적으로 면역됩니다. 당신이 이번 라운드에 그것에게 적대 행동을 취했다면, 당신의 결과는 실패보다 나을 수 없습니다.

대성공 당신과 대상은 당신의 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지, 또는 당신이 그것에게 적대 행동을 취할 때까지 중 먼저 오는 시점까지 동료로 간주됩니다. 당신에게 적대 행동을 취하려면, 대상은 당신의 기만 DC에 대한 의지 내성에 성공해야 하며, 그렇지 않으면 그 행동을 잃습니다.

성공 대성공과 같으나, 당신의 턴이 끝날 때까지, 또는 당신이 그것에게 적대 행동을 취할 때까지 중 먼저 오는 시점까지 지속됩니다.

실패 효과 없음.

대실패 대상은 당신이 자신을 속이려 했다는 것을 알아차리고 맞장구를 칩니다. 당신은 당신의 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 대상에게 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{무방비} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Noxious Odor

description.value: You have developed your skill with your defensive pheromones and have concentrated them into a noxious form. A creature that fails its save against your Emit Defensive Odor action also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure).

_desc_en: You have developed your skill with your defensive pheromones and have concentrated them into a noxious form. A creature that fails its save against your Emit Defensive Odor action also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure).
_desc_ko: 방어 페로몬 기술을 발전시켜 유독한 형태로 농축시켰습니다. 당신의 방어적 악취 발산 행동에 대한 저항 내성에 실패한 생물은 @link[conditions.sickened]{1} 상태가 되며(대실패 시 @link[conditions.sickened]{2} 상태),

name: Assisting Shot

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a ranged weapon.

Using your last shot to gauge your accuracy, you can fire off a quick shot to interfere with a foe in combat. Make a Strike with a ranged weapon. If the Strike hits, the next creature other than you to attack the same target before the start of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their roll, or a +2 circumstance bonus if your Strike was a critical hit.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.zcJii1XyOne9EvMr]{Effect: Assisting Shot}

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a ranged weapon.

Using your last shot to gauge your accuracy, you can fire off a quick shot to interfere with a foe in combat. Make a Strike with a ranged weapon. If the Strike hits, the next creature other than you to attack the same target before the start of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their roll, or a +2 circumstance bonus if your Strike was a critical hit.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.zcJii1XyOne9EvMr]{Effect: Assisting Shot}
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 원거리 무기를 장비하고 있어야 합니다.

마지막 사격으로 정확도를 가늠하여, 전투 중인 적을 방해하기 위해 재빠르게 사격할 수 있습니다. 원거리 무기로 타격을 가하세요. 타격이 적중하면, 다음 턴이 시작되기 전에 같은 대상을 공격하는 당신 이외의 다음 생물체는 주사위 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 타격이 치명타였다면 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.zcJii1XyOne9EvMr]{효과: 지원 사격}

name: Sky and Heaven Stance

description.value:
Requirements You're unarmored.

Your jagged blows are like lightning. The only Strikes you can make are skyward slash unarmed attacks. These unarmed attacks deal 1d10 slashing damage; are in the brawling group; and have the nonlethal, unarmed, and versatile P traits. While in Sky and Heaven Stance, you gain resistance 2 to electricity and resistance 2 to sonic damage. These resistances increase to 5 at 12th level and to 8 at 18th level.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're unarmored.

Your jagged blows are like lightning. The only Strikes you can make are skyward slash unarmed attacks. These unarmed attacks deal 1d10 slashing damage; are in the brawling group; and have the nonlethal, unarmed, and versatile P traits. While in Sky and Heaven Stance, you gain resistance 2 to electricity and resistance 2 to sonic damage. These resistances increase to 5 at 12th level and to 8 at 18th level.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 갑옷을 착용하지 않아야 합니다.

당신의 날카로운 타격은 번개와 같습니다. 수행 가능한 공격은 하늘을 향해 휘두르는 비무장 공격뿐입니다. 이 비무장 공격은 1d10 베기 피해를 입히며, 난투 그룹에 속하고, 비살상, 무장, 다용도 P 특성을 가집니다. 하늘과 천국 자세를 취할 때, 당신은 전기 피해에 대한 저항 2와 음파 피해에 대한 저항 2를 얻습니다. 이 저항은 12레벨에 5로, 18레벨에 8로 증가합니다.

name: Calculated Splash

description.value: You have calculated all the angles to maximize a bomb's splash. When you throw an alchemical bomb with the splash trait, you can cause the bomb to deal splash damage equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 0) instead of the normal amount.

_desc_en: You have calculated all the angles to maximize a bomb's splash. When you throw an alchemical bomb with the splash trait, you can cause the bomb to deal splash damage equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 0) instead of the normal amount.
_desc_ko: 폭탄의 폭발 반경을 극대화하기 위해 모든 각도를 계산했습니다. 폭발 반경 특성을 가진 연금술 폭탄을 던질 때, 폭탄이 정상적인 양 대신 지능 수정자(최소 0)에 해당하는 방사 피해를 입히도록 할 수 있습니다.

name: Signature Spell Expansion

description.value: Your innate connection to magic lets you cast more spells with greater freedom. You gain two additional signature spells, each of which must have a base rank of 3rd or lower.

_desc_en: Your innate connection to magic lets you cast more spells with greater freedom. You gain two additional signature spells, each of which must have a base rank of 3rd or lower.
_desc_ko: 마법에 대한 타고난 연결로 인해 더 많은 주문을 더 자유롭게 시전할 수 있습니다. 기본 랭크이 3rd 이하인 시그니처 주문 두 가지를 추가로 획득합니다.

name: Propeller Attachment

description.value: You've mastered attaching clockwork propellers to your daily quick-deploy snares that use gears. This allows you to place your snares in the air or underwater, where they remain in place for up to 10 minutes, after which the propeller runs out of power and they fall or sink. Unless you use additional precautions to hide it, a propeller snare's location is usually obvious.

_desc_en: You've mastered attaching clockwork propellers to your daily quick-deploy snares that use gears. This allows you to place your snares in the air or underwater, where they remain in place for up to 10 minutes, after which the propeller runs out of power and they fall or sink. Unless you use additional precautions to hide it, a propeller snare's location is usually obvious.
_desc_ko: 기어를 사용하는 일일 신속 배치 올가미에 시계 장치 프로펠러를 부착하는 기술을 마스터했습니다. 이를 통해 공중이나 수중에 올가미를 설치할 수 있으며, 최대 10분 동안 제자리에 유지됩니다. 이후 프로펠러 동력이 소진되어 올가미는 떨어지거나 가라앉습니다. 추가적인 은폐 조치를 취하지 않는 한, 프로펠러 올가미의 위치는 일반적으로 눈에 띕니다.

name: Tenacious Blood Magic

description.value:
Frequency once per minute

Trigger You apply an effect from your blood magic that lasts for 1 round.

You have learned how to invest magic more deeply by witnessing Aroden's works. The triggering blood magic effect lasts for 1 minute instead of 1 round.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per minute

Trigger You apply an effect from your blood magic that lasts for 1 round.

You have learned how to invest magic more deeply by witnessing Aroden's works. The triggering blood magic effect lasts for 1 minute instead of 1 round.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 분당 1회

발동 조건 자신의 혈통 마법으로 1라운드 지속되는 효과를 적용한다.

아로덴의 업적을 목격함으로써 마법을 더 깊이 투영하는 법을 익혔습니다. 발동되는 혈통 마법 효과가 1라운드가 아닌 1분 동안 지속됩니다.

name: Distant Archer

description.value: You've trained to harry your foes from great distances, using your swiftness to maintain distance and keen eyesight to stay on target. You reduce the penalty for attacking beyond your first range increment by 1, to a minimum of 0, when using weapons in the bow weapon group.

_desc_en: You've trained to harry your foes from great distances, using your swiftness to maintain distance and keen eyesight to stay on target. You reduce the penalty for attacking beyond your first range increment by 1, to a minimum of 0, when using weapons in the bow weapon group.
_desc_ko: 당신은 빠른 속도로 거리를 유지하고 예리한 시력으로 표적을 놓치지 않으며, 먼 거리에서 적을 괴롭히는 훈련을 받았습니다. 활 무기 그룹에 속하는 무기를 사용할 때, 첫 번째 사거리 증가량 이후의 공격에 대한 페널티를 1 감소시킵니다(최소 0).

name: Taunting Strike

description.value: The force of your blow causes your enemy to focus their attention on you. Make a Strike. Regardless of whether the Strike hits, you Taunt the target. Your Taunt gains the visual trait.

_desc_en: The force of your blow causes your enemy to focus their attention on you. Make a Strike. Regardless of whether the Strike hits, you Taunt the target. Your Taunt gains the visual trait.
_desc_ko: 타격의 위력이 적의 주의를 당신에게 포커스시킵니다. 공격을 시도하세요. 타격이 명중했는지 여부와 상관없이, 당신은 대상을 도발합니다. 당신의 도발은 시각적 효과를 얻습니다.

name: All This Will Happen Again

description.value:
Trigger You fail or critically fail a Will save against an emotion effect.

Even in the face of overwhelming tribulation, you find solace in the notion that this feeling is fleeting; all things are merely part of a never-ending cycle. Reroll the triggering saving throw with a +1 status bonus. You must use the second result, even if it's worse.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

name_ko: 이 모든 것이 다시 일어날 것이다
_desc_en:
Trigger You fail or critically fail a Will save against an emotion effect.

Even in the face of overwhelming tribulation, you find solace in the notion that this feeling is fleeting; all things are merely part of a never-ending cycle. Reroll the triggering saving throw with a +1 status bonus. You must use the second result, even if it's worse.
_desc_ko:
발동 감정 효과에 대한 의지 내성에 실패하거나 대실패한다.

압도적인 시련 속에서도, 이 감정이 덧없다는 생각에서 위안을 찾습니다. 모든 것은 끝없는 순환의 일부일 뿐이죠. 발동된 내성 굴림을 +1 상태 보너스와 함께 재굴림합니다. 결과가 더 나쁘더라도 두 번째 결과를 반드시 사용해야 합니다.

name: Superior Sight

description.value:
Your senses are peerless. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks, and you gain low-light vision. If you already have low-light vision, gain darkvision instead.

Furthermore, when you target an enemy, you automatically succeed at the flat check if that enemy is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.

_desc_en:
Your senses are peerless. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks, and you gain low-light vision. If you already have low-light vision, gain darkvision instead.

Furthermore, when you target an enemy, you automatically succeed at the flat check if that enemy is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.
_desc_ko:
당신의 감각은 타의 추종을 불허합니다. 지각 판정에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 저조도 시야를 획득합니다. 이미 저조도 시야를 가진 경우, 대신 암흑 시야를 얻습니다.

또한, 적을 대상으로 할 때 해당 적이 @link[conditions.concealed], @link[conditions.hidden], 또는 @link[conditions.undetected] 상태라면 단순 판정에서 자동으로 성공한다.

name: Skeletal Resistance

description.value: Your body becomes resistant, your hardened bones deflecting weapons and other forms of damage. You gain resistance 2 to cold, electricity, fire, piercing, and slashing damage. This resistance increases to 3 at 13th level and 4 at 17th level.

_desc_en: Your body becomes resistant, your hardened bones deflecting weapons and other forms of damage. You gain resistance 2 to cold, electricity, fire, piercing, and slashing damage. This resistance increases to 3 at 13th level and 4 at 17th level.
_desc_ko: 신체가 강인해져 굳어진 뼈가 무기와 다른 형태의 피해를 튕겨냅니다. 냉기, 전기, 화염, 관통, 베기 피해에 대해 저항력 2를 얻습니다. 이 저항력은 13레벨에 3, 17레벨에 4로 증가합니다.

name: Advanced Firearm Familiarity

description.value: You have familiarity with advanced firearms, treating them as martial weapons for the purposes of proficiency. You gain access to all uncommon firearms.

value.value: expert in any kind of weapon or unarmed attack

_desc_en: You have familiarity with advanced firearms, treating them as martial weapons for the purposes of proficiency. You gain access to all uncommon firearms.
_desc_ko: 고급 화기에 패밀리어하여 숙련도 목적상 무술 무기로 취급합니다. 모든 희귀 화기를 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Storm Born

description.value: You are at home out in the elements, reveling in the power of nature unleashed. You do not take circumstance penalties to ranged spell attacks or Perception checks caused by weather, and your targeted spells don't require a flat check to succeed against a target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} by weather (such as fog).

_desc_en: You are at home out in the elements, reveling in the power of nature unleashed. You do not take circumstance penalties to ranged spell attacks or Perception checks caused by weather, and your targeted spells don't require a flat check to succeed against a target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} by weather (such as fog).
_desc_ko: 당신은 야외에서 편안함을 느끼며, 자연이 발휘하는 힘에 흠뻑 취해 있습니다. 날씨로 인한 원거리 주문 공격이나 지각 판정 상황 페널티를 받지 않으며, 날씨(안개 등)로 인해 @link[conditions.concealed] 대상에게도 단순 판정 없이 표적 주문을 성공시킬 수 있습니다.

name: Friend of the Family

description.value: You come from a long line of imperial kobolds—if you meet a stranger who has some political standing in Tian Xia, they might know someone from your family line. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks to Make an Impression or Request when speaking to politicians or other officials.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You come from a long line of imperial kobolds—if you meet a stranger who has some political standing in Tian Xia, they might know someone from your family line. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks to Make an Impression or Request when speaking to politicians or other officials.
_desc_ko: 당신은 오랜 역사의 제국 코볼트 가문 출신입니다-티엔 샤에서 정치적 지위를 가진 낯선 사람을 만나면, 그들은 당신의 가문 출신 누군가를 알 수도 있습니다. 정치인이나 다른 관리들과 대화할 때, 인상 주기나 요청 외교 기술 판정에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Form Up!

description.value:
You've trained in battle formations for a plethora of situations. Choose a formation. Allies within your aura can use their reaction to Stride up to their Speed and take a place in the chosen formation. Allies can't benefit from this movement if there isn't room for them in the chosen formation. If there are more eligible allies than there are available spaces in the chosen formation, you choose which allies benefit.

  • Line Your allies gather adjacent to you and each other to form a straight line in a direction of your choosing.
  • Wedge Your allies gather into any space that would be covered by a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] originating from you in a direction of your choosing.
  • Cluster Your allies gather into any space that would be covered by a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] in an aura around you.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You've trained in battle formations for a plethora of situations. Choose a formation. Allies within your aura can use their reaction to Stride up to their Speed and take a place in the chosen formation. Allies can't benefit from this movement if there isn't room for them in the chosen formation. If there are more eligible allies than there are available spaces in the chosen formation, you choose which allies benefit.

  • Line Your allies gather adjacent to you and each other to form a straight line in a direction of your choosing.
  • Wedge Your allies gather into any space that would be covered by a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] originating from you in a direction of your choosing.
  • Cluster Your allies gather into any space that would be covered by a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] in an aura around you.
_desc_ko:
다양한 상황에 대비해 전투 진형을 훈련했습니다. 진형을 선택하세요. 당신의 오라 범위 내 아군은 반응 행동으로 자신의 이동력만큼 이동하여 선택한 진형에 배치될 수 있습니다. 선택한 진형에 공간이 부족하면 아군은 이 이동의 혜택을 받을 수 없다. 선택한 진형의 공간보다 자격을 갖춘 아군이 더 많을 경우, 혜택을 받을 아군을 선택한다.

  • 라인 아군들은 당신과 서로 인접한 위치에 모여 당신이 선택한 방향으로 일직선을 이룹니다.
  • 쐐기 아군들은 당신이 선택한 방향으로 당신을 기점으로 하는 15피트 원뿔이 덮을 수 있는 어떤 공간에 모입니다.
  • 군집 오라를 형성하며 주변을 감싼 15피트 발산가 덮을 수 있는 공간에 아군을 집결시킵니다.

name: Flexible Halcyon Spellcasting

description.value: You broaden your ability to channel your power into halcyon magic. You gain one more common halcyon spell of each level of halcyon spell you can cast other than your highest (you do not gain an additional cantrip). You also gain one additional halcyon spell slot for each level of halcyon spell you can cast, other than the highest.

_desc_en: You broaden your ability to channel your power into halcyon magic. You gain one more common halcyon spell of each level of halcyon spell you can cast other than your highest (you do not gain an additional cantrip). You also gain one additional halcyon spell slot for each level of halcyon spell you can cast, other than the highest.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신의 힘을 평온 마법으로 전환하는 능력을 확장합니다. 최고 레벨을 제외한, 시전 가능한 각 평온 마법 레벨당 일반 평온 마법 하나를 추가로 얻습니다(캔트립은 추가로 얻지 않습니다). 또한 최고 레벨을 제외한 각 할시온 주문 레벨당 할시온 주문 슬롯을 하나씩 추가로 얻습니다.

name: Stonegate

description.value: Earthen barriers no longer impede your progress. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.115Xp9E38CJENhNS]{Magic Passage} as a 7th-rank divine innate spell that you can cast once per day. Unlike the spell, however, this ability can be used only to open passages through barriers of earth or stone.

_desc_en: Earthen barriers no longer impede your progress. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.115Xp9E38CJENhNS]{Magic Passage} as a 7th-rank divine innate spell that you can cast once per day. Unlike the spell, however, this ability can be used only to open passages through barriers of earth or stone.
_desc_ko: 흙으로 된 장벽이 더 이상 당신의 진로를 막지 못한다. 당신은 @link[spells.magic-passage]를 (7th)랭크 신성 선천 마법으로 하루에 한 번 시전할 수 있게 된다. 그러나 이 능력은 마법과 달리 흙이나 돌로 된 장벽을 뚫고 통로를 열 때만 사용할 수 있다.

name: Expert Animist Spellcasting

description.value: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits as a prepared divine caster.

_desc_en: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits as a prepared divine caster.
_desc_ko: 준비된 신성 주문 시전자로서 전문 주문 시전 혜택을 얻습니다.

name: Expert Scroll Cache

description.value:
Your scroll collection has vastly grown, both in size and potency.

In addition to your daily scrolls from Basic Scroll Cache, add a scroll with a 3rd-rank spell. At 14th level, add a scroll with a 4th-rank spell. At 16th level, add a scroll with a 5th-rank spell.

_desc_en:
Your scroll collection has vastly grown, both in size and potency.

In addition to your daily scrolls from Basic Scroll Cache, add a scroll with a 3rd-rank spell. At 14th level, add a scroll with a 4th-rank spell. At 16th level, add a scroll with a 5th-rank spell.
_desc_ko:
당신의 두루마리 컬렉션은 규모와 위력 모두에서 크게 성장했습니다.

기본 두루마리 저장소에서 매일 얻는 두루마리 외에도, (3rd)랭크 주문이 담긴 두루마리 하나를 추가로 얻습니다. 14레벨에 도달하면 (4th)랭크 주문이 담긴 두루마리 하나를 추가로 얻습니다. 16레벨에 도달하면 (5th)랭크 주문이 담긴 두루마리 하나를 추가로 얻습니다.

name: Voice of Authority

description.value:
You easily command the attention of others, and when the time comes to turn threats into action, your authoritative voice causes foes to falter.

Your voice be heard easily by any creatures within 300 feet if you wish, regardless of the level of ambient noise, although your voice can't penetrate @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gIdDLrbswTV3OBJy]{Silence} or similar effect. If you roll Intimidation for initiative, on the first round of combat, creatures that haven't acted yet are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you.

publication.title: Pathfinder Adventure: Night of the Gray Death

_desc_en:
You easily command the attention of others, and when the time comes to turn threats into action, your authoritative voice causes foes to falter.

Your voice be heard easily by any creatures within 300 feet if you wish, regardless of the level of ambient noise, although your voice can't penetrate @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gIdDLrbswTV3OBJy]{Silence} or similar effect. If you roll Intimidation for initiative, on the first round of combat, creatures that haven't acted yet are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you.
_desc_ko:
당신은 쉽게 타인의 주의를 사로잡으며, 위협을 행동으로 옮길 때가 되면 권위적인 목소리가 적들을 주저하게 만듭니다.

주변 소음 수준과 상관없이, 원한다면 300피트 내 모든 생물에게 당신의 목소리가 쉽게 들립니다. 다만 @link[spells.silence]이나 유사한 효과는 뚫을 수 없습니다. 당신이 인니셔티브를 위해 협박 능력치로 주사위를 굴렸을 경우, 전투 첫 라운드에 아직 행동하지 않은 생물들은 당신에게 @link[conditions.off-guard]가 됩니다.

name: Dragon Spit

description.value: Many Tian-Dan claim to have dragon blood in their veins, and in your case, this is true-you can spit energy, and you might have an especially visible sign of your draconic heritage. Choose one of the following cantrips: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gISYsBFby1TiXfBt]{Acid Splash}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kBhaPuzLUSwS6vVf]{Electric Arc}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6DfLZBl8wKIV03Iq]{Ignition}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gYjPm7YwGtEa1oxh]{Ray of Frost}. You can cast this spell as an innate arcane spell at will, and when you cast it, the spell's energy emerges from your mouth.

_desc_en: Many Tian-Dan claim to have dragon blood in their veins, and in your case, this is true-you can spit energy, and you might have an especially visible sign of your draconic heritage. Choose one of the following cantrips: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gISYsBFby1TiXfBt]{Acid Splash}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kBhaPuzLUSwS6vVf]{Electric Arc}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6DfLZBl8wKIV03Iq]{Ignition}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gYjPm7YwGtEa1oxh]{Ray of Frost}. You can cast this spell as an innate arcane spell at will, and when you cast it, the spell's energy emerges from your mouth.
_desc_ko: 많은 천단인들은 자신들의 혈관에 용의 피가 흐른다고 주장하며, 당신의 경우 이는 사실입니다-에너지를 뿜어낼 수 있으며, 드라코닉 혈통을 특히 뚜렷이 보여주는 징후를 지닐 수도 있습니다. 다음 중 하나의 캔트립을 선택하십시오: @link[spells.acid-splash], @link[spells.electric-arc], @link[spells.ignition], 또는 @link[spells.ray-of-frost]. 이 주문을 타고난 아케인 마법으로 마음대로 시전할 수 있으며, 시전 시 마법의 에너지가 입에서 뿜어져 나온다.

name: Mental Buffer

description.value: Your mind deflects some amount of harm from attacks that induce pain or manipulate your mind directly. You gain resistance to mental damage equal to half your level (minimum 1). This resistance increases to equal to your level while your Psyche is Unleashed.

_desc_en: Your mind deflects some amount of harm from attacks that induce pain or manipulate your mind directly. You gain resistance to mental damage equal to half your level (minimum 1). This resistance increases to equal to your level while your Psyche is Unleashed.
_desc_ko: 당신의 정신은 고통을 유발하거나 정신을 직접 조종하는 공격으로부터 일정량의 피해를 회피합니다. 레벨의 절반(최소 1)에 해당하는 정신 피해에 대한 저항력을 얻습니다. 정신이 해방된 상태에서는 이 저항력이 레벨과 동일하게 증가합니다.

name: Boaster's Challenge

description.value:
You call out a foe, causing them to become flustered and easier to defeat. Select one creature you can see and declare a challenge. For your challenge, attempt a @Check[deception|against:will], @Check[diplomacy|against:will], or @Check[intimidation|against:will] check against that creature's Will DC. Your challenge must include a linguistic, auditory, or visual component and gains the corresponding trait. If you succeed, you gain a +2 status bonus to damage rolls with your weapon or unarmed Strikes against that foe until the end of your next turn; if you have master proficiency in the skill you used, you gain a +4 status bonus instead, and if you're legendary, you gain a +6 status bonus. On a critical success, the status bonus lasts for 3 rounds instead. Whether you succeed or fail, creatures who witnessed your challenge gain a +4 circumstance bonus to their Will DCs against your attempts to challenge for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.0BNGjyW5WigX1FIs]{Effect: Boaster's Challenge}

_desc_en:
You call out a foe, causing them to become flustered and easier to defeat. Select one creature you can see and declare a challenge. For your challenge, attempt a @Check[deception|against:will], @Check[diplomacy|against:will], or @Check[intimidation|against:will] check against that creature's Will DC. Your challenge must include a linguistic, auditory, or visual component and gains the corresponding trait. If you succeed, you gain a +2 status bonus to damage rolls with your weapon or unarmed Strikes against that foe until the end of your next turn; if you have master proficiency in the skill you used, you gain a +4 status bonus instead, and if you're legendary, you gain a +6 status bonus. On a critical success, the status bonus lasts for 3 rounds instead. Whether you succeed or fail, creatures who witnessed your challenge gain a +4 circumstance bonus to their Will DCs against your attempts to challenge for 1 minute.

_desc_ko:
당신은 적을 불러내어 당황하게 만들어 더 쉽게 쓰러뜨릴 수 있게 합니다. 볼 수 있는 생물 하나를 선택하고 도전을 선언하세요. 도전으로 해당 생물의 의지 DC에 대해 기만, 외교 또는 위협 판정을 시도하십시오. 도전에는 언어적, 청각적, 시각적 요소가 포함되어야 하며 해당 특성을 획득한다. 성공 시, 다음 턴 종료까지 해당 적에 대한 무기 또는 비무장 공격의 피해 굴림에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻는다. 사용한 기술에 달인 proficiency를 보유한 경우 +4 상태 보너스를, 전설적인 경우 +6 상태 보너스를 대신 얻는다. 대성공 시 상태 보너스는 3라운드 동안 지속됩니다. 성공 여부와 상관없이, 당신의 도전을 목격한 생물들은 1분 동안 당신에 대한 도전 시도할 때 의지 DC에 +4 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

description.value:
Access You are from Mediogalti Island.

You have learned how to stalk your foes and slay them with a sawtooth saber. You become trained in Stealth and Assassin Lore; if you were already trained, you become an expert instead. Whenever your proficiency in any weapon increases to expert or beyond, you also gain that new proficiency with sawtooth sabers.

You become bound by Achaekek's anathema and can receive his sanctification.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.CB9YE4P7A2Wty1IX]{Red Mantis Assassin}

_desc_ko:
접근 당신은 메디오갈티 섬 출신이다.

적의 뒤를 쫓아 톱니 모양 세이버로 처치하는 법을 익혔습니다. 은신술과 암살자 지식에 숙련됩니다. 이미 숙련 상태였다면 대신 전문가가 됩니다. 어떤 무기 숙련도가 전문가 이상으로 상승할 때마다, 톱니 모양 세이버에 대한 새로운 숙련도도 함께 얻습니다.

아차에케크의 저주에 묶여 그의 성화를 받을 수 있게 된다.

name: Fledgling Flight

description.value:
Frequency once per round

You can fly through the air in short bursts. You Fly. If you don't normally have a fly Speed, you gain a fly Speed of 15 feet for this movement. If you aren't on solid ground at the end of this movement, you fall.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per round

_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 라운드당 1회

짧은 순간 동안 공중을 날아다닐 수 있습니다. 당신은 날아다닙니다. 평소 비행 속도가 없다면, 이 이동에 대해 15피트의 비행 속도를 얻습니다. 이 이동이 끝날 때 단단한 지면에 있지 않으면 추락합니다.

name: Hedge Prison

description.value: You cultivate plants to entrap your foes. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.z0ffligcrkVtKZd6]{Hedge Prison} order spell.

_desc_en: You cultivate plants to entrap your foes. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.z0ffligcrkVtKZd6]{Hedge Prison} order spell.
_desc_ko: 당신은 적을 가두기 위해 식물을 기릅니다. @link[spells.hedge-prison] 명령 주문을 얻습니다.

name: Efficient Preparation

description.value: You've developed techniques for drilling your allies on multiple tactics in a succinct and efficient manner. Increase the number of tactics you can have prepared by 1.

_desc_en: You've developed techniques for drilling your allies on multiple tactics in a succinct and efficient manner. Increase the number of tactics you can have prepared by 1.
_desc_ko: 여러 전술을 간결하고 효율적으로 동료를 훈련시키는 기술을 개발했습니다. 준비할 수 있는 전술의 수를 1 증가시킵니다.

name: Goblin Scuttle

description.value:
Trigger An ally ends a move action adjacent to you.

You take advantage of your ally's movement to adjust your position. You Step.

_desc_en:
Trigger An ally ends a move action adjacent to you.

You take advantage of your ally's movement to adjust your position. You Step.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 아군이 당신과 인접한 위치에서 이동 행동을 종료할 때.

당신은 아군의 이동을 이용해 위치를 조정합니다. 당신은 {신중한 발걸음}합니다.

name: Fortified Elixirs

description.value: Your treatments for diseases and poisons can be very efficacious, though they tend not to last as long. A creature that is under the effect of an infused @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ktjFOp3U0wQD9t0Z]{Antidote} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.UqinuuCWePTYGhVO]{Antiplague} that you created can choose to reroll a failed Fortitude saving throw against an appropriate affliction (poison for antidote and disease for antiplague). The creature doesn't gain the elixir's usual item bonus to the reroll, and after the reroll, the elixir's duration immediately ends. This is a fortune effect.

_desc_en: Your treatments for diseases and poisons can be very efficacious, though they tend not to last as long. A creature that is under the effect of an infused @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ktjFOp3U0wQD9t0Z]{Antidote} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.UqinuuCWePTYGhVO]{Antiplague} that you created can choose to reroll a failed Fortitude saving throw against an appropriate affliction (poison for antidote and disease for antiplague). The creature doesn't gain the elixir's usual item bonus to the reroll, and after the reroll, the elixir's duration immediately ends. This is a fortune effect.
_desc_ko: 질병과 독에 대한 당신의 치료법은 매우 효과적일 수 있으나, 지속 기간이 상대적으로 짧습니다. 강화된 @link[equipment.antidote-lesser]나 @link[equipment.antiplague-lesser]의 효과를 받고 있는 생물은 해당 증상(해독제의 경우 독, 역병 방지제의 경우 질병)에 대한 실패한 인내 내성 굴림 재굴림을 선택할 수 있습니다. 이 생물은 재굴림에 엘릭서의 일반적인 아이템 보너스를 얻지 못하며, 재굴림 후 엘릭서의 지속 시간은 즉시 종료됩니다. 이는 운명 효과입니다.

name: Fleet

description.value: You move more quickly on foot. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.

_desc_en: You move more quickly on foot. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.
_desc_ko: 보행 시 더 빠르게 이동합니다. 이동 속도가 5피트 증가합니다.

name: Mind Over Matter

description.value: Your mind's limits are only what you imagine them to be. You gain an additional 10th-rank spell slot.

_desc_en: Your mind's limits are only what you imagine them to be. You gain an additional 10th-rank spell slot.
_desc_ko: 당신의 정신적 한계는 오직 당신이 상상하는 범위까지입니다. 10랭크 주문 슬롯을 추가로 획득합니다.

name: Inescapable Grasp

description.value:
Your grasp has a supernatural quality to it, preventing your foes from easily escaping—with or without magical assistance. If a creature you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} attempts to use a teleportation spell or effect, it must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:15] or the spell fails. If a creature you have grabbed attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} while under the effect of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aqRYNoSvxsVfqglH]{Unfettered Movement} or a similar effect, it must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:15] or be forced to roll the Escape attempt normally, rather than automatically succeeding.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.dDdxIy1bAvwfuhx0]{Effect: Inescapable Grasp}

_desc_ko:
당신의 손아귀는 초자연적인 특성을 지녀, 마법적 지원 유무와 상관없이 적들이 쉽게 벗어날 수 없게 합니다. 당신이 @link[conditions.grabbed]한 생물이 순간이동 주문이나 효과를 사용하려고 시도할 경우, DC 15 단순에 성공해야만 주문이 발동됩니다. 당신이 붙잡은 생물이 @link[spells.unfettered-movement]나 유사한 효과의 영향 아래 있을 때 @link[actions.escape]을 시도하면, DC 15 단순에 성공해야 하며, 그렇지 않으면 자동 성공 대신 정상적으로 탈출 시도를 굴려야 합니다.

name: Paragon Reanimated Companion

description.value: You have reached the pinnacle of necromantic science, creating a mechanical zombie unlike any the world has seen before. Your reanimated construct companion becomes a paragon construct companion.

_desc_en: You have reached the pinnacle of necromantic science, creating a mechanical zombie unlike any the world has seen before. Your reanimated construct companion becomes a paragon construct companion.
_desc_ko: 당신은 네크로맨틱 과학의 정점에 도달하여 세상이 본 적 없는 기계식 좀비를 창조했습니다. 당신의 재활성된 구조물 동반자는 파라곤 구조물 동반자가 됩니다.

name: Wayfinder Resonance Tinkerer

description.value: You can use the unusual resonance of your wayfinder to grant it additional effects. Choose one cantrip from the arcane, divine, occult, or primal list. You can activate your wayfinder to cast that cantrip at will. As normal, this cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. Additionally, you can Activate your wayfinder with a 1 (envision) activation to transform it into a nondescript pin or brooch to hide your affiliation with the Pathfinder Society. This transformation lasts for 1 hour.

_desc_en: You can use the unusual resonance of your wayfinder to grant it additional effects. Choose one cantrip from the arcane, divine, occult, or primal list. You can activate your wayfinder to cast that cantrip at will. As normal, this cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. Additionally, you can Activate your wayfinder with a 1 (envision) activation to transform it into a nondescript pin or brooch to hide your affiliation with the Pathfinder Society. This transformation lasts for 1 hour.
_desc_ko: 당신은 웨이파인더의 특이한 공명을 이용해 추가 효과를 부여할 수 있습니다. 아케인, 신성, 오컬트, 프라이멀의 주문 목록에서 하나의 캔트립을 선택하십시오. 웨이파인더를 활성화하여 해당 캔트립을 자유롭게 시전할 수 있습니다. 평소와 같이 이 캔트립은 당신의 레벨 절반(올림)에 해당하는 주문 랭크으로 강화됩니다. 추가로, 웨이파인더를 1(상상) 활성화로 작동시켜 평범한 핀이나 브로치로 변형시켜 패스파인더 소사이어티와의 관계를 {숨길} 수 있습니다. 이 변형은 1시간 동안 지속됩니다.

name: Zephyr Guard Dedication

description.value:
Access You are from Katapesh.

As a Zephyr Guard, you're always vigilant against crime and threats to the city's safety. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ijZ0DDFpMkWqaShd]{Palm an Object}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.qVNVSmsgpKFGk9hV]{Conceal an Object} (including you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seeking} concealed objects). You become trained in Society and Katapesh Lore; if you were already trained, you become an expert instead.

_desc_ko:
Access 당신은 카타페시 출신이다.

제피르 가드로서, 당신은 항상 범죄와 도시 안전에 대한 위협에 비질을 기울이고 있다. 당신은 다음 시도에 대한 지각 판정에서 +1 상황 보너스를 얻는다: @link[actions.palm-an-object], @link[actions.steal], 또는 @link[actions.conceal-an-object](당신이 @link[actions.seek]로 가려진 물건을 찾는 경우 포함) 시도에 대한 지각 검사에서 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 사회와 카타페시 지식에 숙련됩니다. 이미 숙련 상태였다면 대신 전문가가 됩니다.

name: Blood Like Water

description.value: The watery fluid in your veins doesn't flow in the same way as traditional blood. Your DC on flat checks to end persistent bleed damage is reduced from 15 to 10, or from 10 to 5 after receiving especially appropriate assistance.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: The watery fluid in your veins doesn't flow in the same way as traditional blood. Your DC on flat checks to end persistent bleed damage is reduced from 15 to 10, or from 10 to 5 after receiving especially appropriate assistance.
_desc_ko: 당신의 혈관 속 물 같은 액체는 일반적인 피와 같은 방식으로 흐르지 않습니다. 지속적인 출혈 피해를 끝내기 위한 단순 판정 DC가 15에서 10으로, 특히 적절한 도움을 받은 후에는 10에서 5로 감소합니다.

name: Disruptive Blur

description.value: You use cacophonous blasts from your gun or distracting shots from your crossbow to cause momentary diversions, letting you move about the battlefield with impunity. After you make a Strike with a firearm or crossbow, creatures can't take reactions that would be triggered by your movement for the rest of your turn.

_desc_en: You use cacophonous blasts from your gun or distracting shots from your crossbow to cause momentary diversions, letting you move about the battlefield with impunity. After you make a Strike with a firearm or crossbow, creatures can't take reactions that would be triggered by your movement for the rest of your turn.
_desc_ko: 당신은 총기의 불협화음 폭발이나 석궁의 주의를 분산시키는 사격을 이용해 순간적인 혼란을 일으켜 전장을 자유롭게 이동합니다. 화기나 석궁으로 공격을 가한 후, 상대 생물들은 당신의 턴이 끝날 때까지 당신의 이동으로 인해 발동되는 반응을 취할 수 없습니다.

name: Wings of the Dragon

description.value: You can manifest draconic wings to soar through the air at great speed. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HWJODX2zPg5cg34F]{Dragon Wings} sorcerer bloodline spell and a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. If you already have a focus pool, increase your number of Focus Points by 1.

_desc_en: You can manifest draconic wings to soar through the air at great speed. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HWJODX2zPg5cg34F]{Dragon Wings} sorcerer bloodline spell and a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. If you already have a focus pool, increase your number of Focus Points by 1.
_desc_ko: 드라코닉 날개를 창조하여 공중을 빠른 속도로 날아다닐 수 있습니다. @link[spells.dragon-wings] 소서러 혈통 주문을 획득하고 1 포커스 포인트의 포커스 풀을 얻습니다. 이미 포커스 풀을 보유하고 있다면 포커스 포인트 수를 1 증가시킵니다.

name: Confounding Image

description.value: When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.j8vIoIEWElvpwkcI]{Mirror Image}, you can modify its duration to be sustained up to 1 minute and modify its range to 30 feet. If you do, replace the spell's standard effects with the following: You create an illusory duplicate of yourself that appears in an unoccupied square within range. The image takes up space and has a reach of 5 feet, and your allies can flank with the image. It doesn't have any other attributes a creature would normally have other than an AC equal to your spell DC and saving throw modifiers equal to your spell DC - 10. If the image is hit by an attack or fails a save, or if you ever move more than 30 feet from it, the spell ends. Creatures can move through its space without hindrance. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move the image to an unoccupied square within range.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar
