If the image is hit by an attack or fails a save, or if you ever move more than 30 feet from it, the spell ends. Creatures can move through its space without hindrance. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move the image to an unoccupied square within range.
_desc_ko: {거울 이미지}를 시전할 때, 지속 시간을 최대 1분으로 연장하고 범위를 30피트로 수정할 수 있다. 이 경우, 해당 주문은 다음과 같은 효과를 가집니다: 당신은 범위 내 비어 있는 칸에 자신의 환영 복제체를 생성합니다. 이 환영은 공간을 차지하며 5피트의 도달 거리를 가지며, 아군은 이 환영과 함께 측면 공격을 할 수 있습니다. 이 환영은 당신의 주문 DC와 동일한 AC와, 당신의 주문 DC - 10과 동일한 내성 굴림 수정자를 제외하고는 생물이 일반적으로 가지는 다른 속성을 가지지 않습니다. 이미지가 공격을 받거나 내성 굴림에 실패하거나, 당신이 이미지로부터 30피트 이상 떨어질 경우 주문은 종료됩니다. 생물들은 방해 없이 그 공간을 통과할 수 있습니다. 지속 주문을 선택할 경우, 범위 내 비어 있는 칸으로 이미지를 이동시킬 수 있습니다.

name: Blessed Spell

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

When you focus your magic on an ally, you can remove harmful conditions.

If your next action is to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast a Spell} from a spell slot, and that spell targets only a single ally, you can also attempt to remove a harmful condition from that ally. The condition must be one that could be removed by your Mercy feat, including those granted by later feats such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.kZdcoaTD849QalR9]{Greater Mercy}.

Attempt a counteract check based on the spell's DC and level. This effect is in addition to the normal effects of your spell.

value.value: ability to cast spells from spell slots

_desc_en:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

When you focus your magic on an ally, you can remove harmful conditions.

If your next action is to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast a Spell} from a spell slot, and that spell targets only a single ally, you can also attempt to remove a harmful condition from that ally. The condition must be one that could be removed by your Mercy feat, including those granted by later feats such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.kZdcoaTD849QalR9]{Greater Mercy}.

Attempt a counteract check based on the spell's DC and level. This effect is in addition to the normal effects of your spell.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 10분에 한 번

동료에게 마법을 포커스하면 해로운 상태 이상을 제거할 수 있습니다.

다음 행동이 주문 슬롯에서 @link[actions.cast-a-spell]이며, 해당 주문이 단일 아군만을 대상으로 할 경우, 그 아군에게 걸린 유해 상태를 제거하려 시도할 수도 있다. 해당 상태는 당신의 자비 피트로 제거 가능한 상태여야 하며, @link[feats.greater-mercy]와 같은 후속 피트로 부여된 상태도 포함됩니다.

주문의 난이도(DC)와 레벨을 기준으로 반격 체킹을 시도합니다. 이 효과는 주문의 일반 효과에 추가로 적용됩니다.

name: Nagaji Spell Mysteries

description.value: You've learned more naga magic. During your daily preparations, choose @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLA0q0WOK2YPuJs6]{Charm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aEM2cttJ2eYcLssW]{Fleet Step}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal}. You can cast the chosen spell as a 1st-rank occult innate spell once that day.

value.value: at least one innate spell from a nagaji heritage or ancestry feat

_desc_en: You've learned more naga magic. During your daily preparations, choose @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLA0q0WOK2YPuJs6]{Charm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aEM2cttJ2eYcLssW]{Fleet Step}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal}. You can cast the chosen spell as a 1st-rank occult innate spell once that day.
_desc_ko: 너는 더 많은 나가 마법을 배웠다. 일일 준비 시간에 @link[spells.charm], @link[spells.fleet-step], 또는 @link[spells.heal] 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 해당 날짜에 한 번, 선택한 주문을 1랭크 오컬트 선천적 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Cascade Bearer's Spellcasting

description.value: Your Cascade Bearer training allows you to broaden the horizons of your halcyon spells further than most Magaambyans, weaving in spiritual magic. You can select halcyon spells from the divine or occult spell lists in additional to the arcane or primal spell lists, though they are still halcyon spells (so you choose when casting if they are arcane or primal spells). You gain a halcyon cantrip and a halcyon 1st-rank spell.

_desc_en: Your Cascade Bearer training allows you to broaden the horizons of your halcyon spells further than most Magaambyans, weaving in spiritual magic. You can select halcyon spells from the divine or occult spell lists in additional to the arcane or primal spell lists, though they are still halcyon spells (so you choose when casting if they are arcane or primal spells). You gain a halcyon cantrip and a halcyon 1st-rank spell.
_desc_ko: 폭포의 전승자 훈련을 통해 당신은 대부분의 마감비아의보다 더 넓은 시야로 평온의 주문을 펼칠 수 있으며, 여기에 영적 마법을 엮어 넣을 수 있습니다. 아케인 마법이나 오컬트 마법 목록에서 평온 마법을 선택할 수 있으며, 이는 여전히 평온 마법으로 간주됩니다(따라서 시전 시 아케인 마법인지 프라이멀 마법인지 선택합니다). 평온 캔트립 하나와 평온 1랭크 주문 하나를 얻습니다.

name: Lastwall Warden

description.value:
You use your shield to protect your allies, not just yourself, especially against the undead. When you have a shield raised, you can use your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction when an attack is made against an ally adjacent to you, in addition to its usual trigger. If you do, the shield prevents that ally from taking damage instead of you, following the normal rules for a Shield Block.

If an undead makes an attack against an ally within 10 feet, you can Step to become adjacent to your ally and then use Shield Block as part of the same reaction.

_desc_en:
You use your shield to protect your allies, not just yourself, especially against the undead. When you have a shield raised, you can use your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction when an attack is made against an ally adjacent to you, in addition to its usual trigger. If you do, the shield prevents that ally from taking damage instead of you, following the normal rules for a Shield Block.

If an undead makes an attack against an ally within 10 feet, you can Step to become adjacent to your ally and then use Shield Block as part of the same reaction.
_desc_ko:
당신은 방패를 자신뿐만 아니라 동료들을 보호하는 데 사용하며, 특히 언데드로부터 그들을 지킵니다. 방패를 든 상태에서, 평소 발동 조건 외에도 당신과 인접한 동료에게 공격이 가해질 때 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{방패 막기} 반응을 사용할 수 있습니다. 이 경우 방패는 정상적인 방패 막기 규칙에 따라 그 아군이 대신 피해를 입도록 막아준다.

언데드가 10피트 이내의 아군을 공격할 경우, 같은 반응으로 아군과 인접하도록 {신중한 발걸음}한 후 방패 막기를 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Unbelievably Believable

description.value: Your words echo with soothing and convincing power. When you attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}, make a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie}, you can spend a Mythic Point to attempt the check at mythic proficiency.

name_ko: 믿기 어려울 정도로 믿을 수 있는
_desc_en: Your words echo with soothing and convincing power. When you attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}, make a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie}, you can spend a Mythic Point to attempt the check at mythic proficiency.
_desc_ko: 당신의 말은 달콤하고 설득력 있게 울려 퍼집니다. @link[actions.gather-information], @link[actions.make-an-impression] 판정을 시도할 때, @link[actions.request], 또는 @link[actions.lie]을 시도할 때, 신화 포인트를 소모하여 신화 숙련도로 해당 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다.

name: Shield Spell Reinforcement

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a shield.

You can empower your defensive magic by channeling it through a physical shield. If your next action is to cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TVKNbcgTee19PXZR]{Shield} cantrip, you use your shield as a locus to cast the spell, raising a magical barrier in the form of a large force projection of your worn shield. You can choose for an adjacent ally to gain the benefits of the shield spell instead of yourself. If the ally would take damage from a physical attack while protected by your shield cantrip, you can use your reaction to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} with the spell on their behalf.

value.value: you can cast the shield cantrip

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a shield.

You can empower your defensive magic by channeling it through a physical shield. If your next action is to cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TVKNbcgTee19PXZR]{Shield} cantrip, you use your shield as a locus to cast the spell, raising a magical barrier in the form of a large force projection of your worn shield. You can choose for an adjacent ally to gain the benefits of the shield spell instead of yourself. If the ally would take damage from a physical attack while protected by your shield cantrip, you can use your reaction to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} with the spell on their behalf.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 방패를 장비하고 있어야 합니다.

물리적 방패를 매개로 방어 마법을 강화할 수 있습니다. 다음 행동으로 @link[spells.shield] 캔트립을 시전할 경우, 방패를 시전 지점으로 삼아 착용한 방패의 거대한 힘 투사 형태로 마법 장벽을 형성합니다. 자신 대신 인접한 아군이 방패 주문의 혜택을 받도록 선택할 수 있습니다. 동료가 당신의 방패 캔트립 보호 중 물리 공격으로 피해를 입을 경우, 당신은 반응을 사용해 그들을 대신해 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{방패 막기}를 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Flowering Path

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Vitality and elemental wood flows out from your body and into the earth, infusing it with a stream of new life. When you walk, you leave blooming flowers and sprouting vines in your wake. For the next minute, each time you Step or Stride, you create difficult terrain in each square you leave during your movement.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Vitality and elemental wood flows out from your body and into the earth, infusing it with a stream of new life. When you walk, you leave blooming flowers and sprouting vines in your wake. For the next minute, each time you Step or Stride, you create difficult terrain in each square you leave during your movement.
_desc_ko:
빈도 하루에 한 번

활력과 원소의 나무 기운이 당신의 몸에서 흘러나와 대지에 스며들어 새로운 생명의 흐름을 불어넣습니다. 걸을 때마다 뒤로 피어나는 꽃과 싹트는 덩굴을 남깁니다. 다음 1분 동안, 당신이 이동할 때마다 {신중한 발걸음}이나 이동으로 이동한 각 칸에 어려운 지형을 생성합니다.

name: Celestial Mercy

description.value: Your celestial powers allow you to remove lesser afflictions with ease. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction} twice per day as a 4th-rank divine innate spell.

value.value: Angelkin, Lawbringer, Musetouched, or another lineage feat associated with celestials

_desc_en: Your celestial powers allow you to remove lesser afflictions with ease. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction} twice per day as a 4th-rank divine innate spell.
_desc_ko: 천상체의 힘으로 사소한 고통을 쉽게 제거할 수 있습니다. 하루에 두 번 @link[spells.cleanse-affliction]를 (4th)랭크 신성 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Unnerving Prowess

description.value:
Trigger You critically succeed at a Strike or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} with your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.iSceAVMkVv1uKK7t]{Aldori Dueling Sword}, or succeed at a Strike or Disarm attempt with your Aldori dueling sword against an opponent during your first turn of an encounter.

Your incredible skill with your blade unnerves your foes. You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} the target of your Strike or Disarm. This Demoralize attempt does not have the auditory trait, nor do you take a penalty to the check if the target doesn't understand your language.

_desc_en:
Trigger You critically succeed at a Strike or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} with your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.iSceAVMkVv1uKK7t]{Aldori Dueling Sword}, or succeed at a Strike or Disarm attempt with your Aldori dueling sword against an opponent during your first turn of an encounter.

Your incredible skill with your blade unnerves your foes. You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} the target of your Strike or Disarm. This Demoralize attempt does not have the auditory trait, nor do you take a penalty to the check if the target doesn't understand your language.
_desc_ko:
Trigger 당신은 @link[equipment.aldori-dueling-sword]으로 공격이나 @link[actions.disarm]에 대성공을 거두거나, 교전 첫 턴에 상대방에게 알도리 결투용 검으로 공격이나 무장 해제 시도하다에 성공합니다.

당신의 놀라운 검술은 적들을 불안하게 만듭니다. 당신은 공격 또는 무장 해제 대상에게 @link[actions.demoralize]를 시도합니다. 이 사기 저하 시도는 청각적 특성을 가지지 않으며, 대상이 당신의 언어를 이해하지 못해도 판정 페널티를 받지 않습니다.

name: Flailtongue

description.value: Your tongue has mutated into a lashing weapon reminiscent of Kabriri's bone-laden flail. You can use a free action to unhinge your lower jaw and sprout rigid bones from your tongue. You gain an unarmed attack that deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage. Until you use an Interact action to reset your jaw and retract your tongue, you can't make a jaws Strike. Your flailtongue is in the flail weapon group and has the disarm, sweep, and trip traits.

_desc_en: Your tongue has mutated into a lashing weapon reminiscent of Kabriri's bone-laden flail. You can use a free action to unhinge your lower jaw and sprout rigid bones from your tongue. You gain an unarmed attack that deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage. Until you use an Interact action to reset your jaw and retract your tongue, you can't make a jaws Strike. Your flailtongue is in the flail weapon group and has the disarm, sweep, and trip traits.
_desc_ko: 당신의 혀는 카브리리의 뼈로 무장한 채찍을 연상시키는 채찍질 무기로 변이되었습니다. 무료 행동으로 아래턱을 분리하고 혀에서 단단한 뼈를 뻗어낼 수 있습니다. 비무장 공격으로 1d6 타격을 입힐 수 있습니다. 턱을 제자리로 돌려놓고 혀를 거두기 위해 상호작용 행동을 사용하기 전까지는 턱 타격을 할 수 없습니다. 당신의 채찍혀는 채찍 무기 그룹에 속하며 무장 해제, 쓸어내리기, 넘어뜨리기 특성을 가집니다.

name: Friendly Toss

description.value:
Requirements You are adjacent to an ally and have one or more hands free.

You toss your friends around the battlefield. Pick up an adjacent ally of your size or smaller and throw them to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet. Their movement doesn't trigger reactions. Your ally ends this movement on their feet and doesn't take damage from the fall. If your ally ends this movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, they can use their reaction to make a melee Strike against such an enemy.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are adjacent to an ally and have one or more hands free.

You toss your friends around the battlefield. Pick up an adjacent ally of your size or smaller and throw them to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet. Their movement doesn't trigger reactions. Your ally ends this movement on their feet and doesn't take damage from the fall. If your ally ends this movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, they can use their reaction to make a melee Strike against such an enemy.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 아군과 인접해 있으며 한 손 이상이 자유로워야 합니다.

전장에서 아군을 던집니다. 인접한 동등하거나 더 작은 체구의 아군을 들어 올려 30피트 내 시야에 있는 빈 공간으로 던집니다. 이 이동은 반응을 유발하지 않습니다. 아군은 발을 딛고 이동을 종료하며 낙하로 인한 피해를 입지 않습니다. 아군이 적어도 한 명의 적과 근접 공격 범위 내에 이동을 종료할 경우, 반응을 사용해 해당 적에게 근접 공격을 가할 수 있습니다.

name: Fiendish Brand

description.value:
Make a Strike with a weapon or unarmed attack that deals piercing or slashing damage. If it's successful and deals damage, you carve bleeding words into your target. The target takes 1d6 bleed damage, which has the unholy trait. Anytime the creature casts a holy spell while this bleed damage persists, it must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] or the spell is disrupted.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.vG11WE95sDmDcip4]{Effect: Fiendish Brand}

value.value: Sister of the Golden Erinys Dedication

_desc_en:
Make a Strike with a weapon or unarmed attack that deals piercing or slashing damage. If it's successful and deals damage, you carve bleeding words into your target. The target takes 1d6 bleed damage, which has the unholy trait. Anytime the creature casts a holy spell while this bleed damage persists, it must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] or the spell is disrupted.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.vG11WE95sDmDcip4]{Effect: Fiendish Brand}
_desc_ko:
관통 또는 참격 피해를 주는 무기나 비무장 공격으로 타격을 합니다. 그것이 성공하여 피해를 준다면, 당신은 대상에게 피 흘리는 글자를 새깁니다. 대상은 불경 특성을 가진 1d6 출혈 피해를 받습니다. 이 출혈 피해가 지속되는 동안 그 생물이 신성 주문을 시전할 때마다, 그것은 @Check[flat|dc:5]에 성공해야 하며, 그렇지 않으면 주문이 방해받습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.vG11WE95sDmDcip4]{효과: 악마의 낙인}

name: Enervating Wail

description.value:
You release a terrible wail that tears at the spirits of all nearby. All living creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:20] take @Damage[((@actor.level - 2)d6)[void]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] save. The damage is 4d6, plus 1d6 for every level you have beyond 6th.

Awakening Your scream echoes in the mind. You can choose to emit a silent psychic wail instead, which changes the damage type to @Damage[(@actor.level - 2)d6[mental]|options:area-damage], changes the save to a @Check[will|against:class-spell|basic|traits:mental,deviant,magical|overrideTraits|options:area-effect] save, removes the auditory trait, and adds the mental trait.

Awakening Your wail saps your foes' strength. In addition to the normal effects, living creatures in the area are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 round on a success (but not a critical success), enfeebled 1 for 1 minute on a failure, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 minute on a critical failure.

_desc_en:
You release a terrible wail that tears at the spirits of all nearby. All living creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:20] take @Damage[((@actor.level - 2)d6)[void]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] save. The damage is 4d6, plus 1d6 for every level you have beyond 6th.

Awakening Your scream echoes in the mind. You can choose to emit a silent psychic wail instead, which changes the damage type to @Damage[(@actor.level - 2)d6[mental]|options:area-damage], changes the save to a @Check[will|against:class-spell|basic|traits:mental,deviant,magical|overrideTraits|options:area-effect] save, removes the auditory trait, and adds the mental trait.

Awakening Your wail saps your foes' strength. In addition to the normal effects, living creatures in the area are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 round on a success (but not a critical success), enfeebled 1 for 1 minute on a failure, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 minute on a critical failure.
_desc_ko:
주변 모든 존재의 영혼을 찢어발기는 끔찍한 울부짖음을 내뿜는다. 20피트 내 모든 생명체는 공허의 피해를 입으며 기본 인내 내성에 성공해야 한다. 피해는 4d6이며, (6th)를 초과하는 레벨당 1d6이 추가됩니다.

각성 당신의 비명이 정신 속에 메아리칩니다. 대신 무음의 정신적 울부짖음을 발산할 수 있으며, 이 경우 피해 유형이 정신로 변경되고, 내성이 기본 의지 내성으로 변경되며, 청각적 특성이 제거되고 정신 특성이 추가됩니다.

각성 당신의 울부짖음이 적의 힘을 고갈시킵니다. 일반 효과에 더해, 해당 영역 내 생명체는 @link[conditions.enfeebled]{1} 상태가 1라운드 지속됩니다(대성공 제외). 실패 시 1분간 약화 1 상태가, @link[conditions.enfeebled]{2} 상태가 1분간 지속됩니다.

name: Internal Dialogue

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You fail a skill check.

Past experiences or even past selves whisper words of advice and encouragement when you need them. Roll an Incarnation Lore check and use that result instead of your failed skill check result.

publication.title: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

_desc_en:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You fail a skill check.

Past experiences or even past selves whisper words of advice and encouragement when you need them. Roll an Incarnation Lore check and use that result instead of your failed skill check result.
_desc_ko:
빈도 10분당 1회

발동 당신이 기술 판정에 실패함.

과거의 경험이나 심지어 과거의 자아들이 당신이 필요로 할 때 조언과 격려의 말을 속삭입니다. 화신 지식 판정을 굴려 실패한 기술 판정 결과 대신 그 결과를 사용합니다.

name: Impose Order (Psychic)

description.value: You bring discipline to your mind and magic, ensuring that you don't under-perform. Until the end of your turn, instead of rolling dice for damage, count each damage die as average damage rounded up (3 for d4, 4 for d6, 5 for d8, 6 for d10, and 7 for d12).

_desc_en: You bring discipline to your mind and magic, ensuring that you don't under-perform. Until the end of your turn, instead of rolling dice for damage, count each damage die as average damage rounded up (3 for d4, 4 for d6, 5 for d8, 6 for d10, and 7 for d12).
_desc_ko: 당신은 정신과 마법에 규율을 부여하여 실력을 발휘하지 못하는 일이 없도록 합니다. 당신의 턴이 끝날 때까지, 피해를 주사위를 굴리는 대신 각 피해 주사위를 평균 피해치로 올림하여 계산합니다(d4는 3, d6는 4, d8는 5, d10는 6, d12는 7).

name: Tiger Stance

description.value:
Requirements You are unarmored

You enter the stance of a tiger and can make tiger claw attacks. These deal 1d8 slashing damage; are in the brawling group; and have the agile, finesse, nonlethal, and unarmed traits.

On a critical success with your tiger claws, if you deal damage, the target takes 1d4 persistent bleed damage.

As long as your Speed is at least 20 feet while in Tiger Stance, you can Step 10 feet.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are unarmored

You enter the stance of a tiger and can make tiger claw attacks. These deal 1d8 slashing damage; are in the brawling group; and have the agile, finesse, nonlethal, and unarmed traits.

On a critical success with your tiger claws, if you deal damage, the target takes 1d4 persistent bleed damage.

As long as your Speed is at least 20 feet while in Tiger Stance, you can Step 10 feet.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 갑옷을 착용하지 않은 상태여야 함

호랑이의 자세를 취하여 호랑이 발톱 공격을 할 수 있습니다. 이 공격은 1d8 베기 피해를 입히며, 격투 계열에 속하고 기민함, 기교, 비살상, 비무장 공격 특성을 가집니다.

호랑이 발톱 공격이 대성공 시, 피해를 입힌 대상은 1d4 지속 출혈 피해를 추가로 받습니다.

호랑이 자세 상태에서 이동 속도가 20피트 이상일 경우, 10피트 {신중한 발걸음}을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Evasiveness

description.value: Your proficiency rank for Reflex saves increases to master.

_desc_en: Your proficiency rank for Reflex saves increases to master.
_desc_ko: 당신의 반사 내성 숙련도 등급이 달인으로 증가합니다.

name: Draconic Veil

description.value: Like some dragons, your forebear had the supernatural ability to change their shape to walk among humanoids. You have learned how to mimic this ability. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2qGqa33E4GPUCbMV]{Humanoid Form} as a 5th-rank innate spell once per day, except that the duration is increased to 1 hour. The spell's tradition matches your draconic exemplar's.

_desc_en: Like some dragons, your forebear had the supernatural ability to change their shape to walk among humanoids. You have learned how to mimic this ability. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2qGqa33E4GPUCbMV]{Humanoid Form} as a 5th-rank innate spell once per day, except that the duration is increased to 1 hour. The spell's tradition matches your draconic exemplar's.
_desc_ko: 일부 드래곤처럼, 당신의 선조는 초자연적인 능력으로 형태를 바꿔 인간형 생물들 사이를 걸어 다닐 수 있었습니다. 당신은 이 능력을 모방하는 법을 배웠다. 하루에 한 번, (5th)랭크 선천적 주문으로 @link[spells.humanoid-form]를 시전할 수 있으며, 지속 시간은 1시간으로 증가한다. 이 주문의 전통은 당신의 드라코닉 이그젬플러에 부합한다.

name: Ratspeak

description.value: You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with rodents, including beavers, mice, porcupines, rats, and squirrels, but not with other mammals, such as dogs or bats. The GM determines which animals count as rodents.

_desc_en: You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with rodents, including beavers, mice, porcupines, rats, and squirrels, but not with other mammals, such as dogs or bats. The GM determines which animals count as rodents.
_desc_ko: 비버, 쥐, 고슴도치, 쥐, 다람쥐를 포함한 설치류에게는 질문을 하고 답변을 받을 수 있으며 외교 기술을 사용할 수 있지만, 개나 박쥐와 같은 다른 포유류에게는 사용할 수 없습니다. 어떤 동물이 설치류로 간주되는지는 GM이 결정합니다.

name: Glass Skin

description.value:
Prerequisites You were present at the death of the medusa Alethsia, whose vitrumantic powers were passed on to you in the wake of her destruction.

Even if vitrumancy is a mystery to you, your blood and flesh know the secrets of the art of arcane glass. Patches of your skin to flicker into glass without warning. By focusing the effect, you can concentrate the glass into a powerful protective layer of magical obsidian. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2BV2yYPfVJ5zirZt]{Mountain Resilience} on yourself as an innate primal spell, though the spell covers you in a layer of glass instead of stone. During this innate mountain resilience, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Xj3LvT3I78cVwzer]{Shatter Glass} reaction. At 18th level, the mountain resilience is heightened to 6th level instead of 4th.

_desc_en:
Prerequisites You were present at the death of the medusa Alethsia, whose vitrumantic powers were passed on to you in the wake of her destruction.

Even if vitrumancy is a mystery to you, your blood and flesh know the secrets of the art of arcane glass. Patches of your skin to flicker into glass without warning. By focusing the effect, you can concentrate the glass into a powerful protective layer of magical obsidian. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2BV2yYPfVJ5zirZt]{Mountain Resilience} on yourself as an innate primal spell, though the spell covers you in a layer of glass instead of stone. During this innate mountain resilience, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Xj3LvT3I78cVwzer]{Shatter Glass} reaction. At 18th level, the mountain resilience is heightened to 6th level instead of 4th.
_desc_ko:
전제 조건 메두사 알레시아의 죽음 현장에 있었으며, 그녀의 파괴 이후 비트루만틱 능력이 당신에게 전수되었습니다.

비트루만시가 당신에게 미스터리라 해도, 당신의 피와 살은 아케인 유리술의 비밀을 알고 있습니다. 피부 일부가 예고 없이 유리로 번쩍일 수 있습니다. 효과를 포커스하면 유리를 강력한 마법 흑요석 보호층으로 응축시킬 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, 당신은 선천적 프라이멀 마법으로 @link[spells.mountain-resilience]을 자신에게 시전할 수 있다. 다만 이 마법은 돌 대신 유리로 당신을 감싼다. 이 선천적 산악의 회복력 동안, 당신은 @link[actions.shatter-glass] 반응을 얻는다. 18레벨에 도달하면 산악 회복력의 강화가 4레벨에서 6레벨로 상승한다.

name: Steam Spell

description.value: You transform your fire spells into steam, making them more effective underwater. If your next action is to Cast a Spell with the fire trait, you can cast it underwater. When you do so, it takes the form of scalding steam. Underwater creatures do not gain the normal fire resistance for being underwater against this spell, but they don't light things on fire or cause @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistent Fire Damage}, nor do they add other effects that would apply to fire but not steam (at the GM's discretion).

_desc_en: You transform your fire spells into steam, making them more effective underwater. If your next action is to Cast a Spell with the fire trait, you can cast it underwater. When you do so, it takes the form of scalding steam. Underwater creatures do not gain the normal fire resistance for being underwater against this spell, but they don't light things on fire or cause @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistent Fire Damage}, nor do they add other effects that would apply to fire but not steam (at the GM's discretion).
_desc_ko: 당신은 화염 마법을 증기로 변환하여 수중에서 더 효과적으로 사용합니다. 다음 행동이 화염 속성 마법 시전인 경우, 수중에서도 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 경우, 주문은 뜨거운 증기 형태로 나타납니다. 수중 생물은 이 주문에 대해 수중 환경으로 인한 일반적인 화염 저항을 얻지 못하지만, 물체를 불태우거나 @link[conditions.persistent-damage]를 입히지 않으며, 화염에는 적용되지만 증기에는 적용되지 않는 다른 효과도 추가하지 않습니다(GM 재량에 따름).

name: Duck!

description.value: Your long experience with your erratic patrons and their peers has given you a lot of practice in hitting the deck when you hear the rumbling of a powerful entity. When you roll a critical failure on a Reflex saving throw against an ability that targets an area and was caused by a Huge or larger creature, you get a failure instead, and when you roll a success against such an effect, you get a critical success instead.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your long experience with your erratic patrons and their peers has given you a lot of practice in hitting the deck when you hear the rumbling of a powerful entity. When you roll a critical failure on a Reflex saving throw against an ability that targets an area and was caused by a Huge or larger creature, you get a failure instead, and when you roll a success against such an effect, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 변덕스러운 후원자들과 그 동료들에 대한 오랜 경험 덕분에, 당신은 강력한 존재의 발소리가 들릴 때 바닥에 엎드리는 연습을 많이 해왔습니다. 거대하거나 그 이상의 크기의 생물이 일으킨 영역 대상 능력에 대한 반사 내성 굴림에서 대실패를 굴릴 경우, 대신 실패를 얻으며, 그러한 효과에 대해 성공을 굴릴 경우 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Ricochet Feint

description.value: While in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.RsNvCSrCN7czHC0G]{Ricochet Stance}, you can bounce a thrown weapon off a foe to distract them. You can attempt a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} against a creature within the first range increment of a thrown weapon you are wielding, rather than only creatures within your melee reach.

_desc_en: While in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.RsNvCSrCN7czHC0G]{Ricochet Stance}, you can bounce a thrown weapon off a foe to distract them. You can attempt a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} against a creature within the first range increment of a thrown weapon you are wielding, rather than only creatures within your melee reach.
_desc_ko: @link[feats.ricochet-stance-rogue] 상태에서는 투척 무기를 적에게 맞혀 튕겨내어 주의를 분산시킬 수 있습니다. 근접 공격 범위 내의 생물뿐만 아니라, 자신이 휘두르는 투척 무기의 첫 번째 사거리 구간 내에 있는 생물에게도 @link[actions.feint]를 시도할 수 있습니다.

name: Provocator Dedication

description.value:
Access Successfully defeat the eberarks in the Irorium.

For you, fighting is as much about style as skill. You become trained in simple weapons, martial weapons, and one advanced weapon of your choice. When you critically succeed at an attack roll using your chosen advanced weapon, you also apply the critical specialization of that weapon. You become an expert in Performance and your choice of either Acrobatics or Athletics. If you were an expert in all three of these skills, you instead become an expert in a skill of your choice.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.XLug8rxIe1KPX6Nf]{Provocator}

_desc_en:
Access Successfully defeat the eberarks in the Irorium.

For you, fighting is as much about style as skill. You become trained in simple weapons, martial weapons, and one advanced weapon of your choice. When you critically succeed at an attack roll using your chosen advanced weapon, you also apply the critical specialization of that weapon. You become an expert in Performance and your choice of either Acrobatics or Athletics. If you were an expert in all three of these skills, you instead become an expert in a skill of your choice.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.XLug8rxIe1KPX6Nf]{Provocator}
_desc_ko:
접근 이로리움의 에버아크를 성공적으로 격파하라.

당신에게 싸움은 기술만큼이나 스타일이 중요합니다. 당신은 단순 무기, 무술 무기, 그리고 선택한 고급 무기 하나를 숙달하게 됩니다. 선택한 고급 무기로 명중 굴림에 대성공을 거둘 경우, 해당 무기의 치명타 특화 효과도 적용됩니다. 당신은 공연술과 곡예 또는 운동술 중 하나를 선택해 전문가가 됩니다. 만약 이 세 가지 기술 모두에 전문가가 되었다면, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 전문가가 됩니다.

name: Symphony of the Unfettered Heart

description.value: You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZAX0OOcKtYMQlquR]{Symphony of the Unfettered Heart} composition spell, which enables you to protect an ally against incapacitating conditions.

_desc_en: You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZAX0OOcKtYMQlquR]{Symphony of the Unfettered Heart} composition spell, which enables you to protect an ally against incapacitating conditions.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @link[spells.symphony-of-the-unfettered-heart] 작곡 주문을 배웁니다. 이 주문은 아군이 무력화 상태에 빠지는 것을 막아줍니다.

name: Loyal Empath

description.value: You have incredible empathy for your friends and family, and you have an innate timing for helping others in distress. You can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} reaction to grant a bonus to another creature's Will saving throw. As usual for Aid, you need to prepare by using an action on your turn to encourage the creature to bravely withstand the effect.

_desc_en: You have incredible empathy for your friends and family, and you have an innate timing for helping others in distress. You can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} reaction to grant a bonus to another creature's Will saving throw. As usual for Aid, you need to prepare by using an action on your turn to encourage the creature to bravely withstand the effect.
_desc_ko: 당신은 친구와 가족에게 놀라운 공감 능력을 지녔으며, 곤경에 처한 이들을 돕는 타고난 타이밍을 가졌습니다. @link[actions.aid] 반응을 사용하여 다른 생물의 의지 내성 굴림에 보너스를 부여할 수 있습니다. 지원의 일반적인 규칙과 마찬가지로, 자신의 턴에 행동을 사용하여 해당 생물이 용감하게 효과를 견뎌내도록 격려하는 준비가 필요합니다.

name: Terrain Master

description.value: You are able to adapt to your surroundings in any natural terrain. You can spend 1 hour practicing in your current terrain in order to make it your favored terrain, replacing your current favored terrain temporarily. If you spend a full day out of the new favored terrain, your favored terrain reverts back to your original choice when you took the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.sgo7J9BVofBqwlsF]{Favored Terrain} feat.

_desc_en: You are able to adapt to your surroundings in any natural terrain. You can spend 1 hour practicing in your current terrain in order to make it your favored terrain, replacing your current favored terrain temporarily. If you spend a full day out of the new favored terrain, your favored terrain reverts back to your original choice when you took the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.sgo7J9BVofBqwlsF]{Favored Terrain} feat.
_desc_ko: 당신은 어떤 자연 지형에서도 주변 환경에 적응할 수 있습니다. 현재 지형에서 1시간 동안 연습하면 해당 지형을 선호 지형으로 설정할 수 있으며, 이는 기존 선호 지형을 일시적으로 대체합니다. 새로운 선호 지형 밖에서 하루를 보낸 후에는, @link[feats.favored-terrain] 피트를 선택했을 때의 원래 선호 지형으로 복귀합니다.

name: Undersea Privateer Dedication

description.value:
Your training has taught you the basics of underwater combat. You become an expert in Athletics and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.iOY6YfGBaOvMNAor]{Underwater Marauder} skill feat. If you're at least an expert in the weapon you're using when fighting in or underwater, you get the critical specialization effect of that weapon when you get a critical hit with it.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.kgHgvP41YRfDRtqo]{Undersea Privateer}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.kgHgvP41YRfDRtqo]{Undersea Privateer}
_desc_ko:
당신의 훈련은 당신에게 수중 전투의 기초를 가르쳤습니다. 당신은 운동에 전문가가 되며 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.iOY6YfGBaOvMNAor]{수중 약탈자} 기술 재주를 얻습니다. 당신이 물속에서 또는 수중에서 싸울 때 사용하는 무기에 최소한 전문가라면, 그 무기로 치명타를 낼 때 해당 무기의 치명 특화 효과를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.kgHgvP41YRfDRtqo]{심해 사략선원}

name: Flexible Tail

description.value: You can perform simple Interact actions with your tail, such as opening an unlocked door. Your tail can't perform actions that require fingers or significant manual dexterity, including any action that would require a check to accomplish, and you can't use it to hold items.

_desc_en: You can perform simple Interact actions with your tail, such as opening an unlocked door. Your tail can't perform actions that require fingers or significant manual dexterity, including any action that would require a check to accomplish, and you can't use it to hold items.
_desc_ko: 꼬리로 간단한 상호작용 행동(예: 잠금 해제된 문 열기)을 수행할 수 있습니다. 손가락이나 상당한 손재주가 필요한 행동(성취를 위해 판정이 필요한 모든 행동 포함)은 수행할 수 없으며, 물건을 잡는 데 사용할 수도 없습니다.

name: Wild Strider

description.value: Natural obstacles pose no obstacle to you. You gain the ranger's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.RlwE99yKnhq8FUuy]{Wild Stride} class feature. This allows you to ignore the effects of all non-magical difficult terrain, treat greater difficult terrain as merely difficult terrain, and gives you an additional benefit from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.sgo7J9BVofBqwlsF]{Favored Terrain} based on the terrain.

_desc_en: Natural obstacles pose no obstacle to you. You gain the ranger's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.RlwE99yKnhq8FUuy]{Wild Stride} class feature. This allows you to ignore the effects of all non-magical difficult terrain, treat greater difficult terrain as merely difficult terrain, and gives you an additional benefit from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.sgo7J9BVofBqwlsF]{Favored Terrain} based on the terrain.
_desc_ko: 자연적 장애물은 당신에게 장애물이 되지 않습니다. 당신은 레인저의 @link[feats.unimpeded-journey] 클래스 특성을 얻습니다. 이로 인해 모든 비마법적 어려운 지형의 효과를 무시하고, 매우 어려운 지형을 단순히 어려운 지형으로 취급하며, 지형에 따라 @link[feats.favored-terrain]의 추가 혜택을 받습니다.

name: Twisting Petal Stance

description.value:
Requirements You're unarmored.

Your body moves like a petal twisting on the wind, confounding your opponents while using their energy against them. You can make gale blossom strikes that deal 1d6 slashing damage. These strikes are in the brawling group and have the agile, finesse, nonlethal, shove, and unarmed traits. While in Twisting Petal Stance, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} and a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude DC to avoid being Shoved. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} and a +2 circumstance bonus to your Perception DC to resist an opponent's Feint attempt.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Requirements You're unarmored.

Your body moves like a petal twisting on the wind, confounding your opponents while using their energy against them. You can make gale blossom strikes that deal 1d6 slashing damage. These strikes are in the brawling group and have the agile, finesse, nonlethal, shove, and unarmed traits. While in Twisting Petal Stance, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} and a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude DC to avoid being Shoved. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} and a +2 circumstance bonus to your Perception DC to resist an opponent's Feint attempt.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 갑옷을 착용하지 않은 상태여야 합니다.

당신의 몸은 바람에 휘날리는 꽃잎처럼 움직이며, 상대의 에너지를 역이용해 혼란을 줍니다. 강풍 꽃잎 타격을 사용해 1d6 베기 피해를 입힐 수 있습니다. 이 타격은 격투 기술 그룹에 속하며 민첩성, 기교, 비살상, 밀치기, 비무장 공격 특성을 지닙니다. 비틀리는 꽃잎 자세 상태에서는 @link[actions.shove] 운동 판정 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 밀쳐짐을 피하기 위한 인내 DC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 또한 @link[actions.feint]에 대한 기만 판정에는 +1 상황 보너스를, 상대의 @link[actions.feint] 시도를 저항하는 지각력 DC에는 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Monstrous Inclinations

description.value:
Requirements Your attuned apparition grants Forest Lore or Ocean Lore as one of its apparition skills.

Your apparitions share with you the monstrous nature of those creatures who dwell in deep seas or ancient woods. You add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8AMvNVOUEtxBCDvJ]{Monstrosity Form} to your apparition spell repertoire, allowing you to cast it with your apparition spellcasting.

Special If you are attuned to a stalker in darkened boughs, add the phoenix form from monstrosity form to your available @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.BhJtCTLbngvZm8EA]{Darkened Forest Form} options when you cast the spell heightened to 8th rank.

If you are attuned to a lurker in devouring dark, add the cave worm and sea serpent forms to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wTldMJx0vyBAehrI]{Devouring Dark Form} options as a polymorph effect when you cast the spell heightened to 8th rank.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your attuned apparition grants Forest Lore or Ocean Lore as one of its apparition skills.

Your apparitions share with you the monstrous nature of those creatures who dwell in deep seas or ancient woods. You add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8AMvNVOUEtxBCDvJ]{Monstrosity Form} to your apparition spell repertoire, allowing you to cast it with your apparition spellcasting.

Special If you are attuned to a stalker in darkened boughs, add the phoenix form from monstrosity form to your available @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.BhJtCTLbngvZm8EA]{Darkened Forest Form} options when you cast the spell heightened to 8th rank.

If you are attuned to a lurker in devouring dark, add the cave worm and sea serpent forms to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wTldMJx0vyBAehrI]{Devouring Dark Form} options as a polymorph effect when you cast the spell heightened to 8th rank.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신의 조율된 환영은 숲의 지식 또는 바다의 지식를 환영 기술 중 하나로 부여합니다.

당신의 환영은 심해나 고대 숲에 서식하는 괴물들의 본성을 공유합니다. 환영 주문 목록에 @link[spells.monstrosity-form]를 추가하여, 환영의 주문 시전 능력으로 이를 발동할 수 있습니다.

특수 어두운 나뭇가지에 숨어있는 스토커와 교감 상태라면, 8랭크으로 강화된 상태에서 괴물 형태의 불사조 형태 옵션을 @link[spells.darkened-forest-form] 옵션에 강화(8th)를 추가합니다.

삼켜버리는 어둠 속에 숨어있는 존재와 교감 중일 경우, 8랭크으로 강화된 상태에서 이 주문을 시전할 때 @link[spells.devouring-dark-form] 옵션에 동굴 벌레와 바다뱀 형태를 변형 효과로 추가합니다.

name: Elaborate Talisman Esoterica

description.value:
As you continue to collect talismanic esoterica, you improve your ability to create temporary talismans. You can create four temporary talismans each day instead of two.

Special You can select this feat a second time if you are 14th level or higher, allowing you to create six talismans each day instead of four.

_desc_en:
As you continue to collect talismanic esoterica, you improve your ability to create temporary talismans. You can create four temporary talismans each day instead of two.

Special You can select this feat a second time if you are 14th level or higher, allowing you to create six talismans each day instead of four.
_desc_ko:
부적 에소테리카의 수집을 계속할수록, 당신은 임시 부적을 제작하는 능력을 향상시킵니다. 하루에 두 개 대신 네 개의 임시 부적을 제작할 수 있습니다.

특수 14레벨 이상일 경우 이 피트를 두 번째로 선택할 수 있으며, 이 경우 하루에 네 개 대신 여섯 개의 부적을 제작할 수 있습니다.

name: Sympathetic Strike

description.value:
Frequency once per round

You collect your patron's magic into one of your witch armaments, causing them to shine with runes, light, or another signifier of your patron.

Make an unarmed Strike with one with your witch's armaments. If you hit, you establish a sympathetic link with the target, making it easier for your patron to affect them. Until the beginning of your next turn, the target takes a –1 circumstance penalty to its saves against your hexes, or a –2 penalty if the triggering Strike was a critical hit.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.qBTJYpopY3AwFFUJ]{Effect: Sympathetic Strike}

_desc_en:
Frequency once per round

You collect your patron's magic into one of your witch armaments, causing them to shine with runes, light, or another signifier of your patron.

Make an unarmed Strike with one with your witch's armaments. If you hit, you establish a sympathetic link with the target, making it easier for your patron to affect them. Until the beginning of your next turn, the target takes a –1 circumstance penalty to its saves against your hexes, or a –2 penalty if the triggering Strike was a critical hit.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.qBTJYpopY3AwFFUJ]{Effect: Sympathetic Strike}
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 라운드당 1회

당신은 후원자의 마법을 마녀의 무기 중 하나로 모아, 그 무기가 후원자를 상징하는 룬, 빛 또는 다른 표식으로 빛나게 합니다.

마녀의 무기 중 하나로 비무장 공격을 가한다. 명중 시 대상과 공명적 연결을 형성하여 후원자가 그에게 영향을 미치기 쉽게 만든다. 다음 턴 시작 전까지 대상은 너의 저주에 대한 내성에 -1 상황 페널티를 받으며, 발동 타격이 치명타였을 경우 -2 페널티를 받는다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.qBTJYpopY3AwFFUJ]{효과: 공명 타격}

name: Swift Leap

description.value:
Your undead physiology allows you to leap quickly toward or away from your opponent. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

If you are satiated, you can choose to end your satiation to instead @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump} without triggering reactions, as you take a quick, enormous jump before any foe can react to your movement.

_desc_en:
Your undead physiology allows you to leap quickly toward or away from your opponent. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

If you are satiated, you can choose to end your satiation to instead @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump} without triggering reactions, as you take a quick, enormous jump before any foe can react to your movement.
_desc_ko:
네 언데드 생리 구조 덕분에 상대에게 빠르게 접근하거나 도망칠 수 있다. @link[actions.leap]한다. 이 이동은 반응을 유발하지 않는다.

만약 포만 상태라면, 포만 상태를 해제하고 대신 @link[actions.high-jump] 또는 @link[actions.long-jump]를 반응을 유발하지 않고 수행할 수 있습니다. 이는 적들이 당신의 움직임에 반응하기 전에 빠르고 거대한 점프를 하기 때문입니다.

name: Greater Enhance Venom

description.value:
You upgrade the vishkanyan venom you can apply with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.s4V7JWSMF9JPJAeX]{Envenom} to greater vishkanyan venom. Envenom's frequency becomes once per minute.

Greater Vishkanyan Venom (level 17)

Frequency once per minute

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[7d6[poison]] damage (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[9d6[poison]] damage (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[11d6[poison]] damage (1 round)

You upgrade the vishkanyan venom you can apply with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.s4V7JWSMF9JPJAeX]{Envenom} to greater vishkanyan venom. Envenom's frequency becomes once per minute.

_desc_ko:
@link[actions.envenom]으로 적용 가능한 비슈카니안 독을 (중급) 비슈카니안 독으로 업그레이드합니다. 독 주입의 사용 빈도가 분당 1회로 변경됩니다.

강화된 비슈카냔 맹독 (레벨 17)

2단계 9d6 독 피해 (1라운드)

3단계 11d6 독 피해 (1 라운드)

name: Wrapped In Smoke

description.value: You ignite a small portion of powder in a rapid, inefficient burn, creating a hazy cloud. You create a cloud of smoke in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] centered on your innovation, which lasts for 1 minute. All creatures and objects within the smoke become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and those outside the smoke become concealed to those within.

_desc_en: You ignite a small portion of powder in a rapid, inefficient burn, creating a hazy cloud. You create a cloud of smoke in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] centered on your innovation, which lasts for 1 minute. All creatures and objects within the smoke become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and those outside the smoke become concealed to those within.
_desc_ko: 당신은 분말의 일부를 빠르고 비효율적으로 태워 흐릿한 구름을 생성합니다. 당신은 혁신을 중심으로 한 5피트 발산 범위 내에 1분 동안 지속되는 연기 구름을 만듭니다. 연기 안의 모든 생물과 물체는 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태가 되며, 연기 밖의 대상은 연기 안의 대상에게 은폐 상태가 됩니다.

name: Koi Secrets

description.value:
Access Tian Xia origin

Due to their beautiful colors, ornamental koi are often found in parks and gardens where townsfolk roam. They hear the gossip and rumors that folks above the water spread. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with fish. As you are a friend of koi—who also strive to be a mighty being one day—koi (as well as carp and goldfish) have a starting attitude toward you of one step better (typically making them friendly).

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Access Tian Xia origin

Due to their beautiful colors, ornamental koi are often found in parks and gardens where townsfolk roam. They hear the gossip and rumors that folks above the water spread. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with fish. As you are a friend of koi—who also strive to be a mighty being one day—koi (as well as carp and goldfish) have a starting attitude toward you of one step better (typically making them friendly).
_desc_ko:
접근 티엔 샤 기원

아름다운 색깔 덕분에 관상용 잉어는 마을 사람들이 거니는 공원과 정원에서 흔히 볼 수 있습니다. 그들은 물 위의 사람들이 퍼뜨리는 소문과 험담을 듣습니다. 물고기에게 질문을 하고, 답변을 받으며, 외교 기술을 사용할 수 있습니다. 언젠가 위대한 존재가 되려 애쓰는 잉어의 친구인 당신에게, 잉어(그리고 잉어와 금붕어)는 당신에게 한 단계 더 우호적인 태도를 보입니다(일반적으로 친근하게 대합니다).

name: Treacherous Earth

description.value:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

You have the power to shatter the earth into a shape of your devising. You crack the ground beneath you, creating difficult terrain in a @Template[burst|distance:5] centered on one corner of your space.

_desc_en:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

You have the power to shatter the earth into a shape of your devising. You crack the ground beneath you, creating difficult terrain in a @Template[burst|distance:5] centered on one corner of your space.
_desc_ko:
발생 빈도 10분마다 한 번

당신은 땅을 원하는 형태로 산산조각낼 수 있는 힘을 지녔습니다. 발밑의 땅을 갈라, 자신의 공간 한 모서리를 중심으로 한 5피트 크기의 어려운 지형을 생성합니다.

name: Ancestral Weaponry

description.value: You blend monastic techniques with the ancestral fighting styles of your people. Choose an ancestry for which you have access to all weapons with that trait. For you, melee weapons with that ancestry trait and either the agile or finesse trait gain the monk trait.

value.value: a feat granting access to all weapons with an ancestry trait (such as elf or orc)

_desc_en: You blend monastic techniques with the ancestral fighting styles of your people. Choose an ancestry for which you have access to all weapons with that trait. For you, melee weapons with that ancestry trait and either the agile or finesse trait gain the monk trait.
_desc_ko: 당신은 수도승의 기술과 조상의 무술을 융합합니다. 특정 혈통을 선택하면 해당 혈통의 모든 무기를 사용할 수 있습니다. 당신에게 있어, 해당 혈통 특성과 기민한 또는 기교 특성을 가진 근접 무기는 모두 몽크 특성을 얻습니다.

name: Legendary Tattoo Artist

description.value: Your craftsmanship at decorating flesh is unparalleled. You become legendary in Crafting. Whenever you craft a magical tattoo whose level is at least 3 lower than your level, increase all attack roll and DC values of the tattoo's activated abilities by 1, and increase all resistances granted by the tattoo by 1.

_desc_en: Your craftsmanship at decorating flesh is unparalleled. You become legendary in Crafting. Whenever you craft a magical tattoo whose level is at least 3 lower than your level, increase all attack roll and DC values of the tattoo's activated abilities by 1, and increase all resistances granted by the tattoo by 1.
_desc_ko: 당신의 살갗을 장식하는 솜씨는 타의 추종을 불허합니다. 당신은 제작 분야에서 전설적인 존재가 됩니다. 자신의 레벨보다 3레벨 이하인 마법 문신을 제작할 때마다, 해당 문신의 활성화 능력에 대한 모든 명중 굴림과 DC 값을 1 증가시키고, 문신이 부여하는 모든 저항력을 1 증가시킵니다.

name: Their Master's Call

description.value: In a pinch, you pull one of your inactive companions from their rest to provide a companion's support benefit. A fragment of your companion materializes or assembles itself in an unoccupied square of your choice within 30 feet of you, grants you its support benefit, and then disappears on your next turn. If it takes any damage before your next turn, it disappears or collapses (as applicable) and the support benefit ends immediately.

value.value: at least one inactive undead companion whose remains or anchor are currently in your possession.

_desc_en: In a pinch, you pull one of your inactive companions from their rest to provide a companion's support benefit. A fragment of your companion materializes or assembles itself in an unoccupied square of your choice within 30 feet of you, grants you its support benefit, and then disappears on your next turn. If it takes any damage before your next turn, it disappears or collapses (as applicable) and the support benefit ends immediately.
_desc_ko: 급박한 상황에서 휴식 중인 동료 중 한 명을 불러내 동료 지원 혜택을 받습니다. 동료의 일부가 당신으로부터 30피트 이내의 빈 칸에 나타나거나 조립되어 당신에게 지원 효과를 부여한 후, 당신의 다음 턴에 사라집니다. 당신의 다음 턴 전에 피해를 입으면 해당 부분은 사라지거나 붕괴(해당되는 경우)되며 지원 효과는 즉시 종료됩니다.

name: Ceremony of Protection

description.value:
You manipulate your exoskeleton to overlap itself. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.9kNbiZPOM2wy60ao]{Effect: Ceremony of Protection}

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en:
You manipulate your exoskeleton to overlap itself. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.9kNbiZPOM2wy60ao]{Effect: Ceremony of Protection}
_desc_ko:
당신은 외골격을 조작하여 겹쳐지게 합니다. 다음 차례 시작까지 AC에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.9kNbiZPOM2wy60ao]{효과: 보호 의식}

name: Tricksterbane Oath

description.value:
You've sworn an oath to ferret out and destroy malevolent shapechangers who pose as mortals with evil intent. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to detect a shapechanged creature's disguise, and a +2 circumstance bonus to attempts to Recall Knowledge about shapechangers. Whenever you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.zUWj4zmBNWOTzeFJ]{Overwhelming Combination} against a shapechanged creature, you attempt to counteract one polymorph effect on that creature. The counteract rank is half your level rounded up, and the counteract check modifier is your Charisma modifier + your proficiency bonus with the weapon used to Strike as part of your Overwhelming Combination. You gain the following edict.

Edict You must reveal and slay evil or predatory shapechangers you discover or encounter, as long as you have a reasonable chance of success.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You've sworn an oath to ferret out and destroy malevolent shapechangers who pose as mortals with evil intent. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to detect a shapechanged creature's disguise, and a +2 circumstance bonus to attempts to Recall Knowledge about shapechangers. Whenever you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.zUWj4zmBNWOTzeFJ]{Overwhelming Combination} against a shapechanged creature, you attempt to counteract one polymorph effect on that creature. The counteract rank is half your level rounded up, and the counteract check modifier is your Charisma modifier + your proficiency bonus with the weapon used to Strike as part of your Overwhelming Combination. You gain the following edict.

Edict You must reveal and slay evil or predatory shapechangers you discover or encounter, as long as you have a reasonable chance of success.
_desc_ko:
당신은 사악한 의도로 인간으로 변장한 악의적인 변신자를 찾아내 파괴하겠다고 맹세했습니다. 변신한 생물의 변장을 감지하는 지각 판정에는 +4 상황 보너스를, 변신자에 관한 지식 회상 시도에는 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 변신한 생물에게 @link[actions.overwhelming-combination]을 사용할 때마다, 해당 생물에게 걸린 변형 효과 하나를 반격하려 시도한다. 반격 등급은 네 레벨의 절반을 올림한 값이며, 반격 판정 수정자는 네 매력 수정치 + 압도적 조합의 일환으로 강타에 사용한 무기의 숙련 보너스이다. 다음의 칙령을 얻는다.

명령 성공 가능성이 합리적으로 존재하는 한, 발견하거나 마주친 사악하거나 포식적인 변신 생물을 반드시 드러내고 처치해야 한다.

name: Hurl at the Horizon

description.value:
Usage imbued into a thrown or melee weapon ikon

Your weapon flies from your hand as if propelled under its own power. The imbued ikon gains the following ability.

Immanence Your weapon gains the thrown 15 feet trait, or increases its thrown distance by 10 feet if it already has the thrown trait.

_desc_en:
Usage imbued into a thrown or melee weapon ikon

Your weapon flies from your hand as if propelled under its own power. The imbued ikon gains the following ability.

Immanence Your weapon gains the thrown 15 feet trait, or increases its thrown distance by 10 feet if it already has the thrown trait.
_desc_ko:
사용법 투척 무기나 근접 무기에 이콘을 부여한다

무기가 마치 스스로 추진력을 얻은 듯 손에서 날아간다. 부여된 이콘은 다음 능력을 얻는다.

내재성 무기는 투척 15피트 특성을 얻거나, 이미 투척 특성을 가진 경우 투척 거리가 10피트 증가한다.

name: Loremaster's Etude

description.value: You magically unlock memories, making them easier to recall. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5Pc55FGGqVpIAJ62]{Loremaster's Etude} composition spell.

_desc_en: You magically unlock memories, making them easier to recall. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5Pc55FGGqVpIAJ62]{Loremaster's Etude} composition spell.
_desc_ko: 당신은 마법으로 기억을 해제하여 더 쉽게 떠올릴 수 있게 합니다. 당신은 @link[spells.loremasters-etude] 작곡 주문을 배웁니다.

name: Halfling Lore

description.value:
You've dutifully learned how to keep your balance and how to stick to the shadows where it's safe, important skills passed down through generations of halfling tradition. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Acrobatics and Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Halfling Lore.

_desc_en:
You've dutifully learned how to keep your balance and how to stick to the shadows where it's safe, important skills passed down through generations of halfling tradition. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Acrobatics and Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Halfling Lore.
_desc_ko:
여러분은 세대를 거쳐 전해진 하플링 전통의 중요한 기술인 균형을 유지하는 법과 안전한 그림자에 숨는 법을 성실히 배웠습니다. 당신은 곡예와 은신에 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 해당 기술 중 하나에 자동으로 숙련이 부여된다면, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련이 부여됩니다.

또한 하플링 지식에 대한 @link[feats.additional-lore] 일반 피트를 얻습니다.

name: Skull Creeper

description.value: You wear skulls to demoralize foes. You become trained in Intimidation and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xQMz6eDgX75WX2ce]{Intimidating Glare} skill feat. If you're already trained in Intimidation, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. If you pay 50 gp for a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.HYnwTFuLsFSsUAMG]{Splendid Skull Mask}, the mask grants you a +1 item bonus to Intimidation; its usage is worn (mask).

_desc_en: You wear skulls to demoralize foes. You become trained in Intimidation and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xQMz6eDgX75WX2ce]{Intimidating Glare} skill feat. If you're already trained in Intimidation, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. If you pay 50 gp for a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.HYnwTFuLsFSsUAMG]{Splendid Skull Mask}, the mask grants you a +1 item bonus to Intimidation; its usage is worn (mask).
_desc_ko: 적의 사기를 꺾기 위해 두개골 장식을 착용합니다. 위협 기술에 숙련되고 @link[feats.intimidating-glare] 기술 피트를 얻습니다. 이미 위협 기술에 숙련된 경우, 대신 선택한 기술에 숙련됩니다. 50gp를 지불하고 @link[equipment.splendid-skull-mask]을 구입하면, 이 가면은 협박에 +1 아이템 보너스를 부여한다. 사용 방식은 착용(가면)이다.

name: Reactive Pursuit

description.value:
Trigger An adjacent foe moves away from you, and you can reach at least one space adjacent to the foe with a Stride action.

You keep pace with a retreating foe. You Stride, but you must end your movement adjacent to the triggering enemy. Your move does not trigger reactions from the triggering enemy. You can use Reactive Pursuit to Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead of Stride if you have the corresponding movement type.

_desc_en:
Trigger An adjacent foe moves away from you, and you can reach at least one space adjacent to the foe with a Stride action.

You keep pace with a retreating foe. You Stride, but you must end your movement adjacent to the triggering enemy. Your move does not trigger reactions from the triggering enemy. You can use Reactive Pursuit to Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead of Stride if you have the corresponding movement type.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 인접한 적이 당신으로부터 멀어지며, 당신이 그 적과 인접한 최소 한 칸 이상을 이동 행동으로 이동할 수 있을 때.

후퇴하는 적과 속도를 맞춘다. 스트라이드를 사용하지만, 이동을 종료할 때는 발동한 적과 인접한 위치여야 한다. 이 이동은 발동한 적의 반응을 유발하지 않는다. 해당 이동 유형을 보유한 경우, 스트라이드 대신 반응적 추적을 사용하여 땅속 이동, 등반, 비행 또는 수영을 할 수 있다.

name: Two-Weapon Fusillade

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding two weapons, each in a different hand. At least one of these weapons must be a loaded firearm or loaded crossbow.

You attack with both your weapons in a furious barrage. Strike twice, once with each weapon.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding two weapons, each in a different hand. At least one of these weapons must be a loaded firearm or loaded crossbow.

You attack with both your weapons in a furious barrage. Strike twice, once with each weapon.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손에 각각 다른 무기를 들고 있어야 한다. 이 중 적어도 하나는 장전된 화기나 장전된 석궁이어야 한다.

당신은 두 무기로 격렬한 연타를 퍼붓습니다. 각 무기로 한 번씩, 총 두 번 공격합니다.

name: Ambush Hunter

description.value: You are always searching for the perfect opportunity to ambush your enemies. You can perform the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{Scout} exploration activity at the same time as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice} exploration activity.

_desc_en: You are always searching for the perfect opportunity to ambush your enemies. You can perform the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{Scout} exploration activity at the same time as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice} exploration activity.
_desc_ko: 당신은 항상 적을 기습할 완벽한 기회를 노리고 있습니다. @link[actions.scout] 탐사 활동과 @link[actions.avoid-notice] 탐사 활동을 동시에 수행할 수 있습니다.

name: Unbalancing Finisher

description.value: You attack with a flashy assault that leaves your target off balance. Make a melee Strike. If you hit and deal damage, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your next turn.

_desc_en: You attack with a flashy assault that leaves your target off balance. Make a melee Strike. If you hit and deal damage, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko: 눈부신 공격으로 상대를 균형을 잃게 만든다. 근접 공격을 시도한다. 명중하여 피해를 입히면, 대상은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 된다.

name: Webslinger

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Your natural ability to create silken webs blends with your magical powers, allowing you to create impossibly large webs with great frequency. This has the effects of a 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9s5tqqXNzcoKamWx]{Web} spell using your class or spell DC, whichever is higher.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Your natural ability to create silken webs blends with your magical powers, allowing you to create impossibly large webs with great frequency. This has the effects of a 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9s5tqqXNzcoKamWx]{Web} spell using your class or spell DC, whichever is higher.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 10분마다 1회

당신의 실크 같은 거미줄을 만드는 타고난 능력이 마법 능력과 결합되어, 불가능할 정도로 거대한 거미줄을 매우 빈번하게 생성할 수 있습니다. 이는 2랭크 @link[spells.web] 주문의 효과를 가지며, 당신의 클래스 난이도 또는 주문 DC 중 더 높은 쪽을 사용합니다.

name: Broad Snare

description.value: You can create longer snares for quick deployment, creating lines on the battlefield. When you prepare snares for quick deployment, you can prepare some of them as broad snares. A broad snare takes up a @Template[type:line|distance:20] starting from the square in which you craft the snare but it costs two of your quick deployment snares. A broad snare can trigger from a creature entering any portion of its area, and all its effects apply over the full area.

_desc_en: You can create longer snares for quick deployment, creating lines on the battlefield. When you prepare snares for quick deployment, you can prepare some of them as broad snares. A broad snare takes up a @Template[type:line|distance:20] starting from the square in which you craft the snare but it costs two of your quick deployment snares. A broad snare can trigger from a creature entering any portion of its area, and all its effects apply over the full area.
_desc_ko: 당신은 빠른 배치를 위한 더 긴 함정을 만들어 전장에 선을 그을 수 있습니다. 빠른 배치를 위한 함정을 준비할 때, 그중 일부를 광역 함정으로 준비할 수 있습니다. 광역 함정은 당신이 함정을 제작하는 칸에서 시작하는 @Template[type:line|distance:20]를 차지하지만, 당신의 빠른 배치 함정 두 개를 소모합니다. 광역 함정은 생물이 그 지역의 어느 부분에라도 진입하면 발동될 수 있으며, 그 모든 효과가 전체 지역에 적용됩니다.

name: Deflecting Cloud

description.value:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

Trigger You are the target of a ranged attack.

Requirements You are aware of the attack and currently have dragon wings active.

You've mastered a defensive technique unique to the ancient dragons of Bloodsalt: beating your wings to create a billowing cloud of mist. You become momentarily @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from the triggering attack if vision is the attacker's only precise sense. Normally this means the attacker must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:11|name:Hidden Flat Check|traits:hidden|showDC:owner] check to target you. You also gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

_desc_en:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

Trigger You are the target of a ranged attack.

Requirements You are aware of the attack and currently have dragon wings active.

You've mastered a defensive technique unique to the ancient dragons of Bloodsalt: beating your wings to create a billowing cloud of mist. You become momentarily @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from the triggering attack if vision is the attacker's only precise sense. Normally this means the attacker must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:11|name:Hidden Flat Check|traits:hidden|showDC:owner] check to target you. You also gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 10분마다 한 번

발동 조건 원거리 공격을 받는 대상이 될 때.

조건 공격을 인지하고 있으며 현재 용의 날개가 활성화된 상태입니다.

당신은 블러드솔트 고대 드래곤만의 방어 기술을 마스터했습니다: 날개를 펄럭여 짙은 안개 구름을 만들어내는 기술입니다. 시야가 공격자의 유일한 정밀 감각일 경우, 당신은 순간적으로 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태가 되어 발동 공격으로부터 숨겨집니다. 일반적으로 이는 공격자가 당신을 명중시키려면 DC 11 단순 판정에 성공해야 함을 의미합니다. 또한 발동 공격에 대해 AC에 +4 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Far Throw

description.value: When you Strike with a thrown weapon, you take only a –1 penalty for each additional range increment between you and the target, rather than a –2 penalty.

_desc_en: When you Strike with a thrown weapon, you take only a –1 penalty for each additional range increment between you and the target, rather than a –2 penalty.
_desc_ko: 투척 무기로 공격할 때, 목표물과의 추가 사거리 증가마다 -2 페널티 대신 -1 페널티만 받습니다.

name: Shield the Faithful

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You and those closest to you are protected by your deity's power. For 1 minute, you and all allies within 10 feet of you gain a +1 item bonus to AC and resistance 10 to spirit damage. In addition, when a creature adjacent to you hits you with a melee attack, or when a creature touches you or hits you with an unarmed attack, that creature takes @Damage[(ternary(gte(@actor.level,20),10,5))[spirit]] damage.

At 20th level, the spirit resistance increases to 15 and the spirit damage increases to 10.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

You and those closest to you are protected by your deity's power. For 1 minute, you and all allies within 10 feet of you gain a +1 item bonus to AC and resistance 10 to spirit damage. In addition, when a creature adjacent to you hits you with a melee attack, or when a creature touches you or hits you with an unarmed attack, that creature takes @Damage[(ternary(gte(@actor.level,20),10,5))[spirit]] damage.

At 20th level, the spirit resistance increases to 15 and the spirit damage increases to 10.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

당신과 가장 가까운 이들은 당신의 신의 힘으로 보호받습니다. 1분 동안, 당신과 10피트 이내의 모든 아군은 AC에 +1 아이템 보너스를 얻고 영혼 피해에 대한 저항력 10을 얻습니다. 또한, 당신과 인접한 생물이 근접 공격으로 당신을 명중시키거나, 생물이 당신을 만지거나 비무장 공격으로 명중시킬 때, 그 생물은 영혼의 피해를 입습니다.

20레벨에 도달하면 영혼 저항력이 15로 증가하고 영혼 피해량이 10으로 증가합니다.

name: Elemental Embellish

description.value: You can summon a harmless but impressive elemental display. You become trained in Intimidation. If you would automatically become trained in Intimidation (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. When you Demoralize a foe, if you choose to Demoralize via an elemental display, Demoralize loses the auditory trait and gains the visual trait, and you don't take a penalty when you attempt to Demoralize a creature that doesn't understand your language.

_desc_en: You can summon a harmless but impressive elemental display. You become trained in Intimidation. If you would automatically become trained in Intimidation (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. When you Demoralize a foe, if you choose to Demoralize via an elemental display, Demoralize loses the auditory trait and gains the visual trait, and you don't take a penalty when you attempt to Demoralize a creature that doesn't understand your language.
_desc_ko: 무해하지만 인상적인 원소 현상을 소환할 수 있습니다. 위협 기술에 숙련됩니다. 배경이나 직업 등으로 위협 기술에 자동 숙련되는 경우, 대신 선택한 기술에 숙련됩니다. 적에게 사기 저하를 걸 때, 원소 현상을 통해 사기 저하를 걸기로 선택하면 사기 저하는 청각적 특성을 잃고 시각적 특성을 얻으며, 당신의 언어를 이해하지 못하는 생물에게 사기 저하를 시도하다 페널티를 받지 않습니다.

name: Second Blessing

description.value: Your continued service grants you another boon. Choose a second @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.ERwuazupczhUSZ73]{Blessing of the Devoted} (different from your first one) and gain its benefits.

_desc_en: Your continued service grants you another boon. Choose a second @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.ERwuazupczhUSZ73]{Blessing of the Devoted} (different from your first one) and gain its benefits.
_desc_ko: 지속적인 봉사로 또 다른 은총을 얻습니다. 두 번째 @link[feats.blessing-of-the-devoted]을 선택하고(첫 번째와 다른 것) 그 혜택을 얻습니다.

name: Untamed Form

description.value: You are one with the wild, always changing and adapting to meet any challenge. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form} order spell, which lets you transform into a variety of shapes that you can expand with druid feats.

_desc_en: You are one with the wild, always changing and adapting to meet any challenge. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form} order spell, which lets you transform into a variety of shapes that you can expand with druid feats.
_desc_ko: 당신은 야생과 하나가 되어 끊임없이 변화하며 어떤 도전에도 적응합니다. @link[spells.untamed-form] 명령 주문을 획득하여 다양한 형태로 변신할 수 있으며, 드루이드 피트를 통해 변신 범위를 확장할 수 있습니다.

name: Instant Credentials

description.value: In a pinch, ink from your tattoo arranges itself into a temporary pass, writ of authority, or similar document. If you're in possession of a blank page of paper, you can [[/act create-forgery traits=concentrate,occult]] as a single action with the concentrate and occult traits. The forgery lasts for 1 minute, and during this time, you can't use any of the other abilities of your Talon's Mark. You can Dismiss the forgery, leaving the paper blank once again.

_desc_en: In a pinch, ink from your tattoo arranges itself into a temporary pass, writ of authority, or similar document. If you're in possession of a blank page of paper, you can [[/act create-forgery traits=concentrate,occult]] as a single action with the concentrate and occult traits. The forgery lasts for 1 minute, and during this time, you can't use any of the other abilities of your Talon's Mark. You can Dismiss the forgery, leaving the paper blank once again.
_desc_ko: 급한 상황에서, 당신의 문신에서 나온 잉크가 스스로 배열되어 임시 통행증, 권한 증서, 또는 유사한 문서를 형성합니다. 당신이 빈 종이 한 장을 소지하고 있다면, 집중 및 오컬트 특성을 가진 단일 행동으로 [[/act create-forgery traits=concentrate,occult]]를 할 수 있습니다. 위조물은 1분 동안 지속되며, 이 시간 동안 당신은 탈론의 표식의 다른 어떤 능력도 사용할 수 없습니다. 당신은 위조물을 해제하여 종이를 다시 백지로 되돌릴 수 있습니다.

name: Cavalier's Charge

description.value:
Requirements You are riding your mount.

You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{Command an Animal} to order your mount to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Bcxarzksqt9ezrs6]{Stride} twice. At any point during this movement, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{Strike} one enemy within reach or within the first range increment of a ranged weapon. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your attack roll.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are riding your mount.

You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{Command an Animal} to order your mount to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Bcxarzksqt9ezrs6]{Stride} twice. At any point during this movement, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{Strike} one enemy within reach or within the first range increment of a ranged weapon. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your attack roll.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 탈것을 타고 있습니다.

당신은 @link[actions.command-an-animal]하여 탈것을 @link[actions.stride]하도록 명령합니다. 이 이동 중 언제든지, 당신은 @link[actions.strike]하여 손이 닿는 범위 내 또는 원거리 무기의 첫 번째 사거리 증가 범위 내에 있는 적 하나를 공격할 수 있습니다. 명중 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Iruxi Armaments

description.value:
Your weapons are those you were born with. Choose one of the following options:

  • Claws Your claw attack deals 1d6 slashing damage instead of 1d4 and gains the versatile P trait.
  • Fangs You gain a fangs unarmed attack that deals 1d8 piercing damage and is in the brawling group.
  • Tail You gain a tail unarmed attack that deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage, is in the brawling group, and has the sweep trait.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of the unarmed attacks you have gained or improved with this feat, you get its critical specialization effect.

Special You can take this feat multiple times, choosing a different unarmed attack option each time.

_desc_en:
Your weapons are those you were born with. Choose one of the following options:

  • Claws Your claw attack deals 1d6 slashing damage instead of 1d4 and gains the versatile P trait.
  • Fangs You gain a fangs unarmed attack that deals 1d8 piercing damage and is in the brawling group.
  • Tail You gain a tail unarmed attack that deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage, is in the brawling group, and has the sweep trait.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of the unarmed attacks you have gained or improved with this feat, you get its critical specialization effect.

Special You can take this feat multiple times, choosing a different unarmed attack option each time.
_desc_ko:
당신의 무기는 태어날 때부터 지닌 것입니다. 다음 옵션 중 하나를 선택하세요:

  • 발톱 발톱 공격이 1d4 대신 1d6 베기 피해를 입히고 다용도 P 특성을 얻습니다.
  • 이빨 송곳니 비무장 공격을 얻습니다. 이 공격은 1d8 관통 피해를 입히며, 난투 공격 그룹에 속합니다.
  • 꼬리 꼬리 비무장 공격을 얻습니다. 이 공격은 1d6 타격을 입히며, 난투 그룹에 속하고, 쓸어치기 특성을 가집니다.

5레벨에 도달하면, 이 피트로 획득하거나 강화한 비무장 공격 중 하나로 치명타를 기록할 때마다 해당 공격의 치명타 특화 효과를 얻습니다.

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있으며, 매번 다른 비무장 공격 옵션을 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Form a Flock

description.value:
You call nearby wild dragonets to swarm to your side. The flock grants you 25 temporary Hit Points that last up to 1 minute. The flock disperses and the effect ends when the temporary Hit Points are gone, the minute elapses, or you Dismiss Form a Flock. As long as you're surrounded by your flock, you gain weakness 5 to area and splash damage and have a flock aura in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10]. Enemies in this aura are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}.

When you use Form a Flock and while it lasts, you can take the Acrid Barrage action.

_desc_en:
You call nearby wild dragonets to swarm to your side. The flock grants you 25 temporary Hit Points that last up to 1 minute. The flock disperses and the effect ends when the temporary Hit Points are gone, the minute elapses, or you Dismiss Form a Flock. As long as you're surrounded by your flock, you gain weakness 5 to area and splash damage and have a flock aura in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10]. Enemies in this aura are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}.

When you use Form a Flock and while it lasts, you can take the Acrid Barrage action.
_desc_ko:
당신은 근처의 야생 새끼 용들을 불러 당신의 곁으로 떼 지어 모이게 합니다. 무리는 최대 1분 동안 지속되는 25의 임시 히트 포인트를 당신에게 부여합니다. 임시 히트 포인트가 소진되거나, 1분이 경과하거나, 당신이 무리 소집을 해제하면 무리가 흩어지고 효과가 종료됩니다. 당신이 무리에 둘러싸여 있는 한, 당신은 범위 및 비산 피해에 약점 5를 얻고 @Template[type:emanation|distance:10]의 무리 오라를 가집니다. 이 오라 내의 적들은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{눈부심} 상태가 됩니다.

무리 소집을 사용할 때와 그것이 지속되는 동안, 당신은 매캐한 탄막 행동을 취할 수 있습니다.

name: Improvisational Warrior

description.value: When you use an improvised weapon, you apply the critical specialization of a brawling weapon to it. Depending on the shape and nature of the improvised weapon, your GM might determine another weapon group's critical specialization is more appropriate.

_desc_en: When you use an improvised weapon, you apply the critical specialization of a brawling weapon to it. Depending on the shape and nature of the improvised weapon, your GM might determine another weapon group's critical specialization is more appropriate.
_desc_ko: 임시 무기를 사용할 때, 당신은 그 무기에 격투 무기의 치명타 전문화 효과를 적용합니다. 임시 무기의 형태와 특성에 따라, 당신의 GM은 다른 무기 그룹의 치명타 전문화 효과가 더 적합하다고 판단할 수 있습니다.

name: Improved Signature Weapon

description.value: Your signature weapon takes on the properties of mystical materials renowned for defeating undead, spirits, and other such creatures. Your signature weapon is treated as dawnsilver, duskwood, and peachwood for the purposes of overcoming resistance.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your signature weapon takes on the properties of mystical materials renowned for defeating undead, spirits, and other such creatures. Your signature weapon is treated as dawnsilver, duskwood, and peachwood for the purposes of overcoming resistance.
_desc_ko: 당신의 시그니처 무기는 언데드, 영혼 및 이와 유사한 생물을 물리치는 데 유명한 신비한 재료의 속성을 지닙니다. 저항력 극복 목적상, 당신의 시그니처 무기는 던실버, 황혼나무, 복숭아나무로 간주됩니다.

name: Ouroboric Pact

description.value:
You've studied pacts at Cobyslarni, or learned under someone who has, and understand them to not only create a bargain between individuals, but a separate entity altogether: the pact itself. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BrCbXsCUIFYfu26E]{Entreat Pact} action, which you can use in association with any pact from the pactbinder archetype. For example, if you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.GvQ9FQ02i7GYuRRh]{Pact of Draconic Fury}, you could Entreat Pact to aid a skill check to obtain an item the dragon desires.

Special Your pacts continually enforce themselves in a circular magical loop. You lose the ability to retrain out of any feats from the pactbinder archetype.

_desc_en:
You've studied pacts at Cobyslarni, or learned under someone who has, and understand them to not only create a bargain between individuals, but a separate entity altogether: the pact itself. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BrCbXsCUIFYfu26E]{Entreat Pact} action, which you can use in association with any pact from the pactbinder archetype. For example, if you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.GvQ9FQ02i7GYuRRh]{Pact of Draconic Fury}, you could Entreat Pact to aid a skill check to obtain an item the dragon desires.

Special Your pacts continually enforce themselves in a circular magical loop. You lose the ability to retrain out of any feats from the pactbinder archetype.
_desc_ko:
코비스라니에서 계약을 연구했거나, 연구한 사람에게 배워서, 계약이 단순히 개인 간의 거래를 만드는 것이 아니라 완전히 별개의 실체인 '계약 자체'를 생성한다는 점을 이해하고 있습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.entreat-pact] 행동을 획득하며, 이는 계약결속자 아키타입의 모든 계약과 연계하여 사용할 수 있습니다. 예를 들어, @link[feats.pact-of-draconic-fury]을 보유한 경우, 용이 원하는 아이템을 획득하기 위한 기술 판정 시 계약 간청을 통해 도움을 받을 수 있습니다.

특수 당신의 협정은 순환 마법 루프를 통해 지속적으로 강제됩니다. 협약결속자 아키타입의 피트 재훈련 능력을 상실합니다.

name: Favor of Heaven

description.value: You're one of Hei Feng's chosen people and have the authority of the Celestial Court on your side. Once per day, you can cast a 6th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PHVHBbdHeQRfjLmE]{Spirit Blast} as a divine innate spell. In addition, you gain resistance 5 to both holy and unholy.

_desc_en: You're one of Hei Feng's chosen people and have the authority of the Celestial Court on your side. Once per day, you can cast a 6th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PHVHBbdHeQRfjLmE]{Spirit Blast} as a divine innate spell. In addition, you gain resistance 5 to both holy and unholy.
_desc_ko: 당신은 헤이펑이 선택한 자 중 하나이며 천상체의 권위를 지니고 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, (6th)랭크 @link[spells.spirit-blast]을 신성 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 또한 신성한 것과 불경한 것에 대해 저항력 5를 얻습니다.

name: Lighter than Air

description.value: Your mysterious steps become even lighter, transcending the mortal world altogether. When you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zXZjC8HLaRoLR17U]{Cursebound} condition, you gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.A2JfEKe6BZcTG1S8]{Fly}. If you are cursebound 3 or greater, you gain a +10-foot status bonus to your fly Speed.

_desc_en: Your mysterious steps become even lighter, transcending the mortal world altogether.
