When you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zXZjC8HLaRoLR17U]{Cursebound} condition, you gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.A2JfEKe6BZcTG1S8]{Fly}. If you are cursebound 3 or greater, you gain a +10-foot status bonus to your fly Speed.
_desc_ko: 당신의 신비로운 발걸음이 더욱 가벼워져, 필멸의 세계를 완전히 초월합니다. @link[conditions.cursebound] 상태일 때, @link[spells.fly]의 효과를 얻습니다. 저주에 묶임이 3 이상일 경우, 비행 속도에 +10피트 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Razzle-Dazzle

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You blind or dazzle a creature.

You've spent considerable time practicing the manipulation of light, weaponizing your blade's reflection or bolstering the luminosity of magical displays to unconventional heights. Extend the duration of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} condition you give the target by 1 round.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You blind or dazzle a creature.

You've spent considerable time practicing the manipulation of light, weaponizing your blade's reflection or bolstering the luminosity of magical displays to unconventional heights. Extend the duration of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} condition you give the target by 1 round.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

발동 조건 생물을 눈멀게 하거나 현혹시킨다.

빛의 조작을 상당 기간 연습하여, 검의 반사를 무기화하거나 마법적 현상의 광도를 비정상적인 수준으로 강화했습니다. 대상에게 부여하는 @link[conditions.blinded] 또는 @link[conditions.dazzled] 상태의 지속 시간을 1라운드 연장합니다.

name: Gildedsoul

description.value: Your elemental lineage manifests in the polished gleam of precious metals, such as silver and gold, or even rare and valuable skymetals like adamantine or orichalcum. This natural luster enhances your charm; you become trained in your choice of Diplomacy or Society. If you would automatically become trained in both these skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. If you're trained in Society, you also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.JtjnFsOToBLnSRO9]{Courtly Graces} skill feat.

_desc_en: Your elemental lineage manifests in the polished gleam of precious metals, such as silver and gold, or even rare and valuable skymetals like adamantine or orichalcum. This natural luster enhances your charm; you become trained in your choice of Diplomacy or Society. If you would automatically become trained in both these skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. If you're trained in Society, you also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.JtjnFsOToBLnSRO9]{Courtly Graces} skill feat.
_desc_ko: 당신의 원소 혈통은 은과 금 같은 귀금속, 혹은 아다만틴이나 오리칼쿰 같은 희귀하고 값진 스카이메탈의 광택으로 창조됩니다. 이 자연스러운 광채는 당신의 매력을 높여주며, 외교 또는 사회 중 하나를 숙련된 기술로 선택할 수 있게 합니다. (배경이나 직업 등으로 인해) 이 두 기술에 자동으로 숙련되는 경우, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다. 사회 기술에 숙련된 경우, @link[feats.courtly-graces] 클래스 피트도 획득합니다.

name: Brawling Focus

description.value: You know how to make the most of your attacks when fighting hand-to-hand. You gain access to the critical specialization effects of unarmed strikes in the brawling group and weapons in the brawling group. If you have Monastic Weaponry, you also gain the critical specialization effects of all monk weapons in which you are trained.

_desc_en: You know how to make the most of your attacks when fighting hand-to-hand. You gain access to the critical specialization effects of unarmed strikes in the brawling group and weapons in the brawling group. If you have Monastic Weaponry, you also gain the critical specialization effects of all monk weapons in which you are trained.
_desc_ko: 당신은 맨손으로 싸울 때 공격을 최대한 활용하는 법을 알고 있습니다. 난투 그룹의 비무장 공격 기술과 무기 사용 기술에 속하는 무기들의 치명타 특화 효과를 사용할 수 있습니다. 수도승 무기 사용 기술을 보유한 경우, 훈련받은 모든 몽크 무기의 치명타 특화 효과도 추가로 얻습니다.

name: Alacritous Action

description.value: Your eidolon moves more quickly. It gains a +10-foot status bonus to its Speed.

_desc_en: Your eidolon moves more quickly. It gains a +10-foot status bonus to its Speed.
_desc_ko: 당신의 에이돌론이 더 빠르게 움직입니다. 이동 속도에 +10피트 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Quick Vengeance

description.value: Indignant at any who would strike you or your allies, you get your revenge. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.vhO1f7oTD2s3Ncg9]{Intercept Attack} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}, you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} on your next turn. You can use the extra action only to Stride closer to the enemy whose attack triggered that reaction or to Strike that enemy.

_desc_en: Indignant at any who would strike you or your allies, you get your revenge. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.vhO1f7oTD2s3Ncg9]{Intercept Attack} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}, you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} on your next turn. You can use the extra action only to Stride closer to the enemy whose attack triggered that reaction or to Strike that enemy.
_desc_ko: 당신이나 동료를 강타하는 자에게 분노하여 복수합니다. @link[actions.intercept-attack]나 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{방패 막기}를 사용할 때, 다음 턴에 @link[conditions.quickened] 상태가 된다. 추가 행동은 오직 해당 반응을 유발한 적에게 다가가기 위한 이동이나 그 적을 공격하는 데만 사용할 수 있다.

name: Legendary Monster Hunter

description.value: Your knowledge of monsters is so incredible that it reveals glaring flaws in your prey. Your bonus from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.YTTJqRKH8QZl6al2]{Monster Hunter} (and the bonus from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.2yq3l8e2Vzz34yRV]{Monster Warden} if you have it) increases from +1 to +2 for you and any allies who benefit.

_desc_en: Your knowledge of monsters is so incredible that it reveals glaring flaws in your prey. Your bonus from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.YTTJqRKH8QZl6al2]{Monster Hunter} (and the bonus from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.2yq3l8e2Vzz34yRV]{Monster Warden} if you have it) increases from +1 to +2 for you and any allies who benefit.
_desc_ko: 당신의 괴물에 대한 지식은 너무나도 뛰어나서 사냥감의 치명적인 약점을 드러냅니다. @link[feats.monster-hunter]의 보너스(그리고 @link[feats.monster-warden]을 보유한 경우 해당 보너스)가 당신과 혜택을 받는 모든 아군에게 +1에서 +2로 증가합니다.

name: Azure Fins

description.value: When submerged in water or another liquid, you form small fin-like arms along your body, granting you far greater maneuverability while swimming. You gain a swim Speed equal to your land Speed. Furthermore, while swimming on the surface of a liquid, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} out of the liquid and do not fall until the end of your turn, allowing you to spend the rest of the turn above the surface.

publication.title: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm

_desc_en: When submerged in water or another liquid, you form small fin-like arms along your body, granting you far greater maneuverability while swimming. You gain a swim Speed equal to your land Speed. Furthermore, while swimming on the surface of a liquid, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} out of the liquid and do not fall until the end of your turn, allowing you to spend the rest of the turn above the surface.
_desc_ko: 물이나 다른 액체에 잠기면 몸에 작은 지느러미 모양의 팔이 생겨 수영 시 훨씬 뛰어난 기동성을 부여합니다. 수영 속도가 지상 속도와 동일해집니다. 또한 액체 표면에서 수영 중일 때, 액체 밖으로 @link[actions.leap]할 수 있으며, 자신의 턴이 끝날 때까지 떨어지지 않아 턴의 나머지 시간을 수면 위에서 보낼 수 있습니다.

name: Armored Counterattack

description.value:
Trigger You use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.vhO1f7oTD2s3Ncg9]{Intercept Attack} against a melee Strike and are adjacent to the creature that made the Strike.

With the might of your armor behind you, you hit back at a foe who would dare try to hurt your allies. After Intercepting the Attack, make your own Strike against the triggering enemy. If your Strike hits, you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.4DYFJ4TUsNkgFBDb]{Taunt} the target; this Taunt gains the visual trait.

_desc_en:
Trigger You use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.vhO1f7oTD2s3Ncg9]{Intercept Attack} against a melee Strike and are adjacent to the creature that made the Strike.

With the might of your armor behind you, you hit back at a foe who would dare try to hurt your allies. After Intercepting the Attack, make your own Strike against the triggering enemy. If your Strike hits, you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.4DYFJ4TUsNkgFBDb]{Taunt} the target; this Taunt gains the visual trait.
_desc_ko:
Trigger 근접 공격을 @link[actions.intercept-attack]으로 막고, 공격을 가한 생물과 인접해 있을 때.

갑옷의 위력을 등에 업고, 동료를 해치려 드는 적에게 반격한다. 공격을 가로챈 후, 발동한 적에게 자신의 공격을 가한다. 공격이 적중하면 대상에게 @link[actions.taunt]을 걸며, 이 도발은 시각적 효과를 부여한다.

name: Zoophonic Communication

description.value: Your studies have expanded your ability to parley and negotiate into the animal realm. You can [[/act request skill=performance]]{Request} from animals using Performance instead of Diplomacy as though you shared a language, although this gives you no special ability to understand their responses. You can also use Performance instead of Nature to [[/act command-an-animal skill=performance]]{Command an Animal}.

_desc_en: Your studies have expanded your ability to parley and negotiate into the animal realm. You can [[/act request skill=performance]]{Request} from animals using Performance instead of Diplomacy as though you shared a language, although this gives you no special ability to understand their responses. You can also use Performance instead of Nature to [[/act command-an-animal skill=performance]]{Command an Animal}.
_desc_ko: 당신의 연구는 동물계와의 교섭 및 협상 능력을 확장시켰습니다. 동물에게 요청을 할 때 외교 대신 공연 기술을 사용할 수 있으며, 마치 공통 언어를 공유하는 것처럼 행동합니다. 다만 이로 인해 그들의 응답을 특별히 이해할 수 있는 능력은 부여되지 않습니다. 또한 자연 대신 공연을 사용하여 동물을 지휘할 수 있습니다.

name: Legendary Guide

description.value:
You know the wilderness so well that you can help your party travel through it with ease.

When you are setting the path for your party through wilderness terrain, your party gains a +10-foot circumstance bonus to its Speed for the purpose of calculating the party's travel speed, your party's travel speed doesn't decrease in difficult terrain, and greater difficult terrain halves your party's travel speed instead of reducing it to a third.

This doesn't increase your party's Speed during an encounter or allow your party to ignore difficult terrain during an encounter.

_desc_en:
You know the wilderness so well that you can help your party travel through it with ease.

When you are setting the path for your party through wilderness terrain, your party gains a +10-foot circumstance bonus to its Speed for the purpose of calculating the party's travel speed, your party's travel speed doesn't decrease in difficult terrain, and greater difficult terrain halves your party's travel speed instead of reducing it to a third.

This doesn't increase your party's Speed during an encounter or allow your party to ignore difficult terrain during an encounter.
_desc_ko:
당신은 황야를 너무나 잘 알고 있어 동료들이 그곳을 쉽게 여행하도록 도울 수 있습니다.

당신의 파티가 황야 지형을 통과하는 경로를 설정할 때, 파티의 이동 속도를 계산할 목적으로 파티는 속도에 +10피트 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 또한 파티의 이동 속도는 어려운 지형에서 감소하지 않으며, 매우 어려운 지형에서는 파티의 이동 속도가 3분의 1로 감소하는 대신 절반으로 줄어듭니다.

이는 교전 중 파티의 이동 속도를 증가시키거나 교전 중 어려운 지형을 무시할 수 있게 하지 않습니다.

name: A Little Bird Told Me...

description.value:
You transform into a small bird, such as a finch or a sparrow, allowing you to eavesdrop on others and gain information you wouldn't otherwise be able to acquire. You become Tiny, gain the animal trait, and you can't make Strikes. You can Dismiss the effect to return to your normal shape, and you resume your normal shape automatically if you're reduced to 0 Hit Points.

You gain the following statistics and abilities:

AC = 20 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.

Fly speed 25 feet.

Weakness 5 to physical damage.

Low-light vision and imprecise scent 30 feet.

Acrobatics and Stealth modifiers of +10, unless your own is higher; Athletics modifier –4.

publication.title: Paizo Blog: Foolish Housekeeping and Other Articles

selfEffect.name: Effect: A Little Bird Told Me...

_desc_en:
You transform into a small bird, such as a finch or a sparrow, allowing you to eavesdrop on others and gain information you wouldn't otherwise be able to acquire. You become Tiny, gain the animal trait, and you can't make Strikes. You can Dismiss the effect to return to your normal shape, and you resume your normal shape automatically if you're reduced to 0 Hit Points.

You gain the following statistics and abilities:

AC = 20 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.

Fly speed 25 feet.

Weakness 5 to physical damage.

Low-light vision and imprecise scent 30 feet.

Acrobatics and Stealth modifiers of +10, unless your own is higher; Athletics modifier –4.
_desc_ko:
당신은 작은 새(예: 핀치나 참새)로 변신하여 타인의 대화를 엿듣고 평소에는 얻을 수 없는 정보를 획득할 수 있습니다. 당신은 초소형 크기가 되며 동물 특성을 얻고, 공격을 할 수 없습니다. 효과를 해제하면 원래 모습으로 돌아갈 수 있으며, HP가 0이 되면 자동으로 원래 모습으로 복귀한다.

다음 능력치와 능력을 얻습니다:

AC = 20 + 레벨. 착용한 갑옷의 판정 불이익과 이동 속도 감소 효과를 무시합니다.

비행 속도 25피트.

물리 피해에 대한 약점 5.

저조도 시야 및 부정확한 후각 30피트.

곡예와 은신 수정자 +10 (본인의 수정자가 더 높을 경우 제외); 운동 수정자 -4.

name: Flash of Omniscience

description.value:
Trigger You turn begins.

You briefly see the world as your deity does, recognizing the truth of those around you for a moment. You spend a Mythic Point to immediately learn the resistances, weaknesses, and immunities, including the amounts of the resistances and weaknesses and any unusual weaknesses or vulnerabilities of a single creature you can see.

_desc_en:
Trigger You turn begins.

You briefly see the world as your deity does, recognizing the truth of those around you for a moment. You spend a Mythic Point to immediately learn the resistances, weaknesses, and immunities, including the amounts of the resistances and weaknesses and any unusual weaknesses or vulnerabilities of a single creature you can see.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신의 턴이 시작됩니다.

당신은 잠시 동안 신의 시선으로 세상을 바라보며, 주변 존재들의 진실을 순간적으로 인식합니다. 신화 포인트를 소모하여 즉시, 시야에 들어오는 단일 생물의 저항력, 약점, 면역력(저항력과 약점의 수치 포함) 및 특이한 약점이나 취약점을 파악합니다.

name: Scaly Hide

description.value:
You were born with a layer of scales across your entire body that resemble those of your draconic progenitor. When you're unarmored, the scales give you a +1 item bonus to AC with a Dexterity cap of +3. The item bonus to AC increases to +2 at 5th level. The item bonus to AC from these scales is cumulative with armor potency runes on your explorer's clothing, the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aAbfKn8maGjJjk2W]{Mystic Armor} spell, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.02q8s6sSicMkhs1l]{Bands of Force}.

Special You can select this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain into or out of this feat.

_desc_en:
You were born with a layer of scales across your entire body that resemble those of your draconic progenitor. When you're unarmored, the scales give you a +1 item bonus to AC with a Dexterity cap of +3. The item bonus to AC increases to +2 at 5th level. The item bonus to AC from these scales is cumulative with armor potency runes on your explorer's clothing, the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aAbfKn8maGjJjk2W]{Mystic Armor} spell, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.02q8s6sSicMkhs1l]{Bands of Force}.

Special You can select this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain into or out of this feat.
_desc_ko:
당신은 드라코닉 선조의 비늘을 닮은 비늘로 온몸이 덮인 채 태어났습니다. 갑옷을 착용하지 않았을 때, 이 비늘은 민첩 상한선 +3까지 AC에 +1 아이템 보너스를 부여합니다. AC에 대한 아이템 보너스는 5레벨에 도달하면 +2로 증가합니다. 이 비늘로 인한 AC 아이템 보너스는 탐험가의 복장에 새겨진 갑옷 강화 룬, @link[spells.mystic-armor] 주문, 또는 @link[equipment.bands-of-force]와 중첩 적용됩니다.

특수 이 피트는 1레벨에서만 선택할 수 있으며, 재훈련으로 추가하거나 제거할 수 없습니다.

name: Pervasive Superstition

description.value: You steep yourself in superstition and practice ancient orc mental exercises for shrugging off the effects of magic. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against spells and magical effects at all times.

_desc_en: You steep yourself in superstition and practice ancient orc mental exercises for shrugging off the effects of magic. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against spells and magical effects at all times.
_desc_ko: 당신은 미신에 깊이 빠져들고, 마법의 영향을 떨쳐내기 위한 고대 오크의 정신 수련을 실천합니다. 항상 주문과 마법 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Scouring Rage

description.value:
Trigger You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Ah5g9pDwWF9b9VW9]{Rage}.

You emit a powerful surge of instinctual energy when you unleash your anger. Each enemy within 20 feet takes @Damage[(@actor.level)|options:area-damage]{damage equal to your level} (@Check[fortitude|against:barbarian|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC) of the same type as your additional damage during that Rage.

value.value: an instinct that allows you to change your additional damage from Rage to a different damage type

_desc_en:
Trigger You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Ah5g9pDwWF9b9VW9]{Rage}.

You emit a powerful surge of instinctual energy when you unleash your anger. Each enemy within 20 feet takes @Damage[(@actor.level)|options:area-damage]{damage equal to your level} (@Check[fortitude|against:barbarian|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC) of the same type as your additional damage during that Rage.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신은 @link[actions.rage] 상태가 됩니다.

분노를 터뜨릴 때 본능적인 에너지의 강력한 파동을 발산한다. 20피트 내의 각 적은 당신의 레벨에 해당하는 피해(기본 인내 당신의 직업 DC에 대한 내성 굴림)를 받으며, 이는 해당 분노 동안의 추가 피해와 동일한 속성이다.

name: Unshakable Idealism

description.value: Your faith and hope can't be shaken, and you won't flee when lives are at stake. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on saves against fear effects and emotion effects that inflict despair. When you would gain the fleeing condition, you can choose to stand your ground and be stunned for the effect's duration as well, preventing you from running and allowing you to re-enter the fight more quickly when the effect ends.

_desc_en: Your faith and hope can't be shaken, and you won't flee when lives are at stake. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on saves against fear effects and emotion effects that inflict despair. When you would gain the fleeing condition, you can choose to stand your ground and be stunned for the effect's duration as well, preventing you from running and allowing you to re-enter the fight more quickly when the effect ends.
_desc_ko: 당신의 믿음과 희망은 흔들리지 않으며, 생명이 위태로울 때 도망치지 않습니다. 공포 효과와 절망을 유발하는 감정 효과에 대한 내성에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 도주 상태가 될 때, 그 자리에서 버티기로 선택할 수 있으며 효과 지속 시간 동안 기절 상태가 됩니다. 이로 인해 도주할 수 없게 되지만, 효과 종료 후 더 빨리 전투에 재참가할 수 있습니다.

name: Black Powder Flash

description.value:
Requirements You're in Powder Punch Stance.

You ignite a pinch of black powder in a foe's face. Choose an adjacent creature. It must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class] save against your class DC.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round and dazzled for 1 minute. The creature can rub its eyes as an Interact action to end this blinded condition.

Critical Failure The creature is blinded for 1 round and dazzled for 1 hour.

publication.title: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powder Keg

_desc_en:
Requirements You're in Powder Punch Stance.

You ignite a pinch of black powder in a foe's face. Choose an adjacent creature. It must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class] save against your class DC.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round and dazzled for 1 minute. The creature can rub its eyes as an Interact action to end this blinded condition.

Critical Failure The creature is blinded for 1 round and dazzled for 1 hour.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 파우더 펀치 스탠스에 있습니다.

적의 얼굴에 소량의 흑색 화약을 점화합니다. 인접한 생물을 선택하세요. 해당 생물은 당신의 직업 DC에 대한 인내 내성을 시도해야 합니다.

대성공 생물은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 생물은 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.dazzled] 상태가 됩니다.

실패 생물은 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.blinded] 상태가 되고 1분 동안 눈부심 상태가 됩니다. 생물은 상호작용 행동으로 눈을 비비며 이 눈멈 상태를 끝낼 수 있습니다.

대실패 생물은 1라운드 동안 눈멈 상태가 되고 1시간 동안 눈부심 상태가 된다.

name: Shield of Reckoning

description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger An enemy's attack against an ally matches the trigger for both your Shield Block reaction and your champion's reaction.

When you shield your ally against an attack, you call upon your power to protect your ally further. You use the Shield Block reaction to prevent damage to an ally and also use your champion's reaction against the enemy that attacked your ally.

Special If you have an ability that gives you an additional reaction you can use to Shield Block or use your champion's reaction, you can use it for Shield of Reckoning.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per round

Trigger An enemy's attack against an ally matches the trigger for both your Shield Block reaction and your champion's reaction.

When you shield your ally against an attack, you call upon your power to protect your ally further. You use the Shield Block reaction to prevent damage to an ally and also use your champion's reaction against the enemy that attacked your ally.

Special If you have an ability that gives you an additional reaction you can use to Shield Block or use your champion's reaction, you can use it for Shield of Reckoning.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 라운드당 1회

발동 조건 아군을 겨냥한 적의 공격이 당신의 방패 막기 반응과 챔피언의 반응 모두에 대한 발동 조건에 부합합니다.

동료에게 가해진 공격을 막아줄 때, 당신은 힘을 발휘해 동료를 더욱 보호합니다. 방패 막기 반응으로 동료의 피해를 막고, 공격한 적에게 챔피언의 반응을 사용합니다.

특수 추가 반응을 부여하는 능력을 보유하고 있다면, 이를 방패 막기나 챔피언 반응 사용에 활용할 수 있으며, 심판의 방패에도 사용할 수 있다.

name: Alluring Performance

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You command the attention of those around you with an elegant display. Attempt a @Check[performance] check and compare it to the Will DC of each creature in a @Template[emanation|distance:15].

Critical Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with you for as long as you perform (unless it breaks from the fascination, as normal for the condition) and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round or as long as it's fascinated, whichever is longer.

Success The target is fascinated for 1 round and is dazzled for 1 round.

Failure The target is dazzled for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is unaffected.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You command the attention of those around you with an elegant display. Attempt a @Check[performance] check and compare it to the Will DC of each creature in a @Template[emanation|distance:15].

Critical Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with you for as long as you perform (unless it breaks from the fascination, as normal for the condition) and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round or as long as it's fascinated, whichever is longer.

Success The target is fascinated for 1 round and is dazzled for 1 round.

Failure The target is dazzled for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is unaffected.
_desc_ko:
빈도 하루에 한 번

당신은 우아한 모습으로 주변 사람들의 시선을 사로잡습니다. 공연 판정을 시도하고 그 결과를 15피트 영역 내 각 생물의 의지 DC와 비교하십시오.

Critical Success 대상은 당신이 수행하는 동안 @link[conditions.fascinated] 상태가 되며(상태 해제 규칙에 따라 매혹에서 벗어날 수 있음), @link[conditions.dazzled] 상태가 1라운드 또는 매혹 상태가 지속되는 동안 중 더 긴 시간 동안 유지됩니다.

성공 대상은 1라운드 동안 매혹 상태이며, 1라운드 동안 눈부심 상태가 됩니다.

실패 대상은 1라운드 동안 눈부심 상태가 된다.

대실패 대상은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

name: Cynical

description.value: You've been approached with suspicion and distrust throughout your life and return these sentiments back to the strangers you encounter. As a result, you are difficult to deceive. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Perception DC against Lies and Impersonations.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Absalom, City of Lost Omens

_desc_en: You've been approached with suspicion and distrust throughout your life and return these sentiments back to the strangers you encounter. As a result, you are difficult to deceive. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Perception DC against Lies and Impersonations.
_desc_ko: 평생 의심과 불신 속에 살아온 당신은 낯선 이들에게도 같은 감정을 되돌려줍니다. 그 결과, 당신은 속이기 어렵습니다. 거짓말과 사칭에 대한 지각 DC에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Blood Ascendancy

description.value: When you would benefit from a blood magic effect through Blood Rising, you can choose to benefit from two different blood magic effects you know. The effects follow the same rules as given in Blood Rising, and each effect can have a different target.

_desc_en: When you would benefit from a blood magic effect through Blood Rising, you can choose to benefit from two different blood magic effects you know. The effects follow the same rules as given in Blood Rising, and each effect can have a different target.
_desc_ko: 혈기 상승을 통해 혈통 마법 효과를 얻을 때, 자신이 아는 서로 다른 두 가지 혈통 마법 효과를 선택하여 얻을 수 있다. 효과는 혈기 상승에 명시된 규칙을 따르며, 각 효과는 서로 다른 대상을 가질 수 있다.

name: Purifying Spell

description.value: You purify the water within a creature's body to cleanse them of illness. If the next action you use is to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} targeting a single living creature, you can attempt to counteract a disease or poison affecting the target, in addition to the other benefits of heal. If you do, heal gains the water trait.

_desc_en: You purify the water within a creature's body to cleanse them of illness. If the next action you use is to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} targeting a single living creature, you can attempt to counteract a disease or poison affecting the target, in addition to the other benefits of heal. If you do, heal gains the water trait.
_desc_ko: 생물의 체내 수분을 정화하여 질병을 치료합니다. 다음 행동으로 @link[spells.heal]를 단일 생명체를 대상으로 시전할 경우, 치유의 다른 효과에 더해 대상에게 영향을 미치는 질병이나 독을 반격할 시도할 수 있습니다. 그렇게 할 경우, 치유는 물 속성을 얻습니다.

name: Seize

description.value:
Requirements Your last action was a successful fist Strike against a creature no more than one size larger than you.

You seize your foe and pull it close. The foe you hit is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} as if you succeeded at an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} the foe.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your last action was a successful fist Strike against a creature no more than one size larger than you.

You seize your foe and pull it close. The foe you hit is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} as if you succeeded at an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} the foe.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 마지막 행동이 자신보다 한 크기 이상 크지 않은 생물에게 성공적인 주먹 공격을 가한 것이어야 합니다.

당신은 적을 붙잡아 가까이 끌어당깁니다. 당신이 공격한 적은 @link[conditions.grabbed] 상태가 되며, 마치 당신이 적을 @link[actions.grapple]하기 위한 운동 판정에서 성공한 것과 같습니다.

name: Wild-Haired Fury

description.value: Your broken bones jut at odd angles, yet this pain only adds to your anger and prowess. You add the combined value of your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} conditions as a circumstance bonus to damage rolls with your melee attacks (for example, if you were doomed 1 and wounded 2, you would gain a +3 circumstance bonus to your melee damage rolls).

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your broken bones jut at odd angles, yet this pain only adds to your anger and prowess. You add the combined value of your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} conditions as a circumstance bonus to damage rolls with your melee attacks (for example, if you were doomed 1 and wounded 2, you would gain a +3 circumstance bonus to your melee damage rolls).
_desc_ko: 부러진 뼈가 기이한 각도로 튀어나와 있지만, 이 고통은 오히려 분노와 위력을 더할 뿐이다. 근접 공격 시 피해 굴림에 @link[conditions.doomed]과 @link[conditions.wounded] 상태의 합산 값을 상황 보너스로 적용한다(예: 파멸 1, 부상 2 상태라면 근접 피해 굴림에 +3 상황 보너스).

name: Giant's Stature

description.value:
Requirements You are Medium or smaller.

You grow to incredible size. You become Large, increasing your reach by 5 feet and gaining the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} condition until you stop raging. Your equipment grows with you.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are Medium or smaller.

You grow to incredible size. You become Large, increasing your reach by 5 feet and gaining the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} condition until you stop raging. Your equipment grows with you.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 중간 크기 이하이다.

당신은 믿기 힘든 크기로 성장합니다. 대형이 되어 도달 거리가 5피트 증가하며, 분노를 멈출 때까지 @link[conditions.clumsy]{1} 상태를 얻습니다. 장비도 함께 커집니다.

name: Rat Familiar

description.value: You have a pet rat that has become magically bonded to you. You gain a familiar, and this familiar must be a rat. It still gets the benefits of familiar abilities, but its base form remains a rat.

_desc_en: You have a pet rat that has become magically bonded to you. You gain a familiar, and this familiar must be a rat. It still gets the benefits of familiar abilities, but its base form remains a rat.
_desc_ko: 당신은 마법적으로 당신과 유대감을 형성한 애완 쥐를 가지고 있습니다. 당신은 패밀리어를 얻으며, 이 패밀리어는 반드시 쥐여야 합니다. 패밀리어 능력의 혜택을 여전히 받지만, 기본 형태는 쥐로 남습니다.

name: Motionless Cutter

description.value:
Usage imbued into a melee weapon ikon that deals slashing damage

Your weapon is so sharp even an insect alighting upon its still blade would be severed. Your weapon ikon gains the following ability.

Transcendence—@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XFdTDDAPO7U0r4Et]{Sever Four Dragonfly Wings} 3 (transcendence)

@Embed[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XFdTDDAPO7U0r4Et inline]

_desc_en:
Usage imbued into a melee weapon ikon that deals slashing damage

Your weapon is so sharp even an insect alighting upon its still blade would be severed. Your weapon ikon gains the following ability.

Transcendence—@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XFdTDDAPO7U0r4Et]{Sever Four Dragonfly Wings} 3 (transcendence)

@Embed[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XFdTDDAPO7U0r4Et inline]
_desc_ko:
사용법 베기 피해를 주는 근접 무기 이콘에 부여됨

무기가 너무 날카로워 정지된 칼날에 앉은 곤충조차 잘려 나간다. 무기 이콘이 다음 능력을 얻는다.

초월-@link[actions.sever-four-dragonfly-wings] 3 (초월)

@link[actions.sever-four-dragonfly-wings]

name: Pack of the Beast Lord

description.value: You and your united companion call upon the service of others of its kind, creating figment duplicates of your companion to form a massive swarm of formidable power. Spend a Mythic Point. Your united companion becomes Gargantuan for 1 minute. It gains immunity to precision damage, resistance to physical damage equal to half your level, and a weakness to area damage equal to half your level. While in this form, your united companion gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ZJ8KJp5mZYgzPJYN]{Amassed Assault} action, which you immediately Command them to use as the final step of this activation.

_desc_en: You and your united companion call upon the service of others of its kind, creating figment duplicates of your companion to form a massive swarm of formidable power. Spend a Mythic Point. Your united companion becomes Gargantuan for 1 minute. It gains immunity to precision damage, resistance to physical damage equal to half your level, and a weakness to area damage equal to half your level. While in this form, your united companion gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ZJ8KJp5mZYgzPJYN]{Amassed Assault} action, which you immediately Command them to use as the final step of this activation.
_desc_ko: 당신과 당신의 통합된 동료는 동류의 존재들을 소환하여 동료의 환영 복제체를 생성하고, 이를 통해 막강한 힘을 지닌 거대한 군집을 형성합니다. 신화 포인트 1점을 소모합니다. 당신의 통합된 동반자는 1분 동안 거대화됩니다. 정밀 피해에 대한 면역, 당신의 레벨 절반에 해당하는 물리 피해 저항, 그리고 당신의 레벨 절반에 해당하는 범위 피해 약점을 얻습니다. 이 형태 동안, 당신의 통합된 동반자는 @link[actions.amassed-assault] 액션을 얻으며, 당신은 이 활성화의 마지막 단계로 즉시 그들에게 이 액션을 사용하도록 커맨더합니다.

name: Fire Savvy

description.value:
Access You are from Dongun Hold or Alkenstar.

You've grown up around a forge and are well-suited to dealing with smoke and flame. Your flat check to remove persistent fire damage is DC 10 instead of DC 15, which is reduced to DC 5 with appropriate assistance. In addition, if you roll a success on a saving throw against suffocation or choking due to smoke or ash, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en:
Access You are from Dongun Hold or Alkenstar.

You've grown up around a forge and are well-suited to dealing with smoke and flame. Your flat check to remove persistent fire damage is DC 10 instead of DC 15, which is reduced to DC 5 with appropriate assistance. In addition, if you roll a success on a saving throw against suffocation or choking due to smoke or ash, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko:
접근 당신은 동군 홀드나 알켄스터 출신입니다.

대장간에서 자라난 당신은 연기와 불꽃을 다루는 데 능숙합니다. 지속적인 화상 피해를 제거하기 위한 단순 판정 난이도는 15 대신 10이며, 적절한 도움을 받을 경우 5로 감소합니다. 또한 연기나 재로 인한 질식 또는 목이 막히는 상황에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴릴 경우, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Assurance

description.value:
Even in the worst circumstances, you can perform basic tasks. Choose a skill you're trained in. You can forgo rolling a skill check for that skill to instead receive a result of 10 + your proficiency bonus (do not apply any other bonuses, penalties, or modifiers).

Special You can select this feat multiple times. Each time, choose a different skill and gain the benefits for that skill.

value.value: trained in at least one skill

_desc_en:
Even in the worst circumstances, you can perform basic tasks. Choose a skill you're trained in. You can forgo rolling a skill check for that skill to instead receive a result of 10 + your proficiency bonus (do not apply any other bonuses, penalties, or modifiers).

Special You can select this feat multiple times. Each time, choose a different skill and gain the benefits for that skill.
_desc_ko:
최악의 상황에서도 기본적인 작업은 수행할 수 있습니다. 훈련받은 기술 하나를 선택하세요. 해당 기술에 대한 기술 판정 주사위를 굴리지 않고 대신 숙련 보너스 +10의 결과를 받습니다(다른 보너스, 페널티, 수정자는 적용하지 않습니다).

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 매번 다른 기술을 선택하여 해당 기술에 대한 혜택을 얻습니다.

name: Disengaging Twist

description.value:
Trigger A creature gives you the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} condition.

Your ability to twist your opponents' bodies into painful locks and holds makes you particularly adept at escaping such predicaments. Attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} the triggering condition. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this check.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature gives you the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} condition.

Your ability to twist your opponents' bodies into painful locks and holds makes you particularly adept at escaping such predicaments. Attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} the triggering condition. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this check.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 생물이 당신에게 @link[conditions.grabbed] 또는 @link[conditions.restrained] 상태를 부여합니다.

상대의 몸을 고통스러운 잠금과 제압으로 비틀어 버리는 당신의 능력은 이러한 곤경에서 벗어나는 데 특히 능숙하게 만듭니다. 운동 판정을 시도하여 @link[actions.escape]을 시도하세요. 이 판정에는 +2 상황 보너스가 적용됩니다.

name: Eagle Eye

description.value: Your practice with crossbows and firearms has sharpened your attention to detail. You become a master in Perception.

_desc_en: Your practice with crossbows and firearms has sharpened your attention to detail. You become a master in Perception.
_desc_ko: 석궁과 화기 사용 훈련으로 세부 사항에 대한 주의력이 날카로워졌습니다. 지각 능력에 있어 달인이 됩니다.

name: Peerless Warden

description.value:
Your mastery of primal magic has given you access to the greatest secrets of warden magic. You gain your choice of one warden spell from the peerless warden spells.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tj86Rnq3QuQnDtG3]{Hunter's Vision}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rtA3HRGoy7PQTOhq]{Terrain Transposition}

Special You can take this feat multiple times, choosing a different peerless warden spell each time.

_desc_en:
Your mastery of primal magic has given you access to the greatest secrets of warden magic. You gain your choice of one warden spell from the peerless warden spells.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tj86Rnq3QuQnDtG3]{Hunter's Vision}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rtA3HRGoy7PQTOhq]{Terrain Transposition}

Special You can take this feat multiple times, choosing a different peerless warden spell each time.
_desc_ko:
프라이멀 마법에 대한 숙련으로 수호자 마법의 가장 위대한 비밀에 접근할 수 있게 되었다. 무적의 수호자 주문 중 하나를 선택하여 습득한다.

@link[spells.hunters-vision]

@link[spells.terrain-transposition]

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있으며, 매번 다른 비할 데 없는 수호자 주문을 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Virtuosic Dancer

description.value: You're so fond of using your Acrobatic feats on the stage that you've begun adding your own flair to these dances on the big stage. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EEDElIyin4z60PXx]{Perform}, if you do a performance that is either related to dance, acting or opera, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the roll. If you're legendary in Acrobatics, this increases to a +2 circumstance bonus. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1ejGup6ouh9t9S96]{Dancing Dodge} reaction.

_desc_en: You're so fond of using your Acrobatic feats on the stage that you've begun adding your own flair to these dances on the big stage. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EEDElIyin4z60PXx]{Perform}, if you do a performance that is either related to dance, acting or opera, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the roll. If you're legendary in Acrobatics, this increases to a +2 circumstance bonus. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1ejGup6ouh9t9S96]{Dancing Dodge} reaction.
_desc_ko: 무대에서 곡예 피트를 사용하는 것을 너무 좋아해서, 이제는 큰 무대에서 춤에 자신만의 개성을 더하기 시작했습니다. 당신이 @link[actions.perform]할 때, 무용, 연기 또는 오페라와 관련된 공연을 하면 해당 주사위 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 곡예에 전설적인 실력을 지녔다면 이 보너스는 +2 상황 보너스로 증가합니다. 당신은 @link[actions.dancing-dodge] 반응을 얻습니다.

name: Synergistic Spell

description.value: You combine your synergy and spells into a fantastic web of magic, allowing you to cast two spells at once. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell from one of your halcyon spell slots, after that spell resolves, you can Cast another Spell as a free action. This spell must be cast from one of your halcyon spell slots and be a spell that would normally take two actions to cast.

_desc_en: You combine your synergy and spells into a fantastic web of magic, allowing you to cast two spells at once. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell from one of your halcyon spell slots, after that spell resolves, you can Cast another Spell as a free action. This spell must be cast from one of your halcyon spell slots and be a spell that would normally take two actions to cast.
_desc_ko: 당신은 시너지와 주문을 환상적인 마법의 거미줄로 결합하여 두 개의 주문을 동시에 시전할 수 있습니다. 다음 행동으로 평온한 주문 슬롯 중 하나에서 주문을 시전할 경우, 해당 주문이 해결된 후 무료 행동으로 다른 주문을 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 주문은 반드시 평온한 주문 슬롯 중 하나에서 시전해야 하며, 일반적으로 두 번의 행동이 필요한 주문이어야 합니다.

name: Split Slot

description.value: You can prepare two spells in one slot, giving you the freedom to choose the spell when you cast it. When you prepare your spells for the day, you can choose one spell slot at least 1 rank lower than the highest-rank spell you can cast and prepare two spells in that slot. When you Cast a Spell from that slot, choose which spell to cast. Once you've chosen, the unused spell dissipates as though you hadn't prepared it at all—for example, it isn't available for use with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.v82XtjAVN4ffgVVR]{Drain Bonded Item}.

_desc_en: You can prepare two spells in one slot, giving you the freedom to choose the spell when you cast it. When you prepare your spells for the day, you can choose one spell slot at least 1 rank lower than the highest-rank spell you can cast and prepare two spells in that slot. When you Cast a Spell from that slot, choose which spell to cast. Once you've chosen, the unused spell dissipates as though you hadn't prepared it at all—for example, it isn't available for use with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.v82XtjAVN4ffgVVR]{Drain Bonded Item}.
_desc_ko: 한 슬롯에 두 개의 주문을 준비할 수 있어, 시전 시 주문을 선택할 자유를 부여합니다. 하루 주문을 준비할 때, 시전 가능한 최고 랭크 주문보다 최소 1랭크 낮은 주문 슬롯 하나를 선택하여 그 슬롯에 두 개의 주문을 준비할 수 있습니다. 해당 슬롯에서 주문을 시전할 때, 시전할 주문을 선택합니다. 선택한 후에는 사용하지 않은 주문은 마치 준비하지 않은 것처럼 소멸됩니다-예를 들어, @link[actions.drain-bonded-item]와 같은 능력으로 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Natural Medicine

description.value:
You can apply natural cures to heal your allies. You can use Nature instead of Medicine to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}, including higher Nature proficiency letting you attempt more difficult checks. It doesn't replace Medicine for uses of the skill other than Treat Wounds or for feat prerequisites.

If you're in the wilderness, you might have easier access to fresh ingredients, allowing you to gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your check to Treat Wounds using Nature, subject to the GM's determination.

_desc_en:
You can apply natural cures to heal your allies. You can use Nature instead of Medicine to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}, including higher Nature proficiency letting you attempt more difficult checks. It doesn't replace Medicine for uses of the skill other than Treat Wounds or for feat prerequisites.

If you're in the wilderness, you might have easier access to fresh ingredients, allowing you to gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your check to Treat Wounds using Nature, subject to the GM's determination.
_desc_ko:
동료들을 치유하기 위해 자연 치유법을 적용할 수 있습니다. @link[actions.treat-wounds]를 수행할 때 의학 대신 자연을 사용할 수 있으며, 높은 자연 숙련도는 더 어려운 판정을 시도할 수 있게 합니다. 이는 상처 치료 외의 기술 사용이나 피트 전제 조건에 대해서는 의학을 대체하지 않습니다.

야생에 있을 경우 신선한 재료를 더 쉽게 구할 수 있어, GM의 판단에 따라 자연을 사용한 상처 치료 판정 시 +2 상황 보너스를 얻을 수 있습니다.

name: Smoke Curtain

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a loaded firearm and are wearing or holding a dose of black powder.

You load an extra dose of powder into your shot, causing it to belch a cloud of smoke. You make a Strike with your firearm and create a cloud of smoke in a @Template[emanation|distance:20] centered on your location. Creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while within the smoke, and creatures outside the area are concealed to creatures within the smoke. The smoke dissipates at the start of your next turn. If your Strike is a critical failure, your firearm misfires.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a loaded firearm and are wearing or holding a dose of black powder.

You load an extra dose of powder into your shot, causing it to belch a cloud of smoke. You make a Strike with your firearm and create a cloud of smoke in a @Template[emanation|distance:20] centered on your location. Creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while within the smoke, and creatures outside the area are concealed to creatures within the smoke. The smoke dissipates at the start of your next turn. If your Strike is a critical failure, your firearm misfires.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 장전된 화기를 휘두르고 있으며, 흑색 화약 한 덩어리를 착용하거나 소지하고 있어야 합니다.

총알에 추가 화약을 장전하여 연기를 뿜어냅니다. 화기로 공격을 가해 현재 위치 중심으로 20피트 크기의 연기 구름을 생성합니다. 연기 안의 생물은 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태가 되며, 연기 영역 밖의 생물은 연기 안의 생물에게 {가려진} 상태로 보입니다. 연기는 다음 턴 시작 시 사라집니다. 공격이 대실패일 경우, 화기가 오발합니다.

name: Twirling Throw

description.value: Your thrown weapons seem to defy physics as they soar through the air and spin back to you after a strike. Make a thrown weapon strike, ignoring the penalty for making ranged attacks within the second and third range increment. The weapon returns to your hand after the attack unless you critically failed on the attack roll.

_desc_en: Your thrown weapons seem to defy physics as they soar through the air and spin back to you after a strike. Make a thrown weapon strike, ignoring the penalty for making ranged attacks within the second and third range increment. The weapon returns to your hand after the attack unless you critically failed on the attack roll.
_desc_ko: 당신의 투척 무기는 공중을 가르고 날아가 타격 후 회전하며 당신에게 되돌아오는 모습으로 물리 법칙을 무시하는 듯합니다. 투척 무기 공격을 수행할 때, 두 번째 및 세 번째 사거리 구간 내 원거리 공격 시 적용되는 페널티를 무시합니다. 명중 굴림에서 대실패를 하지 않는 한, 무기는 공격 후 당신의 손으로 돌아옵니다.

name: Divine Evolution

description.value: The divine might provided by your bloodline flows through you. You gain an additional spell slot of your highest level, which you can use only to cast your choice of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm}. You can cast either of these spells using that spell slot, even if they aren't in your spell repertoire.

_desc_en: The divine might provided by your bloodline flows through you. You gain an additional spell slot of your highest level, which you can use only to cast your choice of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm}. You can cast either of these spells using that spell slot, even if they aren't in your spell repertoire.
_desc_ko: 당신의 혈통이 제공하는 신성한 힘이 당신을 통해 흐릅니다. 가장 높은 레벨의 주문 슬롯 하나를 추가로 얻으며, 이 슬롯은 @link[spells.heal] 또는 @link[spells.harm] 중 하나를 시전하는 데만 사용할 수 있다. 해당 주문 슬롯을 사용해 이 주문들 중 하나를 시전할 수 있으며, 이 주문들이 당신의 주문 목록에 없더라도 가능하다.

name: Student of Water

description.value: Following your studies of water, your qi stirs the water of the natural world. If you're underwater, you have cover against creatures outside of the water. As soon as you meet the prerequisites for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.iOY6YfGBaOvMNAor]{Underwater Marauder} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.MTO0spetPKyIa4sT]{Water Sprint}, you gain those feats.

_desc_en: Following your studies of water, your qi stirs the water of the natural world. If you're underwater, you have cover against creatures outside of the water. As soon as you meet the prerequisites for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.iOY6YfGBaOvMNAor]{Underwater Marauder} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.MTO0spetPKyIa4sT]{Water Sprint}, you gain those feats.
_desc_ko: 물의 연구를 통해 당신의 기는 자연계의 물을 움직입니다. 물속에 있을 때, 물 밖에 있는 생물들로부터 은폐 효과를 얻습니다. @link[feats.underwater-marauder]와 @link[feats.water-sprint]의 전제 조건을 충족하는 즉시, 해당 피트들을 획득합니다.

name: Spirit Guide Form

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You fuse with your spirit guide, becoming a hybrid being with enhanced physical and spiritual power. This effect lasts 1 minute; you can end it early as a free action. During this time, you can't use any other actions granted by this archetype.

You gain the following statistics and abilities, regardless of your type of spirit guide.

  • You become incorporeal.
  • You gain resistance 10 to all damage (except force, ghost touch, or spirit; double resistance vs. non-magical).
  • Darkvision.

  • An unarmed melee attack of the same type as your spirit guide (either claws or jaws), which is the only attack you can Strike with. You're trained with this attack. Your attack modifier is +29 or your normal unarmed attack modifier, whichever is higher. You use the listed statistics for the unarmed attack type:

    • Claws (agile, backstabber, finesse) 1, Damage 3d6+5 slashing plus 1d6 force;
    • Jaws (forceful) 1 Damage 3d10+5 piercing plus 1d6 force.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You fuse with your spirit guide, becoming a hybrid being with enhanced physical and spiritual power. This effect lasts 1 minute; you can end it early as a free action. During this time, you can't use any other actions granted by this archetype.

You gain the following statistics and abilities, regardless of your type of spirit guide.

  • You become incorporeal.
  • You gain resistance 10 to all damage (except force, ghost touch, or spirit; double resistance vs. non-magical).
  • Darkvision.

  • An unarmed melee attack of the same type as your spirit guide (either claws or jaws), which is the only attack you can Strike with. You're trained with this attack. Your attack modifier is +29 or your normal unarmed attack modifier, whichever is higher. You use the listed statistics for the unarmed attack type:

    • Claws (agile, backstabber, finesse) 1, Damage 3d6+5 slashing plus 1d6 force;
    • Jaws (forceful) 1 Damage 3d10+5 piercing plus 1d6 force.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신은 영적 안내자와 융합하여 신체적·영혼 힘이 강화된 혼합체로 변합니다. 이 효과는 1분간 지속되며, 자유 행동으로 조기 종료할 수 있습니다. 이 시간 동안 본 아키타입이 부여하는 다른 행동은 사용할 수 없습니다.

당신은 영혼 안내자의 유형에 관계없이 다음과 같은 능력치와 능력을 얻습니다.

  • 당신은 비물질화됩니다.
  • 모든 피해에 대해 저항력 10을 얻습니다(힘, 고스트 터치, 영혼 피해 제외; 비마법 피해에 대해서는 저항력이 두 배로 적용됩니다).
  • 암흑 시야.

  • 당신의 영혼 안내자와 동일한 유형(발톱 또는 이빨)의 비무장 근접 공격을 가할 수 있으며, 이는 당신이 강타할 수 있는 유일한 공격 방식이다. 이 공격에 숙련되어 있다. 공격 수정자는 +29 또는 일반 비무장 공격 수정자 중 더 높은 값을 적용한다. 비무장 공격 유형에 명시된 통계를 사용한다:

    • 발톱 (기민한, 뒤에서 공격, 기교) 1, 피해 3d6+5 베기 + 1d6 힘;
    • 이빨 (기세) 1 피해 3d10+5 관통 + 1d6 충격.

name: Emotional Push

description.value:
Trigger An enemy you're aware of fails its save against an emotion spell.

You prepare to take advantage of your enemy's sudden change in emotions. The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against your next attack before the end of your next turn.

_desc_en:
Trigger An enemy you're aware of fails its save against an emotion spell.

You prepare to take advantage of your enemy's sudden change in emotions. The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against your next attack before the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신이 인지한 적이 감정 마법에 대한 내성에 실패합니다.

당신은 적의 갑작스러운 감정 변화를 이용하려 준비한다. 대상은 다음 턴 종료 전까지 당신의 다음 공격에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard]가 된다.

name: Be Right Back

description.value:
Cost the Price of the chosen item

Frequency once per day

You can manipulate time to produce an item in a seemingly impossible fashion. You flicker a few times as you make adjustments to your gear, then solidify again with a specific needed item that you purchased from an alternate timeline using coin you have on your person. This allows you to purchase a single common item with a level no higher than your level and its Bulk must be low enough that carrying it wouldn't have made you encumbered. You must spend the standard amount to purchase the item, and this money must be carried on your person. You can be wearing or holding the item, as long as you have the required number of hands free, and if the item has the invested trait, you have already Invested in it, provided you haven't reached your limit of invested items.

publication.title: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

_desc_ko:
비용 선택한 아이템의 가격

빈도 하루 1회

당신은 시간을 조작하여 겉보기에 불가능한 방식으로 아이템을 만들어낼 수 있습니다. 당신은 장비를 조정하면서 몇 차례 깜박이다가, 몸에 지닌 돈을 사용해 대체 시간선에서 구매한 특정 필요 아이템과 함께 다시 실체화됩니다. 이를 통해 당신은 당신 레벨보다 높지 않은 레벨의 일반 아이템 하나를 구매할 수 있으며, 그 부피는 그것을 지녀도 과적이 되지 않을 만큼 충분히 낮아야 합니다. 당신은 아이템을 구매하기 위해 표준 금액을 지불해야 하며, 이 돈은 반드시 몸에 지니고 있어야 합니다. 필요한 수의 손이 비어 있는 한 당신은 그 아이템을 착용하거나 들고 있을 수 있으며, 아이템이 투자 특성을 가진 경우 당신이 투자한 아이템 한도에 도달하지 않았다면 당신은 이미 그것에 투자한 상태입니다.

name: Blade of the Crimson Oath

description.value: You call upon the Crimson Oath to smite undead and then make a weapon or unarmed Strike against an undead foe. The Strike deals two extra weapon damage dice, and you can convert all the physical damage from the attack into vitality damage.

_desc_en: You call upon the Crimson Oath to smite undead and then make a weapon or unarmed Strike against an undead foe. The Strike deals two extra weapon damage dice, and you can convert all the physical damage from the attack into vitality damage.
_desc_ko: 당신은 진홍의 맹세를 불러 언데드를 치고, 언데드 적에게 무기 또는 비무장 공격을 가합니다. 이 공격은 무기 피해 주사위 2개를 추가로 입히며, 공격의 모든 물리 피해를 활력 피해로 전환할 수 있습니다.

name: Munitions Master Dedication

description.value:
You have drilled enough with your light mortar to operate it with unrivaled efficiency. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.qYdreGwopQ1ODgC6]{Engineer's Efficiency} action.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.gZVjoq3A0Ny1dKvI]{Munitions Master (Class Archetype)}

_desc_en:
You have drilled enough with your light mortar to operate it with unrivaled efficiency. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.qYdreGwopQ1ODgC6]{Engineer's Efficiency} action.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.gZVjoq3A0Ny1dKvI]{Munitions Master (Class Archetype)}
_desc_ko: 경박격포를 충분히 숙달하여 타의 추종을 불허하는 효율로 운용할 수 있습니다. @link[actions.engineers-efficiency] 행동을 획득합니다.

name: Strange Script

description.value: You have such familiarity with obscure texts that you can compel them to reveal their secrets. Once per day, you can touch a single text (such as a tome, a wall of hieroglyphics, or something similar) and understand its meaning for 1 hour. If the text is in multiple languages, you gain the ability to understand them all for only the purposes of reading the text. If the text is in a code or cypher, you don't automatically understand the text, but you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to decipher it.

_desc_en: You have such familiarity with obscure texts that you can compel them to reveal their secrets. Once per day, you can touch a single text (such as a tome, a wall of hieroglyphics, or something similar) and understand its meaning for 1 hour. If the text is in multiple languages, you gain the ability to understand them all for only the purposes of reading the text. If the text is in a code or cypher, you don't automatically understand the text, but you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to decipher it.
_desc_ko: 당신은 난해한 문헌에 대한 깊은 패밀리어를 바탕으로 그 비밀을 밝혀낼 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, 단일 문헌(예: 서적, 상형문자 벽 등)을 만지면 1시간 동안 그 의미를 이해할 수 있습니다. 문헌이 여러 언어로 기록된 경우, 해당 문헌을 읽는 목적에 한해 모든 언어를 이해할 수 있는 능력을 얻습니다. 암호나 암호문으로 기록된 경우, 자동으로 내용을 이해하지는 않지만 해독 판정 시 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Long-Nosed Form

description.value:
You transform into a specific, curious-looking human form. This human form is the same age and body type as your tengu form and has roughly analogous physical traits, such as height, though your nose remains as long as your beak and your complexion has red undertones, no matter the skin color of your human form. Using Long-Nosed Form counts as creating a disguise for the Impersonate use of Deception. Due to your imperfect transformation, your transformation doesn't automatically defeat Perception DCs to determine whether you are human, though you may be able to explain away or hide your tengu traits.

You lose your beak unarmed Strike in your human form, as well as any other unarmed Strikes you gained from a tengu heritage or ancestry feat. You remain in your human form indefinitely, until you Dismiss this effect.

_desc_en:
You transform into a specific, curious-looking human form. This human form is the same age and body type as your tengu form and has roughly analogous physical traits, such as height, though your nose remains as long as your beak and your complexion has red undertones, no matter the skin color of your human form. Using Long-Nosed Form counts as creating a disguise for the Impersonate use of Deception. Due to your imperfect transformation, your transformation doesn't automatically defeat Perception DCs to determine whether you are human, though you may be able to explain away or hide your tengu traits.

You lose your beak unarmed Strike in your human form, as well as any other unarmed Strikes you gained from a tengu heritage or ancestry feat. You remain in your human form indefinitely, until you Dismiss this effect.
_desc_ko:
특이한 모습의 인간 형태로 변신합니다. 이 인간 형태는 텐구 형태와 동일한 연령과 체형을 가지며 키 등 신체적 특징도 대체로 유사합니다. 다만 코는 부리처럼 길게 유지되며, 인간 형태의 피부색과 무관하게 붉은 기운이 감도는 피부톤을 가집니다. 긴코 형태 사용은 기만 능력의 변장 사용에 해당한다. 불완전한 변신으로 인해 인간인지 판단하는 지각 DC를 자동으로 무효화하지는 않으나, 텐구 특성을 설명하거나 숨길 수는 있다.

인간 형태에서는 부리 무장 공격을 사용할 수 없으며, 텐구 혈통이나 조상 피트로 얻은 다른 비무장 공격도 사용할 수 없습니다. 이 효과를 해제할 때까지 인간 형태가 무기한 유지됩니다.

name: Predator's Growl

description.value:
Trigger You successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} creature.

You give a throaty growl to attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a creature you just found. You don't take the -4 penalty for not sharing a language with the creature.

_desc_en:
Trigger You successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} creature.

You give a throaty growl to attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a creature you just found. You don't take the -4 penalty for not sharing a language with the creature.
_desc_ko:
Trigger 당신은 @link[actions.seek] 또는 @link[conditions.undetected] 생물을 @link[conditions.hidden] 데 성공합니다.

당신은 방금 발견한 생물을 @link[actions.demoralize]하려고 시도하는 목구멍 깊은 곳으로부터 울리는 소리를 냅니다. 생물과 언어를 공유하지 않아 발생하는 -4 페널티를 받지 않습니다.

name: Voice Cold as Death

description.value:
Requirements You are not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.

Channeling the energy of the Crimson Oath into your voice, you pronounce a threat in a tone so icy it freezes the blood. Attempt an Intimidation check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}; you don't suffer a penalty if the target doesn't understand the language you're speaking, but this otherwise functions as normal. You can't use Intimidating Glare or any other effect that would cause your Demoralize attempt to lose the auditory trait as part of using this feat. If you critically succeed at your Intimidation check, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2} if the target is undead. After using this feat, you are fatigued until the end of your next turn, and you can't use this feat again until the end of your next turn.

_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 @link[conditions.fatigued]가 아니어야 합니다.

진홍의 맹세의 에너지를 목소리에 실어, 피를 얼어붙게 할 만큼 차가운 어조로 위협을 내뱉습니다. @link[actions.demoralize]를 위해 협박 판정을 시도하세요. 대상이 당신의 언어를 이해하지 못해도 페널티를 받지 않지만, 그 외에는 정상적으로 작동합니다. 위협적인 눈빛이나 사기 저하 시도할 때 청각적 특성을 상실시키는 다른 효과를 이 피트 사용과 병행할 수 없다. 위협 수치에 대성공을 거두면 대상은 @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태가 되며, 대상이 언데드일 경우 @link[conditions.stunned]{2} 상태가 된다. 이 피트를 사용한 후, 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 피로 상태가 되며, 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 이 피트를 다시 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Pandemonium Eruption

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You unleash the pent-up chaos within you, becoming a nexus of unbridled destruction that wreaks unfettered havoc on everyone in your vicinity. Each creature within @Template[emanation|distance:15]{15 feet} of you takes 14d6 @Damage[14d6[acid]|options:area-damage]{acid}, @Damage[14d6[electricity]|options:area-damage]{electricity}, or @Damage[14d6[sonic]|options:area-damage]{sonic} damage, chosen randomly for each target. Each target receives a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC, but any creature that is subjected to the type of damage for which you currently have resistance through your Proteankin lineage takes a –2 penalty to the save. Any target that critically fails the save is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} until the end of their next turn.

_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신은 내면에 쌓인 혼돈을 분출하여, 주변의 모든 이에게 제멋대로의 파괴를 퍼붓는 무제한 파괴의 중심이 됩니다. 당신으로부터 15피트 이내의 모든 생물은 14d6 산성, 전기 또는 음파 피해를 무작위로 선택하여 받는다. 각 대상은 당신의 직업 난이도(DC) 또는 주문 난이도(DC) 중 높은 쪽에 대해 기본 반사 내성을 받지만, 당신의 프로테안킨 혈통으로 인해 현재 저항력을 가진 피해 유형을 받는 모든 생물은 내성 굴림에서 -2 페널티를 받습니다. 내성 굴림에서 대실패를 한 대상은 또한 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.confused] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Zealous Rush

description.value:
Trigger You cast a divine spell that takes 1 action or more to cast and that affects only you or your equipment.

You bless yourself on the move. Stride up to 10 feet. If the spell took 2 or more actions, you can Stride up to your full Speed instead.

_desc_en:
Trigger You cast a divine spell that takes 1 action or more to cast and that affects only you or your equipment.

You bless yourself on the move. Stride up to 10 feet. If the spell took 2 or more actions, you can Stride up to your full Speed instead.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신이 1회 이상의 행동이 소요되는 신성 주문을 시전하며, 그 주문이 오직 당신이나 당신의 장비에만 영향을 미칠 때.

이동 중 자신을 축복한다. 최대 10피트까지 스트라이드한다. 주문 시전 시간이 2회 이상의 행동이 소요된 경우, 대신 자신의 전체 이동 속도만큼 스트라이드할 수 있다.

name: Dragon's Journey

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding two fans, one in each hand.

Your movements are like that of a dragon weaving a serpentine path between your enemies and allies. Using your fans, you slice the air and create a path of least resistance, allowing you to move across the battlefield with an ethereal grace. You Stride, your movement doesn't trigger enemy reactions, and any allies you pass within 5 feet of can immediately use their reaction to Stride, moving in the same direction. Allies must end their movement as close as possible to you or another ally who benefited from this ability. During Dragon's Journey, ally movement doesn't trigger reactions.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손에 각각 부채 하나씩을 휘두르고 있다.

당신의 움직임은 용이 적과 아군 사이를 뱀처럼 휘감으며 지나가는 듯합니다. 부채를 휘둘러 공기를 가르고 가장 저항이 적은 길을 만들어, 신비로운 우아함으로 전장을 가로지릅니다. 당신이 '장거리 이동'을 할 때, 당신의 이동은 적의 반응을 유발하지 않으며, 5피트 이내를 지나가는 아군은 즉시 반응을 사용해 같은 방향으로 '장거리 이동'할 수 있습니다. 아군은 이동을 끝낼 때 당신이나 이 능력의 혜택을 받은 다른 아군에게 최대한 가까이 있어야 합니다. '용의 여정' 동안 아군의 이동은 반응을 유발하지 않습니다.

name: Hook 'Em

description.value:
Requirements A rope is within your reach, or you have a rope or grappling weapon in your hand.

The Salt Breakers learned to use whatever they could during the Vidric Revolution, and they quickly mastered the art of making a rope into a useful tool in combat. You take hold of a nearby rope, throw a rope from your hand, or fire a grappling weapon at a solid surface—and then swing up to twice your Speed. If you end your movement next to an enemy, attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} that enemy, tying them up in your rope.

_desc_en:
Requirements A rope is within your reach, or you have a rope or grappling weapon in your hand.

The Salt Breakers learned to use whatever they could during the Vidric Revolution, and they quickly mastered the art of making a rope into a useful tool in combat. You take hold of a nearby rope, throw a rope from your hand, or fire a grappling weapon at a solid surface—and then swing up to twice your Speed. If you end your movement next to an enemy, attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} that enemy, tying them up in your rope.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 손이 닿는 곳에 밧줄이 있거나, 손에 밧줄이나 갈고리 무기를 들고 있어야 한다.

소금 깨는 자들은 비드릭 혁명 당시 사용할 수 있는 모든 것을 활용하는 법을 배웠으며, 전투에서 밧줄을 유용한 도구로 만드는 기술을 빠르게 마스터했다. 근처의 밧줄을 잡거나, 손에서 밧줄을 던지거나, 견고한 표면에 갈고리 무기를 발사한 후, 자신의 이동 속도의 최대 2배까지 휘둘러 올라간다. 이동을 적 옆에서 끝낸다면, @link[actions.grapple] 운동 판정을 시도하여 적을 밧줄로 묶어라.

name: Dragon Grip

description.value: Your hold has a unique draconic connection. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus when you attempt to Make an Impression on a creature with the dragon trait. You gain access to the Riding Drake animal companion.

_desc_en: Your hold has a unique draconic connection. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus when you attempt to Make an Impression on a creature with the dragon trait. You gain access to the Riding Drake animal companion.
_desc_ko: 당신의 잡기는 독특한 드라코닉 연결을 지닙니다. 용 특성을 가진 생물에게 인상을 남기려고 시도할 때 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 드레이크 탑승 동물 동료를 이용할 수 있습니다.

description.value:
Usage imbued into a worn ikon or a body ikon

This badge of office proclaims your sovereignty. The imbued ikon gains the following ability.

_desc_ko:
사용법 착용 이콘 또는 신체 이콘에 주입

이 직책의 상징은 당신의 주권을 선포합니다. 부여된 이콘은 다음 능력을 얻습니다.

초월-@link[actions.heavy-is-the-crown] 2 (집중, 정신, 영혼, 초월)

@link[actions.heavy-is-the-crown]

name: Trample (Centaur)

description.value: You've trained to stampede right over smaller foes without causing yourself any harm. Stride up to double your Speed; you can move through the spaces of creatures at least one size smaller, Trampling each creature whose space you enter. You can attempt to Trample the same creature only once in a single Trample. You deal bludgeoning damage equal to your hoof attack (or your unarmed strike if you lack a hoof attack) against these creatures, who can attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save against your class DC.

_desc_en: You've trained to stampede right over smaller foes without causing yourself any harm. Stride up to double your Speed; you can move through the spaces of creatures at least one size smaller, Trampling each creature whose space you enter. You can attempt to Trample the same creature only once in a single Trample. You deal bludgeoning damage equal to your hoof attack (or your unarmed strike if you lack a hoof attack) against these creatures, who can attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save against your class DC.
_desc_ko: 당신은 작은 적들을 짓밟고 지나가면서도 자신에게 피해를 입히지 않도록 훈련했습니다. 이동 속도의 두 배까지 전진할 수 있으며, 최소 한 크기 작은 생물의 공간을 통과할 수 있습니다. 진입하는 각 생물을 짓밟습니다. 단일 짓밟기 행동으로 동일 생물을 한 번만 짓밟을 수 있다. 해당 생물에게 발굽 공격(발굽 공격이 없을 경우 비무장 공격)에 해당하는 타격 피해를 입히며, 대상은 네 클래스 난이도(DC)에 대한 기본 반사 내성 굴림을 시도할 수 있다.

name: Azarketi Weapon Familiarity

description.value:
You are familiar with weapons that excel underwater. You are trained with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.62nnVQvGhoVLLl2K]{Crossbows}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.XyA6PKV46aNlLXOd]{Hand Crossbows}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.aXuJh4i8HqSu6NYV]{Longspears}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.tOhoGvmCMw4JpWcS]{Spears}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.FJrsDoaIXksVjld9]{Tridents}.

_desc_ko:
당신은 수중에서 뛰어난 성능을 발휘하는 무기에 숙련되어 있습니다. 당신은 @link[equipment.crossbow], @link[equipment.hand-crossbow], @link[equipment.longspear], @link[equipment.spear], 그리고 @link[equipment.trident]에 숙련되어 있습니다.

또한 모든 희귀 아자케티 무기를 사용할 수 있습니다. 숙련도 판정 시, 무술용 아자케티 무기는 단순 무기로, 고급 아자케티 무기는 무술용 무기로 간주됩니다.

name: First World Adept

description.value: Over time your fey magic has grown stronger. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0qaqksrGGDj74HXE]{Revealing Light} as 2nd-rank primal innate spells. You can cast each of these primal innate spells once per day.

value.value: at least one primal innate spell

You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0qaqksrGGDj74HXE]{Revealing Light} as 2nd-rank primal innate spells. You can cast each of these primal innate spells once per day.
_desc_ko: 시간이 지남에 따라 당신의 페이 마법이 더욱 강해졌습니다. @link[spells.invisibility]와 @link[spells.revealing-light]을 (2nd)랭크 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 획득합니다. 이 프라이멀 선천 마법들은 각각 하루에 한 번씩 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Rapid Retraining

description.value: Some feel trapped by their choices and have a tough time reinventing themselves. To you, this dilemma is just a natural part of reincarnation. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.24PSsn1SKpUwYA1X]{Retraining} other feats or skill increases during downtime only takes 4 days instead of a week, and class features that require a choice can be retrained in a week instead of a month. You also never need to find a teacher to retrain, as the memories of abilities you possessed in past lives are superior to any instructor.

publication.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

_desc_en: Some feel trapped by their choices and have a tough time reinventing themselves. To you, this dilemma is just a natural part of reincarnation. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.24PSsn1SKpUwYA1X]{Retraining} other feats or skill increases during downtime only takes 4 days instead of a week, and class features that require a choice can be retrained in a week instead of a month. You also never need to find a teacher to retrain, as the memories of abilities you possessed in past lives are superior to any instructor.
_desc_ko: 어떤 이들은 자신의 선택에 갇혀 있다고 느끼며 자신을 재창조하는 데 어려움을 겪습니다. 당신에게 이 딜레마는 환생의 자연스러운 일부일 뿐입니다. @link[actions.retraining] 다운타임 동안 다른 재주나 기술 향상을 재훈련하는 데 일주일이 아닌 4일만 소요되며, 선택이 필요한 클래스 피트는 한 달이 아닌 일주일 만에 재훈련할 수 있습니다. 또한 재훈련을 위해 스승을 찾을 필요가 없습니다. 과거 생애에서 가졌던 능력에 대한 기억이 어떤 지도자보다 뛰어나기 때문입니다.

name: Barbarian Dedication

description.value:
You become trained in Athletics; if you were already trained in Athletics, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You become trained in barbarian class DC.

You can use the Rage action. While raging, you take a –1 penalty to AC.

Choose an instinct as you would if you were a barbarian. You have that instinct for all purposes, but you don't gain any of the other abilities it grants. If that instinct has anathema, you're bound by them.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.uYCTmos3yZtbD9qs]{Barbarian}

_desc_en:
You become trained in Athletics; if you were already trained in Athletics, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You become trained in barbarian class DC.

You can use the Rage action. While raging, you take a –1 penalty to AC.

Choose an instinct as you would if you were a barbarian. You have that instinct for all purposes, but you don't gain any of the other abilities it grants. If that instinct has anathema, you're bound by them.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.uYCTmos3yZtbD9qs]{Barbarian}
_desc_ko:
당신은 운동 기술에 숙련됩니다. 이미 운동 기술에 숙련된 경우, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다. 바바리안 클래스 DC에 숙련됩니다.

분노 행동을 사용할 수 있습니다. 분노 상태에서는 AC에 -1 페널티를 받습니다.

바바리안인 것처럼 본능 하나를 선택한다. 모든 목적에 해당 본능을 가지지만, 그 본능이 부여하는 다른 능력은 얻지 못한다. 해당 본능에 저주가 있다면, 그 저주에 구속된다.

name: Enlarged Chassis

description.value:
You've empowered your core to support a larger body, granting you size and additional reach. You gain the effects of enlarge constantly.

Enhancement Your core's empowerment has stabilized, allowing for greater support. You are no longer clumsy due to the effects of enlarge.

_desc_en:
You've empowered your core to support a larger body, granting you size and additional reach. You gain the effects of enlarge constantly.

Enhancement Your core's empowerment has stabilized, allowing for greater support. You are no longer clumsy due to the effects of enlarge.
_desc_ko:
당신은 더 큰 몸을 지탱할 수 있도록 핵심을 강화하여 크기와 추가 도달 범위를 얻었습니다. 확대 효과가 지속적으로 적용됩니다.

강화 코어 강화가 안정화되어 더 큰 지지를 제공합니다. 확대 효과로 인한 둔함 상태가 사라집니다.

name: Taste Blood

description.value:
You retain not only your vampiric parent's taste for blood but their ability to gain vitality from it. You drink fresh blood from a living humanoid creature, gaining temporary Hit Points equal to the target's level that last for 10 minutes. The target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class or spell DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}. Regardless of the outcome of this save, the target is temporarily immune to your Taste Blood for 1 day; further uses of this ability against the target don't increase the drained condition or grant you more temporary Hit Points.

To drink a creature's blood, either your last action must have been a fangs Strike that damaged the target, or the target must be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and your last action must have been a Strike that dealt piercing or slashing damage to them. If the target is willing, they don't need to be restrained or unconscious for the latter.

Draining the life force from an unwilling humanoid creature is a greater violation than just drinking their blood. Taste Blood has the evil trait unless the target is willing or is an active foe in combat.

value.value: Cel Rau, Straveika, Svetocher, or another lineage from a vampire with the Drink Blood ability
