_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신의 도달 범위 내의 적이 당신과 인접한 아군을 공격할 때.

조건 방패를 들고 있다.

당신은 적을 밀쳐내고 적과 아군 사이에 끼어들려 시도한다. 공격하는 순간 방패로 적을 @link[actions.shove] 시도하다, 시도 직후 밀어냅니다. 이 밀쳐내기 시도에 방패는 밀쳐내기 특성을 가집니다. 밀쳐내기가 성공하면 적의 타이밍을 흐트러뜨려, 적이 아군을 상대로 한 명중 굴림에 -1 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Shamble

description.value:
You may be slower than you were in life, but your pace is unfaltering. Stride twice, or three times if you spent 3 actions to Shamble. During this movement, you ignore difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain.

You can choose to ignore all circumstance and status penalties to your Speed when you Shamble. If you do, you must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:6] when you finish Shambling or your body deteriorates.

_desc_en:
You may be slower than you were in life, but your pace is unfaltering. Stride twice, or three times if you spent 3 actions to Shamble. During this movement, you ignore difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain.

You can choose to ignore all circumstance and status penalties to your Speed when you Shamble. If you do, you must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:6] when you finish Shambling or your body deteriorates.
_desc_ko:
생전보다 느릴지라도 당신의 걸음은 흔들림이 없습니다. 두 번 이동할 수 있으며, 샴블에 3개의 행동을 사용했다면 세 번 이동할 수 있습니다. 이 이동 중에는 어려운 지형과 매우 어려운 지형을 무시합니다.

샴블할 때 속도에 적용되는 모든 상황 및 상태 페널티를 무시할 수 있다. 이를 선택할 경우, 샴블을 마친 후 DC 6 단순에 성공해야 하며, 실패하면 신체가 쇠퇴한다.

name: Plumekith

description.value: Your blood soars with the power of the magnificent garuda, proud and stoic avian warriors. You only take half the normal damage from falling and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects with the air trait.

_desc_en: Your blood soars with the power of the magnificent garuda, proud and stoic avian warriors. You only take half the normal damage from falling and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects with the air trait.
_desc_ko: 당신의 피에는 위엄 있고 냉철한 조류 전사 가루다의 힘이 깃들어 있습니다. 낙하 피해는 절반만 받고, 공기 속성 효과를 가진 대상에 대한 내성 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Clan's Edge

description.value:
By moving your clan dagger with rapid precision, you can protect yourself more effectively. Make two clan dagger Strikes against different targets. Your multiple attack penalty applies normally to these Strikes. You then use an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} action to gain the +1 circumstance bonus to your AC from your clan dagger's parrying trait.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.fRlvmul3LbLo2xvR]{Effect: Parry}

_desc_en:
By moving your clan dagger with rapid precision, you can protect yourself more effectively. Make two clan dagger Strikes against different targets. Your multiple attack penalty applies normally to these Strikes. You then use an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} action to gain the +1 circumstance bonus to your AC from your clan dagger's parrying trait.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.fRlvmul3LbLo2xvR]{Effect: Parry}
_desc_ko:
부족 단검을 신속하고 정밀하게 움직여 자신을 더 효과적으로 보호할 수 있습니다. 서로 다른 대상에게 두 번의 부족 단검 공격을 가합니다. 이 공격에는 다중 공격 페널티가 정상적으로 적용됩니다. 이후 @link[actions.interact] 행동을 사용하여 클랜 단검의 패리 특성에 따른 AC +1 상황 보너스를 획득합니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.fRlvmul3LbLo2xvR]{Effect: Parry}

name: Wall Jump

description.value:
You can use your momentum from a jump to propel yourself off a wall. If you're adjacent to a wall at the end of a jump (whether performing a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}), you don't fall as long as your next action is another jump. Your previous jump gives you momentum, letting you use High Jump or Long Jump as a single action, but you don't get to Stride as part of the activity.

You can use Wall Jump only once in a turn, unless you're legendary in Athletics, in which case you can use it as many times as you can use consecutive jump actions in that turn.

_desc_en:
You can use your momentum from a jump to propel yourself off a wall. If you're adjacent to a wall at the end of a jump (whether performing a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}), you don't fall as long as your next action is another jump. Your previous jump gives you momentum, letting you use High Jump or Long Jump as a single action, but you don't get to Stride as part of the activity.

You can use Wall Jump only once in a turn, unless you're legendary in Athletics, in which case you can use it as many times as you can use consecutive jump actions in that turn.
_desc_ko:
점프의 추진력을 이용해 벽을 발판으로 삼을 수 있습니다. 점프 종료 시 벽에 인접해 있다면(@link[actions.high-jump], @link[actions.long-jump], @link[actions.leap] 수행 여부와 무관하게), 다음 행동이 또 다른 점프인 한 추락하지 않습니다. 이전 점프가 추진력을 제공하여 하이 점프나 롱 점프를 액션 하나 수행할 수 있지만, 이 활동의 일부로 이동할 수는 없습니다.

벽 점프는 턴당 한 번만 사용할 수 있습니다. 단, 운동이 전설적인 경우 해당 턴에 연속 점프 행동을 사용할 수 있는 횟수만큼 벽 점프를 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Spell Parry

description.value:
Requirements You have one or more hands free.

You infuse magical power into your body or armaments to parry both physical and magical assaults.

You raise your guard, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and to saving throws against spells that target you until the start of your next turn, as long as you continue to meet the requirements.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have one or more hands free.

You infuse magical power into your body or armaments to parry both physical and magical assaults.

You raise your guard, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and to saving throws against spells that target you until the start of your next turn, as long as you continue to meet the requirements.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 한 손 이상이 자유로워야 합니다.

신체나 무기에 마력을 주입하여 물리적 및 마법적 공격을 모두 패리한다.

방어를 강화하여 다음 턴 시작까지 AC와 대상이 되는 주문에 대한 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 단, 계속해서 요구 사항을 충족해야 합니다.

name: Cultivator's Keen Eye

description.value:
Attuned to all arrangements of qi, you gain lifesense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. You can also sense the presence of precious materials in the same range, which cultivators refer to as "cultivation materials."

When you participate in rituals, you can substitute all or part of the ritual's cost with an equivalent value of precious materials. This applies only to costs in valuable substances like diamonds, not to rituals that require specific items to function; the GM makes the call if it's unclear.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Attuned to all arrangements of qi, you gain lifesense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. You can also sense the presence of precious materials in the same range, which cultivators refer to as "cultivation materials."

When you participate in rituals, you can substitute all or part of the ritual's cost with an equivalent value of precious materials. This applies only to costs in valuable substances like diamonds, not to rituals that require specific items to function; the GM makes the call if it's unclear.
_desc_ko:
기(氣)의 모든 배열에 조화를 이루며, 30피트 범위 내에서 생명 감지 능력을 부정확한 감각으로 획득합니다. 또한 동일한 범위 내에서 귀중한 재료의 존재를 감지할 수 있으며, 수련자들은 이를 "수련 재료"라고 부릅니다.

의식에 참여할 때, 의식 비용의 전부 또는 일부를 동등한 가치의 귀중한 재료로 대체할 수 있습니다. 이는 다이아몬드 같은 귀중한 물질로 지불해야 하는 비용에만 적용되며, 특정 아이템이 있어야만 수행 가능한 의식에는 적용되지 않습니다. 불분명한 경우 GM이 판단합니다.

name: Adapted Cantrip

description.value:
Through study of multiple magical traditions, you've altered a spell to suit your spellcasting style. Choose one cantrip from a magical tradition other than your own. If you prepare spells, you can choose this spell when you prepare your cantrips, in addition to your other options. If you have a spell repertoire, replace one of your cantrips known with the chosen spell. You can cast this cantrip as a spell of your class's tradition.

If you swap or retrain this cantrip later, you can choose its replacement from the same alternate tradition or a different one.

_desc_en:
Through study of multiple magical traditions, you've altered a spell to suit your spellcasting style. Choose one cantrip from a magical tradition other than your own. If you prepare spells, you can choose this spell when you prepare your cantrips, in addition to your other options. If you have a spell repertoire, replace one of your cantrips known with the chosen spell. You can cast this cantrip as a spell of your class's tradition.

If you swap or retrain this cantrip later, you can choose its replacement from the same alternate tradition or a different one.
_desc_ko:
여러 마법 전통을 연구하여 자신의 주문 시전 스타일에 맞게 주문을 변형했습니다. 자신의 마법 전통이 아닌 다른 전통의 캔트립 하나를 선택하세요. 주문을 준비하는 경우, 다른 선택지 외에 이 주문을 캔트립 준비 시 선택할 수 있다. 주문 목록을 보유한 경우, 알고 있는 캔트립 중 하나를 선택한 주문으로 대체한다. 이 캔트립을 자신의 직업 전통에 속하는 주문으로 시전할 수 있다.

나중에 이 캔트립을 교체하거나 재훈련할 경우, 동일한 대체 전통이나 다른 전통에서 대체할 캔트립을 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Primal Dragonblood

description.value: A dragon with a deep connection to the natural world, such as an adamantine dragon or a horned dragon, resides somewhere on your family tree. You tend to trust your instincts and might take on the role of a protector of the wilderness. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Nature. If you would automatically become trained in Nature (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You can use Nature to Sense Direction and Subsist in the wilds. If you choose a draconic exemplar, you must choose a primal dragon.

_desc_en: A dragon with a deep connection to the natural world, such as an adamantine dragon or a horned dragon, resides somewhere on your family tree. You tend to trust your instincts and might take on the role of a protector of the wilderness. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Nature. If you would automatically become trained in Nature (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You can use Nature to Sense Direction and Subsist in the wilds. If you choose a draconic exemplar, you must choose a primal dragon.
_desc_ko: 아다만틴 드래곤이나 뿔 드래곤처럼 자연계와 깊은 연관이 있는 드래곤이 당신의 가계도 어딘가에 존재합니다. 당신은 본능을 신뢰하는 경향이 있으며, 야생의 수호자 역할을 맡을 수도 있습니다. 자연 기술에 숙련 등급 을 획득한다. 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 자연 기술에 자동으로 숙련이 부여되는 경우, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련을 부여받는다. 자연 기술을 사용하여 야생에서 방향 감지와 생존을 할 수 있다. 드래곤의 프라이멀 표본을 선택할 경우, 반드시 원초적 드래곤을 선택해야 한다.

name: Memory of Mastery

description.value: Flashes of past selves surface in an instant, especially when you're under duress. You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7UDWeLq8OAL04gHR]{Memory of Skill} once per hour instead of once per day.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Flashes of past selves surface in an instant, especially when you're under duress. You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7UDWeLq8OAL04gHR]{Memory of Skill} once per hour instead of once per day.
_desc_ko: 과거의 자아들이 순간적으로 떠오르는데, 특히 압박을 받을 때 더욱 그렇다. @link[feats.memory-of-skill]을 하루에 한 번이 아닌 시간당 한 번 사용할 수 있다.

name: Awaken the Obake

description.value: Not every tool is well cared for, and those that are treated badly might awaken as malevolent spirits. You can temporarily evoke the spirit within a nearby mistreated tool to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4koZzrnMXhhosn0D]{Fear} as a 5th-rank innate arcane spell once per day. When you do so, the terrifying magic of the spell originates from a single unattended object within 30 feet of you instead of from you, and you measure the spell's range from that object. If a target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} as a result of the spell, they're fleeing from that object instead of from you as their mind fills with the absolute certainty that the object will come to life and attack them with malicious glee.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Not every tool is well cared for, and those that are treated badly might awaken as malevolent spirits. You can temporarily evoke the spirit within a nearby mistreated tool to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4koZzrnMXhhosn0D]{Fear} as a 5th-rank innate arcane spell once per day. When you do so, the terrifying magic of the spell originates from a single unattended object within 30 feet of you instead of from you, and you measure the spell's range from that object. If a target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} as a result of the spell, they're fleeing from that object instead of from you as their mind fills with the absolute certainty that the object will come to life and attack them with malicious glee.
_desc_ko: 모든 도구가 잘 관리되는 것은 아니며, 학대받은 도구들은 악령으로 깨어날 수 있다. 당신은 하루에 한 번, 근처에 있는 소홀히 다뤄진 도구 안에 깃든 영혼을 일시적으로 불러내어 @link[spells.fear]를 (5th)랭크 선천적 아케인 마법 주문으로 시전할 수 있다. 이때, 주문의 끔찍한 마법은 당신으로부터가 아닌, 당신으로부터 30피트 이내에 있는 단 하나의 방치된 물체로부터 발원하며, 당신은 그 물체를 기준으로 주문의 사거리를 측정한다. 이 주문으로 인해 대상이 @link[conditions.fleeing] 상태가 되면, 그 대상은 당신으로부터가 아니라 그 물건으로부터 도주하게 된다. 대상의 마음은 그 물건이 생명을 얻어 악의적인 기쁨으로 자신을 공격할 것이라는 절대적인 확신으로 가득 차기 때문이다.

name: Intimidating Prowess

description.value: In situations where you can physically menace the target when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Intimidation check and you ignore the penalty for not sharing a language. If your Strength modifier is +5 or higher and you are a master in Intimidation, this bonus increases to +2.

_desc_en: In situations where you can physically menace the target when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Intimidation check and you ignore the penalty for not sharing a language. If your Strength modifier is +5 or higher and you are a master in Intimidation, this bonus increases to +2.
_desc_ko: {강요} 또는 @link[actions.demoralize]를 사용할 때 물리적으로 위협할 수 있는 상황에서는 협박 판정에서 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 언어 불일치 페널티를 무시합니다. 근력 능력치 수정자가 +5 이상이고 협박 마스터라면 이 보너스는 +2로 증가한다.

name: Dual Energy Heart

description.value: A second energy dwells in your eidolon. Choose an additional energy damage type. Your eidolon's unarmed attack that deals energy damage gains the versatile trait for the second energy damage type, and your eidolon gains resistance to the second type of energy damage equal to half your level.

_desc_en: A second energy dwells in your eidolon. Choose an additional energy damage type. Your eidolon's unarmed attack that deals energy damage gains the versatile trait for the second energy damage type, and your eidolon gains resistance to the second type of energy damage equal to half your level.
_desc_ko: 당신의 에이돌론에 두 번째 에너지가 깃듭니다. 추가적인 에너지 피해 유형을 하나 선택하십시오. 에이돌론의 비무장 공격이 에너지 피해를 입힐 때, 두 번째 에너지 피해 유형에 대해 다재다능 특성을 얻으며, 에이돌론은 두 번째 에너지 피해 유형에 대해 당신의 레벨 절반에 해당하는 저항력을 얻습니다.

name: Tireless Guide's Mask

description.value: Your mask hosts the legacy of Golden Snake, the Tireless Guide, allowing you to guide others with ease. Your allies can use Follow the Expert to follow you for any of your trained skills, in addition to skills in which you are an expert or better. When they follow you when you use a trained skill, their circumstance bonus is +1. Immediately after you Cast a non-cantrip Spell that targets only one ally, that ally can Stride as a free action.

_desc_en: Your mask hosts the legacy of Golden Snake, the Tireless Guide, allowing you to guide others with ease. Your allies can use Follow the Expert to follow you for any of your trained skills, in addition to skills in which you are an expert or better. When they follow you when you use a trained skill, their circumstance bonus is +1. Immediately after you Cast a non-cantrip Spell that targets only one ally, that ally can Stride as a free action.
_desc_ko: 이 가면은 지칠 줄 모르는 안내자 황금뱀의 유산을 품고 있어, 당신이 손쉽게 타인을 이끌 수 있게 합니다. 동료들은 당신이 숙련된 기술뿐만 아니라 전문 이상인 기술에 대해서도 '전문가 따르기'를 사용하여 당신을 따를 수 있습니다. 당신이 숙련된 기술을 사용할 때 동료가 당신을 따를 경우, 그들의 상황 보너스는 +1입니다. 당신이 한 명의 동료만을 대상으로 하는 캐스트 캔트립이 아닌 주문을 시전한 직후, 해당 동료는 자유 행동으로 '이동'을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Mythic Weapon Specialization

description.value: When you fully embrace your Calling, your blows hit with incredible force that can fell even the mightiest of creatures. When you make a Strike with mythic proficiency, your additional damage from weapon specialization increases to 12.

_desc_en: When you fully embrace your Calling, your blows hit with incredible force that can fell even the mightiest of creatures. When you make a Strike with mythic proficiency, your additional damage from weapon specialization increases to 12.
_desc_ko: 당신이 소명을 완전히 받아들일 때, 당신의 타격은 가장 강력한 생물조차 쓰러뜨릴 수 있는 엄청난 힘으로 적중합니다. 신화 숙련도로 공격을 가할 때, 무기 전문화에서 오는 추가 피해가 12로 증가합니다.

name: Witch's Armaments

description.value:
Your patron's power changes your body to ensure you are never defenseless. You gain one of the following unarmed attacks.

  • Eldritch Nails Your nails are supernaturally long and sharp. You gain a nails unarmed attack that deals 1d6 slashing damage, is in the brawling group, and has the agile and unarmed traits.
  • Iron Teeth With a click of your jaw, your teeth transform into long metallic points. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d8 piercing damage and is in the brawling group.
  • Living Hair You can instantly grow or shrink your hair, eyebrows, beard, or mustache by up to several feet and manipulate your hair for use as a weapon, though your control isn't fine enough for more dexterous tasks. You gain a hair unarmed attack that deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage; is in the brawling group; and has the agile, disarm, finesse, trip, and unarmed traits.

Special You can take this feat more than once, gaining a different unarmed attack each time.

_desc_en:
Your patron's power changes your body to ensure you are never defenseless. You gain one of the following unarmed attacks.

  • Eldritch Nails Your nails are supernaturally long and sharp. You gain a nails unarmed attack that deals 1d6 slashing damage, is in the brawling group, and has the agile and unarmed traits.
  • Iron Teeth With a click of your jaw, your teeth transform into long metallic points. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d8 piercing damage and is in the brawling group.
  • Living Hair You can instantly grow or shrink your hair, eyebrows, beard, or mustache by up to several feet and manipulate your hair for use as a weapon, though your control isn't fine enough for more dexterous tasks. You gain a hair unarmed attack that deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage; is in the brawling group; and has the agile, disarm, finesse, trip, and unarmed traits.

Special You can take this feat more than once, gaining a different unarmed attack each time.
_desc_ko:
후원자의 힘이 당신의 몸을 변화시켜 결코 무방비 상태가 되지 않도록 합니다. 다음 비무장 공격 중 하나를 얻습니다.

  • 초자연적 손톱 당신의 손톱은 초자연적으로 길고 날카롭습니다. 1d6 베기 피해를 입히고, 격투 무기 그룹에 속하며, 기민한 무기와 맨손 무기 특성을 가진 비무장 공격을 얻습니다.
  • 철의 이빨 턱을 찰칵 소리 내며 움직이면 이빨이 긴 금속 뾰족한 끝으로 변합니다. 턱을 이용한 비무장 공격을 얻으며, 1d8 관통 피해를 주고 격투 계열에 속합니다.
  • 살아있는 머리카락 머리카락, 눈썹, 수염, 콧수염을 최대 수 피트까지 즉시 길게 하거나 짧게 할 수 있으며, 머리카락을 무기로 사용하기 위해 조종할 수 있습니다. 다만 정교한 작업에는 제어력이 부족합니다. 머리카락 비무장 공격을 획득하며, 이는 1d4 타격 피해를 입히고, 난투 그룹에 속하며, 기민한, 무장 해제, 기교, 넘어뜨리기, 무기 없는 특성들을 지닙니다.

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있으며, 매번 다른 비무장 공격을 얻습니다.

name: Night Terror

description.value: Buoyed by your fearsome reputation, your steed can take flight. Your apocalypse mount gains a fly Speed equal to its land Speed. If it already has a fly speed, it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Qf1ylAbdVi1rkc8M]{Maneuver in Flight}. At night, or in any environment deprived of natural sunlight, your apocalypse mount gains a +10-foot circumstance bonus to its fly Speed, and critical failures on Acrobatics checks to Maneuver in Flight become failures instead.

_desc_en: Buoyed by your fearsome reputation, your steed can take flight. Your apocalypse mount gains a fly Speed equal to its land Speed. If it already has a fly speed, it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Qf1ylAbdVi1rkc8M]{Maneuver in Flight}. At night, or in any environment deprived of natural sunlight, your apocalypse mount gains a +10-foot circumstance bonus to its fly Speed, and critical failures on Acrobatics checks to Maneuver in Flight become failures instead.
_desc_ko: 당신의 무시무시한 명성에 힘입어, 당신의 탈것은 날 수 있습니다. 당신의 종말 탈것은 지상 속도 및 동일한 비행 속도를 얻습니다. 이미 비행 속도를 가진 경우, @link[actions.maneuver-in-flight] 곡예 판정 시 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 밤이나 자연광이 없는 환경에서는, 당신의 종말의 탈것이 비행 속도에 +10피트 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 비행 기동 아크로바틱스 판정에서 대실패는 실패로 변경된다.

name: No! No! I Created You!

description.value:
Frequency once per minute

Trigger Your construct companion would become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled}.

You appeal to your construct companion's bond with its creator to have it break free of a controlling effect. Attempt to counteract the effect that confused or controlled your construct companion, using your Crafting modifier for the counteract check and half your level rounded up for the counteract rank.

name_ko: 안 돼! 안 돼! 내가 널 창조했어!
_desc_en:
Frequency once per minute

Trigger Your construct companion would become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled}.

You appeal to your construct companion's bond with its creator to have it break free of a controlling effect. Attempt to counteract the effect that confused or controlled your construct companion, using your Crafting modifier for the counteract check and half your level rounded up for the counteract rank.
_desc_ko:
빈도 분당 1회

발동 조건 당신의 창조물 동반자가 @link[conditions.confused] 상태가 되거나 @link[conditions.controlled] 상태가 됩니다.

당신은 창조자와의 유대감을 호소하여 조종 효과를 벗어나게 합니다. 혼란 또는 지배됨 상태에 빠진 조형 동반자의 효과를 반격하려 시도합니다. 반격 판정에는 제작 수정자를, 반격 등급에는 반올림한 레벨의 절반을 적용합니다.

name: Thermal Nimbus

description.value: You direct waves of warmth into or out of your kinetic gate to drastically shift the temperature around you. Choose cold or fire. You and allies in your kinetic aura gain resistance equal to your level to damage of that type. Any creature that starts its turn in your kinetic aura or moves into your aura during its turn takes @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))[@actor.flags.system.kineticist.thermalNimbus]] damage. Elemental resistance from a gate junction is cumulative with resistance from Thermal Nimbus.

_desc_en: You direct waves of warmth into or out of your kinetic gate to drastically shift the temperature around you. Choose cold or fire. You and allies in your kinetic aura gain resistance equal to your level to damage of that type. Any creature that starts its turn in your kinetic aura or moves into your aura during its turn takes @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))[@actor.flags.system.kineticist.thermalNimbus]] damage. Elemental resistance from a gate junction is cumulative with resistance from Thermal Nimbus.
_desc_ko: 당신은 키네틱 게이트 안팎으로 온기 파동을 유도하여 주변 온도를 급격히 변화시킵니다. 냉기 또는 화염 중 하나를 선택합니다. 당신과 당신의 키네틱 오라 내에 있는 아군은 해당 유형의 피해에 대해 당신의 레벨과 동일한 저항력을 얻습니다. 당신의 키네틱 오라 내에서 자신의 턴을 시작하거나 자신의 턴 동안 오라 안으로 이동하는 모든 생물은 의 피해를 입습니다. 게이트 정션으로부터의 원소 저항력은 열기운의 저항력과 중첩됩니다.

name: Can't Fall Here

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger An adjacent and willing ally would be reduced to 0 HP but not killed.

You physically help an ally remain standing and encourage them to push through their pain against dire odds. Your ally doesn't fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and remains at 1 Hit Point. The ally also gains a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last for 1 minute. Fighting onward with such an injury isn't without consequence; your ally's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition increases by 1.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.j6DbvXzg5lTgw3Bq]{Effect: Can't Fall Here}

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger An adjacent and willing ally would be reduced to 0 HP but not killed.

You physically help an ally remain standing and encourage them to push through their pain against dire odds. Your ally doesn't fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and remains at 1 Hit Point. The ally also gains a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last for 1 minute. Fighting onward with such an injury isn't without consequence; your ally's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition increases by 1.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.j6DbvXzg5lTgw3Bq]{Effect: Can't Fall Here}
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 인접한 의지하는 아군이 HP가 0이 되지만 죽지 않을 때.

당신은 물리적으로 아군이 서 있도록 돕고, 극한의 역경 속에서도 고통을 이겨내도록 격려합니다. 아군은 @link[conditions.unconscious] 상태에 빠지지 않고 1 HP로 유지됩니다. 또한 아군은 당신의 레벨 에 해당하는 임시 HP를 얻으며, 이는 1분 동안 지속됩니다. 그러한 부상 상태로 계속 싸우는 것은 무리가 따릅니다; 아군의 @link[conditions.wounded] 상태가 1 증가합니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.j6DbvXzg5lTgw3Bq]{효과: 여기서 쓰러질 수 없음}

name: Let's Try That Again

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a skill check.

You feel a sense of deja vu when you've made a mistake, almost as if you weren't so careless in a past life and could certainly do better if given another chance. Reroll the triggering skill check and use the new result, even if it's worse than your first roll.

publication.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a skill check.

You feel a sense of deja vu when you've made a mistake, almost as if you weren't so careless in a past life and could certainly do better if given another chance. Reroll the triggering skill check and use the new result, even if it's worse than your first roll.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 스킬 판정에 실패할 때.

실수를 저지른 순간 데자뷔를 느낀다. 마치 전생에서 그렇게 부주의하지 않았고, 다시 기회가 주어진다면 분명 더 잘할 수 있을 것 같은 기분이다. 트리거된 스킬 판정을 재굴림하고, 결과가 첫 번째 굴림보다 나쁘더라도 새로운 결과를 사용한다.

name: Siphon Magic

description.value:
Requirements Your last action was to Harvest the Blood of a creature that can cast spells

You gorge upon the magical energies of your foe's blood. You regain one expended spell slot that must be of a lower rank than the highest rank spell you can cast. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} or increase the value of your drained condition by 1.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your last action was to Harvest the Blood of a creature that can cast spells

You gorge upon the magical energies of your foe's blood. You regain one expended spell slot that must be of a lower rank than the highest rank spell you can cast. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} or increase the value of your drained condition by 1.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 마지막 행동이 주문을 시전할 수 있는 생물의 피를 수확한 경우

적의 피에 담긴 마법 에너지를 탐욕스럽게 흡수합니다. 소모된 주문 슬롯 하나를 회복하며, 이는 당신이 시전 가능한 최고 랭크 주문보다 낮은 랭크이어야 합니다. 당신은 @link[conditions.drained]{1} 상태가 되거나, 기력 고갈 상태의 수치를 1 증가시킵니다.

name: Intuitive Crafting

description.value:
Your affinity with process and order makes you a natural artisan. You are trained in Crafting. If you were already trained in Crafting, you instead gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.QLeMH5mQgh28sa5o]{Specialty Crafting} skill feat in a specialty of your choice; if you have both, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. In addition, when you critically fail to Repair an item, you get a failure instead.

Note: If you were already trained in Crafting, you need to manually add the Specialty Crafting feat or select an alternative skill.

_desc_en:
Your affinity with process and order makes you a natural artisan. You are trained in Crafting. If you were already trained in Crafting, you instead gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.QLeMH5mQgh28sa5o]{Specialty Crafting} skill feat in a specialty of your choice; if you have both, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. In addition, when you critically fail to Repair an item, you get a failure instead.

Note: If you were already trained in Crafting, you need to manually add the Specialty Crafting feat or select an alternative skill.
_desc_ko:
과정과 질서에 대한 당신의 친화력은 타고난 장인으로 만듭니다. 당신은 제작에 숙련됩니다. 이미 제작에 숙련된 경우, 대신 선택한 전문 분야의 @link[feats.specialty-crafting] 기술 피트를 선택한 전문 분야에서 획득합니다. 둘 다 보유한 경우, 대신 선택한 기술에 숙련됩니다. 또한, 수리 기술에 대실패를 할 경우, 실패로 처리됩니다.

참고: 제작에 이미 숙련된 경우, 전문 제작 피트를 수동으로 추가하거나 대체 기술을 선택해야 합니다.

name: Vision of Foresight

description.value:
Requirements You're in a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.5LW1k5DUkzbbYuYL]{Daydream Trance}

You use your daydreams to predict the success of actions, rapidly envisioning the possibilities. Once before the end of your next turn, you can call upon these predictions before you roll a saving throw or skill check. You can roll the saving throw or skill check twice and take the better result.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're in a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.5LW1k5DUkzbbYuYL]{Daydream Trance}

You use your daydreams to predict the success of actions, rapidly envisioning the possibilities. Once before the end of your next turn, you can call upon these predictions before you roll a saving throw or skill check. You can roll the saving throw or skill check twice and take the better result.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 몽상 트랜스 상태에 있을 때

당신은 백일몽을 이용해 행동의 성공 여부를 예측하며, 가능성을 빠르게 그려냅니다. 다음 차례가 끝나기 전 한 번, 내성 굴림이나 기술 판정을 굴리기 전에 이 예측을 활용할 수 있습니다. 내성 굴림이나 기술 판정을 두 번 굴려 더 좋은 결과를 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Blast Lock

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a loaded firearm.

Sometimes taking the shortest distance between two points involves removing an obstacle or two. You shoot your firearm at a lock within 10 feet. Make an attack roll against the DC required to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick the Lock}

Critical Success You open the lock, or you achieve two successes toward opening a complex lock.

Success You open the lock, or you achieve one success toward opening a complex lock.

Failure You fail to open the lock, and your shot makes it harder to open. Future attempts to Pick the Lock or Blast the Lock take a -2 circumstance penalty.

Critical Failure You fail to open the lock, and your shot makes it much harder to open. Future attempts to Pick the Lock or Blast the Lock take a -4 circumstance penalty.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a loaded firearm.

Sometimes taking the shortest distance between two points involves removing an obstacle or two. You shoot your firearm at a lock within 10 feet. Make an attack roll against the DC required to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick the Lock}

Critical Success You open the lock, or you achieve two successes toward opening a complex lock.

Success You open the lock, or you achieve one success toward opening a complex lock.

Failure You fail to open the lock, and your shot makes it harder to open. Future attempts to Pick the Lock or Blast the Lock take a -2 circumstance penalty.

Critical Failure You fail to open the lock, and your shot makes it much harder to open. Future attempts to Pick the Lock or Blast the Lock take a -4 circumstance penalty.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 장전된 화기를 장비하고 있어야 합니다.

때로는 두 지점 사이의 최단 거리로 이동하려면 장애물 하나나 둘을 제거해야 합니다. 10피트 이내의 자물쇠를 향해 총기를 발사합니다. @link[actions.pick-a-lock]

에 필요한 난이도(DC)에 대한 명중 굴림을 수행합니다.

대성공 자물쇠를 열거나, 복잡한 자물쇠를 열기 위한 두 번의 성공을 달성합니다.

성공 자물쇠를 열거나, 복잡한 자물쇠를 여는 데 한 번의 성공을 거둡니다.

실패 자물쇠를 열지 못했으며, 당신의 시도는 자물쇠를 여는 것을 더 어렵게 만듭니다. 향후 자물쇠 따기를 시도하거나 자물쇠를 폭파하려고 시도할 때 -2 상황 페널티가 적용됩니다.

대실패 자물쇠를 열지 못했으며, 당신의 시도는 자물쇠를 훨씬 더 열기 어렵게 만듭니다. 향후 자물쇠 따기나 자물쇠 폭파 시도는 -4 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Darkseer

description.value: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.ZfN7jkK6boU1FuiS]{Zon-Kuthon} smiles upon you-even if you curse his name-granting you pitch-black eyes that allow you to see in shadows and darkness. You gain darkvision.

_desc_en: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.ZfN7jkK6boU1FuiS]{Zon-Kuthon} smiles upon you-even if you curse his name-granting you pitch-black eyes that allow you to see in shadows and darkness. You gain darkvision.
_desc_ko: @link[deities.zon-kuthon]은 네가 그의 이름을 저주하더라도 당신에게 미소 지으며, 그림자와 어둠 속을 볼 수 있게 해주는 칠흑 같은 눈을 부여한다. 당신은 암흑 시야를 얻는다.

name: Traditional Ways

description.value: You are a fervent follower of the long-standing elven traditions established when your people returned to Kyonin. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Nature, Society, and Lore skill checks related to Kyonin or the elves that live there, as well as a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against enchantment effects that would force you to act against your will.

_desc_en: You are a fervent follower of the long-standing elven traditions established when your people returned to Kyonin. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Nature, Society, and Lore skill checks related to Kyonin or the elves that live there, as well as a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against enchantment effects that would force you to act against your will.
_desc_ko: 당신은 당신의 민족이 쿄닌으로 돌아왔을 때 확립된 오랜 엘프 전통의 열렬한 추종자입니다. 쿄닌이나 그곳에 사는 엘프와 관련된 자연, 사회, 지식 기술 판정 시 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 자신의 의지에 반하는 행동을 강요하는 마법 효과에 대한 내성 판정 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Sturdy Bindings

description.value: Your grapples are incredibly reliable. When you roll a critical failure on a check to [[/act grapple]] a target, you get a failure instead. In addition, when a creature you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} rolls a failure on its check to Escape, it gets a critical failure instead, and if it rolls a critical success, it gets a success instead.

_desc_en: Your grapples are incredibly reliable. When you roll a critical failure on a check to [[/act grapple]] a target, you get a failure instead. In addition, when a creature you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} rolls a failure on its check to Escape, it gets a critical failure instead, and if it rolls a critical success, it gets a success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신의 그랩 기술은 믿을 수 없을 정도로 안정적이다. 대상에게 @link[actions.grapple]을 판정할 때 대실패를 굴리면, 대신 실패로 처리된다. 또한, 당신이 붙잡은 생물이 @link[actions.escape] 판정에서 실패를 굴릴 경우, 대신 대실패를 얻으며, 대성공을 굴릴 경우 대신 성공을 얻습니다.

name: Rehydration

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You surround your body with a thin layer of water drawn from the moisture in the air. You can spend one hour resting to rehydrate your gills and skin, which counts as submerging your body in water. At the GM's discretion, incredibly dry areas, such as deserts, might not have enough moisture in the air for your Rehydration to work.

_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

공기 중 수분을 끌어와 몸에 얇은 물막을 형성합니다. 1시간 동안 휴식하며 아가미와 피부에 수분을 보충할 수 있으며, 이는 물속에 잠긴 것으로 간주됩니다. GM의 재량에 따라 사막과 같이 극도로 건조한 지역은 공기 중 수분이 부족해 재수분화가 작동하지 않을 수 있습니다.

name: Distracting Explosion

description.value:
Trigger A creature within your reach uses a concentrate action.

Your enemies think they can concentrate on something else while you're nearby? Oh, you'll give them a distraction, all right! Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature with a weapon or unarmed attack that is benefiting from your offensive boost. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

Unstable Function You pull out all the stops to create an explosive distraction. Add the unstable trait to Distracting Explosion. If the attack hits, you disrupt the triggering concentrate action.

Special If your innovation is a minion, it can take this reaction instead of you, even though minions can't normally take reactions or act when it's not their turn. It uses your reaction for the turn to do so.

_desc_ko:
발동 네 도달 범위 내의 생물이 집중 행동을 사용한다.

네가 근처에 있는데도 적들이 다른 것에 집중할 수 있다고 생각하나? 오, 네가 그들에게 방해물을 선사해 주마! 공격력 보너스를 받는 무기나 비무장 공격으로 발동한 생물에게 근접 공격을 가한다. 이 공격은 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되지 않으며, 다중 공격 페널티도 이 공격에는 적용되지 않는다.

불안정한 기능 폭발적인 주의를 분산시키기 위해 모든 수단을 동원한다. 산만하게 하는 폭발에 불안정 특성을 추가한다. 공격이 명중하면, 발동된 집중 행동을 방해한다.

특수 당신의 혁신이 하수인인 경우, 하수인은 일반적으로 자신의 턴이 아닐 때 반응을 취하거나 행동할 수 없지만, 대신 이 반응을 취할 수 있습니다. 이를 위해 해당 턴에 당신의 반응을 사용합니다.

name: Warning Shot

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a loaded firearm.

Who needs words when the roar of a gun is so much more succinct? You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a foe by firing your weapon into the air, using the firearm's maximum range rather than the usual range of 30 feet. This check doesn't take the –4 circumstance penalty if the target doesn't share a language with you.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a loaded firearm.

Who needs words when the roar of a gun is so much more succinct? You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a foe by firing your weapon into the air, using the firearm's maximum range rather than the usual range of 30 feet. This check doesn't take the –4 circumstance penalty if the target doesn't share a language with you.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 장전된 화기를 소지하고 있어야 한다.

총성이 훨씬 더 간결한데 말이 뭐가 필요하겠는가? 당신은 @link[actions.demoralize]를 시도하며, 일반 사거리인 30피트 대신 화기의 최대 사거리를 이용해 공중으로 발사합니다. 대상이 당신과 언어를 공유하지 않는다면 이 판정에는 -4 상황 페널티가 적용되지 않습니다.

name: Inventor

description.value:
You are a genius at Crafting, easily able to determine how things are made and create new inventions. You can spend downtime to invent a common formula that you don't know. This works just like the Craft activity: you spend half the Price of the formula up front, attempt a Crafting check, and on a success either finish the formula by paying the difference or work for longer to decrease the Price. The difference is that you spend the additional time in research, design, and development, rather than in creating an item. Once it's complete, you add the new formula you invented to your formula book.

The GM might allow you to invent uncommon or rare formulas, typically with an increased DC. You need the Alchemical Crafting feat to invent alchemical formulas and the Magical Crafting feat to invent magical formulas.

_desc_en:

Once it's complete, you add the new formula you invented to your formula book.

The GM might allow you to invent uncommon or rare formulas, typically with an increased DC. You need the Alchemical Crafting feat to invent alchemical formulas and the Magical Crafting feat to invent magical formulas.
_desc_ko:
당신은 제작에 천재적 재능을 지녀 사물의 제작 방식을 쉽게 파악하고 새로운 발명품을 창조할 수 있습니다. 다운타임 동안 알지 못했던 일반적인 제조법을 발명할 수 있습니다. 이것은 제작 활동과 동일하게 작동합니다: 공식 가격의 절반을 선불로 지불하고 제작 판정을 시도하며, 성공 시 차액을 지불하여 공식을 완성하거나 더 오래 작업하여 가격을 낮출 수 있습니다. 차이점은 추가 시간을 아이템 제작이 아닌 연구, 설계, 개발에 사용한다는 점입니다. 완성되면 발명한 새 공식을 공식 책에 추가합니다.

GM은 드물거나 희귀한 공식을 발명하도록 허용할 수 있으며, 일반적으로 난이도(DC)가 상승합니다. 연금술 공식 발명에는 연금술 제작 재주가, 마법 공식 발명에는 마법 제작 재주가 필요합니다.

name: Spell Gem

description.value:
Inspired by the degenerate demiliches your kind sometimes devolves into, you've embedded a gem into your brow, fusing it to your necrotic flesh. This gem has been specially calibrated to hold one of the following spells: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yrZA4k2VAqEP8xx7]{Repulsion}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r784cIz17eWujtQj]{Scrying}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight}. You must decide which spell your gem contains when you take this feat; changing the spell requires retraining the feat. Once per day, you can drain the gem's magical energy to Cast the Spell without spending a spell slot.

At 18th level, you can heighten whichever spell you chose to 7th level. At 20th level, you can heighten whichever spell you chose to 8th level; regardless of which spell you chose, you can instead drain the gem's magical energy to cast an 8th-rank spell turning without spending a spell slot.

_desc_en:

You must decide which spell your gem contains when you take this feat; changing the spell requires retraining the feat. Once per day, you can drain the gem's magical energy to Cast the Spell without spending a spell slot.

At 18th level, you can heighten whichever spell you chose to 7th level. At 20th level, you can heighten whichever spell you chose to 8th level; regardless of which spell you chose, you can instead drain the gem's magical energy to cast an 8th-rank spell turning without spending a spell slot.
_desc_ko:
당신의 종족이 때로 퇴화하여 변하는 타락한 데미리치에서 영감을 받아, 당신은 이마에 보석을 박아 부패한 살갗과 융합시켰다. 이 보석은 다음 주문 중 하나를 담도록 특별히 조정되었다: @link[spells.repulsion], @link[spells.scrying], 또는 @link[spells.truesight] 중 하나를 담도록 특별히 조정되었다. 이 재주를 선택할 때 보석에 담을 주문을 결정해야 하며, 주문을 변경하려면 재주를 재훈련해야 한다. 하루에 한 번, 보석의 마법 에너지를 흡수하여 주문 슬롯을 사용하지 않고 해당 주문을 시전할 수 있다.

18레벨에 도달하면 선택한 주문을 (7th)레벨로 강화할 수 있습니다. 20레벨에 도달하면 선택한 주문을 (8th)레벨로 강화할 수 있으며, 선택한 주문과 무관하게 보석의 마법 에너지를 흡수하여 주문 슬롯을 사용하지 않고 (8th)랭크 주문인 '회피'를 시전할 수도 있습니다.

name: Divine Breadth

description.value: As your understanding increases, your god grants you more divine spells each day. Increase the spell slots you gain from cleric archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest cleric spell slots.

_desc_en: As your understanding increases, your god grants you more divine spells each day. Increase the spell slots you gain from cleric archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest cleric spell slots.
_desc_ko: 이해력이 증가함에 따라, 당신의 신은 매일 더 많은 신성 주문을 부여합니다. 클레릭 아키타입 피트 재주로 얻는 주문 슬롯을, 가장 높은 두 개의 클레릭 주문 슬롯을 제외한 각 주문 랭크마다 1씩 증가시킵니다.

name: Gang Up

description.value: You and your allies harry an opponent in concert. You can flank an enemy if it's within reach of both of you and an ally—you and your ally don't have to be on opposite sides. This benefits your allies as well as you, but only if they're flanking with you, not each other. The other requirements for flanking must still be met.

_desc_en: You and your allies harry an opponent in concert. You can flank an enemy if it's within reach of both of you and an ally—you and your ally don't have to be on opposite sides. This benefits your allies as well as you, but only if they're flanking with you, not each other. The other requirements for flanking must still be met.
_desc_ko: 당신과 아군이 협력하여 적을 괴롭힙니다. 적군이 당신과 아군 양쪽의 도달 범위 내에 있을 경우 측면 공격이 가능합니다. 당신과 아군이 서로 반대편에 위치할 필요는 없습니다. 이 효과는 당신뿐만 아니라 아군에게도 적용되지만, 아군끼리 측면 공격을 하는 경우는 제외됩니다. 측면 공격의 다른 조건들은 여전히 충족되어야 합니다.

name: Talon's Mark

description.value:
Requirements You have a magical or mundane tattoo.

On the rare occasions that Twilight Talons need to identify themselves as members of the organization, many rely on an easily concealed tattoo to reveal their allegiance. Choose a tattoo you have. If the tattoo wasn't already a magic item, it becomes a level 6 item with the invested, occult, and tattoo traits. It also gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.8nzfBu9i5oi2WQn0]{Twist Design} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.zB1g4oa3UKARhCSY]{Adopt Persona} abilities.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have a magical or mundane tattoo.

On the rare occasions that Twilight Talons need to identify themselves as members of the organization, many rely on an easily concealed tattoo to reveal their allegiance. Choose a tattoo you have. If the tattoo wasn't already a magic item, it becomes a level 6 item with the invested, occult, and tattoo traits. It also gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.8nzfBu9i5oi2WQn0]{Twist Design} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.zB1g4oa3UKARhCSY]{Adopt Persona} abilities.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 당신이 마법 또는 평범한 문신을 가지고 있음.

여명 탈론이 조직의 일원임을 밝혀야 하는 드문 경우, 많은 이들이 쉽게 감출 수 있는 문신에 의존하여 자신의 소속을 드러냅니다. 당신이 가진 문신 하나를 선택합니다. 문신이 이미 마법 아이템이 아니었다면, 그것은 투자, 오컬트, 문신 특성을 가진 레벨 6 아이템이 됩니다. 그것은 또한 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.8nzfBu9i5oi2WQn0]{디자인 비틀기}와 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.zB1g4oa3UKARhCSY]{페르소나 채택} 능력을 얻습니다.

name: Complete the Hero's Journey

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Requirements You have Sparked Transcendence of at least two different ikons in the last 10 minutes, and your divine spark currently dwells in a third ikon.

As your divine spark travels through each of your ikons in turn, it gains power, culminating its journey when it enters your third ikon. You Spark Transcendence of your final ikon, but instead of its normal effect, the item casts the 3-action version of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} heightened to half your level rounded up.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Requirements You have Sparked Transcendence of at least two different ikons in the last 10 minutes, and your divine spark currently dwells in a third ikon.

As your divine spark travels through each of your ikons in turn, it gains power, culminating its journey when it enters your third ikon. You Spark Transcendence of your final ikon, but instead of its normal effect, the item casts the 3-action version of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} heightened to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 10분마다 1회

Requirements 지난 10분 동안 최소 두 개의 서로 다른 이콘에서 초월을 발동했으며, 현재 당신의 신성한 불꽃이 세 번째 이콘에 머물고 있습니다.

신성한 불꽃이 차례로 각 이콘을 통과할 때마다 힘을 얻으며, 세 번째 이콘에 도달할 때 그 여정이 절정에 이릅니다. 마지막 이콘에 초월의 불꽃을 일으키지만, 일반 효과 대신 해당 아이템은 @link[spells.harm] 또는 @link[spells.heal]의 3회 행동 버전을 발동합니다. 이 효과는 당신의 레벨의 절반(올림)만큼 강화됩니다.

name: Awakened Jewel

description.value: You once held the head gem of a deceased ancestor or loved one, and it awakened a mysterious power in your own. You gain one cantrip from the occult spell list. As long as you possess your head gem, you can cast this spell as an innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You once held the head gem of a deceased ancestor or loved one, and it awakened a mysterious power in your own. You gain one cantrip from the occult spell list. As long as you possess your head gem, you can cast this spell as an innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 당신은 한때 죽은 조상이나 사랑하는 이의 머리 보석을 손에 쥐었고, 그 보석이 당신 안에 잠든 신비한 힘을 깨웠습니다. 당신은 오컬트 주문 목록에서 한 가지 캔트립을 얻습니다. 머리 보석을 소유하고 있는 한, 이 주문을 선천적 주문으로 마음대로 시전할 수 있습니다. 캔트립은 당신의 레벨 절반(올림)에 해당하는 주문 랭크으로 강화됩니다.

name: Throat Pocket

description.value:
You've trained to use unique nagaji eating habits to your advantage. By manipulating your throat muscles, you can create a pocket of air to store up to four items of light Bulk or less without risk of dissolving. None of these items can have a dimension longer than 1 foot.

As long as you have at least one item in your throat pocket, your speech is noticeably difficult to understand, and you have a visible bulge in your neck.

Placing an item in your throat pocket or retrieving one is an Interact action. You can empty your throat pocket with a single action, causing everything you had stored in it to fall to the ground in your square. Any item that was covered in dirt or grime comes out clean.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_ko:
당신은 독특한 나가지 식습관을 활용하는 훈련을 받았습니다. 목 근육을 조종하여 공기 주머니를 만들어 최대 4개의 경량 이하 아이템을 용해 위험 없이 보관할 수 있습니다. 이 아이템들의 어느 것도 1피트를 초과하는 길이를 가질 수 없습니다.

목 주머니에 최소 한 개의 아이템이 들어 있는 동안에는 말투가 현저히 알아듣기 어려워지며, 목에 눈에 띄는 돌출부가 생깁니다.

목 주머니에 물건을 넣거나 꺼내는 것은 상호작용 행동입니다. 액션 하나만으로 목 주머니를 비울 수 있으며, 이때 보관 중이던 모든 물건이 자신의 칸 바닥으로 떨어집니다. 먼지나 때로 덮여 있던 물건은 깨끗한 상태로 나옵니다.

name: Choking Smoke

description.value: When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{Fireball} heightened to at least 6th level, you can modify the spell's standard effects as follows: Reduce the spell's damage by 6d6. Your fireball leaves behind a lingering cloud of toxic smoke in its area. While it's smoke instead of mist, this cloud otherwise has the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GKpEcy9WId6NJvtx]{Stinking Cloud}.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en: When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{Fireball} heightened to at least 6th level, you can modify the spell's standard effects as follows: Reduce the spell's damage by 6d6. Your fireball leaves behind a lingering cloud of toxic smoke in its area. While it's smoke instead of mist, this cloud otherwise has the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GKpEcy9WId6NJvtx]{Stinking Cloud}.
_desc_ko: 6레벨 이상으로 강화된 @link[spells.fireball]를 시전할 때, 다음과 같이 표준 효과를 수정할 수 있습니다: 주문 피해를 6d6 감소시킵니다. 화염구가 폭발한 지역에 유독한 연기가 잔류하는 구름을 남깁니다. 안개 대신 연기 형태이지만, 이 구름은 @link[spells.stinking-cloud]의 효과를 가집니다.

name: Dual-Form Weapon

description.value:
Your innovation has replaceable interlocking pieces that you can use to transform it into another type of weapon. When you select this feat, choose a level 0 weapon. It must be either a common weapon or another to which you have access. This weapon becomes your innovation's second configuration.

Select a new set of weapon modifications for this new configuration. You can spend two Interact actions to switch your weapon innovation between the two configurations. These actions don't need to be taken consecutively, but if you've provided the first and not the second, the weapon is non-functional as it is stranded between states. Your weapon's Bulk is always the greater Bulk of the two configurations, regardless of which configuration it's in—if one weapon is smaller than the other, you still need to keep any weapon parts on hand. Any runes on your weapon innovation affect the second weapon configuration as long as it would normally qualify for them.

_desc_en:
Your innovation has replaceable interlocking pieces that you can use to transform it into another type of weapon. When you select this feat, choose a level 0 weapon. It must be either a common weapon or another to which you have access. This weapon becomes your innovation's second configuration.

Select a new set of weapon modifications for this new configuration. You can spend two Interact actions to switch your weapon innovation between the two configurations. These actions don't need to be taken consecutively, but if you've provided the first and not the second, the weapon is non-functional as it is stranded between states. Your weapon's Bulk is always the greater Bulk of the two configurations, regardless of which configuration it's in—if one weapon is smaller than the other, you still need to keep any weapon parts on hand. Any runes on your weapon innovation affect the second weapon configuration as long as it would normally qualify for them.
_desc_ko:
당신의 혁신 무기는 교체 가능한 맞물리는 부품들을 갖추고 있어 다른 유형의 무기로 변형할 수 있습니다. 이 피트를 선택할 때, 레벨 0 무기 하나를 선택하십시오. 해당 무기는 일반 무기이거나 당신이 접근 가능한 다른 무기여야 합니다. 이 무기는 당신의 혁신 무기의 두 번째 구성으로 지정됩니다.

이 새로운 구성에 적용할 무기 개조 세트를 새로 선택하십시오. 두 개의 상호작용 행동을 소모하여 무기 혁신을 두 구성 사이에서 전환할 수 있습니다. 이 행동들은 연속적으로 수행할 필요는 없으나, 첫 번째 상태만 유지하고 두 번째 상태를 제공하지 않으면 무기는 상태 사이에서 고립되어 기능하지 않습니다. 무기의 벌크는 항상 두 구성 중 더 큰 벌크를 가집니다. 어느 구성에 있든 상관없습니다. 한 무기가 다른 것보다 작더라도, 무기 부품을 계속 보유해야 합니다. 무기 혁신에 새겨진 룬은 두 번째 무기 구성에도 영향을 미칩니다. 해당 룬이 원래 적용될 수 있는 조건을 충족하는 한 말이죠.

name: Old Soul

description.value: Your immortal lineage has granted you a lifespan much longer than most mortals, and you've learned a lot along the way. You become trained in two skills of your choice.

_desc_en: Your immortal lineage has granted you a lifespan much longer than most mortals, and you've learned a lot along the way. You become trained in two skills of your choice.
_desc_ko: 불멸의 혈통 덕분에 당신은 대부분의 인간보다 훨씬 긴 수명을 누렸으며, 그 과정에서 많은 것을 배웠습니다. 선택한 두 가지 기술에 숙련됩니다.

name: Become Destiny

description.value: You defy any external force blocking your mythic purpose. Spend a Mythic Point, and remove any one condition you're afflicted with, end the ongoing effects of any one spell you're currently affected by, or free yourself from the effects of any one trap or hazard (such as a snare or bottomless pit). When freeing yourself from a hazard in this way, you immediately move to the nearest safe location adjacent to the hazard.

_desc_en: You defy any external force blocking your mythic purpose. Spend a Mythic Point, and remove any one condition you're afflicted with, end the ongoing effects of any one spell you're currently affected by, or free yourself from the effects of any one trap or hazard (such as a snare or bottomless pit). When freeing yourself from a hazard in this way, you immediately move to the nearest safe location adjacent to the hazard.
_desc_ko: 신화적 목적을 가로막는 외부 세력을 거부한다. 신화 포인트 1점을 소모하여, 자신이 걸린 상태 이상 중 하나를 제거하거나, 현재 영향을 받고 있는 주문 중 하나의 지속 효과를 종료하거나, 함정이나 위험 요소(예: 덫이나 끝없는 구덩이)의 효과에서 벗어날 수 있습니다. 이 방법으로 위험 요소에서 벗어날 경우, 즉시 해당 위험 요소와 인접한 가장 가까운 안전한 위치로 이동합니다.

name: Cross the Threshold

description.value: You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.D2nPKbIS67m9199U]{Ethereal Jaunt} as an occult innate spell once per day. You don't need to Sustain the Spell; instead, it lasts for 10 minutes or until you choose to return to your material form as a free action.

_desc_en: You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.D2nPKbIS67m9199U]{Ethereal Jaunt} as an occult innate spell once per day. You don't need to Sustain the Spell; instead, it lasts for 10 minutes or until you choose to return to your material form as a free action.
_desc_ko: 하루에 한 번, @link[spells.ethereal-jaunt]를 오컬트 선천적 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 주문을 유지할 필요가 없으며, 대신 10분 동안 지속되거나 자유 행동으로 물질 형태로 돌아가기로 선택할 때까지 지속됩니다.

name: Fey's Trickery

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You connect with the fey trickster within yourself to momentarily vanish from sight. This has the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility}.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

You connect with the fey trickster within yourself to momentarily vanish from sight. This has the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility}.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

자신 내면의 페이 사기꾼과 연결하여 기발한 환상의 복제체를 만들어 적의 주의를 분산시킵니다. 이는 @link[spells.mirror-image]의 효과를 가집니다.

name: Blazing Talon Surge

description.value:
Requirements You are in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.rbiMK71SvGZGRLJ1]{Rain of Embers Stance}.

You rush forward and latch onto your enemy with talons of hungering fire.

Stride once. If you end your movement within reach of at least one enemy, you can make a fire talon Strike against that enemy that deals an additional @Damage[1d4[persistent,fire]] damage. If it hits and deals damage, you can attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} the creature you hit.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en:
Requirements You are in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.rbiMK71SvGZGRLJ1]{Rain of Embers Stance}.

You rush forward and latch onto your enemy with talons of hungering fire.

Stride once. If you end your movement within reach of at least one enemy, you can make a fire talon Strike against that enemy that deals an additional @Damage[1d4[persistent,fire]] damage. If it hits and deals damage, you can attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} the creature you hit.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 @link[feats.rain-of-embers-stance] 상태여야 한다.

당신은 앞으로 돌진하여 갈망하는 불의 발톱으로 적을 움켜쥡니다.

한 걸음 내딛는다. 이동을 적어도 한 명의 적의 도달 범위 내에서 끝낸다면, 해당 적에게 불의 발톱 공격을 가해 1d4 지속 화염의 추가 피해를 입힐 수 있다. 공격이 명중하여 피해를 입혔다면, 명중한 생물을 @link[actions.grapple]하기 위해 운동 능력 판정을 시도할 수 있다.

name: Tree Climber (Goblin)

description.value: Your time in forest or jungle canopies has taught you how to scramble across branches with sure feet. You gain a climb Speed of 10 feet. If you also have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.bo4JG09pkoS7ywSZ]{Cave Climber} ancestry feat, your total climb Speed increases to your land Speed when climbing trees.

value.value: tailed goblin or treedweller goblin heritage

_desc_en: Your time in forest or jungle canopies has taught you how to scramble across branches with sure feet. You gain a climb Speed of 10 feet. If you also have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.bo4JG09pkoS7ywSZ]{Cave Climber} ancestry feat, your total climb Speed increases to your land Speed when climbing trees.
_desc_ko: 숲이나 정글의 캐노피에서 보낸 시간은 당신에게 나뭇가지 위를 발걸음이 확실하게 움직이는 법을 가르쳐 주었습니다. 10피트의 등반 속도를 얻습니다. @link[feats.cave-climber] 혈통 재주도 보유한 경우, 나무를 오를 때 총 등반 속도가 지상 속도로 증가합니다.

name: Reveal Machinations

description.value: You reveal that you played a minor but recurring role in another humanoid's life-or at least convince them that's the case. Attempt a @Check[deception|defense:will] check against the target's Will DC. On a success, the revelation makes them frightened 2, and on a critical success they are frightened 3. In addition, you gain information about the subject as though you had attempted to Recall Knowledge about them using an appropriate skill and received the same result on your roll. You can't use this ability against the same humanoid again until 1 day has passed and you've also successfully disguised yourself as a different person.

_desc_en: You reveal that you played a minor but recurring role in another humanoid's life-or at least convince them that's the case. Attempt a @Check[deception|defense:will] check against the target's Will DC. On a success, the revelation makes them frightened 2, and on a critical success they are frightened 3. In addition, you gain information about the subject as though you had attempted to Recall Knowledge about them using an appropriate skill and received the same result on your roll. You can't use this ability against the same humanoid again until 1 day has passed and you've also successfully disguised yourself as a different person.
_desc_ko: 당신은 다른 인간형 생물의 삶에서 사소하지만 반복적으로 관여했음을 드러내거나, 적어도 상대방이 그렇게 믿도록 설득합니다. 기만 판정을 대상의 의지 DC에 대해 시도하십시오. 성공 시, 이 폭로로 대상은 공포 2 상태가 되며, 대성공 시 공포 3 상태가 된다. 또한, 해당 대상에 대해 적절한 기술로 지식 회상을 시도하여 동일한 결과를 얻은 것처럼 정보를 획득한다. 동일 인간형 생물에게 이 능력을 다시 사용하려면 1일이 경과하고, 다른 인물로 변장하는 데 성공해야 한다.

name: Second Thoughts

description.value:
Trigger You cast a mental spell that targets one creature, and it critically succeeds at its Will save.

When your target proves resilient to your magical deceptions, you can try them again on someone else. You can Cast the triggering Spell a second time, targeting a different creature, without expanding an additional spell slot. You can do so only until the end of your next turn, and you can't use Second Thoughts on it after the second casting of the spell.

_desc_en:
Trigger You cast a mental spell that targets one creature, and it critically succeeds at its Will save.

When your target proves resilient to your magical deceptions, you can try them again on someone else. You can Cast the triggering Spell a second time, targeting a different creature, without expanding an additional spell slot. You can do so only until the end of your next turn, and you can't use Second Thoughts on it after the second casting of the spell.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신은 한 생물을 대상으로 정신 마법을 시전하고, 그 생물이 의지 내성에 대성공합니다.

표적이 당신의 마법적 기만에 저항력을 보일 경우, 다른 대상에게 다시 시도할 수 있습니다. 추가 주문 슬롯을 소모하지 않고도 발동 주문을 두 번째로 시전하여 다른 생물을 대상으로 할 수 있습니다. 이는 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지만 가능하며, 두 번째 시전 후에는 해당 대상에게 재고를 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Lucky Escape

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger A creature targets you with an attack, even if you aren't aware of it.

Your enemy lies in wait, lines up the perfect shot, and pulls the trigger... then at just the right moment you duck down to notice something scrawled on the cobblestone in chalk, a shiny coin, or some other coincidental distraction, creating an opportunity for the attack to miss. The attacker must roll the attack twice and use the worse result.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger A creature targets you with an attack, even if you aren't aware of it.

Your enemy lies in wait, lines up the perfect shot, and pulls the trigger... then at just the right moment you duck down to notice something scrawled on the cobblestone in chalk, a shiny coin, or some other coincidental distraction, creating an opportunity for the attack to miss. The attacker must roll the attack twice and use the worse result.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 생물이 당신을 공격 대상으로 삼을 때, 당신이 그 사실을 인지하지 못하더라도.

적은 매복해 완벽한 조준을 하고 방아쇠를 당깁니다... 그런데 바로 그때 당신이 몸을 숙여 자갈길에 분필로 낙서된 글씨, 반짝이는 동전, 혹은 다른 우연한 주의 분산 요소를 발견하게 됩니다. 이로 인해 공격이 빗나가게 되는 기회를 만듭니다. 공격자는 명중 굴림을 두 번 굴려 더 나쁜 결과를 사용해야 합니다.

name: Improvise Strategy

description.value:
You're a wild card on the battlefield, inventing unpredictable tactics and surprising foes. You employ one of these strategies, adding either your choice of the auditory or visual trait. Attempt a @Check[warfare-lore|against:perception] check against the Perception DC of a creature within 30 feet, after which the target becomes temporarily immune to further uses of Improvise Strategy for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target gains one of the following conditions of your choice until the end of your next turn: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}. The target can end the effect by using either a single action with the concentrate trait to regain their bearings (if your strategy had the auditory trait) or an Interact action to rub their eyes (if your strategy had the visual trait). In addition, the target isn't temporarily immune to further uses of Improvise Strategy.

Success As critical success, but the target is temporarily immune to further uses of Improvise Strategy.

Failure The target is unaffected.

Critical Failure The target sees through the gambit, leaving you off-guard until the beginning of your next turn.

Special Once per day, if you lead a troop that has a skirmish bond, you can Improvise Strategy to attempt a Warfare Lore check against a standard DC for your troop's level, rather than targeting a foe. If you succeed, your troop replaces its current skirmish bond with another of your choice until the end of your next turn.

_desc_en:
You're a wild card on the battlefield, inventing unpredictable tactics and surprising foes. You employ one of these strategies, adding either your choice of the auditory or visual trait. Attempt a @Check[warfare-lore|against:perception] check against the Perception DC of a creature within 30 feet, after which the target becomes temporarily immune to further uses of Improvise Strategy for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target gains one of the following conditions of your choice until the end of your next turn: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}. The target can end the effect by using either a single action with the concentrate trait to regain their bearings (if your strategy had the auditory trait) or an Interact action to rub their eyes (if your strategy had the visual trait). In addition, the target isn't temporarily immune to further uses of Improvise Strategy.

Success As critical success, but the target is temporarily immune to further uses of Improvise Strategy.

Failure The target is unaffected.

Critical Failure The target sees through the gambit, leaving you off-guard until the beginning of your next turn.

Special Once per day, if you lead a troop that has a skirmish bond, you can Improvise Strategy to attempt a Warfare Lore check against a standard DC for your troop's level, rather than targeting a foe. If you succeed, your troop replaces its current skirmish bond with another of your choice until the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
당신은 전장의 예측불허 인물로, 예상치 못한 전술을 고안하여 적을 놀라게 합니다. 당신은 이 전략들 중 하나를 구사하며, 청각 또는 시각 특성 중 당신이 선택한 것을 추가합니다. 30피트 내의 생물의 지각 DC에 대해 @Check[warfare-lore|against:perception] 판정을 시도하며, 그 후 대상은 1시간 동안 즉흥 전략의 추가 사용에 일시적으로 면역됩니다.

대성공 대상은 당신의 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 다음 상태 중 당신이 선택한 하나를 얻습니다: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{둔함 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{눈부심}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{무방비}, 또는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{멍함 1}. 대상은 (당신의 전략이 청각 특성을 가졌다면) 집중 특성을 가진 단일 행동으로 정신을 차리거나, (당신의 전략이 시각 특성을 가졌다면) 상호작용 행동으로 눈을 비벼서 그 효과를 종료할 수 있습니다. 또한, 대상은 즉흥 전략의 추가 사용에 일시적으로 면역되지 않습니다.

성공 대성공과 같으나, 대상은 즉흥 전략의 추가 사용에 일시적으로 면역됩니다.

실패 대상은 영향받지 않습니다.

대실패 대상은 그 계략을 간파하여, 당신을 당신의 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 무방비 상태로 남겨둡니다.

특수 하루 1회, 당신이 교전 유대를 가진 부대를 이끈다면, 당신은 적을 대상으로 하는 대신 당신 부대의 레벨에 대한 표준 DC에 대해 전쟁 지식 판정을 시도하도록 즉흥 전략을 할 수 있습니다. 성공하면, 당신의 부대는 당신의 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 현재의 교전 유대를 당신이 선택한 다른 것으로 대체합니다.

name: Zip! Zoom!

description.value: You can fly longer distances before you need to land. The fly Speed you gain from Take Wing increases to 25 feet.

_desc_en: You can fly longer distances before you need to land. The fly Speed you gain from Take Wing increases to 25 feet.
_desc_ko: 당신은 착지가 필요하기 전까지 더 먼 거리를 날 수 있습니다. 날개 펴기로 얻는 비행 속도가 25피트로 증가합니다.

name: Flesh Wound

description.value:
You fire to ensure that even if your shot doesn't land cleanly, it still lands close enough to deal some damage. Make a ranged Strike. It gains the following effect on a failure (though not a critical failure).

Failure Though your attack misses, it still deals one die of damage plus any damage from your weapon specialization class feature. This uses your weapon's normal damage die and damage type. This attack doesn't add extra damage from any other sources or abilities.

_desc_en:
You fire to ensure that even if your shot doesn't land cleanly, it still lands close enough to deal some damage. Make a ranged Strike. It gains the following effect on a failure (though not a critical failure).

Failure Though your attack misses, it still deals one die of damage plus any damage from your weapon specialization class feature. This uses your weapon's normal damage die and damage type. This attack doesn't add extra damage from any other sources or abilities.
_desc_ko:
당신은 쏜 화살이 정확히 명중하지 않더라도 충분히 가까이 닿아 일부 피해를 입힐 수 있도록 발사합니다. 원거리 공격을 수행하세요. 실패 시(대실패 제외) 다음 효과가 적용됩니다.

실패 공격은 빗나갔지만, 무기 전문화 클래스 특성에 따른 추가 피해와 함께 1주사위 피해를 입힌다. 무기의 기본 피해 주사위와 피해 유형을 사용한다. 다른 출처나 능력으로 인한 추가 피해는 적용되지 않는다.

name: Siphon Torment

description.value:
Your progenitors suffered greatly at the hands of a curse, a fate you willingly take upon yourself rather than let fall upon others. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5OcZ3HBkrRFhSWCz]{Claim Curse} as an innate divine spell. When you do, the target creature gains temporary Hit Points equal to your level.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.cmwlVYHtp3a1OipU]{Effect: Siphon Torment}

_desc_en:
Your progenitors suffered greatly at the hands of a curse, a fate you willingly take upon yourself rather than let fall upon others. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5OcZ3HBkrRFhSWCz]{Claim Curse} as an innate divine spell. When you do, the target creature gains temporary Hit Points equal to your level.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.cmwlVYHtp3a1OipU]{Effect: Siphon Torment}
_desc_ko:
당신의 선조들은 저주에 의해 큰 고통을 겪었으며, 당신은 그 저주가 타인에게 닥치는 것보다 차라리 스스로 그 운명을 받아들이기로 했습니다. 하루에 한 번, 당신은 @link[spells.claim-curse]을 선천적 신성 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 시전 시 대상 생물은 당신의 레벨과 동일한 임시 HP를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.cmwlVYHtp3a1OipU]{효과: 고통 흡수}

name: Tactical Debilitations

description.value:
You learn new debilitations that grant you tactical advantages against your foes. Add the following debilitations to the list you can choose from when you use Debilitating Strike.

  • Debilitation The target can't use reactions.
  • Debilitation The target can't flank or contribute to allies' flanking. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.JUgx48XHMz4QM4Ir]{Effect: Tactical Debilitations (No Flanking)}

_desc_en:
You learn new debilitations that grant you tactical advantages against your foes. Add the following debilitations to the list you can choose from when you use Debilitating Strike.

  • Debilitation The target can't use reactions.
  • Debilitation The target can't flank or contribute to allies' flanking. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.JUgx48XHMz4QM4Ir]{Effect: Tactical Debilitations (No Flanking)}
_desc_ko:
적에게 전술적 이점을 부여하는 새로운 약화 효과를 익힙니다. 약화 타격 사용 시 선택 가능한 목록에 다음 약화 효과를 추가하세요.

  • 무력화 대상은 반응을 사용할 수 없습니다.
  • 쇠약 대상은 측면 공격을 하거나 아군의 측면 공격에 기여할 수 없습니다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.JUgx48XHMz4QM4Ir]{효과: 전술적 쇠약 (측면 공격 불가)}

name: Scorched on the Crackling Mountain

description.value: By ritualistically marking your fur with fire, like an infamous tanuki of legend, you protect yourself against future flames. You gain a black stripe down your back that looks charred. Your flat check to remove persistent fire damage is DC 10 instead of DC 15, which can be reduced to DC 5 with appropriate assistance. The first time each day you would be reduced to 0 Hit Points by a fire effect, you avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point, and your wounded condition increases by 1. Two hairs plucked from your tail can be used as flint and steel to create a fire, emitting a strange crackling sound as they ignite.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: By ritualistically marking your fur with fire, like an infamous tanuki of legend, you protect yourself against future flames. You gain a black stripe down your back that looks charred. Your flat check to remove persistent fire damage is DC 10 instead of DC 15, which can be reduced to DC 5 with appropriate assistance. The first time each day you would be reduced to 0 Hit Points by a fire effect, you avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point, and your wounded condition increases by 1. Two hairs plucked from your tail can be used as flint and steel to create a fire, emitting a strange crackling sound as they ignite.
_desc_ko: 전설 속 악명 높은 타누키처럼 의식적으로 털에 불을 새겨, 앞으로 닥칠 화염으로부터 자신을 보호한다. 등줄기에 그을린 듯한 검은 줄무늬가 생긴다. 지속 화상 피해를 제거하기 위한 단순 판정 난이도가 DC 15에서 DC 10으로 낮아지며, 적절한 도움을 받으면 DC 5까지 낮출 수 있다. 매일 처음으로 화염 효과로 인해 HP가 0이 될 때, 기절하지 않고 HP 1을 유지하며 부상 상태가 1 증가한다. 꼬리에서 뽑은 털 두 가닥은 부싯돌과 강철처럼 사용해 불을 만들 수 있으며, 점화될 때 이상한 딱딱거리는 소리를 낸다.

name: Cloud Walk

description.value: Your growing link to cloud dragons has granted you the ability to walk on clouds. Once per hour, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.b5sGjGlBf58f8jn0]{Air Walk} on yourself as an innate arcane spell, but only to walk on clouds or fog.

_desc_en: Your growing link to cloud dragons has granted you the ability to walk on clouds. Once per hour, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.b5sGjGlBf58f8jn0]{Air Walk} on yourself as an innate arcane spell, but only to walk on clouds or fog.
_desc_ko: 클라우드 드래곤과의 유대가 깊어지면서 구름 위를 걸을 수 있는 능력을 얻었습니다. 시간당 한 번, 자신에게 @link[spells.air-walk]을 선천적 아케인 마법으로 시전할 수 있으나, 구름이나 안개 위를 걷는 용도로만 사용 가능합니다.

name: Whirlwind Toss

description.value:
You whirl a foe to smash into all nearby creatures before throwing them far away. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.rMPL11JRcmlutvRi]{Thrash}. During this Thrash, your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.WY7CjISdz6uwXwIb]{Collateral Thrash} feat applies to all other enemies adjacent to you. You can then throw the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} creature 10 feet, where they fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

If the enemy you choose for Collateral Thrash is also adjacent to you, it attempts only one save and takes the damage only once.

_desc_en:
You whirl a foe to smash into all nearby creatures before throwing them far away. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.rMPL11JRcmlutvRi]{Thrash}. During this Thrash, your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.WY7CjISdz6uwXwIb]{Collateral Thrash} feat applies to all other enemies adjacent to you. You can then throw the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} creature 10 feet, where they fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

If the enemy you choose for Collateral Thrash is also adjacent to you, it attempts only one save and takes the damage only once.
_desc_ko:
적 하나를 휘둘러 주변의 모든 생물에게 부딪히게 한 후 멀리 던져버립니다. 당신은 @link[feats.thrash]을 수행합니다. 이 휘두름 동안, 당신의 @link[feats.collateral-thrash] 피트는 당신과 인접한 다른 모든 적에게 적용됩니다. 이후 @link[conditions.grabbed] 생물을 10피트 던져 @link[conditions.prone]로 떨어뜨릴 수 있다.

부수적 격파 대상으로 선택한 적이 당신과 인접해 있을 경우, 해당 적은 한 번만 내성 굴림을 시도하고 한 번만 피해를 받습니다.

name: Lethal Finisher

description.value:
You stab your foe in a vital organ, possibly killing them outright. Make a Strike. On a success, you forego your precise strike damage from the finisher.

Instead, your target takes additional precision damage based on a @Check[fortitude|against:swashbuckler] save against your class DC. If your Strike was a critical hit, the target's saving throw outcome is one degree worse.

Critical Success You deal 6 precision damage.

Success You deal 6d6 precision damage.

Failure You deal 12d6 precision damage.

Critical Failure You deal 18d6 precision damage.

_desc_en:
You stab your foe in a vital organ, possibly killing them outright. Make a Strike. On a success, you forego your precise strike damage from the finisher.

Instead, your target takes additional precision damage based on a @Check[fortitude|against:swashbuckler] save against your class DC. If your Strike was a critical hit, the target's saving throw outcome is one degree worse.

Critical Success You deal 6 precision damage.

Success You deal 6d6 precision damage.

Failure You deal 12d6 precision damage.

Critical Failure You deal 18d6 precision damage.
_desc_ko:
적의 활력 장기를 찔러, 즉사시킬 수도 있습니다. 타격 검사를 수행하세요. 성공 시, 이 마무리 기술로 인한 정밀 타격 피해를 포기합니다.

대신, 대상은 네 클래스 DC에 대한 인내 내성 굴림에 따라 추가 정밀 피해를 받는다. 네 공격이 치명타였다면, 대상의 내성 굴림 결과는 한 단계 더 나빠진다.

대성공 6의 정밀 피해를 입힙니다.

성공 6d6 정밀 피해를 입힙니다.

실패 당신은 12d6 정밀 피해를 입힙니다.

대실패 당신은 18d6 정밀 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Spell-Woven Shot

description.value: You combine your own magic with that of your magical crossbow or firearm. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3MiV0maH8imtnVwS]{Spell-Woven Shot} activity.

_desc_en: You combine your own magic with that of your magical crossbow or firearm. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3MiV0maH8imtnVwS]{Spell-Woven Shot} activity.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신의 마법과 마법식 석궁 또는 화기의 마법을 결합합니다. @link[actions.spell-woven-shot] 능력을 얻습니다.

name: Patch Job

description.value: You can patch up damage to an object with a quick fix. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xT593tHyPkumPuzz]{Improvised Repair} general feat. When you use Improvised Repair, you can attempt a Crafting check with the same DC as Repair. If you succeed, you can use the object as a normal object of its type until it takes damage rather than as a shoddy object of its type.

_desc_en: You can patch up damage to an object with a quick fix. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xT593tHyPkumPuzz]{Improvised Repair} general feat. When you use Improvised Repair, you can attempt a Crafting check with the same DC as Repair. If you succeed, you can use the object as a normal object of its type until it takes damage rather than as a shoddy object of its type.
_desc_ko: 물건의 피해를 신속하게 수리할 수 있습니다. @link[feats.improvised-repair] 일반 피트를 획득합니다. 임시 수리를 사용할 때, 수리 기술과 동일한 DC로 제작 기술 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다. 성공하면 해당 물건을 손상되기 전까지 해당 유형의 정상적인 물건으로 사용할 수 있으며, 해당 유형의 허술한 물건으로 사용하지 않아도 됩니다.

name: Knight in Shining Armor

description.value: As a knight in shining armor, you train daily in the heaviest armor, expanding your expertise to heavy armor. You gain expert proficiency in heavy armor.

value.value: expert in light armor, medium armor, or unarmored defense

_desc_en: As a knight in shining armor, you train daily in the heaviest armor, expanding your expertise to heavy armor. You gain expert proficiency in heavy armor.
_desc_ko: 빛나는 갑옷의 기사로서, 당신은 매일 가장 무거운 갑옷을 입고 훈련하며 중갑에 대한 전문성을 확장합니다. 중갑에 대한 전문가 숙련도를 얻습니다.

name: Spelldrinker

description.value:
Requirements Your last action was to Harvest Blood.

Frequency once per hour

You temporarily add a 3rd-rank spell to your spell repertoire, as determined by the type of creature whose blood you just drank (see table below). If the creature has more than one of the listed traits, choose one and gain the appropriate spell. If the granted spell is not on your chosen tradition's list, you cast the spell as though it was from your chosen tradition. The spell is removed from your spell repertoire after 24 hours, the next time you use Spelldrinker, or when you next make your daily preparations, whichever comes first.

발동 빈도 시간당 1회

name: Crossbow Terror

description.value: Your skill with a crossbow strikes terror into your opponents when you threaten them with the next bolt. Interact to reload a crossbow and then attempt an Intimidation check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this check if you succeeded at a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{Strike} with a crossbow this turn.

_desc_en: Your skill with a crossbow strikes terror into your opponents when you threaten them with the next bolt. Interact to reload a crossbow and then attempt an Intimidation check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this check if you succeeded at a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{Strike} with a crossbow this turn.
_desc_ko: 당신의 석궁 실력은 다음 화살을 쏘겠다고 위협할 때 상대방에게 공포를 강타합니다. 석궁을 재장전한 후 협박 판정(@link[actions.demoralize])를 시도하세요. 이번 턴에 석궁으로 @link[actions.strike]에 성공했다면 이 판정에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Shield Wallop

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a shield.

Attacks with your shield knock the sense out of your foes. Make a shield bash, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.dfum7DpOEkwxwTsT]{Shield Boss}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.nSO0Z662LkkLfa2u]{Shield Spikes} Strike. If you hit and deal damage, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until the start of your next turn (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} on a critical hit). name: Kitharodian Actor Dedication

description.value:
Access You are from Taldor or have attended Kitharodian Academy.

You've studied classic Taldan theater and learned to embody various roles to a sublime degree. You become trained in Society and in Theater Lore; if you were already trained in either, you become an expert in that skill instead. In addition, when you attempt a Deception or Performance check to portray a famous figure, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your check. This bonus changes to +3 at 10th level and +4 at 17th level. However, you don't gain this bonus while Impersonating a figure whose death is common knowledge (as determined by the GM).

name: Elemental Evolution

description.value:
The elemental power within you is more mutable and versatile than most. Choose a second damage type for your element. Whenever you Rage, you can choose that type instead of the damage type you would normally gain. The new damage type can be the one you did not choose when you selected the element initially if you had multiple options available for your element, or one of the following types:

air cold

earth poison

fire cold

metal electricity

water acid

wood poison.
