air cold

earth poison

fire cold

metal electricity

water acid

wood poison.

name: True Hypercognition

description.value: Your mind works at an incredible pace. You instantly use up to five Recall Knowledge actions. If you have any special abilities or free actions that would normally be triggered when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, you can't use them for these actions.

_desc_en: Your mind works at an incredible pace. You instantly use up to five Recall Knowledge actions. If you have any special abilities or free actions that would normally be triggered when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, you can't use them for these actions.
_desc_ko: 당신의 정신은 놀라운 속도로 작동합니다. 최대 다섯 번의 지식 회상 행동을 즉시 사용할 수 있습니다. 평소 @link[actions.recall-knowledge] 시 발동되는 특수 능력이나 자유 행동이 있다면, 이 행동들에 대해서는 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Giant Hunter

description.value:
You have studied giants and hunt them with efficiency. When you roll initiative and can see a giant, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JYi4MnsdFu618hPm]{Hunt Prey} as a free action, designating that enemy as your prey.

You can use this free action even if you haven't identified the giant yet with Recall Knowledge. The benefit doesn't apply against giants disguised as other creatures, and the GM determines whether it applies against a creature disguised as a giant.

_desc_en:
You have studied giants and hunt them with efficiency. When you roll initiative and can see a giant, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JYi4MnsdFu618hPm]{Hunt Prey} as a free action, designating that enemy as your prey.

You can use this free action even if you haven't identified the giant yet with Recall Knowledge. The benefit doesn't apply against giants disguised as other creatures, and the GM determines whether it applies against a creature disguised as a giant.
_desc_ko:
당신은 거인들을 연구해 왔으며 효율적으로 사냥합니다. 이니셔티브를 굴릴 때 거인을 볼 수 있다면, @link[actions.hunt-prey]을 자유 행동으로 수행하여 해당 적을 사냥감으로 지정할 수 있습니다.

이 무료 행동은 지식 회상으로 거인을 아직 식별하지 못한 상태에서도 사용할 수 있다. 이 혜택은 다른 생물로 변장한 거인에게는 적용되지 않으며, 거인으로 변장한 생물에게 적용되는지는 GM이 결정한다.

name: Advanced Shooting

description.value:
You gain one gunslinger feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your gunslinger level is equal to half your level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another gunslinger feat.

_desc_en:

건슬링어 피트 하나를 획득합니다. 해당 피트의 전제 조건을 충족할 때, 당신의 건슬링어 레벨은 당신의 레벨 절반과 동일합니다.

특수 이 재주를 여러 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 선택할 때마다 추가 건슬링어 피트를 얻습니다.

name: Lobbed Attack

description.value:
Requirements You are Juggling a thrown weapon.

You make a thrown ranged Strike with the required weapon, using the weapon's normal range increment. This attack doesn't trigger reactions, and if the target has never seen you use this feat before, the target is off-guard against this attack.

name: Wheeling Grab

description.value: You cartwheel on your claws, dancing over your foes. You shift into claw stance and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through}. If you moved through an enemy's space, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} it.

_desc_en: You cartwheel on your claws, dancing over your foes. You shift into claw stance and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through}. If you moved through an enemy's space, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} it.
_desc_ko: 발톱으로 공중제비를 돌며 적들 위를 춤추듯 지나간다. 발톱 자세로 전환하고 @link[actions.tumble-through]를 사용한다. 적의 공간을 통과했다면 @link[actions.grapple]로 그 적을 붙잡을 수 있다.

name: Stubborn Defiance

description.value: You're brave and stubborn and refuse to back down or bow to the wishes of another. You gain a +1 status bonus to saves against mental effects. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.wKPtG0pzARZLGHZT]{I Defy You!} reaction.

_desc_en: You're brave and stubborn and refuse to back down or bow to the wishes of another. You gain a +1 status bonus to saves against mental effects. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.wKPtG0pzARZLGHZT]{I Defy You!} reaction.
_desc_ko: 당신은 용감하고 고집스러워 물러서거나 타인의 뜻에 굴복하지 않습니다. 정신 효과에 대한 내성에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 또한 @link[actions.i-defy-you] 반응을 얻습니다.

name: Assured Identification

description.value: You rarely misidentify an item. When using Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion checks to Identify Magic, if you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead. If you would misidentify a cursed item because you roll a success but not a critical success, you simply can't identify it instead.

name: Demand Surrender

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature cannot take any hostile actions that include you as a target for 1 round.

Failure As success, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature drops any weapons or items it is holding, lies @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} on the ground, and does not take any hostile actions against you or your allies for 1 minute, or until you or one of your allies attacks it.

_desc_ko:
Requirements 당신과 아군이 현재 전장에서 적보다 수적으로 우세하며, 당신이나 아군이 지난 턴 시작 이후 @link[conditions.restrained] 상태의 적을 만들거나 적의 HP를 0으로 감소시킨 적이 있어야 합니다.

승리를 확신하며, 당신은 상대방에게 항복을 명령합니다. 관찰 중인 상대방 한 명을 선택하세요. 당신은 그 상대방에게 강한 목소리로 항복하라고 명령합니다. 상대방은 당신의 직업 난이도(DC)에 대한 의지 내성을 시도해야 하며, 결과는 다음과 같습니다.

대성공 대상은 영향을 받지 않는다.

성공 해당 생물은

대실패 해당 생물은 들고 있던 무기나 아이템을 떨어뜨리고, @link[conditions.prone]로 땅에 눕습니다. 이후 1분 동안, 또는 당신이나 당신의 아군 중 한 명이 공격할 때까지 당신이나 아군을 상대로 적대적 행동을 취하지 않습니다.

name: Mortal Herald Dedication

description.value:
You become a mortal herald of your deity, gaining power in return for your service. Others intuitively sense your connection with your deity, which subtly influences the way they act around you. You become bound by your deity's anathema. Depending on your deity, their sanctification can make you holy or unholy. This gives you the holy or unholy trait, which commits you to one side of a struggle over the souls of the planes and can be referenced in other abilities. If you "can be" holy or unholy according to your deity, you make that choice, and if you "must be" holy or unholy you gain the trait automatically. If you gain the opposing trait in some way, you lose the previous trait until you complete an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{Atone} ritual.

In addition, once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} as a 6th-rank innate divine spell. You can only target yourself with the spell, but you gain the benefits of the 2-action version when you spend 1 action to cast it. In addition, if you would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed, you can cast the spell as a free action before you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}. This spell is automatically heightened to a rank equal to half your level.

Special If you have void healing, you instead cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm}.

In addition, once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} as a 6th-rank innate divine spell. You can only target yourself with the spell, but you gain the benefits of the 2-action version when you spend 1 action to cast it. In addition, if you would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed, you can cast the spell as a free action before you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}. This spell is automatically heightened to a rank equal to half your level.

Special If you have void healing, you instead cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.n787ifCmIxuhtcMG]{Mortal Herald}
_desc_ko:
당신은 신의 필멸의 전령이 되어 봉사에 대한 대가로 힘을 얻습니다. 다른 이들은 본능적으로 당신과 신의 연결을 감지하며, 이는 그들이 당신 주변에서 행동하는 방식에 미묘한 영향을 미칩니다. 당신은 신의 저주에 묶이게 됩니다. 신에 따라 그들의 성화(聖化)는 당신을 신성한 존재 또는 불경한 존재로 만들 수 있습니다. 이는 당신에게 신성한 특성 또는 불경한 특성을 부여하며, 이는 평면의 영혼을 둘러싼 투쟁의 한 편에 서게 하며 다른 능력에서 참조될 수 있습니다. 신에 따라 신성한/불경한 상태가 '될 수 있는' 경우 선택을 하며, '반드시' 신성한/불경한 상태여야 하는 경우 해당 특성을 자동으로 획득합니다. 반대 특성을 어떤 방식으로든 획득하면, @link[spells.atone] 의식을 완료할 때까지 기존 특성을 상실합니다.

또한 하루에 한 번, @link[spells.heal]를 6랭크 선천적 신성 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 주문은 자신만을 대상으로 할 수 있지만, 1 행동을 소모하여 시전할 경우 2 행동 버전의 효과를 얻습니다. 또한, HP가 0이 되어 즉시 사망하지 않는 상황에서는 @link[conditions.unconscious] 상태가 되기 전 무료 행동으로 이 주문을 시전할 수 있다. 이 주문은 자동으로 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 랭크으로 강화된다.

특수 공허 치유 능력을 보유한 경우, 대신 @link[spells.harm]을 시전한다.

name: Steal Vitality

description.value: When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.N1Z1oLPdBxaSgrEE]{Vampiric Feast}, you can modify its standard effects as follows: Instead of gaining temporary Hit Points, if your target fails or critically fails its saving throw, you can attempt a counteract check to remove the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} conditions on yourself, using the source of that condition to determine the counteract rank and DC. If the condition was caused by an ongoing effect and you don't remove that effect, the condition returns at the end of your next turn.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en: When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.N1Z1oLPdBxaSgrEE]{Vampiric Feast}, you can modify its standard effects as follows: Instead of gaining temporary Hit Points, if your target fails or critically fails its saving throw, you can attempt a counteract check to remove the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} conditions on yourself, using the source of that condition to determine the counteract rank and DC. If the condition was caused by an ongoing effect and you don't remove that effect, the condition returns at the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko: @link[spells.vampiric-feast]을 시전할 때, 다음과 같이 표준 효과를 수정할 수 있습니다: 일시적 HP를 얻는 대신, 대상이 내성 굴림에 실패하거나 대실패할 경우, 당신은 반격 판정을 시도하여 @link[conditions.clumsy]{1} 또는 @link[conditions.enfeebled]{1} 상태를 제거하기 위한 반격 시도를 할 수 있다. 이때 해당 상태의 원인을 기준으로 반격 랭크과 난이도(DC)를 결정한다. 상태가 지속 효과에 의해 유발되었고 해당 효과를 제거하지 않은 경우, 상태는 다음 턴 종료 시점에 재발생한다.

name: Fulminating Synergy

description.value: When you draw upon your spells' synergy, you create a physical manifestation of their magical resonance and invoke it to harm a foe. When you use Dualistic Synergy, choose a damage type: acid, cold, electricity, or fire. In addition to Dualistic Synergy's normal effect, a foe within 30 feet of you takes an amount of damage of the chosen type equal to the spell's rank. If the spell already deals damage of the chosen type, combine the damage before applying weaknesses and resistances.

_desc_en: When you draw upon your spells' synergy, you create a physical manifestation of their magical resonance and invoke it to harm a foe. When you use Dualistic Synergy, choose a damage type: acid, cold, electricity, or fire. In addition to Dualistic Synergy's normal effect, a foe within 30 feet of you takes an amount of damage of the chosen type equal to the spell's rank. If the spell already deals damage of the chosen type, combine the damage before applying weaknesses and resistances.
_desc_ko: 주문의 시너지를 활용할 때, 당신은 마법의 공명을 물리적 형태로 창조하여 적을 해치도록 소환합니다. 이중적 시너지를 사용할 때, 다음 중 하나의 피해 유형을 선택하세요: 산성, 냉기, 전기, 화염. 이중적 시너지의 기본 효과에 더해, 30피트 내의 적들은 선택한 유형의 마법 랭크에 해당하는 피해를 받는다. 해당 주문이 이미 선택한 유형의 피해를 입히는 경우, 약점과 저항을 적용하기 전에 두 피해를 합산한다.

name: Remnants of the Past

description.value: Memories of your first life are strong and continually return to you, even after several incarnations. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ihN8gkHSdPG9Trte]{Adopted Ancestry} feat and can choose any common or uncommon humanoid ancestry with the feat. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for your chosen ancestry's Lore, such as Dwarven Lore or Ratfolk Lore.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Memories of your first life are strong and continually return to you, even after several incarnations. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ihN8gkHSdPG9Trte]{Adopted Ancestry} feat and can choose any common or uncommon humanoid ancestry with the feat. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for your chosen ancestry's Lore, such as Dwarven Lore or Ratfolk Lore.
_desc_ko: 여러 번의 환생 이후에도 첫 번째 생애의 기억은 강렬하게 남아 계속해서 되살아납니다. @link[feats.adopted-ancestry] 재주를 획득하며, 이 재주와 함께 일반적 또는 흔하지 않은 인간형 혈통 중 하나를 선택할 수 있다. 또한 선택한 혈통의 지식(예: 드워프 지식 또는 랫포크 지식)에 대한 @link[feats.additional-lore] 일반 피트를 획득한다.

name: Scorching Column

description.value:
With an upward gesture, you shape a vertical column of extreme heat. The cylinder is @Template[cylinder|distance:5]{10 feet in diameter} and 30 feet high, and the bottom must be within 60 feet of you. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -1)/3)+1)d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC.

The flame remains briefly, making all squares in the column hazardous terrain until the end of your next turn, and you can Sustain the impulse up to 1 minute. A creature takes @Damage[(2*floor((@actor.level -1)/3)+1)[fire]] damage each time it moves into one of these squares.

Level (+3) The initial damage increases by 1d6, and the hazardous terrain damage increases by 2.

_desc_en:
With an upward gesture, you shape a vertical column of extreme heat. The cylinder is @Template[cylinder|distance:5]{10 feet in diameter} and 30 feet high, and the bottom must be within 60 feet of you. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -1)/3)+1)d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC.

The flame remains briefly, making all squares in the column hazardous terrain until the end of your next turn, and you can Sustain the impulse up to 1 minute. A creature takes @Damage[(2*floor((@actor.level -1)/3)+1)[fire]] damage each time it moves into one of these squares.

Level (+3) The initial damage increases by 1d6, and the hazardous terrain damage increases by 2.
_desc_ko:
위로 손짓하며 극한의 열기를 담은 수직 기둥을 형성한다. 이 원통형 기둥은 5피트에 높이 30피트이며, 바닥은 당신으로부터 60피트 이내여야 한다. 영역 내 모든 생물은 화염 피해를 입으며, 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 기본 반사 내성을 발휘할 수 있다.

불꽃은 잠시 남아 기둥 내 모든 칸을 위험 지형으로 만듭니다. 이 효과는 당신의 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 지속되며, 당신은 최대 1분 동안 이 임펄스를 유지할 수 있습니다. 생물이 이 위험 지형 칸으로 이동할 때마다 화염의 피해를 입습니다.

레벨 (+3) 초기 피해가 1d6 증가하고, 위험 지형 피해가 2 증가합니다.

name: Indomitable Shot

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a ranged warshard weapon.

You can fire a single shot that penetrates multiple foes. Spend 1 Mythic Point, then fire a single shot from your ranged warshard weapon. You inflict your weapon's damage on all creatures in a line, to a maximum distance equal to your weapon's maximum range or until the line hits a solid object that's either thicker than 5 feet or has a Hardness in excess of 20, whichever comes first. Each creature in the area attempts a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, calculated at mythic proficiency. For each range increment beyond the first, a creature gains a cumulative +2 circumstance bonus to their Reflex save. This ability counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty.

publication.title: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a ranged warshard weapon.

You can fire a single shot that penetrates multiple foes. Spend 1 Mythic Point, then fire a single shot from your ranged warshard weapon. You inflict your weapon's damage on all creatures in a line, to a maximum distance equal to your weapon's maximum range or until the line hits a solid object that's either thicker than 5 feet or has a Hardness in excess of 20, whichever comes first. Each creature in the area attempts a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, calculated at mythic proficiency. For each range increment beyond the first, a creature gains a cumulative +2 circumstance bonus to their Reflex save. This ability counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 당신은 원거리 전쟁파편 무기를 들고 있다.

당신은 여러 적을 관통하는 단 한 발을 쏠 수 있다. 신화 점수 1점을 소비한 다음, 원거리 전쟁파편 무기로 단 한 발을 쏜다. 당신은 직선상의 모든 크리처에게 무기의 피해를 입히며, 그 직선은 무기의 최대 사거리에 해당하는 거리까지 뻗어나가거나 두께가 5피트를 초과하거나 경도가 20을 초과하는 단단한 물체에 부딪힐 때까지 뻗어나간다(둘 중 먼저 도달하는 쪽). 범위 내 각 크리처는 당신의 클래스 DC나 주문 DC 중 더 높은 쪽(신화 숙련도로 계산)에 대해 @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] 내성을 시도한다. 첫 번째를 넘어선 사거리 증가분마다 크리처는 반사 내성에 누적 +2 상황 보너스를 받는다. 이 능력은 다중공격 페널티를 계산할 때 두 번의 공격으로 간주한다.

name: Raging Intimidation

description.value: Your fury fills your foes with fear. While you are raging, your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.mZttsiWl1ql5NvrH]{Scare to Death} actions (from the Intimidation skill and an Intimidation skill feat, respectively) gain the rage trait, allowing you to use them while raging. As soon as you meet the prerequisites for the skill feats @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xQMz6eDgX75WX2ce]{Intimidating Glare} and Scare to Death, you gain these feats.

_desc_en: Your fury fills your foes with fear. While you are raging, your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.mZttsiWl1ql5NvrH]{Scare to Death} actions (from the Intimidation skill and an Intimidation skill feat, respectively) gain the rage trait, allowing you to use them while raging. As soon as you meet the prerequisites for the skill feats @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xQMz6eDgX75WX2ce]{Intimidating Glare} and Scare to Death, you gain these feats.
_desc_ko: 당신의 분노가 적들에게 공포를 불러일으킵니다. 분노 상태일 때, @link[actions.demoralize]와 @link[feats.scare-to-death] 행동(각각 위협 기술과 위협 기술 피트에서 비롯됨)은 분노 특성을 획득하여 분노 상태에서도 사용할 수 있게 됩니다. @link[feats.intimidating-glare]과 공포에 질리게 하기 재주의 전제 조건을 충족하는 즉시, 이 피트들을 획득합니다.

name: Pinpoint Poisoner

description.value:
Unsuspecting targets are especially vulnerable to your poisons. When you successfully Strike an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creature with a poisoned weapon or expose an off-guard creature to an inhaled poison, that creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to its initial save against that poison.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.XAdhPJqssO3v4Zvw]{Effect: Pinpoint Poisoner}

_desc_en:
Unsuspecting targets are especially vulnerable to your poisons. When you successfully Strike an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creature with a poisoned weapon or expose an off-guard creature to an inhaled poison, that creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to its initial save against that poison.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.XAdhPJqssO3v4Zvw]{Effect: Pinpoint Poisoner}
_desc_ko:
경계하지 않는 대상은 특히 당신의 독에 대한 약점을 보입니다. 독이 묻은 무기로 @link[conditions.off-guard] 생물을 강타에 성공하거나, 무방비 생물이 흡입 독에 노출될 경우, 해당 생물은 해당 독에 대한 초기 내성에 -2 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.XAdhPJqssO3v4Zvw]{효과: 정밀 독살자}

name: Iron Repercussions

description.value: Disobeying your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M8RCbthRhB4bxO9t]{Iron Command} has lasting consequences. If an enemy refuses to kneel to you, you can deal @Damage[(ternary(gte(@actor.level,19),6,ternary(gte(@actor.level,16),5,ternary(gte(@actor.level,12),4,ternary(gte(@actor.level,9),3,ternary(gte(@actor.level,5),2,1))))))d6[persistent,mental]]{persistent mental damage} instead of normal mental damage. You must decide whether the mental damage will be persistent before your enemy chooses whether to kneel or not. The amount of damage is unchanged.

_desc_en: Disobeying your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M8RCbthRhB4bxO9t]{Iron Command} has lasting consequences. If an enemy refuses to kneel to you, you can deal @Damage[(ternary(gte(@actor.level,19),6,ternary(gte(@actor.level,16),5,ternary(gte(@actor.level,12),4,ternary(gte(@actor.level,9),3,ternary(gte(@actor.level,5),2,1))))))d6[persistent,mental]]{persistent mental damage} instead of normal mental damage. You must decide whether the mental damage will be persistent before your enemy chooses whether to kneel or not. The amount of damage is unchanged.
_desc_ko: 당신의 @link[actions.iron-command]을 거역하면 지속적인 결과가 따른다. 적이 당신에게 무릎 꿇기를 거부할 경우, 일반 정신 피해 대신 지속적 정신 피해를 입힐 수 있다. 정신 피해가 지속성인지 여부는 적이 무릎 꿇을지 여부를 선택하기 전에 결정해야 합니다. 피해량은 변하지 않습니다.

name: Bone Investiture

description.value: You encase yourself in spiritual dinosaur bones to become a Huge dinosaur. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KhM8MhoUgoUjBMIz]{Dinosaur Form} on yourself as a 5th-rank innate spell once per day.

_desc_en: You encase yourself in spiritual dinosaur bones to become a Huge dinosaur. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KhM8MhoUgoUjBMIz]{Dinosaur Form} on yourself as a 5th-rank innate spell once per day.
_desc_ko: 영적인 공룡 뼈로 자신을 감싸 거대한 공룡이 된다. 하루에 한 번, 5랭크 선천적 주문으로 자신에게 @link[spells.dinosaur-form]를 시전할 수 있다.

name: Narrative Conduit

description.value: You act as a conduit for your companions just as your stories are a conduit between teller and listener. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.hPZQ5vA9QHEPtjFW]{Spin a Tale} and the hero of your tale Casts a Spell against the villain, you warp the world, allowing the hero to calculate range and cover to the villain from your space instead of their own if they prefer. The hero must choose to calculate both range and cover from the same space; they can't use one space for range and the other for cover.

publication.title: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind

_desc_en: You act as a conduit for your companions just as your stories are a conduit between teller and listener. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.hPZQ5vA9QHEPtjFW]{Spin a Tale} and the hero of your tale Casts a Spell against the villain, you warp the world, allowing the hero to calculate range and cover to the villain from your space instead of their own if they prefer. The hero must choose to calculate both range and cover from the same space; they can't use one space for range and the other for cover.
_desc_ko: 당신의 이야기가 이야기꾼과 청취자를 연결하는 통로인 것처럼, 당신은 동료들을 위한 통로 역할을 합니다. 당신이 @link[actions.spin-tale]하고 이야기의 주인공이 악당에게 마법을 시전할 때, 당신은 세계를 왜곡하여 주인공이 원할 경우 자신의 위치가 아닌 당신의 위치에서 악당까지의 거리와 엄폐물을 계산할 수 있게 합니다. 주인공은 반드시 동일한 위치에서 거리와 엄폐물을 모두 계산해야 하며, 한 위치는 거리 계산에, 다른 위치는 엄폐물 계산에 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Unmistakable Lore

description.value: You never get information about your areas of expertise wrong. When you Recall Knowledge using any Lore subcategory in which you're trained, if you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead. If you're a master in a Lore subcategory, on a critical success, you gain even more information or context than usual.

rules.text: When you Recall Knowledge using any Lore subcategory in which you're trained, if you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead. If you're a master in a Lore subcategory, on a critical success, you gain even more information or context than usual.

When you Recall Knowledge using any Lore subcategory in which you're trained, if you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead. If you're a master in a Lore subcategory, on a critical success, you gain even more information or context than usual.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신의 전문 분야에 관한 정보를 절대 틀리지 않습니다. 훈련받은 지식 하위 범주를 사용하여 지식을 회상할 때, 대실패를 굴리면 대신 실패로 처리됩니다. 지식 하위 범주의 마스터라면, 대성공 시 평소보다 더 많은 정보나 맥락을 얻습니다.

name: Prevailing Position

description.value:
Trigger You are targeted by an attack or attempt a Reflex saving throw against a damaging effect, and you are in a stance.

Your flexibility with stances lets you sacrifice their benefits to better protect yourself. You leave the stance you were in, gaining a +4 circumstance bonus to the triggering saving throw or to your AC against the triggering attack.

_desc_en:
Trigger You are targeted by an attack or attempt a Reflex saving throw against a damaging effect, and you are in a stance.

Your flexibility with stances lets you sacrifice their benefits to better protect yourself. You leave the stance you were in, gaining a +4 circumstance bonus to the triggering saving throw or to your AC against the triggering attack.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 공격 대상이 되거나 피해 효과를 막기 위해 반사 내성 굴림을 시도할 때, 자세를 취하고 있어야 한다.

자세에 대한 유연성 덕분에 그 이점을 희생하여 자신을 더 잘 보호할 수 있습니다. 현재 취하고 있던 자세를 벗어나며, 발동된 저항에 대한 내성 굴림 또는 발동된 공격에 대한 AC에 +4 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Rokoan Arts

description.value: Ancestral spirits have begun to bond themselves to you, granting you powers characteristic of a rokoa. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.BBvV7qoXGdw09q1C]{Speak with Animals} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HTou8cG05yuSkesj]{Status} as primal innate spells once per day each.

_desc_en: Ancestral spirits have begun to bond themselves to you, granting you powers characteristic of a rokoa. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.BBvV7qoXGdw09q1C]{Speak with Animals} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HTou8cG05yuSkesj]{Status} as primal innate spells once per day each.
_desc_ko: 조상의 영혼들이 당신과 유대를 맺기 시작하여 로코아 특유의 힘을 부여합니다. 하루에 한 번씩 @link[spells.speak-with-animals]와 @link[spells.status]을 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Coordinated Distraction

description.value:
Access Help either the Washboard Dogs or the Diobel Sweepers destroy their rival.

With a sharp whistle or wave of your hands, you distract an opponent from the fact that one of your allies is about to attack them. Choose a target and an ally, both of whom must be within 30 feet. The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the first Strike the ally makes on their next turn; if your ally doesn't Strike that target, the effect is lost. Depending on how you describe your distraction, this action gains either the auditory or visual trait.

_desc_en:
Access Help either the Washboard Dogs or the Diobel Sweepers destroy their rival.

With a sharp whistle or wave of your hands, you distract an opponent from the fact that one of your allies is about to attack them. Choose a target and an ally, both of whom must be within 30 feet. The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the first Strike the ally makes on their next turn; if your ally doesn't Strike that target, the effect is lost. Depending on how you describe your distraction, this action gains either the auditory or visual trait.
_desc_ko:
접근 워시보드 독스 또는 디오벨 스위퍼스 중 한 쪽이 상대방을 파괴하도록 돕는다.

날카로운 휘파람 소리나 손짓으로, 상대방이 당신의 아군 중 한 명이 곧 공격하려 한다는 사실을 방해합니다. 30피트 이내에 있는 대상과 아군을 선택하세요. 대상은 다음 턴에 아군이 가하는 첫 번째 공격에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다. 아군이 해당 대상에게 강타하지 않으면 효과는 사라집니다. 주의 분산 방법을 어떻게 묘사하느냐에 따라 이 행동은 청각적 또는 시각적 특성을 얻습니다.

name: Arcane Shroud

description.value:
Frequency once per turn

Requirements Your most recent action was to Cast a Spell from a spell slot or make a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QDW9H8XLIjuW2fE4]{Spellstrike} with a spell from a spell slot.

Your magic has a powerful aftereffect, briefly granting you a certain spell. When you take this feat, choose three of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8ViwItUgwT4lOvvb]{False Vitality}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YrzBLPLd3r9m6t1p]{Fire Shield}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aEM2cttJ2eYcLssW]{Fleet Step}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zR67Rt3UMHKC5evy]{Flicker}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2BV2yYPfVJ5zirZt]{Mountain Resilience}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen}.

You use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HbejhIywqIufrmVM]{Arcane Cascade} and are subject to an additional aftereffect spell of your choice from the three you selected. This aftereffect spell's duration lasts until the end of your next turn or its normal duration, whichever is shorter. Using Arcane Shroud again ends any existing spell you gained from Arcane Shroud.

_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 턴당 1회

요구 사항 가장 최근에 수행한 행동이 주문 슬롯에서 주문을 시전하거나 주문 슬롯의 주문으로 @link[actions.spellstrike]를 사용한 것이어야 합니다.

당신의 마법은 강력한 잔여 효과를 지니며, 잠시 동안 특정 주문을 부여합니다. 이 피트를 선택할 때, 다음 중 세 가지를 선택하십시오: @link[spells.false-vitality], @link[spells.fire-shield], @link[spells.fleet-step], @link[spells.flicker], @link[spells.invisibility], @link[spells.mountain-resilience], @link[spells.see-the-unseen] 중 세 가지를 선택하십시오.

당신은 @link[actions.arcane-cascade]를 사용하며, 선택한 세 가지 중 하나를 추가 후유증 주문으로 받습니다. 이 후유증 주문의 지속 시간은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 또는 원래 지속 시간 중 더 짧은 쪽까지 유지됩니다. 비전의 장막을 다시 사용하면 비전의 장막으로 얻은 기존 주문이 모두 종료됩니다.

name: Lethal Edge

description.value:
Trigger Your Strike with your spectral dagger hits a frightened creature and deals spirit damage.

When the terrified are struck by your spectral weapon, they feel the anguish of every life taken by Silent Lenore. You apply one of the following effects, which lasts until the end of your next turn.

  • The target can't use reactions.
  • The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

_desc_en:
Trigger Your Strike with your spectral dagger hits a frightened creature and deals spirit damage.

When the terrified are struck by your spectral weapon, they feel the anguish of every life taken by Silent Lenore. You apply one of the following effects, which lasts until the end of your next turn.

  • The target can't use reactions.
  • The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신의 유령 단검 공격이 공포에 질린 생물을 명중시켜 영혼 피해를 입힙니다.

공포에 질린 생물이 당신의 유령 무기에 강타당하면, 침묵의 레노어가 앗아간 모든 생명의 고통을 느낍니다. 다음 효과 중 하나를 적용하며, 이는 당신의 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 지속됩니다.

  • 대상은 반응을 사용할 수 없습니다.
  • 대상은 @link[conditions.enfeebled]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Invisible Trickster

description.value: You have learned how to become invisible and remain so. You can cast 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} as a primal innate spell once per hour.

_desc_en: You have learned how to become invisible and remain so. You can cast 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} as a primal innate spell once per hour.
_desc_ko: 투명해지고 그 상태를 유지하는 법을 익혔습니다. 시간당 한 번씩 (4th) @link[spells.invisibility]를 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Woodcraft

description.value: You have a innate familiarity with forested areas. When in a forest or jungle environment, if you roll a critical failure on a Survival skill check to Sense Direction, Subsist, or Cover Tracks, you get a failure instead, and if you roll a success, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: You have a innate familiarity with forested areas. When in a forest or jungle environment, if you roll a critical failure on a Survival skill check to Sense Direction, Subsist, or Cover Tracks, you get a failure instead, and if you roll a success, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 숲 지역과 타고난 친숙함을 지녔습니다. 숲이나 정글 환경에서 방향 감지, 생존, 생계 유지, 발자국 추적 생존 기술 판정에서 대실패를 굴렸을 경우, 대신 실패를 얻습니다. 그리고 성공을 굴렸을 경우, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Prophesied Monarch Dedication

description.value:
Your Calling has culminated in a destiny of rulership, and you're able to forge a mythic bond with noble knights whose destinies become intertwined with your own. Designate up to five allies as your knights; as long as you're conscious, your knights' doomed condition can't rise above 3, and if they're ever in mortal peril (such as being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} with the dying condition or imprisoned in an enemy fortress), you instantly receive a vision revealing their location and condition.

In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SowCo0BXngrpatgn]{Royal Grace} exploration activity.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.qCtMGydkSVksIFOd]{Prophesied Monarch}

_desc_en:
Your Calling has culminated in a destiny of rulership, and you're able to forge a mythic bond with noble knights whose destinies become intertwined with your own. Designate up to five allies as your knights; as long as you're conscious, your knights' doomed condition can't rise above 3, and if they're ever in mortal peril (such as being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} with the dying condition or imprisoned in an enemy fortress), you instantly receive a vision revealing their location and condition.

In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SowCo0BXngrpatgn]{Royal Grace} exploration activity.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.qCtMGydkSVksIFOd]{Prophesied Monarch}
_desc_ko:
당신의 소명은 통치자의 운명으로 정점을 이루었으며, 운명이 당신과 얽히게 될 고귀한 기사들과 신화적인 유대를 형성할 수 있습니다. 최대 다섯 명의 동료를 당신의 기사들로 지정하십시오. 당신이 의식이 있는 한, 당신의 기사들의 {파멸} 상태는 3을 초과할 수 없으며, 그들이 치명적인 위험에 처했을 때(예: @link[conditions.unconscious] 상태에 죽어가는 상태를 가지거나 적의 요새에 포로로 잡혀 있을 때), 당신은 즉시 그들의 위치와 상태를 드러내는 환상을 받습니다.

또한 @link[actions.royal-grace] 탐사 능력을 획득한다.

name: Dueling Acumen

description.value: You're always ready for a new duel, and you've been trained to start and end fights quickly. When you're in a duel or can see exactly one creature, you can always roll Dueling Lore for initiative. If you do so while in a duel, you must choose from either Deception, Intimidation, or Perception when you roll for initiative; you're considered to have rolled the chosen skill for initiative for the purpose of dueling actions.

_desc_en: You're always ready for a new duel, and you've been trained to start and end fights quickly. When you're in a duel or can see exactly one creature, you can always roll Dueling Lore for initiative. If you do so while in a duel, you must choose from either Deception, Intimidation, or Perception when you roll for initiative; you're considered to have rolled the chosen skill for initiative for the purpose of dueling actions.
_desc_ko: 당신은 항상 새로운 결투를 준비하고 있으며, 싸움을 빠르게 시작하는 것과 끝내는 데 훈련을 받았습니다. 결투 중이거나 정확히 하나의 생물만 볼 수 있을 때, 당신은 항상 결투 지식지식 for 인니셔티브를 굴릴 수 있습니다. 결투 중에 이를 사용할 경우, 이니셔티브 주사위를 굴릴 때 기만, 위협, 지각 중 하나를 선택해야 한다. 결투 행동을 위한 이니셔티브 주사위 굴림 시 선택한 기술을 사용한 것으로 간주된다.

name: Perfect Strike

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GQopUYTuhmtb7WMG]{Perfect Strike} ki spell. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GQopUYTuhmtb7WMG]{Perfect Strike} ki spell. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.
_desc_ko: @link[spells.perfect-strike] 기(氣) 주문을 획득한다. 포커스 풀의 집중 포인트 수를 1 증가시킨다.

name: Dive of the Divine

description.value:
Requirements You are at least 20 feet above the ground.

You dive from the sky, bringing down the might of the divine with you. You Fly straight down, landing safely in the nearest unoccupied space directly below you. When you land, all creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] take @Damage[(ternary(gte(@actor.level,20),10,8))d10[spirit]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[type:fortitude|basic|against:class-spell|options:area-effect] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC). On a failure, the target is pushed 5 feet (or 10 feet on a critical failure).

At 20th level, the spirit damage increases to 10d10.

value.value: fly Speed of at least 20 feet

_desc_en:

You dive from the sky, bringing down the might of the divine with you. You Fly straight down, landing safely in the nearest unoccupied space directly below you. On a failure, the target is pushed 5 feet (or 10 feet on a critical failure).

At 20th level, the spirit damage increases to 10d10.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 지상에서 최소 20피트 이상 떨어져 있어야 합니다.

하늘에서 급강하하며 신성한 힘을 함께 내리꽂습니다. 당신은 곧장 아래로 날아가, 바로 아래에 있는 가장 가까운 빈 공간에 안전하게 착륙합니다. 착륙할 때, 10피트 발산 범위 내의 모든 생물은 영혼의 피해를 입습니다 (기본 인내 당신의 클래스 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 더 높은 것에 대한 내성 굴림). 실패 시 대상은 5피트 밀려난다(대실패 시 10피트).

20레벨에 도달하면 영혼 피해가 10d10으로 증가한다.

name: Augment Senses

description.value:
You open vestigial eyes, unfurl tympanic flaps of skin, or otherwise enhance your senses. Until the start of your next turn, you gain the following benefits: you can't be flanked; when you Seek for creatures, you can scan a @Template[cone|distance:60] or a @Template[burst|distance:30] instead of the normal area; and when you Seek for hidden objects, you can search a 15-foot square instead of the normal area.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.JwDCoBIwyhOFnDGZ]{Effect: Augment Senses}

_desc_en:
You open vestigial eyes, unfurl tympanic flaps of skin, or otherwise enhance your senses. Until the start of your next turn, you gain the following benefits: you can't be flanked; when you Seek for creatures, you can scan a @Template[cone|distance:60] or a @Template[burst|distance:30] instead of the normal area; and when you Seek for hidden objects, you can search a 15-foot square instead of the normal area.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.JwDCoBIwyhOFnDGZ]{Effect: Augment Senses}
_desc_ko:
잔존 눈을 뜨거나, 고막 덮개 피부를 펼치거나, 기타 방법으로 감각을 강화한다. 다음 차례 시작까지 다음과 같은 이점을 얻습니다: 측면 공격을 받을 수 없으며, 생물을 탐색할 때 일반적인 영역 대신 60피트 또는 30피트를 스캔할 수 있고, 숨겨진 물건을 탐색할 때 일반적인 영역 대신 15피트 정사각형을 검색할 수 있습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.JwDCoBIwyhOFnDGZ]{효과: 감각 증강}

name: Spiritual Headhunter

description.value: Your spirit coffin can temporarily detain the spirits of those you kill, allowing you to ask them one last question before they pass on. If you kill a creature with a slashing weapon, you can decapitate it and trap the spirit of its head in your spirit coffin. Once before your next daily preparations, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.FM3SmEW8N1FCRjqt]{Talking Corpse} as a primal innate spell, which targets the spiritual head trapped in your coffin, not its physical corpse. A ghostly version of the head manifests from the coffin to answer the questions, taking a –2 status penalty to its Will save to resist the spell. After the spell resolves, or 1 day later, the head is released and rejoins its spiritual body. You can trap only one spirit in this way at a time.

A ghostly version of the head manifests from the coffin to answer the questions, taking a –2 status penalty to its Will save to resist the spell. After the spell resolves, or 1 day later, the head is released and rejoins its spiritual body. You can trap only one spirit in this way at a time.
_desc_ko: 당신의 영혼 관은 당신이 죽인 자들의 영혼을 일시적으로 가둘 수 있어, 그들이 떠나기 전 마지막 질문을 던질 수 있게 합니다. 베는 무기로 생물을 죽인 경우, 그 머리를 잘라 영혼 관에 갇힐 수 있습니다. 다음 일일 준비 전에 한 번, @link[spells.talking-corpse]를 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 마법은 관에 갇힌 영혼의 머리를 대상으로 하며, 육체적 시체가 아닙니다. 유령 형태의 머리가 관에서 창조되어 질문에 답하며, 이 주문을 저항하는 의지 내성에 -2 상태 불이익을 받습니다. 주문이 해결되거나 1일 후, 머리는 풀려나 영혼의 몸과 재결합합니다. 한 번에 한 영혼만 이 방법으로 가둘 수 있습니다.

name: Legendary Laugh

description.value: Your laugher echoes in the minds of your enemies. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} creatures up to 60 feet away. Additionally, whenever you successfully Demoralize a creature, it takes @Damage[3d8[mental]] damage (or @Damage[6d8[mental]] damage on a critical success).

_desc_en: Your laugher echoes in the minds of your enemies. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} creatures up to 60 feet away. Additionally, whenever you successfully Demoralize a creature, it takes @Damage[3d8[mental]] damage (or @Damage[6d8[mental]] damage on a critical success).
_desc_ko: 당신의 웃음소리가 적들의 마음에 메아리칩니다. 당신은 @link[actions.demoralize] 효과를 최대 60피트 거리 내의 생물에게 줄 수 있습니다. 또한, 생물의 사기를 성공적으로 저하시킬 때마다, 해당 생물은 3d8 정신의 피해를 입습니다(대성공 시 6d8 정신의 피해를 입습니다).

name: Twin Parry

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding two melee weapons, one in each hand.

You use your two weapons to parry attacks. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, or a +2 circumstance bonus if either weapon has the parry trait. You lose this circumstance bonus if you no longer meet this feat's requirement.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding two melee weapons, one in each hand.

You use your two weapons to parry attacks. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, or a +2 circumstance bonus if either weapon has the parry trait. You lose this circumstance bonus if you no longer meet this feat's requirement.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손에 각각 근접 무기 하나씩을 들고 있어야 합니다.

두 무기로 공격을 패리해냅니다. 다음 턴 시작 전까지 AC에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 두 무기 중 하나라도 패리 특성을 지녔다면 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 피트의 요구 조건을 더 이상 충족하지 못하면 이 상황 보너스를 잃습니다.

name: Advantageous Assault

description.value:
After compromising your enemy's movement, you deliver a more deadly blow. Make a Strike against a creature that is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}. You gain a circumstance bonus to damage on this Strike equal to the number of weapon damage dice, or that number + 2 if you're wielding the weapon in two hands. The Strike gains the following failure effect.

Failure You deal damage to the target equal to the number of weapon damage dice, or that number + 2 if you're wielding the weapon in two hands. This damage has the same damage type as the weapon.

_desc_en:
After compromising your enemy's movement, you deliver a more deadly blow. Make a Strike against a creature that is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}. You gain a circumstance bonus to damage on this Strike equal to the number of weapon damage dice, or that number + 2 if you're wielding the weapon in two hands. The Strike gains the following failure effect.

Failure You deal damage to the target equal to the number of weapon damage dice, or that number + 2 if you're wielding the weapon in two hands. This damage has the same damage type as the weapon.
_desc_ko:
상대의 이동을 제한한 후, 더 치명적인 일격을 가합니다. @link[conditions.grabbed], @link[conditions.prone], 또는 @link[conditions.restrained] 상태인 생물에게 공격을 가한다. 이 공격의 피해에 무기 피해 주사위 수만큼의 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 양손으로 무기를 휘두르는 경우 해당 수치에 2를 더한 보너스를 얻는다. 이 공격은 다음과 같은 실패 효과를 가진다.

실패 대상에게 무기 피해 주사위 수만큼의 피해를 입힌다. 양손으로 무기를 휘두를 경우 해당 수치에 2를 더한다. 이 피해는 무기와 동일한 피해 유형을 가진다.

name: Pelagic Aptitude

description.value:
You've learned special tricks to survive underwater. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Survival.

When in an aquatic environment, if you roll a critical failure on a Survival skill check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.fJImDBQfqfjKJOhk]{Sense Direction} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{Subsist}, you get a failure instead.

rules.text: When in an aquatic environment, if you roll a critical failure on a Survival skill check to Sense Direction or Subsist, you get a failure instead.
rules.title: {item|name}

_desc_en:
You've learned special tricks to survive underwater. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Survival.

When in an aquatic environment, if you roll a critical failure on a Survival skill check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.fJImDBQfqfjKJOhk]{Sense Direction} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{Subsist}, you get a failure instead.
_desc_ko:
수중 생존을 위한 특별한 기술을 습득했습니다. 생존 기술에 숙련 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다.

수중 환경에서 @link[actions.sense-direction] 또는 @link[actions.subsist] 생존 기술 판정에서 대실패를 굴렸을 경우, 대신 실패로 처리됩니다.

name: Security

description.value: Those you shield can benefit from your lasting protection. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZL97DcoJ8us6EwAF]{Shields of the Spirit} using 2 actions instead of 1. If you do, you can choose one ally in your champion's aura to gain a spirit shield that accompanies it. For 1 minute, that ally gains the benefits of shields of the spirit, even while the ally isn't in your champion's aura and even if your shield isn't raised. If you create another companion shield, any previous one ends.

_desc_en: Those you shield can benefit from your lasting protection. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZL97DcoJ8us6EwAF]{Shields of the Spirit} using 2 actions instead of 1. If you do, you can choose one ally in your champion's aura to gain a spirit shield that accompanies it. For 1 minute, that ally gains the benefits of shields of the spirit, even while the ally isn't in your champion's aura and even if your shield isn't raised. If you create another companion shield, any previous one ends.
_desc_ko: 당신이 보호하는 대상은 지속적인 수호의 혜택을 받습니다. @link[spells.shields-of-the-spirit]를 1회 행동 대신 2회 행동으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 경우, 챔피언의 오라 범위 내 아군 한 명을 선택하여 영혼의 방패를 부여할 수 있습니다. 1분 동안, 그 아군은 영혼의 방패의 혜택을 받습니다. 아군이 당신의 챔피언 오라 안에 있지 않거나 당신의 방패가 발동되지 않은 상태에서도 적용됩니다. 다른 동반자 방패를 생성하면, 기존 방패는 모두 종료됩니다.

name: Speech of the Mammoth Lords

description.value: You've learned the ancient tongue spoken by the creatures of the far north. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, use the Diplomacy skill with, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce} megafauna. In most cases, megafauna of the Realm of the Mammoth Lords will hear you out.

_desc_en: You've learned the ancient tongue spoken by the creatures of the far north. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, use the Diplomacy skill with, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce} megafauna. In most cases, megafauna of the Realm of the Mammoth Lords will hear you out.
_desc_ko: 당신은 극북 지방 생물들이 사용하는 고대 언어를 익혔습니다. 당신은 거대동물에게 질문을 던지고, 답변을 받을 수 있으며, 외교 기술을 사용하거나 @link[actions.coerce]할 수 있습니다. 대부분의 경우, 매머드 렐름에 속한 거대동물들은 당신의 말을 들어줄 것입니다.

name: Unstoppable Juggernaut

description.value:
You have become a brutal, unstoppable force of nature, able to shrug off mortal wounds with ease. You gain resistance equal to 3 + your Constitution modifier to all damage, and your resistance from raging increases to 8 + your Constitution modifier.

In addition, if you are reduced to 0 Hit Points while raging, you can end your rage as a reaction to stay at 1 Hit Point. If you do, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded 2} (or increase your wounded condition by 2 if you are already wounded).

_desc_en:
You have become a brutal, unstoppable force of nature, able to shrug off mortal wounds with ease. You gain resistance equal to 3 + your Constitution modifier to all damage, and your resistance from raging increases to 8 + your Constitution modifier.

In addition, if you are reduced to 0 Hit Points while raging, you can end your rage as a reaction to stay at 1 Hit Point. If you do, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded 2} (or increase your wounded condition by 2 if you are already wounded).
_desc_ko:
당신은 잔혹하고 막을 수 없는 자연의 힘이 되어 치명상을 가볍게 무시할 수 있습니다. 모든 피해에 대해 3 + 건강 능력치 수정자만큼의 저항력을 얻으며, 분노 상태에서의 저항력은 8 + 건강 능력치 수정치로 증가합니다.

또한, 분노 상태에서 HP가 0이 되면, 반응으로 분노를 종료하여 HP를 1로 유지할 수 있습니다. 그렇게 하면 @link[conditions.wounded]{2} 상태가 됩니다(이미 부상 상태라면 부상 상태가 2 증가합니다).

name: Bloodletting Fangs

description.value: You emulate your vampiric parent's techniques for drawing blood from a victim. Your fangs Strikes deal an additional 1d4 persistent bleed damage on a critical hit.

_desc_en: You emulate your vampiric parent's techniques for drawing blood from a victim. Your fangs Strikes deal an additional 1d4 persistent bleed damage on a critical hit.
_desc_ko: 당신은 뱀파이어 혈통의 부모로부터 피를 빨아들이는 기술을 습득합니다. 당신의 송곳니 공격이 치명타를 기록할 경우 추가로 1d4 지속 출혈 피해를 입힙니다.

name: One-On-One

description.value:
Frequency once per round

Your true skill can be seen in a one-on-one fight where you have room to dance around your opponent. You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} and then Strike an adjacent creature with an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.iSceAVMkVv1uKK7t]{Aldori Dueling Sword}. The Feint attempt must be against the same target as your Strike.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per round

Your true skill can be seen in a one-on-one fight where you have room to dance around your opponent. You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} and then Strike an adjacent creature with an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.iSceAVMkVv1uKK7t]{Aldori Dueling Sword}. The Feint attempt must be against the same target as your Strike.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 라운드당 1회

상대방 주위를 춤추듯 움직일 수 있는 일대일 싸움에서 진정한 실력이 드러난다. @link[actions.feint]를 시도한 후 @link[equipment.aldori-dueling-sword]으로 인접한 생물을 공격한다. 페인트 시도는 공격 대상과 동일해야 한다.

name: Vanara Weapon Expertise

description.value: Thanks to numerous joyous practice exercises, you've become an expert in vanara weapons. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in a given weapon or weapons, you also gain that proficiency in the bo staff, chakram, katar, panabas, urumi, and all vanara weapons in which you're trained.

_desc_en: Thanks to numerous joyous practice exercises, you've become an expert in vanara weapons. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in a given weapon or weapons, you also gain that proficiency in the bo staff, chakram, katar, panabas, urumi, and all vanara weapons in which you're trained.
_desc_ko: 수많은 즐거운 연습을 통해 당신은 바나라 무기의 전문가가 되었습니다. 특정 무기나 무기들에 대해 전문가 이상의 숙련도를 부여하는 클래스 특성을 획득할 때마다, 당신은 육척봉, 차크람, 카타르, 파나바스, 우루미, 그리고 훈련받은 모든 바나라 무기들에 대해서도 동일한 숙련도를 얻습니다.

name: Improvised Critical

description.value: You can apply critical specialization effects to improvised weapons you wield. For any given improvised weapon, the GM determines which critical specialization effect is most applicable, based on the type of object it is.

_desc_en: You can apply critical specialization effects to improvised weapons you wield. For any given improvised weapon, the GM determines which critical specialization effect is most applicable, based on the type of object it is.
_desc_ko: 임시로 만든 무기에 치명타 특화 효과를 적용할 수 있습니다. 각 임시 무기에 대해 GM은 해당 물건의 종류를 기준으로 가장 적합한 치명타 특화 효과를 결정합니다.

name: Inherit the Dreaming Heirloom

description.value:
Whether you always carried it or perhaps only recently inherited, you have a pusaka—an heirloom containing a spirit who you communicate with in your dreams. Choose one item of light Bulk to be your pusaka. It becomes a magic item that has the occult trait. As long as you sleep with this item in reach and spend 10 minutes during your daily preparations pampering the spirit within, you can Activate the pusaka that day.

Activate—Ancestral Recollection 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect The spirit within the pusaka advises you on a subject they knew in life. When you gain this feat, select one Lore skill about a profession and one about a type of environment, such as Accounting Lore and Forest Lore. When you Activate the pusaka, you attempt to Recall Knowledge using one of these skills (you become temporarily trained in these skills for this check). Once you make your choice of Lore skills, they can't be changed.

Activate—Guide My Dreams 2 (concentrate)

Effect You ask the spirit within the pusaka to show you the way. You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.izcxFQFwf3woCnFs]{Guidance} as an occult cantrip. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

Whether you always carried it or perhaps only recently inherited, you have a pusaka—an heirloom containing a spirit who you communicate with in your dreams. Choose one item of light Bulk to be your pusaka. It becomes a magic item that has the occult trait. Frequency once per day

When you Activate the pusaka, you attempt to Recall Knowledge using one of these skills (you become temporarily trained in these skills for this check). Once you make your choice of Lore skills, they can't be changed.

Activate—Guide My Dreams 2 (concentrate)

Effect You ask the spirit within the pusaka to show you the way. You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.izcxFQFwf3woCnFs]{Guidance} as an occult cantrip. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko:
평생 지니고 다녔든 최근에 물려받았든, 당신은 푸사카를 소유하고 있다. 꿈속에서 소통하는 영혼이 깃든 가보다. 가벼운 벌크의 물건 하나를 당신의 푸사카로 선택하세요. 이 물건은 오컬트 특성을 지닌 마법 아이템이 됩니다. 매일 잠들 때 이 아이템을 손이 닿는 곳에 두고, 하루 준비 시간 중 10분을 들여 그 안에 깃든 영혼을 돌본다면, 그날 하루 동안 푸사카를 활성화할 수 있습니다.

활성화-조상의 기억 1 (집중)

발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

효과 푸사카 안에 깃든 영혼이 생전에 알고 있던 주제에 대해 조언해 줍니다. 이 피트를 획득하면 직업 관련 지식 하나와 환경 유형 관련 지식 하나를 선택하세요(예: 회계 지식와 숲 지식). 푸사카를 활성화할 때, 이 기술 중 하나로 지식 회상 시도를 합니다(이 판정 동안 해당 기술에 대해 일시적으로 숙련됩니다). 지식 기술 선택 후에는 변경할 수 없습니다.

활성화-꿈을 인도하라 2 (집중)

효과 당신은 푸사카 안에 깃든 영혼에게 길을 보여달라고 요청합니다. 당신은 @link[spells.guidance]를 오컬트 캔트립으로 시전합니다. 캔트립은 당신의 레벨 절반(올림)에 해당하는 주문 랭크으로 강화됩니다.

name: Distant Wandering

description.value:
Your body falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and your spirit projects out of it. While in spirit form, you can't consciously move your body, and you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} and inaudible, though a creature still might notice the signs of your presence and passing, just like for an invisible creature affected by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gIdDLrbswTV3OBJy]{Silence}, or a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ek5XI0aEdZhBgm21]{Scouting Eye}. You can freely move about, though you can't touch or move anything, cast spells, attack, or otherwise affect anything around you. Despite your ghostly form, you are not incorporeal and can't pass through barriers you couldn't in your body. Most effects can't harm your spirit form, though some spells, like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PHVHBbdHeQRfjLmE]{Spirit Blast} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ht35SDf9PDStJfoC]{Spirit Song}, explicitly damage a creature's spirit.

You can return to your body as a free action. If you are in spirit form at the beginning of your turn, you must attempt another backlash check for your deviation, returning to your body if you fail.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ngwcN8u7f7CnqGXp]{Effect: Distant Wandering}

Awakening Your spirit moves at the speed of thought. You gain a fly Speed and a +20-foot status bonus to your Speed while in spirit form.

Note: No specific fly speed was given by Paizo for this ability. A fly speed equal to your land speed has been used in the effect.

Awakening Time seems to pass more slowly while you are projecting your spirit, letting you notice things around you. When you enter spirit form, you can Recall Knowledge or Seek. You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} while in spirit form and can use the extra action only to Recall Knowledge or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek}.

_desc_en:
Your body falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and your spirit projects out of it. While in spirit form, you can't consciously move your body, and you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} and inaudible, though a creature still might notice the signs of your presence and passing, just like for an invisible creature affected by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gIdDLrbswTV3OBJy]{Silence}, or a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ek5XI0aEdZhBgm21]{Scouting Eye}. You can freely move about, though you can't touch or move anything, cast spells, attack, or otherwise affect anything around you. Despite your ghostly form, you are not incorporeal and can't pass through barriers you couldn't in your body. Most effects can't harm your spirit form, though some spells, like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PHVHBbdHeQRfjLmE]{Spirit Blast} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ht35SDf9PDStJfoC]{Spirit Song}, explicitly damage a creature's spirit.

You can return to your body as a free action. If you are in spirit form at the beginning of your turn, you must attempt another backlash check for your deviation, returning to your body if you fail.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ngwcN8u7f7CnqGXp]{Effect: Distant Wandering}

Awakening Your spirit moves at the speed of thought. You gain a fly Speed and a +20-foot status bonus to your Speed while in spirit form.

Note: No specific fly speed was given by Paizo for this ability. A fly speed equal to your land speed has been used in the effect.

Awakening Time seems to pass more slowly while you are projecting your spirit, letting you notice things around you. When you enter spirit form, you can Recall Knowledge or Seek. You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} while in spirit form and can use the extra action only to Recall Knowledge or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek}.
_desc_ko:
당신의 육체는 @link[conditions.unconscious] 상태가 되고 영혼이 육체를 벗어나 투사됩니다. 영혼 형태로 있을 때, 당신은 의식적으로 육체를 움직일 수 없으며 @link[conditions.invisible]하고 소리를 내지 못하지만, @link[spells.silence]의 영향을 받는 투명 생물이나 @link[spells.scouting-eye]과 마찬가지로 다른 생물이 당신의 존재나 이동 흔적을 감지할 수는 있다. 주변을 자유롭게 이동할 수 있지만, 물건을 만지거나 움직이거나, 주문을 시전하거나, 공격하거나, 주변에 영향을 미칠 수는 없다. 유령 형태임에도 비물질적이 아니므로, 육체 상태에서 통과할 수 없었던 장벽을 통과할 수 없습니다. 대부분의 효과는 영혼 형태에 피해를 줄 수 없으나, @link[spells.spirit-blast]이나 @link[spells.spirit-song]처럼 명시적으로 생물의 영혼에 피해를 주는 일부 주문은 예외입니다.

자유 행동으로 육체로 돌아갈 수 있습니다. 자신의 턴 시작 시 영혼이라면, 편차에 대한 또 다른 역효과 판정을 시도해야 하며, 실패 시 육체로 돌아갑니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ngwcN8u7f7CnqGXp]{효과: 원거리 방랑}

각성 당신의 영혼은 생각의 속도로 이동합니다. 영혼 형태일 때 비행 속도를 얻으며, 이동 속도에 +20피트 상태 보너스가 적용됩니다.

참고: Paizo는 이 능력에 대해 특정 비행 속도를 명시하지 않았습니다. 효과에는 지상 속도와 동일한 비행 속도가 적용되었습니다.

각성 영혼을 투사하는 동안 시간은 더 느리게 흐르는 듯하여 주변 사물을 인지할 수 있습니다. 영혼 형태로 진입할 때 지식 회상이나 탐색을 사용할 수 있습니다. 영혼 형태에서는 @link[conditions.quickened] 상태가 되어 추가 행동을 오직 지식 회상이나 @link[actions.seek]에만 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Monastic Archer Stance

description.value:
Requirements You are unarmored and wielding a longbow, shortbow, or a bow with the monk trait.

You enter a specialized stance for a unique martial art centered around the use of a bow. While in this stance, the only Strikes you can make are those using longbows, shortbows, or bows with the monk trait.

You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.nbfNETdpee8CVM17]{Flurry of Blows} with these bows. You can use your other monk feats or monk abilities that normally require unarmed attacks with these bows when attacking within half the first range increment (normally 50 feet for a longbow and 30 feet for a shortbow), so long as the feat or ability doesn't require a single, specific Strike.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.1dxD3xsTzak6GNj5]{Stance: Monastic Archer Stance}

Special When you select this feat, you become trained in the longbow, shortbow, and any simple and martial bows with the monk trait. If you gain the expert strikes class feature, your proficiency rank for these weapons increases to expert, and if you gain the master strikes class feature, your proficiency rank for these weapons increases to master.

_desc_en:

You enter a specialized stance for a unique martial art centered around the use of a bow. While in this stance, the only Strikes you can make are those using longbows, shortbows, or bows with the monk trait.

You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.nbfNETdpee8CVM17]{Flurry of Blows} with these bows. You can use your other monk feats or monk abilities that normally require unarmed attacks with these bows when attacking within half the first range increment (normally 50 feet for a longbow and 30 feet for a shortbow), so long as the feat or ability doesn't require a single, specific Strike.

_desc_ko:
요구 사항 갑옷을 착용하지 않은 상태에서 장궁, 단궁 또는 몽크 특성이 부여된 활을 사용 중이어야 합니다.

활 사용을 중심으로 한 독특한 무술을 위한 특화된 자세를 취합니다. 이 자세를 취하는 동안 사용할 수 있는 공격은 장궁, 단궁 또는 몽크 특성을 가진 활을 사용한 공격뿐입니다.

이 활들로 @link[actions.flurry-of-blows]를 사용할 수 있습니다. 첫 번째 사거리 증가량의 절반 이내(일반적으로 장궁은 50피트, 단궁은 30피트)에서 공격할 때, 해당 재주나 능력이 단일 특정 타격을 요구하지 않는 한, 무기 없이 수행해야 하는 다른 몽크 재주나 몽크 능력을 이 활들로 사용할 수 있습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.1dxD3xsTzak6GNj5]{자세: 수도승 궁수 자세}

특수 이 피트를 선택하면 롱보우, 쇼트보우, 그리고 몽크 특성을 가진 모든 단순 활과 무술 활에 숙련됩니다. 전문 강타 직업 클래스 특성을 획득하면 이 무기들에 대한 숙련도 등급이 전문가로 상승하며, 달인 강타 직업 클래스 특성을 획득하면 숙련도 등급이 달인으로 상승한다.

name: Arcane Eye

description.value:
Your eye has been magically enhanced to pierce darkness. You gain darkvision.

Enhancement Your eye can see @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures in brief spurts. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen} as an arcane innate spell once per hour.

_desc_en:
Your eye has been magically enhanced to pierce darkness. You gain darkvision.

Enhancement Your eye can see @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures in brief spurts. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen} as an arcane innate spell once per hour.
_desc_ko:
당신의 눈은 마법으로 강화되어 어둠을 관통할 수 있습니다. 암흑 시야를 얻습니다.

강화 당신의 눈은 @link[conditions.invisible] 생물을 잠깐씩 볼 수 있습니다. 시간당 한 번씩 @link[spells.see-the-unseen]를 아케인 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Soulsight (Sorcerer)

description.value:
The spiritual essence in your blood has opened your senses to the world beyond. You gain spiritsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 60 feet.

Spiritsense enables you to sense the spirits of creatures, including living creatures, most non-mindless undead, and haunts within the listed range. As with your hearing and other imprecise senses, you still need to [[/act seek]] to locate an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} creature.

As spiritsense detects spiritual essence, not physical bodies, it can detect spirits projected by spells such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0873MWM0qKDDv81O]{Project Image} or possessing otherwise soulless objects. It can't detect soulless bodies, constructs, or objects, and like most senses, it doesn't penetrate through solid objects.

value.value: bloodline that grants divine or occult spells

As spiritsense detects spiritual essence, not physical bodies, it can detect spirits projected by spells such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0873MWM0qKDDv81O]{Project Image} or possessing otherwise soulless objects. _desc_ko:
피 속에 흐르는 영혼의 정수가 너의 감각을 저 너머 세계로 열어주었다. 너는 60피트 범위의 부정확한 감각으로 영혼감지 능력을 얻는다.

영감각은 지정된 범위 내의 생명체, 대부분의 무의식 언데드, 그리고 유령을 포함한 생물의 영혼을 감지할 수 있게 합니다. 청각 및 기타 부정확한 감각과 마찬가지로, 감지되지 않은 생물의 위치를 파악하려면 여전히 @link[actions.seek]이 필요합니다.

영혼감지 능력은 육체가 아닌 영적 본질을 감지하므로, @link[spells.project-image] 같은 주문으로 투사된 영혼이나 영혼이 없는 물체를 점유한 영혼도 감지할 수 있습니다. 영혼이 없는 시체, 인공 생명체, 물체는 감지할 수 없으며, 대부분의 감각과 마찬가지로 고체 물체를 관통하지 못합니다.

name: Proud Nail

description.value:
Requirements Your taunted enemy is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} because it didn't target you or include you in an area effect.

When a foe ignores your taunts, you make them pay. Make a melee Strike against your taunted enemy. If this Strike hits, you deal an extra die of weapon damage. If you're at least 10th level, increase this to two extra dice, and if you're at least 18th level, increase it to three extra dice.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your taunted enemy is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} because it didn't target you or include you in an area effect.

When a foe ignores your taunts, you make them pay. Make a melee Strike against your taunted enemy. If this Strike hits, you deal an extra die of weapon damage. If you're at least 10th level, increase this to two extra dice, and if you're at least 18th level, increase it to three extra dice.
_desc_ko:
Requirements 도발당한 적은 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태입니다. 당신을 표적으로 삼지 않았거나 영역 효과에 포함시키지 않았기 때문입니다.

적이 당신의 도발을 무시하면, 그 대가를 치르게 합니다. 도발한 적에게 근접 공격을 가하십시오. 이 공격이 적중하면 무기 피해에 추가 주사위 하나를 더합니다. 10레벨 이상일 경우 추가 주사위를 두 개로, 18레벨 이상일 경우 세 개로 증가시킵니다.

name: Acclimated Mount

description.value:
By the grace of your god, your mount can overcome the natural challenges and hazards present in a specific terrain. Choose aquatic, arctic, desert, forest, mountain, plains, sky, swamp, or underground. Your mount must have a swim Speed to select aquatic, and a fly Speed to select sky. Your mount ignores the effects of difficult terrain while in the selected terrain.

If you become an expert in Survival, you can pray during your daily preparations each day to change the type of terrain to which your mount is acclimated.

_desc_en:
By the grace of your god, your mount can overcome the natural challenges and hazards present in a specific terrain. Choose aquatic, arctic, desert, forest, mountain, plains, sky, swamp, or underground. Your mount must have a swim Speed to select aquatic, and a fly Speed to select sky. Your mount ignores the effects of difficult terrain while in the selected terrain.

If you become an expert in Survival, you can pray during your daily preparations each day to change the type of terrain to which your mount is acclimated.
_desc_ko:
신의 은총으로, 당신의 탈것은 특정 지형에 존재하는 자연적 도전과 위험을 극복할 수 있습니다. 수중, 북극, 사막, 숲, 산악, 평원, 하늘, 습지, 지하 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 수중을 선택하려면 탈것의 수영 속도가, 하늘을 선택하려면 비행 속도가 있어야 합니다. 선택한 지형 내에서 탈것은 어려운 지형의 효과를 무시합니다.

생존 기술에 숙달되면 매일 준비 시간에 기도하여 탈것이 적응하는 지형 유형을 변경할 수 있습니다.

name: Free from Bonds

description.value:
As a mortal herald, you cannot easily be captured, nor can your allies. If you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} when you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.N9kJPSRz1Ax9eFdD]{Flash of Omnipresence}, the creature or effect that is imparting that condition on you takes @Damage[(@actor.level)[spirit]]{spirit damage} equal to your level.

If you teleport adjacent to a grabbed or restrained ally using Flash of Omnipresence, attempt a @Check[religion] check against the hard DC for the level of the creature or effect that is imparting that condition. on a success, your ally no longer has that condition.

_desc_en:
As a mortal herald, you cannot easily be captured, nor can your allies. If you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} when you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.N9kJPSRz1Ax9eFdD]{Flash of Omnipresence}, the creature or effect that is imparting that condition on you takes @Damage[(@actor.level)[spirit]]{spirit damage} equal to your level.

If you teleport adjacent to a grabbed or restrained ally using Flash of Omnipresence, attempt a @Check[religion] check against the hard DC for the level of the creature or effect that is imparting that condition. on a success, your ally no longer has that condition.
_desc_ko:
필멸의 전령으로서, 당신은 쉽게 포로가 될 수 없으며 동맹 역시 마찬가지입니다. 당신이 @link[feats.flash-of-omnipresence]을 사용할 때, 그 상태를 부여한 생물이나 효과는 네 레벨과 동일한 영혼 피해를 받는다.

만능의 섬광으로 붙잡기되거나 구속된 아군 옆으로 순간이동할 경우, 해당 상태를 부여하는 생물이나 효과의 레벨에 해당하는 어려운 난이도(DC)에 맞서 종교학 판정을 시도하십시오. 성공 시 아군은 더 이상 해당 상태를 가지지 않습니다.

name: Magnetic Field

description.value:
A magnetic field surrounds you. Choose a polarity when you take this action. You can switch the polarity as a free action at the start of each of your turns while you remain in this stance.

Attract A creature that is wearing metal armor, has the metal trait, or is made of metal treats squares in your kinetic aura as difficult terrain when moving away from you. You pull unattended metal objects of light Bulk or less in your kinetic aura to you. They gather in your space and move with you.

Repel A creature that is wearing metal armor, has the metal trait, or is made of metal treats squares in your kinetic aura as difficult terrain when moving closer to you. You push unattended metal objects of light Bulk or less in your kinetic aura away. They stop moving once they're outside your aura.

You push unattended metal objects of light Bulk or less in your kinetic aura away. They stop moving once they're outside your aura.
_desc_ko:
자력이 당신을 둘러싼다. 이 행동을 취할 때 극성을 선택한다. 이 자세를 유지하는 동안 매 턴 시작 시 자유 행동으로 극성을 바꿀 수 있다.

끌어당김 금속 갑옷을 착용하거나 금속 속성을 지녔거나 금속으로 만들어진 생물은 당신으로부터 멀어지며 이동할 때 당신의 키네틱 오라 내 칸을 어려운 지형으로 간주합니다. 당신은 키네틱 오라 내 경량 이하의 방치된 금속 물체를 자신 쪽으로 끌어당깁니다. 이 물체들은 당신의 공간에 모여 당신과 함께 이동합니다.

밀어내기 금속 갑옷을 착용하거나 금속 속성을 지녔거나 금속으로 만들어진 생물은 당신에게 접근할 때 당신의 키네틱 오라 내의 칸을 어려운 지형으로 간주합니다. 당신은 당신의 키네틱 오라 내에 있는 방치된 경량 이하 금속 물체를 밀어냅니다. 이 물체들은 당신의 오라 밖으로 나가면 움직임을 멈춥니다.

name: Guardian's Deflection (Swashbuckler)

description.value:
Trigger An ally within your melee reach is hit by an attack, you can see the attacker, and a +2 circumstance bonus to AC would turn the critical hit into a hit or the hit into a miss.

Requirements You are wielding a single one-handed melee weapon and have your other hand or hands free.

You use your weapon to deflect the attack against your ally, granting a +2 circumstance bonus to their AC against the triggering attack. This turns the triggering critical hit into a hit, or the triggering hit into a miss. You gain panache until the end of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.w6X7io56B2HHTOvs]{Effect: Guardian's Deflection}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.paKKHPds77fq5VTH]{Effect: Panache (Temporary)}

_desc_en:
Trigger An ally within your melee reach is hit by an attack, you can see the attacker, and a +2 circumstance bonus to AC would turn the critical hit into a hit or the hit into a miss.

Requirements You are wielding a single one-handed melee weapon and have your other hand or hands free.

You use your weapon to deflect the attack against your ally, granting a +2 circumstance bonus to their AC against the triggering attack. This turns the triggering critical hit into a hit, or the triggering hit into a miss. You gain panache until the end of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.w6X7io56B2HHTOvs]{Effect: Guardian's Deflection}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.paKKHPds77fq5VTH]{Effect: Panache (Temporary)}
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 근접 공격 범위 내 아군이 공격을 받았고, 공격자를 볼 수 있으며, AC에 +2 상황 보너스가 적용되어 치명타를 명중으로, 또는 명중을 빗나감으로 바꿀 수 있는 경우.

요구 사항 한 손으로 한 자루의 근접 무기를 휘두르고 있으며, 다른 손이나 손이 자유로워야 합니다.

당신은 무기를 사용하여 아군을 향한 공격을 막아내며, 해당 공격에 대한 아군의 AC에 +2 상황 보너스를 부여합니다. 이로 인해 치명타는 명중으로, 명중은 빗나감으로 바뀝니다. 당신은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.uBJsxCzNhje8m8jj]{파나슈}를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.w6X7io56B2HHTOvs]{효과: 가디언의 회피}

name: Gladiator's Roar

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You can project your voice into a high-pitched screech that damages your foes. Your roar can be heard twice as far as normal, and creatures within a @Template[cone|distance:15] take @Damage[6d10[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage and must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. If your Gladiator's Roar triggers Play to the Crowd, you gain a +2 status bonus to your Performance check to do so.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}

Failure The creature takes full damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You can project your voice into a high-pitched screech that damages your foes. Your roar can be heard twice as far as normal, and creatures within a @Template[cone|distance:15] take @Damage[6d10[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage and must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. If your Gladiator's Roar triggers Play to the Crowd, you gain a +2 status bonus to your Performance check to do so.
