Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신은 고음의 날카로운 비명 소리를 내어 적에게 피해를 줄 수 있습니다. 당신의 포효는 평소보다 두 배 멀리까지 들리며, 15피트 범위 내의 생물들은 6d10 음파의 피해를 입으며, 당신의 클래스 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 더 높은 쪽에 대한 인내 내성을 시도해야 합니다. 글래디에이터의 포효가 관중을 달래기 효과를 유발하면, 이를 수행하는 공연 판정에서 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

대성공 생물은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 생물은 절반의 피해를 입으며 @link[conditions.frightened]{1}

상태가 됩니다.

실패 생물은 전체 피해를 입으며 @link[conditions.frightened]{2} 상태가 됩니다.

대실패 생물은 두 배의 피해를 입으며 @link[conditions.frightened]{3} 상태가 되고 @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태가 된다.

name: Familiar Sage Dedication

description.value:
You've forged an empowered mystical bond with your familiar. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.N7dTFxpjXGn4ddq8]{Enhanced Familiar} feat, increasing your familiar's number of abilities.

Special You can take Familiar Sage Dedication even if you haven't yet gained three feats from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.yaR8E2drX6pFUFCK]{Familiar Master} archetype, and you can take Familiar Master Dedication even if you haven't yet gained three feats from the familiar sage archetype. You can't select another dedication feat until you've gained two other feats from the familiar master or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.bi4WaRQzrOwuEILM]{Familiar Sage} archetypes.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You've forged an empowered mystical bond with your familiar. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.N7dTFxpjXGn4ddq8]{Enhanced Familiar} feat, increasing your familiar's number of abilities.

Special You can take Familiar Sage Dedication even if you haven't yet gained three feats from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.yaR8E2drX6pFUFCK]{Familiar Master} archetype, and you can take Familiar Master Dedication even if you haven't yet gained three feats from the familiar sage archetype. You can't select another dedication feat until you've gained two other feats from the familiar master or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.bi4WaRQzrOwuEILM]{Familiar Sage} archetypes.
_desc_ko:
당신은 패밀리어와 강화된 신비한 유대를 형성했습니다. @link[feats.enhanced-familiar] 피트를 획득하여 패밀리어의 능력 사용 횟수를 증가시킵니다.

특수 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.yaR8E2drX6pFUFCK]{패밀리어 마스터} 아키타입에서 세 가지 피트를 아직 획득하지 않았더라도 Familiar Sage 헌신을 선택할 수 있으며, Familiar Sage 아키타입에서 세 가지 피트를 아직 획득하지 않았더라도 Familiar Master 헌신을 선택할 수 있습니다. 친숙한 마스터 또는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.bi4WaRQzrOwuEILM]{친숙한 현자} 아키타입에서 다른 두 가지 피트를 획득하기 전까지는 다른 헌신 피트를 선택할 수 없습니다.

name: Snap Falling Fruit

description.value:
Trigger You or an ally within reach of your lash is the target of a physical ranged attack.

Your lash whips around to intercept projectiles. The target gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses, you knock it out of the air.

_desc_en:
Trigger You or an ally within reach of your lash is the target of a physical ranged attack.

Your lash whips around to intercept projectiles. The target gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses, you knock it out of the air.
_desc_ko:
발동조건 너 또는 너의 채찍이 닿는 범위 내의 아군이 물리 원거리 공격의 대상이 된다.

네 채찍이 날아오는 투사체를 가로막는다. 대상은 발동 공격에 대해 AC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻는다. 공격이 빗나갈 경우, 공중에서 쳐내 버린다.

name: Tumble Behind (Rogue)

description.value: You tumble under and behind your foe, your rapid movement letting you catch them off guard. When you successfully [[/act tumble-through]], the foe whose space you passed through is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the next attack you make before the end of your turn.

_desc_en: You tumble under and behind your foe, your rapid movement letting you catch them off guard. When you successfully [[/act tumble-through]], the foe whose space you passed through is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the next attack you make before the end of your turn.
_desc_ko: 당신은 적의 아래로 굴러 뒤로 빠져나간다. 빠른 움직임으로 적을 무방비하게 만든다. 당신이 @link[actions.tumble-through]에 성공하면, 당신이 통과한 공간의 적들은 당신의 턴이 끝나기 전까지 당신이 가하는 다음 공격에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard]가 된다.

name: Winter's Clutch

description.value:
Gleaming flakes of chilling snow fall in a @Template[burst|distance:10] within 60 feet. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -1)/2)+2)d4[cold]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. The ground in the area is covered in a snow drift, which is difficult terrain. Each square of the drift lasts until it melts, either naturally or until fire damage is dealt in that square.

Level (+2) The damage increases by 1d4.

_desc_en:
Gleaming flakes of chilling snow fall in a @Template[burst|distance:10] within 60 feet. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -1)/2)+2)d4[cold]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. The ground in the area is covered in a snow drift, which is difficult terrain. Each square of the drift lasts until it melts, either naturally or until fire damage is dealt in that square.

Level (+2) The damage increases by 1d4.
_desc_ko:
60피트 이내의 10피트에 차가운 눈송이가 반짝이며 내립니다. 해당 영역 내 모든 생물은 냉기 피해를 입으며, 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 기본 반사 내성을 발휘할 수 있습니다. 영역 내 지면은 눈더미로 덮여 있으며, 이는 어려운 지형입니다. 눈더미의 각 칸은 자연적으로 녹거나 해당 칸에 화염 피해가 가해질 때까지 지속됩니다.

레벨 (+2) 피해량이 1d4 증가합니다.

name: Junk Tinker

description.value:
You can make useful tools out of even twisted or rusted scraps. When using the Crafting skill to Craft, you can make level 0 items, including weapons and armor, out of junk. This reduces the Price to one-quarter the usual amount but always results in a shoddy item. Shoddy items normally give a penalty, but you don't take this penalty when using shoddy items you made (nor does the worse check penalty of shoddy armor you made apply to you).

You can also incorporate junk to save money while you Craft any item. This grants you a discount on the item as if you had spent 1 additional day working to reduce the cost, but the item is obviously made of junk. At the GM's discretion, this might affect the item's resale value depending on the buyer's tastes.

_desc_en:
You can make useful tools out of even twisted or rusted scraps. When using the Crafting skill to Craft, you can make level 0 items, including weapons and armor, out of junk. This reduces the Price to one-quarter the usual amount but always results in a shoddy item. Shoddy items normally give a penalty, but you don't take this penalty when using shoddy items you made (nor does the worse check penalty of shoddy armor you made apply to you).

You can also incorporate junk to save money while you Craft any item. This grants you a discount on the item as if you had spent 1 additional day working to reduce the cost, but the item is obviously made of junk. At the GM's discretion, this might affect the item's resale value depending on the buyer's tastes.
_desc_ko:
뒤틀리거나 녹슨 찌꺼기 조각으로도 유용한 도구를 만들 수 있습니다. 제작 기술을 사용해 제작할 때, 폐품으로 무기와 방어구를 포함한 레벨 0 아이템을 만들 수 있습니다. 이 경우 가격은 일반적인 금액의 1/4로 감소하지만, 항상 조잡한 아이템이 생성됩니다. 엉성한 아이템은 일반적으로 페널티를 주지만, 자신이 만든 엉성한 아이템을 사용할 때는 이 페널티를 받지 않습니다(자신이 만든 엉성한 갑옷의 더 나쁜 판정 페널티도 적용되지 않습니다).

또한 어떤 아이템을 제작할 때도 잡동사니를 활용해 비용을 절감할 수 있습니다. 이는 마치 추가로 하루 동안 작업해 비용을 줄인 것처럼 아이템에 할인을 적용하지만, 해당 아이템은 명백히 잡동사니로 만들어진 것입니다. GM의 재량에 따라 구매자의 취향에 따라 아이템의 재판매 가치에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

name: Frozen Breadth

description.value: Your attunement to arcane cold enhances the depths of your growing power. Increase the number of spells in your repertoire and number of spell slots you gain from gelid shard archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest gelid shard spell slots.

_desc_en: Your attunement to arcane cold enhances the depths of your growing power. Increase the number of spells in your repertoire and number of spell slots you gain from gelid shard archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest gelid shard spell slots.
_desc_ko: 당신의 아케인 냉기 마법과의 조화는 성장하는 힘의 깊이를 강화합니다. 얼음 조각 아키타입 재주로 얻는 주문 목록과 주문 슬롯 수를, 가장 높은 두 개의 얼음 조각 주문 슬롯을 제외한 각 주문 랭크마다 1씩 증가시킵니다.

name: Friendly Fling

description.value:
Requirements You are adjacent to an ally.

You can scoop up your friends with your horns to hurl them across the battlefield. Pick up an adjacent willing ally who is smaller than you and toss them to an unoccupied space you can see within 20 feet. Since you are using your horns, you don't need to have any hands free to do this. Your ally's movement doesn't trigger reactions. Your ally ends this movement on their feet and doesn't take damage from the fall but takes @Damage[1d6[piercing]] damage from your horns. If your ally ends this movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, they can make a melee Strike against an enemy within their reach as a reaction.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are adjacent to an ally.

You can scoop up your friends with your horns to hurl them across the battlefield. Pick up an adjacent willing ally who is smaller than you and toss them to an unoccupied space you can see within 20 feet. Since you are using your horns, you don't need to have any hands free to do this. Your ally's movement doesn't trigger reactions. Your ally ends this movement on their feet and doesn't take damage from the fall but takes @Damage[1d6[piercing]] damage from your horns. If your ally ends this movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, they can make a melee Strike against an enemy within their reach as a reaction.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 아군과 인접해 있어야 합니다.

뿔로 아군을 들어 올려 전장을 가로질러 던질 수 있습니다. 인접한 의지가 있는 아군 중 자신보다 작은 아군을 들어 올려 20피트 이내에 보이는 빈 공간으로 던집니다. 뿔을 사용하므로 빈 손을 할 필요가 없습니다. 동료의 이동은 반응을 유발하지 않습니다. 동료는 이 이동을 끝내며 발로 서 있고 추락 피해는 받지 않지만, 당신의 뿔로부터 1d6 관통의 피해를 입습니다. 동료가 적어도 한 명의 적과 근접 공격 범위 내에 이 이동을 끝낸다면, 반응으로 자신의 범위 내 적을 상대로 근접 공격을 시도할 수 있습니다.

name: Ancestral Mage

description.value: The magic of your ancestry and bloodline are one and the same. Add any innate spells you have from a heritage or an ancestry feat to your spell repertoire, meaning you can cast them using your spell slots.

_desc_en: The magic of your ancestry and bloodline are one and the same. Add any innate spells you have from a heritage or an ancestry feat to your spell repertoire, meaning you can cast them using your spell slots.
_desc_ko: 조상의 마법과 혈통의 마법은 하나다. 혈통 피트나 조상 피트에서 얻은 선천적 주문을 주문 목록에 추가한다. 즉, 주문 슬롯을 사용해 이 주문을 시전할 수 있다.

name: Crack Retort

description.value: You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KAVf7AmRnbCAHrkT]{Reactive Strike} with a loaded firearm you're wielding. The triggering creature must be within 5 feet of you for you to do so.

_desc_en: You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KAVf7AmRnbCAHrkT]{Reactive Strike} with a loaded firearm you're wielding. The triggering creature must be within 5 feet of you for you to do so.
_desc_ko: 당신은 들고 있는 장전된 화기로 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KAVf7AmRnbCAHrkT]{반응 타격}을 사용할 수 있다. 그렇게 하려면 발동을 유발한 크리처가 당신으로부터 5피트 이내에 있어야 한다.

name: Cascade Bearer's Flexibility

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You haven't yet acted on your turn.

You call upon your Cascade Bearer training to help you adjust a spell for the current situation. Until the end of your turn, you gain a single spellshape feat from the druid class or the wizard class that has a level requirement of no more than half your level.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You haven't yet acted on your turn.

You call upon your Cascade Bearer training to help you adjust a spell for the current situation. Until the end of your turn, you gain a single spellshape feat from the druid class or the wizard class that has a level requirement of no more than half your level.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

요구 사항 자신의 턴에 아직 행동하지 않았을 것.

당신은 폭포의 전승자 훈련을 활용하여 현재 상황에 맞게 주문을 조정합니다. 당신의 턴이 끝날 때까지, 드루이드 클래스 또는 위자드 클래스에서 레벨 요구 조건이 당신의 레벨 절반 이하인 주문형성 재주 하나를 획득합니다.

name: Geologic Attunement

description.value:
You tune to the earth and stone around you, extending your senses through it in rippling waves. You gain tremorsense (imprecise) in your kinetic aura. Once per round, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.sn2hIy1iIJX9Vpgj]{Point Out} a creature you can sense with tremorsense as a free action.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ebCWQB5nfK19GpY5]{Stance: Geologic Attunement}

Level (13th) The tremorsense becomes precise.

_desc_en:
You tune to the earth and stone around you, extending your senses through it in rippling waves. You gain tremorsense (imprecise) in your kinetic aura. Once per round, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.sn2hIy1iIJX9Vpgj]{Point Out} a creature you can sense with tremorsense as a free action.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ebCWQB5nfK19GpY5]{Stance: Geologic Attunement}

Level (13th) The tremorsense becomes precise.
_desc_ko:
주변의 땅과 돌에 조화를 이루며, 파동처럼 퍼져나가는 감각을 확장합니다. 당신은 키네틱 오라 내에서 진동 감지 능력(정확하지 않음)을 얻습니다. 라운드당 한 번, 진동 감지로 감지할 수 있는 생물을 @link[actions.point-out]할 수 있습니다. 이는 무료 행동입니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ebCWQB5nfK19GpY5]{자세: 지질적 조율}

레벨 (13레벨) 지진 감지 능력이 정밀해집니다.

name: Inflame Crowd

description.value: Your performances are a call to action for the crowds who listen to you. For 1 hour after you successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} using Performance, you can make a Request of a member of the affected audience using [[/act make-an-impression skill=performance]]{Performance} instead of Diplomacy.

_desc_en: Your performances are a call to action for the crowds who listen to you. For 1 hour after you successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} using Performance, you can make a Request of a member of the affected audience using [[/act make-an-impression skill=performance]]{Performance} instead of Diplomacy.
_desc_ko: 당신의 공연은 청중에게 행동을 촉구하는 호소입니다. 성공적으로 @link[actions.make-an-impression]를 공연으로 수행한 후 1시간 동안, 외교 대신 공연을 사용하여 영향을 받은 청중 구성원에게 요청을 할 수 있습니다.

name: Embodied Dragoon Subjectivity

description.value: When your allies call for swift reinforcements or lightning raids, you're ready to answer. Your titanic form encompasses both cavalry and rider so that you're able to traverse vast distances and exploit opportunities in the theater of war. Your pores distend and extrude copious amounts of blood, subcutaneous fat, and lymphatic fluid for you to harden and flash-sculpt into gliding wings or a swift-hurtling mount. You can cast feather fall and phantom steed each once per day as innate occult spells. When you cast feather fall in this way, gliding wings slow your fall, and when you cast phantom steed in this way, the steed physically protrudes from your own lower body. Neither of these cosmetic changes alter the spells' effects; for example, foes can still attack the phantom steed as normal.

_desc_en: When your allies call for swift reinforcements or lightning raids, you're ready to answer. Your titanic form encompasses both cavalry and rider so that you're able to traverse vast distances and exploit opportunities in the theater of war. Your pores distend and extrude copious amounts of blood, subcutaneous fat, and lymphatic fluid for you to harden and flash-sculpt into gliding wings or a swift-hurtling mount. You can cast feather fall and phantom steed each once per day as innate occult spells. When you cast feather fall in this way, gliding wings slow your fall, and when you cast phantom steed in this way, the steed physically protrudes from your own lower body. Neither of these cosmetic changes alter the spells' effects; for example, foes can still attack the phantom steed as normal.
_desc_ko: 동료들이 신속한 증원이나 번개 같은 기습을 요청할 때, 당신은 응답할 준비가 되어 있다. 당신의 거대한 형태는 기병과 기수를 모두 아우르므로 광활한 거리를 가로지르고 전장에서 기회를 포착할 수 있다. 모공이 팽창하여 다량의 혈액, 피하 지방, 림프액을 분비하면, 이를 굳혀 순식간에 활공용 날개나 신속하게 질주하는 탈것으로 조각해낸다. 깃털 낙하와 환영의 탈것를 각각 하루에 한 번씩 선천적 오컬트 주문으로 시전할 수 있다. 깃털 낙하를 이렇게 시전하면 활공하는 날개가 낙하 속도를 늦추며, 환영의 말를 이렇게 시전하면 말의 형상이 당신의 하반신에서 물리적으로 돌출됩니다. 이러한 외형적 변화는 주문 효과에 영향을 미치지 않습니다. 예를 들어, 적들은 여전히 환상마를 정상적으로 공격할 수 있습니다.

name: Conflux Focus

description.value:
You imagine how you'll weave magic and combat into future battles, improving your focus.

If you have spent at least 2 Focus Points since the last time you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OSefkMgojBLqmRDh]{Refocused}, you recover 2 Focus Points when you Refocus instead of 1.

_desc_en:
You imagine how you'll weave magic and combat into future battles, improving your focus.

If you have spent at least 2 Focus Points since the last time you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OSefkMgojBLqmRDh]{Refocused}, you recover 2 Focus Points when you Refocus instead of 1.
_desc_ko:
미래 전투에서 마법과 전투를 어떻게 조화시킬지 상상하며 포커스를 높입니다.

마지막으로 @link[actions.refocus]한 이후 최소 2점의 포커스를 소모했다면, 포커스 재조정 시 1점이 아닌 2점의 포커스를 회복한다.

name: Monster Hunter

description.value:
You quickly assess your prey and apply what you know. As part of the action used to Hunt your Prey, you can attempt a check to Recall Knowledge about your prey. When you critically succeed at identifying your hunted prey with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, you note a weakness in the creature's defenses in addition to any other benefits. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll against that prey, and any ally you tell gains the same benefit. You can give bonuses from Monster Hunter only once per day against a particular creature.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.W2tWq0gdAcnoz2MO]{Effect: Monster Hunter}

_desc_en:
You quickly assess your prey and apply what you know. As part of the action used to Hunt your Prey, you can attempt a check to Recall Knowledge about your prey. When you critically succeed at identifying your hunted prey with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, you note a weakness in the creature's defenses in addition to any other benefits. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll against that prey, and any ally you tell gains the same benefit. You can give bonuses from Monster Hunter only once per day against a particular creature.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.W2tWq0gdAcnoz2MO]{Effect: Monster Hunter}
_desc_ko:
당신은 사냥감을 재빨리 평가하고 지식을 활용합니다. 사냥감 추적 행동의 일환으로, 사냥감에 대한 지식을 회상하는 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다. @link[actions.recall-knowledge]으로 사냥감을 식별하는 데 대성공하면, 다른 혜택과 더불어 해당 생물의 방어력 약점을 파악한다. 해당 사냥감에 대한 다음 명중 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 이를 알린 아군도 동일한 혜택을 받는다. 특정 생물에게 몬스터 헌터의 보너스는 하루에 한 번만 부여할 수 있다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.W2tWq0gdAcnoz2MO]{효과: 몬스터 헌터}

name: Bravo's Determination

description.value:
Trigger A foe's Strike reduces you to 0 Hit Points; you were not at 1 Hit Point and you would not be killed.

Your confidence borders on self-delusion, but it keeps you going against overwhelming odds. Attempt a Deception check against the attack DC of the triggering Strike. You take a penalty to this check equal to twice your wounded value, if any. If the triggering attack was a critical hit, use the result one degree of success worse than what you rolled.

Critical Success You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point.

Success You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point, but you increase your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} value by 1.

_desc_en:
Trigger A foe's Strike reduces you to 0 Hit Points; you were not at 1 Hit Point and you would not be killed.

Your confidence borders on self-delusion, but it keeps you going against overwhelming odds. Attempt a Deception check against the attack DC of the triggering Strike. You take a penalty to this check equal to twice your wounded value, if any. If the triggering attack was a critical hit, use the result one degree of success worse than what you rolled.

Critical Success You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point.

Success You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point, but you increase your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} value by 1.
_desc_ko:
발동조건 적의 공격으로 당신의 HP가 0이 되었을 때, 당신이 1 HP가 아니었고 사망하지 않았을 경우.

당신의 자신감은 자기기만에 가깝지만, 압도적인 역경 속에서도 버티게 합니다. 발동 공격의 DC에 대해 기만 판정을 시도하세요. 부상 수치가 있다면 그 두 배에 해당하는 페널티를 받습니다. 발동 공격이 치명타였다면, 검사 결과는 주사위 결과보다 한 단계 낮은 성공 등급으로 적용됩니다.

대성공 기절을 피하고 1 HP를 유지한다.

성공 기절을 피하고 1 HP로 남지만, @link[conditions.wounded] 수치를 1 증가시킵니다.

name: Call the Hurricane

description.value:
Massive waves spiral around you, with you as the eye of the hurricane. The waves appear in a @Template[emanation|distance:20], or a @Template[emanation|distance:30] if you're in a body of water. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -8)/2)+6)d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. A creature that fails its save is battered by the waves and pushed 10 feet (or 20 feet on a critical failure).

Level (+2) The damage increases by 1d8.

_desc_en:
Massive waves spiral around you, with you as the eye of the hurricane. The waves appear in a @Template[emanation|distance:20], or a @Template[emanation|distance:30] if you're in a body of water. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -8)/2)+6)d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. A creature that fails its save is battered by the waves and pushed 10 feet (or 20 feet on a critical failure).

Level (+2) The damage increases by 1d8.
_desc_ko:
당신을 허리케인의 눈으로 삼은 거대한 파도가 소용돌이치며 당신 주위를 휘감습니다. 파도는 20피트 범위, 물속에 있을 경우 30피트 범위 내에 나타납니다. 해당 영역 내 모든 생물은 타격 피해를 입으며, 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 기본 반사 내성에 성공해야 합니다. 내성에 실패한 생물은 파도에 휩쓸려 10피트(대실패 시 20피트) 밀려납니다.

레벨 (+2) 피해량이 1d8 증가합니다.

name: Surging Might

description.value:
You focus the power of your spell to overcome enemies' resistances. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell, the spell ignores an amount of the target's resistance equal to your level against the following types of damage: spirit, vitality, and void.

This applies to all damage the spell deals, including persistent damage and damage caused by an ongoing effect of the spell. This doesn't cause the spell to ignore immunities, only resistances.

_desc_en:
You focus the power of your spell to overcome enemies' resistances. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell, the spell ignores an amount of the target's resistance equal to your level against the following types of damage: spirit, vitality, and void.

This applies to all damage the spell deals, including persistent damage and damage caused by an ongoing effect of the spell. This doesn't cause the spell to ignore immunities, only resistances.
_desc_ko:
당신은 적의 저항력을 극복하기 위해 주문력을 포커스합니다. 다음 행동으로 주문을 시전할 경우, 해당 주문은 대상의 저항력 중 당신의 레벨에 해당하는 양을 무시하며 다음 유형의 피해에 대해 적용됩니다: 영혼, 활력, 공허.

이는 지속 피해 및 주문 지속 효과로 인한 피해를 포함하여 주문이 입히는 모든 피해에 적용됩니다. 이는 면역을 무시하게 하지 않으며, 오직 저항만 무시합니다.

name: Monastic Weaponry

description.value: You have trained with the weaponry of your monastery or school. You gain access to uncommon weapons with the monk trait and become trained in simple and martial monk weapons. When your proficiency for unarmed attacks increases to expert or master, your proficiency rank for these weapons increases to expert or master as well. If you have familiarity with an agile or finesse weapon (such as from the Catfolk Weapon Familiarity feat), that weapon also gains the monk trait for you. You can use melee monk weapons with any of your monk feats or monk abilities that normally require unarmed attacks, though not if the feat or ability requires you to use a single specific type of attack, such as Crane Stance. If you gain the critical specialization benefit for unarmed attacks—with the expert strikes class feature, for example—you also gain it with monk weapons.

_desc_en: You have trained with the weaponry of your monastery or school. You gain access to uncommon weapons with the monk trait and become trained in simple and martial monk weapons. When your proficiency for unarmed attacks increases to expert or master, your proficiency rank for these weapons increases to expert or master as well. If you have familiarity with an agile or finesse weapon (such as from the Catfolk Weapon Familiarity feat), that weapon also gains the monk trait for you. You can use melee monk weapons with any of your monk feats or monk abilities that normally require unarmed attacks, though not if the feat or ability requires you to use a single specific type of attack, such as Crane Stance. If you gain the critical specialization benefit for unarmed attacks—with the expert strikes class feature, for example—you also gain it with monk weapons.
_desc_ko: 당신은 소속 수도원이나 무술 학교의 무기 사용법을 훈련받았습니다. 당신은 몽크 특성과 함께 특이 무기에 대한 접근 권한을 얻으며, 단순 무기와 무술 무기에 숙련됩니다. 무기 사용 숙련도가 숙련자 또는 달인 단계로 상승하면, 해당 무기들의 숙련도 등급도 숙련자 또는 달인으로 상승합니다. 기민한 무기나 기교 무기에 대한 패밀리어(예: 캣포크 무기 친숙도 재주)를 보유한 경우, 해당 무기도 당신에게 몽크 특성을 부여합니다. 근접 무술 무기는 몽크 재주나 능력 중 비무장 공격을 요구하는 것이라면 모두 사용할 수 있으나, 특정 공격 유형(예: 학의 자세)만을 요구하는 재주나 능력은 예외입니다. 비무장 공격에 대한 치명타 특화 혜택(예: 전문가의 일격 클래스 특성)을 획득하면 무술 무기에도 동일하게 적용됩니다.

name: Lead Investigator

description.value: You spend 1 minute briefing up to four allies about one of your open investigations. Those allies gain the same circumstance bonus you do from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xTK2zsWFyxSJvYbX]{Pursue a Lead} to checks to investigate the question at the heart of that investigation. This bonus lasts until you cease Pursing that Lead or for 1 day, whichever comes first. This doesn't confer any other benefits of pursuing a lead, such as adding the circumstance bonus to your saves with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.5cYFHKQK6OZCwavI]{Detective's Readiness}.

_desc_en: You spend 1 minute briefing up to four allies about one of your open investigations. Those allies gain the same circumstance bonus you do from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xTK2zsWFyxSJvYbX]{Pursue a Lead} to checks to investigate the question at the heart of that investigation. This bonus lasts until you cease Pursing that Lead or for 1 day, whichever comes first. This doesn't confer any other benefits of pursuing a lead, such as adding the circumstance bonus to your saves with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.5cYFHKQK6OZCwavI]{Detective's Readiness}.
_desc_ko: 당신은 1분 동안 최대 4명의 동맹에게 진행 중인 수사 중 하나에 대해 브리핑합니다. 해당 동맹들은 @link[actions.pursue-a-lead]에서 당신이 얻는 상황 보너스와 동일한 보너스를 해당 수사의 핵심 질문을 조사하는 판정에서 얻습니다. 이 보너스는 해당 단서를 추적하는 것을 중단하거나 1일이 경과할 때까지 지속됩니다(둘 중 먼저 도래하는 시점). 이는 @link[feats.detectives-readiness]로 인한 내성에 상황 보너스를 추가하는 등 단서 추적의 다른 이점을 부여하지 않습니다.

name: Sovereign's Blade

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a melee weapon.

As you raise your weapon into the air, it begins to shed a bright light that pierces darkness and calls your knights to your side. Spend a Mythic Point; you automatically counteract any magical darkness whose counteract rank is 7 or lower. Any knight who can see your raised weapon can immediately use their reaction to Stride up to twice directly toward you, and any of your knights who are adjacent to you after this movement get a +2 status bonus to their attack rolls until the start of your next turn.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a melee weapon.

As you raise your weapon into the air, it begins to shed a bright light that pierces darkness and calls your knights to your side. Spend a Mythic Point; you automatically counteract any magical darkness whose counteract rank is 7 or lower. Any knight who can see your raised weapon can immediately use their reaction to Stride up to twice directly toward you, and any of your knights who are adjacent to you after this movement get a +2 status bonus to their attack rolls until the start of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
Requirements 근접 무기를 휘두르고 있어야 합니다.

무기를 공중으로 치켜들자, 어둠을 관통하는 빛을 발하며 기사들을 당신 곁으로 부르는 광채가 퍼져 나갑니다. 신화 포인트 1점을 소모하면, 반격 등급이 7 이하인 모든 마법적 어둠을 자동으로 무효화합니다. 당신의 들어 올린 무기를 볼 수 있는 기사는 즉시 반응을 사용해 최대 두 번까지 당신을 향해 곧장 이동할 수 있으며, 이 이동 후 당신과 인접한 기사는 다음 턴 시작까지 명중 굴림에 +2 상태 보너스를 받습니다.

name: Cushion Landing

description.value:
Trigger You fall from a height of 15 feet or higher.

Requirements Your mount can reach your landing location with a single Stride.

As you fall, your mount dashes to your rescue. Your mount Strides up to its Speed, positioning itself below you. Rather than falling on your mount, you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PM5jvValFkbFH3TV]{Mount} your mount. Treat the triggering fall as if it were 15 feet shorter, and you don't land @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} (though both you and your mount both take damage from the fall based on what you would normally take for any remaining distance).

_desc_en:
Trigger You fall from a height of 15 feet or higher.

Requirements Your mount can reach your landing location with a single Stride.

As you fall, your mount dashes to your rescue. Your mount Strides up to its Speed, positioning itself below you. Rather than falling on your mount, you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PM5jvValFkbFH3TV]{Mount} your mount. Treat the triggering fall as if it were 15 feet shorter, and you don't land @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} (though both you and your mount both take damage from the fall based on what you would normally take for any remaining distance).
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 15피트 이상의 높이에서 추락할 때.

요구 사항 당신의 탈것이 한 이동으로 착지 지점에 도달할 수 있어야 합니다.

추락하는 동안, 당신의 탈것이 당신을 구하기 위해 달려옵니다. 당신의 탈것은 자신의 속도만큼 이동하여 당신 아래에 위치합니다. 탈것 위로 떨어지는 대신, 당신은 @link[actions.mount] 탈것을 탑니다. 추락 거리를 15피트 줄인 것으로 간주하며, @link[conditions.prone]로 착지하지 않습니다(단, 남은 거리만큼의 추락 피해를 당신과 탈것 모두 정상적으로 받습니다).

name: Basic Summoner Spellcasting

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.TwSQ0VPXZL0mfPez#basic-bounded-spellcasting-feat]{Basic Bounded Spellcasting Feat} benefits. You gain the Cast a Spell activity. Your key spellcasting ability for summoner archetype spells is Charisma, and they are summoner spells of your eidolon's tradition. You become trained in spell attack rolls and spell DCs of that tradition. You gain a spell repertoire and two cantrips. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the summoner archetype, add a spell of that rank or lower to your repertoire. Each time you lose spell slots of a particular rank, remove those spells from your repertoire.

Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the summoner archetype, add a spell of that rank or lower to your repertoire. Each time you lose spell slots of a particular rank, remove those spells from your repertoire.
_desc_ko: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.TwSQ0VPXZL0mfPez#basic-bounded-spellcasting-feat]{기본 제한된 주문 시전 피트}의 혜택을 얻습니다. 주문 시전 활동을 얻습니다. 소환사 아키타입 주문에 대한 주요 주문 시전 능력치는 매력이며, 이 주문들은 당신의 에이돌론 전통에 속하는 소환사 주문입니다. 해당 전통의 주문 명중 굴림과 주문 난이도(DC)에 숙련됩니다. 주문 목록과 두 개의 캔트립을 얻습니다. 소환사 아키타입으로부터 새로운 랭크의 주문 슬롯을 얻을 때마다, 해당 랭크 이하의 주문을 주문 목록에 추가합니다. 특정 랭크의 주문 슬롯을 잃을 때마다, 해당 레퍼토리에서 그 랭크의 주문을 제거합니다.

name: Beacon Mark

description.value:
When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.AUctDF2fqPZN2w4W]{Sigil}, you can modify the spell to add the following heightened entry.

Heightened (4th) You attune yourself to the marked target. While the spell lasts, you can spend a single action, which has the concentrate, detection, and divination traits, to attempt to locate the target, learning the direction to the target as long as you are within 1 mile of it. If the target is a creature or a creature is in possession of the target object, the creature can attempt a @Check[will] saving throw against your spell DC. If it succeeds, your attempt to locate the target fails and you can't attempt this again for 1 day. You can only have a single target marked with a sigil modified in this way. If you Cast this Spell again on a second target, the sigil spell on the first target ends, and your mark fades.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en:
When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.AUctDF2fqPZN2w4W]{Sigil}, you can modify the spell to add the following heightened entry.

Heightened (4th) You attune yourself to the marked target. While the spell lasts, you can spend a single action, which has the concentrate, detection, and divination traits, to attempt to locate the target, learning the direction to the target as long as you are within 1 mile of it. If the target is a creature or a creature is in possession of the target object, the creature can attempt a @Check[will] saving throw against your spell DC. If it succeeds, your attempt to locate the target fails and you can't attempt this again for 1 day. You can only have a single target marked with a sigil modified in this way. If you Cast this Spell again on a second target, the sigil spell on the first target ends, and your mark fades.
_desc_ko:
{인장}을 시전할 때, 다음 강화 항목을 추가하도록 주문을 수정자할 수 있다.

강화된 (4th) 표적된 대상과 교감한다. 주문이 지속되는 동안, 집중, 탐지, 점술 특성을 가진 액션 하나를 소모하여 대상의 위치를 파악하려고 시도할 수 있다. 대상과 1마일 이내에 있는 한, 대상의 방향을 알게 된다. 표적이 생물이나 표적 물건을 소지한 생물일 경우, 해당 생물은 당신의 주문 DC에 맞서 의지 내성 굴림을 시도할 수 있습니다. 성공하면 표적 찾기 시도는 실패하며, 1일 동안 다시 시도할 수 없습니다. 이렇게 수정자로 조정된 표식으로 표시된 표적은 단 하나만 가질 수 있습니다. 두 번째 대상에게 이 주문을 다시 시전하면 첫 번째 대상의 인장 주문이 종료되고 표식이 사라집니다.

name: Lifelink Surge

description.value: You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lOZhcvtej10TqlQm]{Lifelink Surge} link spell. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.

_desc_en: You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lOZhcvtej10TqlQm]{Lifelink Surge} link spell. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.
_desc_ko: @link[spells.lifelink-surge] 링크 주문을 습득합니다. 포커스 풀의 포커스 포인트 수를 1 증가시킵니다.

name: Necromantic Deflection

description.value: You imbue your shield with life-giving energy to deflect harmful necromantic magic. When you have your shield raised, you gain the shield's circumstance bonus to your AC and saving throws against necromancy spells. If you have the Shield Block reaction, damage you take as a result of a necromancy spell can trigger that reaction, even if it isn't physical damage.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en: You imbue your shield with life-giving energy to deflect harmful necromantic magic. When you have your shield raised, you gain the shield's circumstance bonus to your AC and saving throws against necromancy spells. If you have the Shield Block reaction, damage you take as a result of a necromancy spell can trigger that reaction, even if it isn't physical damage.
_desc_ko: 방패에 생명을 주는 에너지를 불어넣어 해로운 네크로맨틱 마법을 반사합니다. 방패를 든 상태에서는 네크로맨시 주문에 대한 AC와 내성 굴림에 방패의 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 방패 막기 반응을 보유한 경우, 네크로맨시 주문으로 인한 피해는 물리적 피해가 아니더라도 해당 반응을 발동시킬 수 있다.

name: Mighty Bear

description.value: The power of the bear within you can expand your physical presence even further. The @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge} spell you cast with your Great Bear feat is heightened to 4th level.

_desc_en: The power of the bear within you can expand your physical presence even further. The @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge} spell you cast with your Great Bear feat is heightened to 4th level.
_desc_ko: 당신 안에 깃든 곰의 힘은 육체적 존재감을 더욱 확장시킬 수 있습니다. @link[spells.enlarge] 주문을 위대한 곰 피트로 시전할 때 (4th)레벨로 강화됩니다.

name: Aura of Life

description.value: Your aura protects against the power of the Void. You and all allies in your champion's aura gain resistance 5 to void damage and a +1 status bonus to saves against void effects.

_desc_en: Your aura protects against the power of the Void. You and all allies in your champion's aura gain resistance 5 to void damage and a +1 status bonus to saves against void effects.
_desc_ko: 당신의 오라는 공허의 힘으로부터 보호합니다. 당신과 챔피언의 오라 안에 있는 모든 아군은 공허 피해에 대한 저항력 5를 얻으며, 공허 효과에 대한 내성에 +1 상태 보너스를 받습니다.

name: Tumbling Opportunist

description.value:
Frequency once per minute

Requirements Your most recent action was to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jfsmtOx4QgXB19BL]{Tumbling Strike}, and you successfully moved through an enemy's space.

You use a burst of stamina to perform a breathtaking feat of Acrobatics as you speed through a foe's space, leaving your foe lying flat on their back. You attempt to [[/act trip]] the enemy whose space you moved through. You can use Acrobatics ([[/act trip skill=acrobatics]]) instead of Athletics for this check.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per minute

Requirements Your most recent action was to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jfsmtOx4QgXB19BL]{Tumbling Strike}, and you successfully moved through an enemy's space.

You use a burst of stamina to perform a breathtaking feat of Acrobatics as you speed through a foe's space, leaving your foe lying flat on their back. You attempt to [[/act trip]] the enemy whose space you moved through. You can use Acrobatics ([[/act trip skill=acrobatics]]) instead of Athletics for this check.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 분당 1회

요구 사항 귀하의 가장 최근 행동은 @link[actions.tumble-through] 또는 @link[feats.tumbling-strike]를 사용했으며, 적의 공간을 성공적으로 통과했습니다.

체력을 폭발적으로 사용해 아크로바틱스 기술로 숨 막히는 묘기를 선보이며 적의 공간을 가로질러, 적을 뒹굴게 만들었습니다. 당신은 통과한 적의 공간에 있는 적을 @link[actions.trip] 시도합니다. 이 판정에는 곡예를 운동 대신 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Spellmaster's Ward

description.value: You can create a number of powerful shielding runes that bolster your defenses against damaging spells by absorbing the worst of the energy to keep you safe. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VrhCpCIQB8PFax77]{Spellmaster's Ward} focus spell. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en: You can create a number of powerful shielding runes that bolster your defenses against damaging spells by absorbing the worst of the energy to keep you safe. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VrhCpCIQB8PFax77]{Spellmaster's Ward} focus spell. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.
_desc_ko: 당신은 강력한 방어용 룬을 여러 개 생성하여, 피해를 주는 마법으로부터 자신을 보호할 수 있습니다. 이 룬들은 가장 강력한 에너지를 흡수하여 당신을 안전하게 지켜줍니다. 당신은 @link[spells.spellmasters-ward] 포커스 주문을 얻습니다. 포커스 풀의 포커스 포인트 수를 1 증가시킵니다.

name: Acute Vision

description.value: When you are raging, your visual senses improve, granting you darkvision.

_desc_en: When you are raging, your visual senses improve, granting you darkvision.
_desc_ko: 분노 상태일 때 시각이 향상되어 암흑 시야를 얻습니다.

name: Release Spores

description.value:
You create a miasma of spores. These spores fill a @Template[burst|distance:20] within 100 feet and remain for 1 round per level you have. All creatures within the spores become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the spores become concealed to creatures within it. You can see through the spores without difficulty. You can Dismiss the spores.

Awakening The spores smell disgusting. Creatures in the area are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} for as long as they remain in the area, plus 2 rounds.

Awakening The spores are toxic. The miasma deals @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))[poison]|options:area-damage] damage per 2 levels you have to creatures in the area when you Release Spores, to creatures who begin their turn in the area, and to creatures who enter the area.

_desc_en:
You create a miasma of spores. These spores fill a @Template[burst|distance:20] within 100 feet and remain for 1 round per level you have. All creatures within the spores become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the spores become concealed to creatures within it. You can see through the spores without difficulty. You can Dismiss the spores.

Awakening The spores smell disgusting. Creatures in the area are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} for as long as they remain in the area, plus 2 rounds.

Awakening The spores are toxic. The miasma deals @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))[poison]|options:area-damage] damage per 2 levels you have to creatures in the area when you Release Spores, to creatures who begin their turn in the area, and to creatures who enter the area.
_desc_ko:
포자 미아즈마를 생성합니다. 이 포자들은 100피트 내의 20피트를 채우며, 당신의 레벨당 1라운드 동안 유지됩니다. 포자 내부의 모든 생물은 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태가 되며, 포자 외부 생물은 내부 생물에게 은폐 상태로 인식됩니다. 당신은 포자를 통해 아무런 어려움 없이 볼 수 있습니다. 포자를 해제할 수 있습니다.

각성 포자는 역겨운 냄새를 풍깁니다. 해당 지역에 있는 생물은 그곳에 머무는 동안 @link[conditions.sickened]{1} 상태가 되며, 추가로 2라운드 동안 지속됩니다.

각성 포자는 독성이 있습니다. 포자를 방출할 때, 해당 영역에 있는 생물, 자신의 턴을 해당 영역에서 시작하는 생물, 그리고 해당 영역에 진입하는 생물에게 2레벨당 [옵션: 영역 피해]의 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Victorious Vigor

description.value:
Trigger You bring a foe to 0 Hit Points

Your victories in battle fill you with pride and imbue you with the energy to fight a bit longer despite your wounds. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier until the end of your next turn.

_desc_en:
Trigger You bring a foe to 0 Hit Points

Your victories in battle fill you with pride and imbue you with the energy to fight a bit longer despite your wounds. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier until the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 적의 HP를 0으로 만들 때

전투에서의 승리는 당신을 자부심으로 채우고, 상처에도 불구하고 조금 더 싸울 수 있는 에너지를 부여합니다. 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 건강 수정자만큼의 임시 HP를 얻습니다.

name: Reflecting Riposte

description.value:
Trigger An opponent casts a spell and you critically succeed at a saving throw against it.

Requirements You have a shield raised or are benefiting from Dueling Parry or Twin Parry.

You attempt to counteract the triggering spell using powerful magical techniques observed in the Kortos Mounts. Use your attack roll modifier with your shield or parrying weapon for your counteract check. If you counteract the spell, it is reflected upon the caster. If the spell targeted individual creatures, it targets the caster only. If the spell targeted an area centered on a point, the new area is centered on the caster. If the spell was a cone or line, the cone or line emanates from you toward the caster. If the spell has a save DC, it uses your class DC, and if it requires a spell attack roll, use the same attack roll modifier as the counteract check.

value.value: Dueling Riposte, Mirror Shield, or Twin Riposte

_desc_en:
Trigger An opponent casts a spell and you critically succeed at a saving throw against it.

Requirements You have a shield raised or are benefiting from Dueling Parry or Twin Parry.

You attempt to counteract the triggering spell using powerful magical techniques observed in the Kortos Mounts. Use your attack roll modifier with your shield or parrying weapon for your counteract check. If you counteract the spell, it is reflected upon the caster. If the spell targeted individual creatures, it targets the caster only. If the spell targeted an area centered on a point, the new area is centered on the caster. If the spell was a cone or line, the cone or line emanates from you toward the caster. If the spell has a save DC, it uses your class DC, and if it requires a spell attack roll, use the same attack roll modifier as the counteract check.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 상대방이 주문을 시전하고, 당신이 그 주문에 대한 내성 굴림에서 대성공을 거둘 때.

요구 사항 방패를 들고 있거나, 결투 패리 또는 쌍방 패리의 효과를 받고 있어야 합니다.

코르토스 산맥에서 목격한 강력한 마법 기술을 이용해 발동된 주문을 반격하려 시도하다. 방패나 패리 무기로 명중 굴림 수정자를 적용해 반격 판정을 수행한다. 주문을 반격하면 그 주문은 시전자에게 반사된다. 개별 생물을 대상으로 한 주문은 시전자만을 대상으로 한다. 특정 지점을 중심으로 한 영역을 대상으로 한 주문은 새로운 영역의 중심이 시전자로 변경된다. 주문이 원뿔형이나 선형이었다면, 그 원뿔이나 선은 당신을 중심으로 시전자 쪽으로 발산됩니다. 주문에 저항 DC가 있다면 당신의 직업 DC를 사용하며, 주문 명중 굴림이 필요할 경우 반격 판정 시 사용한 것과 동일한 명중 굴림 수정자를 적용합니다.

name: Basic Thaumaturgy

description.value: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level thaumaturge feat of your choice.

_desc_en: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level thaumaturge feat of your choice.
_desc_ko: 선택한 1레벨 또는 2레벨 쏘마터지 피트를 획득합니다.

name: Impassable Wall Stance

description.value: You refuse to let foes past your guard. As long as you are in this stance, when you critically hit with an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KAVf7AmRnbCAHrkT]{Reactive Strike} triggered by a move action, you disrupt that move action.

_desc_en: You refuse to let foes past your guard. As long as you are in this stance, when you critically hit with an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KAVf7AmRnbCAHrkT]{Reactive Strike} triggered by a move action, you disrupt that move action.
_desc_ko: 당신은 적들이 당신의 방어선을 뚫고 지나가는 것을 허용하지 않습니다. 이 자세를 유지하는 동안, 이동 행동으로 유발된 @link[actions.reactive-strike]으로 치명타를 성공시킬 경우, 해당 이동 행동을 방해합니다.

name: Energy Interceptor

description.value: Though other guardians understand how to anticipate the flow of martial combat, you predict blasts of magical lightning, blazing trap runes, and more. You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.vhO1f7oTD2s3Ncg9]{Intercept Attack} when an ally would take acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage, not only when they would take physical damage.

_desc_en: Though other guardians understand how to anticipate the flow of martial combat, you predict blasts of magical lightning, blazing trap runes, and more. You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.vhO1f7oTD2s3Ncg9]{Intercept Attack} when an ally would take acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage, not only when they would take physical damage.
_desc_ko: 다른 가디언들이 무술 전투의 흐름을 예측하는 법을 이해하는 반면, 당신은 마법 번개 폭발, 불타는 함정 룬 등을 예측합니다. 동맹이 물리적 피해를 입을 때뿐만 아니라 산성, 냉기, 전기, 화염, 음파 피해를 입을 때에도 @link[actions.intercept-attack]을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Piercing Quills

description.value: Your quills can dig particularly deep into the flesh of your opponents. Your quills unarmed attack deals @Damage[1d4[bleed]] on a critical hit.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: Your quills can dig particularly deep into the flesh of your opponents. Your quills unarmed attack deals @Damage[1d4[bleed]] on a critical hit.
_desc_ko: 당신의 가시는 적의 살점을 특히 깊게 파고들 수 있습니다. 비무장 공격 시 치명타 시 1d4 출혈의 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Officer's Medical Training

description.value:
Requirements You can prepare at least three tactics.

You received formal training in battlefield triage and wound treatment. You are trained in Medicine and can use your Intelligence modifier in place of your Wisdom modifier for Medicine checks. If you are already trained in Medicine, you instead become trained in another skill of your choosing. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.wYerMk6F1RZb0Fwt]{Battle Medicine} feat.

_desc_en:
Requirements You can prepare at least three tactics.

You received formal training in battlefield triage and wound treatment. You are trained in Medicine and can use your Intelligence modifier in place of your Wisdom modifier for Medicine checks. If you are already trained in Medicine, you instead become trained in another skill of your choosing. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.wYerMk6F1RZb0Fwt]{Battle Medicine} feat.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 최소 세 가지 전술을 준비할 수 있어야 합니다.

전장 분류 및 상처 치료에 대한 정식 훈련을 받았습니다. 의학에 숙련되어 있으며 의학 판정 시 지혜 수정자 대신 지능 수정자를 사용할 수 있습니다. 이미 의학에 숙련된 경우, 대신 선택한 다른 기술에 숙련되게 됩니다. @link[feats.battle-medicine] 피트를 얻습니다.

name: Evangelize

description.value:
You point out a detail that incontrovertibly supports your faith, causing a listener's mind to whirl. Attempt a @Check[diplomacy|against:will] check and compare the result to the Will DC of a single target that can hear you and understands your language; that target is then temporarily immune to Evangelize with respect to your deity or philosophy for 1 day. A creature that already agrees with you is unaffected, and at the GM's discretion, a target that genuinely changes its perspective to support your faith as a result of the argument is also otherwise unaffected.

Critical Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is unaffected.

value.value: follower of a specific religion or philosophy

_desc_ko:
당신은 자신의 신앙을 확고히 뒷받침하는 세부 사항을 지적하여 듣는 이의 정신을 혼란스럽게 합니다. 외교 판정을 시도하고, 그 결과를 당신의 말을 듣고 이해하는 단일 대상의 의지 DC와 비교하십시오; 해당 대상은 이후 1일간 당신의 신이나 철학에 대한 전도 효과에 일시적으로 면역됩니다. 이미 당신과 의견을 같이하는 생물은 영향을 받지 않으며, GM의 재량에 따라 논쟁 결과 진정으로 관점을 바꿔 당신의 신앙을 지지하게 된 대상도 다른 면에서는 영향을 받지 않습니다.

대성공 대상은 @link[conditions.stupefied]{2} 상태가 1라운드 동안 지속됩니다.

성공 대상은 @link[conditions.stupefied]{1} 상태가 1 라운드 동안 지속됩니다.

실패 대상은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

name: Arcane Propulsion

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You redirect energy from your core to ports on your back or feet, allowing you to fly for a short time. You can maintain this redirected energy for 5 minutes. You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed while redirecting the energy.

Enhancement You can maintain your flight for longer. You can redirect your energy at all times, allowing you to fly whenever you want, rather than just once per day for 5 minutes.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You redirect energy from your core to ports on your back or feet, allowing you to fly for a short time. You can maintain this redirected energy for 5 minutes. You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed while redirecting the energy.

Enhancement You can maintain your flight for longer. You can redirect your energy at all times, allowing you to fly whenever you want, rather than just once per day for 5 minutes.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신은 핵심에서 에너지를 등이나 발의 포트들로 재분배하여 잠시 동안 비행할 수 있습니다. 이 재분배된 에너지는 5분 동안 유지할 수 있습니다. 에너지를 재분배하는 동안 비행 속도는 당신의 이동 속도와 동일합니다.

강화 비행 지속 시간을 연장할 수 있다. 에너지를 언제든지 재분배할 수 있어 하루에 한 번 5분 동안만 비행하는 것이 아니라 원하는 때에 비행할 수 있다.

name: Remember Your Training

description.value:
Frequency once per day

During your training to become a Pathfinder Agent you were schooled on a wide variety of creatures you might encounter, and you can think back to that training to gain crucial insight in times of need. Attempt a check to Recall Knowledge about a creature you can see, adding your level as a proficiency bonus if you are untrained (rather than 0). If you roll a failure (but not a critical failure) on this check, you get a success instead.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

Frequency once per day

During your training to become a Pathfinder Agent you were schooled on a wide variety of creatures you might encounter, and you can think back to that training to gain crucial insight in times of need. If you roll a failure (but not a critical failure) on this check, you get a success instead.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

패스파인더 요원이 되기 위한 훈련 중, 당신은 마주칠 수 있는 다양한 생물에 대해 배웠으며, 필요할 때 그 훈련을 떠올려 중요한 통찰력을 얻을 수 있습니다. 당신이 볼 수 있는 생물에 대한 지식 회상 판정을 시도하세요. 미숙련 상태라면 숙련 보너스로 레벨의 1/3을 추가합니다(0이 아닌). 이 판정에서 실패(대실패 제외)를 굴렸다면, 대신 성공으로 처리됩니다.

name: Dual-Weapon Warrior Dedication

description.value:
You're exceptional in your use of two weapons. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.onde0SxLoxLBTnvm]{Double Slice} fighter feat.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.sAFWD8D0RKH4m25n]{Dual-Weapon Warrior}

_desc_en:
You're exceptional in your use of two weapons. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.onde0SxLoxLBTnvm]{Double Slice} fighter feat.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.sAFWD8D0RKH4m25n]{Dual-Weapon Warrior}
_desc_ko: 당신은 두 무기를 다루는 데 탁월합니다. @link[feats.double-slice] 파이터 피트를 얻습니다.

name: Judgement of the Monolith

description.value: You can use the oaths bound in your ka stone to compel the truth from the living and the dead. You can activate your ka stone to target a single living creature, causing that creature to experience the effects of being in a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aewxsale5xWEPKLk]{Ring of Truth}. You can also activate it with a 10-minute activation (envision) to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.FM3SmEW8N1FCRjqt]{Talking Corpse}.

_desc_en: You can use the oaths bound in your ka stone to compel the truth from the living and the dead. You can activate your ka stone to target a single living creature, causing that creature to experience the effects of being in a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aewxsale5xWEPKLk]{Ring of Truth}. You can also activate it with a 10-minute activation (envision) to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.FM3SmEW8N1FCRjqt]{Talking Corpse}.
_desc_ko: 카 스톤에 묶인 맹세를 사용해 산 자와 죽은 자에게서 진실을 강요할 수 있다. 카 스톤을 활성화하여 단일 생명체를 대상으로 삼을 수 있으며, 해당 생명체는 @link[spells.ring-of-truth]에 있는 것과 동일한 효과를 경험하게 됩니다. 또한 10분간 활성화(상상)하여 @link[spells.talking-corpse]를 시전할 수도 있습니다.

name: Siphoning Touch

description.value: When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.N1Z1oLPdBxaSgrEE]{Vampiric Feast}, you can modify its standard effects as follows: Instead of gaining the temporary Hit Points yourself, you can grant the temporary Hit Points to an ally within 30 feet. After 1 minute, the ally loses any of these temporary Hit Points that remain.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en: When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.N1Z1oLPdBxaSgrEE]{Vampiric Feast}, you can modify its standard effects as follows: Instead of gaining the temporary Hit Points yourself, you can grant the temporary Hit Points to an ally within 30 feet. After 1 minute, the ally loses any of these temporary Hit Points that remain.
_desc_ko: 당신이 @link[spells.vampiric-feast]을 시전할 때, 그 표준 효과를 다음과 같이 수정자가 조정할 수 있습니다: 임시 HP를 자신이 얻는 대신, 30피트 내의 아군에게 부여할 수 있습니다. 1분 후, 아군은 남아 있는 임시 HP를 모두 잃는다.

name: Planar Survival

description.value: You can Subsist using Survival on different planes, even those without resources or natural phenomena you normally need. For instance, you can forage for food without penalty even if the plane lacks food that could normally sustain you. A success on your check to Subsist also prevents damage done by the plane to you and anyone else you support with Subsist. This applies only to damage dealt by the general conditions of the plane, not smaller hazards.

_desc_en: You can Subsist using Survival on different planes, even those without resources or natural phenomena you normally need. For instance, you can forage for food without penalty even if the plane lacks food that could normally sustain you. A success on your check to Subsist also prevents damage done by the plane to you and anyone else you support with Subsist. This applies only to damage dealt by the general conditions of the plane, not smaller hazards.
_desc_ko: 생존 기술을 사용하여 자원이 없거나 평소 필요한 자연 현상이 없는 다른 평면에서도 생존할 수 있습니다. 예를 들어, 평면에 평소 당신을 지탱할 수 있는 음식이 없더라도 페널티 없이 음식을 채집할 수 있습니다. 생존 능력 판정 성공 시, 해당 평면이 당신과 생존 능력으로 지원하는 다른 이들에게 가하는 피해도 방지됩니다. 이는 평면의 일반적인 환경 조건으로 인한 피해에만 적용되며, 작은 위험 요소는 제외됩니다.

name: Silencing Strike

description.value:
A quick strike to the face or mouth silences your opponent. Make a melee Strike against an enemy. If it hits, the enemy must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:barbarian|options:inflicts:stunned] save against your class DC.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is dazed and can barely vocalize. It's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} and its speech is raspy and hard to understand. It must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:11] to use linguistic actions or Cast a Spell, unless the spell has the subtle trait.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3} instead of stunned 1.

_desc_en:
A quick strike to the face or mouth silences your opponent. Make a melee Strike against an enemy. If it hits, the enemy must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:barbarian|options:inflicts:stunned] save against your class DC.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is dazed and can barely vocalize. It's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} and its speech is raspy and hard to understand. It must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:11] to use linguistic actions or Cast a Spell, unless the spell has the subtle trait.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3} instead of stunned 1.
_desc_ko:
얼굴이나 입을 향해 가하는 빠른 일격으로 상대를 침묵시킵니다. 적에게 근접 공격을 시도하세요. 명중 시, 적은 당신의 직업 난이도(DC)에 대한 인내 저항 내성에 성공해야 합니다.

성공 대상은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

실패 대상은 정신이 혼미해져 간신히 말을 할 수 있습니다. @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태이며, 목소리가 쉰 듯하고 알아듣기 어렵습니다. 언어적 행동을 사용하거나 주문을 시전하려면 DC 11 단순에 성공해야 합니다. 단, 주문에 '미묘함' 특성이 있는 경우는 예외입니다.

대실패 실패와 동일하나, 대상은 @link[conditions.stunned]{3} 상태가 된다.

name: Point Blank Stance

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a ranged weapon.

You take aim to pick off nearby enemies quickly. When using a ranged volley weapon while you are in this stance, you don't take the penalty to your attack rolls from the volley trait. When using a ranged weapon that doesn't have the volley trait, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to damage rolls on attacks against targets within the weapon's first range increment.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a ranged weapon.

You take aim to pick off nearby enemies quickly. When using a ranged volley weapon while you are in this stance, you don't take the penalty to your attack rolls from the volley trait. When using a ranged weapon that doesn't have the volley trait, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to damage rolls on attacks against targets within the weapon's first range increment.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 원거리 무기를 장비하고 있어야 합니다.

근처의 적을 빠르게 제거하기 위해 조준합니다. 이 자세에서 원거리 연사 무기를 사용할 때, 연사 특성으로 인한 명중 굴림 페널티를 받지 않습니다. 연사 특성이 없는 원거리 무기를 사용할 경우, 무기의 첫 번째 사거리 구간 내 목표물에 대한 공격 시 피해 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Penetrating Fire

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a loaded firearm or crossbow.

You blast a bullet through one foe and into another. Choose two targets, one of which would give the other lesser cover against your ranged attacks. Make a single ranged Strike with the required weapon against both targets. This attack ignores any lesser cover the nearer target provides the other. Roll damage only once and apply it to each creature you hit. Penetrating Fire counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a loaded firearm or crossbow.

You blast a bullet through one foe and into another. Choose two targets, one of which would give the other lesser cover against your ranged attacks. Make a single ranged Strike with the required weapon against both targets. This attack ignores any lesser cover the nearer target provides the other. Roll damage only once and apply it to each creature you hit. Penetrating Fire counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 장전된 화기나 석궁을 휘두르고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 한 적을 관통해 다른 적에게 총알을 명중시킵니다. 두 표적을 선택하세요. 이 중 하나는 다른 표적에게 당신의 원거리 공격에 대한 반엄폐를 제공합니다. 요구되는 무기로 두 표적 모두에게 단일 원거리 공격을 수행하세요. 이 공격은 가까운 표적이 다른 표적에게 제공하는 반엄폐를 무시합니다. 피해 굴림은 한 번만 굴리고 명중한 각 생물에게 적용하세요. 관통 사격은 다중 공격 페널티 계산 시 두 번의 공격으로 간주됩니다.

name: Just One More Thing

description.value:
Requirements Your most recent action was to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}, and you failed but didn't critically fail.

After your attempt to influence someone goes poorly, you add another bit of information or ask a pointed question, possibly salvaging your previous attempt. Reroll the failed check and use the new result. If the target of the failed check is involved with one of your active investigations, double your investigation bonus from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xTK2zsWFyxSJvYbX]{Pursue a Lead} on the rerolled check. That creature is temporarily immune to Just One More Thing for 1 day.

You can also use this action if you failed, but didn't critically fail, at a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce}. In this case, rather than spending 1 action, adding Just One More Thing takes you half the amount of time you initially spent on the check, to a minimum of 1 more round.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your most recent action was to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}, and you failed but didn't critically fail.

After your attempt to influence someone goes poorly, you add another bit of information or ask a pointed question, possibly salvaging your previous attempt. Reroll the failed check and use the new result. If the target of the failed check is involved with one of your active investigations, double your investigation bonus from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xTK2zsWFyxSJvYbX]{Pursue a Lead} on the rerolled check. That creature is temporarily immune to Just One More Thing for 1 day.

You can also use this action if you failed, but didn't critically fail, at a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce}. In this case, rather than spending 1 action, adding Just One More Thing takes you half the amount of time you initially spent on the check, to a minimum of 1 more round.
_desc_ko:
요구사항 귀하의 가장 최근 행동은 @link[actions.feint], @link[actions.request], 또는 @link[actions.demoralize]였으며, 실패했으나 대실패는 아니었습니다.

누군가에게 영향을 주려는 시도를 하다 잘 풀리지 않은 후, 당신은 추가 정보를 제시하거나 날카로운 질문을 던져 이전 시도를 만회할 기회를 잡을 수 있습니다. 실패한 판정을 재굴림하고 새로운 결과를 사용합니다. 실패한 판정의 대상이 당신의 활성 수사 중 하나와 관련되어 있다면, 재굴린 판정에서 @link[actions.pursue-a-lead]의 수사 보너스를 두 배로 적용합니다. 해당 생물은 1일간 '한 가지 더'에 대해 일시적으로 면역됩니다.

다음 판정에서 실패했지만 대실패는 아닌 경우에도 이 행동을 사용할 수 있습니다: @link[actions.lie], @link[actions.gather-information], @link[actions.make-an-impression], 또는 @link[actions.coerce]에 실패했을 때도 이 행동을 사용할 수 있습니다. 이 경우, 1 행동을 소모하는 대신 '한 가지 더'를 추가하면 원래 판정 소요 시간의 절반만큼의 시간이 추가로 소요되며, 최소 1 라운드는 더 소요됩니다.

name: Tenacious Net

description.value: Escaping your nets is no simple task. The Athletics DC to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} your nets increases from 16 to 18. After a creature you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} with a net Escapes or Forces Open the net, stray strands of the net cling to the creature, causing them to remain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the beginning of their next turn.
