name: Sacred Wilds Oath

description.value:
You've sworn an oath to protect the holy places within nature and the spirits that dwell within, from ancient trees to primordial wild guardians. You can use Diplomacy to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on animals and to make very simple Requests of them. In most cases, wild animals will give you time to make your case. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks to Make an Impression when interacting with a beast, fey, or kami. You gain the following edict.

Edict You must aid any animal or nature spirit in need unless it violates your other tenets or puts someone else at risk of immediate harm.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You've sworn an oath to protect the holy places within nature and the spirits that dwell within, from ancient trees to primordial wild guardians. You can use Diplomacy to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on animals and to make very simple Requests of them. In most cases, wild animals will give you time to make your case. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks to Make an Impression when interacting with a beast, fey, or kami. You gain the following edict.

Edict You must aid any animal or nature spirit in need unless it violates your other tenets or puts someone else at risk of immediate harm.
_desc_ko:
당신은 자연 속의 신성한 성지와 그 안에 깃든 영혼들, 고목부터 원초적인 야생 가디언에 이르기까지 보호하겠다고 맹세했습니다. 당신은 외교 기술을 사용하여 동물에게 @link[actions.make-an-impression] 수 있으며, 그들에게 아주 간단한 요청을 할 수 있습니다. 대부분의 경우 야생 동물들은 당신이 설명할 시간을 줄 것입니다. 야수, 페이, 또는 가미와 상호작용할 때 인상을 남기기 위한 외교 판정에는 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 당신은 다음과 같은 칙령을 얻습니다.

칙령 다른 신조 위반이나 타인의 즉각적 위험을 초래하지 않는 한, 곤경에 처한 동물이나 자연 영혼을 반드시 도와야 한다.

name: Sea Legs

description.value: You are comfortable on the water for short bursts. You gain a swim Speed of 10 feet and can breathe underwater for 5 minutes.

value.value: You don't have a swim Speed.

_desc_en: You are comfortable on the water for short bursts. You gain a swim Speed of 10 feet and can breathe underwater for 5 minutes.
_desc_ko: 짧은 시간 동안 물 위에서 편안함을 느낍니다. 수영 속도가 10피트 증가하고 수중에서 5분간 숨을 쉴 수 있습니다.

name: Boulder Roll

description.value:
Your dwarven build allows you to push foes around, just like a mighty boulder tumbles through a subterranean cavern. Take a Step into the square of a foe that is your size or smaller, and the foe must move into the empty space directly behind it. The foe must move even if doing so places it in harm's way. The foe can attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:athletics] saving throw against your Athletics DC to block your Step. If the foe attempts this saving throw, it takes @Damage[(@actor.level + @actor.abilities.str.mod)[bludgeoning]]{bludgeoning damage} equal to your level plus your Strength modifier unless it critically succeeds.

If the foe can't move into an empty space (if it is surrounded by solid objects or other creatures, for example), your Boulder Roll has no effect.

_desc_en:
Your dwarven build allows you to push foes around, just like a mighty boulder tumbles through a subterranean cavern. Take a Step into the square of a foe that is your size or smaller, and the foe must move into the empty space directly behind it. The foe must move even if doing so places it in harm's way. The foe can attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:athletics] saving throw against your Athletics DC to block your Step. If the foe attempts this saving throw, it takes @Damage[(@actor.level + @actor.abilities.str.mod)[bludgeoning]]{bludgeoning damage} equal to your level plus your Strength modifier unless it critically succeeds.

If the foe can't move into an empty space (if it is surrounded by solid objects or other creatures, for example), your Boulder Roll has no effect.
_desc_ko:
당신의 드워프 체격은 지하 동굴을 회피 돌파하는 거대한 바위처럼 적을 밀어낼 수 있게 합니다. 자신과 같은 크기 또는 더 작은 적의 칸으로 {신중한 발걸음}하면, 적은 바로 뒤의 빈 공간으로 이동해야 합니다. 적은 위험에 처하게 되더라도 반드시 이동해야 합니다. 적은 당신의 운동 DC에 대한 인내 내성 굴림을 시도하여 당신의 신중한 발걸음을 막을 수 있습니다. 적이 이 내성 굴림을 시도할 경우, 대성공하지 않는 한 당신의 레벨에 근력 능력치 수정자를 더한 만큼의 타격 피해를 입습니다.

적군이 빈 공간으로 이동할 수 없는 경우(예: 고체 물체나 다른 생물체에 둘러싸여 있는 경우), 당신의 바위 굴리기는 효과가 없습니다.

name: Monstrous Peacemaker

description.value: Your dual human and orc nature has given you a unique perspective, allowing you to bridge the gap between humans and the many intelligent creatures in the world that humans consider monsters. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks against non-humanoid intelligent creatures and against humanoids that are marginalized in human society (at the GM's discretion, but typically at least including giants, goblins, kobolds, and orcs). You also gain this bonus on Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense the Motives} of such creatures.

_desc_en: Your dual human and orc nature has given you a unique perspective, allowing you to bridge the gap between humans and the many intelligent creatures in the world that humans consider monsters. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks against non-humanoid intelligent creatures and against humanoids that are marginalized in human society (at the GM's discretion, but typically at least including giants, goblins, kobolds, and orcs). You also gain this bonus on Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense the Motives} of such creatures.
_desc_ko: 인간과 오크의 이중적 본성은 당신에게 독특한 시각을 부여하여, 인간과 인간이 괴물로 여기는 수많은 지성체 사이의 간극을 메울 수 있게 합니다. 에 속하는 비인간형 지성 생물체와 인간 사회에서 소외된 인간형 생물체(GM 재량에 따르나, 일반적으로 거인, 고블린, 코볼트, 오크 등을 포함)를 상대로 한 외교 판정 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 또한 이러한 생물체의 @link[actions.sense-motive] 판정에 대한 지각 판정 시에도 동일한 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Uplifting Winds

description.value: The winds are eager to keep you aloft. When you are flying and Cast a Spell that has the air or electricity traits, you gain a +10 status bonus to your fly Speed, and you can immediately Fly up to half your Speed.

_desc_en: The winds are eager to keep you aloft. When you are flying and Cast a Spell that has the air or electricity traits, you gain a +10 status bonus to your fly Speed, and you can immediately Fly up to half your Speed.
_desc_ko: 바람이 당신을 하늘에 머물게 하려 애쓴다. 비행 중일 때 공기 또는 전기 속성을 가진 주문을 시전하면 비행 속도에 +10 상태 보너스를 얻으며, 즉시 최대 속도의 절반까지 즉시 상승할 수 있다.

name: Spectral Dagger

description.value:
By touching the splinter of finality in your neck, you conjure a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ts5z3xR9j48Cic5H]{Spectral Dagger} into your hand that resembles the splinter wrapped in a crude hilt. This weapon acts like a +1 ghost touch dagger, and each successful Strike with it deals 1 additional spirit damage. If the attack is a critical hit, this damage increases to 1d6.

If the spectral dagger ever leaves your hand, it vanishes and you must spend an action to conjure it again. If this occurs as the result of you making a ranged thrown Strike with the dagger, you resolve the attack before the weapon vanishes.

You can increase the power of your spectral dagger with runes like you can other weapons, transferring the rune from a runestone or other weapon by meditating over the rune as a downtime activity that takes 1 day.

value.value: You have a hand free and aren't already wielding a spectral dagger.

_desc_en:
By touching the splinter of finality in your neck, you conjure a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ts5z3xR9j48Cic5H]{Spectral Dagger} into your hand that resembles the splinter wrapped in a crude hilt. This weapon acts like a +1 ghost touch dagger, and each successful Strike with it deals 1 additional spirit damage. If the attack is a critical hit, this damage increases to 1d6.

If the spectral dagger ever leaves your hand, it vanishes and you must spend an action to conjure it again. If this occurs as the result of you making a ranged thrown Strike with the dagger, you resolve the attack before the weapon vanishes.

You can increase the power of your spectral dagger with runes like you can other weapons, transferring the rune from a runestone or other weapon by meditating over the rune as a downtime activity that takes 1 day.
_desc_ko:
목에 박힌 최후의 가시를 만지면, 조잡한 손잡이에 감싸인 가시 조각을 닮은 @link[equipment.spectral-dagger]이 손에 소환된다. 이 무기는 +1 고스트 터치 단검처럼 작용하며, 이 무기로 성공한 공격마다 추가로 1의 영혼 피해를 입힌다. 치명타일 경우 이 피해는 1d6로 증가한다.

스펙트럴 단검이 당신의 손을 떠난다면, 그것은 사라지고 당신은 다시 소환하기 위해 행동을 소비해야 합니다. 이 현상이 단검으로 원거리 투척 공격을 시도한 결과 발생한 경우, 무기가 사라지기 전에 공격을 해결합니다.

유령 단검의 위력은 다른 무기와 마찬가지로 룬으로 강화할 수 있습니다. 룬석이나 다른 무기에 새겨진 룬을 1일간의 다운타임 활동으로 명상하여 이식하는 방식입니다.

name: Halfling Luck

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a skill check or saving throw.

Your happy-go-lucky nature makes it seem like misfortune avoids you, and to an extent, that might even be true. You can reroll the triggering check, but you must use the new result, even if it's worse.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a skill check or saving throw.

Your happy-go-lucky nature makes it seem like misfortune avoids you, and to an extent, that might even be true. You can reroll the triggering check, but you must use the new result, even if it's worse.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 기술 판정나 내성 굴림에서 실패할 때.

당신의 낙천적인 성격 덕분에 불운이 당신을 피해가는 것처럼 보이며, 어느 정도는 사실일 수도 있습니다. 발동 조건을 위한 판정을 재굴림할 수 있지만, 결과가 더 나빠지더라도 반드시 새로운 결과를 사용해야 합니다.

name: Death's Drums

description.value:
Your life has been spent challenging death itself, and proximity to that implacable foe only makes your heart beat harder.

When you are taking persistent damage or your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} value is 1 or greater, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saving throws.

_desc_en:
Your life has been spent challenging death itself, and proximity to that implacable foe only makes your heart beat harder.

When you are taking persistent damage or your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} value is 1 or greater, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saving throws.
_desc_ko:
당신의 삶은 죽음 그 자체에 도전하는 데 바쳐졌으며, 그 불굴의 적에 가까워질수록 당신의 심장은 더욱 격렬하게 뛰게 됩니다.

지속적인 피해를 입거나 @link[conditions.wounded] 수치가 1 이상일 때, 인내 내성 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Subtle Shank

description.value:
Access Help either the Washboard Dogs or the Diobel Sweepers destroy their rival.

Requirements You have a melee weapon of light bulk @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} on your person via the Stealth skill, and the target isn't aware of it.

You draw a concealed weapon, attack with it, and then hide it away again in one smooth motion. Interact to draw the weapon, Strike with that weapon, and then Conceal it with a Stealth check. The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for this attack.

_desc_en:
Access Help either the Washboard Dogs or the Diobel Sweepers destroy their rival.

Requirements You have a melee weapon of light bulk @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} on your person via the Stealth skill, and the target isn't aware of it.

You draw a concealed weapon, attack with it, and then hide it away again in one smooth motion. Interact to draw the weapon, Strike with that weapon, and then Conceal it with a Stealth check. The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for this attack.
_desc_ko:
접근 워시보드 독스 또는 디오벨 스위퍼스 중 한 쪽이 라이벌을 파괴하도록 도와라.

요구 사항 은신 기술을 통해 몸에 가벼운 벌크의 근접 무기 @link[conditions.concealed]을 소지하고 있으며, 대상이 이를 인지하지 못해야 합니다.

은은한 무기를 꺼내 공격한 후, 한 번의 유연한 동작으로 다시 숨깁니다. 무기 꺼내기, 해당 무기로 공격하기, 은신 판정 후 다시 숨기기 순서로 상호작용합니다. 대상은 이 공격에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard]입니다.

name: Jalmeri Heavenseeker Dedication

description.value:
You become trained in either Acrobatics or Occultism; if you were already trained in both these skills, you become an expert in one of them instead. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.yA9tsWT9uzL2REnw]{Qi Spells} monk feat, which grants you a qi spell and a focus pool of 1 Focus Point that you can recover using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OSefkMgojBLqmRDh]{Refocus} activity as a monk does. If you already have the Qi Spells feat, you can instead choose a single 1st‐level monk feat.

Special You can't select another dedication feat until you gain two other feats from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.NaG4fy33coUdSFtH]{Jalmeri Heavenseeker} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.EwlYs1OzaMj9BB5I]{Student of Perfection} archetypes.

value.value: Student of Perfection Dedication, or you've trained with a champion of the Challenge of Sky and Heaven

_desc_en:
You become trained in either Acrobatics or Occultism; if you were already trained in both these skills, you become an expert in one of them instead. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.yA9tsWT9uzL2REnw]{Qi Spells} monk feat, which grants you a qi spell and a focus pool of 1 Focus Point that you can recover using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OSefkMgojBLqmRDh]{Refocus} activity as a monk does. If you already have the Qi Spells feat, you can instead choose a single 1st‐level monk feat.

Special You can't select another dedication feat until you gain two other feats from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.NaG4fy33coUdSFtH]{Jalmeri Heavenseeker} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.EwlYs1OzaMj9BB5I]{Student of Perfection} archetypes.
_desc_ko:
곡예 또는 오컬트 중 하나에 숙련됩니다. 이미 두 기술 모두 숙련된 경우, 그 중 하나에 전문가 등급을 얻습니다. @link[feats.qi-spells] 몽크 피트를 획득합니다. 이 피트는 기 주문을 부여하며, 몽크가 @link[actions.refocus] 행동을 통해 회복할 수 있는 1점의 포커스 풀을 제공합니다. 기 주술 피트를 이미 보유하고 있다면, 대신 1레벨 몽크 피트 하나를 선택할 수 있습니다.

특수 다른 헌신 피트를 선택하려면 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.NaG4fy33coUdSFtH]{잘메리 천상추구자} 또는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.EwlYs1OzaMj9BB5I]{완벽의 수련자} 아키타입에서 다른 두 피트를 획득해야 합니다.

name: Pack Takedown

description.value:
Requirements You have two active companions.

The pack is strongest when it acts as one, and like a group of hungry wolves, you work together to bring down a single target. If you and both of your active companions threaten the same creature, each of you makes a melee Strike against it. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against all of these attacks. If more than one attack hits, combine the damage from all successful Strikes, and apply resistances and weaknesses only once.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have two active companions.

The pack is strongest when it acts as one, and like a group of hungry wolves, you work together to bring down a single target. If you and both of your active companions threaten the same creature, each of you makes a melee Strike against it. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against all of these attacks. If more than one attack hits, combine the damage from all successful Strikes, and apply resistances and weaknesses only once.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 활성 상태의 동료 두 명이 있어야 합니다.

무리는 하나가 되어 행동할 때 가장 강력하며, 굶주린 늑대 무리처럼 단일 목표를 쓰러뜨리기 위해 협력합니다. 당신과 두 명의 활성 동료가 동일한 생물을 위협할 경우, 각자가 그 생물을 상대로 근접 공격을 시도합니다. 해당 생물은 이 모든 공격에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다. 두 개 이상의 공격이 명중할 경우, 성공한 모든 공격의 피해를 합산하고 저항력 및 약점은 한 번만 적용합니다.

name: Legendary Codebreaker

description.value: Your skill with languages and codes is so great that you can decipher information with little more than a quick read through a text. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing} using Society while reading at normal speed. If you slow down and spend the full amount of time that's ordinarily required and roll a success, you get a critical success; if you critically succeed while spending the normal amount of time, you gain a nearly word-for-word understanding of the document.

_desc_en: Your skill with languages and codes is so great that you can decipher information with little more than a quick read through a text. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing} using Society while reading at normal speed. If you slow down and spend the full amount of time that's ordinarily required and roll a success, you get a critical success; if you critically succeed while spending the normal amount of time, you gain a nearly word-for-word understanding of the document.
_desc_ko: 언어와 암호에 대한 당신의 숙련도는 매우 뛰어나서, 텍스트를 빠르게 훑어보기만 해도 정보를 해독할 수 있습니다. 정상 속도로 읽으면서 사회 능력으로 @link[actions.decipher-writing]을 사용할 수 있습니다. 속도를 늦추고 일반적으로 필요한 시간을 모두 투자하여 성공을 굴리면, 대성공을 얻습니다. 일반적인 시간 투자로 대성공을 거두면, 문서의 내용을 거의 단어 하나하나까지 정확히 이해하게 됩니다.

name: Just the Facts

description.value:
You fundamentally understand everything to the point where your research can't possibly be wrong. You are permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} and can use the extra action to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}. In addition, you gain the following benefits with Recall Knowledge.

  • Your checks to Recall Knowledge are no longer secret.
  • When you Recall Knowledge, you use the outcome for one degree of success better than the result of your check.
  • If an effect (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1Bt7uCW2WI4sM84P]{Dubious Knowledge}) would give you inaccurate information from your Recall Knowledge check, you know which information is inaccurate.

  • When one of your allies Recalls Knowledge and gains false information, you also know that information is inaccurate if they share it with you

_desc_en:
You fundamentally understand everything to the point where your research can't possibly be wrong. You are permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} and can use the extra action to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}. In addition, you gain the following benefits with Recall Knowledge.

  • Your checks to Recall Knowledge are no longer secret.
  • When you Recall Knowledge, you use the outcome for one degree of success better than the result of your check.
  • If an effect (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1Bt7uCW2WI4sM84P]{Dubious Knowledge}) would give you inaccurate information from your Recall Knowledge check, you know which information is inaccurate.

  • When one of your allies Recalls Knowledge and gains false information, you also know that information is inaccurate if they share it with you
_desc_ko:
당신은 연구가 틀릴 수 없을 정도로 모든 것을 근본적으로 이해하고 있습니다. 당신은 영구적으로 @link[conditions.quickened] 상태이며, 추가 행동을 사용하여 @link[actions.recall-knowledge]을 수행할 수 있습니다. 또한 지식 회상 시 다음과 같은 혜택을 얻습니다.

  • 지식 회상 판정 결과가 더 이상 비밀이 아닙니다.
  • 지식 회상 시 판정 결과보다 한 단계 높은 성공 등급을 적용합니다.
  • 효과(예: @link[feats.dubious-knowledge])로 인해 지식 회상 판정에서 부정확한 정보를 얻게 될 경우, 어떤 정보가 부정확한지 알게 됩니다.

  • 동료가 지식 회상 시술로 허위 정보를 얻었을 때, 그 동료가 당신과 정보를 공유하면 당신도 그 정보가 부정확하다는 것을 알게 됩니다.

name: Lunging Stance

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a melee weapon.

Your body coiled to strike, you can lash out at distant enemies. While you are in this stance, you can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KAVf7AmRnbCAHrkT]{Reactive Strike} against a creature that is outside your reach but within the reach you would have with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.rTkr1EqpAN6YtnAh]{Lunge}. If you do, you increase your range with the Strike by 5 feet.

_desc_en:

Your body coiled to strike, you can lash out at distant enemies. While you are in this stance, you can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KAVf7AmRnbCAHrkT]{Reactive Strike} against a creature that is outside your reach but within the reach you would have with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.rTkr1EqpAN6YtnAh]{Lunge}. If you do, you increase your range with the Strike by 5 feet.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 근접 무기를 휘두르고 있습니다.

몸을 감아 강타하려던 순간, 멀리 있는 적을 향해 휘둘러 공격할 수 있습니다. 이 자세를 취하고 있을 때, @link[actions.reactive-strike]을 사용하여 자신의 공격 범위 밖에 있지만 @link[feats.lunge]으로 닿을 수 있는 거리에 있는 생물에게 공격할 수 있습니다. 이 경우, 공격 범위가 5피트 증가한다.

name: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication

description.value:
You devote much of your study to halcyon magic. You gain the ability to cast a single arcane or primal cantrip of your choice, (as is normal for cantrips, it is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level, rounded up). If you weren't already, you become trained in that tradition's spell DCs and spell attack rolls, with Intelligence as your spellcasting ability if you choose arcane or Wisdom as your spellcasting ability if you choose primal.

Regardless of whether you choose an arcane or primal cantrip, you also either become trained in Arcana or Nature, or an expert in one of those skills in which you were already trained.

When you gain this feat, choose to affiliate with the Cascade Bearers, Emerald Boughs, Rain-Scribes, Tempest-Sun Mages, or Uzunjati. This grants you additional feats available to only that branch.

Special You cannot select another dedication feat other than @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7fU6e3HIT4NvwLYa]{Halcyon Speaker Dedication} until you have gained two other feats from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.eLc6TSgWykjtSeuF]{Magaambyan Attendant} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.pDmUITVao0FDMnVf]{Halcyon Speaker} archetype.

value.value: member of the Magaambya of attendant rank

_desc_ko:
당신은 평온한 마법에 대한 연구에 많은 시간을 할애합니다. 선택한 하나의 아케인 또는 프라이멀 캔트립을 시전할 수 있는 능력을 얻습니다(캔트립의 일반적인 규칙에 따라, 해당 캔트립은 당신의 레벨 절반에 해당하는 마법 랭크으로 강화되며, 소수점은 올림 처리됩니다). 해당 전통의 주문 난이도(DC)와 주문 명중 굴림에 대해 훈련 상태가 됩니다 . 아케인 주문을 선택하면 지능을 주문 시전 능력치로, 프라이멀 주문을 선택하면 지혜를 주문 시전 능력치로 사용합니다.

비전 또는 프라이멀 캔트립 선택 여부와 무관하게, 주문학 또는 자연에 숙련되거나, 이미 숙련된 해당 기술 중 하나에 전문가가 됩니다.

이 재주를 획득할 때, 폭포의 전승자, 비취 가지, 비의 서기관, 폭풍의 태양술사, 우준자티 중 하나와 연대하기로 선택하십시오. 이는 해당 분파에서만 사용할 수 있는 추가 피트를 부여합니다.

Special @link[feats.halcyon-speaker-dedication] 이외의 다른 헌신 피트를 선택하려면, 먼저 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.eLc6TSgWykjtSeuF]{마감비아의 수행자} 또는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.pDmUITVao0FDMnVf]{할시온 스피커} 아키타입에서 다른 두 가지 피트를 획득해야 합니다.

name: Apprentice Sea Witch

description.value: You're familiar with the basic spells that most educated merfolk know. Once per day, you can cast either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WzLKjSw6hsBhuklC]{Create Water} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jfVCuOpzC6mUrf6f]{Hydraulic Push} as a 1st-rank primal innate spell. Each time you cast create water, you choose if you create fresh water or salt water.

_desc_en: You're familiar with the basic spells that most educated merfolk know. Once per day, you can cast either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WzLKjSw6hsBhuklC]{Create Water} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jfVCuOpzC6mUrf6f]{Hydraulic Push} as a 1st-rank primal innate spell. Each time you cast create water, you choose if you create fresh water or salt water.
_desc_ko: 당신은 대부분의 교육받은 어인족이 아는 기본 주문을 익숙하고 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, @link[spells.create-water] 또는 @link[spells.hydraulic-push] 중 하나를 1랭크 프라이멀 선천적 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 물 생성을 시전할 때마다, 담수 또는 해수를 생성할지 선택합니다.

name: Predatory Claws

description.value:
Your nails grow into sharp claws, perfect for seizing and tearing your prey. You gain a claw unarmed attack that deals 1d4 slashing damage. Your claws are in the brawling group and have the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits.

If you hit the same enemy with two consecutive claw Strikes in the same round, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} that same target as a free action, provided you take that action immediately after the second Strike.

_desc_en:
Your nails grow into sharp claws, perfect for seizing and tearing your prey. You gain a claw unarmed attack that deals 1d4 slashing damage. Your claws are in the brawling group and have the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits.

If you hit the same enemy with two consecutive claw Strikes in the same round, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} that same target as a free action, provided you take that action immediately after the second Strike.
_desc_ko:
네 손톱이 날카로운 발톱으로 변해 사냥감을 움켜쥐고 찢기에 완벽해진다. 1d4 베기 피해를 주는 발톱 비무장 공격을 얻는다. 네 발톱은 격투 무기 그룹에 속하며 기민함, 기교, 맨손 특성을 지닌다.

동일한 라운드에 연속으로 두 번의 발톱 공격으로 같은 적을 명중시킨 경우, 두 번째 공격 직후에 즉시 행동을 취하는 조건으로 @link[actions.grapple]을 해당 대상에게 자유 행동으로 시도할 수 있다.

name: Lightning Qi

description.value:
Frequency Once per 10 minutes

Qi flows freely from within you. If your next action is to cast a qi spell that takes at least two actions to cast, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

_desc_en:
Frequency Once per 10 minutes

Qi flows freely from within you. If your next action is to cast a qi spell that takes at least two actions to cast, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 10분에 한 번

기운이 몸속에서 자유롭게 흐릅니다. 다음 행동이 최소 두 번의 행동이 필요한 기 주문을 시전하는 것이라면, 시전하는 행동 횟수를 1 감소시킵니다(최소 1 행동).

name: Final Rest

description.value: As stubborn in death as you are in life, you vow you'll never aid your hated enemies. You can't be transformed into an undead, except by effects that originate from an artifact or deity. Undead creatures that touch your corpse take @Damage[1[vitality]] damage each time they do, or @Damage[1d6[vitality]] damage each time they expose themselves to your corpse in a more thorough manner, such as by biting or carrying your corpse.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en: As stubborn in death as you are in life, you vow you'll never aid your hated enemies. You can't be transformed into an undead, except by effects that originate from an artifact or deity. Undead creatures that touch your corpse take @Damage[1[vitality]] damage each time they do, or @Damage[1d6[vitality]] damage each time they expose themselves to your corpse in a more thorough manner, such as by biting or carrying your corpse.
_desc_ko: 생전처럼 죽음 속에서도 완고한 당신은 증오하는 적을 절대 돕지 않겠다고 맹세합니다. 유물이나 신으로부터 비롯된 효과를 제외하고는 언데드로 변형될 수 없습니다. 네 시체를 만지는 언데드 생물은 매번 1 활력의 피해를 받거나, 네 시체를 더 깊이 접촉할 때마다(예: 시체를 물거나 운반할 때) @Damage[1d6[vitality]의 피해를 받는다.

name: Powder Punch Stance

description.value:
Access You're from Alkenstar or the Mana Wastes.

You infuse your handwraps with black powder. On your first melee Strike each round with an unarmed attack, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.dgXjUcaoQDAY6ZpO]{Knuckle Duster}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.8eGV6fXbmt2v74uB]{Black Powder Knuckle Dusters}, you deal an additional 1 fire Damage. If you critically succeed at an attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} while in this stance, the target is pushed back an additional 5 feet.

_desc_ko:
접근 당신은 알켄스터 또는 마나 웨이스트 출신이다.

손에 감은 붕대에 흑색 화약을 주입합니다. 매 라운드 비무장 공격, @link[equipment.knuckle-duster], 또는 @link[equipment.black-powder-knuckle-dusters]로 첫 근접 공격 시 추가로 화염 피해 1을 입힙니다. 이 자세 상태에서 @link[actions.shove] 시도하기를 대성공하면, 대상은 추가로 5피트 밀려난다.

name: Master Oracle Spellcasting

name: Rampaging Form

description.value:
Once per day, when you Change Shape into a fox, you can instead gain the effects of both the canine form of 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wp09USMB3GIW1qbp]{Animal Form} and 7th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XS7Wyh5YC0NWeWyB]{Fiery Body} for 1 minute or until you shift back, whichever comes first. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6DfLZBl8wKIV03Iq]{Ignition} from the fiery body effect even though you're in a battle form.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.DWrsDJte9sez0Ppi]{Effect: Rampaging Form}

Special If you are a frozen wind kitsune, your form is ice instead of fire. This changes the immunity and damage from the fiery body effect to cold, changes the weakness to fire, and changes ignition to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gYjPm7YwGtEa1oxh]{Ray of Frost}.

하루에 한 번, 여우로 형태 변신할 때 대신 5랭크 @link[spells.animal-form]의 개 형태 효과와 7th-rank @link[spells.fiery-body]의 효과를 1분 동안 또는 형태를 되돌릴 때까지(둘 중 먼저 도래하는 시점까지) 동시에 얻을 수 있다. 전투 형태에 있을 때에도 불꽃 몸 효과로부터 @link[spells.ignition]를 시전할 수 있다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.DWrsDJte9sez0Ppi]{효과: 광란의 형태}

특수 얼어붙은 바람 키츠네라면, 형태가 불 대신 얼음으로 바뀐다. 이는 불의 몸 효과의 면역과 피해를 냉기로 변경하고, 약점을 불로 변경하며, 화염 생성 효과를 @link[spells.ray-of-frost].

로 변경한다.

name: Runic Impression

description.value:
You can temporarily replicate the effects of a property rune for your weapon or unarmed attacks. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.oOaEfsdVpgTXRhrY]{Runic Impression} conflux spell.

Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.

_desc_en:
You can temporarily replicate the effects of a property rune for your weapon or unarmed attacks. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.oOaEfsdVpgTXRhrY]{Runic Impression} conflux spell.

Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.
_desc_ko:
무기나 비무장 공격에 속성 룬의 효과를 일시적으로 재현할 수 있습니다. @link[spells.runic-impression] 혼합 주문을 습득합니다.

포커스 풀의 포커스 포인트 수를 1 증가시킵니다.

name: Mist Strider

description.value: You condense the moisture in the air, solidifying it so it can hold your weight. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Q8fdMjZ2Wv3FawOI]{Water Strider}, you can walk on air. You can ascend and descend at a maximum of a 45-degree angle. You still fall at the end of your movement if you don't end on a surface that can support you, as normal for Water Strider.

_desc_en: You condense the moisture in the air, solidifying it so it can hold your weight. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Q8fdMjZ2Wv3FawOI]{Water Strider}, you can walk on air. You can ascend and descend at a maximum of a 45-degree angle. You still fall at the end of your movement if you don't end on a surface that can support you, as normal for Water Strider.
_desc_ko: 공기 중 수분을 응축하여 체중을 지탱할 수 있도록 고체화합니다. @link[feats.water-strider]를 사용할 때 공중을 걸을 수 있습니다. 최대 45도 각도로 상승 및 하강할 수 있습니다. 물거미의 일반적인 특성과 마찬가지로, 이동 종료 시 지탱할 수 있는 표면에 도달하지 못하면 여전히 추락합니다.

name: Standby Spell

description.value: You've honed one spell as your favored combat technique, and you've practiced it enough that you no longer need to prepare it to cast it. Choose a spell in your spellbook that you could use with Spellstrike and that has a level no higher than the highest-level magus spell slot you have. You can Cast this Spell without having it prepared ahead of time by expending a spell slot of a sufficient level to cast your chosen spell. You can change this spell whenever you add new spells to your spellbook, or by studying your spellbook for 1 hour.

Choose a spell in your spellbook that you could use with Spellstrike and that has a level no higher than the highest-level magus spell slot you have. You can Cast this Spell without having it prepared ahead of time by expending a spell slot of a sufficient level to cast your chosen spell. You can change this spell whenever you add new spells to your spellbook, or by studying your spellbook for 1 hour.
_desc_ko: 당신은 한 가지 주문을 선호하는 전투 기술로 연마했으며, 이를 충분히 연습하여 더 이상 준비 없이도 시전할 수 있습니다. 주문책에서 스펠스트라이크로 사용할 수 있고, 보유한 메이거스 주문 슬롯 중 최고 레벨 이하인 주문을 하나 선택한다. 선택한 주문을 시전하기에 충분한 레벨의 주문 슬롯을 소모함으로써, 미리 준비하지 않고도 이 주문을 시전할 수 있다. 주문책에 새 주문을 추가할 때마다, 또는 주문책을 1시간 동안 연구함으로써 이 주문을 변경할 수 있다.

name: Aegis of Arnisant

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a shield.

Inspired by the tale of Arnisant, you transform your shield into a magic ward. Until the beginning of your next turn, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.S9PZFOVe7zhORkUc]{Absorb into the Aegis} reaction.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a shield.

Inspired by the tale of Arnisant, you transform your shield into a magic ward. Until the beginning of your next turn, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.S9PZFOVe7zhORkUc]{Absorb into the Aegis} reaction.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 방패를 장비하고 있어야 합니다.

아르니산트의 전설에서 영감을 받아, 당신의 방패를 마법의 수호부로 변환합니다. 다음 차례 시작 전까지, 당신은 @link[actions.absorb-into-the-aegis] 반응을 얻습니다.

name: Swift Retribution

description.value: The transgressions of your enemies fuel you to retaliate with divine speed. When an enemy triggers your champion's reaction, you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} on your next turn. You can use the extra action to move closer to that enemy or to Strike that enemy.

_desc_en: The transgressions of your enemies fuel you to retaliate with divine speed. When an enemy triggers your champion's reaction, you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} on your next turn. You can use the extra action to move closer to that enemy or to Strike that enemy.
_desc_ko: 적의 범행이 신성한 속도로 보복하도록 당신을 자극한다. 적이 당신의 챔피언의 반응을 유발할 때, 당신은 다음 턴에 @link[conditions.quickened] 상태가 된다. 추가 행동을 사용하여 그 적에게 더 가까이 이동하거나 그 적을 강타할 수 있다.

name: Dig up Secrets

description.value: You are an endless well of knowledge and can remember several vital pieces of information at once. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZYoC630tNGutgbE0]{Hypercognition} as an innate occult spell once per day.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: You are an endless well of knowledge and can remember several vital pieces of information at once. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZYoC630tNGutgbE0]{Hypercognition} as an innate occult spell once per day.
_desc_ko: 당신은 끝없는 지식의 샘이며 한 번에 여러 활력 정보를 기억할 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번 선천적 오컬트 주문으로 @link[spells.hypercognition]를 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Gods' Palm

description.value:
You control your spirit energy when you attack, using it to reinforce yourself or to thrust past your enemy's physical defenses. Make a fist Strike; on a success, you can choose to either deal all damage from the attack as spirit damage, or deal damage as normal but gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level that last for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.KqyxpiGpEuju3d4z]{Effect: God's Palm (Temporary Hit Points)}

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You control your spirit energy when you attack, using it to reinforce yourself or to thrust past your enemy's physical defenses. Make a fist Strike; on a success, you can choose to either deal all damage from the attack as spirit damage, or deal damage as normal but gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level that last for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.KqyxpiGpEuju3d4z]{Effect: God's Palm (Temporary Hit Points)}
_desc_ko:
공격 시 영혼 에너지를 제어하여 자신을 강화하거나 적의 물리 방어를 뚫고 나아갑니다. 주먹을 쥐고 공격하십시오. 성공 시, 공격의 모든 피해를 영혼 피해로 입히거나, 정상적으로 피해를 입히되 자신의 레벨 절반에 해당하는 임시 HP를 1라운드 동안 획득할 수 있습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.KqyxpiGpEuju3d4z]{효과: 신의 손바닥 (임시 HP)}

name: Lightspeed Assault

description.value:
You zoom from enemy to enemy, striking each in an instant. Stride to an enemy and attempt a Strike against it. If successful, you can add another action to Lightspeed Assault. Stride again and attempt another Strike; if this second Strike is successful, you can spend another action to Stride again and attempt a third Strike. You can use Lightspeed Assault while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type. You attempt a backlash check for your deviation only once, regardless of how many actions you end up spending on your Lightspeed Assault.

Awakening Your speed allows you to slip the bonds of space. Instead of Striding, you simply teleport to your desired destination. Lightspeed Assault gains the teleportation trait.

Awakening You move so quickly that you might as well be in multiple places at once. When you use Lightspeed Assault, you can decide to spend one, two, or three actions up front, selecting your targets ahead of time. You can flank with yourself for any of these Strikes, and if you deal damage to a target more than once, you can add all the damage together for the purpose of overcoming resistances, if it would be more beneficial to you.

_desc_en:
You zoom from enemy to enemy, striking each in an instant. Stride to an enemy and attempt a Strike against it. If successful, you can add another action to Lightspeed Assault. Stride again and attempt another Strike; if this second Strike is successful, you can spend another action to Stride again and attempt a third Strike. You can use Lightspeed Assault while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type. You attempt a backlash check for your deviation only once, regardless of how many actions you end up spending on your Lightspeed Assault.

Awakening Your speed allows you to slip the bonds of space. Instead of Striding, you simply teleport to your desired destination. Lightspeed Assault gains the teleportation trait.

Awakening You move so quickly that you might as well be in multiple places at once. When you use Lightspeed Assault, you can decide to spend one, two, or three actions up front, selecting your targets ahead of time. You can flank with yourself for any of these Strikes, and if you deal damage to a target more than once, you can add all the damage together for the purpose of overcoming resistances, if it would be more beneficial to you.
_desc_ko:
적들 사이를 순식간에 이동하며 각각을 강타한다. 적에게 이동을 사용해 공격을 시도하다. 성공 시, 광속 돌격에 추가 행동을 더할 수 있다. 다시 이동을 사용해 두 번째 공격을 시도하다. 이 두 번째 공격이 성공하면, 또 다른 행동을 소모해 이동을 다시 사용해 세 번째 공격을 시도할 수 있다. 해당 이동 유형을 보유한 경우, 돌진 대신 파고들기, 등반, 비행, 수영 중 하나를 사용해 광속 돌격을 수행할 수 있다. 광속 돌격에 소모한 행동 횟수와 무관하게, 편차에 대한 반동 판정은 단 한 번만 시도한다.

각성 당신의 속도는 공간의 속박을 벗어나게 합니다. 이동 대신 원하는 목적지로 순간이동합니다. 광속 돌격은 순간이동 특성을 획득합니다.

각성 당신은 너무 빠르게 움직여 한 번에 여러 곳에 존재하는 것과 다름없습니다. 광속 돌격을 사용할 때, 사전에 한 번, 두 번, 또는 세 번의 행동을 미리 소비하여 목표를 선택할 수 있습니다. 이 공격들 중 어느 것이든 자신과 측면 공격을 할 수 있으며, 한 대상에게 여러 번 피해를 입힐 경우, 저항력 극복을 위해 모든 피해를 합산할 수 있다(그것이 더 유리할 경우).

name: Crimson Breath

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You gain a fire breath weapon similar to that of a crimson worm. You breathe a blast of flame in a @Template[cone|distance:30] that deals @Damage[((ceil(max(0,((@actor.level - 13)/2)))*2)+12)d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in the area (@Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] save). This damage increases by 2d6 at 14th level and every 2 levels thereafter.

Note: A DC was not provided for this ability by Paizo. The button above uses the better of your class or spell DC.

publication.title: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You gain a fire breath weapon similar to that of a crimson worm. You breathe a blast of flame in a @Template[cone|distance:30] that deals @Damage[((ceil(max(0,((@actor.level - 13)/2)))*2)+12)d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in the area (@Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] save). This damage increases by 2d6 at 14th level and every 2 levels thereafter.

Note: A DC was not provided for this ability by Paizo. The button above uses the better of your class or spell DC.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신은 진홍색 벌레와 유사한 화염 호흡 무기를 얻습니다. 당신은 30피트 범위의 화염을 내뿜어 해당 영역 내 모든 생물에게 화염의 피해를 입힙니다 (기본 반사 내성). 이 피해는 14레벨에 도달하면 2d6씩 증가하며, 이후 2레벨마다 추가로 증가합니다.

참고: Paizo에서 이 능력에 대한 DC를 제공하지 않았습니다. 위 버튼은 클래스 DC와 주문 DC 중 더 높은 값을 사용합니다.

name: Swim Through Earth

description.value:
The earth parts before you, letting you swim through it. You gain a burrow Speed equal to your land Speed and can immediately Burrow once. You don't gain the ability to breathe while in the earth, so you must hold your breath. The impulse ends at the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it up to 1 minute. If you're inside the earth when the impulse ends, you immediately return to the surface directly above you, fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} when you reach the surface, and are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of your next turn.

Level (14th) You can burrow through rock and similar dense earthen matter, leaving no tunnels or signs of your passing.

_desc_en:
The earth parts before you, letting you swim through it. You gain a burrow Speed equal to your land Speed and can immediately Burrow once. You don't gain the ability to breathe while in the earth, so you must hold your breath. The impulse ends at the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it up to 1 minute. If you're inside the earth when the impulse ends, you immediately return to the surface directly above you, fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} when you reach the surface, and are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of your next turn.

Level (14th) You can burrow through rock and similar dense earthen matter, leaving no tunnels or signs of your passing.
_desc_ko:
대지의 틈새가 열리며 그 속을 헤엄쳐 지나갈 수 있습니다. 지상 속도와의 동일한 굴착 이동 속도를 얻으며 즉시 한 번 굴착할 수 있습니다. 대지 속에서는 호흡 능력이 생기지 않으므로 숨을 참아야 합니다. 이 임펄스는 다음 턴 종료 시까지 지속되나 최대 1분까지 연장할 수 있습니다. 임펄스가 종료될 때 땅속에 있다면, 즉시 바로 위 지표면으로 되돌아와 지표면에 닿는 순간 @link[conditions.prone] 상태가 되며, 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.slowed]{1} 상태가 된다.

레벨 (14레벨) 바위나 유사한 고밀도 토양을 뚫고 이동할 수 있으며, 이동 흔적이나 터널을 남기지 않습니다.

name: Call of the Wild

description.value: You call upon the creatures of nature to come to your aid. You can spend 10 minutes in concert with nature to replace a spell you've prepared in one of your druid spell slots with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4YnON9JHYqtLzccu]{Summon Animal} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jSRAyd57kd4WZ4yE]{Summon Plant or Fungus} spell of the same rank.

_desc_en: You call upon the creatures of nature to come to your aid. You can spend 10 minutes in concert with nature to replace a spell you've prepared in one of your druid spell slots with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4YnON9JHYqtLzccu]{Summon Animal} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jSRAyd57kd4WZ4yE]{Summon Plant or Fungus} spell of the same rank.
_desc_ko: 자연의 생물들을 불러 도움을 청한다. 자연과 조화를 이루며 10분을 보내면, 준비한 드루이드 주문 슬롯 중 하나에 있는 주문을 동일한 랭크의 @link[spells.summon-animal] 또는 @link[spells.summon-plant-or-fungus] 주문으로 대체할 수 있다.

name: Drain Emotion

description.value:
You touch an adjacent creature and attempt to draw out its excess emotion. Attempt a counteract check against a single emotion or fear effect affecting the touched creature. If you succeed, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level for a number of rounds equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1 round).

Special This feat gains the trait appropriate for your ancestry (human for human, goblin for goblin, etc.).

_desc_en:
You touch an adjacent creature and attempt to draw out its excess emotion. Attempt a counteract check against a single emotion or fear effect affecting the touched creature. If you succeed, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level for a number of rounds equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1 round).

Special This feat gains the trait appropriate for your ancestry (human for human, goblin for goblin, etc.).
_desc_ko:
인접한 생물을 만져 과도한 감정을 끌어내리려고 시도합니다. 접촉된 생물에게 영향을 미치는 단일 감정 또는 공포 효과에 대해 반격 판정을 시도합니다. 성공 시, 매력 수정자만큼의 라운드 동안(최소 1라운드) 레벨에 해당하는 임시 HP를 얻습니다.

특수 이 피트는 당신의 혈통에 맞는 특성(인간은 인간, 고블린은 고블린 등)을 부여받습니다.

name: Ceremony of Sunlight

description.value: You have learned how to master the power contained within sunlight, just like the trees that form your body. Your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.ancestryfeatures.Item.BgHrucbZ9TH92RDv]{Sunlight Healing} recovers 1d8 Hit Points per level.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: You have learned how to master the power contained within sunlight, just like the trees that form your body. Your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.ancestryfeatures.Item.BgHrucbZ9TH92RDv]{Sunlight Healing} recovers 1d8 Hit Points per level.
_desc_ko: 당신은 몸을 이루는 나무들처럼 햇빛 속에 담긴 힘을 마스터하는 법을 터득했습니다. 당신의 @link[feats.sunlight-healing]는 레벨당 1d8 HP를 회복시킵니다.

name: Forge-Day's Rest

description.value:
Access underground dwarf ethnicity

Your unusual rest cycle allows you to recover faster. As long as you rest for 12 hours, you gain the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.N8Xz5fuW6o7GW124]{Fast Recovery} general feat and you can go 20 hours without resting before becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.

_desc_en:
Access underground dwarf ethnicity

Your unusual rest cycle allows you to recover faster. As long as you rest for 12 hours, you gain the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.N8Xz5fuW6o7GW124]{Fast Recovery} general feat and you can go 20 hours without resting before becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.
_desc_ko:
접근 지하 드워프 종족

당신의 특이한 휴식 주기로 인해 더 빨리 회복할 수 있습니다. 12시간 동안 휴식하면 @link[feats.fast-recovery] 피트 일반 특성의 효과를 얻으며, @link[conditions.fatigued]가 되기 전까지 20시간 동안 휴식 없이 버틸 수 있습니다.

name: Unfazed Assessment

description.value: You have witnessed hundreds of fighting styles and quickly adapt to defend against complicated maneuvers. Choose a creature within 30 feet who you're aware of, and attempt a @Check[perception|against:will] check against that target's Will DC. If you succeed, you size up their fighting style, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws against that creature's attacks (or a +2 circumstance bonus for a critical success). These benefits last until the end of your next turn.

_desc_en: You have witnessed hundreds of fighting styles and quickly adapt to defend against complicated maneuvers. Choose a creature within 30 feet who you're aware of, and attempt a @Check[perception|against:will] check against that target's Will DC. If you succeed, you size up their fighting style, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws against that creature's attacks (or a +2 circumstance bonus for a critical success). These benefits last until the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko: 수많은 전투 스타일을 목격한 당신은 복잡한 기동에 신속히 적응하여 방어합니다. 30피트 내의 인지 중인 생물을 선택하고, 해당 대상의 의지 DC에 대해 지각 판정을 시도합니다. 성공하면 상대방의 전투 스타일을 파악하여, 해당 생물의 공격에 대한 AC와 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다(대성공 시 +2 상황 보너스). 이 효과는 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 지속됩니다.

name: Wellspring Mage Dedication

description.value:
There's no longer a limit on how many temporary spell slots you can gain per day from wellspring magic.

Special You can't select another dedication feat until you gain two other feats from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.zj9z2BwVX6TLHdx3]{Wellspring Mage} archetype.

_desc_en:
There's no longer a limit on how many temporary spell slots you can gain per day from wellspring magic.

Special You can't select another dedication feat until you gain two other feats from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.zj9z2BwVX6TLHdx3]{Wellspring Mage} archetype.
_desc_ko:
웰스프링 마법으로 하루에 획득할 수 있는 임시 주문 슬롯 수에 제한이 더 이상 없습니다.

특수 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.zj9z2BwVX6TLHdx3]{원천 마법사} 아키타입에서 다른 두 가지 피트를 획득하기 전까지는 다른 헌신 피트를 선택할 수 없습니다.

name: Enthralling Allure

description.value: The powers of domination employed by your progenitors have manifested in you as well. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLA0q0WOK2YPuJs6]{Charm} as a divine innate spell once per day. Its spell rank is equal to half your level rounded up, but it doesn't increase its duration or number of targets at 4th and 8th rank.

_desc_en: The powers of domination employed by your progenitors have manifested in you as well. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLA0q0WOK2YPuJs6]{Charm} as a divine innate spell once per day. Its spell rank is equal to half your level rounded up, but it doesn't increase its duration or number of targets at 4th and 8th rank.
_desc_ko: 조상들이 사용하던 지배의 힘이 당신에게도 창조되었습니다. 하루에 한 번, 신성 선천 주문으로 @link[spells.charm]을 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 주문 랭크은 네 레벨의 절반(올림)과 같으나, (4th)와 8th 랭크에서 지속 시간이나 대상 수가 증가하지는 않는다.

name: Kitsune Spell Familiarity

description.value: You've picked up a few magical tricks. During your daily preparations, choose @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4gBIw4IDrSfFHik4]{Daze}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.RA7VKcen3p56rVyZ]{Forbidding Ward}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.atlgGNI1E1Ox3O3a]{Ghost Sound}. Until your next daily preparations, you can cast this cantrip as a divine innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

Until your next daily preparations, you can cast this cantrip as a divine innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 당신은 몇 가지 마법적 기술을 익혔습니다. 일일 준비 시 @link[spells.daze], @link[spells.forbidding-ward], 또는 @link[spells.ghost-sound] 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 다음 일일 준비 시간까지, 이 캔트립을 신성 선천 마법으로 마음대로 시전할 수 있습니다. 캔트립은 레벨의 절반(올림)에 해당하는 마법 랭크으로 강화됩니다.

name: Lessons of Flux

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You fail a skill check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through}.

You apply the persistence and permutation taught by faydhaans to your failures. You reroll the check and take the second result. If it still fails or critically fails, you can ask a question about the creature you were attempting to Grapple, Reposition, Shove, Trip, or Tumble Through as if you had succeeded at a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}.

_desc_ko:
빈도 시간당 1회

발동 조건 다음 기술 판정 실패 시: @link[actions.grapple], @link[actions.reposition], @link[actions.shove], @link[actions.trip], 또는 @link[actions.tumble-through]에 실패합니다.

당신은 실패한 행동에 파이다안들이 가르쳐준 끈기와 변형 기술을 적용합니다. 당신은 해당 판정을 재굴림하고 두 번째 결과를 적용합니다. 여전히 실패하거나 대실패할 경우, 당신이 붙잡기, 위치 변경, 밀치기, 걸려 넘어뜨리기, 또는 회피 돌파를 시도했던 생물에 대해 @link[actions.recall-knowledge] 판정에서 성공한 것처럼 질문할 수 있습니다.

name: Reprepare Spell

description.value:
You've discovered how to reuse some of your spell slots over and over. You can spend 10 minutes to prepare a spell that you already cast today, regaining access to that spell slot. The spell must be of 4th rank or lower and can't have a duration. You can reprepare a spell in this way even if you've already reprepared that spell previously in the same day.

If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.QzWXMCSGNfvvpYgF]{Spell Substitution} arcane thesis, you can instead prepare a different spell in an expended slot, as long as the new spell doesn't have a duration. You can use spell substitution on that slot again, but you remain restricted to preparing only spells without a duration in that slot until the next time you make your daily preparations.

_desc_en:
You've discovered how to reuse some of your spell slots over and over. You can spend 10 minutes to prepare a spell that you already cast today, regaining access to that spell slot. The spell must be of 4th rank or lower and can't have a duration. You can reprepare a spell in this way even if you've already reprepared that spell previously in the same day.

If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.QzWXMCSGNfvvpYgF]{Spell Substitution} arcane thesis, you can instead prepare a different spell in an expended slot, as long as the new spell doesn't have a duration. You can use spell substitution on that slot again, but you remain restricted to preparing only spells without a duration in that slot until the next time you make your daily preparations.
_desc_ko:
당신은 일부 주문 슬롯을 반복적으로 재사용하는 방법을 발견했습니다. 10분을 소모하여 오늘 이미 시전한 주문을 재준비할 수 있으며, 해당 주문 슬롯을 다시 사용할 수 있게 됩니다. 해당 주문은 (4th)랭크 이하여야 하며 지속 시간이 없어야 합니다. 같은 날에 이미 재준비한 주문이라도 이 방법으로 다시 재준비할 수 있습니다.

@link[feats.spell-substitution] 아케인 학설을 보유한 경우, 소모된 슬롯에 지속 시간이 없는 다른 주문을 대신 준비할 수 있습니다. 해당 슬롯에 주문 대체를 다시 사용할 수 있지만, 다음 일일 준비를 할 때까지 해당 슬롯에는 지속 시간이 없는 주문만 준비할 수 있습니다.

name: Educated Assessment

description.value: You attempt to Recall Knowledge about a creature, and the GM uses the same secret roll result against the creature's Deception or Stealth DC, giving you the information from a Battle Assessment. You might get a different degree of success on the Recall Knowledge check than what you get for the Battle Assessment. If you have the Battle Assessment feat, you gain the effects of Educated Assessment whenever you Recall Knowledge (such as with the Automatic Knowledge feat).

_desc_en: You attempt to Recall Knowledge about a creature, and the GM uses the same secret roll result against the creature's Deception or Stealth DC, giving you the information from a Battle Assessment. You might get a different degree of success on the Recall Knowledge check than what you get for the Battle Assessment. If you have the Battle Assessment feat, you gain the effects of Educated Assessment whenever you Recall Knowledge (such as with the Automatic Knowledge feat).
_desc_ko: 당신은 생물에 대한 지식 회상을 시도하며, GM은 동일한 비밀 굴림 결과를 해당 생물의 기만 또는 은신 DC에 적용하여 전투 평가에서 얻는 정보와 동일한 정보를 제공합니다. 지식 회상 판정에서 얻는 성공 정도는 전투 평가에서 얻는 것과 다를 수 있습니다. 전투 평가 피트를 보유한 경우, 지식 회상(자동 지식 피트 등) 시 교육받은 평가 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Share Weakness

description.value:
Requirements You are Exploiting a creature's Vulnerability using mortal weakness.

You select an object from your esoterica that has great personal value to you, such as a locket or treasured ring, and you grant it to an adjacent ally, establishing a personal link that allows your ally to affect an enemy as if they were you. The ally's Strikes apply the weakness from your mortal weakness the same way your Strikes do. This benefit ends when your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.fodJ3zuwQsYnBbtk]{Exploit Vulnerability} ends or you Share Weakness again.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are Exploiting a creature's Vulnerability using mortal weakness.

You select an object from your esoterica that has great personal value to you, such as a locket or treasured ring, and you grant it to an adjacent ally, establishing a personal link that allows your ally to affect an enemy as if they were you. The ally's Strikes apply the weakness from your mortal weakness the same way your Strikes do. This benefit ends when your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.fodJ3zuwQsYnBbtk]{Exploit Vulnerability} ends or you Share Weakness again.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 치명적 약점을 이용해 생물의 약점을 악용하고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 자신의 에소테리카 중 목걸이 같은 목걸이나 소중한 반지처럼 개인적으로 큰 가치를 지닌 물건을 선택하여 아군에게 부여합니다. 이를 통해 아군이 당신인 것처럼 적에게 영향을 미칠 수 있는 개인적 연결을 형성합니다. 동료의 공격은 당신의 치명적 약점 효과를 당신의 공격과 동일한 방식으로 적용한다. 이 효과는 당신의 약점 악용이 종료되거나 당신이 다시 약점 공유를 할 때 끝난다.

name: Communal Sustain

description.value:
Frequency once per round

Choose one spell with a sustained duration that one of your allies has in effect. You must be within 30 feet of the chosen ally. The ally can Sustain the Spell once as a free action, triggered at the start of their next turn.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en:
Frequency once per round

Choose one spell with a sustained duration that one of your allies has in effect. You must be within 30 feet of the chosen ally. The ally can Sustain the Spell once as a free action, triggered at the start of their next turn.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 라운드당 1회

동료 중 지속 효과가 발동 중인 주문을 하나 선택한다. 선택한 동료로부터 30피트 이내에 있어야 한다. 해당 동료는 다음 턴 시작 시 트리거되는 무료 행동으로 해당 주문을 한 번만 지속시킬 수 있다.

name: Spore Cloud

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You unleash a cloud of pollen or similar spores. All creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] around you must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|options:area-effect,inflicts:blinded,inflicts:dazzled] save using your class DC or spell DC (whichever is higher) with the following results. Plants and fungi are immune to this effect.

Critical Success No effect.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is dazzled and can see only 10 feet away for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.

Plants and fungi are immune to this effect.

_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

당신은 꽃가루나 유사한 포자 구름을 방출합니다. 당신 주변 10피트 반경 내의 모든 생물은 당신의 클래스 DC 또는 주문 DC(둘 중 더 높은 쪽)를 사용한 인내 내성을 시도해야 하며, 결과는 다음과 같습니다. 식물과 균류는 이 효과에 면역입니다.

대성공 효과 없음.

성공 생물은 @link[conditions.dazzled] 상태가 되어 1라운드 동안 시야가 10피트로 제한됩니다.

실패 생물은 눈부심 상태가 되어 1라운드 동안 10피트 거리만 볼 수 있습니다.

대실패 생물은 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.blinded] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Swarmkeeper Dedication

description.value:
Your body has become a symbiotic hive for a swarm of crawling insects. You can emit your swarm using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.E48YTUyreo1kc9GM]{Swarm Forth} action, and you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.k6ML9SPMxaGJyjqO]{Bite and Sting} action while your swarm is outside your body to command it to attack. Your deep connection to your swarm precludes you from also having an animal companion, though if an ability allows you to have more than one animal companion (such as the beastmaster archetype), you can count your swarm as one. You're immune to any damage from your swarm, and during your daily preparations you can anoint up to five willing creatures with a concoction made from your pheromones to grant them immunity as well.

While outside your body, your swarm is Large and has a Speed of 15 feet and a climb Speed of 15 feet. It can occupy the same space as other creatures. While outside your body, the swarm can be attacked. It uses your statistics for defenses but is immune to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, and mental effects that target only a specific number of creatures. The swarm has resistance equal to your level to physical damage and weakness equal to your level to area and splash damage. Any damage that would be dealt to the swarm is dealt to you instead, though you take damage only once from any ability that includes both you and the swarm in the area of effect (though you take the greater amount of damage).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.If0rK2DhKh2CrYKR]{Swarmkeeper}

_desc_ko:
당신의 몸은 기어다니는 곤충 떼의 공생적 군집체가 되었다. @link[actions.swarm-forth] 행동으로 떼를 배출할 수 있으며, 떼가 몸 밖으로 나온 상태에서 @link[actions.bite-and-sting] 행동을 사용해 공격을 지시할 수 있습니다. 떼와의 깊은 유대감으로 인해 동물 동료를 추가로 가질 수 없으나, 능력(예: 비스트마스터 아키타입)으로 동물 동료 여러 마리를 가질 수 있다면 떼를 한 마리로 간주할 수 있습니다. 당신은 떼로부터 받는 모든 피해에 면역이며, 일일 준비 시간 동안 당신의 페로몬으로 만든 혼합물로 최대 다섯 마리의 동의한 대상에게 발라 그들에게도 면역을 부여할 수 있습니다.

몸 밖으로 나온 상태에서, 당신의 군집은 대형이며 이동 속도 15피트, 등반 속도 15피트를 가집니다. 다른 생물과 동일한 공간을 차지할 수 있습니다. 몸 밖에서 군집은 공격받을 수 있습니다. 방어 능력은 당신의 능력치를 사용하지만, 특정 수의 생물만을 대상으로 하는 붙잡힘, @link[conditions.prone], @link[conditions.restrained], 정신 효과에 면역입니다. 군집은 물리 피해에 대해 당신의 레벨에 해당하는 저항력을 가지며, 범위 및 방사 피해에 대해 당신의 레벨에 해당하는 의 약점을 가집니다. 떼에게 가해질 피해는 대신 당신에게 가해지지만, 당신과 떼가 모두 효과 범위에 포함되는 능력의 피해는 한 번만 받습니다(다만 더 큰 피해량을 받습니다).

name: Restoring Blood

description.value: Your body can process an alternative to your venom that heals wounds. You can use your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.s4V7JWSMF9JPJAeX]{Envenom} action to produce a blood restorative instead of vishkanyan venom. You can make a blood restorative at most once per 10 minutes, even if your Envenom action can be used more frequently. You or an adjacent creature can Interact to consume the restorative to regain @Damage[(ternary(gte(@actor.level,15),5,3))d6[vitality,healing]|shortLabel] Hit Points. This is a vitality healing effect. A restorative spoils at the start of your next turn. When you reach 15th level, the restorative restores 5d6 Hit Points instead.
