You can use your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.s4V7JWSMF9JPJAeX]{Envenom} action to produce a blood restorative instead of vishkanyan venom. You can make a blood restorative at most once per 10 minutes, even if your Envenom action can be used more frequently. You or an adjacent creature can Interact to consume the restorative to regain @Damage[(ternary(gte(@actor.level,15),5,3))d6[vitality,healing]|shortLabel] Hit Points. This is a vitality healing effect. A restorative spoils at the start of your next turn. When you reach 15th level, the restorative restores 5d6 Hit Points instead.
_desc_ko: 당신의 몸은 상처를 치유하는 독의 대체물을 생성할 수 있습니다. @link[actions.envenom] 행동을 사용하여 비슈카냔 독 대신 혈액 회복제를 생성할 수 있습니다. 맹독 주입 행동을 더 자주 사용할 수 있더라도, 혈액 회복제는 10분에 한 번만 생성할 수 있습니다. 당신이나 인접한 생물이 상호작용하여 회복제를 섭취하면 활력 회복 HP를 회복합니다. 이는 활력 치유 효과입니다. 회복제는 다음 턴 시작 시 부패합니다. 15레벨에 도달하면 회복제가 5d6 HP를 회복시킵니다.

name: Community-Minded

description.value: You are familiar with all the members of your community and their typical movements, and you have learned how to apply these patterns outside those circles. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Perception DC against someone attempting to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} to you and to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} or to detect a creature trying to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} someone they are not.

_desc_en: You are familiar with all the members of your community and their typical movements, and you have learned how to apply these patterns outside those circles. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Perception DC against someone attempting to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} to you and to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} or to detect a creature trying to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} someone they are not.
_desc_ko: 당신은 공동체의 모든 구성원과 그들의 전형적인 움직임을 익숙하게 알고 있으며, 이러한 패턴을 그 범위를 벗어나 적용하는 법을 터득했습니다. 누군가가 당신에게 @link[actions.lie]을 시도할 때의 지각 DC와, @link[actions.sense-motive] 지각 판정, 혹은 자신이 아닌 누군가를 @link[actions.impersonate]하려는 생물을 감지하는 지각 판정에서 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Fearful Symmetry

description.value:
Requirements You're in hybrid or tiger shape and your last action was a critically successful Strike with your unarmed attack.

You attack with a feline grace as captivatingly beautiful as it is deadly. All enemies within 30 feet of the creature you critically hit must attempt at a @Check[will|against:class] save against your class DC. Enemies that fail their saves become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} and are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with you for 1 round. Your hostile actions don't end this fascination, but those of your allies do. Regardless of the effects of the save, the creature is immune to Fearful Symmetry for 1 hour.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're in hybrid or tiger shape and your last action was a critically successful Strike with your unarmed attack.

You attack with a feline grace as captivatingly beautiful as it is deadly. All enemies within 30 feet of the creature you critically hit must attempt at a @Check[will|against:class] save against your class DC. Enemies that fail their saves become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} and are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with you for 1 round. Your hostile actions don't end this fascination, but those of your allies do. Regardless of the effects of the save, the creature is immune to Fearful Symmetry for 1 hour.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 혼혈형 또는 호랑이 형태이며, 마지막 행동이 비무장 공격으로 대성공한 타격이었을 때.

당신은 치명적일 만큼 매혹적인 고양이의 우아함으로 공격합니다. 치명타를 입힌 생물로부터 30피트 이내의 모든 적들은 당신의 직업 난이도(DC)에 대한 의지 저항 검사를 시도해야 합니다. 저항에 실패한 적들은 @link[conditions.frightened]{1} 상태가 되며 1라운드 동안 당신에게 @link[conditions.fascinated]매혹 상태가 됩니다. 당신의 적대적 행동은 이 매혹을 해제하지 않지만, 아군의 행동은 해제합니다. 저항 내성 여부와 상관없이, 해당 생물은 1시간 동안 공포의 대칭에 면역됩니다.

name: Nothing but Fluff

description.value: Your fluffy interior lacks specific organs and struts, with few weak spots to injure. You gain resistance to precision damage equal to half your level.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en: Your fluffy interior lacks specific organs and struts, with few weak spots to injure. You gain resistance to precision damage equal to half your level.
_desc_ko: 당신의 푹신한 내부는 특정 기관과 지지대가 부족하여 손상시킬 약점이 거의 없습니다. 당신은 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 정밀 피해에 대한 저항력을 얻습니다.

name: Illimitable Finisher

description.value: Your strikes flow endlessly. Step and attempt a single one-action finisher. This Strike gains the bravado trait, possibly replenishing your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.LzYi0OuOoypNb6jd]{Panache}; if you regain panache, you can immediately attempt another finisher as part of this action, ignoring the restriction of using actions with the attack trait after a finisher.

_desc_en: Your strikes flow endlessly. Step and attempt a single one-action finisher. This Strike gains the bravado trait, possibly replenishing your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.LzYi0OuOoypNb6jd]{Panache}; if you regain panache, you can immediately attempt another finisher as part of this action, ignoring the restriction of using actions with the attack trait after a finisher.
_desc_ko: 당신의 공격은 끝없이 이어진다. {신중한 발걸음}하며 단일 액션 하나 피니셔를 시도하다. 이 공격은 브라바도를 얻으며, 당신의 파나슈를 회복시킬 수 있다. 파나슈를 회복하면, 피니셔 후 공격 특성이 있는 액션 사용 제한을 무시하고 즉시 이 액션의 일부로 또 다른 피니셔를 시도할 수 있다.

name: Ever-Vigilant Senses

description.value:
Your eidolon has enhanced senses. It gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception, and can't be flanked except by creatures that are higher level than it.

It can see @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures and objects; they appear translucent and are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

When your eidolon moves within 30 feet of an illusion that can be disbelieved, the GM rolls a secret check to disbelieve it, even if your eidolon didn't spend an action to Interact.

_desc_en:
Your eidolon has enhanced senses. It gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception, and can't be flanked except by creatures that are higher level than it.

It can see @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures and objects; they appear translucent and are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

When your eidolon moves within 30 feet of an illusion that can be disbelieved, the GM rolls a secret check to disbelieve it, even if your eidolon didn't spend an action to Interact.
_desc_ko:
당신의 에이돌론은 강화된 감각을 지녔습니다. 지각 능력에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 자신보다 높은 레벨의 생물만이 측면 공격을 가할 수 있습니다.

투명화된 생물과 물체를 볼 수 있으며, 이들은 반투명하게 보이고 {가려진} 상태로 인식됩니다.

당신의 에이돌론이 믿지 않을 수 있는 환상으로부터 30피트 이내로 이동할 때, GM은 비밀 판정을 굴림하여 이를 믿지 않게 합니다. 에이돌론이 상호작용 행동을 사용하지 않았더라도 마찬가지입니다.

name: Tactical Excellence

description.value:
You add two new mobility or offensive tactics to your folio and increase your maximum number of tactics prepared by 1.

Special You can select this feat a second time at 8th level; when you do, you may choose your new tactics from either mobility or offensive tactics you do not already know or from any of the expert tactics you have access to.

_desc_en:
You add two new mobility or offensive tactics to your folio and increase your maximum number of tactics prepared by 1.

Special You can select this feat a second time at 8th level; when you do, you may choose your new tactics from either mobility or offensive tactics you do not already know or from any of the expert tactics you have access to.
_desc_ko:
당신은 두 가지 새로운 기동 전술 또는 공격 전술을 전술집에 추가하고, 준비 가능한 최대 전술 수를 1 증가시킵니다.

특수 (8th)레벨에 이 피트를 두 번째로 선택할 수 있습니다. 이때 새로운 전술은 아직 익히지 않은 기동성/공격 전술 또는 접근 가능한 전문가 전술 중 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Multifarious Muse

description.value:
Your muse doesn't fall into a single label. Choose a type of muse other than that of your own. You gain a 1st-level feat that requires that muse, and your muse is now also a muse of that type, allowing you to take feats with the other muse as a prerequisite. You don't gain any of the other effects of the muse you chose.

Special You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do, you must choose a different type of muse other than that of your own.

_desc_en:
Your muse doesn't fall into a single label. Choose a type of muse other than that of your own. You gain a 1st-level feat that requires that muse, and your muse is now also a muse of that type, allowing you to take feats with the other muse as a prerequisite. You don't gain any of the other effects of the muse you chose.

Special You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do, you must choose a different type of muse other than that of your own.
_desc_ko:
당신의 뮤즈는 단일 범주로 규정되지 않습니다. 자신의 뮤즈 유형과 다른 유형의 뮤즈를 선택하십시오. 해당 뮤즈를 요구하는 1레벨 피트를 획득하며, 이제 당신의 뮤즈는 해당 유형의 뮤즈이기도 하여 다른 뮤즈를 전제 조건으로 하는 피트를 선택할 수 있습니다. 선택한 뮤즈의 다른 효과는 얻지 못합니다.

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 매번 자신의 뮤즈 유형과 다른 유형의 뮤즈를 선택해야 합니다.

name: Cadence Call

description.value:
Frequency once per minute

You call out a quick cadence, guiding your allies into a more efficient rhythm. Each willing ally in your marshal's aura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} until the end of their next turn, and they can use the extra action only to Stride.

If an ally uses this extra action, at the end of its turn that ally becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of its following turn.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per minute

You call out a quick cadence, guiding your allies into a more efficient rhythm. Each willing ally in your marshal's aura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} until the end of their next turn, and they can use the extra action only to Stride.

If an ally uses this extra action, at the end of its turn that ally becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of its following turn.
_desc_ko:
빈도 분당 1회

당신은 빠른 박자를 외치며 동료들을 더 효율적인 리듬으로 이끕니다. 당신의 마셜 오라 안에 있는 각 의지하는 동료는 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.quickened] 상태가 되며, 추가 행동을 오직 이동에만 사용할 수 있습니다.

동료가 이 추가 행동을 사용하면, 그 동료는 자신의 턴이 끝날 때 @link[conditions.slowed]{1} 상태가 되어 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 지속됩니다.

name: Sign Language

description.value:
You learn the sign languages associated with the languages you know, allowing you to sign and understand signs. Sign languages typically require both hands to convey more complex concepts, and they are visual rather than auditory.

Sign language is difficult to understand during combat due to the level of attention needed, unlike basic gestures like pointing at a foe to suggest a target. Sign language is hard to use in areas of low visibility, just like speech is difficult in a noisy environment.

_desc_en:
You learn the sign languages associated with the languages you know, allowing you to sign and understand signs. Sign languages typically require both hands to convey more complex concepts, and they are visual rather than auditory.

Sign language is difficult to understand during combat due to the level of attention needed, unlike basic gestures like pointing at a foe to suggest a target. Sign language is hard to use in areas of low visibility, just like speech is difficult in a noisy environment.
_desc_ko:
당신은 알고 있는 언어와 연관된 수화를 익혀, 수화를 하고 이해할 수 있게 됩니다. 수화는 일반적으로 더 복잡한 개념을 전달하기 위해 양손을 사용하며, 청각적이라기보다 시각적입니다.

수화는 적을 가리켜 목표를 제안하는 것과 같은 기본적인 제스처와 달리, 필요한 주의력 수준 때문에 전투 중에는 이해하기 어렵습니다. 시야가 나쁜 지역에서는 수화를 사용하기 어렵습니다. 이는 시끄러운 환경에서 말하기가 어려운 것과 같습니다.

name: Sunlit Vitality

description.value: You gain nourishment through photosynthesis, like trees and other green plants. You typically don't need to pay for food, though you begin to starve if you go without sunlight for 1 week. You can derive nourishment from specially formulated bottles of sunlight instead of natural sunlight, but these bottles cost 10 times as much as standard rations (4 gp per week).

_desc_en: You gain nourishment through photosynthesis, like trees and other green plants. You typically don't need to pay for food, though you begin to starve if you go without sunlight for 1 week. You can derive nourishment from specially formulated bottles of sunlight instead of natural sunlight, but these bottles cost 10 times as much as standard rations (4 gp per week).
_desc_ko: 나무나 다른 초록색 식물처럼 광합성을 통해 영양분을 얻습니다. 일반적으로 음식 비용을 지불할 필요가 없지만, 햇빛 없이 1주일이 지나면 굶주리기 시작합니다. 자연광 대신 특수 제조된 병에 담긴 햇빛으로 영양분을 얻을 수 있으나, 이 병들은 일반 급식보다 10배 비쌉니다(주당 4gp).

name: Elver Pet

description.value:
Athamarus have bonded with eels more closely than any other fish. You have formed a strong connection with a young eel that serves as your pet. Typically, these eels are tended until they grow large enough to serve as a mount. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.6yPrvbSDaa8glLjn]{Pet} general feat. Instead of the normal choice of pet abilities, your eel has aquatic, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.BXssJhTJjKrfojwG]{Fast Movement}, and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.mK3mAUWiRLZZYNdz]{Damage Avoidance} familiar ability for Reflex saves. The aquatic ability means it gains the aquatic trait, breathes water instead of air, and has a swim Speed instead of a land Speed.

When you aren't in an aquatic environment, you can easily carry your pet eel around in a small water-filled globe that has light Bulk.

_desc_en:
Athamarus have bonded with eels more closely than any other fish. You have formed a strong connection with a young eel that serves as your pet. Typically, these eels are tended until they grow large enough to serve as a mount. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.6yPrvbSDaa8glLjn]{Pet} general feat. Instead of the normal choice of pet abilities, your eel has aquatic, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.BXssJhTJjKrfojwG]{Fast Movement}, and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.mK3mAUWiRLZZYNdz]{Damage Avoidance} familiar ability for Reflex saves. The aquatic ability means it gains the aquatic trait, breathes water instead of air, and has a swim Speed instead of a land Speed.

When you aren't in an aquatic environment, you can easily carry your pet eel around in a small water-filled globe that has light Bulk.
_desc_ko:
아타마루는 다른 어떤 물고기보다 장어와 더 깊은 유대를 형성했습니다. 당신은 애완동물로 삼은 어린 장어와 강한 유대감을 형성했습니다. 일반적으로 이 장어들은 탈것으로 사용할 만큼 커질 때까지 키웁니다. 당신은 @link[feats.pet] 일반 피트를 얻습니다. 애완동물 능력 선택 대신, 당신의 장어는 수중 능력, @link[actions.fast-movement] 능력, 그리고 반사 내성에 대한 @link[actions.damage-avoidance] 패밀리어 능력을 가집니다. 수중 능력은 장어가 수중 특성을 얻고, 공기가 아닌 물을 호흡하며, 지상 속도 대신 수영 속도를 가짐을 의미합니다.

수중 환경이 아닌 곳에서는 가벼운 벌크의 작은 물이 담긴 구형 용기에 애완 뱀장어를 쉽게 휴대할 수 있습니다.

name: Quick Recovery

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger Your turn begins, and you have the wounded condition.

You use your command over your form to repair life-threatening wounds. Reduce your wounded condition by 1.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger Your turn begins, and you have the wounded condition.

You use your command over your form to repair life-threatening wounds. Reduce your wounded condition by 1.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 자신의 턴이 시작되고, 자신이 부상 상태일 때.

자신의 형태에 대한 통제력을 사용하여 생명을 위협하는 상처를 치료합니다. 부상 상태를 1 감소시킵니다.

name: I Sense Malevolence

description.value: Your time in the River of Souls has given you deep insight into the machinations of those who refuse to move on. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.3ehSrqTAm7IPqbIZ]{Spirit Sense} as a 6th-rank occult innate spell, which you can cast once per day.

publication.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

_desc_en: Your time in the River of Souls has given you deep insight into the machinations of those who refuse to move on. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.3ehSrqTAm7IPqbIZ]{Spirit Sense} as a 6th-rank occult innate spell, which you can cast once per day.
_desc_ko: 영혼의 강에서의 시간은 당신에게 떠나기를 거부하는 자들의 계략에 대한 깊은 통찰력을 주었습니다. 당신은 @link[spells.spirit-sense]를 6랭크 오컬트 선천 마법으로 얻으며, 하루에 한 번 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Vishkanya Weapon Expertise

description.value: Extensive training has granted you an elegant control in the use of vishkanyan weapons. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in a given weapon or weapons, you also gain that proficiency in the blowgun, fighting fan, kris, kukri, shuriken, and all vishkanyan weapons in which you are trained.

_desc_en: Extensive training has granted you an elegant control in the use of vishkanyan weapons. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in a given weapon or weapons, you also gain that proficiency in the blowgun, fighting fan, kris, kukri, shuriken, and all vishkanyan weapons in which you are trained.
_desc_ko: 광범위한 훈련을 통해 비슈카냐 무기를 우아하게 다루는 능력을 얻었습니다. 특정 무기나 무기들에 대해 전문가 이상의 숙련도를 부여하는 클래스 특성을 획득할 때마다, 당신은 또한 블로우건, 전투용 부채, 크리스, 쿠크리, 수리검, 그리고 당신이 훈련받은 모든 비슈카냐 무기들에 대해서도 그 숙련도를 획득합니다.

name: Incredible Beastmaster Companion

description.value: Your mature animal companions continue to grow and develop. Each of them becomes a nimble or savage animal companion, gaining additional capabilities determined by the type of companion. You choose nimble or savage individually for each companion, including any companion that becomes mature after you take this feat.

_desc_en: Your mature animal companions continue to grow and develop. Each of them becomes a nimble or savage animal companion, gaining additional capabilities determined by the type of companion. You choose nimble or savage individually for each companion, including any companion that becomes mature after you take this feat.
_desc_ko: 성숙한 동물 동료들은 계속 성장하고 발전합니다. 각 동물 동료는 민첩한 동물 동료 또는 야성적인 동물 동료가 되어, 동물 동료 유형에 따라 추가 능력을 얻습니다. 이 피트를 선택한 후 성숙해지는 동물 동료를 포함해 각 동물 동료에 대해 개별적으로 민첩한/야성적인 유형을 선택합니다.

name: Predator's Pounce

description.value:
Requirements You are unarmored or wearing light armor

You close the distance to your prey in a blur, pouncing on the creature before it can react. You Stride up to your Speed and make a Strike at the end of your movement.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are unarmored or wearing light armor

You close the distance to your prey in a blur, pouncing on the creature before it can react. You Stride up to your Speed and make a Strike at the end of your movement.
_desc_ko:
요건 갑옷을 입지 않았거나 경갑을 착용 중일 것

당신은 먹잇감과의 거리를 순식간에 좁히며, 상대가 반응하기도 전에 달려들어 덮친다. 당신은 이동 속도만큼 전진한 후, 이동이 끝나는 지점에서 공격을 가한다.

name: Incredible Scout

description.value:
When you scout, you are particularly alert for danger, granting your allies precious moments to prepare to fight. When using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{Scout} exploration activity, you grant your allies a +2 circumstance bonus to their initiative rolls instead of a +1 circumstance bonus.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.la8rWwUtReElgTS6]{Effect: Scout (Incredible Scout)}

_desc_en:
When you scout, you are particularly alert for danger, granting your allies precious moments to prepare to fight. When using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{Scout} exploration activity, you grant your allies a +2 circumstance bonus to their initiative rolls instead of a +1 circumstance bonus.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.la8rWwUtReElgTS6]{Effect: Scout (Incredible Scout)}
_desc_ko:
정찰 시 특히 위험에 경계하여 아군이 전투 준비를 할 소중한 시간을 벌어줍니다. @link[actions.scout] 탐사 활동을 사용할 때 아군의 인니셔티브 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스 대신 +2 상황 보너스를 부여합니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.la8rWwUtReElgTS6]{효과: 정찰 (탁월한 정찰)}

name: Acrobat Dedication

description.value:
You become an expert in Acrobatics. At 7th level, you become a master in Acrobatics, and at 15th level, you become legendary in Acrobatics. Whenever you critically succeed at an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} an enemy's space, you don't treat the enemy's space as difficult terrain.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.rhDvoOHAhAlABiae]{Acrobat}

_desc_en:
You become an expert in Acrobatics. At 7th level, you become a master in Acrobatics, and at 15th level, you become legendary in Acrobatics. Whenever you critically succeed at an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} an enemy's space, you don't treat the enemy's space as difficult terrain.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.rhDvoOHAhAlABiae]{Acrobat}
_desc_ko: 당신은 곡예의 전문가가 됩니다. 7레벨에 도약술의 달인이 되고, 15레벨에 도약술의 전설이 됩니다. 적의 공간을 @link[actions.tumble-through]하기 위한 도약술 판정에서 대성공을 거둘 때마다, 적의 공간을 어려운 지형으로 간주하지 않습니다.

name: Pack Hunter

description.value: You were taught how to hunt as part of a pack. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Aid, and your allies gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Aid you.

_desc_en: You were taught how to hunt as part of a pack. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Aid, and your allies gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Aid you.
_desc_ko: 당신은 무리의 일원으로 사냥하는 법을 배웠습니다. 지원 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 동맹들은 당신을 지원하는 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Timber Sentinel

description.value: A slim, symmetrical tree travels from the Plane of Wood. You conjure a tree within 30 feet, as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.K9gI08enGtmih5X1]{Protector Tree} spell of a rank equal to half your level rounded up. If you use this impulse again, any previous one ends, and an ordinary tree remains.

_desc_en: A slim, symmetrical tree travels from the Plane of Wood. You conjure a tree within 30 feet, as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.K9gI08enGtmih5X1]{Protector Tree} spell of a rank equal to half your level rounded up. If you use this impulse again, any previous one ends, and an ordinary tree remains.
_desc_ko: 나무의 평면에서 날렵하고 대칭적인 나무가 이동해 옵니다. 당신은 30피트 이내에 @link[spells.protector-tree] 주문을 당신의 레벨 절반(올림)에 해당하는 랭크으로 시전합니다. 이 임펄스를 다시 사용하면 이전의 모든 효과가 종료되고 평범한 나무가 남는다.

name: Elf Step

description.value: You move in a graceful dance, and even your steps are broad. You Step 5 feet twice.

_desc_en: You move in a graceful dance, and even your steps are broad. You Step 5 feet twice.
_desc_ko: 당신은 우아한 춤을 추듯 움직이며, 발걸음조차도 넓습니다. 당신은 5피트를 두 번 {신중한 발걸음}합니다.

name: Wukong Extension

description.value:
Access Tian Xia origin or worshipper of Sun Wukong

Invoking the name of Sun Wukong's extending cudgel, Ruyi Bang, you activate hidden levers and cranks in your innovation, making it swiftly extend outward like a battering ram. Make a melee Strike with your weapon innovation; your reach for that Strike is 30 feet.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Access Tian Xia origin or worshipper of Sun Wukong

Invoking the name of Sun Wukong's extending cudgel, Ruyi Bang, you activate hidden levers and cranks in your innovation, making it swiftly extend outward like a battering ram. Make a melee Strike with your weapon innovation; your reach for that Strike is 30 feet.
_desc_ko:
티엔 샤(天下) 출신 또는 손오공 숭배자 접근

손오공의 신기루봉(如意棒)의 이름을 부르며, 혁신 무기 내부에 숨겨진 레버와 크랭크를 작동시켜 돌격용 망치처럼 빠르게 바깥쪽으로 뻗어나가게 합니다. 무기 혁신으로 근접 공격을 수행하세요. 해당 공격의 공격 범위는 30피트입니다.

name: Breath Control

description.value: You can breathe even in hazardous or sparse air. You can hold your breath for 25 times as long as usual before suffocating. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against inhaled threats, such as inhaled poisons, and if you roll a success on such a saving throw, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: You can breathe even in hazardous or sparse air. You can hold your breath for 25 times as long as usual before suffocating. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against inhaled threats, such as inhaled poisons, and if you roll a success on such a saving throw, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 위험하거나 희박한 공기 속에서도 숨을 쉴 수 있습니다. 질식하기 전까지 평소보다 25배 더 오래 숨을 참을 수 있습니다. 흡입형 위협(예: 흡입 독)에 대한 내성 굴림 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 해당 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴릴 경우 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Defensive Dismissal

description.value:
Trigger A creature you're aware of critically succeeds on a Strike against you.

Requirements You're under a polymorph effect that you can Dismiss.

You change your form as a means of evading a potentially fatal blow. You Dismiss the polymorph effect you're under, and the result of the triggering Strike becomes a success instead of a critical success. If you would no longer fit in your space as a result of returning to your normal form, this action fails and you don't Dismiss the polymorph effect.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature you're aware of critically succeeds on a Strike against you.

Requirements You're under a polymorph effect that you can Dismiss.

You change your form as a means of evading a potentially fatal blow. You Dismiss the polymorph effect you're under, and the result of the triggering Strike becomes a success instead of a critical success. If you would no longer fit in your space as a result of returning to your normal form, this action fails and you don't Dismiss the polymorph effect.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신이 인지하는 생물이 당신을 상대로 대성공의 공격을 기록한다.

요건 당신이 해제할 수 있는 변형 효과를 받고 있다.

치명적인 공격을 피하기 위해 형태를 변화시킨다. 현재 걸려 있는 변형 효과를 해제하며, 발동된 공격의 결과가 대성공 대신 성공으로 바뀐다. 원래 형태로 돌아온 결과 공간에 맞지 않게 되면 이 행동은 실패하며 변형 효과는 해제되지 않는다.

name: Peer Beyond

description.value:
You have uncanny insight into the way ghosts and haunts manifest, manipulate the mind, and rejuvenate. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against mental effects caused by incorporeal undead and haunts, and you can roll a Spirit Lore or Haunt Lore check for initiative if you know that an incorporeal undead or a haunt is present.

If you are present when a spirit or haunt is defeated, you instantly gain a flash of insight into how it can be permanently put to rest. Typically, this flash manifests as a vision that presents a quick scene closely linked to the source of the spirit or haunt's creation. Attempt a Spirit Lore or Haunt Lore check, respectively, with a DC appropriate for the spirit or haunt's level. On a success, you gain a hint about how to put the spirit to rest or permanently disable the haunt; on a critical success, you learn the exact method of doing so.

_desc_en:
You have uncanny insight into the way ghosts and haunts manifest, manipulate the mind, and rejuvenate. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against mental effects caused by incorporeal undead and haunts, and you can roll a Spirit Lore or Haunt Lore check for initiative if you know that an incorporeal undead or a haunt is present.

If you are present when a spirit or haunt is defeated, you instantly gain a flash of insight into how it can be permanently put to rest. Typically, this flash manifests as a vision that presents a quick scene closely linked to the source of the spirit or haunt's creation. Attempt a Spirit Lore or Haunt Lore check, respectively, with a DC appropriate for the spirit or haunt's level. On a success, you gain a hint about how to put the spirit to rest or permanently disable the haunt; on a critical success, you learn the exact method of doing so.
_desc_ko:
귀신과 유령의 창조 방식, 정신 조종, 재생 능력에 대한 초자연적 통찰력을 지녔습니다. 무형 언데드와 유령의 정신 효과에 대한 내성 굴림 시 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 무형 언데드나 유령의 존재를 인지한 경우 이니셔티브 결정 시 영혼 지식 또는 유령 지식 판정을 굴릴 수 있습니다.

영혼이나 유령이 물리치는 현장에 있다면, 이를 영원히 안식시키는 방법에 대한 통찰이 순간적으로 떠오릅니다. 일반적으로 이 통찰은 영혼이나 유령의 생성 원인과 밀접하게 연관된 짧은 장면을 보여주는 환상으로 나타납니다. 해당 영혼이나 유령의 레벨에 맞는 DC로 각각 영혼 지식 또는 유령 지식를 시도하십시오. 성공 시, 영혼을 안식시키거나 유령 현상을 영구적으로 무력화하는 방법에 대한 힌트를 얻습니다. 대성공 시, 그 정확한 방법을 알게 됩니다.

name: Quick Study

description.value:
During your daily preparations, you can study a particular subject to gain the trained proficiency rank in one Lore skill of your choice. You must have interacted with that subject in some way on the previous day, whether by reading about it, talking to someone knowledgeable on the topic, or experiencing it yourself.

Alternatively, you can reference your notes to instead choose a Lore skill you've prepared before with Quick Study. This proficiency lasts until you prepare again. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a skill increase or a permanent character option like a feat.

_desc_en:
During your daily preparations, you can study a particular subject to gain the trained proficiency rank in one Lore skill of your choice. You must have interacted with that subject in some way on the previous day, whether by reading about it, talking to someone knowledgeable on the topic, or experiencing it yourself.

Alternatively, you can reference your notes to instead choose a Lore skill you've prepared before with Quick Study. This proficiency lasts until you prepare again. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a skill increase or a permanent character option like a feat.
_desc_ko:
일일 준비 시간 동안 특정 주제를 연구하여 선택한 지식 기술 하나에 숙련 숙련도 등급을 얻을 수 있습니다. 전날 해당 주제에 대해 읽거나, 그 분야에 정통한 사람과 대화하거나, 직접 경험하는 등 어떤 방식으로든 접촉했어야 합니다.

대안으로, 필기 노트를 참고하여 신속 학습으로 미리 준비한 지식 기술을 선택할 수도 있습니다. 이 숙련도는 다음 준비 시점까지 지속됩니다. 일시적인 숙련도이므로, 기술 향상이나 피트 같은 영구적 캐릭터 옵션의 전제 조건으로 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Patron's Presence

description.value: Your patron can direct its attention through your familiar, and its mere presence becomes an ominous weight on the minds of other beings to distract them and blot out their magic. Your familiar gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VBwNo2Wbfd4n4Y3g]{Patron's Presence} activity.

_desc_en: Your patron can direct its attention through your familiar, and its mere presence becomes an ominous weight on the minds of other beings to distract them and blot out their magic. Your familiar gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VBwNo2Wbfd4n4Y3g]{Patron's Presence} activity.
_desc_ko: 당신의 후원자는 당신의 패밀리어를 통해 주의를 집중시킬 수 있으며, 그 존재 자체만으로도 다른 존재들의 마음에 불길한 부담이 되어 그들의 주의를 분산시키고 마법을 차단합니다. 당신의 패밀리어는 @link[actions.patrons-presence] 능력을 얻습니다.

name: Malleable Movement

description.value:
Trigger You Leap.

You shift the shape of your weapon to help you Leap farther and faster. You shift your weapon into a long flexible pole, climbing hook, or similar aid, adding an extra 5 feet to the distance you're able to Leap. As normal, this can't increase the distance of your Leap beyond your Speed.

_desc_en:
Trigger You Leap.

You shift the shape of your weapon to help you Leap farther and faster. You shift your weapon into a long flexible pole, climbing hook, or similar aid, adding an extra 5 feet to the distance you're able to Leap. As normal, this can't increase the distance of your Leap beyond your Speed.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신은 도약한다.

당신은 더 멀리, 더 빠르게 도약하기 위해 무기의 형태를 바꿉니다. 무기를 긴 유연한 장대, 등반용 갈고리 또는 유사한 보조 도구로 변형시켜 도약 거리를 추가로 5피트 늘립니다. 평소와 마찬가지로, 이로 인해 도약 거리가 당신의 이동 속도를 초과할 수는 없습니다.

name: Red Mantis School Spell

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.srcPBNjhq7FBSmi3]{Red Mantis magic school's} initial school spell. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.srcPBNjhq7FBSmi3]{Red Mantis magic school's} initial school spell. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @link[feats.red-mantis-magic-school] 초급 학파 주문을 얻습니다. 아직 포커스 풀이 없다면, 1 포커스 포인트의 포커스 풀을 얻습니다.

name: Replenishment of War

description.value:
Striking out against your enemies draws praise and protection from your deity. When you damage a creature with a Strike using your deity's favored weapon, you gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level, or equal to your level if the Strike was a critical hit. These temporary Hit Points last until the start of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.BJc494USeyM011p3]{Effect: Replenishment of War}

value.value: expert in your deity's favoured weapon

_desc_en:
Striking out against your enemies draws praise and protection from your deity. When you damage a creature with a Strike using your deity's favored weapon, you gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level, or equal to your level if the Strike was a critical hit. These temporary Hit Points last until the start of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.BJc494USeyM011p3]{Effect: Replenishment of War}
_desc_ko:
적에게 강타를 가하면 신의 찬사와 보호를 받는다. 신이 선호하는 무기로 강타 공격을 통해 생물에게 피해를 입힐 때 , 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 임시 HP를 얻는다. 강타가 치명타일 경우 레벨 전체에 해당하는 임시 HP를 얻는다. 이 임시 HP는 다음 턴 시작까지 지속된다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.BJc494USeyM011p3]{효과: 전쟁의 보충}

name: Legacy of Monarchs

description.value: No matter what might happen to you, your legacy shall never die. If you're slain, any of your knights who touches your corpse can choose to take up your mantle; over the course of 10 minutes, they don your equipment, replace their attribute modifiers with yours, replace their skills and feats with yours, and become you for all intents and purposes, retaining only their ancestry, heritage, and ancestry feats. If you're later returned to life, you can choose to reclaim your mantle from your former knight; if you do so, they revert to their previous state, and you reclaim all that was yours. Otherwise, you can choose to live a new life, retraining all your skills and feats while adopting a new name and identity.

_desc_en: No matter what might happen to you, your legacy shall never die. If you're slain, any of your knights who touches your corpse can choose to take up your mantle; over the course of 10 minutes, they don your equipment, replace their attribute modifiers with yours, replace their skills and feats with yours, and become you for all intents and purposes, retaining only their ancestry, heritage, and ancestry feats. If you're later returned to life, you can choose to reclaim your mantle from your former knight; if you do so, they revert to their previous state, and you reclaim all that was yours. Otherwise, you can choose to live a new life, retraining all your skills and feats while adopting a new name and identity.
_desc_ko: 당신에게 무슨 일이 생기더라도, 당신의 유산은 영원히 사라지지 않을 것이다. 네가 살해당하면, 네 시체를 만진 기사 중 한 명이 네 역할을 이어받을 수 있다. 10분 동안 그들은 네 장비를 착용하고, 자신의 능력치 수정자를 네 것으로 대체하며, 자신의 기술과 피트를 네 것으로 바꾼다. 결국 그들은 모든 면에서 너와 동일해지며, 오직 혈통, 유산, 그리고 혈통 피트만 유지한다. 나중에 부활하게 되면, 전직 기사에게서 당신의 망토를 되찾을 수 있습니다. 그렇게 하면 그들은 이전 상태로 되돌아가고, 당신은 모든 것을 되찾게 됩니다. 그렇지 않다면, 새로운 삶을 선택할 수 있으며, 모든 기술과 피트를 재훈련하고 새로운 이름과 정체성을 채택하게 됩니다.

name: Life Leap

description.value:
Requirements You must be adjacent to a living creature.

You phase through a space that a living creature occupies in a flash, spontaneously appearing on the opposite side of it in a vibrant display of colorful light. You move from your current location to another location that's still adjacent to the same living creature, but on the opposite side or corner of the creature's space. To determine whether a position is valid, use the same rules as for flanking: a line through the center of the two spaces must pass through opposite sides or corners of the creature's space.

You pass through the creature's life force, appearing in the selected location; this doesn't trigger reactions based on movement. You must be able to see your destination, and you can't move farther than your Speed would allow.

_desc_en:
Requirements You must be adjacent to a living creature.

You phase through a space that a living creature occupies in a flash, spontaneously appearing on the opposite side of it in a vibrant display of colorful light. You move from your current location to another location that's still adjacent to the same living creature, but on the opposite side or corner of the creature's space. To determine whether a position is valid, use the same rules as for flanking: a line through the center of the two spaces must pass through opposite sides or corners of the creature's space.

You pass through the creature's life force, appearing in the selected location; this doesn't trigger reactions based on movement. You must be able to see your destination, and you can't move farther than your Speed would allow.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 살아있는 생명체와 인접해 있어야 합니다.

순식간에 생명체가 차지한 공간을 통과하여, 화려한 빛의 섬광과 함께 그 반대편에 순간적으로 나타납니다. 현재 위치에서 동일한 생명체와 인접한 상태를 유지한 채, 해당 생명체의 공간 반대편 또는 모서리에 위치한 다른 장소로 이동합니다. 위치 유효성 판단은 측면 공격 규칙과 동일하게 적용됩니다: 두 공간의 중심을 지나는 직선이 생명체 공간의 반대편 측면 또는 모서리를 통과해야 합니다.

당신은 생물의 생명력을 통과하여 선택한 위치에 나타나며, 이는 이동에 기반한 반응을 유발하지 않습니다. 목적지를 볼 수 있어야 하며, 자신의 이동 속도가 허용하는 거리 이상으로 이동할 수 없습니다.

name: Innocent Butterfly

description.value: You know how to alter the perceptions of others. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VUMtDHr8CRwwr3Mj]{Aura of the Unremarkable} once per day as an innate arcane spell. The spell uses your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

_desc_en: You know how to alter the perceptions of others. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VUMtDHr8CRwwr3Mj]{Aura of the Unremarkable} once per day as an innate arcane spell. The spell uses your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.
_desc_ko: 당신은 타인의 인식을 바꾸는 방법을 알고 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, 선천적 아케인 주문으로 @link[spells.aura-of-the-unremarkable]를 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 주문은 당신의 직업 난이도(DC) 또는 주문 난이도(DC) 중 더 높은 값을 사용합니다.

name: Crunch

description.value: Your jaws can crush bone and bite through armor. Your jaws unarmed attack deals 1d8 piercing damage instead of 1d6 and gains the grapple trait

_desc_en: Your jaws can crush bone and bite through armor. Your jaws unarmed attack deals 1d8 piercing damage instead of 1d6 and gains the grapple trait
_desc_ko: 당신의 턱은 뼈를 부수고 갑옷을 뚫을 수 있습니다. 비무장 공격 시 1d6 대신 1d8 관통 피해를 입히며, 그랩 특성을 얻습니다.

name: Defensive Roll

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger A physical attack would reduce you to 0 Hit Points.

Dropping into a roll to disperse the force of the blow, you can partially evade a lethal attack and stay conscious. You take half damage from the triggering attack

_desc_en:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger A physical attack would reduce you to 0 Hit Points.

Dropping into a roll to disperse the force of the blow, you can partially evade a lethal attack and stay conscious. You take half damage from the triggering attack
_desc_ko:
발동 주기 10분에 한 번

발동 조건 물리 공격으로 HP가 0이 될 경우.

공격의 충격을 분산시키기 위해 구르며 떨어지면 치명적인 공격을 부분적으로 회피하고 의식을 유지할 수 있습니다. 발동 공격으로부터 받는 피해는 절반으로 줄어듭니다.

name: Hold Mark

description.value:
You bear scars or tattoos enhanced by the mark of your community's prowess. When you select this feat, choose one of the options from the below table. You are trained in the listed skill and gain a +1 status bonus to saves against spells from the listed tradition. You gain a large brand or tattoo in the shape of the chosen emblem or a similar concept (for example, the Burning Sun could be a torch, sun, volcano, or other fiery symbol, while the Empty Hand could be a fist or claw).

Hold Mark Emblem Skill Tradition
Burning Sun Diplomacy Arcane
Death's Head Survival Primal
Defiled Corpse Religion Divine
Empty Hand Intimidation Occult

_desc_en:
You bear scars or tattoos enhanced by the mark of your community's prowess. When you select this feat, choose one of the options from the below table. You are trained in the listed skill and gain a +1 status bonus to saves against spells from the listed tradition. You gain a large brand or tattoo in the shape of the chosen emblem or a similar concept (for example, the Burning Sun could be a torch, sun, volcano, or other fiery symbol, while the Empty Hand could be a fist or claw).

Hold Mark Emblem Skill Tradition
Burning Sun Diplomacy Arcane
Death's Head Survival Primal
Defiled Corpse Religion Divine
Empty Hand Intimidation Occult
_desc_ko:
당신은 소속 공동체의 위엄을 상징하는 상처나 문신을 지니고 있습니다. 이 피트를 선택할 때 아래 표의 옵션 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 해당 기술에 숙련되며, 명시된 전통의 주문에 대한 내성에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 선택한 상징이나 유사한 개념(예: 불타는 태양은 횃불, 태양, 화산 또는 기타 불의 상징일 수 있으며, 빈 손은 주먹이나 발톱일 수 있음)의 형태로 큰 낙인이나 문신을 얻습니다.

홀드 마크 엠블럼 기술 Tradition
불타는 태양 Diplomacy 아케인
죽음의 두개골 Survival 프라이멀
더럽혀진 시체 Religion 신성
빈손 Intimidation 오컬트

name: Perfect Ki Adept

description.value: You gain the appropriate qi spell for your School of Perfection: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VBNevVovTCpn04vL]{Unblinking Flame Revelation} for Unblinking Flame, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ytboJsyZEbE1MLeV]{Unbreaking Wave Advance} for Unbreaking Waves, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tvO6Kmc2pQve9DC5]{Unfolding Wind Rush} for Unfolding Wind, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.FPnkOYyWIaOzkmqn]{Untwisting Iron Buffer} for Untwisting Iron. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.

_desc_en: You gain the appropriate qi spell for your School of Perfection: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VBNevVovTCpn04vL]{Unblinking Flame Revelation} for Unblinking Flame, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ytboJsyZEbE1MLeV]{Unbreaking Wave Advance} for Unbreaking Waves, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tvO6Kmc2pQve9DC5]{Unfolding Wind Rush} for Unfolding Wind, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.FPnkOYyWIaOzkmqn]{Untwisting Iron Buffer} for Untwisting Iron. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신의 완벽의 학파에 해당하는 기 주문을 얻습니다: 불꽃의 학파에는 @link[spells.unblinking-flame-revelation], 파도의 학파에는 @link[spells.unbreaking-wave-advance], @link[spells.unfolding-wind-rush]은 펼쳐지는 바람에, @link[spells.untwisting-iron-buffer]는 풀림강철에 적용됩니다. 포커스 풀의 포커스 포인트 수를 1 증가시킵니다.

name: Venom Purge

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You produce a specialized venom that burns out other toxins and impurities in your body. For each disease or poison currently affecting you, attempt a Medicine check to counteract that disease or poison. As normal, your counteract rank is equal to half your level rounded up.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You produce a specialized venom that burns out other toxins and impurities in your body. For each disease or poison currently affecting you, attempt a Medicine check to counteract that disease or poison. As normal, your counteract rank is equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신은 몸속의 다른 독소와 불순물을 태워 없애는 특수한 독을 생성합니다. 현재 당신에게 영향을 미치는 각 질병이나 독에 대해, 그 질병이나 독을 반격하기 위해 의술 판정을 시도하십시오. 평소와 같이, 당신의 반격 등급은 레벨의 절반을 올림한 값과 같습니다.

name: Strong Tail

description.value: From sheer necessity, you've gotten surprisingly good at moving around on land. Your tail is unusually muscular and lets you hop or slither on land at a modest speed. Your land Speed increases to 15 feet.

_desc_en: From sheer necessity, you've gotten surprisingly good at moving around on land. Your tail is unusually muscular and lets you hop or slither on land at a modest speed. Your land Speed increases to 15 feet.
_desc_ko: 절박한 필요성 때문에, 당신은 육지에서 움직이는 데 놀라울 정도로 능숙해졌습니다. 당신의 꼬리는 비정상적으로 근육질이며, 육지에서 적당한 속도로 뛰거나 기어 다닐 수 있게 해줍니다. 당신의 지상 속도가 15피트로 증가합니다.

name: Endless Memories

description.value: You've lived a thousand lives and done a hundred-thousand things. When you choose a skill in which to become trained with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ptEOt3lqjxUnAW62]{Ancient Memories}, you can also choose a skill in which you're already trained and become an expert in that skill. This lasts until your Ancient Memories expires. When the effects of Ancient Memories and Endless Memories expire, you can retrain one of your skill increases. The skill increase you gain from this retraining must either make you trained in the skill you chose with Ancient Memories or make you an expert in the skill you chose with Endless Memories.

_desc_en: You've lived a thousand lives and done a hundred-thousand things. When you choose a skill in which to become trained with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ptEOt3lqjxUnAW62]{Ancient Memories}, you can also choose a skill in which you're already trained and become an expert in that skill. This lasts until your Ancient Memories expires. When the effects of Ancient Memories and Endless Memories expire, you can retrain one of your skill increases. The skill increase you gain from this retraining must either make you trained in the skill you chose with Ancient Memories or make you an expert in the skill you chose with Endless Memories.
_desc_ko: 당신은 수천 번의 삶을 살았고 수만 가지 일을 해왔습니다. @link[feats.ancient-memories]으로 숙련된 기술을 선택할 때, 이미 숙련된 기술을 하나 더 선택하여 그 기술에 정통해질 수 있습니다. 이 효과는 고대의 기억이 소멸할 때까지 지속됩니다. 고대의 기억과 끝없는 기억의 효과가 소멸할 때, 당신은 자신의 기술 향상 중 하나를 재훈련할 수 있습니다. 이 재훈련으로 얻는 기술 향상은 반드시 고대의 기억으로 선택한 기술에 숙련되게 하거나, 끝없는 기억으로 선택한 기술에 전문가가 되게 해야 합니다.

name: Deceptive Deduction

description.value:
Trigger A creature you can see uses @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}.

You've had to take on many roles while working undercover, so you're practiced at following the example of those around you to pretend expertise in a variety of fields. You learn what skill the creature was using to Recall Knowledge and whether that creature is trained in the skill. If it's trained, you can use Deception to Recall Knowledge as if it were that skill for the next minute.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature you can see uses @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}.

You've had to take on many roles while working undercover, so you're practiced at following the example of those around you to pretend expertise in a variety of fields. You learn what skill the creature was using to Recall Knowledge and whether that creature is trained in the skill. If it's trained, you can use Deception to Recall Knowledge as if it were that skill for the next minute.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신이 볼 수 있는 크리처가 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{지식 회상}을 사용한다.

당신은 잠입 활동을 하면서 여러 역할을 맡아야 했기에, 주위 사람들을 본떠 다양한 분야에 전문성이 있는 척하는 데 능숙하다. 당신은 그 크리처가 지식 회상에 어떤 기술을 사용했는지, 그리고 그 크리처가 해당 기술에 숙련되어 있는지를 알아낸다. 숙련되어 있다면, 다음 1분 동안 당신은 기만을 마치 그 기술인 것처럼 사용하여 지식 회상을 할 수 있다.

name: Lonely Army

description.value:
Requirements You are in your favored location; you are currently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, unobserved, or unnoticed by all enemies; and you are not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.

You move and attack with deadly silence, unbelievable speed, and unlimited ferocity. Strike with a blowgun or sling; if the Strike is successful, the enemy cannot tell where it came from and you remain hidden. Immediately after the successful Strike, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} to a new location, Interact to reload a blowgun or sling, and Strike again, remaining hidden on a successful Strike. If the second Strike is successful, you can Sneak, Interact to reload, and then Strike with a sling or blowgun a third time, remaining hidden after a successful Strike.

After using Lonely Army, you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} for 1 minute.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are in your favored location; you are currently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, unobserved, or unnoticed by all enemies; and you are not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.

You move and attack with deadly silence, unbelievable speed, and unlimited ferocity. Strike with a blowgun or sling; if the Strike is successful, the enemy cannot tell where it came from and you remain hidden. Immediately after the successful Strike, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} to a new location, Interact to reload a blowgun or sling, and Strike again, remaining hidden on a successful Strike. If the second Strike is successful, you can Sneak, Interact to reload, and then Strike with a sling or blowgun a third time, remaining hidden after a successful Strike.

After using Lonely Army, you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} for 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
Requirements 당신은 선호하는 위치에 있으며, 현재 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태이거나, 모든 적에게 관찰되지 않거나, 발견되지 않았으며, @link[conditions.fatigued] 상태가 아닙니다.

당신은 치명적인 침묵, 믿기 힘든 속도, 그리고 무한한 사나움으로 움직이고 공격합니다. 블로우건이나 슬링으로 공격하세요; 공격이 성공하면 적들은 공격이 어디서 왔는지 알 수 없으며 당신은 숨겨진 상태를 유지합니다. 성공적인 공격 직후, 당신은 @link[actions.sneak]으로 새로운 위치로 이동하거나, 상호작용으로 블로우건이나 슬링을 재장전하고, 다시 공격할 수 있으며, 성공적인 공격 시 숨겨진 상태를 유지합니다. 두 번째 공격이 성공하면, {은밀 이동 후 상호작용으로 재장전하고, 다시 투석기나 블로우건으로 세 번째 강타를 가할 수 있으며, 성공 시 {숨기 상태를 유지한다.

'외로운 군대' 사용 후 1분간 @link[conditions.fatigued]가 됩니다.

name: Liberating Dive

description.value:
You sprout wings with steel feathers, resembling those of the celestial Talmandor. With a powerful flap, the wings propel you across the battlefield, slicing foes and restraints along your path. Until the end of your turn, you gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed or 40 feet, whichever is greater. You then Fly up to your Speed, and this movement doesn't trigger reactions.

Choose one foe and one ally you're adjacent to at any point during this movement. Using one wing's sharpened edge, you can use a 1-action Elemental Blast as a melee Strike using the metal element against the foe. With the other wing, you can help the ally break free of an effect grabbing, restraining, immobilizing, or paralyzing them; they either attempt a new save against one such effect that allows a save, or they attempt to Escape as a free action. The ally can use your impulse attack modifier in place of their unarmed attack modifier or skill check modifier.

_desc_en:
You sprout wings with steel feathers, resembling those of the celestial Talmandor. With a powerful flap, the wings propel you across the battlefield, slicing foes and restraints along your path. Until the end of your turn, you gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed or 40 feet, whichever is greater. You then Fly up to your Speed, and this movement doesn't trigger reactions.

Choose one foe and one ally you're adjacent to at any point during this movement. Using one wing's sharpened edge, you can use a 1-action Elemental Blast as a melee Strike using the metal element against the foe. With the other wing, you can help the ally break free of an effect grabbing, restraining, immobilizing, or paralyzing them; they either attempt a new save against one such effect that allows a save, or they attempt to Escape as a free action. The ally can use your impulse attack modifier in place of their unarmed attack modifier or skill check modifier.
_desc_ko:
당신은 강철 깃털을 지닌 날개를 돋우니, 천상의 탈만도르의 날개를 닮았다. 힘찬 날갯짓 한 번으로 날개가 당신을 전장 너머로 밀어내며, 지나가는 길목의 적과 속박을 베어낸다. 당신의 턴이 끝날 때까지, 당신은 당신의 지상 이동력이나 40피트 중 더 큰 값과 같은 비행 이동력을 얻는다. 그런 다음 당신은 자신의 이동력만큼 비행하며, 이 이동은 반응을 유발하지 않는다.

이 이동 중 어느 시점에든 당신과 인접한 적 하나와 아군 하나를 선택한다. 한쪽 날개의 날카로운 가장자리를 사용하여, 당신은 금속 원소를 사용한 근접 타격으로 적에게 1행동 원소 폭발을 쓸 수 있다. 다른 날개로는, 아군이 자신을 붙잡거나 억제하거나 이동 불가로 만들거나 마비시키는 효과에서 벗어나도록 도울 수 있다. 그 아군은 내성을 허용하는 그러한 효과 하나에 대해 새로운 내성을 시도하거나, 자유 행동으로 탈출을 시도한다. 아군은 자신의 비무장 공격 수정치나 기술 판정 수정치 대신 당신의 임펄스 공격 수정치를 사용할 수 있다.

name: Skillful Tail

description.value:
Geniekin You were born with a tail, and with practice you've learned how to perform simple Interact actions with it, such as opening an unlocked door. Your tail can't perform actions that require fingers or significant manual dexterity, including any action that would require a check to accomplish, and you can't use it to hold items.

Nephilim You've always had a tail, but with practice, you've learned to use it for more than signaling your mood. You can perform simple Interact actions with your tail, such as opening an unlocked door. Your tail can't perform actions that require fingers or significant manual dexterity, including any action that would require a check to accomplish, and you can't use it to hold items.

_desc_en:
Geniekin You were born with a tail, and with practice you've learned how to perform simple Interact actions with it, such as opening an unlocked door. Your tail can't perform actions that require fingers or significant manual dexterity, including any action that would require a check to accomplish, and you can't use it to hold items.

Nephilim You've always had a tail, but with practice, you've learned to use it for more than signaling your mood. You can perform simple Interact actions with your tail, such as opening an unlocked door. Your tail can't perform actions that require fingers or significant manual dexterity, including any action that would require a check to accomplish, and you can't use it to hold items.
_desc_ko:
지니킨 당신은 꼬리를 가지고 태어났으며, 연습을 통해 잠기지 않은 문을 여는 등 간단한 상호작용 행동을 꼬리로 수행하는 법을 배웠다. 당신의 꼬리는 손가락이나 상당한 손 놀림이 필요한 행동, 즉 완수하기 위해 판정이 필요한 모든 행동을 수행할 수 없으며, 물건을 쥐는 데도 사용할 수 없다.

네필림 당신은 늘 꼬리를 가지고 있었지만, 연습을 통해 기분을 나타내는 것 이상으로 그것을 활용하는 법을 배웠다. 당신은 잠기지 않은 문을 여는 등 간단한 상호작용 행동을 꼬리로 수행할 수 있다. 당신의 꼬리는 손가락이나 상당한 손 놀림이 필요한 행동, 즉 완수하기 위해 판정이 필요한 모든 행동을 수행할 수 없으며, 물건을 쥐는 데도 사용할 수 없다.

name: I Meant to do That

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements Your previous action was a ranged weapon Strike that missed a foe within 60 feet.

Somehow your stray bullet causes an unintended reaction that creates a problem for your enemy: perhaps a ricochet knocks your foe's weapon away or they stumble over stray debris in an attempt to dodge your bullets. Roll a Deception check to attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} [[/act shove statistic=deception]], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} ([[/act trip statistic=deception]]), or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} ([[/act disarm statistic=deception]])the foe you missed.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

요구 사항 이전 행동이 60피트 이내의 적을 놓친 원거리 무기 강타이어야 함.

어쩌다 보니 빗나간 총알이 의도치 않은 반응을 일으켜 적에게 문제를 일으킵니다: 총알이 튕겨 적의 무기를 떨어뜨리거나, 총알을 피하려다 흩어진 잔해에 걸려 넘어질 수도 있습니다. 기만 능력 판정을 굴려 @link[actions.shove]시도하다{밀치기} 밀기, @link[actions.trip](넘어뜨리기), 또는 @link[actions.disarm](무장 해제)을 시도하세요.

name: Stem the Tide

description.value: You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.K9gI08enGtmih5X1]{Protector Tree} as a 1st-rank primal innate spell once per day. At 7th level, the spell is heightened to 2nd rank, and every 2 levels thereafter, the spell is heightened an additional spell rank.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.K9gI08enGtmih5X1]{Protector Tree} as a 1st-rank primal innate spell once per day. At 7th level, the spell is heightened to 2nd rank, and every 2 levels thereafter, the spell is heightened an additional spell rank.
_desc_ko: 하루에 한 번, 1랭크 프라이멀 선천 마법인 @link[spells.protector-tree]를 시전할 수 있다. 7레벨에 도달하면 이 주문은 2nd 랭크으로 강화되며, 이후 2레벨마다 추가로 1랭크씩 강화됩니다.

name: Five Breaths, One Death

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Requirements You're in an elemental stance, and the target is under the effects of Induce Imbalance.

You cycle through the elements in a devastating combination attack. Strike the target using the unarmed attack associated with your current elemental stance, then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Oh6H1fuXC6jK4Hcp]{Cycle Elemental Stance}. Then, Strike the target with the unarmed attack associated with your new elemental stance. You can continue to Cycle Elemental Stance and Strike until you've made a Strike using the unarmed attack of every elemental stance you know, applying the multiple attack penalty as usual. If you successfully hit the target with all five elemental Strikes using this ability, it must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class|traits:death] save against your class DC or die as each elementally associated organ within its body shuts down; this is a death effect.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 10분에 한 번

요구 사항 원소 자세를 취하고 있으며, 대상이 불균형 유발 효과에 걸려 있어야 합니다.

파괴적인 연속 공격으로 원소를 순환합니다. 현재 원소 자세에 해당하는 비무장 공격으로 대상에게 강타한 후, @link[actions.cycle-elemental-stance]을 사용합니다. 그런 다음 새로 전환한 원소 자세에 해당하는 비무장 공격으로 대상에게 강타합니다. 알고 있는 모든 원소 스탠스의 비무장 공격으로 타격을 가할 때까지 원소 스탠스 순환과 공격을 계속할 수 있으며, 평소처럼 다중 공격 페널티가 적용됩니다. 이 능력으로 다섯 가지 원소 공격을 모두 성공하여 적중시키면, 대상은 인내 클래스 DC에 대한 저항 검사를 시도해야 하며, 실패 시 몸속의 각 원소 관련 장기가 순차적으로 정지하며 사망합니다. 이는 사망 효과입니다.

name: Interfering Surge

description.value:
Trigger A creature you can see Casts a Spell.

Requirements You have an unexpended spell slot and can see the triggering spell's manifestations.

You overcharge the triggering spell with magic. You expend a spell slot and attempt to counteract the triggering spell using the energy of the expended slot. If the triggering spell is in your repertoire and the spell slot you expended was a high enough level to cast it, you take no penalty. Otherwise, you take a -2 penalty to the counteract check if the triggering spell was cast using the same magical tradition you cast, or a -5 penalty if it was cast using a different tradition.

If the triggering spell is successfully counteracted, it creates a wellspring surge from its caster in addition to the normal effects of being counteracted. If it isn't counteracted, your expended spell slot creates a wellspring surge from you.

Special This feat has the trait corresponding to the tradition of spells you cast (arcane, divine, primal, or occult).

_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신이 볼 수 있는 생물이 주문을 시전합니다.

요구 사항 사용하지 않은 주문 슬롯이 있고 발동 주문이 나타나는 모습을 볼 수 있어야 한다.

발동 주문에 마법을 과도하게 주입한다. 당신은 주문 슬롯을 소모하고 소모한 슬롯의 에너지를 이용해 발동 주문을 반격하려 시도합니다. 발동 주문이 당신의 주문 목록에 포함되어 있고 소모한 주문 슬롯의 레벨이 해당 주문을 시전하기에 충분하다면, 당신은 페널티를 받지 않습니다. 그렇지 않은 경우, 발동 주문이 당신과 동일한 마법 전통으로 시전된 경우 반격 판정에서 -2 페널티를, 다른 전통으로 시전된 경우 -5 페널티를 받습니다.

발동 마법이 성공적으로 반격되면, 반격된 마법의 일반 효과에 더해 발동 마법사에게서 원천의 파동이 발생한다. 저지되지 않으면, 소모된 의 마법 슬롯이 당신에게서 원천의 파동을 발생시킨다.

특수 이 피트는 당신이 시전하는 주문 전통(아케인, 신성, 프라이멀, 오컬트)에 해당하는 특성을 지닙니다.

name: Twin Shot Knockdown

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a loaded crossbow or loaded firearm in each hand.

You fire at an enemy while targeting a part of its anatomy that will disrupt its balance. Make two Strikes against the same target, one with each of the required weapons. If both Strikes are successful, the target is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a loaded crossbow or loaded firearm in each hand.

You fire at an enemy while targeting a part of its anatomy that will disrupt its balance. Make two Strikes against the same target, one with each of the required weapons. If both Strikes are successful, the target is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손에 장전된 석궁 또는 장전된 화기를 각각 들고 있다.

적의 균형을 무너뜨릴 신체 부위를 겨냥하여 발사합니다. 동일한 대상에게 두 번의 공격을 가하며, 각 공격은 요구된 무기로 수행됩니다. 두 공격 모두 성공하면 대상은 @link[conditions.prone] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Tower Shield Mastery

description.value: You've learned how to maximize the defensive abilities of your tower shield. You are constantly @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} and can use the additional action only to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} behind your tower shield after you have Raised it.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en: You've learned how to maximize the defensive abilities of your tower shield. You are constantly @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} and can use the additional action only to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} behind your tower shield after you have Raised it.
_desc_ko: 타워 실드의 방어 능력을 극대화하는 법을 익혔습니다. 당신은 항상 @link[conditions.quickened] 상태이며, 추가 행동을 사용하여 @link[actions.take-cover]를 취할 수 있습니다. 단, 타워 실드를 들어 올린 후에만 가능합니다.

name: Amorphous Aspect

description.value: Your body is supremely flexible. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on checks to Escape or Squeeze, and when you critically fail when Squeezing, you get a failure instead.

_desc_en: Your body is supremely flexible. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on checks to Escape or Squeeze, and when you critically fail when Squeezing, you get a failure instead.
_desc_ko: 신체가 극도로 유연해집니다. 탈출 또는 좁은 공간 통과 판정 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 좁은 공간 통과 판정에서 대실패 시 실패로 처리됩니다.

name: Kraken's Call

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You call forth the sleeping krakens of the deep to crush your enemies. You open a dozen small portals to some lightless, watery abyss in a @Template[burst|distance:30] within 120 feet. The powerful tentacles of a kraken reach through to grab at each creature in the area. Each affected creature takes @Damage[8d6[untyped]|options:area-damage] damage depending on its @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. You can Sustain the call up to 1 minute. The first time you Sustain it on each subsequent turn, each creature in the area not already @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the tentacles must attempt the save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is grabbed by a tentacle. A creature that's still grabbed by a tentacle at the end of its turn takes @Damage[3d6[bludgeoning]] damage. The tentacles' @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} DC and AC are both equal to the higher of your class DC or spell DC. A creature can attack a tentacle to attempt to free the creature trapped by it; a tentacle is destroyed if it takes 30 or more damage in a single round.

Critical Failure As failure, but double damage.
