_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신은 잠든 심해의 크라켄을 불러내 적을 짓밟게 합니다. 120피트 이내의 30피트에 빛도 없는 물의 심연으로 통하는 작은 포털 열 개를 엽니다. 크라켄의 강력한 촉수가 뻗어 나와 해당 영역의 모든 생물을 붙잡습니다. 영향을 받은 각 생물은 8d6의 피해를 입는다. 이는 대상의 인내 내성 굴림 결과(네 클래스 DC와 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽)에 따라 결정된다. 이 소환을 최대 1분 동안 유지할 수 있다. 이후 각 턴마다 처음 유지할 때마다, 해당 지역에 이미 @link[conditions.grabbed] 상태가 아닌 생물은 내성을 시도해야 합니다.

성공 생물은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

실패 생물은 전체 피해를 입으며 촉수에 붙잡힙니다. 자신의 턴 종료 시점에도 촉수에 붙잡힘 상태인 생물은 3d6 타격의 피해를 입습니다. 촉수의 @link[actions.escape] DC와 AC는 모두 당신의 직업 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽과 동일하다. 생물은 촉수를 공격하여 그에 갇힌 생물을 풀어보려고 시도할 수 있다; 촉수는 한 라운드에 30 이상의 피해를 입으면 파괴된다.

대실패 실패와 동일하나 피해가 두 배로 증가합니다.

name: Wronged Monk's Wrath

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8TBgEzjZxPaOJOm1]{Wronged Monk's Wrath} ki spell. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8TBgEzjZxPaOJOm1]{Wronged Monk's Wrath} ki spell. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.
_desc_ko: @link[spells.wronged-monks-wrath] 기(氣) 주문을 획득합니다. 포커스 풀의 포커스 포인트 수를 1 증가시킵니다.

name: Water Conjuration

description.value: You carry the ocean with you wherever you go. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WzLKjSw6hsBhuklC]{Create Water} as a primal innate spell once per day. Each time you cast create water, you choose if you create fresh water or salt water.

_desc_en: You carry the ocean with you wherever you go. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WzLKjSw6hsBhuklC]{Create Water} as a primal innate spell once per day. Each time you cast create water, you choose if you create fresh water or salt water.
_desc_ko: 당신은 어디를 가든 바다를 함께 지닙니다. 하루에 한 번, 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 @link[spells.create-water]을 시전할 수 있습니다. 물 생성을 시전할 때마다 담수 또는 해수를 생성할지 선택합니다.

name: Nudge the Scales

description.value:
You lay a finger on the scales of life and death to heal a creature, regardless of whether it's living or undead. You restore @Damage[(2*(1+@actor.level))[healing]] Hit Points to one creature within 30 feet.

In addition, you can mediate during your daily preparations to place yourself on one side of the scales. Choose life or death. If you align yourself with life, you can be targeted and healed by vitality healing effects, as normal for most living creatures; if you align yourself with death, you gain the void healing ability, and can instead be targeted and healed by void effects and other effects that restore Hit Points to undead creatures..

_desc_en:
You lay a finger on the scales of life and death to heal a creature, regardless of whether it's living or undead. You restore @Damage[(2*(1+@actor.level))[healing]] Hit Points to one creature within 30 feet.

In addition, you can mediate during your daily preparations to place yourself on one side of the scales. Choose life or death. If you align yourself with life, you can be targeted and healed by vitality healing effects, as normal for most living creatures; if you align yourself with death, you gain the void healing ability, and can instead be targeted and healed by void effects and other effects that restore Hit Points to undead creatures..
_desc_ko:
생명의 저울에 손가락을 대어 생명체나 언데드 여부와 상관없이 치유합니다. 30피트 내 한 생명체의 회복 HP를 회복시킵니다.

또한 일상적인 준비 과정에서 저울의 한쪽에 자신을 위치시키며 중재할 수 있습니다. 생명과 죽음 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 생명에 자신을 맞추면 대부분의 생명체에게 일반적인 활력 치유 효과로 치유됩니다. 죽음에 자신을 맞추면 공허 치유 능력을 얻어, 공허 효과가 HP를 회복시키고 언데드 생물에게 HP를 회복시키는 기타 효과로 치유됩니다.

name: Contagious Spell

description.value: Your magic can bring devastation to more individuals. Spend a Mythic Point. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that inflicts damage or debilitating conditions and targets a specific number of creatures, you can target one additional creature.

_desc_en: Your magic can bring devastation to more individuals. Spend a Mythic Point. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that inflicts damage or debilitating conditions and targets a specific number of creatures, you can target one additional creature.
_desc_ko: 당신의 마법은 더 많은 대상에게 파괴를 가져올 수 있습니다. 신화 포인트 1점을 소모하세요. 다음 행동이 특정 수의 생물을 대상으로 피해나 약화 상태를 유발하는 주문을 시전하는 것이라면, 추가로 한 명의 생물을 더 대상으로 지정할 수 있습니다.

name: Mature Dragon Companion

description.value:
Your dragon companion matures and the bond you share is strengthened. The dragon companion you gained with your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.hh2aqd0TGsrcSXl0]{Drake Rider Dedication} is now a mature animal companion.

Your dragon companion gains greater independence. During an encounter, even if you don't use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{Command an Animal} action, your dragon companion can still use 1 action that round on your turn to Stride or Strike. It can do this at any point during your turn, as long as you aren't currently taking an action. If it does, that's all the actions it gets that round—you can't Command it later.

_desc_en:
Your dragon companion matures and the bond you share is strengthened. The dragon companion you gained with your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.hh2aqd0TGsrcSXl0]{Drake Rider Dedication} is now a mature animal companion.

Your dragon companion gains greater independence. During an encounter, even if you don't use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{Command an Animal} action, your dragon companion can still use 1 action that round on your turn to Stride or Strike. It can do this at any point during your turn, as long as you aren't currently taking an action. If it does, that's all the actions it gets that round—you can't Command it later.
_desc_ko:
당신의 용 동료가 성숙하고 둘이 나눈 유대가 강해진다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.hh2aqd0TGsrcSXl0]{드레이크 라이더 헌신}으로 얻은 용 동료가 이제 성숙한 동물 동료가 된다.

당신의 용 동료는 더 큰 자율성을 얻는다. 조우 중, 당신이 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{동물 명령} 행동을 사용하지 않더라도, 당신의 용 동료는 당신의 턴에 그 라운드에 1행동을 사용하여 보폭이나 타격을 할 수 있다. 당신이 현재 행동을 취하고 있지 않은 한, 동료는 당신의 턴 중 어느 시점에서든 이를 할 수 있다. 만약 그렇게 한다면, 그것이 그 라운드에 동료가 얻는 행동의 전부이며, 이후에 다시 명령할 수 없다.

name: Share Burden

description.value:
Trigger An ally within 60 feet would be affected by a curse or misfortune effect, and you wouldn't be affected but you are an eligible target for the effect.

You draw the misfortune or curse into yourself, potentially enabling you to enter your curse maelstrom state. Instead of affecting your ally, the triggering curse or misfortune effect affects you.

_desc_en:
Trigger An ally within 60 feet would be affected by a curse or misfortune effect, and you wouldn't be affected but you are an eligible target for the effect.

You draw the misfortune or curse into yourself, potentially enabling you to enter your curse maelstrom state. Instead of affecting your ally, the triggering curse or misfortune effect affects you.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 60피트 내 아군이 저주나 불운 효과에 걸릴 상황인데, 당신은 그 효과에 걸리지 않지만 효과의 대상이 될 수 있는 경우.

불운이나 저주를 스스로 끌어당겨 저주 소용돌이 상태에 진입할 수 있습니다. 발동된 저주나 불운 효과가 아군 대신 당신에게 영향을 미칩니다.

name: Wildborn Magic

description.value:
Access Mualijae ethnicity

You have learned to access the old magic of wild places. Choose one cantrip from the primal spell list. You can cast this cantrip as an innate primal spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

_desc_en:
Access Mualijae ethnicity

You have learned to access the old magic of wild places. Choose one cantrip from the primal spell list. You can cast this cantrip as an innate primal spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko:
접근 무알리재 민족

당신은 야생의 장소에 깃든 고대의 마법에 접근하는 법을 익혔습니다. 원시 주문 목록에서 한 가지 캔트립을 선택하세요. 이 캔트립을 선천적인 프라이멀 주문으로 마음대로 시전할 수 있습니다. 선택한 캔트립은 당신의 레벨 절반(반올림)에 해당하는 주문 랭크으로 강화됩니다.

name: Foolproof Instructions

description.value:
You feel confident that you can explain your scrolls so well that even your allies can use them... hopefully. During your daily preparations, you can select a single scroll and instruct a single ally in its use. Until your next daily preparations, the ally can attempt to use the scroll with a single action that has the manipulate trait. The ally rolls the skill corresponding to the spellcasting tradition. The GM determines the DC based on the scroll's level, possibly adjusted for the situation. If the spell has a spell attack bonus or a spell DC, use your level as the proficiency bonus and the highest of your ally's Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifiers.

Success For the rest of the ally's turn, they can spend actions to Cast the Spell.

Failure The ally misremembers your instructions and can't use the scroll this turn.

Critical Failure The ally misunderstood your instructions and can't use the scroll.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en:
You feel confident that you can explain your scrolls so well that even your allies can use them... hopefully. During your daily preparations, you can select a single scroll and instruct a single ally in its use. Until your next daily preparations, the ally can attempt to use the scroll with a single action that has the manipulate trait. The ally rolls the skill corresponding to the spellcasting tradition. The GM determines the DC based on the scroll's level, possibly adjusted for the situation. If the spell has a spell attack bonus or a spell DC, use your level as the proficiency bonus and the highest of your ally's Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifiers.

Success For the rest of the ally's turn, they can spend actions to Cast the Spell.

Failure The ally misremembers your instructions and can't use the scroll this turn.

Critical Failure The ally misunderstood your instructions and can't use the scroll.
_desc_ko:
당신은 자신의 두루마리를 너무나 잘 설명할 수 있어 아군조차도 사용할 수 있을 거라 확신합니다... 바라건대. 일일 준비 시간 동안, 당신은 두루마리 하나를 선택해 아군 한 명에게 그 사용법을 가르칠 수 있습니다. 다음 일일 준비 시간까지, 그 아군은 조작 특성을 가진 액션 하나(하나의 행동)로 두루마리 사용을 시도할 수 있습니다. 동료는 주문 시전 전통에 해당하는 기술을 굴립니다. GM은 두루마리 레벨을 기준으로 난이도(DC)를 결정하며 상황에 따라 조정할 수 있습니다. 주문에 주문 공격 보너스나 주문 DC가 있다면, 당신의 레벨을 숙련 보너스로 사용하고 동료의 지능, 지혜, 매력 수정자 중 가장 높은 값을 적용합니다.

성공 시 아군의 턴이 끝날 때까지, 아군은 행동을 소모하여 주문을 시전할 수 있습니다.

실패 아군이 당신의 지시를 잘못 기억하여 이번 턴에 두루마리를 사용할 수 없습니다.

대실패 아군이 당신의 지시를 오해하여 두루마리를 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Head Stomp

description.value: Make an unarmed melee Strike against a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} target. If it hits, until the end of your next turn the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} on a critical hit) and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}.

_desc_en: Make an unarmed melee Strike against a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} target. If it hits, until the end of your next turn the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} on a critical hit) and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}.
_desc_ko: {엎드린} 대상에게 무기 없는 근접 공격을 시도한다. 명중 시, 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 대상은 @link[conditions.stupefied]{1} 상태가 되며(치명타 시 @link[conditions.stupefied]{2}), @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Take Flight

description.value:
Frequency once per round

Though it's not fully effective, much of your ability to fly has stayed with you. You Fly. If you don't normally have a fly Speed, you gain a fly Speed of 15 feet for this movement. If you aren't on solid ground at the end of this movement, you fall.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per round

Though it's not fully effective, much of your ability to fly has stayed with you. You Fly. If you don't normally have a fly Speed, you gain a fly Speed of 15 feet for this movement. If you aren't on solid ground at the end of this movement, you fall.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 라운드당 1회

비록 완전히 효과적이진 않지만, 비행 능력의 상당 부분이 남아 있습니다. 당신은 날아다닙니다. 평소 비행 속도가 없다면, 이 이동에 대해 15피트의 비행 속도를 얻습니다. 이 이동이 끝날 때 단단한 지면에 있지 않다면, 추락합니다.

name: Plant Empathy

description.value: You have a connection to flora that allows you to communicate with them on a rudimentary level. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with plants and fungus.

_desc_en: You have a connection to flora that allows you to communicate with them on a rudimentary level. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with plants and fungus.
_desc_ko: 당신은 식물과 연결되어 있어 기초적인 수준으로 소통할 수 있습니다. 식물과 균류에게 질문하고 답변을 받을 수 있으며, 외교 기술도 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Accelerating Touch

description.value:
Your healing energies are infused with bounding energy. A creature that recovers Hit Points from your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zNN9212H2FGfM7VS]{Lay on Hands} gains a +10-foot status bonus to its Speed until the end of its next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.BJldFHlx4kwMY3rX]{Effect: Accelerating Touch}

_desc_en:
Your healing energies are infused with bounding energy. A creature that recovers Hit Points from your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zNN9212H2FGfM7VS]{Lay on Hands} gains a +10-foot status bonus to its Speed until the end of its next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.BJldFHlx4kwMY3rX]{Effect: Accelerating Touch}
_desc_ko:
당신의 치유 에너지에는 탄력적인 힘이 스며들어 있습니다. 당신의 @link[spells.lay-on-hands]로 HP를 회복한 생물은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 이동 속도에 +10피트 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.alyNtkHLNnt98Ewz]{주문 효과: 가속의 손길}

name: Current Spell

description.value:
As you use your magic to manipulate air or water, you spin off some of its currents to form a barrier around you. If your next action is to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast a Spell} with the air or water trait, until the start of your next turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC or a +2 circumstance bonus against ranged attacks. This effect has the air or water trait, or both, depending on the traits of the spell you cast. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all saves against effects with the air trait, water trait, or both until the start of your next turn, depending on the spell's traits.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.8HGz3rQCHNgdAqFC]{Effect: Current Spell}

_desc_en:
As you use your magic to manipulate air or water, you spin off some of its currents to form a barrier around you. If your next action is to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast a Spell} with the air or water trait, until the start of your next turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC or a +2 circumstance bonus against ranged attacks. This effect has the air or water trait, or both, depending on the traits of the spell you cast. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all saves against effects with the air trait, water trait, or both until the start of your next turn, depending on the spell's traits.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.8HGz3rQCHNgdAqFC]{Effect: Current Spell}
_desc_ko:
공기나 물을 조종하는 마법을 사용할 때, 그 흐름 일부를 분출하여 주변에 장벽을 형성합니다. 다음 행동이 @link[actions.cast-a-spell]이며 공기 또는 물 속성을 지닌 경우, 다음 턴 시작 전까지 AC에 +1 상황 보너스 또는 원거리 공격에 대해 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 효과는 시전한 주문의 속성에 따라 공기 속성, 물 속성, 또는 둘 다를 지닙니다. 또한 다음 턴 시작까지, 주문 특성에 따라 공기 특성, 물 특성 또는 둘 다를 가진 효과에 대한 모든 내성에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.8HGz3rQCHNgdAqFC]{효과: 현재 주문}

name: Nephilim Eyes

description.value: Your eyes can see through darkness with visual acuity akin to that possessed by most extraplanar beings. You gain darkvision.

_desc_en: Your eyes can see through darkness with visual acuity akin to that possessed by most extraplanar beings. You gain darkvision.
_desc_ko: 당신의 눈은 대부분의 초월적 존재들이 지닌 것과 유사한 시력으로 어둠 속을 꿰뚫어 볼 수 있습니다. 암흑 시야를 얻습니다.

name: Canopy Sight

description.value: You can see equally well even in dense jungles where only a small amount of light shines through. You gain low-light vision.

_desc_en: You can see equally well even in dense jungles where only a small amount of light shines through. You gain low-light vision.
_desc_ko: 빛이 거의 스며들지 않는 울창한 정글 속에서도 똑같이 잘 볼 수 있습니다. 저조도 시야를 얻습니다.

name: Spinning Stand

description.value:
Requirements You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

You flare your legs around, using the momentum to both lash out and return to a standing position. You enter talon stance if you weren't in it already, make a spinning talon Strike against an enemy in reach, and then Stand. You don't take the -2 circumstance penalty for attacking while prone, and your Stand action doesn't trigger reactions. You can spend two actions using Spinning Stand to make two spinning talon Strikes instead of one; these Strikes must be against separate targets.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

You flare your legs around, using the momentum to both lash out and return to a standing position. You enter talon stance if you weren't in it already, make a spinning talon Strike against an enemy in reach, and then Stand. You don't take the -2 circumstance penalty for attacking while prone, and your Stand action doesn't trigger reactions. You can spend two actions using Spinning Stand to make two spinning talon Strikes instead of one; these Strikes must be against separate targets.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 @link[conditions.prone]입니다.

다리를 휘둘러 모멘텀을 이용해 휘두르며 동시에 일어서서 서 있는 자세로 돌아갑니다. 이미 발톱 자세가 아니었다면 발톱 자세를 취하고, 도달 범위 내의 적에게 회전 발톱 공격을 가한 후 일어서십시오. 넘어짐 상태에서 공격할 때 적용되는 -2 상황 페널티를 받지 않으며, 일어서기 행동은 반응을 유발하지 않습니다. 두 개의 행동을 소비하여 회전 일어서기를 사용하면 하나의 공격 대신 두 번의 회전 발톱 공격을 가할 수 있습니다. 이 공격들은 반드시 서로 다른 대상에게 가해야 합니다.

name: Devastating Spellstrike

description.value:
Requirements You are in Arcane Cascade stance and your Spellstrike is charged.

Your Spellstrike sweeps are so wide and devastating, they splash onto nearby foes. Make a Spellstrike. Foes adjacent to the target take splash damage equal to 2 + the extra damage from Arcane Cascade. The damage type is the same as Arcane Cascade; if the spell already deals splash damage of the same type, combine the damage together before applying weaknesses or resistances.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are in Arcane Cascade stance and your Spellstrike is charged.

Your Spellstrike sweeps are so wide and devastating, they splash onto nearby foes. Make a Spellstrike. Foes adjacent to the target take splash damage equal to 2 + the extra damage from Arcane Cascade. The damage type is the same as Arcane Cascade; if the spell already deals splash damage of the same type, combine the damage together before applying weaknesses or resistances.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 아케인 캐스케이드 자세를 취하고 있으며, 당신의 스펠스트라이크가 충전되어 있어야 합니다.

당신의 스펠스트라이크가 너무나 넓고 파괴적이어서 근처 적들에게도 피해를 입힙니다. 스펠스트라이크를 사용하세요. 대상과 인접한 적들은 2 + 아케인 캐스케이드의 추가 피해량에 해당하는 방사 피해를 입습니다. 피해 유형은 아케인 캐스케이드와 동일합니다. 해당 주문이 이미 동일한 유형의 방사 피해를 입히는 경우, 약점이나 저항을 적용하기 전에 두 피해를 합산하세요.

name: Everyone Duck!

description.value:
Trigger You fail, but don't critically fail, an attempt to Disable a Device on a trap.

You intentionally set off the trap, but you take special precautions to protect yourself and your allies from the trap's effects. For the next 2 rounds, if the trap rolls a critical success on an attack roll, it gets a normal success instead, and if anyone rolls a critical failure on their saving throw against the trap, they get a normal failure instead.

_desc_en:
Trigger You fail, but don't critically fail, an attempt to Disable a Device on a trap.

You intentionally set off the trap, but you take special precautions to protect yourself and your allies from the trap's effects. For the next 2 rounds, if the trap rolls a critical success on an attack roll, it gets a normal success instead, and if anyone rolls a critical failure on their saving throw against the trap, they get a normal failure instead.
_desc_ko:
트리거 함정 장치 해제하려고 시도했으나 실패했으나 대실패는 아님.

당신은 의도적으로 함정을 작동시켰지만, 자신과 아군을 함정의 효과로부터 보호하기 위해 특별한 예방 조치를 취했습니다. 다음 2라운드 동안, 함정이 명중 굴림에서 대성공을 굴리면 일반 성공으로 대체되며, 함정에 대한 내성 굴림에서 대실패를 굴린 사람은 일반 실패로 대체됩니다.

name: Puncturing Horn

description.value:
While many kashrishi never use their horns for more than cracking open hard-shelled fruits or amplifying their psychic powers, you've practiced using yours offensively. You gain a horn unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Your horn is in the brawling group and has the finesse and unarmed traits.

Special If you have the xyloshi heritage, your horn instead deals 1d8 piercing damage.

_desc_en:
While many kashrishi never use their horns for more than cracking open hard-shelled fruits or amplifying their psychic powers, you've practiced using yours offensively. You gain a horn unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Your horn is in the brawling group and has the finesse and unarmed traits.

Special If you have the xyloshi heritage, your horn instead deals 1d8 piercing damage.
_desc_ko:
많은 카슈리시는 단단한 껍질의 열매를 깨거나 사이킥 능력을 증폭시키는 용도 외에는 뿔을 사용하지 않지만, 당신은 공격적으로 사용하는 법을 연습해왔다. 뿔로 비무장 공격할 수 있으며, 1d6 관통 피해를 입힌다. 당신의 뿔은 격투 무기 그룹에 속하며, 기교와 비무장 공격 특성을 지닌다.

특수 자일로시 혈통을 가진 경우, 뿔 공격은 1d8 관통 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Orator's Filibuster

description.value:
When you seek to convince others of the worth of your cause, you are capable of unleashing such an entrancing torrent of rhetoric and metaphor that it is all but impossible to look away from you. When you begin a conversation or similar attempt with the goal of Making an Impression, all creatures who are observing you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} unless they succeed at a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. Creatures who are familiar with you and your verbal techniques, such as allies you've known for at least several days, are immune to this effect, though newer allies who have not heard one of your speeches before might still be affected.

Affected creatures remain fascinated for as long as you continue your filibuster, though they can attempt a new save to end the effect at the end of each minute while your filibuster lasts. A creature who succeeds at a saving throw to end the fascinated condition from your filibuster is also unaffected by your attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}.

You can continue your filibuster indefinitely, but after every 10 minutes you must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:@self.level|adjustment:5|roller:self] saving throw against a hard DC for your level. Failing this save results in your filibuster ending and prevents you from attempting another filibuster for 1 hour.

_desc_en:
When you seek to convince others of the worth of your cause, you are capable of unleashing such an entrancing torrent of rhetoric and metaphor that it is all but impossible to look away from you. When you begin a conversation or similar attempt with the goal of Making an Impression, all creatures who are observing you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} unless they succeed at a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. Creatures who are familiar with you and your verbal techniques, such as allies you've known for at least several days, are immune to this effect, though newer allies who have not heard one of your speeches before might still be affected.

Affected creatures remain fascinated for as long as you continue your filibuster, though they can attempt a new save to end the effect at the end of each minute while your filibuster lasts. A creature who succeeds at a saving throw to end the fascinated condition from your filibuster is also unaffected by your attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}.

You can continue your filibuster indefinitely, but after every 10 minutes you must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:@self.level|adjustment:5|roller:self] saving throw against a hard DC for your level. Failing this save results in your filibuster ending and prevents you from attempting another filibuster for 1 hour.
_desc_ko:
당신이 자신의 대의가 옳다고 타인을 설득하려 할 때, 당신은 그토록 매혹적인 수사학과 은유의 폭풍을 쏟아내어 상대방이 당신에게서 시선을 떼지 못하게 할 수 있다. 인상을 남기려는 목적으로 대화를 시작하거나 유사한 시도를 할 때, 당신을 지켜보는 모든 생물은 @link[conditions.fascinated] 상태가 됩니다. 단, 당신의 클래스 DC와 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽에 대한 의지 내성 굴림에서 성공한 경우는 예외입니다. 당신과 당신의 언어적 기법에 패밀리어인 생물들(예: 최소 며칠 이상 알고 지낸 아군)은 이 효과에 면역이지만, 당신의 연설을 한 번도 들어본 적 없는 새로운 아군은 여전히 영향을 받을 수 있습니다.

영향을 받은 생물은 당신이 필리버스터를 계속하는 동안 매혹 상태가 유지되지만, 필리버스터가 지속되는 동안 매분마다 효과를 종료하기 위한 새로운 내성 굴림을 시도할 수 있습니다. 당신의 필리버스터로 인한 매혹 상태를 종료하기 위한 내성 굴림에서 성공한 생물은 당신이 @link[actions.make-an-impression]를 시도하는 것에도 영향을 받지 않습니다.

당신은 필리버스터를 무기한 지속할 수 있으나, 10분마다 당신의 레벨에 해당하는 어려운 DC의 인내 내성 굴림을 시도해야 합니다. 이 내성 굴림 실패 시 필리버스터가 종료되며, 1시간 동안 다른 필리버스터를 시도할 수 없습니다.

name: Magical Master

description.value:
Your eidolon gains a bevy of lower-rank spells. Choose an innate spell of your eidolon's tradition of each of the spell ranks from 1 to 7 in which your eidolon doesn't currently have an innate spell from Magical Adept. Your eidolon can cast each once per day as innate spells.

You can swap these spells at every even level, but your eidolon can never know more than one spell of each spell rank 1 through 7

_desc_en:
Your eidolon gains a bevy of lower-rank spells. Choose an innate spell of your eidolon's tradition of each of the spell ranks from 1 to 7 in which your eidolon doesn't currently have an innate spell from Magical Adept. Your eidolon can cast each once per day as innate spells.

You can swap these spells at every even level, but your eidolon can never know more than one spell of each spell rank 1 through 7
_desc_ko:
당신의 에이돌론은 다수의 하위 랭크 마법을 습득합니다. 당신의 에이돌론이 마법 숙련자로 인해 현재 선천적 주문을 가지고 있지 않은 1~7레벨 각 레벨의 에이돌론 전통 선천적 주문을 하나씩 선택하십시오. 당신의 에이돌론은 각 주문을 하루에 한 번씩 선천적 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

짝수 레벨마다 이 주문들을 교체할 수 있으나, 각 주문 랭크(1~7)별로 에이돌론이 알 수 있는 주문은 항상 하나만 가능하다.

name: Converge

description.value:
Trigger You make a successful ranged attack against an opponent who is within your overwatch field, and who is within reach of one or more of your allies who is also within your overwatch field.

Informing your ally of an opening created by your shot, you coordinate to set them up to hit the target at the same time. Your ally can make a melee Strike against the triggering foe as a reaction. This Strike doesn't count toward that ally's multiple attack penalty, and their multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike. If your ally's Strike is successful, combine the damage from your successful ranged attack with the damage from your ally's melee attack for the purpose of determining resistances and weaknesses.

_desc_en:
Trigger You make a successful ranged attack against an opponent who is within your overwatch field, and who is within reach of one or more of your allies who is also within your overwatch field.

Informing your ally of an opening created by your shot, you coordinate to set them up to hit the target at the same time. Your ally can make a melee Strike against the triggering foe as a reaction. This Strike doesn't count toward that ally's multiple attack penalty, and their multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike. If your ally's Strike is successful, combine the damage from your successful ranged attack with the damage from your ally's melee attack for the purpose of determining resistances and weaknesses.
_desc_ko:
Trigger 당신의 오버워치 범위 내에 있고, 또한 당신의 오버워치 범위 내에 있는 한 명 이상의 아군의 공격 범위 내에 있는 상대에게 원거리 공격을 성공적으로 가합니다.

당신의 사격으로 생긴 틈을 아군에게 알리고, 동시에 목표를 공격할 수 있도록 협동합니다. 동료는 반응으로 발동 적에게 근접 타격을 가할 수 있다. 이 타격은 동료의 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되지 않으며, 동료의 다중 공격 페널티도 이 타격에 적용되지 않는다. 동료의 타격이 성공하면, 저항력 및 약점 판정을 위해 성공한 원거리 공격 의 피해와 동료의 근접 공격 피해량을 합산한다.

name: Formation Training

description.value:
You know how to fight in formation with your brethren. When you are adjacent to at least two hobgoblin allies, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws. This bonus increases to +2 on Reflex saves against area effects.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.LVPodfYEWKtK3fUW]{Effect: Formation Training}

_desc_en:
You know how to fight in formation with your brethren. When you are adjacent to at least two hobgoblin allies, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws. This bonus increases to +2 on Reflex saves against area effects.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.LVPodfYEWKtK3fUW]{Effect: Formation Training}
_desc_ko:
동료들과 함께 편대를 이루어 싸우는 법을 알고 있다. 적어도 두 명의 홉고블린 아군과 인접해 있을 때, AC와 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻는다. 이 보너스는 영역 효과에 대한 반사 내성에는 +2로 증가한다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.LVPodfYEWKtK3fUW]{효과: 편대 훈련}

name: Whisper on the Wind

description.value:
You speak in a whisper, a soft wind carrying your words far away. This has the effect of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLzFcIaSXs7YTIqJ]{Message} spell with a range of 500 feet, and it can target only a creature surrounded by air. If you start your message with the target's name, you and the target don't need to be able to see each other, nor do you need line of effect.

Level (4th) The range is 1 mile.

Level (14th) The range is planetary plus the Plane of Air.

_desc_en:
You speak in a whisper, a soft wind carrying your words far away. This has the effect of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLzFcIaSXs7YTIqJ]{Message} spell with a range of 500 feet, and it can target only a creature surrounded by air. If you start your message with the target's name, you and the target don't need to be able to see each other, nor do you need line of effect.

Level (4th) The range is 1 mile.

Level (14th) The range is planetary plus the Plane of Air.
_desc_ko:
당신은 속삭임으로 말하며, 부드러운 바람이 당신의 말을 멀리까지 실어 나릅니다. 이는 @link[spells.message] 주문의 효과를 가지며, 범위는 500피트이고, 공기에 둘러싸인 생물만을 대상으로 할 수 있습니다. 목표의 이름으로 메시지를 시작하면, 당신과 목표는 서로를 볼 수 있을 필요도 없고, 효과선도 필요하지 않습니다.

레벨 (4th) 사거리는 1마일이다.

레벨 (14급) 범위: 행성계 및 공기계.

name: Haunting Memories

description.value:
Your soul bears metaphysical impressions of the innumerable other spirits imprisoned with you in the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.5Q5MfHX43Sjm8C6Z]{Final Blade} from which you escaped, allowing you to draw upon their memories. When you make your daily preparations, you can either gain the expert proficiency rank in one skill in which you're untrained or raise your proficiency rank to master in one skill in which you're trained or better. You also gain one skill feat with a minimum requirement of your new rank in the chosen skill. For the purpose of meeting level prerequisites for this feat, your level is equal to half your level.

This proficiency and feat last until you make your daily preparations again. Since the proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for any permanent character option.

_desc_en:
Your soul bears metaphysical impressions of the innumerable other spirits imprisoned with you in the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.5Q5MfHX43Sjm8C6Z]{Final Blade} from which you escaped, allowing you to draw upon their memories. When you make your daily preparations, you can either gain the expert proficiency rank in one skill in which you're untrained or raise your proficiency rank to master in one skill in which you're trained or better. You also gain one skill feat with a minimum requirement of your new rank in the chosen skill. For the purpose of meeting level prerequisites for this feat, your level is equal to half your level.

This proficiency and feat last until you make your daily preparations again. Since the proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for any permanent character option.
_desc_ko:
당신의 영혼은 탈출한 @link[equipment.final-blade]에 함께 갇혀 있던 무수한 다른 영혼들의 초월적 흔적을 지니고 있어, 그들의 기억을 끌어낼 수 있습니다. 일일 준비를 할 때, 당신은 미숙련 기술 중 하나에서 숙련자 등급을 획득하거나, 숙련 이상인 기술 중 하나에서 숙련 등급을 달인 등급으로 올릴 수 있습니다. 또한 선택한 기술의 새 등급을 최소 요구 조건으로 하는 기술 피트 하나를 얻습니다. 이 재주의 레벨 전제 조건을 충족할 때, 당신의 레벨은 실제 레벨의 절반으로 간주됩니다.

이 숙련도와 피트는 다음 일일 준비를 할 때까지 지속됩니다. 숙련도가 일시적이므로 영구적인 캐릭터 옵션의 전제 조건으로 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Lord of the Fiends

description.value: You consider every fiend a future subject and can assess them at a glance. Spend a Mythic Point. Attempt a check at mythic proficiency to Recall Knowledge about every fiend you can see. For the next hour, whenever you roll a success on a Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation check against a fiend, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: You consider every fiend a future subject and can assess them at a glance. Spend a Mythic Point. Attempt a check at mythic proficiency to Recall Knowledge about every fiend you can see. For the next hour, whenever you roll a success on a Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation check against a fiend, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 모든 핀드를 미래의 신하로 여기며, 그들을 한눈에 평가할 수 있습니다. 신화 포인트 1점을 소모합니다. 신화 숙련도 검사를 시도하여 시야에 들어오는 모든 핀드에 대한 지식을 회상합니다. 이후 1시간 동안 핀드를 상대로 기만, 외교, 협박 판정에서 성공을 굴릴 때마다 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Unconventional Expertise

description.value: You've continued to advance your powers using your unconventional weapon. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in certain weapons, you also gain that proficiency in the weapon you chose for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.49mBVNF4SK6iYdJm]{Unconventional Weaponry}.

value.value: trained in the weapon you chose for Unconventional Weaponry

_desc_en: You've continued to advance your powers using your unconventional weapon. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in certain weapons, you also gain that proficiency in the weapon you chose for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.49mBVNF4SK6iYdJm]{Unconventional Weaponry}.
_desc_ko: 넌 비전통적인 무기를 사용해 계속해서 능력을 발전시켜 왔어. 특정 무기에 대해 전문가 이상의 숙련도를 부여하는 클래스 특성을 획득할 때마다, @link[feats.unconventional-weaponry]에 선택한 무기에 대해서도 그 숙련도를 얻게 돼.

name: Quick Coercion

description.value: You can bully others with just a few choice implications. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce} a creature after 1 round of conversation instead of 1 minute. You still can't Coerce a creature in the midst of combat, or without engaging in a conversation.

_desc_en: You can bully others with just a few choice implications. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce} a creature after 1 round of conversation instead of 1 minute. You still can't Coerce a creature in the midst of combat, or without engaging in a conversation.
_desc_ko: 몇 마디의 암시만으로 상대를 위협할 수 있습니다. @link[actions.coerce]를 1분 대신 1라운드의 대화 후에도 사용할 수 있습니다. 다만 전투 중이거나 대화를 나누지 않은 상태에서는 여전히 강요할 수 없습니다.

name: Wind Tempered

description.value: You are at home in tempestuous weather and accustomed to even the harshest winds. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against air and electricity effects. If you roll a success on a save against an air effect, you get a critical success instead.

rules.text: When you roll a success on a save against an air effect, you get a critical success instead.
rules.title: {item|name}

_desc_en: You are at home in tempestuous weather and accustomed to even the harshest winds. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against air and electricity effects. If you roll a success on a save against an air effect, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 폭풍우 속에서도 편안함을 느끼며 가장 거센 바람에도 익숙합니다. 공기 및 전기 효과에 대한 내성에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 공기 효과에 대한 내성에서 성공을 굴릴 경우, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Irriseni Ice-Witch

description.value: You can trace your direct descent from one of the Queens of Irrisen and thus from Baba Yaga herself. Your resistance to cold increases to 5 + half your level, and you can cast 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.R5FHRv7VqyRnxg2t]{Wall of Ice} as an innate arcane spell once per day.

_desc_en: You can trace your direct descent from one of the Queens of Irrisen and thus from Baba Yaga herself. Your resistance to cold increases to 5 + half your level, and you can cast 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.R5FHRv7VqyRnxg2t]{Wall of Ice} as an innate arcane spell once per day.
_desc_ko: 당신은 이리센의 여왕 중 한 명, 즉 바바 야가 자신으로부터 직접 계보를 이어받았습니다. 추위에 대한 저항력이 5 + 레벨의 절반으로 증가하며, 하루에 한 번 (5th)랭크 @link[spells.wall-of-ice]을 선천적 아케인 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Acknowledge Fan

description.value:
Your reputation as a Firebrand precedes you, and you need only make a simple gesture or give a look of recognition to amaze those around you. You're so famous and beloved that even your enemies are fans, and they're shocked to see you here. Choose one target creature who can see you to acknowledge. The target must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Regardless of the result, the target becomes temporarily immune to Acknowledge Fan for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to Acknowledge Fan for 1 day.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} and becomes temporarily immune to Acknowledge Fan for 1 day.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} until the end of your next turn.

Special This feat has either the arcane or occult trait, matching the choice you made when you took @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.gOHBzx5Rqa6TZcrm]{Mesmerizing Gaze}.

Your reputation as a Firebrand precedes you, and you need only make a simple gesture or give a look of recognition to amaze those around you. You're so famous and beloved that even your enemies are fans, and they're shocked to see you here. Choose one target creature who can see you to acknowledge. The target must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Regardless of the result, the target becomes temporarily immune to Acknowledge Fan for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to Acknowledge Fan for 1 day.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} until the end of your next turn.

Special This feat has either the arcane or occult trait, matching the choice you made when you took @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.gOHBzx5Rqa6TZcrm]{Mesmerizing Gaze}.
_desc_ko:
당신의 불꽃의 선동가로서의 명성은 이미 널리 알려져 있어, 간단한 제스처나 알아보는 눈빛만으로도 주변 사람들을 놀라게 할 수 있습니다. 당신은 너무나 유명하고 사랑받아 적들조차 팬이며, 그들이 당신을 여기서 보게 되어 충격에 빠집니다. 당신을 볼 수 있는 대상 생물 하나를 선택하여 인정을 보냅니다. 대상은 당신의 직업 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 더 높은 쪽에 대해 의지 저항 검사를 시도해야 합니다. 결과와 상관없이 대상은 1분 동안 인정 팬에 대해 일시적으로 면역이 됩니다.

대성공 대상은 영향을 받지 않으며, 1일간 '팬 인정'에 일시적으로 면역 상태가 된다.

성공 대상은 @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태가 되며, 1일간 인정의 부채 효과에 일시적으로 면역됩니다.

실패 대상은 @link[conditions.stunned]{2} 상태입니다.

대실패 대상은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.paralyzed] 상태가 됩니다.

특수 이 피트는 @link[feats.mesmerizing-gaze]을 선택했을 때의 선택과 일치하는 아케인 또는 오컬트 특성을 가집니다.

name: Basic Breakthrough

description.value: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level inventor feat of your choice.

_desc_en: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level inventor feat of your choice.
_desc_ko: 선택한 1레벨 또는 2레벨 발명가 피트를 획득한다.

name: Extend Elixir

description.value: Integrating your own personal energy into the elixirs you create causes them to affect you for longer. When you consume one of your alchemical items that has the elixir and infused traits and a duration of 1 minute or longer, that elixir's duration is doubled. If you created the item with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.yzNJgwzV9XqEhKc6]{Quick Alchemy}, this can't cause it to exceed the 10-minute duration limit.

_desc_en: Integrating your own personal energy into the elixirs you create causes them to affect you for longer. When you consume one of your alchemical items that has the elixir and infused traits and a duration of 1 minute or longer, that elixir's duration is doubled. If you created the item with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.yzNJgwzV9XqEhKc6]{Quick Alchemy}, this can't cause it to exceed the 10-minute duration limit.
_desc_ko: 자신이 만든 엘릭서에 개인의 에너지를 융합하면 그 효과가 자신에게 더 오래 지속됩니다. 지속 시간이 1분 이상인 엘릭서 특성과 융합 특성을 지닌 자신의 연금술 아이템을 소비할 때, 해당 엘릭서의 지속 시간이 두 배로 늘어납니다. 해당 아이템을 @link[actions.quick-alchemy]로 제작한 경우, 지속 시간이 10분을 초과할 수 없습니다.

name: I've Had Many Jobs

description.value: Finding and excelling at odd jobs is child's play to one who has worked many occupations during many lives. When you attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income}, you function as if you were trained in the skill used. If you're at least an expert in the skill used, the DC for your skill check is reduced by 2.

publication.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

_desc_en: Finding and excelling at odd jobs is child's play to one who has worked many occupations during many lives. When you attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income}, you function as if you were trained in the skill used. If you're at least an expert in the skill used, the DC for your skill check is reduced by 2.
_desc_ko: 여러 생애 동안 다양한 직업을 경험한 이에게 잡일을 찾아 능숙하게 해내는 것은 식은 죽 먹기다. @link[actions.earn-income]을 시도할 때, 해당 기술에 숙련된 것처럼 행동한다. 사용한 기술에 최소한 전문가 수준이라면, 기술 판정 난이도가 2 감소한다.

name: Unbalancing Appearance

description.value:
Requirements A creature within your reach is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you, and you are unnoticed by that creature.

When you attack from the shadows, your foes are thrown off balance. Make a melee Strike against the creature. If your Strike hits, the target remains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for the rest of your turn and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} on a critical hit) until the beginning of your next turn.

_desc_en:
Requirements A creature within your reach is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you, and you are unnoticed by that creature.

When you attack from the shadows, your foes are thrown off balance. Make a melee Strike against the creature. If your Strike hits, the target remains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for the rest of your turn and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} on a critical hit) until the beginning of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 당신의 간격 내에 있는 크리처가 당신에게 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{무방비} 상태이며, 당신은 그 크리처에게 존재 미인지 상태다.

당신이 그림자에서 공격하면 적들은 균형을 잃는다. 그 크리처에게 근접 타격을 한다. 당신의 타격이 명중하면, 대상은 당신의 턴이 끝날 때까지 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{무방비} 상태를 유지하고, 당신의 다음 턴 시작까지 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{둔함 1}(대성공 시 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{둔함 2}) 상태가 된다.

name: Sneaky

description.value:
Stealth is an important tool in your arsenal. You can move 5 feet farther when you take the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} action, up to your Speed.

In addition, as long as you continue to use Sneak actions and succeed at your Stealth check, you don't become observed if you don't have cover or greater cover and aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} at the end of the Sneak action, as long as you have cover or greater cover or are concealed at the end of your turn.

_desc_en:
Stealth is an important tool in your arsenal. You can move 5 feet farther when you take the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} action, up to your Speed.

In addition, as long as you continue to use Sneak actions and succeed at your Stealth check, you don't become observed if you don't have cover or greater cover and aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} at the end of the Sneak action, as long as you have cover or greater cover or are concealed at the end of your turn.
_desc_ko:
은신은 당신의 무기고에서 중요한 도구입니다. @link[actions.sneak] 행동을 취할 때, 당신의 이동 속도 범위 내에서 5피트 더 멀리 이동할 수 있습니다.

또한, 은밀 이동 행동을 계속 사용하고 은신 판정에서 성공하는 한, 은밀 이동 행동 종료 시 커버나 완전 엄폐가 없거나 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태가 아니더라도, 턴 종료 시 커버나 완전 엄폐가 있거나 은폐 상태라면 관찰되지 않습니다.

name: Shake it Off

description.value: You concentrate on your rage, overcoming fear and fighting back sickness. Reduce your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition value by 1, and attempt a @Check[fortitude] save to recover from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} condition as if you had spent an action retching; you reduce your sickened condition value by 1 on a failure (but not on a critical failure), by 2 on a success, or by 3 on a critical success.

_desc_en: You concentrate on your rage, overcoming fear and fighting back sickness. Reduce your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition value by 1, and attempt a @Check[fortitude] save to recover from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} condition as if you had spent an action retching; you reduce your sickened condition value by 1 on a failure (but not on a critical failure), by 2 on a success, or by 3 on a critical success.
_desc_ko: 분노에 집중하여 공포를 극복하고 병을 물리칩니다. @link[conditions.frightened] 상태 수치를 1 감소시키고, 인내 내성 굴림을 시도하다 @link[conditions.sickened] 상태에서 회복하기 위해 구토하는 행동을 사용한 것처럼 행동하십시오. 실패 시(대실패 제외) 상태 수치를 1 감소시키고, 성공 시 2 감소시키며, 대성공 시 3 감소시킵니다.

name: Ancestral Blood Magic

description.value: The magic of your bloodline mixes with that of your ancestry. You gain your blood magic effect when you cast a non-cantrip spell you gained from a heritage or an ancestry feat, in addition to the normal circumstances that trigger your blood magic.

_desc_en: The magic of your bloodline mixes with that of your ancestry. You gain your blood magic effect when you cast a non-cantrip spell you gained from a heritage or an ancestry feat, in addition to the normal circumstances that trigger your blood magic.
_desc_ko: 혈통의 마법이 조상의 마법과 혼합됩니다. 혈통 마법 발동 조건 외에도, 혈통 또는 조상 재주로 획득한 비캔트립 주문을 시전할 때 혈통 마법 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Hair Trigger

description.value:
No one can react faster than you can pull your trigger. When using your initial deed, instead of Interacting to draw a weapon, you can Strike with a firearm or crossbow you're already wielding. If this Strike hits, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your first turn of the encounter.

Special If your initial deed allows you to Interact to draw a weapon more than once, this feat allows you to replace one of these Interact actions and use the other one to draw a weapon. You can't replace both Interact actions with Strikes, but you can draw a loaded firearm or crossbow with one of the actions and immediately shoot it with the other.

value.value: initial deed that allows you to Interact to draw a weapon

_desc_en:
No one can react faster than you can pull your trigger. When using your initial deed, instead of Interacting to draw a weapon, you can Strike with a firearm or crossbow you're already wielding. If this Strike hits, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your first turn of the encounter.

Special If your initial deed allows you to Interact to draw a weapon more than once, this feat allows you to replace one of these Interact actions and use the other one to draw a weapon. You can't replace both Interact actions with Strikes, but you can draw a loaded firearm or crossbow with one of the actions and immediately shoot it with the other.
_desc_ko:
누구도 당신이 방아쇠를 당기는 것보다 빠르게 반응할 수 없습니다. 초기 행동을 사용할 때, 무기를 뽑기 위해 상호작용하는 대신 이미 휘두르고 있는 화기나 석궁으로 강타할 수 있습니다. 이 공격이 명중하면, 대상은 또한 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 되어 해당 교전의 첫 번째 턴이 끝날 때까지 지속됩니다.

특수 초기 행동으로 무기를 뽑기 위한 상호작용을 두 번 이상 수행할 수 있다면, 이 재주는 그 중 하나의 상호작용을 대체하여 무기를 뽑을 수 있게 합니다. 두 상호작용 모두를 공격으로 대체할 수는 없지만, 한 행동으로 장전된 화기나 석궁을 뽑고 다른 행동으로 즉시 발사할 수 있습니다.

name: Divine Dragonblood

description.value: You can trace your lineage to a dragon with almost deific powers, such as a diabolic dragon or empyreal dragon. You are blessed with a small bit of divine protection. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Religion. If you would automatically become trained in Religion (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. In addition, you are endowed quick reactions. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls. If you choose a draconic exemplar, you must choose a divine dragon.

_desc_en: You can trace your lineage to a dragon with almost deific powers, such as a diabolic dragon or empyreal dragon. You are blessed with a small bit of divine protection. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Religion. If you would automatically become trained in Religion (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. In addition, you are endowed quick reactions. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls. If you choose a draconic exemplar, you must choose a divine dragon.
_desc_ko: 당신은 악마용이나 천상용처럼 거의 신적인 힘을 지닌 용의 혈통을 이어받았습니다. 당신은 약간의 신성한 보호를 받습니다. 종교 숙련 등급을 획득한다. 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 자동으로 종교 숙련을 얻는 경우, 대신 선택한 기술의 숙련을 얻는다. 또한 빠른 반응을 부여받는다. 이니셔티브 굴림 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻는다. 드라코닉 이그젬플러를 선택할 경우 신성 용을 선택해야 한다.

name: Phase Out

description.value:
Your eidolon phases out of reality slightly, gaining resistance to all damage (except force and negative) equal to half your level. It's not incorporeal, but it can't use Strikes or actions that require a fully physical form, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}.

Your eidolon can return to its normal form with a single action, which has the concentrate trait.

_desc_en:
Your eidolon phases out of reality slightly, gaining resistance to all damage (except force and negative) equal to half your level. It's not incorporeal, but it can't use Strikes or actions that require a fully physical form, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}.

Your eidolon can return to its normal form with a single action, which has the concentrate trait.
_desc_ko:
당신의 에이돌론은 현실에서 약간 페이즈 아웃되어, 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 모든 피해(힘 및 부정 피해 제외)에 대한 저항력을 얻습니다. 비물질화되지는 않지만, @link[actions.grapple], @link[actions.shove], @link[actions.trip]와 같이 완전한 물리적 형태가 필요한 공격이나 행동은 사용할 수 없습니다.

당신의 에이돌론은 집중 특성을 가진 액션 하나으로 정상 형태로 되돌아갈 수 있습니다.

name: Loyal Warhorse

description.value: The loyalty you and your mount share is unbreakable. The mount you gained with Faithful Steed is now a mature animal companion. In addition, your mount never attacks you, even if it is magically compelled to do so.

_desc_en: The loyalty you and your mount share is unbreakable. The mount you gained with Faithful Steed is now a mature animal companion. In addition, your mount never attacks you, even if it is magically compelled to do so.
_desc_ko: 당신과 탈것 사이의 충성심은 결코 깨지지 않습니다. 충실한 탈것으로 얻은 탈것이 이제 성숙한 동물 동료가 됩니다. 또한, 탈것은 마법으로 강요당하더라도 절대 당신을 공격하지 않습니다.

name: Protective Strike

description.value:
Trigger A creature moves adjacent to or attempts a melee Strike against your designated ally.

You keep harm at bay. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. On a critical success, you interrupt the triggering action.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature moves adjacent to or attempts a melee Strike against your designated ally.

You keep harm at bay. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. On a critical success, you interrupt the triggering action.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 생물이 지정된 아군과 인접하거나 근접 공격을 시도할 때.

당신은 피해를 막아낸다. 발동한 생물에게 근접 공격을 가한다. 대성공 시, 발동한 행동을 중단시킨다.

name: The Bigger They Are

description.value:
With reckless speed, you dash, jump and swing around a creature to find a more vulnerable spot. Attempt to [[/act tumble-through]] a creature at least one size category larger than you, using the following effects.

Critical Success You move through the enemy's space, treating the squares in its space as difficult terrain (every 5 feet costs 10 feet of movement). If you don't have enough Speed to move all the way through its space, you get the same effect as a failure. If you successfully pass through the target's square, the target gains weakness to your precision damage equal to half your level, which lasts until the end of your turn.

Success As success, but the weakness applies only against the next attack you make against the target.

Failure Your movement ends, and you trigger reactions as if you had moved out of the square you started in.

Critical Failure As failure, and you fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.SLXhPgaeKB0W3k1D]{Effect: The Bigger They Are}

_desc_en:
With reckless speed, you dash, jump and swing around a creature to find a more vulnerable spot. Attempt to [[/act tumble-through]] a creature at least one size category larger than you, using the following effects.

Critical Success You move through the enemy's space, treating the squares in its space as difficult terrain (every 5 feet costs 10 feet of movement). If you don't have enough Speed to move all the way through its space, you get the same effect as a failure. If you successfully pass through the target's square, the target gains weakness to your precision damage equal to half your level, which lasts until the end of your turn.

Success As success, but the weakness applies only against the next attack you make against the target.

Failure Your movement ends, and you trigger reactions as if you had moved out of the square you started in.

Critical Failure As failure, and you fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.SLXhPgaeKB0W3k1D]{Effect: The Bigger They Are}
_desc_ko:
무모한 속도로 돌진하고, 점프하며, 적을 휘둘러 더 약점을 찾아낸다. 다음 효과를 적용하여 자신보다 최소 한 단계 큰 크기의 생물을 회피 돌파하려고 시도한다.

대성공 적의 공간을 통과하며, 그 공간 내 칸을 어려운 지형으로 간주한다(5피트마다 이동 거리 10피트 소모). 적의 공간 전체를 통과할 만큼의 속도가 부족하면 실패 시 효과와 동일하게 처리된다. 대상의 칸을 성공적으로 통과하면, 대상은 당신의 레벨 절반에 해당하는 정밀 피해에 대한 약점을 얻으며, 이는 당신의 턴이 끝날 때까지 지속된다.

성공 성공 시와 동일하나, 약화 효과는 해당 대상에 대한 다음 공격에만 적용됩니다.

실패 이동이 종료되며, 시작했던 칸을 벗어난 것처럼 반응을 유발합니다.

대실패 실패와 동일하며, 당신은 @link[conditions.prone]가 됩니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.SLXhPgaeKB0W3k1D]{효과: 크면 클수록}

name: Hardy Traveler

description.value: There's no journey too far or burden too heavy when you have friends at your side or hope within your heart. Increase your maximum and encumbered Bulk limits by 1. In addition, you gain a +10-foot circumstance bonus to your Speed during overland travel.

_desc_en: There's no journey too far or burden too heavy when you have friends at your side or hope within your heart. Increase your maximum and encumbered Bulk limits by 1. In addition, you gain a +10-foot circumstance bonus to your Speed during overland travel.
_desc_ko: 곁에 친구가 있거나 마음에 희망이 있다면, 너무 먼 여정도, 너무 무거운 짐도 없습니다. 최대 벌크 제한과 과적 벌크 제한을 1씩 증가시킵니다. 또한 육로 이동 시 이동 속도에 +10피트 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Dash of Herbs

description.value:
A small cloud of medicinal herbs heal a creature. The type of herbs depends on which malady you decide to treat: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, disease, poison, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}, or injuries. Target one living creature within 30 feet, who regains @Damage[((floor((max(6,@actor.level)-6)/2)+2)d8+4)[healing]] HP and can attempt a new save against one malady of the chosen kind. If you chose injuries, instead increase the healing dice to @Damage[((floor((max(6,@actor.level)-6)/2)+2)d10+4)[healing]]{d10s}. The creature becomes temporarily immune to Dash of Herbs for 10 minutes.

Alternatively, you can add the herbs to a dish of food being prepared for up to six people. Creatures who partake in the meal gain the benefits. The herbs' healing effects wear off if not eaten within an hour, though their flavor remains.

Level (+2) The healing increases by 1d8.

A small cloud of medicinal herbs heal a creature. The type of herbs depends on which malady you decide to treat: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, disease, poison, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}, or injuries. Target one living creature within 30 feet, who regains @Damage[((floor((max(6,@actor.level)-6)/2)+2)d8+4)[healing]] HP and can attempt a new save against one malady of the chosen kind. If you chose injuries, instead increase the healing dice to @Damage[((floor((max(6,@actor.level)-6)/2)+2)d10+4)[healing]]{d10s}. The creature becomes temporarily immune to Dash of Herbs for 10 minutes.

Alternatively, you can add the herbs to a dish of food being prepared for up to six people. Creatures who partake in the meal gain the benefits. The herbs' healing effects wear off if not eaten within an hour, though their flavor remains.

Level (+2) The healing increases by 1d8.
_desc_ko:
약초의 작은 구름이 생물을 치유합니다. 약초의 종류는 치료하기로 선택한 상태 이상에 따라 달라집니다: @link[conditions.confused], 질병, 독, @link[conditions.sickened], 또는 부상. 30피트 내의 살아있는 생물 하나를 대상으로 하며, 대상은 회복 HP를 회복하고 선택한 유형의 질병 하나에 대해 새로운 내성을 시도할 수 있습니다. 부상을 선택한 경우, 대신 치유 주사위를 d10s로 증가시킵니다. 해당 생물은 10분 동안 허브 한 줌에 대해 일시적으로 면역이 됩니다.

대신, 최대 6인분으로 준비 중인 음식에 약초를 첨가할 수 있다. 식사에 참여한 생물들은 효과를 얻는다. 1시간 이내에 섭취하지 않으면 치유 효과는 사라지지만 맛은 유지됩니다.

레벨 (+2) 치유량이 1d8 증가합니다.

name: Magical Adept

description.value: Your eidolon gains more magic. Choose one 2nd-rank spell and one 1st-rank spell of your eidolon's tradition. Your eidolon can cast them each once per day as innate spells. At every even level after you take this feat, your eidolon can swap one of these innate spells for a new innate spell that's 2 or more levels lower than your highest-rank spell slot.

_desc_en: Your eidolon gains more magic. Choose one 2nd-rank spell and one 1st-rank spell of your eidolon's tradition. Your eidolon can cast them each once per day as innate spells. At every even level after you take this feat, your eidolon can swap one of these innate spells for a new innate spell that's 2 or more levels lower than your highest-rank spell slot.
_desc_ko: 당신의 에이돌론이 더 많은 마법을 얻습니다. 에이돌론의 전통에 속하는 2nd랭크 주문 하나와 1랭크 주문 하나를 선택하세요. 이들 주문을 하루에 한 번씩 선천적 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 피트를 선택한 후 짝수 레벨마다, 이 선천적 주문 중 하나를 최고 랭크 주문 슬롯보다 2레벨 이상 낮은 새로운 선천적 주문으로 교체할 수 있습니다.

name: Ferry Through Waves

description.value:
2 or 3

Requirements You are swimming and have a free hand.

The waters around you permit you passage, a privilege you can share with a willing ally. You hold on to an adjacent ally and Swim, carrying them along with you. If you spend three actions Ferrying through Waves, you instead Swim twice. If your ally would need to attempt any Athletics checks to Swim while you're Ferrying through Waves, you roll the check and your result applies to them.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

2 or 3

_desc_ko:
2 또는 3

요구 사항 수영 중이며 빈 손을 가지고 있어야 합니다.

주변 물이 통과를 허용하며, 이 특권을 의지가 있는 아군과 공유할 수 있습니다. 인접한 동료를 붙잡고 수영하며 함께 이동합니다. 파도를 헤치며 이동하는 데 세 번의 행동을 소모하면, 대신 두 번 수영합니다. 파도를 헤치며 이동하는 동안 동료를 수영시키기 위해 운동을 시도해야 한다면, 당신이 판정을 굴리고 그 결과가 동료에게 적용됩니다.

name: Anchoring Aura

description.value: Your aura hampers fiends' teleportation. Your aura attempts to counteract teleportation spells cast by fiends within 15 feet, using the spell rank and DC of your devotion spells.

_desc_en: Your aura hampers fiends' teleportation. Your aura attempts to counteract teleportation spells cast by fiends within 15 feet, using the spell rank and DC of your devotion spells.
_desc_ko: 당신의 오라는 핀드의 순간이동을 방해합니다. 15피트 내 핀드가 시전하는 순간이동 마법에 대해, 당신의 헌신 마법 랭크과 난이도(DC)를 사용해 반격하려고 시도합니다.

name: Reimagine

description.value: You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.y0Vy7iNL3ET8K00C]{Dreaming Potential} as an innate occult spell. You can cast this spell targeting yourself as your last activity before falling asleep to receive its normal benefits and effects.

_desc_en: You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.y0Vy7iNL3ET8K00C]{Dreaming Potential} as an innate occult spell. You can cast this spell targeting yourself as your last activity before falling asleep to receive its normal benefits and effects.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @link[spells.dreaming-potential]을 선천적 오컬트 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 잠들기 직전 마지막 행동으로 자신을 대상으로 이 주문을 시전하면 정상적인 혜택과 효과를 받습니다.

name: Kitsune Lore

description.value: You excel at navigating social situations and keeping secrets. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Diplomacy and Deception. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also become trained in Kitsune Lore.

_desc_en: You excel at navigating social situations and keeping secrets. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Diplomacy and Deception. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also become trained in Kitsune Lore.
_desc_ko: 사회적 상황을 능숙하게 헤쳐 나가고 비밀을 잘 지키는 데 탁월합니다. 외교와 기만에 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 해당 기술 중 하나에 자동으로 숙련이 부여될 경우, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련이 부여됩니다. 또한 키츠네 지식에 숙련됩니다.

name: Called Shot

description.value:
You target a specific area of your foe's anatomy to debilitating effect. Declare a part of your foe's anatomy to target and make a ranged weapon Strike. If you hit and deal damage, the target takes one of the following effects, based on the body part you targeted. The GM should use the stated effects as a guideline when attacking creatures with stranger anatomy-for instance, applying the "arms" effect to a creature's tentacles if those are what the creature uses to attack.

  • Arms The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} until the end of your next turn. On a critical hit, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 minute.
  • Head The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} until the end of your next turn. On a critical hit, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 minute.
  • Legs The target takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds until the end of your next turn. On a critical hit, it also takes a –5-foot penalty to its Speeds for 1 minute.
  • Wings If the target is flying using its wings, it immediately falls 20 feet, or 40 feet on a critical hit. The fall is gradual enough that if the target hits the ground, it takes no damage from the fall.
