_desc_ko: {생동하는 밧줄} 주문을 시전할 때, 대상이 @link[equipment.net] 하나가 되도록 수정할 수 있습니다. 변경 시, 주문의 표준 효과를 다음과 같이 대체합니다: 네트가 움직여 20피트 이내의 중간 크기 이하 생물을 향해 스스로 던져지도록 합니다. 대상의 반사 DC에 대해 주문 명중 굴림을 시도합니다. 성공 시 대상은 @link[conditions.off-guard]가 되며 탈출할 때까지 이동 속도에 -10피트 상황 페널티를 받습니다. 대성공 시 추가로 @link[conditions.immobilized] 상태가 되어 탈출할 때까지 지속됩니다. 탈출 DC는 주문 지속 기간 동안 당신의 주문 DC와 동일합니다. 주문이 종료되면 탈출 DC는 그물망의 일반 DC(보통 16)로 돌아가고, 대상과 인접한 생물은 상호작용을 통해 그물망을 제거할 수 있습니다.

name: Wounded Party

description.value:
Trigger You or your designated ally takes damage, and you're capable of entering a Rage.

Harm to either you or your allies awakens your fury. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Ah5g9pDwWF9b9VW9]{Rage}.

_desc_en:
Trigger You or your designated ally takes damage, and you're capable of entering a Rage.

Harm to either you or your allies awakens your fury. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Ah5g9pDwWF9b9VW9]{Rage}.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신이나 지정한 아군이 피해를 입었고, 당신이 분노 상태에 진입할 수 있을 때.

당신이나 아군이 피해를 입으면 분노가 일어난다. 당신은 @link[actions.rage]가 된다.

name: Senses of the Bear

description.value: While in ursine form, you gain low-light vision and scent (imprecise) 30 feet. If you already had low-light vision, you instead gain darkvision.

_desc_en: While in ursine form, you gain low-light vision and scent (imprecise) 30 feet. If you already had low-light vision, you instead gain darkvision.
_desc_ko: 곰 형태일 때, 30피트 범위 내의 저조도 시야와 (정확하지 않은) 후각을 얻습니다. 이미 저조도 시야를 가지고 있었다면, 대신 암흑 시야를 얻습니다.

name: Interweave Dispel

description.value: You weave dispelling energy into a spell. If your next action is to cast a single-target spell against an enemy, and you either hit the enemy with the spell attack roll or the enemy fails its saving throw, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} on the enemy as a free action, expending a spell slot as normal and targeting one spell effect affecting the enemy.

value.value: dispel magic in your spell repertoire

_desc_en: You weave dispelling energy into a spell. If your next action is to cast a single-target spell against an enemy, and you either hit the enemy with the spell attack roll or the enemy fails its saving throw, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} on the enemy as a free action, expending a spell slot as normal and targeting one spell effect affecting the enemy.
_desc_ko: 주문 안에 해제 에너지를 엮어 넣습니다. 다음 행동으로 적을 대상으로 한 단일 대상 주문을 시전할 때, 명중 굴림으로 적을 명중시키거나 적이 내성 굴림에서 실패하면, 무료 행동으로 적에게 @link[spells.dispel-magic]를 시전할 수 있다. 이때 평소처럼 주문 슬롯을 소모하며, 적에게 영향을 미치는 하나의 주문 효과를 대상으로 한다.

name: Attuned Stride

description.value: You can move freely through terrain you're attuned to. When you gain a terrain attunement benefit, you ignore difficult terrain in the corresponding type of terrain until the end of your next turn.

_desc_en: You can move freely through terrain you're attuned to. When you gain a terrain attunement benefit, you ignore difficult terrain in the corresponding type of terrain until the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko: 당신은 조율된 지형을 자유롭게 이동할 수 있습니다. 지형 조율 혜택을 획득하면, 해당 지형 유형의 어려운 지형을 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 무시합니다.

name: Risky Surgery

description.value:
Your surgery can bring a patient back from the brink of death, but might push them over the edge. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}, you can deal @Damage[1d8[slashing]] damage to your patient just before applying the effects of Treat Wounds.

If you do, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Medicine check to Treat Wounds, and if you roll a success, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en:
Your surgery can bring a patient back from the brink of death, but might push them over the edge. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}, you can deal @Damage[1d8[slashing]] damage to your patient just before applying the effects of Treat Wounds.

If you do, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Medicine check to Treat Wounds, and if you roll a success, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko:
당신의 수술은 환자를 죽음의 문턱에서 되살릴 수 있지만, 오히려 죽음으로 내몰 수도 있습니다. @link[actions.treat-wounds]를 수행할 때, 상처 치료 효과를 적용하기 직전에 환자에게 1d8 참격의 피해를 입힐 수 있습니다.

그렇게 할 경우, 상처 치료 의술 검사 시 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 성공을 굴릴 경우 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Specialized Beastmaster Companion

description.value:
Your nimble and savage animal companions become cunning enough to become specialized. Each companion gains one specialization of your choice. Choose the specialization separately for each companion, including any companion that becomes specialized after you take this feat.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time, add a different specialization to your nimble and savage companions. Your nimble and savage companions can have up to three specializations each.

_desc_en:
Your nimble and savage animal companions become cunning enough to become specialized. Each companion gains one specialization of your choice. Choose the specialization separately for each companion, including any companion that becomes specialized after you take this feat.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time, add a different specialization to your nimble and savage companions. Your nimble and savage companions can have up to three specializations each.
_desc_ko:
당신의 민첩하고 사나운 동물 동료들은 재치 있어져서 전문화될 수 있습니다. 각 동료는 당신이 선택한 하나의 전문화를 얻습니다. 각 동반자마다 별도로 전문화를 선택하십시오. 이 피트를 획득한 후 전문화를 얻는 동반자도 포함됩니다.

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 매번 민첩한 동반자와 사나운 동반자에게 다른 전문화를 추가하십시오. 민첩한 동반자와 사나운 동반자는 각각 최대 세 가지 전문화를 가질 수 있습니다.

name: Arcane Sense

description.value: Your study of magic allows you to instinctively sense its presence. You can cast 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic} at will as an arcane innate spell. If you're a master in Arcana, the spell is heightened to 3rd rank; if you're legendary, it is heightened to 4th rank.

_desc_en: Your study of magic allows you to instinctively sense its presence. You can cast 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic} at will as an arcane innate spell. If you're a master in Arcana, the spell is heightened to 3rd rank; if you're legendary, it is heightened to 4th rank.
_desc_ko: 마법에 대한 연구로 인해 당신은 마법의 존재를 본능적으로 감지할 수 있습니다. 1랭크 @link[spells.detect-magic]를 아케인의 선천적 주문으로 자유롭게 시전할 수 있습니다. 주문학에 달인인 경우 이 주문은 3랭크으로 강화되며, 전설적인 경우 4랭크으로 강화됩니다.

name: Look Again

description.value:
Frequency once per day

If your illusions or enchantments fail to ensnare the minds of others, you can cast them again. If your next action is to cast an innate enchantment or illusion spell and it fails to affect any targets, you do not lose the spell. You must use the same number of actions to recast the same spell on your following turn; if you can't, or choose not to, you waste that number of actions with no effect. After this second casting, you lose the spell whether it affected any targets or not. Look Again works only with spells that require targets and doesn't do anything if you cast a targeted spell but didn't select any targets.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

If your illusions or enchantments fail to ensnare the minds of others, you can cast them again. If your next action is to cast an innate enchantment or illusion spell and it fails to affect any targets, you do not lose the spell. You must use the same number of actions to recast the same spell on your following turn; if you can't, or choose not to, you waste that number of actions with no effect. After this second casting, you lose the spell whether it affected any targets or not. Look Again works only with spells that require targets and doesn't do anything if you cast a targeted spell but didn't select any targets.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

환상이나 마법이 타인의 마음을 사로잡는 데 실패하면, 다시 시전할 수 있습니다. 다음 행동으로 선천적 마법이나 환상 주문을 시전할 때 어떤 대상도 영향을 받지 못하더라도, 그 주문을 잃지 않습니다. 다음 턴에 동일한 주문을 재시전하려면 동일한 수의 행동을 사용해야 합니다. 그렇게 할 수 없거나 선택하지 않으면 해당 행동 수만큼을 효과 없이 낭비하게 됩니다. 이 두 번째 시전 후에는 대상에 영향을 주었는지 여부와 상관없이 주문을 잃게 됩니다. '다시 보기'는 대상이 필요한 주문에만 적용되며, 대상 지정 주문 시 대상을 선택하지 않은 경우에는 아무런 효과가 없습니다.

name: Flexible Ritualist

description.value: You can perform two aspects of a ritual yourself. When you cast a ritual, you can reduce the number of secondary casters by 1. When you do, you must fulfill any requirements for the secondary caster, and you attempt the secondary check normally performed by that secondary caster. You can't replace a secondary caster who is the target of the spell (as in the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{Atone} ritual).

_desc_en: You can perform two aspects of a ritual yourself. When you cast a ritual, you can reduce the number of secondary casters by 1. When you do, you must fulfill any requirements for the secondary caster, and you attempt the secondary check normally performed by that secondary caster. You can't replace a secondary caster who is the target of the spell (as in the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{Atone} ritual).
_desc_ko: 의식의 두 가지 측면을 직접 수행할 수 있습니다. 의식을 시전할 때 보조 시전자 수를 1명 줄일 수 있습니다. 이 경우 보조 시전자의 요구 사항을 충족해야 하며, 해당 보조 시전자가 수행하는 보조 판정을 시도합니다. 주문의 대상이 되는 보조 시전자(@link[spells.atone] 의식 참조)는 대체할 수 없습니다.

name: Half-Truths

description.value: You are able to weave your words in such a way that you never use actual lies, but still mislead people to certain conclusions. You can attempt to make a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request} of a creature using Deception instead of Diplomacy. You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} to a creature using Diplomacy instead of Deception. If you fail your check to Lie, the creature realizes that you were twisting words to fool them without outright lying.

_desc_en: You are able to weave your words in such a way that you never use actual lies, but still mislead people to certain conclusions. You can attempt to make a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request} of a creature using Deception instead of Diplomacy. You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} to a creature using Diplomacy instead of Deception. If you fail your check to Lie, the creature realizes that you were twisting words to fool them without outright lying.
_desc_ko: 당신은 실제 거짓말을 사용하지 않으면서도 사람들을 특정 결론으로 오도할 수 있도록 말을 교묘히 꾸며낼 수 있습니다. 외교 대신 기만 기술을 사용하여 생물에게 @link[actions.request]을 시도할 수 있습니다. 기만 대신 외교를 사용해 생물에게 @link[actions.lie]을 시도할 수 있습니다. 거짓말 판정 실패 시, 상대는 당신이 노골적인 거짓말 없이도 말을 비틀어 속이려 했다는 사실을 깨닫습니다.

name: Cave Climber

description.value: After years of clambering through caverns, you can climb easily anywhere you go. You gain a climb Speed of 10 feet.

_desc_en: After years of clambering through caverns, you can climb easily anywhere you go. You gain a climb Speed of 10 feet.
_desc_ko: 수년간 동굴을 기어오르며 다닌 덕분에 어디든 쉽게 등반할 수 있습니다. 등반 속도가 10피트 증가합니다.

name: Stealthy As An Octopus

description.value: You're an expert at using the dark of the ocean to conceal yourself. As long as you're separated from a creature by 20 or more feet of water, the turbulence of the water grants you enough cover to attempt to [[/act hide]] from that creature.

_desc_en: You're an expert at using the dark of the ocean to conceal yourself. As long as you're separated from a creature by 20 or more feet of water, the turbulence of the water grants you enough cover to attempt to [[/act hide]] from that creature.
_desc_ko: 당신은 바다의 어둠을 이용해 자신을 감추는 데 전문가다. 크리처와 20피트 이상의 물로 분리되어 있는 한, 물의 격동이 당신에게 그 크리처로부터 [[/act hide]]{숨기}를 시도할 만큼 충분한 엄폐를 제공한다.

name: Ceremony of Strengthened Hand

description.value: Your exoskeleton's weapons are even more potent. If you have a claws unarmed attack, it gains the deadly d8 trait. If you have a branch unarmed attack, it gains the shove and trip traits.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: Your exoskeleton's weapons are even more potent. If you have a claws unarmed attack, it gains the deadly d8 trait. If you have a branch unarmed attack, it gains the shove and trip traits.
_desc_ko: 당신의 외골격 무기가 더욱 강력해집니다. 발톱 비무장 공격을 보유할 경우 치명적 d8 특성을 획득합니다. 가지 비무장 공격을 보유할 경우 밀치기와 넘어뜨리기 특성을 획득합니다.

name: Turn to Mist

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You turn into vapor, gaining the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.V8wXOsoejQhe6CyG]{Vapor Form}.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

You turn into vapor, gaining the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.V8wXOsoejQhe6CyG]{Vapor Form}.
_desc_ko:
빈도 시간당 1회

증기로 변하며 @link[spells.vapor-form]의 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Dragon's Rage Wings

description.value: You sprout dragon wings from your back of the same color as your chosen dragon. While you are raging, you gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed. If you are flying when your rage ends, you start to fall, but your transformation doesn't revert until the last moment, so you take no damage from the fall and land standing up. This action gains the trait of your dragon instinct's tradition.

_desc_en: You sprout dragon wings from your back of the same color as your chosen dragon. While you are raging, you gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed. If you are flying when your rage ends, you start to fall, but your transformation doesn't revert until the last moment, so you take no damage from the fall and land standing up. This action gains the trait of your dragon instinct's tradition.
_desc_ko: 선택한 용과 동일한 색상의 용의 날개가 등 뒤에서 돋아납니다. 분노 상태일 때, 지상 속도 및 비행 속도를 얻습니다. 분노 상태가 끝날 때 비행 중이라면 추락하기 시작하지만, 변신은 마지막 순간까지 유지되어 추락 피해를 입지 않고 서서 착지한다. 이 행동은 네 용 본능 전통의 특성을 획득한다.

name: Instinctive Support

description.value:
Trigger You Cast a non-cantrip spell that targets only your animal companion.

When you support your animal companion, your companion supports you in turn. After your spell takes place, your companion gains its actions for the turn, as if you Commanded it, and one of the actions must be Support. If the companion has used any other actions already, it can't Support you, as normal.

_desc_en:
Trigger You Cast a non-cantrip spell that targets only your animal companion.

When you support your animal companion, your companion supports you in turn. After your spell takes place, your companion gains its actions for the turn, as if you Commanded it, and one of the actions must be Support. If the companion has used any other actions already, it can't Support you, as normal.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신은 동물 동료만을 대상으로 하는 캔트립이 아닌 주문을 시전합니다.

당신이 동물 동료를 지원하면, 동료도 당신을 지원합니다. 당신의 주문이 발동된 후, 동료는 마치 당신이 커맨더한 것처럼 해당 턴의 행동을 얻으며, 그 중 하나는 반드시 지원이어야 합니다. 동반자가 이미 다른 행동을 사용한 경우, 평소처럼 당신을 지원할 수 없습니다.

name: Mage's Field Dressing

description.value:
Requirements Your previous action was to Cast a Spell from a wizard spell slot, and the spell affected an ally within 60 feet.

As your spell takes hold on your ally, you use some of its magic to quickly dress their wounds. You use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.wYerMk6F1RZb0Fwt]{Battle Medicine} on one ally affected by the required spell. You do not need to be holding or wearing a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.s1vB3HdXjMigYAnY]{Healer's Toolkit}, as you conjure glowing threads, bandages, or similar supplies out of pure magic, which adds the arcane trait to Battle Medicine.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your previous action was to Cast a Spell from a wizard spell slot, and the spell affected an ally within 60 feet.

As your spell takes hold on your ally, you use some of its magic to quickly dress their wounds. You use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.wYerMk6F1RZb0Fwt]{Battle Medicine} on one ally affected by the required spell. You do not need to be holding or wearing a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.s1vB3HdXjMigYAnY]{Healer's Toolkit}, as you conjure glowing threads, bandages, or similar supplies out of pure magic, which adds the arcane trait to Battle Medicine.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 이전 행동으로 위자드 주문 슬롯에서 주문을 시전했으며, 해당 주문이 60피트 내 아군에게 영향을 미쳤을 것.

동료에게 걸린 마법이 효과를 발휘하는 동안, 당신은 그 마법의 일부를 이용해 상대의 상처를 신속히 치료합니다. 당신은 필요한 마법의 영향을 받은 한 명의 동료에게 @link[feats.battle-medicine]을 사용합니다. 순수한 마법으로 빛나는 실, 붕대 또는 유사한 물품을 소환하므로 @link[equipment.healers-toolkit]를 소지하거나 착용할 필요가 없으며, 이로 인해 전투 의술에 아케인 속성이 추가됩니다.

name: Inspiring Marshal Stance

description.value:
You become a brilliant example of dedication and poise in battle, encouraging your allies to follow suit. When you spend this action, attempt a @Check[diplomacy|dc:@self.level|adjustment:-2|roller:self] check. The DC is usually an easy DC of your level, but the GM can assign a different DC based on the circumstances. The effect depends on the result of your check.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.er5tvDNvpbcnlbHQ]{Stance: Inspiring Marshal Stance}

Success Your marshal's aura grants you and allies a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and saves against mental effects.

Failure You fail to enter the stance.

Critical Failure You fail to enter the stance and can't take this action again for 1 minute.

_desc_en:
You become a brilliant example of dedication and poise in battle, encouraging your allies to follow suit. When you spend this action, attempt a @Check[diplomacy|dc:@self.level|adjustment:-2|roller:self] check. The DC is usually an easy DC of your level, but the GM can assign a different DC based on the circumstances. The effect depends on the result of your check.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.er5tvDNvpbcnlbHQ]{Stance: Inspiring Marshal Stance}

Success Your marshal's aura grants you and allies a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and saves against mental effects.

Failure You fail to enter the stance.

Critical Failure You fail to enter the stance and can't take this action again for 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
당신은 전투에서 헌신과 침착함의 빛나는 본보기가 되어 동료들이 따라하도록 고무합니다. 이 행동을 사용할 때, 외교 판정을 시도하십시오. DC는 일반적으로 당신의 레벨에 해당하는 쉬운 DC이지만, GM은 상황에 따라 다른 DC를 지정할 수 있습니다. 효과는 당신의 판정 결과에 따라 달라집니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.er5tvDNvpbcnlbHQ]{자세: 영감을 주는 마셜 자세}

성공 마셜의 오라가 당신과 아군에게 정신 효과에 대한 명중 굴림과 내성에 +1 상태 보너스를 부여합니다.

실패 자세를 취하는 데 실패했습니다.

대실패 자세를 취하는 데 실패했으며, 1분 동안 이 행동을 다시 취할 수 없습니다.

name: Challenge Insight

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger A creature you can see Casts a Spell that is from the divine or occult tradition.

Requirements The triggering caster must be able to hear and understand you.

Your deep grasp of the mystical lets you know exactly what to say to make others doubt how well they understand the source of their own power.

Attempt a counteract check against the triggering spell. Your counteract rank is half your level rounded up. You use your Occultism modifier as your counteract modifier if the triggering spell is from the occult tradition, or your Religion modifier if the triggering spell is from the divine tradition.

If you successfully counteract the spell, the caster becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until the end of their next turn.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger A creature you can see Casts a Spell that is from the divine or occult tradition.

Requirements The triggering caster must be able to hear and understand you.

Your deep grasp of the mystical lets you know exactly what to say to make others doubt how well they understand the source of their own power.

Attempt a counteract check against the triggering spell. Your counteract rank is half your level rounded up. You use your Occultism modifier as your counteract modifier if the triggering spell is from the occult tradition, or your Religion modifier if the triggering spell is from the divine tradition.

If you successfully counteract the spell, the caster becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until the end of their next turn.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 당신이 볼 수 있는 생물이 신성 또는 오컬트 전통의 주문을 시전한다.

요구 사항 발동하는 시전자는 당신의 말을 듣고 이해할 수 있어야 한다.

신비에 대한 깊은 이해로, 상대가 자신의 힘의 근원을 얼마나 잘 이해하는지 의심하게 만드는 말을 정확히 할 수 있습니다.

발동된 주문에 대해 반격 판정을 시도한다. 반격 랭크은 레벨의 절반을 올림한 수치이다. 발동된 주문이 오컬트 전통에 속할 경우 오컬트 수정자 수정을, 신성 전통에 속할 경우 종교 수정자 수정을 반격 수정자로 사용한다.

주문을 성공적으로 반격하면 시전자는 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.stupefied]{1} 상태가 된다.

name: Captain Dedication

description.value:
You become trained in your choice of Diplomacy or Intimidation; if you are already trained in both of these skills, you become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain your choice of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KpFetnUqTiweypZk]{Group Impression} or the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.gUqvezs2zzoTXFAI]{Group Coercion} skill feat. If you already have both of these skill feats, you gain another 1st-level skill feat for which you qualify.

You also gain the assistance of a dedicated follower, who has agreed to accompany you on your journeys. They have the minion trait and begin as a novice follower.

Special Once you have a follower, you can never take a feat or class feature that grants an animal companion or another companion that prevents you from having an animal companion.

value.value: you don't have an animal companion, construct companion, or other companion that functions similarly

_desc_en:
You become trained in your choice of Diplomacy or Intimidation; if you are already trained in both of these skills, you become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain your choice of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KpFetnUqTiweypZk]{Group Impression} or the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.gUqvezs2zzoTXFAI]{Group Coercion} skill feat. If you already have both of these skill feats, you gain another 1st-level skill feat for which you qualify.

You also gain the assistance of a dedicated follower, who has agreed to accompany you on your journeys. They have the minion trait and begin as a novice follower.

Special Once you have a follower, you can never take a feat or class feature that grants an animal companion or another companion that prevents you from having an animal companion.
_desc_ko:
당신은 외교 또는 협박술 중 하나를 선택하여 숙련됩니다. 이미 두 기술 모두 숙련된 경우, 원하는 기술 하나를 선택하여 숙련됩니다. 또한 @link[feats.group-impression] 또는 @link[feats.group-coercion] 기술 피트 중 하나를 선택하여 획득합니다. 이미 두 기술 피트를 모두 보유한 경우, 자격 요건을 충족하는 1레벨 기술 피트 하나를 추가로 획득합니다.

또한 당신을 따라다니기로 동의한 헌신적인 추종자의 도움을 받게 됩니다. 이 추종자는 하수인 특성을 가지며 초보자 추종자로 시작합니다.

특수 추종자를 얻은 후에는 동물 동료나 다른 동반자를 부여하는 재주나 클래스 피트를 절대 선택할 수 없습니다.

name: Immortal Bear

description.value: Your body thrums with the primal vitality of the greatest of the ursine beasts. When in Ursine Avenger Form, you gain fast healing 5.

_desc_en: Your body thrums with the primal vitality of the greatest of the ursine beasts. When in Ursine Avenger Form, you gain fast healing 5.
_desc_ko: 당신의 몸은 곰과 동물 중 가장 위대한 존재의 프라이멀 활력으로 진동합니다. 곰의 복수자 형태일 때, 빠른 치유 5를 얻습니다.

name: Patron's Whisper

description.value: You gain the ability to speak to your charge over great distances. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLzFcIaSXs7YTIqJ]{Message} as an innate cantrip of your former patron's tradition. You can send a message to a creature regardless of range if they have ever been your charge. If you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} as part of the message, the target receives a –2 circumstance penalty to their Perception DC and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} checks to reveal the lie.

_desc_en: You gain the ability to speak to your charge over great distances. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLzFcIaSXs7YTIqJ]{Message} as an innate cantrip of your former patron's tradition. You can send a message to a creature regardless of range if they have ever been your charge. If you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} as part of the message, the target receives a –2 circumstance penalty to their Perception DC and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} checks to reveal the lie.
_desc_ko: 당신은 먼 거리에서도 당신의 보호 대상과 대화할 수 있는 능력을 얻습니다. @link[spells.message]를 전 후원자의 전통에 속하는 선천적 캔트립으로 획득합니다. 대상이 과거 당신의 보호 대상이었다면 거리에 상관없이 메시지를 보낼 수 있습니다. 메시지에 @link[actions.lie]을 포함하면 대상은 지각 DC와 @link[actions.sense-motive] 판정에서 거짓말을 간파하는 데 -2 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Expert Red Mantis Magic

description.value: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

_desc_en: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.
_desc_ko: 전문적 주문 시전 혜택을 얻습니다.

name: Flame Jump

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Your peri lineage has opened your mind to fire's raw, purging essence.

You can spend 1 minute in focused preparation, then enter a fire your size or larger to instantly teleport to any fire that is your size or larger up to 5 miles away. You take no damage from entering or exiting fires when using this ability. Once you enter the fire, you instantly know the rough locations of other large fires within range and can exit from the original fire, if you prefer.

You can't carry extradimensional spaces with you when you teleport; if you attempt to do so, the activity fails.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Your peri lineage has opened your mind to fire's raw, purging essence.

You can spend 1 minute in focused preparation, then enter a fire your size or larger to instantly teleport to any fire that is your size or larger up to 5 miles away. You take no damage from entering or exiting fires when using this ability. Once you enter the fire, you instantly know the rough locations of other large fires within range and can exit from the original fire, if you prefer.

You can't carry extradimensional spaces with you when you teleport; if you attempt to do so, the activity fails.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신의 페리 혈통은 불의 원초적이고 정화하는 본질에 대한 당신의 마음을 열었습니다.

1분간 포커스 준비 후, 본인의 크기 이상인 불 속으로 들어가면 최대 5마일 이내의 동일 크기 이상 불로 즉시 순간이동할 수 있습니다. 이 능력을 사용할 때 불 속으로 들어가거나 나올 때 피해를 입지 않습니다. 불 속으로 들어가면 즉시 범위 내 다른 대형 불의 대략적인 위치를 파악할 수 있으며, 원한다면 원래 불에서 나올 수도 있습니다.

순간이동 시 초차원 공간을 함께 운반할 수 없습니다. 시도할 경우 실패합니다.

name: Remove Presence

description.value:
Your spell reaches into the mind of a creature and removes you from it. The amped cantrip must be one that has one or more targets and must either require a spell attack roll or have a saving throw. Use this amp in place of the psi cantrip's normal amp entry.

Amp Choose one target of the spell or one creature in its area. If that enemy fails its save or the spell hits it, you become undetected by that creature, disappearing from its senses for 1 minute or until you use a hostile action. This is similar to being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, but effects like see the unseen don't reveal you-you're affecting the target's mind, not its vision. Truesight can still see through this illusion if the counteract check succeeds.

_desc_en:
Your spell reaches into the mind of a creature and removes you from it. The amped cantrip must be one that has one or more targets and must either require a spell attack roll or have a saving throw. Use this amp in place of the psi cantrip's normal amp entry.

Amp Choose one target of the spell or one creature in its area. If that enemy fails its save or the spell hits it, you become undetected by that creature, disappearing from its senses for 1 minute or until you use a hostile action. This is similar to being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, but effects like see the unseen don't reveal you-you're affecting the target's mind, not its vision. Truesight can still see through this illusion if the counteract check succeeds.
_desc_ko:
당신의 주문이 생물의 정신에 침투하여 당신을 그곳에서 제거합니다. 강화된 캔트립은 하나 이상의 대상이 있어야 하며, 명중 굴림이 필요하거나 내성 굴림이 있어야 합니다. 이 앰프는 사이 캔트립의 일반 앰프 항목 대신 사용하십시오.

앰프 주문 대상 중 하나 또는 그 범위 내의 생물 하나를 선택한다. 해당 적이 내성에 실패하거나 주문이 명중하면, 당신은 그 생물에게 감지되지 않게 되어 1분 동안 또는 적대적 행동을 취할 때까지 그 생물의 감각에서 사라진다. 이는 @link[conditions.invisible] 상태와 유사하지만, 투명화 감지 같은 효과로는 드러나지 않습니다. 대상의 시각이 아닌 정신에 영향을 미치는 것이기 때문입니다. 진실의 시야는 이 환상을 꿰뚫어 볼 수 있으며, 반격 판정이 성공할 경우에도 마찬가지다.

name: Scoundrel's Surprise

description.value: You drop your disguise at the right moment and surprise your target. After you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} someone else using a disguise kit, you can remove your disguise with a dramatic gesture. Any creatures that previously failed to see through your disguise are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the next attack you make before the end of your turn.

_desc_en: You drop your disguise at the right moment and surprise your target. After you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} someone else using a disguise kit, you can remove your disguise with a dramatic gesture. Any creatures that previously failed to see through your disguise are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the next attack you make before the end of your turn.
_desc_ko: 적절한 순간에 변장을 풀고 상대를 기습한다. 변장 키트로 다른 사람을 @link[actions.impersonate]한 후, 극적인 제스처로 변장을 해제할 수 있다. 당신의 변장을 간파하지 못했던 모든 생물은 당신의 턴이 끝나기 전까지 당신이 가하는 다음 공격에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard]가 된다.

name: Inspiring Recitation

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You quietly speak or recall coded phrases and metaphors whose meanings inspire you to complete your mission. You gain a +1 status bonus to one skill of your choice until the beginning of your next turn. You can Sustain this effect for up to 1 minute. If you're an expert in Performance, the bonus increases to +2. If you're a master in Performance, the bonus is +3, and if you're legendary, the bonus is +4.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

You quietly speak or recall coded phrases and metaphors whose meanings inspire you to complete your mission. You gain a +1 status bonus to one skill of your choice until the beginning of your next turn. You can Sustain this effect for up to 1 minute. If you're an expert in Performance, the bonus increases to +2. If you're a master in Performance, the bonus is +3, and if you're legendary, the bonus is +4.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 시간당 1회

당신은 조용히 암기된 암호화된 문구와 은유를 말하거나 떠올리며, 그 의미가 당신의 임무 완수를 고무시킵니다. 다음 차례 시작까지 선택한 한 가지 기술에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 효과는 최대 1분 동안 지속할 수 있습니다. 공연 기술에 숙련자라면 보너스가 +2로 증가합니다. 공연 기술에 달인이라면 보너스는 +3, 전설적인 수준이라면 보너스는 +4입니다.

name: Seasoned Command

description.value:
Allies intuitively follow your orders. Choose an ally within 30 feet and then attempt a Diplomacy or Intimidation check against a hard DC for that ally's level. This counts as a preparatory action to Aid that ally. Regardless of your result, the ally is then temporarily immune to your further uses of Seasoned Command for 1 minute.

Critical Success You immediately gain an additional reaction that can be used only to Aid the chosen ally, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your skill check or attack roll to Aid.

Success As critical success, but you don't gain the circumstance bonus.

Failure You don't gain an additional reaction.

Special Once per hour, you can Take the Lead of a troop as a free action (rather than 2 actions). Outside of combat, you can establish leadership of a troop and grant a skirmish bond in half the normal time (5 minutes and 4 hours, respectively).

value.value: master in either Diplomacy or Intimidation

_desc_en:
Allies intuitively follow your orders. Choose an ally within 30 feet and then attempt a Diplomacy or Intimidation check against a hard DC for that ally's level. This counts as a preparatory action to Aid that ally. Regardless of your result, the ally is then temporarily immune to your further uses of Seasoned Command for 1 minute.

Critical Success You immediately gain an additional reaction that can be used only to Aid the chosen ally, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your skill check or attack roll to Aid.

Success As critical success, but you don't gain the circumstance bonus.

Failure You don't gain an additional reaction.

Special Once per hour, you can Take the Lead of a troop as a free action (rather than 2 actions). Outside of combat, you can establish leadership of a troop and grant a skirmish bond in half the normal time (5 minutes and 4 hours, respectively).
_desc_ko:
아군들이 직관적으로 당신의 명령을 따른다. 30피트 이내의 아군 하나를 선택한 다음, 그 아군의 레벨에 대한 어려운 DC를 상대로 외교나 위협 판정을 시도한다. 이는 그 아군을 지원하기 위한 준비 행동으로 간주한다. 결과와 관계없이, 그 아군은 1분 동안 당신의 노련한 지휘를 추가로 사용하는 것에 대해 일시적으로 면역이 된다.

대성공 당신은 즉시 선택한 아군을 지원하는 데에만 사용할 수 있는 추가 반응을 얻고, 지원을 위한 기술 판정이나 명중 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻는다.

성공 대성공과 같지만, 상황 보너스를 얻지 못한다.

실패 추가 반응을 얻지 못한다.

특별 시간당 1회, 당신은 (2행동 대신) 자유 행동으로 부대의 선두에 설 수 있다. 전투 밖에서는, 부대에 대한 지휘권을 확립하고 교전 유대를 부여하는 것을 절반의 시간(각각 5분과 4시간)에 할 수 있다.

name: Winged Warrior Dedication

description.value:
Through rigorous training, you have strengthened your wings, granting you enough thrust to gain additional altitude. When you make a horizontal @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, increase the distance by 10 feet up to a maximum of your Speed. Any fly Speed granted by ancestry feats and other permanent wings increases by 5 feet.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.uewu2vWQluT8Jyf1]{Winged Warrior}

value.value: you have permanent wings (such as from an ancestry or graft)

Through rigorous training, you have strengthened your wings, granting you enough thrust to gain additional altitude. When you make a horizontal @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, increase the distance by 10 feet up to a maximum of your Speed. Any fly Speed granted by ancestry feats and other permanent wings increases by 5 feet.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.uewu2vWQluT8Jyf1]{Winged Warrior}
_desc_ko: 엄격한 훈련을 통해 날개를 강화하여 추가 고도를 얻을 수 있는 충분한 추력을 얻었다. 수평 @link[actions.leap]을 할 때, 최대 이동 속도까지 거리를 10피트 증가시킵니다. 조상 재주나 영구적인 날개로 부여받은 비행 속도는 5피트 증가합니다.

name: Ensnaring Disarm

description.value:
Trigger Your last action was a critical success to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}.

Requirements Your student is within 15 feet of the Disarmed creature.

You smack your foe's item out of their hand so that your student can grab it. Instead of the item falling to the ground in the target's space, you aim your blow to send the disarmed item flying, allowing your student to immediately catch it as a free action; they must have a free hand to do so.

_desc_en:
Trigger Your last action was a critical success to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}.

Requirements Your student is within 15 feet of the Disarmed creature.

You smack your foe's item out of their hand so that your student can grab it. Instead of the item falling to the ground in the target's space, you aim your blow to send the disarmed item flying, allowing your student to immediately catch it as a free action; they must have a free hand to do so.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 마지막 행동이 @link[actions.disarm]에 대한 대성공이었습니다.

요구 사항 제자가 무장 해제된 생물로부터 15피트 이내에 위치해 있어야 합니다.

당신은 적의 손에서 아이템을 쳐내어 제자가 붙잡기를 가능하게 합니다. 대상의 공간에 아이템이 떨어지는 대신, 당신은 무장 해제된 아이템이 날아가도록 타격을 조준하여 제자가 즉시 무료 행동으로 잡을 수 있게 합니다. 제자는 이를 위해 빈 손을 사용해야 합니다.

name: Hunted Shot

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a ranged weapon with reload 0.

You take two quick shots against the one you hunt. Make two Strikes against your hunted prey with the required weapon. If both hit the same creature, combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses. Apply your multiple attack penalty to each Strike normally.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a ranged weapon with reload 0.

You take two quick shots against the one you hunt. Make two Strikes against your hunted prey with the required weapon. If both hit the same creature, combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses. Apply your multiple attack penalty to each Strike normally.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 재장전 0의 원거리 무기를 장비하고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 사냥하는 대상에게 두 번의 신속 사격을 가합니다. 요구되는 무기로 사냥감에게 두 번의 타격을 가하세요. 두 타격이 같은 생물에게 명중하면, 저항과 약점을 계산할 때 두 타격의 피해를 합산합니다. 다중 공격 페널티는 각 타격에 정상적으로 적용하세요.

name: Usurp the Lunar Reins

description.value:
The moon has always been connected to the tides, and now you can grasp that connection. You can create massive amounts of water and control these tides, subverting even the moon's sovereignty over the oceans and seas. Choose an area @Template[square|distance:50]{50 feet long by 50 feet wide} within 500 feet, and choose two different effects from the options provided below. The effects take place in the listed order.

  • Flood You create a pool of pure, clean water in the area, which coalesces from ambient moisture. This water must be created on a surface-not in air-and flows normally.
  • Control You tug on the moon to raise or lower the level of bodies of water in the area by 10 feet. If you control a portion of a larger body of water, the water then equalizes normally.
  • Modulate With a wave of your hand, you create or smooth ripples, making all bodies of water in the area either calm or turbulent. Making it calm turns difficult terrain or greater difficult terrain to calm water, and making it turbulent turns calm water into difficult terrain.
  • Slow By exercising your rightful control over all water, each creature with the water trait in the area must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:kineticist] save against your class DC or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} on a critical failure).

Flood and control are permanent and non-magical. Modulate and slow last until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain the impulse to continue them.

You can create massive amounts of water and control these tides, subverting even the moon's sovereignty over the oceans and seas. Choose an area @Template[square|distance:50]{50 feet long by 50 feet wide} within 500 feet, and choose two different effects from the options provided below. The effects take place in the listed order.

  • Control You tug on the moon to raise or lower the level of bodies of water in the area by 10 feet. If you control a portion of a larger body of water, the water then equalizes normally.
  • Modulate With a wave of your hand, you create or smooth ripples, making all bodies of water in the area either calm or turbulent. Making it calm turns difficult terrain or greater difficult terrain to calm water, and making it turbulent turns calm water into difficult terrain.
  • Slow By exercising your rightful control over all water, each creature with the water trait in the area must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:kineticist] save against your class DC or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} on a critical failure).

Flood and control are permanent and non-magical. Modulate and slow last until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain the impulse to continue them.
_desc_ko:
달은 항상 조수와 연결되어 왔으며, 이제 그 연결을 장악할 수 있다. 거대한 양의 물을 생성하고 이 조수를 제어하여 달이 바다와 해양에 행사하는 지배권마저 뒤엎을 수 있다. 500피트 이내의 영역 50피트를 선택하고, 아래 제공된 옵션 중 서로 다른 두 가지 효과를 선택한다. 효과는 나열된 순서대로 발생한다.

  • 홍수 해당 지역에 주변 수증기가 응결되어 맑고 깨끗한 물웅덩이를 생성한다. 이 물은 공중이 아닌 지표면에 생성되어야 하며 정상적으로 흐른다.
  • 조절 달을 잡아당겨 해당 지역의 수위를 10피트 올리거나 내립니다. 더 큰 수역의 일부를 조절할 경우, 물은 정상적으로 수위가 균등해집니다.
  • 조절 손짓 하나로 물결을 일으키거나 잔잔하게 하여, 해당 지역의 모든 수역을 고요하게 하거나 요동치게 합니다. 고요하게 하면 어려운 지형이나 매우 어려운 지형이 잔잔한 물로 변하고, 요동치게 하면 잔잔한 물이 어려운 지형으로 변합니다.
  • Slow 모든 물에 대한 정당한 통제권을 행사함으로써, 해당 지역의 물 속성을 가진 모든 생물은 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 인내 저항에 성공해야 하며, 그렇지 않으면 @link[conditions.slowed]{1} 상태가 됩니다(대실패 시 @link[conditions.slowed]{2} 상태).

홍수와 통제는 영구적이며 비마법적입니다. 변조와 감속은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 지속되지만, 지속 임펄스를 사용해 계속할 수 있습니다.

name: Living Monolith Dedication

description.value:
Access You are from the Golden Road region.

You've begun to inscribe a magical stone called a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.C9VvYnjbWertzgMc]{Ka Stone} that you will some day tie to your soul. You gain knowledge of Ancient Osirion and a connection to your nascent ka stone. If you fail a recovery check while dying, your dying condition does not increase; if you critically fail, your dying condition increases by only 1. You become trained in Ancient Osirion Lore, or expert if you were already trained.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.PpoPRKuwanrnhd0Y]{Living Monolith} archetype.

_desc_en:
Access You are from the Golden Road region.

You've begun to inscribe a magical stone called a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.C9VvYnjbWertzgMc]{Ka Stone} that you will some day tie to your soul. You gain knowledge of Ancient Osirion and a connection to your nascent ka stone. If you fail a recovery check while dying, your dying condition does not increase; if you critically fail, your dying condition increases by only 1. You become trained in Ancient Osirion Lore, or expert if you were already trained.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.PpoPRKuwanrnhd0Y]{Living Monolith} archetype.
_desc_ko:
접근 당신은 황금길 지역 출신이다.

어느 날 당신의 영혼과 연결될 @link[equipment.ka-stone]이라 불리는 마법석을 새기기 시작했습니다. 고대 오시리온에 대한 지식과 갓 태어난 카 스톤과의 연결을 얻습니다. 죽어가는 상태에서 회복 판정 실패 시, 죽어가는 상태가 증가하지 않습니다. 대실패할 경우, 죽어가는 상태가 1만 증가합니다. 고대 오시리온 지식에 숙련되거나, 이미 숙련 상태였다면 전문가가 됩니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.PpoPRKuwanrnhd0Y]{살아있는 거석} 아키타입.

name: Feverish Enzymes

description.value:
Your claws and fangs exude an infectious enzyme, related to the necrotic effects of ghoul fever, that causes a creature's wounds to heal slowly. Strike with your claw or jaws. This attack deals void damage instead of its normal type; on a hit, the target halves any healing it receives until the start of your next turn. The target or an adjacent ally can spend two interact actions to squeeze the enzymes from the wound and remove the effect.

If you are satiated, when you hit you can choose to end your satiation and boost your enzymes, increasing the duration to 1 minute.

_desc_en:
Your claws and fangs exude an infectious enzyme, related to the necrotic effects of ghoul fever, that causes a creature's wounds to heal slowly. Strike with your claw or jaws. This attack deals void damage instead of its normal type; on a hit, the target halves any healing it receives until the start of your next turn. The target or an adjacent ally can spend two interact actions to squeeze the enzymes from the wound and remove the effect.

If you are satiated, when you hit you can choose to end your satiation and boost your enzymes, increasing the duration to 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
당신의 발톱과 송곳니는 구울 열병의 괴사 효과와 관련된 감염성 효소를 분비하여 생물의 상처가 느리게 치유되게 합니다. 발톱이나 턱으로 공격하세요. 이 공격은 정상적인 유형 대신 공허 피해를 입힙니다. 명중 시, 대상은 다음 턴 시작까지 받는 치유 효과를 절반으로 줄입니다. 대상이나 인접한 아군은 상호작용 행동 2개를 소모해 상처에서 효소를 짜내 효과를 제거할 수 있다.

포만 상태일 때 적중 시 포만 상태를 해제하고 효소 효과를 강화해 지속 시간을 1분으로 늘릴 수 있다.

name: Swift Tracker

description.value:
Your keen eyes catch signs of passage even when you're moving. You can move at your full Speed while you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track}. If you have master proficiency in Survival, you don't need to attempt a new Survival check every hour while Tracking. If you have legendary proficiency in Survival, you can use another exploration activity while Tracking.

If you roll Survival for initiative while tracking your hunted prey, when you start your first turn of the encounter, you can Stride toward your hunted prey as a free action.

_desc_en:
Your keen eyes catch signs of passage even when you're moving. You can move at your full Speed while you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track}. If you have master proficiency in Survival, you don't need to attempt a new Survival check every hour while Tracking. If you have legendary proficiency in Survival, you can use another exploration activity while Tracking.

If you roll Survival for initiative while tracking your hunted prey, when you start your first turn of the encounter, you can Stride toward your hunted prey as a free action.
_desc_ko:
움직이는 중에도 예리한 눈으로 흔적을 포착한다. 추적 중에도 @link[actions.track] 시 최대 이동 속도로 이동할 수 있습니다. 생존 기술 달인을 가진 경우, 추적 중 매시간 생존 판정을 시도할 필요가 없습니다. 생존 기술에 전설적 숙련도를 가진 경우, 추적 중 다른 탐사 활동을 병행할 수 있습니다.

추적 중인 사냥감을 상대로 이니셔티브를 결정하기 위해 생존 능력 검사를 굴릴 때, 해당 교전 첫 턴 시작 시 자유 행동으로 사냥감을 향해 이동할 수 있습니다.

name: Spiteful Rake

description.value:
Requirements You have both hands free.

Your instincts sing of spite and malice, and you've learned a devastating trick: go for the eyes. You make a claw Strike. If you hit and deal damage, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round. On a critical hit, the target is instead @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round and dazzled until restored to maximum hit points.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have both hands free.

Your instincts sing of spite and malice, and you've learned a devastating trick: go for the eyes. You make a claw Strike. If you hit and deal damage, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round. On a critical hit, the target is instead @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round and dazzled until restored to maximum hit points.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손이 자유로워야 합니다.

당신의 본능은 악의와 증오로 가득 차 있으며, 치명적인 기술을 익혔습니다: 눈을 노리세요. 발톱 공격을 가합니다. 명중하여 피해를 입히면, 대상은 @link[conditions.dazzled] 상태가 1라운드 동안 지속됩니다. 치명타 시, 대상은 대신 @link[conditions.blinded] 상태가 1라운드 지속되며, 최대 HP 회복 시까지 눈부심 상태가 유지됩니다.

name: Assured Knowledge

description.value:
You can procure information with confidence. Whenever you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} using any skill (including Bardic Lore), you can forgo rolling your check to instead receive a result of 10 + your proficiency bonus (don't apply any other bonuses, penalties, or modifiers).

As long as you are an expert in a skill, you meet the prerequisites for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.H3I2X0f7v4EzwxuN]{Automatic Knowledge} skill feat in that skill, even if you don't have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]{Assurance} in that skill.

_desc_en:
You can procure information with confidence. Whenever you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} using any skill (including Bardic Lore), you can forgo rolling your check to instead receive a result of 10 + your proficiency bonus (don't apply any other bonuses, penalties, or modifiers).

As long as you are an expert in a skill, you meet the prerequisites for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.H3I2X0f7v4EzwxuN]{Automatic Knowledge} skill feat in that skill, even if you don't have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]{Assurance} in that skill.
_desc_ko:
당신은 확신을 가지고 정보를 입수할 수 있습니다. 어떤 기술(바드 지식 포함)로 @link[actions.recall-knowledge]을 사용할 때마다, 판정 주사위를 굴리지 않고 대신 숙련 보너스 +10의 결과를 받을 수 있습니다(다른 보너스, 페널티, 수정자는 적용하지 않습니다).

특정 기술에 숙련자라면, 해당 기술에 @link[feats.assurance] 피트를 보유하지 않더라도 @link[feats.automatic-knowledge] 기술 피트의 전제 조건을 충족합니다.

name: Read the Dust

description.value:
Trigger an undead creature is reduced to zero Hit Points or a haunt is disabled within 60 feet of you

You watch the creature or hazard as it collapses, careful for any sign it may return. You immediately learn if the creature or hazard has an ability that will restore it, like rejuvenation or a haunt's reset.

If it can return, you also learn the time span before its return and how to prevent that return in broad terms, such as "lay its body to rest" or "destroy its armor." If this requires any people or objects that aren't already present, you also learn the direction towards each missing piece from the dust's movement.

_desc_en:
Trigger an undead creature is reduced to zero Hit Points or a haunt is disabled within 60 feet of you

You watch the creature or hazard as it collapses, careful for any sign it may return. You immediately learn if the creature or hazard has an ability that will restore it, like rejuvenation or a haunt's reset.

If it can return, you also learn the time span before its return and how to prevent that return in broad terms, such as "lay its body to rest" or "destroy its armor." If this requires any people or objects that aren't already present, you also learn the direction towards each missing piece from the dust's movement.
_desc_ko:
발동 60피트 이내에서 언데드 생물이 HP가 0이 되거나 유령이 무력화될 때

당신은 생물이나 위험 요소가 무너지는 모습을 지켜보며, 그것이 되살아날 징후가 있는지 주의 깊게 살핀다. 당신은 즉시 그 생물이나 위험 요소가 재생 능력(예: 재생을 통한 회복이나 유령의 재설정)을 가지고 있는지 알게 된다.

복귀가 가능하다면, 복귀까지의 시간 간격과 "시신을 안장하라" 또는 "갑옷을 파괴하라"와 같은 광범위한 복귀 방지 방법도 알게 된다. 이를 위해 현장에 없는 특정 인물이나 물건 이 필요하다면, 먼지의 움직임으로부터 각 부족한 요소의 방향도 파악한다.

name: Chorus Companion

description.value: Animals can be musical partners as much as the subjects or audience. Your animal companion becomes trained in Performance (or expert if it was already trained). When you cast a composition spell, you can have it originate either from you or from your animal companion, if your animal companion is within 30 feet of you.

_desc_en: Animals can be musical partners as much as the subjects or audience. Your animal companion becomes trained in Performance (or expert if it was already trained). When you cast a composition spell, you can have it originate either from you or from your animal companion, if your animal companion is within 30 feet of you.
_desc_ko: 동물은 주체나 청중만큼이나 음악적 동반자가 될 수 있습니다. 당신의 동물 동료는 연주 기술 훈련을 받게 됩니다(이미 훈련된 경우 숙련). 당신이 작곡 주문을 시전할 때, 동물 동료가 당신으로부터 30피트 이내에 있다면 그 주문을 당신이나 동물 동료 중 한 쪽에서 발원하도록 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Efficient Alchemy (Alchemist)

description.value:
Thanks to the time you've spent studying and experimenting, you know how to scale your formulas into larger batches that don't require any additional attention. Increase the number of items you can create each day with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Pe0zmIqyTBc2Td0I]{Advanced Alchemy} to 6 + your Intelligence modifier.

In addition, when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} alchemical consumables during downtime, you can produce twice as many alchemical items in a single batch without spending additional preparatory time. For instance, if you are creating @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.hDLbR56Id2OtU318]{Elixirs of Life}, you can craft up to eight elixirs in a single batch using downtime, rather than four. This doesn't change the amount of alchemical reagents or other ingredients required to craft each item, nor does it change your rate of progress for days past the base downtime spent.

_desc_en:
Thanks to the time you've spent studying and experimenting, you know how to scale your formulas into larger batches that don't require any additional attention. Increase the number of items you can create each day with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Pe0zmIqyTBc2Td0I]{Advanced Alchemy} to 6 + your Intelligence modifier.

In addition, when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} alchemical consumables during downtime, you can produce twice as many alchemical items in a single batch without spending additional preparatory time. For instance, if you are creating @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.hDLbR56Id2OtU318]{Elixirs of Life}, you can craft up to eight elixirs in a single batch using downtime, rather than four. This doesn't change the amount of alchemical reagents or other ingredients required to craft each item, nor does it change your rate of progress for days past the base downtime spent.
_desc_ko:
연구와 실험에 쏟은 시간 덕분에, 추가적인 주의 없이도 더 큰 배치로 공식을 확장하는 방법을 알게 되었습니다. @link[feats.advanced-alchemy]로 하루에 제작할 수 있는 아이템 수를 6 + 지능 수정자 수정치로 증가시킵니다.

또한 다운타임 동안 @link[actions.craft]으로 연금술 소모품을 만들 때, 추가 준비 시간 없이 한 번에 두 배의 연금술 아이템을 생산할 수 있습니다. 예를 들어 @link[equipment.elixir-of-life-minor]을 제작할 경우, 다운타임 사용 시 한 번에 최대 8개까지 제작할 수 있습니다(기존 4개에서 증가). 이는 각 아이템 제작에 필요한 연금술 시약이나 기타 재료의 양을 변경하지 않으며, 기본 다운타임 소모 이후의 진행 속도에도 영향을 미치지 않습니다.

name: Ricochet Shot

description.value: You bounce your shot off a nearby surface to strike your opponent from an unexpected angle. Attempt a Strike with a firearm or crossbow. When determining whether a target has cover from this Strike, you can choose one solid surface within your weapon's first range increment to ricochet your shot off of. If you do, you determine the target's cover from the point where you ricochet your shot instead of from you.

_desc_en: You bounce your shot off a nearby surface to strike your opponent from an unexpected angle. Attempt a Strike with a firearm or crossbow. When determining whether a target has cover from this Strike, you can choose one solid surface within your weapon's first range increment to ricochet your shot off of. If you do, you determine the target's cover from the point where you ricochet your shot instead of from you.
_desc_ko: 근처 표면에 탄환을 튕겨 예상치 못한 각도로 적을 강타합니다. 화기나 석궁으로 공격을 시도하세요. 이 공격으로 표적이 엄폐를 얻는지 판단할 때, 무기의 첫 사거리 구간 내 단단한 표면 하나를 선택해 탄환을 튕길 수 있습니다. 이 경우, 표적의 엄폐 여부는 당신 위치가 아닌 탄환이 반사된 지점을 기준으로 판단합니다.

name: Continual Recovery

description.value: You zealously monitor a patient's progress to administer treatment faster. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}, your patient becomes immune for only 10 minutes instead of 1 hour. This applies only to your Treat Wounds activities, not any other the patient receives.

_desc_en: You zealously monitor a patient's progress to administer treatment faster. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}, your patient becomes immune for only 10 minutes instead of 1 hour. This applies only to your Treat Wounds activities, not any other the patient receives.
_desc_ko: 당신은 치료를 더 빨리 시행하기 위해 환자의 상태를 꼼꼼히 모니터합니다. 당신이 @link[actions.treat-wounds]를 할 때, 환자는 1시간이 아닌 10분 동안만 면역 상태가 됩니다. 이는 당신의 상처 치료 활동에만 적용되며, 환자가 받는 다른 치료에는 적용되지 않습니다.

name: Feather Step

description.value: You step carefully and quickly. You can Step into difficult terrain.

_desc_en: You step carefully and quickly. You can Step into difficult terrain.
_desc_ko: 당신은 조심스럽고 빠르게 발걸음을 옮깁니다. 어려운 지형 속으로 발을 들여놓을 수 있습니다.

name: Skill Mastery

description.value:
Rogue: Increase your proficiency rank in one of your skills from expert to master and in another of your skills from trained to expert. You gain a skill feat associated with one of the skills you chose; you must meet all its prerequisites.

Investigator: Increase your proficiency rank in one of your skills from expert to master and in another of your skills from trained to expert. You gain a skill feat associated with one of the skills you chose.

Special You can select this feat up to five times.

value.value: trained in at least one skill and expert in at least one skill

_desc_en:
Rogue: Increase your proficiency rank in one of your skills from expert to master and in another of your skills from trained to expert. You gain a skill feat associated with one of the skills you chose; you must meet all its prerequisites.

Investigator: Increase your proficiency rank in one of your skills from expert to master and in another of your skills from trained to expert. You gain a skill feat associated with one of the skills you chose.

Special You can select this feat up to five times.
_desc_ko:
도적: 당신의 기술 중 하나의 숙련도를 전문가에서 달인으로, 또 다른 기술 하나의 숙련도를 숙련에서 전문가로 올린다. 당신은 선택한 기술 중 하나와 관련된 기술 재주를 얻으며, 그 모든 선행 조건을 충족해야 한다.

수사관: 당신의 기술 중 하나의 숙련도를 전문가에서 달인으로, 또 다른 기술 하나의 숙련도를 숙련에서 전문가로 올린다. 당신은 선택한 기술 중 하나와 관련된 기술 재주를 얻는다.

특별 이 재주는 최대 다섯 번까지 선택할 수 있다.

name: Furious Bully

description.value: You bully foes across the battlefield. While raging, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks for attack actions.

_desc_en: You bully foes across the battlefield. While raging, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks for attack actions.
_desc_ko: 전장에서 적들을 위협합니다. 분노 상태일 때 공격 행동에 대한 운동 판정에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Just the Tool

description.value: You temporarily change your weapon's shape to assist you in the field. You morph your weapon into a single simple tool, such as a shovel or crowbar, to help with a mundane task. You can't replicate entire toolkits with this ability. You can use this action again to change your mind weapon back to a weapon.

_desc_en: You temporarily change your weapon's shape to assist you in the field. You morph your weapon into a single simple tool, such as a shovel or crowbar, to help with a mundane task. You can't replicate entire toolkits with this ability. You can use this action again to change your mind weapon back to a weapon.
_desc_ko: 전장에서 도움을 받기 위해 무기의 형태를 일시적으로 바꿉니다. 삽이나 지렛대 같은 단순한 도구 하나로 무기를 변형시켜 일상적인 작업을 수행합니다. 이 능력으로 전체 공구 세트를 복제할 수는 없습니다. 이 행동을 다시 사용해 무기로 변형된 무기를 원래 무기로 되돌릴 수 있습니다.

name: Bolera's Interrogation

description.value:
Frequency Three times per day

You focus your attention on a single creature within 30 feet. That creature must attempt a @Check[will|against:perception] save against your Perception DC. On a failure, the creature finds itself unable to speak any deliberate and intentional lies and takes a -2 penalty to Deception checks. On a critical failure, the penalty to Deception checks is -4. This effect lasts for 10 minutes as long as you are within 30 feet of the target and the target is aware that you are using the ability against it. If you begin a new interrogation, this effect ends for any previous target. After your interrogation ends, the target is immune to this ability for 24 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.bmVwaN0C4e9fE2Sz]{Effect: Bolera's Interrogation}

publication.title: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace

_desc_en:
Frequency Three times per day

You focus your attention on a single creature within 30 feet. That creature must attempt a @Check[will|against:perception] save against your Perception DC. On a failure, the creature finds itself unable to speak any deliberate and intentional lies and takes a -2 penalty to Deception checks. On a critical failure, the penalty to Deception checks is -4. This effect lasts for 10 minutes as long as you are within 30 feet of the target and the target is aware that you are using the ability against it. If you begin a new interrogation, this effect ends for any previous target. After your interrogation ends, the target is immune to this ability for 24 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.bmVwaN0C4e9fE2Sz]{Effect: Bolera's Interrogation}
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 세 번

당신은 30피트 내의 단일 생물에게 주의를 집중합니다. 해당 생물은 당신의 지각 DC에 대한 의지 저항 검사를 시도해야 합니다. 실패 시, 해당 생물은 의도적이고 고의적인 거짓말을 할 수 없게 되며 기만 판정에서 -2 페널티를 받습니다. 대실패 시 기만 판정 페널티는 -4입니다. 이 효과는 당신이 대상과 30피트 이내에 있고 대상이 당신이 이 능력을 사용 중임을 인지하는 한 10분간 지속됩니다. 새로운 심문을 시작하면 이전 대상에 대한 이 효과는 종료됩니다. 심문이 끝난 후 대상은 24시간 동안 이 능력에 면역됩니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.bmVwaN0C4e9fE2Sz]{효과: 볼레라의 심문}

name: Big Mouth

description.value: Instead of storing up to four items of Light Bulk in your cheek pouches, you can store up to 1 Bulk worth of items. The maximum size of a given item is unchanged.

_desc_en: Instead of storing up to four items of Light Bulk in your cheek pouches, you can store up to 1 Bulk worth of items. The maximum size of a given item is unchanged.
_desc_ko: 뺨 주머니에 최대 4개의 경량 벌크 아이템을 보관하는 대신, 최대 1벌크 상당의 아이템을 보관할 수 있습니다. 개별 아이템의 최대 크기는 변하지 않습니다.

name: Healing Sanctuary

description.value:
When you call upon your deity's power, you also radiate a sense of safety that fortifies your allies. An ally who begins their turn in your Shield the Faithful aura gains 10 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.QKpx9S3JeIMeqFnw]{Effect: Healing Sanctuary}

_desc_en:
When you call upon your deity's power, you also radiate a sense of safety that fortifies your allies. An ally who begins their turn in your Shield the Faithful aura gains 10 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.QKpx9S3JeIMeqFnw]{Effect: Healing Sanctuary}
_desc_ko:
당신이 신의 힘을 부를 때, 동료를 강화하는 안전감도 함께 발산합니다. 당신의 신앙의 방패 오라 안에 턴을 시작하는 동료는 1라운드 동안 지속되는 임시 HP 10을 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.QKpx9S3JeIMeqFnw]{효과: 치유의 성역}

name: Scattered Fire

description.value: When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{Fireball}, you can modify its area to be two non-overlapping @Template[burst|distance:10]{10-foot bursts}.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en: When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{Fireball}, you can modify its area to be two non-overlapping @Template[burst|distance:10]{10-foot bursts}.
_desc_ko: 당신이 @link[spells.fireball]를 시전할 때, 그 범위는 겹치지 않는 두 개의 10피트로 수정자가 될 수 있습니다.

name: Interposing Crowd

description.value: Your enemies can't stop you when there's a host of people between you. Your movement actions don't trigger reactions as long as you remain in a crowd for the entire duration of the action.

_desc_en: Your enemies can't stop you when there's a host of people between you. Your movement actions don't trigger reactions as long as you remain in a crowd for the entire duration of the action.
_desc_ko: 당신과 적 사이에 수많은 사람들이 있을 때, 적들은 당신을 막을 수 없습니다. 행동 전체 동안 군중 속에 머무르는 한, 당신의 이동 행동은 반응을 유발하지 않습니다.

name: Predictable!

description.value:
By observing an opponent, you can get a sense of their next move and prepare to counter or resist it. Choose one target and attempt a Perception check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} against the foe's Deception DC or a hard DC of the foe's level, whichever is higher.

Critical Success You precisely discern the target's strategy, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the creature until the start of your next turn and a +2 circumstance bonus to your next saving throw against the creature before the start of your next turn.

Success You deduce the gist of the target's strategy; as critical success, except the circumstance bonus is only +1.

Failure You fail to discern the target's strategy and gain no benefit.

Critical Failure You misinterpret the target's strategy and take a –1 circumstance penalty to AC against the creature until the start of your next turn, and a –1 circumstance penalty to your next saving throw against the creature before the start of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.5v0ndPPMfZwhiVZF]{Effect: Predictable!}

_desc_en:
By observing an opponent, you can get a sense of their next move and prepare to counter or resist it. Choose one target and attempt a Perception check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} against the foe's Deception DC or a hard DC of the foe's level, whichever is higher.

Critical Success You precisely discern the target's strategy, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the creature until the start of your next turn and a +2 circumstance bonus to your next saving throw against the creature before the start of your next turn.

Success You deduce the gist of the target's strategy; as critical success, except the circumstance bonus is only +1.

Failure You fail to discern the target's strategy and gain no benefit.

Critical Failure You misinterpret the target's strategy and take a –1 circumstance penalty to AC against the creature until the start of your next turn, and a –1 circumstance penalty to your next saving throw against the creature before the start of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.5v0ndPPMfZwhiVZF]{Effect: Predictable!}
_desc_ko:
상대를 관찰함으로써, 당신은 그들의 다음 행동을 예측하고 대응하거나 저항할 준비를 할 수 있습니다. 한 명의 대상을 선택하고, 적의 기만 DC 또는 적의 레벨에 따른 높은 DC 중 더 높은 쪽을 상대로 @link[actions.sense-motive] 지각 판정을 시도합니다.

대성공 당신은 대상의 전략을 정확히 간파하여, 다음 차례 시작 전까지 해당 생물에게 AC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻고, 다음 차례 시작 전까지 해당 생물에 대한 다음 내성 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

성공 당신은 대상의 전략 요지를 추론합니다. 대성공과 동일하나 상황 보너스는 +1만 적용됩니다.

실패 당신은 대상의 전략을 파악하지 못해 아무런 이득도 얻지 못한다.

대실패 당신은 대상의 전략을 오해하여, 다음 턴 시작 전까지 해당 생물에게 AC에 -1 상황 페널티를 받고, 다음 턴 시작 전까지 해당 생물에 대한 다음 내성 굴림에 -1 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.5v0ndPPMfZwhiVZF]{Effect: Predictable!}

name: Spiritual Guides

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail, but don't critically fail, a Perception check or a skill check.

Though no one sees them and only you can hear them, the spirits around you constantly chatter, save when you are raging. Sometimes they're even helpful, and their guidance can even cut through the haze of your rage. Reroll the triggering check, using the second result even if it's worse.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail, but don't critically fail, a Perception check or a skill check.

Though no one sees them and only you can hear them, the spirits around you constantly chatter, save when you are raging. Sometimes they're even helpful, and their guidance can even cut through the haze of your rage. Reroll the triggering check, using the second result even if it's worse.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 지각 판정나 기술 판정에서 실패하지만 대실패는 아닐 때.

주변의 영혼들은 아무도 볼 수 없고 오직 당신만이 들을 수 있지만, 당신이 분노 상태가 아닐 때를 제외하고는 끊임없이 수다를 떱니다. 때로는 도움이 되기도 하며, 그들의 조언은 분노의 안개마저 뚫고 들어올 수 있습니다. 유발 판정을 재굴림하고, 결과가 더 나쁘더라도 두 번째 결과를 사용합니다.

name: Secondary Detonation Array

description.value: You divert some of your spell's energy into an unstable runic array. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that deals damage, has no duration, and affects an area, a glowing magic circle appears in a @Template[burst|distance:5] within that area. At the beginning of your next turn, the circle detonates, dealing @Damage[1d6[force]] damage per rank of the spell to all creatures within the circle, with a basic Reflex save against your spell DC. If the spell dealt a different type of damage, the circle deals this type of damage instead (or one type of your choice if the spell could deal multiple types of damage).

_desc_en: You divert some of your spell's energy into an unstable runic array. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that deals damage, has no duration, and affects an area, a glowing magic circle appears in a @Template[burst|distance:5] within that area. At the beginning of your next turn, the circle detonates, dealing @Damage[1d6[force]] damage per rank of the spell to all creatures within the circle, with a basic Reflex save against your spell DC. If the spell dealt a different type of damage, the circle deals this type of damage instead (or one type of your choice if the spell could deal multiple types of damage).
_desc_ko: 당신은 주문 에너지 일부를 불안정한 룬 배열로 전환합니다. 다음 행동으로 지속 시간이 없고 영역에 영향을 미치는 피해를 주는 주문을 시전할 경우, 해당 영역 내 5피트 크기의 반짝이는 마법 원이 나타납니다. 다음 턴 시작 시, 원은 폭발하여 원 내 모든 생물에게 주문 랭크당 1d6 역장의 피해를 입힌다. 대상은 기본 반사 내성을 통해 주문 DC에 맞선 내성을 시도할 수 있다. 해당 주문이 다른 유형의 피해를 입혔다면, 원은 그 유형의 피해를 대신 입힌다(또는 주문이 여러 유형의 피해를 입힐 수 있다면 선택한 한 가지 유형의 피해를 입힌다).

name: Disciple's Breath

description.value: You unleash your breath weapon without spending focus. This has the effects of your Dragon Breath sorcerer bloodline spell, though it deals @Damage[9d6[@actor.flags.system.dragonDisciple.energyType]] damage instead of its usual damage, and you don't have to cast it or spend a Focus Point. You can't use Disciple's Breath again for [[/r 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

_desc_en: You unleash your breath weapon without spending focus. This has the effects of your Dragon Breath sorcerer bloodline spell, though it deals @Damage[9d6[@actor.flags.system.dragonDisciple.energyType]] damage instead of its usual damage, and you don't have to cast it or spend a Focus Point. You can't use Disciple's Breath again for [[/r 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.
_desc_ko: 집중력을 소모하지 않고 숨결 무기를 발동한다. 이는 드래곤의 숨결 소서러 혈통 주문의 효과를 가지나, 일반적인 피해 대신 의 피해를 입히고, 주문을 시전하거나 포커스 포인트를 소모할 필요가 없다. 1d4 라운드 동안 제자의 숨결을 다시 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Greater Esoteric Spellcasting

description.value:
Your understanding of magic has evolved, and so has your spellcasting. You become an expert in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Also, choose a tradition from which you can cast innate spells due to the Esoteric Spellcasting feat. You also gain a 4th-rank spell of that tradition as an innate spell you can cast once a day. At 12th level, you gain a 5th-rank spell, and at 14th level, you gain a 6th-rank spell, both of the same tradition.

Special You can take this feat a second time, choosing a different eligible tradition.

_desc_en:
Your understanding of magic has evolved, and so has your spellcasting. You become an expert in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Also, choose a tradition from which you can cast innate spells due to the Esoteric Spellcasting feat. You also gain a 4th-rank spell of that tradition as an innate spell you can cast once a day. At 12th level, you gain a 5th-rank spell, and at 14th level, you gain a 6th-rank spell, both of the same tradition.

Special You can take this feat a second time, choosing a different eligible tradition.
_desc_ko:
마법에 대한 이해가 진화함에 따라 주문 시전 능력도 발전했습니다. 주문 공격 수정자와 주문 DC 통계에 대한 전문가가 됩니다. 또한, 신비한 주문 시전 피트 덕분에 선천적 주문을 시전할 수 있는 전통을 하나 선택합니다. 해당 전통의 4랭크 주문을 하루에 한 번 시전할 수 있는 선천적 주문으로 획득한다. 12레벨에 (5th)랭크 주문을, 14레벨에 (6th)랭크 주문을 각각 동일한 전통으로 추가 획득한다.

특수 다른 적격 전통을 선택하여 이 피트를 두 번째로 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Summon Fire Elemental

description.value: You can summon an elemental ally. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lpT6LotUaQPfinjj]{Summon Elemental} as a 5th-rank primal innate spell, but the elemental summoned must be a fire elemental.

_desc_en: You can summon an elemental ally. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lpT6LotUaQPfinjj]{Summon Elemental} as a 5th-rank primal innate spell, but the elemental summoned must be a fire elemental.
_desc_ko: 원소 동료를 소환할 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, @link[spells.summon-elemental]을 (5th)랭크 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있으나, 소환된 원소는 반드시 불 원소여야 합니다.

name: Battering Wings

description.value: Though not powerful enough for flight, your wings can deliver a thrashing to anyone who gets close. You gain a wing unarmed attack that deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage. Your wing attack is in the brawling group and has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits

_desc_en: Though not powerful enough for flight, your wings can deliver a thrashing to anyone who gets close. You gain a wing unarmed attack that deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage. Your wing attack is in the brawling group and has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits
_desc_ko: 비행에는 충분하지 않지만, 당신의 날개는 가까이 다가온 자에게 맹렬한 타격을 가할 수 있습니다. 날개 비무장 공격을 얻으며, 1d4 타격을 입힙니다. 날개 공격은 난투 그룹에 속하며 기민한, 기교, 무기 특성을 가집니다.

name: Fool's Fleeting Plan

description.value:
When Aercelys, hero-god of fools and fire, dove into the funeral pyre of his beloved daughter, he seemed a fool without thought for his safety. Yet when he returned with her body, he showed the slow rise of her chest, and those who doubted became the fools.

You carry Aercelys's spark within you, which protects you from rash decisions. You do not trigger reactions when you use an action that you gained from being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}.

_desc_en:
When Aercelys, hero-god of fools and fire, dove into the funeral pyre of his beloved daughter, he seemed a fool without thought for his safety. Yet when he returned with her body, he showed the slow rise of her chest, and those who doubted became the fools.

You carry Aercelys's spark within you, which protects you from rash decisions. You do not trigger reactions when you use an action that you gained from being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}.
_desc_ko:
어리석음과 불의 영웅신 아에르셀리스가 사랑하는 딸의 장작더미 속으로 뛰어든 순간, 그는 자신의 안전을 전혀 생각하지 않는 어리석은 자처럼 보였다. 그러나 그가 그녀의 시신을 안고 돌아왔을 때, 그는 그녀의 가슴이 천천히 오르내리는 모습을 보여주었고, 의심했던 자들이 오히려 어리석은 자가 되었다.

당신은 내면에 에어셀리스의 불꽃을 품고 있어 성급한 결정을 막아줍니다. @link[conditions.quickened] 상태에서 얻은 행동을 사용할 때 반응을 유발하지 않습니다.

name: Blessing of the Five

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Effect You call out to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.JndhOIHnQoMwnsw3]{The Godclaw} to heal your allies. name: Advanced Glory

description.value:
You gain an exemplar feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your exemplar level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another exemplar feat.

_desc_en:
You gain an exemplar feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your exemplar level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another exemplar feat.
_desc_ko:
이그젬플러 피트를 획득합니다. 전제 조건 충족을 위해, 당신의 이그젬플러 레벨은 캐릭터 레벨의 절반과 동일합니다.

특수 이 재주를 여러 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 선택할 때마다 또 다른 이그젬플러 피트를 얻습니다.

name: Reactive Charm

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You are the target of a spell or attack.

You're so charming and distracting that when pressed, you can cast a simple enchantment in time to foil an attacker. You cast any of your 1st-rank enchantment spells that normally take two actions or fewer to cast. This takes effect before the triggering spell or attack, and if the attacker is affected by your spell, it can make different decisions based on the effects (for instance, if you charm the attacker and it becomes friendly to you, it can choose a different target than you for its attack or spell). The attacking creature must be in range of your chosen spell, and if your spell requires targets, the attacking creature must be a valid target. Your spell affects only the attacking creature, even if it would normally affect more targets or an area.

_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 당신이 주문이나 공격의 대상이 되었을 때.

당신은 너무나 매력적이고 주의를 분산시켜, 위급한 순간에 간단한 마법을 시전하여 공격자를 저지할 수 있습니다. 당신은 일반적으로 두 행동 이하로 시전되는 1랭크 매혹 마법 중 하나를 시전합니다. 이 효과는 발동 마법이나 공격 전에 적용되며, 공격자가 당신의 마법에 영향을 받으면 그 효과에 따라 다른 결정을 내릴 수 있습니다(예: 공격자를 매혹시켜 당신에게 우호적으로 만들면, 공격 대상이나 마법 대상으로 당신 대신 다른 대상을 선택할 수 있음). 공격하는 생물은 선택한 주문의 사정거리 내에 있어야 하며, 주문에 대상이 필요한 경우 공격하는 생물이 유효한 대상이어야 합니다. 주문은 일반적으로 더 많은 대상이나 영역에 영향을 미치더라도 공격하는 생물에게만 영향을 미칩니다.

name: Hideous Ululation

description.value: Your throat has multiple separate chambers that can give your voice an eerie echo. You can be clearly heard at distances of up to 300 feet regardless of ambient sound, although your voice doesn't penetrate a magical @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gIdDLrbswTV3OBJy]{Silence} effect.

_desc_en: Your throat has multiple separate chambers that can give your voice an eerie echo. You can be clearly heard at distances of up to 300 feet regardless of ambient sound, although your voice doesn't penetrate a magical @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gIdDLrbswTV3OBJy]{Silence} effect.
_desc_ko: 목구멍에 여러 개의 분리된 공간이 있어 목소리에 섬뜩한 메아리를 낼 수 있다. 주변 소음과 상관없이 최대 300피트 거리까지 선명하게 들리지만, 마법 @link[spells.silence] 효과는 뚫지 못한다.

name: Stand Back, I'm A Doctor!

description.value:
Requirements You are holding healer's tools, or you are wearing them and have a hand free; a creature with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition is in your reach.

You have mastered techniques to aid those at the brink of death, even if they use dangerous Stasian technology. Attempt a Medicine check on the dying creature as you deliver it a powerful shock. The DC is usually a standard-difficulty DC of a level equal to the target. On a success, the creature's dying condition is reduced by 1 (or 2 on a critical success); if this reduces the value of the dying condition to 0, the creature regains @Damage[(2d8+10)[healing]] Hit Points, its wounded condition doesn't increase, and it can Stand as a free action. Each creature except you adjacent to the target takes @Damage[8d6[electricity]] damage (@Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save against your class DC or spell DC); instead of attempting this save, a creature can Step as a free action and if they end this movement not adjacent to the target, they take no damage.

Each creature except you adjacent to the target takes @Damage[8d6[electricity]] damage (@Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save against your class DC or spell DC); instead of attempting this save, a creature can Step as a free action and if they end this movement not adjacent to the target, they take no damage.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 치유 도구를 들고 있거나 착용 중이며 한 손이 자유로워야 합니다; @link[conditions.dying] 상태의 생물이 당신의 손이 닿는 거리에 있어야 합니다.

죽음의 문턱에 선 이들을 돕는 기술을 마스터했으며, 그들이 위험한 스타시안 기술을 사용하더라도 가능합니다. 죽어가는 생물에게 강력한 충격을 가하며 의술 판정을 시도하세요. DC는 일반적으로 대상 레벨에 해당하는 표준 난이도입니다. 성공 시, 생명이 위태로운 상태가 1 감소합니다(대성공 시 2 감소). 이로 인해 생명이 위태로운 상태가 0이 되면, 생명이 위태로운 생물이 2d8+10 회복 HP를 회복하고, 부상 상태가 증가하지 않으며, 무료 행동으로 일어서게 됩니다. 표적과 인접한 당신을 제외한 모든 생물은 8d6 전기의 피해를 받습니다(당신의 직업 DC 또는 주문 DC에 대한 기본 반사 내성 굴림). 이 내성을 시도하는 대신, 생물은 무료 행동으로 이동할 수 있으며, 이 이동 후 표적과 인접하지 않은 위치에 있으면 피해를 받지 않습니다.

name: Irrepressible (Halfling)

description.value: You are easily able to ward off attempts to play on your fears and emotions. When you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead. If your heritage is gutsy halfling, when you roll a critical failure on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a failure instead.

_desc_en: You are easily able to ward off attempts to play on your fears and emotions. When you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead. If your heritage is gutsy halfling, when you roll a critical failure on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a failure instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신의 두려움과 감정을 이용하려는 시도를 쉽게 수호부할 수 있습니다. 감정 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴릴 경우, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다. 당신의 혈통이 용감한 하플링일 경우, 감정 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 대실패를 굴릴 경우, 대신 실패를 얻습니다.

name: Timelessness

description.value:
Time travelers are rare, but even among them your isolation from time is unique. As long as you remain timewracked, you do not age and cannot die of natural causes. You're immune to hostile spells and effects related to time or aging, as well as the slowed condition (except for when you gain the slowed condition through this mythic destiny). You reduce the DC of recovery checks by 1. Whenever you roll a flat check to end persistent damage, you roll twice and choose your desired result; this is a fortune effect.

In addition, your intimate knowledge of the flow of time gives you a measure of influence over the attempt of another to manipulate it. Whenever an enemy creature that you are aware of and who is within 60 feet of you gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition, you gain the quickened condition for 1 round. The actions available to you from the acquired condition are the same as those granted by the ability that quickens your enemy.

publication.title: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

You reduce the DC of recovery checks by 1. Whenever you roll a flat check to end persistent damage, you roll twice and choose your desired result; this is a fortune effect.

In addition, your intimate knowledge of the flow of time gives you a measure of influence over the attempt of another to manipulate it.
