The actions available to you from the acquired condition are the same as those granted by the ability that quickens your enemy.
_desc_ko:
시간 여행자는 드물지만, 그들 사이에서도 당신의 시간으로부터의 고립은 독특하다. 당신이 시간에 얽매인 상태로 남아 있는 한, 당신은 나이를 먹지 않으며 자연적 원인으로 죽을 수 없다. 당신은 시간이나 노화와 관련된 적대적인 주문과 효과, 그리고 둔화 상태(이 신화 운명을 통해 둔화 상태를 얻는 경우는 제외)에 면역이다. 당신은 회복 판정의 DC를 1 감소시킨다. 지속 피해를 종료하기 위해 평판정을 굴릴 때마다, 당신은 두 번 굴려 원하는 결과를 선택한다. 이는 행운 효과다.

또한, 시간의 흐름에 대한 당신의 깊은 지식은 그것을 조종하려는 타인의 시도에 대해 어느 정도 영향력을 발휘하게 해준다. 당신이 인지하고 있으며 당신으로부터 60피트 이내에 있는 적 크리처가 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{가속} 상태를 얻을 때마다, 당신은 1라운드 동안 가속 상태를 얻는다. 얻은 상태로부터 당신이 사용할 수 있는 행동은 적을 가속시킨 능력이 부여한 것과 동일하다.

name: Velstrac Magic

description.value: You know there's so much more to sensation than whips and chains—but whips and chains also have their place. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.mrDi3v933gsmnw25]{Telekinetic Maneuver} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9s5tqqXNzcoKamWx]{Web} once per day each as 2nd-rank divine innate spells; in both cases, the spells manifest shadowy chains rather than their usual visual signifiers.

_desc_en: You know there's so much more to sensation than whips and chains—but whips and chains also have their place. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.mrDi3v933gsmnw25]{Telekinetic Maneuver} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9s5tqqXNzcoKamWx]{Web} once per day each as 2nd-rank divine innate spells; in both cases, the spells manifest shadowy chains rather than their usual visual signifiers.
_desc_ko: 당신은 채찍과 사슬 이상의 감각이 존재한다는 것을 알고 있지만, 채찍과 사슬 역시 그 나름의 자리를 차지하고 있음을 압니다. @link[spells.telekinetic-maneuver]와 @link[spells.web]을 하루에 한 번씩 (2nd)랭크 신성 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있다. 두 경우 모두 마법은 일반적인 시각적 상징 대신 그림자 사슬로 창조된다.

name: Reliable Squire

description.value: You know the path to victory isn't traveled alone, and you lend aid to your companions whenever you can. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Aid. If you roll a critical failure on a check to Aid, you get a failure instead.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en: You know the path to victory isn't traveled alone, and you lend aid to your companions whenever you can. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Aid. If you roll a critical failure on a check to Aid, you get a failure instead.
_desc_ko: 승리의 길은 혼자서 갈 수 없다는 것을 알고 있으며, 가능한 한 동료들을 돕습니다. 지원 판정 시 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 지원 판정에서 대실패를 굴렸을 경우, 실패로 처리됩니다.

name: Slice and Swipe

description.value:
Access Help either the Washboard Dogs or the Diobel Sweepers destroy their rival.

Requirements You're wielding a melee weapon that deals slashing damage and you have a free hand.

You attempt a melee Strike with the required weapon. If you hit and deal damage and the result of your attack roll exceeds the target's Perception DC, you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} a small object from the target (as if you had succeeded at that task using the Thievery skill). Depending on the object, the target might realize that it has been stolen, and onlookers might realize you have stolen the object if the attack roll doesn't exceed their Perception DCs.

_desc_en:
Access Help either the Washboard Dogs or the Diobel Sweepers destroy their rival.

Requirements You're wielding a melee weapon that deals slashing damage and you have a free hand.

You attempt a melee Strike with the required weapon. Depending on the object, the target might realize that it has been stolen, and onlookers might realize you have stolen the object if the attack roll doesn't exceed their Perception DCs.
_desc_ko:
접근 워시보드 독스나 디오벨 스위퍼스 중 한 쪽이 상대방을 파괴하도록 도와라.

요구 사항 베기 피해를 주는 근접 무기를 들고 있으며, 빈 손을 가지고 있어야 합니다.

필요한 무기로 근접 공격을 시도한다. 명중하여 피해를 입히고 명중 굴림 결과가 대상의 지각 DC를 초과하면, @link[actions.steal]로 대상에게서 작은 물건을 훔친다(도둑질 기술로 해당 작업에 성공한 것과 동일하게). 물건에 따라 대상이 도난당한 사실을 깨달을 수 있으며, 명중 굴림이 관찰자들의 지각 DC를 넘지 못하면 주변 사람들이 당신이 물건을 훔쳤음을 알아챌 수 있습니다.

name: Advanced Construct Companion

description.value: You've upgraded your construct companion's power and decision-making ability. It becomes an advanced construct companion. During an encounter, even if you don't use the Command a Construct action, your construct companion can still use 1 action on your turn that round to Stride or Strike.

_desc_en: You've upgraded your construct companion's power and decision-making ability. It becomes an advanced construct companion. During an encounter, even if you don't use the Command a Construct action, your construct companion can still use 1 action on your turn that round to Stride or Strike.
_desc_ko: 당신은 조력 기계의 힘과 의사결정 능력을 업그레이드했습니다. 이제 고급 조력 기계가 됩니다. 전투 중, 당신이 '하수인 지휘' 행동을 사용하지 않더라도, 해당 라운드 당신의 턴에 조력 기계가 1개의 행동을 사용하여 '이동' 또는 '공격'을 할 수 있습니다.

name: Demon-Hunting Companion

description.value: You gain a young animal companion that has been specially trained to help you fight demons. You can choose any common animal companion, which gains scent as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet that can be used only to smell fiends. If the animal companion already has scent, it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception when using scent against fiends.

_desc_en: You gain a young animal companion that has been specially trained to help you fight demons. You can choose any common animal companion, which gains scent as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet that can be used only to smell fiends. If the animal companion already has scent, it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception when using scent against fiends.
_desc_ko: 데몬 퇴치를 돕도록 특별히 훈련된 어린 동물 동료를 얻습니다. 일반 동물 동료 중 하나를 선택할 수 있으며, 이 동료는 핀드를 감지하는 데만 사용할 수 있는 30피트 범위의 부정확한 감각인 후각을 얻습니다. 동물 동료가 이미 후각을 가지고 있다면, 핀드를 상대로 후각을 사용할 때 지각 능력에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Sixth Pillar Dedication

description.value:
You use your physical discipline to channel your magic. If your proficiency rank in unarmed attacks is at least expert, your proficiency rank in spell attacks increases to expert. Likewise, if your proficiency rank in spell attacks is at least expert, your proficiency rank in unarmed attacks improves to expert. You become an expert in Athletics, or in another trained skill if you were already expert in Athletics.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.F5gBiVGbS8YSgPSI]{Sixth Pillar}

publication.title: Pathfinder Fists of the Ruby Phoenix Hardcover Compilation

_desc_en:
You use your physical discipline to channel your magic. If your proficiency rank in unarmed attacks is at least expert, your proficiency rank in spell attacks increases to expert. Likewise, if your proficiency rank in spell attacks is at least expert, your proficiency rank in unarmed attacks improves to expert. You become an expert in Athletics, or in another trained skill if you were already expert in Athletics.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.F5gBiVGbS8YSgPSI]{Sixth Pillar}
_desc_ko: 당신은 육체적 훈련을 통해 마법을 운용합니다. 비무장 공격 숙련도가 전문가 이상일 경우, 주문 공격 숙련도가 전문가로 상승합니다. 마찬가지로, 주문 공격 숙련도가 전문가 이상일 경우, 비무장 공격 숙련도가 전문가로 향상됩니다. 당신은 운동에 숙련자가 되거나, 이미 운동에 숙련자라면 다른 훈련된 기술에 숙련자가 됩니다.

name: To Battle!

description.value: With a resounding cry, you rally your ally to take the offensive. Choose one ally in your marshal's aura who has a reaction available. If you spend 1 action, that ally can use their reaction to immediately Stride. If you spend 2 actions, that ally can use their reaction to immediately Strike.

_desc_en: With a resounding cry, you rally your ally to take the offensive. Choose one ally in your marshal's aura who has a reaction available. If you spend 1 action, that ally can use their reaction to immediately Stride. If you spend 2 actions, that ally can use their reaction to immediately Strike.
_desc_ko: 우렁찬 함성과 함께, 당신은 동료를 격려하여 공격을 개시하게 합니다. 당신의 마셜 오라 안에 반응을 사용할 수 있는 동료 한 명을 선택하세요. 당신이 행동 1개를 소모하면, 그 동료는 반응을 사용하여 즉시 이동할 수 있습니다. 당신이 행동 2개를 소모하면, 그 동료는 반응을 사용하여 즉시 공격할 수 있습니다.

name: Sing to the Steel

description.value: You strike magical tones that can turn the tide of combat. You and your allies within 30 feet gain the effects of one of the following runes until the end of your next turn: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Wm0X7Pfd1bfocPSv]{Corrosive}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.LwQb7ryTC8FlOXgX]{Vitalizing}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.XszNvxnymWYRaoTp]{Flaming}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.M5M1WJ5KzbYfRGsY]{Frost}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{Ghost Touch}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.NVst7e69agGG9Qwd]{Shock}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.dTxbaa7HSiJbIuNN]{Thundering}. The effects apply to a single weapon the creature is holding or one of the creature's unarmed attacks. You choose the rune and the effect applies to all creatures. You can use an action, which has the concentrate trait, to extend the duration of the rune for 1 additional round up to a maximum of 1 minute. If this would give a weapon or unarmed attack more property runes than its normal maximum, an existing property rune (as the creature chooses) is suppressed until the spell ends.

_desc_ko: 당신은 전투의 흐름을 바꿀 수 있는 마법적인 음조를 강타합니다. 당신과 30피트 내 동맹은 다음 턴 종료까지 다음 룬 중 하나의 효과를 얻습니다: @link[equipment.corrosive], @link[equipment.vitalizing], @link[equipment.flaming], @link[equipment.frost], @link[equipment.ghost-touch], @link[equipment.shock], 또는 @link[equipment.thundering]. 효과는 생물이 들고 있는 무기 하나 또는 생물의 비무장 공격 하나에 적용됩니다. 당신이 룬을 선택하면 그 효과는 모든 생물에게 적용됩니다. 집중 특성을 가진 행동을 사용해 룬의 지속 시간을 최대 1분까지 1라운드 연장할 수 있습니다. 이로 인해 무기나 비무장 공격이 정상 최대치보다 많은 속성 룬을 가지게 될 경우, 기존 속성 룬 하나(생물이 선택)는 주문이 끝날 때까지 억제됩니다.

name: Steed's Toppling Strike

description.value:
Requirements An enemy triggered your champion's reaction since the end of your last turn.

Those who defy your cause feel the powerful attacks of your mount. You Command an Animal to order your steed to Strike the enemy who triggered your champion's reaction. Your steed's unarmed attack deals one extra damage die for this Strike. If the Strike hits, the target is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

_desc_en:
Requirements An enemy triggered your champion's reaction since the end of your last turn.

Those who defy your cause feel the powerful attacks of your mount. You Command an Animal to order your steed to Strike the enemy who triggered your champion's reaction. Your steed's unarmed attack deals one extra damage die for this Strike. If the Strike hits, the target is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 적중자가 당신의 마지막 턴 종료 이후 당신의 챔피언의 반응을 유발했습니다.

당신의 대의를 거스르는 자들은 당신의 탈것의 강력한 공격을 맛보게 됩니다. 당신은 동물 지휘를 사용하여 당신의 기마병에게 챔피언의 반응을 유발한 적을 공격하도록 명령합니다. 이 공격 시 기마병의 비무장 공격은 추가로 1개의 피해 주사위를 입힙니다. 공격이 적중하면 대상은 @link[conditions.prone] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Betraying Shank

description.value:
Requirements You are within melee reach of a target, but it is not in combat with you.

While your usual diplomacy is well intentioned, you know that sometimes those same skills will need to be turned to deception. In a flash, you draw a sheathed or concealed agile or finesse weapon and make a melee Strike. The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against your Strike. You then roll Deception for initiative.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are within melee reach of a target, but it is not in combat with you.

While your usual diplomacy is well intentioned, you know that sometimes those same skills will need to be turned to deception. In a flash, you draw a sheathed or concealed agile or finesse weapon and make a melee Strike. The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against your Strike. You then roll Deception for initiative.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 대상의 근접 공격 범위 내에 있지만, 대상은 당신과 교전 중이 아닙니다.

평소 당신의 외교는 선의에서 비롯되었지만, 때로는 그 능력이 속임수로 전환되어야 한다는 것을 알고 있습니다. 순식간에 칼집에 꽂혀 있거나 {가려진} 기민한 또는 기교 무기를 뽑아 근접 공격을 가합니다. 대상은 당신의 공격에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다. 이후 인니셔티브를 위해 기만 능력치로 주사위를 굴림.

name: Pernicious Poison

description.value: You can add a toxic additive to an alchemical poison to make it splash poison on its target. A poison with this additive deals an amount of poison damage equal to the poison's level if the target succeeds at its initial saving throw against it. A target that critically succeeds at its saving throw against this poison still takes no damage.

_desc_en: You can add a toxic additive to an alchemical poison to make it splash poison on its target. A poison with this additive deals an amount of poison damage equal to the poison's level if the target succeeds at its initial saving throw against it. A target that critically succeeds at its saving throw against this poison still takes no damage.
_desc_ko: 연금술 독에 독성 첨가제를 넣어 대상에게 독이 튀게 할 수 있다. 이 첨가제가 있는 독은 대상이 초기 내성 굴림에서 성공하면 독의 레벨에 해당하는 양의 독 피해를 입힌다. 이 독에 대한 내성 굴림에서 대성공한 대상은 여전히 피해를 입지 않는다.

name: Hardwood Armor

description.value:
Wood and bark grow over your body like armor. This hardwood armor is medium armor but uses your highest armor proficiency. The wooden armor's statistics are: AC Bonus +3; Dex Cap +2; Check Penalty –2; Speed Penalty –5 feet; Strength +2; Bulk 1; Group wood TV. Any bonuses, runes, and magical abilities of your actual armor are suppressed, but any runes that could apply to the hardwood armor are replicated onto it.

When you use this impulse, you can also create a wooden shield in a free hand. You can Shield Block with this shield even if you don't have that feat. The hand wielding this shield counts as a free hand for using impulses. The shield decays in an instant if it becomes broken or leaves your grasp.

The armor lasts for 10 minutes, and you can Dismiss this impulse. If you use this impulse again, any existing one ends.

Level (+3) The shield's Hardness increases by 1, its HP by 4, and its BT by 2.

_desc_en:
Wood and bark grow over your body like armor. This hardwood armor is medium armor but uses your highest armor proficiency. The wooden armor's statistics are: AC Bonus +3; Dex Cap +2; Check Penalty –2; Speed Penalty –5 feet; Strength +2; Bulk 1; Group wood TV. Any bonuses, runes, and magical abilities of your actual armor are suppressed, but any runes that could apply to the hardwood armor are replicated onto it.

When you use this impulse, you can also create a wooden shield in a free hand. You can Shield Block with this shield even if you don't have that feat. The hand wielding this shield counts as a free hand for using impulses. The shield decays in an instant if it becomes broken or leaves your grasp.

The armor lasts for 10 minutes, and you can Dismiss this impulse. If you use this impulse again, any existing one ends.

Level (+3) The shield's Hardness increases by 1, its HP by 4, and its BT by 2.
_desc_ko:
나무와 나무껍질이 갑옷처럼 몸에 자란다. 이 경목 갑옷은 평갑이지만 가장 높은 갑옷 숙련도를 사용한다. 나무 갑옷의 통계는 다음과 같다: AC 보너스 +3; 민첩 상한 +2; 판정 페널티 -2; 속도 페널티 -5피트; 근력 +2; 벌크 1; 그룹 우드 TV. 실제 갑옷의 모든 보너스, 룬, 마법 능력은 억제되지만, 경목 갑옷에 적용될 수 있는 룬은 그대로 복제됩니다.

이 임펄스를 사용할 때, 자유로운 손에 나무 방패를 생성할 수도 있습니다. 해당 피트가 없더라도 이 방패로 방패 막기를 사용할 수 있습니다. 이 방패를 든 손은 임펄스 사용 시 빈 손으로 간주됩니다. 방패가 파손되거나 손에서 떨어지면 즉시 부서집니다.

이 방어구는 10분 동안 지속되며, 이 임펄스를 해제할 수 있다. 이 임펄스를 다시 사용하면 기존에 존재하던 임펄스는 종료된다.

레벨 (+3) 방패의 경도가 1 증가하고, HP가 4 증가하며, BT가 2 증가합니다.

name: Olethros's Decree

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You have a connection to olethroses, the enigmatic psychopomps who successfully swayed the yamaraj to permit the creation of the first duskwalkers. You place a finger on fate's scales by wrapping silk around your bow.

The first time this turn that you hit a creature with a Strike using a weapon in the bow group you've modified in this way, that creature takes an additional @Damage[60[untyped]] damage (@Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic] save using your class or spell DC, whichever is higher) as the arrow works to cut short their very destiny. This additional damage is of the same type as the initial attack dealt. If you hit more than one creature at the same time, choose one to suffer the effect of your decree.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You have a connection to olethroses, the enigmatic psychopomps who successfully swayed the yamaraj to permit the creation of the first duskwalkers. You place a finger on fate's scales by wrapping silk around your bow.

The first time this turn that you hit a creature with a Strike using a weapon in the bow group you've modified in this way, that creature takes an additional @Damage[60[untyped]] damage (@Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic] save using your class or spell DC, whichever is higher) as the arrow works to cut short their very destiny. This additional damage is of the same type as the initial attack dealt. If you hit more than one creature at the same time, choose one to suffer the effect of your decree.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신은 첫 번째 황혼의 방랑자 창조를 허락하도록 신성한 심판관 야마라즈를 설득한 수수께끼의 사이코폼프 올레트로스와 연결되어 있습니다. 당신은 활에 비단을 감아 운명의 저울에 손가락을 얹습니다.

이번 턴에 처음으로, 이렇게 조정된 활 무기 그룹의 무기로 생물을 공격했을 때, 그 생물은 화살이 그 생물의 운명을 단절시키려 애쓰는 동안 추가로 60의 피해를 받습니다(기본 인내 당신의 직업 또는 주문 DC 중 더 높은 것으로 내성). 이 추가 피해는 초기 공격과 동일한 유형이다. 동시에 여러 생물을 명중시킨 경우, 당신의 명령 효과를 받을 대상 하나를 선택한다.

name: Orchard's Endurance

description.value:
Patches of bark appear on the skin of you and your nearby allies. You and your allies in your kinetic aura gain resistance 5 to bludgeoning and piercing damage. In addition, you and your affected allies roll flat checks to recover from persistent damage twice and take the higher result; this is a fortune effect.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.YNoBbHUu7enOSKyv]{Stance: Orchard's Endurance}

Level (+4) The resistance increases by 2.

_desc_en:
Patches of bark appear on the skin of you and your nearby allies. You and your allies in your kinetic aura gain resistance 5 to bludgeoning and piercing damage. In addition, you and your affected allies roll flat checks to recover from persistent damage twice and take the higher result; this is a fortune effect.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.YNoBbHUu7enOSKyv]{Stance: Orchard's Endurance}

_desc_ko:
당신과 주변 아군의 피부에 나무껍질 조각이 나타납니다. 당신의 키네틱 오라 범위 내 아군은 타격 및 관통 피해에 대한 저항력 5를 얻습니다. 또한, 당신과 영향을 받은 아군은 지속 피해 회복 시 단순 판정을 두 번 수행하고 더 높은 결과를 적용받습니다. 이는 행운 효과입니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.YNoBbHUu7enOSKyv]{자세: 과수원의 인내}

레벨 (+4) 저항력이 2 증가합니다.

name: Glad-Hand

description.value: First impressions are your strong suit. When you meet someone in a casual or social situation, you can immediately attempt a Diplomacy check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on that creature rather than needing to converse for 1 minute. If you fail, you can engage in 1 minute of conversation and attempt a new check at the end of that time rather than accepting the failure or critical failure result.

_desc_en: First impressions are your strong suit. When you meet someone in a casual or social situation, you can immediately attempt a Diplomacy check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on that creature rather than needing to converse for 1 minute. If you fail, you can engage in 1 minute of conversation and attempt a new check at the end of that time rather than accepting the failure or critical failure result.
_desc_ko: 첫인상은 당신의 강점입니다. 일상적 또는 사교적 상황에서 누군가를 만날 때, 1분간 대화할 필요 없이 즉시 외교 판정을 시도하여 @link[actions.make-an-impression] 수 있습니다. 실패 시, 실패 또는 대실패 결과를 받아들이지 않고 1분간 대화를 나눈 후 시간 종료 시 새로운 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다.

name: Even the Odds (Eagle Knight)

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Even when overpowered, Eagle Knights hold out hope. If your next action is to use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.TMwqXqqggiblvEGZ]{Commitment to Equality}, you roll the Diplomacy check twice and take the higher result. If you succeed, the target also gains 25 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.xxkCSwizAu2wC7Fo]{Effect: Even the Odds (Eagle Knight)}

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Even when overpowered, Eagle Knights hold out hope. _desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

압도당해도 독수리 기사들은 희망을 버리지 않는다. 다음 행동이 @link[feats.commitment-to-equality] 사용이라면, 외교 판정을 두 번 굴림하고 더 높은 결과를 적용합니다. 성공 시 대상은 1분 동안 지속되는 임시 HP 25를 추가로 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.xxkCSwizAu2wC7Fo]{효과: 균형을 맞추다}

name: Gnome Polyglot

description.value: Your extensive travels, curiosity, and love of learning help you to learn languages quickly. You learn three new languages, chosen from common languages and uncommon languages you have access to. These languages take the same form (signed or spoken) as your other languages. When you select the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.P9HCz0uR6xPHuw72]{Multilingual} feat, you learn three new languages instead of two.

_desc_en: Your extensive travels, curiosity, and love of learning help you to learn languages quickly. You learn three new languages, chosen from common languages and uncommon languages you have access to. These languages take the same form (signed or spoken) as your other languages. When you select the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.P9HCz0uR6xPHuw72]{Multilingual} feat, you learn three new languages instead of two.
_desc_ko: 광범위한 여행, 호기심, 그리고 배움에 대한 사랑 덕분에 당신은 언어를 빠르게 습득합니다. 접근 가능한 일반 언어와 비일반 언어 중에서 세 가지 새로운 언어를 습득합니다. 이 언어들은 기존 언어와 동일한 형태(수화 또는 구어)를 취합니다. @link[feats.multilingual] 피트를 선택할 경우, 두 가지 대신 세 가지 새로운 언어를 습득합니다.

name: Lorefinder

description.value: You know that fate sometimes conspires to keep dangerous knowledge or items from the eyes of those most able to understand them. You deny fate the ability to conceal truths from you. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.LQzlKbYjZSMFQawP]{Locate} as an innate occult spell once per day. When you reach 14th level, this spell is heightened to 5th level.

_desc_en: You know that fate sometimes conspires to keep dangerous knowledge or items from the eyes of those most able to understand them. You deny fate the ability to conceal truths from you. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.LQzlKbYjZSMFQawP]{Locate} as an innate occult spell once per day. When you reach 14th level, this spell is heightened to 5th level.
_desc_ko: 당신은 운명이 때로 위험한 지식이나 물건이 가장 잘 이해할 수 있는 이들의 눈에서 멀어지도록 음모를 꾸미기도 한다는 것을 알고 있습니다. 당신은 운명이 진실을 숨기는 능력을 거부합니다. 하루에 한 번, 선천적 오컬트 주문으로 @link[spells.locate]을 시전할 수 있습니다. 14레벨에 도달하면 이 주문은 5레벨로 강화됩니다.

name: The Moon Weaver's Art

description.value: You've learned to create minor illusions by collecting strands of moonlight and weaving them together to create small images or cloaking veils. You can cast either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2oH5IufzdESuYxat]{Illusory Object} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.nX85Brzax9f650aK]{Invisible Item} as an occult innate spell once per day.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You've learned to create minor illusions by collecting strands of moonlight and weaving them together to create small images or cloaking veils. You can cast either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2oH5IufzdESuYxat]{Illusory Object} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.nX85Brzax9f650aK]{Invisible Item} as an occult innate spell once per day.
_desc_ko: 달빛의 실타래를 모아 작은 형상이나 은폐의 베일을 만들어내는 소규모 환상을 창조하는 법을 익혔습니다. 하루에 한 번, @link[spells.illusory-object] 또는 @link[spells.invisible-item] 중 하나를 오컬트 선천적 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Oil Fire

description.value:
Requirements You have a foe @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}.

Your armor includes flame-resistant gauntlets with oil-filled finger joints. These joints can split apart, dousing your opponent in flammable oil and then igniting it. The opponent must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:inventor] save against your class DC.

Critical Success The grab ends.

Success The grab ends, and the target takes @Damage[1[persistent,fire]] damage.

Failure The target takes @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))[persistent,fire]] damage equal to half your level.

Critical Failure The target takes @Damage[(@actor.level)[persistent,fire]] damage equal to your level.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Requirements You have a foe @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}.

Your armor includes flame-resistant gauntlets with oil-filled finger joints. These joints can split apart, dousing your opponent in flammable oil and then igniting it. The opponent must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:inventor] save against your class DC.

Critical Success The grab ends.

Success The grab ends, and the target takes @Damage[1[persistent,fire]] damage.

Failure The target takes @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))[persistent,fire]] damage equal to half your level.

Critical Failure The target takes @Damage[(@actor.level)[persistent,fire]] damage equal to your level.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 적을 @link[conditions.grabbed].

당신의 갑옷에는 기름이 채워진 손가락 관절이 있는 내화성 건틀릿이 포함되어 있습니다. 이 관절은 갈라져 상대방에게 인화성 기름을 뿌린 후 점화할 수 있습니다. 상대는 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 반사 내성을 시도해야 합니다.

대성공 붙잡기가 종료됩니다.

성공 붙잡기가 종료되고 대상은 1 지속 화염의 피해를 입습니다.

실패 대상은 당신의 레벨 절반에 해당하는 화염 피해를 입습니다.

대실패 대상은 당신의 레벨과 동일한 화염의 피해를 입습니다.

name: Architect of Flame

description.value:
Flames rise and shape to your will, forming a wall or dome of your design. You create a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IarZrgCeaiUqOuRu]{Wall of Fire} within 120 feet. In addition to the normal choices, you can make the wall up to 10 feet long and 60 feet high. The wall lasts until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it up to 1 minute.

Level (+3) The damage increases by 1d6.

_desc_en:
Flames rise and shape to your will, forming a wall or dome of your design. You create a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IarZrgCeaiUqOuRu]{Wall of Fire} within 120 feet. In addition to the normal choices, you can make the wall up to 10 feet long and 60 feet high. The wall lasts until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it up to 1 minute.

Level (+3) The damage increases by 1d6.
_desc_ko:
불꽃이 치솟아 당신의 의지대로 형태를 잡아, 당신이 설계한 벽이나 돔을 형성합니다. 당신은 120피트 이내에 @link[spells.wall-of-fire]을 창조합니다. 일반적인 선택 사항 외에도, 벽을 최대 10피트 길이와 60피트 높이까지 만들 수 있습니다. 벽은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 지속되지만, 최대 1분 동안 유지할 수 있다.

레벨 (+3) 피해량이 1d6 증가한다.

name: Animal Empathy

description.value: You have a connection to the creatures of the natural world that allows you to communicate with them on a rudimentary level. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals. In most cases, wild animals will give you time to make your case.

_desc_en: You have a connection to the creatures of the natural world that allows you to communicate with them on a rudimentary level. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals. In most cases, wild animals will give you time to make your case.
_desc_ko: 자연계의 생명체들과 연결되어 있어 기초적인 수준으로 소통할 수 있습니다. 동물에게 질문을 하고, 답변을 받으며, 외교 기술을 사용할 수 있습니다. 대부분의 경우 야생 동물들은 당신이 설명할 시간을 줍니다.

name: Guardian Lion Roar

description.value:
Your innovation is augmented with plates shaped to resemble the gaping maws of guardian lions, which you can energize to expel a stream of sonic energy reminiscent of a lion's powerful roar. All creatures in a @Template[type:line|distance:20] from your innovation take @Damage[(max(2,(floor(@actor.level/2)-2)))d8[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:inventor|basic] against your class DC. Creatures that fail this save become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round. The damage from this effect increases by 1d8 at 10th level and every 2 levels thereafter.

Unstable Function You press concealed switches in the guardian lions' plates, extending their reach and power. Add the unstable trait to Guardian Lion Roar. The range of your roar increases to a @Template[type:line|distance:60]. Creatures that succeed (but not critically succeed) at their save also become off-guard for 1 round. On a critical failure when attempting the flat check for this unstable action, you take sonic damage equal to your level instead of fire damage.

Special If your innovation is a minion, it can take this action rather than you.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Your innovation is augmented with plates shaped to resemble the gaping maws of guardian lions, which you can energize to expel a stream of sonic energy reminiscent of a lion's powerful roar. All creatures in a @Template[type:line|distance:20] from your innovation take @Damage[(max(2,(floor(@actor.level/2)-2)))d8[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:inventor|basic] against your class DC. Creatures that fail this save become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round. The damage from this effect increases by 1d8 at 10th level and every 2 levels thereafter.

Unstable Function You press concealed switches in the guardian lions' plates, extending their reach and power. Add the unstable trait to Guardian Lion Roar. The range of your roar increases to a @Template[type:line|distance:60]. Creatures that succeed (but not critically succeed) at their save also become off-guard for 1 round. On a critical failure when attempting the flat check for this unstable action, you take sonic damage equal to your level instead of fire damage.

Special If your innovation is a minion, it can take this action rather than you.
_desc_ko:
당신의 혁신은 가디언 사자의 벌린 입을 형상화한 판들로 강화되어 있으며, 이를 활성화하여 사자의 강력한 포효를 연상시키는 [sonic] 에너지의 흐름을 방출할 수 있습니다. 이 혁신 장치로부터 20피트 직선 반경 내의 모든 생물은 음파의 피해를 입으며, 기본 인내에 당신의 클래스 DC를 상대로 저항 검사를 수행합니다. 이 내성에 실패한 생물은 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다. 이 효과의 피해는 10th 레벨과 이후 2레벨마다 1d8씩 증가합니다.

불안정한 기능 가디언사자 갑옷의 {가려진} 스위치를 눌러 그 도달 범위와 힘을 확장합니다. 가디언사자 포효에 불안정 특성을 추가합니다. 포효의 범위가 60피트 직선로 증가합니다. 저항에 성공한(대성공 제외) 생물도 1라운드 동안 무방비가 된다. 이 불안정한 행동의 단순 판정을 시도하다 대실패할 경우, 화염 피해 대신 레벨에 해당하는 음파 피해를 받는다.

특수 혁신 대상이 하수인인 경우, 본인이 아닌 하수인이 이 행동을 수행할 수 있다.

name: Spell-Repelling Form

description.value: Your eidolon evolves to protect itself from the danger posed by spells. It gains a +1 status bonus to all saving throws against magic.

_desc_en: Your eidolon evolves to protect itself from the danger posed by spells. It gains a +1 status bonus to all saving throws against magic.
_desc_ko: 당신의 에이돌론은 주문이 초래하는 위험으로부터 스스로를 보호하기 위해 진화합니다. 마법에 대한 모든 내성 굴림에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Alghollthu Bound

description.value:
Although you may not even be aware, the alghollthus your ancestors once served maintain a stranglehold on the deepest, tethered parts of your mind.

You receive a +2 circumstance bonus to Will saves against mental effects that would make you controlled, and if you roll a success against such an effect, you get a critical success instead.

However, you gain none of these benefits against effects originating from alghollthus and instead take a -2 circumstance penalty against mental effects from alghollthus.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Absalom, City of Lost Omens

rules.label: Alghollthu Bound (vs. mental effects that control from non-alghollthu)
Alghollthu Bound (vs. mental effect from alghollthu)

rules.text: When you roll a success on a save against an mental effect that would control you, you get a critical success instead. This benefit does not apply against effects originating from alghollthus.
rules.title: {item|name}

_desc_en:
Although you may not even be aware, the alghollthus your ancestors once served maintain a stranglehold on the deepest, tethered parts of your mind.

You receive a +2 circumstance bonus to Will saves against mental effects that would make you controlled, and if you roll a success against such an effect, you get a critical success instead.

However, you gain none of these benefits against effects originating from alghollthus and instead take a -2 circumstance penalty against mental effects from alghollthus.
_desc_ko:
당신은 전혀 인지하지 못할지라도, 선조들이 섬겼던 알골투스가 당신의 마음속 가장 깊고 묶인 부분에 대한 지배력을 유지하고 있습니다.

당신은 정신적 효과에 의해 통제당하는 것을 막는 의지 내성에 +2 상황 보너스를 받으며, 해당 효과에 대해 성공을 굴릴 경우 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

그러나 알골투스에서 비롯된 효과에 대해서는 이러한 이점을 전혀 얻지 못하며, 오히려 알골투스의 정신 효과에 대해 -2 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Water Dancer

description.value: You glide through the water with graceful ease. When in an aquatic or swamp environment, you ignore the effects of non-magical difficult terrain. In addition, swimming up or down isn't difficult terrain for you.

_desc_en: You glide through the water with graceful ease. When in an aquatic or swamp environment, you ignore the effects of non-magical difficult terrain. In addition, swimming up or down isn't difficult terrain for you.
_desc_ko: 당신은 우아하고 유연하게 물속을 미끄러지듯 이동합니다. 수중이나 습지 환경에서는 비마법적 어려운 지형의 효과를 무시합니다. 또한, 수중에서 위로 또는 아래로 헤엄치는 것도 당신에게는 어려운 지형이 아닙니다.

name: Magical Edification

description.value: You've learned those tidbits of magic that are most conducive to furthering your acquisition and transmission of knowledge. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.izcxFQFwf3woCnFs]{Guidance}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLzFcIaSXs7YTIqJ]{Message}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.AUctDF2fqPZN2w4W]{Sigil} as innate occult cantrips.

_desc_en: You've learned those tidbits of magic that are most conducive to furthering your acquisition and transmission of knowledge. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.izcxFQFwf3woCnFs]{Guidance}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLzFcIaSXs7YTIqJ]{Message}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.AUctDF2fqPZN2w4W]{Sigil} as innate occult cantrips.
_desc_ko: 지식의 습득과 전수에 가장 도움이 되는 마법의 요령들을 익혔습니다. @link[spells.guidance], @link[spells.message], @link[spells.sigil]을 선천적 오컬트 캔트립으로 얻습니다.

name: Officer's Education

description.value:
You know that a broad knowledge base is critical for a competent commander. You become trained in two skills you are not already trained in, become an expert in one skill you are currently trained in, learn one common language you do not already know, and gain any one general feat that you meet the prerequisites for.

Special You can take this feat twice, gaining its benefits each time.

_desc_en:
You know that a broad knowledge base is critical for a competent commander. You become trained in two skills you are not already trained in, become an expert in one skill you are currently trained in, learn one common language you do not already know, and gain any one general feat that you meet the prerequisites for.

Special You can take this feat twice, gaining its benefits each time.
_desc_ko:
유능한 커맨더에게는 폭넓은 지식 기반이 필수적임을 알고 있습니다. 당신은 아직 숙련되지 않은 두 가지 기술에 숙련되고, 현재 숙련된 한 가지 기술에 전문가가 되며, 아직 알지 못하는 공통 언어 하나를 배우고, 전제 조건을 충족하는 일반 피트 하나를 획득합니다.

특별 이 피트를 두 번 선택할 수 있으며, 매번 그 혜택을 얻습니다.

name: Reinforced Chassis

description.value:
Your body is designed to be particularly resilient. Your chassis is made from reinforced armor plating that grants a +3 item bonus to AC with a Dexterity cap of +1. If you are at least 5th level, the item bonus increases to +4 and at 10th level it increases to +5. You can never wear other armor or remove your chassis; however, you still don't become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} from sleeping. You can etch armor runes onto your chassis. Your chassis is medium armor in the plate group for abilities and for etching runes.

Enhancement Your chassis becomes difficult to overcome. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.uOlyklPCUWLtCaYI]{Chassis Deflection} reaction.

_desc_en:
Your body is designed to be particularly resilient. Your chassis is made from reinforced armor plating that grants a +3 item bonus to AC with a Dexterity cap of +1. If you are at least 5th level, the item bonus increases to +4 and at 10th level it increases to +5. You can never wear other armor or remove your chassis; however, you still don't become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} from sleeping. You can etch armor runes onto your chassis. Your chassis is medium armor in the plate group for abilities and for etching runes.

Enhancement Your chassis becomes difficult to overcome. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.uOlyklPCUWLtCaYI]{Chassis Deflection} reaction.
_desc_ko:
당신의 신체는 특히 탄력적으로 설계되었습니다. 당신의 차체는 강화된 장갑판으로 만들어져 민첩 상한 +1까지 AC에 +3 아이템 보너스를 부여합니다. (5th) 레벨 이상일 경우 아이템 보너스가 +4로 증가하며, (10th) 레벨에서는 +5로 증가합니다. 다른 갑옷을 착용하거나 차체를 제거할 수 없지만, 수면으로 인해 @link[conditions.fatigued]가 되지는 않습니다. 차체에 갑옷 룬을 새길 수 있습니다.

강화 당신의 차체는 극복하기 어려워집니다. @link[actions.chassis-deflection] 반응을 얻습니다.

name: Nightvision Adaptation

description.value: The nanites in your ocular processors have adapted to darkness, enhancing your ability to see in the dark. You gain darkvision.

_desc_en: The nanites in your ocular processors have adapted to darkness, enhancing your ability to see in the dark. You gain darkvision.
_desc_ko: 당신의 안구 프로세서에 있는 나노봇이 어둠에 적응하여 어둠 속 시야 능력을 향상시킵니다. 암흑 시야를 얻습니다.

name: Tap Vitality

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You tap into the entity's life force to heal your wounds, though at the cost of the entity's personality bleeding into your own. You recover a number of @Damage[(4*@actor.level)[healing]]{Hit Points equal to four times your level}. Each time you use Tap Vitality, you begin to bleed more and more of the entity's personality and instincts into your own until the next time you spend an hour or more assuaging the entity, bringing your mind back under your own control.

Special This action has the tradition trait appropriate to your entity, typically divine for a demon, occult for an aberration or outer entity, or primal for a fey.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

You tap into the entity's life force to heal your wounds, though at the cost of the entity's personality bleeding into your own. You recover a number of @Damage[(4*@actor.level)[healing]]{Hit Points equal to four times your level}. Each time you use Tap Vitality, you begin to bleed more and more of the entity's personality and instincts into your own until the next time you spend an hour or more assuaging the entity, bringing your mind back under your own control.

Special This action has the tradition trait appropriate to your entity, typically divine for a demon, occult for an aberration or outer entity, or primal for a fey.
_desc_ko:
빈도 시간당 1회

당신은 상처 치유를 위해 존재의 생명력을 끌어오지만, 그 대가로 그 존재의 성격이 당신의 성격으로 스며들게 됩니다. 당신은 레벨의 4배에 해당하는 HP를 회복합니다. 활력 흡수 사용 시마다, 다음에 1시간 이상을 해당 존재를 달래며 자신의 정신을 되찾을 때까지 점점 더 많은 그 존재의 성격과 본능이 자신에게 스며들기 시작한다.

특수 이 행동은 해당 존재에 적합한 전통 특성을 지니며, 일반적으로 데몬에게는 신성, 이형체나 외부 존재에게는 오컬트, 페이에게는 프라이멀 특성이 부여됩니다.

name: Energize Wings

description.value: Your magic energizes your wings, allowing you to fly farther. The fly Speed you gain from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ryRpqixE7cN8svwB]{Evanescent Wings} increases to 25 feet.

_desc_en: Your magic energizes your wings, allowing you to fly farther. The fly Speed you gain from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ryRpqixE7cN8svwB]{Evanescent Wings} increases to 25 feet.
_desc_ko: 마법이 날개에 활력을 불어넣어 더 멀리 비행할 수 있게 합니다. @link[feats.evanescent-wings]로 얻는 비행 속도가 25피트로 증가합니다.

name: Fresh Ingredients

description.value: It is amazing the difference fresh herbs can make. When using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.WC4xLBGmBsdOdHWu]{Natural Medicine} to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}, you gain the +2 circumstance bonus from having fresh ingredients, even if not in wilderness. If you do this in the wilderness, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus instead.

_desc_en: It is amazing the difference fresh herbs can make. When using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.WC4xLBGmBsdOdHWu]{Natural Medicine} to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}, you gain the +2 circumstance bonus from having fresh ingredients, even if not in wilderness. If you do this in the wilderness, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus instead.
_desc_ko: 신선한 허브가 만들어내는 차이는 놀랍습니다. @link[feats.natural-medicine]을 사용하여 @link[actions.treat-wounds]를 할 때, 야생이 아닌 곳에서도 신선한 재료를 사용함으로써 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 야생에서 이를 수행할 경우, 대신 +4 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Sacred Ground

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You pray continuously for 1 minute to call a subtle shadow of your deity's realm over a @Template[burst|distance:30] centered on you. It lasts for 10 minutes, and a creature that remains in the area for the entire 10 minutes regains Hit Points equal to your level. If you have a healing font, this activity has the healing and vitality traits and heals living creatures. If you have a harmful font, this activity has the healing and void traits and heals undead creatures (or other creatures with void healing). Clerics with Versatile Font can choose either or both. It can't damage creatures in any case.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You pray continuously for 1 minute to call a subtle shadow of your deity's realm over a @Template[burst|distance:30] centered on you. It lasts for 10 minutes, and a creature that remains in the area for the entire 10 minutes regains Hit Points equal to your level. If you have a healing font, this activity has the healing and vitality traits and heals living creatures. If you have a harmful font, this activity has the healing and void traits and heals undead creatures (or other creatures with void healing). Clerics with Versatile Font can choose either or both. It can't damage creatures in any case.
_desc_ko:
빈도 10분마다 1회

당신은 1분 동안 지속적으로 기도하여 신의 렐름에서 미묘한 그림자를 불러내어 당신을 중심으로 한 30피트 렐름에 드리웁니다. 이 효과는 10분 동안 지속되며, 해당 렐름에 10분 내내 머문 생물은 당신의 레벨에 해당하는 HP를 회복합니다. 치유의 샘을 보유한 경우, 이 활동은 치유 및 활력 특성을 가지며 생명체를 치유합니다. 해악의 샘을 보유한 경우, 이 활동은 치유 및 공허 특성을 가지며 언데드 생물(또는 공허 치유를 가진 다른 생물)을 치유합니다. 다용도 샘을 가진 클레릭은 둘 중 하나 또는 둘 다 선택할 수 있습니다. 어떤 경우에도 생물에게 피해를 줄 수 없습니다.

name: Daring Act

description.value: You attempt a death-defying maneuver to distract your enemies. Select one foe within reach and attempt either an @Check[acrobatics|defense:reflex] or @Check[athletics|defense:reflex] check against your target's Reflex DC. If you succeed, you can Stride up to half your Speed (or up to your full Speed if you critically succeed) without triggering reactions from the target due to your movement, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the next melee attack you attempt against it before the end of your turn.

_desc_en: You attempt a death-defying maneuver to distract your enemies. Select one foe within reach and attempt either an @Check[acrobatics|defense:reflex] or @Check[athletics|defense:reflex] check against your target's Reflex DC. If you succeed, you can Stride up to half your Speed (or up to your full Speed if you critically succeed) without triggering reactions from the target due to your movement, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the next melee attack you attempt against it before the end of your turn.
_desc_ko: 당신은 적의 주의를 분산시키기 위해 목숨을 건 기동을 시도합니다. 손이 닿는 범위 내의 적 하나를 선택하고, 대상의 반사 DC에 대해 곡예 또는 운동 중 하나를 시도합니다. 성공 시, 대상의 반응을 유발하지 않고 이동 속도의 절반까지(대성공 시 전체 속도까지) 이동할 수 있으며, 대상은 당신의 턴 종료 전까지 당신이 시도하는 다음 근접 공격에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 된다.

name: Defensive Armaments

description.value: You use bulky firearms or crossbows to shield your body. Any two-handed firearms and two-handed crossbows you wield gain the parry trait. If an appropriate weapon already has the parry trait, increase the circumstance bonus to AC it grants when used to parry from +1 to +2. While parrying with your weapon, you are immune to splash damage.

_desc_en: You use bulky firearms or crossbows to shield your body. Any two-handed firearms and two-handed crossbows you wield gain the parry trait. If an appropriate weapon already has the parry trait, increase the circumstance bonus to AC it grants when used to parry from +1 to +2. While parrying with your weapon, you are immune to splash damage.
_desc_ko: 당신은 몸통을 보호하기 위해 부피가 큰 화기나 석궁을 방패처럼 사용합니다. 양손 화기 및 양손 석궁을 휘두를 때 해당 무기는 '패리' 특성을 얻습니다. 해당 특성을 이미 가진 무기의 경우, 막기 시 부여하는 상황 보너스가 +1에서 +2로 증가합니다. 무기로 패리하는 동안 방사 피해에 면역됩니다.

name: Vernai Training

description.value:
To resurrect a creature you've slain, a spellcaster must counteract your influence on its death. The DC of this check is equal to your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

In addition, you've undergone training to better make use of your magic. Increase the spell slots you gain from Red Mantis assassin archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest Red Mantis spell slots. You can prepare only spells from the Red Mantis magic school curriculum in these extra slots.

_desc_en:
To resurrect a creature you've slain, a spellcaster must counteract your influence on its death. The DC of this check is equal to your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

In addition, you've undergone training to better make use of your magic. Increase the spell slots you gain from Red Mantis assassin archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest Red Mantis spell slots. You can prepare only spells from the Red Mantis magic school curriculum in these extra slots.
_desc_ko:
당신이 죽인 생물을 부활시키려면, 시전자는 그 죽음에 대한 당신의 영향을 반격해야 합니다. 이 체ックの DC는 당신의 직업 DC나 주문 DC 중 더 높은 쪽과 같습니다.

또한 마법을 더 효과적으로 활용하기 위한 훈련을 받았습니다. 레드 맨티스 암살자 아키타입 피트로 얻는 주문 슬롯을, 가장 높은 두 레드 맨티스 주문 슬롯을 제외한 나머지 주문 레벨당 1씩 증가시킵니다. 이 추가 슬롯에는 레드 맨티스 마법 학파 커리큘럼의 주문만 준비할 수 있습니다.

name: None Shall Know

description.value: Even magical means have a hard time prying information from you. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EoKBlgf6Smt8opaU]{Veil of Privacy} as an innate occult spell once per day, which can only be cast on yourself and is automatically heightened to half your level rounded up.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: Even magical means have a hard time prying information from you. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EoKBlgf6Smt8opaU]{Veil of Privacy} as an innate occult spell once per day, which can only be cast on yourself and is automatically heightened to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 마법적 수단조차 당신에게서 정보를 캐내기 어렵습니다. 하루에 한 번, 선천적 오컬트 주문으로 @link[spells.veil-of-privacy]을 얻습니다. 이 주문은 자신에게만 시전할 수 있으며, 자동으로 레벨의 절반(올림)으로 강화됩니다.

name: Person of Interest

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Sometimes, you need to follow the leads as they come in the middle of an investigation. Choose a creature that you can see who isn't, to your knowledge, tied to any of your current investigations. For the next minute, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.m0f2B7G9eaaTmhFL]{Devise a Stratagem} against that creature as a free action.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Sometimes, you need to follow the leads as they come in the middle of an investigation. Choose a creature that you can see who isn't, to your knowledge, tied to any of your current investigations. For the next minute, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.m0f2B7G9eaaTmhFL]{Devise a Stratagem} against that creature as a free action.
_desc_ko:
발생 빈도 10분마다 한 번

수사 도중 갑자기 나타나는 단서를 따라가야 할 때가 있다. 현재 진행 중인 수사와 관련이 없는 것으로 보이는, 눈에 보이는 생물 하나를 선택하라. 다음 1분 동안, 해당 생물을 대상으로 @link[actions.devise-a-stratagem]를 자유 행동으로 수행할 수 있다.

name: Wrath of the First Ghoul

description.value:
Frequency Once per day

The ravenous maggots inside you become capable of exploding forth from your attacks into the wounds of an opponent, whispering telepathic words of destruction that invoke horrific flashbacks of Kabriri's transformation from elf to ghoul or psychic images of hundreds of maggots bursting from the victim's flesh all at once. Make a melee Strike against a target creature. If it hits, in addition to taking damage from the Strike, the target is affected by a 10th-rank casting of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.m3lcOFm400lQCUps]{Power Word Kill}. If Wrath of the First Ghoul is used against a target elf, Leng ghoul, or worshipper of Pharasma and does not instantly kill the creature, the target takes double damage.

_desc_en:
Frequency Once per day

The ravenous maggots inside you become capable of exploding forth from your attacks into the wounds of an opponent, whispering telepathic words of destruction that invoke horrific flashbacks of Kabriri's transformation from elf to ghoul or psychic images of hundreds of maggots bursting from the victim's flesh all at once. Make a melee Strike against a target creature. If it hits, in addition to taking damage from the Strike, the target is affected by a 10th-rank casting of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.m3lcOFm400lQCUps]{Power Word Kill}. If Wrath of the First Ghoul is used against a target elf, Leng ghoul, or worshipper of Pharasma and does not instantly kill the creature, the target takes double damage.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신 내부의 탐욕스러운 구더기들이 공격을 통해 적의 상처 속으로 폭발적으로 튀어나와, 카브리리가 엘프에서 구울로 변모하는 끔찍한 회상이나 수백 마리의 구더기가 피해자의 살갗에서 한꺼번에 터져 나오는 사이킥 이미지를 불러일으키는 파괴의 텔레파시 속삭임을 전합니다. 대상 생물에게 근접 공격을 시도하십시오. 명중 시, 타격으로 인한 피해 외에도 대상은 10랭크의 @link[spells.power-word-kill] 시전 효과를 받는다. 첫 번째 구울의 분노가 엘프, 렝 구울, 파라스마 숭배자를 대상으로 사용되었으나 즉시 처치하지 못했을 경우, 대상은 두 배의 피해를 입는다.

name: Saoc Astrology

description.value:
Access Lirgeni nationality

Frequency 3 times per day

Requirements You must spend 10 minutes just after your daily preparations examining the sky or consulting a star chart or you can't use this action that day.

The ancient Saoc Brethren were the masters of astrology, and while your knowledge may be but a pale shadow of their wisdom, it still comes in handy. You recall the stars' predictions about your current situation. If your next action requires you to attempt one or more skill checks, roll 1d8. On a result of 6, 7, or 8, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the first such skill check you attempt. On a 3, 4, or 5, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus. On a 2, you gain nothing. On a 1, you take a –1 circumstance penalty to the skill check.

_desc_en:
Access Lirgeni nationality

Frequency 3 times per day

Requirements You must spend 10 minutes just after your daily preparations examining the sky or consulting a star chart or you can't use this action that day.

The ancient Saoc Brethren were the masters of astrology, and while your knowledge may be but a pale shadow of their wisdom, it still comes in handy. You recall the stars' predictions about your current situation. If your next action requires you to attempt one or more skill checks, roll 1d8. On a result of 6, 7, or 8, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the first such skill check you attempt. On a 3, 4, or 5, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus. On a 2, you gain nothing. On a 1, you take a –1 circumstance penalty to the skill check.
_desc_ko:
빈도 하루 3회

접근 리르게니 국적

요구 사항 매일 준비를 마친 직후 10분 동안 하늘을 관찰하거나 별자리를 확인해야 하며, 그렇지 않으면 당일 이 행동을 사용할 수 없습니다.

고대 사오크 형제단은 점성술의 마스터였으며, 당신의 지식은 그들의 지혜에 비하면 미약할지라도 여전히 유용합니다. 당신은 현재 상황에 대한 별들의 예언을 떠올립니다. 다음 행동에 하나 이상의 기술 시도 검사가 필요할 경우, 1d8을 굴리십시오. 결과가 6, 7, 8일 경우, 시도하는 첫 번째 해당 기술 판정에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 3, 4, 5일 경우 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 2일 경우 아무것도 얻지 못합니다. 1일 경우 기술 판정에서 -1 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Tongue of Sun and Moon

description.value: You have transcended the barriers between words and meaning. You can speak and understand all spoken languages.

_desc_en: You have transcended the barriers between words and meaning. You can speak and understand all spoken languages.
_desc_ko: 당신은 말과 의미 사이의 장벽을 초월했습니다. 모든 구어체를 말하고 이해할 수 있습니다.

name: Perplex

description.value:
You weave a confusing web of half-truths, conspiracy theories, and plausible motives to goad an enemy into lashing out wildly. Choose a target within 30 feet that can hear you, and attempt a @Check[diplomacy|against:will] check against its Will DC. The creature is then immune to Perplex for 24 hours.

Critical Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is unaffected.

_desc_en:
You weave a confusing web of half-truths, conspiracy theories, and plausible motives to goad an enemy into lashing out wildly. Choose a target within 30 feet that can hear you, and attempt a @Check[diplomacy|against:will] check against its Will DC. The creature is then immune to Perplex for 24 hours.

Critical Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is unaffected.
_desc_ko:
당신은 반쪽짜리 진실, 음모론, 그럴듯한 동기를 엮어 혼란스러운 그물을 짜서, 적이 무모하게 날뛰도록 부추긴다. 30피트 이내에서 당신의 말을 들을 수 있는 대상 하나를 선택하고, 그 의지 DC를 상대로 @Check[diplomacy|against:will] 판정을 시도한다. 그 후 그 크리처는 24시간 동안 당혹에 면역이 된다.

대성공 대상은 1라운드 동안 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{멍함 3}과 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{혼란} 상태가 된다.

성공 대상은 1라운드 동안 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{멍함 1} 상태가 된다.

실패 대상은 영향받지 않는다.

name: Ode to Ouroboros

description.value: You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.DgCS456mXKw97vNy]{Ode to Ouroboros} composition spell, which enables you to temporarily spare your allies from death.

_desc_en: You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.DgCS456mXKw97vNy]{Ode to Ouroboros} composition spell, which enables you to temporarily spare your allies from death.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @link[spells.ode-to-ouroboros] 작곡 주문을 습득하여, 일시적으로 아군을 죽음으로부터 구할 수 있게 됩니다.

name: Emerald Boughs Hideaway

description.value: You use Emerald Bough techniques to create a small extradimensional space called a hideaway that lasts as long as you are conscious. The hideaway functions as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.jaEEvuQ32GjAa8jy]{Bag of Holding (Type I)}, but has no Bulk and takes no hands; it holds one object with a maximum Bulk equal to your highest mental ability score modifier; as you open the hideaway with pure thought, activating it to retrieve an item is a free action with the envision component instead of a single action with the Interact component. The hideaway's access point appears as an obviously magical gap within 1 foot of your body. Only you can access the hideaway; you can you use an Interact action each round to physically hold it open for another person. A successful dispel magic spell or similar effect against your spell DC and the hideaway's counteract rank of 2 expels the object; the object is also expelled if you become unconscious. After a successful dispel magic spell or when you become conscious again, the hideaway immediately reforms with no additional action from you. You can also dismiss the hideaway (if it is empty) or re-form it using a single action with the envision component.

The hideaway functions as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.jaEEvuQ32GjAa8jy]{Bag of Holding (Type I)}, but has no Bulk and takes no hands; it holds one object with a maximum Bulk equal to your highest mental ability score modifier; as you open the hideaway with pure thought, activating it to retrieve an item is a free action with the envision component instead of a single action with the Interact component. The hideaway's access point appears as an obviously magical gap within 1 foot of your body. Only you can access the hideaway; you can you use an Interact action each round to physically hold it open for another person. A successful dispel magic spell or similar effect against your spell DC and the hideaway's counteract rank of 2 expels the object; the object is also expelled if you become unconscious. After a successful dispel magic spell or when you become conscious again, the hideaway immediately reforms with no additional action from you. You can also dismiss the hideaway (if it is empty) or re-form it using a single action with the envision component.
_desc_ko: 에메랄드 가지 기술을 사용해 의식이 있는 동안 지속되는 은신처라는 소형 초차원 공간을 생성합니다. 이 은신처는 @link[equipment.spacious-pouch-type-i]과 동일하게 작동하지만 벌크 제한이 없고 손을 차지 않습니다. 최대 벌크는 당신의 최고 정신 능력치 수정자와 동일하며, 하나의 물품을 보관할 수 있습니다. 은신처는 순수한 생각만으로 열 수 있으므로, 물품을 꺼내기 위해 활성화하는 것은 상호작용 구성 요소가 필요한 액션 하나가 아닌, 시각화 구성 요소가 필요한 자유 행동입니다. 은신처의 접근 지점은 당신의 신체에서 1피트 이내에 위치한 명백히 마법적인 틈새로 나타납니다. 오직 당신만이 은신처에 접근할 수 있습니다. 매 라운드 상호작용 행동을 사용해 다른 사람이 물리적으로 열려 있도록 유지할 수 있습니다. 당신의 주문 DC와 은신처의 2랭크 반격에 성공한 마법 해제 주문이나 유사 효과는 물건을 배출합니다. 당신이 의식을 잃을 경우에도 물건이 배출됩니다. 마법 해제 주문이 성공하거나 의식을 되찾으면, 은신처는 추가 행동 없이 즉시 재형성됩니다. 또한 빈 상태일 때 은신처를 해제하거나, 시각화 구성 요소를 사용해 액션 하나로 재구성할 수 있습니다.

name: Commander's Companion

description.value:
You gain the service of a young animal companion. You can affix your banner to your companion's saddle, barding, or a simple harness, determining the effects of your commander's banner and other abilities that use your banner from your companion's space, even if you are not currently riding your companion. A companion granted by this feat always counts as one of your squadmates and does not count against your maximum number of squadmates.

Special When you use Command an Animal to command the companion granted by this feat, it gains a reaction it can only use in response to your tactics. This reaction is lost if it is not used by the end of your turn.

_desc_en:
You gain the service of a young animal companion. You can affix your banner to your companion's saddle, barding, or a simple harness, determining the effects of your commander's banner and other abilities that use your banner from your companion's space, even if you are not currently riding your companion. A companion granted by this feat always counts as one of your squadmates and does not count against your maximum number of squadmates.

Special When you use Command an Animal to command the companion granted by this feat, it gains a reaction it can only use in response to your tactics. This reaction is lost if it is not used by the end of your turn.
_desc_ko:
젊은 동물 동료의 봉사를 얻습니다. 동물 동료의 안장, 갑옷, 또는 간단한 고삐에 당신의 깃발을 부착할 수 있으며, 이는 당신이 현재 동물 동료를 타고 있지 않더라도 동물 동료의 위치에서 커맨더의 깃발 효과 및 깃발을 사용하는 다른 능력들을 결정합니다. 이 피트로 부여받은 동반자는 항상 당신의 분대원 중 하나로 간주되며, 분대원 최대 수에 포함되지 않습니다.

특수 이 피트로 부여받은 동료에게 '동물을 지휘하다'를 사용할 때, 동료는 당신의 전술에 반응하여만 사용할 수 있는 반응을 얻습니다. 이 반응은 당신의 턴이 끝날 때까지 사용하지 않으면 소멸됩니다.

name: Anthropomorphic Shape

description.value: Humanoids' supposed place apart from animals is folly—taking on their forms just requires some extra practice. You add the shapes listed in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2qGqa33E4GPUCbMV]{Humanoid Form} to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form} list.

_desc_en: Humanoids' supposed place apart from animals is folly—taking on their forms just requires some extra practice. You add the shapes listed in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2qGqa33E4GPUCbMV]{Humanoid Form} to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form} list.
_desc_ko: 인간형 생물이 동물과 별개로 존재한다는 생각은 어리석은 일이다-그들의 형태를 취하는 데는 단지 추가 연습이 필요할 뿐이다. 당신은 @link[spells.humanoid-form]에 나열된 형태들을 당신의 @link[spells.untamed-form] 목록에 추가한다.

name: Bone Spikes

description.value:
Sharp shards of bone tear forth from your elbows, wrists, or other parts of your body. For 1 minute, you can make bone spike unarmed Strikes, which deal 1d6 piercing damage and have the versatile S and sweep traits. When you take the Bone Spikes action, you can choose one weapon on your person and duplicate its weapon runes onto your bone spikes (with the exception of any runes that couldn't apply to the bone spears).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ZsO5juyylVoxUkXh]{Effect: Bone Spikes}

Awakening Your bones grow longer, lashing flexibly at range. While you have bone spikes, you can Interact to give your bone spikes reach 10 feet until the end of the current turn.

Awakening Grooves in your bone spikes form a channel for venom. Your bone spikes deal 1d4 persistent poison damage, which increases to 2d4 at 10th level and 3d4 at 18th level.

_desc_en:
Sharp shards of bone tear forth from your elbows, wrists, or other parts of your body. For 1 minute, you can make bone spike unarmed Strikes, which deal 1d6 piercing damage and have the versatile S and sweep traits. When you take the Bone Spikes action, you can choose one weapon on your person and duplicate its weapon runes onto your bone spikes (with the exception of any runes that couldn't apply to the bone spears).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ZsO5juyylVoxUkXh]{Effect: Bone Spikes}

Awakening Your bones grow longer, lashing flexibly at range. While you have bone spikes, you can Interact to give your bone spikes reach 10 feet until the end of the current turn.

Awakening Grooves in your bone spikes form a channel for venom. Your bone spikes deal 1d4 persistent poison damage, which increases to 2d4 at 10th level and 3d4 at 18th level.
_desc_ko:
팔꿈치, 손목 또는 신체의 다른 부위에서 날카로운 뼈 조각들이 튀어나옵니다. 1분 동안, 뼈 가시로 비무장 공격을 가할 수 있으며, 이는 1d6 관통 피해를 입히고 다용도 S 및 쓸기 특성을 가집니다. 뼈 가시 행동을 취할 때, 몸에 지닌 무기 하나를 선택하여 그 무기의 룬을 뼈 가시에 복제할 수 있습니다(뼈 창에 적용될 수 없는 룬은 제외).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ZsO5juyylVoxUkXh]{효과: 뼈 가시}

각성 뼈가 길게 자라 유연하게 휘둘러 공격한다. 뼈가 있는 동안 상호작용을 통해 뼈의 도달 거리를 10피트까지 늘릴 수 있다(현재 턴 종료 시까지).

각성 뼈 가시에 새겨진 홈이 맹독을 흘러내리게 하는 통로 역할을 한다. 뼈 가시는 1d4 지속 맹독 피해를 입히며, (10th) 2d4, 18레벨에 3d4로 증가한다.

name: Persistent Odor

description.value: Your pheromones now linger on creatures. When a target fails its save against your Emit Defensive Odor ability, they also take @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -1)/4) - 1)d6[persistent,poison]] damage. The damage increases to 2d6 at 13th level and 3d6 at 17th level.

_desc_en: Your pheromones now linger on creatures. When a target fails its save against your Emit Defensive Odor ability, they also take @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -1)/4) - 1)d6[persistent,poison]] damage. The damage increases to 2d6 at 13th level and 3d6 at 17th level.
_desc_ko: 이제 당신의 페로몬이 생물에게 오래 남습니다. 대상이 당신의 방어적 냄새 발산 능력에 대한 저항 검사에서 실패하면, 독의 추가 피해를 입습니다. 이 피해는 13레벨에 2d6, 17레벨에 3d6로 증가합니다.

name: Eternal Boost

description.value:
Your link with your eidolon is so intense that you continuously reinforce its abilities. You are permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}; you can use your extra action only to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HStu2Yhw3iQER9tY]{Boost Eidolon} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TYbCj4dgXDOZou9k]{Reinforce Eidolon}.

While in exploration mode, you can declare that you are also continually casting boost eidolon or reinforce eidolon even while using a different exploration activity. If you do, even before your first turn in a combat encounter, that cantrip is active as if you had cast it on your previous turn.

_desc_en:
Your link with your eidolon is so intense that you continuously reinforce its abilities. You are permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}; you can use your extra action only to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HStu2Yhw3iQER9tY]{Boost Eidolon} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TYbCj4dgXDOZou9k]{Reinforce Eidolon}.

While in exploration mode, you can declare that you are also continually casting boost eidolon or reinforce eidolon even while using a different exploration activity. If you do, even before your first turn in a combat encounter, that cantrip is active as if you had cast it on your previous turn.
_desc_ko:
당신과 에이돌론의 연결이 매우 강렬하여 지속적으로 그 능력을 강화합니다. 당신은 영구적으로 @link[conditions.quickened] 상태이며, 추가 행동은 오직 @link[spells.boost-eidolon]나 @link[spells.reinforce-eidolon] 시전에만 사용할 수 있습니다.

탐색 모드 중일 때, 다른 탐색 활동을 수행하는 중에도 지속적으로 에이돌론 강화 또는 에이돌론 보강을 시전한다고 선언할 수 있다. 이 경우, 전투에서 첫 턴이 시작되기 전이라도 해당 캔트립은 마치 이전 턴에 시전한 것처럼 활성화됩니다.

name: Great Cleave

description.value: Your fury carries your weapon through multiple foes. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.GE96a0UGPYM74qjI]{Cleave}, if your Strike also reduces its target to 0 HP, you can continue to make melee Strikes until you make a Strike that doesn't reduce a creature to 0 HP, or until there are no creatures adjacent to the most recent creature you attacked while Cleaving, whichever comes first.

_desc_en: Your fury carries your weapon through multiple foes. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.GE96a0UGPYM74qjI]{Cleave}, if your Strike also reduces its target to 0 HP, you can continue to make melee Strikes until you make a Strike that doesn't reduce a creature to 0 HP, or until there are no creatures adjacent to the most recent creature you attacked while Cleaving, whichever comes first.
_desc_ko: 분노가 무기를 이끌어 여러 적을 관통한다. @link[feats.cleave]를 사용할 때, 공격이 대상의 HP를 0으로 감소시킨다면, 클리브로 공격한 가장 최근의 생물과 인접한 생물이 없거나, 클리브로 공격한 생물의 HP를 0으로 감소시키지 않는 근접 공격을 할 때까지 근접 공격을 계속할 수 있습니다. 둘 중 먼저 발생하는 경우까지.

name: Sympathetic Vulnerabilities

description.value:
When you apply your will to invoke a vulnerability, the result is more powerful, and the vulnerability ripples out in a web from your main target to affect a broader range of creatures. This has one of two effects, based on the type of vulnerability you invoked.

While you have mortal weakness applied, your Strikes also apply that weakness against any creature that has that weakness, not just creatures of the exact same kind. For instance, if you used mortal weakness against a cinder dragon to apply its weakness to cold to your Strikes, those Strikes would also apply to the weakness to cold of fire elementals or any other creature with a weakness to cold.

While you have personal antithesis applied to a non-humanoid creature, you can apply your custom weakness to all creatures of the exact same kind. For example, if you used personal antithesis against an ort, the custom weakness would apply to other orts but not to other types of devils.

_desc_en:
When you apply your will to invoke a vulnerability, the result is more powerful, and the vulnerability ripples out in a web from your main target to affect a broader range of creatures. This has one of two effects, based on the type of vulnerability you invoked.

While you have mortal weakness applied, your Strikes also apply that weakness against any creature that has that weakness, not just creatures of the exact same kind. For instance, if you used mortal weakness against a cinder dragon to apply its weakness to cold to your Strikes, those Strikes would also apply to the weakness to cold of fire elementals or any other creature with a weakness to cold.

While you have personal antithesis applied to a non-humanoid creature, you can apply your custom weakness to all creatures of the exact same kind. For example, if you used personal antithesis against an ort, the custom weakness would apply to other orts but not to other types of devils.
_desc_ko:
약점을 발동할 때 의지를 집중하면 효과가 강화되며, 주요 대상에서 거미줄처럼 퍼져 더 넓은 범위의 생물에게 영향을 미칩니다. 발동한 약점 유형에 따라 다음 두 효과 중 하나가 적용됩니다.

치명적 약점이 적용된 동안, 당신의 공격은 동일한 종류의 생물뿐만 아니라 해당 약점을 가진 모든 생물에게도 그 약점을 적용합니다. 예를 들어, 레드 드래곤에게 치명적 약점을 사용해 그 약점인 냉기에 대한 약점을 당신의 공격에 적용했다면, 그 공격은 불 정령이나 냉기에 약점을 가진 다른 생물의 냉기 약점에도 적용됩니다.

비인간형 생물에게 개인적 대립이 적용된 상태에서는, 동일한 종류의 모든 생물에게 당신의 맞춤형 약점을 적용할 수 있습니다. 예를 들어 임프에게 개인적 대립을 사용했다면, 맞춤형 약점은 다른 임프에게는 적용되지만 임프가 아닌 다른 데빌에게는 적용되지 않습니다.

name: Luck of the Clowder

description.value: When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7qBuzHY8kEG8SdEP]{Cat's Luck} to reroll, any creatures you choose within 10 feet who also just failed against the same effect (such as a single spell) can also reroll their saving throws and use the better result.

_desc_en: When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7qBuzHY8kEG8SdEP]{Cat's Luck} to reroll, any creatures you choose within 10 feet who also just failed against the same effect (such as a single spell) can also reroll their saving throws and use the better result.
_desc_ko: 당신이 @link[feats.cats-luck]을 사용해 재굴림할 때, 10피트 이내에 있는 당신이 선택한 모든 생물들 중 동일한 효과(예: 단일 주문)에 대해 방금 실패한 생물들도 그들의 내성 굴림을 재굴림하고 더 나은 결과를 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Star Orb

description.value: Your magic has crystallized into a spherical stone. You gain a familiar, except it's a star orb: a Tiny stone of light Bulk. The familiar has no Speeds and must select a Speed familiar ability before it can move, animating in a way appropriate to the chosen Speed and using the statistics of a normal familiar for that day; when it's an immobile stone, it can't select any familiar or master abilities that require it to move. It always has the innate surge master ability, which counts against your limit for familiar and master abilities.

_desc_en: Your magic has crystallized into a spherical stone. You gain a familiar, except it's a star orb: a Tiny stone of light Bulk. The familiar has no Speeds and must select a Speed familiar ability before it can move, animating in a way appropriate to the chosen Speed and using the statistics of a normal familiar for that day; when it's an immobile stone, it can't select any familiar or master abilities that require it to move. It always has the innate surge master ability, which counts against your limit for familiar and master abilities.
_desc_ko: 당신의 마법이 구형의 돌로 결정화되었습니다. 당신은 패밀리어를 얻지만, 이는 별의 구슬입니다: 빛의 작은 돌로, 벌크가 있습니다. 이 패밀리어신은 이동 속도가 없으며, 움직이기 전에 속도의 패밀리어 능력을 선택해야 합니다. 선택한 속도에 맞는 방식으로 움직이며, 그날은 일반 패밀리어의 능력치를 사용합니다. 움직이지 않는 돌 상태일 때는 이동이 필요한 속도의 패밀리어 또는 주인 능력을 선택할 수 없습니다. 항상 선천적 능력인 서지 마스터 능력을 가지며, 이는 패밀리어 및 마스터 능력 제한에 포함됩니다.

name: Dashing Strike

description.value:
Requirements You are adjacent to an enemy.

Springing away from one foe, you Strike at another. Stride up to your Speed, but you must end that movement within melee reach of a different enemy. At the end of your movement, make a melee Strike against an enemy now within reach. You can use Dashing Strike while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are adjacent to an enemy.

Springing away from one foe, you Strike at another. Stride up to your Speed, but you must end that movement within melee reach of a different enemy. At the end of your movement, make a melee Strike against an enemy now within reach. You can use Dashing Strike while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 적과 인접해 있어야 한다.

한 적에게서 뛰어오르며 다른 적을 공격한다. 이동 속도만큼 전진하되, 반드시 다른 적의 근접 공격 범위 내에서 이동을 종료해야 한다. 이동 종료 시, 이제 범위 내에 있는 적에게 근접 공격을 가한다. 해당 이동 유형을 보유한 경우, 전진 대신 땅속 이동, 등반, 비행, 수영 중 하나를 사용하며 돌진 공격을 수행할 수 있다.

name: Defensive Recovery

description.value:
Your faith provides temporary protection in addition to healing. If the next action you use is to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} on a single target and the target regains Hit Points from the spell, it also gains a +2 status bonus to AC and saving throws for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.jwxurN6JPQm9wXug]{Effect: Defensive Recovery}

_desc_en:
Your faith provides temporary protection in addition to healing. If the next action you use is to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} on a single target and the target regains Hit Points from the spell, it also gains a +2 status bonus to AC and saving throws for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.jwxurN6JPQm9wXug]{Effect: Defensive Recovery}
_desc_ko:
당신의 신앙은 치유 외에도 일시적인 보호를 제공합니다. 다음 행동으로 단일 대상에게 @link[spells.harm] 또는 @link[spells.heal]를 시전할 경우, 대상이 해당 주문으로 HP를 회복하면 1라운드 동안 AC와 내성 굴림에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.jwxurN6JPQm9wXug]{효과: 방어적 회복}

name: Clean Take

description.value:
Trigger You fail, but don't critically fail, a Deception or Performance check to portray a famous figure.

Thanks to many long hours of rehearsals, your acting skill is infinitely adaptable. Even when your impressions don't quite hit the mark, you're able to refine and tweak your performance on the spot. Reroll the triggering check and take the second result.

_desc_en:
Trigger You fail, but don't critically fail, a Deception or Performance check to portray a famous figure.

Thanks to many long hours of rehearsals, your acting skill is infinitely adaptable. Even when your impressions don't quite hit the mark, you're able to refine and tweak your performance on the spot. Reroll the triggering check and take the second result.
_desc_ko:
발동 유명 인물을 연기하기 위한 기만 또는 연기 능력 판정에서 실패하지만 대실패는 아닙니다.

수많은 연습 시간 덕분에 당신의 연기력은 무한히 유연합니다. 비록 흉내 내기가 완벽하지 않더라도, 즉석에서 연기를 다듬고 조정할 수 있습니다. 트리거링 판정을 재굴림하고 두 번째 결과를 적용하세요.

name: Instrument of Death

description.value:
Your splinter of finality has reached the apex of its death-dealing potential. Whenever you critically succeed at an attack roll against an enemy and use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Xz9jmwwJnx17PjCu]{Lethal Edge}, add the following effects to the list you can choose from.

  • The target is cursed and can't benefit from circumstance or status bonuses. This is a curse effect.
  • The target gains weakness 10 to spirit damage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.Y2xjlHMGvr8Mkg3r]{Effect: Instrument of Death}

_desc_en:
Your splinter of finality has reached the apex of its death-dealing potential. Whenever you critically succeed at an attack roll against an enemy and use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Xz9jmwwJnx17PjCu]{Lethal Edge}, add the following effects to the list you can choose from.

  • The target is cursed and can't benefit from circumstance or status bonuses. This is a curse effect.
  • The target gains weakness 10 to spirit damage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.Y2xjlHMGvr8Mkg3r]{Effect: Instrument of Death}
_desc_ko:
당신의 최후의 파편이 살상력의 정점에 도달했습니다. 적에 대한 명중 굴림에서 대성공을 기록하고 @link[feats.lethal-edge]을 사용할 때마다, 선택 가능한 효과 목록에 다음을 추가한다.

  • 대상은 저주받아 상황 보너스나 상태 보너스를 받을 수 없다. 이는 저주 효과이다.
  • 대상은 영혼 피해에 대해 약점 10을 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.Y2xjlHMGvr8Mkg3r]{효과: 죽음의 도구}

name: Tactical Acumen

description.value:
Even if you don't know much about its constituent creatures, you can always recognize a troop's capabilities through features like the formation they move in or even more subtle hints others might miss. You can always use Warfare Lore when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} to identify a troop. This works like using an applicable Lore to identify a creature. If you're legendary in Warfare Lore, reduce any adjustment to the Recall Knowledge check's DC caused by the troop's rarity by 5.

If you lead a troop, when you successfully use Warfare Lore to identify a troop, that troop takes a –1 circumstance penalty to saves against your troop's offensive abilities until the end of your next turn.
