Transcendence—@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cfQb0mBbyrjhyGf5]{Plant Thirty Barbs} 1 (death, transcendence)

@Embed[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cfQb0mBbyrjhyGf5 inline]
_desc_ko:
사용법 관통 또는 베기 피해를 주는 무기 이콘에 주입

이콘의 칼날에 하나 이상의 홈이 생겨, 적에게 치명적인 고통을 줄 수 있다.

내재성 이콘으로 공격할 때, 주사위 결과 19가 성공으로 굴림될 경우 대성공을 얻습니다. 실패로 굴림될 경우 19에는 효과가 없습니다.

초월-@link[actions.plant-thirty-barbs] 1 (죽음, 초월)

@link[actions.plant-thirty-barbs]

name: Restitch

description.value: You've learned how to sew even the most terrible tears and wounds together. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2Vkd1IxylPceUAAF]{Regenerate} as a 7th-rank arcane innate spell once per day.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en: You've learned how to sew even the most terrible tears and wounds together. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2Vkd1IxylPceUAAF]{Regenerate} as a 7th-rank arcane innate spell once per day.
_desc_ko: 가장 끔찍한 찢김과 상처조차 봉합하는 법을 익혔습니다. 하루에 한 번 @link[spells.regenerate]을 (7th)랭크 아케인 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Acute Scent

description.value: When your anger is heightened, your sense of smell improves. While you're raging, you gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet.

_desc_en: When your anger is heightened, your sense of smell improves. While you're raging, you gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet.
_desc_ko: 분노가 강화되면 후각이 예민해집니다. 격노 상태일 때, 30피트 범위 내의 대략적인 냄새를 감지할 수 있습니다.

name: Storyteller's Mask

description.value: Your mask remembers the stories of Shifting Frog, Storyteller of the Past and Future. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qsNeG9KZpODSACMq]{Foresight} once per day as an innate spell, either arcane if you have Wizard Dedication or primal if you have Druid Dedication, but the duration is 10 minutes instead of 1 hour. Immediately after you Cast a non-cantrip Spell that targets only a single foe, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about that foe.

_desc_en: Your mask remembers the stories of Shifting Frog, Storyteller of the Past and Future. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qsNeG9KZpODSACMq]{Foresight} once per day as an innate spell, either arcane if you have Wizard Dedication or primal if you have Druid Dedication, but the duration is 10 minutes instead of 1 hour. Immediately after you Cast a non-cantrip Spell that targets only a single foe, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about that foe.
_desc_ko: 당신의 가면은 과거와 미래의 이야기꾼, 변신하는 개구리의 이야기를 기억합니다. 당신은 하루에 한 번 @link[spells.foresight]를 선천적 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 위자드 헌신이나 드루이드 헌신을 가진 경우 아케인 주문으로, 프라이멀 헌신을 가진 경우 프라이멀 주문으로 시전할 수 있으나, 지속 시간은 1시간 대신 10분입니다. 단일 적만을 대상으로 하는 비캔트립 주문을 시전한 직후, 해당 적에 대한 @link[actions.recall-knowledge]을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: My Claws are Daggers

description.value:
Your claws are as sharp as your teeth. You gain a claw unarmed attack that deals 1d6 slashing damage. Your claws are in the knife group and have the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits. At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with your claws or jaws, you get its critical specialization effect.

Special If your dragonet heritage is house drake, your claws count as silver.

_desc_en:
Your claws are as sharp as your teeth. You gain a claw unarmed attack that deals 1d6 slashing damage. Your claws are in the knife group and have the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits. At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with your claws or jaws, you get its critical specialization effect.

Special If your dragonet heritage is house drake, your claws count as silver.
_desc_ko:
당신의 발톱은 이빨만큼이나 날카롭다. 당신은 1d6 참격 피해를 입히는 발톱 비무장 공격을 얻는다. 당신의 발톱은 나이프 부류에 속하며 기민, 정교, 비무장 특성을 지닌다. 5레벨에, 당신이 발톱이나 턱으로 대성공을 거둘 때마다 그 부류의 대성공 특화 효과를 얻는다.

특별 당신의 드래고닛 혈통이 하우스 드레이크라면, 당신의 발톱은 은으로 간주한다.

name: Cathartic Mage Dedication

description.value:
You've learned to harness a particular emotion and mix it into your magic. Choose an emotion to be your catharsis emotion.

If you don't already cast spells from spell slots, you learn to cast spontaneous spells and gain the Cast a Spell activity. You gain a spell repertoire with one cantrip of your choice, from a spell list of your choice. You choose this cantrip from the common spells on your chosen spell list or from other spells to which you have access on that list. You're trained in spell attack rolls and spell DCs for that tradition. Your key spellcasting ability for these spells is Charisma.

If you can already cast spells from spell slots, you learn one additional cantrip from your spellcasting tradition. If you're a prepared caster, you can prepare this spell in addition to your usual cantrips per day; if you're a spontaneous caster, you add this cantrip to your spell repertoire.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2424g94rpoiN1IPh]{Catharsis} reaction and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EhLvRWFKhZ3HtrZO]{Settle Emotions} activity.

Emotional States:

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.EWiUv3UiR3RHSGlA#anger]{Anger}

value.value: Charisma +2 or ability to cast spells from spell slots

_desc_en:
You've learned to harness a particular emotion and mix it into your magic. Choose an emotion to be your catharsis emotion.

If you don't already cast spells from spell slots, you learn to cast spontaneous spells and gain the Cast a Spell activity. You gain a spell repertoire with one cantrip of your choice, from a spell list of your choice. You choose this cantrip from the common spells on your chosen spell list or from other spells to which you have access on that list. You're trained in spell attack rolls and spell DCs for that tradition. Your key spellcasting ability for these spells is Charisma.

If you can already cast spells from spell slots, you learn one additional cantrip from your spellcasting tradition. If you're a prepared caster, you can prepare this spell in addition to your usual cantrips per day; if you're a spontaneous caster, you add this cantrip to your spell repertoire.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2424g94rpoiN1IPh]{Catharsis} reaction and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EhLvRWFKhZ3HtrZO]{Settle Emotions} activity.

_desc_ko:
특정 감정을 활용하여 마법에 혼합하는 법을 익혔습니다. 카타르시스 감정으로 삼을 감정을 선택하십시오.

마법 슬롯으로 마법을 시전하지 않는 경우, 즉흥 시전을 배우고 '마법 시전' 행동을 획득합니다. 선택한 마법 목록에서 원하는 캔트립 하나를 포함한 주문 목록을 얻습니다. 이 캔트립은 선택한 마법 목록의 일반 마법이나 해당 목록에서 접근 가능한 다른 마법 중에서 선택합니다. 해당 전통에 대한 주문 명중 굴림과 주문 난이도(DC)에 숙련됩니다. 이 주문들의 주문 시전 능력치는 매력입니다.

이미 주문 슬롯을 통해 주문을 시전할 수 있다면, 해당 주문 시전 전통에서 추가로 한 가지 캔트립을 배운다. 준비형 시전자라면 하루에 시전하는 일반 캔트립에 이 주문을 추가로 준비할 수 있으며, 즉흥형 시전자라면 이 캔트립을 주문 목록에 추가한다.

@link[actions.catharsis] 반응과 @link[actions.settle-emotions] 행동을 획득한다.

Emotional States:

name: Whirling Knockdown

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a loaded one-handed firearm and a one-handed melee weapon.

You fire your gun while throwing off a target's balance with your melee weapon. Then, you topple your foe to the ground with the quick orchestrated combination. You don't need to use brute force to do so, or even necessarily to hit with your gunshot; the effect is all about performing perfectly and eliminating your target's movements and options, leaving them no choice but to fall. Make a ranged firearm Strike against a creature within the reach of your melee weapon and then attempt a @Check[performance|against:reflex] check against the creature's Reflex DC. If the Strike critically succeeds, the target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to its Reflex DC against this check. The Performance check has the following effects.

Critical Success The target falls and lands @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. It takes @Damage[2d6[bludgeoning]] damage from the fall.

Success The target falls and lands prone.

Critical Failure Your plans backfired on you, and you're forced to drop your melee weapon in your space.

_desc_ko:
요구 사항 장전된 한손 화기와 한손 근접 무기를 동시에 사용 중이어야 합니다.

근접 무기로 적의 균형을 무너뜨리는 동시에 총을 발사합니다. 그런 다음 신속하게 조율된 연계를 통해 적을 땅에 쓰러뜨립니다. 이를 위해 무리한 힘을 쓸 필요도, 총알이 명중할 필요도 없습니다. 효과는 완벽한 수행을 통해 적의 움직임과 선택지를 제거하여 쓰러질 수밖에 없게 만드는 데 있습니다. 근접 무기의 도달 범위 내에 있는 생물에게 원거리 화기 공격을 가한 후, 해당 생물의 반사 DC에 대해 공연 판정을 시도한다. 공격이 대성공하면, 대상은 이 판정에서 반사 DC에 -2 상황 페널티를 받는다. 공연 판정에는 다음과 같은 효과가 있습니다.

대성공 대상은 넘어져 @link[conditions.prone]가 됩니다. 추락으로 2d6 타격의 피해를 입습니다.

성공 대상이 넘어져 넘어짐 상태로 착지한다.

대실패 계획이 역효과를 내어, 근접 무기를 자신의 공간에 떨어뜨려야 합니다.

name: Brinesoul

description.value: Your elemental ancestor's legacy asserts itself as brackish water, like the seawater of the ocean. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.b6CanpXyUKJgxEwq]{Salt Wound} reaction.

_desc_en: Your elemental ancestor's legacy asserts itself as brackish water, like the seawater of the ocean. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.b6CanpXyUKJgxEwq]{Salt Wound} reaction.
_desc_ko: 당신의 원소 조상의 유산이 바닷물처럼 짠 기운을 띤 물로 나타납니다. @link[actions.salt-wound] 반응을 얻습니다.

name: Archaeologist's Luck

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You are more than just skillful; your drive to find the secrets of the past manifests as a strange kind of luck. Reroll the failed check and use the new result.

_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

발동 조건 함정(예: 함정 @link[actions.disable-a-device]를 위한 도둑질 검사 또는 효과 회피를 위한 반사 내성 굴림)에 대한 판정에 실패할 때.

당신은 단순히 능숙한 수준을 넘어섭니다. 과거의 비밀을 찾고자 하는 당신의 열망이 특이한 형태의 행운으로 창조됩니다. 실패한 판정을 재굴림하고 새로운 결과를 사용하세요.

name: Correct the Story

description.value:
Trigger An enemy critically succeeds at an attack roll or saving throw.

You know the story of your journey well and can correct it when your enemy tells it incorrectly. Spend a Mythic Point. The enemy must reroll the triggering attack roll or save and take the new result.

_desc_en:
Trigger An enemy critically succeeds at an attack roll or saving throw.

You know the story of your journey well and can correct it when your enemy tells it incorrectly. Spend a Mythic Point. The enemy must reroll the triggering attack roll or save and take the new result.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 적이 명중 굴림 또는 내성 굴림에 대성공을 거둘 때.

당신은 자신의 여정에 관한 이야기를 잘 알고 있으며, 적이 이를 잘못 전할 때 바로잡을 수 있습니다. 신화 포인트를 1점 소모하세요. 적은 발동 명중 굴림 또는 내성 굴림을 재굴려야 하며, 새로운 결과를 받아들여야 합니다.

name: Greenwatcher

description.value: Your experience fighting against and alongside fey creatures is nearly unrivaled. Any weapon you wield or unarmed attack you make against a fey creature is treated as cold iron. Whenever you critically fail a save against a spell cast by a fey creature, it's instead treated as a normal failure. Whenever you critically succeed on a Strike against a fey creature, the target is immediately subject to the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HRb2doyaLtaoCfi3]{Faerie Fire} spell. For the purposes of counteracting this effect, it's an innate 2nd-rank primal spell.

_desc_en: Your experience fighting against and alongside fey creatures is nearly unrivaled. Any weapon you wield or unarmed attack you make against a fey creature is treated as cold iron. Whenever you critically fail a save against a spell cast by a fey creature, it's instead treated as a normal failure. Whenever you critically succeed on a Strike against a fey creature, the target is immediately subject to the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HRb2doyaLtaoCfi3]{Faerie Fire} spell. For the purposes of counteracting this effect, it's an innate 2nd-rank primal spell.
_desc_ko: 요정 생물과의 전투 경험은 거의 따라올 자가 없습니다. 요정 생물을 상대로 휘두르는 무기나 비무장 공격은 모두 냉철한 철로 간주됩니다. 요정 생물이 시전한 주문에 대한 저항 검사에서 대실패를 할 때마다, 이는 일반 실패로 처리됩니다. 페이 생물에게 가한 공격에서 대성공(대성공)을 거둘 때마다, 대상은 즉시 @link[spells.faerie-fire] 주문의 효과를 받습니다. 이 효과를 반격하기 위한 목적으로, 이는 선천적 2랭크 프라이멀 주문으로 간주됩니다.

name: Jotun's Heart

description.value:
You have unlocked the power of a true giant within you. Your size becomes Huge. You have a 10-foot reach. Your maximum Hit Points increase by your level.

Special When you enter @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ein1K7P51cs3Qusw]{Jotun's Battle Stance}, instead of its previous effects, it now increases the reach of any weapon you are wielding, or your fist unarmed attack, by 5 feet.

_desc_en:
You have unlocked the power of a true giant within you. Your size becomes Huge. You have a 10-foot reach. Your maximum Hit Points increase by your level.

Special When you enter @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ein1K7P51cs3Qusw]{Jotun's Battle Stance}, instead of its previous effects, it now increases the reach of any weapon you are wielding, or your fist unarmed attack, by 5 feet.
_desc_ko:
당신은 내면에 잠든 최상급 거인의 힘을 깨웠습니다. 크기가 거대로 변합니다. 10피트의 도달 거리를 가집니다. 최대 HP가 레벨만큼 증가합니다.

특수 @link[feats.jotuns-battle-stance]를 취할 때, 기존 효과 대신 현재 휘두르는 무기나 비무장 공격의 도달 거리가 5피트 증가합니다.

name: Greater Crossblooded Evolution

description.value: Your bloodline is extraordinarily complex. Choose up to three of the sorcerous gift spells granted by your secondary bloodline. You add these spells to your spell repertoire, heightened to the highest rank of spells you can cast or to the highest rank they can be heightened to that is lower than the highest rank of spells you can cast. You cast these spells as the tradition from your primary bloodline.

_desc_en: Your bloodline is extraordinarily complex. Choose up to three of the sorcerous gift spells granted by your secondary bloodline. You add these spells to your spell repertoire, heightened to the highest rank of spells you can cast or to the highest rank they can be heightened to that is lower than the highest rank of spells you can cast. You cast these spells as the tradition from your primary bloodline.
_desc_ko: 당신의 혈통은 매우 복잡합니다. 보조 혈통이 부여한 마법적 재능 주문 중 최대 세 가지를 선택하십시오. 이 주문들을 당신의 주문 목록에 추가하며, 당신이 시전할 수 있는 최고 랭크으로 강화되거나, 당신이 시전할 수 있는 최고 랭크보다 낮으면서도 강화 가능한 최고 랭크으로 강화됩니다. 이 주문들은 주 혈통의 전통으로 시전됩니다.

name: Skirt the Light

description.value: You can travel the border between the Material and Shadow Planes and even bring others along. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rxvS7EMJ7qmexAyA]{Umbral Journey} as an occult innate spell once per day.

_desc_en: You can travel the border between the Material and Shadow Planes and even bring others along. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rxvS7EMJ7qmexAyA]{Umbral Journey} as an occult innate spell once per day.
_desc_ko: 물질계와 그림자계 사이의 경계를 넘나들 수 있으며, 다른 이들을 동반할 수도 있다. 하루에 한 번, @link[spells.umbral-journey]을 오컬트 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있다.

name: Lingering Chill

description.value: The chill of ice entered your veins and never left, adjusting the internal temperature of your body. Your breath comes out in puffs, and your skin is as cold and smooth as the ice in your veins. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IxhGEKl63R4QBvkj]{Frostbite} as a primal innate cantrip. You gain resistance to cold damage equal to half your level, and you're protected from severe cold temperatures.

value.value: You've been brought to 0 Hit Points by an enemy that has the cold trait or an enemy's ability that has the cold trait.

_desc_en: The chill of ice entered your veins and never left, adjusting the internal temperature of your body. Your breath comes out in puffs, and your skin is as cold and smooth as the ice in your veins. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IxhGEKl63R4QBvkj]{Frostbite} as a primal innate cantrip. You gain resistance to cold damage equal to half your level, and you're protected from severe cold temperatures.
_desc_ko: 얼음의 차가움이 당신의 혈관 속으로 스며들어 영원히 머물며, 몸속 온도를 조절합니다. 숨을 내쉴 때마다 하얀 김이 피어오르고, 피부는 혈관 속 얼음처럼 차갑고 매끄럽습니다. 당신은 @link[spells.ray-of-frost]을 프라이멀 선천적 캔트립으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 냉기 피해 저항력을 얻으며, 극한의 추위로부터 보호받는다.

name: Apocalypse Rider Dedication

description.value:
In the darkest hour of the night, a fearsome and terrible steed arrives as a gift from a powerful daemonic patron. You gain an apocalypse mount, which is loyal and follows your commands as long as you work to spread death and destruction. Your apocalypse mount can be any mature animal companion with the mount special ability, though it is obviously touched by daemonic forces. Choose whether your apocalypse mount is a nimble or savage animal companion. During an encounter, even if you don't use the Command an Animal action, your apocalypse mount can still use 1 action on your turn to Stride or Strike.

You also gain the anathema "You forswear any plans to cheat death or build something that will last beyond your own death." If you break this anathema, you lose access to abilities granted by this archetype until you atone or make amends.

Special If you already have an animal companion with the mount special ability, it becomes your apocalypse mount as daemonic energies infuse its form. In such a case, one of your companion's unarmed attacks increases one die size.

_desc_ko:
밤의 가장 어두운 시간에, 강력한 데이모닉 후원자가 선물로 보내는 무시무시하고 끔찍한 탈것이 나타난다. 당신은 종말의 탈것을 얻게 되며, 이는 당신이 죽음과 파괴를 퍼뜨리기 위해 노력하는 한 충성하며 명령을 따른다. 당신의 묵시록 탈것은 탈것 특수 능력을 가진 성숙한 동물 동료라면 무엇이든 될 수 있으나, 데이모닉한 힘이 깃든 흔적이 뚜렷하다. 당신의 묵시록 탈것이 민첩한 동물 동료인지, 야성적인 동물 동료인지 선택하라. 교전 중에는 동물 지휘 행동을 사용하지 않더라도, 당신의 묵시록 탈것은 당신의 턴에 1개의 행동을 사용하여 이동하거나 강타할 수 있다.

또한 "죽음을 속이거나 자신의 죽음 이후에도 지속될 무언가를 만들려는 모든 계획을 포기한다"는 저주를 얻습니다. 이 저주를 어길 경우, 속죄하거나 보상할 때까지 이 아키타입이 부여하는 능력 사용 권한을 상실합니다.

특수 이미 탈것 특수 능력을 가진 동물 동료가 있다면, 데이모닉 에너지가 그 형태에 스며들어 종말의 탈것이 된다. 이 경우 동반자의 비무장 공격 중 하나가 주사위 크기가 한 단계 증가한다.

name: Emit Defensive Odor

description.value:
Frequency once per day

While athamarus' natural pheromones are typically used for communication, you have developed yours into a defense mechanism to ward off foes. You emit a thick spray of defensive pheromones at an adjacent creature, who takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level +1)/2)+1)d6[poison]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:class|basic] save against your class DC.

At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

While athamarus' natural pheromones are typically used for communication, you have developed yours into a defense mechanism to ward off foes. You emit a thick spray of defensive pheromones at an adjacent creature, who takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level +1)/2)+1)d6[poison]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:class|basic] save against your class DC.

At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

아타마루스의 자연 페로몬은 일반적으로 의사소통에 사용되지만, 당신은 이를 방어 기제로 발전시켜 적을 수호부합니다. 인접한 생물에게 방어용 페로몬을 짙게 분사하며, 해당 생물은 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 기본 인내 내성 굴림을 실패할 경우 독의 피해를 입습니다.

3레벨에 도달하고 이후 2레벨마다 피해량이 1d6씩 증가한다.

name: Targeting Strike

description.value:
Your attack creates an opening in your target's defenses for your allies to capitalize on. When you successfully damage an opponent with either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.3OHdjgDGn4yzMD9b]{Guiding Shot} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.f0fpsr8ZSNrWlfAt]{Set-Up Strike}, the next creature other than you to attack the same target before the start of your next turn deals an amount of additional precision damage equal to your Intelligence modifier.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.VBsWZHdYymig9WsH]{Effect: Targeting Strike}

_desc_en:
Your attack creates an opening in your target's defenses for your allies to capitalize on. When you successfully damage an opponent with either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.3OHdjgDGn4yzMD9b]{Guiding Shot} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.f0fpsr8ZSNrWlfAt]{Set-Up Strike}, the next creature other than you to attack the same target before the start of your next turn deals an amount of additional precision damage equal to your Intelligence modifier.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.VBsWZHdYymig9WsH]{Effect: Targeting Strike}
_desc_ko: 당신의 공격은 아군이 활용할 수 있는 상대의 방어 구멍을 만들어 냅니다. 유도 사격이나 준비 공격으로 상대에게 성공적으로 피해를 입혔을 때, 다음 턴이 시작되기 전에 당신 이외의 다음 생물이 같은 대상을 공격하면 당신의 지능 능력치 수정자만큼의 추가 정밀 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Soul Vessel Mount

description.value: Your mount has a supernatural hunger for mortal souls that you can feed. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GYmXvS9NJ7QwfWGg]{Seize Soul} as a divine innate spell. The spell gains a cost of 1 Mythic Point but you can use your apocalypse mount as the item in which you store the soul. Your apocalypse mount counts as an artifact for the purpose of the spell. At any point while your apocalypse mount contains a soul, you can Sustain the spell to allow your apocalypse mount to consume the soul. It regains a number of Hit Points equal to @Damage[(2*@actor.level)[healing]]{twice your level}. For the next minute, it also gains a +20-foot status bonus to its Speed and its unarmed attack Strikes are made at mythic proficiency.

_desc_en: Your mount has a supernatural hunger for mortal souls that you can feed. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GYmXvS9NJ7QwfWGg]{Seize Soul} as a divine innate spell. The spell gains a cost of 1 Mythic Point but you can use your apocalypse mount as the item in which you store the soul. Your apocalypse mount counts as an artifact for the purpose of the spell. At any point while your apocalypse mount contains a soul, you can Sustain the spell to allow your apocalypse mount to consume the soul. It regains a number of Hit Points equal to @Damage[(2*@actor.level)[healing]]{twice your level}. For the next minute, it also gains a +20-foot status bonus to its Speed and its unarmed attack Strikes are made at mythic proficiency.
_desc_ko: 당신의 탈것은 인간 영혼에 대한 초자연적인 갈망을 지니고 있으며, 당신은 이를 먹일 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, 당신은 @link[spells.seize-soul]를 신성 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 주문은 신화 포인트 1점을 추가로 소모하지만, 당신은 종말의 탈것을 영혼을 저장하는 아이템으로 사용할 수 있습니다. 이 주문에서 종말의 탈것은 유물로 간주됩니다. 탈것에 영혼이 저장된 상태에서 언제든지 이 주문을 지속시켜 탈것이 영혼을 흡수하게 할 수 있습니다. 그러면 탈것은 레벨 × 2만큼의 HP를 회복합니다. 이후 1분 동안, 속도에 +20피트 상태 보너스를 얻으며, 비무장 공격은 신화 숙련도로 수행됩니다.

name: Advanced Herbalism

description.value:
Your herbalist talents continue to grow with use and you have become potent at making even more remedies from less. You can create up to 6 herbal items per day with advanced alchemy.

Special At 10th level or higher, you can select this feat a second time to increase the number to 8.

_desc_en:
Your herbalist talents continue to grow with use and you have become potent at making even more remedies from less. You can create up to 6 herbal items per day with advanced alchemy.

Special At 10th level or higher, you can select this feat a second time to increase the number to 8.
_desc_ko:
약초학자의 재능은 사용함에 따라 계속 성장하며, 적은 재료로 더 많은 치료제를 만드는 데 능숙해졌습니다. 고급 연금술로 하루에 최대 6개의 약초 아이템을 제작할 수 있습니다.

특수 10레벨 이상에 도달하면 이 피트를 두 번째로 선택하여 수량을 8개로 늘릴 수 있습니다.

name: Snowdrift Spell

description.value: The howling wind and precipitation of your magic turn to thick snow. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that has the air, water, or cold trait, and that does not have the fire trait, select one creature affected by the spell on the ground. Each square on the ground under or adjacent to the creature fills with ankle-deep snow. Those squares are difficult terrain until the beginning of your next turn. A creature can Interact to clear a square of snow, and the snow in a square melts if that square is exposed to a fire effect.

_desc_en: The howling wind and precipitation of your magic turn to thick snow. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that has the air, water, or cold trait, and that does not have the fire trait, select one creature affected by the spell on the ground. Each square on the ground under or adjacent to the creature fills with ankle-deep snow. Those squares are difficult terrain until the beginning of your next turn. A creature can Interact to clear a square of snow, and the snow in a square melts if that square is exposed to a fire effect.
_desc_ko: 당신의 마법이 만들어낸 울부짖는 바람과 강수 현상이 굵은 눈으로 변합니다. 다음 행동으로 공기, 물, 냉기 특성을 지니고 불 특성을 지니지 않은 주문을 시전할 경우, 지상에 있는 주문에 영향을 받는 생물 한 마리를 선택합니다. 그 생물 아래 또는 인접한 지면의 각 칸은 발목까지 오는 눈으로 채워진다. 해당 칸들은 네 다음 턴 시작까지 어려운 지형이 된다. 생물은 상호작용을 통해 눈 덮인 칸을 치울 수 있으며, 해당 칸이 불 효과에 노출되면 눈이 녹는다.

name: Hot Foot

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a loaded firearm.

Using a carefully aimed shot, you make a creature "dance." You shoot at the ground near a target's feet, causing them to react involuntarily; even mindless creatures have unconscious responses to dodge an attack, and you can capitalize off those uncontrollable reflexes to achieve your aim. As they dance to the sweet tune of your pistol's retort, you ensure your foe can't use whatever nasty surprise they had planned in store for you and your allies. Make an attack roll against the Reflex DC of a target creature within your firearm's first range increment.

Critical Success The creature can't use reactions, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, and takes a -2 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves. These effects last until the start of its next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.3bvYym3Dz6b6xmEK]{Effect: Hot Foot (Critical Success)}

Success The creature can't use reactions until the start of its next turn.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a loaded firearm.

Using a carefully aimed shot, you make a creature "dance." You shoot at the ground near a target's feet, causing them to react involuntarily; even mindless creatures have unconscious responses to dodge an attack, and you can capitalize off those uncontrollable reflexes to achieve your aim. As they dance to the sweet tune of your pistol's retort, you ensure your foe can't use whatever nasty surprise they had planned in store for you and your allies. Make an attack roll against the Reflex DC of a target creature within your firearm's first range increment.

Critical Success The creature can't use reactions, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, and takes a -2 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves. These effects last until the start of its next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.3bvYym3Dz6b6xmEK]{Effect: Hot Foot (Critical Success)}

Success The creature can't use reactions until the start of its next turn.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 장전된 화기를 휘두르고 있어야 합니다.

정밀하게 조준한 사격으로 생물을 "춤추게" 만듭니다. 목표물 발 근처 지면을 향해 발사하여 무의식적인 반응을 유발합니다. 무의식적인 생물조차도 공격을 회피하려는 무의식적 반응을 보이며, 당신은 이러한 통제 불가능한 반사 신경에 편승하여 목표를 달성할 수 있습니다. 당신 권총의 달콤한 반격 소리에 맞춰 그들이 춤추는 동안, 당신은 적들이 당신과 동료를 위해 준비한 어떤 불쾌한 서프라이즈도 사용할 수 없도록 막습니다. 화기의 첫 사거리 구간 내에 있는 대상 생물의 반사 DC에 대해 명중 굴림을 수행하십시오.

대성공 해당 생물은 반응을 사용할 수 없으며, @link[conditions.off-guard]가 되고 반사 내성에 -2 상황 페널티를 받습니다. 이 효과는 다음 턴 시작까지 지속됩니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.3bvYym3Dz6b6xmEK]{효과: 뜨거운 발 (대성공)}

성공 해당 생물은 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 반응을 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Powerful Lash

description.value: You've learned to swing your lash ever faster and in wider arcs. The damage die of your lash increases to 1d6 instead of 1d4 and it gains the sweep trait.

_desc_en: You've learned to swing your lash ever faster and in wider arcs. The damage die of your lash increases to 1d6 instead of 1d4 and it gains the sweep trait.
_desc_ko: 채찍을 더 빠르고 넓은 궤적으로 휘두르는 법을 익혔습니다. 채찍의 피해 주사위가 1d4에서 1d6으로 증가하며, 쓸기 특성을 얻습니다.

name: Skittering Scuttle

description.value: You can scuttle farther and faster when maneuvering alongside allies. When you use Goblin Scuttle, you can Stride up to half your Speed instead of Stepping.

_desc_en: You can scuttle farther and faster when maneuvering alongside allies. When you use Goblin Scuttle, you can Stride up to half your Speed instead of Stepping.
_desc_ko: 동료와 함께 이동할 때 더 멀리, 더 빠르게 스커틀할 수 있습니다. 고블린 스커틀을 사용할 때, 스텝 대신 최대 이동 속도의 절반까지 스트라이드할 수 있습니다.

name: Tracing Sigil

description.value: When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.AUctDF2fqPZN2w4W]{Sigil}, you can modify the spell to add the following to its standard effects: The target leaves a magical trail that you and others can try to follow. You and other creatures can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} the target, substituting an Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion check (whichever matches the magical tradition of your sigil spell) for the Survival check. Much like Tracking with Survival, this must take place somewhere the target has been and follow the trail; it doesn't allow anyone to find the target from a distance. You can only have a single target marked with a modified sigil in this way. If you use this ability again on a second target, the sigil spell on the first target ends, and your mark fades.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

You and other creatures can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} the target, substituting an Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion check (whichever matches the magical tradition of your sigil spell) for the Survival check. _desc_ko: {인장} 주문을 시전할 때, 표준 효과에 다음을 추가하도록 주문을 수정자를 사용하여 조정할 수 있습니다: 대상은 당신과 다른 이들이 추적할 수 있는 마법적 흔적을 남깁니다. 당신과 다른 생물은 대상의 @link[actions.track]을 시도할 수 있으며, 이때 생존 판정 대신 마법 전통에 맞는 주문학, 자연학, 오컬트 또는 종교학 판정을 사용합니다. 생존 판정으로 추적하는 것과 마찬가지로, 이는 대상이 머문 장소에서 흔적을 따라야 하며 거리에서 대상을 찾는 것은 불가능합니다. 이 방식으로 조정된 시그리로 표식된 대상은 한 명만 가질 수 있습니다. 두 번째 대상에게 이 능력을 다시 사용하면 첫 번째 대상의 시그일 주문이 종료되고 표식이 사라집니다.

name: House of Imaginary Walls

description.value: You erect an imaginary barrier others believe to be real. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PEfSofHm73IT3Khc]{House of Imaginary Walls} composition cantrip.

_desc_en: You erect an imaginary barrier others believe to be real. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PEfSofHm73IT3Khc]{House of Imaginary Walls} composition cantrip.
_desc_ko: 당신은 타인이 실재한다고 믿는 상상의 장벽을 세웁니다. 당신은 @link[spells.house-of-imaginary-walls] 구성 캔트립을 익힙니다.

name: Spirit of Vigil

description.value: Though the city of Vigil itself has been destroyed, you will carry on its warrior spirit to the end of your days. The value of your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition at which you die increases by 1 (normally to dying 5, or dying 6 if you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.I0BhPWqYf1bbzEYg]{Diehard}), and the reduction to your maximum dying value from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} condition is 1 less severe (to a minimum of 0).

_desc_en: Though the city of Vigil itself has been destroyed, you will carry on its warrior spirit to the end of your days. The value of your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition at which you die increases by 1 (normally to dying 5, or dying 6 if you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.I0BhPWqYf1bbzEYg]{Diehard}), and the reduction to your maximum dying value from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} condition is 1 less severe (to a minimum of 0).
_desc_ko: 비질 시가 파괴되었지만, 당신은 생의 마지막까지 그 전사의 영혼을 이어갈 것입니다. 사망 시 발동하는 죽음 상태의 수치가 1 증가하며(기본적으로 죽음 5, 불굴의 의지 보유 시 죽음 6), {파멸 상태로 인한 최대 죽음 수치 감소량이 1 덜 심각해집니다(최소 0).

name: Bellflower Dedication

description.value:
You dedicate yourself to freeing slaves and escorting them to freedom. You gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed. Choose up to six other people to be your "crop." Members of your crop can use your Speed for overland travel if it's higher than their own. Members more than 60 feet from you lose all benefits (from this or other Bellflower tiller feats) of being part of your crop, but they regain those benefits immediately when they return. You can add or remove someone from your crop by spending 10 minutes in conversation with them.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.cdnkS3A8OpOnRjKu]{Bellflower Tiller}

You can add or remove someone from your crop by spending 10 minutes in conversation with them.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.cdnkS3A8OpOnRjKu]{Bellflower Tiller}
_desc_ko: 노예를 해방시키고 자유의 길로 호송하는 데 헌신합니다. 이동 속도에 +5피트 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 최대 6명의 다른 사람을 자신의 "작물"로 선택할 수 있습니다. 작물 구성원은 자신의 이동 속도가 본인보다 높을 경우 육로 이동 시 당신의 속도를 사용할 수 있습니다. 당신으로부터 60피트 이상 떨어진 구성원은 당신의 작물에 속한 혜택(이 재주 또는 다른 벨플라워 경운 재주에서 비롯된)을 모두 상실하지만, 돌아오면 즉시 혜택을 회복합니다. 10분간 대화를 나누면 작물 구성원을 추가하거나 제거할 수 있습니다.

name: Seasong

description.value: Sound carries far beneath the waves, and your people have strong, enchanting voices. You become trained in Performance. If you would automatically become trained in Performance (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.lFwfUvH2708rl6i3]{Virtuosic Performer} skill feat for singing, and your voice carries equally well above and below water.

_desc_en: Sound carries far beneath the waves, and your people have strong, enchanting voices. You become trained in Performance. If you would automatically become trained in Performance (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.lFwfUvH2708rl6i3]{Virtuosic Performer} skill feat for singing, and your voice carries equally well above and below water.
_desc_ko: 파도 아래에서는 소리가 멀리까지 전달되며, 당신의 종족은 강력하고 매혹적인 목소리를 지녔습니다. 당신은 공연에 숙련됩니다. 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 자동으로 공연에 숙련되는 경우, 대신 선택한 기술에 숙련됩니다. 또한 노래에 대한 @link[feats.virtuosic-performer] 기술 재주를 얻으며, 당신의 목소리는 수중과 수면 위에서 똑같이 잘 전달됩니다.

name: Banishing Blow

description.value:
Trigger You use your champion's reaction, triggered by a fiend within your reach.

The erratic teleportation magic you experienced in the Kortos Mounts has taught you a few tricks. You attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} the fiend that triggered your champion's reaction; on a success, the target can't teleport or summon creatures for 1 minute. On a critical success, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} and can't teleport or summon creatures for 1 hour, and if you are on your home plane and the target is a fiend of level 18 or lower from another plane, it is also banished to its home plane. Your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this attack.

_desc_en:
Trigger You use your champion's reaction, triggered by a fiend within your reach.

The erratic teleportation magic you experienced in the Kortos Mounts has taught you a few tricks. You attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} the fiend that triggered your champion's reaction; on a success, the target can't teleport or summon creatures for 1 minute. On a critical success, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} and can't teleport or summon creatures for 1 hour, and if you are on your home plane and the target is a fiend of level 18 or lower from another plane, it is also banished to its home plane. Your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this attack.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신은 도달 범위 내의 핀드에 의해 발동된 챔피언의 반응을 사용합니다.

코르토스 산맥에서 경험한 불규칙한 순간이동 마법이 당신에게 몇 가지 요령을 가르쳐 주었다. 당신은 챔피언의 반응을 유발한 핀드를 @link[actions.shove]하기 위해 운동 판정을 시도하다; 성공 시, 대상은 1분 동안 순간이동하거나 생물을 소환할 수 없다. 대성공 시, 대상은 또한 @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태가 되어 1시간 동안 순간이동이나 생물 소환을 할 수 없으며, 만약 당신이 본래 차원에 있고 대상이 다른 차원의 18레벨 이하 핀드라면 그 핀드는 본래 차원으로 추방된다. 이 공격에는 다중 공격 페널티가 적용되지 않는다.

name: Clockwork Celerity

description.value:
Trigger Your turn begins.

You can use unstable clockwork devices in your innovation to push your invention to act more quickly. You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for this turn. How you can use the extra action depends on your innovation.

  • Armor You can use the extra action to Step, Stride, or use another movement action granted by your innovation (such as Swim if you have the Diving Armor feat).
  • Construct You can use the extra action to Command your construct innovation (or to provide 1 of the actions if you spend 2 actions to Command your construct).
  • Weapon You can use the extra action to Strike with your innovation or Reload your innovation.

_desc_en:
Trigger Your turn begins.

You can use unstable clockwork devices in your innovation to push your invention to act more quickly. You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for this turn. How you can use the extra action depends on your innovation.

  • Armor You can use the extra action to Step, Stride, or use another movement action granted by your innovation (such as Swim if you have the Diving Armor feat).
  • Construct You can use the extra action to Command your construct innovation (or to provide 1 of the actions if you spend 2 actions to Command your construct).
  • Weapon You can use the extra action to Strike with your innovation or Reload your innovation.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신의 턴이 시작됩니다.

혁신에 불안정한 시계 장치들을 사용해 발명품의 작동 속도를 높일 수 있습니다. 이번 턴 동안 당신은 @link[conditions.quickened] 상태입니다. 추가 행동의 사용 방법은 혁신에 따라 다릅니다.

  • 방어구 추가 행동으로 이동, 장거리 이동 또는 혁신이 부여한 다른 이동 행동(예: 잠수 갑옷 피트가 있다면 수영)을 사용할 수 있습니다.
  • 구축체 추가 행동으로 창조물 혁신을 명령하거나(또는 창조물 커맨더에 2개 행동을 소모할 경우 커맨더 행동 중 하나를 제공할 수 있음).
  • 무기 추가 행동을 사용하여 혁신으로 강타하거나 혁신을 재장전할 수 있습니다.

name: This Too Shall Pass

description.value: Mortal worries are such simple matters to you that you leave them behind almost as quickly as you experience them. You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Un8aEKnVULYAzP5L]{All This Will Happen Again} once per hour, rather than once per day.

value.value: And Will Do So Once More

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Mortal worries are such simple matters to you that you leave them behind almost as quickly as you experience them. You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Un8aEKnVULYAzP5L]{All This Will Happen Again} once per hour, rather than once per day.
_desc_ko: 필멸자의 근심은 당신에게 너무나 사소한 일이라, 경험하는 순간 거의 즉시 뒤로 남겨둔다. @link[feats.all-this-will-happen-again]를 하루에 한 번이 아닌 시간당 한 번 사용할 수 있다.

name: Bleeding Finisher

description.value: Your blow inflicts profuse bleeding. Make a slashing or piercing Strike. If you hit, the target also takes persistent bleed damage equal to your precise strike finisher damage.

_desc_en: Your blow inflicts profuse bleeding. Make a slashing or piercing Strike. If you hit, the target also takes persistent bleed damage equal to your precise strike finisher damage.
_desc_ko: 당신의 일격은 심한 출혈을 유발합니다. 베기 또는 관통 공격을 시도하세요. 명중 시, 대상은 정밀 타격 마무리 기술의 피해량과 동일한 지속 출혈 피해를 추가로 받습니다.

name: Flair Rider Stance

description.value: You spend little time in your saddle as you flip unpredictably around your dragon mount, dodging attacks. While mounted and in this stance, your mount always provides you with lesser cover and you don't take the –2 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves while mounted.

_desc_en: You spend little time in your saddle as you flip unpredictably around your dragon mount, dodging attacks. While mounted and in this stance, your mount always provides you with lesser cover and you don't take the –2 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves while mounted.
_desc_ko: 당신은 안장 위에서 보내는 시간이 거의 없이 용 탈것 주위를 예측 불가능하게 뒤집으며 공격을 피한다. 탑승 중이고 이 자세를 취하고 있는 동안, 당신의 탈것은 항상 당신에게 약한 엄폐를 제공하며, 당신은 탑승 중 반사 내성에 –2 상황 페널티를 받지 않는다.

name: Bless Toxin

description.value: You pour void energy into toxins you create to further debilitate your targets. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} an alchemical poison (rather than create it with advanced alchemy, Quick Alchemy, or another means), it becomes a blessed alchemical poison and gains the void trait. When a creature is afflicted with a blessed alchemical poison, for 1 round, any Hit Points it would regain from a vitality effect are reduced by 5, or by 10 if you are legendary in Crafting.

value.value: deity who grants harm divine font

_desc_en: You pour void energy into toxins you create to further debilitate your targets. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} an alchemical poison (rather than create it with advanced alchemy, Quick Alchemy, or another means), it becomes a blessed alchemical poison and gains the void trait. When a creature is afflicted with a blessed alchemical poison, for 1 round, any Hit Points it would regain from a vitality effect are reduced by 5, or by 10 if you are legendary in Crafting.
_desc_ko: 당신은 제작한 독에 공허 에너지를 주입하여 대상의 상태를 더욱 악화시킵니다. @link[actions.craft] 기술로 연금술 독을 만들 때(고급 연금술, 신속 연금술 또는 다른 방법으로 제작하는 경우 제외), 해당 독은 축복받은 연금술 독이 되어 공허 속성을 획득합니다. 생물이 축복받은 연금술 독에 감염되면, 1라운드 동안 활력 효과로 회복할 HP가 5 감소한다. 제작 기술이 전설급일 경우 10 감소한다.

name: Centaur Weapon Familiarity

description.value:
You've trained in the weapons favored by your people, becoming a skilled archer and jouster. You have familiarity with the lance, longbow, longspear, shortbow, and spear—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

_desc_en:
You've trained in the weapons favored by your people, becoming a skilled archer and jouster. You have familiarity with the lance, longbow, longspear, shortbow, and spear—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
_desc_ko:
당신은 당신의 민족이 선호하는 무기들을 훈련하여 숙련된 궁수와 마상 시합 선수가 되었습니다. 당신은 창, 장궁, 장창, 단궁, 그리고 창에 패밀리어를 가지고 있습니다-숙련도 목적상, 이 중 무술 무기인 것은 단순 무기로 취급합니다.

5레벨에 도달하면, 이 무기들로 치명타를 기록할 때마다 해당 무기의 치명타 특화 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Jester's Gambol

description.value:
Requirements You are attuned to an apparition that grants Circus Lore or Fey Lore as one of its apparition skills.

You adopt a stance that makes your movements carefree and sublimely unpredictable, allowing you to move past impediments with ease and resist the attacks and importunateness of natural threats. You ignore difficult terrain, and you gain resistance equal to half your level against damage dealt to you by animals, beasts, fey, fungi, and plants.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are attuned to an apparition that grants Circus Lore or Fey Lore as one of its apparition skills.

You adopt a stance that makes your movements carefree and sublimely unpredictable, allowing you to move past impediments with ease and resist the attacks and importunateness of natural threats. You ignore difficult terrain, and you gain resistance equal to half your level against damage dealt to you by animals, beasts, fey, fungi, and plants.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 서커스 지식 또는 요정 지식를 유령의 기술 중 하나로 부여하는 유령과 교감하고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 움직임이 자유분방하고 예측 불가능한 자세를 취하여 장애물을 쉽게 통과하고 자연적 위협의 공격과 성가심을 저항합니다. 어려운 지형을 무시하며, 동물, 야수, 페이, 균류, 식물이 가하는 피해에 대해 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 저항력을 얻습니다.

name: Gift of the Hoard

description.value: In pleasing the cravings of a mighty dragon, they have deigned to impart some of their magical essence into your body. Your eyes begin to glow and change color while your limbs and neck grow a veneer of scales, visually matching the associated dragon, accompanied by a near-insatiable desire to amass a hoard of your own. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.JcobNl4iE9HmMYtE]{Dragon Breath} sorcerer bloodline spell, emulating the breath of the associated dragon. If you don't have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You Refocus by counting and arranging your treasure.

value.value: You have succeeded at an important task given by a dragon such as procuring a special treasure for their hoard

_desc_en: In pleasing the cravings of a mighty dragon, they have deigned to impart some of their magical essence into your body. Your eyes begin to glow and change color while your limbs and neck grow a veneer of scales, visually matching the associated dragon, accompanied by a near-insatiable desire to amass a hoard of your own. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.JcobNl4iE9HmMYtE]{Dragon Breath} sorcerer bloodline spell, emulating the breath of the associated dragon. If you don't have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You Refocus by counting and arranging your treasure.
_desc_ko: 강력한 용의 갈망을 충족시켜 주자, 용은 당신 몸에 자신들의 마법적 정수를 일부 부여해 주기로 하셨다. 당신의 눈이 빛나기 시작하며 색이 변하고, 팔다리와 목에 비늘이 덮이기 시작한다. 이 비늘들은 모두 연관된 용과 같은 색이며, 자신만의 보물을 모으려는 거의 채워지지 않는 욕망이 동반된다. @link[spells.dragon-breath] 소서러 혈통 주문을 획득하여 해당 드래곤의 숨결을 모방할 수 있으며, 1 포커스 포인트의 포커스 풀을 얻습니다. 이미 포커스 풀을 보유하고 있다면 포커스 포인트 수를 1 증가시킵니다. 보물을 세고 정리함으로써 재집중합니다.

name: Alabaster Eyes

description.value:
In place of the normal vishkanyan golden eyes, you were born with especially perceptive snow-white eyes. You gain darkvision.

Special You can take this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain out of this feat or into this feat.

_desc_en:
In place of the normal vishkanyan golden eyes, you were born with especially perceptive snow-white eyes. You gain darkvision.

Special You can take this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain out of this feat or into this feat.
_desc_ko:
일반적인 비슈카니안의 황금색 눈 대신, 당신은 특히 예민한 눈부신 백색 눈을 타고났습니다. 암흑 시야를 얻습니다.

특수 이 피트는 1레벨에서만 선택할 수 있으며, 재훈련으로 이 피트를 포기하거나 다시 선택할 수 없습니다.

name: Begin Stampede

description.value: The sight of you charging forward into battle emboldens your allies to follow. You Stride up to twice your Speed and make a horns melee Strike. If your Strike hits and damages an enemy, each ally within 60 feet who saw you hit can use a reaction to Stride up to twice their Speed, but each must end their Stride closer to you than where they started. Each such ally that Strides gains a +1 status bonus to their first Strike on their next turn.

_desc_en: The sight of you charging forward into battle emboldens your allies to follow. You Stride up to twice your Speed and make a horns melee Strike. If your Strike hits and damages an enemy, each ally within 60 feet who saw you hit can use a reaction to Stride up to twice their Speed, but each must end their Stride closer to you than where they started. Each such ally that Strides gains a +1 status bonus to their first Strike on their next turn.
_desc_ko: 당신이 전장으로 돌진하는 모습은 동료들에게 용기를 불어넣어 그들도 따라가게 합니다. 당신은 자신의 속도의 최대 두 배까지 이동하며 뿔로 근접 공격을 가합니다. 이 공격이 적을 명중시켜 피해를 입히면, 60피트 내의 모든 아군 중 당신의 명중을 목격한 자는 반응으로 자신의 속도의 최대 두 배까지 이동할 수 있습니다. 단, 각 아군은 이동 후 시작 위치보다 당신에게 더 가까이 있어야 합니다. 이렇게 이동한 아군은 다음 턴에 가하는 첫 번째 공격에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Master Merchant

description.value: Kalistrade teaches that setbacks are only temporary and that perseverance is a treasured virtue. When you fail, but not critically fail, at a Society or Mercantile Lore check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income} at a specific task and are allowed to continue working at that task on subsequent days, you can choose to attempt the skill check again the next day. If you succeed, you get a critical success and continue to earn that amount on further days spent working at the task, if the task lasts that long.

_desc_en: Kalistrade teaches that setbacks are only temporary and that perseverance is a treasured virtue. When you fail, but not critically fail, at a Society or Mercantile Lore check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income} at a specific task and are allowed to continue working at that task on subsequent days, you can choose to attempt the skill check again the next day. If you succeed, you get a critical success and continue to earn that amount on further days spent working at the task, if the task lasts that long.
_desc_ko: 칼리스트라데는 좌절은 일시적일 뿐이며 인내심이 소중한 미덕이라고 가르칩니다. 특정 작업에 대한 @link[actions.earn-income] 사회 또는 상업학 지식 판정에서 대실패가 아닌 실패를 했고, 다음 날에도 해당 작업을 계속할 수 있는 경우, 다음 날 다시 기술 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다. 성공하면 대성공을 얻으며, 작업이 그 정도로 오래 지속된다면 그 작업을 계속하는 동안 해당 금액을 계속 벌 수 있습니다.

name: Noble Resolve

description.value: Once, genies ruled vast kingdoms, and a remnant of that confidence and power is reflected in your strong will. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves against effects with the mental trait. Regardless of success or failure, you become aware of the person who used the effect on you if they were visible to you at the time of use.

_desc_en: Once, genies ruled vast kingdoms, and a remnant of that confidence and power is reflected in your strong will. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves against effects with the mental trait. Regardless of success or failure, you become aware of the person who used the effect on you if they were visible to you at the time of use.
_desc_ko: 한때 지니들은 광대한 왕국을 다스렸으며, 그 자신감과 힘의 잔재가 당신의 강한 의지에 반영되어 있습니다. 정신 속성을 가진 효과에 대한 의지 내성에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 성공 여부와 상관없이, 효과가 사용된 시점에 당신에게 보이던 사람이라면 그 사용자를 인식하게 됩니다.

name: Quick Disguise

description.value: You can set up a disguise in one-tenth the usual time (generally 1 minute). If you're a master in Deception, you can create a full disguise and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} as a 3-action activity. If you're legendary, it takes a single action.

_desc_en: You can set up a disguise in one-tenth the usual time (generally 1 minute). If you're a master in Deception, you can create a full disguise and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} as a 3-action activity. If you're legendary, it takes a single action.
_desc_ko: 변장을 평소 시간의 10분의 1(일반적으로 1분)만에 설정할 수 있습니다. 기만 달인인 경우, 완전한 변장과 @link[actions.impersonate]을 3행동 활동으로 수행할 수 있습니다. 전설적인 실력자라면 액션 하나로 가능합니다.

name: Fabricated Connections

description.value:
You can lie about having taken an action so convincingly that you acquire all the tangible benefits of having successfully completed it.

You can roll Deception in place of a different skill when attempting to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{Subsist}.

You can use Fabricated Connections to [[/act make-an-impression skill=deception]] or [[/act request skill=deception]] once per day, and you can also use it once per week to Earn Income or [[/act subsist skill=deception]]

_desc_en:
You can lie about having taken an action so convincingly that you acquire all the tangible benefits of having successfully completed it.

You can roll Deception in place of a different skill when attempting to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{Subsist}.

You can use Fabricated Connections to [[/act make-an-impression skill=deception]] or [[/act request skill=deception]] once per day, and you can also use it once per week to Earn Income or [[/act subsist skill=deception]]
_desc_ko:
당신은 @link[actions.lie]을 통해 어떤 행동을 취한 것처럼 설득력 있게 꾸며내어, 그 행동을 성공적으로 완료했을 때 얻는 모든 실질적인 이점을 획득할 수 있습니다.

다음과 같은 행동을 시도할 때 다른 기술 대신 기만을 굴릴 수 있습니다: @link[actions.earn-income], @link[actions.make-an-impression], @link[actions.request], @link[actions.subsist].

가짜 인맥을 이용해 하루에 한 번 각인 남기기나 요청을 할 수 있으며, 일주일에 한 번 소득 얻기나 생계를 유지하는 데도 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Deflecting Jewel

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You're the target of a ranged attack while you possess your head gem.

Requirements You're aware of the triggering attack.

You walk the line between two sides of something, such as belonging to two clans, having a mixed allegiance or faith, or being caught between two possible fates. Your dual nature has attuned your head gem to the half moon, and it has manifested the power to ward away attacks by drawing a line between them and you. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You're the target of a ranged attack while you possess your head gem.

Requirements You're aware of the triggering attack.

You walk the line between two sides of something, such as belonging to two clans, having a mixed allegiance or faith, or being caught between two possible fates. Your dual nature has attuned your head gem to the half moon, and it has manifested the power to ward away attacks by drawing a line between them and you. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.
_desc_ko:
빈도 시간당 한 번

발동 조건 머리 보석을 소유한 상태에서 원거리 공격을 받는 대상이 될 때.

조건 트리거 공격을 인지하고 있을 때.

당신은 두 진영 사이의 경계를 걷고 있습니다. 예를 들어 두 부족에 속하거나, 혼합된 충성심이나 신앙을 지니거나, 두 가지 가능한 운명 사이에 갇힌 상태입니다. 이중적 본성은 당신의 머리 보석을 반달에 조율시켰고, 공격과 당신 사이에 선을 그어 공격을 수호부하는 힘을 창조시켰습니다. 발동 공격에 대해 AC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Deadly Grace

description.value: Your graceful attacks are especially powerful. When you score a critical hit with an agile or finesse melee weapon that has the deadly trait, you double the number of dice from that trait. When you wield an agile or finesse melee weapon that doesn't have the deadly trait, it gains the deadly d8 trait instead.

_desc_en: Your graceful attacks are especially powerful. When you score a critical hit with an agile or finesse melee weapon that has the deadly trait, you double the number of dice from that trait. When you wield an agile or finesse melee weapon that doesn't have the deadly trait, it gains the deadly d8 trait instead.
_desc_ko: 당신의 우아한 공격은 특히 강력합니다. 치명적 특성을 지닌 기민한 또는 기교 근접 무기로 치명타를 기록할 때, 해당 특성에서 발생하는 주사위 수를 두 배로 증가시킵니다. 치명적 특성이 없는 기민한 또는 기교 근접 무기를 휘두를 경우, 대신 치명적 d8 특성을 획득합니다.

name: Sash of the Wind

description.value:
Access Tian Xia origin

At your request, the nature spirits of the air and wind spin themselves into an iridescent sash loosely draped around your shoulders that buoys you through the sky. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.A2JfEKe6BZcTG1S8]{Fly} on yourself as a 4th-rank innate primal spell once per day. If the sash created by this feat is removed, the spell immediately ends.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Access Tian Xia origin

At your request, the nature spirits of the air and wind spin themselves into an iridescent sash loosely draped around your shoulders that buoys you through the sky. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.A2JfEKe6BZcTG1S8]{Fly} on yourself as a 4th-rank innate primal spell once per day. If the sash created by this feat is removed, the spell immediately ends.
_desc_ko:
접근 티엔 샤 기원

요청에 따라 공기와 바람의 영혼들이 스스로를 무지갯빛 띠로 변형하여 어깨에 느슨하게 두르며, 이를 통해 하늘을 떠다닐 수 있게 합니다. 하루에 한 번, (4th) 선천적 프라이멀 마법인 @link[spells.fly]을 자신에게 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 피트로 생성된 띠가 제거되면 마법은 즉시 종료됩니다.

name: Unbreakable Resolve

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You fail a Will save.

The experience of coming back after death has granted you a strong sense of resolve; devilish words, slick spells, and conniving trickery can't easily catch you unprepared. Reroll the triggering save, using the second result only if it's better.

publication.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

_desc_en:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You fail a Will save.

The experience of coming back after death has granted you a strong sense of resolve; devilish words, slick spells, and conniving trickery can't easily catch you unprepared. Reroll the triggering save, using the second result only if it's better.
_desc_ko:
빈도 10분마다 한 번

발동 조건 의지 내성에 실패합니다.

죽음 이후 되살아난 경험은 당신에게 강한 결의를 부여했습니다. 악마의 말, 교묘한 주문, 간교한 속임수는 당신을 쉽게 무방비하게 할 수 없습니다. 트리거되는 내성 굴림을 재굴림하고, 두 번째 결과가 더 좋을 경우에만 적용합니다.

name: Relentless Stalker

description.value:
Trigger An adjacent creature you are hunting attempts to move away from you using an action that has the move trait

Your hunted prey cannot escape your relentless pursuit. Stride up to your Speed in tandem with the triggering creature, remaining adjacent to the foe throughout its movement until it stops moving or you run out of movement. You can ignore difficult terrain during this movement unless the difficult terrain is caused by a magical effect.

publication.title: Pathfinder Adventure: The Fall of Plaguestone

_desc_en:
Trigger An adjacent creature you are hunting attempts to move away from you using an action that has the move trait

Your hunted prey cannot escape your relentless pursuit. Stride up to your Speed in tandem with the triggering creature, remaining adjacent to the foe throughout its movement until it stops moving or you run out of movement. You can ignore difficult terrain during this movement unless the difficult terrain is caused by a magical effect.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신이 추적 중인 인접 생물이 이동 특성을 가진 행동으로 당신에게서 멀어지려 시도할 때

당신의 사냥감은 끊임없는 추격을 피할 수 없습니다. 발동한 생물과 함께 당신의 이동 속도만큼 스트라이드를 사용해 이동하며, 상대가 멈추거나 당신의 이동이 소진될 때까지 이동 중에도 계속 인접 상태를 유지합니다. 마법 효과로 인한 어려운 지형이 아닌 한, 이 이동 중에는 어려운 지형을 무시할 수 있습니다.

name: Commander Dedication

description.value:
You gain the tactics class feature like a commander and gain your own folio; this folio contains two common mobility or offensive tactics of your choosing. You can prepare one of these tactics whenever a commander would be able to prepare tactics. You gain a commander's banner that grants you a 30-foot aura for the purposes of using your tactics, but the banner does not grant the commander's banner bonus to Will saves and DCs against fear effects. You become trained in commander class DC and Warfare Lore; if you were already trained in Warfare Lore, you become trained in another Lore skill of your choice.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.FYeYr2IQ7voFSb8y]{Commander}

_desc_en:
You gain the tactics class feature like a commander and gain your own folio; this folio contains two common mobility or offensive tactics of your choosing. You can prepare one of these tactics whenever a commander would be able to prepare tactics. You gain a commander's banner that grants you a 30-foot aura for the purposes of using your tactics, but the banner does not grant the commander's banner bonus to Will saves and DCs against fear effects. You become trained in commander class DC and Warfare Lore; if you were already trained in Warfare Lore, you become trained in another Lore skill of your choice.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.FYeYr2IQ7voFSb8y]{Commander}
_desc_ko: 커맨더처럼 전술 클래스 특성을 얻으며, 자신만의 전술첩을 획득한다. 이 전술첩에는 선택한 두 가지 일반적인 기동 전술 또는 공격 전술이 포함된다. 커맨더가 전술을 준비할 수 있을 때마다 이 전술 중 하나를 준비할 수 있다. 커맨더의 깃발을 획득하여 전술 사용 시 30피트 범위의 오라를 부여받지만, 공포 효과에 대한 의지 내성 및 난이도(DC)에 대한 커맨더의 깃발 보너스는 부여되지 않습니다. 커맨더 클래스 난이도(DC)와 전쟁 지식에 숙련됩니다. 이미 전쟁 지식에 숙련된 경우, 선택한 다른 지식 기술에 숙련됩니다.

name: Battleblooded

description.value:
You descend from those whose lives were touched by legendary einherjars, who were crafted from the souls of mighty warriors slain in battle and chosen by valkyries to serve as foot soldiers to many gods. You may even be the distant mortal descendant of an actual valkyrie.

You are trained in Intimidation. If you were already trained in Intimidation (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xQMz6eDgX75WX2ce]{Intimidating Glare} skill feat.

_desc_en:
You descend from those whose lives were touched by legendary einherjars, who were crafted from the souls of mighty warriors slain in battle and chosen by valkyries to serve as foot soldiers to many gods. You may even be the distant mortal descendant of an actual valkyrie.

You are trained in Intimidation. If you were already trained in Intimidation (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xQMz6eDgX75WX2ce]{Intimidating Glare} skill feat.
_desc_ko:
당신은 전설적인 에인헤리야르의 영향을 받은 자들의 후예입니다. 에인헤리야르는 전장에서 죽은 용맹한 전사들의 영혼으로 제작되어 발키리에게 선택되어 여러 신들의 보병으로 섬기는 존재들입니다. 당신은 실제 발키리의 먼 인간 후손일 수도 있습니다.

당신은 위협 기술에 숙련되어 있습니다. (배경이나 직업 등으로 인해) 이미 위협 기술에 숙련되어 있었다면, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다. 또한 @link[feats.intimidating-glare] 기술 재주를 얻습니다.

name: Defiant Banner

description.value:
You vigorously wave your banner to remind yourself and your allies that you can and must endure. You and all allies within the aura of your commander's banner when you use this action gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage equal to your Intelligence modifier until the start of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.Zy7rrPCgMTeSzKj9]{Effect: Defiant Banner}

_desc_en:
You vigorously wave your banner to remind yourself and your allies that you can and must endure. You and all allies within the aura of your commander's banner when you use this action gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage equal to your Intelligence modifier until the start of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.Zy7rrPCgMTeSzKj9]{Effect: Defiant Banner}
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신과 아군에게 견뎌내야 하며 견딜 수 있음을 상기시키기 위해 깃발을 힘차게 휘두릅니다. 이 행동을 사용할 때 커맨더의 깃발 오라 내에 있는 당신과 모든 아군은 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 지능 능력치 수정자만큼의 타격, 관통, 베기 피해에 대한 저항력을 얻습니다.

name: Reflexive Devotion

description.value:
Trigger You roll initiative.

The power of dragons flows through you at the merest thought. You Channel Draconic Essence.

_desc_en:
Trigger You roll initiative.

The power of dragons flows through you at the merest thought. You Channel Draconic Essence.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신이 우선권을 굴린다.

단지 생각만으로 용의 힘이 당신을 통해 흐른다. 당신은 용의 정수를 흘려보낸다.

name: Swashbuckler Dedication

description.value:
Choose a swashbuckler's style. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.LzYi0OuOoypNb6jd]{Panache} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.TALz3cU06Hb14Key]{Stylish Combatant} class features, and you apply the bravado trait to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} and any actions indicated in your swashbuckler style, allowing you to gain panache. You become trained in Acrobatics or the skill associated with your style. If you were already trained in both skills, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also become trained in swashbuckler class DC. You don't gain any other effects of your chosen style.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.k9Ebp52kt0ZLHtMl]{Swashbuckler}

_desc_en:
Choose a swashbuckler's style. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.LzYi0OuOoypNb6jd]{Panache} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.TALz3cU06Hb14Key]{Stylish Combatant} class features, and you apply the bravado trait to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} and any actions indicated in your swashbuckler style, allowing you to gain panache. You become trained in Acrobatics or the skill associated with your style. If you were already trained in both skills, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also become trained in swashbuckler class DC. You don't gain any other effects of your chosen style.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.k9Ebp52kt0ZLHtMl]{Swashbuckler}
_desc_ko: 스워시버클러의 스타일을 선택합니다. 당신은 @link[feats.panache] 클래스 특성을 얻으며, @link[actions.tumble-through] 및 선택한 스워시버클러 스타일에 명시된 모든 행동에 파나슈를 적용하여 파나슈를 획득할 수 있게 된다. 곡예 또는 해당 스타일과 연관된 기술에 숙련된다. 두 기술 모두에 이미 숙련된 경우, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련된다. 또한 스워시버클러 클래스 DC에 숙련된다. 선택한 스타일의 다른 효과는 획득하지 않는다.

name: Blessed One Dedication

description.value:
You are touched by a deity and gifted with the ability to alleviate the suffering of others.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zNN9212H2FGfM7VS]{Lay on Hands} devotion spell. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OSefkMgojBLqmRDh]{Refocus} by meditating, whether you reflect on the deity granting the blessing or not, allowing your blessing to refill your focus pool. Your devotion spells from the blessed one archetype are divine spells. You become trained in spell attack modifier and spell DC. Your spellcasting attribute is Charisma.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.SUDV5hFZ9WocxWqv]{Blessed One}

_desc_en:
You are touched by a deity and gifted with the ability to alleviate the suffering of others.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zNN9212H2FGfM7VS]{Lay on Hands} devotion spell. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OSefkMgojBLqmRDh]{Refocus} by meditating, whether you reflect on the deity granting the blessing or not, allowing your blessing to refill your focus pool. Your devotion spells from the blessed one archetype are divine spells. You become trained in spell attack modifier and spell DC. Your spellcasting attribute is Charisma.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.SUDV5hFZ9WocxWqv]{Blessed One}
_desc_ko:
신성한 존재의 감동을 받아 타인의 고통을 덜어주는 능력을 부여받았습니다.

@link[spells.lay-on-hands] 포커스 주문을 얻습니다. 명상을 통해 @link[actions.refocus]할 수 있으며, 이때 축복을 내린 신을 떠올리든 그렇지 않든 상관없이 축복이 포커스 풀을 재충전합니다. 축복받은 자 아키타입의 헌신 주문은 신성 주문입니다. 주문 공격 수정자, 주문 DC에 숙련됩니다. 주문 시전 능력치는 매력입니다.

name: Ancestral Linguistics

description.value: Over your extensive lifespan, you've studied many languages. During your daily preparations, you can recede into old memories to become fluent in one common language or one other language you have access to. You know this language until you prepare again. Since this knowledge is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a permanent character option.

_desc_en: Over your extensive lifespan, you've studied many languages. During your daily preparations, you can recede into old memories to become fluent in one common language or one other language you have access to. You know this language until you prepare again. Since this knowledge is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a permanent character option.
_desc_ko: 긴 수명 동안 수많은 언어를 연구해왔습니다. 매일 준비 시간에 오래된 기억 속으로 빠져들어 하나의 공통 언어나 접근 가능한 다른 언어 하나를 유창하게 구사할 수 있습니다. 이 언어는 다음 준비 시간까지 알고 있습니다. 이 지식은 일시적이므로 영구적인 캐릭터 옵션의 전제 조건으로 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Bear Hug (Werecreature)

description.value:
Requirements You're in bear or hybrid shape, and your last action was a successful claw Strike.

You hug your opponent. You make another claw Strike against the same target. If this Strike hits, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} until the end of your next turn, unless you move or your target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escapes}.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're in bear or hybrid shape, and your last action was a successful claw Strike.

You hug your opponent. You make another claw Strike against the same target. If this Strike hits, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} until the end of your next turn, unless you move or your target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escapes}.
_desc_ko:
요건 곰 형태 또는 혼혈 형태이며, 마지막 행동이 성공한 발톱 공격이어야 한다.

상대를 껴안습니다. 동일한 대상에게 또 다른 발톱 공격을 가합니다. 이 공격이 명중하면, 대상은 @link[conditions.grabbed]가 되어 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 지속됩니다. 단, 당신이 이동하거나 대상이 @link[actions.escape]하는 경우는 예외입니다.

name: Steed Form

description.value: Your eidolon changes to make it particularly effective as your mount. While you ride it, you get your full number of actions each round instead of reducing them to 2. This applies only when you ride your eidolon, not when anyone else does. Your eidolon still must be at least one size category larger than you to ride it. Since you work together to move, your eidolon's move actions while you're mounted gain the tandem trait.

_desc_en: Your eidolon changes to make it particularly effective as your mount. While you ride it, you get your full number of actions each round instead of reducing them to 2. This applies only when you ride your eidolon, not when anyone else does. Your eidolon still must be at least one size category larger than you to ride it. Since you work together to move, your eidolon's move actions while you're mounted gain the tandem trait.
_desc_ko: 당신의 에이돌론이 탈것으로 특히 효과적으로 변합니다. 이를 탈 때는 매 라운드 행동 횟수가 2회로 줄어들지 않고 전체를 사용할 수 있습니다. 이는 오직 당신이 에이돌론을 탈 때만 적용되며, 다른 사람이 탈 때는 적용되지 않습니다. 승마 시 에이돌론은 여전히 당신보다 최소 한 단계 큰 크기를 가져야 합니다. 함께 움직이기 때문에, 승마 중 에이돌론의 이동 행동은 '동반' 특성을 얻습니다.

name: Elven Verve

description.value: While all elves are immune to the paralyzing touch of ghouls, you can shake off flesh-numbing magic of all kinds. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against effects that would impose the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} conditions. When you would be immobilized, paralyzed, or slowed for at least 2 rounds, reduce that duration by 1 round.

rules.label: Against effects that would make you Immobilized, Paralyzed, or Slowed

_desc_en: While all elves are immune to the paralyzing touch of ghouls, you can shake off flesh-numbing magic of all kinds. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against effects that would impose the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} conditions. When you would be immobilized, paralyzed, or slowed for at least 2 rounds, reduce that duration by 1 round.
_desc_ko: 모든 엘프는 구울의 마비시키는 접촉에 면역이지만, 당신은 모든 종류의 살을 얼어붙게 하는 마법을 떨쳐낼 수 있습니다. 당신은 @link[conditions.immobilized], @link[conditions.paralyzed], 또는 @link[conditions.slowed] 상태를 부여하는 효과에 대한 저항에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 최소 2라운드 동안 고정된, 마비된, 또는 둔화 상태가 될 경우, 그 지속 시간을 1라운드 줄입니다.

name: Emotionless

description.value: Your malfunctioning emotional processors make it difficult for you to feel strong emotions. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion and fear effects. If you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion or fear effect, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: Your malfunctioning emotional processors make it difficult for you to feel strong emotions. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion and fear effects. If you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion or fear effect, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 고장난 감정 처리 장치로 인해 강한 감정을 느끼기 어렵습니다. 감정 및 공포 효과에 대한 내성 굴림 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 감정 또는 공포 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴렸을 경우, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Unshakable Grit

description.value: You've become hardened by conflict after everything you've faced, and you possess a certain intractable stubbornness. If the reroll granted to you by your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.94PGauGdzrVARMLc]{Grit and Tenacity} reaction is a success, you get a critical success instead; if it's a critical failure, you get a failure instead.

_desc_en: You've become hardened by conflict after everything you've faced, and you possess a certain intractable stubbornness. If the reroll granted to you by your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.94PGauGdzrVARMLc]{Grit and Tenacity} reaction is a success, you get a critical success instead; if it's a critical failure, you get a failure instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 겪어온 모든 갈등 속에서 단련되었으며, 특유의 완고한 고집을 지니고 있습니다. @link[feats.grit-and-tenacity] 반응으로 부여받은 재굴림이 성공하면 대신 대성공을, 대실패하면 대신 실패를 얻습니다.

name: Jinx Glutton

description.value: You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.rFmJVDdB313EibTs]{Eat Fortune} once per hour, rather than once per day.

_desc_en: You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.rFmJVDdB313EibTs]{Eat Fortune} once per hour, rather than once per day.
_desc_ko: {행운을 먹는다}를 하루에 한 번이 아닌 시간당 한 번 사용할 수 있다.

name: Shadow Spell

description.value:
You attach a piece of your shadow to a spell to cloud the senses and cause mischief. If the next action you take is to Cast a Spell that has the shadow trait, choose one creature affected by the spell. This creature either gains a +2 status bonus to Stealth or takes a -2 status penalty to Perception (your choice). This lasts for 1 round. This choice and the effect occur after resolving any checks for the spell's initial effects. If the chosen creature is your enemy, it's affected only if your spell attack roll succeeded or if it failed its saving throw.

The effects of Shadow Spell end if you use Shadow Spell again.

_desc_en:
You attach a piece of your shadow to a spell to cloud the senses and cause mischief. If the next action you take is to Cast a Spell that has the shadow trait, choose one creature affected by the spell. This creature either gains a +2 status bonus to Stealth or takes a -2 status penalty to Perception (your choice). This lasts for 1 round. This choice and the effect occur after resolving any checks for the spell's initial effects. If the chosen creature is your enemy, it's affected only if your spell attack roll succeeded or if it failed its saving throw.

The effects of Shadow Spell end if you use Shadow Spell again.
_desc_ko:
당신은 자신의 그림자 조각을 주문에 붙여 감각을 흐리고 혼란을 일으킵니다. 다음 행동으로 그림자 특성을 가진 주문을 시전할 경우, 해당 주문에 영향을 받는 생물 하나를 선택합니다. 이 생물은 은신에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻거나 지각에 -2 상태 페널티를 받습니다(선택). 이 효과는 1라운드 동안 지속된다. 이 선택과 효과는 주문의 초기 효과에 대한 모든 판정 해결 후 발생한다. 선택한 생물이 적일 경우, 당신의 주문 명중 굴림이 성공했거나 해당 생물이 내성 굴림에 실패했을 때만 영향을 받는다.

그림자 주문의 효과는 그림자 주문을 다시 사용할 경우 종료된다.

name: Student of Perfection Dedication

description.value:
Access You are from Jalmeray.

You have learned the martial arts techniques of your House of Perfection. You become trained in your choice of Acrobatics or Athletics and Warfare Lore; if you were already trained, you become an expert instead. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.yA9tsWT9uzL2REnw]{Qi Spells} monk class feat, which grants you the ki strike ki spell and a focus pool of 1 Focus Point that you can recover using the Refocus activity as a monk does. Your ki spells from Student of Perfection are occult spells.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.EwlYs1OzaMj9BB5I]{Student of Perfection}

value.value: powerful fist or expert in unarmed attacks
member of a House of Perfection
