Access You are from Jalmeray.

You have learned the martial arts techniques of your House of Perfection. You become trained in your choice of Acrobatics or Athletics and Warfare Lore; if you were already trained, you become an expert instead. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.yA9tsWT9uzL2REnw]{Qi Spells} monk class feat, which grants you the ki strike ki spell and a focus pool of 1 Focus Point that you can recover using the Refocus activity as a monk does. Your ki spells from Student of Perfection are occult spells.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.EwlYs1OzaMj9BB5I]{Student of Perfection}
_desc_ko:
접근 당신은 잘메레이 출신입니다.

당신은 완벽의 가문에서 무술 기술을 익혔습니다. 곡예 또는 운동과 전쟁 지식 중 하나를 선택하여 숙련됩니다. 이미 숙련된 경우, 대신 전문가가 됩니다. @link[feats.qi-spells] 몽크 클래스 피트를 획득합니다. 이 피트는 기(氣) 강타 기(氣) 주문을 부여하며, 몽크처럼 재집중 활동을 통해 회복할 수 있는 1점의 포커스 풀을 제공합니다. 완전함의 제자에서 얻은 기(氣) 주문은 오컬트 주문입니다.

name: Poison Coat

description.value: In nature, certain animals are covered in venomous spines, and just brushing against them can prove deadly. You expend a contact or injury poison and spend 10 minutes brushing that poison onto your clothing or weaving sharp, poisoned needles into the garment's fabric. You can have only one poison suffused into your clothing at a time. You can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2r4BY90F9PLFai3c]{Once Bitten} reaction while you have a poison suffused in this way.

_desc_en: In nature, certain animals are covered in venomous spines, and just brushing against them can prove deadly. You expend a contact or injury poison and spend 10 minutes brushing that poison onto your clothing or weaving sharp, poisoned needles into the garment's fabric. You can have only one poison suffused into your clothing at a time. You can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2r4BY90F9PLFai3c]{Once Bitten} reaction while you have a poison suffused in this way.
_desc_ko: 자연계에는 독침으로 뒤덮인 특정 동물들이 존재하며, 그저 스치기만 해도 치명적일 수 있습니다. 접촉 또는 상처 독을 소모하고 10분을 들여 그 독을 옷에 발라 바르거나 날카로운 독침을 옷감에 엮어 넣습니다. 한 번에 한 가지 독만 옷에 스며들게 할 수 있습니다. 이렇게 독을 스며들게 한 상태에서는 @link[actions.once-bitten] 반응을 사용할 수 있다.

name: Perpetual Scout

description.value:
You spot anything out of place in the areas you know best. While in your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.sgo7J9BVofBqwlsF]{Favored Terrain}, you always gain the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{Scout} exploration activity, even if you are performing another exploration activity.

If you're legendary in Survival, you gain these benefits in any terrain.

_desc_en:
You spot anything out of place in the areas you know best. While in your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.sgo7J9BVofBqwlsF]{Favored Terrain}, you always gain the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{Scout} exploration activity, even if you are performing another exploration activity.

If you're legendary in Survival, you gain these benefits in any terrain.
_desc_ko:
가장 잘 아는 지역에서 이상한 점을 발견합니다. @link[feats.favored-terrain]에 있을 때는 다른 탐사 활동을 수행 중이라도 항상 @link[actions.scout] 탐사 활동의 혜택을 얻습니다.

생존 기술이 전설급이라면, 어떤 지형에서도 이 혜택을 얻습니다.

name: Mystery Conduit

description.value: The power of your mystery enables you access to myriad magic. If your next action is to Cast a Spell of 5th rank or lower that has no duration, you do not expend a spell slot.

_desc_en: The power of your mystery enables you access to myriad magic. If your next action is to Cast a Spell of 5th rank or lower that has no duration, you do not expend a spell slot.
_desc_ko: 당신의 신비의 힘은 수많은 마법에 접근할 수 있게 합니다. 다음 행동이 지속 시간이 없는 5랭크 이하의 주문을 시전하는 것이라면, 주문 슬롯을 소모하지 않습니다.

name: Samsaran Lore

description.value:
You have untold ages of knowledge beneath your belt, focused on the pursuit of enlightenment. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Religion and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Samsaran Lore.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You have untold ages of knowledge beneath your belt, focused on the pursuit of enlightenment. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Religion and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Samsaran Lore.
_desc_ko:
깨달음을 추구하는 데 포커스된, 헤아릴 수 없는 오랜 세월의 지식을 갖추고 있습니다. 종교와 사회에 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 해당 기술 중 하나에 자동으로 숙련이 부여될 경우, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련이 부여됩니다.

또한 삼사란 지식에 대한 @link[feats.additional-lore] 일반 피트를 획득합니다.

name: Master Bard Spellcasting

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#master-spellcasting-feat]{Master Spellcasting Feat} benefits.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#master-spellcasting-feat]{Master Spellcasting Feat} benefits.
_desc_ko: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#master-spellcasting-feat]{마스터 주문 시전 피트}의 혜택을 얻습니다.

name: Warp Space

description.value:
You use your magic to bend space, causing your spell to strike from a strange vector. Use this amp in place of a psi cantrip's normal amp entry. The amped psi cantrip must have a range.

Amp Choose a square within 30 feet to which you have line of effect and line of sight. Determine your spell's line of effect and line of sight from there, as well as whether creatures have cover against the spell. The spell can exceed its normal range as measured from you, as long as it's within its normal range from the square you chose.

_desc_en:
You use your magic to bend space, causing your spell to strike from a strange vector. Use this amp in place of a psi cantrip's normal amp entry. The amped psi cantrip must have a range.

Amp Choose a square within 30 feet to which you have line of effect and line of sight. Determine your spell's line of effect and line of sight from there, as well as whether creatures have cover against the spell. The spell can exceed its normal range as measured from you, as long as it's within its normal range from the square you chose.
_desc_ko:
당신은 마법으로 공간을 휘어, 주문을 이상한 벡터로 강타하게 합니다. 이 앰프를 사이 캔트립의 일반 앰프 항목 대신 사용하세요. 증폭된 사이 캔트립은 반드시 사거리를 가져야 합니다.

앰프 효과선과 시야가 확보된 30피트 내의 한 칸을 선택합니다. 해당 지점을 기준으로 주문의 효과선과 시야를 결정하며, 생물들이 주문에 대해 은폐 상태인지 여부도 판단합니다. 선택한 칸으로부터의 정상 사거리 범위 내라면, 당신으로부터 측정된 정상 사거리를 초과할 수 있습니다.

name: Unnerving Terror

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You're in yaoguai form.

You let out a mighty howl, chant of death, or speak with eerie repetition that plants fear in others. All enemies within 30 feet must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is frightened 1 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and off-guard.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You're in yaoguai form.

You let out a mighty howl, chant of death, or speak with eerie repetition that plants fear in others. All enemies within 30 feet must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is frightened 1 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and off-guard.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

요구 사항 당신은 야오과이 형태입니다.

당신은 강력한 울부짖음, 죽음의 주문을 외치거나, 다른 이들에게 공포를 심어주는 섬뜩한 반복으로 말합니다. 30피트 내의 모든 적들은 당신의 직업 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 더 높은 쪽에 대해 의지 저항 검사를 시도해야 합니다.

대성공 대상은 영향을 받지 않는다.

성공 대상은 @link[conditions.frightened]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

실패 대상은 공포 1 상태이며 @link[conditions.off-guard].

대실패 대상은 @link[conditions.frightened]{2} 상태이며 무방비입니다.

name: Seize Advantage

description.value:
Trigger Your student critically succeeds at a Strike or spell attack roll.

You take the openings granted by your student's success to reposition yourself. You Step or Stride up to your Speed.

_desc_en:
Trigger Your student critically succeeds at a Strike or spell attack roll.

You take the openings granted by your student's success to reposition yourself. You Step or Stride up to your Speed.
_desc_ko:
발동 제자가 타격 또는 주문 명중 굴림에서 대성공을 거둔다.

제자의 성공으로 생긴 틈을 이용해 위치를 재조정합니다. 이동 속도 범위 내에서 스텝 또는 스트라이드를 사용합니다.

name: Snare Setter

description.value: You are adept at the time-honored kobold art of making traps. You gain the trained proficiency in Crafting. If you were already trained in Crafting, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain access to all uncommon kobold snares. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.DMetdzt1VJL2Y62i]{Snare Crafting} feat, though when choosing your formulas for that feat, you can also choose from uncommon kobold snares, as well as common snares.

_desc_en: You are adept at the time-honored kobold art of making traps. You gain the trained proficiency in Crafting. If you were already trained in Crafting, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain access to all uncommon kobold snares. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.DMetdzt1VJL2Y62i]{Snare Crafting} feat, though when choosing your formulas for that feat, you can also choose from uncommon kobold snares, as well as common snares.
_desc_ko: 코볼트의 오랜 전통인 함정 제작에 능숙해집니다. 제작 기술에 숙련된 숙련도를 얻습니다. 이미 제작 기술에 숙련된 경우, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다. 모든 희귀급 코볼트 올가미에 접근할 수 있습니다. @link[feats.snare-crafting] 피트를 획득하며, 해당 피트의 제작법을 선택할 때 일반급 올가미뿐만 아니라 희귀급 코볼트 올가미도 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Eidolon's Wrath

description.value:
Your eidolon gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kuZnUNrhXHRYQ2eM]{Eidolon's Wrath} focus spell, which it casts, instead of you. You determine the damage type when you gain the feat: acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic, vitality, or void. If your eidolon is a celestial, fiend, or monitor with an alignment other than true neutral, you can choose a damage type in its alignment.

Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1. As normal, your eidolon shares your Focus Points.

_desc_en:
Your eidolon gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kuZnUNrhXHRYQ2eM]{Eidolon's Wrath} focus spell, which it casts, instead of you. You determine the damage type when you gain the feat: acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic, vitality, or void. If your eidolon is a celestial, fiend, or monitor with an alignment other than true neutral, you can choose a damage type in its alignment.

Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1. As normal, your eidolon shares your Focus Points.
_desc_ko:
당신의 에이돌론은 @link[spells.eidolons-wrath] 포커스 주문을 획득하며, 이 주문을 당신 대신 시전합니다. 이 피트를 획득할 때 피해 유형을 결정합니다: 산성, 냉기, 전기, 화염, 음파, 생명력, 또는 공허. 당신의 에이돌론이 천상체, 핀드, 또는 진정한 중립이 아닌 성향을 가진 모니터라면, 그 성향에 맞는 피해 유형을 선택할 수 있습니다.

포커스 풀의 포커스 포인트 수를 1 증가시킵니다. 평소와 같이, 당신의 에이돌론은 당신의 포커스 포인트를 공유합니다.

name: Overwhelming Blow

description.value: You throw your weight into a powerful attack that leaves you vulnerable. Make a melee Strike. This counts as three attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. If this Strike hits, you get a critical hit. If you roll a critical hit, your weapon or unarmed attack also gains the deadly d12 trait (this replaces any deadly trait it already has). Whether or not you hit, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} and are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn.

_desc_en: You throw your weight into a powerful attack that leaves you vulnerable. Make a melee Strike. This counts as three attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. If this Strike hits, you get a critical hit. If you roll a critical hit, your weapon or unarmed attack also gains the deadly d12 trait (this replaces any deadly trait it already has). Whether or not you hit, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} and are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn.
_desc_ko: 당신은 몸을 던져 강력한 공격을 가하지만, 그로 인해 약점이 됩니다. 근접 공격을 수행하세요. 이 공격은 다중 공격 페널티 계산 시 세 번의 공격으로 간주됩니다. 이 공격이 적중하면 치명타를 기록합니다. 치명타를 굴렸다면, 무기 또는 비무장 공격은 치명적인 d12 특성도 획득한다(기존에 있던 치명적인 특성은 대체됨). 명중 여부와 상관없이, 다음 턴 시작까지 @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태가 되고 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 된다.

name: Basic Psychic Spellcasting

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{Basic Spellcasting Feat} benefits. When you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the psychic archetype, add a spell of the appropriate spell rank to your repertoire: a common occult spell, one of the granted spells from your conscious mind, or another spell you've learned or discovered.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{Basic Spellcasting Feat} benefits. When you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the psychic archetype, add a spell of the appropriate spell rank to your repertoire: a common occult spell, one of the granted spells from your conscious mind, or another spell you've learned or discovered.
_desc_ko: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{기본 주문 시전 피트}의 혜택을 얻습니다. 사이킥 아키타입으로부터 새로운 레벨의 주문 슬롯을 획득할 때, 적절한 주문 랭크의 주문을 주문 목록에 추가하십시오: 일반적인 오컬트 주문, 의식적 마음으로부터 부여받은 주문 중 하나, 또는 배우거나 발견한 다른 주문입니다.

name: Battle Cry

description.value: When you roll initiative, you can yell a mighty battle cry and [[/act demoralize]] an observed foe as a free action. If you're legendary in Intimidation, you can use a reaction to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} your foe when you critically succeed at an attack roll.

_desc_en: When you roll initiative, you can yell a mighty battle cry and [[/act demoralize]] an observed foe as a free action. If you're legendary in Intimidation, you can use a reaction to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} your foe when you critically succeed at an attack roll.
_desc_ko: 이니셔티브를 굴릴 때, 강력한 전투 함성을 지르며 관찰된 적을 @link[actions.demoralize]시킬 수 있다. 이는 무료 행동이다. 협박에 전설적인 실력을 지녔다면, 명중 굴림에 대성공을 거둘 때 반응으로 적의 사기를 저하시킬 수 있다.

name: Unstable Gearshift

description.value:
You shift your body into a higher gear, your speed compounding further and further. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to all your Speeds, which lasts until the end of your next turn. At any time during your next turn, you can use Unstable Gearshift again, increasing the status bonus by another 5 feet and prolonging the effect for another round. You can keep using Unstable Gearshift in this way until you can no longer use your deviant abilities.

Awakening When moving at high speed, your form blurs. You have concealment for the duration of any move action you take while you are affected by Unstable Gearshift.

Awakening Your high-speed form has become partially out of phase with reality. While you are affected by Unstable Gearshift, you are not affected by physical difficult terrain (such as rubble), you do not trigger traps that use weight or pressure plates as a trigger, and you can move through enemy spaces without making checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through}, as you simply phase through them.

_desc_en:
You shift your body into a higher gear, your speed compounding further and further. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to all your Speeds, which lasts until the end of your next turn. At any time during your next turn, you can use Unstable Gearshift again, increasing the status bonus by another 5 feet and prolonging the effect for another round. You can keep using Unstable Gearshift in this way until you can no longer use your deviant abilities.

Awakening When moving at high speed, your form blurs. You have concealment for the duration of any move action you take while you are affected by Unstable Gearshift.

Awakening Your high-speed form has become partially out of phase with reality. While you are affected by Unstable Gearshift, you are not affected by physical difficult terrain (such as rubble), you do not trigger traps that use weight or pressure plates as a trigger, and you can move through enemy spaces without making checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through}, as you simply phase through them.
_desc_ko:
신체를 더 높은 기어로 전환하여 속도가 계속해서 가속됩니다. 모든 이동 속도에 +10피트 상태 보너스를 얻으며, 이는 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 지속된다. 다음 턴 중 언제든지 불안정한 기어 변속을 다시 사용할 수 있으며, 상태 보너스를 추가로 5피트 증가시키고 효과를 한 턴 더 연장한다. 변칙 능력을 더 이상 사용할 수 없을 때까지 이 방식으로 불안정한 기어 변속을 계속 사용할 수 있다.

각성 고속으로 이동할 때 당신의 형체가 흐릿해집니다. 불안정한 기어 변환의 효과가 지속되는 동안 취하는 모든 이동 행동에 대해 은폐 효과를 얻습니다.

각성 고속 형태가 현실과 부분적으로 위상이 어긋났다. 불안정한 기어 변환의 효과가 지속되는 동안, 당신은 물리적 어려운 지형(예: 잔해)의 영향을 받지 않으며, 무게나 압력판을 감지 장치로 사용하는 함정을 작동시키지 않습니다. 또한 적의 공간을 통과할 때 @link[actions.tumble-through] 능력의 판정을 수행할 필요 없이 단순히 위상 이동하여 통과할 수 있습니다.

name: Jotunborn Weapon Familiarity

description.value: You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the jotunborn trait. You have familiarity with weapons with the jotunborn trait plus the bola, greataxe, halberd, maul, longspear, and war flail—for the purpose of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

_desc_en: You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the jotunborn trait. You have familiarity with weapons with the jotunborn trait plus the bola, greataxe, halberd, maul, longspear, and war flail—for the purpose of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.
_desc_ko: 요툰본 특성을 가진 모든 흔하지 않은 무기를 사용할 수 있습니다. 요툰본 특성을 가진 무기 외에도 볼라, 그레이트액스, 할버드, 마울, 롱스피어, 워플레이에 패밀리어입니다. 숙련도 목적상, 이 중 무술 무기인 것은 단순 무기로, 고급 무기인 것은 무술 무기로 취급합니다.

name: Crawling Form

description.value: You can transform into a small animal or celestial creature to scurry and spy. You can Change Shape to assume a crawling form. While in crawling form, you gain the effect of a 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gfPjmG6Fe6D3MFjl]{Pest Form}, except you can transform only into a shape matching your heritage; for example, if you were once were a wolf, you turn into a wolf puppy.

value.value: born of animal or born of celestial heritage

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You can transform into a small animal or celestial creature to scurry and spy. You can Change Shape to assume a crawling form. While in crawling form, you gain the effect of a 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gfPjmG6Fe6D3MFjl]{Pest Form}, except you can transform only into a shape matching your heritage; for example, if you were once were a wolf, you turn into a wolf puppy.
_desc_ko: 작은 동물이나 천상체로 변신하여 재빠르게 움직이며 정찰할 수 있습니다. 변신 능력을 사용해 기어다니는 형태를 취할 수 있습니다. 기어다니는 형태일 때, 1등급 @link[spells.pest-form]의 효과를 얻습니다. 단, 자신의 혈통에 맞는 형태로만 변신할 수 있습니다. 예를 들어, 과거 늑대였던 경우 늑대 새끼로 변신합니다.

name: Shape of the Dragon

description.value:
You've discovered how to transform yourself into a dragon. Once per day, you can cast 7th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5c692cCcTDXjSEzk]{Dragon Form} as an innate arcane spell, transforming into your chosen type of dragon. The spell automatically heightens to 8th level if you're 16th level and 9th rank if you're 18th level.

Any time you score a critical hit with an unarmed Strike gained from dragon form, you recharge the spell's breath weapon immediately.

_desc_en:
You've discovered how to transform yourself into a dragon. Once per day, you can cast 7th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5c692cCcTDXjSEzk]{Dragon Form} as an innate arcane spell, transforming into your chosen type of dragon. The spell automatically heightens to 8th level if you're 16th level and 9th rank if you're 18th level.

Any time you score a critical hit with an unarmed Strike gained from dragon form, you recharge the spell's breath weapon immediately.
_desc_ko:
당신은 자신을 용으로 변신시키는 방법을 발견했습니다. 하루에 한 번, 선천적 아케인 주문으로 (7th)랭크 @link[spells.dragon-form]를 시전하여 선택한 용의 유형으로 변신할 수 있습니다. 이 주문은 16레벨일 경우 자동으로 (8th)레벨로, 18레벨일 경우 9레벨로 강화한다.

용의 형태로 얻은 비무장 공격으로 치명타를 성공시킬 때마다, 해당 마법의 숨결 무기를 즉시 재충전합니다.

name: Siren Song

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You can beguile and bewitch with your song. All creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:60] must attempt a @Check[will|against:performance] save against your Performance DC. On subsequent rounds, you can Sustain the song, causing each creature in the area currently affected by your song to attempt another Will save. Typically, creatures that have traveled with you for a significant time, such as your fellow party members, are immune to your Siren Song.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and becomes immune to your Siren Song for 24 hours.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with you until the end of your next turn.

Failure As success, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for as long as it's fascinated.

Critical Failure As success, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for as long as it's fascinated.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

전제 조건 공연 숙련자

당신은 노래로 매혹하고 홀릴 수 있습니다. 60피트 내 모든 생물은 당신의 공연 DC에 대한 의지 내성을 시도해야 합니다. 후속 라운드에 노래를 지속하면, 현재 노래의 영향을 받는 영역 내 모든 생물이 또 다른 의지 내성을 시도하다. 일반적으로 동료 파티원처럼 오랜 시간 함께 여행한 생물들은 당신의 사이렌 노래에 면역입니다.

대성공 대상은 영향을 받지 않으며 24시간 동안 당신의 사이렌 송에 면역이 됩니다.

성공 대상은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 당신에게 @link[conditions.fascinated]됩니다.

실패 성공과 동일하며, 대상은 매혹 상태가 지속되는 동안 @link[conditions.stupefied]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

대실패 성공 시와 동일하며, 대상은 매혹 상태가 지속되는 동안 @link[conditions.stupefied]{2} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Musetouched

description.value: Your blood sings with the liberating power of the azatas, living embodiments of freedom from the wild realm of Elysium. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}. When you roll a critical failure on a check to Escape, you get a failure instead, and when you roll a success, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_ko: 당신의 피는 엘리시움의 야생 렐름에서 자유를 구현한 생명체인 아자타스의 해방적인 힘으로 울려 퍼집니다. @link[actions.escape]에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 탈출 판정에서 대실패를 굴렸을 때 실패로 처리되며, 성공을 굴렸을 때 대성공으로 처리됩니다.

name: Shared Warding

description.value: You ward your allies from the attacks of your foes whenever you apply those protections to yourself. When you gain a status bonus to AC and saves from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.P6cTyDMTXcC8HBDr]{Esoteric Warden}, you can choose to grant the same benefit to all allies within 30 feet.

_desc_en: You ward your allies from the attacks of your foes whenever you apply those protections to yourself. When you gain a status bonus to AC and saves from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.P6cTyDMTXcC8HBDr]{Esoteric Warden}, you can choose to grant the same benefit to all allies within 30 feet.
_desc_ko: 자신에게 적용하는 보호 효과를 아군에게도 부여합니다. @link[feats.esoteric-warden]로 인해 AC와 내성에 상태 보너스를 얻을 때, 30피트 내 모든 아군에게 동일한 혜택을 부여할 수 있습니다.

name: Stomp Ground

description.value:
You bring your booted foot down on the ground with enough force to rattle your foes. Each creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:guardian|options:area-effect,damaging-effect,inflicts:off-guard,inflicts:prone] saving throw against your class DC.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your turn.

Failure The creature is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Critical Failure The creature is knocked prone and takes @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage from the fall.

_desc_en:
You bring your booted foot down on the ground with enough force to rattle your foes. Each creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:guardian|options:area-effect,damaging-effect,inflicts:off-guard,inflicts:prone] saving throw against your class DC.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your turn.

Failure The creature is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Critical Failure The creature is knocked prone and takes @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage from the fall.
_desc_ko:
부츠를 신은 발을 땅에 힘차게 내리찍어 적들을 덜컹거리게 할 만큼의 힘을 가합니다. 5피트 발산 내 모든 생물은 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 반사 내성 굴림을 시도하다.

대성공 생물은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 해당 생물은 당신의 턴이 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다.

실패 생물은 @link[conditions.prone] 상태가 된다.

대실패 생물은 넘어져 1d6 타격의 낙하 피해를 입습니다.

name: Advanced Muse's Whispers

description.value:
You gain one bard feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your bard level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another bard feat.

_desc_en:
You gain one bard feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your bard level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another bard feat.
_desc_ko:
바드 피트 하나를 획득합니다. 해당 피트의 전제 조건을 충족할 때, 당신의 바드 레벨은 캐릭터 레벨의 절반으로 간주됩니다.

특수 이 재주를 여러 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 선택할 때마다 추가로 바드 피트 하나를 얻습니다.

name: Uplifting Overture

description.value: You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f0Z5mqGA6Yu79B8x]{Uplifting Overture} composition cantrip, which aids your allies' skills with the inspiring nature of your performance.

_desc_en: You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f0Z5mqGA6Yu79B8x]{Uplifting Overture} composition cantrip, which aids your allies' skills with the inspiring nature of your performance.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @link[spells.uplifting-overture] 작곡 캔트립을 배웁니다. 이 주문은 당신의 감동적인 공연으로 아군들의 기술을 돕습니다.

name: Dormant Eruption

description.value: A sweltering heat and sparks of flame that take the form of tiny copies of you surround your body. You're hot to the touch, gaining resistance 5 to cold and fire. Whenever an adjacent creature Strikes you with a melee attack or touches you, it takes @Damage[1d6[persistent,fire]] damage. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cx5tBTy6weK6YSw9]{Thermal Eruption} action.

value.value: You've been brought to 0 Hit Points by an enemy that has the fire trait or an enemy's ability that has the fire trait

_desc_en: A sweltering heat and sparks of flame that take the form of tiny copies of you surround your body. You're hot to the touch, gaining resistance 5 to cold and fire. Whenever an adjacent creature Strikes you with a melee attack or touches you, it takes @Damage[1d6[persistent,fire]] damage. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cx5tBTy6weK6YSw9]{Thermal Eruption} action.
_desc_ko: 무더운 열기와 작은 불꽃이 당신의 몸을 둘러싸고 있습니다. 만지면 뜨겁고, 냉기와 불에 대한 저항력 5를 얻습니다. 인접한 생물이 근접 공격으로 당신을 공격하거나 만질 때마다 1d6 지속 화염의 피해를 입습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.thermal-eruption] 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Bestial Manifestation

description.value:
Part of your body has an animalistic influence from a planar creature. Your hands end in claws, you have hooves instead of feet, sharp teeth fill your mouth, or a tail extends from your spine. You gain your choice of one of the following unarmed attacks. The attack is in the brawling group and has the listed damage die and traits.

Claw 1d4 slashing (agile, finesse, unarmed, versatile piercing)

Hoof 1d6 bludgeoning (finesse, unarmed)

Jaws 1d6 piercing (finesse, unarmed)

Tail 1d4 bludgeoning (agile, finesse, unarmed)

Special You can select this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain into or out of this feat, nor can you change the type of attack you gained.

_desc_en:
Part of your body has an animalistic influence from a planar creature. Your hands end in claws, you have hooves instead of feet, sharp teeth fill your mouth, or a tail extends from your spine. You gain your choice of one of the following unarmed attacks. The attack is in the brawling group and has the listed damage die and traits.

Claw 1d4 slashing (agile, finesse, unarmed, versatile piercing)

Hoof 1d6 bludgeoning (finesse, unarmed)

Jaws 1d6 piercing (finesse, unarmed)

Tail 1d4 bludgeoning (agile, finesse, unarmed)

Special You can select this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain into or out of this feat, nor can you change the type of attack you gained.
_desc_ko:
당신의 신체 일부가 평면 생물의 동물적 영향을 받습니다. 손끝이 발톱으로 변하거나, 발이 발굽으로 바뀌거나, 입안에 날카로운 이빨이 가득하거나, 척추에서 꼬리가 뻗어 나온다. 다음 비무장 공격 중 하나를 선택하여 획득한다. 해당 공격은 난투 그룹에 속하며, 명시된 피해 주사위와 특성을 가진다.

발톱 1d4 베기 (기민한, 기교, 무기, 다용도 관통)

발굽 1d6 타격 (기교, 무장)

턱 1d6 관통 (기교, 맨손)

꼬리 1d4 타격 (기민한, 기교, 맨손)

특수 이 피트는 1레벨에서만 선택할 수 있으며, 재훈련으로 획득하거나 포기할 수 없고, 획득한 공격 유형을 변경할 수도 없습니다.

name: Perfected Gamtu

description.value:
Your hat embodies the illusory grandeur of a master dokkaebi. Your gamtu now grants its wearer a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks when worn, and its Hat Trick activation can grant your choice of 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} or 6th-rank invisibility.

In addition, the gamtu can be removed while Hat Trick is activated. Doing so removes the effects of invisibility from the original wearer, but the spell doesn't end. Instead, the effect continues to elapse; if another creature puts the gamtu on, they're immediately affected by invisibility, which lasts for the remaining duration of Hat Trick.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Your hat embodies the illusory grandeur of a master dokkaebi. Your gamtu now grants its wearer a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks when worn, and its Hat Trick activation can grant your choice of 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} or 6th-rank invisibility.

In addition, the gamtu can be removed while Hat Trick is activated. Doing so removes the effects of invisibility from the original wearer, but the spell doesn't end. Instead, the effect continues to elapse; if another creature puts the gamtu on, they're immediately affected by invisibility, which lasts for the remaining duration of Hat Trick.
_desc_ko:
당신의 모자는 마스터 도깨비의 환상적인 위엄을 구현합니다. 착용 시 은신 판정에서 +1 아이템 보너스를 부여하며, 모자 트릭 발동 시 (2nd)랭크 @link[spells.invisibility] 또는 (6th)랭크 투명화 중 하나를 선택할 수 있습니다.

또한 모자 트릭 활성화 중에도 감투를 벗을 수 있습니다. 이 경우 원래 착용자에게 걸린 투명화 효과가 사라지지만, 주문 자체는 종료되지 않습니다. 대신 효과가 계속해서 소모되며, 다른 생물이 감투를 착용하면 즉시 투명화의 영향을 받게 되며, 이 효과는 해트 트릭의 남은 지속 시간 동안 유지됩니다.

name: Chosen of Lamashtu

description.value: You bear the favor and blessings of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.aipkJQxP4GBsTaGq]{Lamashtu}, the Mother of Monsters. She has bestowed a mutation upon you, granting you the benefits of another heritage. Choose one goblin heritage that you do not already have; you gain that heritage and its benefits.

_desc_en: You bear the favor and blessings of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.aipkJQxP4GBsTaGq]{Lamashtu}, the Mother of Monsters. She has bestowed a mutation upon you, granting you the benefits of another heritage. Choose one goblin heritage that you do not already have; you gain that heritage and its benefits.
_desc_ko: 당신은 괴물의 어머니 @link[deities.lamashtu]의 은총과 축복을 받았습니다. 그녀는 당신에게 변이를 부여하여 다른 혈통의 혜택을 누리게 했습니다. 아직 보유하지 않은 고블린 혈통 하나를 선택하세요. 해당 혈통과 그 혜택을 얻습니다.

name: Strong of Wing

description.value: You can fly with a greater distance. The fly Speed you gain from Take Flight increases to 25 feet.

_desc_en: You can fly with a greater distance. The fly Speed you gain from Take Flight increases to 25 feet.
_desc_ko: 더 먼 거리를 비행할 수 있습니다. 날기 능력으로 얻는 비행 속도가 25피트로 증가합니다.

name: Axiomatic Lore

description.value:
You possess a strong understanding of process among mortals and lawful outsiders alike. The source of this knowledge might be intuition, study, or a childhood spent among other aphorites.

You gain the trained proficiency rank in Diplomacy and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also become trained in Axis Lore.

_desc_en:
You possess a strong understanding of process among mortals and lawful outsiders alike. The source of this knowledge might be intuition, study, or a childhood spent among other aphorites.

You gain the trained proficiency rank in Diplomacy and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also become trained in Axis Lore.
_desc_ko:
당신은 인간과 질서적 외부 존재 모두의 과정에 대한 깊은 이해를 지녔습니다. 이 지식의 근원은 직관, 연구, 혹은 다른 격언주의자들 사이에서 보낸 어린 시절일 수 있습니다.

당신은 외교와 사회에 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 해당 기술 중 하나에 자동으로 숙련되게 된다면, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다. 또한 축의 지식에 숙련됩니다.

참고: 이 피트로 부여되는 기술에 이미 숙련된 경우, 대체 기술을 수동으로 선택해야 합니다. 부여되는 지식 기술도 수동으로 입력해야 합니다.

name: Steelhoof

description.value: You've girded your hooves in steel or other reinforcements aimed to inflict maximum damage. Your hoof attack deals 1d8 bludgeoning damage instead of 1d6.

_desc_en: You've girded your hooves in steel or other reinforcements aimed to inflict maximum damage. Your hoof attack deals 1d8 bludgeoning damage instead of 1d6.
_desc_ko: 당신은 발굽에 강철이나 다른 보강재를 둘러 최대의 피해를 입히도록 했습니다. 당신의 발굽 공격은 1d6 대신 1d8 타격 피해를 줍니다.

name: Grave Sense

description.value: Your time spent hunting the undead allows you to sense them. You sense undead as a vague sense similar to a human's sense of smell, an uncomfortable sensation akin to smelling something cloying and rotting. When in proximity to the undead, you eventually sense their presence, though you might not do so instantly, and you can't pinpoint their location. An undead using a disguise or otherwise trying to hide its presence must attempt a Deception check against your Perception DC to hide its presence from you. If the creature succeeds at its Deception check, it is then temporarily immune to your Grave Sense for 1 day.

_desc_en: Your time spent hunting the undead allows you to sense them. You sense undead as a vague sense similar to a human's sense of smell, an uncomfortable sensation akin to smelling something cloying and rotting. When in proximity to the undead, you eventually sense their presence, though you might not do so instantly, and you can't pinpoint their location. An undead using a disguise or otherwise trying to hide its presence must attempt a Deception check against your Perception DC to hide its presence from you. If the creature succeeds at its Deception check, it is then temporarily immune to your Grave Sense for 1 day.
_desc_ko: 언데드를 사냥하며 보낸 시간 덕분에 당신은 그들을 감지할 수 있게 되었다. 언데드는 인간의 후각과 유사한 막연한 감각으로 느껴지며, 달콤하면서도 썩은 냄새를 맡는 듯한 불쾌한 감각이다. 언데드 근처에 있을 때, 즉시 느끼지 못할 수도 있지만 결국 그들의 존재를 감지하게 되며, 정확한 위치를 파악할 수는 없습니다. 변장이나 다른 방법으로 자신의 존재를 숨기려는 언데드는 당신에게서 자신의 존재를 숨기기 위해 당신의 지각 DC에 대한 기만 판정을 시도해야 합니다. 해당 생물이 기만 판정에서 성공하면, 1일 동안 당신의 무덤 감지 능력에 대해 일시적으로 면역이 됩니다.

name: Temporal Fury

description.value: You shift and skip through time, vanishing during your movement to appear in unexpected and advantageous locations for combat. Spend a Mythic Point. Strike, then Step up to 10 feet. This movement is affected normally by barriers and difficult terrain; you still move physically through the area, just so swiftly that it appears that you've teleported. Then, make another Strike. Apply your multiple attack penalty to both Strikes normally, but this second Strike is made at mythic proficiency and your target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against it.

publication.title: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

_desc_en: You shift and skip through time, vanishing during your movement to appear in unexpected and advantageous locations for combat. Spend a Mythic Point. Strike, then Step up to 10 feet. This movement is affected normally by barriers and difficult terrain; you still move physically through the area, just so swiftly that it appears that you've teleported. Then, make another Strike. Apply your multiple attack penalty to both Strikes normally, but this second Strike is made at mythic proficiency and your target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against it.
_desc_ko: 당신은 시간을 넘나들며 이동 중 사라졌다가 전투에서 예상치 못한 유리한 위치에 나타난다. 신화 점수를 소비한다. 타격을 한 다음, 최대 10피트까지 걸음을 한다. 이 이동은 장벽과 험지의 영향을 정상적으로 받는다. 당신은 여전히 그 영역을 물리적으로 이동하지만, 너무 빠르게 이동하여 마치 순간이동한 것처럼 보일 뿐이다. 그런 다음 또 한 번 타격을 한다. 두 타격 모두에 다중공격 페널티를 정상적으로 적용하지만, 이 두 번째 타격은 신화 숙련도로 이루어지며 당신의 대상은 그에 대해 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{무방비} 상태가 된다.

name: Twin Distraction

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding two melee weapons, each in a different hand.

Your movements with two weapons are so swift and disorienting that they befuddle your opponent. When using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.9XALeVNcmlIxf3tJ]{Twin Feint}, if both your Strikes deal damage to a targeted creature, the target must succeed at a @Check[will|against:rogue] saving throw against your class DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until the end of your next turn.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding two melee weapons, each in a different hand.

Your movements with two weapons are so swift and disorienting that they befuddle your opponent. When using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.9XALeVNcmlIxf3tJ]{Twin Feint}, if both your Strikes deal damage to a targeted creature, the target must succeed at a @Check[will|against:rogue] saving throw against your class DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손에 각각 다른 근접 무기를 들고 있습니다.

두 무기로 하는 당신의 움직임은 너무나 빠르고 혼란스러워 상대방을 당황하게 합니다. @link[feats.twin-feint]를 사용할 때, 두 공격 모두 대상 생물에게 피해를 입힌다면, 대상은 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 의지 내성 굴림에서 성공해야 하며, 그렇지 않으면 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.stupefied]{1}이 됩니다.

name: Rekindled Light

description.value:
Trigger You or an ally within 30 feet of your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.d1FTY5ai9KjpkX59]{Star Orb} familiar would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.

You temporarily drain your star orb familiar's energy to save an ally. The target avoids being knocked out and remains at 1 Hit Point, and their @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition increases by 1. The target then @Damage[@actor.level[healing,vitality]]{regains Hit Points} equal to your level. When the familiar's energy is drained, it becomes dormant until your next daily preparations.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Trigger You or an ally within 30 feet of your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.d1FTY5ai9KjpkX59]{Star Orb} familiar would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.

You temporarily drain your star orb familiar's energy to save an ally. The target avoids being knocked out and remains at 1 Hit Point, and their @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition increases by 1. The target then @Damage[@actor.level[healing,vitality]]{regains Hit Points} equal to your level. When the familiar's energy is drained, it becomes dormant until your next daily preparations.
_desc_ko:
Trigger 당신이나 당신의 @link[feats.star-orb] 패밀리어로부터 30피트 이내에 있는 아군이 HP가 0이 되지만 즉시 죽지는 않습니다.

당신은 아군을 구하기 위해 일시적으로 별의 구슬 패밀리어의 에너지를 흡수합니다. 대상은 기절을 피하고 1 HP로 유지되며, @link[conditions.wounded] 상태가 1 증가합니다. 이후 대상은 HP를 회복하며, 회복량은 당신의 레벨 에 해당합니다. 패밀리어의 에너지가 흡수되면, 다음 일일 준비 시까지 휴면 상태가 됩니다.

name: Advanced Bloodline

description.value: You draw more power from your bloodline. You gain the advanced bloodline spell associated with your bloodline.

_desc_en: You draw more power from your bloodline. You gain the advanced bloodline spell associated with your bloodline.
_desc_ko: 혈통으로부터 더 많은 힘을 끌어냅니다. 자신의 혈통과 연관된 고급 혈통 주문을 얻습니다.

name: Shiny Button Eyes

description.value: You've polished your eyes to reflect the smallest details in dimmest light. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.i4yRvVwvXbGZDsD1]{Canny Acumen} skill feat as a bonus feat, but you must choose Perception. Additionally, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks against visual illusions.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en: You've polished your eyes to reflect the smallest details in dimmest light. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.i4yRvVwvXbGZDsD1]{Canny Acumen} skill feat as a bonus feat, but you must choose Perception. Additionally, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks against visual illusions.
_desc_ko: 어둠 속에서도 가장 미세한 디테일까지 반사할 수 있도록 눈을 갈고닦았습니다. 보너스 피트로 @link[feats.canny-acumen] 기술 재주를 얻지만, 반드시 지각을 선택해야 합니다. 또한 시각적 환상에 대한 지각 판정 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Zealous Inevitability

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding your deity's favored weapon

You channel your zeal through a sacred weapon, bringing a foe closer to their demise. Strike a target with the required weapon. on a success, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} or increases the value of their doomed condition by 1 (most living creatures die when they've reached doomed 4). Creatures doomed in this way take a status penalty to their saving throws against divine spells equal to their doomed value.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.NDCeLFdp5eJ1VYjm]{Effect: Zealous Inevitability}

A creature that would become doomed 4 by this Strike can attempt a @Check[will|against:class|traits:incapacitation|options:inflicts:doomed] saving throw against your class DC to avoid increasing the value of their doomed condition. When this occurs, this ability gains the incapacitation trait.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding your deity's favored weapon

You channel your zeal through a sacred weapon, bringing a foe closer to their demise. Strike a target with the required weapon. on a success, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} or increases the value of their doomed condition by 1 (most living creatures die when they've reached doomed 4). Creatures doomed in this way take a status penalty to their saving throws against divine spells equal to their doomed value.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.NDCeLFdp5eJ1VYjm]{Effect: Zealous Inevitability}

A creature that would become doomed 4 by this Strike can attempt a @Check[will|against:class|traits:incapacitation|options:inflicts:doomed] saving throw against your class DC to avoid increasing the value of their doomed condition. When this occurs, this ability gains the incapacitation trait.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 신이 선호하는 무기를 휘두르고 있을 것

당신은 신성한 무기를 통해 열정을 집중시켜 적을 죽음에 한 걸음 더 가까이 이끕니다. 필요한 무기로 대상을 강타하십시오. 성공 시, 대상은 @link[conditions.doomed]{1} 상태가 되거나 운명 상태 수치를 1 증가시킵니다(대부분의 생명체는 운명 4에 도달하면 사망합니다). 이 방법으로 운명 상태가 된 생물은 신성 마법에 대한 내성 굴림 시 운명 수치와 동일한 상태 페널티를 받습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.NDCeLFdp5eJ1VYjm]{효과: 열렬한 필연성}

이 공격으로 인해 파멸 상태가 될 생물은 자신의 파멸 상태 수치를 증가시키지 않기 위해 당신의 직업 난이도(DC)에 대한 의지 내성 굴림을 시도할 수 있습니다. 이 경우, 이 능력은 무력화 특성을 얻습니다.

name: Round Ears

description.value:
Your elven lineage is subtle enough that you look barely different from other humans, and you've learned to use that to your advantage. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Deception (or another skill of your choice, if you were already trained in Deception). You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to Impersonate checks to pretend you aren't a half-elf. Observers are never granted circumstance bonuses to Perception checks due to you Impersonating a full-blooded human, and you never take circumstance penalties due to you Impersonating a full-blooded human.

Special You can take this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain out of this feat or into this feat.

_desc_en:
Your elven lineage is subtle enough that you look barely different from other humans, and you've learned to use that to your advantage. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Deception (or another skill of your choice, if you were already trained in Deception). You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to Impersonate checks to pretend you aren't a half-elf. Observers are never granted circumstance bonuses to Perception checks due to you Impersonating a full-blooded human, and you never take circumstance penalties due to you Impersonating a full-blooded human.

Special You can take this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain out of this feat or into this feat.
_desc_ko:
당신의 엘프 혈통은 미묘하여 다른 인간들과 거의 다를 바 없으며, 이를 유리하게 활용하는 법을 터득했습니다. 당신은 기만(혹은 이미 기만에 숙련된 경우 선택한 다른 기술)에 숙련 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 반엘프가 아닌 척하는 변장 판정에는 +4 상황 보너스를 받습니다. 순혈 인간으로 변장한 당신을 관찰하는 자들은 지각 판정에서 상황 보너스를 절대 받지 않으며, 순혈 인간으로 변장한 당신도 상황 페널티를 절대 받지 않습니다.

특수 이 피트는 1레벨에만 선택할 수 있으며, 재훈련으로 이 피트를 포기하거나 다시 선택할 수 없습니다.

name: Reverberate

description.value:
Trigger A creature or hazard would deal sonic damage to you.

You can manipulate the acoustics around you to deflect sonic damage back at its source. Attempt a Performance check against the @Check[performance|defense:will]{Will DC} of the creature or @Check[performance|defense:fortitude]{Fortitude DC} of a hazard. If the damage came from a spell, use the creature's spell DC if it's lower.

Critical Success You reduce the triggering damage by an amount up to four times your level. The creature takes sonic damage equal to the amount of damage you reduced in this way.

Success As critical success, but you reduce the triggering damage by an amount up to twice your level.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature or hazard would deal sonic damage to you.

You can manipulate the acoustics around you to deflect sonic damage back at its source. Attempt a Performance check against the @Check[performance|defense:will]{Will DC} of the creature or @Check[performance|defense:fortitude]{Fortitude DC} of a hazard. If the damage came from a spell, use the creature's spell DC if it's lower.

Critical Success You reduce the triggering damage by an amount up to four times your level. The creature takes sonic damage equal to the amount of damage you reduced in this way.

Success As critical success, but you reduce the triggering damage by an amount up to twice your level.
_desc_ko:
발동 생물이나 위험 요소가 당신에게 음파 피해를 입히려 할 때.

주변 음향을 조작하여 음파 피해를 발생원으로 되돌려 보낼 수 있습니다. 생물의 의지 DC 또는 위험 요소의 인내 DC에 대해 연주 검사를 시도하십시오. 피해가 주문에서 비롯된 경우, 해당 생물의 주문 DC가 더 낮다면 이를 사용하십시오.

대성공 발동 피해를 자신의 레벨의 최대 4배까지 감소시킵니다. 해당 생물은 이렇게 감소시킨 피해량만큼의 음파 피해를 입습니다.

성공 대성공과 동일하나, 발동 피해를 자신의 레벨의 최대 2배까지 감소시킵니다.

name: Rope Mastery

description.value: Ropes are your tool of choice, and you deploy them in versatile ways. When Climbing a rope, you move 5 more feet on a success and 10 more feet on a critical success, to a maximum of your Speed. This additional movement stacks with the effects of Quick Climb. In addition, you can use a rope to hamper your foes. When holding a rope, you can attempt an Athletics check to Disarm, Grapple, or Trip a creature up to 10 feet away instead of only adjacent creatures. If you critically fail such a check while holding a rope, you can drop the rope to take the effects of a failure instead of a critical failure.

_desc_en: Ropes are your tool of choice, and you deploy them in versatile ways. When Climbing a rope, you move 5 more feet on a success and 10 more feet on a critical success, to a maximum of your Speed. This additional movement stacks with the effects of Quick Climb. In addition, you can use a rope to hamper your foes. When holding a rope, you can attempt an Athletics check to Disarm, Grapple, or Trip a creature up to 10 feet away instead of only adjacent creatures. If you critically fail such a check while holding a rope, you can drop the rope to take the effects of a failure instead of a critical failure.
_desc_ko: 밧줄은 당신의 주요 도구이며, 이를 다채롭게 활용합니다. 밧줄을 타고 오를 때 성공 시 5피트, 대성공 시 10피트 추가 이동이 가능하며, 최대 이동 거리는 당신의 이동 속도입니다. 이 추가 이동은 신속 등반 효과와 중첩됩니다. 또한, 당신은 밧줄을 이용해 적을 방해할 수 있습니다. 밧줄을 잡고 있을 때, 인접한 생물뿐만 아니라 최대 10피트 떨어진 생물에게도 무장 해제, 그랩, 트립을 시도하다(운동 능력 판정) 할 수 있습니다. 밧줄을 잡고 있을 때 이러한 판정에서 대실패를 하면, 밧줄을 떨어뜨려 대실패 대신 실패의 효과를 받을 수 있습니다.

name: Springsoul

description.value: Your connection to elemental wood manifests as fresh blossoms, spring fruits, and the seeds of new life, and you harness this power to spread vitality and abundance. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uZK2BYzPnxUBnDjr]{Tangle Vine} cantrip as an innate primal or arcane spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

_desc_en: Your connection to elemental wood manifests as fresh blossoms, spring fruits, and the seeds of new life, and you harness this power to spread vitality and abundance. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uZK2BYzPnxUBnDjr]{Tangle Vine} cantrip as an innate primal or arcane spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 당신의 원소 목과의 연결은 싱그러운 꽃봉오리, 봄의 열매, 새로운 생명의 씨앗으로 창조되며, 당신은 이 힘을 활용해 활력과 풍요를 퍼뜨립니다. 당신은 @link[spells.tangle-vine] 캔트립을 선천적인 프라이멀 또는 아케인 마법으로 마음대로 시전할 수 있습니다. 캔트립은 당신의 레벨 절반(반올림)에 해당하는 주문 랭크으로 강화됩니다.

name: Spiral Sworn

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You trace a spiral in the air while intoning prayers to Pharasma, gaining her blessing for a time. For 3 rounds, your Strikes and spells deal additional damage against undead, creatures in possession of an imprisoned soul, or creatures you have witnessed create or command undead. You gain a status bonus to damage with your Strikes against these creatures equal to the number of weapon damage dice. Spells you cast from spell slots gain a status bonus to damage against these creatures equal to the rank of the spell; this bonus applies only to spells that deal damage and don't have a duration.

If your spiral is glowing, you can target a willing creature in its light. If you do, that creature gains the bonuses instead of you.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.2gVP04ZWYbQdX3uS]{Effect: Spiral Sworn}

_desc_en:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You trace a spiral in the air while intoning prayers to Pharasma, gaining her blessing for a time. For 3 rounds, your Strikes and spells deal additional damage against undead, creatures in possession of an imprisoned soul, or creatures you have witnessed create or command undead. You gain a status bonus to damage with your Strikes against these creatures equal to the number of weapon damage dice. Spells you cast from spell slots gain a status bonus to damage against these creatures equal to the rank of the spell; this bonus applies only to spells that deal damage and don't have a duration.

If your spiral is glowing, you can target a willing creature in its light. If you do, that creature gains the bonuses instead of you.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.2gVP04ZWYbQdX3uS]{Effect: Spiral Sworn}
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 10분마다 1회

공중에 나선형을 그리며 파라스마에게 기도를 올리는 동안, 잠시 그녀의 축복을 받습니다. 3라운드 동안, 당신의 공격과 주문은 언데드, 갇힌 영혼을 소유한 생물, 또는 당신이 목격한 언데드를 창조하거나 지휘하는 생물에게 추가 피해를 입힙니다. 이 생물들에 대한 공격 시 무기 피해 주사위 수만큼의 상태 보너스를 받는다. 주문 슬롯으로 시전하는 주문은 해당 주문 랭크만큼의 상태 보너스를 받으며, 이 보너스는 지속 시간이 없는 피해 주문에만 적용된다.

나선형이 빛나고 있다면, 그 빛 안에 있는 동의한 대상을 대상으로 삼을 수 있습니다. 그렇게 할 경우, 해당 생물이 대신 보너스를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.2gVP04ZWYbQdX3uS]{효과: 나선 맹세}

name: Swipe Souvenir

description.value:
Requirements You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by a creature.

When you wriggle free from an enemy's grasp, you take something of theirs with you. You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} from being grabbed or restrained by a creature. If you succeed, you can also attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} from the creature, even if the creature is in combat.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by a creature.

When you wriggle free from an enemy's grasp, you take something of theirs with you. You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} from being grabbed or restrained by a creature. If you succeed, you can also attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} from the creature, even if the creature is in combat.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 @link[conditions.grabbed] 상태이거나 @link[conditions.restrained] 상태여야 합니다.

적의 잡기에서 벗어나면, 당신은 그 생물의 물건을 하나 가져갑니다. 당신은 생물에게 붙잡기거나 구속당하는 상태에서 @link[actions.escape]을 시도합니다. 성공하면, 생물이 전투 중일지라도 그 생물에게서 @link[actions.steal]을 시도할 수 있습니다.

name: Archer's Aim

description.value: You slow down, focus, and take a careful shot. Make a ranged Strike with a weapon in the bow or crossbow weapon group. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll and ignore the target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition. If the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, reduce the flat check from being hidden from 11 to 5.

_desc_en: You slow down, focus, and take a careful shot. Make a ranged Strike with a weapon in the bow or crossbow weapon group. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll and ignore the target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition. If the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, reduce the flat check from being hidden from 11 to 5.
_desc_ko: 속도를 늦추고 포커스를 맞춰 신중하게 조준합니다. 활 또는 석궁 무기 그룹에 속하는 무기로 원거리 강타를 수행합니다. 명중 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 대상의 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태를 무시한다. 대상이 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태라면, 숨김으로 인한 단순 판정 난이도를 11에서 5로 낮춘다.

name: Demonblood Frenzy

description.value:
Access Matanji ethnicity

Frequency once per minute

Trigger You successfully Strike a living creature that has the fiend trait with your tusks unarmed attack.

Just the taste of fiendish blood is enough to send blood rushing through your veins in a supernatural fury. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} until the end of your next turn and you can use the extra action to make a tusks Strike, Stride, or Step.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en:
Access Matanji ethnicity

Frequency once per minute

Trigger You successfully Strike a living creature that has the fiend trait with your tusks unarmed attack.

Just the taste of fiendish blood is enough to send blood rushing through your veins in a supernatural fury. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} until the end of your next turn and you can use the extra action to make a tusks Strike, Stride, or Step.
_desc_ko:
사용 가능 마탄지 종족

빈도 분당 1회

발동 조건 당신은 비무장 공격으로 엄니로 악마 특성을 가진 생명체를 성공적으로 공격했다.

악마의 피 맛만으로도 초자연적인 분노가 혈관을 타고 솟구칩니다. 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.quickened] 상태가 되며, 추가 행동으로 엄니 공격, 이동, 또는 신중한 발걸음을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Form of the Dragon

description.value: You can briefly transform into a paragon of your draconic ancestry. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5c692cCcTDXjSEzk]{Dragon Form} as an 8th-rank innate spell once per day. This spell has the same tradition as your draconic exemplar. When you cast this innate spell, you must transform into your draconic exemplar. However, if you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.oqWclVuvEOh7R5og]{Arcane Dragonblood}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.axDwTLGN32Qfv0SD]{Divine Dragonblood}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.4xP7rC0gmEb66bAY]{Occult Dragonblood}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.XAsPe0mfxfQpgvCR]{Primal Dragonblood} lineage feat, you can instead choose any dragon of that tradition.

_desc_en: You can briefly transform into a paragon of your draconic ancestry. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5c692cCcTDXjSEzk]{Dragon Form} as an 8th-rank innate spell once per day. This spell has the same tradition as your draconic exemplar. When you cast this innate spell, you must transform into your draconic exemplar. However, if you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.oqWclVuvEOh7R5og]{Arcane Dragonblood}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.axDwTLGN32Qfv0SD]{Divine Dragonblood}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.4xP7rC0gmEb66bAY]{Occult Dragonblood}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.XAsPe0mfxfQpgvCR]{Primal Dragonblood} lineage feat, you can instead choose any dragon of that tradition.
_desc_ko: 당신은 잠시 동안 드라코닉 혈통의 파라곤으로 변신할 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, @link[spells.dragon-form]을 (8th)랭크 선천적 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 주문은 당신의 드라코닉 이그젬플러와 동일한 전통을 가집니다. 이 선천적 주문을 시전할 때, 당신은 반드시 당신의 드라코닉 이그젬플러로 변신해야 합니다. 그러나 @link[feats.arcane-dragonblood], @link[feats.divine-dragonblood], @link[feats.occult-dragonblood], 또는 @link[feats.primal-dragonblood] 계보 피트를 보유한 경우, 해당 전통의 드래곤 중 하나를 선택할 수 있다.

name: Sure Feet

description.value: Whether keeping your balance or climbing, your feet easily find purchase. If you roll a success on an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} or an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb}, you get a critical success instead. You're not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} when you attempt to Balance or Climb.

_desc_en: Whether keeping your balance or climbing, your feet easily find purchase. If you roll a success on an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} or an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb}, you get a critical success instead. You're not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} when you attempt to Balance or Climb.
_desc_ko: 균형을 잡거나 등반할 때 발이 쉽게 발판을 찾습니다. @link[actions.balance]에 대한 곡예 판정나 @link[actions.climb]에 대한 운동 판정에서 성공을 굴리면 대신 대성공을 얻습니다. 균형 잡기나 등반을 시도할 때 @link[conditions.off-guard]가 아닙니다.

name: Jotun's Battle Stance

description.value: You emulate the battle stance of your forebears, allowing you to use mighty weapons to attack distant foes. While in this stance, when you wield a melee weapon that requires two hands and doesn't have reach, the weapon gains a reach of 10 feet.

_desc_en: You emulate the battle stance of your forebears, allowing you to use mighty weapons to attack distant foes. While in this stance, when you wield a melee weapon that requires two hands and doesn't have reach, the weapon gains a reach of 10 feet.
_desc_ko: 선조들의 전투 자세를 본받아 강력한 무기로 먼 적을 공격할 수 있습니다. 이 자세를 취한 상태에서 양손이 필요하고 도달 거리가 없는 근접 무기를 휘두를 때, 해당 무기의 도달 거리가 10피트 증가합니다.

name: Patron's Glamour

description.value: Gathering up threads of your old connection, you can temporarily disguise yourself as your missing patron. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise} as an innate spell of your patron's tradition, automatically heightened to the rank of your witch cantrips, but you can use it only to disguise yourself as the humanoid representation of your patron. Detection spells of lower rank than this illusory disguise give your patron's information rather than your own.

_desc_en: Gathering up threads of your old connection, you can temporarily disguise yourself as your missing patron. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise} as an innate spell of your patron's tradition, automatically heightened to the rank of your witch cantrips, but you can use it only to disguise yourself as the humanoid representation of your patron. Detection spells of lower rank than this illusory disguise give your patron's information rather than your own.
_desc_ko: 옛 인연의 실타래를 모아, 실종된 후원자로 일시적으로 변장할 수 있습니다. 당신은 후원자의 전통에 속하는 선천적 주문으로 @link[spells.illusory-disguise]을 얻으며, 이는 자동으로 당신의 마녀 캔트립 랭크으로 강화됩니다. 그러나 이 주문은 오직 후원자의 인간형 모습으로 변장하는 데만 사용할 수 있습니다. 이 환상의 변장보다 낮은 랭크의 탐지 주문은 당신의 정보가 아닌 후원자의 정보를 제공합니다.

name: Mythic Casting

description.value:
You can infuse mythic power directly into your spells to make them exceptionally potent. Spend a Mythic Point; if the next action you use is to Cast a Spell, use mythic proficiency to determine your spell attack rolls and save DC for that spell.

Note: PFS 6-09 allows for the action you use next to be a kineticist impulse, using your mythic proficiency instead of impulse attack rolls and save DC.

_desc_en:
You can infuse mythic power directly into your spells to make them exceptionally potent. Spend a Mythic Point; if the next action you use is to Cast a Spell, use mythic proficiency to determine your spell attack rolls and save DC for that spell.

Note: PFS 6-09 allows for the action you use next to be a kineticist impulse, using your mythic proficiency instead of impulse attack rolls and save DC.
_desc_ko: 신화적 힘을 주문에 직접 주입하여 그 효과를 극대화할 수 있다. 신화적 포인트 1점을 소모하면, 다음 행동으로 주문을 시전할 때 해당 주문의 주문 명중 굴림과 내성(DC)를 결정할 때 신화적 숙련도를 적용한다.

name: Armored Courage

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements You are wearing medium or heavy armor.

You take comfort in the safety of your armor. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last for 1 minute, and you reduce your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition value by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements You are wearing medium or heavy armor.

You take comfort in the safety of your armor. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last for 1 minute, and you reduce your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition value by 1 (to a minimum of 0).
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

요구 사항 평갑 또는 중갑옷을 착용하고 있어야 합니다.

갑옷의 안전함에서 위안을 얻습니다. 당신은 레벨과 동일한 수의 임시 HP를 1분 동안 얻으며, @link[conditions.frightened] 상태 수치를 1 감소시킵니다(최소 0까지).

name: Fly on Shadowed Wings

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Your apparition embraces you, feeding on your magic to become a pair of protective wings. Choose one of your attuned apparitions; for 10 minutes, you gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed and resistance to precision damage equal to your level, but your chosen apparition is dispersed for the duration, automatically re-attuning to you after 10 minutes.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Your apparition embraces you, feeding on your magic to become a pair of protective wings. Choose one of your attuned apparitions; for 10 minutes, you gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed and resistance to precision damage equal to your level, but your chosen apparition is dispersed for the duration, automatically re-attuning to you after 10 minutes.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

당신의 환영이 당신을 감싸며, 당신의 마법을 흡수해 보호의 날개 한 쌍이 됩니다. 조율된 환영 중 하나를 선택하세요; 10분 동안, 당신은 지상 속도 및 동일한 비행 속도와 레벨에 해당하는 정밀 피해 저항을 얻지만, 선택한 환영은 지속 시간 동안 해산되며, 10분 후 자동으로 당신에게 재조율됩니다.

name: Scout's Speed

description.value: You move faster, especially when traveling, allowing you to scout ahead and report back without slowing your allies. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed. When calculating your travel speed, this increases to a +20-foot status bonus.

_desc_en: You move faster, especially when traveling, allowing you to scout ahead and report back without slowing your allies. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed. When calculating your travel speed, this increases to a +20-foot status bonus.
_desc_ko: 당신은 특히 이동 시 더 빠르게 움직여, 동료를 늦추지 않고도 전방을 정찰하고 보고할 수 있습니다. 이동 속도에 +10피트 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 이동 속도를 계산할 때는 이 보너스가 +20피트 상태 보너스로 증가합니다.

name: Spring from the Shadows

description.value: You leap from hiding and assail your target. You Stride up to your Speed, but you must end your movement next to an enemy you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} by. You then Strike that enemy; you remain hidden from or undetected by that creature until after you Strike. You can use Spring from the Shadows while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

_desc_en: You leap from hiding and assail your target. You Stride up to your Speed, but you must end your movement next to an enemy you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} by. You then Strike that enemy; you remain hidden from or undetected by that creature until after you Strike. You can use Spring from the Shadows while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.
_desc_ko: 은신 상태에서 뛰쳐나와 목표를 공격합니다. 이동 속도만큼 이동하지만, 이동을 끝내는 위치는 @link[conditions.hidden]이거나 @link[conditions.undetected] 적 옆이어야 합니다. 그런 다음 해당 적을 공격한다. 공격이 끝날 때까지 그 생물에게 숨겨지거나 탐지되지 않은 상태를 유지한다. 해당 이동 유형을 가진 경우, 돌진 대신 땅속 이동, 등반, 비행 또는 수영 중에도 그림자에서 뛰쳐나오기를 사용할 수 있다.

name: Deadly Aim

description.value: You aim for your prey's weak spots, making your shot more challenging but dealing more damage if you hit. Make a ranged Strike against your hunted prey at a –2 penalty. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to damage on that Strike. This bonus increases to +6 at 11th level and +8 at 15th level.

_desc_en: You aim for your prey's weak spots, making your shot more challenging but dealing more damage if you hit. Make a ranged Strike against your hunted prey at a –2 penalty. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to damage on that Strike. This bonus increases to +6 at 11th level and +8 at 15th level.
_desc_ko: 당신은 사냥감의 약점을 노려, 명중 시 더 큰 피해를 입히지만 사격 난이도가 높아집니다. 사냥감에게 원거리 공격을 시도할 때 -2 페널티를 받습니다. 해당 공격에 +4 상황 보너스를 받습니다. 이 보너스는 11레벨에 +6, 15레벨에 +8로 증가합니다.

name: Proximity Alert

description.value: You're unnaturally in tune with your surroundings and react instinctively to danger. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks made as initiative rolls.

_desc_en: You're unnaturally in tune with your surroundings and react instinctively to danger. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks made as initiative rolls.
_desc_ko: 당신은 주변 환경과 비정상적으로 조화를 이루며 위험에 본능적으로 반응합니다. 이니셔티브 굴림으로 수행하는 지각 판정 시 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Fused Staff

description.value:
When you prepare a staff, you can hold it up to a weapon to merge the two items. You can switch the fused item's form from the weapon to the staff or vice versa as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. When the item is in staff form, you can Cast the Spells from the staff and benefit from any other abilities the staff grants. The staff and the weapon share their fundamental runes, using whichever weapon potency and whichever striking rune is higher level. They don't share any other runes or specific abilities.

You can Cast Spells from the staff as part of a Spellstrike even when the staff is in weapon form. Otherwise, you can't cast the staff's spells while it's in weapon form.

The fusion lasts until your next daily preparations, though you can spend 10 minutes to separate the two items and meld the staff into a different weapon. The melding works for you alone. A different wielder can use the staff in its current form but can't transform it, get the benefit of the shared runes, or use its spells for a Spellstrike if it's in weapon form.

_desc_en:
When you prepare a staff, you can hold it up to a weapon to merge the two items. You can switch the fused item's form from the weapon to the staff or vice versa as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. When the item is in staff form, you can Cast the Spells from the staff and benefit from any other abilities the staff grants. The staff and the weapon share their fundamental runes, using whichever weapon potency and whichever striking rune is higher level. They don't share any other runes or specific abilities.

You can Cast Spells from the staff as part of a Spellstrike even when the staff is in weapon form. Otherwise, you can't cast the staff's spells while it's in weapon form.

The fusion lasts until your next daily preparations, though you can spend 10 minutes to separate the two items and meld the staff into a different weapon. The melding works for you alone. A different wielder can use the staff in its current form but can't transform it, get the benefit of the shared runes, or use its spells for a Spellstrike if it's in weapon form.
_desc_ko:
지팡이를 준비할 때 무기에 대고 두 아이템을 합칠 수 있습니다. 액션 하나로 융합된 아이템의 형태를 무기에서 지팡이로, 또는 그 반대로 전환할 수 있으며, 이 행동은 집중 특성을 가진다. 아이템이 지팡이 형태일 때, 지팡이에서 발동되는 주문을 시전하고 지팡이가 부여하는 다른 능력의 혜택을 받을 수 있다. 지팡이와 무기는 기본 룬을 공유하며, 무기 위력과 강타 룬 중 더 높은 레벨을 적용합니다. 다른 룬이나 특정 능력은 공유하지 않습니다.

지팡이가 무기 형태일 때도 스펠스트라이크의 일부로 지팡이의 주문을 시전할 수 있습니다. 그 외에는 무기 형태일 때 지팡이의 주문을 시전할 수 없습니다.

융합은 다음 일일 준비 시간까지 지속되나, 10분을 소모하면 두 아이템을 분리하고 지팡이를 다른 무기에 융합시킬 수 있습니다. 이 융합은 오직 당신에게만 적용됩니다. 다른 사용자는 지팡이를 현재 형태로 사용할 수 있으나, 변형하거나 공유 룬의 혜택을 받거나 무기 형태일 때 스펠스트라이크에 지팡이 주문을 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Underhanded Assault

description.value: You capitalize on the distraction provided by an ally. You [[/act sneak options=underhanded-assault]] up to a foe adjacent to one of your allies. You can roll against the foe you're Sneaking up on, even if it's currently observing you, as though you were @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}. You take a –2 penalty on your Stealth check. If your Stealth check against the chosen foe succeeds, you can make a melee Strike against that foe at the end of your Sneak.

_desc_en: You capitalize on the distraction provided by an ally. You [[/act sneak options=underhanded-assault]] up to a foe adjacent to one of your allies. You can roll against the foe you're Sneaking up on, even if it's currently observing you, as though you were @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}. You take a –2 penalty on your Stealth check. If your Stealth check against the chosen foe succeeds, you can make a melee Strike against that foe at the end of your Sneak.
_desc_ko: 동료가 제공한 주의를 분산시키는 기회를 활용합니다. 당신은 @link[actions.sneak]하여 동료 중 한 명과 인접한 적에게 다가가게 됩니다. 몰래 접근하는 대상이 현재 당신을 관찰 중이라 하더라도, 마치 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태인 것처럼 행동한다. 은신 판정에는 -2 페널티가 적용된다. 선택한 적에 대한 은신 판정이 성공하면, 은밀 이동 종료 시 해당 적에게 근접 공격을 가할 수 있다.

name: Expert Eldritch Archer Spellcasting

description.value: You learn additional eldritch archer magic. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{Expert Spellcasting Feat} benefits.

_desc_en: You learn additional eldritch archer magic. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{Expert Spellcasting Feat} benefits.
_desc_ko: 추가적인 엘드리치 아처 마법을 배웁니다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{전문 주문 시전 피트}의 혜택을 얻습니다.

name: Natural Swimmer

description.value: Water flows around you, letting you cut through the waves as if born to it. You gain a swim Speed of 15 feet. If you already have a permanent swim Speed, swimming up or down isn't difficult terrain.

_desc_en: Water flows around you, letting you cut through the waves as if born to it. You gain a swim Speed of 15 feet. If you already have a permanent swim Speed, swimming up or down isn't difficult terrain.
_desc_ko: 물이 당신 주위를 흐르며, 마치 물속에서 태어난 듯 파도를 가르는 듯한 움직임을 가능하게 합니다. 수영 속도 15피트를 얻습니다. 이미 영구적인 수영 속도를 가지고 있다면, 위나 아래로 수영하는 것은 어려운 지형이 아닙니다.

name: Legendary Rider

description.value: You and your mount move like one being, effortlessly reading each other's signals and synchronizing even in the thick of battle. Whenever you are riding your mount, you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}; you can use the extra action only to command your mount using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{Command an Animal} skill action.

_desc_en: You and your mount move like one being, effortlessly reading each other's signals and synchronizing even in the thick of battle. Whenever you are riding your mount, you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}; you can use the extra action only to command your mount using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{Command an Animal} skill action.
_desc_ko: 당신과 탈것은 하나의 존재처럼 움직이며, 서로의 신호를 자연스럽게 읽고 전투 한복판에서도 완벽히 조화를 이룹니다. 승마 중일 때, 당신은 @link[conditions.quickened] 상태가 됩니다. 추가 행동은 오직 @link[actions.command-an-animal] 기술 행동으로 탈것을 지휘하는 데만 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Unimpeded Step

description.value: With a burst of divine liberation, your ally's movement from your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IX1VlVCL5sFTptEE]{Liberating Step} is unaffected by difficult terrain, greater difficult terrain, narrow surfaces, and uneven ground. If you have the exalted reaction benefit, this applies to everyone who Steps.

_desc_en: With a burst of divine liberation, your ally's movement from your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IX1VlVCL5sFTptEE]{Liberating Step} is unaffected by difficult terrain, greater difficult terrain, narrow surfaces, and uneven ground. If you have the exalted reaction benefit, this applies to everyone who Steps.
_desc_ko: 신성한 해방의 폭발로, 동맹의 @link[actions.liberating-step] 이동은 어려운 지형, 매우 어려운 지형, 좁은 지면, 고르지 않은 지면의 영향을 받지 않습니다. 당신이 고귀한 반응 혜택을 보유한 경우, 이 효과는 발걸음을 사용하는 모든 대상에게 적용됩니다.

name: Dance of Intercession

description.value:
Frequency three times a day

You either performed in or stood witness to the dance used to invoke the Celestial Dragon and can harness a sliver of their power. You Stride in a dance up to half your Speed, attempting a @Check[performance|dc:35] check. You can perform this dance up to three times per day. The second time you do so in the same day, use the degree of success one worse than your actual roll on the Performance check. The third time in a day, use the degree of success two lower than your actual roll.

Critical Success You perform the movements of the Dance of Intercession so gracefully that you evoke a glimmer of the memory of the Celestial Dragon's awesome power. You cast the 3-action version of either 9th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} at any point during your Stride. This does not use any spell slots.

Success As critical success, but the spell is 7th rank instead of 9th as you stumble through the movements.

Failure As critical success, but the spell is 5th rank instead of 9th as you stumble through the movements.

Critical Failure You fail to remember the steps of the dance. You gain no additional effect beyond Striding half your Speed, and you can't attempt the Dance of Intercession again until your next daily preparations.

_desc_en:
Frequency three times a day

You either performed in or stood witness to the dance used to invoke the Celestial Dragon and can harness a sliver of their power. You Stride in a dance up to half your Speed, attempting a @Check[performance|dc:35] check. You can perform this dance up to three times per day. The second time you do so in the same day, use the degree of success one worse than your actual roll on the Performance check. The third time in a day, use the degree of success two lower than your actual roll.

Critical Success You perform the movements of the Dance of Intercession so gracefully that you evoke a glimmer of the memory of the Celestial Dragon's awesome power. You cast the 3-action version of either 9th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} at any point during your Stride. This does not use any spell slots.

Success As critical success, but the spell is 7th rank instead of 9th as you stumble through the movements.

Failure As critical success, but the spell is 5th rank instead of 9th as you stumble through the movements.

Critical Failure You fail to remember the steps of the dance. You gain no additional effect beyond Striding half your Speed, and you can't attempt the Dance of Intercession again until your next daily preparations.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 세 번

천상체를 소환하는 춤을 직접 추거나 목격한 경험이 있어 그 힘의 일부를 활용할 수 있습니다. 이동 속도의 절반까지 춤을 추며 이동하며 DC 35 공연 판정을 시도합니다. 이 춤은 하루에 최대 세 번까지 수행할 수 있습니다. 같은 날 두 번째로 수행할 때는 실제 공연 판정 결과보다 한 단계 낮은 성공도를 적용합니다. 세 번째 수행 시에는 실제 결과보다 두 단계 낮은 성공도를 적용합니다.

대성공 중재의 춤 동작을 너무나 우아하게 수행하여 천상체의 위엄 넘치는 힘에 대한 희미한 기억을 불러일으킵니다. 이동 중 언제든지 (9th) @link[spells.harm] 또는 @link[spells.heal]의 3액션 버전을 시전합니다. 이로 인해 주문 슬롯이 소모되지 않습니다.

성공 치명적 성공과 동일하나, 동작을 어설프게 수행하여 9랭크 대신 (7th) 주문으로 발동된다.

실패 치명적 성공과 동일하나, 동작을 어설프게 수행하여 9랭크 대신 (5th)랭크 주문으로 발동됩니다.

대실패 춤의 동작을 기억하지 못한다. 이동 속도의 절반을 이동하는 효과 외에 추가 효과를 얻지 못하며, 다음 일일 준비 시간까지 중재의 춤을 다시 시도할 수 없다.

name: Catfolk Lore

description.value:
Growing up among catfolk has taught you the traditional values of freedom, stewardship, and quick reactions to trouble. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Acrobatics and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Catfolk Lore.

_desc_en:
Growing up among catfolk has taught you the traditional values of freedom, stewardship, and quick reactions to trouble. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Acrobatics and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Catfolk Lore.
_desc_ko:
캣포크 사이에서 자라면서 자유, 관리, 위험에 대한 빠른 대응이라는 전통적 가치를 배웠다. 곡예와 생존 기술에 숙련 숙련도 등급을 얻는다. 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 해당 기술 중 하나에 자동으로 숙련이 부여될 경우, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련이 부여된다.

또한 캣포크 지식에 대한 @link[feats.additional-lore] 일반 피트를 얻습니다.

name: Aura of Righteousness

description.value: Your righteous aura dampens evil's might and prevents the unholy from escaping you. You and all allies in your champion's aura gain resistance 5 to unholy spells, unholy Strikes, and other unholy effects. If a teleportation spell or effect would teleport an unholy creature out of your champion's aura, your aura attempts to counteract it, using the spell rank and DC of your devotion spells.

_desc_en: Your righteous aura dampens evil's might and prevents the unholy from escaping you. You and all allies in your champion's aura gain resistance 5 to unholy spells, unholy Strikes, and other unholy effects.
