_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신은 장소 내의 (최하급) @link[conditions.invisible] 영혼을 감지할 수 있는 의식이나 명상을 익혔습니다. 이 피트를 선택할 때 자연, 오컬트, 종교 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 자연을 선택하면 순수한 생명 본질에서 태어난 영적 에너지가 아닌 레시를 형성하는 자연의 영혼과 접촉할 수 있으며, 인근 물이나 식물 생명의 위치와 같은 자연적 특징에 관한 질문에 답할 수 있습니다. 종교는 천사, 데몬 또는 신성한 존재를 섬기는 다른 영혼들의 존재를 드러내며, 이들은 강력한 생명 에너지나 공허의 에너지 원천, 신성하거나 불경한 영향력, 언데드의 존재에 대한 정보를 제공합니다. 오컬트는 남아 있는 영혼, 죽은 자의 사이킥 잔향, 현실 너머의 영들과 접촉할 수 있게 하여, 이상한 오라나 효과, 비정상적인 오컬트 존재의 존재 등에 대해 알려줍니다. 10분을 소모하고 선택한 기술로 지식 회상 판정을 시도하십시오. DC는 GM이 결정합니다(해당 지역에서 만날 수 있는 최고 레벨 생물의 레벨에 비해 매우 높은 DC인 경우가 많음). 선택한 기술에서 전설적인 숙련도를 가진 경우, 이 피트를 하루에 한 번이 아닌 시간당 한 번 사용할 수 있습니다. 단, 이전에 탐색한 지역과 겹치는 지역 에서는 다시 사용할 수 없습니다.

대성공 영혼들이 당신에게 모습을 드러내며 우호적인 태도를 보입니다. 오직 당신만이 이 영혼들을 인지할 수 있습니다. 그들은 당신이 선택한 기술과 접촉하는 영혼의 종류에 따라, 당신으로부터 100피트 이내 환경에 관한 간단한 질문 세 가지에 답합니다. 그들의 답변은 거의 항상 한 단어이며, 그들의 지식은 관심 영역 내로 제한됩니다.

성공 대성공과 같으나, 영혼들은 당신에게 무관심하며 단 하나의 질문에만 답합니다.

실패 이 장소의 영혼들과 접촉할 수 없습니다.

대실패 하나 이상의 악의적인 영혼과 접촉합니다. 그들은 당신에게 적대적이지만, 당장 그렇게 보이지는 않을 수 있습니다. 그들은 최대 세 가지 질문에 답하지만, GM이 결정하는 대로 당신에게 어떤 식으로든 해로운 정보를 제공합니다.

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있으며, 매번 달인 숙련도 등급을 가진 다른 기술을 선택합니다. 이 피트는 각 기술당 하루에 한 번(전설적인 경우 시간당 한 번) 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Fight Through Oblivion

description.value: Mortal wounds that would kill other warriors are no more than the flutter of butterfly wings to you. When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points, you aren't knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and you don't gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition. Until the start of your next turn, you become immune to all damage, but you also can't regain Hit Points in any way except the following. If you Strike and damage a foe on this turn, you regain @Damage[(4d8+30)[healing]] Hit Points. Otherwise, your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} value increases by 1 and you remain immune to damage and healing. This cycle continues until you regain Hit Points by damaging a foe or until you reach wounded 4, at which point you lose the wounded condition, fall unconscious, and gain the dying condition.

_desc_en: Mortal wounds that would kill other warriors are no more than the flutter of butterfly wings to you. When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points, you aren't knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and you don't gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition. Until the start of your next turn, you become immune to all damage, but you also can't regain Hit Points in any way except the following. If you Strike and damage a foe on this turn, you regain @Damage[(4d8+30)[healing]] Hit Points. Otherwise, your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} value increases by 1 and you remain immune to damage and healing. This cycle continues until you regain Hit Points by damaging a foe or until you reach wounded 4, at which point you lose the wounded condition, fall unconscious, and gain the dying condition.
_desc_ko: 다른 전사들을 죽일 치명상은 당신에게 나비 날개 짓에 불과하다. HP가 0이 되어도 @link[conditions.unconscious] 상태가 되지 않으며 @link[conditions.dying] 상태가 되지 않습니다. 다음 차례 시작 전까지 모든 피해에 면역이 되지만, 다음 방법 외에는 HP를 회복할 수 없습니다. 이번 차례에 적을 강타해 피해를 입히면 4d8+30 회복 HP를 회복합니다. 그렇지 않으면 @link[conditions.wounded] 수치가 1 증가하며, 피해와 치유에 대한 면역 상태가 유지됩니다. 이 순환은 적에게 피해를 주어 HP를 회복하거나 부상 수치가 4에 도달할 때까지 계속됩니다. 부상 수치가 4에 도달하면 부상 상태를 잃고 의식을 잃으며, 죽어감 상태를 얻습니다.

name: Feathered Flechettes

description.value: Unfurling your wings in a quick snap, you send feathers scattering in all directions. Creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:15] take @Damage[6d6[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save against your class DC). This increases to @Damage[10d6[slashing]|options:area-damage] if your unarmed attacks have a greater striking rune, such as by etching it onto @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.FNDq4NFSN0g2HKWO]{Handwraps of Mighty Blows}, and @Damage[16d6[slashing]|options:area-damage] if they have a major striking rune.

_desc_en: Unfurling your wings in a quick snap, you send feathers scattering in all directions. Creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:15] take @Damage[6d6[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save against your class DC). This increases to @Damage[10d6[slashing]|options:area-damage] if your unarmed attacks have a greater striking rune, such as by etching it onto @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.FNDq4NFSN0g2HKWO]{Handwraps of Mighty Blows}, and @Damage[16d6[slashing]|options:area-damage] if they have a major striking rune.
_desc_ko: 순식간에 날개를 펼치며, 깃털을 사방으로 흩뿌린다. 15피트 범위 내의 생물들은 6d6 참격의 피해를 입는다 (기본 반사 클래스 DC에 대한 내성 굴림). 이 피해는 비무장 공격에 강타 (중급) 룬이 새겨져 있는 경우(예: @link[equipment.handwraps-of-mighty-blows]에 새겨진 경우) 10d6 참격로 증가하고, 강타 (상급) 룬이 새겨져 있는 경우 16d6 참격로 증가합니다.

name: Soaring Dynamo

description.value: You've built clockwork wings or jets into your dynamo, allowing you to use your prosthesis to fly. You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed. Each minute of flight reduces the operational time of your sterling dynamo by 1 hour, measured from the first time you use the Fly action in a given minute.

_desc_en: You've built clockwork wings or jets into your dynamo, allowing you to use your prosthesis to fly. You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed. Each minute of flight reduces the operational time of your sterling dynamo by 1 hour, measured from the first time you use the Fly action in a given minute.
_desc_ko: 당신은 다이나모에 시계 장치 날개나 제트 엔진을 장착하여 의족으로 비행할 수 있게 되었습니다. 비행 속도는 지상 속도와 동일합니다. 비행 1분마다 스털링 다이나모의 작동 시간이 1시간 감소하며, 이는 해당 분에 비행 행동을 처음 사용한 시점부터 측정됩니다.

name: Storm of Claws

description.value:
Requirements You're in either claw stance or talon stance.

You lash out with your clawed limbs like a beast that has fallen upon its first meal in days, then back off to see your handiwork. Strike three times, with your multiple attack penalty increasing as normal. After each attack that hits and deals damage, you can Step.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're in either claw stance or talon stance.

You lash out with your clawed limbs like a beast that has fallen upon its first meal in days, then back off to see your handiwork. Strike three times, with your multiple attack penalty increasing as normal. After each attack that hits and deals damage, you can Step.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 발톱 자세 또는 갈고리 자세 중 하나를 취하고 있어야 합니다.

여러 날 만에 처음으로 먹이를 덮친 짐승처럼 발톱 달린 팔다리로 내리치며, 그 뒤로 물러나 자신의 흉악한 행적을 살핀다. 세 번 공격하며, 다중 공격 페널티는 평소처럼 증가한다. 명중하여 피해를 입힌 각 공격 후, {신중한 발걸음}을 사용할 수 있다.

name: Corpse-Killer's Defiance

description.value:
Trigger You destroy an undead foe.

You defy Tar-Baphon with every undead you destroy, using your victory to rally your allies. Allies that can see you gain a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls against undead for 1 round, or a +2 status bonus to attack and damage rolls against undead for 2 rounds if the undead foe destroyed was a creature of your level or higher.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ctiTtuRWFjAnWdYQ]{Effect: Corpse-Killer's Defiance (Lower Level)}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.3WzaQKb10AYLdTsQ]{Effect: Corpse-Killer's Defiance}

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en:
Trigger You destroy an undead foe.

You defy Tar-Baphon with every undead you destroy, using your victory to rally your allies. Allies that can see you gain a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls against undead for 1 round, or a +2 status bonus to attack and damage rolls against undead for 2 rounds if the undead foe destroyed was a creature of your level or higher.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ctiTtuRWFjAnWdYQ]{Effect: Corpse-Killer's Defiance (Lower Level)}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.3WzaQKb10AYLdTsQ]{Effect: Corpse-Killer's Defiance}
_desc_ko:
발동조건 언데드 적을 파괴한다.

당신은 처치한 언데드마다 타르-바폰에 맞서며, 승리를 이용해 아군을 격려합니다. 당신을 볼 수 있는 아군은 1라운드 동안 언데드에 대한 명중 굴림 및 피해 굴림에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 처치한 언데드 적의 레벨이 당신과 같거나 높을 경우, 아군은 2라운드 동안 언데드에 대한 명중 굴림 및 피해 굴림에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ctiTtuRWFjAnWdYQ]{효과: 시체 살해자의 도전 (하위 레벨)}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.3WzaQKb10AYLdTsQ]{효과: 시체살해자의 반항}

name: Enforce Oath

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements You can see a creature you've sworn an oath against.

You call on your oath to embolden you in combat. Select one creature you can see that you've sworn an oath against (per the terms of your oath feat). You gain a +1 status bonus to AC and saves against attacks and effects by the chosen creature. You also gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls against the chosen creature. However, your dedication draws your focus away from all other enemies. You take a –1 status penalty to AC, attack rolls, and saves against all other creatures until you stop Enforcing your Oath.

Enforce Oath lasts indefinitely, but it ends if the enemy is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the enemy offers a legitimate surrender to you or your allies, you fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or the enemy goes unnoticed by you for more than 1 minute. You can also Dismiss the effect as a free action.

value.value: any feat with the oath trait

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements You can see a creature you've sworn an oath against.

You call on your oath to embolden you in combat. Select one creature you can see that you've sworn an oath against (per the terms of your oath feat). You gain a +1 status bonus to AC and saves against attacks and effects by the chosen creature. You also gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls against the chosen creature. However, your dedication draws your focus away from all other enemies. You take a –1 status penalty to AC, attack rolls, and saves against all other creatures until you stop Enforcing your Oath.

Enforce Oath lasts indefinitely, but it ends if the enemy is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the enemy offers a legitimate surrender to you or your allies, you fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or the enemy goes unnoticed by you for more than 1 minute. You can also Dismiss the effect as a free action.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

요구 사항 맹세한 적을 볼 수 있어야 한다.

맹세를 불러내 전투에서 용기를 얻습니다. 맹세한 적 중 시야에 있는 생물 하나를 선택합니다(맹세 피트 조건에 따름). 선택한 생물의 공격 및 효과에 대한 AC와 내성에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 또한 선택한 생물에게 가하는 명중 굴림에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 그러나 당신의 헌신은 다른 모든 적에게서 포커스를 빼앗습니다. 맹세 강행을 중단할 때까지 다른 모든 생물에 대한 AC, 명중 굴림, 내성에 -1 상태 페널티를 받습니다.

맹세 강행은 무기한 지속되나, 적의 HP가 0이 되거나, 적에게서 당신이나 동맹에 대한 정당한 항복이 제안되거나, 당신이 @link[conditions.unconscious] 상태에 빠지거나, 적을 1분 이상 감지하지 못할 경우 종료됩니다. 또한 무료 행동으로 효과를 해제할 수 있습니다.

name: Quick Spring

description.value: Ishii Bunji is a skilled tumbler, and learning his technique allows you to push yourself off a foe and propel yourself across the battlefield faster. If you succeed at an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} an enemy's space, you can Stride again as a free action after you complete your current movement.

_desc_en: Ishii Bunji is a skilled tumbler, and learning his technique allows you to push yourself off a foe and propel yourself across the battlefield faster. If you succeed at an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} an enemy's space, you can Stride again as a free action after you complete your current movement.
_desc_ko: 이시이 분지는 숙련된 공중제비 기술자로, 그의 기술을 익히면 적을 발판 삼아 전장을 더 빠르게 가로질러 이동할 수 있습니다. 의 곡예 판정에서 적의 공간을 @link[actions.tumble-through]로 통과하는 데 성공하면, 현재 이동을 완료한 후 자유 행동으로 다시 이동을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Fighting Horn

description.value:
You can modify the size and shape of your horn over time using your mental powers. Choose two of the following weapon traits: disarm, grapple, shove, and trip. Your horn gains the chosen traits.

Special You can take this feat a second time, adding the traits you didn't choose when you first took it.

_desc_en:
You can modify the size and shape of your horn over time using your mental powers. Choose two of the following weapon traits: disarm, grapple, shove, and trip. Your horn gains the chosen traits.

Special You can take this feat a second time, adding the traits you didn't choose when you first took it.
_desc_ko:
정신력을 사용하여 시간이 지남에 따라 뿔의 크기와 모양을 변경할 수 있습니다. 다음 무기 특성 중 두 가지를 선택하십시오: 무기 탈취, 붙잡기, 밀치기, 넘어뜨리기 특성. 선택한 특성이 뿔에 부여됩니다.

특수 이 피트를 두 번째로 선택할 수 있으며, 처음 선택하지 않았던 특성을 추가할 수 있습니다.

name: Morning Side Dishes

description.value: You know a proper breakfast should have a variety of sides. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.Jkl5KOZih7MoMqAJ#advanced-alchemy-benefits]{advanced alchemy benefits}, and you can create 5 alchemical food consumables during your daily preparations.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You know a proper breakfast should have a variety of sides. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.Jkl5KOZih7MoMqAJ#advanced-alchemy-benefits]{advanced alchemy benefits}, and you can create 5 alchemical food consumables during your daily preparations.
_desc_ko: 당신은 제대로 된 아침 식사에는 다양한 반찬이 있어야 한다는 것을 알고 있습니다. 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.Jkl5KOZih7MoMqAJ#advanced-alchemy-benefits]{고급 연금술 혜택}을 얻으며, 매일 준비 시간 동안 5개의 연금술 음식 소모품을 만들 수 있습니다.

name: City Scavenger

description.value:
You know that the greatest treasures often look like refuse. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to Subsist, and you can use Society or Survival when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{Subsist} in a settlement.

When you Subsist in a city, you also gather valuable junk that silly longshanks threw away. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income} using Society or Survival at the same time while you Subsist, without spending any additional days of downtime. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to this check.

Special If you have the irongut goblin heritage, increase the bonuses to +2.

_desc_en:
You know that the greatest treasures often look like refuse. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to Subsist, and you can use Society or Survival when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{Subsist} in a settlement.

When you Subsist in a city, you also gather valuable junk that silly longshanks threw away. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income} using Society or Survival at the same time while you Subsist, without spending any additional days of downtime. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to this check.

Special If you have the irongut goblin heritage, increase the bonuses to +2.
_desc_ko:
가장 귀중한 보물은 종종 쓰레기처럼 보인다는 것을 알고 있습니다. 정착지에서 @link[actions.subsist]할 때, 생존 판정나 사회 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

도시에서 생존할 때, 당신은 어리석은 긴다리가 버린 귀중한 쓰레기도 모읍니다. 생존하는 동안 추가 다운타임을 소모하지 않고 사회 또는 생존술을 사용하여 @link[actions.earn-income]을 동시에 수행할 수 있습니다. 또한 이 판정에는 +1 상황 보너스가 적용됩니다.

특수 철장 고블린 혈통을 보유한 경우, 보너스를 +2로 증가시킵니다.

name: Lawbringer

description.value: You trace your lineage to archons, guardians of the seven-tiered mountain of Heaven and nurturers of law and virtue within mortals. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against emotion effects, and if you roll a success on a save against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.

rules.text: When you roll a success on a save against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.
rules.title: {item|name}

_desc_en: You trace your lineage to archons, guardians of the seven-tiered mountain of Heaven and nurturers of law and virtue within mortals. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against emotion effects, and if you roll a success on a save against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 천상의 일곱 층 산을 지키는 가디언이자 인간 내면의 법과 덕을 길러내는 아콘의 혈통을 잇습니다. 감정 효과에 대한 내성에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 감정 효과 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴릴 경우 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Scholastic Identification

description.value:
You have the knowledge needed to understand ancient texts and cultural artifacts.

You can use Society when [[/act decipher-writing skill=society]]{Deciphering Writing}, no matter the type of writing you are examining.

You can also use Society to [[/act identify-magic skill=society]] when examining a magic item or location with cultural significance.

_desc_en:
You have the knowledge needed to understand ancient texts and cultural artifacts.

You can use Society when [[/act decipher-writing skill=society]]{Deciphering Writing}, no matter the type of writing you are examining.

You can also use Society to [[/act identify-magic skill=society]] when examining a magic item or location with cultural significance.
_desc_ko:
고대 문헌과 유물을 이해하는 데 필요한 지식을 갖추고 있습니다.

사회 기술을 사용하여 문자 해독을 수행할 수 있으며, 해독하는 문자의 종류에 관계없이 적용됩니다.

문화적 의미가 있는 마법 아이템이나 장소를 조사할 때 마법 식별에도 사회 기술을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Dashing Pounce

description.value:
Requirements You are in claw stance and have two open hands.

With a burst of speed, you leap into the air, slashing with your hands. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, and if you end your movement adjacent to an enemy, you make two frenzied claw unarmed strikes against it. Apply your multiple attack penalty to these Strikes normally. If both Strikes miss, you fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} at the end of your Leap.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are in claw stance and have two open hands.

With a burst of speed, you leap into the air, slashing with your hands. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, and if you end your movement adjacent to an enemy, you make two frenzied claw unarmed strikes against it. Apply your multiple attack penalty to these Strikes normally. If both Strikes miss, you fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} at the end of your Leap.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 발톱 자세를 취하고 있으며 두 손이 비어 있어야 합니다.

순간적인 속도로 공중으로 도약하며 손으로 베어 내리친다. 당신은 @link[actions.leap]을 수행하며, 이동을 적과 인접한 위치에서 끝낼 경우 그 적에게 두 번의 광란의 발톱 비무장 공격을 가한다. 이 공격에는 다중 공격 페널티가 정상적으로 적용된다. 두 공격 모두 빗나갈 경우, 도약 종료 시 @link[conditions.prone]가 된다.

name: Second Shield

description.value:
Trigger Your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} causes your shield to break or be destroyed.

You're used to your shield breaking in the middle of battle, and you're prepared to use a backup or any convenient nearby object to defend yourself.

You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} to draw a shield on your person or an unattended shield within your reach. If there is an object within your reach that could serve as an improvised shield-for example, a table or chair-you can Interact to draw it with this feat. The GM determines if something can be used as an improvised shield.

Your new shield isn't raised until you use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xjGwis0uaC2305pm]{Raise a Shield} action, as normal.

_desc_en:
Trigger Your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} causes your shield to break or be destroyed.

You're used to your shield breaking in the middle of battle, and you're prepared to use a backup or any convenient nearby object to defend yourself.

You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} to draw a shield on your person or an unattended shield within your reach. If there is an object within your reach that could serve as an improvised shield-for example, a table or chair-you can Interact to draw it with this feat. The GM determines if something can be used as an improvised shield.

Your new shield isn't raised until you use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xjGwis0uaC2305pm]{Raise a Shield} action, as normal.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신의 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{방패 막기}가 방패를 깨뜨리거나 파괴합니다.

전투 중 방패가 부서지는 것에 익숙해져 있으며, 예비 방패나 주변에 있는 편리한 물건을 이용해 자신을 방어할 준비가 되어 있습니다.

당신은 @link[actions.interact]을 통해 자신의 몸에 방패를 착용하거나 손이 닿는 곳에 방치된 방패를 집어 들 수 있습니다. 손이 닿는 곳에 임시 방패 로 사용할 수 있는 물체(예: 테이블이나 의자)가 있다면, 이 피트를 사용해 상호작용하여 그것을 집어 들 수 있습니다. 무언가가 임시 방패로 사용될 수 있는지 여부는 GM이 결정합니다.

새로운 방패는 평소처럼 @link[actions.raise-a-shield] 행동을 사용할 때까지 들어올려지지 않습니다.

name: Fox Trick

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You always have time for a joke or prank. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.qVNVSmsgpKFGk9hV]{Conceal an Object}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}. All creatures who witnessed your Fox Trick then wise up to it, becoming temporarily immune to your Fox Trick for 24 hours.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

You always have time for a joke or prank. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.qVNVSmsgpKFGk9hV]{Conceal an Object}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}. All creatures who witnessed your Fox Trick then wise up to it, becoming temporarily immune to your Fox Trick for 24 hours.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

당신은 항상 농담이나 장난을 칠 시간이 있습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.create-a-diversion], @link[actions.conceal-an-object], 또는 @link[actions.hide]을 사용합니다. 당신의 여우 속임수를 목격한 모든 생물은 그 속임수를 간파하게 되어, 24시간 동안 당신의 여우 속임수에 일시적으로 면역이 됩니다.

name: Sheltering Jewel

description.value: Your head gem has accessed the power of the full moon through your determination to heal and protect your loved ones. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ikSb3LRGnrwXJBVX]{Vital Beacon} as a 5th-rank innate occult spell once per day, so long as you possess your head gem.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your head gem has accessed the power of the full moon through your determination to heal and protect your loved ones. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ikSb3LRGnrwXJBVX]{Vital Beacon} as a 5th-rank innate occult spell once per day, so long as you possess your head gem.
_desc_ko: 당신의 머리 보석은 사랑하는 이들을 치유하고 보호하려는 결의를 통해 보름달의 힘을 얻었습니다. 머리 보석을 소지하고 있는 한, 하루에 한 번 @link[spells.vital-beacon]를 (5th)랭크 선천적 오컬트 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Express Rider

description.value: You can encourage your mount to cover ground quickly. When calculating your travel Speed for the day while mounted, you can attempt a Nature check to Command an Animal to increase your mount's travel Speed. The DC is determined by the GM, but is typically based on the mount's level or the difficulty of the environment, whichever is harder. On a success, increase your mount's travel Speed by half. This has no effect on your mount's movement in encounters. This benefit extends to up to six other allies traveling with you, as long as all such allies are also mounted, or are quadrupeds with a Speed of at least 30 feet.

_desc_en: You can encourage your mount to cover ground quickly. When calculating your travel Speed for the day while mounted, you can attempt a Nature check to Command an Animal to increase your mount's travel Speed. The DC is determined by the GM, but is typically based on the mount's level or the difficulty of the environment, whichever is harder. On a success, increase your mount's travel Speed by half. This has no effect on your mount's movement in encounters. This benefit extends to up to six other allies traveling with you, as long as all such allies are also mounted, or are quadrupeds with a Speed of at least 30 feet.
_desc_ko: 승마 중 이동 속도를 빠르게 할 수 있습니다. 승마 시 하루 이동 속도를 계산할 때, 자연 판정을 시도하여 동물을 커맨더하여 승마 속도를 높일 수 있습니다. DC는 GM이 결정하지만, 일반적으로 승마 대상의 레벨이나 환경 난이도 중 더 높은 쪽을 기준으로 합니다. 성공 시, 탈것의 이동 속도를 절반만큼 증가시킵니다. 이는 전투 중 탈것의 이동에는 영향을 미치지 않습니다. 이 혜택은 함께 여행하는 최대 6명의 다른 아군에게도 적용됩니다. 단, 해당 아군 모두 탈것을 타고 있거나, 속도가 최소 30피트 이상인 네발 동물이어야 합니다.

name: Leaf Transformation

description.value: You know how to run an enterprise that others would never be able to get off the ground—some say it's your savvy acumen or jovial manner, but you know it's because you can cut costs by transforming leaves into money. You can use Deception to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income}, and you gain a +1 status bonus to your check if you do so. The illusion doesn't hold long, though! The GM rolls a secret d20; that many hours after concluding your check, the money transforms back, likely inviting consequences depending on how far the bills traveled from you in the time they were transformed.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You know how to run an enterprise that others would never be able to get off the ground—some say it's your savvy acumen or jovial manner, but you know it's because you can cut costs by transforming leaves into money. You can use Deception to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income}, and you gain a +1 status bonus to your check if you do so. The illusion doesn't hold long, though! The GM rolls a secret d20; that many hours after concluding your check, the money transforms back, likely inviting consequences depending on how far the bills traveled from you in the time they were transformed.
_desc_ko: 당신은 다른 사람들이 절대 시작조차 못할 사업을 운영하는 방법을 알고 있다-어떤 이들은 당신의 날카로운 통찰력이나 유쾌한 태도 때문이라고 하지만, 당신은 잎을 돈으로 변환해 비용을 절감할 수 있기 때문임을 알고 있다. 기만을 사용해 @link[actions.earn-income]할 수 있으며, 그렇게 할 경우 해당 판정에서 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 하지만 환상은 오래 지속되지 않습니다! GM이 비밀 d20을 굴림. 판정 종료 후 그 수만큼의 시간이 지나면 돈이 다시 변환되며, 변환된 돈이 당신으로부터 얼마나 멀리 이동했는지에 따라 결과가 달라질 수 있습니다.

name: Kip Up

description.value: You stand up. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

_desc_en: You stand up. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.
_desc_ko: 일어선다. 이 동작은 반응을 유발하지 않는다.

name: Roiling Mudslide

description.value:
You form water and earth into a mudslide that smashes your opponents and coats them in mud. Each creature in a @Template[cone|distance:30] takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -6)/4)+2)d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. A creature that fails is also pushed 5 feet (or 10 feet on a critical failure) and coated in mud until the end of its next turn. While coated in mud, the creature falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} at the end of its movement any time it ends a move action other than a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Tj055UcNm6UEgtCg]{Crawl} or Step. The creature can attempt an Acrobatics check or @Check[reflex|against:kineticist] save against your class DC, avoiding the fall if it succeeds.

Level (+4) The damage increases by 1d8.

_desc_en:
You form water and earth into a mudslide that smashes your opponents and coats them in mud. Each creature in a @Template[cone|distance:30] takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -6)/4)+2)d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. A creature that fails is also pushed 5 feet (or 10 feet on a critical failure) and coated in mud until the end of its next turn. While coated in mud, the creature falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} at the end of its movement any time it ends a move action other than a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Tj055UcNm6UEgtCg]{Crawl} or Step. The creature can attempt an Acrobatics check or @Check[reflex|against:kineticist] save against your class DC, avoiding the fall if it succeeds.

Level (+4) The damage increases by 1d8.
_desc_ko:
물과 흙을 섞어 진흙사태를 일으켜 적을 강타하고 진흙으로 뒤덮습니다. 30피트 영역 내의 모든 생물은 타격 피해를 입으며, 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 기본 인내 내성을 시험한다. 실패한 생물은 5피트(대실패 시 10피트) 밀려나며, 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 진흙에 뒤덮인다. 진흙에 뒤덮인 상태에서, 해당 생물은 @link[conditions.prone] 상태가 됩니다. 이는 이동 행동(@link[actions.crawl]나 신중함을 기하는 발걸음 외)을 끝낼 때마다 이동 종료 시 적용됩니다. 생물은 곡예 판정나 반사 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 내성을 시도할 수 있으며, 성공 시 넘어짐을 피할 수 있습니다.

레벨 (+4) 피해량이 1d8 증가합니다.

name: Esteemed Visitor

description.value: Your polite manners and natural ability to comfort others make it easy for you to break down cultural barriers and earn strangers' trust. While you are in a settlement, when you roll a critical failure on a Diplomacy check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}, you get a failure instead.

_desc_en: Your polite manners and natural ability to comfort others make it easy for you to break down cultural barriers and earn strangers' trust. While you are in a settlement, when you roll a critical failure on a Diplomacy check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}, you get a failure instead.
_desc_ko: 당신의 예의 바른 태도와 타인을 위로하는 타고난 능력은 문화적 장벽을 허물고 낯선 이의 신뢰를 얻는 데 유리합니다. 정착지에 있을 때, 외교 판정에서 대실패를 굴림할 때, @link[actions.gather-information] 또는 @link[actions.make-an-impression]에 대실패를 굴릴 경우, 대신 실패로 처리됩니다.

name: Commitment to Protection

description.value:
You attempt to guide an ally into a more defensive pose against a particular danger. Attempt a @Check[warfare-lore] check against the hard DC for the level of a creature or hazard you can see. An ally of your choice within 30 feet gains an effect based on the outcome. If you're legendary in Warfare Lore, when you roll a failure or critical failure, you get a success instead.

Critical Success The ally gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the target creature's or hazard's next attack.

Success As critical success, but the bonus is +1.

Critical Failure The ally takes a –1 circumstance penalty to AC against the target creature's or hazard's next attack.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.eu7DEgjicyYyosCl]{Effect: Commitment to Protection}

_desc_en:
You attempt to guide an ally into a more defensive pose against a particular danger. Attempt a @Check[warfare-lore] check against the hard DC for the level of a creature or hazard you can see. An ally of your choice within 30 feet gains an effect based on the outcome. If you're legendary in Warfare Lore, when you roll a failure or critical failure, you get a success instead.

Critical Success The ally gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the target creature's or hazard's next attack.

Success As critical success, but the bonus is +1.

Critical Failure The ally takes a –1 circumstance penalty to AC against the target creature's or hazard's next attack.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.eu7DEgjicyYyosCl]{Effect: Commitment to Protection}
_desc_ko:
당신은 특정한 위험에 대해 아군을 더 방어적인 자세로 유도하려 시도한다. 당신이 볼 수 있는 크리처나 위험요소의 레벨에 대한 어려운 DC를 상대로 @Check[warfare-lore] 판정을 시도한다. 30피트 이내에서 당신이 선택한 아군 하나가 결과에 따른 효과를 얻는다. 당신이 전쟁 지식에 전설급이라면, 실패나 대실패를 굴릴 때 대신 성공을 얻는다.

대성공 아군은 대상 크리처나 위험요소의 다음 공격에 대해 AC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻는다.

성공 대성공과 같지만, 보너스는 +1이다.

대실패 아군은 대상 크리처나 위험요소의 다음 공격에 대해 AC에 –1 상황 페널티를 받는다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.eu7DEgjicyYyosCl]{효과: 보호에 대한 헌신}

name: Repelling Enforcer

description.value: Your conviction reflects damage from the divine. Whenever you are dealt damage by a creature that can cast divine spells, that creature takes @Damage[5d6[spirit]] damage that ignores any resistance to spirit damage the creature has (but not immunity).

_desc_en: Your conviction reflects damage from the divine. Whenever you are dealt damage by a creature that can cast divine spells, that creature takes @Damage[5d6[spirit]] damage that ignores any resistance to spirit damage the creature has (but not immunity).
_desc_ko: 당신의 신념은 신성으로부터의 피해를 반사한다. 당신이 신성 주문을 시전할 수 있는 크리처로부터 피해를 입을 때마다, 그 크리처는 @Damage[5d6[spirit]] 피해를 입으며, 이 피해는 그 크리처가 지닌 영혼 피해에 대한 어떤 저항도 무시한다(단, 면역은 무시하지 못한다).

name: Nothing Personal

description.value:
Requirements You have an active course of action planned.

When you're on a job, you can't allow anyone to stop you. Designate a single creature you can see as being an impediment to your active course of action. The first time you Strike your impediment in a round, you deal an extra die of weapon damage. At 14th level, this increases to two extra dice, and at 20th level, this increases to three extra dice.

You can have only one creature designated as an impediment at a time. If you use Nothing Personal against a creature when you already have a creature designated, the prior creature loses the designation, and the new impediment gains the designation. Otherwise, your designation lasts for 1 hour.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have an active course of action planned.

When you're on a job, you can't allow anyone to stop you. Designate a single creature you can see as being an impediment to your active course of action. The first time you Strike your impediment in a round, you deal an extra die of weapon damage. At 14th level, this increases to two extra dice, and at 20th level, this increases to three extra dice.

You can have only one creature designated as an impediment at a time. If you use Nothing Personal against a creature when you already have a creature designated, the prior creature loses the designation, and the new impediment gains the designation. Otherwise, your designation lasts for 1 hour.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 활성 행동 경로를 계획 중이어야 합니다.

임무를 수행 중일 때는 누구도 당신을 막을 수 없습니다. 시야 내에 있는 생물 한 마리를 현재 진행 중인 행동의 방해물로 지정하세요. 해당 라운드에 방해물을 처음으로 강타할 때 무기 피해에 추가 주사위 하나를 더합니다. 14레벨에 도달하면 추가 주사위가 두 개로, 20레벨에 도달하면 세 개로 증가합니다.

한 번에 하나의 생물만 방해물로 지정할 수 있다. 이미 지정된 생물이 있는 상태에서 '개인적인 감정은 없다'를 사용하면, 기존 생물은 지정 상태를 잃고 새로 공격한 생물이 지정된다. 그렇지 않으면 지정 상태는 1시간 동안 지속된다.

name: Ashen Veil

description.value: By smearing ash or tainted earth over your skin and armor, you shroud yourself from the dead. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to undead using vision or lifesense, allowing you to Hide and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} without other sources of cover or concealment. This effect lasts only as long as you continue to take no actions other than to Hide, Sneak, or other surreptitious actions. The GM determines which actions end the effect, but attacking, casting spells, activating items, and the like always do.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en: By smearing ash or tainted earth over your skin and armor, you shroud yourself from the dead. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to undead using vision or lifesense, allowing you to Hide and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} without other sources of cover or concealment. This effect lasts only as long as you continue to take no actions other than to Hide, Sneak, or other surreptitious actions. The GM determines which actions end the effect, but attacking, casting spells, activating items, and the like always do.
_desc_ko: 재나 오염된 흙을 피부와 갑옷에 바르면 죽은 자들로부터 자신을 가릴 수 있다. 시야나 생명 감지 능력을 사용하는 언데드에게 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태가 되어, 다른 은폐나 은신 수단이 없어도 숨기기와 @link[actions.sneak]할 수 있게 해줍니다. 이 효과는 숨기거나 은신하는 등 은밀한 행동 외에 다른 행동을 취하지 않는 동안만 지속됩니다. GM이 효과를 종료시키는 행동을 결정하지만, 공격, 주문 시전, 아이템 활성화 등은 항상 효과를 종료시킵니다.

name: Built-In Tools

description.value: You've built tools into your innovation so you can access and use them easily. When you take this feat, choose up to two sets of tools you own, such as thieves' tools or healer's tools, that weigh a total of 2 Bulk or less. These tools become part of your innovation. The innovation's Bulk doesn't increase from this addition. As long as you are wielding, wearing, or adjacent to your innovation, you have the same quick access to these tools as the tools you are wearing, and they don't count against the usual limit of tools you can wear.

_desc_en: You've built tools into your innovation so you can access and use them easily. When you take this feat, choose up to two sets of tools you own, such as thieves' tools or healer's tools, that weigh a total of 2 Bulk or less. These tools become part of your innovation. The innovation's Bulk doesn't increase from this addition. As long as you are wielding, wearing, or adjacent to your innovation, you have the same quick access to these tools as the tools you are wearing, and they don't count against the usual limit of tools you can wear.
_desc_ko: 당신은 혁신에 도구를 내장하여 쉽게 접근하고 사용할 수 있게 했습니다. 이 피트를 선택할 때, 도둑 도구 세트나 치료사 도구 세트 등 소유한 도구 중 총 벌크 2 이하인 최대 두 세트를 선택합니다. 이 도구들은 혁신의 일부가 됩니다. 이 추가로 인해 혁신의 벌크가 증가하지 않습니다. 혁신을 휘두르거나 착용하거나 인접해 있는 동안에는, 착용 중인 도구와 동일한 신속한 접근성을 이 도구들에 대해 가지며, 이 도구들은 착용 가능한 일반적인 도구 수 제한에 포함되지 않습니다.

name: Sacred Defense

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You call upon your deity to grant you their protective blessing. Attempt a @Check[religion|dc:30|immutable:true|showDC:all] check. If you have legendary proficiency in Religion, you can instead attempt a @Check[religion|dc:40|immutable:true|showDC:all] check to increase the temporary Hit Points you gain on a successful check to 15 (25 on a critical success).

Critical Success You gain 10 temporary Hit Points. You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

Success You gain 5 temporary Hit Points. You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

Critical Failure Your deity withholds their blessing. You cannot attempt to call to your deity again for 1 day.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

You call upon your deity to grant you their protective blessing. Attempt a @Check[religion|dc:30|immutable:true|showDC:all] check. If you have legendary proficiency in Religion, you can instead attempt a @Check[religion|dc:40|immutable:true|showDC:all] check to increase the temporary Hit Points you gain on a successful check to 15 (25 on a critical success).

Critical Success You gain 10 temporary Hit Points. You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

Success You gain 5 temporary Hit Points. You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

Critical Failure Your deity withholds their blessing. You cannot attempt to call to your deity again for 1 day.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

당신은 신에게 보호의 축복을 내려달라고 간청합니다. DC 30 종교학 판정을 시도하십시오. 종교에 전설적인 숙련도를 가진 경우, 대신 DC 40 종교학 판정을 시도하여 성공 시 얻는 임시 HP를 15까지 증가시킬 수 있습니다( 로 대성공 시 25). ⟬T0007⟬

대성공 10의 임시 HP를 얻습니다. 1분 후 남은 임시 HP는 모두 소멸됩니다.

성공 임시 HP 5를 얻습니다. 1분 후 남은 임시 HP는 모두 사라집니다.

대실패 당신의 신이 축복을 거두었습니다. 1일 동안 다시 신에게 기도하는 것을 시도할 수 없습니다.

name: Student of the Dueling Arts

description.value:
Dueling is your art, and your weapon is your instrument. You have studied and evaluated a great many combat techniques, which you can review each day without fail to ensure you are prepared for any and every situation that may occur. During your daily preparations, you can swap out any number of your duelist archetype feats for other duelist archetype feats of the appropriate level for which you are qualified. You can't swap out Duelist Dedication or Student of the Dueling Arts in this way.

In addition, you can enter a stance from a duelist archetype feat you don't have (such as one listed under Additional Feats) by increasing the number of actions it takes to enter the stance by 1 (typically to 2 actions). You must still meet the stance feat's prerequisites.

_desc_en:
Dueling is your art, and your weapon is your instrument. You have studied and evaluated a great many combat techniques, which you can review each day without fail to ensure you are prepared for any and every situation that may occur. During your daily preparations, you can swap out any number of your duelist archetype feats for other duelist archetype feats of the appropriate level for which you are qualified. You can't swap out Duelist Dedication or Student of the Dueling Arts in this way.

In addition, you can enter a stance from a duelist archetype feat you don't have (such as one listed under Additional Feats) by increasing the number of actions it takes to enter the stance by 1 (typically to 2 actions). You must still meet the stance feat's prerequisites.
_desc_ko:
결투는 당신의 예술이며, 무기는 당신의 도구입니다. 당신은 수많은 전투 기술을 연구하고 평가해 왔으며, 매일 빠짐없이 이를 복습하여 발생할 수 있는 모든 상황에 대비할 수 있습니다. 일일 준비 과정에서, 당신은 자신이 자격을 갖춘 적절한 레벨의 다른 결투사 아키타입 피트들로 자신의 결투사 아키타입 피트들을 몇 개든 교체할 수 있습니다. 이 방법으로 결투사 헌신이나 결투술의 제자를 교체할 수는 없습니다.

또한, 보유하지 않은 결투사 아키타입 피트(예: 추가 피트 목록에 기재된 것)의 자세를 취하려면 해당 자세를 취하는 데 필요한 행동 횟수를 1회 증가시켜야 합니다(일반적으로 2회 행동). 해당 자세 피트의 전제 조건은 여전히 충족해야 합니다.

name: Boost Summons

description.value: Augmenting your eidolon extends to creatures you summon. When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HStu2Yhw3iQER9tY]{Boost Eidolon}, in addition to your eidolon, it also targets your summoned creatures within 60 feet.

_desc_en: Augmenting your eidolon extends to creatures you summon. When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HStu2Yhw3iQER9tY]{Boost Eidolon}, in addition to your eidolon, it also targets your summoned creatures within 60 feet.
_desc_ko: 에이돌론 강화 효과는 소환한 생물에게도 적용됩니다. @link[spells.boost-eidolon]를 시전할 때, 에이돌론 외에도 60피트 내의 소환 생물을 대상으로 합니다.

name: Chronomancer's Secrets

description.value:
The secrets of time peel back, revealing deeper truths. You gain either the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.cOwSsSXRsBaXUvlr]{Stasis} domain spell or the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.s3LISC5Z55urpBgU]{Path of Least Resistance} focus spell.

Special You can take this feat a second time, gaining the focus spell that you didn't gain the first time.

_desc_en:
The secrets of time peel back, revealing deeper truths. You gain either the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.cOwSsSXRsBaXUvlr]{Stasis} domain spell or the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.s3LISC5Z55urpBgU]{Path of Least Resistance} focus spell.

Special You can take this feat a second time, gaining the focus spell that you didn't gain the first time.
_desc_ko:
시간의 비밀이 벗겨지며 더 깊은 진실이 드러난다. @link[spells.stasis] 도메인 주문 또는 @link[spells.path-of-least-resistance] 포커스 주문 중 하나를 획득한다. 포커스 포인트 풀의 수를 1 증가시킨다.

특수 이 피트를 두 번째로 선택할 수 있으며, 첫 번째 선택 시 얻지 못한 포커스 주문을 획득한다. 포커스 풀의 포커스 포인트 수를 1 증가시킨다.

name: Stumbling Finisher

description.value: Your excellent display of fighting prowess leaves your opponent stumbling back. Make a Strike. If you hit, the target is pushed 5 feet back (or 10 feet on a critical hit).

_desc_en: Your excellent display of fighting prowess leaves your opponent stumbling back. Make a Strike. If you hit, the target is pushed 5 feet back (or 10 feet on a critical hit).
_desc_ko: 당신의 뛰어난 전투 실력에 상대는 비틀거리며 뒤로 물러납니다. 공격을 시도하세요. 명중 시 대상은 5피트(치명타 시 10피트) 뒤로 밀려납니다.

name: Adhyabhau

description.value:
You descend from the rare psychic vampires known as vetalaranas. Your forebear gained sustenance from the mental and emotional energy of living creatures, which manifests in you as powerful resistance to such effects.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves against effects with the emotion trait, and when you roll a success on a saving throw against such an effect, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en:
You descend from the rare psychic vampires known as vetalaranas. Your forebear gained sustenance from the mental and emotional energy of living creatures, which manifests in you as powerful resistance to such effects.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves against effects with the emotion trait, and when you roll a success on a saving throw against such an effect, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko:
당신은 베탈라라나로 알려진 희귀한 사이킥 뱀파이어의 후예입니다. 당신의 선조는 생물의 정신적·감정적 에너지로 생명을 유지했으며, 이는 당신에게 그러한 효과에 대한 강력한 저항력으로 창조됩니다.

감정 특성을 지닌 효과에 대한 의지 내성에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 해당 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴릴 경우 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Avenge in Glory

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Access mountain dwarf ethnicity

Trigger An ally within 30 feet gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition.

You honor your ally's life, gaining temporary Hit Points equal to your level for 1 minute. As long as you have these temporary Hit Points, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack and damage rolls.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Access mountain dwarf ethnicity

Trigger An ally within 30 feet gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition.

You honor your ally's life, gaining temporary Hit Points equal to your level for 1 minute. As long as you have these temporary Hit Points, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack and damage rolls.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

사용 자격 산악 드워프 종족

발동 조건 30피트 내의 아군이 @link[conditions.dying] 상태를 얻는다.

동료의 생명을 존중하며, 1분 동안 레벨에 해당하는 임시 HP를 얻습니다. 이 임시 HP가 유지되는 동안 명중 굴림 및 피해 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 받습니다.

name: Familiar's Language

description.value:
You've learned to speak with your familiar and other creatures like it. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with creatures of the same family of animals as your familiar. For example, if your familiar were a cat, you could gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.BBvV7qoXGdw09q1C]{Speak with Animals} for any felines (including leopards, lions, and tigers, among others). This ability doesn't make them more friendly than normal. If your familiar ever changes to a different creature, you can't use this ability for 1 week while you absorb your new familiar's language.

Special This feat has the trait corresponding to the tradition of spells you cast (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

_desc_en:
You've learned to speak with your familiar and other creatures like it. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with creatures of the same family of animals as your familiar. For example, if your familiar were a cat, you could gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.BBvV7qoXGdw09q1C]{Speak with Animals} for any felines (including leopards, lions, and tigers, among others). This ability doesn't make them more friendly than normal. If your familiar ever changes to a different creature, you can't use this ability for 1 week while you absorb your new familiar's language.

Special This feat has the trait corresponding to the tradition of spells you cast (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).
_desc_ko:
당신은 자신의 패밀리어 및 그와 유사한 생물들과 대화하는 법을 익혔습니다. 패밀리어의 동물군과 동일한 동물군에 속하는 생물들에게 질문을 하고, 답변을 받으며, 외교 기술을 사용할 수 있습니다. 예를 들어, 패밀리어가 고양이인 경우, 고양이과 동물(표범, 사자, 호랑이 등 포함)에게 @link[spells.speak-with-animals] 효과를 얻을 수 있습니다. 이 능력은 그들을 평소보다 더 친근하게 만들지 않습니다. 만약 당신의 패밀리어 존재가 다른 생물로 바뀌면, 새로운 패밀리어 존재의 언어를 익히는 동안 1주간 이 능력을 사용할 수 없습니다.

특수 이 피트는 당신이 시전하는 주문 전통(아케인, 신성, 오컬트, 프라이멀)에 해당하는 특성을 지닙니다.

name: Inured to Alchemy

description.value:
Access You're from Alkenstar or the Mana Wastes.

You've developed control over how your body processes alchemical poisons and drugs. Each of your successful saving throws against an alchemical poison, a drug, or an addiction reduces the stage by 2, or by 1 for a virulent alchemical poison, drug, or addiction. Each critical success reduces the stage by 3, or by 2 for a virulent alchemical poison, drug, or addiction.

publication.title: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powder Keg

_desc_en:
Access You're from Alkenstar or the Mana Wastes.

You've developed control over how your body processes alchemical poisons and drugs. Each of your successful saving throws against an alchemical poison, a drug, or an addiction reduces the stage by 2, or by 1 for a virulent alchemical poison, drug, or addiction. Each critical success reduces the stage by 3, or by 2 for a virulent alchemical poison, drug, or addiction.
_desc_ko:
접근 당신은 알켄스터 또는 마나 웨이스트 출신이다.

당신은 신체가 연금술 독과 약물을 처리하는 방식을 통제하는 능력을 개발했습니다. 연금술 독, 약물 또는 중독에 대한 성공적인 내성 굴림마다 단계가 2 감소하며, 독성이 강한 연금술 독, 약물 또는 중독의 경우 1 감소합니다. 대성공 시 단계가 3 감소하며, 독성이 강한 연금술 독, 약물 또는 중독의 경우 2 감소합니다.

name: Stonewall

description.value:
Trigger An enemy or hazard's effect hits you or you fail a Fortitude save against one.

The strength of stone overcomes you so strongly that it replaces your stout body. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified} until the end of the current turn. You don't take any damage from the triggering effect or any other ill effects that couldn't affect stone.

_desc_en:
Trigger An enemy or hazard's effect hits you or you fail a Fortitude save against one.

The strength of stone overcomes you so strongly that it replaces your stout body. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified} until the end of the current turn. You don't take any damage from the triggering effect or any other ill effects that couldn't affect stone.
_desc_ko:
발동조건 적이나 위험 요소의 효과가 당신에게 적중하거나, 이에 대한 인내 내성 시험에 실패할 때.

돌의 힘이 당신을 압도하여 당신의 튼튼한 몸을 대체합니다. 당신은 @link[conditions.petrified] 상태가 되어 현재 턴이 끝날 때까지 지속됩니다. 발동 효과나 돌에 영향을 줄 수 없는 다른 악영향으로부터 어떤 피해도 받지 않습니다.

name: Dragon Arcana

description.value:
You've discovered how to add the magic of dragons to your tradition.

Add the draconic bloodline's granted spells to your spell list; you must still learn them or add them to your repertoire as normal. These spells are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TVKNbcgTee19PXZR]{Shield}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{Sure Strike}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Fr58LDSrbndgld9n]{Resist Energy}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{Haste}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tgIhRUFtgDSELpJE]{Spell Immunity}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.forsqeofEszBNtLq]{Chromatic Wall}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5c692cCcTDXjSEzk]{Dragon Form}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.O6VQC1Bs4aSYDa6R]{Mask of Terror}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.iL6TujgTCtRRa0Y0]{Prismatic Wall}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.fkDeKktdmbeplYRY]{Overwhelming Presence}.

value.value: ability to cast spells from spell slots

_desc_en:
You've discovered how to add the magic of dragons to your tradition.

Add the draconic bloodline's granted spells to your spell list; you must still learn them or add them to your repertoire as normal. These spells are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TVKNbcgTee19PXZR]{Shield}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{Sure Strike}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Fr58LDSrbndgld9n]{Resist Energy}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{Haste}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tgIhRUFtgDSELpJE]{Spell Immunity}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.forsqeofEszBNtLq]{Chromatic Wall}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5c692cCcTDXjSEzk]{Dragon Form}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.O6VQC1Bs4aSYDa6R]{Mask of Terror}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.iL6TujgTCtRRa0Y0]{Prismatic Wall}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.fkDeKktdmbeplYRY]{Overwhelming Presence}.
_desc_ko:
당신은 전통에 용의 마법을 더하는 방법을 발견했습니다.

드라코닉 혈통이 부여하는 주문을 당신의 주문 목록에 추가하십시오. 여전히 정상적인 방법으로 이를 배우거나 레퍼토리에 추가해야 합니다. 이 주문들은 @link[spells.shield], @link[spells.sure-strike], @link[spells.resist-energy], @link[spells.haste], @link[spells.spell-immunity], @link[spells.chromatic-wall], @link[spells.dragon-form], @link[spells.mask-of-terror], @link[spells.prismatic-wall], 그리고 @link[spells.overwhelming-presence]입니다.

name: Minotaur Weapon Familiarity

description.value:
Your elders taught you to wield weapons that can split skulls and smash through shields. You have familiarity with the battle axe, falchion, glaive, and greataxe—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat these martial weapons as simple weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

_desc_en:
Your elders taught you to wield weapons that can split skulls and smash through shields. You have familiarity with the battle axe, falchion, glaive, and greataxe—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat these martial weapons as simple weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
_desc_ko:
조상들이 가르쳐 준 두개골을 갈라내고 방패를 뚫을 수 있는 무기들을 다루는 법을 익혔습니다. 전투 도끼, 팔치온, 글레이브, 대도끼에 패밀리어를 가지고 있습니다-숙련도 목적상 이 무기들을 단순 무기로 취급합니다.

5레벨에 도달하면, 이 무기들로 치명타를 기록할 때마다 해당 무기의 치명타 특화 효과를 얻는다.

name: Proteankin

description.value: Your blood bubbles with the roiling quintessence of the Maelstrom, the infinite sea of primal chaos that long ago spawned the other Outer Planes. You gain resistance to a single damage type equal to half your level; at the beginning of each day, determine randomly whether this resistance applies to acid, electricity, or sonic damage. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects that would cause you to gain the controlled condition.

_desc_en: Your blood bubbles with the roiling quintessence of the Maelstrom, the infinite sea of primal chaos that long ago spawned the other Outer Planes. You gain resistance to a single damage type equal to half your level; at the beginning of each day, determine randomly whether this resistance applies to acid, electricity, or sonic damage. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects that would cause you to gain the controlled condition.
_desc_ko: 당신의 피는 오래전 다른 외부계들을 탄생시킨 프라이멀 혼돈의 무한한 바다, 소용돌이의 격렬한 정수가 끓어오르고 있습니다. 당신은 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 단일 피해 유형에 대한 저항력을 얻습니다. 매일 시작 시, 이 저항력이 산성, 전기, 또는 음파 피해 중 어느 것에 적용되는지 무작위로 결정합니다. 또한 통제 상태를 유발하는 효과에 대한 내성 굴림 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Reach for Immortality

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Your divine spark is now a bonfire in your soul, bringing you to the very cusp of undying immortality. You cease aging. When you would die for any reason, you can Spark Transcendence as a free action that can be taken at any time, regardless of your current condition. You reach for your divine spark and seize it in your hand to survive at 0 Hit Points, purging yourself of any negative conditions. Invigorated by this return to life, you then heal yourself for half of your total Hit Points, Stand, instantly summon any held ikons to your hand, and Shift your Immanence to any of your ikons.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Your divine spark is now a bonfire in your soul, bringing you to the very cusp of undying immortality. You cease aging. When you would die for any reason, you can Spark Transcendence as a free action that can be taken at any time, regardless of your current condition. You reach for your divine spark and seize it in your hand to survive at 0 Hit Points, purging yourself of any negative conditions. Invigorated by this return to life, you then heal yourself for half of your total Hit Points, Stand, instantly summon any held ikons to your hand, and Shift your Immanence to any of your ikons.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신의 신성한 불꽃이 이제 영혼 속 모닥불이 되어, 당신을 불멸의 문턱까지 이끕니다. 노화가 멈춥니다. 어떤 이유로든 죽을 위기에 처했을 때, 현재 상태와 상관없이 언제든지 자유 행동으로 초월의 불꽃을 발동할 수 있습니다. 신성한 불꽃을 손으로 움켜쥐어 HP 0 상태에서도 생존하며 모든 부정적 상태를 정화한다. 생명의 회복으로 활력을 되찾은 당신은 총 HP의 절반을 치유하고, 즉시 일어나 손에 들고 있던 이콘을 소환하며, 내재성을 보유한 이콘 중 하나로 이동시킨다.

name: Spirit's Wrath

description.value: You call forth an ephemeral spirit, typically the apparition of an ancestor or a nature spirit, which takes the form of a wisp. The wisp makes a melee wisp rush unarmed attack against an enemy within 120 feet of you. The wisp's attack modifier is equal to your proficiency bonus for martial weapons plus your Strength modifier plus a +2 item bonus, and it applies the same circumstance and status bonuses and penalties that you have. On a hit, the wisp deals @Damage[(4d8 + @actor.abilities.con.mod)[spirit]]{spirit damage} equal to 4d8 plus your Constitution modifier. Don't apply your Rage damage or your weapon specialization damage, but circumstance and status bonuses and penalties that would also affect the wisp's damage apply. On a critical hit, the wisp deals double damage and the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}. This attack uses and counts toward your multiple attack penalty as if you were the one attacking.

_desc_en: You call forth an ephemeral spirit, typically the apparition of an ancestor or a nature spirit, which takes the form of a wisp. The wisp makes a melee wisp rush unarmed attack against an enemy within 120 feet of you. The wisp's attack modifier is equal to your proficiency bonus for martial weapons plus your Strength modifier plus a +2 item bonus, and it applies the same circumstance and status bonuses and penalties that you have. On a hit, the wisp deals @Damage[(4d8 + @actor.abilities.con.mod)[spirit]]{spirit damage} equal to 4d8 plus your Constitution modifier. Don't apply your Rage damage or your weapon specialization damage, but circumstance and status bonuses and penalties that would also affect the wisp's damage apply. On a critical hit, the wisp deals double damage and the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}. This attack uses and counts toward your multiple attack penalty as if you were the one attacking.
_desc_ko: 당신은 일시적인 영혼, 일반적으로 조상의 유령이나 자연 정령의 모습을 한 위습을 소환합니다. 이 위습은 당신으로부터 120피트 이내의 적을 상대로 근접 비무장 공격인 위습 돌진 무기 공격을 수행합니다. 이 위습의 공격 수정자는 무기 숙련 보너스 + 근력 수정자 + +2 아이템 보너스와 동일하며, 당신에게 적용되는 상황 및 상태 보너스/페널티를 동일하게 적용받습니다. 명중 시, 위습은 영혼 피해 4d8 + 건강 수정자만큼의 피해를 입힙니다. 분노 피해나 무기 전문화 피해는 적용하지 않으나, 위습의 피해에도 영향을 미치는 상황 및 상태 보너스/페널티는 적용됩니다. 치명타 시 위습은 두 배의 피해를 입히고 대상은 @link[conditions.frightened]{1} 상태가 됩니다. 이 공격은 마치 당신이 직접 공격하는 것처럼 다중 공격 페널티를 사용하며 계산됩니다.

name: Mesmerizing Gaze

description.value: When you meet someone's gaze, they're unable to look away from you. Choose one target creature you can see and that can see you. That creature must succeed at a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with you until the end of your next turn; the DC is the higher of your class DC or spell DC. If the creature succeeds at its save or its fascination ends due to a hostile action, it becomes temporarily immune to your Mesmerizing Gaze for 1 day.

_desc_en: When you meet someone's gaze, they're unable to look away from you. Choose one target creature you can see and that can see you. That creature must succeed at a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with you until the end of your next turn; the DC is the higher of your class DC or spell DC. If the creature succeeds at its save or its fascination ends due to a hostile action, it becomes temporarily immune to your Mesmerizing Gaze for 1 day.
_desc_ko: 상대의 시선을 마주치면, 상대는 당신에게서 시선을 떼지 못한다. 당신이 볼 수 있고 당신을 볼 수 있는 대상 생물 하나를 선택한다. 해당 생물은 의지 내성에 성공하지 못하면 @link[conditions.fascinated] 상태가 되어 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 지속된다. DC는 네 직업 DC와 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽이다. 저항에 성공하거나 적대적 행동으로 매혹이 해제된 생물은 1일간 네 매혹의 시선에 일시적으로 면역이 된다.

name: Perfected Evaluations

description.value: You instantly assess the strengths and weaknesses of the enemy forces. When you use Rapid Assessment, you can attempt up to six @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} checks against enemies you are observing.

_desc_en: You instantly assess the strengths and weaknesses of the enemy forces. When you use Rapid Assessment, you can attempt up to six @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} checks against enemies you are observing.
_desc_ko: 당신은 적군의 강점과 약점을 즉시 파악합니다. 신속 평가를 사용할 때, 관찰 중인 적군을 대상으로 최대 여섯 번의 @link[actions.recall-knowledge] 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다.

name: Asura Magic

description.value: You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TaaMEYdZXQXF0Sks]{Blood Vendetta} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dLdRqT6UxTKlsPgp]{Death Knell} once per day each as 2nd-rank divine innate spells.

_desc_en: You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TaaMEYdZXQXF0Sks]{Blood Vendetta} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dLdRqT6UxTKlsPgp]{Death Knell} once per day each as 2nd-rank divine innate spells.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @link[spells.blood-vendetta]와 @link[spells.death-knell]를 각각 하루에 한 번씩 2랭크 신성 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Flickering Stories

description.value: Stories, like fires, can create shadows as much as they illuminate. When you Offer a Story, you can become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} by shifting shadows for the duration instead of the normal benefits. The action then gains the shadow trait. You can't use this concealment to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}, as normal for concealing effects that leave your location obvious. The creature you share a story with can choose this benefit even if you did not.

_desc_en: Stories, like fires, can create shadows as much as they illuminate. When you Offer a Story, you can become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} by shifting shadows for the duration instead of the normal benefits. The action then gains the shadow trait. You can't use this concealment to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}, as normal for concealing effects that leave your location obvious. The creature you share a story with can choose this benefit even if you did not.
_desc_ko: 이야기는 불빛처럼 비추는 만큼 그림자를 만들기도 한다. 이야기를 바칠 때, 일반적인 효과 대신 지속 시간 동안 그림자를 이동시켜 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태가 될 수 있다. 이 행동은 그림자 특성을 얻는다. 이 은폐는 @link[actions.hide]에 사용할 수 없습니다. 은폐 효과가 자신의 위치를 드러내도록 하는 일반 규칙과 동일합니다. 이야기를 공유한 상대는 당신이 선택하지 않았더라도 이 혜택을 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Mutant Physique

description.value:
Basic mutagens that affect your physical form can bring out the beast within you, turn you nigh invincible, or make your body more elastic. While you're affected by one of the listed mutagens, you get an additional benefit.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.IQK9N2mEOyAj3iWU]{Bestial Mutagen} You gain the mutagen's item bonus to your Intimidation checks. In addition, you increase the damage die size of your claws and jaws by one step, and they gain the deadly d10 trait.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.xE0EdDrf734l2fQH]{Juggernaut Mutagen} You gain resistance to all physical damage equal to half your level.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.5MKBwpE401uz4kNN]{Quicksilver Mutagen} You can stretch your legs and Step up to 10 feet, and you can squish and compress your body, allowing you to make it through tight spaces as if you were one size smaller, in addition to any effect from Squeezing.

Special If you can be under the effects of multiple mutagens (with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.1BKdOJ0HNL6Eg3xw]{mutagenist greater field discovery}, for example), you get all relevant benefits.

_desc_en:
Basic mutagens that affect your physical form can bring out the beast within you, turn you nigh invincible, or make your body more elastic. While you're affected by one of the listed mutagens, you get an additional benefit.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.IQK9N2mEOyAj3iWU]{Bestial Mutagen} You gain the mutagen's item bonus to your Intimidation checks. In addition, you increase the damage die size of your claws and jaws by one step, and they gain the deadly d10 trait.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.xE0EdDrf734l2fQH]{Juggernaut Mutagen} You gain resistance to all physical damage equal to half your level.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.5MKBwpE401uz4kNN]{Quicksilver Mutagen} You can stretch your legs and Step up to 10 feet, and you can squish and compress your body, allowing you to make it through tight spaces as if you were one size smaller, in addition to any effect from Squeezing.

Special If you can be under the effects of multiple mutagens (with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.1BKdOJ0HNL6Eg3xw]{mutagenist greater field discovery}, for example), you get all relevant benefits.
_desc_ko:
신체 형태에 영향을 미치는 기본 혈청은 내면의 야수를 깨우거나, 거의 무적에 가깝게 만들거나, 신체를 더 탄력 있게 만들 수 있습니다. 목록에 있는 혈청의 영향을 받는 동안 추가 혜택을 얻습니다.

  • @link[equipment.bestial-mutagen-lesser] 위 변이 유발 물질의 아이템 보너스를 협박 판정 시 적용받습니다. 또한 발톱과 턱의 피해 주사위 크기가 한 단계 증가하며 치명적인 d10 특성을 얻습니다.
  • @link[equipment.juggernaut-mutagen-lesser] 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 모든 물리 피해에 대한 저항력을 얻습니다.

  • @link[equipment.quicksilver-mutagen-lesser] 다리를 쭉 뻗어 최대 10피트까지 이동할 수 있으며, 몸을 쪼그라들게 하고 압축할 수 있어, '쪼그리기' 효과에 더해 마치 한 사이즈 작아진 것처럼 좁은 공간을 통과할 수 있습니다.

Special 여러 변이 유발 물질의 효과(예: @link[feats.greater-field-discovery-mutagenist] 능력)를 동시에 받을 수 있다면, 모든 관련 이점을 얻습니다.

name: Thaumaturge Dedication

description.value:
You've uncovered the hidden art of basic thaumaturgy. You become trained in thaumaturge class DC. Choose an implement; you can use it to Glimpse Vulnerability, but don't gain its benefits. You also gain a few esoterica, allowing you to use esoterica actions. You become trained in your choice of Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion; if you were already trained in these, you become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Yfl6q6Pi42FttDRE]{Glimpse Vulnerability} action.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.K9Krytj8OtUvQxoc]{Thaumaturge}

You become trained in your choice of Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion; if you were already trained in these, you become trained in a skill of your choice.
