_desc_ko:
빈도 하루 1회

당신의 룬로드는 어스폴에 직면하여 은신처로 물러나야 할 만큼 오래 살지 못했을 수도 있지만, 그럼에도 이 사건의 종말론적 메아리는 저 멀리 뼈뜰에 있는 그들의 영혼에까지 닿았다. 당신은 이 제국을 끝장낸 사건의 침습적인 상념을 견디는 법을 배웠으나, 이제 그 절망을 타인의 마음속에 투사할 수 있다. 신화 점수를 소비하고 당신이 감지할 수 있는 60피트 이내의 크리처 최대 10명을 대상으로 삼는다. 당신은 그들의 마음속에 어스폴의 이미지를 강제로 밀어넣어, 세계의 종말과 그들이 소중히 여기는 모든 것의 종말이라는 환영을 견디게 만든다. 크리처들은 당신의 클래스 DC나 주문 DC 중 더 높은 쪽(신화 숙련도 사용)에 대해 @Check[will|against:class-spell] 내성을 시도해야 한다.

대성공 크리처는 영향받지 않는다.

성공 크리처는 환영에 너무 정신이 팔려 1라운드 동안 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{둔화 1} 상태가 된다.

실패 크리처는 1분 동안 둔화 1과 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{멍함 1} 상태가 된다.

대실패 크리처는 1분 동안 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{둔화 2}와 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{멍함 2} 상태가 된다. 또한, 크리처는 다음에 휴식할 때 악몽 주문의 효과를 겪는다. 크리처가 이 효과에 실패하거나 대실패하면, 크리처가 내성에 성공하거나 6일이 지날 때까지 크리처가 잠들려 할 때마다 효과가 반복된다. 당신은 크리처가 이 악몽을 겪게 하기 위해 크리처의 이름을 알거나 같은 행성에 남아 있을 필요가 없다.

name: Eternal Elixir

description.value: Your body readily accepts and retains minor changes. When you drink one of your alchemical items that has the elixir and infused traits and a duration of 1 minute or more, you can make the elixir's duration indefinite. This can exceed the 10-minute limit of an item made with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.yzNJgwzV9XqEhKc6]{Quick Alchemy}. You can do so only if the elixir's level is half your level or lower. If you later consume a different elixir and make it indefinite, the effect of the previous indefinite elixir ends.

_desc_en: Your body readily accepts and retains minor changes. When you drink one of your alchemical items that has the elixir and infused traits and a duration of 1 minute or more, you can make the elixir's duration indefinite. This can exceed the 10-minute limit of an item made with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.yzNJgwzV9XqEhKc6]{Quick Alchemy}. You can do so only if the elixir's level is half your level or lower. If you later consume a different elixir and make it indefinite, the effect of the previous indefinite elixir ends.
_desc_ko: 당신의 몸은 사소한 변화를 쉽게 받아들이고 유지합니다. 당신이 엘릭서 특성과 주입 특성을 지니고 지속 시간이 1분 이상인 자신의 연금술 아이템을 마실 때, 그 엘릭서의 지속 시간을 무기한으로 만들 수 있습니다. 이는 해당 엘릭서의 레벨이 당신의 레벨 절반 이하일 때만 가능합니다. 이후 다른 엘릭서를 섭취하여 무기한으로 만들 경우, 이전에 무기한으로 만든 엘릭서의 효과는 종료됩니다.

name: Truespeech

description.value:
It is paramount that you are understood and you understand others; language need not impede your message.

You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SwUiVavHKMWG7t5K]{Truespeech} as a 5th-rank divine innate spell once per day on yourself only.

You gain a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy checks for the duration of the spell when speaking to creatures with whom you already shared a language before casting.

_desc_en:
It is paramount that you are understood and you understand others; language need not impede your message.

You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SwUiVavHKMWG7t5K]{Truespeech} as a 5th-rank divine innate spell once per day on yourself only.

You gain a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy checks for the duration of the spell when speaking to creatures with whom you already shared a language before casting.
_desc_ko:
당신이 이해받고 타인을 이해하는 것은 가장 중요합니다; 언어는 당신의 메시지를 방해해서는 안 됩니다.

당신은 하루에 한 번, 자신에게만 @link[spells.truespeech]를 (5th)랭크 신성 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

주문을 시전하기 전에 이미 언어를 공유했던 생물과 대화할 때, 주문 지속 시간 동안 외교 기술 판정에서 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Frostbite Runes

description.value:
Thick tattoos, each one a rune fragment from the saumen kar's long-lost language spelling out their pact with their equally lost deity, cover your body and stretch across your limbs, torso, and face. You gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against evil and necromancy spells and effects. You can sense the presence of evil undead as a pervasive taste of oily corruption in the air; this is a vague sense that allows you to know when such a creature is within 60 feet of you, though you can't precisely pinpoint their location with this sense. As normal for a vague sense, it can be fooled, but undead might not realize they need to take precautions against it. This sense also extends to living creatures who have the void healing ability, like dhampir.

You deal an additional 1 cold damage with all Strikes made with an ice-crafted weapon. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.00uTUJPgJ6kuGR8O]{Crown of the Saumen Kar} feat, you deal an additional 1 cold damage with your unarmed horns Strikes.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth

_desc_en:
Thick tattoos, each one a rune fragment from the saumen kar's long-lost language spelling out their pact with their equally lost deity, cover your body and stretch across your limbs, torso, and face. You gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against evil and necromancy spells and effects. You can sense the presence of evil undead as a pervasive taste of oily corruption in the air; this is a vague sense that allows you to know when such a creature is within 60 feet of you, though you can't precisely pinpoint their location with this sense. As normal for a vague sense, it can be fooled, but undead might not realize they need to take precautions against it. This sense also extends to living creatures who have the void healing ability, like dhampir.

You deal an additional 1 cold damage with all Strikes made with an ice-crafted weapon. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.00uTUJPgJ6kuGR8O]{Crown of the Saumen Kar} feat, you deal an additional 1 cold damage with your unarmed horns Strikes.
_desc_ko:
두꺼운 문신들이 당신의 몸과 팔다리, 몸통, 얼굴을 뒤덮고 있습니다. 각각은 사우멘 카르의 오래전에 사라진 언어에서 유래한 룬 조각으로, 마찬가지로 사라진 신과의 계약을 의미합니다. 악과 네크로맨시 주문 및 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 악의 언데드의 존재를 공기 중에 스며든 기름진 부패의 맛으로 감지할 수 있습니다. 이는 모호한 감각으로, 그러한 생물이 60피트 이내에 있을 때 알 수 있지만 정확한 위치를 파악할 수는 없습니다. 모호한 감각의 특성상 속일 수 있으나, 언데드는 이에 대한 대비가 필요하다는 사실을 깨닫지 못할 수 있습니다. 이 감각은 뱀파이어와 같이 공허 치유 능력을 가진 생명체에게도 적용됩니다.

얼음으로 제작된 무기로 가하는 모든 공격에 추가로 냉기 피해 1을 입힙니다. @link[feats.crown-of-the-saumen-kar] 피트를 보유한 경우, 맨손으로 뿔을 사용한 비무장 공격에도 추가로 냉기 피해 1을 입힙니다.

name: Performance Weapon Expert

description.value: Your experience has made you better with a wide variety of weapons. Your proficiency ranks for simple weapons and martial weapons increase to expert, as does your proficiency rank for your chosen advanced weapon.

value.value: expert in any kind of weapon or unarmed attack

_desc_en: Your experience has made you better with a wide variety of weapons. Your proficiency ranks for simple weapons and martial weapons increase to expert, as does your proficiency rank for your chosen advanced weapon.
_desc_ko: 다양한 무기를 다루는 데 능숙해졌습니다. 단순 무기와 무술 무기에 대한 숙련도 등급이 전문가로 상승하며, 선택한 고급 무기에 대한 숙련도 등급도 전문가로 상승합니다.

name: You're Next

description.value:
Trigger You reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points.

Rogue After downing a foe, you menace another. Attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a creature within 60 feet, with a +2 circumstance bonus. If you have legendary proficiency in Intimidation, you can use this as a free action with the same trigger.

Swashbuckler After downing a foe, you promise another that you're coming after them next. Attempt an Intimidation check with a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a single creature that you can see and that can see you. If you're legendary in Intimidation, you can use this as a free action with the same trigger.

_desc_en:
Trigger You reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points.

Rogue After downing a foe, you menace another. Attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a creature within 60 feet, with a +2 circumstance bonus. If you have legendary proficiency in Intimidation, you can use this as a free action with the same trigger.

Swashbuckler After downing a foe, you promise another that you're coming after them next. Attempt an Intimidation check with a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a single creature that you can see and that can see you. If you're legendary in Intimidation, you can use this as a free action with the same trigger.
_desc_ko:
발동 적의 HP를 0으로 감소시킨다.

로그 적을 쓰러뜨린 후, 다른 적을 위협한다. 60피트 내의 생물에게 @link[actions.demoralize]를 시도하며, +2 상황 보너스를 받는다. 협박에 전설적 숙련도를 가진 경우, 동일한 발동 조건으로 이 행동을 자유 행동으로 사용할 수 있다.

스워시버클러 적을 쓰러뜨린 후, 다음 차례로 그들을 상대하겠다고 다른 적에게 선언한다. 시야 내에 있고 당신을 볼 수 있는 단일 생물에게 @link[actions.demoralize]를 시도하며 +2 상황 보너스를 받습니다. 협박에 전설적인 명성을 지녔다면 동일한 조건으로 이 행동을 자유 행동으로 수행할 수 있습니다.

name: Irresistible Bloom

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You bloom, sprouting flowers and releasing a pleasant smell, becoming irresistible. All creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:30] must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save with a DC equal to your Class DC or Spell DC, whichever is higher. On a failure, a creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with you, and must spend at least one of its actions on its next turn moving toward you. On a critical failure, you acting hostile to that creature allows them to attempt another save, rather than automatically ending the fascination.

These effects last until the beginning of your next turn. You can spend one action at the beginning of your turn to Sustain the effects for an additional round. You can Sustain it in this way for a maximum of 1 minute.

Special This feat gains the trait for your ancestry.

value.value: ardande trait, plant trait, or wood trait

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You bloom, sprouting flowers and releasing a pleasant smell, becoming irresistible. All creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:30] must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save with a DC equal to your Class DC or Spell DC, whichever is higher. On a failure, a creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with you, and must spend at least one of its actions on its next turn moving toward you. On a critical failure, you acting hostile to that creature allows them to attempt another save, rather than automatically ending the fascination.

These effects last until the beginning of your next turn. You can spend one action at the beginning of your turn to Sustain the effects for an additional round. You can Sustain it in this way for a maximum of 1 minute.

Special This feat gains the trait for your ancestry.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신은 꽃을 피우고 향기를 풍기며 저항할 수 없는 매력을 발산합니다. 30피트 내 모든 생물은 당신의 직업 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 더 높은 값과 동일한 DC로 의지 내성을 시도하다 해야 합니다. 실패 시, 생물은 당신에게 @link[conditions.fascinated] 상태가 되어 다음 턴에 최소 한 번의 행동을 당신 쪽으로 이동하는 데 사용해야 합니다. 대실패 시, 당신이 해당 생물에게 적대적으로 행동하면 매혹 상태가 자동으로 종료되지 않고 추가 저항 검사를 시도할 수 있습니다.

이 효과는 당신의 다음 턴 시작까지 지속됩니다. 턴 시작 시 행동 하나를 소비하여 효과를 추가 1라운드 동안 유지할 수 있습니다. 이 방식으로 최대 1분 동안 효과를 유지할 수 있습니다.

특수 이 피트는 당신의 혈통에 대한 특성을 부여합니다.

name: Ascended Dragonet Heritage

description.value: You've awoken the power of your draconic heritage. You gain all the mechanical benefits of the dragonet heritage you selected at first level, allowing you to take feats and gain any benefits that require a specific dragonet heritage.

_desc_en: You've awoken the power of your draconic heritage. You gain all the mechanical benefits of the dragonet heritage you selected at first level, allowing you to take feats and gain any benefits that require a specific dragonet heritage.
_desc_ko: 당신은 용의 혈통의 힘을 각성시켰다. 당신은 1레벨에 선택한 드래고닛 혈통의 모든 기계적 이점을 얻어, 특정 드래고닛 혈통을 요구하는 재주를 취하고 이점을 얻을 수 있다.

name: Formidable Breath

description.value: Thanks to rigorous breathing exercises and a diet similar to that of your lineage, your magical breath is more powerful. The area of your Breath of the Dragon increases to 30 feet for a cone or 60 feet for a line, and the damage dice are d6s instead of d4s.

_desc_en: Thanks to rigorous breathing exercises and a diet similar to that of your lineage, your magical breath is more powerful. The area of your Breath of the Dragon increases to 30 feet for a cone or 60 feet for a line, and the damage dice are d6s instead of d4s.
_desc_ko: 엄격한 호흡 훈련과 혈통에 걸맞은 식단 덕분에 당신의 마법 호흡이 더욱 강력해졌습니다. 드래곤의 숨결의 범위가 원뿔형 30피트 또는 직선형 60피트로 증가하며, 피해 주사위가 d4 대신 d6으로 변경됩니다.

name: All of the Animal

description.value: You know how to make the best and most efficient use of a hunted animal's carcass. Choose a Large or larger corpse of an animal that died within the past day. While using Survival to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{Subsist} near the carcass, you always receive enough food for yourself and one additional Medium creature, using up the meat from the carcass to do so. Since you're using all of the animal, others can't use the carcass's meat for any other purpose, including their own use of All of the Animal.

_desc_en: You know how to make the best and most efficient use of a hunted animal's carcass. Choose a Large or larger corpse of an animal that died within the past day. While using Survival to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{Subsist} near the carcass, you always receive enough food for yourself and one additional Medium creature, using up the meat from the carcass to do so. Since you're using all of the animal, others can't use the carcass's meat for any other purpose, including their own use of All of the Animal.
_desc_ko: 사냥한 동물의 시체를 가장 효율적으로 활용하는 방법을 알고 있습니다. 지난 24시간 이내에 죽은 대형 이상의 동물 시체를 선택하세요. 시체 근처에서 생존 기술을 @link[actions.subsist]에 사용하면, 시체의 고기를 모두 소모하여 자신과 추가로 한 마리의 중간 크기의 생물이 먹을 만큼의 식량을 항상 얻습니다. 동물의 모든 부분을 사용하기 때문에, 다른 이들은 시체의 고기를 다른 용도로 사용할 수 없으며, 자신들이 '동물의 모든 부분' 기술을 사용하는 경우도 포함됩니다.

name: Doom of Sailors

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Sailors know that the sight of an angry merfolk might well mean that they never see the shore again. You sing a song that foretells the fate of a creature you can see within 60 feet. The fear that grips the target's soul causes @Damage[10d10[mental]] damage, depending on the target's @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. A creature who's in the water or onboard a seagoing vessel takes a –4 circumstance penalty to its saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} as it glimpses its demise.

Failure The target takes full damage and is frightened 1. In addition, it rolls twice for all skill checks and saving throws it attempts until the end of its next turn and takes the worse result; this is a misfortune effect.

Critical Failure As failure, except double damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Sailors know that the sight of an angry merfolk might well mean that they never see the shore again. You sing a song that foretells the fate of a creature you can see within 60 feet. The fear that grips the target's soul causes @Damage[10d10[mental]] damage, depending on the target's @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. A creature who's in the water or onboard a seagoing vessel takes a –4 circumstance penalty to its saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} as it glimpses its demise.

Failure The target takes full damage and is frightened 1. In addition, it rolls twice for all skill checks and saving throws it attempts until the end of its next turn and takes the worse result; this is a misfortune effect.

Critical Failure As failure, except double damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

선원들은 분노한 어인족의 모습을 본다면 다시는 육지를 보지 못할 수도 있다는 것을 알고 있다. 당신은 60피트 이내에 보이는 생물의 운명을 예언하는 노래를 부른다. 표적의 영혼을 사로잡는 공포는 10d10 정신의 피해를 입힌다. 이는 표적이 네 직업 DC와 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽에 대한 의지 내성에 따라 결정된다. 물속에 있거나 항해 중인 선박에 있는 생물은 내성에 -4 상황 페널티를 받는다.

대성공 대상은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 대상은 반의 피해를 입으며, 자신의 죽음을 엿보게 되어 @link[conditions.frightened]{1} 상태가 된다.

실패 대상은 전체 피해를 입으며 공포 1 상태가 된다. 또한 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 시도하는 모든 기술 판정 및 내성 굴림에서 두 번 굴려 더 나쁜 결과를 적용받는다. 이는 불운 효과이다.

대실패 실패 효과와 동일하나, 피해가 두 배이며 @link[conditions.frightened]{2} 상태가 추가된다.

name: Clear the Way

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a melee weapon in two hands.

You put your body behind your massive weapon and swing, shoving enemies to clear a wide path. You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} up to five creatures adjacent to you, rolling a separate Athletics check for each target and ignoring the requirement that you have a hand free. Then Stride up to half your Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions from any of the creatures you successfully Shoved. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but don't increase your penalty until you have made all your attacks.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a melee weapon in two hands.

You put your body behind your massive weapon and swing, shoving enemies to clear a wide path. You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} up to five creatures adjacent to you, rolling a separate Athletics check for each target and ignoring the requirement that you have a hand free. Then Stride up to half your Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions from any of the creatures you successfully Shoved. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but don't increase your penalty until you have made all your attacks.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손으로 근접 무기를 휘두르고 있습니다.

거대한 무기를 휘두르며 몸을 뒤로 젖혀 적들을 밀쳐 넓은 길을 냅니다. 인접한 최대 다섯 명의 생물을 @link[actions.shove]하려 시도하며, 각 대상마다 별도의 운동 판정을 굴림하고 한 손을 비워야 한다는 요구사항은 무시합니다. 그런 다음 이동 속도의 절반까지 일반 이동으로 이동한다. 이 이동은 성공적으로 밀어낸 생물들의 반응을 유발하지 않는다. 각 공격은 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되나, 모든 공격을 완료할 때까지 페널티를 증가시키지 않는다.

name: Fey Cantrips

description.value: You've learned the cantrips sprites have used since time immemorial. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.atlgGNI1E1Ox3O3a]{Ghost Sound} as primal innate cantrips. If you have the grig heritage, you also gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic}, and if you have the draxie heritage, you gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Qw3fnUlaUbnn7ipC]{Prestidigitation}.

_desc_en: You've learned the cantrips sprites have used since time immemorial. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.atlgGNI1E1Ox3O3a]{Ghost Sound} as primal innate cantrips. If you have the grig heritage, you also gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic}, and if you have the draxie heritage, you gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Qw3fnUlaUbnn7ipC]{Prestidigitation}.
_desc_ko: 스프라이트가 태고적부터 사용해 온 캔트립을 익혔습니다. @link[spells.light]과 @link[spells.ghost-sound]를 프라이멀 선천적 캔트립으로 얻습니다. 그리그 혈통을 지닌 경우 @link[spells.detect-magic]도 획득하며, 드락시 혈통을 지닌 경우 @link[spells.prestidigitation]을 획득한다.

name: Five-Gods Ram

description.value:
Requirements You're in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BQWGOK0lVmljCunm]{Rushing Goat Stance}.

You attack in an unceasing flurry of charging headbutts. Stride or Climb and then make a ramming horn Strike. If the Strike is successful, you immediately push the target back 10 feet, then Stride or Climb and make a second ramming horn Strike against them. If the second Strike is successful, you immediately knock the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, but if the second Strike is a failure or if you're unable to complete all the required actions, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Both Strikes count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until you've made both of them.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Requirements You're in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BQWGOK0lVmljCunm]{Rushing Goat Stance}.

You attack in an unceasing flurry of charging headbutts. Stride or Climb and then make a ramming horn Strike. If the Strike is successful, you immediately push the target back 10 feet, then Stride or Climb and make a second ramming horn Strike against them. If the second Strike is successful, you immediately knock the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, but if the second Strike is a failure or if you're unable to complete all the required actions, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Both Strikes count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until you've made both of them.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 @link[feats.rushing-goat-stance]에 있습니다.

끊임없이 돌진하며 머리로 연타를 가합니다. 이동 또는 등반 후 뿔로 들이받는 공격하세요. 공격이 성공하면 즉시 대상을 10피트 뒤로 밀어낸 후, 다시 이동 또는 등반하여 두 번째 뿔 들이받기 공격하세요. 두 번째 공격이 성공하면 즉시 대상이 @link[conditions.prone] 상태가 되지만, 두 번째 공격이 실패하거나 필요한 모든 행동을 완료하지 못하면 너는 @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태가 된다.

두 번의 공격 모두 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되나, 페널티는 두 번 모두 공격을 완료한 후에야 증가한다.

name: Quickened Attunement

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Requirements Your previous action was Attunement Shift.

If your next action is to cast a spell that would grant your terrain attunement bonus, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (to a minimum of 1 action).

Special You can't use Quickened Attunement and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.z2ptq23nNBOeEI7H]{Quickened Casting} in the same round.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Requirements Your previous action was Attunement Shift.

If your next action is to cast a spell that would grant your terrain attunement bonus, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (to a minimum of 1 action).

Special You can't use Quickened Attunement and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.z2ptq23nNBOeEI7H]{Quickened Casting} in the same round.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

요구 사항 이전 행동이 조율 전환이어야 함.

다음 행동이 지형 조율 보너스를 부여하는 주문을 시전하는 것이라면, 시전하는 행동 횟수를 1 감소시킵니다(최소 1 행동).

특수 같은 턴에 가속된 조율과 @link[feats.quickened-casting]을 동시에 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Mortification

description.value: Your reckonings have prepared your body for physical punishment. Choose bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, based on the nature of your physical reckonings. You gain resistance to the chosen damage type equal to your number of archetype class feats from the Hellknight archetype.

_desc_en: Your reckonings have prepared your body for physical punishment. Choose bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, based on the nature of your physical reckonings. You gain resistance to the chosen damage type equal to your number of archetype class feats from the Hellknight archetype.
_desc_ko: 당신의 심판은 육체적 고통에 대비해 몸을 단련시켰습니다. 육체적 심판의 성격에 따라 타격, 관통, 베기 피해 유형 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 선택한 피해 유형에 대해 지옥기사 아미거 아키타입 및 기타 지옥기사 아키타입에서 얻은 클래스 피트 수만큼의 저항력을 얻습니다.

name: Fey Tracker

description.value: You are exceptionally skilled at noticing the subtle techniques fey use to avoid notice. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Survival checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} fey creatures, to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} fey, and to your Perception DC to resist a fey creature's attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion}.

_desc_en: You are exceptionally skilled at noticing the subtle techniques fey use to avoid notice. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Survival checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} fey creatures, to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} fey, and to your Perception DC to resist a fey creature's attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion}.
_desc_ko: 당신은 페이가 감지되지 않도록 사용하는 미묘한 기술을 알아차리는 데 탁월한 능력을 지녔습니다. 페이 생물을 @link[actions.track]하는 생존 판정, 숨어 있는 페이를 @link[actions.seek] 위한 지각 판정, 그리고 페이 생물의 @link[actions.create-a-diversion] 시도를 저항하는 지각 DC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. @link[conditions.hidden]한 페이를 @link[actions.seek]하는 지각 검사, 그리고 페이 생물이 @link[actions.create-a-diversion]을 시도할 때 이를 저항하는 지각 DC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Shrouded Magic

description.value: Choose one cantrip from the occult spell list. You can cast this cantrip as an occult innate spell at will, heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

_desc_en: Choose one cantrip from the occult spell list. You can cast this cantrip as an occult innate spell at will, heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 오컬트 주문 목록에서 한 가지 캔트립을 선택하십시오. 이 캔트립을 오컬트 선천적 주문으로 자유롭게 시전할 수 있으며, 시전 랭크은 자신의 레벨 절반(반올림)으로 강화됩니다.

name: Brutish Shove

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a two-handed melee weapon.

Using the momentum of your last attack to throw your weight into another, you make your opponent stumble back. Make a Strike with a two-handed melee weapon. If you hit a target that is your size or smaller, that creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your current turn, and you can automatically @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} it, with the same benefits as the Shove action (including the critical success effect, if your Strike was a critical hit). If you move to follow the target, your movement doesn't trigger reactions.

This Strike has the following failure effect.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your current turn.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a two-handed melee weapon.

Using the momentum of your last attack to throw your weight into another, you make your opponent stumble back. Make a Strike with a two-handed melee weapon. If you hit a target that is your size or smaller, that creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your current turn, and you can automatically @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} it, with the same benefits as the Shove action (including the critical success effect, if your Strike was a critical hit). If you move to follow the target, your movement doesn't trigger reactions.

This Strike has the following failure effect.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your current turn.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손 근접 무기를 휘두르고 있어야 합니다.

마지막 공격의 추진력을 이용해 몸무게를 실어 상대방을 뒤로 비틀거리게 합니다. 양손 근접 무기로 공격을 가하세요. 자신과 같은 크기 이하의 대상에게 명중하면, 해당 생물은 @link[conditions.off-guard]당신의 현재 턴이 끝날 때까지 {무방비} 상태가 되며, 당신은 자동으로 @link[actions.shove] 행동을 수행할 수 있습니다. 이 밀치기 행동은 밀치기 행동과 동일한 효과를 가집니다(당신의 공격이 치명타였다면 치명타 성공 효과도 포함). 목표를 따라 이동할 경우, 당신의 이동은 반응을 유발하지 않습니다.

이 공격은 다음과 같은 실패 효과를 가집니다.

실패 대상은 현재 턴이 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Basic Beast Gunner Spellcasting

description.value: You've unlocked the first secrets of beast guns, granting you your own pool of magical might through the amplifying power of their synergistic magic. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{basic spellcasting benefits}. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from this archetype, add a spell of the appropriate spell rank to your repertoire, either a common spell of your chosen tradition or another spell of that tradition you've learned or discovered.

_desc_en: You've unlocked the first secrets of beast guns, granting you your own pool of magical might through the amplifying power of their synergistic magic. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{basic spellcasting benefits}. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from this archetype, add a spell of the appropriate spell rank to your repertoire, either a common spell of your chosen tradition or another spell of that tradition you've learned or discovered.
_desc_ko: 야수 총의 첫 번째 비밀을 해금하여, 시너지 마법의 증폭력을 통해 자신만의 마법력 풀을 부여받습니다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{기본 주문 시전 혜택}을 얻습니다. 이 아키타입으로 새로운 랭크의 주문 슬롯을 얻을 때마다, 선택한 전통의 일반 주문이나 해당 전통에서 배웠거나 발견한 다른 주문 중 적절한 랭크의 주문을 레퍼토리에 추가하세요.

name: Athamaru Weapon Familiarity

description.value:
You wield weapons designed to work underwater with ease. You have familiarity with weapons with the athamaru trait and with crossbows, heavy crossbows, longspears, spears, and tridents—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

_desc_en:
You wield weapons designed to work underwater with ease. You have familiarity with weapons with the athamaru trait and with crossbows, heavy crossbows, longspears, spears, and tridents—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
_desc_ko:
수중에서 쉽게 사용할 수 있도록 설계된 무기를 능숙하게 다룹니다. 아타마루 특성을 가진 무기와 석궁, 중석궁, 장창, 창, 삼지창에 숙련되어 있습니다. 숙련도 목적상, 이 중 무술 무기에 해당하는 것은 단순 무기로 취급합니다.

5레벨에 도달하면, 이 무기들로 치명타를 기록할 때마다 해당 무기의 치명타 특화 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Impaling Thrust

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a melee weapon that deals piercing damage.

You impale your enemy and hold it in place with your weapon, and leave it bleeding when it gets free. Make a melee Strike with a melee weapon that deals piercing damage. If the Strike hits and deals damage, your target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} until it successfully Escapes, you attack with the weapon again, or you Release the required weapon, whichever comes first. When the target is no longer grabbed, it takes persistent bleed damage equal to the weapon's number of weapon damage dice.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a melee weapon that deals piercing damage.

You impale your enemy and hold it in place with your weapon, and leave it bleeding when it gets free. Make a melee Strike with a melee weapon that deals piercing damage. If the Strike hits and deals damage, your target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} until it successfully Escapes, you attack with the weapon again, or you Release the required weapon, whichever comes first. When the target is no longer grabbed, it takes persistent bleed damage equal to the weapon's number of weapon damage dice.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 관통 피해를 주는 근접 무기를 휘두르고 있어야 합니다.

적에게 창을 꽂아 고정시킨 후, 적의 탈출 시 출혈 상태를 유발합니다. 관통 피해를 주는 근접 무기로 근접 공격을 수행하세요. 공격이 적중하여 피해를 입히면, 대상은 @link[conditions.grabbed] 상태가 됩니다. 이 상태는 대상이 탈출에 성공하거나, 다시 무기로 공격하거나, 필요한 무기를 놓을 때까지 지속됩니다(가장 먼저 발생하는 경우). 목표가 더 이상 붙잡히지 않으면, 무기의 무기 피해 주사위 수와 동일한 지속적인 출혈 피해를 받습니다.

name: Shielded Tome

description.value:
During your daily preparations, you can magically fuse a shield into your favorite book, where it appears as an elaborate bookmark. While the two are fused, the book shares the Hardness, Hit Points, and Broken Threshold of the shield, and it can be used to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} if you have that reaction, with a requirement of "You have Raised the Tome" instead of the usual requirements.

You can switch the fused item's form from a book to a shield with a book-shaped motif as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. When the item is in book form, you can read the book and Raise the Tome, and when it's in shield form, you can Raise the Shield, Activate it, and gain any other benefits or effects the shield normally has (such as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.OqDAx4HJ39ojVtvg]{Spellguard Shield's} bonus to saving throws against magic).

The fusion lasts until your next daily preparations.

_desc_en:
During your daily preparations, you can magically fuse a shield into your favorite book, where it appears as an elaborate bookmark. While the two are fused, the book shares the Hardness, Hit Points, and Broken Threshold of the shield, and it can be used to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} if you have that reaction, with a requirement of "You have Raised the Tome" instead of the usual requirements.

You can switch the fused item's form from a book to a shield with a book-shaped motif as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. When the item is in book form, you can read the book and Raise the Tome, and when it's in shield form, you can Raise the Shield, Activate it, and gain any other benefits or effects the shield normally has (such as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.OqDAx4HJ39ojVtvg]{Spellguard Shield's} bonus to saving throws against magic).

The fusion lasts until your next daily preparations.
_desc_ko:
일일 준비 시간 동안, 마법으로 방패를 애용하는 책에 융합시킬 수 있으며, 이는 정교한 책갈피 형태로 나타납니다. 두 개체가 융합된 동안, 책은 방패의 경도, HP, 파손 임계값을 공유하며, 해당 반응을 보유한 경우 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{방패 막기}를 사용할 수 있습니다. 이때 일반적인 요구 사항 대신 "당신이 그 서적을 들어 올렸다"는 조건이 적용됩니다.

액션 하나로 융합된 아이템의 형태를 책에서 방패 모양의 모티프가 있는 방패로 전환할 수 있으며, 이는 집중 특성을 가집니다. 아이템이 책 형태일 때는 책을 읽고 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{서적을 드높임}을 사용할 수 있으며, 방패 형태일 때는 @link[equipment.spellguard-shield]을 사용해 활성화하고 방패가 일반적으로 제공하는 다른 혜택이나 효과(예: @link[equipment.spellguard-shield]의 마법 내성 굴림 보너스)를 얻을 수 있습니다.

이 융합은 다음 일일 준비 시간까지 지속됩니다.

name: Connect the Dots

description.value:
Ephemeral connections between people, places, and concepts are invisible to most, but seeing them is your stock and trade. Choose an ally and a non-allied creature. You must be able to see both of them. You briefly study the way they both move and attempt a @Check[perception] check against the higher of the non-allied creature's Deception DC or Will DC. Both targets are then temporarily immune to Connect the Dots for 10 minutes.

Critical Success You spot a way for your ally to take advantage of the other target's flaws and let them know about it. Your ally gains your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xTK2zsWFyxSJvYbX]{Pursue a Lead} investigation bonus as a circumstance bonus to all its Strikes or skill checks against the creature until the start of your next turn.

Success As critical success, but your ally gains the bonus only for their next Strike or skill check against the creature.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.4a7g78DOZqHE9pRD]{Effect: Connect the Dots}

Failure You fail to make a connection.

Critical Failure You misconstrue a vital piece of information, which temporarily disconcerts you. You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until the end of your next turn.

_desc_en:
Ephemeral connections between people, places, and concepts are invisible to most, but seeing them is your stock and trade. Choose an ally and a non-allied creature. You must be able to see both of them. You briefly study the way they both move and attempt a @Check[perception] check against the higher of the non-allied creature's Deception DC or Will DC. Both targets are then temporarily immune to Connect the Dots for 10 minutes.

Critical Success You spot a way for your ally to take advantage of the other target's flaws and let them know about it. Your ally gains your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xTK2zsWFyxSJvYbX]{Pursue a Lead} investigation bonus as a circumstance bonus to all its Strikes or skill checks against the creature until the start of your next turn.

Success As critical success, but your ally gains the bonus only for their next Strike or skill check against the creature.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.4a7g78DOZqHE9pRD]{Effect: Connect the Dots}

Failure You fail to make a connection.

Critical Failure You misconstrue a vital piece of information, which temporarily disconcerts you. You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
사람, 장소, 개념 사이의 덧없는 연결은 대부분에게 보이지 않지만, 당신은 이를 보는 것이 본업이다. 아군과 비아군 생물 하나씩을 선택한다. 둘 다 볼 수 있어야 한다. 당신은 잠시 둘의 움직임을 관찰한 후, 비동맹 생물의 기만 DC와 의지 DC 중 높은 쪽을 대상으로 지각 판정을 시도한다. 두 대상은 이후 10분 동안 '점 연결'에 일시적으로 면역됩니다.

대성공 당신은 아군이 다른 대상의 약점을 이용할 방법을 발견하고 그 사실을 알립니다. 동료는 다음 차례 시작까지 해당 생물 대상의 모든 공격 또는 기술 판정 시, 당신의 @link[actions.pursue-a-lead] 조사 보너스를 상황 보너스로 얻습니다.

성공 대성공과 동일하나, 아군은 해당 생물체에 대한 다음 공격 또는 기술 검사 시에만 보너스를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.4a7g78DOZqHE9pRD]{효과: 점 연결}

실패 연결에 실패합니다.

대실패중요한 정보를 오해하여 일시적으로 당황하게 됩니다. 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.stupefied]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Daywalker

description.value: Whether through painstaking exposure, devoted prayer, or simple luck, you've found a greater affinity for life through the sun's light. When in an area of direct natural sunlight, your void healing is suppressed, meaning you are healed by vitality healing effects and harmed by void energy.

_desc_en: Whether through painstaking exposure, devoted prayer, or simple luck, you've found a greater affinity for life through the sun's light. When in an area of direct natural sunlight, your void healing is suppressed, meaning you are healed by vitality healing effects and harmed by void energy.
_desc_ko: 고통스러운 노출, 헌신적인 기도, 혹은 단순한 행운을 통해, 당신은 태양빛을 통해 삶에 대한 더 큰 친화력을 찾았습니다. 자연광이 직접 비치는 지역에 있을 때, 당신의 공허 치유는 억제됩니다. 즉, vitality healing 효과로 치유받고 공허 에너지로 피해를 입습니다.

name: Goring Charge

description.value: Driven by the momentum of your thundering steps and powerful mass, your horns can pierce your foes. Stride twice, then make a horns Strike. If you moved at least 20 feet from your starting position, your horns Strike also deals 1d6 persistent bleed damage.

_desc_en: Driven by the momentum of your thundering steps and powerful mass, your horns can pierce your foes. Stride twice, then make a horns Strike. If you moved at least 20 feet from your starting position, your horns Strike also deals 1d6 persistent bleed damage.
_desc_ko: 우렁찬 발걸음과 강력한 체중의 추진력으로 뿔이 적을 관통할 수 있습니다. 두 걸음 이동한 후 뿔 공격을 수행합니다. 시작 위치에서 최소 20피트 이상 이동했다면, 뿔 공격은 1d6 지속 출혈 피해를 추가로 입힙니다.

name: Pitborn

description.value:
Your blood bears the mark of a demon, a living embodiment of sin from the fetid depths of the Outer Rifts. Demonic power pulses through your veins and manifests in a different way for each pitborn, whether you have webbed fingers and thrive in the water, large hands capable of wrestling larger foes, or some other manifestation. You are trained in Athletics. If you were already trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain any one common 1st-level skill feat with a prerequisite of trained in Athletics, as reflects the manifestation of your fiendish blood.

_desc_en:
Your blood bears the mark of a demon, a living embodiment of sin from the fetid depths of the Outer Rifts. Demonic power pulses through your veins and manifests in a different way for each pitborn, whether you have webbed fingers and thrive in the water, large hands capable of wrestling larger foes, or some other manifestation. You are trained in Athletics. If you were already trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain any one common 1st-level skill feat with a prerequisite of trained in Athletics, as reflects the manifestation of your fiendish blood.
_desc_ko:
당신의 피에는 데몬의 표식이 새겨져 있습니다. 이는 외계 균열의 악취 나는 심연에서 비롯된 죄악의 살아있는 화신입니다. 데몬의 힘이 당신의 혈관을 통해 흐르며, 각 피트본마다 다른 형태로 창조됩니다. 물속에서 번성하는 물갈퀴 손가락일 수도, 거대한 적과 맞설 수 있는 큰 손일 수도, 혹은 다른 형태일 수도 있습니다. 운동에 숙련되어 있다. (배경이나 직업 등으로) 이미 운동에 숙련되어 있었다면, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련되어 있다.

또한 악마의 피가 드러나는 형태를 반영하여, 운동 능력 숙련을 전제 조건으로 하는 일반적인 1레벨 기술 피트 중 하나를 선택하여 획득한다.

name: Spinebreaker

description.value:
Requirements You have a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

You squeeze your opponent in a vicious bear hug, putting intense pressure on their nerves, joints, or other pain points. Attempt an Athletics check to [[/act grapple]] a creature you have grabbed or restrained, with the following additional effects if you succeed.

Critical Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} until the end of its next turn and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 minute.

Success The target is clumsy 1 until the end of its next turn.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

You squeeze your opponent in a vicious bear hug, putting intense pressure on their nerves, joints, or other pain points. Attempt an Athletics check to [[/act grapple]] a creature you have grabbed or restrained, with the following additional effects if you succeed.

Critical Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} until the end of its next turn and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 minute.

Success The target is clumsy 1 until the end of its next turn.
_desc_ko:
Requirements 당신은 생물 @link[conditions.grabbed] 또는 @link[conditions.restrained] 상태입니다.

상대를 사나운 곰 껴안기로 꽉 조여 신경, 관절 또는 기타 통증 부위에 강한 압박을 가합니다. 붙잡거나 제압한 생물을 붙잡기하기 위해 운동 판정을 시도하세요. 성공 시 다음 추가 효과가 적용됩니다.

대성공 대상은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.clumsy]{2} 상태가 되며, 1분 동안 @link[conditions.clumsy]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

성공 대상은 다음 턴 종료 시까지 둔함 1 상태가 됩니다.

name: Secondary Adaptation

description.value: You've continued to adapt to the rigors of your environment by continuing your metamorphosis, even as an adult. Choose one surki heritage that you don't already have; you gain that heritage and its benefits.

_desc_en: You've continued to adapt to the rigors of your environment by continuing your metamorphosis, even as an adult. Choose one surki heritage that you don't already have; you gain that heritage and its benefits.
_desc_ko: 성체에 이르렀음에도 변태를 지속하며 가혹한 환경에 계속 적응해 왔습니다. 아직 보유하지 않은 수르키 혈통 하나를 선택하세요. 해당 혈통과 그 혜택을 얻습니다.

name: Expanded Splash

description.value: You can throw bombs at just the right trajectory to create especially large and powerful explosions. When you throw an alchemical bomb and that bomb has the splash trait, you can have the splash damage affect all creatures within 10 feet of the target instead of 5 feet. If you do, you gain a status bonus to the bomb's splash damage equal to your Intelligence modifier. If you have the bomber 5th-level field discovery, this additional damage applies even if you caused your bomb to deal splash damage equal to your Intelligence modifier instead of the normal amount, allowing your bombs to deal splash damage equal to double your Intelligence modifier.

_desc_en: You can throw bombs at just the right trajectory to create especially large and powerful explosions. When you throw an alchemical bomb and that bomb has the splash trait, you can have the splash damage affect all creatures within 10 feet of the target instead of 5 feet. If you do, you gain a status bonus to the bomb's splash damage equal to your Intelligence modifier. If you have the bomber 5th-level field discovery, this additional damage applies even if you caused your bomb to deal splash damage equal to your Intelligence modifier instead of the normal amount, allowing your bombs to deal splash damage equal to double your Intelligence modifier.
_desc_ko: 폭탄을 정밀한 궤적으로 투척하여 특히 거대하고 강력한 폭발을 일으킬 수 있습니다. 연금술 폭탄을 투척할 때 해당 폭탄이 파편 특성을 지닌다면, 방사 피해를 목표물로부터 5피트가 아닌 10피트 내의 모든 생물에게 적용할 수 있습니다. 이 경우 폭탄의 방사 피해에 지능 능력치 수정자에 해당하는 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 폭격수 5레벨 필드 발견 능력을 보유한 경우, 이 추가 피해는 폭탄이 일반적인 양 대신 지능 능력치 수정자만큼의 방사 피해를 입히도록 했을 때에도 적용됩니다. 이로 인해 폭탄은 지능 능력치 수정자의 두 배에 해당하는 방사 피해를 입힐 수 있습니다.

name: Underground Network

description.value:
You're connected to groups that know what's going on in the streets, and you can get information out of them quickly. When you use Society to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information} in an area where you have a network (typically a settlement where you've spent at least a week or spent a day of downtime to build a network faster), you can contact a member of these groups to get information directly from them. This usually takes about an hour, and it doesn't draw as much attention as Gathering Information in public might. The check and information gained otherwise follow the normal rules for Gather Information.

In addition, if you have successfully consulted the underground network, you get a +1 circumstance bonus to the next check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} you attempt about the subject you were Gathering Information on, or a +2 circumstance bonus if you're using Underworld Lore for the check. The GM might change the Lore skill related to the network depending on your location or the specifics of the network you're tapping into.

_desc_en:
You're connected to groups that know what's going on in the streets, and you can get information out of them quickly. When you use Society to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information} in an area where you have a network (typically a settlement where you've spent at least a week or spent a day of downtime to build a network faster), you can contact a member of these groups to get information directly from them. This usually takes about an hour, and it doesn't draw as much attention as Gathering Information in public might. The check and information gained otherwise follow the normal rules for Gather Information.

In addition, if you have successfully consulted the underground network, you get a +1 circumstance bonus to the next check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} you attempt about the subject you were Gathering Information on, or a +2 circumstance bonus if you're using Underworld Lore for the check. The GM might change the Lore skill related to the network depending on your location or the specifics of the network you're tapping into.
_desc_ko:
당신은 거리에서 벌어지는 일을 잘 아는 집단들과 연결되어 있으며, 그들에게서 신속하게 정보를 얻을 수 있습니다. 네트워크가 구축된 지역(일반적으로 최소 일주일을 머물렀거나 네트워크 구축을 위해 하루의 다운타임 동안 휴식을 취한 정착지)에서 사회 능력으로 @link[actions.gather-information]을 수행할 때, 해당 조직의 구성원에게 직접 연락하여 정보를 얻을 수 있습니다. 이 과정은 보통 한 시간 정도 소요되며, 공개 장소에서 정보 수집을 할 때보다 덜 주목받습니다. 그 외의 판정 및 획득한 정보는 일반적인 정보 수집 규칙을 따릅니다.

또한 지하 네트워크를 성공적으로 활용했다면, 해당 정보 수집 대상에 관한 다음 @link[actions.recall-knowledge] 판정을 시도할 때 +1 상황 보너스를 받습니다. 지하 세계 지식를 사용한 판정라면 +2 상황 보너스를 받습니다. GM은 위치나 활용하는 네트워크의 특성에 따라 지식 스킬을 변경할 수 있습니다.

name: Certain Stratagem

description.value: You know exactly where to strike a foe to target their weak spots. When you make a Strike that you're adding your Intelligence modifier to due to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.m0f2B7G9eaaTmhFL]{Devising a Stratagem} and miss, you deal half of your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.2Fe4YZCvAr9Yf6w7]{Strategic Strike} damage to the target. This damage type is that of the weapon or unarmed attack you used for the Strike.

_desc_en: You know exactly where to strike a foe to target their weak spots. When you make a Strike that you're adding your Intelligence modifier to due to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.m0f2B7G9eaaTmhFL]{Devising a Stratagem} and miss, you deal half of your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.2Fe4YZCvAr9Yf6w7]{Strategic Strike} damage to the target. This damage type is that of the weapon or unarmed attack you used for the Strike.
_desc_ko: 적의 약점을 정확히 노려 강타할 위치를 알고 있다. @link[actions.devise-a-stratagem]으로 지능 수정자를 추가하여 공격을 시도했으나 빗나갔을 때, 대상에게 @link[feats.strategic-strike] 피해의 절반을 입힙니다. 이 피해 유형은 해당 공격에 사용한 무기나 비무장 공격의 피해 유형과 동일합니다.

name: Instrument of Zeal

description.value: Divine energy fills your weapon. Whenever you critically hit an enemy with Blessed Counterstrike or Retributive Strike, your attack deals an extra weapon damage die, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} on its next turn

value.value: Blessed Counterstrike feat or Retributive Strike reaction, champion's reaction that grants an ally resistance to an enemy's damage (including the grandeur, justice, liberation, and redemption causes)

_desc_en: Divine energy fills your weapon. Whenever you critically hit an enemy with Blessed Counterstrike or Retributive Strike, your attack deals an extra weapon damage die, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} on its next turn
_desc_ko: 신성한 에너지가 무기에 가득 차 있습니다. 축복받은 반격이나 보복의 일격으로 적을 치명타로 명중시킬 때마다, 공격은 추가 무기 피해 주사위 하나를 입히고, 대상은 다음 턴에 @link[conditions.slowed]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Kneel Before the Rightful Heir

description.value:
You command that your foes bow down before you or face your wrath. All enemies within 40 feet who can see and hear you must attempt a Will saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Regardless of the result, a creature is then temporarily immune to Kneel Before the Rightful Heir for 24 hours.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[3d6[persistent,mental]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[6d6[persistent,mental]] damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[6d6[persistent,mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} for as long as it's taking that persistent damage.

The persistent mental damage can be ended only if the creature Drops Prone in a location that you can see and doesn't Stand until their next turn. An affected creature is aware of this restriction.

_desc_en:
You command that your foes bow down before you or face your wrath. All enemies within 40 feet who can see and hear you must attempt a Will saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Regardless of the result, a creature is then temporarily immune to Kneel Before the Rightful Heir for 24 hours.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[3d6[persistent,mental]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[6d6[persistent,mental]] damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[6d6[persistent,mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} for as long as it's taking that persistent damage.

The persistent mental damage can be ended only if the creature Drops Prone in a location that you can see and doesn't Stand until their next turn. An affected creature is aware of this restriction.
_desc_ko:
당신은 적들이 당신 앞에 무릎 꿇거나 당신의 분노를 맞이하라고 명령합니다. 당신을 보고 들을 수 있는 40피트 내의 모든 적들은 당신의 직업 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 더 높은 쪽에 대한 의지 내성 굴림을 시도해야 합니다. 결과와 상관없이, 생물은 이후 24시간 동안 '정당한 후계자 앞에 무릎 꿇어라'에 대해 일시적으로 면역이 됩니다.

대성공 생물은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 생물은 3d6 지속 정신의 피해를 입습니다.

실패 생물은 6d6 지속 정신의 피해를 입습니다.

대실패 생물은 6d6 지속 정신의 피해를 입으며, 지속 피해를 받는 동안 @link[conditions.clumsy]{2} 상태가 됩니다.

지속적인 정신 피해는 해당 생물이 당신이 볼 수 있는 위치에서 넘어짐 상태로 떨어지고 다음 차례까지 일어서지 않을 때만 종료될 수 있습니다. 영향을 받은 생물은 이 제한을 인지하고 있습니다.

name: Well-Groomed

description.value: You are fastidious about keeping clean. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a disease, you get a critical success instead. If you have a different ability that would improve the save in this way (such as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.gdSmSTaGDxf4g2d8]{Battle Hardened} fighter class feature), if you roll a critical failure on the save you get a failure instead.

_desc_en: You are fastidious about keeping clean. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a disease, you get a critical success instead. If you have a different ability that would improve the save in this way (such as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.gdSmSTaGDxf4g2d8]{Battle Hardened} fighter class feature), if you roll a critical failure on the save you get a failure instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 청결을 매우 중요하게 여깁니다. 질병 내성 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 질병 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴렸을 경우, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다. 이 방식으로 질병 저항력 내성을 향상시키는 다른 능력(예: @link[feats.battle-hardened] 파이터 클래스 특성)을 보유한 경우, 내성에 대실패를 굴리면 대신 실패를 얻습니다.

name: Armiger's Protection

description.value:
You've learned to wear the iconic Hellknight armor. You become trained in light armor and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.LF7HSNnlGxLJyDZS]{Hellknight Breastplate}, a medium armor. If you were already trained in light armor and medium armor, you gain training in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.U6XqhSFUUowHnnkk]{Hellknight Half Plate} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.lCgXeV52eYYl5cUX]{Hellknight Plate}. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in any type of armor (but not unarmored defense), you also gain that proficiency in the armor types granted to you by this feat. If you have a class feature that grants you expert proficiency in unarmored defense and you're 13th level or higher, you also become an expert in the armor types granted to you by this feat.

In addition, when you choose this feat, you receive a non-magical suit of Hellknight armor of a type you become trained in (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.LF7HSNnlGxLJyDZS]{Hellknight Breastplate}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.U6XqhSFUUowHnnkk]{Hellknight Half Plate}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.lCgXeV52eYYl5cUX]{Hellknight Plate}).

_desc_en:
You've learned to wear the iconic Hellknight armor. You become trained in light armor and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.LF7HSNnlGxLJyDZS]{Hellknight Breastplate}, a medium armor. If you were already trained in light armor and medium armor, you gain training in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.U6XqhSFUUowHnnkk]{Hellknight Half Plate} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.lCgXeV52eYYl5cUX]{Hellknight Plate}. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in any type of armor (but not unarmored defense), you also gain that proficiency in the armor types granted to you by this feat. If you have a class feature that grants you expert proficiency in unarmored defense and you're 13th level or higher, you also become an expert in the armor types granted to you by this feat.

In addition, when you choose this feat, you receive a non-magical suit of Hellknight armor of a type you become trained in (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.LF7HSNnlGxLJyDZS]{Hellknight Breastplate}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.U6XqhSFUUowHnnkk]{Hellknight Half Plate}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.lCgXeV52eYYl5cUX]{Hellknight Plate}).
_desc_ko:
당신은 상징적인 헬나이트 갑옷을 착용하는 법을 익혔다. 당신은 경장 갑옷과 중장 갑옷인 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.LF7HSNnlGxLJyDZS]{헬나이트 흉갑}에 숙련이 된다. 이미 경장 갑옷과 중장 갑옷에 숙련되어 있었다면, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.U6XqhSFUUowHnnkk]{헬나이트 하프 플레이트}와 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.lCgXeV52eYYl5cUX]{헬나이트 플레이트}에 숙련을 얻는다. 어떤 종류의 갑옷(비무장 방어는 제외)에서든 전문가 이상의 숙련도를 부여하는 직업 특징을 얻을 때마다, 이 재주로 당신에게 부여된 갑옷 종류에서도 해당 숙련도를 얻는다. 비무장 방어에서 전문가 숙련도를 부여하는 직업 특징이 있고 당신이 13레벨 이상이라면, 이 재주로 부여된 갑옷 종류에서도 전문가가 된다.

또한, 이 재주를 선택할 때 당신이 숙련이 되는 종류의 비마법 헬나이트 갑옷 한 벌(@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.LF7HSNnlGxLJyDZS]{헬나이트 흉갑}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.U6XqhSFUUowHnnkk]{헬나이트 하프 플레이트}, 또는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.lCgXeV52eYYl5cUX]{헬나이트 플레이트})을 받는다.

name: Political Acumen

description.value: You have spent years following the political maneuvering and secret alliances of elves in Iadara. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} against other elves and to your Perception DC against Lies spoken by agents of Tanglebriar.

_desc_en: You have spent years following the political maneuvering and secret alliances of elves in Iadara. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} against other elves and to your Perception DC against Lies spoken by agents of Tanglebriar.
_desc_ko: 여러 해 동안 이아다라 엘프들의 정치적 술수와 비밀 동맹을 관찰해 왔습니다. 다른 엘프를 상대로 한 @link[actions.sense-motive] 지각 판정 및 탱글브라이어 요원들의 거짓말에 대한 지각 DC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Certain Strike

description.value:
Even when you don't hit squarely, you can still score a glancing blow. Make a melee Strike. It gains the following failure effect.

Failure Your attack deals any damage it would have dealt on a hit, excluding all damage dice. (This removes damage dice from weapon runes, spells, and special abilities, in addition to weapon damage dice.)

_desc_en:
Even when you don't hit squarely, you can still score a glancing blow. Make a melee Strike. It gains the following failure effect.

Failure Your attack deals any damage it would have dealt on a hit, excluding all damage dice. (This removes damage dice from weapon runes, spells, and special abilities, in addition to weapon damage dice.)
_desc_ko:
칸에 정확히 명중하지 못하더라도 스치기 공격을 성공시킬 수 있습니다. 근접 공격을 수행하세요. 이 공격은 다음 실패 효과를 얻습니다.

실패 공격이 명중했을 때 입혔을 모든 피해를 입히되, 모든 피해 주사위를 제외한다. (이는 무기 피해 주사위 외에도 무기 룬, 주문, 특수 능력의 피해 주사위를 제거한다.)

name: Infinite Blades Celestial Arrow

description.value:
Usage imbued into a ranged weapon ikon

Each shot you launch multiplies itself with spiritual blades, rings, and other missiles that shower upon your foes. Your weapon ikon gains the following abilities.

Immanence Whenever you successfully Strike an enemy with your weapon ikon, up to two enemies adjacent to the target take spirit damage equal to your weapon ikon's damage dice as they are struck by duplicated missiles.

Transcendence—@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JtEzSceixS0WA8wn]{Heaven Rains an Ending} 3 (transcendence)

_desc_ko:
사용법 원거리 무기 이콘에 부여됨

발사하는 각 탄환은 영혼의 검, 고리, 기타 투사체로 분열되어 적에게 쏟아집니다. 당신의 무기 이콘은 다음 능력을 얻습니다.

내재성 무기 이콘으로 적을 강타에 성공할 때마다, 대상과 인접한 최대 두 명의 적이 복제된 투사체에 맞아 무기 이콘의 피해 주사위 수치만큼 영혼 피해를 입는다.

description.value: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level alchemist feat.

_desc_ko: 1레벨 또는 2레벨 연금술사 피트를 얻습니다.

name: Radiant Armament

description.value:
Your blessed armament radiates power, further enhancing your chosen weapon. When you choose the weapon for your blessed armament during your daily preparations, add the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.6llILJtsTPgtYXgx]{Astral} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.LbdnZFlyLFdAE617]{Brilliant} property runes to the list of effects you can choose from. If you're holy, also add the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.DH0kB9Wbr5pDeunX]{Holy} rune, and if you're unholy, also add the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.gmMrJREf4JSHd2dZ]{Unholy} rune.

In addition, you can change the rune you've selected for the day to a different rune from your list as a 10-minute activity that has the concentrate, divine, and exploration traits. Changing the rune doesn't restore abilities that can be used only a limited number of times, such as Holy Healing for the holy rune

_desc_ko:
축복받은 무기가 힘을 발산하여 선택한 무기를 더욱 강화합니다. 매일 준비 단계에서 축복받은 무기로 사용할 무기를 선택할 때, 선택 가능한 효과 목록에 @link[equipment.astral] 및 @link[equipment.brilliant] 속성 룬을 선택 가능한 효과 목록에 추가한다. 신성한 경우 @link[equipment.holy] 룬도 추가하고, 불경한 경우 @link[equipment.unholy] 룬도 추가한다.

또한, 집중, 신성, 탐험 특성을 가진 10분 활동으로 당일 선택한 룬을 목록의 다른 룬으로 변경할 수 있습니다. 룬을 변경해도 신성 룬의

신성한 치유

과 같이 제한된 횟수만 사용할 수 있는 능력은 복구되지 않습니다.

name: Mist Escape

description.value:
Trigger You are reduced to 0 HP.

As you fall, your body reacts to defend itself. You Turn to Mist. This doesn't expend a use of Turn to Mist, and you can use Mist Escape even if you've already Turned to Mist in the same day. You take move actions to move directly toward your coffin even though you are at 0 HP, though you aren't conscious and don't have control over how you do so. While at 0 HP in this form, you are unaffected by further damage. You automatically return to your corporeal form, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, if you reach your coffin or after 1 hour when you are destroyed, whichever one comes first.

_desc_en:
Trigger You are reduced to 0 HP.

As you fall, your body reacts to defend itself. You Turn to Mist. This doesn't expend a use of Turn to Mist, and you can use Mist Escape even if you've already Turned to Mist in the same day. You take move actions to move directly toward your coffin even though you are at 0 HP, though you aren't conscious and don't have control over how you do so. While at 0 HP in this form, you are unaffected by further damage. You automatically return to your corporeal form, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, if you reach your coffin or after 1 hour when you are destroyed, whichever one comes first.
_desc_ko:
발동조건 HP가 0이 될 때.

추락하는 동안 몸이 스스로를 방어하려 반응합니다. 당신은 안개로 변합니다. 이는 안개로 변하기의 사용 횟수를 소모하지 않으며, 같은 날 이미 안개로 변한 상태라도 안개 탈출을 사용할 수 있습니다. HP가 0임에도 불구하고 관을 향해 직접 이동하기 위해 이동 행동을 취하지만, 의식이 없고 그 과정을 통제할 수 없습니다. 이 형태로 HP 0 상태일 때 추가 피해는 받지 않는다. 관에 도달하거나 1시간 후 파괴될 경우, 둘 중 먼저 발생하는 시점에 자동으로 @link[conditions.unconscious] 상태의 육체 형태로 복귀한다.

name: Sense the Strike

description.value:
Trigger A creature targets you with an attack and you can see the attacker.

You sense how an incoming attack moves through ambient primal energy, predicting how best to dodge. The triggering attack targets your Survival DC instead of your AC. Though this allows you to avoid taking penalties to your AC, it doesn't remove any conditions or other effects causing such penalties. For example, an enemy with sneak attack would still deal extra damage to you for being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, even though you wouldn't take the –2 circumstance penalty when defending against the attack.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature targets you with an attack and you can see the attacker.

You sense how an incoming attack moves through ambient primal energy, predicting how best to dodge. The triggering attack targets your Survival DC instead of your AC. Though this allows you to avoid taking penalties to your AC, it doesn't remove any conditions or other effects causing such penalties. For example, an enemy with sneak attack would still deal extra damage to you for being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, even though you wouldn't take the –2 circumstance penalty when defending against the attack.
_desc_ko:
발동조건 생물이 당신을 공격 대상으로 삼고, 당신이 공격자를 볼 수 있을 때.

당신은 다가오는 공격이 주변의 프라이멀 에너지를 어떻게 통과하는지 감지하여 가장 효과적인 회피 방법을 예측합니다. 발동된 공격은 당신의 AC 대신 생존 DC를 대상으로 합니다. 이로 인해 AC에 적용되는 페널티는 피할 수 있지만, 해당 페널티를 유발하는 상태 이상이나 기타 효과는 제거되지 않습니다. 예를 들어, 암습을 가진 적의 경우, 공격 방어 시 -2 상황 페널티를 받지 않더라도 @link[conditions.off-guard]로 인해 추가 피해를 입게 됩니다.

name: Airborne Form

description.value: Your eidolon can fly. It gains a fly Speed equal to its Speed.

_desc_en: Your eidolon can fly. It gains a fly Speed equal to its Speed.
_desc_ko: 당신의 에이돌론은 비행할 수 있습니다. 에이돌론은 자신의 이동 속도와 동일한 비행 속도를 얻습니다.

name: Axial Recall

description.value: You have reconfigured the magical resonance of your core to attune to the planar energies of Axis, enabling instantaneous travel to that plane. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5bTt2CvYHPvaR7QQ]{Interplanar Teleport} twice per week as an arcane innate spell that can only target yourself; you can travel only to Axis or the Universe, and your body serves as the focus component.

_desc_en: You have reconfigured the magical resonance of your core to attune to the planar energies of Axis, enabling instantaneous travel to that plane. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5bTt2CvYHPvaR7QQ]{Interplanar Teleport} twice per week as an arcane innate spell that can only target yourself; you can travel only to Axis or the Universe, and your body serves as the focus component.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신의 핵심 마법적 공명을 축계의 평면 에너지에 조율하도록 재구성하여, 해당 평면으로의 순간 이동을 가능하게 합니다. @link[spells.interplanar-teleport]을 주당 두 번, 오직 자신만을 대상으로 하는 아케인 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 이동 가능한 차원은 축계 또는 우주뿐이며, 시전자의 신체가 포커스 재료로 사용됩니다.

name: Say That Again!

description.value:
Trigger An opponent gets a critical failure when attempting to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} you or Lie to you.

The world is full of obnoxious weasels who think they can pull one over on you-put them in their place! When an adjacent creature attempts to Lie to you or to Demoralize you and gets a critical failure on the roll, you can use your reaction to make a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} attempt against that opponent. If combat results, you can roll Intimidation for your initiative check.

_desc_en:
Trigger An opponent gets a critical failure when attempting to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} you or Lie to you.

The world is full of obnoxious weasels who think they can pull one over on you-put them in their place! When an adjacent creature attempts to Lie to you or to Demoralize you and gets a critical failure on the roll, you can use your reaction to make a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} attempt against that opponent. If combat results, you can roll Intimidation for your initiative check.
_desc_ko:
트리거 상대방이 당신을 @link[actions.demoralize]시키거나 거짓말을 시도할 때 대실패를 한다.

세상은 당신을 속일 수 있다고 생각하는 성가신 족제비들로 가득합니다-제대로 혼내주세요! 인접한 생물이 당신에게 거짓말을 하거나 사기를 떨어뜨리려 시도할 때, 그 주사위 굴림에서 대실패를 기록하면, 당신은 반응 행동으로 그 상대에게 @link[actions.shove] 시도를 할 수 있습니다. 전투가 발생하면, 당신은 이니셔티브 판정에서 협박 능력치로 굴릴 수 있습니다.

name: This Time, Bring the Body

description.value: Death sends a soul into the River of Souls. Since your soul has experienced not only death but also rebirth, you can shift your physical body into the Ethereal Plane for brief intervals. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.D2nPKbIS67m9199U]{Ethereal Jaunt} as a 9th-rank occult innate spell that you can cast once per day. Thanks to your soul's intimate connection with the Ethereal Plane, you can move at your normal speed while this spell is in effect.
