You gain two special 2nd-rank creed spell slots, which can be used to prepare @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Fr58LDSrbndgld9n]{Resist Energy}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{Sure Strike}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MZGkMsPBztFN0pUO]{Water Breathing} as divine spells. At 10th level, the extra slots increase to 3rd rank and you add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{Haste} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KqvqNAfGIE5a9wSv]{Heroism} to the spells you can prepare in your creed spell slots. At 14th level, the extra slots increase to 4th rank and you add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.A2JfEKe6BZcTG1S8]{Fly} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aqRYNoSvxsVfqglH]{Unfettered Movement}.
_desc_ko: 당신은 신성한 능력을 확장하여 전투에 더 집중할 수 있도록 지원하는 마법을 얻었습니다. 두 개의 특별한 2nd-rank 신조 주문 슬롯을 획득하며, 이를 사용하여 @link[spells.resist-energy], @link[spells.see-the-unseen], @link[spells.sure-strike], @link[spells.water-breathing]을 신성 마법으로 준비할 수 있습니다. 10레벨에 도달하면 추가 슬롯이 (3rd) 랭크으로 상승하며, @link[spells.haste]과 @link[spells.heroism]을 추가로 준비할 수 있습니다. 14레벨에 도달하면 추가 슬롯이 (4th)로 증가하며 @link[spells.fly]과 @link[spells.unfettered-movement]을 추가로 준비할 수 있습니다.

name: Exploitive Bomb

description.value: You can mix a refractile substance into an alchemical bomb to foil resistances. Choose one damage type the bomb can deal. Any damage dealt by the bomb—including initial, splash, and persistent damage—ignores an amount of that resistance equal to your level.

rules.text: The bomb reduces one resistance the enemy has to its damage type by an amount equal to your level, but only for that attack.
rules.title: {item|name}

_desc_en: You can mix a refractile substance into an alchemical bomb to foil resistances. Choose one damage type the bomb can deal. Any damage dealt by the bomb—including initial, splash, and persistent damage—ignores an amount of that resistance equal to your level.
_desc_ko: 당신은 저항력을 무력화하기 위해 굴절성 물질을 연금술 폭탄에 혼합할 수 있습니다. 폭탄이 가할 수 있는 피해 유형 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 폭탄이 가하는 모든 피해(초기 피해, 방사 피해, 지속 피해 포함)는 당신의 레벨과 동일한 양의 해당 저항력을 무시합니다.

name: Right-Hand Blood

description.value: It's said that the flesh of the right side of a hyena can heal diseases, but that the flesh of the left side is deadly and poisonous. You can deal @Damage[1[slashing]] damage to yourself to feed someone blood from your right side and Administer First Aid or take @Damage[2d8[untyped]] damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TC7OcDa7JlWbqMaN]{Treat Disease} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}; in either case, you don't need a healer's toolkit, and you gain a +1 item bonus to your check. Blood from your left side causes the check to critically fail automatically.

_desc_en: It's said that the flesh of the right side of a hyena can heal diseases, but that the flesh of the left side is deadly and poisonous. You can deal @Damage[1[slashing]] damage to yourself to feed someone blood from your right side and Administer First Aid or take @Damage[2d8[untyped]] damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TC7OcDa7JlWbqMaN]{Treat Disease} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}; in either case, you don't need a healer's toolkit, and you gain a +1 item bonus to your check. Blood from your left side causes the check to critically fail automatically.
_desc_ko: 하이에나의 오른쪽 살은 질병을 치유한다고 전해지지만, 왼쪽 살은 치명적이고 독이 있다고 한다. 자신의 오른쪽 피를 누군가에게 먹여 응급처치를 하려면 1 참격의 피해를 입어야 하며, 2d8의 피해를 입으면 @link[actions.treat-disease] 또는 @link[actions.treat-wounds]를 할 수 있다. 두 경우 모두 치료사 도구 세트가 필요하지 않으며, 해당 판정에서 +1 아이템 보너스를 얻는다. 왼쪽 피는 판정을 자동으로 대실패로 만든다.

name: Unified Theory

description.value: You understand the common underpinnings of the four traditions of magic and magical essences, allowing you to understand them all through an arcane lens. Whenever you use a skill action or a skill feat that requires a Nature, Occultism, or Religion check, depending on the magic tradition, you can use Arcana instead. If you would normally take a penalty or have a higher DC for using Arcana on other magic (such as when using Identify Magic), you no longer do so.

_desc_en: You understand the common underpinnings of the four traditions of magic and magical essences, allowing you to understand them all through an arcane lens. Whenever you use a skill action or a skill feat that requires a Nature, Occultism, or Religion check, depending on the magic tradition, you can use Arcana instead. If you would normally take a penalty or have a higher DC for using Arcana on other magic (such as when using Identify Magic), you no longer do so.
_desc_ko: 당신은 네 가지 마법 전통과 마법적 정수의 공통된 기반을 이해하여, 아케인 시각으로 그 모든 것을 파악할 수 있습니다. 자연, 오컬트, 종교 판정 중 마법 전통에 따라 요구되는 기술 행동이나 기술 피트를 사용할 때마다, 대신 주문학 판정 검사를 사용할 수 있습니다. 다른 마법에 주문을 사용할 때(예: 마법 식별 시) 일반적으로 페널티를 받거나 DC가 높아지는 경우, 더 이상 그러지 않습니다.

name: Communal Tale

description.value: Stories are an experience meant to be shared as a group. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.hPZQ5vA9QHEPtjFW]{Spin a Tale}, you can designate up to six non-minion allies as the heroes of your story. Each hero, once during the tale, can continue the story in your stead by spending an action to Spin the Tale; if they do, the story continues for another round, as if you had Spun the Tale at the start of your turn. This could allow the story to continue for up to 6 additional rounds, if all possible allies Spin the Tale, though you can continue to Spin the Tale on your own as normal.

publication.title: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind

_desc_en: Stories are an experience meant to be shared as a group. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.hPZQ5vA9QHEPtjFW]{Spin a Tale}, you can designate up to six non-minion allies as the heroes of your story. Each hero, once during the tale, can continue the story in your stead by spending an action to Spin the Tale; if they do, the story continues for another round, as if you had Spun the Tale at the start of your turn. This could allow the story to continue for up to 6 additional rounds, if all possible allies Spin the Tale, though you can continue to Spin the Tale on your own as normal.
_desc_ko: 이야기는 집단으로 공유하기 위한 경험이다. 당신이 @link[actions.spin-tale]를 할 때, 최대 여섯 명의 비하수인 아군을 이야기의 주인공으로 지정할 수 있다. 각 영웅은 이야기 진행 중 한 번, 행동을 소모하여 이야기를 이어갈 수 있습니다. 이때 이야기는 마치 당신의 턴 시작에 이야기를 이어간 것처럼 한 턴 더 지속됩니다. 모든 가능한 동맹 이 이야기를 이어간다면 최대 6턴까지 이야기가 연장될 수 있으나, 당신은 평소처럼 직접 이야기를 이어갈 수도 있습니다.

name: Mythic Counter

description.value: You can overwhelm the magical designs of others with sheer magic power. When you attempt a counteract check against a spell, you can spend a Mythic Point to attempt the check at mythic proficiency. If the target of the counteract check is within your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XIgvCPaSy5WXStVD]{Spellsurge} aura, critical failures on this check are treated as failures.

_desc_en: You can overwhelm the magical designs of others with sheer magic power. When you attempt a counteract check against a spell, you can spend a Mythic Point to attempt the check at mythic proficiency. If the target of the counteract check is within your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XIgvCPaSy5WXStVD]{Spellsurge} aura, critical failures on this check are treated as failures.
_desc_ko: 순수한 마법력으로 타인의 마법적 설계도를 압도할 수 있습니다. 주문에 대한 반격 판정을 시도할 때, 신화 포인트를 소모하여 신화 숙련도로 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다. 이 반격 판정의 대상이 당신의 @link[spells.spellsurge] 오라 내에 있을 경우, 이 판정에서 대실패는 실패로 간주됩니다.

name: War Rider Stance

description.value: Your dragon's constant breath threatens your foes. While in this stance, your dragon companion has an aura in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5]. Each creature that starts its turn in the aura takes the damage listed under the dragon's support benefit with a basic Reflex save against your mount's Athletics DC.

value.value: dragon companion with a support benefit that includes damage

_desc_en: Your dragon's constant breath threatens your foes. While in this stance, your dragon companion has an aura in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5]. Each creature that starts its turn in the aura takes the damage listed under the dragon's support benefit with a basic Reflex save against your mount's Athletics DC.
_desc_ko: 당신의 용이 끊임없이 내뿜는 숨결이 적을 위협한다. 이 태세에 있는 동안, 당신의 용 동료는 @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] 오라를 갖는다. 오라 안에서 자기 턴을 시작하는 각 생물은 당신의 탈것의 운동 DC에 대한 기본 반사 내성과 함께 용의 지원 이점에 명시된 피해를 입는다.

name: Mug

description.value: You make a quick attack and rob your foe in the process. Make a melee Strike against an adjacent enemy. If you hit and deal sneak attack damage, you can also attempt to [[/act steal]] from the target, even if the target is in combat.

_desc_en: You make a quick attack and rob your foe in the process. Make a melee Strike against an adjacent enemy. If you hit and deal sneak attack damage, you can also attempt to [[/act steal]] from the target, even if the target is in combat.
_desc_ko: 당신은 신속 공격을 하며 동시에 적을 약탈합니다. 인접한 적에게 근접 공격을 시도하세요. 명중하여 암습 피해를 입혔다면, 대상이 전투 중일지라도 @link[actions.steal]을 시도할 수 있습니다.

name: Storm Spiral

description.value:
Dark thunderclouds swirl in a miniature storm, crisscrossed with lightning bolts; a tremendous thunderclap fills the air. The storm appears in a @Template[burst|distance:20] within 60 feet. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -8)/3)+3)d12[electricity],1d10[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage, with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. A creature that fails its save is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} until the end of its next turn (or for 1 minute on a critical failure). A creature wearing metal armor or made of metal takes a -1 circumstance penalty to its save.

Level (+3) The electricity damage increases by 1d12.

_desc_en:
Dark thunderclouds swirl in a miniature storm, crisscrossed with lightning bolts; a tremendous thunderclap fills the air. The storm appears in a @Template[burst|distance:20] within 60 feet. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -8)/3)+3)d12[electricity],1d10[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage, with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. A creature that fails its save is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} until the end of its next turn (or for 1 minute on a critical failure). A creature wearing metal armor or made of metal takes a -1 circumstance penalty to its save.

Level (+3) The electricity damage increases by 1d12.
_desc_ko:
어두운 뇌운이 번개가 교차하는 소형 폭풍 속에서 소용돌이치며, 엄청난 천둥소리가 공기를 가득 채운다. 폭풍은 60피트 이내의 20피트에 나타난다. 해당 영역 내 모든 생물은 전기 음파의 피해를 입으며, 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 기본 반사 내성 굴림을 수행한다. 내성에 실패한 생물은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 (대실패 시 1분 동안) @link[conditions.deafened] 상태가 된다. 금속 갑옷을 착용하거나 금속으로 만들어진 생물은 내성에 -1 상황 페널티를 받는다.

레벨 (+3) 전기 피해가 1d12 증가합니다.

name: Coordinated Tactics

description.value: You and your follower fight in tandem. Whenever you and your active follower are adjacent to the same foe, you are both flanking that foe with each other, regardless of your actual positions.

_desc_en: You and your follower fight in tandem. Whenever you and your active follower are adjacent to the same foe, you are both flanking that foe with each other, regardless of your actual positions.
_desc_ko: 당신과 추종자는 함께 싸운다. 당신과 활성 추종자가 동일한 적과 인접해 있을 때마다, 실제 위치와 상관없이 서로를 통해 그 적을 측면 공격한다.

name: Gravesight

description.value:
You can see in the darkness as easily as a psychopomp. You gain darkvision.

Special You can select this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain into or out of this feat.

_desc_en:
You can see in the darkness as easily as a psychopomp. You gain darkvision.

Special You can select this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain into or out of this feat.
_desc_ko:
당신은 사이코폼프처럼 어둠 속을 쉽게 볼 수 있습니다. 암흑 시야를 얻습니다.

특수 이 피트는 1레벨에서만 선택할 수 있으며, 재훈련으로 획득하거나 포기할 수 없습니다.

name: Become Shadow

description.value: You unleash your mythic power to shroud yourself in darkness and silence to stalk your prey. When you attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}, or when you roll Stealth for initiative, you can spend a Mythic Point to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} and to attempt the check or roll using mythic proficiency.

_desc_en: You unleash your mythic power to shroud yourself in darkness and silence to stalk your prey. When you attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}, or when you roll Stealth for initiative, you can spend a Mythic Point to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} and to attempt the check or roll using mythic proficiency.
_desc_ko: 신화적 힘을 발동하여 어둠과 침묵으로 자신을 감싸고 사냥감을 추적한다. @link[actions.hide] 또는 @link[actions.sneak] 능력 판정을 시도하거나, 혹은 인니셔티브를 위한 은신 능력 판정을 시도하거나, 신화 포인트를 소모하여 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태가 되고 신화 숙련도를 적용하여 해당 판정나 주사위를 굴릴 수 있다.

name: Generation Digger

description.value: You're so adept at burrowing through the earth that you don't even need tools; in fact, you just might be trusted to lead the latest generation dig. You gain a burrow speed of 15 feet.

_desc_en: You're so adept at burrowing through the earth that you don't even need tools; in fact, you just might be trusted to lead the latest generation dig. You gain a burrow speed of 15 feet.
_desc_ko: 당신은 땅속을 파고드는 데 너무 능숙해서 도구가 필요조차 없습니다. 사실, 최신 세대 굴착 작업을 이끌도록 신뢰받을 수도 있습니다. 땅속 이동 속도가 15피트 증가합니다.

name: Area Armor

description.value: The armor you wear protects you and shelters your allies against explosions and other large-scale assaults. While you're wearing medium or heavy armor, allies adjacent to you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves against area effects. If you're a master in the armor, the bonus is +2 instead.

_desc_en: The armor you wear protects you and shelters your allies against explosions and other large-scale assaults. While you're wearing medium or heavy armor, allies adjacent to you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves against area effects. If you're a master in the armor, the bonus is +2 instead.
_desc_ko: 당신이 착용한 갑옷은 폭발 및 기타 대규모 공격으로부터 당신과 아군을 보호합니다. 평갑 또는 중갑을 착용 중일 때, 인접한 아군은 영역 효과에 대한 반사 내성에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 해당 갑옷의 마스터라면 보너스는 +2로 증가합니다.

name: Vampire Lore

description.value:
You were raised by your vampiric parent, or you've invested substantial time and energy researching the secrets of your undead progenitors. You're trained in Religion and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Vampire Lore.

_desc_en:
You were raised by your vampiric parent, or you've invested substantial time and energy researching the secrets of your undead progenitors. You're trained in Religion and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Vampire Lore.
_desc_ko:
당신은 뱀파이어 부모에게 길러졌거나, 언데드 조상들의 비밀을 연구하는 데 상당한 시간과 에너지를 투자했습니다. 당신은 종교와 사회에 숙련되어 있습니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 자동으로 그 중 하나의 기술에 숙련되게 된다면, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다.

또한 뱀파이어 지식에 대한 @link[feats.additional-lore] 일반 피트를 획득한다.

name: Verduran Shadow Dedication

description.value:
Your awareness of primal energies allows you to explore forests with preternatural ease. You become an expert in Survival. You can substitute your proficiency in Survival for your proficiency in Stealth when meeting feat prerequisites and gaining additional benefits from feats for being an expert, master, or legendary in Stealth; however, unless you also fulfill the Stealth prerequisite, you can only use those feats in forest terrain. While in forests, you can use your Survival modifier in place of your Stealth modifier when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}, or would use Stealth to roll initiative.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.ANj1KgIvIvNDmBSR]{Verduran Shadow}

_desc_en:
Your awareness of primal energies allows you to explore forests with preternatural ease. You become an expert in Survival. You can substitute your proficiency in Survival for your proficiency in Stealth when meeting feat prerequisites and gaining additional benefits from feats for being an expert, master, or legendary in Stealth; however, unless you also fulfill the Stealth prerequisite, you can only use those feats in forest terrain. While in forests, you can use your Survival modifier in place of your Stealth modifier when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}, or would use Stealth to roll initiative.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.ANj1KgIvIvNDmBSR]{Verduran Shadow}
_desc_ko: 프라이멀 에너지에 대한 당신의 인식은 초자연적인 용이함으로 숲을 탐험할 수 있게 합니다. 당신은 생존 기술의 전문가가 됩니다. 재주 피트 전제 조건을 충족하거나 은신 재주에서 전문가, 달인, 전설 등급으로 추가 혜택을 얻을 때 생존 숙련도를 은신 숙련도로 대체할 수 있습니다. 단, 은신 전제 조건도 충족하지 않는 한 해당 재주는 숲 지형에서만 사용할 수 있습니다. 숲에 있을 때, @link[actions.avoid-notice], @link[actions.hide], @link[actions.sneak]를 수행하거나, 이니셔티브 굴림에 은신 능력을 사용할 때 생존 수정자를 은신 수정자 대신 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Vicious Evisceration

description.value: You make a vicious strike that maims your enemy. Make a melee Strike. If the Strike hits and deals damage, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} on a critical success.

_desc_en: You make a vicious strike that maims your enemy. Make a melee Strike. If the Strike hits and deals damage, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} on a critical success.
_desc_ko: 당신은 적을 불구로 만드는 잔혹한 일격을 가합니다. 근접 공격을 시도하세요. 공격이 명중하여 피해를 입히면, 대상은 @link[conditions.drained]{1}, 또는 @link[conditions.drained]{2} 대성공 상태가 됩니다.

name: Genie Weapon Expertise

description.value: Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in certain weapons, you also gain that proficiency in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.XGtIUZ4ZNKuFx1uL]{Falchions}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.UfurZQK6H6SgOjqe]{Ranseurs}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.grmaV4GdoGD7sKbn]{Scimitars}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.FJrsDoaIXksVjld9]{Tridents}, and all geniekin weapons in which you are trained.

_desc_en: Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in certain weapons, you also gain that proficiency in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.XGtIUZ4ZNKuFx1uL]{Falchions}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.UfurZQK6H6SgOjqe]{Ranseurs}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.grmaV4GdoGD7sKbn]{Scimitars}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.FJrsDoaIXksVjld9]{Tridents}, and all geniekin weapons in which you are trained.
_desc_ko: 특정 무기에 대한 숙련도 전문가 이상을 부여하는 클래스 특성을 획득할 때마다, @link[equipment.falchion], @link[equipment.ranseur], @link[equipment.scimitar], @link[equipment.trident], 그리고 훈련받은 모든 지니킨 무기에 대한 숙련도를 획득한다.

name: Canny Acumen

description.value: Your avoidance or observation is beyond the ken of most in your profession. Choose Fortitude saves, Reflex saves, Will saves, or Perception. You become an expert in your choice. At 17th level, you become a master in your choice.

_desc_en: Your avoidance or observation is beyond the ken of most in your profession. Choose Fortitude saves, Reflex saves, Will saves, or Perception. You become an expert in your choice. At 17th level, you become a master in your choice.
_desc_ko: 당신의 회피나 관찰 능력은 동업자 대부분이 이해할 수 없는 수준입니다. 인내 내성, 반사 내성, 의지 내성 또는 지각 중 하나를 선택하세요. 선택한 분야에서 전문가가 됩니다. 17레벨에 도달하면 선택한 분야에서 달인이 됩니다.

name: Butterfly's Sting

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.j1JE61quDxdge4mg]{Sneak Attack} class feature. You don't increase the number of dice as you gain levels.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.j1JE61quDxdge4mg]{Sneak Attack} class feature. You don't increase the number of dice as you gain levels.
_desc_ko: @link[feats.sneak-attack] 클래스 특성을 얻습니다. 레벨이 올라가도 주사위 개수는 증가하지 않습니다.

name: Moldersoul

description.value: Your connection to elemental wood asserts itself in the form of decay, like forgotten logs left to rot and the char that remains after a forest fire, cycles of devastation clearing away what was to make room for the next generation of life. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Qj36ramjkoKE8kzJ]{Decompose} action.

_desc_en: Your connection to elemental wood asserts itself in the form of decay, like forgotten logs left to rot and the char that remains after a forest fire, cycles of devastation clearing away what was to make room for the next generation of life. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Qj36ramjkoKE8kzJ]{Decompose} action.
_desc_ko: 당신의 원소 목재와의 연결은 부패의 형태로 드러납니다. 마치 잊혀진 통나무가 썩어가는 모습이나 산불 후 남은 그을음처럼, 파괴의 순환은 다음 세대의 생명을 위한 공간을 마련하기 위해 존재했던 것들을 쓸어냅니다. 당신은 @link[actions.decompose] 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Leshy Lore

description.value:
You deeply understand your people's cultural traditions and innate strengths. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Nature and Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Leshy Lore.

_desc_en:
You deeply understand your people's cultural traditions and innate strengths. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Nature and Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Leshy Lore.
_desc_ko:
당신은 자신의 민족이 지닌 문화적 전통과 타고난 강점을 깊이 이해합니다. 자연과 은신 기술에 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 해당 기술 중 하나에 자동으로 숙련 상태가 된다면, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련 상태가 됩니다.

또한 레시 지식에 대한 @link[feats.additional-lore] 일반 피트를 획득합니다.

name: Immediate Rebuke

description.value: You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KAVf7AmRnbCAHrkT]{Reactive Strike} when a creature within your reach Strikes one of your allies.

_desc_en: You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KAVf7AmRnbCAHrkT]{Reactive Strike} when a creature within your reach Strikes one of your allies.
_desc_ko: 당신의 도달 범위 내 생물이 당신의 아군 중 한 명을 공격할 때 @link[actions.reactive-strike]을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Explosive Entry

description.value: You know exactly how to make a memorable entrance... by detonating a bomb to produce a devastating explosion, of course! You Set Explosives on a door, window, container, or heavy gate. When the explosives detonate, you can attempt an Engineering Lore check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} the target. If a bomb would add an item bonus to attack rolls, add that item bonus to your Engineering Lore check. Since you're blasting your way in, you can't avoid breaking the object or structure. If you roll a critical success, you get a success instead.

_desc_en: You know exactly how to make a memorable entrance... by detonating a bomb to produce a devastating explosion, of course! You Set Explosives on a door, window, container, or heavy gate. When the explosives detonate, you can attempt an Engineering Lore check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} the target. If a bomb would add an item bonus to attack rolls, add that item bonus to your Engineering Lore check. Since you're blasting your way in, you can't avoid breaking the object or structure. If you roll a critical success, you get a success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 확실히 기억에 남는 입성법을 알고 있습니다... 물론 폭탄을 터뜨려 파괴적인 폭발을 일으키는 거죠! 문, 창문, 컨테이너 또는 무거운 문에 폭발물을 설치합니다. 폭발물이 터질 때, 공학 지식 체킹을 시도하여 @link[actions.force-open] 대상. 폭탄이 명중 굴림에 아이템 보너스를 부여한다면, 해당 보너스를 공학 지식 판정에도 적용한다. 폭파로 진입하는 만큼, 물체나 구조물을 파괴하는 것은 피할 수 없다. 대성공을 굴리면 대신 성공을 얻는다.

name: Quick Stow (Swordmaster)

description.value: You know that situations can change rapidly and might leave you needing to change equipment in the middle of combat. Your training has taught you how to swap your equipment on the fly. You Interact to stow a weapon and then Interact again to draw a readied item or weapon.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en: You know that situations can change rapidly and might leave you needing to change equipment in the middle of combat. Your training has taught you how to swap your equipment on the fly. You Interact to stow a weapon and then Interact again to draw a readied item or weapon.
_desc_ko: 상황이 급변하여 전투 중 장비를 교체해야 할 수도 있음을 알고 있습니다. 훈련을 통해 즉석에서 장비를 교체하는 법을 익혔습니다. 상호작용하여 무기를 보관한 후, 다시 상호작용하여 준비된 아이템이나 무기를 꺼냅니다.

name: Master Witch Spellcasting

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#master-spellcasting-feat]{Master Spellcasting Feat} benefits.

value.value: legendary in the skill associated with your patron's tradition

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#master-spellcasting-feat]{Master Spellcasting Feat} benefits.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#master-spellcasting-feat]{달인 주문 시전 피트}의 혜택을 얻습니다.

name: Pirate Combat Training

description.value:
You're particularly skilled at wielding the weapons used traditionally by pirates. You gain either the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.09PurtIanNUPfNRq]{Combat Climber} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.iOY6YfGBaOvMNAor]{Underwater Marauder} skill feat, even if you do not meet its prerequisites. You have familiarity with the following weapons: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.LGgvev6AV0So8tP9]{Hatchet}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.tH5GirEy7YB3ZgCk]{Rapier}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.grmaV4GdoGD7sKbn]{Scimitar}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.f1gwoTkf3Nn0v3PN]{Whip}—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these weapons as simple weapons. Your GM may add additional martial weapons to this list as appropriate for your world or region.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

_desc_en:
You're particularly skilled at wielding the weapons used traditionally by pirates. You gain either the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.09PurtIanNUPfNRq]{Combat Climber} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.iOY6YfGBaOvMNAor]{Underwater Marauder} skill feat, even if you do not meet its prerequisites. You have familiarity with the following weapons: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.LGgvev6AV0So8tP9]{Hatchet}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.tH5GirEy7YB3ZgCk]{Rapier}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.grmaV4GdoGD7sKbn]{Scimitar}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.f1gwoTkf3Nn0v3PN]{Whip}—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these weapons as simple weapons. Your GM may add additional martial weapons to this list as appropriate for your world or region.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
_desc_ko:
당신은 해적들이 전통적으로 사용해 온 무기를 다루는 데 특히 능숙합니다. 당신은 @link[feats.combat-climber] 또는 @link[feats.underwater-marauder] 피트를 전제 조건을 충족하지 않더라도 획득합니다. 다음 무기들에 패밀리어입니다: @link[equipment.hatchet], @link[equipment.rapier], @link[equipment.scimitar], @link[equipment.whip]-숙련도 목적상 이 무기들은 단순 무기로 간주됩니다. 당신의 GM은 해당 세계관이나 지역에 맞게 이 목록에 추가 무기를 포함시킬 수 있습니다.

5레벨에 도달하면, 이 무기들로 치명타를 성공시킬 때마다 해당 무기의 치명타 특화 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Quicken Heartbeat

description.value:
Frequency once per turn

You've replaced your heart with one made of animated quicksilver and living adamantine. You reduce your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} condition by 1. Alternatively, if you are not slowed, you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} during your next turn, and can use your extra action to Stride or Strike.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per turn

You've replaced your heart with one made of animated quicksilver and living adamantine. You reduce your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} condition by 1. Alternatively, if you are not slowed, you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} during your next turn, and can use your extra action to Stride or Strike.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 턴당 1회

당신은 심장을 움직이는 수은과 살아있는 아다만틴으로 만들어진 심장으로 교체했습니다. @link[conditions.slowed] 상태를 1 감소시킨다. 또는 속도가 저하되지 않은 상태라면, 다음 턴 동안 @link[conditions.quickened]{1} 상태가 되어 추가 행동으로 '이동' 또는 '강타'를 사용할 수 있다.

name: Swordlord Exile

description.value:
You are a swordlord exile. You have abandoned or been abandoned by the Aldori Academy. Aldori swordlords are honor-bound to challenge you on sight. Additionally, your unbridled skill strikes terror in those around you. You can use Dueling Lore instead of Intimidation to [[/act coerce skill=dueling-lore]]{Coerce} and [[/act demoralize skill=dueling-lore]]{Demoralize} while your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.iSceAVMkVv1uKK7t]{Aldori Dueling Sword} is visible to the target of your attempt.

With broken pride, your blade is now a disgraced tool used to remove obstacles between you and your goals, whatever they may be. The first time you hit a creature with an Aldori dueling sword each round, you deal 5 additional precision damage.

Special You can't take both this feat and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BEgz2GnG2MKmmaZX]{Aldori Swordlord}.

value.value: you have broken or forsaken the Aldori swordpact

_desc_en:
You are a swordlord exile. You have abandoned or been abandoned by the Aldori Academy. Aldori swordlords are honor-bound to challenge you on sight. Additionally, your unbridled skill strikes terror in those around you. You can use Dueling Lore instead of Intimidation to [[/act coerce skill=dueling-lore]]{Coerce} and [[/act demoralize skill=dueling-lore]]{Demoralize} while your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.iSceAVMkVv1uKK7t]{Aldori Dueling Sword} is visible to the target of your attempt.

With broken pride, your blade is now a disgraced tool used to remove obstacles between you and your goals, whatever they may be. The first time you hit a creature with an Aldori dueling sword each round, you deal 5 additional precision damage.

Special You can't take both this feat and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BEgz2GnG2MKmmaZX]{Aldori Swordlord}.
_desc_ko:
당신은 추방된 검의 군주입니다. 알도리 아카데미를 떠났거나, 아카데미에 의해 버림받았습니다. 알도리 검의 군주들은 명예를 걸고 당신을 보자마자 결투를 신청할 의무가 있습니다. 또한, 당신의 억제되지 않은 실력은 주변 사람들에게 강타를 날립니다. 당신의 @link[equipment.aldori-dueling-sword]이 대상에게 노출된 상태에서, 협박 대신 결투 지식을 사용하여 강요와 사기 저하를 시도할 수 있습니다.

부서진 자존심과 함께, 당신의 검은 이제 목표를 향해 가로막는 장애물을 제거하는 수치스러운 도구가 되었다. 매 라운드 알도리 결투검으로 생물을 처음 공격할 때, 추가 정밀 피해 5를 입힌다.

특수 이 피트와 @link[feats.aldori-swordlord]를 동시에 선택할 수 없다.

name: Instrument of Slaughter

description.value: Your blessed armament thirsts for the blood of your foes. Whenever you critically hit an enemy with a Strike that has the extra damage from your champion's reaction, the target also takes persistent bleed damage equal to two of the weapon's damage dice.

value.value: champion's reaction that grants extra damage with your Strikes (including the desecration, iniquity, and obedience causes)

_desc_en: Your blessed armament thirsts for the blood of your foes. Whenever you critically hit an enemy with a Strike that has the extra damage from your champion's reaction, the target also takes persistent bleed damage equal to two of the weapon's damage dice.
_desc_ko: 당신의 축복받은 무기는 적의 피를 갈망합니다. 챔피언의 ' ' 반응으로 추가 피해를 입히는 공격으로 적에게 치명타를 입힐 때마다, 대상은 무기의 피해 주사위 2개에 해당하는 지속적인 출혈 피해를 추가로 받습니다.

name: Group Taunt

description.value: Your taunts draw the attention of multiple enemies at once. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.4DYFJ4TUsNkgFBDb]{Taunt}, you can choose up to three targets within range, and you can have up to three taunted enemies at a time. Each time you Taunt, you can choose which enemies remain taunted and which the effect ends for. You must remain at or below this limit.

_desc_en: Your taunts draw the attention of multiple enemies at once. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.4DYFJ4TUsNkgFBDb]{Taunt}, you can choose up to three targets within range, and you can have up to three taunted enemies at a time. Each time you Taunt, you can choose which enemies remain taunted and which the effect ends for. You must remain at or below this limit.
_desc_ko: 당신의 도발은 한 번에 여러 적의 주의를 끕니다. @link[actions.taunt]을 사용할 때, 범위 내 최대 세 명의 대상을 선택할 수 있으며, 동시에 최대 세 명의 적을 도발 상태로 유지할 수 있습니다. 도발할 때마다 도발 상태를 유지할 적과 효과가 종료될 적을 선택할 수 있습니다. 이 한도를 초과하지 않아야 합니다.

name: Planar Traveler

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger Your turn begins.

You concentrate on the spaces between planes, allowing you to enhance your movement for a short period. Your Strides become augmented until the end of your turn, allowing you to instantly teleport to any point you could reach with your Speed instead of traversing normally to the location. While augmented, your Strides gain the teleportation trait. Your augmented Strides don't trigger reactions that can be triggered by move actions or upon leaving or entering a square, unless those reactions are specifically triggered by teleportation.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger Your turn begins.

You concentrate on the spaces between planes, allowing you to enhance your movement for a short period. Your Strides become augmented until the end of your turn, allowing you to instantly teleport to any point you could reach with your Speed instead of traversing normally to the location. While augmented, your Strides gain the teleportation trait. Your augmented Strides don't trigger reactions that can be triggered by move actions or upon leaving or entering a square, unless those reactions are specifically triggered by teleportation.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

발동 조건 당신의 턴이 시작됩니다.

당신은 평면 사이의 공간에 집중하여 짧은 시간 동안 이동 속도를 향상시킵니다. 턴이 끝날 때까지 당신의 '이동'이 강화되어, 속도로 도달 가능한 지점이라면 정상적으로 이동하지 않고도 즉시 순간이동할 수 있습니다. 강화된 동안 '이동'은 순간이동 특성을 얻습니다. 강화된 '이동'은 이동 행동이나 칸을 떠나거나 들어갈 때 발동되는 반응을 유발하지 않습니다. 단, 해당 반응이 순간이동에 의해 특별히 발동되는 경우는 예외입니다.

name: Wake to Strife

description.value:
Requirements A creature within your reach is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} or swimming.

You summon the explosive power of a geyser beneath a foe. The required creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class] save against your class DC as elemental water confounds their senses; if the creature is prone, they can Stand as a free action.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}. If you have a free hand and they are not larger than you, you can attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} them as a free action.

Critical Failure As failure, but if you succeed at the Athletics check to Grapple them, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en:
Requirements A creature within your reach is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} or swimming.

You summon the explosive power of a geyser beneath a foe. The required creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class] save against your class DC as elemental water confounds their senses; if the creature is prone, they can Stand as a free action.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}. If you have a free hand and they are not larger than you, you can attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} them as a free action.

Critical Failure As failure, but if you succeed at the Athletics check to Grapple them, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신의 손이 닿는 범위 내의 생물이 @link[conditions.prone]이거나 수영 중이어야 합니다.

당신은 적 아래에서 간헐천의 폭발적인 힘을 소환합니다. 필요한 생물은 원소수(水)가 감각을 혼란스럽게 하여 네 클래스 DC에 대한 인내 내성을 시도해야 한다. 생물이 넘어짐 상태라면, 무료 행동으로 일어서할 수 있다.

대성공 대상은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 대상은 @link[conditions.sickened]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

실패 대상은 @link[conditions.sickened]{2} 상태가 됩니다. 빈 손이 있고 상대가 당신보다 크지 않다면, 자유 행동으로 운동 판정을 시도하여 @link[actions.grapple]할 수 있습니다.

대실패 실패와 동일하나, 그들을 붙잡기 위한 운동 판정에서 성공하면 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Shining Arms

description.value: When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light}, you can modify its target to be 1 melee weapon, either unattended or possessed by you or a willing ally, and modify its duration to be 1 minute. If you do, add the following to its effects: When a creature wielding the weapon critically hits a foe, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AjLSHZSWQ90exdLo]{Dismiss} the Spell as a reaction, causing the foe to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round. After you use this reaction, you can't use this modification again for 10 minutes.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en: When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light}, you can modify its target to be 1 melee weapon, either unattended or possessed by you or a willing ally, and modify its duration to be 1 minute. If you do, add the following to its effects: When a creature wielding the weapon critically hits a foe, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AjLSHZSWQ90exdLo]{Dismiss} the Spell as a reaction, causing the foe to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round. After you use this reaction, you can't use this modification again for 10 minutes.
_desc_ko: {빛} 주문을 시전할 때, 대상이 방치된 상태이거나 당신 또는 동의한 아군이 소유한 근접 무기 1개로 수정자하여 지속 시간을 1분으로 수정할 수 있습니다. 그렇게 할 경우, 다음 효과를 추가합니다: 해당 무기를 휘두르는 생물이 적에게 치명타를 입힐 때, 당신은 반응으로 @link[actions.dismiss]하여 적을 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.dazzled] 상태로 만들 수 있다. 이 반응을 사용한 후 10분 동안은 이 수정을 다시 사용할 수 없다.

name: Rock Rampart

description.value:
Drawing on your connection to the Plane of Earth, you form a wall of rock and earth. This has the effect of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kOa055FIrO9Smnya]{Wall of Stone}, but the wall's maximum length is 40 feet. The wall lasts until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it up to 1 minute.

Level (+4) The maximum length of the wall increases by 10 feet, and the Hit Points of each section increase by 5.

_desc_en:
Drawing on your connection to the Plane of Earth, you form a wall of rock and earth. This has the effect of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kOa055FIrO9Smnya]{Wall of Stone}, but the wall's maximum length is 40 feet. The wall lasts until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it up to 1 minute.

Level (+4) The maximum length of the wall increases by 10 feet, and the Hit Points of each section increase by 5.
_desc_ko:
대지의 차원계와의 연결을 끌어내어 바위와 흙으로 된 벽을 형성한다. 이 효과는 @link[spells.wall-of-stone]과 동일하나, 벽의 최대 길이는 40피트이다. 벽은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 지속되지만, 최대 1분 동안 유지할 수 있다.

레벨 (+4) 벽의 최대 길이가 10피트 증가하고, 각 구간의 HP가 5씩 증가한다.

name: Invoke Defense

description.value:
Requirements You're under the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.djULKW76BbSoN3zb]{Enter Spirit Trance}.

You manifest a defensive quality of spirits all around, such as the thick hide of an animal spirit or the sturdy bark of a nature spirit. Choose bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing. You gain resistance equal to half your level to that damage type for the duration of your spirit trance.

If you use Invoke Defense again, you can choose a different type of damage, but you lose the previous resistance.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're under the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.djULKW76BbSoN3zb]{Enter Spirit Trance}.

You manifest a defensive quality of spirits all around, such as the thick hide of an animal spirit or the sturdy bark of a nature spirit. Choose bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing. You gain resistance equal to half your level to that damage type for the duration of your spirit trance.

If you use Invoke Defense again, you can choose a different type of damage, but you lose the previous resistance.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 @link[actions.enter-spirit-trance]의 효과 아래에 있습니다.

주변에 동물 정령의 두꺼운 가죽이나 자연 정령의 튼튼한 나무껍질 같은 방어적인 영혼의 특성이 창조됩니다. 타격, 관통, 베기 중 하나를 선택하세요. 영혼의 트랜스 지속 시간 동안 해당 피해 유형에 대해 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 저항력을 얻습니다.

방어 호출을 다시 사용할 경우 다른 피해 유형을 선택할 수 있으나, 이전 저항력은 상실됩니다.

name: Assassin Dedication

description.value:
You've trained to assassinate your foes, and you do so with tenacity and precision. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.orjJjLdm4XNAcFi8]{Mark for Death} activity.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.0e2o62hyCxbIkVoC]{Assassin}

_desc_en:
You've trained to assassinate your foes, and you do so with tenacity and precision. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.orjJjLdm4XNAcFi8]{Mark for Death} activity.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.0e2o62hyCxbIkVoC]{Assassin}
_desc_ko: 적들을 암살하기 위해 훈련했으며, 집요함과 정밀함으로 이를 실행한다. @link[actions.mark-for-death] 활동을 얻는다.

name: Oni Form

description.value:
Your horns flash briefly as you grow in size and ferocity. Your size increases to Large, and you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}. This doesn't change your Speed, reach, or other statistics except as noted here. Your worn equipment automatically resizes to suit your new form, though it immediately returns to its original size if it leaves your possession.

This form is the same age and body type as your true form and has roughly analogous physical traits, such as hair color. Using Oni Form counts as creating a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} use of Deception.

You can Sustain your Oni Form for up to 10 minutes, though you must then spend at least 10 minutes in your natural form before using Oni Form again.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Your horns flash briefly as you grow in size and ferocity. Your size increases to Large, and you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}. This doesn't change your Speed, reach, or other statistics except as noted here. Your worn equipment automatically resizes to suit your new form, though it immediately returns to its original size if it leaves your possession.

This form is the same age and body type as your true form and has roughly analogous physical traits, such as hair color. Using Oni Form counts as creating a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} use of Deception.

You can Sustain your Oni Form for up to 10 minutes, though you must then spend at least 10 minutes in your natural form before using Oni Form again.
_desc_ko:
뿔이 번쩍이며 몸집과 사나움이 커진다. 크기가 대형으로 증가하며 @link[conditions.clumsy]{1} 상태가 된다. 여기 명시된 경우를 제외하고 이동 속도, 공격 범위, 기타 능력치는 변하지 않는다. 착용 중인 장비는 새로운 형태에 맞게 자동으로 크기가 조정되나, 소유에서 벗어나면 즉시 원래 크기로 돌아간다.

이 형태는 본래 모습과 동일한 나이와 체형을 가지며, 머리 색깔 등 대략적으로 유사한 신체적 특징을 지닙니다. 오니 형태 사용은 @link[actions.impersonate] 기만 사용 시 변장 생성으로 간주됩니다.

오니 형태는 최대 10분간 유지할 수 있으나, 이후 다시 오니 형태를 사용하려면 최소 10분간 본래 형태로 있어야 합니다.

name: Plague Sniffer

description.value: You can sniff out the pungent tang of disease. When you detect a creature by scent, you can also detect if that creature is suffering from a disease at a non-carrier state. If the disease is particularly subtle, you might need to attempt a Perception check against the disease's DC (subject to the GM's discretion).

_desc_en: You can sniff out the pungent tang of disease. When you detect a creature by scent, you can also detect if that creature is suffering from a disease at a non-carrier state. If the disease is particularly subtle, you might need to attempt a Perception check against the disease's DC (subject to the GM's discretion).
_desc_ko: 질병의 매운 냄새를 맡아낼 수 있습니다. 냄새로 생물을 감지할 때, 해당 생물이 비보균 상태의 질병에 걸렸는지 여부도 감지할 수 있습니다. 질병이 특히 미묘한 경우, 질병의 DC(GM의 재량에 따름)에 대한 지각 판정 시도를 해야 할 수도 있습니다.

name: Leverage Connections

description.value: You know the right people who can get things done for you in certain circles. Once per week, when you're in an area that has an established group of influential nobles, mercantile elites, or the like (if you have Courtly Graces), or a network of unsavory characters such as a thieves' guild (if you have Streetwise), you can use Society to Request a favor or aid from those people as if they were friendly to you. Your request must make sense for the type of people you contact. For instance, a member of the royal court could secure you a proper invitation to a fancy ball, while a local burglar could point out a way to stealthily infiltrate that same party. If you critically succeed this check, your connection gives a piece of helpful advice or lets you in on a small secret, granting you or a member of your party a +2 circumstance bonus to the first skill check you attempt when acting on the favor. If you critically fail this check, you might have to perform some service for your connection to get back in their good graces, as determined by the GM.

_desc_en: You know the right people who can get things done for you in certain circles. Once per week, when you're in an area that has an established group of influential nobles, mercantile elites, or the like (if you have Courtly Graces), or a network of unsavory characters such as a thieves' guild (if you have Streetwise), you can use Society to Request a favor or aid from those people as if they were friendly to you. Your request must make sense for the type of people you contact. For instance, a member of the royal court could secure you a proper invitation to a fancy ball, while a local burglar could point out a way to stealthily infiltrate that same party. If you critically succeed this check, your connection gives a piece of helpful advice or lets you in on a small secret, granting you or a member of your party a +2 circumstance bonus to the first skill check you attempt when acting on the favor. If you critically fail this check, you might have to perform some service for your connection to get back in their good graces, as determined by the GM.
_desc_ko: 특정 계층에서 일을 처리해 줄 적임자를 알고 있습니다. 주당 한 번, 영향력 있는 귀족 집단, 상인 엘리트 등이 정착한 지역(궁정 예절 숙련 시) 또는 도적 길드 같은 불량배 네트워크(거리 수완 숙련 시)에 있을 때, 사회 기술을 사용해 그들에게 호의나 도움을 요청할 수 있습니다. 마치 그들이 당신에게 우호적인 것처럼요. 요청은 접촉 대상의 성격에 맞아야 합니다. 예를 들어, 왕실 구성원은 고급 무도회 정식 초대장을 확보해 줄 수 있고, 지역 도둑은 같은 파티에 은밀히 잠입하는 방법을 알려줄 수 있습니다. 이 판정에서 대성공 시, 인맥이 유용한 조언을 해주거나 작은 비밀을 알려주어, 그 호의를 실행할 때 시도하는 첫 번째 기술 판정을 하는 당신이나 파티원에게 +2 상황 보너스를 부여합니다. 이 판정에서 대실패 시, GM의 판단에 따라 인맥의 호의를 되찾기 위해 그들에게 어떤 서비스를 제공해야 할 수도 있습니다.

name: Terrifying Resistance

description.value: The spells of those you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} are less effective on you. If you succeed in Demoralizing a creature, for the next 24 hours you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against that creature's spells.

_desc_en: The spells of those you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} are less effective on you. If you succeed in Demoralizing a creature, for the next 24 hours you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against that creature's spells.
_desc_ko: 당신이 @link[actions.demoralize] 상태에 있는 대상의 주문은 당신에게 덜 효과적입니다. 생물을 사기 저하시키는 데 성공하면, 이후 24시간 동안 해당 생물의 주문에 대한 내성 굴림에서 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Order Cross-Training

description.value:
You gain the lesser order benefit of a Hellknight order other than the one to which you belong. This represents your time spent training with members of that order to learn their techniques and teachings. If you aren't in good standing with a given order, you can't receive their training.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, gaining the lesser order benefit from a different order each time by training with members of that order.

_desc_en:
You gain the lesser order benefit of a Hellknight order other than the one to which you belong. This represents your time spent training with members of that order to learn their techniques and teachings. If you aren't in good standing with a given order, you can't receive their training.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, gaining the lesser order benefit from a different order each time by training with members of that order.
_desc_ko:
당신은 자신이 속한 기사단 외의 다른 헬나이트 기사단의 하급 기사단 이점을 얻는다. 이는 해당 기사단의 구성원들과 함께 훈련하며 그들의 기술과 가르침을 익히는 데 보낸 시간을 나타낸다. 특정 기사단과 좋은 관계에 있지 않다면, 그들의 훈련을 받을 수 없다.

특수 이 재주는 여러 번 선택할 수 있으며, 매번 다른 기사단의 구성원들과 훈련하여 각각 다른 기사단의 하급 기사단 이점을 얻는다.

name: Absorb Strength

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements You are adjacent to an enemy's corpse who has been dead for no longer than 1 minute.

You consume a piece of your enemy, absorbing their strength. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to the enemy's level that last for 1 minute.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements You are adjacent to an enemy's corpse who has been dead for no longer than 1 minute.

You consume a piece of your enemy, absorbing their strength. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to the enemy's level that last for 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 시간당 1회

요구 사항 적의 시체와 인접해 있으며, 해당 시체가 사망한 지 1분을 넘지 않아야 합니다.

적의 일부를 섭취하여 그 힘을 흡수합니다. 적의 레벨에 해당하는 임시 HP를 1분 동안 얻습니다.

name: Expanded Elemental Magic

description.value: You reach new understandings of the elements, taking an expansive view. Add to your elemental philosophy any of the following elements it doesn't already include: air, earth, fire, metal, water, and wood.

_desc_en: You reach new understandings of the elements, taking an expansive view. Add to your elemental philosophy any of the following elements it doesn't already include: air, earth, fire, metal, water, and wood.
_desc_ko: 원소에 대한 새로운 이해에 도달하여 확장된 시각을 얻습니다. 기존에 포함되지 않은 다음 원소 중 하나를 원소 철학에 추가하십시오: 공기, 땅, 불, 금속, 물, 나무.

name: Imperious Aura

description.value:
Trigger Your turn begins.

Your glowing and majestic kinetic aura marks you as a true child of the elements. Use a stance impulse that affects your kinetic aura.

value.value: one or more stance impulses that affect your kinetic aura

_desc_en:
Trigger Your turn begins.

Your glowing and majestic kinetic aura marks you as a true child of the elements. Use a stance impulse that affects your kinetic aura.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신의 턴이 시작됩니다.

당신의 빛나고 위엄 있는 키네틱 오라가 당신을 진정한 원소의 자식으로 증명합니다. 당신의 키네틱 오라에 영향을 미치는 자세 임펄스를 사용하십시오.

name: Whirlwind Spell

description.value:
Requirements Your Spellstrike is charged.

You combine the might of a multitarget spell with a whirling flurry of attacks. You use Spellstrike, making a melee Strike against each enemy within your reach instead of against one enemy. If your spell can affect multiple targets, your spell affects all foes you hit, not just the first target, up to the spell's normal maximum targets. If you Strike more foes than the spell could target, choose which foes are affected by the spell. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty but doesn't increase your penalty until you've made all your attacks.

If you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.84n92oBsRVCxjifM]{Expansive Spellstrike} to Spellstrike with an area spell, apply the area as described in Expansive Spellstrike, choosing one of the creatures you Strike to determine the area and whether the spell fails due to a critically failed Strike. If you use Expansive Spellstrike to Spellstrike with a targeted spell, each creature you critically fail to Strike is unaffected by the spell, but the spell isn't lost completely from a single critical failure.

You can use this activity with only melee Strikes, even if you have the starlit span hybrid study or a similar ability.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your Spellstrike is charged.

You combine the might of a multitarget spell with a whirling flurry of attacks. You use Spellstrike, making a melee Strike against each enemy within your reach instead of against one enemy. If your spell can affect multiple targets, your spell affects all foes you hit, not just the first target, up to the spell's normal maximum targets. If you Strike more foes than the spell could target, choose which foes are affected by the spell. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty but doesn't increase your penalty until you've made all your attacks.

If you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.84n92oBsRVCxjifM]{Expansive Spellstrike} to Spellstrike with an area spell, apply the area as described in Expansive Spellstrike, choosing one of the creatures you Strike to determine the area and whether the spell fails due to a critically failed Strike. If you use Expansive Spellstrike to Spellstrike with a targeted spell, each creature you critically fail to Strike is unaffected by the spell, but the spell isn't lost completely from a single critical failure.

You can use this activity with only melee Strikes, even if you have the starlit span hybrid study or a similar ability.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신의 스펠스트라이크가 충전되어 있어야 합니다.

여러 목표를 겨냥하는 마법의 위력과 회오리치는 공격을 결합합니다. 스펠스트라이크를 사용해 한 명의 적이 아닌, 손이 닿는 범위 내의 모든 적에게 근접 공격을 가합니다. 해당 마법이 다중 목표에 영향을 줄 수 있다면, 첫 번째 목표뿐만 아니라 명중한 모든 적에게 마법이 적용되며, 이는 마법의 정상적인 최대 목표 수까지 적용됩니다. 주문이 타겟팅할 수 있는 수보다 더 많은 적을 공격한 경우, 주문이 영향을 미치는 적을 선택한다. 각 공격은 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되지만, 모든 공격을 완료하기 전까지는 페널티가 증가하지 않는다.

{확장 스펠스트라이크}을 사용하여 영역 스펠스트라이크를 할 경우, 확장 스펠스트라이크에 설명된 대로 영역을 적용합니다. 이때 강타한 생물 중 하나를 선택하여 마법 타격의 영역을 결정하고, 대실패로 인해 마법이 실패하는지 여부를 판단합니다. 확장된 스펠스트라이크를 사용하여 표적 스펠스트라이크를 할 경우, 대실패한 각 생물은 해당 스펠스트라이크의 영향을 받지 않지만, 단일 대실패로 인해 스펠스트라이크가 완전히 소멸되지는 않는다.

별빛 스팬 하이브리드 스터디나 유사한 능력을 보유한 경우에도, 이 액티비티는 근접 공격만으로 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Artokus's Fire

description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger You use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.NlEZ0piDxg9buXCL]{Advanced Alchemy} to craft an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.yd3kEK21YknZLlcT]{Alchemist's Fire}, and that bomb's level is at least 2 levels lower than your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Pe0zmIqyTBc2Td0I]{Advanced Alchemy} level.

Artokus developed a mixture of volatile materials that burns hotter and longer than typical alchemist's fire. You include this additive mixture when crafting your alchemist's fire.

The alchemist's fire deals @Damage[1d4[persistent,fire]] damage in addition to what the alchemist fire would normally cause (for instance, a moderate alchemist's fire deals 1d4+2 persistent fire damage).

A creature taking persistent fire damage from the alchemist's fire requires two successful flat checks to end the persistent damage, or one check if the creature had an assisted recovery that reduces the flat check to DC 10.

The enhanced alchemist's fire burns even underwater, and any attempts to end the persistent damage by using water have no effect.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per round

Trigger You use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.NlEZ0piDxg9buXCL]{Advanced Alchemy} to craft an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.yd3kEK21YknZLlcT]{Alchemist's Fire}, and that bomb's level is at least 2 levels lower than your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Pe0zmIqyTBc2Td0I]{Advanced Alchemy} level.

Artokus developed a mixture of volatile materials that burns hotter and longer than typical alchemist's fire. You include this additive mixture when crafting your alchemist's fire.

The alchemist's fire deals @Damage[1d4[persistent,fire]] damage in addition to what the alchemist fire would normally cause (for instance, a moderate alchemist's fire deals 1d4+2 persistent fire damage).

A creature taking persistent fire damage from the alchemist's fire requires two successful flat checks to end the persistent damage, or one check if the creature had an assisted recovery that reduces the flat check to DC 10.

The enhanced alchemist's fire burns even underwater, and any attempts to end the persistent damage by using water have no effect.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 라운드당 1회

Trigger @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.NlEZ0piDxg9buXCL]{고급 연금술}을 사용하여 @link[equipment.alchemists-fire-lesser]을 제작하며, 해당 폭탄의 레벨은 당신의 @link[feats.advanced-alchemy] 레벨보다 최소 2레벨 낮아야 합니다.

아르토쿠스는 일반적인 연금술사의 불보다 더 뜨겁고 오래 타는 휘발성 물질 혼합물을 개발했습니다. 연금술사의 불을 제작할 때 이 첨가제 혼합물을 포함시키세요.

연금술사의 불은 기본 피해에 추가로 1d4 지속 화염 피해를 입힙니다(예: 보통 연금술사의 불은 1d4+2의 지속 화상 피해를 입힙니다).

연금술사의 불으로 지속 화상 피해를 입은 생물은 지속 피해를 끝내기 위해 두 번의 평탄 판정 성공이 필요하며, 보조 회복을 받아 단순 판정 난이도가 DC 10으로 낮아진 경우 한 번의 판정만으로 가능합니다.

강화된 연금술사의 불은 물속에서도 타오르며, 물을 이용해 지속 피해를 끝내려 하는 시도는 효과가 없습니다.

name: Hurricane Swing

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You critically hit a foe with a Strike with a slashing weapon.

Choose either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9AAkVUCwF6WVNNY2]{Lightning Bolt} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.g8QqHpv2CWDwmIm1]{Gust of Wind}. You Cast the chosen Spell as a 6th-rank primal innate spell in the direction of the target of the triggering action.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You critically hit a foe with a Strike with a slashing weapon.

Choose either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9AAkVUCwF6WVNNY2]{Lightning Bolt} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.g8QqHpv2CWDwmIm1]{Gust of Wind}. You Cast the chosen Spell as a 6th-rank primal innate spell in the direction of the target of the triggering action.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 베기 무기로 적에게 치명타를 날릴 때.

다음 중 하나를 선택하십시오: @link[spells.lightning-bolt] 또는 @link[spells.gust-of-wind]. 선택한 주문을 (6th)랭크 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 발동하여, 발동 행동의 대상 방향으로 시전합니다.

name: Assassinate

description.value:
Requirements You have designated a mark using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.orjJjLdm4XNAcFi8]{Mark for Death} and are completely unnoticed by your mark.

You strike with one swift movement, trying to instantly slay your mark. Make a Strike against your mark. If you hit, your mark takes an additional 6d6 precision damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. If the mark critically fails, it dies unless its level is higher than yours. Regardless of the result of its save, the creature is temporarily immune to your Assassinate for 1 day.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have designated a mark using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.orjJjLdm4XNAcFi8]{Mark for Death} and are completely unnoticed by your mark.

You strike with one swift movement, trying to instantly slay your mark. Make a Strike against your mark. If you hit, your mark takes an additional 6d6 precision damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. If the mark critically fails, it dies unless its level is higher than yours. Regardless of the result of its save, the creature is temporarily immune to your Assassinate for 1 day.
_desc_ko:
Requirements 당신은 @link[actions.mark-for-death]을 사용하여 표적을 지정했으며, 표적에게 완전히 눈치채이지 않은 상태여야 합니다.

당신은 한 번의 재빠른 동작으로 공격하여 표적을 즉시 처치하려 합니다. 표적에게 강타를 가하십시오. 명중 시, 표적은 추가로 6d6 정밀도 피해를 입으며, 이는 당신의 직업 난이도(DC)와 주문 난이도(DC) 중 높은 쪽에 대한 기본 인내 저항 검사를 수행합니다. 표적이 치명적으로 대실패할 경우, 자신의 레벨이 당신보다 높지 않으면 사망합니다. 저항 검사 결과와 무관하게, 해당 생물은 1일간 당신의 암살에 대해 일시적으로 면역 상태가 됩니다.

name: Ardent Armiger

description.value:
You've trained to resist the manipulations of fiends, and your Hellknight discipline makes you difficult to influence. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against effects that could inflict the controlled or frightened conditions.

If a mental effect would compel you to act in a way that violates your Hellknight order's tenets (as determined by the GM), you can attempt to break free from the effect as a free action triggered by receiving the violating order, and you gain a new Will save against the effect. You can attempt this save even if the effect would normally prevent you from acting of your own volition. You can attempt this new save only once for a given effect, even if you're compelled to violate your order's tenets multiple times. You can't receive a worse result on this Will save than you originally got against the compelling mental effect.

_desc_en:
You've trained to resist the manipulations of fiends, and your Hellknight discipline makes you difficult to influence. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against effects that could inflict the controlled or frightened conditions.

If a mental effect would compel you to act in a way that violates your Hellknight order's tenets (as determined by the GM), you can attempt to break free from the effect as a free action triggered by receiving the violating order, and you gain a new Will save against the effect. You can attempt this save even if the effect would normally prevent you from acting of your own volition. You can attempt this new save only once for a given effect, even if you're compelled to violate your order's tenets multiple times. You can't receive a worse result on this Will save than you originally got against the compelling mental effect.
_desc_ko:
아키타입 헬나이트 아미거

당신은 핀드의 조종에 저항하도록 훈련받았으며, 지옥기사 훈련으로 인해 영향을 받기 어렵습니다. 태도를 개선하는 정신 효과에 대한 저항에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 누군가가 당신을 {강요하거나}, 사기를 저하시키거나, 인상을 주거나, 요청을 할 때 의지 DC에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

정신 효과가 지옥기사 교단의 교리를 위반하는 행동을 강요할 경우(GM이 판단), 위반 명령을 받는 순간 반응으로 그 효과에서 벗어나려 시도할 수 있으며, 해당 효과에 대한 새로운 의지 내성에 성공할 기회를 얻습니다. 해당 효과에 대해 이 새로운 내성은 단 한 번만 시도할 수 있으며, 교단의 교리를 여러 번 위반하도록 강요받더라도 마찬가지입니다.

name: Empiricist's Eye

description.value:
Sharp and piercing, your eyes see all and convey more. Your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.sn2hIy1iIJX9Vpgj]{Point Out} actions lose the auditory trait, and you don't need to be heard to convey the information to your allies. In addition, a creature you Point Out is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to your allies until the start of your next turn.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.y2XeMe1F18lIyo59]{Blind-Fight} feat, your allies gain that feat's benefits against any creature that's off-guard due to Empiricist's Eye.

_desc_en:
Sharp and piercing, your eyes see all and convey more. Your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.sn2hIy1iIJX9Vpgj]{Point Out} actions lose the auditory trait, and you don't need to be heard to convey the information to your allies. In addition, a creature you Point Out is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to your allies until the start of your next turn.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.y2XeMe1F18lIyo59]{Blind-Fight} feat, your allies gain that feat's benefits against any creature that's off-guard due to Empiricist's Eye.
_desc_ko:
날카롭고 관통하는, 당신의 눈은 모든 것을 보고 더 많은 정보를 전달합니다. 당신의 @link[actions.point-out] 행동은 청각적 특성을 상실하며, 동맹에게 정보를 전달하기 위해 들릴 필요가 없습니다. 또한, 네가 지목한 생물은 다음 턴 시작 전까지 네 동맹에게 @link[conditions.off-guard]가 된다.

특수 네가 @link[feats.blind-fight] 피트를 가지고 있다면, 경험주의자의 눈으로 인해 무방비 상태인 모든 생물에게 동맹이 해당 피트의 혜택을 얻습니다.

name: Along the Deep River

description.value:
Access Tian Xia origin, or you're a follower of Sangpotshi.

Once per year, when you die, you turn into an immaterial ball of light. After a week, you return to life with the effects of a successful (but not critically successful) 9th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gIVaSCrLhhBzGHQY]{Reincarnate} ritual. You always reincarnate into a sprite, but you reincarnate as a randomly selected sprite heritage.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Access Tian Xia origin, or you're a follower of Sangpotshi.

Once per year, when you die, you turn into an immaterial ball of light. After a week, you return to life with the effects of a successful (but not critically successful) 9th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gIVaSCrLhhBzGHQY]{Reincarnate} ritual. You always reincarnate into a sprite, but you reincarnate as a randomly selected sprite heritage.
_desc_ko:
접근 티엔 샤 출신이거나 싱폿시의 추종자여야 합니다.

일 년에 한 번, 죽을 때면 당신은 비물질적인 빛의 구슬로 변합니다. 일주일 후, 당신은 성공적이지만(대성공은 아님) 9등급 @link[spells.reincarnate] 의식의 효과를 지닌 채 생명을 되찾습니다. 항상 스프라이트로 환생하지만, 환생 시 무작위로 선택된 스프라이트 혈통으로 환생한다.

name: Divine Rebuttal

description.value:
Trigger Your ally is about to roll a saving throw against a magical ability of a creature you're adjacent to.

Requirements You are wielding your deity's favored weapon.

You strive against magical threats physically and spiritually. You can Strike the adjacent creature with your deity's favored weapon. If you are holy or unholy, the Strike gains that trait. If your Strike hits, all your allies gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the triggering saving throw (or a +3 circumstance bonus on a critical hit).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.jMQi2kDirzGgddti]{Effect: Divine Rebuttal}

You strive against magical threats physically and spiritually. You can Strike the adjacent creature with your deity's favored weapon. If you are holy or unholy, the Strike gains that trait. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.jMQi2kDirzGgddti]{Effect: Divine Rebuttal}
_desc_ko:
발동조건 당신이 인접한 생물의 마법 능력에 대해 아군이 내성 굴림을 굴릴 때.

요구 사항 당신은 신이 선호하는 무기를 휘두르고 있습니다.

당신은 마법적 위협에 육체적·정신적으로 맞서 싸웁니다. 신이 선호하는 무기로 인접한 생물을 강타할 수 있습니다. 당신이 신성한 존재이거나 불경한 존재라면, 이 강타는 해당 속성을 얻습니다. 강타가 적중하면, 모든 아군은 유발된 내성 굴림에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다(치명타 시 +3 상황 보너스).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.jMQi2kDirzGgddti]{효과: 신성한 반박}

name: Elemental Familiar (Kineticist)

description.value: A small creature made of elemental matter springs forth from your kinetic gate. This elemental familiar appears to be made of one of your kinetic elements, though it might have unusual or distinguishing aspects. Like other familiars, your elemental familiar can assist you in various tasks and on adventures. You gain an elemental familiar with the trait of one of your kinetic elements. If you have more than one kinetic element, you can change the element you've selected for your familiar to a different one of your kinetic elements each time you make your daily preparations. The familiar uses your Constitution modifier to determine its Perception, Acrobatics, and Stealth modifiers.

_desc_en: A small creature made of elemental matter springs forth from your kinetic gate. This elemental familiar appears to be made of one of your kinetic elements, though it might have unusual or distinguishing aspects. Like other familiars, your elemental familiar can assist you in various tasks and on adventures. You gain an elemental familiar with the trait of one of your kinetic elements. If you have more than one kinetic element, you can change the element you've selected for your familiar to a different one of your kinetic elements each time you make your daily preparations. The familiar uses your Constitution modifier to determine its Perception, Acrobatics, and Stealth modifiers.
_desc_ko: 원소 물질로 이루어진 작은 생물이 당신의 키네틱 게이트에서 튀어나옵니다. 이 원소 패밀리어는 당신의 키네틱 에너지 원소 중 하나로 만들어진 것처럼 보이지만, 특이하거나 구별되는 특징을 가질 수도 있습니다. 다른 패밀리어와 마찬가지로, 당신의 원소 패밀리어는 다양한 작업과 모험에서 당신을 도울 수 있습니다. 당신은 자신의 운동 원소 중 하나의 특성을 지닌 원소 패밀리어를 얻습니다. 운동 원소가 둘 이상일 경우, 매일 준비를 할 때마다 패밀리어의 원소를 다른 운동 원소로 변경할 수 있습니다. 패밀리어는 지각, 곡예, 은신 능력치에 적용되는 수정자를 결정할 때 당신의 건강 수정자를 사용합니다.

name: Spinning Release

description.value:
Requirements You have a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} with your lash.

You wind your lash around your opponent, then spin them rapidly to discombobulate them. You release your opponent, sending them wobbling 10 feet in a direction of your choice; this is forced movement. Your opponent must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:class] save against your class DC, with the following effects.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} until the end of their next turn. They are then temporarily immune to being confused or sickened by Spinning Release for 10 minutes, though the ability can still be used to move them.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} from being spun around.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} with your lash.

You wind your lash around your opponent, then spin them rapidly to discombobulate them. You release your opponent, sending them wobbling 10 feet in a direction of your choice; this is forced movement.
