Critical Failure As failure, but the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} from being spun around.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신의 채찍으로 @link[conditions.grabbed] 또는 @link[conditions.restrained] 생물이 있어야 합니다.

당신은 채찍을 상대방 주위에 감은 뒤, 빠르게 회전시켜 상대를 혼란스럽게 합니다. 상대를 풀어주면, 선택한 방향으로 10피트 비틀거리며 강제 이동합니다. 상대는 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 인내 내성에 성공해야 하며, 실패 시 다음 효과가 적용됩니다.

실패 시 대상은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.confused] 상태가 됩니다. 이후 10분 동안 회전 해제로 인한 혼란 또는 병약 효과에 일시적으로 면역이 되나, 이동 목적의 사용은 여전히 가능합니다.

대실패 실패와 동일하나, 대상은 회전으로 인해 @link[conditions.sickened]{1} 상태가 된다.

name: Bullying Staff

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding your staff.

You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} creatures up to two sizes larger than you. If you have master proficiency with your staff, you can attempt to Shove or Trip creatures up to three sizes larger than you.

publication.title: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding your staff.

You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} creatures up to two sizes larger than you. If you have master proficiency with your staff, you can attempt to Shove or Trip creatures up to three sizes larger than you.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 지팡이를 휘두르고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 자신보다 최대 두 크기 큰 생물을 @link[actions.shove]하거나 @link[actions.trip]하려고 시도할 수 있습니다. 지팡이 숙련도가 달인이라면, 자신보다 최대 세 크기 큰 생물을 밀치거나 넘어뜨리기 시도할 수 있습니다.

name: Lifesense

description.value: You have a limited ability to sense life force, like your psychopomp forebears. You gain lifesense as an imprecise sense with a range of 10 feet. This allows you to sense the life force of living and undead creatures within the listed range. The sense can distinguish between the vitality energy animating living creatures and the void energy animating undead creatures, much as sight distinguishes colors.

_desc_en: You have a limited ability to sense life force, like your psychopomp forebears. You gain lifesense as an imprecise sense with a range of 10 feet. This allows you to sense the life force of living and undead creatures within the listed range. The sense can distinguish between the vitality energy animating living creatures and the void energy animating undead creatures, much as sight distinguishes colors.
_desc_ko: 당신은 사이코폼프 선조들처럼 생명력을 감지하는 제한된 능력을 지녔습니다. 당신은 10피트 범위의 부정확한 감각인 생명 감지 능력을 얻습니다. 이 능력으로 지정된 범위 내의 생물과 언데드 생물의 생명력을 감지할 수 있습니다. 이 감각은 시력이 색을 구분하듯, 생물을 움직이는 활력 에너지와 언데드를 움직이는 공허 에너지를 구분할 수 있습니다.

name: Rapid Pheromone Recovery

description.value: Your supply of pheromones replenish very quickly. You can Emit Defensive Odor once per hour, rather than once per day.

_desc_en: Your supply of pheromones replenish very quickly. You can Emit Defensive Odor once per hour, rather than once per day.
_desc_ko: 당신의 페로몬 공급이 매우 빠르게 회복됩니다. 방어적 냄새 발산 능력을 하루에 한 번이 아닌 시간당 한 번 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Underwater Marauder

description.value: You've learned to fight underwater. You are not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while in water, and you don't take the usual penalties for using a bludgeoning or slashing melee weapon in water.

_desc_en: You've learned to fight underwater. You are not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while in water, and you don't take the usual penalties for using a bludgeoning or slashing melee weapon in water.
_desc_ko: 수중 전투 기술을 익혔습니다. 물속에 있을 때 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 되지 않으며, 물속에서 타격이나 베기 근접 무기를 사용할 때 일반적인 페널티를 받지 않습니다.

name: Haunt Ingenuity

description.value:
Your cunning knowledge grants you the ability to notice the emotional echo of a soul that passed on, leaving a haunt in its wake. Even when you aren't Searching while in exploration mode, the GM rolls a secret check for you to notice haunts that usually require you to be Searching.

You can disable haunts that require master proficiency in a skill as long as you're at least trained in the skill. If you have master proficiency in the skill, you can disable haunts that require a proficiency rank of legendary instead.

_desc_en:
Your cunning knowledge grants you the ability to notice the emotional echo of a soul that passed on, leaving a haunt in its wake. Even when you aren't Searching while in exploration mode, the GM rolls a secret check for you to notice haunts that usually require you to be Searching.

You can disable haunts that require master proficiency in a skill as long as you're at least trained in the skill. If you have master proficiency in the skill, you can disable haunts that require a proficiency rank of legendary instead.
_desc_ko:
당신의 재치 있는 지식은 떠난 영혼이 남긴 정서적 잔향, 즉 유령의 흔적을 감지할 수 있는 능력을 부여합니다. 탐색 모드에서 탐색을 하지 않을 때도, GM은 비밀 판정을 굴려 보통 탐색이 필요한 유령의 흔적을 감지하게 합니다.

해당 기술에 달인 이상만 되어도 숙련도 달인이 필요한 유령의 흔적을 제거할 수 있습니다. 해당 기술에 달인이 있다면, 대신 전설적인 숙련도 등급이 필요한 유령의 흔적도 제거할 수 있습니다.

name: Night Magic

description.value: You can tap into the magic that runs through your blood. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wp09USMB3GIW1qbp]{Animal Form} (wolf only, using the statistics for a canine) and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]{Mist} as 2nd-rank divine innate spells. You can cast each of these spells once per day.

_desc_en: You can tap into the magic that runs through your blood. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wp09USMB3GIW1qbp]{Animal Form} (wolf only, using the statistics for a canine) and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]{Mist} as 2nd-rank divine innate spells. You can cast each of these spells once per day.
_desc_ko: 혈맥을 흐르는 마법을 활용할 수 있습니다. @link[spells.animal-form](늑대만 가능, 개과 동물 능력치 적용)와 @link[spells.mist]를 2랭크 신성 선천 마법으로 획득합니다. 이 마법들은 하루에 한 번씩 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Remorseless Lash

description.value: You're skilled at beating an enemy when their morale is already breaking. When you succeed at a melee weapon Strike against a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} enemy, that enemy can't reduce their frightened condition below 1 until the beginning of your next turn.

_desc_en: You're skilled at beating an enemy when their morale is already breaking. When you succeed at a melee weapon Strike against a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} enemy, that enemy can't reduce their frightened condition below 1 until the beginning of your next turn.
_desc_ko: 적의 사기가 이미 무너져 있을 때 상대를 제압하는 데 능숙합니다. @link[conditions.frightened] 적에게 근접 무기 공격을 성공시키면, 해당 적은 다음 차례 시작 전까지 공포 상태를 1 이하로 낮출 수 없습니다.

name: Energy Ablation

description.value: As you direct destructive energy at a foe, you can divert some of its power into a protective barrier that shields you from harm. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that deals at least one type of energy damage (acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, sonic, vitality, or void), you gain resistance to an energy damage type of your choice equal to the spell's rank. The resistance lasts until the end of your next turn. You get the resistance regardless of whether or not your spell dealt damage.

_desc_en: As you direct destructive energy at a foe, you can divert some of its power into a protective barrier that shields you from harm. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that deals at least one type of energy damage (acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, sonic, vitality, or void), you gain resistance to an energy damage type of your choice equal to the spell's rank. The resistance lasts until the end of your next turn. You get the resistance regardless of whether or not your spell dealt damage.
_desc_ko: 적에게 파괴적인 에너지를 발사할 때, 그 힘의 일부를 방어막으로 전환하여 자신을 보호할 수 있습니다. 다음 행동으로 최소 한 가지 이상의 에너지 피해(산성, 냉기, 전기, 화염, 힘, [sonic] 피해, 활력, 공허)를 주는 주문을 시전할 경우, 선택한 에너지 피해 유형에 대해 해당 주문 랭크과 동일한 저항력을 얻습니다. 이 저항력은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 지속됩니다. 주문이 피해를 입혔는지 여부와 관계없이 저항력을 획득합니다.

name: Skillful Climber

description.value: You can scamper up or down surfaces as nimbly as a monkey. You gain a climb Speed of 10 feet. If you have the Climber's Tail ancestry feat, your total climb Speed increases to your land Speed when climbing trees.

_desc_en: You can scamper up or down surfaces as nimbly as a monkey. You gain a climb Speed of 10 feet. If you have the Climber's Tail ancestry feat, your total climb Speed increases to your land Speed when climbing trees.
_desc_ko: 원숭이처럼 민첩하게 표면을 오르내릴 수 있습니다. 등반 속도가 10피트 증가합니다. 등반자의 꼬리 혈통 재주를 보유한 경우, 나무를 오를 때 총 등반 속도가 지상 속도까지 증가합니다.

name: Tumbling Lumber

description.value:
A slew of logs eject from the Plane of Wood and slam into your enemies. They roll in a @Template[line|distance:30|width:10]{10-foot-wide, 30-foot-long line}. Non-magical difficult terrain on any ground the logs roll over is smashed flat; greater difficult terrain remains. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -4)/3)+2)d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage and might be moved by the logs, depending on its @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] save against your class DC.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is pushed out of the line in the most direct path available.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Level (+3) The damage increases by 1d8.

_desc_en:
A slew of logs eject from the Plane of Wood and slam into your enemies. They roll in a @Template[line|distance:30|width:10]{10-foot-wide, 30-foot-long line}. Non-magical difficult terrain on any ground the logs roll over is smashed flat; greater difficult terrain remains. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -4)/3)+2)d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage and might be moved by the logs, depending on its @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] save against your class DC.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is pushed out of the line in the most direct path available.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Level (+3) The damage increases by 1d8.
_desc_ko:
나무의 평면에서 수많은 통나무가 뿜어져 나와 적들에게 부딪힙니다. 통나무들은 30피트을 따라 굴림합니다. 통나무가 지나간 땅의 비마법적 어려운 지형은 평평하게 부서지지만, 매우 어려운 지형은 그대로 남습니다. 해당 영역 내 모든 생물은 타격의 피해를 입으며, 당신의 직업 난이도(DC)에 대한 반사 내성에 따라 통나무에 의해 이동될 수 있다.

대성공 생물은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 생물은 절반의 피해를 입습니다.

실패 생물은 전체 피해를 입으며 가능한 가장 직선 경로로 선 밖으로 밀려난다.

대실패 생물은 두 배의 피해를 입으며 @link[conditions.prone] 상태가 된다.

레벨 (+3) 피해량이 1d8 증가합니다.

name: Initiate Warden

description.value:
You've trained with one of the ranger sects known as wardens, who practice a specialized type of primal magic. You gain your choice of one warden spell from these initial warden spells (or another you have access to).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IWUe32Y5k2QFd7YQ]{Gravity Weapon}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KIV2LqzS5KtqOItV]{Heal Companion}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.u2uSeH6YSbK1ajTy]{Magic Hide}

Special You can take this feat multiple times, choosing a different initial warden spell each time.

_desc_en:
You've trained with one of the ranger sects known as wardens, who practice a specialized type of primal magic. You gain your choice of one warden spell from these initial warden spells (or another you have access to).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IWUe32Y5k2QFd7YQ]{Gravity Weapon}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KIV2LqzS5KtqOItV]{Heal Companion}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.u2uSeH6YSbK1ajTy]{Magic Hide}

Special You can take this feat multiple times, choosing a different initial warden spell each time.
_desc_ko:
당신은 프라이멀 마법의 특수한 유형을 수행하는 수호자(워든)로 알려진 레인저 종파 중 하나와 함께 훈련했습니다. 당신은 이 초기 수호자 주문들(또는 당신이 접근할 수 있는 다른 주문) 중에서 선택한 하나의 수호자 주문을 얻습니다.

@link[spells.gravity-weapon]

@link[spells.heal-companion]

@link[spells.magic-hide]

특수 이 재주를 여러 번 선택할 수 있으며, 매번 다른 초기 수호자 주문을 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Nimble Reprisal

description.value:
You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EAP98XaChJEbgKcK]{Retributive Strike} at greater distance. You can use a ranged weapon to make a ranged Strike instead of a melee Strike for Retributive Strike. The enemy needs to be in range, but not in reach, and it must still be in your champion's aura.

You can also make melee Strikes against enemies a bit farther away. If the enemy that triggered your reaction is outside your reach but is within 5 feet of your reach, as part of your reaction you can Step to put the enemy in your reach before making a melee Retributive Strike.

_desc_en:
You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EAP98XaChJEbgKcK]{Retributive Strike} at greater distance. You can use a ranged weapon to make a ranged Strike instead of a melee Strike for Retributive Strike. The enemy needs to be in range, but not in reach, and it must still be in your champion's aura.

You can also make melee Strikes against enemies a bit farther away. If the enemy that triggered your reaction is outside your reach but is within 5 feet of your reach, as part of your reaction you can Step to put the enemy in your reach before making a melee Retributive Strike.
_desc_ko:
더 먼 거리에서 @link[actions.retributive-strike]을 사용할 수 있습니다. 보복 타격 시 근접 타격 대신 원거리 무기로 원거리 타격을 가할 수 있습니다. 적은 사정거리 내에 있어야 하지만 도달 범위 안에는 있을 필요 없으며, 여전히 당신의 챔피언 오라 안에 있어야 합니다.

조금 더 멀리 있는 적에게도 근접 공격을 할 수 있습니다. 반응을 유발한 적이 당신의 도달 범위 밖에 있지만, 도달 범위에서 5피트 이내에 있는 경우, 반응의 일환으로 신중함을 기한 발걸음을 사용하여 적을 도달 범위 안으로 이동시킨 후 근접 보복 공격을 할 수 있습니다.

name: Incredible Luck (Halfling)

description.value: Even other halflings consider you to be particularly lucky. You can use Halfling Luck once per hour, rather than once per day. If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.k0sXAn4PPq5nW9al]{Guiding Luck}, you can still use Halfling Luck when you fail a Perception check or attack roll only once per day (though you can use it within the same hour that you used Halfling Luck), and if you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.f5Vkk2rM6tCe2zQn]{Shared Luck}, you can still use Halfling Luck on an ally instead of yourself only once per day.

_desc_en: Even other halflings consider you to be particularly lucky. You can use Halfling Luck once per hour, rather than once per day. If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.k0sXAn4PPq5nW9al]{Guiding Luck}, you can still use Halfling Luck when you fail a Perception check or attack roll only once per day (though you can use it within the same hour that you used Halfling Luck), and if you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.f5Vkk2rM6tCe2zQn]{Shared Luck}, you can still use Halfling Luck on an ally instead of yourself only once per day.
_desc_ko: 다른 하플링들조차도 당신을 특히 운이 좋은 존재로 여깁니다. 하루에 한 번이 아닌 시간당 한 번씩 하플링의 행운을 사용할 수 있습니다. @link[feats.guiding-luck]를 보유 중이라면, 지각 판정나 명중 굴림에 실패했을 때 하루에 한 번만 하플링의 행운을 사용할 수 있습니다(하플링의 행운을 사용한 같은 시간 내에 사용할 수 있음). 또한 @link[feats.shared-luck-halfling]를 보유 중이라면, 하루에 한 번만 자신을 대신해 아군에게 하플링의 행운을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Deep Lore

description.value: Your repertoire is vast, containing far more spells than usual. Add one spell to your repertoire of each spell rank you can cast.

_desc_en: Your repertoire is vast, containing far more spells than usual. Add one spell to your repertoire of each spell rank you can cast.
_desc_ko: 당신의 레퍼토리는 방대하여 일반적인 것보다 훨씬 많은 주문을 포함합니다. 당신이 시전할 수 있는 각 주문 랭크마다 레퍼토리에 주문 하나를 추가합니다.

name: Beautiful Knifework

description.value:
You perform surgical adjustments to disguise a willing ally or your construct companion. This counts as preparing a disguise to Impersonate, taking 10 minutes and requiring a healer's toolkit instead of a disguise kit. The DC to see through the deception with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} is your Medicine DC (@Check[perception|against:medicine|rollerRole:target|traits:secret|options:action:seek]) unless the disguised character's Deception DC is higher. If the target directly interacts with someone while disguised, they gain a +2 circumstance bonus to their Deception check.

You can reverse this effect with another 10-minute surgery. The disguised character can also end it as a free action when they receive any healing effect.

_desc_en:
You perform surgical adjustments to disguise a willing ally or your construct companion. This counts as preparing a disguise to Impersonate, taking 10 minutes and requiring a healer's toolkit instead of a disguise kit. The DC to see through the deception with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} is your Medicine DC (@Check[perception|against:medicine|rollerRole:target|traits:secret|options:action:seek]) unless the disguised character's Deception DC is higher. If the target directly interacts with someone while disguised, they gain a +2 circumstance bonus to their Deception check.

You can reverse this effect with another 10-minute surgery. The disguised character can also end it as a free action when they receive any healing effect.
_desc_ko:
당신은 의지하는 아군이나 창조물 동반자를 위장하기 위해 외과적 조정을 수행합니다. 이는 변장을 위한 위장 준비로 간주되며, 10분이 소요되고 변장 키트 대신 치료사 도구 키트가 필요합니다. @link[actions.seek] 능력으로 위장을 간파하는 난이도는 위장된 캐릭터의 기만 난이도가 더 높지 않은 한, 당신의 의술 난이도(지각)와 동일합니다. 위장 상태에서 대상이 누군가와 직접 상호작용할 경우, 상대방은 기만 판정 시 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

10분간의 추가 수술로 이 효과를 역전시킬 수 있습니다. 변장한 캐릭터는 치유 효과를 받을 때 자유 행동으로 효과를 종료할 수도 있습니다.

name: Fracture Timeflow

description.value:
Your ability to interact with and even observe the flow of time allows you to fracture it slightly in a localized place whenever you land a particularly solid blow on a foe. Whenever you achieve a critical success with a Strike, the target of that Strike must also attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell|options:inflicts:slowed,inflicts:stunned] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

Critical Success The target is unaffected by the fractured timeflow.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3}, then slowed 2 for 1 round after they recover from being stunned.

publication.title: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

_desc_en:
Your ability to interact with and even observe the flow of time allows you to fracture it slightly in a localized place whenever you land a particularly solid blow on a foe. Whenever you achieve a critical success with a Strike, the target of that Strike must also attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell|options:inflicts:slowed,inflicts:stunned] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

Critical Success The target is unaffected by the fractured timeflow.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3}, then slowed 2 for 1 round after they recover from being stunned.
_desc_ko:
시간의 흐름과 상호작용하고 심지어 관찰할 수 있는 능력 덕분에, 당신은 적에게 특히 강력한 일격을 가할 때마다 국지적으로 시간을 약간 균열시킬 수 있다. 타격으로 대성공을 거둘 때마다, 그 타격의 대상은 당신의 직업 DC나 주문 DC 중 더 높은 것에 대해 @Check[will|against:class-spell|options:inflicts:slowed,inflicts:stunned] 내성을 시도해야 한다.

대성공 대상은 균열된 시간흐름에 영향을 받지 않는다.

성공 대상은 1라운드 동안 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{둔화 1} 상태가 된다.

실패 대상은 1라운드 동안 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{둔화 2} 상태가 된다.

대실패 대상은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{기절 3} 상태가 되고, 기절에서 회복된 후 1라운드 동안 둔화 2 상태가 된다.

name: Legend of Combat

description.value: You can deliver a lightning-fast series of blows and strikes, bringing all the strength of your legend to bear against those who have yet to experience your prowess. Spend a Mythic Point. For the next minute, you gain an extra reaction at the start of each of your turns. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plLX3yDcKo2YiJ0j]{Speed of Arms} reaction.

_desc_en: You can deliver a lightning-fast series of blows and strikes, bringing all the strength of your legend to bear against those who have yet to experience your prowess. Spend a Mythic Point. For the next minute, you gain an extra reaction at the start of each of your turns. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plLX3yDcKo2YiJ0j]{Speed of Arms} reaction.
_desc_ko: 당신은 번개처럼 빠른 연속 타격과 공격을 퍼부어, 아직 당신의 위력을 경험하지 못한 자들에게 전설의 힘을 쏟아부을 수 있습니다. 신화 포인트 1점을 소모하세요. 이후 1분 동안, 당신의 턴 시작 시마다 추가 반응을 얻습니다. 또한 @link[actions.speed-of-arms] 반응을 얻습니다.

name: Heroic Presence

description.value:
Frequency once per day

The blood of heroes courses through your veins, and you inspire your allies to dig deep and find a new level of resolve. You grant up to 10 willing creatures within 30 feet the effects of a 6th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GYD0XZ4t3tQq6shc]{Zealous Conviction}, though the effect automatically ends on a target if you give that target a command they would normally find repugnant. This action has the auditory trait or visual trait, depending on how you inspire your allies.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

The blood of heroes courses through your veins, and you inspire your allies to dig deep and find a new level of resolve. You grant up to 10 willing creatures within 30 feet the effects of a 6th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GYD0XZ4t3tQq6shc]{Zealous Conviction}, though the effect automatically ends on a target if you give that target a command they would normally find repugnant. This action has the auditory trait or visual trait, depending on how you inspire your allies.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

영웅의 피가 당신의 혈관을 흐르며, 당신은 동맹들이 깊은 곳에서 새로운 결의를 끌어내도록 고무합니다. 30피트 내의 최대 10명의 동의한 대상에게 (6th)등급 @link[spells.zealous-conviction]의 효과를 부여합니다. 단, 대상에게 본래 거부감을 느낄 만한 명령을 내릴 경우 해당 대상에 대한 효과는 자동으로 종료됩니다. 이 행동은 동료를 고무하는 방식에 따라 청각적 특성 또는 시각적 특성을 가집니다.

name: Hungry Eyes

description.value:
Your eyes can see through darkness with an oni's visual acuity. You gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if you already have low-light vision.

Special You can select this feat twice, once to gain low-light vision and a second time to gain darkvision.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Your eyes can see through darkness with an oni's visual acuity. You gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if you already have low-light vision.

Special You can select this feat twice, once to gain low-light vision and a second time to gain darkvision.
_desc_ko:
당신의 눈은 오니의 시력으로 어둠을 꿰뚫어 볼 수 있습니다. 저조도 시야를 얻거나, 이미 저조도 시야를 가지고 있다면 암흑 시야를 얻습니다.

특수 이 피트를 두 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 첫 번째 선택으로 저조도 시야를 얻고, 두 번째 선택으로 암흑 시야를 얻습니다.

name: Known Weaknesses

description.value:
Whenever you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.m0f2B7G9eaaTmhFL]{Devise a Stratagem}, you can also attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} as part of that action before rolling the d20. If you critically succeed at the Recall Knowledge check, you notice a weakness and can convey the information to allies to grant each of them a +1 circumstance bonus to their next attack roll against the subject, as long as their attack is made before the beginning of your next turn. If you choose an attack stratagem, this bonus applies to that attack roll too.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.DvyyA11a63FBwV7x]{Effect: Known Weaknesses}

_desc_en:
Whenever you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.m0f2B7G9eaaTmhFL]{Devise a Stratagem}, you can also attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} as part of that action before rolling the d20. If you critically succeed at the Recall Knowledge check, you notice a weakness and can convey the information to allies to grant each of them a +1 circumstance bonus to their next attack roll against the subject, as long as their attack is made before the beginning of your next turn. If you choose an attack stratagem, this bonus applies to that attack roll too.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.DvyyA11a63FBwV7x]{Effect: Known Weaknesses}
_desc_ko:
전략을 고안할 때마다, d20을 굴리기 전에 해당 행동의 일부로 @link[actions.recall-knowledge]지식 회상 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다. 기억을 떠올리기 판정에서 대성공을 거두면 약점을 발견하고, 그 정보를 아군에게 전달하여 각 아군이 대상에 대한 다음 명중 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 부여받을 수 있습니다. 단, 해당 공격이 당신의 다음 턴 시작 전에 이루어져야 합니다. 공격 전략을 선택한 경우, 이 보너스는 해당 명중 굴림에도 적용됩니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.DvyyA11a63FBwV7x]{효과: 알려진 약점}

name: Well-Versed

description.value: You're resilient to performative influences that aren't your own. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects with the auditory, illusion, linguistic, sonic, or visual traits.

_desc_en: You're resilient to performative influences that aren't your own. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects with the auditory, illusion, linguistic, sonic, or visual traits.
_desc_ko: 타인이 행하는 수행적 영향에 대해 회복력이 있습니다. 청각, 환상, 언어, [sonic], 시각 특성을 지닌 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Slip Into Shadow

description.value: Your shadow magic bleeds into the space around you. Whenever you cast a spell with the darkness trait, a lingering aura of shadows reduces bright light within a @Template[emanation|distance:5] around you to dim light until the end of your turn. Like in natural dim light, you can use these shadows to Hide, but the aura still makes your overall position obvious, so you can't become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} through the use of these shadows alone.

value.value: ability to cast at least one spell with the darkness trait

_desc_en: Your shadow magic bleeds into the space around you. Whenever you cast a spell with the darkness trait, a lingering aura of shadows reduces bright light within a @Template[emanation|distance:5] around you to dim light until the end of your turn. Like in natural dim light, you can use these shadows to Hide, but the aura still makes your overall position obvious, so you can't become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} through the use of these shadows alone.
_desc_ko: 당신의 그림자 마법이 주변 공간으로 스며듭니다. 어둠 속성 주문을 시전할 때마다, 잔존하는 그림자 오라가 당신 주변 5피트 반경 내의 밝은 빛을 당신의 턴이 끝날 때까지 희미한 빛으로 감소시킵니다. 자연적인 희미한 빛과 마찬가지로, 이 그림자를 이용해 숨길 수 있지만, 오라로 인해 전체적인 위치는 여전히 드러나므로 이 그림자만으로는 @link[conditions.undetected] 상태가 될 수 없다.

name: Sheltering Wing

description.value: You raise your fledgling wings to protect you from attack, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and to saving throws against spells that target you until the start of your next turn. If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.zQgdTW7CPYw8km5F]{Dragon's Flight}, this bonus increases to +2 as your large wings provide greater protection.

_desc_en: You raise your fledgling wings to protect you from attack, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and to saving throws against spells that target you until the start of your next turn. If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.zQgdTW7CPYw8km5F]{Dragon's Flight}, this bonus increases to +2 as your large wings provide greater protection.
_desc_ko: 당신은 갓 자란 날개를 들어올려 공격으로부터 자신을 보호하며, 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 AC와 당신을 대상으로 하는 주문에 대한 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻는다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.zQgdTW7CPYw8km5F]{용의 비행}이 있다면, 당신의 큰 날개가 더 큰 보호를 제공하므로 이 보너스가 +2로 증가한다.

name: Headless Haunt

description.value:
Access You were executed with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.5Q5MfHX43Sjm8C6Z]{Final Blade}.

You were condemned to death and executed with one of Galt's infamous final blades, where your soul was trapped for years or even decades. You might have been released alongside a host of other spirits when your prison was destroyed after the Night of the Gray Death, or powerful magic or other unique circumstances might have facilitated your escape. Whatever the method, you have unfinished business preventing you from passing on to the afterlife. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AHCMtFUZXpw98PqS]{Remove Head} action.

_desc_en:
Access You were executed with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.5Q5MfHX43Sjm8C6Z]{Final Blade}.

You were condemned to death and executed with one of Galt's infamous final blades, where your soul was trapped for years or even decades. You might have been released alongside a host of other spirits when your prison was destroyed after the Night of the Gray Death, or powerful magic or other unique circumstances might have facilitated your escape. Whatever the method, you have unfinished business preventing you from passing on to the afterlife. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AHCMtFUZXpw98PqS]{Remove Head} action.
_desc_ko:
접근 당신은 @link[equipment.final-blade]

로 처형당했습니다.

당신은 사형 선고를 받고 갈트의 악명 높은 최후의 검 중 하나로 처형되었으며, 그곳에서 수년 또는 수십 년 동안 영혼이 갇혀 있었습니다. 회색 죽음의 밤 이후 감옥이 파괴되면서 수많은 다른 영혼들과 함께 풀려났을 수도 있고, 강력한 마법이나 다른 특별한 상황으로 탈출했을 수도 있습니다. 어떤 방식이든, 당신은 사후 세계로 넘어가지 못하게 하는 미결된 일이 있습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.remove-head] 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Get Behind Me!

description.value: When saving your allies from harm, you push them behind you to better protect them. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.vhO1f7oTD2s3Ncg9]{Intercept Attack} to protect an ally, you can move that ally up to 10 feet if they're willing. You can't move the ally to a position outside your reach, you can't move them into or through obstacles, and you must move them farther away from the source of the attack if possible. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

_desc_en: When saving your allies from harm, you push them behind you to better protect them. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.vhO1f7oTD2s3Ncg9]{Intercept Attack} to protect an ally, you can move that ally up to 10 feet if they're willing. You can't move the ally to a position outside your reach, you can't move them into or through obstacles, and you must move them farther away from the source of the attack if possible. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.
_desc_ko: 동료를 위험에서 구할 때, 당신은 그들을 더 잘 보호하기 위해 자신의 뒤로 밀어냅니다. @link[actions.intercept-attack]으로 동료를 보호할 때, 상대가 동의한다면 최대 10피트까지 이동시킬 수 있습니다. 동료를 자신의 도달 범위 밖으로 이동시킬 수 없으며, 장애물 안이나 장애물을 통과하여 이동시킬 수 없고, 가능하다면 공격의 근원으로부터 더 멀리 떨어진 곳으로 이동시켜야 한다. 이 이동은 반응을 유발하지 않는다.

name: Thwart Evil

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger A creature you can see uses a spell or ability that has the evil or void traits.

You react instinctively when you sense evil forming, thrusting your spiritual energy toward the source to snuff out evil before it fully manifests. Attempt to counteract the triggering spell or ability using your Religion modifier as your counteract modifier.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger A creature you can see uses a spell or ability that has the evil or void traits.

You react instinctively when you sense evil forming, thrusting your spiritual energy toward the source to snuff out evil before it fully manifests. Attempt to counteract the triggering spell or ability using your Religion modifier as your counteract modifier.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 당신이 볼 수 있는 생물이 사악함 또는 공허 특성을 가진 주문이나 능력을 사용한다.

악이 형성되는 것을 감지하면 본능적으로 반응하여 영적 에너지를 그 근원지로 쏴 악이 완전히 창조되기 전에 진압한다. 종교 수정자를 발동된 주문이나 능력의 수정자로 사용하여 반격하려 시도하다.

name: Deflecting Wave

description.value:
Trigger You would take acid, bludgeoning, fire, or slashing damage from an enemy's attack, spell, or other hostile effect.

Requirements You're aware of the hostile effect, and you aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against it.

A cascade of water blunts or disperses the incoming attack. You gain resistance to damage from the triggering effect equal to your level if it's bludgeoning or slashing, or double your level if it's acid or fire damage. If the effect deals more than one applicable type of damage, apply the highest resistance, but apply it only once.

_desc_en:
Trigger You would take acid, bludgeoning, fire, or slashing damage from an enemy's attack, spell, or other hostile effect.

Requirements You're aware of the hostile effect, and you aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against it.

A cascade of water blunts or disperses the incoming attack. You gain resistance to damage from the triggering effect equal to your level if it's bludgeoning or slashing, or double your level if it's acid or fire damage. If the effect deals more than one applicable type of damage, apply the highest resistance, but apply it only once.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 적의 공격, 주문 또는 기타 적대적 효과로 인해 산성, 타격, 화염 또는 베기 피해를 입을 뻔했다.

요구 사항 당신은 적대적 효과를 인지하고 있으며, 이에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard]가 아닙니다.

물 캐스케이드가 다가오는 공격을 무디게 하거나 분산시킵니다. 유발 효과의 피해 유형이 타격 또는 베기일 경우, 당신의 레벨과 동일한 저항력을 얻습니다. 산성 또는 화염 피해일 경우, 당신의 레벨의 두 배를 얻습니다. 효과가 적용 가능한 피해 유형을 하나 이상 입힐 경우, 가장 높은 저항력을 적용하되 한 번만 적용합니다.

name: Dangle (Vanara)

description.value: You can hang by your tail from any suitable anchor point, such as a tree branch, balcony, or rocky outcropping (subject to the GM's discretion), typically while climbing. While hanging, you have free use of all your other limbs, so you can perform tasks that require both hands, such as firing a bow or swinging a bo staff. You can Release your tail to drop down, and you cease hanging if you take an action with the move trait.

_desc_en: You can hang by your tail from any suitable anchor point, such as a tree branch, balcony, or rocky outcropping (subject to the GM's discretion), typically while climbing. While hanging, you have free use of all your other limbs, so you can perform tasks that require both hands, such as firing a bow or swinging a bo staff. You can Release your tail to drop down, and you cease hanging if you take an action with the move trait.
_desc_ko: 나무 가지, 발코니, 바위 벼랑 등 적절한 고정점(GM의 재량에 따름)에 꼬리를 걸어 매달릴 수 있으며, 주로 등반 중 수행됩니다. 매달린 상태에서도 다른 사지를 자유롭게 사용할 수 있으므로 양손이 필요한 작업(활 쏘기, 보봉 휘두르기 등)을 수행할 수 있습니다. 꼬리를 놓으면 떨어질 수 있으며, 이동 특성이 있는 행동을 취하면 매달린 상태가 해제됩니다.

name: Ankle Biter

description.value:
You fight just as well on the ground as you do standing up. While you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, you are always @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Taking Cover} against ranged attacks, you ignore the status penalty on your attack rolls from being prone, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}.

You can choose to move up to half your Speed when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Tj055UcNm6UEgtCg]{Crawl}. You can instead move up to your full Speed when you Crawl, but if you do, you must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:6] or your body deteriorates.

_desc_en:
You fight just as well on the ground as you do standing up. While you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, you are always @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Taking Cover} against ranged attacks, you ignore the status penalty on your attack rolls from being prone, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}.

You can choose to move up to half your Speed when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Tj055UcNm6UEgtCg]{Crawl}. You can instead move up to your full Speed when you Crawl, but if you do, you must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:6] or your body deteriorates.
_desc_ko:
당신은 서 있을 때와 마찬가지로 땅에 넘어짐 상태에서도 똑같이 잘 싸운다. @link[conditions.prone]일 때, 원거리 공격에 대해 항상 @link[actions.take-cover] 상태가 되며, 넘어짐 상태로 인한 명중 굴림 상태 페널티를 무시하고, @link[actions.trip] 운동 판정 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

{기어다닐} 때 최대 속도의 절반까지 이동할 수 있습니다. 대신 기어다닐 때 최대 속도까지 이동할 수 있지만, 그렇게 할 경우 DC 6 단순에 성공해야 하며, 그렇지 않으면 신체가 쇠약해집니다.

name: Adopted Ancestry

description.value: You're fully immersed in another ancestry's culture and traditions, whether born into them, earned through rite of passage, or bonded through a deep friendship or romance. Choose a common ancestry or another ancestry to which you have access. You can select ancestry feats from the ancestry you chose, in addition to your character's own ancestry, as long as the ancestry feats don't require any physiological feature that you lack, as determined by the GM.

_desc_en: You're fully immersed in another ancestry's culture and traditions, whether born into them, earned through rite of passage, or bonded through a deep friendship or romance. Choose a common ancestry or another ancestry to which you have access. You can select ancestry feats from the ancestry you chose, in addition to your character's own ancestry, as long as the ancestry feats don't require any physiological feature that you lack, as determined by the GM.
_desc_ko: 당신은 다른 조상의 문화와 전통에 완전히 동화되었습니다. 이는 태어날 때부터 그 조상에 속했거나, 통과의례를 통해 획득했거나, 깊은 우정이나 로맨스를 통해 유대감을 형성했기 때문입니다. 일반적인 혈통이나 접근 가능한 다른 혈통 하나를 선택하십시오. 선택한 혈통의 혈통 피트를 캐릭터 본래 혈통의 재주와 함께 선택할 수 있습니다. 단, GM이 판단하기에 자신이 갖추지 못한 생리적 특징을 요구하지 않는 경우에 한합니다.

name: Grudge Strike

description.value:
Requirements Your attuned apparition grants Heraldry Lore or Underworld Lore as an apparition skill.

You channel the spiritual power of spiteful grudges. Make a melee Strike against a creature within your reach. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your attack roll and deal an additional @Damage[2d6[void]] damage to the target; if the target is undead or otherwise has void healing, this Strike instead deals an additional @Damage[2d6[vitality]] damage. This ability gains the vitality trait if it deals vitality damage, or the void trait if it deals void damage.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your attuned apparition grants Heraldry Lore or Underworld Lore as an apparition skill.

You channel the spiritual power of spiteful grudges. Make a melee Strike against a creature within your reach. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your attack roll and deal an additional @Damage[2d6[void]] damage to the target; if the target is undead or otherwise has void healing, this Strike instead deals an additional @Damage[2d6[vitality]] damage. This ability gains the vitality trait if it deals vitality damage, or the void trait if it deals void damage.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신의 조율된 유령은 유령 기술로 문장학 또는 지하세계 지식를 부여합니다.

당신은 원한에 찬 증오의 영적 힘을 집중합니다. 손이 닿는 범위 내의 생물에게 근접 강타를 가하십시오. 명중 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며 대상에게 추가로 2d6 공허의 피해를 입힙니다. 대상이 언데드이거나 공허 치유 능력을 가진 경우, 이 공격은 대신 추가로 2d6 활력의 피해를 입힙니다. 이 능력은 활력 피해를 입힐 경우 활력 속성을, 공허 피해를 입힐 경우 공허 속성을 획득합니다.

name: Torrent in the Blood

description.value:
A healing wave splashes across creatures in a @Template[cone|distance:30], its cleansing water driving afflictions from the body. Each creature in the area regains @Damage[(floor((max(6,@actor.level)-6)/2)+3)d8[healing]] HP and can attempt a new save against one poison or disease affliction affecting it; on a failed save, the condition doesn't worsen.

Each creature that benefited from this impulse becomes temporarily immune to Torrent in the Blood for 10 minutes.

Level (+2) The healing increases by 1d8.

_desc_en:
A healing wave splashes across creatures in a @Template[cone|distance:30], its cleansing water driving afflictions from the body. Each creature in the area regains @Damage[(floor((max(6,@actor.level)-6)/2)+3)d8[healing]] HP and can attempt a new save against one poison or disease affliction affecting it; on a failed save, the condition doesn't worsen.

Each creature that benefited from this impulse becomes temporarily immune to Torrent in the Blood for 10 minutes.

Level (+2) The healing increases by 1d8.
_desc_ko:
치유 파도가 30피트 범위 내 생물들에게 흩뿌려지며, 정화되는 물이 몸에서 질병을 몰아낸다. 영역 내 모든 생물은 회복 HP를 회복하며, 자신에게 걸린 독 또는 질병 상태 중 하나에 대해 새로운 내성을 시도할 수 있다. 내성 실패 시 해당 상태는 악화되지 않는다.

이 임펄스의 혜택을 받은 모든 생물은 10분 동안 '피 속의 급류'에 일시적으로 면역이 된다.

레벨 (+2) 치유량이 1d8 증가한다.

name: Amp Focus

description.value: You've glimpsed the furthest recesses of your mind. When you Refocus, you regain all your Focus Points (even if you spent them on something other than amps).

_desc_en: You've glimpsed the furthest recesses of your mind. When you Refocus, you regain all your Focus Points (even if you spent them on something other than amps).
_desc_ko: 당신은 자기 마음의 가장 깊은 곳을 엿보았다. 재집중할 때, 당신은 모든 집중 점수를 회복한다(증폭 외의 다른 것에 소비했더라도).

name: Swift Swimmer

description.value:
You gain a swim Speed of 15 feet.

Special If you have the wetlander lizardfolk heritage, your swim Speed instead increases to 25 feet.

_desc_en:
You gain a swim Speed of 15 feet.

Special If you have the wetlander lizardfolk heritage, your swim Speed instead increases to 25 feet.
_desc_ko:
수영 속도가 15피트로 증가합니다.

특수 물가 리자드포크 혈통을 가진 경우, 수영 속도가 25피트로 증가합니다.

name: Oath of the Defender

description.value:
During your daily preparations, you can swear an oath to defend against a certain kind of enemy during your deeds that day. Choose aberrations, celestials, dragons, fiends, or undead. You can't choose celestials if you're holy, nor can you choose fiends if you're unholy. You gain an edict to defend against creatures of that kind.

Allies in your champion's aura, not including you, get resistance 2 to damage dealt by creatures with the chosen trait. If such a creature deals more than one damage type at once, apply this resistance only to the highest amount of damage. The resistance increases to 3 at 7th level, 4 at 12th level, and 5 at 17th level. If a creature with the chosen trait triggers your champion's reaction and your champion's reaction grants resistance against the triggering damage, the resistance increases by 5.

_desc_en:
During your daily preparations, you can swear an oath to defend against a certain kind of enemy during your deeds that day. Choose aberrations, celestials, dragons, fiends, or undead. You can't choose celestials if you're holy, nor can you choose fiends if you're unholy. You gain an edict to defend against creatures of that kind.

Allies in your champion's aura, not including you, get resistance 2 to damage dealt by creatures with the chosen trait. If such a creature deals more than one damage type at once, apply this resistance only to the highest amount of damage. The resistance increases to 3 at 7th level, 4 at 12th level, and 5 at 17th level. If a creature with the chosen trait triggers your champion's reaction and your champion's reaction grants resistance against the triggering damage, the resistance increases by 5.
_desc_ko:
일상의 준비 과정에서, 그날의 행동 동안 특정 종류의 적을 방어하기 위한 맹세를 할 수 있습니다. 이형체, 천상체, 용, 핀드, 또는 언데드 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 신성한 존재라면 천상체를 선택할 수 없으며, 불경한 존재라면 핀드를 선택할 수 없습니다. 해당 종류의 생물로부터 방어하는 칙령을 얻습니다.

당신을 제외한 챔피언의 오라 내 아군들은 선택한 특성을 가진 생물이 가하는 피해에 대해 저항력 2를 얻습니다. 해당 생물이 한 번에 여러 종류의 피해를 입힐 경우, 이 저항력은 가장 높은 피해량에만 적용됩니다. 이 저항력은 7레벨에 3, 12레벨에 4, 17레벨에 5로 증가합니다. 선택한 특성을 가진 생물이 당신의 챔피언의 반응을 유발하고, 그 반응이 유발된 피해에 대한 저항력을 부여할 경우, 저항력이 5 증가합니다.

name: Lose Your Chains

description.value:
Trigger An ally gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} condition.

You rouse rebellion in the hearts of your allies, inspiring them to break free of their bonds. The triggering ally can make a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} at mythic proficiency.

_desc_en:
Trigger An ally gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} condition.

You rouse rebellion in the hearts of your allies, inspiring them to break free of their bonds. The triggering ally can make a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} at mythic proficiency.
_desc_ko:
Trigger 동료가 @link[conditions.grabbed] 또는 @link[conditions.restrained] 상태를 얻습니다.

당신은 동료들의 마음에 반란을 일으켜 그들이 속박에서 벗어나도록 고무합니다. 발동한 아군은 신화적 숙련도로 @link[actions.escape] 판정을 수행할 수 있다.

name: Sever the Dreaming Shadow

description.value:
As you whisper to your pusaka, it attempts to cut away an enemy's shadow, leaving them in an eternal sleep. Your pusaka gains the following Activation.

Activate—Cut the Shadow 2 (concentrate, manipulate, mental)

Frequency once per day

Effect Your pusaka becomes a kris made of darkness and drives itself into an adjacent enemy's shadow. That enemy takes @Damage[80[mental]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic] save against your spell DC or class DC, whichever is higher. If this reduces the creature to 0 Hit Points, the target doesn't die, but its shadow is severed from its body, becoming a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.clzHAfegb9Rn6DOe]{Shadow Spawn} that attempts to flee from the target's body. As long as the shadow spawn exists, the target remains in a dreamless slumber; if destroyed, the target regains its shadow and awakens (if its body was kept properly while @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}).

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

As long as the shadow spawn exists, the target remains in a dreamless slumber; if destroyed, the target regains its shadow and awakens (if its body was kept properly while @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}).
_desc_ko:
푸사카에게 속삭이자, 그것은 적의 그림자를 잘라내려 시도합니다. 그들을 영원한 잠에 빠뜨립니다. 당신의 푸사카는 다음 활성화를 얻습니다.

활성화-그림자 베기 2 (집중, 조작, 정신)

발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

효과 당신의 푸사카가 어둠으로 만들어진 크리스가 되어 인접한 적의 그림자 속으로 스스로 파고듭니다. 해당 적은 80 정신의 피해를 입으며, 당신의 주문 DC 또는 클래스 DC 중 더 높은 쪽에 대한 기본 인내 내성을 수행합니다. 이로 인해 생물의 HP가 0이 되면 대상은 죽지 않지만, 그 그림자가 몸에서 분리되어 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.clzHAfegb9Rn6DOe]{그림자 태생}이 되어 대상의 몸에서 도망치려고 시도한다. 그림자 태생이 존재하는 동안 대상은 꿈도 꾸지 않는 잠에 빠져 있으며, 파괴되면 그림자를 되찾고 깨어난다(@link[conditions.unconscious] 상태일 때 시신이 적절히 보존된 경우).

name: Directed Channel

description.value: You can shape the energy you channel in a single direction. When you cast a version of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} that has an area, you can make its area a @Template[cone|distance:60] instead of a @Template[emanation|distance:30].

_desc_en: You can shape the energy you channel in a single direction. When you cast a version of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} that has an area, you can make its area a @Template[cone|distance:60] instead of a @Template[emanation|distance:30].
_desc_ko: 채널링하는 에너지를 한 방향으로 집중시킬 수 있습니다. @link[spells.harm] 또는 @link[spells.heal]의 영역형 버전을 시전할 때, 해당 영역을 30피트 대신 60피트로 만들 수 있습니다.

name: Weft and Warp

description.value: With graceful poise, you perform a dance of dangerous attacks. Stride up to half your speed toward an enemy; if you end this movement adjacent to them make a melee Strike against that foe. If you hit, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition} the target into your square at the same time that you Step into their square. You then make another Strike against the same target, who is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to the attack. Finally, you can Step away from that enemy.

_desc_en: With graceful poise, you perform a dance of dangerous attacks. Stride up to half your speed toward an enemy; if you end this movement adjacent to them make a melee Strike against that foe. If you hit, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition} the target into your square at the same time that you Step into their square. You then make another Strike against the same target, who is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to the attack. Finally, you can Step away from that enemy.
_desc_ko: 우아한 자세로 위험한 공격의 춤을 추듯 움직인다. 적에게 최대 이동 속도의 절반까지 이동하며, 이 동작을 적과 인접한 위치에서 끝낸다면 해당 적에게 근접 공격을 가한다. 명중 시, @link[actions.reposition]로 대상이 있는 칸으로 이동하면서 동시에 그 칸으로 {신중한 발걸음}할 수 있다. 그런 다음 같은 대상에게 추가 공격을 가하며, 대상은 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 된다. 마지막으로 해당 적에게서 {신중한 발걸음}할 수 있다.

name: Whirling Clobber

description.value:
Requirements You have a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} with your lash.

After you've grasped a creature with your lash, you swing them around like a whirling hammer, smashing them into all nearby enemies. Make a melee Strike against each enemy within your melee reach. Your last attack must be against the grabbed creature, and you gain a circumstance bonus to your attack roll equal to the number of enemies you slammed them into, to a maximum of +3. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but don't increase your penalty until you have made all your attacks. After your Whirling Clobber, you release the grabbed or restrained creature into an open square within reach of your lash.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} with your lash.

After you've grasped a creature with your lash, you swing them around like a whirling hammer, smashing them into all nearby enemies. Make a melee Strike against each enemy within your melee reach. Your last attack must be against the grabbed creature, and you gain a circumstance bonus to your attack roll equal to the number of enemies you slammed them into, to a maximum of +3. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but don't increase your penalty until you have made all your attacks. After your Whirling Clobber, you release the grabbed or restrained creature into an open square within reach of your lash.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 채찍으로 생물 @link[conditions.grabbed] 또는 @link[conditions.restrained] 상태여야 합니다.

채찍으로 생물을 붙잡은 후, 회전하는 망치처럼 휘둘러 주변의 모든 적에게 내리친다. 근접 공격 범위 내의 각 적에게 근접 공격을 시도한다. 마지막 공격은 붙잡은 생물을 대상으로 해야 하며, 내리친 적의 수만큼 명중 굴림에 상황 보너스를 얻는다. 보너스는 공격 대상이 맞은 적의 수 에 따라 결정되며, 최대 +3까지 적용된다. 각 공격은 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되나, 모든 공격을 완료하기 전까지는 페널티를 증가시키지 않는다. 회전 강타 후, 채찍의 도달 범위 내 빈 칸으로 붙잡거나 제압한 생물을 풀어준다.

name: Blood And Spirit

description.value:
Your connection to the divine has sanctified your blood, but the power only manifests when you are shedding it. Choose holy or unholy. While you are taking persistent bleed damage, you can Interact to coat a piercing or slashing weapon you're wielding with your blood. Until the end of your turn, your Strikes with that weapon deal an additional 1d6 spirit damage with the chosen trait to creatures with the opposing trait.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.tu36I5HWaqOjaLVu]{Effect: Blood and Spirit}

Alternatively, you can deal @Damage[1d6[slashing]] damage to yourself (which can't be resisted in any way) as part of that Interact action if you aren't taking persistent bleed damage.

_desc_en:
Your connection to the divine has sanctified your blood, but the power only manifests when you are shedding it. Choose holy or unholy. While you are taking persistent bleed damage, you can Interact to coat a piercing or slashing weapon you're wielding with your blood. Until the end of your turn, your Strikes with that weapon deal an additional 1d6 spirit damage with the chosen trait to creatures with the opposing trait.

_desc_ko:
신성과의 연결이 당신의 피를 축성했지만, 그 힘은 피를 흘릴 때만 발현된다. 신성 또는 불경을 선택하라. 지속 출혈 피해를 입고 있는 동안, 당신은 상호작용하여 들고 있는 관통 또는 참격 무기에 자신의 피를 바를 수 있다. 당신의 턴이 끝날 때까지, 그 무기로 하는 타격은 선택한 특성을 가지고 반대 특성을 가진 생물에게 추가로 1d6 영혼 피해를 입힌다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.tu36I5HWaqOjaLVu]{효과: 피와 영혼}

또는, 지속 출혈 피해를 입고 있지 않다면 그 상호작용 행동의 일부로 자신에게 @Damage[1d6[slashing]] 피해(어떤 식으로도 저항할 수 없음)를 입힐 수 있다.

name: Reflexive Catch

description.value:
Requirements The item or thrown weapon is of a Bulk you can Juggle. If the trigger was a thrown weapon attack targeting you, you can't be off-guard to the attack. If you were already Juggling, you can't be Juggling your maximum number of items.

Trigger An item falls within your reach or an attacker fails an attack roll to hit you or a creature within your reach with a thrown weapon.

You grab the triggering item. If you are Juggling, you can immediately add the item to the objects you're Juggling as a free action, which has the concentrate and manipulate traits.

publication.title: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On

_desc_en:
Requirements The item or thrown weapon is of a Bulk you can Juggle. If the trigger was a thrown weapon attack targeting you, you can't be off-guard to the attack. If you were already Juggling, you can't be Juggling your maximum number of items.

Trigger An item falls within your reach or an attacker fails an attack roll to hit you or a creature within your reach with a thrown weapon.

You grab the triggering item. If you are Juggling, you can immediately add the item to the objects you're Juggling as a free action, which has the concentrate and manipulate traits.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 해당 아이템이나 투척 무기는 당신이 저글링할 수 있는 벌크여야 합니다. 트리거가 당신을 대상으로 한 투척 무기 공격인 경우, 해당 공격에 대해 무방비를 취하지 못했을 수 없습니다. 이미 저글링 중이었다면, 최대 개수 이상의 아이템을 저글링할 수 없습니다.

발동 조건 물건이 당신의 손이 닿는 범위 내에 떨어지거나, 공격자가 투척 무기로 당신이나 당신의 손이 닿는 범위 내의 생물을 명중시키려는 명중 굴림에 실패할 때.

당신은 트리거된 아이템을 붙잡습니다. 저글링 중이라면, 즉시 무료 행동으로 해당 아이템을 저글링 중인 물체에 추가할 수 있으며, 이 아이템은 집중과 조작 특성을 가집니다.

name: Alchemical Crafting

description.value: You can use the Craft activity to create alchemical items. When you select this feat, you immediately add the formulas for four common 1st-level alchemical items to your formula book.

_desc_en: You can use the Craft activity to create alchemical items. When you select this feat, you immediately add the formulas for four common 1st-level alchemical items to your formula book.
_desc_ko: 제작 활동을 통해 연금술 아이템을 제작할 수 있습니다. 이 피트를 선택하면 즉시 네 가지 일반적인 1레벨 연금술 아이템의 제조법을 제조법 책에 추가합니다.

name: Dragonet Resistances

description.value: You might be a little dragon, but you are still a dragon, which means it's difficult to constrain you. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against sleep effects and effects that would make you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}.

_desc_en: You might be a little dragon, but you are still a dragon, which means it's difficult to constrain you. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against sleep effects and effects that would make you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}.
_desc_ko: 당신은 작은 용일지 모르지만, 여전히 용이며, 이는 당신을 구속하기 어렵다는 뜻이다. 당신은 수면 효과와 당신을 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{마비} 상태로 만드는 효과에 대한 내성에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻는다.

name: Flourishing Finish

description.value:
Requirements Your last action was a Strike that dropped an opponent to 0 Hit Points.

Attempt a Performance check, comparing the result to the Will DC of each foe within 30 feet who can see you. Regardless of the result, each target is immune to your Flourishing Finish for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Success The target is frightened 1.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your last action was a Strike that dropped an opponent to 0 Hit Points.

Attempt a Performance check, comparing the result to the Will DC of each foe within 30 feet who can see you. Regardless of the result, each target is immune to your Flourishing Finish for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Success The target is frightened 1.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 마지막 행동이 적의 HP를 0으로 떨어뜨린 공격이었을 때.

당신을 볼 수 있는 30피트 내의 각 적에게 의지 DC와 비교하여 연기 판정을 시도하십시오. 결과와 상관없이 각 대상은 10분 동안 당신의 화려한 마무리에 면역이 됩니다.

대성공 대상은 @link[conditions.frightened]{2} 상태가 됩니다.

성공 대상은 공포 1 상태입니다.

name: Advanced Warden

description.value:
You unlock more powerful primal spells. You gain your choice of one warden spell from the advanced warden spells.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vGEgI8e7AW6FQ3tP]{Animal Feature}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8rj45fKzCFcB0fxs]{Enlarge Companion}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GfrKNJ9pNeATiKCc]{Hunter's Luck}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.RGBZrVRIEDb2G48h]{Soothing Mist}

Special You can take this feat multiple times, choosing a different advanced warden spell each time.

_desc_en:
You unlock more powerful primal spells. You gain your choice of one warden spell from the advanced warden spells.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vGEgI8e7AW6FQ3tP]{Animal Feature}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.RGBZrVRIEDb2G48h]{Soothing Mist}

Special You can take this feat multiple times, choosing a different advanced warden spell each time.
_desc_ko:
더 강력한 프라이멀 주문을 사용할 수 있게 됩니다. 고급 수호자 주문 중 원하는 수호자 주문 하나를 선택하여 얻습니다.

@link[spells.animal-feature]

@link[spells.enlarge-companion]

@link[spells.hunters-luck]

@link[spells.soothing-mist]

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있으며, 매번 다른 고급 수호자 주문을 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Quick Root

description.value:
Trigger A creature successfully Shoves or Trips you, or you fail a saving throw against an effect that would move you or knock you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

You react instinctively, sprouting roots from your legs and plunging them deep into the ground to keep your footing. If a force would move you, you move half that distance, to a minimum of 5 feet. If you would be knocked prone, resolve the effect, then you Stand.

Special This feat gains the trait for your ancestry.

value.value: ardande trait, plant trait, or wood trait

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature successfully Shoves or Trips you, or you fail a saving throw against an effect that would move you or knock you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

You react instinctively, sprouting roots from your legs and plunging them deep into the ground to keep your footing. If a force would move you, you move half that distance, to a minimum of 5 feet. If you would be knocked prone, resolve the effect, then you Stand.

Special This feat gains the trait for your ancestry.
_desc_ko:
발동조건 생물이 당신을 성공적으로 밀치거나 넘어뜨리거나, 당신을 이동시키거나 @link[conditions.prone]로 만드는 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 실패할 때.

당신은 본능적으로 반응하여 다리에서 뿌리를 뻗어 땅속 깊숙이 박아 발을 붙입니다. 당신을 이동시키려는 힘이 작용하면, 그 거리의 절반(최소 5피트)만큼 이동합니다. 당신이 넘어질 위기에 처하면, 해당 효과를 해결한 후 일어섭니다.

특수 이 피트는 당신의 혈통에 해당 특성을 부여한다.

name: Marsh Runner

description.value: When you use the Step action, you can ignore difficult terrain caused by flooding, swamps, or quicksand. In addition, when you use the Acrobatics skill to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} on narrow surfaces or uneven marshy ground, you aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, and if you roll a success on the Acrobatics check, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: When you use the Step action, you can ignore difficult terrain caused by flooding, swamps, or quicksand. In addition, when you use the Acrobatics skill to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} on narrow surfaces or uneven marshy ground, you aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, and if you roll a success on the Acrobatics check, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신이 {신중한 발걸음} 행동을 사용할 때, 홍수, 늪, 모래찜질로 인한 어려운 지형을 무시할 수 있습니다. 또한, 좁은 표면이나 고르지 않은 습지 지형에서 곡예 기술로 @link[actions.balance]을 사용할 때, @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 되지 않으며, 곡예 판정에서 성공을 굴릴 경우 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Driving Rain

description.value:
Heavy drops of rain batter down, hitting like sling stones and impeding vision. Each creature in a @Template[burst|distance:15] within 120 feet takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -6)/2)+3)d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. Until the start of your next turn, all creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while in the area, and all creatures outside the area are concealed to creatures within it.

Level (+2) The damage increases by 1d8.

_desc_en:
Heavy drops of rain batter down, hitting like sling stones and impeding vision. Each creature in a @Template[burst|distance:15] within 120 feet takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -6)/2)+3)d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. Until the start of your next turn, all creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while in the area, and all creatures outside the area are concealed to creatures within it.

Level (+2) The damage increases by 1d8.
_desc_ko:
무거운 빗방울이 투석기 돌처럼 내리쳐 시야를 방해합니다. 120피트 내 15피트 영역에 있는 모든 생물은 타격의 피해를 입으며, 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 기본 반사 내성을 발휘합니다. 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지, 영역 내의 모든 생물은 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태가 되며, 영역 외부의 모든 생물은 영역 내 생물에게 은폐 상태로 간주됩니다.

레벨 (+2) 피해량이 1d8 증가합니다.

name: Halcyon Spellcasting Sage

description.value: Your command over halcyon magic is nearly unmatched. You gain two common 6th-rank and 7th-rank halcyon spells. You also gain a 6th-rank halcyon spell slot and a 7th-rank halcyon spell slot. Your proficiency rank in either arcane or primal spell DCs and spell attack rolls advances from expert to master.

value.value: legendary in either Arcana or Nature and master in the other

_desc_en: Your command over halcyon magic is nearly unmatched. You gain two common 6th-rank and 7th-rank halcyon spells. You also gain a 6th-rank halcyon spell slot and a 7th-rank halcyon spell slot. Your proficiency rank in either arcane or primal spell DCs and spell attack rolls advances from expert to master.
_desc_ko: 당신의 평온 마법 숙련도는 거의 따라올 자가 없습니다. 일반 6랭크 및 7랭크 평온 마법 두 가지를 추가로 습득합니다. 또한 6랭크 평온 마법 슬롯 하나와 7랭크 평온 마법 슬롯 하나를 얻습니다. 아케인 마법 또는 프라이멀 마법 주문 난이도(DC) 및 주문 명중 굴림에 대한 숙련도 등급이 전문가에서 달인로 상승합니다.

name: Fated Duel

description.value:
Frequency once per week

You and your knights are an unbeatable force together, but sometimes it's a monarch's duty to resolve the fate of their kingdom with nothing more than their own trusted weapon. Spend a Mythic Point, and choose one opponent within 30 feet; you declare a Fated Duel against that opponent.

If the opponent accepts your challenge, you're locked in mystical combat together. Neither you nor your opponent can move more than 30 feet from each other; you both can't be harmed by any creature other than each other; and you both can't harm any creature other than each other. This mystical bond is incredibly draining on both parties, pulling at their life and spirit; if neither you nor your opponent has defeated the other by the time 1 minute has passed, you both become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}. Your doomed conditions increase by 1 for each additional minute that passes until one or both of you die.

If your opponent refuses your challenge, you regain a Mythic Point and can immediately attempt an Intimidation check at mythic proficiency to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} them.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per week

You and your knights are an unbeatable force together, but sometimes it's a monarch's duty to resolve the fate of their kingdom with nothing more than their own trusted weapon. Spend a Mythic Point, and choose one opponent within 30 feet; you declare a Fated Duel against that opponent.

If the opponent accepts your challenge, you're locked in mystical combat together. Neither you nor your opponent can move more than 30 feet from each other; you both can't be harmed by any creature other than each other; and you both can't harm any creature other than each other. This mystical bond is incredibly draining on both parties, pulling at their life and spirit; if neither you nor your opponent has defeated the other by the time 1 minute has passed, you both become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}. Your doomed conditions increase by 1 for each additional minute that passes until one or both of you die.

If your opponent refuses your challenge, you regain a Mythic Point and can immediately attempt an Intimidation check at mythic proficiency to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} them.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 주 1회

당신과 기사들은 함께라면 무적의 군대이지만, 때로는 군주의 의무로서 오직 자신의 신뢰하는 무기만으로 왕국의 운명을 결정해야 할 때가 있습니다. 신화 포인트 1점을 소모하고, 30피트 이내의 상대 한 명을 선택하세요. 그 상대에게 운명의 결투를 선포합니다.

상대가 당신의 도전을 수락하면, 두 사람은 신비로운 결투에 갇히게 됩니다. 당신과 상대는 서로로부터 30피트 이상 떨어질 수 없으며, 서로 외에는 어떤 생물체도 피해를 줄 수 없고, 서로 외에는 어떤 생물체도 피해를 입을 수 없습니다. 이 신비로운 유대는 양측 모두에게 엄청난 생명력과 영혼을 소모시킵니다. 1분이 지나도 상대방을 쓰러뜨리지 못하면, 양측 모두 @link[conditions.doomed]{1}이 됩니다. 이후 1분마다 파멸 상태가 1씩 증가하며, 한쪽 또는 양측 모두 사망할 때까지 지속됩니다.

상대가 도전을 거부하면 신화 포인트를 회복하고 즉시 신화 숙련도로 위협 판정(@link[actions.demoralize])를 시도할 수 있다.

name: Live Ammunition

description.value: There are generally few things as ill-advised as being shot out of a cannon or launched by a trebuchet, but people use the tactic every so often in a desperate situation. While it's more humane to use this strategy with mindless constructs or undead, occasionally an exceedingly foolhardy adventurer demands the opportunity to try it. Loading a creature requires two additional Load actions, which you must conduct personally. The creature must be willing, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} throughout the process, and the siege weapon must be physically capable of firing the creature in question, based on their size and shape. Typically, that means ballistae don't qualify, for example—nor do auto-catapults which require specifically-sized balls—but normal catapults and onagers work just fine. When you Launch the weapon, if the weapon usually targets an area, you target a single 5-foot square instead. The siege weapon deals its normal damage to its target, or to the modified area, and to the creature fired.

_desc_en: There are generally few things as ill-advised as being shot out of a cannon or launched by a trebuchet, but people use the tactic every so often in a desperate situation. While it's more humane to use this strategy with mindless constructs or undead, occasionally an exceedingly foolhardy adventurer demands the opportunity to try it. Loading a creature requires two additional Load actions, which you must conduct personally. The creature must be willing, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} throughout the process, and the siege weapon must be physically capable of firing the creature in question, based on their size and shape. Typically, that means ballistae don't qualify, for example—nor do auto-catapults which require specifically-sized balls—but normal catapults and onagers work just fine. When you Launch the weapon, if the weapon usually targets an area, you target a single 5-foot square instead. The siege weapon deals its normal damage to its target, or to the modified area, and to the creature fired.
_desc_ko: 대포에서 발사되거나 투석기에 실려 날아가는 것만큼 무모한 일은 거의 없지만, 절박한 상황에서는 가끔 이런 전술을 사용하기도 합니다. 이 전략은 무의식적인 구조물이나 언데드에게 사용하는 것이 더 인도적이지만, 가끔 지나치게 무모한 모험가가 직접 시도해 보겠다고 요구하기도 합니다. 생물을 장전하려면 두 번의 추가 장전 행동이 필요하며, 반드시 직접 수행해야 한다. 생물은 이 과정 내내 @link[conditions.unconscious]이거나 @link[conditions.restrained]여야 하며, 해당 생물의 크기와 형태에 따라 공성 무기가 물리적으로 발사할 수 있어야 한다. 일반적으로 이는 발리스타가 해당되지 않음을 의미한다. 예를 들어 특정 크기의 포탄이 필요한 자동 투석기도 마찬가지다. 그러나 일반 투석기와 오나거는 문제없이 사용 가능하다. 무기를 발사할 때, 해당 무기가 일반적으로 영역을 목표로 삼는다면 대신 단일 5피트 칸을 목표로 삼는다. 공성 무기는 목표물 또는 조정된 영역과 발사된 생물에게 정상적인 피해를 입힌다.

name: Conduit of Void and Vitality

description.value:
Requirements You have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} as a signature spell and an available spell slot to cast it with.

You use the unstable energy of your curse to manipulate the most basic of divine magic. You cast a 3-action heal or harm spell, expending the slot as normal. If the spell restores Hit Points to one or more creatures, then one creature healed by this spell regains a number of additional Hit Points equal to 1d8 × your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zXZjC8HLaRoLR17U]{Cursebound} value; if the spell damages one or more creatures, then one creature harmed by this spell takes additional damage equal to 1d8 × your cursebound value.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} as a signature spell and an available spell slot to cast it with.

You use the unstable energy of your curse to manipulate the most basic of divine magic. You cast a 3-action heal or harm spell, expending the slot as normal. If the spell restores Hit Points to one or more creatures, then one creature healed by this spell regains a number of additional Hit Points equal to 1d8 × your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zXZjC8HLaRoLR17U]{Cursebound} value; if the spell damages one or more creatures, then one creature harmed by this spell takes additional damage equal to 1d8 × your cursebound value.
_desc_ko:
Requirements 당신은 @link[spells.heal] 또는 @link[spells.harm]을 시그니처 주문으로 보유하고 있으며, 이를 시전할 수 있는 주문 슬롯이 사용 가능합니다.

당신은 저주의 불안정한 에너지를 이용해 가장 기본적인 신성 마법을 조작합니다. 3액션 소모의 치유 또는 해악 주문을 시전하며, 슬롯은 정상적으로 소모됩니다. 해당 주문이 하나 이상의 생물에게 HP를 회복시킨다면, 이 주문으로 치유받은 생물 중 하나가 1d8 × 당신의 @link[conditions.cursebound] 값에 해당하는 추가 HP를 회복합니다. 해당 주문이 하나 이상의 생물에게 피해를 입혔다면, 이 주문으로 피해를 입은 생물 중 하나가 1d8 × 당신의 저주에 묶인 값에 해당하는 추가 피해를 받습니다.

name: Forward Gaze Into Life

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Despite the constant cold of death at your back, you keep your gaze forward into the realm of life. You release two @Template[type:cone|distance:15]{15-foot cones}, aimed exactly opposite each other, one ahead of you that deals @Damage[5d10[vitality]|options:area-damage] damage and one behind you that deals @Damage[5d10[void]|options:area-damage] damage, each with a @Check[reflex|against:exemplar|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. Creatures that critically fail also take 5 persistent damage, of the same damage type dealt (@Damage[5[persistent,vitality]] or @Damage[5[persistent,void]]).

publication.title: Pathfinder #217: Death Sails a Wine-Dark Sea

Frequency once per hour

Despite the constant cold of death at your back, you keep your gaze forward into the realm of life. _desc_ko:
빈도 시간당 한 번

죽음의 차가운 기운이 등 뒤에서 끊임없이 느껴지지만, 당신은 시선을 앞으로 돌려 생명의 렐름을 응시한다. 두 개의 15피트 원뿔를 정확히 서로 반대 방향으로 발사한다. 하나는 당신 앞쪽에 5d10 활력의 피해를, 다른 하나는 당신 뒤쪽에 5d10 공허의 피해를 입힌다. 각각 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 기본 반사 내성 굴림을 받는다. 대실패를 한 생물은 동일한 피해 유형(5 지속 활력 또는 5 지속 공허)의 지속 피해 5를 추가로 받습니다.

name: Shield Warfare

description.value: You know how to use shields offensively far better than most. Increase the weapon damage die of any shield bash, shield boss, or shield spikes you wield by one step.

_desc_en: You know how to use shields offensively far better than most. Increase the weapon damage die of any shield bash, shield boss, or shield spikes you wield by one step.
_desc_ko: 당신은 대부분의 사람들보다 방패를 공격적으로 사용하는 방법을 훨씬 잘 알고 있습니다. 당신이 휘두르는 방패 강타, 방패 내리치기, 방패 찌르기의 무기 피해 주사위를 한 단계 증가시킵니다.

name: Towering Size

description.value: Your eidolon becomes even bigger. It becomes Huge, instead of Large, and the reach on all its attacks increases to 15 feet.

_desc_en: Your eidolon becomes even bigger. It becomes Huge, instead of Large, and the reach on all its attacks increases to 15 feet.
_desc_ko: 당신의 에이돌론이 더욱 커집니다. 대형에서 초대형으로 변하며, 모든 공격의 도달 범위가 15피트로 증가합니다.

name: Debilitating Dichotomy

description.value: You reveal a glimpse of the impossible conflicts between the divine anathema behind your curse, forcing you to reckon with another's conflicts as well. You and one creature within 30 feet each take @Damage[(3*(floor((@actor.level - 2)/2)))d6[mental]] damage with a @Check[will|against:class-spell|basic] save, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} if it critically fails its save. You get a degree of success one better than you rolled for your saving throw. At 10th level, and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 3d6.

_desc_en: You reveal a glimpse of the impossible conflicts between the divine anathema behind your curse, forcing you to reckon with another's conflicts as well. You and one creature within 30 feet each take @Damage[(3*(floor((@actor.level - 2)/2)))d6[mental]] damage with a @Check[will|against:class-spell|basic] save, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} if it critically fails its save. You get a degree of success one better than you rolled for your saving throw. At 10th level, and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 3d6.
_desc_ko: 당신은 저주 뒤에 숨겨진 신성한 저주 사이의 불가능한 갈등을 엿보게 하여, 타인의 갈등과도 마주하게 합니다. 당신과 30피트 내의 한 마리의 생물은 각각 정신의 피해를 입으며, 기본 의지 내성에 성공하면, 내성에 대실패한 대상은 @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태가 됩니다. 당신은 자신의 내성 굴림 결과보다 한 단계 높은 성공 등급을 얻습니다. 10레벨에 도달하고 이후 2레벨마다 피해량이 3d6씩 증가합니다.

name: Four Winds

description.value:
Mimicking the anemoi-monarchs of the four winds-you propel four creatures. Target up to four willing creatures within 30 feet of you. Each of those creatures can Stride up to half its Speed. If it has a fly Speed, it can instead Fly up to half its fly Speed.

Level (10th) The targets move up to full Speed instead of half.

_desc_en:
Mimicking the anemoi-monarchs of the four winds-you propel four creatures. Target up to four willing creatures within 30 feet of you. Each of those creatures can Stride up to half its Speed. If it has a fly Speed, it can instead Fly up to half its fly Speed.

Level (10th) The targets move up to full Speed instead of half.
_desc_ko:
네 바람의 군주인 아네모이들을 흉내내어 네 마리의 생물을 추진합니다. 당신으로부터 30피트 이내에 있는 최대 네 마리의 동의한 대상들을 대상으로 합니다. 해당 생물 각각은 자신의 이동 속도의 절반까지 이동할 수 있습니다. 비행 이동 속도를 가진 생물은 대신 자신의 비행 이동 속도의 절반까지 비행할 수 있습니다.

레벨 (10th) 대상은 절반 대신 최대 속도로 이동한다.

name: Sense Alignment

description.value:
You read the body language of an intelligent creature within 30 feet and pick up on subtle cues to detect its general propensity for good or evil and law or chaos. The GM rolls a secret @Check[perception|defense:deception|traits:secret] check, comparing the result against the target's Deception DC.

Critical Success You ascertain the target's alignment.

Success You ascertain the target's alignment, but only along one axis (your choice of either the good-evil axis or the lawful-chaotic axis).

Failure You do not learn the target's alignment.

Critical Failure You incorrectly ascertain the target's alignment, misidentifying their alignment along either one axis or both (GM's choice).

publication.title: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace

The GM rolls a secret @Check[perception|defense:deception|traits:secret] check, comparing the result against the target's Deception DC.

_desc_ko:
30피트 내 지능형 생물의 몸짓 언어를 읽고 미묘한 단서를 포착하여 선악 및 질서/혼돈 성향을 감지합니다. GM은 비밀 지각 판정을 굴림하여 결과와 대상의 기만 DC를 비교합니다.

대성공 대상의 성향을 확인합니다.

성공 당신은 대상의 성향을 확인하지만, 단 하나의 축(선악 축 또는 질서-혼돈 축 중 선택)에 대해서만 확인합니다.

실패 대상의 성향을 알지 못합니다.

대실패 대상의 성향을 잘못 파악하여 한 축 또는 양축 모두에서 성향을 오인합니다(GM 선택).

name: Riddle The Sphinx

description.value:
Usage imbued into a body ikon

You've learned the secrets of the sphinx's riddles and empowered your ikon with them. You can voice these mysteries, forcing others to overcome them as you did.

Transcendence—@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cGCQkCz14sF238gE]{Tangle in Riddle} 1 (auditory, mental, transcendence)

스핑크스의 수수께끼 비밀을 깨닫고 그 힘으로 이콘을 강화했다. 이제 이 신비를 말로 풀어내어, 다른 이들도 너처럼 이를 극복하도록 강요할 수 있다.

name: Fetchling Lore

description.value: You've learned obscure lessons about your fellow fetchlings. You're trained in Occultism and Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also become trained in Shadow Plane Lore.

_desc_en: You've learned obscure lessons about your fellow fetchlings. You're trained in Occultism and Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also become trained in Shadow Plane Lore.
_desc_ko: 동족 페츨링에 관한 희귀한 지식을 습득했습니다. 오컬트와 은신에 숙련되어 있습니다. 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 자동으로 숙련되는 기술이 있다면, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다. 또한 그림자계 지식에 숙련됩니다.

name: Rites of Convocation

description.value: Your patron grants you the power to summon other creatures to aid you. Choose one summon spell (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4YnON9JHYqtLzccu]{Summon Animal}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lKcsmeOrgHtK4xQa]{Summon Construct}, and so forth) that appears on the spell list of your spellcasting tradition. You can spend 10 minutes in communion with your familiar to replace one spell you've prepared in one of your witch spell slots with the spell you chose, heightened to the same rank. The spell you replaced must be of at least the summon spell's minimum spell rank.

_desc_en: Your patron grants you the power to summon other creatures to aid you. Choose one summon spell (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4YnON9JHYqtLzccu]{Summon Animal}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lKcsmeOrgHtK4xQa]{Summon Construct}, and so forth) that appears on the spell list of your spellcasting tradition. You can spend 10 minutes in communion with your familiar to replace one spell you've prepared in one of your witch spell slots with the spell you chose, heightened to the same rank. The spell you replaced must be of at least the summon spell's minimum spell rank.
_desc_ko: 당신의 후원자는 다른 생물을 소환하여 도움을 받을 수 있는 힘을 부여합니다. 당신의 주술 전통 주문 목록에 등장하는 소환 주문 하나(예: @link[spells.summon-animal], @link[spells.summon-construct] 등)을 선택하십시오. 패밀리어와 10분간 교감하여 준비한 마녀 주문 슬롯 중 하나를 선택한 주문으로 대체할 수 있으며, 동일한 랭크으로 강화됩니다. 대체된 주문은 최소한 소환 주문의 최소 주문 랭크 이상이어야 합니다.

name: Ally's Shelter

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You attempt a saving throw while adjacent to one or more allies, but you haven't rolled yet.

You follow your allies' example. Roll the save using an adjacent ally's modifier for that type of saving throw instead of your own.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You attempt a saving throw while adjacent to one or more allies, but you haven't rolled yet.

You follow your allies' example. Roll the save using an adjacent ally's modifier for that type of saving throw instead of your own.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

트리거 한 명 이상의 아군과 인접한 상태에서 내성 굴림을 시도하지만, 아직 굴리지 않은 경우.

아군의 행동을 따른다. 해당 내성 굴림의 유형에 대해 자신의 수정자 대신 인접한 아군의 수정자를 사용하여 내성 굴림을 굴립니다.

name: Bullet Dancer Dedication

description.value:
You mix guns and melee into a deadly art. You gain the Bullet Dancer Stance action. You are also granted familiarity with bayonets, reinforced stocks, martial firearms, and martial combination weapons; for the purposes of proficiency and abilities from this archetype, you treat bayonets, reinforced stocks, martial firearms, and martial combination weapons as simple weapons. You gain access to uncommon combination weapons that have a firearm ranged form.
