name: Embrace the Pain

description.value:
Trigger A creature within your reach damages you with a melee attack.

Ignoring your pain, you reach out and grab the creature or weapon that caused you harm. Attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} the triggering creature or to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} the creature of the weapon it damaged you with.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature within your reach damages you with a melee attack.

Ignoring your pain, you reach out and grab the creature or weapon that caused you harm. Attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} the triggering creature or to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} the creature of the weapon it damaged you with.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신의 도달 범위 내 생물이 근접 공격으로 당신에게 피해를 입힙니다.

고통을 무릅쓰고, 당신은 손을 뻗어 당신에게 해를 입힌 생물이나 무기를 붙잡기를 시도합니다. 운동 판정을 시도하여 @link[actions.grapple]을 시도하여 유발한 생물을 제압하거나, @link[actions.disarm]을 시도하여 그 생물이 당신에게 피해를 준 무기를 빼앗으려 한다.

name: First Frost

description.value: The gelid shard within your heart may sap your ability to feel and experience emotion, but it also lets you create and manipulate cold. You learn to cast arcane spontaneous spells, and you gain a spell repertoire with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IxhGEKl63R4QBvkj]{Frostbite} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WFSazGLCUuPsBv1p]{Frost's Touch} cantrips. You're trained in spell attack modifier and spell DC. Your key spellcasting attribute is Charisma.

_desc_en: The gelid shard within your heart may sap your ability to feel and experience emotion, but it also lets you create and manipulate cold. You learn to cast arcane spontaneous spells, and you gain a spell repertoire with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IxhGEKl63R4QBvkj]{Frostbite} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WFSazGLCUuPsBv1p]{Frost's Touch} cantrips. You're trained in spell attack modifier and spell DC. Your key spellcasting attribute is Charisma.
_desc_ko: 심장 속의 얼음 조각은 감정을 느끼고 경험하는 능력을 약화시킬 수 있지만, 동시에 냉기를 창조하고 조종할 수 있게 합니다. 당신은 아케인 의 즉흥 주문을 시전하는 법을 배우며, @link[spells.frostbite]과 @link[spells.frosts-touch] 캔트립으로 구성된 주문 목록을 얻습니다. 주문 공격 수정자 및 주문 DC에 숙련됩니다. 주문 시전에 필요한 핵심 능력치는 매력입니다.

name: Talmandor's Shout

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You witnessed a creature deal damage to an ally within 30 feet since your last turn.

After seeing an enemy harm one of your allies, you deliver a righteous shout in the name of the celestial Talmandor. Attempt an Intimidation check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}, comparing the result to the Will DC of each enemy within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:60]; this Demoralize attempt doesn't take any penalty for not sharing a language. It's possible to get a different degree of success for each target.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You witnessed a creature deal damage to an ally within 30 feet since your last turn.

After seeing an enemy harm one of your allies, you deliver a righteous shout in the name of the celestial Talmandor. Attempt an Intimidation check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}, comparing the result to the Will DC of each enemy within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:60]; this Demoralize attempt doesn't take any penalty for not sharing a language. It's possible to get a different degree of success for each target.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

요구 사항 지난 턴 이후 30피트 내 아군이 적에게 피해를 입는 것을 목격했을 때.

적 중 하나가 아군을 해치는 것을 목격한 후, 당신은 천상체의 탈만도르의 이름으로 의로운 함성을 지른다. @link[actions.demoralize]를 위해 협박 판정을 시도하고, 그 결과를 60피트 발산 범위 내 각 적의 의지 DC(Will DC)와 비교한다. 이 사기 저하 시도는 언어를 공유하지 않아도 페널티를 받지 않는다. 대상마다 다른 성공 정도를 얻을 수 있습니다.

name: Lingering Breath

description.value: Your draconic breath destroys the surrounding environment and leaves your enemies in pain. When you use Breath of the Dragon, the area of your breath becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute. In addition, a creature who fails or critically fails its saving throw takes 2d6 persistent damage of the same type.

_desc_en: Your draconic breath destroys the surrounding environment and leaves your enemies in pain. When you use Breath of the Dragon, the area of your breath becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute. In addition, a creature who fails or critically fails its saving throw takes 2d6 persistent damage of the same type.
_desc_ko: 당신의 드라코닉 숨결은 주변 환경을 파괴하고 적들에게 고통을 남깁니다. 드래곤의 숨결을 사용할 때, 숨결이 닿은 지역은 1분 동안 어려운 지형이 됩니다. 또한, 내성 굴림에서 실패하거나 대실패한 생물은 동일한 유형의 지속 피해 2d6을 입습니다.

name: Devil in Plain Sight

description.value: You've learned to draw your fiendish nature into a small ball of corruption and hide it in your soul. Your obviously fiendish traits disappear, including any tails, horns, and cloven hooves, though hints remain (claws turn into jagged nails or eyes retain an odd hue, for instance). You're still recognizably yourself, but now appear as a typical, non-tiefling member of your base ancestry. Using Devil in Plain Sight counts as creating a disguise when using Deception to Impersonate, and your transformation automatically defeats Perception DCs to determine if you're a normal member of your base ancestry; only creatures actively rolling Perception to examine you might notice the disguise. While in your shapeshifted form, you can't use unarmed attacks, innate spells, or other abilities that require physical features you receive from a tiefling ancestry feat—for instance, you can't use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.aVRuchEAJIvnd70k]{Skillful Tail} feat. You can remain in your alternate form indefinitely, and can shift back to your tiefling form by using this action again.

_desc_en: You've learned to draw your fiendish nature into a small ball of corruption and hide it in your soul. Your obviously fiendish traits disappear, including any tails, horns, and cloven hooves, though hints remain (claws turn into jagged nails or eyes retain an odd hue, for instance). You're still recognizably yourself, but now appear as a typical, non-tiefling member of your base ancestry. Using Devil in Plain Sight counts as creating a disguise when using Deception to Impersonate, and your transformation automatically defeats Perception DCs to determine if you're a normal member of your base ancestry; only creatures actively rolling Perception to examine you might notice the disguise. While in your shapeshifted form, you can't use unarmed attacks, innate spells, or other abilities that require physical features you receive from a tiefling ancestry feat—for instance, you can't use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.aVRuchEAJIvnd70k]{Skillful Tail} feat. You can remain in your alternate form indefinitely, and can shift back to your tiefling form by using this action again.
_desc_ko: 당신은 악마적인 본성을 작은 타락의 구슬로 응축해 영혼 속에 {숨기}는 법을 터득했습니다. 꼬리, 뿔, 갈라진 발굽 등 명백한 악마적 특징은 사라지지만, 흔적은 남습니다(예를 들어 발톱은 들쭉날쭉한 손톱으로 변하거나 눈동자는 특이한 색조를 유지함). 여전히 본인의 정체성은 유지되지만, 이제 기본 종족의 평범한 티플링이 아닌 구성원으로 보인다. '눈앞의 데빌' 사용은 기만 능력으로 변장할 때 위장 생성으로 간주되며, 이 변신은 기본 종족의 평범한 구성원인지 판단하는 지각 DC를 자동으로 무력화한다. 오직 적극적으로 지각 검사를 굴리며 당신을 관찰하는 생물만이 위장을 알아챌 수 있다. 변신 형태에서는 비무장 공격, 선천적 주문, 티플링 혈통 재주로 얻은 신체적 특징이 필요한 능력(예: @link[feats.skillful-tail] 재주)을 사용할 수 없습니다. 대체 형태는 무기한 유지할 수 있으며, 이 행동을 다시 사용해 티플링 형태로 되돌아갈 수 있습니다.

name: Consecrated Aura

description.value:
Your body radiates vitality energy, making your very presence disorienting to undead and encouraging them to move away from you. The effect plays upon the instincts flowing through their bodies from void energy and can thus affect even mindless creatures. You gain an aura of vitality energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:20]. Each undead creature that ends its turn in your aura must succeed at a Will save against your spell DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure). A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Special Your aura gains the trait of the magical tradition for the spells you used to qualify for Hallowed Necromancer Dedication.

_desc_en:
Your body radiates vitality energy, making your very presence disorienting to undead and encouraging them to move away from you. The effect plays upon the instincts flowing through their bodies from void energy and can thus affect even mindless creatures. You gain an aura of vitality energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:20]. Each undead creature that ends its turn in your aura must succeed at a Will save against your spell DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure). A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Special Your aura gains the trait of the magical tradition for the spells you used to qualify for Hallowed Necromancer Dedication.
_desc_ko:
당신의 몸에서 활력 에너지가 방출되어, 당신의 존재 자체가 언데드에게 혼란을 주고 그들로 하여금 당신에게서 멀어지도록 유도합니다. 이 효과는 공허 에너지로부터 그들의 몸에 흐르는 본능을 이용하므로, 무의식적인 생물에게도 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다. 당신은 20피트 반경 내에 활력 에너지의 오라를 얻습니다. 당신의 오라 안에 턴을 종료하는 모든 언데드 생물은 당신의 주문 DC에 대한 의지 내성에 성공해야 하며, 실패 시 @link[conditions.frightened]{1} 상태가 됩니다(대실패 시 @link[conditions.frightened]{2} 상태). 저항에 성공한 생물은 1분 동안 일시적으로 면역 상태가 됩니다.

특수 당신의 오라는 신성한 네크로맨서 헌신 자격을 얻기 위해 사용한 주문들의 마법 전통 특성을 획득합니다.

name: Disorienting Opening

description.value: You use your foes' openings to expose even greater weaknesses. When you hit a creature as part of a Reactive Strike, that creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn.

_desc_en: You use your foes' openings to expose even greater weaknesses. When you hit a creature as part of a Reactive Strike, that creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn.
_desc_ko: 적의 허점을 이용해 더 큰 약점을 드러낸다. 반응 공격으로 생물을 명중시킬 경우, 해당 생물은 다음 차례 시작까지 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 된다.

name: Anadi Lore

description.value: You've learned how to provide for your community, be it through hard-earned sustenance or useful crafts. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Crafting and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you become trained in a skill of your choice. You also become trained in Anadi Lore.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: You've learned how to provide for your community, be it through hard-earned sustenance or useful crafts. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Crafting and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you become trained in a skill of your choice. You also become trained in Anadi Lore.
_desc_ko:
고된 노력으로 얻은 생계 수단이나 유용한 제작을 통해 공동체를 부양하는 법을 익혔습니다. 제작과 생존 기술에 숙련 등급을 획득합니다. 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 자동으로 숙련 상태가 되는 기술이 있다면, 원하는 기술 하나를 선택하여 숙련 상태가 됩니다. 또한 아나디 지식에 숙련 상태가 됩니다.

참고: 이 피트로 부여되는 기술에 이미 숙련된 경우, 대체 기술을 수동으로 선택해야 합니다. 부여되는 지식 기술도 수동으로 입력해야 합니다.

name: Summon Metal Elemental

description.value: You can summon an elemental ally. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lpT6LotUaQPfinjj]{Summon Elemental} as a 5th-rank primal innate spell, but the elemental summoned must be a metal elemental.

_desc_en: You can summon an elemental ally. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lpT6LotUaQPfinjj]{Summon Elemental} as a 5th-rank primal innate spell, but the elemental summoned must be a metal elemental.
_desc_ko: 원소 동료를 소환할 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, @link[spells.summon-elemental]을 (5th)랭크 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있으나, 소환된 원소는 금속 원소여야 합니다.

name: Pain is Temporary

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Sangpotshi practitioners know that suffering is a fleeting sensation that ultimately strengthens the soul and prepares it for a new reincarnation. Bolstered by this understanding, you've learned to temporarily steel yourself against all forms of pain. You gain resistance 10 to all damage until the end of your next turn.

publication.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

_desc_en:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Sangpotshi practitioners know that suffering is a fleeting sensation that ultimately strengthens the soul and prepares it for a new reincarnation. Bolstered by this understanding, you've learned to temporarily steel yourself against all forms of pain. You gain resistance 10 to all damage until the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
발생 빈도 10분마다 한 번

싱폿시 수행자들은 고통이 결국 영혼을 단련시키고 새로운 환생을 준비시키는 덧없는 감각임을 안다. 이 깨달음에 힘입어, 당신은 모든 형태의 고통에 일시적으로 자신을 단련하는 법을 배웠다. 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 모든 피해에 대해 저항력 10을 얻는다.

name: Side by Side (Druid)

description.value: You and your animal companion fight in tandem, distracting your foes and keeping them off balance. Whenever you and your animal companion are adjacent to the same foe, you are both flanking that foe with each other, regardless of your actual positions.

_desc_en: You and your animal companion fight in tandem, distracting your foes and keeping them off balance. Whenever you and your animal companion are adjacent to the same foe, you are both flanking that foe with each other, regardless of your actual positions.
_desc_ko: 당신과 동물 동료는 함께 싸우며 적의 주의를 분산시키고 균형을 무너뜨립니다. 당신과 동물 동료가 동일한 적과 인접해 있을 때마다, 실제 위치와 상관없이 서로를 통해 그 적을 측면 공격합니다.

name: Kizidhar Magic

description.value: You can wield the arcane magic of a kizidhar, casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.J6vNvrUT3b1hx2iA]{Entangling Flora} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dileJ0Yxqg76LMvu]{One with Plants} once per day each as 2nd-rank arcane innate spells.

_desc_en: You can wield the arcane magic of a kizidhar, casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.J6vNvrUT3b1hx2iA]{Entangling Flora} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dileJ0Yxqg76LMvu]{One with Plants} once per day each as 2nd-rank arcane innate spells.
_desc_ko: 당신은 키지다르의 비전 아케인 마법을 휘둘러 @link[spells.entangling-flora]과 @link[spells.one-with-plants]을 각각 하루에 한 번씩 (2nd)랭크 아케인 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Death from Above

description.value:
Requirements You are standing, climbing, or balancing on a surface at least 10 feet above your target.

You leap down on your target, using their body to cushion your fall and your momentum to empower your attack. Attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} to a space adjacent to the target. If you land adjacent to the target, compare the @Check[athletics|defense:reflex] check result against your target's Reflex DC.

When you leap onto a creature in this way, you do not also deal damage for falling on a creature. Regardless of your result, the target is temporarily immune to your Death from Above for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target falls and lands @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, reducing the falling damage you take by an amount equal to twice your level. You then can make a melee Strike against the target. The Strike gains the deadly d8 weapon property and deals an additional 1d6 bludgeoning damage. This additional damage increases to 2d6 if you are a master in Athletics, and to 3d6 if you are legendary in Athletics.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the beginning of your next turn, reducing the falling damage you take by an amount equal to your level. You can then make a melee Strike against the target, adding the deadly d8 weapon property to the attack.

Failure You can make a Strike against the target.

Critical Failure You fall prone, whether you take falling damage or not.

You leap down on your target, using their body to cushion your fall and your momentum to empower your attack. Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the beginning of your next turn, reducing the falling damage you take by an amount equal to your level. You can then make a melee Strike against the target, adding the deadly d8 weapon property to the attack.

Failure You can make a Strike against the target.

Critical Failure You fall prone, whether you take falling damage or not.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 대상보다 최소 10피트 높은 지면에 서 있거나, 올라가 있거나, 균형을 잡고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 목표물을 향해 뛰어내리며, 그들의 몸을 낙하 완충재로 사용하고 관성을 공격에 활용합니다. @link[actions.leap] 운동 판정을 시도하여 목표물 인접 공간으로 이동하십시오. 목표물 인접 공간에 착지하면, 운동 판정 결과를 목표물의 반사 DC와 비교하십시오.

이 방식으로 생물 위로 도약할 때, 생물 위로 추락하는 데 따른 추가 피해를 입히지 않습니다. 결과와 상관없이 대상은 1분 동안 당신의 '하늘에서 내리는 죽음'에 대해 일시적으로 면역 상태가 됩니다.

대성공 대상은 추락하여 @link[conditions.prone]로 착지하며, 당신이 받는 추락 피해를 당신의 레벨의 두 배에 해당하는 양만큼 감소시킵니다. 이후 대상에게 근접 공격을 가할 수 있다. 이 공격은 치명적인 d8 무기 속성을 얻으며 추가로 1d6 타격 피해를 입힌다. 이 추가 피해는 운동 달인일 경우 2d6로, 운동 전설적일 경우 3d6로 증가한다.

성공 대상은 다음 차례 시작까지 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 되어, 받는 추락 피해를 레벨만큼 감소시킵니다. 이후 대상에게 근접 공격을 가할 수 있으며, 공격에 치명적인 d8 무기 속성을 부여합니다.

실패 대상에게 공격을 가할 수 있습니다.

대실패 낙하 피해를 입었는지 여부와 상관없이 넘어집니다.

name: Crafter's Instinct

description.value:
Access You are from Dongun Hold or Alkenstar.

Frequency once per day

Trigger You misfire with a firearm or you roll a failure on a Strike with a ranged weapon.

You sense a minor flaw in the weapon as you fire it, and quickly adjust your aim on the fly to avoid the flaw. If the triggering Strike was a misfire, you get a normal failure instead. If the triggering Strike was a failure, it becomes a glancing blow that deals minimum damage for the Strike (adding any bonuses as normal but getting a result of 1 for all damage dice that would be rolled on a success). The glancing blow does not apply other effects that would normally happen only on a hit.

_desc_en:
Access You are from Dongun Hold or Alkenstar.

Frequency once per day

Trigger You misfire with a firearm or you roll a failure on a Strike with a ranged weapon.

You sense a minor flaw in the weapon as you fire it, and quickly adjust your aim on the fly to avoid the flaw. If the triggering Strike was a misfire, you get a normal failure instead. If the triggering Strike was a failure, it becomes a glancing blow that deals minimum damage for the Strike (adding any bonuses as normal but getting a result of 1 for all damage dice that would be rolled on a success). The glancing blow does not apply other effects that would normally happen only on a hit.
_desc_ko:
사용 조건 동군 홀드 또는 알켄스터 출신이어야 합니다.

발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 화기 사격 시 오발하거나 원거리 무기 공격 시 실패를 굴렸을 때.

발사하는 순간 무기에 사소한 결함을 감지하고, 재빨리 조준을 수정하여 결함을 피합니다. 발동한 공격이 오발이었다면 일반 실패로 변경됩니다. 발동한 공격이 실패였다면, 공격의 최소 피해만 주는 스치기 공격으로 변경됩니다(보너스는 정상적으로 적용되나, 성공 시 굴려야 할 모든 피해 주사위 결과는 1로 처리됩니다). 스치기는 일반적으로 명중 시에만 발생하는 다른 효과는 적용하지 않는다.

name: Scars of Steel

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger An opponent critically hits you with an attack that deals physical damage.

When you are struck with the mightiest of blows, you can flex your muscles to turn aside some of the damage. You gain resistance to the triggering attack equal to your Constitution modifier plus half your level.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger An opponent critically hits you with an attack that deals physical damage.

When you are struck with the mightiest of blows, you can flex your muscles to turn aside some of the damage. You gain resistance to the triggering attack equal to your Constitution modifier plus half your level.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

Trigger 상대가 물리 피해를 주는 공격으로 당신에게 치명타를 입힙니다.

가장 강력한 타격을 받았을 때, 근육을 긴장시켜 일부 피해를 회피할 수 있습니다. 해당 공격에 대해 건강 수정자에 레벨의 절반을 더한 만큼의 저항력을 얻습니다.

name: Viking Weapon Familiarity

description.value:
From childhood, you have been exposed to traditional viking combat techniques, and you soon learned to handle axe, sword, and shield in battle. Now, you can raid proudly alongside your fellows. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction. Additionally, you have familiarity with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.War0uyLBx1jA0Ge7]{Battle Axe}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.LGgvev6AV0So8tP9]{Hatchet}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.LJdbVTOZog39EEbi]{Longsword}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.dfum7DpOEkwxwTsT]{Shield Boss}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.nSO0Z662LkkLfa2u]{Shield Spikes}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.7tKkkF8eZ4iCLJtp]{Shortsword}—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these weapons as simple weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

_desc_en:
From childhood, you have been exposed to traditional viking combat techniques, and you soon learned to handle axe, sword, and shield in battle. Now, you can raid proudly alongside your fellows. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction. Additionally, you have familiarity with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.War0uyLBx1jA0Ge7]{Battle Axe}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.LGgvev6AV0So8tP9]{Hatchet}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.LJdbVTOZog39EEbi]{Longsword}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.dfum7DpOEkwxwTsT]{Shield Boss}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.nSO0Z662LkkLfa2u]{Shield Spikes}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.7tKkkF8eZ4iCLJtp]{Shortsword}—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these weapons as simple weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
_desc_ko:
어릴 적부터 전통적인 바이킹 전투 기술을 접해왔으며, 전투에서 도끼, 검, 방패를 다루는 법을 금세 익혔습니다. 이제 동료들과 함께 당당히 약탈에 나설 수 있습니다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{방패 막기} 반응을 얻습니다. 추가로, 당신은 @link[equipment.battle-axe], @link[equipment.hatchet], @link[equipment.longsword], @link[equipment.shield-boss], @link[equipment.shield-spikes]에 대한 패밀리어를 가지고 있습니다. @link[equipment.shortsword]에 대한 숙련도 목적으로, 이 무기들을 모두 단순 무기로 취급합니다.

5레벨에 도달하면, 이 무기들로 치명타를 기록할 때마다 해당 무기의 치명타 특화 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Hero-God's Bond

description.value:
At times, the myth of a hero-god includes a favored partner or a bonded ally, such as the hero-gods of promises and shield-bearers, Upion and Warrick. When you gain this feat, select an ally. They are your bonded partner. While you and your bonded partner are on the same plane, you and your bonded partner always have the same doomed value (defaulting to the highest value), so when your bonded partner's doomed condition would increase or be set to a specific amount, your doomed value also increases to match (if it is lower than your current doomed value). When either of you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}, the other knows this immediately, as well as the distance and direction to the dying partner's location. When either of you attempts a recovery check, as long as the other is on the same plane, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the check. You can communicate telepathically with your bonded partner as long as you are within 60 feet of each other.

You can change your bonded partner by spending 1 week of downtime bonding with another ally.

_desc_en:
At times, the myth of a hero-god includes a favored partner or a bonded ally, such as the hero-gods of promises and shield-bearers, Upion and Warrick. When you gain this feat, select an ally. They are your bonded partner. While you and your bonded partner are on the same plane, you and your bonded partner always have the same doomed value (defaulting to the highest value), so when your bonded partner's doomed condition would increase or be set to a specific amount, your doomed value also increases to match (if it is lower than your current doomed value). When either of you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}, the other knows this immediately, as well as the distance and direction to the dying partner's location. When either of you attempts a recovery check, as long as the other is on the same plane, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the check. You can communicate telepathically with your bonded partner as long as you are within 60 feet of each other.

You can change your bonded partner by spending 1 week of downtime bonding with another ally.
_desc_ko:
때로는 영웅 신의 신화에는 약속의 영웅 신과 방패의 영웅 신인 우피온과 워릭처럼 선호하는 동반자나 결속된 동맹이 등장한다. 이 피트를 획득할 때 동맹을 선택한다. 그들은 당신의 결속된 동반자가 됩니다. 당신과 결속된 동반자가 동일한 차원에 있을 때, 당신과 결속된 동반자는 항상 동일한 운명 수치(기본값은 가장 높은 수치)를 가지므로, 결속된 동반자의 운명 상태가 증가하거나 특정 수치로 설정될 때, 당신의 운명 수치도 그에 맞춰 증가합니다(현재 운명 수치보다 낮을 경우). 둘 중 한 명이 @link[conditions.dying] 상태가 되면, 상대방은 즉시 이를 인지하며 죽어가는 파트너의 위치까지의 거리와 방향도 알게 됩니다. 둘 중 한 명 이 회복 판정을 시도할 때, 상대방이 같은 차원에 있는 한 해당 판정에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 서로 60피트 이내에 있는 한, 결속된 파트너와 텔레파시로 소통할 수 있습니다.

다운타임 1주일을 소모하여 다른 아군과 유대를 형성함으로써 유대 파트너를 변경할 수 있습니다.

name: Practiced Brawn

description.value: You're accustomed to long days filled with hard physical labor. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, and to Fortitude saving throws to resist becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}. When you roll a success on an Athletics check to Shove, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: You're accustomed to long days filled with hard physical labor. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, and to Fortitude saving throws to resist becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}. When you roll a success on an Athletics check to Shove, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 힘든 육체 노동으로 가득 찬 긴 날들에 익숙합니다. 다음 운동 판정에서 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다: @link[actions.force-open] 및 @link[actions.shove], 및 @link[conditions.fatigued]에 저항하는 인내 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 받습니다. 밀치기 운동 판정에서 성공을 굴릴 경우, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Hell-Lancer Shot

description.value: Make a ranged Strike with a firearm against a fiend, ignoring the fiend's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition and any lesser cover. If this Strike hits, you gain a circumstance bonus to damage equal to twice the number of weapon damage dice. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty.

_desc_en: Make a ranged Strike with a firearm against a fiend, ignoring the fiend's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition and any lesser cover. If this Strike hits, you gain a circumstance bonus to damage equal to twice the number of weapon damage dice. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty.
_desc_ko: 악마를 상대로 화기 원거리 타격을 하되, 악마의 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{은폐} 상태와 모든 낮은 엄폐를 무시한다. 이 타격이 명중하면, 당신은 무기 피해 주사위 개수의 두 배와 동일한 피해 상황 보너스를 얻는다. 이는 다중공격 페널티를 계산할 때 두 번의 공격으로 간주된다.

name: Greater Magical Edification

description.value: You've continued to expand your compendium of tools to compile knowledge. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vTQvfYu2llKQedmY]{Translate}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.D442XMADp01qJ7Cs]{Mindlink}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VVAZPCvd4d90qVA1]{Secret Page} as innate occult spells, each once per day. When you cast secret page, it is automatically heightened to the same spell rank as your cantrips from Magical Edification.

_desc_en: You've continued to expand your compendium of tools to compile knowledge. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vTQvfYu2llKQedmY]{Translate}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.D442XMADp01qJ7Cs]{Mindlink}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VVAZPCvd4d90qVA1]{Secret Page} as innate occult spells, each once per day. When you cast secret page, it is automatically heightened to the same spell rank as your cantrips from Magical Edification.
_desc_ko: 지식을 편찬하기 위한 도구 모음을 계속 확장해 왔습니다. @link[spells.translate], @link[spells.mindlink], 그리고 @link[spells.secret-page]를 선천적 오컬트 주문으로 하루에 한 번씩 시전할 수 있습니다. 비밀의 페이지를 시전할 때, 이 주문은 자동으로 마법적 계발의 캔트립과 동일한 주문 랭크으로 강화됩니다.

name: Ghostsong

description.value: You have come to understand the pain and fury of spirits and can raise them to do your ghastly work. When you Raise your Horde, you can choose spirits instead of skeletons or zombies. When you do so, your horde gains the incorporeal trait and immunity to disease, poison, and precision damage, and your horde's Mobbing Assault deals void damage.

_desc_en: You have come to understand the pain and fury of spirits and can raise them to do your ghastly work. When you Raise your Horde, you can choose spirits instead of skeletons or zombies. When you do so, your horde gains the incorporeal trait and immunity to disease, poison, and precision damage, and your horde's Mobbing Assault deals void damage.
_desc_ko: 당신은 영혼들의 고통과 분노를 이해하게 되었으며, 그들을 소환하여 당신의 가스트한 일을 수행하게 할 수 있습니다. 군단을 소환할 때 해골이나 좀비 대신 영혼을 선택할 수 있다. 이 경우 군단은 비물질 특성과 질병, 독, 정밀 피해에 대한 면역을 얻으며, 군단의 집단 공격은 공허 피해를 입힌다.

name: Enduring Alchemy

description.value: You've learned how to make your personal energy last just a little bit longer when quickly brewing ad hoc concoctions. When using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.yzNJgwzV9XqEhKc6]{Quick Alchemy} to create an alchemical tool or elixir, that tool or elixir remains potent until the end of your next turn, instead of losing its potency at the start of your next turn.

_desc_en: You've learned how to make your personal energy last just a little bit longer when quickly brewing ad hoc concoctions. When using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.yzNJgwzV9XqEhKc6]{Quick Alchemy} to create an alchemical tool or elixir, that tool or elixir remains potent until the end of your next turn, instead of losing its potency at the start of your next turn.
_desc_ko: 당신은 즉석에서 조제하는 혼합물을 만들 때 개인의 에너지를 조금 더 오래 지속시키는 법을 터득했습니다. @link[actions.quick-alchemy]로 연금술 도구나 엘릭서를 생성할 때, 그 도구나 엘릭서는 다음 턴 시작 시 효능을 잃지 않고 다음 턴 종료 시까지 효능을 유지한다.

name: Versatile Performance

description.value:
You can rely on the grandeur of your performances rather than ordinary social skills. You can use Performance instead of Diplomacy to [[/act make-an-impression statistic=performance]] and instead of Intimidation to [[/act demoralize statistic=performance]]. You can also use an acting Performance instead of Deception to [[/act impersonate statistic=performance]].

In addition, you can use your proficiency rank in Performance to meet the prerequisites of skill feats that require a particular proficiency rank in Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation.

_desc_en:
You can rely on the grandeur of your performances rather than ordinary social skills. You can use Performance instead of Diplomacy to [[/act make-an-impression statistic=performance]] and instead of Intimidation to [[/act demoralize statistic=performance]]. You can also use an acting Performance instead of Deception to [[/act impersonate statistic=performance]].

In addition, you can use your proficiency rank in Performance to meet the prerequisites of skill feats that require a particular proficiency rank in Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation.
_desc_ko:
평범한 사회 기술 대신 화려한 공연 실력에 의존할 수 있습니다. 인상 남기기 (공연)을 위해 외교 대신 공연을, 사기 꺾기 (공연)을 위해 협박 대신 공연을 사용할 수 있습니다. 또한 사칭 (공연)을 위해 기만 대신 연기 공연을 사용할 수 있습니다.

또한 공연 숙련도 등급을 활용하여 기만, 외교, 협박 중 특정 숙련도 등급을 요구하는 기술 피트 전제 조건을 충족시킬 수 있습니다.

name: Mixed Maneuver

description.value: You leverage your knowledge of martial arts to mix different maneuvers together into a single flowing combination. Choose any two of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}. Attempt both of the attacks you chose against the same or different creatures, but don't apply the multiple attack penalty until after resolving both attacks.

_desc_en: You leverage your knowledge of martial arts to mix different maneuvers together into a single flowing combination. Choose any two of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}. Attempt both of the attacks you chose against the same or different creatures, but don't apply the multiple attack penalty until after resolving both attacks.
_desc_ko: 당신은 무술 지식을 활용해 서로 다른 기동을 하나의 유연한 연속 동작으로 결합합니다. @link[actions.grapple], @link[actions.reposition], @link[actions.shove], @link[actions.trip] 중 두 가지를 선택한다. 선택한 두 공격을 동일하거나 다른 생물에게 시도하되, 두 공격을 모두 해결한 후에야 다중 공격 페널티를 적용한다.

name: Pickpocket

description.value: You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ijZ0DDFpMkWqaShd]{Palm an Object} that's closely guarded, such as in a pocket, without taking the –5 penalty. You can't steal objects that would be extremely noticeable or time consuming to remove (like worn shoes or armor or actively wielded objects). If you're a master in Thievery, you can attempt to Steal from a creature in combat or otherwise on guard. When doing so, Stealing requires 2 actions instead of 1, and you take a –5 penalty.

_desc_en: You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ijZ0DDFpMkWqaShd]{Palm an Object} that's closely guarded, such as in a pocket, without taking the –5 penalty. You can't steal objects that would be extremely noticeable or time consuming to remove (like worn shoes or armor or actively wielded objects). If you're a master in Thievery, you can attempt to Steal from a creature in combat or otherwise on guard. When doing so, Stealing requires 2 actions instead of 1, and you take a –5 penalty.
_desc_ko: 주머니처럼 엄중히 경계되는 장소에 있는 물건을 @link[actions.steal]하거나 @link[actions.palm-an-object]할 때 -5 페널티를 받지 않습니다. 극도로 눈에 띄거나 제거하는 데 시간이 많이 걸리는 물건(신발이나 갑옷, 사용 중인 물건 등)은 훔칠 수 없습니다. 도둑질 마스터라면 전투 중이거나 경계 중인 생물에게 훔치기를 시도할 수 있습니다. 이 경우 훔치기에는 1회가 아닌 2회의 행동이 필요하며, -5 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Brine May

description.value: Your mother was a sea hag, granting you one sea-green or blue eye. You find comfort both in the sea and on the shore. Whenever you roll a success on an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c8TGiZ48ygoSPofx]{Swim}, you get a critical success instead. If you end your turn in water without having succeeded at a Swim action that round, you don't sink (but you might still be moved by the current).

rules.text: When you roll a success on an Athletics check to swim, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_ko: 당신의 어머니는 바다 마녀였으며, 당신에게 바다빛 녹색 또는 파란 눈 하나를 부여했습니다. 당신은 바다와 해변 모두에서 위안을 찾습니다. @link[actions.swim] 운동 판정에서 성공을 굴릴 때마다, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다. 해당 턴에 수영 행동에 성공하지 못한 채 물속에서 턴을 종료해도 가라앉지 않는다(하지만 여전히 물살에 휩쓸릴 수 있음).

name: Peony's Flourish

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding two fans, one in each hand.

As you spin around and create wide arching circles with your fans, you manifest a mosaic of peonies that confuses your enemies. Stride twice and then attempt a @Check[performance|defense:will] check against the Will DC of each creature you passed adjacent to.

Critical Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for as long as they're stunned.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} and dazzled for 1 round.

Failure The creature is dazzled for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune to further uses of Peony's Flourish for 24 hours.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

As you spin around and create wide arching circles with your fans, you manifest a mosaic of peonies that confuses your enemies. Stride twice and then attempt a @Check[performance|defense:will] check against the Will DC of each creature you passed adjacent to.

Critical Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for as long as they're stunned.

_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손에 각각 부채 하나씩을 들고 있어야 합니다.

부채를 휘둘러 넓은 원을 그리며 회전하자, 모자이크 같은 모란 무늬가 창조되어 적들을 혼란에 빠뜨립니다. 두 걸음 이동한 후, 인접한 상태로 지나간 각 생물에게 공연 의지 DC 판정을 시도합니다.

대성공 해당 생물은 @link[conditions.stunned]{3} 상태가 되며, 기절 상태가 지속되는 동안 @link[conditions.dazzled] 상태가 됩니다.

성공 해당 생물은 @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태가 되며, 1라운드 동안 눈부심 상태가 됩니다.

실패 생물이 1라운드 동안 눈부심을 경험합니다.

대실패 생물은 영향을 받지 않으며, 24시간 동안 모란의 화려한 기술에 대한 일시적 면역을 얻습니다.

name: Inexhaustible Countermoves

description.value: You can react whenever a foe leaves a gap in their defenses. At the start of each enemy's turn, you gain an extra reaction you can use only during that turn to perform an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Jtn7IugykXDlIoZq]{Opportune Riposte}, or an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.hmShTfPOcTaKgbf4]{Reactive Strike} if you have that reaction.

_desc_en: You can react whenever a foe leaves a gap in their defenses. At the start of each enemy's turn, you gain an extra reaction you can use only during that turn to perform an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Jtn7IugykXDlIoZq]{Opportune Riposte}, or an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.hmShTfPOcTaKgbf4]{Reactive Strike} if you have that reaction.
_desc_ko: 적의 방어에 틈이 생길 때마다 반응할 수 있습니다. 각 적의 턴 시작 시, 해당 턴 동안에만 사용할 수 있는 추가 반응을 얻습니다. 이 반응으로 @link[feats.opportune-riposte]을 수행하거나, 해당 반응을 보유 중이라면 @link[feats.reactive-strike]을 수행할 수 있습니다.

name: Hymn of Healing

description.value: You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gSUQlTDYoLDGAsCP]{Hymn of Healing} composition spell, which imbues your music with rich melodies that help your allies recover from harm.

_desc_en: You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gSUQlTDYoLDGAsCP]{Hymn of Healing} composition spell, which imbues your music with rich melodies that help your allies recover from harm.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @link[spells.hymn-of-healing] 작곡 주문을 배웁니다. 이 주문은 당신의 음악에 풍부한 선율을 불어넣어 아군들이 상처에서 회복하도록 돕습니다.

name: Master Captivator Spellcasting

description.value: You master the most powerful spells that enchant and deceive. You learn a 7th-rank occult spell. At 18th level, you learn an 8th-rank spell, and at 20th level, you learn a 9th-rank spell. Each of these spells must come from either the enchantment or illusion school. You cast these spells as occult innate spells. You become a master with spell attack rolls and spell DCs for occult spells.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en: You master the most powerful spells that enchant and deceive. You learn a 7th-rank occult spell. At 18th level, you learn an 8th-rank spell, and at 20th level, you learn a 9th-rank spell. Each of these spells must come from either the enchantment or illusion school. You cast these spells as occult innate spells. You become a master with spell attack rolls and spell DCs for occult spells.
_desc_ko: 당신은 가장 강력한 마법과 속임수를 구사하는 주술을 마스터합니다. 7랭크 오컬트 주문을 배운다. 18레벨에 8랭크 주문을, 20레벨에 9랭크 주문을 배운다. 이 주문들은 반드시 마법 또는 환상 계열에서 선택해야 한다. 이 주문들은 오컬트 선천적 주문으로 시전한다. 오컬트 주문의 주문 명중 굴림과 주문 난이도(DC)에 있어 달인이 된다.

name: Force of Nature

description.value:
You're a nigh-unstoppable killing machine, with only silver able to quell your rampage. When in hybrid or animal shape, you gain fast healing 5. If you take damage from a silver weapon, your fast healing deactivates until the end of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.PD1tyMvE75VU2qVi]{Effect: Force of Nature (Silver Damage)}

_desc_en:
You're a nigh-unstoppable killing machine, with only silver able to quell your rampage. When in hybrid or animal shape, you gain fast healing 5. If you take damage from a silver weapon, your fast healing deactivates until the end of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.PD1tyMvE75VU2qVi]{Effect: Force of Nature (Silver Damage)}
_desc_ko:
당신은 거의 막을 수 없는 살육 기계로, 오직 은만이 당신의 광란을 진정시킬 수 있습니다. 혼합형 또는 동물 형태일 때, 빠른 치유 5를 얻습니다. 은 무기로 피해를 입으면, 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 빠른 치유가 비활성화됩니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.PD1tyMvE75VU2qVi]{효과: 자연의 힘 (은 피해)}

name: Levering Strike

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding your staff.

Make a Strike with your staff. As long as you don't critically fail, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} and takes a -2 circumstance penalty to its DC against @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} attempts until the start of your next turn.

publication.title: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding your staff.

Make a Strike with your staff. As long as you don't critically fail, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} and takes a -2 circumstance penalty to its DC against @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} attempts until the start of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 지팡이를 휘두르고 있어야 합니다.

지팡이로 강타한다. 대실패를 하지 않는 한, 대상은 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 되며, 다음 차례 시작까지 @link[actions.shove], @link[actions.trip], @link[actions.tumble-through] 시도하다에 대한 DC에 -2 상황 페널티를 받는다.

name: Burning Surge

description.value:
Trigger A creature Casts a Spell within your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XIgvCPaSy5WXStVD]{Spellsurge} aura.

You cause a surge of magical energy to flare up, harming that creature and those near it. The triggering creature and all creatures adjacent to it take @Damage[1d6[untyped]] damage per rank of the spell (@Check[will|against:class-spell|basic] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher). The damage is of the same type as dealt by the spell (or one type of damage of your choosing if the spell deals multiple types of damage). If the spell doesn't deal damage, the damage is mental. The effect gains the trait of the damage dealt. If you spend a Mythic Point as part of using this reaction, calculate the DC with mythic proficiency; you can also choose to deal acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage instead of the type that would normally be dealt, and creatures that fail the saving throw take persistent damage of the same type as the base effect equal to the rank of the triggering creature's spell.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature Casts a Spell within your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XIgvCPaSy5WXStVD]{Spellsurge} aura.

You cause a surge of magical energy to flare up, harming that creature and those near it. The triggering creature and all creatures adjacent to it take @Damage[1d6[untyped]] damage per rank of the spell (@Check[will|against:class-spell|basic] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher). The damage is of the same type as dealt by the spell (or one type of damage of your choosing if the spell deals multiple types of damage). If the spell doesn't deal damage, the damage is mental. The effect gains the trait of the damage dealt. If you spend a Mythic Point as part of using this reaction, calculate the DC with mythic proficiency; you can also choose to deal acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage instead of the type that would normally be dealt, and creatures that fail the saving throw take persistent damage of the same type as the base effect equal to the rank of the triggering creature's spell.
_desc_ko:
발동 생물이 당신의 @link[spells.spellsurge] 오라 내에서 주문을 시전한다.

당신은 마법 에너지의 파동을 일으켜 그 생물과 그 주변 생물들에게 피해를 입힙니다. 발동한 생물과 그 생물과 인접한 모든 생물은 주문 랭크당 1d6의 피해를 받습니다 (기본 의지 당신의 직업 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 더 높은 것에 대한 내성 굴림). 이 피해는 해당 주문이 주는 피해 유형과 동일하다(주문이 여러 유형의 피해를 주는 경우, 당신이 선택한 한 가지 유형의 피해). 주문이 피해를 주지 않는다면, 피해는 정신 피해로 처리된다. 이 효과는 가한 피해의 특성을 획득한다. 이 반응 사용 시 신화 포인트를 소모하면, 신화 숙련도를 적용하여 DC를 계산한다. 또한 일반적으로 가해지는 피해 유형 대신 산성, 냉기, 전기, 화염 피해를 가하도록 선택할 수 있으며, 내성에 실패한 생물은 기본 효과와 동일한 유형의 지속 피해를 받는데, 그 피해량은 유발 생물의 주문 랭크과 같다.

name: Starlight Armor

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You armor yourself in the light of distant suns, shielding yourself from harm. The armor grants you resistance 7 to piercing, bludgeoning, and slashing damage. The armor also sheds bright light for 20 feet (and dim light for the next 20 feet).

Whenever an adjacent creature attacks you, the attacker must attempt a @Check[will|against:spell] save against your spell DC at the end of its action. On a failure, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the end of its next turn. Regardless of the result of the save, the attacker is temporarily immune until the end of its next turn. The dazzling effect has the light and visual traits.

When you reach 17th level, the resistance increases to 10.

Note: A duration for this ability was not provided by Paizo. The effect linked here is set to 1 minute.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You armor yourself in the light of distant suns, shielding yourself from harm. The armor grants you resistance 7 to piercing, bludgeoning, and slashing damage. The armor also sheds bright light for 20 feet (and dim light for the next 20 feet).

Whenever an adjacent creature attacks you, the attacker must attempt a @Check[will|against:spell] save against your spell DC at the end of its action. On a failure, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the end of its next turn. Regardless of the result of the save, the attacker is temporarily immune until the end of its next turn. The dazzling effect has the light and visual traits.

When you reach 17th level, the resistance increases to 10.

Note: A duration for this ability was not provided by Paizo. The effect linked here is set to 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신은 먼 태양들의 빛으로 자신을 갑옷처럼 감싸 해로부터 보호합니다. 이 갑옷은 관통, 둔기, 베기 피해에 대해 저항력 7을 부여합니다. 또한 갑옷은 20피트 범위 내에는 밝은 빛을, 그 다음 20피트 범위 내에는 희미한 빛을 발산합니다.

인접한 생물이 당신을 공격할 때마다, 공격자는 자신의 행동 종료 시점에 당신의 주문 DC(DC)에 대한 의지 내성을 시도해야 합니다. 실패 시, 공격자는 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.dazzled] 상태가 됩니다. 저항 내성 결과와 무관하게, 공격자는 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 일시적으로 면역 상태가 됩니다. 눈부심 효과는 빛과 시각 특성을 지닙니다.

17레벨에 도달하면 저항력이 10으로 증가합니다.

참고: Paizo에서 이 능력의 지속 시간은 제공하지 않았습니다. 여기에 연결된 효과는 1분으로 설정됩니다.

name: Studious Magic

description.value: You've taken an interest in anadi arcane traditions. Choose one cantrip from the arcane spell list. You can cast this spell as an arcane innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: You've taken an interest in anadi arcane traditions. Choose one cantrip from the arcane spell list. You can cast this spell as an arcane innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 당신은 아나디의 비전 전통에 관심을 가지게 되었습니다. 비전 주문 목록에서 한 가지 캔트립을 선택하십시오. 이 주문을 비전 선천 주문으로 마음대로 시전할 수 있습니다. 선택한 캔트립은 당신의 레벨 절반(올림)에 해당하는 주문 랭크으로 강화됩니다.

name: Divine Wall

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a shield.

You use your shield to harry your enemies, preventing them from stepping away from or around you. All spaces adjacent to you are difficult terrain for your enemies.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a shield.

You use your shield to harry your enemies, preventing them from stepping away from or around you. All spaces adjacent to you are difficult terrain for your enemies.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 방패를 장비하고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 방패를 사용하여 적을 괴롭히며, 그들이 당신에게서 멀어지거나 당신을 우회하는 것을 막습니다. 당신과 인접한 모든 공간은 적에게 어려운 지형이 됩니다.

name: Halfling Ingenuity

description.value: While your willingness to dig into a task you know little about might get you into trouble, your incredible luck often saves you from danger. You can attempt skill actions that normally require you to be trained even if you aren't trained in that skill. If you use Halfling Luck when you fail a check for a skill with which you are untrained, you can add a proficiency bonus equal to your level, rather than 0, when you reroll the triggering skill check. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to this rerolled skill check.

_desc_en: While your willingness to dig into a task you know little about might get you into trouble, your incredible luck often saves you from danger. You can attempt skill actions that normally require you to be trained even if you aren't trained in that skill. If you use Halfling Luck when you fail a check for a skill with which you are untrained, you can add a proficiency bonus equal to your level, rather than 0, when you reroll the triggering skill check. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to this rerolled skill check.
_desc_ko: 잘 알지 못하는 일에 무턱대고 뛰어드는 성향이 문제를 일으킬 수도 있지만, 놀라운 행운이 종종 위험에서 구해줍니다. 훈련받지 않은 기술에 대한 숙련도 판정 실패 시 하플링의 행운을 사용하면, 재굴림 시 숙련 보너스 대신 레벨에 해당하는 숙련 보너스를 적용할 수 있다. 이 재굴림 기술 판정에는 +4 상황 보너스가 추가된다.

name: Deep Freeze

description.value:
You vent a jet of supercooled fluid from your innovation, damaging a foe and slowing it down. Target one creature within 60 feet. That creature takes @Damage[@actor.level[cold]]{cold damage equal to your level}, with effects depending on its @Check[reflex|against:inventor] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage and takes a –5-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.

Failure The target takes full damage and takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round, and takes a –15-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.BBGg5gpMmuBSo7Mi]{Effect: Deep Freeze}

Unstable Function Your innovation discharges an enormous cone of supercooled fluid, potentially causing cascading failures. Add the unstable trait to Deep Freeze. The ability affects all creatures within a @Template[cone|distance:60] instead of a single target, and it deals @Damage[(2*@actor.level)[cold]|traits:unstable|options:area-damage]{cold damage equal to double your level} instead of equal to your level.

If you have the revolutionary innovation class feature, you can choose a @Template[cone|distance:60] or a @Template[cone|distance:90] when you use an unstable Deep Freeze.

Special If your innovation is a minion, it can take this action rather than you.

_desc_ko:
당신은 발명품에서 과냉각된 유체를 분사하여 적에게 피해를 주고 이동 속도를 늦춥니다. 60피트 내의 생물 한 마리를 대상으로 합니다. 해당 생물은 당신의 레벨에 해당하는 냉기 피해를 입으며, 그 효과는 대상의 반사 내성에 따라 달라집니다.

대성공 대상은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 대상은 절반의 피해를 입으며, 1라운드 동안 이동 속도에 -5피트 상태 페널티를 받습니다.

실패 대상은 전체 피해를 입으며 1라운드 동안 이동 속도에 -10피트 상태 페널티를 받습니다.

대실패 대상은 두 배의 피해를 입으며, 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.slowed]{1} 상태가 되고, 1라운드 동안 이동 속도에 -15피트 상태 페널티를 받습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.BBGg5gpMmuBSo7Mi]{효과: 극저온 동결}

불안정 기능 당신의 혁신은 과냉각된 액체의 거대한 원뿔을 방출하여 캐스케이드 고장을 일으킬 수 있습니다. 심한 동결에 불안정 특성을 추가합니다. 이 능력은 단일 대상 대신 60피트 범위 내 모든 생물에게 영향을 미치며, 레벨에 해당하는 냉기 피해를 주는 대신 레벨의 두 배에 해당하는 냉기 피해를 줍니다.

혁명적 혁신 클래스 특성을 보유한 경우, 불안정한 딥 프리즈를 사용할 때 60피트 또는 90피트 중 하나를 선택할 수 있습니다.

특수 혁신이 하수인인 경우, 당신 대신 이 행동을 취할 수 있습니다.

name: Sensitive Nose

description.value:
Your large black nose isn't just for show. You can pick up on the faintest scents near you and track them down. You gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet.

Special You can take this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain out of this feat or into this feat.

_desc_en:
Your large black nose isn't just for show. You can pick up on the faintest scents near you and track them down. You gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet.

Special You can take this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain out of this feat or into this feat.
_desc_ko:
당신의 커다란 검은 코는 장식용이 아닙니다. 주변의 가장 희미한 냄새도 감지하고 추적할 수 있습니다. 30피트 범위 내의 대략적인 냄새를 감지하는 능력을 얻습니다.

특수 이 재주는 1레벨에만 선택할 수 있으며, 재훈련으로 이 재주를 포기하거나 다시 선택할 수 없습니다.

name: Sharpened Senses

description.value:
Frequency once per round

Your senses have become so sharp that you notice changes subconsciously. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek}. If you use one of your senses from Natural Senses, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the check.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per round

Your senses have become so sharp that you notice changes subconsciously. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek}. If you use one of your senses from Natural Senses, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the check.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 라운드당 1회

당신의 감각이 매우 예민해져 무의식적으로 변화를 감지합니다. 당신은 @link[actions.seek]합니다. 자연적 감각 중 하나의 감각을 사용하면 해당 판정에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Juggernaut's Fortitude

description.value: Your proficiency rank in Fortitude saves increases to master.

_desc_en: Your proficiency rank in Fortitude saves increases to master.
_desc_ko: 당신의 인내 내성 등급이 달인로 상승합니다.

name: Eerie Flicker

description.value:
Trigger An enemy's Strike would hit you and you weren't already @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} by that enemy.

Your body flickers momentarily into the Ethereal Plane. You become concealed for 1 round, and the flat check for concealment applies to the Strike that would have hit you. If the flat check fails, the Strike misses you.

Awakening When your body flickers, you momentarily assume a terrifying form. If a creature fails the flat check against concealment from your Eerie Flicker, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}, and it doesn't reduce the frightened condition from this effect at the end of the same turn it gained the condition.

Awakening You can choose to compress your flickering movement into a single moment, increasing your chance to avoid the triggering attack in exchange for a shorter-lived effect. If you choose to do so, the flat check for concealment against the triggering attack increases to @Check[flat|dc:9], but the concealment affects only the triggering Strike.

_desc_en:
Trigger An enemy's Strike would hit you and you weren't already @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} by that enemy.

Awakening You can choose to compress your flickering movement into a single moment, increasing your chance to avoid the triggering attack in exchange for a shorter-lived effect. If you choose to do so, the flat check for concealment against the triggering attack increases to @Check[flat|dc:9], but the concealment affects only the triggering Strike.
_desc_ko:
Trigger 적의 공격이 당신을 명중시킬 것이며, 당신은 이미 @link[conditions.concealed], @link[conditions.hidden], 또는 @link[conditions.undetected] 상태가 아니었다.

당신의 몸이 순간적으로 에테리얼 평면으로 흔들리며 사라집니다. 당신은 1라운드 동안 {가려진} 상태가 되며, 당신을 명중했을 공격에 단순 판정 결과가 적용됩니다. 단순 판정이 실패하면 공격은 당신을 빗나갑니다.

각성 몸이 깜빡일 때, 당신은 순간적으로 끔찍한 모습을 취합니다. 생물이 당신의 '섬뜩한 번쩍임'으로 인한 은폐에 대한 단순 판정에 실패하면, @link[conditions.frightened]{1}이 되며, 이 효과로 인한 공포 상태는 상태를 얻은 같은 턴이 끝날 때까지 감소하지 않습니다.

각성 당신은 깜빡이는 움직임을 단일 순간으로 압축할 수 있으며, 효과 지속 시간이 짧아지는 대신 유발 공격을 회피할 확률을 높일 수 있다. 이 경우 유발 공격에 대한 은폐 단순 판정 난이도가 DC 9 단순로 상승하나, 은폐 효과는 유발한 공격에만 적용됩니다.

name: Light of Revelation

description.value: You've learned to call upon light to reveal what is hidden. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ou56ShiFH7GWF8hX]{Light of Revelation} devotion spell. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.

_desc_en: You've learned to call upon light to reveal what is hidden. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ou56ShiFH7GWF8hX]{Light of Revelation} devotion spell. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.
_desc_ko: 은은한 빛을 불러 숨겨진 것을 드러내는 법을 익혔다. @link[spells.light-of-revelation] 헌신 주문을 얻는다. 포커스 풀의 포커스 포인트 수를 1 증가시킨다.

name: Rain-Scribe Sustenance

description.value:
You use the power of your Rain-Scribe magic to draw on a stream of primal power for sustenance. You don't need to eat or drink and need only 6 hours of rest to feel well rested. You must still rest at least 8 hours and spend 1 hour of preparation to regain resources usable only a limited number of times per day, such as spell slots.

You can draw on primal power to stay awake and alert while otherwise resting your body and mind, gaining the full benefits of an 8-hour rest without falling asleep. When you do, you lose the other benefits of Rain- Scribe Sustenance for 1 week while your primal energies recharge.

_desc_en:
You use the power of your Rain-Scribe magic to draw on a stream of primal power for sustenance. You don't need to eat or drink and need only 6 hours of rest to feel well rested. You must still rest at least 8 hours and spend 1 hour of preparation to regain resources usable only a limited number of times per day, such as spell slots.

You can draw on primal power to stay awake and alert while otherwise resting your body and mind, gaining the full benefits of an 8-hour rest without falling asleep. When you do, you lose the other benefits of Rain- Scribe Sustenance for 1 week while your primal energies recharge.
_desc_ko:
당신은 비의 서기관 마법의 힘을 이용해 프라이멀 힘의 흐름을 끌어와 생명을 유지합니다. 음식이나 음료가 필요하지 않으며, 6시간의 휴식만으로 충분히 휴식을 취한 상태가 됩니다. 하지만 하루에 제한된 횟수만 사용할 수 있는 자원(예: 주문 슬롯)을 회복하려면 최소 8시간의 휴식과 1시간의 준비 시간이 필요합니다.

프라이멀 힘을 끌어내어 몸과 마음을 쉬게 하면서도 깨어 있고 경계 상태를 유지할 수 있습니다. 이렇게 하면 잠들지 않고도 8시간 휴식의 완전한 혜택을 얻습니다. 이 경우 프라이멀 에너지가 재충전되는 1주일간 비의 서기관 생명의 다른 혜택은 상실됩니다.

name: Crocodile's Twin

description.value:
Your egg contained your twin, a crocodile. Considered a rare and auspicious event, you share a magical bond with this sibling. You gain a tiny crocodile as a familiar.

Special You can take this feat only at 1st level.

value.value: bakuwa lizardfolk heritage or makari lizardfolk heritage

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Your egg contained your twin, a crocodile. Considered a rare and auspicious event, you share a magical bond with this sibling. You gain a tiny crocodile as a familiar.

Special You can take this feat only at 1st level.
_desc_ko:
당신의 알에는 쌍둥이 악어가 함께 있었습니다. 이는 희귀하고 길조로 여겨지며, 당신은 이 형제와 마법적 유대를 공유합니다. 작은 악어를 패밀리어로 얻습니다.

특수 이 피트는 1레벨에서만 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Aerial Boomerang

description.value:
A blade of shearing wind races away from you in a @Template[line|distance:60]. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -1)/2) +2)d4[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. In the final square of the line, the boomerang whirls in place until the end of your next turn. Any creature that ends its turn in that square has to save against the boomerang.

On your next turn, you can use a single action, which has the concentrate trait, to return the boomerang to you. It returns in a line from its square to your current location, with the same effect as the initial line, then the impulse ends. You must have line of effect to the boomerang and be within 60 feet of it.

Level (+2) The damage increases by 1d4.

_desc_en:
A blade of shearing wind races away from you in a @Template[line|distance:60]. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -1)/2) +2)d4[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. In the final square of the line, the boomerang whirls in place until the end of your next turn. Any creature that ends its turn in that square has to save against the boomerang.

On your next turn, you can use a single action, which has the concentrate trait, to return the boomerang to you. It returns in a line from its square to your current location, with the same effect as the initial line, then the impulse ends. You must have line of effect to the boomerang and be within 60 feet of it.

Level (+2) The damage increases by 1d4.
_desc_ko:
날카로운 바람의 칼날이 60피트로 당신으로부터 날아갑니다. 해당 영역 내 모든 생물은 참격의 피해를 입으며, 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 기본 반사 내성에 성공해야 합니다. 선상의 마지막 칸에서 부메랑은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 제자리에서 회전한다. 해당 칸에서 차례를 끝내는 모든 생물은 부메랑에 대한 내성 굴림을 수행해야 한다.

다음 차례에, 집중 특성을 가진 액션 하나를 사용하여 부메랑을 되돌릴 수 있습니다. 부메랑은 자신의 칸에서 현재 위치까지 직선으로 되돌아오며, 초기 직선과 동일한 효과를 발휘한 후 충격이 종료됩니다. 부메랑과 효과 선이 연결되어 있어야 하며, 부메랑으로부터 60피트 이내에 위치해야 합니다.

레벨 (+2) 피해량이 1d4 증가합니다.

name: Tunnel Roll

description.value: You can more easily navigate underground tunnels by rolling up into a ball. You roll up and move up to four times your Speed in a straight line down an incline. If you reach the bottom of the incline or hit an obstacle during this first turn of movement, you stop rolling. Otherwise, you automatically keep rolling at this Speed during subsequent turns until you hit the bottom of the incline or an obstacle ends this movement (which can happen in the middle of your turn). You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} each turn after the first that you keep rolling; if you hit an obstacle on a turn after the first, you and the obstacle both take @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]] damage, and you stop rolling.

_desc_en: You can more easily navigate underground tunnels by rolling up into a ball. You roll up and move up to four times your Speed in a straight line down an incline. If you reach the bottom of the incline or hit an obstacle during this first turn of movement, you stop rolling. Otherwise, you automatically keep rolling at this Speed during subsequent turns until you hit the bottom of the incline or an obstacle ends this movement (which can happen in the middle of your turn). You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} each turn after the first that you keep rolling; if you hit an obstacle on a turn after the first, you and the obstacle both take @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]] damage, and you stop rolling.
_desc_ko: 공처럼 몸을 굴림하여 지하 터널을 더 쉽게 이동할 수 있습니다. 당신은 몸을 둥글게 말아 내리막길에서 직선으로 이동 속도의 최대 4배까지 이동합니다. 첫 번째 이동 턴에 내리막길 바닥에 도달하거나 장애물에 부딪히면 굴림을 멈춥니다. 그렇지 않으면 이후 턴 동안 자동으로 이 속도로 계속 굴리며, 내리막길 바닥에 도달하거나 장애물에 부딪혀 이동이 종료될 때까지 지속됩니다(이동은 턴 중간에 종료될 수 있음). 첫 번째 턴 이후 계속 굴리는 각 턴마다 @link[conditions.slowed]{2} 상태가 됩니다. 첫 번째 턴 이후 턴에 장애물에 부딪히면, 당신과 장애물 모두 4d6 타격 피해를 입으며 굴림을 멈춥니다.

name: Combine Elixirs

description.value: You can add the full ingredients of a second elixir to an elixir you make to create a hybrid concoction. You must expend an additional versatile vial to make this combined elixir, and the ingredients must be for an elixir of the same level or lower that you could create with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.yzNJgwzV9XqEhKc6]{Quick Alchemy}. When this combination elixir is consumed, both the constituent elixirs take effect. For example, you can combine two @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.TZUskLT7yvP7N2co]{Lesser Elixirs of Life} to create a combined elixir that heals twice the normal amount, or you can combine a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.88pGCHV0uKMskTVO]{Lesser Darkvision Elixir} with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.7Y2yOr4ltpP2tyuL]{Lesser Eagle-Eye Elixir} to both gain darkvision and find secret doors.

You must expend an additional versatile vial to make this combined elixir, and the ingredients must be for an elixir of the same level or lower that you could create with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.yzNJgwzV9XqEhKc6]{Quick Alchemy}. When this combination elixir is consumed, both the constituent elixirs take effect. _desc_ko: 만드는 엘릭서에 두 번째 엘릭서의 전체 재료를 추가하여 혼합 조제물을 만들 수 있습니다. 이 복합 엘릭서를 만들려면 추가로 다용도 약병을 소모해야 하며, 재료는 @link[actions.quick-alchemy]로 제작 가능한 엘릭서의 재료여야 합니다. 이 복합 엘릭서를 섭취하면 구성 엘릭서 두 가지의 효과가 모두 발휘됩니다. 예를 들어, 두 개의 @link[equipment.elixir-of-life-lesser] 두 개를 결합하여 일반 치유량의 두 배 효과를 내는 혼합 엘릭서를 만들거나, @link[equipment.darkvision-elixir-lesser]와 @link[equipment.eagle-eye-elixir-lesser]를 결합하여 암흑 시야를 얻고 비밀문을 찾는 효과를 동시에 얻을 수 있습니다.

name: Fey Life

description.value:
There are some fates worse than death–and you worked to save a fey from one such fate. In return, your life became bound to theirs. Fey magic has since become a part of you, bringing the vibrant colors of the First World to you and all that surrounds you. Your skin, hair, all that you touch, and anything within 5 feet of you changes to the most brilliant hues possible, though the colors fade as you cease to touch an object or you move away. You gain the ability to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.hs7h8f4Z1ZNdUt3s]{Summon Fey} as a 7th-rank primal innate spell once per day. At 18th level the spell heightens to 8th rank, and at 20th level it heightens to 9th rank.

The first time you die after gaining this feat, the bond you made with the fey invokes the power of the First World to return you to life. Immediately after dying, you revive, becoming conscious (and wounded as normal) at @Damage[27[healing]] Hit Points, and you gain the fey trait. Your eyes become a rainbow of colors, and you take on a visual aspect of the fey with whom you are bound, such as by growing wings, horns, or a plantlike body. The change has no mechanical effect; for instance, the wings wouldn't allow you to fly, nor would horns grant a horn unarmed attack.

The second time you die, you reawaken in the First World with the full appearance of the fey that was bound to you. You become an NPC, unconcerned with your old mortal life. You can be returned to your previous life in the Universe by having allies spend 3 days building a shrine to the First World, giving three offerings that hold deep sentimental value for you or another, and holding a raucous, three-day long feast.

Any time that you die after that, you reawaken again in the First World with no memories of your previous life, and you can only be brought back by powerful magic such as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} ritual.

_desc_ko:
죽음보다 더 끔찍한 운명이 존재한다. 그리고 너는 그런 운명에서 한 페이를 내성하기 위해 노력했다. 그 대가로 네 삶은 그들과 얽히게 되었다. 페이의 마법은 이제 네 일부가 되어, 너와 네 주변 모든 것에 제1세계의 생생한 색채를 가져다주었다. 네 피부, 머리카락, 네가 만지는 모든 것, 그리고 네로부터 5피트 이내의 모든 것은 가능한 가장 선명한 색조로 변한다. 다만 물체를 만지는 것을 멈추거나 멀어지면 색깔은 점차 사라진다. 하루에 한 번, 7랭크 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 @link[spells.summon-fey]을 시전할 수 있는 능력을 얻습니다. 18레벨에 도달하면 이 마법은 (8th) 랭크으로, 20레벨에 도달하면 (9th) 랭크으로 강화됩니다.

이 피트를 획득한 후 처음으로 사망할 때, 페이와의 유대가 제1세계의 힘을 불러일으켜 당신을 되살립니다. 사망 직후, 당신은 27 HP로 의식을 회복하며(일반적인 부상 상태로) 되살아나고, 페이 특성을 얻습니다. 눈동자가 무지갯빛으로 변하며, 날개나 뿔, 식물 같은 몸체 등이 자라나는 등 결속된 페이의 외형을 띤다. 이 변화는 기계적 효과를 주지 않는다. 예를 들어 날개로 날 수 없으며, 뿔로 비무장 공격을 할 수도 없다.

두 번째로 죽을 때, 당신은 당신과 결속된 페이의 완전한 모습으로 제1세계에서 다시 깨어납니다. 당신은 NPC가 되어 과거의 인간 삶과는 무관해집니다. 동맹들이 물질계에 있는 당신의 이전 삶으로 돌아오게 하려면, 제1세계를 위한 신전을 3일간 건설하고, 당신이나 다른 이에게 깊은 정서적 가치를 지닌 세 가지 제물을 바치며, 3일간 떠들썩한 잔치를 열어야 합니다.

이후로 당신이 죽을 때마다, 당신은 이전 생애의 기억 없이 다시 첫 번째 세계에서 깨어나며, @link[spells.wish] 주문과 같은 강력한 마법으로만 되돌려질 수 있습니다.

description.value:
You are a xun for the Golden League, aiding the organization. You gain expert proficiency in two of the following skills (or in two other skills of your choice in which you're trained, if you were already an expert in the listed skills): Athletics, Deception, Intimidation, or Stealth. In addition, if you use Underworld Lore to Earn Income or Recall Knowledge, when you get a success, you get a critical success instead.

name: Efficient Rituals

description.value:
You can perform particularly extensive rituals in less time. If the ritual normally requires 1 day to cast, you can cast it in 4 hours. If it takes longer than 1 day, you cast it in half the number of days, rounded up.

At 14th level, if a ritual has a casting time measured in days, you can cast it in an equal number of hours. If this results in a ritual longer than 8 hours, you split the ritual between multiple days, as normal for a ritual.

At 14th level, if a ritual has a casting time measured in days, you can cast it in an equal number of hours. If this results in a ritual longer than 8 hours, you split the ritual between multiple days, as normal for a ritual.
_desc_ko:
특히 방대한 의식을 더 짧은 시간에 수행할 수 있습니다. 의식 시전 시간이 보통 1일이 소요되는 경우, 4시간 만에 시전할 수 있습니다. 1일 이상 소요되는 경우, 소요 일수의 절반(반올림)에 시전합니다.

14레벨에 도달하면, 의식의 시전 시간이 일 단위로 측정될 경우 동일한 시간(시간 단위)에 시전할 수 있습니다. 이로 인해 의식 시간이 8시간을 초과할 경우, 일반적인 의식 시전 방식과 동일하게 여러 날에 걸쳐 의식을 진행합니다.

name: Many Guises (Vigilante)

description.value:
You can take on any number of mundane guises.

Whenever you change your identity, instead of taking on your social or vigilante identity, you can become someone completely ordinary. This identity isn't a specific individual—rather, you become a nondescript member of your ancestry, of any gender, and from a mundane occupation such as common laborer, farmer, or peasant.

Spells and abilities detect you as if you were this ordinary identity, rather than either of your two real identities, unless they succeed at a counteract check against the same Deception DC used for Vigilante Dedication. Using class or dedication abilities ends this disguise.

_desc_ko:
평범한 변장을 무제한으로 취할 수 있습니다.

신분을 바꿀 때마다, 사회적인 신분이나 자경단 신분을 취하는 대신 완전히 평범한 사람이 될 수 있습니다. 이 신분은 특정 개인이 아닌, 당신의 혈통에 속한 평범한 구성원입니다. 성별은 무관하며, 일반 노동자, 농부, 농민 등 평범한 직업을 가진 인물이 됩니다.

주문과 능력은 두 실제 정체성 중 어느 쪽이 아닌 이 평범한 정체성으로 당신을 감지합니다. 단, 자경단 헌신에 사용된 것과 동일한 기만 난이도(DC)에 대한 반격 판정에서 성공할 경우 예외입니다. 직업이나 헌신 능력을 사용하면 이 변장이 해제됩니다.

name: Agile Hand

description.value: When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.pwzdSlJgYqN7bs2w]{Telekinetic Hand}, you can modify its target to be a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zvLyCVD8g2PdHJAc]{Thieves' Toolkit}. When you Cast the Spell in this way, the tools move up to 20 feet towards a device or lock. After you Sustain the spell on future turns, you can use the tools to attempt Thievery checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable a Device} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick a Lock} within the spell's range, but you take a -2 penalty to your Thievery check. If you critically fail, the spell ends and you can't use this modification again for 24 hours.

name: Athlete's Ally

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding your warshard weapon.

You channel the power of your warshard through your weapon to better perform athletic maneuvers. Spend a Mythic Point. For 1 minute, when you attempt Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} with your warshard weapon, you do so at mythic proficiency. Note that this ability doesn't grant additional weapon traits to your weapon, so your options for which of these maneuvers you can attempt might be limited by your weapon's existing traits.
