_desc_ko:
요구조건 당신은 워샤드 무기를 들고 있다.

당신은 워샤드의 힘을 무기를 통해 흘려보내 운동 술책을 더 잘 수행한다. 신화 점수를 소비하라. 1분 동안, 워샤드 무기로 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{무장 해제}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{붙잡기}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{재배치}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{밀기}, 또는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{넘어뜨리기}를 위한 운동 판정을 시도할 때, 신화 숙련도로 그렇게 한다. 이 능력은 당신의 무기에 추가 무기 특성을 부여하지 않으므로, 시도할 수 있는 술책의 선택지는 무기의 기존 특성에 의해 제한될 수 있음에 유의하라.

name: One-Inch Punch

description.value:
You put all your force into a single mighty, carefully controlled blow. Make an unarmed Strike. If you spend two actions and this Strike hits, you deal an extra die of weapon damage. You can instead spend 3 actions to perform an even more powerful attack, dealing a second additional die of weapon damage on a hit.

If you're at least 10th level, the number of additional dice you add from this feat doubles, for a total of 2 additional dice if you spend 2 actions or 4 additional dice if you spend 3 actions.

If you're at least 18th level, the number of additional dice you add from this feat triples, for a total of 3 additional dice if you spend 2 actions or 6 additional dice if you spend 3 actions.

_desc_en:
You put all your force into a single mighty, carefully controlled blow. Make an unarmed Strike. If you spend two actions and this Strike hits, you deal an extra die of weapon damage. You can instead spend 3 actions to perform an even more powerful attack, dealing a second additional die of weapon damage on a hit.

If you're at least 10th level, the number of additional dice you add from this feat doubles, for a total of 2 additional dice if you spend 2 actions or 4 additional dice if you spend 3 actions.

If you're at least 18th level, the number of additional dice you add from this feat triples, for a total of 3 additional dice if you spend 2 actions or 6 additional dice if you spend 3 actions.
_desc_ko:
모든 힘을 한 방에 집중하여 강력하면서도 정교하게 통제된 일격을 가합니다. 비무장 공격을 수행합니다. 두 번의 행동을 소모하고 이 공격이 명중하면 무기 피해 주사위 하나를 추가로 입힙니다. 대신 세 번의 행동을 소모하여 더욱 강력한 공격을 수행할 수 있으며, 명중 시 무기 피해 주사위 하나를 추가로 입힙니다.

(10th)레벨 이상일 경우, 이 재주로 추가되는 주사위 수가 두 배로 증가한다. 즉, 2개의 행동을 소모하면 총 2개의 추가 주사위를, 3개의 행동을 소모하면 총 4개의 추가 주사위를 얻는다.

18레벨 이상일 경우, 이 피트로 추가되는 주사위 수가 세 배로 증가합니다. 즉, 2개의 행동을 소모하면 총 3개의 추가 주사위를, 3개의 행동을 소모하면 총 6개의 추가 주사위를 얻습니다.

name: Reflexive Grip

description.value: You keep hold of your weapons even when knocked out. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Reflex DC when defending against checks to Disarm you. In addition, when you fall unconscious, you don't drop any weapons that you're currently wielding, though somebody else can remove them from you.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en: You keep hold of your weapons even when knocked out. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Reflex DC when defending against checks to Disarm you. In addition, when you fall unconscious, you don't drop any weapons that you're currently wielding, though somebody else can remove them from you.
_desc_ko: 기절 상태에서도 무기를 놓지 않습니다. {무장 해제} 저항 판정 방어 시 반사 DC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 또한 의식을 잃어도 현재 휘두르고 있는 무기를 떨어뜨리지 않지만, 타인이 빼앗을 수는 있습니다.

name: Instinctive Obfuscation

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You are attacked by a foe, but they haven't rolled yet.

The magic within you manifests as a natural reaction to threats. An illusory double of you appears in your space for a brief moment. The triggering attacker must roll a @Check[flat|dc:10]; on a success, the attack targets you normally; if they fail, the attack targets the double and destroys it. The tradition of this action matches the tradition of your gnome ancestry options.

value.value: at least one arcane or occult innate spell gained from a gnome heritage or gnome ancestry feat

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You are attacked by a foe, but they haven't rolled yet.

The magic within you manifests as a natural reaction to threats. An illusory double of you appears in your space for a brief moment. The triggering attacker must roll a @Check[flat|dc:10]; on a success, the attack targets you normally; if they fail, the attack targets the double and destroys it. The tradition of this action matches the tradition of your gnome ancestry options.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

발동 조건 적에게 공격을 받았으나, 상대가 아직 주사위를 굴리지 않은 상태.

위협에 대한 본능적 반응으로 내면의 마법이 창조됩니다. 순간적으로 당신의 공간에 환영의 복제체가 나타납니다. 공격자는 DC 10 단순을 굴려야 합니다. 성공 시 공격은 정상적으로 당신을 겨냥합니다. 실패 시 공격은 복제체를 겨냥하여 파괴합니다. 이 행동의 전통은 당신의 노움 혈통 옵션 전통과 일치합니다.

name: Made for Combat

description.value:
You can use your body as a deadly weapon. You gain one of the following melee unarmed attacks, which must be one that matches your body (for instance, tsukumogami wrap for a tsukumogami that's a bolt of cotton).

  • A blade unarmed attack that deals 1d6 slashing, has the versatile P trait, and is in the sword weapon group.
  • A spoke unarmed attack that deals 1d4 piercing, has the agile and finesse traits, and is in the knife weapon group.
  • A wrap unarmed attack that deals 1d4 bludgeoning, has the grapple, nonlethal, and trip traits, and is in the flail weapon group.

Special You can take this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain into or out of this feat.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You can use your body as a deadly weapon. You gain one of the following melee unarmed attacks, which must be one that matches your body (for instance, tsukumogami wrap for a tsukumogami that's a bolt of cotton).

  • A blade unarmed attack that deals 1d6 slashing, has the versatile P trait, and is in the sword weapon group.
  • A spoke unarmed attack that deals 1d4 piercing, has the agile and finesse traits, and is in the knife weapon group.
  • A wrap unarmed attack that deals 1d4 bludgeoning, has the grapple, nonlethal, and trip traits, and is in the flail weapon group.

Special You can take this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain into or out of this feat.
_desc_ko:
당신은 자신의 몸을 치명적인 무기로 사용할 수 있습니다. 다음 근접 비무장 공격 중 하나를 획득하며, 이는 당신의 몸과 일치해야 합니다(예: 쯔쿠모가미가 솜뭉치인 경우 쯔쿠모가미 감싸기).

  • 1d6 베기 피해를 주고, 다용도 P 특성을 가지며, 검 무기 그룹에 속하는 날 비무장 공격.
  • 1d4 관통 피해를 입히고 기민한 및 기교 특성을 가지며, 칼 무기 그룹에 속하는 비무장 공격.
  • 채찍 무기 그룹에 속하며, 1d4 타격을 입히고, 붙잡기, 비살상, 넘어뜨리기 특성을 가진 감아 치기 비무장 공격.

특수 이 피트는 1레벨에서만 선택할 수 있으며, 재훈련으로 추가하거나 제거할 수 없습니다.

name: Share Eidolon Magic

description.value: Your eidolon shares innate spells with you. You can cast the innate spells your eidolon gained from Magical Understudy, Magical Adept, and Magical Master. You and your eidolon share the same daily uses of these innate spells.

_desc_en: Your eidolon shares innate spells with you. You can cast the innate spells your eidolon gained from Magical Understudy, Magical Adept, and Magical Master. You and your eidolon share the same daily uses of these innate spells.
_desc_ko: 당신의 에이돌론은 선천적 주문을 당신과 공유합니다. 당신은 에이돌론이 마법 수습생, 마법 숙련자, 마법 달인에서 획득한 선천적 주문을 시전할 수 있습니다. 당신과 에이돌론은 이 선천적 주문의 일일 사용 횟수를 공유합니다.

name: Tumbling Strike

description.value:
Requirements You are adjacent to an enemy.

You deftly dive through a gap left by a foe to deliver an advantageous blow. Attempt an Acrobatics check against the Reflex DC of an enemy adjacent to you.

Critical Success You move through the enemy's space to an unoccupied space on the other side of the enemy from your starting position. This movement doesn't trigger reactions. You can't move farther than your Speed, and you must end your movement adjacent to the enemy whose space you moved through. After moving, you make a melee Strike against the enemy whose space you moved through, and the enemy is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against that Strike.

Success As critical success, but the enemy isn't off-guard against the Strike.

Failure You remain in your original space but can still Strike.

Critical Failure You neither move nor Strike.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are adjacent to an enemy.

You deftly dive through a gap left by a foe to deliver an advantageous blow. Attempt an Acrobatics check against the Reflex DC of an enemy adjacent to you.

Critical Success You move through the enemy's space to an unoccupied space on the other side of the enemy from your starting position. This movement doesn't trigger reactions. You can't move farther than your Speed, and you must end your movement adjacent to the enemy whose space you moved through. After moving, you make a melee Strike against the enemy whose space you moved through, and the enemy is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against that Strike.

Success As critical success, but the enemy isn't off-guard against the Strike.

Failure You remain in your original space but can still Strike.

Critical Failure You neither move nor Strike.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 적과 인접해 있어야 합니다.

적의 빈틈을 재빠르게 뚫고 들어가 유리한 공격을 가한다. 인접한 적의 반사 DC에 대해 곡예 판정을 시도하다.

대성공 시 당신은 적의 공간을 통과해 시작 위치에서 적 반대편의 비어 있는 공간으로 이동한다. 이 이동은 반응을 유발하지 않는다. 이동 거리는 자신의 속도보다 멀리 갈 수 없으며, 이동한 적의 공간에 인접한 위치에서 이동을 종료해야 합니다. 이동 후, 이동한 적의 공간을 가진 적에게 근접 공격을 가하며, 해당 적은 그 공격에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다.

성공 대성공과 동일하나, 적의 공격에 대한 무방비가 무너지지 않습니다.

실패 원래 위치에 머무르지만 공격은 가능하다.

대실패 이동도 공격도 할 수 없습니다.

name: Deep Roots

description.value: Your mind-control spells send burrowing mental roots that tear at your target's mind when they're removed or run their course. When you Cast a Spell that imposes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} condition or otherwise forces the target to take certain actions (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aIHY2DArKFweIrpf]{Command}), you can choose one target that critically failed its save. When that target finishes fulfilling any commands issued by your spell, or when the spell is dispelled or counteracted, the target takes @Damage[1d6[mental]] damage per rank of the spell.

_desc_en: Your mind-control spells send burrowing mental roots that tear at your target's mind when they're removed or run their course. When you Cast a Spell that imposes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} condition or otherwise forces the target to take certain actions (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aIHY2DArKFweIrpf]{Command}), you can choose one target that critically failed its save. When that target finishes fulfilling any commands issued by your spell, or when the spell is dispelled or counteracted, the target takes @Damage[1d6[mental]] damage per rank of the spell.
_desc_ko: 당신의 정신 조종 주문은 제거되거나 효과가 끝날 때 대상의 정신을 찢어발기는 파고드는 정신적 뿌리를 보냅니다. @link[conditions.controlled] 상태를 부여하거나 대상에게 특정 행동(예: @link[spells.command]), 내성 굴림에서 대실패를 한 대상 하나를 선택할 수 있습니다. 해당 대상이 당신의 주문이 내린 명령을 모두 이행하거나, 주문이 해제되거나 반격될 때, 대상은 주문 랭크당 1d6 정신의 피해를 입습니다.

name: Stunning Finisher

description.value:
You attempt a dizzying blow. Make a melee Strike. If you hit, your foe must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:swashbuckler|traits:incapacitation] save against your class DC with the following results; the save has the incapacitation trait.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target can't use reactions until its next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3}.

_desc_en:
You attempt a dizzying blow. Make a melee Strike. If you hit, your foe must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:swashbuckler|traits:incapacitation] save against your class DC with the following results; the save has the incapacitation trait.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target can't use reactions until its next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3}.
_desc_ko:
어지러운 일격을 시도합니다. 근접 공격을 시도합니다. 명중 시, 상대는 당신의 직업 난이도(DC)에 대한 인내 저항 검사를 시도해야 하며, 검사 결과는 다음과 같습니다. 이 저항 검사에는 무력화 특성이 적용됩니다.

대성공 대상은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 대상은 다음 턴까지 반응을 사용할 수 없습니다.

실패 대상은 @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

대실패 대상은 @link[conditions.stunned]{3} 상태입니다.

name: Devout Magic

description.value: You gain a devotion spell of your choice listed in the devotion spells class feature, following the same restrictions listed there.

_desc_en: You gain a devotion spell of your choice listed in the devotion spells class feature, following the same restrictions listed there.
_desc_ko: 신앙 주문 클래스 특성에 기재된 신앙 주문 중 원하는 것을 선택하여 획득하며, 해당 특성에 명시된 제한 사항을 따릅니다.

name: Clockwork Reanimator Dedication

description.value:
You can animate corpses through cunning engineering. You gain a prototype construct companion to serve as a minion. Unlike normal construct companions, yours is a corpse animated by clockwork gears and technological prowess.

Special If you retrain out of this feat, you lose the rituals learned from it.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.6DgCLFEGEHvqmy7Y]{Clockwork Reanimator}

_desc_en:
You can animate corpses through cunning engineering. You gain a prototype construct companion to serve as a minion. Unlike normal construct companions, yours is a corpse animated by clockwork gears and technological prowess.

Special If you retrain out of this feat, you lose the rituals learned from it.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.6DgCLFEGEHvqmy7Y]{Clockwork Reanimator}
_desc_ko:
재치 있는 공학으로 시체를 움직일 수 있습니다. 하수인으로 삼을 프로토타입 구조물 동반자를 얻습니다. 일반 구조물 동반자와 달리, 당신의 동반자는 시계 장치와 기술력으로 움직이는 시체입니다.

특수 이 피트를 재훈련하면, 이 피트로 배운 의식을 잃게 된다.

name: Warren Friend

description.value: You're adept at making contact with other ysoki. When you arrive at a new settlement, you automatically find the nearest ratfolk enclave by spending 1 day of downtime searching, provided one exists and its members aren't actively hiding from you. Once you've made contact, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Gather Information and Earn Income in the settlement.

_desc_en: You're adept at making contact with other ysoki. When you arrive at a new settlement, you automatically find the nearest ratfolk enclave by spending 1 day of downtime searching, provided one exists and its members aren't actively hiding from you. Once you've made contact, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Gather Information and Earn Income in the settlement.
_desc_ko: 다른 이소키 종족과 접촉하는 데 능숙합니다. 새로운 정착지에 도착하면, 해당 지역에 랫포크 집단이 존재하고 그 구성원들이 당신을 적극적으로 {숨기지 않는 한}, 1일의 다운타임을 탐색에 사용함으로써 가장 가까운 랫포크 거점을 자동으로 찾아냅니다. 접촉에 성공하면 해당 정착지에서 정보 수집과 수입 창출에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Stonebound Dedication

description.value:
You bind yourself to the very essence of stone. You become trained in Plane of Earth Lore and learn the Terran language. If you are already trained in Plane of Earth Lore, you become trained in a skill of your choice. If you already speak Terran, you learn a common language of your choice. Increase your maximum Hit Points by your level.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.wC2H1yHQg1zu18Bh]{Stonebound}

_desc_en:
You bind yourself to the very essence of stone. You become trained in Plane of Earth Lore and learn the Terran language. If you are already trained in Plane of Earth Lore, you become trained in a skill of your choice. If you already speak Terran, you learn a common language of your choice. Increase your maximum Hit Points by your level.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.wC2H1yHQg1zu18Bh]{Stonebound}
_desc_ko: 당신은 돌의 본질 그 자체와 하나가 됩니다. 대지의 지식 지식을 숙련하게 되며 테란어를 익힙니다. 이미 대지의 지식 지식을 숙련한 경우, 선택한 기술 하나를 숙련하게 됩니다. 이미 테란어를 구사하는 경우, 선택한 공통 언어 하나를 익힙니다. 최대 HP를 레벨만큼 증가시킨다.

name: Rakshasa Ravaged

description.value: You and your family know well the ravages of rakshasa predations, and you know how to best defend yourself against their growing corruption in the world. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against occult spells.

_desc_en: You and your family know well the ravages of rakshasa predations, and you know how to best defend yourself against their growing corruption in the world. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against occult spells.
_desc_ko: 당신과 가족은 라크샤사의 약탈이 초래하는 파괴를 잘 알고 있으며, 세상에 퍼져가는 그들의 타락으로부터 자신을 최선으로 방어하는 방법을 알고 있습니다. 오컬트 주문에 대한 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Slayer's Strike

description.value:
You've dedicated yourself to studying ancient techniques and memorized minor prayers against undead to swiftly dispatch them. Make a Strike against a creature you know is undead. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. If this Strike hits, you deal one extra die of vitality damage, with the same die size as the weapon or unarmed attack you used. Any further Strikes you make against the same creature before the start of your next turn using the same weapon or unarmed attack deal extra vitality damage equal to the number of weapon dice. As normal, the vitality damage harms only undead and creatures with void healing.

If you're at least 10th level, increase this to two extra dice, and if you're at least 18th level, increase it to three extra dice.

_desc_en:
You've dedicated yourself to studying ancient techniques and memorized minor prayers against undead to swiftly dispatch them. Make a Strike against a creature you know is undead. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. If this Strike hits, you deal one extra die of vitality damage, with the same die size as the weapon or unarmed attack you used. Any further Strikes you make against the same creature before the start of your next turn using the same weapon or unarmed attack deal extra vitality damage equal to the number of weapon dice. As normal, the vitality damage harms only undead and creatures with void healing.

If you're at least 10th level, increase this to two extra dice, and if you're at least 18th level, increase it to three extra dice.
_desc_ko:
당신은 고대 기술을 연구하는 데 헌신하여 언데드에 대항하는 소규모 기도를 암기해 신속히 처치할 수 있게 되었습니다. 언데드임을 알고 있는 생물에게 공격을 가하십시오. 이 공격은 다중 공격 페널티 계산 시 두 번의 공격으로 간주됩니다. 이 공격이 명중하면, 사용한 무기나 비무장 공격의 주사위 크기와 동일한 활력 주사위 하나를 추가로 굴려 피해를 입힙니다. 다음 턴이 시작되기 전까지 동일한 무기나 비무장 공격으로 같은 생물에게 가하는 추가 공격은 무기 주사위 수만큼의 활력 피해를 추가로 입힙니다. 평소와 같이 활력 피해는 언데드와 공허 치유 능력을 가진 생물에게만 적용됩니다.

(10th)레벨 이상일 경우 추가 생명력 주사위를 2개로, 18레벨 이상일 경우 3개로 증가시킨다.

name: Locate Lawbreakers

description.value: Your pursuit is relentless, and you can magically locate stolen objects and outlaws. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.LQzlKbYjZSMFQawP]{Locate} as an innate spell of a tradition of your choice, which you can cast once per day. If you're a member of the Order of the Gate, when you reach 14th level, the spell is heightened to 5th rank.

_desc_en: Your pursuit is relentless, and you can magically locate stolen objects and outlaws. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.LQzlKbYjZSMFQawP]{Locate} as an innate spell of a tradition of your choice, which you can cast once per day. If you're a member of the Order of the Gate, when you reach 14th level, the spell is heightened to 5th rank.
_desc_ko: 당신의 추적은 끈질기며, 도난당한 물건과 도적을 마법으로 찾아낼 수 있습니다. 선택한 전통의 선천적 주문으로 @link[spells.locate]을 얻으며, 하루에 한 번 시전할 수 있습니다. 만약 당신이 문파의 일원이라면, 14레벨에 도달할 때 이 주문은 (5th) 랭크으로 강화됩니다.

name: Steal Magic

description.value: You don't just counter your enemy's magic, you instantly master it and make it your own. When you successfully counterspell an enemy's spell using Mythic Counterspell, you can learn that spell as long as it's on the spell list for your tradition. If you have a spellbook, the spell is instantly scribed into the book, creating new blank pages if needed. If you have a spell repertoire, you can instantly retrain any spell currently in your repertoire to the countered spell, though if the spell you replace is one granted to you by a class feature (such as an animist's apparition spells or a sorcerer's bloodline spells), the spell reverts to the one normally granted by that class feature during your next daily preparations.

_desc_en: You don't just counter your enemy's magic, you instantly master it and make it your own. When you successfully counterspell an enemy's spell using Mythic Counterspell, you can learn that spell as long as it's on the spell list for your tradition. If you have a spellbook, the spell is instantly scribed into the book, creating new blank pages if needed. If you have a spell repertoire, you can instantly retrain any spell currently in your repertoire to the countered spell, though if the spell you replace is one granted to you by a class feature (such as an animist's apparition spells or a sorcerer's bloodline spells), the spell reverts to the one normally granted by that class feature during your next daily preparations.
_desc_ko: 상대의 마법을 단순히 무효화하는 것이 아니라, 즉시 그 마법을 마스터하여 자신의 것으로 만듭니다. 신화적 카운터스펠로 적의 마법을 성공적으로 카운터스펠했을 때, 해당 마법이 당신의 전통 마법 목록에 포함되어 있다면 그 마법을 배울 수 있습니다. 마법책이 있다면, 필요한 경우 새 빈 페이지를 생성하며 즉시 그 마법이 책에 기록됩니다. 주문 목록을 보유한 경우, 현재 주문 목록에 있는 어떤 주문이든 즉시 카운터한 주문으로 재훈련할 수 있다. 단, 대체하는 주문이 클래스 의 특성(애니미스트의 환영 주문이나 소서러의 혈통 주문 등)으로 부여받은 것이라면, 다음 일일 준비 시 해당 클래스 특성이 일반적으로 부여하는 주문으로 되돌아간다.

name: Spot Translate

description.value:
Trigger Another creature within 60 feet uses a linguistic effect in a language you understand.

You bridge a language gap, repeating the message in a different language that you know. Choose a language you understand to repeat the message in. The linguistic effect counts as both languages, rather than only the language the triggering creature is using, potentially allowing it to affect a wider range of creatures. As normal, you can translate normal speech without Spot Translate and without using a reaction, but this reaction allows you to apply the benefits of translation to spells and actions such as command or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}.

_desc_en:
Trigger Another creature within 60 feet uses a linguistic effect in a language you understand.

You bridge a language gap, repeating the message in a different language that you know. Choose a language you understand to repeat the message in. The linguistic effect counts as both languages, rather than only the language the triggering creature is using, potentially allowing it to affect a wider range of creatures. As normal, you can translate normal speech without Spot Translate and without using a reaction, but this reaction allows you to apply the benefits of translation to spells and actions such as command or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}.
_desc_ko:
발동 60피트 내의 다른 생물이 당신이 이해하는 언어로 언어적 효과를 사용한다.

당신은 언어 장벽을 넘어 메시지를 당신이 아는 다른 언어로 반복합니다. 메시지를 반복할 언어를 선택하세요 . 언어적 효과는 발동 생물이 사용하는 언어뿐만 아니라 두 언어 모두로 간주되어 더 넓은 범위의 생물에게 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다. 평소처럼 '발견 번역' 능력 없이도 반응을 사용하지 않고 일반 대화를 번역할 수 있지만, 이 반응은 '명령'이나 @link[actions.demoralize]와 같은 주문 및 행동에 번역의 이점을 적용할 수 있게 합니다.

name: Banshee Cry Display

description.value: You've learned how to unleash a sudden and disruptive noisemaker at just the right moment in your display, a technique that can cause a spellcaster to fumble the phrasing of their magic. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.b3h3QqvwS5fnaiu1]{Banshee Cry} fireworks display.

_desc_en: You've learned how to unleash a sudden and disruptive noisemaker at just the right moment in your display, a technique that can cause a spellcaster to fumble the phrasing of their magic. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.b3h3QqvwS5fnaiu1]{Banshee Cry} fireworks display.
_desc_ko: 당신은 공연 중 적절한 순간에 갑작스럽고 방해가 되는 소음기를 터뜨리는 법을 배웠습니다. 이 기술은 마법사가 주문을 읊는 것을 실수하게 만들 수 있습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.banshee-cry] 불꽃놀이를 얻습니다.

name: Inviolable

description.value: Your deity punishes creatures that harm you. Creatures that hit you with an attack take @Damage[3d6[spirit]] damage every time they do. If you have the holy or unholy trait, you can apply it to this damage.

_desc_en: Your deity punishes creatures that harm you. Creatures that hit you with an attack take @Damage[3d6[spirit]] damage every time they do. If you have the holy or unholy trait, you can apply it to this damage.
_desc_ko: 당신을 해치는 생물들은 당신의 신에 의해 벌을 받습니다. 당신을 공격으로 명중시키는 생물은 매번 3d6 영혼의 피해를 입습니다. 당신이 신성한 또는 불경한 특성을 가지고 있다면, 이 피해에 해당 특성을 적용할 수 있습니다.

name: Winglets

description.value: Through the lingering influence of your warren's patron, you've sprouted a small set of wings. While not suitable for full flight, these weak wings can help you jump further with a small flap. When Leaping horizontally, you move an additional 5 feet. This additional distance isn't cumulative with the increased @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} distance from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.HJYQlmGTdtyGWr6a]{Powerful Leap} feat. In addition, when you attempt a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump}, you can jump a distance up to 10 feet farther than you normally would based on the result of your Athletics check, though you still can't jump farther than your Speed. You don't automatically fail your checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump} or Long Jump if you don't Stride at least 10 feet first.

_desc_en: Through the lingering influence of your warren's patron, you've sprouted a small set of wings. While not suitable for full flight, these weak wings can help you jump further with a small flap. When Leaping horizontally, you move an additional 5 feet. This additional distance isn't cumulative with the increased @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} distance from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.HJYQlmGTdtyGWr6a]{Powerful Leap} feat. In addition, when you attempt a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump}, you can jump a distance up to 10 feet farther than you normally would based on the result of your Athletics check, though you still can't jump farther than your Speed. You don't automatically fail your checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump} or Long Jump if you don't Stride at least 10 feet first.
_desc_ko: 당신 굴의 후원자의 잔존 영향으로 작은 날개 한 쌍이 돋아났습니다. 완전한 비행에는 적합하지 않지만, 이 약한 날개는 작은 날갯짓으로 더 멀리 점프하는 데 도움을 줍니다. 수평으로 도약할 때, 추가로 5피트 이동한다. 이 추가 거리는 @link[feats.powerful-leap] 재주로 증가된 @link[actions.leap] 거리와 중복 적용되지 않는다. 또한 @link[actions.long-jump]를 시도할 때, 운동 판정 결과에 기반한 평소보다 최대 10피트 더 멀리 거리를 점프할 수 있습니다. 단, 여전히 자신의 이동 속도보다 멀리 점프할 수는 없습니다. @link[actions.high-jump]나 {멀리뛰기} 판정에서 10피트 이상 먼저 이동하지 않았다고 해서 자동으로 실패하지는 않습니다.

name: Fake It Till You Make It

description.value: When you take on a role, you become more capable with all sorts of tasks involving that role. When you Assume a Role, choose two skills associated with the role in some way; if you're untrained, you can use your level as your proficiency bonus for those skills, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to skill checks with those skills as long as you remain in that role. You and the GM determine which skills you assume.

name_en: Fake It Till You Make It
_desc_en: When you take on a role, you become more capable with all sorts of tasks involving that role. When you Assume a Role, choose two skills associated with the role in some way; if you're untrained, you can use your level as your proficiency bonus for those skills, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to skill checks with those skills as long as you remain in that role. You and the GM determine which skills you assume.
_desc_ko: 역할을 맡으면 해당 역할과 관련된 모든 종류의 작업에 더 능숙해집니다. 역할을 맡을 때, 그 역할과 어떤 식으로든 연관된 두 가지 기술을 선택하십시오. 훈련받지 않은 경우, 해당 기술에 대해 자신의 레벨을 숙련 보너스로 사용할 수 있으며, 그 역할을 유지하는 동안 해당 기술의 기술 판정 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 어떤 기술을 선택할지는 당신과 GM이 결정합니다.

name: Mind Smith Dedication

description.value:
You've learned to imagine a shape in your mind, to envision it so strongly it takes form in the material world. You gain a single melee weapon of your choosing, called a mind weapon. Your mind weapon is a martial melee weapon. The overall shape and design of your mind weapon can be of your choosing but it has one of the following four basic statistics:

  • A one-handed weapon that deals 1d4 damage and has the agile and finesse traits
  • A one-handed weapon that deals 1d6 damage and has the finesse trait
  • A one-handed weapon that deals 1d8 damage
  • A two-handed weapon that deals 1d10 damage and has the reach trait

Each day during your daily preparations, you can decide if you want your weapon to deal bludgeoning damage and be in the club weapon group, deal piercing damage and be in the spear weapon group, or deal slashing damage and be in the sword weapon group. Your mind weapon is an extension of your mind-it has no Hardness, and any ability that would damage your mind weapon instead damages you directly, pushing back against the weapon's corporeal form and becoming mental damage of the same amount the weapon would've taken.

You can project your mind weapon using an Interact action, just as you would draw any other weapon. Only you can hold, carry, or wield your mind weapon; if held by another person, it quickly disappears from their hand, reforming in your mind for you to project again. If you're disarmed of your mind weapon, it dematerializes, but you can draw it again with an Interact action starting at the beginning of your next turn.

Upon creating your mind weapon, you also learn to use a mind smith's keepsake: an object of light Bulk, such as a bracelet or figurine, that you wear or keep on your person and inscribe with weapon runes. Your keepsake can't be a magic item, nor can it have any significant monetary value beyond the value of any runes you inscribe on it. You can buy and inscribe fundamental runes and weapon property runes onto your keepsake in the same way you would for a regular weapon, and you can move runes to and from your keepsake to other weapons or runestones for the usual cost. Any runes inscribed on the keepsake apply to your mind weapon when you create it. If your keepsake is ever lost or destroyed, you can spend 1 week of downtime imprinting a new object with your weapon's mental properties, though this new keepsake won't have any of the runes that were inscribed on the prior keepsake.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.mXywYJJCM9IVItZz]{Mind Smith}
_desc_ko:
당신은 마음속으로 형상을 상상하고, 그것을 너무나 강렬하게 그려내어 물질 세계에 형태를 취하게 하는 법을 배웠습니다. 당신은 마음의 무기라 불리는 근접 무기 하나를 선택하여 획득합니다. 마음의 무기는 무술 근접 무기입니다. 마음의 무기의 전체적인 형태와 디자인은 선택할 수 있으나, 다음 네 가지 기본 통계 중 하나를 가집니다:

  • 1d4 피해를 입히는 한손 무기로 기민한 특성과 기교 특성을 지님
  • 1d6 피해를 입히는 한손 무기로 기교 특성을 지님
  • 손에 한 자루로 드는 무기로 d8의 피해를 입힙니다
  • 양손으로 드는 무기로 1d10의 피해를 입히고 도달 범위가 넓은 특성을 지닙니다

매일 준비 시간 동안 무기가 타격 피해를 주고 몽둥이 무기 그룹에 속할지, 관통 피해를 주고 창 무기 그룹에 속할지, 베기 피해를 주고 검 무기 그룹에 속할지 선택할 수 있습니다. 당신의 정신 무기는 정신의 연장선입니다. 경도가 없으며, 정신 무기에 피해를 입히려는 능력은 대신 당신에게 직접 피해를 입힙니다. 이는 무기의 물질적 형태를 밀어내고, 무기가 받았을 피해량과 동일한 정신 피해를 발생시킵니다.

다른 무기를 뽑듯이 상호작용 행동으로 정신 무기를 투사할 수 있습니다. 오직 당신만이 정신 무기를 들고, 휴대하거나 휘둘 수 있습니다. 다른 사람이 잡으면 즉시 그 손에서 사라져 당신의 정신 속에 재구성되며, 다시 투사할 수 있습니다. 정신 무기를 {무장 해제}하면 무형화되지만, 다음 턴 시작 시 상호작용 행동으로 다시 뽑을 수 있다.

정신 무기를 생성할 때, 정신 대장장이의 유물 사용법도 함께 익히게 됩니다. 이는 팔찌나 조각상처럼 가벼운 벌크의 물건으로, 몸에 지니거나 착용하며 무기 룬을 새깁니다. 유물은 마법 아이템일 수 없으며, 새겨진 룬의 가치 외에 상당한 금전적 가치를 지닐 수 없습니다. 일반 무기와 동일한 방식으로 유물에 기본 룬과 무기 속성 룬을 구매하여 새길 수 있으며, 일반 비용으로 유물과 다른 무기 또는 정신 돌 사이에서 룬을 이동시킬 수 있습니다. 추억의 물건에 새겨진 룬은 정신 무기를 생성할 때 적용됩니다. 추억의 물건을 분실하거나 파괴한 경우, 1주일의 다운타임을 소모하여 새로운 물건에 무기의 정신적 속성을 각인할 수 있으나, 이 새로운 물건에는 이전 물건에 새겨진 룬은 전혀 적용되지 않습니다.

name: Scout's Pounce

description.value:
Requirements You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} by all of your opponents, and you aren't within 10 feet of any enemy.

You leap from the shadows to strike your foes. Stride up to your Speed, then Strike twice. If you were hidden or unnoticed by the target of these Strikes, your foe is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against both attacks.

Your multiple attack penalty applies normally for both attacks.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} by all of your opponents, and you aren't within 10 feet of any enemy.

_desc_ko:
Requirements 당신은 모든 상대에게 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태이거나 @link[conditions.undetected] 상태여야 하며, 어떤 적과도 10피트 이내에 있지 않아야 합니다.

당신은 그림자 속에서 뛰어올라 적을 공격합니다. 이동 속도만큼 전진한 후 두 번 공격합니다. 이 공격 대상이 당신을 숨겨져 있거나 눈치채지 못했다면, 상대는 두 공격 모두에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다.

두 공격 모두에 대해 다중 공격 페널티가 정상적으로 적용된다.

name: Fast Channel

description.value:
Divine power is always at your fingertips, swiftly responding to your call. When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} by spending 2 actions, you can get the effects of the 3-action version instead of the 2-action version.

You can do this with harm if you have harmful font or heal if you have healing font (or both if you have Versatile Font).

_desc_en:
Divine power is always at your fingertips, swiftly responding to your call. When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} by spending 2 actions, you can get the effects of the 3-action version instead of the 2-action version.

You can do this with harm if you have harmful font or heal if you have healing font (or both if you have Versatile Font).
_desc_ko:
신성한 힘은 항상 손끝에 있어, 당신의 부름에 재빨리 응답합니다. @link[spells.harm] 또는 @link[spells.heal]를 2 행동을 소모하여 시전할 때, 2 행동 버전이 아닌 3 행동 버전의 효과를 얻을 수 있다.

해악의 샘을 보유한 경우 해악로, 치유 서체를 보유한 경우 치유로 (또는 다용도 서체를 보유한 경우 둘 다) 이를 수행할 수 있습니다.

name: Armored Rebuff

description.value:
Trigger An adjacent foe critically fails an attack roll to Strike you with a melee weapon or unarmed attack.

Requirements You are wearing medium armor or heavier.

You rebuff puny attacks with your armor, knocking back your foe. Attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} the triggering foe, even if you don't have a hand free. If you succeed, you can't Stride to follow the foe, as you're knocking the foe back with the rebounded attack, not by physically moving towards them.

_desc_en:
Trigger An adjacent foe critically fails an attack roll to Strike you with a melee weapon or unarmed attack.

Requirements You are wearing medium armor or heavier.

You rebuff puny attacks with your armor, knocking back your foe. Attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} the triggering foe, even if you don't have a hand free. If you succeed, you can't Stride to follow the foe, as you're knocking the foe back with the rebounded attack, not by physically moving towards them.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 인접한 적이 근접 무기나 비무장 공격으로 당신을 강타하는 명중 굴림에 대실패를 합니다.

요건 평갑 또는 중갑 이상을 착용하고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 갑옷으로 하찮은 공격을 막아내며 적을 밀쳐냅니다. 손을 자유롭게 쓸 수 없는 상황이라도, 운동 판정을 시도하여 @link[actions.shove]로 공격을 유발한 적을 밀쳐낼 수 있습니다. 성공 시, 반동 공격으로 적을 밀쳐내는 것이지 물리적으로 접근하는 것이 아니므로 적을 따라 이동할 수 없습니다.

name: Guillotine Blade

description.value:
Frequency once per day

The echoes of the splinter of finality's original purpose resonate through the artifact. For the next minute, your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ts5z3xR9j48Cic5H]{Spectral Dagger} gains the benefits of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.6xaxxKfvXED6LfIY]{Vorpal} rune. When you use Snicker-Snack with your spectral dagger, the DC of the @Check[fortitude|dc:resolve(max(37,@actor.system.attributes.classOrSpellDC.value))] save is 37, your class DC, or your spell DC, whichever is higher.

_desc_ko:

name: Salt Kissed

description.value: You have a supernatural ability to survive at sea and keep your companions from drowning. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.W69zswpj0Trdy5rj]{Air Bubble} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MZGkMsPBztFN0pUO]{Water Breathing} as 4th-rank divine innate spells once per day each. Add the water domain to those that you can select with Liberty's Promise.

_desc_en: You have a supernatural ability to survive at sea and keep your companions from drowning. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.W69zswpj0Trdy5rj]{Air Bubble} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MZGkMsPBztFN0pUO]{Water Breathing} as 4th-rank divine innate spells once per day each. Add the water domain to those that you can select with Liberty's Promise.
_desc_ko: 당신은 바다에서 생존하고 동료들이 익사하지 않게 하는 초자연적 능력을 갖고 있다. 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.W69zswpj0Trdy5rj]{공기 방울}과 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MZGkMsPBztFN0pUO]{수중 호흡}을 각각 하루 1회 4랭크 신성 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있다. 자유의 약속으로 선택할 수 있는 영역에 물 영역을 추가한다.

name: Worm Form

description.value:
You take on the form of a purple worm or transform into a humanoid-worm hybrid, retaining your own head but with a worm's body, transforming into a Huge battle form. You must have enough space to expand into or the ability is lost. While in this form, you gain the animal trait. You can Dismiss the form.

You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which battle form you choose:

  • AC = 20 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.
  • 40 temporary Hit Points.
  • Darkvision.
  • One or more unarmed melee attacks specific to the battle form you choose, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +25, and you use the listed damage. Melee attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the enfeebled condition, for example). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead.
  • Athletics modifier of +30, unless your own modifier is higher.

You also gain specific abilities based on the type of monster you choose:

  • Purple Worm Speed 40 feet, burrow 30 feet, swim 20 feet
    • Melee 1 jaws (deadly 2d10, reach 15 feet), Damage 3d10+15 piercing
    • Melee 1 stinger (agile, poison, reach 15 feet), Damage 2d12+15 piercing plus 2d6 persistent poison
    • Melee 1 body (reach 15 feet) Damage 1d10+13 bludgeoning
  • Hybrid Speed 40 feet
    • Melee 1 stinger (agile, poison, reach 10 feet), Damage 2d12+15 piercing plus 1d6 persistent poison
    • Melee 1 body (reach 10 feet), Damage 1d10+13 bludgeoning
    • Hybrid Caster You retain the ability to speak, and can cast spells as long as they don't have somatic or material components.
