_desc_ko:
자주색 벌레의 형태를 취하거나 인간형 벌레 혼혈체로 변신하여 자신의 머리는 유지한 채 벌레의 몸으로 거대한 전투 형태로 변신한다. 확장할 충분한 공간이 없으면 능력은 소멸된다. 이 형태일 때 동물 특성을 얻는다. 형태를 해제할 수 있다.

선택한 전투 형태에 관계없이 다음 능력치와 능력을 획득한다:

  • AC = 20 + 레벨. 착용한 갑옷의 판정 페널티와 속도 감소 효과를 무시합니다.
  • 40의 임시 HP.
  • 선택한 전투 형태에 특화된 한 가지 이상의 맨손 근접 공격. 이 공격들만이 당신이 공격할 수 있는 유일한 수단이다. 당신은 이 공격들에 숙련되어 있다. 공격 수정자는 +25이며, 명시된 피해를 사용한다. 근접 공격은 근력 기반이다(예: 약화된 상태 적용 시). 비무장 공격 수정자가 더 높다면, 대신 이를 사용할 수 있다.
  • 운동 수정자 +30 (본인의 수정자가 더 높을 경우 해당 수정자를 적용).

선택한 몬스터 유형에 따라 특정 능력도 획득합니다:

  • 보라색 벌레 이동 속도 40피트, 땅파기 30피트, 수영 20피트
    • 근접 공격 1 턱 (치명적 2d10, 범위 15피트), 피해 3d10+15 관통
    • 근접 1 침 (기민한, 독, 범위 15피트), 피해 관통 2d12+15 + 지속 독 2d6
    • 근접 공격 1 몸통 (범위 15피트) 피해 1d10+13 타격
  • 하이브리드 이동 속도 40피트
    • 근접 1 침 (기민한, 독, 도달 거리 10피트), 피해 2d12+15 관통 + 1d6 지속 독
    • 근접 공격 1 몸통 (도달 거리 10피트), 피해 1d10+13 타격
    • 하이브리드 시전자 말하기 능력은 유지되며, 신체적 또는 물질적 성분이 없는 주문은 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Squad Tactics

description.value: You are adept at working with your allies to surround an enemy. If an enemy is within reach of you and at least two of your allies, that enemy is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you.

_desc_en: You are adept at working with your allies to surround an enemy. If an enemy is within reach of you and at least two of your allies, that enemy is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you.
_desc_ko: 당신은 아군과 협력하여 적을 포위하는 데 능숙합니다. 적이 당신과 최소 두 명의 아군에게 접근 가능한 범위 내에 있을 경우, 해당 적은 당신에게 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Distracting Flattery

description.value:
Trigger You observe a target's attitude toward yourself or your allies decrease as a result of an ally's behavior.

You know how to maintain a good impression and manage your image, even while keeping uncouth company.

Make a @Check[deception|defense:will] check against the target's Will DC. Regardless of your result, the target is temporarily immune to your Distracting Flattery for 10 minutes.

Success The target's attitude doesn't decrease as a result of your ally's social blunder.

Failure The target's attitude decreases, as normal.

Critical Failure Your attempt makes matters worse, decreasing the target's attitude toward you by one step, in addition to any changes from the behavior that triggered this reaction.

_desc_en:
Trigger You observe a target's attitude toward yourself or your allies decrease as a result of an ally's behavior.

You know how to maintain a good impression and manage your image, even while keeping uncouth company.

Make a @Check[deception|defense:will] check against the target's Will DC. Regardless of your result, the target is temporarily immune to your Distracting Flattery for 10 minutes.

Success The target's attitude doesn't decrease as a result of your ally's social blunder.

Failure The target's attitude decreases, as normal.

Critical Failure Your attempt makes matters worse, decreasing the target's attitude toward you by one step, in addition to any changes from the behavior that triggered this reaction.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 동맹의 행동으로 인해 대상이 자신이나 동맹에 대한 태도가 악화되는 것을 목격한다.

당신은 무례한 사람들과 어울리면서도 좋은 인상을 유지하고 이미지를 관리하는 방법을 알고 있습니다.

대상자의 의지 DC에 대해 기만 판정을 수행하십시오. 결과와 상관없이 대상자는 10분 동안 당신의 '주의 분산하는 아첨'에 일시적으로 면역됩니다.

성공 시 아군의 사회적 실수로 인해 대상의 태도가 감소하지 않습니다.

실패 대상의 태도는 평소처럼 감소합니다.

대실패 당신의 시도는 상황을 악화시켜, 이 반응을 유발한 행동으로 인한 변화에 더해 대상의 당신에 대한 태도를 한 단계 더 낮춥니다.

name: Nocturnal Senses

description.value: Your senses gain even greater clarity. While raging, if you have low-light vision you gain darkvision, and if you have scent the range of your imprecise scent increases to 60 feet.

_desc_en: Your senses gain even greater clarity. While raging, if you have low-light vision you gain darkvision, and if you have scent the range of your imprecise scent increases to 60 feet.
_desc_ko: 당신의 감각이 더욱 선명해집니다. 격노 상태에서, 저조도 시야를 가진 경우 암흑 시야를 얻으며, 후각을 가진 경우 부정확한 후각의 범위가 60피트로 증가합니다.

name: Pact of Eldritch Eyes

description.value:
You've sworn a pact with an entity beyond mortal comprehension, granting you distant visions. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ek5XI0aEdZhBgm21]{Scouting Eye} as an occult innate spell once per hour, using the higher of your class DC and your spell DC to determine the DC.

In exchange, you allow the entity to peer through you at your world. The entity's touch creates strange dreams, typically nightmares. Every morning, you awaken trained in an unexpected Lore skill determined by the GM, which you retain until the next time you rest for the night. While the entity contacts you most often while you sleep, it occasionally peers at you during the day, leading to disorientation and visions. You can generally determine what's going on during these visions, so normally this occurrence imparts no mechanical penalty. However, in the unlikely event that an encounter begins while you're experiencing visions from the entity, you might take a circumstance penalty to your initiative roll.

Special The entity isn't particularly attached to its pact with you. If you want it gone, you can retrain out of Pact of Eldritch Eyes, after which the entity withdraws its eyes to the void.

_desc_en:
You've sworn a pact with an entity beyond mortal comprehension, granting you distant visions. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ek5XI0aEdZhBgm21]{Scouting Eye} as an occult innate spell once per hour, using the higher of your class DC and your spell DC to determine the DC.

In exchange, you allow the entity to peer through you at your world. The entity's touch creates strange dreams, typically nightmares. Every morning, you awaken trained in an unexpected Lore skill determined by the GM, which you retain until the next time you rest for the night. While the entity contacts you most often while you sleep, it occasionally peers at you during the day, leading to disorientation and visions. You can generally determine what's going on during these visions, so normally this occurrence imparts no mechanical penalty. However, in the unlikely event that an encounter begins while you're experiencing visions from the entity, you might take a circumstance penalty to your initiative roll.

Special The entity isn't particularly attached to its pact with you. If you want it gone, you can retrain out of Pact of Eldritch Eyes, after which the entity withdraws its eyes to the void.
_desc_ko:
당신은 인간이 이해할 수 없는 존재와 계약을 맺어 먼 곳의 비전과 통찰력을 얻었습니다. 시간당 한 번씩 @link[spells.scouting-eye]을 오컬트 선천적 주문으로 시전할 수 있으며, 시전 난이도는 직업 난이도와 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽을 기준으로 합니다.

대신 당신은 그 존재가 당신을 통해 당신의 세계를 들여다보도록 허용합니다. 그 존재의 접촉은 기이한 꿈, 주로 악몽을 만들어냅니다. 매일 아침, 당신은 GM이 결정한 예상치 못한 지식 지식에 숙련된 상태로 깨어나며, 이 숙련도는 다음 밤에 휴식을 취할 때까지 유지됩니다. 그 존재는 주로 당신이 잠든 동안 접촉하지만, 가끔 낮에도 당신을 들여다보며 혼란과 환각을 유발합니다. 일반적으로 이러한 환각 중 무슨 일이 벌어지는지 파악할 수 있으므로, 보통 이 현상은 메커니즘상 불이익을 주지 않습니다. 그러나 드물게 존재의 환각을 경험하는 중에 전투가 시작될 경우, 인니셔티브 굴림에 상황 불이익을 받을 수 있습니다.

특수 이 존재는 당신과의 계약에 특별히 집착하지 않습니다. 계약을 해지하고 싶다면 '기이한 눈의 계약'을 재훈련하면 됩니다. 그러면 존재는 자신의 눈을 공허 속으로 거두어 갑니다.

name: Guiding Luck

description.value: Your luck guides you to look the right way and aim your blows unerringly. You can use Halfling Luck twice per day: once in response to its normal trigger, and once when you fail a Perception check or attack roll instead of the normal trigger.

_desc_en: Your luck guides you to look the right way and aim your blows unerringly. You can use Halfling Luck twice per day: once in response to its normal trigger, and once when you fail a Perception check or attack roll instead of the normal trigger.
_desc_ko: 운이 당신을 이끌어 올바른 방향을 바라보고 타격을 정확히 조준하게 합니다. 하플링의 행운은 하루에 두 번 사용할 수 있습니다: 한 번은 일반적인 발동 조건에 따라, 다른 한 번은 지각 판정나 명중 굴림에 실패했을 때 일반적인 발동 조건 대신 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Look but Don't Touch

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Many flowers are beautiful to look upon but deadly to touch—and you're one of them. For 1 minute, any creature that touches you or damages you with a melee weapon without the reach trait or with a melee unarmed attack takes @Damage[3d6[poison]] damage.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Many flowers are beautiful to look upon but deadly to touch—and you're one of them. For 1 minute, any creature that touches you or damages you with a melee weapon without the reach trait or with a melee unarmed attack takes @Damage[3d6[poison]] damage.
_desc_ko:
빈도 하루에 한 번

많은 꽃들은 보기에는 아름답지만 만지면 치명적입니다-당신도 그 중 하나입니다. 1분 동안, 당신을 만지거나 도달 특성 없는 근접 무기로, 또는 비무장 공격으로 당신에게 피해를 입힌 모든 생물은 3d6 독의 피해를 입습니다.

name: Vivacious Afterimage

description.value:
Requirements You have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.LzYi0OuOoypNb6jd]{Panache}.

You move so quickly that you create a short-lived afterimage, looks exactly like you, in front of you or behind you. You Stride. At any point along your movement, you leave an afterimage of yourself behind. Alternatively, you can stop moving and send your afterimage forward instead, up to the remainder of your Speed. A creature that spends actions to engage with your afterimage can attempt to disbelieve it with a @Check[will|against:swashbuckler] save against your class DC. Once an enemy has disbelieved any of your afterimages, they are temporarily immune to all of your Vivacious Afterimages for 10 minutes. As long as a creature has not disbelieved the afterimage, the afterimage counts as a creature for flanking. The afterimage lasts until the beginning of your next turn or until you use Vivacious Afterimage again, whichever comes first.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.LzYi0OuOoypNb6jd]{Panache}.

You move so quickly that you create a short-lived afterimage, looks exactly like you, in front of you or behind you. You Stride. At any point along your movement, you leave an afterimage of yourself behind. Alternatively, you can stop moving and send your afterimage forward instead, up to the remainder of your Speed. A creature that spends actions to engage with your afterimage can attempt to disbelieve it with a @Check[will|against:swashbuckler] save against your class DC. Once an enemy has disbelieved any of your afterimages, they are temporarily immune to all of your Vivacious Afterimages for 10 minutes. As long as a creature has not disbelieved the afterimage, the afterimage counts as a creature for flanking. The afterimage lasts until the beginning of your next turn or until you use Vivacious Afterimage again, whichever comes first.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.uBJsxCzNhje8m8jj]{파나슈}를 보유하고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 매우 빠르게 움직여, 당신과 똑같이 생긴 짧은 잔상을 당신 앞이나 뒤에 생성합니다. 당신은 큰 걸음으로 이동합니다. 이동 중 어느 지점에서든 자신의 잔상을 남깁니다. 또는 이동을 멈추고 잔상을 앞으로 보내는 대신, 남은 속도만큼 앞으로 보낼 수 있습니다. 잔상과 교전하기 위해 행동을 소모한 생물은 당신의 클래스 DC(DC)에 대한 의지 내성을 통해 이를 믿지 않으려 시도할 수 있습니다. 적 중 하나가 당신의 잔상 중 하나를 의심한 경우, 10분 동안 당신의 모든 활기찬 잔상에 대해 일시적으로 면역 상태가 됩니다. 생물이 잔상을 의심하지 않은 한, 잔상은 측면 공격을 위한 생물로 간주됩니다. 잔상은 당신의 다음 턴 시작 시점이나 당신이 활기찬 잔상을 다시 사용할 때까지 지속되며, 둘 중 먼저 도래하는 시점에 사라집니다.

name: Reptile Rider

description.value:
To you, crocodilians, giant lizards, and dinosaurs are loyal steeds, not monsters. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Rq5wkA8DtsmbzoGV]{Ride} feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Nature checks to Handle an Animal as long as the animal is a reptile, dinosaur, or even a non-sapient dragon.

Note This feat refers to Nature checks to Handle an Animal. This check does not exist in Pathfinder 2, and so the feat instead gives a bonus to Nature checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{Command an Animal}.

_desc_en:
To you, crocodilians, giant lizards, and dinosaurs are loyal steeds, not monsters. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Rq5wkA8DtsmbzoGV]{Ride} feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Nature checks to Handle an Animal as long as the animal is a reptile, dinosaur, or even a non-sapient dragon.

Note This feat refers to Nature checks to Handle an Animal. This check does not exist in Pathfinder 2, and so the feat instead gives a bonus to Nature checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{Command an Animal}.
_desc_ko:
당신에게 악어류, 거대 도마뱀, 공룡은 괴물이 아닌 충성스러운 탈것입니다. @link[feats.ride] 피트를 전제 조건을 충족하지 않아도 획득한다. 파충류, 공룡, 심지어 지능이 없는 용까지도 동물 다루기 자연 판정 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻는다.

참고 이 피트는 동물을 다루기 위한 자연 판정을 의미합니다. 이 피트는 패스파인더 2판에는 존재하지 않으므로, 대신 @link[actions.command-an-animal] 능력에 대한 자연 판정 보너스를 부여합니다.

name: Purifying Breeze

description.value:
Requirements Your most recent action was to cast a non-cantrip spell with the healing trait.

You transfer the divine essence of your magic to the air around you, cleansing it of toxins. Attempt a counteract check against each airborne disease or poison effect in a @Template[emanation|distance:15]{15-foot radius} around you. Regardless of your success or failure, until the beginning of your next turn, all creatures in the purified area gain a +1 status bonus to Fortitude saving throws.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.7MQLLkQACZt8cspt]{Effect: Purifying Breeze}

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en:
Requirements Your most recent action was to cast a non-cantrip spell with the healing trait.

You transfer the divine essence of your magic to the air around you, cleansing it of toxins. Attempt a counteract check against each airborne disease or poison effect in a @Template[emanation|distance:15]{15-foot radius} around you. Regardless of your success or failure, until the beginning of your next turn, all creatures in the purified area gain a +1 status bonus to Fortitude saving throws.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.7MQLLkQACZt8cspt]{Effect: Purifying Breeze}
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 가장 최근 행동이 치유 특성을 가진 캔트립 주문을 시전한 것이어야 합니다.

당신은 마법의 신성한 정수를 주변 공기로 옮겨 독소를 정화합니다. 주변 15피트 내의 모든 공기 중 질병 또는 독 효과에 대해 반격 판정을 시도합니다. 성공 여부와 상관없이, 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 정화된 영역 내 모든 생물은 인내 내성 굴림에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻는다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.7MQLLkQACZt8cspt]{효과: 정화하는 산들바람}

name: The Harder They Fall

description.value: You make your foes fall painfully when you trip them. When you successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} foe, your target takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage. On a critical success, the target takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage plus your sneak attack damage.

_desc_en: You make your foes fall painfully when you trip them. When you successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} foe, your target takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage. On a critical success, the target takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage plus your sneak attack damage.
_desc_ko: 당신은 적을 넘어뜨릴 때 고통스럽게 쓰러지게 합니다. @link[conditions.off-guard]인 적을 @link[actions.trip]에 성공하면 대상은 1d6 타격 피해를 입습니다. 대성공 시, 대상은 1d6 타격 피해에 추가로 네 암습 피해를 받는다.

name: Momentum Strike

description.value: Putting your weight behind your weapon's swing, you can push one enemy into another. Make a melee Strike against an enemy of your size or smaller. If you hit and deal damage, you can move the enemy up to 5 feet (up to 10 feet on a critical hit) in a direction of your choice. It must remain within your reach during this movement, and you can't move it into or through obstacles. You can move the target into another creature's space. If you do, the second creature takes bludgeoning damage equal to @Damage[(2*(@actor.abilities.str.mod))[bludgeoning]]{double your Strength modifier} and is pushed away from the target until it's no longer in the same space. If there's no room for the second creature to move, you can't move the target into it.

_desc_en: Putting your weight behind your weapon's swing, you can push one enemy into another. Make a melee Strike against an enemy of your size or smaller. If you hit and deal damage, you can move the enemy up to 5 feet (up to 10 feet on a critical hit) in a direction of your choice. It must remain within your reach during this movement, and you can't move it into or through obstacles. You can move the target into another creature's space. If you do, the second creature takes bludgeoning damage equal to @Damage[(2*(@actor.abilities.str.mod))[bludgeoning]]{double your Strength modifier} and is pushed away from the target until it's no longer in the same space. If there's no room for the second creature to move, you can't move the target into it.
_desc_ko: 무기의 휘두름에 체중을 실어 한 적을 다른 적에게 밀어붙일 수 있습니다. 자신과 같은 크기 또는 더 작은 적에게 근접 공격을 시도합니다. 명중하여 피해를 입히면, 적을 최대 5피트(치명타 시 최대 10피트)까지 원하는 방향으로 이동시킬 수 있습니다. 이동 중에도 대상은 자신의 도달 범위 내에 머물러야 하며, 장애물 안이나 통과하여 이동시킬 수 없습니다. 대상 생물을 다른 생물의 공간으로 밀어낼 수 있다. 그렇게 할 경우, 두 번째 생물은 근력 능력치 수정자 ×2에 해당하는 타격 피해를 입으며 대상 생물로부터 멀어지도록 밀려난다. 두 번째 생물이 이동할 공간이 없을 경우, 대상 생물을 그 생물 쪽으로 밀어낼 수 없다.

name: Unstable Patronage

description.value: You can act as a magical patron for your charges. When you finish your daily preparations, choose a spell your familiar knows and one of your charges. Once before your next daily preparations, that creature can Cast the Spell as an innate spell; this spell can be of no higher a rank than the highest rank of spells you can cast –2.

_desc_en: You can act as a magical patron for your charges. When you finish your daily preparations, choose a spell your familiar knows and one of your charges. Once before your next daily preparations, that creature can Cast the Spell as an innate spell; this spell can be of no higher a rank than the highest rank of spells you can cast –2.
_desc_ko: 당신은 보호 대상에게 마법적 후원자 역할을 할 수 있습니다. 일일 준비를 마친 후, 당신의 패밀리어가 아는 주문 하나와 보호 대상 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 다음 일일 준비 전까지 한 번, 해당 생물은 그 주문을 선천적 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 주문은 당신이 시전할 수 있는 최고 랭크 주문 랭크에서 2를 뺀 랭크을 초과할 수 없습니다.

name: Nonlethal Takedown

description.value: You prefer to use nonlethal means against living opponents, but the weapons you carry are lethal enough to destroy undead. You don't take the normal -2 circumstance penalty when attacking nonlethally with a weapon that lacks the nonlethal trait.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en: You prefer to use nonlethal means against living opponents, but the weapons you carry are lethal enough to destroy undead. You don't take the normal -2 circumstance penalty when attacking nonlethally with a weapon that lacks the nonlethal trait.
_desc_ko: 살아있는 상대에게는 비살상 수단을 선호하지만, 소지한 무기는 언데드를 파괴할 만큼 치명적입니다. 비살상 특성이 없는 무기로 비살상 공격할 때 일반적인 -2 상황 페널티를 받지 않습니다.

name: Reflect Spell

description.value: When you successfully use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.EpBG4CFMNSZQx7vI]{Counterspell} to counteract a spell that affects targeted creatures or an area, you can turn that spell's effect back on its caster. When reflected, the spell affects only the original caster, even if it's an area spell or it would normally affect more than one creature. The original caster can attempt a save and use other defenses against the reflected spell as normal.

_desc_en: When you successfully use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.EpBG4CFMNSZQx7vI]{Counterspell} to counteract a spell that affects targeted creatures or an area, you can turn that spell's effect back on its caster. When reflected, the spell affects only the original caster, even if it's an area spell or it would normally affect more than one creature. The original caster can attempt a save and use other defenses against the reflected spell as normal.
_desc_ko: {카운터스펠}을 성공적으로 사용해 대상 생물이나 영역에 영향을 미치는 주문을 반격할 때, 해당 주문의 효과를 시전자에게 되돌릴 수 있다. 반사된 주문은 영역 주문이거나 원래 하나 이상의 생물에게 영향을 미쳤더라도 오직 원래 시전자에게만 영향을 미칩니다. 원래 시전자는 반사된 주문에 대해 평소처럼 내성을 시도하거나 다른 방어 수단을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Marked for Rebuke

description.value: You declare that an enemy is fit for further punishment in the sight of your deity. If the next action you perform is to Cast a Spell that deals damage, one creature of your choice that takes damage from the spell is marked for rebuke until the end of your next turn. A creature marked this way gains weakness 10 to all damage and becomes immune to Marked for Rebuke for 24 hours.

_desc_en: You declare that an enemy is fit for further punishment in the sight of your deity. If the next action you perform is to Cast a Spell that deals damage, one creature of your choice that takes damage from the spell is marked for rebuke until the end of your next turn. A creature marked this way gains weakness 10 to all damage and becomes immune to Marked for Rebuke for 24 hours.
_desc_ko: 당신은 적 하나가 당신의 신의 시선에서 추가 처벌을 받을 만하다고 선언합니다. 당신이 다음에 수행하는 행동이 피해를 주는 주문을 시전하는 것이라면, 당신이 선택한 의 생물 하나가 그 주문으로부터 피해를 입으면, 당신의 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 그 생물은 질책의 표식이 붙습니다. 이렇게 표식이 붙은 생물은 모든 피해에 대해 약화 10을 얻으며, 24시간 동안 '책망의 표식'에 면역이 된다.

name: Ageless Patience

description.value:
You work at a pace born from longevity that enhances your thoroughness. You can voluntarily spend twice as much time as normal on a Perception check or skill check that takes 1 action or longer. If you do, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the check and don't automatically reduce your degree of success on a natural 1 (you get a critical failure only if your result is 10 lower than the DC). For example, you could get these benefits if you spent 2 actions to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek}, which normally takes 1 action. You can get these benefits during exploration by taking twice as long exploring as normal, or in downtime by spending twice as much downtime.

The GM might determine a situation doesn't grant you a benefit if a delay would be directly counterproductive to your success, such as a tense negotiation with an impatient creature.

_desc_en:
You work at a pace born from longevity that enhances your thoroughness. You can voluntarily spend twice as much time as normal on a Perception check or skill check that takes 1 action or longer. If you do, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the check and don't automatically reduce your degree of success on a natural 1 (you get a critical failure only if your result is 10 lower than the DC). For example, you could get these benefits if you spent 2 actions to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek}, which normally takes 1 action. You can get these benefits during exploration by taking twice as long exploring as normal, or in downtime by spending twice as much downtime.

The GM might determine a situation doesn't grant you a benefit if a delay would be directly counterproductive to your success, such as a tense negotiation with an impatient creature.
_desc_ko:
당신은 장수에서 비롯된 속도로 작업하여 철저함을 높입니다. 1 행동 이상 소요되는 지각 판정나 기술 판정 시, 자발적으로 정상 시간의 두 배를 소모할 수 있습니다. 그렇게 할 경우, 해당 판정에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며 주사위 1로 성공 정도가 자동 감소하지 않습니다(결과가 DC보다 10 낮을 때만 대실패가 발생). 예를 들어, 일반적으로 1 행동이 소요되는 @link[actions.seek]에 2 행동을 소모하면 이러한 혜택을 얻을 수 있습니다. 탐사 중에는 평소보다 두 배의 시간을 들여 탐사하거나, 다운타임에는 두 배의 다운타임을 소비함으로써 이러한 혜택을 얻을 수 있습니다.

GM은 지연이 성공에 직접적으로 역효과를 낼 수 있는 상황(예: 성급한 생물과의 긴박한 협상)에서는 이점을 부여하지 않을 수 있습니다.

name: Finessed Features

description.value: You've learned how to build snares that trigger based on visual stimuli. When you construct a snare using gears, you can cause it to trigger based on the visual features of a creature. For example, you could lay a snare that can only be triggered by a Large or Larger creatures, or one that only activates when a creature wearing red clothing would trigger it. You can use this ability to specify your snares to trigger on creatures that typically do not trigger snares, such as creatures smaller than Small, though the creature must still otherwise satisfy the snare's trigger as normal.

_desc_en: You've learned how to build snares that trigger based on visual stimuli. When you construct a snare using gears, you can cause it to trigger based on the visual features of a creature. For example, you could lay a snare that can only be triggered by a Large or Larger creatures, or one that only activates when a creature wearing red clothing would trigger it. You can use this ability to specify your snares to trigger on creatures that typically do not trigger snares, such as creatures smaller than Small, though the creature must still otherwise satisfy the snare's trigger as normal.
_desc_ko: 시각적 자극에 반응하는 덫을 제작하는 법을 익혔습니다. 기어를 사용해 덫을 만들 때, 생물의 시각적 특징에 따라 작동하도록 설정할 수 있습니다. 예를 들어, 대형 이상 크기의 생물만이 발동시킬 수 있는 함정을 설치하거나, 빨간색 옷을 입은 생물만이 발동시키는 함정을 만들 수 있습니다. 이 능력을 활용하면 소형보다 작은 생물처럼 일반적으로 함정을 발동시키지 않는 생물에게도 함정이 작동하도록 지정할 수 있습니다. 단, 해당 생물은 여전히 함정의 발동 조건을 정상적으로 충족해야 합니다.

name: Winglet Flight

description.value:
Frequency once per round

Intense use and exercise have made your winglets more powerful. You Fly. If you don't normally have a fly Speed, you gain a fly Speed of 20 feet for this movement. If you aren't on solid ground at the end of this movement, you fall.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per round

Intense use and exercise have made your winglets more powerful. You Fly. If you don't normally have a fly Speed, you gain a fly Speed of 20 feet for this movement. If you aren't on solid ground at the end of this movement, you fall.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 라운드당 1회

잦은 사용과 훈련으로 당신의 윙렛이 더욱 강력해졌습니다. 당신은 날아갑니다. 평소 비행 속도가 없다면, 이번 이동 동안 20피트의 비행 속도를 얻습니다. 이번 이동이 끝날 때 단단한 지면에 있지 않다면, 당신은 추락합니다.

name: Conrasu Lore

description.value: You have learned about your history and your people from shapers. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Crafting and Occultism. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also become trained in Conrasu Lore.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: You have learned about your history and your people from shapers. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Crafting and Occultism. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also become trained in Conrasu Lore.
_desc_ko:
당신은 창조자들로부터 자신의 역사와 민족에 대해 배웠습니다. 제작술과 오컬트에 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 해당 기술 중 하나에 자동으로 숙련될 경우, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다. 또한 콘라수 지식에 숙련됩니다.

참고: 이 피트로 부여되는 기술에 이미 숙련된 경우, 대체 기술을 수동으로 선택해야 합니다. 부여되는 지식 기술도 수동으로 입력해야 합니다.

name: Borrow Memories

description.value:
Knowing how someone thinks makes it much easier to know where they'll be, or even replace them altogether. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9BnhadUO8FMLmeZ3]{Mind Probe} as an innate occult spell once per day, using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

If you cast mind probe on a target you're studying for the purpose of Assuming their Role, and the target fails their save, you can delay the spell from coming into effect until you Assume their Role. When you use the spell this way, you can Sustain it up to 10 times during its duration, asking a question each time. The spell lasts until you ask all 10 questions or are no longer Assuming the Role, whichever comes first. You don't need to Sustain the Spell to extend its duration-only when asking a question-nor do you need to be in range or have line of effect to Sustain it.

_desc_en:
Knowing how someone thinks makes it much easier to know where they'll be, or even replace them altogether. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9BnhadUO8FMLmeZ3]{Mind Probe} as an innate occult spell once per day, using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

If you cast mind probe on a target you're studying for the purpose of Assuming their Role, and the target fails their save, you can delay the spell from coming into effect until you Assume their Role. When you use the spell this way, you can Sustain it up to 10 times during its duration, asking a question each time. The spell lasts until you ask all 10 questions or are no longer Assuming the Role, whichever comes first. You don't need to Sustain the Spell to extend its duration-only when asking a question-nor do you need to be in range or have line of effect to Sustain it.
_desc_ko:
상대의 사고 방식을 알면 그 사람이 어디에 있을지 예측하거나 심지어 완전히 대체하는 것이 훨씬 쉬워집니다. 하루에 한 번, 본인의 직업 난이도(DC) 또는 주문 난이도(DC) 중 더 높은 값을 사용하여 선천적 오컬트 주문으로 @link[spells.mind-probe]를 시전할 수 있습니다.

역할을 대신하기 위해 연구 중인 대상에게 마인드 프로브를 시전하고 대상이 내성에 실패하면, 그 대상의 역할을 대신할 때까지 주문 발효를 지연시킬 수 있습니다. 이 방식으로 주문을 사용할 경우, 지속 시간 동안 최대 10 번까지 주문을 유지하며 매번 질문을 할 수 있습니다. 주문은 10개의 질문을 모두 하거나 역할 수행을 중단할 때까지 지속됩니다(둘 중 먼저 발생하는 경우). 질문을 할 때만 주문을 유지해야 하며, 지속 시간을 연장하기 위해 주문을 유지할 필요는 없습니다. 또한 주문을 유지하기 위해 범위 내에 있거나 효과 선상에 있을 필요도 없습니다.

name: Nimble Elf

description.value: Your muscles are tightly honed. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.

_desc_en: Your muscles are tightly honed. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.
_desc_ko: 근육이 단단히 다져져 있습니다. 이동 속도가 5피트 증가합니다.

name: Shadow of the Wilds

description.value: It's difficult to notice your passage through wild areas. As long as you're not in an urban environment, you're always considered to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SB7cMECVtE06kByk]{Covering Tracks}, even if you chose a different activity in exploration mode.

_desc_en: It's difficult to notice your passage through wild areas. As long as you're not in an urban environment, you're always considered to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SB7cMECVtE06kByk]{Covering Tracks}, even if you chose a different activity in exploration mode.
_desc_ko: 야생 지역을 통과하는 당신의 흔적을 알아채기 어렵습니다. 도시 환경에 있지 않은 한, 탐험 모드에서 다른 활동을 선택했더라도 항상 @link[actions.cover-tracks] 상태로 간주됩니다.

name: Liberated Mind

description.value:
Trigger You fail a saving throw against a mental effect.

Your mind won't be held hostage by those who would seek to control you. You reroll the triggering save, taking the new result. If the effect would cause the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} or controlled condition, you gain a +2 status bonus to the reroll.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.Q7d6TRuuVAuSabSW]{Effect: Liberated Mind}

_desc_en:
Trigger You fail a saving throw against a mental effect.

Your mind won't be held hostage by those who would seek to control you. You reroll the triggering save, taking the new result. If the effect would cause the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} or controlled condition, you gain a +2 status bonus to the reroll.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.Q7d6TRuuVAuSabSW]{Effect: Liberated Mind}
_desc_ko:
발동 정신 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 실패한다.

당신의 정신은 당신을 지배하려는 자들에게 인질로 잡히지 않는다. 당신은 발동된 내성을 재굴림하고 새로운 결과를 취한다. 효과가 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{혼란} 또는 지배됨 상태를 유발한다면, 재굴림에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻는다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.Q7d6TRuuVAuSabSW]{효과: 해방된 정신}

name: Advanced Weaponry

description.value:
Your eidolon's attack evolves.

Choose one of your eidolon's starting melee unarmed attacks. It gains one of the following traits, chosen when you gain the feat: disarm, grapple, nonlethal, shove, trip, or versatile bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing.

_desc_en:
Your eidolon's attack evolves.

Choose one of your eidolon's starting melee unarmed attacks. It gains one of the following traits, chosen when you gain the feat: disarm, grapple, nonlethal, shove, trip, or versatile bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing.
_desc_ko:
당신의 에이돌론의 공격이 진화합니다.

에이돌론의 시작 근접 비무장 공격 중 하나를 선택합니다. 이 공격은 피트를 획득할 때 선택한 다음 특성 중 하나를 얻습니다: 무장 해제, 그랩, 비살상, 밀치기, 넘어뜨리기, 또는 다용도 타격, 관통, 베기.

name: Gecko's Grip

description.value:
You cling to walls with a preternatural grip. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.09PurtIanNUPfNRq]{Combat Climber} feat as a bonus feat, and if you roll a success on an Athletics check to climb, you get a critical success instead.

Special If you have the cliffscale lizardfolk heritage, you instead gain a climb Speed of 15 feet.

_desc_en:
You cling to walls with a preternatural grip. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.09PurtIanNUPfNRq]{Combat Climber} feat as a bonus feat, and if you roll a success on an Athletics check to climb, you get a critical success instead.

Special If you have the cliffscale lizardfolk heritage, you instead gain a climb Speed of 15 feet.
_desc_ko:
당신은 초자연적인 그립으로 벽에 매달립니다. @link[feats.combat-climber] 피트를 보너스 피트로 얻으며, 등반을 위한 운동 판정에서 성공을 굴리면 대신 대성공을 얻는다.

특수 절벽리자드포크 혈통을 가진 경우, 대신 등반 속도가 15피트가 됩니다.

name: Spiritual Echo

description.value:
You possess the head gem of a deceased ancestor or loved one, which has begun to resonate with your own. While you possess this gem, you gain the ability to Cast a Spell as a 4th-rank occult innate spell once per day. The type of spell is determined by the clan of the sarangay to whom the head gem belonged, which you choose when you take this feat. In addition, choose a Lore skill to represent knowledge the deceased had. You become trained in that Lore skill. If the gem is lost or destroyed, it can be regrown as if it were your own head gem.

  • Full Moon @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.3ehSrqTAm7IPqbIZ]{Spirit Sense}
  • Half Moon @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HTou8cG05yuSkesj]{Status}
  • New Moon @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4GE2ZdODgIQtg51c]{Darkness}
  • Waning Moon @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TUj8eugNqAvB1vVR]{Creation}
  • Waxing Moon @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TaaMEYdZXQXF0Sks]{Blood Vendetta}

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You possess the head gem of a deceased ancestor or loved one, which has begun to resonate with your own. While you possess this gem, you gain the ability to Cast a Spell as a 4th-rank occult innate spell once per day. The type of spell is determined by the clan of the sarangay to whom the head gem belonged, which you choose when you take this feat. In addition, choose a Lore skill to represent knowledge the deceased had. You become trained in that Lore skill. If the gem is lost or destroyed, it can be regrown as if it were your own head gem.

  • Full Moon @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.3ehSrqTAm7IPqbIZ]{Spirit Sense}
  • Half Moon @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HTou8cG05yuSkesj]{Status}
  • New Moon @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4GE2ZdODgIQtg51c]{Darkness}
  • Waning Moon @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TUj8eugNqAvB1vVR]{Creation}
  • Waxing Moon @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TaaMEYdZXQXF0Sks]{Blood Vendetta}
_desc_ko:
당신은 죽은 조상이나 사랑하는 이의 머리 보석을 소유하고 있으며, 이 보석이 당신의 보석과 공명하기 시작했습니다. 이 보석을 소유하는 동안, 하루에 한 번 4랭크 오컬트 선천적 주문으로 주문을 시전할 수 있는 능력을 얻습니다. 주문의 종류는 이 피트를 선택할 때 결정하는, 머리 보석의 소유주였던 사랑가이의 사신 종족에 따라 결정됩니다. 또한, 고인이 가졌던 지식을 나타내는 지식 기술을 하나 선택하십시오. 해당 지식 기술에 숙련됩니다. 보석을 분실하거나 파괴된 경우, 자신의 머리 보석처럼 다시 자라나게 할 수 있습니다.

  • 보름달 @link[spells.spirit-sense]
  • 반달 @link[spells.status]
  • 초승달 @link[spells.darkness]
  • 지나가는 달 @link[spells.creation]
  • 초승달 @link[spells.blood-vendetta]

name: Transcendent Realization

description.value: You've unleashed even more of your mind's limitless potential. Choose a 3rd-rank occult spell, either a common spell or another to which you have access, including a lower-rank spell heightened to 3rd level if you wish. You can cast that spell once per day as an innate occult spell.

_desc_en: You've unleashed even more of your mind's limitless potential. Choose a 3rd-rank occult spell, either a common spell or another to which you have access, including a lower-rank spell heightened to 3rd level if you wish. You can cast that spell once per day as an innate occult spell.
_desc_ko: 당신은 마음의 무한한 잠재력을 더욱 해방시켰습니다. 3랭크 오컬트 주문을 선택하세요. 일반 주문이거나, 접근 가능한 다른 주문(원한다면 하위 랭크 주문을 3랭크으로 강화한 것도 포함)이어야 합니다. 이 주문을 하루에 한 번 선천적 오컬트 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Kreighton's Cognitive Crossover

description.value:
Trigger You gain no information from a Recall Knowledge check (usually because you failed the secret check) using one of the two skills you chose for this feat.

Kreighton teaches his students that an agile mind can glean clues leading to the truth, even from the most unlikely of sources. You immediately reattempt the triggering check using the other chosen skill.

Special When you gain this feat, choose two of the following skills: Arcana, Crafting, Lore (any one), Medicine, Nature, Occultism, Religion, or Society.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en:
Trigger You gain no information from a Recall Knowledge check (usually because you failed the secret check) using one of the two skills you chose for this feat.

Kreighton teaches his students that an agile mind can glean clues leading to the truth, even from the most unlikely of sources. You immediately reattempt the triggering check using the other chosen skill.

Special When you gain this feat, choose two of the following skills: Arcana, Crafting, Lore (any one), Medicine, Nature, Occultism, Religion, or Society.
_desc_ko:
발동 이 피트를 위해 선택한 두 기술 중 하나로 수행한 지식 회상 판정(보통 비밀 판정 실패로 인해)에서 정보를 얻지 못한다.

크레이튼은 제자들에게 기민한 정신이라면 가장 예상치 못한 출처에서도 진실로 이끄는 단서를 포착할 수 있다고 가르칩니다. 당신은 즉시 다른 선택한 기술로 트리거링 판정을 재시도합니다.

특수 이 피트를 획득할 때, 다음 기술 중 두 가지를 선택하십시오: 주문학, 제작, 지식(어느 하나), 의학, 자연학, 오컬트, 종교학, 사회.

name: Avenger of Wrath

description.value: You've become a champion of the runelords of wrath. You gain the Reactive Strike reaction. The first time each day you score a critical hit with a Reactive Strike, you gain 1 Mythic Point. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.a1FVA0l58GOEq6xP]{Host of Wrath} activity.

_desc_en: You've become a champion of the runelords of wrath. You gain the Reactive Strike reaction. The first time each day you score a critical hit with a Reactive Strike, you gain 1 Mythic Point. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.a1FVA0l58GOEq6xP]{Host of Wrath} activity.
_desc_ko: 당신은 분노의 룬로드의 대전사가 되었다. 당신은 반응 타격 반응을 얻는다. 하루 중 처음으로 반응 타격으로 치명타를 기록할 때, 당신은 신화 점수 1점을 얻는다. 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.a1FVA0l58GOEq6xP]{분노의 군세} 활동을 얻는다.

name: To Thine Own Self

description.value:
Trigger You fail a saving throw against an effect that would alter your memory or cause you to become controlled by another creature.

Awareness of your past perils protects you from those who would manipulate your thoughts. Attempt to counteract the triggering effect using your Incarnation Lore modifier as your counteract modifier and half your level as your counteract rank.

publication.title: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

_desc_en:
Trigger You fail a saving throw against an effect that would alter your memory or cause you to become controlled by another creature.

Awareness of your past perils protects you from those who would manipulate your thoughts. Attempt to counteract the triggering effect using your Incarnation Lore modifier as your counteract modifier and half your level as your counteract rank.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신의 기억을 변경하거나 다른 생물에게 지배당하게 만드는 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 실패한다.

과거의 위험에 대한 자각이 당신의 생각을 조작하려는 자들로부터 당신을 보호한다. 당신의 화신 지식 수정치를 상쇄 수정치로, 레벨의 절반을 상쇄 랭크로 사용하여 발동된 효과의 상쇄를 시도하라.

name: Nocturnal Charm

description.value: The supernatural charm of your vampiric progenitor hangs about you, and you've learned to use it on mortals. Against humanoids (or other creatures of your type, if you're not a humanoid), you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie}, and to Diplomacy checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}.

_desc_en: The supernatural charm of your vampiric progenitor hangs about you, and you've learned to use it on mortals. Against humanoids (or other creatures of your type, if you're not a humanoid), you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie}, and to Diplomacy checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}.
_desc_ko: 당신의 뱀파이어 선조의 초자연적 매력이 당신 주변에 감돌며, 당신은 이를 인간에게 사용하는 법을 익혔습니다. 인간형 생물(혹은 인간형이 아닌 경우, 자신과 같은 유형의 다른 생물)을 상대로 할 때, @link[actions.lie]에 대한 기만 능력 판정, 그리고 @link[actions.gather-information] 및 @link[actions.make-an-impression]에 대한 외교 능력 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Spellshape Mastery

description.value: Altering your spells doesn't take any longer than casting them normally. You can use spellshape single actions as free actions.

_desc_en: Altering your spells doesn't take any longer than casting them normally. You can use spellshape single actions as free actions.
_desc_ko: 주문을 변형하는 데는 정상적으로 시전하는 것보다 더 오래 걸리지 않습니다. 주문형성 액션 하나를 자유 행동으로 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Blessed Denial

description.value:
Trigger An ally within 30 feet would become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied}.

You exude peace and protection, lessening a harmful condition as it falls upon an ally. Reduce the value of the condition your ally would take by 1 (to a minimum of 0). If the ally takes more than one condition at the same time, choose one to reduce.

_desc_en:
Trigger An ally within 30 feet would become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied}.

You exude peace and protection, lessening a harmful condition as it falls upon an ally. Reduce the value of the condition your ally would take by 1 (to a minimum of 0). If the ally takes more than one condition at the same time, choose one to reduce.
_desc_ko:
발동 30피트 내 아군이 @link[conditions.frightened], @link[conditions.drained], @link[conditions.enfeebled], @link[conditions.sickened], 또는 @link[conditions.stupefied] 상태가 된다.

당신은 평화와 보호를 발산하여 아군에게 해로운 상태가 걸릴 때 그 효과를 약화시킵니다. 아군이 받을 상태의 수치를 1 감소시킵니다(최소 0). 아군이 동시에 여러 상태를 받는 경우, 하나를 선택하여 감소시킵니다.

name: Unyielding Force

description.value: Thanks to your armor, almost nothing can stop you. While you are wearing medium or heavy armor, the resistance you receive from guardian's armor increases to 6 + half your level.

_desc_en: Thanks to your armor, almost nothing can stop you. While you are wearing medium or heavy armor, the resistance you receive from guardian's armor increases to 6 + half your level.
_desc_ko: 갑옷 덕분에 거의 아무것도 당신을 막을 수 없습니다. 평갑이나 중갑을 착용 중일 때, 가디언의 갑옷이 제공하는 저항력이 6 + 레벨의 절반으로 증가합니다.

name: Eternal Blessing

description.value: Your deeds have brought your deity's grace to you for all of eternity. You're continuously surrounded by a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless} spell, with a spell rank equal to half your level (rounded up). The radius is 15 feet, and you can't increase it. You can Dismiss the spell; if you do, it returns automatically after 1 minute.

_desc_en: Your deeds have brought your deity's grace to you for all of eternity. You're continuously surrounded by a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless} spell, with a spell rank equal to half your level (rounded up). The radius is 15 feet, and you can't increase it. You can Dismiss the spell; if you do, it returns automatically after 1 minute.
_desc_ko: 당신의 업적은 영원토록 신의 은총을 당신에게 가져다주었습니다. 당신은 지속적으로 @link[spells.bless] 마법에 지속적으로 둘러싸여 있습니다. 이 마법의 등급은 당신의 레벨 절반(올림)과 같습니다. 반경은 15피트이며, 이를 늘릴 수 없습니다. 이 마법을 해제할 수 있습니다. 해제하면 1분 후 자동으로 복귀합니다.

name: Crushing Step

description.value: The weight of your armored feet casts aside natural impediments. When wearing medium or heavy armor, you ignore difficult terrain from non-magical sources. If you are a master in the armor you are wearing, you also ignore greater difficult terrain from non-magical sources.

_desc_en: The weight of your armored feet casts aside natural impediments. When wearing medium or heavy armor, you ignore difficult terrain from non-magical sources. If you are a master in the armor you are wearing, you also ignore greater difficult terrain from non-magical sources.
_desc_ko: 갑옷으로 무장한 발의 무게가 자연적 장애물을 제쳐버린다. 평갑 또는 중갑옷을 착용할 때, 비마법적 원인으로 인한 어려운 지형을 무시한다. 착용 중인 갑옷의 마스터라면, 비마법적 원인으로 인한 매우 어려운 지형도 무시한다.

name: Icy Apotheosis

description.value: You are as much a creature of cold as whatever ancestry you were born to. You are immune to cold damage and gain the cold trait. You automatically succeed on saving throws against effects that have the cold trait.

_desc_en: You are as much a creature of cold as whatever ancestry you were born to. You are immune to cold damage and gain the cold trait. You automatically succeed on saving throws against effects that have the cold trait.
_desc_ko: 당신은 태어난 혈통만큼이나 추위의 존재입니다. 추위 피해에 면역이며 추위 특성을 얻습니다. 추위 특성을 가진 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 자동으로 성공합니다.

name: Angel of Vindication

description.value:
Requirements Your mark is an undead creature.

To aid with your mission of destroying undead, you've specialized in techniques to destroy them, much as other assassins learn to kill the living. When you Strike an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} undead foe with a weapon that has the backstabber weapon trait, you deal 3 extra precision damage instead of 1. If the weapon is a +3 weapon, you deal 6 extra precision damage instead of 2. If you have the Angel of Death feat, your attacks also instantly destroy undead at 0 Hit Points, and attempts for the undead to rejuvenate-such as via a lich's soul cage or a ghost's rejuvenation ability-fail unless the effect's counteract rank is higher than half your level when you killed the creature (rounded up), or originates from an artifact or deity. Finally, if you have the Assassinate feat and an undead mark critically fails its save against your Assassinate, it is destroyed.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en:
Requirements Your mark is an undead creature.

To aid with your mission of destroying undead, you've specialized in techniques to destroy them, much as other assassins learn to kill the living. When you Strike an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} undead foe with a weapon that has the backstabber weapon trait, you deal 3 extra precision damage instead of 1. If the weapon is a +3 weapon, you deal 6 extra precision damage instead of 2. If you have the Angel of Death feat, your attacks also instantly destroy undead at 0 Hit Points, and attempts for the undead to rejuvenate-such as via a lich's soul cage or a ghost's rejuvenation ability-fail unless the effect's counteract rank is higher than half your level when you killed the creature (rounded up), or originates from an artifact or deity. Finally, if you have the Assassinate feat and an undead mark critically fails its save against your Assassinate, it is destroyed.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 표적이 언데드 생물이어야 한다.

언데드를 파괴하는 임무를 수행하기 위해, 다른 암살자들이 살아있는 자를 죽이는 법을 배우듯, 당신은 그들을 파괴하는 기술에 특화되었습니다. @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태의 언데드 적을 백스태버 무기 특성을 가진 무기로 공격할 때, 정밀 피해가 1이 아닌 3 추가로 발생합니다. 해당 무기가 +3 무기일 경우, 정밀 피해가 2가 아닌 6 추가로 발생합니다. '죽음의 천사' 피트를 보유한 경우, 공격 시 0 HP 상태의 언데드는 즉시 파괴되며, 언데드가 재생하는 시도(리치의 영혼 감옥이나 유령의 재생 능력 등)는 해당 효과가 당신의 레벨 절반(올림)보다 높지 않거나 유물/신성 출처가 아닌 한 실패한다. 마지막으로, 네가 암살의 표적 피트와 암살 피트를 보유하고 있고, 네 암살에 대한 언데드의 내성이 대실패하면, 그 언데드는 파괴된다.

name: Cursed Effigy

description.value:
Requirements Your last action was a successful Strike against the target of your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.fodJ3zuwQsYnBbtk]{Exploit Vulnerability}, and the Strike dealt physical damage.

After your attack, you grab a bit of blood, cut hair, or other piece of the creature's body. You incorporate the material into a premade doll, paper figure, or other effigy to create a sympathetic link that makes it harder to resist your abilities. As long as you are Exploiting Vulnerability against that creature, it takes a –2 status penalty to its saving throws against thaumaturge abilities or items that use your thaumaturge class DC.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your last action was a successful Strike against the target of your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.fodJ3zuwQsYnBbtk]{Exploit Vulnerability}, and the Strike dealt physical damage.

After your attack, you grab a bit of blood, cut hair, or other piece of the creature's body. You incorporate the material into a premade doll, paper figure, or other effigy to create a sympathetic link that makes it harder to resist your abilities. As long as you are Exploiting Vulnerability against that creature, it takes a –2 status penalty to its saving throws against thaumaturge abilities or items that use your thaumaturge class DC.
_desc_ko:
Requirements 당신의 마지막 행동은 @link[actions.exploit-vulnerability]의 대상에 대한 성공적인 공격이었으며, 이 공격은 물리적 피해를 입혔습니다.

공격 후, 당신은 그 생물의 피 한 방울을 붙잡거나, 잘린 머리카락을 잘라내거나, 또는 다른 신체 일부를 떼어냅니다. 이 물질을 미리 만들어 둔 인형, 종이 인형 또는 다른 형상에 접목하여 공감적 연결을 형성합니다. 이 연결은 상대가 당신의 능력에 저항하기 어렵게 만듭니다. 당신이 해당 생물에게 약점 악용을 계속하는 동안, 그 생물은 당신의 쏘마터지 능력이나 쏘마터지 클래스 DC를 사용하는 아이템에 대한 내성 굴림에서 -2 상태 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Master Summoning Spellcasting

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.TwSQ0VPXZL0mfPez#master-bounded-spellcasting-feat]{Master Bounded Spellcasting Feat} benefits.

value.value: legendary in the skill associated with your eidolon's tradition

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.TwSQ0VPXZL0mfPez#master-bounded-spellcasting-feat]{Master Bounded Spellcasting Feat} benefits.
_desc_ko: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.TwSQ0VPXZL0mfPez#master-bounded-spellcasting-feat]{마스터 바운드 주문 시전 피트}의 혜택을 얻습니다.

name: Constant Gaze

description.value: Your eyes keep a continual watch for dangers from all sides. You can't be flanked by creatures of your level or lower, even when you haven't used Watchful Gaze.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: Your eyes keep a continual watch for dangers from all sides. You can't be flanked by creatures of your level or lower, even when you haven't used Watchful Gaze.
_desc_ko: 당신의 눈은 사방의 위험을 끊임없이 감시합니다. 경계 시선을 사용하지 않았더라도, 당신과 동급 이하의 생물에게 측면 공격을 당할 수 없습니다.

name: Mirror Shield

description.value:
Trigger An opponent casting a spell that targets you critically fails a spell attack roll against your AC.

Requirements You have a shield raised.

You reflect the spell back against its caster. Make a ranged attack against the attacker using your highest proficiency with a ranged weapon. If you can cast spells, you can choose to make a spell attack roll instead. If you succeed, your opponent takes the effects of a successful spell attack roll for their own spell (or the effects of a critical success if your attack roll was a critical success).

_desc_en:
Trigger An opponent casting a spell that targets you critically fails a spell attack roll against your AC.

Requirements You have a shield raised.

You reflect the spell back against its caster. Make a ranged attack against the attacker using your highest proficiency with a ranged weapon. If you can cast spells, you can choose to make a spell attack roll instead. If you succeed, your opponent takes the effects of a successful spell attack roll for their own spell (or the effects of a critical success if your attack roll was a critical success).
_desc_ko:
발동 당신을 대상으로 하는 주문을 시전하는 상대방은 당신의 AC에 대한 주문 명중 굴림에서 대실패를 합니다.

요구 사항 방패를 들고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 그 주문을 시전자에게 되돌려 반사합니다. 원거리 무기 숙련도 중 가장 높은 것을 사용하여 공격자에게 원거리 공격을 가하십시오. 주문을 시전할 수 있다면, 대신 주문 공격 롤을 선택할 수 있습니다. 성공하면, 상대방은 자신의 주문에 대해 성공한 주문 공격 롤의 효과를 받습니다(또는 당신의 공격 롤이 대성공이었다면 대성공의 효과를 받습니다).

name: Offensive Odor

description.value: You've mastered your defensive pheromones and have nearly complete control over them. When you Emit Defensive Odor, you can either choose to increase the damage dealt to a single target by changing the damage dice to d8s (@Damage[(floor((@actor.level +1)/2)+1)d8[poison]|options:area-damage]), or leave the damage unchanged but spray your pheromones in a @Template[cone|distance:15].

_desc_en: You've mastered your defensive pheromones and have nearly complete control over them. When you Emit Defensive Odor, you can either choose to increase the damage dealt to a single target by changing the damage dice to d8s (@Damage[(floor((@actor.level +1)/2)+1)d8[poison]|options:area-damage]), or leave the damage unchanged but spray your pheromones in a @Template[cone|distance:15].
_desc_ko: 당신은 방어 페로몬을 마스터하여 거의 완벽하게 통제할 수 있게 되었습니다. 방어 냄새를 발산할 때, 단일 대상에 가하는 피해를 d8 주사위로 변경하여 증가시킬 수 있습니다(독), 또는 피해를 변경하지 않고 페로몬을 15피트 방향으로 분사할 수 있습니다.

name: Work Yourself Up

description.value:
Requirements You have a reaction available and aren't prevented from using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2424g94rpoiN1IPh]{Catharsis}.

You concentrate on your mental state, tapping into that raw emotional energy. Take your Catharsis reaction, causing the catharsis activation and entering your emotional fervor as normal. The fervor lasts only until the end of your turn. At the end of your emotional fervor, you experience the effects of your emotional fallout, as normal.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have a reaction available and aren't prevented from using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2424g94rpoiN1IPh]{Catharsis}.

You concentrate on your mental state, tapping into that raw emotional energy. Take your Catharsis reaction, causing the catharsis activation and entering your emotional fervor as normal. The fervor lasts only until the end of your turn. At the end of your emotional fervor, you experience the effects of your emotional fallout, as normal.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 반응을 사용할 수 있고 @link[actions.catharsis] 사용이 금지되지 않아야 합니다.

당신은 정신 상태에 집중하며 그 원초적인 감정 에너지를 끌어모읍니다. 카타르시스 반응을 사용해 카타르시스 활성화를 유발하고 평소처럼 감정적 열정에 진입합니다. 이 열정은 당신의 턴이 끝날 때까지만 지속됩니다. 감정적 열정이 끝날 때, 당신은 평소처럼 감정적 후유증의 효과를 경험합니다.

name: Blazing Spirit

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger A creature damages you with a melee attack.

Requirements Your attuned apparition grants Battlegrounds Lore or Volcano Lore as an apparition skill.

Your apparition grants fiery defenses. You gain resistance equal to your level against the triggering damage, and the triggering creature takes @Damage[(ternary(gte(@actor.level,18),3,ternary(gte(@actor.level,12),2,1)))d6[fire],(ternary(gte(@actor.level,18),3,ternary(gte(@actor.level,12),2,1)))[persistent,fire]] damage. This damage increases to 2d6 fire damage and 2 persistent fire damage at 12th level, and 3d6 fire damage and 3 persistent fire damage at 18th level.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger A creature damages you with a melee attack.

Requirements Your attuned apparition grants Battlegrounds Lore or Volcano Lore as an apparition skill.

Your apparition grants fiery defenses. You gain resistance equal to your level against the triggering damage, and the triggering creature takes @Damage[(ternary(gte(@actor.level,18),3,ternary(gte(@actor.level,12),2,1)))d6[fire],(ternary(gte(@actor.level,18),3,ternary(gte(@actor.level,12),2,1)))[persistent,fire]] damage. This damage increases to 2d6 fire damage and 2 persistent fire damage at 12th level, and 3d6 fire damage and 3 persistent fire damage at 18th level.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 10분에 한 번

발동 조건 생물이 근접 공격으로 당신에게 피해를 입힐 때.

요구 사항 당신의 조율된 유령은 유령 기술로 전장 지식 또는 화산 지식를 부여합니다.

당신의 유령은 불의 방어력을 부여합니다. 발동 피해에 대해 자신의 레벨과 동일한 저항력을 얻으며, 발동한 생물은 화염 지속 불 피해를 입습니다. 이 피해는 12레벨에 2d6 화염 피해와 2 지속 화염 피해로, 18레벨에 3d6 화염 피해와 3 지속 화염 피해로 증가합니다.

name: Spell Network

description.value:
Trigger You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XIgvCPaSy5WXStVD]{Spellsurge}.

Your aura links your friends together with mystic strands. While you're in this stance, an ally within your spellsurge aura can treat any other ally within the aura as the point of origin for a spell they cast, calculating range and cover from the other creature's space instead of their own. This allows all allied creatures within your spellsurge aura to act as though they're in touch range of each other since each creature is in touch range of itself. Additionally, while you're in this stance, an ally casting a spell that targets only the caster can have that spell affect any other ally within your spellsurge aura instead.

_desc_en:
Trigger You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XIgvCPaSy5WXStVD]{Spellsurge}.

Your aura links your friends together with mystic strands. While you're in this stance, an ally within your spellsurge aura can treat any other ally within the aura as the point of origin for a spell they cast, calculating range and cover from the other creature's space instead of their own. This allows all allied creatures within your spellsurge aura to act as though they're in touch range of each other since each creature is in touch range of itself. Additionally, while you're in this stance, an ally casting a spell that targets only the caster can have that spell affect any other ally within your spellsurge aura instead.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신은 @link[spells.spellsurge]을 시전합니다.

당신의 오라가 신비로운 실로 동료들을 연결합니다. 이 자세를 취하는 동안, 당신의 주문파동 오라 안에 있는 아군은 오라 안에 있는 다른 아군을 자신이 시전하는 주문의 발원점으로 간주할 수 있습니다. 이 경우 범위와 가림은 자신의 공간이 아닌 해당 생물의 공간을 기준으로 계산됩니다. 이로 인해 주문파동 오라 내 모든 아군 생물은 각자가 자신과 접촉 범위 내에 있으므로 서로 접촉 범위 내에 있는 것처럼 행동할 수 있습니다. 또한, 이 자세를 취하고 있을 때, 시전자만을 대상으로 하는 주문을 시전하는 아군은 그 주문이 주문파동 오라 내의 다른 아군에게도 영향을 미치도록 할 수 있습니다.

name: Shore Step

description.value:
The shallows and tide pools have always called to you and let you pass unhindered. You ignore difficult terrain resulting from shallow water.

In addition, if you roll a success on an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} on a slippery or wet surface, or on an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c8TGiZ48ygoSPofx]{Swim}, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en:
The shallows and tide pools have always called to you and let you pass unhindered. You ignore difficult terrain resulting from shallow water.

In addition, if you roll a success on an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} on a slippery or wet surface, or on an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c8TGiZ48ygoSPofx]{Swim}, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko:
얕은 물과 조수 웅덩이는 항상 당신을 부르고 방해 없이 통과하게 합니다. 얕은 물로 인한 어려운 지형을 무시합니다.

또한 미끄러운 표면이나 젖은 바닥에서 @link[actions.balance]에 대한 곡예 판정에서 성공하거나, @link[actions.swim]에 대한 운동 판정에서 성공할 경우, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Twinned Defense (Swashbuckler)

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding two melee weapons, one in each hand

You're always ready to use your off-hand weapon to interfere with attacks against you. While you are in this stance, you constantly gain the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Y8LHfkzGyOhPlUou]{Twin Parry} action.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding two melee weapons, one in each hand

You're always ready to use your off-hand weapon to interfere with attacks against you. While you are in this stance, you constantly gain the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Y8LHfkzGyOhPlUou]{Twin Parry} action.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손에 각각 근접 무기 하나씩을 휘두르고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 항상 비주무기로 자신에게 가해지는 공격을 방해할 준비가 되어 있습니다. 이 자세를 취하는 동안, 당신은 지속적으로 @link[feats.twin-parry] 행동의 이점을 얻습니다.

name: Chosen Ward

description.value:
You have designated an ally to be you and your companion's ward, making it your primary directive to shield them from harm. During your daily preparations, choose an ally who isn't your united companion. While either you or your united companion are adjacent to your ward, you grant them a +1 circumstance bonus to their AC and Reflex saves.

When your ward attempts a Reflex saving throw while adjacent to either you or your united companion, you can spend a Mythic Point as a reaction to allow your ward to roll that Reflex save twice and take the better result. This is a fortune effect.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.VlBozDEaEaKE1A3O]{Effect: Chosen Ward}

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.JDF9LWZMReqiXIUi]{Defend Our Union} feat, it can also be triggered when a foe successfully Strikes your ward; if used in this way, the damage to your ward is reduced if your Strike is successful instead.

_desc_en:
You have designated an ally to be you and your companion's ward, making it your primary directive to shield them from harm. During your daily preparations, choose an ally who isn't your united companion. While either you or your united companion are adjacent to your ward, you grant them a +1 circumstance bonus to their AC and Reflex saves.

When your ward attempts a Reflex saving throw while adjacent to either you or your united companion, you can spend a Mythic Point as a reaction to allow your ward to roll that Reflex save twice and take the better result. This is a fortune effect.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.VlBozDEaEaKE1A3O]{Effect: Chosen Ward}

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.JDF9LWZMReqiXIUi]{Defend Our Union} feat, it can also be triggered when a foe successfully Strikes your ward; if used in this way, the damage to your ward is reduced if your Strike is successful instead.
_desc_ko:
당신은 동맹 한 명을 자신과 동반자의 수호부로 지정하여, 그들을 위험으로부터 보호하는 것을 최우선 지시로 삼았습니다. 일일 준비 시간 동안, 당신의 통합 동반자가 아닌 동맹 한 명을 선택하세요. 당신이나 당신의 통합 동반자가 수호부와 인접해 있는 동안, 당신은 그들에게 AC와 반사 내성에 +1 상황 보너스를 부여합니다.

수호부가 당신이나 당신의 결합된 동료와 인접한 상태에서 반사 내성 굴림을 시도할 때, 당신은 신화 포인트를 반응으로 소모하여 수호부가 해당 반사 내성 굴림을 두 번 굴리고 더 좋은 결과를 적용하도록 할 수 있습니다. 이는 행운 효과입니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.VlBozDEaEaKE1A3O]{Effect: Chosen Ward}

Special @link[feats.defend-our-union] 피트를 보유한 경우, 적이 당신의 수호부를 공격에 성공했을 때도 발동할 수 있습니다. 이 방식으로 사용될 경우, 대신 당신의 공격이 성공하면 수호부에 가해지는 피해가 감소합니다.

name: Ritualist Dedication

description.value:
You have begun to master the difficult art of casting rituals. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to all checks to perform a ritual. You learn two uncommon rituals of 2nd rank or lower. You must meet all prerequisites to be the primary caster of a ritual to select it, and you can't teach it to anyone else or allow someone else to serve as primary caster unless they know the ritual as well.

At 8th level and every 4 levels thereafter, you learn two more rituals with the same restrictions and with a maximum rank of half that level.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.Ph7yWRR376aYh12T]{Ritualist}

value.value: expert in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion

_desc_en:
You have begun to master the difficult art of casting rituals. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to all checks to perform a ritual. You learn two uncommon rituals of 2nd rank or lower. You must meet all prerequisites to be the primary caster of a ritual to select it, and you can't teach it to anyone else or allow someone else to serve as primary caster unless they know the ritual as well.

At 8th level and every 4 levels thereafter, you learn two more rituals with the same restrictions and with a maximum rank of half that level.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.Ph7yWRR376aYh12T]{Ritualist}
_desc_ko:
당신은 어려운 의식 시전 기술을 마스터하기 시작했습니다. 의식 수행에 필요한 모든 판정에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 2랭크 이하의 흔하지 않은 의식 두 가지를 배웁니다. 의식을 선택하려면 주 시전자가 되기 위한 모든 전제 조건을 충족해야 하며, 해당 의식을 알고 있지 않은 다른 사람에게 가르치거나 주 시전자로 허용할 수 없습니다.

8레벨과 이후 4레벨마다 동일한 제한 사항이 적용되며, 최대 랭크이 해당 레벨의 절반인 의식 두 가지를 추가로 습득합니다.

name: Basic Wilding

description.value: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level druid feat.

_desc_en: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level druid feat.
_desc_ko: 1레벨 또는 2레벨 드루이드 피트를 획득합니다.

name: Unrivaled Retort

description.value:
Trigger You are about to attempt a Fortitude or Reflex save against an area effect and are wielding a ranged weapon.

You defy the death and destruction around you while using it to fuel your mythic power, spurring you on to acts of incredible speed and empowering a mighty ranged counterattack. Spend a Mythic Point and attempt the triggering save at mythic proficiency. If the save is successful, you can immediately reload and make a ranged Strike targeting the originator of the triggering effect.

_desc_en:
Trigger You are about to attempt a Fortitude or Reflex save against an area effect and are wielding a ranged weapon.

You defy the death and destruction around you while using it to fuel your mythic power, spurring you on to acts of incredible speed and empowering a mighty ranged counterattack. Spend a Mythic Point and attempt the triggering save at mythic proficiency. If the save is successful, you can immediately reload and make a ranged Strike targeting the originator of the triggering effect.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 범위 효과에 대한 인내 내성 또는 반사 내성을 시도하다 원거리 무기를 휘두르고 있을 때.

주변의 죽음과 파괴를 거부하며 이를 신화적 힘의 원동력으로 삼아, 놀라운 속도의 행동을 촉발하고 강력한 원거리 반격을 가능케 합니다. 신화 포인트 1점을 소모하고 신화 숙련도로 유발 저항을 시도하세요. 저항에 성공하면 즉시 재장전하여 유발 효과의 발원지를 겨냥한 원거리 공격을 수행할 수 있습니다.

name: Eldritch Debilitations

description.value:
You know how to apply debilitations that are particularly troublesome for spellcasters. Add the following debilitations to the list you can choose from when you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.bp0Up04x3dzGK5bB]{Debilitating Strike}.

  • Debilitation The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}.
  • Debilitation The target can't Step.

_desc_en:
You know how to apply debilitations that are particularly troublesome for spellcasters. Add the following debilitations to the list you can choose from when you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.bp0Up04x3dzGK5bB]{Debilitating Strike}.

  • Debilitation The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}.
  • Debilitation The target can't Step.
_desc_ko:
당신은 마법사에게 특히 골치 아픈 약화 효과를 적용하는 방법을 알고 있습니다. @link[actions.debilitating-strike]를 사용할 때 선택할 수 있는 목록에 다음 약화 효과를 추가하십시오.

  • 쇠약 대상은 @link[conditions.stupefied]{1} 상태가 됩니다.
  • 쇠약 대상은 {신중한 발걸음}을 할 수 없습니다.

name: Master Siege Engineer

description.value: What you don't know about artillery isn't worth knowing and your mastery allows you to perform an impossible number of actions as part of a siege weapon's crew. You're permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}. You can only use the extra action to Aim or Launch a siege weapon.

_desc_en: What you don't know about artillery isn't worth knowing and your mastery allows you to perform an impossible number of actions as part of a siege weapon's crew. You're permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}. You can only use the extra action to Aim or Launch a siege weapon.
_desc_ko: 포병술에 관한 당신의 지식은 타의 추종을 불허하며, 그 숙련도로 공성 무기 승무원으로서 불가능할 정도로 많은 행동을 수행할 수 있습니다. 당신은 영구적으로 @link[conditions.quickened] 상태입니다. 추가 행동은 공성 무기의 조준 또는 발사에만 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Stumbling Feint

description.value:
Requirements You are in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7FRYyKXDKjGoANYj]{Stumbling Stance}.

You lash out confusingly with what seems to be a weak move but instead allows you to unleash a dangerous flurry of blows upon your unsuspecting foe.

When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.nbfNETdpee8CVM17]{Flurry of Blows}, you can attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} as a free action just before the first Strike.

On a success, instead of making the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against your next attack, they become off-guard against both attacks from the Flurry of Blows.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7FRYyKXDKjGoANYj]{Stumbling Stance}.

You lash out confusingly with what seems to be a weak move but instead allows you to unleash a dangerous flurry of blows upon your unsuspecting foe.

When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.nbfNETdpee8CVM17]{Flurry of Blows}, you can attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} as a free action just before the first Strike.

On a success, instead of making the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against your next attack, they become off-guard against both attacks from the Flurry of Blows.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 @link[feats.stumbling-stance] 상태여야 합니다.

겉보기엔 약해 보이는 공격으로 혼란스럽게 상대방을 공격하지만, 오히려 방심한 적에게 위험한 몰아치는 타격을 퍼붓는 기술이다.

@link[actions.flurry-of-blows]를 사용할 때, 첫 번째 공격 직전에 @link[actions.feint]에 대한 판정을 자유 행동으로 시도할 수 있다.

성공 시, 대상이 다음 공격에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 되는 대신, 몰아치는 타격의 두 공격 모두에 대해 무방비가 해제됩니다.

name: All in Your Head

description.value:
Trigger You're about to attempt a Fortitude save or a Reflex save.

Flames scouring at your body, venom coursing through your veins-you refuse to believe they exist, and nothing can affect you if you don't believe in it. You attempt a Will save against the triggering effect, instead of a Reflex or Fortitude save. You don't gain the benefits of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Hw6Ji7Fgx0XkVkac]{Fortress of Will} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Kf9lSN6pVS2Hy4KI]{Walls of Will} on this save.

_desc_en:
Trigger You're about to attempt a Fortitude save or a Reflex save.

Flames scouring at your body, venom coursing through your veins-you refuse to believe they exist, and nothing can affect you if you don't believe in it. You attempt a Will save against the triggering effect, instead of a Reflex or Fortitude save. You don't gain the benefits of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Hw6Ji7Fgx0XkVkac]{Fortress of Will} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Kf9lSN6pVS2Hy4KI]{Walls of Will} on this save.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신은 곧 인내 내성 굴림나 반사 내성 굴림을 시도하려 합니다.

몸을 핥는 불길, 혈관을 타고 흐르는 독-당신은 그것들의 존재를 믿지 않으며, 믿지 않는 한 그 어떤 것도 당신에게 영향을 미칠 수 없다. 당신은 반사력 저항이나 인내 내성 대신 유발 효과에 대한 의지 내성을 시도하다. 이 저항에 대해서는 @link[feats.fortress-of-will]나 @link[feats.walls-of-will]의 혜택을 받지 못한다.

name: Call Ursine Ally

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You can cast a 3rd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4YnON9JHYqtLzccu]{Summon Animal} as an innate spell, but only to summon a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary-2.Actor.xxP5FJotshmUQNtY]{Black Bear}. At 10th level, the summon animal spell is heightened to 4th level, and you can summon a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.6K4RWus85o8iqy0t]{Grizzly Bear}. name: Thousand Visions

description.value: You open your senses to numerous visions of the immediate future. The visions grant you subtle details of your immediate surroundings within 30 feet. Within this range, you don't need to succeed at a flat check to target a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} creature, you're not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to creatures that are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from you (unless you're off-guard to them for reasons other than the hidden condition), and you need only a successful @Check[flat|dc:5] to target a hidden creature. Beyond 30 feet, the visions become overwhelmed with too many possible futures, making all of your senses imprecise beyond this range. The visions persist for 1 minute.

_desc_ko: 당신은 감각을 열어 가까운 미래의 수많은 비전을 엿봅니다. 이 비전은 30피트 이내의 주변 환경에 대한 미묘한 세부 정보를 제공합니다. 이 범위 내에서 @link[conditions.concealed] 생물을 대상으로 할 때 단순 판정 성공이 필요하지 않으며, 해당 생물에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard]가 되지 않으며, 숨겨진 상태(숨겨진 조건 외의 이유로 상대에게 무방비인 경우는 제외), 숨겨진 생물을 대상으로 할 때는 DC 5 단순만 성공하면 된다. 30피트를 넘어서면, 너무 많은 가능한 미래들이 시야를 압도하여 이 범위 밖에서는 모든 감각이 부정확해진다. 이 시야는 1분 동안 지속된다.

name: Greater Mercy

Your faith enhances your ability to remove conditions. Add the following options to the list of conditions you can counteract for any type of mercy you can grant.

  • Mercy of the Body @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed}; if you're 16th level, add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned}

  • Mercy of Grace @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed}; if you're 12th level, add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified}; if you're 16th level, add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned}

  • Mercy of the Mind @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed}; if you're 16th level, add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned}.

  • Mercy of the Mind @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed}; if you're 16th level, add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned}.
_desc_ko:
당신의 신앙은 상태 이상을 제거하는 능력을 강화합니다. 부여할 수 있는 모든 유형의 자비에 대해, 당신이 반격할 수 있는 상태 목록에 다음 옵션을 추가하십시오.

  • 육체의 자비 @link[conditions.drained], @link[conditions.slowed]; 16레벨일 경우 추가 @link[conditions.stunned]

  • 은혜의 자비 @link[conditions.immobilized], @link[conditions.restrained], @link[conditions.slowed]; 12레벨인 경우 추가 @link[conditions.petrified] 추가; 16레벨인 경우 @link[conditions.stunned] 추가

  • 마음의 자비 @link[conditions.confused], @link[conditions.controlled], @link[conditions.slowed]; 16레벨인 경우 @link[conditions.doomed]과 @link[conditions.stunned].

name: Monster Crafting

description.value:
You can use the parts of monsters to aid in crafting. You can use the body of a monster to help @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} items, using Survival instead of Crafting for the Craft activity when you do so. If parts of the monster's body are valuable, you can expend them toward the item's raw material cost as well. (The GM makes the determination if the monster's entry doesn't list any valuable materials from its body.)

If you spend additional days working on the item, reduce the Price using the monster's level instead of your own. Certain items may require specific creatures in their Craft requirement.

_desc_en:
You can use the parts of monsters to aid in crafting. You can use the body of a monster to help @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} items, using Survival instead of Crafting for the Craft activity when you do so. If parts of the monster's body are valuable, you can expend them toward the item's raw material cost as well. (The GM makes the determination if the monster's entry doesn't list any valuable materials from its body.)

If you spend additional days working on the item, reduce the Price using the monster's level instead of your own. Certain items may require specific creatures in their Craft requirement.
_desc_ko:
몬스터의 부위를 제작에 활용할 수 있다. 몬스터의 시체를 이용해 @link[actions.craft] 아이템을 만들 때, 제작 활동 대신 생존 기술을 사용할 수 있다. 몬스터 몸의 일부가 가치 있다면, 해당 부위를 아이템의 원재료 비용으로 소모할 수도 있습니다. (몬스터 항목에 몸에서 얻는 가치 있는 재료가 명시되지 않은 경우, GM이 판단합니다.)

아이템 제작에 추가 일수를 투자할 경우, 가격 계산 시 자신의 레벨 대신 몬스터의 레벨을 적용합니다. 특정 아이템은 제작 조건으로 특정 생물을 요구할 수 있습니다.

name: Peerless Captain

description.value: When you have an active follower in an encounter, you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}; you can use the extra action only to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.H72AAzknXiojqXdY]{Direct your Follower}.

_desc_en: When you have an active follower in an encounter, you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}; you can use the extra action only to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.H72AAzknXiojqXdY]{Direct your Follower}.
_desc_ko: 교전에서 활성 추종자가 있을 때, 당신은 @link[conditions.quickened] 상태가 됩니다. 추가 행동은 오직 @link[actions.direct-follower]에만 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Spear Dancer

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a weapon from the spear or polearm group

You favor weapons that allow you to lash out viciously while keeping enemies at bay, giving you an opportunity to strike without fear of reprisal. You Step and then Strike with a spear or polearm you are wielding, or Strike with the spear or polearm and then Step.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a weapon from the spear or polearm group

You favor weapons that allow you to lash out viciously while keeping enemies at bay, giving you an opportunity to strike without fear of reprisal. You Step and then Strike with a spear or polearm you are wielding, or Strike with the spear or polearm and then Step.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 창 또는 장창 계열 무기를 사용 중일 것

당신은 적을 멀리 밀어내면서도 맹렬하게 공격할 수 있는 무기를 선호합니다. 이는 보복을 두려워하지 않고 공격할 기회를 제공합니다. 당신은 {신중한 발걸음}한 후 휘두르는 창이나 장창으로 공격하거나, 창이나 장창으로 공격한 후 {신중한 발걸음}합니다.

name: Fuse Stance

description.value:
You have combined two stances into a single stance all your own. When you take this feat, choose two stances you know and combine them into a single fused stance. Give your new fused stance a unique name. When you enter your fused stance, you gain all the effects of both stances, including the requirements and restrictions.

If the stances both grant special attacks, you gain all those attacks. If a stance restricts you to one particular attack (such as Crane Stance), you must abide by that restriction. If the fused stances have incompatible restrictions, the GM determines which apply, or determines you can't fuse those stances at all.

_desc_en:
You have combined two stances into a single stance all your own. When you take this feat, choose two stances you know and combine them into a single fused stance. Give your new fused stance a unique name. When you enter your fused stance, you gain all the effects of both stances, including the requirements and restrictions.

If the stances both grant special attacks, you gain all those attacks. If a stance restricts you to one particular attack (such as Crane Stance), you must abide by that restriction. If the fused stances have incompatible restrictions, the GM determines which apply, or determines you can't fuse those stances at all.
_desc_ko:
당신은 두 가지 스탠스를 결합하여 자신만의 단일 스탠스를 만들었습니다. 이 피트를 선택할 때, 알고 있는 두 가지 스탠스를 선택하여 하나의 융합 스탠스로 결합하십시오. 새로 만든 융합 스탠스에 고유한 이름을 부여하십시오. 융합 스탠스에 진입하면 두 스탠스의 모든 효과(요구 사항 및 제한 사항 포함)를 얻습니다.

두 자세 모두 특수 공격을 부여한다면, 해당 공격들을 모두 획득한다. 특정 공격(예: 학자세)으로 제한하는 자세가 있다면, 그 제한을 반드시 준수해야 한다. 융합된 자세에 상충되는 제한이 있을 경우, GM이 적용할 제한을 결정하거나 해당 자세들을 전혀 융합할 수 없다고 판단한다.

name: Live Off Borrowed Time

description.value:
Frequency once per minute

Trigger Your turn begins.

You tap into the future to steal a bit of time from yourself a few seconds from now that you can use immediately. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 1 round, and can use the extra action to take any basic or specialty basic 1-action action. You gain this extra action immediately and can use it this turn. At the end of your turn, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and are immune to the quickened condition until the end of your next turn.
