_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 생물을 @link[conditions.grabbed] 상태나 @link[conditions.restrained] 상태입니다.

당신은 적의 숨을 조여냅니다. 당신이 @link[conditions.grabbed] 또는 @link[conditions.restrained] 생물에게 비무장 근접 공격을 시도합니다. 성공 시, 무기 피해 주사위 수만큼의 상황 보너스를 피해에 얻으며, 대상은 다음 턴 시작 시점이나 탈출할 때까지(둘 중 먼저 도래하는 시점) 간신히 말할 수만 있습니다. 간신히 말할 수 있는 동안 대상은 쉰 속삭임 이상의 소리를 낼 수 없으며, DC 10 단순에 성공하지 못하면 언어를 요하는 모든 행동을 잃습니다. 말하기가 필요한 행동이 동시에 조작 행동인 경우(예: 집중 및 조작 특성이 있는 @link[actions.cast-a-spell]), 대상은 붙잡힘 상태에 대한 추가 DC 5 단순 판정 대신 단일 DC 10 단순 판정만 굴림합니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.7HXxtWO5MAJWkwnt]{Effect: Strangle}

name: Stir Allies

description.value: You shout a command for your allies to scramble. Allies within 30 feet can use a reaction to Step. If you're legendary in Diplomacy, they can instead Stride.

_desc_en: You shout a command for your allies to scramble. Allies within 30 feet can use a reaction to Step. If you're legendary in Diplomacy, they can instead Stride.
_desc_ko: 당신은 아군에게 재빨리 움직이라는 명령을 외친다. 30피트 내의 아군은 반응으로 '{신중한 발걸음}'을 사용할 수 있다. 당신이 외교에 전설적인 실력자라면, 그들은 대신 '이동'을 사용할 수 있다.

name: Gifted Power

description.value:
Your mystery grants you additional magic. You have an extra spell slot of your highest rank, which you can use only to cast one of your mystery's granted spells, heightened to this rank.

Special If you have the divine access class feature or Mysterious Repertoire feat, you can cast spells that you learned from those abilities using the additional spell slot from Gifted Power.

_desc_en:
Your mystery grants you additional magic. You have an extra spell slot of your highest rank, which you can use only to cast one of your mystery's granted spells, heightened to this rank.

Special If you have the divine access class feature or Mysterious Repertoire feat, you can cast spells that you learned from those abilities using the additional spell slot from Gifted Power.
_desc_ko:
당신의 신비는 추가적인 마법을 부여합니다. 최고 랭크의 주문 슬롯 하나를 추가로 가지며, 이 슬롯은 오직 신비가 부여한 주문 중 하나를 해당 랭크으로 강화하여 시전하는 데만 사용할 수 있습니다.

특수 신성 접근 클래스 특성이나 신비한 레퍼토리 클래스 피트를 보유한 경우, '선천적 능력'의 추가 주문 슬롯을 사용하여 해당 능력으로 습득한 주문을 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Fiery Rebirth

description.value:
Trigger You regain Hit Points while you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.

When you escape death, you return to life with retributive fire that burns those who harmed you. You expend 1 Mythic Point, return to consciousness, Stand, and regain additional Hit Points equal to your level. You then erupt in flames, dealing fire damage equal to twice your level (@Damage[(2*@actor.level)[fire]]) to adjacent foes, with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save against your class DC. Foes that critically fail the save are also pushed 5 feet away from you.

_desc_en:
Trigger You regain Hit Points while you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.

When you escape death, you return to life with retributive fire that burns those who harmed you. You expend 1 Mythic Point, return to consciousness, Stand, and regain additional Hit Points equal to your level. You then erupt in flames, dealing fire damage equal to twice your level (@Damage[(2*@actor.level)[fire]]) to adjacent foes, with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save against your class DC. Foes that critically fail the save are also pushed 5 feet away from you.
_desc_ko:
발동 @link[conditions.unconscious] 상태일 때 HP를 회복한다.

죽음에서 벗어날 때, 당신은 당신을 해친 자들을 태우는 보복의 불꽃과 함께 생명을 되찾습니다. 신화 포인트 1점을 소모하고, 의식을 되찾으며, 일어서고, 레벨과 동일한 추가 HP를 회복합니다. 이어서 불꽃을 뿜어내며 인접한 적에게 레벨의 두 배에 해당하는 화염 피해를 입힌다(화염). 이 공격은 직업 DC에 대한 기본 반사 내성을 받는다. 내성 굴림에서 대실패를 한 적은 당신으로부터 5피트 밀려난다.

name: Critical Debilitation

description.value:
Your debilitations are especially effective on your most powerful attacks. Whenever you critically succeed at an attack roll against an enemy and use Debilitating Strike, add the following debilitation to the list you can choose from.

  • Debilitation The target attempts a @Check[fortitude|against:rogue] save against your class DC with the following effects.

    Critical Success The target is unaffected.

    Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of your next turn.

    Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} until the end of your next turn.

    Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} until the end of your next turn.

_desc_en:
Your debilitations are especially effective on your most powerful attacks. Whenever you critically succeed at an attack roll against an enemy and use Debilitating Strike, add the following debilitation to the list you can choose from.

  • Debilitation The target attempts a @Check[fortitude|against:rogue] save against your class DC with the following effects.

    Critical Success The target is unaffected.

    Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of your next turn.

    Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} until the end of your next turn.

    Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} until the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
당신의 약화 효과는 가장 강력한 공격에 특히 효과적입니다. 적에 대한 명중 굴림에서 대성공을 거두고 약화 강타를 사용할 때마다, 선택할 수 있는 약화 효과 목록에 다음을 추가하십시오.

  • 쇠약 효과 대상은 다음 효과에 대해 당신의 직업 난이도(DC)로 인내 내성을 시도합니다.

    대성공 대상은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

    성공 대상은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.slowed]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

    실패 대상은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.slowed]{2} 상태가 됩니다.

    대실패 대상은 @link[conditions.paralyzed] 상태가 되어 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 지속됩니다.

name: Spellmaster's Tenacity

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You critically fail at a saving throw against a foe's spell, and that spell was cast or created with the tradition of magic you selected with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.dWkf6LhYBfBkeyOA]{Spellmaster's Resilience} feat.

You call upon the power of your spells to protect you from the worst of the magic headed your way. You fail your saving throw instead of critically failing. For 1 minute, increase the circumstance bonus to saving throws from the Spellmaster's Resilience feat to +2, and increase the resistance to damage it grants to 10.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You critically fail at a saving throw against a foe's spell, and that spell was cast or created with the tradition of magic you selected with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.dWkf6LhYBfBkeyOA]{Spellmaster's Resilience} feat.

You call upon the power of your spells to protect you from the worst of the magic headed your way. You fail your saving throw instead of critically failing. For 1 minute, increase the circumstance bonus to saving throws from the Spellmaster's Resilience feat to +2, and increase the resistance to damage it grants to 10.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 적의 주문에 대한 내성 굴림에서 대실패를 했고, 해당 주문이 @link[feats.spellmasters-resilience] 피트로 선택한 마법 전통으로 시전되거나 생성된 경우.

당신은 자신에게 다가오는 최악의 마법으로부터 자신을 보호하기 위해 자신의 주문력을 불러옵니다. 대실패하는 대신 내성 굴림에서 실패합니다. 1분 동안, 스펠마스터 회복력 재주 의 내성 굴림 상황 보너스를 +2로 증가시키고, 이 재주가 부여하는 피해 내성 저항력을 10으로 증가시킵니다.

name: Unlimited Potential

description.value:
Frequency once per minute

The laws of magic can limit your mind only if you think you need them, and you've grown past the need for such limits. If your next action is to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast a Spell} of 5th rank or lower that has no duration, you don't expend the prepared spell as you cast it.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per minute

The laws of magic can limit your mind only if you think you need them, and you've grown past the need for such limits. If your next action is to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast a Spell} of 5th rank or lower that has no duration, you don't expend the prepared spell as you cast it.
_desc_ko:
발생 빈도 분당 1회

마법의 법칙은 오직 당신이 그 법칙이 필요하다고 생각할 때만 당신의 마음을 제한할 수 있으며, 당신은 이미 그러한 제한이 필요하지 않은 경지에 이르렀다. 만약 당신의 다음 행동이 지속 시간이 없는 5랭크 이하의 @link[actions.cast-a-spell]이라면, 시전 시 준비된 주문을 소모하지 않는다.

name: Charlatan

description.value: You've learned to mimic the abilities of spellcasters by studying their flourishes and words. When you activate a magic item to generate a spell effect, attempt a Deception check. If you succeed against an onlooker's Perception DC, to that onlooker, you appear to cast that spell instead. Onlookers who successfully recognize the spell realize you used a magic item, though those who later successfully identify the magic still can't determine that the source of the effect was a magic item.

_desc_en: You've learned to mimic the abilities of spellcasters by studying their flourishes and words. When you activate a magic item to generate a spell effect, attempt a Deception check. If you succeed against an onlooker's Perception DC, to that onlooker, you appear to cast that spell instead. Onlookers who successfully recognize the spell realize you used a magic item, though those who later successfully identify the magic still can't determine that the source of the effect was a magic item.
_desc_ko: 당신은 마법사들의 화려한 동작과 주문을 연구하여 그들의 능력을 모방하는 법을 익혔습니다. 마법 아이템을 활성화하여 주문 효과를 생성할 때, 기만 판정을 시도하십시오. 관찰자의 지각 DC에 성공하면, 그 관찰자에게는 당신이 그 주문을 시전한 것처럼 보입니다. 주문을 성공적으로 알아본 관찰자들은 당신이 마법 아이템을 사용했음을 깨닫지만, 나중에 마법 아이템을 성공적으로 식별한 자들조차도 그 효과의 근원이 마법 아이템이었다는 사실을 알아낼 수 없습니다.

name: Ancillary Motes

description.value:
You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Ewk7h9aQpKvy1RJo]{Crystalline Dust} one more time per day.

Special You can take this feat more than once, gaining one more use of Crystalline Dust per day each time.

_desc_en:
You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Ewk7h9aQpKvy1RJo]{Crystalline Dust} one more time per day.

Special You can take this feat more than once, gaining one more use of Crystalline Dust per day each time.
_desc_ko:
하루에 한 번 더 @link[feats.extraplanar-haze]를 사용할 수 있습니다.

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있으며, 선택할 때마다 하루에 한 번 더 결정 가루를 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Retributive Focus

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Requirements Your focus pool is currently empty.

Your enemy's offenses fuel your righteous power. When an enemy triggers your champion's reaction, you regain 1 Focus Point.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Requirements Your focus pool is currently empty.

Your enemy's offenses fuel your righteous power. When an enemy triggers your champion's reaction, you regain 1 Focus Point.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

요구 사항 현재 당신의 포커스 풀이 비어 있습니다.

적의 공격이 당신의 의로운 힘을 키웁니다. 적군이 당신의 챔피언의 반응을 유발할 때, 당신은 포커스 포인트 1을 회복합니다.

name: No Escape

description.value:
Trigger An enemy within reach attempts to move away from you.

You keep pace with a retreating foe. Stride up to your Speed, following the enemy and keeping it in reach throughout its movement until it stops moving or you've moved your full Speed. You can use No Escape to Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead of Stride if you have the corresponding movement type.

_desc_en:
Trigger An enemy within reach attempts to move away from you.

You keep pace with a retreating foe. Stride up to your Speed, following the enemy and keeping it in reach throughout its movement until it stops moving or you've moved your full Speed. You can use No Escape to Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead of Stride if you have the corresponding movement type.
_desc_ko:
발동 도달 범위 내의 적이 당신으로부터 멀어지려 시도한다.

당신은 후퇴하는 적과 속도를 맞춘다. 속도 범위 내에서 적을 따라가며, 적이 멈추거나 당신이 최대 속도까지 이동할 때까지 계속해서 접근 상태를 유지한다. 해당 이동 유형을 보유한 경우, '도주 불가'를 '이동' 대신 '땅굴 파기', '등반', '비행', '수영'에 사용할 수 있다.

name: Sustaining Steel

description.value:
Trigger You Cast a Spell using a spell slot.

Requirements You're in Arcane Cascade stance.

You pull magic into your weapon, using its substance to transform the magic into restorative energy. You regain Hit Points equal to double the spell's rank and roll to end any @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistent Void Damage} you have.

If the spell was of the necromancy school, any persistent void damage you have ends automatically, and you can change the damage type from Arcane Cascade to vitality if you wish. (Vitality damage typically damages only undead or other creatures with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.TTCw5NusiSSkJU1x]{Void Healing}.)

_desc_en:
Trigger You Cast a Spell using a spell slot.

Requirements You're in Arcane Cascade stance.

You pull magic into your weapon, using its substance to transform the magic into restorative energy. You regain Hit Points equal to double the spell's rank and roll to end any @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistent Void Damage} you have.

If the spell was of the necromancy school, any persistent void damage you have ends automatically, and you can change the damage type from Arcane Cascade to vitality if you wish. (Vitality damage typically damages only undead or other creatures with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.TTCw5NusiSSkJU1x]{Void Healing}.)
_desc_ko:
발동 당신은 주문 슬롯을 사용하여 주문을 시전합니다.

요구 사항 당신은 아케인 캐스케이드 자세를 취하고 있습니다.

무기에 마법을 끌어당겨 그 물질로 마법을 회복 에너지로 변환합니다. 당신은 주문 랭크의 두 배에 해당하는 HP를 회복하고, 보유한 @link[conditions.persistent-damage]를 종료하기 위한 주사위를 굴립니다.

해당 주문이 네크로맨시 계열이라면, 보유한 지속적 공허 피해가 자동으로 종료되며 원할 경우 피해 유형을 아케인 캐스케이드에서 활력 for healing로 변경할 수 있다. (활력 피해는 일반적으로 언데드나 @link[actions.void-healing] 능력을 가진 생물만 피해를 입힌다.)

name: Communal Crafting

description.value: You can have other PCs help you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} an item, under your direction. A helper PC rolls a check with a skill in which they're trained. The skill must be Crafting or another skill relevant to the item, as determined by the GM. For example, a PC might use Religion to help you Craft an item with the divine trait or Warfare Lore to help you Craft a weapon. Your roll still determines whether you successfully create the item. Any helper's roll contributes toward reducing the cost of raw materials using the numbers from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income} table; this uses the ally PC's proficiency rank in the skill and their level – 1 for their level. Helping PCs must accompany you throughout the Craft activity (preventing them from pursuing other downtime activities) or the benefit is lost. The GM might determine that only a certain number of PCs can help depending on the circumstances. Communal Crafting also allows you to take the role of a helper when someone else is crafting, provided they accept your help.

_desc_en: You can have other PCs help you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} an item, under your direction. A helper PC rolls a check with a skill in which they're trained. The skill must be Crafting or another skill relevant to the item, as determined by the GM. For example, a PC might use Religion to help you Craft an item with the divine trait or Warfare Lore to help you Craft a weapon. Your roll still determines whether you successfully create the item. Any helper's roll contributes toward reducing the cost of raw materials using the numbers from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income} table; this uses the ally PC's proficiency rank in the skill and their level – 1 for their level. Helping PCs must accompany you throughout the Craft activity (preventing them from pursuing other downtime activities) or the benefit is lost. The GM might determine that only a certain number of PCs can help depending on the circumstances. Communal Crafting also allows you to take the role of a helper when someone else is crafting, provided they accept your help.
_desc_ko: 당신의 지휘 하에 다른 플레이어 캐릭터가 아이템 @link[actions.craft]을 도울 수 있습니다. 보조 플레이어 캐릭터는 자신이 숙련된 기술로 판정을 굴림합니다. 해당 기술은 제작 기술이거나 GM이 결정한 해당 아이템과 관련된 다른 기술이어야 합니다. 예를 들어, PC가 종교 기술을 사용해 신성 속성이 있는 아이템 제작을 돕거나, 전쟁 지식를 사용해 무기 제작을 도울 수 있습니다. 아이템 제작 성공 여부는 여전히 본인의 굴림으로 결정됩니다. 보조자의 주사위 굴림은 @link[actions.earn-income] 표의 수치를 활용해 원재료 비용을 절감하는 데 기여합니다. 이때 동맹 플레이어의 해당 기술 숙련도 등급과 레벨(레벨에서 1을 뺀 수치)이 적용됩니다. 보조 플레이어는 제작 활동 내내 당신과 동행해야 하며( 다른 다운타임 활동을 할 수 없음), 그렇지 않으면 혜택이 사라집니다. GM은 상황에 따라 특정 수의 플레이어만 도울 수 있다고 판단할 수 있습니다. 공동 제작 시 다른 플레이어가 제작할 때도 그들이 도움을 수락한다면 보조자 역할을 맡을 수 있습니다.

name: Incredible Megafauna Companion

description.value: Under your care and training, your megafauna companion has realized its innate potential. Your companion becomes an indomitable or savage animal companion (your choice), gaining additional abilities determined by the type of companion.

_desc_en: Under your care and training, your megafauna companion has realized its innate potential. Your companion becomes an indomitable or savage animal companion (your choice), gaining additional abilities determined by the type of companion.
_desc_ko: 당신의 보살핌과 훈련 아래, 당신의 거대동물 동반자는 타고난 잠재력을 깨달았습니다. 당신의 동반자는 불굴의 동물 동료 또는 야생 동물 동료(선택)가 되며, 동물 동료 유형에 따라 추가 능력을 얻습니다.

name: Trial by Skyfire

description.value: Your lips murmur as you portend a great disaster, one you hope you survive. A rain of blazing bolts begins to fall from the heavens in a @Template[emanation|distance:10], centered on you, that deals @Damage[2d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in the emanation at the end of each of your turns (@Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] save); you can't exclude yourself from the emanation. The skyfire persists for 1 minute; while you can't Dismiss it, you can suppress the effect for 1 round with a Sustain action. The rain of fire is suppressed if you fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}. If you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zXZjC8HLaRoLR17U]{Cursebound 3} or 4 at any point during Trial by Skyfire's duration, the emanation increases to @Template[emanation|distance:15]{15 feet} and the damage increases to @Damage[4d6[fire]|options:area-damage|shortLabel].

_desc_en: Your lips murmur as you portend a great disaster, one you hope you survive. A rain of blazing bolts begins to fall from the heavens in a @Template[emanation|distance:10], centered on you, that deals @Damage[2d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in the emanation at the end of each of your turns (@Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] save); you can't exclude yourself from the emanation. The skyfire persists for 1 minute; while you can't Dismiss it, you can suppress the effect for 1 round with a Sustain action. The rain of fire is suppressed if you fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}. If you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zXZjC8HLaRoLR17U]{Cursebound 3} or 4 at any point during Trial by Skyfire's duration, the emanation increases to @Template[emanation|distance:15]{15 feet} and the damage increases to @Damage[4d6[fire]|options:area-damage|shortLabel].
_desc_ko:
당신은 입술을 움직이며 큰 재앙을 예언합니다. 그 재앙 속에서 살아남기를 바라며. 하늘에서 불타는 화살비가 10피트 반경으로 당신을 중심으로 쏟아지기 시작하며, 각 당신의 턴이 끝날 때마다 2d6 화염 피해를 반경 내 모든 생물에게 입힙니다(기본 반사 내성). 당신은 이 반경에서 자신을 제외할 수 없습니다. 하늘불은 1분 동안 지속됩니다. 이를 해제할 수는 없지만, 지속 행동으로 1라운드 동안 효과를 억제할 수 있습니다. 당신이 @link[conditions.unconscious] 상태가 되면 불의 비는 억제됩니다. 하늘불의 시련 지속 중 어느 시점에서든 @link[conditions.cursebound]{3} 또는 4 상태가 되면, 발산 범위가 15피트로 확대되고 피해량이 4d6 화염.

로 증가한다.

name: Energy Resistance

description.value: Your eidolon has stronger resistance. Its resistance from Energy Heart and Dual Energy Heart increase to your level.

_desc_en: Your eidolon has stronger resistance. Its resistance from Energy Heart and Dual Energy Heart increase to your level.
_desc_ko: 당신의 에이돌론은 더 강한 저항력을 지닙니다. 에너지 하트와 이중 에너지 하트로부터 얻는 저항력이 당신의 레벨만큼 증가합니다.

name: Magpie Manor Recovery

description.value: Though you're hardly ready to retire from the social life, you appreciate the luxury the older wealthy elite enjoy within the private social club of Magpie Manor in Absalom's Petal District. And you try to bring that luxury even to the wilds of the world. If you have a four-person tent and spend at least 10 minutes setting it up to your level of comfort before taking an 8-hour period of rest, you regain an additional number Hit Points equal to double your level and reduce the severity of your drained condition by 2 instead of 1. Up to three other Medium or smaller creatures can share the tent with you and gain these benefits.

_desc_en: Though you're hardly ready to retire from the social life, you appreciate the luxury the older wealthy elite enjoy within the private social club of Magpie Manor in Absalom's Petal District. And you try to bring that luxury even to the wilds of the world. If you have a four-person tent and spend at least 10 minutes setting it up to your level of comfort before taking an 8-hour period of rest, you regain an additional number Hit Points equal to double your level and reduce the severity of your drained condition by 2 instead of 1. Up to three other Medium or smaller creatures can share the tent with you and gain these benefits.
_desc_ko: 당신은 사교 생활에서 은퇴할 준비는 전혀 되어 있지 않지만, 압살롬의 페탈 지구에 있는 사설 사교 클럽 까치 저택 안에서 나이든 부유한 엘리트들이 누리는 호사를 감상한다. 그리고 당신은 그 호사를 세계의 야생지에까지 가져오려 한다. 4인용 텐트를 가지고 있고 8시간의 휴식을 취하기 전에 최소 10분을 들여 당신의 안락함 수준에 맞게 설치한다면, 당신은 레벨의 두 배와 동일한 추가 히트 포인트를 회복하고 생명력 고갈 상태의 심각도를 1 대신 2 줄인다. 최대 세 명의 다른 중형 이하 생물이 당신과 텐트를 공유하며 이 이점을 얻을 수 있다.

name: Tangle of Limbs

description.value: Dokkaebi have a strong tradition of wrestling. You become trained in Athletics, and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KxaYlC50zzHysJj8]{Titan Wrestler} feat. If you would automatically become trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

value.value: dokkaebi goblin heritage or Tian Xia origin

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Dokkaebi have a strong tradition of wrestling. You become trained in Athletics, and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KxaYlC50zzHysJj8]{Titan Wrestler} feat. If you would automatically become trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.
_desc_ko: 도깨비는 레슬링의 강한 전통을 지녔다. 당신은 운동에 숙련되고, @link[feats.titan-wrestler] 피트를 얻는다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 운동에 자동으로 숙련될 경우, 대신 선택한 기술에 숙련된다.

name: Focused Juggler

description.value:
Trigger Your turn begins.

You continue Juggling until the end of your next turn. Increase the maximum number of items you can juggle by one.

publication.title: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On

_desc_en:
Trigger Your turn begins.

You continue Juggling until the end of your next turn. Increase the maximum number of items you can juggle by one.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신의 턴이 시작됩니다.

다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 저글링을 계속합니다. 저글링할 수 있는 아이템의 최대 개수를 1개 증가시킵니다.

name: Swashbuckler's Riposte

description.value: You've learned to riposte against ill-conceived attacks. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EfjoIuDmtUn4yiow]{Opportune Riposte} reaction.

_desc_en: You've learned to riposte against ill-conceived attacks. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EfjoIuDmtUn4yiow]{Opportune Riposte} reaction.
_desc_ko: 당신은 무모한 공격에 맞서 반격을 하는 법을 익혔습니다. @link[actions.opportune-riposte] 반응을 얻습니다.

name: Effortless Captivation

description.value:
Trigger Your turn begins.

You maintain your innate enchantments and illusions with hardly a thought. You immediately gain the effects of the Sustain a Spell action, which you can use only to extend the duration of an enchantment or illusion spell.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en:
Trigger Your turn begins.

You maintain your innate enchantments and illusions with hardly a thought. You immediately gain the effects of the Sustain a Spell action, which you can use only to extend the duration of an enchantment or illusion spell.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신의 턴이 시작된다.

당신은 타고난 마법과 환상을 거의 생각하지 않고 유지합니다. 당신은 즉시 '주문 유지' 행동의 효과를 얻으며, 이 행동은 마법이나 환상 주문의 지속 시간만 연장하는 데 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Medium's Awareness

description.value: Your apparitions watch over you. You gain a +2 status bonus to Perception checks made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} and when using Perception for your initiative roll. At 12th level, this status bonus increases to +3, and at 20th level, to +4.

_desc_en: Your apparitions watch over you. You gain a +2 status bonus to Perception checks made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} and when using Perception for your initiative roll. At 12th level, this status bonus increases to +3, and at 20th level, to +4.
_desc_ko: 당신의 유령들이 당신을 지켜봅니다. @link[actions.seek]을 위한 지각 판정 및 지각을 사용한 인니셔티브 굴림 시 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 12레벨에 이 상태 보너스는 +3으로, 20레벨에 +4로 증가합니다.

name: Tunnel

description.value: You gain a burrow speed of 10 feet.

publication.title: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm

_desc_en: You gain a burrow speed of 10 feet.
_desc_ko: 굴착 속도 10피트를 얻습니다.

name: Fantastic Leaps

description.value: Your leaps seem to defy gravity as you soar through the air in a single bound. When Leaping, increase the maximum distance you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} horizontally by 10 feet, and the maximum distance you can Leap vertically by 5 feet.

_desc_en: Your leaps seem to defy gravity as you soar through the air in a single bound. When Leaping, increase the maximum distance you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} horizontally by 10 feet, and the maximum distance you can Leap vertically by 5 feet.
_desc_ko: 단번에 공중을 가르는 당신의 도약은 중력을 거스르는 듯하다. 도약 시, 수평으로 @link[actions.leap]할 수 있는 최대 거리를 10피트, 수직으로 도약할 수 있는 최대 거리를 5피트 증가시킨다.

name: Dracomancer

description.value: The power infused into you by your draconic benefactor's presence allows you to manifest their most iconic spells. Choose one 1st-rank spell and one 2nd-rank spell from those listed for a dragon spellcaster of your draconic benefactor's type, (for example, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4koZzrnMXhhosn0D]{Fear} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} for a conspirator dragon benefactor). You can cast each of these spells once per day as innate spells of the same tradition as your draconic benefactor. You gain the trained proficiency rank in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics, and your key spellcasting attribute is Charisma.

_desc_en: The power infused into you by your draconic benefactor's presence allows you to manifest their most iconic spells. Choose one 1st-rank spell and one 2nd-rank spell from those listed for a dragon spellcaster of your draconic benefactor's type, (for example, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4koZzrnMXhhosn0D]{Fear} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} for a conspirator dragon benefactor). You can cast each of these spells once per day as innate spells of the same tradition as your draconic benefactor. You gain the trained proficiency rank in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics, and your key spellcasting attribute is Charisma.
_desc_ko:
당신의 타고난 아케인력은 당신의 이그젬플러의 가장 오랜 전통을 지닌 주문으로 창조됩니다.

당신의 드라코닉 이그젬플러의 드라코닉 유형에 해당하는 드래곤 마법사에게 부여된 1랭크 주문과 2랭크 주문 중 각각 하나씩을 선택하십시오(예: @link[spells.alarm], @link[spells.blur], @link[spells.invisibility], @link[spells.sure-strike] - 블랙 드래곤의 이그젬플러).

이 주문들은 하루에 한 번씩 아케인 선천적 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 아케인 주문 명중 굴림과 주문 난이도(DC)에 숙련 숙련도 등급을 얻으며, 주문 시전에 필요한 주요 능력치는 매력입니다.

name: My Reputation Precedes Me

description.value: Long years of brave exploits haven't gone unnoticed. Whether you know just the right things to say or those you're speaking with recognize you as a reincarnated hero, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks made to Gather Information or Make An Impression, and to Intimidation checks made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce}. At 18th level, these circumstance bonuses increase to +3. If you spend a Mythic point when you attempt such a check, you do so at mythic proficiency.

publication.title: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

_desc_en: Long years of brave exploits haven't gone unnoticed. Whether you know just the right things to say or those you're speaking with recognize you as a reincarnated hero, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks made to Gather Information or Make An Impression, and to Intimidation checks made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce}. At 18th level, these circumstance bonuses increase to +3. If you spend a Mythic point when you attempt such a check, you do so at mythic proficiency.
_desc_ko: 오랜 세월의 용감한 공적이 눈에 띄지 않을 리 없다. 당신이 딱 맞는 말을 알고 있든, 대화 상대가 당신을 환생한 영웅으로 알아보든, 당신은 정보 수집이나 인상 남기기를 위한 외교 판정, 그리고 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{강압}을 위한 위협 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻는다. 18레벨에, 이 상황 보너스는 +3으로 증가한다. 그러한 판정을 시도할 때 신화 점수를 소비하면, 신화 숙련도로 그렇게 한다.

name: Briny Beverage

description.value: You can survive off the sea as well as gain insight from its waters. You can drink saltwater and quench your thirst as though it's freshwater. In addition, once per day, you can take a gulp of seawater using an Interact action to gain imprecise wavesense with a range of 20 feet, which lasts for 1 minute. This wavesense functions only within the body of water you drank from.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You can survive off the sea as well as gain insight from its waters. You can drink saltwater and quench your thirst as though it's freshwater. In addition, once per day, you can take a gulp of seawater using an Interact action to gain imprecise wavesense with a range of 20 feet, which lasts for 1 minute. This wavesense functions only within the body of water you drank from.
_desc_ko: 바다에서 생존할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 바다의 물에서 통찰력을 얻을 수 있습니다. 당신은 바닷물을 마셔 마치 담수처럼 갈증을 해소할 수 있습니다. 또한 하루에 한 번, 상호작용 행동을 사용해 바닷물을 한 모금 마시면 20피트 범위 내에서 1분간 지속되는 부정확한 파도 감지 능력을 얻습니다. 이 파도 감지 능력은 당신이 마신 물속에서만 작동합니다.

name: Specialized Spirit Companion

description.value:
Your animal companion gains a unique specialization, spirit-blessed. Thanks to the blessing bestowed upon it by the spirits of this world. If your animal companion already has the spirit-blessed specialization, it gains one additional specialization of your choice.

Spirit-blessed: Your companion is capable of harming wayward spirits, ghosts, and other incorporeal creatures as easy as if they were made of flesh and bone. Your companion's Strikes all gain the effects of the ghost touch property rune.

Special You can select this feat up to three times. Each time, add a different specialization to your companion. It's first specialization must be spirit-blessed.

_desc_en:
Your animal companion gains a unique specialization, spirit-blessed. Thanks to the blessing bestowed upon it by the spirits of this world. If your animal companion already has the spirit-blessed specialization, it gains one additional specialization of your choice.

Spirit-blessed: Your companion is capable of harming wayward spirits, ghosts, and other incorporeal creatures as easy as if they were made of flesh and bone. Your companion's Strikes all gain the effects of the ghost touch property rune.

Special You can select this feat up to three times. Each time, add a different specialization to your companion. It's first specialization must be spirit-blessed.
_desc_ko:
당신의 동물 동료는 이 세계의 영혼들이 내린 축복 덕분에 '영혼의 축복'이라는 고유 전문화를 얻습니다. 만약 당신의 동물 동료가 이미 '영혼의 축복' 전문화를 가지고 있다면, 당신이 선택한 추가 전문화 하나를 얻습니다.

영혼의 축복: 당신의 동반자는 길 잃은 영혼, 유령 및 기타 비물질적 생물을 마치 살과 뼈로 이루어진 존재처럼 손쉽게 해칠 수 있습니다. 동료의 모든 공격은 고스트 터치 속성 룬의 효과를 얻습니다.

특수 이 피트를 최대 세 번까지 선택할 수 있습니다. 매번 동료에게 다른 전문화를 추가합니다. 첫 번째 전문화는 반드시 영혼의 축복이어야 합니다.

name: Rakshasa Magic

description.value: You remember the secrets of your rakshasa forebears and know how to apply those memories to get results. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2qGqa33E4GPUCbMV]{Humanoid Form} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{Illusory Creature} once per day each as 2nd-rank divine innate spells.

_desc_en: You remember the secrets of your rakshasa forebears and know how to apply those memories to get results. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2qGqa33E4GPUCbMV]{Humanoid Form} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{Illusory Creature} once per day each as 2nd-rank divine innate spells.
_desc_ko: 당신은 라크샤사 선조의 비밀을 기억하며, 그 기억을 활용해 결과를 얻는 법을 알고 있습니다. 하루에 한 번씩 @link[spells.humanoid-form]와 @link[spells.illusory-creature]을 (2nd)랭크 신성 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Dragon Transformation

description.value:
You transform into a ferocious Large dragon, gaining the effects of 6th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5c692cCcTDXjSEzk]{Dragon Form} except that you use your own AC and attack modifier, you apply your extra damage from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Ah5g9pDwWF9b9VW9]{Rage}, and the Dragon Breath action uses your class DC. Add the temporary Hit Points from dragon form to any you already have from entering a rage (or any other action with the rage trait). The action to Dismiss the transformation gains the rage trait.

At 18th level, you gain a +20-foot status bonus to your fly Speed, your damage bonus with dragon Strikes increases to +12, and you gain a +14 status bonus to your Dragon Breath damage.

_desc_en:
You transform into a ferocious Large dragon, gaining the effects of 6th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5c692cCcTDXjSEzk]{Dragon Form} except that you use your own AC and attack modifier, you apply your extra damage from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Ah5g9pDwWF9b9VW9]{Rage}, and the Dragon Breath action uses your class DC. Add the temporary Hit Points from dragon form to any you already have from entering a rage (or any other action with the rage trait). The action to Dismiss the transformation gains the rage trait.

At 18th level, you gain a +20-foot status bonus to your fly Speed, your damage bonus with dragon Strikes increases to +12, and you gain a +14 status bonus to your Dragon Breath damage.
_desc_ko:
당신은 사나운 대형 용으로 변신하며, (6th)등급 @link[spells.dragon-form]의 효과를 얻습니다. 단, 자신의 AC와 공격 수정자를 사용하며, @link[actions.rage]의 추가 피해를 적용하고, 드래곤의 숨결 행동에는 자신의 클래스 DC를 사용합니다. 용 형태로 인한 임시 HP를 분노 상태 진입(또는 분노 특성이 적용되는 다른 행동)으로 이미 획득한 HP에 추가한다. 변형을 해제하는 행동은 분노 특성을 획득한다.

18레벨에 도달하면 비행 속도에 +20피트 상태 보너스를 얻으며, 드래곤 스트라이크의 피해 보너스가 +12로 증가하고, 드래곤 브레스 피해에 +14 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Munitions Machinist

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.Jkl5KOZih7MoMqAJ#quick-alchemy-benefits] benefits, creating up to 4 versatile vials during your daily preparations. You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.yzNJgwzV9XqEhKc6]{Quick Alchemy} only to create bombs or alchemical ammunition. Using Quick Alchemy to create alchemical ammunition also counts as 1 action toward activating that ammunition.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.Jkl5KOZih7MoMqAJ#quick-alchemy-benefits] benefits, creating up to 4 versatile vials during your daily preparations. You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.yzNJgwzV9XqEhKc6]{Quick Alchemy} only to create bombs or alchemical ammunition. Using Quick Alchemy to create alchemical ammunition also counts as 1 action toward activating that ammunition.
_desc_ko: 탄약 제작에 능숙합니다. 신속 연금술의 이점과 다용도 약병 4개를 얻지만, 신속 약병은 폭탄이나 연금술 탄약 제작에만 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Resounding Finale

description.value:
Trigger You or an ally benefiting from your composition spell would take sonic damage.

You bring your performance to a sudden, dramatic finish, drowning out other sounds. Your composition spell ends immediately, and all allies that had been benefiting from the spell's effects gain sonic resistance against the triggering damage equal to twice the composition spell's rank.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ycalVFivloJ14yhA]{Effect: Resounding Finale}

_desc_en:
Trigger You or an ally benefiting from your composition spell would take sonic damage.

You bring your performance to a sudden, dramatic finish, drowning out other sounds. Your composition spell ends immediately, and all allies that had been benefiting from the spell's effects gain sonic resistance against the triggering damage equal to twice the composition spell's rank.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ycalVFivloJ14yhA]{Effect: Resounding Finale}
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신이나 당신의 조성 주문 혜택을 받는 아군이 [sonic] 피해를 입을 때.

당신은 공연을 갑작스럽고 극적으로 마무리하며 다른 소리를 압도합니다. 당신의 작곡 주문은 즉시 종료되며, 해당 주문 효과의 혜택을 받고 있던 모든 아군은 발동된 피해에 대해 작곡 주문 랭크의 두 배에 해당하는 음파 저항력을 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ycalVFivloJ14yhA]{효과: 울려 퍼지는 피날레}

name: Quah Bond

description.value:
Access Shoanti ethnicity

You grew up among the Shoanti tribes, with the spirits watching over you, and they offer you guidance. You gain the trained proficiency rank in the skill listed for your quah (or another skill of your choice, if you're already trained in that skill). You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]{Assurance} skill feat in that skill, as the spirits' help guides your actions.

  • Lyrune-Quah: Religion
  • Shadde-Quah: Athletics
  • Shriikirri-Quah: Nature
  • Shundar-Quah: Diplomacy
  • Sklar-Quah: Intimidation
  • Skoan-Quah: Medicine
  • Tamiir-Quah: Acrobatics

_desc_en:
Access Shoanti ethnicity

You grew up among the Shoanti tribes, with the spirits watching over you, and they offer you guidance. You gain the trained proficiency rank in the skill listed for your quah (or another skill of your choice, if you're already trained in that skill). You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]{Assurance} skill feat in that skill, as the spirits' help guides your actions.

  • Lyrune-Quah: Religion
  • Shadde-Quah: Athletics
  • Shriikirri-Quah: Nature
  • Shundar-Quah: Diplomacy
  • Sklar-Quah: Intimidation
  • Skoan-Quah: Medicine
  • Tamiir-Quah: Acrobatics
_desc_ko:
접근 쇼안티 종족

당신은 쇼안티 부족들 사이에서 자랐으며, 영혼들이 당신을 지켜보고 있으며, 그들은 당신에게 지도를 제공합니다. 당신은 자신의 쿠아에 명시된 기술(또는 이미 숙련된 다른 기술)에 대해 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 영혼들의 도움이 당신의 행동을 인도하므로, 해당 기술에 대해 @link[feats.assurance] 기술 피트를 얻습니다.

  • 리룬-쿠아: 종교
  • 샤데-쿠아: 운동
  • 쉬리키리-쿠아: 자연
  • 슌다르-쿠아: 외교
  • 스클라-쿠아: 위협
  • 스코안-쿠아: 의학
  • 타미르-쿠아: 곡예

name: Devout Blessing

description.value: You gain the blessing of the devoted class feature, choosing from the listed blessings or any other to which you have access.

_desc_en: You gain the blessing of the devoted class feature, choosing from the listed blessings or any other to which you have access.
_desc_ko: 당신은 열성적인 계급 특성의 축복을 얻으며, 나열된 축복이나 접근 가능한 다른 축복 중 하나를 선택합니다.

name: Dazzling Display

description.value: You perform a bewildering show of prowess, such as by whirling and flashing a weapon, that unnerves foes. Attempt Intimidation checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} each enemy within 30 feet. If your last action was a critical hit against an enemy or reduced an enemy to 0 Hit Points, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Intimidation checks. Regardless of the results of your checks, each creature is then temporarily immune to Dazzling Display for 1 minute.

_desc_en: You perform a bewildering show of prowess, such as by whirling and flashing a weapon, that unnerves foes. Attempt Intimidation checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} each enemy within 30 feet. If your last action was a critical hit against an enemy or reduced an enemy to 0 Hit Points, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Intimidation checks. Regardless of the results of your checks, each creature is then temporarily immune to Dazzling Display for 1 minute.
_desc_ko: 무기를 휘두르며 번쩍이는 등 혼란스러운 기교를 선보여 적을 불안하게 만든다. 30피트 내의 각 적에게 @link[actions.demoralize] 효과를 주기 위해 협박 판정을 시도하다. 마지막 행동이 적에게 치명타를 입혔거나 적의 HP를 0으로 만들었다면, 협박 판정 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 검사 결과와 무관하게, 모든 생물은 이후 1분 동안 눈부신 전시 효과에 일시적으로 면역됩니다.

name: Manipulative Charm

description.value:
Against humanoids, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie}, and to Diplomacy checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}.

Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLA0q0WOK2YPuJs6]{Charm} as a divine innate spell using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Casting it requires staring into the target's eyes, giving the spell the visual trait. At 5th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the spell is heightened by an additional level, to a maximum of a 9th-rank charm when you are 19th level.

_desc_en:
Against humanoids, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie}, and to Diplomacy checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}.

Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLA0q0WOK2YPuJs6]{Charm} as a divine innate spell using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Casting it requires staring into the target's eyes, giving the spell the visual trait. At 5th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the spell is heightened by an additional level, to a maximum of a 9th-rank charm when you are 19th level.
_desc_ko:
인간형 생물 상대 시, @link[actions.lie] 기만 판정 및 @link[actions.gather-information]과 @link[actions.make-an-impression] 외교 판정에서 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

하루에 한 번, @link[spells.charm]을 신성 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있으며, 이때 직업 DC와 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽을 사용한다. 시전 시 대상의 눈을 응시해야 하며, 이로 인해 주문은 시각적 특성을 갖게 된다. 5레벨에 도달하고 이후 2레벨마다 이 주문은 추가 레벨만큼 강화되며, 19레벨에 도달하면 최대 (9th)랭크의 매혹 주문으로 강화된다.

name: Intimidating Strike

description.value: Your blow not only wounds creatures but also shatters their confidence. Make a melee Strike. If you hit and deal damage, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical hit.

_desc_en: Your blow not only wounds creatures but also shatters their confidence. Make a melee Strike. If you hit and deal damage, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical hit.
_desc_ko: 당신의 일격은 상대를 상처 입힐 뿐만 아니라 그들의 자신감마저 산산조각 낸다. 근접 공격을 시도한다. 명중하여 피해를 입히면, 대상은 @link[conditions.frightened]{1} 상태가 되며, 치명타 시에는 @link[conditions.frightened]{2} 상태가 된다.

name: Visual Fidelity

description.value:
You've found a way to use a hodgepodge combination of devices to enhance your visual abilities in every situation. You gain darkvision and low-light vision, and you can see @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures and objects as translucent shapes, though these shapes are indistinct enough to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to you.

If an effect would give you the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} condition, the effect must attempt a counteract check against your class DC, with your counteract rank equaling half your level, rounded up. On a failed counteract check, you aren't blinded-your various devices are able to compensate.

_desc_en:
You've found a way to use a hodgepodge combination of devices to enhance your visual abilities in every situation. You gain darkvision and low-light vision, and you can see @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures and objects as translucent shapes, though these shapes are indistinct enough to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to you.

If an effect would give you the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} condition, the effect must attempt a counteract check against your class DC, with your counteract rank equaling half your level, rounded up. On a failed counteract check, you aren't blinded-your various devices are able to compensate.
_desc_ko:
여러 가지 장치를 뒤섞어 조합한 방법으로 모든 상황에서 시각 능력을 향상시키는 방법을 터득했습니다. 암흑 시야와 저조도 시야를 얻으며, @link[conditions.invisible]한 생물과 물체를 반투명한 형상으로 볼 수 있습니다. 다만 이 형상들은 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태로 간주될 만큼 불분명합니다.

효과가 당신에게 @link[conditions.blinded] 상태를 부여하려 할 경우, 해당 효과는 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 반격 판정(카운터액트)를 시도해야 하며, 당신의 반격 판정 등급은 레벨의 절반(반올림)과 동일합니다. 반격 판정 실패 시, 당신은 실명되지 않습니다-여러 장치가 이를 보완할 수 있기 때문입니다.

name: Discerning Gaze

description.value:
You have a sense for when people are lying. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on your secret Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive}.

If you use Sense Motive on a creature you have currently condemned with Harsh Judgment, your GM rolls the Perception check twice and takes the higher result (this is a fortune effect).

publication.title: Pathfinder Adventure: Night of the Gray Death

_desc_en:
You have a sense for when people are lying. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on your secret Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive}.

If you use Sense Motive on a creature you have currently condemned with Harsh Judgment, your GM rolls the Perception check twice and takes the higher result (this is a fortune effect).
_desc_ko:
사람이 거짓말을 할 때 감지하는 능력이 있습니다. @link[actions.sense-motive]에 대한 비밀 지각 판정 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

당신이 가혹한 심판으로 현재 정죄한 생물에게 감정을 읽기를 사용하면, GM은 지각 판정 주사위를 두 번 굴림하여 더 높은 결과를 적용합니다(이는 행운 효과입니다).

name: Expert Snowcasting

description.value: You draw ever more magical cold into your being, learning how to manipulate it to your whims. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{expert spellcasting} benefits.

_desc_en: You draw ever more magical cold into your being, learning how to manipulate it to your whims. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{expert spellcasting} benefits.
_desc_ko: 당신은 점점 더 많은 마법의 냉기를 몸속에 끌어들이며, 이를 마음대로 조종하는 법을 익힙니다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{전문 주문 시전}의 혜택을 얻습니다.

name: Empathic Calm

description.value: Once per day, you can cast either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.b515AZlB0sridKSq]{Calm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8xRzLhwGL7Dgy3EZ]{Sanctuary} as an innate occult spell, heightened to half your level rounded up.

_desc_en: Once per day, you can cast either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.b515AZlB0sridKSq]{Calm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8xRzLhwGL7Dgy3EZ]{Sanctuary} as an innate occult spell, heightened to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 하루에 한 번, @link[spells.calm] 또는 @link[spells.sanctuary] 중 하나를 선천적 오컬트 주문으로 시전할 수 있으며, 이 주문은 네 레벨의 반(반올림)만큼 강화된다.

name: Rain of Bolts

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Throughout the day, your body produces powerful projectiles within your chassis. You fire them all at once in either a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] or a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10]. Foes in the area take @Damage[(3 + floor(@actor.level/3))d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. This increases to 7d6 at 12th level, 8d6 at 15th level, and 9d6 at 18th level.

Enhancement The projectiles regenerate quicker, they are much more powerful, and you can refine the metallic content to harm certain creatures. You can use Rain of Bolts once per hour instead of once per day. The damage increases to 12d6 and each time you use the action, you can choose adamantine, cold iron, or silver. The damage from Rain of Bolts is treated as the metal you chose. At 20th level, the damage increases to 13d6.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Throughout the day, your body produces powerful projectiles within your chassis. You fire them all at once in either a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] or a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10]. Foes in the area take @Damage[(3 + floor(@actor.level/3))d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. This increases to 7d6 at 12th level, 8d6 at 15th level, and 9d6 at 18th level.

Enhancement The projectiles regenerate quicker, they are much more powerful, and you can refine the metallic content to harm certain creatures. You can use Rain of Bolts once per hour instead of once per day. The damage increases to 12d6 and each time you use the action, you can choose adamantine, cold iron, or silver. The damage from Rain of Bolts is treated as the metal you chose. At 20th level, the damage increases to 13d6.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

하루 종일, 당신의 몸은 차체 안에서 강력한 투사체를 생성합니다. 이것들을 30피트 원뿔 또는 10피트 발산 중 하나로 한꺼번에 발사합니다. 해당 영역에 있는 적들은 관통의 피해를 입으며, 기본 반사에 대한 내성 굴림(내성 성공 시 피해 면제)를 수행해야 합니다. 이 피해는 12레벨에 7d6, 15레벨에 8d6, 18레벨에 9d6으로 증가한다.

강화 투사체의 재생 속도가 빨라지고, 훨씬 강력해지며, 특정 생물을 해치기 위해 금속 성분을 정제할 수 있습니다. '번개 비'를 하루에 한 번이 아닌 시간당 한 번 사용할 수 있습니다. 피해량이 12d6로 증가하며, 행동을 사용할 때마다 아다만틴, 냉철, 은 중 하나를 선택할 수 있습니다. 번개 비의 피해는 선택한 금속으로 간주됩니다. 20레벨에 도달하면 피해량이 13d6로 증가합니다.

name: Stone Communion

description.value: You gain a unique communion with the earth and stones. You learn the Terran language and you can Activate your ka stone with a 10-minute activation (envision) to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YIMampGpij4Y30yE]{Speak with Stones}.

_desc_en: You gain a unique communion with the earth and stones. You learn the Terran language and you can Activate your ka stone with a 10-minute activation (envision) to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YIMampGpij4Y30yE]{Speak with Stones}.
_desc_ko:
당신은 대지와 돌과의 독특한 교감을 얻습니다. 테란 언어를 습득하며, 10분간의 활성화(상상)를 통해 카 스톤을 활성화하여 @link[spells.speak-with-stones]

를 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Resuscitate

description.value:
Requirements You are holding healer's tools or are wearing them and have a hand free.

You resuscitate the dead. Attempt a @Check[medicine|dc:40|showDC:all] check to revive a dead creature who has been dead for no more than 3 rounds and whose body is mostly intact. If you succeed, the target returns to life with the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IkGYwHRLhkuoGReG]{Raise Dead}, except it still has the wounded condition it had before dying, increased by 1 (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded 1} if it wasn't wounded before dying). Whether you succeed or fail, the target is temporarily immune to Resuscitate for 1 day.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are holding healer's tools or are wearing them and have a hand free.

You resuscitate the dead. Attempt a @Check[medicine|dc:40|showDC:all] check to revive a dead creature who has been dead for no more than 3 rounds and whose body is mostly intact. If you succeed, the target returns to life with the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IkGYwHRLhkuoGReG]{Raise Dead}, except it still has the wounded condition it had before dying, increased by 1 (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded 1} if it wasn't wounded before dying). Whether you succeed or fail, the target is temporarily immune to Resuscitate for 1 day.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 치유 도구를 들고 있거나 착용 중이며 한 손이 비어 있어야 합니다.

당신은 죽은 자를 소생시킵니다. 사망한 지 3라운드 이내이며 시신이 대체로 온전한 죽은 생물을 되살리기 위해 DC 40 의학 판정을 시도합니다. 성공 시 대상은 부활의 효과로 되살아나지만, 사망 전 가졌던 부상 상태가 1 증가한 상태(사망 전 부상 상태가 아니었다면 @link[conditions.wounded]{1} 상태)로 돌아옵니다. 성공 여부와 상관없이 대상은 1일간 일시적으로 부활술에 면역됩니다.

name: Cartwheel Dodge

description.value:
Requirements You aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered} or overburdened.

Trigger You succeed or critically succeed at a Reflex saving throw.

You Step up to 10 feet.

_desc_en:
Requirements You aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered} or overburdened.

Trigger You succeed or critically succeed at a Reflex saving throw.

You Step up to 10 feet.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 @link[conditions.encumbered] 과도한 짐을 지고 있지 않아야 합니다.

발동 조건 반사 내성 굴림에서 성공하거나 대성공합니다.

10피트까지 앞으로 나아갑니다.

name: Fling Head

description.value:
You Interact to remove your head, if it isn't already detached, and fling it at an enemy within 30 feet, where it emits a bone-chilling wail before dematerializing and returning to your body. Your target must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. You can affect one additional creature within 20 feet of your original target for each additional action you spend.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and can't reduce their frightened value below 1 while they remain within 30 feet of you.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.

_desc_en:
You Interact to remove your head, if it isn't already detached, and fling it at an enemy within 30 feet, where it emits a bone-chilling wail before dematerializing and returning to your body. Your target must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. You can affect one additional creature within 20 feet of your original target for each additional action you spend.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and can't reduce their frightened value below 1 while they remain within 30 feet of you.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.
_desc_ko:
당신은 상호작용을 통해 (아직 분리되지 않았다면) 자신의 머리를 떼어내어 30피트 이내의 적에게 던집니다. 머리는 뼈를 얼어붙게 하는 비명을 지른 후 실체를 잃고 당신의 몸으로 돌아갑니다. 대상은 당신의 직업 난이도(DC) 또는 주문 난이도(DC) 중 더 높은 쪽에 대해 의지 내성을 시도해야 합니다. 추가 행동을 소모할 때마다 원래 대상으로부터 20피트 이내의 생물 한 마리씩 추가로 영향을 줄 수 있다.

대성공 해당 생물은 영향을 받지 않는다.

성공 생물은 @link[conditions.frightened]{1} 상태가 된다.

실패 해당 생물은 @link[conditions.frightened]{2} 상태가 되며, 당신으로부터 30피트 이내에 머무는 동안 공포 수치를 1 이하로 낮출 수 없습니다.

대실패 실패와 동일하나, 해당 생물은 @link[conditions.frightened]{3} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Alchemical Familiar

description.value: You have used alchemy to create life, a simple creature formed from alchemical materials, reagents, and a bit of your own blood. You gain a familiar, which has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.5eqcXtPsYunphMOZ]{Construct} familiar ability; this is permanent, doesn't require the familiar to have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.Le8UWr5BU8rV3iBf]{Tough} familiar ability, and doesn't count against your usual limit of familiar abilities (typically 2). The familiar uses your Intelligence modifier to determine its Perception, Acrobatics, and Stealth modifiers.

_desc_en: You have used alchemy to create life, a simple creature formed from alchemical materials, reagents, and a bit of your own blood. You gain a familiar, which has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.5eqcXtPsYunphMOZ]{Construct} familiar ability; this is permanent, doesn't require the familiar to have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.Le8UWr5BU8rV3iBf]{Tough} familiar ability, and doesn't count against your usual limit of familiar abilities (typically 2). The familiar uses your Intelligence modifier to determine its Perception, Acrobatics, and Stealth modifiers.
_desc_ko: 당신은 연금술로 생명을 창조했습니다. 연금술 재료, 시약, 그리고 당신의 피 일부로 만들어진 단순한 생명체입니다. 당신은 @link[actions.construct] 패밀리어 능력을 가진 패밀리어를 얻습니다. 이 능력은 영구적이며, 패밀리어가 @link[actions.tough] 패밀리어 능력을 가질 필요가 없으며, 일반적인 패밀리어 능력 제한(보통 2개)에 포함되지 않습니다. 이 패밀리어는 당신의 지능 능력치 수정자를 사용하여 지각, 곡예, 은신 능력치 수정자를 결정합니다.

name: Unexpected Sharpshooter Dedication

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Who needs skill when you've got dumb luck? Sometimes your shots hit miraculously, regardless of the fact that you seemed to slip when you pulled the trigger or that you weren't aiming at your foe when you fired. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.FzZAYGib08aEq5P2]{Accidental Shot} activity.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.nVfhX1aisz6jY8qf]{Unexpected Sharpshooter}

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Who needs skill when you've got dumb luck? Sometimes your shots hit miraculously, regardless of the fact that you seemed to slip when you pulled the trigger or that you weren't aiming at your foe when you fired. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.FzZAYGib08aEq5P2]{Accidental Shot} activity.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.nVfhX1aisz6jY8qf]{Unexpected Sharpshooter}
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

기술이 필요할 때, 운이 따라준다면? 때로는 방아쇠를 당길 때 미끄러진 것 같거나 적을 겨냥하지 않았음에도 기적처럼 명중하는 경우가 있다. @link[actions.accidental-shot] 능력을 얻는다.

name: Bloodletting Claws

description.value: Your eidolon inflicts bleeding wounds on a telling blow. If your eidolon critically hits with a melee unarmed Strike that deals slashing or piercing damage, its target takes @Damage[1d6[bleed]]. Your eidolon gains an item bonus to this bleed damage equal to the unarmed attack's item bonus to attack rolls. This is a critical specialization effect.

_desc_en: Your eidolon inflicts bleeding wounds on a telling blow. If your eidolon critically hits with a melee unarmed Strike that deals slashing or piercing damage, its target takes @Damage[1d6[bleed]]. Your eidolon gains an item bonus to this bleed damage equal to the unarmed attack's item bonus to attack rolls. This is a critical specialization effect.
_desc_ko: 당신의 에이돌론은 결정적인 일격으로 출혈 상처를 입힙니다. 에이돌론이 베기 또는 관통 피해를 주는 근접 비무장 공격으로 치명타를 성공시키면, 대상은 1d6 출혈의 출혈 피해를 입습니다. 당신의 에이돌론은 이 출혈 피해에 대해 비무장 공격의 명중 굴림에 적용되는 아이템 보너스와 동일한 아이템 보너스를 얻습니다. 이는 치명타 특화 효과입니다.

name: Flood Stance

description.value: The lessons of the flood teach a stance that distributes and circulates a single breath through the body and allows your punches to contain the focused power of a torrent of water. While in this stance, you hold your breath for up to 10 minutes and leave the stance if you stop holding your breath. You do not lose additional air if you attack, are critically hit, or critically fail a save. You still lose all remaining air if you speak, including to Cast a Spell. The only Strikes you can make are flooded river unarmed attacks. These deal 1d8 bludgeoning damage; are in the brawling group; have the nonlethal, trip, unarmed, and water traits; and don't take the normal penalty for being used underwater. They also gain the forceful trait while you're underwater.

_desc_en: The lessons of the flood teach a stance that distributes and circulates a single breath through the body and allows your punches to contain the focused power of a torrent of water. While in this stance, you hold your breath for up to 10 minutes and leave the stance if you stop holding your breath. You do not lose additional air if you attack, are critically hit, or critically fail a save. You still lose all remaining air if you speak, including to Cast a Spell. The only Strikes you can make are flooded river unarmed attacks. These deal 1d8 bludgeoning damage; are in the brawling group; have the nonlethal, trip, unarmed, and water traits; and don't take the normal penalty for being used underwater. They also gain the forceful trait while you're underwater.
_desc_ko: 홍수의 교훈은 단일 호흡을 몸에 분배하고 순환시키는 자세를 가르치며, 당신의 주먹이 물줄기의 포커스된 힘을 담을 수 있게 합니다. 이 자세를 취하는 동안 최대 10분 동안 숨을 참으며, 숨을 참는 것을 멈추면 자세를 해제합니다. 공격하거나 치명타를 당하거나 내성 굴림에서 대실패를 해도 추가로 숨을 잃지 않습니다. 하지만 말을 하거나 주문을 시전하는 경우 포함해 말을 하면 남은 숨을 모두 잃습니다. 사용 가능한 공격은 홍수 강 비무장 공격뿐이다. 이 공격은 1d8 타격 피해를 입히며, 난투 그룹에 속하고, 비살상, 넘어뜨리기, 비무장, 물 속성 특성을 가지며, 수중 사용 시 일반적인 페널티를 받지 않는다. 또한 수중에서는 기세 특성도 얻는다.

name: Ponpoko

description.value: No true tanuki would ever be caught without a musical instrument to play under the full moon. You can attempt Performance checks and cast spells by drumming on your belly; this requires that you have at least one hand free, and like playing an instrument, it grants the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EEDElIyin4z60PXx]{Perform} action the auditory and manipulate traits. When Casting a Spell, your gestures can include drumming your belly. If you do, any attempt to recognize a spell cast this way gains a -2 circumstance penalty.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: No true tanuki would ever be caught without a musical instrument to play under the full moon. You can attempt Performance checks and cast spells by drumming on your belly; this requires that you have at least one hand free, and like playing an instrument, it grants the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EEDElIyin4z60PXx]{Perform} action the auditory and manipulate traits. When Casting a Spell, your gestures can include drumming your belly. If you do, any attempt to recognize a spell cast this way gains a -2 circumstance penalty.
_desc_ko: 진정한 타누키라면 보름달 아래에서 연주할 악기 없이 잡히는 일은 결코 없다. 배를 두드리며 공연 판정나 주문 시전을 시도할 수 있다. 이를 위해서는 최소한 한 손이 자유로워야 하며, 악기 연주와 마찬가지로 @link[actions.perform] 행동에 청각 및 조작 특성을 부여한다. 주문 시전 시 제스처에 배 두드리기를 포함할 수 있다. 이 경우, 이 방식으로 시전된 주문을 인식하려는 시도는 -2 상황 페널티를 받는다.

name: Smokesoul

description.value: You have a connection to smoke and haze. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pTHMZLqWDJ3lkan9]{Smoke Blending} reaction.

_desc_en: You have a connection to smoke and haze. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pTHMZLqWDJ3lkan9]{Smoke Blending} reaction.
_desc_ko: 당신은 연기나 안개와 특별한 연결고리를 지닙니다. @link[actions.smoke-blending] 반응을 획득합니다.

name: Advanced Synergy

description.value:
You gain one summoner feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your summoner level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another summoner feat.

_desc_en:
You gain one summoner feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your summoner level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another summoner feat.
_desc_ko:
소환사 피트 하나를 얻습니다. 이 피트의 전제 조건을 충족하기 위한 목적으로, 당신의 소환사 레벨은 캐릭터 레벨의 절반과 동일합니다.

특수 이 재주를 여러 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 선택할 때마다 소환사 피트 하나를 추가로 얻습니다.

name: Summon Earth Elemental

description.value: You have a connection to the Inner Sphere, allowing you to summon an elemental ally. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lpT6LotUaQPfinjj]{Summon Elemental} as a 5th-rank primal innate spell, but the elemental summoned must be an earth elemental.

_desc_en: You have a connection to the Inner Sphere, allowing you to summon an elemental ally. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lpT6LotUaQPfinjj]{Summon Elemental} as a 5th-rank primal innate spell, but the elemental summoned must be an earth elemental.
_desc_ko: 당신은 내적 영역과 연결되어 있어 원소 동료를 소환할 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, @link[spells.summon-elemental]를 (5th)랭크 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있으나, 소환된 원소는 반드시 대지 원소여야 합니다.

name: Unwavering Guide

description.value: Sharp-eyed and sure-footed, your presence is a boon to those you guide. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{Scout}, you grant your party a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls instead of the normal +1. When your group uses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JuqmIAnkL9hVGai8]{Hustle} activity, they can use your Constitution modifier to determine how fast the group can Hustle together, even if it isn't the lowest in the group.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Sharp-eyed and sure-footed, your presence is a boon to those you guide. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{Scout}, you grant your party a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls instead of the normal +1. When your group uses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JuqmIAnkL9hVGai8]{Hustle} activity, they can use your Constitution modifier to determine how fast the group can Hustle together, even if it isn't the lowest in the group.
_desc_ko: 예리한 시력과 확고한 발걸음으로, 당신의 존재는 이끄는 이들에게 큰 도움이 됩니다. 당신이 @link[actions.scout]할 때, 파티는 이니셔티브 굴림에 일반적인 +1 대신 +2 상황 보너스를 받습니다. 당신의 파티가 @link[actions.hustle] 행동을 사용할 때, 파티 내 가장 낮은 건강 수정자가 아니더라도 당신의 건강 수정자를 기준으로 파티의 서두르기 속도를 결정할 수 있습니다.

name: Eldritch Researcher Dedication

description.value:
You gain the ability to cast a single arcane or occult cantrip of your choice (which is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up). If you weren't already, you become trained in that tradition's spell DCs and spell attack rolls with Intelligence as your spellcasting ability.

Regardless of whether you choose an arcane or occult cantrip, you also become an expert in your choice of either Arcana or Occultism. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks you attempt with the chosen skill when Investigating or Identifying Magic.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.JBPXisA4IdXI9gVn]{Eldritch Researcher}

_desc_en:
You gain the ability to cast a single arcane or occult cantrip of your choice (which is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up). If you weren't already, you become trained in that tradition's spell DCs and spell attack rolls with Intelligence as your spellcasting ability.

Regardless of whether you choose an arcane or occult cantrip, you also become an expert in your choice of either Arcana or Occultism. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks you attempt with the chosen skill when Investigating or Identifying Magic.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.JBPXisA4IdXI9gVn]{Eldritch Researcher}
_desc_ko:
선택한 하나의 아케인 또는 오컬트 캔트립을 시전할 수 있는 능력을 얻습니다(해당 캔트립은 레벨의 절반(올림)에 해당하는 마법 랭크으로 강화됩니다). 아직 숙련되지 않았다면, 지능을 마법 시전 능력치로 하여 해당 전통의 마법 난이도(DC)와 마법 명중 굴림에 숙련됩니다.

비전 마법 또는 오컬트 마법 중 어떤 캔트립을 선택하든, 아케인 또는 오컬트 중 하나에 대한 전문가가 됩니다. 또한 마법 조사나 식별 시 선택한 기술로 시도하는 검사에서 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Grave Sight

description.value: Your ability to sense undead has improved. You sense undead as an imprecise sense with a range of 60 feet: an uncomfortable sensation brushes against your spirit and stinks of rot. When in proximity to an undead, you can sense its presence, but it has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} condition instead of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.1wQY3JYyhMYeeV2G]{Observed} condition. An undead using a disguise or otherwise trying to hide its presence must attempt a Deception or Stealth check against your Perception DC to hide its presence from you. If the creature succeeds, it's undetected, and you have to use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} basic action to detect the creature. As with hearing and other imprecise senses, you still need to Seek to locate an undetected creature.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en: Your ability to sense undead has improved. You sense undead as an imprecise sense with a range of 60 feet: an uncomfortable sensation brushes against your spirit and stinks of rot. When in proximity to an undead, you can sense its presence, but it has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} condition instead of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.1wQY3JYyhMYeeV2G]{Observed} condition. An undead using a disguise or otherwise trying to hide its presence must attempt a Deception or Stealth check against your Perception DC to hide its presence from you. If the creature succeeds, it's undetected, and you have to use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} basic action to detect the creature. As with hearing and other imprecise senses, you still need to Seek to locate an undetected creature.
_desc_ko: 당신의 언데드 감지 능력이 향상되었습니다. 60피트 범위 내에서 불확실한 감각으로 언데드를 감지합니다: 불쾌한 감각이 당신의 영혼을 스치며 썩은 냄새를 풍깁니다. 언데드 근처에 있을 때 그 존재를 감지할 수 있지만, 해당 언데드는 @link[conditions.observed] 상태 대신 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태를 가집니다. 변장이나 다른 방법으로 존재를 숨기려는 언데드는 당신에게서 존재를 숨기기 위해 당신의 지각 DC에 맞서 기만 또는 은신 판정을 시도해야 합니다. 성공 시 해당 생물은 탐지되지 않은 상태가 되며, 당신은 @link[actions.seek] 기본 행동을 사용해 생물을 탐지해야 합니다. 청각이나 기타 부정확한 감각과 마찬가지로, 탐지되지 않은 생물의 위치를 파악하려면 여전히 탐색이 필요합니다.

name: Advanced Fury

description.value:
You gain one barbarian feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your barbarian level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another barbarian feat.

_desc_en:
You gain one barbarian feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your barbarian level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another barbarian feat.
_desc_ko:
바바리안 재주 하나를 얻습니다. 전제 조건 충족을 위해 바바리안 레벨은 캐릭터 레벨의 절반으로 간주됩니다.

특수 이 재주를 여러 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 선택할 때마다 다른 바바리안 피트를 하나 얻습니다.

name: Iivlar's Deflection

description.value:
Trigger You are struck by a critical hit that deals physical damage.

You're able to use the silk woven into your skin to deflect attacks, reducing the deadliness of grievous blows. Attempt a @Check[flat|dc:17|showDC:all]. If you are successful, the attack becomes a normal hit.

_desc_en:
Trigger You are struck by a critical hit that deals physical damage.

You're able to use the silk woven into your skin to deflect attacks, reducing the deadliness of grievous blows. Attempt a @Check[flat|dc:17|showDC:all]. If you are successful, the attack becomes a normal hit.
_desc_ko:
발동조건 물리 피해를 입히는 치명타를 맞았다.

피부에 짜여진 비단을 이용해 공격을 회피할 수 있어 치명적인 타격의 위력을 줄입니다. DC 17 단순을 시도하세요. 성공하면 공격은 일반 타격으로 바뀝니다.

name: Runescarred Dedication

description.value:
Access You are from the Saga Lands.

Whether through blood (if you're Varisian, Shoanti, or New Thassilonian) or by exposure to rune magic, you have become runescarred, with visible, glowing runes on your body in the form of tattoos or scars. You might have possessed these marks before gaining the archetype, but you only truly became runescarred when you chose to study and tap into the runes' power. You become an expert in Arcana and you also become trained in Thassilon Lore, or an expert in Thassilon Lore if you were already trained in it.

Choose one cantrip from the arcane list. One of the runes on your body corresponds to the chosen cantrip, and you can cast the chosen cantrip as an innate arcane spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.j5uZbCwoHOOEO1bC]{Runescarred}

_desc_en:
Access You are from the Saga Lands.

Whether through blood (if you're Varisian, Shoanti, or New Thassilonian) or by exposure to rune magic, you have become runescarred, with visible, glowing runes on your body in the form of tattoos or scars. You might have possessed these marks before gaining the archetype, but you only truly became runescarred when you chose to study and tap into the runes' power. You become an expert in Arcana and you also become trained in Thassilon Lore, or an expert in Thassilon Lore if you were already trained in it.

Choose one cantrip from the arcane list. One of the runes on your body corresponds to the chosen cantrip, and you can cast the chosen cantrip as an innate arcane spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.j5uZbCwoHOOEO1bC]{Runescarred}
_desc_ko:
접근 당신은 사가 랜드 출신입니다.

혈통(바리시안, 쇼안티, 뉴 타실리온인인 경우)이나 룬 마법에 노출되어, 문신이나 상처 형태로 몸에 빛나는 룬이 새겨진 룬스카드가 되었습니다. 아키타입을 얻기 전에도 이러한 표식을 지녔을 수 있지만, 룬의 힘을 연구하고 활용하기로 선택했을 때 비로소 진정한 룬스카드가 되었습니다. 당신은 주문학에 정통하게 되며, 타실론 지식에 숙련되거나, 이미 숙련된 경우 전문가 수준이 됩니다.

비전 목록에서 한 가지 캔트립을 선택한다. 몸에 새겨진 룬 중 하나가 선택한 캔트립과 대응되며, 선택한 캔트립을 타고난 아케인 주문으로 시전할 수 있다.

name: Gigavolt

description.value: When you unleash electricity from your innovation, you can bounce it off obstacles, creating a field of electric death. When you use Megavolt, each time your line of electricity hits a solid barrier, such as a wall, it bounces off at an angle of your choice and continues until you have reached the full length of the line. Even if a creature is in the area from multiple bounces, it takes the damage only once.

_desc_en: When you unleash electricity from your innovation, you can bounce it off obstacles, creating a field of electric death. When you use Megavolt, each time your line of electricity hits a solid barrier, such as a wall, it bounces off at an angle of your choice and continues until you have reached the full length of the line. Even if a creature is in the area from multiple bounces, it takes the damage only once.
_desc_ko: 혁신에서 전기를 방출할 때, 장애물에 반사시켜 치명적인 전기 장을 생성할 수 있습니다. 메가볼트를 사용할 때, 전류가 벽과 같은 단단한 장벽에 닿을 때마다 선택한 각도로 반사되어 전류의 전체 길이에 도달할 때까지 계속됩니다. 여러 번 반사된 영역에 생물이 있더라도 피해는 한 번만 받습니다.

name: Traditional Resistances

description.value: Due to your blood, you have some resistance to certain types of magic. You gain a +1 status bonus to AC and saves against spells and other magical effects from the same tradition as your lineage. This bonus increases to +2 against sleep and paralysis effects.

value.value: Arcane Dragonblood, Divine Dragonblood, Occult Dragonblood, or Primal Dragonblood

_desc_en: Due to your blood, you have some resistance to certain types of magic. You gain a +1 status bonus to AC and saves against spells and other magical effects from the same tradition as your lineage. This bonus increases to +2 against sleep and paralysis effects.
_desc_ko: 혈통 덕분에 특정 마법 유형에 대한 저항력을 지녔습니다. 혈통과 동일한 전통의 주문 및 마법 효과에 대해 방어력(AC)과 내성에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 수면 및 마비 효과에 대해서는 이 보너스가 +2로 증가합니다.

name: Stalwart Mind

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a Will save.

When necessary to avoid a magical compulsion or curse, you can be as stubborn as your megafauna companion. Attempt a new Will save against the triggering effect.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a Will save.

When necessary to avoid a magical compulsion or curse, you can be as stubborn as your megafauna companion. Attempt a new Will save against the triggering effect.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 의지 내성에 실패할 때.

마법적 강요나 저주를 피하기 위해 필요한 경우, 당신은 거대동물 동반자만큼 고집스러울 수 있습니다. 유발 효과에 대해 새로운 의지 내성을 시도하십시오.

name: Cooperative Nature

description.value: The short human life span lends perspective and has taught you from a young age to set aside differences and work with others to achieve greatness. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus on checks to Aid.

_desc_en: The short human life span lends perspective and has taught you from a young age to set aside differences and work with others to achieve greatness. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus on checks to Aid.
_desc_ko: 짧은 인간의 수명은 관점을 제공하며, 어릴 때부터 차이를 접어두고 위대함을 이루기 위해 타인과 협력하는 법을 가르쳐 주었습니다. 지원 판정 시 +4 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Wash Out

description.value: Toxins seep out of your artificial body quickly. Each time you succeed at a Fortitude save against an ongoing poison, you reduce its stage by 2, or by 1 against a virulent poison. Each critical success you achieve against an ongoing poison reduces its stage by 3, or by 2 against a virulent poison.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en: Toxins seep out of your artificial body quickly. Each time you succeed at a Fortitude save against an ongoing poison, you reduce its stage by 2, or by 1 against a virulent poison. Each critical success you achieve against an ongoing poison reduces its stage by 3, or by 2 against a virulent poison.
_desc_ko: 독소가 인공 신체에서 빠르게 빠져나갑니다. 지속 중독에 대한 인내 내성에 성공할 때마다 중독 단계를 2단계 낮추며, 치명적 중독의 경우 1단계 낮춥니다. 지속 중독에 대한 저항에서 대성공을 거둘 때마다 중독 단계를 3단계 낮추며, 치명적 중독의 경우 2단계 낮춥니다.

name: Expert Beast Gunner Spellcasting

description.value: You've learned the deeper secrets of beast guns, making you an expert in the magic they grant you. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{expert spellcasting benefits}.

value.value: Basic Beast Gunner Spellcasting or Basic Wizard Spellcasting

_desc_en: You've learned the deeper secrets of beast guns, making you an expert in the magic they grant you. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{expert spellcasting benefits}.
_desc_ko: 야수 총의 깊은 비밀을 터득하여, 그로부터 부여받는 마법에 대한 전문가가 되었습니다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{전문 주문 시전 혜택}을 얻습니다.

name: Spirit Warrior Dedication

description.value:
Access Tian Xia origin

You're a warrior who trains your spirit and body to work in perfect harmony, enhancing your attacks with your spiritual energy while fighting with a ferocious martial technique that combines blade and fist.

The damage die for your fist changes to 1d6 instead of 1d4, and your fist gains the parry trait. You don't take the normal –2 circumstance penalty when making a lethal attack with your fist or any other unarmed attacks. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.zUWj4zmBNWOTzeFJ]{Overwhelming Combination} action.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.bT2NuSZ1h02PFhpJ]{Spirit Warrior}

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

Access Tian Xia origin
