_desc_ko:
접근 티엔 샤 기원

당신은 영혼과 육체를 완벽한 조화로 단련하는 전사로, 검과 주먹을 결합한 맹렬한 무술 기술로 싸우면서 영적 에너지로 공격을 강화합니다.

주먹의 피해 주사위가 1d4에서 1d6으로 변경되며, 주먹에 패리 특성이 부여됩니다. 주먹이나 기타 비무장 공격으로 치명타를 가할 때 일반적인 -2 상황 페널티를 받지 않습니다. @link[actions.overwhelming-combination] 액션을 획득합니다.

name: Loremaster Dedication

description.value:
You've compiled a vast repository of information that touches on nearly every subject. You are trained in Loremaster Lore, a special Lore skill that can be used only to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, but on any topic.

If you have legendary proficiency in a skill used to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing}, you gain expert proficiency in Loremaster Lore, but you can't increase your proficiency rank in Loremaster Lore by any other means.

You can take feats in the loremaster's additional feats entry even if you don't meet the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.4ripp6EfdVpS0d60]{Enigma Muse} prerequisite.

If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.uVXEZblPRuCyPRua]{Bardic Lore} class feat, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to skill checks with Bardic Lore.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.ackdHdIAmSb0AiVL]{Loremaster}

value.value: trained in at least one skill to Decipher Writing

_desc_en:
You've compiled a vast repository of information that touches on nearly every subject. You are trained in Loremaster Lore, a special Lore skill that can be used only to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, but on any topic.

If you have legendary proficiency in a skill used to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing}, you gain expert proficiency in Loremaster Lore, but you can't increase your proficiency rank in Loremaster Lore by any other means.

You can take feats in the loremaster's additional feats entry even if you don't meet the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.4ripp6EfdVpS0d60]{Enigma Muse} prerequisite.

If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.uVXEZblPRuCyPRua]{Bardic Lore} class feat, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to skill checks with Bardic Lore.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.ackdHdIAmSb0AiVL]{Loremaster}
_desc_ko:
당신은 거의 모든 주제를 아우르는 방대한 정보 저장고를 구축했습니다. 당신은 로어마스터 지식라는 특수 지식 기술을 숙련했으며, 이는 @link[actions.recall-knowledge]에만 사용할 수 있지만, 어떤 주제든 가능합니다.

{문자 해독}에 사용되는 기술에 전설적 숙련도를 보유한 경우, 로어마스터 지식에 전문가 숙련도를 얻습니다. 다만 다른 방법으로 로어마스터 지식 숙련도 등급을 올릴 수는 없습니다.

@link[feats.enigma] 전제 조건을 충족하지 않더라도, 로어마스터의 추가 피트 항목에 있는 피트를 선택할 수 있습니다.

@link[feats.bardic-lore] 클래스 피트를 보유한 경우, 바드 지식 관련 기술 판정 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Hallowed Initiate

description.value:
You've expanded your focus spellcasting to techniques used by clerics and wizards. You gain an additional focus spell, either the necromancer school spell @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.BH3sUerzMb2bWnv1]{Call of the Grave} or the initial domain spell of the death domain, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HG4afO9EOGEU9bZN]{Death's Call}. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.

Special You can select this feat a second time, choosing the other initial focus spell.

_desc_en:
You've expanded your focus spellcasting to techniques used by clerics and wizards. You gain an additional focus spell, either the necromancer school spell @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.BH3sUerzMb2bWnv1]{Call of the Grave} or the initial domain spell of the death domain, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HG4afO9EOGEU9bZN]{Death's Call}. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.

Special You can select this feat a second time, choosing the other initial focus spell.
_desc_ko:
당신은 포커스 마법 시전 범위를 클레릭과 위자드가 사용하는 기술로 확장했습니다. 추가 포커스 주문을 획득한다. 네크로맨서 학파 포커스 주문 @link[spells.call-of-the-grave] 또는 죽음 도메인의 초기 도메인 주문 @link[spells.deaths-call] 중 하나를 선택한다. 포커스 풀의 집중 포인트 수를 1 증가시킨다.

특수 이 피트를 두 번째로 선택할 수 있으며, 이때 다른 초기 포커스 주문할 수 있습니다.

name: Canopy Predator

description.value: You are as at home in the treetops as you are beneath their branches. You gain a climb Speed of 15 feet when moving through trees, vines, and other foliage. Whenever you succeed at an Athletics check to Climb a tree or an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} on a branch, you get a critical success instead. You aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while Climbing or Balancing on a tree.

_desc_en: You are as at home in the treetops as you are beneath their branches. You gain a climb Speed of 15 feet when moving through trees, vines, and other foliage. Whenever you succeed at an Athletics check to Climb a tree or an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} on a branch, you get a critical success instead. You aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while Climbing or Balancing on a tree.
_desc_ko: 당신은 나무 가지 아래에서처럼 나무 꼭대기에서도 편안함을 느낍니다. 나무, 덩굴, 기타 잎사귀 사이를 이동할 때 15피트의 등반 속도를 얻습니다. 나무를 오르기 위한 운동 판정나 가지 위에서 @link[actions.balance]를 위한 곡예 판정에서 성공할 때마다, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다. 나무를 오르거나 가지 위에서 균형을 잡는 동안 @link[conditions.off-guard]가 되지 않습니다.

name: Swift Paragon

description.value:
The movement of you and your allies is swift and decisive as the judgment of your deity. If your ally starts a move action in your champion's aura, their movement during that action doesn't trigger reactions.

In addition, you're permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}. You can use your extra action only to Step or Stride. If you have a fly Speed, add Fly to this list. If you have an animal companion and are mounted on it at the start of your turn, you can have your mount be quickened that turn instead of you.

_desc_en:
The movement of you and your allies is swift and decisive as the judgment of your deity. If your ally starts a move action in your champion's aura, their movement during that action doesn't trigger reactions.

In addition, you're permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}. You can use your extra action only to Step or Stride. If you have a fly Speed, add Fly to this list. If you have an animal companion and are mounted on it at the start of your turn, you can have your mount be quickened that turn instead of you.
_desc_ko:
당신과 아군의 움직임은 신의 심판처럼 신속하고 단호합니다. 아군이 당신의 챔피언 오라 내에서 이동 행동을 시작하면, 해당 행동 중의 이동은 반응을 유발하지 않습니다.

또한 당신은 영구적으로 @link[conditions.quickened] 상태가 됩니다. 추가 행동은 오직 '{신중한 발걸음}' 또는 '이동'에만 사용할 수 있습니다. 비행 이동 속도를 가진 경우, 이 목록에 '비행'을 추가하십시오. 동물 동료가 있고 당신의 턴 시작 시 그 위에 타고 있다면, 그 턴 동안 당신 대신 당신의 탈것을 가속 상태로 만들 수 있습니다.

name: Blood Must Have Blood

description.value: You tap into a bottomless hunger for carnage. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TaaMEYdZXQXF0Sks]{Blood Vendetta} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.d7Lwx6KAs47MtF0q]{Share Life} as 2nd-rank primal spells, each once per day.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You tap into a bottomless hunger for carnage. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TaaMEYdZXQXF0Sks]{Blood Vendetta} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.d7Lwx6KAs47MtF0q]{Share Life} as 2nd-rank primal spells, each once per day.
_desc_ko: 당신은 끝없는 살육에 대한 갈망을 끌어올립니다. @link[spells.blood-vendetta]와 @link[spells.share-life]를 (2nd)랭크 프라이멀 마법으로 하루에 각각 한 번씩 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Follow-Up Strike

description.value:
Requirements Your last action was a missed Strike with a melee unarmed attack.

You have trained rigorously to use all parts of your body as a weapon, and when you miss with an attack, you can usually continue the attack with a different body part and still deal damage. Make another Strike with a melee unarmed attack, using the same multiple attack penalty as the missed Strike, if any.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your last action was a missed Strike with a melee unarmed attack.

You have trained rigorously to use all parts of your body as a weapon, and when you miss with an attack, you can usually continue the attack with a different body part and still deal damage. Make another Strike with a melee unarmed attack, using the same multiple attack penalty as the missed Strike, if any.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 마지막 행동이 근접 비무장 공격으로 실패한 타격이었을 때.

당신은 신체의 모든 부위를 무기로 활용하기 위해 혹독하게 훈련해왔으며, 공격을 빗나갔을 때도 보통 다른 신체 부위로 공격을 이어가며 여전히 피해를 입힐 수 있습니다. 실패한 공격과 동일한 다중 공격 페널티(있는 경우)를 적용하여 근접 무기 없는 공격으로 또 다른 공격을 수행하십시오.

name: Perfume Cloud

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You issue a cloud of your fragrance like a full-body sneeze—but one that might save your life as the powerful perfume makes your attackers' eyes sting and water. Plants and fungi are immune to this effect, but all other creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC (whichever is higher) with the following results.

Critical Success No effect.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is dazzled and can see only 10 feet away for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

You issue a cloud of your fragrance like a full-body sneeze—but one that might save your life as the powerful perfume makes your attackers' eyes sting and water. Plants and fungi are immune to this effect, but all other creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC (whichever is higher) with the following results.

Critical Success No effect.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is dazzled and can see only 10 feet away for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.
_desc_ko:
발생 빈도 시간당 1회

당신은 온몸을 흔드는 재채기처럼 향기로운 구름을 내뿜습니다. 이 강력한 향수는 공격자의 눈을 따갑게 하고 눈물을 흘리게 하여 생명을 구할 수도 있습니다. 식물과 균류는 이 효과에 면역이지만, 10피트 내의 다른 모든 생물은 당신의 클래스 DC 또는 주문 DC(둘 중 높은 쪽)에 대한 인내 내성을 시도해야 하며, 결과는 다음과 같습니다.

대성공 효과 없음.

성공 해당 생물은 @link[conditions.dazzled] 상태가 1라운드 동안 지속됩니다.

실패 생물은 눈부심으로 인해 1라운드 동안 10피트 밖을 볼 수 없습니다.

대실패 생물은 @link[conditions.blinded] 상태가 되어 1라운드 동안 시야를 잃습니다.

name: Inked Panoply

description.value:
Trigger A creature targets you with an attack, and you can see the attacker.

Your tattoos can briefly animate and extend from your skin, granting you a spectral shield-bearer who protects you from harm. Doing so expends one use of your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.OOcgMpqQzk22n6rl]{Storied Skin}, granting you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. In addition, you gain resistance to mental, spirit, and void damage equal to twice your number of tattooed historian feats against the triggering attack.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature targets you with an attack, and you can see the attacker.

Your tattoos can briefly animate and extend from your skin, granting you a spectral shield-bearer who protects you from harm. Doing so expends one use of your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.OOcgMpqQzk22n6rl]{Storied Skin}, granting you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. In addition, you gain resistance to mental, spirit, and void damage equal to twice your number of tattooed historian feats against the triggering attack.
_desc_ko:
발동 생물이 당신을 공격 대상으로 삼고, 당신이 공격자를 볼 수 있을 때.

네 문신이 잠시 움직이며 피부에서 뻗어나와, 너를 해로부터 보호하는 유령 방패병을 부여한다. 이를 사용하면 전설의 피부 능력 1회분을 소모하며, 발동 공격에 대해 AC에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻는다. 또한 발동 공격에 대해 문신 역사가 재주 수의 두 배에 해당하는 정신, 영혼, 공허 피해에 대한 저항력을 얻는다.

name: Garuda's Squall

description.value: Garudas' marksmanship and magic are second nature to you. Whenever you critically hit using a bow, you apply the weapon's critical specialization effect.

_desc_en: Garudas' marksmanship and magic are second nature to you. Whenever you critically hit using a bow, you apply the weapon's critical specialization effect.
_desc_ko: 가루다의 명사술과 마법은 당신에게 제2의 본능과도 같습니다. 활을 사용해 치명타를 기록할 때마다, 해당 무기의 치명타 특화 효과를 적용합니다.

name: Hedge Maze

description.value:
You sculpt a manicured maze of hedges. Up to 10 hedges spring from the ground where you choose in a 30-foot-square area within 120 feet. Each is 10 feet long, 5 feet wide, and 15 feet tall. The hedges grant standard cover, are difficult terrain, and have a Climb DC of 15. They last until the end of your next turn, and you can Sustain the impulse up to 1 minute.

You can spend 10 minutes using this impulse as an exploration activity to instead create a cozy cabin with hedges for walls. It lasts for 12 hours, but ends if you use the impulse again.

_desc_en:
You sculpt a manicured maze of hedges. Up to 10 hedges spring from the ground where you choose in a 30-foot-square area within 120 feet. Each is 10 feet long, 5 feet wide, and 15 feet tall. The hedges grant standard cover, are difficult terrain, and have a Climb DC of 15. They last until the end of your next turn, and you can Sustain the impulse up to 1 minute.

You can spend 10 minutes using this impulse as an exploration activity to instead create a cozy cabin with hedges for walls. It lasts for 12 hours, but ends if you use the impulse again.
_desc_ko:
당신은 정교하게 다듬어진 덤불 미로를 만들어 냅니다. 120피트 이내의 30피트 칸 영역에서 선택한 지점에서 최대 10개의 덤불이 땅에서 솟아납니다. 각 덤불은 길이 10피트, 너비 5피트, 높이 15피트이다. 이 덤불들은 엄폐를 제공하며, 어려운 지형이고, 등반 DC 15를 가진다. 이들은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 지속되며, 최대 1분 동안 임펄스를 지속할 수 있다.

이 임펄스를 탐사 활동으로 10분간 사용하면 대신 울타리로 벽을 만든 아늑한 오두막을 생성할 수 있습니다. 12시간 동안 지속되나, 임펄스를 다시 사용하면 종료됩니다.

name: Miracle Worker

description.value:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

Your alchemical mastery can resuscitate the recently slain. You can administer a major or true elixir of life to a creature who has been dead for no more than 2 rounds. When you do, that creature is immediately returned to life with 1 Hit Point and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded 1}.

_desc_en:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

Your alchemical mastery can resuscitate the recently slain. You can administer a major or true elixir of life to a creature who has been dead for no more than 2 rounds. When you do, that creature is immediately returned to life with 1 Hit Point and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded 1}.
_desc_ko:
발동 주기 10분마다 한 번

당신의 연금술 숙련도는 최근에 살해된 자를 되살릴 수 있습니다. 당신은 죽은 지 2라운드 이내인 생물에게 상급의 생명의 비약이나 최상급의 생명의 비약을 투여할 수 있습니다. 그렇게 하면 해당 생물은 즉시 1의 HP로 되살아나며 @link[conditions.wounded]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Animal Trainer Dedication

description.value:
You gain the services of a young animal companion that travels with you and obeys simple commands as best as it can. This trained animal is trained in Performance instead of the skill listed for its type.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.bL5cccuvnP5h7Bnn]{Animal Trainer}

publication.title: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God

_desc_en:
You gain the services of a young animal companion that travels with you and obeys simple commands as best as it can. This trained animal is trained in Performance instead of the skill listed for its type.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.bL5cccuvnP5h7Bnn]{Animal Trainer}
_desc_ko: 당신은 함께 여행하며 간단한 명령을 최선을 다해 따르는 어린 동물 동료의 도움을 받습니다. 이 훈련된 동물은 종족에 따라 지정된 기술 대신 공연에 훈련되어 있습니다.

name: Sense Allies

description.value: Like many humans raised in a close-knit community, you have always been strongly attuned to the presence of others. Willing allies that you are aware of within 60 feet that would otherwise be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} by you are instead @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from you. The flat check for you to target willing allies within 60 feet that are hidden from you is @Check[flat|showDC:all|dc:5] instead of 11.

_desc_en: Like many humans raised in a close-knit community, you have always been strongly attuned to the presence of others. Willing allies that you are aware of within 60 feet that would otherwise be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} by you are instead @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from you. The flat check for you to target willing allies within 60 feet that are hidden from you is @Check[flat|showDC:all|dc:5] instead of 11.
_desc_ko: 밀접한 공동체에서 자란 많은 인간들처럼, 당신은 항상 타인의 존재에 예민하게 반응해 왔습니다. 60피트 이내에 있는 당신이 인지하는 의지하는 동맹들은, 그렇지 않으면 @link[conditions.undetected] 존재들이지만, 대신 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태로 인식됩니다. 60피트 내 은폐된 의지하는 동맹을 대상으로 하는 단순 판정 수치는 11이 아닌 DC 5 단순입니다.

name: Cunning Tinker

description.value: Time spent tending to your own form has unlocked your ability to fix other things. You can cast 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dINQzhqGmIsqGMUY]{Mending} once per day as an arcane innate spell. At 7th level, the spell is heightened to 2nd rank, and every 3 levels thereafter, the spell is heightened an additional spell rank. Even though you're alive and not an object, and you can't normally recover Hit Points from effects that repair objects (like the Repair skill), you can target yourself with this innate spell and use it to recover Hit Points.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en: Time spent tending to your own form has unlocked your ability to fix other things. You can cast 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dINQzhqGmIsqGMUY]{Mending} once per day as an arcane innate spell. At 7th level, the spell is heightened to 2nd rank, and every 3 levels thereafter, the spell is heightened an additional spell rank. Even though you're alive and not an object, and you can't normally recover Hit Points from effects that repair objects (like the Repair skill), you can target yourself with this innate spell and use it to recover Hit Points.
_desc_ko: 자신의 형태를 돌보는 데 쏟은 시간이 다른 것들을 고칠 수 있는 능력을 열어주었다. 하루에 한 번, 1랭크 @link[spells.mending]을 아케인 내재 주문으로 시전할 수 있다. (7th)레벨에 도달하면 이 주문은 2nd 랭크으로 강화되며, 이후 3레벨마다 추가로 1랭크씩 강화됩니다. 비록 당신이 살아있는 존재이고 물체가 아니며, 일반적으로 물체를 수리하는 효과(예: 수리 기술)로 HP를 회복할 수 없지만, 이 선천적 주문을 자신에게 시전하여 HP를 회복할 수 있습니다.

name: Rugged Survivalist

description.value: You've studied survival skills with the School of Swords experts and are comfortable spending long periods of time in the wilderness. You don't get fatigued more quickly due to precipitation during overland travel, though you can otherwise be fatigued as normal. You can go 3 days + your Constitution modifier without water before you take damage from thirst and you can go 5 days + your Constitution modifier without food before you take damage from starvation.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en: You've studied survival skills with the School of Swords experts and are comfortable spending long periods of time in the wilderness. You don't get fatigued more quickly due to precipitation during overland travel, though you can otherwise be fatigued as normal. You can go 3 days + your Constitution modifier without water before you take damage from thirst and you can go 5 days + your Constitution modifier without food before you take damage from starvation.
_desc_ko: 당신은 검술 학교의 전문가들과 생존 기술을 연마하여 오랫동안 야생에서 지내는 데 익숙합니다. 육로 이동 중 강수량으로 인해 피로도가 더 빨리 증가하지 않지만, 그 외에는 정상적으로 피로해질 수 있습니다. 갈증으로 인한 피해를 입기 전까지 물 없이 3일 + 건강 수정자를 버틸 수 있으며, 굶주림으로 인한 피해를 입기 전까지 음식 없이 5일 + 건강 수정자를 버틸 수 있습니다.

name: Ancestral Paragon

description.value: Whether through instinct, study, or magic, you feel a deeper connection to your ancestry. You gain a 1st-level ancestry feat.

_desc_en: Whether through instinct, study, or magic, you feel a deeper connection to your ancestry. You gain a 1st-level ancestry feat.
_desc_ko: 본능, 연구, 마법 등을 통해 조상과의 깊은 유대감을 느낍니다. 1레벨 조상 피트를 획득합니다.

name: Chastise

description.value:
With but a mere word from your deity, you exploit a foe's fear to see their inner being brought low. You chastise the spirit of a foe within 30 feet that has the frightened condition. The target must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. The target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[2[persistent,spirit]] damage. The first time the creature fails their flat check to recover from this, the persistent spirit damage doubles.

Failure The target takes @Damage[4[persistent,spirit]] damage. The first time the creature fails their flat check to recover from this, the persistent spirit damage doubles.

Critical Failure The target takes @Damage[6[persistent,spirit]] damage. The first time the creature fails their flat check to recover from this, the persistent spirit damage doubles.

_desc_en:
With but a mere word from your deity, you exploit a foe's fear to see their inner being brought low. You chastise the spirit of a foe within 30 feet that has the frightened condition. The target must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. The target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[2[persistent,spirit]] damage. The first time the creature fails their flat check to recover from this, the persistent spirit damage doubles.

Failure The target takes @Damage[4[persistent,spirit]] damage. The first time the creature fails their flat check to recover from this, the persistent spirit damage doubles.

Critical Failure The target takes @Damage[6[persistent,spirit]] damage. The first time the creature fails their flat check to recover from this, the persistent spirit damage doubles.
_desc_ko:
신성한 존재의 한 마디만으로도, 당신은 적의 공포를 이용해 그들의 내면을 무너뜨립니다. 공포 상태에 빠진 30피트 내 적의 영혼을 질책한다. 대상은 네 클래스 DC와 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽에 대한 의지 내성 굴림을 시도해야 한다. 성공 시 대상은 1시간 동안 일시적으로 면역 상태가 된다.

대성공 대상은 영향을 받지 않는다.

성공 대상은 2 지속 영혼의 피해를 입습니다. 이 영구적 영혼 피해에서 회복하기 위한 단순 판정에서 처음으로 실패할 경우, 피해량이 두 배로 증가합니다.

실패 대상은 4 지속 영혼의 피해를 입습니다. 이 상태에서 회복을 위한 단순 판정에서 처음으로 실패할 경우, 지속되는 영혼 피해가 두 배로 증가합니다.

대실패 대상은 6 지속 영혼의 피해를 입습니다. 이 상태에서 회복을 위한 고정 단순 판정에서 처음으로 실패할 경우, 지속 영혼 피해가 두 배로 증가합니다.

name: Enchanting Shot

description.value:
With a single whisper carried on the wind, you enchant your ammunition to make a foe more vulnerable to your attacks.

Make a bow or crossbow Strike. On a hit, the target takes an additional 2d6 mental damage. On a critical hit, the target also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}. The mental damage increases to 3d6 if your weapon has a greater striking rune, or to 4d6 if your weapon has a major striking rune.

_desc_en:
With a single whisper carried on the wind, you enchant your ammunition to make a foe more vulnerable to your attacks.

Make a bow or crossbow Strike. On a hit, the target takes an additional 2d6 mental damage. On a critical hit, the target also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}. The mental damage increases to 3d6 if your weapon has a greater striking rune, or to 4d6 if your weapon has a major striking rune.
_desc_ko:
바람에 실린 속삭임 하나로 탄환에 마법을 걸어 적을 당신의 공격에 더 약점으로 만듭니다.

활 또는 석궁 공격을 수행합니다. 명중 시 대상은 추가로 2d6 정신 피해를 입습니다. 치명타 시, 대상은 @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태가 됩니다. 무기에 강타 (중급) 타격 룬이 새겨져 있다면 정신 피해가 3d6로 증가하며, 강타 (상급) 타격 룬이 새겨져 있다면 4d6로 증가합니다. .

name: Lesson of Mutual Gambits

description.value:
Requirements Your last action was a success to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint}.

You create an opening for your student, setting them up for their own attack. The creature you Feinted is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to the first Strike or spell attack roll your student makes against it before the end of your next turn.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your last action was a success to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint}.

You create an opening for your student, setting them up for their own attack. The creature you Feinted is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to the first Strike or spell attack roll your student makes against it before the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 마지막 행동이 @link[actions.feint]에 성공했을 때.

당신은 제자에게 공격 기회를 열어주며, 그들이 직접 공격할 수 있도록 준비시킵니다. 당신이 페인트한 대상은 다음 턴이 끝나기 전까지 제자가 그 대상에게 가하는 첫 번째 공격 또는 주문 명중 굴림에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Tupilaq Carver

description.value:
Access Erutaki ethnicity

You know the truth behind old stories that tell of sending a fetish of bone and sinew to seek vengeance. These old magics allow you to conjure constructs with ease. Add the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lKcsmeOrgHtK4xQa]{Summon Construct} spell to your spell list. The constructs you summon have a distinct ivory scrimshaw appearance, and if you include a drop of blood, lock of hair, or other portion of a creature's body as part of the spell's material component, the summoned construct gains a +4 status bonus to Perception checks to sense or locate that creature.

value.value: You have a spellcasting class feature with the divine or primal tradition

_desc_en:
Access Erutaki ethnicity

You know the truth behind old stories that tell of sending a fetish of bone and sinew to seek vengeance. These old magics allow you to conjure constructs with ease. Add the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lKcsmeOrgHtK4xQa]{Summon Construct} spell to your spell list. The constructs you summon have a distinct ivory scrimshaw appearance, and if you include a drop of blood, lock of hair, or other portion of a creature's body as part of the spell's material component, the summoned construct gains a +4 status bonus to Perception checks to sense or locate that creature.
_desc_ko:
접근 에루타키 민족

뼈와 힘줄로 만든 부적을 보내 복수를 하라는 옛 이야기의 진실을 알고 있습니다. 이 오래된 마법으로 당신은 쉽게 구조체를 소환할 수 있습니다. @link[spells.summon-construct] 주문을 당신의 주문 목록에 추가하십시오. 소환한 구조체는 독특한 상아 조각상 같은 외관을 지녔으며, 주문 재료로 피 한 방울, 머리카락 한 올 또는 생물의 신체 일부를 포함할 경우, 소환된 구조체는 해당 생물을 감지하거나 위치 파악하는 지각 판정에서 +4 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Open Mind

description.value: You have inherent psychic abilities that allow you to tap into the power of your mind. Choose one cantrip from the occult spell list. You can cast this spell as an occult innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

_desc_en: You have inherent psychic abilities that allow you to tap into the power of your mind. Choose one cantrip from the occult spell list. You can cast this spell as an occult innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 당신은 마음의 힘을 활용할 수 있는 선천적인 심령 능력을 지녔습니다. 오컬트 주문 목록에서 한 가지 캔트립을 선택하십시오. 이 주문을 마음대로 오컬트 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 선택한 캔트립은 레벨의 절반(반올림)에 해당하는 주문 랭크으로 강화됩니다.

name: Elucidating Vision

description.value: Your eyes have seen many things in your past lives, and your sight seems to have grown more powerful over your lifetimes. You gain darkvision.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your eyes have seen many things in your past lives, and your sight seems to have grown more powerful over your lifetimes. You gain darkvision.
_desc_ko: 당신의 눈은 과거 생애에서 많은 것을 보아왔으며, 생을 거듭할수록 시력이 더욱 강력해진 듯합니다. 암흑 시야를 얻습니다.

name: Frightening Power

description.value:
Requirements You are holding or wearing your draconic gift.

Draconic essence coruscates around you, sapping the resilience of your foes. Each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] must attempt a Will saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. If you are Channeling Draconic Essence, your spectral dragon can be the origin of this emanation. Regardless of the result of its saving throw, a creature that attempts a save is temporarily immune to your Frightening Power for 24 hours.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are holding or wearing your draconic gift.

Draconic essence coruscates around you, sapping the resilience of your foes. Each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] must attempt a Will saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. If you are Channeling Draconic Essence, your spectral dragon can be the origin of this emanation. Regardless of the result of its saving throw, a creature that attempts a save is temporarily immune to your Frightening Power for 24 hours.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 당신은 용의 선물을 들거나 착용하고 있다.

용의 정수가 당신 주위에서 번뜩이며 적의 회복력을 앗아간다. @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] 안에 있는 각 적은 당신의 직업 DC나 주문 DC 중 더 높은 것에 대해 의지 내성 굴림을 시도해야 한다. 당신이 용의 정수를 흘려보내고 있다면, 당신의 유령 용이 이 발산의 기점이 될 수 있다. 내성 굴림의 결과와 관계없이, 내성을 시도한 생물은 24시간 동안 당신의 공포를 주는 힘에 일시적으로 면역이 된다.

대성공 생물은 영향을 받지 않는다.

성공 생물은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{공포 1} 상태가 된다.

실패 생물은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{공포 2} 상태가 된다.

대실패 생물은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{공포 4} 상태가 된다.

name: Resounding Cascade

description.value:
Trigger You use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HbejhIywqIufrmVM]{Arcane Cascade}.

When you enter your Arcane Cascade, you disperse the magical reinforcement to nearby allies. You grant the extra damage of Arcane Cascade in an aura affecting all allies in a @Template[emanation|distance:5]. This uses only the base damage of the stance, based on the ally's weapon specialization; it doesn't use any increase you get from bonuses, the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.3gVDqDPSz4fB5T9G]{Laughing Shadow} hybrid study, or the like.

As normal for duplicate effects, multiple Arcane Cascades affecting the same creature aren't cumulative.

_desc_en:
Trigger You use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HbejhIywqIufrmVM]{Arcane Cascade}.

When you enter your Arcane Cascade, you disperse the magical reinforcement to nearby allies. You grant the extra damage of Arcane Cascade in an aura affecting all allies in a @Template[emanation|distance:5]. This uses only the base damage of the stance, based on the ally's weapon specialization; it doesn't use any increase you get from bonuses, the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.3gVDqDPSz4fB5T9G]{Laughing Shadow} hybrid study, or the like.

As normal for duplicate effects, multiple Arcane Cascades affecting the same creature aren't cumulative.
_desc_ko:
발동조건 당신이 아케인 캐스케이드를 사용한다.

아케인 캐스케이드에 진입할 때, 주변 아군에게 마법적 보강을 분산시킵니다. 5피트 내 모든 아군에게 오라 형태로 아케인 캐스케이드 추가 피해를 부여한다. 이는 아군의 무기 전문화에 기반한 자세의 기본 피해만 사용하며, 보너스나 웃는 그림자 혼혈 연구 등으로 얻은 증가는 적용되지 않는다.

중복 효과의 일반 규칙에 따라, 동일 대상에 적용된 여러 아케인 캐스케이드는 중첩되지 않습니다.

name: Iivlar's Boundary Break

description.value: You can bend the boundary between planes with the natural skill of an iivlar. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zR67Rt3UMHKC5evy]{Flicker} as a 4th-rank occult innate spell once per day. When you Sustain the spell, increase the distance you teleport to 15 feet.

_desc_en: You can bend the boundary between planes with the natural skill of an iivlar. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zR67Rt3UMHKC5evy]{Flicker} as a 4th-rank occult innate spell once per day. When you Sustain the spell, increase the distance you teleport to 15 feet.
_desc_ko: 이이브라의 타고난 능력으로 차원 경계를 휘어잡을 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, (4th)랭크 오컬트 선천 마법인 @link[spells.flicker]를 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 마법을 지속 시전할 경우, 순간이동 거리를 15피트까지 늘릴 수 있습니다.

name: Improved Swift Banishment

description.value: You easily banish creatures with your weapon. You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.t3unBu3PX6AO0uIW]{Swift Banishment} as long as you have a spell slot of 5th rank or higher remaining, even if you don't have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.bay4AfSu2iIozNNW]{Banishment} prepared. You must sacrifice a prepared spell of 5th rank or higher, and the banishment effect you create is heightened to the rank of that spell. The target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to its save as though you'd paid the extra cost for banishment.

_desc_en: You easily banish creatures with your weapon. You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.t3unBu3PX6AO0uIW]{Swift Banishment} as long as you have a spell slot of 5th rank or higher remaining, even if you don't have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.bay4AfSu2iIozNNW]{Banishment} prepared. You must sacrifice a prepared spell of 5th rank or higher, and the banishment effect you create is heightened to the rank of that spell. The target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to its save as though you'd paid the extra cost for banishment.
_desc_ko: 당신은 무기로 생물을 손쉽게 추방합니다. @link[feats.swift-banishment]은 @link[spells.banishment]을 준비하지 않았더라도 5랭크 이상의 주문 슬롯이 남아 있는 한 사용할 수 있습니다. 준비된 5레벨 이상의 주문을 희생해야 하며, 생성하는 ⟬추방⟬ 효과는 해당 주문의 레벨로 강화된다. 대상은 추방의 추가 비용을 지불한 것처럼 내성에 -2 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Instant Return

description.value:
Trigger An enemy misses you with a ranged attack using a type of ammunition appropriate to your weapon (a bullet if you're wielding a firearm).

Requirements You're wielding an unloaded firearm or crossbow.

With a single fluid gesture, you catch a projectile out of the air, load it in your weapon, and shoot it back at the attacker. Interact to load the projectile into your weapon, then make a Strike with the required weapon against the triggering opponent. Since you're using the foe's ammunition, this Strike applies any special effects that ammunition would have (for instance, if it was @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.rKknk8odXDBpON5l]{Explosive Ammunition}, it would explode in a burst of fire if your Strike hits).

_desc_en:
Trigger An enemy misses you with a ranged attack using a type of ammunition appropriate to your weapon (a bullet if you're wielding a firearm).

Requirements You're wielding an unloaded firearm or crossbow.

With a single fluid gesture, you catch a projectile out of the air, load it in your weapon, and shoot it back at the attacker. Interact to load the projectile into your weapon, then make a Strike with the required weapon against the triggering opponent. Since you're using the foe's ammunition, this Strike applies any special effects that ammunition would have (for instance, if it was @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.rKknk8odXDBpON5l]{Explosive Ammunition}, it would explode in a burst of fire if your Strike hits).
_desc_ko:
발동 적의 원거리 공격이 당신의 무기에 적합한 탄약(화기 사용 시 총알)을 사용해 당신을 빗나간다.

요구 사항 장전되지 않은 화기나 석궁을 들고 있어야 합니다.

유연한 동작 하나로 공중의 투사체를 잡아 무기에 장전한 뒤, 공격자에게 되돌려 쏘아냅니다. 무기에 투사체를 장전하기 위해 상호작용한 후, 발동시킨 상대에게 해당 무기로 공격을 가하십시오. 적의 탄약을 사용하므로 이 공격은 해당 탄약의 특수 효과를 적용합니다(예: @link[equipment.explosive-ammunition]인 경우 공격이 명중하면 화염 폭발이 발생함).

name: Second Ikon

description.value: You gain an additional ikon. When you Spark Transcendence, your spark moves automatically from the ikon you just used to the other ikon.

_desc_en: You gain an additional ikon. When you Spark Transcendence, your spark moves automatically from the ikon you just used to the other ikon.
_desc_ko: 추가 이콘을 획득합니다. 초월의 불꽃을 발동할 때, 방금 사용한 이콘에서 다른 이콘으로 불꽃이 자동으로 이동합니다.

name: Officer's Mastery

description.value: Your proficiency in commander class DC increases to master, and you become a master in Warfare Lore. If you're already a master in Warfare Lore, you instead become a master in another Lore skill you're an expert in, an expert in another Lore skill you're trained in, or trained in another Lore skill of your choice.

_desc_en: Your proficiency in commander class DC increases to master, and you become a master in Warfare Lore. If you're already a master in Warfare Lore, you instead become a master in another Lore skill you're an expert in, an expert in another Lore skill you're trained in, or trained in another Lore skill of your choice.
_desc_ko: 커맨더 등급 DC 숙련도가 숙련에서 달인으로 상승하며, 전쟁학 지식에 대한 달인이 됩니다. 이미 전쟁 지식 달인인 경우, 대신 전문 기술을 가진 다른 지식 달인이 되거나, 훈련받은 다른 지식 달인이 되거나, 선택한 다른 지식 달인이 됩니다.

name: Mortal Healing

description.value: You grant greater healing when the gods don't interfere. When you roll a success to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} for a creature that hasn't regained Hit Points from divine magic in the past 24 hours, you get a critical success on your check instead and restore the corresponding amount of Hit Points.

value.value: You follow the Laws of Mortality

rules.text: When you roll a success to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} for a creature that hasn't regained Hit Points from divine magic in the past 24 hours, you get a critical success on your check instead and restore the corresponding amount of Hit Points.
rules.title: {item|name}

_desc_en: You grant greater healing when the gods don't interfere. When you roll a success to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} for a creature that hasn't regained Hit Points from divine magic in the past 24 hours, you get a critical success on your check instead and restore the corresponding amount of Hit Points.
_desc_ko: 신들이 간섭하지 않을 때 더 큰 치유를 베푼다. 지난 24시간 동안 신성한 마법으로 HP를 회복하지 못한 생물에게 @link[actions.treat-wounds]에 굴림할 때, 대신 대성공을 얻어 해당 HP를 회복시킵니다.

name: Advanced Field Training

description.value:
You gain a commander feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your commander level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another commander feat.

_desc_en:
You gain a commander feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your commander level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another commander feat.
_desc_ko:
커맨더 피트를 획득합니다. 해당 피트의 전제 조건을 충족할 때, 당신의 커맨더 레벨은 캐릭터 레벨의 절반으로 간주됩니다.

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 선택할 때마다 추가 커맨더 피트를 획득합니다.

name: Retch Rust

description.value:
You exhale tendrils formed from flakes of rusted metal. All creatures in a @Template[cone|distance:30] take @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -8)/2)+4)d10[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. A metal creature that fails its save also takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -8)/2)+2)d4[persistent,slashing]] damage.

Level (+2) The cloud's slashing damage increases by 1d10 and the persistent damage increases by 1d4.

_desc_en:
You exhale tendrils formed from flakes of rusted metal. All creatures in a @Template[cone|distance:30] take @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -8)/2)+4)d10[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. A metal creature that fails its save also takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -8)/2)+2)d4[persistent,slashing]] damage.

Level (+2) The cloud's slashing damage increases by 1d10 and the persistent damage increases by 1d4.
_desc_ko:
녹슨 금속 조각으로 형성된 촉수를 내뿜습니다. 30피트 범위 내 모든 생물은 참격의 피해를 입으며, 기본 인내에 해당하는 클래스 DC에 대한 내성 굴림을 수행합니다. 내성에 실패한 금속 생물은 추가로 참격 피해를 입는다.

레벨 (+2) 구름의 베기 피해가 1d10 증가하고 지속 피해가 1d4 증가합니다.

name: Mobile Swarm

description.value: The clicking of fast-moving legs accompanies your swarm in all kinds of environments. Your swarm's land and climb Speeds increase to 20 feet, and the swarm gains a 20-foot Swim speed.

_desc_en: The clicking of fast-moving legs accompanies your swarm in all kinds of environments. Your swarm's land and climb Speeds increase to 20 feet, and the swarm gains a 20-foot Swim speed.
_desc_ko: 빠르게 움직이는 다리의 딸깍거리는 소리가 모든 환경에서 당신의 군집을 따라다닙니다. 군집의 지상 및 등반 속도가 20피트로 증가하며, 군집은 20피트 수영 속도를 얻습니다.

name: Hell of 1,000,000 Needles

description.value:
The landscape fills with monumental filaments of metal. The needles lance into a cube 30 feet on a side within 500 feet. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[(ternary(gte(@actor.level,20),17,13))d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage, with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. Each creature that fails its save is impaled, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} until it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escapes} (the DC is your class DC); a creature that critically failed is also off-guard as long as it's impaled. The hell remains until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it up to 1 minute. Using this impulse again ends any previous one. The first time you Sustain it each round, lightning crisscrosses the needles. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[3d12[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic] save against your class DC. Squares in the area are hazardous terrain. A creature takes @Damage[(ternary(gte(@actor.level,20),7,6))[piercing]] damage for every square of the area it moves through.

Level (20th) The initial damage is 17d6, and the hazardous terrain damage is 7.

_desc_en:
The landscape fills with monumental filaments of metal. The needles lance into a cube 30 feet on a side within 500 feet. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[(ternary(gte(@actor.level,20),17,13))d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage, with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. Each creature that fails its save is impaled, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} until it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escapes} (the DC is your class DC); a creature that critically failed is also off-guard as long as it's impaled. The hell remains until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it up to 1 minute. Using this impulse again ends any previous one. The first time you Sustain it each round, lightning crisscrosses the needles. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[3d12[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic] save against your class DC. Squares in the area are hazardous terrain. A creature takes @Damage[(ternary(gte(@actor.level,20),7,6))[piercing]] damage for every square of the area it moves through.

Level (20th) The initial damage is 17d6, and the hazardous terrain damage is 7.
_desc_ko:
거대한 금속 섬유들이 풍경에 가득 차 있다. 이 바늘들은 500피트 이내에 있는 한 변이 30피트인 정육면체 안으로 찔러 들어간다. 해당 영역 내 모든 생물은 관통의 피해를 입으며, 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 기본 반사 내성에 성공해야 한다. 내성에 실패한 모든 생물은 꿰뚫려 @link[conditions.immobilized] 상태가 되며, @link[actions.escape]할 때까지 지속됩니다(DC는 당신의 클래스 DC). 대실패한 생물은 꿰뚫린 상태인 동안 무방비가 풀립니다. 지옥은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 지속되나, 최대 1분까지 유지할 수 있다. 이 임펄스를 다시 사용하면 이전 유지 효과가 종료된다. 매 라운드 처음 유지할 때, 바늘들 사이로 번개가 교차한다. 영역 내 모든 생물은 3d12 전기 피해를 입으며, 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 기본 반사 내성에 성공해야 한다. 영역 내 칸은 위험 지형이다. 생물이 이동할 때마다 해당 영역의 칸 수만큼 관통 피해를 입는다.

레벨 (20레벨) 초기 피해는 17d6이며, 위험 지형 피해는 7입니다.

name: True Shapeshifter

description.value: You transcend the limitations of form. Once per day you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZXwxs5tRjEGrjAJT]{Nature Incarnate}, even if you don't have it prepared, to transform into a kaiju. If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.I9rSWQyueWHQyNxe]{Plant Shape}, you can choose to transform into a green man instead. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pn557VVMaNJyq0jX]{True Shapeshift} activity.

_desc_en: You transcend the limitations of form. Once per day you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZXwxs5tRjEGrjAJT]{Nature Incarnate}, even if you don't have it prepared, to transform into a kaiju. If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.I9rSWQyueWHQyNxe]{Plant Shape}, you can choose to transform into a green man instead. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pn557VVMaNJyq0jX]{True Shapeshift} activity.
_desc_ko: 당신은 형태의 한계를 초월합니다. 하루에 한 번, 준비하지 않았더라도 @link[spells.nature-incarnate]을 시전하여 괴수로 변신할 수 있습니다. @link[feats.plant-shape]을 보유 중이라면, 대신 녹색 인간으로 변신할 수 있다. 또한 @link[actions.true-shapeshift] 능력을 획득한다.

name: Ravel of Thorns

description.value:
Thorny vines grow in geometric patterns on surfaces in your kinetic aura. A creature that starts its turn in the thorns takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until it leaves the area. The thorns are hazardous terrain. A creature takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -4)/4)+2)[piercing]] damage each time it moves into one of these squares. If any square the thorns grow on is water or soil, double the hazardous terrain damage for all thorns. If you move, the thorns disappear; new thorns grow at the end of your turn.

Level (+4) The damage increases by 1.

_desc_en:
Thorny vines grow in geometric patterns on surfaces in your kinetic aura. A creature that starts its turn in the thorns takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until it leaves the area. The thorns are hazardous terrain. A creature takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -4)/4)+2)[piercing]] damage each time it moves into one of these squares. If any square the thorns grow on is water or soil, double the hazardous terrain damage for all thorns. If you move, the thorns disappear; new thorns grow at the end of your turn.

Level (+4) The damage increases by 1.
_desc_ko:
당신의 키네틱 오라 내 표면에 가시 덩굴이 기하학적 패턴으로 자랍니다. 가시 덩굴 영역에서 턴을 시작하는 생물은 해당 영역을 벗어날 때까지 이동 속도에 -10피트 상황 페널티를 받습니다. 가시 덩굴은 위험 지형입니다. 생물이 이 칸 중 하나로 이동할 때마다 관통의 피해를 입습니다. 가시가 자라는 칸이 물이나 흙인 경우, 모든 가시에 대한 위험 지형 피해를 두 배로 적용합니다. 당신이 이동하면 가시는 사라지며, 당신의 턴이 끝날 때 새로운 가시가 자랍니다.

레벨 (+4) 피해량이 1 증가합니다.

name: Draconic Resistance

description.value:
Draconic magic safeguards you against harm. You gain resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1) to the damage type associated with your draconic exemplar. Double this resistance against damage of that type dealt to you by dragons.

If your draconic exemplar is associated with bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, instead of gaining resistance to that type you can choose acid, cold, fire, electricity, or sonic.

_desc_en:
Draconic magic safeguards you against harm. You gain resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1) to the damage type associated with your draconic exemplar. Double this resistance against damage of that type dealt to you by dragons.

If your draconic exemplar is associated with bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, instead of gaining resistance to that type you can choose acid, cold, fire, electricity, or sonic.
_desc_ko:
드라코닉 마법이 당신을 해로부터 보호합니다. 당신은 드라코닉 이그젬플러와 연관된 피해 유형에 대해 레벨의 절반(최소 1)에 해당하는 저항력을 얻습니다. 용이 가하는 해당 유형의 피해에 대해서는 이 저항력을 두 배로 적용합니다.

용의 전형이 타격, 관통, 베기 피해와 연관된 경우, 해당 유형에 대한 저항력을 얻는 대신 산성, 냉기, 화염, 전기, 음파 중 하나를 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Elemental Overlap

description.value:
Though you've dedicated yourself to one element, you learn to mix that element with another. Gain a composite impulse feat that includes your kinetic element. You can use that impulse even though you can't channel all its elements. The feat's level must be lower than the level at which you selected Elemental Overlap.

Special You can select this feat more than once, choosing a different impulse feat each time.

_desc_en:
Though you've dedicated yourself to one element, you learn to mix that element with another. Gain a composite impulse feat that includes your kinetic element. You can use that impulse even though you can't channel all its elements. The feat's level must be lower than the level at which you selected Elemental Overlap.

Special You can select this feat more than once, choosing a different impulse feat each time.
_desc_ko:
단일 원소에 집중했지만, 다른 원소와 혼합하는 법을 익힙니다. 자신의 운동 원소를 포함하는 복합 임펄스 피트를 획득합니다. 모든 원소를 채널링할 수 없더라도 해당 임펄스를 사용할 수 있습니다. 이 피트의 레벨은 원소 중첩을 선택한 레벨보다 낮아야 합니다.

특수 이 피트는 여러 번 선택할 수 있으며, 매번 다른 임펄스 피트를 선택할 수 있다.

name: Mega Bomb

description.value: You can add a highly explosive additive to an alchemical bomb to turn it into a mega bomb. Throwing this bomb takes a 2-action activity instead of a Strike. This isn't a Strike, and you don't make an attack roll. The mega bomb explodes in a @Template[burst|distance:30] within 60 feet. It deals damage as if each creature were the primary target, with a @Check[reflex|against:alchemist|basic] save. On a failed save, a creature also takes any extra effects that affect a primary target (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} from bottled lightning). Though all targets in the area take splash damage as primary targets, there is no further splash beyond that area.

_desc_en: You can add a highly explosive additive to an alchemical bomb to turn it into a mega bomb. Throwing this bomb takes a 2-action activity instead of a Strike. This isn't a Strike, and you don't make an attack roll. The mega bomb explodes in a @Template[burst|distance:30] within 60 feet. It deals damage as if each creature were the primary target, with a @Check[reflex|against:alchemist|basic] save. On a failed save, a creature also takes any extra effects that affect a primary target (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} from bottled lightning). Though all targets in the area take splash damage as primary targets, there is no further splash beyond that area.
_desc_ko: 연금술 폭탄에 고폭성 첨가제를 넣어 메가 폭탄으로 만들 수 있습니다. 이 폭탄을 던지는 것은 공격 대신 2-액션 활동이 필요합니다. 이는 공격이 아니며, 명중 굴림을 수행하지 않습니다. 메가 폭탄은 60피트 반경의 30피트 내에서 폭발합니다. 각 생물이 주적처럼 피해를 입으며, 기본 반사 내성을 수행합니다. 내성에 실패한 생물은 주 표적에 적용되는 추가 효과(예: 병에 담긴 번개의 @link[conditions.off-guard])도 받습니다. 해당 영역 내 모든 표적은 주 표적과 동일한 방사 피해를 입지만, 그 영역을 벗어난 추가 방사 피해는 발생하지 않습니다.

name: Invigorating Surge

description.value:
Requirements Your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XIgvCPaSy5WXStVD]{Spellsurge} aura is active.

You alter the aura of magic surrounding you to protect a nearby ally. You grant one creature within your spellsurge aura temporary Hit Points equal to your level. These temporary Hit Points last for as long as the target is in the aura. Using this ability again cancels the temporary Hit Points from any previous usage. If you spend a Mythic Point as part of this action, you grant the temporary Hit Points to a number of creatures up to half your level that are within the aura.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.iGJ6C4AUQZcSEx1W]{Effect: Invigorating Surge}

_desc_en:
Requirements Your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XIgvCPaSy5WXStVD]{Spellsurge} aura is active.

You alter the aura of magic surrounding you to protect a nearby ally. You grant one creature within your spellsurge aura temporary Hit Points equal to your level. These temporary Hit Points last for as long as the target is in the aura. Using this ability again cancels the temporary Hit Points from any previous usage. If you spend a Mythic Point as part of this action, you grant the temporary Hit Points to a number of creatures up to half your level that are within the aura.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.iGJ6C4AUQZcSEx1W]{Effect: Invigorating Surge}
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신의 @link[spells.spellsurge] 오라가 활성화되어 있어야 합니다.

당신은 주변을 감싸는 마법의 오라를 변형하여 가까운 아군을 보호합니다. 당신은 자신의 주문파동 오라 내에 있는 한 생물에게 자신의 레벨과 동일한 임시 HP를 부여합니다. 이 임시 HP는 대상이 오라 내에 있는 동안 지속됩니다. 이 능력을 다시 사용하면 이전 사용 시 부여된 임시 HP가 모두 소멸됩니다. 이 행동의 일부로 신화 포인트를 소모하면, 오라 내에 있는 생물 중 당신의 레벨 절반까지의 수만큼에게 임시 HP를 부여한다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.iGJ6C4AUQZcSEx1W]{효과: 활력 증폭}

name: Rebirth in Living Stone

description.value:
Rock overflows from within you to consume your form before cracking open to reveal your body transformed into living stone. You gain 40 temporary Hit Points. You're immune to critical hits and precision damage. You can't be pushed, pulled, or tripped while you're standing on earth or stone. Your earth Elemental Blasts deal an additional 1d10 damage of their normal type. These benefits last until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain them up to 1 minute. After you gain temporary Hit Points from this impulse, you can't do so again for 10 minutes.

Level (20th) You gain 50 temporary Hit Points.

_desc_en:
Rock overflows from within you to consume your form before cracking open to reveal your body transformed into living stone. You gain 40 temporary Hit Points. You're immune to critical hits and precision damage. You can't be pushed, pulled, or tripped while you're standing on earth or stone. Your earth Elemental Blasts deal an additional 1d10 damage of their normal type. These benefits last until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain them up to 1 minute. After you gain temporary Hit Points from this impulse, you can't do so again for 10 minutes.

Level (20th) You gain 50 temporary Hit Points.
_desc_ko:
바위가 당신 내부에서 넘쳐나 당신의 육체를 삼키고, 갈라지면서 살아있는 돌로 변한 당신의 몸을 드러냅니다. 당신은 40의 임시 HP를 얻습니다. 치명타와 정밀 피해에 면역입니다. 땅이나 돌 위에 서 있을 때 밀리거나 당겨지거나 넘어지지 않습니다. 네 대지 원소 폭발은 기본 피해 유형에 추가로 1d10의 피해를 입힌다. 이 효과는 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 지속되나, 최대 1분 동안 유지할 수 있다. 이 임펄스로 임시 HP를 획득한 후 10분 동안은 다시 획득할 수 없다.

레벨 (20레벨) 50의 임시 HP를 얻습니다.

name: Juggler Dedication

description.value:
You become trained in Performance; if you were already trained in Performance, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.AYb8PmGJ37HwIMwj]{Juggle} skill feat, even if you don't meet its prerequisites.

Special You cannot select another dedication feat until you have gained one other feat from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.bQeLZt29NnHEn6fh]{Juggler} archetype.

publication.title: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On

_desc_en:
You become trained in Performance; if you were already trained in Performance, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.AYb8PmGJ37HwIMwj]{Juggle} skill feat, even if you don't meet its prerequisites.

Special You cannot select another dedication feat until you have gained one other feat from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.bQeLZt29NnHEn6fh]{Juggler} archetype.
_desc_ko:
당신은 공연에 숙련됩니다. 이미 공연에 숙련된 경우, 대신 선택한 기술에 숙련됩니다. 또한 @link[feats.juggle] 기술 피트를 획득합니다. 해당 피트의 전제 조건을 충족하지 않더라도 획득합니다.

특수 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.bQeLZt29NnHEn6fh]{저글러} 아키타입의 다른 피트 하나를 획득하기 전까지는 다른 헌신 피트를 선택할 수 없습니다.

name: Ratfolk Lore

description.value:
Years of experience among ratfolk communities have made you nimble, and you've learned to run and hide when enemies threaten. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Acrobatics and Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Ratfolk Lore.

_desc_en:
Years of experience among ratfolk communities have made you nimble, and you've learned to run and hide when enemies threaten. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Acrobatics and Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Ratfolk Lore.
_desc_ko:
랫포크 공동체에서의 오랜 경험으로 당신은 민첩해졌으며, 적이 위협할 때 달아나 {숨기}는 법을 배웠다. 당신은 곡예와 은신에 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 해당 기술 중 하나에 자동으로 숙련이 부여된다면, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련이 부여됩니다.

또한 랫포크 지식에 대한 @link[feats.additional-lore] 일반 피트를 얻습니다.

name: Tools of the Trade

description.value:
You're well-versed in weapons that allow you to bring bounties back in one piece, or at least alive. You have familiarity with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.YUzPv0i8d8p2J9yx]{Bola}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.TLQErnOpM9Luy7rL]{Sap}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.f1gwoTkf3Nn0v3PN]{Whip}; for the purposes of proficiency, you treat these weapons as simple weapons. You deal an additional 1d4 precision damage with these weapons when using them to make nonlethal Strikes against your prey while they're off-guard to you.

In addition, you take no penalty when making a nonlethal attack with a weapon without the nonlethal trait.

_desc_en:
You're well-versed in weapons that allow you to bring bounties back in one piece, or at least alive. You have familiarity with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.YUzPv0i8d8p2J9yx]{Bola}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.TLQErnOpM9Luy7rL]{Sap}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.f1gwoTkf3Nn0v3PN]{Whip}; for the purposes of proficiency, you treat these weapons as simple weapons. You deal an additional 1d4 precision damage with these weapons when using them to make nonlethal Strikes against your prey while they're off-guard to you.

In addition, you take no penalty when making a nonlethal attack with a weapon without the nonlethal trait.
_desc_ko:
당신은 현상금을 온전히, 혹은 최소한 살아서 가져올 수 있는 무기들에 능숙합니다. @link[equipment.bola], @link[equipment.sap], @link[equipment.whip]에 대한 숙련이 있으며, 숙련도 목적상 이 무기들을 단순 무기로 취급한다. 당신의 무방비 사냥감에게 비살상 공격을 할 때, 이 무기들로 추가 1d4 정밀 피해를 입힙니다.

또한, 비살상 특성이 없는 무기로 비살상 공격을 수행할 때 페널티를 받지 않습니다.

name: Summoner's Call

description.value:
Trigger You or your eidolon take damage from a foe or hazard.

Requirements Your eidolon is manifested more than 5 feet away.

In a moment of danger, you call your eidolon to your side. Your eidolon teleports to an open space adjacent to you.

Special This feat has the trait matching your eidolon's tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

_desc_en:
Trigger You or your eidolon take damage from a foe or hazard.

Requirements Your eidolon is manifested more than 5 feet away.

In a moment of danger, you call your eidolon to your side. Your eidolon teleports to an open space adjacent to you.

Special This feat has the trait matching your eidolon's tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).
_desc_ko:
발동 당신이나 당신의 에이돌론이 적이나 위험으로부터 피해를 입을 때.

요구 사항 당신의 에이돌론이 5피트 이상 떨어진 곳에 창조됩니다.

위험한 순간에, 당신은 자신의 에이돌론을 곁으로 부릅니다. 에이돌론은 당신과 인접한 열린 공간으로 순간이동합니다.

특수 이 피트는 당신의 에이돌론의 전통(아케인, 신성, 오컬트, 프라이멀)과 일치하는 특성을 가집니다.

name: Impossible Striker

description.value: Nothing can prevent you from making a sneak attack, even if your opponent can see every blow coming. Instead of dealing the damage from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.AbgHCPWOKULeXrJ2]{Sly Striker}, you can deal your full sneak attack damage to a target even if the target isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}.

_desc_en: Nothing can prevent you from making a sneak attack, even if your opponent can see every blow coming. Instead of dealing the damage from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.AbgHCPWOKULeXrJ2]{Sly Striker}, you can deal your full sneak attack damage to a target even if the target isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}.
_desc_ko: 상대가 모든 공격을 예측할 수 있다 해도, 당신의 암습을 막을 수 있는 것은 아무것도 없습니다. @link[feats.sly-striker]의 피해 대신, 대상이 @link[conditions.off-guard]가 아니더라도 대상에게 암습의 전체 피해를 입힐 수 있다.

name: Shared Replenishment

description.value: When your deity blesses your warlike acts, you can extend that favor to your allies. You can grant the temporary Hit Points from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.aMef2VM4mSxl0pmy]{Replenishment of War} to an ally within 10 feet instead of gaining them yourself. You can grant these temporary Hit Points to a different ally each time, meaning you might be able to grant them to multiple creatures in a single turn.

_desc_en: When your deity blesses your warlike acts, you can extend that favor to your allies. You can grant the temporary Hit Points from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.aMef2VM4mSxl0pmy]{Replenishment of War} to an ally within 10 feet instead of gaining them yourself. You can grant these temporary Hit Points to a different ally each time, meaning you might be able to grant them to multiple creatures in a single turn.
_desc_ko: 당신의 신이 당신의 전쟁 행위를 축복할 때, 그 은총을 아군에게도 확장할 수 있습니다. @link[feats.replenishment-of-war]으로 얻는 임시 HP를 자신 대신 10피트 이내의 아군에게 부여할 수 있습니다. 이 임시 HP는 매번 다른 아군에게 부여할 수 있으므로, 한 턴에 여러 생물에게 부여할 수도 있습니다.

name: Grandmother's Wisdom

description.value: You carry the bones of your ancestors with you, and you can ask them for counsel. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X]{Augury} twice per day as a 2nd-rank occult innate spell.

_desc_en: You carry the bones of your ancestors with you, and you can ask them for counsel. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X]{Augury} twice per day as a 2nd-rank occult innate spell.
_desc_ko: 당신은 조상의 뼈를 지니고 다니며 그들에게 조언을 구할 수 있습니다. 하루에 두 번 @link[spells.augury]을 2랭크 오컬트 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Warped Constriction

description.value:
Requirements You have an enemy @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

The entity inhabiting your body is an aberrant being with unfathomable motivations, and when you hold a foe close, tendrils and tentacles unfurl from your body to crush your foe and pollute it with alien wrongness. Your grabbed or restrained foe takes bludgeoning damage equal to your level and mental damage equal to your highest mental attribute modifier. The creature attempts a basic Will save that applies to both types of damage and uses the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

value.value: your entity is an aberration or outer entity

_desc_en:
Requirements You have an enemy @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

The entity inhabiting your body is an aberrant being with unfathomable motivations, and when you hold a foe close, tendrils and tentacles unfurl from your body to crush your foe and pollute it with alien wrongness. Your grabbed or restrained foe takes bludgeoning damage equal to your level and mental damage equal to your highest mental attribute modifier. The creature attempts a basic Will save that applies to both types of damage and uses the higher of your class DC or spell DC.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 적을 @link[conditions.grabbed] 또는 @link[conditions.restrained] 상태여야 합니다.

당신의 몸을 차지한 존재는 헤아릴 수 없는 동기를 가진 이형체로, 적을 가까이 붙잡으면 당신의 몸에서 촉수와 덩굴이 뻗어나와 적을 짓누르고 외계적인 부조리로 오염시킵니다. 붙잡기되거나 구속된 적은 당신의 레벨에 해당하는 타격 피해를 입으며, 정신 피해를 당신의 최고 정신 능력 수정자만큼 추가로 받습니다. 생물은 두 종류의 피해 모두에 적용되는 기본 의지 저항 검사를 시도하며, 이 검사는 당신의 클래스 DC와 주문 DC 중 높은 값을 사용합니다.

name: Basic Hunter's Trick

description.value: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level ranger feat.

_desc_en: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level ranger feat.
_desc_ko: 1레벨 또는 2레벨 레인저 피트를 획득합니다.

name: Nagaji Spell Familiarity

description.value: Either through study, exposure, or familial devotion, you have the magic of nagas bubbling in your blood. During your daily preparations, choose @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4gBIw4IDrSfFHik4]{Daze}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.pwzdSlJgYqN7bs2w]{Telekinetic Hand}. Until your next daily preparations, you can cast the chosen spell as an occult innate cantrip. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

_desc_en: Either through study, exposure, or familial devotion, you have the magic of nagas bubbling in your blood. During your daily preparations, choose @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4gBIw4IDrSfFHik4]{Daze}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.pwzdSlJgYqN7bs2w]{Telekinetic Hand}. Until your next daily preparations, you can cast the chosen spell as an occult innate cantrip. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 연구, 노출, 또는 가문의 헌신을 통해 너의 피에는 나가의 마법이 끓어오르고 있다. 일일 준비 시간 동안 @link[spells.daze], @link[actions.detect-magic], 또는 @link[spells.telekinetic-hand] 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 다음 일일 준비 시까지, 선택한 주문을 오컬트 선천적 캔트립으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 캔트립은 레벨의 절반(올림)에 해당하는 주문 랭크으로 강화됩니다.

name: Leader of All

description.value: You accept anyone who would follow you on your adventures. You can take followers from any common ancestry, and from uncommon or rare ancestries at the GM's discretion. Your follower gains the traits, size, Speeds, languages, and other special abilities listed in their ancestry. For example, elf followers have the elf and humanoid traits, a 30-foot speed, low-light vision, and the typical languages for elves. Followers don't use their ancestry's Hit Points or attribute boosts and flaws. They also don't gain abilities that would allow them to use actions beyond the standard ones available to a follower, such as Activating an Item or Casting a Spell.

_desc_en: You accept anyone who would follow you on your adventures. You can take followers from any common ancestry, and from uncommon or rare ancestries at the GM's discretion. Your follower gains the traits, size, Speeds, languages, and other special abilities listed in their ancestry. For example, elf followers have the elf and humanoid traits, a 30-foot speed, low-light vision, and the typical languages for elves. Followers don't use their ancestry's Hit Points or attribute boosts and flaws. They also don't gain abilities that would allow them to use actions beyond the standard ones available to a follower, such as Activating an Item or Casting a Spell.
_desc_ko: 당신은 모험을 함께할 추종자를 누구든 받아들입니다. 일반적인 혈통의 추종자는 물론, GM의 재량에 따라 흔하지 않거나 희귀한 혈통의 추종자도 데려갈 수 있습니다. 추종자는 자신의 조상에 명시된 특성, 크기, 이동 속도, 언어 및 기타 특수 능력을 얻습니다. 예를 들어, 엘프 추종자는 엘프와 휴머노이드 특성을 가지며, 30피트 이동 속도, 저조도 시야, 그리고 엘프의 일반적인 언어를 사용합니다. 추종자는 자신의 조상이 부여하는 건강이나 능력치 상승, 결함을 사용하지 않습니다. 또한 아이템 활성화나 주문 시전과 같이 추종자에게 기본적으로 허용된 행동을 넘어서는 능력을 얻지도 않습니다.

name: Snagging Strike

description.value:
Requirements You have one hand free, and your target is within reach of that hand.

You combine an attack with quick grappling moves to throw an enemy off balance as long as it stays in your reach. Make a Strike while keeping one hand free. If this Strike hits, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn or until it's no longer within the reach of your hand, whichever comes first.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have one hand free, and your target is within reach of that hand.

You combine an attack with quick grappling moves to throw an enemy off balance as long as it stays in your reach. Make a Strike while keeping one hand free. If this Strike hits, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn or until it's no longer within the reach of your hand, whichever comes first.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 한 손이 자유롭고, 대상이 그 손이 닿는 거리에 있어야 합니다.

당신은 공격과 빠른 그랩 동작을 결합하여 적을 당신의 손이 닿는 범위 내에 머무르는 한 균형을 잃게 합니다. 한 손을 자유롭게 유지한 상태로 강타(공격)를 수행하세요. 이 공격이 적중하면, 공격 대상은 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다. 이 상태는 당신의 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지, 또는 적의 위치가 당신의 손이 닿는 범위에서 벗어날 때까지 지속됩니다(둘 중 먼저 발생하는 시점까지).

name: Basic Prophet Spellcasting

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{Basic Spellcasting Benefits}. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the prophet of Kalistrade archetype, add a common occult spell of the appropriate rank, or another appropriate occult spell you've learned or discovered, to your repertoire.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{Basic Spellcasting Benefits}. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the prophet of Kalistrade archetype, add a common occult spell of the appropriate rank, or another appropriate occult spell you've learned or discovered, to your repertoire.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{기본 주문 시전 혜택}을 얻습니다. 칼리스트레이드 예언자 아키타입으로부터 새로운 랭크의 주문 슬롯을 얻을 때마다, 해당 랭크의 일반 오컬트 주문이나 당신이 배웠거나 발견한 다른 적절한 오컬트 주문을 당신의 레퍼토리에 추가합니다.

name: Fell Rider

description.value: You have trained with your animal companion to become a terrifying juggernaut on the battlefield. Your animal companion becomes trained in Intimidation. If your animal companion uses Support while serving as your mount, it grants you the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} reaction on your first Intimidation check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} on the same turn, even though it can't take reactions.

_desc_en: You have trained with your animal companion to become a terrifying juggernaut on the battlefield. Your animal companion becomes trained in Intimidation. If your animal companion uses Support while serving as your mount, it grants you the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} reaction on your first Intimidation check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} on the same turn, even though it can't take reactions.
_desc_ko: 당신은 동물 동료와 함께 훈련하여 전장에서 두려운 저거너트가 되었습니다. 동물 동무는 위협에 능숙해집니다. 동물 동물이 탈것으로 활동 중 지원 능력을 사용하면, 반응을 취할 수 없음에도 불구하고 같은 턴에 수행하는 첫 번째 위협 판정에서 @link[actions.aid] 반응 효과를 부여합니다. @link[actions.demoralize]에 적용됩니다.

name: Wave Dashes Rocks

description.value:
Requirements You have a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

You slam an unlucky foe with the tremendous power of a plunging wave. Make a melee Strike against the required creature, after which they are no longer grabbed or restrained by you. This Strike must be made with an unarmed attack or a monk weapon. If you deal damage with this Strike, the target is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the end of its next turn.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

You slam an unlucky foe with the tremendous power of a plunging wave. Make a melee Strike against the required creature, after which they are no longer grabbed or restrained by you. This Strike must be made with an unarmed attack or a monk weapon. If you deal damage with this Strike, the target is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the end of its next turn.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 생물을 @link[conditions.grabbed] 또는 @link[conditions.restrained] 상태여야 합니다.

당신은 불운한 적을 들이치는 파도의 엄청난 힘으로 내리친다. 필요한 생물에게 근접 공격을 가한 후, 해당 생물은 더 이상 당신에게 붙잡히거나 제압되지 않는다. 이 공격은 비무장 공격이나 몽크의 무기로 수행해야 한다. 이 공격으로 피해를 입히면 대상은 @link[conditions.prone] 상태가 되며, 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.clumsy]{1}과 @link[conditions.enfeebled]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Awakened Power

description.value:
Your power spontaneously evolves or reconfigures itself. You gain one awakening benefit for a deviant feat of 4th level or lower.

Special You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do, choose a different deviant feat of 4th level or lower, and gain one of its awakening benefits.

_desc_en:
Your power spontaneously evolves or reconfigures itself. You gain one awakening benefit for a deviant feat of 4th level or lower.

Special You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do, choose a different deviant feat of 4th level or lower, and gain one of its awakening benefits.
_desc_ko:
당신의 힘은 자발적으로 진화하거나 재구성됩니다. 4레벨 이하의 변칙 피트 중 하나에 대한 각성 혜택을 하나 얻습니다.

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 선택할 때마다 4레벨 이하의 다른 변칙 피트를 선택하고, 그 피트의 각성 혜택 중 하나를 얻습니다.

name: Silver's Refrain

description.value: You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.xM35hJacTM1BSXUl]{Silver's Refrain} composition cantrip, which aids you when fighting devils.

_desc_en: You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.xM35hJacTM1BSXUl]{Silver's Refrain} composition cantrip, which aids you when fighting devils.
_desc_ko: 당신은 데빌과 싸울 때 도움이 되는 @link[spells.silvers-refrain] 작곡 캔트립을 배웁니다.

name: Scare to Death

description.value:
You can frighten foes so much, they might die. Attempt an @Check[intimidation|defense:will] check against the Will DC of a living creature within 30 feet of you that you sense or observe and who can sense or observe you. If the target can't hear you or doesn't understand the language you are speaking, you take a –4 circumstance penalty. The creature is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:intimidation] save against your Intimidation DC. On a critical failure, it dies. On any other result, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round. The critical failure effect has the death trait.

Success The target becomes frightened 2.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The target is unaffected.

_desc_en:
You can frighten foes so much, they might die. Attempt an @Check[intimidation|defense:will] check against the Will DC of a living creature within 30 feet of you that you sense or observe and who can sense or observe you. If the target can't hear you or doesn't understand the language you are speaking, you take a –4 circumstance penalty. The creature is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:intimidation] save against your Intimidation DC. On a critical failure, it dies. On any other result, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round. The critical failure effect has the death trait.

Success The target becomes frightened 2.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The target is unaffected.
_desc_ko:
당신은 적을 너무나도 무섭게 만들어 죽게 할 수 있습니다. 당신이 감지하거나 관찰할 수 있고, 당신을 감지하거나 관찰할 수 있는 30피트 이내의 생명체의 의지 DC에 대해 위협 판정을 시도하십시오. 목표가 당신의 말을 듣지 못하거나 이해하지 못하면, 당신은 -4 상황 페널티를 받습니다. 생물은 1분 동안 일시적으로 면역 상태가 됩니다.

대성공 . 대상은 당신의 위협 DC에 대한 인내 내성을 시도해야 합니다. 대실패 시, 대상은 사망한다. 그 외 결과 시, 대상은 @link[conditions.frightened]{2} 상태가 되며 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.fleeing] 상태가 된다. 대실패 효과는 사망 특성을 가진다.

성공 대상은 공포 2 상태가 됩니다.

실패 대상이 @link[conditions.frightened]{1} 상태가 된다.

대실패 대상은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

name: Hand of the Lich

description.value:
Void energy intensifies your undead form and makes your very touch the antithesis of life. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.ancestryfeatures.Item.YGk41WV42aTM7CQV]{Advanced Undead Benefits} The damage die for your fist increases to 1d6 instead of 1d4, it deals void damage instead of bludgeoning damage, and it loses the nonlethal trait. Your fist becomes magical.

When you critically hit a living creature with your fist Strike, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of your next turn unless it succeeds at a @Check[fortitude|against:spell] save against your spell DC. This is a critical specialization effect.

_desc_en:
Void energy intensifies your undead form and makes your very touch the antithesis of life. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.ancestryfeatures.Item.YGk41WV42aTM7CQV]{Advanced Undead Benefits} The damage die for your fist increases to 1d6 instead of 1d4, it deals void damage instead of bludgeoning damage, and it loses the nonlethal trait. Your fist becomes magical.

When you critically hit a living creature with your fist Strike, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of your next turn unless it succeeds at a @Check[fortitude|against:spell] save against your spell DC. This is a critical specialization effect.
_desc_ko:
공허 에너지가 네 언데드 형태를 강화하고 네 접촉 자체를 생명의 정반대로 만든다. @link[feats.advanced-undead-benefits]을 획득한다. 주먹의 피해 주사위가 1d4에서 1d6으로 증가하며, 타격 피해 대신 공허 피해를 입히고, 비살상 특성을 상실한다. 주먹이 마법화된다.

주먹 공격으로 생명체에게 치명타를 입힐 경우, 해당 생명체는 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.slowed]{1} 상태가 됩니다. 단, 당신의 주문 DC(DC)에 대한 인내 내성에 성공하면 예외입니다. 이는 치명타 특화 효과입니다.

name: I Knew the Heroes

description.value: Your stories aren't mere tales passed down from elder to youth or teacher to student. They're the lived experiences of those you've met, and they're the stuff of legend. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.UCen3Tq6BJlNI7rx]{Uzunjati Recollection}, if you're legendary in the skill you use to Recall Knowledge, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the Recall Knowledge check, and the circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.my4uFR8cnDC4mJE2]{Uzunjati Storytelling} increases to +2.

name: Worm's Feast

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You call forth a brood of infantile cave worms to feast on your enemy's flesh. Choose a creature within 30 feet; the creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save. At 8th level and every 2 levels above that, the persistent piercing damage taken on a failure increases by 1d6.

Critical Success The worms writhe away harmlessly.

Success The target takes @Damage[2d6[piercing],2d6[persistent,piercing]] damage.

Failure The target takes @Damage[6d6[piercing],(max(2,floor((@actor.level -2)/2)))d6[persistent,piercing]] damage.

Critical Failure As failure, plus the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} as long as it takes persistent piercing damage.

Note: A DC was not provided for this ability by Paizo. The button above uses the better of your class or spell DC.
