You tap deeper into the vortex of magical energy within you. Until the start of your next turn, the radius of your spellsurge aura increases to 30 feet. If you spend a Mythic Point as part of this action, the radius increases to 60 feet instead until the start of your next turn and is then 30 feet for the duration of the spell.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신의 @link[spells.spellsurge] 오라가 활성화되어 있습니다.

당신은 내면의 마법 에너지 소용돌이를 더 깊이 끌어올립니다. 다음 차례 시작 전까지, 당신의 주문파동 오라 반경이 30피트로 증가합니다. 이 행동의 일부로 신화 포인트를 소모하면, 반경이 다음 턴 시작까지 60피트로 증가한 후 주문 지속 기간 동안 30피트로 유지됩니다.

name: Capture Magic

description.value:
Trigger You succeed at your save against a foe's harmful spell, or a foe fails a spell attack roll against you from a harmful spell.

When you resist a spell, you capture some of its magic for your own use. You enter your Arcane Cascade stance, using the triggering spell to determine what damage type your Arcane Cascade deals.

Alternatively, if you're already in Arcane Cascade, you can instead amplify its effects temporarily. Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +2 status bonus to the damage from your Arcane Cascade.

_desc_en:
Trigger You succeed at your save against a foe's harmful spell, or a foe fails a spell attack roll against you from a harmful spell.

When you resist a spell, you capture some of its magic for your own use. You enter your Arcane Cascade stance, using the triggering spell to determine what damage type your Arcane Cascade deals.

Alternatively, if you're already in Arcane Cascade, you can instead amplify its effects temporarily. Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +2 status bonus to the damage from your Arcane Cascade.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 적의 해로운 주문에 대한 내성에 성공하거나, 적의 해로운 주문으로 당신을 대상으로 한 주문 명중 굴림에 실패합니다.

주문을 저항할 때, 그 마법의 일부를 포착하여 자신의 용도로 사용한다. 당신은 아케인 캐스케이드 자세로 진입하며, 발동된 주문을 기준으로 아케인 캐스케이드가 가하는 피해 유형을 결정한다.

대신, 이미 아케인 캐스케이드 상태라면 그 효과를 일시적으로 증폭시킬 수 있다. 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 아케인 캐스케이드의 피해에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻는다.

name: Explosion

description.value: Your innovation can explode on command. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.naKVqd8POxcnGclz]{Explode} action.

_desc_en: Your innovation can explode on command. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.naKVqd8POxcnGclz]{Explode} action.
_desc_ko: 당신의 혁신은 명령에 따라 폭발할 수 있습니다. @link[actions.explode] 행동을 획득합니다.

name: Merfolk Weapon Familiarity

description.value:
You were taught the most effective weapons of the sea. You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the merfolk trait. You have familiarity with crossbows, heavy crossbows, longspears, spears, and tridents—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

_desc_en:
You were taught the most effective weapons of the sea. You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the merfolk trait. You have familiarity with crossbows, heavy crossbows, longspears, spears, and tridents—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
_desc_ko:
당신은 바다에서 가장 효과적인 무기들을 배웠습니다. 어인족 특성이 있는 모든 흔하지 않은 무기를 사용할 수 있습니다. 당신은 석궁, 중석궁, 장창, 창, 삼지창에 숙련되어 있습니다. 숙련도 목적상, 이 중 무술 무기인 것은 단순 무기로, 고급 무기인 것은 무술 무기로 취급합니다.

5레벨에 도달하면, 이 무기들로 치명타를 기록할 때마다 해당 무기의 치명타 특화 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Protective Spirit Mask

description.value:
Your mask carries the protective instincts of White Bull, the Horn Forger, and no one will hurt your allies while you have anything to say about it. Immediately after you Cast a non-cantrip Spell that targets only one ally, you can choose to have the spell also give that creature a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.kzSjzK72CQ67wfBH]{Effect: Protective Spirit Mask}

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.KIU5eDZP9VyQIfas]{Protector's Interdiction} reaction.

_desc_en:
Your mask carries the protective instincts of White Bull, the Horn Forger, and no one will hurt your allies while you have anything to say about it. Immediately after you Cast a non-cantrip Spell that targets only one ally, you can choose to have the spell also give that creature a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.kzSjzK72CQ67wfBH]{Effect: Protective Spirit Mask}

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.KIU5eDZP9VyQIfas]{Protector's Interdiction} reaction.
_desc_ko:
당신의 가면은 뿔의 대장장이인 백색 황소의 보호 본능을 지니고 있으며, 당신이 막을 수 있는 한 아무도 당신의 동료를 해치지 못합니다. 동료 한 명만을 대상으로 하는 캐스트가 아닌 주문을 시전한 직후, 해당 생물에게 다음 차례 시작까지 AC에 +1 상황 보너스를 부여하도록 선택할 수 있다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.kzSjzK72CQ67wfBH]{효과: 보호의 영혼 가면}

또한 @link[actions.protectors-interdiction] 반응을 획득한다.

name: Scuttle Up

description.value: Your environment requires you to climb cave walls or tree trunks with great regularity. You gain a Climb speed of 10 feet.

_desc_en: Your environment requires you to climb cave walls or tree trunks with great regularity. You gain a Climb speed of 10 feet.
_desc_ko: 당신의 환경은 동굴 벽이나 나무 줄기를 매우 자주 등반해야 합니다. 등반 속도가 10피트 증가합니다.

name: Improbable Elixirs

description.value: Your mastery of alchemical secrets enables you to replicate effects most believe can be achieved only via magic. Select a number of potions equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1); these potions must be of 9th level or lower. You gain formulas to create these potions as alchemical consumables with the elixir trait. When making these alchemical elixirs, you can substitute alchemical reagents for an equal value of magical components, and you can use an alchemist's toolkit (for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.yzNJgwzV9XqEhKc6]{Quick Alchemy}) or an alchemist's lab (for the Craft activity) instead of any other required toolkits. Other than that, the formula doesn't change. Once you've chosen the potion formulas, they can't be changed.

_desc_en: Your mastery of alchemical secrets enables you to replicate effects most believe can be achieved only via magic. Select a number of potions equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1); these potions must be of 9th level or lower. You gain formulas to create these potions as alchemical consumables with the elixir trait. When making these alchemical elixirs, you can substitute alchemical reagents for an equal value of magical components, and you can use an alchemist's toolkit (for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.yzNJgwzV9XqEhKc6]{Quick Alchemy}) or an alchemist's lab (for the Craft activity) instead of any other required toolkits. Other than that, the formula doesn't change. Once you've chosen the potion formulas, they can't be changed.
_desc_ko: 당신의 연금술 비밀 숙달로, 대다수가 마법으로만 가능하다고 믿는 효과를 재현할 수 있습니다. 지능 수정자 값과 동일한 수의 물약(최소 1개)을 선택하십시오. 이 물약들은 (9th)레벨 이하여야 합니다. 당신은 이 물약들을 엘릭서 특성을 가진 연금술 소모품으로 제조하는 공식을 얻습니다. 이러한 연금술 엘릭서를 제조할 때, 동등한 가치의 마법 재료 대신 연금술 시약을 사용할 수 있으며, 필요한 다른 도구 키트 대신 연금술사 도구 키트(@link[actions.quick-alchemy])나 연금술사 실험실(제작 활동용)을 사용할 수 있습니다. 그 외에는 제조법이 변경되지 않습니다. 일단 선택한 물약 제조법은 변경할 수 없습니다.

name: Rain-Scribe Mobility

description.value: You surround yourself in a mantle of Rain-Scribe magic and Stride twice; difficult terrain does not reduce your Speed, even if the difficult terrain has been manipulated by magic. Your magic clears the difficult terrain in each square you entered; until your next turn, those squares aren't difficult terrain for any creature walking through them (or are normal difficult terrain if they were previously greater difficult terrain).

_desc_en: You surround yourself in a mantle of Rain-Scribe magic and Stride twice; difficult terrain does not reduce your Speed, even if the difficult terrain has been manipulated by magic. Your magic clears the difficult terrain in each square you entered; until your next turn, those squares aren't difficult terrain for any creature walking through them (or are normal difficult terrain if they were previously greater difficult terrain).
_desc_ko: 당신은 비의 서기관 마법의 망토로 자신을 둘러싸고 두 번의 이동을 합니다. 마법으로 조작된 어려운 지형이라도 어려운 지형은 당신의 이동 속도를 감소시키지 않습니다. 네 마법은 진입한 각 칸의 어려운 지형을 제거한다. 다음 턴의 까지, 해당 칸들은 그곳을 통과하는 모든 생물에게 어려운 지형이 아니다(기존에 매우 어려운 지형이었다면 일반적인 어려운 지형으로 유지된다).

name: Hypnotic Gaze

description.value: You can widen your field of vision, allowing you to affect more creatures with your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BaSl8PmfQwESIiY6]{Hypnotic Lure}. Once per day, when you use Hypnotic Lure, you can affect all creatures in a @Template[cone|distance:30], rather than one creature within 30 feet.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You can widen your field of vision, allowing you to affect more creatures with your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BaSl8PmfQwESIiY6]{Hypnotic Lure}. Once per day, when you use Hypnotic Lure, you can affect all creatures in a @Template[cone|distance:30], rather than one creature within 30 feet.
_desc_ko: 시야 범위를 넓혀 @link[feats.hypnotic-lure]의 영향을 받는 생물 수를 증가시킬 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, 최면 유혹을 사용할 때 30피트 내의 한 생물 대신 30피트 내의 모든 생물에게 영향을 줄 수 있다.

name: Train Animal

description.value:
You spend time teaching an animal to do a certain action. You can either select a basic action the animal already knows how to do (typically those listed in the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{Command an Animal} action) or attempt to teach the animal a new basic action. The GM determines the DC of any check required and the amount of time the training takes (usually at least a week). It's usually impossible to teach an animal a trick that uses critical thinking. If you're expert, master, or legendary in Nature, you might be able to train more unusual creatures, at the GM's discretion.

Success The animal learns the action. If it was an action the animal already knew, you can Command the Animal to take that action without attempting a Nature check. If it was a new basic action, add that action to the actions the animal can take when Commanded, but you must still roll.

Failure The animal doesn't learn the trick.

_desc_en:
You spend time teaching an animal to do a certain action. You can either select a basic action the animal already knows how to do (typically those listed in the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{Command an Animal} action) or attempt to teach the animal a new basic action. The GM determines the DC of any check required and the amount of time the training takes (usually at least a week). It's usually impossible to teach an animal a trick that uses critical thinking. If you're expert, master, or legendary in Nature, you might be able to train more unusual creatures, at the GM's discretion.

Success The animal learns the action. If it was an action the animal already knew, you can Command the Animal to take that action without attempting a Nature check. If it was a new basic action, add that action to the actions the animal can take when Commanded, but you must still roll.

Failure The animal doesn't learn the trick.
_desc_ko:
당신은 동물에게 특정 행동을 가르치는 데 시간을 씁니다. 동물이 이미 알고 있는 기본 행동(일반적으로 @link[actions.command-an-animal] 행동에 나열된 것들)을 선택하거나, 동물에게 새로운 기본 행동을 가르치려 시도할 수 있습니다. GM은 필요한 모든 판정 DC와 훈련 소요 시간(보통 최소 일주일)을 결정합니다. 동물에게 비판적 사고를 요하는 묘기를 가르치는 것은 일반적으로 불가능합니다. 자연에 대해 전문가, 달인, 전설적인 숙련도를 가진 경우, GM의 재량에 따라 더 특이한 생물을 훈련시킬 수 있습니다.

성공 동물이 행동을 배웁니다. 동물이 이미 알고 있던 행동이라면, 자연 능력 판정을 시도하지 않고도 동물을 명령하여 그 행동을 취하게 할 수 있습니다. 새로운 기본 행동이라면, 동물이 명령을 받았을 때 취할 수 있는 행동 목록에 해당 행동을 추가하되, 여전히 굴림을 해야 합니다.

실패 동물이 그 묘기를 배우지 못한다.

name: Snare Commando

description.value:
Trigger A creature fails or critically fails a save against your snare.

Your snares are so befuddling that your victims rarely notice you slipping out of sight. If you have expert proficiency in Deception, you can Create a Diversion against the triggering creature. If you have expert proficiency in Intimidation, you can instead Demoralize the triggering creature. If you have both, choose one of the two effects.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature fails or critically fails a save against your snare.

Your snares are so befuddling that your victims rarely notice you slipping out of sight. If you have expert proficiency in Deception, you can Create a Diversion against the triggering creature. If you have expert proficiency in Intimidation, you can instead Demoralize the triggering creature. If you have both, choose one of the two effects.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 대상 생물이 당신의 올가미에 대한 내성에 실패하거나 대실패할 때.

당신의 올가미는 너무나 혼란스러워 희생자들이 당신이 시야에서 사라지는 것을 거의 눈치채지 못합니다. 기만 숙련도에 전문가 숙련도를 보유한 경우, 발동한 생물에게 주의를 분산시킬 수 있습니다. 협박 숙련도에 전문가 숙련도를 보유한 경우, 대신 발동한 생물을 사기 저하시킬 수 있습니다. 둘 다 보유한 경우, 두 효과 중 하나를 선택하십시오.

name: Restore Omen

description.value:
Requirements You do not have an active harrow omen.

You spend 10 minutes meditating with your harrow deck, then draw a card. The suit of the card grants you a new harrow omen.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.rp6hA52dWVwtuu5F]{Effect: Harrow Omen}

_desc_en:
Requirements You do not have an active harrow omen.

You spend 10 minutes meditating with your harrow deck, then draw a card. The suit of the card grants you a new harrow omen.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.rp6hA52dWVwtuu5F]{Effect: Harrow Omen}
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 활성 상태의 해로우 오멘이 없습니다.

당신은 10분 동안 해로우 카드 덱과 함께 명상한 후, 카드를 한 장 뽑습니다. 뽑은 카드의 무늬가 당신에게 새로운 해로우 오멘을 부여합니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.rp6hA52dWVwtuu5F]{효과: 해로우 예언}

name: Surface Skimmer

description.value: By sinking gently beneath the waves, you obscure your presence and utilize the water as a barrier between you and land combatants. While you are submerged just below the water's surface, you have cover from attacks made by creatures out of the water.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Absalom, City of Lost Omens

_desc_en: By sinking gently beneath the waves, you obscure your presence and utilize the water as a barrier between you and land combatants. While you are submerged just below the water's surface, you have cover from attacks made by creatures out of the water.
_desc_ko: 물결 아래로 부드럽게 가라앉아 존재를 감추고, 물속을 육지 전투원과의 장벽으로 활용한다. 수면 바로 아래 잠수한 상태에서는 물 밖의 생물체 공격으로부터 엄폐 효과를 받는다.

name: Elemental Apotheosis

description.value: You take on an elemental countenance, appearing like a type of elemental of your element. You gain any Speeds listed in the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1K6AYGisvo9gqdhs]{Elemental Form} spell for your element and gain darkvision if you don't already have it. You also gain the elemental trait and the trait of your chosen element.

_desc_en: You take on an elemental countenance, appearing like a type of elemental of your element. You gain any Speeds listed in the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1K6AYGisvo9gqdhs]{Elemental Form} spell for your element and gain darkvision if you don't already have it. You also gain the elemental trait and the trait of your chosen element.
_desc_ko: 당신은 원소의 모습을 띠게 되어, 자신의 속성에 해당하는 원소정령과 유사한 형태로 나타납니다. 자신의 속성에 해당하는 @link[spells.elemental-form] 주문에 기재된 모든 이동 속도를 획득하며, 아직 암흑 시야를 가지고 있지 않다면 이를 얻습니다. 또한 원소 특성과 선택한 원소의 특성을 얻습니다.

name: Dousing Spell

description.value: You enhance your spell with elemental water, soaking the target. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell targeting a single creature, you soak the target of the spell with water. If the target has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistent Acid or Fire Damage}, the DC to end those conditions is reduced to 10, and the creature can attempt a flat check to end those types of persistent damage immediately. The spell gains the water trait (causing it to deal extra damage to creatures with weakness to water).

value.value: water is in your elemental philosophy

_desc_en: You enhance your spell with elemental water, soaking the target. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell targeting a single creature, you soak the target of the spell with water. If the target has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistent Acid or Fire Damage}, the DC to end those conditions is reduced to 10, and the creature can attempt a flat check to end those types of persistent damage immediately. The spell gains the water trait (causing it to deal extra damage to creatures with weakness to water).
_desc_ko: 원소수(水)로 주문을 강화하여 대상에게 물을 적신다. 다음 행동으로 단일 생물을 대상으로 주문을 시전할 경우, 해당 주문의 대상에게 물을 적신다. 대상에게 @link[conditions.persistent-damage]가 적용된 경우, 해당 상태를 해제하는 난이도(DC)가 10으로 감소하며, 해당 생물은 해당 유형의 지속적 피해를 즉시 해제하기 위한 단순 판정을 시도할 수 있다. 이 주문은 물 속성(물 약점을 가진 생물에게 추가 피해를 입힘)을 획득한다.

name: Affliction Mercy

description.value: The divine grace that flows through you grants reprieve from an affliction. Add mercy of recuperation to the types of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.zilwynzk8lIujgZo]{Mercy} you can provide, allowing you to counteract an affliction instead of an effect causing a condition (typically an affliction is a curse, disease, or poison).

_desc_en: The divine grace that flows through you grants reprieve from an affliction. Add mercy of recuperation to the types of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.zilwynzk8lIujgZo]{Mercy} you can provide, allowing you to counteract an affliction instead of an effect causing a condition (typically an affliction is a curse, disease, or poison).
_desc_ko: 당신을 흐르는 신성한 은총이 고통으로부터의 유예를 부여합니다. 당신이 제공할 수 있는 @link[feats.mercy] 유형에 회복의 자비를 추가하여, 상태를 유발하는 효과(일반적으로 저주, 질병, 독) 대신 고통을 반격할 수 있게 합니다.

name: Mastermind's Eye

description.value: When you succeed at identifying a creature using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, that creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against your attacks until the start of your next turn; if you critically succeed, it's off-guard against your attacks for 1 minute. This feat serves as the rogue's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.RyOkmu0W9svavuAB]{Mastermind} racket for the purpose of meeting prerequisites.

_desc_en: When you succeed at identifying a creature using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, that creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against your attacks until the start of your next turn; if you critically succeed, it's off-guard against your attacks for 1 minute. This feat serves as the rogue's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.RyOkmu0W9svavuAB]{Mastermind} racket for the purpose of meeting prerequisites.
_desc_ko: {지식 회상}을 사용하여 생물을 식별하는 데 성공하면, 해당 생물은 @link[conditions.off-guard]가 되어 다음 턴 시작까지 당신의 공격에 취약해집니다. 대성공 시 1분 동안 무방비가 지속됩니다. 본 피트는 로그의 @link[feats.mastermind] 전술 전제 조건 충족 시 동일하게 적용됩니다.

name: Desperate Finisher

description.value:
Trigger You complete the last action on your turn, and your turn has not ended yet.

You throw everything you have into one last, reckless press. Use a single action that you know with the press trait. You forgo the ability to use reactions until the start of your next turn. This press uses your multiple attack penalty, as normal.

_desc_en:
Trigger You complete the last action on your turn, and your turn has not ended yet.

You throw everything you have into one last, reckless press. Use a single action that you know with the press trait. You forgo the ability to use reactions until the start of your next turn. This press uses your multiple attack penalty, as normal.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 자신의 턴에서 마지막 행동을 완료했으나 턴이 아직 끝나지 않은 상태여야 한다.

당신은 마지막 무모한 압박에 모든 것을 쏟아붓습니다. 압박 특성을 가진 액션 하나를 사용합니다. 다음 턴 시작까지 반응 능력을 포기합니다. 이 압박은 평소처럼 다중 공격 페널티를 적용합니다.

name: Living Bonfire

description.value:
Roots and branches of living wood writhe in elemental fire at your command, forming a bonfire fearsome enough to scare off predators in the night. You conjure a bonfire in an unoccupied @Template[square|distance:10]{10-foot-square} space within 30 feet. The bonfire burns for 10 hours, providing all the benefits of a normal campfire. If you use this impulse again, any previous one ends.

When you make a wood ranged Elemental Blast, you can have it come from the bonfire instead of you, flinging burning logs. This blast deals an additional @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -4)/5)+1)d6[fire]] damage. Each time you do this, the size of the bonfire is reduced by one 5-foot square. If all the squares are removed, the impulse ends.

Level (+5) The fire damage increases by 1d6.

_desc_en:
Roots and branches of living wood writhe in elemental fire at your command, forming a bonfire fearsome enough to scare off predators in the night. You conjure a bonfire in an unoccupied @Template[square|distance:10]{10-foot-square} space within 30 feet. The bonfire burns for 10 hours, providing all the benefits of a normal campfire. If you use this impulse again, any previous one ends.

When you make a wood ranged Elemental Blast, you can have it come from the bonfire instead of you, flinging burning logs. This blast deals an additional @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -4)/5)+1)d6[fire]] damage. Each time you do this, the size of the bonfire is reduced by one 5-foot square. If all the squares are removed, the impulse ends.

Level (+5) The fire damage increases by 1d6.
_desc_ko:
살아있는 나무의 뿌리와 가지가 당신의 명령에 따라 원소의 불길 속에서 꿈틀거리며, 밤에 포식자들을 쫓아낼 만큼 무시무시한 모닥불을 형성합니다. 30피트 이내의 비어 있는 10피트 공간에 모닥불을 소환한다. 이 모닥불은 10시간 동안 타오르며 일반적인 모닥불의 모든 이점을 제공한다. 이 임펄스를 다시 사용하면 이전의 모든 효과가 종료된다.

나무 원거리 원소 폭발을 사용할 때, 화염이 타오르는 통나무를 날려 보내며 이 폭발이 당신 대신 모닥불에서 발생하도록 할 수 있습니다. 이 폭발은 추가로 화염의 피해를 입힙니다. 이를 사용할 때마다 모닥불의 크기는 5칸 정사각형 하나씩 줄어듭니다. 모든 칸이 제거되면 임펄스는 종료된다.

레벨 (+5) 화염 피해가 1d6 증가한다.

name: Feral Toss

description.value:
Requirements You're in hybrid or animal shape.

You hurl foes away with a shake of your head. You Strike with your antler, horn, or tusk. If you hit and damage a creature of your size or smaller, push it 5 feet from you (10 feet on a critical hit). This is forced movement.

value.value: your animal shape grants an antler, horn, or tusk unarmed attack

_desc_en:
Requirements You're in hybrid or animal shape.

You hurl foes away with a shake of your head. You Strike with your antler, horn, or tusk. If you hit and damage a creature of your size or smaller, push it 5 feet from you (10 feet on a critical hit). This is forced movement.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 혼혈 형태 또는 동물 형태 상태여야 합니다.

머리를 흔들어 적을 멀리 내던집니다. 뿔, 뿔, 또는 엄니로 공격합니다. 자신과 같은 크기 또는 더 작은 크기의 생물을 명중시켜 피해를 입히면, 그 생물을 자신으로부터 5피트(치명타 시 10피트) 밀어냅니다. 이는 강제 이동입니다.

name: Whispering Steps

description.value:
Your spell leaves a lingering connection between you and a creature-one through which you can nudge the creature's mind this way or that. The amped cantrip must take 2 or more actions to cast, target one or more creatures, and either require a spell attack roll or have a saving throw. Use this amp in place of the psi cantrip's normal amp entry.

Amp Choose one enemy who is a target of the spell. If that enemy fails its save or the spell hits it, you whisper in the creature's mind, forcing it to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Bcxarzksqt9ezrs6]{Stride} up to half its Speed in a direction of your choosing; as this is forced movement, you can't force the creature to move into hazardous terrain, off a ledge, or the like. After it moves, the creature becomes temporarily immune to this amp for 24 hours.

_desc_en:
Your spell leaves a lingering connection between you and a creature-one through which you can nudge the creature's mind this way or that. The amped cantrip must take 2 or more actions to cast, target one or more creatures, and either require a spell attack roll or have a saving throw. Use this amp in place of the psi cantrip's normal amp entry.

Amp Choose one enemy who is a target of the spell. If that enemy fails its save or the spell hits it, you whisper in the creature's mind, forcing it to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Bcxarzksqt9ezrs6]{Stride} up to half its Speed in a direction of your choosing; as this is forced movement, you can't force the creature to move into hazardous terrain, off a ledge, or the like. After it moves, the creature becomes temporarily immune to this amp for 24 hours.
_desc_ko:
당신의 주문은 당신과 한 생물 사이에 지속되는 연결을 남깁니다. 이를 통해 당신은 그 생물의 마음을 이리저리 조종할 수 있습니다. 강화된 캔트립은 2개 이상의 행동을 소모하여 시전해야 하며, 하나 이상의 생물을 대상으로 하고, 주문 명중 굴림이나 내성 굴림을 요구하거나 가져야 합니다. 이 앰프는 사이 캔트립의 일반 앰프 항목 대신 사용하십시오.

앰프 주문의 대상이 되는 적 하나를 선택한다. 해당 적이 내성에 실패하거나 주문에 맞으면, 당신은 그 생물의 마음속으로 속삭여 당신이 선택한 방향으로 @link[actions.step]하도록 강요합니다. 이는 강제 이동이므로, 위험한 지형이나 발판으로 스텝하도록 강요할 수 없습니다. 스텝 후, 해당 생물은 24시간 동안 이 앰프에 대해 일시적으로 면역이 됩니다.

name: Acquired Tolerance

description.value:
Trigger You fail a save against a poison.

A small amount of poison, taken at nonlethal doses, can help the body build up resistance against a more deadly dosage. Reroll the triggering check and use the second result. Once you use Acquired Tolerance, you can continue to use it against the same type of poison that day, but you can't use it against a different type of poison until after you make your next daily preparations. For instance, if you used the reaction on a save against @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.QGXNqpP5KvSldoZz]{Giant Scorpion Venom}, you could use it again against giant scorpion venom even if it came from a different source, but you couldn't use it against @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.WL4O32qFifxnMj0H]{Wyvern Poison}.

_desc_en:
Trigger You fail a save against a poison.

A small amount of poison, taken at nonlethal doses, can help the body build up resistance against a more deadly dosage. Reroll the triggering check and use the second result. Once you use Acquired Tolerance, you can continue to use it against the same type of poison that day, but you can't use it against a different type of poison until after you make your next daily preparations. For instance, if you used the reaction on a save against @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.QGXNqpP5KvSldoZz]{Giant Scorpion Venom}, you could use it again against giant scorpion venom even if it came from a different source, but you couldn't use it against @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.WL4O32qFifxnMj0H]{Wyvern Poison}.
_desc_ko:
Trigger 독에 대한 내성 굴림에서 실패합니다.

비살상 양의 독을 소량 섭취하면, 더 치명적인 양에 대한 내성을 키우는 데 도움이 될 수 있습니다. 발동 판정을 재굴림하고 두 번째 결과를 사용하세요. 획득한 내성을 사용한 후에는 당일 동일 유형의 독에 대해 계속 사용할 수 있지만, 다른 유형의 독에 대해서는 다음 일일 준비를 마칠 때까지 사용할 수 없습니다. 예를 들어, @link[equipment.giant-scorpion-venom]에 대한 내성 굴림에서 이 반응을 사용했다면, 출처가 다르더라도 거대 전갈 맹독에 대해서는 다시 사용할 수 있지만, @link[equipment.wyvern-poison]에는 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Thaumaturge's Investiture

description.value: Magical equipment and gear are the tools of your trade, and you know you need as many as possible to help you against the supernatural. Thus, mastering the efficient use of such magical equipment is a matter of great importance. You gain the Incredible Investiture skill feat, increasing your limit on invested items from 10 to 12. The limit increases to 14 if you have Charisma +4, 16 if you have Charisma +5, 18 if you have Charisma +6, and 20 if you have Charisma +7.

_desc_en: Magical equipment and gear are the tools of your trade, and you know you need as many as possible to help you against the supernatural. Thus, mastering the efficient use of such magical equipment is a matter of great importance. You gain the Incredible Investiture skill feat, increasing your limit on invested items from 10 to 12. The limit increases to 14 if you have Charisma +4, 16 if you have Charisma +5, 18 if you have Charisma +6, and 20 if you have Charisma +7.
_desc_ko: 마법 장비와 도구는 당신의 직업 도구이며, 초자연적 존재에 맞서기 위해 가능한 한 많은 장비가 필요하다는 것을 알고 있습니다. @link[feats.incredible-investiture] 기술 피트를 획득하여 투여 가능한 아이템 한도가 10개에서 12개로 증가한다. 매력 +4일 경우 한도가 14개, 매력 +5일 경우 16개, 매력 +6일 경우 18개, 매력 +7일 경우 20개로 증가한다.

name: Let Death be my Weapon

description.value: You recall your death in vivid detail, and the fear, pain, and uncertainty you suffered are blunted by the truth of your reincarnation. Pain and agony brought on by your foes can be endured and even turned back upon them when you feel yourself at death's door. Whenever you have the doomed, dying, or wounded condition, you gain that condition's value as a status bonus to damage rolls when you make melee or ranged weapon Strikes. If you have multiple conditions, only the highest value condition counts for setting the amount of this damage bonus. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.bwXH0zItp8p8sSjn]{Share Death's Promises} free action.

publication.title: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

_desc_en: You recall your death in vivid detail, and the fear, pain, and uncertainty you suffered are blunted by the truth of your reincarnation. Pain and agony brought on by your foes can be endured and even turned back upon them when you feel yourself at death's door. Whenever you have the doomed, dying, or wounded condition, you gain that condition's value as a status bonus to damage rolls when you make melee or ranged weapon Strikes. If you have multiple conditions, only the highest value condition counts for setting the amount of this damage bonus. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.bwXH0zItp8p8sSjn]{Share Death's Promises} free action.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신의 죽음을 생생하게 기억하며, 당신이 겪은 공포, 고통, 불확실성은 환생의 진실로 무뎌졌다. 적이 가져오는 고통과 괴로움은 견뎌낼 수 있고, 죽음의 문턱에 있다고 느낄 때 그들에게 되돌려줄 수도 있다. 파멸, 빈사, 또는 부상 상태일 때마다, 근접 또는 원거리 무기 타격을 할 때 그 상태의 수치를 피해 굴림에 대한 상태 보너스로 얻는다. 여러 상태를 가지고 있다면, 이 피해 보너스의 양을 정하는 데는 가장 높은 수치의 상태만 반영된다. 당신은 또한 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.bwXH0zItp8p8sSjn]{죽음의 약속 공유} 자유 행동을 얻는다.

name: Performer's Treatment

description.value:
With your experience as a performer, you can keep a set of medical tools handy at all times. You can wear a healer's toolkit as part of any costume or disguise. Creatures will generally only notice the toolkit it if they use a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action and succeed at a @Check[perception|against:performance|traits:secret] check against your Performance DC. In addition, you can realize at the last moment when you should just be pretending to avoid doing any lasting harm.

When you critically fail a Medicine check to Administer First Aid, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TC7OcDa7JlWbqMaN]{Treat Disease}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KjoCEEmPGTeFE4hh]{Treat Poison}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}, you can attempt a @Check[performance|against:perception] check against the patient's Perception DC. On a success, your critical failure at the Medicine check becomes a failure.

_desc_en:
With your experience as a performer, you can keep a set of medical tools handy at all times. You can wear a healer's toolkit as part of any costume or disguise. Creatures will generally only notice the toolkit it if they use a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action and succeed at a @Check[perception|against:performance|traits:secret] check against your Performance DC. In addition, you can realize at the last moment when you should just be pretending to avoid doing any lasting harm.

When you critically fail a Medicine check to Administer First Aid, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TC7OcDa7JlWbqMaN]{Treat Disease}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KjoCEEmPGTeFE4hh]{Treat Poison}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}, you can attempt a @Check[performance|against:perception] check against the patient's Perception DC. On a success, your critical failure at the Medicine check becomes a failure.
_desc_ko:
공연자로서 경험을 바탕으로 항상 의료 도구 세트를 휴대할 수 있습니다. 치유사 도구 키트는 어떤 의상이나 변장에도 포함시킬 수 있습니다. 생물들은 일반적으로 @link[actions.seek] 행동을 사용하고 당신의 공연 DC에 대한 지각 판정에서 성공해야만 도구 키트를 알아챌 수 있습니다. 또한, 당신은 영구적인 피해를 피하기 위해 단순히 연기해야 할 때를 마지막 순간에 깨달을 수 있습니다.

응급처치 대실패, @link[actions.treat-disease], @link[actions.treat-poison], 또는 @link[actions.treat-wounds]에 실패할 경우, 환자의 지각 DC 에 대한 공연 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다. 성공 시, 의학 검사에서의 대실패는 단순 실패로 변경됩니다.

name: Ubiquitous Gadgets

description.value:
They thought you had used up all your devices, but they thought wrong! You have a few more gadgets up your sleeve than others expect. Increase the number of temporary gadgets you can create each day by 2.

Special You can select this feat a second time if you are 14th level or higher.

_desc_en:
They thought you had used up all your devices, but they thought wrong! You have a few more gadgets up your sleeve than others expect. Increase the number of temporary gadgets you can create each day by 2.

Special You can select this feat a second time if you are 14th level or higher.
_desc_ko:
상대는 네가 모든 장치를 다 써버렸다고 생각했지만, 그건 오산이었다! 네가 숨겨둔 장치는 다른 이들이 예상하는 것보다 몇 가지 더 있다. 하루에 생성할 수 있는 임시 가제트의 수를 2개 증가시킵니다.

특수 14레벨 이상일 경우 이 피트를 두 번째로 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Alchemical Scholar

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.is3Oz9wt11lNq62K]{Alchemical Crafting} feat. If you would automatically gain that feat (from your background or the alchemist class, for example), you instead gain a different 1st-level Crafting skill feat. Add an additional common 1st-level alchemical formula to your formula book when you take this feat. Each time you gain a level beyond 1st, add one common alchemical formula of that level to your formula book.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.is3Oz9wt11lNq62K]{Alchemical Crafting} feat. If you would automatically gain that feat (from your background or the alchemist class, for example), you instead gain a different 1st-level Crafting skill feat. Add an additional common 1st-level alchemical formula to your formula book when you take this feat. Each time you gain a level beyond 1st, add one common alchemical formula of that level to your formula book.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @link[feats.alchemical-crafting] 재주를 얻습니다. 만약 배경이나 연금술사 클래스 등으로 인해 자동으로 해당 재주를 얻게 되는 경우, 대신 다른 1레벨 제작 기술 피트를 얻습니다. 이 피트를 선택할 때, 당신의 공식서에 일반적인 1레벨 연금술 공식 하나를 추가로 기록합니다. 1레벨을 초과하여 레벨을 올릴 때마다, 해당 레벨의 일반적인 연금술 공식 하나를 공식서에 추가로 기록합니다.

name: Grimspawn

description.value: Your lineage traces back to a daemon, one of the manifestations of horrific forms of death that devour souls within their foul home of Abaddon. As a result, you cling tenaciously to the last shreds of your own life force. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.I0BhPWqYf1bbzEYg]{Diehard} general feat.

_desc_en: Your lineage traces back to a daemon, one of the manifestations of horrific forms of death that devour souls within their foul home of Abaddon. As a result, you cling tenaciously to the last shreds of your own life force. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.I0BhPWqYf1bbzEYg]{Diehard} general feat.
_desc_ko: 당신의 혈통은 데이몬, 즉 아바돈이라는 추악한 고향 안에서 영혼을 삼키는 끔찍한 죽음의 형태 중 하나로 거슬러 올라갑니다. 그 결과, 당신은 자신의 생명력의 마지막 조각을 집요하게 붙잡고 있습니다. @link[feats.diehard] 일반 피트를 획득한다.

name: Aura Enhancement

description.value: You've enhanced your training with your battle magic, allowing you access to a more potent divine font. Add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HGSCofGACf1TVH55]{Benediction} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.AdZ2rWJStZ5unxzq]{Malediction} to the spells you can prepare with your additional slots from your divine font. These spells are also battle auras.

_desc_en: You've enhanced your training with your battle magic, allowing you access to a more potent divine font. Add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HGSCofGACf1TVH55]{Benediction} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.AdZ2rWJStZ5unxzq]{Malediction} to the spells you can prepare with your additional slots from your divine font. These spells are also battle auras.
_desc_ko: 전투 마법으로 수련을 강화하여 더 강력한 신성 샘에 접근할 수 있게 되었습니다. 신성한 샘의 추가 슬롯으로 준비할 수 있는 주문에 @link[spells.benediction]과 @link[spells.malediction]를 추가한다. 이 주문들은 전투 오라이기도 하다.

name: Riptide

description.value:
Requirements You are within 10 feet of water at least 10 feet deep, and your Speed is sufficient to reach the water in one Stride.

Trigger You successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} a creature of the same size as you or smaller.

You Stride up to 10 feet to enter the water, bringing the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} creature with you into the water.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Absalom, City of Lost Omens

_desc_en:
Requirements You are within 10 feet of water at least 10 feet deep, and your Speed is sufficient to reach the water in one Stride.

Trigger You successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} a creature of the same size as you or smaller.

You Stride up to 10 feet to enter the water, bringing the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} creature with you into the water.
_desc_ko:
요건 깊이 10피트 이상의 물에서 10피트 이내에 위치하며, 한 이동으로 물에 도달할 수 있는 충분한 이동 속도를 보유해야 합니다.

발동 조건 자신과 같은 크기 또는 더 작은 크기의 생물을 성공적으로 @link[actions.grapple]한다.

당신은 최대 10피트를 이동하여 물속으로 들어가며, @link[conditions.grabbed] 생물을 함께 물속으로 끌고 들어갑니다.

name: Conflux Wellspring

description.value:
You've achieved perfect magical and physical balance, allowing magic to flow into and through you more easily.

You can recover 3 Focus Points when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OSefkMgojBLqmRDh]{Refocus} instead of 1 if you have spent at least 3 Focus Points since the last time you Refocused.

_desc_en:
You've achieved perfect magical and physical balance, allowing magic to flow into and through you more easily.

You can recover 3 Focus Points when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OSefkMgojBLqmRDh]{Refocus} instead of 1 if you have spent at least 3 Focus Points since the last time you Refocused.
_desc_ko:
당신은 마법과 육체의 완벽한 균형을 이루었기에, 마법이 당신 안으로 더 쉽게 흘러들고 통과할 수 있습니다.

마지막 재집중 이후 최소 3포커스를 소모한 경우, @link[actions.refocus] 시 1점이 아닌 3포커스를 회복할 수 있습니다.

name: Fulminating Shot

description.value:
Frequency once per round.

You channel magic into your next shot. Choose acid, cold, electricity, or fire. If you hit with your next attack roll using a firearm or crossbow before the end of your turn, you deal 1d6 additional damage of this type. At 12th level, this increases to 2d6 additional damage, and at 18th level, it increases to 3d6 additional damage.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per round.

You channel magic into your next shot. Choose acid, cold, electricity, or fire. If you hit with your next attack roll using a firearm or crossbow before the end of your turn, you deal 1d6 additional damage of this type. At 12th level, this increases to 2d6 additional damage, and at 18th level, it increases to 3d6 additional damage.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 라운드당 한 번.

다음 사격에 마법을 집중합니다. 산성, 냉기, 전기, 화염 중 하나를 선택한다. 자신의 턴이 끝나기 전에 화기나 석궁으로 다음 명중 굴림에 명중하면, 해당 속성의 추가 피해 1d6을 입힌다. 12레벨에 도달하면 추가 피해가 2d6으로 증가하고, 18레벨에 도달하면 추가 피해가 3d6으로 증가한다.

name: Know Your Own

description.value:
You've spent countless hours studying the history of elves on your world and beyond and are a studied expert in your people's ways.

If you critically fail a check to Recall Knowledge about elves, elven society, or elven history, you get a failure instead.

_desc_en:
You've spent countless hours studying the history of elves on your world and beyond and are a studied expert in your people's ways.

If you critically fail a check to Recall Knowledge about elves, elven society, or elven history, you get a failure instead.
_desc_ko:
당신은 자신의 세계와 그 너머의 엘프 역사를 연구하는 데 수많은 시간을 보냈으며, 자신의 종족에 관한 정통한 전문가입니다.

엘프, 엘프 사회, 엘프 역사에 관한 지식 회상 판정에서 대실패를 하면, 대신 실패를 기록한다.

name: Channel Smite

description.value:
Cost Expend a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} spell.

You siphon the energies of life and death through a melee attack and into your foe. Make a melee Strike. On a hit, you cast the 1-action version of the expended spell to damage the target, in addition to the normal damage from your Strike. The target automatically gets a failure on its save (or a critical failure if your Strike was a critical hit). The spell doesn't have the manipulate trait when cast this way.

The spell is expended with no effect if your Strike fails or hits a creature that isn't damaged by that energy type (such as if you hit a non-undead creature with a heal spell).

_desc_en:
Cost Expend a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} spell.

You siphon the energies of life and death through a melee attack and into your foe. Make a melee Strike. On a hit, you cast the 1-action version of the expended spell to damage the target, in addition to the normal damage from your Strike. The target automatically gets a failure on its save (or a critical failure if your Strike was a critical hit). The spell doesn't have the manipulate trait when cast this way.

The spell is expended with no effect if your Strike fails or hits a creature that isn't damaged by that energy type (such as if you hit a non-undead creature with a heal spell).
_desc_ko:
비용 @link[spells.harm] 또는 @link[spells.heal] 주문을 소모한다.

근접 공격을 통해 생명의 기운과 죽음의 기운을 빨아들여 적에게 주입한다. 근접 공격을 시도한다. 명중 시, 타격의 기본 피해에 추가로 소모한 주문의 1-액션 버전을 시전하여 대상에게 피해를 입힌다. 대상은 저항에 자동으로 실패한다(타격이 치명타였을 경우 대실패). 이 방식으로 시전할 경우 해당 주문은 조작 특성을 가지지 않습니다.

타격이 실패하거나 해당 에너지 유형에 피해를 입지 않는 생물(예: 치유 주문을 언데드 생물에 명중시킨 경우)을 명중하면 주문은 소모되지만 효과가 없습니다.

name: Gemsoul

description.value: The earth inside you asserts itself as crystallized gemstones or metals, like a cluster of quartz or veins of iron and gold. This shimmering presence inside your being inspires you to flashy and flamboyant performances. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Performance. If you would automatically become trained in Performance (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xqAdXRd2gSQcqp5E]{Impressive Performance} skill feat.

_desc_en: The earth inside you asserts itself as crystallized gemstones or metals, like a cluster of quartz or veins of iron and gold. This shimmering presence inside your being inspires you to flashy and flamboyant performances. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Performance. If you would automatically become trained in Performance (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xqAdXRd2gSQcqp5E]{Impressive Performance} skill feat.
_desc_ko: 당신 내면의 대지는 수정 덩어리나 철과 금의 광맥처럼 결정화된 보석이나 금속으로 드러납니다. 이 반짝이는 존재감은 당신으로 하여금 화려하고 과시적인 공연을 펼치도록 영감을 줍니다. 당신은 공연 기술에 숙련 등급을 얻습니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 자동으로 공연 기술에 숙련이 된다면, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련이 됩니다. 당신은 @link[feats.impressive-performance] 클래스 피트를 얻습니다.

name: Cold Iron Stomach

description.value: You have steeled yourself against potent odors. Whenever you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} condition, you reduce the value of that condition by 1; if this reduces the value to 0, you avoid becoming sickened entirely. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to all saving throws against olfactory and poison effects created by demons or environmental hazards associated with the Outer Rifts (including all environmental hazards found in Tanglebriar).

_desc_en: You have steeled yourself against potent odors. Whenever you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} condition, you reduce the value of that condition by 1; if this reduces the value to 0, you avoid becoming sickened entirely. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to all saving throws against olfactory and poison effects created by demons or environmental hazards associated with the Outer Rifts (including all environmental hazards found in Tanglebriar).
_desc_ko: 강렬한 악취에 대한 내성을 지녔습니다. @link[conditions.sickened] 상태를 얻을 때마다 해당 상태의 수치를 1 감소시킵니다. 이로 인해 수치가 0이 되면 구역질 상태를 완전히 피합니다. 외계 균열과 관련된 데몬 또는 환경적 위험(탱글브라이어에 존재하는 모든 환경적 위험 포함)이 생성하는 후각 및 독 효과에 대한 모든 내성 굴림에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Font of Knowledge

description.value: Experience or focused study have granted you mastery of a number of topics. When you know about something, you know about it in great detail. When you succeed at a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, you gain additional information or context. When you critically succeed at a check to Recall Knowledge, at the GM's discretion, you might gain even more additional information or context than normal.

_desc_en: Experience or focused study have granted you mastery of a number of topics. When you know about something, you know about it in great detail. When you succeed at a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, you gain additional information or context. When you critically succeed at a check to Recall Knowledge, at the GM's discretion, you might gain even more additional information or context than normal.
_desc_ko: 경험이나 집중적인 연구를 통해 여러 주제에 대한 숙달을 얻었습니다. 무언가에 대해 알 때면, 당신은 그에 대해 매우 상세히 알고 있습니다. @link[actions.recall-knowledge] 판정에서 성공하면 추가 정보나 맥락을 얻습니다. 지식 회상 판정에서 대성공하면, GM의 재량에 따라 평소보다 더 많은 추가 정보나 맥락을 얻을 수도 있습니다.

name: Dimensional Disappearance

description.value:
You take advantage of teleportation to better hide your position. When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5p9Y4ACrtRM4gTpN]{Dimensional Assault}, you're affected by an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} spell at the end of the teleport.

You can choose not to make the Strike that is normally part of dimensional assault. If you do make the Strike, your invisibility ends after the Strike, as normal for invisibility.

_desc_en:
You take advantage of teleportation to better hide your position. When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5p9Y4ACrtRM4gTpN]{Dimensional Assault}, you're affected by an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} spell at the end of the teleport.

You can choose not to make the Strike that is normally part of dimensional assault. If you do make the Strike, your invisibility ends after the Strike, as normal for invisibility.
_desc_ko:
당신은 위치를 더 잘 숨기기 위해 순간이동을 활용합니다. @link[spells.dimensional-assault]을 시전할 때, 순간이동 종료 시점에 @link[spells.invisibility] 마법의 효과가 적용됩니다.

차원 공격의 일부인 공격을 하지 않기로 선택할 수 있습니다. 만약 공격을 수행한다면, 투명화는 투명화의 일반적인 규칙에 따라 공격 후 종료됩니다.

name: Wayfinder Resonance Infiltrator

description.value: You are adept at using the unusual resonance of your wayfinder to aid in any deceptions you might employ. Once per day you can activate your wayfinder to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise}, heightened to 2nd level, as an arcane spell. Additionally, once per day, you can Activate your wayfinder with a single-action envision activation to transform it into a perfect replica of another similarly sized badge of membership or office, such as an Aspis Consortium badge. This transformation lasts for 1 hour.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en: You are adept at using the unusual resonance of your wayfinder to aid in any deceptions you might employ. Once per day you can activate your wayfinder to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise}, heightened to 2nd level, as an arcane spell. Additionally, once per day, you can Activate your wayfinder with a single-action envision activation to transform it into a perfect replica of another similarly sized badge of membership or office, such as an Aspis Consortium badge. This transformation lasts for 1 hour.
_desc_ko: 당신은 웨이파인더의 특이한 공명을 활용하여 수행하는 모든 기만에 능숙합니다. 하루에 한 번, 웨이파인더를 활성화하여 @link[spells.illusory-disguise]을 (2nd) 레벨로 강화된 아케인 마법 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 추가로 하루에 한 번, 웨이파인더를 액션 하나로 활성화하여 아스피스 컨소시엄 배지와 같은 유사한 크기의 다른 소속 또는 직위 배지의 완벽한 복제품으로 변형시킬 수 있습니다. 이 변형은 1시간 동안 지속됩니다.

name: Trap Finder

description.value: You have an intuitive sense that alerts you to the dangers and presence of traps. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to find traps, to AC against attacks made by traps, and to saves against traps. Even if you aren't Searching, you get a check to find traps that normally require you to be Searching. You still need to meet any other requirements to find the trap. You can disable traps that require a proficiency rank of master in Thievery. If you have master proficiency in Thievery, you can disable traps that require a proficiency rank of legendary instead, and your circumstance bonuses against traps increase to +2.

_desc_en: You have an intuitive sense that alerts you to the dangers and presence of traps. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to find traps, to AC against attacks made by traps, and to saves against traps. Even if you aren't Searching, you get a check to find traps that normally require you to be Searching. You still need to meet any other requirements to find the trap. You can disable traps that require a proficiency rank of master in Thievery. If you have master proficiency in Thievery, you can disable traps that require a proficiency rank of legendary instead, and your circumstance bonuses against traps increase to +2.
_desc_ko: 당신은 함정의 위험과 존재를 직감적으로 감지하는 능력을 지녔습니다. 함정 발견을 위한 지각 판정, 함정 공격에 대한 AC , 함정 내성에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 탐색 중이 아니더라도, 일반적으로 탐색이 필요한 함정 발견 판정을 수행할 수 있습니다. 다른 함정 발견 조건은 여전히 충족해야 합니다. 도둑질 숙련도 달인 등급이 필요한 함정은 해제할 수 있습니다. 도둑질 숙련도 달인 등급을 보유한 경우, 대신 전설 등급 숙련도가 필요한 함정도 해제할 수 있으며 함정 관련 상황 보너스가 +2로 증가합니다.

name: Warden's Step

description.value: You can guide your allies to move quietly through the wilderness. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice} during exploration in natural terrain, you can designate any number of your allies to gain the benefits as if they were using that activity during that exploration. This requires no action on their part.

_desc_en: You can guide your allies to move quietly through the wilderness. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice} during exploration in natural terrain, you can designate any number of your allies to gain the benefits as if they were using that activity during that exploration. This requires no action on their part.
_desc_ko: 당신은 동료들이 야생 지대를 조용히 이동하도록 이끌 수 있습니다. 자연 지형에서 탐색 중 @link[actions.avoid-notice]를 수행할 때, 동료 중 원하는 수를 지정하여 해당 탐색 동안 그 활동을 사용하는 것처럼 혜택을 받게 할 수 있습니다. 이 경우 동료들은 별도의 행동을 취할 필요가 없습니다.

name: Bold Defiance

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You Change Shape.

You harden your form as you dance between shapes. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last for 1 minute.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You Change Shape.

You harden your form as you dance between shapes. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last for 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 10분마다 1회

발동형태를 바꾼다.

형태 사이를 오가며 춤추듯 몸을 굳힌다. 1분 동안 지속되는 레벨에 해당하는 임시 HP를 얻는다.

name: Shadow of Death

description.value: Strikes you make with your deity's favored weapon against a creature with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} condition have the death trait, causing the target to be instantly killed when reduced to 0 Hit Points. When killed in this way, attempts to communicate with it, return it to life, turn it into an undead, or otherwise disturb its afterlife fail unless the effect's counteract rank is higher than half your level when you killed the creature (rounded up), or originates from an artifact or a deity.

_desc_en: Strikes you make with your deity's favored weapon against a creature with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} condition have the death trait, causing the target to be instantly killed when reduced to 0 Hit Points. When killed in this way, attempts to communicate with it, return it to life, turn it into an undead, or otherwise disturb its afterlife fail unless the effect's counteract rank is higher than half your level when you killed the creature (rounded up), or originates from an artifact or a deity.
_desc_ko: 신(神)이 선호하는 무기로 @link[conditions.doomed] 상태의 생물을 공격할 때, 해당 공격은 죽음 특성을 가지며 대상의 HP가 0이 되면 즉시 사망하게 합니다. 이 방식으로 죽임을 당한 경우, 해당 생물과 소통하거나 되살리려 하거나 언데드로 변환하거나 사후 세계를 방해하려고 시도하는 것은 실패한다. 단, 해당 효과가 생물을 죽인 시점의 당신의 레벨 절반(올림)보다 높은 반격 등급을 가지거나, 유물이나 신으로부터 비롯된 경우를 제외한다.

name: Reprisal of the Fallen

description.value: You can feel the sorrow, pain, and rage of those fallen to oppression, peering from just behind the veil of death, and you can bring them forth to exact their revenge. You can cast either a 9th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.hghGRzOSzEl4UXdS]{Invoke Spirits} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.FEsuyf203wTNE2et]{Wails of the Damned} once per day as an innate occult spell. For either spell, use your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

_desc_en: You can feel the sorrow, pain, and rage of those fallen to oppression, peering from just behind the veil of death, and you can bring them forth to exact their revenge. You can cast either a 9th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.hghGRzOSzEl4UXdS]{Invoke Spirits} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.FEsuyf203wTNE2et]{Wails of the Damned} once per day as an innate occult spell. For either spell, use your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.
_desc_ko: 당신은 죽음의 장막 바로 너머에서 바라보는 억압에 쓰러진 자들의 슬픔, 고통, 분노를 느낄 수 있으며, 그들을 불러내 복수를 실행하게 할 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, 선천적 오컬트 주문으로 (9th) @link[spells.invoke-spirits] 또는 @link[spells.wails-of-the-damned] 중 하나를 시전할 수 있다. 두 주문 모두 직업 DC와 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽을 적용한다.

name: Witch's Bottle

description.value:
You spend 10 minutes and 1 Focus Point brewing a special potion containing the power of one of your hexes that targets a creature. A creature that consumes this potion is targeted by the hex. If the hex has a sustained duration and you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YVK3JUkPVzHIeGXQ]{Cackle}, you can cast cackle into the bottle just before you seal it. If you do, the hex's duration is extended as if you had cast cackle the round after the hex was cast (typically this extends the duration by 1 round). Your cackling laugh sounds out when the potion is unsealed.

Any potion you create this way loses its power the next time you make your daily preparations. While the potion is in your possession, you can render it inert using a single action that has the concentrate trait. You can't regain the Focus Point you spent to create the potion (or the Focus Point you spent to cast cackle) until the potion is consumed or loses its magic.

_desc_en:
You spend 10 minutes and 1 Focus Point brewing a special potion containing the power of one of your hexes that targets a creature. A creature that consumes this potion is targeted by the hex. If the hex has a sustained duration and you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YVK3JUkPVzHIeGXQ]{Cackle}, you can cast cackle into the bottle just before you seal it. If you do, the hex's duration is extended as if you had cast cackle the round after the hex was cast (typically this extends the duration by 1 round). Your cackling laugh sounds out when the potion is unsealed.

Any potion you create this way loses its power the next time you make your daily preparations. While the potion is in your possession, you can render it inert using a single action that has the concentrate trait. You can't regain the Focus Point you spent to create the potion (or the Focus Point you spent to cast cackle) until the potion is consumed or loses its magic.
_desc_ko:
10분과 포커스 1점을 소모하여 생물을 대상으로 하는 자신의 저주 중 하나의 힘을 담은 특별한 물약을 제조합니다. 이 물약을 마신 생물은 저주의 대상이 된다. 저주가 지속형이고 네가 @link[spells.cackle] 능력을 가지고 있다면, 병을 봉인하기 직전에 카클을 병 안에 시전할 수 있다. 그렇게 하면 저주의 지속 시간이 마치 저주를 시전한 다음 라운드에 cackle을 시전한 것처럼 연장됩니다 (일반적으로 지속 시간이 1라운드 연장됨). 물약이 개봉될 때 당신의 삐걱거리는 웃음소리가 울려 퍼집니다.

이런 방식으로 만든 모든 포션은 다음 일일 준비 시 마력을 상실합니다. 포션을 소지 중일 때, 액션 하나로 포션을 무력화시킬 수 있습니다. 포션이 소모되거나 마력을 잃기 전까지는 포션 제작에 사용한 포커스 포인트(또는 캐클 시전에 사용한 포커스 포인트)를 회복할 수 없습니다.

name: Thrown Voice

description.value: You've learned how to throw your voice through the winds, tricking others as to your location. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yV7Ouzaoe7DHLESI]{Ventriloquism} as a primal innate spell once per day. If you're a songbird strix, you can cast it twice per day instead.

_desc_en: You've learned how to throw your voice through the winds, tricking others as to your location. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yV7Ouzaoe7DHLESI]{Ventriloquism} as a primal innate spell once per day. If you're a songbird strix, you can cast it twice per day instead.
_desc_ko: 바람을 타고 목소리를 던지는 법을 배워, 자신의 위치를 속일 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, 프라이멀 선천 마법인 @link[spells.ventriloquism]을 시전할 수 있습니다. 노래하는 새 스트릭스라면 하루에 두 번 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Too Angry to Die

description.value:
Trigger you stand up from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} after waking up from being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}

You refuse to yield the battle, even after you've been knocked off your feet and nearly killed. For you, such a brush with death is less something to fear and more a thing to become infuriated by. As you stand up, you roar in defiance and can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a foe.

_desc_en:
Trigger you stand up from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} after waking up from being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}

You refuse to yield the battle, even after you've been knocked off your feet and nearly killed. For you, such a brush with death is less something to fear and more a thing to become infuriated by. As you stand up, you roar in defiance and can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a foe.
_desc_ko:
트리거 @link[conditions.unconscious] 상태에서 깨어난 후 @link[conditions.prone]에서 일어서게 된다

발이 헛디뎌 거의 죽을 뻔했음에도 불구하고, 당신은 싸움을 포기하지 않는다. 당신에게 죽음과 맞닥뜨린 경험은 두려움의 대상이라기보다 오히려 분노를 불러일으키는 것이다. 일어서면서 당신은 도전적으로 포효하며 적에게 @link[actions.demoralize]를 시도하다.

name: Mounted Shield

description.value: You've trained with your shield to defend both yourself and your mount. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xjGwis0uaC2305pm]{Raise a Shield} while mounted, both you and your mount gain the shield's circumstance bonus to AC. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction, you can use it when your mount would take physical damage, as long as you're riding your mount. If you do, the shield prevents your mount from taking damage instead of preventing you from taking damage, following the normal rules for Shield Block.

_desc_en: You've trained with your shield to defend both yourself and your mount. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xjGwis0uaC2305pm]{Raise a Shield} while mounted, both you and your mount gain the shield's circumstance bonus to AC. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction, you can use it when your mount would take physical damage, as long as you're riding your mount. If you do, the shield prevents your mount from taking damage instead of preventing you from taking damage, following the normal rules for Shield Block.
_desc_ko: 당신은 방패로 자신과 탈것을 동시에 방어하도록 훈련받았습니다. 탈것에 탑승한 상태에서 @link[actions.raise-a-shield]를 수행하면, 당신과 탈것 모두 방패의 상황 보너스를 AC에 적용받습니다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{방패 막기} 반응을 보유한 경우, 탈것을 타고 있을 때 탈것이 물리 피해를 입을 때 이를 사용할 수 있습니다. 이때 방패는 당신 대신 탈것이 피해를 입지 않도록 막아줍니다. 이는 방패 막기의 일반 규칙을 따릅니다.

name: Flower Magic

description.value: Certain magics in the world flow easily through your sap. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YWrfKetOqDwVFut7]{Oaken Resilience} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dileJ0Yxqg76LMvu]{One with Plants} as 2nd-rank arcane innate spells once per day each. A tree shape spell you cast this way transforms you into a Large flowering plant like a rosebush or lilac bush instead of a tree.

_desc_en: Certain magics in the world flow easily through your sap. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YWrfKetOqDwVFut7]{Oaken Resilience} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dileJ0Yxqg76LMvu]{One with Plants} as 2nd-rank arcane innate spells once per day each. A tree shape spell you cast this way transforms you into a Large flowering plant like a rosebush or lilac bush instead of a tree.
_desc_ko: 세상의 특정 마법이 당신의 수액을 통해 쉽게 흐릅니다. @link[spells.oaken-resilience]과 @link[spells.one-with-plants]을 각각 하루에 한 번씩 (2nd)아케인 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 방법으로 시전한 나무 변형 주문은 당신을 나무 대신 장미 덤불이나 라일락 덤불 같은 대형 꽃 피는 식물로 변신시킵니다.

name: Alarming Disappearance

description.value: Your ability to move unseen is startling for one your size, causing panic among your enemies. When you successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} when previously observed, creatures you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}. They are then temporarily immune to Alarming Disappearance for 1 hour. Typically, creatures that have traveled with you for a significant time, such as your fellow party members, are immune to your Alarming Disappearance.

_desc_en: Your ability to move unseen is startling for one your size, causing panic among your enemies. When you successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} when previously observed, creatures you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}. They are then temporarily immune to Alarming Disappearance for 1 hour. Typically, creatures that have traveled with you for a significant time, such as your fellow party members, are immune to your Alarming Disappearance.
_desc_ko: 당신의 크기에 비해 눈에 띄지 않고 움직이는 능력은 놀라움을 주어 적들에게 공포를 유발합니다. 이전에 관찰된 상태에서 @link[actions.hide]에 성공하면, 당신이 @link[conditions.hidden]가 된 생물들은 @link[conditions.frightened]{1} 상태가 된다. 이후 1시간 동안 경악스러운 소멸에 일시적으로 면역이 된다. 일반적으로 동료 파티원처럼 오랜 시간 함께 여행한 생물들은 경악스러운 소멸에 면역이다.

name: Favored Prey

description.value:
You have studied a specific type of wild creature and can hunt it more easily. When you gain this feat, choose animals, beasts, dragons, or both fungi and plants as your favored prey. When you roll initiative and can see an enemy that belongs to the chosen category, you can Hunt Prey as a free action, designating that enemy.

You can use this free action even if you haven't identified the creature yet with Recall Knowledge. The benefit doesn't apply against favored enemies disguised as other creatures, and the GM determines whether it applies against a creature disguised as a favored prey.

_desc_en:
You have studied a specific type of wild creature and can hunt it more easily. When you gain this feat, choose animals, beasts, dragons, or both fungi and plants as your favored prey. When you roll initiative and can see an enemy that belongs to the chosen category, you can Hunt Prey as a free action, designating that enemy.

You can use this free action even if you haven't identified the creature yet with Recall Knowledge. The benefit doesn't apply against favored enemies disguised as other creatures, and the GM determines whether it applies against a creature disguised as a favored prey.
_desc_ko:
특정 야생 생물을 연구하여 더 쉽게 사냥할 수 있습니다. 이 피트를 획득할 때, 선호하는 사냥감으로 동물, 야수, 용, 또는 균류와 식물 중 하나를 선택합니다. 선택한 범주에 속하는 적을 볼 수 있는 상태에서 이니셔티브를 굴릴 때, 해당 적을 지정하여 사냥감 추적을 자유 행동으로 수행할 수 있습니다.

이 무료 행동은 '지식 회상'으로 아직 생물을 식별하지 못한 상태에서도 사용할 수 있습니다. 선호하는 적이 다른 생물로 변장한 경우에는 이 혜택이 적용되지 않으며, 선호하는 사냥감으로 변장한 생물에게 적용되는지는 GM이 결정합니다.

name: Feral Mending

description.value:
Requirements Your previous action was to Change Shape.

You can heal your wounds while reshaping your flesh. You regain @Damage[(max(1,floor(@actor.level/2)))d6[healing]]{1d6 Hit Points for every 2 levels you have} (minimum 1d6).

value.value: you were not afflicted with the curse of the werecreature

_desc_en:
Requirements Your previous action was to Change Shape.

You can heal your wounds while reshaping your flesh. You regain @Damage[(max(1,floor(@actor.level/2)))d6[healing]]{1d6 Hit Points for every 2 levels you have} (minimum 1d6).
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 이전 행동이 형태 변신이었다.

육체를 재구성하는 동안 상처를 치유할 수 있습니다. 레벨 2당 1d6 HP를 회복합니다(최소 1d6).

name: Order Magic

description.value:
You have delved deeper into the teaching of a new order, gaining access to a coveted order spell. Choose an order you have selected with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.9onf3uGvZRnNLPR6]{Order Explorer}. You gain the initial order spell from that order.

Special You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do, you must choose a different order you have selected with Order Explorer.

_desc_en:
You have delved deeper into the teaching of a new order, gaining access to a coveted order spell. Choose an order you have selected with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.9onf3uGvZRnNLPR6]{Order Explorer}. You gain the initial order spell from that order.

Special You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do, you must choose a different order you have selected with Order Explorer.
_desc_ko:
새로운 교단의 가르침을 더 깊이 탐구하여 갈망하던 교단 주문을 습득했습니다. @link[feats.order-explorer]로 선택한 교단을 하나 선택하세요. 해당 교단의 초급 교단 주문을 얻습니다.

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 매번 선택할 때마다, 당신이 '교단 탐험가'로 선택한 다른 교단을 선택해야 합니다.

name: Warden's Boon

description.value: You point out vulnerabilities present in your hunted prey, granting the benefits listed in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JYi4MnsdFu618hPm]{Hunt Prey} and your hunter's edge to an ally until the end of their next turn. Depending on whether you call out or use gestures, this action gains either the auditory or visual trait.

_desc_en: You point out vulnerabilities present in your hunted prey, granting the benefits listed in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JYi4MnsdFu618hPm]{Hunt Prey} and your hunter's edge to an ally until the end of their next turn. Depending on whether you call out or use gestures, this action gains either the auditory or visual trait.
_desc_ko: 당신은 사냥감의 약점을 지적하여, @link[actions.hunt-prey]과 헌터스 엣지에 명시된 혜택을 아군에게 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 부여합니다. 소리로 알리거나 제스처를 사용하는지에 따라 이 행동은 청각적 또는 시각적 특성을 얻습니다.

name: Powerful Shove

description.value:
You can push larger foes around with your attack. You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.19OLlTrxvEtDAOHc]{Aggressive Block} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.gt9pvIicabSOe6pB]{Brutish Shove} against a creature up to two sizes larger than you.

When a creature you Shove or knock back with a shield, polearm, or club's critical specialization effect has to stop moving because it would hit an object, it takes @Damage[@actor.abilities.str.mod]{damage} equal to your Strength modifier (minimum 1).

_desc_en:
You can push larger foes around with your attack. You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.19OLlTrxvEtDAOHc]{Aggressive Block} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.gt9pvIicabSOe6pB]{Brutish Shove} against a creature up to two sizes larger than you.

When a creature you Shove or knock back with a shield, polearm, or club's critical specialization effect has to stop moving because it would hit an object, it takes @Damage[@actor.abilities.str.mod]{damage} equal to your Strength modifier (minimum 1).
_desc_ko:
공격으로 더 큰 적을 밀어낼 수 있습니다. 자신보다 최대 두 크기 큰 생물에게 @link[feats.aggressive-block]나 @link[feats.brutish-shove]를 사용할 수 있습니다.

방패, 장창, 몽둥이의 치명타 특화 효과로 밀치거나 밀어낸 생물이 물체에 부딪혀 이동을 멈춰야 할 경우, 당신의 근력 능력치 수정자(최소 1)에 해당하는 피해를 입습니다.

name: Basic Magus Spellcasting

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.TwSQ0VPXZL0mfPez#basic-bounded-spellcasting-feat]{Basic Bounded Spellcasting Feat} benefits.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.TwSQ0VPXZL0mfPez#basic-bounded-spellcasting-feat]{Basic Bounded Spellcasting Feat} benefits.
_desc_ko: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.TwSQ0VPXZL0mfPez#basic-bounded-spellcasting-feat]{기본 제한된 주문 시전 피트}의 혜택을 얻습니다.

name: Trickster Tengu

description.value: You can transform yourself or the bodies of others to express your displeasure. Once per day, you can cast either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.NzXpEzcZAjuDTZjK]{Aerial Form} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dN8QBNuTiaBHCKUe]{Cursed Metamorphosis} as a 7th-rank primal innate spell. You must take the form of a bird when casting this aerial form.

_desc_en: You can transform yourself or the bodies of others to express your displeasure. Once per day, you can cast either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.NzXpEzcZAjuDTZjK]{Aerial Form} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dN8QBNuTiaBHCKUe]{Cursed Metamorphosis} as a 7th-rank primal innate spell. You must take the form of a bird when casting this aerial form.
_desc_ko: 당신은 불만을 표현하기 위해 자신이나 타인의 몸을 변형시킬 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, @link[spells.aerial-form] 또는 @link[spells.cursed-metamorphosis] 중 하나를 (7th)랭크 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 공중 형태를 시전할 때는 반드시 새의 형태를 취해야 합니다.

name: Tattooed Historian Dedication

description.value:
You become trained in Diplomacy or Performance; if you are already trained in both skills, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain access to all uncommon magical tattoos with the orc trait.

You gain a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.OOcgMpqQzk22n6rl]{Storied Skin} for free upon gaining this feat (or another magical tattoo of 2nd level or lower if you already have storied skin). You cannot have more than one storied skin tattoo, but the frequency of its Living History ability increases by one use per minute for every three tattooed historian feats you have. For every two tattooed historian feats you have, you can invest one magical tattoo that does not count against the maximum number of items you can have invested at one time.

value.value: trained in Belkzen Lore, Orc Lore, Orc Pantheon Lore, or (at the GM's discretion) a related Lore skill

_desc_en:
You become trained in Diplomacy or Performance; if you are already trained in both skills, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain access to all uncommon magical tattoos with the orc trait.

You gain a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.OOcgMpqQzk22n6rl]{Storied Skin} for free upon gaining this feat (or another magical tattoo of 2nd level or lower if you already have storied skin). You cannot have more than one storied skin tattoo, but the frequency of its Living History ability increases by one use per minute for every three tattooed historian feats you have. For every two tattooed historian feats you have, you can invest one magical tattoo that does not count against the maximum number of items you can have invested at one time.
_desc_ko:
외교 또는 공연에 숙련됩니다. 두 기술 모두 이미 숙련된 경우, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다. 오크 특성을 가진 모든 흔하지 않은 마법 문신을 사용할 수 있게 됩니다.

이 피트를 획득할 때 무료로 @link[equipment.storied-skin]를 얻습니다(이미 이야기가 새겨진 피부를 가지고 있다면 2레벨 이하의 다른 마법 문신을 대신 얻을 수 있습니다). 전설의 피부는 하나만 보유할 수 있으나, 보유한 문신 역사가 재주 3개당 '살아있는 역사' 능력 사용 빈도가 분당 1회 증가합니다. 보유한 문신 역사가 재주 2개당, 최대 보유 개수에 포함되지 않는 마법 문신 1개를 투자할 수 있습니다.

name: Tomb-Watcher's Glare

description.value: When you critically hit an undead creature, or an undead creature critically fails a saving throw against one of your abilities, you drive your divine wrath home in your enemy's heart. The undead is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 round.

_desc_en: When you critically hit an undead creature, or an undead creature critically fails a saving throw against one of your abilities, you drive your divine wrath home in your enemy's heart. The undead is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 round.
_desc_ko: 당신이 언데드 생물을 치명타로 공격하거나, 언데드 생물이 당신의 능력에 대한 내성 굴림에서 대실패할 때, 당신은 신성한 분노를 적의 심장에 깊이 박아 넣습니다. 해당 언데드는 @link[conditions.enfeebled]{1} 상태가 1라운드 동안 지속됩니다.

name: Channeler's Stance

description.value:
You enter a stance that allows power to flow through you. While in this stance, whenever you cast or Sustain an apparition spell or vessel spell that deals energy damage, you gain a status bonus to the spell's damage equal to the spell's rank.

Each time you Cast a Spell that has the vitality or void traits and that restores Hit Points while in this stance, the spells' targets gain a status bonus to the initial amount of healing received equal to the spell's rank. This bonus healing does not apply to healing over time effects (such as fast healing or regeneration).

_desc_en:
You enter a stance that allows power to flow through you. While in this stance, whenever you cast or Sustain an apparition spell or vessel spell that deals energy damage, you gain a status bonus to the spell's damage equal to the spell's rank.

Each time you Cast a Spell that has the vitality or void traits and that restores Hit Points while in this stance, the spells' targets gain a status bonus to the initial amount of healing received equal to the spell's rank. This bonus healing does not apply to healing over time effects (such as fast healing or regeneration).
_desc_ko:
힘이 당신을 통해 흐르도록 하는 자세를 취합니다. 이 자세를 유지하는 동안 에너지 피해를 주는 환영 주문이나 용기 주문을 시전하거나 지속할 때마다, 해당 주문의 랭크과 동일한 상태 보너스를 피해량에 얻습니다.

이 자세를 유지 중일 때 활력 또는 공허 속성을 지니고 HP를 회복시키는 주문을 시전할 때마다, 해당 주문의 대상은 초기 치유량에 해당 주문의 랭크과 동일한 상태 보너스를 받습니다. 이 추가 치유는 지속 치유 효과(예: 빠른 치유 또는 재생)에는 적용되지 않습니다.

name: Aegis for the Innocent

description.value:
Requirements Your nimbus is active.

You transfer a portion of your divine spark to an ally, temporarily dimming your nimbus to encase an ally in a barrier of light that repels attackers. Select a willing creature within the bright light of your nimbus. You surround the target in a protective barrier of light; this is a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] centered on the target. This barrier lasts for 1 minute, or until you Dismiss it. While the Aegis of the Innocent is active, the area of your nimbus is halved.

The target gains a +1 status bonus to AC. Any enemy within the barrier, or entering the barrier, must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] saving throw against your class DC or your spell DC. A creature needs to attempt this save only once each round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.dFNh66uyI5yxVKbt]{Effect: Aegis for the Innocent}

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round and treats the space within the barrier as difficult terrain.

Failure The creature becomes dazzled for 1 minute, is pushed 10 feet, and treats the space within the barrier as difficult terrain. If a creature would be pushed into a solid barrier or another creature, it stops at that point and takes @Damage[2d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your nimbus is active.

You transfer a portion of your divine spark to an ally, temporarily dimming your nimbus to encase an ally in a barrier of light that repels attackers. Select a willing creature within the bright light of your nimbus. You surround the target in a protective barrier of light; this is a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] centered on the target. This barrier lasts for 1 minute, or until you Dismiss it. While the Aegis of the Innocent is active, the area of your nimbus is halved.

The target gains a +1 status bonus to AC. Any enemy within the barrier, or entering the barrier, must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] saving throw against your class DC or your spell DC. A creature needs to attempt this save only once each round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.dFNh66uyI5yxVKbt]{Effect: Aegis for the Innocent}

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round and treats the space within the barrier as difficult terrain.

Failure The creature becomes dazzled for 1 minute, is pushed 10 feet, and treats the space within the barrier as difficult terrain. If a creature would be pushed into a solid barrier or another creature, it stops at that point and takes @Damage[2d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신의 신광이 활성화되어 있습니다.

당신은 신성한 불꽃의 일부를 아군에게 전달하여, 자신의 신광을 일시적으로 어둡게 하여 아군을 공격자를 물리치는 빛의 장벽으로 감쌉니다. 신광의 밝은 빛 안에 있는 동의한 대상을 선택하십시오. 목표물을 보호하는 빛의 장벽으로 둘러쌉니다. 이 장벽은 10피트 발산 크기로 목표물을 중심으로 형성됩니다. 이 장벽은 1분 동안 지속되거나, 당신이 해제할 때까지 유지됩니다. '순수의 방패'가 활성화된 동안, 당신의 신광 영역은 절반으로 줄어듭니다.

대상은 AC에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 장벽 내부에 있거나 장벽 안으로 들어오는 모든 적은 당신의 직업 DC 또는 주문 DC에 맞춘 인내 내성 굴림을 시도해야 합니다. 생물은 매 라운드마다 이 내성 굴림을 한 번만 시도해야 합니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.dFNh66uyI5yxVKbt]{효과: 무고한 자를 위한 방패}

대성공 해당 생물은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 생물은 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.dazzled] 상태가 되며, 장벽 내 공간을 어려운 지형으로 간주한다.

실패 생물은 1분 동안 눈부심 상태가 되며, 10피트 밀려나고 장벽 내 공간을 어려운 지형으로 간주한다. 생물이 단단한 장벽이나 다른 생물에게 밀려 들어갈 경우, 그 지점에서 멈추고 2d6 타격의 피해를 입습니다.

대실패 실패 효과와 동일하나, 생물은 추가로 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.blinded] 상태가 된다.

name: Scion of Many Planes

description.value: The long and complicated history of your bloodline manifests in your ability to draw power from more planar sources than most other nephilim. Choose one nephilim lineage feat that you do not already possess; you gain that feat and all of its benefits, even if you already took a lineage feat at 1st level.

_desc_en: The long and complicated history of your bloodline manifests in your ability to draw power from more planar sources than most other nephilim. Choose one nephilim lineage feat that you do not already possess; you gain that feat and all of its benefits, even if you already took a lineage feat at 1st level.
_desc_ko: 당신의 혈통이 지닌 길고 복잡한 역사는 다른 네필림보다 더 많은 평면적 원천으로부터 힘을 끌어낼 수 있는 능력으로 창조됩니다. 아직 보유하지 않은 네필림 혈통 피트 하나를 선택하십시오. 해당 피트와 그 모든 혜택을 얻습니다. 1레벨에 이미 혈통 피트를 선택했더라도 마찬가지입니다.

name: Marshall Fiendish Forces

description.value:
You have been in contact with a retinue of fiends, brokering all manner of deals so that they may eventually serve you. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IfWF56KiSFQbNmHj]{Manifest your Realm}, you can choose to have one such fiend come to your aid. This fiend is a common fiend of level 11 or lower, which you select when you take this feat. The fiend appears in a place of your choosing within your manifested realm and has the minion trait. They remain for as long as your realm is manifested, until they're reduced to 0 Hit Points, or until you command them to leave, at which point they immediately vanish and return to their place of origin.

At 20th level, you can choose a common fiend of level 15 or lower to appear instead when you Manifest your Realm.

_desc_en:
You have been in contact with a retinue of fiends, brokering all manner of deals so that they may eventually serve you. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IfWF56KiSFQbNmHj]{Manifest your Realm}, you can choose to have one such fiend come to your aid. This fiend is a common fiend of level 11 or lower, which you select when you take this feat. The fiend appears in a place of your choosing within your manifested realm and has the minion trait.
