They remain for as long as your realm is manifested, until they're reduced to 0 Hit Points, or until you command them to leave, at which point they immediately vanish and return to their place of origin.

At 20th level, you can choose a common fiend of level 15 or lower to appear instead when you Manifest your Realm.
_desc_ko:
당신은 핀드 무리와 접촉하며 온갖 거래를 중개해 그들이 결국 당신을 섬기도록 했습니다. 당신이 @link[actions.manifest-realm]할 때, 그러한 핀드 한 마리가 당신을 돕도록 선택할 수 있습니다. 이 핀드는 레벨 11 이하의 일반 핀드로, 이 피트를 선택할 때 당신이 지정한다. 핀드는 당신이 창조한 렐름 내 원하는 장소에 나타나며 하수인 특성을 지닌다. 그들은 당신의 렐름이 창조된 상태 이 유지되는 동안, HP가 0이 될 때까지, 혹은 당신이 떠나라고 명령할 때까지 머문다. 명령 시 즉시 사라져 원래 장소로 돌아간다.

20레벨에 도달하면 렐름을 창조할 때 15레벨 이하의 일반 핀드를 대신 출현시킬 수 있다.

name: Brutal Critical

description.value: Your critical hits are particularly devastating. On a critical hit with a melee Strike, add one extra damage die. This is in addition to any extra dice you gain if the weapon is deadly or fatal. The target also takes persistent bleed damage equal to two damage dice.

_desc_en: Your critical hits are particularly devastating. On a critical hit with a melee Strike, add one extra damage die. This is in addition to any extra dice you gain if the weapon is deadly or fatal. The target also takes persistent bleed damage equal to two damage dice.
_desc_ko: 당신의 치명타는 특히 파괴적이다. 근접 공격으로 치명타를 성공시킬 경우, 추가 피해 주사위 하나를 더 던진다. 이는 무기가 치명적이거나 치명적인 경우 얻는 추가 주사위와 별개로 적용된다. 대상은 또한 두 개의 피해 주사위만큼의 지속 출혈 피해를 입는다.

name: Devastating Shield Wallop

description.value:
The impact of your shield sends foes tumbling to the ground. When you use Shield Wallop, after its other effects, the target attempts a @Check[fortitude|against:guardian|options:inflicts:off-guard,inflicts:prone,inflicts:stunned] saving throw against your class DC. If your shield is a tower shield, fortress shield, or another shield that grants a higher circumstance bonus to AC when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} behind it, the target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to this saving throw.

Critical Success The target takes no additional effect.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you until the end of the current turn.

Failure The target is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Critical Failure The target is knocked prone and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

_desc_en:
The impact of your shield sends foes tumbling to the ground. When you use Shield Wallop, after its other effects, the target attempts a @Check[fortitude|against:guardian|options:inflicts:off-guard,inflicts:prone,inflicts:stunned] saving throw against your class DC. If your shield is a tower shield, fortress shield, or another shield that grants a higher circumstance bonus to AC when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} behind it, the target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to this saving throw.

Critical Success The target takes no additional effect.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you until the end of the current turn.

Failure The target is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Critical Failure The target is knocked prone and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.
_desc_ko:
방패의 충격으로 적들이 땅에 넘어진다. 방패 강타를 사용한 후, 다른 효과가 적용된 뒤 대상은 당신의 직업 난이도(DC)에 맞서 인내 내성 굴림을 시도한다. 당신의 방패가 탑 방패, 요새 방패 또는 그 뒤에 @link[actions.take-cover]할 때 AC에 더 높은 상황 보너스를 부여하는 다른 방패라면, 대상은 이 내성 굴림에 -2 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

대성공 대상은 추가 효과를 받지 않습니다.

성공 대상은 현재 턴이 끝날 때까지 당신에게 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태입니다.

실패 대상은 @link[conditions.prone] 상태가 됩니다.

대실패 대상은 쓰러지고 @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Hellknight Preferment

description.value:
You've forged your body to be able to stand toe-to-toe with a devil, and your mind has been shaped by the strictures of the Measure and the Chain. You've become a true Hellknight. You gain expert proficiency rank in Intimidation (or in another skill in which you're trained of your choice, if you were already an expert in Intimidation). You gain the armor specialization effects of Hellknight breastplate, Hellknight half plate, and Hellknight plate, and your resistance from that armor specialization is 1 higher than normal. In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Intimidation checks while wearing any Hellknight armor.

Special You can't take both this feat and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.3acizttblPMfO1O7]{Hellknight-Errant} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.62hpJOuvYYSa4X7u]{Hellknight Signifer Preferment}.

_desc_en:
You've forged your body to be able to stand toe-to-toe with a devil, and your mind has been shaped by the strictures of the Measure and the Chain. You've become a true Hellknight. You gain expert proficiency rank in Intimidation (or in another skill in which you're trained of your choice, if you were already an expert in Intimidation). You gain the armor specialization effects of Hellknight breastplate, Hellknight half plate, and Hellknight plate, and your resistance from that armor specialization is 1 higher than normal. In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Intimidation checks while wearing any Hellknight armor.

Special You can't take both this feat and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.3acizttblPMfO1O7]{Hellknight-Errant} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.62hpJOuvYYSa4X7u]{Hellknight Signifer Preferment}.
_desc_ko:
당신은 데빌과 정면으로 맞설 수 있도록 몸을 단련했으며, 당신의 정신은 척도와 사슬의 계율에 의해 빚어졌다. 당신은 진정한 헬나이트가 되었다. 당신은 위협에서 전문가 숙련도(또는 이미 위협의 전문가였다면 당신이 선택한 숙련된 다른 기술에서)를 얻는다. 당신은 헬나이트 흉갑, 헬나이트 하프 플레이트, 헬나이트 플레이트의 갑옷 전문화 효과를 얻으며, 해당 갑옷 전문화로 인한 저항이 평소보다 1 높다. 또한, 헬나이트 갑옷을 착용하고 있는 동안 위협 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻는다.

특수 이 재주와 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.3acizttblPMfO1O7]{헬나이트-에런트} 또는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.62hpJOuvYYSa4X7u]{헬나이트 시그니퍼 서임}을 둘 다 취할 수는 없다.

name: Behold, a Pale Horse

description.value:
Your apocalypse mount becomes worthier of an eventual Rider of the Apocalypse. Your apocalypse mount gains one specialization of your choice.

Special You can select this feat up to three times. Each time, add a different specialization to your apocalypse mount. Your apocalypse mount can't have more than three specializations.

_desc_en:
Your apocalypse mount becomes worthier of an eventual Rider of the Apocalypse. Your apocalypse mount gains one specialization of your choice.

Special You can select this feat up to three times. Each time, add a different specialization to your apocalypse mount. Your apocalypse mount can't have more than three specializations.
_desc_ko:
네 종말의 탈것이 종말의 기수에게 걸맞은 존재가 된다. 네 종말의 탈것이 네가 선택한 하나의 특화 능력을 얻는다.

특수 이 피트를 최대 세 번까지 선택할 수 있습니다. 매번 다른 전문화를 종말의 탈것에 추가합니다. 종말의 탈것은 세 가지 이상의 전문화를 가질 수 없습니다.

name: Fleeing Shriek

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You let out an ear-piercing screech. Each creature in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] takes @Damage[ceil(@actor.level/2)d6[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage, with a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. You then Stride, and this movement doesn't trigger reactions from any creature that failed or critically failed its saving throw.

At 11th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

You let out an ear-piercing screech. Each creature in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] takes @Damage[ceil(@actor.level/2)d6[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage, with a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. You then Stride, and this movement doesn't trigger reactions from any creature that failed or critically failed its saving throw.

At 11th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6.
_desc_ko:
빈도 시간당 한 번

귀를 관통하는 듯한 비명을 지른다. 10피트 내 모든 생물은 음파의 피해를 입으며, 당신의 클래스 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽에 대한 기본 인내 내성 굴림을 수행한다. 이후 당신은 이동하며, 이 이동은 내성 굴림에서 실패하거나 대실패한 생물의 반응을 유발하지 않는다.

11레벨과 이후 2레벨마다 피해량이 1d6 증가한다.

name: Cenotaph Stance

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a shield.

You take on a stance that marks your location as a place where none will fall. When you enter this stance and at the beginning of each of your turns while in Cenotaph Stance, you gain 10 temporary Hit Points that last until the start of your next turn. If you move or are forced to move, you automatically leave Cenotaph Stance. While in Cenotaph Stance, you're treated as always having the required shield raised. In addition, you can use your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction when an ally within 15 feet of you takes physical damage, in addition to its normal trigger, thus preventing the ally from taking damage instead of you. Finally, you gain an additional reaction at the start of each of your turns that can be used only for Shield Block.

Special If you can use Shield Block to reduce damage that isn't physical damage (for instance, if you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.n5T4ChWJqDUblYfR]{Bless Shield} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.R337W7VveJxlEddE]{Necromantic Bulwark} feat), you can use your Shield Block reaction when an ally within 15 feet of you takes damage that you could prevent with Shield Block.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a shield.

You take on a stance that marks your location as a place where none will fall. When you enter this stance and at the beginning of each of your turns while in Cenotaph Stance, you gain 10 temporary Hit Points that last until the start of your next turn. If you move or are forced to move, you automatically leave Cenotaph Stance. While in Cenotaph Stance, you're treated as always having the required shield raised. In addition, you can use your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction when an ally within 15 feet of you takes physical damage, in addition to its normal trigger, thus preventing the ally from taking damage instead of you. Finally, you gain an additional reaction at the start of each of your turns that can be used only for Shield Block.

Special If you can use Shield Block to reduce damage that isn't physical damage (for instance, if you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.n5T4ChWJqDUblYfR]{Bless Shield} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.R337W7VveJxlEddE]{Necromantic Bulwark} feat), you can use your Shield Block reaction when an ally within 15 feet of you takes damage that you could prevent with Shield Block.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 방패를 장비하고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 아무도 쓰러지지 않을 장소임을 표시하는 자세를 취합니다. 이 자세를 취할 때와 기념비 자세를 유지하는 동안 자신의 턴 시작 시마다, 다음 턴 시작까지 지속되는 임시 HP 10을 얻습니다. 이동하거나 강제 이동당하면 자동으로 기념비 자세를 해제한다. 기념비 자세를 취하는 동안에는 항상 필요한 방패를 들고 있는 것으로 간주된다. 또한, 15피트 이내의 아군이 물리 피해를 입을 때 기존 발동 조건에 추가로 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{방패 막기} 반응을 사용할 수 있어, 아군이 대신 피해를 입지 않도록 막을 수 있다. 마지막으로, 각 턴 시작 시 방패 막기 전용으로만 사용 가능한 추가 반응을 얻습니다.

특수 물리 피해가 아닌 피해를 실드 블록으로 감소시킬 수 있는 경우(예: @link[feats.bless-shield] 또는 @link[feats.necromantic-bulwark] 재주를 보유한 경우), 15피트 이내의 아군이 실드 블록으로 막을 수 있는 피해를 입을 때 실드 블록 반응을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Wizard Dedication

description.value:
You cast spells like a wizard, gaining a spellbook with four common arcane cantrips of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast a Spell} activity. You can prepare two cantrips each day from your spellbook. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for wizard archetype spells is Intelligence, and they are arcane wizard spells. You become trained in Arcana; if you were already trained in Arcana, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. Select a school; you don't gain any abilities from your choice of school, but qualify for feats as a member.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.XszmLWy174esRrlg]{Wizard}

_desc_en:
You cast spells like a wizard, gaining a spellbook with four common arcane cantrips of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast a Spell} activity. You can prepare two cantrips each day from your spellbook. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for wizard archetype spells is Intelligence, and they are arcane wizard spells. You become trained in Arcana; if you were already trained in Arcana, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. Select a school; you don't gain any abilities from your choice of school, but qualify for feats as a member.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.XszmLWy174esRrlg]{Wizard}
_desc_ko: 위자드처럼 주문을 시전하며, 선택한 네 가지 일반적인 아케인 캔트립이 담긴 주문서를 얻습니다. @link[actions.cast-a-spell] 활동을 획득합니다. 매일 주문서에서 두 개의 캔트립을 준비할 수 있습니다. 당신은 주문 공격 수정자와 주문 DC 통계에 숙련됩니다. 위자드 아키타입 주문에 대한 핵심 주문 시전 능력치는 지능이며, 해당 주문은 아케인 위자드 주문입니다. 당신은 주문학에 숙련됩니다. 이미 주문학에 숙련된 경우, 대신 선택한 기술에 숙련됩니다. 한 학파를 선택하세요. 학파 선택으로 능력치를 얻지는 않지만, 해당 학파 구성원으로서 재주 자격을 얻습니다.

name: Root to Life

description.value:
1 or 2

Marigold, spider lily, pennyroyal-many primal traditions connect flowers and plants with the boundary between life and death, and you can leverage this association to keep an ally on this side of the line. You place a small plant or similar symbol on an adjacent @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} creature, immediately stabilizing them; the creature is no longer dying and is instead @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} at 0 Hit Points.

If you spend 2 actions instead of 1, you empower the act further by uttering a quick folk blessing to chase away ongoing pain, adding the auditory trait to the action. When you do so, attempt flat checks to remove each source of persistent damage affecting the target; due to the particularly effective assistance, the DC is 10 instead of the usual 15.

_desc_en:
1 or 2

Marigold, spider lily, pennyroyal-many primal traditions connect flowers and plants with the boundary between life and death, and you can leverage this association to keep an ally on this side of the line. You place a small plant or similar symbol on an adjacent @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} creature, immediately stabilizing them; the creature is no longer dying and is instead @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} at 0 Hit Points.

If you spend 2 actions instead of 1, you empower the act further by uttering a quick folk blessing to chase away ongoing pain, adding the auditory trait to the action. When you do so, attempt flat checks to remove each source of persistent damage affecting the target; due to the particularly effective assistance, the DC is 10 instead of the usual 15.
_desc_ko:
금잔화, 거미백합, 페니로얄-많은 프라이멀 전통에서 꽃과 식물은 생과 사의 경계와 연결되며, 당신은 이 연관성을 활용해 아군이 그 경계선 이쪽에 머물도록 할 수 있습니다. 인접한 @link[conditions.dying] 생물에게 작은 식물이나 유사한 상징물을 놓으면 즉시 상태가 안정화됩니다. 해당 생물은 더 이상 죽어가는 상태가 아니며, 대신 @link[conditions.unconscious] 상태로 HP가 0이 됩니다.

1회 대신 2회 행동을 소모하면, 지속적인 고통을 쫓아내는 민속의 축복을 속삭여 행동에 청각적 특성을 추가하며 효과를 강화할 수 있다. 이때 대상에게 영향을 미치는 각 지속 피해 원인을 제거하기 위한 단순 판정을 시도한다. 특히 효과적인 지원 덕분에 난이도는 일반적인 15 대신 10이다.

name: Vanara Weapon Familiarity

description.value: You favor weapons steeped in vanaran tradition. You gain access to, and are trained with, the bo staff, chakram, katar, panabas, and urumi. In addition, you gain access to all uncommon vanara weapons. For the purpose of determining your proficiency, martial vanara weapons are simple weapons, and advanced vanara weapons are martial weapons.

_desc_en: You favor weapons steeped in vanaran tradition. You gain access to, and are trained with, the bo staff, chakram, katar, panabas, and urumi. In addition, you gain access to all uncommon vanara weapons. For the purpose of determining your proficiency, martial vanara weapons are simple weapons, and advanced vanara weapons are martial weapons.
_desc_ko: 당신은 바나라 전통이 깃든 무기를 선호합니다. 당신은 육척봉, 차크람, 카타르, 파나바스, 우루미를 사용할 수 있으며 이에 대한 훈련을 받습니다. 또한 모든 흔하지 않은 바나라 무기를 사용할 수 있습니다. 숙련도 판정 시, 무술용 바나라 무기는 단순 무기로, 고급 바나라 무기는 무술 무기로 간주됩니다.

name: Shadowy Disguise

description.value: You wrap yourself in shadow to change your appearance. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise} as a 1st-rank occult innate spell once per day. This spell gains the shadow trait.

_desc_en: You wrap yourself in shadow to change your appearance. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise} as a 1st-rank occult innate spell once per day. This spell gains the shadow trait.
_desc_ko: 자신을 그림자로 감싸 외형을 바꿉니다. 하루에 한 번, @link[spells.illusory-disguise]을 1랭크 오컬트 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 마법은 그림자 속성을 얻습니다.

name: Able Ritualist

description.value: Your readings on rituals make you a skilled participant. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to primary and secondary checks you attempt as part of casting a ritual.

_desc_en: Your readings on rituals make you a skilled participant. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to primary and secondary checks you attempt as part of casting a ritual.
_desc_ko: 의식에 대한 당신의 연구는 숙련된 수행자로 만듭니다. 의식 시전 과정에서 시도하는 주요 및 보조 판정 시 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Blood Shield

description.value:
Cost 1 or more sanguimancy Hit Points

You raise a defensive barrier of your own blood to protect you. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, increasing to a +2 bonus if you spend 10 or more sanguimancy Hit Points. While this bonus is in effect, you can use the Shield Block reaction with your blood shield. The blood shield has Hardness equal to four times the number of sanguimancy Hit Points you spent. After you use Shield Block, the blood shield dissipates, ending the circumstance bonus to AC early.

_desc_en:
Cost 1 or more sanguimancy Hit Points

You raise a defensive barrier of your own blood to protect you. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, increasing to a +2 bonus if you spend 10 or more sanguimancy Hit Points. While this bonus is in effect, you can use the Shield Block reaction with your blood shield. The blood shield has Hardness equal to four times the number of sanguimancy Hit Points you spent. After you use Shield Block, the blood shield dissipates, ending the circumstance bonus to AC early.
_desc_ko:
비용 1 이상 혈기 마법 HP

자신의 피로 방어막을 만들어 자신을 보호합니다. 다음 차례 시작 전까지 AC에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 10 이상의 생혈술 HP를 소모하면 +2 보너스로 증가합니다. 이 보너스가 적용되는 동안 피의 방패로 방패 막기 반응을 사용할 수 있습니다. 피의 방패는 소모한 생혈술 HP 수의 4배에 해당하는 경도를 가집니다. 방패 막기 사용 후 혈액 방패는 소멸되며, 이로 인해 AC에 적용되던 상황 보너스가 조기 종료됩니다.

name: Accompany

description.value:
Trigger An ally within 30 feet Casts a Spell.

You use your performance to supplement an ally's spellcasting, providing magical energy for their spell in their stead. Attempt a @Check[performance] check, using a very high DC for the ally's level, and either spend a Focus Point (if the triggering spell is a focus spell) or expend a spell slot at least 1 rank higher than the triggering spell. If you succeed at your Performance check, your ally's spell doesn't cost the Focus Point or spell slot that ally would normally need to spend.

_desc_en:
Trigger An ally within 30 feet Casts a Spell.

You use your performance to supplement an ally's spellcasting, providing magical energy for their spell in their stead. Attempt a @Check[performance] check, using a very high DC for the ally's level, and either spend a Focus Point (if the triggering spell is a focus spell) or expend a spell slot at least 1 rank higher than the triggering spell. If you succeed at your Performance check, your ally's spell doesn't cost the Focus Point or spell slot that ally would normally need to spend.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 30피트 내의 아군이 주문을 시전한다.

당신은 공연 능력으로 아군의 주문 시전을 보조하여, 그 대신 마법 에너지를 공급합니다. 공연 판정(아군 레벨에 비해 매우 높은 DC)를 시도하고, 포커스 주문인 경우 포커스 포인트를 소모하거나, 발동 주문보다 최소 1랭크 높은 주문 슬롯을 소모합니다. 연주 판정에서 성공하면, 아군의 주문은 원래 소모해야 할 포커스 포인트나 주문 슬롯을 소모하지 않는다.

name: Shared Assault

description.value: In the triumph of battle, you can share the glory with another ally. When the ally you chose for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Asb0UsQqeATsxqFJ]{Courageous Assault} critically succeeds at the Strike granted by that action, another ally affected by your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IAjvwqgiDr3qGYxY]{Courageous Anthem} composition spell can immediately use a reaction to make a melee Strike. This effect doesn't continue to a third ally, even if the second ally also critically succeeds.

_desc_en: In the triumph of battle, you can share the glory with another ally. When the ally you chose for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Asb0UsQqeATsxqFJ]{Courageous Assault} critically succeeds at the Strike granted by that action, another ally affected by your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IAjvwqgiDr3qGYxY]{Courageous Anthem} composition spell can immediately use a reaction to make a melee Strike. This effect doesn't continue to a third ally, even if the second ally also critically succeeds.
_desc_ko: 전투의 승리를 다른 아군과 함께 나눌 수 있습니다. @link[feats.courageous-assault]을 위해 선택한 아군이 해당 행동으로 부여된 공격에서 대성공을 거둘 경우, 당신의 @link[spells.courageous-anthem] 작곡 마법이 영향을 미친 다른 아군이 즉시 반응을 사용해 근접 공격을 할 수 있습니다. 이 효과는 두 번째 아군도 대성공을 하더라도 세 번째 아군에게는 계속되지 않습니다.

name: Brutal Bully

description.value: You push your foes around and leave bruises. While raging, when you successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} an enemy, you deal that enemy @Damage[@actor.abilities.str.mod[bludgeoning]]{bludgeoning} damage equal to your Strength modifier; add this to the damage from a critical success to Trip.

_desc_en: You push your foes around and leave bruises. While raging, when you successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} an enemy, you deal that enemy @Damage[@actor.abilities.str.mod[bludgeoning]]{bludgeoning} damage equal to your Strength modifier; add this to the damage from a critical success to Trip.
_desc_ko: 당신은 적을 제압하고 상처를 남깁니다. 분노 상태에서 @link[actions.disarm], @link[actions.grapple], @link[actions.reposition], @link[actions.shove], 또는 @link[actions.trip]에 성공하면, 해당 적에게 근력 능력치 수정자에 해당하는 타격 피해를 입힌다. 넘어뜨리기에 대성공 시 발생하는 피해에 이 수치를 추가한다.

name: Ranged Combatant

description.value:
Spines, flame jets, and holy blasts are just some of the ways your eidolon might strike from a distance. It gains a ranged unarmed attack with a range increment of 30 feet that deals 1d4 damage and has the magical and propulsive traits.

When you select this feat, choose a damage type: acid, bludgeoning, cold, electricity, fire, piercing, slashing, vitality, or void. If your eidolon is a celestial, fiend, or monitor with an alignment other than true neutral, you can choose a damage type in its alignment.

_desc_en:
Spines, flame jets, and holy blasts are just some of the ways your eidolon might strike from a distance. It gains a ranged unarmed attack with a range increment of 30 feet that deals 1d4 damage and has the magical and propulsive traits.

When you select this feat, choose a damage type: acid, bludgeoning, cold, electricity, fire, piercing, slashing, vitality, or void. If your eidolon is a celestial, fiend, or monitor with an alignment other than true neutral, you can choose a damage type in its alignment.
_desc_ko:
가시, 화염 분사, 신성한 폭발은 당신의 에이돌론이 거리에 있는 대상에게 강타할 수 있는 방법 중 일부에 불과합니다. 에이돌론은 사거리 30피트의 원거리 비무장 공격을 얻으며, 1d4의 피해를 주고 마법적 속성과 추진력을 지닙니다.

이 재주를 선택할 때, 다음 중 하나의 피해 유형을 선택하십시오: 산성, 타격, 냉기, 전기, 화염, 관통, 베기, 활력, 또는 공허. 당신의 에이돌론이 천상체, 핀드, 또는 모니터이며 진정한 중립이 아닌 성향을 가질 경우, 그 성향에 해당하는 피해 유형을 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Subjective Truth

description.value: Your disparate identities allow you to defeat magic that detects lies. As long as what you say is true from the point of view of your current identity, you can deceive effects like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aewxsale5xWEPKLk]{Ring of Truth} that reveal lies.

_desc_en: Your disparate identities allow you to defeat magic that detects lies. As long as what you say is true from the point of view of your current identity, you can deceive effects like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aewxsale5xWEPKLk]{Ring of Truth} that reveal lies.
_desc_ko: 당신의 분열된 정체성들은 거짓을 감지하는 마법을 무력화시킵니다. 현재의 정체성 관점에서 진실된 말을 하는 한, @link[spells.ring-of-truth]와 같은 거짓을 드러내는 효과를 속일 수 있습니다.

name: Abjure Harm

description.value:
Trigger You would take damage from an enemy's critical Strike.

You're nigh invincible, and it's clear that your foe is so far beneath you that they have no hope of winning. Spend 1 Mythic Point. The triggering Strike becomes a regular hit instead of a critical hit and you gain resistance to physical damage equal to your level until the beginning of your next turn. During your next turn, if you attempt a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} check against the triggering creature, you do so at mythic proficiency.

_desc_en:
Trigger You would take damage from an enemy's critical Strike.

You're nigh invincible, and it's clear that your foe is so far beneath you that they have no hope of winning. Spend 1 Mythic Point. The triggering Strike becomes a regular hit instead of a critical hit and you gain resistance to physical damage equal to your level until the beginning of your next turn. During your next turn, if you attempt a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} check against the triggering creature, you do so at mythic proficiency.
_desc_ko:
Trigger 적의 치명타로 피해를 입을 뻔했다.

당신은 거의 무적에 가까우며, 상대가 당신보다 훨씬 열세라 승산이 없다는 것이 명백해졌다. 신화 포인트 1점을 소모하세요. 발동된 치명타는 일반 타격으로 변경되며, 다음 턴 시작까지 레벨에 해당하는 물리 피해 저항력을 얻습니다. 다음 턴에 발동한 생물에게 @link[actions.demoralize] 판정을 시도할 경우, 신화 숙련도로 시도합니다.

name: Perfect Protection

description.value:
Your armor protects you from the deadliest hits. Each time you're critically hit while wearing the medium or heavy armor, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:14|showDC:all]. On a success, it becomes a normal hit.

Special If your armor has a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.8buhFcGwuaJRrp0y]{Fortification} rune, you roll only one flat check, but the DC is 12 (or 10 if it's a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ujWnpVMkbTljMGN9]{Greater Fortification} rune).

_desc_en:
Your armor protects you from the deadliest hits. Each time you're critically hit while wearing the medium or heavy armor, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:14|showDC:all]. On a success, it becomes a normal hit.

Special If your armor has a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.8buhFcGwuaJRrp0y]{Fortification} rune, you roll only one flat check, but the DC is 12 (or 10 if it's a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ujWnpVMkbTljMGN9]{Greater Fortification} rune).
_desc_ko:
당신의 갑옷은 가장 치명적인 공격으로부터 당신을 보호합니다. 평갑 또는 중갑을 착용한 상태에서 치명타를 당할 때마다 DC 14 단순을 시도하십시오. 성공 시 일반 타격으로 변경됩니다.

특수 갑옷에 @link[equipment.fortification] 룬이 새겨져 있다면, 단일 단순 판정만 굴림하나 DC는 12입니다(@link[equipment.fortification-greater] 룬일 경우 DC는 10).

name: Versatile Mutation

description.value:
Your ostilli's darts can deal different types of damage. When you Spit Ambient Magic, you can choose to have the ostilli deal bludgeoning or slashing damage instead of piercing damage. At 8th level, choose one of the following: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage; when your ostilli Spits Ambient Magic, it can deal that damage type instead and adds that trait to the action.

Special You can take this feat a second time at 16th level. When you do, choose two additional energy types from those available through this feat at 8th level; you can choose to have your ostilli deal that damage type when it Spits Ambient Magic.

_desc_en:
Your ostilli's darts can deal different types of damage. When you Spit Ambient Magic, you can choose to have the ostilli deal bludgeoning or slashing damage instead of piercing damage. At 8th level, choose one of the following: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage; when your ostilli Spits Ambient Magic, it can deal that damage type instead and adds that trait to the action.

Special You can take this feat a second time at 16th level. When you do, choose two additional energy types from those available through this feat at 8th level; you can choose to have your ostilli deal that damage type when it Spits Ambient Magic.
_desc_ko:
오스티리의 다트는 다양한 유형의 피해를 입힐 수 있습니다. 주변 마법을 뱉을 때, 오스티리가 관통 피해 대신 타격 피해나 베기 피해를 입히도록 선택할 수 있습니다. 8레벨에 도달하면 다음 중 하나를 선택하십시오: 산성, 냉기, 전기, 화염, 또는 음파 피해; 오스틸리가 주변 마법을 뱉을 때 해당 피해 유형을 대신 입힐 수 있으며, 해당 특성을 행동에 추가합니다.

특수 16레벨에 이 재주를 두 번째로 선택할 수 있습니다. 이때 (8th) 재주에서 선택 가능한 에너지 유형 중 두 가지를 추가로 선택하세요. 오스틸리가 주변 마법을 뱉을 때 해당 피해 유형을 입히도록 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Envenomed Edge

description.value: With a combination of your poison glands and herbal concoctions, you can consistently deliver venomous attacks when you hit an enemy's weak points. When you critically hit using a Strike with a weapon or unarmed attack and deal slashing or piercing damage with that Strike, you deal an additional 1d4 persistent poison damage to your target.

_desc_en: With a combination of your poison glands and herbal concoctions, you can consistently deliver venomous attacks when you hit an enemy's weak points. When you critically hit using a Strike with a weapon or unarmed attack and deal slashing or piercing damage with that Strike, you deal an additional 1d4 persistent poison damage to your target.
_desc_ko: 독샘과 약초 혼합물을 조합하여 적의 약점을 명중시킬 때 지속적으로 맹독 공격을 가할 수 있습니다. 무기 공격이나 비무장 공격으로 치명타를 기록하고 해당 공격으로 베기 또는 관통 피해를 입힐 경우, 대상에게 추가로 1d4 지속 독 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Searing Restoration

description.value:
They told you there was no way that explosions could heal people, but they were fools… Fools who didn't understand your brilliance! You create a minor explosion from your innovation, altering the combustion to cauterize wounds using vaporized medicinal herbs. You or a living creature adjacent to you regains @Damage[max(1,ceil(@actor.level/2))d10[healing]] Hit Points. In addition, the creature you heal can attempt an immediate flat check to recover from a single source of persistent bleed damage, with the DC reduction from appropriate assistance.

At 3rd level, and every 2 levels thereafter, increase the healing by 1d10.

Special If your innovation is a minion, it can take this action rather than you, though because it's not a living creature, it can't use the ability on itself.

_desc_en:
They told you there was no way that explosions could heal people, but they were fools… Fools who didn't understand your brilliance! You create a minor explosion from your innovation, altering the combustion to cauterize wounds using vaporized medicinal herbs. You or a living creature adjacent to you regains @Damage[max(1,ceil(@actor.level/2))d10[healing]] Hit Points. In addition, the creature you heal can attempt an immediate flat check to recover from a single source of persistent bleed damage, with the DC reduction from appropriate assistance.

At 3rd level, and every 2 levels thereafter, increase the healing by 1d10.

Special If your innovation is a minion, it can take this action rather than you, though because it's not a living creature, it can't use the ability on itself.
_desc_ko:
폭발로 사람을 치유할 수 없다는 말을 들었지만, 그들은 바보였어… 네 천재성을 이해하지 못한 바보들이었지! 당신은 혁신적인 방법으로 작은 폭발을 일으켜, 증발된 의약용 쑥 허브를 이용해 화상으로 상처를 소작합니다. 당신이나 당신과 인접한 생명체는 회복 HP를 회복합니다. 또한, 당신이 치유한 생명체는 지속 출혈 피해의 단일 원천으로부터 회복하기 위해 즉시 단순 판정을 시도할 수 있으며, 적절한 지원으로 난이도(DC)가 감소됩니다.

(3rd)레벨에 도달하고 이후 2레벨마다 치유량을 1d10 증가시킵니다.

특수 당신의 혁신이 하수인인 경우, 당신 대신 이 행동을 취할 수 있으나, 살아있는 생물이 아니므로 자신에게 이 능력을 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Sinking Jaws

description.value:
Like how a constrictor wraps itself around its next meal, your companion tightens its teeth around its constrained prey to squeeze the life out of it. Your companions with a qualifying unarmed attack learn the Sinking Jaws activity.

Sinking Jaws 1 Requirements This companion has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} with its jaws or fangs

Effect This companion's grabbed or restrained foe takes piercing damage equal to the companion's level plus Strength modifier.

value.value: animal companion with a jaws or fangs unarmed attack

_desc_en:
Like how a constrictor wraps itself around its next meal, your companion tightens its teeth around its constrained prey to squeeze the life out of it. Your companions with a qualifying unarmed attack learn the Sinking Jaws activity.

Sinking Jaws 1 Requirements This companion has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} with its jaws or fangs

Effect This companion's grabbed or restrained foe takes piercing damage equal to the companion's level plus Strength modifier.
_desc_ko:
뱀이 먹이를 감싸듯, 당신의 동료는 제압된 먹이를 이빨로 조여 생명을 짜냅니다. 비무장 공격을 가진 동료는 '잠수하는 턱' 행동을 습득합니다.

잠식하는 턱 1 요구 사항 이 동료는 턱이나 송곳니로 생물체를 @link[conditions.grabbed] 또는 @link[conditions.restrained] 상태로 만듭니다.

효과 이 동반자가 잡거나 제압한 적은 동반자의 레벨에 근력 능력치 수정자를 더한 만큼의 관통 피해를 받습니다.

name: Very Sneaky

description.value:
Taller folk rarely pay attention to the shadows at their feet, and you take full advantage of this. You can move 5 feet farther when you take the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} action, up to your Speed.

In addition, as long as you continue to use Sneak actions and succeed at your Stealth check, you don't become observed if you don't have cover or greater cover and aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} at the end of the Sneak action, as long as you have cover or greater cover or are concealed at the end of your turn.

_desc_en:
Taller folk rarely pay attention to the shadows at their feet, and you take full advantage of this. You can move 5 feet farther when you take the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} action, up to your Speed.

In addition, as long as you continue to use Sneak actions and succeed at your Stealth check, you don't become observed if you don't have cover or greater cover and aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} at the end of the Sneak action, as long as you have cover or greater cover or are concealed at the end of your turn.
_desc_ko:
키 큰 사람들은 발밑 그림자에 거의 신경 쓰지 않으며, 당신은 이를 최대한 활용한다. @link[actions.sneak] 행동을 취할 때, 당신의 이동 속도 범위 내에서 최대 5피트 더 멀리 이동할 수 있다.

또한, 은밀 이동 행동을 계속 사용하고 은밀 이동 판정에서 성공하는 한, 은밀 이동 행동 종료 시 은폐 또는 완전 엄폐가 없거나 @link[conditions.concealed]가 아니더라도, 자신의 턴 종료 시 은폐 또는 완전 엄폐가 있거나 은폐 상태라면 관찰되지 않는다.

name: Ghoran Weapon Familiarity

description.value: Over the course of your long, long existence, you've had a chance to practice with traditional ghoran weapons. You're trained with the glaive, greatclub, hatchet, scythe, and sickle. In addition, you gain access to all uncommon ghoran weapons. For the purpose of determining your proficiency, martial ghoran weapons are simple weapons and advanced ghoran weapons are martial weapons.

_desc_en: Over the course of your long, long existence, you've had a chance to practice with traditional ghoran weapons. You're trained with the glaive, greatclub, hatchet, scythe, and sickle. In addition, you gain access to all uncommon ghoran weapons. For the purpose of determining your proficiency, martial ghoran weapons are simple weapons and advanced ghoran weapons are martial weapons.
_desc_ko: 오랜 세월 동안 당신은 고란의 전통 무기를 다룰 기회를 가졌습니다. 글레이브, 그레이트클럽, 해쳇, 낫, 낫을 다루는 훈련을 받았습니다. 또한 모든 희귀 고란 무기를 사용할 수 있습니다. 숙련도 판정 시, 마르티얼 고란 무기는 단순 무기로, 어드밴스드 고란 무기는 마르티얼 무기로 간주됩니다.

name: Infiltrate Dream

description.value:
Entering a dream is as natural to you as stepping through a doorway. If you're adjacent to a sleeping creature, you can enter a lucid dreamlike state, a process taking 10 minutes, to mentally walk into their dreamscape. While in the target's dream, you witness its contents, plots, and emotional experiences as an observer, though nothing within the dream can perceive or interact with you. Your target becomes temporarily immune to Infiltrate Dream for 1 week. You can't enter the dreams of a creature that doesn't have a conscious mind or doesn't dream.

While within the dream, you can attempt an @Check[occultism|against:will] check against the target's Will DC to interpret symbolism and learn information about a single topic. If the target has no knowledge of the topic, you learn they don't know about the topic unless your result is a critical failure.

Critical Success You learn a piece of information directly relevant to the topic unless the target would want to hide it. If so, you learn something related to the topic but not a direct answer.

Success You receive a hint or clue about the topic. This clue won't be inaccurate, but it's cryptic, vague, or might be understandable only with additional information.

Critical Failure The dreams mislead you, and you learn an erroneous piece of information.

_desc_en:
Entering a dream is as natural to you as stepping through a doorway. If you're adjacent to a sleeping creature, you can enter a lucid dreamlike state, a process taking 10 minutes, to mentally walk into their dreamscape. While in the target's dream, you witness its contents, plots, and emotional experiences as an observer, though nothing within the dream can perceive or interact with you. Your target becomes temporarily immune to Infiltrate Dream for 1 week. You can't enter the dreams of a creature that doesn't have a conscious mind or doesn't dream.

While within the dream, you can attempt an @Check[occultism|against:will] check against the target's Will DC to interpret symbolism and learn information about a single topic. If the target has no knowledge of the topic, you learn they don't know about the topic unless your result is a critical failure.

Critical Success You learn a piece of information directly relevant to the topic unless the target would want to hide it. If so, you learn something related to the topic but not a direct answer.

Success You receive a hint or clue about the topic. This clue won't be inaccurate, but it's cryptic, vague, or might be understandable only with additional information.

Critical Failure The dreams mislead you, and you learn an erroneous piece of information.
_desc_ko:
꿈속으로 들어가는 것은 당신에게 문턱을 넘는 것만큼 자연스럽습니다. 잠든 생물과 인접해 있다면, 10분 이 소요되는 과정을 통해 명료한 꿈과 유사한 상태에 진입하여 정신적으로 그 생물의 꿈속으로 걸어 들어갈 수 있습니다. 대상 생물의 꿈 속에 있는 동안, 당신은 관찰자로서 그 내용과 줄거리, 감정적 경험을 목격하지만, 꿈 속의 어떤 것도 당신을 인지하거나 상호작용할 수 없습니다. 대상은 1주간 잠입의 꿈에 대해 일시적으로 면역이 됩니다. 의식이 없거나 꿈을 꾸지 않는 생물의 꿈에는 들어갈 수 없습니다.

꿈속에서 당신은 대상의 의지 DC에 맞서 오컬티즘 판정을 시도하여 상징을 해석하고 단일 주제에 대한 정보를 얻을 수 있습니다. 대상이 해당 주제에 대한 지식이 없다면, 당신의 결과가 대실패가 아닌 한 그 주제에 대해 모른다는 사실을 알게 됩니다.

대성공 대상이 {숨기}하지 않는 한 해당 주제와 직접 관련된 정보를 알게 됩니다. {숨기}하려 한다면 주제와 관련된 내용은 알 수 있으나 직접적인 답은 아닙니다.

성공 해당 주제에 대한 힌트나 단서를 얻습니다. 이 단서는 부정확하지는 않지만, 암

대실패 꿈이 당신을 오도하여 잘못된 정보를 알게 됩니다.

name: Demolish Defenses

description.value:
With a powerful blow, you crack a foe's armor or tough hide, opening it up for further attacks. Make a melee Strike. This Strike deals one additional weapon die of damage; if the target is your taunted enemy, this increases to two additional weapon die of damage. This counts as two attacks for the purposes of calculating your multiple attack penalty. If you hit and deal damage, the target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:guardian|options:inflicts:clumsy,inflicts:off-guard] saving throw against your class DC.

Critical Success The target takes no additional effect.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} until the end of your next turn. Once it loses this clumsy condition, it's off-guard for 1 round.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 3}.

_desc_en:
With a powerful blow, you crack a foe's armor or tough hide, opening it up for further attacks. Make a melee Strike. This Strike deals one additional weapon die of damage; if the target is your taunted enemy, this increases to two additional weapon die of damage. This counts as two attacks for the purposes of calculating your multiple attack penalty. If you hit and deal damage, the target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:guardian|options:inflicts:clumsy,inflicts:off-guard] saving throw against your class DC.

Critical Success The target takes no additional effect.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} until the end of your next turn. Once it loses this clumsy condition, it's off-guard for 1 round.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 3}.
_desc_ko:
강력한 일격으로 적의 갑옷이나 단단한 피부를 쪼개 추가 공격을 위한 길을 열어줍니다. 근접 공격을 수행하세요. 이 공격은 무기 주사위 1개를 추가로 피해로 입힙니다. 대상이 당신의 도발 대상 적일 경우, 추가 피해는 무기 주사위 2개로 증가합니다. 이것은 다중 공격 페널티 계산 시 두 번의 공격으로 간주됩니다. 명중하여 피해를 입힌 경우, 대상은 당신의 클래스 난이도(DC)에 대한 인내 내성 굴림을 시도해야 합니다.

대성공 대상은 추가 효과를 받지 않습니다.

성공 대상은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다.

실패 대상은 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.clumsy]{2} 상태가 됩니다. 이 둔함 상태가 해제되면 1라운드 동안 무방비 상태가 됩니다.

대실패 실패와 동일하나, 대상은 @link[conditions.clumsy]{3} 상태가 된다.

name: Deflecting Pulse

description.value: Your ostilli can use its stored magic to protect you from other magic, granting you the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.5g0gCXJnUVipYtW0]{Turn Aside Ambient Magic} action.

_desc_en: Your ostilli can use its stored magic to protect you from other magic, granting you the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.5g0gCXJnUVipYtW0]{Turn Aside Ambient Magic} action.
_desc_ko: 오스티리는 저장된 마법을 사용해 다른 마법으로부터 당신을 보호할 수 있으며, @link[actions.turn-aside-ambient-magic] 행동을 부여합니다.

name: Cascading Ray

description.value:
Requirements Your last action was a successful Spellstrike, and the spell you cast dealt energy damage (acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, sonic, vitality, or void).

Magical energy spills out to extend beyond the creature you struck. The flowing energy forms a ray with a range of 60 feet from the creature you damaged. You can't target any of the creatures you damaged with your Spellstrike with the ray. Make a spell attack roll against the new target's AC, at the same multiple attack penalty as the Strike. On a hit, the target of the ray takes 1d4 damage per spell rank of the same type of energy damage the spell deals (double damage on a critical hit). If you cast the spell in your Spellstrike from a spell slot, the damage from Cascading Ray increases to 1d8 damage per spell rank.

If the spell deals more than one type of energy damage, you choose only one for the ray. This ray has the attack trait, the school and tradition traits of the original spell, and the trait matching the damage type.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your last action was a successful Spellstrike, and the spell you cast dealt energy damage (acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, sonic, vitality, or void).

Magical energy spills out to extend beyond the creature you struck. The flowing energy forms a ray with a range of 60 feet from the creature you damaged. You can't target any of the creatures you damaged with your Spellstrike with the ray. Make a spell attack roll against the new target's AC, at the same multiple attack penalty as the Strike. On a hit, the target of the ray takes 1d4 damage per spell rank of the same type of energy damage the spell deals (double damage on a critical hit). If you cast the spell in your Spellstrike from a spell slot, the damage from Cascading Ray increases to 1d8 damage per spell rank.

If the spell deals more than one type of energy damage, you choose only one for the ray. This ray has the attack trait, the school and tradition traits of the original spell, and the trait matching the damage type.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 마지막 행동으로 성공적인 스펠스트라이크를 사용했으며, 시전한 주문이 에너지 피해(산성, 냉기, 전기, 화염, 힘, 음파, 활력 또는 공허)를 입혔습니다.

마법 에너지가 흘러나와 당신이 공격한 생물 너머로 확장됩니다. 흐르는 에너지는 피해를 입힌 생물로부터 60피트 범위의 광선을 형성합니다. 당신은 이 광선으로 스펠스트라이크로 피해를 입힌 생물들을 표적으로 삼을 수 없습니다. 새로운 표적의 AC에 대해 마법 명중 굴림을 수행하며, 다중 공격 페널티에 따른 페널티는 스펠스트라이크와 동일하게 적용됩니다. 명중 시, 광선의 대상은 해당 주문이 주는 에너지 피해 유형과 동일한 1d4의 피해를 주문 랭크당 받습니다(치명타 시 피해는 두 배). 스펠스트라이크를 위해 주문 슬롯을 사용해 주문을 시전한 경우, 캐스케이딩 레이의 피해는 주문 랭크당 1d8로 증가합니다.

주문이 두 가지 이상의 에너지 피해 유형을 입히는 경우, 광선에는 하나의 유형만 선택됩니다. 이 광선은 공격 특성과 원주문의 학파 및 전통 특성을 가지며, 피해 유형에 해당하는 특성을 갖습니다.

name: Natural Performer

description.value: Entertainment comes naturally to you. You become trained in Performance and gain one 1st-level Performance skill feat.

_desc_en: Entertainment comes naturally to you. You become trained in Performance and gain one 1st-level Performance skill feat.
_desc_ko: 엔터테인먼트는 당신에게 타고난 재능이다. 공연에 숙련되고 1레벨 공연 기술 피트 하나를 얻는다.

name: Emotional Partitions

description.value: You have created strong mental partitions in your mind to filter out negative emotional influences. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on saving throws against emotion effects. If you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: You have created strong mental partitions in your mind to filter out negative emotional influences. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on saving throws against emotion effects. If you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 부정적인 감정적 영향을 걸러내기 위해 마음속에 강력한 정신적 장벽을 세웠습니다. 감정 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 감정 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴렸다면, 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Malleable Form

description.value:
Requirements You're polymorphed by a spell that has multiple choices of battle form.

You adroitly shift your form, taking on another appearance. Choose a different battle form of the polymorph spell affecting you, and change to that form instead of the current one. This destabilizes the spell's magic, reducing its duration by 1 round. Use the rank of the spell to determine the statistics, as normal.

value.value: ability to cast at least one polymorph spell

_desc_en:
Requirements You're polymorphed by a spell that has multiple choices of battle form.

You adroitly shift your form, taking on another appearance. Choose a different battle form of the polymorph spell affecting you, and change to that form instead of the current one. This destabilizes the spell's magic, reducing its duration by 1 round. Use the rank of the spell to determine the statistics, as normal.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 전투 형태를 여러 가지로 선택할 수 있는 주문에 의해 변형되었습니다.

당신은 재빠르게 형태를 바꿔 다른 모습으로 변신합니다. 자신에게 걸린 변신 마법의 다른 전투 형태를 선택하여 현재 형태 대신 그 형태로 바꿉니다. 이로 인해 마법의 안정성이 떨어지며 지속 시간이 1라운드 감소합니다. 능력치는 평소처럼 마법 랭크을 기준으로 결정합니다.

name: Major Deific Power

description.value: As your apotheosis into living godhood approaches, you accrue the strongest of divine power. Choose three common divine spells, one of 6th rank, one of 7th rank, and one of 8th rank. You can cast each of these spells as divine innate spells once per day.

_desc_en: As your apotheosis into living godhood approaches, you accrue the strongest of divine power. Choose three common divine spells, one of 6th rank, one of 7th rank, and one of 8th rank. You can cast each of these spells as divine innate spells once per day.
_desc_ko: 살아있는 신격으로의 신격화가 다가옴에 따라, 당신은 가장 강력한 신성 권능을 축적한다. 일반 신성 주문 세 개를 선택하되, 하나는 6랭크, 하나는 7랭크, 하나는 8랭크로 선택하라. 당신은 이 각 주문을 하루 1회 신성 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있다.

name: Battle-Hardened Companion

description.value:
Accompanying you across countless battlefields has allowed your companion to unleash its full potential. The companion you gained with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.cxWEBBu8oyKTrqbi]{Commander's Companion} is now a nimble or savage animal companion.

Your animal companion is more readily responsive to your will. During an encounter, even if you don't use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{Command an Animal} action, your animal companion can still use 1 action that round on your turn to Stride or Strike. If it does, it also gains a reaction it can use to respond to your tactics, but that's all the actions it gets that round—you can't Command it later.

_desc_en:
Accompanying you across countless battlefields has allowed your companion to unleash its full potential. The companion you gained with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.cxWEBBu8oyKTrqbi]{Commander's Companion} is now a nimble or savage animal companion.

Your animal companion is more readily responsive to your will. During an encounter, even if you don't use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{Command an Animal} action, your animal companion can still use 1 action that round on your turn to Stride or Strike. If it does, it also gains a reaction it can use to respond to your tactics, but that's all the actions it gets that round—you can't Command it later.
_desc_ko:
수많은 전장을 함께 누비며 동행한 덕분에 동반자가 잠재력을 완전히 발휘하게 되었습니다. 커맨더의 동반자로 얻은 동행자는 이제 민첩하거나 사나운 동물 동료가 되었습니다.

당신의 동물 동료는 당신의 의지에 더 민첩하게 반응합니다. 교전 중, 당신이 '동물을 지휘하다' 행동을 사용하지 않더라도, 당신의 동물 동료는 당신의 턴에 그 라운드에 1번의 행동으로 '이동'이나 '공격'을 할 수 있습니다. 그렇게 할 경우, 당신의 전술에 대응하기 위해 사용할 수 있는 반응도 얻지만, 그게 그 라운드에 할 수 있는 전부입니다-나중에 커맨더할 수 없습니다.

name: Blazing Streak

description.value:
Requirements You're in Stoked Flame Stance.

Stride twice, making Strikes against up to four different creatures within reach at any point during your movement. Flashing sparks Strikes made during Blazing Streak deal fire damage instead of slashing.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're in Stoked Flame Stance.

Stride twice, making Strikes against up to four different creatures within reach at any point during your movement. Flashing sparks Strikes made during Blazing Streak deal fire damage instead of slashing.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 불타는 화염 자세를 취하고 있습니다.

두 번의 큰 걸음으로 이동하며, 이동 중 언제든지 도달 범위 내 최대 네 마리의 서로 다른 생물에게 타격을 가합니다. 번쩍이는 불꽃 타격이 날아갑니다. 불꽃의 질주 중 가한 타격은 베기 대신 화염 피해를 줍니다.

name: Leaping Hedgehog Strike

description.value: You pounce toward an enemy and then barrel them over with one fluid movement, ending this maneuver with an attack that may catch them off-balance. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} horizontally toward an enemy you can see; treat your Speed as 30 feet or more for this Leap if it is less than 30 feet. If you end this movement adjacent to that enemy, attempt an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} that enemy's space. On a success, the target is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. You then Strike that same enemy. If the target has been knocked prone, you can spend 1 Mythic Point as part of this Strike to make it at mythic proficiency.

_desc_en: You pounce toward an enemy and then barrel them over with one fluid movement, ending this maneuver with an attack that may catch them off-balance. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} horizontally toward an enemy you can see; treat your Speed as 30 feet or more for this Leap if it is less than 30 feet. If you end this movement adjacent to that enemy, attempt an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} that enemy's space. On a success, the target is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. You then Strike that same enemy. If the target has been knocked prone, you can spend 1 Mythic Point as part of this Strike to make it at mythic proficiency.
_desc_ko: 적에게 달려들며 유연한 동작으로 상대를 밀어넘긴 후, 균형을 잃은 상대를 공격하는 동작으로 마무리한다. @link[actions.leap] 시야 내의 적을 향해 수평으로 도약합니다. 도약 거리가 30피트 미만일 경우, 이 도약에 대한 당신의 이동 속도를 30피트 이상으로 간주합니다. 이 이동을 해당 적과 인접한 위치에서 종료할 경우, @link[actions.tumble-through]를 위해 곡예 판정을 시도합니다. 성공 시 대상은 @link[conditions.prone] 상태가 된다. 이후 동일한 적을 공격한다. 대상이 넘어짐 상태라면, 이 공격 시 신화적 숙련도로 수행하기 위해 신화 포인트 1점을 소모할 수 있다.

name: Double Slice

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding two melee weapons, each in a different hand.

You lash out at your foe with both weapons. Make two Strikes, one with each of your two melee weapons, each using your current multiple attack penalty. Both Strikes must have the same target. If the second Strike is made with a weapon that doesn't have the agile trait, it takes a –2 penalty.

If both attacks hit, combine their damage, and then add any other applicable effects from both weapons. You add any precision damage only once, to the attack of your choice. Combine the damage from both Strikes and apply resistances and weaknesses only once. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding two melee weapons, each in a different hand.

You lash out at your foe with both weapons. Make two Strikes, one with each of your two melee weapons, each using your current multiple attack penalty. Both Strikes must have the same target. If the second Strike is made with a weapon that doesn't have the agile trait, it takes a –2 penalty.

If both attacks hit, combine their damage, and then add any other applicable effects from both weapons. You add any precision damage only once, to the attack of your choice. Combine the damage from both Strikes and apply resistances and weaknesses only once. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손에 각각 다른 근접 무기를 들고 있습니다.

두 무기로 적을 동시에 공격합니다. 각각의 근접 무기로 한 번씩, 총 두 번의 공격을 가합니다. 각 공격은 현재의 다중 공격 페널티를 적용받습니다. 두 공격은 반드시 동일한 대상을 겨냥해야 합니다. 두 번째 공격이 기민한 특성이 없는 무기로 수행될 경우, -2 페널티를 받습니다.

두 공격이 모두 명중하면, 두 무기의 피해를 합산하고 양쪽 무기에 적용되는 기타 효과를 추가한다. 정밀 피해는 선택한 공격에 한 번만 추가한다. 두 공격의 피해를 합산하고 저항 및 약점은 한 번만 적용한다. 이 공격은 다중 공격 페널티 계산 시 두 번의 공격으로 간주된다.

name: Dragon Disciple Dedication

description.value:
Access You are a kobold with the dragonscaled or spellscaled heritage, a dragon instinct barbarian, or a draconic bloodline sorcerer.

You choose to study or worship one type of dragon, and your focus grants you a measure of its power. You become trained in arcane spell DCs and arcane spell attack rolls. Choose one color of dragon when you select this feat; if you are a sorcerer with the draconic bloodline, this must be the same type as your bloodline.

You gain resistance equal to half your level against one type of damage determined by the chosen dragon type. The GM may allow you to choose a dragon type not listed below, and will determine the damage type appropriate for that dragon.

  • Black or Copper Acid
  • Blue, Bronze, or Cloud Electricity
  • Brass, Gold, or Red Fire
  • Green Poison
  • Silver or White Cold

You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against sleep effects and effects that would make you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}.

Special If you later take the sorcerer archetype, you must choose the draconic bloodline.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.SO9d7RSf1zqmTlmW]{Dragon Disciple}
