@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.SO9d7RSf1zqmTlmW]{Dragon Disciple}
_desc_ko:
Access 당신은 드래곤스케일 또는 스펠스케일 혈통을 가진 코볼트, 드래곤 본능 바바리안, 혹은 드라코닉 혈통 소서러입니다.

당신은 한 종류의 드래곤을 연구하거나 숭배하기로 선택하며, 그 포커스는 당신에게 그 힘의 일부를 부여합니다. 당신은 아케인 주문 난이도(DC)와 아케인 주문 명중 굴림에 숙련됩니다. 이 재주를 선택할 때 한 가지 용의 색을 선택하십시오. 드라코닉 혈통을 가진 소서러라면, 이는 반드시 당신의 혈통과 같은 종류여야 합니다.

선택한 용의 종류에 따라 한 가지 피해 유형에 대해 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 저항력을 얻습니다. GM은 아래에 나열되지 않은 용의 종류를 선택하도록 허용할 수 있으며, 해당 용에 적합한 피해 유형을 결정합니다.

  • 검은색 또는 구리색 산성
  • 푸른색, 청동색 또는 구름색전기
  • 황동, 금색 또는 빨간색 불
  • 녹색 독
  • 은색 또는 흰색 냉기

또한 수면 효과 및 @link[conditions.paralyzed] 상태를 유발하는 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

Special 이후 소서러 아키타입을 선택할 경우 반드시 드라코닉 혈통을 선택해야 합니다.

name: Mature Megafauna Companion

description.value: You've raised your megafauna companion to be a more powerful force on the battlefield than most of its kind. The companion you gained through the Mammoth Lord Dedication feat becomes a mature animal companion, granting it additional capabilities. During an encounter, even if you don't use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{Command an Animal} action, your megafauna animal companion can still use 1 action on your turn to Stride or Strike.

_desc_en: You've raised your megafauna companion to be a more powerful force on the battlefield than most of its kind. The companion you gained through the Mammoth Lord Dedication feat becomes a mature animal companion, granting it additional capabilities. During an encounter, even if you don't use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{Command an Animal} action, your megafauna animal companion can still use 1 action on your turn to Stride or Strike.
_desc_ko: 당신은 메가파우나 동반자를 그 종족 대부분보다 전장에서 더 강력한 존재로 키워냈습니다. 매머드 군주 헌신 재주로 얻은 동반자는 성숙한 동물 동료가 되어 추가 능력을 부여받습니다. 교전 중에는 @link[actions.command-an-animal] 행동을 사용하지 않더라도, 당신의 초대형 동물 동료는 당신의 턴에 1개의 행동을 사용하여 이동하거나 공격할 수 있습니다.

name: Avatar's Audience

description.value: Your extensive service affords you certain divine privileges. First, any creature you encounter knows instinctively that you speak for your deity. Second, if you conduct the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7DN13ILADW2N9Z1t]{Commune} ritual to contact your deity, you don't have to pay any cost, and you automatically get a critical success. Third, once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5bTt2CvYHPvaR7QQ]{Interplanar Teleport} as a divine innate spell, but only to travel to the realm of your deity. When you cast it this way, its casting time is 1 minute, your religious symbol is a sufficient planar key for this spell, and you appear exactly where you want to be. If you're in your deity's realm due to this spell, you can return to the point you left when you cast it by spending a single action, which has the concentrate and divine traits.

_desc_en: Your extensive service affords you certain divine privileges. First, any creature you encounter knows instinctively that you speak for your deity. Second, if you conduct the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7DN13ILADW2N9Z1t]{Commune} ritual to contact your deity, you don't have to pay any cost, and you automatically get a critical success. Third, once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5bTt2CvYHPvaR7QQ]{Interplanar Teleport} as a divine innate spell, but only to travel to the realm of your deity. When you cast it this way, its casting time is 1 minute, your religious symbol is a sufficient planar key for this spell, and you appear exactly where you want to be. If you're in your deity's realm due to this spell, you can return to the point you left when you cast it by spending a single action, which has the concentrate and divine traits.
_desc_ko: 당신의 오랜 봉사는 특정 신성한 특권을 부여합니다. 첫째, 당신이 만나는 모든 생물은 본능적으로 당신이 신을 대변한다는 것을 압니다. 둘째, 신과 접촉하기 위해 @link[spells.commune] 의식을 행할 때 비용을 지불할 필요가 없으며, 자동으로 대성공 을 얻습니다. 셋째, 하루에 한 번, @link[spells.interplanar-teleport]을 신성 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있으나, 오직 당신의 신의 영역으로만 이동할 수 있습니다. 이 방식으로 시전할 경우, 시전 시간은 1분이며, 당신의 종교적 상징은 이 주문에 대한 충분한 차원 열쇠 역할을 합니다. 또한 당신은 정확히 원하는 위치에 나타납니다. 이 주문으로 인해 신의 영역에 있는 경우, 집중과 신성 특성을 가진 액션 하나를 소모하여 주문을 시전했을 때 떠났던 지점으로 돌아갈 수 있다.

name: Arcane Dragonblood

description.value: You descend from a dragon that wields mastery of their magical abilities, such as a fortune dragon or mirage dragon. As such, you can instinctively grasp the intricacies of magic. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Arcana. If you would automatically become trained in Arcana (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.blMeVamjGz4ODWxq]{Arcane Sense} skill feat. If you choose a draconic exemplar, you must choose an arcane dragon.

_desc_en: You descend from a dragon that wields mastery of their magical abilities, such as a fortune dragon or mirage dragon. As such, you can instinctively grasp the intricacies of magic. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Arcana. If you would automatically become trained in Arcana (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.blMeVamjGz4ODWxq]{Arcane Sense} skill feat. If you choose a draconic exemplar, you must choose an arcane dragon.
_desc_ko: 당신은 포츈 드래곤이나 신기루 용처럼 마법 능력을 완벽히 구사하는 용의 후예입니다. 따라서 마법의 복잡한 원리를 본능적으로 이해할 수 있습니다. 당신은 주문학에 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 주문학에 자동으로 숙련된 상태가 된다면, 대신 선택한 기술에 숙련된 상태가 됩니다. 당신은 @link[feats.arcane-sense] 기술 피트를 얻습니다. 드라코닉 이그젬플러를 선택할 경우, 반드시 아케인 드라곤을 선택해야 합니다.

name: Lightless Litheness

description.value: Your body is almost as flexible as your shadow. When you critically fail at Squeezing, you get a failure instead. Additionally, when you roll a success at an Escape check, you get a critical success instead; if you roll a critical success, you can Step instead of Striding up to 5 feet.

_desc_en: Your body is almost as flexible as your shadow. When you critically fail at Squeezing, you get a failure instead. Additionally, when you roll a success at an Escape check, you get a critical success instead; if you roll a critical success, you can Step instead of Striding up to 5 feet.
_desc_ko: 당신의 몸은 그림자만큼이나 유연합니다. 좁은 공간 통과에 대실패를 하면 대신 실패로 처리됩니다. 또한 탈출 판정에서 성공을 굴리면 대신 대성공을 얻습니다; 치명적 성공을 굴리면 최대 5피트까지 신중하게 발걸음 대신 발걸음을 할 수 있습니다.

name: Fading

description.value:
Frequency once per @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.M2V1vqAziOkWV30B]{Crimson Shroud}

Trigger You are targeted with a Strike by someone you can detect.

Requirements Your Crimson Shroud is active.

You partially fade from reality. The attacker must attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11]; on a failure, the attack passes harmlessly through the image of your body that remains behind. An instant later you return to reality, and your Crimson Shroud ends.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.M2V1vqAziOkWV30B]{Crimson Shroud}

Trigger You are targeted with a Strike by someone you can detect.

Requirements Your Crimson Shroud is active.

You partially fade from reality. The attacker must attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11]; on a failure, the attack passes harmlessly through the image of your body that remains behind. An instant later you return to reality, and your Crimson Shroud ends.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 {진홍의 장막}

발동 시마다 한 번

발동 조건 감지 가능한 대상이 당신을 타겟으로 삼아 공격합니다.

요구 사항 당신의 진홍색 장막이 활성화되어 있어야 합니다.

당신은 현실에서 부분적으로 사라집니다. 공격자는 DC 11 단순를 시도해야 합니다. 실패 시, 공격은 뒤에 남은 당신의 신체 형상을 무해하게 통과합니다. 순간 후 당신은 현실로 돌아오고, 당신의 진홍색 장막은 종료됩니다.

name: Verdant Metamorphosis

description.value: You have turned into a plant version of yourself, gaining the plant trait and losing traits inappropriate for your new form (typically humanoid). You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JAka1VWMPGOm5JpR]{Verdant Rest} action.

_desc_en: You have turned into a plant version of yourself, gaining the plant trait and losing traits inappropriate for your new form (typically humanoid). You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JAka1VWMPGOm5JpR]{Verdant Rest} action.
_desc_ko: 당신은 식물 형태로 변신하여 식물 특성을 얻고, 새로운 형태(일반적으로 인간형)에 부적합한 특성을 잃습니다. 또한 @link[actions.verdant-rest] 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Swap Reflections

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You've learned how to use even your reflection to your advantage. You send your own reflection to forcibly swap places with the reflection of an enemy, pulling each of you through opposite ends and switching places. The enemy must be within 120 feet, you must both be adjacent to reflective surfaces (such as glass, mirrors, or calm water), and you must be able to see the target's reflection and have line of effect to it. The target attempts a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your spell DC or class DC, whichever is higher.

Critical Success The spell has no effect.

Success You swap positions with your target or arrive adjacent to your target, whichever your target prefers.

Failure You swap positions with your target or arrive adjacent to your target, whichever you prefer.

Critical Failure You instantaneously swap positions with your target, and the target becomes trapped in its own reflection for 1 minute. Once on each of its turns, the target can spend 1 action to attempt another Will save to escape. If the save succeeds, the effect ends early.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You've learned how to use even your reflection to your advantage. You send your own reflection to forcibly swap places with the reflection of an enemy, pulling each of you through opposite ends and switching places. The enemy must be within 120 feet, you must both be adjacent to reflective surfaces (such as glass, mirrors, or calm water), and you must be able to see the target's reflection and have line of effect to it. The target attempts a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your spell DC or class DC, whichever is higher.

Critical Success The spell has no effect.

Success You swap positions with your target or arrive adjacent to your target, whichever your target prefers.

Failure You swap positions with your target or arrive adjacent to your target, whichever you prefer.

Critical Failure You instantaneously swap positions with your target, and the target becomes trapped in its own reflection for 1 minute. Once on each of its turns, the target can spend 1 action to attempt another Will save to escape. If the save succeeds, the effect ends early.
_desc_ko:
발동 주기 10분마다 1회

당신은 자신의 반사상마저 유리하게 활용하는 법을 터득했습니다. 자신의 반사상을 보내 적의 반사상과 강제로 자리를 바꾸게 하여, 서로 반대편 끝으로 끌어당겨 위치를 교환합니다. 적은 120피트 이내에 있어야 하며, 양측 모두 반사 표면(유리, 거울, 잔잔한 물 등)에 인접해 있어야 합니다. 또한 대상의 반사를 볼 수 있고 효과 선상에 있어야 합니다. 대상은 당신의 주문 DC(DC) 또는 직업 DC(DC) 중 더 높은 쪽에 대해 의지 내성 굴림을 시도합니다.

대성공 주문이 효과가 없습니다.

성공 당신은 대상과 위치를 바꾸거나 대상이 원하는 대로 대상과 인접한 위치에 도착합니다.

실패 당신은 대상과 위치를 바꾸거나 대상과 인접한 위치에 도착합니다. 원하는 쪽을 선택하세요.

대실패 당신은 즉시 대상과 위치를 바꾸며, 대상은 1분 동안 자신의 반사상에 갇히게 됩니다. 대상은 자신의 턴마다 한 번씩, 1개의 행동을 소모하여 탈출을 위한 또 다른 의지 내성을 시도할 수 있습니다. 내성에 성공하면 효과가 조기에 종료됩니다.

name: Directed Audience

description.value: You can shape the area of your composition spells. Whenever you cast a composition spell whose area is an emanation, you can change the spell's area to a cone 10 feet larger, to a maximum of twice the original area. For example, you could modify a composition spell that affects a @Template[emanation|distance:30] to affect a @Template[cone|distance:40], but a @Template[emanation|distance:5] could only become a @Template[cone|distance:10].

_desc_en: You can shape the area of your composition spells. Whenever you cast a composition spell whose area is an emanation, you can change the spell's area to a cone 10 feet larger, to a maximum of twice the original area. For example, you could modify a composition spell that affects a @Template[emanation|distance:30] to affect a @Template[cone|distance:40], but a @Template[emanation|distance:5] could only become a @Template[cone|distance:10].
_desc_ko: 당신은 조성 마법의 범위를 조정할 수 있습니다. 발산형 범위를 가진 조성 마법을 시전할 때마다, 해당 마법의 범위를 원뿔형으로 변경하여 10피트까지 확장할 수 있습니다. 최대 확장 범위는 원래 범위의 두 배까지입니다. 예를 들어, 30피트을 대상으로 하는 조성 주문을 40피트을 대상으로 하는 것으로 수정자할 수 있지만, 5피트은 10피트로만 변경할 수 있습니다.

name: Penetrating Shot

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a ranged weapon.

You shoot clear through an intervening creature to hit your prey. Choose a target that is giving lesser cover to your hunted prey. Make a single ranged Strike with the required weapon against the chosen target and your hunted prey. This attack ignores any lesser cover the chosen target provides your hunted prey. Roll damage only once, and apply it to each creature you hit. A Penetrating Shot counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a ranged weapon.

You shoot clear through an intervening creature to hit your prey. Choose a target that is giving lesser cover to your hunted prey. Make a single ranged Strike with the required weapon against the chosen target and your hunted prey. This attack ignores any lesser cover the chosen target provides your hunted prey. Roll damage only once, and apply it to each creature you hit. A Penetrating Shot counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 원거리 무기를 사용 중입니다.

당신은 사냥감을 맞히기 위해 중간에 있는 생물을 관통하여 쏘아댑니다. 사냥감에게 반엄폐를 제공하는 대상을 선택하십시오. 선택한 대상과 사냥감 모두에게 필요한 무기로 단일 원거리 공격을 수행하십시오. 이 공격은 선택한 대상이 사냥감에게 제공하는 반엄폐를 무시합니다. 피해 주사위는 한 번만 굴리고, 명중한 모든 생물에게 적용한다. 관통 사격은 다중 공격 페널티 계산 시 두 번의 공격으로 간주된다.

name: One Among the Masses

description.value: It will take more than a gathered mass of foes to take you down. You gain resistance equal to your level to damage dealt by swarms, troops, and creatures who occupy the same space as you. In addition, you can briefly menace large groups of enemies to step aside. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QGeA2sPtDdryTpWw]{Overawe Crowd} activity.

_desc_en: It will take more than a gathered mass of foes to take you down. You gain resistance equal to your level to damage dealt by swarms, troops, and creatures who occupy the same space as you. In addition, you can briefly menace large groups of enemies to step aside. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QGeA2sPtDdryTpWw]{Overawe Crowd} activity.
_desc_ko: 수많은 적들이 모여도 너를 쓰러뜨리기는 어렵다. 당신은 스웜, 군대, 그리고 당신과 같은 공간을 차지하는 생물들이 가하는 피해에 대해 레벨에 해당하는 저항력을 얻습니다. 또한, 당신은 잠시 동안 대규모 적군을 위협하여 물러서게 할 수 있습니다. 당신은@link[actions.overawe-crowd] 능력을 얻습니다.

name: Quick Juggler

description.value: When you start to juggle or add another item to those you are Juggling, you add two items instead of one. Increase the maximum number of items you can Juggle by one.

publication.title: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On

_desc_en: When you start to juggle or add another item to those you are Juggling, you add two items instead of one. Increase the maximum number of items you can Juggle by one.
_desc_ko: 저글링을 시작하거나 저글링 중인 아이템에 다른 아이템을 추가할 때, 하나 대신 두 개를 추가합니다. 저글링 가능한 최대 아이템 수를 1개 증가시킵니다.

name: Cunning Hair

description.value: Your hair moves under your control. You can perform simple @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} actions with your hair, such as opening an unlocked door. Your hair can't perform actions that require fingers or significant manual dexterity, including any action that would require a check to accomplish, and you can't use it to hold items.

_desc_en: Your hair moves under your control. You can perform simple @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} actions with your hair, such as opening an unlocked door. Your hair can't perform actions that require fingers or significant manual dexterity, including any action that would require a check to accomplish, and you can't use it to hold items.
_desc_ko: 당신의 머리카락은 당신의 통제 하에 움직입니다. 잠금 해제된 문을 여는 것과 같은 간단한 @link[actions.interact] 행동을 머리카락으로 수행할 수 있습니다. 손가락이나 상당한 손재주가 필요한 행동(판정해야 하는 모든 행동 포함)은 수행할 수 없으며, 물건을 잡는 데 사용할 수도 없습니다.

name: Divine Countermeasures

description.value: You've studied your extraplanar heritage with the intent of better defending yourself, whether against creatures aligned with or opposed to your extraplanar lineage, and you've found that your techniques are equally powerful against celestials, fiends, and other divine entities. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all saving throws against divine effects.

_desc_en: You've studied your extraplanar heritage with the intent of better defending yourself, whether against creatures aligned with or opposed to your extraplanar lineage, and you've found that your techniques are equally powerful against celestials, fiends, and other divine entities. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all saving throws against divine effects.
_desc_ko: 당신은 초월계 혈통과 성향이 일치하거나 대립하는 존재들로부터 자신을 더 잘 방어하기 위해 초월계 유산을 연구해왔으며, 그 기술이 천상체, 핀드, 기타 신성 존재에게도 동등하게 강력하다는 것을 발견했습니다. 신성 효과에 대한 모든 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Intercepting Hand

description.value: Your particular martial art includes various defensive actions designed to remove your opponent's ability to cause harm. Your fist unarmed attack gains the disarm trait. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.jl1euufxNpAhVt26]{Disarming Interception} action.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your particular martial art includes various defensive actions designed to remove your opponent's ability to cause harm. Your fist unarmed attack gains the disarm trait. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.jl1euufxNpAhVt26]{Disarming Interception} action.
_desc_ko: 당신의 특정 무술에는 상대의 공격 능력을 제거하기 위한 다양한 방어 기술이 포함됩니다. 당신의 주먹 비무장 공격은 무장 해제 특성을 얻습니다. 당신은 @link[actions.disarming-interception] 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Return to the Pit!

description.value: You can send the fiends who have vexed you back to their home plane where they belong. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.bay4AfSu2iIozNNW]{Banishment} once per day as a divine innate spell. When you take this feat, you craft a personal symbol of the Hellbreakers League that's anathema to devils. If you wield this symbol in one hand when you spend an extra action while casting banishment on a devil, you don't need to pay the extra cost to give that creature a –2 circumstance penalty to its save.

_desc_en: You can send the fiends who have vexed you back to their home plane where they belong. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.bay4AfSu2iIozNNW]{Banishment} once per day as a divine innate spell. When you take this feat, you craft a personal symbol of the Hellbreakers League that's anathema to devils. If you wield this symbol in one hand when you spend an extra action while casting banishment on a devil, you don't need to pay the extra cost to give that creature a –2 circumstance penalty to its save.
_desc_ko: 당신은 당신을 괴롭힌 악마들을 그들이 속한 고향 차원으로 돌려보낼 수 있다. 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.bay4AfSu2iIozNNW]{추방}을 하루 1회 신성 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있다. 이 재주를 취할 때, 당신은 데빌에게 금기시되는 헬브레이커스 연맹의 개인 상징을 제작한다. 데빌에게 추방을 시전하며 추가 행동을 소비할 때 이 상징을 한 손에 들고 있다면, 그 생물에게 내성에 대한 -2 상황 페널티를 주기 위한 추가 비용을 지불할 필요가 없다.

name: Eldritch Archer Dedication

description.value:
You channel powerful magic with your archery, allowing you to deliver potent spells through the tip of an arrow rather than the more mundane flick of the wrist or whatever other gestures are usually used.

If you don't already cast spells from spell slots, you learn to cast spontaneous spells and gain the Cast a Spell activity. You gain a spell repertoire with one cantrip of your choice, from a tradition of your choice. You choose a common cantrip or other cantrip to which you have access. This cantrip must require a spell attack roll and come from your chosen tradition. You're trained in spell attack modifier and spell DC. Your key spellcasting attribute for these spells is Charisma. Regardless of whether you can already cast spells or gained the ability from this dedication, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DS9sDOWkXrz2xmHi]{Eldritch Shot} activity.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.6A9zBmTyt8cn6ioa]{Eldritch Archer}

value.value: expert in at least one weapon from the bow or crossbow weapon group

_desc_en:
You channel powerful magic with your archery, allowing you to deliver potent spells through the tip of an arrow rather than the more mundane flick of the wrist or whatever other gestures are usually used.

If you don't already cast spells from spell slots, you learn to cast spontaneous spells and gain the Cast a Spell activity. You gain a spell repertoire with one cantrip of your choice, from a tradition of your choice. You choose a common cantrip or other cantrip to which you have access. This cantrip must require a spell attack roll and come from your chosen tradition. You're trained in spell attack modifier and spell DC. Your key spellcasting attribute for these spells is Charisma. Regardless of whether you can already cast spells or gained the ability from this dedication, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DS9sDOWkXrz2xmHi]{Eldritch Shot} activity.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.6A9zBmTyt8cn6ioa]{Eldritch Archer}
_desc_ko:
당신은 활쏘기에 강력한 마법을 집중시켜, 평범한 손목 튕김이나 일반적인 제스처 대신 화살촉을 통해 강력한 주문을 발사할 수 있습니다.

기존에 주문 슬롯으로 주문을 시전하지 않았다면, 즉흥 주문을 시전하는 법을 배우고 '주문 시전' 행동을 획득한다. 선택한 전통에서 원하는 캔트립 하나를 포함한 주문 목록을 얻는다. 접근 가능한 일반 캔트립이나 다른 캔트립을 선택한다. 이 캔트립은 주문 명중 굴림이 필요하며 선택한 전통에서 비롯되어야 한다. 당신은 주문 공격 수정자와 주문 DC에 숙련됩니다. 이 주문들에 대한 핵심 주문 시전 능력치는 매력입니다. 이미 주문을 시전할 수 있든, 이 헌신으로 능력을 얻었든 상관없이, 당신은 @link[actions.eldritch-shot] 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Directional Bombs

description.value:
You can lob bombs with great force and a precise trajectory to angle the splash in a cone that sprays in a single direction, potentially allowing you to avoid allies and splash deeper into enemy lines. When throwing an alchemical bomb with the splash trait, instead of splashing all squares adjacent to the target, you can create a splash in a @Template[cone|distance:15]. You choose the cone's direction, but its first square must be a square in the target's space.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.gyVcJfZTmBytLsXq]{Expanded Splash} feat or another ability that increases the radius of splash damage, you can have the splash damage be a @Template[cone|distance:20].

_desc_en:
You can lob bombs with great force and a precise trajectory to angle the splash in a cone that sprays in a single direction, potentially allowing you to avoid allies and splash deeper into enemy lines. When throwing an alchemical bomb with the splash trait, instead of splashing all squares adjacent to the target, you can create a splash in a @Template[cone|distance:15]. You choose the cone's direction, but its first square must be a square in the target's space.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.gyVcJfZTmBytLsXq]{Expanded Splash} feat or another ability that increases the radius of splash damage, you can have the splash damage be a @Template[cone|distance:20].
_desc_ko:
폭탄을 힘차게와 정밀한 궤적으로 던져 폭발 반경을 원뿔 모양으로 한 방향으로 집중시킬 수 있다. 이를 통해 아군을 피해 적 진영 깊숙이 폭발 반경을 뻗칠 수 있다. 폭발 특성이 있는 연금술 폭탄을 투척할 때, 대상에 인접한 모든 칸에 폭발을 일으키는 대신 15피트 원뿔 모양의 폭발을 생성할 수 있습니다. 원뿔의 방향은 선택할 수 있으나, 첫 번째 칸은 반드시 대상의 위치에 있어야 합니다.

특수 @link[feats.expanded-splash] 피트나 방사 피해 반경을 증가시키는 다른 능력을 보유한 경우, 방사 피해를 20피트로 설정할 수 있습니다.

name: Nature Prowler

description.value: When you begin your turn @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} or unnoticed by your hunted prey, that creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you until the end of your turn. If you're in natural surroundings, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} at full speed.

_desc_en: When you begin your turn @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} or unnoticed by your hunted prey, that creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you until the end of your turn. If you're in natural surroundings, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} at full speed.
_desc_ko: 당신의 턴이 시작될 때 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태이거나 사냥감에게 발견되지 않았다면, 그 생물은 당신의 턴이 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다. 자연 환경에 있을 경우, @link[actions.avoid-notice]와 @link[actions.sneak]을 최대 속도로 수행할 수 있다.

name: Dragon Shape

description.value: You can take on the shape of some of the world's most fearsome creatures. Add the shapes listed in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5c692cCcTDXjSEzk]{Dragon Form} to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form} list. Whenever you're polymorphed into another form using untamed form, you gain resistance 5 to your choice of bludgeoning or poison.

_desc_en: You can take on the shape of some of the world's most fearsome creatures. Add the shapes listed in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5c692cCcTDXjSEzk]{Dragon Form} to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form} list. Whenever you're polymorphed into another form using untamed form, you gain resistance 5 to your choice of bludgeoning or poison.
_desc_ko: 세계에서 가장 무시무시한 생물들의 모습을 취할 수 있습니다. @link[spells.dragon-form]에 나열된 형태들을 @link[spells.untamed-form] 목록에 추가하십시오. 야생 형태로 다른 형태로 변형될 때마다, 타격 또는 독 피해 중 선택한 한 가지에 대해 저항력 5를 얻습니다.

name: Engine Bay

description.value: You are practiced at working in vast garages of vehicles and can work on many machines at a time. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ASy9AKEIRxPYUi5o]{Quick Repair} skill feat. If you already have that feat, you gain a different 1st-level skill feat you qualify for instead. In addition, when you successfully Repair a vehicle you restore an additional 10 Hit Points, or 20 Hit Points on a critical success.

_desc_en: You are practiced at working in vast garages of vehicles and can work on many machines at a time. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ASy9AKEIRxPYUi5o]{Quick Repair} skill feat. If you already have that feat, you gain a different 1st-level skill feat you qualify for instead. In addition, when you successfully Repair a vehicle you restore an additional 10 Hit Points, or 20 Hit Points on a critical success.
_desc_ko: 당신은 거대한 차량 정비소에서 작업하는 데 능숙하며 한 번에 여러 대의 기계를 수리할 수 있습니다. 수리 시 10분 전체를 소모하면 최대 두 개의 물체를 고칠 수 있습니다. 제작에 달인인 경우 최대 네 개까지, 전설적인 경우 최대 여덟 개까지 수리할 수 있다. 신속 수리나 수리 시간 단축 능력을 사용할 때는 이 특성의 효과가 적용되지 않는다.

name: Spell Swallow

description.value: Your ostilli has grown strong enough to completely consume a spell cast at you, granting you the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3sgY9afTTBhZXE8V]{Devour Ambient Magic} action.

_desc_en: Your ostilli has grown strong enough to completely consume a spell cast at you, granting you the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3sgY9afTTBhZXE8V]{Devour Ambient Magic} action.
_desc_ko: 당신의 오스티리가 충분히 강해져 당신을 향해 시전된 주문을 완전히 흡수할 수 있게 되었으며, @link[actions.devour-ambient-magic] 액션을 부여합니다.

name: Furious Sprint

description.value: You rush forward. Stride up to five times, or up to eight times if you used 3 actions. All this movement must be in a straight line (though the GM might allow reasonable variance). You can replace any of these Strides with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} action if you need to, which you attempt using an [[/act balance skill=athletics]]{Athletics} check instead of an Acrobatics check, using the same DC.

_desc_en: You rush forward. Stride up to five times, or up to eight times if you used 3 actions. All this movement must be in a straight line (though the GM might allow reasonable variance). You can replace any of these Strides with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} action if you need to, which you attempt using an [[/act balance skill=athletics]]{Athletics} check instead of an Acrobatics check, using the same DC.
_desc_ko: 당신은 앞으로 돌진한다. 최대 다섯 번까지, 또는 3개의 행동을 사용한 경우 최대 여덟 번까지 전진할 수 있다. 이 모든 이동은 직선으로 이루어져야 한다(GM이 합리적인 편차를 허용할 수도 있음). 필요할 경우 이 중 어느 이동도 @link[actions.balance] 행동으로 대체할 수 있다. 이때는 곡예 판정 대신 운동 판정을 시도하며, 동일한 DC를 적용한다.

name: Fabricate Truth

description.value:
You invent a false truth by fast talking, switching arguments, shifting the standard of evidence, and generally confounding others. Choose a creature within 30 feet that you're aware of. Attempt a @Check[deception|against:will] check against that target's Will DC. Regardless of your result, the target is temporarily immune to your attempts to Fabricate Truth for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

_desc_en:
You invent a false truth by fast talking, switching arguments, shifting the standard of evidence, and generally confounding others. Choose a creature within 30 feet that you're aware of. Attempt a @Check[deception|against:will] check against that target's Will DC. Regardless of your result, the target is temporarily immune to your attempts to Fabricate Truth for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.
_desc_ko:
당신은 빠른 말솜씨, 논점 전환, 증거 기준 변경 등으로 허위 진실을 만들어내며 상대를 혼란에 빠뜨립니다. 30피트 이내에 있는 당신이 인지하는 생물을 선택하세요. 해당 대상의 의지 DC에 대해 기만 판정을 시도합니다. 결과와 상관없이, 대상은 10분 동안 당신의 진실 조작을 시도하는 것에 일시적으로 면역됩니다.

대성공 대상이 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.stupefied]{2} 상태가 됩니다.

성공 대상은 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.stupefied]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Hex Focus

description.value: Your patron's teachings have allowed you to achieve a deeper focus. Whenever you Refocus, completely refill your focus pool.

_desc_en: Your patron's teachings have allowed you to achieve a deeper focus. Whenever you Refocus, completely refill your focus pool.
_desc_ko: 당신의 후원자의 가르침은 더 깊은 포커스를 얻게 해주었습니다. 재집중할 때마다, 당신의 포커스 풀을 완전히 채우십시오.

name: Apex Companion

description.value: You can call upon the essence of every individual animal of a particular species to temporarily transform your animal into an exemplar of its kind. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qqQYrXaRJXr7uc4i]{Apex Companion} order spell. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.

_desc_en: You can call upon the essence of every individual animal of a particular species to temporarily transform your animal into an exemplar of its kind. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qqQYrXaRJXr7uc4i]{Apex Companion} order spell. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.
_desc_ko: 특정 종의 모든 개체 본질을 불러내어 일시적으로 자신의 동물을 그 종의 이그젬플러로 변형시킬 수 있다. @link[spells.apex-companion] 포커스 주문을 습득한다. 포커스 풀의 포커스 포인트 수를 1 증가시킨다.

name: Growing Eel Friend

description.value: Your eel pet grows larger and stronger. Your eel pet's size changes to Small, and the eel gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.FlRUb8U13Crj3NaA]{Scent} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.Le8UWr5BU8rV3iBf]{Tough} pet abilities. However, it becomes too large to carry in a water-filled globe.

_desc_en: Your eel pet grows larger and stronger. Your eel pet's size changes to Small, and the eel gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.FlRUb8U13Crj3NaA]{Scent} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.Le8UWr5BU8rV3iBf]{Tough} pet abilities. However, it becomes too large to carry in a water-filled globe.
_desc_ko: 당신의 장어 펫이 더 크고 강해집니다. 당신의 장어 펫 크기가 소형으로 변경되며, 장어는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Item.FlRUb8U13Crj3NaA]{후각}과 @link[actions.tough] 펫 능력을 얻습니다. 그러나 물이 채워진 구형 용기에 넣고 다닐 수 없을 만큼 커집니다.

name: Semblance of Life

description.value:
Trigger You deal damage to a living creature with your fist Strike or with Desiccating Inhalation.

You draw the moisture you've drained from others into your own flesh, temporarily taking on the appearance of life. This has the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise}, except you can appear only as yourself while you were a living humanoid.

_desc_en:
Trigger You deal damage to a living creature with your fist Strike or with Desiccating Inhalation.

You draw the moisture you've drained from others into your own flesh, temporarily taking on the appearance of life. This has the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise}, except you can appear only as yourself while you were a living humanoid.
_desc_ko:
발동조건 주먹 공격이나 건조한 흡입으로 생명체에게 피해를 입힐 때.

당신은 타인에게서 빼앗은 수분을 자신의 육체로 흡수하여 일시적으로 생명의 모습을 취합니다. 이는 @link[spells.illusory-disguise]의 효과를 가지나, 살아있던 인간형 생물체 시절의 자신의 모습으로만 변장할 수 있습니다.

name: Read Psychometric Resonance

description.value: With a touch, you can read the psychic impressions left on objects by their previous owners. This exploration activity functions similarly to Detect Magic in that you move at half your travel speed or slower while looking for psychometric resonance. You must brush your bare hands over any objects you pass while you do this. This detects objects with significant emotional resonance attached to them, such as the joy from a child's beloved teddy bear, the sorrow from a widower's wedding ring, or the fear from a victim's murder weapon. If you're looking for a particular type of emotional resonance, you can choose to ignore other emotions. If you find an item with that resonance, you can explore that resonance with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.jZQoAHmGJvi53NRR]{Psychometric Assessment} action.

_desc_en: With a touch, you can read the psychic impressions left on objects by their previous owners. This exploration activity functions similarly to Detect Magic in that you move at half your travel speed or slower while looking for psychometric resonance. You must brush your bare hands over any objects you pass while you do this. This detects objects with significant emotional resonance attached to them, such as the joy from a child's beloved teddy bear, the sorrow from a widower's wedding ring, or the fear from a victim's murder weapon. If you're looking for a particular type of emotional resonance, you can choose to ignore other emotions. If you find an item with that resonance, you can explore that resonance with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.jZQoAHmGJvi53NRR]{Psychometric Assessment} action.
_desc_ko: 물건을 만지면 이전 소유자가 남긴 사이킥 흔적을 읽을 수 있습니다. 이 탐색 활동은 @link[spells.detect-magic]와 유사하게 작동하며, 정신적 공명을 찾으면서 이동 속도의 절반 이하로 움직여야 합니다. 이 작업을 수행할 때는 지나치는 모든 물체에 맨손으로 살짝 스쳐야 합니다. 이를 통해 아이가 사랑하는 테디베어의 기쁨, 홀아비의 결혼반지에서 느껴지는 슬픔, 피해자의 살인 무기에서 느껴지는 공포처럼 강한 감정적 공명이 깃든 물체를 감지할 수 있습니다. 특정 유형의 감정적 공명을 찾고 있다면, 다른 감정을 무시하도록 선택할 수 있습니다. 해당 공명이 있는 물건을 발견하면 @link[actions.psychometric-assessment] 행동으로 그 공명을 탐구할 수 있다.

name: Shackleborn

description.value: Your lineage shows the signs of velstrac tampering, including some curious quirk bequeathed by those shadowy surgeons of flesh and souls. Your flesh heals cleanly and quickly—all the better for you to serve as a subject for their ghastly art. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.N8Xz5fuW6o7GW124]{Fast Recovery} feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites.

_desc_en: Your lineage shows the signs of velstrac tampering, including some curious quirk bequeathed by those shadowy surgeons of flesh and souls. Your flesh heals cleanly and quickly—all the better for you to serve as a subject for their ghastly art. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.N8Xz5fuW6o7GW124]{Fast Recovery} feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites.
_desc_ko: 당신의 혈통에는 벨스트렉들의 개입 흔적이 남아 있으며, 그 그림자 같은 육체와 영혼의 외과의사들이 남긴 기이한 특이점도 포함되어 있습니다. 당신의 살갗은 깨끗하고 빠르게 치유됩니다-그들의 가스트 예술을 위한 실험 대상으로서 더할 나위 없이 적합하죠. 전제 조건을 충족하지 않더라도 @link[feats.fast-recovery] 피트를 획득합니다.

name: Holy Bloom

description.value:
Though you might not be a priest of Milani, her divine spirit flows through you. You gain holy sanctification. Select the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.EEZvDB1Z7ezwaxIr.JournalEntryPage.5MjSsuKOLBoiL8FB]{freedom} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.EEZvDB1Z7ezwaxIr.JournalEntryPage.DI3MYGIK8iEycanU]{zeal} domain. You gain the initial domain spell for that domain. If you don't have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You can Refocus by praying to Milani or by working with others to plan a just uprising. You become trained in spell attack modifier and spell DC, and your spellcasting attribute for these spells is Wisdom.

Special You can choose this feat a second time, gaining the initial domain spell of the domain you didn't gain the first time.

_desc_en:
Though you might not be a priest of Milani, her divine spirit flows through you. You gain holy sanctification. Select the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.EEZvDB1Z7ezwaxIr.JournalEntryPage.5MjSsuKOLBoiL8FB]{freedom} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.EEZvDB1Z7ezwaxIr.JournalEntryPage.DI3MYGIK8iEycanU]{zeal} domain. You gain the initial domain spell for that domain. If you don't have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You can Refocus by praying to Milani or by working with others to plan a just uprising. You become trained in spell attack modifier and spell DC, and your spellcasting attribute for these spells is Wisdom.

Special You can choose this feat a second time, gaining the initial domain spell of the domain you didn't gain the first time.
_desc_ko:
당신은 밀라니의 사제가 아닐지 몰라도, 그녀의 신성한 영혼이 당신을 통해 흐른다. 당신은 신성 성별을 얻는다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.EEZvDB1Z7ezwaxIr.JournalEntryPage.5MjSsuKOLBoiL8FB]{자유} 또는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.EEZvDB1Z7ezwaxIr.JournalEntryPage.DI3MYGIK8iEycanU]{열정} 영역을 선택하라. 당신은 그 영역의 초기 영역 주문을 얻는다. 없다면, 집중 점수 1점의 집중 풀을 얻는다. 당신은 밀라니에게 기도하거나 다른 이들과 함께 정의로운 봉기를 계획하는 것으로 재집중할 수 있다. 당신은 주문 명중 수정치와 주문 DC에 숙련이 되며, 이 주문들의 주문시전 능력치는 지혜다.

특수 이 재주를 두 번째로 선택하여, 첫 번째에 얻지 않은 영역의 초기 영역 주문을 얻을 수 있다.

name: Snow Step

description.value: Snow and ice are no hindrance to you. You ignore difficult terrain caused by snow and ice, treat greater difficult terrain created by snow and ice as difficult terrain, and leave no tracks when moving through areas of snow or ice.

_desc_en: Snow and ice are no hindrance to you. You ignore difficult terrain caused by snow and ice, treat greater difficult terrain created by snow and ice as difficult terrain, and leave no tracks when moving through areas of snow or ice.
_desc_ko: 눈과 얼음은 당신에게 장애물이 되지 않습니다. 눈과 얼음으로 인한 어려운 지형을 무시하고, 눈과 얼음으로 생성된 매우 어려운 지형을 어려운 지형으로 취급하며, 눈이나 얼음 위를 이동할 때 발자국을 남기지 않습니다.

name: Primadonna

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

The spotlight should always be on you and you alone. Attempt a @Check[performance|defense:will] check against the Will DCs of all enemies within @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30 feet} who can see or hear you. On a success, the targets focus on you and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to hit you, but they're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to all creatures other than yourself. On a critical success, the effect lasts for 3 rounds.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

The spotlight should always be on you and you alone. Attempt a @Check[performance|defense:will] check against the Will DCs of all enemies within @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30 feet} who can see or hear you. On a success, the targets focus on you and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to hit you, but they're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to all creatures other than yourself. On a critical success, the effect lasts for 3 rounds.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

스포트라이트는 항상 오직 당신만을 비춰야 합니다. 당신을 보거나 들을 수 있는 30피트 내 모든 적의 의지 DC에 대해 공연 판정을 시도하다. 성공 시, 대상은 당신에게 포커스를 맞춰 당신을 명중시키는 데 +1 상황 보너스를 얻지만, 당신 이외의 모든 생물에게는 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다. 대성공 시 효과는 3라운드 동안 지속됩니다.

name: Crown of Bone

description.value: When you came of age, you were blessed by the Mother Earth with a thickened skull, which was celebrated as an auspicious sign among your community. Your horns come together to form a bony plate that protects your head from heavy impacts. The damage die for your horns unarmed attack increases to 1d8, and it gains the concussive trait.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: When you came of age, you were blessed by the Mother Earth with a thickened skull, which was celebrated as an auspicious sign among your community. Your horns come together to form a bony plate that protects your head from heavy impacts. The damage die for your horns unarmed attack increases to 1d8, and it gains the concussive trait.
_desc_ko: 성년이 되었을 때, 대지의 어머니께서 두꺼워진 두개골로 당신을 축복하셨고, 이는 공동체 내에서 길조로 여겨졌습니다. 뿔이 합쳐져 뼈판으로 변해 머리를 강한 충격으로부터 보호합니다. 뿔로 비무장 공격 시 피해 주사위가 1d8로 증가하며, 충격 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Elaborate Flourish

description.value:
You embellish your spellcasting with entrancing flourishes and grand pronouncements, making it harder to identify or counter.

If the next action you use is to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast a Spell}, creatures with the ability to Cast that Spell don't automatically know what the spell is.

In addition, creatures that witness your spellcasting take a -2 circumstance penalty to checks to identify the spell with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} and checks to counteract the spell during its casting (such as with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.EpBG4CFMNSZQx7vI]{Counterspell}).

_desc_en:
You embellish your spellcasting with entrancing flourishes and grand pronouncements, making it harder to identify or counter.

If the next action you use is to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast a Spell}, creatures with the ability to Cast that Spell don't automatically know what the spell is.

In addition, creatures that witness your spellcasting take a -2 circumstance penalty to checks to identify the spell with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} and checks to counteract the spell during its casting (such as with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.EpBG4CFMNSZQx7vI]{Counterspell}).
_desc_ko:
당신은 주문을 매혹적인 화려한 동작과 웅장한 선언으로 장식하여, 상대가 주문을 식별하거나 대응하기 어렵게 만듭니다.

다음 행동이 @link[actions.cast-a-spell]인 경우, 해당 주문을 시전할 수 있는 능력의 생물들은 자동으로 그 주문이 무엇인지 알지 못한다.

또한, 당신의 주문 시전을 목격한 생물들은 @link[actions.recall-knowledge]으로 주문을 식별하는 판정나 시전 중 주문을 반격하는 판정(예: @link[feats.counterspell-prepared])에 -2 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Veil May

description.value:
Born of a blood hag, a fiery blood drinker hidden behind a false skin, you have one blood-red eye and the ability to slough off your appearance in an instant.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Dvz54d6aPhjsmUux]{Lie to Me} skill feat, and you can shed a disguise quickly by peeling off the outer layer of your skin.

Changing from a disguise used to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} back to your true appearance is a 3-action activity for you; if you're an expert in Deception, it's a 2-action activity, and if you're legendary in Deception, it takes only a single action. This doesn't allow you to don or remove armor or other equipment any faster, but your physical appearance otherwise returns to its normal state.

_desc_en:
Born of a blood hag, a fiery blood drinker hidden behind a false skin, you have one blood-red eye and the ability to slough off your appearance in an instant.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Dvz54d6aPhjsmUux]{Lie to Me} skill feat, and you can shed a disguise quickly by peeling off the outer layer of your skin.

Changing from a disguise used to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} back to your true appearance is a 3-action activity for you; if you're an expert in Deception, it's a 2-action activity, and if you're legendary in Deception, it takes only a single action. This doesn't allow you to don or remove armor or other equipment any faster, but your physical appearance otherwise returns to its normal state.
_desc_ko:
피의 마녀에게서 태어난, 가짜 피부 뒤에 숨긴 불타는 피의 흡혈귀로서, 당신은 핏빛 눈 하나를 지니고 있으며 순간적으로 외형을 벗어던질 수 있는 능력을 가집니다.

@link[feats.lie-to-me] 기술 피트를 획득하며, 피부 바깥층을 벗겨내어 변장을 신속히 벗을 수 있다.

@link[actions.impersonate]에 사용한 변장을 본래 모습으로 되돌리는 데는 3행동이 소요된다. 속임수 숙련자라면 2행동, 속임수 전설급 숙련자라면 액션 하나만으로 가능하다. 이것은 갑옷이나 다른 장비를 더 빨리 착용하거나 벗을 수 있게 해주지는 않지만, 그 외의 신체적 외모는 정상 상태로 돌아갑니다.

name: Spectral Advance

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VNAOHrWhNYX3jKdy]{Spectral Advance} devotion spell, which lets you move to an enemy, bypassing hindrances.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VNAOHrWhNYX3jKdy]{Spectral Advance} devotion spell, which lets you move to an enemy, bypassing hindrances.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @link[spells.spectral-advance] 헌신 주문을 얻습니다. 이 주문은 장애물을 무시하고 적에게 이동할 수 있게 합니다.

name: Vindictive Thoughts

description.value:
Trigger You attempt a saving throw against a spell.

Those who seek to do you personal harm with magic must suffer the same misfortune. Before you attempt your saving throw, spend a Mythic Point. You make this saving throw at mythic proficiency. On any result but a critical failure, the spell's caster takes @Damage[10d6[mental]] damage (@Check[will|against:class-spell|basic] save against your class DC or spell DC using mythic proficiency, whichever is higher). At 18th level, the mental damage increases to 11d6, and at 20th level, the mental damage increases to 12d6.

publication.title: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

_desc_en:
Trigger You attempt a saving throw against a spell.

Those who seek to do you personal harm with magic must suffer the same misfortune. Before you attempt your saving throw, spend a Mythic Point. You make this saving throw at mythic proficiency. On any result but a critical failure, the spell's caster takes @Damage[10d6[mental]] damage (@Check[will|against:class-spell|basic] save against your class DC or spell DC using mythic proficiency, whichever is higher). At 18th level, the mental damage increases to 11d6, and at 20th level, the mental damage increases to 12d6.
_desc_ko:
발동 주문에 대한 내성 굴림을 시도한다.

마법으로 당신에게 개인적 해를 끼치려는 자들은 같은 불운을 겪어야 한다. 내성 굴림을 시도하기 전에, 신화 점수를 소비하라. 당신은 이 내성 굴림을 신화 숙련도로 한다. 대실패를 제외한 모든 결과에서, 주문의 시전자는 @Damage[10d6[mental]] 피해를 입는다(당신의 직업 DC나 주문 DC 중 더 높은 것에 대해 신화 숙련도를 사용한 @Check[will|against:class-spell|basic] 내성). 18레벨에, 정신 피해가 11d6으로 증가하고, 20레벨에, 정신 피해가 12d6으로 증가한다.

name: Mental Balm

description.value:
Your spells release soothing mental waves. Use this amp in place of a psi cantrip's normal amp entry. You can use this amp only on a psi cantrip that targets or affects you or one or more of your allies and doesn't target or affect any enemies.

Amp You or one ally within 30 feet gains a +2 status bonus to Will saves against emotion effects for 1 minute. You can also have the amped psi cantrip attempt to counteract one effect imposing the frightened condition on yourself or the chosen ally, or an effect imposing the stupefied condition that has a duration of 1 hour or less. If you successfully counteract the effect, you remove only the frightened and stupefied conditions, not any other part of the effect.

_desc_en:
Your spells release soothing mental waves. Use this amp in place of a psi cantrip's normal amp entry. You can use this amp only on a psi cantrip that targets or affects you or one or more of your allies and doesn't target or affect any enemies.

Amp You or one ally within 30 feet gains a +2 status bonus to Will saves against emotion effects for 1 minute. You can also have the amped psi cantrip attempt to counteract one effect imposing the frightened condition on yourself or the chosen ally, or an effect imposing the stupefied condition that has a duration of 1 hour or less. If you successfully counteract the effect, you remove only the frightened and stupefied conditions, not any other part of the effect.
_desc_ko:
당신의 주문은 정신을 진정시키는 파동을 방출합니다. 이 앰프를 사이 캔트립의 일반 앰프 항목 대신 사용하십시오. 이 앰프는 당신이나 한 명 이상의 아군을 대상으로 하거나 영향을 미치며, 적을 대상으로 하거나 영향을 미치지 않는 사이 캔트립에만 사용할 수 있습니다.

앰프당신 또는 30피트 내 한 명의 아군이 1분 동안 감정 효과에 대한 의지 내성에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 또한 앰프된 사이 캔트립이 선택한 대상(당신 또는 아군)에게 반격 시도합니다. @link[conditions.frightened] 상태를 자신이나 선택한 아군에게 부여하는 효과, 또는 지속 시간이 1시간 이하인 @link[conditions.stupefied] 상태를 부여하는 효과를 반격할 수 있습니다. 효과를 성공적으로 반격하면 공포와 멍함 상태만 제거되며, 효과의 다른 부분은 제거되지 않습니다.

name: Strafing Breath

description.value:
Requirements @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ht9ctVLibKCaFQdc]{War Rider Stance} is active.

You urge your dragon mount forward, wreathed in magical power. Your mount Strides three times. If your mount has a fly Speed, it can substitute a Fly action for any of these Stride actions. As it moves, your dragon companion's magical breath billows around you. The aura from War Rider Stance increases to a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] during this movement, and each creature that's in the emanation at any point during your movement takes the damage from it (with the normal save). A creature can take damage only once, even if you move past it multiple times.

_desc_en:
Requirements @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ht9ctVLibKCaFQdc]{War Rider Stance} is active.

You urge your dragon mount forward, wreathed in magical power. Your mount Strides three times. If your mount has a fly Speed, it can substitute a Fly action for any of these Stride actions. As it moves, your dragon companion's magical breath billows around you. The aura from War Rider Stance increases to a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] during this movement, and each creature that's in the emanation at any point during your movement takes the damage from it (with the normal save). A creature can take damage only once, even if you move past it multiple times.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ht9ctVLibKCaFQdc]{전쟁 기수 태세}가 활성화되어 있다.

당신은 마법의 힘에 휩싸인 용 탈것을 앞으로 몰아간다. 당신의 탈것이 세 번 보폭한다. 탈것에 비행 속도가 있다면, 이 보폭 행동 중 어느 것이든 비행 행동으로 대체할 수 있다. 탈것이 이동하면서, 당신의 용 동료의 마법 숨결이 당신 주위로 소용돌이친다. 전쟁 기수 태세의 오라가 이 이동 중에 @Template[type:emanation|distance:10]로 증가하며, 당신의 이동 중 어느 시점에라도 발산 안에 있는 각 생물은 그 피해를 입는다(일반 내성과 함께). 당신이 생물을 여러 번 지나치더라도, 생물은 피해를 한 번만 입을 수 있다.

name: Purge Sins

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You call on your celestial forebears to rid your body of all toxins and impurities. For each disease or poison currently affecting you, attempt a @Check[religion] check to counteract that disease or poison. As normal, your counteract level is equal to half your level, rounded up.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You call on your celestial forebears to rid your body of all toxins and impurities. For each disease or poison currently affecting you, attempt a @Check[religion] check to counteract that disease or poison. As normal, your counteract level is equal to half your level, rounded up.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

천상체를 불러 몸속의 모든 독소와 불순물을 제거합니다. 현재 영향을 받고 있는 각 질병이나 독에 대해, 해당 질병이나 독을 반격하기 위한 종교학 판정을 시도합니다. 평소와 같이, 반격 수준은 레벨의 절반(반올림)과 같습니다.

name: Gird Champion

description.value:
Your will manifests into divine weapons to protect and arm your followers. When you gain this feat, choose one type of weapon with special significance to you, such as a longsword or a sickle. This becomes your favored weapon. You and your hierophant both treat this weapon as a simple weapon for the purposes of proficiency. You and your hierophant gain the critical specialization effect of your favored weapon and deal an additional 1d6 spirit damage with Strikes made with your favored weapon. If one of your current domain spells can deal a type of damage other than spirit, you can choose to match this damage type (for instance, wreathing your weapon in sacred ashes that deal fire damage if you have the fire domain).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.3K8fNQKjmrHU8dzi]{Effect: Gird Champion (Hierophant)}

_desc_en:
Your will manifests into divine weapons to protect and arm your followers. When you gain this feat, choose one type of weapon with special significance to you, such as a longsword or a sickle. This becomes your favored weapon. You and your hierophant both treat this weapon as a simple weapon for the purposes of proficiency. You and your hierophant gain the critical specialization effect of your favored weapon and deal an additional 1d6 spirit damage with Strikes made with your favored weapon. If one of your current domain spells can deal a type of damage other than spirit, you can choose to match this damage type (for instance, wreathing your weapon in sacred ashes that deal fire damage if you have the fire domain).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.3K8fNQKjmrHU8dzi]{Effect: Gird Champion (Hierophant)}
_desc_ko:
당신의 의지가 신성한 무기로 창조되어 추종자들을 보호하고 무장시킵니다. 이 피트를 획득할 때, 장검이나 낫처럼 당신에게 특별한 의미를 지닌 무기 유형 하나를 선택하십시오. 이것이 당신의 선호 무기가 됩니다. 당신과 당신의 계시자는 숙련도 목적상 이 무기를 단순 무기로 취급합니다. 당신과 당신의 계시자는 선호 무기의 치명타 특화 효과를 얻으며, 선호 무기로 가한 공격에 추가로 1d6 영혼 피해를 입힙니다. 현재 보유한 도메인 주문 중 영혼 피해 외 다른 유형의 피해를 입힐 수 있는 주문이 있다면, 해당 피해 유형을 일치시킬 수 있습니다(예: 불 도메인을 보유한 경우, 무기를 신성한 재로 감싸 불 피해를 입힘).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.3K8fNQKjmrHU8dzi]{효과: 챔피언의 갑옷 (제사장)}

name: Defensive Growth

description.value:
Trigger You're the target of a physical attack.

You grow a shield of woven flowers and branches, then Raise that Shield to defend yourself from the triggering attack. If you would take damage from the attack, you immediately @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}. This is a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ezVp13Uw8cWW08Da]{Wooden Shield} (Hardness 3, HP 12, BT 6). The shield remains in your possession for a number of rounds equal to your level, or until it's destroyed.

Awakening The shield becomes stronger. It has Hardness 5, HP 40, BT 20.

Awakening The shield takes on a mind of its own and lashes out vengefully when destroyed. When the shield is destroyed, is explodes, dealing @Damage[4d6[piercing]] damage to your attacker, with a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save.

_desc_en:
Trigger You're the target of a physical attack.

You grow a shield of woven flowers and branches, then Raise that Shield to defend yourself from the triggering attack. If you would take damage from the attack, you immediately @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}. This is a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ezVp13Uw8cWW08Da]{Wooden Shield} (Hardness 3, HP 12, BT 6). The shield remains in your possession for a number of rounds equal to your level, or until it's destroyed.

Awakening The shield becomes stronger. It has Hardness 5, HP 40, BT 20.

Awakening The shield takes on a mind of its own and lashes out vengefully when destroyed. When the shield is destroyed, is explodes, dealing @Damage[4d6[piercing]] damage to your attacker, with a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save.
_desc_ko:
발동조건 당신이 물리 공격의 대상이 됩니다.

꽃과 나뭇가지로 엮은 방패를 만들어 그 방패를 들어 트리거 공격으로부터 자신을 방어합니다. 공격으로 피해를 입을 경우 즉시 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{방패 막기}를 사용합니다. 이는 @link[equipment.wooden-shield](경도 3, HP 12, 방어력 6)입니다. 방패는 당신의 레벨과 동일한 턴 수 동안, 또는 파괴될 때까지 소유합니다.

각성 방패가 더 강해집니다. 경도 5, HP 40, 방어력 20을 가집니다.

각성 방패가 의지를 가지게 되어 파괴될 때 복수심으로 공격한다. 방패가 파괴되면 폭발하여 공격자에게 4d6 관통의 피해를 입히며, 기본 반사 내성을 받는다.

name: Sanguivolent Roots

description.value:
Blood-drinking vines grow from the ground in a @Template[burst|distance:15] within 120 feet. Each living enemy in the area has its blood drained, taking @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -8)/2)+3)d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. Each time the vines drink blood, living creatures in the area who aren't your enemies regain HP equal to half the damage a single creature took; calculate this using the highest damage a single creature took. This is a healing vitality effect. Your enemies with void healing in the area take vitality damage in the same amount as the healing.

The vines last until the end of your next turn, and you can Sustain the impulse. The first time you Sustain the impulse on subsequent turns, you can repeat the effect.

Level (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Blood-drinking vines grow from the ground in a @Template[burst|distance:15] within 120 feet. Each time the vines drink blood, living creatures in the area who aren't your enemies regain HP equal to half the damage a single creature took; calculate this using the highest damage a single creature took. This is a healing vitality effect. Your enemies with void healing in the area take vitality damage in the same amount as the healing.

The vines last until the end of your next turn, and you can Sustain the impulse. The first time you Sustain the impulse on subsequent turns, you can repeat the effect.

Level (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.
_desc_ko:
피를 빨아먹는 덩굴이 120피트 반경의 15피트 범위 내 지면에서 자란다. 해당 영역 내의 모든 살아있는 적들은 피를 흡수되어 관통의 피해를 입으며, 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 기본 인내 내성 굴림을 수행합니다. 덩굴이 피를 마실 때마다, 해당 지역에 있는 당신의 적이 아닌 생명체들은 한 생명체가 받은 피해량의 절반에 해당하는 HP를 회복한다. 이는 치유 활력 효과이다. 해당 지역에 있는 공허 치유 능력을 가진 당신의 적들은 치유량과 동일한 양의 활력 피해를 입는다.

덩굴은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 지속되며, 당신은 이 임펄스를 지속할 수 있습니다. 이후 차례에서 처음으로 임펄스를 지속할 때, 효과를 반복할 수 있습니다.

레벨 (+2) 피해량이 1d6 증가합니다.

name: One with the Wild

description.value:
You naturally blend in with the wilderness, becoming camouflaged. In natural terrain, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} even without cover or being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Special This feat gains the trait for your ancestry.

_desc_en:
You naturally blend in with the wilderness, becoming camouflaged. In natural terrain, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} even without cover or being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Special This feat gains the trait for your ancestry.
_desc_ko:
당신은 자연스럽게 야생과 조화를 이루어 위장 상태가 됩니다. 자연 지형에서는 은폐물이나 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태가 아니더라도 @link[actions.hide]와 @link[actions.sneak]이 가능합니다.

특수 이 피트는 당신의 혈통에 해당 특성을 부여합니다.

name: Goblin Jubilee Display

description.value: Flames and explosions sear the air in a riot of color and devastation that rivals that wrought by even the wildest goblin party. The display is both so beautiful and chaotic that, while mesmerizing, it poses a significant risk to the physical health, sight, and hearing of anyone who gets too close. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.izvfZ561JTdeyh6i]{Goblin Jubilee} fireworks display.

_desc_en: Flames and explosions sear the air in a riot of color and devastation that rivals that wrought by even the wildest goblin party. The display is both so beautiful and chaotic that, while mesmerizing, it poses a significant risk to the physical health, sight, and hearing of anyone who gets too close. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.izvfZ561JTdeyh6i]{Goblin Jubilee} fireworks display.
_desc_ko:
불꽃과 폭발이 공기를 태우며, 가장 난폭한 고블린 파티가 만들어낸 것과 견줄 만한 화려함과 파괴의 향연을 펼친다. 이 불꽃놀이는 너무나 아름답고 혼란스러워 매혹적이면서도, 너무 가까이 다가간 이의 신체 건강, 시력, 청각에 심각한 위험을 초래한다. @link[actions.goblin-jubilee] 불꽃놀이

를 획득합니다.

name: Aldori Duelist Dedication

description.value:
Access You are from the Broken Lands region.

Your Aldori duelist training teaches you martial techniques and increases your dedication to the Aldori dueling sword. You become trained in your choice of Acrobatics or Athletics; if you were already trained in that skill, you become an expert instead. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} feat for Dueling Lore; if you were already trained in Dueling Lore, you also become trained in a Lore skill of your choice.

You have familiarity with Aldori dueling swords, treating them as martial weapons for the purposes of proficiency. You gain access to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.iSceAVMkVv1uKK7t]{Aldori dueling swords}.

_desc_en:
Access You are from the Broken Lands region.

Your Aldori duelist training teaches you martial techniques and increases your dedication to the Aldori dueling sword. You become trained in your choice of Acrobatics or Athletics; if you were already trained in that skill, you become an expert instead. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} feat for Dueling Lore; if you were already trained in Dueling Lore, you also become trained in a Lore skill of your choice.

You have familiarity with Aldori dueling swords, treating them as martial weapons for the purposes of proficiency. You gain access to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.iSceAVMkVv1uKK7t]{Aldori dueling swords}.
_desc_ko:
Access 당신은 부서진 땅 지역 출신입니다.

알도리 결투사 훈련을 통해 무술 기술을 익히고 알도리 결투검에 대한 헌신도가 높아집니다. 곡예 또는 운동 중 하나를 선택하여 숙련됩니다. 해당 기술에 이미 숙련된 경우, 대신 전문가가 됩니다. @link[feats.additional-lore] 피트를 결투 지식에 대해 획득합니다. 이미 결투 지식에 숙련된 경우, 선택한 지식 지식 하나에 숙련됩니다.

알도리 결투용 쌍검에 대한 숙련이 있으며, 숙련도 목적상 이를 무술 무기로 취급합니다. @link[equipment.aldori-dueling-sword]을 사용할 수 있게 됩니다.

name: Advanced Witchcraft

description.value:
You gain one witch feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your witch level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another witch feat.

_desc_en:
You gain one witch feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your witch level is equal to half your character level.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another witch feat.
_desc_ko:
마녀 피트 하나를 얻습니다. 전제 조건 충족을 위해, 당신의 마녀 레벨은 캐릭터 레벨의 절반과 동일합니다.

특수 이 재주를 여러 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 선택할 때마다 추가로 마녀 피트 하나를 얻습니다.

name: Air Cushion

description.value:
Trigger A creature within 60 feet is falling.

Air currents flow upward to slow the target's fall to 60 feet per round. The cushion ends when the target reaches the ground, and the creature takes no damage from the fall. The cushion expires if the creature doesn't reach the ground within 1 minute, but any distance it fell during that minute doesn't count for any damage the creature would take from the fall. You can't use Air Cushion again while you have one in effect.

Level (8th) The range is 120 feet, and you can create cushions for up to 5 falling creatures with one reaction.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature within 60 feet is falling.

Air currents flow upward to slow the target's fall to 60 feet per round. The cushion ends when the target reaches the ground, and the creature takes no damage from the fall. The cushion expires if the creature doesn't reach the ground within 1 minute, but any distance it fell during that minute doesn't count for any damage the creature would take from the fall. You can't use Air Cushion again while you have one in effect.

Level (8th) The range is 120 feet, and you can create cushions for up to 5 falling creatures with one reaction.
_desc_ko:
발동조건 60피트 이내의 생물이 추락 중일 때.

공기 흐름이 위로 흘러 대상의 낙하 속도를 라운드당 60피트로 늦춘다. 대상이 지면에 닿으면 완충 효과가 끝나며, 해당 생물은 낙하로 인한 피해를 입지 않는다. 생물이 1분 이내에 지면에 닿지 않으면 완충 효과가 소멸되나, 그 1분 동안 떨어진 거리는 낙하로 인한 피해 계산에 포함되지 않는다. 공기 쿠션 효과가 지속되는 동안에는 다시 사용할 수 없다.

레벨 (8th) 범위는 120피트이며, 하나의 반응으로 최대 5명의 추락 생물을 위한 쿠션을 생성할 수 있습니다.

name: That's Odd

description.value:
When you enter a new location, such as a room or corridor, you immediately notice one thing out of the ordinary. The GM determines what it is, or whether there's nothing reasonable to pick up, skipping obvious clues that can be easily noticed without a check or specifically looking for them. You learn only that an area or object is suspicious, but not why it's suspicious. For example, if you entered a study with a large bloodstain on the ground, the bloodstain is so obviously suspicious it's evident to you already, so the GM might note that there's something suspicious about the desk drawer instead. You would then need to investigate the drawer further to find out what specifically is out of the ordinary. If you wish, you can Pursue a Lead concerning this detail even if you have Pursued a Lead less than 10 minutes ago.

That's Odd doesn't reveal whether creatures are suspicious. You don't typically get any benefit when you leave and come back to a place, though if a major change has happened there and time has passed, the GM might determine that you do.

_desc_en:
When you enter a new location, such as a room or corridor, you immediately notice one thing out of the ordinary. The GM determines what it is, or whether there's nothing reasonable to pick up, skipping obvious clues that can be easily noticed without a check or specifically looking for them. You learn only that an area or object is suspicious, but not why it's suspicious. For example, if you entered a study with a large bloodstain on the ground, the bloodstain is so obviously suspicious it's evident to you already, so the GM might note that there's something suspicious about the desk drawer instead. You would then need to investigate the drawer further to find out what specifically is out of the ordinary. If you wish, you can Pursue a Lead concerning this detail even if you have Pursued a Lead less than 10 minutes ago.

That's Odd doesn't reveal whether creatures are suspicious. You don't typically get any benefit when you leave and come back to a place, though if a major change has happened there and time has passed, the GM might determine that you do.
_desc_ko:
방이나 복도 같은 새로운 장소에 들어설 때, 당신은 즉시 한 가지 이상한 점을 발견한다. GM이 그 내용을 결정하거나, 판정 없이도 쉽게 알아차릴 수 있거나 특별히 찾아보지 않아도 되는 명백한 단서는 제외하고, 합리적으로 발견할 만한 것이 없는지 판단한다. 해당 지역이나 물건이 의심스럽다는 사실만 알게 되며, 의심스러운 이유는 알 수 없습니다. 예를 들어 바닥에 커다란 혈흔이 있는 서재에 들어갔다면, 혈흔 자체가 너무나도 명백히 의심스러워 이미 눈치챘을 테니, GM은 대신 책상 서랍에 뭔가 수상한 점이 있다고 언급할 수 있습니다. 그러면 서랍을 더 조사하여 구체적으로 무엇이 비정상적인지 알아내야 합니다. 원한다면, 10분 이내에 단서를 추적한 적이 있더라도 이 세부 사항에 대해 단서를 추적할 수 있습니다.

'이상하다'는 생물체가 의심스러운지 여부를 드러내지 않습니다. 일반적으로 장소를 떠나고 다시 돌아왔을 때 이점을 얻지는 못하지만, 그곳에 중대한 변화가 발생하고 시간이 지났다면 GM이 이점을 부여할 수도 있습니다.

name: Twin Stars

description.value:
Usage imbued into a one-handed weapon ikon

Your divine spark embodies a primordial duality, and your ikon splits itself accordingly into two corresponding halves. You can use an Interact action to split the imbued ikon into two copies of itself, which both gain the twin trait; these copies are identical except for one mirrored feature, such as a sun motif on one and a moon motif on another. You can use this ability again to fuse the two halves back into their original form. As these are both manifestations of the same object, your divine spark empowers the two halves as if they were a single ikon.

_desc_en:
Usage imbued into a one-handed weapon ikon

Your divine spark embodies a primordial duality, and your ikon splits itself accordingly into two corresponding halves. You can use an Interact action to split the imbued ikon into two copies of itself, which both gain the twin trait; these copies are identical except for one mirrored feature, such as a sun motif on one and a moon motif on another. You can use this ability again to fuse the two halves back into their original form. As these are both manifestations of the same object, your divine spark empowers the two halves as if they were a single ikon.
_desc_ko:
사용법 한손 무기 이콘에 부여됨

당신의 신성한 불꽃은 원초적인 이원성을 구현하며, 이에 따라 당신의 이콘은 두 개의 대응하는 반쪽으로 분할됩니다. 상호작용 행동을 사용하여 주입된 이콘을 두 개의 복제본으로 분할할 수 있으며, 이 복제본들은 쌍둥이 특성을 획득합니다. 이 복제본들은 한쪽에는 태양 문양이, 다른 쪽에는 달 문양이 새겨지는 등 한 가지 특징만 거울처럼 반전된 것을 제외하면 동일합니다. 이 능력을 다시 사용해 두 조각을 원래 형태로 융합할 수 있습니다. 둘 다 동일한 물체의 현현이므로, 신성한 불꽃은 두 조각을 하나의 이콘인 것처럼 강화합니다.

name: For the Fallen!

description.value: So many other hopefuls have attempted the Test of the Starstone before you and failed. Whether they were killed or disappeared, you vow to honor their memories by succeeding where they failed. This drive allows to push forward after you've already made an attack. You Step and then Strike.

_desc_en: So many other hopefuls have attempted the Test of the Starstone before you and failed. Whether they were killed or disappeared, you vow to honor their memories by succeeding where they failed. This drive allows to push forward after you've already made an attack. You Step and then Strike.
_desc_ko: 당신보다 앞서 수많은 다른 지원자들이 별돌의 시험에 도전했다가 실패했다. 그들이 죽었든 사라졌든, 당신은 그들이 실패한 곳에서 성공함으로써 그들의 기억을 기리겠다고 맹세한다. 이 열망은 당신이 이미 공격을 한 후에도 앞으로 밀고 나아가게 해준다. 당신은 걸음한 다음 타격한다.

name: Haft Striker Stance

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a two-handed hammer, spear, or polearm.

You enter a stance that allows you to leverage the haft of your weapon to brutal effect as an effective and frighteningly efficient weapon in its own right. You treat the haft of your wielded weapon as a simple weapon dealing @Damage[1d4[bludgeoning]] damage. The haft is in the club group and has the agile and finesse traits. The haft shares any fundamental runes attached to the main weapon, so long as it would normally qualify for them.

While in Haft Striker Stance, you can use feats and abilities that normally require you to be wielding two melee weapons each in a different hand, treating the haft as the second weapon, but you can't use abilities that require you to be wielding a two-handed weapon.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a two-handed hammer, spear, or polearm.

You enter a stance that allows you to leverage the haft of your weapon to brutal effect as an effective and frighteningly efficient weapon in its own right. You treat the haft of your wielded weapon as a simple weapon dealing @Damage[1d4[bludgeoning]] damage. The haft is in the club group and has the agile and finesse traits. The haft shares any fundamental runes attached to the main weapon, so long as it would normally qualify for them.

While in Haft Striker Stance, you can use feats and abilities that normally require you to be wielding two melee weapons each in a different hand, treating the haft as the second weapon, but you can't use abilities that require you to be wielding a two-handed weapon.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손 망치, 창, 또는 장창을 휘두르고 있어야 한다.

무기의 자루를 효과적이고 위협적으로 효율적인 무기로 활용하여 잔혹한 효과를 발휘할 수 있는 자세를 취합니다. 휘두르는 무기의 자루를 1d4 타격 피해를 입히는 단순 무기로 취급합니다. 자루는 몽둥이 계열에 속하며 기민성과 기교 특성을 지닙니다. 자루는 주 무기에 부착된 기본 룬을 공유하며, 해당 룬이 일반적으로 적용될 수 있는 조건을 충족하는 경우에 한합니다.

손잡이 타격자 자세 상태에서는, 일반적으로 양손에 각각 다른 근접 무기를 휘두르는 것을 요구하는 피트와 능력을 사용할 수 있으며, 이때 손잡이를 두 번째 무기로 간주합니다. 그러나 양손 무기를 휘두르는 것을 요구하는 능력은 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Aerobatics Mastery

description.value:
You move with grace in flight and can perform amazing aerial stunts.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Qf1ylAbdVi1rkc8M]{Maneuver in Flight} and can combine two maneuvers into a single action, such as reversing direction while making a steep ascent or descent or hovering in gale-force winds. The DC of the Acrobatics check is equal to the DC of the most difficult maneuver + 5.

If you're legendary in Acrobatics, you can combine three such maneuvers into a single action; the DC of the Acrobatics check is equal to the DC of the most difficult maneuver + 10. Regardless of the combination, these maneuvers rarely allow you to move farther than your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cS9nfDRGD83bNU1p]{Fly} Speed.

_desc_en:
You move with grace in flight and can perform amazing aerial stunts.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Qf1ylAbdVi1rkc8M]{Maneuver in Flight} and can combine two maneuvers into a single action, such as reversing direction while making a steep ascent or descent or hovering in gale-force winds. The DC of the Acrobatics check is equal to the DC of the most difficult maneuver + 5.

If you're legendary in Acrobatics, you can combine three such maneuvers into a single action; the DC of the Acrobatics check is equal to the DC of the most difficult maneuver + 10. Regardless of the combination, these maneuvers rarely allow you to move farther than your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cS9nfDRGD83bNU1p]{Fly} Speed.
_desc_ko:
비행 중 우아하게 움직이며 놀라운 공중 묘기를 수행할 수 있습니다.

@link[actions.maneuver-in-flight]에 대한 곡예 판정 시 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 두 가지 기동을 액션 하나로 결합할 수 있습니다. 예를 들어 급상승 또는 급강하 중 방향을 전환하거나 강풍 속에서 공중에 정지하는 것이 가능합니다. 곡예 판정 DC는 가장 어려운 기동의 DC +5와 동일합니다.

곡예에 전설적인 실력을 지녔다면, 세 가지 곡예 동작을 액션 하나로 결합할 수 있습니다. 이때 곡예 판정 난이도는 가장 어려운 동작의 DC에 10을 더한 값과 같습니다. 어떤 동작을 결합하든, 이 동작들로 이동할 수 있는 거리는 @link[actions.fly] 속도를 거의 넘지 않습니다.

name: Poisoner's Twist

description.value:
Requirements Your last action was a successful melee Strike that dealt damage against a target afflicted by a poison, and you know which poison.

Poisons attack specific parts of the body—one venom might target the lungs, another the circulatory system, while another deteriorates the nerves. You know how to take advantage of such weaknesses. You deal @Damage[1d6[untyped]] damage of the required Strike's damage type and @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage to the target. If you're at least 18th level, you deal @Damage[2d6[untyped]] damage of each type.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your last action was a successful melee Strike that dealt damage against a target afflicted by a poison, and you know which poison.

Poisons attack specific parts of the body—one venom might target the lungs, another the circulatory system, while another deteriorates the nerves. You know how to take advantage of such weaknesses. You deal @Damage[1d6[untyped]] damage of the required Strike's damage type and @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage to the target. If you're at least 18th level, you deal @Damage[2d6[untyped]] damage of each type.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 마지막 행동으로 독에 걸린 대상에게 피해를 입은 근접 공격을 성공시켰으며, 어떤 독인지 알고 있습니다.

맹독은 신체의 특정 부위를 공격합니다-어떤 맹독은 폐를, 다른 맹독은 순환계를, 또 다른 맹독은 신경을 손상시킵니다. 당신은 이러한 약점을 활용하는 방법을 알고 있습니다. 당신은 대상에게 필요한 공격의 피해 유형으로 1d6의 피해를 입히고, 추가로 1d6 독의 피해를 입힙니다. 18레벨 이상일 경우 각 유형별로 2d6의 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Expert Combat Eidolon

description.value: Your eidolon advances its capabilities in combat. Your eidolon becomes an expert in unarmed attacks. If you are an expert in unarmored defense, your eidolon also becomes an expert in unarmored defense. If you have weapon specialization, your eidolon also gains weapon specialization.

_desc_en: Your eidolon advances its capabilities in combat. Your eidolon becomes an expert in unarmed attacks. If you are an expert in unarmored defense, your eidolon also becomes an expert in unarmored defense. If you have weapon specialization, your eidolon also gains weapon specialization.
_desc_ko: 에이돌론의 전투 능력이 향상됩니다. 에이돌론은 비무장 공격에 전문가가 됩니다. 당신이 무장 방어에 숙련된 경우, 당신의 에이돌론도 무장 방어에 숙련됩니다. 당신이 무기 전문화를 가진 경우, 당신의 에이돌론도 무기 전문화를 얻습니다.

name: Bonded Animal

description.value:
You forge strong connections with animals. You can spend 7 days of downtime regularly interacting with a normal animal (not a companion or other special animal) that is friendly or helpful to you. After this duration, attempt a @Check[nature|defense:will] check against the animal's Will DC. If successful, you bond with the animal. The animal is permanently bonded to you until you form a bond with a different animal or do something egregious to break your bond.

A helpful animal is easier to direct. If your bonded animal is level –1, it gains the minion trait, allowing you to command it more efficiently. The maximum level of creature that can be your minion increases to 3 if you're a master in Nature and to 11 if you're legendary.

Special You can't have both a bonded animal and an animal companion (though you can have both a bonded animal and a pet or familiar).

_desc_en:
You forge strong connections with animals. You can spend 7 days of downtime regularly interacting with a normal animal (not a companion or other special animal) that is friendly or helpful to you. After this duration, attempt a @Check[nature|defense:will] check against the animal's Will DC. If successful, you bond with the animal. The animal is permanently bonded to you until you form a bond with a different animal or do something egregious to break your bond.

A helpful animal is easier to direct. If your bonded animal is level –1, it gains the minion trait, allowing you to command it more efficiently. The maximum level of creature that can be your minion increases to 3 if you're a master in Nature and to 11 if you're legendary.

Special You can't have both a bonded animal and an animal companion (though you can have both a bonded animal and a pet or familiar).
_desc_ko:
동물과 강한 유대를 형성합니다. 평범한 동물(동반자나 특수한 동물이 아닌) 중 당신에게 우호적이거나 도움이 되는 개체와 7일간 다운타임 동안 꾸준히 교류할 수 있습니다. 이 기간이 지나면 동물의 의지 DC에 대한 자연학 판정을 시도하십시오. 성공하면 동물과 유대를 형성합니다. 다른 동물과 유대를 형성하거나 유대를 깨뜨릴 만한 중대한 잘못을 저지르기 전까지 동물은 영구적으로 당신과 유대됩니다.

도움이 되는 동물은 지시하기 더 쉽습니다. 유대감을 형성한 동물의 레벨이 -1인 경우, 하수인 특성을 얻어 더 효율적으로 명령할 수 있습니다. 자연 달인인 경우 최대 레벨 3까지, 전설적인 경우 최대 레벨 11까지 하수인으로 삼을 수 있습니다.

특수 결속 동물과 동물 동료를 동시에 가질 수 없습니다(단, 결속 동물과 애완동물 또는 패밀리어는 동시에 가질 수 있음).

name: Ghost Strike

description.value: Once per day, you can infuse a weapon you are carrying with magical energies that allow it to strike true against incorporeal undead. The weapon gains the effects of the ghost touch property rune for 10 minutes. At 10th level, you can apply this effect to two weapons instead of one.

_desc_en: Once per day, you can infuse a weapon you are carrying with magical energies that allow it to strike true against incorporeal undead. The weapon gains the effects of the ghost touch property rune for 10 minutes. At 10th level, you can apply this effect to two weapons instead of one.
_desc_ko: 하루에 한 번, 소지한 무기에 마법 에너지를 주입하여 비물질적 언데드에게 정확히 강타할 수 있게 할 수 있습니다. 해당 무기는 10분 동안 고스트 터치 속성 룬의 효과를 얻습니다. (10th)레벨에 도달하면 이 효과를 한 개 대신 두 개의 무기에 적용할 수 있습니다.

name: Obscured Emergence

description.value: You are, by nature, a thing of gloomy woods and barren wilds, and when you choose show yourself, a bit of this gloom clings to you, obscuring your form with strange distortions or mist. When you stop being hidden due to your own actions (not due to someone successfully finding you), you gain concealment until the start of your next turn as people's eyes find it oddly hard to focus on you. As usual for concealment involving an obvious visual manifestation, you can't use this concealment to hide.

_desc_en: You are, by nature, a thing of gloomy woods and barren wilds, and when you choose show yourself, a bit of this gloom clings to you, obscuring your form with strange distortions or mist. When you stop being hidden due to your own actions (not due to someone successfully finding you), you gain concealment until the start of your next turn as people's eyes find it oddly hard to focus on you. As usual for concealment involving an obvious visual manifestation, you can't use this concealment to hide.
_desc_ko: 당신은 본질적으로 음울한 숲과 황량한 황야의 존재이며, 모습을 드러낼 때면 이 어둠의 일부가 당신에게 달라붙어 기묘한 왜곡이나 안개로 형체를 가립니다. 당신의 행동으로 인해 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태가 해제될 때(다른 이가 당신을 성공적으로 찾아낸 것이 아닌 경우), 다음 턴 시작까지 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태를 얻습니다. 사람들의 시선이 당신에게 이상하게도 포커스하기 어렵기 때문입니다. 명백한 시각적 현상을 동반하는 은폐의 경우처럼, 이 은폐 상태로는 @link[actions.hide]을 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Snow May

description.value: You're the child of a winter hag, with one blue-white eye and an affinity for rime and snow. When moving over ice or snow in arctic terrain, you always gain the benefits of the Cover Tracks action without needing to use the activity or having to move half your Speed. You don't treat icy terrain as uneven ground (though it's still difficult terrain for you), and you ignore difficult terrain caused by snow. Cold precipitation and environmental cold effects don't alter the time it takes for you to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.
