_desc_en: You're the child of a winter hag, with one blue-white eye and an affinity for rime and snow. When moving over ice or snow in arctic terrain, you always gain the benefits of the Cover Tracks action without needing to use the activity or having to move half your Speed. You don't treat icy terrain as uneven ground (though it's still difficult terrain for you), and you ignore difficult terrain caused by snow. Cold precipitation and environmental cold effects don't alter the time it takes for you to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.
_desc_ko: 당신은 겨울 마녀의 자식으로, 푸르스름한 흰 눈동자를 지녔으며 서리와 눈에 대한 친화력을 가집니다. 북극 지형의 얼음이나 눈 위를 이동할 때, 활동 사용이나 이동 속도의 절반을 소모하지 않고도 항상 '흔적 감추기' 행동의 이점을 얻습니다. 얼음 지형을 고르지 못한 지형으로 간주하지 않으며(하지만 여전히 너에게는 어려운 지형임), 눈으로 인한 어려운 지형도 무시한다. 찬 강수나 환경적 냉기 효과는 네가 @link[conditions.fatigued]가 되는 데 걸리는 시간을 변경하지 않는다.

name: Undead Slayer Dedication

description.value:
Your training has prepared you to recognize most undead on sight. You become trained in two Lore skills, each about a specific type of undead, or become an expert if you were already trained. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JpcegMRqdizrkG0m]{Slayer's Identification} free action.

Special You can't select another dedication feat until you have gained two other feats from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.mV0K9sxD3TWnZDcy]{Undead Slayer} archetype.

_desc_en:
Your training has prepared you to recognize most undead on sight. You become trained in two Lore skills, each about a specific type of undead, or become an expert if you were already trained. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JpcegMRqdizrkG0m]{Slayer's Identification} free action.

Special You can't select another dedication feat until you have gained two other feats from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.mV0K9sxD3TWnZDcy]{Undead Slayer} archetype.
_desc_ko:
당신의 훈련은 대부분의 언데드를 한눈에 알아볼 수 있도록 준비시켰습니다. 특정 유형의 언데드에 관한 두 가지 지식 기술에 숙련되거나, 이미 숙련 상태라면 전문가가 됩니다. @link[actions.slayers-identification] 자유 행동을 얻습니다.

특수 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.mV0K9sxD3TWnZDcy]{언데드 슬레이어} 아키타입에서 다른 두 가지 피트를 획득하기 전까지는 다른 헌신 피트를 선택할 수 없습니다.

name: Keep up Appearances

description.value:
Access Taldan nationality

Trigger You are affected by an emotion effect.

Taldan pride means you never show weakness. Roll a @Check[deception] check and compare the result to any observing creatures' Perception DCs. On a success, that creature believes you were unaffected by the emotion effect.

A creature tricked in this manner can't benefit from the emotion effect and can't use abilities that require you to be under this emotion effect; for example, if you successfully use this ability to trick a will-o'-wisp into believing you aren't under a fear effect, it can't use its Feed on Fear ability on you.

_desc_en:
Access Taldan nationality

Trigger You are affected by an emotion effect.

Taldan pride means you never show weakness. Roll a @Check[deception] check and compare the result to any observing creatures' Perception DCs. On a success, that creature believes you were unaffected by the emotion effect.

A creature tricked in this manner can't benefit from the emotion effect and can't use abilities that require you to be under this emotion effect; for example, if you successfully use this ability to trick a will-o'-wisp into believing you aren't under a fear effect, it can't use its Feed on Fear ability on you.
_desc_ko:
접근 탈단 국적

발동 당신은 감정 효과의 영향을 받고 있습니다.

탈단인의 자존심은 결코 약점을 드러내지 않음을 의미합니다. 기만 판정을 굴리고 결과를 관찰하는 생물의 지각 DC와 비교하세요. 성공 시, 해당 생물은 당신이 감정 효과의 영향을 받지 않았다고 믿습니다.

이런 식으로 속은 생물은 감정 효과의 혜택을 받을 수 없으며, 해당 감정 효과 하에 있어야 발동되는 능력을 사용할 수 없습니다. 예를 들어, 이 능력을 성공적으로 사용해 윌-오-위습을 속여 당신이 공포 효과에 걸리지 않았다고 믿게 했다면, 윌-오-위습은 당신에게 공포 흡수 능력을 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Rushing Boar

description.value:
Requirements You're in boar or hybrid shape.

Trigger An attack from a creature that isn't adjacent to you damaged you.

You embrace the pain of the triggering attack, allowing it to drive you into a violent rush. You Stride in a straight line toward the triggering creature.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're in boar or hybrid shape.

Trigger An attack from a creature that isn't adjacent to you damaged you.

You embrace the pain of the triggering attack, allowing it to drive you into a violent rush. You Stride in a straight line toward the triggering creature.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 멧돼지 형태 또는 혼혈 형태를 취하고 있어야 합니다.

발동 당신과 인접하지 않은 생물의 공격이 당신에게 피해를 입혔습니다.

발동 공격의 고통을 받아들여, 그 고통이 당신을 격렬한 돌진으로 몰아넣게 합니다. 당신은 발동 생물을 향해 직선으로 이동합니다.

name: Quick Shield Block

description.value: You can bring your shield into place with hardly a thought. At the start of each of your turns, you gain an additional reaction that you can use only to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}.

_desc_en: You can bring your shield into place with hardly a thought. At the start of each of your turns, you gain an additional reaction that you can use only to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}.
_desc_ko: 방패를 거의 생각할 필요 없이 제자리에 가져올 수 있다. 각 턴 시작 시, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{방패 막기}에만 사용할 수 있는 추가 반응을 얻는다.

name: Animal Actor

description.value: You participated in a performance of The Leaping Lion, a play focusing on Cyricas, the animal-loving adventurer who traveled with his ape friend Mardu and remains a favorite hero among Taldan youth. You become trained in Nature and a Lore skill related to a particular type of animal commonly used in show business (such as Canine Lore, Ursine Lore, or Primate Lore); if you were already trained in either, you become an expert in that skill instead. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to all checks to Command an Animal and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about creatures with the animal trait. You can use your chosen animal Lore to Command an Animal of that type.

_desc_en: You participated in a performance of The Leaping Lion, a play focusing on Cyricas, the animal-loving adventurer who traveled with his ape friend Mardu and remains a favorite hero among Taldan youth. You become trained in Nature and a Lore skill related to a particular type of animal commonly used in show business (such as Canine Lore, Ursine Lore, or Primate Lore); if you were already trained in either, you become an expert in that skill instead. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to all checks to Command an Animal and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about creatures with the animal trait. You can use your chosen animal Lore to Command an Animal of that type.
_desc_ko: 당신은 '뛰어오르는 사자'라는 연극 공연에 참여했습니다. 이 연극은 원숭이 친구 마르두와 함께 여행하며 동물 애호가로 알려진 모험가 시리카스를 포커스로 하며, 탈단 청년들 사이에서 여전히 사랑받는 영웅입니다. 자연에 대한 숙련도를 획득하며, 공연계에서 흔히 사용되는 특정 동물 유형(개류 지식, 곰류 지식, 영장류 지식 등)과 관련된 지식 기술을 숙련하게 됩니다. 해당 지식 기술 중 하나를 이미 숙련한 경우, 그 지식 기술에 대한 전문가가 됩니다. 동물 특성을 지닌 생물에 대한 동물 조종 및 @link[actions.recall-knowledge] 모든 판정에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 선택한 동물 지식지식 for that type의 동물을 조종할 수 있습니다.

name: Tag Team

description.value:
Trigger You or your spotter misses with a Strike against a creature, and the creature is within the other's melee reach or first range increment.

Your skilled teamwork with your spotter enables you both to assist one another when you falter, using either other's failures as opportunities to strike. If you used Tag Team after your spotter missed the triggering Strike, make a ranged Strike against the same target with a -2 penalty. If you used this reaction after you missed the triggering Strike, your spotter can use their reaction to make a melee or ranged Strike against the same target. Strikes granted by this feat don't count toward your or your spotter's multiple attack penalty and your or your spotter's multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to the granted Strike.

_desc_en:
Trigger You or your spotter misses with a Strike against a creature, and the creature is within the other's melee reach or first range increment.

Your skilled teamwork with your spotter enables you both to assist one another when you falter, using either other's failures as opportunities to strike. If you used Tag Team after your spotter missed the triggering Strike, make a ranged Strike against the same target with a -2 penalty. If you used this reaction after you missed the triggering Strike, your spotter can use their reaction to make a melee or ranged Strike against the same target. Strikes granted by this feat don't count toward your or your spotter's multiple attack penalty and your or your spotter's multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to the granted Strike.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신이나 당신의 스포터가 생물에게 가한 공격이 실패하고, 해당 생물이 상대방의 근접 공격 범위 또는 첫 번째 사거리 내에 있을 때.

스포터와의 숙련된 팀워크로, 서로 실수할 때 이를 기회로 삼아 공격할 수 있습니다. 스포터가 발동 스트라이크를 놓친 후 태그 팀을 사용했다면, 동일한 대상에게 -2 페널티를 적용한 원거리 스트라이크를 수행합니다. 트리거링 스트라이크를 놓친 후 이 반응을 사용했다면, 스포터는 자신의 반응으로 동일한 대상에게 근접 또는 원거리 스트라이크를 시도할 수 있습니다. 이 피트로 부여된 스트라이크는 본인이나 스포터의 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되지 않으며, 본인이나 스포터의 다중 공격 페널티도 부여된 스트라이크에는 적용되지 않습니다.

name: Foresee Danger

description.value:
Trigger A creature targets you with an attack and you can see the attacker.

You perceive every possible way your foe's attack could land and attempt to avoid them all.

The triggering attack roll targets your Perception DC instead of your AC. Though this allows you to avoid taking penalties to your AC, it doesn't remove any conditions or other effects causing such penalties.

For example, an enemy with sneak attack would still deal extra damage to you for being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, even though you wouldn't take the –2 circumstance penalty when defending against the attack.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature targets you with an attack and you can see the attacker.

You perceive every possible way your foe's attack could land and attempt to avoid them all.

The triggering attack roll targets your Perception DC instead of your AC. Though this allows you to avoid taking penalties to your AC, it doesn't remove any conditions or other effects causing such penalties.

For example, an enemy with sneak attack would still deal extra damage to you for being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, even though you wouldn't take the –2 circumstance penalty when defending against the attack.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 생물이 당신을 공격 대상으로 삼고, 당신이 공격자를 볼 수 있을 때.

당신은 적의 공격이 닿을 수 있는 모든 가능성을 인지하고 그 모든 것을 피하려 시도합니다.

발동된 명중 굴림은 AC 대신 당신의 지각력 DC를 대상으로 합니다. 이로 인해 AC에 페널티를 받지 않게 되지만, 해당 페널티를 유발하는 상태 이상이나 기타 효과는 제거되지 않습니다.

예를 들어, 암습을 가진 적의 경우, 공격 방어 시 -2 상황 페널티를 받지 않더라도 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태로 인해 추가 피해를 입게 됩니다.

name: Knockback

description.value:
Requirements Your last action was a successful Strike

The weight of your swing drives your enemy back. You push the enemy back 5 feet, with the effects of a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}. You can follow the enemy as normal for a successful Shove.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your last action was a successful Strike

The weight of your swing drives your enemy back. You push the enemy back 5 feet, with the effects of a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}. You can follow the enemy as normal for a successful Shove.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 마지막 행동이 성공적인 공격이었음

당신의 휘두름의 무게가 적을 밀쳐냅니다. 적을 5피트 뒤로 밀어내며, 성공적인 @link[actions.shove]의 효과를 적용합니다. 성공적인 밀치기 시 적을 따라갈 수 있습니다.

name: Black Powder Embodiment

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a loaded magical firearm or crossbow.

You merge your body with your ammunition, enabling you to travel the same path as your bolt or bullet. Strike a creature with the required weapon. On a success, if the target was within 120 feet, you and all your gear are teleported to an open space of your choice within 10 feet of the target.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a loaded magical firearm or crossbow.

You merge your body with your ammunition, enabling you to travel the same path as your bolt or bullet. Strike a creature with the required weapon. On a success, if the target was within 120 feet, you and all your gear are teleported to an open space of your choice within 10 feet of the target.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 장전된 마법 화기나 석궁을 휘두르고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 탄환과 육체를 융합하여 화살이나 총알과 동일한 경로를 이동합니다. 요구되는 무기로 생물을 강타하세요. 성공 시, 대상이 120피트 이내에 있었다면 당신과 모든 장비가 대상으로부터 10피트 이내의 원하는 개활지로 순간이동합니다.

name: Aura Shaping

description.value: You control the size of your kinetic aura. You can make your kinetic aura's emanation any size from a @Template[emanation|distance:5] to a @Template[emanation|distance:20] (you must choose a multiple of 5). You choose the size when you Channel Elements and can change it when you use a stance impulse that affects your kinetic aura. Increase the maximum size you can choose by 5 feet at 15th and 20th levels.

_desc_en: You control the size of your kinetic aura. You can make your kinetic aura's emanation any size from a @Template[emanation|distance:5] to a @Template[emanation|distance:20] (you must choose a multiple of 5). You choose the size when you Channel Elements and can change it when you use a stance impulse that affects your kinetic aura. Increase the maximum size you can choose by 5 feet at 15th and 20th levels.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신의 키네틱 오라가 발산하는 오라의 크기를 제어합니다. 키네틱 오라가 발산하는 오라의 크기를 5피트에서 20피트 사이의 어떤 크기로도 설정할 수 있습니다(5의 배수로 선택해야 함). 원소 채널링 시 크기를 선택하며, 키네틱 오라에 영향을 미치는 자세 임펄스 를 사용할 때 변경할 수 있습니다. 15레벨과 20레벨에 도달할 때마다 선택 가능한 최대 크기를 5피트씩 증가시킵니다.

name: Nourishing Symbiosis

description.value: As you recuperate from your wounds, life energy flows from you to the land and back to you again. During downtime mode, when you take the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DXIZ4DHGxhZiWNWb]{Long-Term Rest} activity, you regain an additional @Damage[24[healing]]{24 Hit Points} after the first 24 hours of rest. You can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{Subsist} activity during a long-term rest and don't need to spend any additional time to do so. When you do so, fruits, nuts, and vegetables sufficient to feed 5 people flourish overnight around you, ripe for the picking.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: As you recuperate from your wounds, life energy flows from you to the land and back to you again. During downtime mode, when you take the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DXIZ4DHGxhZiWNWb]{Long-Term Rest} activity, you regain an additional @Damage[24[healing]]{24 Hit Points} after the first 24 hours of rest. You can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{Subsist} activity during a long-term rest and don't need to spend any additional time to do so. When you do so, fruits, nuts, and vegetables sufficient to feed 5 people flourish overnight around you, ripe for the picking.
_desc_ko: 상처에서 회복하는 동안 생명 에너지가 당신으로부터 땅으로 흘러나갔다가 다시 당신에게 돌아옵니다. 다운타임 모드 중 @link[actions.long-term-rest] 활동을 수행할 때, 첫 24시간 휴식 후 추가로 24 HP를 회복합니다. 장기 휴식 중에도 @link[actions.subsist] 활동을 사용할 수 있으며, 이를 위해 추가 시간을 소모할 필요가 없습니다. 이 활동을 수행하면, 5명이 먹을 수 있을 만큼의 과일, 견과류, 채소가 하룻밤 사이에 주변에 무성하게 자라 익어 따기만 하면 됩니다.

name: Kobold Momentum

description.value: You possess the confidence of a dragon, and your success emboldens you to draw on power reserves you didn't know you had. You recharge your Kobold Breath whenever you score a critical hit with a Strike. In addition, if you score a critical hit with a Strike and then use your Kobold Breath on the same turn, you can reroll any 1s on the damage dice. You must use the new result, even if it's a 1.

_desc_en: You possess the confidence of a dragon, and your success emboldens you to draw on power reserves you didn't know you had. You recharge your Kobold Breath whenever you score a critical hit with a Strike. In addition, if you score a critical hit with a Strike and then use your Kobold Breath on the same turn, you can reroll any 1s on the damage dice. You must use the new result, even if it's a 1.
_desc_ko: 당신은 용의 자신감을 지녔으며, 당신의 성공은 자신도 몰랐던 힘의 비축분을 끌어내도록 대담하게 만든다. 당신은 타격으로 치명타를 기록할 때마다 코볼드 숨결을 재충전한다. 또한, 타격으로 치명타를 기록한 뒤 같은 턴에 코볼드 숨결을 사용한다면, 피해 주사위의 1을 재굴림할 수 있다. 당신은 새로운 결과를 사용해야 하며, 그것이 1이더라도 그렇게 한다.

name: Home in the Deep

description.value: You cut through the water, and dwell beneath the surface with ease. Increase your swim Speed by 15 feet; you also gain the amphibious trait.

_desc_en: You cut through the water, and dwell beneath the surface with ease. Increase your swim Speed by 15 feet; you also gain the amphibious trait.
_desc_ko: 당신은 물살을 가르며 수면 아래에서 편안하게 거주한다. 당신의 수영 속도를 15피트 증가시킨다. 당신은 또한 양서 특성을 얻는다.

name: Basic Field Training

description.value: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level commander feat.

_desc_en: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level commander feat.
_desc_ko: 1레벨 또는 2레벨 커맨더 피트를 획득한다.

name: Edict of Mortality

description.value:
You recite an excerpt of the Laws of Mortality, often the first law: "Let no mortal be beholden to a god." Attempt an @Check[intimidation|against:will] check against all enemies within 60 feet that worship a deity, comparing your result against each target's Will DC. Targets are then temporarily immune to your use of this ability for 24 hours.

Critical Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}. Until the start of your next turn, if the target attempts to Cast a Spell with the divine trait, it must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:7] or the action is lost.

Success As critical success, but @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}, and the DC of the flat check is 5.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.6lwPOXa25qx9Lo46]{Effect: Edict of Mortality}

_desc_en:
You recite an excerpt of the Laws of Mortality, often the first law: "Let no mortal be beholden to a god." Attempt an @Check[intimidation|against:will] check against all enemies within 60 feet that worship a deity, comparing your result against each target's Will DC. Targets are then temporarily immune to your use of this ability for 24 hours.

Critical Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}. Until the start of your next turn, if the target attempts to Cast a Spell with the divine trait, it must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:7] or the action is lost.

Success As critical success, but @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}, and the DC of the flat check is 5.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.6lwPOXa25qx9Lo46]{Effect: Edict of Mortality}
_desc_ko:
당신은 필멸의 법칙 중 한 구절, 흔히 첫 번째 법칙인 "어떤 필멸자도 신에게 예속되지 말지어다"를 낭송합니다. 60피트 이내에서 신을 숭배하는 모든 적을 상대로 @Check[intimidation|against:will] 판정을 시도하며, 당신의 결과를 각 대상의 의지 DC와 비교합니다. 그런 다음 대상들은 24시간 동안 당신의 이 능력 사용에 일시적으로 면역이 됩니다.

대성공 대상은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{공포 2}가 됩니다. 당신의 다음 턴 시작 시까지, 대상이 신성 특성을 가진 주문을 시전하려 하면 @Check[flat|dc:7]에 성공해야 하며, 실패하면 그 행동을 잃습니다.

성공 대성공과 같으나 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{공포 1}이며, 평판정의 DC는 5입니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.6lwPOXa25qx9Lo46]{효과: 필멸의 칙령}

name: Horizon Walker Dedication

description.value:
You've mastered travel within a specific type of terrain. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.sgo7J9BVofBqwlsF]{Favored Terrain} feat.

When in your favored terrain, you gain a +10-foot circumstance bonus to your travel Speed. When other creatures @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tfa4Sh7wcxCEqL29]{Follow the Expert} with you as a guide in your favored terrain, they gain both the ability to ignore non-magical difficult terrain for the purpose of their travel Speed and the bonus to travel Speed.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.M5QOocGyP4zkMo9m]{Horizon Walker}

_desc_en:
You've mastered travel within a specific type of terrain. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.sgo7J9BVofBqwlsF]{Favored Terrain} feat.

When in your favored terrain, you gain a +10-foot circumstance bonus to your travel Speed. When other creatures @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tfa4Sh7wcxCEqL29]{Follow the Expert} with you as a guide in your favored terrain, they gain both the ability to ignore non-magical difficult terrain for the purpose of their travel Speed and the bonus to travel Speed.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.M5QOocGyP4zkMo9m]{Horizon Walker}
_desc_ko:
특정 지형 유형 내 이동을 마스터했습니다. @link[feats.favored-terrain] 피트를 얻습니다.

선호 지형에 있을 때 이동 속도에 +10피트 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 다른 생물들이 선호 지형에서 당신을 안내자로 @link[actions.follow-the-expert] 경우, 이동 속도 계산 시 비마법적 어려운 지형을 무시할 수 있는 능력과 이동 속도 보너스를 모두 얻습니다.

name: Festering Wounds

description.value: Wounds you inflict with your unarmed attacks fester and rot, becoming infected and difficult to heal. The DC to Treat these Wounds using Medicine increases by 5, and magically or alchemically healing these wounds requires a counteract check against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Succeeding at any of these removes the disease. The effect also ends if the creature is healed to full Hit Points by any means.

_desc_en: Wounds you inflict with your unarmed attacks fester and rot, becoming infected and difficult to heal. The DC to Treat these Wounds using Medicine increases by 5, and magically or alchemically healing these wounds requires a counteract check against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Succeeding at any of these removes the disease. The effect also ends if the creature is healed to full Hit Points by any means.
_desc_ko: 당신의 비무장 공격으로 입힌 상처는 곪고 썩어 감염되어 치유가 어려워집니다. 이 상처를 치유하기 위한 의술의 난이도(DC)가 5 증가하며, 마법이나 연금술로 이 상처를 치유하려면 당신의 직업 난이도(DC) 또는 주문 난이도(DC) 중 더 높은 쪽에 대한 반격 판정이 필요합니다. 이 중 하나에 성공하면 질병이 제거됩니다. 또한 대상이 어떤 방법으로든 완전히 치유되면 효과가 종료됩니다.

name: Double Prey

description.value: You can focus on two foes at once, hunting both of them down. When you use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JYi4MnsdFu618hPm]{Hunt Prey} action, you can pick two creatures as your prey.

_desc_en: You can focus on two foes at once, hunting both of them down. When you use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JYi4MnsdFu618hPm]{Hunt Prey} action, you can pick two creatures as your prey.
_desc_ko: 당신은 두 적을 동시에 포커스하여 둘 다 사냥할 수 있습니다. @link[actions.hunt-prey] 행동을 사용할 때, 두 생물을 사냥감으로 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Juvenile Flight

description.value: Your wings become stronger, allowing you to fly farther. The fly Speed you gain from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.UuVz1QY7QXD5cnLu]{Fledgling Flight} increases to 25 feet.

_desc_en: Your wings become stronger, allowing you to fly farther. The fly Speed you gain from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.UuVz1QY7QXD5cnLu]{Fledgling Flight} increases to 25 feet.
_desc_ko: 날개가 더 강해져 더 멀리 날 수 있습니다. @link[feats.fledgling-flight]에서 얻는 비행 속도가 25피트로 증가합니다.

name: Cutting Heaven, Crushing Earth

description.value:
Your skill in combining fist and blade has grown into a seamless art where each attack makes an opponent more vulnerable to the next. As long as you have invested and are wearing a set of handwraps of mighty blows, you also apply their runes to a single weapon you're wielding that can be used with your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.zUWj4zmBNWOTzeFJ]{Overwhelming Combination} ability. You gain the following benefits.

  • When you successfully Strike an opponent with this weapon, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to the next Strike you make against it with a fist unarmed attack before the end of your next turn.
  • When you successfully Strike an opponent with your fist unarmed attack, it's off-guard to the next Strike you make against it with a one-handed, agile, or finesse melee weapon before the end of your next turn.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Your skill in combining fist and blade has grown into a seamless art where each attack makes an opponent more vulnerable to the next. As long as you have invested and are wearing a set of handwraps of mighty blows, you also apply their runes to a single weapon you're wielding that can be used with your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.zUWj4zmBNWOTzeFJ]{Overwhelming Combination} ability. You gain the following benefits.

  • When you successfully Strike an opponent with this weapon, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to the next Strike you make against it with a fist unarmed attack before the end of your next turn.
  • When you successfully Strike an opponent with your fist unarmed attack, it's off-guard to the next Strike you make against it with a one-handed, agile, or finesse melee weapon before the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
주먹과 칼을 결합하는 당신의 기술은 매 공격이 다음 공격에 상대의 약점을 더욱 드러나게 만드는 완벽한 예술로 발전했습니다. 강력한 주먹의 핸드랩 세트를 장착하고 착용 중일 경우, @link[actions.overwhelming-combination] 능력으로 사용할 수 있는 단일 무기 에 해당 핸드랩의 룬 효과를 적용한다. 다음 혜택을 얻는다.

  • 이 무기로 적을 공격에 성공하면, 다음 턴이 끝나기 전까지 주먹 비무장 공격으로 해당 적을 다시 공격할 때 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다.
  • 비무장 공격으로 적을 성공적으로 강타했을 때, 다음 턴이 끝나기 전까지 한손 무기, 기민한 무기, 또는 기교 무기로 그 적을 강타하는 다음 공격에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Lich Dedication

description.value:
After years of study and careful planning, you finally completed a soul cage to house your soul and successfully performed a ritual to transform yourself into a lich. Now, neither death nor time can prevent you from pursuing your studies and achieving your grand ambitions. You gain the undead trait and the basic undead benefits. Your undead craving is for knowledge.

You gain a unique @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.qFVPeeJ70B1u2n81]{Soul Cage}—a magic item that houses your soul. Whenever you would die, your soul flees to the soul cage to allow you to be rebuilt. As long as your soul cage exists, you can't truly be destroyed.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.r43lPEEL7WHOZjHL]{Lich}

value.value: ability to cast 6th-rank or higher spells from spell slots
completed ritual to become a lich and crafted a soul cage

_desc_en:
After years of study and careful planning, you finally completed a soul cage to house your soul and successfully performed a ritual to transform yourself into a lich. Now, neither death nor time can prevent you from pursuing your studies and achieving your grand ambitions. You gain the undead trait and the basic undead benefits. Your undead craving is for knowledge.

You gain a unique @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.qFVPeeJ70B1u2n81]{Soul Cage}—a magic item that houses your soul. Whenever you would die, your soul flees to the soul cage to allow you to be rebuilt. As long as your soul cage exists, you can't truly be destroyed.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.r43lPEEL7WHOZjHL]{Lich}
_desc_ko:
수년간의 연구와 신중한 계획 끝에, 마침내 자신의 영혼을 담을 영혼의 감옥을 완성하고 자신을 리치로 변모시키는 의식을 성공적으로 수행했습니다. 이제 죽음도 시간도 당신의 연구를 방해하거나 위대한 야망을 이루는 것을 막을 수 없습니다. 당신은 언데드 특성과 기본 언데드 혜택을 얻습니다. 당신의 언데드 갈망은 지식입니다.

당신은 고유한 @link[equipment.soul-cage]-당신의 영혼을 담는 마법 아이템을 얻습니다. 당신이 죽을 때마다, 당신의 영혼은 영혼의 감옥으로 도피하여 당신이 재구성될 수 있게 합니다. 영혼의 감옥이 존재하는 한, 당신은 진정으로 파괴될 수 없습니다.

name: Spell Devourer

description.value: You don't just resist magic; you devour it. Whenever you succeed at a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to double the spell's rank, or equal to the level if the magical effect isn't a spell. These temporary Hit Points last until the end of your next turn.

rules.text: Whenever you succeed at a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to double the spell's rank, or equal to the level if the magical effect isn't a spell. These temporary Hit Points last until the end of your next turn.
rules.title: {item|name}

_desc_en: You don't just resist magic; you devour it. Whenever you succeed at a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to double the spell's rank, or equal to the level if the magical effect isn't a spell. These temporary Hit Points last until the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko: 당신은 마법을 단순히 저항하는 것이 아니라 삼켜버립니다. 주문이나 마법 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공할 때마다, 해당 주문의 랭크 수의 두 배에 해당하는 임시 HP(또는 마법 효과가 주문이 아닌 경우 레벨에 해당하는 임시 HP)을 얻습니다. 이 임시 HP는 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 지속됩니다.

name: Quiet Allies

description.value: You're skilled at moving with a group. When you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoiding Notice} and your allies @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tfa4Sh7wcxCEqL29]{Follow the Expert}, you and those allies can roll a single Stealth check, using the lowest modifier, instead of rolling separately. This doesn't apply for initiative rolls.

_desc_en: You're skilled at moving with a group. When you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoiding Notice} and your allies @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tfa4Sh7wcxCEqL29]{Follow the Expert}, you and those allies can roll a single Stealth check, using the lowest modifier, instead of rolling separately. This doesn't apply for initiative rolls.
_desc_ko: 당신은 집단과 함께 움직이는 데 능숙합니다. 당신이 @link[actions.avoid-notice] 상태이고, 동맹이 @link[actions.follow-the-expert]를 사용할 때, 당신과 해당 아군들은 개별적으로 굴리지 않고 가장 낮은 수정치를 적용하여 단일 은신 검사만 굴릴 수 있습니다. 이 효과는 선공 검사에는 적용되지 않습니다.

name: Axe Thrower

description.value: You have mastered the weight and balance of a variety of axes and can lob them with ease. Any one-handed axe weapon you wield has the thrown trait with a range of 10 feet. For axes that already have the thrown trait, the range increases by 10 feet. When you critically succeed at an attack roll with a thrown axe weapon, you apply the axe's critical specialization effect.

_desc_en: You have mastered the weight and balance of a variety of axes and can lob them with ease. Any one-handed axe weapon you wield has the thrown trait with a range of 10 feet. For axes that already have the thrown trait, the range increases by 10 feet. When you critically succeed at an attack roll with a thrown axe weapon, you apply the axe's critical specialization effect.
_desc_ko: 다양한 도끼의 무게와 균형을 마스터하여 쉽게 던질 수 있습니다. 당신이 휘두르는 모든 한손 도끼 무기는 투척 특성을 가지며 사거리는 10피트입니다. 이미 투척 특성을 가진 도끼의 경우 사거리가 10피트 증가합니다. 투척 도끼 무기로 명중 굴림에 대성공 시, 해당 도끼의 치명타 전문화 효과를 적용합니다.

name: Spiritual Explorer

description.value: You're familiar with the danger that lingering spirits can pose to an unwary adventurer, and you're particularly attuned to their presence. Even if you aren't Searching in exploration mode, you can attempt a check to find haunts that normally require you to Search for them. You still need to meet any other requirements to find a particular haunt.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en: You're familiar with the danger that lingering spirits can pose to an unwary adventurer, and you're particularly attuned to their presence. Even if you aren't Searching in exploration mode, you can attempt a check to find haunts that normally require you to Search for them. You still need to meet any other requirements to find a particular haunt.
_desc_ko: 유령이 방심한 모험가에게 끼칠 수 있는 위험을 패밀리어하게 알고 있으며, 특히 그들의 존재를 감지하는 데 능숙합니다. 탐색 모드에서 탐색을 하지 않더라도, 일반적으로 탐색이 필요한 유령의 출몰지를 찾아내기 위한 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다. 특정 유령을 찾기 위한 다른 조건들은 여전히 충족해야 합니다.

name: Shared Attunement

description.value: When you would gain a benefit from your terrain attunement, you can grant it to one ally within 30 feet instead of yourself. This has no effect if the terrain attunement affects your foes instead of granting you a benefit.

_desc_en: When you would gain a benefit from your terrain attunement, you can grant it to one ally within 30 feet instead of yourself. This has no effect if the terrain attunement affects your foes instead of granting you a benefit.
_desc_ko: 지형 조율로 혜택을 받을 때, 자신 대신 30피트 내의 한 동맹에게 이를 부여할 수 있다. 지형 조율이 자신에게 혜택을 주지 않고 적에게 영향을 미치는 경우에는 효과가 없다.

name: Stunt Performer Stance

description.value:
Requirements You are unarmored.

You clear your mind, regulate your breathing, and prepare your muscles in a stance inspired by Kemen Kayton, a graduate of Zimar's Monastery of the Seven Forms. Kemen controversially shunned monastic life and instead used his martial skills as a death-defying stunt performer, winning acclaim for exhibitions that saw him survive great falls and escape deadly traps. While in this stance, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Reflex saving throws and skill checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}, as well as resistance 2 to all physical damage.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are unarmored.

You clear your mind, regulate your breathing, and prepare your muscles in a stance inspired by Kemen Kayton, a graduate of Zimar's Monastery of the Seven Forms. Kemen controversially shunned monastic life and instead used his martial skills as a death-defying stunt performer, winning acclaim for exhibitions that saw him survive great falls and escape deadly traps. While in this stance, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Reflex saving throws and skill checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}, as well as resistance 2 to all physical damage.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 갑옷을 착용하지 않은 상태여야 합니다.

당신은 지마르의 칠형 수도원 출신인 케멘 카이톤에게서 영감을 받은 자세로 마음을 비우고 호흡을 조절하며 근육을 준비합니다. 케멘은 논란 속에 수도원 생활을 거부하고 대신 무술 실력을 죽음과 맞서는 스턴트 연기자로서 활용했으며, 높은 곳에서 추락을 견디고 치명적인 함정에서 탈출하는 공연으로 명성을 얻었습니다. 이 자세를 취하는 동안, 당신은 반사 내성 에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며, @link[actions.escape] 기술 판정에도 +2 상황 보너스를 얻고, 모든 물리적 피해에 대해 저항력 2를 얻습니다.

name: Underworld Investigator

description.value: Your work as an investigator makes you familiar with the criminal element. You might be a criminal yourself, or you might have gained an understanding of how they operate from the outside. You become trained in Underworld Lore, and you gain your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xTK2zsWFyxSJvYbX]{Pursue a Lead} investigation bonus to Thievery checks to investigate a case (such as checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} a clue from a suspect or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick a Lock} to open a safe with damning documents).

_desc_en: Your work as an investigator makes you familiar with the criminal element. You might be a criminal yourself, or you might have gained an understanding of how they operate from the outside. You become trained in Underworld Lore, and you gain your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xTK2zsWFyxSJvYbX]{Pursue a Lead} investigation bonus to Thievery checks to investigate a case (such as checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} a clue from a suspect or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick a Lock} to open a safe with damning documents).
_desc_ko: 조사자としての 업무로 인해 범죄 조직에 패밀리어하게 되었습니다. 본인이 범죄자일 수도 있고, 외부에서 그들의 운영 방식을 이해했을 수도 있습니다. 당신은 지하세계 지식에 정통해지며, 사건 수사 시 도둑질 판정(예: 용의자로부터 단서를 @link[actions.steal]하거나 결정적 증거가 담긴 금고를 @link[actions.pick-a-lock]로 여는 판정)에 @link[actions.pursue-a-lead] 수사 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Vishkanya Lore

description.value: You deeply understand vishkanyan strengths and cultural traditions. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Performance and Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also become trained in Vishkanya Lore.

_desc_en: You deeply understand vishkanyan strengths and cultural traditions. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Performance and Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also become trained in Vishkanya Lore.
_desc_ko: 당신은 비슈카냐의 강점과 문화적 전통을 깊이 이해합니다. 공연술과 은신술에 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 해당 기술 중 하나에 자동으로 숙련이 부여될 경우, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련이 부여됩니다. 또한 비슈카냐 지식에 숙련이 부여됩니다.

name: Master Sorcerer Spellcasting

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#master-spellcasting-feat]{Master Spellcasting Feat} benefits.

value.value: legendary in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion depending on bloodline

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#master-spellcasting-feat]{Master Spellcasting Feat} benefits.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#master-spellcasting-feat]{마스터 주문 시전 피트}의 혜택을 얻습니다.

name: Terrain Form

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You crumble to pieces, becoming composed of the very terrain to which you're bound, with the effects of the gaseous form spell, or you reconstitute into your normal form. The substance you're formed of depends upon your bound terrain, and the action gains the corresponding trait or traits.

Arctic Snow (water)

Desert Sand (earth)

Mountain Cloud (water)

Swamp Mud (earth, water)

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You crumble to pieces, becoming composed of the very terrain to which you're bound, with the effects of the gaseous form spell, or you reconstitute into your normal form. The substance you're formed of depends upon your bound terrain, and the action gains the corresponding trait or traits.

Arctic Snow (water)

Desert Sand (earth)

Mountain Cloud (water)

Swamp Mud (earth, water)
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신은 산산조각이 나며, 기체 형태 마법의 효과를 지닌 채 묶인 지형 그 자체로 구성되거나, 원래 형태로 재구성됩니다. 당신이 형성된 물질은 묶인 지형에 따라 달라지며, 해당 행동은 그에 상응하는 특성 하나 또는 여러 가지를 얻습니다.

북극 눈 (물)

사막 모래 (흙)

산 구름 (물)

늪 진흙 (흙, 물)

name: Iruxi Spirit Strike

description.value: Your iruxi unarmed attacks channel the spiritual energy of your ancestors. Any unarmed attacks you acquire from the lizardfolk ancestry, lizardfolk heritages, or lizardfolk ancestry feats gain the effects of a ghost touch property rune.

_desc_en: Your iruxi unarmed attacks channel the spiritual energy of your ancestors. Any unarmed attacks you acquire from the lizardfolk ancestry, lizardfolk heritages, or lizardfolk ancestry feats gain the effects of a ghost touch property rune.
_desc_ko: 당신의 이룩시 비무장 공격은 조상의 영적 에너지를 집중합니다. 리자드포크 혈통, 리자드포크 유산, 또는 리자드포크 혈통 피트로 획득한 모든 비무장 공격은 고스트 터치⟬0003⟭ 속성 룬의 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Westyr's Wayfinder Repository

description.value:
Requirements You have at least one 1st-rank spell slot and a wayfinder.

You can use your wayfinder to store a little extra magic for when you need it most. When making your daily preparations, you can choose one 1st-rank spell from your spellbook or spell repertoire and store it in your wayfinder. You can cast this spell from the wayfinder using the normal actions required. Once the spell has been cast, it is expended, and you must make your next daily preparations to store another spell in your wayfinder.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en:
Requirements You have at least one 1st-rank spell slot and a wayfinder.

You can use your wayfinder to store a little extra magic for when you need it most. When making your daily preparations, you can choose one 1st-rank spell from your spellbook or spell repertoire and store it in your wayfinder. You can cast this spell from the wayfinder using the normal actions required. Once the spell has been cast, it is expended, and you must make your next daily preparations to store another spell in your wayfinder.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 1랭크 주문 슬롯이 하나 이상 있고 웨이파인더가 있어야 합니다.

웨이파인더로 가장 필요한 순간을 위해 약간의 마법을 추가로 저장할 수 있습니다. 일일 준비를 할 때, 주문서나 주문 목록에서 1랭크 주문 하나를 선택하여 웨이파인더에 저장할 수 있습니다. 이 주문은 웨이파인더를 통해 일반 행동 을 사용해 시전할 수 있습니다. 주문이 시전되면 소모되며, 다음 일일 준비를 통해 웨이파인더에 다른 주문을 저장해야 합니다.

name: Mystical Flare

description.value:
Requirements Your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XIgvCPaSy5WXStVD]{Spellsurge} aura is active.

You release a torrent of magic to fill the air with tiny, distracting explosions of light. All creatures within your spellsurge aura become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the aura are concealed to creatures within it. However, you can ignore this concealment. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn, but you can extend the duration for an additional round by Sustaining it once per round.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XIgvCPaSy5WXStVD]{Spellsurge} aura is active.

You release a torrent of magic to fill the air with tiny, distracting explosions of light. All creatures within your spellsurge aura become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the aura are concealed to creatures within it. However, you can ignore this concealment. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn, but you can extend the duration for an additional round by Sustaining it once per round.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신의 @link[spells.spellsurge] 오라가 활성화되어 있습니다.

당신은 마법의 폭풍을 방출하여 공기를 산란시키는 작은 빛의 폭발로 가득 채웁니다. 당신의 주문파동 오라 내 모든 생물은 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태가 되며, 오라 외부의 모든 생물은 오라 내 생물에게 은폐 상태가 됩니다. 그러나 당신은 이 {가려진}을 무시할 수 있다. 이 효과는 당신의 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 지속되지만, 턴당 한 번씩 지속함으로써 추가 1라운드 동안 지속 시간을 연장할 수 있다.

name: Armor in Earth

description.value:
Stone encases you like armor. The stone armor is medium armor but uses your highest armor proficiency. The stone armor's statistics are: AC Bonus +4; Dex Cap +1; Check Penalty –2; Speed Penalty –10 feet; Strength +3; Bulk 1; Group plate. You gain its armor specialization effect. Any bonuses, runes, and magical abilities of your actual armor are suppressed, but any runes that could apply to the stone armor are replicated onto it. The stone armor lasts for 10 minutes, and you can Dismiss this impulse. If you use this impulse again, any existing one ends.

Level (3rd) The armor becomes heavy armor. Its AC Bonus becomes +5, and it gains the bulwark armor trait.

_desc_en:
Stone encases you like armor. The stone armor is medium armor but uses your highest armor proficiency. The stone armor's statistics are: AC Bonus +4; Dex Cap +1; Check Penalty –2; Speed Penalty –10 feet; Strength +3; Bulk 1; Group plate. You gain its armor specialization effect. Any bonuses, runes, and magical abilities of your actual armor are suppressed, but any runes that could apply to the stone armor are replicated onto it. The stone armor lasts for 10 minutes, and you can Dismiss this impulse. If you use this impulse again, any existing one ends.

Level (3rd) The armor becomes heavy armor. Its AC Bonus becomes +5, and it gains the bulwark armor trait.
_desc_ko:
돌이 갑옷처럼 당신을 감쌉니다. 이 돌 갑옷은 평갑이지만, 당신의 가장 높은 갑옷 숙련도를 사용합니다. 돌 갑옷의 통계는 다음과 같습니다: AC 보너스 +4; 민첩 상한 +1; 판정 페널티 -2; 속도 페널티 -10피트; 근력 +3; 벌크 1; 그룹 플레이트. 당신은 이 갑옷의 특화 효과를 얻습니다. 실제 착용한 갑옷의 모든 보너스, 룬, 마법 능력이 억제되지만, 돌 갑옷에 적용될 수 있는 룬은 그대로 복제됩니다. 돌 갑옷은 10분 동안 지속되며, 이 충동을 해제할 수 있습니다. 이 충동을 다시 사용하면 기존 효과는 종료됩니다.

레벨 (3rd) 갑옷이 중갑으로 변합니다. AC 보너스가 +5가 되며, 방벽 갑옷 특성을 얻습니다.

name: Shory Aerialist

description.value: Unique in Golarion's history, the Shory people developed fighting styles dedicated to combat in the air. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to Maneuver in Flight and a +5-foot status bonus to your fly Speed whenever you are flying via magic.

value.value: Shory Aeromancer or ability to cast fly

_desc_en: Unique in Golarion's history, the Shory people developed fighting styles dedicated to combat in the air. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to Maneuver in Flight and a +5-foot status bonus to your fly Speed whenever you are flying via magic.
_desc_ko: 골라리온 역사상 유일무이하게, 쇼리족은 공중 전투에 헌신한 격투 기술을 발전시켰습니다. 비행 중 기동 곡예 판정 시 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 마법으로 비행할 때마다 비행 속도에 +5피트 상태 보너스가 적용됩니다.

name: Reason Rapidly

description.value: Your mind works through clues at an unbelievable speed. You instantly use up to five @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} actions. If you have any special abilities or free actions that would normally be triggered when you Recall Knowledge, you can't use them for these actions.

_desc_en: Your mind works through clues at an unbelievable speed. You instantly use up to five @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} actions. If you have any special abilities or free actions that would normally be triggered when you Recall Knowledge, you can't use them for these actions.
_desc_ko: 당신의 정신은 단서들을 믿기 힘든 속도로 분석합니다. 최대 다섯 번의 @link[actions.recall-knowledge] 행동을 즉시 사용합니다. 지식 회상 시 일반적으로 발동되는 특수 능력이나 자유 행동이 있다면, 이 행동들에 대해서는 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Overwhelming Spellstrike

description.value:
Requirements Your Spellstrike is charged.

You pierce through your foe's resistance. Make a Spellstrike. The spell you cast as part of the Spellstrike ignores an amount of the target's resistance to acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage equal to your level. This applies to all damage the spell deals, including @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistent Damage} and damage caused by an ongoing effect of the spell. A creature's immunities are unaffected.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your Spellstrike is charged.

You pierce through your foe's resistance. Make a Spellstrike. The spell you cast as part of the Spellstrike ignores an amount of the target's resistance to acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage equal to your level. This applies to all damage the spell deals, including @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistent Damage} and damage caused by an ongoing effect of the spell. A creature's immunities are unaffected.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신의 스펠스트라이크가 충전되어 있어야 합니다.

당신은 적의 저항력을 관통합니다. 스펠스트라이크를 수행하십시오. 주문타격의 일환으로 시전한 주문은 대상의 산성, 냉기, 전기, 화염, 음파 피해에 대한 저항력을 당신의 레벨만큼 무시합니다. 이는 주문이 주는 모든 피해(@link[conditions.persistent-damage] 및 주문의 지속 효과로 인한 피해 포함)에 적용됩니다. 생물의 면역력은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

name: Unbalancing Sweep

description.value: You make a great sweep with your weapon or fists about yourself, knocking creatures off their feet and away from you. Choose up to three enemies within your reach and choose whether to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} all three of them. Whichever of the two options you choose, roll a separate Athletics check against each enemy, performing the same action against each enemy. Each attempt counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but don't increase your penalty until you have made all the attempts.

_desc_en: You make a great sweep with your weapon or fists about yourself, knocking creatures off their feet and away from you. Choose up to three enemies within your reach and choose whether to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} all three of them. Whichever of the two options you choose, roll a separate Athletics check against each enemy, performing the same action against each enemy. Each attempt counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but don't increase your penalty until you have made all the attempts.
_desc_ko: 무기나 주먹으로 주변을 크게 휘둘러 생물들을 넘어뜨리고 멀리 밀쳐냅니다. 손이 닿는 범위 내의 적 최대 세 명을 선택하고 다음 중 하나를 선택하세요: @link[actions.shove] 또는 @link[actions.trip] 중 하나를 선택한다. 선택한 옵션에 따라 각 적에게 별도의 운동 판정을 굴리며, 동일한 행동을 적용한다. 각 시도는 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되나, 모든 시도를 완료하기 전까지는 페널티를 증가시키지 않는다.

name: Eerie Environs

description.value: The natural world can be scary to those not used to it—and you make it scarier still. If you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from a creature, you can attempt to [[/act demoralize]] it without losing your hidden condition—imitating the sounds of strange beasts or causing the foliage to rustle menacingly. When you do so, you don't take a penalty to your check if the target doesn't understand your language.

_desc_en: The natural world can be scary to those not used to it—and you make it scarier still. If you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from a creature, you can attempt to [[/act demoralize]] it without losing your hidden condition—imitating the sounds of strange beasts or causing the foliage to rustle menacingly. When you do so, you don't take a penalty to your check if the target doesn't understand your language.
_desc_ko: 자연계는 익숙하지 않은 이들에게 공포를 주는데, 당신은 그 공포를 더욱 증폭시킵니다. 생물에게 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태라면, 당신은 시도할 수 있습니다. @link[actions.demoralize] 시도를 할 수 있습니다. 이때 은신 상태를 유지한 채로, 괴물의 소리를 흉내 내거나 위협적으로 나뭇잎을 바스락거리게 할 수 있습니다. 대상이 당신의 언어를 이해하지 못할 경우, 이 시도에 페널티가 적용되지 않습니다.

name: You Don't Smell Right

description.value: You can sniff out fellow werecreatures and master impersonators alike. You gain scent as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet or extend the range of your scent by 30 feet. When a creature that's transformed into another form or is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonating} a specific creature passes within range of your scent ability, the GM rolls a secret @Check[perception|traits:secret] check for you to realize that the creature is transformed, even if you didn't spend an action to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek}. When you actively Seek a creature within range of your scent, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Perception check to determine if it's disguised.

_desc_en: You can sniff out fellow werecreatures and master impersonators alike. You gain scent as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet or extend the range of your scent by 30 feet. When a creature that's transformed into another form or is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonating} a specific creature passes within range of your scent ability, the GM rolls a secret @Check[perception|traits:secret] check for you to realize that the creature is transformed, even if you didn't spend an action to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek}. When you actively Seek a creature within range of your scent, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Perception check to determine if it's disguised.
_desc_ko: 동족의 변신 생물이나 마스터 변장자를 후각으로 추적할 수 있습니다. 30피트 범위의 부정확한 감각으로 후각을 획득하거나 기존 후각 범위를 30피트 확장합니다. 다른 형태로 변신했거나 특정 생물을 @link[actions.impersonate] 중인 생물이 당신의 후각 능력 범위 내로 들어오면, GM은 비밀 지각 판정을 굴려 당신이 그 생물이 변신했음을 알아차리게 합니다. 이때 당신은 @link[actions.seek] 행동을 사용하지 않아도 됩니다. 당신의 후각 범위 내 생물을 적극적으로 탐색할 때, 그 생물이 변장했는지 판단하는 지각 판정에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Cannon Corner Shot

description.value: By loading special ammunition in a particular way, you can make your siege weapons do all manner of tricks that other siege engineers can barely even imagine. If you personally contribute an additional Load action to the siege weapon's loading, above the minimum, you can change a burst into a line twice as long as the size of the burst, or vice versa (so a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] turns into a @Template[type:line|distance:20], or a @Template[type:line|distance:20] turns into a @Template[type:burst|distance:10]).

_desc_en: By loading special ammunition in a particular way, you can make your siege weapons do all manner of tricks that other siege engineers can barely even imagine. If you personally contribute an additional Load action to the siege weapon's loading, above the minimum, you can change a burst into a line twice as long as the size of the burst, or vice versa (so a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] turns into a @Template[type:line|distance:20], or a @Template[type:line|distance:20] turns into a @Template[type:burst|distance:10]).
_desc_ko: 특수 탄약을 특별한 방식으로 장전함으로써, 다른 공성 기술자들이 상상조차 하기 어려운 온갖 묘기를 공성 무기로 발휘할 수 있습니다. 공성 무기 장전에 최소 요구량 이상의 추가 장전 행동을 직접 기여하면, 연발 사격을 연발 사격 범위 길이의 두 배로 늘리거나 그 반대로 변경할 수 있습니다(예: 10피트 폭발가 20피트 직선로, 또는 20피트 직선가 10피트 폭발로 변환).

name: Thoughtform Summoning

description.value:
You can create a prototypical creature from the depths of your imagination instead of calling one from elsewhere. Whenever you summon a creature, you can choose to instead create a psychic construct of that creature. This grants it resistance to physical damage equal to half its level, weakness 5 to force and mental damage, and the ability to pass through enemies' spaces without needing to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} (though it can't end its turn in an occupied space).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ByXEvk0gyFwUk5gU]{Effect: Thoughtform Summoning}

_desc_en:
You can create a prototypical creature from the depths of your imagination instead of calling one from elsewhere. Whenever you summon a creature, you can choose to instead create a psychic construct of that creature. This grants it resistance to physical damage equal to half its level, weakness 5 to force and mental damage, and the ability to pass through enemies' spaces without needing to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} (though it can't end its turn in an occupied space).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ByXEvk0gyFwUk5gU]{Effect: Thoughtform Summoning}
_desc_ko:
다른 곳에서 소환하는 대신 상상력의 심연에서 원형 생물을 창조할 수 있습니다. 생물을 소환할 때마다, 대신 그 생물의 사이킥 구조체를 창조할 수 있다. 이 구조체는 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 물리 피해 저항력을 부여받으며, 힘 및 정신 피해에 대해 약점 5를 지닌다. 또한 적의 공간을 통과할 때 @link[actions.tumble-through] 기술이 필요하지 않다(단, 점유된 공간에서 턴을 종료할 수는 없다).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ByXEvk0gyFwUk5gU]{효과: 사상체 소환}

name: Inspire Imitation

description.value: Your actions inspire your allies to great achievements. Whenever you critically succeed at a skill check, you automatically qualify to use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} reaction when attempting to help an ally using the same skill, even without spending an action to prepare to do so.

_desc_en: Your actions inspire your allies to great achievements. Whenever you critically succeed at a skill check, you automatically qualify to use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} reaction when attempting to help an ally using the same skill, even without spending an action to prepare to do so.
_desc_ko: 당신의 행동은 동료들에게 위대한 업적을 이루도록 영감을 줍니다. 스킬 판정에 대성공할 때마다, 동일한 스킬을 사용해 동료를 돕는 시도에 @link[actions.aid] 반응을 자동으로 사용할 자격을 얻습니다. 이를 위해 행동을 소모해 준비할 필요조차 없습니다.

name: Coating of Slime

description.value: An acidic ooze coats your limbs. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 persistent acid damage on a critical hit.

_desc_en: An acidic ooze coats your limbs. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 persistent acid damage on a critical hit.
_desc_ko: 신체 사지에 산성 우즈가 코팅됩니다. 비무장 공격이 치명타를 기록할 경우 추가로 1d4 지속성 산성 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Speak with Flowers

description.value: At your very heartwood, you're a flower animated by elder magic, and with a little effort, you can speak to your kindred. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with flowering plants of all types.

_desc_en: At your very heartwood, you're a flower animated by elder magic, and with a little effort, you can speak to your kindred. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with flowering plants of all types.
_desc_ko: 당신은 가장 깊은 속살까지 고대의 마법으로 움직이는 꽃이며, 약간의 노력으로 동족과 대화할 수 있습니다. 모든 종류의 꽃피는 식물에게 질문을 하고, 답변을 받으며, 외교 기술을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Sacral Monarch

description.value: You have come into your full powers and are truly a monarch of your realm, by your own definition at least. While in your territory, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.bay4AfSu2iIozNNW]{Banishment} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8THDHP0UC7SgOYYF]{Inevitable Disaster} as innate divine spells, each once per day.

_desc_en: You have come into your full powers and are truly a monarch of your realm, by your own definition at least. While in your territory, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.bay4AfSu2iIozNNW]{Banishment} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8THDHP0UC7SgOYYF]{Inevitable Disaster} as innate divine spells, each once per day.
_desc_ko: 당신은 완전한 힘을 얻었으며, 적어도 스스로의 정의에 따르면 진정한 렐름의 군주가 되었다. 영토 내에 있을 때, 당신은 @link[spells.banishment]과 @link[spells.inevitable-disaster]을 선천적 신성 마법으로 하루에 각각 한 번씩 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Catrina's Presence

description.value: You've adopted the calming presence of catrinas, the festive dead; you might have even danced with a catrina yourself! So long as you are visibly carrying fresh flowers or colorful ribbons somewhere on your person, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.b515AZlB0sridKSq]{Calm} twice per day as a 2nd-rank divine innate spell.

_desc_en: You've adopted the calming presence of catrinas, the festive dead; you might have even danced with a catrina yourself! So long as you are visibly carrying fresh flowers or colorful ribbons somewhere on your person, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.b515AZlB0sridKSq]{Calm} twice per day as a 2nd-rank divine innate spell.
_desc_ko: 당신은 축제적인 죽은 자들인 카트리나들의 평온한 존재감을 받아들였습니다. 어쩌면 직접 카트리나와 춤을 추기도 했을지 모릅니다! 신체 어느 부위에든 눈에 띄게 신선한 꽃이나 화려한 리본을 지니고 있는 한, 하루에 두 번 @link[spells.calm]을 (2nd)랭크 신성 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있다.

name: Ancient Memories

description.value: In the long years since Ghorus's day, you've done pretty much everything at one time or another. During your daily preparations, you can explore your memories of your past lives to become trained in one skill of your choice. This proficiency lasts until you prepare again. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a skill increase or a permanent character option like a feat.

_desc_en: In the long years since Ghorus's day, you've done pretty much everything at one time or another. During your daily preparations, you can explore your memories of your past lives to become trained in one skill of your choice. This proficiency lasts until you prepare again. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a skill increase or a permanent character option like a feat.
_desc_ko: 고루스의 시대 이후 오랜 세월 동안, 당신은 거의 모든 일을 한 번쯤은 해봤습니다. 일상적인 준비 과정에서, 당신은 과거 생애의 기억을 탐구하여 선택한 한 가지 기술에 숙련될 수 있습니다. 이 숙련도는 다음 준비 시까지 지속됩니다. 이 숙련도는 일시적이므로, 기술 향상이나 피트와 같은 영구적인 캐릭터 옵션의 전제 조건으로 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Diverse Weapon Expert

description.value: Your proficiency ranks for simple weapons and martial weapons increase to expert, and your proficiency rank for advanced weapons increases to trained.

value.value: expert in any kind of weapon or unarmed attacks

_desc_en: Your proficiency ranks for simple weapons and martial weapons increase to expert, and your proficiency rank for advanced weapons increases to trained.
_desc_ko: 단순 무기와 무술 무기에 대한 숙련도 등급이 전문가로 상승하며, 고급 무기에 대한 숙련도 등급이 훈련된 수준으로 상승합니다.

name: Duo's Aim

description.value: With assistance from your spotter, you aim for an especially accurate attack. Make a crossbow or firearm Strike against a foe either within your spotter's melee reach or the first range increment of a ranged weapon your spotter is wielding. On this Strike, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll and ignore the target's concealment. If you're using a firearm with the kickback trait, you don't take the normal circumstance penalty to this Strike for not having the required Strength modifier or firing without using a tripod.

_desc_en: With assistance from your spotter, you aim for an especially accurate attack. Make a crossbow or firearm Strike against a foe either within your spotter's melee reach or the first range increment of a ranged weapon your spotter is wielding. On this Strike, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll and ignore the target's concealment. If you're using a firearm with the kickback trait, you don't take the normal circumstance penalty to this Strike for not having the required Strength modifier or firing without using a tripod.
_desc_ko: 관측병의 도움을 받아 특히 정밀한 공격을 조준한다. 관측병의 근접 공격 범위 내 또는 관측병이 휘두르는 원거리 무기의 첫 사거리 구간 내에 있는 적을 대상으로 석궁 또는 화기 공격을 수행한다. 이 공격 시, 명중 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며 대상의 은폐를 무시합니다. 반동 특성이 있는 화기를 사용할 경우, 필요한 근력 수정자를 갖추지 않았거나 삼각대 없이 발사하는 것에 대한 일반적인 상황 페널티를 받지 않습니다.

name: Echo of the Fallen

description.value: With the utmost gratitude for your help in releasing them from their unearthly coil, a tiny sliver of a ghostly entity has remained attached to you. This manifests as an echo of their former self that follows you around and that you and anyone capable of casting divine or occult spells can see and speak with. When you take this feat, work with your GM to choose one martial weapon and one skill (or an advanced weapon if you're trained in all martial weapons) that are appropriate for the spirit; once you've chosen the weapon and skill, you can't change them. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VAcxOCFQLb3Bap7K]{Accept Echo} action.

value.value: You helped to lay a haunt, ghost, or spirit to rest

_desc_en: With the utmost gratitude for your help in releasing them from their unearthly coil, a tiny sliver of a ghostly entity has remained attached to you. This manifests as an echo of their former self that follows you around and that you and anyone capable of casting divine or occult spells can see and speak with. When you take this feat, work with your GM to choose one martial weapon and one skill (or an advanced weapon if you're trained in all martial weapons) that are appropriate for the spirit; once you've chosen the weapon and skill, you can't change them. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VAcxOCFQLb3Bap7K]{Accept Echo} action.
_desc_ko: 당신이 그들을 초자연적인 속박에서 해방시켜 준 것에 대한 깊은 감사의 표시로, 유령 같은 존재의 아주 작은 조각이 당신에게 붙어 있습니다. 이는 과거의 모습을 닮은 메아리로 나타나 당신을 따라다니며, 당신과 신성 마법이나 오컬트 마법을 시전할 수 있는 자라면 누구나 보고 대화할 수 있습니다. 이 피트를 선택할 때, GM과 협의하여 해당 영혼에 적합한 무기 한 종류와 기술 한 가지(모든 무기 사용에 숙련된 경우 고급 무기 한 종류)를 선택하십시오. 무기와 기술을 선택한 후에는 변경할 수 없습니다. @link[actions.accept-echo] 행동을 획득합니다.

name: Ghostly Resistance

description.value:
Your ghostly form becomes innately weaker but also gains resistance to many forms of damage. Your maximum HP is reduced by your level. You gain resistance 1 to all damage except for force, vitality, and any damage done by a weapon with the ghost touch rune (or any other source that acts like a ghost touch rune). This resistance increases to 2 if the source is non-magical.

At 10th level, the resistance increases to 2, or 4 if the source is non-magical. At 16th level, the resistance increases to 3, or 5 if the source is non-magical.

_desc_en:
Your ghostly form becomes innately weaker but also gains resistance to many forms of damage. Your maximum HP is reduced by your level. You gain resistance 1 to all damage except for force, vitality, and any damage done by a weapon with the ghost touch rune (or any other source that acts like a ghost touch rune). This resistance increases to 2 if the source is non-magical.

At 10th level, the resistance increases to 2, or 4 if the source is non-magical. At 16th level, the resistance increases to 3, or 5 if the source is non-magical.
_desc_ko:
유령 형태는 본질적으로 약해지지만 다양한 형태의 피해에 대한 저항력을 얻습니다. 최대 HP가 레벨만큼 감소합니다. 당신은 힘, 활력, 그리고 고스트 터치 룬이 새겨진 무기(또는 고스트 터치 룬과 유사한 효과를 내는 다른 출처)로 입는 피해를 제외한 모든 피해에 대해 저항력 1을 얻습니다. 이 저항력은 출처가 비마법일 경우 2로 증가합니다.

10레벨에 도달하면 저항력이 2로 증가하며, 비마법적 출처일 경우 4로 증가합니다. 16레벨에 도달하면 저항력이 3으로 증가하며, 비마법적 출처일 경우 5로 증가합니다.

name: Wylderheart Dedication

description.value:
Access You're from Kyonin.

You're primed to face off against threats from the Outer Rifts. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} skill feat for Demon Lore. If you were already trained in Demon Lore, you also become trained in a Lore skill of your choice. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls in encounters against fiends, and if you tie with a fiend's initiative roll, you go first.

Certain wylderheart feats give you focus spells. When you gain your first wylderheart focus spell, you become trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for the wylderheart archetype spells is Wisdom, and they're primal spells. You can Refocus by celebrating life or spending time in nature.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.7LY03W9SJHfIAhWr]{Wylderheart}

_desc_en:
Access You're from Kyonin.

You're primed to face off against threats from the Outer Rifts. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} skill feat for Demon Lore. If you were already trained in Demon Lore, you also become trained in a Lore skill of your choice. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls in encounters against fiends, and if you tie with a fiend's initiative roll, you go first.

Certain wylderheart feats give you focus spells. When you gain your first wylderheart focus spell, you become trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for the wylderheart archetype spells is Wisdom, and they're primal spells. You can Refocus by celebrating life or spending time in nature.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.7LY03W9SJHfIAhWr]{Wylderheart}
_desc_ko:
Access 당신은 쿄닌 출신입니다.

외계 균열의 위협에 맞설 준비가 되어 있습니다. @link[feats.additional-lore] 피트를 데몬 지식에 대해 획득합니다. 이미 데몬 지식를 숙련한 경우, 선택한 지식 재주 하나를 추가로 숙련하게 됩니다. 핀드와의 전투에서 인니셔티브 굴림 시 +1 상황 보너스를 받으며, 핀드와 인니셔티브 굴림 결과가 동률일 경우 먼저 행동합니다.

특정 와일더하트 재주는 포커스 주문을 부여합니다. 첫 와일더하트 포커스 주문을 획득할 때, 해당 주문 공격 수정자와 주문 DC 통계에 숙련됩니다. 와일더하트 아키타입 주문의 핵심 주문 시전 능력치는 지혜이며, 이들은 프라이멀 주문입니다. 생명을 축하하거나 자연 속에서 시간을 보내며 재집중할 수 있습니다.

name: Molten Wire

description.value:
Spinning molten iron through a vortex of fire, you trap your foe in searing wires. Make an @Check[impulse|defense:ac]{impulse attack} roll against a creature within 15 feet. On a success, the target takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -6)/4)+2)d6[slashing]] damage and is wrapped in molten wire for 1 minute. It is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} and takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -6)/4)+2)d4[fire]] damage at the start of each of its turns, with a basic Reflex save. The wire's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} DC is your class DC. The wire has AC 10 and 75 HP. The impulse ends if the creature Escapes or the wire is destroyed.

Level (+4) The slashing damage increases by 1d6, the fire damage increases by 1d4, and the wire's HP increases by 25.

_desc_en:
Spinning molten iron through a vortex of fire, you trap your foe in searing wires. Make an @Check[impulse|defense:ac]{impulse attack} roll against a creature within 15 feet. On a success, the target takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -6)/4)+2)d6[slashing]] damage and is wrapped in molten wire for 1 minute. It is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} and takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -6)/4)+2)d4[fire]] damage at the start of each of its turns, with a basic Reflex save. The wire's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} DC is your class DC. The wire has AC 10 and 75 HP. The impulse ends if the creature Escapes or the wire is destroyed.

Level (+4) The slashing damage increases by 1d6, the fire damage increases by 1d4, and the wire's HP increases by 25.
_desc_ko:
불의 소용돌이 속에서 녹아내린 철을 휘둘러, 적을 달아오른 철사로 옭아매십시오. 15피트 이내의 생물에게 임펄스 명중 굴림을 수행하십시오. 성공 시, 대상은 참격 피해를 입으며 1분 동안 용융 철사에 갇힌다. 대상은 @link[conditions.clumsy]{1} 상태가 되며, 매 턴 시작 시 기본 반사 내성 굴림을 통과하지 못하면 화염 피해를 추가로 입는다. 철사의 @link[actions.escape] DC는 당신의 직업 DC와 동일합니다. 철사의 AC는 10, HP는 75입니다. 생물이 탈출하거나 철사가 파괴되면 임펄스가 종료됩니다.

레벨 (+4) 베기 피해가 1d6 증가하고, 화염 피해가 1d4 증가하며, 와이어의 HP가 25 증가합니다.

name: Eternal Bane

description.value: Your life has made you a nexus for your deity's vile power. You're continuously surrounded by a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7ZinJNzxq0XF0oMx]{Bane} spell, with a spell rank equal to half your level (rounded up). The radius is 15 feet, and you can't increase it. You can Dismiss the spell; if you do, it returns automatically after 1 minute.

_desc_en: Your life has made you a nexus for your deity's vile power. You're continuously surrounded by a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7ZinJNzxq0XF0oMx]{Bane} spell, with a spell rank equal to half your level (rounded up). The radius is 15 feet, and you can't increase it. You can Dismiss the spell; if you do, it returns automatically after 1 minute.
_desc_ko: 당신의 삶은 당신을 신의 사악한 힘의 연결고리로 만들었습니다. 당신은 지속적으로 @link[spells.bane] 주문에 둘러싸여 있으며, 이 주문의 랭크은 당신의 레벨 절반(올림)과 같습니다. 반경은 15피트이며, 이를 늘릴 수 없습니다. 당신은 이 주문을 해제할 수 있습니다. 해제하면 1분 후 자동으로 복원됩니다.

name: Unending Emptiness

description.value: You pool the power of shadow within your eyes, gaining the ability to gather darkness into a turbulent orb of crushing emptiness within your line of sight. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sFwoKj0TsacsmoWj]{Darklight} domain spell. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.

_desc_en: You pool the power of shadow within your eyes, gaining the ability to gather darkness into a turbulent orb of crushing emptiness within your line of sight. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sFwoKj0TsacsmoWj]{Darklight} domain spell. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.
_desc_ko: 당신은 눈 속에 그림자의 힘을 모아 시야 내에 어둠을 소용돌이치는 공허의 구슬로 응집시키는 능력을 얻습니다. @link[spells.darklight] 도메인 주문을 획득합니다. 포커스 풀의 포커스 포인트 수를 1 증가시킵니다.

name: Shame the Sin

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You critically hit a demon with a Strike.

Your conviction against the sins that all demons grow from is so strong that you can force a demon to suffer from its sins when you strike a sound blow against them. In addition to doing the normal damage for your critical hit, the demon also suffers the effects of its special vulnerability. If the demon has no special vulnerability, it instead takes an additional @Damage[(ternary(gte(@actor.level,17),3,ternary(gte(@actor.level,13),2,1)))d6[mental]] damage. This increases to 2d6 mental damage at 13th level and to 3d6 mental damage at 17th level.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You critically hit a demon with a Strike.

Your conviction against the sins that all demons grow from is so strong that you can force a demon to suffer from its sins when you strike a sound blow against them. In addition to doing the normal damage for your critical hit, the demon also suffers the effects of its special vulnerability. If the demon has no special vulnerability, it instead takes an additional @Damage[(ternary(gte(@actor.level,17),3,ternary(gte(@actor.level,13),2,1)))d6[mental]] damage. This increases to 2d6 mental damage at 13th level and to 3d6 mental damage at 17th level.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

발동 조건 당신이 데몬에게 치명타를 입힌다.

당신은 모든 데몬이 자라나는 죄악에 대한 확고한 신념을 지니고 있어, 데몬에게 강력한 강타를 가할 때 그 데몬으로 하여금 자신의 죄악으로 고통받게 할 수 있습니다. 치명타로 인한 일반적인 피해 외에도, 데몬은 자신의 특수 약점 효과를 추가로 받습니다. 데몬에게 특수 약점이 없다면, 대신 정신의 추가 피해를 입습니다. 이 피해는 13레벨에 2d6 정신 피해로, 17레벨에 3d6 정신 피해로 증가합니다.

name: Martial Performance

description.value:
Your muse has taught you how to handle a wider variety of weapons than most bards, empowering you to effortlessly blend your performance into combat tools. When you have a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IAjvwqgiDr3qGYxY]{Courageous Anthem} composition cantrip active, and you damage an enemy with a Strike, the spell's duration is extended by 1 round. You can extend an individual casting only once in this way.

If you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.bH0kPuf7UKxRvi2P]{Rallying Anthem} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Xxdwkt0EEDgP1LGc]{Song of Strength} composition cantrips, you can apply this benefit to those cantrips as well.

_desc_en:
Your muse has taught you how to handle a wider variety of weapons than most bards, empowering you to effortlessly blend your performance into combat tools. When you have a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IAjvwqgiDr3qGYxY]{Courageous Anthem} composition cantrip active, and you damage an enemy with a Strike, the spell's duration is extended by 1 round. You can extend an individual casting only once in this way.

If you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.bH0kPuf7UKxRvi2P]{Rallying Anthem} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Xxdwkt0EEDgP1LGc]{Song of Strength} composition cantrips, you can apply this benefit to those cantrips as well.
_desc_ko:
당신의 뮤즈는 대부분의 바드보다 더 다양한 무기를 다루는 법을 가르쳐 주었으며, 이를 통해 공연을 전투 도구로 자연스럽게 융합할 수 있게 되었습니다. @link[spells.courageous-anthem] 작곡 캔트립이 활성화된 상태에서 적을 공격으로 피해를 입히면, 해당 주문 지속 시간이 1라운드 연장됩니다. 개별 시전만 한 번만 이렇게 연장할 수 있습니다.

@link[spells.rallying-anthem] 또는 @link[spells.song-of-strength] 작곡 캔트립을 획득하면, 이 혜택을 해당 캔트립에도 적용할 수 있습니다.

name: Clawdancer Dedication

description.value:
You've practiced the art of fighting with your natural claws, hooking them into prey and thrashing at targets surrounding you. You gain the following two actions, which let you assume specific stances to strike more effectively with your claws.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.zs4ZMcH9oFSCgkBx]{Claw Stance}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IR95FFdO7MtC8C0E]{Talon Stance}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.RkKrtZMb8Ifrrs2l]{Clawdancer}

value.value: permanent unarmed claw or talon attack (such as one granted by your ancestry or a graft)

_desc_en:
You've practiced the art of fighting with your natural claws, hooking them into prey and thrashing at targets surrounding you. You gain the following two actions, which let you assume specific stances to strike more effectively with your claws.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.zs4ZMcH9oFSCgkBx]{Claw Stance}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IR95FFdO7MtC8C0E]{Talon Stance}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.RkKrtZMb8Ifrrs2l]{Clawdancer}
_desc_ko:
당신은 본능적인 발톱으로 싸우는 기술을 연마해 왔습니다. 발톱을 먹잇감에 걸어 넣고 주변의 목표물을 마구 휘둘러 강타하는 것이죠. 다음 두 가지 행동을 획득하여 특정 자세를 취함으로써 발톱으로 더 효과적으로 강타할 수 있습니다.

@link[actions.claw-stance]

@link[actions.talon-stance]

name: Conductor's Redirection

description.value:
Trigger You are hit by an attack, spell, or other effect that deals electricity damage.

You conduct the damage through your body, taking damage as normal (if applicable) and redirecting it at one target within 10 feet that you can see. That target takes an equal amount of damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. The damage they take is based on the triggering damage, not modified by your degree of success, resistances, and so forth.

_desc_en:
Trigger You are hit by an attack, spell, or other effect that deals electricity damage.

You conduct the damage through your body, taking damage as normal (if applicable) and redirecting it at one target within 10 feet that you can see. That target takes an equal amount of damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. The damage they take is based on the triggering damage, not modified by your degree of success, resistances, and so forth.
_desc_ko:
발동조건 당신이 전기 피해를 주는 공격, 주문 또는 다른 효과에 맞았습니다.

당신은 피해를 몸으로 전도하여 정상적으로 피해를 입으며(해당되는 경우), 시야 내 10피트 이내의 한 목표를 향해 피해를 전환합니다. 해당 목표는 동등한 양의 피해를 입으며, 당신의 직업 난이도(DC) 또는 주문 난이도(DC) 중 높은 쪽에 대한 기본 인내 저항 검사를 수행합니다. 피격 대상이 받는 피해는 발동 시 입은 피해량을 기준으로 하며, 성공, 저항력 등으로 조정되지 않습니다.

name: Shift Spell

description.value:
Access member of the Magaambya

Requirements You have an active spell that affects an area and you are within the spell's range.

You move the spell's area to a new location within 120 feet. The spell's remaining duration is reduced by half. The spell no longer affects its previous area.

_desc_en:
Access member of the Magaambya

Requirements You have an active spell that affects an area and you are within the spell's range.

You move the spell's area to a new location within 120 feet. The spell's remaining duration is reduced by half. The spell no longer affects its previous area.
_desc_ko:
사용 가능 마감비아 종족 구성원

요구 사항 영역에 영향을 미치는 활성 주문이 발동 중이며, 해당 주문 범위 내에 위치해 있어야 합니다.

주문 영역을 120피트 이내의 새로운 위치로 이동시킵니다. 주문의 남은 지속 시간은 절반으로 감소합니다. 주문은 이전 영역에 더 이상 영향을 미치지 않습니다.

name: Moray Ambush

description.value:
Trigger You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} and a creature who hasn't detected you passes within 20 feet of you.

Like the moray eels athamaru communities raise and train, you know how to quickly strike from hiding. Stride or Swim directly toward the triggering creature and make a melee Strike against it. The target creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to this attack.

Special If you're mounted on an eel, you can have the eel move instead of yourself.

_desc_en:
Trigger You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} and a creature who hasn't detected you passes within 20 feet of you.

Like the moray eels athamaru communities raise and train, you know how to quickly strike from hiding. Stride or Swim directly toward the triggering creature and make a melee Strike against it. The target creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to this attack.

Special If you're mounted on an eel, you can have the eel move instead of yourself.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신은 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태이며, 당신을 감지하지 못한 생물이 20피트 이내를 지나갈 때.

아타마루 공동체가 기르고 훈련시키는 곰치처럼, 당신은 은신 상태에서 빠르게 공격하는 법을 알고 있습니다. 트리거링한 생물체 쪽으로 곧장 이동하거나 헤엄쳐 가서 근접 강타를 가하세요. 대상 생물체는 이 공격에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태입니다.

특수 곰치에 탑승 중일 경우, 자신 대신 곰치를 이동시킬 수 있다.

name: Transfusion

description.value:
Cost 5 or more sanguimancy Hit Points

You bring forth the regenerative properties of blood on behalf of an ally or yourself. You touch a willing creature and grant them fast healing 1 for 5 rounds. You can spend an additional 5 sanguimancy Hit Points to increase the fast healing by 1, to a maximum of 8.

_desc_en:
Cost 5 or more sanguimancy Hit Points

You bring forth the regenerative properties of blood on behalf of an ally or yourself. You touch a willing creature and grant them fast healing 1 for 5 rounds. You can spend an additional 5 sanguimancy Hit Points to increase the fast healing by 1, to a maximum of 8.
_desc_ko:
비용 5 이상의 생혈술 HP

동료나 자신을 대신해 피의 재생 능력을 발휘합니다. 동의한 대상에게 접촉하여 5라운드 동안 빠른 치유 1을 부여합니다. 추가로 혈술력 5 HP를 소모하면 빠른 치유를 1씩 증가시킬 수 있으며, 최대 8까지 가능합니다.

name: Barricade Snare

description.value:
Using clever gnomish engineering, you can quickly erect small barriers in which your snares are hidden. When you prepare snares for quick deployment, you can prepare some of them as barricade snares. A barricade snare consists of a small barricade in which the snare is hidden, but it costs two of your quick deployment snares. Though creatures can automatically see the barricade, the snare hidden inside the barricade must be detected like a standard snare, but with a +2 circumstance bonus to the DC. The barricade occupies the same space as the snare and is 5 feet high; it provides standard cover, can be Climbed with a successful @Check[athletics|dc:12] check, has an AC of 10, Hardness 5, and 20 healing Hit Points, and is immune to critical hits and precision damage. The barricade lasts as long as the snare does. A creature triggers and is affected by the hidden snare when it attempts to Climb the barricade or successfully attacks the barricade while adjacent to it. The snare and barricade are destroyed when the snare is triggered or if the barricade is destroyed, whichever comes first.

Special Even if you have the Surprise Snare feat, you must craft a barricade snare in an empty square.

_desc_en:
Using clever gnomish engineering, you can quickly erect small barriers in which your snares are hidden. When you prepare snares for quick deployment, you can prepare some of them as barricade snares.
