@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.yWtwNUkGyj79Q04W]{Hellknight}
_desc_ko:
당신은 '측정'과 '사슬'에 젖어든 정신 명령에 순응하도록 몸을 단련했습니다. 위협 기술에 숙련도를 얻습니다(이미 협박에 숙련된 경우, 선택한 다른 훈련 기술에 숙련도를 얻습니다). 지옥기사 갑옷의 방어구 특화 효과를 얻으며, 해당 특화 방어구로부터 얻는 저항력은 일반보다 1 높습니다. 또한 지옥기사 갑옷을 착용 중일 때 협박 판정에서 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

특수 다른 헌신 피트를 선택하려면 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.yWtwNUkGyj79Q04W]{헬나이트} 또는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.ARYrFIOsT3JxpjDY]{헬나이트 아미거} 아키타입에서 다른 피트 두 가지를 획득해야 합니다.

name: Doublespeak

description.value:
You are skilled at saying one thing while meaning something different. You disguise your true meaning behind other words and phrases, relying on subtle emphasis and shared experience to convey meaning that only your allies understand.

Any allies who have traveled alongside you for at least 1 full week automatically discern your meaning. Other observers must succeed at a Perception check against your Deception DC to realize you are passing a secret message, and they must critically succeed to understand the message itself.

_desc_en:
You are skilled at saying one thing while meaning something different. You disguise your true meaning behind other words and phrases, relying on subtle emphasis and shared experience to convey meaning that only your allies understand.

Any allies who have traveled alongside you for at least 1 full week automatically discern your meaning. Other observers must succeed at a Perception check against your Deception DC to realize you are passing a secret message, and they must critically succeed to understand the message itself.
_desc_ko:
당신은 다른 의미를 내포한 말을 능숙하게 구사합니다. 미묘한 어조와 공유된 경험을 바탕으로 진정한 뜻을 다른 단어와 문장 뒤에 숨겨, 오직 동맹만이 이해할 수 있는 의미를 전달합니다.

최소 1주일 이상 함께 여행한 동맹은 자동으로 당신의 의도를 파악합니다. 다른 관찰자는 당신의 기만 DC에 맞선 지각 판정에서 성공해야 비밀 메시지를 전달 중임을 깨닫고, 메시지 자체를 이해하려면 대성공이 필요합니다.

name: Ricochet Master

description.value: You have an eye for angles and can find shots that others believe are impossible. When using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.c7mCj6wUdb47rrnw]{Ricochet Shot}, you can bounce your bullet off up to two solid surfaces within your weapon's first range increment instead of just one. In addition, a creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} the first time you attack it with a Ricochet Shot during an encounter.

_desc_en: You have an eye for angles and can find shots that others believe are impossible. When using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.c7mCj6wUdb47rrnw]{Ricochet Shot}, you can bounce your bullet off up to two solid surfaces within your weapon's first range increment instead of just one. In addition, a creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} the first time you attack it with a Ricochet Shot during an encounter.
_desc_ko: 당신은 각도를 보는 눈이 뛰어나 다른 이들이 불가능하다고 여기는 사격 경로를 찾아낼 수 있습니다. @link[feats.ricochet-shot]을 사용할 때, 총기 사거리 첫 구간 내 최대 두 개의 단단한 표면에 탄환을 반사시킬 수 있습니다(기존 한 개에서 증가). 또한, 한 전투 중 리코첼 샷으로 처음 공격하는 대상은 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Friendform

description.value:
The shared bond between you and your allies allows you to act on their behalf.

During your daily preparations, you can perform a simple ritual with up to five willing Small or Medium humanoids, where participants exchange minor tokens of personal significance.

As long as you hold onto a participant's token, you can assume their form with your Change Shape ability, gaining a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to pass as that person and adding your level to the check even if you're untrained. You lose access to a participant's form if they're not carrying your token or if you use the ritual again.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en:
The shared bond between you and your allies allows you to act on their behalf.

During your daily preparations, you can perform a simple ritual with up to five willing Small or Medium humanoids, where participants exchange minor tokens of personal significance.

As long as you hold onto a participant's token, you can assume their form with your Change Shape ability, gaining a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to pass as that person and adding your level to the check even if you're untrained. You lose access to a participant's form if they're not carrying your token or if you use the ritual again.
_desc_ko:
동료들과의 공유된 유대감으로 인해 당신은 그들을 대신해 행동할 수 있습니다.

일일 준비 시간 동안, 최대 다섯 명의 소형 또는 중형 인간형 생물과 간단한 의식을 행할 수 있습니다. 참가자들은 개인적으로 의미 있는 작은 증표를 교환합니다.

참가자의 토큰을 소지하고 있는 동안에는 형태 변신 능력으로 그 참가자의 모습을 취할 수 있으며, 해당 인물로 위장하기 위한 기만 판정에서 +4 상태 보너스를 얻고, 훈련받지 않은 경우에도 판정 결과에 자신의 레벨을 추가할 수 있다. 참가자가 당신의 토큰을 소지하지 않거나 의식을 다시 사용할 경우 그 참가자의 모습을 사용할 수 없게 된다.

name: Stormsoul

description.value: Your elemental ancestor's influence manifests in you as tumultuous, thundering storms, with dark clouds and bolts of lightning. You gain resistance to electricity equal to half your level (minimum 1).

_desc_en: Your elemental ancestor's influence manifests in you as tumultuous, thundering storms, with dark clouds and bolts of lightning. You gain resistance to electricity equal to half your level (minimum 1).
_desc_ko: 원소 조상의 영향이 당신 안에서 격렬한 천둥번개와 먹구름, 번개로 창조됩니다. 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 전기 저항력을 얻습니다(최소 1).

name: Domain Acumen

description.value:
Every oracle's mystery touches on a divine domain of the deities that fuel it; you can access that power. Choose one of the domains associated with your mystery for which you don't already have an initial domain spell. You gain an initial domain spell from that domain, which you cast as a revelation spell.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, selecting a different domain each time and gaining its domain spell as a revelation spell.

_desc_en:
Every oracle's mystery touches on a divine domain of the deities that fuel it; you can access that power. Choose one of the domains associated with your mystery for which you don't already have an initial domain spell. You gain an initial domain spell from that domain, which you cast as a revelation spell.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, selecting a different domain each time and gaining its domain spell as a revelation spell.
_desc_ko:
모든 오라클의 신비는 그 힘을 공급하는 신들의 신성한 도메인과 연결되어 있으며, 당신은 그 힘에 접근할 수 있습니다. 당신의 신비와 연관된 도메인 중 아직 초기 도메인 주문을 가지고 있지 않은 도메인 하나를 선택하십시오. 해당 도메인의 초급 도메인 주문을 획득하며, 이를 계시 주문으로 시전한다.

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있으며, 매번 다른 도메인을 선택해 해당 도메인 주문을 계시 주문으로 획득한다.

name: Reclaimant Plea

description.value:
You call on the power of the Crimson Oath to gain magical aid. Choose one of the following spells: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.b5sGjGlBf58f8jn0]{Air Walk}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ksLCg62cLOojw3gN]{Planar Tether}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aqRYNoSvxsVfqglH]{Unfettered Movement}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.DyiD239dNS7RIxZE]{Holy Light}. You can Cast that Spell once per day as a 4th-rank divine innate spell. At 14th level, the spell heightens to 5th level, and at 16th level, the spell heightens to 6th level. If you anger the mysterious source of the Crimson Oath's power, you lose the ability to cast the spell until you atone.

Special You can select this feat a second time at 14th level, gaining a second spell from the list above, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YvXKGlHOt7mdW2jZ]{Death Ward}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.E3X2RbzWHCdz7gsk]{Flame Strike}, which you can cast once per day; you also become an expert in spell attack modifiers and DCs. You can select this feat a third time at 18th level, gaining either a third spell from the list above, death ward, flame strike, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.a3aQxCpoj1q1NQxC]{Sunburst}, which you can cast once per day; additionally, all three spells from this feat heighten to 7th level, and you become a master of spell attack modifiers and DCs.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en:
You call on the power of the Crimson Oath to gain magical aid. Choose one of the following spells: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.b5sGjGlBf58f8jn0]{Air Walk}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ksLCg62cLOojw3gN]{Planar Tether}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aqRYNoSvxsVfqglH]{Unfettered Movement}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.DyiD239dNS7RIxZE]{Holy Light}. You can Cast that Spell once per day as a 4th-rank divine innate spell. At 14th level, the spell heightens to 5th level, and at 16th level, the spell heightens to 6th level. If you anger the mysterious source of the Crimson Oath's power, you lose the ability to cast the spell until you atone.

Special You can select this feat a second time at 14th level, gaining a second spell from the list above, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YvXKGlHOt7mdW2jZ]{Death Ward}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.E3X2RbzWHCdz7gsk]{Flame Strike}, which you can cast once per day; you also become an expert in spell attack modifiers and DCs. You can select this feat a third time at 18th level, gaining either a third spell from the list above, death ward, flame strike, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.a3aQxCpoj1q1NQxC]{Sunburst}, which you can cast once per day; additionally, all three spells from this feat heighten to 7th level, and you become a master of spell attack modifiers and DCs.
_desc_ko:
당신은 진홍의 맹세의 힘을 불러 마법적 지원을 얻습니다. 다음 주문 중 하나를 선택하십시오: @link[spells.air-walk], @link[spells.planar-tether], @link[spells.unfettered-movement], @link[spells.invisibility], @link[spells.cleanse-affliction], @link[spells.holy-light] 이 주문을 하루에 한 번 (4th)랭크 신성 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있다. 14레벨에 도달하면 주문이 (5th)랭크으로 강화되고, 16레벨에 도달하면 (6th)랭크으로 강화된다. 진홍의 맹세의 힘의 신비로운 근원을 분노하게 하면 속죄할 때까지 이 주문을 시전할 수 있는 능력을 상실한다.

Special 14레벨에 이 재주를 두 번째로 선택할 수 있으며, 위 목록에서 두 번째 주문, @link[spells.death-ward] 또는 @link[spells.flame-strike]을 획득하여 하루에 한 번 시전할 수 있습니다. 또한 주문 공격 수정자와 난이도(DC)에 대한 전문가가 됩니다. 18레벨에 이 피트를 세 번째로 선택할 수 있으며, 위 목록에서 세 번째 주문을 획득합니다. 죽음의 수호부, 화염 타격, 또는 @link[spells.sunburst] 중 하나를 선택할 수 있으며, 이 주문은 하루에 한 번 시전할 수 있습니다. 또한 이 특성의 세 주문 모두 7레벨로 강화되며, 당신은 주문 공격 수정자와 난이도(DC)의 달인이 됩니다.

name: Tandem Movement

description.value: You and your eidolon move together. You each use a single action to Stride. Either of you that has the corresponding movement type can Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead.

_desc_en: You and your eidolon move together. You each use a single action to Stride. Either of you that has the corresponding movement type can Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead.
_desc_ko: 당신과 당신의 에이돌론은 함께 이동합니다. 각자 액션 하나를 사용하여 스트라이드합니다. 이동 유형이 일치하는 쪽은 대신 땅굴 파기, 등반, 비행 또는 수영을 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: The Harder They Fall (Kingmaker)

description.value: You know how to make a larger creature hurt when it falls to the ground. If you successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} a foe that's larger than you, it takes @Damage[1d8[bludgeoning]] damage (or @Damage[2d8[bludgeoning]] damage on a critical success). If you are master in Athletics, the damage increases to @Damage[2d8[bludgeoning]] damage (or @Damage[4d8[bludgeoning]] damage on a critical success).

_desc_en: You know how to make a larger creature hurt when it falls to the ground. If you successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} a foe that's larger than you, it takes @Damage[1d8[bludgeoning]] damage (or @Damage[2d8[bludgeoning]] damage on a critical success). If you are master in Athletics, the damage increases to @Damage[2d8[bludgeoning]] damage (or @Damage[4d8[bludgeoning]] damage on a critical success).
_desc_ko: 당신은 더 큰 생물이 땅에 넘어질 때 고통을 주는 방법을 알고 있습니다. 자신보다 큰 적을 @link[actions.trip]에 성공하면, 1d8 타격의 피해를 입습니다 (대성공 시 2d8 타격의 피해). 당신이 운동의 마스터라면, 피해는 2d8 타격 피해(대성공 시 4d8 타격 피해)로 증가합니다.

name: Slayer's Presence

description.value: Your very presence strikes fear into the undead. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JpcegMRqdizrkG0m]{Slayer's Identification} and succeed at your check, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.RCjMbLyRnG70R7cO]{Frighten Undead} as a free action, targeting the creature you identified. Any time you get a critical success to Frighten Undead, if the target's level is lower than yours, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

_desc_en: Your very presence strikes fear into the undead. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JpcegMRqdizrkG0m]{Slayer's Identification} and succeed at your check, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.RCjMbLyRnG70R7cO]{Frighten Undead} as a free action, targeting the creature you identified. Any time you get a critical success to Frighten Undead, if the target's level is lower than yours, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.
_desc_ko: 당신의 존재 자체가 언데드에게 공포를 강타합니다. @link[actions.slayers-identification]을 사용해 판정에서 성공하면, 식별한 생물을 대상으로 @link[feats.frighten-undead]를 자유 행동으로 사용할 수 있습니다. 언데드 공포에 대성공을 거둘 때마다, 대상의 레벨이 당신보다 낮다면 대상은 @link[conditions.fleeing] 상태로 1라운드 동안 이동합니다.

name: Kodama Call

description.value:
Access Tian Xia origin

The small spirits known as kodama pride themselves in taking care of trees and other vegetation, and they'll happily come to your aid as well. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kcYCWMd1NVCJ5Zbu]{Helpful Wood Spirits} as a 2nd-rank innate primal spell twice per day

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Access Tian Xia origin

The small spirits known as kodama pride themselves in taking care of trees and other vegetation, and they'll happily come to your aid as well. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kcYCWMd1NVCJ5Zbu]{Helpful Wood Spirits} as a 2nd-rank innate primal spell twice per day
_desc_ko:
사용 가능 지역 티엔 샤 출신

코다마라 불리는 작은 영혼들은 나무와 다른 식물을 돌보는 것을 자랑스러워하며, 기꺼이 당신을 도울 것입니다. 하루에 두 번, (2nd) 선천적 프라이멀 마법인 @link[spells.helpful-wood-spirits]을 시전할 수 있습니다

name: Uncanny Agility

description.value: You have near-supernatural poise that lets you move swiftly across the most unsteady surfaces. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.CnqMJR8e9jqJR7MM]{Steady Balance} skill feat. You can Step into difficult terrain caused by uneven ground, such as a rocky field, hilly incline, or rocking ship.

_desc_en: You have near-supernatural poise that lets you move swiftly across the most unsteady surfaces. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.CnqMJR8e9jqJR7MM]{Steady Balance} skill feat. You can Step into difficult terrain caused by uneven ground, such as a rocky field, hilly incline, or rocking ship.
_desc_ko: 당신은 초자연적이라 할 만한 평정심으로 가장 불안정한 지형 위에서도 재빠르게 움직일 수 있습니다. @link[feats.steady-balance] 기술 피트를 획득합니다. 바위투성이 들판, 구릉지, 흔들리는 배 등 고르지 않은 지형으로 인한 어려운 지형 속으로 발을 내딛을 수 있습니다.

name: Ravenous Charge

description.value: Hungry for the flesh of the living, you hurl yourself into the fray, teeth gnashing. You Stride. If you end your movement within melee reach of a living creature, you can make an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} that creature. If you succeed, you then make a jaws Strike against that creature.

name: Tragic Lament

description.value:
Trigger A creature you're aware of critically succeeds on a Strike against you and would deal damage to you.

Frequency once per 10 minutes

You dramatically cry out in poetic verse about the tragedies that led to your doom at this very moment, instilling guilt in your attacker. The Strike deals normal damage rather than critical damage as your foe relents on their attack at the last moment as they're moved by your words, though other effects that happen on a critical hit still occur. The creature that made the triggering Strike must then succeed on a @Check[will|against:class] save against your Class DC or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round by guilt at its actions against you.

발동 조건 당신이 인지하는 생물이 당신을 상대로 대성공을 이루며 피해를 입히려 할 때.

발동 주기 10분에 한 번

당신은 이 순간 자신의 파멸로 이어진 비극을 시적인 운율로 극적으로 외치며 공격자에게 죄책감을 심어줍니다. 적의 말이 감동받아 마지막 순간 공격을 멈추게 되므로 치명타 대신 일반 피해를 입히지만, 치명타 시 발생하는 다른 효과는 여전히 적용됩니다. 발동 공격을 가한 생물은 이후 당신의 직업 난이도(DC)에 대한 의지 내성에 성공하지 못하면, 당신에게 가한 행동에 대한 죄책감으로 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.slowed]{1} 상태가 된다.

name: Camouflage

description.value: You alter your appearance to blend in to the wilderness. In natural terrain, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} even without cover or being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

name: Fade Away

description.value: Your ability to blend into the background allows you to fade away entirely or appear innocuous even to magical effects. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PRrZ7anETWPm90YY]{Disguise Magic} as 2nd-rank innate occult spells. You can target only yourself with invisibility, and you must be the primary target of disguise magic. You can cast each spell once per day.

_desc_ko: 배경에 녹아드는 능력으로 완전히 사라지거나 마법 효과에도 무해해 보일 수 있습니다. @link[spells.invisibility]와 @link[spells.disguise-magic]을 (2nd)랭크 선천적 오컬트 주문으로 획득합니다. 투명화는 오직 자신만을 대상으로 할 수 있으며, 변장 마법의 주 대상은 반드시 자신이어야 합니다. 각 주문은 하루에 한 번씩 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: No!!!

description.value:
Trigger A non-minion ally within 60 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

The shock of seeing your ally near death breaks whatever limits exist in your mind, sending your power spilling forth. If your psyche is currently unleashed, you can immediately use a psyche action that takes 1 action or less to use. If your psyche is not currently unleashed, you Unleash your Psyche, which remains unleashed until the end of your next turn. You can ignore Unleash Psyche's requirement of needing to have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast a Spell} on your previous turn, but you still can't Unleash your Psyche if you're stupefied or for 2 rounds after your psyche subsides.

_desc_ko:
발동 60피트 내의 비(非) 하수인 아군이 HP가 0으로 감소한다.

동료가 죽음 직전에 있는 모습을 목격한 충격이 마음속의 모든 제약을 깨뜨리며, 당신의 힘이 쏟아져 나온다. 현재 정신이 해방된 상태라면, 1 행동 이하로 사용 가능한 정신 행동을 즉시 사용할 수 있다. 현재 정신이 해방되지 않은 상태라면, 정신을 해방시키며 이는 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 해방된 상태로 유지된다. 정신 해방의 전제 조건인 @link[actions.cast-a-spell] 요건은 무시할 수 있으나, 멍함 상태이거나 정신이 가라앉은 후 2라운드 동안은 정신을 해방할 수 없다.

name: Eternity-Incinerating Blaze

description.value:
Usage imbued into a weapon ikon

The blaze of your divine spark is hot enough that it burns in not just the present, but the past and future as well. Whenever you score a critical hit with the imbued ikon, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} or increases its doomed condition by 1. If the target's maximum dying value is reduced to 0 by this ability, it immediately dies in a flash of spiritual fire that reduces its body to ash. This effect applies even when the ikon is not empowered. The ikon also gains the following transcendence ability.

신성한 불꽃의 열기는 현재뿐만 아니라 과거와 미래까지 태울 만큼 뜨겁다. 이 주입된 이콘으로 치명타를 성공시킬 때마다 대상은 @link[conditions.doomed]{1} 상태가 되거나 파멸 상태가 1 증가한다. 이 능력으로 대상의 최대 죽음 값이 0이 되면, 영혼의 불꽃이 번쩍이며 즉시 죽어 육체가 재로 변한다. 이 효과는 이콘이 강화되지 않은 상태에서도 적용됩니다. 이콘은 또한 다음 초월 능력을 얻습니다.

name: Battle Planner

description.value:
You are constantly drawing up plans and battle scenarios, assembling strategies and gathered intelligence for later use. When you scout an enemy's position or receive a detailed report from an ally who scouted the enemy's position, if you have a clear indication of the number, position, and identities of your potential foes, you can spend 1 minute to come up with a battle plan that takes such potential factors into account and reduces the role luck plays in the equation.

Roll a Warfare Lore check. As long as the information was accurate and remains accurate when you roll initiative against those enemies, you can use the Warfare Lore result you previously rolled for your initiative roll; if you do, this is a fortune effect.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ZkYDgSSlKML9BUjg]{Effect: Battle Planner}

_desc_ko:
당신은 끊임없이 계획과 전투 시나리오를 구상하며, 전략을 수립하고 수집한 정보를 나중에 활용하기 위해 정리합니다. 적의 위치를 정찰하거나 적의 위치를 정찰한 아군의 상세한 보고를 받을 때, 잠재적 적의 수, 위치, 신원을 명확히 파악했다면, 1분을 소모하여 이러한 잠재적 요소를 고려하고 전투에서 운의 역할을 줄이는 전투 계획을 수립할 수 있습니다.

전쟁 지식 판정을 굴림하십시오. 해당 정보가 정확하고, 해당 적군과의 인니셔티브 검사 시에도 여전히 정확하다면, 이전에 굴린 전쟁 지식 판정 결과를 인니셔티브 검사 시 사용할 수 있습니다. 이 경우 이는 행운 효과로 간주됩니다.

name: Exemplar Dedication

description.value:
A spark of inherent divine power has lit itself within you. You become trained in martial weapons. You gain one ikon, the ability to use the ikon's immanence and transcendence actions and effects, and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.9cGJBXSJW6EpgibP]{Shift Immanence} action. Because you have only a single ikon, when you Spark Transcendence, your divine spark recedes back to the depths of your soul and must be recalled with Shift Immanence to re-empower your ikon. You become trained in exemplar class DC.

description.value:
Access You are from Dongun Hold or Alkenstar.

You're knowledgeable in trades that are important to your people's survival and commercial interests. Pick two of the following Lore skills: Engineering Lore, Explosive Lore, or Firearm Lore. At 2nd level, you gain expert proficiency in these Lore skills; at 7th level, you gain master proficiency in these Lore skills; and at 15th level, you gain legendary proficiency in them.

당신은 민족의 생존과 상업적 이익에 중요한 기술에 정통합니다. 다음 지식 기술 중 두 가지를 선택하십시오: 기계학 지식 , 폭발물 지식, 또는 화기 지식. (2nd)레벨에 도달하면 이 지식 기술들에 대한 달인 숙련도를 얻습니다; (7th)레벨에 도달하면 이 지식 기술들에 대한 전문가 숙련도를 얻습니다; 15레벨에 도달하면 이 지식 기술들에 대한 전설적 숙련도를 얻습니다.

name: Fatal Bullet

description.value: You're especially talented at striking your enemies in their most vulnerable areas. When you critically hit with a fatal firearm, you deal an additional die of the appropriate size and damage type for the fatal trait after doubling the weapon's damage. For example, after getting a critical hit with a fatal d12 weapon, you add a total of 2d12 additional damage to the attack after doubling its damage.

_desc_en: You're especially talented at striking your enemies in their most vulnerable areas. When you critically hit with a fatal firearm, you deal an additional die of the appropriate size and damage type for the fatal trait after doubling the weapon's damage. For example, after getting a critical hit with a fatal d12 weapon, you add a total of 2d12 additional damage to the attack after doubling its damage.
_desc_ko: 당신은 적의 가장 약점을 강타하는 데 특히 재능이 있습니다. 치명적인 화기로 치명타를 성공시킬 경우, 무기의 피해량을 두 배로 계산한 후 치명적 특성에 해당하는 크기와 피해 유형의 주사위 하나를 추가로 굴려 피해를 입힙니다. 예를 들어 치명적인 d12 무기로 치명타를 성공시킨 후, 해당 무기의 피해를 두 배로 계산한 뒤 추가로 총 2d12의 피해를 더합니다.

name: Unrivaled Analysis

description.value: Your experience allows you to derive even more information about your opponents from a mere glance. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.4BbywSvO2ByHxdbZ]{Rapid Assessment}, you can attempt up to four checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about creatures you are observing.

_desc_en: Your experience allows you to derive even more information about your opponents from a mere glance. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.4BbywSvO2ByHxdbZ]{Rapid Assessment}, you can attempt up to four checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about creatures you are observing.
_desc_ko: 당신의 경험은 단 한 번의 시선만으로 상대방에 대한 더 많은 정보를 추론할 수 있게 합니다. 신속 평가를 사용할 때, 관찰 중인 생물에 대해 최대 네 번의 @link[actions.recall-knowledge] 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다.

name: Shrouded Mien

description.value: You're used to dealing with dangerous situations and sinister creatures. You become trained in Deception (or another skill of your choice, if you're already trained in Deception), and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.HEBXaS656MZTiWFu]{Lengthy Diversion} skill feat as a bonus feat.

_desc_en: You're used to dealing with dangerous situations and sinister creatures. You become trained in Deception (or another skill of your choice, if you're already trained in Deception), and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.HEBXaS656MZTiWFu]{Lengthy Diversion} skill feat as a bonus feat.
_desc_ko: 위험한 상황과 사악한 생물들을 다루는 데 익숙하다. 기만(이미 기만에 숙련된 경우 선택한 다른 기술)에 숙련되고, 보너스 피트로 @link[feats.lengthy-diversion] 기술 재주를 얻는다.

name: Arcane Evolution

description.value:
Your arcane legacy allows you to perceive how magic affects everything. You become trained in one skill of your choice.

Additionally, you can use arcane arts to tinker with your selection of spells. During your daily preparations, you can choose one spell in your spell repertoire to be a signature spell that day.

You can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Q5iIYCFdqJFM31GW]{Learn a Spell} activity to add more arcane spells to the list you choose from, but if you prepare a spell that isn't in your repertoire, you temporarily add it to your repertoire at the spell rank of your choice instead of making it a signature spell.

_desc_en:
Your arcane legacy allows you to perceive how magic affects everything. You become trained in one skill of your choice.

Additionally, you can use arcane arts to tinker with your selection of spells. During your daily preparations, you can choose one spell in your spell repertoire to be a signature spell that day.

You can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Q5iIYCFdqJFM31GW]{Learn a Spell} activity to add more arcane spells to the list you choose from, but if you prepare a spell that isn't in your repertoire, you temporarily add it to your repertoire at the spell rank of your choice instead of making it a signature spell.
_desc_ko:
당신의 아케인 유산은 마법이 모든 것에 미치는 영향을 감지하게 합니다. 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다.

또한, 당신은 아케인 기술을 사용하여 선택한 주문들을 조정할 수 있습니다. 매일 준비 시간 동안, 당신은 자신의 주문 목록에서 하나의 주문을 그날의 시그니처 주문으로 선택할 수 있습니다.

@link[actions.learn-a-spell] 활동을 사용하면 선택할 수 있는 주문 목록에 더 많은 아케인 주문을 추가할 수 있습니다. 다만, 레퍼토리에 없는 주문을 준비할 경우, 시그니처 주문으로 만드는 대신 선택한 주문 랭크으로 일시적으로 레퍼토리에 추가됩니다.

name: Swamp Stealth

description.value:
Requirements You are in a swamp environment near an environmental feature that would allow you to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover}.

In swamplands, you are particularly skilled at quickly hiding behind bits of underbrush or foliage, or moving quietly through murky water. You Take Cover and then use that cover to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are in a swamp environment near an environmental feature that would allow you to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover}.

In swamplands, you are particularly skilled at quickly hiding behind bits of underbrush or foliage, or moving quietly through murky water. You Take Cover and then use that cover to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}.
_desc_ko:
Requirements 당신은 @link[actions.take-cover]를 할 수 있는 지형적 특징 근처의 습지 환경에 있습니다.

습지에서는 특히 덤불이나 잎사귀 뒤에 재빨리 숨기거나 탁한 물을 조용히 헤엄쳐 이동하는 데 능숙합니다. 당신은 엄폐를 취한 후 그 엄폐물을 이용해 @link[actions.hide]합니다.

name: Sure-Footed

description.value: Even if you're knocked off balance, your armor continues to protect you. You don't take a penalty to AC from the clumsy condition if you're wearing medium or heavy armor. Your clumsy condition still applies to other Dexterity-based checks and DCs, and this benefit is negated if the armor is broken.

_desc_en: Even if you're knocked off balance, your armor continues to protect you. You don't take a penalty to AC from the clumsy condition if you're wearing medium or heavy armor. Your clumsy condition still applies to other Dexterity-based checks and DCs, and this benefit is negated if the armor is broken.
_desc_ko: 균형을 잃더라도 갑옷은 계속해서 당신을 보호합니다. 평갑이나 중갑을 착용 중이라면 둔함 상태로 인한 AC 페널티를 받지 않습니다. 둔함 상태는 여전히 다른 민첩 기반 판정나 난이도(DC)에는 적용되며, 갑옷이 파손되면 이 혜택은 무효화됩니다.

name: Lightning Tongue

description.value: Your tongue darts out faster than the eye can see to retrieve loose objects. You Interact to pick up a single unattended object of light Bulk or less within 10 feet of you. If you don't have enough hands free to hold the object, it falls to the ground in your space.

_desc_en: Your tongue darts out faster than the eye can see to retrieve loose objects. You Interact to pick up a single unattended object of light Bulk or less within 10 feet of you. If you don't have enough hands free to hold the object, it falls to the ground in your space.
_desc_ko: 눈으로 따라잡을 수 없을 만큼 빠르게 혀를 내밀어 흩어진 물건을 집어 올립니다. 상호작용을 통해 10피트 이내에 있는 가벼운 벌크 이하의 방치된 물건 하나를 집어 올릴 수 있습니다. 물건을 잡을 만큼 손이 자유롭지 않으면, 그 물건은 당신의 공간에 떨어집니다.

name: Cut the Bonds

description.value: Select a magical effect that has made an adjacent member of your crop clumsy, grabbed, paralyzed, restrained, or slowed. Attempt a counteract check using your attack modifier (including your multiple attack penalty) with a melee weapon with which you have expert proficiency. Your counteract rank is half your level rounded up. On a success, you free that member from the effect; on a failure, you can't attempt to use Cut the Bonds on that effect on that crop member until 24 hours have passed.

_desc_en: Select a magical effect that has made an adjacent member of your crop clumsy, grabbed, paralyzed, restrained, or slowed. Attempt a counteract check using your attack modifier (including your multiple attack penalty) with a melee weapon with which you have expert proficiency. Your counteract rank is half your level rounded up. On a success, you free that member from the effect; on a failure, you can't attempt to use Cut the Bonds on that effect on that crop member until 24 hours have passed.
_desc_ko: 당신의 작물 구성원 중 인접한 한 명을 서투르게 만들거나, 붙잡기거나, 마비시키거나, 구속하거나, 속도를 늦춘 마법 효과를 선택하십시오. 당신이 숙련된 근접 무기를 사용하여 공격 수정자(다중 공격 페널티 포함)로 반격 판정을 시도하십시오. 당신의 반격 등급은 레벨의 절반을 올림한 수치입니다. 성공 시 해당 구성원을 효과에서 해방시킵니다. 실패 시 24시간이 지나기 전까지 해당 작물 구성원에게 '결속 끊기'를 시도할 수 없습니다.

name: Ghost Eater Dedication

description.value:
You have trained as a ghost eater, a hunter specialized in the destruction of spirits. You know how to channel your own spiritual energy to harm spirits. Your weapon and unarmed attack Strikes become magical. Against incorporeal creatures, they also gain the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{Ghost Touch} property rune.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.xMdIENo4w9bEzZuK]{Ghost Eater}

_desc_en:
You have trained as a ghost eater, a hunter specialized in the destruction of spirits. You know how to channel your own spiritual energy to harm spirits. Your weapon and unarmed attack Strikes become magical. Against incorporeal creatures, they also gain the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{Ghost Touch} property rune.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.xMdIENo4w9bEzZuK]{Ghost Eater}
_desc_ko: 당신은 영혼을 파괴하는 데 특화된 사냥꾼인 영혼 사냥꾼으로 훈련받았습니다. 자신의 영적 에너지를 활용해 영혼에게 피해를 주는 방법을 알고 있습니다. 무기와 비무장 공격인 공격은 마법적 속성을 띱니다. 비물질적 생물에게는 @link[equipment.ghost-touch] 속성 룬의 효과도 추가로 적용됩니다.

name: Blast Tackle

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a two-handed crossbow or a firearm that has the kickback or scatter trait.

You throw yourself at an enemy, bracing your weapon against it and pulling it close before releasing a destructive shot. Attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple}; if you're wielding your weapon in both hands, you Release one hand to do so. If your Grapple succeeds, you can immediately Strike the target of the Grapple with the required weapon, even if it's a two-handed weapon you're holding in one hand. This Strike deals an additional 3d6 precision damage.

As long the creature remains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, you can use just one hand to reload the weapon and Strike that creature with it.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a two-handed crossbow or a firearm that has the kickback or scatter trait.

You throw yourself at an enemy, bracing your weapon against it and pulling it close before releasing a destructive shot. Attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple}; if you're wielding your weapon in both hands, you Release one hand to do so. If your Grapple succeeds, you can immediately Strike the target of the Grapple with the required weapon, even if it's a two-handed weapon you're holding in one hand. This Strike deals an additional 3d6 precision damage.

As long the creature remains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, you can use just one hand to reload the weapon and Strike that creature with it.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손 석궁이나 반동 또는 산탄 특성을 가진 화기를 사용 중이어야 합니다.

적에게 몸을 던져 무기를 그 몸에 고정시킨 후 가까이 끌어당겨 파괴적인 일격을 가한다. @link[actions.grapple]을 시도하다. 양손으로 무기를 휘두르고 있다면, 이를 위해 한 손을 놓아야 한다. 그랩이 성공하면, 한 손으로 쥔 양손 무기라도 즉시 그랩 대상에게 강타할 수 있다. 이 강타는 추가로 3d6 정밀 피해를 입힌다.

생물이 @link[conditions.grabbed] 또는 @link[conditions.restrained]로 유지되는 동안, 한 손만으로 무기를 재장전하고 그 생물을 강타할 수 있다.

name: Tremor

description.value:
You unleash a small, localized tremor in a @Template[burst|distance:10] within 30 feet. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2)d8)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. A creature that critically fails is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. Earth and stone in the area is difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.

Level (+2) The damage increases by 1d8.

_desc_en:
You unleash a small, localized tremor in a @Template[burst|distance:10] within 30 feet. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2)d8)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. A creature that critically fails is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. Earth and stone in the area is difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.

Level (+2) The damage increases by 1d8.
_desc_ko:
30피트 반경의 10피트 범위 내에서 국소적인 작은 진동을 일으킵니다. 영역 내 모든 생물은 타격 피해를 입으며, 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 기본 인내 내성을 발휘합니다. 대실패한 생물은 @link[conditions.prone] 상태가 됩니다. 영역 내의 땅과 돌은 다음 턴 시작까지 어려운 지형이 됩니다.

레벨 (+2) 피해량이 1d8 증가합니다.

name: Far Shot

description.value: Your experience in the field has taught you how to focus your aim at a distance, increasing your accuracy. Double your weapons' range increments.

_desc_en: Your experience in the field has taught you how to focus your aim at a distance, increasing your accuracy. Double your weapons' range increments.
_desc_ko: 전장에서의 경험으로 먼 거리에서도 조준을 포커싱하는 법을 터득하여 정확도가 향상되었습니다. 무기의 사거리 증가량을 두 배로 늘립니다.

name: Duelist Dedication

description.value:
You are always ready to draw your weapon and begin a duel, no matter the circumstances. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.qFt6zyWVX1njJf1l]{Quick Draw} feat, enabling you to both draw and attack with a weapon as 1 action.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.BwPUY2X7TSmlJj5c]{Duelist}

value.value: trained in light armor and simple weapons

_desc_en:
You are always ready to draw your weapon and begin a duel, no matter the circumstances. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.qFt6zyWVX1njJf1l]{Quick Draw} feat, enabling you to both draw and attack with a weapon as 1 action.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.BwPUY2X7TSmlJj5c]{Duelist}
_desc_ko: 어떤 상황에서도 무기를 뽑아 결투를 시작할 준비가 되어 있다. @link[feats.quick-draw] 피트를 얻어, 무기를 뽑고 공격하는 것을 하나의 행동으로 수행할 수 있다.

name: Cloud Step

description.value: Using fantastic acrobatic skill, you can walk for brief stretches across insubstantial surfaces. When you Stride, you can move across water, air, and solid surfaces that can hold only limited weight as if they were normal ground. If you Stride over a trap with a weight-sensitive pressure plate, you don't trigger it. At the end of your turn, you sink, fall, break fragile surfaces, or trigger traps as normal for your current location.

_desc_en: Using fantastic acrobatic skill, you can walk for brief stretches across insubstantial surfaces. When you Stride, you can move across water, air, and solid surfaces that can hold only limited weight as if they were normal ground. If you Stride over a trap with a weight-sensitive pressure plate, you don't trigger it. At the end of your turn, you sink, fall, break fragile surfaces, or trigger traps as normal for your current location.
_desc_ko: 환상적인 곡예 기술을 사용해 실체가 없는 표면 위를 잠시 걸을 수 있습니다. 이동 시 물, 공기, 그리고 무게 감지 압력판이 제한된 무게만 견딜 수 있는 단단한 표면 위를 일반 지면처럼 이동할 수 있습니다. 무게 감지 압력판이 설치된 함정 위를 이동해도 함정이 작동하지 않습니다. 턴 종료 시, 현재 위치에 따라 가라앉거나, 추락하거나, 취약한 표면을 파괴하거나, 함정을 정상적으로 작동시킵니다.

name: Deceptive Worship

description.value: Members of your cult frequently pass themselves off as worshippers of other religions. You can use Occultism instead of Deception to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} a typical worshipper of another faith or to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} specifically to claim you are a member of the faith you are Impersonating. You still need to use the Deception skill to Impersonate a specific worshipper or to perform other deceptive actions, such as attempting to Lie about any other matter.

_desc_en: Members of your cult frequently pass themselves off as worshippers of other religions. You can use Occultism instead of Deception to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} a typical worshipper of another faith or to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} specifically to claim you are a member of the faith you are Impersonating. You still need to use the Deception skill to Impersonate a specific worshipper or to perform other deceptive actions, such as attempting to Lie about any other matter.
_desc_ko: 당신의 교단 구성원들은 종종 다른 종교의 신도로 위장합니다. 당신은 기만 대신 오컬트를 사용하여 @link[actions.impersonate] 다른 신앙의 전형적인 신도로 행세하거나 @link[actions.lie]을 통해 자신이 사칭하는 신앙의 구성원이라고 주장할 수 있습니다. 특정 신도를 사칭하거나 다른 사기 행위(예: 다른 사안에 대해 거짓말하기 시도)를 수행하려면 여전히 기만 기술을 사용해야 합니다.

name: Countercharm

description.value:
Trigger A creature Casts a Spell from the enchantment or illusion school.

Requirements You have an innate non-cantrip captivator spell of the same school.

Your enchantments and illusions are so dominant that you can use them to counteract similar magic cast by others. When a foe casts an enchantment or illusion spell and you can see its manifestations, you can use your own innate magic to disrupt it. You lose an innate, non-cantrip spell of the same school as the triggering spell as if you had Cast the Spell. You then attempt to counteract the triggering spell with your spell.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature Casts a Spell from the enchantment or illusion school.

Requirements You have an innate non-cantrip captivator spell of the same school.

Your enchantments and illusions are so dominant that you can use them to counteract similar magic cast by others. When a foe casts an enchantment or illusion spell and you can see its manifestations, you can use your own innate magic to disrupt it. You lose an innate, non-cantrip spell of the same school as the triggering spell as if you had Cast the Spell. You then attempt to counteract the triggering spell with your spell.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 생물이 마법 또는 환상 계열의 주문을 시전할 때.

요구 사항 당신은 동일한 계열의 선천적 비-캔트립 매혹자 주문을 보유하고 있어야 합니다.

당신의 마법과 환상은 매우 강력하여 타인이 시전한 유사한 마법을 반격할 수 있습니다. 적이 마법 또는 환상 주문을 시전하고 그 효과가 눈에 보일 때, 자신의 선천적 마법으로 이를 방해할 수 있습니다. 발동된 주문과 동일한 학파의 선천적 캔트립 주문을 마치 '주문 시전'을 한 것처럼 잃습니다. 그런 다음 자신의 주문으로 발동된 주문을 반격하려 시도합니다.

name: Terrifying Transformation

description.value: Your flesh tears and warps as you transform. Attempt Intimidation checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} each enemy within 30 feet. This Demoralize loses the auditory trait and gains the visual trait, and you don't take a penalty if a creature doesn't understand your language. Regardless of the results of your checks, each creature is temporarily immune to Terrifying Transformation for 1 minute.

value.value: you were afflicted with the curse of the werecreature

_desc_en: Your flesh tears and warps as you transform. Attempt Intimidation checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} each enemy within 30 feet. This Demoralize loses the auditory trait and gains the visual trait, and you don't take a penalty if a creature doesn't understand your language. Regardless of the results of your checks, each creature is temporarily immune to Terrifying Transformation for 1 minute.
_desc_ko: 변신하는 동안 당신의 살점이 찢어지고 뒤틀립니다. 30피트 내의 각 적에게 @link[actions.demoralize]를 시도하다 위협 판정을 수행하십시오. 이 사기 저하 효과는 청각적 특성을 잃고 시각적 특성을 얻으며, 대상이 당신의 언어를 이해하지 못해도 페널티를 받지 않습니다. 판정 결과와 무관하게, 각 대상은 1분 동안 공포의 변형에 일시적으로 면역됩니다.

name: Minion Guise

description.value:
When you are in your social identity, you can also grant a social identity to an animal companion, familiar, or other minion you gained from a class feature.

When changing to your social identity, you also change your minion's appearance to that of a socially acceptable creature of its type, such as grooming a wolf to appear as a large dog or disguising a familiar to appear as an exotic pet.

Commanding your minion to use unusual magical or combat abilities it gained from your class features or feats while in this social identity risks exposing your vigilante identity.

_desc_en:
When you are in your social identity, you can also grant a social identity to an animal companion, familiar, or other minion you gained from a class feature.

When changing to your social identity, you also change your minion's appearance to that of a socially acceptable creature of its type, such as grooming a wolf to appear as a large dog or disguising a familiar to appear as an exotic pet.

Commanding your minion to use unusual magical or combat abilities it gained from your class features or feats while in this social identity risks exposing your vigilante identity.
_desc_ko:
사회적 정체성 상태일 때, 직업 특성에 의해 획득한 동물 동료, 패밀리어 또는 다른 하수인에게도 사회적 정체성을 부여할 수 있습니다.

사회적 정체성으로 전환할 때, 하수인의 외형도 그 유형에 맞는 사회적으로 수용 가능한 생물의 모습으로 바뀝니다. 예를 들어 늑대를 큰 개처럼 보이도록 손질하거나, 패밀리어를 이국적인 애완동물처럼 위장하는 식입니다.

이 사회적 정체성 상태에서 하수인에게 클래스 피트나 피트로 얻은 특이한 마법 또는 전투 능력을 사용하도록 명령하면 자경단원 신분이 노출될 위험이 있습니다.

name: Sea Witch

description.value: You've studied the waves, and they obey your will as extensions of your own fin. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.oUDNCArkQTdhllxD]{Aqueous Orb} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zfn5RqAdF63neqpP]{Control Water} as 5th-rank primal innate spells, each once per day.

_desc_en: You've studied the waves, and they obey your will as extensions of your own fin. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.oUDNCArkQTdhllxD]{Aqueous Orb} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zfn5RqAdF63neqpP]{Control Water} as 5th-rank primal innate spells, each once per day.
_desc_ko: 파도를 연구한 당신은 파도가 자신의 지느러미처럼 의지대로 움직이게 합니다. @link[spells.aqueous-orb]과 @link[spells.control-water]을 (5th)랭크 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 하루에 각각 한 번씩 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Mobile Shot Stance

description.value:
Your shots become nimble and deadly. While you're in this stance, your ranged Strikes don't trigger Reactive Strike or other reactions that are triggered by a ranged attack.

Special If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KAVf7AmRnbCAHrkT]{Reactive Strike}, you can use it with a loaded ranged weapon you're wielding. The triggering creature must be within 5 feet of you for you to do so.

_desc_en:
Your shots become nimble and deadly. While you're in this stance, your ranged Strikes don't trigger Reactive Strike or other reactions that are triggered by a ranged attack.

Special If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KAVf7AmRnbCAHrkT]{Reactive Strike}, you can use it with a loaded ranged weapon you're wielding. The triggering creature must be within 5 feet of you for you to do so.
_desc_ko:
당신의 사격이 민첩하고 치명적으로 변합니다. 이 자세를 취하는 동안, 당신의 원거리 공격은 반응 공격이나 원거리 공격에 의해 유발되는 다른 반응을 유발하지 않습니다.

특수 @link[actions.reactive-strike]을 보유한 경우, 장전된 원거리 무기를 사용 중일 때 이를 발동할 수 있다. 발동 대상 생물은 5피트 이내에 위치해야 한다.

name: Slip Sideways

description.value: Like many fiends, you have the supernatural ability to teleport yourself to safety. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Translocate} as a 5th-rank divine innate spell.

value.value: Grimspawn, Pitborn, or Hellspawn, or another lineage feat associated with fiends or the Maelstrom

_desc_en: Like many fiends, you have the supernatural ability to teleport yourself to safety. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Translocate} as a 5th-rank divine innate spell.
_desc_ko: 많은 핀드들처럼, 당신은 초자연적인 능력으로 자신을 안전한 곳으로 순간이동시킬 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, @link[spells.translocate]을 (5th)랭크 신성 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Awesome Blow

description.value:
Your attacks are so powerful, they can flatten your opponents. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.pVLdMOqYwul745k3]{Knockback}, you can attempt an @Check[athletics|against:fortitude] check against your target's Fortitude DC.

Critical Success You gain the critical success effect of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, then the critical success effect of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} against the target.

Success You gain the success effect of a Shove, then the success effect of a Trip against the target.

Failure You gain the normal effect of Knockback.

_desc_en:
Your attacks are so powerful, they can flatten your opponents. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.pVLdMOqYwul745k3]{Knockback}, you can attempt an @Check[athletics|against:fortitude] check against your target's Fortitude DC.

Critical Success You gain the critical success effect of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, then the critical success effect of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} against the target.

Success You gain the success effect of a Shove, then the success effect of a Trip against the target.

Failure You gain the normal effect of Knockback.
_desc_ko:
당신의 공격은 너무 강력해서 상대를 눕힐 수 있습니다. @link[feats.knockback]을 사용할 때, 대상의 인내 DC에 대한 운동 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다.

대성공 대상에게 @link[actions.shove]의 대성공 효과를 부여한 후, @link[actions.trip]의 대성공 효과를 추가로 부여합니다.

성공 대상에게 밀치기 성공 효과를 얻은 후, 넘어뜨리기 성공 효과를 얻습니다.

실패 당신은 밀쳐내기의 일반 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Dizzying Spin Dance

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a fan.

You're practiced in using your fans to spin with dizzying speed. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} an opponent's space, and then Strike that opponent. If both the Tumble Through and Strike are successful, the opponent is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to the next attack made against it before the start of your next turn, and you can attempt to Tumble Through the space of a different opponent and Strike again with the same effect. If this second Tumble Through and Strike are successful, you can repeat these actions a third time against a third opponent.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a fan.

You're practiced in using your fans to spin with dizzying speed. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} an opponent's space, and then Strike that opponent. If both the Tumble Through and Strike are successful, the opponent is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to the next attack made against it before the start of your next turn, and you can attempt to Tumble Through the space of a different opponent and Strike again with the same effect. If this second Tumble Through and Strike are successful, you can repeat these actions a third time against a third opponent.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 부채를 휘두르고 있어야 합니다.

부채를 휘둘러 현기증 나는 속도로 회전하는 데 능숙합니다. @link[actions.tumble-through]상대방의 공간을 {회피 돌파}한 후, 그 상대를 강타합니다. 회피 돌파와 강타가 모두 성공하면 상대는 @link[conditions.off-guard]다음 차례 시작 전까지 다음 공격에 대해 {무방비} 상태가 되며, 다른 상대의 공간을 회피 돌파하여 통과한 후 동일한 효과로 다시 공격할 시도할 수 있습니다. 이 두 번째 회피 돌파 및 공격이 성공하면, 세 번째 상대를 상대로 이 행동을 세 번째로 반복할 수 있습니다.

name: Tear Tendons

description.value:
Requirements You are in claw stance and have two open hands.

You rake into your opponent with two claws, cutting into their muscle and depriving them of needed strength. Make two frenzied claw attacks against the same target, increasing the multiple attack penalty normally. If both attacks hit, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:class] save against your class DC or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 round; if it critically fails, it's instead enfeebled 2 for 1 minute.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are in claw stance and have two open hands.

You rake into your opponent with two claws, cutting into their muscle and depriving them of needed strength. Make two frenzied claw attacks against the same target, increasing the multiple attack penalty normally. If both attacks hit, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:class] save against your class DC or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 round; if it critically fails, it's instead enfeebled 2 for 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 발톱 자세를 취하고 양손이 비어 있어야 합니다.

두 발톱으로 상대를 갈퀴질하며 근육을 베어내 필요한 힘을 빼앗습니다. 동일 대상에게 광란의 발톱 공격을 두 번 수행하며, 다중 공격 페널티를 정상적으로 증가시킵니다. 두 공격 모두 명중 시, 대상은 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 인내 내성에 성공해야 하며, 실패 시 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.enfeebled]{2} 상태가 됩니다. 대실패 시, 대신 1분 동안 약화된 2 상태가 됩니다.

name: Graceful Poise

description.value: With the right positioning, your off-hand weapon can strike like a scorpion's stinger. While you are in this stance, if you make your second Strike from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.onde0SxLoxLBTnvm]{Double Slice} with an agile weapon, Double Slice counts as one attack when calculating your multiple attack penalty.

_desc_en: With the right positioning, your off-hand weapon can strike like a scorpion's stinger. While you are in this stance, if you make your second Strike from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.onde0SxLoxLBTnvm]{Double Slice} with an agile weapon, Double Slice counts as one attack when calculating your multiple attack penalty.
_desc_ko: 적절한 위치 선정으로 비주무기 무기를 전갈의 침처럼 날카롭게 휘둘 수 있습니다. 이 자세를 취한 상태에서 기민한 무기로 @link[feats.double-slice]의 두 번째 공격을 수행할 경우, 다중 공격 페널티 계산 시 더블 슬라이스는 하나의 공격으로 간주됩니다.

name: Scholarly Defense

description.value: Your knowledge of strange creatures and their bizarre anatomy allows you to anticipate their physical attacks and reduce the damage you take from them. You gain resistance to physical damage from melee attacks made by aberrations and oozes. This resistance is equal to one-third your level.

_desc_en: Your knowledge of strange creatures and their bizarre anatomy allows you to anticipate their physical attacks and reduce the damage you take from them. You gain resistance to physical damage from melee attacks made by aberrations and oozes. This resistance is equal to one-third your level.
_desc_ko: 기이한 생물과 그들의 기괴한 해부학적 구조에 대한 지식으로 인해, 당신은 그들의 물리적 공격을 예측하고 그로부터 받는 피해를 줄일 수 있습니다. 변종 생물과 우즈가 가하는 근접 공격의 물리적 피해에 대해 저항력을 얻습니다. 이 저항력은 당신의 레벨의 1/3에 해당합니다.

name: Eat Fortune

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger A creature within 60 feet uses a fortune or misfortune effect.

As someone tries to twist fate, you consume the interference. The triggering effect is disrupted. If it's a misfortune effect, Eat Fortune gains the fortune trait; if it's a fortune effect, Eat Fortune gains the misfortune trait. This fortune or misfortune applies to the same roll the triggering effect would have, so you couldn't negate a fortune effect with Eat Fortune and then apply a misfortune effect to the same roll.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger A creature within 60 feet uses a fortune or misfortune effect.

As someone tries to twist fate, you consume the interference. The triggering effect is disrupted. If it's a misfortune effect, Eat Fortune gains the fortune trait; if it's a fortune effect, Eat Fortune gains the misfortune trait. This fortune or misfortune applies to the same roll the triggering effect would have, so you couldn't negate a fortune effect with Eat Fortune and then apply a misfortune effect to the same roll.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 60피트 내 생물이 행운 또는 불운 효과를 사용한다.

누군가 운명을 뒤틀려 할 때, 당신은 그 간섭을 흡수한다. 발동된 효과는 중단된다. 불운 효과라면 '운명 먹기'는 행운 특성을 얻고, 행운 효과라면 불운 특성을 얻는다. 이 행운 또는 불운은 발동된 효과가 적용되었을 것과 동일한 굴림에 적용되므로, '운명 먹기'로 행운 효과를 무효화한 후 동일한 굴림에 불운 효과를 적용할 수는 없다.

name: Weight of Experience

description.value: The experience you've accumulated over multiple lifetimes envelops you like a weighted blanket, providing comfort and bestowing confidence under pressure. You gain the trained proficiency rank in one skill of your choice and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]{Assurance} skill feat in that skill as a bonus feat.

publication.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

_desc_en: The experience you've accumulated over multiple lifetimes envelops you like a weighted blanket, providing comfort and bestowing confidence under pressure. You gain the trained proficiency rank in one skill of your choice and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]{Assurance} skill feat in that skill as a bonus feat.
_desc_ko: 여러 생애에 걸쳐 쌓아온 경험은 무거운 담요처럼 당신을 감싸 안으며, 압박 속에서도 안락함과 확신을 선사합니다. 당신은 선택한 한 가지 기술에 숙련 숙련도 등급을 획득하며, 해당 기술에 대한 @link[feats.assurance] 기술 피트를 보너스 피트로 얻습니다.

name: Skeleton Commander

description.value:
You gain the ability to summon your own skeletal minions. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.c3b6LdLlQDPngNIb]{Create Undead} rituals to create three types of undead for which you meet the prerequisites. These undead must have the skeleton trait or be other skeletal undead the GM agrees to. You can't teach these rituals to anyone else, and you can't participate in either ritual while allowing someone else to serve as the primary caster unless they also know the ritual.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Religion checks for create undead rituals. You can also perform the ritual without the aid of a secondary caster; in this case, you attempt the secondary check normally performed by that caster.

_desc_en:
You gain the ability to summon your own skeletal minions. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.c3b6LdLlQDPngNIb]{Create Undead} rituals to create three types of undead for which you meet the prerequisites. These undead must have the skeleton trait or be other skeletal undead the GM agrees to. You can't teach these rituals to anyone else, and you can't participate in either ritual while allowing someone else to serve as the primary caster unless they also know the ritual.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Religion checks for create undead rituals. You can also perform the ritual without the aid of a secondary caster; in this case, you attempt the secondary check normally performed by that caster.
_desc_ko:
자신의 해골 하수인을 소환하는 능력을 얻습니다. 당신은 @link[spells.create-undead] 의식을 배워, 자신이 전제 조건을 충족하는 세 종류의 언데드를 창조할 수 있습니다. 이 언데드는 해골 특성을 가져야 하거나, GM이 동의하는 다른 해골형 언데드여야 합니다. 이 의식은 타인에게 가르칠 수 없으며, 다른 사람이 주 시전자 역할을 수행할 때 본인이 의식에 참여할 수 없습니다. 단, 해당 의식을 알고 있는 경우 예외입니다.

언데드 생성 의식에 대한 종교 능력 판정 시 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 보조 시전자의 도움 없이도 의식을 수행할 수 있으며, 이 경우 해당 시전자가 수행하는 보조 판정을 대신 시도합니다.

name: Cycle of Souls

description.value:
Trigger Your turn starts.

Your spiritual allies guide your movements, allowing you to prepare for the trials before you at a speed faster than thought. You Step, then enter an animist stance you know.

value.value: liturgist practice, at least one animist stance

_desc_en:
Trigger Your turn starts.

Your spiritual allies guide your movements, allowing you to prepare for the trials before you at a speed faster than thought. You Step, then enter an animist stance you know.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신의 턴이 시작됩니다.

영적 동맹들이 당신의 움직임을 인도하여, 생각보다 빠른 속도로 다가올 시련에 대비할 수 있게 합니다. 당신은 {신중한 발걸음}을 취한 후, 알고 있는 애니미스트 자세를 취합니다.

name: Thaumaturge's Demesne

description.value:
You have claimed an area or location as your demesne, granting you the ability to ward and protect it. When you select this feat, choose a demesne, an area of no more than 2,000 square feet. You must legitimately own the area or, if its a public area, you must lay claim to the area without anyone contesting it.

Once you've chosen your demesne, it's automatically protected by an arcane @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.onjZCEHs3JJJRTD0]{Peaceful Bubble} spell with an unlimited duration, heightened to half your level rounded up and using your thaumaturge class DC in place of a spell DC, if necessary. Additionally, the demesne is attended by three unseen custodians, as a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uuoPmbjEtqzWZs0v]{Unseen Custodians} ritual, and one object in the area gains an elemental sentinel, as a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rOwOLlfVgLMg1FND]{Elemental Sentinel} ritual.

_desc_en:

Once you've chosen your demesne, it's automatically protected by an arcane @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.onjZCEHs3JJJRTD0]{Peaceful Bubble} spell with an unlimited duration, heightened to half your level rounded up and using your thaumaturge class DC in place of a spell DC, if necessary. Additionally, the demesne is attended by three unseen custodians, as a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uuoPmbjEtqzWZs0v]{Unseen Custodians} ritual, and one object in the area gains an elemental sentinel, as a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rOwOLlfVgLMg1FND]{Elemental Sentinel} ritual.
_desc_ko:
당신은 특정 지역이나 장소를 자신의 영지로 주장하여, 그곳을 수호부하고 보호할 수 있는 능력을 부여받았습니다. 이 재주를 선택할 때, 2,000제곱피트 이하의 영지 한 곳을 선택하십시오. 해당 지역을 합법적으로 소유하고 있어야 하며, 공공 장소인 경우 누구의 이의도 없이 그 지역에 대한 권리를 주장해야 합니다.

영지를 선택하면, 무제한 지속 시간의 아케인 @link[spells.peaceful-bubble] 주문이 자동으로 적용됩니다. 이 주문은 필요 시, 귀하의 레벨의 절반(올림)으로 강화되며, 주문 DC 대신 귀하의 쏘마터지 클래스 DC가 적용됩니다. 추가로, 영지에는 보이지 않는 수호자 3명이 상주하며(성공한 @link[spells.phantasmal-custodians] 의식), 영역 내 한 물체는 원소 수호자를 얻습니다(성공한 @link[spells.elemental-sentinel] 의식).

name: Bright Lion Dedication

description.value:
Access @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.backgrounds.Item.JfGVkZkaoz2lnmov]{Bright Lion} background

You become trained in your choice of Deception or Diplomacy and in Mzali Lore; if you were already trained, you become an expert instead. You incorporate enough worship of Walkena in your daily life to avoid suspicion. You typically don't need to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} to pass yourself off as a worshipper of Walkena. Against careful inspection, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to Deception checks specifically to pass yourself off as a version of yourself faithful to Walkena.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.vS9iMDapZN9uW33Q]{Bright Lion}

_desc_ko:
접근 @link[backgrounds.bright-lion] 배경

당신은 선택한 기만 또는 외교 기술과 므잘리 지식에 숙련됩니다. 이미 숙련된 경우, 대신 전문가가 됩니다. 당신은 일상생활에 월케나에 대한 충분한 숭배를 포함시켜 의심을 피합니다. 일반적으로 @link[actions.lie]이나 @link[actions.impersonate]을 사용하지 않아도 월케나 신도로 위장할 수 있습니다. 세심한 조사에 대비해, 월케나에 충실한 자신의 모습으로 위장하는 데 특화된 기만 검사에서 +4 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Emblazon Energy

description.value:
With elemental forces, you make your emblazoned symbols more potent. When you Emblazon an Armament, you can choose from the following effects instead of the effects listed in that feat. These effects have the same restrictions as the base options.

  • Shield Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. The wielder gains the shield's circumstance bonus to saving throws against that damage type and can use Shield Block against damage of that type. The shield also gains resistance to that damage type equal to half your level if you have a domain spell with a trait matching that type (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.oJKZi8OQgmVXHOc0]{Fire Ray}).
  • Weapon Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. The weapon deals an extra 1d4 damage of that type. Increase this extra damage to 1d6 if you have a domain spell with a trait matching that type (such as fire ray).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.jUUjgpEEOeZeG7II]{Effect: Emblazon Energy}
