name: Grave's Voice

description.value: You can use your choice of Spirit Lore or Haunt Lore to Make an Impression or Request things of incorporeal creatures. At the GM's discretion, an incorporeal spirit might be willing to hear you out.

_desc_en: You can use your choice of Spirit Lore or Haunt Lore to Make an Impression or Request things of incorporeal creatures. At the GM's discretion, an incorporeal spirit might be willing to hear you out.
_desc_ko: 영혼 지식 또는 유령 지식을 선택하여 비물질적 생물에게 인상을 남기거나 요청을 할 수 있습니다. GM의 재량에 따라 비물질적 영혼이 당신의 말을 들어줄 수도 있습니다.

name: Know Oneself

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Access Vudrani ethnicity

Trigger You roll a critical failure on a saving throw against an emotion effect.

You center yourself and call to mind the Vudrani monastic ideals of mindfulness and self-knowledge. You fail the save against the emotion effect instead of critically failing.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Access Vudrani ethnicity

Trigger You roll a critical failure on a saving throw against an emotion effect.

You center yourself and call to mind the Vudrani monastic ideals of mindfulness and self-knowledge. You fail the save against the emotion effect instead of critically failing.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

접근 부드라니 민족

발동 조건 감정 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 대실패를 굴렸을 때.

당신은 마음을 가다듬고 부드라니 수도원의 마음챙김과 자기인식에 대한 이상을 떠올립니다. 감정 효과에 대한 내성을 대실패하는 대신 실패합니다.

name: Constricting Hold

description.value:
Requirements Your eidolon has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

Your eidolon constricts the creature, dealing @Damage[(@actor.level+@actor.abilities.str.mod)[bludgeoning]]{bludgeoning damage} equal to your eidolon's level plus its Strength modifier, with a basic Fortitude save against your spell DC.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your eidolon has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

Your eidolon constricts the creature, dealing @Damage[(@actor.level+@actor.abilities.str.mod)[bludgeoning]]{bludgeoning damage} equal to your eidolon's level plus its Strength modifier, with a basic Fortitude save against your spell DC.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신의 에이돌론이 생물을 @link[conditions.grabbed] 또는 @link[conditions.restrained] 상태로 유지하고 있어야 합니다.

당신의 에이돌론이 생물을 조여, 당신의 에이돌론 레벨에 근력 능력치 수정자를 더한 만큼의 타격 피해를 입힙니다. 대상은 당신의 주문 DC(DC)에 대한 기본 인내 내성 굴림을 수행합니다.

name: No Need to Fear

description.value:
Trigger You or an ally within 60 feet attempts a saving throw against a fear effect.

With a simple reminder of perseverance, you bolster the bravery of yourself and your allies. You attempt to counteract the triggering effect with a @Check[warfare-lore] check, using half your level rounded up as the counteract rank.

_desc_en:
Trigger You or an ally within 60 feet attempts a saving throw against a fear effect.

With a simple reminder of perseverance, you bolster the bravery of yourself and your allies. You attempt to counteract the triggering effect with a @Check[warfare-lore] check, using half your level rounded up as the counteract rank.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신 또는 60피트 이내의 아군이 공포 효과에 대한 내성 굴림을 시도합니다.

인내에 대한 간단한 상기만으로, 당신은 자신과 아군의 용기를 북돋웁니다. 당신은 @Check[warfare-lore] 판정으로 발동시킨 효과를 상쇄하려 시도하며, 당신의 레벨의 절반(올림)을 상쇄 랭크로 사용합니다.

name: Denier of Destruction

description.value:
Requirements You have a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} spell prepared and you aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to the source of the damage.

Trigger Any ally within 30 feet that you can heal with your heal spell would take damage from an attack or effect from a source you can observe.

You can manipulate the same energies that the aeon orbs use to sustain life. You cast heal on the triggering target. Instead of its normal effects, the heal spell reduces the triggering damage by an amount equal to the Hit Points a 1-action heal spell of that rank would have recovered. As usual, if this reduces the damage to 0, it might also remove additional effects of the triggering attack, such as injury poisons.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} spell prepared and you aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to the source of the damage.

Trigger Any ally within 30 feet that you can heal with your heal spell would take damage from an attack or effect from a source you can observe.

You can manipulate the same energies that the aeon orbs use to sustain life. You cast heal on the triggering target. Instead of its normal effects, the heal spell reduces the triggering damage by an amount equal to the Hit Points a 1-action heal spell of that rank would have recovered. As usual, if this reduces the damage to 0, it might also remove additional effects of the triggering attack, such as injury poisons.
_desc_ko:
Requirements 당신은 @link[spells.heal] 주문을 준비하고 있으며, 해당 피해의 원천에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 아니다.

발동 당신이 치유 주문으로 치유할 수 있는 30피트 내의 아군이 관측 가능한 출처의 공격이나 효과로부터 피해를 입을 때.

당신은 영원 구슬이 생명을 유지하는 데 사용하는 동일한 에너지를 조작할 수 있습니다. 당신은 치유 주문을 발동 대상에게 시전합니다. 이 치유주문은 일반적인 효과 대신, 발동된 피해를 해당 랭크의 1-액션 치유주문이 회복했을 HP치만큼 감소시킵니다. 평소처럼, 이로 인해 피해가 0으로 감소하면 유발 공격의 추가 효과(예: 부상 독)도 제거될 수 있다.

name: Primal Proportions

description.value: You can mimic the sheer mass of the largest beasts. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge}, targeting yourself once per 10 minutes as an innate 2nd-rank primal spell. At 12th level, the spell is heightened to 4th rank.

_desc_en: You can mimic the sheer mass of the largest beasts. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge}, targeting yourself once per 10 minutes as an innate 2nd-rank primal spell. At 12th level, the spell is heightened to 4th rank.
_desc_ko: 가장 거대한 짐승의 웅장한 체구를 모방할 수 있습니다. 10분에 한 번씩 자신을 대상으로 @link[spells.enlarge]를 선천적 (2nd) 프라이멀 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 12레벨에 도달하면 이 마법은 (4th) 랭크으로 강화됩니다.

name: Dual-Weapon Reload

description.value: You carry your ammunition in a way that allows you to reload while holding two weapons. While you're wielding two one-handed weapons, each in a different hand, you don't need a free hand to reload a one-handed ranged weapon you're wielding.

_desc_en: You carry your ammunition in a way that allows you to reload while holding two weapons. While you're wielding two one-handed weapons, each in a different hand, you don't need a free hand to reload a one-handed ranged weapon you're wielding.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손에 각각 다른 한손 무기를 들고 있으며, 그중 하나는 원거리 무기여야 한다.

두 개의 무기를 들고 있는 동안 재장전이 가능하도록 탄약을 휴대합니다. 양손에 각각 다른 한손 무기를 들고 있는 동안, 들고 있는 한손 원거리 무기를 재장전하기 위해 빈 손이 필요하지 않습니다.

name: Stone Brawler Dedication

description.value:
You've learned to call the primal power of elemental stone to your aid. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.k5S2a2a6o2GS5l01]{Stonestrike Stance} action.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.YbGa7Rdxh2iQxPfG]{Stone Brawler}

_desc_en:
You've learned to call the primal power of elemental stone to your aid. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.k5S2a2a6o2GS5l01]{Stonestrike Stance} action.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.YbGa7Rdxh2iQxPfG]{Stone Brawler}
_desc_ko: 원소의 돌이 지닌 프라이멀한 힘을 불러일으키는 법을 터득했습니다. @link[actions.stonestrike-stance] 행동을 획득합니다.

name: Remote Trigger

description.value:
You've learned how to trigger snares from afar, creating ranged hazards to assail your opponents and allowing you to disarm enemies' snares harmlessly.

You can Strike a snare to trigger it prematurely. If you crafted the snare, you automatically hit. If someone else crafted it, attempt a ranged Strike against the Crafting DC, triggering the snare only if you hit.

_desc_en:
You've learned how to trigger snares from afar, creating ranged hazards to assail your opponents and allowing you to disarm enemies' snares harmlessly.

You can Strike a snare to trigger it prematurely. If you crafted the snare, you automatically hit. If someone else crafted it, attempt a ranged Strike against the Crafting DC, triggering the snare only if you hit.
_desc_ko:
원거리에서 덫을 작동시키는 법을 익혀, 원거리 위험을 조성해 적을 공격하고 적의 덫을 무해하게 {무장 해제}할 수 있습니다.

덫을 치면 조기에 발동시킬 수 있습니다. 자신이 제작한 덫이라면 자동으로 명중합니다. 타인이 제작한 덫이라면 제작 난이도(DC)에 대한 원거리 공격을 시도하며, 명중 시에만 덫이 발동됩니다.

name: Bleed Out

description.value:
Requirements Your most recent action was to cast a non-cantrip spell that granted you a blood magic effect.

You channel the residual energy from the last spell you cast into a ranged bloodletting. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the AC of a target within 60 feet. This attack deals persistent bleed damage equal to the rank of the spell you just cast.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your most recent action was to cast a non-cantrip spell that granted you a blood magic effect.

You channel the residual energy from the last spell you cast into a ranged bloodletting. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the AC of a target within 60 feet. This attack deals persistent bleed damage equal to the rank of the spell you just cast.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 가장 최근에 캐스트한 비캔트립 주문이 혈통 마법 효과를 부여한 경우.

당신은 마지막으로 시전한 주문에서 남은 에너지를 원거리 출혈로 전환합니다. 60피트 이내 대상의 AC를 상대로 원거리 주문 명중 굴림을 수행하세요. 이 공격은 방금 시전한 주문의 랭크과 동일한 지속 출혈 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Seven Changes Performance

description.value: While kitsune are known for their magical illusion powers, you're skilled at stage magic, especially costuming and quick changes. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.e4KB4pSkx2lDBNw3]{Quick Disguise} feat. You can use [[/act impersonate skill=performance]]{Performance} in place of Deception for the purposes of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonating} someone.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: While kitsune are known for their magical illusion powers, you're skilled at stage magic, especially costuming and quick changes. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.e4KB4pSkx2lDBNw3]{Quick Disguise} feat. You can use [[/act impersonate skill=performance]]{Performance} in place of Deception for the purposes of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonating} someone.
_desc_ko: 키츠네는 마법적 환상 능력으로 유명하지만, 당신은 무대 마술, 특히 의상 및 빠른 변신에 능숙합니다. @link[feats.quick-disguise] 피트를 얻습니다. @link[actions.impersonate]을 위해 기만 대신 공연를 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Goblin Lore

description.value:
You've picked up skills and tales from your goblin community. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Nature and Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Goblin Lore.

_desc_en:
You've picked up skills and tales from your goblin community. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Nature and Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Goblin Lore.
_desc_ko:
고블린 공동체로부터 기술과 이야기를 습득했습니다. 자연과 은신에 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 해당 기술 중 하나에 자동으로 숙련될 경우, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다.

고블린 지식에 대한 @link[feats.additional-lore] 일반 피트도 획득합니다.

name: Cleric Dedication

description.value:
You cast spells like a cleric. You gain the Cast a Spell activity. You can prepare two common cantrips each day from the divine spell list or any other divine cantrips you have access to. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for cleric archetype spells is Wisdom, and they are divine cleric spells. Choose a deity as you would if you were a cleric. You become bound by that deity's anathema and can receive that deity's divine sanctification. You become trained in Religion and your deity's associated skill; for each of these skills in which you were already trained, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You don't gain any other abilities from your choice of deity.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.ZJHhPFjLnizAaUM1]{Cleric}

_desc_en:
You cast spells like a cleric. You gain the Cast a Spell activity. You can prepare two common cantrips each day from the divine spell list or any other divine cantrips you have access to. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for cleric archetype spells is Wisdom, and they are divine cleric spells. Choose a deity as you would if you were a cleric. You become bound by that deity's anathema and can receive that deity's divine sanctification. You become trained in Religion and your deity's associated skill; for each of these skills in which you were already trained, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You don't gain any other abilities from your choice of deity.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.ZJHhPFjLnizAaUM1]{Cleric}
_desc_ko: 클레릭처럼 주문을 시전한다. '주문 시전' 행동을 획득한다. 매일 신성 주문 목록이나 접근 가능한 다른 신성 캔트립 중 일반 캔트립 두 개를 준비할 수 있다. 주문 공격 수정자와 주문 DC 통계에 숙련된다. 클레릭 아키타입 주문의 핵심 주술 능력치는 지혜이며, 이들은 신성 클레릭 주문이다. 클레릭처럼 신을 선택한다. 해당 신의 저주에 얽매이게 되며 그 신의 신성한 성화를 받을 수 있다. 종교와 선택한 신의 연관 기술에 숙련된다. 이미 숙련된 해당 기술 각각에 대해, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련된다. 신 선택으로 인한 다른 능력은 얻지 못합니다.

name: Eclipsed Vitality

description.value: You shroud yourself in ashes that hide the vital essence sought by life-sensing undead. You're always taking precautions when @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoiding Notice}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hiding}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneaking} to foil lifesense, and you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to any creature using only precise lifesense to observe you.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en: You shroud yourself in ashes that hide the vital essence sought by life-sensing undead. You're always taking precautions when @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoiding Notice}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hiding}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneaking} to foil lifesense, and you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to any creature using only precise lifesense to observe you.
_desc_ko: 생명 감지 능력으로 생명의 정수를 탐색하는 언데드의 시야를 가리는 재로 몸을 감쌉니다. @link[actions.avoid-notice], @link[actions.hide], 그리고 @link[actions.sneak]할 때 생명의 감지를 무력화시키기 위한 예방 조치를 취하며, 정밀한 생명 감지 능력만을 사용하는 모든 생물에게 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태로 존재한다.

name: Supernatural Senses

description.value: Your scent is preternaturally sharp, and you can always rely on your sense of smell to help guide you when your vision is compromised. When you target a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} opponent while you are raging, you reduce the DC of the flat check to 3 for a concealed target or to 9 for a hidden one.

_desc_en: Your scent is preternaturally sharp, and you can always rely on your sense of smell to help guide you when your vision is compromised. When you target a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} opponent while you are raging, you reduce the DC of the flat check to 3 for a concealed target or to 9 for a hidden one.
_desc_ko: 당신의 후각은 초자연적으로 예민하여, 시야가 차단되었을 때 항상 냄새를 통해 길을 찾을 수 있습니다. 분노 상태에서 @link[conditions.concealed] 또는 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태의 적을 대상으로 할 때, 가려진 대상에 대한 단순 판정 DC는 3으로, 숨겨진 대상에 대한 단순 판정 DC는 9로 감소한다.

name: Voluminous Vials

description.value:
Your number of versatile vials per day increases to 5.

Special At 12th level or higher, you can select this feat a second time to increase your number of versatile vials per day to 6. At 18th level or higher, you can select this feat a third time to increase your number of versatile vials per day to 7.

_desc_en:
Your number of versatile vials per day increases to 5.

Special At 12th level or higher, you can select this feat a second time to increase your number of versatile vials per day to 6. At 18th level or higher, you can select this feat a third time to increase your number of versatile vials per day to 7.
_desc_ko:
하루에 사용할 수 있는 다용도 약병의 수가 5개로 증가합니다.

특수 12레벨 이상에서 이 피트를 두 번째로 선택하면 하루에 사용할 수 있는 다용도 약병의 수가 6개로 증가합니다. 18레벨 이상에서 이 피트를 세 번째로 선택하면 하루에 사용할 수 있는 다용도 약병의 수가 7개로 증가합니다.

name: Release Me!

description.value:
Requirements An enemy has you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

Your retribution against one who would detain you is swift and dangerous. Make a melee Strike against the creature who has you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}. You can still make this attack even if you are restrained, though not if you are wielding a two-handed weapon. Unless your Strike is a critical failure, you can then attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}. If the creature who has you grabbed or restrained is the target of your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cwBsPU24715fUCub]{Ultimatum of Liberation}, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this check. Both the Strike and the Escape count toward your multiple attack penalty, but it doesn't increase until you've made both rolls.

_desc_en:
Requirements An enemy has you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

Your retribution against one who would detain you is swift and dangerous. Make a melee Strike against the creature who has you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}. You can still make this attack even if you are restrained, though not if you are wielding a two-handed weapon. Unless your Strike is a critical failure, you can then attempt a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}. If the creature who has you grabbed or restrained is the target of your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cwBsPU24715fUCub]{Ultimatum of Liberation}, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this check. Both the Strike and the Escape count toward your multiple attack penalty, but it doesn't increase until you've made both rolls.
_desc_ko:
Requirements 적에게 @link[conditions.grabbed] 또는 @link[conditions.restrained] 상태입니다.

당신을 억류하려는 자에 대한 보복은 신속하고 위험합니다. 당신을 붙잡은 생물에게 근접 강타를 시도하세요 @link[conditions.grabbed] 또는 @link[conditions.restrained] 상태인 생물에게 근접 공격을 시도하십시오. 제압 상태일 때도 이 공격을 할 수 있지만, 양손 무기를 휘두르고 있다면 불가능합니다. 공격이 대실패가 아닌 경우, @link[actions.escape] 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다. 당신을 붙잡거나 구속한 생물이 @link[actions.ultimatum-of-liberation]의 대상일 경우, 이 판정에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 타격과 탈출 모두 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되지만, 두 굴림 모두 완료하기 전까지는 페널티가 증가하지 않습니다.

name: Tears of Pearl

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You weep, and your tears become gleaming pearls as they fall to the ground, so beautiful others can't help but grab at them. All creatures adjacent to you must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. The pearls dissolve at the start of your next turn, turning into salt water.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the start of your next turn as it covets the pearls or reaches for them.

Failure The target is slowed 1 until the start of your next turn as it grabs for the pearls, and if it doesn't have a free hand (or similar appendage), it must spend its first action on its next turn to Release one item it's holding.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} instead of slowed 1.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You weep, and your tears become gleaming pearls as they fall to the ground, so beautiful others can't help but grab at them. All creatures adjacent to you must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. The pearls dissolve at the start of your next turn, turning into salt water.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the start of your next turn as it covets the pearls or reaches for them.

Failure The target is slowed 1 until the start of your next turn as it grabs for the pearls, and if it doesn't have a free hand (or similar appendage), it must spend its first action on its next turn to Release one item it's holding.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} instead of slowed 1.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신이 울면, 눈물이 땅에 떨어질 때 반짝이는 진주로 변합니다. 너무 아름다워 다른 이들이 저절로 잡기게 됩니다. 당신과 인접한 모든 생물은 당신의 클래스 DC와 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽에 대해 의지 내성을 시도해야 합니다. 진주는 당신의 다음 턴 시작 시 소금물로 녹아 없어집니다.

대성공 대상은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 대상은 진주를 탐내거나 뻗어 잡으려 하므로 다음 턴 시작까지 @link[conditions.slowed]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

실패 대상은 진주를 붙잡으려다 다음 차례 시작까지 1회 느려짐을 겪으며, 빈 손(또는 유사한 부속)이 없는 경우 다음 차례 첫 행동으로 들고 있는 아이템 하나를 놓아야 합니다.

대실패 실패 효과와 동일하나, 대상은 @link[conditions.slowed]{2} 상태가 된다.

name: Impossible Technique

description.value:
Trigger An enemy's attack hits you or you fail a saving throw against an enemy's ability.

Requirements You are not armored or fatigued.

You execute a maneuver that defies possibility. If the triggering effect was an enemy's attack hitting you, the enemy rerolls the attack roll and uses the lower result. If the triggering effect was you failing a saving throw, you reroll the saving throw and use the higher result.

_desc_en:
Trigger An enemy's attack hits you or you fail a saving throw against an enemy's ability.

Requirements You are not armored or fatigued.

You execute a maneuver that defies possibility. If the triggering effect was an enemy's attack hitting you, the enemy rerolls the attack roll and uses the lower result. If the triggering effect was you failing a saving throw, you reroll the saving throw and use the higher result.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 적의 공격이 당신을 명중시키거나, 적의 능력에 대한 내성 굴림에서 실패할 때.

요구 사항 갑옷을 착용하지 않았거나 피로 상태가 아니어야 합니다.

당신이 불가능을 무시한 기동을 실행한다. 발동 효과가 적의 공격이 당신을 명중시킨 경우, 적은 명중 굴림을 재굴림하고 낮은 결과를 사용한다. 발동 효과가 당신의 내성 굴림 실패인 경우, 당신은 내성 굴림을 재굴림하고 높은 결과를 사용한다.

name: Nourishing Gate

description.value: You can sustain yourself on a single drop of elemental dew or the slightest spark from the Plane of Fire. You gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against poisons, sleep, and effects that would make you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}. You don't need to breathe, eat, or sleep, though you must still take a full night's rest every 24 hours to be able to make your daily preparations. During this time, you remain awake and alert, but you must spend the time meditating or attuning to your kinetic gate rather than engaging in other complex activities. Each kineticist attunes in their own individual way.

_desc_en: You can sustain yourself on a single drop of elemental dew or the slightest spark from the Plane of Fire. You gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against poisons, sleep, and effects that would make you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}. You don't need to breathe, eat, or sleep, though you must still take a full night's rest every 24 hours to be able to make your daily preparations. During this time, you remain awake and alert, but you must spend the time meditating or attuning to your kinetic gate rather than engaging in other complex activities. Each kineticist attunes in their own individual way.
_desc_ko: 원소의 이슬 한 방울이나 불의 평면에서 날아온 가장 작은 불꽃으로도 생존할 수 있습니다. 독, 수면, 그리고 @link[conditions.paralyzed] 상태를 유발하는 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 호흡, 식사, 수면이 필요하지 않으나, 매일 준비를 위해 24시간마다 완전한 밤의 휴식을 취해야 합니다. 이 시간 동안 깨어 있고 경계 상태를 유지하지만, 다른 복잡한 활동 대신 명상하거나 자신의 키네틱 게이트에 조율하는 데 시간을 할애해야 합니다. 각 키네티스트는 자신만의 방식으로 조율합니다.

name: Reach for the Sky

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a loaded firearm.

You command the room, firing a gun into the air and ordering everyone to surrender and put their hands in the air. You fire your firearm and then attempt a single Intimidation check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} each enemy within 30 feet. Creatures who become frightened instinctively put their hands in the air. If they had Raised a Shield, they lose the benefits, as they raise the shield above their head where it's of little use to block attacks. With their hands in the air, each of these frightened creatures can't use reactions or free actions that require their hands, or items held in their hands, until the beginning of their next turn. Regardless of the result, each creature is then temporarily immune to Reach for the Sky for 1 minute.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a loaded firearm.

You command the room, firing a gun into the air and ordering everyone to surrender and put their hands in the air. You fire your firearm and then attempt a single Intimidation check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} each enemy within 30 feet. Creatures who become frightened instinctively put their hands in the air. If they had Raised a Shield, they lose the benefits, as they raise the shield above their head where it's of little use to block attacks. With their hands in the air, each of these frightened creatures can't use reactions or free actions that require their hands, or items held in their hands, until the beginning of their next turn. Regardless of the result, each creature is then temporarily immune to Reach for the Sky for 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 장전된 화기를 소지하고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 방을 장악하며 공중으로 총을 쏘고 모두 항복하고 손을 들어 올리라고 명령합니다. 총을 쏜 후, 30피트 내의 각 적에게 @link[actions.demoralize]를 위한 단일 위협 판정을 시도합니다. 겁에 질린 생물들은 본능적으로 손을 들어 올립니다. 방패를 든 상태였다면, 방패를 머리 위로 들어 올려 공격을 막는 데 거의 쓸모없게 되므로 그 효과를 잃습니다. 손을 든 상태에서 공포에 질린 이 생물들은 다음 차례 시작 전까지 손을 사용하거나 손에 든 아이템이 필요한 반응 행동이나 자유 행동을 할 수 없습니다. 결과와 상관없이, 각 생물은 이후 1분 동안 '하늘을 향해 뻗기'에 대해 일시적으로 면역이 됩니다.

name: Kinetic Dampening

description.value:
You feed off energy in your immediate surroundings, allowing you to dampen the force imparted by incoming blows. Until the beginning of your next turn, you gain resistance 5 to physical damage. At 10th level, and every 4 levels thereafter, the resistance increases by 5. Any blows that strike you during this time make no sound as their energy is drained.

Awakening You can extend your dampening field around you to create a safe haven for your allies. If you spend an additional action when using Kinetic Dampening, your field extends in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] around you. You can choose which creatures within the emanation are affected.

Awakening You dampen a greater variety of wavelengths. When you use this feat, you also gain resistance to your choice of fire, electricity, or sonic damage.

_desc_en:
You feed off energy in your immediate surroundings, allowing you to dampen the force imparted by incoming blows. Until the beginning of your next turn, you gain resistance 5 to physical damage. At 10th level, and every 4 levels thereafter, the resistance increases by 5. Any blows that strike you during this time make no sound as their energy is drained.

Awakening You can extend your dampening field around you to create a safe haven for your allies. If you spend an additional action when using Kinetic Dampening, your field extends in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] around you. You can choose which creatures within the emanation are affected.

Awakening You dampen a greater variety of wavelengths. When you use this feat, you also gain resistance to your choice of fire, electricity, or sonic damage.
_desc_ko:
당신은 주변의 에너지를 흡수하여 다가오는 타격의 힘을 약화시킵니다. 다음 턴 시작 전까지, 물리 피해에 대해 저항 5 를 얻습니다. 10레벨에 도달하고 이후 4레벨마다 저항력이 5씩 증가한다. 이 기간 동안 당신을 강타하는 모든 타격은 에너지가 흡수되어 소리를 내지 않는다.

각성 주변에 감쇠 장을 확장하여 아군을 위한 안전한 피난처를 만들 수 있습니다. 키네틱 에너지 감쇠 사용 시 추가 행동을 소모하면 장이 주변 15피트 발산 범위까지 확장됩니다. 이 범위 내의 어떤 생물체가 영향을 받을지 선택할 수 있습니다.

각성 더 다양한 파장을 감쇠시킵니다. 이 재주를 사용할 때, 화염, 전기, 음파 피해 중 선택한 한 가지에 대한 저항력을 추가로 얻습니다.

name: Meteoric Spellstrike

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a ranged or thrown weapon, or have a ranged unarmed attack.

A trail of energy flows from your target back to you. Make a Spellstrike with a ranged weapon or ranged unarmed attack against a target within the ranged weapon or unarmed attack's first range increment. The spell you cast for the Spellstrike can't be a cantrip or focus spell. Each creature in a line between you and the target, excluding you and the target, takes damage equal to double the spell's rank. Determine the damage type as described in Arcane Cascade.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a ranged or thrown weapon, or have a ranged unarmed attack.

A trail of energy flows from your target back to you. Make a Spellstrike with a ranged weapon or ranged unarmed attack against a target within the ranged weapon or unarmed attack's first range increment. The spell you cast for the Spellstrike can't be a cantrip or focus spell. Each creature in a line between you and the target, excluding you and the target, takes damage equal to double the spell's rank. Determine the damage type as described in Arcane Cascade.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 원거리 무기나 투척 무기를 사용 중이거나, 원거리 비무장 공격을 가할 수 있어야 합니다.

목표물에서 당신을 향해 에너지의 흔적이 흘러나옵니다. 원거리 무기나 원거리 비무장 공격의 첫 번째 사거리 구간 내에 있는 목표물을 대상으로 원거리 무기나 비무장 공격으로 스펠스트라이크를 수행하십시오. 스펠스트라이크에 사용하는 주문은 캐스트나 포커스 주문일 수 없습니다. 당신과 대상 사이의 직선 상에 있는 모든 생물(당신과 대상 제외)은 해당 주문의 랭크 수의 두 배에 해당하는 피해를 입습니다. 피해 유형은 아케인 캐스케이드의 설명에 따라 결정합니다.

name: Courageous Advance

description.value: With a rousing call, you exhort an ally to advance. If your next action is to cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IAjvwqgiDr3qGYxY]{Courageous Anthem} composition cantrip, one ally of your choice who gains a status bonus from the spell can immediately use their reaction to Stride.

_desc_en: With a rousing call, you exhort an ally to advance. If your next action is to cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IAjvwqgiDr3qGYxY]{Courageous Anthem} composition cantrip, one ally of your choice who gains a status bonus from the spell can immediately use their reaction to Stride.
_desc_ko: 격려의 함성으로 아군 한 명에게 전진을 촉구합니다. 다음 행동으로 @link[spells.courageous-anthem] 작곡 캔트립을 시전할 경우, 해당 주문으로 상태 보너스를 얻은 아군 한 명이 즉시 반응으로 이동할 수 있습니다.

name: Debilitating Bomb

description.value: You can add a crystalline additive to an alchemical bomb to have it undermine your enemy. Choose @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, or a –5-foot status penalty to Speeds. If the attack with the bomb hits, in addition to the bomb's normal effects, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:class] saving throw or take that effect until the start of your next turn. Use your class DC for this saving throw, even if someone else throws the bomb.

_desc_en: You can add a crystalline additive to an alchemical bomb to have it undermine your enemy. Choose @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, or a –5-foot status penalty to Speeds. If the attack with the bomb hits, in addition to the bomb's normal effects, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:class] saving throw or take that effect until the start of your next turn. Use your class DC for this saving throw, even if someone else throws the bomb.
_desc_ko: 연금술 폭탄에 결정질 첨가제를 넣어 적을 무력화시킬 수 있습니다. @link[conditions.dazzled], @link[conditions.deafened], @link[conditions.off-guard], 또는 이동 속도에 -5피트 상태 페널티 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 폭탄 공격이 명중하면 폭탄의 일반 효과에 더해, 대상은 인내 내성 굴림에서 성공하지 못하면 다음 차례 시작까지 해당 효과를 받습니다. 다른 사람이 폭탄을 던졌더라도 이 내성 굴림에 본인의 직업 DC(DC)를 적용하십시오.

name: Blood Calls Blood

description.value:
Trigger You fail a flat check to Cast a Spell or your spell would be disrupted by another creature's reaction.

The magical potency of your blood will not be denied. You finish Casting the Spell, then become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} or increase the value of your drained condition by 1.

_desc_en:
Trigger You fail a flat check to Cast a Spell or your spell would be disrupted by another creature's reaction.

The magical potency of your blood will not be denied. You finish Casting the Spell, then become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} or increase the value of your drained condition by 1.
_desc_ko:
발동 주문 시전 단순 판정 실패 시, 또는 다른 생물의 반응으로 주문이 방해받을 때.

당신의 피가 지닌 마법적 효능은 부정될 수 없다. 당신은 주문을 시전한 후 @link[conditions.drained]{1} 상태가 되거나 기력 감소 상태의 수치를 1 증가시킨다.

name: Cunning Climber

description.value: Whether you are climbing a ship's rigging, a jungle tree, or a clock tower, you have an uncanny knack for finding footholds and handholds where larger creatures can't. You gain a climb Speed of 10 feet.

_desc_en: Whether you are climbing a ship's rigging, a jungle tree, or a clock tower, you have an uncanny knack for finding footholds and handholds where larger creatures can't. You gain a climb Speed of 10 feet.
_desc_ko: 배의 돛대, 정글의 나무, 시계탑을 오르든 간에, 당신은 더 큰 생물들이 잡을 수 없는 곳에서 발걸이와 손걸이를 찾는 놀라운 재주를 지녔다. 등반 속도가 10피트 증가한다.

name: Call the Hunt

description.value:
Requirements You are observing your hunted prey.

You instruct your allies on how best to defeat your prey. Until the start of your next turn, whenever your hunted prey is within reach of you and at least one of your allies, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to all melee attacks. If you are sanctified, the unarmed attacks and weapon Strikes of you and all your allies gain the benefits of your sanctification against your hunted prey.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are observing your hunted prey.

You instruct your allies on how best to defeat your prey. Until the start of your next turn, whenever your hunted prey is within reach of you and at least one of your allies, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to all melee attacks. If you are sanctified, the unarmed attacks and weapon Strikes of you and all your allies gain the benefits of your sanctification against your hunted prey.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 사냥감을 관찰하고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 동맹들에게 사냥감을 제압하는 최선의 방법을 지시합니다. 다음 차례가 시작될 때까지, 사냥감이 당신과 적어도 한 명의 동맹이 닿을 수 있는 거리에 있을 때마다, 사냥감은 모든 근접 공격에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다. 당신이 성화 상태라면, 당신과 모든 동맹의 비무장 공격과 무기 공격은 사냥감에 대해 당신의 성화 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Master Snowcasting

description.value: You have unlocked the deeper magic of your gelid shard, gaining access to new ranks of spells. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#master-spellcasting-feat]{master spellcasting} benefits.

_desc_en: You have unlocked the deeper magic of your gelid shard, gaining access to new ranks of spells. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#master-spellcasting-feat]{master spellcasting} benefits.
_desc_ko: 당신은 얼음 조각의 깊은 마법을 해금하여 새로운 계급의 주문에 접근할 수 있게 되었습니다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#master-spellcasting-feat]{마스터 주문 시전}의 혜택을 얻습니다.

name: Metallic Skin

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Duration 1 minute

You fortify your natural resistances with elemental metal, covering your skin with thick metal. You gain a +2 status bonus to AC and resistance 10 to physical damage (except adamantine), but you take a –10-foot penalty to Speed. If you take fire damage while this ability is active, until the end of your next turn, you deal an additional @Damage[2d6[fire]] damage with all your unarmed melee Strikes.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Duration 1 minute

You fortify your natural resistances with elemental metal, covering your skin with thick metal. You gain a +2 status bonus to AC and resistance 10 to physical damage (except adamantine), but you take a –10-foot penalty to Speed. If you take fire damage while this ability is active, until the end of your next turn, you deal an additional @Damage[2d6[fire]] damage with all your unarmed melee Strikes.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

지속 시간 1분

원소 금속으로 본능적 저항력을 강화하여 피부를 두꺼운 금속으로 덮습니다. AC에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻고 물리 피해(아다만틴 제외)에 대한 저항력 10을 얻지만, 이동 속도에 -10피트 페널티를 받습니다. 이 능력이 활성화된 상태에서 화염 피해를 입으면, 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 모든 비무장 공격으로 추가 2d6 화염의 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Nalinivati's Light

description.value:
Your slit eyes expand to absorb light and can see in the darkest of places. You gain darkvision.

Special You can select this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain into or out of this feat.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Your slit eyes expand to absorb light and can see in the darkest of places. You gain darkvision.

Special You can select this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain into or out of this feat.
_desc_ko:
당신의 가늘게 뜬 눈은 빛을 흡수하도록 확장되어 가장 어두운 곳에서도 볼 수 있습니다. 암흑 시야를 얻습니다.

특수 이 피트는 1레벨에서만 선택할 수 있으며, 재훈련으로 획득하거나 포기할 수 없습니다.

name: Overwatch Dedication

description.value:
You have an innate knack for tactical observation, and you've innovated to apply that knack in a variety of ways that allow you to assist your allies. With the help of enhanced visual gear (such as a specially modified telescope, goggled visor, or binoculars) and a set of carefully curated signals to share the information you uncover with your allies, you and your team are always keenly aware of the movement of combatants on the battlefield. You quickly and efficiently disperse the information you discover to your nearby allies so they can use it to direct their own observations and reactions to danger.

You're surrounded by an overwatch field aura in a 30-foot emanation. Your overwatch field aura grants you increased perception and allows you to call out warnings to your allies within the aura to point out threats. This aura has the auditory and visual traits. When you roll Perception for initiative, you and allies within your overwatch field receive a +2 circumstance bonus on your initiative rolls.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.AKKHagjg5bL1fMG5]{Effect: Overwatch Field}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.yOEiNjHLQ6XuOruq]{Overwatch}

With the help of enhanced visual gear (such as a specially modified telescope, goggled visor, or binoculars) and a set of carefully curated signals to share the information you uncover with your allies, you and your team are always keenly aware of the movement of combatants on the battlefield. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.yOEiNjHLQ6XuOruq]{Overwatch}
_desc_ko:
당신은 전술적 관찰에 타고난 재능을 지녔으며, 그 재능을 다양한 방식으로 응용하여 동료를 지원할 수 있도록 혁신했습니다. 특수 조정된 망원경, 고글형 바이저, 쌍안경 등 강화된 시각 장비와 신중하게 선별된 신호 체계를 통해 수집한 정보를 아군과 공유함으로써, 당신과 팀은 전장의 적군 동향을 항상 예리하게 파악합니다. 발견한 정보를 신속하고 효율적으로 주변 아군에게 전달하여 그들이 위험에 대한 관측과 대응을 스스로 지휘할 수 있도록 합니다.

30피트 반경의 오버워치 필드 오라에 둘러싸여 있습니다. 이 오라 덕분에 지각력이 향상되고, 오라 내 동맹에게 위협을 경고할 수 있습니다. 이 오라는 청각적·시각적 특성을 지닙니다. 선제 인니셔티브를 결정하는 지각력 굴림 시, 당신과 오버워치 필드 내 동맹은 선제 인니셔티브 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 받습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.AKKHagjg5bL1fMG5]{효과: 오버워치 필드}

name: Costume Change

description.value: Enough of your life has been spent performing that you've mastered the art of the quick change—especially when it comes to armor or invested items. You can remove any armor as a 3-action Interact activity. You can don light armor in 2 rounds, or in 1 minute for medium or heavy armor. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.WKEFnxUH0CkM8bWq]{Impromptu Investment} activity.

value.value: Acrobat, Celebrity, Dandy, or Gladiator Dedication

_desc_en: Enough of your life has been spent performing that you've mastered the art of the quick change—especially when it comes to armor or invested items. You can remove any armor as a 3-action Interact activity. You can don light armor in 2 rounds, or in 1 minute for medium or heavy armor. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.WKEFnxUH0CkM8bWq]{Impromptu Investment} activity.
_desc_ko: 당신은 인생의 상당 부분을 공연에 바쳐 왔기에, 특히 갑옷이나 투자된 아이템에 관해서는 신속한 교체 기술을 마스터했습니다. 어떤 갑옷이든 3회 행동으로 상호작용 활동을 통해 벗을 수 있습니다. 경갑은 2라운드, 평갑이나 중갑은 1분 안에 착용할 수 있다. @link[actions.impromptu-investment] 활동을 획득한다.

name: Divine Effusion

description.value:
The power of your mystery surges through you like a font of divine energy, even when your own magic dwindles.

Twice per day, you can cast a spell after you've run out of spell slots of the appropriate spell rank; the two spells you cast with this feat must be of different spell ranks.

_desc_en:
The power of your mystery surges through you like a font of divine energy, even when your own magic dwindles.

Twice per day, you can cast a spell after you've run out of spell slots of the appropriate spell rank; the two spells you cast with this feat must be of different spell ranks.
_desc_ko:
신비의 힘이 신성한 에너지의 샘처럼 당신을 관통하며, 자신의 마법이 고갈된 순간에도 지속됩니다.

하루에 두 번, 해당 주문 랭크의 주문 슬롯이 모두 소진된 후에도 주문을 시전할 수 있다. 이 피트로 시전하는 두 주문은 서로 다른 주문 랭크이어야 한다.

name: Rain of Rust

description.value:
You conjure a red raincloud in a @Template[burst|distance:10] within 60 feet, which pours rust-colored rain directly below it. Any creature in the rain with the metal trait, that is made of metal, or is wearing metal armor is covered in corrosive build-up. Any such creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} as long as it remains in the area. If such a creature is in the rain at the start of its turn, it takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -4)/2)+3)d6[untyped]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC, plus @Damage[1d6[persistent,untyped]|options:area-damage] damage if it fails. Damage from this impulse ignores Hardness. The cloud lasts 1 minute but ends if you use the impulse again.

Level (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d6.

_desc_en:
You conjure a red raincloud in a @Template[burst|distance:10] within 60 feet, which pours rust-colored rain directly below it. Any creature in the rain with the metal trait, that is made of metal, or is wearing metal armor is covered in corrosive build-up. Any such creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} as long as it remains in the area. If such a creature is in the rain at the start of its turn, it takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -4)/2)+3)d6[untyped]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC, plus @Damage[1d6[persistent,untyped]|options:area-damage] damage if it fails. Damage from this impulse ignores Hardness. The cloud lasts 1 minute but ends if you use the impulse again.

Level (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d6.
_desc_ko:
60피트 이내의 10피트에 붉은 비구름을 소환하여 그 바로 아래로 녹슨 비를 쏟아붓습니다. 비 속에 있는 금속 특성을 지닌 생물, 금속으로 만들어진 생물, 금속 갑옷을 착용한 생물은 부식성 침전물로 뒤덮입니다. 해당 생물은 @link[conditions.clumsy]{1} 상태가 되며, 이 영역에 머무는 동안 지속됩니다. 해당 생물이 자신의 턴 시작 시 비 속에 있다면, 피해를 입으며, 당신의 직업 DC에 대한 기본 인내 내성에 성공해야 합니다. 실패 시 1d6 지속 추가 피해를 입습니다. 이 임펄스로 인한 피해는 경도를 무시합니다. 구름은 1분 동안 지속되지만, 당신이 다시 임펄스를 사용하면 종료된다.

레벨 (+2) 초기 피해가 1d6만큼 증가한다.

name: Towering Presence

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You fill an area with your force of will, towering beyond where your true form should be. Increase your size to Large until the beginning of your next turn. Your equipment grows with you but returns to natural size if removed. You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}. Your reach increases by 5 feet (or by 10 feet if you started out Tiny), and you gain a +2 status bonus to melee damage. Towering Presence has no effect if you were already Large or larger.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

You fill an area with your force of will, towering beyond where your true form should be. Increase your size to Large until the beginning of your next turn. Your equipment grows with you but returns to natural size if removed. You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}. Your reach increases by 5 feet (or by 10 feet if you started out Tiny), and you gain a +2 status bonus to melee damage. Towering Presence has no effect if you were already Large or larger.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

당신의 의지력으로 영역을 채우며, 본래의 형태를 넘어 우뚝 솟아오릅니다. 다음 턴 시작까지 크기를 대형으로 증가시킵니다. 장비는 함께 커지지만 제거 시 원래 크기로 돌아간다. @link[conditions.clumsy]{1} 상태가 된다. 공격 범위가 5피트 증가하며(초기 크기가 초소형일 경우 10피트 증가), 근접 공격 피해에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻는다. 원래 대형 이상일 경우 우뚝 선 위엄 효과는 적용되지 않는다.

name: Shed Tail

description.value:
Trigger You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}.

Requirements You have a fully grown tail.

You can shed a portion of your tail to escape. You cease being grabbed, then Stride without triggering any reactions from the creature that grabbed you. It takes 1 day for your tail to fully grow back. Until it does, you can't use your tail unarmed attack, and you take a –2 circumstance penalty on checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance}.

_desc_en:
Trigger You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}.

Requirements You have a fully grown tail.

You can shed a portion of your tail to escape. You cease being grabbed, then Stride without triggering any reactions from the creature that grabbed you. It takes 1 day for your tail to fully grow back. Until it does, you can't use your tail unarmed attack, and you take a –2 circumstance penalty on checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance}.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신은 @link[conditions.grabbed] 상태가 됩니다.

요구 사항 완전히 자란 꼬리를 가지고 있어야 합니다.

탈출하기 위해 꼬리 일부를 떨어뜨릴 수 있습니다. 붙잡힘 상태가 해제되며, 붙잡은 생물의 반응을 유발하지 않고 이동할 수 있습니다. 꼬리가 완전히 재생되기까지 1일이 소요됩니다. 재생되기 전까지는 비무장 공격으로 꼬리를 사용할 수 없으며, @link[actions.balance] 능력치 판정 시 -2 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Experienced Smuggler

description.value:
You often smuggle things past the authorities. When the GM rolls your Stealth check to see if a passive observer notices a small item you've concealed, the GM uses the number rolled or 10—whichever is higher—as the result of your die roll, adding it to your Stealth modifier to determine your Stealth check result. If you're a master in Stealth, the GM uses the number rolled or 15, and if you're legendary in Stealth, you automatically succeed at hiding a small concealed item from passive observers. This provides no benefits when a creature attempts a Perception check while actively searching you for hidden items.

PFS Note This feat allows you to Earn Income with Underworld Lore with tasks of your level -1 (instead of the normal level -2).

_desc_en:
You often smuggle things past the authorities. When the GM rolls your Stealth check to see if a passive observer notices a small item you've concealed, the GM uses the number rolled or 10—whichever is higher—as the result of your die roll, adding it to your Stealth modifier to determine your Stealth check result. If you're a master in Stealth, the GM uses the number rolled or 15, and if you're legendary in Stealth, you automatically succeed at hiding a small concealed item from passive observers. This provides no benefits when a creature attempts a Perception check while actively searching you for hidden items.

PFS Note This feat allows you to Earn Income with Underworld Lore with tasks of your level -1 (instead of the normal level -2).
_desc_ko:
당신은 종종 당국을 피해 물건을 밀수합니다. 수동 관찰자가 당신이 @link[conditions.concealed]한 소형 물품을 발견하는지 확인하기 위한 은신 판정에서 GM이 주사위를 굴릴 때, GM은 굴린 숫자 또는 10 중 더 높은 값을 당신의 주사위 결과로 사용하며, 이를 은신 수정자에 더해 은신 판정 결과를 결정합니다. 은신에 달인인 경우, GM은 굴린 숫자나 15를 사용하며, 은신에 전설적인 경우 소형 은닉 물품을 수동 관찰자로부터 숨기는 데 자동으로 성공한다. 이는 생물이 @link[conditions.hidden] 물품을 적극적으로 수색하며 지각 판정을 시도할 때는 이점을 제공하지 않는다.

PFS 참고 이 피트는 지하 세계 지식로 소득을 얻는 작업을 자신의 레벨 -1(일반적인 레벨 -2 대신)로 수행할 수 있게 합니다.

name: Swift Banishment

description.value:
Trigger You critically hit a creature that is not on its home plane.

Requirements You have a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.bay4AfSu2iIozNNW]{Banishment} spell prepared.

The force of your blow sends your victim back to its home plane. You expend a banishment spell you have prepared, affecting the creature you critically hit without needing to cast the spell. The creature can attempt to resist the spell as normal.

_desc_en:
Trigger You critically hit a creature that is not on its home plane.

Requirements You have a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.bay4AfSu2iIozNNW]{Banishment} spell prepared.

The force of your blow sends your victim back to its home plane. You expend a banishment spell you have prepared, affecting the creature you critically hit without needing to cast the spell. The creature can attempt to resist the spell as normal.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 본래 차원에 있지 않은 생물을 치명타로 명중시킨다.

요구 사항 당신은 @link[spells.banishment] 주문을 준비해 놓았다.

타격의 충격이 대상 생물을 고향 평면으로 되돌려 보낸다. 준비해 둔 추방 주문을 소모하여, 치명타를 입힌 생물에게 주문을 시전하지 않고도 효과를 발휘한다. 해당 생물은 평소와 같이 주문을 시도할 수 있다.

name: Focused Fire

description.value: You limit the blast of your shot for accuracy. You Launch your light mortar, targeting a single square. The blast is limited to the targeted square but deals one additional die of damage.

_desc_en: You limit the blast of your shot for accuracy. You Launch your light mortar, targeting a single square. The blast is limited to the targeted square but deals one additional die of damage.
_desc_ko: 당신은 정확도를 위해 사격의 폭발 범위를 제한합니다. 단일 칸을 목표로 경박격포를 발사합니다. 폭발은 목표 칸으로만 제한되지만 추가로 주사위 하나 분량의 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Counter Perform

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WILXkjU5Yq3yw10r]{Counter Performance} composition spell. This is a focus spell, granting you a focus pool or expanding that pool. You can Refocus by engaging your muse.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WILXkjU5Yq3yw10r]{Counter Performance} composition spell. This is a focus spell, granting you a focus pool or expanding that pool. You can Refocus by engaging your muse.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @link[spells.counter-performance] 작곡 주문을 얻습니다. 이는 포커스 주문으로, 포커스 풀을 부여하거나 확장시킵니다. 뮤즈와 교감함으로써 리포커스할 수 있습니다.

name: Hag Magic

description.value:
Through your heritage, you can replicate a hag's magic. Choose one common spell of 4th rank or lower from those available to a coven, including the spells contributed to a coven by a hag of your mother's type. You can cast this spell once per day as a 4th-rank occult innate spell.

Spells available to all covens are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X]{Augury}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLA0q0WOK2YPuJs6]{Charm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HXhWYJviWalN5tQ2]{Clairaudience}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zvKWclOZ7A53DObE]{Clairvoyance}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yM3KTTSAIHhyuP14]{Dream Message}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise}. The eligible spells granted by the most prominent types of hag are:

Cuckoo Hag @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Uqj344bezBq3ESdq]{Nightmare}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8Umt1AzYfFbC4fui]{Spellwrack}

Iron Hag @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gPvtmKMRpg9I9D7H]{Earthbind}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8Umt1AzYfFbC4fui]{Spellwrack}

Sea Hag @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2qGqa33E4GPUCbMV]{Humanoid Form}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.z2mfh3oPnfYqXflY]{Mariner's Curse}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Seaah9amXg70RKw2]{Water Walk}

Sweet Hag @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLA0q0WOK2YPuJs6]{Charm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.JyxTmqjYYn63V5LY]{Honeyed Words}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KSAEhNfZyXMO7Z7V]{Outcast's Curse}

_desc_ko:
혈통을 통해 마녀의 마법을 재현할 수 있습니다. 마녀회가 사용할 수 있는 4랭크 이하의 일반 주문 중 하나를 선택하세요. 여기에는 어머니 유형의 마녀가 마녀회에 기여한 주문도 포함됩니다. 이 주문을 하루에 한 번, (4th)랭크 오컬트 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

모든 마녀회가 사용할 수 있는 주문은 @link[spells.augury], @link[spells.charm], @link[spells.clairaudience], @link[spells.clairvoyance], @link[spells.dream-message], 그리고 @link[spells.illusory-disguise]입니다. 가장 저명한 유형의 마녀가 부여하는 적격 주문은 다음과 같습니다:

뻐꾸기 마녀 @link[spells.nightmare], @link[spells.spellwrack]

철의 해그 @link[spells.earthbind], @link[spells.spellwrack]

바다 마녀 @link[spells.humanoid-form], @link[spells.mariners-curse], @link[spells.water-walk]

달콤한 해그 @link[spells.charm], @link[spells.honeyed-words], @link[spells.outcasts-curse]

name: Trampling Charge

description.value:
Requirements You are riding a mount that has a melee Strike using its legs (claw, talons, hoof, etc.).

You urge your mount to charge into the fray, trampling all enemies who stand in your path. You command your mount to Stride up to double its Speed (or to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.H6v1VgowHaKHnVlG]{Burrow}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cS9nfDRGD83bNU1p]{Fly}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.c8TGiZ48ygoSPofx]{Swim}, if it has the corresponding movement type), moving through the spaces of any foes in your path up to one size smaller than your mount. Your mount deals the damage of one of its melee Strikes to each creature whose space you move through, with a basic Reflex save against your mount's Athletics DC. On a critical failure, the creature also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your next turn. Roll the damage only once. You can damage a given creature only once during this movement.
