@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.0UrqPv7XLDDRwZ13]{Pactbinder}
_desc_ko:
성공적인 협정을 맺기 위한 첫걸음은 그 배후의 마법을 이해하고 협상 기술을 갖추는 것이다. 또한 약속을 지키기 위해 자신을 마법으로 구속하는 방법을 배워 협상을 더 수월하게 할 수 있다는 점도 도움이 된다. 당신은 외교 숙련도를 훈련에서 전문가로 올리고, 다음 중 하나에서 숙련도를 올립니다: 주문학, 자연학, 오컬트, 종교학.

@link[actions.binding-vow]

name: Call of the Green Man

description.value: You can call forth nearby nature spirits to augment your body. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zCcfPS4y5SrZzU2x]{Plant Form} as a 5th-rank primal innate spell. When you reach 17th level, you can heighten the spell to 6th rank when you cast it.

_desc_en: You can call forth nearby nature spirits to augment your body. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zCcfPS4y5SrZzU2x]{Plant Form} as a 5th-rank primal innate spell. When you reach 17th level, you can heighten the spell to 6th rank when you cast it.
_desc_ko: 근처의 자연 정령을 불러내 몸을 강화할 수 있다. 하루에 한 번, @link[spells.plant-form]를 (5th)랭크 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있다. 17레벨에 도달하면 이 마법을 시전할 때 (6th)랭크으로 강화할 수 있다.

name: Rivethun Spiritual Attunement

description.value:
Access Rivethun Adherent background or you are a member of the Rivethun

Your time spent among the Rivethun has heightened your awareness of animate spirits around you, giving you the ability to sense them briefly. Once per day, you can use an action, which has the concentrate trait, to gain spiritsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 60 feet for 1 minute. You can sense the presence of spirits as described in the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.DYc108IqRBP9N9W6]{Soulsight} feat.

_desc_en:
Access Rivethun Adherent background or you are a member of the Rivethun

Your time spent among the Rivethun has heightened your awareness of animate spirits around you, giving you the ability to sense them briefly. Once per day, you can use an action, which has the concentrate trait, to gain spiritsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 60 feet for 1 minute. You can sense the presence of spirits as described in the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.DYc108IqRBP9N9W6]{Soulsight} feat.
_desc_ko:
접근 리베툰 신봉자 배경이거나 리베툰의 구성원인 경우

리베툰과 함께 보낸 시간은 주변의 생명체 영혼에 대한 당신의 인식을 강화, 잠시 동안 그들을 감지할 수 있는 능력을 부여합니다. 하루에 한 번, 집중 특성을 가진 행동을 사용하여 1분 동안 60피트 범위의 부정확한 감각으로 영혼 감지 능력을 얻을 수 있습니다. @link[feats.soulsight-bard] 피트에 설명된 대로 영혼의 존재를 감지할 수 있습니다.

name: Discreet Inquiry

description.value:
You are subtle in your efforts to learn the things you need to know.

When @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information}, you can hide the true subject of your inquiry among other topics of little interest to you without increasing the difficulty of the check or taking more time to Gather Information.

Anyone trying to Gather Information to determine if someone else was asking around about the topic in question must exceed your Deception DC or the normal DC to Gather Information about your inquiries, whichever is higher, or else they don't learn of your efforts.

_desc_en:
You are subtle in your efforts to learn the things you need to know.

When @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information}, you can hide the true subject of your inquiry among other topics of little interest to you without increasing the difficulty of the check or taking more time to Gather Information.

Anyone trying to Gather Information to determine if someone else was asking around about the topic in question must exceed your Deception DC or the normal DC to Gather Information about your inquiries, whichever is higher, or else they don't learn of your efforts.
_desc_ko:
당신은 필요한 정보를 알아내는 데 교묘한 방법을 사용합니다.

{정보 수집} 시, 관심 없는 다른 주제들 사이에 진짜 조사 대상을 숨길 수 있으며, 이 경우 판정 난이도가 증가하거나 정보 수집에 더 많은 시간이 소요되지 않습니다.

다른 사람이 해당 주제에 대해 주변에 물어봤는지 알아내려고 정보를 수집하려는 자는, 당신의 기만 DC 또는 당신의 탐문에 대한 정보 수집의 일반 DC 중 더 높은 쪽을 초과해야만 당신의 노력을 알아낼 수 있다. 그렇지 않으면 그들은 당신의 노력을 알지 못한다.

name: Interrogate

description.value:
You ask questions you know will be answered. Ask a question of a non-allied creature that you can see and have been conversing with. Attempt an Intimidation check against the creature's Will DC; if the creature is a member of the same religion as you, or is an undead or werecreature pretending to be a member of your faith, you get a +2 circumstance bonus on this check. The creature is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target must directly answer your question. It doesn't have to answer truthfully, but you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to your Perception DC if the creature attempts to Lie to you.

Success As critical success, but the circumstance bonus is +2.

Failure The target can refuse to answer you and becomes unfriendly if they weren't already unfriendly or hostile.

Critical Failure The target refuses to answer you and becomes hostile if they weren't already. You can't use Interrogate on the target again for 24 hours.

_desc_en:
You ask questions you know will be answered. Ask a question of a non-allied creature that you can see and have been conversing with. Attempt an Intimidation check against the creature's Will DC; if the creature is a member of the same religion as you, or is an undead or werecreature pretending to be a member of your faith, you get a +2 circumstance bonus on this check. The creature is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target must directly answer your question. It doesn't have to answer truthfully, but you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to your Perception DC if the creature attempts to Lie to you.

Success As critical success, but the circumstance bonus is +2.

Failure The target can refuse to answer you and becomes unfriendly if they weren't already unfriendly or hostile.

Critical Failure The target refuses to answer you and becomes hostile if they weren't already. You can't use Interrogate on the target again for 24 hours.
_desc_ko:
당신은 답을 알면서도 질문을 던진다. 당신이 보고 대화 중이던 비동맹 생물에게 질문을 던집니다. 해당 생물의 의지 DC에 대한 협박 판정을 시도하세요. 만약 그 생물이 당신과 같은 종교의 신도이거나, 당신의 신앙을 가장한 언데드 또는 변신 생물이라면, 이 검사에서 +2 상황 보너스를 받습니다. 그 생물은 이후 1시간 동안 일시적으로 면역 상태가 된다.

대성공 대상은 당신의 질문에 직접 답해야 한다. 진실을 말할 필요는 없으나, 해당 생물이 당신에게 거짓말을 시도할 경우 당신의 지각 DC에 +4 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

성공 대성공과 동일하나 상황 보너스는 +2입니다.

실패 대상은 답변을 거부할 수 있으며, 이미 적대적이거나 호전적이지 않았다면 비우호적으로 변합니다.

대실패 대상은 답변을 거부하며, 아직 적대적이지 않았다면 적대적으로 변합니다. 24시간 동안 대상에게 심문을 다시 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Elemental Explosion

description.value:
Requirements You're raging, and you haven't used this ability since you last Raged.

You unleash the energy roiling within you, exploding elemental matter in a @Template[emanation|distance:15]. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[(@actor.level)d8[@actor.flags.system.elementalInstinctDamage]|options:area-damage]{1d8 damage per level you possess}, with the same type you chose for elemental rage. Each creature in the area must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:barbarian|basic|options:area-effect]. Elemental Explosion gains the trait of your element.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're raging, and you haven't used this ability since you last Raged.

You unleash the energy roiling within you, exploding elemental matter in a @Template[emanation|distance:15]. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[(@actor.level)d8[@actor.flags.system.elementalInstinctDamage]|options:area-damage]{1d8 damage per level you possess}, with the same type you chose for elemental rage. Each creature in the area must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:barbarian|basic|options:area-effect]. Elemental Explosion gains the trait of your element.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 분노 상태이며, 마지막으로 분노한 이후 이 능력을 사용하지 않았습니다.

당신은 몸속에서 끓어오르는 에너지를 분출하여 15피트 범위 내의 원소 물질을 폭발시킵니다. 해당 영역 내의 모든 생물은 당신의 레벨당 1d8 피해를 입으며, 이는 원소 분노 시 선택한 원소 속성과 동일합니다. 영역 내 모든 생물은 기본 반사을 시도해야 한다. 원소 폭발은 당신의 원소 속성 특성을 획득한다.

name: Swimmer's Guidance

description.value: You're always ready to help those floundering in the water. Any ally who starts their turn within 30 feet of you and in the same body of water gains a 10-foot swim Speed until the end of their turn. If any ally affected by Swimmer's Guidance rolls a critical failure on an Athletics check to Swim, they get a failure instead.

_desc_en: You're always ready to help those floundering in the water. Any ally who starts their turn within 30 feet of you and in the same body of water gains a 10-foot swim Speed until the end of their turn. If any ally affected by Swimmer's Guidance rolls a critical failure on an Athletics check to Swim, they get a failure instead.
_desc_ko: 물속에서 허우적대는 이들을 돕기 위해 항상 준비되어 있습니다. 당신과 같은 수역 내에서 30피트 이내에 자신의 턴을 시작하는 모든 아군은 자신의 턴이 끝날 때까지 수영 속도가 10피트 증가합니다. 수영자의 안내 효과에 영향을 받는 아군이 수영 운동 판정에서 대실패를 굴릴 경우, 대신 실패로 처리됩니다.

name: Parry and Riposte

description.value:
Your parries and finishers allow you to riposte with the slightest provocation.

You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EfjoIuDmtUn4yiow]{Opportune Riposte} against an enemy who fails at a Strike against you (not just critically fails), provided you have both damaged that creature with a finisher on your last turn and currently have a circumstance bonus to AC from the parry weapon trait or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.WcY7H7mRiK2VDquV]{Extravagant Parry}.

_desc_en:
Your parries and finishers allow you to riposte with the slightest provocation.

You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EfjoIuDmtUn4yiow]{Opportune Riposte} against an enemy who fails at a Strike against you (not just critically fails), provided you have both damaged that creature with a finisher on your last turn and currently have a circumstance bonus to AC from the parry weapon trait or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.WcY7H7mRiK2VDquV]{Extravagant Parry}.
_desc_ko:
당신의 패리와 피니셔는 사소한 도발에도 리포스트를 가능하게 합니다.

당신은 @link[actions.opportune-riposte]를 사용할 수 있습니다. 이는 적의 공격이 실패했을 때(대실패가 아닌 경우도 포함) 적용되며, 다음 두 조건을 모두 충족해야 합니다: 지난 턴에 해당 생물에게 피니셔로 피해를 입혔고, 현재 패리 무기 특성이나 @link[feats.extravagant-parry]로 인해 AC에 상황 보너스를 받고 있을 때입니다.

name: Intensify Investiture

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Your bond to your invested items enables you to put more of yourself into them. If you next action is to activate an invested item that has a saving throw DC, you can use your thaumaturge class DC instead of the item's DC if it is higher.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Your bond to your invested items enables you to put more of yourself into them. If you next action is to activate an invested item that has a saving throw DC, you can use your thaumaturge class DC instead of the item's DC if it is higher.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 10분마다 1회

투입된 아이템과의 유대감으로 인해 그 안에 더 많은 자신을 담을 수 있습니다. 다음 행동이 내성 굴림 DC가 있는 투입된 아이템을 활성화하는 것이라면, 해당 아이템의 DC보다 높을 경우 자신의 쏘마터지 직업 DC를 대신 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Wolf Drag

description.value:
Requirements You are in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.AN9jY1JVcU20Qdw6]{Wolf Stance}

You rip your enemy off their feet.

Make a wolf jaw Strike. Your wolf jaw gains the fatal d12 trait for this Strike, and if the attack succeeds, you knock the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.AN9jY1JVcU20Qdw6]{Wolf Stance}

You rip your enemy off their feet.

Make a wolf jaw Strike. Your wolf jaw gains the fatal d12 trait for this Strike, and if the attack succeeds, you knock the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 @link[feats.wolf-stance]

상태여야 합니다.

당신은 적을 발밑에서 뜯어냅니다.

늑대 턱 공격을 수행합니다. 이 공격 시 늑대 턱은 치명적인 d12 특성을 얻으며, 공격이 성공하면 대상은 @link[conditions.prone] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Unbound Leaper

description.value:
Your jumping prowess is unmatched. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} up to 30 feet in any direction without touching the ground and without requiring an Athletics check; when doing so, you must land on a space of solid ground within 30 feet of you, or else you fall after using your next action. You can exceed your normal Speed while Leaping.

Special If you have the Fantastic Leaps feat, the total distance you can Leap horizontally is 40 feet, and the total distance you can Leap vertically is 35 feet.

_desc_en:
Your jumping prowess is unmatched. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} up to 30 feet in any direction without touching the ground and without requiring an Athletics check; when doing so, you must land on a space of solid ground within 30 feet of you, or else you fall after using your next action. You can exceed your normal Speed while Leaping.

Special If you have the Fantastic Leaps feat, the total distance you can Leap horizontally is 40 feet, and the total distance you can Leap vertically is 35 feet.
_desc_ko:
당신의 점프 능력은 타의 추종을 불허합니다. @link[actions.leap]을 통해 지면에 닿지 않고 운동 판정 없이 어느 방향으로든 최대 30피트까지 도약할 수 있습니다. 이때 반드시 30피트 이내의 단단한 지면에 착지해야 하며, 그렇지 않으면 다음 행동을 사용한 후 추락합니다. 도약 시 정상 이동 속도를 초과할 수 있습니다.

특수 환상적 도약 재주를 보유한 경우, 수평 도약 총 거리는 40피트, 수직 도약 총 거리는 35피트입니다.

name: Basic Devotion

description.value: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level champion feat.

_desc_en: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level champion feat.
_desc_ko: 1레벨 또는 2레벨 챔피언 피트를 획득합니다.

name: Ignite the Sun

description.value:
The fires of creation become yours to control. You create a miniature sun in a @Template[burst|distance:5] within 500 feet. A creature takes @Damage[7d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage any time it's in the miniature sun, with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. A creature can take this damage no more than once per round. The sun sheds bright light in a @Template[emanation|distance:500] (and dim light for another 500 feet); this is sunlight for creatures with a particular vulnerability to sunlight.

The sun lasts until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it up to 1 minute. The first time you Sustain the impulse each round, you can choose to increase the size of the sun's burst by 5 feet, then make it Fly up to 30 feet. The sun can move through creatures, damaging them as described above.

The sun continually channels fire into you and your allies. You and each of your allies within the sun's light deal an additional @Damage[1d6[fire]] damage with all Strikes, spells that deal fire damage, and impulses that deal fire damage (except for Ignite the Sun itself). These aren't cumulative with multiple suns.

_desc_en:
The fires of creation become yours to control. You create a miniature sun in a @Template[burst|distance:5] within 500 feet. A creature takes @Damage[7d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage any time it's in the miniature sun, with a @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. A creature can take this damage no more than once per round. The sun sheds bright light in a @Template[emanation|distance:500] (and dim light for another 500 feet); this is sunlight for creatures with a particular vulnerability to sunlight.

The sun lasts until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it up to 1 minute. The first time you Sustain the impulse each round, you can choose to increase the size of the sun's burst by 5 feet, then make it Fly up to 30 feet. The sun can move through creatures, damaging them as described above.

The sun continually channels fire into you and your allies. You and each of your allies within the sun's light deal an additional @Damage[1d6[fire]] damage with all Strikes, spells that deal fire damage, and impulses that deal fire damage (except for Ignite the Sun itself). These aren't cumulative with multiple suns.
_desc_ko:
창조의 불꽃을 마음대로 다스릴 수 있게 된다. 500피트 이내의 5피트에 소형 태양을 생성합니다. 생물이 소형 태양 안에 있을 때마다 7d6 화염의 피해를 입으며, 당신의 클래스 DC에 대한 기본 반사 내성에 성공해야 합니다. 생물은 라운드당 한 번만 이 피해를 입을 수 있다. 태양은 500피트 범위 내에 밝은 빛을, 추가로 500피트 범위 내에 희미한 빛을 비춘다. 이는 태양광에 대한 생물체의 약점을 나타낸다.

태양은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 지속되나, 최대 1분까지 유지할 수 있습니다. 매 라운드 처음 유지할 때 태양 임펄스를 5피트 증가시키고 최대 30피트 높이까지 상승시킬 수 있습니다. 태양은 생물체를 관통하며 위와 같은 피해를 입힙니다.

태양은 지속적으로 당신과 아군에게 불을 전달합니다. 태양의 빛 안에 있는 당신과 각 아군은 모든 공격, 화염 피해를 주는 주문, 화염 피해를 주는 임펄스(태양 점화 자체는 제외)로 추가 1d6 화염의 피해를 줍니다. 이는 여러 태양과 중첩되지 않습니다.

name: Flinging Blow

description.value:
You take a moment to center yourself, then unleash a powerful blow that sends your target tumbling away.

Make an unarmed Strike. If you hit, the target must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or be pushed up to 10 feet directly away from you (or 20 feet, on a critical failure) and fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

If another creature or physical object would prevent this movement, both your target and the blocking creature or object take @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] damage per 5 feet of movement that was prevented.

_desc_en:
You take a moment to center yourself, then unleash a powerful blow that sends your target tumbling away.

Make an unarmed Strike. If you hit, the target must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or be pushed up to 10 feet directly away from you (or 20 feet, on a critical failure) and fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

If another creature or physical object would prevent this movement, both your target and the blocking creature or object take @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] damage per 5 feet of movement that was prevented.
_desc_ko:
잠시 중심을 잡은 뒤, 강력한 일격을 날려 대상을 굴러가게 만든다.

비무장 공격을 시도한다. 명중 시, 대상은 네 직업 난이도(DC)에 대한 인내 내성에 성공해야 한다. 실패하면 최대 10피트(대실패 시 20피트)까지 네 쪽에서 멀리 밀려나며 @link[conditions.prone]가 된다.

다른 생물이나 물리적 장애물이 이 이동을 방해할 경우, 대상과 방해하는 생물 또는 장애물 모두 방해당한 이동 거리 5피트당 1d6 타격의 피해를 입는다.

name: Claws of the Dragon

description.value:
Your fingernails grow into razor-sharp claws, and scales speckle your fingers, hands, and wrists. Your claws are agile, finesse unarmed attacks that deal 1d6 slashing damage and are in the brawling weapon group.

If you're a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.ZHabYxSgYK0XbjhM]{Draconic} sorcerer, when you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.K8vvrOgW4bGakXxm]{Dragon Claws}, increase the spell's slashing damage die from d4 to d6 and increase the resistance to 10 at 1st level, 15 at 5th level, and 20 at 9th level.

_desc_en:
Your fingernails grow into razor-sharp claws, and scales speckle your fingers, hands, and wrists. Your claws are agile, finesse unarmed attacks that deal 1d6 slashing damage and are in the brawling weapon group.

If you're a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.ZHabYxSgYK0XbjhM]{Draconic} sorcerer, when you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.K8vvrOgW4bGakXxm]{Dragon Claws}, increase the spell's slashing damage die from d4 to d6 and increase the resistance to 10 at 1st level, 15 at 5th level, and 20 at 9th level.
_desc_ko:
네 손톱이 날카로운 발톱으로 변하고, 손가락과 손, 손목에 비늘이 돋아난다. 네 발톱은 기민한 비무장 공격으로 1d6 베기 피해를 입히며, 싸움용 무기 그룹에 속한다.

@link[feats.bloodline-draconic] 소서러라면, @link[spells.flurry-of-claws]을 시전할 때, 1레벨에서는 마법의 베기 피해 주사위를 d4에서 d6으로 증가시키고 저항력을 10으로, (5th)레벨에서는 15로, (9th)레벨에서는 20으로 증가시킵니다.

name: Tempo Shift

description.value:
Trigger You Delay.

Frequency once per hour

You are always ready to embrace to a change in tempo and adapt your actions to take advantage of unforeseen developments. When you return to the initiative order after you Delay, you do so in an unpredictable way. All enemies are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you until the start of your next turn, and you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for the current round but can only use the extra action to Stride or Strike.

_desc_en:
Trigger You Delay.

Frequency once per hour

You are always ready to embrace to a change in tempo and adapt your actions to take advantage of unforeseen developments. When you return to the initiative order after you Delay, you do so in an unpredictable way. All enemies are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you until the start of your next turn, and you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for the current round but can only use the extra action to Stride or Strike.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신이 지연합니다.

빈도 시간당 한 번

당신은 항상 변화하는 속도에 적응할 준비가 되어 있으며, 예상치 못한 상황에 맞춰 행동을 조정하여 이점을 취합니다. 지연 후 이니셔티브 순서를 되찾을 때, 당신은 예측 불가능한 방식으로 행동합니다. 모든 적들은 다음 턴 시작까지 당신에게 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 되며, 당신은 현재 라운드 동안 @link[conditions.quickened]가 됩니다. 다만 추가 행동은 이동이나 공격에만 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Cloaking Pulse

description.value: Your ostilli can emit illusion magic to mask your position, granting you the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GKIKJNInDev72qai]{Drape Ambient Magic} action.

_desc_en: Your ostilli can emit illusion magic to mask your position, granting you the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GKIKJNInDev72qai]{Drape Ambient Magic} action.
_desc_ko: 오스티리가 환상 마법을 발산하여 당신의 위치를 가릴 수 있으며, 이로 인해 @link[actions.drape-ambient-magic] 행동을 부여받습니다.

name: Captivating Curiosity

description.value: You can snare the attentions of onlookers with your unique appearance. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IihxWhRfpsBgQ5jS]{Enthrall} as a 3rd-rank occult innate spell once per day.

_desc_en: You can snare the attentions of onlookers with your unique appearance. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IihxWhRfpsBgQ5jS]{Enthrall} as a 3rd-rank occult innate spell once per day.
_desc_ko: 당신은 독특한 외모로 구경꾼들의 시선을 사로잡을 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, (3rd) 랭크 오컬트 선천적 주문으로 @link[spells.enthrall]을 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Jotunborn Grappler

description.value: Wrestling is a common pastime for jotunborn, and you've done your fair share. You are trained in Athletics. If you would automatically become trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KxaYlC50zzHysJj8]{Titan Wrestler} skill feat.

_desc_ko: 레슬링은 요툰본족에게 흔한 오락이며, 당신도 상당한 경험을 쌓았습니다. 당신은 운동 능력에 숙련되어 있습니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 운동 능력에 자동으로 숙련되는 경우, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다. 또한 @link[feats.titan-wrestler] 기술 피트를 얻습니다.

name: Talismanic Sage

description.value: Normally, affixing more than one talisman to an item causes the talismans to be suppressed, but when you Affix a Talisman, you can specially treat one item you're working on, allowing it to have two active talismans at once. This special treatment ends if you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.UAaQk93a30nx0nYY]{Affix a Talisman} to treat a new item for this ability.

This special treatment ends if you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.UAaQk93a30nx0nYY]{Affix a Talisman} to treat a new item for this ability.
_desc_ko: 일반적으로 한 아이템에 두 개 이상의 부적을 부착하면 부적들이 억제되지만, 당신이 부적을 부착할 때 작업 중인 아이템 하나를 특별히 처리하여 동시에 두 개의 활성 부적을 가질 수 있게 할 수 있습니다. 이 특전은 @link[actions.affix-a-talisman]으로 새로운 아이템에 이 능력을 적용할 경우 종료됩니다.

name: For Love, For Lightning

description.value:
Access A character who performs a specialized mission for Clarethe Iomedar has access to this option.

Rumors suggest this technique was pioneered by knights who undertook missions for Clarethe Iomedar at the half-moon, but many Crimson Reclaimers have since mastered it. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.mtxMpGWpwwWSbySj]{For Love, For Lightning} focus spell. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can regain using the Refocus activity to recite the Crimson Oath and meditate on its teachings; if you already have a focus pool, increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1. Your knight reclaimant focus spells are divine spells; when you gain this feat, you become trained in divine spell attacks and spell DCs. Charisma is the key spellcasting ability for knight reclaimant focus spells.

_desc_ko:
접근 클라레테 이오메다르를 위해 특수 임무를 수행하는 캐릭터는 이 옵션을 사용할 수 있습니다.

전설에 따르면 이 기술은 반달에서 클라레테 이오메다르의 임무를 수행한 기사들이 최초로 개발했으나, 이후 수많은 크림슨 리클레이머들이 이를 마스터했다고 한다. 당신은 @link[spells.for-love-for-lightning] 포커스 주문을 습득한다. 아직 포커스 풀이 없다면, 1 포커스 포인트의 포커스 풀을 얻습니다. 이 포커스 포인트는 '크림슨 맹세'를 암송하고 그 가르침에 명상하는 재집중 활동을 통해 회복할 수 있습니다. 이미 포커스 풀이 있다면, 포커스 풀의 포커스 포인트 수를 1 증가시킵니다. 기사 회수자의 포커스 주문은 신성 주문입니다. 이 재주를 획득하면 신성 주문 공격과 주문 난이도(DC)에 숙련됩니다. 매력는 기사 재수련자의 포커스 주문을 시전하는 데 핵심 능력치입니다.

name: Pride Hunter

description.value: You avoid the attention of creatures focused on your allies. You can use lesser cover from your allies to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}.

_desc_en: You avoid the attention of creatures focused on your allies. You can use lesser cover from your allies to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}.
_desc_ko: 동료에게 포커스를 받은 생물의 주의를 피할 수 있습니다. 동료가 제공하는 반엄폐를 이용해 @link[actions.hide]할 수 있습니다.

name: Advanced Domain

description.value:
Your prayers have unlocked deeper secrets of your deity's domain. You gain an advanced domain spell from one of your domains for which you have an initial domain spell.

Special You can select this feat multiple times. Each time, you must select a different advanced domain spell.

_desc_ko:
당신의 기도는 신의 영역에 대한 더 깊은 비밀을 깨우쳤습니다. 초기 영역 주문을 가진 영역 중 하나에서 고급 영역 주문을 하나 얻습니다.

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 매번 다른 고급 영역 주문을 선택해야 합니다.

name: Trick Magic Item

description.value:
You examine a magic item you normally couldn't use in an effort to fool it and activate it temporarily. For example, this might allow a fighter to cast a spell from a wand or allow a wizard to cast a spell that's not on the arcane list using a scroll. You must know what activating the item does, or you can't attempt to trick it.

Attempt a check using the skill matching the item's magic tradition, or matching a tradition that has the spell on its list, if you're trying to cast a spell from the item. The relevant skills are @Check[arcana] for arcane, @Check[nature] for primal, @Check[occultism] for occult, @Check[religion] for divine, or any of the four for an item that has the magical trait and not a tradition trait. The GM determines the DC based on the item's level (possibly adjusted depending on the item or situation).

If you activate a magic item that requires a spell attack modifier or spell DC and you don't have proficiency in the relevant statistic, use your level as your proficiency bonus and the highest of your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifiers. If you're a master in the appropriate skill for the item's tradition, you instead use the trained proficiency bonus; if you're legendary, you instead use the expert proficiency bonus.

Success For the rest of the current turn, you can spend actions to activate the item as if you could normally use it.

Failure You can't use the item or try to trick it again this turn, but you can try again on subsequent turns.

Critical Failure You can't use the item, and you can't try to trick it again until your next daily preparations.

_desc_ko:
평소에는 사용할 수 없는 마법 아이템을 속여 일시적으로 작동시키려 시도합니다. 예를 들어, 파이터가 지팡이로 주문을 시전하거나, 위자드가 아케인 목록에 없는 주문을 두루마리로 시전하는 것이 가능해질 수 있습니다. 아이템 활성화 시 발생하는 효과를 반드시 알고 있어야 속임수를 시도할 수 있다.

아이템의 마법 전통에 맞는 기술로, 또는 아이템의 주문 목록에 포함된 전통에 맞는 기술로 검사를 시도하십시오. 관련 스킬은 주문학(아케인), 자연학(프라이멀), 오컬티즘(오컬트), 종교학(신성)이며, 전통 속성이 아닌 마법 속성을 가진 아이템의 경우 네 가지 중 하나를 선택합니다. GM은 아이템의 레벨을 기준으로 DC를 결정합니다(아이템이나 상황에 따라 조정될 수 있음).

주문 공격 수정치나 주문 DC 검사가 필요한 마법 아이템을 활성화할 때, 해당 능력치 숙련도가 없다면 레벨을 숙련 보너스로 사용하고 지능, 지혜, 매력 중 가장 높은 능력치 수정자를 적용합니다. 해당 아이템 전통에 필요한 기술의 달인라면 숙련 숙련 보너스를 사용하며, 전설적 달인라면 전문가 숙련 보너스를 사용합니다.

성공 현재 턴이 끝날 때까지, 평소처럼 아이템을 사용할 수 있는 것처럼 행동을 소비하여 아이템을 활성화할 수 있습니다.

실패 이번 턴에는 아이템을 사용하거나 속이려 시도할 수 없지만, 이후 턴에 다시 시도할 수 있습니다.

대실패 해당 아이템을 사용할 수 없으며, 다음 일일 준비 시간까지 다시 속이려 시도할 수 없습니다.

name: Twirling Strike

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a fan.

Your fans, one raised up alongside your head and the other alongside your hip, become a blur as you twirl across the battlefield. Attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} an enemy's space using [[/act tumble-through skill=performance]]{Performance}; on a success, you can make a melee Strike against the enemy with a fan you're wielding at any point during the movement. On a critical success, the enemy is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against this attack.

_desc_ko:
요구 사항 부채를 휘두르고 있어야 합니다.

한 손에는 머리 옆으로, 다른 손에는 허리 옆으로 부채를 든 채 전장을 가로질러 회전하며 움직입니다. 공연으로 적의 공간을 @link[actions.tumble-through]하려 시도합니다. 성공 시, 이동 중 언제든지 휘두르는 부채로 적에게 근접 공격을 가할 수 있습니다. 대성공 시, 이 공격에 대해 적의 방어가 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 된다.

name: Trapsmith Dedication

description.value:
You use glimmering gears and gnashing mechanisms to manufacture snares using specialized parts. Your snares include clockwork and steam-powered cogwheels and gears, and their gush of steam can hinder those you ensnare. If you choose to construct a snare using gears and a creature fails their saving throw against the snare, all creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to that creature for 1 round, as a burst of steam obscures its vision.

Special You can select the dedication feat for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.lc3iBCamQ8jvr9dp]{Trapsmith} archetype even if you haven't yet gained three feats from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.G9Fzy5ZK4KtAmcFb]{Snarecrafter} archetype.

_desc_ko:
반짝이는 기어와 으르렁거리는 장치를 이용해 특수 부품으로 올가미를 제작합니다. 당신의 올가미에는 시계 장치와 증기 동력 톱니바퀴 및 기어가 포함되며, 뿜어져 나오는 증기는 걸려든 자들을 방해할 수 있습니다. 기어를 사용해 덫을 제작하기로 선택하고 생물이 덫에 대한 내성 굴림에서 실패하면, 증기 분출이 시야를 가려 해당 생물에게 1라운드 동안 모든 생물이 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태가 됩니다.

특수 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.lc3iBCamQ8jvr9dp]{함정 제작자} 아키타입의 헌신 재주를 선택할 수 있으며, 이는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.G9Fzy5ZK4KtAmcFb]{덫 제작자} 아키타입에서 세 가지 피트를 아직 획득하지 않았더라도 가능합니다.

name: Wilderness Born

description.value:
You're at home in the wilderness and easily disappear into it. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} in natural terrain, and a +1 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.fJImDBQfqfjKJOhk]{Sense Direction} in natural terrain. While in natural terrain, you're always considered to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SB7cMECVtE06kByk]{Covering Tracks}, even if you chose a different activity in exploration mode.

Special This feat gains the trait for your ancestry.

name: Like a Roach

description.value: Living with the bare necessities isn't terribly hard for someone who has defied death, and like a cockroach, you always know how to survive. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{Subsist} during downtime, the DC for your skill check is reduced by 2. You don't need a minimum proficiency rank to Subsist in unusual environments, nor do you take a –5 penalty if you Subsist after 8 hours or less of exploration.

publication.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

_desc_en: Living with the bare necessities isn't terribly hard for someone who has defied death, and like a cockroach, you always know how to survive. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{Subsist} during downtime, the DC for your skill check is reduced by 2. You don't need a minimum proficiency rank to Subsist in unusual environments, nor do you take a –5 penalty if you Subsist after 8 hours or less of exploration.
_desc_ko: 죽음을 거스른 자에게 최소한의 필수품만으로 살아가는 것은 그리 어렵지 않다. 바퀴벌레처럼, 당신은 항상 생존하는 법을 알고 있다. 다운타임에 @link[actions.subsist]할 때, 기술 판정 DC가 2 감소합니다. 특이한 환경에서 생존할 때 최소 숙련도 등급이 필요하지 않으며, 8시간 이하 탐사 후 생존해도 -5 페널티를 받지 않습니다.

name: Bardic Lore

description.value: Your studies make you informed on every subject. You are trained in Bardic Lore, a special Lore skill that can be used only to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, but on any topic. If you have legendary proficiency in Occultism, you gain expert proficiency in Bardic Lore, but you can't increase your proficiency rank in Bardic Lore by any other means.

_desc_en: Your studies make you informed on every subject. You are trained in Bardic Lore, a special Lore skill that can be used only to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, but on any topic. If you have legendary proficiency in Occultism, you gain expert proficiency in Bardic Lore, but you can't increase your proficiency rank in Bardic Lore by any other means.
_desc_ko: 당신의 연구는 모든 주제에 대해 통달하게 합니다. 당신은 바드적 지식에 숙련되어 있습니다. 이는 @link[actions.recall-knowledge]에만 사용할 수 있는 특별한 지식 기술이지만, 어떤 주제든 가능합니다. 오컬트에 전설적인 숙련도를 보유한 경우, 바드적 지식에 전문가 숙련도를 얻지만, 다른 어떤 방법으로도 바드적 지식 숙련도 등급을 올릴 수 없습니다.

name: Unwavering Mien

description.value:
Your mystic control and meditations allow you to resist external influences upon your consciousness. Whenever you are affected by a mental effect that lasts at least 2 rounds, you can reduce the duration by 1 round.

You still require natural sleep, but you treat your saving throws against effects that would cause you to fall asleep as one degree of success better. This protects only against sleep effects, not against other forms of falling @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.

_desc_en:
Your mystic control and meditations allow you to resist external influences upon your consciousness. Whenever you are affected by a mental effect that lasts at least 2 rounds, you can reduce the duration by 1 round.

You still require natural sleep, but you treat your saving throws against effects that would cause you to fall asleep as one degree of success better. This protects only against sleep effects, not against other forms of falling @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.
_desc_ko:
신비한 통제력과 명상 덕분에 의식에 대한 외부 영향을 저항할 수 있습니다. 최소 2라운드 지속되는 정신 효과에 영향을 받을 때마다 지속 시간을 1라운드 줄일 수 있습니다.

자연적인 수면은 여전히 필요하지만, 잠들게 하는 효과에 대한 내성 굴림의 성공 확률이 1단계 상승합니다. 이는 수면 효과에만 적용되며, 다른 형태의 @link[conditions.unconscious]에는 적용되지 않습니다.

name: Scatter Swarm

description.value: Your patron reaches through your familiar to magically disperse a group of smaller threats. A swarm that shares a space with your familiar takes damage equal to the swarm's weakness to area damage. You choose whether this is acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage, and this action gains the trait of the damage type you choose.

_desc_en: Your patron reaches through your familiar to magically disperse a group of smaller threats. A swarm that shares a space with your familiar takes damage equal to the swarm's weakness to area damage. You choose whether this is acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage, and this action gains the trait of the damage type you choose.
_desc_ko: 당신의 후원자가 당신의 패밀리어 존재를 통해 마법으로 작은 위협들을 흩어지게 합니다. 당신의 패밀리어 존재와 공간을 공유하는 무리는 그 무리의 영역 피해에 대한 약점에 해당하는 피해를 입습니다. 이 피해가 산성, 냉기, 전기, 또는 화염 피해 중 어느 것일지는 당신이 선택하며, 이 행동은 당신이 선택한 피해 유형의 특성을 얻습니다.

name: Emergency Targe

description.value:
Trigger An enemy hits you with a melee Strike or a melee spell attack roll, or you fail a save against an enemy's spell.

Requirements You are wielding a shield or have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TVKNbcgTee19PXZR]{Shield} spell prepared.

You immediately Raise a Shield or cast shield. The circumstance bonus applies to your defenses when determining the outcome of the triggering attack or spell.

_desc_en:
Trigger An enemy hits you with a melee Strike or a melee spell attack roll, or you fail a save against an enemy's spell.

Requirements You are wielding a shield or have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TVKNbcgTee19PXZR]{Shield} spell prepared.

You immediately Raise a Shield or cast shield. The circumstance bonus applies to your defenses when determining the outcome of the triggering attack or spell.
_desc_ko:
발동 적의 근접 공격이나 근접 주문 명중 굴림에 맞거나, 적의 주문에 대한 내성에 실패했을 때.

요구 사항 방패를 들고 있거나 @link[spells.shield] 주문을 준비한 상태여야 합니다.

당신은 즉시 방패를 들어 올리거나 방패를 시전합니다. 발동 공격이나 주문의 결과를 결정할 때 방어력에 상황 보너스가 적용됩니다.

name: Emboldened with Glorious Purpose

description.value:
Communing with powerful spirits of the world and other powers far greater than yourself fills your heart with purpose and inspires you to strive for greater accomplishments. Whenever you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.8cy4XIaSoL3UtpFq]{Consult the Spirits}, you gain a +1 status bonus to Will saving throws until the next time you make your daily preparations. This bonus increases to +2 against emotion and fear effects.

In addition, until the next time you make your daily preparations, you can do each of the following once.

  • Roll a Will save twice and use the better result.
  • Roll an attack roll twice and use the better result.
  • Roll a skill check twice and use the better result; this skill check must be made with the skill that the spirits blessed during Consult the Spirits.

_desc_en:
Communing with powerful spirits of the world and other powers far greater than yourself fills your heart with purpose and inspires you to strive for greater accomplishments. Whenever you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.8cy4XIaSoL3UtpFq]{Consult the Spirits}, you gain a +1 status bonus to Will saving throws until the next time you make your daily preparations. This bonus increases to +2 against emotion and fear effects.

In addition, until the next time you make your daily preparations, you can do each of the following once.

  • Roll a Will save twice and use the better result.
  • Roll an attack roll twice and use the better result.
  • Roll a skill check twice and use the better result; this skill check must be made with the skill that the spirits blessed during Consult the Spirits.
_desc_ko:
세상의 강력한 영혼들과 자신보다 훨씬 위대한 다른 힘들과 교감하며, 당신의 마음은 목적의식으로 가득 차고 더 큰 성취를 위해 노력하도록 고무됩니다. 당신이 @link[feats.consult-the-spirits-rivethun-emissary]할 때마다, 다음 일일 준비를 할 때까지 내성 굴림에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 보너스는 감정 및 공포 효과에 대해 +2로 증가한다.

또한, 다음 일일 준비를 할 때까지 다음 각 행동을 한 번씩 수행할 수 있다.

  • 의지 내성을 두 번 굴리고 더 좋은 결과를 사용합니다.
  • 명중 굴림을 두 번 굴리고 더 좋은 결과를 사용합니다.
  • 기술 판정을 두 번 굴리고 더 좋은 결과를 사용합니다; 이 기술 판정은 '영혼과 상담' 시 영혼들이 축복한 기술로 수행해야 합니다.

name: Folk Healer

description.value: Your community recognizes you as a shaman or other animist, a status you obtained through lineage, apprenticeship, or a supernatural event. You're trained in Medicine and Occultism. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Medicine checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TC7OcDa7JlWbqMaN]{Treat Disease}.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your community recognizes you as a shaman or other animist, a status you obtained through lineage, apprenticeship, or a supernatural event. You're trained in Medicine and Occultism. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Medicine checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TC7OcDa7JlWbqMaN]{Treat Disease}.
_desc_ko: 당신의 공동체는 당신을 샤먼이나 다른 애니미스트로 인정합니다. 이 지위는 혈통, 수련, 또는 초자연적 사건을 통해 얻었습니다. 당신은 의술과 오컬트에 숙련되어 있습니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 해당 기술 중 하나를 자동으로 숙련하게 되는 경우, 대신 선택한 기술 하나를 숙련하게 됩니다. @link[actions.treat-wounds]와 @link[actions.treat-disease]에 대한 의술 판정 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Dismal Harvest

description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger Your last action was a Mobbing Assault made by your horde that reduced at least one living creature to 0 Hit Points.

The expiring breaths of your enemies fuel your power. You gain 15 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute. The temporary Hit Points you gain increase by 5 at 10th level and every 2 levels thereafter.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per round

Trigger Your last action was a Mobbing Assault made by your horde that reduced at least one living creature to 0 Hit Points.

The expiring breaths of your enemies fuel your power. You gain 15 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute. The temporary Hit Points you gain increase by 5 at 10th level and every 2 levels thereafter.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 라운드당 1회

발동 조건 당신의 마지막 행동이 무리가 수행한 집단 공격으로 적어도 한 생명체의 HP를 0으로 감소시켰을 때.

적들의 마지막 숨결이 당신의 힘을 북돋운다. 1분 동안 지속되는 임시 HP 15를 얻는다. 10레벨 달성 시, 그리고 이후 2레벨마다 획득하는 임시 HP가 5씩 증가한다.

name: Graveshift

description.value:
Frequency Once per day

Requirements You are standing at the bottom of an open grave adjacent to up to four willing target creatures or objects roughly the size of a creature.

The maggots inhabiting your body impart you with the knowledge to travel from grave to grave, drawing upon the mystical power of the labyrinthine network of magical warrens and tunnels that connect Everglut to the Material Plane. You can spend 10 minutes channeling this power to transport you and all target creatures or objects that are inside the grave you are standing in to a chosen grave you are aware of (unoccupied or occupied) within 100 miles. When you target an occupied or filled grave, you and all transported creatures and objects appear scattered aboveground around the targeted grave (or belowground in adjacent tunnels or passageways if available).

_desc_en:
Frequency Once per day

Requirements You are standing at the bottom of an open grave adjacent to up to four willing target creatures or objects roughly the size of a creature.

The maggots inhabiting your body impart you with the knowledge to travel from grave to grave, drawing upon the mystical power of the labyrinthine network of magical warrens and tunnels that connect Everglut to the Material Plane. You can spend 10 minutes channeling this power to transport you and all target creatures or objects that are inside the grave you are standing in to a chosen grave you are aware of (unoccupied or occupied) within 100 miles. When you target an occupied or filled grave, you and all transported creatures and objects appear scattered aboveground around the targeted grave (or belowground in adjacent tunnels or passageways if available).
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

요구 사항 최대 4마리의 자발적인 대상 생물 또는 생물 크기의 물체가 인접한 열린 무덤 바닥에 서 있어야 합니다.

당신의 몸에 서식하는 구더기들은 에버글럿과 물질계를 연결하는 미로 같은 마법 굴과 터널 네트워크의 신비한 힘을 끌어내어 무덤에서 무덤으로 이동하는 지식을 부여합니다. 10분 동안 이 힘을 집중하여, 자신이 서 있는 무덤 안에 있는 모든 대상 생물이나 물체와 함께 100마일 이내에 있는 자신이 알고 있는 선택한 무덤(비어 있거나 채워져 있음)으로 이동할 수 있다. 채워진 무덤을 대상으로 할 경우, 이동한 모든 생물과 물체는 대상 무덤 주변 지상(또는 가능한 경우 인접한 지하 터널이나 통로)에 흩어져 나타난다.

name: Bullet Dancer Burn

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a simple combination weapon or an attached bayonet or reinforced stock.

The fiery blaze of your weapon shocks your enemies. While in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SMF1hTWPHtmlS8Cd]{Bullet Dancer Stance}, when you successfully Strike an opponent with the melee form of a combination weapon or a bayonet or reinforced stock attached to a simple firearm, the next ranged Strike you make against that opponent doesn't trigger reactions that would trigger on a ranged attack, such as Reactive Strike. While in Bullet Dancer Stance, when you make a successful ranged Strike against an opponent within your melee reach using a firearm, the next melee attack against that opponent with that weapon or a weapon attached to it deals an additional 1 fire damage and 1 persistent fire damage per weapon damage die of the attached firearm.

The benefit on your next Strike from either use of Bullet Dancer Burn is lost if not used by the end of your next turn.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a simple combination weapon or an attached bayonet or reinforced stock.

The fiery blaze of your weapon shocks your enemies. While in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SMF1hTWPHtmlS8Cd]{Bullet Dancer Stance}, when you successfully Strike an opponent with the melee form of a combination weapon or a bayonet or reinforced stock attached to a simple firearm, the next ranged Strike you make against that opponent doesn't trigger reactions that would trigger on a ranged attack, such as Reactive Strike. While in Bullet Dancer Stance, when you make a successful ranged Strike against an opponent within your melee reach using a firearm, the next melee attack against that opponent with that weapon or a weapon attached to it deals an additional 1 fire damage and 1 persistent fire damage per weapon damage die of the attached firearm.

The benefit on your next Strike from either use of Bullet Dancer Burn is lost if not used by the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 단순 복합 무기, 부착형 총검 또는 강화형 총열을 장착하고 있어야 합니다.

당신의 무기에서 뿜어져 나오는 불꽃이 적들을 충격에 빠뜨립니다. @link[actions.bullet-dancer-stance] 상태에서 복합 무기의 근접 형태나 단순 화기에 부착된 총검 또는 강화된 총열로 적을 성공적으로 강타할 경우, 해당 적에게 가하는 다음 원거리 공격은 반응 강타와 같이 원거리 공격 시 발동되는 반응을 유발하지 않습니다. @link[actions.bullet-dancer-stance] 상태에서, 근접 공격 범위 내의 상대에게 화기로 원거리 공격을 성공적으로 가했을 때, 해당 무기나 그에 부착된 무기로 그 상대에게 가하는 다음 근접 공격 은 추가로 화염 피해 1과 부착된 화기의 무기 피해 주사위 당 지속 화염 피해 1을 입힌다.

다음 턴 종료 시까지 사용하지 않으면, 불릿 댄서 화상 효과의 두 가지 사용 중 하나에서 얻는 다음 공격의 혜택이 소멸됩니다.

name: Core Rejuvenation

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition and are about to attempt a recovery check.

Your soul taps into your core's power to push against the grasp of death and allow you to recover consciousness. You're restored to 1 Hit Point, lose the dying and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} conditions, and can act normally on this turn. You gain or increase the wounded condition as normal when losing the dying condition in this way.

Enhancement Your soul can draw even more power from your core, granting you additional benefits. When you use Core Rejuvenation, you also gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to three times your level. These Hit Points remain for 1 minute.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition and are about to attempt a recovery check.

Your soul taps into your core's power to push against the grasp of death and allow you to recover consciousness. You're restored to 1 Hit Point, lose the dying and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} conditions, and can act normally on this turn. You gain or increase the wounded condition as normal when losing the dying condition in this way.

Enhancement Your soul can draw even more power from your core, granting you additional benefits. When you use Core Rejuvenation, you also gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to three times your level. These Hit Points remain for 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 @link[conditions.dying] 상태에 걸렸으며 회복 검사를 시도하다.

당신의 영혼이 핵심의 힘을 끌어내어 죽음의 손아귀를 밀어내고 의식을 회복하게 합니다. HP가 1로 회복되며, 죽음 직전 상태와 @link[conditions.unconscious] 상태를 잃고 이번 턴에 정상적으로 행동할 수 있습니다. 이 방법으로 죽음 직전 상태를 잃을 때, 상처 입음 상태를 정상적으로 획득하거나 증가시킵니다.

강화 당신의 영혼은 핵심에서 더 많은 힘을 끌어내어 추가 혜택을 부여합니다. 핵심 재생술을 사용할 때, 레벨의 3배에 해당하는 임시 HP를 얻습니다. 이 HP는 1분 동안 유지됩니다.

name: Efficient Controls

description.value: By reducing redundant systems and streamlining essential functions, you have made it easier for the vehicle to operate with fewer crew. Reduce the number of crew required to operate your signature vehicle by 25%. For example, you would reduce a sailing ship from needing 1 pilot and 8 crew to 1 pilot and 6 crew. This adjustment only affects the number of crew needed to operate the vehicle; it doesn't reduce the vehicle's need for a pilot.

_desc_en: By reducing redundant systems and streamlining essential functions, you have made it easier for the vehicle to operate with fewer crew. Reduce the number of crew required to operate your signature vehicle by 25%. For example, you would reduce a sailing ship from needing 1 pilot and 8 crew to 1 pilot and 6 crew. This adjustment only affects the number of crew needed to operate the vehicle; it doesn't reduce the vehicle's need for a pilot.
_desc_ko: 중복 시스템을 줄이고 핵심 기능을 간소화함으로써, 더 적은 승무원으로 차량을 운용하기 쉽게 만들었습니다. 특수 차량 운용에 필요한 승무원 수를 25% 감소시킵니다. 예를 들어, 범선 의 경우 조종사 1명과 승무원 8명이 필요했던 것을 조종사 1명과 승무원 6명으로 줄일 수 있습니다. 이 조정은 차량 운용에 필요한 승무원 수에만 영향을 미치며, 조종사 필요성은 감소시키지 않습니다.

name: Impaling Bone

description.value: Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.oXeEbcUdgJGWHGEJ]{Impaling Spike} as a 7th-rank innate occult spell, except the spike is made of bone instead of cold iron. The bone from the spell has the effects of the ghost touch property rune and can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilize} incorporeal creatures as if they were corporeal.

_desc_en: Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.oXeEbcUdgJGWHGEJ]{Impaling Spike} as a 7th-rank innate occult spell, except the spike is made of bone instead of cold iron. The bone from the spell has the effects of the ghost touch property rune and can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilize} incorporeal creatures as if they were corporeal.
_desc_ko: 하루에 한 번, @link[spells.impaling-spike]를 (7th)랭크 선천적 오컬트 주문으로 시전할 수 있다. 단, 가시는 냉철 대신 뼈로 만들어진다. 이 주문으로 생성된 뼈는 고스트 터치 속성 룬의 효과를 가지며, @link[conditions.immobilized] 효과를 통해 비물질적 생물을 마치 물질적 생물인 것처럼 고정시킬 수 있다.

name: Spell Acceleration

description.value: Special time-weaving techniques let you compress your spellcasting gestures and incantations into a short burst so you can cast with incredible speed—though it causes temporal strain. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.z2ptq23nNBOeEI7H]{Quickened Casting} feat. It applies to your cantrips and spells from the class you used to qualify for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.bTQVvkEuPj9QAiAi]{Time Mage Dedication}.

_desc_en: Special time-weaving techniques let you compress your spellcasting gestures and incantations into a short burst so you can cast with incredible speed—though it causes temporal strain. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.z2ptq23nNBOeEI7H]{Quickened Casting} feat. It applies to your cantrips and spells from the class you used to qualify for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.bTQVvkEuPj9QAiAi]{Time Mage Dedication}.
_desc_ko: 특별한 시간 직조 기술은 당신의 주문 시전 몸짓과 주문을 짧은 폭발로 압축하게 해 주어, 놀라운 속도로 시전할 수 있게 합니다—다만 이는 시간적 부담을 일으킵니다. 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.z2ptq23nNBOeEI7H]{가속 시전} 재주를 얻습니다. 이것은 당신이 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.bTQVvkEuPj9QAiAi]{시간 마법사 헌신} 자격을 얻는 데 사용한 클래스의 캔트립과 주문에 적용됩니다.

name: Shield from Spells

description.value: Your prowess with a shield allows you to block magic and more. You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.wzJnJI6d2PaoTZIZ]{Shield from Arrows} against ranged spell attacks and other ranged attacks, not just physical ranged Strikes.

_desc_en: Your prowess with a shield allows you to block magic and more. You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.wzJnJI6d2PaoTZIZ]{Shield from Arrows} against ranged spell attacks and other ranged attacks, not just physical ranged Strikes.
_desc_ko: 방패를 다루는 당신의 숙련도는 마법 등을 막아낼 수 있게 합니다. @link[feats.shield-from-arrows]는 물리적 원거리 공격뿐만 아니라 원거리 주문 공격 및 기타 원거리 공격에도 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Hit and Run

description.value:
Requirements You are unnoticed or undetected by your target.

Leaping from a hiding place, you quickly attack your foe before retreating. You Stride or Step, then attempt a melee or ranged Strike against a creature. After your Strike, you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} away. None of the movement taken as part of this activity triggers reactions.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are unnoticed or undetected by your target.

Leaping from a hiding place, you quickly attack your foe before retreating. You Stride or Step, then attempt a melee or ranged Strike against a creature. After your Strike, you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} away. None of the movement taken as part of this activity triggers reactions.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 대상에게 발견되지 않았거나 감지되지 않은 상태여야 합니다.

은신처에서 뛰쳐나와 적을 재빨리 공격한 후 후퇴합니다. 당신은 일반 이동이나 걸음을 한 뒤, 생물에게 근접 또는 원거리 공격을 시도합니다. 공격 후, 당신은 @link[actions.sneak]하며 사라집니다. 이 행동의 일환으로 취한 이동은 어떤 반응도 유발하지 않습니다.

name: Solar Detonation

description.value:
Blinding flames explode in a swirling sphere! The detonation fills a @Template[burst|distance:20] within 60 feet of you. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[(floor((@actor.level -8)/2)+6)d6[fire],(floor((@actor.level -8)/2)+2)d6[vitality]|options:area-damage] damage, and can become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} depending on the result of its @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] save. The light from Solar Detonation is sunlight for creatures with a particular vulnerability to sunlight. Each creature that attempts a save becomes temporarily immune to being dazzled or blinded by Solar Detonation for 10 minutes, but not the impulse's other effects.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is dazzled until the start of your next turn.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is blinded until the start of your next turn.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is blinded for 1 minute.

Level (+2) Increase the fire damage by 1d6 and the vitality damage by 1d6.

The light from Solar Detonation is sunlight for creatures with a particular vulnerability to sunlight. Each creature that attempts a save becomes temporarily immune to being dazzled or blinded by Solar Detonation for 10 minutes, but not the impulse's other effects.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is dazzled until the start of your next turn.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is blinded until the start of your next turn.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is blinded for 1 minute.

Level (+2) Increase the fire damage by 1d6 and the vitality damage by 1d6.
_desc_ko:
실명 불꽃이 소용돌이치는 구체로 폭발한다! 이 폭발은 당신으로부터 60피트 이내의 20피트를 채운다. 영역 내 모든 생물은 화염 활력의 피해를 입으며, @link[conditions.dazzled] 상태가 되거나 @link[conditions.blinded] 상태가 될 수 있습니다. 태양 폭발의 빛은 햇빛에 약한 생물에게 햇빛으로 간주됩니다. 내성에 성공한 생물은 10분 동안 태양 폭발로 인한 눈부심이나 실명 효과에 일시적으로 면역이 되지만, 임펄스의 다른 효과에는 영향을 받지 않습니다.

대성공 생물은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 생물은 절반의 피해를 입으며, 당신의 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 눈부심을 경험합니다.

실패 대상은 전체 피해를 입으며, 다음 차례 시작까지 눈멈 상태가 됩니다.

대실패 생물은 두 배의 피해를 입으며 1분 동안 눈멈 상태가 됩니다.

레벨 (+2) 화염 피해 1d6 증가, 활력 피해 1d6 증가.

name: Acclimatization

description.value:
Your time spent in the hostile parts of the world has inured you to extreme climates.

In your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.sgo7J9BVofBqwlsF]{Favored Terrain}, you gain resistance equal to half your level to all environmental damage and are affected by temperature effects as though they were one step less severe (incredible heat or cold becomes extreme, extreme heat or cold becomes severe, and so on).

When other creatures @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tfa4Sh7wcxCEqL29]{Follow the Expert} with you as a guide in your favored terrain, they too treat temperature effects as one step less severe.

_desc_en:
Your time spent in the hostile parts of the world has inured you to extreme climates.

In your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.sgo7J9BVofBqwlsF]{Favored Terrain}, you gain resistance equal to half your level to all environmental damage and are affected by temperature effects as though they were one step less severe (incredible heat or cold becomes extreme, extreme heat or cold becomes severe, and so on).

When other creatures @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tfa4Sh7wcxCEqL29]{Follow the Expert} with you as a guide in your favored terrain, they too treat temperature effects as one step less severe.
_desc_ko:
적대적인 지역에서의 경험으로 극한 기후에 대한 내성이 생겼습니다.

당신의 @link[feats.favored-terrain]에서는 모든 환경 피해에 대해 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 저항력을 얻으며, 온도 효과의 영향도 한 단계 덜 심한 것으로 간주됩니다(극심한 더위나 추위는 극한으로, 극한의 더위나 추위는 심한 것으로 변경됩니다).

다른 생물들이 선호 지형에서 당신을 안내자로 삼아 @link[actions.follow-the-expert] 경우, 그들도 온도 효과를 한 단계 덜 심한 것으로 간주합니다.

name: Scrollmaster Dedication

description.value:
Your experience chronicling adventures and discoveries grants you heightened discernment and memory. For 24 hours after learning a prominent fact-such as the name of an NPC you have met, the details of your mission briefing, and similar information-you can recall it without attempting a check, though this doesn't allow you to automatically memorize long strings of numbers or text. You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to remember a detail that has come up before in the current adventure, even if it was more than 24 hours ago.

If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.0Dy8RlFqrzCVOTl4]{Thorough Reports} feat and have expert proficiency in the skill you're using to Recall Knowledge, your circumstance bonus to Recall Knowledge about creatures from that feat increases to +4.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.0ZXiLwvBG20MzkO6]{Scrollmaster}

value.value: member of the Pathfinder Society affiliated with the School of Scrolls

_desc_en:
Your experience chronicling adventures and discoveries grants you heightened discernment and memory. For 24 hours after learning a prominent fact-such as the name of an NPC you have met, the details of your mission briefing, and similar information-you can recall it without attempting a check, though this doesn't allow you to automatically memorize long strings of numbers or text. You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to remember a detail that has come up before in the current adventure, even if it was more than 24 hours ago.

If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.0Dy8RlFqrzCVOTl4]{Thorough Reports} feat and have expert proficiency in the skill you're using to Recall Knowledge, your circumstance bonus to Recall Knowledge about creatures from that feat increases to +4.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.0ZXiLwvBG20MzkO6]{Scrollmaster}
_desc_ko:
모험과 발견을 기록해온 경험은 당신에게 강화된 식별력과 기억력을 부여합니다. 주요 사실(만난 NPC의 이름, 임무 브리핑 세부사항 등)을 알게 된 후 24시간 동안은 판정을 시도하지 않고도 이를 회상할 수 있습니다. 단, 긴 숫자열이나 텍스트를 자동으로 암기할 수는 없습니다. 또한 현재 모험에서 이전에 언급된 세부사항을 기억하는 판정에는 +2 상황 보너스를 받습니다. 24시간이 넘은 내용도 포함됩니다.

@link[feats.thorough-reports] 피트를 보유하고 있으며, 지식 회상 기술에 전문 숙련도를 가진 경우, 해당 피트로 얻는 생물에 대한 지식 회상 상황 보너스가 +4로 증가합니다.

name: Draconic Acolyte Dedication

description.value:
As an acolyte of dragonkind, you have an item known as a draconic gift that you can use to summon a portion of the magical essence of the dragon you received it from. Choose a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.kzxu2dI7tFxv6Ix6.JournalEntryPage.GduFISQ6kzEB6sec#draconic-benefactors]{Draconic Benefactor} with a trait that matches the trained skill you used to qualify for this feat (arcane for Arcana, primal for Nature, occult for Occultism, and divine for Religion). You can't change your draconic benefactor later. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} feat for Dragon Lore. If you were already trained in Dragon Lore, you also become trained in a Lore skill of your choice.

You gain a draconic gift, a palm-sized magic item of negligible Bulk with a level equal to your level and a trait matching your draconic benefactor's tradition. Choose this item's appearance when you take this feat. This item is linked to your spirit, so if you ever lose possession of it (whether by dropping it or having it stolen from your person), it appears back in your possession at the beginning of your next turn.

Finally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Ce9vzE3XWn0u5NcL]{Channel Draconic Essence} action and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.hSTE1wvCsYYvCsHC]{Draconic Salvation} reaction. These and all other actions from this archetype gain the tradition trait of your draconic benefactor.

value.value: trained in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion

Choose a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.kzxu2dI7tFxv6Ix6.JournalEntryPage.GduFISQ6kzEB6sec#draconic-benefactors]{Draconic Benefactor} with a trait that matches the trained skill you used to qualify for this feat (arcane for Arcana, primal for Nature, occult for Occultism, and divine for Religion). If you were already trained in Dragon Lore, you also become trained in a Lore skill of your choice.

You gain a draconic gift, a palm-sized magic item of negligible Bulk with a level equal to your level and a trait matching your draconic benefactor's tradition. Choose this item's appearance when you take this feat. This item is linked to your spirit, so if you ever lose possession of it (whether by dropping it or having it stolen from your person), it appears back in your possession at the beginning of your next turn.

Finally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Ce9vzE3XWn0u5NcL]{Channel Draconic Essence} action and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.hSTE1wvCsYYvCsHC]{Draconic Salvation} reaction. These and all other actions from this archetype gain the tradition trait of your draconic benefactor.
_desc_ko:
용족의 시종으로서, 당신은 그것을 받은 용의 마법적 정수의 일부를 소환하는 데 사용할 수 있는, 용의 선물이라 알려진 물품을 가지고 있습니다. 이 재주 자격을 얻는 데 사용한 숙련 기술과 일치하는 특성을 가진 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.kzxu2dI7tFxv6Ix6.JournalEntryPage.GduFISQ6kzEB6sec#draconic-benefactors]{용의 후원자}를 선택합니다(주문학이면 비전, 자연학이면 원시, 오컬티즘이면 비학, 종교학이면 신성). 나중에 용의 후원자를 바꿀 수 없습니다. 당신은 용 지식에 대해 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{추가 지식} 재주를 얻습니다. 이미 용 지식에 숙련되어 있었다면, 원하는 지식 기술 하나에도 숙련됩니다.

당신은 용의 선물을 얻습니다. 이는 손바닥 크기의 마법 물품으로 부피는 무시할 정도이며, 당신의 레벨과 같은 레벨을 가지고, 당신의 용의 후원자의 전통과 일치하는 특성을 가집니다. 이 재주를 취할 때 이 물품의 외형을 선택합니다. 이 물품은 당신의 영혼과 연결되어 있으므로, 당신이 그것을 (떨어뜨리거나 몸에서 도난당하는 등으로) 잃게 되면, 당신의 다음 턴 시작 시에 당신의 소유로 돌아옵니다.

마지막으로, 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Ce9vzE3XWn0u5NcL]{용의 정수 발산} 행동과 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.hSTE1wvCsYYvCsHC]{용의 구원} 반응을 얻습니다. 이것들과 이 아키타입의 다른 모든 행동은 당신의 용의 후원자의 전통 특성을 얻습니다.

name: Play to the Crowd (Dandy)

description.value: You have a knack for knowing just how to manipulate groups by saying exactly what needs to be said. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} in a public area in front of a crowd, you can gauge the reactions of the crowd as you speak to know how your Lie is working, and Lie loses its secret trait. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.CLX9WEYXdntl2wrt]{Reactive Falsehood} reaction.

_desc_en: You have a knack for knowing just how to manipulate groups by saying exactly what needs to be said. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} in a public area in front of a crowd, you can gauge the reactions of the crowd as you speak to know how your Lie is working, and Lie loses its secret trait. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.CLX9WEYXdntl2wrt]{Reactive Falsehood} reaction.
_desc_ko: 당신은 필요한 말을 정확히 함으로써 집단을 조종하는 데 능숙합니다. 군중이 있는 공공 장소에서 @link[actions.lie]을 할 때, 말하는 동안 군중의 반응을 살피며 거짓말이 통하는 정도를 알 수 있고, 거짓말의 비밀 특성이 사라집니다. @link[actions.reactive-falsehood] 반응을 얻습니다.

name: Steady Spellcasting

description.value: Confident in your technique, you don't lose spells easily. If a reaction would disrupt your spellcasting action, attempt a @Check[flat|showDC:all|dc:15]. If you succeed, your action isn't disrupted.

_desc_en: Confident in your technique, you don't lose spells easily. If a reaction would disrupt your spellcasting action, attempt a @Check[flat|showDC:all|dc:15]. If you succeed, your action isn't disrupted.
_desc_ko: 당신의 기술에 자신감을 가지고 있어, 주문을 쉽게 잃지 않습니다. 반응이 주문 시전 행동을 방해할 경우, DC 15 단순을 시도하십시오. 성공하면 행동이 방해받지 않습니다.

name: Chance Death

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would die as a result of a failed recovery check or saving throw.

Your previous life ended due to sheer poor luck, struck by lightning or choking on a fish bone. You can reroll the triggering recovery check or saving throw, but you must use the new result, even if it's worse.

Special You can select this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain into or out of this feat.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would die as a result of a failed recovery check or saving throw.

Your previous life ended due to sheer poor luck, struck by lightning or choking on a fish bone. You can reroll the triggering recovery check or saving throw, but you must use the new result, even if it's worse.

Special You can select this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain into or out of this feat.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 회복 판정나 내성 굴림 실패로 인해 죽을 뻔한 상황.

순전히 운이 나빠 번개에 맞거나 생선 가시에 질식해 전생이 끝났습니다. 유발된 회복 판정나 내성 굴림을 재굴릴 수 있지만, 결과가 더 나빠도 반드시 새 결과를 사용해야 합니다.

특수 이 피트는 1레벨에서만 선택할 수 있으며, 재훈련으로 획득하거나 포기할 수 없습니다.

name: Rivethun Involutionist Dedication

description.value:
Access Followers of Rivethun have access to this feat.

You're a practicing Rivethun involutionist, with a deep well of inner power. You become an expert in Nature and Religion. You cast spells and gain the Cast a Spell activity. You gain a spell repertoire with two common cantrips from the divine spell list or any other divine cantrips you've learned or discovered. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for Rivethun involutionist archetype spells is Wisdom.

_desc_ko:
접근 리베툰의 추종자는 이 피트에 접근할 수 있다.

당신은 실천하는 리베툰 내적 역학자로, 깊은 내적 힘의 원천을 지닌다. 자연과 종교에 정통하게 된다. 주문을 시전하며 '주문 시전' 행동을 획득한다. 신성 주문 목록에서 두 개의 일반적인 캔트립 또는 당신이 배우거나 발견한 다른 신성 캔트립으로 구성된 주문 목록을 얻습니다. 당신은 주문 공격 수정자와 주문 DC 통계에 숙련됩니다. 리베툰 내적 변형주의자 아키타입 주문에 대한 핵심 주문 시전 능력치는 지혜입니다.

name: Psi Strikes

description.value:
Frequency once per turn

Requirements Your most recent action was to Cast a Spell or to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7GeguyqyD1TjoC4r]{Unleash your Psyche}.

You siphon residual psychic energies from your spell into one weapon you're wielding or one of your unarmed attacks and when you unleash your mind, the energies flare to match. The attack deals an extra 1d6 force damage until the end of the current turn. If your Psyche is Unleashed, this benefit instead lasts until your psyche subsides.

_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 턴당 1회

요구 사항 가장 최근 행동이 주문 시전 또는 @link[actions.unleash-psyche]이었을 것.

당신은 시전한 마법에서 남은 사이킥 에너지를 휘두르는 무기 하나 또는 비무장 공격 하나에 흡수합니다. 정신을 해방할 때, 이 에너지가 폭발하며 공격에 추가로 1d6 역장 피해를 줍니다. 이 효과는 현재 턴이 끝날 때까지 지속됩니다. 정신이 해방된 상태라면, 이 효과는 정신이 가라앉을 때까지 지속됩니다.

name: Auspicious Mount

description.value:
Guided by your ongoing care, your steed has developed incredible intelligence and skill. The mount you gained with Faithful Steed is now a specialized animal companion. You can select one of the usual specializations or the auspice specialization. A faithful steed with the auspice specialization gains the following benefits.

  • It gains the celestial, fiend, or monitor trait—whichever best matches your deity's servitors, and its appearance shifts to look more like those servitors. It also gains the holy trait if it's a celestial or the unholy trait if it's a fiend.
  • Its Intelligence modifier increases by 2 and its Wisdom modifier by 1.
  • Its proficiency rank in Religion increases to expert.
  • It can speak the language associated with your deity's servitors (such as Empyrean for celestials, Chthonian for demons, or Requian for psychopomps).
  • Its maximum Hit Points increase by 20, increasing to 25 at 18th level and 30 at 20th level. If the mount has the celestial trait, the extra HP increase by 5, and the mount gains weakness 5 to unholy. If it has the fiend trait, the extra HP increase by 5, and the mount gains weakness 5 to holy.

  • It gains wings that grant it a fly Speed equal to its land Speed.

_desc_en:

You can select one of the usual specializations or the auspice specialization. A faithful steed with the auspice specialization gains the following benefits.

  • It gains the celestial, fiend, or monitor trait—whichever best matches your deity's servitors, and its appearance shifts to look more like those servitors. It also gains the holy trait if it's a celestial or the unholy trait if it's a fiend.
  • Its Intelligence modifier increases by 2 and its Wisdom modifier by 1.
  • Its proficiency rank in Religion increases to expert.
  • It can speak the language associated with your deity's servitors (such as Empyrean for celestials, Chthonian for demons, or Requian for psychopomps).
  • Its maximum Hit Points increase by 20, increasing to 25 at 18th level and 30 at 20th level. If the mount has the celestial trait, the extra HP increase by 5, and the mount gains weakness 5 to unholy. If it has the fiend trait, the extra HP increase by 5, and the mount gains weakness 5 to holy.

  • It gains wings that grant it a fly Speed equal to its land Speed.
_desc_ko:
지속적인 보살핌 덕분에 당신의 마차는 놀라운 지능과 기술을 갖추게 되었습니다. '충실한 마차'로 얻은 탈것은 이제 전문화된 동물 동료가 됩니다. 일반 전문화 중 하나나 '호운 전문화'를 선택할 수 있습니다. 조짐 전문화를 가진 충실한 말은 다음과 같은 혜택을 얻습니다.

  • 천상체의, 핀드의, 또는 모니터의 특성 중 당신의 신의 종복과 가장 잘 어울리는 특성을 얻으며, 외형이 그 종복들을 닮아 변합니다. 천상체의 종복인 경우 신성한 특성을, 핀드의 종복인 경우 불경한 특성을 추가로 얻습니다.
  • 지능 능력치 수정자가 2 증가하고 지혜 능력치 수정자가 1 증가합니다.
  • 종교 숙련도 등급이 전문가로 상승합니다.
  • 당신의 신의 종복들과 연관된 언어를 구사할 수 있습니다(천상의 존재라면 천상의 언어, 데몬이라면 크토니안 언어, 사이코폼프라면 레퀴안 언어 등).
  • 최대 HP가 20 증가하며, 18레벨에 25, 20레벨에 30으로 증가합니다. 탈것이 천상체를 가질 경우 추가 HP가 5 증가하며, 탈것은 불경한 것에 대한 약점 5를 얻습니다. 핀드 특성을 가진 경우 추가 HP가 5 증가하며, 탈것은 신성한 공격에 대한 약점 5를 얻습니다.

  • 날개가 생겨 지상 속도와 동일한 비행 속도를 얻습니다.

name: Scalding Spit

description.value: Your bodily fluids burn with surprising volatility, as if you ran on oil instead of blood. As long as you are taking @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistent Fire Damage}, you gain a boiling spit ranged unarmed attack with a range of 30 feet that deals @Damage[1d6[fire]] damage.

_desc_en: Your bodily fluids burn with surprising volatility, as if you ran on oil instead of blood. As long as you are taking @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistent Fire Damage}, you gain a boiling spit ranged unarmed attack with a range of 30 feet that deals @Damage[1d6[fire]] damage.
_desc_ko: 당신의 체액은 놀라울 정도로 휘발성이 강해, 마치 피 대신 기름으로 움직이는 듯합니다. @link[conditions.persistent-damage]를 받는 동안, 30피트 사거리의 끓는 침 비무장 공격을 얻으며 1d6 화염의 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Cornered Fury

description.value: If a foe of a larger size than you critically hits and damages you, that foe is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you for 1 round.

_desc_en: If a foe of a larger size than you critically hits and damages you, that foe is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you for 1 round.
_desc_ko: 자신보다 큰 크기의 적이 치명타를 성공시켜 피해를 입힌 경우, 해당 적은 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 된다.

name: Billowing Wings

description.value: You've trained your winged companions to gather air in their wings, whipping up a concentrated gust of wind at opponents, potentially staggering them. Your companions with wings gain a gust ranged unarmed attack, which deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage with a range of 30 feet and has the air and propulsive traits. On a critical hit, the target is pushed back 5 feet. This is forced movement.

_desc_en: You've trained your winged companions to gather air in their wings, whipping up a concentrated gust of wind at opponents, potentially staggering them. Your companions with wings gain a gust ranged unarmed attack, which deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage with a range of 30 feet and has the air and propulsive traits. On a critical hit, the target is pushed back 5 feet. This is forced movement.
_desc_ko: 날개 달린 동료들을 훈련시켜 날개에 공기를 모아 집중된 돌풍을 적에게 휘둘러, 잠재적으로 적을 비틀거리게 합니다. 날개를 가진 동료들은 돌풍 원거리 비무장 공격을 얻습니다. 이 공격은 30피트 사거리로 1d4 타격을 입히며, 공기 및 추진 특성을 가집니다. 치명타 시 대상은 5피트 밀려납니다. 이는 강제 이동입니다.

name: Woodworker

description.value: Denizens of the Plane of Wood take immense pride in the magnificent works of art they can craft from wood, and practicing your own woodcraft helps you feel a connection with your planar heritage. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in Crafting (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.QLeMH5mQgh28sa5o]{Specialty Crafting} skill feat for woodworking.

_desc_en: Denizens of the Plane of Wood take immense pride in the magnificent works of art they can craft from wood, and practicing your own woodcraft helps you feel a connection with your planar heritage. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in Crafting (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.QLeMH5mQgh28sa5o]{Specialty Crafting} skill feat for woodworking.
_desc_ko: 나무의 평면 주민들은 나무로 제작하는 웅장한 예술 작품에 엄청난 자부심을 느끼며, 목공 기술을 연마하는 것은 평면적 유산과의 연결감을 느끼게 해줍니다. 제작 기술에 숙련 등급을 획득한다. 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 제작 기술에 자동으로 숙련이 부여되는 경우, 대신 선택한 기술에 숙련이 부여된다. 목공을 위한 @link[feats.specialty-crafting] 기술 재주를 획득한다.

name: Reflexive Riposte

description.value: You can riposte almost without a thought. At the start of each of your turns when you regain your actions, you gain an additional reaction that can be used only to perform an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EfjoIuDmtUn4yiow]{Opportune Riposte}.

_desc_en: You can riposte almost without a thought. At the start of each of your turns when you regain your actions, you gain an additional reaction that can be used only to perform an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EfjoIuDmtUn4yiow]{Opportune Riposte}.
_desc_ko:
당신은 거의 생각할 필요 없이 즉각 반격할 수 있습니다. 자신의 턴이 시작되어 행동을 회복할 때마다, @link[actions.opportune-riposte]

만을 수행할 수 있는 추가 반응을 얻습니다.

name: Internal Compartment

description.value:
You can hide a small object of up to light Bulk inside a hollow cavity on one of your forearms. It takes three @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} actions to store an object in this way.

You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to the DCs of checks for others to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} objects stored inside your arm.

If you store a weapon in your arm, you can use a single action to Interact to draw the weapon into the hand corresponding to your internal cavity, then Strike with the weapon.

_desc_en:
You can hide a small object of up to light Bulk inside a hollow cavity on one of your forearms. It takes three @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} actions to store an object in this way.

You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to the DCs of checks for others to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} objects stored inside your arm.

If you store a weapon in your arm, you can use a single action to Interact to draw the weapon into the hand corresponding to your internal cavity, then Strike with the weapon.
_desc_ko:
팔뚝의 빈 공간에 최대 가벼운 벌크의 소형 물체를 숨길 수 있습니다. 이 방식으로 물체를 보관하는 데는 세 번의 @link[actions.interact] 행동이 필요합니다.

다른 이가 당신의 팔 안에 보관된 물건을 @link[actions.seek]하거나 @link[actions.steal]하려는 판정 DC에 +4 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

팔에 무기를 보관한 경우, 액션 하나 사용하여 상호작용하여 내부 공간에 해당하는 손으로 무기를 뽑은 후, 해당 무기로 강타할 수 있습니다.

name: Exceptional Follower

description.value: Your followers' abilities have soared to new heights. All your followers become exceptional followers.

_desc_en: Your followers' abilities have soared to new heights. All your followers become exceptional followers.
_desc_ko: 추종자들의 능력이 새로운 차원으로 도약했습니다. 모든 추종자가 탁월한 추종자가 됩니다.

name: Vigilante Dedication

description.value:
You have two identities, each with its own name and abilities. Your social identity is an upstanding member of society, while your vigilante identity is a skilled and cunning warrior. Neither of these identities is a false front; you really are both of these people. If someone attempts to discern your other identity, they must use a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to attempt a Perception check against your Deception DC, as if you were using the Impersonate action. Your Deception DC against such attempts is 20 + your proficiency modifier instead of the normal DC. Unlike with Impersonate, you don't have to attempt a Deception check to interact with someone to conceal your other identity—a check happens only if someone else specifically tries to uncover your other identity.

Changing from one identity to the other takes 1 minute and must be done out of sight from other creatures. As this process involves both physical changes such as clothing and makeup, along with an altered state of mind, other effects that change your appearance don't reduce the time required to change identities.

Your two identities are completely distinct. Checks to Recall Knowledge about one of your identities don't reveal information about the other unless the person attempting the check knows both identities are the same person. Effects that detect you based on your identity work only if you are currently in the identity the effect is trying to detect; otherwise, the effect fails as if the target didn't exist.

To maintain the separation between your identities, some of your abilities have the vigilante trait. Your class feats and vigilante feats are associated with your vigilante identity, and using them while in your social identity may risk exposing you as a vigilante. If your identity is exposed to the public, you lose the benefits of Vigilante Dedication to disguising yourself, but you can spend 1 week of downtime to create a new social identity.
