Each creature in any of the emanations takes @Damage[10d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:occult|basic|options:area-effect]. If this damage reduces an enemy to 0 Hit Points, its head also explodes, potentially damaging more creatures and potentially causing more detonations. A given creature can take damage only once from a single use of Cranial Detonation.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 라운드당 1회

발동 조건 당신이 주문으로 하나 이상의 비정신적 적을 HP 0으로 성공적으로 감소시켰을 때.

당신의 압도적인 정신력이 생물을 쓰러뜨리면, 당신은 그 생물의 흔들리는 의식을 이용해 그 생물의 머리에서 사이킥 에너지를 폭발시킵니다. HP를 0으로 만든 각 적들은 죽고 머리가 폭발합니다. 폭발하는 각 머리는 해당 적을 중심으로 15피트 반경에 충격파를 생성합니다. 충격파가 닿는 범위 내의 모든 생물은 10d6 타격의 피해를 입으며 , 기본 반사의 지속 피해를 받습니다. 이 피해로 적의 HP가 0이 되면 그 적의 머리도 폭발하여 더 많은 생물에게 피해를 주고 추가 폭발을 일으킬 수 있습니다. 단일 크레니얼 디토네이션 사용으로 한 생물이 입을 수 있는 피해는 한 번뿐입니다.

name: Command Corpse

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xYakFeP6olBsxpZN]{Command Undead} feat, but you can use it only to transform the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} spells you cast on mindless undead. These spells can control creatures with a level equal to or lower than your level -1 (instead of your level - 3).

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xYakFeP6olBsxpZN]{Command Undead} feat, but you can use it only to transform the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} spells you cast on mindless undead. These spells can control creatures with a level equal to or lower than your level -1 (instead of your level - 3).
_desc_ko: @link[feats.command-undead] 피트를 얻지만, 이는 당신이 무의식적인 언데드에게 시전한 @link[spells.harm] 주문 효과를 변환하는 데만 사용할 수 있습니다. 이 주문들은 당신의 레벨 -1(레벨 -3 대신) 이하인 생물을 통제할 수 있습니다.

name: Veil of Bugs

description.value: Your swarm is dense, blotting out vision. You and your allies gain lesser cover when in your swarm's space.

_desc_en: Your swarm is dense, blotting out vision. You and your allies gain lesser cover when in your swarm's space.
_desc_ko: 당신의 무리는 빽빽하여 시야를 가립니다. 당신과 아군은 무리의 공간에 있을 때 반엄폐 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Proud Mentor

description.value:
You enjoy mentoring others and take pride in your students' accomplishments. If you get a critical failure on an attempt to Aid, you get a failure instead. Whenever you successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} an ally who critically succeeds on the check you Aided them on, you feel a rush of pride, gaining temporary Hit Points equal to your level, which last for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.D7JhDc4dcWhORY9h]{Effect: Proud Mentor}

_desc_en:
You enjoy mentoring others and take pride in your students' accomplishments. If you get a critical failure on an attempt to Aid, you get a failure instead. Whenever you successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} an ally who critically succeeds on the check you Aided them on, you feel a rush of pride, gaining temporary Hit Points equal to your level, which last for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.D7JhDc4dcWhORY9h]{Effect: Proud Mentor}
_desc_ko:
당신은 다른 이들을 지도하는 것을 즐기며 제자들의 성취를 자랑스럽게 여깁니다. 지원 시도에서 대실패를 기록하면, 대신 실패로 처리됩니다. 당신이 지원한 동맹이 해당 지원 판정에서 대성공을 거둘 때마다, 당신은 자부심이 솟구쳐 레벨에 해당하는 임시 HP를 얻으며, 이는 1분 동안 지속됩니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.D7JhDc4dcWhORY9h]{효과: 자랑스러운 멘토}

name: Greater Distracting Shot

description.value: Even a single missile can throw off your enemy's balance, and more powerful attacks leave it flustered for longer. If you hit your hunted prey with a ranged weapon, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn. If you critically hit your prey or hit it twice on the same turn with a ranged weapon, it's off-guard until the end of your next turn instead.

_desc_en: Even a single missile can throw off your enemy's balance, and more powerful attacks leave it flustered for longer. If you hit your hunted prey with a ranged weapon, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn. If you critically hit your prey or hit it twice on the same turn with a ranged weapon, it's off-guard until the end of your next turn instead.
_desc_ko: 단 하나의 투사체만으로도 적의 균형을 무너뜨릴 수 있으며, 더 강력한 공격은 더 오래 혼란에 빠뜨립니다. 원거리 무기로 사냥감을 명중시키면, 다음 차례 시작까지 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 된다. 사냥감을 치명타로 명중시키거나 같은 차례에 원거리 무기로 두 번 명중시키면, 다음 차례 끝까지 무방비가 해제된다.

name: Sabotage

description.value:
Requirements You have a free hand.

You subtly damage others' equipment. Choose one item that a creature within your reach wields or carries. The item must have moving parts that you could possibly sabotage (a shortbow could be sabotaged, but a longsword could not). Attempt a @Check[thievery|defense:reflex] check against the Reflex DC of the creature. Damage dealt by Sabotage can't take the item below its Broken Threshold.

Critical Success You deal damage equal to 4 x your Thievery proficiency bonus.

Success You deal damage equal to double your Thievery proficiency bonus.

Critical Failure The item is temporarily immune to your Sabotage for 1 day.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have a free hand.

You subtly damage others' equipment. Choose one item that a creature within your reach wields or carries. The item must have moving parts that you could possibly sabotage (a shortbow could be sabotaged, but a longsword could not). Attempt a @Check[thievery|defense:reflex] check against the Reflex DC of the creature. Damage dealt by Sabotage can't take the item below its Broken Threshold.

Critical Success You deal damage equal to 4 x your Thievery proficiency bonus.

Success You deal damage equal to double your Thievery proficiency bonus.

Critical Failure The item is temporarily immune to your Sabotage for 1 day.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 한 손이 빈 손이어야 합니다.

당신은 은밀하게 타인의 장비에 피해를 줍니다. 당신의 손이 닿는 범위 내 생물이 휘두르거나 휴대하는 아이템 하나를 선택하십시오. 해당 아이템은 당신이 고장낼 수 있는 움직이는 부품이 있어야 합니다(단궁은 고장낼 수 있지만, 장검은 불가능합니다). 해당 생물의 반사 DC에 대해 도둑질 판정을 시도하십시오. 고장으로 인한 피해는 아이템을 파손 임계점 이하로 떨어뜨릴 수 없습니다.

대성공 당신은 도둑질 숙련 보너스의 4배에 해당하는 피해를 입힙니다.

성공 당신은 도둑질 숙련 보너스의 두 배에 해당하는 피해를 입힙니다.

대실패 해당 아이템은 1일간 당신의 방해술에 일시적으로 면역 상태가 됩니다.

name: Fermenting Liquors

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You have a hand free.

You always have a special batch of preserved liquor ready for each day. You serve your liquor to a willing adjacent creature. The creature recovers @Damage[(2*@actor.level)[healing]]{Hit Points equal to twice your level}. Additionally, for 1 hour, all Diplomacy checks to influence the creature gain a +1 status bonus.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You have a hand free.

You always have a special batch of preserved liquor ready for each day. You serve your liquor to a willing adjacent creature. The creature recovers @Damage[(2*@actor.level)[healing]]{Hit Points equal to twice your level}. Additionally, for 1 hour, all Diplomacy checks to influence the creature gain a +1 status bonus.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

요구 사항 한 손이 자유로워야 합니다.

매일 사용할 특별한 양조주를 항상 준비해 두어야 합니다. 당신은 동의한 대상에게 술을 제공합니다. 해당 생물은 당신의 레벨의 두 배에 해당하는 HP를 회복합니다. 또한 1시간 동안, 해당 생물을 설득하기 위한 모든 외교 판정에는 +1 상태 보너스가 적용됩니다.

name: Shared Sight

description.value: You bestow the mystical vision granted to you by your muse upon your allies. If your next action is to cast a non-cantrip spell that affects one or more of your allies, all affected allies gain your spiritsense for 1 minute.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en: You bestow the mystical vision granted to you by your muse upon your allies. If your next action is to cast a non-cantrip spell that affects one or more of your allies, all affected allies gain your spiritsense for 1 minute.
_desc_ko: 당신의 뮤즈가 부여한 신비한 시야를 아군에게 전수합니다. 다음 행동으로 아군 한 명 이상에게 영향을 미치는 캐스트 횟수 제한이 없는 캔트립 주문을 시전할 경우, 영향을 받은 모든 아군은 1분 동안 당신의 영혼 감지 능력을 얻습니다.

name: Rupture Stomp

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You are in Tenacious Stance.

Every dwarf knows that the rock they walk upon can be either a best friend or a treacherous path. With a heavy impact of your armored heel, you crack the ground underneath you. The ground within a @Template[emanation|distance:10] becomes difficult terrain. If you are a master or better in the armor you are wearing, this becomes greater difficult terrain. The cracked ground settles and reverts to normal terrain after 1 minute.

Special At 16th level, you can take this feat again. If you do, you can use it once per hour instead of once per day.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You are in Tenacious Stance.

Every dwarf knows that the rock they walk upon can be either a best friend or a treacherous path. With a heavy impact of your armored heel, you crack the ground underneath you. The ground within a @Template[emanation|distance:10] becomes difficult terrain. If you are a master or better in the armor you are wearing, this becomes greater difficult terrain. The cracked ground settles and reverts to normal terrain after 1 minute.

Special At 16th level, you can take this feat again. If you do, you can use it once per hour instead of once per day.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

요구 사항 당신은 끈질긴 자세를 취하고 있다.

모든 드워프는 자신이 걷는 바위가 가장 든든한 친구가 될 수도, 배신적인 길이 될 수도 있음을 알고 있다. 갑옷으로 무장한 발뒤꿈치의 무거운 충격으로, 당신은 발밑의 땅을 갈라놓는다. 10피트 범위 내 지면이 어려운 지형이 된다. 착용 중인 갑옷에 달인 이상의 숙련도를 가진 경우, 이 지형은 매우 어려운 지형이 된다. 갈라진 지면은 1분 후 안정되어 정상 지형으로 돌아온다.

특수 16레벨에 도달하면 이 피트를 다시 선택할 수 있다. 선택 시 하루에 한 번이 아닌 시간당 한 번 사용할 수 있다.

name: Harbinger's Protection

description.value: You often work on missions alone, making sure to cover up your weaknesses more effectively than other members of your faith. You are trained in heavy armor. When you gain expert or greater proficiency in any type of armor, you also gain that proficiency in heavy armor.

_desc_en: You often work on missions alone, making sure to cover up your weaknesses more effectively than other members of your faith. You are trained in heavy armor. When you gain expert or greater proficiency in any type of armor, you also gain that proficiency in heavy armor.
_desc_ko: 당신은 종종 혼자 임무를 수행하며, 신앙의 다른 구성원들보다 자신의 약점을 더 효과적으로 숨기려 합니다. 당신은 중갑 사용에 숙련되어 있습니다. 어떤 종류의 갑옷에 대해 전문가 이상의 숙련도를 획득할 때마다, 중갑에 대한 숙련도도 함께 획득합니다.

name: Eyes That See Eternity

description.value: Mythic power opens your eyes to the secrets of reality and eternity. Spend a Mythic Point; for the next minute, you gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight} and roll all Perception checks with mythic proficiency.

_desc_en: Mythic power opens your eyes to the secrets of reality and eternity. Spend a Mythic Point; for the next minute, you gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight} and roll all Perception checks with mythic proficiency.
_desc_ko: 신화적 힘이 현실과 영원의 비밀을 보게 한다. 신화 포인트 1점을 소모하면, 다음 1분 동안 @link[spells.truesight] 효과를 얻고 모든 지각 판정에서 신화 숙련도를 적용한다.

name: Volatile Grease

description.value:
When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Wu0xFpewMKRK3HG8]{Grease}, you can modify its target to be 1 creature. If you do, replace the spell's standard effects with the following: You splash the target with combustible grease. The target must attempt a @Check[reflex] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is splattered with grease and gains weakness 2 to fire until the end of your next turn. The target or an adjacent creature can rub off the combustible grease with an Interact action, ending the effect.

Failure As success, except the weakness to fire lasts for 1 minute.

Heightened (+2) The weakness increases by 1.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en:
When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Wu0xFpewMKRK3HG8]{Grease}, you can modify its target to be 1 creature. If you do, replace the spell's standard effects with the following: You splash the target with combustible grease. The target must attempt a @Check[reflex] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is splattered with grease and gains weakness 2 to fire until the end of your next turn. The target or an adjacent creature can rub off the combustible grease with an Interact action, ending the effect.

Failure As success, except the weakness to fire lasts for 1 minute.

Heightened (+2) The weakness increases by 1.
_desc_ko:
당신이 @link[spells.grease]을 시전할 때, 대상은 1마리의 생물로 수정자가 될 수 있다. 그렇게 할 경우, 이 주문이 주는 일반적인 효과를 다음으로 바꿔 줍니다: 당신은 대상에게 가연성 기름을 뿌립니다. 대상은 반사 내성 굴림을 시도해야 합니다.

대성공 대상은 영향을 받지 않는다.

성공 대상은 기름이 튀어 불에 약해짐 2 상태가 되며, 이 효과는 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 지속됩니다. 대상이나 인접한 생물은 상호작용 행동으로 가연성 기름을 닦아낼 수 있으며, 이로써 효과는 종료됩니다.

실패 성공과 동일하나, 화염에 대한 약화 효과가 1분 동안 지속됩니다.

강화 (+2) 약점이 1 증가한다.

name: Safe House

description.value:
You establish a safe house-a secure space in which to hide your secrets from the outside world.

This safe house is roughly the size of two 10-foot cubes. It's in a location you have access to, and it can be part of a larger building or structure, like a hidden room or an underground cave.

The safe house protects objects and people inside it from magical detection. This has the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EoKBlgf6Smt8opaU]{Veil of Privacy}, using your Deception modifier for the counteract DC and half your level rounded up for the counteract rank.

Setting up or moving your safe house takes a week of downtime.

The size of the safe house expands to four 10-foot cubes if you're an expert in Deception, eight cubes if you're a master, and 16 cubes if you're legendary.

_desc_en:
You establish a safe house-a secure space in which to hide your secrets from the outside world.

This safe house is roughly the size of two 10-foot cubes. It's in a location you have access to, and it can be part of a larger building or structure, like a hidden room or an underground cave.

The safe house protects objects and people inside it from magical detection. This has the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EoKBlgf6Smt8opaU]{Veil of Privacy}, using your Deception modifier for the counteract DC and half your level rounded up for the counteract rank.

Setting up or moving your safe house takes a week of downtime.

The size of the safe house expands to four 10-foot cubes if you're an expert in Deception, eight cubes if you're a master, and 16 cubes if you're legendary.
_desc_ko:
당신은 외부 세계로부터 비밀을 {숨길} 수 있는 안전한 공간인 안전가옥을 마련합니다.

이 안전가옥은 대략 10피트 큐브 두 개 크기로, 접근 가능한 장소에 위치한다. 더 큰 건물이나 구조물(예: 숨겨진 방이나 지하 동굴)의 일부일 수 있다.

안전가옥은 내부 물품과 인원을 마법 탐지로부터 보호한다. 이는 @link[spells.veil-of-privacy] 효과를 발휘하며, 반격 DC는 속임수 능력치 수정자를, 반격 등급은 반올림한 레벨의 절반을 적용한다.

안전가옥을 설치하거나 이동하는 데는 일주일의 다운타임이 소요됩니다.

은신처의 크기는 기만이 전문가 수준일 경우 10피트 큐브 4개, 달인 수준일 경우 8개, 전설적 수준일 경우 16개로 확장됩니다.

name: Draconic Scent (Dragon Disciple)

description.value: Your sense of smell is uncanny, much like a dragon's. You gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet. The GM might double the range if you're downwind from the creature or halve the range if you're upwind, at their discretion.

_desc_en: Your sense of smell is uncanny, much like a dragon's. You gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet. The GM might double the range if you're downwind from the creature or halve the range if you're upwind, at their discretion.
_desc_ko: 당신의 후각은 용과 마찬가지로 놀라울 정도로 예민합니다. 30피트 범위 내에서 대략적인 냄새를 감지할 수 있습니다. GM의 재량에 따라, 대상의 바람 아래쪽에 있을 경우 범위를 두 배로 늘리거나 바람 위쪽에 있을 경우 범위를 절반으로 줄일 수 있습니다.

name: Ocean's Bite

description.value: Your jaws open wider than a humanoid mouth should, showing off multiple rows of serrated shark teeth or a viperfish-like nest of needles. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d8 piercing damage. Your jaws are in the brawling group.

_desc_en: Your jaws open wider than a humanoid mouth should, showing off multiple rows of serrated shark teeth or a viperfish-like nest of needles. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d8 piercing damage. Your jaws are in the brawling group.
_desc_ko: 당신의 턱은 인간형 생물의 입보다 훨씬 넓게 벌어지며, 여러 줄의 톱니 모양 상어 이빨이나 독사물고기 같은 바늘 둥지를 드러냅니다. 1d8 관통 피해를 주는 비무장 공격인 턱 공격을 얻습니다. 당신의 턱은 난투 무기에 속합니다.

name: Goloma Lore

description.value: You lived an insulated life focused on avoiding danger. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Stealth and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also become trained in Goloma Lore.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: You lived an insulated life focused on avoiding danger. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Stealth and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also become trained in Goloma Lore.
_desc_ko:
위험을 피하는 데 포커스를 둔 고립된 삶을 살았습니다. 은신과 생존에 숙련 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 자동으로 숙련 상태가 되는 경우, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련 상태가 됩니다. 또한 골로마 지식에 숙련 상태가 됩니다.

참고: 이 피트로 부여되는 기술에 이미 숙련된 경우, 대체 기술을 수동으로 선택해야 합니다. 부여되는 지식 기술도 수동으로 입력해야 합니다.

name: Bullet Split

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a firearm or crossbow in one hand and a slashing (or versatile S) melee weapon in the other.

You carefully align your weapon with the edge of your blade, splitting the projectile in two as you fire to attack two different targets. Make two Strikes, one each against two separate targets. The targets must be adjacent to each other and within your weapon's maximum range. Each of these attacks takes a –2 penalty to the attack roll, but the two count as only one attack when calculating your multiple attack penalty.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a firearm or crossbow in one hand and a slashing (or versatile S) melee weapon in the other.

You carefully align your weapon with the edge of your blade, splitting the projectile in two as you fire to attack two different targets. Make two Strikes, one each against two separate targets. The targets must be adjacent to each other and within your weapon's maximum range. Each of these attacks takes a –2 penalty to the attack roll, but the two count as only one attack when calculating your multiple attack penalty.
_desc_ko:
Requirements 한 손에는 화기나 석궁을, 다른 손에는 베기(또는 다용도 S) 근접 무기를 들고 있습니다.

무기의 날과 탄환의 가장자리를 정밀하게 성향하여 발사하며, 탄환을 두 조각으로 갈라 두 개의 서로 다른 표적을 공격합니다. 두 개의 공격을 각각 다른 두 목표물에 가합니다. 목표물은 서로 인접해 있어야 하며 무기의 최대 사거리 내에 있어야 합니다. 각 공격은 명중 굴림에 -2 페널티를 받지만, 다중 공격 페널티 계산 시 두 공격은 하나의 공격으로 간주됩니다.

name: Spraying Mutation

description.value: Your ostilli can launch a multitude of darts at once over a short distance. When you Spit Ambient Magic, you can have it affect all creatures within a @Template[cone|distance:15] instead of the normal target.

_desc_en: Your ostilli can launch a multitude of darts at once over a short distance. When you Spit Ambient Magic, you can have it affect all creatures within a @Template[cone|distance:15] instead of the normal target.
_desc_ko: 당신의 오스틸리는 짧은 거리에 다수의 다트를 동시에 발사할 수 있습니다. 주변 마법을 뱉을 때, 일반적인 대상 대신 15피트 범위 내의 모든 생물에게 영향을 미치도록 할 수 있습니다.

name: Forewarn

description.value:
Frequency once per minute

Trigger An enemy within your overwatch field attempts an attack against an ally who is also within your overwatch field.

Your foresight and planning are more valuable than armor as you direct your ally away from danger, but there's a limit to how often you can guide your allies away from a foe's relentless assaults. The triggering attack roll targets your Perception DC instead of your ally's AC. Though this allows your ally to avoid taking penalties to their AC, it doesn't remove any conditions or other effects causing such penalties. For example, an enemy with sneak attack would still deal extra damage to your ally if they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, even though they wouldn't take the –2 circumstance penalty when defending against the attack.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per minute

Trigger An enemy within your overwatch field attempts an attack against an ally who is also within your overwatch field.

Your foresight and planning are more valuable than armor as you direct your ally away from danger, but there's a limit to how often you can guide your allies away from a foe's relentless assaults. The triggering attack roll targets your Perception DC instead of your ally's AC. Though this allows your ally to avoid taking penalties to their AC, it doesn't remove any conditions or other effects causing such penalties. For example, an enemy with sneak attack would still deal extra damage to your ally if they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, even though they wouldn't take the –2 circumstance penalty when defending against the attack.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 분당 1회

발동 조건 감시 범위 내의 적이, 감시 범위 내에 있는 아군을 공격하려고 시도할 때.

당신의 예지력과 계획은 아군을 위험에서 벗어나게 하는 데 방어구보다 더 가치 있지만, 적의 끊임없는 공격으로부터 아군을 얼마나 자주 이끌어낼 수 있는지에 한 한계가 있습니다. 트리거 명중 굴림은 아군의 AC 대신 당신의 지각 DC를 대상으로 합니다. 이는 아군이 AC에 페널티를 받지 않도록 하지만, 그러한 페널티를 유발하는 상태나 다른 효과는 제거하지 않습니다. 예를 들어, 암습을 가진 적의 경우 동맹이 @link[conditions.off-guard]일 때 여전히 추가 피해를 입히지만, 해당 공격을 방어할 때 -2 상황 페널티는 적용되지 않습니다.

name: Black Powder Boost

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a loaded firearm.

You fire your weapon as you jump, using the kickback to go farther. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} and discharge your firearm to add a +10-foot status bonus to the distance traveled. If you spend 2 actions for Black Powder Boost, you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump} instead.

Special An ability that allows you to High Jump or Long Jump as a single action (like the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ZBhvJ9O8MvBFAlhq]{Quick Jump} skill feat) lets you use Black Powder Boost as a single action for those jumps as well.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a loaded firearm.

You fire your weapon as you jump, using the kickback to go farther. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} and discharge your firearm to add a +10-foot status bonus to the distance traveled. If you spend 2 actions for Black Powder Boost, you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump} instead.

Special An ability that allows you to High Jump or Long Jump as a single action (like the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ZBhvJ9O8MvBFAlhq]{Quick Jump} skill feat) lets you use Black Powder Boost as a single action for those jumps as well.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 장전된 화기를 장비하고 있어야 합니다.

점프하면서 무기를 발사하여 반동을 이용해 더 멀리 이동합니다. 당신은 @link[actions.leap]하며 화기를 발사해 이동 거리에 +10피트 상태 보너스를 추가합니다. 흑색 화약 부스트에 2개의 행동을 소비하면, 대신 @link[actions.high-jump] 또는 @link[actions.long-jump]를 수행합니다.

특수 액션 하나로 높이뛰기나 멀리뛰기를 할 수 있게 해주는 능력(@link[feats.quick-jump] 피트와 유사)은 해당 점프 시에도 흑색화약 부스트를 액션 하나로 사용할 수 있게 합니다.

name: Expanded Domain Initiate

description.value: You have long venerated one of your deity's lesser-known aspects. Select one domain from your deity's alternate domains. You gain access to that domain and an initial domain spell for that domain.

_desc_en: You have long venerated one of your deity's lesser-known aspects. Select one domain from your deity's alternate domains. You gain access to that domain and an initial domain spell for that domain.
_desc_ko: 당신은 오랫동안 당신의 신이 지닌 (하급) 측면 중 하나를 숭배해왔습니다. 당신의 신이 지닌 대체 도메인 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 해당 도메인에 접근할 수 있으며, 해당 도메인의 초급 도메인 주문을 하나 얻습니다.

name: Warding Jewel

description.value: A life of hunting and battle has caused your head gem to attune to the waxing moon, which has manifested in the power to protect you from harm. Your head gem protects you by making your skin difficult to pierce. While you possess your head gem, you gain resistance 2 to piercing damage and resistance 1 to slashing damage. The resistance to each type of damage increases by 1 at 9th level and every 4 levels thereafter.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: A life of hunting and battle has caused your head gem to attune to the waxing moon, which has manifested in the power to protect you from harm. Your head gem protects you by making your skin difficult to pierce. While you possess your head gem, you gain resistance 2 to piercing damage and resistance 1 to slashing damage. The resistance to each type of damage increases by 1 at 9th level and every 4 levels thereafter.
_desc_ko: 사냥과 전투의 삶은 당신의 머리 보석이 차오르는 달과 조화를 이루게 하여, 당신을 해로부터 보호하는 힘으로 창조되었습니다. 머리 보석은 피부를 뚫기 어렵게 만들어 당신을 보호합니다. 머리 보석을 소유하는 동안 관통 피해에 대한 저항력 2와 베기 피해에 대한 저항력 1을 얻습니다. 각 피해 유형에 대한 저항력은 9레벨에 도달할 때마다, 그리고 이후 4레벨마다 1씩 증가합니다.

name: Moment of Clarity

description.value: You push back your rage for a moment in order to think clearly. Until the end of this turn, you can use actions with the concentrate trait even if those actions don't have the rage trait.

_desc_en: You push back your rage for a moment in order to think clearly. Until the end of this turn, you can use actions with the concentrate trait even if those actions don't have the rage trait.
_desc_ko: 분노를 잠시 억누르고 명료하게 생각할 수 있다. 이번 턴이 끝날 때까지, 집중 특성을 가진 행동은 분노 특성이 없더라도 사용할 수 있다.

name: Burning Jet

description.value:
A condensed burst of flame shoots behind you, propelling you forward with its sheer force. Stride up to 40 feet in a straight line. Movement from this impulse ignores difficult terrain and doesn't trigger reactions.

Level (6th) The maximum distance of the Stride is 60 feet. You can choose to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} up to 40 feet in any direction instead of Striding. If you're in the air at the end of this Leap, you fall normally.

Level (10th) As 6th level, but you hover briefly after leaping into the air. If you Leap, you don't fall until the end of your next turn. If you use Burning Jet again on a subsequent turn, you remain airborne.

_desc_en:
A condensed burst of flame shoots behind you, propelling you forward with its sheer force. Stride up to 40 feet in a straight line. Movement from this impulse ignores difficult terrain and doesn't trigger reactions.

Level (6th) The maximum distance of the Stride is 60 feet. You can choose to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} up to 40 feet in any direction instead of Striding. If you're in the air at the end of this Leap, you fall normally.

Level (10th) As 6th level, but you hover briefly after leaping into the air. If you Leap, you don't fall until the end of your next turn. If you use Burning Jet again on a subsequent turn, you remain airborne.
_desc_ko:
응축된 화염이 뒤에서 솟구쳐 그 강력한 힘으로 당신을 앞으로 밀어냅니다. 직선으로 최대 40피트까지 이동합니다. 이 추진력으로 인한 이동은 어려운 지형을 무시하며 반응을 유발하지 않습니다.

레벨 (6th) 이동의 최대 거리는 60피트이다. 스트라이드 대신 @link[actions.leap]으로 최대 40피트까지 어느 방향으로든 이동할 수 있습니다. 이 도약이 끝날 때 공중에 있다면 정상적으로 추락합니다.

레벨 (10th) (6th)와 동일하나, 공중으로 도약한 후 잠시 공중에 떠 있을 수 있습니다. 도약 시 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 추락하지 않습니다. 이후 턴에 다시 불타는 제트를 사용하면 공중에 계속 머무를 수 있습니다.

name: Throttle the Divine

description.value: You grasp the godly by their throats and damage their connection to their deities. When you have a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, it must roll its flat check to use manipulate actions with the divine trait twice and take the worse result. Each time it attempts such an action while you have it grabbed, you tighten your grip further, dealing bludgeoning damage equal to @Damage[(2d6 + @actor.abilities.str.mod)[bludgeoning]]{2d6 + your Strength modifier} to that target.

_desc_en: You grasp the godly by their throats and damage their connection to their deities. When you have a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, it must roll its flat check to use manipulate actions with the divine trait twice and take the worse result. Each time it attempts such an action while you have it grabbed, you tighten your grip further, dealing bludgeoning damage equal to @Damage[(2d6 + @actor.abilities.str.mod)[bludgeoning]]{2d6 + your Strength modifier} to that target.
_desc_ko: 당신은 신적인 존재의 목을 움켜쥐고 그들의 신과의 연결을 손상시킵니다. 당신이 생물을 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{조이기} 상태로 붙잡고 있을 때, 그 생물은 신성 특성을 가진 조작 행동을 사용하기 위해 평판정을 두 번 굴려 더 나쁜 결과를 취해야 합니다. 당신이 붙잡고 있는 동안 그 생물이 그러한 행동을 시도할 때마다, 당신은 손아귀를 더 죄어 @Damage[(2d6 + @actor.abilities.str.mod)[bludgeoning]]{2d6 + 당신의 근력 수정치}만큼의 타격 피해를 그 대상에게 줍니다.

name: Vindicator Dedication

description.value:
Your church ensures that you are cared for. You can use Religion to [[/act coerce skill=religion]]{Coerce}, [[/act gather-information skill=religion]]{Gather Information}, [[/act make-an-impression skill=religion]]{Make an Impression}, or [[/act request skill=religion]]{Request} as long as you are in a town or city with a church dedicated to your deity. If the target of the check is also a worshipper of your deity or is your hunted prey, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the check.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.Aka7A3c28QqBeRxU]{Vindicator}

_desc_en:
Your church ensures that you are cared for. You can use Religion to [[/act coerce skill=religion]]{Coerce}, [[/act gather-information skill=religion]]{Gather Information}, [[/act make-an-impression skill=religion]]{Make an Impression}, or [[/act request skill=religion]]{Request} as long as you are in a town or city with a church dedicated to your deity. If the target of the check is also a worshipper of your deity or is your hunted prey, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the check.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.Aka7A3c28QqBeRxU]{Vindicator}
_desc_ko: 당신의 교회는 당신이 돌봄을 받도록 보장합니다. 당신이 신을 모시는 교회가 있는 마을이나 도시에 있는 한, 종교 기술을 사용하여 강요, 정보 수집, 인상 남기기, 또는 요청을 할 수 있습니다. 해당 기술의 대상이 당신의 신을 숭배하는 자이거나 당신이 추적 중인 사냥감일 경우, 해당 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Oath of the Slayer

description.value:
During your daily preparations, you can swear an oath to defeat, topple, or destroy a certain kind of enemy during your deeds that day. Choose aberrations, celestials, dragons, fiends, or undead. You can't choose celestials if you're holy, nor can you choose fiends if you're unholy. You gain an edict to banish or slay creatures of that kind.

Your Strikes and devotion spells that deal damage do an additional 1 spirit damage against a creature with the chosen trait. This damage increases to 2 at 7th level and 3 at 14th level. If a creature with the chosen trait triggers your champion's reaction, this additional damage doubles until the end of your next turn.

_desc_en:
During your daily preparations, you can swear an oath to defeat, topple, or destroy a certain kind of enemy during your deeds that day. Choose aberrations, celestials, dragons, fiends, or undead. You can't choose celestials if you're holy, nor can you choose fiends if you're unholy. You gain an edict to banish or slay creatures of that kind.

Your Strikes and devotion spells that deal damage do an additional 1 spirit damage against a creature with the chosen trait. This damage increases to 2 at 7th level and 3 at 14th level. If a creature with the chosen trait triggers your champion's reaction, this additional damage doubles until the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
일일 준비 시간 동안, 그날의 행동에서 특정 종류의 적을 패배시키거나, 전복시키거나, 파괴하겠다는 맹세를 할 수 있습니다. 이형체, 천상체, 용, 핀드, 언데드 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 신성한 존재라면 천상체를, 불경한 존재라면 핀드를 선택할 수 없습니다. 해당 종류의 생물을 추방하거나 살해하는 칙령을 얻습니다.

선택한 특성을 가진 생물에게 피해를 주는 당신의 공격 및 헌신 주문은 추가로 1의 영혼 피해를 입힙니다. 이 피해는 (7th)레벨에 2로, 14레벨에 3으로 증가합니다. 선택한 특성을 가진 생물이 당신의 챔피언 반응을 유발하면, 이 추가 피해는 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 두 배가 됩니다.

name: Magic Ammunition

description.value:
You imbue your ammunition with raw and potent magic, transforming it to suit your needs in any situation.

When you select this feat, choose three types of common magical ammunition of 4th level or lower from GM Core or this book. Your GM might allow you to choose from other types of magical ammunition of an appropriate level, such as uncommon ammunition, or ammunition from other books. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.97jWk4XbIrGQK4Cp]{Transform Ammunition} action.

Special You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you do, select three additional types of magical ammunition as described above.

_desc_en:
You imbue your ammunition with raw and potent magic, transforming it to suit your needs in any situation.

When you select this feat, choose three types of common magical ammunition of 4th level or lower from GM Core or this book. Your GM might allow you to choose from other types of magical ammunition of an appropriate level, such as uncommon ammunition, or ammunition from other books. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.97jWk4XbIrGQK4Cp]{Transform Ammunition} action.

Special You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you do, select three additional types of magical ammunition as described above.
_desc_ko:
당신은 탄약에 원초적이고 강력한 마법을 불어넣어, 어떤 상황에서도 필요에 맞게 변형시킵니다.

이 피트를 선택할 때, GM 코어 또는 이 책에서 4레벨 이하의 일반 마법 탄약 세 종류를 선택한다. GM은 희귀 탄약이나 다른 책의 탄약 등 적절한 레벨의 다른 마법 탄약 중에서 선택하도록 허용할 수도 있다. @link[actions.transform-ammunition] 행동을 획득합니다.

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 선택할 때마다 위에서 설명한 대로 마법 탄약의 종류를 세 가지 추가로 선택하십시오.

name: Disperse Into Petals

description.value:
You merge with the blossoms sprouting from you and disperse, becoming a visible cloud of blossoms and petals. You're amorphous. You lose any item bonus to AC and all other effects and bonuses from armor, and you use your proficiency modifier for unarmored defense. You gain resistance to physical damage equal to half your level and are immune to precision damage. You can't cast spells, activate items, or use actions that have the attack or manipulate trait. You gain a fly Speed of 10 feet. You can remain in this form for up to 1 minute. You can Dismiss this effect.

Awakening You can maintain your form for a longer time. You can remain in this form for up to 1 hour.

Awakening You've learned to harm others, even while in your blossom state. You can occupy the same space as someone else. While occupying someone else's space, you can spend 1 action to spin around in a vortex of blossoms, dealing @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/5)d4)[slashing]]{1d4 slashing} damage for every 5 levels you have to the creature, with a basic Reflex save.

_desc_en:
You merge with the blossoms sprouting from you and disperse, becoming a visible cloud of blossoms and petals. You're amorphous. You lose any item bonus to AC and all other effects and bonuses from armor, and you use your proficiency modifier for unarmored defense. You gain resistance to physical damage equal to half your level and are immune to precision damage. You can't cast spells, activate items, or use actions that have the attack or manipulate trait. You gain a fly Speed of 10 feet. You can remain in this form for up to 1 minute. You can Dismiss this effect.

Awakening You can maintain your form for a longer time. You can remain in this form for up to 1 hour.

Awakening You've learned to harm others, even while in your blossom state. You can occupy the same space as someone else. While occupying someone else's space, you can spend 1 action to spin around in a vortex of blossoms, dealing @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/5)d4)[slashing]]{1d4 slashing} damage for every 5 levels you have to the creature, with a basic Reflex save.
_desc_ko:
당신은 몸에서 피어나는 꽃잎과 융합하여 흩어지며, 눈에 보이는 꽃잎 구름이 됩니다. 형태가 불분명해지며, AC에 적용되던 모든 아이템 보너스와 갑옷의 효과 및 보너스를 잃고, 비무장 방어 시 숙련 수정자를 사용합니다. 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 물리 피해 저항력을 얻으며 정밀 피해에 면역이 된다. 주문을 시전하거나 아이템을 활성화하거나 공격 또는 조작 특성이 있는 행동을 사용할 수 없다. 비행 속도 10피트를 얻는다. 이 형태를 최대 1분 동안 유지할 수 있다. 이 효과를 해제할 수 있다.

각성 형태 유지 시간이 연장됩니다. 최대 1시간 동안 이 형태를 유지할 수 있습니다.

각성 꽃 형태로 있을 때도 타인에게 해를 입힐 수 있게 되었다. 다른 존재와 동일한 공간을 점유할 수 있습니다. 타인의 공간을 점유 중일 때, 1 행동을 소모하여 꽃잎 소용돌이 속에서 회전하며, 기본 반사 내성 굴림을 적용한 후 자신의 레벨 5당 1d4 베기 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Always Ready

description.value: Extensive training against undead has taught you to cover your weak points, even when you think that you're alone. You aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}, or flanking undead of your level or lower. However, the undead can still help their allies flank. If all of your opponents are undead, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls; the GM determines whether to apply this bonus if undead are disguised as another type of creature, if another type of creature is disguised as undead, or if there are additional opponents you haven't noticed who aren't undead.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en: Extensive training against undead has taught you to cover your weak points, even when you think that you're alone. You aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}, or flanking undead of your level or lower. However, the undead can still help their allies flank. If all of your opponents are undead, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls; the GM determines whether to apply this bonus if undead are disguised as another type of creature, if another type of creature is disguised as undead, or if there are additional opponents you haven't noticed who aren't undead.
_desc_ko: 언데드에 대한 광범위한 훈련으로 인해, 혼자 있다고 생각할 때조차도 자신의 약점을 가리는 법을 배웠다. 당신은 @link[conditions.off-guard]가 아니며, @link[conditions.hidden], @link[conditions.undetected]의 언데드나, 당신 레벨 이하의 언데드가 측면 공격을 가할 때에도 @link[conditions.off-guard]가 되지 않습니다. 다만, 해당 언데드는 여전히 아군의 측면 공격을 도울 수 있습니다. 모든 상대가 언데드일 경우, 이니셔티브 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 언데드가 다른 생물로 변장했거나, 다른 생물이 언데드로 변장했거나, 당신이 눈치채지 못한 언데드가 아닌 추가 상대가 있을 경우 이 보너스 적용 여부는 GM이 결정합니다.

name: Assume Earth's Mantle

description.value:
Enormous pieces of rock cluster around your body. You can Dismiss this impulse.

  • You become Large if you were smaller. This increases your reach by 5 feet (or by 10 feet if you started out Tiny).
  • You gain a climb Speed equal to your land Speed, but you can use it only to climb surfaces of earthen matter.
  • The armor grants you a +1 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude saves and a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DCs against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} you, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} you, or knock you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
  • If your Strength is below +4, this armor raises your Strength to +4. If your Strength is +4 or higher, this armor grants you a +1 item bonus to your Strength.
  • If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.plEZoAyPwjAOdY4e]{Armor in Earth} impulse, you can add its effects to Assume Earth's Mantle.

_desc_en:
Enormous pieces of rock cluster around your body. You can Dismiss this impulse.

  • You become Large if you were smaller. This increases your reach by 5 feet (or by 10 feet if you started out Tiny).
  • You gain a climb Speed equal to your land Speed, but you can use it only to climb surfaces of earthen matter.
  • The armor grants you a +1 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude saves and a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DCs against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} you, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} you, or knock you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
  • If your Strength is below +4, this armor raises your Strength to +4. If your Strength is +4 or higher, this armor grants you a +1 item bonus to your Strength.
  • If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.plEZoAyPwjAOdY4e]{Armor in Earth} impulse, you can add its effects to Assume Earth's Mantle.
_desc_ko:
거대한 암석 조각들이 네 몸 주위에 뭉쳐진다. 이 충동을 무시할 수 있다.

  • 원래 크기가 더 작았다면 대형이 된다. 이로 인해 당신의 공격 범위가 5피트 증가합니다(초기 크기가 초소형이었다면 10피트 증가).
  • 지상 속도 및 등반 속도와 동일한 등반 속도를 얻지만, 이 속도는 흙으로 된 표면만을 등반할 때만 사용할 수 있습니다.
  • 이 갑옷은 인내 내성에 +1 상황 보너스를 부여하며, @link[actions.shove], @link[actions.trip], @link[conditions.prone] 시도할 때 인내 내성 또는 반사 내성 저항 DC에 +2 상황 보너스를 부여합니다.
  • 근력 능력치가 +4 미만일 경우, 이 갑옷은 근력 능력치를 +4로 올립니다. 근력 능력치가 +4 이상일 경우, 이 갑옷은 근력 능력치에 +1 아이템 보너스를 부여합니다.
  • @link[feats.armor-in-earth] 충동을 보유한 경우, 그 효과를 대지의 망토를 입음에 추가할 수 있습니다.

name: Domain Focus

description.value: Your devotion to your deity's domains grows greater, and so does the power granted to you. Whenever you Refocus, completely refill your focus pool.

_desc_en: Your devotion to your deity's domains grows greater, and so does the power granted to you. Whenever you Refocus, completely refill your focus pool.
_desc_ko: 당신의 신의 도메인에 대한 헌신이 더욱 깊어지고, 그에 따라 부여받은 힘도 커집니다. 재집중할 때마다, 당신의 포커스 풀을 완전히 채웁니다.

name: Seeker of Truths

description.value:
Your devotion to discovering and hoarding abstruse truths borders on the fanatical, and you can bring this devotion to bear. You gain the cleric's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.hT4INKGtly4QY8KN]{Domain Initiate} feat but must select knowledge, secrecy, or truth as your domain. You cast that domain's domain spell as a focus spell of the same tradition as your cantrip from Eldritch Researcher Dedication, and you Refocus by contemplating abstruse mysteries rather than praying to a god. When an ability would manifest a divine symbol—such as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aF7RiG7c8GzSQLYt]{Word of Truth} focus spell—it instead manifests as a strange shape unique to you that seems to defy geometry.

Special You can take this feat up to three times, selecting a different domain each time.

_desc_en:
Your devotion to discovering and hoarding abstruse truths borders on the fanatical, and you can bring this devotion to bear. You gain the cleric's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.hT4INKGtly4QY8KN]{Domain Initiate} feat but must select knowledge, secrecy, or truth as your domain. You cast that domain's domain spell as a focus spell of the same tradition as your cantrip from Eldritch Researcher Dedication, and you Refocus by contemplating abstruse mysteries rather than praying to a god. When an ability would manifest a divine symbol—such as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aF7RiG7c8GzSQLYt]{Word of Truth} focus spell—it instead manifests as a strange shape unique to you that seems to defy geometry.

Special You can take this feat up to three times, selecting a different domain each time.
_desc_ko:
당신은 난해한 진리를 발견하고 축적하는 데에 대한 헌신이 광신에 가깝고, 이 헌신을 발휘할 수 있습니다. 클레릭의 @link[feats.domain-initiate] 피트를 얻지만, 지식, 은밀, 진리 중 하나를 도메인으로 선택해야 합니다. 해당 도메인의 도메인 포커스 주문은 엘드리치 연구자 헌신에서 얻은 캔트립과 동일한 전통의 포커스 주문으로 시전하며, 신에게 기도하는 대신 난해한 신비를 숙고함으로써 재집중합니다. 신성한 상징이 창조되는 능력(예: @link[spells.word-of-truth] 포커스 주문)은 대신 기하학을 거스르는 듯한 당신만의 독특한 기묘한 형태로 창조됩니다.

특수 이 피트를 최대 세 번까지 선택할 수 있으며, 매번 다른 도메인을 선택해야 합니다.

name: Rocky Flesh

description.value: Your flesh takes on the hardness of stone. You gain resistance to physical damage (except adamantine) equal to your number of class feats from the Stonebound archetype.

_desc_en: Your flesh takes on the hardness of stone. You gain resistance to physical damage (except adamantine) equal to your number of class feats from the Stonebound archetype.
_desc_ko: 당신의 살갗이 돌처럼 단단해집니다. 스톤바운드 아키타입의 클래스 피트 수만큼 물리 피해(아다만틴 제외)에 대한 저항력을 얻습니다.

name: Elude the Divine

description.value: You are able to escape inquisitions involving divine magic, allowing you to blend in well in Mzali but also to avoid unwanted attention in other oppressive theocracies. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.RiuZT3H4QZIIEQXJ]{Slippery Secrets} skill feat, and its benefits also apply against divination effects that attempt to discern your deity. When using Slippery Secrets against a divine divination, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus, and on a critical success, the divination reveals false information appropriate to your false persona, rather than nothing.

_desc_en: You are able to escape inquisitions involving divine magic, allowing you to blend in well in Mzali but also to avoid unwanted attention in other oppressive theocracies. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.RiuZT3H4QZIIEQXJ]{Slippery Secrets} skill feat, and its benefits also apply against divination effects that attempt to discern your deity. When using Slippery Secrets against a divine divination, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus, and on a critical success, the divination reveals false information appropriate to your false persona, rather than nothing.
_desc_ko: 신성 마법과 관련된 심문에서 벗어날 수 있어, 므잘리에서는 잘 녹아들 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 다른 억압적인 신정 정치 체제에서도 원치 않는 관심을 피할 수 있습니다. @link[feats.slippery-secrets] 기술 피트를 획득하며, 이 피트의 효과는 신을 시도하여 식별하려는 점술 효과에도 적용됩니다. 신성 점술에 미끄러운 비밀을 사용할 경우 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 대성공 시 점술은 아무것도 드러내지 않는 대신 당신의 가짜 인격에 맞는 허위 정보를 드러냅니다.

name: Magical Scrounger

description.value:
You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} a temporary wondrous item using the magic scrounged from all around. Once per day, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PE1jm9lBveujj2md]{Cobble Together} a temporary magic item. The temporary item must be common, magical, half your level or lower, and be able to be held, wielded, or worn. Any Craft requirements must be provided as normal.

You can't Cobble Together a consumable, a rune, or an item with runes. If the item must be worn or affixed, removing it once it's affixed or donned destroys it.

_desc_en:
You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} a temporary wondrous item using the magic scrounged from all around. Once per day, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PE1jm9lBveujj2md]{Cobble Together} a temporary magic item. The temporary item must be common, magical, half your level or lower, and be able to be held, wielded, or worn. Any Craft requirements must be provided as normal.

You can't Cobble Together a consumable, a rune, or an item with runes. If the item must be worn or affixed, removing it once it's affixed or donned destroys it.
_desc_ko:
주변에서 모은 마법을 이용해 임시 경이로운 아이템을 @link[actions.craft]할 수 있습니다. 하루에 한 번, 당신은 @link[actions.cobble-together]로 일시적인 마법 아이템을 만들 수 있습니다. 일시적인 아이템은 일반 등급이어야 하며, 마법적이어야 하고, 당신의 레벨의 절반 이하이어야 하며, 손에 쥐거나 휘두르거나 착용할 수 있어야 합니다. 필요한 제작 기술은 평소와 같이 제공되어야 합니다.

소모품, 룬, 룬이 새겨진 아이템은 임시 제작할 수 없습니다. 착용하거나 부착해야 하는 아이템의 경우, 부착 또는 착용 후 제거하면 파괴됩니다.

name: Violent Vines

description.value: When angered, you can imbue nearby vines with your wrath, provoking them into a murderous rampage. Once per hour, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kCgkreCT6g0dipMd]{Murderous Vine} as a primal innate spell.

_desc_en: When angered, you can imbue nearby vines with your wrath, provoking them into a murderous rampage. Once per hour, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kCgkreCT6g0dipMd]{Murderous Vine} as a primal innate spell.
_desc_ko: 분노할 때, 주변 덩굴에 당신의 분노를 불어넣어 살육의 광란으로 몰아넣을 수 있습니다. 시간당 한 번, @link[spells.murderous-vine]을 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Fumesoul

description.value: The air inside you asserts itself as a toxic miasma, inuring you to most poisons. You gain resistance to poison equal to half your level (minimum 1).

_desc_en: The air inside you asserts itself as a toxic miasma, inuring you to most poisons. You gain resistance to poison equal to half your level (minimum 1).
_desc_ko: 당신 내부의 공기는 유독한 악취로 작용하여 대부분의 독에 대한 내성을 부여합니다. 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 독 저항력을 얻습니다(최소 1).

name: Dirge of Doom

description.value: You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1xLVcA8Y1onw7toT]{Dirge of Doom} composition cantrip, which frightens your enemies and keeps them from fully recovering from their fear.

_desc_en: You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1xLVcA8Y1onw7toT]{Dirge of Doom} composition cantrip, which frightens your enemies and keeps them from fully recovering from their fear.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @link[spells.dirge-of-doom] 작곡 캔트립을 익히게 되며, 이는 적들을 공포에 떨게 하고 공포 상태에서 완전히 회복하지 못하게 합니다.

name: Tweak Appearances

description.value: You spend 1 minute making quick adjustments to someone's clothing and appearance, causing their words to carry more weight with an audience of your choice. While speaking to that audience, the target gains a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy and Performance checks. If you have master proficiency in Crafting, the bonus increases to +2; if you have legendary proficiency in Crafting, the bonus increases to +3. This bonus lasts until this ability is used on the target again, the situation they were prepared for ends, or they next change their outfit.

_desc_en: You spend 1 minute making quick adjustments to someone's clothing and appearance, causing their words to carry more weight with an audience of your choice. While speaking to that audience, the target gains a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy and Performance checks. If you have master proficiency in Crafting, the bonus increases to +2; if you have legendary proficiency in Crafting, the bonus increases to +3. This bonus lasts until this ability is used on the target again, the situation they were prepared for ends, or they next change their outfit.
_desc_ko: 1분 동안 대상의 복장과 외모를 신속히 조정하여, 선택한 청중에게 더 큰 설득력을 부여합니다. 해당 청중에게 말할 때 대상은 외교 및 공연 판정에서 +1 아이템 보너스를 얻습니다. 만약 제작에 숙련을 달인했다면 보너스가 +2로 증가하며, 제작에 전설적 숙련을 가졌다면 보너스가 +3으로 증가한다. 이 보너스는 대상에게 이 능력이 다시 사용될 때까지, 대상이 준비한 상황이 종료될 때까지, 또는 대상이 다음에 복장을 바꿀 때까지 지속된다.

name: Winding Flow

description.value:
Frequency once per round

Any journey consists of more than simply reaching your destination. You use two of the following actions in any order: Stand, Step, and Stride. You can't use the same action twice.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per round

Any journey consists of more than simply reaching your destination. You use two of the following actions in any order: Stand, Step, and Stride. You can't use the same action twice.
_desc_ko:
빈도 라운드당 한 번

어떤 여정도 단순히 목적지에 도달하는 것 이상으로 이루어집니다. 다음 행동 중 두 가지를 순서와 상관없이 사용합니다: 서기, {신중한 발걸음}, 이동. 같은 행동을 두 번 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Dragon Lore

description.value:
You've set your mind on learning more about your ancestor and their kin, and perhaps you were even raised by a dragon parent. You've come to understand how dragons can invoke fear but also how they've contributed to society as a whole. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Diplomacy and Intimidation. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Dragon Lore.

_desc_en:
You've set your mind on learning more about your ancestor and their kin, and perhaps you were even raised by a dragon parent. You've come to understand how dragons can invoke fear but also how they've contributed to society as a whole. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Diplomacy and Intimidation. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Dragon Lore.
_desc_ko:
당신은 조상과 그 혈족에 대해 더 깊이 배우기로 마음먹었으며, 어쩌면 용 부모에게 길러졌을 수도 있습니다. 용이 공포를 불러일으킬 수 있지만 동시에 사회 전체에 기여해온 방식도 이해하게 되었습니다. 당신은 외교와 협박에 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 해당 기술 중 하나에 자동으로 숙련되게 된다면, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다.

또한 드래곤 지식에 대한 @link[feats.additional-lore] 일반 피트를 얻습니다.

name: Thunderclap Spell

description.value: Your lightning splits the air, generating a booming shock wave. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that has the electricity trait or deals electricity damage, has no duration, and requires creatures to attempt a saving throw, the force of the spell's lightning creates a thunderclap, in addition to its other effects. Each creature that failed its Reflex save against the spell is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round, and those who critically failed are also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

_desc_en: Your lightning splits the air, generating a booming shock wave. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that has the electricity trait or deals electricity damage, has no duration, and requires creatures to attempt a saving throw, the force of the spell's lightning creates a thunderclap, in addition to its other effects. Each creature that failed its Reflex save against the spell is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round, and those who critically failed are also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
_desc_ko: 당신의 번개가 공기를 가르고 우렁찬 충격파를 생성합니다. 다음 행동으로 전기 속성을 지니거나 전기 피해를 입히며 지속 시간이 없고 생물이 내성 굴림을 시도해야 하는 주문을 시전할 경우, 해당 주문의 번개 힘이 다른 효과에 더해 천둥소리를 발생시킵니다. 해당 주문에 대한 반사 내성에 실패한 모든 생물은 @link[conditions.deafened] 상태가 1라운드 동안 지속되며, 대실패한 생물은 추가로 @link[conditions.prone] 상태가 된다.

name: Cracked Mountain

description.value:
Trigger You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.

Requirements You are in Tenacious Stance.

You fight on, staying on your feet and lashing out at a foe. You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point, and your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} condition increases by 1. Make a melee Strike at an enemy within reach. You immediately end your Tenacious Stance.

Trigger You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.

Requirements You are in Tenacious Stance.

You fight on, staying on your feet and lashing out at a foe. _desc_ko:
발동 조건 HP가 0이 되지만 즉시 사망하지는 않습니다.

요구 사항 당신은 끈질긴 자세를 취하고 있습니다.

당신은 계속 싸우며 발을 딛고 적을 향해 공격합니다. 기절을 피하고 1 HP로 남으며, @link[conditions.wounded] 상태가 1 증가합니다. 도달 범위 내의 적에게 근접 공격을 가하세요. 당신은 즉시 끈질긴 자세를 종료합니다.

name: Blood Component Substitution

description.value:
You can bypass the need for incantations and gestures by drawing energy directly from your blood, causing you to visibly glow the color of your blood and crackle with magical energy. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast a Spell}, you can replace all verbal, material, or somatic spellcasting components with a blood component.

To use a blood component, you lose Hit Points equal to twice the spell's rank as the energy in your blood is depleted, and you can't decrease the Hit Points lost in any way.

As usual for altering components, this has no effect on the number of actions required to Cast the Spell, and your Cast a Spell activity gains the concentrate trait but not the manipulate trait. You can't use blood components to replace any required part of a spell's cost.

_desc_en:
You can bypass the need for incantations and gestures by drawing energy directly from your blood, causing you to visibly glow the color of your blood and crackle with magical energy. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast a Spell}, you can replace all verbal, material, or somatic spellcasting components with a blood component.

To use a blood component, you lose Hit Points equal to twice the spell's rank as the energy in your blood is depleted, and you can't decrease the Hit Points lost in any way.

As usual for altering components, this has no effect on the number of actions required to Cast the Spell, and your Cast a Spell activity gains the concentrate trait but not the manipulate trait. You can't use blood components to replace any required part of a spell's cost.
_desc_ko:
주문과 제스처 없이 피에서 직접 에너지를 끌어올 수 있으며, 이로 인해 피의 색깔로 눈에 띄게 빛나고 마법 에너지로 쩍쩍 갈라지는 소리가 납니다. @link[actions.cast-a-spell], 모든 언어적, 물질적, 신체적 주문 시전 요소를 혈액 요소로 대체할 수 있다.

혈액 성분을 사용하면, 혈액의 에너지가 고갈되면서 해당 주문 랭크의 두 배에 해당하는 HP를 잃게 되며, 어떤 방법으로도 손실되는 HP를 줄일 수 없습니다.

성분 변경 시 일반적인 규칙과 마찬가지로, 이는 주문을 시전하는 데 필요한 행동 횟수에 영향을 미치지 않으며, '주문 시전' 행동은 '집중' 특성을 얻지만 '조작' 특성은 얻지 못합니다. 혈액 성분으로 주문 비용의 필수 요소를 대체할 수 없습니다.

name: Share Rage

description.value:
Requirements You haven't used this ability since you last Raged.

You stoke an ally's fury. While you are raging, one willing creature within 30 feet gains the effects of the Rage action, except it can still use concentrate actions. It doesn't get any added benefits from your instinct, feats, or the like.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.RoGEt7lrCdfaueB9]{Effect: Share Rage}

_desc_ko:
요구 사항 마지막으로 분노한 이후 이 능력을 사용하지 않았습니다.

당신은 아군의 분노를 부채질합니다. 당신이 분노 상태일 때, 30피트 내의 한 동의한 대상은 집중 행동을 계속 사용할 수 있다는 점을 제외하고는 분노 행동의 효과를 얻습니다. 이 대상은 당신의 본능, 재주 등으로부터 추가적인 혜택을 받지 않습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.RoGEt7lrCdfaueB9]{효과: 분노 공유}

name: To Me!

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Two lives spent in adventuring groups has given you a special gift for bolstering party morale and pushing your allies to achieve greater ends when they work as a team. Spend a Mythic Point to rally your allies to your side to regroup or push your advantage. Stride and then make a melee Strike. As soon as your turn is over, your allies within 30 feet who can see and hear you may Stride in your direction as a free action, but don't have to. Your allies control their own movement and may move in such a way as to avoid obstacles or creatures, but if they Stride, they must be at least 5 feet closer to you than where they were when they started by the end of this movement. If yours or an ally's movement this round triggers reactions, you or your ally uses mythic proficiency to determine their AC or to attempt a saving throw to resist the reaction.

If an ally is within melee range of the target of the Strike you made with this ability, that ally may also make a melee Strike against that enemy as a reaction instead of Striding toward you.

Any Strikes from To Me! made against your nemesis, be they Strikes you make or Strikes made by allies, use mythic proficiency.

_desc_ko:
빈도 하루 1회

모험단에서 보낸 두 번의 삶은 당신에게 파티의 사기를 북돋우고 아군이 팀으로 협력할 때 더 큰 성취를 이루도록 독려하는 특별한 재능을 주었습니다. 신화 점수 1점을 소모해 재집결하거나 우위를 밀어붙이도록 아군을 당신 곁으로 규합합니다. 보폭을 취한 뒤 근접 타격을 합니다. 당신의 턴이 끝나자마자, 당신을 보고 들을 수 있는 30피트 이내의 아군은 자유 행동으로 당신 방향으로 보폭을 취할 수 있으나, 반드시 할 필요는 없습니다. 당신의 아군은 자신의 이동을 통제하며 장애물이나 생물을 피하도록 이동할 수 있으나, 보폭을 취한다면 이 이동이 끝날 때 시작 지점보다 당신에게 최소 5피트 더 가까워야 합니다. 이번 라운드에 당신이나 아군의 이동이 반응을 유발한다면, 당신 또는 아군은 신화 숙련도를 사용해 AC를 결정하거나 그 반응에 저항하는 내성 굴림을 시도합니다.

아군이 당신이 이 능력으로 한 타격의 대상의 근접 사거리 내에 있다면, 그 아군은 당신 쪽으로 보폭을 취하는 대신 반응으로 그 적을 상대로 근접 타격을 할 수도 있습니다.

당신의 숙적을 상대로 나에게로!에서 이루어진 모든 타격은, 당신이 하는 타격이든 아군이 하는 타격이든, 신화 숙련도를 사용합니다.

name: Environmental Explorer

description.value: You've traversed enough untamed wilderness to gain an intuitive understanding of the dangers that exist in such places. Your extensive familiarity means you sometimes notice perils even when you're not trying to. Even if you aren't Searching in exploration mode, you can attempt a check to find environmental hazards that normally require you to Search for them. You still need to meet any other requirements to find a particular hazard.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en: You've traversed enough untamed wilderness to gain an intuitive understanding of the dangers that exist in such places. Your extensive familiarity means you sometimes notice perils even when you're not trying to. Even if you aren't Searching in exploration mode, you can attempt a check to find environmental hazards that normally require you to Search for them. You still need to meet any other requirements to find a particular hazard.
_desc_ko: 당신은 야생의 황야를 충분히 누비며 그곳에 도사린 위험을 직관적으로 이해하게 되었습니다. 광범위한 패밀리어 덕분에 의도하지 않았을 때조차 위험을 감지하는 경우가 있습니다. 탐색 모드에서 탐색을 하지 않더라도, 일반적으로 탐색이 필요한 환경적 위험을 발견하기 위한 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다. 특정 위험을 발견하기 위한 다른 요건은 여전히 충족해야 합니다.

name: Distracting Shadows

description.value: You have learned to remain hidden by using larger folk as a distraction to avoid drawing attention to yourself. You can use creatures that are at least one size larger than you (usually Medium or larger) as cover for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} actions, though you still can't use such creatures as cover for other uses, such as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} action.

_desc_en: You have learned to remain hidden by using larger folk as a distraction to avoid drawing attention to yourself. You can use creatures that are at least one size larger than you (usually Medium or larger) as cover for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} actions, though you still can't use such creatures as cover for other uses, such as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} action.
_desc_ko: 당신은 더 큰 존재들을 주의를 분산시키는 수단으로 활용해 자신을 숨기는 법을 익혔습니다. 자신보다 최소 한 크기 이상 큰 생물(보통 중간 크기 이상)을 @link[actions.hide] 및 @link[actions.sneak] 행동을 위한 은폐물로 사용할 수 있지만, @link[actions.take-cover] 행동과 같은 다른 용도로는 여전히 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Resilient Physiology

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You're afflicted by a disease or poison, or are taking persistent damage.

Your ordered physiology rejects unwelcome elements, allowing you to reject the negative effects of poisons and diseases or shrug off other lasting negative effects. Choose one.

Disease or Poison Attempt a saving throw against the affliction. On a failure or critical failure, the affliction's stage doesn't increase.

Persistent Damage Attempt a @Check[flat|showDC:all|dc:10] to recover from the persistent damage.

_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

요구 사항 질병이나 독에 감염되었거나 지속적인 피해를 받고 있을 때.

정교한 생리 구조가 불필요한 요소를 거부하여 독과 질병의 부정적 효과를 차단하거나 다른 지속적인 부정적 효과를 무시할 수 있습니다. 하나를 선택하십시오.

질병 또는 독 해당 상태에 대한 내성 굴림을 시도합니다. 실패 또는 대실패 시, 상태의 단계가 증가하지 않습니다.

지속적 피해지속적 피해 회복을 위해 DC 10 단순을 시도하십시오.

name: Solar Rejuvenation

description.value:
Ghoran - The warmth and light of the sun gives you life. If you rest outdoors for 10 minutes during the day, you regain Hit Points equal to your @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2)*@actor.abilities.con.mod)[healing]]{Constitution modifier × half your level}. You gain this benefit in addition to any healing from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}.

Leshy - If you rest outdoors for 10 minutes during the day, you regain Hit Points equal to your @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2)*@actor.abilities.con.mod)[healing]]{Constitution modifier × half your level}. You gain this benefit in addition to any healing from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}. Leshies whose plant nourishment does not rely on photosynthesis require a similarly suitable environment. For example, fungus leshies need dark, damp environments and a pile of decaying plant matter.

_desc_ko:
고란 - 태양의 온기와 빛이 당신에게 생명을 줍니다. 낮에 야외에서 10분간 휴식을 취하면, 건강 능력치 수정자 × 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 HP를 회복합니다. 이 효과는 @link[actions.treat-wounds]로 인한 치유 효과에 추가로 적용됩니다.

레시 - 낮에 야외에서 10분간 휴식을 취하면, 건강 수정자 × 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 HP를 회복합니다. 이 효과는 @link[actions.treat-wounds]로 인한 치유 효과에 추가로 적용됩니다. 광합성에 의존하지 않는 식물성 영양분을 섭취하는 레시는 유사한 환경이 필요합니다. 예를 들어, 균류 레시는 어둡고 습한 환경과 부패한 식물 잔해 더미가 필요합니다.

name: Expert Longevity

description.value:
You've continued to refine the knowledge and skills you've gained through your life. When you choose a skill in which to become trained with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.WoLh16gyDp8y9WOZ]{Ancestral Longevity}, you can also choose a skill in which you are already trained and become an expert in that skill. This lasts until your Ancestral Longevity expires.

When the effects of Ancestral Longevity and Expert Longevity expire, you can retrain one of your skill increases. The skill increase you gain from this retraining must either make you trained in the skill you chose with Ancestral Longevity or make you an expert in the skill you chose with Expert Longevity.

The skill increase you gain from this retraining must either make you trained in the skill you chose with Ancestral Longevity or make you an expert in the skill you chose with Expert Longevity.
_desc_ko:
평생에 걸쳐 습득한 지식과 기술을 지속적으로 연마해 왔습니다. @link[feats.ancestral-longevity]로 숙련된 기술을 선택할 때, 이미 숙련된 기술 중 하나를 추가로 선택하여 그 기술에 대한 전문가가 될 수 있습니다. 이 효과는 조상의 장수 효과가 만료될 때까지 지속됩니다.

조상의 장수와 전문가의 장수 효과가 만료될 때, 당신은 자신의 기술 향상 중 하나를 재훈련할 수 있습니다. 이 재훈련으로 얻는 기술 향상은 반드시 조상의 장수로 선택한 기술에 숙련되게 하거나, 전문가의 장수로 선택한 기술에 전문가가 되게 해야 합니다.

name: Channeled Protection

description.value:
Requirements You are in Channeler's Stance and your last action was to Cast a Spell from your spell slots.

Your apparition uses excess energy to protect you. You and all adjacent allies gain a +1 status bonus to your AC and to your Reflex saving throws until the start of your next turn. If the spell was at least 7th rank, the status bonus increase to +2.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.UookwOq46zEokGOM]{Effect: Channeled Protection}

_desc_en:
Requirements You are in Channeler's Stance and your last action was to Cast a Spell from your spell slots.

Your apparition uses excess energy to protect you. You and all adjacent allies gain a +1 status bonus to your AC and to your Reflex saving throws until the start of your next turn. If the spell was at least 7th rank, the status bonus increase to +2.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.UookwOq46zEokGOM]{Effect: Channeled Protection}
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 채널러의 자세 상태이며, 마지막 행동으로 주문 슬롯에서 주문을 시전한 경우.

당신의 환영이 과잉 에너지를 사용해 당신을 보호합니다. 당신과 인접한 모든 아군은 다음 턴 시작까지 AC와 반사 내성에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 해당 주문이 7레벨 이상일 경우 상태 보너스가 +2로 증가합니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.UookwOq46zEokGOM]{효과: 채널링 보호}

name: Determined Dash

description.value:
Nothing can keep you from your enemy. Stride twice. During this movement you ignore difficult terrain, greater difficult terrain, and any effects that would impose a penalty to Speed.

You can attempt an [[/act balance skill=athletics]]{Athletics} check instead of an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} when moving across narrow surfaces or uneven ground, using the same DC. This doesn't prevent you from being harmed by hazardous terrain.

You can increase the number of actions this activity takes to 3 to Stride three times instead.

_desc_en:
Nothing can keep you from your enemy. Stride twice. During this movement you ignore difficult terrain, greater difficult terrain, and any effects that would impose a penalty to Speed.

You can attempt an [[/act balance skill=athletics]]{Athletics} check instead of an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} when moving across narrow surfaces or uneven ground, using the same DC. This doesn't prevent you from being harmed by hazardous terrain.

You can increase the number of actions this activity takes to 3 to Stride three times instead.
_desc_ko:
아무것도 당신을 적에게서 막을 수 없다. 두 걸음 이동한다. 이 이동 동안 당신은 어려운 지형, 매우 어려운 지형, 그리고 속도에 페널티를 부과하는 모든 효과를 무시한다.

좁은 표면이나 고르지 않은 지면을 이동할 때, 곡예 검사 대신 운동 검사를 시도하여 @link[actions.balance]을 유지할 수 있다. DC는 동일하게 적용된다. 이는 위험한 지형으로 인한 피해를 막아주지는 않는다.

이 활동에 소요되는 행동 횟수를 3으로 늘려 세 번에 걸쳐 큰걸음으로 이동할 수도 있습니다.

name: Bond Conservation

description.value:
Requirements The last action you used was to Cast a Spell enabled by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.v82XtjAVN4ffgVVR]{Drain Bonded Item}.

By efficiently and carefully manipulating the arcane energies unleashed by your bonded item, you can conserve just enough power to cast another spell, though this second spell is slightly weaker. You gain an extra use of Drain Bonded Item. You can use it to cast a spell 2 or more ranks lower than the previous spell, and must use it before the end of your next turn or you lose it.

_desc_en:
Requirements The last action you used was to Cast a Spell enabled by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.v82XtjAVN4ffgVVR]{Drain Bonded Item}.

By efficiently and carefully manipulating the arcane energies unleashed by your bonded item, you can conserve just enough power to cast another spell, though this second spell is slightly weaker. You gain an extra use of Drain Bonded Item. You can use it to cast a spell 2 or more ranks lower than the previous spell, and must use it before the end of your next turn or you lose it.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 마지막으로 사용한 행동이 @link[actions.drain-bonded-item]로 발동된 주문을 시전한 것이어야 합니다.

결속된 아이템이 발산하는 아케인 에너지를 효율적이고 신중하게 조작함으로써, 다른 주문을 시전할 만큼의 힘을 간신히 보존할 수 있습니다. 다만 이 두 번째 주문은 약간 약해집니다. '결속된 아이템 흡수' 능력을 한 번 더 사용할 수 있습니다. 이 능력을 사용해 이전 주문보다 2단계 이상 낮은 주문을 시전할 수 있으며, 다음 턴이 끝나기 전에 사용해야 합니다. 그렇지 않으면 능력을 잃게 됩니다.

name: Druid Dedication

description.value:
You cast spells like a druid. You gain the Cast a Spell activity. You can prepare two common cantrips each day from the primal spell list or any other primal cantrips you learn or discover. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for druid archetype spells is Wisdom, and they are primal druid spells. You learn the Wildsong language, and you are bound by the druid's anathema. Choose a druidic order. You become a member of that order and are also bound by its specific anathema, allowing you to take the order's feats. You become trained in Nature and your order's associated skill; for each of these skills in which you were already trained, you become trained in a skill of your choice. You don't gain any other abilities from your choice of order.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.gbBf6x89m4SEFpsL]{Druid}

_desc_en:
You cast spells like a druid. You gain the Cast a Spell activity. You can prepare two common cantrips each day from the primal spell list or any other primal cantrips you learn or discover. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for druid archetype spells is Wisdom, and they are primal druid spells. You learn the Wildsong language, and you are bound by the druid's anathema. Choose a druidic order. You become a member of that order and are also bound by its specific anathema, allowing you to take the order's feats. You become trained in Nature and your order's associated skill; for each of these skills in which you were already trained, you become trained in a skill of your choice. You don't gain any other abilities from your choice of order.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.gbBf6x89m4SEFpsL]{Druid}
_desc_ko: 드루이드처럼 주문을 시전합니다. '주문 시전' 행동을 얻습니다. 프라이멀 주문 목록이나 배우거나 발견한 다른 프라이멀 캔트립 중 일반 캔트립 두 개를 매일 준비할 수 있습니다. 주문 공격 수정자와 주문 DC 통계에 숙련됩니다. 드루이드 아키타입 주문의 핵심 주문 시전 능력치는 지혜이며, 이들은 프라이멀 드루이드 주문입니다. 와일드송 언어를 습득하며, 드루이드의 저주에 묶입니다. 드루이드 교단을 선택하십시오. 해당 교단의 일원이 되며, 교단 고유의 저주에도 얽매여 교단의 피트를 선택할 수 있습니다. 자연과 교단 관련 기술에 숙련됩니다. 이미 숙련된 이 기술들 각각에 대해, 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다. 교단 선택으로 인한 다른 능력은 얻지 않습니다.

name: Scamper Underfoot

description.value: You are used to ducking under foes and can scurry around the battlefield with ease. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} the spaces of Medium or larger enemies, and the presence of an enemy doesn't make the squares difficult terrain.

_desc_en: You are used to ducking under foes and can scurry around the battlefield with ease. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} the spaces of Medium or larger enemies, and the presence of an enemy doesn't make the squares difficult terrain.
_desc_ko: 적 아래로 몸을 숙이는 데 익숙하여 전장을 쉽게 누비며 다닐 수 있습니다. 중간 크기 이상의 적의 공간을 @link[actions.tumble-through]하는 곡예 판정 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 적의 존재로 인해 해당 칸이 어려운 지형으로 간주되지 않습니다.

name: Lead Climber

description.value: When climbing, you can prepare routes for others to follow, and you can pull your allies up to avoid disaster. When your allies attempt to Climb a route you set using the Follow the Expert exploration activity, if any of them critically fail their checks to Climb, you can attempt an Athletics check against the same DC. If you succeed, your ally only fails instead of critically failing. If you also critically fail, you both experience the consequences of the critical failure.

_desc_en: When climbing, you can prepare routes for others to follow, and you can pull your allies up to avoid disaster. When your allies attempt to Climb a route you set using the Follow the Expert exploration activity, if any of them critically fail their checks to Climb, you can attempt an Athletics check against the same DC. If you succeed, your ally only fails instead of critically failing. If you also critically fail, you both experience the consequences of the critical failure.
_desc_ko: 등반 시 다른 이들이 따라갈 경로를 준비할 수 있으며, 동료를 끌어올려 재난을 피할 수 있습니다. 동료가 '전문가 따르기' 탐험 활동으로 당신이 설정한 경로를 등반하려 할 때, 그들 중 누군가가 등반 판정에서 대실패를 하면 당신은 동일한 DC로 운동 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다. 성공하면 동료를 대실패 대신 단순 실패로 만듭니다. 당신도 대실패를 하면 둘 다 대실패의 결과를 겪습니다.

name: Crafter's Appraisal

description.value: Your knowledge of items' construction allows you to discern their magical effects as well. You can use Crafting instead of a skill associated with a magic tradition to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} on magic items, though not on any other sorts of magic.

_desc_en: Your knowledge of items' construction allows you to discern their magical effects as well. You can use Crafting instead of a skill associated with a magic tradition to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} on magic items, though not on any other sorts of magic.
_desc_ko: 아이템 제작에 대한 당신의 지식은 마법 효과까지도 식별할 수 있게 합니다. 마법 전통 관련 스킬 대신 제작 기술을 사용하여 마법 아이템에 @link[actions.identify-magic]을 수행할 수 있으나, 다른 종류의 마법에는 적용되지 않습니다.

name: Siege Celerity

description.value:
Trigger Your turn begins.

You push yourself and your light mortar beyond your limits. You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for this turn. You can use the extra action to Load or Launch your light mortar. This doesn't allow you bypass the normal limit of one Launch per round.

_desc_en:
Trigger Your turn begins.

You push yourself and your light mortar beyond your limits. You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for this turn. You can use the extra action to Load or Launch your light mortar. This doesn't allow you bypass the normal limit of one Launch per round.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신의 턴이 시작됩니다.

당신은 자신과 경박격포를 한계 이상으로 밀어붙입니다. 이번 턴 동안 당신은 @link[conditions.quickened] 상태입니다. 추가 행동을 사용하여 경박격포를 장전하거나 발사할 수 있습니다. 이는 턴당 한 번의 발사라는 일반적인 제한을 우회할 수 있게 해주지 않습니다.

name: Shared Tide

description.value: You Swim up to twice the normal distance. Any ally you pass within 30 feet of during that movement gains your swim Speed until the beginning of your next turn.

value.value: your animal shape has a swim Speed

_desc_en: You Swim up to twice the normal distance. Any ally you pass within 30 feet of during that movement gains your swim Speed until the beginning of your next turn.
_desc_ko: 당신은 평소의 두 배까지 수영할 수 있습니다. 그 이동 중 30피트 이내를 지나가는 모든 아군은 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 당신의 수영 속도를 얻습니다.

name: Enticing Dwelling

description.value: Your spirit dwelling is particularly inviting to spirit wisps. During your daily preparations, and whenever you spend 10 minutes to find more wisps, you entice two wisps into your spirit dwelling instead of one.

_desc_en: Your spirit dwelling is particularly inviting to spirit wisps. During your daily preparations, and whenever you spend 10 minutes to find more wisps, you entice two wisps into your spirit dwelling instead of one.
_desc_ko: 당신의 영혼 거처는 특히 영혼 위습들에게 매력적이다. 일일 준비 시간 동안, 그리고 10분을 들여 더 많은 위습을 찾을 때마다, 당신은 한 마리가 아닌 두 마리의 위습을 영혼 거처로 유혹한다.

name: Sun's Fury

description.value: The Old Sun Gods have granted you a gift in your fight against Walkena. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.LrFUj76CHDBV0vHW]{Sun's Fury} focus spell. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can regain using the Refocus activity to pray to the Old Sun Gods; if you already have a focus pool, increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1. Your Bright Lion focus spells are divine spells; when you gain this feat, if you aren't already, you become trained in divine spell attacks and spell DCs, using Charisma as your spellcasting ability score.

_desc_en: The Old Sun Gods have granted you a gift in your fight against Walkena. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.LrFUj76CHDBV0vHW]{Sun's Fury} focus spell. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can regain using the Refocus activity to pray to the Old Sun Gods; if you already have a focus pool, increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1. Your Bright Lion focus spells are divine spells; when you gain this feat, if you aren't already, you become trained in divine spell attacks and spell DCs, using Charisma as your spellcasting ability score.
_desc_ko: 옛 태양의 신들이 월케나와의 싸움에서 당신에게 선물을 내리셨습니다. @link[spells.suns-fury] 포커스 주문을 획득한다. 포커스 풀이 없는 경우, 1 포커스 포인트의 포커스 풀을 획득하며, 리포커스 활동을 통해 고대 태양신에게 기도하여 회복할 수 있다. 이미 포커스 풀이 있는 경우, 포커스 풀의 포커스 포인트 수를 1 증가시킨다. 당신의 브라이트 라이언 포커스 주문은 신성 주문입니다. 이 피트를 획득할 때, 아직 그렇지 않다면 매력를 주문 시전 능력치로 사용하여 신성 주문 공격과 주문 난이도(DC)에 숙련됩니다.

name: Basic Rivethun Spellcasting

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{Basic Spellcasting Benefits}. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the Rivethun involutionist archetype, add a common divine spell of the appropriate rank, another appropriate divine spell you learned or discovered, or any other divine spell to which you have access, to your repertoire.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{Basic Spellcasting Benefits}. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the Rivethun involutionist archetype, add a common divine spell of the appropriate rank, another appropriate divine spell you learned or discovered, or any other divine spell to which you have access, to your repertoire.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{기본 주문 시전 혜택}을 얻습니다. 리베툰 내향주의자 아키타입으로 새로운 랭크의 주문 슬롯을 획득할 때마다, 해당 랭크의 일반 신성 주문, 학습하거나 발견한 다른 적절한 신성 주문, 또는 접근 가능한 다른 신성 주문을 레퍼토리에 추가합니다.

name: Preserve the Moment

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger Your turn ends.

Sometimes, your actions are so successful and impressive that it's worth going back to them. Note the actions you took during the turn that just ended (excepting the reaction you used to trigger Preserve the Moment), including the die roll results (not the actual check results). Die rolls you made as a result of others' actions on you or from the environment are not recorded. For example, if you Stride up to a firewyrm, roll a basic Reflex save against its intense heat aura, then Strike the firewyrm with a longsword, and then Climb up an adjacent wall, when you activate Preserve the Moment you record only the Stride action, the Strike action (and the die roll result you roll for the Strike), and the Climb action (and the die roll result you roll for the Athletics check to do so); you do not record your Reflex save against the aura's effects. Preserve the Moment works best, as a result, when the actions you take are relatively standard and when rolls associated with those are high rolls.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.0jJQglG57R6ss04M]{Restore the Moment} reaction, which you can use once during the next 24 hours.
