_desc_ko:
빈도 하루 1회

발동 당신의 턴이 끝납니다.

때때로 당신의 행동은 너무나 성공적이고 인상적이어서 그것으로 되돌아갈 가치가 있습니다. 방금 끝난 턴 동안 당신이 취한 행동들을(순간 보존을 발동하는 데 사용한 반응은 제외) 주사위 굴림 결과(실제 판정 결과가 아님)와 함께 기록합니다. 타인의 행동이나 환경으로 인해 당신이 굴린 주사위는 기록되지 않습니다. 예를 들어, 당신이 화염룡에게 보폭으로 다가가, 그 강렬한 열기 오라에 대해 기본 반사 내성을 굴리고, 장검으로 화염룡을 타격한 뒤, 인접한 벽을 기어오른다면, 순간 보존을 발동할 때 당신은 보폭 행동, 타격 행동(및 타격을 위해 굴린 주사위 결과), 기어오르기 행동(및 그렇게 하기 위한 운동 판정으로 굴린 주사위 결과)만 기록하며, 오라 효과에 대한 반사 내성은 기록하지 않습니다. 따라서 순간 보존은 당신이 취한 행동이 비교적 표준적이고 그와 관련된 굴림이 높은 굴림일 때 가장 잘 작동합니다.

당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.0jJQglG57R6ss04M]{순간 복원} 반응을 얻으며, 이는 다음 24시간 동안 1회 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Clotting Elixirs

description.value: Your restorative concoctions have a clotting effect on the drinker's blood. When a living creature drinks an infused elixir with the healing trait that you have created, it can immediately attempt a @Check[flat|dc:10] to remove any persistent bleed damage.

_desc_en: Your restorative concoctions have a clotting effect on the drinker's blood. When a living creature drinks an infused elixir with the healing trait that you have created, it can immediately attempt a @Check[flat|dc:10] to remove any persistent bleed damage.
_desc_ko: 당신이 제조한 회복성 혼합물은 마시는 이의 혈액에 응고 효과를 줍니다. 생물이 당신이 만든 치유 특성이 부여된 혼합 엘릭서를 마셨을 때, 즉시 DC 10 단순을 시도하여 지속 출혈 피해를 제거할 수 있습니다.

name: Duel Spell Advantage

description.value:
When you start a psychic duel, you gain a third natural psychic spell. You can't choose the same spell twice.

If you're 9th level or higher, add the following spells to the list of natural psychic spells you can choose: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.LiGbewa9pO0yjbsY]{Confusion}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.U58aQWJ47VrI36yP]{Hallucination}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qwlh6aDgi86U3Q7H]{Suggestion}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.BilnTGuXrof9Dt9D]{Synaptic Pulse}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OAt2ZEns1gIOCgrn]{Synesthesia}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GaRQlC9Yw1BGKHfN]{Wave of Despair}.

_desc_en:
When you start a psychic duel, you gain a third natural psychic spell. You can't choose the same spell twice.

If you're 9th level or higher, add the following spells to the list of natural psychic spells you can choose: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.LiGbewa9pO0yjbsY]{Confusion}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.U58aQWJ47VrI36yP]{Hallucination}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qwlh6aDgi86U3Q7H]{Suggestion}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.BilnTGuXrof9Dt9D]{Synaptic Pulse}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OAt2ZEns1gIOCgrn]{Synesthesia}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GaRQlC9Yw1BGKHfN]{Wave of Despair}.
_desc_ko:
사이킥 결투를 시작할 때, 세 번째 자연 사이킥 주문을 획득한다. 동일한 주문을 두 번 선택할 수 없다.

9레벨 이상일 경우, 선택 가능한 자연 사이킥 주문 목록에 다음 주문들을 추가한다:

  • @link[spells.confusion]
  • @link[spells.wave-of-despair]
  • @link[spells.hallucination]
  • @link[spells.suggestion]
  • @link[spells.synaptic-pulse]
  • @link[spells.synesthesia]

name: Numbing Spice Exhalation

description.value: You can mix alchemically preserved peppers into an alchemical food consumable to spice it up with alchemical fire. When the modified alchemical food is consumed, the user's mouth goes numb temporarily. Once within the next hour, they can spend a single action to breathe a gout of flame in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15]. Each creature in the cone takes @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))d6[fire]|options:area-damage]{1d6 fire damage for every two levels you have} with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: You can mix alchemically preserved peppers into an alchemical food consumable to spice it up with alchemical fire. When the modified alchemical food is consumed, the user's mouth goes numb temporarily. Once within the next hour, they can spend a single action to breathe a gout of flame in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15]. Each creature in the cone takes @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))d6[fire]|options:area-damage]{1d6 fire damage for every two levels you have} with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC.
_desc_ko: 연금술적으로 보존된 고추를 연금술 음식에 혼합하여 연금술 불꽃으로 매운맛을 낼 수 있습니다. 이렇게 조정된 연금술 음식을 섭취하면 사용자의 입이 일시적으로 마비됩니다. 이후 1시간 이내에 한 번, 액션 하나를 소모하여 15피트 원뿔 범위의 화염을 내뿜을 수 있습니다. 원뿔 범위 내의 모든 생물은 소지한 레벨 2당 1d6 화염 피해를 입으며, 기본 반사 난이도의 내성 굴림(클래스 DC 기준)를 수행합니다.

name: Divine Wings

description.value:
Frequency once per day

With effort, you can call forth magical wings from your back, similar in appearance to those of your extraplanar forebear, whether they be elegantly feathered wings or ominous bat wings. These wings remain for 10 minutes. You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed while you've manifested your wings.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

With effort, you can call forth magical wings from your back, similar in appearance to those of your extraplanar forebear, whether they be elegantly feathered wings or ominous bat wings. These wings remain for 10 minutes. You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed while you've manifested your wings.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

노력을 기울이면, 우아한 깃털 날개든 불길한 박쥐 날개든, 차원 너머 조상의 날개와 유사한 마법 날개를 등에서 불러낼 수 있다. 이 날개는 10분 동안 유지된다. 날개를 창조한 동안, 이동 속도와 동일한 비행 속도를 얻는다.

name: Ironclad Fortitude

description.value: Your proficiency rank in Fortitude saves increases to master.

_desc_en: Your proficiency rank in Fortitude saves increases to master.
_desc_ko: 당신의 인내 내성 숙련도 등급이 달인로 상승합니다.

name: Plague Rat

description.value:
Your bites carry a cursed infection. When you hit and deal damage to a creature with a jaws Strike while in hybrid or rat shape, the creature is cursed until the start of your next turn. Whenever they regain Hit Points during that time, they must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

Success The creature regains Hit Points normally.

Failure The creature regains half the normal Hit Points.

Critical Failure The creature regains no Hit Points.

_desc_en:
Your bites carry a cursed infection. When you hit and deal damage to a creature with a jaws Strike while in hybrid or rat shape, the creature is cursed until the start of your next turn. Whenever they regain Hit Points during that time, they must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

Success The creature regains Hit Points normally.

Failure The creature regains half the normal Hit Points.

Critical Failure The creature regains no Hit Points.
_desc_ko:
당신의 물기는 저주받은 감염을 동반합니다. 하이브리드 형태나 쥐 형태일 때 턱 공격으로 생물에게 명중하여 피해를 입히면, 해당 생물은 다음 차례 시작까지 저주 상태가 됩니다. 해당 기간 동안 HP를 회복할 때마다, 대상은 네 직업 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽을 기준으로 인내 저항 검사를 시도해야 한다.

성공 생물은 정상적으로 HP를 회복한다.

실패 생물은 정상 HP의 절반을 회복합니다.

대실패 생물은 HP를 회복하지 못한다.

name: Practiced Defender

description.value: After extensive practice with the Swords, you're comfortable enough with your shield to move at a normal pace with it raised. You may use the Defend exploration activity while traveling at your full travel speed instead of half your travel speed.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en: After extensive practice with the Swords, you're comfortable enough with your shield to move at a normal pace with it raised. You may use the Defend exploration activity while traveling at your full travel speed instead of half your travel speed.
_desc_ko: 검술을 오랫동안 연마한 덕분에 방패를 든 상태에서도 평상시 속도로 움직일 수 있을 만큼 숙달되었습니다. 이동 속도의 절반이 아닌 최대 이동 속도로 이동 중에도 탐색 활동 '방어'를 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Spellmaster Dedication

description.value:
As a Spellmaster, you are adept at identifying magic. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} with a skill in which you are trained or better. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.UyMQ1X8KLSZvm7AT]{Wayfinder Resonance Tinkerer} feat, you can change the cantrip you chose for that feat each day during your daily preparations.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.O7fKfFxCx3e1YasX]{Spellmaster}

value.value: member of the Pathfinder Society affiliated with the School of Spells

_desc_en:
As a Spellmaster, you are adept at identifying magic. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} with a skill in which you are trained or better. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.UyMQ1X8KLSZvm7AT]{Wayfinder Resonance Tinkerer} feat, you can change the cantrip you chose for that feat each day during your daily preparations.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.O7fKfFxCx3e1YasX]{Spellmaster}
_desc_ko: 스펠마스터로서 당신은 마법 식별에 능숙합니다. 당신이 숙련된 기술 이상으로 @link[actions.identify-magic]을 수행할 때 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. @link[feats.wayfinder-resonance-tinkerer] 피트를 보유한 경우, 매일 준비 시간 동안 해당 재주로 선택한 캔트립을 변경할 수 있습니다.

name: Ore Fists

description.value: When you enter the Stonestrike Stance, your fists appear to be covered with veins of unrefined ore. Your stonestrike attacks count as cold iron and silver when determining weaknesses and bypassing resistances.

_desc_en: When you enter the Stonestrike Stance, your fists appear to be covered with veins of unrefined ore. Your stonestrike attacks count as cold iron and silver when determining weaknesses and bypassing resistances.
_desc_ko: 스톤스트라이크 자세를 취하면 주먹에 정제되지 않은 광석의 정맥이 드러난 듯 보인다. 스톤스트라이크 공격은 약점 판정 및 저항 회피 시 냉철과 은으로 간주된다.

name: Repositioning Block

description.value:
Trigger You used @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} to prevent damage from an adjacent creature's attack.

As you absorb a blow from an enemy, you can use their attack's momentum against them. Attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition} the creature whose attack you used Shield Block against. You don't need to have a hand free to do so. You gain a +1 item bonus to the Athletics check if your shield is at least 4th level, a +2 item bonus if your shield is at least 10th level, and a +3 item bonus if your shield is at least 16th level.

_desc_en:
Trigger You used @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} to prevent damage from an adjacent creature's attack.

As you absorb a blow from an enemy, you can use their attack's momentum against them. Attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition} the creature whose attack you used Shield Block against. You don't need to have a hand free to do so. You gain a +1 item bonus to the Athletics check if your shield is at least 4th level, a +2 item bonus if your shield is at least 10th level, and a +3 item bonus if your shield is at least 16th level.
_desc_ko:
Trigger 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{방패 막기}를 사용해 인접한 생물의 공격으로 인한 피해를 막았습니다.

적의 공격을 흡수하는 동시에 그 공격의 추진력을 역이용할 수 있습니다. 방패 막기로 막은 생물의 위치를 @link[actions.reposition] 시도하다{재위치} 당신이 방패 막기로 막은 공격을 한 생물의 위치를 바꿔보세요. 이를 위해 손을 비울 필요는 없습니다. 당신의 방패가 최소 (4th)레벨 이상일 경우 운동 판정에서 +1 아이템 보너스를, 최소 (10th)레벨 이상일 경우 +2 아이템 보너스를, 최소 16레벨 이상일 경우 +3 아이템 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Green Tongue

description.value: You share a special kinship with all things green and living. You (and your leshy familiar, if you have one) are constantly under the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qvwIwJ9QBihy8R0t]{Speak with Plants}. Most non-creature plants recognize you as a druid of the leaf order and are friendly to you.

_desc_en: You share a special kinship with all things green and living. You (and your leshy familiar, if you have one) are constantly under the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qvwIwJ9QBihy8R0t]{Speak with Plants}. Most non-creature plants recognize you as a druid of the leaf order and are friendly to you.
_desc_ko: 당신은 모든 푸르고 살아있는 것들과 특별한 유대감을 공유합니다. 당신(그리고 레시 패밀리어이 있다면 그 패밀리어도)은 지속적으로 @link[spells.speak-with-plants]의 효과를 받습니다. 대부분의 비생물 식물들은 당신을 잎의 계통 드루이드로 인식하며 친근하게 대합니다.

name: Roar Mimicry

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You unleash a roar so loud that it's felt as deeply as it's heard. All creatures within a @Template[emanation|distance:15] take @Damage[(max(8,(floor(@actor.level/2)*2)-4))d6[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage and must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. This damage increases by 2d6 at 14th level and every 2 levels thereafter.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}. If the creature is adjacent to you, they're also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}. If the creature is adjacent to you, they're also deafened for 1 minute.

value.value: you have been targeted by a creature's auditory ability that affects an area or have identified a creature with an auditory ability that affects an area

_desc_en:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You unleash a roar so loud that it's felt as deeply as it's heard. All creatures within a @Template[emanation|distance:15] take @Damage[(max(8,(floor(@actor.level/2)*2)-4))d6[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage and must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. This damage increases by 2d6 at 14th level and every 2 levels thereafter.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}. If the creature is adjacent to you, they're also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}. If the creature is adjacent to you, they're also deafened for 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
빈도 10분마다 한 번

당신은 들리는 만큼 깊이 느껴질 정도로 우렁찬 포효를 내지른다. 15피트 범위 내의 모든 생물은 음파의 피해를 입으며, 당신의 클래스 DC와 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽에 대한 인내 내성을 시도해야 한다. 이 피해는 14레벨에 2d6씩 증가하며, 이후 2레벨마다 추가로 증가한다.

대성공 생물은 영향을 받지 않는다.

성공 생물은 절반의 피해를 받습니다.

실패 생물은 전체 피해를 입으며 @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태가 됩니다. 생물이 당신과 인접해 있다면, 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.deafened] 상태가 됩니다.

대실패 생물은 두 배의 피해를 입으며 @link[conditions.stunned]{2} 상태가 됩니다. 생물이 당신과 인접해 있다면, 1분 동안 귀가 먹먹해집니다.

name: Cruelty

description.value: The harm you deal with your corrupting touch saps the strength from your enemy's body. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jFmWSIpJGGebim6y]{Touch of the Void} targeting a living creature using 2 actions instead of 1. If you do, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 minute if it fails its save (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} if it critically fails).

_desc_en: The harm you deal with your corrupting touch saps the strength from your enemy's body. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jFmWSIpJGGebim6y]{Touch of the Void} targeting a living creature using 2 actions instead of 1. If you do, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 minute if it fails its save (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} if it critically fails).
_desc_ko: 부패의 손길로 가하는 피해는 적의 몸에서 힘을 빼앗습니다. 당신은 1번 대신 2번의 행동 을 사용해 살아있는 생물을 대상으로 공허의 손길을 시전할 수 있다. 그렇게 할 경우, 대상이 내성에 실패하면 1분 동안 @link[conditions.enfeebled]{1} 상태가 된다(@link[conditions.enfeebled]{2} 상태가 되는 것은 대실패 시).

name: Precious Munitions

description.value: You mix flecks of precious materials you've gathered on your journeys into your custom bullets to bring out those properties in your temporary ammunition. You can use advanced alchemy to create standard-grade adamantine, cold iron, or silver ammunition, spending 1 daily consumable per piece of ammunition. At 15th level, you can create high-grade adamantine, cold iron, or silver ammunition.

_desc_en: You mix flecks of precious materials you've gathered on your journeys into your custom bullets to bring out those properties in your temporary ammunition. You can use advanced alchemy to create standard-grade adamantine, cold iron, or silver ammunition, spending 1 daily consumable per piece of ammunition. At 15th level, you can create high-grade adamantine, cold iron, or silver ammunition.
_desc_ko: 여행 중 수집한 귀중한 재료의 조각들을 맞춤형 탄환에 혼합하여 임시 탄약에 해당 특성을 부여합니다. 고급 연금술을 사용해 표준 등급의 아다만틴, 냉철, 은 탄약을 제작할 수 있으며, 탄약 한 발당 일일 소모품 1개를 소모한다. 15레벨에 도달하면 고급 등급의 아다만틴, 냉철, 은 탄약을 제작할 수 있다.

name: Mask of Rejection

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a saving throw against an effect from your warmask's magical tradition.

Requirements You're wearing your warmask.

Your warmask projects a white-hot fury that attempts to vaporize the offending magic. You reroll the triggering check with a +2 circumstance bonus, but you must use the new result, even if it's worse than your first roll.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a saving throw against an effect from your warmask's magical tradition.

Requirements You're wearing your warmask.

Your warmask projects a white-hot fury that attempts to vaporize the offending magic. You reroll the triggering check with a +2 circumstance bonus, but you must use the new result, even if it's worse than your first roll.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 네가 전쟁 가면의 마법 전통에 따른 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 실패할 때.

요구 사항 당신은 전쟁 가면을 착용하고 있습니다.

당신의 전투용 가면은 불타는 분노를 발산하며 공격 마법을 증발시키려고 시도합니다. 재굴림에 +2 상황 보너스가 적용되나, 결과가 이전보다 나빠도 반드시 새 결과를 사용해야 합니다.

name: Rites of Liberation

description.value: You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4ddJSjC9Zz5DX0oG]{Freedom} ritual. If you spend an additional Mythic Point while casting it, you reduce its casting time to 1 hour, and both the primary and secondary casters attempt their corresponding skill checks at mythic proficiency. If you would critically fail the ritual, you fail instead. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gwOYh5zMVZB0HNcT]{Unimpeded Stride} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2jB9eyX7YekwoCvA]{Word of Freedom} domain spells. These are focus spells, granting you a focus pool of 2 Focus Points or expanding that pool if you already have one. You can Refocus while you meditate on the concepts of freedom and liberty.

_desc_en: You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4ddJSjC9Zz5DX0oG]{Freedom} ritual. If you spend an additional Mythic Point while casting it, you reduce its casting time to 1 hour, and both the primary and secondary casters attempt their corresponding skill checks at mythic proficiency. If you would critically fail the ritual, you fail instead. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gwOYh5zMVZB0HNcT]{Unimpeded Stride} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2jB9eyX7YekwoCvA]{Word of Freedom} domain spells. These are focus spells, granting you a focus pool of 2 Focus Points or expanding that pool if you already have one. You can Refocus while you meditate on the concepts of freedom and liberty.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @link[spells.freedom] 의식을 배운다. 시전 시 신화 포인트를 추가로 소모하면 시전 시간을 1시간으로 단축하며, 주 시전자와 보조 시전자 모두 해당 기술 검사를 신화 숙련도로 시도한다. 의식에 대실패를 할 경우, 대신 실패로 처리됩니다. 또한 @link[spells.unimpeded-stride]과 @link[spells.word-of-freedom] 도메인 주문을 획득합니다. 이 주문들은 포커스 주문으로, 2 포커스 포인트의 포커스 풀을 부여하거나 기존 풀을 확장합니다. 자유와 해방의 개념을 명상하며 재집중할 수 있습니다.

name: Absorb Toxin

description.value:
Trigger You attempt a saving throw against a disease or poison effect that affects an area.

Your skin readily absorbs poison and can consciously draw toxins into your body to spare others. Attempt a counteract check against the triggering effect; your counteract rank equals half your level (rounded up), and for the roll use either your class DC – 10 or your spellcasting attribute modifier plus your spellcasting proficiency bonus. If you counteract the triggering effect, you end the effect for all other creatures in the area; however, you must still save against the effect with a –2 penalty to the initial save.

value.value: You are not immune to diseases or poisons

_desc_en:
Trigger You attempt a saving throw against a disease or poison effect that affects an area.

Your skin readily absorbs poison and can consciously draw toxins into your body to spare others. Attempt a counteract check against the triggering effect; your counteract rank equals half your level (rounded up), and for the roll use either your class DC – 10 or your spellcasting attribute modifier plus your spellcasting proficiency bonus. If you counteract the triggering effect, you end the effect for all other creatures in the area; however, you must still save against the effect with a –2 penalty to the initial save.
_desc_ko:
발동 영역에 영향을 미치는 질병이나 독 효과에 대해 내성 굴림을 시도합니다.

당신의 피부는 독을 쉽게 흡수하며, 의식적으로 독소를 몸 안으로 끌어당겨 다른 이들을 구할 수 있습니다. 유발 효과에 대해 반격 판정을 시도하십시오. 반격 랭크은 레벨의 절반(올림)이며, 굴림에는 직업 DC - 10 또는 주문 시전 능력치 수정자에 주문 시전 숙련 보너스를 더한 값을 사용합니다. 발동 효과를 반격하면 해당 영역 내 다른 모든 생물의 효과도 종료됩니다. 다만, 초기 내성 굴림에는 여전히 -2 페널티가 적용됩니다.

name: Play Dead

description.value: You lie @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} and pretend to be an ordinary skeleton. As long as you don't move or take any actions requiring anything other than your mind, you appear dead. To see through your ruse, another creature must succeed at a check against your Deception DC, either by Seeking or Recalling Knowledge (typically using Religion or an appropriate Lore skill). This ability doesn't work against creatures that already know you're an animate undead unless you have changed your appearance.

_desc_en: You lie @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} and pretend to be an ordinary skeleton. As long as you don't move or take any actions requiring anything other than your mind, you appear dead. To see through your ruse, another creature must succeed at a check against your Deception DC, either by Seeking or Recalling Knowledge (typically using Religion or an appropriate Lore skill). This ability doesn't work against creatures that already know you're an animate undead unless you have changed your appearance.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @link[conditions.prone]로 누워 평범한 해골인 척합니다. 정신 외의 다른 것을 요구하는 행동을 취하거나 움직이지 않는 한, 당신은 죽은 것처럼 보입니다. 이 속임수를 간파하려면 다른 생물이 당신의 기만 DC에 대한 판정에 성공해야 하며, 이는 탐색하거나 지식 회상(일반적으로 종교 또는 적절한 지식 지식를 사용)을 통해 이루어집니다. 이 능력은 당신이 외형을 바꾸지 않는 한, 이미 당신이 움직이는 언데드임을 알고 있는 생물에게는 효과가 없습니다.

name: Whirling Throw

description.value:
Requirements You have a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

You propel your enemy away. Attempt an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.7zqvzpR9gvHPUDqC]{Athletics} check against the foe's Fortitude DC. You take a –2 circumstance penalty to your check if the target is one size larger than you and a –4 circumstance penalty if it's larger than that. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your check if the target is one size smaller than you and a +4 circumstance bonus if it's smaller than that.

Critical Success You throw the creature any distance up to 10 feet, plus 5 feet × your Strength modifier ([[/r 10+(5*@actor.abilities.str.mod)]] feet). It takes bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier plus 1d6 per 10 feet you threw it (@Damage[((floor((10+(5*@actor.abilities.str.mod))/10))d6 + @actor.abilities.str.mod)[bludgeoning]] damage). If you threw the target at least 10 feet and into a solid obstacle, use the maximum distance you could have thrown it to calculate the damage. The creature falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Success As critical success, but the creature doesn't fall prone.

Failure You don't throw the creature.

Critical Failure You don't throw the creature, and it's no longer @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by you.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

You propel your enemy away. Attempt an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.7zqvzpR9gvHPUDqC]{Athletics} check against the foe's Fortitude DC. You take a –2 circumstance penalty to your check if the target is one size larger than you and a –4 circumstance penalty if it's larger than that. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your check if the target is one size smaller than you and a +4 circumstance bonus if it's smaller than that.

Critical Success You throw the creature any distance up to 10 feet, plus 5 feet × your Strength modifier ([[/r 10+(5*@actor.abilities.str.mod)]] feet). It takes bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier plus 1d6 per 10 feet you threw it (@Damage[((floor((10+(5*@actor.abilities.str.mod))/10))d6 + @actor.abilities.str.mod)[bludgeoning]] damage). If you threw the target at least 10 feet and into a solid obstacle, use the maximum distance you could have thrown it to calculate the damage. The creature falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Success As critical success, but the creature doesn't fall prone.

Failure You don't throw the creature.

Critical Failure You don't throw the creature, and it's no longer @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by you.
_desc_ko:
Requirements 당신은 생물을 @link[conditions.grabbed] 또는 @link[conditions.restrained] 상태로 만듭니다.

당신은 적을 밀쳐냅니다. 적의 인내 DC에 대해 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.7zqvzpR9gvHPUDqC]{운동} 판정을 시도합니다. 대상이 당신보다 한 크기 크면 판정에서 -2 상황 페널티를, 그보다 더 크면 -4 상황 페널티를 받습니다. 목표가 자신보다 한 크기 작을 경우 판정에서 +2 상황 보너스를, 그보다 작을 경우 +4 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

대성공 당신은 생물을 최대 10피트 + 근력 능력치 수정자 × 5피트(10+(5*@actor.abilities.str.mod) 피트)까지 던집니다. 던진 거리 10피트당 근력 능력치 수정자 + 1d6의 타격 피해를 입습니다(타격 피해). 목표물을 최소 10피트 이상 던져 단단한 장애물에 부딪히게 했다면, 던질 수 있는 최대 거리를 기준으로 피해를 계산한다. 생물은 @link[conditions.prone] 상태가 된다.

성공 대성공과 동일하나, 생물이 넘어지지 않습니다.

실패 생물을 던지지 못한다.

대실패 당신은 생물을 던지지 않으며, 더 이상 당신에 의해 @link[conditions.grabbed] 상태나 @link[conditions.restrained] 상태가 아닙니다.

name: Touch Focus

description.value:
Trigger You begin to Cast a Spell that requires a spell attack roll.

You can redirect a spell's power through you to deliver it within striking distance. If your next action is to Cast a Spell with 1 or more targets and a range farther than touch, you change the range to touch. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack. This only allows you to touch a single target with the spell, even if the spell originally affected more than 1 target. As long as your spell attack is successful, the target is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} in addition to the spell's normal effects.

publication.title: Pathfinder Fists of the Ruby Phoenix Hardcover Compilation

_desc_en:

This only allows you to touch a single target with the spell, even if the spell originally affected more than 1 target. As long as your spell attack is successful, the target is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} in addition to the spell's normal effects.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신이 명중 굴림이 필요한 주문을 시전하기 시작할 때.

주문의 힘을 자신을 통해 재지향하여 강타 거리 내로 전달할 수 있습니다. 다음 행동이 1개 이상의 대상과 접촉보다 먼 거리의 주문을 시전하는 것이라면, 범위를 접촉으로 변경합니다. 공격에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 이로 인해 원래 1개 이상의 대상에 영향을 미쳤던 주문이라도 단일 대상에게만 접촉할 수 있습니다. 주문 공격이 성공하면 대상은 주문의 일반 효과에 더해 @link[conditions.prone] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Cold Minded

description.value: The subtle strands of beguiling magic leave little impression on your mind. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion effects, and whenever you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: The subtle strands of beguiling magic leave little impression on your mind. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion effects, and whenever you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 매혹적인 마법의 미묘한 실타래는 당신의 마음에 거의 흔적을 남기지 않습니다. 감정 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 감정 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴릴 때마다 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Improved Twin Riposte (Fighter)

description.value: Your weapons are a blur, blocking and biting at your foes. You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.GJIAecRq1bD2r8O0]{Twin Riposte} even if you aren't benefiting from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Y8LHfkzGyOhPlUou]{Twin Parry}. At the start of each of your turns, you gain an additional reaction that you can use only to make a Twin Riposte.

_desc_en: Your weapons are a blur, blocking and biting at your foes. You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.GJIAecRq1bD2r8O0]{Twin Riposte} even if you aren't benefiting from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Y8LHfkzGyOhPlUou]{Twin Parry}. At the start of each of your turns, you gain an additional reaction that you can use only to make a Twin Riposte.
_desc_ko: 당신의 무기는 흐릿하게 움직이며 적을 막고 물어뜯습니다. @link[feats.twin-riposte]은 @link[feats.twin-parry]의 효과를 받지 않아도 사용할 수 있다. 각 턴 시작 시, 쌍검 반격만을 위해 사용할 수 있는 추가 반응을 얻는다.

name: Body Barrier

description.value:
Trigger You and at least one ally are in the area of an effect that requires a Reflex save.

When your allies are in danger, you don't hesitate to take the brunt of the blow for them. You grant all allies in the area standard cover against the triggering effect, and you gain weakness to all damage against the triggering effect equal to twice the number of allies that gain cover in this way.

_desc_en:
Trigger You and at least one ally are in the area of an effect that requires a Reflex save.

When your allies are in danger, you don't hesitate to take the brunt of the blow for them. You grant all allies in the area standard cover against the triggering effect, and you gain weakness to all damage against the triggering effect equal to twice the number of allies that gain cover in this way.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신과 최소 한 명의 아군이 반사 내성이 필요한 효과의 범위 내에 있을 때.

동료가 위험에 처하면 주저 없이 그들을 위해 공격의 충격을 대신 받습니다. 해당 영역 내 모든 동료에게 유발 효과에 대한 표준 의 엄폐를 부여하며, 이로 인해 엄폐를 얻은 동료 수의 두 배에 해당하는 수치만큼 유발 효과에 대한 모든 피해에 약점을 얻습니다.

name: Shield of Faith

description.value:
Residual energy from your domain spells bolsters your defenses. When you spend a Focus Point to cast a domain spell, you gain a +1 status bonus to your AC until the start of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.5uMMLUvJOEmfMgeV]{Effect: Shield of Faith}

_desc_en:
Residual energy from your domain spells bolsters your defenses. When you spend a Focus Point to cast a domain spell, you gain a +1 status bonus to your AC until the start of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.5uMMLUvJOEmfMgeV]{Effect: Shield of Faith}
_desc_ko:
영역 마법에서 남은 에너지가 방어력을 강화합니다. 포커스 포인트를 소모해 영역 마법을 시전할 때, 다음 턴 시작 전까지 AC에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.5uMMLUvJOEmfMgeV]{효과: 신앙의 방패}

name: Bestial Brutality

description.value: Your animalistic unarmed attack grows more dangerous. The unarmed attack you chose for Bestial Manifestation gains the deadly d6 trait. Whenever you score a critical hit with this unarmed attack, you get the brawling critical specialization effect.

_desc_en: Your animalistic unarmed attack grows more dangerous. The unarmed attack you chose for Bestial Manifestation gains the deadly d6 trait. Whenever you score a critical hit with this unarmed attack, you get the brawling critical specialization effect.
_desc_ko: 당신의 동물적인 비무장 공격이 더욱 위험해집니다. 야수적 창조에 선택한 비무장 공격은 치명적인 d6 특성을 얻습니다. 이 비무장 공격으로 치명타를 성공시킬 때마다, 당신은 격투 치명타 특화 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Everyone's a Suspect

description.value:
You are so suspicious of everyone you meet that you keep mental notes on how to defeat them all-even your own allies.

After interacting with a creature for at least 1 minute, you automatically @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xTK2zsWFyxSJvYbX]{Pursue a Lead} with that creature as the subject. You can have any number of such leads at any given time, and when you Pursue a Lead again, you don't give up any of these automatic subjects.

_desc_en:
You are so suspicious of everyone you meet that you keep mental notes on how to defeat them all-even your own allies.

After interacting with a creature for at least 1 minute, you automatically @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xTK2zsWFyxSJvYbX]{Pursue a Lead} with that creature as the subject. You can have any number of such leads at any given time, and when you Pursue a Lead again, you don't give up any of these automatic subjects.
_desc_ko:
만나는 모든 사람을 의심스러워하여, 심지어 자신의 아군까지도 그들을 어떻게 제압할지에 대한 정신을 새겨둔다.

생물과 1분 이상 상호작용하면 자동으로 @link[actions.pursue-a-lead]하게 되며, 해당 생물이 대상이 된다. 동시에 여러 개의 단서를 보유할 수 있으며, 다시 단서를 추적할 때 기존 자동 대상들을 포기하지 않는다.

name: Predispose Settlement

description.value:
You spend 7 days of downtime seeding propaganda through a settlement with a population of 2,500 or fewer. At 10th level, this increases to a settlement with a population of 10,000 or fewer, and at 16th level, you can affect settlements of any size.

Select a faction or organization (such as the Pathfinder Society, the Hellknights, or the Firebrands) that this propaganda targets and whether you are improving or decreasing the settlement's attitude toward that faction. After this period, attempt a @Check[deception] or @Check[diplomacy] check against the hard DC of the level of the settlement. These changes last for 1 week before the people return to their original attitudes.

Critical Success You adjust the starting attitude of the settlement's inhabitants toward the targeted faction by two steps. In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus on initiative rolls made in encounters that include members of your targeted faction while in the settlement for 1 week.

Success As critical success, but the inhabitants' attitude is adjusted by one step.

Critical Failure The propaganda attempt backfires. The attitude of the settlement's inhabitants toward you decreases by one step.

_desc_en:
You spend 7 days of downtime seeding propaganda through a settlement with a population of 2,500 or fewer. At 10th level, this increases to a settlement with a population of 10,000 or fewer, and at 16th level, you can affect settlements of any size.

Select a faction or organization (such as the Pathfinder Society, the Hellknights, or the Firebrands) that this propaganda targets and whether you are improving or decreasing the settlement's attitude toward that faction. After this period, attempt a @Check[deception] or @Check[diplomacy] check against the hard DC of the level of the settlement. These changes last for 1 week before the people return to their original attitudes.

Critical Success You adjust the starting attitude of the settlement's inhabitants toward the targeted faction by two steps. In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus on initiative rolls made in encounters that include members of your targeted faction while in the settlement for 1 week.

Success As critical success, but the inhabitants' attitude is adjusted by one step.

Critical Failure The propaganda attempt backfires. The attitude of the settlement's inhabitants toward you decreases by one step.
_desc_ko:
당신은 인구 2,500명 이하의 정착지를 통해 선전을 퍼뜨리는 데 7일의 다운타임을 소모합니다. (10th) 레벨에 도달하면 이 범위가 인구 10,000명 이하의 정착지로 확대되며, 16레벨에 도달하면 규모에 상관없이 모든 정착지에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

이 선전이 겨냥하는 세력이나 조직(예: 패스파인더 소사이어티, 헬나이트, 파이어브랜즈 등)을 선택하고, 해당 정착지의 그 세력에 대한 태도를 개선할지 악화시킬지 결정하십시오. 이 기간이 지나면 정착지 레벨에 해당하는 고정 DC에 대해 기만 또는 외교 판정을 시도하십시오. 이러한 변화는 1주일 동안 지속된 후 주민들은 원래 태도로 돌아갑니다.

대성공 대상 세력에 대한 정착지 주민들의 초기 태도를 두 단계 조정합니다. 또한, 정착지에 머무는 1주간 대상 세력 구성원이 포함된 전투에서 이니셔티브 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

성공 대성공과 동일하나, 주민들의 태도는 한 단계 조정됩니다.

대실패 선전 시도가 역효과를 낸다. 정착지 주민들의 당신에 대한 태도가 한 단계 하락한다.

name: Devil Allies

description.value: You can call forth devils to assist your efforts in preventing criminal acts. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.29ytKctjg7qSW2ff]{Summon Fiend} as a 6th-rank innate spell of a tradition of your choice, which you can cast once per day. When you cast this spell, you can summon only creatures that have the devil trait. At 14th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the spell is heightened by one rank (to a maximum of 10th rank when you reach 20th level).

_desc_en: You can call forth devils to assist your efforts in preventing criminal acts. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.29ytKctjg7qSW2ff]{Summon Fiend} as a 6th-rank innate spell of a tradition of your choice, which you can cast once per day. When you cast this spell, you can summon only creatures that have the devil trait. At 14th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the spell is heightened by one rank (to a maximum of 10th rank when you reach 20th level).
_desc_ko: 당신은 데빌을 소환하여 자신의 노력을 지원할 수 있습니다. 선택한 전통의 선천적 주문으로 @link[spells.summon-fiend]을 얻으며, 하루에 한 번 시전할 수 있습니다. 이 주문을 시전할 때 데빌 특성을 가진 생물만 소환할 수 있습니다. 16레벨에 도달하고 이후 2레벨마다 이 주문은 1랭크씩 강화됩니다(20레벨에 도달하면 최대 8th 랭크까지).

name: Trained Swimmer

description.value: Thanks to tireless practice, water has become a natural environment for you. You gain a swim Speed of 15 feet. If you already have a permanent swim Speed, swimming up or down isn’t difficult terrain.

_desc_en: Thanks to tireless practice, water has become a natural environment for you. You gain a swim Speed of 15 feet. If you already have a permanent swim Speed, swimming up or down isn’t difficult terrain.
_desc_ko: 끊임없는 연습 덕분에, 물은 당신에게 자연스러운 환경이 되었습니다. 당신은 15피트의 수영 이동력을 얻습니다. 이미 영구적인 수영 이동력을 가지고 있다면, 위나 아래로 수영하는 것이 험지가 아니게 됩니다.

name: Reactive Shield

description.value:
Trigger An enemy hits you with a melee Strike.

Requirements You are wielding a shield.

You can snap your shield into place just as you would take a blow, avoiding the hit at the last second. You immediately use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xjGwis0uaC2305pm]{Raise a Shield} action and gain your shield's bonus to AC. The circumstance bonus from the shield applies to your AC when you're determining the outcome of the triggering attack.

_desc_en:
Trigger An enemy hits you with a melee Strike.

Requirements You are wielding a shield.

You can snap your shield into place just as you would take a blow, avoiding the hit at the last second. You immediately use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xjGwis0uaC2305pm]{Raise a Shield} action and gain your shield's bonus to AC. The circumstance bonus from the shield applies to your AC when you're determining the outcome of the triggering attack.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 적이 근접 공격으로 당신을 명중시킨다.

요구 사항 방패를 장비하고 있어야 합니다.

타격을 받는 순간 방패를 찰싹 치며 막아내어 마지막 순간에 공격을 피할 수 있습니다. 당신은 즉시 @link[actions.raise-a-shield] 행동을 사용하며 방패의 AC 보너스를 얻습니다. 방패의 상황 보너스는 발동 공격의 결과를 결정할 때 당신의 AC에 적용됩니다.

name: Ulfen Guard Dedication

description.value:
Access At least one of your parents is Ulfen.

Central to your Ulfen Guard training is the ability to protect an ally. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} skill feat for Warfare Lore. If you were already trained in Warfare Lore, you also become trained in a Lore skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JmCuw6Rhwfwo90ed]{Designate Ally} action.

It's anathema for you to abandon your designated ally or allow your designated ally to die when you can prevent it. If you violate this anathema, you lose the ability to Designate Ally and any feats that use this ability until you spend 1 day of downtime reaffirming your dedication to your allies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.AgfaSXYYYvPhxn8L]{Ulfen Guard}

value.value: member of the Ulfen Guard, trained in Athletics and Intimidation

_desc_en:
Access At least one of your parents is Ulfen.

Central to your Ulfen Guard training is the ability to protect an ally. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} skill feat for Warfare Lore. If you were already trained in Warfare Lore, you also become trained in a Lore skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JmCuw6Rhwfwo90ed]{Designate Ally} action.

It's anathema for you to abandon your designated ally or allow your designated ally to die when you can prevent it. If you violate this anathema, you lose the ability to Designate Ally and any feats that use this ability until you spend 1 day of downtime reaffirming your dedication to your allies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.AgfaSXYYYvPhxn8L]{Ulfen Guard}
_desc_ko:
접근 부모 중 적어도 한 분이 울펜족입니다.

울펜 가드 훈련의 핵심은 동료를 보호하는 능력입니다. 당신은 @link[feats.additional-lore] 기술 피트를 전쟁 지식에 대해 획득합니다. 이미 전쟁 지식를 훈련받은 경우, 선택한 지식 기술 하나를 추가로 훈련받게 됩니다. 당신은 @link[actions.designate-ally] 행동을 획득합니다.

지정한 동료를 버리거나 막을 수 있음에도 죽게 내버려 두는 것은 당신에게 금기입니다. 이 금기를 어길 경우, 동료를 재지정하는 능력과 이 능력을 사용하는 모든 피트를 잃게 되며, 동료를 향한 헌신을 재확인하기 위해 1일의 다운타임을 소비해야 합니다.

name: Tusks (Half-Orc)

description.value:
Most half-orcs have visible tusks, but yours are particularly large and sharp, capable of gouging deep wounds. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage.

Special You can take this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain out of this feat or into this feat.

_desc_en:
Most half-orcs have visible tusks, but yours are particularly large and sharp, capable of gouging deep wounds. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage.

Special You can take this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain out of this feat or into this feat.
_desc_ko:
대부분의 하프오크는 송곳니가 보이지만, 당신의 송곳니는 특히 크고 날카로워 깊은 상처를 낼 수 있습니다. 턱을 이용한 비무장 공격을 얻으며, 1d6 관통 피해를 입힙니다.

특수 이 피트는 1레벨에서만 선택할 수 있으며, 재훈련으로 이 피트를 포기하거나 다시 선택할 수 없습니다.

name: Adamantine Fists

description.value: You imbue your unarmed strikes with one of the strongest metals. Your stonestrike attacks are treated as adamantine.

_desc_en: You imbue your unarmed strikes with one of the strongest metals. Your stonestrike attacks are treated as adamantine.
_desc_ko: 당신은 비무장 공격에 가장 단단한 금속 중 하나를 부여합니다. 당신의 돌로 치는 공격은 아다만틴으로 간주됩니다.

name: Flying Kick

description.value:
You launch yourself at a foe. Make a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} or attempt a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump}.

At the end of the jump, if you're adjacent to a foe, you can immediately Strike that foe with an unarmed attack, even if the foe is in midair. You fall to the ground after the Strike. If the distance you fall is no more than the height of your jump, you land upright and take no damage.

_desc_en:
You launch yourself at a foe. Make a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} or attempt a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump}.

At the end of the jump, if you're adjacent to a foe, you can immediately Strike that foe with an unarmed attack, even if the foe is in midair. You fall to the ground after the Strike. If the distance you fall is no more than the height of your jump, you land upright and take no damage.
_desc_ko:
적에게 몸을 날린다. @link[actions.leap]을 하거나 @link[actions.high-jump] 또는 @link[actions.long-jump]를 시도한다.

점프가 끝나는 순간, 적과 인접해 있다면 공중에 있는 적이라도 즉시 비무장 공격할 수 있다. 공격 후 땅에 떨어진다. 떨어진 거리가 점프한 거리보다 크지 않다면 똑바로 착지하여 피해를 입지 않는다.

name: True Senses

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Your senses are so sharp they pierce through all illusions. You can heighten your senses to non-magically gain the effects of a 6th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight} spell for 10 minutes. The ability to "see through" illusions and polymorph effects applies to any precise sense you possess.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Your senses are so sharp they pierce through all illusions. You can heighten your senses to non-magically gain the effects of a 6th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight} spell for 10 minutes. The ability to "see through" illusions and polymorph effects applies to any precise sense you possess.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신의 감각은 모든 환상을 관통할 만큼 예리합니다. 감각을 강화하여 마법 없이도 (6th)랭크 @link[spells.truesight] 주문의 효과를 10분간 얻을 수 있습니다. 환상과 변형 효과를 "꿰뚫어 보는" 능력은 당신이 가진 모든 정밀한 감각에 적용됩니다.

name: Control Tower

description.value:
Your keen senses and ability to process battlefield information have dramatically improved, allowing you to drastically reduce the advantage of unseen foes. You and allies in your overwatch field gain a +2 circumstance bonus when using the Seek action to find @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} creatures within the overwatch field.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.mkIamZGtQaSsUWLk]{Effect: Control Tower}

You and your allies don't have to succeed at a flat check to target a concealed creature within your overwatch field. When you or an ally targets a hidden creature in your overwatch field, reduce the DC of the flat check to 5.

_desc_en:
Your keen senses and ability to process battlefield information have dramatically improved, allowing you to drastically reduce the advantage of unseen foes. You and allies in your overwatch field gain a +2 circumstance bonus when using the Seek action to find @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} creatures within the overwatch field.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.mkIamZGtQaSsUWLk]{Effect: Control Tower}

You and your allies don't have to succeed at a flat check to target a concealed creature within your overwatch field. When you or an ally targets a hidden creature in your overwatch field, reduce the DC of the flat check to 5.
_desc_ko:
당신의 예민한 감각과 전장 정보 처리 능력이 극적으로 향상되어 보이지 않는 적의 이점을 크게 줄일 수 있습니다. 당신과 감시 범위 내 아군은 감시 행동을 사용하여 감시 범위 내 @link[conditions.hidden] 또는 @link[conditions.undetected] 상태의 생물을 찾을 때 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.mkIamZGtQaSsUWLk]{효과: 관제탑}

당신과 아군은 오버워치 필드 내 은폐된 생물을 표적 지정할 때 단순 판정에 성공할 필요가 없습니다. 당신이나 아군이 오버워치 필드 내 숨겨진 생물을 표적 지정할 경우, 단순 판정의 DC를 5로 낮춥니다.

name: Basic Bloodline Spell

description.value: You gain your bloodline's initial bloodline spell. If you don't already have one, you also gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can Refocus without any special effort.

_desc_en: You gain your bloodline's initial bloodline spell. If you don't already have one, you also gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can Refocus without any special effort.
_desc_ko: 혈통의 초기 혈통 주문을 획득합니다. 아직 혈통 주문을 가지고 있지 않다면, 1 포커스 포인트의 포커스 풀도 획득하며, 특별한 노력 없이 재집중할 수 있습니다.

name: Signifer Armor Expertise

description.value: You've spent enough time helping your comrades equip medium and heavy armor that you spread your own expertise to those armors as well. If you have expert proficiency in any armor or unarmored defense, you also gain expert proficiency in medium and heavy armor.

_desc_en: You've spent enough time helping your comrades equip medium and heavy armor that you spread your own expertise to those armors as well. If you have expert proficiency in any armor or unarmored defense, you also gain expert proficiency in medium and heavy armor.
_desc_ko: 동료들이 중갑과 중갑옷을 착용하도록 돕는 데 충분한 시간을 보냈기에, 그 전문성을 해당 갑옷에도 확장시켰다. 어떤 갑옷이나 무장 방어에 숙련 숙련도를 보유 중이라면, 중갑과 중갑옷에 대한 숙련 숙련도도 추가로 획득한다.

name: Apparition Stabilization

description.value: Your attuned apparition ensures that even if you would be distracted or disrupted, your magic does not go to waste. If a reaction would disrupt your spellcasting action, attempt a @Check[flat|showDC:all|dc:15]. If you succeed, your action isn't disrupted. When you gain the third apparition class feature, this DC is reduced to 13, and when you gain the fourth apparition class feature, this DC is reduced to 10.

_desc_en: Your attuned apparition ensures that even if you would be distracted or disrupted, your magic does not go to waste. If a reaction would disrupt your spellcasting action, attempt a @Check[flat|showDC:all|dc:15]. If you succeed, your action isn't disrupted. When you gain the third apparition class feature, this DC is reduced to 13, and when you gain the fourth apparition class feature, this DC is reduced to 10.
_desc_ko: 당신의 조율된 환영은 주의가 산만해지거나 방해받더라도 마법이 헛되이 소모되지 않도록 보장합니다. 반응으로 인해 당신의 주문 시전 행동이 방해받을 경우, DC 15 단순을 시도하십시오. 성공하면 행동이 방해받지 않습니다. 세 번째 유령 클래스 특성을 획득하면 이 DC가 13으로 감소하며, 네 번째 유령 클래스 특성을 획득하면 이 DC가 10으로 감소합니다.

name: Unfettering Strike

description.value:
Requirements A creature within your reach has an ally @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

With a damaging blow, you cause a foe to loosen their grip on an ally they're holding down. Make a melee Strike against the creature. If you hit and deal damage, your ally can attempt to Escape from being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} as a free action. If your Strike is a critical hit, your ally gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the attempt.

_desc_en:
Requirements A creature within your reach has an ally @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

With a damaging blow, you cause a foe to loosen their grip on an ally they're holding down. Make a melee Strike against the creature. If you hit and deal damage, your ally can attempt to Escape from being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} as a free action. If your Strike is a critical hit, your ally gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the attempt.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 당신의 사거리 내의 생물이 아군 하나를 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{조이기} 또는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{억제} 상태로 붙잡고 있습니다.

피해를 주는 일격으로, 당신은 적이 붙잡고 있는 아군에 대한 손아귀를 느슨하게 만듭니다. 그 생물을 상대로 근접 타격을 합니다. 명중하여 피해를 준다면, 당신의 아군은 자유 행동으로 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{조이기} 또는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{억제} 상태에서 탈출을 시도할 수 있습니다. 당신의 타격이 치명타라면, 아군은 그 시도에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Nosoi's Mask

description.value:
Many psychopomps wear masks when dealing with the living, and many cultures believe that seeing an unmasked psychopomp's face invites death.

You are trained in Intimidation and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xQMz6eDgX75WX2ce]{Intimidating Glare} skill feat. If you were already trained in Intimidation (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also know how to make masks like those worn by psychopomps, a process that takes 1 hour and 1 sp of appropriate material. If you instead pay 50 gp for a splendid psychopomp mask, the mask grants you a +1 item bonus to Intimidation while you are wearing it. Its usage is worn (mask).

_desc_en:
Many psychopomps wear masks when dealing with the living, and many cultures believe that seeing an unmasked psychopomp's face invites death.

You are trained in Intimidation and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xQMz6eDgX75WX2ce]{Intimidating Glare} skill feat. If you were already trained in Intimidation (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also know how to make masks like those worn by psychopomps, a process that takes 1 hour and 1 sp of appropriate material. If you instead pay 50 gp for a splendid psychopomp mask, the mask grants you a +1 item bonus to Intimidation while you are wearing it. Its usage is worn (mask).
_desc_ko:
많은 사이코폼프들은 산 자들과 접촉할 때 가면을 쓰며, 많은 문화권에서는 가면을 벗은 사이코폼프의 얼굴을 보면 죽음을 부른다고 믿습니다.

위협 기술에 숙련되어 @link[feats.intimidating-glare] 기술 피트를 얻습니다. 이미 위협 기술에 숙련된 경우(배경이나 직업 등으로 인해), 대신 선택한 기술에 숙련됩니다.

또한 사이코폼프가 착용하는 것과 유사한 가면을 제작하는 방법을 알고 있습니다. 제작에는 1시간과 적절한 재료 1스푼이 소요됩니다. 대신 화려한 사이코폼프 가면을 50gp에 구입할 경우, 착용 시 협박에 +1 아이템 보너스를 부여합니다. 사용 방식은 착용(가면)입니다.

name: Scion Transformation

description.value: You go into hibernation for twenty-four hours and perform a ritual dedicated to your ancestors, undergoing a one-time metamorphosis. You permanently gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge}, and your maximum Hit Points increase by your level. The ritual transforms most of your gear to the appropriate size for your new body (though powerful items like artifacts or items strongly tied to their original size may not transform, at the GM's discretion).

_desc_en: You go into hibernation for twenty-four hours and perform a ritual dedicated to your ancestors, undergoing a one-time metamorphosis. You permanently gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge}, and your maximum Hit Points increase by your level. The ritual transforms most of your gear to the appropriate size for your new body (though powerful items like artifacts or items strongly tied to their original size may not transform, at the GM's discretion).
_desc_ko: 24시간 동안 동면 상태에 들어가 조상에게 바치는 의식을 행하며, 일회성 변태를 겪습니다. @link[spells.enlarge]의 효과를 영구히 획득하며, 최대 HP가 레벨만큼 증가한다. 의식은 대부분의 장비를 새로운 몸에 맞는 크기로 변형시킨다(단, 유물이나 원래 크기에 강하게 묶인 강력한 아이템은 GM의 재량에 따라 변형되지 않을 수 있음).

name: Plentiful Snares

description.value: You can prepare incredible numbers of snares each day out of simple ingredients. Double the number of prepared snares granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.4MUbwilvb9dI0X59]{Snarecrafter Dedication}.

_desc_en: You can prepare incredible numbers of snares each day out of simple ingredients. Double the number of prepared snares granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.4MUbwilvb9dI0X59]{Snarecrafter Dedication}.
_desc_ko: 간단한 재료로 매일 엄청난 수의 올가미를 준비할 수 있습니다. @link[feats.snarecrafter-dedication]이 부여하는 준비된 올가미 수를 두 배로 늘립니다.

name: Kneel for No God

description.value:
Access Vahird ethnicity

Your ancestors' defiance of magic and your people's strictly egalitarian mindset mean that certain forms of magic have little effect on you. When you use your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.8w6esW689NNbbq3i]{Call on Ancient Blood} reaction against a divine spell and roll a critical failure on the saving throw against that spell, you get a failure instead.

_desc_en:
Access Vahird ethnicity

Your ancestors' defiance of magic and your people's strictly egalitarian mindset mean that certain forms of magic have little effect on you. When you use your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.8w6esW689NNbbq3i]{Call on Ancient Blood} reaction against a divine spell and roll a critical failure on the saving throw against that spell, you get a failure instead.
_desc_ko:
접근 바히르드 종족

조상들의 마법에 대한 저항과 민족의 엄격한 평등주의적 사고방식으로 인해 특정 형태의 마법은 당신에게 거의 영향을 미치지 않습니다. 신성 마법에 대해 @link[actions.call-on-ancient-blood] 반응을 사용하고 해당 마법에 대한 내성 굴림에서 대실패를 굴렸을 때, 대신 실패를 얻습니다.

name: Obscured Terrain

description.value: When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]{Mist}, you can modify the spell to replace its standard effects with the following: You cause a cloud of thick fog to blanket the area, making it difficult to see the ground. The area within the fog is difficult terrain for creatures that can't see through fog or mist. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AjLSHZSWQ90exdLo]{Dismiss} the cloud.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

_desc_en: When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]{Mist}, you can modify the spell to replace its standard effects with the following: You cause a cloud of thick fog to blanket the area, making it difficult to see the ground. The area within the fog is difficult terrain for creatures that can't see through fog or mist. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AjLSHZSWQ90exdLo]{Dismiss} the cloud.
_desc_ko: @link[spells.mist]를 시전할 때, 이 주문의 표준 효과를 다음과 같이 수정할 수 있습니다: 두꺼운 안개 구름이 지역을 뒤덮어 지면을 보기 어렵게 만듭니다. 안개 속 지역은 안개나 안개를 뚫어볼 수 없는 생물에게 어려운 지형이 됩니다. @link[actions.dismiss]하여 안개를 없앨 수 있다.

name: Unrivaled Builder

description.value: Building things is like solving a puzzle, and you know how to use anything at your disposal to get the job done. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TUj8eugNqAvB1vVR]{Creation} as a 5th-rank innate primal spell. You must have an equivalent Bulk of material to create an item, such as wood or scrap metal to make a wheelbarrow. You can cast this spell once each day.

_desc_en: Building things is like solving a puzzle, and you know how to use anything at your disposal to get the job done. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TUj8eugNqAvB1vVR]{Creation} as a 5th-rank innate primal spell. You must have an equivalent Bulk of material to create an item, such as wood or scrap metal to make a wheelbarrow. You can cast this spell once each day.
_desc_ko: 물건을 만드는 것은 퍼즐을 푸는 것과 같으며, 당신은 주어진 모든 것을 활용해 작업을 완수하는 방법을 알고 있습니다. @link[spells.creation]를 (5th)랭크 선천적 프라이멀 마법으로 획득한다. 물건을 만들기 위해서는 그에 상응하는 벌크의 재료가 필요하다. 예를 들어 수레를 만들려면 나무나 고철이 필요하다. 이 마법은 하루에 한 번 시전할 수 있다.

name: Positive Luminance

description.value: You learn how to create a luminous reservoir of vitality energy that you can use to punish undead who dare attack you. You gain the domain spell @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8XuNn0h0rHE24m3B]{Vital Luminance}. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus spell. This feat grants a focus pool of 1 Focus Point that you can recover using the Refocus activity.

_desc_en: You learn how to create a luminous reservoir of vitality energy that you can use to punish undead who dare attack you. You gain the domain spell @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8XuNn0h0rHE24m3B]{Vital Luminance}. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus spell. This feat grants a focus pool of 1 Focus Point that you can recover using the Refocus activity.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신에게 감히 공격하는 언데드를 처벌하기 위해 사용할 수 있는 활력 에너지로 빛나는 저장고를 만드는 법을 배웁니다. 도메인 주문 @link[spells.vital-luminance]를 획득한다. 포커스 주문을 시전하는 데 1점의 포커스가 소모된다. 이 피트는 재집중 활동을 통해 회복할 수 있는 1점의 포커스 풀을 부여한다.

name: Shared Avoidance

description.value:
You can project your premonitions of danger to your allies. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KYl1rWFOHe0e6VqJ]{Premonition of Avoidance}, allies within 20 feet of you who are rolling the same saving throw against the same hazard also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to their saving throws.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.svVczVV174KfJRDf]{Effect: Shared Avoidance}

_desc_en:
You can project your premonitions of danger to your allies. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KYl1rWFOHe0e6VqJ]{Premonition of Avoidance}, allies within 20 feet of you who are rolling the same saving throw against the same hazard also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to their saving throws.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.svVczVV174KfJRDf]{Effect: Shared Avoidance}
_desc_ko:
당신은 위험에 대한 예감을 아군에게 투사할 수 있습니다. @link[feats.premonition-of-avoidance]을 사용할 때, 당신으로부터 20피트 이내에 있는 아군 중 동일한 위험에 대해 동일한 내성 굴림을 굴리는 자들도 내성 굴림에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.svVczVV174KfJRDf]{효과: 공유 회피}

name: Qi Center

description.value:
Frequency once per minute

You center yourself with the universe and draw upon its vast power. You cast a single action qi spell with the stance trait, without spending a Focus Point.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per minute

You center yourself with the universe and draw upon its vast power. You cast a single action qi spell with the stance trait, without spending a Focus Point.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 분당 1회

당신은 우주와 하나가 되어 그 광대한 힘을 끌어모읍니다. 포커스 포인트를 소모하지 않고 자세 특성을 가진 액션 하나 기 주문을 시전합니다.

name: Collapse Construct

description.value:
You've modified your construct companion and built it out of light materials, enabling you to collapse it into a carrying case or other compact and innocuous form. Either your construct or you (if you're adjacent to it) can Collapse your Construct to turn it into its compact form or back into its normal form.

In compact form, your construct can't act but is easily carried, with a Bulk of 2 if it's Small, 4 if it's Medium, or 8 if it's Large. The compact form has wheels, so you can easily drag it behind you at half your Speed (rather than the usual slower Speed for dragging).

_desc_en:
You've modified your construct companion and built it out of light materials, enabling you to collapse it into a carrying case or other compact and innocuous form. Either your construct or you (if you're adjacent to it) can Collapse your Construct to turn it into its compact form or back into its normal form.

In compact form, your construct can't act but is easily carried, with a Bulk of 2 if it's Small, 4 if it's Medium, or 8 if it's Large. The compact form has wheels, so you can easily drag it behind you at half your Speed (rather than the usual slower Speed for dragging).
_desc_ko:
당신은 조형체 동반자를 조정하여 가벼운 재료로 제작함으로써, 이를 휴대용 케이스나 기타 소형화되고 눈에 띄지 않는 형태로 접을 수 있게 했습니다. 조형체 자체 또는 (조형체와 인접한 경우) 당신이 조형체를 접어 소형 형태로 만들거나 다시 정상 형태로 되돌릴 수 있습니다.

소형 상태에서는 구조체가 행동할 수 없지만 운반이 용이하며, 소형일 경우 벌크 2, 중형일 경우 벌크 4, 대형일 경우 벌크 8로 계산됩니다. 소형 형태에는 바퀴가 달려 있어 평소의 느린 속도 대신 이동 속도의 절반으로 쉽게 끌고 다닐 수 있습니다.

name: A Tale To Believe In

description.value: You recite a tale of prowess that rewrites the combat unfolding around you. You can attempt a counteract check against a mental effect that's currently affecting an ally within 30 feet, using Deception for the counteract check and half your level as the counteract rank.

_desc_en: You recite a tale of prowess that rewrites the combat unfolding around you. You can attempt a counteract check against a mental effect that's currently affecting an ally within 30 feet, using Deception for the counteract check and half your level as the counteract rank.
_desc_ko: 당신은 주변에서 벌어지는 전투를 재구성하는 위대한 이야기를 읊조립니다. 30피트 이내의 아군에게 현재 영향을 미치고 있는 정신 효과에 대해, 기만 능력으로 반격 판정을 시도할 수 있으며, 반격 등급은 당신의 레벨 절반을 사용합니다.

name: Wild Winds Gust

description.value:
Requirements You are in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SkarN4VlNxSJSJNw]{Wild Winds Stance}

You build air pressure with repeated motions, before releasing an enormous crescent of rushing wind strikes. Make a wind crash Strike against each creature in your choice of a @Template[cone|distance:30] or a @Template[line|distance:60]. These attacks all count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after you make all the attacks.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SkarN4VlNxSJSJNw]{Wild Winds Stance}

You build air pressure with repeated motions, before releasing an enormous crescent of rushing wind strikes. Make a wind crash Strike against each creature in your choice of a @Template[cone|distance:30] or a @Template[line|distance:60]. These attacks all count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after you make all the attacks.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 @link[spells.wild-winds-stance] 상태입니다.

반복적인 동작으로 공기 압력을 축적한 후, 거대한 초승달 모양의 돌풍을 방출한다. 선택한 30피트 또는 60피트 범위 내의 모든 생물에게 바람 충돌 공격을 가한다. 이 공격들은 모두 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되지만, 페널티는 모든 공격을 완료한 후에야 증가한다.

name: Instinctive Maneuvers

description.value: When you allow an apparition control over your body, it might vent its fury against your foes. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Gw8tjM91F6i3fOnR]{Relinquish Control}, you add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} to the list of actions you can take. You gain a +2 status bonus to the Athletics check to attempt these actions.

_desc_en: When you allow an apparition control over your body, it might vent its fury against your foes. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Gw8tjM91F6i3fOnR]{Relinquish Control}, you add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} to the list of actions you can take. You gain a +2 status bonus to the Athletics check to attempt these actions.
_desc_ko: 유령이 당신의 몸을 지배하도록 허용하면, 그 유령이 당신의 적에게 분노를 표출할 수 있습니다. 당신이 @link[feats.relinquish-control]할 때, 당신은 @link[actions.grapple], @link[actions.reposition], @link[actions.shove], @link[actions.trip]를 수행 가능한 행동 목록에 추가한다. 이러한 행동을 시도할 때 운동 판정에서 +2 상태 보너스를 얻는다.

name: Soaring Shape

description.value: Wings free you from the shackles of the ground below. Add the bat and bird shapes in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.NzXpEzcZAjuDTZjK]{Aerial Form} to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form} list. If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.OWedlrKGsVZVkSnT]{Insect Shape}, you also add the wasp shape to your untamed form list. If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Le30algCdKIsxmeK]{Ferocious Shape}, you also add the pterosaur shape to your untamed form list. Whenever you use untamed form to take a shape that grants you a specific Acrobatics modifier, you gain a +1 status bonus to Acrobatics checks.

_desc_en: Wings free you from the shackles of the ground below. Add the bat and bird shapes in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.NzXpEzcZAjuDTZjK]{Aerial Form} to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form} list. If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.OWedlrKGsVZVkSnT]{Insect Shape}, you also add the wasp shape to your untamed form list. If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Le30algCdKIsxmeK]{Ferocious Shape}, you also add the pterosaur shape to your untamed form list. Whenever you use untamed form to take a shape that grants you a specific Acrobatics modifier, you gain a +1 status bonus to Acrobatics checks.
_desc_ko: 날개는 땅의 섀클스에서 당신을 해방시킵니다. @link[spells.aerial-form]의 박쥐와 새 형태를 @link[spells.untamed-form] 목록에 추가하십시오. @link[feats.insect-shape]를 가지고 있다면, 말벌 형태도 길들여지지 않은 형태 목록에 추가합니다. @link[feats.ferocious-shape]를 가지고 있다면, untamed form 목록에 익룡 형태도 추가합니다. untamed form을 사용하여 특정 곡예 수정자를 부여하는 형태를 취할 때마다, 곡예 판정에서 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Eliminate Red Herrings

description.value: You have a keen sense for avoiding spurious lines of inquiry. When you roll a critical failure on a skill check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} related to a question about one of your active investigations, you get a failure instead.

_desc_en: You have a keen sense for avoiding spurious lines of inquiry. When you roll a critical failure on a skill check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} related to a question about one of your active investigations, you get a failure instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 허위 단서를 피하는 예리한 감각을 지녔습니다. 진행 중인 수사 관련 질문에 대한 @link[actions.recall-knowledge] 기술 판정에서 대실패를 굴릴 경우, 대신 실패를 얻습니다.

name: Duo Dragon Kick

description.value:
Requirements Your construct innovation is adjacent to you.

You've practiced an impressive spin technique with your construct, automatically attacking in tandem as you launch each other through the air. You Command your construct companion to fight alongside you, after which you both @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} in the same direction, making an unarmed Strike at the start or end of the Leap; this uses your companion's actions for the turn. If the Strikes both hit the same creature, combine their damage for the purposes of resistances and weaknesses.

Unstable Function You spin farther and higher, though the extreme movement risks discombobulating your innovation. Add the unstable trait to Duo Dragon Kick. Increase the distance of your Leaps by 10 feet if horizontal or 5 feet if vertical.
