name: Improvised Repair

description.value: You can hastily patch damaged equipment together, but the temporary fix lacks the full care required for lasting repairs. You patch together a broken item possessed by you or an adjacent willing creature. Until the item takes damage again, it still functions as a shoddy item of its type. If it's a magic item or another item with activations, it can't be activated while patched together, but can be used for normal functions (such as Striking with a weapon or using Shield Block with a shield). This activity restores no Hit Points, so the item is easy to destroy. Once the item is Repaired normally such that it is no longer broken, it is also no longer shoddy.

_desc_en: You can hastily patch damaged equipment together, but the temporary fix lacks the full care required for lasting repairs. You patch together a broken item possessed by you or an adjacent willing creature. Until the item takes damage again, it still functions as a shoddy item of its type. If it's a magic item or another item with activations, it can't be activated while patched together, but can be used for normal functions (such as Striking with a weapon or using Shield Block with a shield). This activity restores no Hit Points, so the item is easy to destroy. Once the item is Repaired normally such that it is no longer broken, it is also no longer shoddy.
_desc_ko: 손상된 장비를 급하게 임시로 수리할 수는 있지만, 이 임시 수리는 오래 지속되는 수리에 필요한 완전한 관리가 부족합니다. 당신은 자신이나 인접한 동의한 대상이 소유한 파손된 아이템을 임시로 수리합니다. 해당 아이템이 다시 피해를 입을 때까지, 여전히 그 종류의 허술한 아이템으로 기능합니다. 마법 아이템이나 활성화 기능이 있는 다른 아이템인 경우, 임시 수리 상태에서는 활성화할 수 없지만 일반적인 기능(예: 무기로 강타하거나 방패로 방패 막기 사용)은 사용할 수 있습니다. 이 활동은 HP를 회복시키지 않으므로 아이템은 쉽게 파괴될 수 있습니다. 아이템이 정상적으로 수리되어 더 이상 고장 나지 않게 되면, 더 이상 허술한 상태도 아닙니다.

name: Improved Elemental Bulwark

description.value: You gain resistance 10 from Elemental Bulwark instead of 5.

_desc_en: You gain resistance 10 from Elemental Bulwark instead of 5.
_desc_ko: 원소 방벽으로 인한 저항력이 5가 아닌 10이 됩니다.

name: Slag May

description.value: Your mother was an iron hag known for physical prowess, and you have one violet or steel-gray eye. You have thick, sturdy claws made of cold iron that grow naturally from your body. You gain a claw unarmed attack that deals 1d6 slashing damage. Your claws are in the brawling group, have the unarmed and grapple traits, and are cold iron.

_desc_en: Your mother was an iron hag known for physical prowess, and you have one violet or steel-gray eye. You have thick, sturdy claws made of cold iron that grow naturally from your body. You gain a claw unarmed attack that deals 1d6 slashing damage. Your claws are in the brawling group, have the unarmed and grapple traits, and are cold iron.
_desc_ko: 당신의 어머니는 육체적 능력이 뛰어난 철의 마녀였으며, 당신은 보라색 또는 강철 회색의 한쪽 눈을 가졌습니다. 당신 몸에서 자연스럽게 자라는 차가운 철로 된 두껍고 튼튼한 발톱을 지녔습니다. 발톱 비무장 공격을 얻으며, 1d6 베기 피해를 입힙니다. 발톱은 난투 무기 그룹에 속하며, 무기 공격과 잡기 특성을 지녔고 차가운 철로 만들어졌습니다.

name: Frightful Moan

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You lament your fate, forcing each living creature in a @Template[emanation|distance:30] to attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

Success The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune to Frightful Moans for 1 minute.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You lament your fate, forcing each living creature in a @Template[emanation|distance:30] to attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

Success The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune to Frightful Moans for 1 minute.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 10분마다 한 번

당신은 자신의 운명을 한탄하며, 30피트 내 모든 생명체가 당신의 직업 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 더 높은 쪽에 대해 의지 내성 굴림을 시도하다 강요합니다.

성공 시 해당 생물은 영향을 받지 않으며 1분 동안 공포의 신음에 일시적으로 면역 상태가 된다.

실패 생물은 @link[conditions.frightened]{1}.

대실패 생물은 @link[conditions.frightened]{2} 상태입니다.

name: Restorative Strike

description.value:
Requirements You have a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} spell you can cast.

You balance both sides of the scales, restoring yourself while striking a foe. Cast a 1-action harm or heal spell to heal yourself, expending the spell normally. It loses the manipulate trait when cast this way. Then make a melee Strike. If you make this Strike with your deity's favored weapon, you gain a +1 status bonus to the attack roll.

If the Strike hits, you can target a second willing creature to heal the same amount from the spell. This creature can be outside of the spell's range, provided it's adjacent to the enemy you hit.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} spell you can cast.

You balance both sides of the scales, restoring yourself while striking a foe. Cast a 1-action harm or heal spell to heal yourself, expending the spell normally. It loses the manipulate trait when cast this way. Then make a melee Strike. If you make this Strike with your deity's favored weapon, you gain a +1 status bonus to the attack roll.

If the Strike hits, you can target a second willing creature to heal the same amount from the spell. This creature can be outside of the spell's range, provided it's adjacent to the enemy you hit.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신이 시전할 수 있는 @link[spells.harm] 또는 @link[spells.heal] 주문이 있어야 합니다.

저울의 양쪽을 균형 있게 잡아, 자신을 치유하면서 적을 강타합니다. 1-액션 해악 또는 치유 주문을 시전하여 자신을 치유하며, 주문을 정상적으로 소모합니다. 이 방식으로 시전하면 조작 특성을 상실한다. 이후 근접 공격을 가한다. 신이 선호하는 무기로 이 공격을 가할 경우 , 명중 굴림에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻는다.

타격이 적중하면, 두 번째 동의한 대상을 대상으로 하여 동일한 양의 치유 효과를 부여할 수 있다. 이 생물은 적중시킨 적과 인접해 있다면 주문 범위 밖에 있을 수 있다.

name: Magical Crafting

description.value: You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} magic items, though some have other requirements. When you select this feat, you gain formulas for four common magic items of 2nd level or lower.

_desc_en: You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} magic items, though some have other requirements. When you select this feat, you gain formulas for four common magic items of 2nd level or lower.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @link[actions.craft] 마법 아이템을 만들 수 있으나, 일부는 다른 요구 사항이 있습니다. 이 재주를 선택하면 2레벨 이하의 일반적인 마법 아이템 네 가지에 대한 제작법을 얻습니다.

name: Skilled Partner

description.value: Your eidolon gains a 1st-level skill feat and a 2nd-level or lower skill feat. At 7th level, your eidolon gains an additional skill feat, of 7th level or lower.

_desc_en: Your eidolon gains a 1st-level skill feat and a 2nd-level or lower skill feat. At 7th level, your eidolon gains an additional skill feat, of 7th level or lower.
_desc_ko: 당신의 에이돌론은 1레벨 기술 피트와 2nd-레벨 이하 기술 피트를 하나 얻습니다. 7레벨에 도달하면, 에이돌론은 7레벨 이하 기술 피트를 추가로 얻습니다.

name: Healing Bomb

description.value: You can add a foamy catalyst to an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.hDLbR56Id2OtU318]{Elixir of Life} to turn it into a topical projectile. You can throw the elixir at a creature within 20 feet as an Interact action to heal that creature and those near it. The target is affected as though it drank the elixir, and each living creature adjacent to it regains HP from the bomb equal to the elixir's number of damage dice (3 HP for a lesser elixir of life, for example).

_desc_en: You can add a foamy catalyst to an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.hDLbR56Id2OtU318]{Elixir of Life} to turn it into a topical projectile. You can throw the elixir at a creature within 20 feet as an Interact action to heal that creature and those near it. The target is affected as though it drank the elixir, and each living creature adjacent to it regains HP from the bomb equal to the elixir's number of damage dice (3 HP for a lesser elixir of life, for example).
_desc_ko:
생명의 비약에 거품 촉매제를 첨가하여 발사 가능한 투사체로 만들 수 있습니다. 이 엘릭서를 연금술 폭탄처럼 던질 수 있으며, 다음과 같은 결과를 초래한다.

성공 대상은 엘릭서를 마신 것처럼 영향을 받으며, 그 주변의 모든 생명체는 폭탄으로부터 엘릭서의 피해 주사위 수만큼 HP를 회복합니다(예: 하급 생명의 비약의 경우 3 HP).

실패 대상은 엘릭서의 피해 주사위 수만큼 HP를 회복한다.

대실패 치유 폭탄이 아무런 효과를 발휘하지 못합니다.

name: Unwind Death

description.value:
Requirements The target's body must be mostly intact.

Combining necromancy with the mysterious temporal powers of clockwork, you wind a creature backward from the moment of its death. Attempt a @Check[crafting|dc:40] check to revive a dead creature that has been dead for no more than 3 rounds. If you succeed, the target returns to life with the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IkGYwHRLhkuoGReG]{Raise Dead}, except it still has the wounded condition it had before dying, increased by 1 (or wounded 1 if it wasn't wounded before dying). Whether you succeed or fail, the target is then temporarily immune to Unwind Death for 1 day.

_desc_en:
Requirements The target's body must be mostly intact.

Combining necromancy with the mysterious temporal powers of clockwork, you wind a creature backward from the moment of its death. Attempt a @Check[crafting|dc:40] check to revive a dead creature that has been dead for no more than 3 rounds. If you succeed, the target returns to life with the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IkGYwHRLhkuoGReG]{Raise Dead}, except it still has the wounded condition it had before dying, increased by 1 (or wounded 1 if it wasn't wounded before dying). Whether you succeed or fail, the target is then temporarily immune to Unwind Death for 1 day.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 대상의 신체는 대부분 온전해야 합니다.

네크로맨시와 시계 장치의 신비한 시간 조작 능력을 결합하여, 생물이 죽은 순간부터 시간을 거꾸로 감는다. 사망한 지 3라운드 이내인 생물을 되살리려면 DC 40 제작 판정을 시도하다. 성공 시 대상은 @link[spells.raise-dead]의 효과와 함께 되살아나지만, 사망 전 가졌던 부상 상태가 1 증가한 상태(사망 전 부상이 없었으면 부상 1)로 유지된다. 성공 여부와 상관없이 대상은 이후 1일간 '죽음 되감기'에 일시적으로 면역된다.

name: Command Undead

description.value:
You grasp the animating force within an undead creature and bend it to your will.

If the next action you use is to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} targeting one undead creature, you transform the effects of that harm spell.

Instead of harm's normal effects, the target becomes controlled by you if its level is equal to or lower than your level - 3. It can attempt a Will saving throw to resist being controlled by you.

If the target is already under someone else's command, the controlling creature also rolls a saving throw, and the undead uses the better result.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune for 24 hours.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The undead creature becomes a minion under your control. The spell gains a duration of 1 minute, but it is dismissed if you or an ally attacks the minion undead.

Critical Failure As failure, but the duration is 1 hour.

_desc_en:
You grasp the animating force within an undead creature and bend it to your will.

If the next action you use is to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} targeting one undead creature, you transform the effects of that harm spell.

Instead of harm's normal effects, the target becomes controlled by you if its level is equal to or lower than your level - 3. It can attempt a Will saving throw to resist being controlled by you.

If the target is already under someone else's command, the controlling creature also rolls a saving throw, and the undead uses the better result.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune for 24 hours.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The undead creature becomes a minion under your control. The spell gains a duration of 1 minute, but it is dismissed if you or an ally attacks the minion undead.

Critical Failure As failure, but the duration is 1 hour.
_desc_ko:
당신은 언데드 생물 내부의 생명력을 장악하고 자신의 의지대로 휘두릅니다.

다음 행동으로 @link[spells.harm]를 한 언데드 생물을 대상으로 시전할 경우, 해당 해로운 효과의 효과를 변형시킨다.

해의 일반 효과 대신, 대상의 레벨이 당신의 레벨 - 3 이하일 경우 대상은 당신에게 통제됩니다. 대상은 당신에게 통제되는 것을 저항하기 위해 의지 내성 굴림을 시도할 수 있습니다.

대상이 이미 다른 존재의 지배를 받고 있다면, 지배하는 생물도 내성 굴림을 굴리며, 언데드가 더 좋은 결과를 사용한다.

대성공 대상은 영향을 받지 않으며 24시간 동안 일시적으로 면역 상태가 됩니다.

성공 대상은 영향을 받지 않습니다.

실패 언데드 생물이 당신의 통제 하에 있는 하수인이 됩니다. 이 주문은 1분 동안 지속되지만, 당신이나 아군이 하수인 언데드를 공격하면 해제됩니다.

대실패 실패와 동일하나 지속 시간은 1시간이다.

name: Rejuvenating Touch

description.value:
Your healing energies linger after you cast, providing continual benefits. An ally that recovers Hit Points from your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zNN9212H2FGfM7VS]{Lay on Hands} gains 10 temporary Hit Points immediately and at the start of their turn during each of the next 10 rounds. These temporary HP last until the start of the creature's next turn. This effect ends if the ally is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.0jKdU1YdER9dLBdx]{Effect: Rejuvenating Touch}

_desc_en:
Your healing energies linger after you cast, providing continual benefits. An ally that recovers Hit Points from your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zNN9212H2FGfM7VS]{Lay on Hands} gains 10 temporary Hit Points immediately and at the start of their turn during each of the next 10 rounds. These temporary HP last until the start of the creature's next turn. This effect ends if the ally is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.0jKdU1YdER9dLBdx]{Effect: Rejuvenating Touch}
_desc_ko:
주문을 시전한 후에도 치유 에너지가 지속되어 지속적인 효과를 제공합니다. 당신의 @link[spells.lay-on-hands]로 HP를 치유한 아군은 즉시 10의 임시 HP를 얻으며, 이후 10라운드 동안 자신의 턴 시작 시마다 추가로 10의 임시 HP를 얻습니다. 이 임시 HP는 대상의 다음 턴 시작 시까지 지속됩니다. 아군이 @link[conditions.unconscious] 상태가 되면 이 효과는 종료됩니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.oaRt210JV4GZIHmJ]{주문 효과: 재생 회복의 손길}

name: Mind Shards

description.value: With a swing and a thought, you detonate your mind weapon into a burst of psychic shards that shred the mind. You concentrate and unleash a @Template[cone|distance:15] that deals @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2)d6)[mental]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in the area, with a @Check[will|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. After the attack, your mind weapon automatically re-forms, and you can't use this ability again for 1 minute. Mind Shards' damage increases by 1d6 at level 7 and every two levels thereafter.

_desc_en: With a swing and a thought, you detonate your mind weapon into a burst of psychic shards that shred the mind. You concentrate and unleash a @Template[cone|distance:15] that deals @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2)d6)[mental]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in the area, with a @Check[will|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. After the attack, your mind weapon automatically re-forms, and you can't use this ability again for 1 minute. Mind Shards' damage increases by 1d6 at level 7 and every two levels thereafter.
_desc_ko: 한 번 휘두르고 생각만으로, 당신은 정신 무기를 폭발시켜 정신을 갈가리 찢는 사이킥 파편의 폭발을 일으킵니다. 집중하여 15피트을 발동하면 범위 내 모든 생물에게 정신의 피해를 입히며, 대상은 기본 의지에 대한 저항 검사(당신의 클래스 DC 또는 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽)를 수행합니다. 공격 후 정신 무기는 자동으로 재형성되며, 1분 동안 이 능력을 다시 사용할 수 없다. 정신 파편의 피해는 7레벨과 이후 2레벨마다 1d6씩 증가한다.

name: Clang!

description.value:
Trigger An enemy critically misses a Strike or spell attack roll against your AC.

You make a foe pay for attacking you as its blow or spell glances off your armor. Either Strike the triggering enemy or Stride up to your Speed toward the triggering enemy. If you Stride and end your movement adjacent to the triggering enemy, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your next turn.

_desc_en:
Trigger An enemy critically misses a Strike or spell attack roll against your AC.

You make a foe pay for attacking you as its blow or spell glances off your armor. Either Strike the triggering enemy or Stride up to your Speed toward the triggering enemy. If you Stride and end your movement adjacent to the triggering enemy, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 적이 당신의 AC를 대상으로 한 타격 또는 주문 명중 굴림에 치명적으로 실패할 때.

적의 공격이 갑옷에 스치듯 빗나가게 하여 공격 대가를 치르게 합니다. 발동 적을 공격하거나, 이동 속도만큼 발동 적 쪽으로 일반 이동합니다. 일반 이동 후 이동을 발동 적과 인접한 위치에서 끝내면, 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 발동 적은 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Quick Bomber

description.value: You keep your bombs and bomb-related reagents in easy-toreach pouches from which you draw without thinking. You Interact to draw a bomb, draw a versatile vial, or use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.yzNJgwzV9XqEhKc6]{Quick Alchemy} to create a bomb, then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{Strike} with the bomb. If you have the ability to create more than one bomb at a time with Quick Alchemy (such as from the double brew class feature), you can Strike with only one of the bombs you create with this action.

_desc_en: You keep your bombs and bomb-related reagents in easy-toreach pouches from which you draw without thinking. You Interact to draw a bomb, draw a versatile vial, or use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.yzNJgwzV9XqEhKc6]{Quick Alchemy} to create a bomb, then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{Strike} with the bomb. If you have the ability to create more than one bomb at a time with Quick Alchemy (such as from the double brew class feature), you can Strike with only one of the bombs you create with this action.
_desc_ko: 폭탄과 폭탄 관련 재료를 손쉽게 꺼낼 수 있는 파우치에 보관하며, 생각 없이 꺼내 사용한다. 상호작용으로 폭탄을 꺼내거나 다용도 약병을 꺼내거나 @link[actions.quick-alchemy]로 폭탄을 생성한 후 @link[actions.strike]을 가한다. 신속한 연금술로 한 번에 여러 폭탄을 생성할 수 있는 능력(예: 이중 양조 클래스 특성)이 있다면, 이 행동으로 생성한 폭탄 중 하나만으로 강타할 수 있다.

name: Sin Counterspell

description.value: Your deep connection to a specific sin allows you to easily negate spells that sin opposes. Instead of being able to counter a foe's spell with Counterspell only if you have the same spell prepared, you can Counterspell it with any of your curriculum spells if the spell cast would violate your sin's anathema.

_desc_en: Your deep connection to a specific sin allows you to easily negate spells that sin opposes. Instead of being able to counter a foe's spell with Counterspell only if you have the same spell prepared, you can Counterspell it with any of your curriculum spells if the spell cast would violate your sin's anathema.
_desc_ko: 특정 죄악과의 깊은 유대감으로 인해, 그 죄악이 반대하는 주문을 쉽게 무효화할 수 있습니다. 적의 주문을 카운터스펠로 무효화하려면 동일한 주문을 준비해 두어야 하는 대신, 발동된 주문이 당신의 죄악의 금기를 위반하는 경우 당신의 커리큘럼 주문 중 어느 것으로든 카운터스펠을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Eye for Smugglers

description.value: Your time checking seemingly innocent cargo ships for illicit goods has made you as canny as you are suspicious. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to locate hidden panels, secret doors or hatches, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} objects, and similar items (at the GM's discretion). If you aren't using the [[/act seek]] action or Searching, the GM automatically rolls a secret check for you to notice these types of objects when you pass within 10 feet of them.

_desc_en: Your time checking seemingly innocent cargo ships for illicit goods has made you as canny as you are suspicious. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to locate hidden panels, secret doors or hatches, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} objects, and similar items (at the GM's discretion). If you aren't using the [[/act seek]] action or Searching, the GM automatically rolls a secret check for you to notice these types of objects when you pass within 10 feet of them.
_desc_ko: 겉보기에 무해한 화물선에서 불법 물품을 검사하던 시간은 당신을 의심 많은 만큼 영리하게 만들었습니다. 당신은 숨겨진 판, 비밀 문이나 해치, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{은폐}된 물체, 그리고 유사한 물품(GM 재량)을 찾기 위한 지각 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 당신이 [[/act seek]] 행동이나 수색을 사용하고 있지 않더라도, GM은 당신이 그러한 종류의 물체에서 10피트 이내를 지날 때 그것을 알아채도록 자동으로 당신을 위한 비밀 판정을 굴립니다.

name: Fortunate Blow

description.value:
You set an enemy up for a devastating follow-through from your allies. When you successfully damage an opponent with either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.3OHdjgDGn4yzMD9b]{Guiding Shot} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.f0fpsr8ZSNrWlfAt]{Set-Up Strike}, the next creature other than you to attack the same target before the start of your next turn rolls twice on their attack roll and takes the higher result.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.x9xNnTl1sRGCqthu]{Effect: Fortunate Blow}

_desc_en:
You set an enemy up for a devastating follow-through from your allies. When you successfully damage an opponent with either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.3OHdjgDGn4yzMD9b]{Guiding Shot} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.f0fpsr8ZSNrWlfAt]{Set-Up Strike}, the next creature other than you to attack the same target before the start of your next turn rolls twice on their attack roll and takes the higher result.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.x9xNnTl1sRGCqthu]{Effect: Fortunate Blow}
_desc_ko: 당신은 아군들이 적에게 결정타를 날릴 수 있도록 준비합니다. 유도 사격이나 준비 공격으로 적에게 피해를 성공적으로 입혔을 때, 다음 턴이 시작되기 전에 같은 대상을 공격하는 당신 이외의 다음 생물은 명중 굴림을 두 번 굴리고 더 높은 결과를 적용합니다.

name: We're on the List

description.value:
Trigger An ally you can see and hear is about to attempt a Deception check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} someone or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie}.

Emulating Shensen whenever she arrives at a show, you share your knowledge of the region and drop a few important local names to make a good impression and help your allies do the same. Attempt a Society check to Aid your ally. If you succeed, you recall a few specific details about local culture and personalities to help support your ally's deception. In addition to the benefits of your Aid, the triggering ally rolls their Deception check twice and takes the better result. This is a fortune effect.

value.value: Alter Ego Dedication or Archaeologist Dedication

_desc_en:
Trigger An ally you can see and hear is about to attempt a Deception check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} someone or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie}.

Emulating Shensen whenever she arrives at a show, you share your knowledge of the region and drop a few important local names to make a good impression and help your allies do the same. Attempt a Society check to Aid your ally. If you succeed, you recall a few specific details about local culture and personalities to help support your ally's deception. In addition to the benefits of your Aid, the triggering ally rolls their Deception check twice and takes the better result. This is a fortune effect.
_desc_ko:
Trigger 당신이 보고 들을 수 있는 아군이 누군가를 @link[actions.impersonate]하거나 @link[actions.lie]하기 위해 기만 판정을 시도합니다.

쇼에 도착할 때마다 쉔센을 흉내 내며, 해당 지역에 대한 지식을 공유하고 몇몇 중요한 현지 인물의 이름을 언급해 좋은 인상을 남기고 동맹이 똑같이 하도록 돕습니다. 동맹을 돕기 위해 사회성 판정을 시도하세요. 성공 시, 동맹의 기만을 뒷받침할 지역 문화와 인물에 관한 구체적인 세부 사항을 떠올립니다. 지원 효과에 더해, 발동한 동맹은 기만 판정을 두 번 굴림하고 더 좋은 결과를 적용받습니다. 이는 행운 효과입니다.

name: Arcane Slam

description.value:
Requirements You have a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

You channel magical power from your core into your arm, empowering your attack as you attempt to slam your foe into the ground. Attempt an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.ZS5z1TqckWPIMGDN]{Athletics} check against the foe's Fortitude DC. You take a –2 circumstance penalty to your check if the target is one size larger than you and a –4 circumstance penalty if it's larger than that. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your check if the target is one size smaller than you and a +4 circumstance bonus if it's smaller than that.

Critical Success You slam the foe down and the magical energy overwhelms it. The creature is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round, and takes damage equal to 2d6 plus your Strength modifier. The foe is no longer @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by you.

Success You slam the foe down. The creature is knocked prone and takes damage equal to your Strength modifier. The foe is no longer grabbed or restrained by you.

Failure You are unable to slam the creature, but your hold on the creature remains.

Critical Failure The creature breaks free and is no longer grabbed or restrained by you.

Enhancement Your arms better channel your core's power. You no longer take penalties for attempting to slam larger foes. Your foe takes damage equal to 2d6 plus your Strength modifier on a success (or double that on a critical success).

_desc_en:
Requirements You have a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}.

You channel magical power from your core into your arm, empowering your attack as you attempt to slam your foe into the ground. Attempt an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.ZS5z1TqckWPIMGDN]{Athletics} check against the foe's Fortitude DC. You take a –2 circumstance penalty to your check if the target is one size larger than you and a –4 circumstance penalty if it's larger than that. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your check if the target is one size smaller than you and a +4 circumstance bonus if it's smaller than that.

Critical Success You slam the foe down and the magical energy overwhelms it. The creature is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round, and takes damage equal to 2d6 plus your Strength modifier. The foe is no longer @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by you.

Success You slam the foe down. The creature is knocked prone and takes damage equal to your Strength modifier. The foe is no longer grabbed or restrained by you.

Failure You are unable to slam the creature, but your hold on the creature remains.

Critical Failure The creature breaks free and is no longer grabbed or restrained by you.

Enhancement Your arms better channel your core's power. You no longer take penalties for attempting to slam larger foes. Your foe takes damage equal to 2d6 plus your Strength modifier on a success (or double that on a critical success).
_desc_ko:
Requirements 당신은 생물 @link[conditions.grabbed] 또는 @link[conditions.restrained] 상태입니다.

당신은 핵심에서 마법력을 팔로 집중시켜 공격력을 강화하며 적을 땅에 내리찍으려고 시도합니다. 적의 인내 DC에 대해 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.ZS5z1TqckWPIMGDN]{운동} 판정을 시도하십시오. 대상이 당신보다 한 크기 크면 판정에서 -2 상황 페널티를, 그보다 더 크면 -4 상황 페널티를 받습니다. 대상이 당신보다 한 크기 작으면 판정에서 +2 상황 보너스를, 그보다 더 작으면 +4 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

대성공 상대를 강타하여 마법 에너지가 상대를 압도합니다. 생물은 @link[conditions.prone]가 되고 @link[conditions.dazzled] 상태가 1라운드 지속되며, 2d6 + 근력 능력치 수정자에 해당하는 피해를 입는다. 적은 더 이상 당신에게 @link[conditions.grabbed] 또는 @link[conditions.restrained] 상태가 아니다.

성공 적을 땅에 내리찍습니다. 생물은 넘어져 쓰러지고 당신의 근력 능력치 수정자만큼의 피해를 입습니다. 적은 더 이상 당신에게 붙잡기되거나 제압되지 않습니다.

실패 당신은 생물을 내리칠 수 없지만, 생물에 대한 당신의 잡기는 유지됩니다.

대실패 생물이 탈출하여 더 이상 당신에게 붙잡기되거나 제압되지 않습니다.

강화 팔이 기운의 흐름을 더 잘 전달합니다. 더 큰 적을 내리치려 시도할 때 페널티를 받지 않습니다. 성공 시 적에게 근력 능력치 수정자에 2d6을 더한 피해를 입힙니다(대성공 시 두 배).

name: Stone Body

description.value:
Requirements You are in Tenacious Stance.

Emulating the great defenders throughout dwarven history, you close your mind to the sensation of pain, becoming as resolute as stone itself. You gain resistance 10 to all damage. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn or immediately upon being critically hit.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are in Tenacious Stance.

Emulating the great defenders throughout dwarven history, you close your mind to the sensation of pain, becoming as resolute as stone itself. You gain resistance 10 to all damage. This effect lasts until the end of your next turn or immediately upon being critically hit.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 끈질긴 자세를 취하고 있습니다.

드워프 역사 속 위대한 수호자들을 본받아, 당신은 고통의 감각을 차단하고 돌처럼 굳건해집니다. 모든 피해에 대해 저항력 10을 얻습니다. 이 효과는 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 지속되거나 치명타를 당하는 즉시 해제됩니다.

name: Smite

description.value:
You single out one enemy to destroy in your deity's name. Designate one enemy you can see. Until the start of your next turn, your Strikes against that enemy gain a +3 status bonus to damage, increasing to +4 if you have master proficiency with the weapon or unarmed attack you're using for the Strike. If you're holy or unholy and the target has the opposite trait, the bonus is +4 (or +6 if you're a master).

If the target takes a hostile action against you or one of your allies before the start of your next turn, the duration extends to the end of that enemy's next turn. If the enemy continues to take these hostile actions each turn, the duration continues to extend.

Your current Smite ends if you use the Smite action again.

_desc_en:
You single out one enemy to destroy in your deity's name. Designate one enemy you can see. Until the start of your next turn, your Strikes against that enemy gain a +3 status bonus to damage, increasing to +4 if you have master proficiency with the weapon or unarmed attack you're using for the Strike. If you're holy or unholy and the target has the opposite trait, the bonus is +4 (or +6 if you're a master).

If the target takes a hostile action against you or one of your allies before the start of your next turn, the duration extends to the end of that enemy's next turn. If the enemy continues to take these hostile actions each turn, the duration continues to extend.

Your current Smite ends if you use the Smite action again.
_desc_ko:
당신은 신의 이름으로 파괴할 적 한 명을 지목합니다. 볼 수 있는 적 한 명을 지정하세요. 다음 차례 시작 전까지, 해당 적에 대한 당신의 공격은 피해에 +3 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 공격에 사용하는 무기나 비무장 공격 에 숙련 달인를 보유한 경우 +4로 증가합니다. 당신이 신성한거나 불경한 상태이고 대상이 반대 특성을 가질 경우, 보너스는 +4(당신이 달인일 경우 +6)가 됩니다.

다음 턴 시작 전에 대상이 당신이나 아군에게 적대적 행동을 취하면 지속 시간이 해당 적의 다음 턴 종료까지 연장됩니다. 적이 매 턴마다 이러한 적대적 행동을 계속하면 지속 시간도 계속 연장됩니다.

당신이 다시 '심판' 행동을 사용하면 현재의 심판 효과가 종료됩니다.

name: Incredible Reanimated Companion

description.value: You imbue the necrotized flesh of your reanimated construct companion with strange chemicals and fine-tune the clockwork within, enhancing all its capabilities. It becomes an incredible construct companion.

_desc_en: You imbue the necrotized flesh of your reanimated construct companion with strange chemicals and fine-tune the clockwork within, enhancing all its capabilities. It becomes an incredible construct companion.
_desc_ko: 당신은 되살아난 조형물 동반자의 괴사된 살에 기묘한 화학 물질을 주입하고 내부의 시계 장치를 정밀하게 조정하여 모든 능력을 강화합니다. 그것은 놀라운 조형물 동반자가 됩니다.

name: Spell Mastery

description.value: You have mastered a handful of spells to such a degree that you can cast them even if you haven't prepared them in advance. Select any four spells of 9th rank or lower that are in your spellbook; each spell you select must be of a different rank. These spells are automatically prepared when you make your daily preparations, and you gain an extra spell slot for each spell. You can select a different combination of spells by spending 1 week of downtime studying your spellbook and retraining your mastered spells.

_desc_en: You have mastered a handful of spells to such a degree that you can cast them even if you haven't prepared them in advance. Select any four spells of 9th rank or lower that are in your spellbook; each spell you select must be of a different rank. These spells are automatically prepared when you make your daily preparations, and you gain an extra spell slot for each spell. You can select a different combination of spells by spending 1 week of downtime studying your spellbook and retraining your mastered spells.
_desc_ko: 당신은 몇 가지 주문을 마스터하여 사전에 준비하지 않아도 시전할 수 있습니다. 주문서에 있는 (9th) 랭크 이하 주문 중 서로 다른 랭크의 주문 4개를 선택하십시오. 선택한 주문은 매일 준비할 때 자동으로 준비되며, 각 주문마다 추가 주문 슬롯을 얻습니다. 1주일의 다운타임 동안 주문서를 연구하고 마스터한 주문을 재훈련하면 다른 조합의 주문을 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Shielded Recovery

description.value:
You can bandage wounds with the same hand you use to hold your shield. You can use the same hand you are using to wield a shield to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} or use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.wYerMk6F1RZb0Fwt]{Battle Medicine}, and you are considered to have a hand free for other uses of Medicine as long as the only thing you are holding or wielding in that hand is a shield. When you use Battle Medicine on an ally while wielding a shield, they gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and Reflex saves that lasts until the start of your next turn or until they are no longer adjacent to you, whichever comes first.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.KOVUFiN6nkttuiRb]{Effect: Shielded Recovery}

_desc_en:
You can bandage wounds with the same hand you use to hold your shield. You can use the same hand you are using to wield a shield to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} or use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.wYerMk6F1RZb0Fwt]{Battle Medicine}, and you are considered to have a hand free for other uses of Medicine as long as the only thing you are holding or wielding in that hand is a shield. When you use Battle Medicine on an ally while wielding a shield, they gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and Reflex saves that lasts until the start of your next turn or until they are no longer adjacent to you, whichever comes first.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.KOVUFiN6nkttuiRb]{Effect: Shielded Recovery}
_desc_ko: 방패를 든 손으로 상처를 붕대 감을 수 있습니다. 방패를 휘두르는 데 사용하는 손으로 @link[actions.treat-wounds]를 하거나 전투 의술을 사용할 수 있으며, 해당 손에 방패만 들고 있거나 휘두르고 있는 한 의술의 다른 용도를 위해 한 손이 자유로운 것으로 간주됩니다. 방패를 휘두르는 동안 아군에게 전투 의술을 사용하면, 해당 아군은 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 또는 당신과 인접 상태가 해제될 때까지(둘 중 먼저 도래하는 시점까지) AC와 반사 내성에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Perfect Encore

description.value: You develop another incredible creation. You gain an additional 10th-rank spell slot.

_desc_en: You develop another incredible creation. You gain an additional 10th-rank spell slot.
_desc_ko: 당신은 또 하나의 놀라운 창조물을 개발합니다. (10th) 주문 슬롯을 추가로 획득합니다.

name: Twinned Defense (Fighter)

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding two melee weapons, one in each hand.

You're always ready to use your off-hand weapon to interfere with attacks against you. While you are in this stance, you constantly gain the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Y8LHfkzGyOhPlUou]{Twin Parry} action.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding two melee weapons, one in each hand.

You're always ready to use your off-hand weapon to interfere with attacks against you. While you are in this stance, you constantly gain the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Y8LHfkzGyOhPlUou]{Twin Parry} action.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 양손에 각각 한 자루씩, 총 두 자루의 근접 무기를 휘두르고 있습니다.

당신은 항상 비주무기를 사용하여 자신에게 가해지는 공격을 방해할 준비가 되어 있습니다. 이 자세를 취하고 있는 동안, 당신은 지속적으로 @link[feats.twin-parry] 행동의 이점을 얻습니다.

name: Azarketi Lore

description.value:
You have learned the history and origins of your people and how to connect to both your land and sea heritage.

You become trained in Athletics and Nature. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also become trained in Azarketi Lore.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Absalom, City of Lost Omens

_desc_en:
You have learned the history and origins of your people and how to connect to both your land and sea heritage.

You become trained in Athletics and Nature. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also become trained in Azarketi Lore.
_desc_ko:
당신은 자신의 민족의 역사와 기원을 배우고, 육지와 바다의 유산 모두와 연결하는 법을 익혔습니다.

당신은 운동과 자연에 숙련됩니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 자동으로 그 중 하나의 기술에 숙련될 경우, 대신 선택한 기술에 숙련됩니다. 또한 아자케티 지식에 숙련됩니다.

참고: 이 피트로 부여되는 기술을 이미 숙련한 경우, 대체 기술을 수동으로 선택해야 합니다. 부여되는 지식 기술도 수동으로 입력해야 합니다.

name: Steal Spell

description.value:
When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.IZbjUaZI5zHTd1Vp]{Legendary Thief} to steal the impossible, you can steal a prepared spell or spontaneous spell from a foe. The spell is randomly selected from the highest-rank spells the foe knows that have a target or area, to a maximum of 8th-rank spells; the target loses the appropriate spell slot as if they had cast it themself.

You can Cast the Spell once within the next [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}, after which the fleeting magic fades; this otherwise works the same as casting a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.80DU0IvIzOIBGuUa]{Loaner Spell}.

_desc_en:
When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.IZbjUaZI5zHTd1Vp]{Legendary Thief} to steal the impossible, you can steal a prepared spell or spontaneous spell from a foe. The spell is randomly selected from the highest-rank spells the foe knows that have a target or area, to a maximum of 8th-rank spells; the target loses the appropriate spell slot as if they had cast it themself.

You can Cast the Spell once within the next [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}, after which the fleeting magic fades; this otherwise works the same as casting a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.80DU0IvIzOIBGuUa]{Loaner Spell}.
_desc_ko:
당신이 @link[feats.legendary-thief] 능력을 사용해 불가능한 것을 훔칠 때, 적에게서 준비된 주문이나 즉흥 주문을 훔칠 수 있습니다. 해당 주문은 적이 알고 있는 대상 지정 또는 영역 효과가 있는 최고 랭크 주문 중 무작위로 선택되며, 최대 (8th)랭크 주문까지 가능합니다. 대상은 마치 자신이 직접 시전한 것처럼 해당 주문 슬롯을 소모합니다.

다음 1d4 라운드 내에 해당 주문을 한 번 시전할 수 있으며, 이후 덧없는 마법은 사라집니다. 이 외에는 @link[feats.loaner-spell]을 시전하는 것과 동일하게 작동합니다.

name: Twilight Dweller

description.value:
You're accustomed to shaded forests and caves. You gain low-light vision. If you already have low-light vision, you gain darkvision.

Special You can select this feat twice.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
You're accustomed to shaded forests and caves. You gain low-light vision. If you already have low-light vision, you gain darkvision.

Special You can select this feat twice.
_desc_ko:
그늘진 숲과 동굴에 익숙합니다. 저조도 시야를 얻습니다. 이미 저조도 시야를 가지고 있다면 암흑 시야를 얻습니다.

특수 이 피트를 두 번 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Colugo's Traversal

description.value: Forbidding valleys and sheer cliffs can't curb your vows to reunite the lost. You can cast your choice of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TTwOKGqmZeKSyNMH]{Gentle Landing} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Q7QQ91vQtyi1Ux36]{Jump} as a primal innate spell once per day. At 9th level, these spells are heightened to 3rd rank.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Forbidding valleys and sheer cliffs can't curb your vows to reunite the lost. You can cast your choice of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TTwOKGqmZeKSyNMH]{Gentle Landing} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Q7QQ91vQtyi1Ux36]{Jump} as a primal innate spell once per day. At 9th level, these spells are heightened to 3rd rank.
_desc_ko: 험준한 계곡과 깎아지른 절벽도 잃어버린 자들을 재결합하겠다는 당신의 맹세를 막을 수 없습니다. 하루에 한 번, 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 @link[spells.gentle-landing] 또는 @link[spells.jump] 중 하나를 선택하여 시전할 수 있습니다. 9레벨에 도달하면 이 주문들은 (3rd) 랭크으로 강화됩니다.

name: Never!

description.value: The idea that you would hurt your companions, even when you've lost your reason, is unthinkable. Each time you would attack an ally due to being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} or controlled, you can attempt another saving throw against the effect that caused you to be confused or controlled with a +4 circumstance bonus to the save. If you succeed, you don't make the attack, though you still expend any actions it would have taken. If your save ends the effect making you confused or controlled, you can take any remaining actions during your turn as normal. Failing or critically failing this additional save doesn't increase the effect's duration or otherwise worsen it.

_desc_en: The idea that you would hurt your companions, even when you've lost your reason, is unthinkable. Each time you would attack an ally due to being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} or controlled, you can attempt another saving throw against the effect that caused you to be confused or controlled with a +4 circumstance bonus to the save. If you succeed, you don't make the attack, though you still expend any actions it would have taken. If your save ends the effect making you confused or controlled, you can take any remaining actions during your turn as normal. Failing or critically failing this additional save doesn't increase the effect's duration or otherwise worsen it.
_desc_ko: 이성을 잃은 상태라 해도 동료에게 해를 끼칠 것이라는 생각은 상상조차 할 수 없다. @link[conditions.confused] 상태이거나 통제당해 아군을 공격하려 할 때마다, 혼란 또는 지배됨 상태를 유발한 효과에 대해 추가 내성 굴림을 시도할 수 있으며, 이 굴림에는 +4 상황 보너스가 적용됩니다. 성공하면 공격을 하지 않지만, 공격에 소모될 행동은 여전히 소모된다. 이 추가 저항으로 혼란 또는 통제 효과가 종료되면, 턴 내 남은 행동을 정상적으로 수행할 수 있다. 이 추가 저항에 실패하거나 대실패해도 효과의 지속 시간이 늘어나거나 악화되지는 않는다.

name: Defend Summoner

description.value: Your eidolon blocks attacks against you. After your eidolon uses this action, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC until the beginning of your next turn. This bonus applies only while you're within your eidolon's reach (in most cases, this means your eidolon is adjacent to you or in your space).

_desc_en: Your eidolon blocks attacks against you. After your eidolon uses this action, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC until the beginning of your next turn. This bonus applies only while you're within your eidolon's reach (in most cases, this means your eidolon is adjacent to you or in your space).
_desc_ko: 당신의 에이돌론이 당신을 향한 공격을 막아줍니다. 에이돌론이 이 행동을 사용한 후, 다음 차례 시작까지 AC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 보너스는 에이돌론의 도달 범위 내에 있을 때만 적용됩니다(대부분의 경우 에이돌론이 당신과 인접하거나 당신의 공간에 있을 때).

name: Reaper of Repose

description.value: Your skill and fervor allow you to pierce undead defenses and exploit their weaknesses. When you make an attack using a weapon with which you have master proficiency and hit an undead creature, you ignore 5 points of the creature's resistances, and the undead's weaknesses are 2 higher against your attack.

_desc_en: Your skill and fervor allow you to pierce undead defenses and exploit their weaknesses. When you make an attack using a weapon with which you have master proficiency and hit an undead creature, you ignore 5 points of the creature's resistances, and the undead's weaknesses are 2 higher against your attack.
_desc_ko: 당신의 숙련된 기술과 열정은 언데드의 방어력을 관통하고 그들의 약점을 공략할 수 있게 합니다. 달인 무기로 공격하여 언데드 생물을 명중시킬 경우, 해당 생물의 저항력 5점을 무시하며, 언데드의 약점은 당신의 공격에 대해 2 더 높아집니다.

name: Holy Light

description.value: You raise your arms to the sky and pray fervently, surrounding yourself in a beacon of holy light. The beacon sheds bright light in a @Template[cylinder|distance:30]{30-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder} centered on you until the beginning of your next turn. Evil creatures in the area must succeed at a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save equal to your class DC or spell DC (whichever is higher) or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en: You raise your arms to the sky and pray fervently, surrounding yourself in a beacon of holy light. The beacon sheds bright light in a @Template[cylinder|distance:30]{30-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder} centered on you until the beginning of your next turn. Evil creatures in the area must succeed at a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save equal to your class DC or spell DC (whichever is higher) or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.
_desc_ko: 당신은 하늘을 향해 두 팔을 들어 간절히 기도하며, 자신을 신성한 빛의 등대로 둘러쌉니다. 이 등대는 다음 차례 시작까지 당신을 중심으로 한 30피트 영역에 밝은 빛을 비춥니다. 해당 영역 내의 악의적인 생물은 당신의 직업 난이도(DC) 또는 주문 DC(DC) 중 더 높은 값에 해당하는 의지 저항 검사에서 성공하지 못하면 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.dazzled] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Winter Sleet

description.value:
Bone-chilling, swirling sleet surrounds you, cruel as deepest winter. Surfaces in your kinetic aura are coated in slippery ice. A creature that moves on the ice immediately falls unless it succeeds at an @Check[acrobatics|against:kineticist|adjustment:-2|rollerRole:target] check or @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|adjustment:-2] save against your impulse DC – 2. A creature that Steps or Crawls doesn't have to attempt a check or save. You're immune to this effect.

If a creature on the ice is critically hit by one of your water impulses or critically fails at a save against one, that creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of its next turn.

_desc_en:
Bone-chilling, swirling sleet surrounds you, cruel as deepest winter. Surfaces in your kinetic aura are coated in slippery ice. A creature that moves on the ice immediately falls unless it succeeds at an @Check[acrobatics|against:kineticist|adjustment:-2|rollerRole:target] check or @Check[reflex|against:kineticist|adjustment:-2] save against your impulse DC – 2. A creature that Steps or Crawls doesn't have to attempt a check or save. You're immune to this effect.

If a creature on the ice is critically hit by one of your water impulses or critically fails at a save against one, that creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of its next turn.
_desc_ko:
뼈를 시리게 하는 소용돌이치는 진눈깨비가 당신을 둘러싸고, 가장 혹독한 겨울처럼 잔혹합니다. 당신의 키네틱 오라에 닿는 표면은 미끄러운 얼음으로 덮여 있습니다. 얼음 위를 이동하는 생물은 즉시 넘어지며, 곡예 판정나 반사 내성에 성공해야 합니다. 판정 대상은 당신의 임펄스 에 대한 DC - 2입니다. {신중한 발걸음}이나 기어다니기로 이동하는 생물은 판정나 내성을 시도할 필요가 없습니다. 당신은 이 효과에 면역입니다.

얼음 위의 생물이 당신의 물 임펄스에 의해 치명타를 받거나 이에 대한 내성에 대실패를 하면, 해당 생물은 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.slowed]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Magical Resistance

description.value:
Your animating magic provides some defense. Choose one of the following energy damage types: cold, electricity, or sonic. You gain resistance 5 to that damage type.

Enhancement You tap deeper into your animating magic, and your resistances improve. Choose one of the following benefits: you gain resistance 5 to the remaining two damage types from the above list, or your chosen resistance increases to a value equal to 1 + half your level.

_desc_en:
Your animating magic provides some defense. Choose one of the following energy damage types: cold, electricity, or sonic. You gain resistance 5 to that damage type.

Enhancement You tap deeper into your animating magic, and your resistances improve. Choose one of the following benefits: you gain resistance 5 to the remaining two damage types from the above list, or your chosen resistance increases to a value equal to 1 + half your level.
_desc_ko:
생명을 부여하는 마법이 방어력을 제공합니다. 다음 에너지 피해 유형 중 하나를 선택하세요: 냉기, 전기, [sonic]. 해당 피해 유형에 대해 저항력 5를 얻습니다.

강화 당신은 생명의 마법을 더 깊이 활용하여 저항력을 향상시킵니다. 다음 혜택 중 하나를 선택하세요: 위 목록에서 남은 두 가지 피해 유형에 대해 저항력 5를 얻거나, 선택한 저항력이 1 + 레벨의 절반에 해당하는 값으로 증가합니다.

name: Divine Aegis

description.value:
Trigger You attempt a saving throw against a magical effect, but you haven't rolled yet.

A barrier offers protection against other magic but leaves you exposed to divine energy. Until the beginning of your next turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against nondivine magical effects, but you also take a –1 circumstance penalty to saves against divine effects

_desc_en:
Trigger You attempt a saving throw against a magical effect, but you haven't rolled yet.

A barrier offers protection against other magic but leaves you exposed to divine energy. Until the beginning of your next turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against nondivine magical effects, but you also take a –1 circumstance penalty to saves against divine effects
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 마법 효과에 대한 내성 굴림을 시도하지만 아직 굴리지 않은 상태입니다.

장벽은 다른 마법으로부터 보호하지만 신성한 에너지에는 노출됩니다. 다음 턴 시작 전까지 비신성 마법 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻지만, 신성 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에는 -1 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Impressive Performance

description.value: Your performances inspire admiration and win you fans. You can [[/act make-an-impression skill=performance]] using Performance instead of Diplomacy. If you spend at least 10 minutes performing in front of an audience, you can Make an Impression targeting up to 10 members of the audience who were there for the whole performance, without taking the normal penalty. The number of targets increases to 20 for a 1-hour performance and 50 for a 2-hour performance.

_desc_en: Your performances inspire admiration and win you fans. You can [[/act make-an-impression skill=performance]] using Performance instead of Diplomacy. If you spend at least 10 minutes performing in front of an audience, you can Make an Impression targeting up to 10 members of the audience who were there for the whole performance, without taking the normal penalty. The number of targets increases to 20 for a 1-hour performance and 50 for a 2-hour performance.
_desc_ko: 당신의 공연은 감탄을 자아내며 팬을 확보합니다. 외교 대신 공연 능력으로 @link[actions.make-an-impression]를 수행할 수 있습니다. 관객 앞에서 최소 10분간 공연하면, 공연 전체를 관람한 관객 중 최대 10명을 대상으로 정상적인 페널티 없이 인상을 남길 수 있습니다. 1시간 공연 시 대상은 20명으로, 2시간 공연 시 50명으로 증가합니다.

name: Worldsphere Gravity

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Though creating demiplanes usually requires lengthy rituals, you know how to establish minor planar effects in imitation of Syndara's masterpieces. If your next action is to Cast a Spell of at least 5th rank from your spell slots that affects an area, you can apply one of the following planar effects to a @Template[burst|distance:20] centered within the spell's area. The effect persists for 1 minute.

Gravitational Morass The pull of gravity is amplified here, creating greater difficult terrain. Flying creatures that pass through the area must succeed at a Reflex save against your spell DC or fall to the ground, taking bludgeoning damage equal to half the distance fallen.

Flowing Time Erratic timestreams aid you within this space. A creature that starts its turn in the burst is affected by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{Haste} on that turn.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Though creating demiplanes usually requires lengthy rituals, you know how to establish minor planar effects in imitation of Syndara's masterpieces. If your next action is to Cast a Spell of at least 5th rank from your spell slots that affects an area, you can apply one of the following planar effects to a @Template[burst|distance:20] centered within the spell's area. The effect persists for 1 minute.

Gravitational Morass The pull of gravity is amplified here, creating greater difficult terrain. Flying creatures that pass through the area must succeed at a Reflex save against your spell DC or fall to the ground, taking bludgeoning damage equal to half the distance fallen.

Flowing Time Erratic timestreams aid you within this space. A creature that starts its turn in the burst is affected by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{Haste} on that turn.
_desc_ko:
빈도 시간당 한 번

반평면 생성에는 일반적으로 긴 의식이 필요하지만, 당신은 신다라의 걸작을 모방한 소규모 평면 효과를 생성하는 방법을 알고 있다. 다음 행동으로 주문 슬롯에서 5랭크 이상의 영역 효과 주문을 시전할 경우, 해당 주문 영역 중심에 위치한 20피트에 다음 평면 효과 중 하나를 적용할 수 있다. 이 효과는 1분간 지속된다.

중력 늪 이곳에서는 중력이 증폭되어 매우 어려운 지형이 생성됩니다. 이 지역을 통과하는 비행 생물은 당신의 주문 DC에 대한 반사 내성에 성공하지 못하면 땅으로 추락하며, 추락한 거리 절반에 해당하는 타격 피해를 입습니다.

흐르는 시간 이 공간 안에서 불규칙한 시간 흐름이 당신을 돕습니다. 폭발 범위 내에서 자신의 턴을 시작하는 생물은 해당 턴 동안 @link[spells.haste]의 효과를 받습니다.

name: Targeted Redirection

description.value: You aim a shot at your spotter, intending for your spotter to redirect that shot off their own weapon or shield to hit your foe from a better angle, and avoid your foe's cover. If your next action is to make a ranged Strike, you treat your spotter's position as your own for the purposes of determining cover and range. Your spotter must be within your weapon's first range increment and they must use their reaction to redirect your shot.

_desc_en: You aim a shot at your spotter, intending for your spotter to redirect that shot off their own weapon or shield to hit your foe from a better angle, and avoid your foe's cover. If your next action is to make a ranged Strike, you treat your spotter's position as your own for the purposes of determining cover and range. Your spotter must be within your weapon's first range increment and they must use their reaction to redirect your shot.
_desc_ko: 당신은 스포터에게 사격을 조준하며, 스포터가 자신의 무기나 방패로 그 사격을 전환해 더 나은 각도에서 적을 명중시키고 적의 엄폐를 회피하도록 의도합니다. 다음 행동이 원거리 공격인 경우, 엄호와 사거리 판단 시 스포터의 위치를 자신의 위치로 간주한다. 스포터는 무기의 첫 번째 사거리 구간 내에 있어야 하며, 반응 행동을 사용해 사격을 전환해야 한다.

name: Miresoul

description.value: You have a connection to the muddier denizens of the Plane of Earth from its border with the Plane of Water, and your elemental lineage manifests as clay or mud, reflecting that bond. Your body's mudlike quality makes it easy for you to compress and squeeze yourself through smaller areas. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Acrobatics. If you would automatically become trained in Acrobatics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.3G8xUlgCjRmRJNfP]{Quick Squeeze} skill feat.

_desc_en: You have a connection to the muddier denizens of the Plane of Earth from its border with the Plane of Water, and your elemental lineage manifests as clay or mud, reflecting that bond. Your body's mudlike quality makes it easy for you to compress and squeeze yourself through smaller areas. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Acrobatics. If you would automatically become trained in Acrobatics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.3G8xUlgCjRmRJNfP]{Quick Squeeze} skill feat.
_desc_ko: 당신은 물계와 접한 땅계의 더 탁한 존재들과 연결되어 있으며, 그 유대를 반영하듯 당신의 원소 혈통은 진흙이나 흙으로 창조됩니다. 몸이 진흙처럼 변하는 특성 덕분에 좁은 공간을 쉽게 압축하거나 비집고 들어갈 수 있습니다. 당신은 곡예에 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 자동으로 곡예에 숙련된 상태가 된다면, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련된 상태가 됩니다. 당신은 @link[feats.quick-squeeze] 클래스 피트를 얻습니다.

name: Debilitating Venom

description.value:
Your venom is particularly potent, affecting targets in different ways. When you gain this feat, select one of the following debilitations. When you use Envenom, you can choose to apply a debilitation to your venom to adjust its effects. The changes to each stage of the venom are listed. You can apply only one debilitation to your venom.

  • Hampering (level 5)

    Stage 1 –5-foot status penalty to Speed

    Stage 2 –5-foot status penalty to Speed

    Stage 3 –10-foot status penalty to Speed

  • Stumbling (level 5)

    Stage 1 no adjustment

    Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}

    Stage 3 off-guard and a –5-foot penalty to Speed

Special You can select this feat a second time to gain the other debilitation.

_desc_en:
Your venom is particularly potent, affecting targets in different ways. When you gain this feat, select one of the following debilitations. When you use Envenom, you can choose to apply a debilitation to your venom to adjust its effects. The changes to each stage of the venom are listed. You can apply only one debilitation to your venom.

  • Hampering (level 5)

    Stage 1 –5-foot status penalty to Speed

    Stage 2 –5-foot status penalty to Speed

    Stage 3 –10-foot status penalty to Speed

  • Stumbling (level 5)

    Stage 1 no adjustment

    Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}

    Stage 3 off-guard and a –5-foot penalty to Speed

Special You can select this feat a second time to gain the other debilitation.
_desc_ko:
당신의 맹독은 특히 강력하여 대상에게 다양한 방식으로 영향을 미칩니다. 이 피트를 획득할 때 다음 약화 효과 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 맹독을 사용할 때, 맹독에 약화 효과를 적용하여 그 효과를 조정할 수 있습니다. 각 독 단계별 변경 사항은 다음과 같습니다. 맹독에는 하나의 약화 효과만 적용할 수 있습니다.

  • 방해 (레벨 5)

    1단계 -속도에 5피트 상태 불이익

    2단계 -속도에 5피트 상태 페널티

    3단계 -속도에 10피트 상태 페널티

  • 비틀거림 (레벨 5)

    1단계 조정 없음

    2단계 @link[conditions.off-guard]

    3단계 무방비 및 이동 속도 -5피트 페널티

특수 이 피트를 두 번째로 선택하여 다른 약화 효과를 얻을 수 있습니다.

name: Rallying Charge (Knight Vigilant)

description.value: When you lead your allies to the front lines, you leave no one behind. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.TW0fUdqqB69rIbRx]{Lead the Way}, instead of choosing one ally that has a reaction available, you can choose any number of allies within 10 feet of you. Any chosen allies that use their reaction to immediately Stride as part of you Leading the Way can end their Stride anywhere within 10 feet of you.

_desc_en: When you lead your allies to the front lines, you leave no one behind. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.TW0fUdqqB69rIbRx]{Lead the Way}, instead of choosing one ally that has a reaction available, you can choose any number of allies within 10 feet of you. Any chosen allies that use their reaction to immediately Stride as part of you Leading the Way can end their Stride anywhere within 10 feet of you.
_desc_ko: 당신이 아군을 전선으로 이끌 때, 누구도 뒤에 남겨두지 않습니다. 당신이 @link[feats.lead-the-way]를 사용할 때, 반응을 사용할 수 있는 아군 한 명을 선택하는 대신, 당신으로부터 10피트 이내에 있는 아군을 몇 명이라도 선택할 수 있습니다. 선택된 아군이 당신의 선두 행군에 참여하여 즉시 반응으로 이동하면, 당신으로부터 10피트 이내 어디에서든 이동을 종료할 수 있다.

name: Rouse the Dreaming Relic

description.value:
The spirit within your pusaka resonates with other magical items in your possession. Your pusaka gains the following activation.

Activate—Replenish Heirloom f (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect Your pusaka uses its power to spark one of your depleted magic items to life. You Activate an Item you've invested even after you've used that activation the maximum number of times for its frequency. You can do so only if the item's level is half your level or lower, the activation has a frequency of once per day or more frequent, and you haven't already used the activation this round.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
The spirit within your pusaka resonates with other magical items in your possession. Your pusaka gains the following activation.

Activate—Replenish Heirloom f (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect Your pusaka uses its power to spark one of your depleted magic items to life. You Activate an Item you've invested even after you've used that activation the maximum number of times for its frequency. You can do so only if the item's level is half your level or lower, the activation has a frequency of once per day or more frequent, and you haven't already used the activation this round.
_desc_ko:
당신의 푸사카 안에 깃든 영혼이 소유한 다른 마법 아이템들과 공명합니다. 당신의 푸사카는 다음 활성화 효과를 얻습니다.

활성화-가보 재충전 f (집중)

발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

효과 당신의 푸사카는 힘을 발휘해 소진된 마법 아이템 중 하나에 생명을 불어넣습니다. 해당 아이템의 사용 빈도 최대 횟수를 모두 사용한 후에도, 당신이 투자한 아이템을 활성화할 수 있습니다. 단, 아이템 레벨이 당신의 레벨의 절반 이하이고, 활성화 빈도가 하루에 한 번 이상이며, 이번 라운드에 해당 활성화를 아직 사용하지 않은 경우에만 가능합니다.

name: Triangulate

description.value: Your spotter's quick signals help you make even difficult shots seem simple. As long as both you and your spotter can see the target of your attacks, you don't take a penalty for attacking within your second range increment with a crossbow or firearm. The penalty you take for firing into further range increments is –3 for the third range increment, with an additional –2 penalty for each additional increment beyond the third (–5 for the fourth range increment, –7 for the fifth, and –9 for the sixth).

_desc_en: Your spotter's quick signals help you make even difficult shots seem simple. As long as both you and your spotter can see the target of your attacks, you don't take a penalty for attacking within your second range increment with a crossbow or firearm. The penalty you take for firing into further range increments is –3 for the third range increment, with an additional –2 penalty for each additional increment beyond the third (–5 for the fourth range increment, –7 for the fifth, and –9 for the sixth).
_desc_ko: 정찰병의 신속한 신호 덕분에 어려운 사격도 쉽게 느껴집니다. 당신과 정찰병 모두 공격 대상이 보인다면, 석궁이나 화기로 두 번째 사거리 구간 내에서 공격할 때 페널티를 받지 않습니다. 더 먼 사거리 구간으로 발사할 경우 받는 페널티는 세 번째 사거리 구간에서 -3이며, 세 번째 이후 추가 구간마다 -2의 페널티가 더해집니다(네 번째 사거리 구간 -5, 다섯 번째 -7, 여섯 번째 -9).

name: Sanctify Armament

description.value:
You touch a weapon and bring it into concordance with your deity. For 1 round, that weapon gains your holy or unholy trait. It also deals an additional 2d6 spirit damage to creatures of the opposed trait. For example, if you are holy, the weapon would deal an extra 2d6 spirit damage to unholy creatures.

If you use Sanctify Armament again, any previous use of it expires.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ImkjllInxmrdDCOq]{Effect: Sanctify Armament}

_desc_en:
You touch a weapon and bring it into concordance with your deity. For 1 round, that weapon gains your holy or unholy trait. It also deals an additional 2d6 spirit damage to creatures of the opposed trait. For example, if you are holy, the weapon would deal an extra 2d6 spirit damage to unholy creatures.

If you use Sanctify Armament again, any previous use of it expires.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.ImkjllInxmrdDCOq]{Effect: Sanctify Armament}
_desc_ko:
무기를 만져 신과 조화를 이루게 합니다. 1라운드 동안 해당 무기는 당신의 신성한 또는 불경한 특성을 얻습니다. 또한 반대 특성을 가진 생물에게 추가로 2d6 영혼 피해를 입힙니다. 예를 들어, 당신이 신성한 경우 무기는 불경한 생물에게 추가로 2d6 영혼 피해를 입힙니다.

무기 성화 주문을 다시 사용하면, 이전에 사용한 효과는 모두 소멸한다.

name: Preternatural Polish

description.value:
Armor you polish shines with righteous grace. You can take 10 minutes to recite prayers or oaths while polishing a suit of heavy armor that you or a willing creature is wearing. If you do, attempt a @Check[crafting|dc:35|showDC:all] check with the following results. The armor then becomes temporarily immune to this ability until your next daily preparations.

Critical Success Once in the next hour, the creature wearing the polished armor can use a reaction to shine majestically. This reaction is triggered when they would be affected by a spell or ability with the darkness trait. The creature attempts a counteract check against the triggering effect using your Crafting modifier. Additionally, the creature wearing the polished armor gains an additional reaction at the start of each of their turns that can be only used for this reaction.

Success As critical success, but the creature wearing the polished armor doesn't gain an additional reaction at the start of each of their turns.

_desc_en:
Armor you polish shines with righteous grace. You can take 10 minutes to recite prayers or oaths while polishing a suit of heavy armor that you or a willing creature is wearing. If you do, attempt a @Check[crafting|dc:35|showDC:all] check with the following results. The armor then becomes temporarily immune to this ability until your next daily preparations.

Critical Success Once in the next hour, the creature wearing the polished armor can use a reaction to shine majestically. This reaction is triggered when they would be affected by a spell or ability with the darkness trait. The creature attempts a counteract check against the triggering effect using your Crafting modifier. Additionally, the creature wearing the polished armor gains an additional reaction at the start of each of their turns that can be only used for this reaction.

Success As critical success, but the creature wearing the polished armor doesn't gain an additional reaction at the start of each of their turns.
_desc_ko:
당신이 닦는 갑옷은 의로운 은총으로 빛난다. 당신이나 동의한 대상이 착용한 중갑을 닦으면서 10분 동안 기도나 맹세를 낭송할 수 있다. 그렇게 할 경우, 다음 결과에 따라 DC 35 제작 판정을 시도하다. 그러면 갑주는 다음 일일 준비 시간까지 이 능력에 대해 일시적으로 면역이 된다.

대성공 다음 1시간 동안 한 번, 닦인 갑주를 착용한 생물은 반응을 사용해 위엄 있게 빛날 수 있다. 이 반응은 어둠 속성을 가진 주문이나 능력의 영향을 받을 때 발동됩니다. 생물은 발동 효과에 대해 제작 수정자를 적용한 대응 판정(반격 판정)를 시도합니다. 또한, 광택 처리된 갑옷을 착용한 생물은 자신의 턴 시작 시마다 이 반응에만 사용할 수 있는 추가 반응을 얻습니다.

대성공 대성공 시 효과와 동일하나, 광택이 나는 갑옷을 입은 생물은 자신의 턴 시작 시마다 추가 반응을 얻지 못한다.

name: No Hands, No Problem

description.value: After a lifetime of using temporary, ghostly limbs to manipulate objects, you hardly need real hands. You can extend your limbs to perform simple Interact actions at a range 5 feet beyond your normal range, after which your limbs contract back to their normal length. You can also cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.pwzdSlJgYqN7bs2w]{Telekinetic Hand} cantrip as an arcane or occult innate spell at will, which always takes the ghostlike form of telekinetic hand and is tethered to your body via a snaking, illusory arm. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

You can also cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.pwzdSlJgYqN7bs2w]{Telekinetic Hand} cantrip as an arcane or occult innate spell at will, which always takes the ghostlike form of telekinetic hand and is tethered to your body via a snaking, illusory arm. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 일생 동안 유령 같은 임시 사지를 이용해 물체를 조작해온 당신은 실제 손이 거의 필요하지 않습니다. 사지를 뻗어 정상 범위보다 5피트 더 먼 거리에서 간단한 상호작용 행동을 수행할 수 있으며, 이후 사지는 정상 길이로 수축합니다. 또한 @link[spells.telekinetic-hand] 캔트립을 아케인 또는 오컬트 선천적 주문으로 마음대로 시전할 수 있으며, 이는 항상 텔레키네틱 핸드라는 유령 같은 형태를 취하고, 뱀처럼 꿈틀대는 환상의 팔을 통해 몸에 연결된다. 캔트립은 당신의 레벨 절반(올림)에 해당하는 주문 랭크으로 강화됩니다.

name: Basic Skysage Divination

description.value:
The stars move, granting you a sliver of their magic. Choose one of the following 1st-rank spells to your spell repertoire: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5LYi9Efs6cko4GGL]{Object Reading} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{Sure Strike}. You can Cast this Spell as an occult Oatia skysage spell.

At 6th level, choose one of the following 2nd-rank spells to add to your spell repertoire: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.41TZEjhO6D1nWw2X]{Augury} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen}. At 8th level, you choose one of the following 3rd-rank spells to add to your spell repertoire: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HXhWYJviWalN5tQ2]{Clairaudience} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.LQzlKbYjZSMFQawP]{Locate}.

_desc_en:

Choose one of the following 1st-rank spells to your spell repertoire: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5LYi9Efs6cko4GGL]{Object Reading} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{Sure Strike}. You can Cast this Spell as an occult Oatia skysage spell.
