At 8th level, you choose one of the following 3rd-rank spells to add to your spell repertoire: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HXhWYJviWalN5tQ2]{Clairaudience} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.LQzlKbYjZSMFQawP]{Locate}.
_desc_ko:
별들이 움직이며, 그 마법의 일부를 당신에게 부여합니다. 다음 1랭크 주문 중 하나를 당신의 주문 목록에 추가하십시오: @link[spells.object-reading] 또는 @link[spells.sure-strike]. 이 주문을 오컬트 오아티아 스카이세이지 주문으로 시전할 수 있습니다.

6레벨에 도달하면 다음 (2nd) 랭크 주문 중 하나를 선택하여 주문 목록에 추가하십시오: @link[spells.augury] 또는 @link[spells.see-the-unseen]. 8레벨에 도달하면 다음 (3rd)랭크 주문 중 하나를 선택하여 주문 목록에 추가합니다: @link[spells.clairaudience] 또는 @link[spells.locate].

name: Construct Dynamo

description.value:
Access You are an automaton or are otherwise from the ancient Jistka Imperium.

You've learned the secrets of Jistkan construct prostheses, allowing you to incorporate construct components into your dynamo and gain a portion of their magic. You gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against magic, and your dynamo Strikes become magical.

_desc_en:
Access You are an automaton or are otherwise from the ancient Jistka Imperium.

You've learned the secrets of Jistkan construct prostheses, allowing you to incorporate construct components into your dynamo and gain a portion of their magic. You gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against magic, and your dynamo Strikes become magical.
_desc_ko:
접근 당신은 오토마톤이거나 고대 지스트카 제국 출신이다.

당신은 지스트카 인공체 보철 기술의 비밀을 터득하여, 자신의 다이나모에 인공체 부품을 통합하고 그 마법의 일부를 흡수할 수 있습니다. 마법에 대한 내성 굴림에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻으며, 다이나모의 공격은 마법 공격이 됩니다.

name: Scamper

description.value:
Requirements You are adjacent to at least one enemy.

You Stride up to your Speed, with a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against reactions triggered by this movement. You must end this movement in a space that's not adjacent to any enemy.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are adjacent to at least one enemy.

You Stride up to your Speed, with a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against reactions triggered by this movement. You must end this movement in a space that's not adjacent to any enemy.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 적어도 한 명의 적과 인접해 있어야 합니다.

당신은 자신의 이동력만큼 스트라이드를 하며, 이동력에 +5피트 상태 보너스를 받고, 이 이동으로 유발된 반응에 대해 AC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 이동은 적과 인접하지 않은 공간에서 끝나야 합니다.

name: Tongue Disarm

description.value: You lash out with your tongue to disarm your foe. You attempt to Disarm a creature within 10 feet, ignoring the requirement that you must have at least one hand free.

_desc_en: You lash out with your tongue to disarm your foe. You attempt to Disarm a creature within 10 feet, ignoring the requirement that you must have at least one hand free.
_desc_ko: 당신은 혀를 휘둘러 적의 무기를 빼앗는다. 10피트 이내의 생물에게 {무장 해제}를 시도하며, 한 손이 자유로워야 한다는 조건은 무시된다.

name: Witch Dedication

description.value:
You cast spells like a witch. Choose a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.KPtF29AaeX2sJW0K]{Patron}; you gain a familiar with two common cantrips of your choice from your chosen patron's tradition, but aside from the tradition, you don't gain any other effects the patron would usually grant. Your familiar gains the normal number of abilities for a familiar instead of those a witch familiar normally gets.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast a Spell} activity. You can prepare one cantrip each day from your familiar. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for witch archetype spells is Intelligence, and they are witch spells of your patron's tradition.

You become trained in the skill associated with the patron's tradition; if you were already trained in it, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.eNTStXeuABNPSLjw]{Witch}

_desc_en:
You cast spells like a witch. Choose a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.KPtF29AaeX2sJW0K]{Patron}; you gain a familiar with two common cantrips of your choice from your chosen patron's tradition, but aside from the tradition, you don't gain any other effects the patron would usually grant. Your familiar gains the normal number of abilities for a familiar instead of those a witch familiar normally gets.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast a Spell} activity. You can prepare one cantrip each day from your familiar. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for witch archetype spells is Intelligence, and they are witch spells of your patron's tradition.

You become trained in the skill associated with the patron's tradition; if you were already trained in it, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.eNTStXeuABNPSLjw]{Witch}
_desc_ko:
당신은 마녀처럼 주문을 시전합니다. @link[feats.patron]를 선택하세요; 선택한 후원자의 전통에서 원하는 두 가지 일반적인 캔트립을 가진 패밀리어를 얻습니다. 그러나 전통 외에는 후원자가 일반적으로 부여하는 다른 효과는 얻지 못합니다. 네 패밀리어는 마녀의 패밀리어가 일반적으로 얻는 능력 대신 패밀리어에게 주어지는 일반적인 수의 능력을 얻는다.

당신은 @link[actions.cast-a-spell] 활동을 얻습니다. 매일 당신의 패밀리어로부터 하나의 캔트립을 준비할 수 있습니다. 당신은 주문 공격 수정자와 주문 DC 통계에 숙련됩니다. 마녀 아키타입 주문에 대한 당신의 주요 주문 시전 능력치는 지능이며, 이들은 당신의 후원자의 전통에 속하는 마녀 주문입니다.

후원자의 전통과 연관된 기술에 숙련됩니다. 이미 숙련된 경우, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련됩니다.

name: Elven Persistence

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a skill check you're at least trained in.

Elves don't give up easily on their pursuits. Instead of the result you received for the triggering skill check, you receive a result of 12 + your proficiency bonus (don't apply any other bonuses, penalties, or modifiers).

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a skill check you're at least trained in.

Elves don't give up easily on their pursuits. Instead of the result you received for the triggering skill check, you receive a result of 12 + your proficiency bonus (don't apply any other bonuses, penalties, or modifiers).
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

발동 조건 숙련 이상인 기술 판정에서 실패할 때.

엘프는 자신의 목표를 쉽게 포기하지 않는다. 트리거된 스킬 판정의 결과 대신, 12 + 숙련 보너스(다른 보너스, 페널티, 수정자는 적용하지 않음)의 결과를 받습니다.

name: Blind-Fight

description.value:
Fighter, Rogue, Investigator Your battle instincts make you more aware of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} opponents.

Ranger Your heightened senses allow you to instinctively detect unseen opponents.

You don't need to succeed at a flat check to target concealed creatures. You're not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to creatures that are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from you (unless you're off-guard to them for reasons other than the hidden condition), and you need only a successful @Check[flat|showDC:all|dc:5] to target a hidden creature.

While you're adjacent to an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} creature of your level or lower, it is instead only hidden from you.

_desc_en:
Fighter, Rogue, Investigator Your battle instincts make you more aware of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} opponents.

Ranger Your heightened senses allow you to instinctively detect unseen opponents.

You don't need to succeed at a flat check to target concealed creatures. You're not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to creatures that are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from you (unless you're off-guard to them for reasons other than the hidden condition), and you need only a successful @Check[flat|showDC:all|dc:5] to target a hidden creature.

While you're adjacent to an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} creature of your level or lower, it is instead only hidden from you.
_desc_ko:
파이터, 로그, 조사자 전투 본능으로 인해 @link[conditions.concealed] 및 @link[conditions.invisible] 상태의 적을 더 잘 감지합니다.

레인저 당신의 강화된 감각은 보이지 않는 적을 본능적으로 감지하게 합니다.

은폐된 생물을 대상으로 할 때 단순 판정에서 성공할 필요가 없습니다. 당신은 당신에게 @link[conditions.hidden] 생물에게 @link[conditions.off-guard]가 아닙니다(숨겨진 상태 이외의 이유로 그들에게 무방비인 경우는 제외). 또한 숨겨진 생물을 표적으로 삼기 위해 필요한 것은 단지 성공적인 DC 5 단순 검사뿐입니다.

당신이 자신의 레벨 이하인 @link[conditions.undetected] 생물과 인접해 있을 때, 해당 생물은 당신에게만 숨겨진 상태로 간주됩니다.

name: Mythic Containment

description.value: You infuse a receptacle, such as a normal bag, sack, or box, with mythic power, transforming it into a prison into which you can command a creature. Spend a Mythic Point, and attempt a @Check[deception|against:will], @Check[diplomacy|against:will], or @Check[intimidation|against:will] check at mythic proficiency against the Will DC of a creature within 30 feet to trick, convince, or command it into entering the receptacle. The receptacle can hold a creature of any size, and the creature enters the receptacle if your check is successful. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}, and has to hold its breath or start suffocating. A creature trapped in the receptacle can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}; use the skill you used to lure the creature into the bag for the DC, and calculate the DC using mythic proficiency. The trapped creature is automatically freed after 1 minute, but you can spend an additional Mythic Point as a free action to prolong the duration of the containment for an additional minute when it would expire.

_desc_en: You infuse a receptacle, such as a normal bag, sack, or box, with mythic power, transforming it into a prison into which you can command a creature. Spend a Mythic Point, and attempt a @Check[deception|against:will], @Check[diplomacy|against:will], or @Check[intimidation|against:will] check at mythic proficiency against the Will DC of a creature within 30 feet to trick, convince, or command it into entering the receptacle. The receptacle can hold a creature of any size, and the creature enters the receptacle if your check is successful. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}, and has to hold its breath or start suffocating. A creature trapped in the receptacle can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}; use the skill you used to lure the creature into the bag for the DC, and calculate the DC using mythic proficiency. The trapped creature is automatically freed after 1 minute, but you can spend an additional Mythic Point as a free action to prolong the duration of the containment for an additional minute when it would expire.
_desc_ko: 일반적인 가방, 자루, 상자 같은 용기에 신화적 힘을 주입하여 생물을 가둘 수 있는 감옥으로 변환합니다. 신화 포인트 1점을 소모하고, 30피트 내 생물의 의지 DC에 대해 신화 숙련도로 기만, 외교 또는 위협 판정을 시도하여 그 생물을 속이거나 설득하거나 명령하여 용기에 들어가게 합니다. 수납함은 모든 크기의 생물을 수용할 수 있으며, 판정에 성공하면 생물은 수납함 안으로 들어간다. 생물은 @link[conditions.grabbed] 상태가 되고, @link[conditions.slowed]{1} 상태가 되며, 숨을 참지 않으면 질식하기 시작한다. 수납함에 갇힌 생물은 판정을 시도하다 @link[actions.escape]을 시도할 수 있습니다. DC는 생물을 가방으로 유인하는 데 사용한 스킬을 적용하며, 신화 숙련도를 사용하여 DC를 계산합니다. 갇힌 생물은 1분 후 자동으로 풀려나지만, 제한 시간이 만료될 때 추가 신화 포인트 1점을 무료 행동으로 소모하여 갇힘 상태를 1분 더 연장할 수 있습니다.

name: Ferrousoul

description.value: Whether in their pure elemental forms or as part of an alloy such as steel, the elemental metal in your soul resonates strongly with iron, bronze, and other sturdy, practical metals suitable for weaponry. Your fist attacks gain the modular B, P, or S trait and lose the nonlethal trait. Your fist's damage die increases to 1d6.

_desc_en: Whether in their pure elemental forms or as part of an alloy such as steel, the elemental metal in your soul resonates strongly with iron, bronze, and other sturdy, practical metals suitable for weaponry. Your fist attacks gain the modular B, P, or S trait and lose the nonlethal trait. Your fist's damage die increases to 1d6.
_desc_ko: 순수한 원소 형태이든 강철 같은 합금의 일부이든, 당신의 영혼 속 원소 금속은 철, 청동 등 무기 제작에 적합한 견고하고 실용적인 금속들과 강하게 공명합니다. 당신의 주먹 공격은 모듈러 B, P 또는 S 특성을 얻고 비살상 특성을 잃습니다. 주먹의 피해 주사위가 1d6으로 증가합니다.

name: Mysterious Breadth

description.value: Increase the number of spells in your repertoire and number of spell slots you gain from oracle archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest oracle spell slots.

_desc_en: Increase the number of spells in your repertoire and number of spell slots you gain from oracle archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest oracle spell slots.
_desc_ko: 오라클 아키타입 피트로 얻는 주문 슬롯을, 가장 높은 두 주문 랭크을 제외한 나머지 각 주문 랭크당 1씩 증가시킵니다.

name: Furious Focus

description.value: You've learned to maintain your balance even when swinging furiously. When you make a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.2xk4jdwcCfmasYfT]{Vicious Swing} with a melee weapon you're wielding in two hands, it counts as one attack toward your multiple attack penalty instead of two.

_desc_en: You've learned to maintain your balance even when swinging furiously. When you make a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.2xk4jdwcCfmasYfT]{Vicious Swing} with a melee weapon you're wielding in two hands, it counts as one attack toward your multiple attack penalty instead of two.
_desc_ko: 당신은 격렬하게 휘두르면서도 균형을 유지하는 법을 터득했습니다. 양손으로 휘두르는 근접 무기로 @link[feats.vicious-swing]을 수행할 때, 이는 다중 공격 페널티 계산 시 두 번이 아닌 한 번의 공격으로 간주됩니다.

name: Poisoner Dedication

description.value:
You make a point of always having a few toxins near at hand—you never know when some arsenic or the like might prove useful. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.Jkl5KOZih7MoMqAJ#advanced-alchemy-benefits]{advanced alchemy benefits}. You can use advanced alchemy to create four alchemical poison consumables each day. You remember alchemical poison formulas and don't need a formula book for them.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.HvbDEgCsLbzuMRiR]{Poisoner}

_desc_en:
You make a point of always having a few toxins near at hand—you never know when some arsenic or the like might prove useful. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.Jkl5KOZih7MoMqAJ#advanced-alchemy-benefits]{advanced alchemy benefits}. You can use advanced alchemy to create four alchemical poison consumables each day. You remember alchemical poison formulas and don't need a formula book for them.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.HvbDEgCsLbzuMRiR]{Poisoner}
_desc_ko: 항상 몇 가지 독성 물질을 가까이에 두는 것을 원칙으로 삼습니다-비소 같은 것이 언제 유용할지 모르니까요. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.Jkl5KOZih7MoMqAJ#advanced-alchemy-benefits]{고급 연금술 혜택}을 얻습니다. 고급 연금술을 사용하여 매일 네 개의 연금술 독 소모품을 제작할 수 있습니다. 연금술 독 제조법을 기억하므로 해당 제조법 책이 필요하지 않습니다.

name: Elven Aloofness

description.value:
As much as you might care for them, you've come to terms with the ephemeral nature of non-elves, and it makes their threats feel less troublesome.

If a non-elf rolls a failure on a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce} you using Intimidation, it gets a critical failure instead (and thus can't try to Coerce you again for 1 week).

When a non-elf attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} you, you become temporarily immune for 1 day, instead of 10 minutes.

_desc_en:
As much as you might care for them, you've come to terms with the ephemeral nature of non-elves, and it makes their threats feel less troublesome.

If a non-elf rolls a failure on a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce} you using Intimidation, it gets a critical failure instead (and thus can't try to Coerce you again for 1 week).

When a non-elf attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} you, you become temporarily immune for 1 day, instead of 10 minutes.
_desc_ko:
비록 그들을 아끼는 마음이 있더라도, 당신은 비엘프들의 덧없는 본성을 받아들였기에 그들의 위협이 덜 부담스럽게 느껴집니다.

비엘프가 협박(U0001)으로 당신을 강요하려는 판정에 실패할 경우, 대신 대실패를 굴림한다(따라서 1주일 동안 다시는 당신을 강요할 수 없다).

비엘프가 당신에게 @link[actions.demoralize]를 시도할 때, 10분이 아닌 1일간 일시적으로 면역 상태가 됩니다.

name: Retaliatory Cleansing

description.value:
Trigger You would take damage from an adjacent creature's Strike.

Requirements You're holding holy water or a bomb that deals vitality damage in one of your hands.

You twist your hand in front of the blow, ensuring the enemy's attack shatters the required holy water or bomb. The creature takes the on-hit and splash damage from the holy water or required bomb, not counting any additional effects you would add or apply when you throw the bomb, such as weapon specialization or Calculated Splash. You're splashed by the holy water or required bomb, although since vitality damage harms only undead and creatures with void healing, it's unlikely you will take damage.

_desc_ko:
발동 조건 인접한 생물의 공격으로 피해를 입을 뻔했다.

요구 사항 한 손에 활력 피해를 주는 신성한 성수나 폭탄을 들고 있어야 합니다.

타격이 오기 전에 손을 비틀어 적의 공격이 필요한 신성한 물이나 폭탄을 부수게 한다. 생물은 신성한 물이나 필요한 폭탄의 직격 및 방사 피해를 받으며, 폭탄을 던질 때 적용되는 무기 전문화나 계산된 방사 같은 추가 효과는 포함되지 않는다. 당신도 신성한 물이나 폭탄의 비산 피해를 받지만, 활력 피해는 언데드나 공허 치유 능력을 가진 생물에게만 적용되므로 피해를 입을 가능성은 낮다.

name: Magic Hide

description.value: You can defend your companion in battle. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.u2uSeH6YSbK1ajTy]{Magic Hide} warden spell. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.

_desc_en: You can defend your companion in battle. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.u2uSeH6YSbK1ajTy]{Magic Hide} warden spell. Increase the number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.
_desc_ko: 전투 중 동료의 방어를 도울 수 있습니다. @link[spells.magic-hide] 워든 주문을 획득합니다. 포커스 풀의 포커스 포인트 수를 1 증가시킵니다.

name: Meddling Futures

description.value:
You open yourself to the guidance of whatever spirits or powers deign to help you. Roll 1d4 to see what type of spirit is drawn to you. Your next action must be the type of action the spirit prefers, but you also gain the listed benefit for the action as the spirit guides you. If you attempt to use a different action, you must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:6] or the action is lost.

1 Warrior You must attempt a Strike. You gain a +1 status bonus to your attack roll and a +2 status bonus to damage, or a +6 status bonus to damage if you are at least @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zXZjC8HLaRoLR17U]{Cursebound 3}.

2 Adept You must attempt a Perception check or a skill action. You gain a +1 status bonus to the check, or a +2 status bonus if you are cursebound 3.

3 Sage You must attempt to Cast a Spell. You gain a status bonus to the spell's damage or healing equal to the spell's rank, or equal to the spell's rank + 3 if you are at least cursebound 3.

4 Wanderer You must attempt a Stride action, or a Fly, Climb, or Burrow action if you have the relevant speed. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed for the action, or a +20-foot status bonus if you are at least cursebound 3.

_desc_en:
You open yourself to the guidance of whatever spirits or powers deign to help you. Roll 1d4 to see what type of spirit is drawn to you. Your next action must be the type of action the spirit prefers, but you also gain the listed benefit for the action as the spirit guides you. If you attempt to use a different action, you must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:6] or the action is lost.

1 Warrior You must attempt a Strike. You gain a +1 status bonus to your attack roll and a +2 status bonus to damage, or a +6 status bonus to damage if you are at least @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zXZjC8HLaRoLR17U]{Cursebound 3}.

2 Adept You must attempt a Perception check or a skill action. You gain a +1 status bonus to the check, or a +2 status bonus if you are cursebound 3.

3 Sage You must attempt to Cast a Spell. You gain a status bonus to the spell's damage or healing equal to the spell's rank, or equal to the spell's rank + 3 if you are at least cursebound 3.

4 Wanderer You must attempt a Stride action, or a Fly, Climb, or Burrow action if you have the relevant speed. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed for the action, or a +20-foot status bonus if you are at least cursebound 3.
_desc_ko:
당신은 당신을 도우려 하는 영혼이나 힘의 인도에 마음을 엽니다. 1d4를 굴려 어떤 유형의 영혼이 당신에게 끌리는지 확인합니다. 다음 행동은 반드시 해당 영혼이 선호하는 유형이어야 하며, 영혼의 인도에 따라 해당 행동에 명시된 이점을 얻습니다. 다른 행동을 시도할 경우 DC 6 단순에 성공해야 하며, 실패하면 행동이 무효화됩니다.

1 전사 공격을 시도해야 합니다. 명중 굴림에 +1 상태 보너스와 피해에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. @link[conditions.cursebound]{3} 이상일 경우 피해에 +6 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

2 숙련자 지각력 판정나 기술 행동을 시도해야 합니다. 해당 판정에서 +1 상태 보너스를 얻으며, 저주에 묶임 3 상태일 경우 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

3 현자 당신은 주문을 시전하려고 시도해야 합니다. 당신은 주문의 랭크에 해당하는 상태 보너스를 주문의 피해나 치유량에 얻습니다. 저주에 묶인 3단계 이상이라면 주문의 랭크 +3에 해당하는 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

4 방랑자 해당 속도를 가진 경우, 이동 행동 또는 비행, 등반, 굴착 행동을 시도해야 합니다. 해당 행동 시 속도에 +10피트 상태 보너스를 얻으며, 저주에 묶인 상태가 3단계 이상일 경우 +20피트 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Explosive Arrival

description.value: Your summoned creature appears in a detonation of arcane runes. If your next action is to Cast a Spell with the summon trait, all creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] around the creature you summoned take 1d4 fire damage per spell rank. If the creature summoned has the acid, cold, electricity, sonic, or spirit trait, you can deal damage of that type instead.

_desc_en: Your summoned creature appears in a detonation of arcane runes. If your next action is to Cast a Spell with the summon trait, all creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] around the creature you summoned take 1d4 fire damage per spell rank. If the creature summoned has the acid, cold, electricity, sonic, or spirit trait, you can deal damage of that type instead.
_desc_ko: 소환한 생물은 아케인 룬이 폭발하는 가운데 나타난다. 다음 행동으로 소환 특성을 가진 주문을 시전할 경우, 소환한 생물 주변 10피트 내 모든 생물은 주문 랭크당 1d4 화염 피해를 입는다. 소환한 생물이 산성, 냉기, 전기, 음파 또는 영혼 특성을 가진 경우, 해당 유형의 피해를 대신 입힐 수 있다.

name: Qi Spells

description.value:
You have cultivated your qi to produce magical effects. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZL8NTvB22NeEWhVG]{Inner Upheaval}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ps0nmhclT6aIXgd8]{Qi Rush}, or another 1st-rank monk qi spell you have access to.

Special You can select this feat more than once, choosing a different spell each time.

_desc_en:
You have cultivated your qi to produce magical effects. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZL8NTvB22NeEWhVG]{Inner Upheaval}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ps0nmhclT6aIXgd8]{Qi Rush}, or another 1st-rank monk qi spell you have access to.

Special You can select this feat more than once, choosing a different spell each time.
_desc_ko: 당신은 기를 수련하여 마법 효과를 만들어 냈습니다. 당신은 @link[spells.inner-upheaval], @link[spells.qi-rush] 또는 당신이 사용할 수 있는 다른 1랭크 몽크 기 주문을 얻습니다.

name: Dragging Strike

description.value:
You aim your weapon to snag a foe's armor, clothing, or flesh to pull them closer.

Make a melee Strike. If you hit a target that is your size or smaller, that creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your current turn, and you can move it 5 feet toward you. When you move the creature, you can move the same distance in the same direction as it, even if you're adjacent to the target. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

This Strike has the following failure effect.

Failure The target becomes off-guard until the end of your current turn.

_desc_en:
You aim your weapon to snag a foe's armor, clothing, or flesh to pull them closer.

Make a melee Strike. If you hit a target that is your size or smaller, that creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your current turn, and you can move it 5 feet toward you. When you move the creature, you can move the same distance in the same direction as it, even if you're adjacent to the target. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

This Strike has the following failure effect.

Failure The target becomes off-guard until the end of your current turn.
_desc_ko:
무기를 겨누어 적의 갑옷, 옷, 살점을 걸어 당겨 들이민다.

근접 공격을 가한다. 네 크기와 같거나 작은 대상을 명중시키면, 그 생물은 네 현재 턴이 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 되며, 당신은 그 생물을 당신 쪽으로 5피트 이동시킬 수 있다. 생물을 이동시킬 때, 대상과 인접해 있더라도 동일한 방향으로 동일한 거리만큼 이동할 수 있다. 이 이동은 반응을 유발하지 않는다.

이 공격은 다음과 같은 실패 효과를 가집니다.

실패 대상은 현재 턴이 끝날 때까지 무방비 상태가 된다.

name: Shoony Lore

description.value: Growing up in shoony society, you learned the value of honesty, friendship, and hard work, even during trying times. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Diplomacy and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also become trained in Shoony Lore.

_desc_en: Growing up in shoony society, you learned the value of honesty, friendship, and hard work, even during trying times. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Diplomacy and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also become trained in Shoony Lore.
_desc_ko: 슈니 사회에서 자라난 당신은 어려운 시기에도 정직, 우정, 근면의 가치를 배웠습니다. 외교와 생존 기술에 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 해당 기술 중 하나에 자동으로 숙련이 부여될 경우, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련이 부여됩니다. 또한 슈니 지식 숙련도를 획득합니다.

name: Dustsoul

description.value: Your earth elemental ancestor's influence manifests in you as dust and dirt, like the soil of a field or the hot desert sands. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Survival. If you would automatically become trained in Survival (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You can sustain yourself on dirt and ash instead of normal food and water.

_desc_en: Your earth elemental ancestor's influence manifests in you as dust and dirt, like the soil of a field or the hot desert sands. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Survival. If you would automatically become trained in Survival (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You can sustain yourself on dirt and ash instead of normal food and water.
_desc_ko: 당신의 대지 정령 조상의 영향이 들판의 흙이나 뜨거운 사막의 모래처럼 먼지와 흙으로 당신에게 창조됩니다. 생존 기술에 숙련 등급을 얻습니다. 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 생존 기술에 자동으로 숙련이 부여될 경우, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련이 부여됩니다. 일반적인 음식과 물 대신 흙과 재로도 생존할 수 있습니다.

name: Eye for Weakness

description.value: When you successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about a creature you can see, you automatically learn if it has a weakness to holy or unholy in addition to any other results. If you critically succeed at the check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, that creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you until the end of your turn.

value.value: Sister of the Golden Erinys Dedication

_desc_en: When you successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about a creature you can see, you automatically learn if it has a weakness to holy or unholy in addition to any other results. If you critically succeed at the check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, that creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you until the end of your turn.
_desc_ko: 당신이 볼 수 있는 생물에 대한 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{지식 회상}에 성공하면, 다른 결과에 더해 그 생물이 신성이나 불경에 약점을 가지고 있는지 자동으로 알게 됩니다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{지식 회상} 판정에 대성공하면, 그 생물은 당신의 턴이 끝날 때까지 당신에게 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{무방비} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Communal Healing

description.value: You're an exceptional conduit for vitality and, as you channel it through you, you can divert some to heal yourself or another creature. When you cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} spell to heal a single creature, choose another willing living creature within range of your heal to regain Hit Points equal to the heal spell's rank.

_desc_en: You're an exceptional conduit for vitality and, as you channel it through you, you can divert some to heal yourself or another creature. When you cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} spell to heal a single creature, choose another willing living creature within range of your heal to regain Hit Points equal to the heal spell's rank.
_desc_ko: 당신은 활력의 탁월한 통로이며, 이를 자신에게 흘려보낼 때 일부를 전환하여 자신이나 다른 생물을 치유할 수 있습니다. 단일 생물을 치유하기 위해 @link[spells.heal] 주문을 시전할 때, 치유 범위 내의 다른 동의한 생물을 선택하여 치유 주문의 랭크에 해당하는 HP를 회복시킵니다.

name: Klingegeist

description.value:
Your imprisonment inside a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.5Q5MfHX43Sjm8C6Z]{Final Blade} used to perform countless executions has instilled in you an aptitude for entering and possessing similar sharp implements of murder. You project your mind and incorporeal body into an unattended weapon of 2 Bulk or less that deals slashing damage.

While possessing a blade, you have a space of 5 feet, but you don't block or impede enemies attempting to move through your space, nor do you benefit from or provide flanking. You're trained in the use of the weapon, unless your proficiency was already better, and you can make Strike actions with the weapon as if you were wielding it.

You gain a Fly speed of 30 feet and can only take Strike and Fly actions, which don't trigger reactions. You have an AC of 18 + your level and the Hardness and Hit Points of the weapon you're possessing, which for most one-handed slashing weapons is Hardness 5 and HP 20. You can't be Disarmed, nor can your true body be directly injured except by spirit damage, which bypasses both the weapon's Hardness and Hit Points to damage you directly.

If you're reduced to 0 Hit Points or the weapon you're inhabiting is broken or destroyed, you're immediately ejected from it and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round. Otherwise, the effect lasts for 10 minutes or until you Dismiss it.

_desc_en:
Your imprisonment inside a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.5Q5MfHX43Sjm8C6Z]{Final Blade} used to perform countless executions has instilled in you an aptitude for entering and possessing similar sharp implements of murder. You project your mind and incorporeal body into an unattended weapon of 2 Bulk or less that deals slashing damage.

While possessing a blade, you have a space of 5 feet, but you don't block or impede enemies attempting to move through your space, nor do you benefit from or provide flanking. You're trained in the use of the weapon, unless your proficiency was already better, and you can make Strike actions with the weapon as if you were wielding it.

You gain a Fly speed of 30 feet and can only take Strike and Fly actions, which don't trigger reactions. You have an AC of 18 + your level and the Hardness and Hit Points of the weapon you're possessing, which for most one-handed slashing weapons is Hardness 5 and HP 20. You can't be Disarmed, nor can your true body be directly injured except by spirit damage, which bypasses both the weapon's Hardness and Hit Points to damage you directly.

If you're reduced to 0 Hit Points or the weapon you're inhabiting is broken or destroyed, you're immediately ejected from it and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round. Otherwise, the effect lasts for 10 minutes or until you Dismiss it.
_desc_ko:
수많은 처형에 사용된 @link[equipment.final-blade] 안에 갇혀 있던 경험은 당신에게 유사한 날카로운 살인 도구에 들어가 그 것을 지배하는 능력을 부여했습니다. 당신은 무게 2 이하의 방치된 베기 피해를 주는 무기에 정신과 비물질적 몸을 투사합니다.

칼을 점유하는 동안 당신은 5피트 공간을 차지하지만, 적들이 당신의 공간을 통과하려고 시도할 때 방해하거나 막지 않으며, 측면 공격의 이점을 받거나 제공하지도 않습니다. 무기 숙련도가 이미 더 높지 않은 한, 당신은 해당 무기 사용에 숙련되어 있으며, 마치 직접 휘두르는 것처럼 무기로 공격 행동을 수행할 수 있습니다.

30피트의 비행 속도를 얻으며, 공격 행동과 비행 행동만 취할 수 있다. 이 행동들은 반응을 유발하지 않는다. AC는 18 + 레벨이며, 점유 중인 무기의 경도와 HP를 갖습니다. 대부분의 한손 베기 무기는 경도 5, HP 20입니다. 무장 해제당할 수 없으며, 영혼 피해(무기의 경도와 HP를 우회하여 직접 피해를 주는)를 제외하고는 본체가 직접 손상되지 않습니다.

HP가 0이 되거나 점유 중인 무기가 파손/파괴되면 즉시 무기에서 쫓겨나며 @link[conditions.paralyzed]1라운드 동안 {마비} 상태가 됩니다. 그렇지 않은 경우 효과는 10분 동안 지속되거나 당신이 해제할 때까지 유지됩니다.

name: Divert Streamflow

description.value:
Trigger You're damaged by a melee Strike by a creature in your reach.

With a brief gesture, you adapt swiftly to an attack like a flowing stream. Attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition} the creature who dealt the triggering damage. If you're successful, you can Step as a free action.

_desc_en:
Trigger You're damaged by a melee Strike by a creature in your reach.

With a brief gesture, you adapt swiftly to an attack like a flowing stream. Attempt an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition} the creature who dealt the triggering damage. If you're successful, you can Step as a free action.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신의 도달 범위 내 생물의 근접 공격으로 피해를 입습니다.

짧은 동작으로 흐르는 물줄기처럼 공격에 재빨리 적응합니다. 운동 판정을 시도하여 @link[actions.reposition] 유발 피해를 입힌 생물의 위치를 바꿉니다. 성공하면 자유 행동으로 이동할 수 있습니다.

짧은 동작으로 흐르는 물줄기처럼 공격에 재빨리 적응합니다. 운동 판정을 시도하여 @link[actions.reposition] 유발

name: Eternal Composition

description.value: The world is a stage upon which you are always playing. You are permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}; you can use your extra action only to cast a composition cantrip that requires 1 action to cast. While in exploration mode, you can declare that you are performing an eligible composition cantrip while using any exploration tactic. Even before your first turn in a combat encounter, that cantrip is active as if you had cast it on your previous turn.

_desc_en: The world is a stage upon which you are always playing. You are permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}; you can use your extra action only to cast a composition cantrip that requires 1 action to cast. While in exploration mode, you can declare that you are performing an eligible composition cantrip while using any exploration tactic. Even before your first turn in a combat encounter, that cantrip is active as if you had cast it on your previous turn.
_desc_ko: 세상은 당신이 항상 연기하는 무대다. 당신은 영구적으로 @link[conditions.quickened]; 추가 행동은 1 행동이 필요한 작곡 캔트립 시전에만 사용할 수 있다. 탐색 모드 중일 때, 어떤 탐색 전술을 사용하면서 해당 캔트립을 수행한다고 선언할 수 있다. 전투 교전에서 첫 턴이 시작되기 전이라도, 그 캔트립은 마치 이전 턴에 시전한 것처럼 활성화된다.

name: Beastbrood

description.value: One of your ancestors was a rakshasa, the corrupt and aristocratic reincarnated souls that call Golarion home. You have some dim echo of your ancestor's memories—enough to play the role of noble as needed, no matter your origins. You're trained in Society. If you're already trained in Society (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.JtjnFsOToBLnSRO9]{Courtly Graces} skill feat.

_desc_en: One of your ancestors was a rakshasa, the corrupt and aristocratic reincarnated souls that call Golarion home. You have some dim echo of your ancestor's memories—enough to play the role of noble as needed, no matter your origins. You're trained in Society. If you're already trained in Society (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.JtjnFsOToBLnSRO9]{Courtly Graces} skill feat.
_desc_ko:
당신의 조상 중 한 명은 골라리온을 고향으로 삼은 타락하고 귀족적인 환생 영혼인 라크샤사였습니다. 당신은 조상의 기억이 희미하게 남아 있어, 출신과 상관없이 필요할 때 귀족 역할을 할 수 있습니다. 당신은 사회에 숙련되어 있습니다. 만약 이미 사회에 숙련되어 있다면(배경이나 직업 등으로 인해), 대신 선택한 기술에 숙련됩니다. 또한 @link[feats.courtly-graces] 클래스 피트를 얻습니다.

참고: 이 피트로 제공되는 기술에 이미 숙련된 경우, 수동으로 대체 기술을 선택해야 합니다.

name: Controlled Blast

description.value: You maximize the effectiveness of your explosives by controlling every possible parameter of the blast meticulously. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ozvYhY4hG1deXly8]{Directional Bombs} feats, you can use it with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.vvYsE7OiSSCXhPdr]{Set Explosives} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KCwXj3y7Nm4e3NbI]{Demolition Charge}, even though you didn't throw the bombs. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.8QAFgy9U8PxEa7Dw]{Bomber's Field Discovery} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.gyVcJfZTmBytLsXq]{Expanded Splash} feats, you can apply the additional splash damage to one of the bombs when you Set Explosives or use Demolition Charge, and you can apply the increased splash area from Expanded Splash to all the bombs.

value.value: Bomber's field discovery, Directional Bombs, or Expanded Splash

_desc_en: You maximize the effectiveness of your explosives by controlling every possible parameter of the blast meticulously. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ozvYhY4hG1deXly8]{Directional Bombs} feats, you can use it with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.vvYsE7OiSSCXhPdr]{Set Explosives} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KCwXj3y7Nm4e3NbI]{Demolition Charge}, even though you didn't throw the bombs. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.8QAFgy9U8PxEa7Dw]{Bomber's Field Discovery} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.gyVcJfZTmBytLsXq]{Expanded Splash} feats, you can apply the additional splash damage to one of the bombs when you Set Explosives or use Demolition Charge, and you can apply the increased splash area from Expanded Splash to all the bombs.
_desc_ko: 폭발물의 모든 가능한 매개변수를 꼼꼼히 통제함으로써 폭발 효과를 극대화합니다. @link[feats.directional-bombs] 피트를 보유한 경우, 폭탄을 직접 투척하지 않았더라도 @link[actions.set-explosives] 또는 @link[feats.demolition-charge]와 함께 사용할 수 있습니다. @link[feats.calculated-splash] 또는 @link[feats.expanded-splash] 피트를 보유한 경우, 폭발물 설치나 폭파 장전 시 추가 방사 피해를 한 개의 폭탄에 적용할 수 있으며, 확대된 파편 효과로 증가된 파편 범위는 모든 폭탄에 적용할 수 있습니다.

name: First World Magic

description.value: Your connection to the First World grants you a primal innate spell, much like those of the fey. Choose one cantrip from the primal spell list. You can cast this spell as a primal innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

_desc_en: Your connection to the First World grants you a primal innate spell, much like those of the fey. Choose one cantrip from the primal spell list. You can cast this spell as a primal innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 제1세계와의 연결로 인해 페이와 유사한 프라이멀 선천 마법을 얻습니다. 프라이멀 마법 목록에서 한 가지 캔트립을 선택하세요. 이 마법은 프라이멀 선천 마법으로 마음대로 시전할 수 있습니다. 선택한 캔트립은 레벨의 절반(올림)에 해당하는 마법 랭크으로 강화됩니다.

name: Refined Motion in Darkness

description.value: The ability to move elegantly and undetected through darkness aided your people as they fled the Netherworld. You can move 5 feet farther when you take the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} action, up to your Speed. In addition, as long as you continue to use Sneak actions and succeed at your Stealth check, you don't become observed if you end a Sneak action in dim light or darkness, as long as you have cover or greater cover or are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} at the end of your turn.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: The ability to move elegantly and undetected through darkness aided your people as they fled the Netherworld. You can move 5 feet farther when you take the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} action, up to your Speed. In addition, as long as you continue to use Sneak actions and succeed at your Stealth check, you don't become observed if you end a Sneak action in dim light or darkness, as long as you have cover or greater cover or are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} at the end of your turn.
_desc_ko: 어둠 속을 우아하고 은밀하게 이동하는 능력은 네 종족이 저승에서 탈출할 때 도움이 되었다. @link[actions.sneak] 행동을 취할 때, 네 이동 속도 범위 내에서 5피트 더 멀리 이동할 수 있다. 또한, 은밀 이동 행동을 계속 사용하고 은신 판정에서 성공하는 한, 희미한 빛이나 어둠 속에서 은밀 이동 행동을 종료할 때도, 커버나 완전 엄폐를 가지고 있거나 턴 종료 시 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태라면 관찰되지 않습니다.

name: Distracting Bites

description.value: You know how to take advantage of those your swarm has attacked. A creature who has taken damage from your swarm's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.k6ML9SPMxaGJyjqO]{Bite and Sting} is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the first Strike you make against it in the same turn.

_desc_en: You know how to take advantage of those your swarm has attacked. A creature who has taken damage from your swarm's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.k6ML9SPMxaGJyjqO]{Bite and Sting} is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the first Strike you make against it in the same turn.
_desc_ko: 당신은 무리가 공격한 상대를 이용하는 법을 알고 있습니다. 당신의 무리가 @link[actions.bite-and-sting]로 피해를 입힌 생물은 같은 턴에 당신이 가하는 첫 번째 공격에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Muckraking

description.value:
It seems like your knowledge has come in handy after all and you have your enemy at your feet. Pulling out your fan mail, you read your fans' scathing remarks about your enemy to their face, letting them feel just how much everyone hates them and everything that they've done. They hate the way that they walk, they hate the way that they talk.

Your enemy takes @Damage[10d10[mental]] damage, with a @Check[will|against:class-spell|basic] save. On a critical failure, they're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the beginning of your next turn and lose all reactions, except to cry, loudly.

publication.title: Paizo Blog: Foolish Housekeeping and Other Articles

_desc_en:
It seems like your knowledge has come in handy after all and you have your enemy at your feet. Pulling out your fan mail, you read your fans' scathing remarks about your enemy to their face, letting them feel just how much everyone hates them and everything that they've done. They hate the way that they walk, they hate the way that they talk.

Your enemy takes @Damage[10d10[mental]] damage, with a @Check[will|against:class-spell|basic] save. On a critical failure, they're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the beginning of your next turn and lose all reactions, except to cry, loudly.
_desc_ko:
결국 당신의 지식이 도움이 된 모양입니다. 적을 발 아래에 두고 있군요. 팬 메일을 꺼내 적의 얼굴에 대고 팬들이 적에 대해 쓴 신랄한 비난을 읽어주며, 모두가 그들과 그들이 한 모든 일을 얼마나 증오하는지 느끼게 한다. 그들은 적의 걸음걸이도, 말투도 싫어한다.

적은 10d10 정신 피해를 입으며, 기본 기본 의지 내성을 시도합니다. 대실패 시, 다음 차례 시작까지 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 되며, 큰 소리로 울부짖는 것 외에는 모든 반응 능력을 상실합니다.

name: Elemental Wrath

description.value: You are so attuned to the land that you can call forth a bolt of energy from your surroundings. When you gain this feat, select acid, cold, electricity, or fire. You can call to the land to cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gISYsBFby1TiXfBt]{Acid Splash} cantrip as an innate primal spell at will, except the spell has only verbal components and deals the type of damage you chose instead of acid damage; the spell gains the trait appropriate to its damage instead of the acid trait. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

_desc_en: You are so attuned to the land that you can call forth a bolt of energy from your surroundings. When you gain this feat, select acid, cold, electricity, or fire. You can call to the land to cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gISYsBFby1TiXfBt]{Acid Splash} cantrip as an innate primal spell at will, except the spell has only verbal components and deals the type of damage you chose instead of acid damage; the spell gains the trait appropriate to its damage instead of the acid trait. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
_desc_ko: 당신은 땅과 깊이 조화를 이루어 주변 환경에서 에너지 광선을 불러낼 수 있습니다. 이 피트를 획득할 때 산성, 냉기, 전기, 화염 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 대지를 호출하여 @link[spells.acid-splash] 캔트립을 선천적 프라이멀 마법으로 자유롭게 시전할 수 있습니다. 단, 이 마법은 언어적 구성 요소만 존재하며 산성 피해 대신 선택한 피해 유형을 입힙니다. 또한 산성 특성 대신 해당 피해 유형에 맞는 특성을 획득합니다. 캔트립은 레벨의 절반(올림)에 해당하는 마법 랭크으로 강화됩니다.

name: Thaumaturgic Ritualist

description.value:
Your studies into the supernatural have resulted in an especially strong knowledge of rituals. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to all primary checks to perform a ritual. You learn two uncommon rituals with a rank no higher than half your level; you must meet all prerequisites for casting the ritual to choose it. You can cast these as the primary caster, but you can't teach them to anyone else or allow someone else to serve as primary caster unless they know the ritual as well.

At 8th level and every 4 levels thereafter, you learn another uncommon ritual with a rank no higher than half your level and for which you meet the prerequisites.

_desc_en:
Your studies into the supernatural have resulted in an especially strong knowledge of rituals. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to all primary checks to perform a ritual. You learn two uncommon rituals with a rank no higher than half your level; you must meet all prerequisites for casting the ritual to choose it. You can cast these as the primary caster, but you can't teach them to anyone else or allow someone else to serve as primary caster unless they know the ritual as well.

At 8th level and every 4 levels thereafter, you learn another uncommon ritual with a rank no higher than half your level and for which you meet the prerequisites.
_desc_ko:
초자연적 현상에 대한 연구로 인해 의식에 대한 지식이 특히 뛰어나다. 의식을 수행하는 모든 주요 판정에서 +2 상황 보너스를 얻는다. 당신은 자신의 레벨 절반 이하 랭크의 흔하지 않은 의식 두 가지를 배웁니다. 의식을 선택하려면 해당 의식을 시전하기 위한 모든 전제 조건을 충족해야 합니다. 당신은 이 의식들을 주 시전자로 시전할 수 있지만, 다른 사람에게 가르치거나 다른 사람이 주 시전자가 되도록 허용할 수 없습니다. 단, 그 사람이 해당 의식을 알고 있는 경우는 예외입니다.

8레벨과 이후 4레벨마다, 자신의 레벨 절반 이하 랭크이며 전제 조건을 충족하는 또 다른 흔하지 않은 의식을 배운다.

name: Fire Lung

description.value:
A lifetime of proximity to flames has inured your lungs and eyes to smoke. You can breathe normally in areas of ash and smoke without risk of suffocation, and you ignore the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition from smoke.

You need only a successful DC 10 flat check to recover from persistent fire damage, rather than DC 15 (and the DC when receiving particularly effective assistance is @Check[flat|dc:5] instead of 10).

_desc_en:
A lifetime of proximity to flames has inured your lungs and eyes to smoke. You can breathe normally in areas of ash and smoke without risk of suffocation, and you ignore the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition from smoke.

You need only a successful DC 10 flat check to recover from persistent fire damage, rather than DC 15 (and the DC when receiving particularly effective assistance is @Check[flat|dc:5] instead of 10).
_desc_ko:
평생 불꽃에 노출되어 연기에 대한 폐와 눈이 강해졌습니다. 재와 연기가 자욱한 지역에서도 질식 위험 없이 정상적으로 호흡할 수 있으며, 연기로 인한 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태를 무시합니다.

지속적인 화상 피해에서 회복하려면 DC 15 대신 DC 10 단순 판정만 성공하면 됩니다(특히 효과적인 도움을 받을 때의 DC는 10 대신 DC 5 단순입니다).

name: Pistolero's Challenge

description.value:
With a stern call, carefully chosen barb, or some other challenging declaration, you demand your foe's attention in a duel. Choose an opponent within 30 feet who you can perceive and can hear you, and make your choice of a @Check[deception|defense:will] or @Check[intimidation|defense:will] check against the target's Will DC. No matter the result of the check, the foe is temporarily immune to your Pistolero's Challenge until noon the next day.

Success Both you and the opponent gain a +2 status bonus to damage rolls with Strikes made against each other. If you're a master in the skill you used for the check, the status bonus to damage rolls increases to +3, and if you're legendary, it increases to +4.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.0kO3M46aK64a8ru8]{Effect: Pistolero's Challenge}

You can have only one challenge in effect at a time; challenging a new opponent ends this effect on any current target. Otherwise, the effect lasts until one of you is defeated, flees, or the encounter ends.

Critical Failure You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} and can't use this ability again for 1 minute.

_desc_ko:
엄숙한 외침, 신중히 선택한 모욕, 또는 다른 도전적인 선언으로 결투에서 적의 주의를 요구합니다. 30피트 이내에서 당신이 인지할 수 있고 당신의 목소리를 들을 수 있는 상대를 선택하고, 대상의 의지 DC에 대해 기만 또는 위협 판정 중 하나를 선택하여 수행합니다. 판정 결과와 상관없이, 상대는 다음 날 정오까지 당신의 피스톨레로의 도전에 일시적으로 면역됩니다.

성공 당신과 상대방은 서로에게 가하는 공격의 피해 굴림에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 당신이 검사한 기술의 달인라면 피해 굴림 상태 보너스가 +3으로 증가하며, 전설적인 달인라면 +4로 증가합니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.0kO3M46aK64a8ru8]{효과: 피스톨레로의 도전}

도전 효과는 한 번에 하나만 유효합니다. 새로운 상대에게 도전하면 현재 대상에 대한 이 효과는 종료됩니다. 그렇지 않으면, 이 효과는 상대 중 한 명이 패배하거나 도주하거나 전투가 종료될 때까지 지속됩니다.

대실패 당신은 @link[conditions.frightened]{1} 상태가 되어 1분 동안 이 능력을 다시 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Magical Knowledge

description.value: Increase your proficiency rank in one of Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion from expert to master and in another from trained to expert. You gain a skill feat associated with each of the skills you chose.

value.value: trained in at least one of Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion and expert in at least one other

_desc_en: Increase your proficiency rank in one of Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion from expert to master and in another from trained to expert. You gain a skill feat associated with each of the skills you chose.
_desc_ko: 아르카나, 자연, 오컬트, 종교 중 하나의 숙련도 등급을 전문가에서 달인로, 다른 하나의 숙련도 등급을 훈련된 자에서 전문가로 상승시킵니다. 선택한 기술과 관련된 기술 피트를 획득합니다.

name: Takedown Expert

description.value: You've mastered combat practices that let you get up close and bring down perpetrators alive. You can use your Intelligence modifier on attack rolls for an attack stratagem if you're using a weapon of the club group in one hand (like a club or staff), in addition to the usual weapons, and those Strikes qualify for your strategic strike. Additionally, you can make any of your Strikes nonlethal without taking the normal –2 penalty.

_desc_en: You've mastered combat practices that let you get up close and bring down perpetrators alive. You can use your Intelligence modifier on attack rolls for an attack stratagem if you're using a weapon of the club group in one hand (like a club or staff), in addition to the usual weapons, and those Strikes qualify for your strategic strike. Additionally, you can make any of your Strikes nonlethal without taking the normal –2 penalty.
_desc_ko: 당신은 근접 전투 기술을 마스터하여 생포 상태로 범인을 제압할 수 있습니다. 일반 무기 외에도 한 손으로 클럽 계열 무기(클럽이나 장봉 등)를 사용할 경우, 공격 전술의 명중 굴림에 지능 수정자를 적용할 수 있으며 해당 타격은 전략적 타격으로 인정됩니다. 또한 모든 타격을 비살상하게 할 때 일반적인 -2 페널티를 받지 않습니다.

name: Strength of Eight Legions

description.value: You meditate for 24 hours in a one-time ceremony within a forest or cave; after your seclusion, your frame and limbs swell with warlike might to enact your vows. You permanently gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge}, and your maximum Hit Points increase by your level. The ceremony transforms most of your gear to the appropriate size for your new body (though powerful items like artifacts or items strongly tied to their original size can't transform, at the GM's discretion).

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

name: Ember's Eyes

description.value:
Your eyes blaze with inner flame. You gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision.

Special If your ancestry has neither low-light vision nor darkvision, you can take this ancestry feat a second time to gain darkvision. You can't retrain out of this feat.

_desc_en:
Your eyes blaze with inner flame. You gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision.

Special If your ancestry has neither low-light vision nor darkvision, you can take this ancestry feat a second time to gain darkvision. You can't retrain out of this feat.
_desc_ko:
당신의 눈이 내면의 불꽃으로 타오릅니다. 저조도 시야를 얻거나, 조상이 이미 저조도 시야를 가진 경우 암흑 시야를 얻습니다.

특수 당신의 혈통이 저조도 시야나 암흑 시야를 모두 가지지 않은 경우, 이 혈통 재주를 두 번째로 선택하여 암흑 시야를 얻을 수 있습니다. 이 재주는 재훈련으로 제거할 수 없습니다.

name: Rapid Spark

description.value:
Trigger Your turn begins.

Frequency once per day

Your spark shifts to where it needs to be. You Shift Immanence.

_desc_ko:

발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신의 불꽃이 필요한 곳으로 이동합니다. 당신은 '시프트 임마넌스'를 발동합니다.

name: Intense Implement

description.value: You have an exceptional link to your third implement. You gain the adept benefit for your third implement.

_desc_en: You have an exceptional link to your third implement. You gain the adept benefit for your third implement.
_desc_ko: 당신은 세 번째 무기와의 특별한 유대감을 지닙니다. 세 번째 무기에 숙련자 혜택을 얻습니다.

name: Illuminating Stories

description.value:
Stories serve as beacons in the night, illuminating valuable knowledge even if the tale itself misses the mark. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7wQe43fSCG9DSWdj]{Offer a Story} about any topic, you can choose that illumination in place of the normal benefits of Offer Story. You receive a +1 status bonus on checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} for the duration and can Recall Knowledge about the topic of the story as a free action. The creature you share a story with can choose this benefit even if you did not.

The bonus increases to +2 if you are a master of Religion and +3 if you are legendary.

이야기는 밤의 등대 역할을 하여, 이야기 자체가 빗나가더라도 소중한 지식을 밝혀낸다. 어떤 주제에 대해 @link[actions.offer-story]할 때, 이야기 제공의 일반적인 혜택 대신 그 빛을 선택할 수 있다. 지속 시간 동안 @link[actions.recall-knowledge] 판정 시 +1 상태 보너스를 받으며, 무료 행동으로 이야기 주제와 관련된 지식을 회상할 수 있습니다. 이야기를 공유한 상대는 당신이 선택하지 않았더라도 이 혜택을 선택할 수 있습니다.

종교 달인인 경우 보너스가 +2로, 전설적인 경우 +3으로 증가합니다.

name: Kindle Inner Flames

description.value:
As a candle can light another, you awaken the latent potential to channel fire in other creatures. You shed faint, glowing embers, as do your allies while they're in your kinetic aura. Anyone shedding these embers gains a +1 status bonus to Reflex saves and Acrobatics checks and can Step as a free action once per round. When an affected creature takes a move action, its Strikes deal an extra @Damage[2[fire]] damage until the end of its turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.hrEG2smy3tZyGxIn]{Stance: Kindle Inner Flames}

Level (12th) The status bonus to Reflex saves and Acrobatics checks is +2, and the Strikes gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.XszNvxnymWYRaoTp]{Flaming} rune instead of the extra 2 fire damage.

_desc_ko:
초가 다른 초를 밝히듯, 당신은 다른 생명체 안에 잠든 불의 잠재력을 깨웁니다. 당신은 희미하게 빛나는 불씨를 발산하며, 당신의 키네틱 오라 안에 있는 아군들도 마찬가지입니다. 이 불씨를 발산하는 모든 대상은 반사 내성과 곡예 판정에서 +1 상태 보너스를 얻으며, 라운드당 한 번 무료 행동으로 '{신중한 발걸음}'을 사용할 수 있다. 영향을 받은 생물이 이동 행동을 취할 경우, 그 생물의 공격은 자신의 턴이 끝날 때까지 추가 2 화염의 피해를 입힌다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.hrEG2smy3tZyGxIn]{자세: 내면의 불꽃을 피우다}

레벨 (12레벨) 반사 내성과 곡예 판정 상태 보너스는 +2이며, 공격은 추가 화염 피해 2 대신 @link[equipment.flaming] 룬을 부여받습니다.

name: Trick Shot

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a loaded crossbow or firearm.

You shoot not at your foe but at an object nearby. Make a Strike with your firearm against an AC equal to an easy DC for your level. On a success, instead of hitting your foe, your attack hits an object behind or to the side of your target, creating one of the following effects. The GM might determine that a different AC is appropriate or that a particular effect isn't a valid option, such as using the explosive barrel option when there's no such object on the battlefield. The GM should inform you if a Trick Shot is feasible before you spend your actions, since your trained eye can easily recognize loose or volatile objects.

  • Dislodge Object Your attack knocks an unattended object of no more than 2 Bulk out of position, moving it up to 10 feet in a direction of your choice. For example, the weapon could knock a wizard's crystal ball off a table.

  • Explosive Barrel Your attack strikes a barrel of expensive rum, a vial of volatile alchemical fluids, a demonic pustule erupting from the earth, or some other explosive object. The object explodes in a @Template[type:burst|distance:20], and creatures in the area take @Damage[(6 + floor((@actor.level - 10) / 2))d6|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:gunslinger|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. The damage type is chosen by the GM, based on the exploding object. Increase the damage by 1d6 for every 2 levels you have above 10th.

_desc_ko:
요구 사항 장전된 석궁이나 화기를 들고 있어야 합니다.

적 대신 근처의 물체를 쏜다. 당신의 레벨에 해당하는 쉬운 난이도 DC에 해당하는 AC를 상대로 화기로 공격하십시오. 성공 시, 적을 명중시키는 대신 목표물 뒤나 옆에 있는 물체를 명중시켜 다음 효과 중 하나를 발생시킵니다. GM은 다른 AC가 적절하다고 판단하거나 특정 효과가 유효하지 않다고 결정할 수 있습니다(예: 전장에 폭발성 통이 없을 때 폭발성 통 옵션을 사용하는 경우). 트릭 샷이 가능한지 여부는 행동을 사용하기 전에 GM이 알려주어야 합니다. 숙련된 눈으로 느슨하거나 불안정한 물체를 쉽게 식별할 수 있기 때문입니다.

  • 물체 밀어내기 공격으로 벌크 2 이하의 방치된 물체를 제자리에서 밀어내어 최대 10피트까지 원하는 방향으로 이동시킬 수 있습니다. 예를 들어, 위자드의 수정구를 탁자에서 떨어뜨릴 수 있습니다.

  • 폭발성 통 당신의 공격이 값비싼 럼주 통, 휘발성 연금술 액체가 든 유리병, 땅에서 솟아오른 데몬의 종기, 또는 다른 폭발성 물체를 강타합니다. 물체가 20피트 폭발 범위 내에서 폭발하며, 해당 영역 내 생물들은 피해를 입습니다. 피해 유형은 폭발한 물체에 따라 GM이 결정합니다. (10th)를 초과한 레벨당 2레벨마다 피해량을 1d6씩 증가시킵니다.

name: Robust Health

description.value: Your physiology responds well to first aid. You gain a circumstance bonus to the number of Hit Points you regain equal to your level from a successful attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat your Wounds} or use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.wYerMk6F1RZb0Fwt]{Battle Medicine} on you. After you or an ally use Battle Medicine on you, you become temporarily immune to that Battle Medicine for only 1 hour, instead of 1 day.

_desc_en: Your physiology responds well to first aid. You gain a circumstance bonus to the number of Hit Points you regain equal to your level from a successful attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat your Wounds} or use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.wYerMk6F1RZb0Fwt]{Battle Medicine} on you. After you or an ally use Battle Medicine on you, you become temporarily immune to that Battle Medicine for only 1 hour, instead of 1 day.
_desc_ko: 당신의 생리적 구조는 응급처치에 잘 반응합니다. @link[actions.treat-wounds]에 성공하거나 @link[feats.battle-medicine]을 사용해 회복하는 HP에 레벨만큼의 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 당신이나 아군이 당신에게 전투 의학을 사용한 후, 해당 전투 의학에 대해 일시적으로 면역 상태가 됩니다. 이 효과는 1일 동안 지속되는 대신 1시간 동안만 지속됩니다.

name: Whodunnit?

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You carefully consider your case and narrow down some of the details. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xTK2zsWFyxSJvYbX]{Pursue a Lead} and learn there's a larger mystery, you can ask two questions related to your investigation when you open it. The GM must answer truthfully with "yes" or "no," though if the answer would be misleading or have no practical application to your investigation, the GM can answer "immaterial." You can't use Whodunnit? more than once for the same lead, even across different days. Your questions must come from the following list, applying to the detail that spurred your investigation.

  • Was this clue left by a [creature trait]? (Choose a creature trait such as humanoid, undead, or dwarf; this trait must be accurate as of the time the clue was left.)
  • Was this clue left within the last hour?
  • Was this clue left within the last day?
  • Was the creature that left this clue in a heightened emotional state when it left the clue?
  • Did anyone attempt to conceal this clue?

The GM must answer truthfully with "yes" or "no," though if the answer would be misleading or have no practical application to your investigation, the GM can answer "immaterial." You can't use Whodunnit? more than once for the same lead, even across different days. Your questions must come from the following list, applying to the detail that spurred your investigation.

  • Was this clue left by a [creature trait]? (Choose a creature trait such as humanoid, undead, or dwarf; this trait must be accurate as of the time the clue was left.)
  • Was this clue left within the last hour?
  • Was this clue left within the last day?
  • Was the creature that left this clue in a heightened emotional state when it left the clue?
  • Did anyone attempt to conceal this clue?
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

당신은 사건을 신중히 검토하며 세부 사항을 좁혀 나갑니다. @link[actions.pursue-a-lead]하여 더 큰 미스터리가 있음을 알게 되면, 사건을 열 때 조사와 관련된 두 가지 질문을 할 수 있습니다. GM은 "예" 또는 "아니오"로 진실되게 답변해야 하지만, 답변이 오해를 불러일으키거나 조사에 실질적 적용이 없다면 "관련 없음"이라고 답할 수 있습니다. 동일한 단서에 대해 '범인은 누구인가?'를 여러 번 사용할 수 없습니다. 다른 날짜에 걸친 경우에도 마찬가지입니다. 질문은 다음 목록에서 선택해야 하며, 수사를 촉발한 세부 사항에 적용되어야 합니다.

  • 이 단서는 [생물 특성]에 의해 남겨졌는가? (인간형, 언데드, 드워프 등 생물 특성을 선택하십시오. 이 특성은 단서가 남겨진 시점의 정확한 상태여야 합니다.)
  • 이 단서는 지난 1시간 이내에 남겨졌는가?
  • 이 단서는 지난 24시간 이내에 남겨졌는가?
  • 이 단서를 남긴 생물이 단서를 남길 당시 감정 상태가 강화되어 있었는가?
  • 누군가 이 단서를 숨기려 시도했는가?

name: Crashing Slam

description.value:
You can dash your foe to the ground with a single blow. If the Strike you make with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.39CqlOzlHjEhh0E4]{Slam Down} hits, you can automatically get a critical success on your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} instead of rolling a check. (Both the Strike and Trip still count toward your multiple attack penalty).

If you used a two-handed melee weapon for the Strike, you can use the weapon's damage die size instead of the regular die size for the damage from a critical Trip.

_desc_en:
You can dash your foe to the ground with a single blow. If the Strike you make with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.39CqlOzlHjEhh0E4]{Slam Down} hits, you can automatically get a critical success on your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} instead of rolling a check. (Both the Strike and Trip still count toward your multiple attack penalty).

If you used a two-handed melee weapon for the Strike, you can use the weapon's damage die size instead of the regular die size for the damage from a critical Trip.
_desc_ko: 단일 타격으로 적을 땅에 내리꽂을 수 있습니다. 슬램 다운 사용 시, 타격 후 @link[actions.trip]를 시도하는 대신 단일 타격만 시도하다. 그렇게 하고 공격이 적중하면, 넘어뜨리기 시도를 시도하는 대신 자동으로 넘어뜨리기의 대성공 효과를 적용한다. 공격에 양손 근접 무기를 사용했다면, 대성공 넘어뜨리기로 인한 피해에 일반 주사위 크기 대신 무기의 피해 주사위 크기를 사용할 수 있다.

name: Celestial Form

description.value: You take on a celestial countenance, gaining the features of a type of celestial who serves your deity; for example, as an angel, you gain a halo and feathery wings. You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed. You gain darkvision if you don't already have it, and you gain the celestial trait and the trait appropriate to the type of servitor you've become (archon, angel, or azata, for example).

_desc_en: You take on a celestial countenance, gaining the features of a type of celestial who serves your deity; for example, as an angel, you gain a halo and feathery wings. You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed. You gain darkvision if you don't already have it, and you gain the celestial trait and the trait appropriate to the type of servitor you've become (archon, angel, or azata, for example).
_desc_ko: 천상체의 용모를 취하며, 당신의 신을 섬기는 천상체의 유형에 해당하는 특징을 얻습니다. 예를 들어 천사라면 후광과 깃털 날개를 얻습니다. 당신의 이동 속도와 동일한 비행 속도를 얻습니다. 아직 암흑 시야를 가지지 않았다면 이를 얻으며, 천상체 특성 및 당신이 된 천상의 종복 유형(예: 아콘, 천사, 아자타)에 해당하는 특성을 얻습니다.

name: Advanced Reanimated Companion

description.value: Your corpselike construct companion becomes much more powerful and can act with limited autonomy to follow your greater directives. It becomes an advanced construct companion. During an encounter, even if you don't use the Command a Minion action, your construct companion can still use 1 action on your turn that round to Stride or Strike.

_desc_en: Your corpselike construct companion becomes much more powerful and can act with limited autonomy to follow your greater directives. It becomes an advanced construct companion. During an encounter, even if you don't use the Command a Minion action, your construct companion can still use 1 action on your turn that round to Stride or Strike.
_desc_ko: 시체 같은 구조물 동료가 훨씬 강력해지며, 제한된 자율성으로 당신의 주요 지시를 따를 수 있습니다. 이 동료는 고급 구조물 동료가 됩니다. 전투 중, 당신이 '하수인 명령' 행동을 사용하지 않더라도, 구조물 동료는 해당 턴에 당신의 차례에 1개의 행동을 사용하여 '이동' 또는 '공격'을 할 수 있습니다.

name: Energetic Resonance

description.value:
Trigger You would take acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage from a spell.

Requirements You have an unexpended spell slot of a rank equal to or higher than the triggering spell.

Your blood resonates with magical energy, mitigating the effects of harmful spells.

Expend one of your spell slots of a rank equal to or higher than that of the triggering spell. You gain resistance to one of the triggering effect's damage types equal to twice the expended spell slot's rank.

_desc_en:
Trigger You would take acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage from a spell.

Requirements You have an unexpended spell slot of a rank equal to or higher than the triggering spell.

Your blood resonates with magical energy, mitigating the effects of harmful spells.

Expend one of your spell slots of a rank equal to or higher than that of the triggering spell. You gain resistance to one of the triggering effect's damage types equal to twice the expended spell slot's rank.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신이 주문으로부터 산성, 냉기, 전기, 화염 또는 음파 피해를 입을 때.

요구 사항 발동 마법과 동급 이상의 사용하지 않은 마법 슬롯을 보유해야 합니다.

혈액이 마법 에너지와 공명하여 유해 마법의 효과를 완화합니다.

발동 마법과 동급 이상의 마법 슬롯 하나를 소모합니다. 소모한 마법 슬롯 랭크의 두 배에 해당하는 발동 효과의 피해 유형 하나에 대한 저항력을 얻습니다.

name: Read Lips

description.value: You can read lips of others nearby who you can clearly see. The language read must be one that you know. When you're at your leisure, you can do this automatically. In encounter mode or when attempting a more difficult feat of lipreading, you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} during each round in which you focus on lip movements, and you must succeed at a Society check (DC determined by the GM) to successfully read someone's lips.

_desc_en: You can read lips of others nearby who you can clearly see. The language read must be one that you know. When you're at your leisure, you can do this automatically. In encounter mode or when attempting a more difficult feat of lipreading, you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} during each round in which you focus on lip movements, and you must succeed at a Society check (DC determined by the GM) to successfully read someone's lips.
_desc_ko: 주변에서 선명히 보이는 타인의 입술을 읽을 수 있다. 읽는 언어는 반드시 자신이 아는 언어여야 한다. 여유가 있을 때는 자동으로 수행할 수 있다. 교전 상태이거나 더 어려운 입술 읽기를 시도할 때는, 입술 움직임에 포커스를 두는 각 라운드 동안 @link[conditions.fascinated] 상태가 되며 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 됩니다. 또한 누군가의 입술을 성공적으로 읽으려면 사회성 판정(GM이 결정하는 DC)에 성공해야 합니다.

name: Syncretism

description.value: You have come to see the overlap between two deities' teachings. Choose a second deity. You must meet their alignment requirements, and you are subject to their edicts and anathema. If you are a cloistered cleric, select one of that deity's domains, gaining the benefits of the Expanded Domain Initiate feat with that domain. If you are a warpriest, you gain the favored weapon of that deity as a second favored weapon, and it gains the benefits of feats and abilities you have that affect your deity's favored weapon, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.DfLkIIg2reyYW3a8]{Deadly Simplicity}. If you have a different doctrine than cloistered cleric or warpriest, either apply whichever of the above options is most appropriate for your doctrine, or, at the GM's discretion, add a benefit from the second deity more closely tied to your doctrine.

_desc_en: You have come to see the overlap between two deities' teachings. Choose a second deity. You must meet their alignment requirements, and you are subject to their edicts and anathema. If you are a cloistered cleric, select one of that deity's domains, gaining the benefits of the Expanded Domain Initiate feat with that domain. If you are a warpriest, you gain the favored weapon of that deity as a second favored weapon, and it gains the benefits of feats and abilities you have that affect your deity's favored weapon, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.DfLkIIg2reyYW3a8]{Deadly Simplicity}. If you have a different doctrine than cloistered cleric or warpriest, either apply whichever of the above options is most appropriate for your doctrine, or, at the GM's discretion, add a benefit from the second deity more closely tied to your doctrine.
_desc_ko: 두 신의 가르침 사이에 겹치는 부분을 깨달았습니다. 두 번째 신을 선택하십시오. 해당 신의 성향 요건을 충족해야 하며, 그 신의 칙령과 파문 대상이 됩니다. 클레릭인 경우, 해당 신의 도메인 중 하나를 선택하여 확장 도메인 입문자 특성의 혜택을 얻습니다. 전사 성직자인 경우, 해당 신의 선호 무기를 두 번째 선호 무기로 얻으며, 이 무기는 @link[feats.deadly-simplicity]과 같이 선호 무기에 영향을 미치는 피트와 능력의 혜택을 받습니다. 은둔 클레릭이나 전사 클레릭 외의 다른 교리를 가진 경우, 자신의 교리에 가장 적합한 위 옵션 중 하나를 적용하거나, GM의 재량에 따라 자신의 교리와 더 밀접하게 연관된 두 번째 신의 혜택을 추가할 수 있다.

name: Soul Warden Dedication

description.value:
You can take 10 minutes to emblazon @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma's} holy sigil-a spiraling comet that represents the winding path a soul takes through its existence-upon a shield, tabard, banner, or other prominent object that your wear or wield. The symbol doesn't fade until 1 year has passed, but if you emblazon the symbol again, any symbol you previously emblazoned and any symbol already emblazoned on that item instantly disappears. The item becomes a religious symbol of Pharasma and can be used as a divine focus while emblazoned.

Whenever an undead creature or captive soul is within 100 feet of this object, the spiral glows, shedding dim blue light in a 10-foot radius. If the creature is hiding or the soul is hidden, it must succeed at a @Check[stealth|against:perception] check against your Perception DC to fool the sigil and prevent the spiral from glowing.

In addition, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kcelf6IHl3L9VXXg]{Vitality Lash} as a divine innate cantrip at will. As normal, a cantrip is automatically heightened to half your level rounded up. You gain access to the Cast a Spell activity if you didn't have it already. You're trained in divine spell attack rolls and spell DCs. Your key spellcasting ability for these spells is Wisdom.

When you have at least two other feats from this archetype, the spiral glows with bright light in a 10-foot radius (and dim light for the next 10 feet). Feats that require a creature or object to be in the light of your spiral function whether it's in the bright or dim light.

Special You can't select another dedication feat until you have gained two other feats from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.9g14DjBZNj27goTt]{Soul Warden} archetype.

_desc_ko:
10분을 들여 방패, 타바드, 깃발 또는 착용하거나 휘두르는 눈에 띄는 물체에 @link[deities.pharasma] 신성한 문장-영혼이 존재를 통해 걷는 구불구불한 길을 상징하는 나선형 혜성-을 새길 수 있다. 이 상징은 1년이 지나기 전까지 사라지지 않으나, 다시 새길 경우 이전에 새긴 모든 상징과 해당 물품에 이미 새겨진 상징은 즉시 사라집니다. 이 물품은 파라스마의 종교적 상징이 되며, 새겨진 상태에서는 신성 포커스로 사용할 수 있습니다.

언데드 생물이나 포로 영혼이 이 물건으로부터 100피트 이내에 있을 때마다, 나선형 문양이 희미한 푸른 빛을 내며 10피트 반경에 걸쳐 빛을 발합니다. 숨겨진 생물이나 영혼은 당신의 지각 DC에 대한 은신 판정에 성공해야만 문양을 속여 나선형이 빛나는 것을 막을 수 있습니다.

추가로, 당신은 신성 선천적 캔트립으로 @link[spells.vitality-lash]을 마음대로 시전할 수 있습니다. 일반적으로 캔트립은 자동으로 당신의 레벨의 절반(올림)으로 강화됩니다. 아직 시전 활동이 없다면, 이 능력을 획득하게 됩니다. 신성 주문 명중 굴림과 주문 난이도 계산에 숙련됩니다. 이 주문들의 주요 주문 능력치는 지혜입니다.

이 아키타입의 다른 재주 두 개 이상을 보유할 경우, 나선형이 반경 10피트 범위 내에서는 밝은 빛으로, 그 다음 10피트 범위 내에서는 희미한 빛으로 빛납니다. 생물이나 물체가 당신의 나선형 빛 안에 있어야 하는 재주는 밝은 빛이든 희미한 빛이든 관계없이 작동합니다.

특수 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.9g14DjBZNj27goTt]{영혼 수호자} 아키타입의 다른 피트 두 가지를 획득하기 전까지는 다른 헌신 피트를 선택할 수 없습니다.

name: Water to Water

description.value: You allow your body to collapse into water, then reconstitute your corporeal form elsewhere. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Translocate} as an occult innate spell twice per day; the spell additionally gains the water trait. If you Cast this Spell while standing in a body of water of at least ankle depth, you don't need to perform any incantations or gestures to Cast the Spell (typically preventing reactions, such as Reactive Strike), and the spell gains the subtle trait as you simply fall into the water without so much as a splash.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide
