You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Translocate} as an occult innate spell twice per day; the spell additionally gains the water trait. If you Cast this Spell while standing in a body of water of at least ankle depth, you don't need to perform any incantations or gestures to Cast the Spell (typically preventing reactions, such as Reactive Strike), and the spell gains the subtle trait as you simply fall into the water without so much as a splash.
_desc_ko: 당신은 몸을 물속으로 녹아들게 한 후, 다른 곳에서 육체를 재구성합니다. 하루에 두 번 @link[spells.translocate]을 오컬트 선천적 주문으로 시전할 수 있으며, 해당 주문은 물 속성을 추가로 획득합니다. 발목 깊이 이상의 물속에 서서 이 주문을 시전할 경우, 주문 시전에 필요한 주문 발성이나 손동작이 필요하지 않습니다(일반적으로 반응 행동, 예를 들어 반응 타격 등을 방지함). 또한 물속으로 떨어질 때 물보라조차 일으키지 않으므로 주문은 미묘 특성을 얻습니다.

name: Uncanny Cheeks

description.value: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.lHFz4MmebvPqTb0A]{Prescient Consumable} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.bh2jHyyYrkLMsIdX]{Prescient Planner} feats, except that you always withdraw the objects from your cheek pouches. This means the object you retrieve must fit in your cheek pouches; this is generally an item of negligible Bulk unless you also have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Pox93XMBaFmeLIDM]{Cheek Pouches} feat.

_desc_en: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.lHFz4MmebvPqTb0A]{Prescient Consumable} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.bh2jHyyYrkLMsIdX]{Prescient Planner} feats, except that you always withdraw the objects from your cheek pouches. This means the object you retrieve must fit in your cheek pouches; this is generally an item of negligible Bulk unless you also have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Pox93XMBaFmeLIDM]{Cheek Pouches} feat.
_desc_ko: 당신은 @link[feats.prescient-consumable]과 @link[feats.prescient-planner] 피트를 얻지만, 물건을 항상 뺨 주머니에서 꺼내야 합니다. 이는 꺼내는 물건이 뺨 주머니에 들어갈 수 있어야 함을 의미합니다. 일반적으로 @link[feats.cheek-pouches] 피트를 보유하지 않는 한 벌크가 무시할 만한 아이템입니다.

name: United Assault

description.value: Through countless battles, you've learned you're stronger when working alongside your allies. Make a Strike. Your Strike gains a circumstance bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of other different creatures that damaged the target since the end of the target's last turn, to a maximum of a +4 circumstance bonus.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Knights of Lastwall

_desc_en: Through countless battles, you've learned you're stronger when working alongside your allies. Make a Strike. Your Strike gains a circumstance bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of other different creatures that damaged the target since the end of the target's last turn, to a maximum of a +4 circumstance bonus.
_desc_ko: 수많은 전투를 통해 당신은 아군과 함께할 때 더 강해진다는 것을 깨달았습니다. 공격을 수행하세요. 당신의 공격은 대상의 마지막 턴 종료 이후 다른 종류의 생물들이 대상에게 입힌 피해 횟수만큼 피해 굴림에 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 최대 +4 상황 보너스까지 적용됩니다.

name: Versatile Font

description.value: As you explore your deity's aspects, you move beyond restrictions on healing or harming. You can prepare either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} in the spell slots gained from the harmful font or healing font.

value.value: deity that allows clerics to have both fonts

_desc_en: As you explore your deity's aspects, you move beyond restrictions on healing or harming. You can prepare either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} in the spell slots gained from the harmful font or healing font.
_desc_ko: 당신이 신의 속성을 탐구함에 따라, 치유나 해악에 대한 제약을 넘어섭니다. 당신은 해로운 샘이나 치유의 샘으로부터 얻은 주문 슬롯에 @link[spells.harm] 또는 @link[spells.heal] 중 하나를 준비할 수 있습니다.

name: Clan Protector

description.value:
Your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.kJJvKm80KwWXPukV]{Clan Dagger} can protect your allies as easily as yourself. When you use an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} action to gain a circumstance bonus to AC from your clan dagger's parry trait, you can grant the circumstance bonus to an adjacent ally instead of gaining it yourself. You can use multiple Interact actions to protect multiple allies, or to protect yourself and an ally. The ally benefits from the bonus to AC only when they are adjacent to you.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.fRlvmul3LbLo2xvR]{Effect: Parry}

_desc_en:
Your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.kJJvKm80KwWXPukV]{Clan Dagger} can protect your allies as easily as yourself. When you use an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} action to gain a circumstance bonus to AC from your clan dagger's parry trait, you can grant the circumstance bonus to an adjacent ally instead of gaining it yourself. You can use multiple Interact actions to protect multiple allies, or to protect yourself and an ally. The ally benefits from the bonus to AC only when they are adjacent to you.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.fRlvmul3LbLo2xvR]{Effect: Parry}
_desc_ko:
당신의 @link[equipment.clan-dagger]은 자신을 보호하듯 동료를 보호할 수 있습니다. @link[actions.interact] 행동을 사용하여 클랜 단검의 패리 특성으로 AC에 상황 보너스를 얻는 경우, 자신 대신 인접한 아군에게 그 상황 보너스를 부여할 수 있습니다. 여러 상호작용 행동을 사용하여 여러 아군을 보호하거나, 자신과 아군을 보호할 수 있습니다. 아군은 당신과 인접해 있을 때만 AC에 대한 보너스의 혜택을 받습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.fRlvmul3LbLo2xvR]{Effect: Parry}

name: Skittertalk

description.value: You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with spiders and other arachnids. The GM determines which creatures count for this ability.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Mwangi Expanse

_desc_en: You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with spiders and other arachnids. The GM determines which creatures count for this ability.
_desc_ko: 거미 및 기타 거미류에게 질문을 하고 답변을 받으며, 외교 기술을 사용할 수 있다. 이 능력에 해당하는 생물은 GM이 결정한다.

name: Mental Forge

description.value: Your experiences in combat shape your mind's capability to strengthen and shape your weapon to match the way you move in combat. Choose two of the following weapon traits to give your mind weapon: grapple, modular (B, P, or S), nonlethal, shove, or trip. Once chosen, these weapon traits can't be changed unless you spend 1 week retraining your fighting style to swap one property for another from the list.

_desc_en: Your experiences in combat shape your mind's capability to strengthen and shape your weapon to match the way you move in combat. Choose two of the following weapon traits to give your mind weapon: grapple, modular (B, P, or S), nonlethal, shove, or trip. Once chosen, these weapon traits can't be changed unless you spend 1 week retraining your fighting style to swap one property for another from the list.
_desc_ko: 전투 경험은 당신의 움직임에 맞춰 무기를 강화하고 형성하는 정신적 능력을 다듬습니다. 다음 무기 특성 중 두 가지를 선택하여 정신 무기에 부여하십시오: 그랩, 모듈식, 비살상, 밀치기, 걸어 넘어뜨리기. 선택한 무기 특성은 1주일간 전투 스타일을 재훈련하여 목록에서 다른 속성으로 교체하지 않는 한 변경할 수 없습니다.

name: Warped Reflection

description.value:
Frequency once per minute

Due to your origins, your form is more flexible than most. You shift your appearance to resemble a creature within 30 feet but with an unsettling, horrifying twist. Though this transformation is momentary, witnessing it gives the target deep existential dread. It must succeed at a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure) and be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} as long as the frightened condition lasts. Once you've used Warped Reflection against a creature, it's temporarily immune for 24 hours.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per minute

Due to your origins, your form is more flexible than most. You shift your appearance to resemble a creature within 30 feet but with an unsettling, horrifying twist. Though this transformation is momentary, witnessing it gives the target deep existential dread. It must succeed at a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure) and be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} as long as the frightened condition lasts. Once you've used Warped Reflection against a creature, it's temporarily immune for 24 hours.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 분당 1회

당신의 기원으로 인해, 당신의 형태는 대다수보다 유연합니다. 30피트 내의 생물과 닮은 모습으로 변신하지만, 불안하고 끔찍한 변형이 가미됩니다. 이 변신은 순간적이지만, 이를 목격한 대상은 깊은 실존적 공포를 느낍니다. 대상은 당신의 클래스 DC와 주문 DC 중 높은 쪽에 대한 의지 저항 내성에 성공해야 하며, 실패 시 @link[conditions.frightened]{1} 상태가 됩니다 (@link[conditions.frightened]{2} 상태가 됨) 상태가 되며, 공포 상태가 지속되는 동안 @link[conditions.stupefied]{1} 상태가 된다. 한 생물에게 왜곡된 반사술을 사용한 후에는 해당 생물이 24시간 동안 일시적으로 면역 상태가 된다.

name: Eclectic Polymath

description.value: Your flexible mind can quickly shift from one spell to another. If you add a spell to your repertoire during your daily preparations using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.4HZTLPKPteEFsa7n]{Esoteric Polymath}, when you prepare again, you can choose to keep the new spell from Esoteric Polymath in your repertoire and instead lose access to another spell of the same rank in your repertoire.

_desc_en: Your flexible mind can quickly shift from one spell to another. If you add a spell to your repertoire during your daily preparations using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.4HZTLPKPteEFsa7n]{Esoteric Polymath}, when you prepare again, you can choose to keep the new spell from Esoteric Polymath in your repertoire and instead lose access to another spell of the same rank in your repertoire.
_desc_ko: 유연한 사고로 주문을 신속히 전환할 수 있습니다. @link[feats.esoteric-polymath]을 사용하여 일일 준비 중에 레퍼토리에 주문을 추가한 경우, 다음 준비 시 에소테리카의 다재다능함으로 추가한 새 주문을 레퍼토리에 유지하고 대신 레퍼토리 내 동일 랭크의 다른 주문 하나를 사용할 수 없게 할 수 있습니다.

name: Shared Clarity

description.value:
You can project your premonitions of clarity to your allies. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.2h8a6pKhXTXwpJjP]{Premonition of Clarity}, allies within 15 feet of you who failed the same saving throw against the same mental effect can also spend their reactions to reroll the failed saving throw with a +2 circumstance bonus.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.CUtvkuGSxq1raBIB]{Effect: Shared Clarity}

_desc_en:
You can project your premonitions of clarity to your allies. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.2h8a6pKhXTXwpJjP]{Premonition of Clarity}, allies within 15 feet of you who failed the same saving throw against the same mental effect can also spend their reactions to reroll the failed saving throw with a +2 circumstance bonus.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.CUtvkuGSxq1raBIB]{Effect: Shared Clarity}
_desc_ko:
당신은 선견지명의 명료함을 아군에게 투사할 수 있습니다. @link[feats.premonition-of-clarity]을 사용할 때, 당신으로부터 15피트 이내에 있는 아군 중 동일한 정신 효과에 대한 동일한 내성 굴림에서 실패한 자들도 자신의 반응을 소모하여 +2 상황 보너스를 적용해 실패한 내성 굴림을 재굴림할 수 있습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.CUtvkuGSxq1raBIB]{효과: 공유된 명료함}

name: Dance of the Jester

description.value:
Through your incredible dance skill, you can embody the character of the Jester, able to take control of the shadows of other players on stage (much to your amusement). Attempt a @Check[performance|against:fortitude] check against the Fortitude DC of a single enemy within 30 feet.

Critical Success Your shadow and the opponent's synchronize, forcing your target to match your movements step for step. You perform any two of the following actions: Drop Prone, Release an object, Stand, Step, or Stride. You must perform two different actions. Your opponent also takes these actions, moving in the same direction as you (for instance, if you Stride north, so does your opponent) or Releasing an object when you do. The target is then temporarily immune to your Dance of the Jester for 1 day.

Success As critical success, except you can take only one action, not two, before your target becomes temporarily immune to your dance, and you cannot move the target into hazardous terrain.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Through your incredible dance skill, you can embody the character of the Jester, able to take control of the shadows of other players on stage (much to your amusement). Attempt a @Check[performance|against:fortitude] check against the Fortitude DC of a single enemy within 30 feet.

Critical Success Your shadow and the opponent's synchronize, forcing your target to match your movements step for step. You perform any two of the following actions: Drop Prone, Release an object, Stand, Step, or Stride. You must perform two different actions. Your opponent also takes these actions, moving in the same direction as you (for instance, if you Stride north, so does your opponent) or Releasing an object when you do. The target is then temporarily immune to your Dance of the Jester for 1 day.

Success As critical success, except you can take only one action, not two, before your target becomes temporarily immune to your dance, and you cannot move the target into hazardous terrain.
_desc_ko:
놀라운 춤 실력으로 광대의 모습을 구현하여 무대 위 다른 플레이어들의 그림자를 조종할 수 있습니다(당신은 이를 매우 즐깁니다). 30피트 내의 단일 적에 대해 공연 인내 DC에 대한 판정을 시도하다.

대성공 당신의 그림자와 상대의 그림자가 동기화되어, 대상이 당신의 움직임을 발걸음 하나하나 따라하게 됩니다. 다음 행동 중 두 가지를 수행한다: 엎드린 자세 취하기, 물건 놓기, 일어서기, {신중한 발걸음}, 큰 걸음 내딛기. 반드시 서로 다른 두 가지 행동을 수행해야 한다. 상대방도 동일한 방향으로 이동하거나(예: 네가 북쪽으로 큰 걸음 내딛으면 상대도 동일하게 행동) 네가 물건을 놓을 때 함께 놓는다. 이후 대상은 1일간 네 '광대의 춤'에 일시적으로 면역이 된다.

대성공 대성공 시, 대상이 당신의 춤에 일시적으로 면역되기 전에 두 가지가 아닌 한 가지 행동만 취할 수 있으며, 대상을 위험 지형으로 이동시킬 수 없습니다.

name: Hands That Unweave Disaster

description.value: Your hands move with uncanny sureness, dismantling danger. When you attempt an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge}, you can spend a Mythic Point to attempt the check at mythic proficiency. You can expend a Mythic Point when attempting to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable a Device} to attempt the check at mythic proficiency. As normal when attempting a check with mythic proficiency, this allows you to attempt to Disable a Device even if the check normally requires expert or greater proficiency.

_desc_en: Your hands move with uncanny sureness, dismantling danger. When you attempt an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge}, you can spend a Mythic Point to attempt the check at mythic proficiency. You can expend a Mythic Point when attempting to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable a Device} to attempt the check at mythic proficiency. As normal when attempting a check with mythic proficiency, this allows you to attempt to Disable a Device even if the check normally requires expert or greater proficiency.
_desc_ko: 당신의 손은 놀라울 정도로 정확하게 움직이며 위험을 해체합니다. @link[actions.grab-an-edge]를 위한 곡예 판정 시, 신화 포인트를 소모하여 신화 숙련도로 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다. @link[actions.disable-a-device]를 시도할 때 신화 포인트를 소모하면 신화 숙련도로 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다. 신화 숙련도로 판정을 시도하다 할 때와 마찬가지로, 이로 인해 일반적으로 전문가 이상의 숙련도가 필요한 검사라도 장치 해체를 시도할 수 있습니다.

name: Angelkin

description.value: You descend from an angel, a winged messenger from Nirvana or one of the other celestial realms. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Society. If you would automatically become trained in Society (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You know the Empyrean language, and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.P9HCz0uR6xPHuw72]{Multilingual} skill feat.

_desc_en: You descend from an angel, a winged messenger from Nirvana or one of the other celestial realms. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Society. If you would automatically become trained in Society (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You know the Empyrean language, and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.P9HCz0uR6xPHuw72]{Multilingual} skill feat.
_desc_ko: 당신은 천사, 즉 열반이나 다른 천상체 영역에서 온 날개 달린 사자의 후예입니다. 사회 기술에 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 사회 기술에 자동으로 숙련된 상태가 된다면, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련된 상태가 됩니다. 천상의 언어를 알고 있으며, @link[feats.multilingual] 기술 피트를 얻습니다.

name: Opening Stance

description.value:
Trigger You roll initiative.

At the first sign of trouble, often before you consciously realize the danger, you drop into a stance with a mere thought. Use an action that has the stance trait.

_desc_en:
Trigger You roll initiative.

At the first sign of trouble, often before you consciously realize the danger, you drop into a stance with a mere thought. Use an action that has the stance trait.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 이니셔티브를 굴립니다.

위험의 첫 징후가 보이면, 종종 위험을 의식적으로 깨닫기도 전에, 생각만으로 자세를 취한다. 자세 특성을 가진 행동을 사용한다.

name: One More Activation

description.value: You've forged a deeper bond to your invested items, allowing you to activate them more than usual. Once each day, you can Activate an Item you've invested even after you've used that activation the maximum number of times for its frequency. You can do so only if the item's level is half your level or lower, the activation has a frequency of once per day or more frequent, and you haven't already used the activation this round.

_desc_en: You've forged a deeper bond to your invested items, allowing you to activate them more than usual. Once each day, you can Activate an Item you've invested even after you've used that activation the maximum number of times for its frequency. You can do so only if the item's level is half your level or lower, the activation has a frequency of once per day or more frequent, and you haven't already used the activation this round.
_desc_ko: 투자한 아이템과의 유대가 깊어져 평소보다 더 자주 활성화할 수 있게 되었다. 하루에 한 번, 해당 아이템의 최대 활성화 횟수를 모두 사용한 후에도 활성화할 수 있다. 해당 아이템의 레벨이 당신의 레벨의 절반 이하이고, 활성화 빈도가 하루에 한 번 이상이며, 이번 턴에 해당 활성화 사용을 아직 하지 않은 경우에만 가능합니다.

name: Gathering Moss

description.value:
Trigger You enter Tenacious Stance.

By rooting yourself in place, you are able to focus your body's natural healing to work faster. You gain fast healing equal to your level. This fast healing remains for 1 minute or until you end your Tenacious Stance, whichever comes first.

_desc_en:
Trigger You enter Tenacious Stance.

By rooting yourself in place, you are able to focus your body's natural healing to work faster. You gain fast healing equal to your level. This fast healing remains for 1 minute or until you end your Tenacious Stance, whichever comes first.
_desc_ko:
발동 당신은 끈질긴 자세를 취합니다.

자리를 굳게 잡고 뿌리내림으로써, 몸의 자연 치유력을 포커스하여 더 빠르게 작동하게 합니다. 레벨에 해당하는 빠른 치유 효과를 얻습니다. 이 빠른 치유 효과는 1분 동안 지속되거나, 끈질긴 자세를 종료할 때까지 유지됩니다. 둘 중 먼저 도래하는 시점까지입니다.

name: Future Spell Learning

description.value: More future memories of time magic percolate back to the present, teaching you spells you've yet to learn. Add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.3mQkAjexj6hhAnkR]{Behold the Weave}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OdqM06M0wDUqZWiR]{Cast into Time}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{Haste}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.mLAYvbafVKfBgEhz]{Loose Time's Arrow}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lETZeqBPoj2htGVk]{Quicken Time}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WsUwpfmhKrKwoIe3]{Slow}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.3E1p58MNQMO4GAxt]{Stagnate Time} to your spell list. If you have a repository of spells, like a witch's familiar or a spellbook, add these spells to it. If you have a spell repertoire, when you gain this feat you can retrain one spell in it, replacing it with one of the added spells.

If you have a spell repertoire, when you gain this feat you can retrain one spell in it, replacing it with one of the added spells.
_desc_ko: 시간 마법에 관한 더 많은 미래의 기억들이 현재로 스며들어, 아직 배우지 못한 주문을 가르쳐 준다. @link[spells.behold-the-weave], @link[spells.cast-into-time], @link[spells.haste], @link[spells.loose-times-arrow], @link[spells.quicken-time], @link[spells.slow], @link[spells.stagnate-time]를 주문 목록에 추가한다. 따라서 이 주문들은 본래 네 전통의 주문 목록에 없더라도 잠재적으로 배울 수 있다.

name: Talisman Esoterica

description.value:
You know how to assemble the supernatural objects in your esoterica into a number of temporary talismans. Each day during your daily preparations, you can make two talismans with an item level no higher than half your level. You must know each talisman's formula. A talisman created this way is a temporary item and loses its magic the next time you make your daily preparations.

You know the formulas for all common talismans in GM Core of your level or lower. You remember your talisman formulas through oral tradition or mnemonics, so you don't need a formula book for them.

_desc_en:
You know how to assemble the supernatural objects in your esoterica into a number of temporary talismans. Each day during your daily preparations, you can make two talismans with an item level no higher than half your level. You must know each talisman's formula. A talisman created this way is a temporary item and loses its magic the next time you make your daily preparations.

You know the formulas for all common talismans in GM Core of your level or lower. You remember your talisman formulas through oral tradition or mnemonics, so you don't need a formula book for them.
_desc_ko:
당신은 에소테리카에 담긴 초자연적 물건들을 조합해 여러 임시 부적을 만드는 법을 알고 있습니다. 매일 준비 시간 동안, 자신의 레벨 절반 이하의 아이템 레벨로 두 개의 부적을 만들 수 있습니다. 각 부적의 제조법을 반드시 알고 있어야 합니다. 이렇게 제작된 부적은 임시 아이템이며, 다음 일일 준비 시 마법이 사라집니다.

당신은 코어 룰북에 수록된 자신의 레벨 이하의 모든 일반 부적 제조법을 알고 있습니다. 구전 전통이나 기억법을 통해 부적 제조법을 기억하므로 별도의 제조법 책이 필요하지 않습니다.

name: Greater Interpose

description.value:
Your divine grace empowers you to avoid hits when you otherwise could not.

You can use Sacrifice Armor to reduce any type of damage from an attack or effect requiring a Reflex save. When you use Sacrifice Armor against a critical hit or a critical failure on a Reflex save that would otherwise cause you to take double damage, you take the normal amount of damage instead.

_desc_en:
Your divine grace empowers you to avoid hits when you otherwise could not.

You can use Sacrifice Armor to reduce any type of damage from an attack or effect requiring a Reflex save. When you use Sacrifice Armor against a critical hit or a critical failure on a Reflex save that would otherwise cause you to take double damage, you take the normal amount of damage instead.
_desc_ko:
신의 은총이 당신을 감싸, 피할 수 없는 공격을 피할 수 있게 합니다.

반사 내성을 요구하는 공격이나 효과로부터 받는 모든 유형의 피해를 줄이기 위해 희생 방어구를 사용할 수 있습니다. 치명타나 반사 내성 실패로 인해 두 배의 피해를 입게 될 때 희생 방어구를 사용하면, 대신 정상적인 양의 피해를 입습니다.

name: Chronoskimmer Dedication

description.value:
You became partially unstuck from time and have learned how to manipulate your place in the flow of time. When you roll initiative, you can choose one of three options: either do nothing and roll initiative normally, stabilize your timestream, or destabilize your timestream and send it into intense fluctuations.

  • Stabilize your Timestream (fortune) You don't roll initiative, and instead your initiative is equal to 10 + the modifier you would have used for initiative.
  • Destabilize your Timestream (fortune) You don't roll initiative, and instead attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11]. On a success, your initiative is equal to 19 + the modifier you would have used for initiative, and on a failure, your initiative is equal to 1 + that modifier.

Additionally, if your initiative roll result is tied with an opponent's initiative roll, you go first.

Your manipulation of time grants you access to a number of abilities, some of which require a saving throw. The DC for these abilities is either your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, and is called your chronoskimmer DC

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.xgk1Qc6nzGNJ7LSz]{Chronoskimmer}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.xgk1Qc6nzGNJ7LSz]{Chronoskimmer}
_desc_ko:
시간 흐름에서 부분적으로 분리되어 자신의 시간적 위치를 조작하는 법을 익혔습니다. 이니셔티브 주사위를 굴릴 때 다음 세 가지 옵션 중 하나를 선택할 수 있습니다: 아무것도 하지 않고 평소처럼 이니셔티브를 굴리거나, 자신의 시간 흐름을 안정화시키거나, 시간 흐름을 불안정하게 만들어 격렬한 변동을 일으킵니다. 시간 흐름을 안정화하기로 선택하면 이니셔티브를 굴리지 않으며, 대신 이니셔티브는 10 + 이니셔티브 수정자 with 동일해집니다. 시간 흐름을 불안정하게 만들기로 선택하면 DC 11 단순을 시도한다. 성공 시 이니셔티브는 19 + 이니셔티브 수정자 with +1, 그리고 실패 시 이니셔티브는 1 + 이니셔티브 수정자 with +1과 같다. 시간 흐름의 안정화 및 불안정화 모두 운명 효과이다.

추가로, 당신의 이니셔티브 굴림 결과가 상대방의 이니셔티브 굴림과 동점일 경우, 당신이 먼저 행동합니다. 시간 조작 능력은 여러 능력을 사용하게 해주며, 일부 능력은 내성 굴림을 요구합니다. 이 능력들의 난이도(DC)는 당신의 직업 난이도(DC)와 주문 DC(DC) 중 더 높은 값을 사용하며, 이를 크로노스키머 난이도(DC)라고 부릅니다.

참고: 인쇄된 이 피트는 헌신 특성이 포함되어 있지 않습니다. 이것이 아키타입 헌신 특성이므로, 해당 특성을 추가하였습니다.

name: Signature Weapon

description.value:
Your energy saturates one of your weapons; it might be one inherited or one tied to your history. Pick a weapon and give it a name; this weapon gains the unique trait. You gain access to its critical specialization effect. You can spend one action saying the name of your weapon, summoning it into your empty hand if the weapon is unattended and within 1 mile; this is an occult teleportation effect.

If your signature weapon is destroyed, you can spend three days and three nights saturating a new weapon with your energy, creating a new signature weapon.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Your energy saturates one of your weapons; it might be one inherited or one tied to your history. Pick a weapon and give it a name; this weapon gains the unique trait. You gain access to its critical specialization effect. You can spend one action saying the name of your weapon, summoning it into your empty hand if the weapon is unattended and within 1 mile; this is an occult teleportation effect.

If your signature weapon is destroyed, you can spend three days and three nights saturating a new weapon with your energy, creating a new signature weapon.
_desc_ko:
당신의 에너지가 무기 하나에 스며듭니다. 이는 물려받은 무기이거나 당신의 역사와 연결된 무기일 수 있습니다. 무기를 하나 선택하고 이름을 지어라. 이 무기는 고유 특성을 얻는다. 당신은 이 무기의 치명타 특화 효과를 사용할 수 있다. 무기가 방치되어 있고 1마일 이내에 있다면, 한 행동을 소비하여 무기의 이름을 불러 빈 손에 소환할 수 있다. 이는 오컬트 순간이동 효과이다.

당신의 시그니처 무기가 파괴되면, 사흘 밤낮을 들여 새로운 무기에 당신의 에너지를 포화시켜 새로운 시그니처 무기를 창조할 수 있습니다.

name: Might of the Realm

description.value: Bolstered by the presence of your knights, you strike a mighty blow in the name of your rule. Strike an enemy. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. If this Strike hits, you deal an additional amount of damage equal to double the number of your designated knights whom you can see. If the Strike is a critical hit, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

_desc_en: Bolstered by the presence of your knights, you strike a mighty blow in the name of your rule. Strike an enemy. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. If this Strike hits, you deal an additional amount of damage equal to double the number of your designated knights whom you can see. If the Strike is a critical hit, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.
_desc_ko: 기사들의 존재에 힘입어, 당신은 통치권을 위해 강력한 일격을 가한다. 적을 공격한다. 이 공격은 다중 공격 페널티 계산 시 두 번의 공격으로 간주된다. 이 공격이 적중하면, 시야 내에 있는 지정 기사 수의 두 배에 해당하는 추가 피해를 입힌다. 이 공격이 치명타일 경우, 대상은 다음 차례 시작까지 @link[conditions.enfeebled]{1} 상태가 된다.

name: Wrathful Presence

description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You channel the unending wrath of the erinyes all around you. You have a 30-foot aura for 1 minute or until you Dismiss it. You and your allies in the aura gain a +3 status bonus to damage with Strikes. Your enemies who end their turn within the aura can't reduce their frightened value below 1.

_desc_ko:
빈도 10분당 1회

당신은 당신 주변 곳곳에 에리니에스의 끝없는 분노를 발산합니다. 당신은 1분 동안 또는 당신이 해제할 때까지 30피트 오라를 가집니다. 오라 안의 당신과 아군은 타격 피해에 +3 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 오라 안에서 턴을 끝내는 당신의 적은 자신의 공포 값을 1 미만으로 줄일 수 없습니다.

name: Scattering Charge

description.value:
Requirements You are wearing medium or heavy armor.

You charge into a group of enemies to send them flying. Stride up to your Speed. At the end of your movement, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} up to three creatures within your reach. You don't need a hand free to do so. You attempt a separate Athletics check for each one; each attempt counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after you've made all the attempts. Regardless of your results, you can't Stride to follow any of the targets.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wearing medium or heavy armor.

You attempt a separate Athletics check for each one; each attempt counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after you've made all the attempts. Regardless of your results, you can't Stride to follow any of the targets.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 평갑 또는 중갑옷을 착용하고 있어야 한다.

적군 무리를 향해 돌진하여 그들을 날려버립니다. 이동 속도만큼 전진합니다. 이동 종료 시, @link[actions.shove]도달 범위 내 최대 세 명의 생물을 {밀쳐낼} 수 있습니다. 이를 위해 빈 손이 필요하지 않습니다. 각 대상마다 별도의 운동 판정을 시도합니다. 각 시도는 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되지만, 페널티는 모든 시도를 마친 후에야 증가합니다. 결과와 상관없이, 어떤 대상도 따라가려고 이동할 수 없습니다.

name: Diverse Recognition

description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger You successfully Recall Knowledge about a creature you can see, using a skill in which you are a master.

Your Pathfinder training allows you to quickly size up numerous threats. Attempt to Recall Knowledge against a different kind of creature you can see using the same skill. You must still meet the requirements to attempt this check.

_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 라운드당 1회

발동 조건 당신이 달인한 기술을 사용하여, 시야 내에 있는 생물에 대한 지식을 성공적으로 회상합니다.

당신의 패스파인더 훈련 덕분에 수많은 위협을 빠르게 파악할 수 있습니다. 동일한 기술을 사용하여 볼 수 있는 다른 종류의 생물에 대해 지식을 회상해 보십시오. 이 판정을 시도하려면 여전히 요구 사항을 충족해야 합니다.

name: Mature Animal Companion (Druid)

description.value:
Your animal companion has grown up over the course of your adventures, becoming a mature animal companion and gaining additional capabilities.

Your animal companion has greater independence. During an encounter, even if you don't use the Command an Animal action, your animal companion can still use 1 action that round on your turn to Strike or Stride (or Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim if it has that Speed). It can do this at any point during your turn, as long as you aren't currently taking an action. If it does, that's all the actions it gets that round—you can't Command it later.

_desc_en:

During an encounter, even if you don't use the Command an Animal action, your animal companion can still use 1 action that round on your turn to Strike or Stride (or Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim if it has that Speed). It can do this at any point during your turn, as long as you aren't currently taking an action. If it does, that's all the actions it gets that round—you can't Command it later.
_desc_ko:
당신의 동물 동료는 모험을 거치며 성장하여 성숙한 동물 동료가 되었으며, 추가 능력을 얻었습니다.

당신의 동물 동료는 더 큰 독립성을 지닙니다. 전투 중, 당신이 '동물 명령' 행동을 사용하지 않더라도 당신의 동물 동료는 당신의 턴에 그 라운드 동안 1개의 행동을 사용하여 '이동'이나 '공격'을 할 수 있습니다. 당신이 현재 행동을 취하고 있지 않다면, 당신의 턴 중 언제든지 이를 수행할 수 있습니다. 만약 그렇게 한다면, 그것이 그 라운드 동안 수행할 수 있는 모든 행동입니다-나중에 명령할 수 없습니다.

name: Riptide (Undersea Privateer)

description.value:
Requirements You're in Anchor Stance, and your target is within 5 feet of the edge of a water vehicle or already in the water.

You swirl water around you to make a current that pulls creatures closer. Attempt an Athletics check against the Fortitude DC of a creature within 20 feet. If the creature is willing, you increase your degree of success by one (turning a failure into a success and a success into a critical success).

Critical Success The target is pulled 10 feet toward you.

Success The target is pulled 5 feet toward you.

Critical Failure Your movements cause you to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the beginning of your next turn.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're in Anchor Stance, and your target is within 5 feet of the edge of a water vehicle or already in the water.

You swirl water around you to make a current that pulls creatures closer. Attempt an Athletics check against the Fortitude DC of a creature within 20 feet. If the creature is willing, you increase your degree of success by one (turning a failure into a success and a success into a critical success).

Critical Success The target is pulled 10 feet toward you.

Success The target is pulled 5 feet toward you.

Critical Failure Your movements cause you to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the beginning of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 당신은 닻 자세를 취하고 있으며, 당신의 대상은 수상 탈것 가장자리에서 5피트 이내에 있거나 이미 물속에 있습니다.

당신은 주변의 물을 소용돌이치게 하여 생물을 더 가까이 끌어당기는 물살을 만듭니다. 20피트 이내 생물의 인내 DC를 상대로 운동 판정을 시도합니다. 그 생물이 자발적이라면, 당신은 성공 정도를 한 단계 높입니다(실패를 성공으로, 성공을 대성공으로 전환).

대성공 대상은 당신 쪽으로 10피트 끌려옵니다.

성공 대상은 당신 쪽으로 5피트 끌려옵니다.

대실패 당신의 움직임으로 인해 당신은 다음 턴 시작 시까지 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{무방비} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Alchemical Assessment

description.value: You can identify alchemical items quickly. When using the Crafting skill to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Q4kdWVOf2ztIBFg1]{Identify Alchemy} on an alchemical item you hold, you can do so as a single action, rather than spending 10 minutes.

_desc_en: You can identify alchemical items quickly. When using the Crafting skill to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Q4kdWVOf2ztIBFg1]{Identify Alchemy} on an alchemical item you hold, you can do so as a single action, rather than spending 10 minutes.
_desc_ko: 당신은 연금술 아이템을 신속하게 식별할 수 있습니다. 제작 기술을 사용하여 소지한 연금술 아이템에 @link[actions.identify-alchemy]을 수행할 때, 10분을 소모하는 대신 액션 하나만으로 처리할 수 있습니다.

name: Dominating Gaze

description.value: You stare into your target's eyes and enthrall them, shattering their free will. Once per day, you can cast 7th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P]{Dominate} as a divine innate spell, using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. It gains the visual trait. At 18th level, the dominate is heightened to 8th level; at 20th level, it's heightened to 9th rank. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune to your domination for 24 hours, though in most cases, you can't Cast the Spell again within 24 hours. If you are destroyed, all your dominate spells from Dominating Gaze immediately end.

_desc_en: You stare into your target's eyes and enthrall them, shattering their free will. Once per day, you can cast 7th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P]{Dominate} as a divine innate spell, using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. It gains the visual trait. At 18th level, the dominate is heightened to 8th level; at 20th level, it's heightened to 9th rank. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune to your domination for 24 hours, though in most cases, you can't Cast the Spell again within 24 hours. If you are destroyed, all your dominate spells from Dominating Gaze immediately end.
_desc_ko: 당신은 대상의 눈을 응시하며 매혹시켜 자유 의지를 산산조각 낸다. 하루에 한 번, (7th)랭크 @link[spells.dominate]를 신성 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있으며, 당신의 클래스 DC(DC) 또는 주문 DC(DC) 중 더 높은 값을 사용한다. 시각적 특성을 획득한다. 18레벨에 도미네이트는 (8th)레벨로 강화되며, 20레벨에 (9th)레벨로 강화된다. 저항에 성공한 생물은 24시간 동안 당신의 지배에 일시적으로 면역이 되나, 대부분의 경우 24시간 내에는 해당 주문을 다시 시전할 수 없다. 당신이 파괴되면 지배의 시선에서 비롯된 모든 도미네이트 주문이 즉시 종료된다.

name: Cathartic Focus Spell

description.value: You learn the focus spell listed under your emotion's entry. You can cast it only while in emotional fervor. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can Refocus while you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EhLvRWFKhZ3HtrZO]{Settle Emotions}.

_desc_en: You learn the focus spell listed under your emotion's entry. You can cast it only while in emotional fervor. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can Refocus while you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EhLvRWFKhZ3HtrZO]{Settle Emotions}.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신의 감정 항목에 기재된 포커스 주문을 습득합니다. 감정적 열광 상태일 때만 시전할 수 있습니다. 아직 보유하지 않았다면, 1점의 포커스 구성된 포커스 풀을 얻으며, @link[actions.settle-emotions] 사용 중 재집중할 수 있습니다.

name: Flow of War

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger Your turn begins.

Divine battle instincts take over your body, letting you move and lash out with instinctive speed. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} until the end of your turn and can use the extra action only to Strike or Stride.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger Your turn begins.

Divine battle instincts take over your body, letting you move and lash out with instinctive speed. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} until the end of your turn and can use the extra action only to Strike or Stride.
_desc_ko:
빈도 시간당 1회

발동조건 당신의 턴이 시작된다.

신성한 전투 본능이 몸을 지배하며, 본능적인 속도로 움직이고 공격하게 한다. 당신은 @link[conditions.quickened] 상태가 되어 턴 종료까지 추가 행동을 사용할 수 있으며, 이는 오직 공격 또는 이동에만 사용 가능합니다.

name: Iruxi Glide

description.value: You glide slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down and up to 25 feet forward through the air. As long as you spend at least 1 action gliding each round and haven't yet reached the ground, you remain in the air at the end of your turn.

_desc_en: You glide slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down and up to 25 feet forward through the air. As long as you spend at least 1 action gliding each round and haven't yet reached the ground, you remain in the air at the end of your turn.
_desc_ko: 공중에서 천천히 지면을 향해 활공하며, 5피트 아래로 내려가고 최대 25피트 앞으로 이동합니다. 매 턴 최소 1개의 행동을 활공에 사용하며 아직 지면에 도달하지 않은 한, 자신의 턴이 끝날 때까지 공중에 머무를 수 있습니다.

name: Timewracked Dedication

description.value:
The current of time shifts subtly in your field of view. You have learned to tread these temporal eddies, moving forward and pushing backward in small strokes—sometimes even gaining the ability to move your allies and enemies through time as you choose. Whether or not you'll ever be fully restored to your proper timeline, you can't predict—but until then you continue to manipulate your estrangement from time to move unseen, defy your opponents in combat, and occupy future or past versions of yourself to escape distress. With practice you could gain the ability to rehearse a speech at the same tie you deliver it or attack distant foes without spending the time to move between them. Eventually, you might gain the power to vanish from existence altogether while you hop forward and backward in time or even become immortal.

Your Speed increases by 5 feet for each mode of movement available to you. You can spend a Mythic Point to roll any check made to determine your initiative at mythic proficiency. If your initiative roll result is tied with an opponent's initiative roll, you can choose to go first. In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.gCVox3KLuKFXCUqZ]{Sidestep Through Time} reaction.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.j9wnNvtSNXVdcJcu]{Timewracked (Rare)}

publication.title: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

Whether or not you'll ever be fully restored to your proper timeline, you can't predict—but until then you continue to manipulate your estrangement from time to move unseen, defy your opponents in combat, and occupy future or past versions of yourself to escape distress. With practice you could gain the ability to rehearse a speech at the same tie you deliver it or attack distant foes without spending the time to move between them. Eventually, you might gain the power to vanish from existence altogether while you hop forward and backward in time or even become immortal.

Your Speed increases by 5 feet for each mode of movement available to you. You can spend a Mythic Point to roll any check made to determine your initiative at mythic proficiency. If your initiative roll result is tied with an opponent's initiative roll, you can choose to go first. In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.gCVox3KLuKFXCUqZ]{Sidestep Through Time} reaction.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.j9wnNvtSNXVdcJcu]{Timewracked (Rare)}
_desc_ko:
시간의 흐름이 당신의 시야에서 미묘하게 변화합니다. 당신은 이 시간적 소용돌이를 밟는 법을 배워, 작은 획으로 앞으로 나아가고 뒤로 밀어냅니다—때로는 당신이 선택한 대로 아군과 적을 시간을 통해 이동시키는 능력까지 얻습니다. 당신이 언젠가 온전히 본래의 시간선으로 복원될지는 예측할 수 없지만—그때까지 당신은 남들 눈에 띄지 않게 움직이고, 전투에서 적에게 맞서고, 곤경에서 벗어나기 위해 미래나 과거의 자신을 점유하고자 시간과의 분리를 계속 조작합니다. 연습을 통해 당신은 연설을 전달하는 동시에 그것을 예행하거나, 사이를 이동하는 시간을 들이지 않고 멀리 있는 적을 공격하는 능력을 얻을 수 있습니다. 결국 당신은 시간을 앞뒤로 넘나들며 존재에서 완전히 사라지거나 심지어 불멸이 되는 힘을 얻을지도 모릅니다.

당신의 이동력은 당신에게 가능한 각 이동 방식마다 5피트씩 증가합니다. 당신은 신화 점수 1점을 소모해 우선권을 결정하기 위한 판정을 신화 숙련도로 굴릴 수 있습니다. 당신의 우선권 굴림 결과가 적의 우선권 굴림과 동점이라면, 당신이 먼저 행동하도록 선택할 수 있습니다. 또한, 당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.gCVox3KLuKFXCUqZ]{시간을 통한 회피} 반응을 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.j9wnNvtSNXVdcJcu]{시간에 찢긴 자 (희귀)}

name: Great Bear

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

When you transform, you can take on a bear's bulk and size. You can spend an additional action when using Ursine Avenger Form to gain the effects of a 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge} spell, which lasts for the spell's normal duration or until you leave your Ursine Avenger Form, whichever comes first.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

When you transform, you can take on a bear's bulk and size. You can spend an additional action when using Ursine Avenger Form to gain the effects of a 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge} spell, which lasts for the spell's normal duration or until you leave your Ursine Avenger Form, whichever comes first.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 시간당 1회

변신 시 곰의 벌크와 크기를 취할 수 있습니다. 곰의 복수자 형태를 사용할 때 추가 행동을 소비하면 1랭크 @link[spells.enlarge] 주문의 효과를 얻을 수 있으며, 이는 주문의 정상 지속 시간 동안 또는 곰의 복수자 형태를 벗을 때까지 중 먼저 도래하는 시점까지 지속됩니다.

name: Ancestor's Rage

description.value: You transform into an enormous, otherworldly hyena. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wp09USMB3GIW1qbp]{Animal Form} (canine form only) once per day as a 5th-rank occult innate spell.

_desc_en: You transform into an enormous, otherworldly hyena. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wp09USMB3GIW1qbp]{Animal Form} (canine form only) once per day as a 5th-rank occult innate spell.
_desc_ko: 당신은 거대하고 초자연적인 하이에나로 변신합니다. 하루에 한 번, 5랭크 오컬트 선천 마법으로 @link[spells.animal-form](개과 형태만 가능)를 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Unobstructed Shot

description.value: With a quick use of brute force, you remove an obstacle and take a calculated shot as part of the same motion. Attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} one adjacent creature, then make a ranged Strike with a bow or crossbow you're wielding. The Strike is made at the same multiple attack penalty as the Shove or Trip attempt, and this activity counts as one attack when calculating your multiple attack penalty.

_desc_en: With a quick use of brute force, you remove an obstacle and take a calculated shot as part of the same motion. Attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} one adjacent creature, then make a ranged Strike with a bow or crossbow you're wielding. The Strike is made at the same multiple attack penalty as the Shove or Trip attempt, and this activity counts as one attack when calculating your multiple attack penalty.
_desc_ko: 순식간에 무력을 사용해 장애물을 제거하고, 같은 동작으로 계산된 사격을 가한다. 시도하다 @link[actions.shove] 또는 @link[actions.trip]로 인접한 생물 하나를 시도한 후, 당신이 휘두르는 활이나 석궁으로 원거리 공격을 가한다. 이 공격은 밀치기나 걸려 넘어뜨리기 시도와 동일한 다중 공격 페널티를 적용받으며, 다중 공격 페널티 계산 시 이 행동은 하나의 공격으로 간주된다.

name: Apparition's Quickening

description.value:
Frequency once per round

Requirements You are attuned to at least 2 apparitions.

If your next action is to cast a cantrip or a spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank spell slot you have, you can draw power from one of your attuned apparitions to reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action). The chosen apparition is dispersed until you can re-attune to it at your next daily preparations, but you can't disperse an apparition in this way if you would no longer be attuned to any apparitions afterward.

Special This can only be used on a cantrip or spell from the class matching the one you gained this feat from.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per round

Requirements You are attuned to at least 2 apparitions.

If your next action is to cast a cantrip or a spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank spell slot you have, you can draw power from one of your attuned apparitions to reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action). The chosen apparition is dispersed until you can re-attune to it at your next daily preparations, but you can't disperse an apparition in this way if you would no longer be attuned to any apparitions afterward.

Special This can only be used on a cantrip or spell from the class matching the one you gained this feat from.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 라운드당 1회

요구 사항 최소 2개의 유령에 조율되어 있어야 합니다.

다음 행동이 캔트립이나 자신이 보유한 최고 랭크 주문 슬롯보다 최소 2랭크 낮은 주문을 시전하는 것이라면, 조율된 환영 중 하나로부터 힘을 끌어와 시전 행동 수를 1 감소시킬 수 있습니다(최소 1 행동). 선택한 환영은 다음 일일 준비 시까지 해산되지만, 이후 어떤 환영에도 조율 상태가 유지되지 않는다면 이 방법으로 환영을 해산할 수 없습니다.

특수 이 재주는 획득한 재주와 동일한 직업의 캔트립이나 주문에만 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Traces of the Divine

description.value: You can detect those who use divine magic like an additional sense. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to [[/act seek]] and Survival checks to [[/act track]] creatures that can cast divine spells. In addition, you automatically succeed at the flat check to target a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} creature that can cast divine spells, and the flat check to target a hidden creature that can cast divine spells is reduced to DC 5.

_desc_en: You can detect those who use divine magic like an additional sense. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to [[/act seek]] and Survival checks to [[/act track]] creatures that can cast divine spells. In addition, you automatically succeed at the flat check to target a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} creature that can cast divine spells, and the flat check to target a hidden creature that can cast divine spells is reduced to DC 5.
_desc_ko: 당신은 추가적인 감각처럼 신성 마법을 사용하는 자들을 감지할 수 있습니다. 당신은 신성 주문을 시전할 수 있는 생물을 대상으로 [[/act seek]]하기 위한 지각 판정과 [[/act track]]하기 위한 생존 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 또한, 당신은 신성 주문을 시전할 수 있는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{은폐}된 생물을 대상으로 하는 평판정에 자동으로 성공하며, 신성 주문을 시전할 수 있는 숨겨진 생물을 대상으로 하는 평판정은 DC 5로 낮아집니다.

name: Apparition's Enhancement

description.value:
Frequency once per turn

Requirements Your most recent action was to cast a non-cantrip spell.

Spiritual power encases your weapon or unarmed attack. Until the end of your turn, one wielded weapon or unarmed attack you have deals an extra 1d6 spirit damage and gains the divine trait, if it didn't have it already.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per turn

Requirements Your most recent action was to cast a non-cantrip spell.

Spiritual power encases your weapon or unarmed attack. Until the end of your turn, one wielded weapon or unarmed attack you have deals an extra 1d6 spirit damage and gains the divine trait, if it didn't have it already.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 턴당 1회

요구 사항 가장 최근에 캐스트한 주문이 캔트립이 아닌 주문이어야 합니다.

영력이 무기나 비무장 공격을 감쌉니다. 당신의 턴이 끝날 때까지, 당신이 휘두르는 무기 하나 또는 비무장 공격 하나가 추가로 1d6 영혼 피해를 입히고, 아직 신성 속성을 가지지 않았다면 신성 속성을 얻습니다.

name: Cutting Without Blade

description.value:
While tales of your divine ikons have spread far and wide, you've realized that, as they are all manifestations of your soul, the object itself is unnecessary. Your ikons disintegrate into golden light. Any ikon feats you've taken now apply to any applicable ikon you have, not just one, and you can immediately retrain any ikon feats you selected more than once.

Each day during your daily preparations, you can select one ikon feat of 16th level or lower and gain it temporarily for that day. You can place your divine spark into any object in your possession, even a nonthreatening object like a single strand of grass, to transform it into a fully functional copy of your ikon made out of pure divine radiance. You can do this as a free action immediately before or after Striking with or otherwise using the ikon.

_desc_en:
While tales of your divine ikons have spread far and wide, you've realized that, as they are all manifestations of your soul, the object itself is unnecessary. Your ikons disintegrate into golden light. Any ikon feats you've taken now apply to any applicable ikon you have, not just one, and you can immediately retrain any ikon feats you selected more than once.

Each day during your daily preparations, you can select one ikon feat of 16th level or lower and gain it temporarily for that day. You can place your divine spark into any object in your possession, even a nonthreatening object like a single strand of grass, to transform it into a fully functional copy of your ikon made out of pure divine radiance. You can do this as a free action immediately before or after Striking with or otherwise using the ikon.
_desc_ko:
당신의 신성한 이콘에 관한 이야기가 널리 퍼졌지만, 그것들이 모두 당신의 영혼의 현현임을 깨달은 당신은 물건 자체가 불필요함을 알게 되었습니다. 당신의 이콘들은 황금빛으로 분해된다. 선택한 이콘 피트는 이제 하나의 이콘이 아닌, 해당 피트가 적용 가능한 모든 이콘에 적용되며, 중복 선택한 피트는 즉시 재훈련할 수 있다.

매일 준비 시간 동안, 16레벨 이하의 이콘 피트 하나를 선택하여 그날 하루 동안 일시적으로 획득할 수 있다. 당신은 신성한 불꽃을 소유한 어떤 물체에도, 심지어 한 줄기의 풀처럼 위협적이지 않은 물체에도 넣어 순수한 신성한 광채로 이루어진 이콘의 완전한 기능적 복제물로 변환할 수 있습니다. 이는 이콘으로 강타하거나 사용하는 직전 또는 직후에 자유 행동으로 수행할 수 있습니다.

name: Selective Energy

description.value: As you call down divine power, you can prevent some enemies from benefiting or some allies from being hurt. When you cast a version of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} that has an area, you can designate up to 5 creatures in the area. They are not targeted by the spell.

_desc_en: As you call down divine power, you can prevent some enemies from benefiting or some allies from being hurt. When you cast a version of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} that has an area, you can designate up to 5 creatures in the area. They are not targeted by the spell.
_desc_ko: 신성한 힘을 불러내면서, 일부 적들이 혜택을 받지 못하게 하거나 일부 아군이 피해를 입지 않도록 막을 수 있습니다. @link[spells.harm] 또는 @link[spells.heal]의 영역형 버전을 시전할 때, 해당 영역 내 최대 5명의 생물을 지정할 수 있습니다. 이들은 해당 주문에 표적이 되지 않습니다.

name: Maelstrom Flow

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements You're wielding an improvised weapon.

You pour energy into an improvised weapon, speeding its destruction to grant it power. The overloaded energy grants your improvised weapon the effect of the astral, corrosive, extending, or frost rune for 1 minute, after which the item is destroyed. If the item has a Hardness greater than your level, or if it's an artifact, cursed item, or other item that's difficult to break or destroy, it is not destroyed, and this ability only lasts until the end of your turn.

This effect doesn't count against the number of property runes a weapon can have based on its potency rune, but a given weapon can only have one application of Maelstrom Flow at a time.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements You're wielding an improvised weapon.

You pour energy into an improvised weapon, speeding its destruction to grant it power. The overloaded energy grants your improvised weapon the effect of the astral, corrosive, extending, or frost rune for 1 minute, after which the item is destroyed. If the item has a Hardness greater than your level, or if it's an artifact, cursed item, or other item that's difficult to break or destroy, it is not destroyed, and this ability only lasts until the end of your turn.

This effect doesn't count against the number of property runes a weapon can have based on its potency rune, but a given weapon can only have one application of Maelstrom Flow at a time.
_desc_ko:
빈도 시간당 한 번

요구 사항 당신은 즉석 무기를 휘두르고 있습니다.

당신은 즉석 무기에 에너지를 쏟아부어 파괴 속도를 높여 힘을 부여합니다. 과부하된 에너지는 즉석 무기에 1분 동안 아스트랄, 부식, 연장, 또는 서리 룬의 효과를 부여한 후, 해당 아이템은 파괴됩니다. 아이템의 경도가 당신의 레벨보다 높거나, 유물, 저주받은 아이템, 또는 깨거나 파괴하기 어려운 다른 아이템인 경우, 아이템은 파괴되지 않으며 이 능력은 당신의 턴이 끝날 때까지만 지속됩니다.

이 효과는 무기의 위력 룬에 기반한 속성 룬 보유 개수에 포함되지 않으나, 특정 무기는 한 번에 하나의 소용돌이 흐름 효과만 적용받을 수 있습니다.

name: Animal Speaker

description.value: You can speak to all animals, not just a particular subset. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Make an Impression on animals (which usually uses the Diplomacy skill).

value.value: ability to communicate with some type of animals (such as bats or arthropods)

_desc_en: You can speak to all animals, not just a particular subset. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Make an Impression on animals (which usually uses the Diplomacy skill).
_desc_ko: 특정 종류가 아닌 모든 동물과 대화할 수 있습니다. 동물에게 인상을 남기는 데(보통 외교 기술 사용) +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Tattoo Artist

description.value:
You can craft tattoos, including magical tattoos. When you select this feat, you gain the formulas for four common magical tattoos of 2nd level or lower.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Crafting checks to Craft tattoos. If you're a master in Crafting, this bonus increases to +2 and you gain the formulas for four common magical tattoos of 7th level or lower.

_desc_en:
You can craft tattoos, including magical tattoos. When you select this feat, you gain the formulas for four common magical tattoos of 2nd level or lower.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Crafting checks to Craft tattoos. If you're a master in Crafting, this bonus increases to +2 and you gain the formulas for four common magical tattoos of 7th level or lower.
_desc_ko:
문신을 제작할 수 있으며, 마법 문신도 포함된다. 이 피트를 선택하면 2레벨 이하의 일반적인 마법 문신 네 가지의 제작법을 습득한다.

문신 제작 제작 기술 판정 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 제작에 달인인 경우 이 보너스가 +2로 증가하며, 7레벨 이하의 일반적인 마법 문신 네 가지의 제작법을 얻습니다.

name: Devilish Wiles

description.value: Traditionally, fiends are exceptionally good at persuading people to do things, even when their targets know it's a bad idea. You're also rather good at it, compelling the weak and weak-willed to your bidding. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLA0q0WOK2YPuJs6]{Charm} once per day as a 1st-rank divine innate spell.

_desc_en: Traditionally, fiends are exceptionally good at persuading people to do things, even when their targets know it's a bad idea. You're also rather good at it, compelling the weak and weak-willed to your bidding. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLA0q0WOK2YPuJs6]{Charm} once per day as a 1st-rank divine innate spell.
_desc_ko: 전통적으로 핀드들은 상대가 나쁜 생각임을 알면서도 일을 하도록 설득하는 데 탁월합니다. 당신 역시 약한 자나 의지가 약한 자를 자신의 뜻대로 움직이게 하는 데 능숙합니다. 하루에 한 번, 1랭크 신성 선천 마법인 @link[spells.charm]을 시전할 수 있습니다.

name: Different Worlds

description.value:
Your separate experiences in different societies have evolved into entirely separate lives. Create a second identity for yourself with a different name, history, and background. This identity must correspond to one of the ancestries whose ancestry feats you can select. You gain the trained proficiency rank in the Lore skill from the second background you chose (but you don't gain any of the background's other benefits), and you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to Deception checks when making a statement that would be true of your second identity or when disguising yourself as your second identity.

Special At the GM's discretion, this feat can be used against non-humanoids if they have regular contact with humanoids or you are able to disguise yourself as a member of the target's ancestry or type of creature.

value.value: ability to select ancestry feats from multiple ancestries

_desc_en:
Your separate experiences in different societies have evolved into entirely separate lives. Create a second identity for yourself with a different name, history, and background. This identity must correspond to one of the ancestries whose ancestry feats you can select. You gain the trained proficiency rank in the Lore skill from the second background you chose (but you don't gain any of the background's other benefits), and you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to Deception checks when making a statement that would be true of your second identity or when disguising yourself as your second identity.

Special At the GM's discretion, this feat can be used against non-humanoids if they have regular contact with humanoids or you are able to disguise yourself as a member of the target's ancestry or type of creature.
_desc_ko:
서로 다른 사회에서의 경험이 완전히 별개의 삶으로 진화했다. 다른 이름, 역사, 배경을 가진 두 번째 정체성을 창조하라. 이 정체성은 선택 가능한 조상 피트 중 하나의 조상에 부합해야 한다. 선택한 두 번째 배경의 지식 기술에 숙련 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다(단, 배경의 다른 혜택은 얻지 못함). 또한 두 번째 정체성에 대해 사실인 진술을 하거나 두 번째 정체성으로 변장할 때 기만 검사에서 +4 상황 보너스 를 얻습니다.

특수 GM의 재량에 따라, 이 피트는 비인간형 생물에게도 적용될 수 있습니다. 단, 해당 생물이 인간형 생물과 정기적으로 접촉하거나, 대상의 조상이나 생물 유형에 속하는 존재로 변장할 수 있는 경우에 한합니다.

name: Quickened Casting

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Bard If your next action is to cast a bard cantrip or a bard spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank bard spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

Witch You accelerate your spellcasting. If your next action is to cast a witch cantrip or a witch spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank witch spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

Wizard Straining your mind, you collapse as much of your spell's formulas as you can, resulting in a shorter but much more complex incantation. If your next action is to cast a wizard cantrip or a wizard spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank wizard spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

Others If your next action is to cast a class cantrip or a class spell that is at least 2 levels lower than the highest-level class spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

Frequency once per day

Bard If your next action is to cast a bard cantrip or a bard spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank bard spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

Witch You accelerate your spellcasting. If your next action is to cast a witch cantrip or a witch spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank witch spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

If your next action is to cast a wizard cantrip or a wizard spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank wizard spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

바드 다음 행동이 바드 캔트립이나 보유한 최고 랭크 바드 주문 슬롯보다 최소 2랭크 낮은 바드 주문을 시전하는 것이라면, 시전에 필요한 행동 횟수를 1회 감소시킨다(최소 1 행동).

마녀 당신은 주문 시전을 가속화합니다. 다음 행동이 마녀의 캔트립이나, 당신이 보유한 최고 랭크 마녀 주문 슬롯보다 최소 2랭크 낮은 마녀 주문을 시전하는 것이라면, 시전에 필요한 행동 횟수를 1 감소시킵니다(최소 1 행동).

위자드 정신을 집중하여 주문의 공식 대부분을 압축합니다. 그 결과 주문 발음은 짧아지지만 훨씬 더 복잡해집니다. 다음 행동이 위자드 캔트립이나, 자신이 보유한 최고 랭크 위자드 주문 슬롯보다 최소 2랭크 낮은 위자드 주문을 시전하는 것이라면, 시전에 필요한 행동 수를 1 감소시킵니다(최소 1 행동).

기타 다음 행동이 클래스 캔트립이나 자신이 보유한 최고 레벨 클래스 주문 슬롯보다 최소 2레벨 낮은 클래스 주문을 시전하는 것이라면, 시전에 필요한 행동 횟수를 1 감소시킨다(최소 1 행동).

name: Scar-Thick Skin

description.value: Glorious, storied scars cover and protect much of your body, girding you in fleshly armor that resists any wound weaker than those you have already survived. Your DC on flat checks to end persistent bleed damage is reduced from 15 to 10, or from 10 to a @Check[flat|dc:5] after receiving especially appropriate assistance.

_desc_en: Glorious, storied scars cover and protect much of your body, girding you in fleshly armor that resists any wound weaker than those you have already survived. Your DC on flat checks to end persistent bleed damage is reduced from 15 to 10, or from 10 to a @Check[flat|dc:5] after receiving especially appropriate assistance.
_desc_ko: 영광스럽고 전설적인 상처들이 당신의 몸 대부분을 덮고 보호하며, 이미 견뎌낸 상처보다 약한 어떤 상처도 막아내는 육체의 갑옷으로 당신을 감쌉니다. 지속적 출혈 피해를 끝내기 위한 단순 판정 DC가 15에서 10으로 감소하거나, 특히 적절한 도움을 받은 후에는 10에서 DC 5 단순로 감소한다.

name: The Bitter Scholar's Promotion

description.value:
Tian Xia's shining cities belie its empires' long shadow of death, darkened by thousands of years of suffering and injustice. You pursue immortality not through tuft-hunting with Heaven's dragons or their imperial brats; yours is the power to crack its corrupt wheel, for you can now release the ghost gates to expedite the dead's revenge at being cheated of their fates.

You cease aging and, regardless of your actual existential state, now register as an undead to effects that can detect undead (such as lifesense or spiritsense).

In addition, you learn @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.c3b6LdLlQDPngNIb]{Create Undead} rituals for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.book-of-the-dead-bestiary.Actor.XrSjNpkJkBO6ysRG]{Gashadokuro}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.book-of-the-dead-bestiary.Actor.ZSrMFLrb5CzFH5WX]{Jiang-shi}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.lost-omens-bestiary.Actor.k5f4vITTc7mclQzH]{Shui Gui}. On a success with one of these rituals, you gain the effects of a critical success instead.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Tian Xia's shining cities belie its empires' long shadow of death, darkened by thousands of years of suffering and injustice. You pursue immortality not through tuft-hunting with Heaven's dragons or their imperial brats; yours is the power to crack its corrupt wheel, for you can now release the ghost gates to expedite the dead's revenge at being cheated of their fates.

You cease aging and, regardless of your actual existential state, now register as an undead to effects that can detect undead (such as lifesense or spiritsense).

In addition, you learn @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.c3b6LdLlQDPngNIb]{Create Undead} rituals for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.book-of-the-dead-bestiary.Actor.XrSjNpkJkBO6ysRG]{Gashadokuro}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.book-of-the-dead-bestiary.Actor.ZSrMFLrb5CzFH5WX]{Jiang-shi}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.lost-omens-bestiary.Actor.k5f4vITTc7mclQzH]{Shui Gui}. On a success with one of these rituals, you gain the effects of a critical success instead.
_desc_ko:
티엔 샤의 빛나는 도시들은 수천 년의 고통과 불의로 어두워진 제국의 죽음의 긴 그림자를 감추고 있다. 네가 추구하는 불멸은 천상의 용이나 제국의 자식들과의 깃털 사냥을 통한 것이 아니다. 네 힘은 부패한 운명의 바퀴를 깨뜨릴 수 있는 힘이다. 이제 네가 유령의 문을 열어 죽은 자들이 속아 넘어가 운명을 빼앗긴 것에 대한 복수를 서두르게 할 수 있기 때문이다.

당신은 노화를 멈추며, 실제 존재 상태와 무관하게 이제 언데드 감지 효과(생명 감지나 영혼 감지 등)에 언데드로 인식된다.

또한 @link[spells.create-undead], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.book-of-the-dead-bestiary.Actor.XrSjNpkJkBO6ysRG]{강시}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.book-of-the-dead-bestiary.Actor.ZSrMFLrb5CzFH5WX]{수이구이}를 위한 @link[spells.create-undead] 의식을 익힌다. 이 의식 중 하나에 성공하면, 대신 대성공의 효과를 얻습니다.

name: Take the Wheel

description.value:
Requirements You are adjacent to a vehicle's point of entry.

Diving into a moving vehicle and seizing the controls is nothing new for you. You Board and Take Control of the adjacent vehicle.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are adjacent to a vehicle's point of entry.

Diving into a moving vehicle and seizing the controls is nothing new for you. You Board and Take Control of the adjacent vehicle.
_desc_ko:
Requirements 차량의 승차 지점에 인접해 있어야 합니다.

움직이는 차량에 뛰어들어 조종 장치를 장악하는 것은 당신에게 익숙한 일입니다. 인접한 차량에 탑승하여 조종을 장악합니다.

name: Tetraelemental Assault

description.value: Your Elemental Assault cycles through all four elements. When you use Elemental Assault, instead of choosing a single element, you can choose an element from the list when using the action, and then choose a different element at the beginning of each of your next 3 turns without spending an action; once you have chosen an element, you can't choose it again during this Elemental Assault, meaning you must select all four elements over the course of 4 turns. Each time you choose an element, until the beginning of your next turn, your Strikes deal an additional @Damage[1d6[untyped]] damage of the indicated type and have the trait corresponding to that element.

_desc_en: Your Elemental Assault cycles through all four elements. When you use Elemental Assault, instead of choosing a single element, you can choose an element from the list when using the action, and then choose a different element at the beginning of each of your next 3 turns without spending an action; once you have chosen an element, you can't choose it again during this Elemental Assault, meaning you must select all four elements over the course of 4 turns. Each time you choose an element, until the beginning of your next turn, your Strikes deal an additional @Damage[1d6[untyped]] damage of the indicated type and have the trait corresponding to that element.
_desc_ko: 당신의 원소 공격은 네 가지 원소를 순환합니다. 원소 공격을 사용할 때, 단일 원소를 선택하는 대신 행동 사용 시 목록에서 원소를 선택한 후, 이후 3턴 동안 각 턴 시작 시마다 행동을 소모하지 않고 다른 원소를 선택할 수 있습니다. 원소를 선택할 때마다, 다음 턴 시작 전까지 당신의 공격은 표시된 유형의 추가 1d6 피해를 입히고 해당 원소에 해당하는 특성을 가집니다.

name: Shove Down

description.value:
Requirements Your last action was a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}.

You leverage your weight to topple foes that you move. You attempt to [[/act trip]] the target, even if the target is no longer in your reach.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your last action was a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}.

You leverage your weight to topple foes that you move. You attempt to [[/act trip]] the target, even if the target is no longer in your reach.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 마지막 행동이 성공적인 @link[actions.shove]였어야 합니다.

당신은 이동하는 적을 넘어뜨리기 위해 체중을 이용합니다. 대상이 더 이상 도달 범위 밖에 있더라도 @link[actions.trip]를 시도합니다.

name: You're So Cute!

description.value: You know how to put on the charm, doing playful tricks to win favor. You are trained in Performance and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xqAdXRd2gSQcqp5E]{Impressive Performance} feat. When performing for humanoids, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} with Performance.

_desc_en: You know how to put on the charm, doing playful tricks to win favor. You are trained in Performance and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xqAdXRd2gSQcqp5E]{Impressive Performance} feat. When performing for humanoids, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} with Performance.
_desc_ko: 당신은 매력을 발산하는 법을 알고 있으며, 호감을 얻기 위해 장난스러운 묘기를 부립니다. 공연 훈련을 받아 @link[feats.impressive-performance] 피트를 얻습니다. 인간형 생물에게 공연할 때, 공연 능력으로 @link[actions.make-an-impression]에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Reincarnated Companion

description.value: You're not alone in having a legendary past life—so too does your companion. This previous life might be the return of an animal companion or familiar a previous PC of yours had that perished, or it could be the reincarnation of an entirely different legendary creature. It could even be the returning spirit of a close friend or ally who stood by your side. If you have an animal companion, it gains one specialization of your choice. If you have a familiar, it gains two additional familiar abilities. If your fated companion is slain, you can replace it at no cost when you perform your daily preparations.

value.value: familiar or nimble or savage animal companion

publication.title: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

If you have a familiar, it gains two additional familiar abilities. If your fated companion is slain, you can replace it at no cost when you perform your daily preparations.
_desc_ko: 전설적인 전생을 가진 것은 당신만이 아닙니다—당신의 동료 역시 그렇습니다. 이 전생은 당신의 이전 PC가 가졌던, 죽은 동물 동료나 사역마의 귀환일 수도 있고, 완전히 다른 전설적 생물의 환생일 수도 있습니다. 심지어 당신 곁을 지켰던 가까운 친구나 아군의 돌아온 영혼일 수도 있습니다. 당신에게 동물 동료가 있다면, 그것은 당신이 선택한 전문화 하나를 얻습니다. 당신에게 사역마가 있다면, 그것은 추가 사역마 능력 두 개를 얻습니다. 당신의 운명적 동료가 죽으면, 매일의 준비를 수행할 때 비용 없이 그것을 교체할 수 있습니다.

name: Aura of Determination

description.value: Your aura protects against powers that would twist the mind and body. You and all allies in your champion's aura gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against mental, morph, and polymorph effects.

_desc_en: Your aura protects against powers that would twist the mind and body. You and all allies in your champion's aura gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against mental, morph, and polymorph effects.
_desc_ko: 당신의 오라는 정신과 육체를 뒤틀려는 힘으로부터 보호합니다. 당신과 챔피언의 오라 안에 있는 모든 아군은 정신, 변형, 다형 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Vengeful Spirit Deck

description.value:
Requirements You have an active harrow omen.

You manifest a ghostly deck of harrow cards. Draw a card from a harrow deck, then select a target within 60 feet. The card flies through the air to strike at that target, inflicting 4d6 damage, with a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] saving throw against your class DC or spell DC. The type of damage inflicted is determined by your active harrow omen; if the card drawn is in the same suit as your active harrow omen, the target takes a –2 status penalty to its saving throw. The damage increases to 6d6 if you're 10th level and 8d6 if you're 15th level. You can continue to throw cards at targets on your turn as long as you Sustain the Vengeful Spirit Deck—throwing a card takes two actions. This effect lasts as long as you Sustain it, up to 1 minute, or until you no longer have an active harrow omen. Once the effect ends, you lose your active harrow omen.

Keys: @Damage[(ternary(gte(@actor.level,15),8,ternary(gte(@actor.level,10),6,4)))d6[fire]]

Shields: @Damage[(ternary(gte(@actor.level,15),8,ternary(gte(@actor.level,10),6,4)))d6[poison]]

Crowns: @Damage[(ternary(gte(@actor.level,15),8,ternary(gte(@actor.level,10),6,4)))d6[acid]]
