_desc_ko:
발동 당신은 피해를 입습니다.

요구 사항 당신은 와일드 윈즈 자세를 취하고 있습니다.

다음 차례 시작까지 레벨에 해당하는 전기 저항력을 얻습니다. 발동 피해를 준 것이 전기라면 이 저항력이 적용됩니다. 발동 피해를 준 것이 근접 공격이라면 공격자는 3d6 전기의 피해를 입습니다.

특수 이 피트는 당신이 시전하는 기(氣) 주문의 전통(신성 또는 오컬트)에 해당하는 특성을 지닙니다.

name: Paired Shots

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding two weapons, each of which can be either a loaded one-handed firearm or loaded one-handed crossbow.

Your shots hit simultaneously. Make two Strikes, one with each of your two ranged weapons, each using your current multiple attack penalty. Both Strikes must have the same target.

If both attacks hit, combine their damage and then add any applicable effects from both weapons. You add any precision damage, only once, to the attack of your choice. Combine the damage from both Strikes and apply resistances and weaknesses only once. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding two weapons, each of which can be either a loaded one-handed firearm or loaded one-handed crossbow.

Your shots hit simultaneously. Make two Strikes, one with each of your two ranged weapons, each using your current multiple attack penalty. Both Strikes must have the same target.

If both attacks hit, combine their damage and then add any applicable effects from both weapons. You add any precision damage, only once, to the attack of your choice. Combine the damage from both Strikes and apply resistances and weaknesses only once. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 두 개의 무기를 휘두르고 있으며, 각각 장전된 한손 화기 또는 장전된 한손 석궁일 수 있습니다.

당신의 사격은 동시에 명중합니다. 두 개의 원거리 무기로 각각 한 번씩, 총 두 번의 공격을 수행합니다. 각 공격은 현재의 다중 공격 페널티를 적용받습니다. 두 공격은 반드시 동일한 대상을 겨냥해야 합니다.

두 공격이 모두 명중하면, 두 무기의 피해를 합산하고 적용 가능한 효과를 모두 추가합니다. 정밀 피해는 한 번만 선택한 공격에 추가합니다. 두 공격의 피해를 합산하고 저항 및 약점은 한 번만 적용합니다. 이 공격은 다중 공격 페널티 계산 시 두 번의 공격으로 간주됩니다.

name: Forest Stealth

description.value:
Requirements You are in a forest or jungle environment near an environmental feature that would allow you to Take Cover.

You are skilled at quickly hiding behind bits of underbrush or foliage. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} and then use that cover to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are in a forest or jungle environment near an environmental feature that would allow you to Take Cover.

You are skilled at quickly hiding behind bits of underbrush or foliage. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} and then use that cover to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}.
_desc_ko:
요건 은신할 수 있는 지형적 특징이 있는 숲이나 정글 환경에 위치해 있어야 합니다.

당신은 덤불이나 잎사귀 뒤에 재빨리 숨는 데 능숙합니다. 당신은 @link[actions.take-cover]한 후 그 엄폐물을 이용해 @link[actions.hide]합니다.

name: Living Weapon

description.value:
You've learned to use part of your form as a weapon. When you select this feat, you gain a claws unarmed attack that deals 1d4 slashing damage and has the agile and finesse traits; a horn, jaws, or tusk unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage and has the versatile S trait; or a tail unarmed attack that deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage and has the backswing trait. Each of these unarmed attacks is in the brawling weapon group.

Your features are mutable; you can select this feat at any level, and you can retrain into or out of this feat or change the type of attack you gain.

Special You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do, select a new attack from the options above.

_desc_en:
You've learned to use part of your form as a weapon. When you select this feat, you gain a claws unarmed attack that deals 1d4 slashing damage and has the agile and finesse traits; a horn, jaws, or tusk unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage and has the versatile S trait; or a tail unarmed attack that deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage and has the backswing trait. Each of these unarmed attacks is in the brawling weapon group.

Your features are mutable; you can select this feat at any level, and you can retrain into or out of this feat or change the type of attack you gain.

Special You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do, select a new attack from the options above.
_desc_ko:
당신은 자신의 신체 일부를 무기로 사용하는 법을 익혔습니다. 이 피트를 선택하면 다음 중 하나를 얻습니다: 1d4 베기 피해를 주고 기민한 및 기교 특성을 지닌 발톱 비무장 공격, 1d6 관통 피해를 주고 다목적 S 특성을 지닌 뿔, 턱, 또는 엄니 비무장 공격, 1d6 타격 피해를 주고 백스윙 특성을 지닌 꼬리 비무장 공격. 이 비무장 공격들은 모두 싸움 무기 그룹에 속합니다.

당신의 특징은 변형 가능합니다. 이 피트는 레벨에 상관없이 선택할 수 있으며, 재훈련을 통해 획득하거나 포기할 수 있고, 획득하는 공격 유형을 변경할 수 있습니다.

특수 이 피트를 여러 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 선택할 때마다 위 옵션에서 새로운 공격을 선택하십시오.

name: Mercy

description.value:
Your touch soothes the body or mind. You can cast lay on hands targeting a living creature using 2 actions instead of 1. If you do, you can attempt to counteract one condition of your choice affecting the target. When you select this feat, choose one of the following options, which determines the conditions you can choose:

  • Mercy of the Body @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened};

  • Mercy of Grace @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed};

  • Mercy of the Mind @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied}.

Special You can select this feat up to three times. Each time, choose a different type of mercy and add its options to those you can choose when you cast a 2-action lay on hands.

_desc_ko:
당신의 손길은 몸이나 마음을 달래줍니다. 당신은 1번 대신 2번의 행동을 사용해 살아있는 생물을 대상으로 안수치료를 시전할 수 있습니다. 그렇게 할 경우, 대상에게 영향을 미치는 상태 중 하나를 선택해 그 효과를 반격할 시도할 수 있습니다. 이 피트를 선택할 때 다음 옵션 중 하나를 선택하십시오. 이는 선택 가능한 상태 이상을 결정합니다:

  • 육체의 자비 @link[conditions.blinded], @link[conditions.dazzled], @link[conditions.deafened], @link[conditions.enfeebled], @link[conditions.sickened];

  • Mercy of Grace @link[conditions.clumsy], @link[conditions.grabbed], @link[conditions.paralyzed];

  • 마음의 자비 @link[conditions.fleeing], @link[conditions.frightened], @link[conditions.stupefied].

특별 이 피트를 최대 세 번까지 선택할 수 있습니다. 매번 다른 유형의 자비를 선택하고, 2-액션 안수치료를 시전할 때 선택할 수 있는 옵션에 해당 유형을 추가합니다.

name: I've Been Here Before

description.value:
You adapt quickly to new settings and terrains. When you make your daily preparations in a region you've never visited before (such as a city, geographical region, or small demiplane, but not in a dungeon, structure, or other location that focuses on encounter mode play), you spend part of that time introspectively digging into the memories of your past life to get a feel for the adventure that awaits.

Choose one of the following Exploration activities: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYtYKa1gDEl7y2N0]{Defend}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{Scout}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}. You perform that exploration activity at full speed rather than at half speed, and any skill check you attempt as a result of this Exploration activity is made at mythic proficiency.

These benefits end as soon as you enter a new region, as determined by the GM.

_desc_ko:
당신은 새로운 환경과 지형에 빠르게 적응합니다. 이전에 방문한 적 없는 지역에서(도시, 지리적 지역, 소형 반차원 등이지만, 던전, 구조물, 또는 조우 모드 플레이에 초점을 둔 다른 장소는 아님) 매일의 준비를 할 때, 당신은 그 시간의 일부를 내성적으로 전생의 기억을 파고드는 데 써서 앞에 놓인 모험에 대한 감을 잡습니다.

다음 탐험 활동 중 하나를 선택합니다: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{남몰래 이동}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYtYKa1gDEl7y2N0]{방어}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{조사}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{정찰}, 또는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{수색}. 당신은 그 탐험 활동을 절반 속도가 아닌 전속력으로 수행하며, 이 탐험 활동의 결과로 시도하는 모든 기술 판정은 신화 숙련도로 이루어집니다.

이 이점은 GM이 결정하는 대로, 당신이 새로운 지역에 들어서는 즉시 종료됩니다.

name: Gravel Guts

description.value: Stone never becomes queasy, so why should you? You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} condition. When you succeed at a Fortitude save to reduce your sickened value, you reduce it by 2 (or by 3 on a critical success).

_desc_ko: 돌은 절대 메스껍지 않으니, 당신도 그럴 필요 없지 않겠는가? @link[conditions.sickened] 상태에 대한 내성 굴림 시 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 병약 수치를 줄이기 위한 인내 내성 굴림에 성공하면, 해당 수치를 2 감소시킵니다(대성공 시 3 감소).

name: Elven Lore

description.value:
You've studied traditional elven arts, learning about arcane magic and the world around you. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Arcana and Nature. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Elf Lore.

_desc_en:
You've studied traditional elven arts, learning about arcane magic and the world around you. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Arcana and Nature. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Elf Lore.
_desc_ko:
전통적인 엘프의 예술을 연구하여 아케인 마법과 주변 세계에 대해 배웠습니다. 주문학 및 자연에 숙련된 숙련도 등급을 얻습니다. 만약 배경이나 직업 등으로 인해 해당 기술 중 하나에 자동으로 숙련이 된다면, 대신 선택한 기술 하나에 숙련이 됩니다.

또한 엘프 지식에 대한 @link[feats.additional-lore] 일반 피트를 얻습니다.

name: Kishin Rage

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Your eyes glow a deep red and your body courses with adrenaline as you obtain a fraction of the power of the kishin oni. You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} all creatures within a 10- foot radius; you don't take a penalty when you attempt to Demoralize a creature that doesn't understand your language.

You also gain the following abilities for 1 minute.

  • 40 temporary Hit Points.
  • A fly Speed equal to your Speed.
  • The effects of 6th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EE7Q5BHIrfWNCPtT]{Runic Body}, and your horns deal an additional @Damage[1d4[electricity]] damage.
  • Bloodsense as a precise sense with a range of 60 feet, allowing you to detect freshly spilled blood; this allows you to accurately detect creatures taking persistent bleed damage, creatures whose Hit Points are currently at half or less of their maximum, and freestanding puddles or droplets of recently spilled blood.

Kishin Rage lasts for 1 minute. Once it ends, you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3} as you recharge and recenter yourself.

  • Bloodsense as a precise sense with a range of 60 feet, allowing you to detect freshly spilled blood; this allows you to accurately detect creatures taking persistent bleed damage, creatures whose Hit Points are currently at half or less of their maximum, and freestanding puddles or droplets of recently spilled blood.

Kishin Rage lasts for 1 minute. Once it ends, you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3} as you recharge and recenter yourself.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

귀신 오니의 힘 일부를 얻으며, 당신의 눈은 짙은 붉은 빛을 띠고 몸에는 아드레날린이 솟구칩니다. 당신은 반경 10피트 내의 모든 생물에게 @link[actions.demoralize]를 시도합니다; 당신의 언어를 이해하지 못하는 생물에게 사기 저하를 시도할 때 페널티를 받지 않습니다.

또한 1분 동안 다음 능력을 얻습니다.

  • 40의 임시 HP.
  • 당신의 이동 속도와 동일한 비행 속도.
  • 6등급 @link[spells.runic-body] 효과와 함께, 뿔로 가하는 피해에 1d4 전기 추가 피해가 적용됩니다.
  • 60피트 범위 정밀 감각으로 작용하는 혈액 감지 능력. 이를 통해 갓 흘린 피를 감지할 수 있으며, 지속적인 출혈 피해를 입은 생물, 현재 HP가 최대치의 절반 이하인 생물, 그리고 최근에 흘린 피로 이루어진 독립된 웅덩이나 물방울을 정확히 식별할 수 있다.

귀신 분노는 1분간 지속됩니다. 효과가 끝나면 재충전과 정신 집중을 위해 @link[conditions.stunned]{3} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Martial Artist Dedication

description.value:
You have trained to use your fists as deadly weapons and can deliver devastatingly powerful blows with them. The damage die for your fist unarmed attacks becomes 1d6 instead of 1d4. You don't take the –2 circumstance penalty for making a lethal attack with your nonlethal unarmed attacks.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.N01RLMQPaSeoHEuL]{Martial Artist}

_desc_en:
You have trained to use your fists as deadly weapons and can deliver devastatingly powerful blows with them. The damage die for your fist unarmed attacks becomes 1d6 instead of 1d4. You don't take the –2 circumstance penalty for making a lethal attack with your nonlethal unarmed attacks.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.N01RLMQPaSeoHEuL]{Martial Artist}
_desc_ko: 당신은 주먹을 치명적인 무기로 사용하도록 훈련받았으며, 이를 통해 파괴적인 강도의 타격을 가할 수 있습니다. 주먹을 사용한 비무장 공격의 피해 주사위는 1d4 대신 1d6이 됩니다. 비살상 무장 공격으로 치명타를 시도할 때 -2 상황 페널티를 받지 않습니다.

name: Morph-Risen

description.value: You were once a shapeshifter or spellcaster using polymorph magic, but something went wrong, and you became trapped in the form of the creature you were imitating. This accident might have drained your power, or you might have retained some of your skills, but either way, your form resists further forced transformation. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against morph and polymorph effects, and if you roll a success on a saving throw against a hostile morph or polymorph effect, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en: You were once a shapeshifter or spellcaster using polymorph magic, but something went wrong, and you became trapped in the form of the creature you were imitating. This accident might have drained your power, or you might have retained some of your skills, but either way, your form resists further forced transformation. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against morph and polymorph effects, and if you roll a success on a saving throw against a hostile morph or polymorph effect, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko: 당신은 한때 변신술사나 다형 마법을 사용하는 마법사였으나, 어떤 사고로 인해 모방하던 생물의 형태에 갇히게 되었습니다. 이 사고로 인해 당신의 힘이 흡수되었을 수도 있고, 일부 능력을 유지했을 수도 있지만, 어느 쪽이든 당신의 형태는 기세적인 변형을 거부합니다. 변형 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻으며, 적대적인 변형 또는 다형 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴리면 대신 대성공을 얻습니다.

name: Covet Hoard

description.value:
You have a dragon's desire for treasure. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.C0Tcelg3BAPhML6J]{Hefty Hauler} skill feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites. You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Perception DC against attempts to [[/act steal]] from you and to any saving throw against an effect targeting an item you're holding or carrying.

At 11th level, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.4vu6P3cYoOOeUbLK]{Incredible Investiture} general feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites.

_desc_en:
You have a dragon's desire for treasure. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.C0Tcelg3BAPhML6J]{Hefty Hauler} skill feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites. You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Perception DC against attempts to [[/act steal]] from you and to any saving throw against an effect targeting an item you're holding or carrying.

At 11th level, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.4vu6P3cYoOOeUbLK]{Incredible Investiture} general feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites.
_desc_ko:
당신은 보물에 대한 용의 욕망을 지니고 있습니다. 당신은 전제조건을 충족하지 않더라도 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.C0Tcelg3BAPhML6J]{힘센 운반자} 기술 재주를 얻습니다. 당신은 또한 당신에게서 [[/act steal]]하려는 시도에 대한 지각 DC와 당신이 들고 있거나 지니고 있는 물품을 대상으로 하는 효과에 대한 모든 내성 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

11레벨에, 당신은 전제조건을 충족하지 않더라도 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.4vu6P3cYoOOeUbLK]{경이로운 착용} 일반 재주를 얻습니다.

name: Focus Ally

description.value:
Trigger An adjacent ally fails, but doesn't critically fail, a saving throw against an effect with the incapacitation trait.

You're so focused on your allies that you can help them to recenter when something would take them out of the fight. Your ally rerolls the failed saving throw. That ally must take the second result.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

_desc_en:
Trigger An adjacent ally fails, but doesn't critically fail, a saving throw against an effect with the incapacitation trait.

You're so focused on your allies that you can help them to recenter when something would take them out of the fight. Your ally rerolls the failed saving throw. That ally must take the second result.
_desc_ko:
발동 인접한 아군이 무력화 특성을 가진 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 실패하지만 대실패하지 않을 때.

동료들에게 포커스를 맞춰, 그들이 전투에서 이탈할 위기에 처했을 때 정신을 차리게 도울 수 있습니다. 동료는 실패한 내성 굴림을 재굴림합니다. 해당 동료는 두 번째 결과값을 적용받아야 합니다.

name: Mythic Heightening

description.value:
Frequency once per day

You overload your minor spells to give them greater effect. Spend a Mythic Point. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell, that spell is heightened to the highest spell rank that you can cast. Any spell attack roll is made with mythic proficiency, and the spell's DC is calculated with mythic proficiency. The spell slot used to cast the spell isn't changed.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

You overload your minor spells to give them greater effect. Spend a Mythic Point. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell, that spell is heightened to the highest spell rank that you can cast. Any spell attack roll is made with mythic proficiency, and the spell's DC is calculated with mythic proficiency. The spell slot used to cast the spell isn't changed.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

소형 주문을 과부하시켜 효과를 증폭시킵니다. 신화 포인트 1점을 소모합니다. 다음 행동 이 주문 시전일 경우, 해당 주문은 당신이 시전 가능한 최고 주문 랭크으로 강화됩니다. 모든 주문 명중 굴림은 신화 숙련도로 수행되며, 주문의 난이도(DC)도 신화 숙련도로 계산됩니다. 주문 시전에 사용된 주문 슬롯은 변경되지 않습니다.

name: Replenishing Hydration

description.value: You draw life from the water around you. If you submerge in water and rest for 10 minutes, you regain Hit Points equal to your @Damage[((floor(@actor.level/2))*(@actor.abilities.con.mod))[healing]]{Constitution modifier × half your level}.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Absalom, City of Lost Omens

_desc_en: You draw life from the water around you. If you submerge in water and rest for 10 minutes, you regain Hit Points equal to your @Damage[((floor(@actor.level/2))*(@actor.abilities.con.mod))[healing]]{Constitution modifier × half your level}.
_desc_ko: 주변 물에서 생명을 끌어모읍니다. 물속에 잠긴 상태로 10분간 휴식하면 건강 능력치 수정자 × 레벨의 절반만큼 HP를 회복합니다.

name: Red-Gold Mortality

description.value:
Usage imbued into a weapon ikon

By channeling your divinity into a creature along with a strike, you can disrupt their ability to recover. The imbued ikon gains the following ability.

Immanence When you successfully damage an enemy with the ikon, a marking appears around the wound, painted in the red of mortal blood and the gold of divine ichor. When the target would regain Hit Points, such as from a healing effect or an ability like fast healing or regeneration, it must attempt a @Check[will|against:exemplar] save against your class DC to determine the effects, and then the marking fades. The marking otherwise fades after 1 minute.

Success The creature regains the full number of Hit Points that would be healed.

Failure The creature regains only half the number of Hit Points as the contradictory energies swirl within it.

Critical Failure The creature doesn't regain any Hit Points.

_desc_en:
Usage imbued into a weapon ikon

By channeling your divinity into a creature along with a strike, you can disrupt their ability to recover. The imbued ikon gains the following ability.

Immanence When you successfully damage an enemy with the ikon, a marking appears around the wound, painted in the red of mortal blood and the gold of divine ichor. When the target would regain Hit Points, such as from a healing effect or an ability like fast healing or regeneration, it must attempt a @Check[will|against:exemplar] save against your class DC to determine the effects, and then the marking fades. The marking otherwise fades after 1 minute.

Success The creature regains the full number of Hit Points that would be healed.

Failure The creature regains only half the number of Hit Points as the contradictory energies swirl within it.

Critical Failure The creature doesn't regain any Hit Points.
_desc_ko:
사용법 무기 이콘에 주입

신성을 생물에게 주입하며 공격할 경우, 대상의 회복 능력을 방해할 수 있다. 주입된 이콘은 다음 능력을 획득한다.

내재성 이콘으로 적에게 피해를 성공적으로 입힐 때, 상처 주변에 필멸자의 붉은 피와 신성한 이크로의 황금빛으로 그려진 표식이 나타난다. 대상은 치유 효과나 빠른 치유, 재생 같은 능력으로 HP를 회복하려 할 때, 효과 적용 여부를 결정하기 위해 당신의 직업 난이도(DC)에 대한 의지 저항 검사를 시도해야 하며, 성공 시 표식이 사라집니다. 그렇지 않으면 표식은 1분 후 사라집니다.

성공 생물은 치유될 예정이었던 HP를 모두 회복합니다.

실패 상반된 에너지가 생물체 내부에서 소용돌이치며, 생물체는 회복될 수 있는 HP의 절반만 회복한다.

대실패 생물은 HP를 전혀 회복하지 못한다.

name: My Kingdom, My Blood

description.value:
The health of the ruler is the health of the kingdom, and the health of the kingdom is that of its ruler, each bound to the other inextricably. Stride. You can Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type. You then plant your fist or weapon into the ground at your feet, creating a @Template[type:emanation|distance:60] in an aura around you that lasts for 1 minute. Whenever an ally within this aura takes damage, you can use your reaction to take half the damage in their stead while they take the remainder. When you take damage through this link, you don't apply any resistances, weaknesses, or other abilities you have to that damage; you simply take that amount of damage. Whenever you take damage while this effect is active, an ally within the aura can use their reaction to take half the damage for you in the same manner.

The effect ends immediately if you're reduced to 0 Hit Points.

_desc_en:
The health of the ruler is the health of the kingdom, and the health of the kingdom is that of its ruler, each bound to the other inextricably. Stride. You can Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type. You then plant your fist or weapon into the ground at your feet, creating a @Template[type:emanation|distance:60] in an aura around you that lasts for 1 minute. Whenever an ally within this aura takes damage, you can use your reaction to take half the damage in their stead while they take the remainder. When you take damage through this link, you don't apply any resistances, weaknesses, or other abilities you have to that damage; you simply take that amount of damage. Whenever you take damage while this effect is active, an ally within the aura can use their reaction to take half the damage for you in the same manner.

The effect ends immediately if you're reduced to 0 Hit Points.
_desc_ko:
통치자의 건강은 왕국의 건강이며, 왕국의 건강은 통치자의 건강이다. 둘은 뗄 수 없이 서로 연결되어 있다. 이동. 해당 이동 유형을 보유한 경우, 이동 대신 땅파기, 등반, 비행, 수영을 선택할 수 있다. 이때 발밑 땅에 주먹이나 무기를 박아 1분간 지속되는 60피트 발산 오라를 생성한다. 이 오라 내 아군이 피해를 입을 때마다, 반응으로 그 피해의 절반을 대신 받아들이고 아군은 나머지 피해를 입는다. 이 연결을 통해 피해를 입을 때, 당신은 해당 피해에 대한 저항력, 약점 또는 기타 능력을 적용하지 않습니다. 단순히 그 양만큼의 피해를 입습니다. 이 효과가 활성화된 동안 당신이 피해를 입을 때마다, 오라 내의 아군은 자신의 반응을 사용해 동일한 방식으로 당신을 대신해 피해의 절반을 받을 수 있습니다.

당신의 HP가 0이 되면 이 효과는 즉시 종료됩니다.

name: Perfect Shot

description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a loaded ranged weapon with reload 1 or more, and you have not reloaded your weapon since your last turn.

After watching the motions of combat with incredible intensity and precision, you fire at your prey at the perfect moment to deliver maximum pain. Make a ranged Strike with the required weapon against your hunted prey. If you hit, the Strike deals maximum damage. After the Strike, your turn ends.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are wielding a loaded ranged weapon with reload 1 or more, and you have not reloaded your weapon since your last turn.

After watching the motions of combat with incredible intensity and precision, you fire at your prey at the perfect moment to deliver maximum pain. Make a ranged Strike with the required weapon against your hunted prey. If you hit, the Strike deals maximum damage. After the Strike, your turn ends.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 재장전 1 이상인 장전된 원거리 무기를 휘두르고 있으며, 지난 턴 이후로 무기를 재장전하지 않았습니다.

놀라운 집중력과 정밀함으로 전투의 움직임을 관찰한 후, 최대의 고통을 안길 완벽한 순간에 사냥감을 향해 발사합니다. 사냥감에게 필요한 무기로 원거리 공격을 시도하세요. 명중 시 공격은 최대 피해를 입힙니다. 공격 후 당신의 턴이 종료됩니다.

name: Blood Rising

description.value:
Trigger A creature targets you with a spell of the same tradition as your bloodline.

The magic in your blood surges in response to your foe's spell. You generate a blood magic effect you know, even if you are already under the effects of blood magic. The target must be either you or the creature that triggered Blood Rising. If the blood magic effect grants you a bonus to AC or the appropriate saving throw, that bonus applies against the triggering spell. If the effect has a duration, it instead lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

Special This feat has the trait corresponding to the tradition of your bloodline.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature targets you with a spell of the same tradition as your bloodline.

The magic in your blood surges in response to your foe's spell. You generate a blood magic effect you know, even if you are already under the effects of blood magic. The target must be either you or the creature that triggered Blood Rising. If the blood magic effect grants you a bonus to AC or the appropriate saving throw, that bonus applies against the triggering spell. If the effect has a duration, it instead lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

Special This feat has the trait corresponding to the tradition of your bloodline.
_desc_ko:
발동 적 생물이 당신의 혈통과 동일한 전통의 주문으로 당신을 표적으로 삼을 때.

적의 주문에 반응하여 네 피 속의 마법이 솟구친다. 이미 혈통 마법 효과를 받고 있더라도, 네가 알고 있는 혈통 마법 효과를 생성한다. 대상은 반드시 자신이나, 혈기 상승을 발동시킨 생물 중 하나여야 한다. 해당 혈통 마법 효과가 네 AC나 해당 내성 굴림에 보너스를 부여한다면, 그 보너스는 발동시킨 주문에 대해 적용된다. 효과에 지속 시간이 있다면, 대신 당신의 다음 턴 시작까지 지속됩니다.

특수 이 피트는 당신의 혈통 전통에 해당하는 특성을 지닙니다.

name: Grim Insight

description.value: Others' attempts to scare you often grant you insights about your would-be bullies that you can then exploit. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a fear effect, you get a critical success instead, and the source of the fear effect is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you until the end of your next turn.

_desc_en: Others' attempts to scare you often grant you insights about your would-be bullies that you can then exploit. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a fear effect, you get a critical success instead, and the source of the fear effect is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you until the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko: 다른 이들이 당신을 위협하려고 시도할 때, 종종 그 위협의 근원에 대한 통찰력을 얻게 되며 이를 활용할 수 있습니다. 공포 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에서 성공을 굴리면, 대신 대성공을 얻으며 공포 효과의 원천은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 당신에게 @link[conditions.off-guard]가 된다.

name: Charred Remains

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Your next fire spell leaves embers in its wake. If your next action is to Cast a Spell with an area and the fire trait, for 1 minute, your spell's area becomes difficult terrain as well as hazardous terrain, dealing @Damage[1[fire]] damage for each square a creature moves through.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Your next fire spell leaves embers in its wake. If your next action is to Cast a Spell with an area and the fire trait, for 1 minute, your spell's area becomes difficult terrain as well as hazardous terrain, dealing @Damage[1[fire]] damage for each square a creature moves through.
_desc_ko:
발동 빈도 하루에 한 번

다음에 사용하는 화염 마법은 불씨를 남깁니다. 다음 행동으로 화염 속성을 가진 영역 마법을 시전할 경우, 1분 동안 해당 마법의 영역이 어려운 지형이자 위험 지형이 되어, 생물이 통과하는 각 칸마다 1 화염의 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Lucky Keepsake

description.value: You have a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.nza9skYTNtJe2Wd3]{Keepsake} that grants you luck. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against spells and magical effects at all times, not just when you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.fYVFBnv9aVHv1UNg]{Leshy Superstition}. If you lose the keepsake, you lose the bonus until you designate a new keepsake, typically over the course of a week.

_desc_en: You have a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.nza9skYTNtJe2Wd3]{Keepsake} that grants you luck. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against spells and magical effects at all times, not just when you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.fYVFBnv9aVHv1UNg]{Leshy Superstition}. If you lose the keepsake, you lose the bonus until you designate a new keepsake, typically over the course of a week.
_desc_ko: 당신은 행운을 부여하는 @link[equipment.lucky-keepsake]을 소지하고 있습니다. @link[feats.leshy-superstition]을 사용할 때뿐만 아니라 항상 주문과 마법 효과에 대한 내성에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 기념품을 잃으면, 일반적으로 일주일 정도 걸려 새로운 기념품을 지정할 때까지 보너스를 잃게 됩니다.

name: Vicious Debilitations

description.value:
The debilitations you dish out seriously impair your foes. Add the following debilitations to the list you can choose from when you use Debilitating Strike.

  • Debilitation The target gains weakness 5 to your choice of bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.Rgt9hH3W1oh9dvku]{Effect: Vicious Debilitations}
  • Debilitation The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}.

_desc_en:
The debilitations you dish out seriously impair your foes. Add the following debilitations to the list you can choose from when you use Debilitating Strike.

  • Debilitation The target gains weakness 5 to your choice of bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.Rgt9hH3W1oh9dvku]{Effect: Vicious Debilitations}
  • Debilitation The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}.
_desc_ko:
당신이 가하는 쇠약 상태는 적을 심각하게 무력화시킵니다. 쇠약 타격을 사용할 때 선택할 수 있는 쇠약 상태 목록에 다음을 추가하십시오.

  • 쇠약 대상은 타격, 관통, 베기 피해 중 선택한 피해 유형에 대해 5의 쇠약 상태를 얻습니다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.Rgt9hH3W1oh9dvku]{효과: 악의적인 쇠약}
  • 쇠약 대상은 @link[conditions.clumsy]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Advanced Element Control

description.value:
You gain one kineticist feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your kineticist level is equal to half your level. Your options include impulse feats for your kinetic element, as normal for a kineticist.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another kineticist feat.

_desc_en:
You gain one kineticist feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your kineticist level is equal to half your level. Your options include impulse feats for your kinetic element, as normal for a kineticist.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another kineticist feat.
_desc_ko:
당신은 키네티스트 피트 하나를 획득합니다. 해당 피트의 전제 조건을 충족할 때, 당신의 키네티스트 레벨은 당신의 레벨 절반과 동일합니다. 선택 가능한 피트에는 운동술사의 기본 규칙에 따라 당신의 운동 원소에 대한 임펄스 피트가 포함됩니다.

특수 이 재주를 여러 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 선택할 때마다 추가로 키네티스트 피트를 얻습니다.

name: Pact of Infernal Prowess

description.value:
You've sworn a pact with devils, granting you success in life in exchange for your soul in the afterlife. Once per hour, when you critically fail a check, you can reroll the check as a free action; this is a fortune effect. Additionally, you can choose to automatically succeed at checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income} for tasks below your level, without rolling.

However, when you die, your soul is consigned to Hell. You can't be returned to life except by powerful magic such as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} ritual, and even then, the devils responsible for the contract can track your every move for 1 year. The devils gain the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.CeSh8QcVnqP5OlLj]{Pinpoint} spell. They can also use 10th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r784cIz17eWujtQj]{Scrying} on you at will, and you automatically critically fail your saving throw.

Special You can't retrain out of a Pact of Infernal Prowess without journeying to Hell and destroying the devil's written contract spelling out the terms of your pact.

_desc_en:
You've sworn a pact with devils, granting you success in life in exchange for your soul in the afterlife. Once per hour, when you critically fail a check, you can reroll the check as a free action; this is a fortune effect. Additionally, you can choose to automatically succeed at checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income} for tasks below your level, without rolling.

However, when you die, your soul is consigned to Hell. You can't be returned to life except by powerful magic such as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} ritual, and even then, the devils responsible for the contract can track your every move for 1 year. The devils gain the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.CeSh8QcVnqP5OlLj]{Pinpoint} spell. They can also use 10th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r784cIz17eWujtQj]{Scrying} on you at will, and you automatically critically fail your saving throw.

Special You can't retrain out of a Pact of Infernal Prowess without journeying to Hell and destroying the devil's written contract spelling out the terms of your pact.
_desc_ko:
당신은 데빌과 계약을 맺어, 사후에 영혼을 대가로 현세에서의 성공을 얻었다. 시간당 한 번, 판정에서 대실패를 했을 때, 무료 행동으로 해당 판정을 재굴릴 수 있다. 이는 행운 효과이다. 추가로, 자신의 레벨보다 낮은 작업에 대한 @link[actions.earn-income] 판정에서는 주사위 굴림 없이 자동 성공을 선택할 수 있다. 그러나 죽을 경우 영혼은 지옥으로 보내진다. @link[spells.miracle]과 같은 강력한 마법으로만 부활할 수 있으며, 그 경우에도 계약을 맺은 데빌들이 1년간 당신의 모든 행동을 추적할 수 있습니다. 데빌들은 @link[spells.pinpoint] 주문의 효과를 얻습니다. 또한 마음대로 (10th)랭크 @link[spells.scrying]를 당신에게 사용할 수 있으며, 당신은 내성 굴림에서 자동으로 대실패를 합니다.

특수 지옥의 숙련 계약을 해제하려면 지옥으로 가서 계약 조건이 명시된 데빌의 서면 계약서를 파괴해야 합니다.

name: Dismounting Strike

description.value:
Requirements You are mounted on your horse, and your last action was to Command an Animal to order your horse to Stride at least once.

You leap from your horse, using the momentum of its movement to deal a devastating blow with your melee weapon. You use the Mount action to dismount your horse but can move to any space within 10 feet of your mount, as long as your horse moved at least 15 feet. You then make a melee Strike. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. If this Strike hits, you deal an extra die of weapon damage. If you're at least 14th level, increase this to two extra dice.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are mounted on your horse, and your last action was to Command an Animal to order your horse to Stride at least once.

You leap from your horse, using the momentum of its movement to deal a devastating blow with your melee weapon. You use the Mount action to dismount your horse but can move to any space within 10 feet of your mount, as long as your horse moved at least 15 feet. You then make a melee Strike. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. If this Strike hits, you deal an extra die of weapon damage. If you're at least 14th level, increase this to two extra dice.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 당신은 말에 올라타 있으며, 당신의 마지막 행동은 말이 최소 한 번 보폭을 취하도록 동물 명령을 내리는 것이었습니다.

당신은 말에서 뛰어내려, 말의 이동 기세를 이용해 근접 무기로 파괴적인 일격을 가합니다. 당신은 탑승 행동을 사용해 말에서 내리지만, 말이 최소 15피트를 이동한 한, 당신의 탈것에서 10피트 이내의 어떤 공간으로든 이동할 수 있습니다. 그런 다음 근접 타격을 합니다. 이것은 다중공격 페널티를 계산할 때 두 번의 공격으로 칩니다. 이 타격이 명중하면, 당신은 무기 피해 주사위 하나를 추가로 줍니다. 당신이 최소 14레벨이라면, 이를 추가 주사위 두 개로 늘립니다.

name: Cat Nap

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You can regain your energy quickly with a brief nap. You sleep for 10 minutes, after which you gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.l3S9i2UWGhSO58YX]{Effect: Cat Nap}

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

You can regain your energy quickly with a brief nap. You sleep for 10 minutes, after which you gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.l3S9i2UWGhSO58YX]{Effect: Cat Nap}
_desc_ko:
빈도 시간당 한 번

짧은 낮잠으로 빠르게 에너지를 회복할 수 있습니다. 10분간 잠을 자고 나면, 1시간 동안 지속되는 레벨에 해당하는 임시 HP를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.l3S9i2UWGhSO58YX]{효과: 고양이 낮잠}

name: Spell Relay

description.value:
Trigger An ally @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Casts a Spell} and you are within that spell's range.

You open the power in your blood to your ally's spellcasting, using your magic to boost their range. Your ally can use you as the point of origin for their spell, calculating range and cover from your space instead of their own.

_desc_en:
Trigger An ally @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Casts a Spell} and you are within that spell's range.

You open the power in your blood to your ally's spellcasting, using your magic to boost their range. Your ally can use you as the point of origin for their spell, calculating range and cover from your space instead of their own.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 아군이 @link[actions.cast-a-spell]하고, 당신이 그 주문 범위 내에 있을 때.

당신은 피 속에 흐르는 힘을 아군의 주문 시전에 열어젖혀, 자신의 마법으로 아군의 사거리를 증폭시킵니다. 아군은 자신의 위치 대신 당신의 위치를 기준으로 사거리와 가림을 계산하여 당신을 주문 발사점으로 삼을 수 있습니다.

name: Feathered Cloak

description.value: To blend in with the grounded and wingless, you fold your wings just so on your back, creating the illusion of a feathered cloak. You receive a +2 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} a version of yourself who is not a strix. Additionally, your folded wings help you obscure objects on your person, providing a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.qVNVSmsgpKFGk9hV]{Conceal an Object}.

_desc_en: To blend in with the grounded and wingless, you fold your wings just so on your back, creating the illusion of a feathered cloak. You receive a +2 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} a version of yourself who is not a strix. Additionally, your folded wings help you obscure objects on your person, providing a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.qVNVSmsgpKFGk9hV]{Conceal an Object}.
_desc_ko: 땅에 발을 디딘 날개 없는 존재들과 어울리기 위해, 당신은 등 뒤로 날개를 접어 깃털 망토 같은 환상을 만들어 낸다. @link[actions.impersonate] 스트릭스가 아닌 자신의 모습을 연기하는 기만 판정 시 +2 상황 보너스를 받습니다. 또한 접힌 날개는 몸에 지닌 물건을 가리는 데 도움이 되어 @link[actions.conceal-an-object] 은신 판정 시 +2 상황 보너스를 제공합니다.

name: Wooden Palisade

description.value:
Planks of wood, embellished with carvings, spring forth to form a wall within 120 feet. The palisade is up to 30 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 inch thick. It must form in a straight line in an unbroken open space that doesn't pass through any creatures or objects, or the impulse fails. When you create the wall, you can choose to create ledges on one side of the wall, 4 feet from the top, with ladders reaching to them from the bottom of the wall.

Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of the wall has AC 10, Hardness 10, and 20 Hit Points, and is immune to critical hits and precision damage. The wall lasts until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it up to 1 minute.

Level (+2) The maximum length of the wall increases by 10 feet, and the HP of each section increase by 10.

_desc_en:
Planks of wood, embellished with carvings, spring forth to form a wall within 120 feet. The palisade is up to 30 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 inch thick. It must form in a straight line in an unbroken open space that doesn't pass through any creatures or objects, or the impulse fails. When you create the wall, you can choose to create ledges on one side of the wall, 4 feet from the top, with ladders reaching to them from the bottom of the wall.

Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of the wall has AC 10, Hardness 10, and 20 Hit Points, and is immune to critical hits and precision damage. The wall lasts until the end of your next turn, but you can Sustain it up to 1 minute.

Level (+2) The maximum length of the wall increases by 10 feet, and the HP of each section increase by 10.
_desc_ko:
조각으로 장식된 나무 판자가 120피트 이내에 벽을 형성하며 솟아오릅니다. 이 울타리는 최대 길이 30피트, 높이 20피트, 두께 1인치입니다. 벽은 생물이나 물체를 통과하지 않는 틈 없는 열린 공간에서 직선으로 형성되어야 하며, 그렇지 않으면 임펄스 실패한다. 벽을 생성할 때, 벽 상단에서 4피트 떨어진 한쪽 면에 벽 하단에서 연결되는 사다리가 있는 발판을 만들 수 있다.

벽의 각 10피트×10피트 구역은 AC 10, 경도 10, HP 20을 가지며 치명타와 정밀 피해에 면역이다. 벽은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 지속되나, 최대 1분까지 유지할 수 있다.

레벨 (+2) 벽의 최대 길이가 10피트 증가하고, 각 구간의 HP가 10 증가합니다.

name: Journey of the Sky Chariot

description.value:
Usage imbued into a body ikon or worn ikon

Small wings, flaming wheels, or another signifier of flight sprout from your ikon as it gains the power to lift you from the ground. Your ikon gains the following effects.

Immanence Your ikon keeps you hovering even without conscious effort. You can remain in the air at the end of this turn, even if you didn't use a Fly action.

Transcendence—@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MrTULCUsE9naPxXg]{Race the Skies} 1 (concentrate, transcendence)

@Embed[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MrTULCUsE9naPxXg inline]

_desc_en:
Usage imbued into a body ikon or worn ikon

Small wings, flaming wheels, or another signifier of flight sprout from your ikon as it gains the power to lift you from the ground. Your ikon gains the following effects.

Immanence Your ikon keeps you hovering even without conscious effort. You can remain in the air at the end of this turn, even if you didn't use a Fly action.

Transcendence—@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MrTULCUsE9naPxXg]{Race the Skies} 1 (concentrate, transcendence)

_desc_ko:
사용법 몸 이콘에 주입하거나 착용 이콘으로 사용

작은 날개, 불타는 바퀴, 또는 비행의 상징이 이콘에서 솟아나며 땅에서 당신을 들어 올리는 힘을 얻습니다. 이콘은 다음과 같은 효과를 얻습니다.

내재성 의식적인 노력 없이도 이콘이 공중에 떠 있게 합니다. 비행 행동을 사용하지 않았더라도 이번 턴 종료 시 공중에 머룰 수 있습니다.

초월-@link[actions.race-the-skies] 1 (집중, 초월)

@link[actions.race-the-skies]

name: Haphazard Repair

description.value: You quickly fix your innovation, at the cost of its stability. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.bT3skovyLUtP22ME]{Repair} your innovation almost immediately. You don't have to place the innovation on a flat surface, but you do need to be adjacent to it (including holding or wearing it), as well as having a repair kit as normal.

_desc_en: You quickly fix your innovation, at the cost of its stability. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.bT3skovyLUtP22ME]{Repair} your innovation almost immediately. You don't have to place the innovation on a flat surface, but you do need to be adjacent to it (including holding or wearing it), as well as having a repair kit as normal.
_desc_ko: 당신은 혁신품의 안정성을 희생하는 대가로 신속히 수리합니다. 혁신품을 거의 즉시 @link[actions.repair]합니다. 혁신을 평평한 표면에 놓을 필요는 없지만, 평소처럼 수리 키트를 가지고 있을 뿐만 아니라 혁신과 인접해 있어야 합니다(들거나 착용하는 것도 포함).

name: Tunnel Wall

description.value:
Requirements You are in Tenacious Stance.

Using your shield, you guard against the movement of foes as surely as if you were a wall of stone. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xjGwis0uaC2305pm]{Raise a Shield} and become anchored for 1 round. While anchored, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to the DC to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} your space.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are in Tenacious Stance.

Using your shield, you guard against the movement of foes as surely as if you were a wall of stone. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xjGwis0uaC2305pm]{Raise a Shield} and become anchored for 1 round. While anchored, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to the DC to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} your space.
_desc_ko:
요구 사항 당신은 끈질긴 자세를 취하고 있어야 합니다.

방패를 사용해 적의 움직임을 마치 돌벽처럼 확실히 막아냅니다. 당신은 @link[actions.raise-a-shield]하고 1라운드 동안 고정됩니다. 고정 상태에서는 당신의 공간을 @link[actions.tumble-through]하는 데 필요한 난이도(DC)에 +4 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Tangle-Tongue's Wit

description.value: Your talent for language is a blessing from the yaksha makers of old. You learn two new languages, chosen from languages you have access to. You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your saving throws against linguistic effects.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en: Your talent for language is a blessing from the yaksha makers of old. You learn two new languages, chosen from languages you have access to. You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your saving throws against linguistic effects.
_desc_ko: 언어에 대한 당신의 재능은 옛 야크샤 창조자들의 축복입니다. 접근 가능한 언어 중에서 두 가지 새로운 언어를 배웁니다. 또한 언어적 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Supreme Spellstrike

description.value: You've made it almost effortless to combine spells and attacks. You're permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}. You can use your extra action only to Strike or to recharge @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QDW9H8XLIjuW2fE4]{Spellstrike}.

_desc_en: You've made it almost effortless to combine spells and attacks. You're permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}. You can use your extra action only to Strike or to recharge @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QDW9H8XLIjuW2fE4]{Spellstrike}.
_desc_ko: 주문과 공격을 결합하는 것이 거의 수월해졌습니다. 당신은 영구적으로 @link[conditions.quickened] 상태입니다. 추가 행동은 공격하거나 @link[actions.spellstrike]를 재충전하는 데만 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Infectious Emotions

description.value: When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2424g94rpoiN1IPh]{Catharsis}, one ally within 30 feet gains the catharsis activation benefits in addition to you. If these benefits require an emotional focus, they use your emotional focus as they're experiencing an empathic imprint of your emotions. Depending on the activation benefit, it might be impossible to grant it to an ally; for instance, pride could only have an effect for an ally if both you and the ally critically failed the same saving throw against the same effect.

_desc_en: When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2424g94rpoiN1IPh]{Catharsis}, one ally within 30 feet gains the catharsis activation benefits in addition to you. If these benefits require an emotional focus, they use your emotional focus as they're experiencing an empathic imprint of your emotions. Depending on the activation benefit, it might be impossible to grant it to an ally; for instance, pride could only have an effect for an ally if both you and the ally critically failed the same saving throw against the same effect.
_desc_ko: 당신이 @link[actions.catharsis]를 사용할 때, 30피트 내의 한 동맹도 당신과 함께 카타르시스 발동 효과를 얻습니다. 이 효과에 감정적 집중이 필요한 경우, 그들은 당신의 감정에 대한 공감적 인상을 경험하며 당신의 감정적 집중을 사용합니다. 활성화 혜택에 따라 아군에게 부여하는 것이 불가능할 수 있습니다. 예를 들어, 자부심은 당신과 아군이 동일한 효과에 대해 동일한 내성 굴림에서 대실패했을 때만 아군에게 효과가 있을 수 있습니다.

name: Selfless Parry

description.value: You protect those near to you with a flash of steel and a stroke of good luck. When you're benefiting from Dueling Parry, allies adjacent to you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC. If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.mf2cdCRV8uowOMOm]{Dueling Riposte}, you can use it when an enemy within your reach critically fails a Strike against an ally adjacent to you, not just against yourself.

_desc_en: You protect those near to you with a flash of steel and a stroke of good luck. When you're benefiting from Dueling Parry, allies adjacent to you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC. If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.mf2cdCRV8uowOMOm]{Dueling Riposte}, you can use it when an enemy within your reach critically fails a Strike against an ally adjacent to you, not just against yourself.
_desc_ko: 당신은 번뜩이는 검과 행운의 일격으로 주변 이들을 보호합니다. 당신이 결투 패리 효과를 받고 있을 때, 인접한 아군들은 AC에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 만약 당신이 @link[feats.dueling-riposte]을 가지고 있다면, 적의 공격이 당신에게만 아니라 인접한 아군을 대상으로 대실패했을 때도 이를 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Sleep of the Reborn

description.value: Philosophers compare the cycle of life, death, and rebirth to sleeping, dreaming, and waking. You take it to another level by reliving previous lives in dreams, always waking invigorated and thankful for a new chance at life. Whenever you rest for 8 hours, you gain the effects of a long-term rest. If you're an ancestry that neither sleeps nor dreams, you still receive this benefit by entering a reflective, meditative state during rest.

publication.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

_desc_en: Philosophers compare the cycle of life, death, and rebirth to sleeping, dreaming, and waking. You take it to another level by reliving previous lives in dreams, always waking invigorated and thankful for a new chance at life. Whenever you rest for 8 hours, you gain the effects of a long-term rest. If you're an ancestry that neither sleeps nor dreams, you still receive this benefit by entering a reflective, meditative state during rest.
_desc_ko: 철학자들은 삶과 죽음, 그리고 재생의 순환을 잠들고, 꿈꾸고, 깨어나는 과정에 비유한다. 당신은 꿈속에서 과거의 삶을 재경험하며 이를 한 단계 더 끌어올립니다. 항상 활력을 되찾은 채 깨어나 새로운 삶의 기회를 감사히 여깁니다. 8시간 동안 휴식할 때마다 장기 휴식의 효과를 얻습니다. 잠도 꿈도 꾸지 않는 조상이라면, 휴식 중 명상적인 상태에 들어감으로써 이 혜택을 여전히 받습니다.

name: Tandem Onslaught

description.value: You have trained your body and mind to work in tandem, and you can combine your combat and spellcasting prowess to better support yourself in battle. The first time each round that you successfully hit and deal damage to an enemy creature with a Strike using a weapon or unarmed attack, you can automatically Sustain a single battle aura that you currently have active, applying any additional effects that come with Sustaining the spell.

_desc_en: You have trained your body and mind to work in tandem, and you can combine your combat and spellcasting prowess to better support yourself in battle. The first time each round that you successfully hit and deal damage to an enemy creature with a Strike using a weapon or unarmed attack, you can automatically Sustain a single battle aura that you currently have active, applying any additional effects that come with Sustaining the spell.
_desc_ko: 당신은 몸과 마음을 조화롭게 훈련시켜 전투와 주문 시전 능력을 결합함으로써 전투에서 자신을 더 효과적으로 지원할 수 있습니다. 매 라운드마다 무기나 비무장 공격으로 적 생물을 타격해 피해를 입히는 첫 번째 공격에 성공할 때마다, 현재 활성화된 전투 오라 중 하나를 자동으로 지속시킬 수 있으며, 해당 주문을 지속시킬 때 발생하는 추가 효과도 적용됩니다.

name: Preparation

description.value: You survey the battlefield, calculating the possibilities. You gain one additional reaction, which you can use before the beginning of your next turn for any rogue reaction.

_desc_en: You survey the battlefield, calculating the possibilities. You gain one additional reaction, which you can use before the beginning of your next turn for any rogue reaction.
_desc_ko: 전장을 살피며 가능성을 계산합니다. 추가 반응을 하나 얻으며, 다음 턴 시작 전에 로그의 반응으로 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Temperature Adjustment

description.value:
Access Hwanggot origin

You learn Hwan temperature classifications for the elements—wood and water are cold elements, while fire, earth, and metal are hot elements. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.NMbOfl885pn0Yzu9]{Prepare Elemental Medicine}, you can alter the environmental effects on the recipient's body. If you created hot elemental medicine, the recipient ignores the effects of severe cold while the medicine lasts. If you created cold elemental medicine, the recipient ignores the effects of severe heat while the medicine lasts.

value.value: master in Crafting, Herbalism Lore, or Medicine

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

_desc_en:
Access Hwanggot origin

You learn Hwan temperature classifications for the elements—wood and water are cold elements, while fire, earth, and metal are hot elements. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.NMbOfl885pn0Yzu9]{Prepare Elemental Medicine}, you can alter the environmental effects on the recipient's body. If you created hot elemental medicine, the recipient ignores the effects of severe cold while the medicine lasts. If you created cold elemental medicine, the recipient ignores the effects of severe heat while the medicine lasts.
_desc_ko:
접근 환곡 기원

당신은 원소의 환온 분류를 배운다-목과 수는 냉원소, 화·토·금은 열원소다. 당신이 @link[feats.prepare-elemental-medicine] 시, 수혜자 몸에 미치는 환경 효과를 변경할 수 있다. 열원소 의약품을 만들었다면, 의약품이 지속되는 동안 수혜자는 극한 추위의 영향을 무시한다. 차가운 원소 의약품을 만들었다면, 의약품이 지속되는 동안 수혜자는 극심한 더위의 영향을 무시합니다.

name: Surgical Shock

description.value:
With a few well-placed jabs with your fist or weapon, you render your opponent disoriented or ungainly. Attempt a @Check[medicine|against:fortitude] check against the Fortitude DC of a target within your reach. The result of your check determines the severity of the condition you inflict.

Critical Success The target is either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 3} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3} until the end of your next turn. The target is then immune to Surgical Shock for 1 hour.

Success As critical success, but the target is either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}.

Failure The target is minorly inconvenienced. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the next attack action you attempt against it before the end of your turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.tMsVpICbBU3kL1lp]{Effect: Surgical Shock (Failure)}

Critical Failure The target is unaffected and you overextend yourself, triggering reactions as if you had used a manipulate action.

_desc_en:
With a few well-placed jabs with your fist or weapon, you render your opponent disoriented or ungainly. Attempt a @Check[medicine|against:fortitude] check against the Fortitude DC of a target within your reach. The result of your check determines the severity of the condition you inflict.

Critical Success The target is either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 3} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3} until the end of your next turn. The target is then immune to Surgical Shock for 1 hour.

Success As critical success, but the target is either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}.

Failure The target is minorly inconvenienced. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the next attack action you attempt against it before the end of your turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.tMsVpICbBU3kL1lp]{Effect: Surgical Shock (Failure)}

Critical Failure The target is unaffected and you overextend yourself, triggering reactions as if you had used a manipulate action.
_desc_ko:
주먹이나 무기로 적절히 배치된 몇 차례의 찌르기로 상대를 혼란스럽게 하거나 비틀거리게 합니다. 손이 닿는 범위 내의 대상에 대해 의학 인내 DC에 대한 판정을 시도하십시오. 판정 결과에 따라 가하는 상태 이상이 결정됩니다.

대성공 대상은 다음 차례가 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.clumsy]{3} 또는 @link[conditions.stupefied]{3} 상태가 됩니다. 이후 1시간 동안 외과적 쇼크에 면역이 됩니다.

성공 대성공과 동일하나, 대상은 @link[conditions.clumsy]{2} 또는 @link[conditions.stupefied]{2} 상태가 된다.

실패 대상이 사소한 불편을 겪습니다. 당신의 턴이 끝나기 전에 대상에게 시도하는 다음 공격 행동에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.tMsVpICbBU3kL1lp]{효과: 외과적 쇼크 (실패)}

대실패 대상은 영향을 받지 않으며, 당신은 무리하게 행동하여 조작 행동을 사용한 것처럼 반응을 유발합니다.

name: Ruin Resistance

description.value: At 5th level and every 3 levels thereafter, your kingdom becomes more resistant to Ruin. Choose one of the four Ruin categories and increase its threshold by 2. When you do so, reset that Ruin's penalty to 0. See page 533 for more information about Ruin.

_desc_en: At 5th level and every 3 levels thereafter, your kingdom becomes more resistant to Ruin. Choose one of the four Ruin categories and increase its threshold by 2. When you do so, reset that Ruin's penalty to 0. See page 533 for more information about Ruin.
_desc_ko: 5레벨과 그 이후 3레벨마다, 당신의 왕국은 파멸에 더욱 저항력을 갖게 됩니다. 네 가지 파멸 범주 중 하나를 선택해 그 한계치를 2 증가시킵니다. 그렇게 할 때, 해당 파멸의 페널티를 0으로 초기화합니다. 파멸에 대한 자세한 내용은 533쪽을 참조하십시오.

name: Defensive Stance

description.value:
Requirement Defensive Tactics

Your army hunkers down behind its shields, presents pole arms in a wall of blades, or moves into position to protect a target allied army that is outflanked. Attempt a @Check[maneuver|defense:maneuver] check against an enemy army.

Critical Success The target allied army is no longer outflanked by any army.

Success The target allied army is no longer outflanked by the target army.

Critical Failure Your defensive stance fails, and your army is now outflanked by the target enemy army.

_desc_en:
Requirement Defensive Tactics

Your army hunkers down behind its shields, presents pole arms in a wall of blades, or moves into position to protect a target allied army that is outflanked. Attempt a @Check[maneuver|defense:maneuver] check against an enemy army.

Critical Success The target allied army is no longer outflanked by any army.

Success The target allied army is no longer outflanked by the target army.

Critical Failure Your defensive stance fails, and your army is now outflanked by the target enemy army.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 방어 전술

당신의 부대는 방패 뒤에 웅크리거나, 장병기를 칼날의 벽처럼 내밀거나, 측면이 노출된 아군 부대를 보호하기 위해 위치를 잡습니다. 적 부대를 상대로 @Check[maneuver|defense:maneuver] 판정을 시도하십시오.

대성공 대상 아군 부대는 더 이상 어떤 부대에게도 측면이 노출되지 않습니다.

성공 대상 아군 부대는 더 이상 대상 부대에게 측면이 노출되지 않습니다.

대실패 당신의 방어 태세가 실패하고, 당신의 부대는 이제 대상 적 부대에게 측면이 노출됩니다.

name: Recover Army

description.value:
When an army endures ill fortune, it can become afflicted by negative conditions. You can use the Recover Army activity to work at removing an affliction with a basic skill check (this DC increases by 5 if you are attempting to Recover from the defeated condition); the skill required for the check depends on the affliction (see the table on page 569).

Critical Success You reduce the affliction's value by 2 (or in the case of a damaged army, increase its HP by 2 up to its maximum). If the affliction does not have a value, it is removed.

Success As critical success but you reduce the affliction's value by 1 (or in the case of a damaged army, increase its HP by 1 up to its maximum).

Failure You fail to remove the affliction.

Critical Failure You fail to remove the affliction and your soldier's lowered morale spreads discontent; increase Unrest by 1. If you were attempting to recover a defeated army, the army is destroyed.

_desc_en:
When an army endures ill fortune, it can become afflicted by negative conditions. You can use the Recover Army activity to work at removing an affliction with a basic skill check (this DC increases by 5 if you are attempting to Recover from the defeated condition); the skill required for the check depends on the affliction (see the table on page 569).

Critical Success You reduce the affliction's value by 2 (or in the case of a damaged army, increase its HP by 2 up to its maximum). If the affliction does not have a value, it is removed.

Success As critical success but you reduce the affliction's value by 1 (or in the case of a damaged army, increase its HP by 1 up to its maximum).

Failure You fail to remove the affliction.

Critical Failure You fail to remove the affliction and your soldier's lowered morale spreads discontent; increase Unrest by 1. If you were attempting to recover a defeated army, the army is destroyed.
_desc_ko:
부대가 불운을 겪으면 부정적인 조건에 시달릴 수 있습니다. 당신은 부대 회복 활동을 사용해 기본 기술 판정으로 이상 상태를 제거하려 시도할 수 있습니다(패배 조건에서 회복을 시도하는 경우 이 DC는 5 증가합니다). 판정에 필요한 기술은 이상 상태에 따라 다릅니다(569쪽의 표 참조).

대성공 이상 상태의 값을 2 감소시킵니다(손상된 부대의 경우, 최대치까지 HP를 2 증가시킵니다). 이상 상태에 값이 없으면 제거됩니다.

성공 대성공과 같으나 이상 상태의 값을 1 감소시킵니다(손상된 부대의 경우, 최대치까지 HP를 1 증가시킵니다).

실패 이상 상태를 제거하지 못합니다.

대실패 이상 상태를 제거하지 못하고, 병사들의 저하된 사기가 불만을 퍼뜨립니다. 소요를 1 증가시킵니다. 패배한 부대를 회복하려 시도했다면 그 부대는 파괴됩니다.

name: Clandestine Business

description.value:
You know there are criminals in your kingdom, and they know you know. You encourage them to send kickbacks in the form of resources and Commodities to the government, but the common citizens will be more than upset if they find out! This starts as a basic @Check[intrigue|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check against your Control DC, but every subsequent Kingdom turn you pursue Clandestine Business, the DC increases by 2. Every Kingdom turn that passes without Clandestine Business reduces the DC by 1 (until you reach your Control DC).

Critical Success Immediately roll 2 Resource Dice. Gain RP equal to the result. In addition, you gain 1d4 Luxury Commodities. The public is none the wiser.

Success Either immediately roll 2 Resource Dice and gain RP equal to the result, or gain 1d4 Luxury Commodities. Regardless of your choice, rumors spread about where the government is getting these "gifts." Increase Unrest by 1.

Failure Immediately roll 1 Resource Die and gain RP equal to the result. Rumors are backed up with eyewitness accounts. Increase Unrest by 1 and Corruption by 1.

Critical Failure You gain nothing from the Clandestine Business but angry citizens. Increase Unrest by 1d6, Corruption by 2, and one other Ruin of your choice by 1.

_desc_en:
You know there are criminals in your kingdom, and they know you know. You encourage them to send kickbacks in the form of resources and Commodities to the government, but the common citizens will be more than upset if they find out! This starts as a basic @Check[intrigue|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check against your Control DC, but every subsequent Kingdom turn you pursue Clandestine Business, the DC increases by 2. Every Kingdom turn that passes without Clandestine Business reduces the DC by 1 (until you reach your Control DC).

Critical Success Immediately roll 2 Resource Dice. Gain RP equal to the result. In addition, you gain 1d4 Luxury Commodities. The public is none the wiser.

Success Either immediately roll 2 Resource Dice and gain RP equal to the result, or gain 1d4 Luxury Commodities. Regardless of your choice, rumors spread about where the government is getting these "gifts." Increase Unrest by 1.

Failure Immediately roll 1 Resource Die and gain RP equal to the result. Rumors are backed up with eyewitness accounts. Increase Unrest by 1 and Corruption by 1.

Critical Failure You gain nothing from the Clandestine Business but angry citizens. Increase Unrest by 1d6, Corruption by 2, and one other Ruin of your choice by 1.
_desc_ko:
당신은 왕국에 범죄자들이 있다는 것을 알고, 그들도 당신이 안다는 것을 압니다. 당신은 그들이 자원과 상품 형태로 정부에 상납금을 보내도록 부추기지만, 일반 시민들이 이를 알게 되면 몹시 분노할 것입니다! 이는 당신의 통제 DC를 상대로 하는 기본 @Check[intrigue|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] 판정으로 시작하지만, 은밀한 거래를 추진하는 이후의 왕국 턴마다 DC가 2씩 증가합니다. 은밀한 거래 없이 지나가는 왕국 턴마다 DC가 1씩 감소합니다(통제 DC에 도달할 때까지).

대성공 즉시 자원 주사위 2개를 굴립니다. 결과와 같은 RP를 획득합니다. 또한 사치 상품 1d4개를 획득합니다. 대중은 전혀 알지 못합니다.

성공 즉시 자원 주사위 2개를 굴려 결과와 같은 RP를 획득하거나, 사치 상품 1d4개를 획득합니다. 선택과 관계없이 정부가 이러한 "선물"을 어디서 얻는지에 대한 소문이 퍼집니다. 소요를 1 증가시킵니다.

실패 즉시 자원 주사위 1개를 굴려 결과와 같은 RP를 획득합니다. 소문이 목격자 증언으로 뒷받침됩니다. 소요를 1, 부패를 1 증가시킵니다.

대실패 은밀한 거래에서 아무것도 얻지 못하고 성난 시민들만 얻습니다. 소요를 1d6, 부패를 2, 그리고 당신이 선택한 다른 파멸 하나를 1 증가시킵니다.

name: Celebrate Holiday

description.value:
You declare a day of celebration. Holidays may be religious, historical, martial, or simply festive, but all relieve your citizens from their labors and give them a chance to make merry at the kingdom's expense. Attempt a basic @Check[folklore|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check, but if your kingdom Celebrated a Holiday the previous turn, the DC increases by 4, as your kingdom hasn't had a chance to recover from the previous gala.

Critical Success Your holidays are a delight to your people. The event is expensive, but incidental income from the celebrants covers the cost. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Loyalty-based checks until the end of your next Kingdom turn.

Success Your holidays are a success, but they're also expensive. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Loyalty-based checks until the end of your next Kingdom turn. Immediately roll 1 Resource Die and spend RP equal to the result. If you can't afford this cost, treat this result as a Critical Failure instead.

Failure The holiday passes with little enthusiasm, but is still expensive. Immediately roll 1 Resource Die and spend RP equal to the result. If you can't afford this cost, treat this result as a Critical Failure instead.

Critical Failure Your festival days are poorly organized, and the citizens actively mock your failed attempt to celebrate. During the next turn, reduce your Resource Dice total by 4. The failure also causes you to take a –1 circumstance penalty to Loyalty-based checks until the end of the next Kingdom turn.

The failure also causes you to take a –1 circumstance penalty to Loyalty-based checks until the end of the next Kingdom turn.
_desc_ko:
당신은 축제일을 선포합니다. 축제는 종교적, 역사적, 군사적이거나 단순히 흥겨운 것일 수 있지만, 모두 시민들을 노동에서 해방시키고 왕국의 비용으로 즐길 기회를 줍니다. 기본 @Check[folklore|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] 판정을 시도하되, 당신의 왕국이 이전 턴에 축제를 개최했다면 왕국이 이전 축제에서 회복할 기회가 없었으므로 DC가 4 증가합니다.

대성공 당신의 축제는 백성들에게 기쁨을 줍니다. 행사는 비용이 많이 들지만, 참가자들로부터 나오는 부수 수입이 비용을 충당합니다. 다음 왕국 턴이 끝날 때까지 충성 기반 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

성공 당신의 축제는 성공적이지만 비용도 많이 듭니다. 다음 왕국 턴이 끝날 때까지 충성 기반 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 즉시 자원 주사위 1개를 굴려 결과와 같은 RP를 소비합니다. 이 비용을 감당할 수 없다면 이 결과를 대신 대실패로 취급합니다.

실패 축제가 별다른 열기 없이 지나가지만, 여전히 비용이 많이 듭니다. 즉시 자원 주사위 1개를 굴려 결과와 같은 RP를 소비합니다. 이 비용을 감당할 수 없다면 이 결과를 대신 대실패로 취급합니다.

대실패 당신의 축제일은 형편없이 조직되고, 시민들은 실패한 축제 시도를 대놓고 조롱합니다. 다음 턴 동안 당신의 자원 주사위 총량을 4 감소시킵니다. 또한 이 실패로 인해 다음 왕국 턴이 끝날 때까지 충성 기반 판정에 –1 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Cavalry Experts

description.value: The army's expert training with mounts increases its status bonus from its Overrun ability to +2. At 12th level, the army ignores the status penalty to Maneuver and Morale saves from its Overrun ability.

_desc_en: The army's expert training with mounts increases its status bonus from its Overrun ability to +2. At 12th level, the army ignores the status penalty to Maneuver and Morale saves from its Overrun ability.
_desc_ko: 부대가 탈것을 다루는 전문가 훈련을 받아 짓밟기 능력에서 얻는 지위 보너스가 +2로 증가합니다. 12레벨에, 부대는 짓밟기 능력으로 인한 기동 및 사기 내성 굴림의 지위 페널티를 무시합니다.

name: Fame and Fortune

description.value: Your kingdom's reputation has spread far and wide, bringing in visitors to behold the spectacle of your greatness and pay their respects. Whenever you achieve a critical success on any Kingdom skill check during the Activity phase of a Kingdom turn, gain 1 bonus Resource Die at the start of your next Kingdom turn.

_desc_en: Your kingdom's reputation has spread far and wide, bringing in visitors to behold the spectacle of your greatness and pay their respects. Whenever you achieve a critical success on any Kingdom skill check during the Activity phase of a Kingdom turn, gain 1 bonus Resource Die at the start of your next Kingdom turn.
_desc_ko: 당신 왕국의 명성이 널리 퍼져, 당신의 위대함이라는 볼거리를 보고 경의를 표하기 위해 방문객들이 찾아옵니다. 왕국 턴의 활동 단계 동안 임의의 왕국 기술 판정에서 대성공을 달성할 때마다, 다음 왕국 턴 시작 시 보너스 자원 주사위 1개를 얻습니다.

name: Establish Trade Agreement

description.value:
Requirements You have diplomatic relations with the group you wish to establish an agreement with. You send a band of merchants out to establish a trade agreement between your kingdom and a group with whom you've established diplomatic relations. If a navigable river connects your kingdom with the other group's territory, you can attempt a Boating check to Establish the Trade Agreement. If your kingdom's proficiency rank in Magic is Master or higher, you can attempt a Magic check. Otherwise, attempt a Trade check. The check's DC is either the group's Negotiation DC (see sidebar) or your kingdom's Control DC, whichever is higher.

Critical Success You successfully establish a trade agreement with your target, and your merchants return with gifts! Immediately roll 2 Resource Dice, then gain RP equal to the result of roll.

Success You successfully establish a trade agreement.

Failure Your traders reach their destination but need to sweeten the deal to secure the trade agreement. Immediately roll 2 Resource Dice, and then spend RP equal to the result of this roll. If you do so, you successfully establish a trade agreement, otherwise the attempt fails.

Critical Failure Your trade agreement is a total loss and your traders do not return. Gain 1 Unrest, and until the end of the next Kingdom turn, take a –1 circumstance penalty to all Economy-related checks.

_desc_en:
