_desc_ko:
요구조건 협정을 체결하고자 하는 집단과 외교 관계를 맺고 있어야 합니다. 당신은 상인 무리를 파견해 왕국과 외교 관계를 맺은 집단 사이에 무역 협정을 체결합니다. 항행 가능한 강이 당신의 왕국과 상대 집단의 영토를 연결한다면, 항해 판정으로 무역 협정 체결을 시도할 수 있습니다. 당신 왕국의 마법 숙련도가 달인 이상이라면 마법 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다. 그렇지 않으면 무역 판정을 시도합니다. 판정의 DC는 집단의 협상 DC(측면 상자 참조)와 당신 왕국의 통제 DC 중 더 높은 것입니다.

대성공 당신은 대상과 무역 협정을 성공적으로 체결하고, 상인들이 선물을 가지고 돌아옵니다! 즉시 자원 주사위 2개를 굴린 뒤, 굴림 결과와 같은 RP를 획득합니다.

성공 당신은 무역 협정을 성공적으로 체결합니다.

실패 당신의 상인들은 목적지에 도달하지만 무역 협정을 확실히 하려면 조건을 더 좋게 만들어야 합니다. 즉시 자원 주사위 2개를 굴린 뒤, 이 굴림 결과와 같은 RP를 소비합니다. 그렇게 하면 무역 협정을 성공적으로 체결하고, 그렇지 않으면 시도가 실패합니다.

대실패 당신의 무역 협정은 완전한 손실이며 상인들은 돌아오지 않습니다. 소요 1을 얻고, 다음 왕국 턴이 끝날 때까지 모든 경제 관련 판정에 –1 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Offensive Gambit

description.value:
Requirements You have at least one army in the same hex as an enemy army.

You order an attack against an enemy army, causing a war encounter to begin after this Kingdom turn ends. No check is necessary if you wish to engage the enemy without attempting to gain an advantage in initiative. If you want to gain an advantage by surprising the enemy, attempt an Intrigue check. If you want to gain an advantage by intimidating the enemy, attempt a Warfare check. In either case, the DC is equal to the enemy army's Scouting DC.

Critical Success Your approach surprises or intimidates the enemy. Your armies in this hex gain a +2 circumstance bonus on their initiative checks, and one enemy army of the party's choice in this hex becomes shaken 1.

Success Your approach gives you an advantage. Your armies in this hex gain a +2 circumstance bonus on their initiative checks.

Failure You gain no advantage in the battle.

Critical Failure Not only do you fail to gain advantage, but the enemy forces have anticipated the attack. Enemy armies in this hex at the time of the Offensive Gambit gain a +4 circumstance bonus on their initiative checks in any resulting war encounters.

_desc_en:
Requirements You have at least one army in the same hex as an enemy army.

You order an attack against an enemy army, causing a war encounter to begin after this Kingdom turn ends. No check is necessary if you wish to engage the enemy without attempting to gain an advantage in initiative. If you want to gain an advantage by surprising the enemy, attempt an Intrigue check. If you want to gain an advantage by intimidating the enemy, attempt a Warfare check. In either case, the DC is equal to the enemy army's Scouting DC.

Critical Success Your approach surprises or intimidates the enemy. Your armies in this hex gain a +2 circumstance bonus on their initiative checks, and one enemy army of the party's choice in this hex becomes shaken 1.

Success Your approach gives you an advantage. Your armies in this hex gain a +2 circumstance bonus on their initiative checks.

Failure You gain no advantage in the battle.

Critical Failure Not only do you fail to gain advantage, but the enemy forces have anticipated the attack. Enemy armies in this hex at the time of the Offensive Gambit gain a +4 circumstance bonus on their initiative checks in any resulting war encounters.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 적 부대와 같은 헥스에 최소 하나의 부대가 있어야 합니다.

당신은 적 부대를 상대로 공격을 명령하여, 이 왕국 턴이 끝난 후 전쟁 조우가 시작되게 합니다. 우선권에서 우위를 확보하려 하지 않고 적과 교전하고자 한다면 판정이 필요 없습니다. 적을 기습해 우위를 얻고자 한다면 첩보 판정을 시도합니다. 적을 위협해 우위를 얻고자 한다면 전쟁 판정을 시도합니다. 어느 경우든 DC는 적 부대의 정찰 DC와 같습니다.

대성공 당신의 접근이 적을 기습하거나 위협합니다. 이 헥스에 있는 당신의 부대들은 우선권 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻고, 파티가 선택한 이 헥스의 적 부대 하나가 동요 1 상태가 됩니다.

성공 당신의 접근이 우위를 줍니다. 이 헥스에 있는 당신의 부대들은 우선권 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

실패 전투에서 아무런 우위를 얻지 못합니다.

대실패 우위를 얻지 못할 뿐만 아니라, 적군이 공격을 예측했습니다. 공세 감행 시점에 이 헥스에 있는 적 부대들은 그로 인해 발생하는 모든 전쟁 조우에서 우선권 판정에 +4 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Ambush

description.value: Your skirmishers are experts at ambushing. On the first round of a war encounter, if your turn occurs before any enemy army turns, you can choose to start the encounter with your army already engaged with an enemy army whose initiative result is lower than yours. If you do so, your army gains a +2 status bonus on the first Attack war action they make against that army on the first round of the encounter.

rules.label: First Attack war action against ambushed opponent

_desc_en: Your skirmishers are experts at ambushing. On the first round of a war encounter, if your turn occurs before any enemy army turns, you can choose to start the encounter with your army already engaged with an enemy army whose initiative result is lower than yours. If you do so, your army gains a +2 status bonus on the first Attack war action they make against that army on the first round of the encounter.
_desc_ko: 당신의 척후병들은 매복의 전문가입니다. 전쟁 조우의 첫 라운드에, 당신의 턴이 어떤 적 부대의 턴보다 먼저 온다면, 당신은 조우를 시작할 때 우선권 결과가 당신보다 낮은 적 부대와 이미 교전 중인 상태로 부대를 배치하도록 선택할 수 있습니다. 그렇게 하면 당신의 부대는 조우 첫 라운드에 그 부대를 상대로 하는 첫 공격 전쟁 행동에 +2 지위 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Collect Taxes

description.value:
Tax collectors travel through the lands to collect funds for the betterment of the kingdom. Attempt a basic @Check[trade|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check.

Critical Success Your tax collectors are wildly successful! For the remainder of the Kingdom turn, gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Economy-based checks.

Success Your tax collectors gather enough to grant you a +1 circumstance bonus to Economy-based checks for the remainder of the Kingdom turn. If you attempted to Collect Taxes during the previous turn, increase Unrest by 1.

Failure As success, but the people are unhappy about taxes—increase Unrest by 1 (or by 2 if you attempted to Collect Taxes the previous turn).

Critical Failure Your tax collectors encounter resistance from the citizens and their attempts to gather taxes are rebuffed. While the tax collectors still manage to gather enough taxes to support essential government needs, they have angered the kingdom's citizens and encouraged rebellious acts. Increase Unrest by 2, and choose one Ruin to increase by 1.

_desc_en:
Tax collectors travel through the lands to collect funds for the betterment of the kingdom. Attempt a basic @Check[trade|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check.

Critical Success Your tax collectors are wildly successful! For the remainder of the Kingdom turn, gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Economy-based checks.

Success Your tax collectors gather enough to grant you a +1 circumstance bonus to Economy-based checks for the remainder of the Kingdom turn. If you attempted to Collect Taxes during the previous turn, increase Unrest by 1.

Failure As success, but the people are unhappy about taxes—increase Unrest by 1 (or by 2 if you attempted to Collect Taxes the previous turn).

Critical Failure Your tax collectors encounter resistance from the citizens and their attempts to gather taxes are rebuffed. While the tax collectors still manage to gather enough taxes to support essential government needs, they have angered the kingdom's citizens and encouraged rebellious acts. Increase Unrest by 2, and choose one Ruin to increase by 1.
_desc_ko:
징세관들이 왕국의 발전을 위한 자금을 모으기 위해 각지를 돌아다닙니다. 기본 @Check[trade|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] 판정을 시도하십시오.

대성공 당신의 징세관들이 대단히 성공적입니다! 왕국 턴이 끝날 때까지 경제 기반 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

성공 당신의 징세관들이 충분히 거두어 왕국 턴이 끝날 때까지 경제 기반 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 부여합니다. 이전 턴에 세금 징수를 시도했다면 소요를 1 증가시킵니다.

실패 성공과 같으나, 사람들이 세금에 불만을 품습니다—소요를 1 증가시킵니다(이전 턴에 세금 징수를 시도했다면 2).

대실패 당신의 징세관들이 시민들의 저항에 부딪혀 세금을 걷으려는 시도가 거부됩니다. 징세관들이 필수적인 정부 수요를 지탱할 만큼은 세금을 거두지만, 왕국 시민들을 분노케 하고 반란 행위를 부추깁니다. 소요를 2 증가시키고, 파멸 하나를 골라 1 증가시킵니다.

name: Hold the Line

description.value: The army has trained to maintain position even in the face of overwhelming opponents. The army gains a +1 status bonus on Morale checks made to resist rout, and its Rout Threshold is equal to 1/4 it's total Hit Points (rounded up).

rules.label: Morale checks made to resist Rout

_desc_en: The army has trained to maintain position even in the face of overwhelming opponents. The army gains a +1 status bonus on Morale checks made to resist rout, and its Rout Threshold is equal to 1/4 it's total Hit Points (rounded up).
_desc_ko: 부대는 압도적인 상대 앞에서도 위치를 유지하도록 훈련했습니다. 부대는 궤멸에 저항하기 위한 사기 판정에 +1 지위 보너스를 얻고, 궤멸 한계치가 총 히트 포인트의 1/4(올림)과 같아집니다.

name: Establish Work Site

description.value:
Your hire a crew of workers to travel to a hex that contains Lumber, Ore, or Stone to be harvested. Spend RP as determined by the hex's most inhospitable terrain (see the Building on Rough Terrain sidebar on page 519). Then attempt a basic @Check[engineering|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check. Lumber camps can be established in any hex that contains a significant amount of forest terrain. Mines and quarries can be established in any hex that contains a significant amount of hill or mountain terrain.

Critical Success You establish a Work Site in the hex and proceed to discover an unexpectedly rich supply of high quality Commodities. All Commodity yields granted by this site are doubled until the end of the next Kingdom turn.

Success You establish a Work Site in the hex.

Failure You fail to establish a Work Site in the hex.

Critical Failure Not only do you fail to establish a Work Site, but you lose several workers to an accident, banditry, a vicious monster, or some other unforeseen occurrence. Gain 1 Unrest.

_desc_en:
Your hire a crew of workers to travel to a hex that contains Lumber, Ore, or Stone to be harvested. Spend RP as determined by the hex's most inhospitable terrain (see the Building on Rough Terrain sidebar on page 519). Then attempt a basic @Check[engineering|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check. Lumber camps can be established in any hex that contains a significant amount of forest terrain. Mines and quarries can be established in any hex that contains a significant amount of hill or mountain terrain.

Critical Success You establish a Work Site in the hex and proceed to discover an unexpectedly rich supply of high quality Commodities. All Commodity yields granted by this site are doubled until the end of the next Kingdom turn.

Success You establish a Work Site in the hex.

Failure You fail to establish a Work Site in the hex.

Critical Failure Not only do you fail to establish a Work Site, but you lose several workers to an accident, banditry, a vicious monster, or some other unforeseen occurrence. Gain 1 Unrest.
_desc_ko:
당신은 목재, 광석, 석재를 채취할 수 있는 헥스로 이동할 작업 인부들을 고용합니다. 헥스의 가장 척박한 지형에 따라 결정되는 RP를 소비합니다(519쪽의 험지 건설 측면 상자 참조). 그런 다음 기본 @Check[engineering|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] 판정을 시도합니다. 벌목 캠프는 상당한 양의 삼림 지형을 포함하는 헥스에 설치할 수 있습니다. 광산과 채석장은 상당한 양의 언덕이나 산악 지형을 포함하는 헥스에 설치할 수 있습니다.

대성공 당신은 헥스에 작업장을 설치하고, 예상치 못한 고품질 상품의 풍부한 매장량을 발견합니다. 이 작업장이 부여하는 모든 상품 산출량이 다음 왕국 턴이 끝날 때까지 두 배가 됩니다.

성공 당신은 헥스에 작업장을 설치합니다.

실패 당신은 헥스에 작업장을 설치하지 못합니다.

대실패 작업장 설치에 실패할 뿐만 아니라, 사고, 도적질, 흉포한 괴물, 또는 예기치 못한 사건으로 몇몇 인부를 잃습니다. 소요 1을 얻습니다.

name: Rally

description.value:
Your army's leaders attempt to bolster the soldiers' morale and fight back the effects of fear and panic. Attempt a @Check[morale|defense:morale|roller:self|options:action:rally] check against a target enemy army of your choice.

Critical Success If your army is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.aZImSBBmTHff2POP]{Routed}, it loses the routed condition. Reduce your army's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.7LMDwpVijK7x5Jst]{Shaken} condition by 2.

Success Reduce your army's shaken condition by 1.

Critical Failure Your attempt to rally backfires—increase your army's shaken condition by 1.

_desc_en:
Your army's leaders attempt to bolster the soldiers' morale and fight back the effects of fear and panic. Attempt a @Check[morale|defense:morale|roller:self|options:action:rally] check against a target enemy army of your choice.

Critical Success If your army is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.aZImSBBmTHff2POP]{Routed}, it loses the routed condition. Reduce your army's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.7LMDwpVijK7x5Jst]{Shaken} condition by 2.

Success Reduce your army's shaken condition by 1.

Critical Failure Your attempt to rally backfires—increase your army's shaken condition by 1.
_desc_ko:
당신 부대의 지휘관들이 병사들의 사기를 북돋우고 공포와 공황의 영향을 물리치려 시도합니다. 당신이 선택한 대상 적 부대를 상대로 @Check[morale|defense:morale|roller:self|options:action:rally] 판정을 시도하십시오.

대성공 당신의 부대가 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.aZImSBBmTHff2POP]{궤멸} 상태라면 궤멸 조건을 잃습니다. 당신 부대의 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.7LMDwpVijK7x5Jst]{동요} 조건을 2 감소시킵니다.

성공 당신 부대의 동요 조건을 1 감소시킵니다.

대실패 결집 시도가 역효과를 냅니다—당신 부대의 동요 조건을 1 증가시킵니다.

name: Engines of War

description.value:
Note: Basic siege armies know Engines of War automatically, and must 'spend' their first tactic on it.

Siege engines cannot be outfitted with gear. They cannot attack @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.2IqM1XHELKwARAx1]{Engaged} armies. They are more difficult to destroy due to their higher hit points than other basic armies. A siege engine can attack and damage fortifications with its ranged attacks as part of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.qCxyuNhzaaYlYBum]{Battle} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.HLu1o1RzCZxWjOJJ]{Overwhelming Bombardment} actions.

_desc_en:
Note: Basic siege armies know Engines of War automatically, and must 'spend' their first tactic on it.

Siege engines cannot be outfitted with gear. They cannot attack @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.2IqM1XHELKwARAx1]{Engaged} armies. They are more difficult to destroy due to their higher hit points than other basic armies. A siege engine can attack and damage fortifications with its ranged attacks as part of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.qCxyuNhzaaYlYBum]{Battle} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.HLu1o1RzCZxWjOJJ]{Overwhelming Bombardment} actions.
_desc_ko:
참고: 기본 공성 부대는 전쟁 병기를 자동으로 알고 있으며, 첫 번째 전술을 여기에 '소비'해야 합니다.

공성 병기는 장비를 갖출 수 없습니다. 공성 병기는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.2IqM1XHELKwARAx1]{교전 중}인 부대를 공격할 수 없습니다. 공성 병기는 다른 기본 부대보다 히트 포인트가 높아 파괴하기가 더 어렵습니다. 공성 병기는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.qCxyuNhzaaYlYBum]{전투} 또는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.HLu1o1RzCZxWjOJJ]{압도적 포격} 행동의 일부로 원거리 공격을 사용해 요새를 공격하고 피해를 줄 수 있습니다.

name: Counterattack

description.value:
Requirement @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.mHWF5XwUi8RK2lET]{Flexible Tactics}

Trigger An army you are engaged with attempts a maneuver war action.

Your army lashes out at the foe as they attempt to perform a maneuver. Attempt a melee Strike against the triggering army's AC. Counterattack doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

Critical Success You inflict 1 point of damage on the army and increase its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.7LMDwpVijK7x5Jst]{Shaken} condition value by 1.

Success You inflict 1 point of damage on the army.

_desc_en:
Requirement @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.mHWF5XwUi8RK2lET]{Flexible Tactics}

Trigger An army you are engaged with attempts a maneuver war action.

Your army lashes out at the foe as they attempt to perform a maneuver. Attempt a melee Strike against the triggering army's AC. Counterattack doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

Critical Success You inflict 1 point of damage on the army and increase its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.7LMDwpVijK7x5Jst]{Shaken} condition value by 1.

Success You inflict 1 point of damage on the army.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.mHWF5XwUi8RK2lET]{유연한 전술}

발동 당신과 교전 중인 부대가 기동 전쟁 행동을 시도합니다.

당신의 부대가 기동을 수행하려는 적에게 반격을 가합니다. 발동시킨 부대의 AC를 상대로 근접 타격을 시도합니다. 반격은 당신의 다중공격 페널티에 산입되지 않으며, 당신의 다중공격 페널티도 이 타격에 적용되지 않습니다.

대성공 부대에 1점의 피해를 입히고 그 부대의 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.7LMDwpVijK7x5Jst]{동요} 조건 값을 1 증가시킵니다.

성공 부대에 1점의 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Insider Trading

description.value: Your leading citizens share valuable business information with one another and with associates in other lands, and they hire one another's workers to supply the labor they need to fuel their production. You gain a +1 status bonus to Establish Work Site, Establish Trade Agreement, and Trade Commodities activities. In addition, gain 1 bonus Resource Die at the start of each Kingdom turn.

_desc_en: Your leading citizens share valuable business information with one another and with associates in other lands, and they hire one another's workers to supply the labor they need to fuel their production. You gain a +1 status bonus to Establish Work Site, Establish Trade Agreement, and Trade Commodities activities. In addition, gain 1 bonus Resource Die at the start of each Kingdom turn.
_desc_ko: 당신의 유력 시민들은 서로 그리고 다른 지역의 동업자들과 귀중한 사업 정보를 공유하고, 생산에 필요한 노동력을 공급하기 위해 서로의 인부를 고용합니다. 당신은 작업장 설치, 무역 협정 체결, 상품 거래 활동에 +1 지위 보너스를 얻습니다. 또한 각 왕국 턴 시작 시 보너스 자원 주사위 1개를 얻습니다.

name: Field Triage

description.value: The army's soldiers are adept at using emergency methods to treat wounds. The army gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.agjqRWTTIWHwiKsd]{Battlefield Medicine} tactical war action.

_desc_en: The army's soldiers are adept at using emergency methods to treat wounds. The army gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.agjqRWTTIWHwiKsd]{Battlefield Medicine} tactical war action.
_desc_ko: 부대의 병사들은 긴급 방법을 사용해 부상을 치료하는 데 능숙합니다. 부대는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.agjqRWTTIWHwiKsd]{전장 의술} 전술 전쟁 행동을 얻습니다.

name: Civic Planning

description.value: During the Civic Activities step of the Activities phase of a Kingdom turn, one settlement of the party's choice can attempt two Civic activities rather than one. The second Civic activity occurs after all other settlements have taken their individual Civic activities.

_desc_en: During the Civic Activities step of the Activities phase of a Kingdom turn, one settlement of the party's choice can attempt two Civic activities rather than one. The second Civic activity occurs after all other settlements have taken their individual Civic activities.
_desc_ko: 왕국 턴의 활동 단계 중 시정 활동 단계에서, 파티가 선택한 정착지 하나가 하나가 아닌 두 개의 시정 활동을 시도할 수 있습니다. 두 번째 시정 활동은 다른 모든 정착지가 각자의 시정 활동을 마친 후에 일어납니다.

name: False Retreat

description.value:
Requirement Flexible Tactics

Trigger Your army succeeds at a morale check.

Your army feigns defeat to trick an enemy army. Attempt a @Check[morale|defense:morale|roller:self] check against a target army.

Critical Success The target army is caught off guard by your army's deception. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.ibcMcEGRbPRtk9Pu]{Outflanked} and is unable to take reactions until the start of your next turn.

Success The target army is caught off guard by your army's deception and is outflanked until the start of its next turn.

Critical Failure The enemy anticipated your tactic and moves to take advantage of the situation. Your army becomes outflanked until the start of your next turn.

_desc_en:
Requirement Flexible Tactics

Trigger Your army succeeds at a morale check.

Your army feigns defeat to trick an enemy army. Attempt a @Check[morale|defense:morale|roller:self] check against a target army.

Critical Success The target army is caught off guard by your army's deception. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.ibcMcEGRbPRtk9Pu]{Outflanked} and is unable to take reactions until the start of your next turn.

Success The target army is caught off guard by your army's deception and is outflanked until the start of its next turn.

Critical Failure The enemy anticipated your tactic and moves to take advantage of the situation. Your army becomes outflanked until the start of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 유연한 전술

발동 당신의 부대가 사기 판정에 성공합니다.

당신의 부대가 패배를 가장해 적 부대를 속입니다. 대상 부대를 상대로 @Check[morale|defense:morale|roller:self] 판정을 시도합니다.

대성공 대상 부대가 당신 부대의 기만에 허를 찔립니다. 대상은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.ibcMcEGRbPRtk9Pu]{측면 노출} 상태가 되고 당신의 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 반응을 할 수 없습니다.

성공 대상 부대가 당신 부대의 기만에 허를 찔려, 자신의 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 측면이 노출됩니다.

대실패 적이 당신의 전술을 예측하고 상황을 이용하려 움직입니다. 당신의 부대가 당신의 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 측면이 노출됩니다.

name: Craft Luxuries

description.value:
You encourage your artisans to craft luxury goods and may even aid them in this pursuit. Roll 1 Resource Die and spend RP equal to the result. Then attempt a basic @Check[arts|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check.

Critical Success Your artisans exceed expectations and craft extravagant goods. Gain 1d4 Luxury Commodities.

Success Your artisans produce some delightful goods. Gain 1 Luxury Commodity.

Failure Your artisans fail to produce anything noteworthy.

Critical Failure Your artisans not only fail to produce anything noteworthy, but some took advantage of the opportunity to push their own agendas or earn more for themselves by selling to underground markets. Increase one of your Ruins by 1.

_desc_en:
You encourage your artisans to craft luxury goods and may even aid them in this pursuit. Roll 1 Resource Die and spend RP equal to the result. Then attempt a basic @Check[arts|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check.

Critical Success Your artisans exceed expectations and craft extravagant goods. Gain 1d4 Luxury Commodities.

Success Your artisans produce some delightful goods. Gain 1 Luxury Commodity.

Failure Your artisans fail to produce anything noteworthy.

Critical Failure Your artisans not only fail to produce anything noteworthy, but some took advantage of the opportunity to push their own agendas or earn more for themselves by selling to underground markets. Increase one of your Ruins by 1.
_desc_ko:
당신은 장인들에게 사치품을 제작하도록 장려하고, 심지어 이 일을 돕기도 합니다. 자원 주사위 1개를 굴려 결과와 같은 RP를 소비합니다. 그런 다음 기본 @Check[arts|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] 판정을 시도합니다.

대성공 당신의 장인들이 기대를 뛰어넘어 호화로운 물품을 제작합니다. 사치 상품 1d4개를 획득합니다.

성공 당신의 장인들이 훌륭한 물품을 만듭니다. 사치 상품 1개를 획득합니다.

실패 당신의 장인들이 주목할 만한 것을 만들어내지 못합니다.

대실패 당신의 장인들이 주목할 만한 것을 만들어내지 못할 뿐만 아니라, 일부는 이 기회를 이용해 자신의 이익을 도모하거나 암시장에 팔아 사익을 챙깁니다. 당신의 파멸 중 하나를 1 증가시킵니다.

name: Pull Together

description.value: Your people are very reliable, and their swift decision-making keeps most projects from getting too far off track. Once per Kingdom turn when you roll a critical failure on a Kingdom skill check, attempt a DC 11 flat check. If this succeeds, your citizens heed the call to put in extra work to mitigate the disaster; treat the Kingdom skill check result as failure instead. The DC of this flat check increases by 5 each time you subsequently use it, but it decreases by 1 (to a minimum of 11) for each Kingdom turn that passes when you do not use it.

_desc_en: Your people are very reliable, and their swift decision-making keeps most projects from getting too far off track. Once per Kingdom turn when you roll a critical failure on a Kingdom skill check, attempt a DC 11 flat check. If this succeeds, your citizens heed the call to put in extra work to mitigate the disaster; treat the Kingdom skill check result as failure instead. The DC of this flat check increases by 5 each time you subsequently use it, but it decreases by 1 (to a minimum of 11) for each Kingdom turn that passes when you do not use it.
_desc_ko: 당신의 백성들은 매우 믿음직스럽고, 그들의 신속한 결정은 대부분의 사업이 지나치게 궤도를 벗어나지 않게 합니다. 왕국 턴당 한 번, 왕국 기술 판정에서 대실패를 굴렸을 때 DC 11 평판정을 시도합니다. 이것이 성공하면, 당신의 시민들이 재앙을 완화하기 위해 추가 노동을 하라는 부름에 응합니다. 그 왕국 기술 판정 결과를 대신 실패로 취급합니다. 이 평판정의 DC는 이후 사용할 때마다 5씩 증가하지만, 사용하지 않고 지나가는 왕국 턴마다 1씩 감소합니다(최소 11).

name: Kingdom Assurance

description.value:
Even when things go poorly in other areas, you can count on consistency in carrying out kingdom activities with a chosen skill. Choose one Kingdom skill in which your kingdom is trained. Once per Kingdom turn, when you would attempt a skill check for that skill, you can forgo rolling and instead take a result equal to 10 + your proficiency bonus; do not apply any other bonuses, penalties, or modifiers to this result.

Special You can select this feat multiple times. Each time, choose a different skill and gain the benefits of this feat for that skill.

value.value: trained in at least three skills

_desc_en:
Even when things go poorly in other areas, you can count on consistency in carrying out kingdom activities with a chosen skill. Choose one Kingdom skill in which your kingdom is trained. Once per Kingdom turn, when you would attempt a skill check for that skill, you can forgo rolling and instead take a result equal to 10 + your proficiency bonus; do not apply any other bonuses, penalties, or modifiers to this result.

Special You can select this feat multiple times. Each time, choose a different skill and gain the benefits of this feat for that skill.
_desc_ko:
다른 영역에서 일이 잘 풀리지 않을 때에도, 당신은 선택한 기술로 왕국 활동을 수행할 때 일관성을 믿을 수 있습니다. 당신의 왕국이 숙련된 왕국 기술 하나를 선택합니다. 왕국 턴당 한 번, 그 기술로 기술 판정을 시도할 때, 굴리기를 포기하고 대신 10 + 당신의 숙련도 보너스와 같은 결과를 취할 수 있습니다. 이 결과에는 다른 어떤 보너스, 페널티, 수정치도 적용하지 않습니다.

특수 당신은 이 재주를 여러 번 선택할 수 있습니다. 매번 다른 기술을 선택하고 그 기술에 대해 이 재주의 이점을 얻습니다.

name: Fine Living

description.value:
Your people celebrate your leadership by indulging you with feasts and finery. All PCs associated with the kingdom enjoy a Fine standard of living (Pathfinder Core Rulebook 294) at no cost whenever they're in the kingdom. Any PCs in hostile wilderness, a monster-filled dungeon, or otherwise cut off from their citizens must provide their own sustenance as usual even if they are within the boundaries of their kingdom.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all checks made to Craft or Earn Income while in your kingdom.

_desc_en:
Your people celebrate your leadership by indulging you with feasts and finery. All PCs associated with the kingdom enjoy a Fine standard of living (Pathfinder Core Rulebook 294) at no cost whenever they're in the kingdom. Any PCs in hostile wilderness, a monster-filled dungeon, or otherwise cut off from their citizens must provide their own sustenance as usual even if they are within the boundaries of their kingdom.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all checks made to Craft or Earn Income while in your kingdom.
_desc_ko:
당신의 백성들은 잔치와 값비싼 물품으로 당신을 대접하며 당신의 지도력을 기립니다. 왕국과 관련된 모든 PC는 왕국 내에 있을 때 언제나 무료로 상급 수준의 생활을 누립니다(패스파인더 코어 룰북 294쪽). 적대적인 야생, 괴물이 가득한 던전, 또는 그 외 시민들과 단절된 곳에 있는 PC는 왕국 경계 내에 있더라도 평소처럼 스스로 식량을 마련해야 합니다.

당신은 왕국 내에 있는 동안 제작 또는 수입 획득을 위한 모든 판정에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Increased Ammunition

description.value: You increase the number of times your army can use ranged Strikes in each war encounter by 2. This tactic can be taken multiple times; each time you do so, increase the army's maximum number of ranged Strikes by 2.

_desc_en: You increase the number of times your army can use ranged Strikes in each war encounter by 2. This tactic can be taken multiple times; each time you do so, increase the army's maximum number of ranged Strikes by 2.
_desc_ko: 당신의 부대가 각 전쟁 조우에서 원거리 타격을 사용할 수 있는 횟수를 2 증가시킵니다. 이 전술은 여러 번 선택할 수 있으며, 그럴 때마다 부대의 최대 원거리 타격 횟수를 2 증가시킵니다.

name: Focused Devotion

description.value:
The army is particularly loyal to your cause. The army gains a +1 status bonus on Morale checks made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.8XXylMGJuqe1ozMk]{Rally}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level, and +3 at 17th level.

The army can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.ggVahjiAlVICpiPA]{Taunt} tactical war action.

_desc_en:
The army is particularly loyal to your cause. The army gains a +1 status bonus on Morale checks made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.8XXylMGJuqe1ozMk]{Rally}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level, and +3 at 17th level.

The army can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.ggVahjiAlVICpiPA]{Taunt} tactical war action.
_desc_ko:
부대가 당신의 대의에 특히 충성스럽습니다. 부대는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.8XXylMGJuqe1ozMk]{결집}을 위한 사기 판정에 +1 지위 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 보너스는 9레벨에 +2, 17레벨에 +3으로 증가합니다.

부대는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.ggVahjiAlVICpiPA]{도발} 전술 전쟁 행동을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Experienced Leadership

description.value:
Invested leadership roles in your kingdom now grant a +2 status bonus to kingdom checks associated with their leadership role's key ability.

At 16th level, this increases to a +3 status bonus.

_desc_en:
Invested leadership roles in your kingdom now grant a +2 status bonus to kingdom checks associated with their leadership role's key ability.

At 16th level, this increases to a +3 status bonus.
_desc_ko:
당신 왕국에서 임명된 지도 직책은 이제 그 지도 직책의 핵심 능력치와 관련된 왕국 판정에 +2 지위 보너스를 부여합니다.

16레벨에, 이는 +3 지위 보너스로 증가합니다.

name: Build Roads

description.value:
Requirements The hex in which you seek to build roads must be claimed by your kingdom.

You order your kingdom's engineers to construct a network of robust roads through the hex. Travel along roads uses a terrain type one step better than the surrounding terrain; for example, roads through forest hexes—normally difficult terrain—allow travel as if it were open terrain. Spend RP as determined by the hex's most inhospitable terrain (see Building on Rough Terrain on page 519; if the hex includes any rivers that cross the hex from one hex side to any other, you must spend double the normal RP cost to also build bridges; this adds the Bridge structure to that hex). Then attempt a basic @Check[engineering|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check. Work with the GM to determine where your roads appear on the map.

Critical Success You build roads into the target hex and one adjacent claimed hex that doesn't yet have roads and whose terrain features are at least as hospitable as those of the target hex. If no adjacent hex is appropriate, treat this result as a Success instead.

Success You build roads in the hex.

Failure You fail to build roads in the hex.

Critical Failure Your attempt to build roads ends in disaster. Not only do you fail to build roads, but you lose several workers to an accident, banditry, a vicious monster, or some other unforeseen occurrence. Gain 1 Unrest

_desc_ko:
요구조건 도로를 건설하려는 헥스는 당신의 왕국이 점유하고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 왕국의 기술자들에게 헥스를 관통하는 튼튼한 도로망을 건설하도록 명령합니다. 도로를 따라 이동하면 주변 지형보다 한 단계 나은 지형 유형으로 처리됩니다. 예를 들어, 보통 험지인 삼림 헥스를 관통하는 도로는 개활지처럼 이동할 수 있게 합니다. 헥스의 가장 척박한 지형에 따라 결정되는 RP를 소비합니다(519쪽의 험지 건설 참조. 헥스에 한 헥스 변에서 다른 어느 변으로 헥스를 가로지르는 강이 있다면, 다리도 건설하기 위해 평소 RP 비용의 두 배를 소비해야 합니다. 이는 해당 헥스에 다리 구조물을 추가합니다). 그런 다음 기본 @Check[engineering|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] 판정을 시도합니다. 도로가 지도상 어디에 나타나는지는 GM과 함께 결정하십시오.

대성공 대상 헥스와, 아직 도로가 없으며 지형 특성이 대상 헥스만큼은 우호적인 인접한 점유 헥스 하나에 도로를 건설합니다. 적절한 인접 헥스가 없다면 이 결과를 대신 성공으로 취급합니다.

성공 헥스에 도로를 건설합니다.

실패 헥스에 도로를 건설하지 못합니다.

대실패 도로 건설 시도가 재앙으로 끝납니다. 도로를 건설하지 못할 뿐만 아니라, 사고, 도적질, 흉포한 괴물, 또는 예기치 못한 사건으로 몇몇 인부를 잃습니다. 소요 1을 얻습니다

name: Keen Eyed

description.value: The army includes several spotters and scouts who are particularly keen-eyed. The army gains a +2 status bonus on initiative checks.

_desc_en: The army includes several spotters and scouts who are particularly keen-eyed. The army gains a +2 status bonus on initiative checks.
_desc_ko: 부대에는 특히 눈이 예리한 정찰병과 척후병이 여럿 포함되어 있습니다. 부대는 우선권 판정에 +2 지위 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Send Diplomatic Envoy

description.value:
You send emissaries to another group to foster positive relations and communication. The DC of this check is the group's Negotiation DC (see the sidebar on page 519). Attempts to Send a Diplomatic Envoy to a nation with which your kingdom is at war take a –4 circumstance penalty to the check and have the result worsened one degree. At the GM's option, some wars might be so heated that this activity has no chance of success.

Critical Success Your envoys are received quite warmly and make a good first impression. You establish diplomatic relations with the group (see page 534 for more information) and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to all checks made with that group until the next Kingdom turn.

Success You establish diplomatic relations.

Failure Your envoys are received, but the target organization isn't ready to engage in diplomatic relations. If you attempt to Send a Diplomatic Envoy to the group next Kingdom turn, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to that check.

Critical Failure Disaster! Your envoy fails to reach their destination, is turned back at the border, or is taken prisoner or executed, at the GM's discretion. The repercussions on your kingdom's morale and reputation are significant. Choose one of the following results: gain [[/r 1d4 #Unrest]]{1d4 Unrest}, add 1 to a Ruin of your choice, or immediately roll 2 Resource Dice and spend RP equal to the result. In any event, you cannot attempt to Send a Diplomatic Envoy to this same target for the next 3 Kingdom turns. The first time your kingdom succeeds at establishing diplomatic relations in the campaign, gain 60 kingdom XP as a milestone award.

In any event, you cannot attempt to Send a Diplomatic Envoy to this same target for the next 3 Kingdom turns. The first time your kingdom succeeds at establishing diplomatic relations in the campaign, gain 60 kingdom XP as a milestone award.
_desc_ko:
당신은 긍정적인 관계와 소통을 촉진하기 위해 다른 집단에 사절을 보냅니다. 이 판정의 DC는 집단의 협상 DC입니다(519쪽의 측면 상자 참조). 당신의 왕국과 전쟁 중인 국가에 외교 사절을 파견하려는 시도는 판정에 –4 상황 페널티를 받고 결과가 한 단계 악화됩니다. GM의 재량에 따라, 일부 전쟁은 너무 격렬해서 이 활동이 성공할 가능성이 전혀 없을 수도 있습니다.

대성공 당신의 사절들이 매우 따뜻하게 영접받고 좋은 첫인상을 남깁니다. 당신은 집단과 외교 관계를 수립하고(자세한 내용은 534쪽 참조) 다음 왕국 턴까지 그 집단과 하는 모든 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

성공 당신은 외교 관계를 수립합니다.

실패 당신의 사절들이 영접받지만, 대상 조직은 외교 관계를 맺을 준비가 되어 있지 않습니다. 다음 왕국 턴에 그 집단에 외교 사절을 파견하려 시도하면, 그 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

대실패 재앙입니다! 당신의 사절이 목적지에 도달하지 못하거나, 국경에서 돌려보내지거나, 포로로 잡히거나 처형됩니다(GM 재량). 당신 왕국의 사기와 명성에 미치는 여파가 심각합니다. 다음 결과 중 하나를 선택하십시오: [[/r 1d4 #Unrest]]{소요 1d4}를 얻거나, 당신이 선택한 파멸에 1을 더하거나, 즉시 자원 주사위 2개를 굴려 결과와 같은 RP를 소비합니다. 어느 경우든, 앞으로 3번의 왕국 턴 동안 같은 대상에 외교 사절을 파견하려 시도할 수 없습니다. 캠페인에서 왕국이 외교 관계 수립에 처음 성공하면, 이정표 보상으로 왕국 XP 60을 얻습니다.

name: Envy of the World

description.value: Your kingdom is one of the world's prominent nations. The first time in a Kingdom turn when your kingdom would gain Unrest or Ruin, ignore that increase. You can ignore additional increases to Unrest or Ruin later in the same turn as well, but you must spend a Fame or Infamy point each time you do so. Your maximum Fame or Infamy point total increases by 1.

_desc_en: Your kingdom is one of the world's prominent nations. The first time in a Kingdom turn when your kingdom would gain Unrest or Ruin, ignore that increase. You can ignore additional increases to Unrest or Ruin later in the same turn as well, but you must spend a Fame or Infamy point each time you do so. Your maximum Fame or Infamy point total increases by 1.
_desc_ko: 당신의 왕국은 세계의 손꼽히는 국가 중 하나입니다. 왕국 턴에서 처음으로 당신의 왕국이 소요나 파멸을 얻게 될 때, 그 증가를 무시합니다. 같은 턴 후반에 소요나 파멸의 추가 증가도 무시할 수 있지만, 그럴 때마다 명성 또는 악명 점수 1점을 소비해야 합니다. 당신의 최대 명성 또는 악명 점수 총량이 1 증가합니다.

name: Recruit Army

description.value:
Note that you pursue this activity during the Leadership step of the Activity phase. Either you recruit an army from your kingdom's citizens, or you secure the allegiance of a specialized army you encountered in the Stolen Lands. If you're recruiting an army from your kingdom's citizens, choose one of the basic armies listed at the start of page 570 and attempt a Warfare check against the army's Recruitment DC. If you're securing a specialized army, you must attempt a Statecraft check against the Recruitment DC; statistics for these armies appear starting on page 571.

Critical Success You recruit the army; it becomes efficient.

Success You recruit the army.

Failure You fail to recruit the army.

Critical Failure Many of the individuals in the army you attempted to recruit took offense at the attempt. Gain 1 Unrest, and you cannot attempt to recruit an army again until the next Kingdom turn.

_desc_en:
Note that you pursue this activity during the Leadership step of the Activity phase. Either you recruit an army from your kingdom's citizens, or you secure the allegiance of a specialized army you encountered in the Stolen Lands. If you're recruiting an army from your kingdom's citizens, choose one of the basic armies listed at the start of page 570 and attempt a Warfare check against the army's Recruitment DC. If you're securing a specialized army, you must attempt a Statecraft check against the Recruitment DC; statistics for these armies appear starting on page 571.

Critical Success You recruit the army; it becomes efficient.

Success You recruit the army.

Failure You fail to recruit the army.

Critical Failure Many of the individuals in the army you attempted to recruit took offense at the attempt. Gain 1 Unrest, and you cannot attempt to recruit an army again until the next Kingdom turn.
_desc_ko:
이 활동은 활동 단계의 지도 단계에서 추진한다는 점에 유의하십시오. 당신은 왕국의 시민들로부터 부대를 모집하거나, 도둑맞은 땅에서 마주친 특수 부대의 충성을 확보합니다. 왕국 시민들로부터 부대를 모집한다면, 570쪽 시작 부분에 나열된 기본 부대 중 하나를 선택하고 그 부대의 모집 DC를 상대로 전쟁 판정을 시도합니다. 특수 부대를 확보한다면, 모집 DC를 상대로 국정 판정을 시도해야 합니다. 이러한 부대의 수치는 571쪽부터 나옵니다.

대성공 당신은 부대를 모집하고, 그 부대는 정예가 됩니다.

성공 당신은 부대를 모집합니다.

실패 당신은 부대 모집에 실패합니다.

대실패 당신이 모집하려 한 부대의 많은 이들이 그 시도에 불쾌감을 느낍니다. 소요 1을 얻고, 다음 왕국 턴까지 다시 부대를 모집하려 시도할 수 없습니다.

name: Dirty Fighting

description.value:
Requirement @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.mHWF5XwUi8RK2lET]{Flexible Tactics}

Your army uses trickery, deception, and unfair tactics to attempt a devastating attack against an outflanked army. Attempt a melee Strike or a ranged Strike against the AC of a target outflanked army that is not distant.

Critical Success The target army becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.dmzpRlOrorEFUETl]{Weary 2} until the start of your next turn.

Success The target army becomes weary 1 until the start of your next turn.

Critical Failure Your attack deals no damage to the target army, which is emboldened by your failed attempt at dirty fighting. This reduces the target army's weary value by 1.

_desc_en:
Requirement @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.mHWF5XwUi8RK2lET]{Flexible Tactics}

Your army uses trickery, deception, and unfair tactics to attempt a devastating attack against an outflanked army. Attempt a melee Strike or a ranged Strike against the AC of a target outflanked army that is not distant.

Critical Success The target army becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.dmzpRlOrorEFUETl]{Weary 2} until the start of your next turn.

Success The target army becomes weary 1 until the start of your next turn.

Critical Failure Your attack deals no damage to the target army, which is emboldened by your failed attempt at dirty fighting. This reduces the target army's weary value by 1.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.mHWF5XwUi8RK2lET]{유연한 전술}

당신의 부대가 속임수, 기만, 부당한 전술을 사용해 측면이 노출된 부대에 치명적인 공격을 시도합니다. 멀리 있지 않은 측면 노출 대상 부대의 AC를 상대로 근접 타격 또는 원거리 타격을 시도합니다.

대성공 대상 부대가 당신의 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.dmzpRlOrorEFUETl]{탈진 2} 상태가 됩니다.

성공 대상 부대가 당신의 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 탈진 1 상태가 됩니다.

대실패 당신의 공격이 대상 부대에 아무 피해도 주지 못하고, 대상 부대는 당신의 실패한 비열한 싸움 시도에 대담해집니다. 이는 대상 부대의 탈진 값을 1 감소시킵니다.

name: Opening Salvo

description.value: Your army has trained to take the first shot at distant foes. On the first round of a war encounter, if your turn occurs before any enemy army turns, you can choose to start the encounter with your army @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.8upne4E6Q7Da5T5w]{Distant} from all enemy armies.

_desc_en: Your army has trained to take the first shot at distant foes. On the first round of a war encounter, if your turn occurs before any enemy army turns, you can choose to start the encounter with your army @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.8upne4E6Q7Da5T5w]{Distant} from all enemy armies.
_desc_ko: 당신의 부대는 멀리 있는 적에게 첫 발을 쏘도록 훈련했습니다. 전쟁 조우의 첫 라운드에, 당신의 턴이 어떤 적 부대의 턴보다 먼저 온다면, 당신은 조우를 시작할 때 당신의 부대가 모든 적 부대로부터 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.8upne4E6Q7Da5T5w]{원거리} 상태로 시작하도록 선택할 수 있습니다.

name: Rest and Relax

description.value:
Working non-stop can burn out even the most devoted and dedicated individual. As such, it's important to take time for yourself, and thus set a good example for the nation. You take time to relax, and you extend the chance to unwind to your citizens as well. The Kingdom skill you use to determine the effectiveness of your time off depends on how you want to spend it: Use a basic @Check[arts|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check to spend the time engaged in entertainment or the pursuit of a hobby. Use a basic @Check[boating|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check to enjoy trips on the lakes and rivers of your kingdom. Use a basic @Check[scholarship|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check to spend the time reading or studying a topic of personal interest beyond your daily duties. Use a basic @Check[trade|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check to spend your time shopping or feasting. Use a basic Wilderness check to get away from the bustle and relax in the countryside. If your kingdom Rested and Relaxed the previous Kingdom turn, the DC increases by 4, as your kingdom's production and output hasn't had a chance to catch up to all those vacation days.

Critical Success The citizens enjoy the time off and are ready to get back to work. Reduce Unrest by 1, and the next Leadership activity you take gains a +2 circumstance bonus.

Success The time spent relaxing has calmed nerves; reduce Unrest by 1.

Failure The rest is welcome, but not particularly beneficial in the long term.

Critical Failure The time is wasted, and when you get back to work, you have to spend extra time catching up. Take a –2 circumstance penalty to your next skill check made as a Leadership activity.

_desc_en:
Working non-stop can burn out even the most devoted and dedicated individual. As such, it's important to take time for yourself, and thus set a good example for the nation. You take time to relax, and you extend the chance to unwind to your citizens as well. Use a basic @Check[boating|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check to enjoy trips on the lakes and rivers of your kingdom. Critical Success The citizens enjoy the time off and are ready to get back to work. Reduce Unrest by 1, and the next Leadership activity you take gains a +2 circumstance bonus.

Success The time spent relaxing has calmed nerves; reduce Unrest by 1.

Failure The rest is welcome, but not particularly beneficial in the long term.

Critical Failure The time is wasted, and when you get back to work, you have to spend extra time catching up. Take a –2 circumstance penalty to your next skill check made as a Leadership activity.
_desc_ko:
쉼 없이 일하면 아무리 헌신적이고 열성적인 사람이라도 지쳐 나가떨어질 수 있습니다. 그러므로 자신을 위한 시간을 갖는 것이 중요하며, 이는 국가에 좋은 본보기가 됩니다. 당신은 휴식할 시간을 갖고, 그 여유를 시민들에게도 나누어 줍니다. 휴식의 효과를 결정하는 데 사용하는 왕국 기술은 당신이 시간을 어떻게 보내고자 하는지에 따라 다릅니다: 오락이나 취미 활동에 시간을 쓰려면 기본 @Check[arts|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] 판정을 사용합니다. 왕국의 호수와 강에서 여행을 즐기려면 기본 @Check[boating|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] 판정을 사용합니다. 일상 업무를 벗어나 개인적 관심 주제를 읽거나 공부하며 시간을 보내려면 기본 @Check[scholarship|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] 판정을 사용합니다. 쇼핑이나 잔치로 시간을 보내려면 기본 @Check[trade|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] 판정을 사용합니다. 번잡함에서 벗어나 시골에서 휴식하려면 기본 야생 판정을 사용합니다. 당신의 왕국이 이전 왕국 턴에 휴식과 여가를 취했다면, 왕국의 생산과 산출이 그 모든 휴가일을 따라잡을 기회가 없었으므로 DC가 4 증가합니다.

대성공 시민들이 휴식을 즐기고 다시 일할 준비가 됩니다. 소요를 1 감소시키고, 당신이 취하는 다음 지도 활동이 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

성공 휴식으로 보낸 시간이 긴장을 풀어 줍니다. 소요를 1 감소시킵니다.

실패 휴식은 반갑지만, 장기적으로 특별히 이롭지는 않습니다.

대실패 시간을 허비하고, 일에 복귀할 때 밀린 것을 따라잡느라 추가 시간을 써야 합니다. 지도 활동으로 시도하는 다음 기술 판정에 –2 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Covering Fire

description.value:
Requirement @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.lcNZMlMNPUrnMgQ2]{Sharpshooter}

Your army's ranged fire provides cover and protection for an allied army to maneuver. Attempt a ranged Strike against a target army's AC.

Critical Success You inflict 2 points of damage to the target army, and it cannot take reactions triggered by maneuver war actions from any army until the start of your next turn.

Success You inflict 1 point of damage to the target army, and it can't take reactions triggered by maneuver war actions from any army until the start of your next turn.

Failure Your attack fails to provide covering fire, but you inflict 1 point of damage to the target army.

Critical Failure Your attempt fails.

_desc_en:
Requirement @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.lcNZMlMNPUrnMgQ2]{Sharpshooter}

Your army's ranged fire provides cover and protection for an allied army to maneuver. Attempt a ranged Strike against a target army's AC.

Critical Success You inflict 2 points of damage to the target army, and it cannot take reactions triggered by maneuver war actions from any army until the start of your next turn.

Success You inflict 1 point of damage to the target army, and it can't take reactions triggered by maneuver war actions from any army until the start of your next turn.

Failure Your attack fails to provide covering fire, but you inflict 1 point of damage to the target army.

Critical Failure Your attempt fails.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.lcNZMlMNPUrnMgQ2]{명사수}

당신 부대의 원거리 사격이 아군 부대의 기동을 위한 엄호와 보호를 제공합니다. 대상 부대의 AC를 상대로 원거리 타격을 시도합니다.

대성공 대상 부대에 2점의 피해를 입히고, 그 부대는 당신의 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 어떤 부대의 기동 전쟁 행동으로도 유발되는 반응을 할 수 없습니다.

성공 대상 부대에 1점의 피해를 입히고, 그 부대는 당신의 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 어떤 부대의 기동 전쟁 행동으로도 유발되는 반응을 할 수 없습니다.

실패 당신의 공격이 엄호 사격을 제공하지 못하지만, 대상 부대에 1점의 피해를 입힙니다.

대실패 당신의 시도가 실패합니다.

name: Bloodied but Unbroken

description.value: The army is at its greatest during the most desperate times. When the army's hit points are at or below its Rout Threshold, it gains a +1 status bonus to its AC, Mobility, Morale, and attack rolls. At 10th level or higher, this bonus increases to +2.

_desc_en: The army is at its greatest during the most desperate times. When the army's hit points are at or below its Rout Threshold, it gains a +1 status bonus to its AC, Mobility, Morale, and attack rolls. At 10th level or higher, this bonus increases to +2.
_desc_ko: 부대는 가장 절박한 순간에 최고의 기량을 발휘합니다. 부대의 히트 포인트가 궤멸 한계치 이하일 때, AC, 기동력, 사기, 명중 굴림에 +1 지위 보너스를 얻습니다. 10레벨 이상에서 이 보너스는 +2로 증가합니다.

name: Inspiring Entertainment

description.value: Your kingdom's artists and entertainers are talented and prolific, and there's never a shortage of new plays, operas, novels, music, sculptures, paintings, or other forms of distraction to entertain the citizens, even during times of upheaval. When you check for Unrest during the Upkeep phase of a Kingdom turn, you may roll a Culture-based check rather than a Loyalty-based check to determine the outcome. Your kingdom also gains a +2 status bonus to all Culture-based skill checks whenever your kingdom has at least 1 Unrest.

_desc_en: Your kingdom's artists and entertainers are talented and prolific, and there's never a shortage of new plays, operas, novels, music, sculptures, paintings, or other forms of distraction to entertain the citizens, even during times of upheaval. When you check for Unrest during the Upkeep phase of a Kingdom turn, you may roll a Culture-based check rather than a Loyalty-based check to determine the outcome. Your kingdom also gains a +2 status bonus to all Culture-based skill checks whenever your kingdom has at least 1 Unrest.
_desc_ko: 당신 왕국의 예술가와 연예인들은 재능 있고 다작하여, 격변의 시기에도 시민들을 즐겁게 할 새로운 연극, 오페라, 소설, 음악, 조각, 그림, 또는 그 밖의 여흥거리가 끊이지 않습니다. 왕국 턴의 유지 단계에서 소요를 확인할 때, 결과를 결정하기 위해 충성 기반 판정 대신 문화 기반 판정을 굴릴 수 있습니다. 또한 당신의 왕국은 소요가 최소 1 이상일 때마다 모든 문화 기반 기술 판정에 +2 지위 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Overwhelming Bombardment

description.value:
Requirement @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.ZSUPsqeMBDTaX2H4]{Explosive Shot}

Your siege engines focus all their fire on a fortification. This war action counts as using two ranged Strikes for the purposes of depleting an army's shots. Attempt a ranged Strike against the target fortification's AC.

Critical Success You deal 2 points of damage to the fortification. You also deal 1 point of damage to up to two armies of your choice that are within the fortification.

Success You deal 1 point of damage to the fortification, and an additional 1 point of damage either to the fortification or to an army within the fortification (your choice of which).

Failure You deal 1 damage to the fortification.

Critical Failure You deal no damage, and your army becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.ibcMcEGRbPRtk9Pu]{Outflanked} until the start of its next turn.

_desc_en:
Requirement @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.ZSUPsqeMBDTaX2H4]{Explosive Shot}

Your siege engines focus all their fire on a fortification. This war action counts as using two ranged Strikes for the purposes of depleting an army's shots. Attempt a ranged Strike against the target fortification's AC.

Critical Success You deal 2 points of damage to the fortification. You also deal 1 point of damage to up to two armies of your choice that are within the fortification.

Success You deal 1 point of damage to the fortification, and an additional 1 point of damage either to the fortification or to an army within the fortification (your choice of which).

Failure You deal 1 damage to the fortification.

Critical Failure You deal no damage, and your army becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.ibcMcEGRbPRtk9Pu]{Outflanked} until the start of its next turn.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.ZSUPsqeMBDTaX2H4]{폭발탄}

당신의 공성 병기가 모든 화력을 요새에 집중합니다. 이 전쟁 행동은 부대의 사격 소모를 계산할 때 원거리 타격 두 번을 사용한 것으로 칩니다. 대상 요새의 AC를 상대로 원거리 타격을 시도합니다.

대성공 요새에 2점의 피해를 줍니다. 또한 요새 내에 있는 당신이 선택한 최대 두 부대에 각각 1점의 피해를 줍니다.

성공 요새에 1점의 피해를 주고, 추가로 요새 또는 요새 내의 부대에 1점의 피해를 줍니다(둘 중 당신이 선택).

실패 요새에 1점의 피해를 줍니다.

대실패 아무 피해도 주지 못하고, 당신의 부대가 자신의 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.ibcMcEGRbPRtk9Pu]{측면 노출} 상태가 됩니다.

name: Flaming Shot

description.value: The army attacks with projectiles treated with alchemical or magical oils that ignite as they are fired. When your army succeeds at a ranged Strike, the target army must attempt a @Check[maneuver|dc:resolve(@actor.strikes.ranged.variants.0.mod + 10)] check against your army's attack DC; if it fails, the Strike inflicts [[/r 1 #damage]] additional point of damage.

_desc_en: The army attacks with projectiles treated with alchemical or magical oils that ignite as they are fired. When your army succeeds at a ranged Strike, the target army must attempt a @Check[maneuver|dc:resolve(@actor.strikes.ranged.variants.0.mod + 10)] check against your army's attack DC; if it fails, the Strike inflicts [[/r 1 #damage]] additional point of damage.
_desc_ko: 부대가 발사될 때 점화되는 연금술 또는 마법 기름을 바른 발사체로 공격합니다. 당신의 부대가 원거리 타격에 성공하면, 대상 부대는 당신 부대의 공격 DC를 상대로 @Check[maneuver|dc:resolve(@actor.strikes.ranged.variants.0.mod + 10)] 판정을 시도해야 합니다. 실패하면, 그 타격은 추가로 [[/r 1 #damage]]점의 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Feint

description.value:
Requirement Flexible Tactics

Your army launches a probing attack meant to trick the enemy into thinking you are attacking from one quarter while your real thrust comes elsewhere.

Critical Success The target army's defenses are thrown off; it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.ibcMcEGRbPRtk9Pu]{Outflanked} until the end of your turn.

Success The target army is fooled, but only momentarily. It is outflanked against the next melee Strike your army attempts against it before the end of your current turn.

Critical Failure The enemy anticipates your feint and presses the advantage. You are outflanked by the target army until the end of your next turn.

_desc_en:
Requirement Flexible Tactics

Your army launches a probing attack meant to trick the enemy into thinking you are attacking from one quarter while your real thrust comes elsewhere.

Critical Success The target army's defenses are thrown off; it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.ibcMcEGRbPRtk9Pu]{Outflanked} until the end of your turn.

Success The target army is fooled, but only momentarily. It is outflanked against the next melee Strike your army attempts against it before the end of your current turn.

Critical Failure The enemy anticipates your feint and presses the advantage. You are outflanked by the target army until the end of your next turn.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 유연한 전술

당신의 군대는 실제 주공이 다른 곳에서 이루어지는 동안 적이 한쪽 방면에서 공격받는다고 착각하도록 유도하는 견제 공격을 감행합니다.

대성공 대상 군대의 방어가 흐트러집니다. 대상 군대는 당신의 턴이 끝날 때까지 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.ibcMcEGRbPRtk9Pu]{측면 노출}됩니다.

성공 대상 군대는 속아 넘어가지만, 잠깐뿐입니다. 대상 군대는 이번 턴이 끝나기 전에 당신의 군대가 그 대상에게 시도하는 다음 근접 타격에 대해 측면 노출됩니다.

대실패 적이 당신의 기만 동작을 예측하고 그 이점을 파고듭니다. 당신의 군대는 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 대상 군대에게 측면 노출됩니다.

name: Disband Army

description.value: You can choose to disband an army with no check needed. If the army consisted of conscripts from your kingdom, the soldiers revert to being citizens. If the army was recruited from creatures encountered in the wilds, they return to their homes. A disbanded army no longer contributes to your kingdom's Consumption.

_desc_en: You can choose to disband an army with no check needed. If the army consisted of conscripts from your kingdom, the soldiers revert to being citizens. If the army was recruited from creatures encountered in the wilds, they return to their homes. A disbanded army no longer contributes to your kingdom's Consumption.
_desc_ko: 판정 없이 군대를 해산하기로 선택할 수 있습니다. 그 군대가 당신 왕국의 징집병으로 구성되어 있었다면, 병사들은 다시 시민으로 돌아갑니다. 야생에서 마주친 생물로 편성된 군대였다면, 그들은 자신의 고향으로 돌아갑니다. 해산된 군대는 더 이상 당신 왕국의 소비량에 기여하지 않습니다.

name: Retreat

description.value:
Prerequisite Your army is not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.2IqM1XHELKwARAx1]{Engaged}.

Your army tries to escape from the battlefield. If your army is already @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.8upne4E6Q7Da5T5w]{Distant}, it flees the battlefield, is no longer part of the war encounter, and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.aZImSBBmTHff2POP]{Routed}. Otherwise, your army gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.8upne4E6Q7Da5T5w]{Distant} condition.

_desc_en:
Prerequisite Your army is not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.2IqM1XHELKwARAx1]{Engaged}.

Your army tries to escape from the battlefield. If your army is already @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.8upne4E6Q7Da5T5w]{Distant}, it flees the battlefield, is no longer part of the war encounter, and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.aZImSBBmTHff2POP]{Routed}. Otherwise, your army gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.8upne4E6Q7Da5T5w]{Distant} condition.
_desc_ko:
선행조건 당신의 군대가 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.2IqM1XHELKwARAx1]{교전 중}이 아니어야 합니다.

당신의 군대가 전장에서 빠져나가려 시도합니다. 당신의 군대가 이미 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.8upne4E6Q7Da5T5w]{원거리} 상태라면, 전장에서 도주하여 더 이상 전쟁 조우의 일부가 아니게 되고 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.aZImSBBmTHff2POP]{궤멸} 상태가 됩니다. 그렇지 않으면, 당신의 군대는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.8upne4E6Q7Da5T5w]{원거리} 상태를 얻습니다.

name: Toughened Soldiers

description.value: The army is particularly hardy. Increase its maximum Hit Points by 1. You can take this tactic multiple times; each time you do, increase the army's maximum Hit Points by 1.

_desc_en: The army is particularly hardy. Increase its maximum Hit Points by 1. You can take this tactic multiple times; each time you do, increase the army's maximum Hit Points by 1.
_desc_ko: 군대가 특히 강인합니다. 최대 히트 포인트를 1 증가시킵니다. 이 전술은 여러 번 취득할 수 있으며, 취득할 때마다 군대의 최대 히트 포인트를 1씩 증가시킵니다.

name: Irrigation

description.value:
Requirements You control a hex adjacent to a river or lake that itself does not contain a river or lake.

You send excavators to build waterways, canals, or drainage systems to convey water from areas that have natural access to a river or lake. Spend RP as determined by the hex's most inhospitable terrain feature (see the Building on Rough Terrain sidebar on page 519). Then attempt a basic @Check[engineering|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check.

Critical Success The hex gains a river or lake terrain feature (or you change the effects of a previous critical failure at Irrigation in this hex into a failure); work with your GM to determine where these features appear in the hex. In addition, your workers were efficient and quick, and you regain half the RP you spent building the waterways.

Success As success, but without regaining any RP.

Failure You fail to build workable systems or to restore a previous critical failure, and the hex does not gain the river or lake terrain feature.

Critical Failure As failure, but your attempts at Irrigation are so completely useless that they become breeding grounds for disease. Gain 1 Unrest. From this point onward, at the start of your Kingdom turn's Event phase, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:4]. This flat check's DC increases by 1 for each hex in your kingdom that contains a critically failed attempt at Irrigation. If you fail this flat check, your kingdom suffers a Plague event in addition to any other event it might have. You can attempt this activity again in a later Kingdom turn to undo a critically failed Irrigation attempt.

_desc_en:
Requirements You control a hex adjacent to a river or lake that itself does not contain a river or lake.

You send excavators to build waterways, canals, or drainage systems to convey water from areas that have natural access to a river or lake. Then attempt a basic @Check[engineering|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check.

Critical Success The hex gains a river or lake terrain feature (or you change the effects of a previous critical failure at Irrigation in this hex into a failure); work with your GM to determine where these features appear in the hex. In addition, your workers were efficient and quick, and you regain half the RP you spent building the waterways.

Success As success, but without regaining any RP.

Failure You fail to build workable systems or to restore a previous critical failure, and the hex does not gain the river or lake terrain feature.

Critical Failure As failure, but your attempts at Irrigation are so completely useless that they become breeding grounds for disease. Gain 1 Unrest. From this point onward, at the start of your Kingdom turn's Event phase, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:4]. This flat check's DC increases by 1 for each hex in your kingdom that contains a critically failed attempt at Irrigation. If you fail this flat check, your kingdom suffers a Plague event in addition to any other event it might have. You can attempt this activity again in a later Kingdom turn to undo a critically failed Irrigation attempt.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 강이나 호수에 인접하되 그 자체는 강이나 호수를 포함하지 않는 헥스를 지배하고 있어야 합니다.

당신은 굴착 인부를 보내 강이나 호수에 자연적으로 접근할 수 있는 지역에서 물을 끌어오는 수로, 운하, 배수 시설을 건설합니다. 헥스에서 가장 열악한 지형 요소에 따라 결정되는 RP를 소비합니다(519페이지의 거친 지형에서의 건설 곁말상자 참조). 그런 다음 기본 @Check[engineering|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] 판정을 시도합니다.

대성공 헥스가 강 또는 호수 지형 요소를 얻습니다(또는 이 헥스에서 이전에 관개에 대실패했던 효과를 실패로 바꿉니다). 이러한 요소가 헥스의 어디에 나타나는지는 GM과 함께 정합니다. 또한, 당신의 인부들이 효율적이고 신속하여, 수로 건설에 소비한 RP의 절반을 되찾습니다.

성공 대성공과 같지만, RP를 되찾지는 못합니다.

실패 작동하는 시설을 건설하지 못하거나 이전의 대실패를 복구하지 못하며, 헥스는 강 또는 호수 지형 요소를 얻지 못합니다.

대실패 실패와 같지만, 당신의 관개 시도가 완전히 쓸모없어져 질병의 온상이 됩니다. 불안 1을 얻습니다. 이 시점부터 왕국 턴의 사건 단계 시작 시, @Check[flat|dc:4]를 시도합니다. 이 평면 판정의 DC는 당신 왕국에서 관개에 대실패한 시도를 포함하는 헥스마다 1씩 증가합니다. 이 평면 판정에 실패하면, 당신의 왕국은 다른 사건이 있더라도 이에 더해 역병 사건을 겪습니다. 이후 왕국 턴에서 이 활동을 다시 시도하여 대실패한 관개 시도를 되돌릴 수 있습니다.

name: Clear Hex

description.value:
Engineers and mercenaries attempt to prepare a hex to serve as the site for a settlement, or they work to remove an existing improvement, a dangerous hazard, or an encounter. If you're trying to prepare a hex for a settlement or demolish an improvement you previously built (or that was already present in the hex), spend RP as determined by the hex's most inhospitable terrain feature (see the Building on Rough Terrain sidebar nearby). Then attempt a basic @Check[engineering|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check. If you're trying to remove a hazard or encounter, instead attempt an @Check[exploration|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check. The DC of this check is set by the highest level creature or hazard in the hex (as set by Table 10–5: DCs by Level, on page 503 of the Pathfinder Core Rulebook). If the hex you're attempting to Clear has existing Ruins or an existing Structure, your action doesn't physically remove the buildings from the area and you can later incorporate these buildings (or repair ruined ones) into a Settlement you build here later (see page 542). Regardless of the skill used, increase the basic DC by 2 if the hex to be cleared is not yet part of your kingdom.

Critical Success You successfully clear the hex. If you spent RP to attempt this activity, you're refunded half of the RP cost. If you were removing dangerous creatures (but not hazards) from the hex, your explorers and mercenaries recover 2 Luxury Commodities as treasure.

Success You successfully clear the hex.

Failure You fail to clear the hex.

Critical Failure You catastrophically fail to clear the hex and several workers lose their lives. Gain 1 Unrest.

Failure You fail to clear the hex.

Critical Failure You catastrophically fail to clear the hex and several workers lose their lives. Gain 1 Unrest.
_desc_ko:
기술자와 용병들이 헥스를 정착지 부지로 사용할 수 있도록 정비하려 시도하거나, 기존 개량 시설, 위험한 위험 요소, 또는 조우를 제거하려 작업합니다. 정착지를 위해 헥스를 정비하거나 이전에 건설한(또는 이미 헥스에 있던) 개량 시설을 철거하려 한다면, 헥스에서 가장 열악한 지형 요소에 따라 결정되는 RP를 소비합니다(근처의 거친 지형에서의 건설 곁말상자 참조). 그런 다음 기본 @Check[engineering|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] 판정을 시도합니다. 위험 요소나 조우를 제거하려 한다면, 대신 @Check[exploration|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] 판정을 시도합니다. 이 판정의 DC는 헥스에서 가장 높은 레벨의 생물이나 위험 요소에 의해 정해집니다(Pathfinder Core Rulebook 503페이지의 표 10–5: 레벨별 DC 참조). 정리하려는 헥스에 기존 폐허나 기존 구조물이 있다면, 당신의 행동은 그 건물을 물리적으로 제거하지 않으며, 나중에 이곳에 정착지를 건설할 때 이 건물들을 편입하거나 폐허가 된 건물을 수리할 수 있습니다(542페이지 참조). 사용된 기술과 무관하게, 정리하려는 헥스가 아직 당신 왕국의 일부가 아니라면 기본 DC를 2 증가시킵니다.

대성공 헥스를 성공적으로 정리합니다. 이 활동을 시도하기 위해 RP를 소비했다면, RP 비용의 절반을 환급받습니다. 헥스에서 위험한 생물(위험 요소는 제외)을 제거하고 있었다면, 당신의 탐험가와 용병들이 사치품 물자 2를 보물로 회수합니다.

성공 헥스를 성공적으로 정리합니다.

실패 헥스를 정리하지 못합니다.

대실패 헥스 정리에 처참하게 실패하고 여러 인부가 목숨을 잃습니다. 불안 1을 얻습니다.

name: Abandon Hex

description.value:
Requirements The hex to be abandoned must be controlled.

After careful consideration, you decide that you would rather not hold onto a particular hex as part of your claimed territory. You renounce your claim to it and pull back any settlers or explorers. Attempt a basic @Check[exploration|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] or @Check[wilderness|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check. You can abandon more than one hex at a time, but each additional hex you abandon increases the DC of this check by 1.

Critical Success You abandon the hex or hexes, decreasing your kingdom's Size by 1 per hex abandoned (this affects all statistics determined by Size; see page 532). Settlers and explorers return and resettle elsewhere in your kingdom, bringing with them bits of salvage from the abandoned hexes. Gain 1 RP per abandoned hex.

Success As critical success, but you gain no RP and increase Unrest by 1.

Failure You abandon the hex or hexes, decreasing your kingdom's Size by 1 per hex abandoned (this affects all statistics determined by Size; see page 532). Some citizens become disgruntled refugees who refuse to leave the hex. Increase Unrest by 2 and then attempt a @Check[flat|dc:6]. If you fail, the refugees become bandits, and during your next Event phase, your kingdom experiences a Squatters kingdom event automatically in addition to any other event that might occur.

Critical Failure As failure, but increase Unrest by 3 and automatically experience a Bandit Activity kingdom event instead of a Squatters event.

Special The Unrest gained from abandoning a hex doubles if it includes a settlement. A settlement in an abandoned hex becomes a Freehold.

_desc_ko:
요구조건 포기하려는 헥스를 지배하고 있어야 합니다.

신중히 고려한 끝에, 당신은 특정 헥스를 당신이 주장하는 영토의 일부로 유지하지 않기로 결정합니다. 그에 대한 영유권을 포기하고 정착민이나 탐험가를 철수시킵니다. 기본 @Check[exploration|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] 또는 @Check[wilderness|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] 판정을 시도합니다. 한 번에 여러 헥스를 포기할 수 있지만, 포기하는 헥스가 추가될 때마다 이 판정의 DC가 1씩 증가합니다.

대성공 헥스(들)를 포기하여, 포기한 헥스당 왕국의 크기를 1씩 감소시킵니다(이는 크기로 결정되는 모든 능력치에 영향을 줍니다. 532페이지 참조). 정착민과 탐험가들이 돌아와 왕국의 다른 곳에 재정착하며, 포기한 헥스에서 나온 잔해 조각들을 가져옵니다. 포기한 헥스당 RP 1을 얻습니다.

성공 대성공과 같지만, RP를 얻지 못하고 불안이 1 증가합니다.

실패 헥스(들)를 포기하여, 포기한 헥스당 왕국의 크기를 1씩 감소시킵니다(이는 크기로 결정되는 모든 능력치에 영향을 줍니다. 532페이지 참조). 일부 시민이 불만을 품은 난민이 되어 헥스를 떠나기를 거부합니다. 불안을 2 증가시킨 다음 @Check[flat|dc:6]를 시도합니다. 실패하면, 난민들이 산적이 되어, 다음 사건 단계 동안 당신의 왕국은 발생할 수 있는 다른 사건에 더해 무단 거주자 왕국 사건을 자동으로 겪습니다.

대실패 실패와 같지만, 불안을 3 증가시키고 무단 거주자 사건 대신 산적 활동 왕국 사건을 자동으로 겪습니다.

특수 정착지를 포함한 헥스를 포기하면 그로 인해 얻는 불안이 두 배가 됩니다. 포기된 헥스의 정착지는 자유 영지가 됩니다.

name: Fortified Fiefs

description.value: Your vassals take their duty to protect those under their stewardship seriously, and your engineers emphasize the value of a strong defense when it comes to building settlements and fortifications. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks attempted as part of the Fortify Hex activity and on activities to build or repair a Barracks, Castle, Garrison, Keep, Stone Wall, or Wooden Wall. In addition, you gain a +1 status bonus to all kingdom checks attempted during dangerous events that directly impact your settlements' defenses.

_desc_en: Your vassals take their duty to protect those under their stewardship seriously, and your engineers emphasize the value of a strong defense when it comes to building settlements and fortifications. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks attempted as part of the Fortify Hex activity and on activities to build or repair a Barracks, Castle, Garrison, Keep, Stone Wall, or Wooden Wall. In addition, you gain a +1 status bonus to all kingdom checks attempted during dangerous events that directly impact your settlements' defenses.
_desc_ko: 당신의 봉신들은 자신의 관할하에 있는 이들을 보호하는 의무를 진지하게 받아들이며, 당신의 기술자들은 정착지와 방어 시설을 건설할 때 강력한 방어의 가치를 강조합니다. 헥스 요새화 활동의 일부로 시도하는 판정과 병영, 성, 주둔지, 성채, 석벽, 목벽을 건설하거나 수리하는 활동에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 또한, 정착지 방어에 직접적으로 영향을 미치는 위험한 사건 동안 시도하는 모든 왕국 판정에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Civil Service

description.value:
Everyone has a place and a role, and as long as those roles are filled, the government functions. When you select this feat, choose one leadership role; that role is now supported by your efficient civil servants, so its vacancy penalty is no longer applicable. If you wish to change the leadership role to which Civil Service applies, you can do so using the New Leadership activity at the start of a Kingdom turn.

You gain a +2 status bonus to New Leadership checks.

_desc_en:
Everyone has a place and a role, and as long as those roles are filled, the government functions. When you select this feat, choose one leadership role; that role is now supported by your efficient civil servants, so its vacancy penalty is no longer applicable. If you wish to change the leadership role to which Civil Service applies, you can do so using the New Leadership activity at the start of a Kingdom turn.

You gain a +2 status bonus to New Leadership checks.
_desc_ko:
모든 이에게는 자리와 역할이 있으며, 그 역할이 채워져 있는 한 정부는 기능합니다. 이 재주를 선택할 때, 지도자 역할 하나를 고릅니다. 그 역할은 이제 유능한 공무원들에 의해 뒷받침되므로, 그 공석 페널티가 더 이상 적용되지 않습니다. 공무 조직이 적용되는 지도자 역할을 바꾸고자 한다면, 왕국 턴 시작 시 신임 지도부 활동을 사용하여 그렇게 할 수 있습니다.

신임 지도부 판정에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Manage Trade Agreements

description.value:
You send agents out to attend to established trade agreements. Spend 2 RP per Trade Agreement you wish to manage. Then attempt a basic @Check[trade|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check. If you Managed Trade Agreements on the previous turn, increase this DC by 5.

Critical Success At the start of your next Kingdom turn, you gain 1 bonus Resource Die per trade agreement, and 1 Commodity of your choice per trade agreement (no more than half of these Commodities may be Luxuries).

Success As critical success, but you must choose between gaining Resource Dice or Commodities.

Failure You gain 1 RP per trade agreement at the start of your next turn.

Critical Failure You gain no benefit, as your traders and merchants met with bad luck on the road. You can't Manage Trade Agreements for 1 Kingdom turn.

_desc_en:
You send agents out to attend to established trade agreements. Spend 2 RP per Trade Agreement you wish to manage. Then attempt a basic @Check[trade|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check. If you Managed Trade Agreements on the previous turn, increase this DC by 5.

Critical Success At the start of your next Kingdom turn, you gain 1 bonus Resource Die per trade agreement, and 1 Commodity of your choice per trade agreement (no more than half of these Commodities may be Luxuries).

Success As critical success, but you must choose between gaining Resource Dice or Commodities.

Failure You gain 1 RP per trade agreement at the start of your next turn.

Critical Failure You gain no benefit, as your traders and merchants met with bad luck on the road. You can't Manage Trade Agreements for 1 Kingdom turn.
_desc_ko:
당신은 성립된 교역 협정을 처리하기 위해 요원을 파견합니다. 관리하고자 하는 교역 협정당 RP 2를 소비합니다. 그런 다음 기본 @Check[trade|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] 판정을 시도합니다. 이전 턴에 교역 협정을 관리했다면, 이 DC를 5 증가시킵니다.

대성공 다음 왕국 턴 시작 시, 교역 협정당 보너스 자원 주사위 1개와 교역 협정당 원하는 물자 1을 얻습니다(이 물자의 절반 이상이 사치품이어서는 안 됩니다).

성공 대성공과 같지만, 자원 주사위와 물자 중 하나를 선택해야 합니다.

실패 다음 턴 시작 시 교역 협정당 RP 1을 얻습니다.

대실패 당신의 상인과 무역업자들이 노중에서 불운을 겪어 아무런 이익을 얻지 못합니다. 왕국 턴 1회 동안 교역 협정을 관리할 수 없습니다.

name: Settlement Construction

description.value:
You can establish villages in your kingdom immediately (page 542). At 3rd level, you can expand villages into towns. At 9th level, you can expand towns into cities. And at 15th level, you can expand cities into metropolises.

As villages grow into larger settlements, you not only gain more room to build, but the maximum item bonus you can gain from that settlement's structures increases as well (see table on page 541).

_desc_en:
You can establish villages in your kingdom immediately (page 542). At 3rd level, you can expand villages into towns. At 9th level, you can expand towns into cities. And at 15th level, you can expand cities into metropolises.

As villages grow into larger settlements, you not only gain more room to build, but the maximum item bonus you can gain from that settlement's structures increases as well (see table on page 541).
_desc_ko:
당신은 즉시 왕국에 마을을 세울 수 있습니다(542페이지). 3레벨에는 마을을 읍으로 확장할 수 있습니다. 9레벨에는 읍을 도시로 확장할 수 있습니다. 그리고 15레벨에는 도시를 대도시로 확장할 수 있습니다.

마을이 더 큰 정착지로 성장함에 따라, 건설할 공간이 더 늘어날 뿐만 아니라 그 정착지의 구조물에서 얻을 수 있는 최대 아이템 보너스도 증가합니다(541페이지의 표 참조).

name: Supernatural Solution

description.value:
Your spellcasters try to resolve issues when mundane solutions just aren't enough. Attempt a basic @Check[magic|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check.

Critical Success You can call upon your spellcasters' supernatural solution to aid in resolving any Kingdom skill check made during the remainder of this Kingdom turn. Do so just before a Kingdom skill check is rolled (by yourself or any other PC). Attempt a Magic check against the same DC in addition to the Kingdom skill check, and take whichever of the two results you prefer. If you don't use your Supernatural Solution by the end of this Kingdom turn, this benefit ends and you gain 10 kingdom XP instead.

Success As critical success, but the solution costs the kingdom 1d4 RP to research. This cost is paid now, whether or not you use your supernatural solution.

Failure Your attempt at researching a supernatural solution costs the kingdom [[/r 2d6 #RP]]{2d6 RP}, but is ultimately a failure, providing no advantage.

Critical Failure As failure, but your spellcasters' resources and morale are impacted such that you cannot attempt a Supernatural Solution again for 2 Kingdom turns.

Special You cannot influence a check with Supernatural Solution and Creative Solution simultaneously

_desc_en:
Your spellcasters try to resolve issues when mundane solutions just aren't enough. Attempt a basic @Check[magic|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check.

Critical Success You can call upon your spellcasters' supernatural solution to aid in resolving any Kingdom skill check made during the remainder of this Kingdom turn. Do so just before a Kingdom skill check is rolled (by yourself or any other PC). Attempt a Magic check against the same DC in addition to the Kingdom skill check, and take whichever of the two results you prefer. If you don't use your Supernatural Solution by the end of this Kingdom turn, this benefit ends and you gain 10 kingdom XP instead.

Success As critical success, but the solution costs the kingdom 1d4 RP to research. This cost is paid now, whether or not you use your supernatural solution.

Failure Your attempt at researching a supernatural solution costs the kingdom [[/r 2d6 #RP]]{2d6 RP}, but is ultimately a failure, providing no advantage.

Critical Failure As failure, but your spellcasters' resources and morale are impacted such that you cannot attempt a Supernatural Solution again for 2 Kingdom turns.

Special You cannot influence a check with Supernatural Solution and Creative Solution simultaneously
_desc_ko:
당신의 주문시전자들은 평범한 해결책만으로는 충분하지 않을 때 문제를 해결하려 시도합니다. 기본 @Check[magic|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] 판정을 시도합니다.

대성공 이번 왕국 턴의 남은 동안 이루어지는 어떤 왕국 기술 판정이든 해결하는 데 도움이 되도록 당신의 주문시전자들의 초자연적 해결책을 불러올 수 있습니다. 왕국 기술 판정을 굴리기 직전에(당신 자신 또는 다른 PC가) 그렇게 합니다. 왕국 기술 판정에 더해 같은 DC에 대한 마법 판정을 시도하고, 두 결과 중 선호하는 쪽을 취합니다. 이번 왕국 턴이 끝날 때까지 초자연적 해결책을 사용하지 않으면, 이 혜택은 종료되고 대신 왕국 XP 10을 얻습니다.

성공 대성공과 같지만, 그 해결책은 연구에 왕국의 RP 1d4를 소모합니다. 이 비용은 초자연적 해결책의 사용 여부와 관계없이 지금 지불됩니다.

실패 초자연적 해결책을 연구하려는 시도가 왕국의 [[/r 2d6 #RP]]{RP 2d6}를 소모하지만, 결국 실패하여 아무런 이점도 제공하지 않습니다.

대실패 실패와 같지만, 당신의 주문시전자들의 자원과 사기가 타격을 입어 2 왕국 턴 동안 초자연적 해결책을 다시 시도할 수 없습니다.

특수 초자연적 해결책과 창의적 해결책으로 판정에 동시에 영향을 줄 수 없습니다.

name: Infiltration

description.value:
You send spies out to gather intelligence on a neighboring nation, a cult or thieves' guild within your borders, an unclaimed Freehold, or even an unexplored adventure site. Alternately, you can simply send your spies out to investigate the current health of your kingdom. Attempt a basic @Check[intrigue|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check.

Critical Success You learn something valuable or helpful. If you were infiltrating a specific target, the GM decides what is learned, but the information is exact and precise. For example, if you were infiltrating an unexplored ruin, you might learn that the site is infested with web lurkers and spider swarms. If you were investigating your kingdom's health, your spies reveal easy methods to address citizen dissatisfaction, allowing you to choose one of the following: reduce Unrest by 1d4 or reduce a Ruin of your choice by 1.

Success You learn something helpful about the target, but the information is vague and imprecise. For example, if you were infiltrating the same ruin mentioned in the critical success above, you might learn that some sort of aberration uses the ruins as its lair. If you were investigating your kingdom's health, your spies learn enough that you can take action. Reduce your kingdom's Unrest by 1.

Failure Your spies fail to learn anything of import, but they are not themselves compromised.

Critical Failure You never hear from your spies again, but someone certainly does! You take a –2 circumstance penalty on all kingdom checks until the end of the next Kingdom turn as counter-infiltration from an unknown enemy tampers with your kingdom's inner workings.
