_desc_ko:
당신은 첩자를 파견하여 이웃 국가, 국경 안의 교단이나 도둑 길드, 영유권이 없는 자유 영지, 또는 아직 탐험되지 않은 모험지에 대한 정보를 수집합니다. 대안으로, 단순히 첩자를 보내 당신 왕국의 현재 상태를 조사할 수도 있습니다. 기본 @Check[intrigue|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] 판정을 시도합니다.

대성공 당신은 가치 있거나 유용한 무언가를 알아냅니다. 특정 대상에 잠입하고 있었다면, GM이 무엇을 알아내는지 결정하지만, 그 정보는 정확하고 상세합니다. 예를 들어, 미탐험 폐허에 잠입하고 있었다면, 그곳에 거미줄 잠복자와 거미 무리가 우글거린다는 것을 알아낼 수 있습니다. 왕국의 상태를 조사하고 있었다면, 첩자들이 시민 불만을 해소하는 손쉬운 방법을 밝혀내어, 다음 중 하나를 선택할 수 있습니다: 불안 1d4 감소, 또는 원하는 폐허 1 감소.

성공 당신은 대상에 대해 유용한 무언가를 알아내지만, 그 정보는 막연하고 부정확합니다. 예를 들어, 위 대성공에서 언급된 같은 폐허에 잠입하고 있었다면, 어떤 종류의 기형체가 그 폐허를 소굴로 사용한다는 것을 알아낼 수 있습니다. 왕국의 상태를 조사하고 있었다면, 첩자들이 조치를 취할 수 있을 만큼 알아냅니다. 왕국의 불안을 1 감소시킵니다.

실패 당신의 첩자들은 중요한 것을 아무것도 알아내지 못하지만, 자신들이 발각되지는 않습니다.

대실패 당신은 첩자들의 소식을 다시는 듣지 못하지만, 분명 누군가는 듣습니다! 알 수 없는 적이 당신 왕국의 내부 운영을 교란하는 역잠입을 벌이는 동안, 다음 왕국 턴이 끝날 때까지 모든 왕국 판정에 –2 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Build Structure

description.value: You attempt to build a structure in the settlement that's granting the Civic activity. You may choose any structure for which you meet the requirements. Select the appropriate number of contiguous buildable lots in a single block as specified by the structure's entry and spend the specified RP and Commodity cost. Then attempt the structure's skill check. You can also use this activity to attempt to repair a structure that was damaged as the result of an event but hasn't been replaced by Rubble. To do this, first spend half the structure's listed RP and Commodity cost, and then attempt the specified check. The existing structure gives you a +2 item bonus to the check. On a success, record the new construction on the Urban Grid. Unless the structure's entry states otherwise, its effects are immediate; if the structure adjusts a Ruin's point total, adjust it upon construction.

_desc_en: You attempt to build a structure in the settlement that's granting the Civic activity. You may choose any structure for which you meet the requirements. Select the appropriate number of contiguous buildable lots in a single block as specified by the structure's entry and spend the specified RP and Commodity cost. Then attempt the structure's skill check. You can also use this activity to attempt to repair a structure that was damaged as the result of an event but hasn't been replaced by Rubble. To do this, first spend half the structure's listed RP and Commodity cost, and then attempt the specified check. The existing structure gives you a +2 item bonus to the check. On a success, record the new construction on the Urban Grid. Unless the structure's entry states otherwise, its effects are immediate; if the structure adjusts a Ruin's point total, adjust it upon construction.
_desc_ko: 당신은 시정 활동을 부여하는 정착지에 구조물을 건설하려 시도합니다. 요구조건을 충족하는 어떤 구조물이든 선택할 수 있습니다. 구조물 항목에 명시된 대로 단일 블록 내에서 인접한 건설 가능 부지를 적절한 수만큼 선택하고, 명시된 RP 및 물자 비용을 소비합니다. 그런 다음 구조물의 기술 판정을 시도합니다. 이 활동을 사용하여 사건의 결과로 손상되었으나 아직 잔해로 대체되지 않은 구조물을 수리하려 시도할 수도 있습니다. 그렇게 하려면, 먼저 구조물에 표기된 RP 및 물자 비용의 절반을 소비한 다음, 명시된 판정을 시도합니다. 기존 구조물은 판정에 +2 아이템 보너스를 줍니다. 성공 시, 도시 격자에 새 건축물을 기록합니다. 구조물 항목에 달리 명시되지 않는 한, 그 효과는 즉각적입니다. 구조물이 폐허의 총점을 조정한다면, 건설 즉시 조정합니다.

name: Liquidate Resources

description.value: Your kingdom's economy can liquidate resources in an emergency when funding runs out. The first time during a Kingdom turn in which you are forced to spend RP as the result of a failed skill check or a dangerous event, and that expense reduces you to 0 RP, you may instead reduce your RP to 1 and treat the expense as if it were paid in full. At the start of your next Kingdom turn, roll 4 fewer Resource Dice than normal.

_desc_en: Your kingdom's economy can liquidate resources in an emergency when funding runs out. The first time during a Kingdom turn in which you are forced to spend RP as the result of a failed skill check or a dangerous event, and that expense reduces you to 0 RP, you may instead reduce your RP to 1 and treat the expense as if it were paid in full. At the start of your next Kingdom turn, roll 4 fewer Resource Dice than normal.
_desc_ko: 당신 왕국의 경제는 자금이 바닥났을 때 비상시에 자원을 처분할 수 있습니다. 왕국 턴 중 실패한 기술 판정이나 위험한 사건의 결과로 RP를 소비해야 하고 그 지출로 RP가 0까지 줄어드는 첫 번째 경우, 대신 RP를 1로 줄이고 그 지출이 전액 지불된 것으로 취급할 수 있습니다. 다음 왕국 턴 시작 시, 평소보다 자원 주사위를 4개 적게 굴립니다.

name: Free and Fair

description.value: Your reputation for transparency and fairness in conducting elections, appointments, and other changes in government inspires tremendous public trust. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Loyalty-based checks attempted as part of the New Leadership and Pledge of Fealty activities. If you fail or critically fail such a check, you can spend 2 RP to reroll the check (but without the +2 circumstance bonus); attempting this adds the Fortune trait. You must take the result of the second roll, even if it is worse than the original roll.

_desc_en: Your reputation for transparency and fairness in conducting elections, appointments, and other changes in government inspires tremendous public trust. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Loyalty-based checks attempted as part of the New Leadership and Pledge of Fealty activities. If you fail or critically fail such a check, you can spend 2 RP to reroll the check (but without the +2 circumstance bonus); attempting this adds the Fortune trait. You must take the result of the second roll, even if it is worse than the original roll.
_desc_ko: 선거, 임명, 그 밖의 정부 교체를 투명하고 공정하게 진행한다는 당신의 명성이 엄청난 대중적 신뢰를 불러일으킵니다. 신임 지도부와 충성 서약 활동의 일부로 시도하는 충성도 기반 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 그러한 판정에 실패하거나 대실패하면, RP 2를 소비하여 그 판정을 재굴림할 수 있습니다(단, +2 상황 보너스 없이). 이렇게 시도하면 행운 특성이 추가됩니다. 두 번째 굴림의 결과가 원래 굴림보다 나쁘더라도 그 결과를 취해야 합니다.

name: Quality of Life

description.value: Your kingdom's robust economy makes the creature comforts of civilization more readily available to all, and even finer luxuries are more easily had. The first time you gain Luxury Commodities in a Kingdom turn, increase the total gained by 1. All of your settlements are treated as 1 level higher than their actual level for the purposes of determining what sorts of magic items might be offered for sale at their markets and shops.

_desc_en: Your kingdom's robust economy makes the creature comforts of civilization more readily available to all, and even finer luxuries are more easily had. The first time you gain Luxury Commodities in a Kingdom turn, increase the total gained by 1. All of your settlements are treated as 1 level higher than their actual level for the purposes of determining what sorts of magic items might be offered for sale at their markets and shops.
_desc_ko: 당신 왕국의 탄탄한 경제는 문명의 편의를 모두에게 더욱 손쉽게 제공하며, 심지어 더 고급스러운 사치품도 더 쉽게 구할 수 있게 합니다. 왕국 턴에 사치품 물자를 얻는 첫 번째 경우, 얻는 총량을 1 증가시킵니다. 당신의 모든 정착지는 시장과 상점에서 어떤 종류의 마법 아이템이 판매될 수 있는지 결정하는 목적상 실제 레벨보다 1 레벨 높은 것으로 취급됩니다.

name: Disengage

description.value:
Your army attempts to disengage from enemy armies to put some distance between itself and the enemy.

Attempt a @Check[maneuver|defense:maneuver|roller:self|options:action:disengage] check against each army your army is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.2IqM1XHELKwARAx1]{Engaged} with.

Critical Success Your army is no longer engaged with the target army. In addition, your army is automatically no longer engaged with any armies you haven't yet rolled a Maneuver check against during this war action.

Success Your army breaks free and is no longer engaged with the target army.

Failure Your army remains engaged with the target army.

Critical Failure Your army remains engaged with the target army and, for the remainder of this turn, your army cannot attempt to disengage from any army with which it is still engaged.

_desc_en:
Your army attempts to disengage from enemy armies to put some distance between itself and the enemy.

Attempt a @Check[maneuver|defense:maneuver|roller:self|options:action:disengage] check against each army your army is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.2IqM1XHELKwARAx1]{Engaged} with.

Critical Success Your army is no longer engaged with the target army. In addition, your army is automatically no longer engaged with any armies you haven't yet rolled a Maneuver check against during this war action.

Success Your army breaks free and is no longer engaged with the target army.

Failure Your army remains engaged with the target army.

Critical Failure Your army remains engaged with the target army and, for the remainder of this turn, your army cannot attempt to disengage from any army with which it is still engaged.
_desc_ko:
당신의 군대는 적 군대로부터 교전을 이탈하여 자신과 적 사이에 거리를 두려 시도합니다.

당신의 군대가 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.2IqM1XHELKwARAx1]{교전 중}인 각 군대에 대해 @Check[maneuver|defense:maneuver|roller:self|options:action:disengage] 판정을 시도합니다.

대성공 당신의 군대는 더 이상 대상 군대와 교전 중이 아닙니다. 또한, 당신의 군대는 이번 전쟁 행동 동안 아직 기동 판정을 굴리지 않은 모든 군대와도 자동으로 더 이상 교전 중이 아니게 됩니다.

성공 당신의 군대가 빠져나와 더 이상 대상 군대와 교전 중이 아닙니다.

실패 당신의 군대는 대상 군대와 계속 교전 중입니다.

대실패 당신의 군대는 대상 군대와 계속 교전 중이며, 이번 턴의 남은 동안 여전히 교전 중인 어떤 군대로부터도 교전 이탈을 시도할 수 없습니다.

name: Request Foreign Aid

description.value:
Requirements You have diplomatic relations with the group you are requesting aid from.

When disaster strikes, you send out a call for help to another nation with whom you have diplomatic relations. The DC of this check is equal to the other group's Negotiation DC +2 (see the sidebar on page 519).

Critical Success Your ally's aid grants a +4 circumstance bonus to any one Kingdom skill check attempted during the remainder of this Kingdom turn. You can choose to apply this bonus to any Kingdom skill check after the die is rolled, but must do so before the result is known. In addition, immediately roll 2 Resource Dice and gain RP equal to the result; this RP does not accrue into XP at the end of the turn if you don't spend it.

Success As success, but choose the benefit given by the aid: either roll 1 Resource Die and gain RP equal to the result or gain a +2 circumstance bonus to a check.

Failure Your ally marshals its resources but cannot get aid to you in time to deal with your current situation. At the start of your next Kingdom turn, gain [[/r 1d4 #RP]]{1d4 RP}.

Critical Failure Your ally is tangled up in its own problems and is unable to assist you, is insulted by your request for aid, or might even have an interest in seeing your kingdom struggle against one of your ongoing events. Whatever the case, your pleas for aid make your kingdom look desperate. You gain no aid, but you do increase Unrest by [[/r 1d4]].

_desc_en:
Requirements You have diplomatic relations with the group you are requesting aid from.

When disaster strikes, you send out a call for help to another nation with whom you have diplomatic relations. The DC of this check is equal to the other group's Negotiation DC +2 (see the sidebar on page 519).

Critical Success Your ally's aid grants a +4 circumstance bonus to any one Kingdom skill check attempted during the remainder of this Kingdom turn. You can choose to apply this bonus to any Kingdom skill check after the die is rolled, but must do so before the result is known. In addition, immediately roll 2 Resource Dice and gain RP equal to the result; this RP does not accrue into XP at the end of the turn if you don't spend it.

Success As success, but choose the benefit given by the aid: either roll 1 Resource Die and gain RP equal to the result or gain a +2 circumstance bonus to a check.

Failure Your ally marshals its resources but cannot get aid to you in time to deal with your current situation. At the start of your next Kingdom turn, gain [[/r 1d4 #RP]]{1d4 RP}.

Critical Failure Your ally is tangled up in its own problems and is unable to assist you, is insulted by your request for aid, or might even have an interest in seeing your kingdom struggle against one of your ongoing events. Whatever the case, your pleas for aid make your kingdom look desperate. You gain no aid, but you do increase Unrest by [[/r 1d4]].
_desc_ko:
요구조건 원조를 요청하는 집단과 외교 관계를 맺고 있어야 합니다.

재난이 닥치면, 당신은 외교 관계를 맺은 다른 국가에 도움을 요청합니다. 이 판정의 DC는 상대 집단의 협상 DC +2와 같습니다(519페이지 곁말상자 참조).

대성공 동맹의 원조가 이번 왕국 턴의 남은 동안 시도하는 어떤 왕국 기술 판정 하나에 +4 상황 보너스를 부여합니다. 주사위를 굴린 후에 어떤 왕국 기술 판정에든 이 보너스를 적용하기로 선택할 수 있지만, 결과를 알기 전에 그렇게 해야 합니다. 또한, 즉시 자원 주사위 2개를 굴려 그 결과와 같은 RP를 얻습니다. 이 RP는 소비하지 않아도 턴 종료 시 XP로 누적되지 않습니다.

성공 성공과 같지만, 원조가 주는 혜택을 선택합니다: 자원 주사위 1개를 굴려 그 결과와 같은 RP를 얻거나, 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

실패 동맹이 자원을 동원하지만 당신의 현 상황에 대처할 만큼 제때 원조를 보내지 못합니다. 다음 왕국 턴 시작 시, [[/r 1d4 #RP]]{RP 1d4}를 얻습니다.

대실패 동맹은 자신의 문제에 얽매여 당신을 도울 수 없거나, 당신의 원조 요청에 모욕감을 느끼거나, 심지어 당신의 왕국이 진행 중인 사건에 맞서 고전하는 것을 보고 싶어 할지도 모릅니다. 어느 경우든, 당신의 원조 요청은 왕국을 절박해 보이게 만듭니다. 원조를 얻지 못하지만, 불안을 [[/r 1d4]] 증가시킵니다.

name: Merciless

description.value:
This army is difficult to escape from. The army's Maneuver DC gains a +2 status bonus when other armies attempt Maneuver checks against it while attempting to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.Pu5bptxLrKFyEzFh]{Disengage}.

This army can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.Z6jMZgAxI1zRO7Sl]{All-Out Assault} tactical war action.

_desc_en:
This army is difficult to escape from. The army's Maneuver DC gains a +2 status bonus when other armies attempt Maneuver checks against it while attempting to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.Pu5bptxLrKFyEzFh]{Disengage}.

This army can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.Z6jMZgAxI1zRO7Sl]{All-Out Assault} tactical war action.
_desc_ko:
이 군대는 벗어나기 어렵습니다. 다른 군대가 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.Pu5bptxLrKFyEzFh]{교전 이탈}을 시도하며 이 군대에 대해 기동 판정을 시도할 때, 이 군대의 기동 DC는 +2 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

이 군대는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.Z6jMZgAxI1zRO7Sl]{전면 강습} 전술 전쟁 행동을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Focused Attention

description.value: You set aside time to focus attention on aiding another leader in an activity. Choose another leader and a Kingdom skill, then attempt a DC 20 check using the chosen skill. On a success, you grant that leader a +2 circumstance bonus to one kingdom check using that skill, provided that leader attempts the skill check during the same Kingdom turn. The Cooperative Leadership Kingdom feat increases the efficiency of this activity.

_desc_en: You set aside time to focus attention on aiding another leader in an activity. Choose another leader and a Kingdom skill, then attempt a DC 20 check using the chosen skill. On a success, you grant that leader a +2 circumstance bonus to one kingdom check using that skill, provided that leader attempts the skill check during the same Kingdom turn. The Cooperative Leadership Kingdom feat increases the efficiency of this activity.
_desc_ko: 당신은 다른 지도자의 활동을 돕는 데 주의를 기울일 시간을 따로 마련합니다. 다른 지도자와 왕국 기술 하나를 선택한 다음, 선택한 기술을 사용하여 DC 20 판정을 시도합니다. 성공 시, 그 지도자가 같은 왕국 턴 동안 해당 기술 판정을 시도하는 한, 그 기술을 사용하는 왕국 판정 하나에 +2 상황 보너스를 부여합니다. 협동 지도부 왕국 재주는 이 활동의 효율을 높입니다.

name: Tap Treasury

description.value:
You tap into the cash reserves of your kingdom for the PCs' personal use or to provide emergency funding for an event. This is a basic @Check[statecraft|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check, but after you succeed or critically succeed at this activity, all future attempts to Tap Treasury have their results worsened two degrees. This penalty persists until funds equal to those taken from the treasury are repaid via Capital Investment.

Critical Success You withdraw funds equal to the Currency per Additional PC column on Table 10–9: Party Treasure By Level on page 509 of the Pathfinder Core Rulebook (using your kingdom's level to set the amount), or you successfully fund the unexpected event that required you to Tap your Treasury.

Success As critical success, but you overdraw your treasury in the attempt. You take a –1 circumstance penalty to all Economy-based checks until the end of your next Kingdom turn.

Failure You fail to secure the funds you need, and rumors about the kingdom's potential shortfall of cash cause you to take a –1 circumstance penalty to all Loyalty and Economy-based checks until the end of your next Kingdom turn.

Critical Failure As failure, but the rumors spiral out of control. Increase Unrest by 1 and add 1 to a Ruin of your choice.

_desc_en:
You tap into the cash reserves of your kingdom for the PCs' personal use or to provide emergency funding for an event. This is a basic @Check[statecraft|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check, but after you succeed or critically succeed at this activity, all future attempts to Tap Treasury have their results worsened two degrees. This penalty persists until funds equal to those taken from the treasury are repaid via Capital Investment.

Critical Success You withdraw funds equal to the Currency per Additional PC column on Table 10–9: Party Treasure By Level on page 509 of the Pathfinder Core Rulebook (using your kingdom's level to set the amount), or you successfully fund the unexpected event that required you to Tap your Treasury.

Success As critical success, but you overdraw your treasury in the attempt. You take a –1 circumstance penalty to all Economy-based checks until the end of your next Kingdom turn.

Failure You fail to secure the funds you need, and rumors about the kingdom's potential shortfall of cash cause you to take a –1 circumstance penalty to all Loyalty and Economy-based checks until the end of your next Kingdom turn.

Critical Failure As failure, but the rumors spiral out of control. Increase Unrest by 1 and add 1 to a Ruin of your choice.
_desc_ko:
당신은 PC의 개인적 용도나 사건에 대한 비상 자금 조달을 위해 왕국의 현금 준비금을 인출합니다. 이것은 기본 @Check[statecraft|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] 판정이지만, 이 활동에 성공하거나 대성공한 후에는, 향후 국고 인출 시도가 모두 결과가 두 단계 악화됩니다. 이 페널티는 국고에서 인출한 자금과 같은 액수가 자본 투자를 통해 상환될 때까지 지속됩니다.

대성공 Pathfinder Core Rulebook 509페이지의 표 10–9: 레벨별 파티 보물의 추가 PC당 통화 열과 같은 자금을 인출하거나(왕국 레벨을 사용하여 금액을 정합니다), 국고 인출을 필요로 했던 예상치 못한 사건에 성공적으로 자금을 조달합니다.

성공 대성공과 같지만, 그 시도에서 국고를 초과 인출합니다. 다음 왕국 턴이 끝날 때까지 모든 경제 기반 판정에 –1 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

실패 필요한 자금을 확보하지 못하며, 왕국의 잠재적 자금 부족에 대한 소문이 퍼져 다음 왕국 턴이 끝날 때까지 모든 충성도 및 경제 기반 판정에 –1 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

대실패 실패와 같지만, 소문이 걷잡을 수 없이 퍼집니다. 불안을 1 증가시키고 원하는 폐허 하나에 1을 더합니다.

name: Establish Settlement

description.value:
Requirements The hex in which you're establishing the settlement has been Cleared and doesn't currently have a settlement (including a Freehold) in it.

You draw up plans, gather resources, entice citizens, and establish boundaries to found a brand new settlement in the hex. Attempt a basic @Check[engineering|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)], Industry, Politics, or Scholarship check. If you cannot pay the RP required by the result of this check, treat your result as a critical failure. A settlement always starts as a village. See page 540 for further details about building settlements.

Critical Success You establish the settlement largely with the aid of enthusiastic volunteers. Spend [[/r 1d6 #RP]]{1d6 RP}.

Success You establish the settlement. Spend [[/r 3d6 #RP]]{3d6 RP}.

Failure You establish the settlement, but inefficiently and at great expense. Spend [[/r 6d6 #RP]]{6d6 RP}.

Critical Failure You fail to establish the settlement

_desc_en:
Requirements The hex in which you're establishing the settlement has been Cleared and doesn't currently have a settlement (including a Freehold) in it.

You draw up plans, gather resources, entice citizens, and establish boundaries to found a brand new settlement in the hex. Attempt a basic @Check[engineering|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)], Industry, Politics, or Scholarship check. If you cannot pay the RP required by the result of this check, treat your result as a critical failure. A settlement always starts as a village. See page 540 for further details about building settlements.

Critical Success You establish the settlement largely with the aid of enthusiastic volunteers. Spend [[/r 1d6 #RP]]{1d6 RP}.

Success You establish the settlement. Spend [[/r 3d6 #RP]]{3d6 RP}.

Failure You establish the settlement, but inefficiently and at great expense. Spend [[/r 6d6 #RP]]{6d6 RP}.

Critical Failure You fail to establish the settlement
_desc_ko:
요구조건 정착지를 설립하는 헥스가 정리되어 있고 현재 그 안에 정착지(자유 영지 포함)가 없어야 합니다.

당신은 계획을 세우고, 자원을 모으고, 시민을 유치하고, 경계를 확립하여 헥스에 새로운 정착지를 세웁니다. 기본 @Check[engineering|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)], 산업, 정치, 또는 학문 판정을 시도합니다. 이 판정의 결과가 요구하는 RP를 지불할 수 없다면, 결과를 대실패로 취급합니다. 정착지는 항상 마을로 시작합니다. 정착지 건설에 대한 자세한 내용은 540페이지를 참조하십시오.

대성공 열성적인 자원자들의 도움으로 대부분 정착지를 설립합니다. [[/r 1d6 #RP]]{RP 1d6}를 소비합니다.

성공 정착지를 설립합니다. [[/r 3d6 #RP]]{RP 3d6}를 소비합니다.

실패 정착지를 설립하지만, 비효율적이고 큰 비용을 들여서입니다. [[/r 6d6 #RP]]{RP 6d6}를 소비합니다.

대실패 정착지 설립에 실패합니다.

name: Favored Land

description.value: Your heartland's terrain becomes your kingdom's favored land—the wilderness terrain that your people feel the strongest emotional ties to and to which your resource gatherers tend to flock. Once per Kingdom turn, during the Region Activities step of the Activity phase, you can attempt two Region activities simultaneously as long as both activities take place in the same hex and that hex contains the same terrain as your heartland. You take a –2 penalty to Kingdom skill checks made during these two activities.

_desc_en: Your heartland's terrain becomes your kingdom's favored land—the wilderness terrain that your people feel the strongest emotional ties to and to which your resource gatherers tend to flock. Once per Kingdom turn, during the Region Activities step of the Activity phase, you can attempt two Region activities simultaneously as long as both activities take place in the same hex and that hex contains the same terrain as your heartland. You take a –2 penalty to Kingdom skill checks made during these two activities.
_desc_ko: 당신의 본거지 지형이 왕국의 선호 영토가 됩니다—당신의 백성이 가장 강한 정서적 유대를 느끼고 자원 채집자들이 몰려드는 경향이 있는 야생 지형입니다. 왕국 턴당 1회, 활동 단계의 지역 활동 절차 동안, 두 활동이 모두 같은 헥스에서 이루어지고 그 헥스가 당신의 본거지와 같은 지형을 포함하는 한 두 지역 활동을 동시에 시도할 수 있습니다. 이 두 활동 동안 이루어지는 왕국 기술 판정에 –2 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Creative Solution

description.value:
You work with your kingdom's scholars, thinkers, and practitioners of magical and mundane experimentation to come up with new ways to resolve issues when business as usual is just not working. Attempt a basic @Check[scholarship|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check.

Critical Success You can call upon the solution to aid in resolving any Kingdom skill check made during the remainder of this Kingdom turn. Do so when a Kingdom skill check is rolled, but before you learn the result. Immediately reroll that check with a +2 circumstance bonus; you must take the new result. If you don't use your Creative Solution by the end of this turn, you lose this benefit and gain 10 kingdom XP instead.

Success As critical success, but the Creative Solution costs the kingdom 1d4 RP to research. This cost is paid now, whether or not you use your Creative Solution.

Failure Your attempt at researching a Creative Solution costs the kingdom 2d6 RP but is ultimately a failure. It provides no advantage.

Critical Failure As failure, but your scholars and thinkers are so frustrated that you take a –1 circumstance penalty to Culture-based checks until the end of the next Kingdom turn.

Special You cannot influence a check with Supernatural Solution and Creative Solution simultaneously.

_desc_en:
You work with your kingdom's scholars, thinkers, and practitioners of magical and mundane experimentation to come up with new ways to resolve issues when business as usual is just not working. Attempt a basic @Check[scholarship|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check.

Critical Success You can call upon the solution to aid in resolving any Kingdom skill check made during the remainder of this Kingdom turn. Do so when a Kingdom skill check is rolled, but before you learn the result. Immediately reroll that check with a +2 circumstance bonus; you must take the new result. If you don't use your Creative Solution by the end of this turn, you lose this benefit and gain 10 kingdom XP instead.

Success As critical success, but the Creative Solution costs the kingdom 1d4 RP to research. This cost is paid now, whether or not you use your Creative Solution.

Failure Your attempt at researching a Creative Solution costs the kingdom 2d6 RP but is ultimately a failure. It provides no advantage.

Critical Failure As failure, but your scholars and thinkers are so frustrated that you take a –1 circumstance penalty to Culture-based checks until the end of the next Kingdom turn.

Special You cannot influence a check with Supernatural Solution and Creative Solution simultaneously.
_desc_ko:
당신은 왕국의 학자, 사상가, 마법적·평범한 실험의 실천가들과 협력하여 평소 방식이 통하지 않을 때 문제를 해결할 새로운 방법을 고안합니다. 기본 @Check[scholarship|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] 판정을 시도합니다.

대성공 이번 왕국 턴의 남은 동안 이루어지는 어떤 왕국 기술 판정이든 해결하는 데 도움이 되도록 그 해결책을 불러올 수 있습니다. 왕국 기술 판정이 굴려질 때, 단 결과를 알기 전에 그렇게 합니다. 즉시 그 판정을 +2 상황 보너스와 함께 재굴림합니다. 새 결과를 취해야 합니다. 이번 턴이 끝날 때까지 창의적 해결책을 사용하지 않으면, 이 혜택을 잃고 대신 왕국 XP 10을 얻습니다.

성공 대성공과 같지만, 창의적 해결책은 연구에 왕국의 RP 1d4를 소모합니다. 이 비용은 창의적 해결책의 사용 여부와 관계없이 지금 지불됩니다.

실패 창의적 해결책을 연구하려는 시도가 왕국의 RP 2d6를 소모하지만, 결국 실패합니다. 아무런 이점도 제공하지 않습니다.

대실패 실패와 같지만, 당신의 학자와 사상가들이 매우 좌절하여 다음 왕국 턴이 끝날 때까지 문화 기반 판정에 –1 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

특수 초자연적 해결책과 창의적 해결책으로 판정에 동시에 영향을 줄 수 없습니다.

name: Endure Anarchy

description.value: Your kingdom holds together even in the midst of extreme peril. If your kingdom's Unrest is 6 or higher and you use a kingdom activity that decreases Unrest, decrease the Unrest by an additional 1. You do not fall into anarchy unless your kingdom's Unrest reaches 24 (see last paragraph of Step 2: Adjust Unrest on page 538).

_desc_en: Your kingdom holds together even in the midst of extreme peril. If your kingdom's Unrest is 6 or higher and you use a kingdom activity that decreases Unrest, decrease the Unrest by an additional 1. You do not fall into anarchy unless your kingdom's Unrest reaches 24 (see last paragraph of Step 2: Adjust Unrest on page 538).
_desc_ko: 당신의 왕국은 극도의 위기 속에서도 결속을 유지합니다. 왕국의 불안이 6 이상이고 불안을 감소시키는 왕국 활동을 사용하면, 불안을 추가로 1 감소시킵니다. 왕국의 불안이 24에 도달하지 않는 한 무정부 상태에 빠지지 않습니다(538페이지 2단계: 불안 조정의 마지막 문단 참조).

name: Keep up the Pressure

description.value: The commander's swift, decisive directions help the army attack more accurately. If an army attacks the same target a second time in a round, its multiple attack penalty is –4 rather than –5, and if they attack that same army a third time in a round, its multiple attack penalty is –8 rather than –10.

_desc_en: The commander's swift, decisive directions help the army attack more accurately. If an army attacks the same target a second time in a round, its multiple attack penalty is –4 rather than –5, and if they attack that same army a third time in a round, its multiple attack penalty is –8 rather than –10.
_desc_ko: 지휘관의 신속하고 단호한 지시가 군대를 더 정확하게 공격하도록 돕습니다. 군대가 한 라운드에 같은 대상을 두 번째로 공격하는 경우, 다중공격 페널티가 –5 대신 –4가 되며, 같은 군대를 한 라운드에 세 번째로 공격하는 경우, 다중공격 페널티가 –10 대신 –8이 됩니다.

name: Defensive Tactics

description.value:
The army is especially good at enacting defensive tactics. The army gains a +1 status bonus on Maneuver checks made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.phtwOol1wETryF7b]{Guard}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level, and +3 at 17th level.

The army can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.1U9SbpBDXgsLGlzq]{Defensive Stance} tactical war action.

_desc_en:
The army is especially good at enacting defensive tactics. The army gains a +1 status bonus on Maneuver checks made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.phtwOol1wETryF7b]{Guard}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level, and +3 at 17th level.

The army can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.1U9SbpBDXgsLGlzq]{Defensive Stance} tactical war action.
_desc_ko:
군대가 방어 전술을 펼치는 데 특히 능숙합니다. 군대는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.phtwOol1wETryF7b]{경계}에 이루어지는 기동 판정에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다. 이 보너스는 9레벨에 +2, 17레벨에 +3으로 증가합니다.

군대는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.1U9SbpBDXgsLGlzq]{방어 태세} 전술 전쟁 행동을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Purchase Commodities

description.value:
You can spend RP to Purchase Commodities, but doing so is more expensive than gathering them or relying upon trade agreements. When you Purchase Commodities, select the Commodity you wish to purchase (Food, Lumber, Luxuries, Ore, or Stone). Expend 8 RP if you're purchasing Luxuries or 4 RP if you're purchasing any other Commodity. Then attempt a basic @Check[trade|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check.

Critical Success You immediately gain 4 Commodities of the chosen type and 2 Commodities of any other type (except Luxuries).

Success You gain 2 Commodities of the chosen type.

Failure You gain 1 Commodity of the chosen type.

Critical Failure You gain no Commodities.

_desc_en:
You can spend RP to Purchase Commodities, but doing so is more expensive than gathering them or relying upon trade agreements. When you Purchase Commodities, select the Commodity you wish to purchase (Food, Lumber, Luxuries, Ore, or Stone). Expend 8 RP if you're purchasing Luxuries or 4 RP if you're purchasing any other Commodity. Then attempt a basic @Check[trade|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check.

Critical Success You immediately gain 4 Commodities of the chosen type and 2 Commodities of any other type (except Luxuries).

Success You gain 2 Commodities of the chosen type.

Failure You gain 1 Commodity of the chosen type.

Critical Failure You gain no Commodities.
_desc_ko:
당신은 RP를 소비하여 물자를 구매할 수 있지만, 그렇게 하는 것은 물자를 채집하거나 교역 협정에 의존하는 것보다 비용이 더 많이 듭니다. 물자를 구매할 때, 구매하고자 하는 물자를 선택합니다(식량, 목재, 사치품, 광석, 또는 석재). 사치품을 구매한다면 8 RP를, 그 밖의 물자를 구매한다면 4 RP를 소모합니다. 그런 다음 기본 @Check[trade|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] 판정을 시도합니다.

대성공 즉시 선택한 종류의 물자 4와 다른 종류의 물자(사치품 제외) 2를 얻습니다.

성공 선택한 종류의 물자 2를 얻습니다.

실패 선택한 종류의 물자 1을 얻습니다.

대실패 물자를 얻지 못합니다.

name: Muddle Through

description.value: Your people are independent-minded and take care of the small things around the kingdom, not letting them pile up into bigger problems. Increase two of your Ruin thresholds by 1 and one of them by 2.

_desc_en: Your people are independent-minded and take care of the small things around the kingdom, not letting them pile up into bigger problems. Increase two of your Ruin thresholds by 1 and one of them by 2.
_desc_ko: 당신의 백성은 독립적인 기질을 지녀 왕국 곳곳의 사소한 일들을 스스로 처리하며, 그것들이 더 큰 문제로 쌓이지 않게 합니다. 폐허 임계값 중 둘을 1씩, 그중 하나를 2 증가시킵니다.

name: Crush Dissent

description.value: Your rule brooks no dissent and stamps out traitors, making harsh examples of them. Once per Kingdom turn when you gain Unrest, you can attempt to crush the dissent by attempting a basic @Check[warfare|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check. On a success, the Unrest increase is canceled, but on a critical failure, the Unrest increase is doubled. In addition, you gain a +1 status bonus to checks to resolve dangerous kingdom events that involve internal bickering, such as Feud.

_desc_en: Your rule brooks no dissent and stamps out traitors, making harsh examples of them. Once per Kingdom turn when you gain Unrest, you can attempt to crush the dissent by attempting a basic @Check[warfare|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check. On a success, the Unrest increase is canceled, but on a critical failure, the Unrest increase is doubled. In addition, you gain a +1 status bonus to checks to resolve dangerous kingdom events that involve internal bickering, such as Feud.
_desc_ko: 당신의 통치는 어떠한 반대도 용납하지 않고 반역자를 뿌리 뽑아, 그들을 가혹한 본보기로 삼습니다. 왕국 턴당 1회, 불안을 얻을 때, 기본 @Check[warfare|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] 판정을 시도하여 반대를 진압하려 시도할 수 있습니다. 성공 시, 불안 증가가 취소되지만, 대실패 시, 불안 증가가 두 배가 됩니다. 또한, 반목과 같이 내부 갈등이 관련된 위험한 왕국 사건을 해결하는 판정에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: Outfit Army

description.value:
You provide your army with better gear. Choose what sort of gear you wish to provide your army with from the list beginning on page 574. The level of the gear chosen must be equal to or less than the army's level. If you're crafting or purchasing gear, the level of the gear chosen must be equal to or less than your kingdom level. If you're distributing resources gained from battle, the level of the gear chosen must be equal to or less than the highest level of an enemy army defeated in that battle. If you're purchasing the gear, this activity requires a basic @Check[trade|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check and costs the standard amount of RP for the gear; you cannot purchase magic gear unless your kingdom is at least expert rank in Magic. If you're distributing gear gained from battle, this activity requires a basic @Check[warfare|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check and does not cost RP.

Critical Success The gear proved particularly easy to outfit, and the army becomes efficient.

Success The gear is sufficient, and your army becomes outfitted with it immediately.

Failure The gear proves to be unusable and the attempt to outfit the army fails. If you spent RP on the check, it is refunded.

Critical Failure As failure, but spent RP is not refunded.

_desc_en:
You provide your army with better gear. Choose what sort of gear you wish to provide your army with from the list beginning on page 574. The level of the gear chosen must be equal to or less than the army's level. If you're crafting or purchasing gear, the level of the gear chosen must be equal to or less than your kingdom level. If you're distributing resources gained from battle, the level of the gear chosen must be equal to or less than the highest level of an enemy army defeated in that battle. If you're purchasing the gear, this activity requires a basic @Check[trade|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check and costs the standard amount of RP for the gear; you cannot purchase magic gear unless your kingdom is at least expert rank in Magic. If you're distributing gear gained from battle, this activity requires a basic @Check[warfare|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check and does not cost RP.

Critical Success The gear proved particularly easy to outfit, and the army becomes efficient.

Success The gear is sufficient, and your army becomes outfitted with it immediately.

Failure The gear proves to be unusable and the attempt to outfit the army fails. If you spent RP on the check, it is refunded.

Critical Failure As failure, but spent RP is not refunded.
_desc_ko:
당신은 군대에 더 나은 장비를 제공합니다. 574페이지부터 시작되는 목록에서 군대에 제공하고자 하는 장비의 종류를 선택합니다. 선택한 장비의 레벨은 군대의 레벨과 같거나 낮아야 합니다. 장비를 제작하거나 구매하는 경우, 선택한 장비의 레벨은 당신의 왕국 레벨과 같거나 낮아야 합니다. 전투에서 얻은 자원을 분배하는 경우, 선택한 장비의 레벨은 그 전투에서 격퇴한 적 군대의 가장 높은 레벨과 같거나 낮아야 합니다. 장비를 구매하는 경우, 이 활동은 기본 @Check[trade|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] 판정을 요구하고 장비에 대한 표준 RP 액수를 소모합니다. 당신의 왕국이 최소 마법 전문가 등급이 아니라면 마법 장비를 구매할 수 없습니다. 전투에서 얻은 장비를 분배하는 경우, 이 활동은 기본 @Check[warfare|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] 판정을 요구하고 RP를 소모하지 않습니다.

대성공 장비를 지급하기가 특히 수월하여, 군대가 효율적이 됩니다.

성공 장비가 충분하며, 당신의 군대는 즉시 그것으로 장비됩니다.

실패 장비를 사용할 수 없는 것으로 판명되어 군대에 장비를 지급하려는 시도가 실패합니다. 판정에 RP를 소비했다면, 환급됩니다.

대실패 실패와 같지만, 소비한 RP는 환급되지 않습니다.

name: Relocate Capital

description.value:
Requirements One of your settlements that is not your current capital must contain a Castle, Palace, or Town Hall. All leaders must spend all of their leadership activities during the Activity phase of a Kingdom turn on this activity.

The kingdom leaders announce that they are uprooting the seat of government from its current home and reestablishing it in another settlement. Attempt a @Check[industry|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc + 5)] check with a DC equal to the kingdom's Control DC + 5. You cannot Relocate your Capital again for at least 3 Kingdom turns.

Critical Success The move goes off splendidly, with people excited about the new capital and celebrating the leadership's wisdom.

Success The move goes smoothly and with minimal disruption, but some folks are upset or homesick. Increase Unrest by 1.

Failure The move causes unhappiness. Gain 1 Unrest and increase two Ruins of your choice by 1.

Critical Failure The people reject the idea of the new capital and demand you move it back. The move is unsuccessful, and your capital remains unchanged. Gain [[/r 1d4 #Unrest]]{1d4 Unrest}. Increase three Ruins of your choice by 1 and the fourth Ruin by 3.

_desc_en:
Requirements One of your settlements that is not your current capital must contain a Castle, Palace, or Town Hall. All leaders must spend all of their leadership activities during the Activity phase of a Kingdom turn on this activity.

The kingdom leaders announce that they are uprooting the seat of government from its current home and reestablishing it in another settlement. Attempt a @Check[industry|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc + 5)] check with a DC equal to the kingdom's Control DC + 5. You cannot Relocate your Capital again for at least 3 Kingdom turns.

Critical Success The move goes off splendidly, with people excited about the new capital and celebrating the leadership's wisdom.

Success The move goes smoothly and with minimal disruption, but some folks are upset or homesick. Increase Unrest by 1.

Failure The move causes unhappiness. Gain 1 Unrest and increase two Ruins of your choice by 1.

Critical Failure The people reject the idea of the new capital and demand you move it back. The move is unsuccessful, and your capital remains unchanged. Gain [[/r 1d4 #Unrest]]{1d4 Unrest}. Increase three Ruins of your choice by 1 and the fourth Ruin by 3.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 현재 수도가 아닌 당신의 정착지 중 하나가 성, 궁전, 또는 시청을 포함하고 있어야 합니다. 모든 지도자가 왕국 턴의 활동 단계 동안 자신의 모든 지도부 활동을 이 활동에 소비해야 합니다.

왕국의 지도자들이 현재 근거지에서 정부의 소재지를 뽑아내어 다른 정착지에 다시 세운다고 발표합니다. 왕국의 지배 DC + 5와 같은 DC로 @Check[industry|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc + 5)] 판정을 시도합니다. 최소 3 왕국 턴 동안 수도를 다시 이전할 수 없습니다.

대성공 이전이 훌륭하게 진행되어, 사람들이 새 수도에 열광하며 지도부의 지혜를 기립니다.

성공 이전이 매끄럽게, 최소한의 혼란으로 진행되지만, 일부는 언짢아하거나 향수를 느낍니다. 불안을 1 증가시킵니다.

실패 이전이 불만을 일으킵니다. 불안 1을 얻고 원하는 폐허 둘을 1씩 증가시킵니다.

대실패 사람들이 새 수도라는 발상을 거부하고 되돌릴 것을 요구합니다. 이전은 실패하고, 당신의 수도는 변하지 않은 채로 유지됩니다. [[/r 1d4 #Unrest]]{불안 1d4}를 얻습니다. 원하는 폐허 셋을 1씩, 네 번째 폐허를 3 증가시킵니다.

name: Reckless Flankers

description.value:
Your army is skilled at surrounding their foes and distracting them, at the cost of spreading out too much and being more vulnerable. When you use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.wHoXoyci1lddRR2R]{Advance} war action to successfully engage an army, you can choose to take a –2 circumstance penalty to your AC in order to gain a +1 circumstance bonus on attack rolls. If you do so, these modifiers remain in effect until you are no longer engaged.

You can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.dEdTJgaaYiDitp5O]{Outflank} tactical war action.

_desc_en:
Your army is skilled at surrounding their foes and distracting them, at the cost of spreading out too much and being more vulnerable. When you use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.wHoXoyci1lddRR2R]{Advance} war action to successfully engage an army, you can choose to take a –2 circumstance penalty to your AC in order to gain a +1 circumstance bonus on attack rolls. If you do so, these modifiers remain in effect until you are no longer engaged.

You can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.dEdTJgaaYiDitp5O]{Outflank} tactical war action.
_desc_ko:
당신의 군대는 적을 에워싸고 교란하는 데 능숙하지만, 너무 넓게 흩어져 더 취약해지는 대가를 치릅니다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.wHoXoyci1lddRR2R]{전진} 전쟁 행동을 사용하여 군대와 성공적으로 교전할 때, AC에 –2 상황 페널티를 받는 대신 명중 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻기로 선택할 수 있습니다. 그렇게 하면, 이 수정치들은 더 이상 교전 중이 아니게 될 때까지 유효합니다.

당신은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.dEdTJgaaYiDitp5O]{측면 포위} 전술 전쟁 행동을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: All-Out Assault

description.value:
Requirement @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.QRwIcmCEHpDQm9DO]{Merciless}

Your army attacks with frightening vigor. Attempt a melee Strike against an enemy army's AC.

Critical Success Your army inflicts @Damage[3|domains:melee-damage,strike-damage] points of damage to the target army. If your army's next war action this turn is an attack war action against a different target army, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the Strike as your fury continues to the new target.

Success Your army deals @Damage[2|domains:melee-damage,strike-damage] points of damage to the target army.

Failure Your army falters, but still deals @Damage[1|domains:melee-damage,strike-damage] point of damage to the target army.

Critical Failure Your army deals no damage to the target army and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.ibcMcEGRbPRtk9Pu]{Outflanked} until the start of its next turn.

_desc_en:
Requirement @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.QRwIcmCEHpDQm9DO]{Merciless}

Your army attacks with frightening vigor. Attempt a melee Strike against an enemy army's AC.

Critical Success Your army inflicts @Damage[3|domains:melee-damage,strike-damage] points of damage to the target army. If your army's next war action this turn is an attack war action against a different target army, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the Strike as your fury continues to the new target.

Success Your army deals @Damage[2|domains:melee-damage,strike-damage] points of damage to the target army.

Failure Your army falters, but still deals @Damage[1|domains:melee-damage,strike-damage] point of damage to the target army.

Critical Failure Your army deals no damage to the target army and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.ibcMcEGRbPRtk9Pu]{Outflanked} until the start of its next turn.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.QRwIcmCEHpDQm9DO]{무자비}

당신의 군대가 무시무시한 기세로 공격합니다. 적 군대의 AC에 대해 근접 타격을 시도합니다.

대성공 당신의 군대가 대상 군대에 @Damage[3|domains:melee-damage,strike-damage] 점의 피해를 입힙니다. 이번 턴 당신 군대의 다음 전쟁 행동이 다른 대상 군대에 대한 공격 전쟁 행동이라면, 당신의 격노가 새 대상으로 이어지면서 그 타격에 +1 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

성공 당신의 군대가 대상 군대에 @Damage[2|domains:melee-damage,strike-damage] 점의 피해를 입힙니다.

실패 당신의 군대가 주춤하지만, 그래도 대상 군대에 @Damage[1|domains:melee-damage,strike-damage] 점의 피해를 입힙니다.

대실패 당신의 군대가 대상 군대에 아무런 피해도 입히지 못하고 다음 턴 시작 시까지 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.ibcMcEGRbPRtk9Pu]{측면 노출}됩니다.

name: Explosive Shot

description.value: The army's ranged attacks explode and spray fire, shrapnel, or other damaging material in every direction. Whenever the army critically hits a non-distant army with a ranged Strike, inflict 1 point of additional damage to another non-distant enemy army of your choice. You can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.HLu1o1RzCZxWjOJJ]{Overwhelming Bombardment} tactical war action with the army.

_desc_en: The army's ranged attacks explode and spray fire, shrapnel, or other damaging material in every direction. Whenever the army critically hits a non-distant army with a ranged Strike, inflict 1 point of additional damage to another non-distant enemy army of your choice. You can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.HLu1o1RzCZxWjOJJ]{Overwhelming Bombardment} tactical war action with the army.
_desc_ko: 군대의 원거리 공격이 폭발하며 화염, 파편, 또는 그 밖의 피해를 입히는 물질을 사방으로 흩뿌립니다. 군대가 원거리 타격으로 원거리에 있지 않은 군대에 결정타를 날릴 때마다, 원거리에 있지 않은 원하는 다른 적 군대에 1 점의 추가 피해를 입힙니다. 당신은 그 군대와 함께 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.HLu1o1RzCZxWjOJJ]{압도적 포격} 전술 전쟁 행동을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Battlefield Medicine

description.value:
Requirement Field Triage

Your army attempts to patch up an allied army's wounds during battle. Once you attempt this war action on an army, that army is temporarily immune to Battlefield Medicine for the remainder of the war encounter. Attempt a @Check[scouting|dc:25] check to successfully sort the army's wounded and provide swift aid.

Critical Success You restore 2 HP to the target army.

Success You restore 1 HP to the target army

Critical Failure Your attempt to heal the army fails, and that army's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.dmzpRlOrorEFUETl]{Weary} condition value increases by 1.

_desc_en:
Requirement Field Triage

Your army attempts to patch up an allied army's wounds during battle. Once you attempt this war action on an army, that army is temporarily immune to Battlefield Medicine for the remainder of the war encounter. Attempt a @Check[scouting|dc:25] check to successfully sort the army's wounded and provide swift aid.

Critical Success You restore 2 HP to the target army.

Success You restore 1 HP to the target army

Critical Failure Your attempt to heal the army fails, and that army's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.dmzpRlOrorEFUETl]{Weary} condition value increases by 1.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 야전 응급 처치

당신의 군대가 전투 중 아군 군대의 부상을 치료하려 시도합니다. 어떤 군대에게 이 전쟁 행동을 시도하면, 그 군대는 전쟁 조우의 남은 동안 전장 의술에 일시적으로 면역이 됩니다. @Check[scouting|dc:25] 판정을 시도하여 군대의 부상자를 성공적으로 분류하고 신속한 치료를 제공합니다.

대성공 대상 군대에 HP 2를 회복시킵니다.

성공 대상 군대에 HP 1을 회복시킵니다.

대실패 군대를 치료하려는 시도가 실패하고, 그 군대의 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.dmzpRlOrorEFUETl]{피폐} 상태 값이 1 증가합니다.

name: Hire Adventurers

description.value:
While the PCs can strike out themselves to deal with ongoing events, it's often more efficient to Hire Adventurers. When you Hire Adventurers to help end an ongoing event, the DC is equal to your Control DC adjusted by the event's level modifier. Roll 1 Resource Die and spend RP equal to the result each time you attempt this activity.

Critical Success You end the continuous event.

Success The continuous event doesn't end, but you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to resolve the event during the next Event phase.

Failure You fail to end the continuous event. If you try to end the continuous event again, the cost in RP increases to 2 Resource Dice.

Critical Failure As failure, but word spreads quickly through the region—you can no longer attempt to end this continuous event by Hiring Adventurers.

_desc_en:
While the PCs can strike out themselves to deal with ongoing events, it's often more efficient to Hire Adventurers. When you Hire Adventurers to help end an ongoing event, the DC is equal to your Control DC adjusted by the event's level modifier. Roll 1 Resource Die and spend RP equal to the result each time you attempt this activity.

Critical Success You end the continuous event.

Success The continuous event doesn't end, but you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to resolve the event during the next Event phase.

Failure You fail to end the continuous event. If you try to end the continuous event again, the cost in RP increases to 2 Resource Dice.

Critical Failure As failure, but word spreads quickly through the region—you can no longer attempt to end this continuous event by Hiring Adventurers.
_desc_ko:
PC들이 직접 나서서 진행 중인 사건에 대처할 수도 있지만, 종종 모험가를 고용하는 것이 더 효율적입니다. 진행 중인 사건을 종결시키는 것을 돕도록 모험가를 고용할 때, DC는 사건의 레벨 수정치로 조정된 당신의 지배 DC와 같습니다. 이 활동을 시도할 때마다 자원 주사위 1개를 굴려 그 결과와 같은 RP를 소비합니다.

대성공 지속되는 사건을 종결시킵니다.

성공 지속되는 사건이 종결되지는 않지만, 다음 사건 단계 동안 그 사건을 해결하는 데 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

실패 지속되는 사건을 종결시키지 못합니다. 그 지속되는 사건을 다시 종결시키려 시도하면, RP 비용이 자원 주사위 2개로 증가합니다.

대실패 실패와 같지만, 지역 전체에 소문이 빠르게 퍼집니다—당신은 더 이상 모험가 고용으로 이 지속되는 사건을 종결시키려 시도할 수 없습니다.

name: Train Army

description.value:
You train an army in the use of a tactic. Choose one of the tactics from those listed starting on page 575, then attempt a Scholarship or Warfare check against the tactic's Training DC. If your army has already learned its maximum number of tactics, the newly learned tactic replaces a previously learned tactic of your choice.

Critical Success The army learns the tactic and then becomes efficient.

Success The army learns the tactic.

Failure The army fails to learn the tactic.

Critical Failure The army not only fails to learn the tactic but becomes frustrated and exhausted from the training; increase the army's weary condition by 1.

_desc_en:
You train an army in the use of a tactic. Choose one of the tactics from those listed starting on page 575, then attempt a Scholarship or Warfare check against the tactic's Training DC. If your army has already learned its maximum number of tactics, the newly learned tactic replaces a previously learned tactic of your choice.

Critical Success The army learns the tactic and then becomes efficient.

Success The army learns the tactic.

Failure The army fails to learn the tactic.

Critical Failure The army not only fails to learn the tactic but becomes frustrated and exhausted from the training; increase the army's weary condition by 1.
_desc_ko:
당신은 군대에 전술 사용법을 훈련시킵니다. 575페이지부터 나열된 전술 중 하나를 선택한 다음, 그 전술의 훈련 DC에 대해 학문 또는 전쟁술 판정을 시도합니다. 당신의 군대가 이미 최대 수의 전술을 익혔다면, 새로 익힌 전술이 이전에 익힌 전술 중 당신이 선택한 것을 대체합니다.

대성공 군대가 전술을 익히고 나서 효율적이 됩니다.

성공 군대가 전술을 익힙니다.

실패 군대가 전술을 익히지 못합니다.

대실패 군대가 전술을 익히지 못할 뿐만 아니라 훈련으로 좌절하고 지칩니다. 군대의 피폐 상태를 1 증가시킵니다.

name: Claim Hex

description.value:
Requirements You have Reconnoitered the hex to be claimed during hexploration. This hex must be adjacent to at least one hex that's already part of your kingdom. If the hex to be claimed contains dangerous hazards or monsters, they must first be cleared out—either via standard adventuring or the Clear Hex activity.

Your surveyors fully explore the hex and attempt to add it into your kingdom's domain. Spend 1 RP and then attempt a @Check[exploration|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)], @Check[intrigue|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)], @Check[magic|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)], or @Check[wilderness|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)] check.

Critical Success You claim the hex and immediately add it to your territory, increasing your kingdom's Size by 1 (this affects all statistics determined by Size; see page 532). Your occupation of the hex goes so smoothly that you can immediately attempt another Region activity.

Success You claim the hex and add it to your territory, increasing your kingdom's Size by 1 (this affects all statistics determined by Size; see page 532).

Failure You fail to claim the hex.

Critical Failure You fail to claim the hex, and a number of early settlers and explorers are lost, causing you to take a –1 circumstance penalty to Stability-based checks until the end of your next Kingdom turn.

Special At 1st level, when selecting the three activities you take during the Region Activities step of the Activity phase of the Kingdom turn, you may select this activity no more than once. Once your kingdom reaches 4th level, you may select it up to twice per turn, and after reaching 9th level you may select it up to three times per turn. When you successfully claim a hex, gain 10 kingdom XP (see page 540). Many hexes have terrain features that grant benefits to your kingdom when claimed; see Terrain Features on page 535.
